Lindy can't believe she ended up sleeping with Shane, her boss! She's his personal secretary and last night was his birthday party—in a drunken state, he opened up to her about his crippling feelings of loneliness and isolation, and she fell for him hard. But this morning, after she ran out of his bedroom and awkwardly ran into him again at work, Shane comes to her with a most perplexing request: he wants her to find the woman he just slept with! He doesn't seem to remember a thing!

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Attack of Zashiki Children
title_japanese: アタック・オブ・ザシキチルドレン

title: Junshoku Madara Nikki
synopsis: A collection of short stories detailing exaggerations of mundane events in the author's life.

title: Sadistic Madness
title_japanese: サディスティック・マッドネス
synopsis:
"I've been thinking from the first time I saw you—it seemed like you'd have a big one."

While sitting in the waiting area, the receptionist, Kazama, appeared, full of androgynous sexual appeal. "Oniisan, do you like to be bullied?" In fact, Mizushima has trauma regarding SM. He tried to resist but was forced by his ex-girlfriend, and now, he has to try resisting again, but this time against another man?!

(Source: Brite Shuppan, translated)

title: Choukyuu! Kidou Butouden G Gundam
title_japanese: 超級!機動武闘伝Gガンダム
synopsis:
In F.C. 60, the 13th Gundam Fight begins. Domon Kasshu pilots the Shining Gundam as the representative of Neo Japan, the Japanese space colony. Along with his crew member Rain Mikamura, he battles the other countries' representatives in order to earn the right to rule Earth and the colonies for four years for Neo Japan. However, Domon seems to be more concerned with finding his brother and the stolen Devil Gundam.

(Source: MU)

title: Sazanka
synopsis: ADHD girls struggles in life.

title: Koishita node Cast shitemita
title_english: I Fell in Love So I'm Streaming It
title_japanese: 恋したので配信〈キャス〉してみた
synopsis:
Yuu Inuzuka's villainous face strikes terror in the hearts of others, no matter how hard he tries to smile and look normal. He's really just an ordinary guy trying to get a fresh start in high school. Inuzuka shares a co-ed dorm with others who have secrets similar to his own—they're all live-streamers! However, Inuzuka gave up that lifestyle to start his new life. Given his current sticky living situation, will he be drawn back in?

(Source: Mangamo)

title: Ai wo Kobamanaide
synopsis:
One year after her husband's death, Crys is still grieving when she agrees to visit her best friend's brother's house. When she gets there, she encounters Sam, a closed-off, guarded man. As Crys's stay continues, she feels more and more attached to Sam. But her enduring love of her late husband makes it difficult for her to accept the feelings that are taking hold of her heart...

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Watashi no Aishita Playboy
title_japanese: 私の愛したプレイボーイ
synopsis:
Rebekah, a chef who is a live-in staff member at talented lawyer Dante's mansion, is also secretly in love with him because he's sexy and perfect. One fateful night, Dante skillfully seduces Rebekah, who is unable to tamp down the longing whirling within her. The next morning, she offers her resignation, but Dante stubbornly refuses and instead suggests that they live together for a month in his secondary residence. It's a loveless relationship, but it's one month when he can get his fill of Rebekah. What will become of her now that a playboy has gotten his fangs into her?

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Kakehiki wa Okuman Chouja to
title_japanese: 駆け引きは億万長者と
synopsis:
Meet Constance, a scrupulous and by-the-book accountant. When she's assigned to investigate a casino's finances, she visits the casino with the bad reputation. If there are any illegal activities afoot, she's confident she'll uncover them. Then, she meets John Fairweather, the CEO of the casino. Flashing an irresistible smile, he compliments her and plants his lips on hers! Is this the game he'll play to undermine her work? Bewildered by John's uninhibited behavior, Constance can't entirely suppress her desire for him... though she's acutely aware that she'd lose everything if she ever got involved with him.

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Athens kara Kita Boukun
title_english: A Tycoon to Be Reckoned With
synopsis:
Every night Sarah sings at a nightclub under the stage name Sabine. But Sarah dreams of being an opera singer. Though she isn't enamored with the scandalous outfits she has to wear or dealing with the club's wealthy clientele, Sarah sings as Sabine in exchange for operatic rehearsal time at the venue. Despite her general disinterest in the club's clients, she is taken with Bastiaan, a Greek businessman who shows up backstage at her performance one day. She knows he can only be interested in the persona of Sabine and not the real Sarah, but her heart beats faster all the same.

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Sayonara wa Watashi kara
synopsis:
Belvia has always looked out for her shy twin sister, Josy... Then, one day, her father invites Latham Tavenner, a ruthless financial mogul who's looking for help with his struggling business, over for dinner. Handsome Latham takes an interest in Josy, but all he offers Belvia is a cold stare. Bel is so frustrated by the time dinner is over, she blurts out an audacious lie... but now Latham thinks she's a reckless woman who's having an affair. Meanwhile Bel is doing all she can to protect Josy. She knows Latham's bad opinion of her shouldn't hurt this much, but it still stings.

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Uchiki na Angel
synopsis:
After losing her husband in an accident the day after their wedding, Josy still holds feelings of guilt one year later. Her life is full of household chores and is dictated by her abusive father. Then Dacre, her late husband's cousin, pays her a visit. He is a refined gentleman, and he invites her to his villa in France for a fresh start in life. Her heart is swayed by his gentle and affectionate eyes. But she knows she can't fall for him. She tells herself she doesn't have the right to love again—her husband is dead... and it's her fault!

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Seitokaichou wa Bed no Ue de Subete wo Hodoku
title_japanese: 生徒会長はベッドの上で全てを解く

title: Koakuma Setsuko no Himitsu
title_english: The Secret of the Little Devil Setsuco
synopsis:
One day, high school student Setsuco Yukaribe discovers that she has grown a tail and that her ears have become pointy. Moreover, her sex drive has dramatically increased! Unable to control her lust, Setsuco begins a sexual relationship with her childhood friend, Yuji Tadano. Even though Yuji is initially ecstatic, Setsuco continues to be more demanding, and he finds it increasingly difficult to satisfy her perverted desires.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kekkon no Merit
synopsis:
In the Kekkon no Merit series:

1. Migawari no Kekkon (Honeymoon Hitch) [Amano Nasuno]
2. Fusawashikunai Koibito (Coming Home to Wed) [Hori Erio]
3. Konyakusha wa Princess (Accidental Fiancee) [Ide Chikae]

title: Okuman Chouja no Zankoku na Uso
synopsis:
Angel gifted her purity to Alex and believed he was the love of her life. But the very next morning, a ring fell out of his pocket. Angel was devastated and hid her broken heart beneath her memories. Six years later, she was a popular model on a small island in Greece for a photo shoot. While she was at a party on location, Alex showed up. Angel played it cool, but there was more than her heart on the line—she was keeping a secret from Alex that he must never find out.

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Jikan Teishi Yuusha
synopsis:
After being cancelled on social media, Sekai Kuzuno falls into despair and wishes so hard to leave his life behind that he suddenly finds himself in a fantasy RPG world. He has nothing but the clothes on his back...and his handy game controller. With a press of the pause button, he becomes a literal Time Stop Hero. Running off with money, one-shotting static mobs, and flipping the skirts of every girl in sight, Sekai's desires are boundless, but his power isn't! If he doesn't clear the game in three days, time will stop for Sekai—forever!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Kieta Kioku to Ai no Kizuna
synopsis:
As a child, Laura appeared on the poster of a nonprofit, and her angelic looks captured the public's imagination. Now she's an adult, and her beauty has captured the heart of millionaire Samual Bishop. But he's overprotective of her. He treats Laura so delicately, she feels like a porcelain doll. She can't tell if it's love or pity that he feels for her... so she asks for a separation. Though she loves Samuel, she doesn't know if there's a future for them. While working through her concerns, Laura slips and hits her head and suffers a spell of amnesia... taking her back to the time when she and Samuel were madly in love!

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Lady Annica no Nazo
synopsis:
Annica, of royal descent, is an unusual woman by the standards of London society. Independent and liberated, she doesn't humble herself before any man. Tristan likes her the moment he sees her, and comes up with many excuses to approach her. But she is hard to pin down, and he's all wrapped up in her outrageous actions. Meanwhile, Annica feels attracted to Tristan since he seems to understand her, but right now she's more concerned with trying to help her friend Sarah, even if that means leaping into danger...

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Souda na, Tashika ni Kawaii na
title_japanese: そうだな、確かに可愛いな
synopsis:
This novel is a sweet and fluffy romcom telling the days of a boyfriend and girlfriend right after they've started dating. The boyfriend, Kairi Watase, 17 years old, is a first-year high school student (two years behind). Having just woken up from a 2-year coma, he's a young man with some problems. The girlfriend, Nano Koori, 16 years old, is also a first-year in high school. A slightly annoying beauty, who loves fashion and anything that sounds interesting. The daily lives of the two basically boil down to this.

"Senpaaai, am I not super duper cute today~? Come on, it wouldn't hurt to praise me a—"

"Yeah, you really are cute."

"~~~!"

"Koori?"

"—This is exactly what I'm talking about, senpai!"

A story of a slightly unaware senpai, and the always immediately flustered kouhai. No dangers of a heroine race or a breakup, just a pure and wholesome romcom.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo! Yorimichi!
title_japanese: この素晴らしい世界に祝福を! よりみち!
synopsis: A collection of short stories originally included with the limited edition DVD/Blu-Ray volumes of the Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo! anime.

title: Ai ni Tsuite no Hachishou
synopsis:
Cam, a reporter who leaps into danger and has a reputation as a playboy, returns to Spain for the first time in six months. When he arrives at his villa with a beautiful woman in tow, a quiet widow appears in front of him. Widowed Liz, who's in charge of managing the villa's garden, isn't Cam's type, but he can't get her out of his mind. When she cries at the memory of her late husband, it shocks him. Is there even one woman who would cry for Cam? He realizes he wants a loyal partner. He'll even give up his playboy ways to win one!

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Ai wo Meijita Yuigon
synopsis:
It's been over a year since she caught him cheating on her. Although she's been struggling, Samantha's getting used to a new life with her young daughter. One day, her estranged husband showed up at her apartment. He came to tell her about the massive inheritance that her father-in-law left for his granddaughter. But he gave her a shocking condition in order to receive it. If Samantha wants to receive the inheritance, she and Annie need to live with him for the next six months. Samantha can't live with the man who betrayed her. But when she thinks about her daughter's future... Samantha decided to go back to his house and engage in a marriage in name only.

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Utsukushiki Houfuku
synopsis:
In the Utsukushiki Houfuku series:

1. Yuuwaku no Otoshiana (The Mistress Assignment)
2. Mezametara Koibito Doushi (Lover by Deception)
3. Koi wo Suru no ga Kowai (A Treacherous Seduction)
4. Uragirareta Saikai (The Marriage Resolution)

title: Uwasa no Blonde Musume
synopsis:
The biggest problem in Serina's life is her appearance. She has perfect proportions, long blond hair and bewitching lips. However, she's shy, so it doesn't make her happy. Instead, it only attracts men who think she's easy. One day, she reunites with Aaron at the restaurant where she is waitressing. He was her first love who saved her when they were students. However, now he has the aura of someone successful and he looks her up and down with interest... He says to her, "Every man wants you even if you don't work for it."

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Ai to Yobanaide
synopsis:
Clare was saved by millionaire Jack Straker six years ago and stayed with him afterward. When his gravely ill father died one day, she slept with him to console him. The following day, he thanked her and handed her a check. Adding to her mortification, he told her he was married. What an insult! Years later, she runs into him again, and now she has a secret she'll never tell him, not when he doesn't know what real love is...

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Beth to Okuman Chouja
synopsis:
Beth winds up on a date with young, wealthy businessman Todd after he participates in a charity auction. She can't believe that she, a widow living with kids in the suburbs, is going out on a date with a notorious playboy. Gentlemanly Todd picks up Beth in a limo and treats her like a queen, but she feels uncomfortable in his high-class world and ends up leaving in the middle of their date!

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Hatsukoi no Nokoriga
synopsis:
Thea is to marry the eldest son of the notable Ashton family in just a few days. But that's when her first love—the one she hasn't forgotten about after eight years—shows up. Her heart becomes restless when she faces her first love and his suggestive stare. Zeke used to be an heir to the Ashton family, but he left after his relationship with his father deteriorated. He asked Thea to come with him, but she declined his offer. So why has he come back now... and why does she still want him?

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Aitakute Nemurenai
synopsis:
Josie's still a virgin and she's reluctant to go to her school reunion because she knows her spiteful classmate will laugh at her if she goes alone. A friend suggests Josie hire an escort for the night, and that's just what she does. The escort who arrives at her door is Callum, a man so handsome he seems to have stepped out of a dream. He plays the part of her boyfriend perfectly and Josie finds herself drawn to him. When they return from the reunion, Josie's house has been burgled! Which is why Callum agrees to stay the night at her house... just to be safe.

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Guuzen no Hanayome
synopsis:
Clare's target is the heartless Mark King, a playboy broker who toyed with her sister and dumped her. Clare plans to seduce Mark and bring him back home to see her sister. Before she can do that, Mark's good looks and charm begin to reel her in. Clare soon begins to stray from her goal, but she manages to pull through and bring Mark back home. After everything is set and done with Clare's sister, Mark and Clare's paths cross one more time.

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Greece no Hanayome
synopsis:
In the Greece no Hanayome series:

1. Glass no Kutsu no Yukue (The Millionaire's True Worth)
2. Hakkou no Cinderella (A Wedding for the Greek Tycoon)

title: Azamukareta Muku na Hanayome
synopsis:
Cassidy is nine months pregnant. Donovan, the vice-president of a massive corporation, can't stand children. He broke their relationship off before she had the opportunity to reveal she was pregnant with his baby. But now he's appeared out of the blue to visit her. Donovan sees how pregnant Cassidy is and is shocked... He then goes on to proclaim that he will marry her and become the child's father! The truth is, Cassidy is still deeply in love with him, and his sincere words open her heart. While still puzzled about Donovan's change of heart, she accepts his proposal... If only she had realized that, for him, it was only a marriage of convenience to help him land the CEO position!

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Kaseifu demo Aijin demo Naku
title_japanese: 家政婦でも愛人でもなく
synopsis:
It's a lie! Her mother can't be committing embezzlement! Ravenna was shocked. Jonas Devson seems like an angry and hate-filled man. Ravenna's mother used to be a maid at the Devson family's estate, but she fell in love with Jonas's father. After Jonas's father passes away, Jonas was sorting the enormous inheritance and realized that a large sum of money was missing. Revenna claimed that she did it, not her mother. Realizing that her mother took the money to give Ravenna a good life, she can't help but take the blame in order to hide the truth. And so she becomes a maid as punishment.

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Inochi no Mebuku Paris de
title_english: A Vow to Secure His Legacy
synopsis:
After her sister and mother died of brain cancer, Imogen noticed she was experiencing the same symptoms they did. So she prepares for her death and flies to Paris to spend her last days in luxury. There she attends a high-class party and meets a Frenchman named Thierry. The two hit it off and spend a passionate two weeks together. On her way home, though, Imogen learns she is pregnant. What a dreadful turn of events... She explains the situation to Thierry, but his reaction is beyond anything she expected!

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Nazo no Mrs.
synopsis:
Perry lives a quiet life in London. But when the man she's just started dating starts talking about their future together, she knows she must take action. The truth is, she got married when she was eighteen years old. The marriage was for their mutual benefit and really only exists on paper. They've both kept it a secret. Perry must get a divorce asap, but she can't get a hold of her successful businessman "husband," Nash. Letters and emails go unanswered as the days pass. And then she sees Nash on the news announcing that he's seeking a court-mediated settlement with his wife!

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Koi wa Poker Face de
title_japanese: 恋はポーカーフェイスで
synopsis:
Eliza does her twin sister a favor and goes to a party in her place, but how long will she be able to fend off the roguish glances of her sister's boyfriend? He seems intent on taking her to bed. Eliza is trying to find a way out of the situation when her first love, Giles, appears out of the crowd. Just seeing his face brings back old memories... and he's the only one who can help her now! She explains the situation and asks for his help. But he says he wants something in return!

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Wakare wa Koibito-tachi no Machi de
title_japanese: 別れは恋人たちの街で
synopsis:
"Thank you. It was the memory of a lifetime." That's what Emily told Luca, the man she met while on vacation in Verona. She leaves for London tomorrow and she'll never see him again. The time she spent with Luca was a luxurious dream that she must wake up from. No promises were made, and so she left him with a goodbye. She couldn't hope for more, no matter how strong her feelings for him. But leaving Luca behind will prove difficult—he's carved his passion into Emily's body and she can't get him out of her mind...

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Shoushin Otoko ni Haru no Arashi
synopsis:
"To prefer an old man like, you're really a strange one." An awkward honor student and a peevish writer in his 30s. A 200% pure heart-pounding age gap romance.

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: Gemini
synopsis:
A girl with a gas mask attempting to fight back against the strange world.

(Source: MU)

title: Ishuzoku Reviewers Comic Anthology: Darkness
title_japanese: 異種族レビュアーズコミックアンソロジー 〜ダークネス〜
authors: Nishi, Yoshiyuki|Shinozuka, Atsuto|Takura, Mahiro|Inui, Takemaru|Nakamura, Morisu|Hiyama, Daisuke|Sakurai, Energy|Cool-kyou Shinja|Shindou|Yuuki, Rey|Gamma, Ray|Kafun|Oumi, Noko|Sasaki, Masahito|Niitsu, Nii|Shitara, Nana|Enda, Marimo|solopipB|Fusa|Kometsubu
synopsis: An anthology comic of Ishuzoku Reviewers by various mangaka.

title: Haru no Ongaeshi
synopsis:
A cute kitten is taken in by Shuu, a high school student, who names her Haru. Grateful to her new owner for taking her in and naming her, Haru decides to make a deal with the great cat god to allow her to acquire a human form and thus reward him... What she doesn't realize is that he is in love with a girl from his class, which complicates her initial plan and triggers the cat jealousy?!!! What can Haru do in the time she has left as a human?

(Source: MU)

title: Kimi ga Suki.
synopsis:
1. Goukaku Ecchi!
2. Natsu to Jun
3. Koiseyo Otome
4. Kago no Mushi, Kumo wo Shitau.
5. Daisuki.
6. Kitto Oneechan yori...
7. Sakyutto!
8. Nanka Ii Koto Atta?
9. Danchou, Onegaishimasu!
10. Will You Marry Me?

title: Mikansei demo Koi ga Ii
synopsis:
Oustandly shy beauty Ichika just entered high school, but nobody talks to her, and she has trouble making friends. One day, the rumored "most evil" former delinquent Yuuya Yotsukado talks to her behind the school, and for some reason ended up going to karaoke together...

There, he said "I wanted to return something that you dropped," and makes a suggestion that's extremely different from what the rumors say? The after school strategy meetings(?!) in order to fulfill their dreams start now!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Sweet Home
synopsis:
Cha Hyun is a reclusive high school student who spends his days holed up in his room playing video games. But when he loses his entire family in a tragic car accident, he is forced to leave his home and carefree lifestyle behind and move into a new apartment all by himself. However, his pesky neighbors and lack of money soon become the least of his worries as people around him suddenly begin turning into horrifying monsters, plunging the world into apocalyptic chaos.

The situation takes a turn for the worse when Hyun realizes that he himself is slowly turning into a monster, while a mysterious voice in his head grows louder and louder. With his time running out, Hyun must work together with his fellow tenants to uncover the cause of the outbreak and find a way to survive in this hopeless new world, all the while fighting to retain his humanity.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Crow Record: Infinite Dendrogram Aot
title_japanese: クロウ・レコード Infinite Dendrogram Aot

title: Hiyumi no Inaka Michi
synopsis:
Hiyumi is an ordinary teenage girl who, when her father told her they were going to move to Nagano prefecture, immediately pictured life in one of the biggest, liveliest centers of Japan.

She never expected for them to move to one of the least populated towns in the area. A town which takes a mile-long walk to get to a single convenience store. A town where you can count the different families on one hand. That type of town.

Anyway, let’s watch Hiyumi experience her new life in the boonies.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Shiawase Taputapu Sour
synopsis:
1. Kinyoku Auction
2-3. Senia no Bouken
4. Hatsujou Kamen
5. Chikyuu Daihyou no Chichi
6. Boku wa Josei wo Oppai de Erandari Shinai (I don't pick my women based on their breasts)
7. Saki Splash
8. Kanako-san no Oppai
9. Bushitsu no Soyokaze

title: Ameku Takao Series
synopsis:
In Tenikai General Hospital's general diagnostic department, patients who are deemed difficult to treat by other doctors are collected here. From mysteries of unknown illness to murders that even the police can't handle. Genius doctor Takao Ameku reveals the shocking truth hidden behind these mysterious "disease."

(Source: Official Site, translated)

title: Katagiri-kun Chi ni Neko ga Iru
title_japanese: 片桐くん家に猫がいる
synopsis: Follow the daily life of Katagiri-kun who lives alone with his cats.

title: Joou Heika to Yobanaide
title_japanese: 女王陛下と呼ばないで
synopsis:
A recluse becoming Queen?! In a contest for the throne with scions of noble families, I'll do everything in my power to avoid getting embroiled in it!

In the Kingdom of Lindtor, renowned for being governed by a wise ruler, I, Francesca, am the King's granddaughter—a homebody who delights in chess and staying indoors. However, in the wake of my grandfather's sudden demise, it's revealed that he nominated me in his will as a Queen candidate.

While I was stricken with panic, several young noblemen competing to become sovereign appeared before me: the radiant yet overbearing Stewart, the highly intelligent Cyan, and the captain of the knights, Irwine. "Please choose the King from amongst them!" I struggle hard against it, but my efforts are futile. Furthermore, "I pledge my allegiance to you, my Queen." Is that supposed to be an oath, or a marriage proposal?

I'll get back my peaceful and tranquil days!

What will result from this shut-in princess's desperate resistance?

(Source: Kadoka

title: Violet Evergarden Ever After
title_japanese: ヴァイオレット・エヴァーガーデン エバー・アフター
synopsis:
The world turns, even if it will meet its demise one day. As the CH Postal Company approaches a time of change and the world around her is about to transform, Violet visits the town of "dreamers," Alfine.

(Source: Kyoto Animation, translated)

title: Kaikan Douki
synopsis:
Niwa Tasuku working at Sanden Printing Company for 2 years now but still can't get along at all with with Yukino Tsumugi, a female colleague at the DTP temperament. Their colleagues try to "break the ice" by inviting them out for drinks but later that night, they ended up in a love hotel. A strange "connection" is made between these two, one that would 'link' them during the most private thoughts and moments!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Royal Affair
synopsis:
In the Royal Affair series:

1. Koori no Fugou to Muku na Oujo (A Royal World Apart)
2. Ainaki Ouji no Konyakusha (At His Majesty's Request)
3. Houtou Ouji to Shuudoujo (Pretender to the Throne)

title: Star x Fanboy
synopsis:
Renowned actor Park Star has portrayed numerous roles on television, but he is best known as Kang Chan in the "Sweet" series. With an enormous interest in Twitter, Star creates a character bot—an account that role-plays a person or character.

Meanwhile, Kim Fanboy, a theater actor at Cheomji University, loves to linger on Twitter. After finally finding a character bot that portrays his favorite character, Kang Chan, Fanboy is ecstatic. However, with the account's affectionate yet in-character lines and greetings, Fanboy thinks the account is too surreal. On top of that, the user sends an unreleased photo of Star, causing Fanboy's heart to race even more. But little does he know, the person behind all these acts is actually Star himself!

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: BL Motel
synopsis:
Some parents give their kids an inheritance. Some give their kids a car. Jinwon's parents gave him... a motel. And not even a great one. Rundown and in need of massive repairs, the Ballantine Motel used to be a golden goose. But, of course, a drunk driver running his car through the entrance tends to change things. So when Jinwon takes over, he makes some upgrades and additions. And while "Ballantine" is a nice name, it's a bit long. So, of course, he makes the obvious choice and shortens it. The BL Motel is the neighborhood's newest addition. Of course, now all Jinwon needs is some new help and maybe find out why so many gay couples have started visiting. Then again, when life give you lemons, you lean in and stock the vending machines with lube.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Baker on the First Floor
title_english: The Baker on the First Floor
synopsis:
Sun Hwa is a BL artist using his room as a secret base to draw his work. One day, he gets caught working on his comic by a handsome blond man. Later, he finds out that this man is the new baker on the first floor. But there's just more to this man than simply his looks.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: My Little Inferno
title_japanese: マイリトルインフェルノ
synopsis:
Hitoshi Arai is just an average college student with a mediocre life. During high school, he was bullied for being fat and got stressed and anxious easily. He had hoped that college would give him a fresh new start, but he remains his ordinary lone self.

One night on his way home from his part-time job, Hitoshi accidentally bumps his bag of groceries into a car. He immediately inspects the car to see if he left any scratches while internally musing about Aladdin's story. Realizing he has been reincarnated, he quickly wonders what is going on before he gets another shocker: the man and woman who are raising him are in fact his previous life’s parents! That’s right - Eric was reincarnated, but as himself. No alternate worlds, no skill trees, just his memories sent back to the moment he popped out of his mother. However, for a lady of Inglis's ambition, this is less a setback and more the challenge she was (re)born to overcome. title: Psycho-Pass Asylum
synopsis:
Psycho-Pass Asylum contains four short stories. The first is about Guseong Choi's early life in North Korea. The second is about Kagari Shuusei's life, complete with his cuisines. The third one is about Yayoi Kunizuka and Shion Karanomori's relationship. The last one is about the daily life of Nobuchika Ginoza as a young Inspector.

(Source: Psycho-Pass Wiki, edited)

title: HG ni Koisuru Futari
synopsis:
Sixteen years ago, Sayaka Kanzaki witnessed the Strike Gundam for the first time during the premiere of Mobile Suit Gundam SEED. Its magnificent figure as it arose from a sea of flames etched a lifelong passion for the franchise within her heart. However, as a 30-year-old office lady self-conscious about her public image, Kanzaki has kept this love hidden from her coworkers.

One day, Kanzaki meets Sora Takamiya, a 16-year-old high school student who also loves the Gundam franchise, especially Gundam Plastic Models. Sora's passion for creating these "Gunpla" models reminds Kanzaki of her own childhood as a young Gundam-loving girl. Guided by Sora, Kanzaki makes her first foray into the world of Gunpla building, and with it, reignites her love for Gundam.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Never Good Enough
synopsis:
After Louis was dumped by his boyfriend of many years, his ex-boyfriend's younger brother, Theo, appeared before him. Frustrated with Theo's relentless inquiring, and in spite of his dejection, Louis lied: "I was the one who broke up with your brother." That's when Theo started to follow him. "If my lie is uncovered, it'll all end. That's good." That must have been what he thought, but before he knew it, Theo's obsession for him began.

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Sake to Sakana
synopsis:
Fumi and Haru are two university friends with a shared passion for the swim team, until Fumi's "unique" heritage complicates matters.

(Source: MU)

title: Kawaii Kouhai ni Iwasaretai
title_japanese: かわいい後輩に言わされたい
synopsis:
The manga centers on Yasu and Moriyama. Yasu is Moriyama's upperclassman, but one day decides to ask Moriyama for romantic advice regarding "a certain girl." Moriyama gives Yasu the advice he asks for, although she does it by trying to steer Yasu toward confessing to her instead, in her own passive-aggressive yet deadpan way. In the end, Yasu ends up telling Moriyama that he loves her (the "certain girl" whom Yasu was talking about was indeed Moriyama). The story follows their mutually loving relationship, although Moriyama tends to get her way by bargaining aggressively with Yasu.

(Source: ANN)

title: Fuuin Maou wa Mederaretai
title_japanese: 封印魔王は愛でられたい
synopsis:
Lilian Eddington finds a mysterious but cute black beast in the woods, which she refuses to abandon when her grandfather says she can't keep it as a pet. After he finally consents, she kisses the newly named Woolbo on the nose only for it to release the seal on it and it turns into the Maou. While condescending at first, the Maou decides he can't abandon Lilia either. How will their days together play out in the future?

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Shihou Yuugi: Endou Tatsuya Tanpenshuu
title_english: Four Lives Remain: Tatsuya Endo Before Spy x Family
title_japanese: 四方遊戯 遠藤達哉短編集
synopsis:
1. Seibu Yuugi (Western Game)
2. Gekka Bijin (pilot) (Blade of the Moon Princess)
3. Witch Craze
4. PMG-0

title: Bukiyou ni Koishite: Toshishita Danshi to Himitsu no Doukyo
title_english: Clumsy Love: Secret Cohabitation with a Younger Guy
title_japanese: 不器用に恋して～年下男子と秘密の同居
synopsis:
Hinayo Otose is a lively, cheerful girl whose slightly flashy appearance brings her a lot of attention from the boys, but also causes misunderstandings. Everyone thinks she's a flirt, but all she wants is to find true love! Enter Yuzuki Kiyohara, a younger guy she meets at work. He seems very serious and reliable for his age, but won't he get swayed by the rumors like all the others...? And when Hinayo finds herself in a bind, it turns out that they have to start living together!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Moeru!! Joshi Pro Wrestling
synopsis: A manga based on Manami Toyota, a real life female professional wrestler.

title: Edomae Elf
synopsis:
Koito Koganei works as the teenage shrine maiden at the Takamimi Shrine, catering to the whims of its resident: a centuries-old elf who loves video games as much as she hates going outside! Line up your offerings for the otaku elf—some energy drinks, chips and video games will do nicely—and watch her new friends scramble to keep up!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Deep Insanity: Nirvana
synopsis:
One day, a large hole named Asylum is discovered in Antarctica. At the same time, the mysterious coma-inducing illness Randolph Syndrome begins spreading around the world. Many countries sent an investigation squad to the asylum, believing it to be the cause of the disease, but not a single person safely returned. Sergiu Sol, a boy with a special resistance to the disease, and Antarctica's jack-of-all-trades Hildegard Olympiada Yamada, decide to take on the challenge of the large hole without a map, but...!? What is the cause of the coma-inducing disease? What in the world is the Asylum? Go down to the deep, jet-black bottom, one with insanity.

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Youkai Izakaya Nonbereke.
title_japanese: ようかい居酒屋 のんべれケ。
synopsis:
Girls cry! Laugh! And get harassed! Young female college student Hino Motogane starts a part-time job at a small late night izakaya. However the shop's clientele are youkai. These youkai do all kinds of things to their favorite Hino; sometimes they strip her, sometimes they cover her in spit—no matter what, they work her to death! After all, she wants her paycheck... Come on in under the curtain into an izakaya comedy where girls are full of laughter, tears, sweat, spit, and who knows what fluids that are flying about.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Yuzu no Doubutsu Karte: Chiisana Juui - Kochira Wan Nyan Doubutsu Byouin
title_japanese: ゆずのどうぶつカルテ~小さな獣医~こちらわんニャンどうぶつ病院

title: H&H Roman Company
synopsis:
With rapid developments to the human civilization, the need for God and his angels have decreased at a significant rate. Thus, the angels are experiencing a historic unemployment crisis! With this problem in hand, God decides to start a company that will reduce the unemployment rate in both Heaven and Hell. He hereby founds the company, H&H Roman Company!

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Itoshi no Ebi-senpai
synopsis:
Yuuta Kogure confesses to Ebina-senpai. This is the story of their relationship.

(Source: MU)

title: Youkoso! BL Kenkyuu Club e
title_english: Welcome to the Yaoi Research Club
title_japanese: ようこそ! BL研究クラブへ
synopsis:
Behind on his bills and barely surviving, dirt-poor college student Satou just wants a break. He wants a job, any job that would pay up, super fast! When Kaname and Hata offered a part-time job doing research with them, Satou thought he's finally struck gold. But he probably should've asked for the fine print, because the research is on BL, specifically male sexual pleasure—and he's the test subject!

(Source: MediBang/Julian Publishing)

Included one-shot: Suki ni Shichatte Gomennasai ne

title: Gishin Eiyuu no Amadeus
title_english: Amadeus: The Hero Against False Gods
title_japanese: 偽神英雄のアマデウス

title: Suzu-tsuki Neko wa Nyao to Naku?
title_english: Does the Cat with the Bell Say Meow?
title_japanese: 鈴付きネコはにゃおと鳴く?
synopsis:
Does the cat with the bell say meow? Found sick on the side of the road, when they first met he was like a stray cat. Nao and Suzu begin their journey with each other in a way, unlike others. Follow this cute, fluffy story as their life and past slowly combines.

(Source: MU)

title: Yuuenchi: Baki Gaiden
synopsis:
The boy asked the man and the man answered: "I've been there, in the Korakuen Arena, fought against Hanayama Kaoru, it was amazing." The boy asked him again but this time a question that terrified him to the core: 'Where's the amusement park?" The man had no answer.

This is a series of illustrated tales about a dark place inside the world of the Baki series, the so-called "Amusement Park." Come and discover by yourself why strong men fear it so much. Take a peek at darkness itself!!!

(Source: MU)

title: Kono Healer, Mendokusai
title_japanese: このヒーラー、めんどくさい
synopsis:
A fantasy and adventure comedy starring Karla, a dark elf cleric who invested too much in her insulting skills, and Alvin, a swordsman who has to put up with her antics.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kekkon suru tte, Hontou desu ka
title_japanese: 結婚するって、本当ですか 365 Days To The Wedding
synopsis:
The J.T.C. travel agency is looking for someone to manage its brand-new branch in Irkutsk. But for employees Takuya Oohara and Rika Honjouji, they'd rather just stay home in Tokyo! Thankfully, they've discovered a way out—their manager has narrowed down the recruits to bachelors, so what if they just...got married? The problem is they barely know each other at all! Can they convince their office they're engaged just long enough for the transfer to finish up?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Madan no Ou to Michelia
title_japanese: 魔弾の王と凍漣の雪姫〈ミーチェリア〉
synopsis:
The Lord Marksman and Michelia novel series is an alternative parallel world to Kawaguchi's Lord Marksman and Vanadis light novel series, with Ludmila instead of Eleonora as the main heroine. In this alternate world, Zhcted does not declare war on Brune, but instead forms an alliance to wage war against the kingdom of Muozinel. A young man named Tigre goes to war in his father's place, and his first taste of battle begins to go well, until Brune's battle lines crumble to an ambush. The commander of Tigre's unit flees, until Ludmila, the Vanadis warrior of Olmutz, comes to the rescue. Two years after that battle, Tigre and Ludmila have a chance reunion, just as the curtain is raised on a new war, and a legendary evil awakens.

(Source: ANN)

title: Wizardly Tower
synopsis:
A powerful grand wizard named Raim reappears after a millennium because of a failed experiment. While sets out to regain his lost tower, he meets Are and Ere, who have been trafficked as slaves... a combination of a weird grand magician who only uses his wits to make money and the cute, lovable brother and sister of the Miao tribe! Their endless adventure is beginning to unfold.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Shousetsu no Kamisama
synopsis:
Ichiya Chitani made his debut as a novelist when he was in middle school. His novels received severe criticisms and were not popular. Now, Ichiya is a high school student. His confidence as a writer is shot. One day, an editor proposes that Ichiya collaborate with his classmate Shiina Koyurugi, who is a popular writer, on a novel. The editor wants a novel that can touch the hearts of people around the world.

Ichiya and Shiina have completely different personalities and reside on different levels in terms of popularity as writers, collaborate on a new novel.

(Source: AsianWiki)

title: Kamigami ni Sodaterareshi Mono, Saikyou to Naru
title_english: A Boy Raised By Gods Will Be the Strongest
title_japanese: 神々に育てられしもの、最強となる
synopsis:
Will was a boy left to his fate in the middle of nowhere, but his luck changed when the gods gave him another destiny. That child who was destined to die is now destined to become the mightiest of all with the help of the god of the sword, the god of magic and the goddess of sanction, Will's adventures are about to begin!

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Dekisokonai to Yobareta Motoeiyuu wa Jikka kara Tsuihou sareta node Sukikatte ni Ikiru Koto ni Shita @comic
title_english: The Banished Former Hero Lives as He Pleases
title_japanese: 出来損ないと呼ばれた元英雄は、実家から追放されたので好き勝手に生きることにした＠comic
synopsis:
Deemed a "good-for-nothing" for his low level and lack of a god-given Gift, Allen is stripped of his noble status and banished from the Duchy of Westfeldt. But Allen has a secret: he was a great hero in a previous life, and he's thrilled for the chance to finally live the way he pleases! His drama-free existence, however, is soon interrupted by a desperate encounter with his ex-fiancée. As a former hero who still possesses the incredible powers from his past life, Allen can't ignore someone in need—no matter how much he might like to! And so begins the new heroic saga our former hero never wanted!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Ashita Kakeru!
synopsis:
Driven by his childhood dreams, Shunpei wants to become a screenwriter. However, neither his friends nor his family expected such a resolution. Out of high school, here he is soaring into the unknown with the sole ambition of telling the most beautiful story.

(Source: MU)

title: Ore no Shunkan: Ishikawa Saburou Tanpen Kessakushuu
title_japanese: オレの瞬間 石川サブロウ短編傑作集
synopsis:
Taro decided to dedicate his life to animal photography. His heart is devoted to them but his eye, like his mind, is far from being sharp enough. He then accepts to take up a challenge, that of seizing the power and the beauty of the wild fauna. Then begins a real initiatory journey through the most authentic territories of Japan. From North to South, he searches for that moment that will make him an accomplished man and photographer.

(Source: Black Box Editions, translated)

Included one-shots: Ten to Daichi to, Tooi Michi

title: Hyobokure Bunza: Oumu Rouchuuki yori
title_japanese: ひょぼくれ文左〜鸚鵡籠中記より〜
synopsis:
Our story takes place during the Genroku era (1688-1704), a period of peace and stability. We follow the adventures of the samurai Bunzaemon Asahi, his love affairs and his way of life full of enthusiasm...

(Source: Black Box Editions, translated)

title: Arifureta Shokugyou de Sekai Saikyou Shouhenshuu
title_english: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World’s Strongest - Short Stories
title_japanese: ありふれた職業で世界最強 小篇集
synopsis: Arifureta Shokugyou de Sekai Saikyou side stories.

title: Trinity Seven: Anastasia Seiden
title_japanese: トリニティセブン アナスタシア聖伝
synopsis:
While Arata and the rest of girls are training to go to Dante's Gate, Anastasia goes to Biblia Academy to investigate a strange event that is related to "The Demise."

(Source: MU)

title: Therapy Game: Restart
title_japanese: セラピーゲーム リスタート
synopsis:
Shizuma and Minato are officially a couple. But Shizuma—now a resident veterinarian—is so busy he barely has time to catch his breath, let alone go on a date. When he finally manages to find time for Minato, the universe intervenes once again, and he learns quickly that his feisty new beau is not to be ignored!

(Source: SuBLime)

title: Kodomo Otona
synopsis:
A quiet, atmospheric journey through the ordinary life of a young boy growing up in Showa era Japan. Masterfully told through the scattered memories of seemingly-mundane moments in his young life, this short work captures the zeitgeist of a generation.

(Source: MU)

title: Senpai wa Kouiu no Kirai desu ka!?
title_japanese: 先輩はこういうの嫌いですか!?

title: Yankee JK Kuzuhana-chan
title_japanese: ヤンキーJKクズハナちゃん
synopsis:
Moteshiro High School was once an all-girls school, but that changed when a boy enrolled. As the only male student, Hodaka Saotome enters the school to pursue a career in fashion, notably as he prepares to inherit his family's tailoring business. However, most of his schoolmates are unwelcoming, leading to him being targeted and harassed.

One day, Saotome's seemingly kind classmate Kasumi Takae invites him to the rooftop for lunch. Believing this may be his chance to finally make a friend, he instead falls into her trap, where she attempts to blackmail him. To everyone's surprise, the dire situation is interrupted when Hanako Kuzuryuu, an intimidating delinquent, steps in to save Saotome.

After defending Saotome from Takae's plan, Hanako forms an unexpected friendship with him and tries her best to keep the boy safe from any mischief. With Hanako’s help, Saotome strives to avoid the other girls' antics and survive at the school.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Ochikazuki ni Naritai Miyazen-san
title_english: Miss Miyazen Would Love to Get Closer to You
title_japanese: お近づきになりたい宮膳さん
synopsis:
Souta Matsubayashi is seen by his classmates as a gruff delinquent; in contrast, Sakura Miyazen is viewed as a beautiful princess. From their appearances, it may seem like they have nothing in common. However, with the polar opposites beginning the school year in the same class, the two both want to get closer to each other, but their nerves get in the way when trying to start conversations.

One thing they mutually share is their love for yakuza movies. Miyazen tries to get through to Matsubayashi by referencing these films, yet Matsubayashi misinterprets her intentions in the most embarrassing of ways instead. As the two awkward teens stumble their way through every conversation, a blossoming friendship seems more probable than ever.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Ichizu na Takita-kun wa Nido Dakanai
title_english: Wataru Won't Sleep with the Same Girl Twice
title_japanese: 一途な田北くんは二度抱かない
synopsis:
What does it mean when someone loves you, but doesn't want to take it to the next level? Ayaka works at a college as an administrative assistant, and one day, Wataru, the hottest guy on campus, tells her he likes her. Having seen him a few times, Ayaka thinks he's nice enough, but there are rumors he's with a new girl every day! One such girl even tells Ayaka that Wataru's awful, though Ayaka isn't really sure why... When Ayaka asks Wataru himself, he says it's because he has one condition for anyone who dates him... In the middle of a packed train, where anyone could catch them in the act, Ayaka pretends to be a meek secretary... who gets felt up by Wataru! This is all down to his "condition"...!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Youkai Gakkou no Seito Hajimemashita!
title_english: The Terrifying Students at Ghoul School!
title_japanese: 妖怪学校の生徒はじめました!
synopsis:
As the cherry blossoms fall, a new school year kicks off at Hyakki Academy—a school attracting youkai from all over Japan! Unfortunately, the first years are far from model students, especially the troublemaking idiot duo, Mamekichi Maizuka (a mame-danuki) and Tamao Akisame (a nekomata).

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Sekiro Gaiden: Shinazu Hanbei
title_english: Sekiro Side Story: Hanbei the Undying
title_japanese: SEKIRO 外伝 死なず半兵衛
synopsis:
The Sengoku Era... A time when losing a battle meant losing it all. The Sword Saint, Isshin Ashina, aims for world domination... That is until he encounters a certain samurai...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Nanafushi
synopsis: An unexpected inhabitant occupies the old run-down house of the protagonist.

title: Akuyaku Reijou wa Dannasama wo Yasesasetai
title_japanese: 悪役令嬢は旦那様を痩せさせたい

title: Tonari no Kuni kara
synopsis:
Kafka, a strange being living in the Land of Night, encounters a girl at the off-limits borderland known as "The Wall." The girl, Lucy, lives in the Land of Morning. They bond with each other, but strange things happen to Lucy as she visits a forbidden land.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Kyou no Hi mo Mabushikute
title_japanese: きょうの陽もまぶしくて
synopsis:
Joana misses her old town terribly. Will a chance encounter open her eyes to the beauty around her?

(Source: Lovely Strange Dark)

title: Mugiwara Boushi to Koi
synopsis: A god, tired of this world. A little girl, lively but sickly. The summer they cross paths.

title: Kingyo no Osushi
synopsis: A fish in love watches out for the object of her affection.

title: Mononoke: Nue
synopsis: Manga adaption of the Nue arc.

title: Suteki na Alice Wong Obasan
title_japanese: すてきなアリス・ウォンおばさん
synopsis:
When a ghost appears that only Noah can see, he turns to his Aunt Alice for help. She is the Cornfield Witch, after all.

(Source: Lovely Strange Dark)

title: Akuyaku Reijou Tensei Ojisan
title_english: From Bureaucrat to Villainess: Dad's Been Reincarnated!
title_japanese: 悪役令嬢転生おじさん
synopsis:
In his previous life in modern-day Japan, he was Kenzaburou Tondabayashi, a 52-year-old civil servant—and now he's the villainess! Reborn as Grace Auvergne, the drill-haired villainess of an otome game his daughter used to play, Kenzaburou is quite confused.

From the little information he possesses, Kenzaburou knows he should be a haughty noble girl, but the disciplined older man is simply unable to act in such a manner. His calm and kind aura leads him to befriend the heroine and further endear him to the student body as the pinnacle of elegance. As he tries to keep the story on track, Kenzaburou will have to draw on his years of experience in the workforce, his perfect Japanese manners, and his family-oriented morals to fit in with the fellow kids.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Hebi no Yama
synopsis: One year has passed since 17-year old Hana died by suicide. Her little brother Masaya and childhood friend Jun decide to find a snake skin for her as she wished before her death. But all three of them have secrets they've kept from each other which will unfold during their trip into the mountains.

title: Tasuuketsu
synopsis:
Suddenly, the game begins. Tasuuketsu is a harsh survival game where the majority of players will lose. In order to confront the game's powerful mastermind, The Emperor, male and female players will carve out their own destiny using their mysterious special powers known as Privileges.

(Source: ANN)

title: Kowai Hanashi: Otona no Tame no Gokujou Horror
title_japanese: こわいはなし 大人のための極上ホラー
synopsis: Horror anthology by various mangaka.

title: Mou Ikkai
synopsis: A high school girl runs into her ex-boyfriend at a train station and the two reconnect.

title: Spy Kyoushitsu
synopsis:
After a gruesome war wreaked havoc on the general populace, the governments of the world turned to a more elusive tactic to further their agendas—a war fought in the shadows.

Lily, a beautiful girl with white locks, is a student in one of the many institutions that train youths into becoming capable spies. Unfortunately, despite scoring well in the written exams, she only manages to barely pass her practicals. With no real world skills to speak of, her hopes of graduating are dismal—until she is offered an opportunity to join the mysterious team "Tomoshibi" and partake in an Impassable Mission.

Excited by the prospect of working with the elite, Lily enthusiastically accepts. However, she is struck dumb when she arrives at Kagerou Palace and the true purpose of Tomoshibi and its hopeless situation comes into light. Joined by other problematic female spies along with a mysterious young man spearheading the operation, Lily realizes that this is not the ideal escapade she had pictured.

title: Spy Kyoushitsu
synopsis:
In a world torn apart by war and ruled by intelligence, Lily—code name Flower Garden—is determined to become a master spy and help bring peace to the nation. So, when she's offered to join an elite squad that takes on Impossible Missions with 90 percent mortality rates, she's ecstatic...until she finds out that said "elite squad" is made up entirely of spy academy washouts, like her. But each and every one of them has the potential to change the world, and under the tutelage of master spy Klaus, it's time for them to bloom!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Suki Style
synopsis:
1. Yomeiri Open Campus (Bridal Open Campus)
2. Muko-dono U-turn Ship? (Groom U-Turn Ship?)
3. Zettai Kozukuri Super Express (Super Express to Baby Town)
4. Ore no Kanojo Puripuri Pretty (My Girlfriend Is Pretty Pouty)
5. Shucchou da zo Sakuraba (We're Going On a Business Trip, Sakuraba)
6. Runners Heaven
7. Sashiire H 3 on 1 (Sex on Demand 3-on-1)
8. Tayotte Ii no yo Kandagawa-san (You Can Count On Kandagawa-san)
9. ♂Chuusha Chu Chu Chu (♂ I Want My Kiss Kiss Kiss)
10. Kodou Tsutaete Inochi Anata e (Feel my Pulse, Receive my Life)
11. Oinari-sama Juicy Beasty (Juicy, Beastly Guardian Foxes)

title: Metamol Isuke
synopsis:
The time is the Edo period. Isuke, a young painter, has the ability to transform into anything he strongly envisions. Isuke was living happily every day with his ability to transform, but a group of rogues called the Tenguto appeared in the town of Edo where he lives...?

(Source: Beaglee, translated)

Included one-shot:
Volume 1: Metamol Isuke (pilot)

title: Yankee JK Kuzuhana-chan
title_japanese: ヤンキーJKクズハナちゃん

title: Live Dungeon!
synopsis:
An old MMORPG called Live Dungeon. Before the service was terminated, Tsutomu Kyoutani made full use of 5 notebook PCs to clear the game and was invited to a different world. And then, Tsutomu was speechless when he saw a live relay of a dungeon capture in the different world. They bulldozed through without any thought of strategy. The misfortune of getting the healer position. Tsutomu reinstated the White Mage that had always been his favorite in games and aimed to conquer the dungeon to find the key to his escape from the different world.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Komorebi Neko
synopsis: A girl with a crush gets help from an odd little cat.

title: Asahina Wakaba to ○○ na Kareshi
synopsis:
Wakaba Asahina is a shy and slightly awkward girl. She is coerced by her classmates as a punishment game to confess to Haruto Iruma, the number one most hated boy in school. Though her relationship with Haruto starts out with an air of gloom for Wakaba, her depressing school life is dyed with color when she discovers that they share more in common than what she thinks.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Id:Invaded: #Brake-Broken
synopsis:
When I open my eyes, I find myself in an unfamiliar car, in an unfamiliar town, in front of the on-ramp to an unfamiliar highway. Before I can process any of this, I see the fiery explosions of multiple car crashes in the distance, and without thinking, I stomp on the accelerator and race toward the scene. I soon find that I’ve driven straight into hell at full speed with no brakes, just like everyone around me...! In the midst of this insanity, I discover the corpse of a girl, and suddenly I know—I am the brilliant detective. And I must solve the mystery of her death.

(Souce: Yen Press)

title: Aoao
synopsis:
Kengo is overwhelmed. As his wife Ayumi gets hospitalized, he has to take care of his baby daughter Momo. He ends up asking Hitomi, who's a little girl herself, for help.

(Source: MU)

title: Rakuen Sekai
synopsis:
A pair of space explorers return to Earth centuries after their departure.

(Source: Lovely Strange Dark)

title: Yoru no Suizokukan
synopsis:
A young man takes a part-time job which leads him to question his life choices. 

(source: MU)

title: Jumokui
synopsis:
As some trees in Yuzuru Kashiwagi's lush garden mysteriously start withering, he decides to consult Shida, a talented arborist. What he finds, however, is no normal disease...

(Source: Lovely Strange Dark)

title: Apollo
synopsis:
Yoji is completely in love with Tsukiko, a high schooler five years older than him who has a boyfriend. But never fear, he has a plan.

(Source: MU)

title: Message no Ato
synopsis: During a meteor shower Jin makes a wish that his girlfriend Arako sleeping beside him should disappear, leading to unexpected consequences for the couple.

Trying to relax, Mitsuomi goes to a man-boob pub, where he meets Megu-kun—who has big pecs, a big ass, and an erotic body—and falls in love at first sight. title: Blood Bank
synopsis:
Long ago, darkness overtook the world, and humans were saved by their natural predators: vampires. As an act of gratitude, humans willingly sell their blood to them, leading to the creation of "blood banks." When Shell Overlord, an elite bank lord's son and successor, visits the bank, he notices something amiss about a banker. Going by the name "One," he seems to be one of the extremely rare humans who are immune to pheromones—a unique fragrance that bends humans to any vampire's will.

However, One is not the only odd one out. Shell is an "abnormal" vampire, meaning that he likes to be dominated by humans, although superior by nature. Attracted—and aroused—by One's resistance to his pheromones and the fact he is the only human who can truly degrade him, Shell begs One to fulfill his submissive needs. While the two are now forced to keep their steamy relationship a secret, they might soon realize that the feelings they have for one another go far beyond what the limits of society will

title: Iwakutsuki Bukken no Yakuro-san
title_japanese: 曰く付き物件の夜黒さん
synopsis:
Nineteen-year-old university student Yuuki Reikan moves into an allegedly haunted apartment, and sure enough, a female ghost reveals herself with the intent of scaring him away. However, Reikan is not the ordinary tenant the ghost expects him to be, and dating a ghost is something Reikan has always dreamed of, so he has no intention of leaving! The shy ghost is given the name "Yakuro-san" and is lovingly pursued by the eccentric Reikan, who unnerves her more than she frightens him.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Koto no Ha
synopsis:
Cruel words turn into swords which pierce the hearts of the people they are directed at. Will a boy and a girl be able to overcome the misunderstandings created by their words?

(Source: MU)

title: Jigoro Jigorou
synopsis:
The main character of the series is Jigorou Ishikawa, the second of three brothers. Jigorou is a homely, fat, dirty-minded guy and frankly, a loser compared to his brothers. The elder brother Kusuo is the local "Service Area King"—a cool and good-looking young man who gets all the girls, while the youngest brother Isao already has stalkers even though he's still young.

The story begins in the first volume with how Jigorou "borrows" Kusuo's Cadillac so he can impress some girls by pretending that he's the "Service Area King." But since he's an utter twit, he ends up crashing the car. To make it short, Kusuo arrives and beats the crap out of his younger brother, who is saved only when Isao intervenes.

Later at his part-time job, Jigorou then somehow gets himself stuck in a mess when he agrees to challenge Hideki "Guillotine" Okada in a little driving duel. He rushes off to buy a car for the duel with his savings but finds that out of 500,000 yen, he's only got 50,000 yen left in his ac

title: Blattodea
synopsis:
Alice Fujii still isn't having much fun. She survived an assault of psychotic bug-themed assassins at her school, but all the battles, the truth behind her family, the two betrayals from false friends who ended up dead and the loss of her Kumoito knife-gun took a toll on her mental state. As such, she spends her days alone splitting open the heads of the rapist zombies who overran Japan since the aforementioned incident. The organization wants to hire her as their new boss, and elsewhere her allies Gokiburi and Kabutomushi are looking for her. What will become of all this?

(Source: MU)

title: Xevec
synopsis:
2057, Hemisphere, a man-made city in Tokyo Bay, has wiped out virtually all crime by introducing the quantum AI system "XEVEC", through which the "law" acts as a physical force to protect all citizens. Hemisphere is a "utopia", an ultra-nomocratic society in which the righteous are rewarded and permanent peace is guaranteed. Or so I thought. Until that incident...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Hatsukoi Reset
synopsis:
Ako and Hiro were always together. Ako was so sure that Hiro reciprocated her feelings, but after he rejected her, it left a deep scar in her heart. Ten years have passed since then. Ako decides she needs to spread her wings and forget all about what happened. Right when she's having trouble convincing her dad to let her move out on her own, someone comes to the door. It turns out to be Hiro, her first love, and they haven't seen each other since the rejection. But, since Ako's parents trust him a lot, they let her move into his apartment building. Ako is thrilled to be on her own, but when she forgets to call the gas company, she's forced to ask Hiro for help and close the distance between them. Ako wants to reset the bittersweet memories of her first love and try her relationship with Hiro again.

(Source: Renta!)

title: SD Gundam Sangokuden: Fuuun Gouketsu-hen
title_japanese: SDガンダム三国伝 風雲豪傑編
synopsis:
It was the times of war in the continent of Mirisha, a time where the three kingdoms of Shou, Gou and Giga struggle for power and authority. Before the three countries become established, the rebellion of the Yellow Scarves has allowed Toutaku to seize control over the government, he killed Reitei  the emperor of that time and stole the "Gyokuji," then promoted himself to Prime Minister spreading tyranny through the land. But a year after, the anti-Toutaku spirits are on the rise because of the discovery of Reitei's assassination, Enshuu was quick on gathering troops and with Sousou on board the anti-Toutaku alliance is formed. Heroes from all over gather under the anti-Toutaku banner, including Ryuubi's Yuushu Resistance. The anti-Toutaku allied forces fought against the Toutaku Troops at the Korou Fortress which is just outside Rakuyou.

(Source: Gundam Wikia)

title: Zeus no Te
title_english: The Hand of God or Devil
synopsis:
The story revolves around 6 young criminals held in a youth training center. One day a mysterious man appears from the wall. He finds himself wounded and entrusts them with a "hand", which is called "the Hand of Zeus". It harbors a mysterious power and energy. This hand can create a "mouth" that acts like a portal, which they use to escape the correctional room, however having in their possession that "hand" is a great danger, since strange beings are after it so they will have to face them.

(Source: MangaDex, edited)

title: See You Later, Mermaid
synopsis:
Amidst the crashing of raging waves, two strangers meet by the oceanside, their eyes filled with loneliness. Tatsumi Higaki has always believed his voice to be a curse, an unwanted "talent" placed upon his shoulders: the power of compulsion. Fearing its consequences, he has resolved to remain alone forever. On the other hand, Kazushi Kimijima came to the sea in search of something—or someone.

As the two men are put at odds, they are forced to confront their intertwining histories, and as their emotions reach a peak, the two are borne back ceaselessly into the past.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Adabana
synopsis:
A horrifying double murder and a shocking confession uncovers a dark secret in this suspenseful criminal drama manga.
 
A small town is shocked by the gruesome murder of a student and a ramen shop owner. Mizuki Aikawa, one of the victims' best friend and classmate, confesses to the brutal crime. However, a local reporter and Mizuki's public defenders are convinced there's more to the story. As the truth unravels, a tale of class, exploitation, and the demands of family is revealed.

(Source: Dark Horse)

title: Don't Like This
synopsis: Megumi Yoshida, who works as an illustrator and lives an indoor life, is asked to look after the house of an acquaintance. She's not fond of her situation, but taking interest in fishing might slowly change that.

title: Bonnou Musume Souryo ni Koi wo Suru
title_japanese: 煩悩ムスメ僧侶に恋をする
synopsis:
High-school student Nako spends so much of her time in idle amusement that her grades are dropping. So as punishment, she is forced to spend her summer holidays at a temple! She thought it was going to the worst summer holiday ever but her instructor, the vice-priest Ikkei is a super hottie!?

He's stubborn and strict but he's also kind and reliable at the same time so she keeps getting drawn to him!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Lawless Kid
synopsis:
A month has passed since a declaration of peace, and, ever since then, the big city disposes of trash outside its walls—including the expendable humans. Every day, the hungry scour the heap of waste for food. Among them is the young, brave ex-soldier Orga, together with his sister Harika, who gives him the strength to persevere. The siblings, along with Orga's best friend Nick, barely scrape by.

Orga collects potentially valuable junk to save enough money and provide the three of them with a comfortable life away from the impoverished streets. But while Orga works, Nick intends to accelerate their salvation; he proposes a plan to Harika—one that only she can execute.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Yuzu no Koto
synopsis:
People tend to look different when they return to school following a summer break. This is especially true for Ichigo's best friend, Yuzuki—who is now attending school as a boy. Shocked and utterly confused, Ichigo struggles to process why "Yuzu" decided to change his gender. Meanwhile, Yuzu has to deal with the new attention that is not always kind to him. Navigating this situation may be difficult, but there is no challenge these two friends cannot overcome.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Tonari no Mitsuru-san: Kono Apartment ni wa Domestic na Oniisan ga Sundeiru

synopsis:
Taku Kinashi's just moved to Tokyo this spring to attend college, with the dream of getting himself a pretty girlfriend and having his first time at last. He just can't wait to finally live alone like he's always wanted. After settling in, he goes to greet his new neighbor, and who should come out of the door but... a smoldering-hot young man with his shirt hanging open displaying his soft, glistening chest and supple thighs! What's more, he seems to know Taku from somewhere...! What happens when a plain old college straight boy like Taku lives under the same roof as an irresistible, exhibitionist flirt like Mitsuru?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Saiyouki
synopsis:
In a world where humanity stopped progressing and started heading toward ruin, The Superior, Akane, and her group head toward India to find out about humanity's difficult future conclusion. At a village, Akane accepts a request to defeat a Youma at the mine where it is said to reside. The group encounters a young man; he has no feet and no "orb," which gives people their identity in this world. As he is a prince of the country of Sai, Akane suggests taking this mysterious young man along with them to India.

(Source: Hundred Scans)

title: Futatabi no Caribbean-kai
title_english: The Greek And The Single Mum
synopsis:
The fancy and stylish playboy Xander Anaketos could have had his pick of any woman. Handsome, rich, and successful, he had it all, so Clare never understood why he chose a country bumpkin like her. For an entire year, they were intimate, traveling the globe together and basking in each other's presence. However, that dreamlike time came to an abrupt end when Xander broke off their relationship. Unbeknownst to him, Clare was pregnant with their child, but cast aside, she ran out without ever informing him.

Four years later, Clare is a single mother working as a waitress to get by. One fateful day at the high-class restaurant where she works, she encounters Xander once again. After he tracks her down at home, he discovers Joey—his son—and insists he be part of his child's life from now on.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Koi wa Sannenme ni
synopsis:
It's been three years since they broke up, but now Dray, Cass's ex, has appeared before her once more. The way he broke up with her was downright cruel, so what could he possibly want now? Her little sister married his younger brother, and up to this point she'd been lucky enough to not have to see him at all. Dray had the same beautiful blue eyes as before, and he stared coolly at Cass while he told her that Pen had passed away, leaving behind a baby. Pen's death will have repercussions for Cass and Dray's relationship that the heartbroken Cass can't yet imagine.

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Junshin na Rakusatsusha
synopsis:
Corrine wants a promotion in her company and makes the highest bid to win three dates with rumored playboy Rand Pearson. She just wants someone to escort her to events; that was the original plan. But when the gorgeous Rand approaches, Corrine cannot keep her body still. The so-called ice queen can feel her heart wavering before this new man. But Corrine simply doesn't have time for romance—she has a goal to accomplish. She needs romance to take a back seat while she spends time with this dangerously handsome man!

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Bosabosa Melancholy
title_japanese: ボサボサメランコリー
synopsis:
"Do you mind if I take some liberties in the style?"

After moving into a new town, Shion Kimura's biggest worry is finding a new hairdresser. After letting her hair grow out for far too long, she decides to walk around town and explore her options. While walking, she is called out to by Karin Ishiwaka, a hairdresser at a nearby salon. Insisting that she cut Shion's hair, Ishiwaka drags her into her shop. Although she initially dislikes what Ishiwaka does with her hair, Shion finds herself frequently coming back to the shop, seeking the comfort of having her head in Ishiwaka's hands.

Bosabosa Melancholy follows the blossoming relationship between two girls as they help each other explore themselves through hair and love.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Koishikawa-san wa Nikushokukei
synopsis:
Akane Koishikawa is a cute, stylish gyaru with gray hair. But she's got a glare that gives a bad impression to most of her classmates, who now keep their distance. Chika Nishimura is the only one kind to her.

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Buna no Mori no Aria
synopsis:
The witch Aria is a little shy. She's good at cooking and knitting. And she's a real wiz at growing herbs. As for what she's bad at? Why, that's magic! One fateful day, the sheltered girl encounters a talking wolf, who becomes her very first friend. Watch the witch and wolf snuggle up in this comfy story with a touch of mystery set in the forests of Ireland!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Mou Ichido Shinjite
synopsis:
Helen loved her husband, Dan, from the bottom of her heart. The teenage sweethearts tied the knot two years ago, and their life together was wonderful. Until the day Helen came home from work early with a nasty cold... and found her half-naked husband with his secretary, Celine. When she wasn't home, it seems the two of them had been... She couldn't even think about it! Dan begged her to trust him. But what on earth was she supposed to believe!

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Kusakabe-san

A man finds a mysterious young woman on his doorstep. Her passion and hunger for life suddenly shine bright for him in what has been a pretty mundane existence.

(Source: Denpa)

title: Suitou to!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Mezametara Saikyou Soubi to Uchuusenmochi Datta node, Ikkodate Mezashite Youhei toshite Jiyuu ni Ikitai

synopsis:
Sato Takahiro was an ordinary office worker and hobbyist gamer until the day he woke up on a spaceship–one that strangely resembled a craft from a favorite space-shooter game. With a decked-out ship, a crew full of babes, and a fantastic universe to explore, he’s going to make the most of his good luck and create the life he’s always dreamed of!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

It's tempting to tease the girl that you like, right? Nanase is interested in her classmate Momo. Whenever Nanase sees her, she can't help but play with her. A yuri comedy about a girls' school where the law is out of bounds and the girls are always on the edge of their seats.

Two sisters, with ten years separating them. Once close, they grew distant with time. As the younger sister enters high school, their relationship once again begins to change. This time in an unusual direction.

title: Ashita, Watashi wa Dareka no Kanojo
title_english: Tomorrow I Will Be Someone's Girlfriend
title_japanese: 明日、私は誰かのカノジョ
synopsis:
To cover her expenses, university student Yuki Shirai works as a part-time rental girlfriend. Once a week, she has to manage the burn scar on her face and put on a fake personality—hiding her cold, calculating, and cynical self—all to suit her client's desires. Having grown up in a family lacking any warmth or love, she works believing money is the only thing that will never betray her.

Meanwhile, Tsuji Souta is unlike Yuki's past clients. Having lied to his friend about having a girlfriend, he hires Yuki for a double date, from where they develop a growing acquaintance. As Tsuji discovers the true Yuki, she sees him as a refreshing change from her other clients. But as they get closer, the two wonder how far they should take this relationship, or perhaps they should just part ways as merely a client and rental girlfriend.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Oretachi no Irekawari Seikatsu
title_japanese: 俺たちの入れ替わり生活
synopsis:
Mitsuru Hanahata is the jokester of the class, always singing and bringing smiles to everyone's faces. Conversely, Takuya Daizenji is the aloof, wealthy, and good-looking heir to the Daizenji Conglomerate. Their lives couldn't be any more different, yet the thought "wouldn't life be better if I were him?" is always on their minds. While thinking this one day, they bump into each other and switch bodies!

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Higeki no Genkyou to Naru Saikyou Gedou Last Boss Joou wa Tami no Tame ni Tsukushimasu.
title_english: The Most Heretical Last Boss Queen: From Villainess to Savior
title_japanese: 悲劇の元凶となる最強外道ラスボス女王は民の為に尽くします。
synopsis:
Pride Royal Ivy is the final boss and all-around scum in the otome game Our Ray of Light. She committed innumerable crimes—from enslaving her adopted brother in a soul-binding contract to abusing her position against the servants in the household. In short, she is a villain of pure evil.

A normal high school student in Japan reincarnates into the eight-year-old body of Princess Pride. The first order of business: survive to see another day. Using her cheat-like abilities, she resolves to save her father, rescue the kingdom, and become a kind and benevolent ruler. And so, Pride resolves to change her fate, no matter what it takes!

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Isekai One Turn Kill Neesan: Ane Douhan no Isekai Seikatsu Hajimemashita
title_japanese: 異世界ワンターンキル姉さん ～姉同伴の異世界生活はじめました～
synopsis:
"It wasn't me who was the strongest in another world, but my sister?!"

As a result of an accident in the real world, Asahi Ikusaba is transported to another world. He tries to enjoy the different world he imagined, but his abilities prove to be the weakest. Just as he's about to be attacked by a vicious monster, Asahi's doting elder sister Mayu comes into his rescue and saves him.

Chasing after Asahi's love, Mayu too ended up in the same world as him, with the strongest of abilities and cheat skills. The fantasy tale of the strongest elder sister with a brother complex and the younger brother with the weakest skills begins.

The two will pose as lovers so Beth can get Andreas's attention and Theo can break his brother's engagement. But can Beth go through with Theo's plan? And does she still want Andreas now that she's seen another side of Theo?

One day, Haruto Saijou was forcefully transmigrated and cursed by a god from another world. A world of swords and magic. In this world you get stronger by increasing your battle levels. Suddenly living together with the most easily flustered man!? A gap love, a difference in age and generation!

Gaku, the somewhat nostalgic young delinquent, showed up in front of Akira, a high school teacher around thirty years old. Moreover, why are they suddenly living together!? This is the heart-throbbing, awkward love between Gaku, a cute, earnest, slightly foolish boy who likes to look good, and Akira, an older woman who unconsciously leads him around the nose!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Korisenman
synopsis:
It is said that there are some special animals occasionally born with great powers. Senzou the black fox is one of those... but instead of using his powers for good, he abused his strength until the Sun Goddess imprisoned him for his bad behavior. Three hundred years later, he's finally been released, but only on one condition—he can't have any of his abilities back until he successfully helps a tanuki cub named Manpachi become an assistant to the gods. Unfortunately for Senzou, there's no cheating when it comes to completing his task! The magic beads around his neck make sure he can't wander too far from his charge or ignore his duties, and so... Senzou the once-great Fox Spirit must figure out how to be an actually-great babysitter to a innocent little tanuki or risk being stuck without his powers forever!

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Senran Kagura: Senshi Bankou no Haruka

Too bad he hooked up with Mariam, an undead demon. So, what do you get when you combine unquenchable thirst and deviant appetites? A sexual fantasy of epic proportions from the creator of The Baker on the First Floor.

title: Ariel
synopsis:
To save the Earth from alien invaders and their giant monsters, Dr. Kishida does what any other red-blooded mad scientist would do: he builds a giant robot—the ultimate feminine fighting robot!

Unfortunately, his grand-daughters refuse to pilot it! Apparently, they've got more important things to do than becoming teenage super-heroes. Besides, how are you supposed to study for your college entrance exams while getting beaten-up in battle?

Fortunately for Dr. Kishida, things aren't too well for the invaders, either. According to their reports, the Earth was the perfect target: lush, peaceful, and relatively defenseless. Theoretically, the planet should've surrendered long ago. Now, the war is at a standstill, the dreaded Accounting Department is warning about the serious cost overruns, and the head of the home office has arrived from Galactic Headquarters to personally oversee operations. Has Headquarters decided to unleash, The Audit—or do they have something even more evil in mind?

This is a heartwarming story that depicts their transition from boyfriend and girlfriend to husband and wife.
