Tsutsuki Tsuranuki, a middle school boy who lives a happy life despite slightly strange family circumstances. But when a great disaster strikes, strange zombie-like creatures kidnap his younger sister. To find the whereabouts of his younger sister, Tsutsuki heads to monster-infested Tokyo, and there has a chance encounter with a high school girl wielding a mysterious sword.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Koi ni Ochita Daifugou
synopsis:
This strange man who's suddenly appeared...just who is he?

Circumstances led Sophy to take a DNA test, but now she's misplaced the all-important letter containing the results and can't find it anywhere. If anyone else sees it, it will mean major trouble for her! In a panic, she searches a room reserved for breastfeeding, but, as if to thwart her search, the room is already occupied...by a shirtless, muscular man who is shaving. Sophy turns bright red and averts her eyes while he keeps a perfect poker face—it's almost as though he had known she was coming. Just who is this thoroughly mysterious man?

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Aijin Shigan
synopsis:
My life was laid out peaceful and predictable before me...so how did I end up here?

Mercy has a quiet, unassuming life in the small English village where she was born. Engaged to a frugal yet polite man, she believes that her peaceful life will continue from here on out...that is, until her best friend returns from London and turns everyone on their head! Her friend's wedding is an extravagant affair, very different from anything Mercy has ever known. But then the bride goes into a panic when a handsome man with cold eyes appears. She says that this man, Croft, is here to ruin the wedding. Rushing to her friend's rescue, Mercy tries to distract the man...and ends up ruining her own life instead!

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Lingua Dolce!
synopsis:
He's unfriendly and uncouth, yet his kisses are as sweet as his desserts... Neither body nor soul can resist this Italian beauty... Keito is a chef at the privately managed Italian restaurant "Molte Stelle." He's been asked to supervise a new hire, the Italian dessert specialist Gino. Gino's an inscrutable man of few words, and Keito is constantly at his wit's end trying to settle him in. One day, Gino leaps on him and steals a rich, syrupy kiss...!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Great Pretender
synopsis:
Makoto Edamura may be young, but he's already one of Japan's best conmen. However, he meets his match when he gets tangled up with Laurent Thierry, a French con artist with big plans. Soon, Makoto is in LA, working (begrudgingly) with Laurent to swindle a big-time movie producer/drug dealer. Laurent's plan is a good one, but can Makoto trust him?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Kyrie
synopsis:
In a world where social class is completely decided by race, Shigure, who was promoted to a Holy Knight despite being born from the lower wolf race, meets Kyrie of the cursed snake race Katara in a church and believes that he is the messenger of God. He develops a love for the snake and this eventually turns into an uncontrollable passion.

(Source: Akaneshinsha, translated)

title: Kabukichou Stray Flamingo
title_japanese: 歌舞伎町ストレイフラミンゴ
synopsis:
Rui, the number one host of club Baroque in Kabukichou, changed from his newcomer days when he was called "prince" to a trashy host who sells by pushy methods and sleeping with clients. The biggest eyesore for him is currently the presence of the number two host, a calm newcomer called Youji. One day, Rui gets dead-drunk at an after party and Youj,i who had been sitting with him, makes love to him at a hotel, making him get erectile dysfunction because of the shock!! From that day on, his life that he thought was going well starts getting out of order as if falling down a slope...!? Love is fictitious, the only thing that can be trusted is money. An exciting and pure love comedy unfolding in a world full of desire!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Kiyoku Tadashiku Utsukushiku
synopsis:
A sole omega was born into an alpha family. They hid him away and raised him in secret, ashamed of his existence. Chikage (omega) is named heir of the Souma clan after his older sister ran away, the first omega to be the leader of an alpha-only clan. Hiroto (alpha) met Chikage once when they were both kids. They met again when Hiroto is chosen to take care of Chikage at school. But he's nothing like the sweet child who clung to him before, Chikage now has a cold attitude but a slutty body... and wants nothing to do Hiroto?!

(Source: MU)

title: Jisatsu Houjo
synopsis:
The manga centers on a string of suicides by hanging that have been plaguing the town of Kongou for the past two years, with an urban legend that a girl supposedly appears before the victims to sign a suicide contract with them, pursuing them until the victims commit suicide. Saotome, a college student of folklore studies in Kongou, has been having recurring dreams for months of himself hung by a rope in a graveyard. He begins to see a woman named Koyomi Hirasaka, a therapist who specializes in suicidal thoughts, but unbeknownst to him, he is misled into signing a suicide contract with her, and she begins to shadow him everywhere.

(Source: ANN)

title: Tonari no Heya kara Aegigoe ga Suru n desu kedo...
title_japanese: 隣の部屋から喘ぎ声がするんですけど...

title: Watashi, Maou. Nazeka Yuusha ni Dekiai sareteimasu.
title_japanese: 私、魔王。―なぜか勇者に溺愛されています。
synopsis:
By the order of the king, Oliver and his comrades head toward the demon king to subjugate him.

The true identity of the easily defeated demon king is a beautiful girl, Cecilia. Oliver falls in love at first sight, and despite his comrades' objections, he just takes her home with him!

Oliver spoils Cecilia at every turn, but unfortunately, not a single one of his thoughts has reached her. Will there ever be a day where the hearts of the hero and the demon queen align...?!

(Source: Shufu to Seikatsu-sha, translated)

title: Ichizu Bitch-chan
synopsis:
When Ayumi "Kouhai" Yurino learns that her senior Yuuki "Senpai" Hisamizu is heading to Minami High School, a fairly difficult institution to enroll in, she believes her current results are insufficient to pass the entrance exam. Despite this, Senpai gives her a word of encouragement and promises to tutor Kouhai if she succeeds.

One year passes, and Senpai finds Kouhai to be one of the new first-year students enrolling at his school. However, he also quickly realizes that his junior has become extremely flirtatious toward him! Now fulfilling his promise, the two experience many events together—whether they be funny, embarrassing, or even romantic.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Toaru Tenin to Kyaku no Hanashi
title_english: The Story of a Waitress and Her Customer.
synopsis:
Saki Komatsu, a college student who works at a bar, is in love with a regular customer, Yamato Shiraishi. Despite the slight age difference between them, Saki is head over heels for this office worker. For many months, she has wished to convey her feelings to him, but her lack of courage has left her love letter undelivered for six months.

However, thanks to a small mishap, Saki finally finds the opportunity to give him her letter. The two have no prior experience with romantic relationships, leaving them unsure of how to deal with the butterflies of being in love. The simple act of making eye contact with each other is enough to make them blush. Nonetheless, day by day, the pair slowly grows ever closer in this heartwarming love story between a waitress and her customer.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Nemurasare Okasareta Kyonyuu Miboujin
title_japanese: 眠らされ犯された巨乳未亡人
synopsis:
1-5. Miboujin Konsui Rinkan
6. Hamaru Hitozuma
7. Mawaru Hitozuma
8. Haramu Hitozuma
9. Hitozuma 10-byou
10. Fukujuu suru Musuko no Yome

title: Ano Tsuki ni Mukatte Ute!
title_japanese: あの月に向かって打て！

title: Isekai Sniper wa Onna Senshi no Mofumofu Pet
title_english: Another World Sniper Is Female Warrior's Mof-moffy Pet
title_japanese: 異世界狙撃手〈スナイパー〉は女戦士のモフモフ愛玩動物〈ペット〉
synopsis:
A 31-year-old gun otaku, completely penniless, dies and reincarnates in another world! But he was reincarnated as a fluffy, cute little monster?! He meets a female warrior and they begin adventuring together. It turns out his gun knowledge is extremely useful in this other world. An other world, reincarnation fantasy!

(Source: Shounen Gahou-sha, translated)

title: Football Alchemist
title_japanese: フットボールアルケミスト
synopsis:
In football, an agent handles contracts and transfers on behalf of pro players. For their ability to move astronomical amounts of money, these agents are known as alchemists. This one has a notorious name: Kyousuke Senzaki. With him is Risa Natsume, a college student tracing her missing brother's footsteps. The lives of pro players and their complex world of money and power are realistically rendered by a sports writer and a football manga artist.

(Source: Japan Media Arts Festival)

title: Yatta ne Tae-chan!
synopsis:
After being abandoned by her mother, Tae-chan is left alone with Koro-chan, a teddy bear that she treats as if it was a family member as it's the last thing still connecting her to her mom.

Tae-chan is usually quiet but she won't have any pity for those who dare hurt Koro-chan...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: BNA
title_japanese: BNA ビー・エヌ・エー
synopsis:
A society where beastmen and humans coexist.

Michiru, a high school student who suddenly turned into a tanuki beastman one day, runs away from the human anti-beastmen advocates and makes her way to "Anima City," a city where beastmen live, to search for a way to turn back into a human.

While bewildered about the differences between the human cities and etiquette and that of beastmen, she starts learning about the way beastmen live.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Cuprum no Hanayome
synopsis:
Shiina, a female college student, is dating Shuu, a coppersmith. For many years, Shiina has heard the rhythm of Shuu's hammer striking copper. Unable to know what he is thinking, she continues to watch him hammer away, as he has always done. However, one day, Shuu suddenly proposes to Shiina! With marriage in mind, Shuu will come to realize that love and craftsmanship may very well be correlated with one another.

[Written by Phloup]

title: Kimi ga Niku ni Nattemo
synopsis:
One day, Hinako came across a living piece of flesh. On the same day, her friend Maki had a peculiar dream. Was it real life? Or was it a dream? A story of friendship, youth, and horror.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: The iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls: Cinderella Girls Gekijou Wide☆
title_japanese: アイドルマスター シンデレラガールズ シンデレラガールズ劇場 わいど☆

title: Ohimesama no Ohimesama
synopsis:
Heidi Nanzan dreams of meeting the perfect girl so she comes to the girls school with one goal: to be a princess for her princess. At Choyuri Gakuen, it's girls as far as the eye can see.

A no-boys-allowed yuri comedy!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Jimi de Medatanai Watashi wa, Kyou de Owari ni Shimasu.
title_japanese: 地味で目立たない私は、今日で終わりにします。
synopsis:
Elaine Lana Norris, a woman of noble birth, appears to be in crisis. Her fiancé has annulled their engagement, her childhood friend Evan has cast her aside, and her grandfather has banished her from the household. All of this is the doing of their country's two-faced "Saint" Sandra, who falsely accused Elaine of misdeeds. 

Instead of sadness, however, what Elaine feels is elation! As it turns out, Elaine's previous life in Japan revolved around makeup and cosplay, and she retains these hobbies in her current one. Finally free from the chains of her aristocratic responsibilities, she assumes her commoner name of "Lana" and returns to her true calling as the owner of the warm and welcoming Fairy's Inn.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Bukyou Souha
synopsis:
Life is the most fragile thing. That's the world of "martial madmen." A lone drifter, Bowie, appears in the violent city of Longshanbó. There he meets a mysterious non-human girl, Shiyu, for whom he throws himself into a bloody battle in order to save her! A violent action work where life and death are constantly at stake!

(Source: GOT, translated)

title: Iya na Kao sare nagara Opantsu Misete Moraitai Manga
title_japanese: 嫌な顔されながらおパンツ見せてもらいたい漫画

title: Harapeko na Joushi no I wo Tsukamu Houhou: Sasen-saki wa Kyuutei Madoushi no Senzoku Chef
title_japanese: 腹ぺこな上司の胃をつかむ方法 ～左遷先は宮廷魔導師の専属シェフ～
synopsis:
With a sudden job transfer, Wilfred is thrown into a certain division filled with weirdos! There, he meets Ester, his boss who has nothing to do but eat. Wilfred originally intended to hone and master magic, but he finds himself thrown into the duty of being her exclusive chef?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Isekai Cheat Kaitakuki
synopsis:
A neat man, who died due to neglecting his health, reincarnates as the son of the ruler, Enid, in a different world where magic exists. He is surrounded by his beautiful mother Carla, the large-breasted maid and Dark Elf Ruina, and his non-blood-related sister Amelia. As a teenager, Enid enjoys his everyday life making full use of his top-tier magic skills and modern knowledge.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Momentum
synopsis:
Momentum is a series of beautifully drawn vignettes that glimpse into the life-altering moments of several couples as they fall in and out of love. This BL features a series of characters learning how to love, understand, and forgive one another—and in some cases, the world—at different moments in their lives.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Tensei Youjo wa Akiramenai
title_english: Reincarnation's little girl never gives up
title_japanese: 転生幼女はあきらめない
synopsis:
When I woke up, I had been reborn as a baby. My mother passed away and I was neglected by my father. Even though I was born in a marquis family, my life started on HARD MODE. But I won't be discouraged. I will eat well, sleep well, move a lot, get whatever I can get and live happily. But for some reason, a lot of incidents happen. This is a story of a little girl with the power to create barriers in a world where the hollows and humans are in conflict. She gets other people involved in those incidents and becomes happy.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: One Piece Novel: A
synopsis:
Washed up on the shores of a deserted island at the edge of the East Blue Sea, two men from different backgrounds unite in their shared thirst for adventure. One of them, Portgaz D. Ace, will follow in his infamous father’s footsteps as the fearless captain of a pirate crew. The other, Masked Deuce, becomes the reluctant first member of Ace’s Spade Pirates. Survival is not enough for these seafaring buccaneers, as together they seek treasure, excitement, and a route to the New World.

(Source: Viz Media)

title: Wondance
synopsis:
Kaboku Kotani is starting high school, and he plans to do what he's always done: go along with his friends, keep quiet, and not draw too much attention to himself. After all, it's hard enough to get by with a stutter like his—why make things worse by standing out from the crowd? But then he sees another first-year, Hikari Wanda, dancing like no one is watching—or like she doesn't care who sees her. It makes Kaboku wonder: Could he reach that same freedom? To find his way to Wanda, he does something he never thought he could: He joins the dance club. After all, every routine begins with a single step, right? Join Kaboku and Wanda as they freestyle their way to life and love!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Shishunki no Obenkyou
synopsis:
1-7. Shishunki no Obenkyou
8. Oneechan ni Makasenasai!

title: Suterareta Yuusha wa Maou to Narite Shinimodoru
title_japanese: 捨てられた勇者は魔王となりて死に戻る
synopsis:
Daichi Katsuragi, a youth who had suffered through gruesome bullying, suddenly teleported into another world together with his classmates. Daichi did his best in trying to be a hero, but as he was useless even after reincarnating, he was abandoned in a Monster House to be a scapegoat. Daichi should have died. However, he rose, somehow unharmed. The ability he gained was "Revenge of the Grudgebearer." It was a unique ability, one that would revive him each and every time he died and bring him an extreme level of growth! The strongest ability in his grasp, Daichi set out to take his revenge...

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Shuusai Ryman to Haraguro Megami
title_japanese: 秀才リーマンと腹黒女神

title: Kaminaki Sekai no Kamisama Katsudou
title_english: Working for God in a Godless World
title_japanese: 神無き世界のカミサマ活動
synopsis:
Yukito Urabe is the son of a cult founder who worships the omnipotent god, Mitama. To become the next guru of the organization, Yukito participates in a ritual, but it ends up costing him his life. In his final moments, he wishes to be reincarnated in a world without gods and religion.

Just as he desired, Yukito wakes up in a village in a strange and godless world. While gradually bonding with the people around him and adjusting to his new life, he soon discovers this world's grisly reality. As citizens of the ruling empire reach a certain age, they are legally obligated to take their own lives. Furthermore, the villagers that Yukito has grown to know are deemed abnormal by the government for their fear of death.

When Yukito and his newfound friends face execution for disobeying orders, Mitama—the god from Yukito's past life—appears before him and saves them. Clear proof of Mitama's existence reshapes Yukito's warped perceptions, and he realizes that the faith he despises is the key

title: Mei-chan wa Yakiniku ga Koishii
title_japanese: メイちゃんは焼肉が恋しい

title: Tensei shitara Ken deshita: Another Wish
title_english: Reincarnated as a Sword: Another Wish
title_japanese: 転生したら剣でした Another Wish
synopsis:
Reincarnated as a sentient weapon with memories of his past life, but not his name, a magical sword saved a young beastgirl from a life of slavery. Fran, the cat-eared girl, has become his wielder, and wants only to grow stronger, while the sword wants to know why he is here. Follow their new adventures in this spin-off manga series!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Futago-tachi no Shojijou
title_english: The Personal Circumstances of the Twins.
synopsis:
Kouki and Nao Fujiyoshi are twins who both have a big secret: they are in love with one another. Naturally, they would suppress their feelings due to being brother and sister. However, their mother accidentally reveals that Kouki is actually adopted! Ever since learning that they are not related by blood and put under the impression that the other still views them as a sibling, Kouki and Nao have no idea how to handle their long-hidden feelings. As the twins accept this new circumstance, their relationship suddenly changes, slowly bringing the two closer together than they were ever before.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Romantic Killer
title_japanese: ロマンティック・キラー
synopsis:
The declining birth rate in Japan has led to a significant decrease in the sparkly innocence of human children, a vital energy source for the magical world. With businesses closing due to the shortage, a resolution is passed: a lasting romance will be created for humans who prioritize their hobbies or careers over falling in love.

Before this policy is enforced nationwide, the magical fairy Riri selects high school student Anzu Hoshino as a preliminary test subject. Primarily preoccupied with her video games, beloved pet cat, and her obsession with chocolate, Anzu is the perfect candidate. Unfortunately for Riri, Anzu is vehemently against this idea and actively works to thwart the magical world's vain attempts at forcing her into a romance.

Even with her distractions confiscated, Anzu stubbornly tries to evade her new predetermined fate, only for it to backfire when she collides with Tsukasa Kazuki, a hot guy from her school. Now unable to avoid the boy she had not even noticed befo

title: Karate Baka Ichidai
synopsis: A semibiographical manga depicting the life of Ooyama Masutatsu, the founder of the Kyokushinkai school of karate.

title: Kaibutsu Maid no Karei naru Oshigoto
title_english: The Splendid Work of a Monster Maid
title_japanese: 怪物メイドの華麗なるお仕事
synopsis:
Sumire, a nekomata who lost her beloved master, was wandering around, got lost, and arrived in a foreign country in the demon world!? In order to take back "a certain something," she will clean the cluttered rooms with the undead Rose and the android Ivy!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Coil-senpai wa Omo-Eroi
title_japanese: コイル先輩はオモエロイ
synopsis: Genius is 1% inspiration and 99% libido. An ecchi/cute one-shot.

title: Usotsuki na Tsugai: Sono Nioi, Naka made Shimikomasete
title_english: Liar Mate: Let That Scent Soak Deep Inside
title_japanese: 嘘つきな番～その匂い、ナカまで染み込ませて
synopsis:
"I'll sleep with you until you can't take anymore; until you're soaked with my scent..." Akari is an omega despised even by his own family as useless, since he never had his first heat even after becoming an adult. However, one day, the alpha Shinji appears before him and claims he wants Akari to be his mate. Using drugs to force him into heat, Shinji has his way with Akari, now soaking wet, countless times. "Ah! ...Something's... coming!" Though Akari's body was yet immature, Shinji awakens the lust within him...

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title: Akuma no Mokushiroku
synopsis:
Luka, a blond and blue-eyed orphan, is the son of God. He and his 12 chosen friends try to save humanity from the powerful Ren and his demons.

(Source: MU)

title: From Points of Three
synopsis:
Jisuh is quiet, unassuming... observant. He's suited to working behind the camera. But for reasons he's not exactly quick to disclose, he's run into some debt. Heejae, an actor he's worked with before, proposes he work with him exclusively on a private project of his...shooting himself and his partner having sex. Jisuh thought he was hired for his camera skills, but Heejae seems to know an awful lot about him and he can't help but wonder why he really hired him.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Koisuru Daigo-sensei
title_japanese: 恋するダイゴ先生
synopsis:
1-3. Koisuru Daigo-sensei
4-6. Love Limit!!
7. Koisuru Daigo-sensei: Gojitsudan

title: Hibike! Euphonium Series: Rikka Koukou Marching Band e Youkoso
title_english: Sound! Euphonium: Welcome to the Marching Band!
title_japanese: 響け！ユーフォニアムシリーズ 立華高校マーチングバンドへようこそ

title: Navigatoria ni Koi
synopsis:
Kei, a hot transfer student from the U.S., mistakes Yuri for a girl. Even when he realizes Yuri's a guy, he won't stop making passes at him! Yuri's always had a complex about his cute name and appearance, and Kei keeps pushing Yuri's buttons from day one at school! Kei's weirdly attached to Yuri. He's way too touchy-feely, and on top of that, he loves to call Yuri "cute"...! One day, they're alone together in the library, and Kei can't resist making a move...! "I've never been with a guy, either... Wanna try it?" A handsome, half-Japanese playboy from the U.S. meets a cute-but-ballsy Japanese high-school boy. One just can't seem to say no to the other. A bewildering yet oh-so-sweet teen romance!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Koko wa Ore ni Makasete Saki ni Ike to Itte kara 10-nen ga Tattara Densetsu ni Natteita.
title_japanese: ここは俺に任せて先に行けと言ってから10年がたったら伝説になっていた。
synopsis:
The Hero's party was attacked by a large group of powerful devils. The party will no doubt be annihilated if this were to go on. One member of the party, the strongest mage, Rakku, decided to stop the enemies in their tracks.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Kenritsu Umisora Koukou Yakyuubu-in Yamashita Tarou-kun
title_japanese: 県立海空高校野球部員山下たろーくん
synopsis:
Tarou Yamashita is a hopless klutz, but his enthusiasm for baseball know no bounds! Inspired by his passion, the members of the Umisora High School Baseball Club decide to try to compete at the prestigious Koshien Stadium. The sight of the players slowly but surely improving over time got readers fired up in a way many other baseball manga couldn't.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

Included one-shots:
Volume 21: Umisora Koukou 4-ban Sanrui Yamashita Tarou-kun, Umisora Koukou 5-ban Pitcher Yamashita Tarou-kun

title: Tale of the Yellow Dragon
synopsis:
With the screech of rubber and a crunch of metal, Dojin departs the mortal world, leaving behind his beloved sister and niece. He awakens in the kingdom of Yooguk, where the people call him "emperor" and serve a god named Yellow Dragon. Dojin soon discovers that Yellow Dragon called him to Yooguk for a purpose: to share his "life force" and protect the kingdom. As Dojin slips deeper into Yellow Dragon's cold embrace, how far will he go in order to get back home?

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Kasshoku Mermaid
synopsis:
1-9. Kasshoku Mermaid
10. Mei An♡

title: Shousetsu Hirune Hime: Shiranai Watashi no Monogatari
title_english: Napping Princess: The Story of the Unknown Me
title_japanese: 小説 ひるね姫～知らないワタシの物語～
synopsis:
When Kokone sleeps she dreams of Heartland, a place full of technology and warring machines, where she's the Princess Ancien who possesses magical powers. But when events in her dreams and real life start to intersect, Kokone has to run from bad guys in both worlds. Will her dreams provide a way out, or get her into deeper trouble...?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Hello, Innocent
synopsis:
Yukito is a handsome scholarship student who also excels at sports. One night, when he was depressed because he had to quite his beloved kendo due to family circumstances, he met a girl. They parted before he learned her name, but the next day, he sees her in his class. Her name is Yui, and she has been refusing to go to school all year...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

Included one-shot:
Volume 1: Sakurazawa Filter

title: Sensei de ○○ Shicha Ikemasen!
title_japanese: 先生で○○しちゃいけません!
synopsis:
“Want to learn about sex with sensei?”

Immensely popular with students, and who is both beautiful and kind, is the infirmary’s Yui-chan-sensei! She has a charm on a level that makes you unintentionally ○○, and for the students in the midst of puberty, they always think up the wrong things with her. And today as well, students with concerns about sex are coming in for guidence from Yui-chan-sensei. “Sensei, I can’t get a grip on studying because I can’t stop myself from jerking off!” “Sensei, did your first time feel good?” While learning about sex, peek into sensei’s secret that nobody knows☆

A very titillating and serious sexual education erotic comedy!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Meitantei Kouko wa Yuuutsu
synopsis:
The manga is set during the height of the Showa era, and centers on a little girl named Kouko who is in training to become a detective. She is hired by a notable family to find out who sent a death threat to the family's son Inugami, who currently resides in a dormitory in Tokyo. To this end, she moves in to the dormitory to begin her investigation, but she is bad at cooking and even worse at figuring out where to start with the case.

(Source: ANN)

title: Makai no Shuyaku wa Wareware da!
synopsis:
A spin-off of Mairimashita! Iruma-kun made in collaboration with the Japanese Let's Player group ○○ no Shuyaku wa Wareware da! (○○の主役は我々だ!).

The series focuses on the (mis)adventures of Xiaolong, a demon enrolling in Babyls Demon School whose goal is to stand out, become popular, and join the student council.

(Source: MangaDex, edited)

title: Ohitoyoshi Shokunin no Burari Isekai Tabi
title_english: A Good-Natured Craftsman Leisurely Travels Through Another World
title_japanese: お人好し職人のぶらり異世界旅
synopsis:
Young Ryoichi Ishikawa lost his only remaining relative, his father, so the electronics shop they worked so hard to build is now closed. Strange things happen and Ryoichi chooses to transfer to a foreign world as a result. Our protagonist wanted to just explore this second life, but can't just abandon those in need. Ryoichi solves their problems with God-granted skills along ability as a craftsman. Very quickly, Ryoichi's surrounded by a bunch of quirky weirdos that become his friend?! The goofy off-world adventures of this good-natured craftsman begins here!

(Source: AlphaPolis)

title: Rokujou Hitoma
synopsis:
"I want to be popular! I want a girlfriend!"

The wish of the unpopular virgin college student, Ikuta, has finally been answered! Before his eyes, a cute demon girl called Gremory has appeared! However, this demon girl likes beautiful girls so much that she can't even look them in the eye!

(Source: Kill Time Communication, translated)

title: Itomo Tayasuku Okonawareru Juusansai ga Ikiru Tame no Oshigoto
title_japanese: いともたやすく行われる十三歳が生きる為のお仕事
synopsis:
The work is a crime story that portrays a 13-year-old serial killer, Shoutarou, whose job is to kill. A young man, Akito, whose sister was killed by a small group, one day met with Shoutarou and finally helped with his work. After learning about Shoutarou's work, Akito asks him to find the people who killed his sister and get rid of them.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Hero Tantei Nick
synopsis:
Nick Spade, a detective in a city where super heroes are exist. However, his work is walking dogs and investigating cheating cases. One day, the client who visited him is a former well-known super villain. What request would a super villain make to an ordinary detective?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Utsurohiya
synopsis: Shop where you can go up to 20 years in the future and spend one day there.

title: Mirai no Mirai
synopsis:
Little Kun isn't too happy about the latest addition to his family. With the arrival of a new baby sister in the house, he worries his parents may not love him as much as they used to... But when a teenage girl shows up and tells Kun that she is his sister from the future, it may be that there's more to this new relationship than Kun ever could've dreamed!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Gravitation
synopsis: A story of Meifas, a one-armed fortune-teller (who first appeared as a child in Tamago no Hi), and Einz Serganotzkada Tswinza, a crown prince, who refused the crown in order to search for the man who was foretold to be his life's partner.

title: Ookami Kodomo no Ame to Yuki
title_japanese: おおかみこどもの雨と雪
synopsis:
When Hana worked up the courage to speak to the mysterious loner in her college class, she never expected the encounter would blossom into true love-nor that he was secretly a wolf living in human form. Their relationship was far from ordinary, but she wouldn't have had it any other way. Her joy only grows with the births of Ame and Yuki, who have inherited their father's unique ability to transform. But life is full of both joy and hardship, and Hana is left to bring up her little wolves on her own. Raising human children is hard enough... but how will she handle their wild side, too?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Tate no Yuusha no Nariagari Anthology: Raphtalia to Issho
title_japanese: 盾の勇者の成り上がりアンソロジー ラフタリアといっしょ
synopsis: A collection of stories by various mangaka, centered around the hit series Tate no Yuusha no Nariagari. This manga is filled with the charm of the heroine Raphtalia.

title: Classmate no Tanaka-san wa Sugoku Kowai
title_english: My Classmate Tanaka-san is Super Scary.
title_japanese: クラスメイトの田中さんはすごく怖い
synopsis:
At Nakajima's high school, there is a rather frightening girl named Tanaka. Having heard rumors about her killing people with a simple glance, Nakajima hopes to avoid becoming her desk neighbor. Unfortunately for him, though, that is exactly what happens!

Not wanting to form any preconceptions about Tanaka, Nakajima attempts to be friendly with his classmate. However, every time he looks at her, he is always met with a glare! Nonetheless, as he spends more time with her, Nakajima is slowly exposed to Tanaka's endearing side—realizing that she might not be so scary after all.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Matsukage ni Ikou
synopsis: The story of Shouin Yoshida, who acted as mentor for many of the Meiji Restoration's influential figures, including Hirobumi Itou.

title: Hoshikuzu Telepath
synopsis:
Fifteen-year-old Umika Konohoshi is having a hard time socializing at school, but she hopes her words will someday reach other people. When self-proclaimed alien Yuu Akeuchi enters her life, Umika will learn more about being open.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Sheikh ni Metorarete
synopsis:
Chloe secretly carried and gave birth as the surrogate mother of her half sister, the queen of a desert country. However, as Chloe waited for her sister to pick up her baby, her sister and her husband perished in an accident. To Chloe, who is a dedicated researcher and has never given any thought to love or marriage, the child they left behind is her only blood relative. She's determined to raise the child with all her love, no matter how difficult it might be. But then Sayid, the younger brother of the late sheikh, who is now serving as regent, appears at her door. With a cold, stern expression, he informs her that he has come to collect his country's future ruler and is prepared to take the baby by force. Now the only way for Chloe to stay by her child's side is to marry Sayid! She will do anything for her child—even wed Sayid in a loveless marriage. But will her heart be able to withstand the charm hidden under Sayid's serious facade?

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Kumo no Ito
synopsis: About those who work in the jack-of-all-trades shop "Byaku-ya" found in Border, the town where humans and non-humans gather.

title: 1031 Wan Sheng Jie
synopsis:
In this world, angels, demons, and other supernatural beings peacefully coexist with humans. Neil Bowman is a demon who is unlike most; he is mesmerized with human culture, and no matter how hard he tries, he can't do anything evil. Thus, he runs away from Hell and up to Earth.

Neil moves in with his online friend and vampire, Ira Blood, along with Ira's many roommates. Despite coming to Earth to meet humans, Neil discovers that not a single one of his new roommates is actually human. Along with Ira, there's Lynn Angel, the stern angel landlord; Lynn's little sister, Lily, who falls from Heaven; Abu, a mummy who never speaks; and Vladimir Eliot Kirilenko, a werewolf tasked with monitoring Neil.

What most of them don't realize—not even Neil himself—is that Neil possesses the powers of the Demon King. What effect will this have on the residents of Apartment 1031 on All Saints Street?

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Ijimeru Aitsu ga Warui no ka, Ijimerareta Boku ga Warui no ka?
title_english: Is It My Fault That I Got Bullied?
title_japanese: いじめるアイツが悪いのか、いじめられた僕が悪いのか?
synopsis:
Twenty years ago, Yuuichi Aizawa suffered through insurmountable bullying, ultimately culminating in him dropping out of middle school. Riddled with the signs of cigarette butts and gouged out skin, Aizawa's body is a testament to what he was forced to endure. All this time, he has not forgotten those who turned a blind eye or those who laughed in glee, but the memory of none lingers quite as vividly as Shinji Suzuki, the ringleader of his tormentors. With a successful career, lovely wife, and cheerful daughter, Suzuki is living life to the fullest, never facing adversity. However, he is unaware that his daughter, Shiori, has recently been assigned a new homeroom teacher—Aizawa himself.

Holding onto the pain of his past, Aizawa has his own agenda for how to handle his class. Meanwhile, Suzuki claims that it is the fault of the victim who suffers from bullying, too weak to stand up for themselves. But will he be able to say the same when his loved one becomes the next victim?

She turns out to be the princess of a kingdom in the Mediterranean, and the prince she is betrothed to is a notorious playboy on the cover of every tabloid. Wanting to experience a life of freedom before her wedding, the princess and Natalie decide to switch places temporarily. "This prince needs to be taught a lesson. I'll put him in his place!" says a resolved Natalie, but when she meets Prince Rodolfo, she is swept away by him...

synopsis:

All that changes when she encounters the Blade Runners, a group of one-legged athletes who run with "blades"—carbon fiber prosthetics specialized for competitive running—made by their gifted prosthetist, Kazami. The blades are light, flexible, and formidably difficult to control—Rin can barely walk with one, much less sprint. But as she tumbles to the ground again and again, she rediscovers many of the things that she'd forgotten, and finds a new goal: to compete in the Paralympics.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

synopsis:

He met his fellow teachers on his first day and everything is sailing smoothly until Kousuke Seta came, his arts teacher back in high school. Everything became worse when he accidentally broke Seta-sensei's phone and was asked to be his lover in the span of his four months stay. Turns out, there's a rumor going around school (Got a love problem? Find Heesu in Class 2 and he'll tell you what to do!) and with that, Heesu suddenly finds himself the center of attention. But how could he give anyone advice? He doesn't even know what to do about his own crush!

title: Restart wa Tadaima no Ato de

Twenty-five-year-old Mitsuomi Kozuka finds himself back in the countryside after recently losing his job in Tokyo. At first glance, it seemed as if time froze in the rural area where he grew up. However, it is not long until Yamato Kumai comes into his life.

Unlike Mitsuomi, Yamato is cheerful and full of youth, even though the two are of the same age. Despite their contrast, Mitsuomi finds solace in Yamato's presence, making him feel right at home. But living in a closed and conservative community holds them back from being open about their feelings as they both face unsettling situations and receive critical looks from the residents.

But while Yuuji has moved away from him to suffer less, Souichi reappears, thinner and exhausted by his work. Listening only to his concern, Yuuji invites him to his brewery. Now that they are adults, wouldn't their relationship take on a different meaning?

She still hasn't healed from his betrayal five years ago, but when he whispers sweetly to her, she's captivated by his wild eyes. Why is he trying to get involved with her again? Justina decides to spend one last night with him, unable to resist his charms, but it ends up leaving her with a secret she can never tell him...

For the first time in her long career as a detective, Hyeon Seola stands frozen before a gruesome scene with a mutilated corpse. The abandoned body, helplessly lying on the bloodied ground, belongs to Seola's longtime lover, Hwan Hara. A mere week ago, Hara had stormed off after the two exchanged some heated words, but Seola assumed that Hara would—as she always had—eventually return home.

While Seola hid her sexuality in fear, Hara had a strong sense of justice, advocating for queer rights and often clashing with violent homophobes. Now that Hara has been robbed of her voice, Seola takes on the case of her murder, but gut-wrenching regret and suffocating guilt threaten to consume her. As she loses her sense of self while probing deeply into Hara's relationships and the events that took place before her tragic death, Seola swears to avenge her beloved—even if it is the last thing she does.

Ready to throw herself into enemy lines against all orders, there is only one thing she fears; the allied reptilian medic, Captain Ruce Duval. While "Red" is ready to put herself in harm's way for the sake of her comrades, her reckless tactics always send her back into the clutches of the twisted captain. Even in the midst of battle, these two seem to always run into each other. While Ruce can't keep her hands to herself, Red can't figure out why Ruce keeps running through her mind. But this growing interest soon traps Red like a leash around her neck. As passions spark and boundaries are pushed, how long before this wet-nosed virgin is swept up by her scaly superior?

Born in a dumpster, raised in an orphanage, living as a yakuza, he is tough enough that he fights all his fights bare-handed, and is covered with countless knife and bullet scars from his battles. But his life changes when he saves the five-year-old Ayumi, daughter of the new police chief, Masayoshi Enjouji, and befriends their family. For the first time in his life, Jinsei feels like he's found a family of his own, and decides to start his life over, but his past and his ties to the yakuza keep getting in the way.

Instinct takes over, and she pelts them with potatoes to save the man. He is Sir Douglas Drury, a courtroom lawyer and a baronet. His mind in a haze, he calls out to her and plants a sweet, passionate kiss on her cheek. When he wakes up, though, he's forgotten all about the kiss and treats Juliette as his servant, but when Sir Douglas's mysterious assailant targets Juliette's life, she pretends to be Sir Douglas's lover and makes her debut in high society in search of the culprit!

But only a little while later, she discovered he was unfaithful and she broke it off. Three years have passed since then, and now that Leon has assumed his father's role as copartner at Stephen & Gregoris, he's come back for her. Just remembering the humiliation makes Bea angry, but Leon doesn't care—the first thing he does is kiss her in front of everyone at her twenty-first birthday party!

Hajime, however, is a glutton for punishment, and wants the arrogant Shion to treat him like a slave in exchange for his blood. Shion reluctantly agrees... He hates it, but the pleasure is too much to resist. Will Hajime end up going to town on his cute new master!? This is a love story between a depraved human and a pushy vampire.

Just when he thinks he can survive hiding his truth through college, another incident leads to him reuniting with his so-called fated alpha—but is a bite in the heat of the moment really enough to map out the rest of their lives?

His dear departed mother's last hope was for him to live his life as a splendid warrior, but a cruel curse repels and distorts any metal that gets near him. Will he ever be able to wield a sword, much less live the life of an honorable samurai?

It is said that a samurai's spirit rests in their sword—and Ryuudo can't even pick one up! Destitute and hopeless, he decides to end it all. But when a beautiful and mysterious woman saves his life and his soul, it is the beginning of Ryuudo's journey into a strange world of magic that exists a step away from his own.

Can Yuuki escape from the facility protected by magic and demons?

One day, Souda shows up at the music store Yukiya works in and tries to reinsert herself into his life. synopsis:
Akiba Okado is 27 years old and has one conviction: she will never get married. However, one fine day, a strange marriage proposal is offered to her: Shin Momose, an editor, wants to marry her not out of love, but because he needs the title of "groom" for some obscure reason... Akiba ends up accepting and a very unusual marriage begins... Could what was supposed to be a simple arranged marriage lead to a real romantic relationship?

(Source: Shodensha, translated)

title: Secret Alliance
synopsis:
Eun Sian, otherwise known as Shanshan by her good friend Hyunee, is popular with all the girls at school. Which would be great if she swung that way, but she doesn't. It just happens that she's terrified of men, and her mother is obsessed with protecting her from all men. And suddenly, Yuri, the prettiest girl at school, has admitted to Sian that she has feelings for her. Now Yuri won't stop following Sian around, which would also be fine by Sian, except it seems like Yuri wants Sian all to herself... and who knows how far she'll go to make sure that happens.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Lanxi Zhen
synopsis:
Lanxi Zhen tells the story of Lao Jun, Xuan Li, and Qing Ning during the war. It shows a different world of demons and gods.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Kekkonshiki ga Owattara
synopsis:
Ever since Alix was small, she's had a crush on Rhys, a boy ten years her elder. Now, at twenty years old, her thoughts still run wild with dreams of marrying him... So when, after years spurning her advances, Rhys proposes to her, Alix accepts, overjoyed that her childhood dream has at last come true. But Rhys continues to put work first—he won't even set the wedding date. Alix begins to wonder if Rhys even loves her... and that's when she hears a rumor she can hardly believe: the construction conglomerate where Rhys works will only consider employees for executive positions if they're married...and that's the only reason he's proposed to her!

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Window to Window
synopsis:
Childhood friends Ginu and Yubin live in separate apartments in separate buildings right next to each other—so close, in fact, they can talk to each other and see into each other's apartments through their windows. But Yubin's long-held secret is revealed one day when Ginu sees him doing something naughty through the window...

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Yakimochi wa Kitsuneiro
synopsis:
Akiha Konno is excited for the opportunity to move from his rural home to attend college in Tokyo. However, one thing makes him incredibly nervous: he is possessed by a fox spirit that seems to take over his body at the most inconvenient times. When the spirit causes Akiha to embrace a man he meets on the subway, he thinks his only saving grace is that they are unlikely to cross paths again. But Akiha soon learns that the man he hugged is Yukuri Takahashi, the son of the distant relative who he is staying with.

As Akiha tries his best to manage his new life, he discovers that the fox spirit has taken a liking to Yukuri and wants to get much more intimate with him. With the threat of the spirit controlling his body looming, Akiha is willing to do whatever it takes to have some normalcy. But as the line between strangers and something else blurs, Akiha begins to wonder if the time he spends with Yukuri is truly just for the sake of the spirit.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Minos no Beef 100%
synopsis:
In this Jashin-chan Dropkick spin-off, Minos and the girls bar-hop searching for the most delectable cuts of meat they can find!

May the meat and booze come aplenty!

title: 4-gatsu no Tokyo wa...
synopsis:
"Are you against being my sex-friend?"

The new employee Kazuma, who returned to Tokyo from America, reunites with his close friend from middle school, Ren, who is currently working as the top designer at their company. It is their first meeting since their abrupt farewell during their third year in middle school, 10 years ago. Ren was his best friend and his first love. He is as strong and good-looking as ever... And Kazuma is happy just being with him. However, Ren avoids the subject of their time in middle school rather unnaturally and acts like a friendly former classmate... But he's behaving this way because he is gay, and above all, fears being rejected by Kazuma. Yet one night, the two of them get together again...?!

(Source: Taiyo Tosho, translated)

title: Koisuru Hypnotic Therapy
title_japanese: 恋するヒプノティックセラピー
synopsis:
The closet gay working at a boys' bar and single for as long as he's been alive, Kazushi Takasumi, can't resist immediately viewing the guys around him as romantic interests and is worried about how quick he is to fall in love. Recently, Kazushi has gotten close with the younger university student living next to him, Sou Isaki. Kazushi's heart quickly starts to pound for the ikemen Sou who makes food for him as an apology for being taken care of after passing out drunk. One day, Sou invites Kazushi to the hypnotic aroma oil massage salon he works at after learning about Kazushi's worries and proposes for him to undergo a special training in order to build up his resistance...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Tonari no Metaller-san
title_japanese: となりのメタラーさん
synopsis:
Due to the increase in college dorm fees, graduate student Kentou Sasaki has no choice but to move out. He quickly finds an apartment with cheap rent, but there is a catch: neither the bath nor the stove work. Confident that his body will be able to handle the cold, Kentou has no problem with moving in immediately. However, luck is not on his side because he almost freezes to death after a heavy day of snowfall.

He is unexpectedly saved by Soushi Ikematsu—a man with an aloof personality who loves listening to metal and is Kentou's neighbor. Despite his scary appearance, Soushi makes Kentou a meal to warm him up. Thus, a year goes by, with the two neighbors falling into a comfortable routine of sharing their meals together. To Kentou's disappointment, their relationship has not progressed further. However, in fear that it could put an end to their friendship, Kentou does not have the courage to confess to Soushi that he likes men. Will he be able to keep it a secret when he starts to f

title: Kanraku Alpha: Enigma - Dai-4 no Verse
title_japanese: 陥落アルファ ―エニグマ:第4のバース―
synopsis:
Tsukasa Kuga is the heir to a great company. One day, at a party, he meets a man who appears to be the heir to the Amou empire. Tsukasa intends to use this man for his own gain, but without realizing it he is already underneath him in his bed!

(Source: Futurecomics, translated)

title: 23-ji no Time Shift
synopsis:
1-2. 23-ji no Time Shift
3-4. Yumemiru Shoujo ja Irarenai
5. Futouhen Sankakukei no Teiri
6. Untitled

title: Jyajya
synopsis:
Rena Takizawa knows everything there is to know about Italian Motorcycles—she owns a repair shop and has a good business dealing with exotic bikes. Susumu Miyagi, a 19 year-old, rents the apartment upstairs. It's cheap, but it's noisy as hell living above a motorcycle shop. But Susumu has the hots for the older Rena, and he will do what he can to help Rena, despite the fact that she knows far more about what she's doing than he does...

(Source: MU, edited)

title: Waiyoku
synopsis:
1-2. Hina Asobi (Hina's Game)
3. Futago Yuugi (Twin Play)
4-5. Ibunka "Ran" Kouryuu
6-7. Sakurako-sensei no Tokubetsu Jugyou

title: Yo ga Yo nara!
title_english: It's Just Not My Night!: Tale of a Fallen Vampire Queen
synopsis:
Powerful, world-conquering vampiress Manamir is on the verge of world conquest, but when a teleportation spell goes awry, she finds herself stranded on Earth. Not only has she been flung into a world that's not her own, she has lost the very power that defines a vampire: the ability to drink human blood! Unable to steal energy from others, Manamir has to make ends meet somehow, which is why she ends up working part-time at a convenience store, selling smokes to bikers while trying to grasp the subtleties of Earth life. Maybe she'd make more money selling her panties...

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Nanpuu: Jitensha no Tabikoi
title_japanese: 南風～自転車のタビコイ～

title: Isekai Teni, Jirai Tsuki.
title_english: To Another World... with Land Mines!
synopsis:
When an entire class of high school students die in a tragic bus accident, an evil god sends them to a different world with supernatural skills to help them survive. However, they don't realize that some of those skills are land mines—powers that seem good but have deadly downsides!

Among those students are the childhood friends Haruka, Nao, and Touya, who work together to establish a safe and stable life in this new world. None of them want to be a hero, and that realistic perspective is exactly what they need to survive. After all, the world they're in isn't a game. It's reality.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Dívčí Válka Gaiden II: Hi wo Tsugu Monotachi
title_japanese: 乙女戦争〈ディーヴチー・ヴァールカ〉 外伝 II 火を継ぐ者たち
synopsis:
It is the 1440s and the Kingdom of Hungary is on the brink of civil war following the death of Emperor Sigismund. As the encroaching threat of the Ottoman Empire threatens Hungary, Clara, daughter of Šárka, strikes out on her own adventure.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Moonlight Garden
synopsis:
The enchanting flower maidens of Moonlight Garden are coveted by all, as they are known to provide sexual pleasures beyond the imagination. But Dohwa, a young flower maiden who has not yet "bloomed," concocts potions in the hopes of escaping her destined fate at the brothel. One night, she is caught stealing ingredients for her potions by Lady Hyewon, the new mistress of the Garden. But it turns out Dohwa isn't the only one with an agenda. Lady Hyewon harbors a few terrible secrets of her own.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Odai wa Kekkou desu
synopsis:
Ichi is a club host working in a family restaurant during the daytime, and that's where he meets his ideal man. The handsome stranger introduces himself as Kyouichi Satou and seems to be the embodiment of Ichi's dreams. Ichi tries to look perfect in his eyes, but Kyouichi keeps witnessing Ichi's most compromising situations. In an unexpected turn of events, Kyouichi becomes his customer and Ichi is about to break quite a few of his professional and personal rules!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Toutoi. 4P Short Stories
title_japanese: 尊い。 4Pショート・ストーリーズ
authors: Namori|Mizu, Asato|Wakai, Ken|Yoneda, Kazusa|Akitaka|Takaki, Tsuyoshi|Yanagida, Fumita|Fujichika, Koume|Nakahara, Kaihei|Oohara, Roron|Ikuhana, Niiro|Yuzuchiri|Sorato, Shunsuke|Arita, Imari|Konbu, Wakame|Shiromanta|ruch_f|Kinoue, Seiichi|Azuma, Fuyu|Kudou, Makoto|Niichi|Rei.
synopsis: A collection of sweet and short stories by various mangaka.

title: Cinderella wa Sagasanai.
title_japanese: シンデレラは探さない。
synopsis:
My little sister and I looked up at a high-rise apartment-building, touching the clouds like a castle would. Even if there was a princess living in there, it doesn't have anything to do with us, merely an unreachable existence, or so we thought. With a pure chance meeting, I ran into Rei Shindou, and realized that the Rei in front of me wasn't a princess, or the untouchable idol at school, but just a cute girl you could find anywhere.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Rettoujin no Makentsukai: Skill Board wo Kushi shite Saikyou ni Itaru
title_japanese: 劣等人の魔剣使い　スキルボードを駆使して最強に至る
synopsis:
Tooru Minasuki, a normal office worker, is reborn in another world after falling through a dimensional rift. A god grants him an ability called Skill Board upon his reincarnation. Taking advantage of this, he acquires essential skills—and an overpowered skill called Magic Blade. Despite his status as a stray—those known as inferiors for being seemingly incapable of leveling up—he presses forward on the path to becoming the strongest!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Tensei Kizoku, Kantei Skill de Nariagaru: Jakushou Ryouchi wo Uketsuida node, Yuushuu na Jinzai wo Fuyashiteitara, Saikyou Ryouchi ni Natteta
title_english: As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World
title_japanese: 転生貴族、鑑定スキルで成り上がる～弱小領地を受け継いだので、優秀な人材を増やしていたら、最強領地になってた～
synopsis:
An ordinary salaryman dies one day and is reborn as Ars Louvent, the son of a noble. Although he is not talented in magic or swordplay, he does have one skill that no one else possesses: Appraisal. Using this ability, Ars can determine a person's current strength, how much potential they hold, and where their talents rest.

This skill is especially useful in the present situation of the country. The government is corrupt, revolts occur more often than not, and nobles far and wide are strengthening their fortifications in preparation for an all-out war. With this in mind, Ars realizes he too must prepare by gathering talented people.

A persecuted foreigner unparalleled with the sword, a slave with an unknown talent for magic, and a timid boy with an unquenchable thirst for knowledge—such talents lend Ars their support as he aims to create the most powerful territory.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: "Watashi ga Inakutemo Shiawase ni Natte Kudasai" Nante, Fuzakenna.
title_japanese: 「私がいなくても幸せになってください」なんて、ふざけんな。
synopsis:
As I was spending my student days alongside my beloved girlfriend, one day, she suddenly said goodbye to me. After becoming a shadow of my former self, I learned that she died after struggling with an illness.

The diary I received from her family was filled with her happy memories with me.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kouchuugun Shikan, Boukensha ni Naru
title_english: Captain Corinth: The Galactic Navy Officer Becomes an Adventurer
title_japanese: 航宙軍士官、冒険者になる
synopsis:
The spaceship which Imperial Galactic Navy Officer Alan Corinth helms is shot down by a surprise attack during hyper-space navigation. Completely due to freak coincidence, Alan is the only one in the ship to survive. The severely damaged spaceship loses its navigation capabilities and plummets onto a nearby planet.

Using an escape pod, Alan heads toward the planet alone. Thus begins Alan's quest for survival on the underdeveloped planet utilizing the symbiotic nanomachines [Nanom] within his body. Surprisingly, the planet is home to a thriving human civilization whose genetic code closely resemble Alan's own. Even while remaining at a loss due to being thrown into a world of swords and magic, he tries to live as best he can together with his newfound comrades.

What will Alan achieve in this strange world? The sci-fi fantasy story in a medieval setting now begins!

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: End of Balor
title_japanese: エンド・オブ・バロル

title: Atarashii Ashi de Kakenukero.
title_japanese: 新しい足で駆け抜けろ。
synopsis:
Shouta Kikuzato's hopes of starting on his school's prestigious soccer team are derailed when a terrible incident costs him his leg. Now in his first year of high school (again), Kikuzato has resigned himself to never reaching his athletic dreams. But when Chidori, a passing prosthetist, notices Kikuzato's artificial limb—and speed—as he races through the train station, the specialist proposes a partnership: Chidori will build Kikuzato a brand-new leg designed solely for speed. All Kikuzato has to do is run!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Seireki 2200-nen no Ota
synopsis:
When seeing his favorite idol in the hands of an old man, Oota's heart breaks into a thousand pieces, but he doesn't have time to grieve! As the ground beneath him rips open, he falls into a time rift that sends him into the distant future of 2200 A.D.! This future is an era where men have now been replaced with sex bots and machines are powered by women's orgasms. Oota thinks he's fallen into a pretty sweet deal, but he soon finds himself as a pawn in some futuristic class warfare. Will this virgin from the past be the hero this future needs?!

(Source: FAKKU)

title: Onnanoko no Ouchi H
title_japanese: おんなのこのおうちえっち
synopsis:
1. Futaba Seichou Jitsugi
2. Janken H
3. Dekita Musume
4. My Place
5. Hana no Iwato
6. Operation:Eats The Cherry
7. Pushover
8. PV Koubousen
9. Shitsuren Death Front
10. Present Friday
11. Futaba Seichou Kouki

title: Chiisai Nozomi to Ookina Yume
title_japanese: 小さいノゾミと大きなユメ
synopsis:
High schooler Nozomi Koiwa wakes up and discovers she's lost her memories...and a whole lot of height. Now the size of a soda can, she flees from a feline assault into the disgusting den of Yume Okubo, a drunken shut-in NEET who's terrified of people and hasn't been outside for months. Between falling beer cans and deadly insect traps, Nozomi survives long enough to convince the airheaded Yume that she's a figment of her imagination who's come to save her from hitting rock bottom...all while investigating how she ended up funsized. But despite their differences—height, brains, and otherwise—each half of this quirky combo might just be what the other needs!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Netsujou Drawing
title_japanese: 熱情ドローイング
synopsis:
Daiki is an illustrator and has a preference for male bodies. Actually, the role distribution is clear: the model poses and Daiki draws. But his latest model Yuusuke has a completely different view; he has his own wishes and thus messes up the purely professional relationship between these two!

(Source: MU)

title: Yoshioka-sensei wa Boku Senyou Deep Throat Onahole.
title_japanese: 吉岡先生は僕専用ディープスロートオナホール。

title: Suterareta Tensei Kenja: Mamono no Mori de Saikyou no Daima Teikoku wo Tsukuriageru
title_japanese: 捨てられた転生賢者～魔物の森で最強の大魔帝国を作り上げる～
synopsis:
Belamus was once a great sage with the power of reincarnation...but as all lives must pass, so did his. He reincarnated with his memories, but was suddenly abandoned as a newborn child! Luckily for him, he was adopted by the nearby goblin tribe...but this moment of kindness may mean more for both the Goblins and Belamus than either of them know!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Jigoku no Gouka de Yakare Tsuzuketa Shounen. Saikyou no Honootsukai to Natte Fukkatsu suru.
title_english: The Ultimate Fire Sorcerer's Return: Through Hellfire and Back!
title_japanese: 地獄の業火で焼かれ続けた少年。最強の炎使いとなって復活する。
synopsis:
"Hellfire"—once sealed unquenchable fire, whose fierce flames can burn the entire world to the ground. Flare is an ordinary guy who lives in a border village and is sacrificed to an out-of-control fire. Experiencing inhuman torments in the hellfire, he would seem to have no chance of surviving...

But wait a minute! Is he not dying? Had he endured the fury of hellfire? Flare literally rose from the ashes and returned to the world of the living, gaining the ability to control the "Hellfire!" This is a fantasy story about the travels of a free hero who conquered the flame and cheated death itself!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Jaa, Kimi no Kawari ni Korosou ka?
title_english: Then Shall I Kill in Your Stead?
title_japanese: じゃあ、君の代わりに殺そうか?
synopsis:
The manga centers on Yuuma Fujikura, a constantly bullied first-year high school student. When a classmate named Ryou Ameri, nicknamed "Amelie," helps him out one day, Yuuma tells him not to get any more involved, or else the bullies will target Amelie too. In response to this, Amelie only tells Yuuma that he would commit murder for him if Yuuma wanted.

(Source: ANN)

title: Neconeco Baby
synopsis:
This is the story of Kai—the eldest brother in the Nekoya family who fell in love at first sight with Kyousuke Suzuki. Kyou-chan and Kai are university classmates, and Kai is constantly confessing to Kyou-chan, but is always rejected. So, how far will this love affair of a sensitive brother from the Nekoya family go? Will "beauty" Kyou-chan accept the affection of this frail brother?

(Source: Mangago, edited)

title: Zanzou Slow Motion
title_english: Twilight Out of Focus: Afterimages in Slow Motion
title_japanese: 残像スローモーション
synopsis:
Things have always been intense between Midorigaoka Film Club's narcissistic president Jin Kikuchihara and second-year star director Giichi Ichikawa. The two club members cannot see eye-to-eye on anything related to movies or their production, which often causes bitter verbal spats in front of the other club members. Now in his final year, Kikuchihara has to decide who to give the club presidency to before he graduates, and Ichikawa is a shoo-in for the position—if only they could get along with each other.

Complicating matters is when Ichikawa moves into Kikuchihara's dorm room due to unfortunate circumstances. Though Ichikawa is only there temporarily, Kikuchihara cannot shake the awkwardness of the situation entirely—especially when his temperamental club member practically has a different personality in private than he does at school. As he struggles to determine which version of his roommate is the real Ichikawa, Kikuchihara finds it harder to ignore his potential attraction to h

title: Magatsu Wahrheit: Hitotsukiri no Madousho
title_english: Magatsu Wahrheit Only One Magic Book
title_japanese: 禍つヴァールハイト ひとつきりの魔導書

title: Zense wa Kentei. Konjou Kuzu Ouji
title_english: Previous Life was Sword Emperor. This Life is Trash Prince.
title_japanese: 前世は剣帝。今生クズ王子
synopsis:
Once upon a time, there was a swordsman who wielded the sword, lived by the sword, and died by the sword. After days and months of battle, the swordsman chose death by his own free will, but was reborn as Fay Hanse Diestburg, the third prince of the kingdom of Diestburg. Wanting to distance himself from his past life where he lived as if possessed by the sword, Fay decided to just lead a life of a wastrel, earning the nickname Trash Prince. However one day, because of a pact with the neighboring kingdom's Afillis royal house, Fay is sent to war, leading reinforcement troops. On the battlefield, Fay witnesses a scene of despair, as the "Hero," an existence possessing power rivaling tens of thousands, ravaged the battlefield. Fay considered returning to the kingdom, but a certain knight's death manages to shake his heart, thus he decided to wield the sword once again. The legend of the strongest lazy prince begins!

(Source: Novel Updates)

title: Yokohama Meibutsu: Otoko Katayama-gumi!
title_japanese: 横浜名物 男片山組!

title: Tensei shitara Ore ga Heroine de Aitsu ga Yuusha Datta
title_english: When I Was Reincarnated in Another World, I Was a Heroine and He Was a Hero
title_japanese: 転生したらオレがヒロインであいつが勇者だった
synopsis:
After waking up from an accident, ordinary high school student Keito Azumi finds himself reincarnated as the heroine in a different world. The worst thing about it is that his best friend Taiga became the hero!

(Source: MU)

title: Shakunetsu no Nirai Kanai
synopsis:
Meet hard-boiled cop Boyle Samejima. He's just been assigned to the remote Ogasawara Islands. There he finds coworkers, a mysterious young girl and a dolphin for a partner?! Cop x girl x ocean! Welcome to the craziest hard-boiled cop story you'll ever read!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Isekai Tensei... saretenee!
title_japanese: 異世界転生…されてねぇ!
synopsis:
On the first day of high school, Kousuke Yuuki was killed while trying to help someone. However, that was not the end of his story. The old man he helped happened to be a god. As thanks, he lets Kousuke reincarnate into another world. He was overjoyed to live the life of those overpowered protagonists seen in his favorite isekai stories. However, when he came to, he found himself at the very same spot he died. This is the story of a protagonist living a peaceful life in the modern era with the cheat ability given to him by a god... not.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Tights de Iyashite Kureru Yome
title_english: My Wife's Tights Soothe My Soul
title_japanese: タイツで癒してくれる嫁
synopsis:
Taito Sumeragi works at a "black company"—one that exploits its workers through bad business culture. He relies on his wife, Hakua, to make his life bearable. Lending him an ear for emotional support and thigh-filled tights for physical support, Hakua helps Taito be able to keep pushing through his tiresome days at work by giving him something to look forward to when he finally comes home.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Aa-chan wa Sobakasukko
title_japanese: あーちゃんはそばかすっコ
synopsis:
Narcissistic Seiiji Agou believed that no other beauty could move his heart until he accidentally ran into the gentle and charming Narumi Maimoto. Maimoto hinted that they would meet again, but before that happens Agou suddenly got cursed by a girl stalker! Not knowing what his curse is, Agou walked to the class and met Maimoto who just got transferred. However, he does not seem to recognize Agou's face even though they met only yesterday!

Annoyed Agou walked to the bathroom only to realize that he had lost his precious beauty. Well, thankfully he doesn't turn "ugly" in everyone's eyes, just in the eyes of the subject of his affection. Eh? Does that mean... Love is beautiful, but it doesn't have to be beautiful to be Love! Agou and His Curse is undeniably an adorable youthful BL that will make your heart flutter!

(Source: MediBang/Media Do International)

title: Mainichi Kanon, Nichinichi Kanon
title_japanese: 毎日カノン、日日カノン

title: Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu: Sekai Saikyou no Majutsushi de Aru Shounen wa, Majutsu Gakuin ni Nyuugaku suru
title_english: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World
title_japanese: 冰剣の魔術師が世界を統べる 世界最強の魔術師である少年は、魔術学院に入学する
synopsis:
Everyone knows of the most powerful soldier, the Iceblade Sorcerer, who led the country to victory three years ago, but few know his true name: Ray White. After weathering through a bloody war, Ray enrolls at Arnold Academy, ready to experience a normal life—a luxury he never had. To further this goal, he keeps his identity as the Iceblade Sorcerer a secret, the scars of the past still haunting him to this very day.

Despite being ostracized for being a commoner, Ray befriends the prideful yet kind Amelia Rose, the muscle-brained Evi Armstrong, and the shy and bookish Elisa Griffith. However, conspiracy is lurking in the academy walls, and Ray is tasked with hunting down a spy whose motives remain unclear. To protect his newfound friends and the people he holds dear, Ray will do whatever it takes, even if it means confronting his past.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Ippanjin Enpou yori Kaeru. Mata Hatarakaneba!
title_english: An Ordinary Person Returns From a Distance. I Have to Work Again!
title_japanese: 一般人遠方より帰る。また働かねば！
synopsis:
Shigeru Sugiyama, a cafe assistant, suddenly teleports to a fantasy world, where he realizes he is different from the rest. However, it's not in a good way. The younger high school students who teleported to the same world had titles of "Heroes" and "Saints," but Shigeru didn't have any titles to his name. But then it happened again. Shigeru teleported once more, but this time, to the real world!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Torotoro ni Shite Ageru
title_japanese: とろとろにシてあげる
synopsis:
1. Makana-san to Engage Chinpo (Makana-san's Engagement Dick)
2. Shinobu-chan no Sukusuku Nikki (Shinobu-chan's Quick Diary)
3. Shinobu-chan no Meromero Daisakusen!! (Shinobu-chan's Lovey-Dovey Strategy)

He's already got a bad rap with the other students, and though Satsuki tries to approach him, he seems to always weasel out of her grasp. title_english: Even If You Slit My Mouth
synopsis:
Miroku is a slit-mouthed woman whose ear-to-ear smile strikes fear into the superstitious, but who would have thought she had a fiancé? Once an infamous urban legend, the self-proclaimed "Queen of Folklore" has found her existence threatened by the public's declining belief in her. She is also roped into a contractual marriage with 17-year-old Kouichi Sano, a member of a family responsible for the continued existence of the supernatural.

Miroku is unenthused by the arrangement and wishes to regain her notoriety through her own means. For this reason, Sano makes his fiancée a deal: if she can scare him once before he turns 18, he will end the engagement. Miroku concedes to these terms but is unsettled by Sano's proposed condition—where he must make her fall in love with him.

synopsis:

With adulthood, everything gets fuzzy and lines begin to blur, but still... some things stay crystal clear. Susie Kang is a modern woman of independent thought and deeply felt emotions, eternally single but with two women always on her mind. The best friend who might-have-been, and her first crush who she never told. Life is complicated... except when it isn't.

title: Hana yori Ookami

Riku Kirishima, a rough-looking high school student, is a lover of romantic comic books who takes care of his family in place of his late mother. He has a younger brother, who he cares for deeply. One evening, he is suddenly embraced by a man in the park who offers him $300 to spend the night. Riku runs away, but soon learns that the handsome pervert who approached him is actually the guardian of his brother's friend! Enjoy this love story between a handsome florist and a romantic high school tough guy!

(Source: Renta!)

The girls love his younger bandmate, Hibiki Shinjou, because he's a man of few words and is very aloof, but he normally delights in bugging Rui. Their manager thinks it's sweet, like Hibiki's a little kid... Since Hibiki has a hard time getting up in the mornings, he sleeps over at Rui's one night before an early photoshoot. While Rui is taking a bath, Hibiki does an internet search for their names... even though they've been warned against doing just that. They find a very suspicious-looking, password-protected website, and they can't believe what they see!! In these fan-created manga, the two of them get up to such naughty things...! Rui's imagination starts running wild, and Hibiki makes a suggestion...

(Source: Renta!)

As Hakaze's acts grow worse, Mizuki can't take it and blurts out, "how can we get you back to how you were before!?" In response, Hakaze says he'll show Mizuki how...by kissing him (!) and even jerking him off (!!) Konatsu, a woman of small stature working at a publishing company, has gotten her wish and been transferred to the sales section of the shoujo manga department. When she cheerfully enters the office, she collides with a tall, handsome man: Mr. Shishio, the section chief! He is strict about his work and looks scary at first glance, but he always helps Konatsu out in a pinch. This kindness is being bestowed as a boss... right...? Or perhaps... Too embarrassed to look her in the eye, he blurts out his feelings for her and pops the question. "Okay," a guy who is definitely not Jung-yun answers. Startled, Minkyu turns around to find Jung-hyun with an "h" blushing in front of him. Wait, wait, waaaait... Did he just ask out a dude? And did the dude just say yes? Does that mean he now has a 192 cm-tall, curtain-haired boyfriend? What the heck is going on?!

Amasawa, who works at a police box nearby, became a regular customer and asked Isumi for a recommended dinner every time they met. Youta's the manager of a high-end women's designer shoe store. One day, part-timer Chika gets forced to try on some sample heels, and Youta gets blown away by the most angelic pair of perfect, slender, and flawless legs he has ever seen. Youta keeps telling himself that Chika's a guy and it was just a momentary lapse of judgment, but when Chika tries them on again after hours, Youta gets so turned on that he loses control and starts licking Chika's legs...!! Despite considering herself unlovable, and despite feeling deeply satisfied with Sawako's companionship, Kurumi decides to put herself out there and try dating. Kouki Sena has always desired to understand the world his father saw through his camera's viewfinder. But after his father disappeared from his life too soon, the struggle of coming to terms with abandonment prevents Kouki from reaching his true potential as a photographer.

The one who has been with Kouki throughout these difficulties is his younger stepbrother Yuuri, who is affectionately close to him. While Kouki suppresses his emotions to fit in with his new stepfamily, Yuuri obsesses over him to the point of intense jealousy.

Afraid of facing his future and feelings for Yuuri, Kouki begins to distance himself from everyone. To make matters worse, an unexpected visitor arrives, further complicating his situation. As he works through this hurdle, Kouki must find the courage to stop running away and decide what is important to him.

Twenty-four-year-old Mitsuki is a proper yet cute company worker who has dated plenty of guys. However, when her boyfriends pat her on the head, caress her cheeks, and say heart-racing lines, she ends up shuddering at these heart-pounding actions instead...!

Unable to enjoy the "ordinary happinesses of women" and unable to date anyone for long, Mitsuki has reached the age of 24... "This next relationship will be the end of that!" Declaring as much, Mitsuki started going out with her current boyfriend, the handsome 28-year-old elite company worker Shinomiya.

He has grown up with his eccentric father—or rather, Haruka has grown up supporting his eccentric father and his spontaneous endeavors, his most recent surprise in store being marriage to a man with three kids of his own, all similar in age to Haruka. Initially expecting the worst, Shizuku finds herself in tears of joy when Kaori tells her the novel deeply moved her. Kaori wishes to read more of her stories, but as Shizuku did not plan on writing anything else, she has no idea what to write. As a result, Kaori comes up with a bizarre suggestion—their love.

title: Grass
synopsis:
Grass is a powerful antiwar graphic novel, telling the life story of a Korean girl named Okseon Lee who was forced into sexual slavery for the Japanese Imperial Army during the Second World War—a disputed chapter in twentieth-century Asian history.

Beginning in Lee's childhood, Grass shows the lead-up to the war from a child's vulnerable perspective, detailing how one person experienced the Japanese occupation and the widespread suffering it entailed for ordinary Koreans. Keum Suk Gendry-Kim emphasizes Lee's strength in overcoming the many forms of adversity she experienced. Grass is painted in a black ink that flows with lavish details of the beautiful fields and farmland of Korea and uses heavy brushwork on the somber interiors of Lee's memories.

The cartoonist Gendry-Kim's interviews with Lee become an integral part of Grass, forming the heart and architecture of this powerful nonfiction graphic novel and offering a holistic view of how Lee's wartime suffering changed her. Grass i

However, she chooses to be indifferent toward the attention she receives and spends her days normally—that is, until the school's other prince, Kohaku Ichimura, waltzes into her life and calls her beautiful.

Kohaku is nothing like a prince—he acts thoughtlessly and does as he pleases. But when he compliments her, Yoi feels flustered, and the way he looks at her gets her all nervous. He is the first boy to acknowledge her as a girl, and her attempts to distance herself prove futile as he seems to have set his sights on her. Every time he tries to look at her, she quickly turns her head so that he can only see her side profile.

Despite what her actions may entail, Sachi also shares Arata's sentiment. But one thing prevents her from doing so: her feelings for him cause her to be too embarrassed to show her face! synopsis:
What links together two bands of worshippers, one deep in the Arctic snows, one hidden in the bayous of Louisiana, is more than their shared practice of blood sacrifice.

It is the inhuman phrase they both chant: Ph'nglui mglw'nafh Cthulhu R'lyeh wgah'nagl fhtagn—"In his house at R'lyeh dead Cthulhu waits dreaming." Now these nightmares will disturb the sanity of Francis Thurston, a young man pursuing an investigation into the cult of Cthulhu that leads to the most forsaken spot in the vast Pacific...and to Earth's supreme terror, the risen corpse-city of R'lyeh.

First published in 1928, The Call of Cthulhu, rendered in chilling detail by modern manga horror master Gou Tanabe, is the most famous of all of H.P. Lovecraft's stories, and was the namesake of the acclaimed role-playing game system set within the Cthulhu Mythos.

Luckily, he meets friends along the way who can help him get by—but how will they react when they find out about Percival's destiny... and how it's connected to the end of the world?
