title_japanese: ご注文は溺愛ラブレッスンで～処女OL、初恋とえっちのはじめ方～

title: Yatoinushi to, Shitemo Ii desu ka?: Babysitter Yamada-san no Junan
title_japanese: 雇い主と、シてもいいですか?～ベビーシッター山田さんの受難～

title: Kimi wa Shinenai Haikaburi no Majo
title_english: You Are the Cindery Witch That Will Not Die.
title_japanese: 君は死ねない灰かぶりの魔女
synopsis:
I'm a magic apprentice. "My master," who has been living under this same run-down roof with me, is a shut-in girl who proclaimed herself to be a great witch. Despite sounding all high-and-mighty, my defenseless master loves to watch her disciple cooking for her. Our daily lives, filled with happiness, go by quietly. However, little did I know that behind that quiet, happy daily life is a terrible secret that involves the fate of the world... 

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Meiou-sama ga Tooru no desu yo!
title_japanese: 冥王様が通るのですよ!
synopsis:
Osamu is a young man who died at a young age due to an incurable illness. His second life was to drift as a spirit (demon) in an unknown world! Osamu, who is hated by humans and unreasonably deprived of his "life," does not want to die anymore. At that time, he gained the power of "life-sucking" that feeds on the vitality of others. In addition, he will resist the approaching death by using the science that he learned in his previous life and the creation magic that makes the best use of his own dexterity.

One day, he met an immortal girl was also in despair.

"—You tried to kill me. You guys are bad." In order to live, the pair leans into the evil side.

An anti-heroic fantasy where a ghost who wants to live and a girl who can't die conflict with the world!

(Source: TO Books, translated)

title: Oshi ga Kounin Stalker ni Narimashita
title_japanese: 推しが公認ストーカーになりました
synopsis:
Romantic comedy between a popular idol and an idol otaku!

Rooting for the super popular idol Moco Nanami is the reason for living for 17-year-old idol otaku Sora Amano. Lately, he's been worried because his belongings have been going missing. In the middle of this, Sora pursued and caught a suspicious person that was running away with his smartphone, but the identity of this person is his favorite idol Moco Nanami!?!!?

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Dead End Loop
synopsis:
Watching his little sister attacking and killing someone was a shock but the surprise was bigger when the corpse disappeared together with the feet of his little sister! What is happening? What are the "replacements" and why, when his sister dies, he goes "back" to the fateful night when everything begun? How can he escape this dead-end loop?

(Source: MU)

title: Henkyougurashi no Maou, Tensei shite Saikyou no Majutsushi ni Naru
title_japanese: 辺境ぐらしの魔王、転生して最強の魔術師になる
synopsis:
There was a mage called "The Lone Demon King" at the frontier. He was just a creature that never grew old, but he was loved by the villagers as something of a guardian deity. However, he was destroyed by a magic organization that sees his existence as dangerous. 200 years later, he is reincarnated as the second son of an aristocrat and obtains the strongest magic power. 

"Let's pretend to be a human this time..."

However, being a human lover, he didn't particularly think of revenge and has decided to pretend to be human in this life. In his past life, he was the guardian deity of a region, and in this life, he's a local aristocrat, but he does not know common sense. He doesn't know how to take it easy. As the second son of an aristocrat, he is loved by his family and friends, and while he is regarded as a master of magic in the magic guild, he becomes an "Immortal Mage" behind the scenes.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Sword Art Online: Alicization Lycoris
title_japanese: ソードアート・オンライン アリシゼーション リコリス
synopsis:
While on their way to Zakkaria from Rulid Village, Eugeo and Kirito encounter a noble girl named Medina battling monsters on the highway. Medina Orthinanos is a noble whose family was banished to the borderlands due to being considered defects by the empress of Norlangarth. Having lost her father in an accident, Medina seeks to become an Integrity Knight to clear her family's besmirched name. Little did she know that the two boys she encountered on the road to Zakkaria shared her goal of becoming Integrity Knights but would one day go up against the Axiom Church and kill the supreme ruler of the church...

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Seijo no Hazu ga, Douyara Nottoraremashita
title_english: I Was Summoned to Be a Saint, but Was Robbed of the Position
title_japanese: 聖女のはずが、どうやら乗っ取られました
synopsis:
Anise suddenly gets a message on her phone one day asking whether she'd be willing to lend her their aid. As if responding to her thoughts, it chooses for her and she finds herself suddenly summoned into the world of an otome game. While Anise is dumbfounded at her situation, Hime, the girl who is summoned with her declares, "I'm the Saintess!" As a result, Anise is treated as useless and driven out.

If things were to continue to go on like this, then the general of the neighboring country will die. Hime, as the saint, will take over, and a tragic ending will be met. To avoid that and take her life into her own hands, Anise resolves to save the general, change the scenario, and just settle down somewhere. That was what she planned, however...

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Murder Lock: Satsujinki no Kyoushitsu
title_english: Murder Lock: School of the Killing
title_japanese: マーダーロック-殺人鬼の凶室-
synopsis:
Koutarou Kudou was known as the "Streets' Strongest." Once, 13 thugs, thirsty for revenge, kidnapped his younger sister Hinami. Kotaro beat everyone, and on the same night, he was arrested on suspicion of murder, as each of them was later found dead. He is then forcefully enrolled to a certain school, in which all students must meet "a special criteria" to enter...

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Choujin X
synopsis:
Second-year high school student Tokio Kurohara likes to slack off in class. However, despite his attitude at school, he works alongside his childhood friend Azuma Higashi to combat the brewing injustice in their town. In contrast to Tokio, Azuma is physically capable and rarely struggles against the common thugs the pair regularly encounter.

Yet, there are fights that even Azuma will not pick. Choujins—supernatural beings with powers beyond mere mortals—are entities that Tokio and Azuma avoid at all costs. One day, when a previously defeated thug returns to exact revenge, the two are forced into a scuffle. Unable to flee from their foe, the duo injects themselves with a drug that can turn someone into a Choujin.

While the dose seemingly has no physical effect on Azuma, Tokio grows a beak. In fear of being seen, Tokio must now figure out how to hide his new identity as a Choujin. But it seems that there are people out there who are angry at Tokio and Azuma's use of the Choujin drug, a

title: Anjou-san no Gakkou no Hokenshitsu no Komaki-sensei
title_japanese: 安城さんの学校の保健室の小牧先生
synopsis:
Seto is a completely ordinary and somewhat boring high school student. Yet, for whatever reason, his errant gyaru classmate Anjou just won't leave him alone! But this spinoff series isn’t really about them—it's more about Komaki-sensei, the school's resident nurse/therapist, as she deals with students and their troubles.

(Source: MU)

title: Yoake no Joshou
synopsis:
A collection of connected short stories.

1-2. Sangakki wa Tanin no Migite (Third Term, Someone Else's Right Hand)
3-4. Sayonara Tooku no Migite (Farewell, Faraway Right Hand)
5-6. Yoake no Joshou (Daylight Prologue)
7. Yoake no Shuushou (Daylight Epilogue)

title: Yome wa Hakoiri Musuko
title_english: The Bride Is a Well Brought up Boy
synopsis:
Having lived as the second son of a temple, worshiped as a deity, and being a sheltered boy capable of transforming into a snake, Sei finally decides he's had enough of this life, and sets out to run away from home! Not being used to human society, Sei gets worn out and escapes to a grassy field where he meets and is helped by Murasaki, the reptile enthusiast college student. As the sheltered boy who longed to be "normal," Sei takes this chance to befriend the unfriendly and hard-to-read Murasaki, but their cohabitation life is riddled with misunderstandings...?! The two experience their first love together in a hot and cute love comedy!

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

Included one-shots: Shitsuke ga Nattenai! Tokubetsu-hen

title: Rockabye Dear
synopsis:
Rui is an adopted child who is a top student, while Yahiro is a rich kid who lives alone. They are childhood friends with a relationship that goes beyond the boundaries.

Rui is very thankful to his adoptive parents, so he tries to be the perfect son. But after a big change in his family, what will happen to his relationship with Yahiro?

title: Backstage de Aimashou
title_japanese: バックステージであいましょう
synopsis:
Shuuma Takatsu is a young rookie actor quickly rising in popularity. After a night of drinking, he wakes up one morning to a naked man next to him with no memory of what had happened?! That naked man turned out to be the talented actor, Motoi Shiozawa! To make things worse, now he's going to be Shuuma's new co-star!

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

Included one-shot: Ore no Sensei

title: Boku no Ω yo Samenaide
synopsis:
Ao, born as a rare Omega with only 10% Omega traits rather than a normal 100% Omega, was thought to be a Beta in the public as his slight heat would disappear during his estrus periods by taking light heat suppressants. He vowed to live his life out as it is without being bound and controlled by an Alpha, but one day, Ao experienced a lot of change in his life after he helped a crouching man on the street, who was Reiji, a freeloader Alpha...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: My Sweet Home
synopsis:
Yuu has fond memories of his childhood at his grandpa's house and playing games with his step-cousin Hatahiko. So when Yuu arrives in Tokyo to attend university, he is beyond excited to see him again after all these years. But Grandpa back in Akita warns Yuu that "Hatahiko's changed a lot since moving to Tokyo." Perplexed, Yuu can't imagine a Hatahiko that isn't kind and gentle like he used to be. Do his grandpa's words have something to do with why Hatahiko doesn't visit home anymore?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Game-ya Bucchake Life
title_japanese: ゲーム屋BL〈ぶっちゃけライフ〉
synopsis:
I, Anan Naoyoshi, joined Last Boss Korin, Co. in pursuit of Nobu-san, the game planner I've long admired. Things, however, are sour between us. Our strained relationship aside, the two of us went on an overseas business trip. But then whyyyyy are we on a desert island?! And as if that wasn't bad enough, he now tells me we're stuck in a game of his own creation. Wait—we're in a whaaaaat?!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Ore no Aoharu wa Watasanai
title_japanese: 俺のアオハルは渡さない
synopsis:
The cool prince of the school's popular circle, Subaru, is actually a pure boy and a huge nerd for shoujo manga! Using shoujo mangas as his bible, he is constantly working towards becoming the ideal protagonist. One day, his old friend Jinnai, the only one that knows his true nature, transfers into his class! "I won't let you interfere with my plans for my ideal youth!" Yet, for some reason, his heart always pounds like the heroines of his favorite books when it comes to Jinnai!

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

title: Yokoshima Innocent Days
title_japanese: よこしまイノセントデイズ
synopsis:
"I have to protect him."

Yuki is overprotective of his friend Natsuki, who remains childlike even as his body grows. Will Natsuki, who follows Yuki around like a dog, finally be able to become independent...?!

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

title: Omae ni Dakareru nante Kiitenai!: Hamatta Otoko wa AV Danyuu
title_english: I Didn't Ask You to Make Love to Me! The Man I'm Obsessed with Is a Male Porn Star
title_japanese: お前に抱かれるなんて聞いてない! ～ハマった男はAV男優
synopsis:
He's your average office worker yet, watching crossdressing porn while masturbating to the point of dry orgasm has become a daily routine for Natori. One day, after learning that Seo, whom he had run into at a class reunion, works in the porn industry, Natori asks Seo to introduce him to a girl who'll be understanding of him exploring anal. However, the one who steps into the private room is none other than Seo himself!! "Just how much have you jerked off to porn of me?" A mildly sadistic, popular male porn star meets an anally trained, straight salary man. Is this a match made in heaven...!?

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title: Yoru to Futari
synopsis:
Mitsuru came to live in a remote village where, legend has it, "vampires live." He started living in the villa his late grandfather left behind when one day, he met Naoji, who claimed to be an acquaintance of his grandfather. Since Naoji's face was his type, Mitsuru just wanted a taste, but a half asleep Naoji kissed him instead!? In the end, Mitsuru becomes friends with Naoji but...??

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

title: Oretachi wa Shinkon-san kamo Shirenai
title_japanese: 俺達は新婚さんかもしれない
synopsis:
Nasukawa, a pragmatic graduate student in science, and Kaburagi, an elite office employee, are university colleagues and very good friends. They've been living together to save money, but are told by their landlord, that two male friends are prohibited from sharing a room, so the two get married as camouflage. Nasukawa notices that ever since their marriage, his heart is throbbing for Kaburagi, who's supposed to be just his friend. Meanwhile, when Nasukawa's bed breaks and ends up sleeping with Kaburagi in his bed, Kaburagi makes a move. A mildly intense physical intimacy between two adults. When Nasukawa's body inadvertently reacts, and he's trying to calm himself down, Kaburagi suggests, "practical mutual masturbation" and...!? A heart throbbing and steamy story of a twisted newlyweds' life between a thoughtful elite office worker, and a kind and laid-back graduate student.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Sore wo Koi to Yobazu ni Nanto Iu
title_english: What to Say Without Calling It Love
title_japanese: それを恋と呼ばずになんと言う
synopsis:
Kouki had secretly loved Haru-nii, who used to live in the neighborhood when he was young. Five years later, despite Kouki making up his mind to move on, he unexpectedly gets reunited with Haru-nii as neighbors!

Although being invited to dinner or accidentally meeting outside gave him joy, Kouki couldn't help but feel dejected every time Haru-nii treated him like his younger brother. On top of that, the more they spent time together, his supposedly forgotten feelings bubble up even more!

(Source: Kasakura Shuppansha, translated)

title: Sukebe no Seishun
synopsis:
Mitamura, who is a virgin, has a personal view about "lewd." He also realizes a friend in the same class, Hayami,  never takes off his clothes in public. A person who is good looking and excels in studies and sports, just like the male lead from a shoujo manga, why doesn't he take off his clothes? What in the world is Hayami hiding...? And why am I getting excited about it...? His hands move with confusion and desire, making a lewd (erotic) photo of Hayami. However, Hayami's secret has been found out?

(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)

Included one-shot: Sukebe no Seishun (pilot)

title: Nakittsura ni Hug
synopsis:
Masaki Fuwa suffers from an extreme shyness that forces him to keep an unnecessary distance away from people. He has always wanted to change himself, but never knew what to do. One day, Masaki bumps into Takeru Miyatsuka, a medical student who picks up his cell phone. For some reason, he decides to train Masaki to overcome his illness!

(Source: Kasakura Shuppansha, translated)

title: Koisuru Ryuu no Shima
title_english: The Island of Dragons in Love
synopsis:
After graduating high school, Nijino takes up part-time work to cover his little sister's medical bills—until the day his "destiny" arrives in the form of Byakuya, a white-haired, imposing man who is supposedly an ancient legendary dragon. Soon enough, the dragon rips off his clothes and gives him a mind-blowing experience... and a lucrative one, at that. In exchange for money, Nijino gives up his freedom to Byakuya, though his doubts about their arrangement grow. But, he can't deny that sleeping with Byakuya gives him a thrill. It's as if Byakuya only has eyes for him... What is this feeling...!?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Yume nara Doko made Yurusaremasu ka?
title_english: How Far Is My Dream Allowed?
title_japanese: 夢ならどこまで許されますか?
synopsis:
"I've killed someone, please arrest me!"

...is what he said as he rushed into the police station, but it was all just a dream. 27-year-old Kaga Mitsuki has just done something unspeakably embarrassing. Later, Kaga goes to the police station to apologize and is greeted by Seto Kenya, a young police officer who is kind and has great taste. Moreover, Seto tells Kaga, "If you have another nightmare and feel anxious, please come see me!" and they become closer and closer friends... At this rate, Kaga won't be able to resist falling for Seto! From then on, Kaga's nightmares turn into erotic dreams of Seto... An erotic and heart-wrenching romantic comedy BL featuring a young, dog-like police officer and a corporate slave!

(Source: Sankosha, translated)

title: Boku to Kanojo no Meguru Isekai
title_japanese: 僕と彼女の転生〈めぐ〉る異世界

title: Akai Ringo
synopsis:
Japan in the Reiwa XX era, where sexual activity is illegal. Inuta Hikaru, an honor student whose father is the director of the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare's Sexual Enforcement Division, witnesses something shocking at a club he visits for the first time with her friend. There are a lot of people who enjoy sex with a great deal of alcohol and music! And among them is Inuta's favorite idol, Misora. In front of this unusual sight, an impulse that he's never felt runs around Inuta's body.

(Source: MU)

title: Koutsuu Jiko Kanteinin Tamaki Rinichirou
title_japanese: 交通事故鑑定人 環倫一郎

title: Tonari no Helvetica: Manga de Wakaru Oubun Font no Sekai
title_english: What the Font?! – A Manga Guide to Western Typeface
title_japanese: となりのヘルベチカ マンガでわかる欧文フォントの世界
synopsis:
When the designer in a small production company disappears, Marusu is forced to take over the job of creating logos. Unfortunately, Marusu is a sales rep who doesn't know the first thing about fonts. Luckily, Helvetica, the personification of that font, appears to guide Marusu into the world of typeface and design. Learn about typography in this fun manga story with anthropomorphic fonts as your guide!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Onna no Sono no Hoshi
synopsis:
Hoshi-sensei, a Japanese language teacher at an all-girls school, is at the mercy of his students and colleagues. Students challenge him to their shiritori word games illustrated in their daily notes, convince him to bring a dog into the classroom, and seek his advice on becoming a manga artist, while colleagues drag him along on their rounds to the pub. Matter-of-fact interactions between a cast of unique characters make for an offbeat comedy.

(Source: Japan Media Arts Festival, edited)

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Shuumatsu no Koe
synopsis:
Rei Ametani lives his life day by day waiting for the sweet embrace of a merciful death. Although a former childhood trumpet genius, he now sleeps through classes—a much more ordinary lifestyle than his former one. This peace is suddenly interrupted, though, by a note found in his shoe locker. Believing it to be a fake love confession, he humors the sender by showing up at the appointed meeting spot. To his surprise, Sora Kamizono shows up with an unusual plea: she needs his help to destroy the world.

Kamizono is the first of seven angels from the Book of Revelations who has been sent down to Earth by God to sound the trumpets that will bring ruin to the world. The only issue is that she has no idea how to play the instrument. And so, Kamizono needs Ametani to teach her before the week is over. Eager to bring about a swift end to his life, Ametani agrees to help Kamizono during the remaining seven days. However, Ametani's and Kamizono's pasts flow to the surface, causing their resolve

title: Sex Friend
synopsis:
Shougo, a man who's fast, accurate, and talented at work, and Leo, a popular radio DJ.  The two have a fuck-buddy relationship that skips all the annoying stuff. They're only supposed to be interested in each other's bodies, but, bit by bit, their hearts grow closer!? A mix-up love comedy about two people who cannot say they love each other.

(Source: Shounen Gahousha, translated)

title: -50kg no Cinderella
synopsis:
Hime, a chubby girl, is a university student who is currently looking for a job. At a company briefing, she gets injured and is helped by an employee from the information desk, Osamu. With Osamu looking like a prince, Hime falls in love at first sight. Wanting to see him again, Hime went on a diet and successfully lost 50 kilograms. She eventually gets employed at the same company as Osamu, but after an entire year, she has yet to meet him again. One day, the most handsome guy at the company, rumoured to be the son of the CEO, transfers to Hime's department. As it turns out, that man was Osamu! However, Hime's happiness at their reunion is short-lived after Osamu confesses that there is a woman he is interested in. However, for some reason, he keeps hugging her, whispers sweet words to her, and treats her differently. Will Hime remain at the mercy of this unexpected doting...!?

(Source: Starts Shuppan, translated)

title: Mezametara Saikyou Soubi to Uchuusenmochi Datta node, Ikkodate Mezashite Youhei toshite Jiyuu ni Ikitai
title_english: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!

synopsis:
Sato Takahiro was an ordinary office worker and hobbyist gamer until the day he woke up on a spaceship–one that strangely resembled a craft from a favorite space-shooter game. With a decked-out ship, a crew full of babes, and a fantastic universe to explore, he's going to make the most of his good luck and create the life he's always dreamed of!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

In the Burquat-koku series:

2. Sheikh to Musubu Hatsukoi (The Call of the Desert)

title: Kamen Byoutou
synopsis:
Shuugo Hayami is a doctor at a nursing hospital, which was once a psychiatric hospital. One evening, when he was on night duty, a man in a clown mask breaks into the hospital, and he is not alone. He is with Hitomi Kawasaki, a university student who has been shot by the masked man. The masked man tells Shuugo to treat Hitomi, and also takes the 64 people in the hospital hostage. Soon, Shuugo and Hitomi try to escape from the hospital, and they encounter mysterious cases one at a time.

(Source: AsianWiki, edited)

synopsis:
Included one-shots:
Volume 1: Ouji-sama de Gomennasai.
Volume 2: Arigato ne.
Volume 6: Hatsukoi Debut shimasu!

title: Genkaigoe no Skill wa, Tenseisha ni shika Atsukaenai: Over Limit Skill Holder
title_japanese: 限界超えの天賦〈スキル〉は、転生者にしか扱えない　―オーバーリミット・スキルホルダー―
synopsis:
In a world where everyone has eight skill slots, people can put skills like “Strengthen arm ★” and “Fire Magic★★” from skill orbs, abilities that prove extremely useful for survival. The total number of stars in the skills cannot exceed the number of slots.

Reiji works as a slave mining skill orbs. Along with his precious older sister, Lark, they work gruelingly in the mines until a rebellion occurs at the mine, and Reiji gets his hands on a ten-star, a so-called “overlimit” skill, called “World Ruler.”

From a powerless slave to having an ability that surpasses human limits, Reiji gains unfathomable power but is separated by Lark in the chaos of the revolt.

(Source: MU, edited)

title: Assault Lily: League of Gardens - Full Bloom
title_japanese: アサルトリリィ League of Gardens -full bloom-
synopsis:
In the near future, humanity is on the verge of destruction with the advent of mysterious creatures called "Huge". Young women called "Lilies" continue to fight to salvage what's left, using advanced weapons called "CHARMs". Gardens, Lily training institutions, were established all over the world, becoming bases of resistance against the Huge. Riri Hitotsuyanagi, a new student at Yurigaoka Girls Academy, one of the many gardens in the Tokyo area, formed Team Hitotsuyanagi with her newfound friends and traveled with them to Tokyo for a special mission. The fates of Yurigaoka Girls Academy, Ludovic Girls Academy, Herensuge Girls Academy, Kanba Girls School of Arts, Odaiba Girls School, and Sagami Women's High School begin to intersect...

(Source: assaultlily-pj.com, translated)

title: Ookami to Koushinryou: Ookami to Komugikou no Kunen
title_english: Wolf & The Sweet Scent of Baking Bread
title_japanese: 狼と香辛料 狼と小麦香の薫煙
synopsis: A special 14-page chapter included in the official art book.

title: 45-sai, Ojisama wa Bukiyou na Kemono.
title_english: The 45-Year-Old Gentleman Is a Tactless Beast: Tonight, Teach Me How It's Supposed to Be Done...
synopsis:
On the night Shihori Ogasawara finds out the coworker she had feelings for is engaged to another woman, she happens to bump into a customer she helped earlier that day! His receptive ear and comforting shoulder lead to a night of passion... Firm hands gently caressing her body, like handling a broken treasure, his warm features make Shihori's heart race as she gives in to the ecstasy... He returns to ask her a question before making his request... Will a 45-year-old gentleman and a heartbroken 27-year-old find romance in this love story with an age gap!?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Mazinger Z: Interval Peace
title_japanese: マジンガーZ インターバルピース
synopsis:
The manga takes place in a world where the use of Super Robots is questioned. Koji is a former pilot with his companions faced with both personal and outer conflicts. They were once heroes but peace was achieved, bringing their robot's use into question. Can this peace even last and can it even lead to true peace...?

(Source: Mazinger Wiki)

title: Soubi Seisaku-kei Cheat de Isekai wo Jiyuu ni Ikiteikimasu
title_english: Live Freely in Another World with an Equipment Manufacturing Cheat
title_japanese: 装備製作系チートで異世界を自由に生きていきます
synopsis:
There's the ordinary 29-year-old salesman named Touji Akino who, one day, is suddenly brought to another world. However, it turns out that he was a byproduct of a kingdom's hero summoning ritual and, since the people around him have better skills and levels than he does, he is quickly kicked out of the kingdom. However, he has a unique cheat skill that allows him to look at the status of any object he is touching. Using this power, he resolves to live a slow life and attain a harem of cute girls and mascot characters.

(Source: MU)

title: Motokano no Otouto ga Kawaii tte Hanashi
title_english: My Ex-Girlfriend's Little Brother Is So Cute
title_japanese: 元カノの弟が可愛いって話
synopsis:
After six years of dating, Takuya gets dumped by his childhood-best-friend-turned-girlfriend. Takuya has sunk to his lowest—and then a message comes in from Naoki, his ex-girlfriend's little brother. Naoki, who has grown into a stunning, long-haired young man, shocks Takuya with words that just might turn his world upside-down...

(Source: Houbunsha)

title: Futari de Papa Hajimemashita
title_japanese: 二人でパパはじめました
synopsis:
Before transferring to New York, Nogi Shinjiro confessed to his crush, Aoyama Yuki, and was rejected for not being gay. Nogi came back from overseas after 2 years and is surprised go see that Aoyama has a kid now. What happened while he was away?

(Source: MU)

title: Midara na Ω wa Koi wo Shinai
synopsis:
Nanao Sakushima is an omega who enrolls at a boarding school. To earn some money for buying medicine, he joins a circle that sells the members' bodies to elite alphas within the school. Soushi Ashiya , an alpha transfer student, bothers Nanao under pretense that he fell in love with him at first sight. Because Nanao thinks that alphas' goals are always sex in the end, he invites Soushi to do it once , but somehow he refuses instead. Isesaki, the circle's sponsor, witnesses that moment and punishes Nanao. Moreover, he even orders Nanao to invites Soushi using the mating period "heat"...! Soushi is agitated by the mating period succumbs to the lust... Even though he doesn't wish for it, his body can't stop yearning for that heat! "I thought I would never fall in love..." A love trap that tricks alpha-hater omega.

(Source: Amucomi, translated)

title: Aragane no Ko
synopsis:
A world where "stone" is at the center. Akaboshi, an ore craftsman visits an underground village and meets a boy whose left foot is petrified. The boy's goal is to find the man with a three-line piercing but he holds a secret...?! The two of them set off on a journey to save his family!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Isekai Hitokko Doubutsuen: Boku wa Zetsumetsu Kigushu no Shiikuin ni Narimashita
title_japanese: 異世界ひとっ娘動物園　僕は絶滅危惧種の飼育員になりました

title: Jinrui wo Metsubou sasete wa Ikemasen
title_japanese: 人類を滅亡させてはいけません
synopsis:
On his way home from work, 26-year-old salaryman Osamu Kawakita encounters an alien named Lilin. She and her species plan on invading the earth, but she ends up getting stranded on this planet. Can Osamu raise her to become a kind-hearted kid before her species eradicates humanity in five years?

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Kimetsu no Yaiba Gaiden
title_english: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - Stories of Water and Flame
synopsis:
1-2. Kimetsu no Yaiba: Tomioka Giyuu Gaiden
3-4. Kimetsu no Yaiba: Rengoku Kyoujurou Gaiden
5. Kimetsu no Aima!

title: Chicchai Kanojo Senpai to Dousei Shimasu.
title_japanese: ちっちゃい彼女先輩と同棲します。

title: Hentai Shinshi to Kisekae Danshou
title_english: A Pervert Gentleman and a Man Who Dresses Up
title_japanese: 変態紳士と着せ替え男娼

title: Days on Fes
title_japanese: デイズ・オン・フェス
synopsis:
Kanade Sora has never been to a music festival before. But when her friend Otoha lures her along with the promise that her favorite band will be playing, she finds herself having more fun than she ever imagined. And if one small show is enough to hook her, what might a huge overnight event at a major venue be like? As Kanade dives into a whole new world of rocking out, will her life ever be the same?!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Osananajimi wa Ichiransei no Kedamono
synopsis:
When I returned to my hometown, I reunited with my twin childhood friends. They used to be my secret first love, but even now I'm still a little excited by these two handsome boys. They invited me to their house and listened to my complaints while drinking, and suddenly...

"Which kiss do you like?"

"I'll love you."

"I want to make you feel good."

My childhood friends are doing some naughty things to me at the same time. Kissing and licking my chest and beneath... underneath... What is going on?!

(Source: Kasakura Shuppansha, translated)

title: Totsuzen Papa ni Natta Saikyou Dragon no Kosodate Nikki: Kawaii Musume, Honobono to Ningenkai Saikyou ni Sodatsu
title_english: Dragon Daddy Diaries: A Girl Grows to Greatness
title_japanese: 突然パパになった最強ドラゴンの子育て日記～かわいい娘、ほのぼのと人間界最強に育つ〜
synopsis:
An immensely powerful and ancient dragon, once worshipped as a god by humans but now only a myth in their eyes, wakes up one day to find a human girl poking around his lair. The infant is barely old enough to say her own name, but is quite confident in calling the dragon "Daddy"! Bewildered by the unexpected visitor, the dragon soon learns that returning her to human civilization isn't going to be an option...not yet, anyway. He quickly decides to raise the girl himself, determined to give her a happy life that will lead her back to human society when she is older—surely a simple task for a legendary being such as himself. All he needs to do now is find a place for her to sleep. And figure out where he is going to get clothes for her. And...wait, what do humans eat again?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: [Haishinchuu] Megami Channel! E, Kore Baimei desu no!?
title_japanese: 【配信中】女神チャンネル! え、これ売名ですの!?

title: Enmadou Sara no Suiri Kitan
title_japanese: 閻魔堂沙羅の推理奇譚

title: Saki-chan wa Inma no Ko (Gasshou)
title_japanese: 咲ちゃんは淫魔の子（合掌）
synopsis:
Succubus Saki-chan falls in love with, out of everyone, a monk's son, Rokuhara. Even though she tries her best to talk to him, her succubus blood starts rushing and unintentionally makes the situation rather... tempting. 'It wish I could just tell him that I like him, normally!' Where is this devilishly cute succubus's naughty love headed to...?! A full power love comedy about a pitiful succubus and a straight laced monk boy!

(Source: Flex Comix, translated)

title: Ojousama, Otona no Kiss no Ojikan desu.
title_english: It's Time for the Kiss, My Lady.
title_japanese: お嬢様、大人のキスのお時間です。
synopsis:
She has a fiance, but she has an unrequited love for her butler. And in order to get married and be an excellent wife, she has to get bridal training from her butler!? Her heart will pound from all kinds of love lessons soon! It's so stimulating, she might go crazy.

(Source: Chibi Manga)

Included one-shots:
Volume 1: Shinkon♡Shoya
Volume 2: Ouji-sama wa Midara ni Midareru.
Volume 5: Ano Hi, Kimi wa Aozora no Shita (Story: Tokunaga Satsuki)

Note: The second one-shot was collected in 17-sai, Hajimete: Hatsunetsu.

title: Kyuukyoku Shinka shita Full Dive RPG ga Genjitsu yori mo Kusoge Dattara
title_japanese: 究極進化したフルダイブRPGが現実よりもクソゲーだったら
synopsis:
In an unexpected turn of events, dull high school student Hiro Yuuki obtains the full dive role-playing game Kiwame Quest. Created by the best of technology, the game claims to take "reality to its extremes," from stunning graphics, NPCs' behavior, to the scent of vegetation, and even the sensation of wind brushing against the skin—everything was the result of an ultimate workmanship.

Except, the game is a little too realistic and messy to clear. Kiwame Quest features over ten quadrillion flags and reflects the players' real-life physical abilities in the game. Being hit in the game also hurts in real life and slash wounds take days to heal.

The only reward here is the sense of accomplishment. Conquer the most stressful game in history that can't be played casually!

(Source: MAL News)

title: Koisuru Ookami to Mille-Feuille
title_japanese: 恋する狼とミルフィーユ
synopsis:
Maaya Suou, A high school girl who was called "Wolf Girl" in the past, was living her usual everyday life. "I don't want to get involved in extraordinary events anymore..." Even though Maya decided that, she was suddenly dragged into a fight between a "Little Red Riding Hood" and a "Wolf." Maya smirked unconsciously. "I have a plan. I also have the means. Ending everything here despite that would be such a waste and I won't allow it." And so began this dark fairy tale as the wolf fell in love.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Dakishimetemo Ii yo
synopsis:
Unless they find a family that will love them, the stuffed animals in a certain shop keep growing until they're larger than life! Which is exactly what happened to the cute teddy bear Rio. He loves the boss and his friends who live in the store, though, so he hasn't been lonely. Then, one day, a new shopping mall calls up, looking to make Rio their mascot! Except... Rio would rather stay with his boss. In order to make this happen, he asks the owner (who happens to be a magician) to turn him into a human, but the magic doesn't last long! The two of them have to figure out how to make it last before the mall comes to pick him up if he's to stay that way...! This is a pure love story between a teddy bear-turned-boy who doesn't know what love is, and his hot-and-cold boss!

(Source: Renta!)

title: "Kawaii" wa Kimi no Mono
synopsis:
Noriyuki Tamaru, a short and adorable boy, is often teased by his classmates for being cute. Much to his dismay, they frequently force him to wear embarrassing things like bows and flower crowns. Tamaru has a crush on Morinaga: a tall and cool girl seen as a stone cold beauty and the idol of their class.

With the two seemingly being complete opposites, Tamaru cannot find any way to talk to her. One day, however, Tamaru finds Morinaga secretly trying on a bow, and he discovers just how adorable she truly is. Can keeping Morinaga's secret help Tamaru bond with his crush?

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Hoshokusha Kisumi-kun
synopsis:
Yasuharu has all that it takes to be very popular. His only fault is loving his childhood friend Yuma way too much. Every time Yuma says his pet phrase, "I wanna die," he replies smilingly, "I'll eat you, then," creeping his friend out. But, one day Yuma says something that triggers a change in their relationship...! A stolen kiss, a daring request, forced cohabitation... the exciting story of a possessive love!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Shinjuu suru made, Mattete ne
title_japanese: 心中するまで、待っててね

title: Dekiai Keiyaku
synopsis:
Masato, who has a mysterious skill (?!) of making men fall in love with him, ends up getting fired from his modeling job because of that very skill. When he's at his wit's end, he gets a job from Kuramoto, the capable heir of an apparel maker. However, one of the conditions is to be his lover by contract?! Drastic love between a super darling heir and a complicated model!

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

title: #DRCL Midnight Children
synopsis: Based on Bram Stoker's "Dracula," a gothic horror story at the end of the 19th century.

title: Papa's Cooking! Chichi to Yobeta Hi
synopsis:
When he notices that his stepson Hikota is hungry, Mitsuro seizes the opportunity to prepare him a meal. Hoping Hikota will finally call him "papa," the middle-aged man gives it his all in the kitchen, but his questionable dish choices confuse the young boy. Still, Hikota gives them a try and begins to learn that food—and people—should not be judged by their looks.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: December Rain
synopsis:
Fresh out of the army, Suchae decides to take some time off and travel around the country by himself. On the first day of his trip, he spots a guy who looks totally his type at a rundown bus terminal. The only problem is, it's the same guy who was jerking off in the bathroom 5 minutes ago. Despite the possibility of him being a creep, however, Suchae is drawn to the mysterious stranger. He finds everything about him...arousing. Who is this stranger? And why is he on the road?

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Yakusoku no Neverland: Tokubetsu Bangai-hen - Jijyuu no Sora wo Motomete
title_english: The Promised Neverland: Special Side Story - Seeking the Sky of Freedom
title_japanese: 約束のネバーランド 特別番外編 自由の空を求めて
synopsis: A one-shot focusing on Sister Krone.

title: Uchuu Sensou
synopsis: An adaptation of the H.G. Wells novel.

title: Kajiya de Hajimeru Isekai Slow Life
title_english: My Quiet Blacksmith Life in Another World
title_japanese: 鍛冶屋ではじめる異世界スローライフ
synopsis:
Eizo is a middle-aged, overworked software engineer who loves cats. One night after working late, he saves an injured cat from a speeding truck. The cat survives, but Eizo does not... Luckily, that cat turns out to be a god-like being who offers him a second chance in another world! Eizo decides that he wants a slower life, one where he can live off the things he creates with his own hands. So, why not become a blacksmith? He does have one other stipulation: a cat companion for his quiet life. These requests are granted, and Eizo is whisked away to a new world and imbued with blacksmithing knowledge. He soon finds out that his abilities are above average—in fact, his new skills are so overpowered that they're like cheats. On top of that, his cat companion turns out to be a half-tiger girl! Eizo's blades soon garner attention, and he realizes that he can turn the tides of battle with his forge and hammer. With so much commotion in store, will Eizo truly be able to enjoy a quiet life?

title: Kajiya de Hajimeru Isekai Slow Life
title_english: My Quiet Blacksmith Life in Another World
title_japanese: 鍛冶屋ではじめる異世界スローライフ
synopsis:
Eizo Tanya is a middle-aged, very burned-out, software engineer. One night after working late, he throws himself in front of a speeding truck to save a cat. Although the cat survives, Eizo is not so lucky. In a spark of divine fate, the cat turns out to be a godlike being who offers him a second chance in another world! Should he be a legendary warrior? A noble king? Nope! All Eizo wants is a peaceful life making things for others, and what better way to do that than becoming a blacksmith? He does have one other wish: to live alongside a cute cat. His requests are granted but with a twist—Eizo's blacksmithing skills are so overpowered that they're practically cheat abilities. On top of that, the cat companion he wished for turns out to be a half-tiger girl! With so much commotion in this world, will Eizo be able to forge a quiet new life?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Love Score
synopsis:
All answers to romantic troubles are but a click away with the mobile application, Wiss. Utilizing the personal information given by its users, Wiss can simulate romantic relationships and provide scores indicating a couple’s potential compatibility. Curious about the application’s growing popularity, Yuuji Kawasaki decides to test his affinity with his college underclassman, Chise Amamiya. When confronted with the scores, he soon realizes that the results may be more accurate than he could have ever imagined.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Konna Watashi ni Kitai Shinaide
title_japanese: こんな私に期待しないデ
synopsis:
When anyone walks by Elicia, they immediately notice that she is a cool and beautiful girl with a piercing glare. However, she is not the ice queen that everyone make her up to be. In fact, she is only creating this persona to not disappoint everyone's perception of her. Wanting to protect her image, Elicia will have to make every effort to hide her unexpected side from others.

[Written by Phloup]

title: Tosca no Inu
synopsis:
The Kuroda clans and Kirigaya clans are rival yakuza gangs that control parts of the Kanto region. A certain incident leads to a volatile situation between the two groups. Tomoya Nishina, the second in command of the Kirigaya clan, who wants to avoid the conflict at all costs, makes a proposition to Touji Kuroda. The price is his own body. In order to keep his mouth shut, Nishina offers his body to Touji as if to seduce him, but... In the world of men with moral code, tactics and pleasure intersect!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Zutto Otokonoko dato Omotteita Gaki Taishou ga Onnanoko deshita
title_japanese: ずっと男の子だと思っていたガキ大将が女の子でした

title: Lisa no Taberarenai Shokutaku
title_japanese: リサの食べられない食卓
synopsis:
"I can't eat anything but delicious food. It must taste delicious." Young Lady Lisa is working hard, doing her best making delicious meals. And so, the Young Lady serves her dishes with great confidence. Those who taste her cooking, however, say it's... "terrible?!" It tastes bad, much to her dismay! Lisa doesn't actually try her own cooking. Rather, she doesn't even eat the food she makes...?! But one day, after she meets a boy who's fallen on the side of the road, she finally gets serious! Many characters, each with their own distinct circumstances, provide their unique flavor to this unusual cooking tale.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Party kara Tsuihou sareta Sono Chiyushi, Jitsu wa Saikyou ni Tsuki
title_english: The Healer Who Was Banished From His Party, Is, in Fact, the Strongest
title_japanese: パーティーから追放されたその治癒師、実は最強につき
synopsis:
A healer gets booted from his party because the leader notices he isn't really contributing much to the team. Soon enough, the healer must look for new members to party with. After finding a cute martial artist to work together with, he reveals his secret: while he's a fairly mediocre healer, he actually fights well in close combat. This is the story of a support who's secretly a DPS, and where the entire conflict stems from the fact that he never told his old party he was a DPS.

(Source: MU)

title: Neko ga OL ni Miete Komarimasu
title_japanese: ネコがOLに見えて困ります

title: Ojou to Nanahiki no Inu
synopsis:
This story takes place in a world where humans and beastmen coexist. Our protagonist, a dog beastman, was a former gangster who's fallen on hard times, living on the streets and scraping by on what he can get. On one particular rainy day, he tries to fall asleep in an alley before being found by an eccentric "Yamato Nadesico" type of girl. She offers him a home to sleep in, in exchange for him becoming her bodyguard. He doesn't think much of it until he sees her home and it's explained to him by the servants in it that she's the daughter of a Yakuza boss and has a sadistic personality. On top of all that, almost all her servants are beastmen as well!

(Source: MU)

title: Mimasaka-kun to Mayoeru Kobuta
title_japanese: 美作くんと迷える子豚
synopsis:
Satou-kun, with his fluffy body and heart, spends his days in peace. One day, while being surrounded by tough-looking guys, he was rescued by a fiercer-looking gentleman...?!

(Source: MU)

title: Yours to Claim
synopsis:
Nothing crazy ever happens to Jooin. He's just your average college student, keeping his head down and flying under the radar. Yahwi, on the other hand, is drop dead gorgeous, super popular...but also kinda mean. So why has the campus heartthrob taken an interest in a total nobody? There must be an ulterior motive...but it's hard to care when faced with those killer looks. Will Jooin become a slave to his desires? Or perhaps he'll become the master himself...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Osananajimi no Kao ga Yosugite Sakaraenai
title_japanese: 幼なじみの顔が良すぎて逆らえない
synopsis:
Akane, a high school student who loves pretty faces and is an idol otaku, is being pressed by his handsome childhood friend, Harumi. "Wake me up," "Kiss me," "Stay here." Akane can't resist when he's begging, but he's too thick-headed to notice Harumi's affection for him. They are in a state of "Are they not dating yet?" because they've been really close to each other since they were young. But at one point, Harumi gets serious and approaches Akane...?!

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Sekai Saikyou no Shinjuutsukai
synopsis:
Magu was gifted the skill "Decoy," a skill capable of attracting monsters and causing disasters. As such, he was banished from the city. Therefore, he decided to live alone in a hunting cabin deep in the mountains. However, there, he draws the attention of Divine Beasts: Loa the Dragon (a beautiful girl), Fiana the Phoenix (another beautiful girl), and Kelpie the Maera (another beautiful girl). In the end, Magu decides to spend an easygoing life in the mountains with the Divine Beasts. But the "Decoy" skill is not making it easy for him...

(Source: Sankosha, translated)

title: Mitsugetsukon
synopsis:
Misuzu and Seiji are a newlywed couple with a 14-year age difference. Misuzu is overjoyed to be married... to her childhood love! But even so, they haven't done more than kiss. They've never slept together! Misuzu enjoys being kissed and touched, but what's wrong with expecting a little more? Rather than touching herself, she longs for Sei to love her with his fingers and tongue. Could this be the beginning of a sweet and naughty honeymoon for both of them?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Baker Baker Paradox
title_japanese: ベイカーベイカーパラドクス

title: Romance 101
synopsis:
University student Jung Bareum always has her days planned. She lives her life to its fullest efficiency and carries out her aims without fail. But while her rigid lifestyle pays off, she lacks one thing: romance! When asked about relationships, Bareum uses her busy schedule as an excuse. However, once Shin Jaehyun, her handsome schoolmate, enters her life, Bareum has a chance to get on track with dating.

Bareum joins Jaehyun's small programming club spontaneously in hopes of seeing him more frequently. However, her path to achieving love is not all moonlight and roses. She crosses paths with Na Yuyeon, a fellow club member who likes online games and tends to be late to class. Just by comparing their ways of living, Bareum believes the two will not find any compatibility. But despite being polar opposites, there may lie something special underneath. How can Bareum juggle her schedule, romance, and annoyances?

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Governess Nazuna-san
title_japanese: 家庭教師〈ガヴァネス〉なずなさん
synopsis:
The Koyomi Family once ruled the underside of Japan. Now in ruins, the young heir Kashitarou Koyomi remains, all in his lonesome. Starting up in solitude and having to live with the anger and grudges of others, a self proclaimed caretaker and tutor appears, introducing herself as "Nazuna." It is here, she proclaims, "I will raise you to be a great man of evil!"

(Source: MU)

title: Replay
synopsis:
Yuuta and Ritsu have been playing baseball together since they were children, but after being defeated in a local tournament over the summer, they must retire from the high school team to study for university entrance exams. Still, Yuuta finds himself unable to give up his lingering attachment to baseball. The one person who can truly understand him is Ritsu, who has been acting worryingly distant since they quit the team. But there's something Yuuta himself doesn't understand... Does he think of Ritsu as his partner in the way that a teammate would, or is the affection between them something stronger?

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Dosukebe♡Onei-chan
title_japanese: ドスケベ♡おねいちゃん

title: Gomashio to Pudding
title_english: Black Sesame Salt and Custard Pudding
synopsis:
Twenty-two-year-old Haruhi Fukunaga lives her dream life in Tokyo working her long-desired job as a heavy machine operator. When her father suddenly demands that she return to the countryside to help with the family business, a frustrated Haruhi decides to visit a bar for a few drinks. The next morning, she discovers that—in her drunken stupor—she had married a man twice her age! Feeling partially responsible for the incident, Haruhi's now-husband Nagato Sunohara determines to assist his new bride in convincing her father that Tokyo is where she truly belongs.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Maid Kanojo to Toshishita Kareshi
title_japanese: メイド彼女と年下彼氏

title: On or Off
synopsis:
Yiyoung is building a startup with his college friends. They get a chance to present their proposal to SJ Corporation, one of the leading companies in the country. But in the meeting room he sees Kang Daehyung, the extremely handsome company big shot that's so very much his type, and Yiyoung's heart starts to race...! Can pretty-faced Yiyoung win both in love and his career?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Hoka Atatte Kudasai
synopsis:
Kunou, a college student, has a secret nobody knows about: he is a succubus. As a person that consumes semen as food, he possesses a body that will get sick if he ejaculates. By chance, Kunou met Watarase, a gay man who is rumored to welcome anyone who comes to him. Kunou was thinking how perfect prey he was and attempted to approach him but...The supposed target is a total bottom?! He got wrung dry instead? This is bad! How will Kunou deal with this?

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

title: Ote, Osuwari, Kiss
synopsis:
One day, the overworked researcher Kouki discovers a "dog" lying unconscious at the foot of his apartment complex and decides to bring it home. The next day, Kouki wakes up to an unknown man in his apartment! Is he a burglar?! Amidst Kouki's panic, the man transforms into the "dog" he found last night and starts talking...! "Kouki, I'm the dog you saved! Thank you, you're really kind!" Thus starts the duo's life in the shared apartment as pet(?) and owner...?! A loving story about the lives of a handsome human-transforming dog and a fussy scientist under one roof!

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: Kuro no Senki: Isekai Teni shita Boku ga Saikyou nano wa Bed no Ue dake no you desu
title_japanese: クロの戦記 異世界転移した僕が最強なのはベッドの上だけのようです
synopsis:
Kurono Crawford, a noble of Cepheus Empire had a secret. It was that he came from a different world... modern Japan. Having the knowledge about the modern weapons and his sense of values, he was an existence almost like a cheat, aiming to be the Harem king. Abandoned by his superiors, left in command of the Empire's rejects consisting of demi-humans such as Minotaur's, Dwarfs, and Elves, and thrust into a position as head of a poor fiefdom, Kurono will do everything he can to rebuild and strengthen his forces and revitalize the land, aided in part by his knowledge of the other world.

(Source: Novel Updates)

title: Yasashiku Furetai
synopsis:
Sawada can't take his eyes off of Tsuji, a quiet classmate who seems to have been closing himself off to everyone. One day, Sawada bumps into Tsuji and touches the cut on his finger, but Tsuji...moans?? It turns out the reason why Tsuji's been isolating himself because he's hyper-sensitive to other people's touches, so Sawada comes up with a plan: get Tsuji used to touching others, by touching him! With careful after-school practice, Tsuji gets used to touching Sawada's fingers, hands, arms... but how about his heart?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Hello
synopsis:
Due to a particular incident, second-year high school student Izumi transferred schools and took his first year twice. He's not interested in getting along and making new friends, but his classmate Riku won him over, and they become each other's best friend... So now that Izumi had fallen in love with Riku, he chooses to hide his feelings to protect their friendship. But what happens when Izumi's former schoolmates out him in front of Riku?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Katsutoshi
synopsis:
1. Automatic Control
2. Monologue
3. Katsutoshi
4-5. Sweet Harassment

title: Hanzawa Naoki
synopsis:
Naoki Hanzawa is the Loans Division Chief of the Osaka Nishi branch of the third largest megabank in the world, the Tokyo Chuo Bank. To meet the target loan amount set by the headquarter branch, the Branch Manager of the Osaka Nishi branch, Tadasu Asano, asks Hanzawa to handle a loan required by Nishi Osaka Steel. However, after obtaining the loan, the President of Nishi Osaka Steel, Mitsuru Higashida, declares bankruptcy and goes missing. Hanzawa must now race against time to retrieve the loan and uphold the capital and honor of the bank!

(Source: MU)

title: Hinoenma ga Ore wo Yuuwaku shitekuru!!
title_japanese: 三姉妹〈ヒノエンマ〉が俺をユウワクしてくる!!
synopsis:
Our protagonist, after failing the medical school exam, moves to a village to focus on his studies and become a great doctor like his grandfather. However, the place where he will stay is administered by three beautiful sisters who hide a great secret, besides the village itself and its people. Why are there only women!? Why does the youngest want to "eat" me? Why does she have... fangs!? What's going on in this place?!

(Source: MU)

title: Ennead
synopsis:
The once peaceful land of Egypt has been stained with blood under the tyrannical rule of Seth, the god of war. Horus, son of the god Isis but not yet one himself, rises to challenge the throne and put an end to the chaos and destruction. Although the confrontation between Seth and Horus began with hatred, in time it becomes blurred by obsession and desire... The ancient mythology of Egypt comes to life as you've never seen it before in this compelling fantasy BL.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: A Shoulder to Cry On
synopsis:
Dayeol hears two guys fooling around in the nurse's office and accidentally knocks over the curtain rod. When the nurse walks in on the scene, devilishly handsome Taehyun tells her that Dayeol tried to make out with him. Before Dayeol can correct the misunderstanding, the rumor spreads and his archery scholarship is in jeopardy. To make matters worse, Taehyun doesn't show the slightest bit of remorse; in fact, he shamelessly begins hanging around Dayeol. It's not long before the two begin walking the thin line between hate and love.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Zuihou de Zhaohuan Shi
synopsis:
All things bright, those who can summon the spirits of all things are called summoners. Since ancient times, the legends about summoners can be found in each history...summon the earth, the skeletons, the souls and the stars...with the passage of time, the lends of the summoners are gradually forgotten by the world...and now, a new era, the strongest summoner wakes up!

(Source: SideWalk Group)

title: Deadpool: Samurai
synopsis:
Wade Winston Wilson does not consider himself a hero despite sporting a superhero-like black-and-red costume and fighting under the name "Deadpool." Rather than following a strict moral code, Deadpool's actions are dictated by money. When billionaire Anthony "Tony" Stark offers the mercenary a job in Tokyo, Deadpool is fully primed to take down an evil organization headed by the God of Mischief, Loki, who aims to seize control over Japan.

As Deadpool travels to his next zany escapade, he encounters Sakura Spider, a young girl with a familiar yet unimpressive backstory. She is by no means a fan of Deadpool and his unconventional methods, but in the face of a formidable enemy, her strong sense of responsibility and inability to fight alone outweigh any hesitation to join forces. With Sakura Spider on board, Deadpool caps off his team with Neiro Aratabi, a popular idol housing a symbiote in her body. Combining their powers, the trio must work together to save Japan—so Deadpool can safely

title: Yoake ni Yamadori
title_english: The Mountain Bird Cries at Dawn
synopsis:
Yamato Edogawa is heir to a mafia family, and he harbors secret feelings for his attendant, Yoru. In all truth, he doesn't want to take over the family, but his dad and the other members won't listen to him. He's run away from home many times, and Yoru's always been the one to come get him. One day, Yamato reaches his breaking point and refuses to go home, except on one condition. "If you want me home that bad... You have to sleep with me!" While Yamato's horrified by his own outburst, Yoru doesn't seem fazed...!

Could puppy love turn to something more between this future mafia boss and his beautiful tease of an attendant!?

(Source: Renta)

title: Unholy Blood
synopsis:
Ten years ago, the world changed after the appearance of vampires—beings of immeasurable strength and endless bloodlust. With no way to distinguish them apart from humans, these entities recklessly slaughter people to fulfill their selfish desires.

Orphan Park Hayan has always wanted a normal life: to keep her siblings safe from any potential danger and be able to find friends as a college student. But with the rise in vampire attacks, she fears that her life may crumble as traumatic memories return to haunt her.

After a tragic accident makes her a target for the "Angels of Death," an underground organization ruled by the most powerful vampires, Hayan decides to confront her past and partners up with Euntae Hwang, a member of the police force who is more than meets the eye. Her plan to eradicate every vampire begins here.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: She's My Type
synopsis:
After tomboy Haedam is thoroughly friend zoned by her first love, she's determined to glow up before college. But when she makes the wrong impression on her first day of school, she realizes she needs the help of her reluctant neighbor. In exchange, she promises to put up with their living circumstances and keep his secret. What could possibly go wrong?

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Class de Ichiban no Kanojo, Jitsu wa Bocchi no Ore no Kanojo desu
title_japanese: クラスで一番の彼女、実はボッチの俺の彼女です
synopsis:
Seiji Shinomiya, a self-described loner who thinks that youth is a pain, and Kotone Kanzaki, an unobtainable flower who has the best grades in their year and is also a model. The two of them, who absolutely never interact in class, have a secret: they are actually secretly going out, and nobody knows it. When this boyfriend who doesn't know how to depend on others and girlfriend who wants to be spoiled are together, they're able to be their true selves. Eating lunch together in the Literature Club room, using the rain as an excuse to have a sleepover date, secretly embracing each other behind the gym... They're distant in class, but when together, they're close.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Daikenja no Manadeshi: Bougyo Mahou no Susume @comic
title_japanese: 大賢者の愛弟子～防御魔法のススメ～＠COMIC

title: Ienai Himitsu no Aishikata
title_english: How to Love a Secret You Can't Tell Anyone About
title_japanese: いえない秘密の愛し方
synopsis:
Highschool teacher Nao Saeki is secretly a hardcore otaku who loves yuri manga. One day, at a doujinshi convention they participate in, Nao is eager to convey her feelings to "Nyapoleon", an artist she worships. However, it turned out to be a girl from her school, Haruka Kurumizawa, and moreover, she had to help her. After the event, they decided to go out for a meal, at Haruka's suggestion... When she wakes up in the morning, there is Haruka in the bed...?!

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Kuudere Sugiru Mirai no Yome no Mendou na 7-kakan
title_japanese: クーデレすぎる未来の嫁の面倒な7日間
synopsis:
Picking up what appeared to be a runaway girl, next to the cigarette vending machine at a convenience store, Katsuki Hira, the protagonist, reluctantly takes her home to protect her, thinking it would be troublesome to leave her with a handmade cardboard tag around her neck that says "Please pick me up" and that she would be involved in a crime if left unattended. When he asks her why she ran away from home, she continues to joke around about it. The two gradually come to know each other through their conflicting conversations, and promise to live together for one week only. Living together while being unaccustomed to each other, the two of them...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Koi ka Mahou ka Wakaranai!
title_english: I Don't Know If It's Love or Magic!
title_japanese: 恋か魔法かわからない!
synopsis:
Kaito Miyamae can't use magic at all! At this rate, his promise with his childhood friend of becoming great magic-wielders together will be ruined... When he was about to give up on his dream, Kaito suddenly feels magic power. However, that was magic that makes people who meet his eyes fall in love with him, a "charming magic!" Being popular is fine and all, but is this kind of magic really alright!? An envious fantasy love comedy of dreams and magic—the luckiest harem academy life, begins!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Tensei shitara Mahou to Ken no Bouken ga Matteiru to Omotteita noni
title_japanese: 転生したら魔法と剣の冒険が待っていると思っていたのに

title: GJ
synopsis:
Among the elites and criminals, Giichiro Jin is known for his top-notch plastic surgery skill that can transform patients appearance along with their fates. But his service costs an arm and a leg, on top of that, he will never operate the same patient twice. Because he believed what he does is a God's Job, thus should never be taken lightly. He travels around the world and encounters many dangerous cases that would not only change people's lives but also his own.

(Source: MediBang/Nihonbungeisha)

title: Chihira-kun wa Maryoku ga Tarinai
title_english: Chihira Can't Get Enough Magic Power
title_japanese: ちひらくんは魔力がたりない
synopsis:
Chihira is an ordinary boy looking to lose his innocence. One day, his "succubus blood" awakens, which means he now needs to steal other men's vitality in order to survive. He desperately asks his best friend Arou for help... Wait! He wanted to take someone for the first time but now he's being taken?!

What is an ordinary high school student to do when he suddenly becomes a succubus?! A rom-com featuring a taciturn airhead and a cheerful dunce.

(Source: Renta!)

title: No One's Perfect
synopsis:
38-year-old businessman Masami has the best boyfriend in the world. Tora's tall, built, and super hot! More than anything, he's incredibly kind. It's no wonder Masami relies on him so much. He even has four other boyfriends besides Tora, but Tora doesn't seem to mind. He always welcomes Masami with a warm smile and a gentle kiss. But, what if Tora has other guys on the side, too...? Is that why he's so "understanding" about Masami's other lovers?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Neta Character Tensei toka Anmari da! the Comic
title_english: Did I Seriously Just Get Reincarnated as My Gag Character?!
title_japanese: ネタキャラ転生とかあんまりだ! THE COMIC
synopsis:
Tooru Aikawa is a university student who spends his days going through the motions of attending school and working at a local convenience store. The only time he really feels alive is when he's playing the massive multiplayer VR game Real World Online.

One day, he has a stroke of luck: he's hit by a runaway bus and reincarnated as his game character. But something's gone wrong... Instead of the invincible warrior he mains, he's in the body of Nacht Schatten, the alluring dragon princess he made as a joke! Nacht's build is anything but optimized—she would never survive in the cutthroat world of an isekai story! And more to the point, she's a girl! But perhaps things aren't as bad as they seem as Nacht Schatten is more capable than she appears.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Isekai demo Fuuzokujou Yattemita
title_japanese: 異世界でも風俗嬢やってみた
synopsis:
Stranded in a fantasy world inhabited by magical beings and demons, call girl Yuzuki has only one clue on how to get home again: her enchanted grimoire has a list of creatures she must pleasure in order to break the spell. Fortunately that's all in a day's work for this consummate professional! The skilled and chipper Yuzuki introduces her own magic to the land in this upbeat tale of service with a smile.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: AV Danyuu Hajimemashita
title_english: Manga Diary of a Male Porn Star
synopsis:
When your company goes bankrupt and your marriage is on the rocks, what's a guy to do? Move to Tokyo to become an adult film star, of course! This diary-style comedy explores the pitfalls of an everyman who tries to break into the world of porno because it seems like a pleasurable way to restart his life. He soon learns that it's a harder job than he bargained for!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Uranaishi no Nayamigoto
synopsis:
Shouko Uranai is a master fortune teller who can solve any problem brought before her. Except for her own, of course, which appears in the form of a young boy.

(Source: MU)

title: Denki Unagi no Strategy
title_japanese: 電気ウナギの美少女攻略〈すとらてじー〉
synopsis:
Shunichi Odagiri can hear humans' inner thoughts through their spirit animals which are called heart beasts. Shunichi, who knows the ugliness and foolishness of human beings more than anyone else, have felt that he'll be alone forever. Until a beautiful girl who doesn't have a beast appears in front of him...

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Genkai Level 1 kara no Nariagari: Saijaku Level no Ore ga Isekai Saikyou ni Naru made
title_english: I'm Capped at Level 1?! Thus Begins My Journey to Become the World's Strongest Badass!
title_japanese: 限界レベル1からの成り上がり ～最弱レベルの俺が異世界最強になるまで～
synopsis:
I'm Tetsuya Takahashi. I was transported to a different world while trying to save a girl from some thugs. In this world, I'm "defective," and they tossed me out—all because my level caps at 1! Luckily, I've got an ability called Corpse Absorb, which lets me grab stat boosts and abilities off of any dead body I can get my hands on. With the help of an energetic cat-sith and a stuffed bear, my journey to make it to the top awaits! I'll prove to everyone that I'm not defective—I'm a badass!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Disney Twisted-Wonderland Anthology Comic
title_japanese: 『ディズニー ツイステッドワンダーランド』アンソロジーコミック
authors: Majiko!|Yuzuki, Shou|Mochi|Shiota, Haruto|CHRIS|Natsume, Ayano|Hirai, Runa|Amaichi, Esora|Karasuzuki, Rui|Komachi, Yuki|Kitaguni, Rato|Nohara, Mosae|Kaname, Monika|Fujimoto, Sakura|Takeda, Hazumi|Ginno, Yuu|Ichiruno, Nozomi|Yamada, Ryuusei|Watari, Zarame|Neko, Himako
synopsis: An anthology of stories centered around Disney's Twisted-Wonderland game.

title: Silver Pole Flowers
title_japanese: シルバーポールフラワーズ
synopsis: Hana's mother was a pole dancer. Hiding her face, she now carries on her mother's love for dance, even if she has to hide her identity, pole dancing being subject to prejudice due to its connection to the indecent. When Karin, a pole sports athlete sees her dance for the first time, she begins to grasp what her dance lacks in comparison. A heated rivalry between girls dancing on different paths and poles is born.

title: Tsuki to Ookami
synopsis:
1. Woo, Au Waon! (Woo, Awoo Woof!)
2-3. Woo-san to Ao (Woo and Ao)
4. Danshari no Susume (A Suggestion in Minimalism)
5. Osorubeki Nonke (The Straight Guy of Choice)
6-7. Nonke to Yobanaide (Don't Call Me Straight)
8. Full Moon Light Trip

title: Kimi no Kao ga Suki da
synopsis:
1-3. Kimi no Kao ga Suki da
4-6. Soine Boyfriend
7. Untitled

title: Ookami wa Nemuranai
synopsis:
One-eyed Wolf Lecan is a skilled adventurer who has conquered many dungeons all over the world. He had been going solo for a long time, but in the last three years, he's had a partner. That partner jumps into the black hole together with Lecan, and both go their separate ways as they fall into another world. Dungeons and magical beasts also exist in that world. After learning the native language, Lecan goes on a journey. Meeting a good teacher, Lecan studies medicine making and magic under that teacher, and begins his dungeon explorations for real.

(Source: Sousetsuka)

title: Kimi ni Koisuru Hazu ga Nai
title_japanese: 君に恋するはずがない
synopsis:
Kitaooji, an elite salaryman, yearns for a shoujo manga-like love. But he's paired up with Arima, a guy he doesn't get along with. Will Kitaooji's earnest wish come true one day...?

(Source: Rose Squad Scans)

title: Osananajimi to Iu dake dewa
title_japanese: 幼馴染みというだけでは
synopsis:
Itsuki and Haru are childhood friends. But Haru is secretly in love with Itsuki. And when he proposed to him, the latter didn't take it seriously. Just being by his side will be enough... so Haru thought. Until one day Itsuki came to stay at Haru's place for a week. Will all Haru's suppressed desires finally come out?!

(Source: Affogato Comics, translated)

title: Ippou Sono Koro
synopsis:
Kuroishi, the director of an evil organization that fights against magical girls, is serious, cute, and sexy despite being a bad guy. However, he's accidentally locked up alone with his talented and handsome subordinate, Akaya, in a room where they can't leave unless they get laid... What's to be done about this predicament?! (We have no choice!) This is the most popular magical and erotic BL!

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Tsue to Tsurugi no Wistoria
title_japanese: 杖と剣のウィストリア
synopsis:
Will Serfort dreams of keeping his promise to a childhood friend by becoming a Magia Vander, one of the mighty magicians who sit atop the Wizard's Tower. However, he is unable to cast even the simplest of spells, leaving him to fight dungeon monsters to earn credits at Regarden Magical Academy. As if that weren't enough, he finds himself putting his sword skills to the test against a bullying professor!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Fushouji Idol
synopsis:
"Let's prove to them that we can still do it!" Kiyoshi Shinonome, a former top idol who left the group because of a scandal. Issei Kaburagi, who immediately retired after the debut interview. Rui Tachibana and Tamotsu Hanagasa, a pair of childhood friend who ruined a lot of TV programs. These four Idols who once disappeared from the scene gathered and made a debut known as "SCaNDaL!"

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Kane to Otome to Koi to Junjou
synopsis: The story of a love that begins from a single love letter.

title: Unmei no Hito to Deaeru Koisuru Appli
title_japanese: 運命の人と出逢える恋するアプリ
synopsis:
Despite having received confessions from numerous girls, Hiroto Kyouno has never had any love interest and despises the idea of pursuing someone. But when his classmates force him to use Meet Your Soulmate—a fortune-teller app that reveals data about one's future companion—he starts wondering if there is more depth to love.

As his strong opinions on love falter, Kyouno encounters Horikita Kazusa, an underclassman with a remarkable resemblance to his soulmate's qualities that the app offered. Kyouno falls in love with Horikita Kazusa at first sight. He is deeply intrigued by the young man and wishes to ensure that Kazusa is his soulmate. Fortunately, they attend the same school, which allows Kyouno to ask Kazusa about his profile. To his amusement, Kazusa perfectly matches the soulmate description! With their fates intertwined thanks to the app, it is now only a matter of whether they are truly destined to become lovers.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kanojo no Ane wa Gal de Bitch de Yariman de
title_japanese: 彼女の姉はギャルでビッチでヤリマンで

title: Papakatsu Gal to Kimeseku kara no Ranpako
title_japanese: パパ活ギャルとキメセクからの乱パコ

title: Succubus Shoukan
title_japanese: サキュバスショウカン

title: Hidai! Kakuchou! Nikubenki Kaizou Shinryou

You’ve heard of meet cute, but reunite cute? Now that they’re both grown up, newly swole Shun visits his old friend Nana after an extended absence hoping to put a (figurative) stake in the heart of his one-time first love. But it looks like neither of these tiddy monsters is ready to let go! Join our hilariously awkward (maybe?) couple as they (hopefully!?) begin to bumble their way into an adorable relationship!

title: Aishite Kurenakya Bukkorosu!!!

Shouta, a guy born with a silver spoon in his mouth, has one dream : to be the cool, bad guy. Ever since he was a young boy, he has looked up to the strongest, worst delinquent in the area, Soushi. But because of his upbringing, he was never able to even pretend to be like him. Now he is finally in university and will start going out at night in order to become a delinquent himself...or at least he was supposed to. Instead, he ends up working part-time at a bar that belongs to his mom's friend, the strong delinquent Soushi! Soushi is divorced, has no kids and has settled down now when he's nearing 40. He's the complete opposite of the guy Shouta looked up to! Shouta takes it upon himself to make sure Soushi remembers his true self, and he starts by giving Soushi his body, even though Soushi doesn't seem to show much interest at all. This is a comedic and explosive love story between a middle-aged, retired delinquent and a rich and pure delinquent-admiring university student!

title_japanese: 映画妖怪ウォッチ シャドウサイド 鬼王の復活
synopsis:
There was once a 11 year old boy named Keita Amano who held a wristwatch that could command Youkai, he would make friends with the Youkai and fulfill a great many deeds. But when the boy grew up, he lost his ability to see Youkai. And as for the wristwatch that could control Youkai, its existence threatened to disturb the balance between human and Youkai worlds, so it was cast away into oblivion beyond time and space. Soon... the story of the Youkai controlling wristwatch became but a legend. But then, something took place after many, many years had passed... an epidemic Youkai virus known as Onimaro started affecting people with malevolent intentions and is spreading indefinitely, turning them into Kaodeka Oni and causing chaos throughout the city. With the end near, only the ones chosen by a new Youkai Watch can stand up against the upcoming threat and would save both Youkai and humans from certain destruction.

(Source: Wiki)
