The unpopular shoujo mangaka Senai Yaro is being tormented by a "ghost" with lingering attachment to this world! Ghost or not, the deadline still approaches!

(Source: MU)

title: Hetakuso Love Step
title_japanese: ヘタクソラブステップ
synopsis:
Spring, 2nd year of university. When you're free to let loose. But Kotarou has no friends, female or otherwise. He doesn't mind, he just wants to live peacefully. Enter childhood friend & bully Kyou, who forces Kotarou to pretend to be his boyfriend to put off an unwelcome suitor.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Kiss wa Tsugai ni Hizamazuku
title_english: Wanton Kisses Are Keys of Sin.
title_japanese: キスは番にひざまずく
synopsis:
In a world where fated pairs are deemed to be a mere legend, Iori (α) still dreams of finding his destined omega. But when he finally crosses paths with him, it turns out the one he's been longing for is the school's famous "alpha devourer," Leo (Ω), who wants absolutely nothing to do with him. Nevertheless, Iori has no intention of giving up. Is this feeling love, fate, or instinct...?

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Osananajimi Doushi ja Irarenai
title_english: I Can't Stay Friends Anymore: Love Begins with an Offer
title_japanese: 幼なじみ同士じゃいられない
synopsis:
Shiori Mizuno is a university student, and Yamato Mochizuki is her childhood friend and next-door neighbor. They used to be good friends, but he confessed to her and caused a rift between them. Shiori was devoted to track and field at the time and, while Yamato was her biggest supporter, she could only see him as like a little brother. She distanced herself from him by going to a boarding school, and that was that.

Several years later, however, losing both Yamato and track and field made Shiori realize how important he really was to her. Shiori desperately wants to go back to the way they were before, and is prepared to accept anything if it'll change his heart... but their relationship becomes solely physical with no feelings from him, and the pain drives her to tears...

(Source: Renta!)

title: Hitogoto desukara!
synopsis:
Ms. Komori is the ace of the Sales and Marketing Department, and she damned well knows it. With a smile that can convince anyone to do anything, she always goes well over her monthly quota—so imagine how surprised she is after finding out she's getting transferred over to the dull, uptight Personnel Department! But little does she know that she may have more in common with her new coworker Ms. Yamanobe than she originally thought...

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Another 2001
synopsis:
It has been three years since the "calamity" of 1998 that claimed the lives of many students in Yomiyama North Middle's Class 3. After Sou Hiratsuka, an acquaintance of 1998 survivor Mei Misaki, discovers that he's being placed into the cursed class, he and his peers develop a series of countermeasures to avert a new tragedy. But when Sou's classmates and their family members begin dying in a series of horrific "accidents," he and Mei realize that the calamity has taken hold of their town once again. To stem the tides of death, the pair will be forced to reckon with Yomiyama's deepest mysteries...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Isekai kara no Kigyou Shinshutsu?! Moto Shachiku ga Isekai Tenshoku shite Nariagaru! Yuusha ga Kouryaku Dekinai Meikyuu wo Tsukuriagero
title_japanese: 異世界からの企業進出!? ～元社畜が異世界転職して成り上がる! 勇者が攻略できない迷宮を作り上げろ～
synopsis:
Former black company employee, Jirou Tanaka leaves his job due to overwork. In his home, he founds a job recruitment template which is from another world company. The job is to test the dungeon created by the demon king. There, the days of diving into the dungeon as a "dungeon tester" were waiting for him to complete the dungeon that even the hero would not be able to clear. He has a hot dark elf boss who has an amazing ability "Magic resistance." The new life of our main character starts! 

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Wagaya wa Kakuriyo no Kashihonya-san
title_english: The Haunted Bookstore: Gateway to a Parallel Universe
title_japanese: わが家は幽世の貸本屋さん
synopsis:
Kaori lives in a bookstore where the boundaries between the mortal realm and the spirit realm are blurred. She spends her days in peace, selling books to otherworldly beings alongside her adoptive father, a spirit himself. But all of that is disrupted when a self-proclaimed exorcist stumbles into this ghostly utopia. Can Kaori embrace her better nature and help a man who's vowed revenge against all spirits find his way back home?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Wakeari Kusushi no Yorozu Hoechiyou
title_japanese: ワケあり薬師の万覚帳
synopsis:
The pharmacist Kohaku, who works at the drugstore "Seishindo," goes to get some herbs with his snake Hakkaku. One day, Kohaku gets attacked by a man-eating spirit and his chest is torn open. As his heart is about to get eaten, the one who saves him is Hakkaku in human form.

(Source: MU)

title: Ichijou Karen wa Yuuwaku suru
title_japanese: 一条かれんは誘惑する
synopsis:
Karen is head over heels in love with her childhood friend, the brusque and fierce-looking Mii-kun. Day after day, she makes amorous advances toward him in hopes of making him her future husband. But when it's just the two of them, she can't help but feel a little nervous...? She's a headstrong queen in front of everyone else, but when faced with the boy she likes, she can't help but turn back into a blushing schoolgirl?! A youthful love comedy that will make your heart pound!

(Source: NINO, translated)

title: Tensei Kyousouba H-Man
title_japanese: 転生競走馬 エッチマン

title: Re:birth
synopsis:
Society is divided into three 'verses' or secondary gender: Alpha, Beta, and Omega. While betas make the most of the population, alphas and omegas are capable of forming a special connection through mating. Yukimura Habaki is a newly transferred police inspector currently handling a case concerning murdered omegas. Being an alpha, he can't help but worry about his mate, En, even though they have a somewhat distant relationship. On the other hand, En is plagued by guilt on the web of lies he's woven around his relationship with Yukimura. Will their relationship continue or fall apart once everything is unraveled?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Konna no Unmei ja Nai kara Kanchigai shinaide
title_english: There's No Way This Is Fate
title_japanese: こんなの運命じゃないから勘違いしないで
synopsis:
Yuuzen, Kouetsu, and Ginga have been best friends since preschool, and they're at the top of the pecking order at a prestigious academy for only the most elite alphas. With their good looks, money, and academic prowess, they enjoy life on easy mode... at least, until one day, Yuuzen displays symptoms of being an omega! Unable to resist Yuuzen's pheromones despite the medicine they take, Kouetsu and Ginga give in to their instincts. Taking turns, they force themselves upon a confused and ecstatic Yuuzen...

(Source: Renta!)

Retired boxer Soo-young discovers he has to pay off his father's debt when Tae-seung hunts him down. Fascinated by Soo-young's persistence, Tae-seung offers him an alternative—to learn the ropes and start from the rock bottom. Will this dangerous relationship work, or will this be another living hell for Soo-young?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Escape into Oblivion
synopsis:
Woojin wants nothing more than to escape reality. Hwon wants nothing more than to be with Woojin. Baffled by the intensity of Hwon's love, Woojin makes a series of absurd demands to push him away. But no matter how cruel the demands are, Hwon never gives up.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Unfather
synopsis:
Kyunghee's strapped for cash and with classes about to start soon, he's running out of options. He was fine last year, Sihyun paid him well for his "company." But that ended not long after it started. The old man was clingy and the last thing Kyunghee wanted was a relationship. Things make a turn for the worse when Kyunghee meets his mother's new boyfriend, a vindictive Sihyun.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: How Sweet Is a Sugar Daddy?
title_english: How Sweet Is a Sugar Daddy?
synopsis:
Sihoon is handsome, cultured and rich. What else would you expect from an established doctor? He's everything that Junyoung wants to be, once he gets out of college. Oh, and Junyoung's not gay. At least, that's what he says... while he's more or less having sex with Sihoon. A man. A married man. A married man who happens to be dating his his best friend, Mari.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Down and Dirty
synopsis:
How far (or low) can an attractive body take you in a slum? Pretty and well endowed, Choi Hyungdo scrapes together a living as a waiter by day and porn actor by night. He's occasionally called in for odd jobs at the male brothel where the charismatic owner, Lee Gyung, relentlessly tries to seduce him. Hyungdo feels as though he's spiraling, but his attraction to Gyung feels as real as his imminent bankruptcy. The descent may be ruthless, but it's not without its pleasures.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Dine With a Vampire
synopsis:
Caught in the clutches of an abusive relationship, Sooin longs to escape. A vampire who finds human blood repulsive, Chi-hwan only drinks the blood of other vampires. When chance brings the two together, Chi-hwan makes Sooin an enticing proposal. Chi-hwan will help Sooin get out of his living hell, and in exchange...Sooin has to let Chi-hwan drink his blood. Will this proposal change both their lives for the better?

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Dispar
synopsis:
Miha has always felt like an outsider, even within his own family. Sohwa takes full advantage of that, forcing him to do his biddings. However, an incident takes place that helps Miha and Sohwa to reflect and figure out what they are feeling for each other.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: The Devil's Temptation
synopsis:
Hyun was supposed to spend Christmas snuggling with his cat on a comfy couch, watching TV. This year, however, he decides to attend the company holiday party to make his existence known to his office crush—the devilishly handsome Alek—but instead, downs too many drinks, makes a fool of himself, and blacks out. The morning after, he wakes up to a Christmas nightmare: lying next to him butt naked is his despicable colleague, Ivan Mariani. Hyun has always hated everything about Ivan. So why does Ivan suddenly look different...smell wonderful...and radiate irresistible sexual energy?

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Boku no Trauma Red
title_japanese: ぼくのトラウマレッド
synopsis:
Chitose Aoyagi is a returnee from France. At his new school, he's reunited with Tasuke Akayuge, his childhood nemesis... a traumatic trigger he wishes he'd never have to deal with again! Why traumatic, you ask? In 4th grade, Tasuke not only stole the coveted Gad Red role in the school play, but he was the pervert who stole Chitose's first kiss! In Chitose's mind,"he's not 'Red' at all!" But, Tasuke quickly becomes popular and even gets chummy with Chitose's best friend, then professes his feelings for Chitose and does dirty things to him! Chitose feels all mixed up and doesn't know what to do...!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Trillion Game
synopsis:
Meet Haru Tennouji, a charismatic communicator beloved by all, regardless of age or gender. He may come across as easygoing, but beneath that façade lies an unwavering ambition for success. When offered a prestigious position at the nation's largest IT company, "Dragon Bank," he does the unexpected—turning it down in favor of embarking on an entrepreneurial journey alongside his friend, Manabu Taira. Their audacious objective: to amass a staggering 1 trillion dollars.

Now, let's introduce Manabu, a brilliant engineer armed with remarkable IT acumen. Personality-wise, he's the antithesis of Haru—introverted, and a tad awkward in social interactions. Having faced rejection from "Dragon Bank" due to his communication challenges, he joins forces with Haru, sharing in the colossal ambition of earning that elusive 1 trillion dollars.

(Source: MAL News)

title_japanese: セイクリッド・シュヴァリエ
synopsis:
In the world of the Goddess Wellos, after sex, women are blessed with strength and good looks and men with good luck. The women who gain this godly strength and good looks become Paladins and participate in battle, and the men support the Paladins as Chevaliers. In Lente village, Kite, the son of a blacksmith, is a boy with a very strong libido. Former Paladin Lilia identifies him as a Chevalier candidate and encourages him to join the Royal Academy in the capital to become a Royal Chevalier.

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

title: Usotsuki Satsuki wa Shi ga Mieru
title_japanese: ウソツキ皐月は死が視える
synopsis:
With eyes the color of blood, Satsuki Minazuki can see death; specifically, she can see the illusion of corpses exactly 24 hours before they manifest in reality. Unfortunately, her reputation as a compulsive liar who spews ominous warnings about impending deaths means that no one ever believes her—even though she has never once told a lie.

Shunned by her classmates, Satsuki is accustomed to being alone, until she prevents the death of the ever-kind Komako Komachi. This small deviation in fate ripples outward, creating a massive change. What lengths will Satsuki go to in order to save a life?

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Tate no Yuusha no Nariagari Anthology: Filo to Issho
title_japanese: 盾の勇者の成り上がりアンソロジー　フィーロといっしょ
authors: Futaba, Masumi|Sanshoku, Amido.|Aiya, Kyu|Yoshino, Sora|Araragi, Ayune|Akano, Amamichi
synopsis: A collection of stories by various mangaka, centered around the hit series Tate no Yuusha no Nariagari. This manga is filled with the charm of the filolial Filo.

title: Hypnosis Mic: Before the Battle - Dawn of Divisions
title_japanese: ヒプノシスマイク -Before the Battle- Dawn of Divisions
synopsis:
Before Ichirou Yamada, Samatoki Aohitsugi, Ramuda Amemura, and Jakurai Jinguji came together, they were members of three separate units: Mad Comic Dialogue, Naughty Busters, and Kujaku Posse. Aside from rapping and defending their respective division borders, these men find themselves competing against each other in eating contests, investigating haunted houses, and solving petty crimes. Even when they are not busy spitting hot rhymes and annihilating enemies with their flawless lyrical flow, the depictions of their lives are anything but mundane.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

In a time when the 6 Goddesses of the world vanished without a trace, a hunter by the name of Wein miraculously stumbles upon a girl who calls herself Elise, claiming to be the 7th Goddess. After finding himself in a losing battle against a monster and suffering severe wounds, Wein was on the brink of death. With the help of Elise's powers, he was able to cling onto dear life. But as an aftermath of exerting her power, Elise's body turned into a little girl...

In order to restore Elise's lost power, Wein and his friends set off on an adventure!!

(Source: MangaDex)

Lerunda has always been treated unfairly, constantly compared to her twin sister, whose personality is bright and beautiful. One day Lerunda was thrown away into the forest, abandoned by her parents when her sister was taken over to the Great Temple as a child...
In disappointment, the strongest monster Griffon in the forest and a Sky Horse helped her lonely person...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Bash had earned the title of a "Hero" for his unparalleled achievements in a great war between twelve races. He, the one respected by all orcs, embarks on a journey. To show the pride and honor of his race, and to get rid of the secret that he can't tell anyone: his virginity.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Takane no Hana-san
synopsis:
A cold-looking business woman constantly mocks and degrades her coworker for his mistakes during work. But secretly she's madly in love with him!

(Source: MU)

title: Shika no Sono: Kamimura Kazuo Eros Kessakusen Volume 1
title_english: Kazuo Kamimura Eros Horror Volume 1: Le Parc Aux Cerfs
synopsis:
Azusa Wakaba, the daughter of Azusa Fumiko, famous film actress, jumps into the film industry with her beauty to find the truth behind her mother's mysterious suicide. Wakaba catches the eye of Murase Takayuki, a man on the verge of a promotion to director, and wins the lead role, but Murase loses his job to his mentor, Makiguchi, a master of the film industry. In a world where lust becomes murderous intent and hatred abounds, Wakaba's starring film is in a world full of hatred.

(Source: Soft Magic, translated)

title: Kono Yubi Tomare
synopsis:
Japan's favorite child celebrity, Ena Fujie is busy with her entertainment gig! Except for Tashiro, Ena's clumsy manager, the adults around her have not realized that behind her cute and captivating performance, she is a very ambitious kid that calculates every move to win everyone's heart! What kind of shenanigans will she pull out today?

synopsis:
Juu Juuzawa is a delinquent high school boy who just wants to be left alone. One day, he is approached by Ame Ochibana, who claims that she knew him in a previous life, and now wants to serve him as his "knight." At first Juu wants nothing to do with Ame, but after a classmate is murdered, he accepts her help as he looks for the killer.

(Source: ANN)

title: Nokemono-tachi no Yoru
synopsis:
Wisteria is an orphan girl living in a corner of the British Empire at the end of the 19th century. Her life is desolate and bleak–until she encounters Marbas, a powerful but equally lonely immortal being with a furry appearance, hounded by hunters. Together, Wisteria and Marbas roam the Empire–populated by humans and human-like beasts–in search of a place where they can live together in peace.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Amayakasanaide Fukushachou: Dannasama wa SSR
title_japanese: 甘やかさないで副社長〜ダンナ様はSSR〜
synopsis:
Twenty-seven-year-old Maki Enomoto is done with relationships. One year ago, her terrible boyfriend made her the joint guarantor on a loan before promptly ghosting her with a mountain of debt. Now she just wants to be left alone to her quiet otaku life, working her office job to make her ex's monthly repayments, and devoting what scant little is left to her hobbies. Namely, her virtual boyfriend Allen-kun, who is hot, kind, and dependable in a way that real-life men aren't—least of all the hotshot young VP that keeps getting on her case about deadlines and deliverables. But when said VP shows up with a rather interesting proposal, Maki must decide if she's ready to roll the dice one last time...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Oresama Fukushachou ni Tsukamarimashita.

Momoka, a secretary involved in an office romance, quit her job due to a broken heart. She begins working as a housekeeper and finds out that her new employer is Mr. Mizusawa, the vice president of her former company! Although he once brought her to a party and forced her to pose as his girlfriend, Momoka gradually discovers Mizusawa's gentler side and becomes attracted to him. Indulge in the forbidden romance between a housekeeper and a control-freak vice president!

(Source: NHN comico Corp.)

title: Kimi wa Kawaii Koi no Dorei
title_english: You're a Cute Slave of Love
synopsis:
Tenya and Yamato Hagiwara were raised as twin brothers, but then they found out the truth. Ever since then, the younger of the two - Yamato - started skipping class and hanging out with the delinquents at school. Tenya takes it upon himself to fix Yamato and make sure he ends up on the right track again, but it's proving to be difficult. One day, Yamato's friend Tatsumi tells Tenya where he can find his brother, but it ends up being a trap as he walks in on his brother going at it! Afterwards, Yamato tells Tenya that he will have to make up for his interruption by being a replacement for the girl who ran off...!! 

(Source: Renta!)

title: Sentai Daishikkaku
synopsis:
When the Monster Army invaded Earth thirteen years ago, the Divine Dragon Rangers rose up to stop them! With the war raging on, these great heroes are mankind's last hope!

...or are they?

In truth, the invaders were subjugated within a year, forced to continue to crank out a monster a week for the Rangers to crush in front of their adoring fans! But one monster has had enough. Something has to change! He'll rebel against the might of the Dragon Rangers and destroy them all...from the inside!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Reizouko no Naka wa Karappo
title_english: The Refrigerator Has Nothing in His Body
title_japanese: 冷蔵庫の中はからっぽ
synopsis:
Shimizu (a spoiled rich high school boy) leaves his home to become a comic artist, and ends up rooming with his friend Umeya. Umeya is so poor that he's got nothing in his fridge except mayonnaise to eat with the rice!

(Source: MU)

Included one-shots:
Volume 1: Crybaby, Anata ga Suki desu, Daisuki desu., Tsuma ni Natte yo.

title: Isekai Tensei Kabushikigaisha: Anshin Anzen na Tensei Life, Teikyou shimasu
title_japanese: 異世界転生株式会社～安心安全な転生ライフ、提供します～

title: Tsuki to Kin no Shangri-La
title_japanese: 月と金のシャングリラ
synopsis:
The year is 1945. At a monastery in beautiful Tibet, two boys met... Unknowing of the harsh fate awaiting them... Dawa is on a long journey with his father to find "Shangri-La." However, at the monastery, his father leaves without him. Left all alone, Dawa, along with a boy he meets at the monastery, Dorje, become novice monks together... A pure and fleeting love, set in Tibet before the upheaval.

(Source: East Press, translated)

title: Isekai ni Otosareta... Jouka wa Kihon! @comic
title_english: Flung Into a New World? Time to Lift the 200-Year Curse!
title_japanese: 異世界に落とされた…浄化は基本! @COMIC
synopsis:
Akira Tennou, an unremarkable thirty-five-year-old man, gets hit by a truck on his way home from work and, after a brief experience in some mystical limbo, wakes up in a gloomy forest. This forest is beset by a sinister black mist—his memories of his little sister's lectures about fantasy novels tell him that it's probably under an evil curse. He soon encounters one of the forest's residents: an enormous silver wolf. At first the creature is hostile, but he finds that it's been corrupted by the same black mist, and he only needs to cry "Purify!" to banish the curse and heal the wolf. Akira discovers that the residents of the forest are all animals, and once purified, they are far from feral beasts.

His newfound magic allows him to speak to his new animal companions; he finds that they are intelligent and the rightful rulers of the forest. Akira decides to explore this new world, purifying the land and its inhabitants as he goes. But the source of the cursed mist can't be far away...

title: Nichijou dewa Saenai Tada no Ossan, Hontou wa Chijou Saikyou no Senshin
title_english: A Normally Dowdy Man Is in Essence the Mightiest War-God.
title_japanese: 日常ではさえないただのおっさん、本当は地上最強の戦神
synopsis:
Bar, an ordinary middle-aged mister and a veteran adventurer, lived an easy, comforting life in the Imperial Capital. He would carry items for adventuring parties or help the guild's staff from time to time.

"Mr. Bar, glad to have you today!"

"Thank you for your words."

That uncle who was liked by everyone in the capital, was actually the strongest arsenal of the Empire—one of the "Laevateinn"—Bartolomeus.

"Please step forward, Lord Bar."

With a delicate and beautiful elven girl, Welhe Mina, to back him up, his gallant figure racing across the battlefield or the political battleground was simply godly—like a War God. The heroic tales of the dowdy adventurer AND the mightiest arsenal starts here!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Sanzennenme no Kamitaiou
synopsis: 3000 year old god decides she wants to quit being a god so she becomes a high school girl.

title: Youjo to Scoop to Maganou
title_english: The Girl, the Shovel, and the Evil Eye
title_japanese: 幼女とスコップと魔眼王
synopsis:
Tsuguto Sumihara is way too nice...or rather, was too nice. He lost his life in a bus accident after being bullied into giving up his seat, and somehow was reincarnated into a mining camp! Not only that, the mine is at the base of an impossibly tall tower. It's there he meets the ram—horned Loulier, his first friend in this bizarre land. But when she's bullied, Tsuguto finds that maybe he wasn't reincarnated without powers after all...and that, if he's to have a future in this strange new land, Loulier's just the partner he needs.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: S-ken K-shi Shakaijin Joshi Volleyball Circle no Jijou
title_japanese: S県K市 社会人女子バレーボールサークルの事情

title: Pale Blue Dot: Battle Athletess Daiundoukai ReSTART!
title_japanese: ペイル・ブルー・ドット バトルアスリーテス大運動会 ReSTART!

title: NEET Kunoichi to Nazeka Dousei Hajimemashita
title_japanese: ニートくノ一となぜか同棲はじめました

title: You Are My Darling!!!
title_japanese: ユア マイ ダーリン!!!
synopsis:
When a new person moves in next door, the appearance of a cockroach forces him to ask his neighbor for help. This strange situation is how two people with opposite personalities, one calm and composed the other prone to exaggeration, form an unlikely friendship.

(Source: MU)

title: Kage no Kyuutei Majutsushi: Munou dato Omowareteita Otoko, Jitsu wa Saikyou no Gunshi Datta
title_japanese: 影の宮廷魔術師 ～無能だと思われていた男、実は最強の軍師だった～
synopsis:
Leon is the kingdom's most worthless Court Magician. One day, his repeated absences are punished and he is sent to the battlefield, but with the quick wits he was hiding he saved the Third Princess Sicily? Then, along with the reformer princess, and steeling his own resolve, Leon becomes a specialized officer determined to control events from the shadows.

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Arashi-kun no Dakimakura
title_japanese: 嵐士くんの抱きマクラ
synopsis:
Sora, a high school girl who loves her family, hurt her back after carrying her sleeping younger brother and went to the infirmary. It seems like she was having a wonderful dream whilst taking a break but, when she woke up... the beautiful Arashi Tsukinose was sleeping in the same bed as her! It seems like Sora has been chosen by Arashi-kun to be by his side to help him sleep?? Although you'd think that NOBODY at the age of 16 needs a sleeping buddy, the sound of her heartbeat is resonating with the multi talented pretty boy. Ayu Watanabe's attention drawing new story is an intimate romance that starts from sleeping side by side...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Kyochuu Sanmyaku
synopsis:
College students went to a tunnel in the mountains in order to livestream a test of courage... where they are attacked by giant insects! A brutal survival story of giant insects vs. humans!!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Niwatori Fighter
title_japanese: ニワトリ・ファイター
synopsis:
The neighborhood cock of the walk is more than just an ordinary rooster—he's humanity's greatest defender! His opponents may be ten stories tall, but nothing is bigger than his stout heart and his fearsome battle cry—cock-a-doodle-doo!

(Source: VIZ Media)

title: Boku wa Shitteiru.
synopsis:
High school student Sunao was commuting to school when he noticed a salaryman on the bus. On his ring finger, were teeth marks hidden by a ring. Who left those marks? Is it a sign of possession? Or maybe... Before he knew it, Sunao's head was filled with fantasies about him. One day, he runs into the salaryman at his part time job at an izakaya. He drunkenly confronts Sunao and kisses him...!? These straightforward and painful emotions are too young to be called love. A love between a high school student and a salaryman!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Marvelous Kiss
synopsis:
At the start of his difficult journey to find a bride, the Strega (witch) young man named Noah was accidentally kissed (through CPR) by the popular male student, Mattis, due to some circumstances and turned into a girl! This phenomenon is called "Marvelous Kiss." If an unmarried Strega kisses someone of the same gender, their gender will be changed into the opposite one. But, despite the gender change, Noah recklessly approaches Mattis to learn how to be popular! Will Noah ever be able to find a marriage partner at this rate...?!

(Source: Endless Journey)

title: Mutekitekki Spin-chan
title_japanese: 無敵鉄姫スピンちゃん
synopsis:
It will be the first year of high school for Tooru and as such, she decided to go live with her grandpa to be close to school. But it turns out that the old man is a robot engineer with a peculiar dream... for which he created the robot assistant Spin! What will happen to Tooru from now on!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Sei-chan Capacity Over desu!
title_english: Sei-chan, Your Love Is Too Much!
title_japanese: せいちゃんキャパオーバーです！
synopsis:
Futaba Ito is just about to start her first year of high school when Seiichirou "Sei" Izumi, her childhood friend, decides to move into the Ito residence because of his overseas-based parents. Sei is quite the charming young man and two years older than Futaba—the same age as her elder brother, Tsumugi. Naturally, Tsumugi is wary of leaving Sei and his sister to their own devices, and he has a quick chat with Sei to assert that he won't tolerate any shameful behavior. Sei agrees―but teenage zeal is a difficult thing to control.

Every time Tsumugi looks away for too long, Futaba and Sei get a little closer, exchanging smiles and holding hands discreetly. Thanks to their cute little escapades, Futaba finds herself helplessly falling for Sei. But as their interactions rapidly grow more intimate, Futaba wonders if Sei's affection might just be too much for her to handle!

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Mashin Eiyuuden Wataru: Shichikon no Ryuujinmaru
title_japanese: 魔神英雄伝ワタル~七魂の龍神丸~
synopsis: A manga adaptation based on the ONA of the same name.

title: Tensei Inja wa Hokusoemu
title_japanese: 転生隠者はほくそ笑む
synopsis:
By the power of the goddess, he was reincarnated in the world of VRMMORPG "Valkyria Chronicle." Apparently, in the real world, he died from overwork due to his life as a company slave.

I don't have the original body... If so, I will live faithfully to my desires, create a dungeon with the female character I like, and have a carefree (innocent) sex life... I will live a good life!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Ten kara Kita
synopsis:
A short story about a female aspiring singer to follow her grandfathers footsteps and an angel who follow the orders of his father an elder angel who met female singers grandfather when he was young.

(Source: MU)

title: Natsume-senpai ni Semarareru Hibi
title_japanese: 棗センパイに迫られる日々
synopsis:
For Kaho, a man's muscles are all that matters. She's sports-agnostic, type-agnostic—all she cares about are that those abs, pecs, biceps and delts look good. She thinks she's found her perfect Muscle Prince in Natsume-senpai...that is, until he finds out what a muscle-freak she is. But instead of ridiculing her, he instead suggests she becomes manager of the basketball team—the one he just so happens to be on? For a muscle-lover like Kaho, there's nothing to lose...and everything to gain.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Every Day Is a Good Day
title_japanese: エブリデイ イズ ア グッドデイ
synopsis:
It's been a year since Toki lost his twin sister in an accident. Toki is still dealing with the pain, but while his parents are away on a trip, he must now also take care of his orphaned nephew, who hasn't spoken a word since losing both of his parents. While Toki struggles to raise a child, his friend's younger brother Chihiro, starts giving a helping hand. How will these three people become a temporary family?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: Akuyaku Reijou? Iie, Gokuaku Reijou desu wa
title_japanese: 悪役令嬢？ いいえ、極悪令嬢ですわ
synopsis:
Rosalia, a Marquis' daughter, for some reason only lived within the premises of the Marquis' residence. One day when she was sixteen, she fell in love with a red-headed knight who wandered into the garden by accident. It was at that moment the powerful Marquis' daughter felt something trigger―A knight who is a reincarnator, but doesn't realize that he's a capture target in an otome game and the main villainess, who began to change once she met the knight.

The heroine who has been reborn with the knowledge of the game would be the fall of Rosalia, however, it does not go through according to the scenario...

"What are you?! You're the villainess, aren't you?"

"Villain? You think you could play such an outrageous role? I am a genuine villainess."

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Kuro Bara Alice D.C. al fine
Ochikobore Kuni wo Deru: Jitsu wa Sekai de 4-ninme no Fuyo Jutsushi Datta Ken ni Tsuite
title_english: Homeland Dropout: The Time I Was Reincarnated as the Fourth Enchanter in the Entire World
title_japanese: 落ちこぼれ国を出る ～実は世界で4人目の付与術師だった件について～
synopsis:
He only just got reincarnated in another world as Zinc, a dropout noble, but he's immediately banished from the kingdom?! However, that's not enough to make Zinc just give up! With "Enchantment," a power that can make anyone stronger by granting abilities to items, Zinc wants to make a life for himself as an adventurer. The curtain draws on Zinc's journey as he uses this incredibly rare ability, that's basically a cheat code, to go from zero to hero!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Psychopath Kanojo to Houkai suru Boku no Nichijou
title_japanese: サイコパス彼女と崩壊する僕の日常

title: Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint
synopsis:
Kim Dokja does not consider himself the protagonist of his own life. Befitting the name his parents gave him, he is a solitary person whose sole hobby is reading web novels. For over a decade, he has lived vicariously through Yoo Joonghyuk, the main character of the web novel Three Ways to Survive the Apocalypse (TWSA). Through Joonghyuk, Dokja has experienced secondhand the trials of repeatedly regressing in time, in search of an end to life-threatening "scenarios" that force people to act out narratives for the amusement of god-like "Constellations."

After reading 3,149 chapters—long after all other readers lost interest—Dokja finally resigns himself to the story ending. However, he receives an enigmatic message from the author, stating that the story will soon be monetized, before his surroundings suddenly go dark. He swiftly realizes that fiction has become reality and he is now living through TWSA. Although he is the singular omniscient reader of the events yet to come, his succe

title: Kirei na Oniisan ga Ore no Pet ni Narimashita
title_english: The Beautiful Man Became My Pet
title_japanese: キレイなお兄さんが俺のペットになりました
synopsis:
Haruki is a prep student who is living alone with no parents nor money. He currently works as a cabaret boy. One night, he met a beautiful drunkard older mister who was sleeping in the garbage area. Thus, Haruki decided to take him home as the thought of leaving him alone was too dangerous. However, the mister suddenly attacked him as he mistook the situation for a one-night stand and made him cum dry. Haruki continues living with this mysterious mister because the sex-service felt so good that he could melt.

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: Kawaikereba Hentai demo Suki ni Natte Kuremasu ka?: Abnormal Harem
title_japanese: 可愛ければ変態でも好きになってくれますか? アブノーマルハーレム
synopsis: A spin-off with each chapter focusing on one of the girls.

title: Kazoku ni Nattemimasen ka?
title_english: Would You Like to Be a Family?
title_japanese: 家族になってみませんか?
synopsis:
1-2. Kazoku ni Nattemimasen ka? (Would You Like to Be a Family?)
3. Kuma no Kimochi (Kuma's Feelings)
4. Hajimete no Renai Shinrigaku (The First Love Psychology)
5. Untitled

title: BL Mangaka, Shucchou Host wo Kau
title_english: The Boys Love Comic Artist Buys a Delivery Host
title_japanese: BL漫画家、出張ホストを買う
synopsis:
1-2. Ouji-sama Kaimasu
3. Ookina Boku to Chiisana Kimi
4. Honjitsu wa Ohigara mo Yoku
5. Triangle Logic

title: Funky Yankee Baby-kun
title_japanese: ファンキーヤンキーベイビーくん
synopsis:
Kikka, the chief of the bancho, is a charismatic existence who is recognized by the bad guys around him because of his overwhelming fighting strength. One of Kikka's natural enemies is the teacher Kayane. He asks his old friend Chiaki to capture Kikka in order to receive supplementary lessons. However, a battle love between Chiaki, who is proud of his skill as a collector, and Kikka, who never wants to lose, breaks out. The encounter between the two has evolved into a fiercely hot yankee conflict involving everyone from sukeban to the boy!?

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special
title_english: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special
synopsis:
The world is on the brink of destruction after a devastating ten-year war in the "shadow labyrinth." Desir Herrman is one of the last skilled magicians left standing, but even he is no match for the formidable foe threatening humanity's very existence. Just when he's certain the end has come, he is sent back in time to his early days of studying magic at the prestigious Hebrion Academy! With this rare second chance, Desir is determined to save not only himself but also the friends and comrades he once lost. Armed with the knowledge of what their future holds, can his efforts make a difference, or are they all doomed to relive the same terrible destiny? Based on the hit novel.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Tensei Shirayukihime wa Doku Ringo wo Tabetakunai
title_japanese: 転生白雪姫は毒リンゴを食べたくない
synopsis:
When she was five years old, Snow White recalled her past life as a Japanese high schooler who knew of a fairy tale about a queen who wanted the death of a princess with skin as white as snow, lips as red as blood, and hair as black as ebony—and realizes that she has reincarnated as that princess! Ever since then, she has been training in hopes of avoiding the grim future that awaits her.

On the day of reckoning, Snow White escapes the castle before the queen calls for the hunter... only to fall onto the man himself! Will the reincarnated Snow White be able to avoid her deadly fate in this isekai spin of the classic fairy tale?

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Mask Hazushite yo, Ishikawa-san
title_japanese: マスクはずしてよ、石川さん
synopsis:
Ishikawa-san, the girl in the neighbouring seat, wears a mask no matter what she is doing. One day, Izawa catches sight of her face without a mask and begins wanting to see it more and more... Masked or unmasked, it's a cute romantic comedy!

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Perfect Fit
synopsis:
Mashimo is a senior in university, wondering whether he should apply to the school's graduate program. Intending to collect papers to aid him in the decision, he goes to his professor's office only to find a new face greeting him at the door. Mashimo later finds out that the strange man he met in the office earlier is Yuuto Tanaka, a first-year star graduate student from another university. Mashimo quickly realizes that the personality he sees when he sees Tanaka is not the same personality that everybody else sees. But one night, as Mashimo stumbles home and wanders into an unknown street, he runs into—is that Tanaka?!

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Youkai Ame Onna ni Yoru Kamikakushi
title_japanese: 妖怪雨女による神隠し
synopsis: A rain woman starts taking care of a child she found crying in the rain.

title: Inu no Nakumura
synopsis:
Isazuki village, where the Inugami belief is deeply rooted, the people of the construction company who came to investigate the Inugami shrine died while the village opinions were divided over redevelopment. Tsukiko Tachibana and three childhood friends who live in the village are involved in the incident while participating in the festival to send Inugami...?!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Kusogaki, Sassato Watashi ni Horero!
title_japanese: クソガキ、さっさと私に惚れろ！

title: Hiyori-chan no Onegai wa Zettai
title_english: When She Wish Upon a Planet
title_japanese: 日和ちゃんのお願いは絶対
synopsis:
Hiyori Hamure. From the moment she confessed her love to me, I thought we were going to spend our days as a normal couple. Until I learned of her special ability... This is a sweet and sad love story between a boy and a girl who has the power that will drag the whole world with it.

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Tropical-Rouge! Precure: Precure Collection
title_japanese: トロピカル～ジュ！プリキュア プリキュアコレクション

title: Aishite Hoshii to Itte Kure
title_japanese: 愛してほしいと言ってくれ
synopsis:
Self-made lawyer Yukitoshi Nakaso is reunited with Tomoe Gojou, his former college classmate, in court. After being headhunted by the law firm's director, Tomoe begins working at the same firm as Yukitoshi. However, after drinking too much at the welcoming party, they return to their office together, where Tomoe passionately gazes at Yukitoshi and makes advances on him. Unable to control himself, Yukitoshi bends Tomoe over and things escalate from there. Can love save the man chained down by his past? This is an office love story between a self-made man and a beautiful son from a rich family who is afraid to love!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Egao no Ura ni wa
synopsis:
Suzuta's a nurse living in hospital housing designated for singles only. He has to hide the younger half-brother he's been caring for. That is, until Dr. Tomioka discovers his secret. He pleads with his colleague to keep it between them. Dr. Tomioka agrees, but on one condition... that he and Suzuta become an official couple! Aggressive love between a mean-spirited doctor and soft-hearted nurse!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Koisuru Alpha no Sodatekata
title_english: How To Raise an Alpha You Love
title_japanese: 恋するアルファの育て方
synopsis:
The prominent Kamimura family treasures all of their talented descendants. But this isn't the case for Nio, the only omega in the Kamimuras' long unbroken line of alphas. When the death of his brother Reo and sister-in-law Ruri forces Nio back to the house he left behind, their newly orphaned sons remind Nio of his past - especially the older brother Suou, who inherited Nio's brother's abilities despite not sharing any of his blood. What happens when these unlikely almost-relatives begin a new life together?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Dramatic de Nani ga Warui
title_japanese: ドラマチックでなにが悪い
synopsis:
Haru and Kai are childhood friends, and their friendship is stronger than most. Haru likes hanging out with girls—they're cute, they're soft, and they smell good. But at the same time, he feels most at ease hanging out with Kai. One day, Haru stumbles upon Kai getting off while he calls Haru's name. Shocked at what he has seen, he becomes oddly intrigued with Kai. Two high school boys: an eligible bachelor and an outgoing pretty boy. A bittersweet story of a glittering young romance and more is about to unfold!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Sentimental Rodeo
title_japanese: センチメンタル・ロデオ
synopsis:
Kou is the number one actor in the gay adult video industry, and he has a secret longing for his cameraman, Shuuzou, who's like a partner to him. Kou's gay and Shuuzou's straight. That is a huge frustrating barrier for Kou and his feelings for Shuuzou keep welling up inside him. This eventually leads Kou to fantasize about Shuuzou as he's being filmed through Shuuzou's camera...

(Source: Renta!)

title: Aisaretagari no Shohousen
title_english: Prescription for a Lonely Boy Who Wants Love
title_japanese: 愛されたがりの処方箋
synopsis:
Kippei is a bum, flitting from one partner to another. When his girlfriend dumps him at a cafe, he notices the same thing happening with a male couple at the next table. Deciding to forget their misery together, Kippei and the average-looking dumpee, Sousuke, head to a hotel. Once there, Kippei is floored to see how aggressive Sousuke actually is. This is a heartrending, raunchy story about a playboy who's never known love and strait-laced doctor. The latter's unpredictable personality will make you faint!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Kimi no Namida wo Nomihoshitai
title_japanese: 君の涙を飲み干したい
synopsis:
Kippei is a high school boy feared for his mean look, but in reality, he's just a kind and gentle boy that cries a lot. Umegami is the beautiful and popular school idol, adored by many, however she also has a hidden side...  One day, their fates unexpectedly intertwine when cry baby Kippei asks her out expecting to be rejected...  A clumsy and unusual love story begins!

(Source: Comikey Media)

title: Tensei Ryoushu no Yuuryou Kaitaku: Zense no Kioku wo Ikashite White ni Tsutometara, Yuunou na Jinzai ga Atsumarisugimashita
title_english: Reborn as a Feudal Lord Gathering a Talented Elite So This Land Can Thrive by Employing My Past Life Experiences as an Overworked White-Collar Worker
title_japanese: 転生領主の優良開拓～前世の記憶を生かしてホワイトに努めたら、有能な人材が集まりすぎました～
synopsis:
When I woke up after collapsing from overwork working for a black company, I had been reborn as the son of a minor feudal lord in a different world. Our lands were attacked by monsters, I lost my new parents, and the people fled... In order to survive, I must gather a talented elite so this land can thrive by employing my knowledge from my past life as a overworked white-collar worker! A story of managing a fiefdom in another world starting from zero citizens!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: GT-giRl
synopsis:
In this world, the acquisition of a driver's license has been lowered to 16 years old due to the improvement of autonomous driving technology in automobiles. As such, high school students are excited about car racing. Hinata Satou is a second-year student who attends Mihama Girls' High School. She is gathering members to establish the automotive competition club.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Ore, Twintail ni Narimasu. π
title_japanese: 俺、ツインテールになります。π
synopsis:
Souji Mitsuka is an ordinary high school boy who has an obsession for twintails. One day he encounters a mysterious girl named Twoearle, who is from a parallel world, when monsters appear in his town and declare that all twintails in the world belong to them. These monsters feed off "attribute strength," the spiritual energy of humans. Twoearle entrusted Souji with Tail Gear, imaginary armor initiated by powerful twintail attributes. With the armor, Souji transforms into a girl and twintail warrior branded Tail Red, to protect Earth.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Boku dake no Romantist
title_japanese: 僕だけのロマンチスト
synopsis:
Shinobu Aizawa is already in his forties, but he works part-time as a security guard while pursuing his dream of becoming an archaeologist. One day, he is sent to work at a royal party venue and steps in to stop a fight, only the guy responsible for making the fuss turns out to be Aldo, the very prince who organized the party. Before Shinobu has a chance to understand what's going on, he's being dragged into the center of the room and introduced as the prince's fiance! This is a romantic love story between a bold and brazen young prince and a middle-aged dreamer by the popular manga artist Nerima zim!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Sensei no Iu Koto Kikinasai!
title_japanese: 先生の言うことききなさい!
synopsis:
Masaki Tsuji's a 30-something year old high school teacher as sincere as they come. His student, Souta Izumi, is in love with him. Through many twists and turns, Souta's earnest feelings eventually swayed Masaki and the two are now in a romantic relationship. Souta's dating Masaki, something he thought he only could've dreamed of. His fantasies are reigned in by Masaki, who forbids any kind of hanky-panky at school and sex until graduation! Forced to hold back right after attaining his love, Souta's jealousy builds day by day. Just then, Mr. Noda, the new school nurse, catches on to their relationship...

(Source: Renta!)

title: Usotsuki Android
title_japanese: うそつきアンドロイド
synopsis:
For new high school students, great first impressions are a must. Being the earnest boy that he is, Jun Iriomote presents himself to his new classmates as someone who loves androids and robots. Next in line, Yuzu Tokashiki has to quickly think of a way to create an impression on Jun, the boy she has loved since middle school. With no hesitation at all, Yuzu decides to introduce herself as an android. Although her classmates doubt her words, they swiftly believe her upon seeing her remain completely emotionless.

However, this maiden in love is not as dull as she appears to be. She is simply a reserved and normal girl, and only her friend Miyako Aguni knows how truly expressive Yuzu is. Now, Yuzu must continue to fool everyone into believing she is a real android and, with the power of love and impressive new gadgets, win over her crush!

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

Included one-shot:
Volume 3: Agent BBA

title: Dungeon Busters: Chuunen Otoko desu ga Niwa ni Dungeon ga Shutsugen shita node Sekai wo Sukuimasu
title_japanese: ダンジョン・バスターズ ～中年男ですが庭にダンジョンが出現したので世界を救います～
synopsis:
Clear all the dungeons! There are 666 of them and 10 years to do it. If not, the only thing that awaits...is total annihilation. Kazuhiko Ezoe suddenly finds a mysterious underground space in his yard. When he steps into what turns out to be the very first dungeon in this world, he ends up activating the Dungeon System and learns from the mysterious beauty who appears to him, Akane, that the world is doomed to destruction if the 666 total dungeons that will be appearing in this world are not all cleared within 10 years. As countries begin taking measures in response to the dungeons appearing all over the world, Ezoe seeks out companions together with whom he establishes Dungeon Busters Inc., a company dedicated to clearing all the dungeons in the world! The curtains rise on this dungeon-delving epic with overwhelming realism!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Choppiri Ecchi na Sanshimai demo, Oyomesan ni Shitekuremasu ka?
title_japanese: ちょっぴりえっちな三姉妹でも、お嫁さんにしてくれますか?
synopsis:
The three sisters of a distinguished family have perverted hobbies?! Erotic and cute sisters in this romantic comedy manga~

"Live with the three popular sisters at school, and teach them how to become suitable brides!" Tenma Ichijou is a high school student who has fallen onto bad times. He is approached by the sisters' doting, high-ranking father, who proposes a strange job. However, all three sisters have strange (perverted) hobbies...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Shachiku Dungeon Master no Shokudou Keiei: Danjite Shijou Saiaku no Maou nado dewa Nai!!
title_english: Company Slave Dungeon Master's Diner Management
title_japanese: 社畜ダンジョンマスターの食堂経営 ～断じて史上最悪の魔王などでは無い!!～
synopsis:
A corporate drone is summoned to another world to become a dungeon master, whereupon he turns his dungeon into a restaurant.

(Source: MU)

title: Mizuki-senpai no Koi Uranai
synopsis:
High school second-year Soujiro Sakagami is late for school one day, when he is given a ride by a mysterious girl who looks like a third-year, and claims that her fortunes are 100% accurate. She declares that he is fated to be with a girl younger than him... but little does he know that she's referring to herself! So begins a comedy of love between the fumbling Mizuki-"senpai" and clueless Sakagami!

(Source: Comikey Media)

title: Death Note Tanpenshuu
synopsis:
A collection of short stories about Death Note.

1. C Kira-hen (C-Kira)
2. a Kira-hen (a-Kira)
3. Death Note ni Rakugaki 4-koma (Death Note Four-Panel Comics)
4. L: Day One
5. L: The Wammy's House
6. Kagami Tarou-hen (Taro Kagami)

title: Erotomaniac Play
title_japanese: エロトマニアックプレイ
synopsis:
Haruki is a school nurse by day, natural-born manhunter by night. Lately, though, he hasn't been able to catch any prey. As his frustration reaches a boiling point, he is approached by a mysterious young man named Shion. "Give it up. I'm only gonna stop you." Haruki laughs this off, believing it to be some kind of immature revenge plot. Shion seizes this opportunity to push Haruki down and bind his hands. In a state of rapture, Shion says, "I've been told I'm pretty good. So, all you gotta do is sit back and take it." Despite not usually being on the receiving end, Haruki can't help but lose himself to the pleasure...!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Danball Senki Gaiden
synopsis:
1. Danball Senki Kaidou Jin Gaiden
2. Danball Senki Boost Gaiden
3. Danball Senki Wars Gaiden

title: Himesama Sore wa Seisui desu ka?
title_japanese: 姫様それは聖水ですか？

title: Maou no Jinji
synopsis:
Iguel is an elite demon who is in charge of protecting the seventh dungeon of the Demon King's castle. Her dream is to become one of the four heavenly kings of the Demon King's army. But her sudden transfer destination was the Demon Resources Department!?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Masaka Anoko ga Konna Koto
title_english: A Girl Like Her? Doing Stuff Like That?!
title_japanese: まさかあの娘がコンナコト
synopsis:
1. Masaka Anoko ga Konna Koto: Natsu-hen
2. Masaka Anoko ga Konna Koto: Tennis Musume-hen

title: Paradise Gakuen
synopsis:
Paradise Gakuen's annual competition Miss Paradise is coming soon! But a major incident occurred: one of the girls who hoped to be a contestant, Chihiro, had her precious part seen by a boy! Chihiro, who holds a principle that she won't let anyone other than her husband to see her naked, wants to become Shiba's wife. Because the latter didn't believe her intention, she decides to prove it, by entering the annual competition!

(Source: MU)

title: Paid
synopsis:
Heejae is the youngest executive director of the Jinhwa Group, nicknamed the "Chaebol Prince" by the public. But his life is turned upside down when documents linking him to an embezzlement scheme are found by an accounting student, Taekyung! To make sure the secret stays that way, Heejae pretends to have a crush on him, but... is there more to Taekyung than meets the eye? Watch sparks fly as this chaebol rom-com begins!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Nali Lai de Da Baobei
authors: Wen Ren Niao Shi Duo|Wuxian, Zuoye|Yayoshi
synopsis:
Yiyun, an aspiring actor, is also a single father raising Rourou on his own- a baby with superpowers he gave "birth" to, with the help of science. But a rich man suddenly barges into their lives claiming that Rourou, is in fact, his son. Just who is this crazy man, and whose baby is Rourou!?

(Source: Copin Communications)

title: Botabota
synopsis:
In a certain food container factory, suggestive rumors about Mako Higari say that she will sleep with anybody. Her coworker Kinoshita believes this, so testing his luck, he strikes up a conversation with Mako, and the two eventually end up in a hotel room.

Soon, the pair are ready to have sexual intercourse. However, the night quickly does not go as planned—while engaged in the act, a stream of blood suddenly gushes out of Mako's nose! Mako explains this frequently occurs whenever she comes into physical contact with anything impure. Finding it unsettling, Kinoshita runs away and leaves Mako back at square one.

Botabota follows Mako's journey toward obtaining a normal life where all her unfulfilled desires are achieved—which proves difficult when everyone and everything she touches is filthy one way or another.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

Included one-shot: Shirohige to Boin (White Beard and Boobs)

title: AI Kareshi to Mojo Hakase
synopsis:
Due to a request, the genius Dr. Sumiko developed an "AI boyfriend". Sumiko is pleased with her success, but the AI boyfriend began to recognize her as "his girlfriend"...!? Initially, Sumiko rejected the AI boyfriend. However, being subject to his constant love gradually leads her to acknowledge him...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Baskerville-ke no Seiryaku Kekkon
title_english: The Marriage of Convenience Mr. Baskerville
title_japanese: バスカヴィル家の政略結婚
synopsis:
Baskerville, the family of tragedy.

Sophia, the daughter of a wealthy family, is to marry Gwyn Baskerville, the young heir of the Baskerville family who succeeded the title at the mere age of thirteen. After the recent death of his family, Gwyn, the "tragedy boy" was thrown into the public eye. Although Sofia manages to establish a good relationship with Gwyn, she holds a secret that, when uncovered, will keep everyone away.

This is the tale of a boy seeking the truth of his family's death and a girl who can see the dead as their bond grows deeper and deeper.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Korogaru Onna to Koi no Numa
title_english: She Is Rolling and Fall in Love.
synopsis:
My motto is "continue as you are." What will my precious life become once it starts to change?

(Source: Shodensha, translated)

title: Sakkon no Cinderella wa Kutsu wo Otosanai.
title_english: Modern Cinderella Does Not Drop Shoes.
title_japanese: 昨今のシンデレラは靴を落とさない。
synopsis:
In the middle of a grand ball, my fiancé cancelled the engagement. The reason was... I tried to avoid the cancellation of the engagement, but it wasn't meant to be. An unfortunate pitiful lady and a stubborn general.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Haikei "Koori no Kishi to Hazure-hime" Datta Watashitachi e
title_english: Dear Sir, to Us Who Were "Ice Knight and Mediocre Princess"
title_japanese: 拝啓「氷の騎士とはずれ姫」だったわたしたちへ
synopsis:
The sickly and socially withdrawn Princess Ridelle fell in love with the quick-witted knight, Sir Oscar and became his wife. But after finding out that Oscar didn't wish for the marriage, their marriage life became no different than a pile of misfortunes.

Soon, Ridelle was struck down by another tragedy, changing both of their lives tremendously, but...

This is the love story between a former princess who was looked down upon as "the Failure Princess," and the young count known as "the Ice Knight"—the crossing of their paths weaving tragedies in their wake.

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Konyaku Kaihi no Tame, Koe wo Dasanai to Kimemashita!!
title_japanese: 婚約回避のため、声を出さないと決めました!!
synopsis:
Altina who's fond of books starts pretending to be a mute in order to escape the imposed image of her as a "perfect lady" role that's set-up by her older brother and older sisters. However, that being said, that pretend act will soon be discovered by no other than the head librarian, sir Shijar himself?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Tensei shitara 15-sai no Ouhi deshita: Moto Shachiku no Watashi ga, Toshishita no Kokuou Heika ni Semarareteimasu!?
title_english: Reincarnated as a 15-Year-Old Queen: I'm an Ex-office Worker, but the Young King Is Interested in Me?!
title_japanese: 転生したら15歳の王妃でした～元社畜の私が、年下の国王陛下に迫られています!?～
synopsis:
I'm Saeki Emi, 28 years old. After I died from overworking, I was reincarnated and opened my eyes in the body of a 15-year-old queen. I have a husband (His Majesty, the King) but... He's only 17 years old! After I reincarnated, I thought I'd be pampered and live a life of luxury. But his Majesty said, "A reincarnator's life is likely to be targeted." (As you can see, my identity was discovered.) The original personality of her reincarnated body, Emilia, also appears as a ghost. Somehow, my second life is difficult and full of drama? I was released from being a corporate slave. This time, I thought I could live a relaxed and peaceful life...! 

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Underskin
synopsis:
As the private secretary of Congressman Kawada, Hirose has numerous duties, including: handling correspondence, managing his employer's engagements, and turning a blind eye to the old man's extramarital affairs. However, he finds it difficult to overlook the latest youth being bedded by Kawada. When their gazes first meet, the young man glares at him with poorly concealed hostility, and Hirose cannot explain why he would be immediately hated.

Wishing to know about Akira Tano's past prior to his involvement with the congressman, Hirose uncovers a suspicious suicide linked to fraud and embezzlement. Intent on warning Akira away from Kawada, Hirose suddenly finds himself being seduced in the old man's stead.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Isekai no Sata wa Shachiku Shidai
title_english: The Other World's Books Depend on the Bean Counter
title_japanese: 異世界の沙汰は社畜次第
synopsis:
Already at his wit's end, 29-year-old corporate slave Seiichirou Kondou suddenly witnesses the ground opening up and swallowing a woman. Amid his efforts to save her, the two are transported to another world. He soon learns that the people in this world summoned a saint to save their kingdom from a plague. As compensation for dragging Kondou into the mess, the kingdom assures him that they will provide him with a comfortable life and fulfill any of his desires. To everyone's surprise, Kondou asks for a job.

After successfully becoming an accountant at the Royal Palace, Kondou devotes himself to his new post. His accurate and thorough work catches the attention of various high-ranking officials and knights, especially Aresh Indolark, the cold-hearted Knight Captain. As Kondou adjusts to his new exhausting and dangerous environment, he begins to find solace in the company of Aresh, whose icy demeanor may be just a facade.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Tanpopo no Watage
synopsis:
3 sole men are what make up the Yamagiwa family. 4-year-old Haruki is embraced by his easy going dad and his good big brother. Under their wings, Haruki is growing up little by little.

(Source: MU)

Included one-shots:
Volume 1: Ohisama no Kuni

title: Youkai Daisensou: Guardians
title_japanese: 妖怪大戦争 ガーディアンズ
synopsis:
After giant kaiju threaten to destroy Japan, the guardian spirits of the nation, known as 'Yokai' appear before the young boy Kei... They tell him he is the descendant of the legendary monster slayer Watanabe no Tsuna, and may be the only person who can stop the catastrophe. The Great Yokai War: Guardians is the epic manga adaptation of the hit movie!

(Source: Titan Comics)

title: Zassou Reijou wa Tousouchuu!: Kono Tabi, Kishidan no Makanai-gakari wo Haimei shimashita
title_japanese: 雑草令嬢は逃走中！～このたび、騎士団のまかない係を拝命しました～

title: Haga-kun wa Kamaretai
title_japanese: 羽賀くんは噛まれたい
synopsis:
Prisoner Haga was tired of his boring life in jail and thought of staging a jailbreak! Just at that moment, an alpha prison officer was assigned to him...?

(Source: Rose Squad Scans)

title: Seijo ja Nakatta node, Oukyuu de Nonbiri Gohan wo Tsukuru Koto ni Shimashita
title_japanese: 聖女じゃなかったので、王宮でのんびりご飯を作ることにしました
synopsis:
Rina, who came to another world by summoning a saint is surprised at the unpleasant taste of rice. Even the royal palace has this taste...? "I will make it myself, so lend me a kitchen!" Freed from the role of a saint, Rina grabs the hearts and stomachs of the royal family with delicious food!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kikaijikake no Marie
synopsis:
Wealthy, handsome, and successful, Arthur Louis Zetes is no stranger to the greed of people. Constantly doubting those around him, he has no faith in humanity; thus, he makes a request for the perfect maid—a robot maid. However, his butler is unable to acquire such a servant due to technological limitations, so he finds the next best substitute.

Marie Evans is a former child prodigy in martial arts known for her lack of expression. Drowning in debt, she readily accepts the offer to be a maid that acts like a robot. While Arthur is often blunt toward humans, he cannot help but dote on his personal robot; in turn, Marie is moved by his drive and consideration toward her.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Shinyuu Ouji to Koshiginchaku: Oshi no Ouji ni Kyuukon Sarete Komattemasu
title_japanese: 親友王子と腰巾着～推しの王子に求婚されて困ってます～
synopsis:
I was cursed to become a woman in place of the prince, and then he proposed to me!? My best friend from childhood, the high-spec Prince Vincent, and me, his follower Renoa. Though I've always been a loyal yes-man... Even if you're taking responsibility for me, I can't accept that proposal! The infatuating love story between a troublesome prince and his scapegoat attendant!

(Source: Flex Comix, translated)

title: Juujin Taichou no (Kari) Konyaku Jijou
title_japanese: 獣人隊長の(仮)婚約事情
synopsis:
A member of the beastkin nobility and the heir to the Bearwolf Marquis, Leold, suddenly bites Katie on the shoulder, branding her with a "Mark of Proposal." Katie, who was crossdressed at the time, is mistaken as a male and dragged into being his fiancée for a few years until the mark disappears... But the two have the worst relationship...! What is this? A form of courtship?!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Ask Affection
title_japanese: アスク・アフェクション
synopsis:
Hiroto Kikuma's into men and he hates how his good looks are nothing but a curse because he only attracts guys who want him for his body and appearance. He gets pissed off when his latest ex-boyfriend follows this same pattern and he ends up dead drunk and passed out on the street. Then, is the person who finds and takes care of him the extremely popular male adult film star, Issa Okami...!?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Zutaboro Reijou wa Ane no Moto Konyakusha ni Dekiai sareru
title_japanese: ずたぼろ令嬢は姉の元婚約者に溺愛される
synopsis:
Marie has spent her life living under her sister's shadow as the two grew up in an impoverished baron's home. Every nice thing went to Marie's sister, leaving her without even a proper dress! And right when her sister was being married off to a wealthy Earl–tragedy strikes and Marie's sister is killed en route. With the dowry already spent, it's decided that Marie will take her sister's place and become the Earl's betrothed. But, when she gets there, she finds there's been a serious mix-up—the proposal was a total misunderstanding! Can Marie win the heart of the handsome Earl, or is she destined to live a life without a single nice thing?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Koi Utau Chou wa Yotsu Hana ni Mau
title_english: The Love-Chanting Butterfly Flutters in the Petals
title_japanese: 恋唄う蝶は四つ花に舞う
synopsis:
Located in the north, south, east, and west, just like flower petals. Those four kingdoms that border each other are known as "The Four Blossoms." In each of these four kingdoms, there are saints who are called as "Butterflies of the Four Blossoms." The Butterfly of the West, Carnelia is about to visit the Southern Kingdom for the first time as her duty. What awaits her there, is...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Togetoge
synopsis:
In modern Japan, the strength of this world has horns on their heads, while, like the weak, these horns are broken. Sumio, a high school student, is in the hospital with an incurable disease, because of which he does not have much time left in this world. And in addition, his horn is not intact or broken, it is cracked for some reason.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Yoteigai Kekkon: Wakeari Reijou wa Outaishihi ni Erabarete
title_japanese: 予定外結婚 ～訳あり令嬢は王太子妃に選ばれて～

title: From Another World
title_japanese: フロム・アナザー・ワールド

title: Home
synopsis:
After years of battling the stubborn odds against them, Hikaru Kusakabe and Rihito Sajou are at last living together. Inside their modest apartment, there is now plenty to experience for the first time. Between sharing one coffee mug and learning each other's food preferences, Kusakabe and Sajou are growing ever closer—and very soon, they have issues just keeping their hands to themselves.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Chiya-kun wa Joucho Fuantei
title_japanese: 地屋くんはじょうちょふあんてい
synopsis:
"Don't hold back. You can come all you want."

For Chiya, who's just an unstable guy, his younger boyfriend Kei is like a sedative. Even when things go badly, Kei pampers Chiya like no other and makes him feel better and ready to face another day. Aware that he's a poor communicator and unusually shy, Chiya realizes one day that he has never honestly told Kei how he feels about him and starts to worry that the younger man might fall out of love with him and leave. Is he just a convenient partner for Kei? Chiya would simply die if that's what Kei thought about him. "Just you wait... because I love you, too...!"

A super-sweet yaoi about a gentle, optimistic darling and a shy guy who can't get over his awkwardness.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Aniki no Ichiban Oishii Tokoro
title_japanese: 兄貴の一番おいしいところ
synopsis:
Azuma Sakuragi is deeply in love... with his twin brother, Miyabi! Miyabi is a pure genius at archery, but pretty much useless at everything else. You would think Azuma would be fed up with taking care of him all the time, but instead, he's happy to spend as much time with Miyabi as he can... until one day, the A.C. in Miyabi's room breaks down, and Miyabi has to sleep in Azuma's room... and share his bed! Can Azuma keep himself from secretly touching his brother?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Konyaku Haki wo Mochikakerarete Juusuunen, Soko made Iu nara Haki shimashou!
title_japanese: 婚約破棄を持ちかけられて十数年、そこまで言うなら破棄しましょう！
synopsis:
Diana Bailey, the daughter of the Duke, has been sentenced to abandon her engagement many times since she was a child. Diana has been honing herself in response to Prince Robert's request each time, but one day she was told that he would be "relieved and calm" with another woman...!?

A work published in Though I May Be a Villainess, I'll Show You I Can Obtain Happiness! is getting a short-term serialization due to it's popularity! A romantic comedy with Prince Robert's sister, Princess Lizzie, and her fiancé Sergio is about to begin!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Akuyaku Reijou no Shitsuji-sama: Hametsu Flag wa Ore ga Tsubusasete Itadakimasu
title_english: The Villainess' Butler: Death Flag Destroyer at Your Service
title_japanese: 悪役令嬢の執事様 破滅フラグは俺が潰させていただきます
synopsis:
Regaining the memories of his previous life, Cyril realized that he was an otome game's character, the villainous daughter Sophia's butler. At the rate things were going, Sophia would eventually have the prince stolen away from her by the heroine, fall into darkness, and be executed. Wanting to save the villainous daughter he was so fond of, Cyril moved to eliminate all the factors that would cause her to fall into darkness, raising her up to be a talented and beautiful girl who could win the prince's love, however...

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Hakushaku-sama wa Otenba Reijou wo Goshomou desu
title_japanese: 伯爵様はお転婆令嬢をご所望です
synopsis:
Emilia is the beloved daughter of a renowned Earl. As such, she's expected to be a lady, through and through. But the truth is, Emilia is a tomboy who likes horseback riding and hunting. One day, after slipping out to go hunting, she stumbles into territory belonging to another lord and runs into none other than the young Earl Freed. Freed finds himself attracted to Emilia's lightheartedness and offers her a proposal: a limited-time, contractual marriage. "Why don't you marry me?" Emilia accepts, but what awaits her in marriage is arguments over bloodlines, and a warning over someone's title?!

(Source: NTT Solmare)

title: Aneue. Skirt wo Makutte Mata wo Hiraite Misete Kuremasen ka?
title_english: Why Don't You Lift Up That Skirt and Show Me Yours, Sister?
title_japanese: 姉上。スカートをまくって股を開いて見せてくれませんか？
synopsis:
Loretta Shelgram's adoptive brother, Alt Dinertoll, is on the hunt for the mysterious lady he slept with after the recent masquerade ball. All he can recall are the feelings of bliss from when he held her and a distinctive birthmark on her upper thigh. He is completely unaware that the very lady he is searching for is Loretta!

Although she is aware of this fact, Loretta is afraid to reveal it due to her adversarial relationship with Alt. She has always been one who has trouble putting her thoughts into words; instead, everything she says somehow has a rude edge. As new love rivals put a strain on the siblings' relationship, Loretta and Alt will have to properly express themselves if they want their own happy ending together.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Maou-sama ni Parfait wo Tsukuttara Yorokobaremashita
title_english: Mr. Devil Rejoiced When I Made Parfait.
title_japanese: 魔王様にパフェを作ったら喜ばれました
synopsis:
Cruz reincarnated in the lower demons of the demon world. Cruz, who was aiming for a first-class pastry chef in her previous life, is just confused by the world where there is only black food.

Still, she touched the kindness of the demons around her—"I want to make the demon world happy with sweets!" Deciding so, she completed the first "parfait" in the demon world with limited materials. The demons are instantly captivated by the sweets they eat for the first time! Furthermore, she was called by the strongest Demon Lord in history who heard the rumor...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Angula Blue
synopsis:
Yuuya's secret fetish is his love of wearing women's lingerie. As Yuuya stares into a lingerie store window on his way home from work, he bumps into his old high-school classmate, Kazuaki. Yuuya's obviously flustered state piques Kazuaki's curiosity, and a few days later, he pops the big question. "So, Yuuya, do you like wearing women's lingerie?"

(Source: Renta!)

Included one-shots: Yoru Gentei no Kare (My Nighttime-Only Boyfriend), Ore ga Shitteiru Kare no Koto (What I Know About Him)

title: Senran Freaks
synopsis: The story takes place in the Sengoku period and follows a boy who dreams of unifying the world using the power of his blood, which can revive the dead.

title: Senwaku Porno
synopsis:
The top star in the adult movie industry, Takumi, is proud of the fact he's a professional and can get it up no matter who he his partner is. Lately, the movie producers' requests have become very hardcore, and his new video is an all-boys' night of fun with the top model and a cross-dresser. Takumi isn't sure about filming the video... but doing it with the model Kai actually feels pretty good. Just as Takumi is filled with regret when he loses himself while filming, Kai asks him if he would be willing to pretend to be his boyfriend...

(Source: Renta!)

title: Ijime no Kejime
synopsis:
A black notebook arrived for Amano, a high school teacher. What was spelled out there was the story of fierce bullying that one of the students who Amano was in charge of received. After 17 years, Amano, who quit teaching, continued to search for the student who was a victim of bullying, but he has yet to find out where he is. At that time, his classmates at that time began to be killed one after another...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Tensei shita Daiseijo wa, Seijo de Aru Koto wo Hitakakusu
title_english: A Tale of the Secret Saint
title_japanese: 転生した大聖女は、聖女であることをひた隠す
synopsis:
Fia always dreamed of becoming a knight. Born into a family of knights, she's the least talented among them, but she still clutches to her hope and trains with everything she has. When the day comes for her to slay a small demon and prove her worth, she ends up face to face with a dragon instead! A deadly injury makes her life flash before her eyes... and she suddenly remembers her former life, when she was a powerful Saint in a bygone era who defeated the Demon King. That life ended in pain because of who she was, making her fear ever becoming a Saint again. Now that the magic from her previous life has been rekindled, she may become a more powerful knight than she ever dreamed–if only she can survive long enough!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Akuyaku Reijou, Cecilia Sylvie wa Shinitakunai node Dansou suru Koto ni Shita.
title_japanese: 悪役令嬢、セシリア・シルビィは死にたくないので男装することにした。
synopsis:
After being reincarnated as the villainess of her favorite dating sim, Cecilia Sylvie realizes she's slated for an untimely demise no matter how the game's story unfolds. Convinced she can cheat death by assuming a new identity, she becomes Cecil Admina, the dashing son of a baron. Unfortunately, Cecilia adapts to the role a little too well-and ends up replacing her brother as one of the knights who protects the heroine! To top it all off, the prince betrothed to Cecilia is now catching feelings for her alter ego...?! This villainess will do whatever it takes to achieve a carefree life, but if her guise ever slips, it's Game Over!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Otto ga Uwaki wo Shita naraba?
title_japanese: 夫が浮気をしたならば？

title: Death Ball
synopsis:
This may seem just like baseball, but when you can switch out the bats for weapons and the balls for bullets, is it even still just a "game"? When idol Yuki Tengoku accidentally throws an unbelievable pitch, she gets invited to play for the lowest-ranked Death Ball, team Dangerous. But when she's dropped right into a game where nothing is off-limits, everyone has superpowers and special moves, and any wrong move could lose her uniform – is her uncontrollable hard fastball "Titanic" enough to keep her afloat?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Jijo nanoni... Seiken wo Nuite Shimatta!
title_english: I'm a Maid, but I've Pulled Out the Holy Sword?!
title_japanese: 侍女なのに…聖剣を抜いてしまった!
synopsis:
When I pulled out the holy sword, I noticed the handsome prince?!

Eleanor, a maid who works at the royal palace, pulls out the holy sword of the legendary goddess, which is given to the hero who protects the country from the demon king, which no one could pull out for a thousand years. However, now is a peaceful era that does not require the success of heroes. If you become a hero, you will lose your job?! I'm going to assume that I didn't gently put the holy sword back, but I was found by a handsome but unfriendly prince...

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Tsuihou sareta Akuyaku Reijou desu ga, Mofumofu-tsuki!? Slow Life Hajimemashita
title_english: The Simple Life of an Ex-Villainess (With a Fluffy Friend?!)
title_japanese: 追放された悪役令嬢ですが、モフモフ付き!?スローライフはじめました
synopsis:
Irene, who has reincarnated as a villain daughter in the world of otome games, is banished from the school according to the scenario of the game by the trick of the evil heroine. However, Irene, who has dreamed of spending a second life in the countryside leisurely and quietly, is delighted with the expulsion!

Immediately, she decided to move to My Berry Village, a famous strawberry producing area, but for some reason her classmates Cargo and Luke will go with her?

(Source: Starts Shuppan, translated)

title: Akuyaku Reijou desu ga Kouryaku Taishou no Yousu ga Ijou Sugiru @comic
title_english: I Was Reincarnated as the Villainess in an Otome Game but the Boys Love Me Anyway!
title_japanese: 悪役令嬢ですが攻略対象の様子が異常すぎる＠COMIC
synopsis:
Mystia Aren is the daughter of a noble family who just started at high school. She's surrounded by a group of adoring classmates and her charming fiancé. Everything seems perfect.

Except that this world is actually a dating sim called "Kyun Love," and she's destined to become the main character's evil rival! Mystia is determined to do everything she can to avoid her fate but it's not as easy as it sounds. Especially when all the boys keep falling in love with her!

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Otome Game Tensou, Ore ga Heroine de Kyuuseishu!?
title_japanese: 乙女ゲー転送、俺がヒロインで救世主!?
synopsis:
Tarou, a high school boy has been transferred as a heroine to a fantasy stage otome game because of his sister. He unintentionally raises the liking of the handsome guys who are the targets of the otome game, is about to enter the love route with the handsome guys...!

Can he really return to the original world? And will Tarou's chastity be protected?

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Uchi no Ojousama ga Hametsu End shika Nai Akuyaku Reijou no You nanode Ore ga Kyuusai Shitai to Omoimasu.
title_english: My Not-So-Fair Lady is Doomed! (But Not If I Can Help It)
title_japanese: うちのお嬢様が破滅エンドしかない悪役令嬢のようなので俺が救済したいと思います。
synopsis:
I'm a otome game capture character?

One day, Vincent, the deacon of the Countess, suddenly remembered that this world was a maiden game in the previous life, and that her beloved daughter died as a villain daughter...!?
