synopsis:
Yuuri, a 30-year-old housewife who was unilaterally abandoned in marriage, suddenly gets lost in a different world. She, who was introduced to the work of potion harvesting by an S-class adventurer and gradually got used to life in a different world, realized the ridiculous secret of the harvested potion. The potion without the recovery function that she thought was off was actually soy sauce. In addition, dishes made with it have a bonus of correction function! Will Yuuri's dishes change the common sense of the other world?

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Villains Are Destined to Die
synopsis:
The latest otome game is all the rage recently, so a regular university student decides to see for herself if its fame is well-deserved. She clears the normal mode in no time and finds herself pitying the villainess, Penelope Eckhart. Penelope is a fake―a replacement for the duke's missing daughter, the protagonist of the game.

Initially confident about clearing the hard mode as well, the woman is shocked by the sheer leap in the level of difficulty, eventually passing out from exhaustion. However, when she wakes up, she no longer recognizes her surroundings, for she has been reincarnated into the body of the villainess!

In a world where everyone seems to be out for her blood, Penelope must make wise decisions that keep her away from the death route. A tyrant prince, a suspicious magician, a nobleman from a fallen nation, or one of her nasty adoptive brothers―whose affections will she win?

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Akumu kara Mezameta Gouman Reijou wa Yarinaoshi wo Mosakuchuu
title_japanese: 悪夢から目覚めた傲慢令嬢はやり直しを模索中

title: Akuyaku Reijou no Taida na Tameiki
title_japanese: 悪役令嬢の怠惰な溜め息
synopsis:
I was reincarnated as a villainess from an otome game I was playing. At this rate, I'll be exiled for being in the heroine's way of conquering love. However, in this world... there are no entertainment materials! No doujinshis, no otome games, no smartphone! I'm really bored! Of course, I should be avoiding the destructive bad end...but before that I'm going to die from boredom!

"If there's no entertainment, just create it!"

Using the knowledge from my past life to create toys and romance novels, I'll make this boring world fun! After becoming the queen's favorite entrepreneur, I thought this scenario change will bring me to my wonderful future...but now the novel I wrote has brought me to the destruction flag?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Akuyaku Reijou no Yakuwari wa Oemashita
title_english: My Role As The Villainess Is Over!
title_japanese: 悪役令嬢の役割は終えました
synopsis:
Yukino Amaishi signed a contract with God to save her sister. She was then reborn in a different world as Lefina Eilferia, the daughter of a duke and the Crown Prince's fiancée. After successfully completing the objective of giving the heroine and the prince a happy end, Lefina, who played the role of the villainess, ends up working in the castle as a maid.

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title: Koyoi, Lorenzi-ke de Kanbi Naru Chuusei wo
title_japanese: 今宵、ロレンツィ家で甘美なる忠誠を
synopsis:
Rita was born with a golden eye, a rare and coveted trait that has all but vanished from the face of the earth. She was captured to be sold as a slave, and owing to her trauma, Rita lost her ability to speak. On the night she is about to be auctioned, Rita is saved by a charismatic young man and his accomplice who expertly dispatch the slavers that pursue them.

In the safety of a boat, Rita's mysterious savior introduces himself as Albert Lorenzi, the leader of a mafia organization. With terror blooming in her chest, Rita realizes that although she was rescued from a miserable life of slavery at the hands of the wealthy, she has ended up amid far more dangerous people. Nonetheless, the true surprise comes when Albert declares that he has stolen Rita away from her terrible fate to make her his bride!

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Shoushin Koushaku Reijou Layla no Touhikou
title_japanese: 傷心公爵令嬢レイラの逃避行
synopsis:
I will never let you escape.

On the day she woke up from a two-year coma caused by an accident, Layla learned that her engagement with the crown prince had been abandoned. He has already been engaged to Layla's sister Rose, and she is said to have a child. What happened to the days of sacrificing everything and enduring rigorous daughter education... Waiting for Layla, who escaped from the prince's family, was a marriage proposal from a legendary magician. But the prince, who should have fallen out of love with her, is still holding on to her!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Akuyaku Reijou, Shomin ni Ochiru
title_english: Lady Villain Fell Into a Common Person
title_japanese: 悪役令嬢、庶民に堕ちる
synopsis:
A salaryman was suddenly killed one day. When he woke up, for some reason he became Kotone Kisaragi, the selfish daughter of a famous family. Taking over the life of the daughter who was disowned by her parents' house, he decided to lead a normal daily life. However, because of the original Kotone, he can't live a normal life!

(Source: Gentosha, translated)

title: Watashi Konotabi, Oukoku Kishidan Dokushinryou no Kaseifu wo Suru Koto ni Narimashita
title_japanese: 私この度、王国騎士団独身寮の家政婦をすることになりました
synopsis:
Azusa Suzuhara moves to another world on the way home from overtime! In dangerous places, she was helped by handsome and beautiful knights, and was treated as like a princess. Even though she a has hobby of saving money, she is loved by the knights and the handsome prince?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Otomege no Mob desura Nain da ga
title_english: I'm Not Even an NPC In This Otome Game!
title_japanese: 乙女ゲーのモブですらないんだが
synopsis:
Taichi reincarnated in the world of otome games as a gardener apprentice. However, there is no such character in the original game... A story of interaction and growth woven by the daughter of the Duke, Lydia, and a boy who is not even a mob character.

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Boku wa Oneko-sama no Geboku desu.
title_japanese: 僕はお猫様の下僕です。
synopsis:
Izumi Yukihara, high school second year. His life is completely average-until a series of misfortunate events turn his life upside down. As if losing his parents weren't enough, he's saddled with their massive debt and forced to relocate to a new residence. On the bright side, the owners of his new residence offer him a chance to repay his debt...by serving cats?!

(Source: Yen Press)

Included one-shot:
Volume 2: Toritsuita Onryou ga Kawaisugite Shiawase desu (The Vengeful Ghost That Haunts Me Is So Cute, I Might Die of Happiness)

title: Futsutsuka na Akujo dewa Gozaimasu ga: Suuguu Chouso Torikae Den
title_english: Though I Am an Inept Villainess: Tale of the Butterfly-Rat Body Swap in the Maiden Court
title_japanese: ふつつかな悪女ではございますが ～雛宮蝶鼠とりかえ伝～
synopsis:
Within the Kingdom of Ei's opulent inner court is the thriving Maiden Court, where the empress and the four imperial consorts are chosen from five prominent clans. Among them, one pristine consort-in-training, Reirin Kou, stands out as the perfect candidate for the future empress. Her virtue and elegance are unrivaled, and she is flawless—save for her extremely sickly constitution. Compared to the court's gentle butterfly, the boorish Keigetsu Shu is like a sewer rat. Always staring at Reirin with bitter envy, Keigetsu is a disgrace to the Maiden Court.

During the night of a rare comet sighting, Keigetsu's jealousy reaches its peak, and she attempts to murder Reirin by pushing her off a balcony. Reirin is quickly saved from death, and Keigetsu is imprisoned to await her execution. Unbeknownst to all, Keigetsu has cast a spell to swap bodies with Reirin in order to steal all that belongs to her. But while Keigetsu is hindered by Reirin's frail body, Reirin fully embraces freedom and ph

title: Boku wa Konyaku Haki nante Shimasen kara ne
title_english: I'm Not Breaking Off the Engagement.
title_japanese: 僕は婚約破棄なんてしませんからね
synopsis:
"Ah... Ahhhhhhhhhhh!"

The one who's become the Crown Prince's fiancée is the Duke's daughter Serea, but during their first meeting, she screamed and collapsed! Had she remembered something from her previous life? Are you an evil villainess? Am I going to break you if I fool around too much? A me that's programmed to be like that, is so horrible. Isn't that right~ An "event" and those "program settings" have no connection to me though. Let's go back to my place and I'll slowly and sweetly make you fall desperately in love with me!

This otome game's villainess is going to follow a harsh path, and will fight to change her fate.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Munasawagi no Eve
synopsis:
Junichiro Nogi is a serious, stoic yet dull man at work and at home. Satoshi Miyamoto has a beautiful wife, a successful career, yet enjoys his extramarital relationships. Two men, both 40 years old, meet the women of their destinies. Nogi, tired of his job and family, spends time in his friend Asahina's apartment (who is currently away as an expat in a foreign country). He enjoys his alone-time, and manages to decompress there. Suddenly, a beautiful young woman named Ayami Fujimori appears at the apartment and says "Please make me your girlfriend" as she gives him a kiss...!?

(Source: Media Do International/Nihon Bungeisha)

title: Xiu Zhen Liaotian Qun
synopsis:
One day, Song Shuhang accidentally joined an online chat group filled with Xianxia-obsessed chuunis. They called each other "fellow daoists," had all sorts of strange usernames, and even referred to one their pets as a "demon dog." Some time later, however, Shuhang came to a realization. The other members of the group were actually real-life cultivators—the kind that move mountains and can live for thousands of years!

(Source: Webnovel)

title: Kou-2 ni Time Leap Shita Ore ga, Touji Suki datta Sensei ni Kokutta Kekka
title_japanese: 高２にタイムリープした俺が、当時好きだった先生に告った結果
synopsis:
I was a corporate worker in my 30s, when I woke up and found that I had time leaped to the spring of my second year of high school. At the time, there was a teacher that I had regretted not confessing to, so I confessed to her in the heat of the moment, and now we’re dating! However, the teacher is one who would make any man a good for nothing person, so I end up being spoiled by her a lot.

While secretly dating my overworked teacher (lover), a sweet school life filled with flirting awaits.

(Source: SB Creative, translated)

title: Isekai Tensei de Kenja ni Natte Boukensha Seikatsu: "Mahou Kairyou" de Isekai Saikyou
title_english: Become a Wise Man in Different World: Reincarnation and Adventurer Life
title_japanese: 異世界転生で賢者になって冒険者生活 ～【魔法改良】で異世界最強～
synopsis:
When Minato died in an unfortunate accident, he was reincarnated in a different world where magic was woefully underdeveloped. Superfluous magic circles. Barely working attack magics.

"What's with these inefficient magic?"

By getting rid of the excesses in the magic circle, the destructive capabilities of the magic can be multiplied! Furthermore, he creates the flawless Extreme magic with his own hands. With his boundless wisdom, Minato enhances magic beyond wonder. In no time, his magical powers and techniques outclassed anyone else's. In a world where magic was lost to the people, Minato is praised as an omnipotent wise man who controls all of the elements.

The tale of a wise man commanding the lost magic with overwhelming power starts now!

(Source: SB Creative, translated)

title: Isekai Kenja no Tensei Musou: Game no Chishiki de Isekai Saikyou
title_english: The Invincible Sage in the Second World.
title_japanese: 異世界賢者の転生無双 ～ゲームの知識で異世界最強～
synopsis:
A young man unfortunately died in the modern era, he reincarnated in another world under the name "Eldo," which also happened to be a world similar to a VRMMO game that he used to play in his previous life. However, it's a world where he knows the "basic skills." Eldo became a level 1 adventurer, playing as a "novice," but he knows the world better than anyone, and this is because of the "data he knows." Will the reincarnation in this world make him strong?

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Senmetsu Madou no Saikyou Kenja: Musai no Kenja, Madou wo Kiwame Saikyou e Itaru
title_english: The Strongest Sage: The Story of a Talentless Man Who Mastered Magic and Became the Best
title_japanese: 殲滅魔導の最強賢者 無才の賢者、魔導を極め最強へ至る
synopsis:
Despite being born with the crest that's most unsuited for battle, Gaius devoted his life to researching magic, and became the world's strongest mage. Still, he yearns for more formidable enemies, even though he's painfully aware of how powerless he would be against them. And so, he goes in search of allies. But who would be fitting for the strongest battle mage?! Meet Iris, the Dragon of Darkness in a young girl's body; Yuril, the Sorceress of Annihilation, known as the strongest in the kingdom; Reuter, the Demigod of the Blade, and his skills worthy of being praised in legends. Join these four as they go through battles that transcend imagination!!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Senmetsu Madou no Saikyou Kenja: Musai no Kenja, Madou wo Kiwame Saikyou e Itaru
title_japanese: 殲滅魔導の最強賢者 無才の賢者、魔導を極め最強へ至る

title: Oda Nobunaga to Iu Nazo no Shokugyou ga Mahou Kenshi yori Cheat Datta node, Oukoku wo Tsukuru Koto ni Shimashita
title_japanese: 織田信長という謎の職業が魔法剣士よりチートだったので、王国を作ることにしました
synopsis:
The greatest conqueror history's never seen!

At last, the time has come for the gods to bestow young Alsrod Nayvil with his official profession. As a minor feudal lord, Alsrod hopes he'll get a job impressive enough to let him step out of his older brother's shadow. However, he ends up with an unheard-of job called..."Oda Nobunaga?!"

It's not long before Alsrod learns the Oda Nobunaga entity involved is a famous conqueror from another world who will forever change his destiny! Now the young ruler has his sights set on greater endeavors?—namely, taking over the entire kingdom!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Sekai Saikyou no Fukushuu Shinkan: Kami ni Tsukaeshimono, Maou no Chikara wo Te ni Ireru
title_english: The Servant of God Gets the Power of the Demon King.
title_japanese: 世界最強の復讐神官 〜神に仕えし者、魔王の力を手に入れる〜
synopsis:
Raze was a prodigious priest who supported the legendary Hero. However, he was betrayed by the Hero with his party and sister was killed. He later absorbed the power of the Demon King and now seeks revenge on the Hero and the others that wronged him. The devastating revenge story of the priest who gained the power of the Demon King begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Strike the Blood: Append
title_japanese: ストライク・ザ・ブラッド APPEND
synopsis: A collection of short stories of Strike the Blood.

title: Magan to Dangan wo Tsukatte Isekai wo Buchinuku!
title_japanese: 魔眼と弾丸を使って異世界をぶち抜く！
synopsis:
Ataru, a young man who lost his life in an unfortunate case, receives three special powers from God and reincarnates into a different world. The strongest gun, the ability to create bullets freely, and the ability to see everything called "magic eyes." Ataru, who is the only gunner in this world, throws himself into an elite adventurer guild with the beast girl Caro who he rescued from slavery. The heroic story of a sniper who eliminates any enemy with a single blow starts here.

(Source: Hobby Japan, translated)

title: Fenrir Kaasan to Attaka Gohan: Isekai Mofumofu Seikatsu
title_japanese: フェンリル母さんとあったかご飯～異世界もふもふ生活～
synopsis:
Femrude is picked up by the legendary Fenrir as a baby. Originally Japanese, the reborn 12-year-old spends his days being spoiled by his beloved new mother, while being brought up with lots of love.

To give back to his precious family, he reproduces Japanese cuisine in this new world, one dish after another. To his surprise, not only his mother (Fenrir), but also the beastmen living in this world love his food.

Solving problems one after another with his honest, gentle character, and the skills to attract both races, he aims to become a bridge between the humans and the beastmen! Even magicians will jump! This fluffy gourmet fantasy is about to start!

(Source: MU)

title: Ore no Zense no Chishiki de Teihenshoku Tamer ga Joukyuushoku ni Natte Shimaisou na Ken
title_english: The Useless Tamer Will Turn into the Top Unconsciously by My Previous Life Knowledge.
title_japanese: 俺の前世の知識で底辺職テイマーが上級職になってしまいそうな件
synopsis:
Due to an accident, the protagonist Varius died and was reincarnated. He was shocked to find in this new world, his former job as a Tamer in the previous world was acknowledged as a low class job in this new world.

Utilizing his knowledge from his previous life as a basis, he then applied unique buffs to his beasts, taking back the ultimate power that he once possessed.

With this power in his hands, he sought to start his life as an adventurer. However...

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Seisan-shoku wo Kiwamesugitara Densetsu no Buki ga Ore no Yome ni Narimashita
title_japanese: 生産職を極め過ぎたら伝説の武器が俺の嫁になりました
serializations: Suiyoubi wa Mattari Dash X Comic
synopsis:
I walk in a different world with my strongest management and smithing ability!

I belonged to the management team of MMORPG "Armed Edda," and when I awoke one day, I was embraced by a red-haired girl in a strange world. What's more, my figure and ability are exactly like the game's debugging character, Blacksmith Laguna Smith, and the girl Rein who helped me is the legendary weapon "Reyvatein" that I trained in the game! When I live, I start to explore the mysteries of the world...!? Using a trained Legendary weapon as a bride, fantasy begins!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Gokukon: Chou Dekiai Yakuza to Keiyaku Kekkon!?
title_japanese: 極婚～超溺愛ヤクザとケイヤク結婚!?～
synopsis:
When Hasumi has a chance meeting with her old high school crush, Yamato Kujo, she figures she might as well spend one night in bliss before she deals with the debt collectors that hound her steps. But when Yamato reveals he's become a yakuza member, Hasumi panics and runs away—only to have Yamato pop up again, but this time with a proposition: He'll buy her debt if she becomes his bride. But can she take the pressure and drama of becoming a yakuza wife?

(Source: Kodansha Comics USA)

title: Nande Neteru Ore no Chinko Nameta no?
title_japanese: なんで寝てる俺のちんこ舐めたの?
synopsis:
Daiya is a university student who wishes to have a girlfriend. He spends his days studying and playing around. He usually goes to Oohashi's apartment after a long night out. Living alone, he doesn't have to worry about anything, and his location is also convenient. Moreover, Oohashi is always willing to take care of Daiya! One night, however, a shocking incident occurs... This warm and fuzzy feeling between his legs—it was Oohashi's mouth, sucking on Daiya's private parts?!

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

title: Kirari Books Meisouchuu!
title_japanese: きらりブックス迷走中！
synopsis:
Kirari Kiryuuin, a rich young lady who doesn't know anything of the world, is introduced by her mother to the historic Meisou Bookstore, which will be the setting of her first part-time job. It turns out the Meisou Bookstore is in fact filled with anime goods, doujinshis, and idol merch—a true otaku bookstore!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Megami no Café Terrace
title_english: The Café Terrace and Its Goddesses
synopsis:
When Hayato's grandmother passed, he planned to sell her rundown café on the shore—not realizing that it was also home to five young women who call themselves her family?! Their desperation to keep the café open convinces Hayato to give it a shot...but even their best intentions might not be enough to make it work! And can he even work with these five unruly women? No matter what, he's got his work cut out for him!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Yuukoku no Moriarty
synopsis:
In the Yuukoku no Moriarty series:

1. "Hiiro" no Kenkyuu
2. Kinjirareta Asobi
3. Niji wo Miru Shoujo

title: Attouteki Gacha Un de Isekai wo Nariagaru!
title_japanese: 圧倒的ガチャ運で異世界を成り上がる!
serializations: Suiyoubi wa Mattari Dash X Comic

title: Harapeko na Joushi no I wo Tsukamu Houhou: Sasen-saki wa Kyuutei Madoushi no Senzoku Chef
title_japanese: 腹ぺこな上司の胃をつかむ方法 ～左遷先は宮廷魔導師の専属シェフ～
synopsis:
With a sudden job transfer, Wilfred is thrown into a certain division filled with weirdos! There, he meets Ester, his boss who has nothing to do but eat. Wilfred originally intended to hone and master magic, but he finds himself thrown into the duty of being her exclusive chef?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Tensei Tokuten de Commuryoku ni Zenfuri Shita Watashi Saikyou de Kawaii!
title_japanese: 転生特典でコミュ力に全振りしたわたし最強でかわいい！

title: Chicchakute Kawaii Senpai ga Daisuki nanode Ichinichi 3-kai Teresasetai
title_japanese: ちっちゃくてかわいい先輩が大好きなので一日三回照れさせたい

title: Akuyaku Reijou wa, Dragon to wa Odoranai
title_japanese: 悪役令嬢は、ドラゴンとは踊らない
synopsis:
I died. When I woke up, I was in the world of the otome game "Rose Garden"...? No way! What's more, I was reborn as the girl with the reputation of "unlucky, unrequited, pathetic." That is to say, the old royal family's princess, the heroine's rival, Remilia-sama, isn't it?!

However, I prefer the main couple! I would like to watch the love of the princess and Ryuuko if possible! Political dispute of the new and old royal family? I want to live peacefully and safely regardless of it! And that is, to sometimes leisurely take a walk in the sky with a dragon. A fantasy of magic and dragon that can be folded as "let's quit being a villain, let's give up the first love, let's get straight to home."

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Mahou Yakushi ga Niban Deshi wo Mederu Riyuu: Senzoku Oshokuji-gakari ni Ninmei saremashita
title_english: Reason Why a Magical Pharmacist Loves the Second Disciple
title_japanese: 魔法薬師が二番弟子を愛でる理由～専属お食事係に任命されました～
synopsis:
Liliana was in despair. The secret surrounding her life was exposed by the high-class aristocrat, Brail. Summoned to the royal castle, she was waiting for her sentence to be either the death penalty or dissection when... she was told, "Number 2, starting today, you're in charge of meals." Wait, what?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Isekai Harem Dungeon Master: Ero Trap de Himekishi Party & Maou wo Yarimakuri!
title_japanese: 異世界ハーレムダンジョンマスター～エロトラップで姫騎士パーティー＆魔王をヤリまくり！～
synopsis:
The protagonist was summoned into a world where only women exist by a Demon Queen and made a Dungeon Master, tasked with assaulting a party formed by the world's strongest heroines. Thrilled to learn his adversaries are gorgeous women, he sets out to use perverted traps and his huge cock to capture the heroines one by one and make them yield. And on top of taking this world's most beautiful and powerful women, he also plans on bringing the Demon Queen herself down to her knees.

(Source: Getchu)

title: Yakuza to Metsuki no Warui Onna Keiji no Hanashi
title_japanese: ヤクザと目つきの悪い女刑事の話
synopsis:
Todoroki, an underboss of the underground syndicate "Tsuchigumo", and Arigaya, a detective of the 4th police division, are constantly at each others throats. But although the two are on opposite sides of the law, they're both actually madly in love with one another! Can love even flourish between a Yakuza and a Cop? Yakuza to Metsuki no Warui Onna Keiji no Hanashi is a hilarious romcom between two unsuspecting prisoners of love as they navigate their way through the stakeouts and sting operations of a love you would've least expected!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Seiyuu Radio no Uraomote
title_japanese: 声優ラジオのウラオモテ
synopsis:
Yuuhi Yuugure and Yasumi Utatane, two high school voice actresses who just happened to attend the same school and coincidentally got placed into the same class, are the two hosts of a radio weekly program. As fellow classmates and voice actresses, they show all the listeners their great friendship! At least, on the surface. In reality, the quiet girl Chika and the gyaru Yumiko are complete opposites. And they absolutely cannot stand each other. Off air, chaos and insults erupt. On air, they're the best of friends. Just where will this tumultuous relationship lead them?

(Source: MU)

title: Yumemiru Danshi wa Genjitsushugisha
title_english: The Dreaming Boy Is a Realist
title_japanese: 夢見る男子は現実主義者
synopsis:
Wataru Sajou, who is deeply in love with his beautiful classmate Aika Natsukawa, approaches her without getting discouraged while having dreams about their mutual love. However, one day, he woke up thinking, "I am not really fit to be together with someone as good as her, huh..." Upon realizing this, Wataru started keeping an appropriate distance from her, much to Aika's surprise. "Could it be that he hates me now...?"

Did his intentions slip by her because she was getting impatient after arriving at the wrong conclusion?! This is the start of a romcom revolving around two people who just can't get their feelings across and both think their love is unrequited!

(Source: Hobby Japan, translated)

title: Erotical Wizard to 12-nin no Hanayome
title_japanese: エロティカル・ウィザードと12人の花嫁
synopsis:
Junpei Ichinose, who attends Tokyo Magical Academy, could no longer prove his magical aptitude. Out of nowhere, a beautiful witch named Meryl appeared in front of him and said: "You, the reincarnation of the 'Maou,' are needed for..."

Junpei is now the only person who knows that he has the power of the demon lord. Furthermore the information leaked to the beautiful Sonia, who is a descendant of the hero. Junpei doesn't know how to use the demon lord's power and manages to convince Sonia to help him find the real way to use it. But as it turns out, the demon lord's magic power is called "Ero Magic." Thus begins the battle harem story with beautiful girls and the "Ero Magic" spell!!

(Source: Hobby Japan, translated)

title: Shigatsu Kissa no Himitsu no Jikenbo
title_english: The Secret Case Files of the Cafe April
title_japanese: 四月喫茶の秘密の事件簿
synopsis:
Customers come to the Cafe April with all sorts of issues. The owner, Miharu, brews to please, sometimes offering pleasure, other times comfort, and other times a first experience. In a part of town where passion and desire swirl about, he's tired of waiting for real love to show up. Hyogo Kijima's compilation offers a great touch of titillation.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Hatsujou Porno Star
synopsis:
Popular adult film star tops Daiki and Sogo can't stand each other! Even so, the two are thrown together in an upcoming feature! They're tricked by a cunning director into taking a role where one will need to be the bottom. First, they'll have to learn to get along, and to make sure they do, they've been handcuffed together and forced to stay that way for one week! They'll have to shower and use the bathroom together...and what's more, nothing's stopping them from taking on other scenes...!!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Jagaimo Hatake no Kodomotachi
title_japanese: ジャガイモ畑の子どもたち

title: Tsuribaka Nisshi​ Bangai-hen: Shadow Man
title_japanese: 釣りバカ日誌番外編 シャドーマン

title: Hobohobo Horobimashite
title_japanese: ほぼほぼほろびまして

title: Seijo-sama wo Amayaka Shitai!: Tadashi Yuusha, Omae wa Dame da
title_japanese: 聖女様を甘やかしたい！ ただし勇者、お前はダメだ
synopsis:
Bale Beresford serves as a personal agent to the Pope of the Papal Kingdom of Apostolo. Having finished his previous mission, his next assignment is to monitor and attend to Luna, a potential candidate to become the Holy Maiden. Will he handle this mission the same as the others, or will something in him change?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kamigami ni Sodaterareshi Mono, Saikyou to Naru
title_english: A Boy Raised by Gods Will Be the Strongest.
title_japanese: 神々に育てられしもの、最強となる
synopsis:
Will was a boy left to his fate in the middle of nowhere, but his luck changed when the gods gave him another destiny. That child who was destined to die is now destined to become the mightiest of all with the help of the god of the sword, the god of magic and the goddess of sanction, Will's adventures are about to begin!

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Saikyou no Shienshoku "Wajutsushi" de Aru Ore wa Sekai Saikyou Clan wo Shitagaeru
title_english: The Most Notorious "Talker" Runs the World's Greatest Clan
title_japanese: 最凶の支援職【話術士】である俺は世界最強クランを従える
synopsis:
Noel longs to be a Seeker like his heroic grandfather, slaying the beasts that emerge from Abysses and exploring far-off lands. Unfortunately, it turns out he's nothing but a measly Talker–a job with no combat skills whatsoever. Undaunted, Noel sets out to establish the strongest clan in all the land, using his silver-tongued Talker skills to unite assassins and heroes under his leadership.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Ane no Yuujin
synopsis:
Fourteen-year-old Ruriko Kanada has always liked her sister Nacchan's best friend Kyouko Watarai, but following a fight, she has not seen her in two years. When a chance encounter leads her to Kyouko again, Ruriko is enchanted by her radiant mature aura and meets up with her every week to talk about anything—from her school troubles to sharing random thoughts.

But when Ruriko gets upset about Kyouko being more affectionate with her other female friend, Kyouko kisses her and claims that she looks just like Nacchan when she is troubled. Furthermore, Kyouko reveals that she had once inadvertently confessed her love to Nacchan, but she was rejected—which caused her to stop hanging out with Nacchan and, by proxy, Ruriko.

Although it has been a while since they last talked, the two girls long for each other just the same. However, their inability to properly convey their deep feelings to one another could leave them unsatisfied forever.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: 1978-nen no Manga Mushi
synopsis: An autobiographical manga about Fujihiko Hosono's life during 1978, an important year in his life.

title: Wakamen: The Mineral Boys
synopsis: A story about some seaweed that have transformed into beautiful and handsome men.

title: Unnamed Memory
synopsis:
"My wish as champion is for you to descend the tower and be my wife." Climbing a deadly tower, Oscar seeks the power of its master, the Witch of the Azure Moon. He hopes her incredible magic can break a curse that will kill any woman he takes for a wife. When the prince sees how beautiful Tinasha is, though, he has a better idea—since she's surely strong enough to survive his curse, she should just marry him instead! Tinasha isn't keen on the idea, but agrees to live with Oscar in the royal castle for a year while researching the spell placed on the prince. The witch's pretty face hides several lifetimes of dark secrets, however—secrets that begin resurfacing...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Oshite Dame nara Oshitemiro!
title_japanese: 押して駄目なら押してみろ！
synopsis: The story of a girl who is romantically attracted to snakes falling in love with her teacher.

title: Yandere Kanojo ni Nemurasete Moraenai Hanashi
title_japanese: ヤンデレ彼女に眠らせてもらえない話
synopsis:
A high school girl lost her beloved boyfriend, Rei, in a car accident. In the midst of her despair, she manages to successfully transfer Rei's soul to a teddy bear. They had dates together, gave gifts to each other, and although his appearance was different, they were happily living together. However, something was gradually starting to change within Rei...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kore wa Yuganda Shokurepo desu
title_japanese: これはゆがんだ食レポです
synopsis: Autobiographical essay manga from Kabi Nagata surrounding her struggles with her eating disorder and binge-eating.

title: Daifuku-chan to Ouji-sama
title_japanese: 大福ちゃんと王子さま
synopsis:
For the first time, 19-year-old Kinari Setoya is striking out on her own, swapping life in the countryside for the bright city lights of Tokyo before her first semester of college begins. She has a few goals for her new life. Among them is goal one: move into the rowdy but lovable Kitten Blue Boarding House. Goal two: find a new love in Tokyo. But this boarding house has one problem—an extremely hot resident named Towa who totally mistakes her for a stalker. Yikes.

(Source: Lovesick Alley)

title: Hatsukoi Maze
synopsis:
On a day like any other, high school student Kokoro Aomi runs into Makoto Shirabe in a school corridor. What follows is nothing short of strange: Makoto asks her out, and on the spur of the moment, Kokoro says yes. Neither knows the other well enough to even be friends, and yet they end up as an impromptu couple!

Kokoro's friend Mika Totsuka advises her against being with someone she barely knows, but Kokoro cannot help but be drawn to Makoto's kindness―not to mention how adorably shy he acts around her. As Kokoro gradually gets over her own qualms of getting together with Makoto, she yearns to open up to him and hopes he does the same.

Hatsukoi Maze is a sugar-sweet high school romance that captures the essence of first love and all the exciting experiences that come with it.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Newton no Tsubomi
synopsis: The story of Ogi, a boy who can see the colours of people and sounds, and the girl who tackles him to the ground one day.

title: Yoru no Shita de Machiawase
synopsis:
Our heroine, whose name no one in school can remember, can't decide what's weirder—that the most popular guy in school, Koga-kun, wants to be her friend...or that he insists he's an alien. But one thing's for sure—he knows her name, and doesn't seem ready to let her go through high school anonymous!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Nazeka Gakkou-ichi no Bishoujo ga Yasumi Jikan no Tabi ni, Bocchi no Ore ni Hanashikaketekuru n daga?
title_japanese: 何故か学校一の美少女が休み時間の度に、ぼっちの俺に話しかけてくるんだが?
synopsis:
"Andou-kun, good morning ♪"

"Asakura-san, mornin'..."

(I got the seat next to the most beautiful girl in the school. A person who is willing to greet a loner like me, what a kind person she is. But in any case it's just lip service, she'll probably find me a bother if I start talking to her.)

"..."

"..."

(Even though I tried to greet him, why won't he talk to meee!! I can't talk about light novels to anyone besides Andou-kun, so please talk to meee!!)

This is that sort of school rom-com.

(Source: Kakuyomu, translated)

title: Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo! Kappore!
title_japanese: この素晴らしい世界に祝福を！かっぽれ！

title: Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo! Extra: Ano Orokamono ni mo Kyakkou wo!
title_japanese: この素晴らしい世界に祝福を！エクストラ あの愚か者にも脚光を！

title: Souyoku no Busoutsukai
synopsis:
The world is on the brink of extinction due to an ever-expanding disaster called the "Eternal Storm." However, humanity has a new source of hope in this dying world: weapons which grant power beyond human understanding—the Ability Armaments. Two boys destined to inspire awe with their splendor set out on a journey. Ability Armaments in hand, they won't stop until the world is saved!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Bareteru! Cocktail Knight
title_japanese: バレてる！ カクテルナイト
synopsis:
Stressmen, ghastly monsters that originate from pent-up stress, relentlessly wreak havoc in Kirameki City. In response to the imminent threat these creatures pose, a group known as the Cocktail Knights—- four maidens with magical powers—is formed to defeat the stressmen. Although these heroines are admired by the entire population, only few know of their true identities. One such person is Riku Daichi, an ordinary high school boy who knows the identity of Valencia—one of the Cocktail Knights dubbed the Prince of Beauty. She is actually Sora Amagami, a cool cross-dressing girl and Riku's best friend.

Since Riku and Sora's classmates have yet to realize that Sora is a girl and a Cocktail Knight, Sora is unaware that her best friend knows her secret. However, there is something about Riku that Sora and their classmates are fully aware of: Riku's immense love for Valencia. Despite Riku constantly protecting the identity of his first love and best friend, Sora's actions toward Riku do not

title: Kedamono-tachi no Jikan: Kyouizon Shoukougun
title_japanese: けだものたちの時間～狂依存症候群～
synopsis:
With her cute looks and successful career, fashion model Airi Hirakawa is content with her life—until she wakes up dazed and bruised, chained up in a room filled to the brim with trash. Her captor is Hirokazu Imai, a crazed stalker and fan who has been watching her for ages. He has her underwear, used sanitary pads, and now her as well. Before Airi is even given a chance to breathe, she is forced to marry Hirokazu. From then on, her days are filled with rape, brutality, and torture; but she never loses hope to regain her freedom—even if she is tainted in the process.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: My Joy
synopsis:
In an all-girls high school, the popular Min Namsu's brightest moment of the day is seeing her best friend Kwon Joy. Her heart races when Joy cheers her on during her running practices, and when Joy snaps pictures of her, intense feeling strikes through her body, making her believe she must be camera-shy. Namsu has heard numerous stories about Joy's childhood friend Lim Hye-yeon, so when Joy shares that Hye-yeon is returning to Korea after years of studying abroad, Namsu is excited for her.

However, the moment Hye-yeon steps off the train, she kisses Joy on the lips. The mere sight of the interaction stirs something up inside Namsu, to the point that, despite Hye-yeon's magnetic personality, she cannot bring herself to like her. As Hye-yeon spends time with Joy, she realizes that Namsu harbors the same feelings as she does. Hye-yeon subtly declares war on Namsu for Joy's heart, but Namsu must confront and understand her own feelings and determine how to handle them before she can figh

title: Onaji Kakera de Dekiteiru
title_japanese: 同じかけらでできている
synopsis:
1. Mo Ichido Waratte
2. Wan! Fine Day!
3. Kazehiki Johnny
4. Fujunai Prelude
5. Fujunai Rhapsody
6-7. Onaji Kakera de Dekiteiru
8. Akiramesasete
9. Only Lonely
10. Yotsuba-shi Dayori

title: Futakuchi-san
synopsis: The story about a girl who lives with a big handicap on the back of her head.

title: Conveni of the Dead: 100-nichigo ni Kyuujo sareru Conveni Tenin
title_japanese: コンビニ・オブ・ザ・デッド 100日後に救助されるコンビニ店員

title: Suuji de Sukuu! Jakushou Kokka
title_english: Survival Strategy Thinking with Game Theory for Save the Weak
synopsis:
With tensions between the neighboring country rising signaling the presence of a war soon to begin, Soalla, the princess of a small country, worried whether her own country would be able to defend itself with its weak national power. The king was bedridden and the retainers who were her last rays of hope had nothing but the antiquated motto of battle honor in mind. Not one person had a concrete proposal to protect the country, leaving Soalla to wonder if this was where Favell would fall... However, it was then that Naoki appeared before her. A "magician," that left his name in history who possessed the power she desired to save the country.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Gogo Kyuu-ji, Veranda-goshi no Megami-senpai wa Boku dake no Mono
title_japanese: 午後九時、ベランダ越しの女神先輩は僕だけのもの
synopsis:
9 p.m., 1 meter apart. That is the secret time and distance between me and the goddess. Yes, a goddess-like girl lives next door to me.

"Asahi-kun, why do I like you?" Kanako Himi, a perfect girl, asked sweetly on the balcony.

She never should have had anything to do with me. But it all started when I moved next door and she said she liked me. Irreplaceable days of gathering precious time with an overly cute senpai. The world on the secret veranda, which brings us closer and yet further at the same time, is one only she and I know.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Hikawa-sensei wa Otaku Kareshi ga Hoshii.
title_japanese: 氷川先生はオタク彼氏がほしい。

title: Adachi to Shimamura: Koushiki Comic Anthology
title_japanese: 安達としまむら 公式コミックアンソロジー
authors: majoccoid|Mizusaki, Hiroaki|Kumo, Suzume|Arima|Yoshikita, Popuri|Yuino, Chiri|Yuzuhara, Moke
synopsis: An anthology comic of Adachi to Shimamura by various mangaka.

title: Tonari no Kimi ga Ichiban Kawaii
title_english: The You Next to Me Is the Cutest One of All
title_japanese: 隣の君が一番かわいい
synopsis:
Akari Kohinata finds the classmate who sits next to her, Yuu Hoshikawa, cuter than any other girl she has ever met. However, Yuu has one small problem with this: he is actually a boy and in love with Akari, but he believes that his feminine features make her oblivious to his feelings. In order to resolve his predicament, Yuu makes an effort to flaunt his masculine side to Akari, but that only makes him cuter!

While Akari has an overwhelming admiration for her classmate's charm, Yuu firmly believes that Akari is much cuter than him. As they spend more time together, the pair only grow more enamoured with each other. After all, each finds the person sitting next to them to be the cutest one of all.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kamome no Koto wa Yoku Shiranai
title_japanese: かもめのことはよく知らない
synopsis:
A collection of loosely connected one-shots revolving around the residents of a small island town. Little snippets of life, love, and growth.

1. Nana Kairi no Hanashi
2. Kamome no Koto wa Yoku Shiranai
3. Yoru no Tobari
4. Hakka
5. Mushikui Machi nite
6. Caramel-kun
7. Sumire
8. Tsugumi no Koto

title: Ookami Otoko to Shirousa Shounen
title_english: The Wolf and His Little White Bunny
title_japanese: オオカミ男と白うさ少年
synopsis:
College student Tomoya, dumped by his first love, gets drunk and passes out in the pouring rain, only to be found by cafe-owner Takawa. But... at night, the cafe becomes a bar, where the (all male!) staff become lingerie-clad bunnies! Tomoya ends up working at the cafe, forced to become a bunny himself, and then even gets down and dirty with Takawa! This is a sweet-but-sexy love story between a cool, arrogant older man and an ordinary college student.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Kowloons' Ball Parade
title_japanese: クーロンズ・ボール・パレード
synopsis:
Hakuo Gakuin's mighty baseball team consistently makes it to Koushien, and Tamao Azukida dreams of making the team. To achieve his goal, Tamao does extensive research and undergoes a strict daily training regimen. But at tryouts, Tamao meets the enigmatic genius pitcher Tao Ryuudou, and the course of his destiny may be forever changed! If people aren't laughing, then you're not dreaming big enough! A new baseball tale for the era begins!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Ao no Maharaja
synopsis: Moira came to India with her parents when it was still under British rule. At the Royal Palace in Jodhpur, she met Prince Silva...

title: Mahou Shoujo Fairy Flower: Seigi no Kokoro wo Kyokon de Kujike! - Saikyou Heroine-tachi no Zettai Chuusei Harem♪
title_japanese: 魔法少女フェアリーフラワー～正義の心を巨根で挫け！最強ヒロイン達の絶対忠誠ハーレム♪～

title: Hametsu no Kanojo
synopsis:
Reiko, Kazu and Yukari are three childhood friends with a good relationship. Reiko, the self-proclaimed older sister of the group, tells herself that they are like family, and throws away her love for Kazu. As for Yukari, she also has feelings for Kazu. Thus, one day, the relationship between the three begins its gradual descent into madness... A shocking psycho-love story between young people begins!!

(Source: MU)

title: Bem
synopsis:
The plot of the series revolves around three youkai, Bem, Bela and Belo, who arrive at a large coastal city and come across an evil atmosphere, which was brought about by immoral behavior by humans and mischief caused by monsters and youkai. They therefore decide to stay in the city, fighting against other monsters and youkai which attack humans, making a few friends along the way. Even though the three youkai are often abused and discriminated against by other human beings due to their appearance, they still strive in protecting the human populace of the city from other monsters, one day hoping to become human beings in return for their good actions.

(Source: Wikipedia)

title: Otasuke Chara ni Kanojo ga Iru Wake Nai ja Nai desu ka
title_japanese: お助けキャラに彼女がいるわけないじゃないですか

title: Sewazuki de Kawaii JK 3-shimai Dattara, wo Uchi de Amaetemo Ii desu ka?
title_japanese: 世話好きで可愛いJK3姉妹だったら、おうちで甘えてもいいですか？

title: Isekai kara JK Tensei shita Moto Imouto ga, Chouguigui kuru.
title_japanese: 異世界からJK転生した元妹が、超グイグイくる。

title: Ayako
synopsis: A remake of Osamu Tezuka's 1972 series set in the modern day.

title: HeiSei Nanairo Inko
synopsis: Thirty years after the original series, the Heisei era is nearing its end, and Nanairo Inko reappears to take center stage. Is this the same phantom thief as before, or is someone merely borrowing the moniker?

title: Mitsume ga Warau
synopsis:
Sharaku is a timid boy often the target of bullying. However, when the bullies tear off the bandage on his head, his third eye appears...

Included one-shots: Hatsukoi wa Kaze no Naka, Barbara

title: Kyoujuu Monogatari
synopsis:
The manga is set in modern Kyoto (as opposed to Tokyo in the earlier manga) and centers on aspiring manga creator Ako Kitayama. One day, while on a train station platform, she witnesses a battle between a "hunter" and another young man who can also transform. She decides to use the incident as story material for her manga. Ako submits the storyboard draft for the manga to her editor. But not only does he reject the manga, he says "He told me to bring you," delivering Ako to a young man who suddenly appears in the room. The man takes Ako to the head of his clan.

(Source: Comic Natalie, translated)

title: Ani no Yuujin
synopsis:
Kei's older brother just recently passed away, leaving Kei with a large inheritance. When his mother relinquishes his brother's tablet to him, Kei is surprised to find pictures of his brother and his friend and former schoolmate, Akinari being intimate with each other—in a relationship. Kei reminiscences his memories of the two: his admiration for both his brother and Akinari, in two different contexts. Kei decides to visit Akinari to confront him. Reunited, Kei realizes that his feelings for Akinari are more than just childish admiration. But Kei also realizes that his brother's ghost will always continue to linger in everything around him.

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: K, the Cleanskin
synopsis:
I'm K, my daughter was raped and killed by dregs but they twisted all the truths and, in the end, my daughter became the one who's to be blamed. The police are afraid of them, the law can't control them, then I'm going to clean those dregs for good. I'm K, you are the next to be terminated!

(Source: Mangatoon)

title: Kore mo Brocon no Uchi desu ka?
title_english: This Is Taking Brotherly Love Way Too Far
title_japanese: これもブラコンのうちですか?
synopsis:
Haruhi's sick of being bossed around by his younger stepbrother, Akito, and tells him he's had enough. Haruhi's too nice, though. Upon seeing Akito's sad expression, he tries to console his brother, only for Akito to kiss him right then and there! Haruhi's never seen Akito so desperate. Akito doesn't hate him!? ...But, why show it with a kiss!? Akito's behavior escalates, and Haruhi's still not sure what's going on in his brother's head. This is a romantic comedy about two stepbrothers in a taboo relationship. One's besotted yet stand-offish, and the other's entirely at his mercy!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Smoky Nectar
synopsis:
Writer Mitsuru Hasegawa has been investigating a case that was rumored to be the work of vampires known as "Biters." His childhood friend, Yuusei Annaka a.k.a. Anna, warns him not to stick his head into where it doesn't belong. But the truth is, Anna is actually a Biter. Under the pretense of gathering information for his article, Mitsuru agrees to let Anna suck his blood. On top of that, he impulsively sleeps with Anna and experiences indescribable pleasure. In addition, there seems to be a secret about Mitsuru that he himself isn't aware of...?

(Source: Taiyo Tosho, translated)

title: Sleeping Bug
synopsis:
Uruno started as an intern in a programming company where the person he's interested in, his senior, Hongo, works at. While Uruno is skeptical about love matters, he finds himself drawn to Hongo every time he spends with him. All in all, Uruno was fine with the way things are. But when Hongo transfers out, Uruno is left hollow and indifferent. When news of Hongo's company being booted out reaches Uruno, he is persistent in finding Hongo. He succeeds in finding Hongo, now jobless and homeless, with only his drones for company. Desperate to keep Hongo by his side, Uruno offers to buy Hongo for $50,000.

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Ichizu na Inu wa Akiramenai
title_english: The Dog Will Not Give Up Unrequited Love
synopsis:
Yuu Shimazaki, now a senior, is just looking forward to the day he enters college. He spends his time getting intimate with the people he likes. When one almost-sex encounter is interrupted by a younger student, Daisuke Akizuki, Yuu is embarrassed but moves on. That is until he finds out that he and Daisuke now live in the same dormitory. Looking to move the awkwardness away, he talks to Daisuke, whom Yuu is surprised to find taking things smoothly. But when Daisuke suddenly confesses his love for Yuu, things get complicated. For one, Yuu thinks it's just puppy love on Daisuke's part, but the latter is determined to prove him wrong. Is Yuu ready for Daisuke's feelings, especially when he hasn't fallen in love for real before?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Oretachi no Nichijou wa Hajimatta Bakari da
title_japanese: 俺たちの日常は始まったばかりだ

title: Rec Me
synopsis:
Yusuke and Chizuru are known actors in the showbiz industry. To everyone else, they appear to be amicable work colleagues, but off cam, they are in a secret and complicated sexual relationship. While their relationship just sort of happened, Yusuke wants nothing but to monopolize Chizuru, but the latter is insistent on riling him up by seducing other people. At times, Yusuke finds something familiar about Chizuru here and there, and it seems Chizuru has his secrets and a plan he's been plotting for all this time.

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Ryoukatakoi no Susume
synopsis:
When they were younger, cool, collected Kousuke was the one who asked tiny, adorable Hiraku to be his lover—even when Hiraku couldn't quite understand what being lovers meant. Now that they're older and hopefully wiser, can they finally figure out what they got wrong the first time?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Melt at Night
title_japanese: メルト アット ナイト
synopsis:
Tomoki is an average salaryman with a meek personality. Due to this, he has little confidence in himself, including in matters of sex. One night, he gets himself drunk after an office drinking party and falls asleep on his front door. To his surprise, he gets awoken with a kiss from a call boy named Haru.  As it turns out, Haru got the building location wrong and, as an apology, offers Tomoki drinks and a lending ear to all his sex troubles since Haru is a sex pro himself. Tomoki takes Haru's offer, and when he divulges his fear of sex to Haru, Haru readily offers himself to Tomoki as his practice partner to overcome his fear of sex.

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Kanako-san
synopsis:
A woman was looking at him from outside his window. His room was on the second floor.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Mouken Darling to Donkan-chan
title_english: Little Miss Oblivious and her Savage Darling
title_japanese: 猛犬ダーリンと鈍感ちゃん
synopsis:
"I'm the smallest person in our grade... but love came for me, too!"

Hina's very petite, but her first love confession ever comes from the tough-looking Akitaka, who happens to be the tallest guy in their grade. Hina is overjoyed to get her first boyfriend, but at the same time, she's overwhelmed... What do lovers do? That means... k-kissing, right? The couple decides to experience their firsts at their own pace, but many trials await them! And amidst all that, Akitaka reaches for Hina in a sudden outburst of desire...!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Zettai ni Furo ni Hairitakunai Kanojo vs Zettai ni Furo ni Iretai Kareshi
title_japanese: 絶対に風呂に入りたくない彼女VS絶対に風呂に入れたい彼氏
synopsis:
Twenty-three-year-old Hina currently lives with her boyfriend Teppei. Although the two are deeply in love, there is one thing that they have clashing opinions on: baths. Naturally, Teppei would like for Hina to bathe every day, but the latter hates baths, finding them to be too much of a hassle. This prompts him to devise various strategies that always end with his stubborn girlfriend in the bathtub alongside him, creating sweet and bubbly memories for both of them.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Otona no Koi no Hajimekata
synopsis:
Matt is at his wit's end. As if he isn't busy enough with business transactions for the company he manages, he's left to take care of his ten-year-old daughter, Samantha, when his ex-wife passes away. Samantha rejects every nanny Matt hires. Just as the temp agency refuses to deal with him anymore, one of his employees introduces him to her younger sister, Tess. He learns that Tess is spending the summer at her sister's place, and he hires her as a nanny. She immediately befriends Samantha, but Matt doesn't expect to find himself falling for Tess's carefree charms...!

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Kantoku, Neko na Ore wa Dame desu ka
title_japanese: 監督、ネコな俺はダメですか
synopsis:
Daichi enters the gay porn world as a model who plays tops and immediately gains popularity. However, he's actually an exclusive bottom who used sex toys on his ass every night!!! Although he dreams of playing a bottom role with Kouhei, the actor he admires, for some reason, he's very popular as a top. Of course he could never request to play the bottom... Living his life in frustration, one day he happens to meet director Sasakawa on set...who's actually his beloved Kouhei-kun!!

(Source: Sankosha, translated)

Included one-shots: Konomi no Type wa Toshishita Osananajimi (My Younger Childhood Friend is Just My Type), Shiawase no Sono Saki e

A skillful secretary by day and choosy cruiser by night, Suha is a young professional who's in search of some no-strings-attached action. He hasn't had much luck lately, though, since a handsome face doesn't always match what's in a guy's pants. This might be why he finds himself wondering about his dreamboat boss, Director Park Jiwoon. But there's no way he can mix business with pleasure... That is, until Jiwoon and Suha run into each other in the gay bar bathroom.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Hyakkakyu no Osouji-gakari: Tensei shita Shinmai Kyuujo, Koukyuu no Onayami Kaiketsu shimasu.

Yui Mei has two secrets. First, she retained the memories of her past life. Second, it is highly probable that she is a daughter of the Sai Kingdom's Emperor. As a certified die-hard fan of Chinese dramas in her past life, she willingly participated in the court lady selection just for the sake of seeing the imperial harem in the flesh.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Dappou Tamer no Nariagari Boukentan: S-Rank Bishoujo Boukensha ga Ore no Juuma ni Natteimasu
title_english: Adventure of the Outlawed Tamer with Beautiful Explorers.

synopsis:
D-rank beast-tamer Lint takes all the worst jobs just trying to scrape by and survive–but all that changes for the better when a hot S-rank catgirl named Birena begs him to tame her! Birena believes submitting to Lint will help her evolve into an even more amazing warrior–is she right? Is she horny? Is she...both??

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Under a single roof, a teacher and a student secretly agree to live together?! Reina Sakurakouji, a beautiful woman, my teacher, and my fiancee?! And we're going to be living together in secret?! And also, Sensei is surprisingly defenseless and shy, so it's pretty cute! The story of a secret agreement to live together between teacher and student begins here!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

synopsis:
The youngest A-rank adventurer, child prodigy Kaiser, finds three babies who were the only survivor of a destroyed village. Then he decided to give up his job as an adventurer and raise them. Over time, the girls grow brightly and show exceptional talents in fencing, magic and management. However, these girls also seem to love their father, Kaiser!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Isekai Hoikuen wo Hirakimashita: Fusei Skill de Saikyou Loli Seirei-tachi wa Deredere desu
title_english: I Opened the "Different World Nursery School".
title_japanese: 異世界保育園を開きました ～父性スキルで最強ロリ精霊たちはデレデレです～
synopsis:
Oliver, an adventurer almost in his forties, received a certain mission due to his earnest personality. That mission is to bind a contract with deredere little spirits who have great power?! Thus, the spirits gathered and the new life of Oliver as school principal began!!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Nise no Koibito datta Class no Bishoujo-tachi ga, Hontou ni Ore no Koto wo Suki ni Natteita Ken
title_japanese: 偽の恋人だったクラスの美少女たちが、本当に俺のことを好きになっていた件
synopsis:
"I have a girlfriend!"

Tired of being forced into marriage with my non-blood-related younger sister, I told her a lie. Without any moment to lose, I rushed to plead the raijuu Sakurai, the perfectionist Senbongi, and my childhood friend Hotaru for either one to form a fake relationship with me in order to create an alibi. Just when I thought I could take a breather... Eh? All three accepted my request!? In addition to the scramble to vie for me, my sister noticed something amiss and strengthened her surveillance!? Let the romantic comedy between my fake lovers that's full of mistakes commence!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Zero no Daikenja: Wakagaetta Saikyou Kenja wa Shoutai wo Kakushite Nariagaru
title_japanese: ゼロの大賢者 ~若返った最強賢者は正体を隠して成り上がる~
synopsis:
The second rising of the reincarnated strongest sage, the opening of the adventure!

Siegfried, the grand hero of the Great Sage, is deprived of his position, honor, and power by the guilty tactics of Gilbald who was his right arm. He is expelled to the Forest Without Return, where he has a fateful encounter with a dying vampire girl. He who sacrificed himself and dedicated his blood to a girl - transformed into a vampire and rejuvenated into a boy! He who regained infinite magical power and acquired the special abilities of the vampire was named "Zero," and vowed revenge on Gilbald along with the vampire girl.

"It's bad, it doesn't matter a hundred before infinity" - the heroes who once gathered for the great war​ forced to run up from "Zero" this time!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Zombie darake no Kono Sekai dewa Sex shinai to Ikinokorenai
title_japanese: ゾンビだらけのこの世界ではセックスしないと生き残れない
synopsis:
The world has been brought to a near-apocalyptic state by a mysterious virus that turns people into zombies. But thankfully we've found the only method to keep the zombies at bay, and that is... having sex... welcome to this new survival love-action adventure!!

(Source: MU)

title: Yingxiong Zai Lin
synopsis:
Zero was mankind's first real superhero. Under his watch, countless other superheros appeared and followed in his footsteps. However, after 5 years of war, Zero disappeared without a trace.

(Source: SF Qing Xiaoshuo, translated)

title: Onna Doushi toka Arienai desho to Iiharu Onnanoko wo, Hyakunichikan de Tetteiteki ni Otosu Yuri no Ohanashi
title_japanese: 女同士とかありえないでしょと言い張る女の子を、百日間で徹底的に落とす百合のお話
synopsis:
"Girls going out with girls? That can't be! But..."

One day, Marika Sakakibara, a popular high school girl, was offered one million yen by her beautiful classmate, Aya Fuwa.

"Sakakibara-san, I will buy you for 10000 yen a day for one hundred days. Let us see if girls going out with girls really cannot be."

"H-Huh?!"

From that day, their after school xx time began.

(Source: SB Creative, translated)

title_japanese: 異世界で手に入れた生産スキルは最強だったようです。
synopsis:
29 year old corporate slave Kou Kousaka is randomly transported to another world and gifted some standard skills. He has the option to be the sage, hero, or demon king. He chooses none of them and acquires a secret skill. With the skill, "Creation," and the hidden skill, he starts his life as an adventurer.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Seishun Buta Yarou wa Logical Witch no Yume wo Minai
title_english: Rascal Does Not Dream of Logical Witch
title_japanese: 青春ブタ野郎はロジカルウィッチの夢を見ない
synopsis:
"For the past three days, there have been two Rio Futabas." After successfully breaking the time loop that he and Koga were trapped in, Sakuta's threshold for what qualifies as "odd" was higher than most. So seeing his friend Futaba in a net café late at night should have been downright unremarkable—if he wasn't already on the phone with another Futaba...The ever-logical second-year has a doppelgänger, and neither one can (or will) explain what's caused this sudden case of Adolescence Syndrome. With one of the Futabas staying at his place, Sakuta will have to work fast in order to solve this. After all, who knows what could happen if the two doppelgängers meet?"

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Shujinkou ja Nai!
synopsis:
Once upon a time, there was a middle-aged Japanese salaryman, a schoolgirl, and a speed demon of a truck driver. The man tried to rescue the girl from the truck, and... Well, I bet you can guess what happened next. That man was me, by the way—"was" being the operative word, because the next thing I knew, I came to inside the world of my favorite game, Braves and Blades, as Rex Tauren. Rex is the most powerful character in the early stages of BB, a level 50 jack-of-all-trades who's got tons of class skills and one huge drawback—Rex is only a minor character, so past the tutorial stage, his growth rate tanks and he's all but useless. In other words, my quest is now to find BB's true protagonist and dump all of this saving-the-world stuff on them. I just wanna kick back and... Hold up! Why does everyone keep calling me the hero?!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Katakoi Lamp
synopsis:
Kazuto Muronoi runs a cute little coffee shop, where many people enjoy doing some work or writing papers for school. Among his coffee shop's regulars is a college student named Jun, who often studies there. It was love at first sight for Kazuto! Will Kazuto be able to find the courage to confess his crush before Jun graduates college and stops frequenting the shop? And to make matters even more complicated... it seems Jun has his sights set on another worker at the café!

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: No.9
synopsis:
A young girl Nae is ostracized for always talking to herself; but in reality, she converses with a bizarre creature that is only visible to her. Following the death of her beloved grandfather in a tragic car accident, Nae feels that a spectral force is at work, prompting her to cause a ruckus at her kindergarten. Given the circumstances, a specialist is summoned to assess the situation: Hiromasa "Nine" Tsukumo, an eccentric individual who is shadowed by his own abnormal companion. Nine quickly teaches Nae about the true nature of their special friends and resolves to help pursue her grandfather's murderer.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Shishunki to Danshikou!? to Nakano-kun
title_japanese: 思春期と男子校!?と中野くん
synopsis:
Hajime Nakano is going to an all-boys school, yet he feels blushing and flustered around his classmates for some reason. Nakano wonders, "Am I attracted to both men and women?" But what he doesn't know is that all of his classmates are girls disguised as men... Not knowing this secret, Nakano begins high school!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Osananajimi ga Zettai ni Makenai Love Comedy: Otonari no Yonshimai ga Zettai ni Honobono suru Nichijou

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Neko no Massage-ya-san
title_japanese: ねこのマッサージ屋さん
synopsis:
Nekoyama, worn out after another long day at the office, stops at a therapeutic massage parlor—only to discover that it's run by a cat! Not only that, but the cat actually does the massaging?! As the professional "meowsseur" digs soft toe beans into Nekoyama's aching muscles, his heart warms and his worries melt away. This is only the beginning, as he and other world-weary workers are about to meet the other feline professionals who have mastered pawfully cute techniques to reduce human stress.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Isekai wo Denma dake de Ikinuku!!
title_japanese: 異世界を電マだけで生き抜く!!
synopsis:
While carrying suspicious adult toys, Kenji is run over by a car. "Will I die a virgin?" he thinks as he fades out. At that moment, he reincarnates in another world. Standing before him is a beautiful female knight. In his hand, he is not holding a sword...rather, it's an electric vibrator.

This is the rise of one man and his vibrator in another world.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Sonouchi Kekkon made Iku kedo Ima wa Mada
title_japanese: そのうち結婚までいくけど今はまだ
synopsis:
Childhood-friends-turned-couple Ritsuho and Kyoichi have been dating for five years but naughty times are nowhere to be found. Ritsuho tries to bring their relationship to the next level, but Kyoichi doesn't seem very interested...?

(Source: MU)

title: Kimi ni Somaru Machi no Iro
synopsis:
The model student Yoshiyuki and the overt Chiba have been friends since childhood. However, Yoshiyuki feels more for his beloved classmate, but he doesn't intend to reveal his feelings to him. Only when it's clear that their paths will part after graduating from high school he starts to have doubts...

(Source: MU)

title: Double Play
synopsis:
Tamao Hiroi, a second year high school student, is a former member of the baseball team. When he came home one day, someone was in his room. There, the most beautiful girl in his school and the ace of the softball team, Ran Homura, was masturbating while calling his name. He is soon found out though and a strange "master/slave" relationship begins.

(Source: Nihon Bungeisha, translated)

title: Amagami-san Chi no Enmusubi
title_english: Tying the Knot with an Amagami Sister
synopsis:
After spending a majority of his life in an orphanage, aspiring doctor Uryuu Kamihate has finally found a place willing to take him in—the Amagami Shrine. There is only one problem: he is an ardent atheist.

Arriving at the shrine, Uryuu discovers that he will not be alone. Living with him are three shrine maidens: the childlike eldest sister Yae; the confrontational middle sister Yuna; and the mischievous youngest sister Asahi, all members of the Amagami household. While Yae and Asahi welcome his company, Yuna refuses to accept his presence and repeatedly clashes with him over their contrasting beliefs. However, Asahi soon unravels the reason behind his lack of faith.

Just as things are beginning to settle, Chidori Amagami, grandfather of the three sisters, suddenly reveals the condition for Uryuu's stay: he must marry one of the sisters and inherit the shrine.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Attachment Love
synopsis:
One night, Hiyama, a police officer working in a small neighborhood police station, provides counselling for a college student, Okazaki, who had attempted to flash his body at people. Hiyama, unable to leave the naive Okazaki alone, who only resorted to what he did as he was unable to properly vent out his peculiar fetish, called out to Okazaki asking, "If you're fine with me, shall I keep you company?" And from then on, the days of their secret meetings kept from everyone in a unrecognized hotel began...?!

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

title: Itsuka Kamen wo Nugu Tame ni: Warau Kishin to Yumemiru Dorei
title_japanese: いつか仮面を脱ぐ為に ～嗤う鬼神と夢見る奴隷～
synopsis:
A blooming romance between two individuals, as seen through a demon's mask.

"Samurai" Reo Aramogord is the strongest soldier protecting the kingdom. In the middle of the conflict, as he was about to destroy his enemy, he fell in love at first sight with a girl who is a "part" of the enemy. A romance story through the "masks" they wear to war.

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Leviathan

title: Kyuukyoku Shinka shita Full Dive RPG ga Genjitsu yori mo Kusoge Dattara
title_japanese: 究極進化したフルダイブRPGが現実よりもクソゲーだったら
synopsis:
In an unexpected turn of events, dull high school student Hiro Yuuki obtains the full dive role-playing game Kiwame Quest. Created by the best of technology, the game claims to take "reality to its extremes," from stunning graphics, NPCs' behavior, to the scent of vegetation, and even the sensation of wind brushing against the skin—everything was the result of an ultimate workmanship.

Except, the game is a little too realistic and messy to clear. Kiwame Quest features over ten quadrillion flags and reflects the players' real-life physical abilities in the game. Being hit in the game also hurts in real life and slash wounds take days to heal.

The only reward here is the sense of accomplishment. Conquer the most stressful game in history that can't be played casually!

(Source: MAL News)

title: Akito wa Card wo Hiku you desu

title: Ikigami to Donor
synopsis:
"Your blood and flesh, all of it is mine." An ikigami and a healer, together their souls support each other, blooming into love...

In the distant future, ordinary teacher Yoshino learns that he is a "donor" for the strongest species, the "ikigami." These warriors are tasked with protecting the country. "The unique ability of a donor is to use their bodily fluids to heal ikigami." Yoshino learns this fact and is shocked. Thus, Yoshino is forced to live with Kidou... At first, he is like a beast, demanding Yoshino's bodily fluids, but slowly, the underlying loneliness begins to show...

"Someday, if I met a donor, could they come to love me? That thought is the only reason I survived..."

(Source: Shodensha, translated)

title: Last Order
synopsis:
A post-apocalyptic world. Following her last order, the mechanical soldier Ria has been fighting an endless war for over a hundred years. With the people she was meant to protect gone, and her comrades-in-arms lost, Ria spends her days fighting alone. Then, a human appears before her once more..!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Gaps
synopsis:
Naoyuki Hasegawa, 37 years old. His work is perfect, but by contrast, in his private life, he's become aware that he's gotten out of shape. Satoshi Katagiri, 30 years old. Handsome, smart, good personality, likes both men and women, a prince admired by all at his company. Or he should have been. He stole money from a university student, and he destroyed the car of a man he didn't like. And secretly, he's totally bankrupt?! One night in a park, Hasegawa meets the Katagiri that nobody knows!

(Source: Taiyo Tosho, translated)

title: Paizuri Cheerleader vs Sakunyuu Ouendan!
title_japanese: ぱいずりチアリーダーVS搾乳応援団！
synopsis:
Shin belongs to a cheer group. Though he wasn't interested in it, Yuko, his older sister, forced him to join it... As a matter of fact, there are only two members, Shin and Yuko. On the other hand, a cheerleading club has a lot of members. One day, Shin accidentally collides with Chieru, a member of the cheerleading club, and she gets injured... In compensation for her injury, he decides to work as a caretaker of the cheerleading club. But days later, Satsuki, a coach of the cheerleading club, suddenly orders the members, "You should give him a titjob to overcome your sense of shame!" As they are all confused, Satsuki starts giving Shin a titjob...!

synopsis:
Caruel and Euricienne have a lot in common: they're both 16 years old, belong to royal families, and absolutely hate the idea of a political marriage! Both are determined to make the other beg for divorce. But enemies on the sidelines are also scheming to tear them apart and even threaten their lives! As Caruel and Euricienne overcome various obstacles together, perhaps they're more drawn to each other than they initially thought... Will they follow through with the original plans to end their arranged marriage? Or does fate have something else in store for the reluctant couple?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Roland Roland
synopsis:
The adventure story of Prince Corgi Roland and Louisa the witch. The secrets of the high priest's past and the church, which were hidden in the veil, are finally revealed...

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Gorin no Sho

After consecutively winning 60 martial arts duels, Miyamoto Musashi wrote The Book of Five Rings. His philosophical guide to all fields of martial arts is now adapted into comic format!

title: Cupid ni Rakurai: Tsuigeki

synopsis:
Shingo met his match—literally—in his senpai, the darkly mysterious Ao. Now the two have begun a relationship, and Shingo is starting to see the cuter, gentler sides of Ao. It’s enough to make him fall in love all over again! But trouble looms as the sports festival approaches, bringing a steadfast and handsome third-year student who singles out Ao as his rival. Can Shingo put his worries aside and support the boy he loves?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Zange
synopsis:
Yamada Kiyoshi, a struggling family man with a strong sense of justice oversteps his bounds and attempts to stop a public disturbance. Unfortunately for him, he's caught himself in the crosshairs of a violent personality...

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Daddy Darling
synopsis:
Long before the events of Don't Call Me Dirty, Hanao Kaji and Ryuuji Mita were close friends...

When Ryuuji is left to raise his son Shouji as a single father, Hanao steps up to help him out. At first, their family life is happy and content, but Hanao's true feelings for Ryuuji become more and more difficult for him to ignore. The pressure of staying closeted eventually becomes too much to bear; Hanao leaves, choosing to run from his feelings and his fears of somehow "messing up" Shouji's life when he starts getting teased at school for having two dads. Years later, when he comes home to care for his aging father and ends up advising Shouji on his blossoming relationship with Hama, Hanao realizes it's time to face his own past... and his future.

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Maou no Migiude ni Natta node Gensaku Kaiakushimasu

synopsis:
Tohru, a passionate fan of the "absolute evil" Demon King, who died as the symbol of the happy ending of the manga ‘Lapis Lazuli World', was in despair.

"I wanted to dedicate everything to you."

Such was Tohru's last thought as she fell from a high building. The next time she woke up, she had already transferred to the Lapis Lazuli World. And to the castle of her beloved Demon King, at that!

title_english: Fiancee of the Wizard: Eternally Yours
title_japanese: 魔法使いの婚約者 ～Eternally Yours～

After being involved in an accident in her former world, Filimina reincarnated into the world of sword and magic. The one who stayed beside her in this new world, was the unsociable handsome young boy with enormous magic power, Eguiedills.

Time goes by, Eguiedills is now the Head of Royal Magician and Filimina is his wife. After unraveling the mystery behind the origins of Filimina's nightmares, they both are living their happily married life, but...a new encounter seems to bring some more trouble to their life!?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Mairimashita! Iruma-kun Koushiki Anthology: Houkago no! Iruma-kun

authors: Shinobi|Sakurai, Norio|Fukui, Takumi|Heriyama|Sako, Misaki|Rio|Itagaki, Paru|Hachi|Nangou, Kouta|Tsudanuma, Atsushi|Kakemaru, Kakeru

title: Spy no Tsuma
synopsis:
Set in 1940, Yusaku runs a trading company in Kobe, Japan and he is married to Satoko. While on a business trip in Manchuria, Yusaku learns of a horrific national secret. For the sake of justice, he decides to let the whole world know about his discovery. Satoko believes Yusaku, who is now accused of being a traitor. She swears to be with Yusaku no matter the consequences.

(Source: AsianWiki, edited)

title: Duel Masters Fighting Edge
title_japanese: デュエル・マスターズ FE〈ファイティングエッジ〉
synopsis:
The story focuses on Shoubu traveling all over the world to stop the machinations of Zakira and his elites from killing the world's strongest Duelists.

(Source: Duel Masters Wiki)

title: Ore no Shibou Flag ga Todomaru Tokoro wo Shiranai
