synopsis:
Normal college student Kazuki Hirasawa finds himself inside the body of Harold Stokes, an evil character in the world of Kazuki's favorite game, Brave Hearts. The problem is, if the game's events go as they should, he'll one day find himself defeated by the hero's party. Will he be able to find a path to survival and avoid his many death flags using the incredible power of Harold Stokes's body and his own knowledge of the game?

(Source: One Peace Books)

title: Musubu to Hon.
synopsis:
Musubu is a boy who can hear the voices of books. One day, he meets a children's book who wants to go back to someone named Hana, and the search begins. Will he be able to fulfill the book’s request...?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Fusatsu no Fushiou no Saiseiki
title_english: The Undead King's Reign of Peace
title_japanese: 不殺の不死王の済世記
synopsis:
A young girl, Mira, on the brink of death due to an epidemic is rescued by the terrifying No Life King, a skeleton of great power. As he continues to help and provide for her and others, the people around him eventually come to trust and rely on him. However, their peaceful life is shattered when the local ruler hears talk about sightings of a powerful undead and dispatches soldiers to put the threat down. Will the No Life King and Mira be able to achieve a world where everyone can live in peace when everyone's first instinct is to either fight them or run away?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Meikyuu Kingdom: Tokushubutai SAS no Ossan no Isekai Dungeon Survival Manual!
title_english: Meikyuu: Labyrinth Kingdom, A Tactical Fantasy World Survival Guide
title_japanese: 迷宮キングダム　特殊部隊SASのおっさんの異世界ダンジョンサバイバルマニュアル！
synopsis:
After being transported to another world, one man's mission is to rebuild a kingdom. He has a very particular set of skills and he's ready to face any obstacle because...who dares, wins! Monster, dungeon, and war stand no chance against the special forces!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Samoto-ke no Nike
synopsis:
A naked cat-eared girl suddenly appeared next to an office lady who can't rely on others!? A heartwarming comedy that makes you feel at home when you read it, for people who are currently worried about their relationship!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Niizuma Koyomi
synopsis:
Soushirou is about to graduate college, but at this point he still hasn't found his calling professionaly speaking, that is till he admires a vase made by a famous potter. That's Soushirou's calling, the work of art captivates him so much that he immediately makes a vow to become a potter under that famous artist's tutetalage. Soushirou is accepted as a disiciple, with that Soushirou moves from Tokyo to a quite and cozy rural prefecture to live and learn with his master; there is where Soushirou will find love and marry while he develops his skills, becoming a worthy successor to his master.

(Source: VNDB)

title: Tetori Ashitori Oshieteyaru yo
title_japanese: 手とり足とり教えてやるよ
synopsis:
Out of the blue, the plain high schooler Misaki's heart is crushed when her boyfriend breaks up with her. Misaki is about to resign to her fate, considering herself boring and bland, when she meets a handsome guy who will turn her life around.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Ougo Mitsunaga wa Namagoroshi ga Tsurai
title_english: Mitsunaga Ougo is Trying to Control Himself
title_japanese: 淡河実永は生殺しがつらい
synopsis:
"When I turn 18..."

Mitsunaga will grant a wish of his cute girlfriend Karen(!?), after adding layers and layers of endurance. Even though he is an untalkative and diehard person, he has a bit more sexual desire than the normal person so there's no helping it for him to expect something. However, something unexpected happened on their memorial day that should've been celebrated!? She's precious so he won't lay a hand on her but because he likes her, he wants to touch her more...a troubled pure love story of a full-grown man!

(Source: NINO, translated)

title: Red Fox
synopsis:
Welcome to Ibana, a beautiful country also known as the red country. Here, lives the red fox, a wily beast who takes on the form of a human and feasts on the livers of humans. For hundreds of years, the fox kills without hesitation until, thanks to one human woman, it comes to know what that human emotion called "love," truly is. Out of the land of fire, erupts the cruel yet tragic love story of one evil spirit who yearns to possess the heart of one human woman.

(Source: NetComics)

title: Soshite Kaede wa Hanayaka ni Saku
title_japanese: そして楓は華やかに咲く
synopsis: The story of a slave acting as her master's legs.

title: Ikka Koukyuu Ryourichou
title_english: Culinary Chronicles of the Court Flower
synopsis:
Rimi has spent most of her life making food for the protector god of the land. She is suddenly sent as a tribute to the great empire of Konkoku, becoming one of the emperor's concubines. She comes close to losing the taste of her home country, but she is saved by the cuisinologist Shusei. As she dreams of a reunion with the kind scholar, she does her best to survive in the envy-filled rear palace with the help of her natural cheerfulness and her skill as a cook. Then out of nowhere, she is arrested and sentenced to be executed on the charge of disrespecting the emperor! How will Rimi get out of this mess? Find out in this China-inspired fantasy story about a princess and her love for food surrounded by gorgeous men.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Nora
synopsis:
Sabatora has been down on his luck. Needing money, Sabatora takes a break from college to work. His life changes, though, when Tsuchiya shows up like a knight in shining armor to take him out for food whenever he's hungry. Despite (or because of) Tsuchiya's kindness, Sabatora's pride is hurt whenever Tsuchiya treats him and buys him gifts. How will each of them adjust as they realize their feelings are neither that of a stray cat and its owner or even just friends, but more romantic?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Usotsuki Kitsune no Koi Hanashi
title_japanese: うそつきキツネの恋噺

title: Engoku no Bara-hime
synopsis:
In the small country of Ciel-Terra, the Royal Prince staged a coup d'etat, killed his own brother, the former King and took control of the throne with the backing of the Four Great Kingdoms. On her 10th birthday, René was apprehended by the knights of the Royal Prince faction for being a cursed child with silver hair and silver eyes and learnt that she was the abandoned Princess of the country. And so, branded as one who "was related to the depraved once-king," she was put through hellish torture before being executed via guillotine.

As her head parted from her body, René remembered. That, she once already lived life as a man by the name of Nagajiro Satou on Earth, and, falling victim to this world's God flattery, was forcibly reincarnated. And whilst in such a state, a woman who called herself an evil goddess appeared before her.

"Do you not detest him? The God who only kept half his word and reincarnated you in this form?"

"Do you not detest them? The people who pushed you to your

title: Keikoku no Shitateya Rose Bertin
title_english: Rose Bertin: The Dressmaker That Launched a Thousand Dreams
title_japanese: 傾国の仕立て屋 ローズ・ベルタン
synopsis:
18th century France, just before the revolution. The palace of Versailles hosted a dressmaker with more style than even the nobles themselves. This is the story of Rose Bertin, the mother of fashion design and the favorite stylist of Marie Antoinette.

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Yojouhan Shinwa Taikei
synopsis:
College is full of opportunities to leave one's comfort zone. One third year student is constantly fantasizing about how his life might differ had he joined various campus circles—chasing, with mixed results, an idealistic rose-colored campus life where romance, friendships, and purpose fuse into a perfect university experience... at least until bad luck, questionable decisions, and dubious relationships enter the mix!

(Source: Funimation)

title: 1 Plus 1
synopsis:
This romance starts with some bumps in the night, that turn into some truly irritating bumps in the day, that then turn into Sung-eun literally bumping into the reason for all the noise: her handsome and charming neighbor, Eun-sung. She quickly finds out that the private student representative has a somewhat questionable reputation, but that doesn't mean she shouldn't do her duty as the kind neighbor. I mean, they are literal neighbors, after all. She hides her true feelings to him, and the two grow so close that it isn't long before Sung-eun has to wonder if maybe Eun-sung...is also hiding something from her?

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Kao ga Nai Onnanoko
synopsis:
Her boyfriend thinks she's the cutest girl around, but her expressions can be a bit hard to read... Despite the miscommunications, there's one thing that always comes across—their love for each other.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Shoujo☆Kageki Revue Starlight Comic Anthology: Nine Stories
title_japanese: 少女☆歌劇 レヴュースタァライト コミックアンソロジー ナイン・ストーリーズ
synopsis: An anthology comic of Shoujo☆Kageki Revue Starlight by various mangaka.

title: Shigokare: Ecchi na Joshidaisei to Doki x2 Love Lesson!!
title_japanese: しごカレ エッチな女子大生とドキ×2ラブレッスン！！
synopsis:
The protagonist miraculously recovers from an incurable disease, however, he still suffers a considerable drop in mental and physical ability. Moreover, his school suddenly announces an exam which, if he can't pass it, will get him expelled immediately. Through the help of his doctor, he is introduced to several private tutors, but all of them are female college students. Furthermore, he needs to study at their dormitory and university. And so, his dorm life​ filled with private ecchi lessons begins.

(Source: Atelier Kaguya)

title: Ao no Eins
synopsis:
The manga centers on Aoi Kamiya, a 20-year-old goalkeeper in a professional soccer club. In his three-year career, he has seen his club go from low-ranking to third-highest. Kamiya is selected as a representative of Japan. He feels the pressure as he enters an important game in the second half. Dedicated to his role, Kamiya protects Japan's goalmouth to the end.

(Source: ANN)

Included one-shot:
Volume 1: Hiraku

title: Yomigaeru Shoujo
synopsis:
1. Yomigaeru Shoujo
2. Barabara
3. Kyoufu no Kazuko-san
4. Family
5. Niku no Kioku
6. Fushuu ni Sasowarete

title: Sex suru yori Hazukashii Koto
title_japanese: セックスするよりはずかしいこと
synopsis:
Haruyoshi is an extremely good-natured person who is too easily fooled by people. While searching for a job to pay for his grandfather's medical expenses, a young man with a mysterious aura calls out to him at a park: Sora, who introduces him to a part-time job that's almost too good to be true. But, it turned out to be an outrageous job where he has to live stream (pretend) sex with Sora?! A silly love comedy between a good-natured ikemen and a beautiful artist with poor emotions!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Suki da!! Oka-kun!!
synopsis:
Satsuki Oka's classmate Hajime Tsunefusa asks to meet on the roof, and then asks Satsuki out. Although he has no problem with two guys dating, Satsuki's not interested in guys himself. He rejects Hajime straight away, but then Hajime starts following him around...

(source: Renta!)

title: Junjou Dummy Heroine
synopsis:
1-2. Hadaka no Ohimesama
3. Usotsuki to Naishobanashi
4. Boku no Gemini
5. Konomi ja Nai kara
6. Soshite, Sorekara, Korekara mo

title: Otonarisan to Hajimeru Setsuyaku Seikatsu. Denkidai no Tame ni Issho no Heya de Sugoshimasen ka?
title_english: I Begin Saving Life With Neighbor
title_japanese: お隣さんと始める節約生活。 電気代のために一緒の部屋で過ごしませんか？

title: RPG Fudousan
synopsis:
The story begins 15 years after the demon king was defeated and the world has become peaceful. Kotone, who graduated from school and became a magician, inquired the kingdom-affiliated RPG Real Estate in order to find a new home. In reality, RPG Real Estate was Kotone's place of employment, and together with Fa, a demi-human, the priest Rufuria, and the soldier Rakira, they help support the searches of new homes for the customers with various circumstances.

(Source: MU)

title: Splatoon: Ikasu Kids 4-koma Fes
title_japanese: Splatoon イカすキッズ4コマフェス
synopsis:
The coolest squid kids live in Haikara City—or at least that is what Hit thinks. Moving from the countryside, Hit enters Haikara Square in hopes of following the trends and having fun. There, he meets Maika, an Inkling city girl who he tries to help recover her lost items, only to mess up in the process.

From then on, the two Inklings spend their time together doing popular activities around the city, with plenty of Hit's random reactions and Maika's occasional mishandling of Turf Battle weapons along the way. Joining their adventures is the rich Inkling boy Kou, who works in Salmon Runs part-time. With these three around, life in Haikara is never boring!

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Hyper Hard Special Mission
title_japanese: ハイパーハードスペシャルミッション
synopsis:
An awkward hitman is told by his girlfriend and partner that she has a new mission for him. "I want you to meet my parents." An important step for anyone in a relationship. What will happens in their meeting?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Quanzhi Fashi
synopsis:
Our hero, Mo Fan, inherits a magical necklace—the next day, he wakes up to find that the world has changed. His high school now teaches magic, and students are encouraged to try and become accomplished magicians. A world that ran on science now runs on magic. However, some things are still the same. He still has a teacher who sees him as a hopeless student, classmates who look the same, a father who struggles to make ends meet, and a not-by-blood little sister who can't walk on her own. However, Mo Fan discovers that the vast majority of magicians can only harness one element of magic. As luck would have it, however, he is an exception—a versatile mage!

(Source: Webnovel)

title: Suki, dakara Furetai.
title_english: I Want To Feel You Because I Like You
synopsis:
With the help of a friendly ghost, Masaki, Ono-sensei can examine his young patient's teeth without much fuss. It seems that only Ono-sensei and children can see Masaki. He brings a calming presence, which is convenient for children at the dentist and for Ono-sensei as well. But is he really a ghost? He doesn't remember much about his past but for some reason, he's very attached to Ono-sensei. So much so that Masaki hangs out around the office and even walks Ono-sensei home. Once they reach the entrance to Ono-sensei's apartment however, Masaki is asked to stay out. Ono-sensei doesn't want Masaki to know that something else haunts him behind closed doors.

(Source: MediBang/Julian Publishing)

title: Maou Evelogia ni Mi wo Sasage yo
title_english: Reincarnated Into Demon King Evelogia's World
title_japanese: 魔王イブロギアに身を捧げよ
synopsis:
Having hated heroes since he was a child, Toshiaki Gozu has always idolized the villain of his favorite game, the fearsome demon king Evelogia: a character who fights for himself after being despised by all, destined to someday die by the hero's sword.

In the present, after living a life of crime, Gozu is fatally shot. Surprisingly, he awakens in the world of his favorite game, reincarnated as a mob character—the assassin sent to kill Evelogia when he was a mere child. Confronted with Evelogia's immense power, Gozu's love for the game's final boss conquers all. Vowing to protect the young Evelogia, he changes the course of the game for good.

Unfortunately, Evelogia had already cast a charm spell on Gozu, causing his body to flush hot and his breath to run short. Despairing over his actions and faced with Gozu's plea for death by his hand, Evelogia seeks to remedy the magic by any means necessary. He finds, however, only one solution: the affected must take in the caster's bodily flui

title: Watashi, Nichijou wa Heikinchi de tte Itta yo ne!
title_english: Didn't I Say to Make My Abilities Average in the Next Life?! Everyday Misadventures!
title_japanese: 私、日常は平均値でって言ったよね!
synopsis:
Enjoy the fun and fluffy everyday (mis)adventures of the Crimson Vow! This spin-off comedy is a lighthearted romp featuring the unforgettable cast of Didn't I Say To Make My Abilities Average in the Next Life?!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Uchi no Ojousama ga Hametsu End shika Nai Akuyaku Reijou no You nanode Ore ga Kyuusai Shitai to Omoimasu.
title_japanese: うちのお嬢様が破滅エンドしかない悪役令嬢のようなので俺が救済したいと思います。
synopsis:
I'm an otome game capture character?

One day, Vincent, the deacon of the Countess, suddenly remembered that this world was a maiden game in the previous life, and that her beloved daughter died as a villain daughter...!? "Do not be silly! The ruin flag that the young lady dies will be broken by me!" A high-tension isekai reincarnation comedy in which the young lady who loves the butler struggles to avoid the bad end of the villainess!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Tsuihou Akuyaku Reijou no Dannasama
title_japanese: 追放悪役令嬢の旦那様
synopsis:
"I" had the luck of being the one who reached out towards the young lady whose engagement was annulled by Prince Alephaldo, Elana. The day after the annulment, I was banished with her and married even though we dated for exactly 0 days. Well, it's just a slow country lifestyle of banishment in the neighboring country! Or so I thought, but...? This is my story about becoming a banished villainess's husband.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Futsutsuka na Akujo dewa Gozaimasu ga: Suuguu Chouso Torikae Den
title_english: Though I Am an Inept Villainess: Tale of the Butterfly-Rat Body Swap in the Maiden Court
title_japanese: ふつつかな悪女ではございますが ～雛宮蝶鼠とりかえ伝～
synopsis:
In a kingdom inspired by historical China, five clans put forth their maidens as imperial consorts–but only one will be crowned empress. The frail and beautiful Kou Reirin, the so-called "butterfly" of the imperial court, is a shoo-in to marry the crown prince. But when "court rat" Shu Keigetsu lashes out at her during the glittering Lantern Festival, it's Reirin who wakes up in the dungeons! Body-swapped by her assailant to steal her position at court, Reirin's plight seems dire...to everyone else! Now that she's got a robust new body, not even the looming threat of execution can stop her!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Moto Home Center Tenin no Isekai Seikatsu: Shougou "DIY Master" "Green Master" "Pet Master" wo Kushi shite Isekai wo Kimama ni Ikimasu
title_japanese: 元ホームセンター店員の異世界生活～称号≪DIYマスター≫≪グリーンマスター≫≪ペットマスター≫を駆使して異世界を気儘に生きます～

title: Genshin: Dengeki Comic Anthology
title_japanese: 原神 電撃コミックアンソロジー
authors: Mikage, Baku|Kanyapyi|Sakurai, Energy|Hirose, Madoka|Arito, Arayuru|Enda, Marimo|Tsumumi|Kanbara, Erika
synopsis: An anthology of stories set in the world of the game Genshin Impact.

title: Murazukuri Game no NPC ga Namami no Ningen to shika Omoenai
title_english: The NPCs in this Village Sim Game Must Be Real!
title_japanese: 村づくりゲームのNPCが生身の人間としか思えない
synopsis:
Yoshio is thirty years old, and his life is a mess. A shut-in living with his parents, he has no job, no relationship, and no prospects. When he receives a new sim computer game that boasts characters created with a new kind of A.I., he doesn't think much of it–until he gets drawn into a fantasy world so vibrant and lifelike that its residents can't just be game characters. Suddenly finding himself the benevolent god of a scrappy fantasy village is a lot for Yoshio to handle, but it might be the key to the change he desperately needs.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Hitsuji ni Narasete Itadakimasu!
title_english: Please Let Me Be Your Sheep!
title_japanese: ヒツジにならせていただきます！
synopsis:
Stuck in a job that does not pay well, Baba is struggling to pay for his food and rent. After a drunken night with his coworkers, a package arrives at his door—an expensive sex toy he has no recollection of ordering. Now in debt with no way out, Baba is desperate for money.

Right before making a rash decision, a coworker suggests Baba an odd part-time job: become a test subject in an experimental laboratory with the goal of bringing VR technology into the sex industry. Left with no other choice, he visits the facility and meets the young and attractive scientist Iida, the one in charge of the experiments.

Although initially wary, Baba is elated to start the tests. The technology offers him a realistic experience with his favorite actress, Miori, and intense pleasure he has never felt before. However, he is unaware that behind Miori's sensual actions is someone beyond his imagination...

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Zannen datta na, Unmei da!
synopsis:
One day, nightclub host and womanizer Yuuto Izumi is suddenly kidnapped by men in black suits. They question him about seducing the fiancée of a certain heir to a business empire and reprimand him for breaking up the engagement... But the heir in question turns out to be Kaname Mikoshiba, a classmate from high school!! Kaname has a proposition for his old friend Yuuto. He's willing to forgive him on the condition that he become Kaname's possession. Yuuto is confused, and he doesn't know what to think - until he's taken to the Mikoshiba estate where Kaname professes his love to him, gets on top of him, and...!! Don't miss this exciting rom-com!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Tottemo Love Voice
synopsis:
1. Tottemo Love Voice
2. Tottemo Tottemo Love Voice
3. Taneakashi wo Shimashou ka
4. Taneakashi no Sono Ato de
5. Sono Te de Ai wo Oshiete yo
6. Yowamushi wa Koi no Hajimari

title: Tatoeba Ore ga, Champion kara Oujo no Himo ni Job Change shita toshite.
title_japanese: たとえば俺が、チャンピオンから王女のヒモにジョブチェンジしたとして。
synopsis:
In a world where human "professions" are determined by nature, there was a person who was the strongest, despite being "jobless." Fuuta, who trained harder than anyone else to achieve this and became a champion was cast out and exiled. At the end of his wandering, he was picked up by Lilac M Fangini, the first princess and ruler of a city.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Shuukatsu Shippai shita Succubus-san wo Hiroimashita
title_japanese: 就活失敗したサキュバスさんを拾いました

title: Xiuluo Wushen
synopsis:
Regarding potential—even if you are not considered a genius, you can still learn Mysterious Techniques and martial skills. Anyone can be enlightened without a master. Regarding strength—despite having a myriad of artifacts, you may not defeat my army of World Spirits. Who am I? All of the world's living perceives me as Asura, but I was ignorant to such a thing. I thus ascend to be the Martial God as Asura.

(Source: WuxiaWorld)

title: Hataraku Kappa
synopsis:
Anne's father suffered from a strange illness and was laid off from his job as a chef. Anne decided to work in her father's stead, and went to a job interview on a cold morning. However, the underwater elevator to the interview destination is attacked by a giant octopus. Then, an octopus fishing submarine with a Kappa crew...

(Source: Seirinkogeisha, translated)

title: Koi ni Hentai wa Tsukimono desu.
title_japanese: 恋にヘンタイは憑きものです。
synopsis:
Chizuru is your typical shrine maiden high schooler living in a shinto shrine. One day, her friend, Aki, asked her to do an exorcism for her but since Chizuru couldn't do it, they decided to ask the help of their attractive senior, Asakura, who's said to be able to do exorcisms. However, Asakura has an unbelievable fetish! In addition, Asakura's batchmate, Suyazaki, is just as much of a weirdo as he is! What shall Chizuru do as her fate gets entangled with such a ridiculous group of people?! 

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Summer Solstice Point
synopsis:
"I've never kissed anyone before... so help me out. Please?" Seoha's divorce is still fresh in her mind when 20-year-old Jihoo begins working at her café. Jihoo's unassuming beauty immediately draws her in, and his desire for Seoha burns too bright for her not to notice. Seoha decides it wouldn't hurt to shake him up a bit... but Jihoo's not the only one stepping into unfamiliar territory this summer.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Ex-Arm: The Novel - Kikaishin
title_english: Ex-Arm: The Novel - Deus Ex Machina
title_japanese: EX-ARM エクスアーム THE NOVEL 機械神
synopsis:
Shin Kagurazaka, a town that escaped the Tokyo Olympic terrorist attacks. From general ikazayas, to sexbot-specialized brothels, or undergound gambling dens, it is regarded as a gigantic entertainment district where one can indulge in their pleasures. In this town, the EX-ARM Countermeasure Division receive reports of a "smuggler," and sends in Alma in an undercover operation. Her target of infiltration is a girl's bar. Meanwhile, Minami encounters a mother who asks for help in finding her daughter.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Ex-Arm: Another Code
title_japanese: EX-ARM Another Code エクスアーム アナザーコード
synopsis:
2030, Tokyo. Minami, an officer in the EX-ARM Countermeasure Division, and Shiho, a junior officer in the traffic division, respond to a tip of a suspicious person and find a drug called "Happy" at the scene. By chance, they meet a mother in the vicinity who says her daughter was kidnapped, leading Minami to information related to "Alpha K," a new religious group that is rapidly gaining followers. Then, the EX-ARM task force is called in...?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Koori no Reijou no Tokashikata
title_english: How to Melt the Ice Queen's Heart
synopsis:
Asahi Kagami—a rather outgoing guy with a tendency to try to help anyone in need—happens to be neighbors and classmates with a girl named Fuyuka Himuro. At school she's been nicknamed "The Ice Queen" by her classmates, and for good reason: she prefers to keep everyone at arm's length and seldom talks to others.

Neither Fuyuka nor Asahi have had a chance to interact with each other yet, but Asahi's tendency to meddle in other people's business slowly but surely marks the beginning of a relationship that blooms into something more...

(Source: Tentai Books)

title: Ryoute ni Imouto. Docchi wo Erande Kuremasu ka?
title_japanese: 両手に妹。どっちを選んでくれますか？

title: Kimama ni Tokyo Survive.: Moshimo Nihon ga Mamono darake de, Level Up to Hack-and-Slash Youso ga Atte, Survival Seikatsu made Tanoshimetara.
title_japanese: 気ままに東京サバイブ。もしも日本が魔物だらけで、レベルアップとハクスラ要素があって、サバイバル生活まで楽しめたら。
synopsis:
White-collar worker Gotou Shizuka is attacked by a slasher who suddenly appears in the heart of the shopping district. Just as she is lost to her wounds, she hears a voice ring in her head.

And even worse, these dreams include someone staring at me during my filthy fish time: the marine biology nerd from my class, Ogasawara-kun! The guy is so obsessed with undersea life that honestly, he kinda weirded me out at first. But now that I'm deep in the closet pretending to be "normal," I think it's attractive that he can be true to himself without caring what people think. Of course, the moment I realized I like him, my dreams became even more obscene! Cut to our hang-out at the aquarium, and while I'm looking at fish with Ogasawara-kun, I actually get turned on?! Seriously, what is wrong with me?!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Under the Greenlight
synopsis:
Cheongwoo Jin has led a lonely existence of promiscuity, violence, and drugs. Dabbling in both legal and criminal activities, he has created a name for himself and an extravagant lifestyle he can enjoy. His newest venture is to buy the construction rights for an expensive plot of land, where his boss plans to build an art museum. By chance, this simple job leads him to encounter Matthew Raynor—a young sculpture student who is expressionless and mysterious yet completely enchanted by Jin.

Desperate to keep Jin in his life and unintimidated by his threatening attitude, Matthew asks him to model for his sculpturing project. Despite it being an outrageous request, Jin accepts the offer in exchange for sex, agreeing to regularly meet in Matthew's studio. As enemy organizations compete for the same lot as Jin, his sketchy past begins to catch up to him, and he wonders if he is truly going insane by deciding to risk everything to protect one innocent student.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Ai wo Okizari ni
synopsis:
Even though you hate me, I still love you...

Worried about her aging grandmother, Emily visited her grandmother's mansion after a long absence. Eleven years earlier, she'd fallen in love with Lucas, the man next door. However, after a painful encounter, and his engagement, she fell out of love with him. At least Lucas was now working as a doctor in faraway Africa—there was no way that they would run into each other now. But, sadly, his wife passed away and he had returned to his home. To make matters worse, a fire broke out in her grandmother's mansion the very night Emily arrived, meaning Emily and her grandmother have nowhere else to go but Lucas's nearby home. Unbelievable! How on earth is Emily going to be able to share a roof him?

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

Before him are five beautiful girls, all in contention to become his lover—and each with her own agenda. It's up to Kouta to investigate and choose who he wants...but with his hands full from the girls' advances, will he really be the one controlling the board, or will he become a pawn instead?

title: Sakura, Saku.
synopsis:
Overcome by her anemia, Saku Fujigaya falls unconscious and loses her precious handbag while disembarking from a crowded train. Upon waking up in an infirmary, she finds her bag and all its contents beside her, along with a note with only her benefactor's name and phone number. To her dismay, her calls never manage to connect.

Saku used to think of herself as a background character—someone whose presence would always go unnoticed. However, one person had gone out of their way to notice her predicament and come to her aid. Moved by such an act of pure kindness, Saku begins to change her views on herself and the world. Despite being ridiculed as a goody-two-shoes by those who merely stand by and watch, Saku makes it her purpose to assist everyone who needs or wants help—an ambition she carries into high school.

During her first day of high school, Saku thinks she hears someone calling her name, only to realize they are looking for a Sakura—the same name as that of her mysterious savior

title: Sakaki-kun no Flight Plan

synopsis:
Kosuke is distressed by his failed love life. Working as a flight dispatcher, every day is hectic, causing the relationships with his boyfriends to turn sour. His pilot friend and work colleague, Ayumu, is a shoulder to lean on, and is also the only one that knows of Kosuke's sexual orientation. One night, mistaking Ayumu for his boyfriend, Kosuke embraces his friend? someone he treasures dearly, but never intended to cross that line with! What will become of their relationship!?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Nakimushi Akuma no Maria-kun
title_japanese: なきむし悪魔のマリアくん
synopsis:
College student Satoru Shiiyama had a crush on Jun Mariya ever since middle school, but the object of his affections dies in an accident. In the midst of his grieving, Satoru accidentally summons a demon and gets a once-in-a-lifetime offer: "In return for your life span, I'll grant you a wish." Having lost all hope, Satoru agrees. Just what is the wish that he made? This is a heart-warming(?) love story between a selfish, lustful guy and an honest, cute little demon.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Kawaigaru nara Shitemo Ii
title_english: If You Treat Me Nice, We Can Do It
title_japanese: かわいがるならシてもいい
synopsis:
Aki Himejima is a lawyer who used to be a bad boy... and he has a secret. Although he acts cool and masculine at the office, he adores cute things... and loves to be treated like a beautiful princess. Yakuza gangster Ryuuji, a younger guy he went to school with, is the only person who knows about it. Ryuuji is in love with Aki, and he lavishes him with the sweet words that Aki wants to hear. Ryuuji is devoted to giving him all the pleasure that he desires, even if the lawyer figures that it's just a handy method of release for the younger guy. And Aki has been in love with someone else for a long time... A yaoi comic about a younger yakuza who never gives up and a former bad-boy lawyer who wants to be treated like a princess!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Dare ga Yonda no!?: Isekai to Game Tsukuri to Recruit Shoukan
title_japanese: 誰が喚んだの!?　～異世界とゲーム作りとリクルート召喚～
synopsis:
Fearing a magic power crisis, the sword and sorcery world of Fairleaf takes to summoning not people, but copies of entire buildings from other worlds. After repeated failures, one day they try summoning not a mere building, but an entire town—and accidentally get the entire neighborhood of Akihabara, the legendary otaku mecca. After an investigation, Akihabara's culture and technology spreads throughout Fairleaf, sparking a revolution.

Accidentally brought along for the ride, Kubo Toshinori runs the Galge company "Eternal Soft" in this new world. Alongside his cute Beastfolk assistant (and PR manager, and voice actress) Monica and his half-elf potion-binging programmer Iris, Kubo and Eternal Soft continue the constant struggle against deadlines, Twitter trolls, and software bugs!

(Source: MU)

After Koganei was rejected by a girl he had confessed to, he angrily ran off and was hit by a car.

When he woke up, he found that he was reincarnated in another world as Theodore Goldberg, the eldest son of a marquis. And of course, as Koganei is no stranger to isekai series, he knows that he will have some sort of cheat skill to become overpowered and live a slow life.

And so he tries to open up his status screen... only to find that this world doesn't have video game stats. He then tries to use his OP magic skills... only to find out he is too young to even learn magic. So then he tries swordsmanship... but turns out to be weak with the blade. And so he decides to just invent modern technology to get ahead... only to find out that this world has magical devices which are identical to modern technology.

Theodore is at an impasse. He's not strong, he's not smart, and he's not handsome. So what exactly is his cheat skill? For what purpose was he reincarnated in the first place if he

synopsis:
Bar, an ordinary middle-aged mister and a veteran adventurer, lived an easy, comforting life in the Imperial Capital. He would carry items for adventuring parties or help the guild's staff from time to time.

"Mr. Bar, glad to have you today!"

"Thank you for your words."

That uncle who was liked by everyone in the capital, was actually the strongest arsenal of the Empire—one of the "Laevateinn"—Bartolomeus.

"Please step forward, Lord Bar."

With a delicate and beautiful elven girl, Welhe Mina, to back him up, his gallant figure racing across the battlefield or the political battleground was simply godly—like a War God. The heroic tales of the dowdy adventurer AND the mightiest arsenal starts here!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

As he's wandering the streets trying to get his life back on track, the person who saves him is veteran actor Akiomi Satake. After being invited over, Asahi starts living with Akiomi. Then, that night, while he's trying to sleep, Asahi notices that a guy's touching him. Even though he was half-hoping it was Akiomi, it turns out to be a handsome college student, Hayato, whom he's never met before...!! That's when Akiomi enters the room and the rest of the night is filled with shameful acts of love... Let this comedic love story about three guys living under the same roof begin!

An intriguing tale of otherworldly marriage is about to begin!

Nagisa thinks that there's no reason for Taiyou to fall in love with such a hardcore otaku like her. My sister Nilla, who became the Emperor's Queen after having dreamt of fairy tales and true loves, came back divorced and accused of high treason. If I become queen in your stead, you and our family need not suffer. This life of yours can have a happy ending, sister. I promise.

Garam has always loved to draw, but his dreams of being an artist have been on hold ever since his mother passed away. Instead, he's pressing her to reenact their wedding night to help her regain Annelie's memories! Will she be able to resist his touch or is she destined to bend to his every whim?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Miyasato Haruka, lover of video games and sweets, was going to spend her school days immersed in video games, when Ibuki, determined to bring back the Golf Club, appeared! Ibuki then dragged Haruka into playing golf...

And so, the story of the high school girls of the Golf Club unfolds, a cute and youthful slice-of-life comedy!

Growing up in a rural town, Lee Jihyun had dreamed of becoming a fashion columnist. Now at 30, she finds herself working for a celebrity gossip website with a bulldog clip in her hair. A rumored relationship concerning her favorite star, Haneul, and an observation from a colleague causes her to reminisce about her childhood crush, Jimin. Is Haneul really the boy she once knew? At least they have a class together this semester: a lecture taught by the popular Professor Seo Joohyuk. Hours after the first class, Hajoon remembers he left his assignments in the classroom. Upon reaching the lecture hall, he becomes witness and accomplice to a series of private lessons Joo-hyuk is giving Eun-woo—lessons that unleash his own deepest, riskiest desires.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: The Shape of Sympathy
synopsis:
Yuri attends the wedding of his unrequited love. There, he runs into his former homeroom teacher Seonwoo, who seems just as heartbroken by the union. But little does he know that Seonwoo's tears are meant not for the bride, but for the groom...

(Source: Manta)

title: Pocket Monsters Diamond/Pearl
title_japanese: ポケットモンスター ダイヤモンド・パール
synopsis: A one-shot following young Kenta and Barry as they set off on their adventure in the Sinnoh region, drawn to commemorate the release of the games.

title: Shinobe yo! Stalker
title_japanese: 忍べよ! ストーカー
synopsis:
As a runaway ninja, Benimaru has little to no prospects in life. As he was lying in the woods, contemplating his death, a stranger approaches him and gives him back his will to live. Benimaru finds out that the man was none other than the province's feudal lord's son, Lord Shinosuke Kiyohisa Yamato. Putting his skills to use, Benimaru sneaks around and secretly looks after Lord Shinosuke, who may be much more clueless than he lets on...

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Isekai Elf no Dorei-chan
title_japanese: 異世界エルフの奴隷ちゃん

title: Ouritsu Mahou Gakuen no Saikasei: Slum Agari no Saikyou Mahoushi, Kizoku darake no Gakuen de Musou suru
title_english: The Irregular of the Royal Academy of Magic
title_japanese: 王立魔法学園の最下生～貧困街〈スラム〉上がりの最強魔法師、貴族だらけの学園で無双する～
synopsis:
"Magic." A sacred mystery usable only by those chosen. One day, a child from the slums named Ars finds he has the power to use magic. A sorcerer by the name of Genos Wilzard learns of his talent and raises him, turning him into the greatest of assassins. One day, Genos gives him an order: To enroll at the Magic Academy...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Shijou Saikyou no Mahou Kenshi, F-Rank Boukensha ni Tensei suru: Kensei to Matei, Futatsu no Zense wo Motta Otoko no Eiyuutan
title_japanese: 史上最強の魔法剣士、Fランク冒険者に転生する ～剣聖と魔帝、2つの前世を持った男の英雄譚～
synopsis:
Yuuri Aizawa has reincarnated 2 times now and is dead tired of being the emperor of this and that. Using his skills, he acquired a reincarnation artifact, and starts his life in a brand new world!

(Source: MU)

title: Amai, Nigai, Amai
synopsis: Just before Valentine's Day, my older childhood friend appears before my eyes.

title: Majo Raba Majo Reba
synopsis:
Ever since a lifesaving blood transfusion, Haruka Kuze has been indebted to Maruna Rinjou. The only problem: How do you show your gratitude to someone who barely gives you the time of day? So when he finds out she's actually a witch, Haruka swears he'll do whatever it takes to help her graduate from magic school-even if it means cross-dressing as a girl! But does Maruna really hate him, or is there another reason she gets so flustered when he's around?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Dokuzetsu Shoujo wa Amanojaku: Kabegoshi nara Sunao ni Suki tte Ierumon!
title_japanese: 毒舌少女はあまのじゃく ～壁越しなら素直に好きって言えるもん！～
synopsis:
A love comedy through a wall!

Yukina, a very talented beautiful girl, is a neighbor who lives in the same apartment as me. For some reason, Yukina-senpai always has a sharp tongue when talking to me, but that attitude is simply because she is very shy and she really wants to get along with me. I can hear everything he says through the wall!

(Source: Hobby Japan, translated)

title: Assassin no Kyuujitsu
synopsis: Follow the most feared assassin in the Italian mafia and see what he does on his days off.

title: A Business Proposal
synopsis:
In an attempt to ward off yet another one of Jin Yeong-seo's suitors, Shin Ha-ri goes on a blind date in her best friend's place with the goal of ruining the meeting. Arriving in a thick layer of makeup, a ridiculous pink wig, and a seductive outfit, Ha-ri is prepared to scare the man away so badly that Yeong-seo's father will be forced to stop setting his daughter up on blind dates. However, the handsome young man who appears in front of Ha-ri is none other than Kang Tae-mu, the newly appointed CEO of the company she works at.

Despite Ha-ri's attempts to act as crazy and undesirable as possible, Tae-mu remains indifferent during their date and even proposes to Ha-ri—whom he still believes is Yeong-seo. Caught in a web of deceit, Ha-ri must find a way to reject the oddly persistent Tae-mu or risk being exposed and losing her job. However, the more Tae-mu pursues Ha-ri, the more she begins to question her feelings toward him.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: FX Senshi Kurumi-chan
synopsis:
When middle school student, Fukuga Kurumi's mother commits suicide after losing 20 million yen in FX trading (Foreign Exchange trading), she vows to recoup the money her mother lost "I'll easily get that much back!"

Now, when she is a university student she makes her long-awaited debut in FX trading, unaware that the world she just entered could turn from heaven to hell in the blink of an eye.

This is a cute and slightly dangerous story as it explains technical terms by thrilling market fluctuations as the chart drives up and down, which becomes more heated with the entry of quirky FX warriors: Yasuko Takane, Mochiko Kogane, and Mebuki Yamashi. Can Kurumi and her friends survive this world with unstoppable heartbeat moments and unrealized losses!?

(Source: MAL News)

title: Shinpai-chan wa Kyou mo Asedaku
title_japanese: 心配ちゃんは今日も汗だく

title: Sono Koi, Jihanki de Kaemasu ka?
title_english: Can I Buy Your Love from a Vending Machine?
title_japanese: その恋、自販機で買えますか？
synopsis:
Salaryman Ayumu Koiwai just can't tear his eyes away from the strong, muscular man as he checks on the stocks of the vending machine in his office. He may be a proper adult now, but everything about the emotions Yamashita awakens in him feels like a teenager's first love...

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Tantei wa Mou, Shindeiru. The Lost Memory
title_japanese: 探偵はもう、死んでいる。-the lost memory-
synopsis:
Kimihiko Kimizuka, a young man who four years ago became the assistant of a mysterious detective known as "Siesta" on a hijacked airplane. Together, Kimihiko and Siesta went on mind-boggling, globe-trotting adventures while combatting a secret organization, but all of that came to an end when they were separated by Siesta's death. In the present day, Kimihiko tries to return to an ordinary, boring life as a high school student, but things are never that simple, even though the detective is already dead.

(Source: Crunchyroll, edited)

title: Rough Sketch
synopsis:
1. Tonari no Ie no Kanojo (The Beautiful Girl Next Door)
2. Borderline
3. Happening
4-6. Sensei,
7. Tamago
8. Namigiwayori

title: Kiss de Fusaide, Barenaide.
title_english: Seal My Lips With a Kiss
title_japanese: キスでふさいで、バレないで。
synopsis:
"You're so turned on for someone trapped in this situation..."

My sensitive spots are getting rubbed harshly over my shirt and a finger is slowly creeping inside of me. How can I suppress my voice so that we won't get found out...!

One night, Kaede was accidentally locked out in the corridor of her workplace. She's helped by her unrequited love, Shioya, who happened to pass by. He then lets her stay overnight at his house. Surprised by Shioya's roommate, they hide in the closet. Kaede's thrilled by how close his body is to her... At that moment, his lips touch her chest.

(Source: Solmare Henshuubu, translated)

title: BJ Alex
synopsis:
University student Nam Dong-Gyun never misses out on the nightly livestream of his favorite broadcasting jockey, Alex. To fulfill his viewers' neverending fantasies, BJ Alex—who wears a mask to conceal his face—performs sensually arousing acts. Most of the time, Dong-Gyun ends up indulging in sexual pleasure after watching the steamy show. Being in blissful ignorance, he has fallen in love with the gay cam boy.

At school, Dong-Gyun meets Ahn Jiwon, the amiable and radiant president of the student council. When he invites Dong-Gyun to a drinking party, it quickly ends in total failure as Dong-Gyun becomes extremely intoxicated. In the company of Jiwon, he arrives safely in his apartment.

While his colleague cleans himself from the bumpy ride, Dong-Gyun fixes his eyes on Jiwon's half-naked body; his physique resembles that of BJ Alex's! Unable to contain his excitement, Dong-Gyun asks if he and BJ Alex are the same person—the response he gets is unexpected. With a different side of Jiw

title: Hoshi wo Ou Kodomo
synopsis:
Asuna is a shy and diffident girl who lives in the mountain town of Mizunofuchi. One day, she meets Shun, a boy who claims to be from a mythical land known as Agartha. However, just as a bond is beginning to form between them, Shun vanishes. As Asuna wishes she could see him again, she encounters Shin, another boy who looks just like Shun, and Morisaki, a teacher searching for Agartha. The three of them set out for the legendary country, each with their own goal in mind—and their own lessons to learn along the way.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Shoot! no Sekai ni Gon Nakayama ga Tensei shiteshimatta Ken
title_english: That Time Gon Nakayama Got Reincarnated into the World of Shoot!
title_japanese: シュート!の世界にゴン中山が転生してしまった件
synopsis:
The manga centers on professional soccer player Masashi Nakayama, otherwise known as Gon Nakayama, getting reincarnated into the world of Shoot! and impressing the world with his skills.

(Source: ANN)

title: Hana-san wa Minorasetai!
title_japanese: ハナさんは実らせたい!
synopsis:
Hana meets a good-looking guy at the train station, then happens to meet him again on a blind date. However, despite his indifferent attitude, Hana discovers that he just might be the person she's been talking to online for the past four years!

(Source: MU)

title: Like Wind on a Dry Branch
title_english: Like Wind on a Dry Branch
synopsis:
Vivisepulture—the practice of burying a living person to accompany the deceased as a sacrifice—awaited Rieta Tristi following the passing of Casarius, the Count of Cevitas. Her sacrificial burial to appease the gods comes amidst a plague that has claimed the lives of many, including her first husband. Rieta's daughter had been sold into the slave trade by the same person who is now asking her to be buried alongside him. While she accepts her death sentence, the ceremony is interrupted by the Archduke of Axias Manor.

The Archduke is an outcast of his empire, owing to widespread tales of bloodshed and merciless killing by his hands. He appears unannounced at Count Casarius' funeral to settle a debt, but he is disappointed when he is met with a wooden coffin instead. Seeing something intriguing in her gloomy demeanor, Archduke Axias requests for Rieta's life to be entrusted to him in exchange for debt forgiveness, which the late Count's son hastily accepts.

Now a consort for Archduke Ax

title: Akuyaku Reijou wa Nightingale wo Mezasu
title_english: The Villainess Who Became a Nightingale
title_japanese: 悪役令嬢は夜告鳥〈ナイチンゲール〉をめざす
synopsis:
I reincarnated into the world of a European online novel?!

When I realized I was in a novel world without route branching, I hit a wall from the very beginning for one simple reason. The main character of the original novel is a former doctor, but there is no way I can cheat and do the same. I can't help but wonder what I can do as a former mourning woman against so many capture characters. If this happens, I will aim to become a nightingale in this world!

A medical slapstick romance that involves a former mourning woman who is wild and has not a single romantic bone in her body.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Akuyaku Reijou wa Heroine wo Ijimeteiru Baai dewa Nai
title_english: This Is No Time for the Villainess to Bully the Heroine!
title_japanese: 悪役令嬢はヒロインを虐めている場合ではない
synopsis:
In an unexpected turn of events, Haru transmigrates into the body of Reina, the villainess of an otome game.

As soon as she transmigrates, an event in which the villainess bullies the heroine starts. If she bullies the heroine just like the game, the only ending waiting for Reina will be one of destruction. This isn't the time to be acting like a villainess, I want to enjoy my life! That's what Reina decided, but the heroine and the game's love interests keep falling into trouble?!

This is the long awaited manga version of the story of the villainess aiming for a happy ending in an unprecedented isekai life.

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title: Betabore no Konyakusha ga Akuyaku Reijou ni Saresou nanode.
title_japanese: ベタ惚れの婚約者が悪役令嬢にされそうなので。
synopsis:
Elizabeth is devastated, her engagement was broken with the exact same lines as the scene in The Holy Maiden Makes the Stars Fall in the Night Sky, a popular novel among the nobility. Just as she's about to explode in anger at the villainous heroine grinning beside her, the crown prince turns around and begins to denounce the heroine actions against her? Actually, everything is in the palm of the prince's hand.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Jimi Hime to Kuroneko no, Enman na Konyaku Haki
title_english: Gloomy Princess and the Black Cat's Peaceful Engagement Annulment
title_japanese: 地味姫と黒猫の、円満な婚約破棄
synopsis:
Seren, the eldest daughter of a duke family, has been compared to her sister Marietta, who is said to be an exquisite beauty, and has grown up being called the "Plain Princess." She overhears her fiancé, Prince Helios, and his friends talking about how Marietta should be the princess consort instead of Seren.

In order to make Prince Helios happy, she want to break off the engagement without causing any trouble to anyone. With the black cat familiar she borrowed from the "Commander of the Ice Mages," Viol, she aims for an amicable engagement annulment.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Hoshigarisugi da yo, Sumida-kun!
title_japanese: 欲しがりすぎだよ、墨田くん!
synopsis:
1-2. Hoshigari nano wa
3. Renai Ketteiron
4. Renai Ketteiron: Takaramono
5. Reizoku

title: Katawarezuki, Renren toshite
synopsis:
A childhood friend, Akira Sajima, who suddenly disappeared more than 20 years ago, appeared in front of Makoto Ooe, who runs a local bakery. Akira, who has nowhere to go, decides to live together with Makoto while helping out. Makoto slept with Akira every night while whispering sweet words "Become my family," but when he asked what he was doing after he went missing, he didn't answer for some reason...?

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Cover Iranai desu yo ne
title_japanese: カバーいらないですよね

title: Hydrangea
synopsis:
1. Hydrangea
2. The Key
3. Netemo Sametemo (Waking or Sleeping)
4. Memoria
5. Arabis lyrata var

title: Surechigai, Meguriai
synopsis:
How can I tell him this child is his?

Annie Talbot can't believe what her former boss, Brant, is telling her. After reuniting for the first time in years, he reveals that the son she's been raising alone is actually his son—the babies had been switched at birth! She still vividly remembers how Brant supported her in the past, but she's lived her life hiding a grave secret from him. And now Brant's asked her to live in his house to raise the children together!

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Our Paradise
synopsis:
Mae-hwa, who had secretly been in love with Jae-won throughout high school, finally made up his mind to stop loving Jae-won and forget about him after graduation. But at the first party after entering university, he found out that Jae-won was also there! Mae-hwa tries to keep his distance from Jae-won. Jae-won tries to get closer to him. Will his hidden feelings finally be discovered? Jae-won finds out how they can get along in the future...

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Mama ga Hoshii no
synopsis:
He was paying her to pretend to love him, but soon his whole family had stolen her heart!

Merry, a server, was in desperate need of money. One day out of the blue, Peter, one of her customers, asked her to pretend to be his girlfriend over the Thanksgiving holiday. He seemed serious and the money would certainly help, so Merry accepted his proposal. When they went to visit his family, his sweet mother welcomed Merry with open arms. She believed that Merry and her son were going to get married. Merry was concerned that Peter's mother was getting too excited about their fake relationship. But she was more concerned about how Peter and his son didn't seem to get along. Perhaps there was a way Merry could help Peter and his family...

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Nanatsu no Taizai: Tenkuu no Torawarebito
title_japanese: 七つの大罪 天空の囚われ人
synopsis: A booklet of side stories distributed to those who watched Nanatsu no Taizai: Tenkuu no Torawarebito in theaters.

title: 30 Minutes With You
synopsis:
Seongeun has always walked home alone from Galaxy Academy... that is until she met Gubong! Now, the two of them spend 30 minutes walking home together once a week. This 30-minute walk home becomes an exciting time for both of them as their friendship grows... into a budding romance?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Wicked Queen
synopsis:
There's a well-known saying that everyone living in the palace needs to know in order to survive: "If you see the Queen, you absolutely must avoid her!" Although the Queen is amazingly beautiful, she is a jealous woman. An uncountable number of people have fallen prey to that vicious and cruel person. However, all of the Queen's evil deeds were done with only one goal in mind—to hear the Emperor confesses his love and make her his Empress.

(Source: Kakao, translated)

title: Are You Going to Eat?
synopsis:
The daily life of Baek Mi with her interest in food and cooking.

(Source: MU)

title: Goodbye, In-Law!
synopsis:
In high school, the free-spirited Jung Da-ae and the diligent Lee Han-eol despised each other. Now, their older siblings—Mirim and Tae-gang—have fallen in love and decided to get married, though it does not quell the eight-year-long hatred between the two bitter enemies. Tragically, Mirim and Tae-gang die in a car accident on their wedding day, leaving their loved ones devastated. As Da-ae and Han-eol get into yet another fight during the funeral, a speeding truck hits them, and they awaken in their teenage bodies with their memories intact.

Da-ae and Han-eol still cannot see eye to eye, but there must be a reason they were sent to the past together. When they find Mirim's diary from the original timeline, detailing the beginning of her relationship with Tae-gang, everything starts to make sense. For the first time in their lives, Da-ae and Han-eol agree: to save their beloved siblings, they must prevent them from ever meeting.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: The Legend of the Northern Blade
title_english: The Legend of the Northern Blade
synopsis:
For decades, the brave warriors of the Northern Heavenly Sect fought to keep the world safe from the evil Silent Night. But when the fourth generation leader is accused of colluding with the enemy, he is forced to disband the sect and commit suicide to protect his son, Moowon. With no family and allies left, Moowon leads a dreary life under close surveillance... until a surprise attack from the Silent Night gives him a chance to escape to the mountains. There, the young warrior trains to master the fighting techniques of his predecessors, before the mysterious disappearance of a loved one brings him back to the mainland. Follow Moowon as he embarks on a journey to avenge his father's death and take down the villains who threaten to plunge the world into darkness!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Between Us
synopsis:
Jung Inha basically has two parental figures in his life. His real father of course, and Ohn Wujoo—his best friend of 18 years who's even more invested in his personal affairs than the average parent. Inha is desperate to get Wujoo something special for his birthday, but being just a mere high school student, he unfortunately just doesn't have the money. Inha comes up with a very unorthodox method to earn some cash, but he knows if the ever-overprotective Wujoo finds out, he will try and put a stop to it. Can Inha pull off his plan without Wujoo catching on? Watch as the relationship of these lifelong best friends blossoms into something much, much more.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: July That I Randomly Discovered
synopsis:
Eun Danoh believes she has a perfectly mundane life—until she notices shocking gaps in her memory. One moment, it will be Monday; in another, it is Tuesday, and she has somehow appeared on her school's roof. For some reason, she is the only one who notices anything amiss. She will experience five minutes here, a single moment there, and, the next thing she knows, a week has gone by in a blur.

A mysterious cafeteria worker soon reveals the nature of these strange occurrences—Danoh is a side character in a fictional manhwa being written at this very moment. After meeting an unnamed extra who catches her eye, Danoh resolves to fight against her fate and the rules that constrain her universe.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Star's Last Wish
synopsis:
Star, a mysterious, naïve child, searches for Garion, an alleged miracle-maker who is said to live in a lone apple tree, so that he can keep his best friend Miru, a seasonal flower, from withering in the coming winter.

(Source: Chocolate Kimchi Scans)

title: Jeong-Nyeon
synopsis:
Jeong-Nyeon has no money or education, but she is a Mokpo girl with a talent for singing! Her dream is to join a women's traditional theater company, and make it big. But she has a lot to learn and a long way to go before becoming a lead actor. Will Jeong-Nyeon achieve her dream of becoming a big star and getting rich?

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Homework of the Mind
synopsis:
Yi Gyung Jo moves to a new town in hopes of finding a new, quiet life but is quickly thrown into a peculiar situation when she finds out that the said town is inhabited by vampires...

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Shin no Seijo de Aru Watashi wa Tsuihou saremashita. Dakara Kono Kuni wa Mou Owari desu
title_japanese: 真の聖女である私は追放されました。だからこの国はもう終わりです
synopsis:
"You are not the real saint; you're nothing but a fake!"

I, Eliane, am suddenly exiled. Not only that, my engagement was also annulled by Claude, who was both my fiancé and the first prince of my country. Claude claims that Leticia is the "real saint," but I know from the beginning, she is the woman he has been cheating on me with. So here I am, sharing his wish to cancel our engagement.

But is exiling me truly a wise decision, I wonder? Exiling this me, the actual "real saint" who has been setting up barriers and supporting this kingdom from shadows? Maybe, just maybe, dragons and archdemons will invade my kingdom starting from tomorrow. Who knows—not like it's any of my business anymore. I have abandoned my own country and have thus decided to have a peaceful life. Meanwhile, the kingdom, which has lost its true saint, is on the path to ruin.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Shuyaku no Isu wa Ore no Isu
title_japanese: 主役の椅子はオレの椅子

title: Jinjori Barai
synopsis:
When newlywed Takako accompanies her husband to his remote hometown for his grandfather's funeral, she is uncertain what to make of their strange customs. 

(Source: MU)

title: Isekai Furin: Maou Toubatsu kara 10-nen, Tsuma to wa Less no Motoyuusha to, Otto wo Nakushita Onna Senshi
title_english: Isekai Affair: 10 Years After Defeating the Demon King, the Hero Cheats on His Wife with a Warrior Woman Who Lost Her Husband
title_japanese: 異世界不倫～魔王討伐から十年、妻とはレスの元勇者と、夫を亡くした女戦士～
synopsis:
Getting hit by a truck and sent to another world to face off against the Demon King was the best thing that ever happened to Yuuta. He attained unmatched powers, saved the world, and even married the princess. But now that the adventure's over, he finds himself in a boring, sexless marriage with no battles left to fight. The only excitement he can find comes from sneaking out for intimate nights with his former party member. Can the powers he once used to save the realm keep him from getting busted by his royal family?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Nakitai Watashi wa Neko wo Kaburu
title_japanese: 泣きたい私は猫をかぶる
synopsis:
Young Miyo "Muge" Sasaki merely wishes to escape her already troublesome life. As if by fate, she comes across a large talking cat tending to its store, offering a solution to all her problems: a magical cat mask.

Now in middle school, the eccentric and playful Muge never ceases to surprise her peers with her persistent teasing of Kento Hinode, a quiet boy who mostly ignores her. Cherishing old memories of the boy, Muge puts on her cat mask and miraculously transforms into a white cat. Using her adorable form, Muge visits Hinode and makes him smile, all while fleeing from her own family ordeals.

However, the mask does not come without a price. In exchange for the happiness that it brings Muge, the cat mask seller demands one simple thing—her humanity. Growing greedy for both the freedom of being a cat and her flourishing friendship with Hinode as a girl, Muge attempts to evade this deal. But even Muge understands that there will come a day when she must choose between remaining human

title: Icchuuya
synopsis:
1. Ippai Asobo! (Let's Play a Bunch!)
2. Kaettekita Yuu-kun♂ (Yuu-kun Came Home ♂)
3. Sameda Kyoudai (The Sameda Brothers)
4. Uraniwa Daigaku Rugby-bu (Uraniwa U. Rugby Club)
5. Buta to Present (Piggy Present)
6. Shinshi Yuugi Club (Gentlemen Play Club)
7. Mana no Nikki (Mana's Diary)
8. Tsukaeru Sanae (Useful Sanae)

title: Girls & Panzer: Momi no Ki to Tetsu no Hane no Majo
title_japanese: ガールズ&パンツァー 樅の木と鉄の羽の魔女
synopsis:
The manga centers around Noemi Kohiyama, a second-year student at Count High School, a school with no established reputation in the world of tankery. Her first match as a tank commander is against Saunders University High School. She directs the crew of her tank with her orders, and she follows the orders of their team leader. At that time, she remembers the words that her senior said to her.

(Source: ANN)

title: Konoko Haramasetemo Ii desu ka?
title_japanese: この子孕ませてもいいですか？
synopsis:
1. Futari no Kyoushitsu (Their Classroom)
2. Shuukyoujou no Riyuu Onanie Dekinai Kyoudai
3. Papa to Musume no Gimukyouiku Ecchi♥ (Father and Daughter's Sex Education♥)
4. Ciel no Nichiyoubi (Ciel's Sunday)
5. Ponkotsu Succubus: Lily-chan no Sainan
6-7. Kyoudai no Katachi

title: Kuzuryuu-san no Oshi wa Chiisai
title_japanese: 九頭竜さんの推しは小さい
synopsis: Hana Kuzuryuu, a former Hollywood actress, is enamored by Chome, a Siberian dwarf hamster at a local pet shop.

title: Matsuyoi no Oni
synopsis:
From a young age, Minoru is bewitched by the supernatural - he can see and attracts faeries. One day, he picked up a strange dog collapsed near his home. It turns out that this dog was actually a demon whose name was sealed and lost it's powers. He suddenly said "I finally found you." By some kind of fate, he is needed to gain powers. The only way he can be on human form is to form a contract. He craved for him from the depths of his body, but the truth is he was just being played?!

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

title: Mahoujin Guruguru Gaiden: Buyuuden Kita Kita
title_japanese: 魔法陣グルグル外伝　舞勇伝キタキタ

title: Kara Sawagi
synopsis:
Alice Tobe, the student vice president at the all-girls Margaret Academy, always speaks badly of boys. Ikuo Bene, the vice president of the neighboring boys school Kigiku Gakuen, doesn't believe in love. But when they have to work together for their schools' annual joint Cultural Festival, a new story unfolds. A modern take on the classic Shakespeare comedy Much Ado About Nothing!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Ore no Kanojo ga Bakemono datta
title_japanese: 俺の彼女がバケモノだった

title: Honzuki no Gekokujou: Shisho ni Naru Tame ni wa Shudan wo Erandeiraremasen Dai 4-bu - Kizokuin no Toshokan wo Sukuitai!
title_english: Ascendance of a Bookworm: I'll Do Anything to Become a Librarian! Part 4 - I Want to Save the Royal Academy's Library!
title_japanese: 本好きの下剋上～司書になるためには手段を選んでいられません～第四部 貴族院の図書館を救いたい!
synopsis:
Rozemyne has awoken from her two-year slumber. Everything and everyone has changed, which is as terrifying as it sounds, but she doesn't have time to waste before she's thrust toward the Royal Academy—a requirement for becoming a noble. There, she will meet all sorts of colorful teachers and students from other duchies... but can she keep her composure in the face of the most books she's seen yet? Our bookworm goes to school in the newest installment of this biblio-fantasy by book lovers, for book lovers.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Mairimashita! Iruma-kun Gaiden: Kalego-hen
title_japanese: 魔入りました!入間くん外伝 ―カルエゴ編―
synopsis:
A young Kalego Naberius' school days at Babyls Demon School do not begin as planned, as he is immediately targeted by several students who mistake him for the infamous "top dog" of Babyls. Despite having hospitalized several students, little is known about the top dog's identity aside from the fact they have dark curly hair, sport two horns, and wear a combination of the boys' and girls' uniforms—all of which also apply to Kalego.

Desiring a more peaceful school life, Kalego and his friend Baramu "Balam" Shichirou resolve to uncover the true identity of this mysterious troublemaker and put an end to their reign of chaos.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Imouto no Suki na Vtuber ga Jitsu wa Ore da nante Ienai
title_japanese: 妹の好きなVtuberが実は俺だなんて言えない

title: Hatsukoi, Tokimeki Usuihon
title_japanese: はつ恋、ときめき うすいほん
synopsis:
Cheerleaders Hime and Itoha have recently become lovers. However, they are both sheltered girls who don't know the first thing about love. In a misguided attempt to be a better lover to Iroha, Hime takes the advice of her friend and uses... erotic doujin as a guide?! A yuri love comedy about two girls experiencing love using ero doujins!

(Source: AniList)

title: Finder-goshi no Ano Ko
title_japanese: ファインダー越しのあの子
synopsis:
Hajime, a girl who can't seem to properly express her feelings into words, is worrying all on her own about the preparations for the cultural festival. This will be the last festival for her film club. There's always been things she's wanted to do for the festival, but like last year, she's given up and the festival will probably end without her doing what she wants to do. That's when she meets Kei Ichinose, another student at her school.

(Source: Dogenzaka Shobo, translated)

title: Akanesasu Zakuro no Miyako
synopsis:
In the lobby of the Granada airport in southern Europe, 14-year-old Natsuki Tachibana was anxious. He had no other family left in this world. So now he is going to live with his aunt Alba, who is Spanish and seemed unfriendly at first. A new life begins in a strange country, with family he has never met before!

The beautiful cityscape, with its white stone walls casting deep shadows. The brightly colored tables, serving up gazpacho and tortillas. The cheerful people who gather at the Spanish-style shared-house "pisos" and bars.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Damdam!!
synopsis:
In the mountains of M prefecture, villagers are disappearing. "Something is slicing people apart" was the final message desperate police managed to yell through the radio, before disappearing. Specialized in hunting monsters, two high school girls begin their hunt!

(Source: MU)

title: 6-sai no Kenja wa Hikage no Michi wo Ayumitai
title_english: The 6-Year-Old Sage Wants to Hide in the Shadows
title_japanese: 6歳の賢者は日陰の道を歩みたい
synopsis:
"I defeated the demon king...?" The strongest sage reincarnates as the six-year-old Eddie Radcliffe. Despite his inherited memories and magical prowess making him stronger than he ever was, he's determined to live a peaceful life. Contrary to his wishes, he's now tasked with saving the world from behind the scenes and is trusted as a ruler in the dark.

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Kensei no Osananajimi ga Power Harassment de Ore ni Tsuraku Ataru node, Zetsuen shite Henkyou de Makenshi toshite Denaosu Koto ni Shita.
title_japanese: 剣聖の幼馴染がパワハラで俺につらく当たるので、絶縁して辺境で魔剣士として出直すことにした。

title: Neko ni wa Inu wo
synopsis:
After a night of drinking, Neko woke up to find another man sleeping naked next to him. His clothes were strewn about and there was a pile of used condoms in the trash. "White liquid stained the sheets but it can't be mine because... I can't get an erection, so there's no way I could ejaculate!"

Neko, a young man with a Kansai dialect suffering from ED, and Inukai, who helps him deal with it.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Chouetsusha to Natta Ossan wa My Pace ni Isekai wo Sansaku suru
title_english: A Middle-Aged Guy Turned Transcendent Explores a Different World at His Own Pace
title_japanese: 超越者となったおっさんはマイペースに異世界を散策する
synopsis:
Hiroshi Yamada, a 42-year-old dull office worker, was suddenly sent to another world, after being chosen to be summoned as a hero that should have been limited to young people. As a promised development in the summoning, Hiroshi was thrown into another world that is teeming with monsters, with three strongest skills given by God, "One-shot Kill," "Magic Creation," and the ultimate physical strengthening skill, "Transcendent." It was thought that Hiroshi makes full use of the skills and defeats one monster after another! but, with his clumsiness, he can't control the power of the skills and goes on a rampage! This is the story of Hiroshi, livelily exploring another world at his own pace, through which, he meets an adorable fairy and a middle-aged muscular warrior, and fights over enemies whose from-time-to-time atrociousness causes people the trouble.

(Source: AlphaPolis)

title: Dungeon Battle Royale: Maou ni Natta node Sekai Touitsu wo Mezashimasu
title_japanese: ダンジョンバトルロワイヤル〜魔王になったので世界統一を目指します〜
synopsis:
In the year 20XX, God put the "World Salvation Project," into motion to save humanity from heading towards its destruction. As a result, Shion Kurosaki, a college student who continued to struggle in a broken world, was picked to be the demon king. As he repels the self-proclaimed hero as she leads the raid on his dungeon, a war for supremacy between the demon lords unfold?!

(Source: Hifumishobo, translated)

title: Hell Mode: Yarikomizuki no Gamer wa Hai Settei no Isekai de Musou suru
title_english: Hell Mode: The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World with Garbage Balancing
title_japanese: ヘルモード ～やり込み好きのゲーマーは廃設定の異世界で無双する～ はじまりの召喚士
synopsis:
Kenichi Yamada, a single, 35-year-old businessman, has spent the majority of his adult life playing every MMORPG to hit the market. Tired of the constant cycle of repetitive, newbie-centric gameplay, he is immediately drawn in by the promise of a new game that, on top of being never-ending, offers up a "Hell Mode"—a difficulty level that makes it nigh impossible to level up but also promises uncapped growth potential. Upon selecting the newly released Summoner class, Kenichi finds himself reborn as Allen, an infant in a serf family, with nothing but his wits and old memories to guide him. Allen works diligently to level himself up despite Hell Mode requiring vast amounts of experience between levels. In doing so, he hopes to uncover the secrets the Summoner class holds. All the while, he dedicates himself to freeing his new family from serfdom.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Marie-sama wo Wakarasetai!
title_japanese: マリー様をわからせたい！

title: Doutei Tora to Tsundere Usagi
title_english: Cherry Boy Tiger and Hot-and-Cold Rabbit
title_japanese: 童貞トラとツンデレうさぎ
synopsis:
Welcome to "Moon," an underground dreamworld (read: host club) for rich men to enjoy alcohol, sex, and anonymity. Workers of moon, aka bunnies, aren't allowed to ask about their customers' private life, but there are no rules against knowing each others'. Bunnies all have their reasons and motivations for staying and working, and just like that, moon is home to an interesting mix of characters, stories, and... relationships?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

Included one-shots: Usagi-san, Honey My Bunny!, Honey My Bunny! After!

Note: The first chapter was collected in Chakuero BL. Honey My Bunny! was collected in Yuri BL.

title: Game Center no Kanojo
synopsis:
At his job working in an arcade, "Mobuo" gets pretty much ignored by everyone–even his nickname references the way he blends into the background like some kind of NPC. All that changes when gorgeous, larger-than-life Nanora Yaegashi barges into the place and demands his help learning the ins and outs of the arcade's trickiest games. And did she just ask him out?! One thing's for sure, it's the beginning of a summer full of arcade fun and simmering sexual tension!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Ane ga Haramu made
synopsis: Sister-in-law and brother-in-law in that sort of relationship...

title: Kukkorose no Himekishi to Nari, Yuri Shoukan de Hataraku Koto ni Narimashita.
title_english: Becoming a Princess Knight and Working at a Yuri Brothel
title_japanese: くっ殺せの姫騎士となり、百合娼館で働くことになりました。
synopsis:
Talk about your extreme career changes! Naruse Soushi, a middle-aged man and private secretary to a politician, lies on the verge of death. Meanwhile, in another world, the princess knight Reina has been captured by an enemy nation. The princess' soul is removed–and Naruse is summoned into the empty husk of her body! Now that he's taken over the form of this beautiful young woman, he's doomed to her fate: being sold to a yuri brothel where he has to service female customers. He's determined to learn more about Reina's life before he took it over...while he finds a way to work the grind in her body!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Ookami Rise
synopsis:
In the near future, the state of Japan has disappeared. The island is now split in two. The north is administered by Russia and the south by China. The border between the two countries is delimited by a buffer zone, demilitarized and emptied of its inhabitants. It is there, in this forbidden zone, that the Wolang have found refuge. These 49 fugitives are the result of failed experiments by the Chinese army, which wanted to transform them into biological weapons to be used against its Russian neighbour. Caught between China, which wants to erase the traces of its experiments, and Russia, which is trying to capture them to study them, the Wolang will have to fight for their survival.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Dai-kun wa Hitori de Nerarenai
title_japanese: 橙くんはひとりで寝られない
synopsis:
Riko was looking forward to the arrival of her neighbor and childhood friend from 6 years ago. Her memories of him were of a handsome and friendly boy who always took care of her. But for some reason, the gentle boy she knew seems to have changed into a different person now.

(Source: MU)

title: Genjitsu de Love Comedy Dekinai to Dare ga Kimeta?
title_japanese: 現実でラブコメできないとだれが決めた?
synopsis:
"I want to have a romcom-like experience." Haven't all romcom lovers who enjoy light novels thought this before? Being all lovey-dovey with the heroine, and leading a fulfilling high school life with the best of friends. However, there's no way something that exciting could happen in reality. I have no younger step-sister, no childhood friend, no classmate who's an idol, no mysterious senpai, and not even a male best friend character. That being the case, what can I do? Obviously, I have to put it together myself! For a romantic comedy, you need both data analysis and constant practice! As well as...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Isekai Saikyou no Daimaou, Tenseishi Boukensha ni Naru
title_english: The Greatest Demon King in the Other World
title_japanese: 異世界最強の大魔王、転生し冒険者になる
synopsis: Lucifer, the greatest demon lord, who saved the demon race in the war with gods, is reincarnated as a normal adventurer.

title: Hero Girl x Healer Boy: Touch or Death
title_japanese: ヒーローガール×ヒーラーボーイ～TOUCH or DEATH～
synopsis:
In a world where heroes fight against evil from space sometimes they get hurt... and in comes a man with special powers... a massage that heals.

(Source: MU)

title: Me no Tsukedokoro ga Deep Desho
title_english: I Like Your Point of View.
title_japanese: 目の付けどころがディープでしょ
synopsis:
Mina is a girl who has a strong hope of finding her destined person. With that goal in mind, she tries her best with different types of guys wishful of finding the right person. Even when her childhood friend, a yankee named Yuito, is already by her side. Will she ever find her destined person? A romantic comedy, coming-of-age tale of love and friendship.

(Source: Lovesick Alley)

title: Moto Yakuza ga BL Sakka ni Natta Rashii.
title_japanese: 元ヤクザがBL作家になったらしい。

title: Penguin Shinshi.
synopsis:
The dapper staff of The Watering Hole are always eager to serve their clientele with grace and charm. But little do the patrons know that these handsome gents are actually penguins in disguise! The sharply-dressed flightless birds love all that the human world offers, but as the saying goes: "You can take the penguin out of the Antarctic, but you can't take the Antarctic out of the penguin!"*
 
*Not all penguins come from the Antarctic.**** Yes, this actually matters in the world of Penguin Gentlemen.

(Source: Yen Press)
