Rauf, who has gorgeous hazel eyes, coldly abandons her right after taking her virginity because he sees her as a wicked, calculating woman. Unbeknownst to Lilly, he plans to manipulate her for his own desires, thinking she is a fraud and a crook...!

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Tsurai Saikai
synopsis:
There's no denying the way his gentle eyes melt her heart, and the emotions she'd tried so hard to push back are once again coming alive...

Ellie was seventeen when she fell in love with Andrew, a handsome older boy in medical school. Though she was filled with joy when he proposed to her, she began to feel trapped by the thought of a future with him and his single-minded devotion. When Ellie was caught with another man on the day before their wedding, they canceled the wedding in heartbreak. Twelve years later, Ellie is struggling as a single mother and caring for a daughter with a serious heart condition when Andrew enters her life once again—as Hetta's doctor. She has no right to feel regret, no right to think of him and what could have been. She was the one who ran. But why does her heart feel so unsettled?

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Ai wo Suteru Riyuu
synopsis:
One night, Hani, a teacher on a small tropical island, suffers from a fit at a local festival. A man named Kelt with cold, beautiful copper eyes and a strong body offers to help her. Even though she swore she'd never love again, Hani feels her heart throbbing fast. She's the princess of Moraz, who had to leave her country after she helped commit a shameful crime. With such a secret, such a past, she doesn't have the right to love anyone...

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Fushichou no Tsubasa
synopsis:
When Leigh was eighteen, she fell in love with the multi-millionaire Raoul at first sight, and they were married. Their sweet and gorgeous life as newlyweds seemed like a dream... and the young and innocent Leigh was soon entranced with Raoul. But that life suddenly ended. One day, Leigh saw a beautiful woman lying in her bed, and ran out of the house, stricken with despair... It's been five years since then. Leigh's artistic talent was recognized by society, and she is invited to a party as an artist, where she and Raoul are reunited. "You're still my wife, aren't you?" Raoul says, stealing a kiss like it was the most natural thing in the world!

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Kieta Fantasy
synopsis:
Our special night together was nothing but a fantasy...

Romance novelist Kristin is struggling to recover from a heartbreak that has caused her severe writer's block. Her mother tries to help her out by taking her to an auction where guests can bid on dates with single men. Although Kristin should feel indifferent to these sorts of things, when a talented campaign advisor named Perry takes the stage, she feels her heart skip a beat. Without thinking, she stands up and bids on him for ten thousand dollars! The two of them lead completely different lifestyles. How will their special night end?

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Yuuwaku no Yukue
synopsis:
I thought this love would never happen, but now an older man is suddenly seducing me?

The shrewd attorney Hawke is known in legal circles as the devil. For the young reporter Siri, he's someone to keep an eye on. Years ago, she pined for the man who was her father's business partner. Hawke always treated her like a child...but Siri is now a grown woman! When she's offered an exclusive scoop on the case that Hawke's working on, she heads down to Panama City, Florida. There, she and the man she still wants find they're staying in a hotel suite together! Hawke's gaze feels different than before... Is this what being seduced feels like?

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Warui Uwasa no Otoko
synopsis:
Tara Delaney comes from a long line of witches. The men who marry them are blessed with good fortune. However, Tara's own fortune has not been great. She was left at the altar, and now she's inherited her grandma Brigid's old house in Whiskey River. When she finally arrives in town to deal with the house, she meets the town's mysterious recluse, Gavin. Gavin was good friends with Tara's grandma, but there's something from his past haunting him, and there's something dark surrounding Brigid's death.

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Jounetsu wa Horonigaku
synopsis:
Claire has been taken advantage of as a caregiver for her grandfather, who adopted her as a young girl. When her grandfather passes on, he leaves his fortune in her hands. But there is one condition—she has to marry one of her cousins to receive the inheritance. Nothing has been left for an old couple who served her grandfather for a long time, and Claire wishes to give them compensation in some way, so she makes a bold move—she proposes to her notorious playboy cousin Dane. How will he react?

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Hozumi-sensei to Matsuri-kun to.
title_japanese: ホヅミ先生と茉莉くんと。

title: Papakatsu JK no Yowami wo Nigitta node, Inu no Sanpo wo Onegai Shitemita.
title_japanese: パパ活ＪＫの弱みを握ったので、犬の散歩をお願いしてみた。

title: Koibito Daikou wo Hajimeta Ore, Naze ka Bishoujo no Shimei Irai ga Haittekuru
title_japanese: 恋人代行をはじめた俺、なぜか美少女の指名依頼が入ってくる
synopsis:
Ryoma Shiba, a poor college student, looking for a part-time job with a high hourly wage, and Himeno Kashiwagi, who desires a relationship while telling everyone around her that she is disinterested in love.

Simultaneously, they discover about "Lover's Agent" from mutual connections, so they register straight away and ended up scheduling a date.

On the day of the date, the two meet for the first time, and despite their nervousness, they spent a lovely time holding hands and drinking tapioca, just like lovers.

However, when Himeno's friend finds out the truth, things get awkward. Ryoma lies to her and tells her that they are dating. Himeno's heart skips a beat when Ryoma pretends to be her actual boyfriend. This is a true love story that begins with a rental relationship.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: ∞ Shatei Majutsutsukai no Ore wa, Yagate Gakuen no Chouten e
title_english: As an Infinite Range Magician, I Eventually Reached the Top of the School
title_japanese: ∞射程魔術使いの俺は、やがて学園の頂点へ

title: Mitsu to Adabana
synopsis:
Kai Matsunaga runs his own small flower shop. Masamune Tatsumi is a man who doesn't look like he belongs among all of the roses and tulips. Though one day, Masamune walks in and, to Kai's chagrin, simply orders "white flowers." Kai's appalled at how rude and curt Masamune is, but the more they talk, the more they get to know each other. Unfortunately, Shiro Yagami is about to ruin whatever relationship they were building. He violates Kai's sweet, innocent body... but why?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Tonari no Kimi de Atama ga Ippai.
title_japanese: 隣のキミであたまがいっぱい。
synopsis:
"I'm going to be sitting next to you! I hope we get along well, okay?"

Kisaragi, who is now in the same class as me, seems to be able to "hear the thoughts of others." There was a huge difference between "hearing" and "reading" the thoughts of others, and she was tired of being able to hear everyone's thoughts, regardless of whether she wanted to or not.

Well, of course I felt pity for her, but there wasn't anything I could do about it. That was what I thought, but... Somehow, it looks like when she's beside me, her power is only limited to my thoughts, and she can get some peace and quiet. But even so, aren't you a little too close to me?! No, it's not like I'm getting nervous just because there's a beautiful girl right beside me or anything like that!

That's right. Today, my thoughts are once again being read by her.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Untitled Blue
title_japanese: アンタイトル・ブルー
synopsis:
Akari Ogihara (24), who has given up her dream of becoming a Japanese painter to support her family, one day rescues a man who has attempted suicide in the sea. The only thing she can learn about the man, whose age and name are unknown, is that he has a talent for Japanese painting. For reasons unclear, Akari lends him her name, "Akari Ogihara," and together they somehow begin selling Japanese paintings...?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Sabaku no Ou to Senichiya
synopsis:
Due to her sister's infertility, Sheridan decides to undergo artificial insemination, but as a result of the hospital's mistake, she is provided with the semen of a man who is not her brother-in-law. As it turns out, the semen belongs to Rashid, the King of Kyr. Though Sheridan finds him authoritarian, he is as handsome as any prince you might read about in The Arabian Nights. Sheridan frantically resists Rashid's urgings that she should join him in Kyr, but then he makes an unimaginable move, sweeping Sheridan up off her feet and kissing her passionately. Sheridan suddenly finds herself lost in Kyr's intense passion... What will she do next?

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

authors: Azuma, Kouji|Hattori, Masaki|Kurono, Yuu|Kyo zip|Takahara, Yu
synopsis: A collection of stories set in the universe of miHoYo's Genshin Impact video game by various artists.

title: Lessons in Lust
synopsis:
Ivan is a guardian android, responsible for teaching the orphanage children everything they'll need to thrive in the big, wide world. Rau has been in Ivan's care for years now, but recently they've grown distant. What's more, Rau's graduation into adulthood has brought on physical changes, mood swings and uncontrollable urges. Desperate to rebuild bridges before Rau's impending departure, Ivan offers to grant him a birthday wish. The problem is, Rau's most ardent desire is to get lessons in sex. From Ivan. Kids these days sure grow up fast...

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

"Sorry I'm not a girl." Turns out, I knew nothing about Saku. Kyosuke had always thought that his childhood friend was a girl. And he was likely already in love by the time he realized that Saku was a guy. Thinking that this kind of attention from another guy would only annoy him, Kyosuke decided not to pursue Saku. But one day, he noticed hickeys on Saku's back... Thus began a tale of earnest love that would take a turn for the worse.

title: Kiss yori Yasashiku
synopsis:
Chihiro Ayase and Sota Fujisawa are lovers. They like each other, kiss each other, and touch each other often. When they decide they want to experience something better, they find that the reality is that sex isn’t as easy as it seems. Chihiro and Sota are scared to go further, and they’ve even been interrupted during their attempts! But even though some obstacles stand in the way of their goal, they still share the same love.

(Source: Taiyo Tosho, translated)

title: Donald Onsen Monogatari
synopsis:
Donald Duck works for the American furniture company "Duck Furniture". It has already been two months since he was transferred to the Asian Cultural Distribution Department, which has only three people: his subordinates, José Carioca and Panchito. One day, they receive a sudden phone call from the company president. What are the instructions that they were given by the president...? What is Japan, what is hospitality, and how does it work? 

Donald's swashbuckling hot spring adventure opens on the stage of Yukawakusa, the first place! Will the three be able to safely return to New York?!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Danjo no Yuujou wa Seiritsu suru? (Iya, Shinai!!)
title_japanese: 男女の友情は成立する?（いや、しないっ!!）
synopsis:
A boy and a girl pledge lifelong friendship in a small town junior high school. The relationship between the two, who are destined to share a common dream, has passed two years without any particular development.

Himari Inuzuka, a bubbly girl who has yet to find her first love, and Yuu Natsume, a plant-loving boy who enjoys flowers, still spend their days peacefully as best friends in the gardening club in the second year of high school.

"If Yuu can't get married, I have to take responsibility."
"I'm having trouble now because after Himari said that, your brother began calling me 'My brother-in-law!'"

However, when Yuu reunites with his first crush, the gears of their relationship suddenly go out of sync! Will Himari be able to escape her "ideal friend" now that she has found love?

(Source: MAL News)

title: Tobioriyou to Shiteiru Joshikousei wo Tasuketara Dou Naru no ka?
title_japanese: 飛び降りようとしている女子高生を助けたらどうなるのか?
synopsis:
The start of a happy life together with a high school girl who has fallen into the bottom of despair.

One day, Yuusuke Yuuki, who spent his high school life only in studying and working part-time in order to maintain his scholarship, found himself strongly wishing for a girlfriend. On the way home, feeling lonely from such thought, he casually looked up into the sky and saw a girl who was about to throw herself off the rooftop of an abandoned building.

"Why the hell are doing something like this!" "Because I...don't have any...reason to live..." "Wait. It'd be a shame for a beauty to die" "....?" "Rather than dying, be my girlfriend" "Eeh?"

Thus, a new love story and daily life with a mysterious girl, Kotori Hatsushiro, which all started from a strange encounter, begins.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Houkago no Seijo-san ga Toutoi dake ja Nai Koto wo Ore wa Shitteiru
title_japanese: 放課後の聖女さんが尊いだけじゃないことを俺は知っている
synopsis:
"Are you coming?" The time is 11:00 p.m.

Yamato Kuraki, an ordinary high school student, is on his way home from the convenience store when he meets Sayla Shirase, a beautiful girl from his class who is known as a saint. She invites him to spend some time with her in the downtown area in the middle of the night, and that day is the start of a new relationship between the two. They play darts for the first time, lend and borrow CDs, and visit ramen shops...

Yamato's boring daily life becomes more colorful as he gets involved with Sayla, who sometimes spoils him and has a mischievous side.

"I'm really glad that Yamato came along with me at that time."

This is the beginning of a sweet, precious story of youth and love spent with a saintly woman who is a natural in every way.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Ore to Koitsu no Oshi wa Saikou ni Kawaii
title_english: I and My Rival are Pushing the Cutest Girl

title: Oresama na Douki ni Yoru no Shigoto ga Baremashita.
title_english: He Knows What I Do After Dark
title_japanese: 俺様な同期に夜の仕事がバレました。
synopsis:
Mizuto Kusaka is a serious and diligent office worker... by day. At night, however, he works as a rent-boy! One day, he heads to the club after work as usual, but the client who's waiting for him is, unbelievably, his obnoxious, accomplished coworker Shinichi Takasugi! Shinichi gently caresses Mizuto, who can't help finding it... irresistible... An arrogant hotshot and a goody-goody with a wild side get down 'n' dirty in this steamy office romance!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Koko made Yaru to wa Kiitenaii!
title_japanese: ここまでヤるとは聞いてないっ!
synopsis:
Handyman Maki has taken in a guy called Naru who helps with work in return for a roof over his head. The pair are roommates, work partners, and friends with benefits! Naru may complain a lot, but he'll do whatever Maki says because he's deeply in love with him. He can't seem to accept that they only have a physical relationship, and finds his heart racing whenever Maki touches him. One day, Naru meets a client who happens to be someone from Maki's past... Can these two really stay purely physical considering how they feel about each other? This is a chaotic comedy involving work and romance between a stoic, fearless dom and his devoted but volatile pet!!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Aishiteru nante Iwanaide
title_japanese: 愛してるなんて言わないで

title: Enoch Dainibutai no Harapeko Ensei Gohan
title_japanese: エノク第二部隊のはらぺこ遠征ごはん
synopsis:
Mel, a doctor assigned to an expeditionary unit, agonizes over the disgusting taste of the preserved food she is given. The bread is sour and stony. The dried meat is tasteless and odorless and impossible to chew. This doctor, remembering that her life is in danger, stands alone. This is the story of an elf girl, Mel, who struggles to use her knowledge and experience of forest life to eat a good meal on her expedition.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title_japanese: 創造錬金術師は自由を謳歌する 故郷を追放されたら、魔王のお膝元で超絶効果のマジックアイテム作り放題になりました
synopsis:
The story centers around a bureaucrat named Thor, whose alchemy skills go unappreciated in his line of work. When he is expelled to the demon lord's domain, his life takes a huge turn. With his ability to create powerful magic items, he turns the kingdom around, alongside the company of a beautiful maid.

(Source: ANN)

title: Takane no Hana no Imakano wa, Zettai Motokano ni Maketakunai you desu
title_japanese: 高嶺の花の今カノは、絶対元カノに負けたくないようです
synopsis:
As he graduated from junior high, Nagito Senda began dating Kiri Asatani, but he got dumped when he they started high school. While recovering from his broken heart, he saw Nozomi Takane, a girl in his class, being harassed by a pushy club recruiter, and decided to help her. The two quickly grew closer as they sit together in class and go to and from school together. One day, as the two were cleaning the library, Kiri comes up to Nozomi and asks, "Can I borrow Nagi-kun?" When Nozomi asked Kiri about her relationship with Nagito...?

"I was Nagi-kun's ex-girlfriend"

"Well from now on I'll be his new girlfriend."

Now that both girls have declared themselves, what will be his real intention? Sparks will fly in the game between the ex-girlfriend and the current girlfriend.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Watashi no Shiawase na Kekkon
synopsis:
Ever since her mother's death, Miyo Saimori has had little other than her memories to remind her of happiness. Being talentless herself, Miyo has grown up in the shadow of her gifted stepsister and faced every snide remark thrown her way without complaint. Her stepmother's loathing for her is evident in the way she treats Miyo: devoid of any scrap of pity or concern. Miyo accepts that her fate is to slave away for her uncaring family—until her father arranges for her to be wed to Kiyoka Kudou, a revered man with a military background.

The rumors about Kudou are grim, and he is infamous for having been incredibly unkind to all his prospective brides in the past. When Miyo, armed with the barest of essentials for a new life, arrives at her betrothed's residence, she is bewildered to find that not all hearsay about Kudou is true. As she begins to separate fact from fiction, Miyo hopes that her marriage will finally give her the happiness she desires.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Alpha Sentai Al-Ranger
title_japanese: アルファ戦隊 アルレンジャー
synopsis:
In the omegaverse, alphas, betas, and omegas are born into inequality. One day, as three little boys played in the mountains, their hometown Omega Forest came under attack of the alphas. The three boys survived but were never the same again. Twenty years after their world flipped upside down, Homura, Satsuki, and Minato begin their revenge on alphas to avenge their fellow omegas who fell victim to the brutal attack. Their name: Dark Omega. Their goal: Get revenge on alphas. Their weapon: Pheromones...!? The Dark Omega execute their plans, but they won't have an easy time terrorizing the country when the Alpha Rangers come to fight back!

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

synopsis:
What do you do when your body doesn’t match the ideal shape as dictated by society? What do you wear when sweats seem to be the only clothes that fit you? How do you deal with the constant, overwhelming...

(Source: Yen Press)

synopsis:
Hisanori Nouchi is a 38-year-old virgin. It's not that he's uninterested in women; it's just that he hasn't had many successful opportunities to meet them. While he works for an ordinary company during the day, at night, he's actually a successful erotic novelist. One day after work, he happens to help a pretty lady named Chika who invites him to a meal as thanks. However, there's no way that Chika is actually a young man dressed as a woman is there?

(Source: Kaiousha, translated)

title: Ichigo Syndrome
synopsis:
Itsuki Furuse, a student in her second year of high school. Touma Hino, a mathematics teacher at Itsuki's school. The two live in the same neighbourhood, and have been dating for a half a year, although this innocent couple have yet to even kiss. Touma always responds to Itsuki's conveyance of love either in a cool and calm manner, and sometimes very sweetly. Every day, Itsuki's flirting brings cuteness and wholesomeness.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

synopsis:
"Expulsion boom." In this world, such phrase had become prevalent. With the advent of "Status Scouter," a convenient item that quantifies and visualizes stats, a trend was set for high-ranking parties to expel their friends whose status numbers were on the low-end. Eisen, who had graduated from the Guild Master Academy, had been harboring doubts regarding the status-oriented world. In addition, with his inherent skill called "Appraisal Eye" that detects hidden skills in people, he realized that the adventurers who had been exiled for their "incompetence" were actually competent people with hidden skills. Thus, Eisen decided to initiate a new guild for these exiles and took them in one after another. Just like that, the guild began to grow bigger.

"Off you go with your useless ability!"

"Ah, then you wouldn't mind it if I take them in, yes?"

"We don't need people with low stats here!"

title: Guild no Uketsukejou desu ga, Zangyou wa Iya nanode Boss wo Solo Toubatsu Shiyou to Omoimasu
title_english: I May Be a Guild Receptionist, but I'll Solo Any Boss to Clock Out on Time
title_japanese: ギルドの受付嬢ですが、残業は嫌なのでボスをソロ討伐しようと思います
synopsis:
Alina Clover signed up to be a receptionist for the Adventurers Guild thinking it would be her ticket to the good life—stable pay, regular hours, and safe workplace conditions. Unfortunately, her dream gig turns into a nightmare of endless paper work and overtime whenever the adventurers she helps coordinate get stuck clearing a dungeon. But people aren't made to grind forever, so Alina sneaks off at night to give the monsters holding things up a beatdown, courtesy of her massive war hammer. Keeping this all under wraps to avoid violating her office's ban on second jobs is difficult, especially when the tales of her exploits start to spread, but Alina somehow manages to keep her identity safe...until the leader of the strongest party in the guild catches her defeating a boss one fateful night! Does Alina have what it takes to stop her life from going topsy-turvy?!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Guild no Uketsukejou desu ga, Zangyou wa Iya nanode Boss wo Solo Toubatsu Shiyou to Omoimasu
title_english: I May Be a Guild Receptionist, but I'll Solo Any Boss to Clock Out on Time
title_japanese: ギルドの受付嬢ですが、残業は嫌なのでボスをソロ討伐しようと思います
synopsis:
Alina Clover thought being a receptionist for the Adventurers Guild would be her ticket to the good life...but her dream gig turns into an overtime nightmare whenever adventurers get stuck clearing a dungeon. To save herself from paperwork, Alina turns to the simplest solution at hand—beating down the monsters herself! A mysterious adventurer showing up out of nowhere, soloing the boss, then disappearing without taking credit is bound to create rumors, and Alina's treasured job forbids side hustles. So there might be trouble when the leader of the Silver Sword party discovers her secret...!

A high school boy, Itsuki Tomonari, gets involved in a kidnapping and ends up taking care of Hinako Konohana, a young lady from one of Japan's largest conglomerates.

On the surface, Hinako seems to be a brilliant and charming girl, but in reality, she is a lazy girl with no life skills. However, due to family reasons, Hinako has to play the role of the "perfect young lady" at school. Wanting to protect her, Itsuki takes care of her in a very caring manner. Eventually, Hinako begins to fawn on Itsuki with all her might...

"Now...if Itsuki isn't around, I would hate it."

This is a love story that begins with a cute young lady with a gap that transcends the master-servant relationship.

(Source: Hobby Japan, translated)

title: Saijo no Osewa: Takane no Hanadarake na Meimonkou de, Gakuin Ichi no Ojousama (Seikatsu Nouryoku Kaimu) wo Kagenagara Osewa suru Koto ni Narimashita
title_japanese: 才女のお世話 高嶺の花だらけな名門校で、学院一のお嬢様（生活能力皆無）を陰ながらお世話することになりました

title: Nyako to Hakase
synopsis: One day, the professor wanted a cat-eared maid. So she made one.

title: Dog Days Sugar
synopsis:
Dog Days Sugar follows the people of Flonyard through short stories featuring battles, action, and laughter, intertwining both light and serious elements.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Gou: Comic Anthology
title_english: Higurashi When They Cry: Gou Anthology Comic
title_japanese: ひぐらしのなく頃に 業　コミックアンソロジー
authors: Tonogai, Yoshiki|Himeno, Taka|Kawamura, Taku|Usui, Tsukasa|Yamaguchi, Aki|Mahcdai|Akase, Tomato
synopsis: An anthology comic of Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Gou by various mangaka.

title: Cradle of Imae
synopsis:
In the demon-plagued kingdom of Jinyeok, a child named Ryujin is born. Upon seeing him, a passing exorcist utters a warning: "Beware of fire." Yet by the time Ryujin is grown, the evil spirts have robbed him of all he holds dear. As his home stands engulfed in flames, the exorcist reappears, telling Ryujin to head for the Exorcism Academy. Here he will learn how to combat the demons that torment him. But on the way, he runs into the mysterious Imae. Henceforth, their bodies and souls become entwined... For Imae is his intense and unrelenting fate.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Koi to Iu Ji wo Hodoite Mireba
title_japanese: 戀という字をほどいてみれば
synopsis:
Jinzo Hatta was picked up from the side of the road by Shizuichiro Yanagi, who runs a small kendo dojo. Living with Master Yanagi, who seems stubborn and has an unexpectedly childish side, Jinzo finds himself being physically drawn to him. The budding love becomes uncontrollable and so one night Jinzo secretly kisses Yanagi while he is sleeping. 

One day, a big request came to Yanagi to teach swordsmanship at a samurai's residence. Yangi is reluctant and has conflicting feelings, as Jinzo wishes to please him and help him progress in his career but does not know that that is not of great importance to him. Then one night, as the two conversed, Yanagi became drunk and lustfully propositioned Jinzo to lie with him and let natural instincts guide them. The next morning, Yanagi, who has a backache, makes an unexpected proposal to Jinzo!?

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

Included one-shot: Ashimoto ni Koi ga Aru

title: Gal to Inkya no Kousai Shuukan.
title_japanese: ギャルと陰キャの交際週間。

title: Dekiai Yakuza ni wa Amayakasarenai!
title_english: I Won't Fall for the Infatuated Yakuza's Affections!
title_japanese: 溺愛ヤクザには甘やかされない！
synopsis:
Riko, the granddaughter of a family of Japanese yakuza, has a one-sided crush on Iori, the overprotective caretaker of the family. Iori has always spoiled, Riko; Iori's main focus has always been Riko and she's at the center of everything he does. When Riko finds out that Iori has a girlfriend, Riko decides to "leave Iori" in order to give up on her unrequited love! Riko tries her best to gradually increase the things she can do on her own, but Iori is still not satisfied?!

(Source: Frontier Works)

title: Clevatess: Majuu no Ou to Akago to Shikabane no Yuusha
title_english: Clevatess: The King of Dark Beasts, the Baby, and the Undead Hero
title_japanese: クレバテス-魔獣の王と赤子と屍の勇者-
synopsis:
The manga centers on the titular Clevatess, the lord of all magical beasts, who wields both uncanny intellect and destructive power. Bothered by the 13 heroes tasked to destroy him, he has decided to be rid of humanity once and for all. However, he has been charged with one nuisance: the care of a newborn human baby. Now the world stands upon the brink of Armageddon, with the obligation of raising one child holding it all back.

(Source: ANN)

title: Usotsuki Mille Feuille
title_english: Sweet Lies Layered Like a Mille Feuille
synopsis:
Akane Kinuta, an office lady who lies about getting married to keep her job station and otaku hobbies safe. She gets caught by her hot, perfect gentleman boss Kuroki Tsuneyasu... who orders her to do a fake wedding!! They practice having sex to keep their marriage lies from being found out, but Akane's naive body is at the mercy of sexual pleasure...

(Source: Medibang/Media Do International)

title: Grapefruit Moon
title_japanese: グレープフルーツムーン
synopsis:
College student Kazuki, a lover of sweets, starts working part-time at a small local pastry shop called Fujimura. There, he meets Youichirou, a handsome genius pastry chef who has lost his enthusiasm for his job. To Youichirou's dismay, Kazuki is super clumsy and fails at many tasks. Kazuki soon discovers that Youichirou quit his job at a famous hotel for unknown reasons and has since lost his passion as a pastry chef... This story is about a 19-year-old brimming with happiness for the start of his dream and a 31-year-old approaching the end of his...

(Source: Printemps Shuppan, translated)

title: Madougushi Dahliya wa Utsumukanai: Kyou kara Jiyuu na Shokunin Life
title_english: Dahlia in Bloom: Crafting a Fresh Start with Magical Tools
title_japanese: 魔導具師ダリヤはうつむかない ~今日から自由な職人ライフ~
synopsis:
After dying of overwork in Japan, Dahlia is reborn into a world filled with magic. Raised by a master of magical toolmaking, she develops a passion for the craft and becomes engaged to her father's apprentice. Before her father can see her wed, however, he suddenly passes away. As if this weren't enough, on the day before their wedding, her fiancé announces that he's in love—but not with her! Dahlia finally realizes she needs to live for herself. She vows to be her own woman from now on and devote herself to her craft, even if it's not quite the quiet life she was hoping for! From a chance encounter with a knight to starting her own company, there are challenges aplenty on the horizon. But this young craftswoman is no longer a shrinking violet—she's Dahlia, and she's ready to bloom.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Hell Mode: Yarikomizuki no Gamer wa Hai Settei no Isekai de Musou suru
title_english: Hell Mode: The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World with Garbage Balancing
title_japanese: ヘルモード ～やり込み好きのゲーマーは廃設定の異世界で無双する～ はじまりの召喚士
synopsis:
"Level up even while offline?! That's not a game on 'easy mode'—that's just an AFK game!" The online game Kenichi Yamada had been playing religiously is shutting down its servers, leaving him with a void in his heart. He looks for a new game to fill it, but everything he finds is way too easy. The kind of game he likes—the kind punishing enough to make players want to spend thousands of hours on it—just isn't around anymore. 

"What's this? 'You are invited to a game that will never end.'" Kenichi stumbles upon an untitled game, one promising incomparable challenge with unprecedented potential. Without hesitation, he selects the "Hell Mode" difficulty. Lo and behold, he finds himself reincarnated in another world as a serf! Now called Allen, he sets out to unlock the secrets of his mystery-laden Summoner class; without the convenience of walkthroughs, game guides, or online forums, he must grope his way to the top of his new world!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Seijo no Maryoku wa Bannou desu: Mou Hitori no Seijo
title_english: The Saint's Magic Power is Omnipotent: The Other Saint
title_japanese: 聖女の魔力は万能です ～もう一人の聖女～
synopsis:
Aira Misono is a run-of-the-mill high school girl, and never imagined that she'd be summoned to another world, let alone declared its savior. Yet from the moment the handsome Prince Kyle lays eyes on her, he's convinced that she's the long-awaited Holy Saint destined to banish darkness from his world. Aira herself maintains significant doubts. Is she really up to this challenge? She might be able to use magic, but is she really a Saint? Aira's fears and struggles only deepen when the woman summoned alongside her begins to look more and more like the one who truly deserves that title.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Natsu e no Tunnel, Sayonara no Deguchi
title_english: The Tunnel to Summer, the Exit of Goodbyes
title_japanese: 夏へのトンネル、さよならの出口
synopsis:
There is a strange rumor surrounding the Urashima Tunnel: it grants the wish of those who enter at the cost of their lifespan. Kaoru Touno did not think much of this silly urban legend until he stumbled across a dark tunnel one night.

Initially dismissing the idea of going in, Kaoru is enticed by the possibility of bringing back his sister, Karen. Karen had died in an accident five years prior as a result of Kaoru's carelessness. As he enters the tunnel, what Kaoru discovers within is not quite the same as the rumors imply. The rules of the tunnel are uncertain, but that does not stop him from testing the waters.

Unbeknownst to Kaoru, his aloof classmate Anzu Hanashiro follows him on one of his expeditions. Much to his reluctance, she is intrigued by the tunnel and wants to team up with him. Although he is wary of her intentions, Kaoru accepts Anzu's offer and spends the summer with her in hopes of reviving his sister.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Natsu e no Tunnel, Sayonara no Deguchi: Gunjou
title_english: The Tunnel to Summer, the Exit of Goodbyes: Ultramarine
title_japanese: 夏へのトンネル、さよならの出口 群青
synopsis:
Kaoru Tono heard a rumor: The laws of space and time mean nothing to the Urashima Tunnel. If you find it, walk through and you'll find your heart's desire on the other side...in exchange for years of your own life. On the night Kaoru just so happens to find himself standing in front of a tunnel that looks suspiciously like the one the rumor describes, he finds himself thinking of Karen, the sister he lost in an accident five years ago. To Kaoru's surprise, he's been followed by the new transfer student Anzu Hanaki, who promises to help him experiment with the mysterious tunnel—but what does she want from Kaoru in exchange? And what will he have left to give, after the tunnel's done with him?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Christmas wa Tokubetsu ni
synopsis:
When will he stop treating his wife like his little sister?

Ever since she was young, Mattie has had a crush on James, her father's business partner. But the eligible young bachelor, poised to marry a beautiful socialite, is always hounded by the media. Mattie believes that a plain girl like her is no match for him. One day, his engagement is suddenly called off. To evade the media, he stays at Mattie's house during the Christmas holidays. He then proposes marriage to her. Is it an act to get back at his ex-fiancée? Or could it be something else?

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Watashi no Oshi wa Akuyaku Reijou.: Revolution
title_english: I'm in Love with the Villainess
synopsis:
Ordinary office worker Rei Oohashi wakes up in the body of the protagonist of her favorite otome game, Revolution. To her delight, the first person to greet her is also her favorite character, Claire Francois—the main antagonist of the story! Now, Rei is determined to romance Claire instead of the game's male leads. But how will her villainous ladylove react to this new courtship?!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Drug Candy
synopsis:
Reassigned and demoted at work. Add to that a broken marriage and Seunggu's life is at an all time low. But along comes a smart and sassy girl by the name of Yura. Hard to resist and with no desire to resist, Seunggu slowly becomes addicted to the drug called Han Yura.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: 1 Second
synopsis:
Every second counts when you're a first responder. But what if you could see a glimpse into the future? Hosu is a firefighter with the supernatural ability to do just that. There’s just one catch. It only works when he feels extreme stress under pressure. Will knowing what will happen ahead of time help Hosu extinguish fires before they completely destroy homes and lives? And will he learn to wield his ability when he needs it most?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Hattatsu Shougai to Issho ni Otona ni Natta Watashitachi
title_english: My Brain Is Different: Stories of ADHD and Other Developmental Disorders
title_japanese: 発達障害と一緒に大人になった私たち
serializations: Hontou ni Atta Yukai na Hanashi Geinou Zukyun
synopsis:
This intimate manga anthology is about the struggles and triumphs of individuals learning to navigate daily life with a developmental disorder. The comics follow the stories of nine people, including: a junior high dropout finding an alternate path to education; a former "troublesome" child helping kids at a support school; a so-called problem child realizing the beauty of his own unique quirks; and a man falling in love with the world with the help of a new medication. This inspiring volume illustrates their diverse anxieties and finding self-empowerment in a world not quite built with them in mind.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Gyakutai Chichi ga Youyaku Shinda
title_english: My Father Abusing Me a Lot, Has Died at Last.
title_japanese: 虐待父がようやく死んだ
serializations: Hontou ni Atta Yukai na Hanashi Geinou Zukyun
synopsis:
Even today, my childhood haunts me... This is the story of a woman who grew up with violence...

A message to parents who mistreat their kids: your children never forget. Neither the beatings nor the abuse. The same goes for insults or the feeling of being betrayed over and over again. Thus, I would like you to keep one thing in mind: when you get older, remember that your fate will be in their hands.

All I yearned for was a normal life... With normal parents...

(Source: Meian, translated)

title: Lost Lad London
title_japanese: ロスト・ラッド・ロンドン
synopsis:
Working a part-time job, living without relying on his adoptive parents, getting paid by his flatmate to do his work for him—such is the daily life of Al Adley, a rather dry South Asian man in his 20s. His self-reliant and simple lifestyle changes on the day he realizes that a single event can change one's whole life: that day is when news breaks out that the mayor of London has been fatally stabbed while on a train through the Tube. Al just happened to be at the scene of the crime, and suspicions that he may be the culprit only grow when he finds a bloody knife in his jacket pocket later that evening.

It is not long before Al gets a knock on his door from Lenny Ellis, an inspector for the police who is overly dedicated to his job. With the detective willing to give the young man the benefit of the doubt, Al and Ellis begin a race against time to find the mayor's true murderer.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: 4-nin wa Sorezore Uso wo Tsuku
synopsis:
Rikka, Chiyo, Sekine, and Tsubasa are just average middle school girls on the surface. Underneath their ideal friendship, however, each one of them has their own secret that they are hiding from each other. The airheaded Rikka is an alien who crash landed on Earth, graceful Chiyo is a retired ninja, nervous Sekine has weak psychic powers, and apathetic Tsubasa is a boy in disguise! As they all try to navigate the new, unfamiliar world, these four girls constantly find themselves in absurd situations to protect their secrets.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Hitori de Shinitai
synopsis:
A hardworking career woman who never married died alone, found in a miserable state. Her niece, Yamaguchi Narumi (35 and single), who was hit hard by the news shifted from looking for marriage to preparing for her death. She decided that the only way to die alone without bothering anyone and die better is to live the same way.

(Source: MU)

title: Kokkyou no Emilia
synopsis:
In January 1946, Japan has just recently made it through the country's deciding battle in the Pacific War. Japan becomes divided up and occupied by the armies of various nations, including the Soviet Union. Before long, the land becomes split into two independent nations: "Japan," and the "Democratic People's Republic of Japan." Now subject to factions from either the East or the West, an iron curtain descends upon the archipelago—a strong wall is constructed in order to maintain the boundaries of each country. Tokyo, which lies on the border of both countries, is split into eastern and western regions.

Fast forward to East Tokyo, 1962. Nineteen-year-old Emilia Sugiura is a young woman who lives in Oshiage and works in a dining establishment in Juugatsu-Kakumei Station (formerly Ueno Station). But there's one more side to her: she's a contractor who helps people in the east flee to the west. What does the future hold for this young woman who crosses the most dangerous bridge of all?!

title: Cake no Kirenai Hikou Shounen-tachi
title_japanese: ケーキの切れない非行少年たち
synopsis:
Doctor Rokumugi is engaged in psychiatric care at a juvenile training school in a certain prefecture. He found that the boys had something in common: they couldn't cut the cake into three equal parts. This is a story that reveals the intellectual problems behind delinquency and abnormal behavior.

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Kono Koi wa Kataranai
synopsis:
Kiyono-kun often gets confessed to by his co-worker, Aoyagi-kun. However, when they are alone, Aoyagi-kun acts coldly towards him, making their relationship awkward. On a business trip with just the two of them. Will something change?

(Source: MU)

Included one-shot: Q.E.D

title: Tsugunai Mahou Shoujo Carenza
title_japanese: 償い魔法少女カレンザ
synopsis:
The manga's story begins when a girl named Yuki takes her own life after being bullied at school, while her friend Hina blames herself and regrets all the things she couldn't say to Yuki. Hina meets a man who only calls himself "026" and enters into a contract with him that grants her special powers.

(Source: ANN)

title: Ruri Dragon
synopsis:
Ruri Aoki is a perfectly ordinary high school girl—until one day, she grows horns overnight. Confused by the change, Ruri asks her mother about it, only to find out a shocking truth: Ruri is actually a half-dragon.

Though worried, Ruri heads to school, hoping her new appearance does not catch the attention of those around her. Unfortunately, Ruri's classmates quickly notice and start to swarm her with questions. Additionally, this newfound revelation comes with a dangerous ability to spew balls of fire. In an effort to help Ruri contain her power, her mother takes her to the forest where Ruri's dragon father resides, hoping he might have the answer to curtailing the problem before it hurts anyone else.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Koi no Hajimari
synopsis:
Average-looking, always speaks-her-mind Hachiya Nanami just wants a boyfriend that likes her for her—preferably the school's popular soccer star, Mizuno. As their best friends start dating, they immediately find that they, too have a lot in common. This is the perfect chance for Hachiya to finally score her dream guy. But does Mizuno feel the same way?

(Source: Lovesick Alley)

title: Make Heroine ga Oosugiru!
title_japanese: 負けヒロインが多すぎる！
synopsis:
Plain, boring, and friendless Kazuhiko Nukumizu has witnessed something completely baffling: popular girl Anna Yanami was friend-zoned by her childhood friend and crush! In fact, all the popular girls around him are getting similarly rejected by the boys they like. Without realizing it, Kazuhiko becomes entangled in the relationship drama where all the leading heroines are losing out on love! Can he keep their spirits up and help them find happiness?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Kaijin Kaihatsu-bu no Kuroitsu-san
title_english: Kuroitsu-san from the Monster Development Department
title_japanese: 怪人開発部の黒井津さん
synopsis:
Touka Kuroitsu is a research assistant who belongs to the Monster Development Department of the evil organization Agastia. However, the enemy she has to fight right now isn't the heroes of justice, but her boss.

So long as justice exists, evil too, will exist. This is the story of those who fight secretly in the shadows of justice and evil's confrontation.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Pino
synopsis:
The near-future sci-fi manga's story centers on Hana, a woman who works in a pharmaceutical company, and her regular correspondences with the titular Pino, a robot equipped with an AI. Pino is tasked as a caretaker of the animals the company regularly uses for medical trials. But one day, Pino undergoes an unexpected change.

(Source: ANN)

title: Tensousha: Minagawa Ryouji Tanpenshuu
title_japanese: 転送者 皆川亮二短編集
synopsis:
1-2. Tensousha
3. You Can Do It?
4. Dakkan
5-6. S.O.L
7. The Killing Pawn

title: Chikashitsu Dungeon: Binbou Kyoudai wa Goraku wo Motomete Saikyou e
title_english: Basement Dungeon: Poor Brother and Sister Become the Strongest in Search of Entertainment
title_japanese: 地下室ダンジョン ～貧乏兄妹は娯楽を求めて最強へ～
synopsis:
A dungeon suddenly appeared in the basement of the shabby house where two poor siblings, Fuyuka and Haruka live. Delving every day for the treasure and meat that monsters drop, before they know it they have become the strongest dungeon explorers in Japan...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Vampire Kachou
synopsis:
On the first basement floor of a certain major company is the Accounting Second Department where Kakuta finds himself in a new position as an assistant to Chief Hiroshi Utsugi. The chief is beautiful and has strange tastes. The chief has all the telltale characteristics of a vampire, but Kakuta simply can't believe it. As he tends to this eccentric man, will he uncover the truth about his chief and how will their relationship change as a result?

(Source: MU)

title: Safety Game
synopsis:
Kashima Seiki, a timid doctor, admires Tomomura Masafumi, the president of the Tomomura Hospital, who is starting to do cross-dressing. No matter how much Kashima Seiki admires him, he still can't convey his feelings, so he wants to give up on this love because they are business partners. However...?

(Source: MU)

title: New Normal
synopsis:
"Shortly before we were born, an infectious disease changed the world."

In the near future, hiding your mouth with a mask has become the norm. Natsuki, a girl who secretly thinks about the world before the pandemic, and her classmate Hata suddenly become friends and share a small secret. The extraordinary story of two people living in the new normal begins to unfold.

(Source: Funguild, translated)

title: Keikakuteki Pavlov Maker
title_japanese: 計画的パブロフメイカー
synopsis:
However cliche his motives were, Aki became a chef to see people's faces light up when they eat good food. So, when Eiji, the high schooler who would watch him grill meat through the window every day shows up yet again one rainy day, Aki can't help but beckon him in. Soon, Eiji is chowing down the meat, and while this satisfies Aki's desire to feed him... it lights a fire under his desire to be eaten, too...

(Source: Renta!)

title: Runway no Yukue wo Shiritai ka
title_english: Do You Want to Know Their Future?
title_japanese: ランウェイの行方を知りたいか
synopsis:
He's got urges, so much so that he wants to bang every second of every day. Hikoichi Namino is a college student slash magazine model. Akira Tada is a stylist slash magazine model. The two have known each other for four years and have been dating for six months. With the dignified and beautiful Akira by his side, Hikoichi's modeling career is going well. Their peers are cheering them on, too. Although Hikoichi's beside himself with joy every day, there's just one thing missing... he and his beloved Akira have yet to go all the way! Akira's as pure and innocent as they come, which only stirs up Hikoichi even more...! This raunchy and dramatic story features a hottie with a big heart, his coolheaded-yet-aloof beauty, the glamorous world they live in, and a future where their hearts and bodies will connect and live together!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Mimori-san no Yarashii Okuchi
title_japanese: 三森さんのやらしいおくち
synopsis:
Young Mimori finds out how sensitive an erogenous zone his mouth is during a routine dental visit during his 1st year of middle school. After the embarrassment of it and the follow-up clinic visit, he was determined to take care of his teeth, so he'd never have to go to the dentist again. Now in his mid-30's, a newly-ruptured wisdom tooth has caused cavities, so he is forced to go to the dentist. What he finds is a dentist, who seems to enjoy his little embarrassing sensitivity problem, by making it much, much worse.

(Source: garnetCROW)

title: Ecchi na Mousou ga Kanacchaimashita.
title_japanese: えっちな妄想が叶っちゃいました。
synopsis:
Innocent-faced Yuki gets a personal trainer who sees in him untapped physical potential... Did we mention Yuki loves to fantasize, and his trainer is a massive tease!?

One day, Yuki visits a gym, having heard about the handsome personal trainer there. He's told himself not to think dirty thoughts, but all hope is gone when he meets the charismatic Masaki, whose allure sends him into a full-blown trip! First comes the teasing, then the sweet dirty talk, then the pleasure from his fingers, and finally, that great big...! Masaki asks Yuki if he's growing his hair out to hide those dirty thoughts. Wait. Is this really happening...? Before he knows it, Yuki's signed up to join the gym, and his life of nerve-wracking personal training sessions has begun!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Juken no Hime no Overkill
title_japanese: 呪剣の姫のオーバーキル
synopsis:
Follows Thea, a boy whose dream is to become a ceremonial swordmaker. On his way to the capital to realize his dream, he is attacked by orcs, but just at that moment, a strange female swordfighter appears and slaughters the orcs brutally in an obvious overkill. Her name is Shey, and she wields a cursed weapon. Thea then finds himself becoming Shey's exclusive blacksmith.

(Source: ANN)

title: Seishun Holic
synopsis:
