So continues the double life. Tsundere-like, but good at taking care of people Ichijou-kun. A bit mischievous Tachibana-san with an innocent smile. With this and that happening, the two get along so well that others cringe.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Zettai ni Derete wa Ikenai Tsundere
title_japanese: 絶対にデレてはいけないツンデレ
synopsis:
"Don't get the wrong idea, okay. I definitely don't like people such as you!"

This template tsundere phrase marked the beginning of mine and Mifuyuu Aotsuki's story. Because of her cold and indifferent attitude, she always stands out negatively in class. However one day, we ended up talking more and more with each other, and I started to see the warmth behind her cold words. Why is she so distanced and unaffectionate toward people despite being so kind? That seems to be related to her past that I don't know about...

This is a story about love, telling the coming along of a boy and girl until they finally act affectionate toward each other.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Omiai Shitakunakatta node, Murinandai na Jouken wo Tsuketara Doukyuusei ga Kita Ken ni Tsuite
title_japanese: お見合いしたくなかったので、無理難題な条件をつけたら同級生が来た件について
synopsis:
One day, Yuzuru Takasegawa—a first-year high school student—is urged by his grandfather to go to an arranged marriage meeting, insisting that he wants to see his great-grandson before he dies.

However, not wanting to bear the weight of a fiancée at the tender age of a freshman in high school, Yuzuru tries to avoid the arranged marriage meeting by imposing an irrational condition. "If she is blonde-haired, blue-eyed, fair-skinned, etc, only then I will think about the marriage."

But somehow, he finds the girl who meets the conditions that Yuzuru has put out, and he reluctantly ends up going to matchmaking only once. And on the day of matchmaking, Arisa Yukishiro, a beautiful girl with reputation at school, shows up on the scene. Upon hearing her story, it seems she was also reluctantly made to go on matchmaking. Therefore, the two of them try to prevent themselves from further marriage proposals with their false "engagement." And so, as they play the role of fake lovers, they find the

title: Ore no Ie ni Nazeka Gakuen no Megami-sama ga Iribitatteiru Ken
title_english: The Cutest High-School Girl Is Staying in My Room.
title_japanese: 俺の家に何故か学園の女神さまが入り浸っている件
synopsis:
Day after day, Towa Tokiwagi spends all of his time toiling at his part-time job. His life was far from fulfilling. One day, by a strange coincidence, he gets involved with Rin Wakamiya, a beauty who was the most popular girl in his school. They weren't supposed to have anything to do with each other. And yet, this is how these two people gradually come to a compromise with each other's differences.

(Source: Kakuyomu, translated)

title: Tensei Oujo to Tensai Reijou no Mahou Kakumei
title_english: The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady
title_japanese: 転生王女と天才令嬢の魔法革命
synopsis:
Despite her supposed ineptitude with regular magic, Princess Anisphia defies the aristocracy's expectations by developing "magicology," a unique magical theory based on memories from her past life. One day, she witnesses the brilliant noblewoman Euphyllia unjustly stripped of her title as the kingdom's next monarch. That's when Anisphia concocts a plan to help Euphyllia regain her good name-which somehow involves them living together and researching magic!  Little do these two ladies know, however, that their chance encounter will alter not only their own futures, but those of the kingdom...and the entire world!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Chéri, Unmei no Hito!
synopsis:
Kaoru Sakura is a young pastry chef who takes pride in his outstanding skills and good looks. As a result, his newly-opened Western-style pâtisserie, Bisous, quickly gains popularity—especially among women. But his success is soon bogged down when a nearby Japanese confectionery store captures the attention of his clientele. 

Unsure of what the appeal of traditional sweets are, Kaoru decides to scope out the competition himself. He finds that the long-established, family-owned store is operated by the charming and composed Soujirou Tatsugawa—who, unlike Kaoru, seems indifferent about the two establishments sharing the same customer base. In fact, he is rather intrigued by Kaoru's creations. As the two get to know each other, Kaoru realizes his business rival is more delightful than what either of their shops have to offer.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

Included one-shot: Kamisama Onegai!

title: Ouchi e Kaerou: Nekomimi Omegaverse
title_japanese: おうちへかえろう-猫耳オメガバース-
synopsis:
Shiina and Aoi are a romantic Alpha and Omega couple who live happily together with their little son, Noel. Protected and sheltered by his parents, Noel is unaware that his family is different from any other until he one day accompanies Shiina to work and notices something strange. Why is it that he and Aoi are the only ones with cat ears?

(Source: Sankosha, translated)

title: Boku no Hero Academia Tokubetsu Spin-off: Endeavor's Mission
title_english: My Hero Academia Special Spin-off: Endeavor's Mission
title_japanese: 僕のヒーローアカデミア 特別スピンオフ ENDEAVOR'S MISSION
synopsis: Special prelude to Boku no Hero Academia the Movie 3: World Heroes' Mission.

title: Hikikomari Kyuuketsuki no Monmon
title_english: The Vexations of a Shut-In Vampire Princess
title_japanese: ひきこまり吸血姫の悶々
synopsis:
Three years into her life as a shut-in, vampire Terakomari Gandesblood (Komari for short), awakens to find she's been appointed as a Commander in the Mulnite Imperial Army! The thing is, her new unit consists solely of belligerent ruffians who revolt against their superiors at the slightest hint of weakness. Although Komari hails from a line of vampires as powerful as they are prestigious, her refusal to drink blood has made her the picture of mediocrity—scrawny, un-coordinated, and inept at magic. With the odds stacked against her, will the help of her trusty (and slightly infatuated) maid Vill be enough for this recluse to blunder her way to success? Or will Komari rue the day she ever left the safety of her room?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Sleeping & Gang
title_japanese: すりーぴんぐ＆ギャング

title: Bad Tripper
synopsis: Death row convict Heidi investigates a mysterious island on government orders.

title: Osananajimi (♂) to no Arekore.
title_japanese: 幼なじみ(♂)とのアレコレ。
synopsis:
High school students Fumi and Kaichi have been friends for almost 10 years, even though Fumi is dazzling and Kaichi is just an ordinary otaku. Fumi seems very comfortable with being childhood friends, he often sneaks into Kaichi's bed and loves to be spoiled by him. But Kaichi sees him differently...

(Source: MU)

title: Sensei no Otoriyose
synopsis:
When erotic novelist Haruka Enomura and shojo artist Miruku Nakata are brought together by their publisher to collaborate on a new manga, it seems like a perfect match—until the two meet in person and realize just how different they are! Haruka is a bit of a sadist with a cool-guy personality, and he immediately clashes with Miruku, who's something of a masochist and doesn't match his bright shojo style at all. There's one thing the two have in common, however—their love of gourmet food, especially the mail-order variety. Can their passion for amazing food bridge the gap between them? Or could food be the catalyst that causes their passions to boil over?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Dadadadaan
synopsis:
Sadame Hino's life has always been dictated by his stern father. Though he was destined to follow in his father's footsteps and become a physician, Sadame realizes that is not what he wishes for himself. To ensure that future can never come to pass, the boy purposely fails every one of his high school entrance exams, sending his father into a fit of rage as he disowns his son.

Now freeloading off a stranger, Sadame has no idea what to do with his life. When his roommate has to move back home, Sadame is forced to search for a new place to stay. Upon entering a music store, the distorted sound of a piano being played captures Sadame's attention, igniting in him a desire to try and recreate the melody—which is a more daunting task than he realizes.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kaibutsu-san wa Mimamoritai
title_japanese: 怪物さんは見守りたい

title: Conveni de Kimi to no 5-funkan.
title_english: The 5 Minutes We Share at the Convenience Store.
title_japanese: コンビニで君との５分間。
synopsis:
Shibasaki is a high school student who works part-time at a convenience store. At work, he encounters a petite office lady and finds himself infatuated by her. Likewise, the woman's interest in the young man gradually increases—mainly due to his face resembling her cat's. With each brief encounter, the student and the office lady slowly grow closer during the five minutes they share at the convenience store.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kashoku no Shiro
synopsis:
A mysterious disease in which one day people suddenly rise back from the Underworld: The Withering Death. When Kiso, a newspaper journalist, starts investigating the strange disease, he is attacked by a grotesque-looking demon. The one who saves him is a girl he had met by chance... The girl, whom Kiso is peculiarly drawn to, for some reason calls herself a "Demon's Burning Light"...?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Nureta Ou wa Senya Ichiya no Yume wo Miru
title_english: A Sexy King Have a Dream of "Thousand and One Nights."
title_japanese: 濡れた王は千夜一夜の夢をみる
synopsis:
After catching the eye of Arab hotel magnate Azam, doorman Tokio has to live with him in his suite. Swayed by a domineering attitude and sudden kisses, Tokio can't help but find Azam's "dere" side cute. But their relationship seems to go way back, a fact Tokio can't remember...

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Shirosugi! Aku no Soshiki
title_japanese: しろすぎ!アクノソシキ

title: Onii Tama wa Neko ja Nyai!
title_japanese: お兄タマは猫じゃニャい!

title: Karada wa Kodomo, Nakami wa Ossan no Nariagari Boukenki
title_japanese: 身体は児童〈こども〉、中身はおっさんの成り上がり冒険記
synopsis:
Grey Millard was born as the third son of the poorest aristocrat in the empire. In the Millard territory of the empire lives its feudal lord, Grey's father. However, his father is being controlled by his fiendish stepmother. Disliking this kind of trouble, Grey immediately determined to leave the Millard territory. Until Grey severs his relationship with his parents at 13, he devotes his entirety on self-improvement, ignoring those suffering under his stepmother's tyrannical rule. But...

This is the adventure of a boy with the mind of a middle-aged man.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Twilight
synopsis:
"I'll be your slave."

Lonely high school student Youhei doesn't belong to anywhere, be it his home or his school. That time, he ran into Ryou, a classmate who is also an ace in soccer club. The two were gradually drawn to each other, but... After an accident, their relationship was changed significantly. That was the beginning of a distorted pure love that would last for several years later...

"I'll do housework, I'll drop you off, pick you up. I'll have sex with you. I'll do anything Ryou wants. Everything, as long as I can be with Ryou."

(Source: Printemps Shuppan, translated)

title: Sabishisugiru Onna Shachou ga Lesbian Fuuzokujou ni Byou de Ochiru Hanashi
title_english: A Lonely Female CEO Falls for a Lesbian Prostitute in Seconds.
title_japanese: 寂しすぎる女社長がレズ風俗嬢に秒で落ちる話
synopsis:
She has money, status, and fame. Even though she has everything, she can't compensate for her loneliness. How can she become satisfied?

The destination that such a female CEO headed for was... a lesbian brothel?? Perhaps this person can satisfy her? A slightly erotic yuri comedy~

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Mitsugetsuhime to Vampire
title_japanese: 蜜血姫とヴァンパイア
synopsis:
Kagari Tojyo is smart and beautiful...but what really draws a crowd is her rare "honey blood"—a crowd of vampires, that is! Enter Ryotaro, her bodyguard and a vampire himself...with quite the perverted, sadistic streak! What's Kagari got to do to have a "normal" life?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Sanda
synopsis:
The story starts with Sanda, a second year middle school student, getting attacked with a kitchen knife by his classmate Fuyumura. While Sanda couldn't make sense of the situation at first, he gradually came to believe that Fuyumura's actions were just mean acts stemming off from the latter having a peculiar puberty phase.

But that was all actually a misunderstanding. Fuyumura is seriously questioning if Sanda is actually the descendant of a certain family...

(Source: MU)

title: Lit a Light
synopsis: The story of an assassin falling in love with a store clerk.

title: Nando, Toki wo Kurikaeshitemo Honnouji ga Moerun ja ga!?
title_japanese: 何度、時をくりかえしても本能寺が燃えるんじゃが!?

title: Shachiku-senpai wa Yutori-kouhai ni Sakaraenai
title_japanese: 社畜先輩はゆとり後輩に逆らえない
synopsis:
At the order of his black-hearted boss, corporate slave, Niwa, works overtime every day without a day off. His heart is without rest these days without a cute girlfriend... However, after passing out drunk, he wakes up in the embrace of his easygoing kouhai, Nagase?! Niwa tries to keep his distance from Nagase, but his body has already been exploited by him.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

Included one-shots: Yuutousei no Theory, Hirefuse! Senpai Yankee

title: Nee, Onnanoko ni Shite Ageru
title_japanese: ねえ、おんなのこにしてあげる
synopsis:
Shiro Manabe has a stressful job managing a travel agency, and when the workday is done he blows off steam by working as a "maid" at a cross-dressing café. The café is Shiro's safe place, until one night his sardonic subordinate Kuro Nabatame comes in! Though the two might not get along at work, now that Kuro knows his secret, Shiro is willing to do whatever it takes to make sure Kuro keeps his mouth shut. Can this fraught relationship become something fulfilling for both men?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Bushi-stant Aisaka-kun!
title_japanese: 武士スタント逢坂くん!
synopsis:
On the verge of death a passionate shunga painting samurai from Edo period somehow travels through time just before his execution.

(Source: MU)

title: Hajime Love Comedy: Oga-Bebe
title_japanese: はじめラブコメ オガベベ

title: Engage
synopsis:
The highlight of chef Mei Suzumori's year is the Tanabata Festival—the one day a year when a pair of mythical lovers reunites. For Mei, it's the day that a mysterious handsome stranger visits his adopted family's restaurant to buy tasty seasonal taiyaki. Unable to hold his feelings for the attractive stranger back any longer, Mei professes his love—and finds he's linked to the enigmatic Naru by a bond much deeper and more complicated than he ever imagined.

(Source: SuBLime)

title: Takane no Hana wa, Midasaretai
title_english: Scattering His Virgin Bloom: Love Frenzy
title_japanese: 高嶺の花は、乱されたい
synopsis: Hana and Renjaku thought they'd spend happy days together as pairs, but...

title: Hitozukiai ga Nigate na Miboujin no Yukionna-san to Noroi no Yubiwa
title_english: The Shy Snow Woman and the Cursed Ring
title_japanese: 人付き合いが苦手な未亡人の雪女さんと呪いの指輪
synopsis:
In a world where many different species coexist, Takahashi inherits his father's youkai-exclusive apartment complex after he passes away. One day, Takahashi meets and instantly becomes attracted to a yuki-onna, or snow woman, named Yukino. Although they initially get along, an argument drives the two apart.

While pondering how to fix their situation, Takahashi finds a strange ring inside a mysterious box. The included description states that if one directs their desires at a youkai who is within view of the ring, it is possible to control their mind. Takahashi remains skeptical until, during another desperate attempt to talk to Yukino, he shows the ring to her and witnesses its potential. With immense power at his fingertips, Takahashi must decide whether to use the ring to restore his relationship with Yukino or to fulfill his primitive desires.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Nihongo ga Hanasenai Russia-jin Bishoujo Tennyuusei ga Tayoreru no wa, Tagengo Master no Ore Hitori
title_english: The Russian Transfer and the Polyglot
title_japanese: 日本語が話せないロシア人美少女転入生が頼れるのは、多言語マスターの俺1人
synopsis:
Tina, a super-cute Russian, has transferred into the class. She is immediately popular but does not speak Japanese, so she is troubled and looks like she is about to burst out crying. In such a case, the only one she can rely on is the main character Iori, who is hated by everyone due to a certain misunderstanding.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Shimai wo Sotsugyou shite Koibito ni Narimashita
title_japanese: 姉妹を卒業して恋人になりました
synopsis: Yukine is confessed to by Rika at graduation.

title: Great Trailers
title_japanese: グレイト トレイラーズ

title: The Tale of Goldiluck, the Black Kitten
title_english: The Tale of Goldiluck, the Black Kitten
synopsis:
A sweet tale of companionship and found family set in Joseon dynasty Korea between a lonely young scholar with a kind but weak heart, a stray black kitten with a strange secret, and a loyal but jealous servant boy.

(Source: NHN comico)

title: A Bitch and a Punk
synopsis:
Middle school, year 2, summer. The me who was unable to say "don't go" or that "I liked you" to her in the past appeared before me 3 years later. The story of a boy and a girl confronting the time spent apart from each other.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Parrot Blade
synopsis:
"Those with blood on their blades don't cross the Lower Yangtze."

No So-ha, the sole heir to the reputedly invincible Nine Flow Swordsmanship, lives a low-profile life with three sources of income—fishing, ferrying customers through the Lower Yangtze, and as a contract hitman for victims of injustice. Despite trying to stay away from the conflicts among martial arts factions, he finds himself taking up the most dangerous job of all: escorting to safety a girl who holds the missing part of the Sun Gun Gyung, a medical treatise written for Emperor Qin Shi Huang that is the key to achieving immortality.

(Source: MU)

title: 2 People
synopsis:
My life has been sold to two different people. Now I have to live as a different person in the day and night.

(Source: MU)

title: Girl Under Trial
synopsis:
An unexpected series of trials begin for a girl who was close to the bottom of the school hierarchy. The winner gets a prize!

(Source: MU)

title: Boku no Tsugai wa Thoroughbred Ω
title_japanese: 僕の番はサラブレット
synopsis:
Second-generation actor and alpha Leo Asaka is accustomed to his achievements being attributed to his father. It was not as if he chose to be his father's son. Even so, when a big-name director offers a film role to Leo—co-starring with Eito Yanagi, another second-generation actor—he can hardly refuse.

Leo is anything but excited to be working alongside the notably promiscuous alpha Eito, and the two clash in their very first meeting. However, after they are locked in a hotel room to forcibly get to know each other better, Leo learns Eito's shocking secret: he is an omega, a secondary gender looked down upon in the acting community. Not a moment later, their lips entwine, but can they make it in a society that would disapprove of their pair?

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Oni Joushi Gokudera-san wa Abakaretai.
title_english: My Demon Boss, Mr. Gokudera, Wants to Be Exposed!
title_japanese: 鬼上司・獄寺さんは暴かれたい。
synopsis:
A lewd body, with lewd underwear... It's insanely arousing.

Even though he's capable, Shouji is a corporate slave, who is always being berated by his boss, Gokudera-san. In an unexpected turn of events, Gokudera-san accidentally sends him the link of a sexy man wearing women’s underwear instead of his dog's social media account... This can't be...?! The gap between the boss who is devilish by day, and erotic and cute by night is enough to make a corporate dog explode in desire!!! 

(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)

title: Survivor's Guilt: Asobinin no Koi
title_japanese: サバイバーズ・ギルト～遊び人の恋
synopsis:
It's been 15 years, and yet every time Daisuke closes his eyes, as if etched onto the back of his eyelids, the tragic scene replays ruthlessly. The only other person who knows of his past is his coworker and best friend, Kengo, who sees past his playboy personality that he has adopted. As Daisuke slowly starts to accept that this is and will be his life, a fresh spring breeze blows in his direction, in the form of Kengo's little brother, a college student named Riku. Riku, traumatized in his own way, shows Daisuke a different way of living and forces him to confront himself, whether he wants to or not.

(Source: Torico)

title: Super Baby
synopsis:
A pure-hearted kuro-gal and a simple diamond-in-the-rough... With a love as odd as theirs, who's to say where it will lead? Dreaming of finally becoming a Tokyo girl, Tamao moves to the capital and falls in love with Yamada, a guy working at a supermarket. At first glance he may seem unappealing, but a love as pure as theirs is second to none!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Shibuya: Gal Yuri Anthology
title_japanese: SHIBUYA ギャル百合アンソロジー
synopsis: Yuri anthology about gals by various mangaka.

title: Ankoku Kishi Danchou to Seishun Girl
title_japanese: 暗黒騎士団長と青春ガール

title: Watashi wo Misete, Ore wo Mite
title_english: Please Show Me and Watch Me.
title_japanese: わたしをみせて、おれをみて
synopsis:
1-2. Watashi wo Misete, Ore wo Mite (Please Show Me and Watch Me.)
3. Kimi shika Mienai
4. Watashi wo Misete, Ore wo Mite Sonogo!
5. Densha wo Oritara
6. Densha wo Oritara Sonogo!

title: Evening Dinner
synopsis:
Kyosuke, a college student bound for Tokyo dreaming of a "Destined Love," was called out at a gay bar by Subaru, a guy who was just his type. Under the influence of alcohol, they went straight into a hotel and Kyosuke had sex for the first time. Their physical compatibility was the best however... After that, Kyosuke got irritated with Subaru's attitude and decided never to see him again. But, it turns out they live in the same sharehouse?!

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

title: Akayoroshi: Yami Hanafuda Yugitan
title_japanese: あかよろし ～闇花札遊鬼譚～

title: Rin-chan wa Suezen Shitai
title_japanese: りんちゃんは据え膳したい
synopsis:
Kobayashi is a high school art teacher in his thirties, and Rin-chan is a beautiful girl who is popular at school. Although there is no common trait between the two, they actually share a certain secret...!? This is the beginning of a hesitant love comedy between a teacher in his thirties and a naive JK!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Yuliqueur: Alcohol Yuri Anthology
title_japanese: ユリキュール アルコール百合アンソロジー
authors: Mita, Ori|2C=Galore|Mochi au Lait|Gotou, Yuki|Yukio, Yuki|Yoshino, Kaya|Kashikaze|Chicole
synopsis: A slightly mature anthology about alcohol and girls' love.

title: Cinnamon: Jingai x Ningen Yuri Anthology
title_japanese: シナモン Cinnamon 人外×人間百合アンソロジー
synopsis: An anthology of yuri short stories featuring human x non-human couples by various mangaka.

title: Do S Kouhai nanka ni Zettai Makenai!
title_japanese: ドS後輩なんかに絶対負けない！

title: Maou 2099
synopsis:
​The cyberpunk metropolis Shinjuku—a massive city-state bedecked with neon signs, towering skyscrapers, and the latest cutting-edge technology. It is here, in year 2099 of the Fused Era, where the legendary Demon Lord Veltol has his second coming five centuries in the making. But this landscape is nothing like the one he conquered all those years ago, for the fusion of magic and engineering has elevated civilization to dazzling, unprecedented heights. Veltol may have been reduced to a historical footnote, but make no mistake...this brave new world will be his for the taking!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: OL-san to Neko no Hanashi
title_english: The Cute Life of OL and Cat
synopsis:
Included one-shot:
Volume 1: Kyuuketsuki-chan x Kouhai-chan: After Season

title: SHWD
synopsis:
The year is 20XX. Tough but idealistic Koga has just joined the Tokyo branch of SHWD, the Special Hazardous Waste Disposal unit responsible for eradicating mysterious biological weapons that were left behind after the great war. Her mentor is Sawada, a woman with a powerful psyche who complements Koga's physical prowess. Something is sizzling between the two of them, and it's more than just a shared mission. Together, these two badass women must team up to confront horrors beyond their wildest nightmares.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Ansatsu Skill de Isekai Saikyou: Renkinjutsu to Ansatsujutsu wo Kiwameta Ore wa, Sekai wo Kage kara Shihai suru
title_english: Killer Alchemist: Assassinations in Another World
title_japanese: 暗殺スキルで異世界最強　～錬金術と暗殺術を極めた俺は、世界を陰から支配する～
synopsis:
Late has just accepted an assassination from a strange, mysterious client. To his surprise, it was actually the goddess Mises. A goddess from another world whose exsistence was on the brink of destruction after her defeat in war. Mises' quest... is to assassinate Masura Dzur, another god in her world. Late, the assassin with a 99.9% success rate, was tasked to assassinate a god in another world?!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Sacchi sarenai Rule Breaker
title_japanese: 察知されない最強職〈ルール・ブレイカー〉
synopsis:
By some ill fortune, Hikaru died in a traffic accident. He was in heaven standing in line, waiting to be judged, when he ended up being convinced to transfer his soul to a person in another world. He received an ability called Soul Board which he could use to allocate points to Skills to make himself more powerful. But there was a catch...

"You must kill a certain person within one hour. If you don't, your soul will be destroyed."

To pull off the absurd task assigned to him, he poured all his available points to the Stealth skill tree. This is a story of a boy who specialized in Stealth. With his skill trees as weapons, he would demonstrate his unrivaled strength in another world.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Yurufuwa Nouka no Mojibake Skill: Isekai de Catalog Tsuuhan Yattemasu
title_english: Cheat Mode Farming in Another World
title_japanese: ゆるふわ農家の文字化けスキル　～異世界でカタログ通販やってます～
synopsis:
Tatsuya, a 29-year-old bachelor, gets accidentally summoned to another world and obtains "Agricultural Skills." In order to survive, he starts a vegetable garden in a secluded forest. He thought that his life in another world would be extremely difficult, but the ingredients in this other world were delicious and the crops he grew on his own were also very delicious! Furthermore, he's also very happy with the dishes he made with Japanese seasonings! Typical. Rice and sake are going to be a staple apparently, but you guys know the drill. Besides, if there are beautiful brides, isn't it okay if he lives in this other world? Loose and fluffy, a relaxing other world harem life!!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Naguri Tamer no Isekai Seikatsu: Kouei nanoni Zenei de Tatakau Mamonotsukai
title_japanese: 殴りテイマーの異世界生活 ～後衛なのに前衛で戦う魔物使い～
synopsis:
Kaito Arihara, a high school student who has never been liked by animals by nature, is caught up in a magic circle that suddenly appears around his classmate Chisato Shishihara, who he met by chance on his way home from school.

Kaito, who has been blown into an unknown space, meets Schiff, a shape shifter, a monster in the shape of a black cat. Schiff discovers the nature of "Tamer" in the unique mana in Kaito's body, and decided to be his familiar. However, as a result of the combination of Kaito's mana and Schiff's abilities, it turned out that it was more efficient for Kaito to fight by himself than to use his familiar for some reason. Using that ability of him, Kaito is looking for a way of life in this other world.

The whereabouts of Chisato Shishihara, who has been separated with Kaito, the girl called Leafa who knows Kaito's name that has just been summoned, and the existence of the demon king who moves secretly—the only thing waiting for Kaito is turmoil!?

Breaking the norm

title: Ponkotsu Megami no Isekai Souseiroku
title_english: Ponkotsu Goddess's Genesis of Another Universe
title_japanese: ポンコツ女神の異世界創世録
synopsis:
Artesia Gaia Nagasus, the goddess of creation, went into a deep slumber in order to bring new life to the fallen planet, and to prepare for the inevitable arrival of the Hero, whom she would then provide with guidance. However, she woke up too early... Not only was there no Hero waiting for her, she was met with an extremely cold glacial period without intelligent life...?! She just wants to be worshiped and intervene in humanity's wars! This is a tale of creation, starring a defective goddess who can't help but mess with humanity, and her journey to set the world in motion—with a few troubles here, and a little hard work there.

(Source: Kill Time Communication, translated)

title: Yuusha Party wo Tsuihou sareta Shiromadoushi, S-Rank Boukensha ni Hirowareru: Kono Shiromadoushi ga Kikakugai Sugiru
title_english: Scooped Up by an S-Rank Adventurer! This White Mage Is One Heck of a Healer
title_japanese: 勇者パーティーを追放された白魔導師、Sランク冒険者に拾われる～この白魔導師が規格外すぎる～
synopsis:
Lloyd, a white mage trained by Lady Merlin herself, is a member of the illustrious Hero's Party—until they kick him out for being "too weak," that is. What the Hero's Party doesn't know, however, is that he's actually crazy strong! No longer shackled to the party that never understood his worth, Lloyd is quickly Scooped Up by an S-Rank Adventurer who immediately recognizes his talent and invites him to join her party.

Together, Lloyd and his new comrades set off on a quest to hunt a pack of high wolves, but they soon discover that there's much more to this simple job than what meets the eye...

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Oi, Hazure Skill dato Omowareteita "Cheat Code Sousa" ga Bakemono Sugirun daga.
title_japanese: おい、外れスキルだと思われていた《チートコード操作》が化け物すぎるんだが。
synopsis:
In a world where everyone is bestowed a skill at the age of 18, Arios, the son of a sword saint, was without a doubt expected to be granted the Sword Saint skill, but... was instead given a skill called Cheat Code Manipulation. With the unprecedented skill being treated like garbage, Arios gets thrown out of his home. However, with this useless skill, he is able to control some not-so-ordinary cheat codes! With his childhood friend, the princess following him, he spreads his peerlessness across a new land without even knowing it!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Kaettekita Motoyuusha
synopsis:
Once, a hero was summoned to a different world in order to defeat the demon king. After the war stretching 3 years ended, the commendable hero slayed the demon king, and he was forcibly deported back to earth after being dismissed.

"Give me a break! Elves in addition to beast race, dwarfs and demon race.
Even though I wanted to make a harem in the different world I saved! My dream will not come true on earth, where there is no magic at all."

Thus, the hero returns on his own. Without the blunder of being extradited to earth this time, he will build a harem of his own in a different world.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Adultoys!
synopsis:
Akane Oguri is a high school girl. Her curiosity got the better of her one day and she goes in to a sex shop, and the rest is history. In this series, Akane and her friends will teach us about masturbation in hilarious, silly and playful stories.

(Source: MU, edited)

title: Bomber Boy
synopsis:
Yamato is a small country at war with the military might of Mars. In the face of this overwhelming superiority, Yamato's defeat seems inevitable.

Even on the island of Gallé in the South Pacific Ocean, where fierce battles are also being fought, Yamato's army is in a state of collapse. Sergeant Tatsumi fights for the survival of his regiment, which is in a desperate situation. One day, just when all hope seems to be gone, he sees an "object" named Kitetsu drop from a transport plane...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Amaetai Kemono
title_english: The Beast That Yearns to be Tamed
synopsis:
Arata's a college student working as a "big brother for rent." One day, he meets his new client, Junta, who looks like a total tough guy!! Arata wonders if this is some sort of trap to get his money, but what Junta wants is for someone to pat him on the head. Seeing someone this hot go bright red and be so vulnerable is turning Arata on... Junta's just so adorable... what's going on here!!?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Oni to Hebi
synopsis:
Unlucky man Kiryuu was at a loss. He went to jail in place of his aniki, and when he was back, the group was long gone. Since then, he got entangled with weird people, his electricity was cut off, and finally he ran over a man. Mita, the accident's victim, is a handyman. Kiryuu decided to take care of Mita to apologize for injuring him. However, after a while, disturbing signs began to surround Mita...?

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

title: Tensei-saki ga Zannen Ouji Datta Ken: Ima wa Fukkin 1-kai mo Dekinai kedo Yasete Isekai Sukuimasu
title_japanese: 転生先が残念王子だった件 ～今は腹筋１回もできないけど痩せて異世界救います～
synopsis:
A young man who gets into a plane crash while returning from a business trip overseas is reincarnated into another world after being asked by the goddess to defeat the evil god.

However, he was reincarnated as a stupid prince who is known among the aristocrats as the "Pig Prince" because of his fat and ugly appearance. If you can't even do one sit-up, how are you going to defeat the evil god? This is the story of the Pig Prince's struggle to lose weight!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Hajimete no Kedamono
synopsis:
Hana, a lonely girl without relatives is discovered to be the grandchild of a yakuza leader. She starts being escorted by the handsome yakuza member Gin! In front of other people, Gin is a gentleman but when they're both alone he turns into a sexual harassment deity! He loves touching Hana's underwear and kissing her constantly. Even though he's a douche, he's got a warm touch and Hana's heart won't stop pounding...!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Takeki Ougon no Kuni: Inou Tadataka
title_japanese: 猛き黄金の国 伊能忠敬

title: One Chance!
synopsis:
Shocked and dismayed that his girlfriend not only dumped him but was dating someone else on the side, Hiyori walks home from school, deflated. On his way, he happens to meet Makoto who works at a dog café owned by his parents. He sees Makoto give a dog so much affection, he wishes he could get it, too. After spending some time with Makoto, Hiyori knows for sure he's the one for him and resolves to get closer. But, the next day, a new student teacher comes to school, and guess who it is...!!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Itooshiki Hibi
synopsis:
A 50s x 60s BL. We met when we were 18 and 28, from that time... until now, I've always loved you.

"I'll wait no matter how long, even 10 years or 20 years. Even when we've become old men."

Following the life path of two people from different generations—this is a tender life story. Akihiko, an employee in his 50s and Makoto, who's 10 years older than him, are lovers, sons and family. From when we meet as tutor and pupil, things that have changed, and things that are unchanged...

(Source: Sankosha, translated)

title: Sweets wa Teiji no Ato de
title_japanese: スイーツは定時のあとで
synopsis:
Reika has it all—she's a model-tall cool beauty with a high-powered job at her sweets company. But it's precisely because of all that that she's never had a boyfriend...men find her too unapproachable, or beg her to be their mistress, in the S&M sort of way. But when she meets a young coworker, Hasegawa-kun, she happens to find out that they have more in common than just their job, including secrets...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Included one-shots:
Volume 3: Hoshifuru Yoru ni Escape
Volume 4: Tenshi ga Niji wo Tsuretekuru (Angels Bring Rainbows)

title: Fukumen Tantei Mask de Holmes to Kiss Dorobou
title_japanese: 覆面探偵マスク・ド・ホームズとキス泥棒

title: Sayonara Manuke na Yuukaihan-san
title_japanese: さよならマヌケな誘拐犯さん

title: Gal na Hiiragi-san to Haenai Boku
title_japanese: ギャルな柊さんと映えない僕

title: Soushoku Joshi Paopao-senpai
title_japanese: 草食女子パオパオ先輩

title: Black Maid Revengers
title_japanese: ブラックメイドリベンジャーズ

title: Kurogane no Bara
synopsis:
A series following a knight in service to the Duke of Somerset, one of the supporters of the House of Lancaster in the Wars of the Roses, a conflict in 15th-century England between the supporters of two rival houses with crests of red and white roses. What is this knight thinking, as he faces the encroaching enemy...?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Ouroboros
synopsis:
Woo Hyung's life has hit rock bottom. He's traumatized after several days of being imprisoned and raped by his brother-in-law, an event that eventually left him both wifeless and jobless. His only way of coping is sex, and two very different men who can provide exactly that show up in his life. Caught between the two people who each drag him into their orbit, Hyung sinks deeper into obsession fueled by his trauma, and it seems like there's no escape from his despair...or is there?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Mitsubachi to Lemon Balm
title_japanese: ミツバチとレモンバーム
synopsis:
A former yakuza falls fast and hard for the delicate florist who sets him on the right path in this quirky and heartfelt BL manga!

Kaoru Mitsuya has all but given up on living a meaningful life. Ensnared at a young age by the temptations of organized crime, he has neither a penny to his name nor anything he holds truly dear. It is at this lowest point that he encounters Yuuichirou Shirouzu—a delicately beautiful florist with a secret or two hidden beneath his kind demeanor. When Yuuichirou offers Kaoru a job at his nighttime flower shop, it marks a turning point for Kaoru, both in how he lives his life, and whom he wishes to spend it with...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Mitsuboshi Immoral
synopsis:
1. Musuko no Kanojo
2. Sentaku ga Owaru made
3. Aizou Soukan
4. Haha wa Yoru no Chou
5. Deai wo Motomeru Haha
6. Wakige Haha

title: Hosome Ottori Kyonyuu Mama.
title_japanese: 細目おっとり巨乳ママ。

title: Gyakusatsu!!! Heartful Company
title_japanese: 虐殺!!! ハートフルカンパニー
synopsis:
Kiichi Nakai, CEO of Heartful Company, is confronted with a grim diagnosis. To make the most of his final days, he commits to only carrying out good deeds. Here begins a tale of love and passion for doing the right thing, a story to warm even the coldest of hearts.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Shika no Ou: Yuna to Yakusoku no Tabi
title_english: The Deer King: Yuna and the Promised Journey
title_japanese: 鹿の王 ユナと約束の旅
synopsis:
After a pack of infected dogs attacks a group of miners, soldier-turned-slave Van awakens to find himself blessed with preternatural strength. As he effortlessly breaks free of his chains, he notices a young girl-the only other survivor-standing before him. The two escape the mine, but with Van's captors in pursuit and a deadly disease ravaging the area, how will they survive on the lam?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED Eclipse
title_japanese: 機動戦士ガンダムSEED ECLIPSE
synopsis:
C.E.72 was a unique era which would later be called the "two blank years." Some also call it "the time of peace on thin ice," and others call it "the break before the oncoming frenzy." This is the story of an interval. A story that takes place between two large wars in which members of a hollow unit known as ODR risked their lives.

(Source: GUNDAM.INFO)

title: Surechigai wa Fuufu no Hajimari
title_japanese: すれ違いは夫婦の始まり
synopsis: Wakaba Eri and Sakato Ryouhei are co-workers whose ideal partners are the complete opposites of each other, yet they eventually get married!

title: Mad Place
synopsis:
Seconds after winning his case, Sehyuk is immediately called to investigate another murder—this time, with a suspect who claims to be his biggest fan. Ideun, the suspect in question who holds the key to the investigation, requests a "private" sitting with Sehyuk, in all essence of the word. As the mystery unveils, unpleasant truths and painful memories rise to the surface once again, plunging Sehyuk deeper into madness.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Susume! Jump Heppoko Tankentai
title_japanese: すすめ!ジャンプへっぽこ探検隊

title: Jidou Hanbaiki ni Umarekawatta Ore wa Meikyuu wo Samayou
title_english: Reborn as a Vending Machine, I Now Wander the Dungeon
title_japanese: 自動販売機に生まれ変わった俺は迷宮を彷徨う
synopsis:
How far are you willing to go to protect your interests? For one Japanese vending-machine enthusiast, the answer is "to the grave." Crushed by his favorite contraption, his life as a fanboy of dispensed goods may be over, but his close connection to vending machines can only grow—when he's reborn as one in a fantasy world! Is a land of monsters and magic ready for this modern marvel of convenience?!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Choushoujo UFO
synopsis:
1-6. Choushoujo UFO
7-9. Bravo!! Sensei
10. Goronbo Tanteisha
11. Enma Jigoku

title: Yamagami-san no Iru Tokoro
title_japanese: 山神さんのいるところ

title: Kaerimichi
synopsis:
On her way home, a young girl is distracted by all of the delicious food she sees. From streetside tacos to fresh-baked goods, her growling stomach and empty wallet sadden her, as she cannot afford to buy any of them. But when she does find something to eat, a familiar scene reminds her of her journey and what awaits at the end of it.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Aoi-kun wa Shinitagari no Onnanoko (♂)
title_japanese: 葵くんは死にたがりの女の子(♂)
synopsis:
A guy gains a younger step-brother named Aoi after his mom remarries, only to discover later that Aoi enjoys cross-dressing.

(Source: MU)

title: Houkago Virginity
title_japanese: 放課後ヴァージニティー
synopsis:
I'll never have a love affair like this in all my life! thinks Masato, a high school boy who always watches adult movies and touches himself in the company of his two best friends. What's more, he arrives at the conclusion that the greatest pleasure attainable would be a dry climax...!! After stimulating himself inside, he realizes that he can come by doing it with another guy, and immediately strives to train his body. Meanwhile, the cool and handsome Uta, who sleeps with girls every day, sees him watching gay movies, and getting carried away he asks to do it with him, too!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Tora no Ejiki
synopsis:
Hayato, a small-time gangster, has taken the name "Tiger" to impersonate a yakuza leader. "Tiger" is the code name for the yakuza leader who is in charge of the city Hayato lives in, and that man also has a tiger tattoo on his back. What will happen if he's discovered... but Hayato does not listen to the advice of those around him. As Hayato is drinking with the money he "earned" today in his favorite gay bar, a handsome man appears...?!

(Source: Media Soft, translated)

title: DeSpo FighterZ
synopsis:
The era of e-sports has arrived, where anyone can compete and enjoy gaming tournaments! Kenzou, a gamer who loves the fighting game Dragon Ball FighterZ, enters the e-sport world and is prepared to challenge everyone with only his intuition and fists!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Mother Parasite
synopsis:
Ryouta Miki is a middle schooler who lives a happy life with his single mother. But his relationship with his mother is strange, as she is always afraid of causing the slightest trouble. Meanwhile, his classmate Kaoru Kasai is fed up with his overprotective mother, and feels that it’s his mother’s fault that he ended up bullied. But one day, Ryota starts talking to Kaoru for the first time after saving him from bullying... A psychological suspense thriller about a boy obsessed with finding the ultimate mother!

(Source: Coamix)

title: Watashi no Oyome-kun
synopsis:
Hayami is the it-woman at her job—she's cool, confident, and admired by all. But her has-it-all exterior belies a dark secret...her house is a mess, and she's no good at taking care of herself! Enter Yamamoto-kun—her colleague who thinks the world of her, and who refuses to let her slobbish behavior slide. Soon he's over at her house often enough that she asks him to move in with her! Where will this roundabout relationship take them?!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Negative Happy Chainsaw Edge
title_japanese: ネガティブハッピー・チェーンソーエッヂ
synopsis: Yousuke Yamamoto is a typical underachiever, searching for a reason to live while struggling to come to terms with the death of his friend Noto a year ago. Everything changes dramatically for him one night when he runs into Eri Yukizaki, a beautiful girl hiding a tragic loss of her own, out on the streets. When a chainsaw-wielding giant falls from the sky and engages her in battle, it marks the beginning of Yousuke finally finding his purpose in life.

title: Hotel Inhumans
title_japanese: ホテル・インヒューマンズ
synopsis:
A luxury hotel is required to offer certain amenities. First-rate food, sublime comforts, enchanting entertainment, and...the latest weapons, forged IDs, and body disposal service?! This is a hotel where the guests are professional assassins and its concierges never say no to any request. No matter what their dangerous guests need, the hotel staff are at their service!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Okane Daisuki
synopsis:
Toa needed some extra spending money, and a friend has the hook up on a sweet new job! It starts as a simple hostess gig, but when one customer is willing to shell out some big bucks for some hotel action, Toa's eyes light up. With the acts getting more extreme with each new sugar daddy, the lines are blurring on what she loves more—the moolah or the dick!

(Source: FAKKU)

synopsis:

synopsis:

3. Bosei Honnou Bousou Switch

5. Ki no Tsuyoi Motoyan Mama wa Dogeza ni Yowai

title: Otaku datte Gal to Koi Shitai
title_english: I'm an Otaku but I Want to Fall in Love with a Gal
title_japanese: オタクだってギャルと恋したい
synopsis: The story of an otaku becoming friends with four gals.

title: Unrivaled: Naomi Tenkaichi
title_japanese: アンライバルド NAOMI天下一
synopsis:
Naomi is a Space Tennis player who travels the universe with her family. She admires Sara, the "Queen of the Winds." She decides to participate in the Astro Open, where she can play against Sara if she wins. However, she is confronted by players who are controlled by the power of "darkness"...? Naomi will fight until the end to become the best Space Tennis player!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Toaru Majutsu no Index Gaiden: Toaru Kagaku no Mental Out
title_english: A Certain Magical Index: A Certain Scientific Mental Out
title_japanese: とある魔術の禁書目録外伝 とある科学の心理掌握〈メンタルアウト〉
synopsis:
The Tokiwadai student council election is approaching. Shokuhou Misaki, one of the leading candidates, is in the midst of an election campaign in spite of her own expectations due to the people around her and the fate of being the head of the largest clique...!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Saikyou Yankee ga Omega na Wake Nai!
title_english: The Toughest Guy in School Is an Omega!?
title_japanese: 最強ヤンキーがオメガなわけない!
synopsis:
Under the country's law, omegas are obligated to wear a chastity belt. A rumor is going around that there's a key that will unlock the belt, and people are fighting to find this key.

Sashima is the toughest delinquent around. An elite group of alphas, the Snakes, hear about Sashima and come to fight him. The leader of the Snakes, Aoda, is expecting a big, towering man, and while the Sashima standing in front of him has glaring, piercing eyes, he's also short... and an omega!

After telling Sashima that he chooses him as his partner, Aoda suddenly grabs Sashima and starts kissing him. This Aoda is out of control! Sashima's right-hand man, Taketora, has also been pulled into this whole mess. Who's going to be the one to soften the toughest omega?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Hikaeme ni Ittemo, Kore wa Ai
title_japanese: ひかえめに言っても、これは愛
synopsis:
Risa Amakawa is only in high school, but she is extraordinarily self-sufficient. With the tools inside her seemingly bottomless bag, she is prepared for any freak incident that lady luck chooses to throw her way. So when Risa encounters a delinquent—all battered and bruised—on a rainy afternoon, she takes advantage of the power bestowed upon her by her own sense of caution and uses it to help him. What she does not expect is the victim, Zen Oohira, to take a liking to her.

Zen checks all the boxes of a typical delinquent; he has an air of nonchalance about him and even owns a motorcycle. Even so, he is oddly cheerful and sweet, going so far as to give Risa a "help coupon" as thanks for her aid in his time of need. When an unforeseen episode forces Risa to redeem her coupon, she realizes that Zen can be far more charming than he lets on. But is she prepared to sacrifice her meticulousness for a carefree gamble on romance?

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Mada Mahou nanka ni Tayotterassharu no deshou ka?
title_japanese: まだ魔法なんかに頼ってらっしゃるのでしょうか?

title: Tensei shitara Dainana Ouji Datta node, Kimama ni Majutsu wo Kiwamemasu
title_japanese: 転生したら第七王子だったので、気ままに魔術を極めます
synopsis:
A magic nerd's life came to an end after a dreadful encounter with the nobles who ended his life with a powerful spell. His last wish, being able to study and master more magic, has been answered when he was reincarnated as Lloyd de Saloom, the 7th prince of Saloom Kingdom. Now he'll be able to perfect his magic as he pleases...

(Source: MU)

title: Kanshakudama no Love Song
title_english: The Love Song of the Cracker Ball
title_japanese: かんしゃく玉のラブソング
synopsis:
Since they were kids, Takeo has looked after his next-door neighbor Wako. Though they are the same age, Wako was very sensitive to the cold and would often fall so sick he had to miss school, days at a time. But now, Wako is stronger than before, perhaps thanks to Takeo's incessant care... or perhaps because Wako has been fighting a silent battle every single day... Being next door neighbors with the love of your life, having them sneak into your room at night and sleep in your bed, walking to school together every day, and watching them date others while having to support them would make anybody stronger... Wako wants to stay by Takeo's side for as long as possible. He doesn't mind if Takeo finds a girlfriend and has mentally prepared himself for when Takeo finds a wife. But Wako's world flips upside down when Takeo says something unexpected like, "I could go for a guy, too."

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: His Little Amber
title_japanese: ヒズ・リトル・アンバー
synopsis:
Twenty years ago, Genji, a widower and former Yakuza, rescued what he thought was an abandoned kitten in the rain. That "cat" turned out to be a shape-shifting non-human, and Genji found himself raising a young boy. That boy has grown into a handsome young man, and now, their relationship begins to change.

(Source: MU)

title: Jimikon
synopsis:
1. Gyaku Proposal Hanayome
2. Futarijime Hanayome
3. Sakizome Hanayome
4. Omoi Hanamuko to Karui Hanayome

title: Lili Words
synopsis:
In a world where things that cannot be explained by science are labeled as "magic," a new research field called "Protoscience" investigating such phenomena was born. Professor Lili and his curious assistant Words are protoscience researchers who are struggling to get funding for their next project. When all seems hopeless, a desperate butler asks the two for their expertise on a new mystery—how to "unfreeze" his master from being frozen in time.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Shousetsu to, Shounen to, Sailor Fuku.
title_japanese: 小説と、少年と、セーラー服。
synopsis:
Tsukasa Minase is an 11-year-old boy who gets asked by his next door neighbor and novelist Chifuyu Kuga to dress up as a girl to help her write her current manuscript.

(Source: MU)

title: The Dog Diaries
synopsis:
Dana is a freelance illustrator who feels lonely and stressed out from working all day and doing little else. But this all changes when she is joined by a new four-legged friend: a small Pomeranian puppy called Myeongdong. This cute little pup shows her what unconditional love looks like, and Dana does her best to look after her new pal, too.

title_japanese: ひだまりが聴こえる－春夏秋冬－
synopsis:
Kohei Sugihara, college student with hearing loss, and Taichi Sagawa, his ever-optimistic former classmate, met in a chance encounter that ignited an undeniable spark that would eventually blossom into love.

Now it's spring and as Kohei nears graduation, his search for a job begins. Meanwhile, Taichi finds himself in charge of someone new at work. Life is busier than ever, but all in all, things seem to be looking up for the pair. That is, until the sudden appearance of Ena, one of Kohei's old flames.

(Source: One Peace Books)

title: Megami ni nante Narenai.
title_japanese: 女神になんてなれない.
synopsis:
A story about being liked by a girl with problems.

Spreading horrible gossip about her old friends, Mami Tsuga gained the reputation of a problem child among her peers. But one day, due to a chance encounter, she stumbled upon Taka Itou who lent her a helping hand.

(Source: BOOTH, translated)

title: Coffee Thief
synopsis:
There is a cafe in the mountains behind the school called "Coffee Thief." Rumors spread that there is "a man who buys time" there. Yoo Narae, who was in an accident a year ago, went there with the Grim Reaper, Saewoo, and tried to steal the time manager's watch to come back to life...

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: A Compendium of Ghosts
synopsis:
Sang, once the little boy too afraid to jump into the lake with the older children, comes back home a brave new man—a huntsman, to be exact. It's only after reuniting with his friend Sejin, the shaman's daughter, that he notices a black shadow has been following him... The experience reminds him that there are spirits that walk amongst us, and not always in the dark.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Rose Rosy Roseful Bud
title_japanese: ローズ ローズィ ローズフル バッド
synopsis:
Masako Kanbara, 40 years old. Occupation, manga artist. The protagonist of her currently publishing manga series is a comical character called "Faburo." But truly, she would like to draw shoujo manga instead...?!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

Volume 1: Rose Rosy Roseful Bud (pilot)

title: Toshi to Mahou wa Kiss Shidai
synopsis:
Tooru has a superpower—he manages to be invisible without any magic at all! In fact, the only one who truly sees him is his childhood friend, Tsumugi, leading Tooru to have the crush to end all crushes on her. But when Tooru's "ability" leads him to accidentally discover a witch and strip her of her powers, he thinks he's screwed...until she offers to help him hook up with Tsumugi. But this witch's powers are revived only with a kiss? One thing's for sure—Tooru won't be invisible for long!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Toki wo Kakeru Sukeban Deka
title_english: Sukeban Deka Who Leapt Through Time
title_japanese: 時をかけるスケバン刑事〈デカ〉
synopsis:
Based on Shinji Wada's Sukeban Deka manga, the Toki wo Kakeru Sukeban Deka manga's story centers on a high school girl named Tomoe, who is talented in karate, but lacks self-confidence and has a timid personality. She gets involved in a riot one day, and a mysterious man tells her to become a Sukeban detective. Tomoe travels across time and space, and meets another Sukeban detective, Saki Asamiya.

(Source: ANN)

title: Sukeban Deka Pretend
synopsis:
A spinoff of Shinji Wada's Sukeban Deka manga, Sukeban Deka Pretend centers on Asami, a cheerful girl who attends Takanoha High School. The story begins when she encounters a mysterious yo-yo and a mysterious girl.

(Source: ANN, edited)

title: Sono Mimi Sawarasete Kudasai
title_japanese: その耳触らせてください
synopsis:
Tomoya, a cool and handsome high school student, secretly loves cute things. One day, he notices a freshman, Aki, who sneezes and grows fluffy ears from his head!?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Make It Only Love
title_japanese: メイクイットオンリーラブ
synopsis:
"Suddenly, a kiss with someone you admire!?" Nakamura Oto, a model who gets nervous even shooting promotional pictures is thinking about quitting his job. That's when Shion, a cameraman, tells him that an acquaintance of his is looking for a model. Unable to refuse, he decides to meet with the client... but when arrives at the meeting place, Ryou, a makeup artist he admires is there?! Moreover, he's kissed by a half-asleep Ryou!?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Yoromeki Yomawari
title_english: The Hooligan and the Night Patrol
synopsis:
Aspiring police officer Makoto is currently paying his dues at the Kabukicho police substation. Bustling Kabukicho is no walk in the park, especially with customer-luring Ren. Makoto struggles to stay professional in the face of this hooligan. After a drunken night, he awakens to a pleasant, but confusing, surprise from Ren.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Kamiyama-san no Kamibukuro no Naka ni wa
title_japanese: 紙山さんの紙袋の中には
synopsis:
On Namito Kominato's first day of high school, he fantasizes about making friends and walking home with a girl. Luckily, he's seated behind a gorgeous girl in class! She's tall, strong...constantly dripping with sweat...and...she wears a paper bag over her head?!

Meet Samidare Kamiyama, a kind but shy student with severe social anxiety. Though Kamiyama couldn't talk her way out of a wet paper bag (literally—it's hard to breathe under there), Namito gets her to open up. The pair become fast friends, and soon enough, the outgoing, uniform-obsessed class representative is joining in. Together, they decide to found the "Conversation Club" to help Kamiyama participate in high school life. The club needs four members to become official, and there just so happens to be the perfect addition: a student who can only talk to a cardboard cutout of a magical girl!

When given a welcoming space to be themselves, even social outcasts can flourish. Let the first meeting of the Conversation Club comme

title: Kizuitara Kiss shiteta: Rinjin no Ninki Haiyuu to Himitsu no Kankei...?
title_english: Before I Knew It, We Were Kissing: The Famous Actor Next Door and Our Secret Relationship
title_japanese: 気づいたらキスしてた-隣人の人気俳優と秘密の関係…？-
synopsis:
Izumi Yasaka comes home one day dead-tired from work and is ready for a beer. That's when she receives a package from her family. It's vegetables. Lots of them. Unable to eat all of them by herself, she goes to ask the neighbor if he wants any. When she rings the doorbell, a really handsome guy answers the door... but he seems to be very nervous for some reason. But, after talking to him, they hit it off and have a few drinks together, which leads to something else.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Hana naru Mono
synopsis:
A beautiful dog has thrown the imperial palace into chaos. As the Heian period nears its end, Takasaki—whose lowly beginnings as the mere third son of a warrior family put him at a disadvantage in a society obsessed with rank and titles—has managed to climb the social ladder by spending the night with many a powerful man. Eventually Takasaki even becomes a favorite of the retired emperor himself. Stares of fear and envy have followed the gorgeous upstart at every turn, yet behind the gaze of Tomozane, the son of a powerful noble, lies a calm warmth, which makes Takasaki uncomfortable. But something happens that will change their relationship forever...

(Source: Renta!)

title: Underdog ni Ai no Te wo
title_japanese: 嘘吐き達〈アンダードッグ〉に愛の手を
synopsis:
Volleyball teammates Yuichi and Ryo were unstoppable on the court until a career-breaking injury forces Yuichi to walk away from it all. Years after, he’s a perfectly ordinary salaryman living a perfectly normal life—but what happens when he and Ryo meet again?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Soujou Fly Again
synopsis:
Yoshiyuki Kikusawa is a talented mechanic at JAW. He's kind but stern when it comes to training his juniors, and he's loved by his co-workers, who call him "Yoshi." Because he's open about his sexuality, people often assume he's had many partners, but he's strict in not letting his personal feelings affect his work and often says that airplanes are his boyfriends. But, while he's dealing with the persistent rumors about him, he bumps into Gaku Maizuru, a young marshal. Even though Yoshi thinks Gaku is distant because he's like him, he soon realizes that Gaku is friendly and they finally end up close-literally face-to-face...!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Soutai Flight Sign
synopsis:
Japan Airways mechanic Daiki Iwatobi's scars from getting dumped on Christmas are still fresh. Now his extremely busy schedule and the elite, hotshot pilots are rubbing salt in his wounds! Wondering what he did to deserve such torture, Daiki vents his frustration on the handsomest pilot his age, Rihito Takagami. With Rihito usually in the sky and Daiki on the ground, the two shouldn't cross paths often, if at all... But it happens in the cafeteria, in the hanger, all over the place. Bigger trials and tribulations await the two who more or less clash on sight...!

(Source: Renta!)

Included one-shot: Osewa ni Narimasu, Nararemasu.

title: Santa Claus wo Koroshita. Soshite, Kiss wo Shita.
title_english: We Killed Santa Claus and Then Kissed
title_japanese: サンタクロースを殺した。そして、キスをした。
synopsis:
To erase Christmas, I decided to become the girl's lover. It all began in early December, when the holy night was just around the corner and the city started to become cheerful. Dumped by my seniors, I was trembling with irresistible irritation and sadness as I watched the beautifully shining light (illuminations) in front of the station. I wished that "Christmas" would just disappear already... And suddenly, a girl who seemed to be a high school student appeared in front of me.

"You can do it. You can make 'Christmas' disappear."

The notebook that she held seemed to be able to "to grant an unwanted wish." But I needed to like Christmas first before she could erase it with the power of her notebook. That was why...

"With me, please become a pseudo-lover with me."

This is a story to end love, starting with a strange relationship between me and a girl.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

A training school where elite psychics gather. Everything is judged there by the result of the game. Jin, a boy who entered the school despite being incompetent for a certain purpose, is actually the strongest scammer. The ultimate deception entertainment made up of fraud and tactics.

(Source: Dengeki Wiki)

title_japanese: マッド・バレット・アンダーグラウンド
synopsis:
"Hey, Ralph. By the way, what's your job today, permission to kill?"

"Government official. Please kill them all for love and justice."

Oops, don't get me wrong? I and Liza are good bounty hunters who kill the crap for their clients in the tolerant crime district of Iredda, which tolerates both murder and meds. Well, it doesn't matter if the client is a good guy or a bad guy. The most important thing is money. What was given to us was a tiny job of catching a girl. However, it was also transformed into a crazy "pleasant kidnapping drama" by the attack of the devil's different ability "Silver Master."

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

(Source: WWWave Corporation)

synopsis:
"You're this turned on when I've hardly touched you yet? What a naughty boy..."

Kaoru is a tough guy with a secret he can't reveal to anyone: after getting chased down by the police... he likes to jack off!! But how could he possibly tell anyone about a fetish like that!? It's a secret he can never allow to get out. After Kaoru and his friend get involved in another police chase, his arousal demands his attention in the park. Just as he's about to masturbate... a police officer appears...!! When a cop catches Kaoru exposed, is his darkest fantasy going to become real...!!?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Happy End wa Goissho ni
title_japanese: ハッピーエンドはご一緒に
synopsis:
Company-man Sakuraba makes himself cute lunches every day, reads girls' comics, and generally loves all things feminine. Sakuraba is speechless when he meets his favorite manga artist, Megumi Nono, at a book signing... because it turns out that his idol is actually his neighbor! He goes to visit him a few days later, only to have Megumi collapse, leaving Sakuraba to care for him. And that's how he becomes friends with his neighbor and idol...! Feminine top Sakuraba sometimes shows remarkable tolerance towards his tough bottom, who suddenly comes over adorably shy. This heartwarming yaoi manga from noted new star Chito Hanakawa will ruffle your feathers with cuteness!!

(Source: Renta!)

title_japanese: 狡猾×純情ラブシッター

title: Naka ga Warusugiru Osananajimi ga, Ore ga 5-nen Ijou Hamatteiru FPS Game no Friend Datta Ken ni Tsuite.
title_japanese: 仲が悪すぎる幼馴染が、俺が5年以上ハマっているFPSゲームのフレンドだった件について。
synopsis:
"If I become stronger than you, Shintaro, you'll stay with me forever, right?"

I'm the world's number-one ranked player in that popular FPS game. I'm aiming to become a pro gamer and wanted to compete in the national tournament... My accomplice, the world's number-two ranked 2N, turns out to be my childhood friend Natsuki. A big-tiddy streamer and a handsome, blue-eyed, thoroughbred homosexual also join in, forming a team with too many quirks.

FPS love-comedy about shooting and being shot at with a childhood friend who's a sharp-tongued tsundere.

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)

title: Tenkaichi: Nihon Saikyou Bugeisha Ketteisen
title_english: Tenkaichi: The Greatest Warrior Under the Rising Sun
title_japanese: テンカイチ 日本最強武芸者決定戦
synopsis:
This is not history as we know it. The year is 1600. Ten years have passed since Oda Nobunaga unified the whole of Japan. When Nobunaga realizes he is nearing the end of his life, he announces that he will hand over the reins of power to whoever brings him the strongest warrior. The generals, whose dreams of conquering the country had been crushed, put up their own strongest warriors and aim to become the king of the country!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Love All Apartment
title_japanese: ラブオール・アパートメント

title: Nidoto Jidori Okutte Yannai!
title_english: I'll Never Send a Selfie Again!
title_japanese: 二度と自撮り送ってやんない！
synopsis:
Himari has never been one to abandon a friend in need, so when her friend Eisuke asks her for a selfie so he can use it as an art reference, how can she refuse? Even if it is...embarrassing... But what's MORE embarrassing is the kind of art he ends up drawing! But he needs her help, and Himari just can't say no, no matter how suggestive the poses get!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Colorful
synopsis:
"Congratulations, you've won the lottery!" shouts the angel Prapura to a formless soul. The soul hasn't been kicked out of the cycle of rebirth just yet—he's been given a second chance. He must recall the biggest mistake of his past life while on "homestay" in the body of fourteen-year-old Makoto Kobayashi, who has just committed suicide. It looks like Makoto doesn't have a single friend, and his family don't seem to care about him at all. But as the soul begins to live Makoto's life on his own terms, he grows closer to the family and the people around him, and sees their true colors more clearly, shedding light on Makoto's misunderstandings.

(Source: Counterpoint)

title: Boukoku no Marguerite
title_english: Princess Marguerite of the Ruined Country
synopsis:
One day Marguerite, a young princess of the kingdom of Lunaria, rushes recklessly into the forest, where she is kidnapped by a wolf. Later, a warrior named Christoph, from the village of Elbe and a childless father, saves her life. From that moment Marguerite begins to live with Christoph, from whom she is raised as a boy and takes the name of Nicola. The story starts ten years later, with Nicola and two of his friends as protagonists.

(Source: MU)

title: Tsurumaki Machi Natsu Jikan
title_japanese: つるまき町 夏時間
synopsis:
On the last day of school, Mitsuru, a primary school student who has the power to talk to plants waters a forgotten water hyacinth in his classroom. Since then, strange incidents start occurring in the town of Tsurumaki.

A story of summer vacation in a nostalgic and warm world, drawn by a genius.

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Kirameku Koi wa Isekai de
synopsis:
Himari is a cheerful high school girl who has a childhood friend named Kou. As they grew older, Kou became colder and before she knew it, they have grown distant from each other. One day, Himari saw Kou in front of a torii gate and when she went after him through the torii entrance, she found herself in another world instead! She soon got into trouble but was saved thanks to the usually unfriendly and cold Kou putting his life on the line for her.

"I promise to protect you."

Will Himari be able to get back to her own world? And just what is the secret that Kou is keeping from her?

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Painter of the Night
synopsis:
Baek Na-kyum is a young man with a single talent: painting explicit depictions of men caught in the throes of passion. Having published his pornographic art under a pseudonym for several years, Na-kyum has ultimately decided to quit painting for good. That is, until the appearance of Yoon Seungho—a nobleman who abuses his authority to force Na-kyum to return to his illicit hobby.

Seungho, notorious for his sodomizing ways and insatiable lust, coerces Na-kyum to illustrate his regular private affairs. Although he initially tries to resist, Seungho's indecent nights of thrusting men into the very depths of pleasure awakens something in Na-kyum. However, Yoon Seungho's side is a dangerous place to be, and Na-kyum quickly finds himself tangled in a web of desire and jealousy—with many a looming threat hoping to devour him.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Mukuchi na Omoi wa Koi to Naru
title_japanese: 無口な想いは恋となる

title: Tokyo Kettou Kanjousen
synopsis:
The Tokyo Duel system was first introduced to support Japan’s postwar development. It is a bloody battle over the stations along the Yamanote Line, the lifeline of Tokyo. The long stalemate is about to be broken with the construction of Takanawa Gateway Station. Now, Koinosuke Yasuda is throwing himself into the fray to protect his district of Kanda...

(Source: Coamix)

title: Ren Jiang
synopsis:
Cheng Shan, a mysterious one-armed young man, travels around the world with his companion, a young girl named Ming Cai, in search of a miraculous medicine, the "Faded Dragon Scale." The theft of the black umbrella from the imperial palace resulted in heavy sins. Due to past relations to the black umbrella, Cheng Shan and Ming Cai decide to search for the black umbrella and recover it. However, after several twists and turns where their lives were in danger, they find that the matter is not as simple as they thought.

Will Cheng Shan finally be able to unravel all mysteries and distinguish good from evil? Will he be able to escape unscathed from the lethal threats and dangers lurking in every corner, and eventually find the Faded Dragon Scale? dragon? Or, is there a greater conspiracy behind this? In this life, he is destined to be unable to hide and have no other option but to fight with his life because he is...the Craftsman.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: Yamanai Fukou no Owarasekata
title_english: How to Stop the Never Ending Unhappiness
title_japanese: やまない不幸の終わらせ方
synopsis:
After many years, Takayuki Udou has finally fulfilled his desperate unrequited love and began a relationship with Seiji Kiyotake. Now as a working member of society his only goal is to protect this love. However, when Udou visits Kiyotake's parents' house he witnesses the reality of what stands in the way of their love. What future will they choose?

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Risou no Koibito Himemiya-kun
title_japanese: 理想の恋人 姫宮くん
synopsis:
Akihito is a diligent local masseur who is loved by his regular elderly customers. He has but a simple dream, to find a person of his type: A black-haired beauty. When his co-workers learn about it, they tease him, telling him to have realistic standards on finding a girlfriend. But the thing is, Akihito's co-workers don't have an idea that Akihito isn't looking for the ideal girl but the ideal man. In short, he's gay. Enter Kei Himemiya, the new trainee. The first time Akihito laid his eyes on Kei, Kei totally has everything Akihito is looking for in an ideal partner that it's almost a miracle. And when the two got closer and slept together, Akihito is over the moon for Kei. Is this the start of a blossoming love life for Akihito, or is Kei not that ideal as he seems?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: DT to Koigokoro wa Kiku Mimi Motanai.
title_english: Love and Virginity Turn a Deaf Ear
title_japanese: DTと恋心は聞く耳持たない。
synopsis:
Shiro used to be a cafe worker, and Ko was one of his regular customers whom he had a bit of a crush on, but an unfortunate accident leaves the cafe he works at burnt to the ground. With the owners being too old to do anything to rebuild the cafe, they entrusted the land to Shiro, who had always thought of opening his own shop. To help with finances, Ko invites Shiro to work with him at the host club he works and even offers Shiro to live with him. Considering the circumstances, Shiro agrees. But it seems that working and living with Ko is more complicated than what Shiro expected. Ko seemed to be keen at harassing and making a manservant of Shiro any chance he gets, and Shiro's virgin self could only take so much. But even with all the harassment, Shiro just finds himself falling even deeper for Ko. Will Shiro be able to survive his first love?

(Source: Torico)

title: Masumura-ban Miyazawa Kenji Douwashuu: Cairo Danchou/Horakuma Gakkou wo Sotsugyou shita Sannin
title_japanese: ますむら版 宮沢賢治童話集 カイロ団長／洞熊〈ほらくま〉学校を卒業した三人
synopsis:

2. Horakuma Gakkou wo Sotsugyou shita Sannin

title: Yakuza ga Tensei shitara Mori Ranmaru Datta Ken
title_english: That Time a Gangster Was Reincarnated into a Historical Era: Nobunaga Wants to Make Me His Page!?
title_japanese: ヤクザが転生したら森蘭丸だった件
synopsis:
Young mafia boss Hajime thought he was shot and killed by his enemies... Until he snapped into the world of the Warring States period! When the one and only great Nobunaga Oda takes a liking to him, Nobunaga renames him Ranmaru Mori for some reason, but that isn't Hajime's biggest shock. Nobunaga fondles him all over, kisses his neck, and forces himself into Hajime's untouched parts. Frustrated as he is with his domination, Hajime can't stop moaning. Turned into a Nobunaga's subordinate, what will become of Hajime?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Gotou-san wa Furimukasetai!
title_japanese: 後藤さんは振り向かせたい！
synopsis:
Gotou, the most beautiful girl in school, keeps messing with Maeda, the boy sitting in front of her. She has a secret crush on him, but she cannot clearly convey her intentions to Maeda, who has no self-confidence. What will be the outcome of Gotou's unwavering love?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Fushi to Batsu
synopsis:
A young man burdened with a heavy secret finds himself trapped, broke and alone, in a love hotel. As he falls deeper into despair, an echo of his past haunts him—"Live on so you can atone..." Meanwhile, chaos erupts on the streets as grotesque figures begin to appear all around the city.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: David
synopsis:
At a pig farm in the rural town of Vernier, U.S.A., farmer James gifts his son George a piglet, who he names David. Soon after, David begins to speak like a human. David rejects that he is a pig and instead wants to be recognized as a human being, but James hides his existence from the world. Eventually, David escapes the farm goes out into the world with George to be recognized as a human, but David's presence shakes up the city and the entire continent of America. Will David be able to cross the line between animal and human and be recognized as a person?

(Source: Prunsoop, translated)

title: Erita
synopsis:
The Earth has been ruined by human greed and left covered in a strange substance. The only human being left is Erita, a six-year-old child; Erita is humanity, and humanity is Erita. Gaon, an artificial intelligence with the special order to "always put Erita first" constantly sends rescue messages into space to ask for Erita's salvation from aliens, who Gaon believes are better than humanity.

But will the message reach them? Can Gaon keep Erita safe on a mutant monster-infested Earth? In the face of humanity's greatest crisis, Gaon must choose between the Erita of today and the Erita of tomorrow.

(Source: Prunsoop, translated)

title: Necromancer
synopsis:
Death is usually the end. But for Erik, who finds himself revived after a fatal betrayal, it's just the beginning. Together with Moll, the mysterious girl who brought him back from the dead, the two embark on a journey seeking revenge and salvation.

(Source: Manta)

title: Trauma Center: Golden Hour
synopsis:
Patients who can be potentially saved die every day. And to prevent that, a doctor takes a stand. A doctor, with a strong sense of duty and responsibility. synopsis:

Mami wants to know why witch numbers are declining in every city save one. In Kamihama City, the witch population is greater and stronger than ever, not to mention there's a mysterious magical presence unlike anything Mami has encountered before...!

title: Aiin Honey Melt
synopsis:
Oomori works in product development for a coffee store chain, and he finds himself constantly butting heads with his colleague in Marketing, Tsutsumi. Oomori suspects that the stoic Tsutsumi is particularly harsh towards him, and he spends his days complaining about this situation to his co-workers. One day, as he's struggling to develop a new drink, Oomori finds a mysterious jar of honey, which he uses to make a latte. It tastes great and just might get approved for development, so he immediately sends it in for tasting. But, for some reason, when Tsutsumi drinks it, Oomori starts to hear the other man's thoughts! As it turns out, Tsutsumi's worried that he might be making Oomori hate him...!?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Tategami ni I Love You

synopsis:
At a high school full of delinquents, Leo Shishiyama, a boy who looked cute but was the best fighter, is puzzled. Takeru Kurosawa, who had constantly challenging Leo to fights that ended up in a draw, has sent him an eighth challenge letter. Leo likes winning, but he doesn't particularly like fighting, and enjoys gorging on strawberry rice cakes, his favorite snack, much more. He tries to ignore Takeru, but bumps into his beautiful little sister on the street, who shows him kindness. If he can beat Takeru, maybe he can make a move on her! Leo faces Takeru, but who comes out victorious...?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Unknown Code
synopsis:
Alien invasions come in all shapes and sizes. This time, the Earth is under attack by "Unknown Codes" that infiltrate digital devices to eviscerate the human race. The only known way to counter these codes is to play their own game. An awkward mesh of men with different motives are recruited to fight. How is everything going to end?
