synopsis:
Soushi Sakura is said to be the most handsome and brilliant student in the school. Yuria Saionji is a mysterious beautiful girl who is known as the reincarnation of an angel. They are beautiful and popular, but on the inside they are actually unpopular idiots with terrible communication skills. One day, they meet in a place where they can’t see each other, and without recognizing each other, they grow closer in this gag comedy of misunderstandings.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Minna Hajimete no Kuse ni
title_japanese: みんなはじめての癖に
synopsis:
After Tomoru is dumped by his girlfriend yet again, he starts thinking that something is uniquely wrong with him. Surprised by the sudden downfall of his mood, Naru and Anji, inseparable twins who rarely talk to anybody besides each other, try to cheer Tomoru up. Tomoru's main concern is that he can't satisfy, nor be satisfied by, his partner when they get intimate. Can Naru and Anji help Tomoru overcome his slump? He's about to find out how inseparable these two really are.

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Shoujo-tachi no Kizuato ni Kuchizuke wo
title_english: Kiss the Scars of the Girls
title_japanese: 少女たちの痕にくちづけを
synopsis:
"I'm sure someday, I'll get you to look my way." Danger and uncertainty are common for a young vampire, which is why Emille will be assigned a "Big Sister" on her fourteenth birthday, like all the girls at her school. Deep within a secluded forest, her sister will teach her how to hunt and safely feed on humans. Learning to rely on each other for survival cultivates a deep relationship comparable to that between family-but does theirs have the potential to evolve into something more?"

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Shachou Hasumi You Taiho Sunzen!
title_english: CEO Yoh Hasumi Is About to Be Arrested!
title_japanese: 社長蓮実瑶 逮捕寸前!
synopsis:
Cocoon Continental Tokyo is a first class hotel. Ryousuke is a proud top of 28 years who works as a bellhop. He has bedded many men... and never had a regret. He is happy with his job since he can appreciate the men he fancies from all over the world, but that all changes when, one day, he winds up injuring You, the most infamous man in Japan at the moment. He finds himself in a position where he can't refuse You anything, but what will he do when You tells him he wants to get off inside him...!? A straight ideal man x a bellhop top. A battle of love with the pride of an executive employee of the hotel on the line!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Ura Baito: Toubou Kinshi
synopsis:
"Ura Baito," also known as a shady part-time job, is a job that pays very well. The price you pay is your life. Yume Kokuryo and Nagomi Shirahama are seeking a large sum of money for some reason. To that end, they casually dive into various shady part-time jobs.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Cha no Namida: Larmes de thé
Romantic ja Mono Tarinai
title_english: I Need More Than Just Romance
title_japanese: ロマンチックじゃモノ足りない
synopsis:
Kousuke and Shuuji have been dating for three months now, but they haven't even kissed each other yet. All they do is meet up after work and have dinner accompanied by a boring conversation. They also follow the same quiet routine on the weekends. Since Shuuji is sick of this boring relationship, he prepares for their first time together by loosening himself up, and it turns out to be a lot more pleasurable than he expected and he winds up getting hooked on it... This comedic love story full of happiness and lust is about these two lovey-dovey guys who find their relationship challenged when Shuuji's older brother shows up.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Super Darling-sama to Super Darling-kun
title_japanese: スパダリさまとスパダリくん
synopsis:
Takakura is a gentle, kind internist who is adored by the patients, but he's secretly troubled by his erectile dysfunction. Surgeon Date, his rival from medical school time, is capable but arrogant, and undisciplined in relationships. When he spent one night with Date in a one-bed nap room, a strange phenomenon happened to Takakura's lower body... But he doesn't want to admit the reason was because he was embraced by Date?!!

A bickering love story between doctors who know everything about a man's body.

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Light of My Life
title_japanese: ライトオブマイライフ
synopsis:
Back in high school, best friends Aki and Minagi were inseparable. Aki dreamed of becoming a professional football player, while Minagi was seen as a "genius" who was eager to chase his dream of working in medicine. Years later, Aki has taken over his grandfather's hair salon, and Minagi set his interest in medicine aside to work in a host club. Despite the growing tension between them following their high school fallout, Minagi shows up at Aki's apartment one day asking for a place to stay. Can the two men confront their past in order to repair their future?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Shiba wa Kyou mo Baka!
synopsis:
Maybe I was confessed to by my childhood friend?! An energetic and foolish high school boy, Shiba isn't sure if he was confessed to by his childhood friend Ryou. To find out if he can also like boys, Shiba offers to give Ryou a massage. While Shiba comes to the conclusion that he can date Ryou, Ryou rejects him?!

(Source: MU)

title: Yurufuwa-kun ni wa Wake ga Aru
title_japanese: ゆるふわくんにはワケがある

title: Rokudenashi to Ore
synopsis:
Kitakata met Misato, who was his classmate, on the street coincidentally. He becomes friendly with him and ends up living with him. Misato is a novelist who is in a slump currently, and Kitakata promises him that he will have sex with him if Misato publishes a new novel. As a result, Misato tries to do his best...?!

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

Included one-shot: Mitsuiro Pancake

title: Love & Hate
synopsis:
Ichigo was once a popular detective that used his good looks as a weapon. However, now that he's completely worn out, he is in needy circumstances... A man named Kuki Otohide then requests his services. Ichigo is enthusiastic about the reward, since it's been a while for him. Unfortunately, he fails, after all, his client had to help him out. However, there was something Kuki wanted to check with Ichigo, so he suddenly pressed him for... what?!

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

title: Derail
synopsis:
Best friends Hikaru and Haru have always been close enough. Close enough to be each other's number one. Close enough to live together and sleep in the same bed. When Hikaru brings someone over, Haru decides he's no longer content with "close enough." But is he the only one?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Jinmyaku Cheat de Hajimeru Hitomakase Eiyuu-tan
title_japanese: 人脈チートで始める人任せ英雄譚

title: Gal ga Rakugoka ni Koishitara
title_english: When Gyaru Falls in Love with a Rakugoka
title_japanese: ギャルが落語家に恋したら
synopsis: What happens when a gyaru falls in love with an up-and-coming handsome rakugo storyteller? A 4-koma exploration of the collision of worlds!

title: Worst Gaiden: Saburoku Santa - Na mo Naki Karasu-tachi
title_japanese: WORST外伝 サブロクサンタ 名もなきカラスたち
synopsis:
The manga will depict the one-year gap in the story when Harumichi Bouya leaves Suzuran Boys High School until Hana Tsukishima arrives at Toaru City.

(Source: ANN)

title: Michimichi naru Mama ni
synopsis:
Takeda fulfilled his childhood dream of becoming a manga artist while Osanai gave up on drawing and left his home. In high school the two of them were like lovers, but Osanai betrayed Takeda who was, consequently, severely bullied. Years later, the two of them meet again during their class reunion...

(Source: Akaneshinsha, translated)

title: Gedou Tenisha no Harem Dungeon Seisakuki
title_japanese: 外道転移者のハーレムダンジョン製作記
synopsis:
While all of his classmate were transported to another world as heroes, for some reason he was left out as the dungeon master... and he, Satoshi Shinta, became the world's enemy. As the enemy of humankind, in order to survive and live a pleasant life in another world, he had a big choice to make... Through devilish methods, make his enemies fall, and strengthen his dungeon!! To violate his enemies or kill them, the curtain raises on (male) Satoshi Shinta's devilish dungeon management!!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Shimotsuki-san wa Mob ga Suki
title_english: She is in Love with the Mob!
title_japanese: 霜月さんはモブが好き
synopsis:
Only you are special.

After school, Koutarou Nakayama returns to school to pick up something he forgot and finds Shiho Shimotsuki asleep in an empty classroom. Shiho is rumored to be Ryouma Ryuuzaki's crush, a popular boy who has formed a harem in his class, but she is always expressionless and no one has ever seen her smile.

But now, her fair skin is holding Koutarou's hand...?! The "secret relationship" between the heroine and the mob begins!

(Source: Micro Magazine-sha, translated)

title: Worst Gaiden: Guriko
synopsis:
Before Guriko Hanaki reluctantly reigned supreme over Toarushi, he lived in Fukuoka. This is the story about his time kicking ass and taking names in middle school there.

(Source: MU)

title: Worst Gaiden: Dokuro
synopsis:
A story that reveals how a pre-6th Gen Head Tesshou Kawachi first encounters and then joins The Front of Armament, and also meets characters like Shougo Murata.

(Source: MU)

title: Debu to Love to Ayamachi to!
synopsis:
"This is the punishment for a fat, ugly girl like me falling in love with someone as beautiful as you..." Yumeko had a mountain of complexes about herself. Then, a terrible accident befalls her. Though somehow saved from the brink of death, Yumeko wakes up a completely different person. "This is...me...?! I'm SO cute!!" Those around her can't hide their surprise and wonderment at this 180°change... But, Yumeko's new hyper-positive attitude starts to change her surroundings, too. Worries and complexes can affect anyone, and Yumeko will chop right through those of her various supporting characters!! In love, work, friendship... And an attempted murder case?! This frenzied romantic comedy will leave you bubbling with energy!

(Source: Solmare Publishing)

title: Tonari no Megane Ouji to Yankee to!
title_japanese: となりのメガネ王子とヤンキーと!

title: Ami-chan no Nikki
synopsis:
"On June X, we changed our uniform to short sleeves."

Ami is a beautiful girl who is looked back at by both boys and girls. She is the most beautiful girl in Tsubaki High School, but she has a secret that she can't tell anyone. That's because this diary is...

(Source: Galette Works, translated)

title: Nanbun no Ichi kano Junjou na Kanjou
title_japanese: 何分の一かの純情な感情

title: Ore no Imouto ga Konnani Kawaii Wake ga Nai: Kuroneko If
title_japanese: 俺の妹がこんなに可愛いわけがない 黒猫if
synopsis: A spinoff of Ore no Imouto ga Konnani Kawaii Wake ga Nai following Kuroneko's route.

title: Ashita, Kimi no Mono ni Shite
title_japanese: 明日、きみのものにして
synopsis:
Yuki is a quiet, average boy who falls head over heels for the confident and cool Hayato in his new high school class. The two hit it off with an easygoing friendship, but when Yuki realizes that a female classmate has a crush on his friend, he tries to put some distance between them. As his feelings come to a head, he finally confesses to Hayato... who confesses right back!

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Shishunki Danshi wa Douka shiteiru.
title_japanese: 思春期男子はどうかしている。

title: Shikabane to Hanayome
synopsis:
They were the only two brothers in a sprawling family mansion. At the end of a gruesome battle for succession, the younger brother, now head of the family, held a solemn wedding. The bride's face remained hidden from everyone behind a thick veil, and she became rumored as "the faceless wife." But in the bridal chamber on their wedding night, the face revealed is that of his elder brother, who was supposed to be dead.

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Mijuku na Papa wa Share House de Koi wo Shiru
title_japanese: 未熟なパパはシェアハウスで恋を知る
synopsis:
Shiki Kagino, 35 years old, is free-spirited. There's no shortage of men in his life. However, due to the sudden death of his sister, he now has to temporarily look after his nephew. In order to get help raising the child, he moved into a share house attached to a kindergarten, where he meets a young inspiring actor named Natsume Takaishi.

(Source: MU)

title: Kimi wa Beta
synopsis:
Asahi (Beta) and Seiya (Alpha) are childhood friends who grew up together. The spring they began high school, their parents decide to marry each other. Although, Asahi is surprised, he begins to accept being by Seiya's side as a family member. However, one day he ends up spraying on himself a fragrance that contains the smell of Omega pheromones...!?

(Source: MU)

title: Maiasa 8-ji ni, 3-ryoume de
synopsis:
1. Trouble Train
2. Himitsu Settai (Behind Closed Doors)
3. Hentai Seitai! Aoyama-sensei (Dr. Aoyama, Perverted Therapist)
4. Ore no Mousou wa Uragaeru (My Visions Betray Me)
5. Karera no Jijou (Their Situation)
6. Sonogo no Futari

title: My Only Doggy
title_japanese: マイ オンリー ドギー
synopsis:
Kobayashi may not know how to deal with people, but he does know how to sell sweets; and as the best salesman in sweets company Inujirushi, his talent could be the biggest help to their slowly dying pet food subsidiary. He may have a childhood fear of dogs, but that's definitely not going to get in the way of his work...right?!

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

Included one-shot: With My Doggy

title: Shishi to Myoujou
synopsis:
Shishio who was an omega living in the low class of society was picked up by Masami, an alpha who gives him a place in the yakuza society. "I want to become your mate, Masami." He used to live every day fighting his strong omega instincts, but...?!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Rhapsody in Red
title_japanese: ラプソディ・イン・レッド
synopsis: A story about a boy who decides to play piano to express himself.

title: Red Blue
synopsis: A story about the sullen Aoba Suzuki and the rising star Kenshin Akasawa making their way into the world of MMA fighting.

title: Hatsujou Ookami-kun Ai wo Sakebu
title_japanese: 発情オオカミ君愛を叫ぶ
synopsis:
1. Harapeko Ookami-kun no Baai
2. Yatoware Risukko no Kunou
3. Oazuke Ookami-kun to Risukko no Kakugo
4. Yuuryou Bukken Arimasu
5-6. Shiawase no Tsubo
7. Yuuryou Bukken nite

title: Rikai Dekinai Kare to no Koto
title_english: What I Don't Understand About Him
title_japanese: 理解できない彼との事
synopsis:
1-3. Rikai Dekinai Kare to no Koto
4. Cute de Erotic na Ossan to no Koto
5-6. Oni ga Miteiru
7. Oni ga Miteiru Sonogo
8. Date

title: Iu Koto Kiite, Sensei
synopsis:
Takano is the tutor to Iori, the son of a wealthy family. He has multiple part-time jobs but barely has any money to his name. While tutoring Iori was difficult due to the student's stubbornness, Takano is determined to have Iori open up to him, even with little progress. During one of his study sessions with Iori, Takano's landlord makes a call and threatens to evict Takano if he doesn't pay up soon. Takano is at his wits end on how to find a job to earn more money. Coincidentally, Iori overhears the conversation, and asks Takano if he needs money, to which Takano embarrassingly admits that he does and that he is willing to do anything. To his surprise, Iori suddenly throws money at him and says he will give Takano the money he needs as long as Takano does what Iori says—the first command being for Takano to masturbate in front of him.

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Project Sekai Colorful Stage! feat. Hatsune Miku: Comic Anthology
title_japanese: プロジェクトセカイ カラフルステージ! feat.初音ミク コミックアンソロジー
synopsis: An anthology of stories set in the world of Sega and Colorful Palette's game Project Sekai Colorful Stage! feat. Hatsune Miku, released for iOS and Android on September 30, 2020.

title: "Jimi de Tsumaranai" to Suterareta node, Jimichi ni Renkinjutsushi wo Mezashimasu!: Kenjitsu Reijou wa Konyaku Hakigo ni Shiawase ni Naru
title_japanese: 「地味でつまらない」と捨てられたので、地道に錬金術師を目指します!〜堅実令嬢は婚約破棄後に幸せになる〜

title: Kuroe to Mesu no Sono
title_english: Kuroe and the Garden of Feminine Pleasures
synopsis:
Sonogi, an employee at the host club "Eden," is in the biggest crisis of his life. He's woken up with female parts in addition to his male ones! After hearing that the number one host at the club, Kuroe, with his beautiful face, baritone voice, and relentlessly womanizing nature, went to med school, Sonogi tries confiding to him in private. Not only does Kuroe wildly misunderstand him, he's weirdly intrigued. Even after hearing Sonogi's story, he's still keen to "study" up on what's happening inside Sonogi's pants! A scary-faced, lovable psychopath toys with a vulnerable, shaved, and untouched new "girl" in this gender-bending romance!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Snow White no Doku ni Shimu
title_japanese: スノーホワイトの毒に染む
synopsis:
There's a strikingly beautiful student in Takumi's seminar class: Yukiya Mimori, one of the famously beautiful fraternal Mimori twins. When Takumi ends up as Yukiya's partner for their research presentation and tries speaking to him, he discovers that Yukiya is unexpectedly easy to talk to. Takumi finds himself caring about Yukiya and wanting to close the distance between them. However, Takumi can't help but feel uneasy when Yukiya, cheeks flushing, casually talks about his over-possessive crush...

(Source: Renta!)

title: Nurse Station
title_japanese: ナース・ステーション

title: Mangaka, Parkinson-byou ni Naru.
title_japanese: 漫画家、パーキンソン病になる。
synopsis:
In 2001, the manga artist Kyouko Shimazu began to experience uncontrollable shaking in her right hand, then throughout the right side of her body. The doctors she visited told her to relax and that everything was fine. She quit drawing manga and got lots of sleep, but the symptoms only worsened. Increasingly nervous, she went "doctor shopping" for seven years, trying to find out what her problem was. She finally discovered that she has Parkinson's disease, a long-term neurodegenerative disorder.

(Source: ANN)

title: Ryuuou no Kagehime
synopsis:
"Ever since that night, I've lived only to kill you."

Kohaku was the lone survivor from her hometown, which was sunk and destroyed by the kingdom's guardian water dragon. She entered the Imperial Place under the guise of a lady-in-waiting, plotting to take revenge on Prince Miaki, who was supposed to be the only person who could control the dragon.

However, he seemed nothing like she imagined. And when he caught her, he unexpectedly asked her, "Why don't you pretend to be my consort instead?"

This begins their thrilling contract marriage, to uncover the plot involving the succession to the throne!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Ao wo Sagasu Bokura: Oosora Akira Sakuhinshuu
title_japanese: 大宙晃作品集「青を探す僕ら」
synopsis:
1. Ao wo Sagasu Bokura
2. Kimi to Tsunagu 100-nenme no Monogatari
3. Funade no Uta
4. Sora Girl Ten

title: Boku ga Tsumugu Kimi no Kotonoha
title_japanese: ぼくが紡ぐ君のコトノハ

title: Bitch na Neko wa Dokusenyoku ni Aragaenai
title_english: The Loose Cat Can't Resist Possessiveness
title_japanese: ビッチな猫は独占欲に抗えない
synopsis:
Kyosuke never thought that he'd ever be content with just one person, but now that he has Fujishima in his heart and on his bed, suddenly everything is different. From soft kisses to sharing spare keys, every first between the newly-minted lovers is uncharted territory, but with both their busy schedules it's been hard to get some time just to themselves. Is this the biggest of their problems, however, when Kyosuke gets a threatening letter in the mail?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Bitch na Neko wa Retsujou no Tsume wo Togu
title_english: The Loose Cat Sharpens Claws of Lust
title_japanese: ビッチな猫は劣情の爪を研ぐ
synopsis:
Mr. Shinzou Hiruma, playwright, actor, and spokesman of the theatre troupe "Hydra" expresses interest in the up-and-coming actor KYO. But there's a problem—Kyosuke has no repertory theater experience, and especially not in the stage combat scenes Hydra is well-known for! Can Kyosuke successfully juggle his intense training and make time for his non-celebrity boyfriend Fujishima, or will his admiration for "Mr. Shin" drive a wedge in their relationship for good?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Bitch na Neko wa Himitsu ni Shippo wo Yurasu
title_english: The Loose Cat Wags Its Tail in Secret
title_japanese: ビッチな猫は秘密に尻尾をゆらす
synopsis:
Multi-talented entertainer Kyo has finally got his big break and now can't seem to get the attention off of him. Kyosuke's busy schedule and high demand barely allow for the two lovebirds to meet, and just when they thought they finally caught some alone time, a woman shows up at Naoya's front door... with a kid! Okay, Kyosuke, let's be rational here and NOT freak out... he looks a lot like Naoya, doesn't he? Wait... is that Naoya's kid!?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Fushigi na Antique Shop: Makura Kurama Sakuhinshuu
title_english: Welcome to the Peculiar Antique Shop
title_japanese: 不思議なアンティークショップ まくらくらま作品集
synopsis:
"Welcome. What is it that you desire?"

A blue door sits at the end of a narrow alley on a dimly lit street. It seems that more customers have come to request things today at this mysterious antique shop that connects two worlds, the "Front" and the "Back." The brother and sister who run the shop accept all kinds of orders to fulfill the desires of their customers.

(Source: Pie International, translated)

title: Cover Crack
synopsis:
Maki, a gay nail technician, meets Mutsumi while running an errand for his salon. The next thing he knows, Mutsumi, who has a thing for hands, suddenly tells Maki his fingers are gorgeous, completely enchanted by his stylish nails. Intrigued, Maki asks if Mutsumi is satisfied with merely looking before shoving his fingers deep in Mutsumi's mouth... "I'm a perv with a kink for gorgeous hands."

(Source: Renta!)

Included one-shot: Omohi Someshi (Love Poetry)

title: Shoukan suru Sekai
synopsis:
When creatures, items, and even space itself can be summoned from other worlds, no one should want for anything...right? Tokoyo, a boy who was abandoned to live with the Summoned in the Fantasy District aims to become a summoner to help all his Summoned friends. When he arrives in Tokyo to attend the Summoning Academy, he's told he'll never make it by the first summoner he meets! Tokoyo realizes he has a lot left to learn...and finds a new dream: to become the bridge between humanity and the Summoned!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Metsuki Warui Ko Kawaii Ko
title_english: A Cute Girl with Nasty Look
title_japanese: 目つき悪い子かわいい子
synopsis:
Tanaka is a high school student who believes that scary girls are actually cute. He secretly wants to become friends with Mizuno-san, a delinquent who sits next to him. She has a "nasty look," creating rumors about her and making her feared by her classmates! At first, she shuns Tanaka, but gradually, she opens up to his fierce attacks. Tanaka plans to make her fit in with their class, but on the day of the school festival, a big incident breaks out.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kemono Joushi ni Jitsu wa Mitomerareteita Hanashi
title_japanese: 獣上司に実は認められていた話
synopsis:
In a world where humans are thought to be inferior to beastfolk, human office worker Saki Oki endures a constant stream of ridicule and scorn from her beastfolk colleagues and superiors. So when she gets called into the CEO's office, she's prepared for the worst—but instead of firing Saki, the CEO acknowledges her hard work and makes her his private secretary! With all eyes in the office on her, Saki struggles to get used to her new position, not to mention her boss's intimidating—yet oddly charming—aura...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Stalker Kishi no Seijitsuna Kyuukon
title_japanese: ストーカー騎士の誠実な求婚

title: Stalker Kishi no Seijitsu na Kyuukon
title_japanese: ストーカー騎士の誠実な求婚

title: Ore no Aoharu ga Susumanai
title_japanese: 俺のアオハルが進まない
synopsis:
Subaru and Jinnai's first springtime bore fruit in the form of them becoming lovers! However, Jinnai hasn't tried doing anything further ever since they first touched each other at Subaru's house. Subaru now found himself worrying about this especially since the shoujo mangas that he makes his bible don't show anything beyond kissing between lovers...

Then one day, the two got into the hottest mood they've ever been in before but then Subaru, in his nervousness, bluntly said to Jinnai with a smile, "If it's you, I'm sure you can do it smoothly and well, right?"

(Source: MU)

title: Oshibana!
synopsis: A romantic comedy centered around the "school prince," bringing the tense conflict of young boys and girls to the breaking point!

title: Sotozura Danshi no Shimizu-kun
title_english: Shimizu Is Just a Tad Two-Faced
synopsis:
Awkward high school student Koharu Minami is in love with Shimizu, the popular boy in her class. So she's shocked when she inadvertently discovers that his friendly demeanor is all an act. Or is it? The more time they spend time together, the more Koharu notices the kindness hidden behind the constant teasing and disgruntled comments. Could finding out about "the real Shimizu" actually end up bringing the two closer together?!

(Source: Shodensha)

title: Goshidou no Hodo!
synopsis:
In this world, people are separated into the following genders: alphas, betas, and omegas. Yukihiko Fuyukawa is the successful, strong, and strict manager of a leading sales company. He is good looking, kind, and rich; the perfect package. Everybody swoons in his presence. On the other hand, Natsume, Fuyukawa's subordinate, is weak, sad, and disorganized. He often makes mistakes and has to make up for them by staying late in the office. One such night, Fuyukawa was waiting for his last subordinate, Natsume, to finish his tasks. Suddenly, something utterly dire comes to light: his suppressants have run out! He is in danger! And just as he thought his luck couldn't get any worse, the man he wants least in the entire world, decides to... BOND with him! We repeat: he is in danger!

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: MaOL! Shachiku OL to Isekai Saikyou Maou Irekawari Seikatsu
title_japanese: まおーえる！～社畜OLと異世界最強魔王入れ替わり生活～
synopsis:
Mao, a timid office worker, gets hit by a bicycle and switches bodies with a demon lord from another world.

(Source: MU, edited)

title: Kedamono Arashi: Hold Me Baby!
title_japanese: ケダモノアラシ -Hold me baby!-
synopsis:
In this world, there are humans without beast ears, and humans with beast ears called Bestia. After the ordeal with Sougo's father, Akira and Sougo are spending one happy day at a time with their son, Shouta. A relaxing vacation in Hawaii brings them closer than ever, and it seems Shouta will soon be a big brother! On another note, Sougo's father, Soushi, is reunited with his first love: Yuu Ohara, one of Shouta's daycare teachers. Memories between the two resurface, and they are still drawn to each other, just like the day they first met. Can the two of them finally have their happily ever after?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Kedamono Arashi: Touch Me Baby!
title_japanese: ケダモノアラシ -Touch me baby!-
synopsis:
In this world, there are humans without beast ears and humans with beast ears called Bestia. Sougo and Akira, a happily married Bestia couple, live blissfully with their ever-growing family. Things stir up a bit when Sougo's half-brother, Kazuhisa, makes his appearance and offers Akira to produce an offspring with him, much to Sougo's annoyance. What will Akira do? On another note, while the interaction between Nurse Kirigaya and Doctor Kurosaki is the same as ever, Kirigaya can't deny that Kurosaki is growing on him. Even their co-workers assumed that the two were a couple more often than not. But there are reasons why Kirigaya is reluctant to return Kurosaki's advances. Will Kirigaya be able to open his heart to Kurosaki?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Front Mission Series: Gun Hazard
title_japanese: フロントミッションシリーズ　ガンハザード
synopsis: A collection of stories revolving around the characters of Front Mission Series: Gun Hazard.

title: Isekai Neko to Fukigen na Majo
title_english: A Cat from Our World and the Forgotten Witch
title_japanese: 異世界猫と不機嫌な魔女
synopsis:
In her youth, Jeanne was a powerful witch who vanquished the evil Demon King and saved the world–but over time, the people she rescued have forgotten about her and her noble deeds. Now she is a short-spoken old woman, living by herself in a secluded forest...until she summons a cat from Earth to her home. The former city kitty is now the size of a giant, and must acclimate to this new world at Jeanne's side. Through eating the food Jeanne prepares, and offering a head for pats, can this furry feline soothe the loneliness of the forgotten witch?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Ibitte Konai Gibo to Gishi
title_english: My Stepmother and Stepsisters Aren't Wicked
title_japanese: いびってこない義母と義姉
synopsis:
Miya is the illegitimate child of a certain prominent family. When her mother dies, she's convinced she knows what awaits her in her new home: a life of servitude and misery at the hands of her wicked stepmother and stepsisters! Yet when she finally meets the women she expects to treat her like dirt, they actually end up being...sweet?!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Tensui no Sakuna-hime: Ikusa Datara no Kamigami
title_japanese: 天穂のサクナヒメ 戦だたらの神々
synopsis: An original story taking place after the events of the Tensui no Sakuna-hime video game.

title: Ai no Utagoe wo Kikasete
title_japanese: アイの歌声を聴かせて
synopsis:
Ai no Utagoe wo Kikasete tells the story of the beautiful and mysterious Shion who transfers to Keibu High School where she quickly becomes popular due to her open-hearted personality and exceptional athletic talent...but she turns out to be an AI in the testing phase!

Shion's goal is to bring chronic loner Satomi "happiness." However, her strategy is something no human would expect: she serenades Satomi in the middle of the classroom. After finding out that Shion is an AI, Satomi and her childhood friend, engineering geek Touma, steadily warm up to the new student. Along with the popular and attractive Gocchan, the strong-willed Aya, and judo club member "Thunder," they become more and more moved by Shion's singing and earnestness even as her antics bewilder them. But what Shion does for Satomi's sake ends up involving them all in some serious pandemonium. Get ready for the heartwarming story of a not quite market-ready AI and her classmates!

(Source: Funimation)

title: Hiroware Koneko to Moto Yakuza
title_japanese: 拾われ子猫と元ヤクザ
synopsis:
After being abandoned in the cold rain, tiny kitten Sabu should have been grateful to find a new home. But when he's rescued by Jin, whose every atom screams "yakuza," Sabu suspects he's out of the frying pan and into the fire! Yet Jin's scarred hands and face hide a sweet man beneath...a man who pampers kitties with baths and bottle-feedings!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Oshi ga Tonari de Jugyou ni Shuuchuu Dekinai!
title_english: My Idol Sits the Next Desk Over!
title_japanese: 推しが隣で授業に集中できない!
synopsis:
Chiro-chan is a world-class idol...at least, to Sakiko Manaka, your run-of-the-mill hard-core idol fan. So when Chiro—real name Chihiro—ends up sitting next to her in school, Sakiko's world is turned upside-down, and all her brain cells vanish. After all, how can she concentrate when her absolute fav is just inches away?! But she needs to be on her A-game, because she may not be the only one who is totally gaga for Chihiro...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

synopsis: The story of a mangaka who becomes imprisoned by a mysterious high school girl.

title: Ochita Saki wa Koi
synopsis:
It was just the beginning of autumn. Senpai fell from a tree in front of Shiori, who was looking up the sky by herself, and started to cling to her.

At first, Shiori was keeping away from Senpai, but started to realize that spending time with her became natural. During the winter, when Senpai was about to graduate, Shiori makes a move...

(Source: Yuri Hub, edited)

title: Nichiyoubi, Gogo 1-ji
synopsis:
Maki is a shy person who is not good at talking with Hoshino, an unfriendly woman working at the dentists' front desk. Even though Maki forms many thoughts in her mind, she cannot speak those aloud.

One day, Maki had an opportunity to talk to Hoshino, and she slowly started to like her. When her cavity treatment is complete, she would no longer be seeing Hoshino. Where will Maki's romance lead her...?

(Source: Yuri Hub, edited)

title: Roku to Rui
synopsis:
Rui Takanashi dreams of a wonderful campus life. One day, the girl he's interested in calls him to meet to confess her feelings! Cheerfully heading there, all Rui finds is his childhood friend, Roku Koga. Looking back, Roku has kept on interfering with Rui's important moments. Like stealing the girl Rui liked or kissing him just to mess around... When Rui finally couldn't take it any longer, the only thing Roku said was just these unexpected words: "But I'm the one who likes you longer, Rui."

"I never knew this side of my childhood friend!!" The exciting love life of Roku, who can’t be honest at all, and Rui, who is a beginner in love, starts now!

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Seichoutsuu
synopsis:
Subaru Kashino travels to a high school in the countryside for a sports training camp where he meets Kei Natsume, a library committee member. Subaru finds himself curious about the boy in the library. Then one night Subaru has a sensual dream about his new friend. When it's time to return to Tokyo, Natsume suggests instead of calling each other to write letters. Confused, but intrigued, Subaru decides to start writing to Natsume.

(Source: MU)

title: Larkspur no Ori
synopsis:
Noah, an orphan with a rebellious attitude, is deceived by a friend and put up for auction. Gilbert, the person who bought him for 200 million, was rumored to be a ruthless man. Noah was prepared to be treated badly, but during his first sexual encounter, he was taught pleasure he had never felt before. He should have wanted to escape, but he was gradually moved by the clumsy kindness of Gilbert and the reason why he bought him.

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

title: Kemono wa Oku made Aisaretai
title_japanese: けものは奥まで愛されたい
synopsis:
Haku grew up in the slums, a.k.a. the "Management Zone." That's where all the mutts like him live. Now that his father has died and he's being targeted, Haku manages to escape. An accident happens and Haku is saved by a human, Eiichi Mibu. "Haku, from now on, you're my pet." How will this work out when Haku's heat starts?

(Source: BL Tsundoku Scans)

title: Hamerare Hitozuma Furin Nikki: Sorekara no Mari
title_japanese: ハメラレ人妻不倫日記 ～それからのマリ～
synopsis:
1. Natsuyasumi no Boku
2-8. Sorekara no
9. Ooyasan no Okusan
10. Yuruyuru Okusan

title: Chikyuu-san wa Level Up shimashita! @comic
title_japanese: 地球さんはレベルアップしました！＠COMIC
synopsis:
As a result of the Earth getting a Level Up, the world has become tinged with fantasy. Dungeons and monsters have appeared, and a karma-style status system has been applied to many lifeforms.

That day, along with other people all over the world, chuuni girl Meiko Yotani is swallowed up by the appearance of a monster-filled dungeon. Meiko generously shares the amazing information she has discovered and, with the involvement of the town she lives in and the school she attends, makes the world more lively.

This is the tale of a group of high school girls from the country running through the dawn of a new world and attracting attention from people all over the globe.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Saigo no Furyou
synopsis:
The year is 2027. A sixteen-year-old boy named Kan Kirigaya, who yearns to be a delinquent, comes to Tokyo, unaware that Shibuya has become a peaceful town due to the policy of purifying the downtown area. He despairs at the love and peace of the heart of Shibuya, but the fierce struggle for supremacy among the delinquents is still going on underground!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Mawaru Gakuen to, Senpai to Boku: Simple Life
title_english: The School, the Senior and I
title_japanese: 廻る学園と、先輩と僕 Simple Life
synopsis:
This is a romantic comedy and sometimes serious school life of Nachi (1st year), a new student with a cute face but a reckless streak, and Tsukasa (3rd year), a senior who is rumored to be the most beautiful girl in school. Nachi is constantly being pushed around by the senior he admires. In fact, Tsukasa is extremely jealous. It’s not easy to be around these two.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Teihen Boukensha dakedo Mahou wo Kiwametemiru Koto ni Shita: Munou Skill kara Kami Skill ni Shinka shita "Mahou Souzou" to "Item Sakusei" de Musou suru
title_japanese: 底辺冒険者だけど魔法を極めてみることにした ～無能スキルから神スキルに進化した【魔法創造】と【アイテム作成】で無双する～
synopsis:
Loa is a bottom tier adventurer who is regarded by everyone as "incompetent." The only skill he possesses is "Create Item," which is the ability to create an item in exchange for your levels. Because of this skill, Loa is still weak for his level when compared to others. However, Loa continued to raise his level without using the Item Creation ability in order to improve his ability as much as possible. He has been hunting low-level monsters such as slimes and goblins for a year.

When Loa finally reached Level 50, an extraordinary change happens to him. "'Item Creation' has evolved into 'Magic Creation.'" The Magic Creation skill allows you to create a new magic in exchange for levels. The more levels you sacrifice, the more powerful magic you can create. Furthermore, by using the Item Creation ability, you can supplement your status with powerful equipment, create high-value items, and it's super convenient!

Item Creation and Magic Creation—the two skills have a synergistic effect,

title: Maou no Niwa no Shiroi Hana
title_english: White Flowers in the Devil's Garden

title: Nishuume no Boku wa Kimi to Koi wo Suru
title_english: I of Second Round Fall in Love with You...
title_japanese: 二周目の僕は君と恋をする
synopsis:
In the summer of my third year of high school, Matsuri Tokiwa went missing. She was the first girl I ever fell in love with. I turned twenty, still unable to accept the harsh reality, when for some reason time turned back to the spring of two years ago. While savoring the joy of being able to see her like it's only natural, I confessed, went on dates, and did things that I would never have done the first time... But summer is my time limit. Does she have an idea of why she disappeared? I don't want to lose her again.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Sabikui Bisco 2
synopsis:
In a world corroded by the Rusty Wind, a journey begins for the newly-immortal Akaboshi Bisco.

Together with Milo, they arrive in Shimane. There, rumors of the "Immortal Priest" Kelshinha—said to have ruled Shimane for 200 years—reach their ears. In search of a cure for Bisco's immortality, the two infiltrate a city of turmoil, strange rituals, and gruesome sacrifices, where many religious groups dwell in a precarious balance.

Read the exciting sequel to the story of two boys who, swift as arrows, fight to protect their loved ones and achieve their dreams!

(Source: Comikey Media)

title: Isekai Kokka Alchimaira: Saijaku no Ou to Musou no Gunzei
title_english: Different World Alchimaira: The Weakest King and Matchless Army
title_japanese: 異世界国家アルキマイラ ～最弱の王と無双の軍勢～
synopsis:
The VR game "Tactics Chronicle" is a state-management game. One day, Helian, a player who has reached the top of the game and become the king of a land of demons, is suddenly transported to another world, his own country in the game. What he saw there was a character from the game acting with his own ego...!

(Source: MU)

title: Hikikomari Kyuuketsuki no Monmon
title_english: The Vexations of a Shut-in Vampire Princess
title_japanese: ひきこまり吸血姫の悶々
synopsis:
Three years into her life as a shut-in, vampire Terakomari Gandesblood (Komari for short), awakens to find she's been appointed as a commander in the Mulnite Imperial Army! The thing is, her new unit consists solely of belligerent ruffians who revolt against their superiors at the slightest hint of weakness. Although Komari hails from a line of vampires as powerful as they are prestigious, her refusal to drink blood has made her the picture of mediocrity—scrawny, un-coordinated, and inept at magic. With the odds stacked against her, will the help of her trusty (and slightly infatuated) maid Vill be enough for this recluse to blunder her way to success? Or will Komari rue the day she ever left the safety of her room?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Maou 2099
synopsis:
The cyberpunk metropolis Shinjuku—a massive city-state bedecked with neon signs, towering skyscrapers, and the latest cutting-edge technology. It is here, in year 2099 of the Fused Era, where the legendary Demon Lord Veltol has his second coming five centuries in the making. But this landscape is nothing like the one he conquered all those years ago, for the fusion of magic and engineering has elevated civilization to dazzling, unprecedented heights. Veltol may have been reduced to a historical footnote, but make no mistake...this brave new world will be his for the taking!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Zengun Funtou!: Yamada Kintetsu Tanpenshuu
title_english: Yamada Kintetsu: The Collection of Short Stories
title_japanese: 山田金鉄短編集　全軍奮闘！
synopsis:
1. Tetsuwan Wabisuke
2. Tenka no Hanayome
3. Wolf & Rabbit
4. Mononoke Banchou Muramasa
5. Telework Yotobanashi
6. Meets Sekken

title: Usotsuki Jouzu to Banken
synopsis:
Yuuji Samejima spends his days doing nothing but getting into fights, but one day, his fight ended up damaging an expensive car nearby. To pay back the loan for the damages, Samejima accepts the car owner, Shinichi Uotani's offer to become the latter's guard dog. As a collateral for the loan, Samejima also had to accept 3 extra conditions. One of it is to work as a staff at the cafe that Uotani runs. He felt tricked because this was a lot different from what he imagined his job as a "guard dog" would be but...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint
synopsis:
In the web novel Three Ways to Survive the Apocalypse, people are forced to fight monsters and each other for coins, food, and—ultimately—survival. While mysterious "Constellations" watch the unwilling participants for their own entertainment, one man emerges as the protagonist: Yoo Joonghyuk, who repeatedly lives and dies in an endless struggle to close the book on this indiscriminate torture.

Kim Dokja has lived a challenging and action-packed life through Joonghyuk for over a decade. While other readers abandoned the story early on, Dokja has remained its sole reader until the very last chapter. At that time, he receives a puzzling message from the author, and the novel's inhumane world suddenly becomes reality.

As the only person aware of what lies ahead, Dokja realizes that he must utilize his omniscience to navigate the deadly scenarios and stay alive. Dokja was never meant to play a main part, but in defiance of those who wish to spell his fate, he might just have to take the

title: Oniichan no Tomodachi ga Roshutsu-kei Danshi Dattara
title_english: My Brother's Friend Likes to Flaunt It
title_japanese: お兄ちゃんの友達が露出系男子だったら
synopsis:
1. Oniichan no Tomodachi ga Roshutsu-kei Danshi Dattara (My Brother's Friend Likes to Flaunt It)
2. Yukata no Kareshi ni Yokujou shitemo Ii desu ka? (Is It Okay to Be Excited by My Boyfriend in a Yukata?)
3-4. Dokujo, Himo wo Hiroimashita  (A Lonely Lady Picks up a Freeloader)
5. Hontou Iu to Kekkon shitai (To Be Honest, I Do Want to Get Married)
6. Hajimete no Kareshi ga Roshutsu-kei Danshi Dattara (My First Boyfriend Likes to Flaunt It)

title: Sampling Sex
title_japanese: サンプリング・セックス
synopsis:
Araeda may have gotten himself into his college friend's adult toy company, but he'd never really thought of putting his hands on the merchandise—not until big, burly Sakuma asks him for some help! Araeda's skills may be focused on device connectivity, but is that the only thing he wants to connect with Sakuma right now?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Takusan Kimochi Yoku shite Ageru
title_english: Sexy Gentleman's Superb Techniques: I'll Teach You How to be Sexy
title_japanese: たくさん気持ちよくしてあげる
synopsis:
Rika likes to drink. She goes to this bar to find a "man with a wrist watch" who once comforted her when she got drunk. But the only man who talks to her at the bar is Masa, who's an unshaven older man... One night, Rika finds herself in a strange place after she passed out, and sees the man she was looking for kissing her and caressing her body... But when she wakes up, the man next to her was not whom she expected!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Ojisama Shousetsuka to Papa-katsu Hajimemashita!?
title_english: My Favorite Author Became My Sugar Daddy!?
title_japanese: オジサマ小説家とパパ活はじめました!?
synopsis:
After a friend asks her to go on a questionable date in her place, Ran Yoshizaki hesitantly decides to go in order to help her father pay back his loan.
However, she was given an aphrodisiac without her knowledge and is about to be taken to the hotel! Just when her chastity is in danger, it's none other than a regular at her part-time job and a person she looks up to, writer Haruyoshi Mikami, that saves her! With an uncontrollable heat overflowing from within her, Haruyoshi gently whispers into Ran's ears and reaches deep inside her. What will happen next?

(Souce: Renta!)

title: Hadan kara Yoroshiku Onegai Itashimasu
title_english: We Didn't Match, but Let's Start Anew
title_japanese: 破談から宜しくお願い致します

title: Last Karte: Houjuuigakusha Touma Kenshou no Kioku
title_japanese: ラストカルテ ―法獣医学者 当麻健匠の記憶―

title: Kokou Kemono to Obaka Yankee
title_japanese: 孤高けものとおバカヤンキー
synopsis:
One morning, high schooler Inoda Nagi saves a kitten beastman from being bullied at the park, even though he loses the fight. Later, Mikejima Mao transfers into Nagi’s school, and he turns out to be the older brother of the kid Nagi saved. But instead of being grateful, Mikejima makes enemies of Nagi and everyone else in the class. Will these two ever stop fighting?

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

Included one-shot: Kokou Kemono to Obaka Yankee: Dachi-hen

title: Akogare no Neechan ga Gal ni Natte Kaettekita Natsuyasumi
title_japanese: 憧れの姉ちゃんがギャルになって帰ってきた夏休み

title: Maou no Musuko wa Sunao ni Narenai!
title_english: Tell Us How You Really Feel, Demon Prince!
title_japanese: 魔王の息子は素直になれないっ!
synopsis:
In the distant future, there will be species from different realms that walk this earth and coexist with humans. And of course, not everyone and everything will be peaceful. To combat any conflicts that arise, a new Special Task Force is founded: Soul Justice. The Soul Justice is so strong that they even defeated the Demon King and stopped his quest for world domination. (Don't worry, he has since turned a new leaf as a highly-skilled farmer.) Mamoru Akamichi is Soul Red of the Soul Justice. And although he helped save the world from the Demon King, he remains as upbeat and humble as ever. He protects everybody, even the Demon King's clumsy son, Lulud, who has proclaimed himself to be Soul Red's arch-nemesis. To Akamichi, defeating Lulud is simple as pie, much to the Demon Prince's dismay. Challenge after challenge, duel after duel, Akamichi always comes out the victor. What can Lulud do to conquer his archenemy finally?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Hoshino Doubutsuen Koimonogatari
synopsis:
Kurihara, a student aiming for art university, has always had the ability to see animals in humanoid form, and converse with them. Because of that, there's a bit of a distance between himself and others. He goes to Hoshino Zoo to sketch the animals and they often consult in him. Within the zoo grounds, there's a flame of love between a Parus major (great tit) and a small squirrel, fierce advance on the older lion from the younger lion, and sweet thoughts about the male zookeeper from an old penguin. Spring even comes to Kurihara...! You'll feel warm and fuzzy from reading these zoo love stories!

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: Miyako wa Ruri-iro, Roman-iro
synopsis:
Set in the early Shouwa period.

Ruri, born to an English father and Japanese mother, lost both parents at an early age and currently works at a boarding house. Lonely, Ruri is impatient to grow up quickly, when she meets a mysterious painter staying at the lodgings. Drawn to his easygoing, carefree attitude, Ruri finds she doesn't hate the time she spends with him...

A historical romance drawn with beautiful brush strokes ♪

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Kiss and Night
title_japanese: キス・アンド・ナイト
synopsis:
Omi, known as the Queen of an exclusive strip club called Grand Cage, and only special members can see him perform. Subaru Shinonome, a rich heir of sake brewery declared to Omi he'll make him his. How will Omi respond to him?

(Source: MU)

title: Omiai Shitakunakatta node, Murinandai na Jouken wo Tsuketara Doukyuusei ga Kita Ken ni Tsuite
title_japanese: お見合いしたくなかったので、無理難題な条件をつけたら同級生が来た件について
synopsis:
One day, Yuzuru Takasegawa—a first-year high school student—is urged by his grandfather to go to an arranged marriage meeting, insisting that he wants to see his great-grandson before he dies.

However, not wanting to bear the weight of a fiancée at the tender age of a freshman in high school, Yuzuru tries to avoid the arranged marriage meeting by imposing an irrational condition. "If she is blonde-haired, blue-eyed, fair-skinned, etc, only then I will think about the marriage."

But somehow, he finds the girl who meets the conditions that Yuzuru has put out, and he reluctantly ends up going to matchmaking only once. And on the day of matchmaking, Arisa Yukishiro, a beautiful girl with reputation at school, shows up on the scene. Upon hearing her story, it seems she was also reluctantly made to go on matchmaking. Therefore, the two of them try to prevent themselves from further marriage proposals with their false "engagement." And so, as they play the role of fake lovers, they find the

title: Gimai wa Uwaki ni Fukumarenai yo, Oniichan
title_english: It's Not Cheating If It's with Your Step-sister.
title_japanese: 義妹は浮気に含まれないよ、お兄ちゃん

title: Pashirare Inkya ga Jitsu wa Saikyou Datta Ken
title_japanese: パシられ陰キャが実は最強だった件

title: Camera-senpai to Sewayaki Jouzu na Kouhai-chan
title_japanese: カメラ先輩と世話焼き上手な後輩ちゃん

title: Ryuu to Sairei
synopsis:
Broke and recently homeless, fledgling wandmaker Ix leaves his isolated village in search of employment only to run into Yuui, a girl with a contract entitling her to a free wand repair from his late instructor. But when Ix decides to honor the guarantee and complete the job in his teacher's stead, he quickly realizes that this is no routine tune-up. Against all odds, Yuui's wand is powered by the heart of a mythical creature thought to have gone extinct over a thousand years ago—a dragon. To complete the restoration and put both their pasts to rest, the pair must now uncover the truth behind the dragons' disappearance from the world...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Happy Happy Birthday
title_japanese: ハッピー・ハッピー・バースデイ

title: Kami wa Game ni Ueteiru.
title_japanese: 神は遊戯〈ゲーム〉に飢えている。
synopsis:
The supreme Gods who had too much free time created the ultimate brain games "Play of the Gods." Former Goddess Leche awoke from a long slumber and declared to the world, "Bring forth the person who is the best in games in this era!" Fay is nominated to represent humanity as the "best rookie in recent years."

The "Game of the Gods" that is about to begin between the two may be a little too difficult, as there has yet to be a victor throughout human history, because Gods are capricious, very unreasonable, and sometimes completely incomprehensible. However, given the nature of the games, it would be a waste not to have a good time and play with all of one's heart! The ultimate brain battles of a genius gamer boy, a former Goddess, and friends begin!

(Source: MAL News)

title: Futsutsuna
synopsis:
The excellent part-timer Yamasono seems to hate Endou since he, for some reason, avoids Endou and never talks to him. Determined not to let an excellent employee go, Endou tells Yamasono "I like you (because you never leave open shifts)" at a drinking party, and then gets attacked at an empty parking lot. On top of that, Yamasono claims "We have the same feelings for each other," an odd misunderstanding, and starts to pursue Endou! The love tactics of an excellent part-timer with wild assumptions and an around thirty employee who is very serious about his job!

(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)

title: Soredemo Kimi wo Shiawase ni Shitai
title_english: Still, I Want to Make You Happy
title_japanese: それでも君を幸せにしたい
synopsis:
Kouya is reunited with Manaki, a girl he used to play with when they were little, for the first time in nine years. Even though they've lived far apart, Kouya's feelings for her have been growing through their social media exchanges, and he decided to take the opportunity of their reunion to reveal his feelings to her! But she has a secret...?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Hametsu no Keishisha: Naikaku Jouhou Chousashitsu "Tokumu Sousa" Bumon CIRO-S
title_english: The Hanged Man Falls Into Ruin.
title_japanese: 破滅の刑死者 内閣情報調査室「特務捜査」部門CIRO-S

title: Koukyuu no Zatsuyouki
synopsis:
Shaoran (Xiaolian) is an orphaned girl who lives alone in the mountains at the very nook of an impoverished village. One day, an envoy from the palace arrives and scouts her to to be a lady-in-waiting for the imperial harem. This was how a wild girl raised on the mountains was able to live in a luxurious palace working as a lady-in-waiting, however...

On her first day (due to various reasons), Shaoran had suddenly become a criminal after slapping one of the consorts.

Though execution appeared certain, she was specially pardoned and demoted from a lady-in-waiting to a maidservant in charge of odd jobs. She is ridiculed by the other consorts as the, "Princess of Odd Jobs," however, this is where her rapid advance begins. She implements reforms to the worn-down palace and optimizes her chores through the knowledge she learned from her life of living in poverty, earning the gaze of the other ladies-in-waiting and the imperial consorts alike. Continuing these course of events, Shaoran's n

title: Otome Game no Heroine de Saikyou Survival @comic
title_english: The Otome Heroine's Fight for Survival
title_japanese: 乙女ゲームのヒロインで最強サバイバル＠COMIC
synopsis:
Orphaned by a monster attack on her village, young Alicia spends three horrid years in an orphanage before finally running away. When she flees, however, Alicia has a violent encounter with an older woman hell-bent on killing her. During their tussle, she comes into contact with a strange crystal that bestows upon her a wealth of knowledge, transforming her from an innocent child into a cool and calculated planner. Now aware that she was meant to be the protagonist of an otome game and disgusted with her supposed fate, Alicia decides to take matters into her own hands and become strong—by any means necessary. Using her newfound knowledge, and with some help from a stranger she meets in the woods, she learns to survive by herself in a world far too harsh and unforgiving for a girl her age. Ready or not, she's determined to carve her own path.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Akuyaku Reijou no Okiniiri: Ouji...... Jama!
title_english: The Prince Is in the Villainess' Way!
title_japanese: 悪役令嬢のお気に入り 王子……邪魔っ
synopsis:
Iris, the "Wise Princess Who Never Smiles," had her memories of her reincarnation come back to her. She discovers that Fiona, a princess of a neighboring kingdom, is her from a former life, and that she is in danger due to Prince Alvin's betrayal.

Iris goes to the neighboring country as the princess's educator to save Fiona, but an obstacle stands in her way in the form of a cool-headed prince who has no sense of tact. So unfolds the love between a wise princess who never smiles and a cool-headed prince.

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Henyoku no Drops
synopsis:
The year is 3015, the ocean covers 90% of the planet, and it is normal for humans to fly in the sky. People who cannot fly are called "Drops" (the old generation), and Tsubasa is one of them. She lives in a world where there are almost no stairs or ladders, even though the buildings and space between floors is getting higher and farther.

On her first day of the high school she chose (because it had stairs), Tsubasa Fukami jumps off a landing to see if she can fly, and collides with Ren Takatsuki who was also using the stairs...

(Source: Comic Natalie, translated)

title: Koori no Kimi wo Tokasu made
title_japanese: 氷のキミを溶かすまで
synopsis:
Otaka Touya and Kandachi Rei have been figure skating partners since they were kids and their goal is the top. There is only one rule between them: they are forbidden from having a romantic relationship. Many successful pairs have met failure because they let intimate feelings get in the way of their performances. They swear they feel nothing for each other but how they behave on the ice says otherwise.

(Source: MU)

title: Kimi wa Boku no Koto wo Suuhai shisugiteiru.
title_japanese: 君は僕の事を崇拝しすぎている。
synopsis:
Miyaji's recent breakup with his girlfriend of three months leads him crying to his best friend, Tomoki, who has been his friend since high school and is a doujinshi artist who likes Momo-tan. Miyaji complains to Tomoki that every girl he has broken up with has the same reason: that Miyaji was bored and didn't love them. Miyaji begs to differ, and Tomoki agrees that Miyaji is perfect the way he is, which gives the latter feelings he was sure a friend shouldn't have. As Miyaji figures out what he feels for Tomoki, a drunken night and a heated kiss change everything between the two friends. Will Miyaji be able to come to terms with his newfound feelings?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Tsukikagerou de Aimashou: Yuukaku Omegaverse
title_english: Let's Meet At Tsukikagerou: Red Light Omegaverse
title_japanese: 月影楼で逢いましょう～遊郭オメガバース～
synopsis:
In the Omegaverse, alphas and omegas are born into two different worlds. While alphas excel in life, omegas are treated as scum who lure alphas into mating. Sousuke Tsukigase is a blissfully naive alpha until he falls in love with an omega, Jun. Inexperienced Haruma has accepted his feelings for his teasing bodyguard, Shoyo. He's fixated on their relationship, though, and toyed with to no end! Bodyguard-slash-boyfriend Shoyo and innocent Haruma become one emotionally and physically for the first time!!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Netsuai Control
synopsis:
Haruma Kagetsu, grandson of the super wealthy Kagetsu family, and his bodyguard, Shoyo Kurehashi, are officially in love. However, the inseparable duo get split up...!! Haruma does his best to subdue his anxiety, but the beautiful bodyguard Glen makes a move! Can Shoyo and Haruma protect true love...?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Rakuen Noise
synopsis:
When I dressed up as a woman and posted a music video on the internet, I suddenly became famous as a mysterious high school girl net musician (although I'm really a guy). I thought it was okay as long as I didn't show my face, but my high school music teacher, Misao Hanazono, discerned my identity, and I was blackmailed. My high school life—which should have been uneventful—was noisily and annoyingly colored by the three girls I meet through Hanazono-sensei: Rinko, the "twisted genius pianist," Shizuki, the "flower-arrangement princess drummer," and Akane, the "truant zashiki-warashi vocalist."

A boy-meets-girls story, spending all their time in love, youth, and the band!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Urara no Pantsu wa Tenchou wo Komaraseru
title_japanese: うららのパンツは店長を困らせる
synopsis:
The part-timer is more interested in honeypotting than working! Sumiyoshi is the new manager of a family restaurant with the worst sales. He wants to rebuild the restaurant and get a promotion, but he's confronted by Urara, the kitchen manager, who plays tricks on him to make his life easier, Ai, the big-boobed girl in the hall who's planning to become the manager behind the scenes, and Ayano, the serious but quirky part-timer who leaves work early because she's in high school.

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Konna Jinsei wa Zettai Iya da
title_japanese: こんな人生は絶対嫌だ
synopsis:
Saki is an ordinary high school girl, living a simple life of striving at her studies. The problem is she does not have a good relationship with her parents, and they lash out at her because of it. One day, scared of a group of delinquents who noticed her at school, she accepts and smokes a single cigarette, and somehow she and the delinquents get along comfortably. Troubled by her relationship with her parents, Saki flourishes in her time with the delinquents. That was when the tragic events began. What will become of Saki's life? A suspense tragedy about a quick descent from familiar everyday life! 

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Saiyaku ni Shite Madowazu
title_english: Unfazed by the Disaster in My Life
synopsis:
Masato works as a chef at a local restaurant. During one of his breaks, he had a chance encounter with one of his schoolmates, Mitsukuni, who accidentally spills coffee on his lap. In a rush, Mitsukuni immediately leaves, passively giving Masato a cleaning fee and an irritable temper. Worse, Masato's wallet gets in Mitsukuni's briefcase, which had all of his money and keys. As fate would have it, the two meet again later on at the restaurant Masato works at. While Masato perfectly remembers Mitsukuni during their high school days, Mitsukuni barely remembers the former. When Masato's home ends up catching fire, Mitsukuni is nagged by Masato's co-workers to take him in. Now that the two are living together, certain things come to light and unfold between them.

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Saiyaku ni Shite Madowazu: Love in Room Share
title_english: Unfazed by the Disaster in My Life
title_japanese: 災厄にして惑わず～ラブインルームシェア～

title: Saiyaku ni Shite Madowazu: Sweet in Room Share
title_english: Even If This Relation Is the Disaster, Not Puzzled
title_japanese: 災厄にして惑わず～スイートインルームシェア～

title: Colette wa Shinu Koto ni Shita: Megami-hen
title_japanese: コレットは死ぬことにした―女神編―
synopsis: Sequel series about Hades and Colette's marriage.

title: Kakuriyo Shinjuuki: Isekai de, Kamisama no Oishasan Hajimemasu.
title_english: Chronicles of the Hidden World: How I Became a Doctor for the Gods
title_japanese: かくりよ神獣紀　異世界で、神様のお医者さんはじめます。
synopsis:
A girl named Yae reincarnates into a world where one's name determines their essence. When a monster attacks her, she unleashes Arai, an ex-god in the form of a golden tiger, to defend herself. Shortly after, however, Arai manipulates Yae into assisting his little brother, who has been warped into a grotesque form by a disease that strips people of their essences. As Yae searches for a cure, she finds herself warming to the pompous, threatening Arai...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Taiyou no Tou
synopsis:
ABANDON THE PURSUIT OF ORDINARY HAPPINESS! One young man's barren college life changes forever when he shares a budding romance with a girl named Mizuo...only for it to all come crashing down when she has the gall to dump him! With the specter of a solitary Christmas Eve looming, he tears through the streets of Kyoto with just his powerful (some might say delusional) imagination to protect him from the cruel world at large. A Japanese fantasy novel for every man who's been let down by love—and those still bracing for it!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Kanjisugiru Onna: Tatsumi Yoshihiro Kannou Kessakushuu
title_japanese: 感じすぎる女 辰巳ヨシヒロ官能傑作集
synopsis:
1. Iroawase
2. Shitataka na Onna
3. Sasayaku Onna
4. Fuzaketa Onna
5. Kanjisugiru Onna
6. Yanagase no Onna

title: Kamidanomi Konkatsu
synopsis:
Natsuki has struck out at speed dating a bunch of times and doesn't know what to do to improve her luck with men. Then, one day, as she's walking home drunk, Natsuki visits a shrine she used to play at as a kid and prays to the spirit there for a boyfriend... When she does, a hot and wild-looking guy in a kimono suddenly appears before her and unexpectedly says, "I'll be your boyfriend if you'll have me!" Since she's drunk and the guy's also her type, Natsuki doesn't hesitate to accept his offer... but then they're suddenly in her bed at home and he starts taking her clothes off!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Saikyou Onmyouji no Isekai Tenseiki: Geboku no Youkai-domo ni Kurabete Monster ga Yowasugirun da ga
title_english: The Reincarnation of the Strongest Exorcist in Another World: Monsters Can't Match my Youkai!
title_japanese: 最強陰陽師の異世界転生記 ～下僕の妖怪どもに比べてモンスターが弱すぎるんだが～
synopsis:
Betrayed by his allies and on the verge of death, the strongest exorcist, Haruyoshi Kuga, desired only one thing—to be happy in his next life. Using the secret art of reincarnation, he was transported to another world. Reborn as Seika Lamprogue, third son of a distinguished family of magic scholars, he's found to have no magical power whatsoever, which is an unacceptable shame in a family of mages. However, he soon comes to realize that his new world's magic is nothing compared to the sorcery he mastered as an exorcist. With his control over divination, curses, and legions of youkai who serve him, his life in this new world should be a breeze! The only question is: how can he make use of those powers while laying low to avoid another untimely demise?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Kawaii Chikyuujin ga Ita node Kouhai wo Moushiiretemita
title_english: I Found a Cute Earthling So I Asked Him to Mate With Me
title_japanese: 可愛い地球人がいたので交配を申し入れてみた
synopsis:
Sora Hoshino is an unassuming college student who loves astronomy. One day, a handsome man appears before Sora completely nude, and introduces himself as Regulus, prince of a dying alien species with an extremely low fertility rate. While scouting for a new breeding partner, Regulus has been watching Sora from space, and asks for his hand in marriage. Sora has his doubts, but Regulus's tentacles and mysterious cosmic powers feel too good to resist...

(Source: Renta!)

title: Shunrai to Mitsu
synopsis:
Yuen was abandoned by his parents and taken to an orphanage. His only support was Yan, who was like an older brother. Yan also cherished Yuen like his younger brother, but one night, a cruel incident that separates them occurs. A few years later Yan, who became a yakuza and lived as Aoyagi, visited the facility again. However, Yuen, whom he reunited with, is different from the boy in his memory. He was a bewitching young man filled with allure...

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: Shouwaru Neko mo Koi wo Suru
title_english: The Wicked Cat Fall in Love
synopsis:
He is the top-billed announcer of the morning program, nicknamed "Prince". Aiming for the No.1 most liked, he looks down on the guys who made a fool of him when he was in junior high! But one day, when he was hiding his ambition under a smile, he is reunited with Sakaguchi, his first love!? He's divorced with a kid, but doesn't feel ashamed about it, and nonchalantly praises Doujou's success, saying, "You've worked hard." While feeling frustrated about the guy who won't even let him gloat, his unrequited love that should have been sealed away rekindles itself?!

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

title: Itadakimasu, Ookami-san.
title_japanese: いただきます、オオカミさん。
synopsis:
In a world where beastkin evolved from different species of animals and now coexist, Natsuki, who stands out even among the dominant wolves, is traumatized by a heat he experienced to the point that he can never tell anyone about it. One day, while showing Hakuto, an inferior rabbit transfer student around school he was suddenly taken to an empty classroom. Natsuki tried to escape as Hakuto whispered, "I missed your pheromones..." Then suddenly Natsuki went into heat...?!

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

title: Naka made Aishite
title_english: I Want You to Love Me to the Inside.
synopsis:
Yuzuriha has a feminine face that can beat most girls' and he is fed up with people who only care about the other person's looks. Sitting next to him in class is Tokiwa, the very personification of the type of person he hates. One night, Yuzuriha was about to enter a hotel with a man he had met on a dating app but unfortunately for him, he was seen by Tokiwa. To make things worse, Tokiwa thought that Yuzuriha is used to doing it with men so, he went crazy inside Yuzuriha when actually it was his first time!

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: Sexual Exploits
synopsis:
Ever dreamed about your friend's wife? How about a charming masseur, or a MILF who's hired you as a tutor? In Sexual Exploits, an array of characters share their juiciest sexual experiences. Toeing the line between reality and fantasy, these stories will pull you in real, real close...

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Boku no Doubutsuen Nikki
synopsis: This manga is based on the actual life & experiences of a zookeeper at Ueno Zoo in Taito, Tokyo, Japan's oldest zoo.

title: Dream☆Drunkers: Yakuza to Mahou no Tsue
title_japanese: ドリーム☆ドランカーズ～ヤクザと魔法の杖～
synopsis:
A yakuza, is entrusted with a star-shaped box by his dying brother. The brother's last words were, "When the time comes, take this and chant: Dreaming Star!'" and when he did a spirit appeared with a magic wand...

(Source: Comic Natalie, translated)

title: One Room ni Shitsuji.
synopsis:
A beautiful man suddenly turns up at Satori's run-down apartment, saying, "I am Saizo Kusunoki, your butler." In truth, Satori is descended from a super rich family. As a young child, though, he began to show signs of social withdrawal as a result of constant stress, so his mother, who was opposed to her family's privileged mindset, left home along with Satori and his father. The three of them lived a humble but happy life... And now, after his parents' sudden death, Satori lives as a poor student who spends all of his time working. Enter the butler. He is from the main family and informs Satori of the recent death of his grandfather along with the will which names Satori as the next family head... Satori receives daily training on how to purport himself from this handsome, older, aristocratic, slightly sadistic butler. Kusunoki calls it his "duty," and soon starts to train Satori's body, too!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Shitsuji Senyou.
synopsis:
When he was young, Satori couldn't handle the pressures of the noble lifestyle that the Matsunomiya name came with. As such, Satori's parents decided to lead an average life for his sake. However, after his parents' lives were taken in an accident and his grandfather passed away, Satori was appointed the head of the Matsunomiya family. Now, Master Satori must fix his posture, dining etiquette, and education to become a fitting head. What's worse, relationships between the family and the staff are prohibited. Not only does Satori have to change his entire nature, he must do it with the love of his life, whom he is not allowed to touch, at his every beck and call!

(Source: Torico)

title: Kiiteyaru kara Ittemina?
title_japanese: 聞いてやるから言ってみな?
synopsis:
Takeru Suga is your average university student. He has wet dreams like others his age, he has his feelings wired up like others his age, and he has a personal minder for 24/7 protection from rival gang attacks, like others... Takeru Suga is almost your average university student. The only difference between him and his friends is that his father is the boss of a Yakuza group. And as such, Takeru has Naruse, a personal minder, to take care of him and protect him from danger. Feeling like a caged bird, Takeru tries to extend his wings... but is it his wings that Naruse has a hold of... or his heart?

(Source: Torico)

title: Mangetsu no Chikai
synopsis:
The once-peaceful land of Embria now suffers under the occupation of cruel conquerors. Enchantress Maura Woodbury has spent her young life trying to avoid their notice at all costs. Until her wizard guardian reveals that she has been chosen to seek and waken a legendary warrior who is destined to free their people. First she must procure an ancient map which will reveal The Waiting King's resting place. Since Maura's journey will lead her into dangerous territory, she is forced to accept a magic-wary outlaw as her escort. But can she trust a man like Rath Talward...or will he prove an even greater threat to her quest?

(Source: Harlequin)

title: Kimi no Sekai ni Koi wa Nai
title_japanese: きみのせかいに恋はない
synopsis:
Chika Hanai cannot fathom the concept of romance. During high school, she was uncomfortable with being touched by her former boyfriend, and things did not work out with the next guy her friends introduced her to, either. Clueless about the social cues around dating, she feels alienated from the rest of the world, wondering if something is wrong with her.

In hopes of figuring herself out, Chika enrolls in a college in Tokyo where a psychology professor she greatly admires teaches. By pure chance, Chika meets the professor, Shinobu Ishii, who—instead of advising her how to be "normal"—gives Chika the words she needed the most: she does not have to fall in love. Meeting peers who also feel differently about affection and receiving Professor Ishii's advice, Chika comes to understand that she is not alone in this confusing world and that love might not be the answer to everything.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Ao no Shi, Boku no Koukai
synopsis:
One day, a sudden meeting is held at school. The news was that Ao Tamaki of Class 2B had passed away. Kitajima, who had been going out with Ao until last week, couldn't believe his ears when he heard the news.

The beautiful and cheerful Ao was a much respected person at school, but why did she suddenly die? Kitajima wonders if it was his fault for saying goodbye to her last week, but he can't quite believe that she is dead. Then Rui, who was in the same class and club as Ao, appears in front of Kitajima.

Rui has the ability to see the past related to an object when she touches it with her feelings, so she touches a protective charm made by Aoi and sees the past...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Asa Okitara Tsuma ni Natte Ninshin shiteita Ore no Report
title_english: This Is My Report That When I Woke Up, I Noticed I Was My Wife and Was Pregnant!
title_japanese: 朝起きたら妻になって妊娠していた俺のレポート
synopsis:
The main character Yuuichi suddenly faces a divorce when his wife Hana says "It's impossible to raise a child with you," but he doesn't understand why she would say this. When Yuuichi wakes up after hitting his head and losing consciousness, he finds himself in the body of Hana near the start of the pregnancy—he will relive his past behaviors from the perspective of his wife.

(Source: Chibi Manga)

title: Asa Okitara Tsuma ni Natte Ninshin shiteita Ore no Report: Kosodate-hen
title_english: This Is My Report That When I Woke Up, I Noticed I Was My Wife and Was Pregnant!
title_japanese: 朝起きたら妻になって妊娠していた俺のレポート 子育て編
synopsis:
"I don't need you to raise our child."

I am Seiichi Itou. My wife left me with those words, leaving behind divorce papers. After falling down in a panic, I woke up to find myself in the body of my wife, Kaori when she had just given birth?!

"I'm sure you can do it, Kaori-chan!"
"Can you do more of the housework?"
"Tell me, what should I do?"

I thought I had been doing my part in raising our child, but the fact was that I didn't know anything at all...

This is the next part of the much talked about "Asa Okitara" maternity comedy series which centers around "childcare!"

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Apartment Connection
title_japanese: アパートメントコネクション
synopsis:
Akari Kajino is in his second year at his first job, and he's already sick and tired of the daily grind. It feels as if he's simply repeating the same day over and over again, and he wonders if this is what he really wants to do with his life. Then, one day, he comes home from work, exhausted as usual, only to realize something is wrong with his apartment building... He rushes into his apartment, and the electricity and wifi aren't working!

Feeling hopeless, he hears voices outside, so he goes out to meet the other tenants in the building... one of them a man who is drop dead gorgeous. For some reason, he ends up borrowing the man's bath, and...

(Source: Renta!)

title: Romantic Lament

synopsis:
In a world where people can be alphas, betas, or omegas, Asahi doesn't want to be with an alpha. But one drunken night, he stumbles into a one-night stand with an alpha who looks just like his ex. Of course, Asahi runs off the morning after—but what can he do when familiar-faced Akiomi asks him to be his pretend boyfriend?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)
