title: Makikomare Shoukan!? Soshite Watashi wa "Kami" deshita??
title_english: An Entangled Summon?! And I'm a "God" Now??
title_japanese: 巻き込まれ召喚!? そして私は『神』でした??
synopsis:
Takumi Saiki has retired from work and is living a life free from care, when he finds he's been summoned to another world. He is one of four people brought as heroes through a secret ceremony and tasked with defeating an invading army of the Demon Lord. There's a "Hero," a "Sage," a "Priestess"...and Takumi's...a "God?" This heartwarming (?) story is about a FORMER old man that becomes "God" in another world.

(Source: AlphaPolis)

title: Tonari no Kuuderella wo Amayakashitara, Uchi no Aikagi wo Watasu Koto ni Natta
title_english: I Spoiled "Quderella" Next Door and I'm Going to Give Her a Key to My House
title_japanese: 隣のクーデレラを甘やかしたら、ウチの合鍵を渡すことになった
synopsis:
Katagiri Natsuomi, a high school student living alone for two years, has a beautiful black-haired, blue-eyed girl move into the next room. The girl, Yui, seems to be a real noblewoman, and her nickname is "Kuudere-lla" because of her indifferent reaction at school. When Natsuomi finds out that Yui doesn't want to rely on others, but is actually quite naive, he decides to help her out.

"Tonight's dinner is... chicken karaage?"

"Chicken was cheap."

"I love your fried chicken, so I'm really looking forward to it."

This is the beginning of a sweet and tantalizing relationship between two neighbors.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Toku Chou: Shikyoku Tokushu Chou Hanzai Taisakushitsu
title_japanese: 特蝶 死局特殊蝶犯罪対策室
synopsis:
When a person dies, their soul leaves the body in the form of a butterfly. It's the Death Bureau's battle to protect them... 

(Source: MU)

title: Kensen Hyoukyoku
title_japanese: 剣仙鏢局 ケンセンヒョウキョク
synopsis:
Setsuka, the third son of the mighty and immensely powerful country of Jan, always spent his days taking fencing lessons from a beautiful young woman named Karen alongside two hostages from an enemy country: Suiran and his childhood friend Shiraha. Then one day, everyone in the country of Jan is gruesomely attacked and slaughtered by the enemy country! But then, Kokuyou, a rookie swordsman with remarkable technique, arrives spearheading a group of smugglers known as the Karanhyoukyoku! Thus begins the grand story of crossing the continent to deliver Setsuka, who has become "baggage" due to being the imperial prince of a now-dead country, to a place of safety!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Shiteru no, Misete
title_english: Show Me How You Do It!
synopsis:
After getting her underwear mixed up with that of her sexy girlfriend Maika after a wild night, Aoi is enchanted by how good it smells—and ends up doing something a little risque. When Aoi lets the embarrassing secret slip, she expects an angry reaction, but instead, Maika rents out a room for the both of them and demands a reenactment—and she wants to see every last detail!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Happy Nudist Beach
title_japanese: ハッピーヌーディストビーチ
synopsis:
A frisky lesbian looking to meet fellow singles escapes the woes of the pandemic by taking a vacation to a private beach where you can ditch the mask... and the swimsuit.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Zangyou Office Love: Koe ga Dechau kara Zutto Kiss
title_english: After-Hours Office Love: Silence Me With a Kiss!
title_japanese: 残業オフィスラブ～声が出ちゃうからずっとキス～
synopsis:
Just when things are going smoothly at work, Aoi receives a huge shock when her lover and mentor Maika announces that she's leaving the company at the end of the month! Worried that this could be goodbye forever, Aoi confronts her during a late-night overtime shift, and Maika decides to smooth it all over with a steamy last hurrah at the office where they share so many memories... It's their last chance, so it'd better be one spectacular night!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Noid: Ai no Sukuu Hoshi
title_english: Noid: The Star That Saves Love
synopsis:
In this world, a new alien species named Humanoids or "noids" roam the earth, indistinguishable from regular humans. However, the full moon triggers a transformation in them, though the shape they take differs between each noid. As such, noids are ostracized by society. Near seems to be one such noid and suddenly appears in the mountains where Keiji lives. With no identity and no memories, Near (named "Near" by Keiji) has nowhere to go. Keiji opens up his secluded home in the mountains to Near, knowing full well that what he was doing was a criminal act. But Near doesn't seem dangerous, and Keiji would love the company. It can get so lonely up in the mountains...

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Aioi Focus
synopsis:
Arima, a two-faced honor student, was asked by a teacher to help Mizutani, a delinquent student with poor grades study. However, Mizutani seems disinterested in school, which only agitates Arima. Finally, in a fit of anger Arima reveals his true self. A love story that begins after school hours!

(Source: Shishokan, translated)

title: Kanojo ga Senpai ni NTR-reta node, Senpai no Kanojo wo NTR-masu
title_japanese: 彼女が先輩にNTRれたので、先輩の彼女をNTRます
synopsis:
Yuu Isshiki, a first-year university student, learns that his girlfriend Karen is having an affair with his senior, Kamokura. He was so devastated that he asked Kamokura's girlfriend and the most beautiful girl on campus, Touko: "Please have sex with me!"

If you are the victim of NTR, just return the same treatment back. This is the shocking "revenge" romantic comedy depicting the relationship between the minds and bodies of four college students!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Suiyou Kyoudai
synopsis:
Following her mother's remarriage, Tooko, a 26-year-old office lady, gains a younger brother, Natsu—a boy half her age. Upon their first meeting, Tooko is immediately met with a glare, which gives her the impression that he hates her. Furthermore, as their newlywed parents wish to spend time alone every week, Natsu ends up staying over at Tooko's apartment every Wednesday, filling her with unease during each of their reunions.

After forgetting their meeting and arriving late to her apartment, Tooko panics, believing that she has further angered her brother. However, Natsu unexpectedly starts showing care for her instead, preparing dinner alongside a mocktail—a non-alcoholic cocktail. As the two drink together, they begin to put their feelings into words, revealing their shared desire to grow closer to one another. Hoping to bring this wish to fruition, the siblings start making mocktails every Wednesday, slowly forming an everlasting bond in the process.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Satsuki Matsu
synopsis:
Satsuki is a regular office worker with a little secret: dating his boss, Mr. Matsuri. Although they don't leave the office together, what makes the heart race more than knowing that your lover is waiting for you to go home together? One particular night, Satsuki is invited over to Mr. Matsuri's and is shocked to learn that his boss lives in a run-down, rickety, old apartment. Is there a reason why Mr. Matsuri lives here? That night, Satsuki has a dream from what looks like long ago in history... but it feels so real... a memory...? It surely isn't Satsuki's. So, whose...?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Double Face
synopsis:
Mr. Harui works for "Moonlight Finance," a mediocre loan shark company. His performance is abysmal, but in fact he is the company's shadow proprietor. Harui operates as a debt collector in one of the company's branches. No one knows his true colors except the branch manager Sugamo. But Harui also has another face: super magician, codename Dr. WHOO. He goes out incognito to punish greedy fellows and collects bad debts, using inside information available through his daily work in the branch office.

(Source: Shogakukan, edited)

title: Otona no Zukan Kaiteiban
title_japanese: おとなのずかん改訂版
synopsis:
With those words, Souichiro Kudou's life was changed forever. Suddenly, he has a four-year-old daughter named Kiki, thanks to his late friend Haruki. And it only gets more complicated when he proposes to a total stranger... Husband, lover, father, and friend—only time will tell whether Kudou can reconcile his past with Haruki and learn to fill these roles for the new people in his life. Luckily for him, Kiki and his new spouse, Fusako, are ready and willing to figure it out alongside him!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Kyou mo E ni Kaita Mochi ga Umai @comic
title_english: Let's Eat a Pie in the Sky
title_japanese: 今日も絵に描いた餅が美味い＠COMIC
synopsis:
After forgetting to eat while engrossed in his art, Tougo seemingly wakes up in a mysterious new world filled with all kinds of oddities and wonders. On the verge of starvation, he discovers his drawings become reality! From food to monsters, anything Toguo draws comes to life! As he draws a new life for himself, can he finally find a place where he belongs, or does this brand-new world have something else in store for him?

(Source: TO Books)

title: Occhan Boukensha no Senya Ichiya
title_japanese: おっちゃん冒険者の千夜一夜
synopsis:
"Occhan" is a humble middle-aged adventurer who makes a living accepting jobs from a guild in a certain town. But his true form is a "Shape-Shifter," a dungeon monster. He used his transformation abilities to live a carefree second life in a peaceful human town. Just as he has acquired the life he wanted, he lets his kindhearted nature gets the better of him and he finds himself poking his nose into all kinds of troublesome business. But every time, he uses his transformation skills and his experience in the "monster world" to resolve one incident after another.

(Source: Hobby Japan, translated)

title: Utakata Calendar
synopsis:
Saki Noze works in the Department of Public Relations at Yayagi University. Though he lacks charisma and general social skills, his colleagues care for him like a loving child. Saki Noze is an anxious and timid person. But he knows all that. What he doesn't know is why this young man in front of him is acting so frantic. Who even is he?! Let's rewind... Saki Noze works in the Department of Public Relations at Yayagi University. His facial expressions are hard to read, he lacks social skills, and he has recently slipped on a leaf which rendered him unconscious. When Saki comes to, he is in a hospital bed with no recollection of the past six months... Aha! So this person must be someone he's met within the past six months! Hm... But still... who is he?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Makyou Seikatsu: Gakeppuchi Boukensha ga Hikikomoru ni wa Hirosugiru
title_japanese: 魔境生活 ～崖っぷち冒険者が引きこもるには広すぎる～
synopsis:
After being expelled from his family home, our main character tries his hand at becoming an adventurer, only to find out that things aren't quite as they seem. Determined to change his fate, and with the money he's saved up, he heads out to purchase a plot of land in the remote, unexplored wilderness, with the intent of forging his perfect new life. Little does he know, this expanse is infamous as the "Demonic Realm," a treacherous territory brimming with savage plants and creatures!

But navigating the daily trials of this life-threatening wilderness may prove be a challenge. In his journey of growth, an array of inhabitants, each driven by their motives, decide to follow him, bringing vibrancy back into his life. However, unseen powers resolute in preventing the Demonic Realm from being conquered begin to surface... Will he be able to endure, triumph, and make this land his new home?

(Source: MU)

title: Koori no Shitsuji to Yuuwaku Otome: Atsui Yubisaki de Torokesasete
title_japanese: 氷の執事と誘惑乙女 熱い指先でとろけさせて

title: Gotsugou Simulation
title_japanese: ご都合シミュレーション
synopsis:
Riku Chitose has a boyfriend. Yaichi Kaga. He is comfortable in social situations and having girls around him dress him up and play with his hair. But Riku knows a side of Yaichi that nobody else has seen: his cool side. Coincidentally, Yaichi Kaga has a boyfriend, too. Riku Chitose. He is always so cool and composed. But Yaichi knows a side of Riku that nobody else has seen: his adorable side. Yaichi and Riku go on dates, hug, and kiss. Yaichi and Riku are merrily in love with their boyfriends. Who knows, maybe one day they'll finally be able to talk to each other.

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Melancholic Spiral
title_japanese: メランコリックスパイラル

title: Boku wa Kimi dake no Mono
synopsis:
Ryouhei and Yuuma finally got together and it's been half a year since they've started dating. Yuuma has made a new friend, and seems to have gotten close with him. Ryouhei has become jealous of this. He can't help but think that Yuuma, who tries his best to convey his unwavering feelings with his whole body, is cute. Ryouhei, who should have been a playboy, finally comes to the realization that he can't let go of Yuuma anymore.

(Source: BL Tsundoku Scans)

title: Band of Children
title_japanese: バンドオブチルドレン

title: Motokare x Security
synopsis:
Since dating Miharu in high school, Rikuya Nishiki has been dependent on certain... pleasures. Deeply ashamed, he swears to become a strong, manly man, and gets a job as a bodyguard at a security company. But, part of him can't forget all the dirty things his younger ex-boyfriend taught his body to enjoy. One day, who should turn up but Miharu himself, now a successful novelist, demanding that Rikuya be his bodyguard...! All those suppressed longings and obsessions come rushing back as Miharu casually puts the moves on him, just like old times!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Sweetie Agape
title_japanese: スウィーティーアガペー
synopsis:
Father Lucas seems to attract misfortune wherever he goes. It all started with the fire that took his parents' lives. Since then, he has met numerous pickpockets and swindlers. And now? He has stumbled upon a badly injured man, unconscious in the middle of the woods! Lucas, alarmed, brings the man to the nearest church to tend to his wounds. By some miracle, the man wakes up soon after and seems almost completely recovered, even though the doctor said he might be out for another three days. Just who is this beautifully invincible man!? Has Lucas attracted yet another calamity...?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Turn Up the World
title_japanese: ターンアップザワールド
synopsis:
Yuu is a bandsman who, despite being in the music scene, can't handle women and has never gotten laid. One day, on the way home from a concert, he encounters a suspicious man named Keita Kawabata. Keita instantly takes a liking to Yuu and offers to sleep with him to show him how to overcome his inexperience. But, it doesn't end there. Before Yuu knows it, he finds himself on his back!?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Hatsukoi Note
synopsis:
Shouya, a teenager with no knowledge of love, accidentally stumbles upon the blog of a gay teen while browsing the web. But surprise surprise, he discovers that the author of that blog is a loner in his class called Tsubame Sanjou! It's a story of first crushes with a puppy-like guy and a delinquent.

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

title: Watashi no Otto wa Reitouko ni Nemutteiru
title_japanese: 私の夫は冷凍庫に眠っている
synopsis:
One fateful day, after enduring months of abuse from her husband Ryou, Nana strangles him to death. She revels in her newfound freedom knowing she won't have to face his abuse again. But her dreams of a peaceful life are destroyed when her husband, the one she killed and stuck in the freezer, comes back from the dead.

(Source: Home Hero Scans)

title: Kinyoubi no Baby Violet
title_japanese: 金曜日のベイビーヴァイオレット
synopsis:
Ms. Sumire Mizuno, an efficient office worker has a secret hobby... She wears cute and very erotic lingerie and posts sexy selfies on social media! To relieve the stress of everyday work, she does it on her secret account. But one day, Murasaki, a designer of the company's supplier has identified her by chance. In exchange for keeping it a secret, he makes an unexpectedly serious proposal. He wants Sumire to model the lingerie he designs so he can get feedback and test the texture and functionality of the product in real situations. Puzzled as she has imagined much worse, but mixed with such shame and confusion, she spontaneously asks him to "Have sex with me"!!!

(Source: Takeshobo)

title: Ookisugite Gomennasai!
title_english: Sorry If I'm Too Big For You!
title_japanese: 大きすぎてごめんなさい!
synopsis:
Yuta Sato is a good Samaritan college student who offers a helping hand to Sei Tsutsui. He's stunned when Sei suddenly asks him to marry him. At first, Yuta thinks he's kidding, but the handsome quarter-Russian persists until Yuta gives in and starts dating him. After that, everything seems fine-until they decide to deepen their relationship, and Yuta realizes just how big Sei really is.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Ai no Su e Ochiro!
synopsis:
The low-class gossamer-winged butterfly Tsubasa happens to see Sumiya Nagumo, the son of a distinguished tarantula family. Saved by his words, Tsubasa holds admiration for him. From a single glance, he wants to meet him, and he enrolls in Sumiya's school: Seihoku Academy, where only the elite gather. However, hardships due to his low class awaited him there. On top of that, Sumiya—his only hope—tosses him aside, saying, "I hate gossamer-winged butterflies." Tsubasa had believed that he would be acknowledged, and becomes depressed. At that time, he becomes trapped in the web that Sumiya had laid, where he's injected with an aphrodisiac venom and is held down...?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Makoto no Ai wo Chikaimasu ka: Watashi no Hajimete, Moratte Kudasai
title_english: Shall I Swear True Love, Makoto? Please Be My First
title_japanese: まことの愛を誓いますか～私のハジメテ、もらってください～
synopsis:
Twelve years ago, Makoto-bobo, Airi's surrogate older brother, moved to Tokyo to become a chef. Airi chases him to his bachelor pad in Tokyo, to make good on their childhood promise. So, why does Makoto-bobo still treat Airi like a kid after all this time...? Now's the time for Airi to show him she's a grown woman, so he'll make her his bride!!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Ukkari Osananajimi to Kekkon no Yakusoku wo Shite Shimatteta Kekka
title_english: Promise to Marry Me When I'm Older!
title_japanese: うっかり幼馴染と結婚の約束をしてしまってた結果
synopsis:
Younger kids are often making promises to marry each other, but what happens when one of them takes it seriously? Yuka mistakes a dismissive comment from Ryo that they're meant to be and holds him to it, 10 years later! Ryo is too kind to tell her that was all just childish play, but that just makes things more difficult. Get ready for a series filled with wacky cover-ups and failed attempts to set the record straight!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: BL Drama no Shuen ni Narimashita
title_english: We Star in a BL Drama.
title_japanese: BLドラマの主演になりました

title: Sonna Kao Shitemo Kiss wa Dame
title_japanese: そんな顔してもキスはだめ
synopsis:
"I got a perfect boyfriend that looks like my favorite character!" Tanaka is a college student and an otaku. Suzuki is a guy who's got it all, and is Tanaka's classmate. One day, Suzuki steals Tanaka's first kiss and asks him out. While Tanaka has always secretly admired Suzuki, the pressure from the sudden confession puts him in a panic, and he turns down Suzuki. But Suzuki continues to steal kisses, and it gets Tanaka flustered every time. Tanaka tries to run away from the kisses, but then Suzuki tells him he'll stop trying to kiss him if he starts dating him?!

(Source: Frontier Works)

title: Sake yo Hana Sake!
synopsis:
Upon graduating from an all-boys high school, Tobishima Ichita (18) enrolls in the manga course at an art school. Ichita's genre of choice is Boy's Love (BL) and he has always wanted to connect with girls who love BL just as much as he does. As such, Ichita heads to his first day of class with a dream in his heart! When he arrives, though, his nerves get the best of him—he can't seem to have a normal conversation with a girl. What's more, his class is nothing but girls...! What will become of Ichita?!

(Source: Houbunsha)

title: Yuusha Party wo Oidasareta Shiryou Majutsushi wa Lich ni Natte Maougun de Daisuki na Kenkyuu Life wo Okuru
title_japanese: 勇者パーティーを追い出された死霊魔術師はリッチになって魔王軍で大好きな研究ライフを送る
synopsis:
The strongest necromancer in the hero's party was thought to have lost his life in the midst of battle and was abandoned. However, he had not died. He was revived as a lich, the creature strongest in terms of both physical and magical power, and resolved to leave the human race and live on the side of the demon races. The reason was because among the demon races, he could freely research the necromantic arts in a easygoing environment! With Alice as his partner (a beauty, one of six demon generals), the lich immerses himself in his research. Will the lich really be able to live a life of research in peace and quiet without being disturbed by adventurers!?

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

title: Stripper no Midara na Itazura
title_japanese: ストリッパーの淫らな悪戯
synopsis:
After being dumped by his college girlfriend, Masashi's gal pals drag him to a men's strip club to cheer him up. He finds himself bewilderingly attracted to the club's top dancer, Kaoru, and before long he becomes a regular customer. One day, Kaoru invites him out for drinks. Although Masashi is used to being nothing more than a fan, Kaoru makes a move on him. Kaoru gives him an out: "If you're uncomfortable, you can leave." But after they share a passionate kiss, their relationship changes from one of "a dancer and his fan" to "fuck buddies."

(Source: Funguild/Mobile Media Research)

title: Ittoke!!
synopsis:
Makoto, a man of virtue with a strong sense of justice and camaraderie, works hard to make ends meet. However, he used to be a biker gang's top dog. While he was known as the strongest leader ever, he was also pure, and is still a virgin to this day... Makoto's memories of the day student council member Chigusa Tokuyama stole his first kiss back in high school are as vivid as ever. One day, he happens to run into Tokuyama, now a cop, who claims he can tell if someone is a virgin "just by looking." Tokuyama then pins him to the floor...! The innocent "Mako" is on the verge of panic!! Yet, his heart and body start to yearn for his high-school nemesis!!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Black Lagoon Dokuhon
title_english: Black Lagoon: The Book of Venom
title_japanese: ブラック・ラグーン毒本
synopsis: A booklet sold at Comic Market 76 containing manga, illustrations, and essays by various creators, and the Loser's Horizon column.

title: Realist Maou ni Yoru Seiikinaki Isekai Kaikaku
title_english: The Legend of Rebuilding World by Realist Demon King
title_japanese: リアリスト魔王による聖域なき異世界改革
synopsis:
By the will of a whimsical goddess, the seventy-second Demon King has been reincarnated to rule alongside a chaotic mixture of humans and heroes in another world. The newly minted Demon King Astaroth has been tasked with overseeing the reconstruction of this strange, new land, and as a realist, he will use rarely seen resourcefulness and tactics to reshape the fate of all who live under his reign!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam F90 FF
title_english: Mobile Suit Gundam F90: Fastest Formula
title_japanese: 機動戦士ガンダムF90FF 〈ファステストフォーミュラ〉
synopsis:
In Universal Century 0112, there was the Fastest Formula. They wielded the ultimate, general-purpose weapon: the F90. Seven years following the Mufti Uprising, in the surging wave of mobile suit miniaturization, there was a team operating behind the scenes. These are the records of its various operations.

(Source: Zeonic Scanlations)

title: Kare wa Superstar de Motokare de.
title_japanese: 彼はスーパースターで元カレで。
synopsis:
Mugi can't forget about her middle school boyfriend, Hiraga. Now that he's become the nation-wide famous actor Kouyou Yoshida, Mugi is certain he's forgotten about her. But when she goes to her school's 10-year reunion, she feels someone grab her hand. To her surprise, it's Hiraga! This is her reunited love with her ex-boyfriend who became a superstar.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Dull & Sweet
synopsis:
Naoto Sewa works at a marketing company during the day and at a gay bar at night. During a gay matching party at the bar, Nibu Kazuma, who's straight, mistakes it for a marriage matching party... Sewa saves Nibu from some unwanted attention and sends the man on his way. However, unexpectedly the next day, they meet again at the marketing company where they turn out to be colleagues. While spending time together as colleagues, Sewa can't help but be attracted to Nibu's kindness and sincerity. But Sewa swore that he would never fall in love with a straight man again!

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Ako to Bambi
synopsis:
Horror writer Yuu "Bambi" Kojika has just moved into a new apartment. While the apartment is comfortable, conveniently located, and affordable on his terrible salary, there is a catch: the previous tenant committed suicide in the unit. Despite being a horror writer—or perhaps because of that—Bambi never believed in the supernatural and is completely unfazed by this revelation.

Following the cancellation of his serialization, Bambi's editor suggests that Bambi try writing a supernatural story based on his own experiences for a change. The only issue with this request is that Bambi has never had any other-worldly encounters before. However, just as he begins to lose hope, he notices the elusive spirit of a high school-aged girl appearing in his apartment at night.

The spirit known as Ako is more than willing to give her story to Bambi to write about. At the same time, local high school student Ako Yamashiro has been dreaming about an apartment inhabited by a man who looks awfully simil

title: Shitsukete Tokashite Abaite Medete
title_english: Discipline, Melt, Disclose and Love Me, Please.
title_japanese: 躾けてとかして暴いて愛でて
synopsis:
"Senpai, I'll dominate you to the marrow of your bones."

Sumio Tachibana, an orthopedic surgeon (a resident), has spent his days as a Sub controlling his desires to be dominated and controlled. However, he doesn't have a designated Dom, and remaining in this state will damage him both mentally and physically. Because of this, Sumio decides to visit a Sub-only club... There he meets his old high school kouhai, now a yakuza, Itsumi Wanizuka (Dom). Since he doesn't have a designated Dom, Itsumi urges, "Let me become senpai's dom." A trying story of a jealous young yakuza and a surgeon who really just wants to be spoiled?!

(Source: Media Soft, translated)

title: Hanafuru Futari
synopsis:
Minakami is a successful man tormented by his past. When he meets Kakuta, an upright colleague with a strong sense of justice, he uses his secret to lure Kakuta into his embrace. But fate turns the past that haunts him into a catalyst that brings them closer together.

(Source: MU)

title: Majo to Kishi wa Ikinokoru
title_english: The Witch and the Knight Will Survive
title_japanese: 魔女と騎士は生きのこる
synopsis:
Agredios, the son of a local landowner, arrives home from a long hunt...only to find his village silent and devoid of its usual laughter and commotion. What he discovers is an unimaginable agony that sparks a desire to avenge his fallen people by slaying the witch of the forbidden woods. But is the witch truly as vile as rumors say? A new quest begins: to discover the truth, save lives, and survive.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Onedari mo Kiss mo Hoshikunai
title_english: Don't Beg Me, Don't Kiss Me
title_japanese: おねだりもキスも欲しくない
synopsis:
Part-time cafe worker Kasumi is handsome and sociable, but has a hangup around being begged. Unable to finish with his partners, he couldn't help but wonder if he was the problem. It's around this time that Kasumi starts to take a liking for one of his regulars, Seiichiro. It's just, ever since "Seiichi" showed up to the cafe with his friend, he's been acting weird... Unable to control himself, Kasumi ends up giving Seiichi a kiss, and is thrown off by his reaction! A love story about two men, each with their own traumatic past.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Complex x Jijou
title_japanese: コンプレックス×ジジョウ
synopsis:
Yutaro can't catch a break. He's a decent guy, but he's been dumped, fired and kicked out of his apartment... All because of his angry, gangster-like face! When a friend arranges a job interview, Yutaro hopes his luck is changing. However the man who turns up to meet him looks like a Yakuza, with a flashy shirt, greased hair, and a glare that could burn down buildings. But why is he carrying a bouquet of flowers? And why is the interview in a love hotel? Maybe this Kumazawa guy isn't as rough as he looks. A story of accidental love between a drifter and a florist: two scary-looking men!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Shirouto nanoni Hameraremashita
title_japanese: 素人なのにハメられました
synopsis:
Due to certain circumstances, office worker Hajime ends up working part-time on an adult film set. After making a mistake that ruins the film, he gets put into debt! He's saved from this predicament by the number one actor Yuu, who suggests that he pay back his debt by appearing in a gay adult film. With no other choice, Hajime accepts the conditions, and takes a test in order to appear in an adult film! Even though it's Hajime's first time, Yuu uses his pro techniques to fuck him silly, and even cums inside him.

"This is only the beginning, you know?"

The lovey-dovey, super sadistic sex lessons continue...

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Yankee Ω wa Juuou-sama no Mono!
title_english: Delinquent Omega Belongs to the Beast King!
title_japanese: ヤンキーΩは獣王様のもの!
synopsis:
"I can't believe I wanna be messed up even more... This can't be my body!!" In an unexpected turn of events, a delinquent named Rintarou is transported to another world. Then, all of a sudden, his body starts burning up inside...!? Rintarou is bewildered when Varuna, a beastman with piercing eyes, appears before him. "I'm going to help your body relax." The hands stroking his burning skin are gentle, but the kiss that entwines their tongues is so tantalizing that there's no way he can resist...!! The Alpha beast king who's in love and the stupid yet straightforward delinquent Omega, the king's adoration doesn't stop! An Omegaverse BL story about being reborn in a different world.

(Source: Funguild/Mobile Media Research)

title: Oyaku ni Tatsu node Chi wo Kudasai
title_english: Please Give Me Your Blood, I Will Serve You in Gratitude.
title_japanese: お役に立つので血をください
synopsis:
A young man picked up a vampire girl who collapsed in the street. Although she tries to serve him wholeheartedly to repay him for his blood, she is too clumsy to succeed. A warm slife-of-life interspecies vampire comedy where nobody is left behind or abandoned!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Futari Switch
synopsis:
Shinichi and Ichigo are childhood friends in their first year of high school. Both have someone that they're interested in but can't seem to find a way to get closer to that special person. However, everything changes one summer day, when the power of...a (magical?!) bitter melon switches their bodies!! The two aren't complaining, though, because this is their chance to get closer to their crushes. Just how will the wacky duo manage to do so?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Kekkon ga Zentei no Love Comedy
title_japanese: 結婚が前提のラブコメ

title: Teihen Yuusha dakedo Saikyou Party no Mote Shujinkou Yattemasu.
title_japanese: 底辺勇者だけど最強パーティのモテ主人公やってます。
synopsis:
Through no fault of his own, a low-level hero somehow amasses a party powerful enough to take down the Demon Queen—but not only are they super strong, they're also super affectionate! These handsome men are gunning for his affection as much as they are helping him on his quest, whether he wants them to or not.

Meanwhile at the lair, the Demon Queen is getting impatient over when her knight in shining armor will show up to challenge her...

(Source: MU)

title: Nurarihyon no Hanayome
synopsis:
Nurarihyon no Hanayome is a Japanese-style fantasy romance featuring Tsukiyo, a lonely girl who works in the red-light district. She has a burn scar on her face which she covers with a mask. Holding dear the memories of her late mother, she has soldiered on, facing each day after another.

One day, a mysterious man suddenly chooses Tsukiyo. He is a youkai king named Oboro, who says he is looking for a stone to become a complete youkai. Oboro seems to think that Tsukiyo may have the stone...

"Be my wife and stay by my side."

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Motto Teikou shite Kure yo: Sawayaka Ouji no Yuganda Seiheki
title_english: Resist Me More: The Prince's Secret Fetish
title_japanese: もっと抵抗してくれよ 爽やか王子の歪んだ性癖
synopsis:
Okumura is just another regular playboy who dislikes Karasawa, who's more popular & has better grades. Until one day, Okumura hears from his friend that Karasawa has erectile dysfunction. Okumura tries to oppress Karasawa because of his supposed ED.

(Source: Shusuisha, translated)

title: Oishii Coffee no Irekata
title_japanese: おいしいコーヒーのいれ方
synopsis:
When Izumi Shiori's father is transferred away for his job, Izumi wanted to stay to finish high school so he moves in with his cousins. The younger cousin Joe was just like how Izumi remembered him, but the older cousin Karen has become a beautiful young woman.

(Source: MU)

title: Keikenchi Chochiku de Nonbiri Shoushin Ryokou: Yuusha to Koibito ni Tsuihou sareta Senshi no Mujikaku Zamaa
title_japanese: 経験値貯蓄でのんびり傷心旅行 ～勇者と恋人に追放された戦士の無自覚ざまぁ～
synopsis:
After losing his girlfriend to a brave hero, Tooru is expelled from his S-Rank party. With a feeling of sadness and pain in his heart, he defeats a demon he meets outside the city, and his ability "Saving  Experience" is broken! Tooru becomes level 300 in the blink of an eye!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Usotsuki Omega no Kamasekata
title_english: A Lying Omega's Guide to Getting Bitten
title_japanese: 嘘つきオメガの噛ませ方
synopsis:
Narumiya, an Alpha and a top performer at a trading company, hates his rival Tsukishima, and is passionate about not losing to him. Not only has this made it one of the best selling and most loved manga in Japan, if you include the anime and merch, it supports a trillion yen industry annually.

This is not that manga.

This is the story of the manga’s editor, Kurei Soichi. Once an aspiring manga artist himself, he now has one of the easiest jobs in the world… until he finds himself involved in one of the biggest cover-ups in all of manga history.

During their tussle, she comes into contact with a strange crystal that bestows upon her a wealth of knowledge, transforming her from an innocent child into a cool and calculated planner. Now aware that she was meant to be the protagonist of an otome game and disgusted with her supposed fate, Alicia decides to take matters into her own hands and become strong—by any means necessary. Using her newfound knowledge, and with some help from a stranger she meets in the woods, she learns to survive by herself in a world far too harsh and unforgiving for a girl her age. title: Kuzu demo Dekiru Renairon

title: Niwa-kun no Koi to Bousou

For him, happy high school life is just a fantasy. One day, Noah, a blonde and handsome Canadian student moved to Tsubasa's class. His bright and friendly personality instantly made him popular... But why did he approach, and hold the timid Tsubasa's hands instead?!

"You are my angel!"
"I want to get to know you"
"You are so cute, Tsubasa."

From an awkward friendship to a more-than-platonic love... Niwa-kun's Love and Rampage will certainly warm your day!

They've competed over grades, sports, and even the number of Valentine's chocolates received! And now that they're salesmen at the same company, their rivalry has reignited. One night, while out for drinks, the two begin arguing about who's more experienced in love. Suddenly, their newest competition is set: the winner is whoever makes the other fall in love with them first! But will this competition of hearts really lead to a win or something far more complicated?

"Oniisan, if you haven't left yet, let's go home together."

But recently, there was a little change that occurred in his daily life: Rin Mamiya. She is his sister's best friend. A girl who often comes to their house... At first, their relationship was just that. But now that they go to school together, they go home together, and hang out together on holidays as a matter of course. They also also started to hang out on weekends, and their relationship grew stronger and stronger. Even so, Touma only treats her as a "friend of the opposite sex." But on the other hand, Rin seems to have her own feelings about this relationship...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Haruka Shijouin, a beautiful girl whom he met before, suddenly appears even more innocent and cuter than Shinichirou remembers, and above all, she stares straight at him...

"I feel that you are quite different from the Niihama I knew yesterday. You seem like an adult, but while still keeping your kindness!"

If he could change the future, Shinichirou would, without a doubt, save her after she died following severe bullying. With his adult mentality and corporate powers, he is going to enact his revenge by bringing the best out of his second youth with her!

Udagawa has long convinced himself he has no talent, and Sumisaki lacks the confidence to hold her head high and flaunt her stunning features. Even so, Sumisaki proposes that they switch: Udagawa will have all creative freedom, and she will boldly strut the runway like her mother once taught her. Notable figures from the glamor industry will be watching, but it may prove to be the push Udagawa needs to return to the fashion and beauty scene and conquer it alongside his favorite model.

title: Kimi no Yoru ni Fureru
synopsis:
Chinatsu and his older brother, Fuyuki, have been trained by their father to become professional assassins for their whole lives. However, Fuyuki is slain as a result of Chinatsu failing at his first job. Chinatsu is discovered by a blind boy who lends him a shoulder to cry on.

The trauma still haunts Chinatsu five years later, and he is unable to kill any of his targets as a result. While waiting around the streets, he recovers a stolen object owned by Kasumi, the blind boy he had met back then. As a token of gratitude, Kasumi invites the assassin to his home that is located in a traditional Japanese inn. Chinatsu learns that the boy sees himself as a burden to his family due to his disability.

Despite being complete strangers, Kasumi feels a connection with Chinatsu and asks him to be his friend, to which the assassin readily agrees. But Chinatsu discovers more from being around Kasumi's kindhearted nature, and he realizes he may have found a way through the darkness of his life: a

title: Pink to Habanero
synopsis:
She wants a boyfriend—anyone but him. He wants girls to buzz off. Sucks for them 'cos he's paid to please princesses! High school freshman Mugi can barely muster the confidence to talk to a boy, much less to take one on a date. Plus, the first time she meets Kei Kurose, the wrong sort of sparks fly—even if Kei is head-turningly hot, who could put up with the way he treats girls like trash? Mugi has no patience for his rude attitude, but when she just so happens to discover the scandalous secret of his part-time job, she might have to learn to keep his trust!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Tonari no Stella
title_english: Gazing at the Star Next Door
synopsis:
Chiaki is a pretty normal teenage girl. Since they were kids, she's had a thing for her best friend Subaru—who's fast becoming the hottest young actor in Japan! With Subaru threatening to slip away, Chiaki has a decision to make: Will she finally take her shot, or give Subaru up to his adoring public?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Tiger & Dragon: Osananajimi 3-nin no Otawamure Biyori
title_japanese: たいがー＆どらごん ～幼馴染3人のおたわむれ日和～
synopsis:
When Konomi was five years old, her best friend and neighbor Kagetora moved away. After ten years with no communication, Konomi decides it's time to finally move on from her childhood crush. Luckily, with her other childhood friend Tatsuomi waiting in the wings, it looks like romance is right around the corner. That is, until Kagetora suddenly reappears, and Konomi's love life is thrown into chaos!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Futanari Yodoushi Hatsujouki
title_japanese: ふたなり夜どおし発情期
synopsis:
1. Fuufuritannari.
2. Hitozuma Futanari Mitsudomoe
3-4. Shiawase ni Naritai
5. Goho-bi Triangle

title: Jinsei Keikaku of the End
title_japanese: 人生計画オブジエンド
synopsis:
Sosuke Miki is looking for a very specific kind of relationship. All he wants are fun and purely physical relationships without any commitment whatsoever—so what's he supposed to do when his sales department's highest seller, a younger guy named Tohru Kai, will stop at nothing to tie him down?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Yoichi to Tsugumo: Yuukyuu no Musubi
title_japanese: 与一とツグモ -悠久の結-

title: Baka to Hasami
synopsis:
Yousuke is enjoying a care-free life, living off of a wealthy woman. One day, management of an establishment that forbids sex between staff and their clients, finds out that he's been sleeping with the girls! Yousuke receives punishment as payment for breaking the rules, by having his virgin ass stuffed with a dildo and being forced to wear a chastity device. Yousuke, who's been kicked out of his home as a result of what's happened, confronts the man who is the source of his issues and tells him that he'll be the next one to take him in.

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

title: Akuyaku Reijou wa Nightingale wo Mezasu
title_japanese: 悪役令嬢は夜告鳥〈ナイチンゲール〉をめざす
synopsis:
I reincarnated into the world of a European online novel?!

When I realized I was in a novel world without route branching, I hit a wall from the very beginning for one simple reason. The main character of the original novel is a former doctor, but there is no way I can cheat and do the same. I can't help but wonder what I can do as a former mourning woman against so many capture characters. If this happens, I will aim to become a nightingale in this world!

A medical slapstick romance that involves a former mourning woman who is wild and has not a single romantic bone in her body.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Hagure Yuusha no Isekai Bible
title_japanese: はぐれ勇者の異世界バイブル
synopsis:
Suzuki is an unpopular erotic manga artist whose latest series had just gotten axed. Depressed, he prayed at a shrine for a chance for people to appreciate his work, and he was suddenly sent to a fantastical kingdom. When the king saw Suzuki's books, he was so impressed that he hired Suzuki to be the royal mangaka, and hailed Suzuki as the savior of the kingdom…!?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Hagure Yuusha no Isekai Bible
title_japanese: はぐれ勇者の異世界バイブル

title: Make Heroine wo Katasetai!!
title_japanese: 負けヒロインを勝たせたい!!
synopsis:
In romcoms, the generic main character and the obvious tsundere heroine always end up together but what about loser heroine? This is the story of a losing heroine trying to break that very cliche!

(Source: MU)

title: Ore no Te wa Koi wo Tsukamenai
title_japanese: おれの手は恋をつかめない

title: Akane-banashi
synopsis:
Rakugo, a traditional form of storytelling, takes years for any apprentice to master and ascend to the top rank of shinuchi. Ever since she could remember, Akane Ousaki has been mesmerized by her father Tooru's rakugo performances. Peeking in behind a sliding door, she would spend hours watching and mimicking his work.

For Tooru, the only thing separating him from that coveted rank is a promotion test in front of an audience and a senior rakugo master, Isshou Arakawa. Despite his passionate performance, Tooru finds himself expelled from the rakugo school following the exam. This makes him give up on rakugo entirely and settle for a regular job, breaking his daughter's heart.

Filled with grief and anger, Akane now seeks vengeance on the man who refuses to see the genius behind her father's rakugo style. She begs Tooru's former rakugo master, Shiguma Arakawa, to take her under his wing. But Shiguma feels unworthy of taking on another pupil after what happened to her father six years pr

title: Itose-sensei ni wa Kanawanai.
title_japanese: 愛世先生にはかなわない。
synopsis:
Izumi Watanabe has been in love with Itose-sensei since the day of the school entrance ceremony, when he helped her with some guys who were hitting on her. Since then, Izumi confesses her love for her teacher everyday, but he keeps ignoring her. What can she do to make Itose-sensei notice her?

(Source: MU)

title: Yuuki Aru Mono yori Chire
title_japanese: 勇気あるものより散れ
synopsis:
The Edo period has ended, and former samurai Haruyasu is adrift in a strange new world. Not even the promise of rebellion can cure him of his desire for death. But after an assassination gone wrong, Haruyasu finds himself at the mercy of his intended victim's bodyguard, an intriguing young woman with the power to heal–so intriguing, in fact, that he decides he wants to live in order to learn more about her. But what will she ask in return for saving his life?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Isekai Arigatou
synopsis:
Chiba and Sheina, a pair of single, otaku males in their 30s that met during a highschool reunion! Shortly after hitting it off with each other, they're thrown into one misfortune after another, and before they know it... They got reincarnated in an Isekai as pretty babes!

(Source: Comikey Media)

title: Hijou Kaidan de Aimashou
title_japanese: 非常階段で逢いましょう
synopsis:
Azumi Sasakawa is a proud bottom that has a side job as gay bar bartender. Currently, he only has a casual relationship with Kashima, a handsome interior designer but his interest is actually a patron from neighbor design office, Tomoki Konno. Tomoki was always a bit anti-social and would not even take the same elevator with other customers, moreover, his weak posture invokes Azumi's "motherly" instinct. After an unexpected conversation with the little guy, Azumi assumes Tomoki is cold to him because he is homophobic. Until one night, he met with Tomoki again in Kashima's doorstep... What would happen between these three?

(Source: Torico)

title: Soushite Kimi ni Fureru made
title_japanese: そうして君に触れるまで
synopsis:
For a long time, Shuuhei Ibuki has been in love with Kaoru Tobita, the yakuza boss's son who picked him up. Ibuki stayed close to Kaoru, hiding his feelings. But one day, when he was masturbating while watching Kaoru's drunken sleeping face, Kaoru happened to wake up and hit Ibuki. Because of this incident, Ibuki decided to change their relationship, but Kaoru told Ibuki that he wanted to introduce a woman to him...

"I only want Kaoru, I want to turn you into someone who belongs to me only."

What was revealed later was a pure love mixed with obsession, possessiveness, and desire.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kono Koi wa, Hanabi ga Kieru Shunkan ni
title_japanese: この恋は、火花が消える瞬間に
synopsis:
Shunma Yasaka, a HAMAL member, is a highly anticipated super rookie and former Japanese F3 champion. The man who he admires so much is Falcon, a legendary man who quickly conquered the F1. Yasaka, who was determined to fight on the same track with Falcon someday, is delighted with the news that Falcon's team, Arcturus, will compete in the upcoming season!

"I will face the one I admire the most," Yasaka said with excitement as he drank at the bar.

At that time, a man wearing a mask and sunglasses, who knows about Falcon so much, thought how Yasaka was just like him, so they ended up talking. Even though he suspected that it was too suspicious, he was so immersed in the conversation they had. On the next day, when he arrived at the press conference, surprisingly, the man who sat down and talked to him last night, was the man who he admired the most, Falcon.

(Source: Kasakura Shuppansha, translated)

title: Houkago no Kuroi-san
synopsis:
Kuroi-san's always doing something all by herself after class. And even though she makes sure no one bothers her, one day, a certain person happens to find out what it is she's up to... and next thing he knows, he's declared her accomplice?!

(Source: MU)

title: Kazoku wo Amu
synopsis:
Hiyori is a social worker who works in the association "Hidamari no Ko", which helps families and children in need. We follow her daily life and her very human approach with the people she helps: infertile women wishing to adopt, unwanted pregnancies, etc.

(Source: MU)

title_japanese: 溺れるキスに酔わされて

2. Hoshi ga Yatsu wo Korosu. Sono Mae ni
3. Seki
4. Ace "Erin Brockovich Miman"-hen 
5. Kutsu Himo wo Musube!: "Toumei Sanka"

title: Gogo 0-ji no Kyouhansha
synopsis:
A secret in broad daylight—just by watching you eat, I'm being saved... have I finally gone mad?

A protagonist who hides his small appetite because of a past trauma, and a heroine who doesn't tell anyone that she's a big eater. What do these two do on the rooftop at noon...?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Star Eater: Mozou Crystal Sakuhinshuu
title_japanese: スターイーター 模造クリスタル作品集
synopsis:
1. Cauldron Bubble Dokubutsu-ten
2. Star Eater
3. Zach no Dungeon
4. Nemultein no Bouken

title: Chikyuugai Shounen Shoujo
synopsis:
In the year 2045, Internet and artificial intelligence have become widespread in the outer space. Following a massive accident at a space station, a group of children are left behind. Using narrowband and SNS, low intelligence AI, and smartphone-controlled drones, they overcome numerous crises.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Kimi no Nioi
synopsis:
Ito, a hairdresser, decided to rent a share-house in Tokyo. As he moved in, he noticed a sweet, nostalgic scent. There, at the same day, another person came to move in on the same house. It was Takehisa Hijiri, his close friend that he fell in love with!

Ito has a body that ends up getting excited whenever he smells Hijiri's scent. Because it was between men – a love that will never come true – he thought of giving up, but his body still reacts?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Shikisaki Shimai wa Abakaretai
title_japanese: 四季崎姉妹はあばかれたい
synopsis:
One day, Tarou Yamada, who runs a detective business, slips on a banana peel and is reincarnated as Tsukushi Shikisaki, who is the younger brother of three beautiful sisters and who died on the same day. He ends up spending his time surrounded by three beautiful sisters, but he realizes that Tsukushi Shikizaki was killed by one of his three sisters...?!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: When the Day Comes
synopsis:
Norang and Paran are known at school to be the perfect couple—minus the fact that they've already broken up. But unable to back out of a promise to participate in their school's dance festival as their class's representative couple, they decide to keep their split a secret, just until the competition is over. As the day of the festival—and their "official" break-up—approaches, the two begin to realize that ending their relationship may not be as simple as they thought.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Sono Shukujo wa Guuzou to Naru
title_japanese: その淑女は偶像となる
synopsis:
It unfolds here... The story of a girl who gave up on being an idol. Himemiya Sakurako is a student from Elizabeth Girls' School. She is popular in the school for being the role model of a lady. However, that was merely a mask she wore...?!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Ikemen Douryou ga Ore no Juukakin Fan deshita
title_japanese: イケメン同僚が俺の重課金ファンでした
synopsis:
Your love (donations) is too much to bear!!!

Unbeknownst to those around him, Shirafuji is a game streamer who goes by "Shirocho" online. At work, he hides his love for games and "camouflages" himself as a nice young man. He also finds it hard to deal with his naturally exuberant and handsome co-worker, Meguro. However, he discovers that Meguro is actually his hardcore top donor fan who has been constantly donating hefty amounts during his streams...?!

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

title: Hizamazuite Ai wo Tou
synopsis:
A world where two sexes exist: Subs, who wants to be a dominated, and Doms, who wants to dominate people. Masami, who works at a sub-only club, is ordered by Yuusei, a transfer student...!?

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

title: Te wo Nobashitara, Tsubasa
title_japanese: 手を伸ばしたら、つばさ
synopsis:
Chikara is a university student working hard on his research for his childhood dream, hoping to someday achieve flight. One night, he witnesses the secret on the back of Satomi, a transfer student with a perfect body and face. The two quickly grow closer, but there is a side to Satomi that Chikara does not know.

(Source: Denpa)

title: Your Majesty, Please Spare Me This Time
title_english: Your Majesty, Please Spare Me This Time
synopsis:
The day 18-year-old Laliette Isabelle De Bellua died is forever etched in her mind. Her entire family already six feet under on false charges of treason, she is sent to the gallows with her sentence being handed down by the tyrannical Emperor Rupert Edgar Laspe Vellelum. In contrast to his ethereal beauty, he has bathed himself in blood; not even his wife was free from the carnage, falling victim to his hand on their wedding night.

After meeting her end, Laliette awakens in the past on her 12th birthday. Despite having knowledge of the grim future, the only way she can think of to save her beloved family is to endear herself to the bloodthirsty Rupert before his rise to power. There is only one problem: Rupert is currently living as a woman—the oft-forgotten "Princess Rapertte," whom no one wants to serve. With little in her pocket, Laliette runs away from home to pledge herself to Rapertte, hoping to one day earn the princess's trust and save the people she treasures.

[Written by MA

title: Kono Kyouai wa Tensai desu
synopsis:
Because of their evil deeds, the Four Perils had their bodies sealed in a rocky mountain. After the death of Matsuei's grandfather, they make their return. Having mistakenly swallowed the magatama that contained their power when she was little, she becomes their target.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: A DeadbEAT's Meal
synopsis:
What's better than a good meal? My name's Jaeho and I love food. While some may call me a deadbEAT because I don't have a job at the moment, I'm just your normal happy guy who loves eating and my girlfriend of 7 years... That is until I got a breakup text yesterday... Where did things go wrong? I keep trying to look back through the years, but I just can't figure it out...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Miriam Blue no Mizuumi
title_japanese: ミリアム・ブルーの湖
synopsis:
A love story of a sweet girl, Miriam Blue, whose heart vacillates between her unpredictable boyfriend, Henri, and her step-brother Laurie.

(Source: MU)

title: Lorient no Aoi Sora
synopsis:
Claudine moves to the countryside from Paris when her father hits bankrupcy and commits suicide and she's left all alone...

(Source: MU)

title: Shousetsu Candy Candy: Final Story
title_japanese: 小説 キャンディ･キャンディ FINAL STORY

title_japanese: 先生、いじわるしないでください
synopsis:
1-3. Sensei, Ijiwaru shinaide Kudasai
4-5. Konna Ore demo Kimi ga Suki

title: Dakara Hoikushi wa Kunou suru.
title_japanese: だから保育士は苦悩する。
synopsis:
1-3. Dakara Hoikushi wa Kunou suru. (That's Why Nursery Teachers Suffer)
4. Hoshi no Shita de (Under The Stars)
5. Hoshikute Tamanarai (Dying to Have It)
6. Imasara dakedo (After All This Time)
7. Sonogo mo Hoikushi wa Kunou suru.

title: Junkoku no Alpha: Omega Versailles
title_japanese: 殉国のアルファ～オメガ・ベルサイユ～
synopsis:
The French Revolution, which started with the king, sent many citizens to the guillotine, "exporting" the momentum of democratization to countries around the world—marking a turning point in history. But underneath the surface, there was another world that none were aware of...

18th century France—this was a time where the world's royalty, nobility, and commoners were separated into a 3-tier system, α (alpha), β (beta), and Ω (omega).

King Louis XVI was known as the "dim-witted α." Queen Marie Antoinette, who married in from a neighboring country in a political marriage, was ridiculed as the "lustful Ω." Then there was a certain girl who held a grudge against the royal family...

Seeking, hating, deceiving... A swirling conspiracy emerged, catching everyone in a revolutionary storm!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Ouchi ni Kaerou
synopsis:
Mei, who lives in Kyoto, is a big fan of Iori Tachibana, a very successful author who's also a university student! When she comes to Tokyo to work as a live-in housekeeper, she finds out that Iori is in reality... a man?! Furthermore, his language is bad and he has a cold demeanor... the exact opposite of the image of a person who writes gentle and heart-touching novels. The exciting life in a share house is about to begin...?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Machi no Yakuza to Panya-san
title_japanese: まちのヤクザとパン屋さん
synopsis:
Hatori, an intellectual Yakuza, has a secret hobby of visiting bakeries. He discovered a certain bakery that is open late at night run by the baker Ayase, and engages in a lively discussion about pastries. But when he woke up, he discovered that he's being "eaten" by Ayase...?! A "delicious" and "dangerous" relationship between a baker and a yakuza.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Machi no Yakuza to Panya-san Kiwami
title_japanese: まちのヤクザとパン屋さん 極

title: Umi Hime Mare
synopsis:
Nirai Canai, the underwater kingdom that lies on the far side of the ocean. Mare, the mermaid princess of the kingdom, is angry at the humans who pollute the sea. However, her father, the king, doesn't even try to deal with it. When Mare reaches the end of her patience, in a decaying cave, she finds out the existence of a great "Queen of the Sea" who once ruled over all. Mare's admiration for the Queen grows, but when she learns that the "divine arrow" with which the Queen is sealed in has been stolen by humans, she decides to go to land. Where she lands is a small island called Mitaka Island, inhabited by humans.

(Source: Kyoto Animation, translated)

title: Mushijo
synopsis:
The main character, Hinako Yomotsuki, is a high school girl who loves the anime "Puri Puri" and devotes all her energy into otaku activities.  However, in actuality, when she unites with a mysterious "Maji" centipede life form, she becomes a distorted hero who saves people. Now she fights both to save the town assailed by "Maji" and to protect her unrequited crush, Himuro-senpai.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Osananajimi ja Gaman Dekinai
title_english: I Can't Stand Being Your Childhood Friend
title_japanese: 幼馴染じゃ我慢できない
synopsis:
Aoi and Ryouta have been friends for as long as they can remember, so when it comes time to head off to college, it only makes sense for them to room together! Practically joined at the hip, they are convinced that their relationship will stay the same forever...until one day, Aoi wakes up to find Ryouta leaning in to kiss him! Now Aoi must unpack this bewildering development, but he just can't seem to forget Ryouta's touch...

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: 100-mankai Kiss shitai!
synopsis:
Yuu is a college drop out who works part time, but he's at his happiest point in his life so far. He just started to become really intimate with his girlfriend Saya and they can’t keep their hands off each other. But Yuu’s stepsister, Sana, suddenly pops into his life after 5 years. They were separated when their parents divorced and with their mother getting remarried, Sana could not stand living with her anymore. With nowhere else to go, Sana starts living together with Yuu, but at 19 years old, she has grown into her body. Yuu is torn between the two women in his life and has to pick one or risk losing both of them.

(Source: MangaHelpers)

title: Jimikei Iinchou wa Okane ga Nai!
title_english: The President Needs a Quick Buck
title_japanese: 地味系委員長はオカネがない!
synopsis:
Nana needs some money to buy makeup and clothes like all the other attractive girls. She does that by looking for a sugar daddy, but what she has to swallow ends up being very salty indeed...

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Manbiki Hitozuma Soushuuhen
title_english: The Reason Why I Shoplifted Anthology
synopsis:
All of the shoplifters are together now in one collection! Whether it's a housewife stealing meat for dinner, a teacher stealing clothes to look cuter, or a gyaru stealing for fun, they all meet the inescapable justice of unforgettable sex.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Icha Love Temptation
title_japanese: いちゃらぶテンプテーション
synopsis:
1. Yukionna no Mayoiga de Icha Love Harem Seikatsu (Spirited Away to the Snow Women's Harem)
2. Maeda-san Chi no Succubus Jijou (Succubus Situation)
3. Natsu no Kami, Hitoshizuku (A Teardrop for the Deity of Summer)
4. Yarimoku Night Pool

title: Suiei-bu no Mukuchi de Otonashii Tsukishima-san wa H ni Kyoumi Shinshin
title_english: The Cool Beauty from the Swim Club Is Mad About Sex
title_japanese: 水泳部の無口で大人しい月島さんはHに興味津々
synopsis:
A P.E. coach is shocked when the cool, composed swimmer Tsukishima approaches him requesting he teach her all he knows about sex. Despite her antisocial leanings, she turns out to be an eager student and a fast learner when it comes to the art of lovemaking!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Homestay Harem wa Totsuzen ni!?: Itsuki-kun, Saikin Onna no Ko to Sumi Hajimetan datte
title_english: Homestay Harem: Itsuki's Roomies Are Girls!?
title_japanese: ホームステイハーレムは突然に!?-樹くん、最近女の子と住み始めたんだって-
synopsis:
Itsuki lives in a big house all on his own. One day, a foreign girl starts living at his house and things get steamy in the bathroom. Itsuki's childhood friend catches them in the act, and to Itsuki's surprise, she joins in on the fun!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Seifuku Gal to Doutei Kyoushi no Himitsu no Seikyouiku
title_japanese: 制服ギャルと童貞教師の秘密の性教育
synopsis:
The school's got a legendary problem student, Yuri Takanashi, and it's up to newbie teacher Nozomi Yamane to set her straight! The only problem is... he's a total push-over. And now Yuri's shown up to her guidance meeting with a lesson plan of her own for this virgin teacher!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Machikirenai Kouhai Kanojo Tsujinaka-chan
title_japanese: 待ちきれない後輩彼女辻中ちゃん

title: Soukou Akki Muramasa: Makai-hen
title_japanese: 装甲悪鬼村正 魔界編
synopsis:
Takes place right after the True Ending of the visual novel. Kageaki Minato accepts a request from a man known as the Patriarchal Priest, who wants to be protected from musha who share the names of the legendary Japanese heroes of old.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Minus Skill Mochi Yonin ga Atsumattara, nanka Synergy Hakki shite Saikyou Party ga Dekita Ken
title_english: How Four Negative Skills = Unrivaled Synergy
title_japanese: マイナススキル持ち四人が集まったら、なんかシナジー発揮して最強パーティーができた件
synopsis:
Minus Skill. A negative debuff possessed by a select few since birth. A swordsman who has one such skill is once again in the throes of being thrown out of another party. Despite his abilities, that single skill had a huge downside, which would make him a burden to any would-be adventuring partners. 

Sick and tired of the never-ending cycle, he has taken it upon himself to challenge a dungeon that may possess an item that could remove a skill of his. There, he meets a girl with the Priestess class who also has a Minus Skill but...

"Eh? Aren't our skills synergistic? Negatives coming together to form a positive!"

This is the story of people exiled from parties, who possess Minus Skills, banding together to eventually become the strongest party.

(Source: Novel Updates)

title: Juliet wo Ute
synopsis:
Amidst the dark glamor of host club Velvet Kiss, Juri—also called Juliet—commands a vice-like grip on the number one position. 1. Koisuru Tsubaki wa Shoya ni Saku
2. Koisuru Tsubaki wa Shoya ni Saku: Bukiyou na Ai no Minorasekata
3. Himitsu no Douryou-kun
4. Sabishii Usagi no Koiwazurai
5. Shinomiya (Ani) no Renai Jijou

title: Amagami wo Kimi ni
synopsis:
In the present day where humans and werebeast are living in harmony, there is something that has been bothering Matsumoto, a Kishu weredog, who actually likes cats. It a about a male calico cat that kept appearing when he was feeding the cats near the school as part of his daily routine. And... there's also the fact that he finds Sasaki, a student from the same seminar, to be cute. One day, he found out that Sasaki is a werecat as well as that calico cat. And from then on, he can cuddle and pet Sasaki's cat form all he wants! But the more time they spend together, the more Matsumoto's feelings for Sasaki go in a direction other than friendship... This is a fluffy sweet werebeast love story between a quiet Kishu weredog who likes to take care of others and an honestly sweet werecat who start out as friends.

(Source: Kasakura Shuppansha, translated)

title: Koi wa Inamono Komarimono
title_japanese: 恋は異なもの困りもの
synopsis:
One day, Takeda, an overly serious model student, suddenly received a passionate confession of love from his rival Fukamachi, a frivolous elite who's top tier in looks, brains and athletic abilities. Takeda has only ever seen Fukamachi in a hostile manner and he's been going all out in rejecting the latter's persistent advances. Then one night, he got dragged into helping Fukamachi who was out helping his private detective brother to look for a lost cat. That's when Takeda saw an unexpected side of Fukamachi who he always thought he would never be able to get along with... This is the bumpy high school romance between a carefree, frivolous and handsome natural genius and an overly serious and straightlaced model student who just don't get along. 

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Included one-shot: Sashinomi

title: Mangaka-sensei to Zashiki Warashi
title_japanese: マンガ家先生と座敷わらし
synopsis:
After moving in his new place, a mangaka is now pretending he can't see the Zashiki Warashi​ who was already living here.

(Source: MU)

title: Bad Girl
synopsis:
What does one do when you have a crush on the president of the public morals club? Well, if you're first-year high school student Yuu, the answer is turning to a life of delinquency! In a bid for the president's heart, Yuu becomes a self described "bad girl" hoping to thrill and excite her crush. But Yuu's adorableness (despite her best efforts) outshines any attempts to come off otherwise—and the president can't see past that tiny, adorable exterior. What's a girl got to do to get in trouble around here?!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Ryuu to Ayumu Nariagari Boukensha-dou: Youzumi toshite S-Rank Party kara Tsuihou sareta Kaifuku Majutsushi, Suterareta Saki de Saikyou no Shinryuu wo Fukkatsu sasete Shimau
title_japanese: 竜と歩む成り上がり冒険者道～用済みとしてSランクパーティから追放された回復魔術師、捨てられた先で最強の神竜を復活させてしまう～
synopsis:
Dion, a healer, was thrown into the deepest part of a dungeon in a plot by his fellow party member. As he was facing certain death, he found a wounded dragon there. Dion healed the dragon with the last of his strength, and it turned out that it's a divine dragon named Eldora. Now that Eldora has regained her power, she will join Dion the exiled healer on a journey together as adventurers. Meanwhile, Yuki, the leader of the party that ditched Dion, was searching for him alone...

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

title: Ore no Shoukanjuu, Shinderu
synopsis:
In an academy for summoners, students combine impressive stores of magical energy with artful incantations to usher legends, great and small, onto the battlefield. Feil Fonaf, an eighteen-year-old son to a poor farmer, may have had a rougher upbringing than his more affluent peers, but he's here to prove he deserves his spot at the academy! As luck would have it, his counterpart summon winds up being the legendary god-slaying beast, Pandora! There's just one problem...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Reisei na Kanojo
synopsis: A girl who's always calm finds a boy underneath her bed. How does she react?

title: Macho★Max
synopsis:
Saburou, a first-year university student whose daily life consisted of nothing but laziness, found the joy of muscle training and started hanging out in the bodybuilding club. Will Saburou be able to lose his belly and change himself...? Or perhaps...

(Source: Densho Bato, translated)

Included one-shot: Otokotachi no Houkago Gym

title: Futsuu no Onnanoko ni Modoritai
title_japanese: ふつうのおんなのこにもどりたい
synopsis:
Nanami Naruse is a former member of the idol group "Seishun Junjou Otome Girls." After graduating from her idol activities, she returns to her parents' house in the countryside, where she meets Naoto Kusaka, a handsome high school student. Naoto, who is cool and open-minded, seems to misunderstand the baby-faced Nanami as a younger, middle school student...

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

title: Ijiwaru na Tsugai
synopsis:
After being abandoned by his influential family for being an Omega, Akito Kisaragi sells his body for a living. On his way after work he got kidnapped by some masked men only to be sold at some underground auction. Reiji Asahina aka "the ruthless prince," of the Asahina Group brought him for 3 billion. Akito, who thought that he will be treated as a slave and plaything, is shocked when Reiji asked him to bear his child?! Akito, who has experienced a lot, didn't think much before accepting the offer. Akito, who always hated the omega heat, ends up yearning for it while being embraced by Reiji.

(Source: MU, edited)

title: Tachi Neko Soudatsu BL
synopsis: An anthology of boys love short stories by various mangaka.

title: Chikyuu no Ko
synopsis:
A regular person falls in love with a superhero who protects Earth! In terms of circumstances, ability, experience—they are from two different worlds, but they get to know each other, support each other, and then... A unique love story on a planetary scale now begins!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Going Ubatte♡Oujisama!
title_english: Take Me By Force, Sweet Prince!
synopsis:
1-4. Going Ubatte♡Oujisama!
5. Yappari♡My Prince
6-8. Hapiseku: Happy Sex Triangle
9. No 3P, No Life?!

title: Ore no Soutei shiteita H na Tensei Life wa Kore ja Nai
title_japanese: 俺の想定していたHな転生ライフはこれじゃない

title: Boys Rumble
synopsis:
For Misao Saijou, a high school teacher in his thirties, love has become such a distant concept for him that even his students make fun of him for it. One night, while drinking alone at a bar, he runs into Ryouhei Takashi, a teaching materials sales rep that he barely knows. However, he's never seen Takashi look like this before...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Boku no Barber e Youkoso
title_japanese: 僕のバーバーへようこそ
synopsis:
On the wedding day of the best friend he's always been in love with, Iga decided to go to a barber shop to get a long overdue hair cut. A story about a barber and a salaryman with no confidence.

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

title: SOTUS
synopsis:
SOTUS is an educational system in which upperclassmen impose "trials" upon underclassmen. Arthit, leader of the engineering seniors, plans to put his new juniors through a harsh training regimen to earn the symbol of their major—the gear. However, a first-year named Kongpob causes new headaches for Arthit when he declares he'll snatch the gear from him: "I'll make you my wife!"

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Nigoru Hitomi de Nani wo Negau: Highserk Senki
title_japanese: 濁る瞳で何を願う　ハイセルク戦記
synopsis:
Raizou Takakura, who died of a heart attack, was reborn in another world as the third son of a penurious farmer. He is known as Walm in his second life and he has been living as a soldier for the Highserk Empire, a small country currently being invaded by the surrounding large countries.

To survive, Walm was forced to spend his days killing people left and right. The Highserk empire decided to point their fangs toward their enemy and plotted a great invasion battle against the principality of Myard as well as the Ferrius Kingdom. This led to Walm being covered in blood and witnessing the dying breaths of comrades and enemies alike, as well as learning of the fine line between life and death.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo!: Fantastic Days
title_english: Konosuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World! Fantastic Days
title_japanese: この素晴らしい世界に祝福を! ファンタスティックデイズ
synopsis:
Follow Kazuma and his party as they help a team of aspiring dancers, fight a former general of the Demon King, and more in a series of adventures based on the Fantastic Days game, along with new, unique content!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Eigyou desu kara
synopsis:
In order to be pampered by girls, Ren has been "Selling BL" (fanservice) by flirting with Issei, a handsome guy who attends the same college. But one day, Ren is suddenly kissed by Issei?! A fascinating love comedy that begins with a lie.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Tsumugu to Koi ni Naru Futari
title_japanese: つむぐと恋になるふたり
synopsis:
The manga centers on Tsumugi, who isn't good at socializing with others, when suddenly she moves and ends up becoming a freeloader at the house of a manga artist named Ryoutarou.

(Source: ANN)

title: Kagami no Kojou
synopsis:
In a tranquil neighborhood of Tokyo, seven teenagers wake to find their bedroom mirrors are shining. At a single touch, they are pulled from their lonely lives to a wondrous castle filled with winding stairways, watchful portraits and twinkling chandeliers. In this new sanctuary, they are confronted with a set of clues leading to a hidden room where one of them will be granted a wish. But there's a catch: if they don't leave the castle by five o'clock, they will be punished. As time passes, a devastating truth emerges: only those brave enough to share their stories will be saved.

(Source: Doubleday)

title: Hahaoya ga Ero Ranobe Taishou Jushou shite Jinsei Tsunda
title_japanese: 母親がエロラノベ大賞受賞して人生詰んだ
synopsis:
My mom, Mirei, wrote a mother-son incest ero light novel that won an award. For some reason, I ended up accepting the award instead. ...wait, what the hell?! And the high school girl author who also won an award is my crush... Ahh, I'm done for. My life is over.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Mazu wa Oishii Gohan wo Tabeyou
title_japanese: まずは美味しいご飯を食べよう
synopsis:
A delicate story in which a man who is trapped in his own mind gradually expands his world with the help of cooking and love.

(Source: MU)

title: Kimidori
synopsis:
"Will you take pictures of ghosts for me?" Shouma, whose hobby is photography, meets a person while searching for a photography subject after school. The person, Akira Uguhara, with tears in his beautiful yellow-green eyes, was drawing a picture of someone without a face. Shouma, who couldn't forget him, visits his class the next day and asks him to become his model. He refuses bluntly, but Shouma, who can't give up, persistently tries to find out more about Akira...? A curious and lively photographer and a hazel-eyed boy with a closed-off heart... The clumsy and conflicted youth of immature high school boys.

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: Kakureboshi wa Kokoro wo Tsunaide: Konyaku wo Kaishou shita Ato no, Oishii Gohan to Koi no Ohanashi
title_japanese: 隠れ星は心を繋いで～婚約を解消した後の、美味しいご飯と恋のお話～
synopsis:
Alicia, the youngest daughter of the Bloom Trading Company, which does business with neighboring countries, is cheated on by the son of a viscount and demands that they end their engagement...?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Dekiai nante Mitomemasen!
title_japanese: 溺愛なんてみとめません!
synopsis:
It's been half a year since Naoto and his best friend, Toudou, became lovers. After many twists and turns, their relationship is going so well that Naoto stays at Toudou's house every weekend!!! Although their relationship is out in the open, the two decide to have a proper talk with Naoto's mother. However, the situation rolls in an unexpected direction...

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

Included one-shot: Uchi no Tama wa Challenger

title: Kimi ni Kanaderu Boku no Oto
Kimi Gazer
synopsis:
Working in a bento shop, Arata cannot help but be curious about Shun, a young boy who regularly comes to buy food. However, he stops appearing all of sudden. One day, Arata awakes in the other world after saving a dog from drowning in a river. He has to stay in a hotel before passing on—and out of all places, that is where he meets Shun again! A heartfelt love story about a lethargic guy and a straightforward delinquent that unfolds in the afterlife.

(Source: Home-sha, translated)

title: Kioku Soushitsu ni Natta node, Kazoku no Naka de Ichiban Shinyou Dekisou na Oniisama wo Tayoru Koto ni Shimashita
title_japanese: 記憶喪失になったので、家族の中で一番信用できそうなお兄様を頼ることにしました

title: Boku ga Shiranai Kimi no Kao
synopsis:
Aoba, a third-year university student, is living with his childhood friend Shou, who is one year younger than him. Except for the small apartment they share, their life together was quite comfortable, but one rainy day, Shou came home soaking wet and crying, and ever since then, Aoba can't get that crying face out of his head.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Koi wa Isogaba Maware Migi: Anzai Karin Tanpenshuu
