1. Koi wa Isogaba Maware Migi
2. Gojiai Kudasai, Yakumo-kun
3. Kakeru Hanabi to Warau Kimi
4. Renai Category
5. Minohodo Shirazu no Hero

title: Happy Parasite
synopsis:
One night, Kazuhisa, a company employee who doesn't like getting involved with others, meets Haru, a backpacker lying down on the street. Surprised and annoyed by his decision, Kazuhisa decided to let Haru, who had trouble sleeping, stay with him. Kazuhisa is swayed by the brazenness and energy of Haru, while he tries to take care of him the best he can. To top it all off, Haru tries to repay Kazuhisa with his body...?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Included one-shot: Kotae no Kazu dake

title: Hoshoku Taishou Hinadori-kun Encore
title_japanese: 捕食対象ひなどりくん アンコール

title: Hetare to Bakatare
synopsis:
Yoshiro has had hidden, unrequited feelings for his childhood friend, Dai, for several years. He constantly turns down cute girls when they ask him out. Oblivious to Yoshiro's feelings, Dai envies Yoshiro's popularity with girls, and always makes a fuss about wanting a girlfriend. Yoshiro has no intention of ever telling his airheaded friend the truth and resigns himself to a life of fluxing between appreciation for their friendship and sorrow that they can't be more. That is, until one day when the two are invited to a mixer, where Yoshiro somehow ends up dragging Dai to a motel and tries pushing him down on the bed...! This is a tantalizing love story about how a loser with unrequited feelings and his airheaded childhood friend become a couple.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Noumin Kanren no Skill bakka Agetetara Nazeka Tsuyoku Natta.
title_japanese: 農民関連のスキルばっか上げてたら何故か強くなった。
synopsis:
To live as a top-class farmer, Al Wayne leveled up his agricultural skills, and sometimes his other skills by helping out his friends. One day, when his last skill level hit MAX, his life changes.

"I want to live as a farmer!!"

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Inma Tsuihou: Hentai Gift wo Sazukatta Sei de Outo wo Owareru mo, Onnanoko to "Nakayoku" suru dake de Chouzetsu Level Up
title_japanese: 淫魔追放～変態ギフトを授かったせいで王都を追われるも、女の子と”仲良く”するだけで超絶レベルアップ～
synopsis:
A world where one's life is decided by one's talent, called a "Gift." The main character, Erio Scarlet, who was born in the house of an influential noble family that had produced a lot of Holy Knights, manifested a suspicious Gift called "Incubus" in the conferment ceremony. Furthermore, the only skill attached to that Gift was one embarrassingly called "Peerless."

Erio was banished from the city because there was no way his indecent existence could be permitted in a family of Holy Knights, but... somehow he went through an amazing growth when he dealt with his horniness?! In addition, when his childhood friend who was bestowed with the Gift "Sacred Knight" chased after him and reverse ra... did it with him, a lot of powerful indecent skills showed up, and on top of that they even got bound by Master-Servant contract...?!

This is the indecent heroic tale of the boy who was gifted with and indecent Gift rising in the world while "getting along" with a lot of girls.

(Source: Kakuyomu,

title: Bad Romance Freak Show
title_japanese: バッドロマンス・フリーク・ショー
synopsis:
Hiiragi, a good-natured art student, has a secret hobby. He likes to peep into people's lives by using his planted listening devices at home and receiving radio waves from taxis and trucks. Despite his peaceful campus life, Hiiragi is facing a crisis. For some reason, he hasn't been able to get it up for the last 3 months, no matter what he did. One day, Hiiragi's crotch reacts to the panting sounds of a man on his radio. As Hiiragi searches for the man owning the erotic voice, the owner of the panting sounds, a serious-looking, handsome librarian names Kurosuda, shows up in front of him.

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: Shojo wo Chirasu Heya: Kimoota no Boku ga Class no Gal-tachi no Shojo Soushitsu ni Tsukiau Koto ni Natta Ken
title_english: No Virgins Allowed: The Time a Creepy Otaku Like Me Helped the Class Gyarus Lose Their Virginity
title_japanese: 処女を散らす部屋ーキモオタの僕がクラスのギャル達の処女喪失に付き合うことになった件
synopsis:
A group of besties wanted to make their first times special, but they ended in disappointment. Will a weird otaku in the same class be the one to give them a night to remember? 

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Hinata no Blue
synopsis:
The story starts with Hinata Naru entering the first year of high school. She had always been a quiet girl who would only hang out with her childhood friends You-chan and Micchan, but decided to change her ways after entering high school. She wanted to make many new friends, but had been having a hard time doing so due to her shyness; her life takes a turn for the better, though, after she meets the student council president Natsuno Sora and he becomes her first friend! And also... maybe something more?

(Source: MU)

title: Taishuu Sakaba Wakao: Wakako-zake Betten
title_japanese: 大衆酒場ワカオ ワカコ酒別店
synopsis:
The manga centers on a small bar, which is a 15-minute walk from the nearest train station, and located in a questionable part of town. A man named Wakao owns the bar, and he always serves customers with a serious look on his face. He doesn't think his bar is that big of a deal compared to other bars in the area, and he serves a regular menu consisting of things like rolled omelettes and clams.

(Source: ANN)

title: A Villainess for the Tyrant
synopsis:
The beautiful illegitimate daughter of the Navitan Kingdom's royal family, Cecile Franvier, has been selected as the bride of the Arkia Empire's notorious Emperor Estian. He is a heartless despot who possesses inhuman strength, and all surrounding countries live in constant fear of his savage conquests. Everyone treats Cecile as if marrying Estian means she is certain to die soon—and she refuses to go down without a fight.

Cecile pretends to be a wretched woman who will never tremble before the tyrannical Estian. She demands that he carry her to the altar, and she is not sure which is more surprising—that the emperor complies or how handsome he is. As the new empress, Cecile becomes an immediate target of various assassins. However, Estian takes a liking to her, revealing one way she can survive: she must become a villainess infamous enough to outshine even him!

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Okaasan to Issho ga Tsurakatta
title_japanese: おかあさんといっしょがつらかった
synopsis:
To everyone who is a parent, to everyone who is someone's child. Till the author who was raised by "toxic parent" severs her ties with her painful past and gains a happy present.

Hurling insults on her children, being violent at every turn, making them follow a new religion she blindly accepted, and, on top of all that, shuts herself in a dirt room and escapes to alcohol... how difficult her life was living "together with such a mother." How did she escape from such an environment and started her life over again? This is a manga essay that gently approaches not only those who are struggling with family relationships, but also those who have stumbled and stopped in all kinds of human relationships.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

3. Ano Sora no Kanata ni

synopsis:
1. Angelus no Kane
2-3. Ashita e Kakeru Hashi

title: Gozen 2-ji made Kimi no Mono
synopsis:
Michio has liked his close friend Kyouichi ever since their school days. Having never confessed his feelings, their platonic relationship continues as he turns 21. When Michio awakens one morning, he finds the world around him unfamiliar. He is 29, and the sleeping face next to his is... From Waku Okuda comes a lovely, heartrending, post-midnight countdown love story.

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

title: Medarot: Girls' Mission
title_japanese: メダロット ガールズミッション

title: Ooyukiumi no Kaina
title_english: Kaina of the Great Snow Sea
synopsis:
A world blanketed in an endless and ever-growing ocean of snow. The people eke out a living, either huddled around the roots of enormous trees dotting the surface, or high in the canopy, which spreads over the planet's atmosphere.

A chance meeting between Kaina, a youth from the canopy, and Liliha, a young woman from the surface, sets off a chain of events that will change the fate of the world.

(Source: Polygon Pictures)

title: Keikenzumi na Kimi to, Keiken Zero na Ore ga, Otsukiai suru Hanashi.
title_english: You Were Experienced, I Was Not: Our Dating Story
title_japanese: 経験済みなキミと、経験ゼロなオレが、お付き合いする話。
synopsis:
Ryuuto Kashima is a gloomy high-schooler who quietly spends his days watching his crush, the beautiful Runa Shirakawa, from afar. She rules the school and has had no shortage of boyfriends. Although Ryuuto is fully convinced she'd never accept him, fate leads him to confess his feelings to her anyway. To his astonishment, she accepts—simply because she's "available" at the time—but the surprises don't end there. She immediately invites him over as if it's the most natural thing in the world! This odd couple is different in just about every way—the friends they keep, their hobbies, their love lives—but with every passing day, they grow a little bit closer. This may not be Runa's first relationship, but their dating story is going to be full of firsts for them both!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Hakui no Kedamono: Sensei no Yubi de Kanjichau
title_english: A Wolf in Doctor's Clothing: Why is His Touch so Good?
title_japanese: 白衣のケダモノ～先生の指で感じちゃう～
synopsis:
Yuri is dating the upperclassmen of her dreams and life has never been better! Or it should be, but she has a secret... She can't get turned on by his touch in bed. So, Yuri goes to get help from a specialist, but that doctor...!! To make matters even worse, she climaxes!! But, she's in love with her boyfriend... Yet, she can't get that doctor out of her head! Dr. Narumi and Yuri's secret sessions are underway...!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Kuchibeta Shokudou
synopsis: The story of a waitress and a customer who have difficulty speaking to each other.

title: Watashi no Keiyaku Kekkon ni wa Uso ga Aru.
title_english: There is a Lie in My Contract Marriage
title_japanese: わたしの契約結婚にはウソがある。
synopsis:
Ugly, penniless, and unloved, 18-year-old Youko Moji is ready to end it all. But as she takes the final leap, a pair of arms drag her back. Youko's savior is Kagami Kirihara, a handsome young man who lives in an expensive highrise apartment. He offers her a strange proposition: enter a contract marriage with him, with the only stipulation being that she must get cosmetic surgery to reflect his ideal partner's face.

Youko takes him up on the offer, and, six months later, she is happily married. However, on the news one evening, she learns of an unsolved murder case from 10 years ago—and the victim has the exact same face as Youko, right down to the mole under her eye. Kagami claims that the victim was his first love, and Youko wants to believe him. But could there be a lie hiding within their contract marriage?

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Psychedelia
synopsis:
Shouhei Mizoshiri has just been assigned to the organized crime division and has already developed a crush on his senpai, experienced detective Toranosuke Hino. But when Hino gets shot, Mizo feels responsible and decides to take drastic measures.

(Source: MU)

title: Hatsukoi wa Natsukanai
synopsis:
"Who is this guy all over my girlfriend?"

Satoru told his fiancee he wouldn't be able to make it home that night, but he managed to take the last train, only to find his fiancee in bed with another man. Satoru just nonchalantly left the two how he found them... but the other man followed him out.

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

title: End of Arcadia
title_japanese: エンド・オブ・アルカディア
synopsis:
Due to advancement in clone technology, mankind had finally obtained eternal life. Arcadia, the ultimate life regeneration system. Through it, the frail mortal human received salvation from absolute death... Or so it was meant to be. For some reason, the implantation of memories into duplicated bodies were only successful in the case of teenagers. With the onset of war, this defect meant the deployment of these undying children to the front lines.

Akito Ichinose was one of them, a second lieutenant in the United States of Elmea Army. As penalty for his militaristic underperformance, the platoon he led was ordered to undertake a salvage operation for top secret information with a survival rate of virtually zero. In the midst of a sudden enemy encounter, Akito covered his teammates from a crustal collapse and found himself face-to-face with his arch-enemy: Philia Loadrain of the Lorelia Federation. To make things worse, they were cut off from the surface and the ability to respawn. The

title: Konya Bed de Matteiro
title_japanese: 今夜ベッドで待っていろ
synopsis:
Childhood friends Kagetora and Haruta are a super lovey-dovey high-school couple! After finally going steady with Haruta, who he has always liked, Kagetora is on cloud nine!!! ...or he should be, but for some reason, he keeps desperately avoiding all of Haruta's "invitations." The reason is because Kagetora's *beep* is *beep*?! It's the battle of love between an offensive uke who wants to become one with the one he loves, and a defensive seme who doesn't want to lay hands on the one he loves!

Onoda Shun struggles against the walls blocking his own path. Nakamura Yuki hopes to become one of the few female members of the special rescue corps known as "Orange." When these three young firefighters who share the goal of becoming members of Orange come together, the story of how Japan will one day be saved begins... and what looms before them is a crisis that endangers the entire country!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Jibun no Karada wo Yurusu made
title_english: Until I Love Myself: The Journey of a Nonbinary Manga Artist
synopsis:
Though they were assigned female at birth, manga artist Poppy Pesuyama feels like anything but a girl. Struggling to come to terms with who they are in a binary world, Poppy finds themself becoming an assistant for the famous manga artist X. Not only is Poppy nervous working with such an influential industry figure, but also X's less-than-appropriate behavior exacerbates their gender dysphoria, leading to something much worse.

Years later, the non-binary manga artist is still tortured by the abuse and ridicule they faced working under X, never receiving the closure they needed to move on. Angered by it all, Poppy recounts their experiences and life up to that point. Through their journey of self-acceptance, gender identity, and society, Poppy discovers what they have been desperately looking for.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

Seren, the eldest daughter of a duke, has grown up being teased for her plain looks, nicknamed "Princess Drab" in comparison to her younger sister, who is a real beauty. One day she overhears her fiancé, Prince Helios, and his friends talking about how her sister would make a much better wife.

In order to avoid marriage with the prince, Seren plans to become a top-level magician and gain the freedom that comes with the title. To achieve this, she teams up with a black cat, a familiar lent to her by Viol, leader of the Ice Magicians, after she finds out about his secret weakness to sweets! Together they're going to do whatever it takes to bring a peaceful end to her unwanted engagement!

Now everyone—from average citizens to soldiers—explores these monster-filled labyrinths in search of wealth, power, and magic. Keigo Yoshimura is an office worker with no sense of adventure, who dreams of quitting his job to live the easy life. While out on a business call, he stumbles on the birth of a new dungeon and accidentally gains a magical skill that turns subterranean exploration into an RPG. Things spiral out of control and Keigo winds up as the world's top explorer. With help from Azusa Miyoshi, his mathematically gifted colleague and new business partner in dungeon diving, he might be able to turn the status screens he sees into piles of cash. Unfortunately, Keigo ends up under the scrutiny of the military, government agencies, and even more sinister forces. What happened to his dream of taking it easy?!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Alone on the rooftop, I was supposed to tell her how I felt and finally become lovers—but I got caught up in a "Confession Quartet," a game about love and romance. If you fall in love during the game, you are promised "eternal love" by the power of magic; but if your love is not fulfilled, it will be as if it never existed in the first place. His intuition leads him to Kujou Mansion, home of a mysterious talking doll named Mary. Mary explains that the mark represents a spirit's curse. If he and others bearing the mark wish to survive, they must cleanse each spirit's grudge.

But why are these marks appearing now? Who is Yashiki really? And will everybody survive?

Mao, who had repeated a year for some reason, decides to start over in the second year of high school. Hachiya, a junior high school boy in the soccer club, is now in the same class as Mao. Even though he is in the same grade as her, he doesn't stop using honorifics, which Mao finds difficult, but...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Tsuma wo Katta Okuman Chouja
synopsis:
Victoria is resolved to call her estranged Greek husband, Alexei, who she hasn't seen in seven years—ever since the day he suspected her of having an affair and verbally assaulted her. But at the moment, it's not the wounds on her own heart she's concerned about. She needs money from the divorce settlement to save a dear friend who is in the hospital after collapsing from an illness. Alexei said he'll only allow Victoria a divorce if she comes to Athens personally. When she does, he throws a humiliating demand at her: in exchange for signing the divorce papers, Victoria must spend one week with Alexei as his lover...

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Shikumareta Jouji
synopsis:
Unfortunately for the beautiful Eve, it's no accident when handsome CEO Talos—who she now can't remember after losing her memory in a car accident—reappears in her life. According to Talos, he's her lover and the father of her unborn child. But Eve glimpses the coldness in his gaze, and reflexively pushes him away when he moves in for a kiss. Why would she do that if they were in love? Plagued by a crushing sense of loneliness, Eve has yet to realize that a vow for revenge is hidden in Talos's reassuring words...

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Hageshiku Daite Ii desu ka? Do Majime Danshi to Tsuyogari Around 30
title_english: Can We Do It Harder? A Too-Serious Man and a Tough 30-Year-Old
title_japanese: 激しく抱いていいですか? ド真面目男子と強がりアラサー
synopsis:
Riko Kurita, a 30-year-old university administrator who's dying to get married, meets archery club captain Daisuke "Mr. Serious" Shimizu. Daisuke asks her out and confesses his love, even though they've hardly spoken. Plus, he's a university student ten years her junior! But, when Daisuke prepares an "action plan" for dating through marriage, Riko realizes it's time to take a chance on this guy. "Marriage" is the word she always wanted to hear from her ex, so Riko can't help but start a relationship with him. Little does she know, this ultra-serious, straight-laced guy is a wild beast in the sack who can only imagine making violent love to her!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Koubutsu wa Ichiban Saigo ni Hara no Naka
title_japanese: 好物はいちばんさいごに腹のなか
synopsis:
1. Koubutsu wa Ichiban Saigo ni Hara no Naka (Saving My Favorite For Last)
2. Koubutsu wa Sodatetemitara Hara no Naka (Raising My Favorite)
3-4. Koubutsu wa Kizuita Toki ni wa Hara no Naka (I'd Had My Favorite the Whole Time)
5. Koubutsu wa Daiji ni Hara e Osamemashou (Keeping My Favorite Safe Inside)
6. Imamade Mitaku, Imamade Ijou ni. (Just Like Always and More)

title: Kuroneko Osananajimi ga Nigashite Kurenai.
title_english: My Sneaky Childhood Friend Won't Let Me Get Away
title_japanese: 黒猫おさななじみが逃がしてくれない。
synopsis:
Moegi Mizutani is a hard-working office worker who has decided to start her new life in Tokyo. One day, when she comes back home, a guy in the buff hugs her from behind! She has no idea who it is until she turns around and sees a man with black hair, cat eyes, and a big grin on his face. He's Haruka, the boy she played with back in her hometown!

He's been teasing and using her as his toy for as long as she can remember, and before she left for Tokyo, they even spent an intimate moment together. That moment made Moegi insecure and completely at a loss to define their relationship.

Things were supposed to be better, but he's back now? And she has no idea why!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Savage Fang Ojousama: Shijou Saikyou no Youhei wa Shijou Saikyou no Bougyaku Reijou to Natte Nidome no Sekai wo Musou suru
title_english: Miss Savage Fang: The Strongest Mercenary in History Is Reincarnated as an Unstoppable Noblewoman
title_japanese: サベージファングお嬢様　史上最強の傭兵は史上最凶の暴虐令嬢となって二度目の世界を無双する
synopsis:
Mylene has it all: She's the daughter of nobility, she boasts incredible aptitude with magic and the blade, and she possesses striking vermilion-tinged locks that signify she has been chosen by God. Yet this elegant warrior hides a shocking secret—inside her lurks the soul of the strongest mercenary in history, Savage Fang. In his past life, Savage Fang cut down countless foes of superior ability for his employers with nothing but cunning and strength. Now reborn as Mylene, this former sellsword will use her past experience and newfound powers to shape the world as she sees fit...even if she has to get her aristocratic peers involved along the way!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Suichuu Renka: Yoshiwara Oshoku Shikun
title_english: Underwater Flower of Love: Senior Courtesan Shikun
title_japanese: 水中恋花 -吉原御職・紫薫-
synopsis:
Death by euthanasia if she doesn't find a man to buy her freedom by the age of 24!? A dramatic love story about a high-class courtesan in modern times!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Konya mo, Ecchi na Shiiku wa Chika no Shoko de...
title_english: We'll Continue Your Training in the Archives Tonight
title_japanese: 今夜も、エッチな飼育は地下の書庫で…
synopsis:
"Since you're inexperienced, I'll just have to teach you" are the words said to Sayo, a young librarian who works hard at her job. She has lots of book knowledge about romance and sexual encounters, but zero experience. Suddenly, she is taken into the home of the heir to a large financial conglomerate, Shuya. Her lessons in what real sex is begin after she is caught peering into "The 48 Sexual Positions" down in the basement archives of his manor. Shuya tells her that she should put what she has learned in books to good use and pushes her body to overflow with pleasure as they try out different positions each night. "Have you heard of this one, Criss-cross Pine Needles?"

(Source: Manga Reborn)

title: Black Terror
synopsis:
Creepy Side is an eerie neighborhood. This is a story about a series of tragicomedies with Creepy Side as its setting.

(Source: MU)

title: Hanauta Pub
synopsis: Two short stories focused on crossdressing pubs.

title: Taberare Usa.
synopsis:
The future of hungry dad and son rabbit is food heaven! However... the sweetness was too sweet! A surreal and comedic sweet adventure! A father and son bunny duo reincarnates into desserts, but they struggle to escape their endless loop of rebirth into delectable foods.

(Source: NHN comico Corp., translated)

title: Heiye Yousuo Si
title_english: Fall in the Night with You
synopsis:
Hated by those around him for seemingly bringing bad luck wherever he goes, Ren Xi unwittingly makes a pact with a witch named Nyx to save his sick mother. But there are consequences... If only Nyx could remember them! It doesn't help that she has amnesia, either. It seems there's something more to Ren Xi's "jinxed" past, too... something scarier than even a witch, and they'll need each other to get through it.

(Source: Comikey Media)

title: Danshi dato Omotteita Osananajimi to no Shinkon Seikatsu ga Umaku Ikisugiru Ken ni Tsuite
title_japanese: 男子だと思っていた幼馴染との新婚生活がうまくいきすぎる件について
synopsis:
Shuuichi and Yuika have been close friends since they were kids. But Shuuichi had always thought Yuika was a boy, so their reunion 10 years ago was filled with surprise when Yuika had seemingly transformed into a beautiful young woman! Intimidated by his friend's beauty, Shuuichi was sure this would be the end of their friendship. And it was... because the two traded in friendship for marriage! 

A sweet and charming love story about finding friendship and love with your person.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Senki to Senki no Kiyoshi Wazawai Sensou
title_english: The Holy War of War Demons & War Princesses
title_japanese: 戦鬼と戦姫の聖災戦争

title: Shachiku OL to Akuma Shota
synopsis:
After coming home from her black company—one that exploits its employees—an office lady makes a desperate attempt to escape her grueling working conditions by summoning a demon, hoping that it could destroy her workplace. But while she succeeds in her endeavor, the demon that emerges is completely different from her expectations!

The invoked young boy immediately asks the office lady for her wish. However, her exhaustion and despair lead her to simply request a tasty meal. With a pure smile on his face, the demon—whom the woman later names Kuroha—begins taking care of the chores around her home. No matter how hard life at a black company may be, being looked after by the innocent Kuroha always heals the tired office lady, becoming the light in her draining life.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Uketsukejou ni Kokuhaku shitakute Guild ni Kayoitsumetara Eiyuu ni Natteta
title_english: I Wanted to Confess to the Receptionist, but When I Went to the Guild, I Became a Hero
title_japanese: 受付嬢に告白したくてギルドに通いつめたら英雄になってた

title: Kimi to Tsugai ni Narenai Riyuu
title_english: Reason Why You Cannot Be Pair
title_japanese: きみと番になれない理由
synopsis:
There was never a time when they didn't like each other. Minato (omega) and Jin (alpha) have sworn to each other to become a "pair." However, when Minato was supposed to go into heat, the doctor reveals to him that the chance of him getting pregnant are close to zero... Minato is shocked that is seems like he's unable to bear a child! After all of this he separates from Jin and they drift apart...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Okaeri, Hatsukoi.
synopsis: At a high school reunion, the shy Yamane reunites with Taguchi, a friend who used to be a delinquent. Have they changed? Or are they the same as ever?

title: Kagami Alice to Bishounen to Bishounen to Bishounen to Bishounen to Bishounen.: Otome Game Royale
title_japanese: 神鏡アリスと美少年と美少年と美少年と美少年と美少年 。～乙女ゲームロワイヤル～
synopsis:
Alice Kagami is an ordinary high school girl who doesn't really get her friend Tamami's obsession with idol games. There's more to life than handsome digital boys, dating sims, and mini-games, right? But then, Tamami is "chosen" as one of the top idol fangirls in the country and gets drawn into the game—and hapless Alice gets pulled in too!

Between dealing with the mismatched members of her idol group to intense pressure to spend real money on gachas, how is a total idol game newbie supposed to take them to the top?

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Gekijouban Hunter x Hunter: Phantom Rouge
title_japanese: 劇場版 HUNTER×HUNTER 緋色の幻影〈ファントム・ルージュ〉

title: Akatsuki no Koiuta
synopsis:
Between her father's poor health and the lack of business at their family inn, Grace believes that the best way to ensure her parents' well-being is to sell the inn. But the appearance of a wandering bard, Alaine, turns out to be a miracle in disguise. Though he has no money to pay for his stay, his skills as a bard are bringing in more customers than Grace could ever dream of. Everyone is entranced by Alaine's charm, including Grace, but she can't find it in herself to be so selfish as to ask him to stay, especially after she learns a hidden truth about him. Grace left quite the impression on Alaine, as well, for her beauty have captivated him since they first met. Will Alaine be able to figure out his true feelings before it's too late?

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Shima-san
synopsis:
At a certain late-night convenience store, an old man who was a little unreliable, but a little reliable, had a part-time job.

(Source: MU)

title: Sukeban to Tenkousei
title_english: The Delinquent and the Transfer Student
synopsis:
Riri is a transfer student with a unique fascination—she wants the school delinquent, Atsuko, to say adorable things! Despite her fearful reputation, Atsuko goes along with it, thinking Riri is just a harmless weirdo. However, she soon finds herself getting increasingly flustered every time she reads one of Riri's lists of cute words. And she's not the only one whose heart races after each interaction! Will this game bring them closer together and lead to an entirely new relationship?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Bukiyou na Hakui no Nugashikata
title_english: How to Remove a Lab Coat
title_japanese: 不器用な白衣の脱がし方
synopsis:
Kaoru Kuze, a school nurse, was forced to transfer to a countryside high school due to being relentlessly stalked by a co-worker. His first day starts out rough when he walks into his new office, only to be greeted by Motoaki Wakura, a tall, blonde guy who looks like he belongs in a gang...! Kaoru soon learns that this scary-looking guy is in fact very caring and dependable. When Kaoru falls asleep in his office one day, he's shocked to find Motoaki beside him when he wakes up, with a flirtatious look on his face...

(Source: Renta!)

title: Kyou, Sekaiichi no Kokuhaku wo.
synopsis: A "confession" is that moment when you become special to the person you love... A collection of 4 short stories about pure confessions from each season!

title: Fukufuku Hitobito
title_japanese: 服福人々―ふくふくひとびと―
synopsis:
Sakuma, a 32-year-old office worker who spends his days in depression, has only one hobby: buying clothes. Then, he happens to meet a former fashion designer and painter named Meguriya? Shopping is fun even when you are alone. But if you go shopping together, your life will change. 

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Kin no Chikara: Takahashi Rumiko Kessakushuu
title_japanese: 高橋留美子傑作集 金の力
synopsis:
1. Futari no Ie

3. Iya na Runner
4. Mukashi no Onna
5. S ni Sasagu
6. Kin no Chikara

synopsis:
1-2. Hajimete wa Mechakucha Hageshii (One Helluva First Time)
3. Wagamama de Usotsuki (My Selfish Self-Denial)
4. Out of Focus
5. Lucky Asterisk

title: Bitch Friend: Netori no Sahou
title_japanese: ビッチフレンド 寝取りの作法
synopsis:
1-2. Joushi to Nenai Career Woman nado Inai
3. Kuro Gal-zuma no Uwaki no Hajimekata
4. Bitch Friend
5. Enkou JK Riko-chan no Haiboku
6. Motokare no Sex ga Kimochi Yosugiru Hanashi
7. Kounin Sefure
8. Kasumisou no Hana ga Chiru

title: Rokushiki Tensou Ataraxia
title_japanese: 六識転想アタラクシア
synopsis:
Shigure Konno is getting bullied in class. One day, however, she leaves her physical body and is able to enter the world of spirit. Shigure can now look inside people's minds, discover their innermost secrets and even manipulate them... When the seeds of trouble sown in the hearts of good citizens blossom, bizarre incidents will happen...

(Source: Mangadex)

title: Ecchi na Mirai no Dannasama
title_english: My Sexy Husband in the Future: He Is Going to Break My Body...
title_japanese: エッチな未来の旦那さま
synopsis:
"P-please...you can't touch me like that." "But you like this, don't you, Mirai?" "But I'm not Mirai!" Sakurako, who lives in the Meiji era, travels through time to the current era because of an accident, and finds herself in a girl's body named Mirai. Mirai has a boyfriend named Souma, who looks very much like Sakurako's fiance. Souma always desires her body, and makes her body hot.

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title: Watashi no Chiisana Ohimesama.
title_japanese: 私のちいさなお姫さま。
synopsis:
Soga Tsukihi had a childhood prince that she used to play with. Now at present time, she's a competitive high schooler who one-sidedly competes with Ouji Kanade, a popular girl in her class. After getting a little closer with Kanade, she happens to see her prince again.

(Source: MU)

title: Kao ni Doro wo Nuru
synopsis:
"You’re great just the way you are."

Even though Miku is 25 years old, she hasn’t learned a thing about how to do her own makeup -- but her boyfriend, Haru, tells her that he prefers her that way. Miku and Haru live together, after all, and they might get married, in which case she’ll just quit her job anyway, so it’s probably fine never to learn... At least, that’s what she tells herself. One day, a boy with a special love for makeup suddenly appears in her life. The beautiful stranger does Miku up gorgeously and Haru’s reaction to her new look is almost unbelievable--? 

A story of starting anew and taking one’s life back through makeup!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title: Salad Viking
title_japanese: サラダ・ヴァイキング

title: Koakuma-chan no Kougeki!
title_japanese: 小悪魔ちゃんのこうげき！
synopsis:
Liath is your typical girl-next-door: cute, bubbly, a little clingy... a succubus. You know, the usual. But for modern-day succubi like her who can feed off of human feelings of embarrassment instead of sucking out their life essence directly, things become dire when her boy-toy tries to give her the cold shoulder due to upcoming exams. Will he be able to say no to the plan she's got cooked up for him though?

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: The Abyss
synopsis:
Several days of torture is not enough to make the Captain disclose the location of his team's safe house. Seeing that their tricks are working in vain, his captors call in the Colonel to get the vital information out of him. This cold-blooded Colonel will readily kill anyone within a heartbeat to get the information he needs. However, the Captain just so happens to have a pretty face...and the Colonel knows just what he wants to do to it.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Saikyou no Maou ni Kitaerareta Yuusha, Isekai Kikansha-tachi no Gakuen de Musou suru
title_japanese: 最凶の魔王に鍛えられた勇者、異世界帰還者たちの学園で無双する
synopsis:
Kyouya Kujou is a boy who was unable to save the world because he does not possess the unique abilities that are the blessings of a goddess. In another world where returned heroes who have saved many worlds gather, he is a boy who could not save the world. In the academy, he was ridiculed as a "Failure Hero." However, he is the most powerful and unique hero who trained for 30,000 years in another world with Felice, the most evil demon king who has destroyed 3,000 worlds!

Kyouya's latent ability is so powerful that even the strongest heroes cannot compete with him...? The tale of a boy trained by the most powerful demon king is about to begin!

(Source: Hobby Japan, translated)

title: Manga Nekoneko Yokochou: Tokyo Kanban Neko
title_english: The Shop Cats of Tokyo: A Manga from Cat Avenue
title_japanese: まんが ねこねこ横丁 東京かんばん猫
synopsis:
Within the back alleys fusing retro and modern aesthetics, Chief, the cat in charge of the Tourist Information Center guides feline tourists to the actual shops best known for their respective cats.

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Caligula no Koi
synopsis:
Take control of my pleasure, my beloved master. This is the last time, so you can grant it to me, the forbidden treat I wanted.

(Source: MU)

title: Diego!!: Kami to Yobareta Otoko no Arata naru Chousen
title_japanese: Diego!!～神と呼ばれた男の新たなる挑戦～

title: Gran Familia
synopsis:
This is a world where demi-humans with special abilities hide in the shadows. It's a story of the sorrow and compassion of a vampire who inherits the will of the legendary family "Gran Familia" that reigns at the top of the demi-humans.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Kanojo Shoukan shimashita!?
synopsis:
Yuuta Agatsuma is a high school student who has no romantic experience. He doesn't know what true love is like, but he finds his classmate Nodoka Kanzaki interesting. Is this love!? Meanwhile, his younger sister Yoru, who dreams of summoning demons, is performing summoning rituals again. This time, the summoning circle suddenly starts to glow, and a girl descends from above. She is Lars, a demon from the underworld, and she offers Yuuta a contract!? A thrilling seven-way love comedy begins, where cheating = the end of the world!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Osananajimi to wa Love Comedy ni Naranai
title_english: You Can't Be in a Rom-Com with Your Childhood Friends!
title_japanese: 幼馴染とはラブコメにならない
synopsis:
Hero, your average high school boy, has a problem: Shio and Akari, his two female childhood friends, go to the same school as him, and they're way too cute! He's certain they don't see him as more than a friend, though, and would be mortified if they learned how he feels. Meanwhile, the girls have their own secrets... Enjoy a sweet and vexing love triangle as longtime friends struggle to be more honest with each other!

(Source: Kodansha)

title: Homestay-chuu no Doitsukko ga Issho ni Furo ni Haitte Kuru Wake
title_japanese: ホームステイ中のドイツっ娘が一緒に風呂に入ってくるワケ

title: Konna Watashi ga Koi nante
synopsis:
High school student Mio, with no interest in fashion, makeup, or design, stumbles into the glitzy world of fashion shows when she gets a makeover from classmate Izumi. Because Izumi, who has top marks, is also interested in the world of top models and knows the tricks of how to bring out and emphasize the beauty of a person. Mio is not only taken with her new look and Izumi's artistry, but also with Izumi herself. And when she's asked to fill in as a model for a fashion company show, her heart starts beating even faster... Is it the excitement for the show or Izumi himself which makes her nervous?

(Source: Tokyopop, translated)

Included one-shots:
Volume 1: White Day made Tsukiatte ><!
Volume 2: Datte Kawaii n damon

title: Stage S
synopsis:
Meguru Ukiyo has fallen for his childhood friend, Sara Tatsumi. One day, he stumbles across a white snake that...says it can see the future?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Ren-kun wa Muitara Onnanoko.
title_english: Underneath It All, Ren Is a Woman
title_japanese: 蓮くんは剥いたらおんなのこ。
synopsis:
A secret photoshoot with the Lingerie Boy?! I tried to keep a straight face... but when he strips, I can't believe how sexy he is.

(Source: WWWave Corporation)

title: Hoshizora wo Mitsumeta Sono Ato de
title_english: After We Gazed at the Starry Sky
title_japanese: 星空を見つめたそのあとで
synopsis:
Graphic designer Subaru Miyazawa has always loved the stars and dreams of traveling to Lake Tekapo, New Zealand, to view its breathtaking night sky. However, due to his physical disability, he instead lives his dream vicariously through the astrophotography work of Tougo Amase. While he reluctantly accepts his reality, Subaru receives a design opportunity from his close friend Akari Tsurikane that propels him in the direction of the photographer he has always admired.

As they meet and start growing closer, Tougo becomes enamored with Subaru's determination and ability to triumph over adversity. One day, he invites Subaru on a stargazing trip he has planned in Okinawa. Scared of being a burden and his budding feelings for Tougo, Subaru initially rejects the offer, but Tougo convinces him he has no reason to hold back. Despite his initial hesitation, once he sees the beauty of the starry sky in person, his love for Tougo blossoms.

However, Tougo's professional obligations pull him all

title: Fuwamomi
synopsis:
Aoi Ebihara, an office lady in her first year as a member of society, is exhausted by work she is not accustomed to every day. Meanwhile, she met a beautiful masseuse in the city...!??

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Ringo Tensei: Kindan no Kajitsu wa Kyou mo Korokoro to Musou suru
title_japanese: 林檎転生～禁断の果実は今日もコロコロと無双する～
synopsis:
My name is Daisuke Furutsu, and I died getting hit by a truck full of apples. Yes, I know it's a cliché setup. Apparently somebody upstairs fell asleep on the job. Anyway, as an apology, God lets me draw five Cards of Fate that are supposed to grant me superpowers in my next life. My first four draws are amazing—stuff like magic and an infinite inventory. But everything changes with the fifth card: a "curse" that turns me into whatever killed me. I thought I was gonna end up a truck, but now I'm an apple! Luckily, I've made a friend who can teach me how to move around. I also end up saving a wannabe adventurer who just might be willing to take me along for the ride. Time for this overpowered apple to get rollin'!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Okaeri
synopsis: The story follows a young man who has just lost his older brother, and who has a chance meeting with a beautiful girl.

title: Succubus to Hajimeru Shinken Kousai
title_japanese: サキュバスとはじめる真剣交際
synopsis:
Tsuyoshi is the captain of a club that prohibits romance. A devil (succubus) who can seduce men appears under him. How much can he endure in front of a girl who is sexy but far from neat and clean? How far can you go through a pure and uninterrupted love affair?

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Pocket no Naka no Sensou
title_english: Mobile Suit Gundam 0080: War in the Pocket
title_japanese: 機動戦士ガンダム0080 ポケットの中の戦争

title: Fairy Tail: Ooedo Fairy Tail
title_japanese: FAIRY TAIL 大江戸フェアリーテイル

title: Silent Witch: Chinmoku no Majo no Kakushigoto
title_japanese: サイレント・ウィッチ 沈黙の魔女の隠しごと
synopsis:
Monica Everett is the Silent Witch, the only mage in the world who has mastered the art of unchanted mage craft. But Monica hides a secret: The reason she learned to use magic without speaking is merely because of her extreme shyness. Until now, she's been content living a peaceful life hidden away in the mountains, but an unexpected visit from a colleague brings her a task more daunting than any other. Now, it's up to the world's shiest mage to infiltrate an academy and protect the second prince from danger...without letting her fears get to her!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Konyakusha wa Dekiai no Furi
synopsis:
For the sake of her impoverished family, Rachiel, a member of the Jaharry family, plans a political marriage with Fahad, the second son of the Aurecia family, who has good looks, good family and financial power. When she asks him to marry her, he unexpectedly says yes! Rachiel, who is not good at romance, tries to show off her flirtatious side in front of everyone, but is always being pushed around by Fahad.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Kagetoki-sama no Kurenai Koukyuu
title_japanese: 影時さまのくれなゐ後宮
synopsis:
Haunted by death and rumored to be a "Death Goddess," Kito Tsutsuji falls off a building because of a man who believed those same rumors and resented her for them. At the point of dying, Tsutsuji is summoned to another world. The one who called her is the abhorred first prince of the Shinju Empire. Due to a commotion at the time of her summoning, she becomes known as the Holy Maiden.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Gakuen no Ouji to Game Jikkyousha
title_japanese: 学園の王子とゲーム実況者
synopsis:
I don't know who she is, but she's very, very close!?

A serious honor roll student, Umeko Watanuki, is in love with the school's prince, Shizuru Inarida. However, she has almost no contact with him at school almost always thinking negatively about herself. All the while, Umeko is actually hiding a secret from everyone—she actually person behind the screen of a famous streamer, Tanupon! On the other hand, their school's prince, Inarida Shizuru, also has a secret side that he never shows to anyone!? So close, but so far—a school romantic comedy!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Maimaimaigoen
synopsis:
New teacher Yuu Okada and his senior, Ms. Rumi are on a field trip with their 16 elementary students to Sanrio Puroland. But suddenly they wander into a mysterious and horrific theme park called "Yuropia!" Amid their confusion, ominous Frog Egg mascots announce that the only way for them to escape is to "conquer the attractions and gather 10 medals." Will they be able to get out of Yuropia in one piece?! This is a story for those of you who "carry pain in your heart."

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Bonkotsu Shinpei no Monster Life @comic
title_english: The Monster Life of the Freshly Drafted: The Comic
title_japanese: 凡骨新兵のモンスターライフ＠COMIC
synopsis:
The protagonist is an ordinary soldier from an empire at war who gets used as a guinea pig for genetic engineering experiments, turned into a monster and put into cryosleep.

Two hundred years later, he wakes up in a world of swords and sorcery. The empire is gone and he has to survive alone in the body of a monster whom everybody wants to kill on sight. Meanwhile, he encounters various pretty ladies (and elves) in need of rescue.

(Source: MU)

title: Okubyou na Hakushaku Reijou wa Momegoto wo Nozomanai
title_english: The Countess Is Timid and Doesn't Want Any Trouble
title_japanese: 臆病な伯爵令嬢は揉め事を望まない
synopsis:
Amelia is a plain girl who is Sophie's fan and follower. One day, she sees Marion, Sophie's fiancé, with Rozetta, another girl. "I wonder if His Highness will look at me more if I earn Rozetta's ire..." To prevent Sophie from becoming the antagonist, Amelia begins to coach Sophie in love. However, this attracts the attention of Sophie's tsundere brother?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Ochikobore Oujo to Kuro no Banken
title_japanese: 落ちこぼれ王女と黒の番犬

title: Douka Ore wo Houtteoite Kure: Nazeka Bocchi no Owatta Koukou Seikatsu wo Kanojo ga Kaeyou to Shitekuru
title_japanese: どうか俺を放っておいてくれ なぜかぼっちの終わった高校生活を彼女が変えようとしてくる
synopsis:
"Let's start a strategy meeting for making friends."

This is a story about her and me. It's the worst and the best second-life high school rom-com ever. Love, friendship, and the sparkling joys of youth. The high school life that I've looked forward to- still ended with me being alone. Then, just a day before the graduation ceremony...

"Don't die! Nanamura-kun!" Sora Hanamitsuji, she's a beautiful girl that even models can't compare. My life ended after getting hit by a truck to protect her... That should've been the case.

"It must be because the gods got bored."

However, with this accident, Hanamitsuji-san and I returned to the day of our high school's entrance ceremony. The second high school life is no longer as charming and youthful. I was going to spend it modestly and alone... But, she said that won't do.

"Well, I'll help you make friends."

This is a story about my second high school life. It's the worst and best teenage rom-com ever.

(Source: SB Creative Corp, translated)

title: RWBY: Hyousetsu Teikoku the Comic
title_japanese: RWBY 氷雪帝国 THE COMIC
synopsis:
In the world of Remnant, a place where science and fairy tales coexist, human civilization is plagued by deadly monsters known as the Grimm. For a time, victory by the Grimm seemed all but certain, if not for the heroism of those sworn to protect humanity—Huntsmen and Huntresses.

These warriors are trained and assembled into teams at schools like Beacon Academy, where Ruby meets Weiss and Blake—forming Team RWBY along with Ruby's sister, Yang.

While team RWBY studies to become the greatest Huntresses the world of Remnant has ever known, they are faced with a horrifying threat...

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Imaizumin Chi wa Douyara Gal no Tamariba ni Natteru Rashii: Deep
title_english: Imaizumi Brings All the Gals to His House
title_japanese: 今泉ん家はどうやらギャルの溜まり場になってるらしい～DEEP～
synopsis:
Imaizumi lives a life that most high school boys could only dream of! During the day, he attends his classes like any dutiful student, only to return each evening to a home full of hotties! It seems his home has become the go-to hangout for the coolest gyarus in town. From endless gossip fests to snack binges to getting downright physical with his three new housemates, his once-quiet abode is now buzzing with non-stop energy and exciting escapades. Can Imaizumi keep up with the lively antics of his lusty gal pals?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Shippo no Koi
synopsis:
Salaryman Ryou Inukai dreams of leaving his high-stress job and finding a career that gives him enough free time to care for a dog of his own. Until that becomes possible, he relieves stress by visiting a pet store and spending time with puppies and his favorite clerk, Teruaki Hoshi. These visits give him the motivation to make his dream a reality, eventually adopting a puppy he calls Wataame.

With Wataame waiting for him at home, Inukai's days are more pleasant than ever. Still, he stays in touch with Hoshi so he can share cute moments with the small dog. One day, the two meet in a park, where Hoshi shares that he was a dog in his past life, and he believes it was Inukai who saved him. Inukai questions this but does not stop Hoshi from paying back his debt the best way a former dog can: by ensuring that Wataame receives the best care possible—even if that means living in Inukai's home.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Taniku-chan
synopsis:
Akira Hanada is 34 years old and unemployed. That's okay, though, because his mom is going out of town for a bit and asked him to watch her plant shop for her. The problem is that he doesn't know anything about plants. And so the succulents of the plant shop pray to the plant fairy, who grants their wish and gives them the ability to talk with Akira! Now this job is getting weirder and weirder, and his mom just let him know she'll be gone for a year!!

(Source: Mangamo)

title: Azakoi
synopsis:
Masumi, a second-year high school student, is said to be absurd even though she just wants to please others. She is in love with Minato-senpai at the same school, but she is afraid to take a step and cannot convey her thoughts! At that time, her popular junior, Moji-kun, appeared and said that he would help her in love!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Oneechan no Midori-kun
synopsis:
The manga centers on Sui, a girl in her third year of junior high. She doesn't really get along with her older sister's boyfriend, Midori-kun, since he always treats her like a kid and makes fun of her. But Midori-kun is suddenly asked to be Sui's home tutor.

(Source: ANN)

title: Soredemo Otouto wa Koishitagaru
title_english: Still, My Brother Wants to Fall in Love.
title_japanese: それでも弟は恋したがる

title: Crane Game wa Yamerarenai!
title_japanese: クレーンゲームはやめられない!

title: Oshie Syllabus
synopsis:
One day, on a whim, Matoi buys an old college entrance exam study guide. Upon opening the book, a cheerful, long-haired girl magically appears, claiming to be her new in-home tutor!

Despite her family's acceptance of the magical girl, called Oshie, Matoi is thoroughly unhappy about her new circumstances. As a first year high school student, she wants to spend her time hanging out with her friends, not being forced by an overzealous magical tutor to constantly study for her college entrance exams.

She's even more horrified when Oshie points out the fine print that she missed. In opening the book, Matoi has apparently agreed that she will either be accepted into her chosen college... or die!

(Source: MU)

title: Sex shita kedo, Suki ja Nai
title_japanese: セックスしたけど、好きじゃない
synopsis:
"Your straightforward love hurts."

On a solo trip to Paris to relieve his broken heart, Genta meets a beautiful older man named Kamisaka. As they spend time together, Genta is charmed by him, and on their final night, a sweet invitation incites him to embrace him fiercely. Kamisaka treats him as a one-night stand, and Genta is about to give up when they reunite at university after returning to their home country. After boldly confessing to him, Kamisaka says, "It's all right if we're sex friends," and kisses him?! A platonic love that begins with the body.

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

title: Doushitara Yuumei Namanushi ni Naremasu ka?
title_japanese: どうしたら有名生主になれますか?
synopsis:
Shiori knew her best path to fame and recognition without doing too much work was to become a streamer, but she didn't know just how perverted her viewers would be. Watch and see her come face to face with the question every streamer asks themselves: "do I show tits?"

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Rinjin wa Yuumei Haishinsha Soushuuhen
title_japanese: 隣人は有名配信者総集編
synopsis:
1. Rinjin wa Yuumei Haishinsha (The Camgirl Next Door)
2. Rinjin wa Yuumei Haishinsha Futarime (The Camgirl Next Door: Yuno's Story)
3. Rinjin wa Yuumei Haishinsha Sanninme (The VTuber Next Door: Aoi's Story)
4. Rinjin wa Yuumei Haishinsha Yoninme (The Camgirl Next Door: Rittsun's Story)

title: Uraaka Mousou Joshi
title_japanese: ウラアカモウソウジョシ
synopsis:
Onomichi is a shy and unassuming bookworm who's in charge of the front desk at the school library. But secretly, she uploads nudes online, hoping that her underclassman Dougaki will come across her account and recognize her. She constantly fantasizes about Dougaki blackmailing her with the nudes and ravaging her. Unfortunately for her, some other students recognize her from the account, and Dougaki isn't one of them... 

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Aki-chan wa Kangaechuu
synopsis:
Aki and Kei are two regulars at a family restaurant. What happens when they start hanging out and Kei confesses her love?

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Natsu made no Kankei
synopsis:
When a chance encounter at an unexpected place brings two barely-acquainted women together, they decide to help each other understand their identities... through sex!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Shinseiki Evangelion: Eva & Eva 2 Anthology
title_japanese: 新世紀エヴァンゲリオン エヴァ&エヴァ2アンソロジー
authors: Katsura, Asuka|Yabuki, Gou|Hayashi, Fumino|Gotsubo, Ryuuji|Tamaoki, Benkyou|Betten, Court|Takuma, Tomomasa|Kikkawa, Kabao|Takezaki, Tony|Takahashi, Osamu|Kodama, Miki|Iwasaki, Masakazu|Takeuchi, Motoki|Konoya, Kiyoshi
synopsis: An anthology comic of the video games Shinseiki Evangelion and Shinseiki Evangelion 2 by various mangaka.

title: Saenai Boku ga Kimi no Heya de Shiteiru Koto wo Classmate wa Daremo Shiranai
title_english: I Am Boring, but My Classmates Do Not Know What I Am Doing in Your Room.
title_japanese: 冴えない僕が君の部屋でシている事をクラスメイトは誰も知らない
synopsis:
Yuuki Tooyama, a social outcast, has a secret that he hasn't told anyone. He is in a strictly sexual relationship with his classmate Yumi Takai. The two are not looking for mutual love, but rather treat each other as a convenient sexual partner.

One day, Marika Uehara, a popular girl in the class, sees Yuuki buying condoms. Unexpectedly, Marika takes an interest in Yuuki and starts to get involved with him during lunch break and after school. Yumi is confused, but at the same time, she is not completely satisfied with Yuuki, and she begins to realize that she has a crush on him.

This is the start of a vivid, sweet and sour youth romantic comedy.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Yume no Naka demo Aishite
synopsis:
1. Yume no Naka demo Aishite: Konya, Uwaki shimasu
2. Yume no Naka demo Aishite: Anata wo Nozokimasu
3. Yume no Naka demo Aishite: Anata wa Dare?
4. Yume no Naka demo Aishite: Daikirai na Aitsu to shichatta!
5. Yume no Naka demo Aishite: Special Short

title: Oniichan to no Honki no Koi nante Darenimo Barecha Dame da yo ne?
title_japanese: お兄ちゃんとの本気の恋なんて誰にもバレちゃダメだよね？

title: Sono Mori no Hanashi
synopsis: A boy wanders into a mysterious forest one night.

title: Mayonaka no Kaijuutachi
title_japanese: 真夜中のカイジュウたち
synopsis: Nagiko works at an aquarium where, at night, the animals turn into men.

title: Kare nanka yori, Watashi no Hou ga Ii desho?
title_japanese: 彼なんかより、私のほうがいいでしょ?
synopsis:
"I think I've found someone I like..."

What? At those words, Kano Mizusawa's soul almost left the earth for a moment. Her childhood friend, Nene Horimiya. With her soft, semi-long hair, she is attractive, has excellent grades except in sports, and is very family-oriented and considerate.

However, Kano likes Nene even though they are both girls. Before she knew it, she had become more than just her best friend. And yet... the first thing that comes to mind is the fact that the two of them have been in the same room together for a long time.

"I can't give you my heart, but I can give you my body!" (!?)

Thus, Kano's reckless and a little extreme "strategy to capture Nene" begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Goodbye Sengen Series
title_japanese: グッバイ宣言シリーズ
synopsis:
As long I met the minimum attendance for credit in my classes, I was fine. Well, I'll just study hard, go to a regular college, and become a salaryman or something, I guess...

That was the future I envisioned as I lazed around at home. But in the spring of my last year of high school, I met you. The you, who was wild, naive, and direct with your dreams more than anyone else. I was infected by your attitude.

We, complete opposites, meet, and are instantly drawn to each other. The two of us are torn between the delicate balance of love and the actualization of our dreams, but... Face your true self, declare goodbye to yesterday's pretense, and bloom wildly in the blue spring!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kyoudai Shuffle
title_japanese: キョーダイシャッフル

title: Bokura wa Eiyuu ni Nareru no Darou ka
title_english: I Wonder if Can We Be Heroes
title_japanese: 僕らは英雄になれるのだろうか

title: 100-nichigo ni Shinu Akuyaku Reijou wa Mainichi ga Totemo Tanoshii.
title_english: The Villain Daughter Who Dies 100 Days Later Has a Lot of Fun Every Day.
title_japanese: 100日後に死ぬ悪役令嬢は毎日がとても楽しい。
synopsis:
The duke's daughter, Lelouche, receives a revelation from God: "You'll die in 100 days."

There are rumors that her fiancé, the crown prince, has found another woman and is about to annul their engagement. ...Moreover, it seems that no matter what she does, Lelouche can't escape death. However, the circumstances and the method of her death can be changed. After being told that, Lelouche offers a bet to God. "If I can show you a beautiful death, I want you to reward me."

"All right. In your next life, I will grant your wishes."

'...Well, looks like I got my hands full,' thinks Lelouche. She can't leave that thieving cat as it is. She also has to do something about her withdrawn brother. She has to prepare something to support her parents. She has a lot of things to do...! In the end, she shall regret nothing...! Thus, a life where she made a bet with God begins.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Cool na Tsukishiro-san wa Ore ni dake Dere Kawaii
title_japanese: クールな月城さんは俺にだけデレ可愛い

title: Kichiku Sensei no Hakuai Kyouiku
synopsis:
An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth. Getting a academy where unusual powers go wild back into shape!

The government is running several schools to manage and educate the people with special powers that have started appearing in this era. One of them is the island academy Tartaros. Kamui Kaminaga, a newly appointed teacher for this academy has witnessed in what kind of state this institution currently is. Very few teachers are able to interfere when the students with special abilities start fights or bully each other. Furthermore, some are even trying to aim their powers at the outside world. Kamui who used to be a student at this academy himself, is now trying to tackle this problem head on and is working hard to resolve these problems!

(Source: MF Bunko J, translated)

title: Ponkotsu Yuusha no Gekokujou
title_japanese: ポンコツ勇者の下剋上

title: Love Comedy Manga ni Haitteshimatta node, Oshi no Make Heroine wo Zenryoku de Shiawase ni Suru
title_japanese: ラブコメ漫画に入ってしまったので、推しの負けヒロインを全力で幸せにする
synopsis:
I love romantic comedy manga. However, my favorite heroine is a sub-heroine, a loser heroine who will never be able to connect with the protagonist. One day I was hit by a truck and woke up to find myself playing the role of the hero's best friend in a romantic comedy manga. Yeah, this is probably a dream. I'm dreaming about being hit by a truck.

In the scene where the hero's best friend is talking alone with my favorite heroine, I possessed that best friend. In the classroom alone with my favorite heroine, all I have to do is to say it.

"I like you."
"What? What are you suddenly saying...?!"
"I'll make you happy. I want you to go out with me."
"Huh?!"

Because I was dreaming, I casually told her. If this wakes me up from my dream, I won't have any regrets.

...Hey, I can't wake up from my dream? It's usually the next day, you know? What, am I reincarnated as this character by any chance? This is the story of how I make sure my favorite heroine is happy.

(Source: Kakuyomu, translate

title: Junai no Kago no Tori
title_english: The Devoted Love of a Caged Bird
synopsis:
1. Junai no Kago no Tori (The Devoted Love Of A Caged Bird)
2. Haru to Sayonara (The Last of Spring)
3. Kekkon Shiyou yo (Let's Get Married)
4. Jou Yoru (A Night of Passion)

title: Kimi ja Nakya Dame na Dorei Shoujo
title_japanese: 君じゃなきゃダメな奴隷少女
synopsis: Hiroto Takasaki, a typical Japanese high school boy who lives alone for unspecified reasons, discovers a silver-haired isekai slave girl lying on the floor in the entryway of his apartment.

title: 10-nenkan Karada wo Nottorare Akujo ni Natteita Watashi ni, Nido to Kao wo Miseruna to Konyaku Haki shitekita Kishi-sama ga Kyou mo Sugattekuru
title_english: I Body-Switched with an Evil Hag for 10 Years, and Now My Knight Ex-Fiancé Who Never Wanted to See Me Again Can't Let Me Go
title_japanese: 10年間身体を乗っ取られ悪女になっていた私に、二度と顔を見せるなと婚約破棄してきた騎士様が今日も縋ってくる
synopsis:
The earl's daughter Sadie has made quite a name for herself as the villainess of the century during the ten years that her body was hijacked. When she realizes she has gotten back in her original body, Rufus, the commander of the knights, is in the middle of breaking off their betrothal. Even when she tells him the truth that her body has been hijacked, he refuses to believe her. Thus, Sadie begins to look for the culprit as well as the cause of the body-switching. Meanwhile, Rufus cannot hide his confusion over Sadie's sudden change in personality... The story unfolds as the two slowly get closer to each other, overcoming a slew of misunderstandings along the way.

(Source: Kodansha)

title: Kanjichau no wa, Daikirai na Kare no Yubi dake.
title_english: I Only Like the Fingers of the Guy I Hate
title_japanese: 感じちゃうのは、大嫌いな彼の指だけ。
synopsis:
Mahiro works at a model agency, and is a super career woman who cares more about work than love. She thought she didn't need a man, until one day a cameraman mistakes her for a swimsuit model and tries to have his way with her! And the man who calls himself Miyano is actually the #1 guy that Mahiro hates!

(Source: Manga Reborn)

title: Ganjigarame na Mitsu no Hana ni Torawarete
title_english: Imprisoned and Bound in a Honey Flower
title_japanese: がんじがらめな蜜の華に囚われて
synopsis:
"How does it feel to have someone else touch you? It feels good, doesn't it?" The young man acts like a gentleman, but he's actually an incubus! And now he's infiltrated the mission academy as a priest, in order to get closer to Tsubaki, the noble woman who everyone calls the lady saint. His aim is to take her body... "Let's play a game," he says. Tsubaki, curious about the incubus, accepts... And so, days of his sweet seduction and twisted gazes begin. If she loses, pleasure awaits her...

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title: Otoko no Honshou, Oshieteyaru yo: Karada ni Kizamareru Doukyo Rule
title_english: I'll Teach You What Men Really Want: Cohabitation Rules Etched into My Body
title_japanese: 男の本性、教えてやるよ～カラダに刻まれる同居ルール～
synopsis:
"Want me to teach you just how scary a man can be?" If she breaks a rule, an erotic punishment is waiting for her! Aki lost her parents when she was young, so she was taken in by the old man who lives next door. Afterwards, she started living with his grandson, a calligrapher named Akinari, and soon fell in love with him. Then, when Aki's 20th birthday rolls around, he hands her "A rulebook for living together from 20 onwards," and tells her that if she breaks the rules, they can't live together any longer. "If you can't remember them, then I'll just have to teach them to your body!" Akinari strips Aki and begins writing the rules on her body... What will this spine-tingling sensation and humiliation bring for Aki!?

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title: Sono Junketsu, Motto Nurashite Ii desu ka?
title_japanese: その純潔、もっと濡らしていいですか?
synopsis:
Anna is the lone daughter of a well-to-do family. She's also in love with Takamasa, her educator. Her forbidden crush stings her heart... But then, one day, Takamasa tells Anna that he will be ending his term as her educator.

(Source: Manga Reborn)

title: Nidome no Hatsukoi wa, Hageshiku Fukaku.
title_english: The Rough and Deep Second First Love
title_japanese: 二度目の初恋は、激しく深く。
synopsis:
"Nao," who lost her family as a child, loses Arata, her fiancé, her only support in an accident. Unable to withstand loneliness, she throws herself into a river during a storm. She awakens in a old shack. There, Nao witnesses a mysterious man with the exact same face as Arata. "I won't let you go back to him" The man spits out, and forcibly steals Nao's lips. "Please... Stop... Nnh" She knows the man isn't Arata, but she can't say no. "Nao..." he calls in the same voice as him. Who... are you?

(Source: Manga Reborn)

title: Reikoku Ookami-kun ni Kyou mo Watashi wa Taberareru
title_english: The Cold-Hearted Wolf Has Come to Devour Me Again
title_japanese: 冷酷オオカミくんに今日も私は食べられる
synopsis:
I'm going to break the old you. His lips feel so forceful and hot, and refuse to let me go... For the first time in 9 years, Mao meets her childhood friend Yuto, who's turned into a cold man whose job is breaking couples up. Mao wants him to turn back to the gentle Yuto she remembers, but Yuto proposes a trade...

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title: Shanai de Ichiban Kiken na Otoko to Kiss no Aji
title_english: The Flavour of a Kiss from the Most Dangerous Guy at Work
title_japanese: 社内で一番キケンな男とキスの味
synopsis:
Saya, who works in public relations at a publisher, was proposed by her boyfriend on Christmas Eve. However, after her boyfriend carelessly told her "You can work part time after you marry me," she got in a fight with him and ended up breaking up. Saya is focused on her career more than ever, but meets a hot young man. He treats her lightheartedly, leaving a horrible impression. But his true identity is...!!

(Source: Manga Reborn)

title: Hajimete Atta noni... Konyakusha!?: Omae no Ikigao, Shitteru yo
title_english: We Just Met and Yet... We're Engaged!?
title_japanese: 初めて会ったのに…婚約者!?-お前のイキ顔、知ってるよ
synopsis:
"You always loved my kisses," says the handsome Souma. This is the situation Hana finds herself in whens he wakes up after an accident surrounded by her parents and a handsome man she doesn't know. Her parents seem at an utter loss as they tell her it is her fiance Souma. He seems sweet a first, but behind his mask lies a sadist who tells Hana that he is pissed off to have been forgotten.

(Source: Manga Reborn)

title: Blue Note
synopsis: Included one-shot: Hatsukoi Refrain

title: Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo!: Fantastic Days
title_japanese: この素晴らしい世界に祝福を！ ファンタスティックデイズ
synopsis:
Follow Kazuma and his party as they help a team of aspiring dancers, fight a former general of the Demon King, and more in a series of adventures based on the Fantastic Days game, along with new, unique content!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Chou Gingakei Gedou Shoujo Leona
title_japanese: 超銀河系外道少女レオナ
synopsis:
A seriously dangerous chick has appeared!! The galaxy's most brutal girl has just transferred to one of Earth's most elite high school for young ladies. It seems that Earth's peace rests in the hands of this young lady with a terrible attitude and her talking nail bat!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Shousetsu Yoake Tsugeru Lu no Uta
title_japanese: 小説 夜明け告げるルーのうた
synopsis:
In the seaside village of Hinashi Town, Kai Ashimoto's grandfather is one of the locals who reinforces the legend that mermaids lurk near Merfolk Island and consume humans. Due to allegedly attracting merfolk and subsequently causing the death of the elder's mother, music is seldom discussed in the Ashimoto household. Even so, Kai finds solace in making looped beats on his laptop and uploading them to the internet.

Despite his reserved and glum demeanor, Kai is approached by Kunio and Yuuho Ebina, two cheerful classmates that happened upon one of his videos. The pair ask him to join their rock band but are met with apathy. Nevertheless, Kai agrees to accompany them in a practice session on Merfolk Island, where he soon witnesses something that he cannot explain.

Later that night, Kai is composing music in his room when he attracts a familiar entity—a mermaid. As she twirls and grins to the sound of his stereo, Kai discovers a number of aspects about the being who introduces herself a

title: Murai no Koi
synopsis:
The story tells a romantic comedy between Tanaka, a high school teacher who loves otome games, and Murai, a high school boy who is in love with Tanaka. Tanaka, who has never been involved in a real-life romance, is confessed to by Murai but rejects his confession. On the next day, Murai transforms himself into the exact likeness of Tanaka's favorite character from her favorite otome game.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Funsou deshitara Hatta made
title_japanese: 紛争でしたら八田まで
synopsis: The story follows Hatta Yuri, a geopolitical risk consultant who travels around the world solving problems.

title: Kishi-sama (Ikuseichuu) to Doukyo shimasu
title_japanese: 騎士様(育成中)と同居します
synopsis:
Ares the knight, with red-eyed gaze fixed upon me, was my favorite "game character" that I casually created based on what came to my mind. He should be a 2D character I jokingly flirt with, and yet that "Ares" flew out of the screen and right into my room!
He kissed my hand, and then as his face drew near, my heart began to flutter... and that just can't be helped! He's the perfect character I created, you know!!!

I'm falling in love with this handsome knight who is exactly my type... but is this the time to do it?! He's a knight who you can rely on to destroy monsters in the game world! A beginner, never-kissed-before knight in this modern world?! My pounding heart is in training too.

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Persona 5: Dengeki Comic Anthology
title_japanese: ペルソナ５　電撃コミックアンソロジー
synopsis: An anthology comic of Persona 5 by various mangaka.

title: Yakuza no Koibito wa Aho Kawaii
title_japanese: ヤクザの恋人はアホかわいい
synopsis:
"If you want a sucker that bad, I've got something for you..." Jouji looks like a violent gangster, but he's actually a kind and caring person. Yuu, on the other hand, makes a living with his body. Ever since he found Yuu beaten in an alley, Jouji can't say no whenever the boy begs for food or money. Jouji is worried about Yuu and makes him promise to find honest work. But, despite his promise, Jouji finds Yuu trying to pick up customers again. Yuu doesn't value his life no matter how much danger he's in, and Jouji finds himself acting impulsively...! With a caring gangster and a boy of questionable virtue, this is a romantic comedy with a touch of danger!

(Source: Renta!)

title: "Bijin de Okanemochi no Kanojo ga Hoshii" to Ittara, Wakeari Joshi ga Yattekita Ken.
title_english: When I Said "I Want a Beautiful and Rich Girlfriend," a Girl with Her Own Reason Came to Me.
title_japanese: 「美人でお金持ちの彼女が欲しい」と言ったら、ワケあり女子がやってきた件。
synopsis:
Iori Shino (virgin), a college student in Fukuoka, becomes engaged to Tsukasa Tendou, a well-known celebrity on campus, because of an unintentional comment he made to his family. She is a beauty and rich—however, Iori is put off by his fiancée, who is rumored to "sleep with anyone," and Tsukasa is aggressively coming onto him... where will their future go?! This is the start of a "slightly mature" romantic comedy of a breaking-off-engagement genre that questions the meaning of falling in love!!

(Source: Micro Magazine-sha, translated)

title: Anti Alpha Another
title_japanese: アンチアルファアナザー

title: Isekai Nonbiri Kaitakuki: Heibon Salaryman, Bannou Jizai no Build & Craft Skill de, Kimama na Slow Life Kaitaku Hajimemasu!
title_japanese: 異世界のんびり開拓記 -平凡サラリーマン、万能自在のビルド&クラフトスキルで、気ままなスローライフ開拓始めます! -

title: Bishuu Gyakuten Sekai de Chiryoushi Yattemasu
title_english: I'm a Healer in the Reversed World of Beauty and Ugliness
title_japanese: 美醜逆転世界で治療師やってます
synopsis:
"Please, somehow—examine me, ugly as I am!"

Toowa has been transmigrated to a world where beauty and ugliness are reversed, where what would be considered a beautiful appearance on earth is instead despised as ugly. Aiming to become an adventurer using his goddess-granted power of healing, he suffered setbacks and decided to open a healing clinic.

One day, returning from a dungeon, an elf with drool dripping from her mouth and reddened cheeks comes to the clinic, pushes Toowa down, and starts to moan! However, when he thoroughly examines her without touching, he discovers a dark design in the vicinity of her belly button!

When she—Sylvie, an A-rank adventurer—recovers her senses, she dashes out of the clinic and returns with her comrades...!?

Toowa, who treats all manner of people he encounters with kindness, is going to heal both their bodies and minds.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Tonda Couple
synopsis:
Aspiring to be admitted to a good university and to become a lawyer, Yuusuke Tashiro, a tenth-grader from Kyushu, enrolls in a prestigious high school in Tokyo. Plans are made for him to live in his uncle's house, part of which is rented out while his uncle is abroad on business. A realtor's mistakes leaves Tashiro sharing the house with Kei Yamaba, the most beautiful girl in the school, who is also his classmate. There is the risk that their unexpected cohabitation will be discovered by the school authorities. While he grows increasingly attracted to her, he is often irritated by her innocent and nonchalant attitude towards their predicament. They each develop other romantic attachments, but end up turning to each other...

(Source: IMDb)

title: Seiso Kanojo, Ochiru.
synopsis:
Even though it's against the school rules for students to date, Tsukimi and Takagi have been going steady in secret for a whole 6 months. On a date at the amusement park, they finally share their first kiss, only for it to be caught on camera by an interloper. When the would-be paparazzo threatens to show the faculty, Tsukimi, being the good girl she is, goes along with his demands in order to preserve her and her boyfriend's academic standing.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Meimon! Daisan Yakyuubu
synopsis:
Asunaro is a new student at a school with three baseball teams; the first is renowned as being one of the best in the prefecture, but the third, Asunaro's team, is filled with the rejects and unskilled of the baseball world. As the baseball instructor deems them to be nothing but trash, he informs the team that they will be disbanded in one month—that is, until one of the players begs him to let them play a single game. They'll be up against the first team, and if they win, they'll get to take over the title and even work their way towards playing at Koshien Stadium. With the help of Kaido, an ex-member of the first team, Asunaro and his friends will do whatever it takes to show they're more than meets the eye!

(Source: Anime-Planet)

Included one-shot:
Volume 21: Naita Aka Oni

title: Seasons of Blossom
synopsis:
Oh, to be young and in love. Oh, to be wild and carefree. The springtime of life is intense, tumultuous, and at times, oh so confusing. Spring, summer, fall and winter—love blossoms in all seasons.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Koneko ♂ ga Matteru node Kaerimasu.
title_japanese: 子猫♂が待ってるので帰ります。

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Aggressor
title_japanese: 機動戦士ガンダム アグレッサー
synopsis:
The story follows the Aggressor unit, a "traitor" Federation unit of soldiers who defected from the Zeon side.

(Source: ANN)

title: ShiraMari
synopsis:
What is an idol? It's a profession that means admiration. A ray of hope to continue your dreams in any era. A deliverer of happiness through smiles and songs. This is the complete record of the sparkling activities of the legendary idol Mari Shirase!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Sankaku Sando
synopsis:
Included one-shot: 
Volume 1: Koi wa Komaku kara

title: Tensei Reijou ga Kokuou Heika ni Dekiai sareru Tatta Hitotsu no Wake: Eterna
title_english: The Only Reason Why a Reincarnation Daughter Is Drowned by His Majesty the King
title_japanese: 転生令嬢が国王陛下に溺愛されるたった一つのワケ eterna

title: Maigo ni Natteita Youjo wo Tasuketara, Otonari ni Sumu Bishoujo Ryuugakusei ga Ie ni Asobi ni Kuru you ni Natta Ken ni Tsuite
title_japanese: 迷子になっていた幼女を助けたら、お隣に住む美少女留学生が家に遊びに来るようになった件について
synopsis:
One day, Charlotte Bennett comes to study abroad in Akihito Aoyagi's class.

All of his classmates are attracted to Charlotte's innocent, elegant behavior and cute appearance, but Akihito calmly feels that she lives in a different world and takes a step back. However, when he helps Charlotte's younger sister, Emma, who was lost, Akihito's daily life changes drastically. After finding out that the Bennett sisters live in the next room of the apartment building, and also that Emma has grown fond of Akihito, the Bennett sisters come to visit his room every day. The three of them play dominoes, sit around the dinner table, and go out together. As they spend time together, Akihito and Charlotte grow closer, despite their clumsiness―a sweet and enticing love comedy next door begins!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Alien in My Wardrobe
synopsis:
"Hey you, Livestock, I need a subject for my alien probe" are not words Haesung expected to ever hear. He spends his days spacing out, hopelessly fantasizing about being tied up by his office crush, Shiwon. But his secret BDSM fantasies come to life as a brutally sexy alien crash-lands on Earth and ropes in Haesung as his research subject (and roommate). Things heat up when Haesung submits to the experiment—in exchange for sexual favors that are out of this world!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Boku no Heya ga Dungeon no Kyuukeijo ni Natteshimatta Ken: Houkago no Isekai Bouken-bu
title_english: About My Room Leads to Dungeon: After School Club Activities of Different World Adventure
title_japanese: 僕の部屋がダンジョンの休憩所になってしまった件 放課後の異世界冒険部
synopsis:
After my parents disappeared, I, Tooru Suzuki, bounced around from place to place and ended up as a caretaker of a school dormitory in Tachikawa. The building is in disrepair, the student boarders are all weirdos, and of course, there are rumors about ghosts haunting it too. It turns out that believe it or not, the dorm is connected to another world! Although I don't have a single friend in class, I can always just go to the dungeon to slay monsters and level-up. There, I became friends with a slime, a female knight, and even a female sorcerer! Thus, I begins another day of after-school club activities in another world!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Boku no Heya ga Dungeon no Kyuukeijo ni Natteshimatta Ken: Houkago no Isekai Bouken-bu
title_english: About My Room Leads to Dungeon: After School Club Activities of Different World Adventure
title_japanese: 僕の部屋がダンジョンの休憩所になってしまった件 放課後の異世界冒険部
synopsis:
After my parents disappeared, I, Tooru Suzuki, bounced around from place to place and ended up as a caretaker of a school dormitory in Tachikawa. The building is in disrepair, the student boarders are all weirdos, and of course, there are rumors about ghosts haunting it too.
