It turns out that believe it or not, the dorm is connected to another world! Although I don't have a single friend in class, I can always just go to the dungeon to slay monsters and level-up. There, I became friends with a slime, a female knight, and even a female sorcerer! Thus, I begins another day of after-school club activities in another world!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Black Channel
synopsis:
The manga's story centers on the demon Black who comes to the human world in search of content for videos. He wants to expose the hidden side of humans, games, and hobbies. Black's "high-efficiency assistant" is the camera demon Camera-chan.

(Source: ANN)

Included one-shots:
Volume 4: Kotodamaster Okuchi & Mukuchi
Volume 13: Devirus x Doctor

title: Zan Zhong Lu
synopsis:
The famous female detective Huang Zixia turns from a genius at solving cases to a murderess who poisoned her whole family, a wanted criminal in all the lands. She can only escape to the capital, but unfortunately, she meets the Kui prince, Li Shubai. As a mere eunuch, she must now investigate the mysteries around her. The sky grows darker and the rain keeps pouring down. Huang Zixia and Li Shubai follow the endless clues through the whole world.

(Source: Webcomics)

title: Kemono Signal
synopsis:
Ayano is a newly employed office worker, who finds it hard to deal with his senior, Oogami. Though extremely capable, Oogami has an air of aloofness about him. Yet, they are assigned to go on a field survey together...

At the old mansion they were surveying, Ayano had a bizarre experience that completely changed his world. He is now able to see the species known as "mimitsuki," the animal-eared. Since humans who can see them are considered extremely valuable, Ayano is now getting targeted. However, he gets saved by Oogami, who is a mimitsuki...?!

The supernatural fantasy tale begins between the unsociable senior with animal ears and the newcomer who can see the unseen!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Aurora Node
synopsis:
In a not so far away future, all forms of entertainment in Japan have become fully digitised. The people have even totally accepted the world as it is now without even thinking much of it. Fujio Nonaka was also one of them. That is until he met a girl with a doll-like appearance who possesses an Aurora Blonde and that's when the cogs of his life began to turn. Just what will Fujio stand to gain now that he has started to think and make decisions for himself?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Oretachi Tsukiattenai kara
title_japanese: 俺たちつき合ってないから
synopsis:
Yurika lives true to the motto "A woman's worth is judged by the salary of her man" and only wants to marry a very rich guy. But just as it seems she finally found one...

(Source: MU)

title: Fanren Xiu Xian Zhuan
title_english: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality
synopsis:
A poor and ordinary boy from a village joins a minor sect in Jiang Hu and becomes an Unofficial Disciple by chance. How will Han Li, a commoner by birth, establish a foothold for himself in in his sect? With his mediocre aptitude, he must successfully traverse the treacherous path of cultivation and avoid the notice of those who may do him harm. This is a story of an ordinary mortal who, against all odds, clashes with devilish demons and ancient celestials in order to find his own path towards immortality.

(Source: Wuxia World)

title: Villain Duke's Precious One
synopsis:
Dietrich Lagrange is destined to become the story's most evil villain, in a family where everyone cruelly vies to claim their place as its head. But somehow, Anissa is worming her way into his cold, shut-off heart. Little does he know that she's actually a reader reborn as his baby sister. No matter what happens, she plans to survive the story rather than live out her character's original deadly fate! Can she remain by Dietrich's side as he rises in power within the dangerous Lagrange family?

(Source: Tapas)

title: I Became the Villain's Mother
synopsis:
Summoned into her favorite novel as the infamous Duchess Roselia Chade, Haena is bathed in riches, power, and a family of her own. Life couldn't be better, save for the small detail that her beloved stepson, Einspanner Chade, is also the evil mastermind destined to kill her. At this point in the story Ein is still just an adorable child yet to reach his cruel awakening, and so Roselia is determined to stop him from becoming a ruthless killer. But with the duke getting in her way and trying to poison his own son, safely raising a child that was primed for villainy may prove harder than she originally thought. The survival of both mother and child depends on whether Roselia can successfully rewrite their tragic ending!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Unintentional Love Story
synopsis:
When Ji Wonyoung's superior is fired in a corruption scandal, the young man finds himself caught up in the mess and is unjustly suspended from the company. Seeking a breath of fresh air, he decides to stay in a remote town until he can clear his name.

As Wonyoung wanders around, he meets the chairman's favorite artist, Yoon Taejun, who disappeared from the public eye two years prior. Determined to win the chairman's favor, Wonyoung befriends Taejun, lying and hiding his true intentions in the process. Living under an alias, Taejun wants to put his past behind him, but Wonyoung must dig up the artist's hidden history to regain his post. As Wonyoung infiltrates Taejun's wary heart, he begins to lose sight of his initial objective and worry for the future, as a relationship built on lies is bound to crumble.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Again My Life
synopsis:
A righteous prosecutor, life reset, punish the villain!

A hot-blooded prosecutor, Kim Hee-wu was murdered, cast into the ocean while chasing the tyrant who controlled Korea. But, Kim Hee-wu meets a grim reaper who gives him a second chance and sends him back to when he was 18 years old. As a high schooler, Kim Hee-wu prepares to punish the tyrant Jo Tae-seop.

"To catch the devil, you must become one."

(Source: Kakao, translated)

title: Hitogirai Koushaku wa Wakaki Niizuma ni Koi wo Suru
title_english: The Unsociable Duke Adores His New Wife
title_japanese: 人嫌い公爵は若き新妻に恋をする
synopsis:
One day, Minerva's engagement to the Crown Prince is called off. However, she soon got engaged to Duke Mars, the brother of the King. Marriage with the Duke, who is unrivaled in terms of beauty and status, would make anyone envious. However, he is famous for his "misanthropy" and rarely shows up at social gatherings or smiles. What will happen to her marriage with him?

(Source: Harper Collins Japan, translated)

title: Jukokuin no Tensei Boukensha: Saikyou Kenja, Jiyuu ni Ikiru
title_english: Reincarnated Adventurer of the Curse Mark: Enjoying Freedom As the Strongest Sage
title_japanese: 呪刻印の転生冒険者 ～最強賢者、自由に生きる～
synopsis:
The great sage, Grameos, tired of his current life as a famous mage, decided to reincarnate as a young boy 200 years in the future. Before reincarnating, he places two magic restraint seals on his hands, so that we can hide his enormous magical power after he is reborn. His motto for the next life is "Hide my powers, don't stand out, and be free."

(Source: MU)

title: Incomplete
synopsis:
I was Eunho Sun's biggest fan... And I never should've let her meet my boyfriend. I thanked my lucky stars when this mysterious author granted me the only interview she'd ever given in her illustrious career. She shared intense, off-the-record secrets with me. I even thought we could be friends. At first, it seemed like an invitation to her home would solidify our friendship, but she wound up in bed with my boyfriend. Will the woman I once idolized actually steal away the love of my life?!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Your Perfume
synopsis:
What if you could return to a moment in your memories that can be recalled by a scent? This is the story of a perfumer, who goes by the name J, and the people who are tranced by the perfumes J makes in which the extract of a fragrance is reminiscent of their nostalgia.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Sweet Salty
synopsis:
I can't get fired from my part-time job! The troublemaker police trainee with a fiery temper starts a new part-time job.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Osananajimi Choukyo: Boyish no Ura ni Kakusareta Mesu no Honshou
title_english: Training My Childhood Friend: A Tomboy's Hidden Lust
title_japanese: 幼馴染調教～ボーイッシュの裏に隠されたメスの本性～
synopsis:
Eisuke only sees his childhood friend Teru as one of the guys. But will he change his mind when she asks him to be her "master"!? 

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Shinai naru Fantôme e: Opera-za no Kaijin
title_japanese: 深愛なるF〈ファントム〉へ～オペラ座の怪人～
synopsis:
There lies a phantom in the opera house of Paris. The being named "F" is rumored to not only be a talented magician and composer, but he is also blessed with a hypnotic singing voice. Due to his odd requests, no one dares to go against his wishes.

Christine Daaé is a part of the chorus at the opera house. As the daughter of a violin player, she has been surrounded by music since she was a child. While trying to catch the only memento of her father from falling into the river, Christine is saved by a strange man with red eyes, who disappears as quickly as he appeared.

When the prima donna Carlotta quits from an upcoming show, Christine becomes her replacement but has no confidence in singing by herself. In hopes of meeting F, Christine goes to the central-western balcony, and luckily, he appears before her. She is shocked to find out that the elusive ghost is the same man who helped her not too long ago. He reveals his real name is Erik and tells Christine he will become her teacher o

title: Ryuu to Sobakasu no Hime
synopsis:
Suzu, a seventeen-year-old high school student living in rural Kochi Prefecture, has kept the world at arm's length ever since her mother's death years ago. But at a friend's urging, she decides to dip her toes into another world: U, the largest online community in history. As her avatar, Belle, Suzu reveals her hidden singing talent and instantly becomes a global internet sensation, leading her to cross paths with a mysterious beast known as the Dragon. Who is this ferocious yet lonely stranger, and what will come of their fateful encounter...?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Hello World if: Kadenokouji Misuzu wa Sekai de Saisho no Shitsuren wo Suru
title_japanese: HELLO WORLD if ー勘解由小路三鈴は世界で最初の失恋をするー

title: Take Five
synopsis:
Jay is a guitarist...well, a bass guitarist. He was even kicked out of the house by his father for having signed up to a music high school without telling him. But he's missing something, his music just feels bland. One day, he starts to understand when he hears the Dave Brubeck Quartet's "Take Five" and meets three eccentric characters: a drummer, a pianist, and a trumpet player. With their help, Jay starts to understand that music is never as beautiful as when it's played in a band, and that a musician can never be above his own art. It's the beginning of an epic journey for Jay, an internal voyage beyond even music itself.

(Source: Editions Milan, translated)

title: Zange Meshi
synopsis:
A salesman of a food manufacturer, Taka-chan loves his newly-married wife, Chinatsu a lot. The love should be deeper than anything else but for some reason she is always angry at him. He loves the way she scorns him, but he wants to see her smile. This is a tasty "I'm sorry" from a jerk of a husband who is a great cook and dedicated to making his wife happy.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Oshi ga Imouto ni Narimashite.
title_japanese: 推しが妹になりまして。
synopsis:
Ichika Kojima is a high school girl obsessed with the idol "Kanon-chan." Ichika is beautiful and popular among the younger students (girls), but she gives herself over completely to idol-otaku activities.  When her dad remarries, she ends up with a new stepsister.  It turns out to be "the little sister of all humanity," her beloved "Kanon-chan" (real name: Akane). A hyper-yuri love comedy begins!

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

title: Ayaka-chan wa Hiroko-senpai ni Koishiteru
title_english: Ayaka is in Love with Hiroko!
title_japanese: 彩香ちゃんは弘子先輩に恋してる
synopsis:
Soft and bubbly office lady Ayaka is madly in love with her senior at work, Hiroko! Two lovestruck coworkers who both think the other is straight totally crush on each other...

(Source: Futabasha)

title: Wagamama Oujo ni Tsukaeta Bannou Shitsuji, Tonari no Teikoku de Saikyou no Gunjin ni Nariagari Musou suru
title_english: Fed Up with Being the Spoiled Queen's Genius Butler, I Ran Away and Built the World's Strongest Army
title_japanese: わがまま王女に仕えた万能執事、隣の帝国で最強の軍人に成り上がり無双する
synopsis:
Leet isn't just any butler. His mistress, Princess Kilik, demands the impossible—and he delivers it, seven times before breakfast. But one day, Leet decides enough is enough, and he flees for a neighboring land where the talented rise up through the ranks instead of languishing in thankless, dead-end jobs. Under a new name, Lilt, he enrolls in a training and job placement program, and rapidly discovers that, easy as "wax on, wax off," his butlering skills make him a valuable asset!

(Source: MU)

title: Shin Sekaiju no Meikyuu: Millennium no Shoujo
title_japanese: 新・世界樹の迷宮 ミレニアムの少女
synopsis:
The Highlander's help is requested in Etria, where an organization called the Radha hires him to explore a labyrinth. Soon, the highlander discovers an amnesiac girl in a futuristic tube, and meets some fellow investigators from the Midgard Library. The group of them team up as a party to continue their exploration!

(Source: MangaHelpers)

title: Shin Sekaiju no Meikyuu: Millennium no Shoujo
title_japanese: 新・世界樹の迷宮 ミレニアムの少女
synopsis:
The Highlander's help is requested in Etria, where an organization called the Radha hires him to explore a labyrinth. Soon, the highlander discovers an amnesiac girl in a futuristic tube, and meets some fellow investigators from the Midgard Library. The group of them team up as a party to continue their exploration!

(Source: MangaHelpers)

title: Papa to Boku to Kazoku ni Natte yo
title_japanese: パパとぼくとかぞくになってよ
synopsis:
"Daddy doesn't smile anymore. Do you think he hates me?"

After losing his wife, Tsubasa spends his days with his five-year-old son Sora whilst trying to balance his job, household chores, and childrearing. Wishing to raise his son to be a respected adult, Tsubasa continues to show a strict side to his son and gradually loses his smile. However, it is at this moment that the straightforward and sociable Hiro moves into the same apartment. Upon witnessing the demanding life Tsubasa lives, Hiro decides to lend a hand, but for Tsubasa who doesn't know how to rely on others, will Hiro's efforts reach him...?

(Source: Kobunsha, translated)

title: Omae no Hou ga Kawaii Kuse ni
title_japanese: お前のほうがかわいいくせに
synopsis:
Kazuki and Seiji live together to save on costs and they've been friends their entire lives... or so it seemed. When Kazuki says he's gonna use an escort to experience his "first time", their relationship totally changes. Seiji says he's willing to help him and, for some reason, they become a couple! Kazuki knows that Seiji also hasn't done the deed, so he thinks Seiji just wants to prevent him from being the first to pop his cherry, but...

(Source: Renta!)

title: Sadistic Beauty
synopsis:
The lives of two men are thrown into chaos when the sexy Chun Duna returns to town. On one end is student Woo Haesol whose timid nature reveals a man just begging to be dominated. On the other is Professor Byun Minho, a male chauvinist who bitterly views Duna as his mortal enemy. Tempers flare as pain turns into pleasure under the watchful eye of a sadistic beauty.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Koukyuu no Karasu
synopsis:
Deep within the palace lives a mysterious woman known only as the Raven Consort. Some say she's an old woman, others that she's young and beautiful. But all are agreed on this: her dark arts have the power to exorcise spirits, lay fatal curses, and find what has been lost—for a price. When the young emperor, Koushou, seeks out the Raven Consort to make use of that magic, what follows will overturn the court...and perhaps even the country.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Da Wang Rao Ming
synopsis:
After the revivification and return of the spirit energy, men and women did their best to capture every strands of spirit energy and train, except Lu Shu, with his Negative Emotion System, he becomes stronger by taunting others! He only wanted to protect his younger sister, but the change of an era in unavoidable, then all he could do was... to taunt others in passing, and become the strongest! Then, are you ready? Here comes Lu Shu, "The Great Demon King!"

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Akuyaku Reijou no Ani ni Tensei shimashita
title_japanese: 悪役令嬢の兄に転生しました
synopsis:
"I was...reincarnated as the brother of a villainess! How did it come to this?!" The main character who got reincarnated as the brother of a villainous daughter in the world of otome games struggles to prevent his sister's bad ending!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Kamigoroshi no Maou, Saijaku Shuzoku ni Tenseishi Shijou Saikyou ni Naru
title_english: The God-Slaying Demon King: Reincarnated as a Mere Mortal to Become the Strongest in History!
title_japanese: 神殺しの魔王、最弱種族に転生し史上最強になる
synopsis:
Hiram, the strongest demon king in history and ruler of all demons, defies the Demon God's demands for sacrifices. This defiance leads to a fierce battle that leaves Hiram dead. Despite being the strongest, he could not overcome the truth of this world: Demons cannot defeat the Demon God.

Five hundred years later, Hiram has finally reincarnated as a human. While humans are considered the weakest race, they actually have the highest potential for growth—and Hiram fully intends to take advantage of that fact. So begins Hiram's new quest to kill the Demon God in this unique adventure story!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Osananajimi no S-kyuu Party kara Tsuihou sareta Seijuutsukai. Bannou Shien Mahou to Nakama wo Fuyashite Saikyou e!
title_japanese: 幼馴染のS級パーティーから追放された聖獣使い。万能支援魔法と仲間を増やして最強へ!
synopsis:
A beast tamer without a familiar, Lock had been supporting his friends in an S-Rank party until they finally decided to use him as a decoy and abandoned him. After a conversation with the Fenrir that his party was attacking, it chose to serve Lock as his familiar. By using and expanding the "Mini Monster Garden," Lock gathers more and more familiars to form the strongest—and cutest—party ever. A fantasy where men and beasts go on adventures together.

(Source: MU, edited)

title: Tanjoubi no Cocktail
synopsis:
A strange man comes up to Alice as she's drinking alone at a bar. His intense stare stirs something within her. It's her birthday—why can't she spend a night of fun with a handsome stranger? The next morning, though, she is shocked to learn that this man, Liam, is actually her new boss!

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Kamiato ni Kiss
synopsis:
Life is going well for Hidaka. He has good interpersonal relationships, has a nice face and is entrusted with a big project. His life is set on easy mode, hiding behind a façade of his prince-like appearance. That is until one day, Tachibana, a handsome and elite junior joins the company and finds out about Hidaka's true nature! With a devious smile, Tachibana successfully lures Hidaka in with drinks and they end up in bed?! "Can we keep seeing each other if we're fuck buddies?" A bite mark is the proof of submission?

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: My Dear Agent
title_japanese: マイディア・エージェント
synopsis:
Professional bodyguard Riichi is employed to protect the son of the leader of a large conglomerate and takes his work incredibly seriously. One day, he's tasked with coaching Tachibana, a rookie new hire, who unfortunately has no money and no place to go. Opening his home to the new employee, Riichi is taken aback by Tachibana's brashness... and his endless flirting! Just who is this mysterious new coworker and what's his problem?

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Akuma wa Tengoku ni Ikitakunai!
title_japanese: 悪魔は天国にイキたくないっ!
synopsis:
"You think I, a former lust demon, would let an angel love me?!" 

After thousands of years, a former demon has reincarnated as a human, Makoto Aino. Though he retains his memories from his previous life, he has sealed his powers and lives as a good person. Suddenly, former angel and rival Yuu Minakata appears in front of Makoto, jokingly calling himself a "disciple of love." Minakata has no memory of his previous life, and has transformed into a complete playboy...Makoto is afraid to get involved with Minakata, but ends up taking him home to care for him after Minakata gets dead drunk. Minakata wakes up and Makoto is about to throw him out, when he sees Minakata's area is reacting and he's suddenly horny!? Don't mate with me...!! The overflowing love and sex from this former angel is too good, could this be...?!

(Source: Amucomi, translated)

title: Junket Bank
synopsis:
Karasu Bank is one of Japan's leading banks, boasting the third-highest operating profits in the country. Akira Mitarai is a young employee in his second year at the bank's central branch. His exceptional math skills allow him to instantly spot accounting errors but also make his day-to-day life incredibly boring.

One day, Akira is suddenly transferred to the Special Operations Department's "Appraisal Unit," which he is told is a key department within the bank. Suspicious of his transfer and the unfamiliar department, he is told by his new boss that the bank actually operates a massive underground casino, and that the Appraisal Unit is the department responsible for managing this gambling as well as the gamblers who participate in it. But these gamblers are putting more than just their money on the line, with their very lives serving as collateral to play! Higher risk means higher rewards, but at the top level losing is a death sentence.

Overwhelmed and confused by the strange state

title: Karakida-ke no Koshogurashi
title_japanese: 百木田家の古書暮らし
synopsis:
Kanda Jinbouchou, the oldest bookstore in the world. The three Karakida sisters moved to the city to protect their grandfather's will. Surrounded by the scent of used books, the three sisters spend their everyday lives.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Ningen Ijou
synopsis:
1-3. Ningen Ijou
4. Godzilla
5. Return of the Godzilla
6. Sandaikaijuu: Chikyuu Saidai no Kessen
7. All Kaijuu Daishingeki
8. Ikyou
9. Hanran

title: Curtain Call ni wa Mada Hayai
title_japanese: カーテンコールにはまだ早い
synopsis:
Minami works part-time at a coffee shop and can't forget his first love. Coloring his mundane everyday life is that same omega MAI who is active in video distribution. "If you become a paid member, you too can also see how to comfort yourself during heat!"

(Source: MU)

title: Love All Play
synopsis:
Ryou Mizushima enrolls in junior high and joins the badminton club with great vigor. Although the club didn't have a proper coach, Mizushima improved his skills with his own physical strength by the time he participated in the prefectural tournament. Afterwards, he is approached by the Yokohama Minato High School's badminton coach, Ebihara.

Indecisive and timid, Mizushima hesitates to attend such a prestigious school. However, with his elder sister Rika giving him a strong push, he decides to go to Yokohama Minato. Now blessed with a coach and idiosyncratic teammates, Mizushima will gain experience he's lacked till now, and aims to win the inter-high tournament.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Love All Play
synopsis:
Ryou Mizushima enrolls in junior high and joins the badminton club with great vigor. Although the club didn't have a proper coach, Mizushima improved his skills with his own physical strength by the time he participated in the prefectural tournament. Afterwards, he is approached by the Yokohama Minato High School's badminton coach, Ebihara.

Indecisive and timid, Mizushima hesitates to attend such a prestigious school. However, with his elder sister Rika giving him a strong push, he decides to go to Yokohama Minato. Now blessed with a coach and idiosyncratic teammates, Mizushima will gain experience he's lacked till now, and aims to win the inter-high tournament.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Maou Reijou kara Hajimaru Sangokushi: Touhakuden
title_japanese: 魔王令嬢から始める三国志～董白伝～
synopsis:
Sasane Shirokawa (30) is a former trading company employee and a huge fan of Romance of the Three Kingdoms. One day, after losing consciousness in Chinatown, he wakes up to find himself in the form of a little girl. However, the new body he finds himself in isn't just any little girl, but the daughter of the infamous tyrannical Dong Zhuo, Dong Bai. In order to avoid the fate of being executed alongside Dong Zhuo, Dong Bai will have to use both experience as a Japanese businessman as well as knowledge of the era!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Satsujin Gokko
synopsis:
Miki Fujisaki is a first year student whose obsession with murder frightens many of her peers. Student Council President Aoi takes it upon herself to scold Miki and set her right. But instead, Aoi is drawn into an increasingly elaborate game of "pretend-murder" with Miki that threatens her social status at school, and awakens new feelings deep within her.

(Source: MU)

title: Gokigen Naname no Yoshioka-san: Fukuchi Tsubasa Tanpenshuu
title_japanese: ご機嫌ナナメの吉岡さん～福地翼短編集～

title: Loop 8-shuume wa Shiawase na Jinsei wo: 7-shuubun no Keikenchi to Daisan Oujo no "Kantei" de Kakusei shita Ore wa, Aibou no Behemoth to Tomo ni Musou suru
title_english: 8th Loop for the Win! With Seven Lives' Worth of XP and the Third Princess's Appraisal Skill, My Behemoth and I Are Unstoppable!
title_japanese: ループ8周目は幸せな人生を ～7周分の経験値と第三王女の『鑑定』で覚醒した俺は、相棒のベヒーモスとともに無双する～
synopsis: Master swordsman, sage, dragon knight... Remille can't believe his ears when the princess lists off his possible futures. Born to a lesser noble house, he's never been anything but a low-level adventurer. In fact, he's lived that same life seven times—always forming an adventuring party with his friends at age fifteen, and always giving his own life to save theirs three years later. But not this time. The eighth loop is going to be different. After his most recent death reveals his friends' treachery, Remille finally takes a different path that leads him to Princess Ciel, wielder of the powerful Eye of Appraisal that can judge anyone's true potential. Will her wild claims about Remille's future come to pass? With her guidance, can he really become a great sage or a rider of dragons? Is the adorable catlike familiar he's tamed in past lives really a mighty behemoth, the strongest of the magical beasts? And will he really be able to escape the deadly destiny that's claimed his life seven

title: Aijitsu to Hanayome
title_english: Kind Winter Sun and Smiling Blossom
synopsis:
"I wonder if someone would have helped me if I told them I was actually scared."

Luka, a young man from the village who suddenly became an omega, is now, according to tradition, the bride of a god, a "sacrifice"... He is married to a god who is said to eat people for the sake of the village, but the sun god, Kuro, is not as he is rumored to be...? Spinning days with a god, they soon turn into something lovely.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Oni-san Dochira? Koushoku Haraishi to Toraware no Oni
title_english: Who's the Real Demon? The Naughty Exorcist and His Captive Demon
title_japanese: 鬼さんどちら? ～好色祓い師と捕われの鬼～
synopsis:
A female demon, Tama, is held captive by Mutsu, a handsome, ruthless exorcist with a horrible personality. She is forced to help Mutsu with day to day chores as well as finding clients for exorcisms. One day, she tries to escape while Mutsu is asleep, only for him to wake up and force himself onto her. As his hands wander under her clothes, Tama, unfamiliar with her own body, is unable to contain the pleasure she feels. She melts into a puddle after her first "mating" experience...especially after seeing certain expressions on the face of such a brutal man!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Yankee Joshi wa Otaku ni Naritai
title_japanese: ヤンキー女子は腐女子〈オタク〉になりたい
synopsis: An otaku and a yankee that seems to be interested in reading manga?

title: Danshi Chuugakusei ni Mamakatsu Shitai Joshikousei no Ohanashi
title_japanese: 男子中学生にママ活したい女子高生のおはなし
synopsis: The story of a middle school boy cooperating with his friend's cousin to help her experience what it's like being a mother.

title: Mochizuki-san Chi no Yankee
title_japanese: 望月さん家のヤンキー
synopsis:
When their mother passed away, the Mochizuki family's eldest daughter Yuka tried to take care of her father and siblings as best she could, but her cooking was simply catastrophically bad. After her father stumbles by chance upon a boy who made an incredible bento, he proceeds to ask him to come to their home as a housekeeper. However, that person turned out to be Kuraku, the blonde-haired delinquent in Yuka's class!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Onna Kajishi wa Ohitoyoshi Guild ni Hirowaremashita: Shintenchi de Ganbaru Kajishi Seikatsu
title_japanese: 女鍛冶師はお人好しギルドに拾われました　～新天地でがんばる鍛冶師生活～
synopsis:
Liliana gave up her aristocratic title in order to survive, and through her natural blacksmithing skills and hard work, she became a court blacksmith at the young age of 15. One day, however, she is scoffed at as a "woman who stinks of iron" by a hero whom she admires, and is banished from the court for a baseless crime. At a loss for what to do, she is picked up by a young swordsman, Glaive, who allows her to stay at his guild, the Sword of the Blue Sky. The court that banished her, on the other hand, is unable to repair the hero's holy sword.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Chou Donkan Mob ni Heroine ga Kouryaku sarete, Otome Game ga Hajimarimasen@comic
title_japanese: 超鈍感モブにヒロインが攻略されて、乙女ゲームが始まりません@COMIC
synopsis:
Masahiko Shinoyama reincarnated into the world of an otome game as a mob character. Being an ordinary guy, he didn't think he'd be involved in any way, so he decided to just live his second life without any regrets. Nevertheless, he ends up solving all the troublesome events of the game for the sake of the love interests. Seeing his actions, the heroine of the game ends up pursuing him instead. However, Masahiko's so stupidly dense that even the love interests cheer for the heroine.

(Source: MU)

title: Ansatsu Koukyuu: Ansatsu Jokan Karin wa Yuttari Ikitai
title_japanese: 暗殺後宮～暗殺女官・花鈴はゆったり生きたい～
synopsis:
The imperial harem is where the world's beauties have all gathered. Karin (Hua Ling), a maid in training, dreams of making friends. However, due to her father's heinous acts as a politician, she spends tearful days with everyone too scared to approach her... It was then that she noticed that the young emperor, the only one willing to treat her with kindness, was being targeted by assassins. What will come of her as she becomes involved in the imperial harem's conspiracies while protecting the emperor with the assassination skills inherited from her father?

(Source: MU)

title: Kamitsuite, Jareatte
title_japanese: かみついて、じゃれあって
synopsis: A man gets more than he bargained for when he helps out a young man who recently arrived in town.

title: Princess Principal
title_japanese: プリンセス・プリンシパル
synopsis:
At the end of the 19th century, London, the Kingdom of Albion has been split into East and West sides by a giant wall. Five girls attend Queen's Mayfaire, a conventional and prestigious school. Under the guise of regular high school girls, they act as spies under cover. Disguise, reconnaissance, infiltration, car chases... Each girl uses their own set of special skills to dart around the world of shadow.

(Source: Sentai Filmworks)

title: Glass Top!
synopsis:
1. Being Late
2. Omoikomi Onna x Nagasare Otoko
3. Okazu no Tonari
4. Tsuitemasu ne
5. Game Center no Onna.
6. Ya〇shii Dannasama
7. Kyoudai dakara No Count!
8. Toaru Kyouin no Seichou Kiroku
9. Hansoku no Onna Kyoushi

title: Seijo, Yuusha Party kara Kaiko sareta node Guild wo Tsukuttara At Home na Saikyou Guild ni Sodachimashita. @comic
title_english: I, a Saint, Was Dismissed from the Hero Party; Therefore, I Established a Guild, Which Grew up to Be the Strongest One Having a Homey Atmosphere @comic
title_japanese: 聖女、勇者パーティーから解雇されたのでギルドを作ったらアットホームな最強ギルドに育ちました。＠COMIC
synopsis:
In a world where humans battle monsters, the skilled Saint Sia is tasked to defeat the Demon King but finds herself labeled incompetent and banished from the Hero's party. But instead of despairing, she's actually thrilled! This is her chance to meet truly wonderful and top-notch companions! Determined to build a guild that values character over strength, she seeks out her ideal party members. Her recruits are a mix of odd yet charming individuals: a sincere and hardworking young man living as a vagrant, an endearingly naive little girl, and a clumsy older man—ordinary folk notable only for their kindness. With her Saintly powers, Sia recognizes their hidden talents and helps them flourish through quests. Though still rough around the edges, they might just become strong enough to take on the Demon King! With the resourceful guild leader by their side, perhaps they can become something more.

(Source: TO Books)

title: Koujou Yakei: Aruga Rie Rensakushuu
title_english: Night View of the Factory: A Collection of Stories by Rie Aruga
title_japanese: 有賀リエ連作集　工場夜景
synopsis:
Ao and Takaomi are two childhood friends living near an industrial area. Keeping their feelings hidden from one another, they carry on with their high school everyday.

"It's our final summer in school. Let's go see the factory nightscapes—just the two of us." This is their promise, and a romance begins to bloom. However, a certain incident spells turmoil for their budding relationship, placing them at the mercy of an unstoppable fate...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Otonari wa Tenshi to Akuma
title_english: The Angel, the Devil, and Me
title_japanese: おとなりは天使と悪魔
synopsis:
Nozomi Shindou is house-sitting for her uncle for two weeks while he's on an international business trip, and though she knows she ought to let the neighbors know, she thinks it's too much trouble...until her neighbor happens to be utterly gorgeous. His name is Yuuta Honjou, and she's in love at first sight, until his roommate Chiaki Shiki steps out and is somehow even more gorgeous than Yuta. The possibility of a relationship between her gorgeous neighbors fuels her fujoshi mind (and her online novel), but she can't help but wonder...what is the actual relationship between the two? And is there any space in it for her?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Otoko wo Dame ni Suru Shucchou Este
title_japanese: 男をダメにする出張エステ
synopsis:
How did a straight office worker end up in an aphrodisiac-powered beauty massage?!

Hiroki Ichinose is a dime-a-dozen office worker who feels the stress of being repeatedly sent on business trips. On one such a trip, his co-worker suggests he undergo a beauty massage, and so Hiroki ends up ordering a 5-day course for around $100.

"Good evening! Thank you for your reservation. I will be your beauty specialist tonight. Call me Hiiragi!" The friendly and approachable Hiiragi gives Hiroki a sense of security. But after the session, his body is all hot and bothered, and so he ends up touching himself to release the tension. His masseur Hiiragi is the person cropping up in his thoughts. Over the next couple of days, Hiiragi's massages escalate in intensity, until Hiroki eventually can't stop his excitement anymore... Will this spell disaster...?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Saye
synopsis:
Seventeen-year-old Jiang Cheng is cast aside by his adoptive parents and sent to a desolate northern town to live with his gambling-obsessed, deadbeat father. Arriving with just a suitcase, a pack of cigarettes, and a looming sense of dread over his uncertain future, he steps off the train and into a bleak, rundown place far from everything he knows. There, he meets Gu Miao, a quiet, troubled girl, and her brother Gu Fei, a boy his age with musical notes shaved into his hair. Disenchanted with life, Jiang Cheng and Gu Fei are reluctant to connect, but fate—and Gu Miao—have other plans.

In this frigid snow-covered town, hope seems frozen in time, yet the unexpected bond between Jiang Cheng and Gu Fei might prove to be the warmth they both desperately need.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Kono Koi wa Te ni Amaru
title_english: This Love Is Too Much for Me
synopsis:
Izumi, a high school teacher, playfully asks his student, Enomoto Ritsu, "Would you like to go out with me?" Izumi was so desperately pushed out, but due to an event in the past, he didn't really intend to go out with anyone. Izumi was trying to put a brake on his feelings, even though he thought that the pure and naïve reaction of Ritsu, who was not accustomed to romance, was cute...?

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

title: "Kimi wo Aisuru Ki wa Nai" to Itta Jiki Koushaku-sama ga Nazeka Dekiai shitekimasu
title_japanese: 「きみを愛する気はない」と言った次期公爵様がなぜか溺愛してきます
synopsis:
Elsa, daughter of a fallen aristocrat, receives a marriage proposal from Julius, an elite aristocrat. "Why would such a noble man marry me?" Elsa was perplexed, but after the wedding, Julius, who until then had been kind and gentle, changed his mind!

(Source: Flex Comix, translated)

title: Shinimodori no Mahou Gakkou Seikatsu wo, Moto Koibito to Prologue kara (※Tadashi Koukando wa Zero)
title_english: Re-Living My Life with a Boyfriend Who Doesn't Remember Me
title_japanese: 死に戻りの魔法学校生活を、元恋人とプロローグから（※ただし好感度はゼロ）
synopsis:
Oriana, a seventeen-year-old magic student, suddenly dies alongside her boyfriend, Vincent. However, she returns from death in the body of her seven-year-old self with the memories of her past life intact—except for the knowledge of what killed her. She fantasizes for years about reuniting with her beloved, but when they finally meet, Vincent doesn’t remember her! Can she make Vincent fall in love with her again and avoid the death that started this mysterious time loop?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Kimi no Gomeifuku nante Inoranai
title_japanese: きみのご冥福なんていのらない
synopsis:
After being confessed to by her close friend Ono, Shinohara runs way in embarrassment. Ono is then killed in an accident that same evening without getting a reply. Drown in grief and regret, Shinohara wishes to see Ono again in front of his grave, and the newly dead Ono rises up in answer.

(Source: MU)

title: Tsukihime: A Piece of Blue Glass Moon - Anthology Comic Star
title_japanese: 月姫 －A piece of blue glass moon－ アンソロジーコミックSTAR
synopsis: An anthology comic of Tsukihime: A Piece of Blue Glass Moon by various mangaka.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Oni
title_japanese: ひぐらしのなく頃に 鬼
synopsis:
Taisho, year 12 (1923). A tragedy in Hinamizawa village changes the fate of a girl and her friends. The turbulent early life of Oryou, head of the Sonozaki family, one of the Three Great Families, who would later be feared and known as Empress Sonozaki.

The missing link to the original Higurashi no Naku Koro ni is now revealed.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Sayonara Eri
synopsis:
Suffering from a terminal illness, Yuuta Itou's mother asks him to film her last moments, which he does. From her radiant smile when she is with her family to the times when sickness ravages her body in the hospital, he records hours upon hours of footage. After her passing, Yuuta compiles her life into a movie to screen at his school, deciding to add a bit of fantasy to the ending of his film, Dead Explosion Mother, with a literal explosion!

Following the backlash caused by his supposedly tone-deaf portrayal of his mother's death, Yuuta trudges to the hospital roof to take his own life—but there, he meets a girl named Eri. Captivated by his film, Eri requests Yuuta to make a new one that will blow the previous out of the water and prove his critics wrong. The movie they set out to make will stand apart by blurring the line between fact and fiction. And of course, it would not be a Yuuta film if it did not have his personal flavor—just a dash of fantasy.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kakuriyo Shinjuuki: Isekai de, Kamisama no Oishasan Hajimemasu.
title_japanese: かくりよ神獣紀 異世界で、神様のお医者さんはじめます。
synopsis:
A girl named Yae reincarnates into a world where one's name determines their essence. When a monster attacks her, she unleashes Arai, an ex-god in the form of a golden tiger, to defend herself. Shortly after, however, Arai manipulates Yae into assisting his little brother, who has been warped into a grotesque form by a disease that strips people of their essences. As Yae searches for a cure, she finds herself warming to the pompous, threatening Arai...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Yoi Ten Totte ne Watashi no Tame ni
title_japanese: 良い点取ってね 私のために
synopsis:
Kanade has been tutoring Nao, but his grades are not improving. What happens when she notices that he has been distracted?

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Suki de Suki de... Suki dakara
title_english: I Just Really, Really Love Him
title_japanese: 好きで好きで...好きだから
synopsis:
Timid Chiko is so scared of her boyfriend Ryoya rejecting her, she does anything he asks. Whether it be blowjobs at school, wearing a vibrator for a day, or even group sex, she reluctantly follows all his orders.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Sonna no tte... Hen ja Nai desu ka
title_english: I Did It Out of Love...
title_japanese: そんなのって…変じゃないですか
synopsis:
How far would you go for love? For Miyo, at least, catching another girl trying to hit on her boyfriend is enough to make her see red. But if your (hot) girlfriend was THIS crazy over you, that couldn't possibly be a bad thing... could it?

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Jouzu ni Waraitai
synopsis:
Nanase just wants to be loved, but her menacing facial expressions and steely eyes make it difficult for people to approach her. But when one of her classmates confesses to liking her in spite of her peculiar mannerisms, all that's left is to make things official with some good old sex.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Ikkagetsukan no Paradise
synopsis:
Hana, a shut-in, is enjoying her life at home with meals her brother cooks. But when she catches her brother and his girlfriend having sex one day, how will her paradise change? 

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: 10-nenkan Tomodachi dato Omotteta Otokonoko ni Kokuhaku sareru Ohanashi
title_english: A Boy Who Was Just a Friend for Ten Years Confessed Love to Me
title_japanese: 10年間友達だと思ってた男の子に告白されるお話

title: Shiitagerareshi Reijou wa, Sekaiju no Aruji ni Narimashita
title_english: The Oppressed Daughter Became the Master of Yggdrasil
title_japanese: 虐げられし令嬢は、世界樹の主になりました
synopsis:
This is a Cinderella fantasy about an unlucky girl hiding strength and the power of destiny.

Despite being a count's daughter, Fiora is treated unreasonably. Her engagement broken, the sapling that was the last memento of her late mother gone up in flames, every day is spent suffering through this cruel treatment. However, one day, a strange yet beautiful man appears before her. His name is Arum. What's this about being the incarnation of Yggdrasil, and Fiora is now his master?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Himegimi wa Kishi Danchou
title_english: The Knight Captain Is the New Princess-to-Be
synopsis:
Christina, a.k.a. "Lady Chris," was born into a noble family and treated more or less like a boy growing up. Now a dashing young woman, Chris is not only captain of the imperial guards–she personally protects Prince Leonardo, who has been a dear friend since childhood. When his father, the king, demands he find a suitable girl to marry, Leo insists that he's already found one: Chris! Chris is shocked, but figures that Leo doesn't really love her like that; it's probably just some ploy to keep the king happy. Chris decides to play along, but as the charade goes on, she starts to wonder if maybe her princely pal has actually fallen for her!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Included one-shots:
Volume 1: Maou-sama wa Kindan no Koi ga Shitai (The Demon King Longs for Forbidden Love), Shinobi no Dannasama (My Husband, the Ninja)

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

synopsis:

While the other six are blessed with grandiose titles and superlative stats, Sora is stuck with no title, no level, and a single, underwhelming skill: he never gets tired from walking. After being judged useless to the cause, Sora is thrown out into the streets and left to fend for himself. Nevertheless, he grows determined to turn his unjust treatment and seemingly "useless" skill into a positive by earning money, making friends, and seeing sights he's never seen before!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Akuyaku Reijou desu ga Shibou Flag Kaihi no Tame ni Seijo ni Natte Kenryoku wo Koushi Shiyou to Omoimasu
title_japanese: 悪役令嬢ですが死亡フラグ回避のために聖女になって権力を行使しようと思います
synopsis:
One day, Letisha realized that she had been reincarnated as a "villainess" (6 years old) who was doomed to die in an otome game. According to the game's plot, she will be condemned by her fiancé, the second prince, at the age of 18, and even her fiefdom will be taken over, in the worst possible outcome. To start, she saves her poor territory with her knowledge from her previous life, and when she plays a big role in helping the faerie king, she is called a "saint"...? Then, she will use the power of a saint to "lure" the true villain who tried to bring her down! Under the protection of her doting father and the faerie king, she will do everything in her power to avoid the death flag!

(Source: Starts Shuppan, translated)

title: Rental Kareshi ni Hiru mo Yoru mo Moteasobaretemasu!?

Yuu pretends he can't have a girlfriend because he has a secret he can't tell anyone—he likes boys. But before he gets busy studying for exams, he wants some dating experience! Yuu takes the plunge and applies for a rental boyfriend. On the day of the date, his rental boyfriend—Makoto, was surprised to see a boy and whispered: "I like your face." Yuu keeps getting distracted by his words and behaviors. It makes Yuu wonder... what's Makoto's real identity?

(Source: Kill Time Communication, translated)

She tries to write a love story through logical inference, but she is shown the overwhelming difference in power of Narukawa, a handsome and capable editor who puts out a series of hits. title: Seijo ja Nai to Tsuihou sareta node, Mofumofu Juusha (Seijuu) to Onigiri wo Nigiru

Nina Kamisato is a corporate drone, always heading home on the last train. But one night, when she's about to eat her late dinner, she's suddenly transported to another world (along with her rice cooker) as part of a saintess summoning ritual. Unfortunately, her beautiful, young neighbor ends up being summoned along with her and is immediately assumed to be the true saintess. Thus, Nina is banished from the royal capital.

Alone in an unknown world with nothing other than her rice cooker, what's a girl to do?! As she tries to wrap her head around what had just ensued, a puppy-like creature then appears before her... An adorable, heartwarming tale of an overworked woman turned exiled saintess, her handsome Sacred Beast companion, and their leisurely adventures traveling and cooking.

He never came to see her husband after he fell seriously ill, and she'll never forgive him for that. However, her husband's will completely blindsided her—unbelievably her husband asked his brother, Guy, to marry Francesca and take care of her for the rest of her life!

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

Club Bar Puddle looks like any other nightclub on the surface, but in reality, it runs an illegal entertainment service in the form of prostitution. The club's resident omega, Aoi, who boasts the top sales of the club, is the envy of everyone. It doesn't matter who his client is, he'll sleep with any omega, beta, or alpha as long as he's the one on top.

Turning his pleasures into money, Aoi enjoys his life until one day when an alpha who isn't swayed by any omega server at the club catches his eyes. The man, who emits a pheromone he's never felt before, relentlessly seeks Aoi out. Will Aoi's hidden trauma be revealed little by little in the hands of this alpha...?

Ever since he was a student, Fukawa has always been told by everyone about how "normal" he is. He was just a temporary staff working hard to become a full-time employee when Subada, the company's ace, suddenly called out to him with an offer, "I'm going to go independent to start my own company, and I'd like you to join me."

Though the offer surprised him, Fukawa decided to work for Subada in order to make a change for himself. However, Subada turned out to be a "special" person who has an abnormal affinity to be liked by just about anyone! His life used to be ordinary, but as he comes to learn of Subada's many different sides, Fukawa now finds that not only his lifestyle but also his feelings are beginning to change...

synopsis:

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title_japanese: 花の散るらん－吉原遊郭恋がたり－

After her family perishes in a fire, Sakura is sold to the Yoshiwara neighborhood. Her life intersects with Gin's, and everything changes. A forbidden love between a prostitute and her boss, set in Edo times with the famous red-light district as a backdrop.

Despite saying that, Shun also loves Haruto and began to have perverted dreams about him frequently. At the height of his puberty, Shun couldn't be honest and acted hot and cold every day until, one day, he mistook the real Haruto for the one in his dreams and kissed him...?!

This is a BL about a youth full of worldly desires!

title: Kimi wa Nazotoki no Ma Chérie

During the 1930s, a period of rampant shifts is reshaping Japan's societal structure. Mitsuko Hoshino is a prime example of such change, being the first female detective to ever exist in the country. Despite receiving back-handed compliments on a daily basis regarding her gender and profession, Mitsuko would not change her job for anything in the world and strives to be the best at the Ginza Detective Bureau.

At a cafe, Mitsuko meets a handsome young waiter named Saku Yoshida, who requests help to find the owner of a shoe he found. After handling the case, Mitsuko is shocked to find out that Saku has not only been cast off by his wealthy family, but the college student is also now employed by the bureau to be Mitsuko's assistant! While their relationship slowly blossoms, the duo is tasked with solving mysteries side by side in these ever-changing times.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Bijutsubu no Kamimura ga Shinda

Kamimura died then came back to life. When he goes to school, he says, "It's all useless" then locks himself away at home. His neighbor Nishiuchi tries to bring him back out, but...?!

To Hitomi's surprise, Enokida reappears at her office one day after returning from an overseas assignment. It turns out they have both been working at the same company for three years, but their paths have never crossed until now. As the two meet up more often, her efforts to move on are futile, and old feelings seem to rekindle for the both of them.

One day, the most beautiful girl in school suddenly shows up at Kento Ikuno's door. She shows him a "ticket" written in awkward handwriting. This is the start of a romantic comedy about a "ticket to do anything I say" that came from his childhood.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Yomei 2-kagetsu no Isekai Kenkouhou
title_english: Two Months Left to Live in Another World
title_japanese: 余命２ヶ月の異世界健康法
synopsis:
Meet Kaichi Takemura, aged 82. Owner of the Takemura Dojo and master of the Churyu Akai-Jutsu martial arts, he is now wheelchair-ridden due to severe lung cancer. He is estimated to only have two months left to live. Realizing his time on this earth is ending, Takemura creates a bucket list of things he wants to do before then, which he shares with his nurse Tokiko Tanaka. However, one day his illness flares up, and Tanaka wheels him to the nearest doctor as fast as she can. When he comes to, he finds that the two of them aren't in the emergency room of the hospital. In fact, it doesn't seem like they're in Japan at all...

(Source: MU)

title: Oneesama to Watashi: Ojousama ga Isekai Tensei
title_english: Sister and Giant: A Young Lady Is Reborn in Another World
title_japanese: お姉さまと巨人〈わたし〉 お嬢さまが異世界転生
synopsis:
Reincarnated in another world, Hinako declines the cheat-like powers offered to her and instead takes a vow of sisterhood with the giant Ellis, becoming known as the Smallest Giant. A prim and proper lady might not have a lot in common with a fearsome titan, but the two share a goal: searching for those who once meant so much to them. However, they must be cautious, for just as their strength wins them fame, it also captures the attention of an ill-mannered paladin...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Lingerie Girl wo Okinimesu mama
title_japanese: ランジェリーガールをお気に召すまま

title: Aisare Seijo wa Yamiochi Akayuku wo Sukuitai
title_english: The Saint, Loved by All, Wants to Save the Villain Who Falls to the Dark.
title_japanese: 愛され聖女は闇堕ち悪役を救いたい
synopsis:
Due to her lack of magical powers, the count's daughter Sufia has been trapped in her house from a young age. Upon her father's remarriage, she sees her new stepmother and stepsister. From this comes a revelation: she has been reincarnated in an otome game. According to the storyline, Sufia will suffer under the thumb of her stepsister, Lily... But with her positivity and composure, Sufia is unmoved!

Furthermore, in order to save her favorite character, Evuard, who is bound to fall into evil, Sufia begins manipulating her sister from behind the scenes. Sufia succeeds in preventing his downfall. After using her knowledge of the game, Sufia acquires the title of "saint" and enrolls in the magic academy! No matter what, she resolves to save the other characters as well!

Thereupon, perplexed by Sufia's actions, Evuard begins showing an interest in her...? This is the story of an overwhelmingly positive heroine seizing her own happiness!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title_english: One Day, out of the Blue, I Got a Gal's Forgiving Wife.
title_japanese: ある日突然、ギャルの許嫁ができた

title_english: Haikyu!! Special One-shot: A Party Reignited
title_japanese: ハイキュー!! 特別番外編 祭り再び

title: Itoshi no Kanojo wa Kakure Otaku
title_english: My Lover Is a Closet Otaku
title_japanese: 愛しの彼女は隠れオタク
synopsis:
The story centers on a straight-laced and serious man who slowly starts to become a "fudanshi" (guy who loves boys-love stories) after he starts dating a girl.

(Source: ANN, edited)

title: Level 1 kara Hajimaru Shoukan Musou the Comic
title_english: The Invincible Summoner Who Crawled Up from Level 1
title_japanese: レベル1から始まる召喚無双
synopsis:
After losing his father in a tragic accident, Shinobu Iijima and his younger sister Megumi are taken in by their father's old friend, Ayumu. Shinobu works hard in the hopes of starting a new life for himself. Megumi, and a mobile game called La Vita Online, are the only things keeping him afloat. One day, Ayumu reveals his true intentions of tearing Shinobu down and getting his hands on Megumi. But just after Shinobu learns that Ayumu deleted all of his game data in La Vita, their high-rise apartment catches on fire and Shinobu falls to his death, Megumi in tow. He wakes up in a strange new world... and realizes he's been reincarnated into the world of La Vita Online. An announcement from the devs tells him that Ayumu is already there, and a countdown to Megumi's arrival is ticking. Shinobu vows to protect Megumi after she arrives at any cost, even if it means he has to crawl his way up from level 1 to fend off all the other reincarnated players.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Tensei shitara Koutei deshita: Umarenagara no Koutei wa Konosaki Ikinokoreru ka? @comic
title_english: Imperial Reincarnation: I Came, I Saw, I Survived
title_japanese: 転生したら皇帝でした～生まれながらの皇帝はこの先生き残れるか～@COMIC
synopsis:
"I command thee, kneel!" When a history buff reincarnates as the infant emperor Carmine, he's immediately struck by despair—child rulers aren't known for their longevity. But as he learns the ins and outs of his new reality's elaborate metaphysics and "his" corrupt and bloated state apparatus, he sets in motion a scheme to purge the rot—and woe betide any scheming noble standing between Carmine and a functioning government. Of course, he'll have to survive first—no easy feat for a child emperor dancing on other men's strings. But hey, how hard could running an empire be?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

2. Natsu no One Shota

title_english: Our Circumstances at the Bottom of the Hierarchy
synopsis:
Ichika is a high school girl who works as the lead of an underground girl band, but one day she's suddenly forced out of this role. At the same time, Nirai, a high school boy who has spent 377,800 yen on a VTuber idol is driven to despair over being treated as a mere pay object. With this terrible history, at their very bottom, what will happen when those two meet?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Aishitagari W Darling
synopsis:
Introverted high school student Mugi falls in love with his neighbor, Iyo, who always greets him kindly. One day, Mugi was kissed suddenly by Iyo, who has a different atmosphere than usual. Which is the real Iyo? Was he a gentleman or a playboy? While visiting at Iyo's place one night, Mugi learned that Iyo has a twin brother, Kiyo. While being groped all over by the rough Kiyo, Mugi was spoiled slowly with gentle kisses from Iyo...? The most erotic and cute 3P love is here!!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Doushitara Osananajimi no Kanojo ni Naremasu ka!?
title_english: How Do I Turn My Best Friend into My Girlfriend?
title_japanese: どうしたら幼馴染の彼女になれますか!?
synopsis:
Minami and Yuzu have been inseparable since elementary school. But now that they're in high school, Minami just can't accept that Yuzu may someday get a boyfriend. How come some random guy gets to wake her up in the morning, feed her lunch, take baths with her...? It doesn't take long for Minami to realize that her feelings can't quite be described as "friendship" anymore, but how can she get Yuzu to see her the same way?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Yaku nara Mug Cup mo: Comicalize!
title_japanese: やくならマグカップも こみからいず!
synopsis:
Former Tokyoite Himeno Toyokawa is a sweet, playful high schooler who's recently moved to Tajimi City with her grandmother and widower (and bankrupt) father, who owns a cafe. Naturally, she's eager to find a place to fit in at her new high school. So when she discovers the Pottery Club, she decides to give it a shot, even though she has some very personal history with pottery...

(Source: ANN)

title: Hikikomori Hakoiri Reijou no Kekkon
title_english: The Cloistered Princess and the Royal Groom
title_japanese: 引きこもり箱入令嬢の結婚
synopsis:
The ballroom buzzes with chatter as its guests whisper under their breaths, their attention taken by the mysterious box tucked away in the corner. Despite their attempts to ignore the out-of-place wooden object, the second prince of the royal family, Prince Cyphon was unable to contain his curiosity, and decides to approach it. But then, as he investigates the box, a lovely voice came from within to greet him, "Do you...need something from me?"

(Source: Kodansha)

title: I My Me Mine
synopsis:
He lives alone and falls in love at first sight. But he's the most fearsome yankee in the world?!

(Source: Lilac Scans)

title: Tsuki to Maple Syrup: Sensei to no Koi wa Mitsu no Aji
title_japanese: 月とメープルシロップ－先生との恋は蜜の味－
synopsis:
A heart-squeezing secret love with a teacher ♥️ Kaede, the number one frivolous guy of his school, is trying to charm Tsukiko-sensei, whom he admires...?!

(Source: MU)

title: Jishou Akuyaku Reijou na Tsuma no Kansatsu Kiroku.
title_english: An Observation Log of My Wife Who Calls Herself a Villainess
title_japanese: 自称悪役令嬢な妻の観察記録。
synopsis:
Crown Prince, Cecil, married Bertia who is a self-proclaimed "Villainess." While they were enjoying their lives as newlyweds, Bertia received a request from her friend, Princess Risona of the Umube Kingdom, to produce her wedding ceremony. On their way to Umube, Bertia is being really excited, and Cecil has to support her...

(Source: AlphaPolis)

title: Gorisen: Panic Mono de Massaki ni Shinu Type no Taiiku Kyoushi
title_japanese: ゴリせん ～パニックもので真っ先に死ぬタイプの体育教師～

title: Bros.
synopsis:
A cute little brother suddenly became a beast.

"Little brother, don't you have something to tell me?"

"You're one to talk!"

Yuusuke and Tokio are brothers living together in their parents' house during their absence. One night, they have an unexpected encounter in the city, and their secret is revealed: Yuusuke is gay, and Tokio is bi. Even though it was a choking discovery, Yuusuke keeps trying to play the good older brother role, while the younger brother Tokio can't see him with the same eyes anymore. The love battle between a poker face brother and another that has a soft spot for bad men begins!

(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)

title: Kyoushitsu no Katasumi de Seishun ga Hajimaru
title_japanese: 教室の片隅で青春がはじまる
synopsis:
Mari Yoshida, a girl that only becomes the main character for a brief moment, before situations go sideways and she becomes cringe. Meanwhile, the alien Nell has held a dream of wanting to do something on Earth. Also in the classroom are people wanting to hide their otakudom, people who act out their ideal life on social media, and people who have confidence in their special destiny. Every kid in the classroom has their own secret, and you can't even claim to understand the kid right next to you.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Konya Sukiyaki da yo
synopsis:
Aiko is a freelance interior designer who wants to marry her current boyfriend, but envisions herself as far from the ideal wife, due to her being bad at household chores. Meanwhile, Tomoko is a picture book illustrator that is good at housework, but societal notions of marriage and romance don't hit home for her. They mutually decide that, until they find their perfect marriage partner, that they should get married with each other.

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Watashi ga Watashi wo Uru Riyuu
title_japanese: 私がわたしを売る理由
synopsis:
There's nothing I want; I'm only alive because I can't die. In truth, I'd rather die before I get old and ugly. The only thing I have is my looks...

(Source: Cygames, translated)

title: Hakumokuren wa Kirei ni Chiranai
title_japanese: 白木蓮はきれいに散らない
synopsis:
Three classmates, including Mari, a full-time housewife, Sayo, who is in divorce mediation with her husband, and Satoe, a career woman, gather when their high school classmate Hiromi die lonely in an apartment owned her. The will left by Hiromi was accompanied by the names of three people who were not so close to each other for some reason, and included a request for the remaining apartment, Hakurensou, and the mysterious inhabitants afterwards. It is a story about three women born in 1963 who live in a "difficult reality" in an unchanging relationship and changing circumstances.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Manga Niku
authors: Kotegawa, Yua|Yokota, Takuma|Ooi, Masakazu|Tanahashi, Namoshiro|KUJIRA|Takao, Jingu|Curryzawa, Kaoru|Konayama, Kata|Miyama, Okara|Miyamoto, Issa|Sendou, Masumi|Kii, Kanna|Ooshima, Chiharu|Matsuda, Kouta|Nakagawa, Asako|Usui, Tsukasa|Chikyuu no Osakana Pon-chan|Uno, Yukiaki|Kawabata, Arata|Battan|Numa, Chiyoko|Matsuzaki, Natsumi|Taniguchi, Natsuko

title: Kimi no Haigo wa Boku no Basho
Love Letter
synopsis: Story of a shy girl struggling to confess her feelings to the boy she loves and how destiny brings them together.

title: Kamisama wa Southpaw: Diamond
synopsis:
Deceived by a desperate coach into a boxing match that he has no business winning, Kaneishi Gou is under the impression that boxing is not as hard as one might think. The promise of easy money whether he wins or not brushes off even more pressure out off his first and last match... until he is knocked out in the first round.

(Source: Anilist)

title: Maryoku Cheat na Majo ni Narimashita: Souzou Mahou de Kimama na Isekai Seikatsu
title_english: Making Magic: The Sweet Life of a Witch Who Knows an Infinite MP Loophole
title_japanese: 魔力チートな魔女になりました～創造魔法で気ままな異世界生活～
synopsis:
Looks like I've been reincarnated into a gamelike world filled with monsters and dungeons. But don't worry—it's nothing I can't handle. I chose Creation Magic for my unique skill, you see, and it lets me make whatever item I want...so long as I've got enough mana. Ah, there's always a catch, isn't there? But where there's a rule, there's a loophole—and this little witch knows just the trick to expand her mana pool a bit more each day.As for what I'll be up to in the meantime, first I'll make a friend. (Literally. Golems are a thing in this world.) Next, I'll make some tracks. (And the sooner, the better. The goddess dropped me off in the middle of the wastelands). Then finally, one day, I'll make myself a place where I can truly belong. (That's the plan, at least.) Time to make some magic!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Yukifuru Yoru no Futari
synopsis:
Ailsa lost her unborn baby in an accident, and the grief caused her to give up her marriage as well. Four years later, on the day when her 9-year-old daughter was supposed to return from a temporary visit to her ex-husband's house, her ex-husband, Jake, was the only one to show up. The phone lines were disrupted by the snow, so he came to tell her in person that their daughter's stay had been extended. Her ex-husband was still as handsome as ever, full of confidence as a successful businessman. I'm done with him—but then why am I so bothered by the fact that... we are going to spend one night together?

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Kizuna wo Mou Ichido
synopsis:
Today is Kelly's eighth wedding anniversary. It's also the day her divorce from Jake, her famous journalist husband, has finally been made official. Jake is a daredevil who flies around the world and is never home. Not even on the day that she miscarried. In order to sever all ties with the past, Kelly cuts off her beautiful long hair and throws a party in her new home to celebrate her divorce. But Jake, who never wanted the divorce, suddenly shows up, rudely throws out her party guests and forceably kisses her!

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Kazoku Soukan Zushiki
synopsis:
1-7. Kazoku Soukan: Imouto wa Muku de Haha wa Teishuku na Hazu nanoni
8. Kyoudai Soukan: Kasou Taiken nanoni Real Sounyuu sarechau Nante
9. Imouto Saimin Soukan Zushiki
10. Sister Doll: Kyonyuu Osananajimi ga Imouto ni Hyoui sare Moteasobarete Namaiki Imouto mo Icchau no!

title: Kono Manga no Heroine wa Morisaki Amane desu.
title_english: Morisaki Amane Is a Heroine of This Comic.
title_japanese: このマンガのヒロインは守崎あまねです。
synopsis:
Amane Morisaki is eager to take care of her younger childhood friend Kyousuke Aizumi, as they both enroll at the same university. But Kyousuke wants to become a mangaka and asks Amane to be the model for the heroine of his manga.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: The Divine Twilight's Return
synopsis:
After being put on trial, the deity once known as "The Divine Twilight" is offered a job by Thanatos, king of the underworld! Now, the fallen deity is back on Earth as his former self, Changsun Lee, and is tasked with sealing those trying to invade from beyond. With the promise of a fresh start, Changsun is gathering the gear and skills needed to get the job done, but he's feeling some watchful eyes on him... Will this Divine Twilight see a new day, or is the sun setting on his second chance?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Eiyuu to Kenja no Tenseikon: Katsute no Koutekishu to Konyaku shite Saikyou Fuufu ni Narimashita
title_english: The Hero and the Sage, Reincarnated and Engaged
title_japanese: 英雄と賢者の転生婚～かつての好敵手と婚約して最強夫婦になりました～
synopsis:
In a world ravaged by war and conflict, Hero Raid Freeden and Sage Eluria Caldwin clashed time and time again over fifty long years as the strongest soldiers of their respective nations. However, their long-standing rivalry came to an inevitable yet bitter end with Eluria's sudden death. A thousand years later, Raid finds he has been reincarnated—and so has Eluria! The world may now be at peace, but the two have an unsettled rivalry between them and the mystery of their reincarnation looms ominously over their heads. There's so much that needs to be done, so they decide to...get engaged and attend the Royal Institute of Magic together?!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Suit ni Seiheki
synopsis:
Miu Sakuramori is, by all appearances, a prim and proper young lady with a respectable job in planning and development. There's no way she could be anything but vanilla and innocent! But when she's off the clock and behind closed doors, Miu's got a taste for more sensual pleasures and fetishes. To her surprise, her sales manager, Shiro Takeda, is also hiding his own secret fantasies behind his buttoned-up reputation. When the two match their desires, they'll make for one steamy office romance!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Seireishi
synopsis:
The one-shot follows "Spiritsetter" Fujiwara and his assistant Sadako; who quell lingering ghosts with the help of Fujiwara's psychic ability to see spirits.

(Source: Death Toll Scans, edited)

title: Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken: Clayman Revenge
title_english: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime: Clayman's Revenge
title_japanese: 転生したらスライムだった件 クレイマンREVENGE
synopsis:
After that final scream rang out during the Walpurgis Festival, the dreams of the Marionette Master were thought to be done for good. But either through the vagaries of fate or the decision of the world at large, Clayman's theater has opened up for one more act.

(Source: Kodansha)

title: Higyaku no Kanro
synopsis: Between a woman and a man, a story of dom and sub.

title: Gankake Shoujo to Yubiwa Shokunin
title_japanese: 願かけ少女と指輪職人

title: Mujikaku na Tensai Shoujo wa Kizukanai
title_japanese: 無自覚な天才少女は気付かない
synopsis:
Despite being a genius, the duke's daughter Liana is unable to earn her family's recognition. As such, she decides to run away. On her journey, she meets Fred, who seems to be just any other handsome adventurer. Sympathizing with her plight, he proposes they "become a couple"?! This is the tale of a genius girl seeking happiness, an isekai story of second chances!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Midori-kun ni wa Sawarenai
title_japanese: ミドリくんには触れない
synopsis:
Talk about meet-cutes... Misaki doesn't recognize her cute new neighbor when he comes to formally introduce herself...until he reminds her that they went to school together for years! But Midori Tachibana is no longer the awkward kid she remembers—he's the leader of Japan's hottest new idol group! But their fated meeting is cut short when he finds out she's an adult film actress...and he can't be seen with her if he's to preserve his squeaky-clean idol image! But can the chemistry between them be so easily erased?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Koigakubo-kun ni Hajimete wo Ubawaremashita
title_japanese: 恋ヶ窪くんにはじめてを奪われました
synopsis:
Eiko Kagehara truly loves one thing in this world: the MMO she's played with her friends for the last 15 years, in which she leads a fantasy life as a sought-after blacksmith. But when her friends start leaving to, of all things, get married, have kids, find new jobs...she's thrown for a loop. So much so, in fact, that she drunkenly shares her gamer ID with her super-hot new colleague...who just happens to have been helped by her in-game in the past, and who wants to repay her by teaching her how to love?!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Usokon: Rosé
synopsis:
Remi Nikitani is no shy violet—she's elegant, direct, and ambitious, with plans to take over her father's corporation. So she's not interested in marrying for business or political reasons. After all, why be saddled with someone she doesn't love when she can make her way to the top by herself? But when her father sets her up with Jun Arata, a young hotshot in his own right and someone who knows about the unrequited love Remi fostered for years, she's thrown for a loop. She rejects him, of course, but somehow he keeps finding his way back into her life. But is he interested in her? Or does he only want to take over her business and leave her in the dust? 

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Hatarake! Ojisan no Mori
title_japanese: はたらけ! おじさんの森

title: Platinum Blood
title_japanese: PlatinumBlood プラチナ・ブラッド
synopsis:
Alucard, known by "Al" for short, is a vampire who has been raised by a priest, You. Providing Al the fluids he needs to survive has created an unusually close relationship between the two, but what will become of their partnership as You's mortality catches up to him?

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Wagahai wa Neko de Aru
title_english: Soseki Natsume's I Am A Cat: The Manga Edition
synopsis:
Soseki Natsume's comic masterpiece, I Am a Cat, satirizes the foolishness of upper-middle-class Japanese society in early 20th century Tokyo. Written with biting wit and sardonic perspective, it follows the whimsical adventures of a rather cynical stray kitten. He finds his way into the home of an English teacher, where his running commentary on the follies and foibles of the people around him has been making readers laugh for more than a century.

(Source: Tuttle Publishing)

title: Kusojoushi wa Yarimederu Mono to Kokoroe yo
title_english: My Annoying Boss Is... Kinda Sexy?!
title_japanese: クソ上司はヤリ愛でるものと心得よ
synopsis:
It's all because of the arrogant, condescending prick that is supposed to be my boss, power harassing me again and again...! He was so cute, and now I really want to fuck him...?!

(Source: WWWave Corporation)

title: Shinigami no Hatsukoi: Botsuraku Kazoku no Reijou wa Ai wo Shiranai Shinigami ni Totsugu
title_japanese: 死神の初恋～没落華族の令嬢は愛を知らない死神に嫁ぐ～
synopsis:
When the daughter of a fallen noble family is chosen to become a sacrificial bride, her groom is none other than the Shinigami—a cold-hearted, human-hating God of Death.

Chizuru works for the Sanjou family, a newly made noble house with a thriving textiles factory in Koishigawa. However, as the daughter of a family which once ranked far higher than the Sanjous, Chizuru receives nothing but scorn and contempt from her new employers.

Without warning, a plague breaks out in the town and victims of the disease all die with the same words on their lips: "The Shinigami stands at my bedside." In a desperate attempt to appease the god who brought the plague upon them, Chizuru is selected as a sacrificial bride.

This is a story of a ruined noble, a God of Death, and the romance that blossoms between their two lonely souls.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Mu Town no Kodomotachi
title_japanese: ムー・タウンの子供たち
synopsis:
Stylistically intermingling themes of gentrification and rebirth within the setting of a classic yakuza crime drama, Mu Town no Kodomotachi follows the course charted by youths of an aging residential housing complex who are struggling for their lives: burdened by financial issues, peer pressure, and uncertain futures, ensnared in the clutches of organized crime, they are searching for a way to survive. When a municipal renovation project seems to offer a future of stability for their dilapidated town, the mysterious and far-reaching consequences that their actions set into motion may leave Juichi and his friends with no option but annihilation…..

A stunning modern "tenement masterpiece" manga, Mu Town no Kodomotachi is a story of small town gang intimidation, escalating immigration tensions, political intrigue, and the yearning desperation of youth.

(Source: Glacier Bay Books)

title: Kimi wa Gochisou
synopsis:
In a world where humans coexist with demi-humans, such as vampires, werewolves, and succubi; Hiroto, a university student, meets Rio, a vampire who is looking for a "fated partner." Rio says Hiroto is his fated partner and begs to suck his blood. Hiroto decides to provide blood, although he refuses at first. However, when Rio kisses Hiroto, he realizes that blood alone is not enough...?!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: My Home Honey
synopsis:
1. My Home Honey
2. Spring Has Love!
3-4. Kuromitsu Yotogi
5. My Home Darling

title: Neconeco Keiyaku
synopsis:
"Strip if you don't want this to be spread around."

Komano is secretly interested in Konemori, an older classmate who is repeating the year. While he tells himself that he isn't in love, he finds himself exploding from anger after seeing Konemori in a compromising situation with Kurokawa, his friend since middle school. Komano then threatens to expose Konemori and forces him into becoming his sex friend. They continue this strictly physical relationship until one day, Konemori rejects a kiss with an almost crying expression after which he suddenly turns into a cat??

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Bar Mao no Oshinagaki
synopsis:
Cats who live over 10 years have a special power that enables them to transform into humans. This is the story about a bar that serves them.

(Source: MU)

title: Heat x Beat: Omega dakedo Idol Hajimemashita
title_english: Heat x Beat: I May Be an Omega, but I'm Going to Be an Idol!
title_japanese: Heat×Beat～オメガだけどアイドル始めました～
synopsis:
Aiming to enter the entertainment industry, Amaya Asahi, an omega, applied for and passed an idol audition. Unbeknownst to him, another member chosen in his unit, the big newbie whom everyone has high hopes for, Mochizuki Madoka, is an alpha. Both of them are instinctively attracted to each other...?! In a moment of despair, Madoka makes a suggestion to Asahi, so that he can continue his idol activities—"become mates with me"...

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Juou Heika to Sunakaburi no Hanayome
title_japanese: 獣王陛下と砂かぶりの花嫁
synopsis:
Just as Sunakaburi was almost killed by slave traders, he was saved by a snow leopard, the Beast King. Sunakaburi, who did not belong because of his different fur color, was told by the king that he was his "destined mate," and was given beautiful clothes, a soft bed to sleep in, and delicious food to eat instead of leftovers. The king even gave Sunakaburi a lovely name, "Kouran." Overjoyed, Kouran wants to be of use to the king, but Kouran doesn't really know what a "destined mate" is...

(Source: Gentosha, translated)

title: Neco-senpai to Necokaburi-kun
title_japanese: ねこ先輩と猫かぶりくん
synopsis:
The school's most popular senpai is actually a cat?!

Kani loves fluffy animals and one day he picked up a white cat that was totally covered in mud. He brought the cat home and fell asleep while looking after it. When he woke up, the one in front of him wasn't the cat, but was Nekogami, the school's most popular senpai instead?!

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Kozure Ω to Boukun Yakuza
synopsis:
New omega mother Tatsumi snaps at the yakuza Ryuuga and catches his interest. Cajoled and pampered... the start of a life as a yakuza's wife!

(Source: Overlap, translated)
