title_japanese: 俺が主役なわけがない
synopsis:
With a hobby of writing BL novels, Akiharu, a university student fudanshi who loves shipping, quickly approaches his favorite ship (a delusion)? His dream of becoming a wall that watches over them was fulfilled—was what he thought, but one day, a shocking truth from the mouth of the uke (a delusion)...! But reality is stranger than his delusions! This is a new era of a fudanshi's heartful comedy!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Omae no Suki wa Shinjinai!
title_japanese: お前の好きは信じない!
synopsis:
One day, Nishino, who has a virginity complex, loses his "first kiss" to his friend Higashiyama in a fender bender. Nishino is shocked to lose his cherished first kiss to Higashiyama, an experienced and charming guy, who is very carefree.

The next day, Nishino, depressed and sleep deprived, is sleeping in the infirmary when he suddenly feels a groping sensation in his mouth! When he wakes up, he finds that Higashiyama has taken his lips again! Nishino's face blushes from the unaccustomed pleasure of being kissed so intensely, and he is out of breath. Higashiyama sees this and suddenly confesses, "Cute, I've fallen in love with you..."

(Source: East Press, translated)

title: Kimi no Nakigao ni Koi wo Shita.
title_english: I Fell in Love With Your Tearful Face.
title_japanese: きみの泣き顔に恋をした。
synopsis:
One day, Nanase, a high school student, sees an unsociable girl, Ao, crying. The tears make him more nervous than he's ever felt before... but it seems that something new awakens within him...

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

title: Ore no Class ni Wakagaetta Motoyome ga Iru
title_japanese: 俺のクラスに若返った元嫁がいる

title: Kimi-iro ni Kegasaretai
synopsis:
A naturally handsome model x a university student whose handsome looks was gained from hard work.

After a certain incident, Oumi lost contact with Haku, his cool childhood friend whom he had always leaned on. But who would have thought that he would one day be attending the same university as his friend that he likes so much. "Haku debuted as a model while we were apart and he has become someone who's very much adored by his surroundings. But here I am once again, only able to gaze at his blinding presence from afar."

"I want to be next to him. I want him to look at me with those eyes and do xx to me..."

Just what is the true nature of Oumi's feelings towards his ex-best friend, Haku?

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

title: Keiyaku Cohabitation
title_japanese: 契約コハビテーション
synopsis:
Hayasaka is a handsome salaryman who, despite his outwardly pleasant demeanor, is actually very spiteful inside. His favorite routine when coming back home from work includes stopping by the convenience store to buy beer to drink at home. One day, he happens across the convenience store's part-timer, Kumagai, jumping into a river to save a cat.

(Source: MU)

title: Gal-kun no Koi wa Kitto
title_english: Gal-kun Will Definitely Fall in Love!
title_japanese: ギャルくんの恋はきっと

title: Kinpatsu Obocchama to Nihonjin Shitsuji
title_japanese: 金髪お坊ちゃまと日本人執事
synopsis:
The 9-year-old boy, who lives in a mansion surrounded by servants, is interested in Tanaka, who is the only Asian. He says that it is rare for him to come from Japan, the country of NINJA. One day, the boy barges into the servant's room and falls in love upon seeing Tanaka with messy hair. Later, at the request of the boy, Tanaka became an exclusive caretaker. Shota vs natural love romance begins!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title_japanese: 九尾狐家妃譚 ~仔猫の褥~

A sparkling adolescent love story about a secretly good-looking boy with a secret crush and a popular model who is a devoted childhood friend.

title_japanese: 我が不徳の致すところです

synopsis: How are Toudou and Naoto doing now?

title: Hai Shinigami to Fushi no Neko
synopsis: Gatto inspires to become a great state-approved assassin. One day, while he is scolded for failing to neutralize a target, his colleague gets killed and turned into a puppet in front of his very eyes... This event leads him to meet a strange individual that claims they are a god of death.

title: Hokuto no Ken: Seikimatsu Drama Satsuei-den
title_japanese: 北斗の拳 世紀末ドラマ撮影伝
synopsis:
The time is the end of the century, the seas have dried up and the earth has been torn apart, a man in a leather jacket confronts the bad guys that hurts the weak and a loud shout overlaps as he brilliantly defeats the enemy. "Cuut!!" Both the withered seas and the torn earth are large drama sets. This is a record of the blood, tears and sweat of the persons who spent day and night filming the drama "Hokuto no Ken."

(Source: Coamix, translated)

title: Bokunchi no Maid-san-tachi.
title_japanese: ボクんちのメイドさんたち。

title: Toumei na Ai no Utsuwa
title_english: The Vessel of a Transparent Love
synopsis:
Miki Donoue has been plagued by bad luck since childhood... Then, one evening, he encounters a mysterious, semi-transparent man who claims to live by consuming other people's emotions. Is this merely a dangerous deception, or could this intriguing stranger change the direction of Miki's life?

(Source: Hero Scans)

title: Toushin Devilman
synopsis:
The ruler of the demon world Zenon gives the order to kill the humans. One of the four heavenly demons Amon however did not view humanity to be as weak as the others believed. This caused unease within the rest of the ranks and Amon escaped them before encountering a junior high student named Kei Kamishiro. The two made an agreement to work together by fusing together as the new identity Devilman.

(Source: Mangadex)

title: Bow
synopsis:
The series follows Bow, a bull terrier that, starting out as a stray dog, lounges in with a struggling manga artist for a while before being adopted by Sayaka, a third grader and the daughter of a yakuza family.

(Source: Wikipedia)

title: Kamo no Negi ni wa Doku ga Aru: Kamo Kyouju no Ningen Keizaigaku Kougi
title_japanese: カモのネギには毒がある 加茂教授の人間経済学講義
synopsis:
Youhei Kamo is a genius economist whose "Camorism Economic Theory" has gained worldwide acclaim. In a society where the economically weak are exploited and cheated, he puts his economic theories into practice and feeds poison to the powerful...!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Period
synopsis:
Two childhood friends enjoy sparring over a fighting game on the day their lives would be irrevocably changed.

(Source: MU)

title: Shousetsu Blue Period
title_japanese: 小説 ブルーピリオド
synopsis:
Yatora is the perfect high school student, with good grades and lots of friends. It's an effortless performance, and, ultimately...a dull one. But he wanders into the art room one day, and a lone painting captures his eye, awakening him to a kind of beauty he never knew. Compelled and consumed, he dives in headfirst—and he's about to learn how savage and unforgiving art can be!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: DTC: Yukemuri Junjou-hen from High & Low
Agattetanse
synopsis:
It's the middle of winter in the northern region. A young man named Haruki comes all the way from Tokyo and collapses during a snowstorm. By chance, he ends up under the care of three brothers (the straight-laced eldest son and his twin brothers who are high school students). However, rumors spread that he turned up to be the bride of Kentarou, the eldest among the three brothers, and the bride is completely acknowledged throughout town...?!

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Himekoi
synopsis:
In Crescent Moon Village, where high school students Mikata and Kuro live, the descendants of a fox clan that saved the village from starvation in the past and the descendants of a fox's bride hold a marriage ceremony at the annual summer festival to mingle and protect the village from disaster. As the descendants of the same family, Mikata and Kuro are supposed to take over the role this summer. However, unlike him, who believes in the village customs, Kuro seems to be completely unwilling to do anything. What will happen to the love between the childhood friends who suffer from the village custom of marriage between men?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Koi wa Sodatte Ai ni Naru
synopsis:
When Yuzuru Sakurai returned to his hometown to sell fertilizer for his company, he runs into his former classmate Sou Nakamichi who's now working as a farmer. Depressed by his inability as a salesman, Sakurai cheers up and begins to think fondly of his work when Nakamichi comforts him. Even though they weren't friends in school, the two grow closer, and Sakurai begins to think that they could become great friends. Then suddenly, Nakamichi confesses that he always thought Sakurai was cute?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Damatte Ireba Tada no Bijin
title_japanese: 黙っていればただの美人

title: Koi wa Futago de Warikirenai
title_japanese: 恋は双子で割り切れない

title: Märchen na Otokotachi
synopsis:
Hoshimi is a soft feminine man who loves reading the popular shoujo manga The Dark Horse Prince. Hoshimi, who lives a life of being continuously dumped and unpopular with women, meets a beautiful man named Himesaki after registering on a matchmaking app. Hoshimi had no intentions of being in a relationship with a man so why is he now being pursued by Himesaki?!

(Source: BL Tsundoku Scans)

title: Souteigai no Sweet Marriage
title_japanese: 想定外のスウィートマリッジ
synopsis:
Ritsu Yuuki, a cool-headed and serious office worker, was suddenly proposed to by his colleague and rival Haruma Honjou, due to some special circumstances. With same-sex marriage becoming possible in Japan, the people around the single, 29-year old Ritsu had been constantly nagging at him to get married soon. On the other hand, Haruma had found himself in a bind due to his uncontrollable popularity. With Haruma's suggestion of a marriage that would benefit both parties, Ritsu decided to accept his proposal in order to escape from the corner he was driven into.

Little did he know that married life with Haruma, who loves taking care of others, would be so comfortable... Plus, he gives massages that are out of this world...! Although it started with a lie, a sweet and delicious marriage love between the two single, handsome office workers in their thirties starts to bloom!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Pulitzer - Amuro Ray wa Kyokkou no Kanata e
title_english: Mobile Suit Gundam: Pulitzer - Amuro Ray Beyond the Aurora
title_japanese: 機動戦士ガンダム　ピューリッツァー　―アムロ・レイは極光の彼方に―

title: Sweet Home: Mofumofu Tanuki Kyoudai to Kazoku ni Narimasu
title_english: I Wanna Be Family with You.
title_japanese: スイートホーム もふもふたぬき兄弟と家族になります
synopsis:
The corporate slave meets a pair of fluffy brothers?! Hinata Chihiro is the so-called "corporate slave" who works for a black company. Today, after buying a convenience store box meal, as usual, he arrived home late at night just to find a lost kid wandering near his house?! Chihiro then welcomes the adorable small tanuki, Rio, and his tsundere older brother who hates humans, Itta. And that's how his life with the fluffy tanuki brothers, who were driven out of their natural habitat, begins...!

(Source: Media Soft, translated)

title: Wakeari Omega wa Nige no Itte
title_japanese: ワケありオメガは逃げの一手

title: Kaibutsu Shoujo wa Hatsukoi no Yume wo Miru ka?
title_japanese: 怪物少女は初恋の夢を見るか?
synopsis:
Sousuke Kusanagi's childhood friend, Kyouko Mikadodai possesses world-renown intellect! Known as a living national treasure, not only are there rumors of her being called a monster throughout Earth, it even reaches another world. They laugh, cry, and fall in love(?) as they aim to live a normal high school life in this youthful romantic comedy.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Byoushitsu de Nenbutsu wo Tonaenai de Kudasai
title_japanese: 病室で念仏を唱えないでください
synopsis:
Shouen Matsumoto entered monkhood because he could not rescue his childhood friend who was drowning right in front of him when he was a kid. Wanting to save the lives of the people important to him in their last moments, he also aspired to be a doctor. At the hospital, Shouen engages in medical care as an emergency doctor and also chants sutra for the deceased at the morgue or provides psychological care for terminally ill patients as a Buddhist monk. As a result, there are times when he treats patients brought into the emergency centre while he is in his robes and causes them to jump to the conclusion that they have died. Although he is disliked not only by patients but also colleagues for chanting prayers to Buddha and preaching for everything, he is cheerful and sincere. As Shouen grapples with how he should save lives, attend to deaths and support the families of patients, he grows as a doctor, a monk and a person.

(Source: jdramas.wordpress.com)

title: Kyuubi no Kitsune to Kozure no Bouzu
title_english: Nine-tailed Fox and a Priest With a Child
title_japanese: 九尾の狐と子連れの坊主

title: Reset
synopsis:
"No matter how many rejections you get, I'll always be by your side..."

Sou, a senior of the basketball club, is Touma's childhood friend and lover. Although Sou is popular among his teammates and friends, male and female, once he has a steady partner, he gets obsessed with them, and eventually clings to Touma in tears when the relationship ends. Their relationship began in secret when Touma took advantage of Sou's heart of glass. No matter how deep their relationship goes, Touma is on pins and needles, wondering if Sou will find out the truth. Maki, a teammate who noticed Sou's distorted possessiveness, finds it hard to leave Touma alone...!

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

title: Kouguu no Omega
synopsis:
In the Kingdom of Romelidahl, omegas—individuals with a secondary sex that causes them to emit enticing pheromones and become pregnant regardless of their primary sex—hold the lowest status in society and are often sold into slavery. As the 13th son of the royal family, Ilya is spared this fate, instead being married off to the neighboring Kingdom of Hanu for political gains. Though he assumes that he will be one of many partners used for the king's pleasure, he is surprised to learn that in Hanu, omegas are thought to be messengers from the god Ratati. Moreover, Khalid, the king, is only 10 years old.

Ilya is unprepared to enjoy such a peaceful life, but Khalid slowly proves himself to be a wise ruler and a caring companion. However, these calm days do not last forever, as some wish to claim the throne of Hanu for themselves.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Amber Vanilla no Hanayome
title_japanese: アンバーバニラの花嫁
synopsis:
Mizuki is an ordinary office worker who came to Haidar, a country in the Middle East, for business negotiations. After he arrived, he was suddenly struck by a white luxury car and fell unconscious. When he woke up, he was already in Prince Basil's gorgeous mansion! Mizuki cannot refuse Basil's forceful demand to treat him as his apology for the accident. Thus, he is treated with extraordinary hospitality. However, when he was too relaxed from the food and alcohol, Basil, who started to like Mizuki, forced him to stay with sweet words saying, "If you let me hold you overnight, I will consider the business negotiations." What was requested from a foreign land was a one-night pillow business?!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Komochi Host no Shinshi na Rinjin
title_japanese: 子持ちホストの紳士な隣人

title: Ore ga BL Manga no Heroine nante Arienee!
title_japanese: オレがBL漫画のヒロインなんてありえねぇ!
synopsis:
Akihisa Fukunari is the trueborn BL fanboy who works as the associate editor in BL editorial department. Perhaps because he loves BL so much, one day he suddenly could see a "narrative box" floating in the air! According to the "box," he and the newcomer subordinate editor Kento Shibasaki were destined to fall in love with each other! This shocking prophecy left Fukunari in an utterly bewildered state. He was invited by worried Shibasaki to his house, but while he was using the bathroom, Shibasaki suddenly entered the dressing room...?! Could it be, my chastity is in big danger?!

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

title: Yuutousei wa Unmei no Akaiito ni Sakaraitai
title_english: The Honor Student Wants to Go Against the Red Thread of Fate
title_japanese: 優等生は運命の赤い糸に逆らいたい
synopsis:
Miyanari is a straight-laced model student who, one day, suddenly starts being able to see a red string connecting him to Hashiba, a delinquent in his class.

"There's no way such a person would be my fated person!" Even as he repeats this to himself, it's as if the red string is playing tricks on him as he finds himself in various situations with Hashiba like getting treated by Hashiba when he got injured and getting stuck in a space alone with Hashiba, among others. As Miyanari spends more time with Hashiba, he begins to find out about Hashiba's gentle side that's different from his appearance...

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

title: Mitsu ni Kiba
synopsis:
In this world, where omegas are rare, there is a rumor about a problematic omega who is like a honey trap... None can escape his seduction. Omaki Kazua, who was waiting to get his secondary gender test results, comes across Kurogane (an alpha) and Nadame Sachiyuki (an omega) having sex at school. Sachiyuki approaches him, claiming that they are "Fated Mates," but Omaki and the others refuse to believe this. However, Sachiyuki, who turns out to be the infamous "Problematic Omega," refuses to back down.

(Source: MU)

title: Sayonara Bye-Bye
synopsis:
He was all alone, until he found his savior...

Rei has eternal life by feeding on the energy of other beings. He's not human and the only way for him to become mortal is to find his "soulmate"... As all of his fellow beings find their partners and die along with them, he's been alone now for hundreds of years without ever finding his soulmate. But, when he meets the wealthy and carefree Yuuto, Rei begins to feel something that he's never felt before...

(Source: Renta!)

title: Fundari, Kettari, Aishitari
title_japanese: 踏んだり、蹴ったり、愛したり
synopsis:
What's the best way to relax after a hard day's work? If you ask Kaho, it's to kick back and relax at a bar with her best drinking bro, Akira. Sure, everyone around her thinks he's pretty hot, but he smokes, gets in fights, and is a bit of a playboy—so definitely not boyfriend material. But when one thing leads to another and she wakes up in his bed one morning, it makes it infinitely harder to deny that there is absolutely nothing between them...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Yuukyuu Omega: Sansankudo
title_japanese: 有休オメガ 三三九度

title: Geist x Revenant: Kusozako Mob na Ore wa, Aibou no Seirei wo Bishoujo ni Shinka sasete Saikyou ni! @comic
title_english: Geist & Revenant: How I Went from Zero to Hero When I Evolved My Geist into a Pretty Girl! @comic
title_japanese: ガイスト×レブナント クソザコモブな俺は、相棒の精霊を美少女に進化させて最強に!@COMIC
synopsis: Yohei Mochizuki enrolls at a school for Geist (spirit) summoners and power-levels a crappy goblin until she becomes strong and beautiful.

title: Mangaka-sensei no Assistant-kun
title_japanese: マンガ家先生のアシスタントくん
synopsis:
Kenta's beloved dog needs an operation, so he takes a high-paying job as a manga artist's assistant in order to pay for it. However, the artist in question, Rei Natsukawa, draws yaoi comics and sexually harasses Kenta on a daily basis! His frustrating personality totally lays waste to his devilish good looks!! Rei's hot when he keeps his mouth shut, but when he doesn't, he comes out with bold lines like "I bet you taste good down there" and "I'm going to get off to these photos of you tonight."

It's such a shame... Kenta thinks he's a lost cause, but then Rei's manliness and kindness shine through the frequent bouts of sexual harassment! In this fight of love between a horny artist and his assistant, who'll emerge victorious?!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Shinizokonai wa Ai ni Naku
title_english: A Near-Death Experience Is a Cry for Love
title_japanese: 死にぞこないは愛に啼く
synopsis:
I was reincarnated... Into a world where you die if no one loves you!? A fantasy world romance between an infatuated bachelor and a lonely boy!

(Source: WWWave Corporation)

title: Dekiai-kun wa Te wo Dasenai
title_japanese: 溺愛くんは手を出せない
synopsis:
Miura, a healthy high school boy, wants to deepen his relationship with his beloved girlfriend Karen. However, she is incredibly sheltered and innocent. Miura always acts like a "prince-like person" to not scare her away, even if he extremely wants to hold her hand. This is a romantic comedy about a doting boy agonizing between instinct and reason!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Drawing: Saikyou Mangaka wa Oekaki Skill de Isekai Musou suru!
title_japanese: ドローイング　最強漫画家はお絵描きスキルで異世界無双する!
synopsis:
Akira Kamishiro was a very successful manga author, who was diagnosed with blood cancer one day. He regretted the way he lived, where he could only build up empty relationships. Angry at his mother for asking him to send her some money, he died in a car accident. He was given a chance to choose his new mother and reincarnate in another world.

Akira, not wanting to have a repeat of his past life, decided to choose an ordinary but safe life.. He was reincarnated as Akira, the only son of a magic store, with his previous life's memories. He had no talent for swordsmanship or magic, but he didn't care as he was still loved by his family. At one point, he realized that he can embody various things by "drawing a picture". That's when he noticed his cheat ability...!?

This is a story of Akira who wanted to live a mediocre life in another world and his adventures to protect his peaceful place!!

(Source: Kill Time Communication, translated)

title: Misaki-chan to Ecchi♥
title_japanese: みさきちゃんとえっち♥
synopsis:
Misaki, a girl with a lot of energy, drops by her boyfriend's place to bring him more than just lunch. 

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Soushinma: Haute Couture
title_japanese: 装身魔～オートクチュール～
synopsis:
There is a shop called Terra which creates accessory demons for magicians. One day, an accessory demon called Vienna is returned to Lock, the owner of Terra, because the man who bought her believes she is broken. However, Vienna, who is in the form of a human, seems to have lost her memories...

(Source: MU)

title: Tetsu to Ken
synopsis:
Two buddies running a detective agency, all the mess they keep falling into and the overdue back rent: will our guys manage to make it through this potentially explosive mix?

(Source: MU)

Included one-shots:
Volume 3: Warae Tatsuo, Tabi Ichiza Yami Nezumi, Hybrid X Gokutou no Hakobune

title: Imouto wa Neko
synopsis:
After losing his mother at a young age, Nekota is taken in by family friends...who happen to be a couple of human-sized walking, talking cats. Not only do his new parents have paws, tails, and furry pointed ears, but now he also has an adorable little sister, Neneko-chan! As a high schooler, he's integrated well into their household, and his precocious adoptive sister has fully accepted him as her big brother. Whether she's showing him things she brought home from elementary school, purrsistently asking him to play with her mouse toy, or waking him up at the same early hour every morning for breakfast, life with this charming feline family is never dull!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Mahou ni Kakatta Shingakki
title_japanese: 魔法にかかった新学期
synopsis:
It is spring, and Kotomi has just transferred to a new high school for her third year. At the opening ceremony, Kotomi discovers that the boy she knew as "Maa-kun" during childhood is actually the Japanese history teacher! After school that day, a first-year student is involved in an incident that seems to have occult origins, which causes Kotomi, Maa-kun, and three other students to be sent to a different space. What happens there...!?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Itoshi no Kemukujara
title_japanese: いとしの毛むくじゃら
synopsis:
Shinichirou Tsuji is a freelancer with a complex about his thin body hair. Today, again and again, he would look at his smooth arms and crotch in the bathtub at home and feel depressed, remembering the teasing of his friends. He would close his eyes and ponder over things as usual. Today, too, his daily routine was supposed to go by like that.

When he looked up, he found himself in a foreign palace. He was mesmerized by the glossy hair fluttering in front of him. And in the blink of an eye, he became a prisoner. Among the people in the royal palace who never saw this, the only one who called out to Shinichiro and touched him was the youngest prince, Prince Falu. His body reacts to the hairy man who touches him as if he is probing him. His body reacts to the touch, and...?

(Source: Sankosha, translated)

title: Ookami no Bonito
synopsis:
Ioto is a Japanese man who have traveled to a distant country to study architecture. His destination, Spain, is a beautiful country inhabited by many beastmen. While Ioto is still unfamiliar with the country, he is approached by Leo, a wolf-beastman who works as a police officer.

Finally, he has a friend...! Ioto is happy to finally have a friend, but Leo kisses him. He is puzzled, thinking it is a greeting from a carnivorous beastman, but then he is embraced and asked for his body...! Ioto is passionately persuaded that he is Leo's "pair." A heartwarming romance of destiny in a distant foreign land!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

Included one-shot: Dear Photographer

title: Kichiku Eiyuu
synopsis:
Ten years since he reincarnated in hell... Takamichi is troubled. His "incubus" power becomes stronger by having sex with women, but his growth has peaked. "I'll move to a new area and meet beautiful women of the new world!" This is a sexy, violent pretty girl battle fantasy!

(Source: COMICSMART, translated)

title: Oyasumi, Itoshii Kotori-sama
title_japanese: おやすみ、いとしい小鳥さま
synopsis:
Despite disliking the haughtiness of winged people, Shuu begins work at a winged person's manor doing miscellaneous chores. He meets Rai, a winged person who is the head of the manor he works at and is rumored to be hard to deal with. Shuu winds up in an awkward situation where he's told by Rai that he has to "incubate the egg."

A developing romance in a world where "winged people" and humans co-exist.

(Source: Good Girls Scan BL)

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Bangai-hen
synopsis:
After depleting their savings, the Tokyo Jujutsu High first-years—Yuuta Okkotsu, Maki Zenin, Toge Inumaki, and Panda—search for part-time jobs. When they all start working at a cosmetics store, they are visited by Utahime Iori, who appears to have some adult skin issues that the young students cannot understand.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Yaotome x 2
synopsis:
Kai Yaotome is a sixth grade elementary school student with a new neighbor living in the apartment next door, the slightly weird girl Haruru Yaotome. Eating school lunches, having likes and dislikes, and forgetting things as elementary school students do. Casually hanging out whilst their parents get along, as next-door neighbors do. A comedy of two elementary school neighbors.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Bubble
synopsis:
In a Tokyo where gravity has broken, a boy and a girl are drawn to each other...

The story is set in Tokyo, after bubbles that broke the laws of gravity rained down upon the world. Cut off from the outside world, Tokyo has become a playground for a group of young people who have lost their families, acting as a battlefield for parkour team battles as they leap from building to building.

Hibiki, a young ace known for his dangerous play style, makes a reckless move one day and plummets into the gravity-bending sea. His life is saved by Uta, a girl with mysterious powers. The pair then hear a unique sound audible only to them.

Why did Uta appear before Hibiki? Their encounter leads to a revelation that will change the world.

(Source: Netflix)

title: Maneki Neko Jinja no Tenteko Mai na Hibi
title_english: The Fortune Cat Shrine's Hectic Days
title_japanese: 招き猫神社のテンテコ舞いな日々
synopsis:
After the company he established went bankrupt and he was left with nothing but the clothes on his back, Kazumi Iwakura comes to a small shrine at the far end of Tokyo to become its caretaker. However, upon arriving, he finds three cats who have called the shrine their home; a big, ugly ginger tabby and two furball-like gray kittens, one a gray-she and the other a gray-he.

As it turns out, they are bakeneko (cats that turned into youkai) and can change into human forms; the tabby into a handsome man with a death glare, and the two kittens into twins about three years of age...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Neko Youkai
synopsis:
Think cats are mischievous pranksters? Wait till you meet the yokai cats! One has a neck that can stretch to steal food off the counter, another looks like a wall big enough to block a road, but is still warm and fluffy. And that's just the start! Get ready to be surprised and delighted by the daily life of these supernatural felines and their humans.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Kamakura Bakeneko Club
synopsis:
The manga centers on a story centered on humans, cats, and bakeneko, a kind of supernatural shapeshifting cat in Japanese folk myth.

(Source: ANN)

title: Kawaii Sekai Seifuku
title_japanese: かわいいせかいせいふく
synopsis:
A heartful comedy that focuses on NK-22, a failed moon angel. Moon angels are a group of creatures hidden on the dark side of the moon. NK-22 is ordered to descend to Earth and "be loved."

(Source: ANN)

title: Kamisama, Okosama, Kitsune-sama!
title_japanese: かみさま、おこさま、きつねさま!
synopsis:
(Self-proclaimed) god-in-training struggling to achieve his goal?!

A small child suddenly appears in front of Koutarou, a (genius) young potter. The child has fluffy ears and tail, and turns out, he is a fox who is a "god-in-training"?! The fox, Gin, stubbornly insists that he will stay with Koutarou for his training, and it seems he has taken a liking to the bowls Koutarou makes. Look forward to a lively and nature-filled comedy!

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

title: Layton Mystery Tanteisha: Katri no Nazotoki File
title_japanese: レイトンミステリー探偵社 カトリーのナゾトキファイル
synopsis:
The Layton Detective Agency, a business that helps its clients solve unusual mysteries, is run by Katrielle Layton—daughter of the world-renowned archaeology professor Hershel Layton. Together with her assistant Noah Montoir and talking dog Sherl, Katrielle finds herself unraveling cases involving a newly purchased cursed house, a dress imbued with a "demon's curse," and the zombie of a client's deceased spouse, just to name a few.

Aside from her more quirky cases, Katrielle has been working on another unsolved problem: the disappearance of her father. Founding the agency was only the first step in her attempt to uncover the truth behind his vanishing. As she continues to take on client after client, each with wackier and stranger issues to tackle, Katrielle steadily closes in on the answer to the biggest mystery of her life.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Yarerumon nara Haramasete Miyagare: Yankee x Omegaverse
title_english: Omegaverse Delinquents: Impregnate Me if You Can!
title_japanese: ヤレるもんなら孕ませてみやがれ-ヤンキー×オメガバース-
synopsis:
He's the only omega in an all-alpha school. "Even if It's only a limited-time relationship, and even though I tricked you, I wanted you to be the first one to take me."

Toba and Banzawa are a pair of delinquents having the time of their lives at a high school for alphas. Every day, all they do is fight with delinquents from other schools, and Banzawa is the only one who has Toba's back. But Toba has a secret he can't tell Banzawa... In reality, Toba's an omega!? While anticipating that he'll have to leave school when he goes into heat for the first time, one day he suddenly goes into heat right in front of Banzawa...!? "Have sex with me, please!" With omega pheromones in the air, Banzawa rips Toba's shirt off...!!

(Source: WWWave Corporation)

title: Isekai Yakuza Mofumofu no Taizaiki: Zenshoku - Wakagashira, Genshoku - Nekomimi-zoku no Ecchi na Fujo-sama Yattemasu
title_japanese: 異世界ヤクザのモフモフ滞在記 ～前職：若頭、現職：ネコミミ族のえっちな巫女様やってます～
synopsis:
The yakuza head Kohaku was shot while attempting to save a cat, but instead of dying, he was summoned into a different world. But how did he end up as the priestess of the animal-eared and tailed Cat Ear Clan?! And to add to that, his job as a priestess is to do ecchi things with the nekomimi chief and cause a miracle???!!!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Ookami Kakka no Uso to Dilemma
title_english: Your Excellency's Like a Wolf Lie and Dilemma
title_japanese: 狼閣下の嘘とジレンマ
synopsis:
Mizoguchi is the masculine president of a small system software company. Due to a crisis, he had to sign a "servant contract" with Washinomiya, a client and the young president of a large company, in exchange for money. Despite being one year younger, Washinomiya exudes a sharp, sadistic aura. Mizoguchi, who had always found him unpleasant, decided to accept this deal for his colleagues... In the hotel shower room, long fingers play with his body and relaxes his behind... What will happen to Mizoguchi, who is put in a humiliating situation...?!

(Source: KATTS, translated)

title: Rikai Funou Kuso Cutie
title_japanese: 理解不能クソキューティ
synopsis:
Nakahara is a skilled (money-grubbing) designer, who works as a part-time lecturer at a fashion school. Will he warn his student, who is fearless and incomprehensible, that this work is all for money...?

(Source: Yannu no Mahou)

1-3. Kumo to Saga (The Spider's Web)
4-6. Shou-energy Ouji to Sukekomashi (The Energy-Saving Prince and the Philanderer)
7. Arekara (The Days After)

title: Kimi dake ga Hontou
synopsis:
High school boy, Rikimaru, is unable to touch women due to childhood trauma. He has a pair of childhood friends who are siblings. The older sister, Kagami, and then the younger brother, Kyou. Between the two of them they share a similar height and appearance. Under these circumstances a unique twin love romance begins to bloom.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Omachi shitemasu Shitamachi Wagashi Kurimarudou

title: Saitou Yoshitatsu ni Umarekawatta node, Oda Nobunaga ni Kuni Yuzurishite Nagaiki suru no wo Mezashimasu!
title_japanese: 斎藤義龍に生まれ変わったので、織田信長に国譲りして長生きするのを目指します!
synopsis:
A modern day doctor who died from overwork was reborn as Oda Nobunaga's early rival, Yoshitatsu Saitou. He died young at the age of 33, and he was not able to stand his life as an enemy of Oda Nobunaga. So his goal is to hand over his territory to Nobunaga Oda and try hard to aim for long and comfortable life. However, he was afraid of his father, Dousan Saitou, and worried that he wouldn't be able to resist him.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Kemono to Ω
synopsis:
"They will abandon you if you are an omega."

I still remember the blood-stained white roses from that confrontation that happened when I was a child. I was cornered by the alphas who became half-beast when affected by the pheromones of my first heat. My parents abandoned me and put me up for adoption. In the place I was adopted, they made me feel necessary, and I thought I could be happy, but... It was hell. I met an animal half-alpha who couldn't express himself. In that situation, zeal came to me, and then I remembered that I am an omega... "Ah, so there is this kind of warmth."

(Source: G-Walk, translated)

title: Futari no Polaris
title_english: The Journey to Find Only Star
synopsis:
Two people who have never talked before suddenly become sisters...? A sparkling friendship story! Hikari, a girl who thinks keeping up with everyone is annoying. Mitsuki, a girl who is bullied by her classmates. One day, Hikari's mother and Mistuki's father decided to get married!? Even if they don't get along, they decide to become sisters...?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

Included one-shot:
Volume 3: Nijika ni Naritai
Volume 5: Kyou kara Ii Ko Yametemita

title: Ken to Mahou no Zeikin Taisaku @comic
title_english: Brave and Satan and Tax Accountant
synopsis:
This world is ruled by a certain "strange law". After the hero and the demon lord decide to cooperate, a beautiful angel suddenly appeared. The angel then told the hero this: "You have obtained half of the world. A tax will be imposed related to this donation." In short, the "strange law" is paying taxes to the god! The hero, frightened by the enormous donation tax caused by their immense fortune that is "half of the world", comes up with a scheme to escape from the taxes. That is to fake a marriage with the demon lord and to rely on a certain girl.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

synopsis: An anthology comic of Persona 5 by various mangaka.

title_japanese: ペルソナ5 キャラクターアンソロジー
synopsis: An anthology centered on Persona 5. It features mostly character art, but it also includes nine short manga chapters.

title: Sugoi Smartphone
synopsis:
Googugu is a mysterious new app that can search for information, but unlike other popular search engines, Googugu can search through all information that exists on Earth, including confidential government documents and even people's journal entries. With great power comes great limitations though, as Googugu can only be used on a tiny device known as a "super smartphone."

First-year high school student Kyuu "Q" Sagurada happens to be an owner of one such device by chance. Though he is academically brilliant, Q strives to barely pass all of his courses by turning every test into a game, much to the ire of his childhood friend Yuika Noumaru. His behavior stems back to an incident seven years prior, when his younger brother, Shuu, disappeared without a trace. Despite the police's best efforts, they were never able to solve the case.

Realizing that his new smartphone has the potential to crack his younger brother's cold case, he attempts to search for it, only to see that any relevant in

title: Surviving as a Maid
synopsis:
Ash Tolkayn was an ordinary office worker before she somehow became a maid in a BL novel with a scandalous love triangle between the King, his mysterious male lover, and the jilted Queen. But everything changes when the King appoints Ash as the crown prince's new nanny... after murdering the previous one! Now, on top of juggling the duties of childcare, she finds herself smack dab in the middle of the cutthroat royal drama. Can Ash rise to the challenge and survive as a maid?

(Source: Tapas)

title: I Am the Real One
synopsis:
Only in the House of Parvis can an "elementalist" be born. Blessed by the goddess of water, an elementalist has the power to protect the continent from the deplorable demon race and bring rain to the cursed, arid lands. Duke Ludwig Parvis received a prophecy stating that one sole elementalist would be born from his lineage—and his daughter, Keira, has spent her life preparing for this great responsibility, always yearning for her father's unattainable affection.

However, a girl named Cosette Weinberg suddenly appears, announcing herself as the duke's only daughter and the true elementalist, stealing everything from Keira. Eventually, Cosette's abilities somehow manifest—proving her claims—and Keira is hastily executed for deceiving the entire nation. But as if by magic, Keira awakens in the past, two months before Cosette's arrival and with her memories intact. Determined to prove her legitimacy, Keira attempts to enjoy life far from her distant father and prepares to expose Cosette's

synopsis: An anthology comic of Persona 5 by various mangaka.

title: Dantou no Archange
synopsis:
Gruesome historical manga series about French revolutionary politician Louis Antoine de Saint-Just, a prominent figure in the infamous period of "Reign of Terror" during the French revolution.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Soredemo Otoko wa Shinjimasen
title_english: Still I Don't Believe in Male.
title_japanese: それでも男は信じません
synopsis:
Ran Kouda, who runs a ceramics class, has a secret: she has a phobia of men. However, she is troubled when men of various ages keep coming into her classroom, which she manages while creating works of art as an artist. As she interacts with and understands the five men in the class, Ran begins to change. This work depicts a variety of human situations.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Maisis!!!: Trouble Maid Sisters
title_japanese: めいしす!!! トラブルメイドシスターズ

title: Make Heroine ga Oosugiru! @comic
title_japanese: 負けヒロインが多すぎる!@comic
synopsis:
The popular girls in Kazuhiko Nukumizu's class seem to have it all—good looks, lots of friends, and the hearts of all their crushes! Except...not?! Upon witnessing the shocking turn of events where the popular Anna Yanami gets friend-zoned by the boy who has crushed on her since childhood, Kazuhiko starts noticing all the fan favorites are getting similarly turned down by the boys they like. Surrounded by heartbroken heroines, can he keep their spirits up and make sure they don't give up? Or is this a rom-com world where the girls never get their dream guy?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Koukou Debut shita Juumai ga Mount Tottekuru.
title_japanese: 高校デビューした従妹がマウントとってくる。
synopsis:
I have a younger sister who's three years younger than me. Before, she was just a generic girl, but ever since getting into high school, she's become a wonderful gal. Going through our everyday life, she would dominate me, or so I thought, but there were tears, and believing lies, huh? It's only her looks that have changed!? Dominating and getting dominated! A pure older brother and a bad and easygoing little sister, a 1-on-1 love comedy begins!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Koukou Debut shita Juumai ga Mount Tottekuru.
title_japanese: 高校デビューした従妹がマウントとってくる。
synopsis:
I have a younger sister who's three years younger than me. Before, she was just a generic girl, but ever since getting into high school, she's become a wonderful gal. Going through our everyday life, she would dominate me, or so I thought, but there were tears, and believing lies, huh? It's only her looks that have changed!? Dominating and getting dominated! A pure older brother and a bad and easygoing little sister, a 1-on-1 love comedy begins!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: The Advanced Player of the Tutorial Tower
title_english: The Advanced Player of the Tutorial Tower
synopsis:
After being trapped for 12 years in a tower full of regenerating monsters, Hyeonu Kim is more powerful than just about any human or monster on Earth. Now that he's free, he's determined to find out who was behind his imprisonment, even if that means he has to kill hordes of monsters—and inadvertently save the world—along the way.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Kurai Ano Ko to Shitai Koto
title_japanese: くらいあの子としたいこと
synopsis:
A comedy about school life with that gloomy and unapproachable girl, but who you're a little interested in!

Ren Tabata is a second-year high school student aiming to break away from being a loner starting from the new semester. The first person he calls out to for friends is Touko Sasaki, a girl who is somehow dark and a little scary. But he can't take his eyes off her... A comedy about breaking away from being a loner with that shy and cute girl!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Sasaki to Miyano: Koushiki Anthology Comic
title_english: Sasaki and Miyano Official Comic Anthology
title_japanese: 佐々木と宮野 公式アンソロジーコミック
authors: Yuki, Amino|Itokichi|Mika|Fuji, Azuki|Harusono, Shou|Sasaki, Aoko|Dorokawa, Megumi|Tanno, Chikuwabu|Shimosegawa, Hinaru|Touya, Tsugumi|Hinata, Kyou|Konno, Paru|Toriya, Kou|Yutoto
synopsis: A compilation of stories centered around the characters of Sasaki to Miyano.

title: Pigpen
synopsis:
A man with no memories awakens on the shore of a desolate island with only a washed-up mailbox next to him. Soon enough, he stumbles upon an odd bed and breakfast, run by an even stranger family. The mother's kind smile quickly turns uncanny, the overly devout father relishes brutal hunts, and their three children are unnervingly unpredictable. The family makes no effort to conceal their home's sinister air as they taunt him and make him question his sanity.

Fearing for his life, the man steels himself to survive. As the family's hair-raising secrets slowly pile up, he grasps at his forgotten memories, haunted by dreams of unnaturally large pigs and a child that does not exist. The island's horrors close in, and the man is left with a desperate goal to uncover the truth behind his arrival and escape this cursed place before he loses his mind—or his life—to the creeping dread.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Shotgun Boy
synopsis:
With a nasty attitude and something rotten in his soul, high school student Yu Seongbin has picked the weak Han Gyuhwan as his victim. As no one cares enough to put a stop to the violence Gyuhwan suffers, his mind festers with fantasies of standing up to his bully and the useless adults around him, picturing himself pulling out a shotgun to exterminate them all.

When their class leaves for a trip, it quickly spirals into a living nightmare for Gyuhwan. Seongbin inevitably starts harassing him, but Gyuhwan finally finds the courage to resist him. However, his bravery is short-lived, and he escapes into the woods, with an enraged Seongbin close behind him. But after he falls off a cliff, Gyuhwan stumbles upon a strange shotgun and a box of 30 bullets that he, in his desperation and exhaustion, intends for his classmates and apathetic teacher.

Back at the camp, the class' talent show turns sinister. Something unnatural creeps in from the shadows, and as people begin transforming into tw

title: Study Group
synopsis:
Nicknamed the "school for future criminals," Yusung Technical High School isn't exactly the ideal place to study. A rarity among his peers, Gamin is a student with just one goal: to get into university. At a school where it's every man for himself, he is rejected from countless study groups before he decides to form his own. When Hankyeong, Gamin's former tutor, joins his high school in hopes of earning her teacher certification, it seems like they're both reaching for the impossible. Can they defeat the odds and achieve their dreams?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Mugi-kun ni Koi wo Shite wa Ikenai
title_japanese: 麦くんに恋をしてはいけない
synopsis:
When 28-year-old office worker Yui Natsume expects a proposal from her boyfriend on their second anniversary, her dream is crushed as he returns his apartment key and breaks up with her. Wishing to leave the heartbreak behind her, Yui decides to move into a shared house. Initially believing the other tenants to all be women, she is shocked to meet a 19-year-old boy, Mugi Uehara, at the front door.

Despite the initial awkwardness, Yui finds herself at peace in her new home. One day, when Yui is invited to a concert by a popular band, she discovers Mugi is the support guitarist for the group. After the show, she learns about the band members' resentment toward one another. As Yui and Mugi confide in each other, they gradually grow closer despite their age gap.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: No Nyanko No Life: Bokura no Chiiki Neko Keikaku
title_english: No Cat No Life (Our Community Cat Project)
title_japanese: ノーにゃんこ ノーライフ~僕らの地域ねこ計画~
synopsis:
They're not meant to be fed nor exterminated. So just what are "community cats" that are meant to simply coexist with humans?

Sou Fujima has just lost his beloved cat, Chiiko, who he had lived with since he was a child. Overwhelmed with grief, he ended up cutting himself off from the world and holed up in his room until one day, something appeared in front of him! Both happiness and connections to the heart, all will be taught by cats. This is a story brought about by these tiny lives.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: The Skeleton Soldier Failed to Defend the Dungeon
title_english: The Skeleton Soldier Failed to Defend the Dungeon
synopsis:
The Skeleton Soldier has only one goal: to protect its beloved mistress, Lady Succubus, from any harm. Unfortunately, it fails miserably when a group of invaders storm their dungeon and kill them both. However, mysterious circumstances cause the Skeleton Soldier to be reborn 20 years in the past, giving it a second chance at life and to alter its destiny.

As it struggles to gain new skills and abilities, the Skeleton Soldier acquaints itself with the world and unfamiliar companions. It embarks on a journey to achieve ultimate power, all for the sake of shielding its master from the tragic fate that will befall her. While seeking to uncover the dark conspiracies of the different factions residing in the world, the Skeleton Soldier might also step closer to unveiling the secret of its own existence.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Anime 5-toubun no Hanayome Novelize
title_japanese: アニメ 五等分の花嫁 ノベライズ
synopsis:
High-school student Fuutarou Uesugi is an academically gifted student that leads a difficult life—his mother has died, he has no friends, and on top of all that, his father has incurred a large amount of debt.

An opportunity presents itself when the rich Nakano family transfers to his school. Fuutarou is promptly hired as a highly paid tutor. However, much to Fuutarou's dismay, he discovers that his five charges—identical quintuplet sisters of varied personalities—have no interest in studying at all and have abysmal grades. Some of the quintuplets are against having Fuutarou, whom they view as a stranger, in their apartment, but Fuutarou's diligent tenacity gradually convinces those girls to accept him and to improve their grades.

Throughout the series, Fuutarou develops special relationships with each of the quintuplets. Through a flashforward, it is revealed that he eventually marries one of them, but her true identity is only revealed near the end of the series.

(Source: Wikipedi

title: Sabaku no Kuni no Amefurashi Hime: Zense de Shokei sareta Mahoutsukai wa Nouka no Musume ni Narimashita

title_japanese: 砂漠の国の雨降らし姫 ～前世で処刑された魔法使いは農家の娘になりました～
synopsis:
Alesia possesses the ability to make it rain while she sleeps. Her parents go to great lengths to protect her and conceal her abilities. One day, Alesia's memories of her past life return: Alesia used to be Aura, a wizard who excelled at water magic. She had fought on the front lines for her country and was promised the title of queen. However, at the age of twenty-three, she was falsely accused of conspiracy and executed. Because of her past life, she prefers to live a normal, peaceful life and serve others in this life rather than enjoy honor and status. This is the story of Alesia, a girl who makes it rain when she sleeps and who tries to live a positive life and be kind to others out of regret for her past life.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

5. Mamotte! Shugorei-kun
6. Akuma na Tenshi ni Goyoujin♥

title: Random Chat
synopsis:
If you lived through—or are still living through—high school, you can relate to Joon-Woo. An outcast and a loner, his only joy comes from the hours he spends on his phone, randomly chatting with strangers. It's all weird and meaningless, until Joon-Woo strikes gold—as he's matched in a private chat with a pretty young girl his age. Jackpot! But when he discovers that this same pretty girl is actually his classmate Seung Ah, things get a little too real for a guy who's never even remotely been kissed.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Last Order wa Ojousan de: Dekiai Jourenkyaku ni Kyuuai saretemasu
title_japanese: ラストオーダーはお嬢さんで 溺愛常連客に求愛されてます
synopsis:
Mei, the daughter of a restaurant owner, is troubled by a certain "regular customer," Chikage. She warns him not to smoke, but he won't listen to her at all! But he's a mysterious person who somehow interests her... When Chikage finds out that Mei has gone to a party, he suddenly changes his tune and his mind...? Mei is constantly being pushed around, including being taken to a hotel for shelter on a rainy day. While Mei is glued to an AV video that she accidentally turned on, he asks her if she'd like to "imitate them"...!

"I'll teach you everything from scratch starting now."

This is the first and last true love of the uncontrollable Chikage.

(Source: Eiwa Shuppansha, translated)

title: Kimi wa Boku wo Kanrisuru
synopsis:
"Would you let me take control of your nutrition?"

College student Sudo is unable to eat other people's cooking after a traumatic incident. One day, while going to the convenience store he usually frequents, Sudo is handed a homemade bento from a worker at the store he has never seen before. He rejects the offer coldly at first, but opens up after seeing how worried the worker, Hasegawa, is over his health. Around the same time, a rumor starts to spread about a pervert hanging around the university...?

(Source: Torico)

Included one-shot: Yasashii Jigoku (Sweet Hell)

title: Sunde, Mitsukete, Kirameite
title_japanese: すんで、みつけて、きらめいて
synopsis:
"I should have wanted to go back to my friends. I want to get closer than that."

Hayakawa Akira, a third-year high school student, changes seats and sits next to his childhood friend, Kuno Sumika. Akira, who has many friends and is active, and Sumiya, who likes astronomy and is quiet. The two grew up in the house next door from an early age and were best friends despite their opposite personalities. However, in elementary school, they had a trivial quarrel and couldn't apologize to each other, estranging the two friends. Akira feels awkward to start preparing for the school festival in the same group, and Sumiya is being as kind as before...

(Source: Leed-sha, translated)

title: Kare ga Ore wo Sukisugite Komaru
title_english: I Have Trouble Because He Loves Me Too Much
title_japanese: 彼が俺を好きすぎて困る
synopsis:
Keiichi Sonezaki is popular... Too popular for his own good. Too popular for his own peace of mind. He hates it. He hates how most people look at him once and fall head over heels for him. The rest of them just hate him for that popularity. So he keeps to himself and only complains to his brother, Megumi. Until one day Megumi invites Natsuki Takamiya home. Just like the others, Natsuki's face shows the same expression of falling for Keiichi. But somehow, that look gives Keiichi goosebumps, rather than makes him sick. What is this? Why is that? He is baffled by it, so he sets out to find the answers!

(Source: MU)

title: [Hihou] Josou Danshi dakedo Ikemen no Senpai ni Onnanoko ni Saremashita
title_english: News Flash: I Just Like Dressing Like a Girl but He Wants More
title_japanese: 【悲報】女装男子だけどイケメンの先輩に女の子にされました
synopsis:
Kanato Tsuyuri is a geeky introverted high school boy who's insecure about his looks, but he actually has a secret life as "Shirahime." Shirahime is a popular cosplayer who dresses up as a girl and has over ten thousand followers. One day, his best friend Ikiri convinces him to play a trick on the handsome and popular Taiki Suga. He dresses up as a girl and tells Taiki that he has feelings for him. The next thing Kanato knows, he's in Taiki's room!

Kanato is shocked to find out that Taiki knows about Shirahime and that he invited Kanato to his room even though he knew Kanato was a boy dressed as a girl! Kanato is in a predicament and he needs to get out or Taiki might try to do more...!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Itsuka Kanau Yume
synopsis:
Sitting outside the dance floor at her cousin's wedding reception, Matty notices a man beside her and says hello. His name: Sebastian. A banker from New York. They start to hit it off, and Matty decides he is the ideal companion...for now. That's right—no matter how much Matty enjoys the relationship, she refuses to get too close to any man. That is the decision she made after her own carelessness cost her the use of her legs. Goodbye, Handsome. Little did Matty know that the man in question was determined to take the woman in the wheelchair out on a date!

Jihan Han is your typical high school student—minus the fact the he's acquired the special ability to view the world around him as a video-game. Not long after this discovery, he stumbles upon a hidden world filled with others just like him. Now, amidst juggling homework and completing quests, Jihan must learn how to navigate his newfound power in order to level up in life.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

synopsis:
Gail Hamilton is a "curse crafter" who got booted from his party for allegedly not pulling his weight...right after they were promoted to the Guild's "S" rank. Unfortunately, the party didn't realize that Gail's cursed goods pack the power of holy relics and legendary gear! But too bad for them, because Gail's going it alone now...and causing a sensation with the creepy-yet-useful curses he works with!

(Source: Kodansha)

title: The New Recruit
synopsis:
Enter Seunghyun, a virgin in his late twenties. A late bloomer, he finally manages to score the internship of his dreams. On his first day at work, he runs into the handsome yet cold Jongchan Kim. Who is he? Just Seunghyun's new boss! Will the two be able to keep their hands off each other at work?

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Semantic Error
synopsis:
Chu Sangwoo, a computer science student, is an uncompromising creature of habit who follows a meticulously organized schedule, drinks the same coffee every day, and sits in the same spot in each class. Tasked with doing a group assignment alongside freeloaders, Sangwoo decides that it is only logical not to credit them. However, his strict treatment causes his popular senior Jang Jaeyoung to lose the opportunity to graduate and study abroad. Seeing as he did nothing wrong, Sangwoo avoids Jaeyoung's constant phone calls.

As fate would have it, the two men meet when Sangwoo needs a new graphic designer for the 2D game he is making. Jaeyoung is known for his charming personality, but he actually hides a hot temper. Despite his unchanging situation, Jaeyoung cannot stand Sangwoo's apathetic attitude and decides to get revenge by interrupting everything Sangwoo spent years carefully planning. Sangwoo tries his best to keep his calm, but Jaeyoung's presence and attractive smile may prove to

title: Houkago no Etude
synopsis:
When Minobe Chihiro is admitted to a private arts academy to study ballet, the last person he expects to train with is surly second-year student Ichinomiya Shun. Yet by some stroke of luck, the two are paired up for their school's mandatory pas de deux practice. While Minobe has fallen at first sight for Ichinomiya's superior dance sense, the second-year's attitude leaves a lot to be desired. For Ichinomiya, being paired with Minobe as a dance partner is just one of the ways he'd like to be together with his new partner. It's not just grades that have Ichinomiya dancing with Minobe—he's head over heels, and he's after Minobe's heart!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Love Comedy Quest
synopsis:
Milia, the great witch who reigns over the demon world, has fallen in love for the first time... and the other person, believe it or not, is her arch-enemy, the "hero"!? The witch is maxed out in MP but has a zero points in love experience. An other-world romantic comedy!

title_japanese: 迷宮メトロ ～目覚めたら最強職だったのでシマリスを連れて新世界を歩く～
synopsis:
Shuu Abe wakes up in a strange place—at the fiftieth underground floor of the Ootsuka Metro, a labyrinth of metro beasts. The city of Tokyo has been transformed by the "Metro Overflow" and the "Super Fungus Pollution" for the past 100 years.

"It's like you were thrown into the last floor of the dungeon at level 1..."

But even so, Shuu and his partner, the chipmunk (Carbuncle race) Tamiko, stand up for themselves. They eat the Sporangium of defeated metro beasts to level up and learn "fungal skills." From the weakest to the top, this is the beginning adventure of one person and one small animal.

"New Tokyo," the land of thread people, has been rebuilt after the catastrophic collapse of the "Tokyo Tribunal." This is the adventure of a hunter spun into a new world.

(Source: Novel Updates, edited)

title: Kamigami no Kago de Seisan Kakumei: Isekai no Katasumi de Mattari Slow Life shitetara, Naze ka Tasai na Jinzai ga Atsumatte Saikyou Kokka ga Dekitemashita
title_english: Production Revolution by Blessing of Gods
title_japanese: 神々の加護で生産革命～異世界の片隅でまったりスローライフしてたら、なぜか多彩な人材が集まって最強国家ができてました～
synopsis:
During his reincarnation, Tadashi, a corporate livestock in Japan, was impressed by the gods for choosing the blessing of agriculture, which no one had ever chosen, and received an unprecedented generous blessing. And live the slow life of his dreams in a different world—but what he landed on was a huge, miasma-filled peninsula called Hengoku! While Tadashi struggles, he steadily expands the scale of agriculture with his innate serious personality and divine protection. The persecuted ex-queen of the elves, the female hero of the beastman, and the master craftsman of the dwarves also gathered in search of the supplies that Tadashi made. Agriculture, founding a country, slow life! The long-awaited comicalization of a heartwarming different world farming fantasy!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: The Lazy Lord Masters the Sword
title_english: The Lazy Lord Masters the Sword
synopsis:
After witnessing the shocking death of his mother, young Airen Farreira uses sleep to escape his painful reality, earning him the nickname, "the lazy lord." Yet, in spite of others' jeers and whispers, Airen has no intention of changing his ways. But when he awakens one day from a dream about a mysterious swordsman, his life's trajectory takes a complete turn...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: A Matter of Time
synopsis:
Rent-free living? What's the catch?

When her mom gets a new boyfriend, 19-year-old Soohyun decides to move out. In a stroke of luck, her college classmate Yujin offers for her to move in for free, no strings attached. But Yujin has a hidden motive... Will her secret affect their dynamic as roommates?

(Source: Manta)

synopsis: Kamui Fujiwara's adaptation of the Old Testament.

The "Old Testament," often called the world's best-selling book, which has formed the basis for Islam, Judaism, and Christianity. Follow the trials and tribulations of God's people, depicted with the unique touches of Satonaka Machiko, one of Japan's most famous manga authors.

(Source: Manga Reborn)

title: Super Dragon Ball Heroes: Ultra God Mission!!!!
title_japanese: スーパードラゴンボールヒーローズ ウルトラゴッドミッション!!!!
synopsis:
Warriors and fighters, from all over the space-time, gather to participate in the Space-Time Ultra Tournament. Goku and his allies will face very powerful opponents.

(Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)

title: Watch Dogs Tokyo
synopsis:
The Tokyo Metropolitan Government has decided to introduce J-ctOS, an urban infrastructure management system developed by Bloom Japan. The high level of convenience in which all infrastructures are managed has completely changed people's lives. There is no way to know the existence of a big darkness that can be put overhead...

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Junwaidan
synopsis:
A collection of sexual experiences to which you wish you couldn't relate.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Pocket Monster: Mewtwo! Ware wa Koko ni Ari
title_japanese: ポケットモンスター ミュウツー! 我ハココニ在リ
synopsis: The Team Rocket leader, Giovanni, has found Mewtwo in a remote area of the Johto region. As Giovanni tries to re-capture Mewtwo, Ash and his friends are kidnapped by Domino, a new Team Rocket member, while trying to rescue Pikachu from Jessie and James. The Clone Pokemon are also captured and are then used as bait for Mewtwo. The situation then becomes a battle between the wills of Mewtwo and Giovanni; and Mewtwo also tries to discover if it and the clones have a purpose in life, even though they are products of science.

title: Dareka Yume dato Itte Kure
title_japanese: 誰か夢だと言ってくれ
synopsis:
Sayo Hoshikawa, a high schooler who's insecure about his height, witnesses his unrequited crush getting rejected by a tall and handsome boy named Mashiba. Sayo challenges Mashiba to contest after contest, but he can't win a single time. Nothing gets under his skin more than when Mashiba calls him cute! But then, he starts having strange dreams about a certain someone embracing him—and soon enough, the dreams devolve into something even deeper...! 

(Source: Yen Press)

title: The Tutorial Is Too Tough!
synopsis:
Lee Hojae had given up his life as a pro gamer, until one day he received a mysterious message: "Congratulations! You've been invited to the Tutorial World." Intrigued, he enters the game and confidently chooses "hell" difficulty, but soon learns that he is trapped there. With a mere 0.01% survival rate, Hojae must somehow overcome the game's agonizing challenges to figure out the real reason he was invited. This tutorial may be tough, but its secrets are what's truly hellacious.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Ogi-kun no Natsuyasumi
title_japanese: 小木くんのなつやすみ
synopsis:
On the first day of summer vacation, Haruto Ogi fell in love with legally blind Shinya Tago. All though they connected immediately, Tago was at first utterly unaware that Ogi had fallen for him. For once, Ogi felt comfortable fully being himself; if his crush can't see him, then he's safe from being judged. A sweet love story about overcoming differences and accepting yourself for who you truly are.

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Kimi no Koto ga Suki de Ienai.
title_japanese: 君のことが好きで言えない。
synopsis:
It's been thirty years since meteorites from space turned everyone on the Earth gay. In a world where heterosexuality no longer exists, Kazusa Takanashi falls for her childhood friend Ayumu–a boy. Though she's doing everything she can to act normal whenever they hang out, her love for Ayumu is growing stronger by the day. How much longer can she hide her secret feelings?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Sotsugyou Lost Virgin
synopsis:
A lonesome girl comforting herself on a sleepless night. Picturing the man of her heart under her strained eyelids...

(Source: FAKKU)

title: Level 1 no Himekishi-san to Yurufuwa Mujintou Life
title_english: Laid-Back Deserted Island Life With a Level 1 Princess Knight
title_japanese: レベル1の姫騎士さんとゆるふわ無人島ライフ

title: The Breaker: Eternal Force
synopsis:
Haje Kang can't take it anymore. Pushed to the breaking point by relentless bullying, Haje stands at the edge of the school roof, ready to end it all. But just as he's about to jump, he's given a push—literally—by a mysterious upperclassman named Si-un Lee, only to wake up the next day, unscathed. Little does Haje know that Si-un happens to be one of the most powerful martial artists in the Murim, the hidden world of martial arts. Haje begs Si-un to train him, but he never could have imagined just how tumultuous things could get in the martial arts underworld...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title_japanese: 異世界召喚!魔王がパパで俺がママ!?

title: Get Schooled
synopsis:
Hwajin Na's teaching techniques are pretty violent for someone who works in the Ministry of Education. That being said, when punishments don't seem to work on even the worst of school bullies, there is no better man for the job. Sometimes you can't get a good education until those bullies are taught a lesson.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Trump
synopsis:
Sophie, a boy with vampire and human blood, is transferred from an orphanage to an institution called Clan. The school houses vampire boys who have reached their Cocoon period, or puberty in human terms. Sophie has a fateful encounter with a boy named Ul while being coldly greeted by the vampires around him.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Return of the Blossoming Blade
synopsis:
When Cheongmyeong of the Mount Hua Sect awakens a hundred years in the future, his last memories are of a bloody battle against the Leader of the Demonic Cult, the evil Cheonma. The battle almost saw the end of the Ten Great Sects of ancient China, when Cheongmyeong ended the hard-fought struggle by striking down Cheonma. Soon after, he succumbed to his wounds, filled with regret at their pyrrhic victory. All is not lost, however, as he awakens to his second chance at life. Shocked to find his beloved Mount Hua Sect reduced to a mere shadow of itself in the present day, Cheongmyeong embarks on a journey to restore Mount Hua to its former glory.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Manager Kim
synopsis:
Single father, company manager, and former black-ops member, Mr. Kim lived an ordinary life until his daughter, Minji, went missing. After discovering his daughter could be dead, Mr. Kim turns merciless and sets out for information. He will rescue his daughter by any means necessary, even if it means destroying everything and everyone standing in his path.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Ho!
synopsis:
Kim Woni was a college student that once met Ho, a deaf girl, when he worked as a tutor to teach her. Time flies, and they meet again a few years later. How will be their story end?

(Source: Dongman Manhua, translated)

title: Mystic Pop-up Bar
synopsis:
Burned out from dealing with their difficult lives, they are all at the end of their ropes... until they come across the Mystic Pop-Up Bar. Beckoned by its warm promise of delicious food and free-flowing drinks, they end up pouring out their troubles to the sympathetic (and occasionally abrasive) ear of the proprietor, Wolju. The keeper of the DreamWorld, she uses her powers to improve the lives of her customers, one late-night session at a time.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Nurse Sheena's Asylum Diary
synopsis:
The misadventures of patients in a mental ward, from the viewpoint of Sheena Jung, a nurse in the early stages of her career. Sheena works hard to take care of her patients and get along with her colleagues. She treats patients with various mental illnesses, such as mania, depression, delusion, and eating disorders. In the process, she learns how to treat her own self with love and kindness.

(Source: NHN comico Corp.)

title: Memorist
synopsis:
With a single touch, Detective Dong Baek can read anyone's memory. Thanks to his supernatural skill, he's gotten cocky over his virtually flawless track record. But a mysterious serial killer ends up mystifying even his supernatural ability, and a genius criminal profiler is brought in to close the case. Dong Baek will have to swallow his pride and work with her if they want any hope of stopping the slaughter...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Izumo: Takeki Tsurugi no Senki
synopsis:
Sucked into the underworld to fulfill the deeds of the Gods, Takeru soon finds himself at odds against the demons... and his best friend.

(Source: MU)

title: The Boy of Death
synopsis:
Kyeong-Ho's stubbornness to die seduces Sierra, a reaper from the underworld, who proposes a pact. This pact gives him the possibility of borrowing the powers of the dead in exchange for years of life. In order to get what he wants, he finally accepts it...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment, translated)

title: Douzaki Kachou wa Hameraretai

title_japanese: 同崎課長はハメられたい

Manager Douzaki is not the only one who wants to be screwed. Manager Douzaki is down on his luck with his private life, and it's affecting his work. To cheer him up, his coworker Ishimi offers to hear him out over some drinks, but one thing leads to another and... We find out what happens after the walk of shame the morning after.

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Dekiai Osananajimi wa Watashi no Otto de Stalker!?

synopsis:
Aoi married her childhood friend, Ren, who she's loved since she was younger. However, Ren has never once touched Aoi. She has tried to seduce him in the past to no avail. One day, she goes into his locked room, and what she finds changes the course of their relationship forever...

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

title: Golden Boy: Babel the 2nd

synopsis:
Drugs, women, money, Shinjuku Kabukicho is filled with all kinds of desires. Riku, a high school student, is called the "Golden Boy" in this town, and is even feared by the yakuza. What is the game that Riku plays against the outlaws who haunt this entertainment district, where one puts money and life on the line?

(Source: Hero's, translated)
