title_japanese: D級冒険者の俺、なぜか勇者パーティーに勧誘されたあげく、王女につきまとわれてる
synopsis:
If you become a hero and defeat the Demon King, a life of idleness awaits you...! This is what the young man Jirei believed, and he works hard day and night to achieve his goal. However, when he finds out that the heroes who defeated the Demon King were the ones who were doing all the hard work, he ran away. But the girls that Jirei had been saving on his journeys before he knew it came pouring in one after another to win his heart and body...?

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Sokushi to Hametsu no Saijaku Majutsushi
title_japanese: 即死と破滅の最弱魔術師

title: Tensei Mae wa Otoko Datta node Gyaku Harem wa Okotowarishite Orimasu: Kanpeki Shukujo e no Michi
title_japanese: 転生前は男だったので逆ハーレムはお断りしております 完璧淑女への道
synopsis:
By prioritizing the life of his best friend during a maritime disaster, the soul of a young man who lost his life was reborn as the Baroness Sophie Linier in another world. At the age of six, Sophie began to remember her past life.

(Source: Novel Updates)

title: Hotel Metsäpeura e Youkoso
title_japanese: ホテル・メッツァペウラへようこそ
synopsis:
In the Lapland region of Finland, the domain of snow, midnight sun, and auroras, there is the small Hotel Metsäpeura, run by two older gentlemen. One night during a terrible blizzard, a mysterious young man named Jun arrives at the hotel. He is clearly in dire straits, with a large tattoo on his back, no relatives and no money. However, the gentlemen warmly welcome him in and offer him a job at the hotel. The kindness of the people living in the harshness of nature will melt the heart of this awkward young man.

(Source: MU)

title: Watashi no Hatsukoi Aite ga Kiss shiteta
title_japanese: 私の初恋相手がキスしてた
synopsis:
Takasora Hoshi's life is upended when her schoolmate Umi Mizuike and her mother temporarily move into her family's cramped apartment. From the outset of this arrangement, Takasora is annoyed by Umi's behavior...and her good looks. Though the two girls initially agree to avoid interfering in each other's lives, Takasora can't help but start to wonder where Umi keeps wandering off to at night...From the author of Adachi and Shimamura comes the bittersweet tale of two high school girls whose lives are pushed together under the same roof.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: SSS-Class Revival Hunter
synopsis:
After the Tower suddenly appeared, individuals who wished to pursue their personal values began to inhabit it, coming to be called "hunters." Everyone had their own goals, but only a chosen few were acknowledged and given powerful skills by the mysterious structure. Kim Gong-Ja, a weak F-Class hunter without any skills, is envious of those who were blessed by the Tower. Letting his jealousy overcome him one day, Gong-Ja abruptly receives a S-Class skill that allows him to copy a skill from someone else—after they kill him.

Sooner than he likes, Gong-Ja gets to test his newly acquired ability on the legendary hunter known as the Flame Emperor. As he is dying, Gong-Ja learns the evil truth about the man he once admired the most. Receiving another potent skill that allows him to revive and go back in time by 24 hours, Gong-Ja devises a plan to travel 11 years into the past to eliminate the Flame Emperor and cement himself as the world's best hunter.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kei x Yaku: Abunai Aibou
title_english: Kei x Yaku: Bound by Law
title_japanese: ケイ×ヤク ーあぶない相棒ー
synopsis:
Ichirou, an investigator at the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department Public Security Bureau, under the order of his superior, approaches Shirou, a yakuza who is engaging in sexual companionships with politicians, in order to investigate and monitor him. However, he unexpectedly finds out that Shirou is the younger brother of his senior investigator. Ichirou, who always wanted to find his senior who disappeared under mysterious circumstances, secretly teams up with Shirou, and the two of them decide to solve the mystery of his senior's case. While they pretend to be lovers in order to deceive Ichirou's boss...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Beware the Villainess!
synopsis:
Unlike most villainesses, Melissa Foddebrat is not destined for the gallows or a life of misery. She is a beautiful but sharp-tongued young woman whose childish attitude is merely an annoyance to those around her. However, for a modern Korean woman who has been reincarnated in Melissa's body, none of that matters. She is inside the world of a novel she once read, reliving the life of a wealthy duke's daughter.

Melissa rejects the idea of continuing down the path of villainy. Instead, she strives toward a life of leisure, and to achieve this, she must first end her engagement with the womanizing and simple-minded crown prince. But severing her ties to an undesirable future is more challenging than expected, as the prince proves to be a stubborn opponent. Melissa must rely on her resilience from her former life to shake off the troubles of her new one and instead pursue what—and who—she truly wants.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Maria Children
title_japanese: 少女戎機 〈マリアチルドレン〉

title: Majo to Neko
synopsis:
Sudo, who ostensibly works as a normal deliveryman but actually acts as a "courier" for the underworld, sleeps with his neighbor Uno after they got drunk over dinner. The next day, Uno becomes very distant from him. Worried about Uno's feelings for him, Sudo sees Uno being harassed by some thugs on the street, and he reflexively takes Uno by the hand and try to run away. Attacked by enemies, the wounded Sudo was saved by forming a contract bond with Uno, a descendant of witches, who has been hiding his powers in secret.

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: Niji wa Yakou ni Kirameku
title_english: The Rainbow Will Sparkles at Night
synopsis:
Nakajima, who enjoys traveling alone, gets lost wandering on a legendary mountain of many rumors. He is helped by Kanzawa, who lives alone nearby. In the midst of his purposeless journey, Nakajima is fascinated by Kanzawa, who lives like a recluse. This is the story of Kanzawa who lives quietly on a secluded mountain and Nakajima who comes from a crowded city.

(Source: MU)

title: Meppou Yatara to Yowaki ni Kiss
title_english: An Extremely Haphazard and Weak-willed Kiss
title_japanese: 滅法矢鱈と弱気にキス
synopsis:
Yokosuka is a high school boy who gets the result of alpha in his secondary gender test. This is a big surprise since his parents are beta, so he is forced to attend the dating party for the marriage interview proposed by the city council. There, he meets many cute omega girls, but will he be able to find a nice girlfriend...?! Motivated by this, Yokosuka decides to undergo the compatibility diagnosis, and the kind of partner who was on the other side of the door with whom he obtained a maximum percentage of 92% was someone rather gruff with a look of unfriendliness that turned out to be... A MAN??!!

(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)

title: Sei Shounagon to Moushimasu
synopsis:
The manga is centered on the famous Heian-era poet and The Pillow Book author Sei Shounagon, and on court life in the Heian era.

(Source: ANN)

title: Ossan, Yuusha to Maou wo Hirou @comic
title_english: Middle-Aged Man Pick Up a Brave and a Devil
title_japanese: おっさん、勇者と魔王を拾う＠COMIC
synopsis:
An old man is forced to retire from the adventurer's guild and decides to return to his hometown. On his way, he picks up two babies. The first one is a human baby with the emblem of a hero. The second was a baby of the demon tribe with the emblem of the demon king. And so the story of the old man who picked up the hero and the demon king begins.

(Source: MU)

title: Hardcore Leveling Warrior
synopsis:
Known as Hardcore Leveling Warrior, Ethan is the #1 player of the world's biggest game, Lucid Adventure. But when a mysterious player kills Ethan and forces his character back to level 1, he will do anything to get back on top. New friends and old foes, as well as mysterious forces and his own dark past, will follow him as he does his best to take back what was once his.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Jintian de Ta Yeshi Ruci Keai
title_japanese: 今天的她也是如此可爱
synopsis:
Sixteen-year-old Cang Shu is an exemplary student and a beauty, which is why everyone simply assumes she and the school's prince, Cui Xin, are the perfect match. But Cang Shu has no interest in boys, and to quell the pesky rumors, she claims the person she likes is Qi Lin, the student with the worst scores in their grade!

By chance, the high-spirited troublemaker Qi Lin overhears Cang Shu's inadvertent confession and expresses her own romantic feelings. Although Cang Shu could clear the misunderstanding if she wanted to, Qi Lin's genuine eagerness and affection lead her to just request that they remain friends for now. The two girls are polar opposites, yet their differences only make their hearts grow fonder.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kono Hon wo Nusumu Mono wa
synopsis:
Descended from a long line of book collectors, high school student Mifuyu is surrounded by books in every aspect of her life. Her great-grandfather established the famous Mikura Hall, a library in the heart of town, and even the townspeople are all avid readers. There's just one problem—Mifuyu hates books! But when a thief in Mikura Hall triggers an ancient curse, she's left with no choice but to reclaim the stolen books herself...by entering the very stories she despises! With the help of the mysterious Mashiro, will she be able to restore her great-grandfather's collection and save her town from a magical doom?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Your Forma
synopsis:
In an alternate 2023, the Your Forma, a miraculous "smart thread" technology initially developed to treat a massive outbreak of viral encephalitis, has become an integral part of daily life. But these convenient devices come with an invasive drawback—they record every sight, sound, and even emotion their users experience.

For electronic investigator Echika Hieda, diving into peoples' memories via the Your Forma and hunting for evidence to solve the toughest crimes is all part of a day's work. The problem is, she's so good at what she does that her assistants literally fry their brains trying to keep up with her. After putting one too many aides in the hospital, the top brass finally furnish Echika with a partner on her level, a brilliant yet cheeky android named Harold Lucraft. Does this unlikely duo have what it takes to resolve their mutual suspicions and avert a deadly technological infection from sweeping across the globe before it's too late?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: The Swordmaster's Son
synopsis:
Jin Runcandel was destined to become the head of his swordmaster clan. But despite his best efforts, he's banished for his shoddy swordsmanship. Though Jin eventually makes a contract with the god Solderet and is freed from the curse that hindered his abilities, he meets a rather unfortunate end. In the next moment, however, he awakens as a baby, long before his tragedy began. Armed with a second chance and some new powers, Jin swears to fulfill his destiny and become the ultimate swordmaster.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Takane no Hana ni wa Sakaraenai
title_english: No Can Resist the Perfect Girls.
title_japanese: 高嶺の花には逆らえない

title: Buchigire Reijou wa Houfuku wo Chikaimashita. Madousho no Chikara de Sokoku wo Tatakitsubushimasu
title_english: A Livid Lady's Guide to Getting Even: How I Crushed My Homeland with My Mighty Grimoires
title_japanese: ブチ切れ令嬢は報復を誓いました。～魔導書の力で祖国を叩き潰します～
synopsis:
Elizabeth Leiston, the daughter of Haldoria's powerful prime minister, is the picture of a refined noble lady and the perfect future queen. But when her fiancé publicly humiliates her, calls off their engagement, and starts spreading nasty rumors about her, Elizabeth reaches her breaking point. Why should her only friend be her loyal maid, and why should she continue to serve a country that doesn't respect her? Elizabeth concludes she won't stand it any longer and will bring down the kingdom, even if it's the last thing she does! As such, she uses her quick wit and, more importantly, her seven magic grimoires to embark on a quest for revenge. And let her tell you, there will be hell to pay!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Tonari no Seki no Moto Idol wa, Ore no Produce ga Nai to Ikite Ikenai
title_japanese: 隣の席の元アイドルは、俺のプロデュースがないと生きていけない

title: Ghoul ga Sekai wo Sukutta Koto wo Watashi dake ga Shitteiru
title_english: Only I Know the Ghoul Saved the World
title_japanese: グールが世界を救ったことを私だけが知っている
synopsis:
A heavy mist has fallen over the world, twisting many humans into horrifying monsters. Humanity is losing the battle against these grotesque fiends, but it is not entirely without defenses. Leon Crossheart is an adventurer, a hero, a hunter of ghouls... and a ghoul himself ! His strength and regenerative ability are unmatched, but this power comes at a price: He's reviled by the very people he strives to protect. However, there is one girl he saved who sees beyond his frightening appearance. Alice is so grateful that she wants to be his disciple, and she isn't taking no for an answer! Will she bring light into his dark and bloodstained life, or will he keep her—and therefore his own salvation—out of reach?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Koushiki Comic Anthology: 86
title_japanese: 公式コミックアンソロジー 86―エイティシックス―
synopsis: Eighty Six anthology by various mangaka.

title: Rooms: Umishima Senbon Illustration + Comic-shuu
title_english: Rooms: An Illustration and Comic Collection by Senbon Umishima
title_japanese: Rooms 海島千本イラスト＋コミック集
synopsis:
Rooms: Umishima Senbon Illustration + Comic-shuu is an omnibus-style collection of illustrations and short comics showcasing the colorful and unique rooms and the everyday lives of the girls who live there. There is one story per room, with nine rooms featured in total. Each room is lovely enough to make anyone want to actually live in them. The layout of each room, the arrangement of the furniture, and the accessories on display reveal the personalities and characters of each girl. Cute pets, such as cats and dogs, also sometimes appear in the story, adding a touch of warmth and coziness. The detail in the illustrations of each room alone is enough to give readers everywhere a fascinating glimpse into each girl's life and story.

(Source: PIE International, edited)

title: Morris: Tsuno ga Haeta Neko no Bouken
title_japanese: MORRIS ～つのがはえた猫の冒険～

title: Teenage Mercenary
synopsis:
When he was eight years old, Yu Ijin was the sole survivor of a fiery plane crash in a foreign land. To survive, he became a notorious mercenary—honing his arm-to-arm capabilities, marksmanship, and combat prowess into those of a skilled predator. However, 10 years later, after encountering soldiers deployed from South Korea, he rediscovers his remaining family: an adorable little sister named Dayun and a warm-hearted grandfather.

Upon returning to his home country, a brand new trial is presented to Ijin—to assume the mundane life of a typical high school student. From scheming bullies to newfound friendships, every experience is new for Ijin. However, when his past begins to catch up to him, Ijin will have to use his years of experience on the battlefield to protect his loved ones.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Host Kateikyoushi Ore
title_japanese: ホスト家庭教師 俺

title: Hone no Zui made Aishite ne
title_english: Love Me From Deep in Your Heart.
synopsis:
Mimi Momoi, who originally was a plain girl, falls in love with a popular boy, Ruito Kurose, and undergoes a major transformation! Becoming a twin-tailed beauty, she approaches Ruito, determined to become his lover by any means necessary?! This is a heavy-handed and forceful love battle story!!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Kill the Hero
synopsis:
After he's killed by the righteous leader of his own guild, Woojin gets a chance to start over. This time he's not interested in saving the world from monsters—he's got his sights set on revenge! His high-level kills quickly garner him notoriety among the game plebs, while boosting his stats as he masterminds his way closer to the top. But there's something no one can figure out: whose side he's playing for. Now that he knows how to play to win, Woojin will stop at nothing to destroy the hero!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Latna Saga: Survival of a Sword King
title_english: Latna Saga: Survival of a Sword King
synopsis:
After being recently discharged from military service and just drifting through life, Hanbin Ryu is suddenly transported to another world. However, his "guide line," the system bestowed upon him to help with his survival and growth, was filled with errors, causing him to be stuck in the tutorial stage for over 20 years. When he is finally released from this personal hell, he finds everyone has turned against otherworlders like him. Just how will this low-level, super-tutorial newbie survive?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Beppin Majo Miriya & Marie
title_japanese: べっぴん魔女ミリヤ&マリー
synopsis:
Even though the wealthy young girl Miriya has almost everything she could ever need, what she really wants is to find her missing parents. But this year, she gets an extra special birthday gift when Marie, a magical white kitten, appears and whisks her away to Paris! Learning the art of magic is one thing, but getting to eat the tastiest French pastries and wear the most beautiful fashion takes Miriya and Marie's journey to a whole new level!

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Joushi to Kaisha de Game no Jikkyou wo
title_japanese: 上司と会社でゲームの実況を

title: Dragon Circus 0
synopsis:
One day, humanity was faced with a threat it could not resist—dragons. The crown of a pitiful machine. The great divine beasts that descended from heaven. When two sentiments intersect, the world begins to spin violently.

(Source: Hero's, translated)

title: Fukujuu no Ato
synopsis:
"If you don't want to get hurt stay still." Kiichi finds Shouta, the guy he met on an online dating site, passed out in the garbage. Kiichi, liking the blond-haired boy with a pierced ear, takes care of him and then tries to have sex with him. But Shouta resists! Ready for action, Kiichi holds Shouta down and stimulates him in all the right spots to get him just as turned on. What waits for Shouta after he's forced into submission...!!?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Boss to Yasu
synopsis:
When the boss of a notorious gang tells you to do something, you do it, and you do it well, even if that something changes from finding his ideal woman to BECOMING his ideal woman. Yasu, Boss Ginji's right-hand man, has only three words to say: You got it... And just like that, Yasu learns how to hypnotize Ginji to view him as Ginji's ideal type: strong, protective, gorgeous. The Boss falls in love at first sight. In his eyes, she (Yasu) is his very definition of perfect... in his eyes...

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Binbou Kenshi, Gum-chan wo Kau.
title_japanese: 貧乏剣士、ガムちゃんを買う。

title: Otouto ni Himitsu ga Arimashite
title_japanese: 義弟に秘密がありまして
synopsis:
Shogo and Haruya were perfect strangers before Shogo's mom and Haruya's dad decided to get married. One day, Shogo finds out Haruya's naughty little secret, and ever since, they become "partners in crime"...!! Is Haruya the cool and cocky jerk he seems to be, or is he the dirty and adorable younger man he shows Shogo? A story about family and love revolving around a passionate ex-troublemaker who falls in love with his cute younger stepbrother!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Inran Onna Kyoushi to Boku
synopsis:
1. Micchaku♥Kojin Shidou (Intimate Personal Guidance)
2. Senjou no Misshitsu (The Honey Room of Sensation)
3. Yokujou! Shuugaku Ryokou
4. Musaboritsukushite! Rinko-sensei
5. Dekiwaku no Kaori

title: Kono Naka ni Hitori 11-sai ga Iru!
title_japanese: この中に一人11歳がいる!

title: Aisha
synopsis:
The twins who have lost both their mother and father had their humongous inheritance stolen by their evil stepmother. The three sons of their stepmother have a special relationship towards their non-biological sisters. Thus, a scene of love and hate occurred in this old mansion. This is a fairy tale of romance and vengeance.

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

title: Genki na Kyuuketsuki ja Dame desu ka?
title_japanese: 元気な吸血鬼じゃダメですか?

title: Isekai Yuusha no Death Game
title_japanese: 異世界勇者の殺人遊戯〈デスゲーム〉

title: Momo Kanchou no Himitsu Kichi
synopsis:
In the year 3019 AD, humanity has gotten even more work casual: most of the time, Momo doesn't bother to wear her captain's uniform—or anything at all—onboard the cargo vessel Blue Chateau, as she struggles against interstellar tedium, company directives, low battery strength, and her ever-underfoot cat John. But fear not, for equipped with plenty of reading material and a crate of peach liqueur, in the long haul past Proxima Centauri space slacker Captain Momo will at last prove Newton correct—a body at rest will remain at rest!

(Source: Dark Horse)

title: Queen in the Shadows
synopsis:
"Could you become my daughter?"

Thanks to the Grand Duke Friedrich's proposition, Elena became his fake daughter. Yet after marrying the Crown Prince, having his child, and acquiring land to oversee herself, the "late" Duke's daughter, Lady Veronica, appeared before her. All along, she had been nothing but a mere puppet for the real thing. Elena's son is thus taken from her, and she is murdered. In a twist of events however, she ends up returning to the past.

"I will crush each and every one of you."

She would never live the life of a puppet again. And so begins Elena's second life, swearing vengeance on her enemies.

(Source: KW Books, translated)

title: Hamasaki-san nara Hiiteiru
title_japanese: 浜咲さんなら引いている

title: Chuuousen Ensen Shoujo
synopsis:
The usual scenes gazed from the train window, even those scenes contain new encounters. A childhood friend met after eight years, a mysterious girl met at the hospital... A collection of short stories interwoven with various heroines.

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Gaikotsu to Koi wa Dekiru no ka?
title_japanese: 骸骨と恋はできるのか？
synopsis: A love story between a human and a skeleton.

title: Yuusha Densetsu no Uragawa de Ore wa Eiyuu Densetsu wo Tsukurimasu: Oudougoroshi no Eiyuutan
title_japanese: 勇者伝説の裏側で俺は英雄伝説を作ります 〜王道殺しの英雄譚〜
synopsis:
Yukina was a young man who hailed from the same village as the Hero who shouldered the fate of the world. Through a certain incident, he got ahold of the talking spear, Gram. It was a weapon that was on par with the legendary sword the Hero wielded.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Dainana Ouji ni Umareta kedo, Nani Surya Ii no?
title_english: I Was Born as the Seventh Prince, What Should I Do?
title_japanese: 第七王子に生まれたけど、何すりゃいいの?
synopsis:
In rare cases, there are children that have reincarnated while holding the memories of their previous lives. Dependent on the god's caprice, they will be reincarnated into another world. One such case is the seventh prince of a certain kingdom.

The eldest son is the crown prince, the second, the third a diplomat, the fourth is bewed to the princess of another country, and the fifth and sixth are geniuses in music and art. Wait? Then what's left for me?

(Source: MU)

title: Touhou Project Niji Sousaku Series: Nisemono ni Koishita Mahoutsukai
title_english: The Magician In Love with a Fake
title_japanese: 偽物に恋した魔法使い

title: Inaka ni Kaeru to Yakeni Natsuita Kasshoku Ponytail Shota ga Iru
title_japanese: 田舎に帰るとやけになついた褐色ポニテショタがいる

title: Pony Shota Jojika Daisakusen!?
title_japanese: ポニショタ女児化大作戦!?

title: Zero no Daikenja: Wakagaetta Saikyou Kenja wa Shoutai wo Kakushite Nariagaru
title_japanese: ゼロの大賢者 ～若返った最強賢者は正体を隠して成り上がる～
synopsis:
The second rising of the reincarnated strongest sage, the opening of the adventure!

Siegfried, the grand hero of the Great Sage, is deprived of his position, honor, and power by the guilty tactics of Gilbald who was his right arm. He is expelled to the Forest Without Return, where he has a fateful encounter with a dying vampire girl. He who sacrificed himself and dedicated his blood to a girl - transformed into a vampire and rejuvenated into a boy! He who regained infinite magical power and acquired the special abilities of the vampire was named "Zero," and vowed revenge on Gilbald along with the vampire girl.

"It's bad, it doesn't matter a hundred before infinity" - the heroes who once gathered for the great war​ forced to run up from "Zero" this time!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Katame Kakure Musume no Susume
title_japanese: カタメカクレムスメノススメ

title: Hakui no Eiyuu
synopsis:
Kaito Tenchi is a rare genius scientist. When he wakes up one day, he has been transferred to another world. Kaito obtains a rare magic called "Creation" that allows him to create things he once saw. With the help of a female mercenary, Kaito lives with her, earns money by using his creation magic, and spends his days in peace and fun, but he gets caught up in various disturbances... Using his unparalleled brain and creative magic, he lays waste to his enemies! Other than athleticism and a good sense of naming, this is an otherworldly fantasy due to a natural disaster that's perfect!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Uzaki-chan wa Asobitai! dj - Soto Uzaki
synopsis: Shinichi and the Uzaki family find themselves in the world of doujinshi, where they can do things they normally can't in the world of web manga.

title: Uzaki-chan wa Asobitai! dj - Soto Uzaki
synopsis: Shinichi and the Uzaki family find themselves in the world of doujinshi, where they can do things they normally can't in the world of web manga.

title: Kyokuten no Honoo Majutsushi: Fireball shika Tsukaenai kedo, Motetai Isshin de Saikyou ni Narimashita
title_japanese: 極点の炎魔術師～ファイアボールしか使えないけど、モテたい一心で最強になりました～
synopsis:
Igni is born into a noble family that aims to be the strongest. At the "Rite of Appropriateness" held on his twelfth birthday, it is revealed that he can only use the elementary magic of fireball, and he is banished from his family home.

Igni lives an oppressed life in the town, but when he is reunited with his grandfather, who was once called the "Pole" and was one of the strongest, the wheels of fate begin to turn... A school magic fantasy of a boy who becomes the strongest just because he wants to be popular.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Bakumatsu Tobaku Barbaroi
synopsis:
The manga's story is set 250 years since the establishment of the Edo Shogunate, and when "gambling" is the way people who forgot about war fight. A female swordsmanship dojo instructor meets a man who has a rare talent for gambling, and the man has an ambition to change history.

(Source: ANN)

title: The First Night With the Duke
title_english: The First Night With the Duke
synopsis:
A handsome, selfish noble falls for a beautiful, kind commoner—at least, that's how the story's supposed to go. When an average college student wakes up as Ripley, an extra in her favorite romance novel, she resolves to enjoy the luxuries of her character's status while watching the novel's plot unfold from the sidelines. However, her plans are soon derailed when she finds herself in bed with no other than Duke Zeronis, the novel's hero! Dodging the villainess' schemes, the Duke's advances, and her own feelings, can Ripley keep the story on track and survive beyond the first night?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Jungle Juice
synopsis:
Suchan Jang is an extraordinary college student at the top of the social food chain. But underneath the perfect facade, he hides a pair of insect wings that suddenly grew when he used a mysterious bug spray called "Jungle Juice." Suchan's life crumbles when he bares his wings to the world to save someone's life. When all hope seems lost, Suchan stumbles upon a hidden world of insect humans where everyone is accepted for what they are. But the law of the jungle governs this secret society and all must fend for themselves in order to survive.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Gunjin Shoujo, Kouritsu Mahou Gakuen ni Sennyuu suru Koto ni Narimashita.: Otome Game? Sonna no Kiitemasen kedo?
title_japanese: 軍人少女、皇立魔法学園に潜入することになりました。~乙女ゲーム? そんなの聞いてませんけど?~

title: Dekiai Shachou wa Neratta Emono wo Nigasanai
title_japanese: 溺愛社長は狙った獲物を逃がさない

title: Kuchikake Ryuu no Keiyakusha
synopsis:
Kuchikake Ryuu no Keiyakusha is set in a Chinese-themed fantasy world, and centers on Yao, the proprietor of an antique shop who is also searching for someone who can wake their sister from her eternal slumber. Yao meets someone in the course of fulfilling a client's request.

(Source: ANN)

title: See You in My 19th Life
synopsis:
Jieum Ban has an extraordinary ability: she can remember the memories of all her past lives. After her previous life is cut short by a tragic accident, she sets out to reconnect with the people of her past life in her current one. Will memories of her 18th life sabotage romance in her 19th? Or will love endure across different lives?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: 9-banme no Musashi: Ghost & Gray
title_japanese: 9番目のムサシ ゴースト アンド グレイ

title: Akuma Shoujo wa Exorcist to Keiyaku Haki shitai
title_english: A Devil Girl Wants to Destroy a Contract with an Exorcist
title_japanese: 悪魔少女はエクソシストと契約破棄したい

title: Akuyaku Reijou desu ga, Moto Geboku no Juujin ni Flag Kaishuu saretemasu!?
title_japanese: 悪役令嬢ですが、元下僕の獣人にフラグ回収されてます!?
synopsis:
Agnieszka was once a member of a count's family and called a "villainess" because of her behavior. She instructed the beastman she had picked up to attack the fiancée of the prince she fell in love with, but she was betrayed and disgraced. After that, she changed her name to Annika and moved to live in a remote village.

One day, Annika receives a call from a lord who wants to take her as his wife. However, that lord is Ray, the beastman who once betrayed her. Annika is taken to the mansion of Ray, the man she once treated as a slave, and she prepares herself, saying, "From now on, I'll be able to clear my long-standing grudge...!"

(Source: MU)

title: Kocchi Muite yo Mukai-kun
title_japanese: こっち向いてよ向井くん
synopsis:
After taking some time away from relationships and love, it's been 10 years... "How can I find a girlfriend?" Mukai is a man in his 30's living at home with his family. He realized it's been 10 years since he's had a girlfriend. He told his last girlfriend, Miwako, that he wanted to "protect her". He was then told "what does that even mean?" and their relationship eventually fell apart. Ever since then, Mukai has felt things like "love" and "marriage" were distant concepts. However, he starts to find interest in the new person in the office, Nakatani...? Now begins Mukai's new search for love, stuck between new encounters and memories of his past!

(Source: Shodensha)

title: My Daughter Is a Zombie
synopsis:
One year after an unprecedented zombie attack that killed hundreds of thousands, South Korea has finally been declared zombie-free. But Jeonghwan holds a secret: his daughter is the last zombie left on earth. When her cravings are satisfied and her violent tendencies die down, it almost seems like there's hope for her to have a normal life. But how long can he keep Su-ah a secret from everyone else?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Medical Return
synopsis:
Kim Jihyun, who lived his life as a disreputable surgeon, gains a second chance to relive his life. He then goes back to his middle school days, and live his life to the fullest unlike before, he studies nonstop. His goal is to become a dermatologist who make lots of money instead of the poor surgeon he was from previous life!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translaetd)

title: The Choujin-sama
synopsis:
A Kinnikuman spin-off where Canadianman, Puripuriman, and Specialman sit at a restaurant and discuss things about the Kinnikuman universe.

(Source: Mangadex)

title: Scrap Sandayuu
synopsis:
In the year 20XX AD, an organization named ROK was founded to combat crime with their robot policemen. Because of a malfunction, a new robot named Sandayuu has a bucket for a head. Sandayuu is considered a piece of junk by some, but he has tremendous force hidden in that head of his!

(Source: Mangadex)

title: Guruman-kun
synopsis:
Shokui Kantai is a world famous gourmet and he wants his grandson Kunro to surpass him in this strict discipline that is haute cuisine.

After a long and grueling training, our young cook, barely a schoolboy in elementary school, will have to prove his worth against other talented and eccentric gourmets who will stand in his way!

(Source: Mangadex)

title: My Life as a Loser
synopsis:
My life was ruined after you bullied me in high school. So why do you get to be happy and successful? I'll give you a taste of your own medicine! Now you'll see what it felt like to be me... And you better be ready to pay the price if you want to return to your own body.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Kickboxer Mamoru
title_japanese: 蹴撃手〈キックボクサー〉マモル
synopsis:
Included one-shot:
Volume 4: Kick Boxer Mamoru (pilot)

title: Yuurei Kozo ga Yatte Kita!
title_japanese: ゆうれい小僧がやってきた!

title: F no Senkou: Ayrton Senna no Chousen!!
title_japanese: Fの閃光 -アイルトン・セナの挑戦!!
synopsis: A biographical manga depicting the success of brazilian F1 driver Ayrton Senna in the 1991 F1 scenario. It covers his first time in the McLaren team, along with some great racing moments, like his dramatic first victory on Brazil GP.

title: Hiiragi-senpai to Ofutari-sama
title_japanese: 柊先輩とおふたりさま
synopsis:
Tired of having to change schools because of her dad's job, Moemi, a first-year high school student, is allowed to stay behind at her parents' home on the condition that she lives with the daughter of her dad's boss. This girl, however, ends up being... a boy! And not just any boy, but one of the most handsome and popular boys at school! Moemi's formerly humdrum life becomes anything but as she traverses the excitement of living with a hot upperclassman!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Perfect Girl
title_japanese: パーフェクト・ガール
synopsis:
Kujou Yuriko's nickname is "The Perfect Girl." A nickname that was conceived due to her stellarness, beauty, athletic ability, and academic acumen. She is also the school idol who everyone adores. But she has one fatal flaw, she is madly in love with Apollon, a fictional manga character.

Nothing will stop her from collecting Apollon merch, not even the mysterious creatures "Crayshere" which appear from a person's insecurities. How will Yuriko defeat the Craysheres? And who are the mysterious beings that hunt the Craysheres?

(Source: MU)

title: Who Can Define Popularity?
synopsis:
Having been chubby as a child, Cha Siwon suffered cruel rejection from his first love, and it completely crushed him. For years, he has studied, worked out, and taught himself to exude confidence and be the most popular guy wherever he goes. Now in college, Siwon is ready to conquer another social scene, until he meets a man he can only describe as a natural charmer—Hyung Daun.

Daun effortlessly outshines everyone else, and his self-awareness and ego match Siwon's. He comes from a wealthy family, his beauty is blinding, and everyone is remarkably drawn to him. So, Siwon just cannot quite understand why someone who has everything would be so clingy and refuse to leave his side. But even though Siwon insists he has no interest in Daun, it soon becomes difficult to ignore his enchanting presence.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kono Kiss wa Kiji ni Dekinai
title_english: This Kiss Can't Be an Article.
title_japanese: このキスは記事にできない
synopsis:
A cunning actor with a cult-like following x toyed-with paparazzi photographer!

Manato, a reporter who shot the scandal of the super popular actor Ryuu Honda, is caught by said actor. The man has an appearance and personality that even men will love. However, beneath that veneer of elegance lies a cunning individual. "This is how you beg," Honda boasts. Unable to resist, Manato loses his virginity to the practiced actor. Furthermore, someone took a photo of them in the act?!

(Source: Shodensha, translated)

title: Seihantai na Kimi to Boku
title_english: You and I Are Polar Opposites
synopsis:
Next to Miyu Suzuki, a trendy and bubbly high school girl, sits Yuusuke Tani, a quiet and frank boy. Their interactions are brief, limited to Suzuki's unprompted random questions and Tani's succinct answers. Yet, beneath these simple exchanges, feelings of love are quietly blossoming.

Suzuki sees Tani for who he is: a straightforward boy who respects everyone equally, completely unconcerned about fitting in. Unlike Tani, she is too hung up on what everyone else thinks, desperate to keep her crush a secret. However, a slight misunderstanding leads to Suzuki confessing her feelings—and to her delight, Tani feels the same. Jittery with excitement, the young couple starts dating, embarking on a wonderful journey of friendship and love.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Sasha-chan to Classmate Otaku-kun
title_japanese: サーシャちゃんとクラスメイトオタクくん
synopsis:
I am an aspiring mangaka, currently assisting in the production of erotic doujinshi as a middle school student. While I was reading doujinshi at school, a beautiful girl very interested in erotic things, Sasha-san, suddenly called me "Master"!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Akuyaku Reijou to Kichiku Kishi
title_english: The Villainess and the Demon Knight
synopsis:
When noblewoman Cecilia realizes she's been reincarnated into an otome game, her shock is further complicated by the fact that she's the villainess! What's worse, she can't seem to change her fate. Now, her engagement is broken off, the heroine is harassing her, and she's forced to work in a brothel—where her very first customer turns out to be the debauched Leader of the Imperial Guard, Lucas Herbst. This dangerous Casanova looks like he'll be the end of her, until he takes her as a fiancée!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Delusion
synopsis:
It's 1935 in Gyeongseong, and struggling artist Iho Yun has been commissioned by the reclusive, elderly Madam Jeonghwa Song to paint a portrait. Madam Jeonghwa Song allows Iho to set eyes upon her—an unprecedented event—and standing before him is a young woman. But why does she ask him to paint an elderly version of her? "Don't finish the portrait." Tucked between the previous artist's paint tubes is an ominous letter. Iho learns that no artist has left Madam Song's abode alive or of sound mind. Just what is she hiding and what will happen if Iho finishes the portrait?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Magician
synopsis:
Iremy and Enz follow the Ethermask around the world looking for a lost magic. They make friends, defeat enemies, and uncloak the mystery of the Ethermask's immortality along the way.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Kimi ni Barenakya Honto wa Motto
title_japanese: 君にバレなきゃホントはもっと
synopsis:
It's been over a year since Takumi and Aki became roommates. They split housework perfectly, pay their bills on time, and their private lives are smooth sailing... or so Takumi makes it seem. He harbors deep feelings for Aki and hides them at all costs to preserve their harmonious lifestyle. However, Takumi's feelings get out, and now he fears the destruction of their relationship. On his 20th birthday, when he reaches legal drinking age, he drowns his sorrows in a bottle... and the minute he and Aki end up alone together, he makes a serious blunder.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Shousetsu Kidou Senshi Gundam: Cucuruz Doan no Shima
title_english: Mobile Suit Gundam: Cucuruz Doan's Island
title_japanese: 小説 機動戦士ガンダム ククルス・ドアンの島
synopsis:
After a covert mission goes wrong, Mobile Suit pilot Amuro Ray and his comrades are stranded on a remote island. The battalion was sent to a land called the Island of No Return to clear off any enemy forces, only to find a group of children and an enemy mecha attack. Now Amuro must find a way for them all to escape this mysterious land, but not before meeting a strange man—Cucuruz Doan.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: God, Please Make Me a Demon!
title_english: God, Please Make Me a Demon!
synopsis:
At a glance, high-schooler Moran Baek appears to be a beautiful girl who's perfect in every way... or so it would seem. In reality, she is an exiled demon who has been trapped in a human body for over 5,000 years. When she learns that she is still unable to use her demonic powers despite finishing her exile, Moran despairs and struggles to find a way to become a demon again. One day, she accidentally discovers that doing a good deed restores her powers, and sets out to find a way to keep doing good deeds so she can return to her devilish ways.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Mad Dog
synopsis:
Some people thirst for power while others want nothing more than to live low. Hamin has always been resentful of the label that comes with being his father's son—he didn't ask to be born into a mob family! After much trial and error, Hamin finally breaks ties with his family and begins to live the life he's dreamed about. That is, until he gets kidnapped and finds himself under the protection of a certain Kwon Sehyuk. All Hamin wants is his "normal" life back, but Sehyuk is as far from normal as a person can get...

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Go Jin and Gam-rae
synopsis:
After only one day's performance in this new village, someone has destroyed Go Jin and his musical troupe's instruments. His search for the culprit leads him to Gam-rae, the Taoist master of the village. Endowed with supernatural gifts, suspicion often falls on him. But Go Jin soon finds that there is much more to this man than his gifts, as he becomes caught in the middle of Gam-rae's own supernatural battle.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Hotel Phryne
synopsis:
It's Christmas Eve, and Doyoung's made a reservation at a luxurious hotel in the hopes of spending a romantic day with his crush, Hyunjin. But nothing seems to be going according to plan. They lose cell service, miss their reservation, and drive through a terrible rainstorm only to arrive at a haunted-looking hotel. When Doyoung asks for a refund, the imposing concierge insists he must participate in a game—a game that quickly turns Christmas into a nightmare.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Miss Guillotine
synopsis:
The era of the anonymous hero has ended, and the world's protectors—the Magical Girls—now live their lives in near celebrity status. But it turns out these protectors are really school bullies in their everyday lives. One day, a new, never-before-seen Magical Girl appears with a proclamation of war against the original Magical Girls! With imagery reminiscent to your favorite planetary protectors, Miss Guillotine promises nostalgic visuals with a dark premise.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Saenai Boku wa, Kimi no Hero
title_english: I'm Kinda Chubby and I'm Your Hero
title_japanese: 冴えない僕は、君のヒーロー
synopsis:
Lights, camera, Boys' Love!

Honjirou is a rookie actor trying his best to land a breakout role, but he fears that his weight stands in the way of his dreams. One day, he's surprised by fan mail full of sweets. The package came from Konnosuke, a local pastry chef–Honjirou's first major fan! As Konnosuke supports Honjirou's work and gives him new confidence to face the stage, will their relationship grow beyond just aspiring star and fanboy?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Watashi to Dasshutsu shimasen ka?
title_english: Let's Play Escape Games With Me!

title: Kamisama nanka Shinjinai Bokura no Eden
title_japanese: 神様なんか信じない僕らのエデン
synopsis:
Shy, introverted Shikito Takai has spent most of his life with his head in a book. He's the complete opposite of his classmate, the handsome and charismatic Ririto Nishio, whom he's always admired. The two have little reason to speak to one another—until one day, when Takai notices an alluring scent coming from Nishio. Later, during gym class, a strange feverish heat suddenly overtakes Nishio, and he begs Takai to help him. But rather than take his classmate to the nurse's office, Takai finds himself alone with Nishio in a storage room, the heat in his own body almost unbearable. Little do these two know that they are about to become the world's first alpha and omega, witnesses to the birth of the omegaverse...

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Flawed Almighty
synopsis:
Do good or go to hell. The conditions of his new curse seem simple enough for once-hopeful hoodlum Jeonji Kim. Or so it seems when his perky guardian angel shows up on his doorstep one day and heals his limp. But will simply going through the motions of helping people be enough to appease a petty god with a grudge?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Isekai Kenja no Mazoku Hanzai Chousa
title_japanese: 異世界賢者の魔族犯罪調査

title: Pet Wiz
synopsis:
Sakura loves animals, but animals hate her. Alice is scared of animals because animals like her too much. This is their struggle as they work at a pet shop!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Gakuen Mono no Otome Game no Sekai ni Tensei shita kedo, Cheat-mochi no Haikei Danshi Seito Datta you desu.
title_japanese: 学園物の乙女ゲームの世界に転生したけど、チート持ちの背景男子生徒だったようです。
synopsis:
Kenta who spend time by working part time in home center, suddenly reincarnated into a world that look like school setting otome game world that his sister liked, moreover as a background male student character. When he reincarnated, he’s given a magical item that can order anything that’s sold at home center where he worked at. Reincarnated as commoner Kent, he tries his best at improving his living environment by making bakery where he work part time at the opposite side of his house prosper, but somehow the number of attractive women around him increases.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Okazari Ouhi ni Natta node, Kossori Hataraki ni Deru Koto ni Shimashita: Usagi ga Iru node Hitorine mo Sabishiku Arimasen!
title_japanese: お飾り王妃になったので、こっそり働きに出ることにしました ～うさぎがいるので独り寝も寂しくありません！～
synopsis:
I'm a decorative wife... I love being a waitress during the day and a fluffy rabbit at night!

Roceline has been married to King Sieghart Luberia for half a year and has become a "decorative queen" without being touched during that time. That is because Sieghart is cursed and can't spend the night together! Not knowing that, Line doted on the rabbit who came to her bed every night, and by chance she decided to work as a waitress at a restaurant in the downtown area?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Akuu no Seijo: Imouto ni Nureginu wo Kiserareta Saikyou Majutsushi wa, Shoutai wo Kakushite Yarinaosu
title_japanese: 亜空の聖女 ～妹に濡れ衣を着せられた最強魔術師は、正体を隠してやり直す～
synopsis:
A young girl named Soalis was a genius at magic. By the time she was ten years old, she had become one of the top court magicians in the country. Now at the age of sixteen, she is respected and called a saint by the people. Whether it be demons, Demon Kings, and Evil Gods, she has defeated anything that threatens her country.

But one day, she is tricked by her own little sister, who is also a court magician. She is framed for a crime she did not commit, as she is found to have the banned magic potion, Elixir, in her room. She was tricked by her sister, whom she trusted, and without realizing the trap, Soalis was sealed inside the strongest mythical grade magic tool.

However, it only took her 20 years to break the powerful seal that was supposed to last for hundreds of years. In addition, while she was sealed, she had created spatial magic to escape and return to the kingdom. While in the seal, Soalis had not aged and was still a 16-year-old-girl. In the past twenty years, the kingdom

title: Saikyou no Koutei ni Hangyaku shitara Choueki 666-nen wo Kuratta Ore, Tsuihou-saki no Seireikai de Shin no Saikyou to Natte Maimodoru
title_english: I Rebelled Against the Strongest Emperor and Was Sentenced to 666 Years in Fairyland. I Became a Real Elementalor and Later Returned.
title_japanese: 最強の皇帝に叛逆したら懲役666年をくらった俺、追放先の精霊界で真の最強となって舞い戻る

title: Pine in the Flower Garden
synopsis:
The story of the growing up of a high school student that hates spring and has a phobia for flowers.

(Source: MU)

title: It's Mine
synopsis:
Do Yohan does not remember much about his past, but he does know that Lee Dajeong is the most important person in his life. She is the center of his world; he knows what she is doing at any moment in time, and her face captured from every angle is plastered throughout his bedroom. He does not consider himself a stalker and believes his intentions are pure. After all, he just wants to protect her.

Unable to approach Dajeong, Yohan watches over her from afar, always one step away in case she needs help. And she truly needs it; someone else seems to also have their gaze affixed on her, and their intentions are far less kind. Could this person and Dajeong be the keys to unlocking Yohan's past?

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Norowareta Yoru no Soleil
title_japanese: 呪われた夜の太陽〈ソレイユ〉
synopsis:
An era dominated by wizards. Ten years after the fall of the night, when the five "Wizards of the Night" were killed. The only surviving member is Ena of the "Family of The Sun (Soleil)" with the ability to purify the curse lived in hiding, but she is finally found. Oswald, a mysterious boy, helps her when she is being chased. He tells her he is one of the "wizards of the night" who should have been killed, and is made into the form of a child by a curse.

He asked to use Ena's abilities to break the curse...?!

A fantasy romance between a cursed wizard and a surviving girl!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

Included one-shot: Ena to Oz no Mahou Jijou

title: Sunggi's Study Group
synopsis:
A study group is where students gather together with the same goal in mind and help each other succeed. But not every study group is the same. And nooobody said there had to be a single goal in mind. Sunggi enters a study group that is supposedly focused on studying for the government service exam. But that doesn't mean that's all they have to do, right?

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Sunggi's Study Group
synopsis:
A study group is where students gather together with the same goal in mind and help each other succeed. But not every study group is the same. And nooobody said there had to be a single goal in mind. Sunggi enters a study group that is supposedly focused on studying for the government service exam. But that doesn't mean that's all they have to do, right?

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title: Spa Date
synopsis:
A temperamental designer can only see women's heads as those of animals. One day he meets a girl working at a spa whose face he can see as human.

(Source: MU)

title: Hatsujou Muchimuchi Girl
synopsis:
A monster girl on the surface can be the most lovely creature on the planet, but at the end of the day, there still beats the heart of a monster! Sometimes they can turn out sweet like an enchanting djinn granting her master's most intimate wishes or a stray cat girl looking to snuggle up all night with her new owner. And other times, such kindness can be manipulated like a slime looking to swallow more than her savior's seed, or a shapeshifting plant looking for nutrients. But what of a defeated demon lord who's fallen from her throne and now stares down the tip of the hero's sword? Will the monster come out and slay the hero or will she fall prey to the hero's mighty blade?

(Source: FAKKU)

title: Nuyi Jiuqing
synopsis:
After losing her mother and her own life, Jiuqing gets a chance to make things right! Now she'll stop at nothing to uncover the truth and to save her beloved mother. No longer playing the part of the dutiful daughter blindly following orders or the mild girl preparing to be an obedient wife, she's learning medicine, the healing arts, and what it means to fall in love. As she discovers more in a few months than she had in her last lifetime, where will this newfound fire within her lead to?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Light and Shadow
synopsis:
An uprising in the kingdom of Earlswald has led to the death of its lecherous and tyrannical king, his wife, and their son. Cayden, the leader of the rebellion, is crowned as the new monarch and grants his right-hand man, Eli—a peasant—the title of duke. Although considered a hero thanks to his achievements during the war, Eli is rumored to be a cold-blooded madman who strikes fear in his allies and enemies alike.

Due to supporting the former king in the past, a nobleman must marry off his eldest daughter to Eli. But he instead sends a servant named Edna under the pretext that she is his illegitimate child.

Despite their rocky start as newlyweds, Eli is intrigued by Edna's sophisticated demeanor and fiery personality, while she finds her husband to be more than what the rumors make him out to be. Nonetheless, Edna must maintain her facade because if Eli were to discover who she truly is and why she cares so much for the kingdom, it would cost her not only their marriage—but also her

title: Eleceed
synopsis:
Jiwoo is a kind-hearted young man who harnesses the lightning quick reflexes of a cat to secretly make the world a better place—one saved little child or foster pet at a time. Kayden is a secret agent on the run, who finds himself stuck in the body of a...um...decidedly fat old fluffy cat. Together, armed with Jiwoo's super powers and Kayden's uber-smarts, they're out to fight those forces who would let evil rule this world. That is, if they can stand each other long enough to get the job done.
