9. Kegawa wo Kita Kemono (A Beast Can't Change Its Sports)
10. Rin-kei Bitch na Seitokaichou (Cold Slutty Student Council President)
11. Little Magnum

title: The Gourmet Gamer
synopsis:
When he lost his ability to taste and smell, Rim Lee's life as a chef ended. Just as he's sinking deeper and deeper into depression, Rim discovers [Real], an incredibly immersive VR game that simulates all five senses. There, he's able to regain his senses of taste and smell. Not only that, but he can cook, too! Although he does need to hunt his own monster ingredients down... Now, Rim is here to cook up delicious food, hunt some dangerous monsters, and maybe even build a whole new legacy along the way. Welcome to Rim Lee's new life as "Rice," the gourmet gamer!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Meikyuu Teikoku no Tsukurikata: Rensei Jutsushi wa Mazu Risou no Mura wo Kaitaku shimasu
title_japanese: 迷宮帝国の作り方 ～錬成術士はまず理想の村を開拓します～

title: Shio no Machi: Jietai Sanbusaku Series
title_japanese: 塩の街 ～自衛隊三部作シリーズ～
synopsis:
The era of "salt damage" when salt fills the city.

Mana, who lives in Tokyo which is on the verge of collapse, picks up a weakened young man carrying a heavy backpack named Ryouichi. Together with Akiba, a man who acts like her guardian, the three head towards Ryouichi's destination, the sea, but...?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Hinata-san, Hoshino desu.
title_english: Opening the Door to Hinata-san's Heart
synopsis:
Meet Misaki Hoshino, a first-year high schooler and the most reliable guy in his class. Around a month after school starts, a teacher tasks him with delivering some handouts to his ever-absent classmate, Momo Hinata. However, upon meeting this girl who spent the last three years as a shut-in, Hoshino's life slowly begins to change. With Momo's feelings trapped behind her bedroom door, how will she make her after-school romcom dreams a reality?!

(Source: Kodansha)

title: Isekai Nihon: Ansatsu Ikka no Sannan wa Isekaika shita Nihon de Musou suru
title_japanese: 異世界日本～暗殺一家の三男は異界化した日本で無双する～

title: Watashi no Hara no Naka no Bakemono
Muse no Shinzui
title_english: The Essence of Being a Muse
synopsis:
Twenty-three-year-old art school reject Miyuu Seno has a blue print for the future, but it's not her own. Instead, she's stuck on the "secure"path her mom has laid out for her—from her office job, to her clothes, to the guys she meets—and it's making Miyuu more miserable by the day. When things come to a head between them, Miyuu leaves home with a blank canvas in tow, holding on to the hope that painting can somehow undo the phony she's become...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Boku dake ga Sex Dekinai Ie
title_japanese: ぼくだけがセックスできない家

title: Kimi no Neko ni Naritai
title_japanese: きみのネコになりたい
synopsis:
College orientation. A boy more beautiful than he has ever seen before, Sunakawa, has Murata falling in love at first sight. Living his everyday life as a straight man without giving it second thought turns on its head, with his sudden confession ending tragically in rejection. Undeterred, he sets his heart on becoming the "bottom" to his "top," always doing his best and looking for opportunities to get closer day after day. Despite turning pale with anger and astonishment at Murata's advances, before long Sunakawa becomes unable to ignore him... A good looking top and average looking straight guy—an anything-goes (?) battle of love begins?!

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

title: Akemashite, Goshuushousama desu
title_japanese: あけまして、ご愁傷様です
synopsis:
1. Akemashite, Goshuushousama desu
2. Yoshiko-chan
3. Kanojo wa Mainichi Tobioriru
4. Watashi ga Ichiban Suki na Sekai
5. Tesou
6. Tenkousei no Sachiko-san

title: The Hero Returns
synopsis:
With the unexplained emergence of dungeons came a relentless onslaught of monsters that overwhelmed humanity. Even the Awakened, humans with special abilities to fight monsters, couldn't stop the destruction of the world. In the end, only Sungin Kim, the most powerful Awakened, was left standing. Upon his death, Sungin wakes up twenty years in the past as an unassuming high school student named Soohyun Kim. He's not sure how or why he was brought back, but he does know this is his second chance to save the world and redeem himself as a hero.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kyuutei Nyokan Myeong-hwa: Taiyoukyuu no Kage to Unmei no Ouhi
title_japanese: 宮廷女官ミョンファ 太陽宮の影と運命の王妃
synopsis:
Myeong-hwa, a court lady, tries to get ahead in life, but is seen as an enemy by her superiors. However, her life turns around when she meets a young, attractive military officer in the palace and is offered a strange deal. The next morning, Mweong-hwa is ordered to be a candidate to become the king's concubine!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Saikyou ni Uzai Kanojo no, Ashita kara Tsukaeru Mount Lesson
title_english: The Most Annoying Girlfriend's Condescending Lesson You Can Use from Tomorrow.
title_japanese: 最強にウザい彼女の、明日から使えるマウント教室〈 レッスン 〉

title: Ink-iro no Yoku wo Haku
synopsis:
Based on the life of the 19th-century English painter Aubrey Beardsley, who died at the young age of 25.

(Source: MU)

title: Shutter-gai no Sakura Hime
title_japanese: シャッター街のさくら姫
synopsis:
Shinnosuke Ichijou, a high school student who likes to draw, has transferred from Tokyo to a high school in the countryside. He is asked by his classmate Sakurada, the daughter of a butcher in the shopping district, to draw a "nobori" for the store. However, Shinnosuke was bullied for drawing at his previous school.

(Source: MU)

title: Kaika Apartment
synopsis:
Everyone who lives there has a "reason" for doing so.

Towards the end of the Taisho era (1912-1926), Fuji, a translator, moves into "Kaika Apartment," a luxurious housing complex overflowing with elegance. Little does he know that the residents there all harbor secrets... but what are they? And does Fuji have a secret of his own...?

Peculiar tales of an apartment complex filled to bursting with bewitching, intertwining, and twisted human relationships.

(Source: MU)

title: Girasol: Gogh no Harukanaru Michi
title_japanese: ジラソウル -ゴッホの遥かなる道-
synopsis:
Set in Paris in 1890, the year Van Gogh passed away, this what-if historical drama depicts the meeting of 8-year-old prodigy artist Pablo Picasso and free-spirited painter Vincent Van Gogh.

(Source: Manga Mogura RE, edited)

title: Yamada-ke no Onna
synopsis:
Mitsuha Yamada is a high school girl who grew up in a family of women. Because both her grandmother and her mother had divorced many times, Mitsuha dreamed of marrying a strong, earnest partner. After accidentally injuring Kubo-kun, her blonde-haired classmate who seems like a delinquent, she begins to see an unexpected side of him...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Aoi Haru yo Saraba!
synopsis:
Yu's uneventful everyday life gradually starts to be filled with uncertainty. He wants to be with Kodai. He means it. He really does... however, one day they'll date girls and marry them... and their relationship will come to an end... He can't stop thinking about that day. Just as Yu is fretting over the inevitable, Kodai shows up at his doorstep. Kodai asks Yu to run away with him!

...Should they?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Mitai Mitai
synopsis:
A love between two people who don't know each other's faces. A short story full of excitement!

(Source: MU)

title: Tsuki ga Kirei ni Mieru kara
title_japanese: 月がきれいに見えるから

title: Anatomia: Kaibou shite Wakatta Koto da ga, Ningen wa Kanarazu Shinu You ni Dekiteiru
title_japanese: アナトミア～解剖してわかったことだが、人間は必ず死ぬようにできている～
synopsis: Set in the Duchy of Milan at the end of the 15th century, when anatomy began to be taught through autopsies.

title: Six Sense Minus One
title_japanese: シックスセンスマイナスワン

title: Sleeping Dead
synopsis:
Sada is an earnest high school teacher admired by students and colleagues alike, a man who always goes above and beyond both inside and outside of the classroom. One night while walking through the city, he stumbles upon a student being violently attacked in an alley. As he tries to call for help, Sada finds himself on the end of the attacker's blade, bleeding to death on the ground. When he wakes up on a slab in an unknown laboratory, he comes face-to-face with his savior, a scientist named Mamiya. But Sada quickly realizes that in cheating death, he has become something...inhuman. What's more, he's now fully dependent on Mamiya to survive. What awaits him in this new life of death and deadly secrets?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: No Marriage Is Perfect
synopsis:
An argument, a fall, and a lie. Determined to save her loveless marriage, Yeonhwa impulsively fakes memory loss to buy herself some time. After all, who would insist on divorcing someone with a brain injury? But now, not only is her ice-cold husband suddenly warm and caring, he's telling her that they've always shared a bed—even though she knows they've never even kissed! How long can she hold him at bay? Does she even want to? And maybe more to the point, who's playing who, here?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Put a Smile On
synopsis:
For Lee Kang, the captain of the swim team, life is a constant power struggle. And whether it's in sports, or in bed—he always wins. But when Junho from the baseball team accidentally witnesses him having sex with the TA, Kang finds his unyielding new opponent. Will Junho get destroyed just like the others, or will he remain standing with a defiant look in his eyes?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Oniichan wa Oshimai! Koushiki Anthology Comic
title_japanese: お兄ちゃんはおしまい! 公式アンソロジーコミック
authors: Yuuki, Shinichi|Namori|Hara, Yui|Mori, Misaki|Tsuchii|Hami|TOmoe|Kamaboko, Red|Terai, Akane|Suka|Cool-kyou Shinja|majoccoid|Fujichika, Koume|Hori|Kakitsubata, Waka|Hatopopoko|Nekoume|Dobato|Okada, Anmitsu|Igarashi, Masakuni|Kobayashi, Kina|Kawamura, Taku|Onio|Sorato, Shunsuke|9℃|Tadano, Natsu|Adachi, Imaru|ruch_f|Yuuki, Suzu|Minamito|Yuuchi, Mikumi|Yukimoto, Shuuji|Ceramic|Asazuki, Norito|Tokita, Shigure|Fukuoka, Tarou|Kometsubu|Moricocco|Sasuke|zinbei|Ouchi, Kaeru|Toyobayashi, Sakane
synopsis: An anthology comic of Oniichan wa Oshimai! by various mangaka.

title: My Boss Is My Biggest Fan!
title_english: My Boss Is My Biggest Fan!
synopsis:
By day, Naeul Ju is an unassuming pushover at J&H Tab House. By night, she is Author Juna, a popular writer known for her web novel, Love Shot. No one knows about her secret double life except for her two closest friends. Hiding behind her taglines, she struggles to speak up while working for her ignorant boss, Dobin Kwon. She finds comfort in her cyberfriend, Dobi, who has always been there to support her. Workplace drama, pen names, and hidden identities... what will Naeul do when she realizes that Dobi is actually her ruthless boss, Dobin?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Sleeping with the Enemy
synopsis:
"Do you have any thoughts of becoming an actor? I can't see anyone but you from far away." God's hands in the entertainment industry, golden eyes, Iyeon Shin. The person she cast always became a big star. In a few years, she fell in love with the person she street casted, Taejin Yeo. Beautiful face and perfect body shape, no matter what anyone says, he'll be a great actor! However, she didn't know that he's the CEO of her competitor, Jin Entertainment. She didn't know that he was a spy who came to steal her casting secrets. "Maybe i didn't recognize your star sense from the beginning, instead I fell in love with you at the first sight?" "The thing I was curious about, was it the secret of SINI Ent. casting, or was it you, Iyeon Shin?" Their cheerful and lively love story, full of confusion and sweetness!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Dokusenyoku Tsuyome na Shachou no Dekiai ga Tomarimasen!
title_japanese: 独占欲強めな社長の溺愛がとまりません!
synopsis:
Kiyo works in product development at a chocolate manufacturer; she's what they call a "science type" with her white lab coat and glasses, plus her lack of romantic prospects. "I've spent my whole life focused on research, but now I want to give 'love' a try." — Her mind made up, Kiyo registers with a matchmaking service, but the dates just keep going down in flames... Then one day, she's met with a shocking invitation from the young and handsome president of her company, Mr. Sendo: "Would you like to go out with me? I need you." Kiyo has zero experience with romance, so this well-mannered and gallant man gazing sweetly at her as he calls her beautiful is enough to leave her reeling...! Her heart is still pounding on the day of their date, and then Mr. Sendo suddenly reveals his red-blooded, manly side and proclaims, "I'll shatter that logic of yours with my passion"...?! 

(Source: Starts Shuppan)

title: 0 kara Hajimeru Office Love
synopsis:
Akari, a tall and elegant, almost thirty-year-old accomplished chief wedding planner who has two big secrets. She's not the mature and sophisticated career woman she appears to be, she's actually a virgin who is really into cute things. 

Akari's life was normal until a new and handsome director was appointed at her job. Since being appointed, Akari has been stretched thin and had her work constantly criticized by her new boss. She resented him, until one day, she had one too many drinks at a work party and brought her boss home. Since then, he's discovered both of her secrets, and their relationship has since become more intertwined and complicated since then. Will this relationship blossom, or will it just make work more complicated then it already is?

title: Tensei Ningyohime wa Awa ni Natte Kietakunai
title_japanese: 転生人魚姫は泡になって消えたくない

title: Haraguro Onzoushi ga Ijiwaru desu
title_english: Merciless Teasing from a High-Class Suitor
title_japanese: 腹黒御曹司がイジワルです
synopsis:
Office worker Shiho, age 28, plays the go-getter career woman so well that everyone at work calls her the "Iron Lady." Feeling uneasy about her relationship with her boyfriend Ken, Shiho takes the leap and invites him to a company party, but as the party begins he's still not there... In that moment, her handsome coworker, and heir to the company, Miyagi strikes up a conversation with her. Miyagi is a big hit among the female employees, but Shiho has always treated him casually, never taking much interest in his charms. However, when she runs into him again on the way to the bathroom, the usual sweet and chipper Miyagi is nowhere to be found! His speech is rougher, and he's dropped the workplace niceties, and on top of that he backs her up against the wall, blocking her retreat with his body...?! An office romance with a high-class bachelor, at once wicked and earnest, who just might be her Mr. Right!

(Source: NTT Solmare)

title: Zomgan
synopsis:
The world has already fallen. Remaining human survivors are oppressed under the iron rule of "zomgans"—half-human, half-zombie hybrids who evolved from a viral outbreak that wiped out human civilization. The only thing that stands between zomgans and total domination over humanity is the Eradication Front, a ragtag band of resistance fighters that includes "transcenders," humans who possess special powers. The struggle against the undead looks hopeless, until one day they come across Mirae On, a boy who can't die...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Celestial Bride
synopsis:
For thousands of years, humans have worshiped the gods of the heavenly world, but faith has been on the decline since a celestial last graced the earth. That is, until a scorned princess with a target on her back is miraculously rescued by one. Hunted down by soldiers from her own nation, Princess Chaeyeon is in a desperate battle for her life. As if to answer her prayers, a mysterious man with wings swoops down from the sky, whisking Chaeyeon away to the land of Mount Kunlun, home of the Great Celestial Phoenix who will soon become her husband. Blessed with this unprecedented opportunity, Chaeyeon is determined to become the Celestial Bride and right the wrongs of her past. In doing so, she may just change the course of her fate, both on Earth and in Heaven.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Cradle of Heaven
synopsis:
Three years ago, the celestial empire came under attack by the demons. With his kind on the verge of extinction, the celestial being and emperor, Kasin, is tasked to go down to the human world and find a way to restore peace. After three years without much progress, he encounters Daran, a merchant who has disguised herself as a man to travel and sell medicinal herbs. Daran was born with the power to heal anyone with a single touch. This ability makes her the exact person Kasin needs on his quest. Although Kasin swears he has no interest in men and is only keeping Daran with him as an aide, the more time passes, the more he finds himself becoming attracted to the special merchant...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Kyou mo Ashita mo, Kazoku desu.
title_japanese: 今日も明日も、家族です。
synopsis:
Naguru once lived a rough life as the leader of a gang, getting into fights in order to protect his friends. His loved ones all admired his strength and kindness, but also worried that his dangerous lifestyle would get him killed. When Hirao first met Naguru, he didn't know about the man's gang affiliation: all Hirao knew in that moment was that he wanted to spend the rest of his life with Naguru.

Thanks to Hirao's love, Naguru found a new path—and a new future. Now, the former gang leader is a devoted father, raising their adorable son, Towa, alongside the man who changed his life.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Akogareta Hito wa 42-sai no Shoufu deshita
title_japanese: 憧れた人は42歳の娼夫でした
synopsis:
Dandy is a 42-year-old prostitute who enjoys playing the role of the ideal man for his customers. His life takes a turn when a coworker from his past workplace shows up and demands to talk to him.

(Source: MU)

title: Ousama no Mimi: Himitsu no Bar e Youkoso
title_japanese: 王様の耳～秘密のバーへようこそ～
synopsis:
The story is set in a bar where you can sell any secret at a price. The bar's owner is seeking an extraordinary secret, while his patrons want to reveal the secrets they were holding to someone.

(Source: MU, edited)

title: Kidou Zekki Gundam Sequel
title_japanese: 機動絶記ガンダム SEQUEL
synopsis:
Seven hundred years ago, half of humanity perished in the Great War in the Earth Sphere. Powerful weapons called Gundams, piloted by evolved humans called Newtypes, helped bring the war to an end, and became venerated as god-like guardians. Despite this, the Earth government considered Newtypes and Gundams to be a threat. Shortly after the war, the Newtypes were rounded up and banished to the space colony Cocytus, which was then gassed to kill its 10 million inhabitants and ejected from Earth's orbit.

Unknown to the Earth government, some of the inhabitants of Cocytus survived the gassing, and they and their descendants built a new civilization within the colony as it drifted through deep space. In the present day, inside Cocytus, the infamous assassin Bloody Kaoris is captured and sentenced to public execution in the Imperial City of Gun Dorado, but the authorities do not realize that this is exactly what she wants.

(Source: Gundam Wiki, edited)

title: Henjin no Salad Bowl
synopsis:
Kaburaya Sosuke, an impoverished detective, meets Sarah, a princess from another world with magical powers. They start living together, and Sarah quickly adjusts her life to modern Japan.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: The Queen of Kisses
synopsis:
World-renowned actress Son Yuri has it all: beauty, talent, and now even unimaginable wealth upon her marriage to IT magnate, Dave Chun. But the happiest day of Yuri's life soon becomes the worst when her husband suddenly goes missing after the first night of their honeymoon. With them having been the only two on their yacht in the middle of the vast sea, Yuri is immediately suspected of murdering Dave. Just when the entire world seems to be against her, Yuri is reunited with Lee Dojun, a lawyer and old acquaintance. Despite their complicated history and disadvantage in the case, Dojun is determined to prove Yuri's innocence by uncovering the truth behind this impossible mystery...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Super Genius DNA
synopsis:
If you had the power to heal the world, would you have the strength to make it happen? Youngjoon Ryu, a research scientist at one of the biggest pharmaceutical companies in South Korea, must step up to this challenge. After being infected by an artificial cell creation project called Rosaline, Ryu's suddenly able to perceive heightened biomedical knowledge via auditory and visual hallucinations. With his brand new superpower, Ryu vows to overcome the corruption of big pharma and create medicine for the good of all humanity... but will he succeed?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Chichi no Tamashii
synopsis:
The story of a boy named Hayato Nanjou and his life about baseball. Troubled between becoming a professional baseball player like his departed uncle or succeeding his father's baseball bat manufacturing business, Hayato faces the challenges ahead of life while rising to the stage of his dreams.

(Source: Animanga Wiki)

title: Ayakashi no Oyomesan ni wa Narimasen!: Hirotta Neko ga (Jishou) Daiyoukai deshita
title_japanese: あやかしのお嫁さんにはなりません! 拾った猫が(自称)大妖怪でした
synopsis:
"I've decided for you to be my bride!"

I left the company I worked for to finally open a restaurant in the countryside. But even though I tried my best, things didn't go so well. Until one night, a cat that I saved while I was out for a walk suddenly turned into a handsome man?! What's more—he proposed to me? But he's a cat?!

This new, heart racing lifestyle begins!

(Source: Flex Comix, translated)

title: Dokoka no Hoshi no Futari: Hagino Makoto Tanpenshuu
title_japanese: 萩埜まこと短編集 どこかの星のふたり
synopsis:
1. Madobe no Rinoa
2. Nami yori mo Odayaka de, Kumo yori mo Hayaku
3. Kamiyui no Musume
4. Kamisama Gokko
5. Dokoka no Hoshi no Futari

title: Ookami wo Katteimasu
title_japanese: オオカミを飼っています
synopsis:
Ino, an expressionless and unsociable office worker, lives with a younger man who is in love with him like a dog with its master. Even though the two of them barely know each other, Taichiro suddenly volunteers himself when Ino and his colleagues put out a drunken call for candidates to be Ino's partner. Ino turns Taichiro down, but because Taichiro has no home to go back to, Ino offers to let him live with him. Taichiro is patient, and although he sometimes can be touchy and steadfast about his love for Ino, he makes sure never to do anything that Ino won't like. One day, after starting to come to terms with his own feelings for Taichiro and his boundless devotion, Ino falls into a suspiciously deep puddle and somehow enters a parallel world. He finds Taichiro there, but in this world, the two of them are complete strangers, and Taichiro's cold demeanor seems to be almost the complete opposite of the man Ino knows and loves...

(Source: Shinkosha)

title: Inu to Yuusha wa Kazaranai
synopsis:
Sousuke Satou, 18 years old (elementary school graduate), was summoned to another world, defeated the demon king, and returned to Earth for the first time in several years. While he is unable to find a job anywhere and lives a part-time job, he encounters a battle between a "magician" and a "monster" who he thought did not exist on earth! Sousuke easily defeats monsters, but that power catches the attention of others, and he ends up getting involved in demon subjugation...?! The former strongest hero takes part in modern, supernatural battles!!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Gun Dragon II
synopsis:
At the opening of space borders, a special force, made up of humans and extraterrestrials, is created to maintain peace between different peoples: the Gun Dragons. Agent Omega is not the same since her teammate Alpha lost his life in an attack on a Gun Dragon ship by the terrible sorceress Ashura and her right hand, Lucifer. Time does not erase her wounds and she takes refuge at work, multiplying her missions, when suddenly, during a stakeout on famous arms dealer Himler, Ashura appears again...

(Source: ART Teknika, translated)

title: Love Alarm
synopsis:
"Someone within a 10m radius likes you." With these words, LoveAlarm, an app that alerts users to the feelings of others, turned the world upside down. For struggling but optimistic high-schooler Jojo Kim, the day it-boy Sunoh Hwang rang her LoveAlarm felt like the start of a beautiful romance. But when the app that was meant to bring people together begins to dig up the darkest of emotions, Jojo quickly realizes that people may have been better off before they lived in a "ringing world"...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Slumbering Ranker
synopsis:
After sleeping a total of 10,000 hours inside Idea, the hottest online game around, Lee Hyunsung becomes one overpowered player! He's given an exclusive hidden class with an array of unique skills, and one of which allows him to fight in his sleep! He's slowly making his way up to the top, and everyone from the developers to other players are starting to take notice of this odd rookie. Will Hyunsung eventually become the top ranker in Idea? Or is this all just a dream that's too good to be true?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Yi Gwol: The Grand Commander
synopsis:
Due to his master's scheme, Yi Gwol, Head Disciple of the Skysword Sect, was sent off to war. After 70 grueling years of military service, he's finally permitted to retire from his position as Grand Commander. Once he regains his youth through rejuvenescence, Yi Gwol secretly passes on several powerful swords to his junior disciples before starting his carefree life as a teahouse owner. But what began as a small gesture is about to cause a big conflict in the martial world...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Art of Reincarnation
synopsis:
Despite having only one arm, Daven had finally proven his worth after defeating his cousin Kazin in honorable combat. But Kazin took advantage of Daven's mercy, stabbing him in the back and imprisoning him for life. 500 years later, the minor god Yulian is reborn and unknowingly summons Daven’s soul into the body of a young boy named Vincent Adenka. As the pair work to reveal the truth of Daven and Kazin, Vincent must relearn the art of combat while Yulian discovers the art of reincarnation.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Magan de Hajimeru Gekokujou
title_english: Rebellion Against Authority Starting with the Evil Eye
synopsis:
A treasure with the "power to change the world" sleeps in a certain ruinous dungeon. Now there were those who aimed at that treasure and challenged the dungeon infested with ancient creatures. First, Princess Knight Lilithia, the first princess of the Kingdom of Langbird. Next, the soldiers of the Georgian Empire, who are hostile to the Kingdom of Langbird. And a young man, Eight, who has just become a slave of Lilithia for some reason. Eight was unintentionally embroiled in a battle to scramble for a treasure that could affect the survival of the nation, but when he approached the depths of the dungeon, he heard a girl's voice out of nowhere!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Bokura no Sennen to Kimi ga Shinu made no 30-nichikan
title_japanese: 僕らの千年と君が死ぬまでの30日間
synopsis:
The manga centers on Towa, a girl who barely feels anything of the world, and experiences it as if looking from the inside of an ash-colored box. But her life begins to change when she meets a mysterious young man.

(Source: ANN)

title: Samurai ga Tensei shitara Idol ni Natta Hanashi
title_japanese: サムライが転生したらアイドルになった話
synopsis:
The story centers on Sakura, a warrior during Japan's Warring States period who was cut down in battle alongside the famous "Demonic Six Swords" samurai whom he admired. Bearing a strong lingering regret even in death, Sakura awakens to find himself in the modern day, as a member of the idol group "SSS7" about to make their debut.

(Source: ANN)

title: Ryuu no Hanayome Okotowari
synopsis:
A town with a dragon legend. Sakura and Ren, who have dragon blood, have protected the town as "dragon people" with the power to control water. One day, Sakura breaks the seal of the sealed dragon Kouka in order to save the frail Ren. Taking Ren as a hostage, Sakura helps Kouka to revive completely...⁉

A Japanese-style fantasy in which a dragon and a girl violate a taboo!

(Source: MU)

title: Kimi no Ashiato wa Barairo
synopsis:
Haruka and Takumi had their bodies swapped when they fell down a staircase at a shrine. After several years of searching for a way to go back to normal, they find themselves increasingly aware of each other as their physical sex...

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

Included one-shot: Yuri to Pocha to Wakarebanashi to, Sorekara

title: The Reborn Ranker Chronicles
synopsis:
Legendary SSS-rank hunter Kang Taeha finally met his end. But just as he prepares to enter eternal sleep, he awakens once more in... imperial China?! Now, he must live as Liu Xinyun, the delinquent heir to a powerful company. All he wants to do is put his hunting days behind him, but in order to survive his new power-hungry relatives, Xinyun must hone his skills again, starting from level one. Can his own unique blend of necromancy and martial arts take him from useless bum to ultimate boss?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Mythic Item Obtained
synopsis:
In a world where technology and magic are almost indistinguishable from one another, monsters and creatures of myth and legend reign terror upon mankind. In humanity's darkest moment, individuals with special god-like powers emerge to save the day. They are—the Awakened. Meet Jaehyeon, a feeble Awakened human Raider, who struggles to make ends meet until one day a series of confounding events allow him to claim a powerful item that will change the course of history forever...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Michizure Encore
synopsis:
"Pamper me! Right! Now!" On his way home from work, Tatemaru comes across his high school senpai, Yukihito Miyama. He's supposed to be this super perfect and talented person, but he's here in his house, lazing around, acting selfish. Seeing Miyama reveal a weaker side of himself to him, Tatemaru can't bring himself to kick Miyama out. Thus begins their domestic life together.

(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)

title: Efforts Never Betray
synopsis:
Jae-kyung, who grew up under a perfectionist father, must keep first place in the entire school.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: So You're Raising a Warrior
synopsis:
All Ell wants is for a warrior to come along and kill him so he can finally achieve a comfortable life after death. Just when it looks like he might get his wish, he accidentally kills the warrior who came to end his life. But Ell soon comes up with a different plan: if there are no warriors to kill him, he can raise one himself! So Ell the dragon, Lafi the magician, and Dino the baby warrior become an unconventional family. However, Ell soon discovers it's harder than he thought to teach a baby combat moves!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The iDOLM@STER Million Live!: Theater Days - Lively Flowers
title_japanese: THE IDOLM@STER MILLION LIVE! THEATER DAYS LIVELY FLOWERS
synopsis: Spin-off of The iDOLM@STER Million Live! series. Take a look into the daily lives of the idols of the 765Pro Theater!

title: Youhei to Shousetsuka
synopsis:
With the advent of the transcontinental railroad, smoke from steam locomotives veils the cities and mercenaries are a thing of the past. Sword, a mercenary, is down on his luck when he accepts a job from the bestselling lady novelist, Verderon. They set out on a journey to a dangerous, uncharted mountain... Only to be caught up in a conspiracy between church and state?! A tale of iron swords and typewriters!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Get Back
synopsis:
The accident that occurred seven years ago at the orphanage changed the lives of these two girls forever. In a world where talent and ability are everything, what will be their destiny now?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment, translated)

title: Warukute H na Ojisama wa, Are mo Yappari Sugoin desu!
title_english: The Wild Sex Drive of an Older Man
title_japanese: ワルくてHなオジサマは、アレもやっぱり凄いんです!
synopsis:
Meet Misaki, an office worker who had just been duped by her boyfriend for not being able to enjoy sex with him. She goes and seeks the advice of her silver fox drinking buddy Mr. Asami, who just happens to be a playboy. Wait... what do you mean you want to test me out yourself?! Oh but, maybe with Mr. Asami, who has plenty of experience it might be different...? And so, expert fingers reach for her tingling body... they find her sweet spot... How will this end for the most unlikely of couples...?

(Source: WWWave Corporation)

title: The Master's Appetite
synopsis:
Captain Kyle is a man of the people. He works hard to help merchants secure fair prices and, most importantly, he hates people who value money over mankind. People just like the Roches... So, when the Roche household starts searching for a new servant, Kyle sees an oh-so-appetizing opportunity: the chance to sneak behind enemy lines and prove that the Roches are rotten to the core. But in between inter-family feuding and painfully obvious political plots, Kyle unearths a bigger mystery: the eldest son refuses to eat. Determined to get to the bottom of the Roche family's decay, Kyle takes it upon himself to solve this particular conundrum. However, it soon turns out that food might not be the only appetite that begins to stir...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Between Husband and Wife
synopsis:
Goo Jun and Sung Woo are a gay couple that have been married for 1 year. They were looking forward to a happy future but there were many more responsibilities to being a married couple than they thought. One, a student and the other, an office worker, both with different routines. (They are not accepted as married men!) Will this marriage work out?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: To. Dominant
synopsis:
Sungjin Yoon is a man born into wealth who never experienced true love. It's only after he listens to Phillip Jung play the piano that his heart starts beating. But it turns out, Phillip is a deprived, twisted child in the body of a man! The two are at each other's throats as soon as they meet...! Will these two men be able to find true love? The tale of awkward emotions exploding behind a mask called perfection.

(Source: Copin Communications)

title: Memento Memori
synopsis:
Ichi's eyes show him things he doesn't want to see. For every person he looks at, he sees a clock counting down their remaining days of life. Knowing when everyone around him is going to die leaves him feeling disconnected from the world. But one day, he sees a girl at school with only 78 hours left to live, and this causes him to change his attitude. Maybe this time will be different—maybe this time he can save someone!

(Source: Mangamo)

title: Santiago: Rebellion Shimabara
title_japanese: サンチャゴ -レベリオン・シマバラ-

title: Forget My Husband, I'll Go Make Money
title_english: Forget My Husband, I'll Go Make Money
synopsis:
I became the wife of a man who had a mistress. Then, I must keep his innocence, right?

"Sleep on the floor."
"What?" Those eyes say I don't want to! No matter how hard the floor is, I have no choice.
"I'll just hold your hand and sleep. Trust me."

But why did the bed break on my first night with my husband? Aristine is a princess imprisoned all her life, not allowed to be in front of the emperor. But the fact is that she possesses of the "The King's Eye," allowing her to see both the future, the present and the past. She becomes the scapegoat for a political marriage, marrying a fearsome barbarian...

"The most precious things should be given to my wife."

The person who will soon become my husband seems very strange, but it is much more ordinary than I thought. However, he has a mistress. "I have to make money quickly." Will Aristine really achieve her dream of living freely on a pile of money? Or will she end up killing two birds with one stone?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp.,

title: Accidental Roommates
synopsis:
Taesoo was at a drinking party when he got a dare to kiss his crush Gyeol. Very embarrassing indeed! But Gyeol doesn't seem to remember...? Later, in the future, they bump into each other and end up becoming roommates! How will their college life go now?

(Source: MU)

title: A Typical Romance
synopsis:
Sung-jae is a diligent, clean-cut doctor who has lingering feelings for his first love from high school. Sung-Jae always finds Sa-in reappearing in his dreams just as his memories of him are about to fade. Then for the first time in 11 years, he shows up again in Sung-jae's life. However, Sa-in's playfulness makes it hard to tell if he also has genuine feelings for Sung-jae. Will this atypical encounter unfurl into romance?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Be My Guest
synopsis:
Ever wanted to give it all up and book a one-way ticket to paradise? Well, Yeonwoo did just that. Upon arriving in Okinawa on a sultry summer night, she's ready to kick back at her hotel with a cold beer and meet some cute guys. Ah, hang on—the hotel's burnt down. Unfazed, she decides to go for a sneaky skinny-dip and work out a plan of action! But mid-swim, she gets into trouble and is saved by a mysterious man in a helmet. She wakes up in Yururi Guesthouse, and soon decides to stay (helmet-man turning out to be a hottie may have played a part.) After all, when the scenery's as gorgeous as the staff and the guests are this, er, open-minded, who'd wanna leave?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Back in Time to You
synopsis:
Accidentally stumbling across a hidden attic after moving back to a house in his hometown, Yeoh-Ho finds a 10-year-old diary which makes him recall the memory he most wanted to erase: the day his friend Jae-Ha died!

(Source: MU)

title: Consumua and Sudutist!
synopsis:
Jung Woo spends most of his time nerding out, looking at various fanworks of his favorite characters. One day, he meets the artist of his favorite fanworks, Yoo Jooin, and the more he spends time with her, the more he falls for her. An artist and her number 1 fan: a match made in heaven?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Love for Sale
synopsis:
College student Lee Namwoo considers his life a bottomless pit. No matter how much he strains his body to work and earn money, it seems like he is always hindered by the lack of it, constantly wondering if he will even be able to afford a modest meal. In a random drunken stupor, he shares his financial woes with a complete stranger—Choe Si-eon—who happens to be a company CEO and willing to simply hand cash over to Namwoo.

All Si-eon wants in return is for Namwoo to date him. Although Namwoo's pride would never allow him to accept this, an accident ends in him losing his jobs and having to reevaluate. Si-eon is sweet and gentle, and he has an air of ease that only comes from never having to worry about bills and expenses. They may never see eye-to-eye regarding money, but through this transactional relationship, they may both realize that love does not carry a price tag.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: A Song of Blood and Fire
synopsis:
Circa, who had always failed in his summoning classes, accidentally summoned... Bisnuth, the king of fire! Bisnuth who was angry at being summoned suddenly, and the clueless Circa who got enamored with him... this is a couple's love story which is thicker than blood and hotter than fire.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Capture
synopsis:
To Gahee, sex is just a means to fulfill her artistic desires. She uses her camera to capture intimate moments of her sex partners, friends, and other couples. So when she meets Sungha, a cute phys ed major at her school, she wonders what he'd look like through her lens, what faces he'd make in bed. But she quickly learns Sungha is different from the guys she's used to "dating." Will he just be another photograph in her collection, or something more?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Base to Base
synopsis:
Sung Moon High fields one the country's top 5 high school baseball teams. On the field, players hit hard, run fast, and pull their weight to strive towards victory. Off the field, competition is fierce with students vying for position—and affection. Some might play for love of the game, others are just in it for love.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: 685 Days
synopsis:
"I'm sorry..." The second year of high school enters the new semester while Juyeon and Mihyang, who became awkward after a rejected confession, avoided each other due to misunderstandings and worries. The two meet again, and with a fluttering heart, a slightly different special story begins. From the thrilling confession to the day when the first snow falls for the two, 685 days.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Digitalis
synopsis:
Jinwoo has lived many different lives, but he's fallen for the same person over and over again. In this particular life, he is an office worker living in Korea and his lover has taken the form of Yoosung, a good friend of his little sister's. Will fate work its magic to bring them together?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Masters of Masturbation
synopsis:
Everyone knows someone like Yoon-gi. Tall, handsome, and six-pack abs hidden under a tailored suit. But behind his horn-rimmed glasses and cultured facade, Yoon-gi hides a secret passion for sex toys. And there's nothing he likes more than to wait until everyone leaves the office so he can strip down and put his favorite one to good use. Of course, like any good secret, it's more fun when you've got someone to share it with.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Steel Under Silk
synopsis:
Yeonjo used to have it all: a highly respected family, a kind brother, and a comfortable life. Now, with his father executed for high treason, his last kin dead, and damned to a lifetime of slavery, Yeonjo has nothing to lose. All that is left is vengeance, and his chance comes when the new governor assigned to the region is none other than Hee-ryang Kwon, the man who destroyed everything Yeonjo loved. Now, Yeonjo will do everything to get his revenge...even if it means getting in bed with his greatest enemy. Hiding a blade behind his beautiful smile, like silk hiding steel, Yeonjo waits for his moment to strike. But things are not going to be so easy...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Do You Still Like Me?
synopsis:
After a bad break up with his first love, Jinwoo falls into a creative slump with his ceramic art. During this slump he meets Colton, an alpha with whom he has a history. As things get steamy, it's clear that they both have an agenda. And soon enough, the situation starts to get a whole lot more complicated. It was bound to, especially when pheromones are involved...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Monster Musume no Oishasan 0
title_japanese: モンスター娘のお医者さん 0
synopsis:
Before Glenn Litbeit opened his own clinic, he was just a med student—in an academy full of monsters! Take a trip back through time in this prequel volume about young Glenn's trainee days at the lab run by his upperclassmen Sapphee and Lime. Dog-headed girls, hypersensitive marionettes, amorous silkworm-ladies and more—with such tantalizing adventures in consultation under his belt, it's no wonder Glenn became the doctoral sensation he did!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Accidentally in Love
synopsis:
"I would like to go back in time one year. I lost someone important to me then." That's what workaholic Eunkyeol Jung wishes one Christmas at a mysterious bar, as she laments being dumped by her boyfriend a year ago. And against all odds... her wish comes true! Unfortunately, she still gets dumped, but this time around she saves her best friend's brother Yiyool from a tragic death. He even becomes her coworker! With this time to do over and without the love life she hoped for, will Eunkyeol find unexpected happiness or another year of heartbreak?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Babel Nisei: The Returner
title_japanese: バビル2世 ザ・リターナー
synopsis:
After 40 years, "Babel II" is miraculously back! This time, the enemy is the world's most powerful military nation, the United States of America! A supernatural battle of modern warfare vs. Babel II breaks out...!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Hyung, You're My Idol
synopsis:
As the youngest member of hit idol group LoverU, Ryeojoon never suspected that a book gifted by a fan would be... riveting fan fiction starring himself and the other LoverU members! Drawn deeper into the mysterious world of fanfics, he just can't stop himself anymore... How long can this bookworm keep his not-so-innocent hobby a secret? Superstar turns superfan as Ryeojoon walks a dangerous line between idol and fanboy!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Secretary Undercover
synopsis:
Thanks to her foolish twin brother, Seowon Han has found herself in a pickle—she must pretend to be him for six whole months to save his job as the company VP's secretary. However, Seowon's boss immediately senses that something's not right. To make matters worse, why is the vice president's biggest rival trying to get to know her? All she wants is to go on a nice vacation... Can Seowon prove her innocence and keep her secret safe amidst all this office drama?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Jashin Sensen Restructuring Boy
title_japanese: 邪神戦線リストラ・ボーイ
synopsis:
In order to repair the synergy that was distorted by the evil deities in the ancient past, a young boy named Shuri has appeared in the present day. But the evil deities have set the "Groundskeepers" in place to stop him.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Call Sign
synopsis:
Taegun Kang was an eager but bumbling assistant firefighter. But after Sergeant Chaeyong Lee and fellow firefighter Sungkyu Park are killed in a huge fire while trying to save Taegun, he is no longer the man that he once was... especially now that he can see how flames move and smoke flows! Although unsure of how this ability was ignited, Taegun is ready to use it to save lives. Will Taegun be able to master his new power to rescue those that cry for help?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kohaku no Aki, 0-byou no Tabi
title_english: An Autumn in Amber, a Zero-Second Journey
synopsis:
Socially awkward loner Kayato has an intense fear of being touched and finds making friends extremely difficult. When he and his high school classmates visit Hakodate for a field trip, he suffers through some attempts to engage with the others, until...

Time stops for the entire world, but not for him.

All the hustle and bustle of the city fades into an eerie veil of silence, leaving him the only soul left in motion–until he finds another in Akira, a sharp-tongued local delinquent. Though she's his total opposite, she begrudgingly agrees to help him solve the mystery. Their only lead is something Kayato's uncle said just before he died about a "world plucked out of time," as if preserved in amber. Hoping to find a clue among his late uncle's possessions in Tokyo, the two teens must travel through the frozen world.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Conveni Yakin no Akuma-chan
title_english: Workin' the Night Shift at Akumart
title_japanese: コンビニ夜勤のあくまちゃん
synopsis:
In Minami, Osaka, there's a convenience store that has some seriously strange customers coming through the late shift. But the customers aren't the only ones out of place here—the late-night shift is full of weirdos! And for the arrogant demon Aruru, she's responsible for keeping up with every oddity that walks through the door. It may be a pain, but she's determined to do her best!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Honey x Bullet
synopsis:
This is the story of Motoko and her younger brother Satoru who have come to America to live with their grandfather after their parents' deaths. When they siblings run away from home and get lost in the desert, they stumble upon a once-in-ten-years Native American festival.

During a puppet show, the chieftain-puppet announces that only upon this rare occasion the Great Spirit will send his thunderbirds to grant peoples' wishes. Motoko prays to "go back in time" to the days when her parents were alive. Suddenly Motoko and Satoru are transported back in time—to the late 1800s, the time of the cowboys! There they meet up with the handsome bandit, Vincent, and the dashing but devious "gentleman," Heath, and their adventures in the Wild Wild West begin!

(Source: MU)

title: Saikyou Onna Shishou-tachi ga Ikusei Houshin wo Megutte Shuraba
title_english: Training Regimes of the World's Strongest Women
title_japanese: 最強女師匠たちが育成方針を巡って修羅場
synopsis:
For the three strongest adventurers in the world, finding a man strong enough to be with them is a herculean task. He simply doesn't exist. With that in mind, they decide to take on a perfect novice—the level-zero, unremarkable Cross Alacart—and train him up to be their perfect match. Freshly expelled from Adventurers' school, Cross sets his eyes on redemption; training hard and learning to believe in himself along the way.

(Source: Comikey Media)

title: Showtime!
title_english: Even an Innocent TV Show Singer Needs Sex...
synopsis:
The story begins when Shouji Fujimoto, a widowed single father who aspires to be a picture book author, encounters Minami Takasaki, a singing idol on the children's educational show Oneesan to Utaou! (Let's Sing Along With Our Songstress!), outside work. As a television idol for children, Minami is lonely in her private life and is not allowed to fall in love. Any scandals are absolutely prohibited. Thus begins an adult love story with a songstress.

(Source: ANN, edited)

5. Seishun Triangle

8. Chikashitsu Paradise: Mixed

title: Nidome no Isekai, Shounen datta Kare wa Toshiue Kishi ni Nari Dekiai shitekuru
title_japanese: 二度目の異世界、少年だった彼は年上騎士になり溺愛してくる
synopsis:
"The boy I saved before becomes an older and a highly talented knight!" One day, Sara is transported to another world and saves a boy named Luke who was pursued and collapsed in the forest for some reason, and decided to live together with him. However, just as Luke is beginning to recover from his injuries, Sara is abruptly sent back to her own world. Three years later, Sarah returns to another world again and is reunited with 25-year-old Luke, the finest ice magician in the country and a knight who earned baronetcy for his achievements! He used to be 10 years younger than she, but now he's two years older and is now a romantic interest. "I'll reward you with my entire life," he says as he began to dote on Sara.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: How to Be the Chosen One
title_english: How to Be the Chosen One
synopsis:
Cho Sunwon finds his life boring and tedious. Sex is the only thing he isn't sick of, but it's getting a little too easy to talk any guy into bed. He wants a new life, a new world, and a new challenge...and he totally gets all of those when he's summoned into another world as the so-called god of Abroria! Awesome, right? Except, nobody seems to fall for his bedroom talk, and there's a sexy king hell-bent on exposing Sunwon as a fraud. Seducing the gorgeous men around him without blowing his cover is going to be quite the divine challenge. Can Cho Sunwon actually become the Chosen One?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Jack Be Invincible
synopsis:
After getting revenge on the Thulcaan Empire, Jack Valantier took his last breath. But just when he thinks it's all over, he finds himself transported back to when he was 14! From his negligent and wicked family to his loyal servant and caring sister, it's all just as he had remembered. But this time, Jack is armed to the teeth with decades of experience from his previous life! He's ready to give them hell, and those that have wronged him will pay dearly. Because this time, he's invincible.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kaoru Watashi ni Kiss wo Shite.
title_japanese: 香るわたしにキスをして。
synopsis:
The manga centers on a girl who has a secret crush on her upperclassman, who one day tells her that she smells nice. She later finds out that her upperclassman is training to be a perfumer, and their relationship becomes closer and more dangerous.

(Source: ANN)

title: 100-nichigo ni Suterareru Papakatsu JC
synopsis:
1-5. 100-nichigo ni Suterareru Papakatsu JC

title: Haru no Higurashi
synopsis:
"If you don't like it, you can leave." Tsukasa starts living alone in a new place after her grandmother is hospitalized. When she is lost in an unfamiliar place, a man with red hair and pierced ears suddenly approaches her...!? This new life of expectation and anxiety was not supposed to be like this...!?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Sonna Koto Yori Imasugu Asobo!
title_japanese: そんなことより今すぐあそぼ!
synopsis:
Suzu has passed the high school entrance exam by intuition and, as expected, she can't keep up with her subjects at all. Enters Jin, a super genius foreigner student, to help her!

(Source: MU)

title: Yatto Kimi to Meguri Aetanda
title_japanese: やっと君とめぐり逢えたんだ
synopsis: A love story between two high-schoolers and their cute height difference.

title: Aka no Tachi
synopsis:
The manga centers on Akane, a girl who was unbeatable at kendo. She wanted nothing more than to fight her friend and rival Taki in an official match, and she finally got her wish in her last elementary school match, when they crossed swords for the first time. All that time, Akane thought she and Taki were even, but was surprised and disappointed when his skill surpassed hers. Bitter but unwilling to give up, Akane seeks to train even more and surpass Taki. But her unyielding spirit attracts another boy.

(Source: ANN)

title: Koi Koi Koi
synopsis: This is a romantic comedy about Sakura, a girl who gives her all for love, and Matsuyuki, a boy who absolutely hates romance.

title: Otome Game ni Tensei shita kedo Kinniku de Kaiketsu shimasu
title_japanese: 乙女ゲーに転生したけど筋肉で解決します

title: Sahara no Sekiganrou
synopsis:
In a desert kingdom, childhood friends Loki, Tol, and Ingle care for each other as if they were family. However, Byaku, who's in love with Ingle, can't stand how close they are. In an effort to help him get with Ingle, Byaku's men ask Ingle to guard Byaku against a made-up stalker. However, Byaku and Ingle end up teaming up when someone from Ingle's dark past rears their ugly head again! This is the story of a wolf inexperienced in love and a snake hopelessly in love with him.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Burberry Blue Period
synopsis:
Channeling the attitude of the Lola bag, Yamaguchi's one-off tale continues to be shaped by the values of the Blue Period series and depicts an emotional journey in which Yatora and Ryuuji meet with and become inspired by a new character, Lola.

(Source: row.burberry.com)

title: Akuma ga Kitarite Kimi ni Muchuu
title_japanese: アクマが来りて君に夢中
synopsis:
Corporate slave Yuuto, under the influence of drunkenness, summoned the demon Morax. He made a contract with him where, in return of granting a single wish, Morax would receive his soul. Yuuto had used his wish to "become happy," and so began his comfortable life of ordering around a demon. However, Morax is the type of demon that feeds off of human bodily fluids and vitality. Because of that, Yuuto ends up having sex with him! They continue this strange cohabitation with a demon...?!

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

title: Perennial
synopsis:
Matsuri is a girl who continues to kill others by impulse while her father who is the mayor continues to cover her crimes. Momose is the detective that Matsuri has fallen in love with as well as the son of the man she has killed. Momose does not know this and has already overcome many of the traps she has set for him while he tries to uncover the culprit. In the end, will he be able to reach the truth?

(Source: MU)

title: 49 Days
synopsis:
After coming back from work, Haejoon finds a random man in his empty studio. Not only that, the man seems to be able to walk through walls and disappear from sight. Haejoon is sure that he must've been dreaming, only to find the same man in his room the very next day.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Gensui Koutei no Okiniiri: Botsuraku Reijou wa Kakoware Dekiai ni Honrou saretemasu
title_japanese: 元帥皇帝のお気に入り～没落令嬢は囲われ溺愛に翻弄されてます
synopsis:
One day, Roseline, the daughter of an indebted lord, helps an injured knight named Clemens. Although he does not reveal his identity and seems to be involved in the war for the throne, Roseline quickly falls in love. After a turn of events, he unbelievably becomes the new Emperor! As soon as he conquered the capital, he came and marries Roseline. They spend many nights together, teaching each other pleasures with their bodies. However, no matter how much love they have for each other, being the daughter of a dishonored noble could become an obstacle in becoming an Empress...

(Source: Harper Collins Japan, translated)

title: Pop Life
synopsis:
Sakura and Akemi are two single mothers in their forties who decided to start living together in order to help each other raise their children. Take a deep dive into their everyday lives and find out what it's like to live a humble, yet peaceful life as a single parent in Japan.

(Source: Star Fruit Books)

title: Pheromone Phobia
synopsis:
Jeong-oh is a beta who lives with his alpha friend, Yeong-won. They've maintained a close friendship for years now, and everything seemed fine...until Ha-yeon, the newly hired alpha at Jeong-oh's office, brings a crucial fact to Jeong-oh's attention: Yeong-won has been secretly showering Jeong-oh with his pheromones to keep other alphas and omegas away. As the trust in their friendship cracks and reveals hidden depths underneath, Jeong-oh must navigate his rapidly changing relationship with Yeong-won—which is going to be infinitely harder with Ha-yeon entering the picture.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Tyrant's Comfort Doll
synopsis:
Legend has it that a man with black hair and red eyes will bring ruin to Den Helder's royal family. Because he was born with these features, Rayton is shunned by the palace as "the cursed one." When the vengeful prince stages a bloody coup detat years later, the powerless youngest princess, Setz, also dies by his sword. Little does Setz know that she's about to wake up in her body five years in the past—but now that she has, it's her chance to get on Rayton's good side and turn her fate around. Cracking the prince's cold exterior is a challenge, but once she does, there seems to be no going back! As Rayton grows more and more attached to her, Setz is pulled deeper into the midst of the dark conspiracies brewing around the palace. Has the princess truly escaped death, or is she in more danger than ever before?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Legend of an Asura: The Poison Dragon
title_english: Legend of an Asura: The Poison Dragon
synopsis:
The mighty Medicine Faction has fallen to the evil hands of the Venom Clan. As they travel across the land, taking out each clan under the faction, Zhen Ziqiang becomes a test subject for the Elder of the Venom Clan. After being injected with various poisons, Ziqiang rises from the depths of hell as an Asura. Full of anger, he escapes and begins to plan his revenge as the sole survivor of his faction. Now, his goal is to destroy the entire Poison Faction and give them a taste of their own venom.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Keep a Dog
synopsis:
Ryu Jiwoo wakes up to a nightmare: blindfolded and leashed, he awakes in the basement of a madman. In order to see the one he loves again, he will have to bend to his master's will, forgoing his sense of decency for the chance to escape and see the sunlight once more...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Dorei wo Choukyou shite Harem Tsukuru
title_english: Train Slaves and Create a Harem
title_japanese: 奴隷を調教してハーレム作る
synopsis:
I bought three slave girls, to mold them into women to my liking. As their master, I bathed them, fed them delicious food until they were stuffed, and prepared clean beds for them. I repeat: all to mold them into the kind of women I love!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Osananajimi ga Kyouteki desu.
synopsis:
After entering high school, Makoto finds herself becoming classmates with her childhood friend, Tsukasa. But just when she started being happy from being able to talk more with Tsukasa, she is now being led around by his casual words and actions! "Hey... was that intentional? Is this love?!"

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Yamoo to Oyama
synopsis:
After losing his wife and child, Kouichi runs a cafe by himself. One day, he meets a mysterious and beautiful boy who has run away from home. His true identity is Ennosuke Kitagawa, a leading male player of female roles, who has absconded from the world of popular theater. Ennosuke proposes that he live and work at Koichi's cafe for the time being... Kouichi, who missed his chance as a father, and Ennosuke, a star female impersonator who is hiding from the world, begin living together...?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Sharaku Shinjuu: Shoujo no Shunga wa Edo ni Saku
title_english: Syaraku Shinjyu: Her Shunga Blooms in Edo
title_japanese: 写楽心中 少女の春画は江戸に咲く

title: Koisuru Butsuzou
synopsis:
Two childhood friends—the shy and socially awkward Muga, and his polar opposite, the popular Reo—have both devoted themselves to carving statues of Buddha ever since they were children. Muga, who was told he's been curbing his own abilities in order to match Reo, is now gradually coming into his true talent and realizing the joy of carving. On the other hand, Reo gets impatient with the change in Muga.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Motokare ga Seiyuu ni Natte Arawareta!
title_japanese: 元カレが声優になって現れた！

title: Kono Koi wa Fusei Login nanode!
title_japanese: この恋は不正ログインなので!
synopsis:
An inevitable and sudden romance between the son of a wealthy IT employee trying to buy a marriage agency and the genius hacker girl JK, who finds out that this guy is apparently in love with her.

(Source: MU)

Volume 1: Danshi Koukousei to Neko, Torokeru Chocolate ni Amai Kiss: Tsubasa & Chihiro no Baai
Volume 2: Honjitsu Couple Hajimemashita, Torokeru Chocolate ni Amai Kiss: Shiro & Kuro no Baai
Volume 3: Suki toka Ienai!
Volume 4: Senpai Zurui desu

title: Oni no Shokuji wa Mendokusai
title_english: Demon's Meal Is Such a Bother.
title_japanese: 鬼の食事はめんどくさい
synopsis:
Kyou, a young man who lost his family and was living alone, ran into a man collapsed in front of his house. Thinking "It'd be troublesome if he dies here," Kyou let the man rest in house, but as soon as he came to, that man urged Kyou "Let me eat you!!"...?!

Turned out that man, Ren, is a demon!!! If he doesn't consume "human's energy" regularly, he'll die. He said, "The energy generated when making love is the most delicious" and invited Kyou to have sex, but was flatly refused! Kyou wanted to drive Ren out soon, but he seldom had contact with other people so he ended up letting Ren stay for a while. He thought Ren would be a troublesome existence, but he has been living alone for so long that spending lively days with Ren made his feelings for him start to grow, and Ren's existence became bigger and bigger. However, Kyou had a reason to not give Ren the "delicious energy"...

title: Makoto no Momoka
synopsis:
It has been a year since Momoka opened her bar. Although her business prospers, she shares a secret with her regular customer Makoto. Feeling insecure about her own name, Momoka uses Makoto's name for work, while Makoto utilizes Momoka's feminine name to seduce any men who come in for drinks. As they continue to interact using the other's name, Momoka starts to fall in love with Makoto! However, knowing Makoto's unfaithful nature, Momoka wonders if their relationship will ever deepen.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Full Volume
synopsis:
Dowon has a problem. His neighbor, Beom, seems awfully rude, but he's infuriatingly gorgeous. And the completely ridiculous cherry on top? Beom turns out to be Dowon's all-time favorite camboy, which only adds to the (sexual) frustration. Beom is a metaphorical pain in Dowon's ass, and Dowon would like to return the favor physically, thank you very much. So, Dowon has a problem—in his pants. The question is, how is he going to solve it? You'll find out the answer if you crank the volume up, and watch very, very closely...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: I'm Deleting Them From My Life
title_english: I'm Deleting Them From My Life
synopsis:
Antonia Serhii lost her voice after her parents' death. Left with the Serhii countship as a defenseless young child, she endured cruel manipulation and abuse from her covetous uncle, his staff, and later, her violent husband. But when Antonia gets a chance to redo her childhood, she'll stop at nothing to wreak vengeance upon her abusers! Armed with her memories and her new cunning nature, she swears to delete them from her life, one by one. But will Antonia succeed, or will her dismal past repeat itself?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Almark
synopsis:
As war in the north comes to an end, Almark, the son of mercenaries, finds himself at a crossroads. When he was a child, a foreigner told him that he had the potential to wield magic. Now he sets out to fulfill his father's wish for him to go to the peaceful land of the south to become a sorcerer. After a long journey to the institute of magic, he discovers that life there is entirely different from how he has lived so far.

The people in the south view the warlike northerners as savage barbarians. And at the institute there is an invisible divide between the nobility and commoners. While hiding his mercenary lineage and with help from his friends, Almark takes steps toward becoming a true sorcerer. And he might just make some changes to the institute in the process!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Yu☆Gi☆Oh! OCG Stories
synopsis: An anthology series that delves into the backstory of cards in the Yu-Gi-Oh! card game. The first story focuses on Raye and the Sky Striker archetype, the second one on Crowley and the Magistus archetype.

title: Lethal Romance
synopsis:
Yubi leads the action-packed life of a legendary martial artist on the hunt for her father's killer. Shinwoo is the aloof teen heartthrob with a heart of gold who's searching for his leading lady. As heroes of their own respective genres, their destinies are seemingly set in stone. But when their worlds collide in a miraculous twist of fate, the two team up to stray from the paths originally laid out for them. Now, they'll have to mix tropes of both the action and romance genres to battle assassins, terminal illnesses, and unnecessary love triangles. As they enter each other's worlds and come to understand the struggles of one another, will these lost protagonists be able to overcome the odds and make it to their happily ever after?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Call Me the Devil
synopsis:
Like other devils of his kind, Hyeonshin has adapted to the modern world to consume the Deadly Sin, Pride. Working as a plastic surgeon means there's always more than enough ego around him to feed off of. There's just one small problem: because of past trauma, he has an overwhelming repulsion toward blood! Luckily, a solution appears in the form of a plucky human named Ina, whose eyes seem to have the mysterious effect of alleviating this condition. Knowing that she's desperate to book a surgery at his busy clinic, Hyeonshin agrees to operate on her if she helps him with his "blood tolerance experiments." But due to their clashing personalities and constant interruptions from his devil coworkers, Hyeonshin's recovery seems far away. Will the devil and human both be able to attain what they truly desire?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: You're Perfect for Me
synopsis:
To make sure her webtoon is perfect, author Mireu Baek starts working as a maid at the Sophist Hotel to help inspire her story, but ends up in trouble that could make her lose her job. Thankfully, the good-looking and wealthy hotel president Hyuk Kang is there to save her, but there's a catch—she must agree to a contractual relationship to help get his marriage-crazed mother off his back. But even though the relationship is fake, Hyuk slowly finds that his feelings for Mireu might be real.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Ikenai Hinata-kun
synopsis:
Hinata Koga, a university student working part-time at a karaoke place, is put in charge of high schooler and clubber Kai Kimura's training. As they're cleaning up one the karaoke rooms, Kai suddenly asks him, "You're gay, right?" Despite realizing that Kai couldn't possibly know of his orientation, Hinata ends up agreeing to a date so that Kai won't spread the word. Right afterwards, Kai makes a move on him, but then he suddenly adds the strange condition "not to fake pleasure"...!!??

(Source: Renta!)

title: Onna 59-sai: Uretari Karetari Koishitari
title_japanese: オンナ59歳 熟れたり枯れたり恋したり
synopsis: A romance manga about a 59-year-old woman experiencing a new love.

title: Kimi no Yokogao wo Miteita
title_english: I See Your Face, Turned Away
title_japanese: きみの横顔を見ていた
synopsis:
Hikari's your typical freshmen in high school who's been recently daydreaming about Mari's, her shy best friend, love story. She decides to ship Mari with Ootani-kun, their classmate, after finding out about his crush on Mari when his friend, Asagiri-kun, tried getting the two to talk. The main character is Mari, the leading man is Ootani, and Hikari is the typical best friend in the story. Not bad... right? A youthful story between four kids going through unrequited love.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Shinjuku 69 Heaven
synopsis:
"I should have said it properly, that I love you." Keita Kutani, a reporter for the sex industry, chooses the popular gay sex worker Hiromu for a one-night stand. Kutani can't forget his encounter with Hiromu, so when the two end up in a temporary room-share, he is shocked by Hiromu's dismissive behavior towards him. Hiromu only opens up to Kutani when he pays for it, but Kutani is determined to get through to Hiromu, who pretends to be strong and never shows his true feelings... A romance between a guarded sex worker and his earnest roommate!

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Existence
synopsis:
Lee Jain has existed on Earth for 3.5 billion years, dying and being reborn as countless animal species. Now in his final life, he is reborn in South Korea as a human, his most hated species. Having inherited all the animal superpowers from his past lives, Jain is determined to survive and wipe out humanity. But when a sudden car accident erases his memory, Jain crosses paths with new beings that force the question: is humanity worth saving, or is it bound for extinction?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Heishi to Burikiya
synopsis:
Is a person still a person even if they've been replaced?

A whitesmith in a certain small village has been making artificial metal bodies for the village's soldiers, and allowing them to keep on living... The whitesmith has also been replacing the body parts of a young female soldier with artificial ones. But each time the whitesmith replaces a body part, it feels as though something is lost, and she becomes less and less human. Can the young woman and the whitesmith manage to hold on to their humanity, and continue living in this cruel world that's so repulsive that it's beautiful?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: Mugen no Ou
title_japanese: ジョジョの奇妙な冒険 無限の王
synopsis:
Set between Battle Tendency and Stardust Crusaders in 1973, a  research group from the Speedwagon Foundation is dispatched to Antigua, Guatemala under Lisa Lisa's orders to investigate the identity of a serial killer with an unknown power.

(Source: JoJo Wiki)

title: Rasud
synopsis:
A world where 11 Kings with absolute reign live protected by knights. Apprentice knight Hinta, together with his partner Kanut, venture on a journey to become appointed as formal knights. An action-packed fantasy story of two boys as they fight to become real knights!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Troll Trap
synopsis:
Have you ever noticed that someone you knew is no longer themselves? The subtle changes they show that indicate that they are no longer...human? Join hunter Ha-Te and the part-timer hunter Ji-Hyun on their adventure of hunting trolls to save the humanity!

(Source: MU)

title: Lover Boy
synopsis:
For Eunho Jung, there has always been one constant in life—his feelings for the boy next door, Jaeha Yoo. From a proposal at the age of three to a confession in his teenage years, the torch Eunho carries for the older man has never gone out...not even when Jaeha got married to a woman. With Eunho now in college, a chance meeting leads the two to reconnect, and Eunho will do everything in his power to make the recent divorcee his lover. There's just a small hiccup—Jaeha has only ever seen him as a cute and annoying kid...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Hyakuemu.
synopsis:
Togashi is born to run. As a kid, he is naturally gifted and wins every 100-meter race without effort. But in sixth grade, he meets Komiya, a transfer student who is full of determination but lacks technique. In teaching him, Togashi gives Komiya a new purpose: to win no matter what. Years pass by, Togashi and Komiya meet again as rivals on the track and reveal their true selves.

(Source: Annecy Festival)

Included one-shots:
Volume 4: Kasaku, Ope

title: Chaos Game
synopsis:
Ran Suzuki, a self-righteous journalist, receives a tip about a politician who has connections to the underworld. But her knowledge is exposed, and now her life is in danger... However, "something" even more dangerous than the underworld is lurking out there.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Hellhound
synopsis:
The manga centers on Shou, a young man who becomes a mercenary for the sake of his family. When he meets a "demon" on the battlefield, the powder keg explodes on a grand battle.

(Source: ANN)

Usotsuki wa Jigoku no Hajimari

title_japanese: 嘘つきは地獄の始まり

title_japanese: ハイスクールランウェイ

title: Dankira!!! Adrenaline Burst
title_japanese: ダンキラ!!! アドレナリンバースト
synopsis: "Dankira," a dance battle where teams of three compete to be the best. This story follows young men who strive to be at the top.

title: Ojou, Omezame no Jikan desu
title_english: Lady, It's Time to Wake Up
title_japanese: お嬢、お目覚めの時間です

title: Yama Koi: Yama de Koi wa Umareru ka
title_japanese: 山恋～山で恋は生まれるか～

title: Nanahoshi Toriko Maker
synopsis: A narcissistic girl meets a boy with brainwashing powers.

title: Hatoko-san wa Tokidoki Mahou Shoujo
title_english: Hatoko Rarely Acts as a Magical Girl
title_japanese: 鳩子さんは時々魔法少女
synopsis: Hatoko-san wa Tokidoki Mahou Shoujo is about an office lady who transforms into a magical girl to fight aliens.

title: Kono Koe wa Itsuka no Owakare
title_japanese: この声はいつかのお別れ

title: Watashi no Astilbe
synopsis:
Aoi Nagawa has always struggled with relationships in general, let alone getting a boyfriend. All her life, she has tried desperately to understand what it means to fall in love, to no avail. Fearing that she is just weird, Aoi lives with these inadequacies until she has a chance encounter with a perceptive woman named Kanade. As soon as Aoi confides in Kanade, she is offered an explanation: Aoi could be an aromantic asexual—a person who does not experience romantic or sexual attraction to anyone.

Though initially hesitant to accept that identity, Aoi feels a weight being lifted off her chest when she learns that such a thing exists and that she is not alone. Aoi's life brightens up as she lets go of her obsession with the significance of love and embraces life fully. But just as acceptance settles in, a friendship with one of her coworkers begins to blossom into something more, forcing Aoi to confront complicated feelings once again.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Yukionna wa Tsumetaku Saretai
title_japanese: 雪女は冷たくされたい

title: Jiryoku de Omou Kimi no Koto
Shindai Kyuusha
synopsis:
A sleeper train headed for Violet Spring City. Davy, a young boy traveling with his parents, encounters a group of boys in strange uniforms, all of whom have wounds all over their bodies. They are all out of breath, and Davy is entrusted with a single "communication tube." This encounter changes Davy's fate and the boys' future.

(Source: Japan Book Bank)

title: Youhei to Shousetsuka
synopsis:
"You know what, you are more of an unpleasant fellow than I imagined."

"Your opinion that comes from your poor imagination lacks any cogency in any standard."

The smoke from the steam engine covers the city in 1873. A request from a certain novelist happens to reach a mercenary who has lost his place of employment. It is an escort request to "the mountain that was not recorded on the map" in order to collect information. The mercenary who has to protect his belly with his back and the novelist who has no choice but to hire him after the process of elimination. The journey of the two people, who are constantly swearing at each other, eventually gets caught up in a plot involving the nation... The era of rapid economic growth when the transcontinental railroads were completed, but the era of twilight when the illuminations from electricity were not yet born. A story about a world that "somehow" feels like 19th century America.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Idol x Idol Story!
synopsis:
Meet Mimi, a college grad working part-time at a convenience store. Once an aspiring idol, she abandoned her dream when her group failed to make it big. Enter Ibuki, a rising star inspired by Mimi's past. Their unexpected encounters reignite Mimi's passion for the spotlight. Together, they decide to audition for a high-stakes idol competition show. Can they achieve their dreams and forge an unbreakable bond, or will the intense rivalry tear them apart?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Genkai OL-san wa Akuyaku Reijou-sama ni Tsukaetai
title_english: The Fed-Up Office Lady Wants to Serve the Villainess
title_japanese: 限界OLさんは悪役令嬢さまに仕えたい
synopsis:
Midori Natori has been giving it all at her hum-drum office job for three years now, only to have the rug pulled out from under her when she's suddenly laid off. But just as she's feeling lost and adrift, she is summoned to the world of the visual novel she's currently playing, Fairy Tale of Jewels. And the person who summoned her there? None other than the game's cruel villainess, Lapis Tenebrau, who's trying to take down the main cast of the game. Driven into a corner, Natori pretends she's psychic and uses her knowledge of the game to save Lapis from danger. Now Lapis has taken a shine to her, and is going to make Natori her private secretary?! Can Natori handle this new job, and her growing feelings for her villainess boss?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Gokusotsu Kraken
synopsis:
A young man, Kuma Shimizu, who is struggling to find employment, is suddenly transported to another world. He is taken to the women's prison, Sea Prison Castle, where he fuses with Kraken, the ruler of the sea, and gains great powers. Kraken entrusts Kuma with rescuing Princess Zeina, so he decides to sneak into Sea Prison Castle, but there he finds a group of female prisoners with unique personalities waiting for him...

(Source: Square Enix, translated)
