title: Zenith
synopsis:
I was a top agent who was abandoned by my superiors. I thought I would finally have a peaceful death, but I became the count's beloved daughter! Life is full of pain, and all that remains is betrayal. Filled with human distrust, she enters the battlefield of the social world. Girls with a fever of love and a mysterious death! I'm nervous about playing with fire and risking my life.

"If you want, I'll let you have it. So, what do you do with those hazy eyes?" Janice, who is troublesome all over the world, begins to meddle!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Doctor, Live Again
synopsis:
I had been abroad to do medical volunteer work, when I was swept up in a civil war. I was killed by a rebel soldier, while taking a bullet for a patient. But when I finally woke up, I had become a child?!? And in front of me stood a destroyed carriage and a group of oddly dressed people, who were unconscious!

"It's just like a Murim world."

As I hurry to perform first aid in an attempt to save even one person, I realize that this world is that of "The Supreme Demon King," a Murim novel I've enjoyed reading. After meeting the rescue team of the "Three Great Doctors," I found out that one of the person I saved was the protagonist of this novel, the future Demon King "Yeoharyun!"

"Hey, since I'm indebted to you for saving me, call me 'hyung.'"

For saving his life, I become sworn brothers with the future Demon King, and Baekrineuison, one of the most knowledgeable people around, recognized my potential and took me in as his disciple. This is the story of how I became the greatest physi

title: Debut or Die!
title_japanese: 데뷔 못 하면 죽는 병 걸림
synopsis:
Falling drunk after failing the civil service exam again, Ryu Gunwoo is shocked to wake up in a motel with an unfamiliar appearance. Somehow, not only is he inhabiting the body of Park Moondae—a 20-year-old orphan who took his own life—but he has also regressed three years into the past. Furthermore, he is unable to find information about his original body anywhere.

Recovering from his surprise, Moondae wonders if his present situation is similar to the action fantasy novels he knows of. To test his theory, he calls for a status window, which actually appears, albeit bearing the worst news possible: "Debut or Die." Unless he debuts as an idol within a year, he will perish.

To avoid his deadly fate, Moondae must secure a spot on the idol survival show Idol Inc. and improve his abilities to the maximum. Due to his past job as a paparazzo, at least Moondae has some insight into the idol experience. However, one wrong step could put his future career—and entire existence—in jeopardy.

[W

title: The Crimson Lady
synopsis:
A gray and sullen sky, the muddy ground squelching beneath her feet, and a faint drizzle of rain soaking her to the bone—after every regression, Karen Heyer recovers her memories of the past at this moment. While she has lived her life over and over, an untimely death is the only ending she can achieve. On her first iteration, she merely thought she had awakened in a novel, compelling her to follow the story to reach her happy end. But happiness is not written in her fate.

No matter what she does, whom she meets, or what she says, a brutal death awaits. On the 100th iteration, however, Karen decides to try something new—murder. Ninety-nine deaths would drive any normal person mad, and Karen has never considered herself anything but ordinary. Perhaps trying to stir the pot will help her reach a different ending entirely.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Joseon Fox Scandal
synopsis:
The traditional fairy tale we all know is actually a crime drama about the shapeshifters who fled from the sky! This story is about a fox sent down from the sky and Joseon's greatest gisaeng swindler, Choran. Many skillful storytellers turn the gears of fairy tales around to talk about the evil gods and goblins who torment humankind, but let us now start a true story of love that will make even the sky tear.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: The Girl That Got Stuck in the Wall
title_english: The Girl That Got Stuck in the Wall
synopsis:
Jieun is smart and witty, but she's got a penchant for running late. Luckily, she's got a few tricks up her sleeve, like a quick shortcut to help her get to work on time. Jisoo, on the other hand, is trying to find his first corporate job while nursing old wounds. Everyday's the same boring routine, to the library and back home where he lives alone. At least, until one day when he takes a wrong turn down an alley and discovers Jieun... stuck in a wall.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Hanaemi no Majo ni Tsugu
synopsis:
1. Hanaemi no Majo ni Tsugu
2. Wonderslam Hole
3. Airy Blue ni Nemure
4. Yukifuri no Ichibanboshi wa Kimi ni

title: The Skeleton Becomes a Cat Dad
title_english: The Skeleton Becomes a Cat Dad
synopsis:
Life becomes a nightmare for Skelly when the oddest cat they've ever seen arrives on their doorstep. It's definitely not the Persian cat they ordered... not only is it hairless, but it pees constantly and cries around the clock. As if the neighbors' complaints aren't enough trouble, the vet bills are sky high and nearly bankrupts the newly independent skeleton. But even a mutant cat deserves an owner—and so, Skelly struggles to fill the shoes of a cat dad with the help of an alcoholic succubus and a devil priest. Meanwhile, a mysterious demon notices their unique pet and wants to steal it for sinister reasons. Can Skelly protect their new cat from kidnappers and other threats within the Devildom, let alone handle living together with it?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Yumemiru Maid no Tea Time
title_japanese: 夢見るメイドのティータイム
synopsis:
In the spring of her second year of high school, Fuyuka Yukinoshita starts working part-time at a maid cafe. She dreams of becoming someone who can make people smile, like the manager she admired, but she is always getting flustered by her idiosyncratic coworkers!

It is the magic that makes you smile. A fluffy and sweet moment.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Metamorphosis Den
synopsis:
Included one-shot:
Volume 2: Shrinks Pan

title: Joshikousei Joreishi Akane!
title_japanese: 女子高生除霊師アカネ!
synopsis:
Akane Shinonome is a slightly shady but otherwise ordinary high school girl. However, everything changes when her father, who had disappeared with his mistress and their savings, leaves her to inherit his role as an exorcist to earn a living! Using dubious techniques passed down from her father, she spends her days exorcising spirits! Of course, she can't see spirits at all.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Kiss shitai, Ecchi shitai. Omowazu Osocchatta, 3-nenme no Natsu
title_english: Kiss You & Fuck You: I Find Myself Attacking Him on Our Third Summer Together
title_japanese: キスしたい、エッチしたい。～思わず襲っちゃった、3年めの夏
synopsis:
"I haven't had... enough." "...Ah! I said you can't...!" I've put up with waiting for three years... When our tongues are entangled and he caresses me, can I not stop any more...!?

(Source: WWWave Corporation)

title: Heiwa no Kuni no Shimazaki e
title_english: Shimazaki in the Land of Peace
synopsis:
After surviving a terrorist incident as a child, Shingo Shimazaki was forced to join the League for Economic Liberations' revolutionary army. Now, thirty years later, he's back in Japan and trying to assimilate to a normal life. His Japanese may be awkward, and his grasp of ordinary tasks a little weak, but he has all the combat and surveillance training of a green beret. There are many kindhearted souls who want to help him—and a few not so kind ones who will do anything to stop him.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: My F-Rank High School Life
synopsis:
Mankind discovered the essence of the human soul, Edeya, and were achieving materialization. Society was built around Edeya, which was invulnerable to conventional weapons. Humanity started to place all their focus into the combat power of Edeya. Jinsong Park, the main character, possessed an F-rank soul and F-rank combat power. After the introduction of a poor military program to his high school and the Edeya rank system, Park Jinsong became one of the weak, and suffered under his peers' contempt for 10 years...

However, in reality, the Edeya he had awakened was actually the S-rank "Absolute Killing Intent." Jinsong was greatly disturbed by the fact that the essence of his soul revolved around the thought of killing others, and continued to live his life while thinking of himself as a worthless F-rank. Will Jinsong, with a soul for killing, be able to get his killing intent under control and prove that there are no ranks to one's soul?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Lion wa Okiteteiru
title_japanese: ライオンは起きている
synopsis:
Set in the American television industry, this coming-of-age success story follows the exploits of Arney, a boy who struggles to become a famous producer like his father.

(Source: MU)

title: I: Hakoniwagurashi
title_japanese: I－アイ－ はこにわぐらし

title: Black Heart Star
title_japanese: ブラックハートスター
synopsis:
A dull high school girl becomes a sexy female boss for the "bad army"! A world with Magical Girl and Love Heart. The timid and plain girl Sora, too, is someone who adores Love Heart. "One day, I also want to be a Magical Girl... <3" One day, she gets scouted! "Huh? So fast?! Magic?" But to be a female boss for the opposite group, Black Star Army?! "No way, I won't do such things...!" Handsome guys all under her command, the talent hidden within the skies starts to blossom?!

(Source: MU)

title: Higashi no Mori no Majo no Niwa
title_english: Our Precious Witch Garden in the Easter Forest
synopsis: A heartwarming fantasy about a grumpy witch, the two children she has taken in to raise, and the three beasts that live with them.

title: The Villainess's Bestie
synopsis:
A commoner maid extra who, with her beautiful looks, is killed because of the evil empress's jealousy... Yes, I was reincarnated as THAT "Charlize." Fortunately, I am still only five years old! Until the beginning of the original story, I decided to avoid the emperor and empress, but... "Charlize, what about His Majesty the emperor?" "It's Ebiji." "Charlize, am I the best in the world?" That evil empress likes me so much...?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Taishou Renai Katsudou
synopsis:
Set in 1918, this manga is about an arranged marriage between two people with totally different backgrounds.

(Source: MU)

Included one-shot:
Volume 2: Sakura-san no Yasashii Coffee

title: Tenshi Kinryouku: Tokyo Chronos
title_japanese: 天使禁猟区－東京クロノス－
synopsis:
The story centers on Kanae Kuon, a junior high school student who was in Tokyo on the day white feathers fell. Kuon sometimes sees feathers on people's back, and sometimes sees the sky filled with black letters...

(Source: ANN)

title: Isekai Saikou no Kizoku, Harem wo Fuyasu hodo Tsuyokunaru
title_japanese: 異世界最高の貴族、ハーレムを増やすほど強くなる
serializations: Suiyoubi wa Mattari Dash X Comic
synopsis:
Yuuto is suddenly reincarnated into the other world in a smartphone game and becomes the third son of a noble family. "Skills" exist in that world, and Yuuto was reincarnated with "Noblesse Oblige." When Yuuto, who has become an adult, sleeps with a woman as a rite of passage, Noblesse Oblige is activated. It is a rare skill that lets him copy the skills of the women he sleeps with! Yuuto sleeps with women possessing skills one after another, becoming the strongest with the skills he acquires, and building a harem of women who fall in love with him. Furthermore, it was discovered that Noblesse Oblige can awaken skills and evolve skills, and the cheating keeps on coming! All the women and skills I want are mine! The strongest cheat harem begins here!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Akuyaku Reijou, 94-kaime no Tensei wa Heroine Rashii.: Character Guild no Haken Staff wa Tensei ga Oshigoto desu!
title_english: On Her 94th Reincarnation, This Villainess Became the Heroine!
title_japanese: 悪役令嬢、94回目の転生はヒロインらしい。 ～キャラギルドの派遣スタッフは転生がお仕事です！～
synopsis:
Madeline belongs to the Villainess Guild where she works as a temporary staff member. Her job is to reincarnate into novels or manga in order to liven up the story and for a total of 93 times, her occupation was villainess. With her 94th reincarnation, her goal was to be promoted to a permanent staff member. However, there already was a curly-haired villainess like her in the next place she was going to reincarnate to. By accident, Madeline was reincarnated as the heroine.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Bakashoujiki ga Taosenai!
synopsis:
Three words sealed his fate...

People pleaser Kakeru Senma's spent his whole life putting on a smile, and it's made his life easy. Everybody likes him. That is, until a total stranger, Makoto Takafuji, comes up to him and says, "I hate you." Swallowing his shock and anger, Kakeru vows to avoid the guy at all costs, but for some reason he keeps popping up everywhere!!

Just when he's wracking his brains for some solution to his predicament, Kakeru is captivated by the sight of Makoto sternly practicing Japanese archery. Maybe he's not such a bad guy after all... Then again, he's always stealing kisses and feeling him up without warning!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Tasogare City Graffiti
title_japanese: 黄昏シティ・グラフィティ
synopsis:
A comedy about the Tachibana triplets who live together.

Included one-shots:
Volume 3: Ao Neko ni Fanfare, Watashi no Otomodachi-hen
Volume 5: Neko mo Shakushi mo, Watashi no Suki na Mono

title: Isekaigaeri no Around 40 Ryman, 17-sai no Koro ni Modotte Musou suru
title_japanese: 異世界帰りのアラフォーリーマン、17歳の頃に戻って無双する

title: Wolfhound
synopsis:
Mura is the number one host in the business. His affections and time demand a high price. Miroku is a part-time employee who's completely devoted to him—maybe a little too devoted. It's starting to interfere with his work. When Mura goes to discipline his obsessive employee, he notices how Miroku's eyes light up with desire. These two might be in for some "obedience training" that they'll never forget!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Reality Quest
synopsis:
Dowan Ha is a bullied gamer, whose bullies force him to grind to obtain in-game items for them. After one such bully demands that Dowan obtain an impossibly rare item for him or be beaten in front of the prettiest girl in school, Dowan games day and night for a week until he drops dead from exhaustion. However, as soon as he dies, he respawns back in his classroom one week before his death. Everything is the same as it was before, except now he has all the skills he's acquired from the games he's played in real life! Will Dowan be able to use his newfound abilities and gamified existence to defeat his bullies?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Saye
synopsis:
Jiang Cheng, an accomplished student, was "exiled" to the steel mill where his biological father worked. This strange, foreign environment, coupled with his rather vulgar biological father, caused Jiang Cheng to feel quite depressed. That is, until one day, he met Gu Fei, the "Delinquent of the Steel Mill", by chance. Thus begins the story of Jiang Cheng and Gu Fei, a story of salvation and hope.

(Source: Kuaikan World, translated)

title: Marry My Husband
synopsis:
Dying from cancer and unhappy with how she has lived, 37-year-old Kang Jiwon catches her husband of 10 years—Park Minhwan—in bed with her best friend Jeong Sumin. In the ensuing confrontation, Minhwan becomes enraged and injures his wife, unremorseful even in her last moments as he allows her to bleed out. Feeling betrayed from the injustice she has endured for years, Jiwon is somehow reincarnated as her youthful 27-year-old self, a decade before her fateful death at the hand of her husband.

With feelings of resentment, vengeance, and rage, Jiwon uses the knowledge of her past life to set straight all the wrongs and misfortunes she suffered as a result of her cheating husband and fake best friend. She will stop at nothing to make their lives as miserable as possible. But between acts of revenge, there is the potential for Jiwon to meet a more worthy lover this time around.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Okuchi ga Ecchi na Jakuten Datte, Rival no Elite Douryou ni Barete Shimaimashita
title_japanese: おくちがエッチな弱点だって、ライバルのエリート同僚にバレてしまいました
synopsis:
Suzuka Takamine has worked at a major business consulting company for three years. At the office, she's called the unattainable "Flower on the Peak" because of her work performance and good looks. But she has a complex. Her mouth is overly sensitive. When her mouth is stimulated, her body reacts with a jolt and her eyes overflow with tears.

One day, the secret she's been hiding from everyone is discovered by her colleague; the company's ace, Kouma Zaizen. To get caught by her rival, of all people, could have been the end of her, but Takamine's reaction seems to match Zaizen's fetish to a T.

"What a sexy expression... So cute. I want to make you cry more."

He's a little sadistic and totally infatuated with her, complex and all.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Isekai Tenisha no My Pace Kouryakuki
title_english: Live Life My Own Way in the Transferred to Another World
title_japanese: 異世界転移者のマイペース攻略記
synopsis:
While immersed in a virtual reality MMORPG game, Yuuki was transported to another world where he adopts the name of his character Grosse Hendler, his goal being to make the most of his unique ability "Mail Order" to be a great trader in another world! All this while trying to enjoy a quiet life... will that be possible for him?

(Source: MU)

title: Ishibashi Boueitai (Kounin)
synopsis:
This is the much awaited continuation of the popular series Ishibashi Boueitai (Kojin)! Even after they've become lovers, you still won't be able to find a chink in the now official Ishibashi Defense Corps!

(Source: MU)

title: Konyaku Haki sareta Reijou wo Hirotta Ore ga, Ikenai Koto wo Oshiekomu: Oishii Mono wo Tabesasete Oshare wo Sasete, Sekaiichi Shiawase na Shoujo ni Produce!
title_english: I'm Giving the Disgraced Noble Lady I Rescued a Crash Course in Naughtiness: I'll Spoil Her with Delicacies and Style to Make Her the Happiest Woman in the World!
title_japanese: 婚約破棄された令嬢を拾った俺が、イケナイことを教え込む ～美味しいものを食べさせておしゃれをさせて、世界一幸せな少女にプロデュース!～
synopsis:
Betrayed by her betrothed and bullied by her family, a young noblewoman named Charlotte Evans flees her home and stumbles into the hands of Allen Crawford, a misanthropic wizard known as the Dark Lord who lives in a solitary mansion deep in the forest. When he hears the sad story of Charlotte's pitiful life, he discovers a new calling—giving her a crash course in all things naughty, from late-night feasts of cake and ramen to sleeping in till the afternoon, from dressing up in cute outfits to fun-filled days at the beach! Allen is determined to pamper Charlotte with every irresistible pleasure imaginable. Will he succeed in healing her emotional trauma and building up her confidence? And is there anything special between this odd couple? Here begins the tale of a wicked sorcerer who leads an innocent girl astray...down the path of pure self-indulgence!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Mangaban Saredo Itoshiki Otsuma-sama
title_japanese: 漫画版 されど愛しきお妻様
synopsis:
Saredo Itoshiki Otsuma-sama is an autobiographical story about Daisuke Suzuki, who worked as a reporter but had a stroke at age 41. The story follows his rehabilitation and recovery, and his wife, who supported him.

(Source: ANN, edited)

title: Douka Ore wo Houtteoite Kure: Nazeka Bocchi no Owatta Koukou Seikatsu wo Kanojo ga Kaeyou to Shitekuru
title_english: Let Me Be Single in Peace!
title_japanese: どうか俺を放っておいてくれ なぜかぼっちの終わった高校生活を彼女が変えようとしてくる
synopsis:
Love, friendship, and a glorious adolescence—that's what Hodoka Nanamura hoped for when he entered high school. But by his final year, he had none of it. Then, on the eve of graduation, he sacrifices himself to save his classmate, Sora Hanamitsuji, from on oncoming truck, ending his life... Or so it should have.

Instead, he and Hanamitsuji were both transported back in time to their first year of high school, just before the entrance ceremony. Though Nanamura resigned himself to reliving the same unremarkable, lonely high school years, Hanamitsuji swears that she'll drag him out of his loner lifestyle!

With a second chance at high school, Nanamura gets to experience the best (and worst) coming-of-age romcom of his life!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Foreigner on the Periphery
synopsis:
I don't want to work. Like at all. But I don't have a choice. On earth where Humans, Elves, Orcs, Trolls, Dragons, and Alien immigrants live, it is an endless repetition of incidents. This is the story of a man that's had to work in secrecy for 800 years because he'll die if he doesn't work.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: My Farm by the Palace
synopsis:
When Hazel Mayfield is sent to live with the Martins as a child, she falls in love with rural life and vows to have a farm of her own one day. Eleven years later, she receives an unexpected windfall as her grandfather hands her the deed to a plot of land in the middle of the capital. Ecstatic, Hazel sets out to realize her longtime dream of becoming a farmer. There's only one problem: Her new farm is right next to the imperial palace! And it seems the emperor himself has his eye on her land...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Genkai Bonnou Katsugeki Osamu
synopsis:
Vengeful spirit is a mass of emotions that clings to this world with a grudge. In the growing modern world, vengeful spirits with various "grudges" were born, and there were also exorcists who specialized in that particular field. The wild "shitty big emotion" that the exorcist Osamu faces is... a fangirl?! She loves manga and anime, and she calms raging spirits. A gag series featuring a contemporary exorcist!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Tensei Akuyaku Youjo wa Saikyou Papa no Manamusume ni Narimashita
title_english: The Reincarnated Little Villainess Becomes the Beloved Daughter of a Mean Daddy
title_japanese: 転生悪役幼女は最恐パパの愛娘になりました
synopsis:
After restoring her memories, Samara realizes she's been reincarnated as the villain in her favorite dating-sim game. She also remembers that every road this character takes leads to her death by the age of 16! To rewrite this tragic fate, Samara attempts to get in good with her father, the world's strongest mage. However, her usual selfish antics have made her father grow cold and distant from Samara...! Ever determined, Samara puts in work to win the love and affection of her otherwise cool and standoffish father! Let this grand adventure in reincarnation and strategic planning begin!

(Source: Starts Shuppan)

title: Size Matters
synopsis:
Mirim may be a bartender, but she doesn't really have the ear to listen to her customers' woes... and that's why she has Hyunmi (who she pays with free drinks). Hyunmi's a professional consultant by day, and a professional wingwoman by night. She may have heard and seen it all, but she's still on the hunt for her own young, handsome man that can keep her satisfied all night long. Best if he were unemployed, too, so she can call on him whenever she needs to. It's not too much to ask for, right?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Rose Without Thorns
synopsis:
It was not easy to be the son and successor of a major hotel company. After spending his life for 16 years abroad, Seungha Yoo came back to Korea to succeed as an executive of his family's hotel business. Seungha was an workaholic who was ignorant of love life, until he met Seyeon Han. Turns out, she is the concierge manager in the hotel owned by his family. The misunderstanding on their first meeting leads them to understanding each other. However, they live with a very different family background, which eventually became the wall they have to overcome to make their relationship works. Can they overcome it?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment, translated)

title: Breaking News
synopsis:
An ordinary college student, Ye-Seul Lee starts a part-time job at a broadcasting station cafe to meet Min-Jun Kim, the youngest main news announcer in South Korea, who is also known as a spy. Contrary to her expectations, Min Jun is a very cold person...

"Do you know how long I've liked you? Why are you being so cold towards me?"

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: You Are Extraordinary
synopsis:
Chaekyung Shin must accept the punishment of confessing to a senior on the new employee training night. The problem was, the manager she had to confess to was notoriously cold and not interested in women. After successfully confessing, Chaekyung was held back by her manager, Yunu Jung. The manager made an interesting offer, which was for Chaekyung to be his shield at the office. Chaekyung, who is only a new employee, can't just refuse. How will Chaekyung's life be at the office?

(Source: Kakao Webtoon Indonesia, translated)

title: Washi Jijii, Yowai Rokujuu ni Shite Tenpu no Sai ni Kizuku
title_english: I'm Old Man 60 Years Old and Notice the Natural Talent
title_japanese: わしジジイ、齢六十にして天賦の才に気付く

title: Biryuu Enshoutan: Jikokouteikan ga Gekihiku na Dragon-kyuu Bishoujo Maou wo, Yuusha ga Icha Love de Taijisuru Ohanashi
title_japanese: 美龍艶笑譚～自己肯定感が激低なドラゴン級美少女魔王を、勇者がイチャラブで退治するお話～

title: Pie Game
synopsis:
Seven participants, 24 hours, and individual pots of money. This is Pie Game, a reality TV show where participants' individual pots of money grow as time flows. And when blood flows, their time grows. Marooned on a specially designed seven-floor TV set with a set of clothes and daily rations, every other item they purchase reduces their time. How will the participants increase their time on the set and how much money will they manage to leave with?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Yuusha to Yobareta Ato ni: Soshite Musou Otoko wa Kazoku wo Tsukuru
title_japanese: 勇者と呼ばれた後に　―そして無双男は家族を創る―
synopsis:
In a world where humans and demons clash—the one who decimated the Demon Lord's army was a lone hero named Lloyd. Possessing power so immense that he was said by the Demon Lord to be near godlike, after the war, Lloyd was appointed by the king to be the lord of a remote territory and was sent far away. Furthermore, he was tasked with subduing the Emperor Dragon residing in that land, which he quickly defeated. However, the defeated dragon transformed into a beautiful woman and chose to become Lloyd's companion!? This is the story of a man, hailed as the strongest, yet unable to recognize his own worth, finding a "family."

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Kaibutsu Chuudoku
synopsis:
This is the Masked Ballroom: a place where people revert to beasts, let go of reason, and revel in freedom and anonymity. Here, with the help of a "monster supplement," anyone can transform into beasts and do as they please. It's the only "government-approved slum," where people can forget the suffocating atmosphere of the surveillance state. It's in this city where Reiji, a young vampire and a real monster, and his werewolf partner Tsuki take on the task of keeping the streets clean. They search for centaurs who have committed hit-and-runs and fight life-and-death battles against the urban legends that manifest. And a meeting with the "Medicine Witch" will change the fate of Reiji and his friends...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Ashita, Hadashi de Koi.
synopsis:
Having given up on both study and dreams, Meguri Sakamoto ended his lackluster high school life. But, on the day of the graduation ceremony, the disappearance of his ex-girlfriend and now famous musician Chika Nito, has been reported in the news?!

Starting with a time leap, this is a love story about redoing one's youth.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Mayonaka, Kare wa Betsu no Kao
Kami wa Saibu ni Yadoru no yo
Kin no Button Gin no Eri: Palace Meidi Sokubun
title_japanese: 金の釦 銀の襟 ―パレス・メイヂ側聞―

title: Kimi to Hasu no Niwa de
synopsis:
In postwar Japan, Tamao has lost the love of his life. Working as a male prostitute for a living, the money he earned went to the alcohol that he drank to make him forget the pain of loneliness. One day, Gorou, the younger brother and the spitting image of his past lover, showed up. "I came to see you," and was embraced with all of his might.

At first, Tamao simply saw the shadow of his old lover's face, But then unknowingly, he came to want to know more about Gorou himself. Having lost an irreplaceable person, this is the story of the love reborn between the two of them.

(Source: Kasakura Shuppansha, translated)

title: Henkyou no Renkinjutsushi: Imasara Yosan Zero no Shokuba ni Modoru toka Mou Muri
title_english: The Frontier Alchemist: I Can't Go Back to That Job After You Made My Budget Zero
title_japanese: 辺境の錬金術師 ～今更予算ゼロの職場に戻るとかもう無理～
synopsis:
Roost, an alchemist who specialized in basic research, found out that the guild's bureaucrats didn't understand his work and cut his budget to zero for the next fiscal year. Realizing that there was no future for him at the Alchemist Guild, he decided to resign. However, Roost was in fact the world's top alchemist, and the materials he produced were at an extremely high level that no one else can recreate. After Roost's resignation, the guild fell into turmoil, but it was too late.

Freed from the confines of his former workplace, Roost will begin a slow life on the frontier, developing new alchemy at his leisure!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Koudouryou no Seiza na Hibi
synopsis:
At Koudouryou Girls' Dormitory, students call each other by the names of the 12 zodiac signs. One day, a girl with a secret intention comes in and wishes to enter the dormitory, taking the name of Virgo.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Avengers Social Club
synopsis:
Three women from different walks of life come together for revenge.

(Source: Wikipedia)

title: Behind His Kind Mask
synopsis:
As the #1 stalker of Pope Ulysses, the kind male lead, Yoidel was to be executed for her crimes. Just minutes before her end, Yoidel escapes her cell to ask Ulysses for help, only to come across a bloody madman... who turns out to be the male lead himself! In a desperate attempt to survive, Yoidel binds herself to him in a magical contract, dooming the two to share their lives and deaths. Now stuck with a two-faced psycho, will Yoidel find a way to break their bond before it breaks her?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Hero's Savior
synopsis:
I remember the memory of my previous life when I was abused by my father for the experiment. Then I realized. According to my previous life, this is the world of fantasy fiction I've read. That she was born with a minor role and died before the novel even started. Ariadne thought calmly, "I am screwed."

She was also screwed on a global basis, this novel has a bad ending. The end of this 10-volume Munchkin (overpowered) fantasy novel is it was the failure of the protagonist and the destruction of the world.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Daifugou to Okizari no Hanayome
title_japanese: 大富豪と置き去りの花嫁
synopsis:
Daisy, a poor waitress, decided to marry multimillionaire Matteo after they met by chance. Matteo needed a wife in order to take over his grandfather's company and he assured her the marriage would be for two years only. However, three years have gone by now and Daisy is still married! Exasperated, she asks Matteo for a divorce. But she's shocked when he proposes that they make their relationship real. He's never so much as looked at her in the past three years, and now he wants a real marriage?

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Helmut

Helmut was a child who had been abandoned in the Demonic Beast Forest at birth. Raised by Demonic Beasts, the first human that he met was the Sword Saint Darien. Little did Helmut know that the chance encounter would soon shake the foundation of his fate...

"Grow stronger If you want to get out of here."

The boy who'd lived like a beast was thrown into the human world! He possessed overwhelming swordsmanship, outstanding looks and sharp intelligence, but there was one thing he lacked: humanity. I am no longer a prey. I am now a predator!

(Source: Yeonpil, translated)

title: Kirakira Boshi to Koi no Ballad

title: Hanabi wa Samenai Yume wo Miru
title_japanese: 花火は醒めない夢をみる
synopsis:
Olivia was betrayed by her fiancé, Luke, and publicly executed. But when she wakes up, she finds herself in a different world, as a high school girl named Hanabi Kaburagi! It seems that Hanabi has been bullied by everyone, and when she goes to school, she is targeted by her class. What's more, a classmate, Oshino, who looks exactly like Luke, appears there...?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

Volume 6: Hoshikage Hisoka ni Boku ni Furu

title_japanese: るるてる ルル魔法学校においでよ
synopsis: The manga follows 12-year-old Nedoko Nekomoto, who attends Ruru, a school of magic.

title: Himitsu no Hiroko-chan
title_japanese: ヒミツのヒロコちゃん
synopsis:
I've always loved you. That's why whether in sickness or in heath, I want to walk beside you...

I went to Hanafuu University, a different school than my best friend, Aiko. I'm sad to be separated from Aiko, but I thought I would be fine if I can be with my lover, Ritsu... but he's been busy with the opening of his second store, and we can hardly meet. I don't want to bother him, so I pretend to be mature and behave myself, but it seems like I've made a mistake...?!

(Source: MU)

title: My Sweet Dark Hero
synopsis:
Oyoung Ji is a survivor! Growing up as an orphan, life wasn't easy for her. To make matters worse, she narrowly escaped a brutal attack at her orphanage. The only reason Oyoung's life was spared was that she was saved by a mysterious man. Years later, she is barely scraping a living as a hospital custodian. So when she is offered a job as a live-in assistant for Logan Lee, one of the most prestigious (and handsome!) surgeons at the hospital, she gladly accepts! Little does she know... her new boss is her savior from the orphanage!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Houkago no Dungeon Diver: Nihon to Isekai wo Ikiki Dekiru You ni Natta Boku wa Level Up ni Isoshimimasu
title_japanese: 放課後の迷宮冒険者〈ダンジョン・ダイバー〉～日本と異世界を行き来できるようになった僕はレベルアップに勤しみます～
synopsis:
Why not unwind in another world once in a while? High schooler Kudo Akira happens upon the ability to travel between Japan and the fantastical world of Do-Melta. Not bound by any dire mission or duty, he leisurely enjoys exploring his way through the massive dungeon in the center of the world and all the trappings that come with it. The guild receptionist is trying to mooch off of him, his magic instructor has "rewards" for him, and he just might have some fun with a girl he saves...

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Houkago Strongberry
title_japanese: 放課後ストロングベリー

A modern Japanese teacher who finds herself in a gym and discovers her hidden potential in boxing.

(Source: MU)

Rikka, a dog groomer with a gift for taming wild pups, finds her life turned upside down when the Doberman she rescues one night suddenly turns into a hunky guy! This dog-man is on the prowl for a mate and chooses Rikka—and he's not holding back his horndog desire. Can Rikka resist his puppy eyes, or will she be caught in his leash of love?

(Soure: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title_japanese: イケメン騎士を拾ったんだがどうしたらいい? ～恋するMOON DOGスピンオフ～

title: Anime Seisakugaisha de BL shitemasu ga, Nani ka?
title_english: So What If I Work on Yaoi Content at an Anime Production Studio?
title_japanese: アニメ制作会社でBLしてますが、なにか?
synopsis:
Ryota Ukawa is a production manager at an anime production studio. He takes over on an episode after the previous manager up and quits one day. He's reunited with Tomoya Kaneshiro, an anime producer Ryota worked with when he was just starting out. Tomoya's as stoic and twisted as ever as he bosses Ryota around. Ryota and Tomoya have a past together, though, that goes beyond the office walls...

A boys' love story set in the animation industry between a younger production manager who's always willing to lend a hand with anything and his complicated, arrogant-but-shy anime producer.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Bokura no Micro na Shuumatsu
title_english: The End of the World With You.
synopsis:
A meteor heading toward Earth will bring the end of the world in 10 days. This devastating news has caused people to resort to panic and violence. However, others have gradually accepted the impending doom and have decided to await their demise with dignity. Life has never pampered Masumi Nishina, and the end of the world barely upsets him. To have his final days pass quicker, Nishina visits his old university's library; but instead of finding peace, he runs into Ritsu Kusakabe—the single worst person to have ever entered his life.

During their brief affair in college, Ritsu betrayed Nishina and shattered his heart. Ritsu always did whatever he pleased, and now he wishes to spend the rest of his life with Nishina. Although Nishina is hesitant to be anywhere near this wicked man, there is truly not much else to do. So when Ritsu asks Nishina for a favor, it takes them on one final trip across the country before everything falls into darkness.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

synopsis:
Yuuta was your typical introverted loser.

One day, he got invited to an IRL meeting by someone he met online with a shared interest. He wondered what kind of person will be there, and it turned out to be a beautiful lady far beyond his expectation! Yuuta felt thrilled but guilty, and he was flustered at every turn.

Seeing his nervousness, she tried to draw him out of his shell...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Siren's Song
synopsis:
One snowy evening out on the terrace, Luan hears Yul singing and is immediately captivated by his voice. Luan is surprised to see his own honest reaction, while Yul is surprised by the simple fact that he was heard by another human being. To what lengths will Luan go to claim Yul for himself...?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Mesugaki ga Yattekita!!
title_japanese: メスガキがヤってきた！！
synopsis:
It's been years since Takeshi last saw his cousin Hatsuse, and she's developed into quite a pretty young lady. But he's about to discover that she's also developed a taste for cash and sex!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Bokura wa Minna *ndeiru

title: Trust Me, Little Duke!
synopsis:
After a tragic life spent in the shadow of her superior Duke Senoc Blacknight, the powerful Dame Aspyn Soir is sent back in time and given a lucky second chance at life. She's thrilled, at least until she runs into the very same Senoc! However, this frightened boy is very different from the cool, composed sword master Aspyn knew. Even though Senoc nearly killed her, she can't help taking pity on his younger self. If nobody stops her, Aspyn just might end up helping out her greatest enemy.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Thumbs Up, Level Up
synopsis:
Jicheok Um was just an underappreciated hunter's assistant until an odd dream and a simple thumbs up triggered his awakening as a hunter and hot GodTube influencer. Jicheok doesn't earn points by killing monsters though. Instead, he must do good deeds and gain the approval of others. So when a heroic video of him goes viral and top companies start wooing him with contracts, it seems like the sky's the limit. But will fame be a more dangerous game than our rising star expected...?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Crazy Neighbor
synopsis:
Shinosaki has lived his life by putting up walls against the world to protect himself from getting emotionally involved with other people. On one rainy day however, he tries reaching out to form a connection and ends up confessing his feelings to a colleague he cares about, but is rejected. When he arrives at his workplace the next day, rumors that he is gay seem to be spreading around. Overwhelmed and desperate, Shinosaki tries to kill himself. Fortunately, his attempt is interrupted by Alex, a cheerful foreigner who has just moved in next door.

(Source: Leed-sha, translated)

title: Kanawanakatta Koi no Tsuzuki wo
title_japanese: 叶わなかった恋の続きを
synopsis:
It is so painful to love people as they are in a small world.

Makio is a high school student in the countryside who has kept his gay identity a secret and has lived his whole life without even making close friends. Shibukawa, who transferred to the same class, is a neighbor of Makio's and tries to forcefully close the gap between them because of their shared love of sweets. Makio, who does not want to get close to anyone, is perplexed, but gradually realizes that he is attracted to Shibukawa's straightforward and gentle personality. He realizes the feelings he has for Shibukawa, but continues to be "friends" with him...

(Source: Leed-sha, translated)

title: Heart nante Iranai
title_japanese: ハートなんていらない

synopsis:
Thanks to a strange turn of events, Tomari Ousuke, an apathetic detective, and his former classmate, Kijima Yaichi, an ex-yakuza with a unique ability, have formed a strange investigative partnership!

(Source: MU)

title: Tsumasaki no Ajisai
synopsis:
"I want to be the place you come home to."

Ao and Sou live together in a house a little ways removed from the city. Ao is far too kind for his own good and always gets the raw end of the deal, which frustrates Sou to no end. Despite all this, they eat together and passionately connect their bodies, and soon the days they spend together grow into something so precious that they are afraid of losing it. See their personal happiness shine bright in this charming daily life shared by two clumsy people.

(Source: Shodensha, translated)

title: Tale of the Floating Sages
synopsis:
Sangun, the tiger lord of Baek Mountain, was living a peaceful life until a young, white-haired girl named Choa visits his cave, claiming to be his bride. Sangun immediately realizes that Choa is a descendant of the White-blooded Demon Beast, a dangerous creature feared by all spirits and beasts. He tries to send her away for fear of the dangers she will bring, but changes his mind upon discovering that she has nowhere to go. Unfortunately for him, this marks the beginning of his hardships...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kiniro no Mabinogion: Arthur Ou no Imoutohime

title: Koushi Kondou Itashimasen!

title: Reforming the Obsessive Male Lead
synopsis:
Once, I was reborn in an unknown novel. But as soon as my parents from the new world died and I was adopted into the duchy, I realized what kind of work I got into... It was a BL-webtoon with a tragic ending, where all the characters die, and I am a minor character who, in the course of the story, will have to die the very first! Moreover, I am destined to die at the hands of my beloved Lucian?!

Fortunately or unfortunately, there is still plenty of time before the tragedy begins. Now I am the daughter of the duchy in which my pet lives, so I can have time to change the sad ending! However... I was just trying to make Lucian an affectionate ML and achieve a happy ending, but his obsession suddenly turned out to be directed at me?!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: The Emperor Reverses Time
synopsis:
In the majestic heart of a sprawling empire, the story of Emperor Leonhardt and Empress Elizabeth Isolde von Elysium unfolds. When tragedy strikes and the beloved—by all but one—Empress perishes, Leonhardt discovers a diary that reveals her silent struggles and undying love for him. Overwhelmed with remorse, he seeks out the mystical Witch of the Clock Tower to turn back the sands of time.

Awakening in the innocence of his youth, Leonhardt once again meets his future bride, Elizabeth, and he's determined to treat her right. With the weight of past memories on his shoulders, he aims to foster a bond built on genuine understanding and love. Yet, Elizabeth's past is fraught with dark family secrets and pressures that threaten to break her spirit.  As the empire watches, Leonhardt and Elizabeth must navigate their love amidst a backdrop of treachery and the heavy burden of past mistakes.

(Source: Editio Publishing)

title: Ore no Kokan wa Bishoujo Datta no ka
title_japanese: 俺の股間は美少女だったのか
synopsis:
Ayumu Kosuga, a high school boy, was living an ordinary, boring life. Ayumu thought that spring break would also pass without incident, but then... his penis became personified as a cute girl!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Nitenai Bokura no Mama de Tsuzuku

title: Reversal
synopsis:
Hiding both his real name Yuhan and his past as a dominant Omega, Lee Hajin lives quietly as a Beta, drowning in debt and scraping by as a personal aide to the spoiled son of J Tech's CEO. With no family to rely on, survival is his only goal.

Everything changes when Hajin runs into Kwon Seong-hyeob, his first love from high school, at a business meeting. Once the son of his family's chauffeur, Seong-hyeob is now a powerful corporate leader. Time has reversed their positions, but their pheromones still recognize each other as if no years have passed.

In this new, twisted dynamic, Seong-hyeob refuses to let Hajin disappear again. Determined to keep him close, he proposes a dangerous arrangement that blurs the line between desire, control, and unresolved love.

Between secrets, power, and lingering attraction, Hajin must decide whether he can survive being pulled back into the past he tried so hard to escape.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Slide Green
synopsis:
Satoru and Kousei are childhood friends who started living in neighboring rooms after starting university. Kousei has always been looking after the sickly Satoru ever since that time the latter got injured when they were kids. 

One day, the two of them went to a fireworks festival with friends from their university club, but Satoru started feeling unwell halfway through. After noticing Satoru's condition, Kousei was about to go back home with him when a club member questioned why Kousei had to go back too. No longer able to stand the strange mood in the club, Satoru came to feel that he is holding Kousei back and getting in his way and thus decided to distant himself from the latter...

(Source: Leed-sha, translated)

title: Elden Ring: Ougonju e no Michi
title_english: Elden Ring: The Road to the Erdtree
title_japanese: ELDEN RING 黄金樹への道
synopsis:
The Lands Between is a domain where demigods once waged war against each other to claim the shards of the Elden Ring, a set of runes containing immense power. In the present, an exiled man named Aseo emerges from a graveyard in Limgrave with almost nothing to his name and no recollection of how he ended up there. Immediately encountering the cruel land and its inhabitants, Aseo has little hope for survival—until he crosses paths with Melina, a mysterious maiden who makes him a dangerous offer.

With little choice in the matter, Aseo accepts the request from Melina. However, in exchange for providing some much needed aid in his travels, he must take Melina with him, following a guiding light down an arduous road to the Erdtree. Armed with nothing but a loincloth, a club, and his trusty steed Torrent, Aseo must brave the many dangers and face off against the quirky inhabitants of the Lands Between.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

Kantarou ascended to heaven because he masturbated too much and reincarnates in a different world. Being a fatty, he is disliked even after reincarnating, but he notices that a cloudy potion that cures anything from his crotch appears. Moreover, it also has the effect of powering up the demons, and it will be loved by the demons...!? A different world reincarnation fantasy that is unmatched in the crotch!!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Kiss shicha Dame nano?
synopsis:
Tarou, an ultra-pure virgin who has a complex with red hair and freckles, feels a sense of closeness to Rui, a transfer student who, like himself, is "half but not good at English," and becomes friends with him. However, the physical contact from Rui is so excessive and sweet that it surpasses Tarou's idea of ​​"friends," and it keeps making his heart beat faster every day...! Is it okay to kiss friends...!? synopsis:
A younger, clingy but pure and innocent man and an older office worker with little self-control! Kazunari, an exhausted office worker, has started living with Kei, the younger neighbor he grew up next door to, after Kei's house burns down. One night after seeing Kei leave the shower topless, Kazunari finds his heart racing over the smoking body Kei has, but stifles it immediately. Later, however, Kei slaps photo evidence of Kazunari's hook-ups with other men in his face...! Kazunari faces one dilemma after another, including Kei coming onto him based on Kazunari's wanton reputation, not to mention Kei being 11 years younger! Will Kazunari be able to maintain his pride under Kei's pressure!?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Tonari no Hyakkai Kenbunroku
title_english: Tales of the Hundred Monsters Next Door
synopsis:
Jinpachi Katagiri is a man plagued by mysteries, and the only one who can help him is the mysterious Oriza Harada, a famed painter of ghost and youkai portraits. These two men share the same peculiar fate, and their wicked tale of the ghastly and the curious, the strange and the shocking, all begins here.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Doukyonin ga Kono Yo no Mon ja Nai
title_japanese: 同居人がこの世のモンじゃない
synopsis:
The young man's new apartment is haunted, but as it turns out, even the dead have their own personal shortcomings... issues of the flesh included. For the dead have lingering desires, and are more susceptible to the world of the living than what one may think. There's anger, there's hate, there's curiosity... and there's love too. Here he finds a ghastly girl who observes him quietly, certainly desiring something... No wonder the rent is cheap!

(Source: MU)

"I just might suffocate from this love that keeps growing stronger...?!"

Yuki is a music college student who has unrequited feelings for Takeshi, a genius pianist who is 10 years older than him. He has been smitten with the sound of the music Takeshi plays ever since they first met, but ever since realising his own feelings, he has always kept them hidden. However, one day, he starts living with Takeshi at his house in Vienna all because of a passing comment! After hearing Takeshi say that he could never turn down anything Yuki asks of him and being spurred on by his drunkenness, Yuki presses Takeshi to kiss him...?!

Heroism—a punishment for only the worst criminals. Those sentenced to the fate of a hero are forced to fight at the front lines against the demon king's army—and if they die, all they can expect is to be revived and continue the battle. But when their leader, convicted of killing a goddess, meets another goddess himself, the contract they forge may be enough to change the world...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Finding Camellia
synopsis:
Camellia was a flower born of a gutter rat, her face more ethereal than any other. When she was a child, a wealthy noblewoman took her and forced her to become Camellius Bale, the second-born son of House Bale. From that day on, her life was no longer her own.

For years, Camellius has lived to protect the position of her older brother, Kieran, even though this does not benefit her at all. With nowhere to run, she obeys her mother's orders, burying herself deep beneath a facade of lies. As she begins to cross paths with Claude del Ihar, the heir to the grand dukedom, she continues to hope that someday she can reclaim what was once hers—the life of Camellia.

title: Koori no Reijou no Tokashikata
title_english: How to Melt the Ice Queen's Heart
synopsis:
Asahi Kagami—a rather outgoing guy with a tendency to try to help anyone in need—happens to be neighbors and classmates with a girl named Fuyuka Himuro. At school she's been nicknamed "The Ice Queen" by her classmates, and for good reason: she prefers to keep everyone at arm's length and seldom talks to others.

Neither Fuyuka nor Asahi have had a chance to interact with each other yet, but Asahi's tendency to meddle in other people's business slowly but surely marks the beginning of a relationship that blooms into something more...

(Source: Tentai Books)

title: Tsukaeru Mahou wa Hitotsu shika Nai keredo, Kore de Cool Kawaii Dark Elf to Ichaicha Dekiru nara Dou Kangaetemo Kachigumi dato Omou
title_japanese: 使える魔法は一つしかないけれど、これでクール可愛いダークエルフとイチャイチャできるならどう考えても勝ち組だと思う
synopsis:
Klaus Knockburn, an apprentice scientist from the Court Magic Academy, ventured deep into the forest in search for the legendary clan he's long obsessed of, the Dark Elves.

(Source: Novel Updates)

title: Isekai de Ane ni Namae wo Ubawaremashita
title_english: In Another World, My Sister Stole My Name
title_japanese: 異世界で姉に名前を奪われました
synopsis:
Through a handheld mirror connected to another world, college student Ichika shares a friendship with a boy named Cecil—one that only her older sister, Karen, knows about. When Karen and the mirror disappear one day, Ichika is devastated. But grief turns to shock a year later when she, too, is sent to the world on the other side, only to find her lost sister and a grown-up Cecil! Except...why are her sister's first words to her "I've missed you, Karen"? And why is everyone else calling her "Ichika"?! In a world where her name and her past have been stolen, Ichika must find a way to forge her own destiny!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Isekai Ouji no Toshiue Cinderella
title_english: Cinderella of the Prince in Another World
title_japanese: 異世界王子の年上シンデレラ
synopsis:
Rika was suddenly summoned to another world to become the prince's bride. However, the prince is only 11 years old! Rika expresses her displeasure, but gradually bonds with the prince who loves her. As she looks for a way to return to her own world, Rika decides to watch over the prince's growth with sisterly affection. And so a life with the prince begins!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title: Kawaii Hito
synopsis:
Kenzaki, a female yankee, has a crush on Nakajima, a boy who gets constantly teased in class. One day, she saves him from his bullies, bringing the two to become closer with one another.

Shortly after, Kenzaki notices a girl who looks a lot like Nakajima. However, it turns out that it is indeed Nakajima crossdressing!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kaginado: Comic Anthology
title_japanese: かぎなどコミックアンソロジー
synopsis: An anthology comic of Kaginado by various mangaka.

title: Quit Writing, Dear Author!
synopsis:
Hee-wun is the personal assistant of his childhood friend Geon-ju, whose wealthy family took him in when he was a young boy. For years, he's been nursing a crush on his friend and boss, but Geon-ju seems to have no clue. Sounds like the stuff of BL romance, right? It turns out, Hee-wun's life actually is. The night before Hee-wun is to start an odd new job for Geon-ju, he comes across a strange BL novel where the main characters have their names. It's a funny coincidence...until it's got Hee-wun yelling, "Quit Writing, Dear Author!"

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

synopsis:
The student Nakatani Yuto was supposed to be having a regular life, however his whole class was transferred to another world. All the students gained powerful skills and were worshipped as heroes, but for Yuto who got the unfavorable skill [Absorption]...! ?

(Source: MU)

About a rich man unable to open his heart to others and a woman who is poor but lives life filled with love and hope.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Stand Up Start
synopsis:
Taiyou Mihoshi is the CEO of investment company Sunshine Fund and self-proclaimed human investor. He holds the belief that "Assets are people. No investor will dispose of their assets." Taiyou Mihoshi approaches people who are having difficulties in their personal lives or business career. He talks to them and proposes doing a start-up together, allowing them to dream again.

(Source: AsianWiki)

title: Shen Sheng
synopsis:
Shen Sheng is a college freshman studying literature. He has always been obedient, never once deviating from the goals and expectations that others have set for him. When he stumbles upon his new Modern Literature History professor, Cheng Mu, in a compromising situation, everything changes. Little does Shen Sheng know that his teacher has also just discovered the story he’s been secretly working on. Will Shen Sheng start following his own desires? And will his professor be the one to help him find his way?

(Source: Comikey Media)

synopsis:
Going on with our lives after having lost someone is always painful. What does it mean to move on without forgetting them? This is a story about survivors struggling to find happiness within their guilt and grief.

(Source: Manta)

title: Houkago Saitensei!
synopsis:
Ten years ago, a magic circle suddenly appeared above Earth, connecting it to the parallel world Alterna. This led to the invention of the Alternaphone, which allows people to freely "reincarnate" between worlds, allowing earthlings to become adventurers and otherworlders to become normal citizens. The series follows two amnesiac girls, earthling Utaho Kurami and otherworlder Melua Solaris, as they go back and forth between ordinary life on Earth and adventuring on Alterna. 

(Source: MU)

title: Shikeishuu: Ijou Hanzaisha no Matsuro
title_japanese: 私刑囚 ―異常犯罪者の末路―
synopsis: Depraved serial killers, seemingly free to take peoples lives, meet their ends at the hands of a mysterious female albino, Mio Shiraki.

title: Kekkaishi no Ichirinka
synopsis:
Hana Ichise is from a branch family to one of five barrier-weaving magical clans who protect and support Japan. But in the eyes of her mother and father, she's an afterthought compared to her talented older twin sister. When Hana's true potential awakens at age fifteen, she decides to keep her newfound abilities a secret—including from her parents—so she can have a quiet life. But the powerful new head of the elite Ichinomiya clan, Saku Ichinomiya, is looking for a bride...and he has his eyes on Hana!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Lycoris Recoil
synopsis:
Located on the east side of Tokyo, overlooking the old, destroyed radio tower, Café LycoReco is a stylish and delicious place to relax. And this is a story depicting the everyday, extraordinary life of the charming staff who work there. Irresistible sweets, gun action, incredible games, heartwarming dramas, zombies and monsters...and a touch of love!? Of course, you can't forget the coffee!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Zesshoku Kareshi Kouryaku seyo
synopsis:
Zesshoku Kareshi Kouryaku seyo follows the story of relationship-hunting girl Kokona and aromantic guy Chihaya.

Included one-shot:
Volume 2: Zesshoku Danshi Kouryaku seyo (pilot)

title: How to Live as a Villain
synopsis:
"You have been chosen as a player in the great game to select the next god's successor, the Mission! Congratulations!"

Seonghoon has suddenly fallen into another world to participate in a game to become a god. This other world that is akin to that of a game contains players who cooperate and also kill each other in cold blood...!! Seonghoon, a person without an ounce of talent, uses wicked and crude tricks to become an all-powerful player!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: The Grand Duchess of the North Was Secretly a Villainess
title_english: The Grand Duchess of the North Was Secretly a Villainess
title_japanese: 북부 대공의 정체가 흑막 악녀라 곤란하다
synopsis:
Eloise Wayana, the grand duchess of the North, is executed by Emperor Caien Helisis after it is revealed that she was secretly a villainess all along. This marks the end of season two of the latest trending web novel, "The Crown of Blood." As one of its avid readers, Kim Dakyung is eagerly waiting for the next season when she is suddenly hit by a truck on her way home! But once she reawakens, she finds that she is in the body of the grand duchess herself and has been teleported back to the novel's beginning. Already knowing what road Eloise will go down, Dakyung is desperate to change her fate and survive until season three. Lucky for her, a younger version of Caien falls right into her hands, and she is going to do whatever it takes to keep him on her side.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Ushiro no Seki no Gal ni Sukarete Shimatta. Mou Ore wa Dame Kamoshirenai.
title_english: The Gal Is Sitting Behind Me, and Loves Me.
title_japanese: うしろの席のぎゃるに好かれてしまった。もう俺はダメかもしれない。
synopsis:
A high-school boy Sandai, who liked to spend his time alone, accidentally helped the most beautiful girl in his class, Shino, when she fell into a ditch near his home. He let her use shower at his home, and lend her some clothes, although he had never talked with her before.

From that day, she started to act like his friend. In fact, she seems to like him...but that can't be! She's the most popular babe in his high school! But what he didn't know was, Shino had never went out with a guy. She was not very good with guys, and Sandai was the first guy she could talk naturally with. As they spend time together, Sandai can't help himself to have special feelings for Shino. A story of a boy whose life was completely changed by a cute babe!

(Source: Kadokawa)

title: Kyonyuu Suki nanoni BL-kai ni Tensei shimashita
title_english: I Got Reincarnated in a (BL) World of Big (Man) Boobs
title_japanese: 巨乳好きなのにBL界に転生しました
synopsis:
Nagare Otokawa was an otaku loser obsessed with breasts. He tragically died never knowing the feel of the sweet, sweet bosoms he'd craved all his life. Little does he know, his wish is about to be granted in a way he never would have expected.

Nagare gets reincarnated as a handsome guy and quickly realizes that he's living in a (BL) world full of sexy (male) beauties. Even so, he sets out to find and squeeze the bust of his dreams. He does, in fact, end up with his face planted deeply in some luscious cleavage, but to his dismay, it's the magnificent pecs of the super-muscular class delinquent, Ryuuji Onizuka!

Now Nagare must try to dodge his way past the barrage of BL scenarios that hurtle into his path. Will he persevere and get the busty girlfriend of his dreams, or will he end up falling for the all-man—yet temptingly bodacious—Ryuuji?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Hotaru wa Ashita Shinu dj - Enough
synopsis:
Saneatsu Asada and Nao Nimiya start celebrating Nimiya's birthday a day early. Asada makes a resolution after contemplating the different relationships in his life.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Rise and Shine, Hero!
synopsis:
As the winner of the Kingdom Warrior Tournament, Ah-in is tasked by the king with finding the missing princess. During his journey, he encounters various buxom beauties who are more than willing to help him however they can! In fact, most of them want to ravish him, including his childhood friend and companion, Garnet. Will Ah-in be able to complete his quest with so many girls vying for his attention?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Twin Recipe
synopsis:
When Kyung-chan goes back to his hometown, he immediately gets tossed into living with Jinmi and Yoomi—the hot twins who need help running their restaurant. But things don't look too bright for Kyung-chan, what with the restaurant in shambles and Jinmi constantly harassing him and teasing him for being a crook! Will Kyung-chan manage to make the twins warm up to him and save their failing restaurant?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Mia's Fantastic Toys
synopsis:
The future is a vast wonderland of technological pleasures hampered by a dwindling population. Their only hope is Mia, a well-endowed time traveler with a bag of sex toys determined to save mankind!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Maryoku Cheat na Majo ni Narimashita: Souzou Mahou de Kimama na Isekai Seikatsu
title_english: Making Magic: The Sweet Life of a Witch Who Knows an Infinite MP Loophole
title_japanese: 魔力チートな魔女になりました～創造魔法で気ままな異世界生活～
synopsis:
Looks like I've been reincarnated into a gamelike world filled with monsters and dungeons. But don't worry—it's nothing I can't handle. I chose Creation Magic for my unique skill, you see, and it lets me make whatever item I want...so long as I've got enough mana. Ah, there's always a catch, isn't there? But where there's a rule, there's a loophole—and this little witch knows just the trick to expand her mana pool a bit more each day.As for what I'll be up to in the meantime, first I'll make a friend. (Literally. Golems are a thing in this world.) Next, I'll make some tracks. (And the sooner, the better. The goddess dropped me off in the middle of the wastelands). Then finally, one day, I'll make myself a place where I can truly belong. (That's the plan, at least.) Time to make some magic!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Ringo Tensei: Kindan no Kajitsu wa Kyou mo Korokoro to Musou suru
title_english: Reincarnated as an Apple: This Forbidden Fruit Is Forever Unblemished!
title_japanese: 林檎転生～禁断の果実は今日もコロコロと無双する～
synopsis:
My name is Daisuke Furutsu, and I died getting hit by a truck full of apples. Yes, I know it's a cliché setup. Apparently somebody upstairs fell asleep on the job. Anyway, as an apology, God lets me draw five Cards of Fate that are supposed to grant me superpowers in my next life. My first four draws are amazing—stuff like magic and an infinite inventory. But everything changes with the fifth card: a "curse" that turns me into whatever killed me. I thought I was gonna end up a truck, but now I'm an apple! Luckily, I've made a friend who can teach me how to move around. I also end up saving a wannabe adventurer who just might be willing to take me along for the ride. Time for this overpowered apple to get rollin'!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: The Body Game
synopsis:
Back on campus after his military service, Daechu Jang can't wait to get some action. However, a series of untimely events leaves him knee-deep in debt and with a tarnished reputation. All hope seems lost, but one day, he receives an invitation to the "Body Game." The rules look simple: hide a number on your body, then find the numbers of three other participants. How? By having as much sex as you can! With 30 million won on the line, will this raunchy game help Daechu get back on his feet?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Gal Assistant
synopsis:
Mie is a dull high school student who happens to be a professional manga author. He hires an assistant, but the person who came is the number one gal in his class! Despite her looks though, she's extremely good at what she does, and working with her is exciting, stimulating, busy, and fun!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Joucho wo Mechakucha ni Shitekuru Onna
title_japanese: 情緒をめちゃくちゃにしてくる女
synopsis:
Yuuta was your typical introverted loser.

One day, he got invited to an IRL meeting by someone he met online with a shared interest. He wondered what kind of person will be there, and it turned out to be a beautiful lady far beyond his expectation! Yuuta felt thrilled but guilty, and he was flustered at every turn.

Seeing his nervousness, she tried to draw him out of his shell...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kemuri to Mitsu
synopsis:
Himeko Hanatsuka, age 12, and Bunji Tsuchiya, age 30. Their relationship status is: "engaged." This story takes place during the Taisho Era, when Western and modern culture was beginning to spread in Japan. In this unsettling and vibrant atmosphere, the two, who call each other "Bunji-sama" and "Fiancée-dono" slowly develop their love, surpassing the 18 year age gap.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Bena
synopsis:
"Were you... thrown away, too?" The Edo period. Circus sideshow worker Ichi is left in charge of the care and training of a beast captured to become the sideshow's next showpiece. Ferocious as well as ghastly, the beast terrifies all the caretakers; Ichi, already in a vulnerable position, was simply stuck with the task. At first he cared for the beast grudgingly, regarding it with a contempt born of his dark past experiences, but he begins to sense some humanity in the beast's actions and gives it a name—Bena. Bena's childlike innocence reminds Ichi of his deceased brother and, wanting to somehow return Bena home to his family, Ichi attempts to help him escape. But Bena is no human; he is a child of demons...

(Source: Futabasha)

title: Ayashi Ayakashi Akemi-chan
title_japanese: あやしあやかしあけみちゃん
synopsis:
There is something off about Akemi, the new girl at school who recently moved into a haunted house. She is often spotted talking to and playing with the air around her. Everyone avoids her due to her odd behavior; but Maki, another loner at school, knows the real reason why Akemi does these strange things: Akemi can interact with monsters that only she and Maki can see. With a mutual understanding, Maki asks Akemi if they can be friends, unaware of her and the monsters’ true nature.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: My Far Too Tumultuous Marriage
synopsis:
"I'll do this marriage."

Woo So-ran, a dedicated lawyer, is the only person who's aware of Baek Kang-ho's contract. She agreed to marry him instead of his runaway bride. "You'll regret it." Well, I don't make decisions which I'll regret in the first place. She entered the tiger's den with confidence. Even though her life has been quiet and boring so far, a messy and secret romance begins. Will I regret this marriage?

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: The SSS-Ranker Returns
synopsis:
What would you do with the chance to become far greater than your greatest rivals… before they could even start? When a dominant guild gangs up on Rokan to humiliate him and destroy his hard-earned achievements in the world's most realistic fantasy VR game, he becomes desperate for revenge. But just when Rokan thinks he's lost it all, a twist in space-time sends him back to right before the game is even launched. Now, this former SSS-ranker sees the perfect opportunity to return to glory!

(Source: Tapas Media)

synopsis: This food manga follows a middle-aged cook in a back alley restaurant trying to help his customers with their problems while cooking for them. However, he misunderstands their problems and gives confusing advice.

title: The Logbook
synopsis:
Ji-Eun, a children's storybook author, goes to Guam for her friend's wedding. There, she develops a strong fascination with the ocean and decides to become a diver. As a scuba diver and free-diver, she experiences the universe beneath the earth, a new life, and people who love the sea, and explores lost dreams, love, and the meaning of life.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kami wo Kiri ni Kimashita.
title_english: To Revive in the Tender Island.
synopsis: Riku, a hairstylist, and his son Issei have a very strong bond. One day, they land on the remote island of Haruta, in the Okinawa archipelago. A new peaceful and restful life begin for those two...

title: Fatal Mistake
synopsis:
Han Sungmin, an escort who repeatedly fails to satisfy his clients is given a last chance to make a big score. But by some twist of fate, he mistakes the wrong man for his client and leads him to the hotel—only to discover that the man is actually a mob boss...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Hellen
synopsis:
Haein, or Hellen, got his nickname for one simple reason—it sounds like Hell. Haein's specific hell begins after he is kidnapped, finding himself constantly drugged and made dependent on his master, Phillip. But Phillip seems to have a different reason for choosing the name Hellen. Did he really take Haein because he wanted a rare beauty, or is there more to it than Haein realizes...?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Ginka to Glüna
synopsis:
This story begins deep on a snowy mountain... Glüna lives alone until the day she meets a mysterious snowman named Ginka. In order to see the outside world, Glüna is determined to learn magic from Ginka and leave the mountains. "As long as we're together, nothing is impossible!" Where will their fun adventure take them?! Now begins a magical fantastic journey like you've never seen!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Included one-shot:
Volume 4: Pekopeko no Yamai (Extremus Appetitus)

title: The Rules of Insane Top
synopsis:
Jungwoo, a kind-hearted soul, follows an injured pigeon he once helped to a hidden spot behind his school. There, he discovers his ideal type: Hae-in, peacefully napping with an angelic presence.

Instantly captivated, Jungwoo feels destined to be with Hae-in and approaches him—only to learn that Hae-in's type is the opposite of who he is: a ruthless "insane top."

Eight years later, they meet again at a bookstore. A fierce showdown begins between Jungwoo, determined to prove he's become the "insane top" of Hae-in's dreams, and Hae-in, intent on bringing back the sweet man he once fell in love with.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Suishou no Hibiki
synopsis:
Included one-shot:
Volume 1: Suishou no Oto

title: Blindspot
synopsis:
Seon Jinwoo's life takes a sharp turn when someone he once helped vanishes—leaving him stuck with a mountain of debt that isn't even his. Refusing to give in, Jinwoo stands his ground. But loan shark Seonghyeon has other ideas, pressuring him to seal an unusual deal: a contract that uses his very body as collateral. Which begs the question, how far are you willing to go to pay for someone else's mistakes?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: What's Home
synopsis: A comedy about a 16-year-old boy living with the 36-year-old friend of his deceased mother.

title: Please, Candy!
synopsis:
Talented office worker Hagong Park's life takes an unexpected turn when Jin Woon, a former friend who confessed his feelings for him years ago, joins the company. As their mutual attraction rekindles, Hagong begins to notice that Woon keeps avoiding any physical contact. Frustrated and confused, Hagong decides to visit Woon's home late at night—only to see a stranger leaving Woon's place...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Paramour
synopsis:
A family misunderstanding leaves Merry and his mother to live on an island away from the city, and away from Merry's father. Twenty years later, Merry's mother falls sick, and she asks Sooho to help care for them. Believing Sooho is his half-brother, Merry can't understand his aversion to touching. But there's a family secret yet to be revealed, and Sooho is having a hard time keeping himself away from Merry...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

8-11. Jun x Jou Renka

title: The Legendary Beasts Animal Hospital
synopsis:
Ahyoung is the director of a down-on-its-luck animal hospital. Pragmatic, blunt, and single, this 30-year-old veterinarian is determined to succeed! But she is barely able to make ends meet... that is until a mythical creature makes its way to her hospital. With the help of her talking cat, her softie werewolf assistant, and her chipper dragon friend, she is committed to treating all fantastical beasts that make their way to her door. It can't be that hard... right?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Suna no Ue no 1DK
synopsis:
An innocent woman is injured during a sabotage operation at a research institute. On the brink of death, she is somehow healed when cells of unknown origin that were being studied there hijack her body. The life-form, christened "Algernon," slowly acclimates to human life. And what it wishes for is to live a peaceful life, like that of any other human being.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Koibito desu ken! Oogata Inu wa Te ga Hayai
title_english: We're Lovers Now! This Big Mutt Moves Fast
title_japanese: 恋人ですけん！～大型犬は手が早い
synopsis:
Fashion student Subaru is on the hunt for a model for his next show when he happens upon an unfashionable young man on the train whose raw assets showed a lot of promise!! As he's praying for the chance to see him again, the unfashionable guy from before, Kazue, shows up at his part-time job!? As his friend, Subaru teaches Kazue how to up his style game, and is blown away by the final result. "I knew he had a nice face..." Kazue agrees to be his model, but on one condition: "I'll be your model if you go out with me"! Subaru really needs a model, so he agrees to date him without a second thought. But when he does, the now stunning Kazue forcibly puts his tongue in Subaru's mouth...!?

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title: Lili-Men
synopsis:
Succubi, a species that uses humans as seedbeds to reproduce, and humanity, which is set on the eradication of every single succubus. As the unrelenting war between these two incompatible groups wages on, a "king" who will bring about the end of the war is born. The one chosen for the role of king is...?!
