(Source: Tapas Media)

title: My Baby
synopsis:
This is the story of this family that takes the form of "we." Girl Ash's dad isn't a "person," but he taught me a lot. The letters, the four seasons, the love of the family... If two people can put it together, that's fine.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Sousei Mahou no Saigensha
synopsis:
"You're a failure, don't ever cross my threshold again!"

In a country where magic is everything, especially in a kingdom where everything is determined by the ability of "bloodline magic" that only nobles are born with. Hermes, who was born as the second son of a certain noble family, was found to be a "failure" with no bloodline magic despite his high magical talent, and was exiled from the family. Hermes was almost killed in the depths of his disappointment, but then he was picked up by Rose, a "witch" he met, who saw his talent and made him her apprentice.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Kentei Gakuin no Magan Kenja
title_english: The Last Wizard of the Sword Emperor Academy

title: Soko de Hoshikuzu Miagetero
title_japanese: そこで星屑見上げてろ

title: Yama-san: Yamagoya Sanshimai
title_japanese: やまさん～山小屋三姉妹～

title: Save Lawrence
synopsis:
Welcome to our workplace. Home to the rich and powerful—a place where they come to play and their desires are fulfilled. The most beautiful and talented are invited to entertain them. Among those is Lawrence, our beautiful and wholesome Lawrence. We are her biggest fans and we must protect her!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Wave
synopsis:
Everything is made up of unique vibrations. Energy and sound waves, constantly vibrating in perfect synchronicity. However, there are those that can manipulate those frequencies... capable of mass destruction and chaos. Uncover the mystery of the wave.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Caldera
synopsis:
After finding out his wife's and daughter's safety is at risk, former secret agent Min goes on a mission to save his family. But he only has a matter of time before Baekdu Mountain erupts.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Prince Cinderella
synopsis:
Outgoing and athletic, Darim's always surrounded by friends. But back in elementary school, she used to be a social outcast—she only started making friends when Taehoo brought her into the fold. Now in high school, the two have drifted apart, but Darim is waiting for a chance to reunite with her icy Prince Charming. There's just one issue: Darim's body transforms into a boy's at noon every day, only to turn back at midnight! Well, if she can't get close to Taehoo as a girl... Why not try as a boy?!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Knight of the Falling Star
title_english: The Knight of the Falling Star
synopsis:
During a meteor shower, a magical Faerie appears in a dark alley. Lemon, the Fae Knight has come to the human world to complete his final knighthood test. Alongside him is his human companion, Mira, who dreams of being a Black Mage. Will Lemon be able to complete his test in time? Find out in this whimsical romantic comedy!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Watashi no Class no Seito ga, Hitoban de 24-nin Shinimashita.
title_japanese: 私のクラスの生徒が、一晩で24人死にました。
synopsis:
What happened in the classroom that night?! Kitahara, the Nanjo High School homeroom teacher of class 2-C, is involved in an unbelievable incident triggered by the disappearance of a female student, Tomoe Miyata... What happened to those 24 students, and who is behind this horror?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Scandalous
synopsis:
Who says a woman can't be smart and sexy at the same time? But can a woman get away with cheating on two men at once? Saeeun's simply SCANDALOUS!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Régiment
synopsis:
Régiment revolves around the shogunate infantry corps, the Western-style army developed by the Edo shogunate at the end of the Edo period.

(Source: ANN)

title: Seshuusei Triangle
title_japanese: 世襲制トライアングル
synopsis:
Childhood friends Koutarou Fujiki, Kajiwara, and Fuyuko thought they would always be together. They spent their youth in a strange love triangle, the two boys fighting over who would date Fuyuko. But suddenly one day, that life ends. Kajiwara goes missing, and Koutarou takes his sweetheart's hand in marriage. Now middle-aged, Koutarou is left to wonder—would his wife have chosen differently if Kajiwara were still around? On a visit to his hometown, the memories come rushing back...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Kemutai Hanashi
synopsis:
Takeda and Arita have not met since they graduated high school. That is, until they run into each other one rainy day and end up caring for an abandoned cat together. Thus, their relationship begins to shift.

Without a shred of romantic feelings, they have no reason to be living together—but even so, they both want to stay by the other's side. What answer will they reach as they search for their own special relationship that goes beyond labels?

(Source: Kobunsha, translated)

title: Red-Haired James
synopsis:
Henry Cuthbert asks for a strong worker who can help at his farm, but unexpectedly he ends up with a red-haired orphan called James. Although he is far from being strong, Henry ends up accepting James into his home. As the years pass by, James grows up to be a handsome young man, and the two find themselves falling for each other. But can their love be enough to heal their dark pasts and overcome the obstacles that keep trying to pull them apart?

(Source: Copin Communications)

title: Shiro Gal to Kuro Gal no Yuuwaku
title_japanese: 白ギャルと黒ギャルの誘惑
synopsis:
Rei, the white gal, and Natsuyu, the black gal, gets their classmate "Otaku-kun" involved in one thing or another. You'd think the two of them were seductively tempting Otaku-kun, but the one who was interested in Rei was the black gal next to her, Natsuyu...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: My Bad Painkiller
title_japanese: マイ・バッド・ペインキラー
synopsis:
Leo Mikuni is past praying to gods. Having cast all pretty notions of kindness aside, he's drawn to the occult, which affirms his all-consuming negative emotions. He knows his solace in demons is only a temporary solution to his problems, but summoning demons is the only thing that keeps his loneliness at bay. One day, when he's performing a stress-relieving summoning ritual, a handsome, scowling man dressed in black appears in a crash of lightning. A real demon in the flesh! Thrilled beyond belief, Leo accepts the demon into his home. But, it doesn't stop there. The demon demands he accept him in bed...! Leo's difficult life drives him to worship demons, but one day, a summoning ritual turns real and brings a handsome demon into his home!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Monitor-goshi no Joushi/Buka
title_japanese: モニター越しの上司／部下
synopsis:
Young office worker Yuri Awazaki has been at his job for two years now, but his boss is just way too good-looking for him to concentrate! He can't help but stare at that dreamy face that's absolutely his type until... Uh oh, their eyes meet! Oh god, he's smiling, what should Yuri do?! He can't just tell him how he feels! His solution: put a big computer monitor between them! Keep reading to see where it goes between a handsome boss and his tsundere subordinate in this slightly niche office rom-com!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Daijuukou to Unicornis no Otome
title_japanese: 大獣公とユニコニスの乙女
synopsis:
A fairytale fantasy where a girl's prayer changes the world! In a world where humans and beasts coexist, Lana lives in the hidden village of Sherwood. It is a place where the weaker sub-tribes live in seclusion. Although her mother is a skillful, higher-class dwarf, Lana's appearance and talents are not like hers as she leads a useless, slave-like life. Until... An encounter with Reyfold, a human who arrives in the village, changes Lana's destiny forever...!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Sex Unfriend
title_japanese: セックスアンフレンド
synopsis:
All it took was a kiss to turn Misaki's life upside down... It was during their final year of high school when Asahi changed bright, fun-loving Misaki's life forever. Kissing his best friend and proceeding to touch his body, Asahi didn't realize that he had made Misaki aware of his own nature. Misaki is crushed when he goes to see Asahi and finds him with a girl. They end their friendship, and five years quickly go by.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Koiseyo Maou, Aiseyo Yuusha
title_japanese: 恋せよ魔王、愛せよ勇者
synopsis:
A young man returns to his home world after defeating the demon lord, only to find his enemy followed him back... and is now head-over-heels for him. A semi-fantastic romcom about the budding relationship between two former enemies, as well as the groupmates our hero left behind.

(Source: MU)

title: Suki ni Sasete Miseru kara!
title_japanese: 好きにさせてみせるから!
synopsis:
Hiro Outa, a university student, is currently in a one-sided love with his childhood friend who lives next door, Shun Sakiyama. Hiro believes he's been slowly closing the distance between him and Shun, who was like a brother figure to him. When the time comes, he confesses, but he is rejected?! However, if there is even the slightest chance, he won't give up!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: My Royal Awakening
synopsis:
When your average guy struggling through life in modern day Korea gets "reborn" as a grand prince in the Joseon Dynasty, it seems like a pretty sweet deal, right? Nope, not if you're the younger brother of King Yeonsan, one of the most tyrannical kings in Joseon's history. A reign of terror is imminent, and it's only a matter of time before everything goes downhill. But with a new Grand Prince Jin-seong taking matters into his own two hands, perhaps history won't repeat itself...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Your Highness, Please!
synopsis:
What on earth happened last night?! Hustling through life with three jobs, the extremely average Sunwoo meets Zeus, the secret prince of Zerdel, one fateful night. The unlikely pair grow closer as they retrace their memories, but their relationship is shaken by the hidden past and the Prime Minister who holds the key to the secret...!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Kitsune no Okite: Chuugoku Gensousen
title_english: A Chinese Fantasy: Law of the Fox
title_japanese: 狐の掟 中国幻想選
synopsis:
When a man saves a fox, the last thing he expects is for her to return to him as a beautiful maiden, but gratitude is powerful and so is the law of the fox. When it comes to finding a love match, don’t rule out pairing with a tiger, wolf, or bear, either! This collection of eight fantasy tales are all about finding love in the weirdest of places.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

1. Zhao Shishi
2. Irui no Musume [Tora] (Daughter of a Different Kind [Tiger])
3. Irui no Musume [Ookami] (Daughter of a Different Kind [Wolf])
4. Kuma ni Tasukerareta Otoko (Man Who Was Save by a Bear)
5. Kitsune no Okite (Law of the Fox)
6. Meifu ni Itta Yome (Wife Who Went to the Underworld)
7. Ashina

title_japanese: 恋する彼のシークレット・チャンネル

title: Messiah: Isekai wo Sukutta Motoyuusha ga Mamono no Afureru Genjitsu Sekai wo Musou suru
title_japanese: 救世主〈メシア〉～異世界を救った元勇者が魔物のあふれる現実世界を無双する～
synopsis:
The "former" savior, Takeru Yamato, was summoned to another world and executed because of his strength. When he wakes up, he finds himself in Japan, where he spent time before being summoned. However, in the city, demons appearing from "gates" rampage, and those called hunters fight using magic. Returning from another world, Takeru decides to hide his powers and live, but...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Tsuki wa Michikake Kemono no Koi
title_english: A Beast's Love Is Like the Moon
title_japanese: 月はみちかけケモノの恋
synopsis:
Unable to fit in with the city, Idzuki, a lonely young man, moves into the countryside. However, the land is rumored to be haunted by youkai. As he struggles to get used to life in the mountains, with the abundance of insects and the lack of reception, he is suddenly attacked by a youkai. Cornered, out of the blue, a handsome young man with dog ears rescues him. The man claims to be a komainu youkai, a guardian lion-dog protecting shrines, pressing Idzuki to become his master—?! A sensitive love story between a youkai and a human!

(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)

title: Inran Hitozuma no Uwaki Nikki: "Mukashi no Sex Friend"
title_japanese: 淫乱人妻の浮気日記『昔のセフレ』
synopsis:
Mizuki loves her husband, she really does... But for her, good dick is a need, not a want, and he just can't seem to deliver. Fortunately, she has a way of fulfilling her desires, and as long as she's home to care for her sweetheart at the end of the day, what's the harm in a fling or two on the side?

(Source: Irodori Comics)

synopsis:

title: Rookie Talent Agent Knows It All
title_english: Rookie Talent Agent Knows It All
synopsis:
Yoonho seems to have it all: he is the successful VP of Top Entertainment and married to an A-list celebrity. But when he's faced with a terminal illness, the shallow people he relied upon disappear, and he's on his deathbed filled with regret. Unexpectedly, Yoonho awakens ten years in his past as a rookie talent agent at Hoop Entertainment, the company that nurtured his career. His goal: boost his loyal circle of actor and idol contacts to reach their full potential! With a decade of experience, will Yoonho be able to set this industry right?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Tsugi no Koi wa Hana Emu
title_english: In the Next Love, the Flowers Will Bloom.

title: Gal niPA-chan wa Semararetai
title_japanese: ギャルにぱちゃんはせまられたい
synopsis:
The popular teen model niPA, aka Futaba Asahino, is strong willed and refuses dance by someone else's tune, but the plain guy who is her seatmate refuses to budge before her... "Damn that four-eyed nobody, how dare he tell me off!" But at the same time, remembering that makes her feel somehow strange. Her fingers slip beneath her skirt as if by reflex and while thinking about getting assaulted by that disgusting man she pleasures herself against her better judgment while she is brought to climax in her fantasies!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Akatsuki Jihen
synopsis:
The Sukaku (Zhu He) family is a distinguished line of shamans that protects mankind from divine beasts. Our protagonist, Mutsuki, (Wang Yue) bears a promising future while his sister Uzuki (Chu Yue) completely lacks the capability to use any spiritual techniques. "You are not a child of Sukaku if you are not a shaman." Bound by those antiquated customs, Uzuki is forbidden from leaving the house. As her older brother, Mutsuki is determined to free Uzuki from her confines.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Sweet Room Escape
title_japanese: スウィートルームエスケイプ
synopsis:
Globetrotting businessman Haruto has achieved the optimal formula for work-life balance: put in your hours and then party hard off-hours. He makes the most of wherever the job sends him, building rapport in each local gay scene and a bon(e)afide booty-call directory. But the hot shot meets his match against the genteel, winsome Albrecht when en route to France. From airplane rowmates, to an invitation to drinks, to the best sex ever in a luxury suite, it's as if fate itself seems to be green-lighting this opportunity. But now Haruto can't seem to escape that heavenly night and resume his carefully crafted no-strings-attached game plan... Especially when Al seems to be plotting to capture Haruto's heart!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title_japanese: おっとり義母〈ママ〉は息子のオネダリに弱い

title: Castle
synopsis:
"Castle," South Korea's omnipotent crime syndicate. One man returns to Korea in order to topple the absolute stronghold that is "Castle": Shin Kim, the Korean-born Russian killer named "Amur Tiger." He comes back to the crime-ridden city of Hoe-Am in accordance with the last will of his mentor, Min Sung Kang. Shin Kim and his comrades put their lives on the line as they head for the final showdown...

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Sangeki Kaiiki: Shark Panic
title_japanese: 惨劇海域 シャークパニック
synopsis:
Seven classmates reunite in their hometown for the first time in a while. They rent a recreational boat and experience a fleeting sense of freedom, but in the sea lurks a giant man-eating shark. One after another, the youths fall prey to the shark. And when the boat breaks down during the shark attack, it's a desperate situation in the open ocean!

(Source: Nihon Bungeisha, translated)

title: Scent of a Witch
synopsis:
Beyond the borders of the kingdom of Yarke, is the blighted land of Uren. Peasants and nobility listen with open ears as travelers recount tales of witchcraft under the moonlight. As tensions mount, the third prince of Yarke travels outside of his kingdom under a full moon only to encounter a beautiful woman. While the prince is charmed by her graceful appearance, she isn't all that he seems.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Shoudou
synopsis:
Nagisa Yamagami is a high school girl in her rebellious phase. Constantly in trouble at school, she has even abandoned her one redeeming quality—ballet—in opposition to her mother's wishes. However, on the way home one day, a chance encounter with a blind teenage boy in the middle of town changes her fate drastically.

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Konjiki no Gash!! 2
synopsis:
100 demon children fought to determine the new king of the demon world. Once the war ended, the new king was crowned, and the demon world was at peace... or so you thought! The shocking reality of the current-day demon world is now revealed—and deep in the maw of despair, three demon children make a dangerous gambit.

(Source: Birgdin Board, translated)

title: The Villain's Beloved Daughter
synopsis:
It's already unfair that I suffered greatly because I closely resembled the saintess, but why did the villain kill me without any mercy at all? No, actually, it said in the book that I was really bound to die. 'My life is already ruined. Of all things, why do I have to be the one to die a ridiculous death?' There's still hope! I haven't met any of the characters yet so I'll just run away! But why did the villain collapse in front of me...?

With a lot of effort, I barely saved the life of the villain who was on the brink of death. But now he's saying that he wanted to adopt me as his daughter and raise me to be a saintess?! Just like that, I decided to become his daughter for a few days before leaving quietly.

"My daughter is a genius. There's no child that is more angelic in this world other than my daughter."

title: Abella's Dessert Cafe
synopsis:
Seo Hyunji was just an ordinary office worker when she died and was reborn as Lady Abella Travis, the daughter of a wealthy noble family. Sadly, in this life, she has horrid in-laws, a playboy husband, and ultimately ends up dying tragically with no way of getting revenge. Reborn as Abella again, she vows that this time, things will be different. She calls off her wedding and decides to fulfill her fantasy of opening a dessert cafe. Will she finally have the sweet life she always dreamed of?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Divorcing My Tyrant Husband
synopsis:
When the strong-willed Im Jeongah reads a novel titled The Flower From Another World, she sincerely relates to the villainess. Empress Robellia Blanchett is slowly pushed out by the saintess from another world, Aisha, who wins the heart of the tyrant emperor, Alexandros Grandia Kshayarsha Le Castilla. Robellia eventually dies, and Alexandros never even bats an eye.

Jeongah suddenly awakens in Robellia's body, determined to break free and repeatedly demand a divorce until the emperor yields. The new Robellia has no emotional connection to her indifferent husband, though she quite dislikes Aisha's obvious pretense. Although Alexandros harbors no kind feelings for Robellia, her uncharacteristic request and subsequent acting out only pique his curiosity. The more outrageously Robellia rebels against him, the more Alexandros holds onto her, unwillingly falling for both her haughty temper and tender heart.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: The Max Level Heroine
synopsis:
Even if I rub it, I can't get a critical hit, so I'm suffering from a painful max-level goddess, Advent! Stress-free, fantastic, adventure, romance unfolded by her X mystic and pure deer man who fell into the world of the game! I was summoned to another world because of the quest window I accidentally clicked! A game that provides a realistic fantasy: Arcadia Online.

Joo Se-young, nicknamed "Honse Demon King," suddenly falls into another world "Arcadia." Her confusion is short-lived, but for her as a max-level user, her attack on this world is a breeze. She collects cute party members, destroys dungeons to get treasures, and has a relationship with Karad, a pretty pretty deer. However, the quest of God, which is conditional on Se-young's return to the original world, entangles Se-young and her companions in a grand and dark conspiracy! Besides, to complete the quest, you have no choice but to sacrifice Karad...? Will she be able to break through the series of legendary difficulties?

title: Marriage B: Wed to the Enemy
title_english: Marriage B: Wed to the Enemy
synopsis:
When Goyoh Rubiet receives a marriage proposal from Marquess Anthe Betelgeuse, she politely declines since she is already betrothed to her childhood sweetheart, Terrio Alte. However, Terrio no longer reciprocates Goyoh's affections and instead wishes to marry her younger sister, Melisse. Even so, Goyoh presses on, vowing her love to Terrio; consequently, Melisse is sent away to marry Anthe in her stead. This series of events marks the beginning of the end.

Years later, Anthe exterminates the Rubiet family, including his own wife. Only Goyoh remains, and she falls victim to Terrio's abuse as he blames her for Melisse's death. With nothing left to live for, Goyoh takes her own life. But in a twist of fate, she awakens in the past, back when she had just received the proposal from Anthe.

If she is destined for tragedy no matter whom she chooses, Goyoh would rather those she cares for most find happiness. Resigned, Goyoh takes Anthe's hand, but this marriage that was only a Plan B turns

title: Melody: The Crazy Flower Blooms
synopsis:
"I, Melody Corbella, wish to marry him!" The rest of the table reacted in a cold enough manner for the princess to feel ashamed, having raised her right arm vigorously with sparkles in her eyes.

And then, Prince Deimos broke the silence to open his mouth, "We must not send a nutcase like her, Your Majesty!!"

It was finally the moment where all of her crazy deeds in the past came to fruition; because the only way she could escape being sent off for royal marriage was to throw away the image of a princess that everyone expected. She chose to cut her hair short and be reborn as the Crazy Flower in the Royal Palace.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: You've Got the Wrong Girl
synopsis:
Evelyn Monstera knows two things. First, she's been reborn as a mean girl in a fantasy novel, and second, if nothing changes, her cruelty to the main characters will be her undoing. So when the male lead of the novel, Casis Urquio, comes to stay at her manor, all she has to do is stay out of his way. Unfortunately, Evelyn not only causes a fight between the protagonists, but also wins the affection of the male lead too! Can Evelyn set the story straight and get the happily ever after she wants?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: No More Nice Sis
synopsis:
When Yiren catches her fiancé and her crafty sister Rielle kissing, something in her snaps. She decides she must get married in order to escape her family. Yiren happens to learn that the icy, aloof Noel Cristan is looking for a bride in order to inherit his father's title of archduke. They agree to an arranged marriage to get what they both want, but it turns out Noel isn't the only one after his father's title. With all the family drama and intrigue, will Noel's family be any safer for Yiren?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: June Peach
synopsis:
The summer she turns 17, Leah Louise Riverton receives three prospective husbands. Antoine Guel's flattery and poetry are childish; Phil Rosemund's promises of riches do not excite her; but Duke Julian Hardy Raenal leaves an impression by only offering her a famous June peach from his estate. However, the duke never initiates another interaction.

Leah ends up marrying Antoine, but by the time she is 40, she only has a destitute and miserable life behind her. By a twist of fate, she turns back to the summer when she was 17 and decides to change her fate by accepting Phil's proposal. All over again, her husband proves to be rotten. A teenager once more, Leah swears off marriage.

When she meets Julian for the third time, Leah tells him all about her previous lives. They unexpectedly form a beautiful friendship, and the day of Julian's proposal approaches. But something strangely sinister bubbles under the surface bliss, and the truth behind all the years Leah has lived is a shadow she c

title: Still, I Like You
synopsis:
Minjae pushes Jinwoo away after five years but now ends up being suppressed by his pheromones. Another person who came to Minjae with a headache, Hyunwoo. Hyunwoo starts to shed tears at his reunion with his missing first love, Minjae, who disappeared. To make matters worse, Minjae even got a heat cycle. A story of three people that begins when everything goes awry.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Saigo no Ryuukishi no Eiyuutan: Panzer Ryouheidan Senki
title_japanese: 最後の竜騎士の英雄譚 パンジャール猟兵団戦記

title: Guan Jing Chuang Nei Bu Jujiao
synopsis:
After an accident that made him unable to distinguish people's faces, the main character is shocked when he realizes that he can see the new transfer student properly, and thinks he's found The One.

(Source: Zandy no Fansub)

title: Akasaka Buchou no Prince Boy Ikusei Keikaku
title_english: Mr. Akasaka's Prince Boy Training Plan
title_japanese: 赤坂部長のプリンスボーイ育成計画
synopsis:
Mr. Akasaka is a successful salaryman. He's got money, looks and style. But for some reason he cannot find a good man for himself. So after consulting his favorite bartender, he was given some great advice... "If you can't find a good partner, then just make one for yourself." Now Akasaka is determined to find himself a young partner who he can turn into the perfect prince! Maybe he may find one amongst his new work recruits...

(Source: Denpa)

title: JK-san Chi no Sartre-san
title_japanese: JKさんちのサルトルさん

title: Shinimodori Reijou no Lucetta
title_english: Lady Lucetta, Back from the Dead
title_japanese: 死に戻り令嬢のルチェッタ
synopsis:
"My second chance at life was never meant to turn out this way!"

To save her formerly illustrious family from destitution, Lady Lucetta Ambridge accepts a political marriage to Mister Kyle Wisley, a new-money businessman aiming for her noble title. On the day that their loveless marriage is set to start, Lucetta is killed by a gunman with a grudge against Kyle, and she is sent back in time by two years!

Now equipped with knowledge of the future, Lucetta is determined to pay off her family's debts alone by secretly becoming a fortune-teller renowned for her accuracy, so that she can break off her engagement, and finally marry for love. However, Kyle himself suddenly comes to seek her prophetic advice, on none other than...his secret, decades-long love for Lucetta?!

Who will win out in the end—the besotted Kyle, or the determined-to-run Lucetta? Are they both too hard-headed to get along? Will this end up being more of a comedy or a romance?

So yeah, what should have totally ended someone else's career might just end up being the thing that lands Hee-tae the deal of a lifetime.

Living as a fictional heroine is stressful, so why bother? Having read the story in her past life, Eliana, faithful maid to heroine Eslyn Arnele, knows it's far better to be a well-paid extra. While serving Eslyn, Eliana uses her knowledge of the story to buy some land. This catches the eye of Sortain Bisto, the villain set to steal Eslyn's fortune, who takes a liking to Eliana. Disinterested, Eliana vows to protect Eslyn and make it big in real estate, but will pesky Sortain spoil her riches?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Bungou Stray Dogs: Dazai, Chuuya, Juugosai
title_english: Bungo Stray Dogs: Dazai, Chuuya, Age Fifteen
title_japanese: 文豪ストレイドッグス 太宰、中也、十五歳
synopsis:
Yokohama's Suribachi district is a lawless zone swarming with all kinds of people. To protect each other, a group of teenagers created a self-defense organization called Sheep, with 15-year-old Chuuya Nakahara as their "King." Thanks to Chuuya's powerful ability to control gravity, few dare oppose the Sheep.

However, worrying news spread around Suribachi: the Port Mafia's deceased leader has been witnessed roaming around. His successor, Ougai Mori, sends his protege Osamu Dazai to uncover the truth. While investigating, Dazai runs into Chuuya, and a fight erupts between the two. But before Chuuya can deal the final blow, the Port Mafia captures him.

Mori offers Chuuya a deal: if the teenager helps unravel the mystery behind his predecessor's alleged resurrection, the Port Mafia will not harm any of Sheep's members. Backed into a corner, Chuuya reluctantly accepts. As he and Dazai are paired together, they must overcome their disdain for each other to save Yokohama. Unfortunately, the

title: Corridor of Mirs
synopsis:
Baek Nabi is saved from a speeding truck by a handsome man who disappears from the scene before she can thank him. The experience gives her the ability to see shadowy creatures attracted to negative emotions and a strange bracelet she can't take off. It's hard enough being a high schooler, but now she faces a supernatural world of Reapers and past lives. Why now and why her? Join Nabi as she simultaneously slays high school and Reapers, while unraveling the secrets that tie her to the mysterious new men in her life.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Komorebi Shoutengai no Changing Wonder
title_english: Changing Wonder of Komorebi Shopping Street
title_japanese: こもれび商店街のチェンジングワンダー

title: Seducing the Lady's Lover
synopsis:
I'm Lydel Cross. When I turned 18 the emperor trapped me in a magical tower and used me in whatever way he saw fit. That was the life I lived before it was rewound. In order to be happy during my second chance at life, I decided to turn away from anything related to magic, even becoming the maid of a count. At least, that's how it was supposed to be...

"You're the only person I have! Please steal him from Milena! I beg of you!"

Wait a moment, Master. The "boy" you want me to pull from her lady wouldn't happen to be the butler, whose face looks so much like the emperor's I can't get used to it, now would it? Just looking at his face makes me anxious, and you're telling me to seduce Graham? ...Will I not be able to live this life quietly either?

(Source: Peppermint, translated)

title: I'm the Queen in This Life
title_english: I'm the Queen in This Life
synopsis:
Fiancé, sister, and parent. The day Ariadne lost all of these, she returned to fourteen years in the past. "Shit! I'm trying to woo you right now!" From her fiancé, whose personality is completely different from her past life, "Don't cry, Ariadne. Do you even know how beautiful you are?" to the prince, who fell in love with her at first sight. This time, she's going to become the queen and get her revenge.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Talented Baby Squirrel
synopsis:
Beatty, a weak squirrel shapeshifter who was born into a lion family. Because of that, I lived my life being abused at my aunt's house in the capital. When I told my only friend and fiancé, the second prince, that I would leave to achieve my dream... "Ritter, you bastard...!"

I died on his fangs. I opened my eyes again to my childhood, the time before I got myself involved with the second prince. At times like this, what do you need? Speed. I immediately withdrew my body only and ran away to the territory of my biological father, the Lion Duke. Though I won't be welcomed, if I possess this one great secret that will only be discovered in the future, I won't get kicked ou—

"Welcome, Young Miss!"
"OMG! When did you grow up like this...?"
"Young Miss is walking with those two cute feet!"

...Huh? Why am I welcomed like this? No way, is that my statue?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: The Tyrant's Whereabouts
synopsis:
Once upon a time, there was a beautiful king who was merciless and greedy. Upon taking a look at his life record, God shook his head. God asked the three women who suffered greatly because of the king, "What punishment would you like him to receive?" Then, the three women, glancing at one another, answered all at once. "Please send all of us back to Earth."

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Ryuui no Luca
synopsis:
Luca was raised in a world where people can fly—to travel, work, or war—on the backs of dragons, and she knows what she wants to be: a dragon vet! Standing in her way are stringent admissions rules, impossibly difficult classes, and a notorious family name...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Bloody Romance
synopsis: We've all heard that people would do anything for their 15 minutes of fame, and up-and-coming Mukbang star, Hari Bang is no different. She was dead set on eating her way to the top until she got slammed with a doctor's order to lose 20 kg or run the risk of contracting diabetes, coronary heart disease, high blood pressure, and so on. Determined to get back to making mukbang videos, Hari starts exercising every day after school. Meanwhile, her classmate, Doyun On, has his own problems. Busy fighting his inner demons and trying to keep his urges to suck blood at bay, this half-vampire is in for a shock when the scent of Hari's blood proves impossible to resist. What makes things even harder is that Hari won't stop offering to let him drink her blood. This unlikely pair strikes up a deal to have weekly blood-sucking sessions. But, Doyun can't seem to figure out what makes her sweet-smelling blood so delicious and why she'd go to such trouble just for her career as a mukbang vlogger. As he

title: Stay Good Boy
synopsis:
Kaoru is a pro baseball player who's dating Seijirou, a police officer. Seijirou gets caught up with work and leaves Kaoru hanging for two months, causing him to suspect Seijirou of cheating!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Suezen ni Kiss
synopsis:
Tamaki finally gets his first crush after moving to the city, but ends up in an awkward situation when a friend literally delivers him to his doorstep one night—and he's in a frisky mood.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Jigoku no Gundan
synopsis:
A boy abandoned at birth and raised by rats, with the mysterious power to control rats, grows up seeing the dark side of the humans that rejected him, and vows to become humanity's greatest enemy.

(Source: MangaDex)

title_japanese: さよなら初恋またきたなんで
synopsis:
After graduating from high school, his old crush, Nao, whom he hadn't met, suddenly appears in front of him. Osamu was impatient, thinking that he should be working in Tokyo, but he said, "I'm going to work here because of a job transfer, so will you let me stay until you decide where to live?" He remembers him from his high school days, and when he witnesses the grown-up Minami, his old feelings seem to rekindle...?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Haikara Otome: Kaika Sengen
title_japanese: ハイカラおとめ〜開花宣言〜
synopsis:
The one who proposed to me is a mafia boss!? It is the age of Westernization during the Meiji era.  Asuka Haruomi, the daughter of a trading merchant, is being attacked on the street, when she is rescued by Gil, a blonde-haired, blue-eyed foreigner. Suddenly, having fallen in love at first sight, he proposes to her, but believe it or not, he is a mafia boss...?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Included one-shots:
Volume 1: Tsumetakute Attakai.
Volume 2: Kono En, Zannen Nagara.

title: The Naked Tree
synopsis:
The year is 1951. Twenty-year-old wallflower Kyeonga Lee ekes out a living at the US military Post Exchange where goods and services of varying stripes are available for purchase. She peddles hand-painted portraits on silk handkerchiefs to soldiers passing through. When a handsome, young northern escapee and erstwhile fine artist is hired despite waning demand, an unlikely friendship blossoms into a young woman's first brush with desire against the backdrop of the Korean War at its most devastating.

(Source: Drawn & Quarterly)

title: Gold Gray
synopsis:
Fifty years go, a virus sweeps through the world, wiping out all the omegas from the face of the earth. Rain, the sole surviving omega, lives his whole life hiding his identity—until he accidentally runs into Lukas. As the chairman of the facility that used to produce artificial omegas, Lukas has to produce an alpha heir in order to succeed his father's business. And while he has his mind set on winning Rain over, things don't seem to go so smoothly...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: PathFinder
synopsis:
Tomorrow is Garam's 25th birthday and not only have her parents forgotten, but she still hasn't found a full-time job. As she lay in bed wishing for another life, the clock strikes midnight and a strange window opens up before her. She steps through and discovers that she's a pathfinder, or a traveler of worlds. But somehow stepping into this other world has caused her family and everything she knew back on earth to disappear. To rejoin her family and set things back to normal, Garam will have to learn all that she can about being a pathfinder.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Detective Akutsu and a high school boy named Shino have recently taken notice of strange occurrences in Shibuya regarding disappearances of high school teenage girls. Shino believes that this may be related to a recent rumor regarding a demon girl named Karuta. The main question is though, is she an ally... or an enemy?

(Source: MU)

title: Serenade
synopsis:
A professor living a successful life with a secret. Two students who each have a hold on their mentor: one who knows her secret and another who reminds her of her first love... A romantic thriller that will leave you hanging for more.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Surviving as the Prince's Fiancée
synopsis:
On her way back home late one night, office worker Sophie stumbles into another world where she's a princess?! Well that's what Alan, prince of the Lapis Kingdom, says. To return to her world she must fulfill the prophecy and help Alan become king. Sophie agrees but...amidst a war for the crown, can she survive?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Admiral's Monstrous Wife
synopsis:
They call her a monster... but to this admiral, she's a sacred descendant of the sea! Rudia Flang has been mistreated her whole life, so when the emperor arranges her marriage to Alexander Cilia, war hero and the youngest admiral in history, she cowers in fear at the thought of marrying a violent seaman. As this ocean voyage treks on, she's met with benevolence from the Sercilian Island people who, unbeknownst to her, find the scales glistening on her body far from the marking of a monster...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Crowning a Spoiled Prince
synopsis:
Though sorcery and witches have long disappeared from the Elias Empire, the emperor was suddenly assassinated with an enchanted potion at Prince Theore Alpere's birthday banquet. In the ensuing chaos, Theore, although defiant as a child, is exposed to be a pushover, and despite Princess Legina B. Alpere's attempts to maintain order, she is eventually defeated by her treacherous fiancé, Herman Sylveig, and Annetta, the witch that helped him lead an uprising. However, apart from unique violet eyes, Legina inherited a relic from the first emperor: a pendant that allows her to sacrifice her own life for any wish.

Legina awakens as her 15-year-old self, now aware of the betrayal and tragedy that awaits. Most importantly, she remembers the witch's face and, this time, knows who to be wary of. Determined to crown the spoiled Theore, turn him into a proper ruler, and prevent the past from repeating, Legina must first ensure that Theore never becomes a weakling—by pretending to be an even bigg

title: Hyouka no Emi ga Saku
synopsis: Sawaguchi, a part timer at a coffee shop, offers to help his workmate Hisaki learn how to express her emotions. Together they try out different methods in order to achieve their goal.

title: Sex Influencer
title_japanese: セックスインフルエンサー
synopsis:
A pompous supermodel meets a stone-faced shopkeeper. Popular supermodel Akira Kuroaki has his regrets. Surrounded by a greedy, seedy modeling industry, he developed a nasty personality. One day, when he encounters a shopkeeper with a rude attitude, he decides to tease him and drags him into a fitting room. However, even when he initiates steamy activities in close quarters, the shopkeeper doesn't resist, let alone bat an eye. Perplexed, Akira can't get the sight of his o-face out of his mind... This encounter just might turn into love! Don't miss this modern-day love story! An arrogant supermodel and a poker-faced apparel shop staff fall in love under strange circumstances.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Love Comedy Manga ni Haitteshimatta node, Oshi no Make Heroine wo Zenryoku de Shiawase ni Suru

synopsis:
In the world of a popular rom-com manga, my only mission as the friend of the MC is to make the losing heroine, Sei-chan, happy!

"I'll definitely make you happy. Please go out with me."
"W-Wait, what!? Y-You're being serious...?!"

The manga adaptation of the sweet rom-com from Kakuyomu starts now!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

It was the happiest day in the world. Our sad and fleeting "love with a deadline" has begun.

In the winter of his freshman year of high school, Akito Hayasaka is diagnosed with a heart disease and told that he has little time left to live. In the midst of despair, Akito meets Sakurai Haruna, who is hospitalized at the hospital. Haruna, too, is seriously ill and has only a few days left to live. Akito begins to talk with her, hiding his illness, and becomes interested in Haruna, who says she is not afraid of dying. Can I still be in love with her? The days that pass by as he asks himself these questions begin to change?

The story is the ultimate story of pure love, with a sense of fragile beauty and tenderness in their daily lives, which are depicted in a lighthearted manner.

(Source: Poplar-sha, translated)

title: Loss Time ni Hanamuke wo
title_english: Send Them a Farewell Gift for the Lost Time
synopsis:
For four years, Naruse was swept up in his love for his novelist boyfriend, Toui. But tiring of his flightiness and lack of commitment, Naruse finally walks away from his relationship.

Or at least, he tries to. Every time he runs into Toui, they seem to get tangled in one another's emotions and end up sleeping together. They argue and fight, then afterwards comes the pang of regret. Maybe their relationship is doomed to fail. Or maybe, it just needs a new angle...

(Source: Tokyopop)

It is the Genroku era in the bustling Edo. With the unreliable Suki-san and Kaki-san in tow, the shameless Koumon-sama's journey through the provinces begins!!

Anton, the heir to the Arnault family, has finally come of age. As is customary for nobles, he is given access to the Cyrene Salon, a cafe filled with pleasure...and secrecy. After just one unforgettable evening with Arwin, the parlor's "number one," the normally reserved Anton has soon become filled with lust and curiosity. Who is Arwin? How did he come to such a place? What is his connection to the head of the Arnault family? But most importantly, why can't Anton get enough of him?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Tulong Mountain
synopsis:
Iryong can become a dragon after thousands of years of cultivation in the mortal world, replacing the gods to govern the heaven and the earth. But now it has been reduced to livestock that can be slaughtered and used in medicine. The Quan family clan has cultivated and slaughtered Iryong for generations. The youngest daughter, Quan Sanfu, accidentally met a wild Iryong in the woods, and thus started a tale of hostility between races...

(Source: MangaDex)

synopsis:
A freelance designer loves to relax from work through gardening on his balcony. There, he starts talking to his new neighbor next door and over the wall without knowing her face.

(Source: MU)

title: Atwight Game
synopsis:
The fantasy manga is set in a trading city named Kunlong, and centers on Marco, a minor member in the city's ruling crime syndicate, the Serpent Ring. Marco lives a normal, boring life, never dipping into notoriety. But his life takes a turn for the unique when he meets Atwight, a girl who seemingly fell from the sky. Atwight's arrival begins to upset the balance of not only Marco's life, but the regularity of life in Kunlong.

(Source ANN)

title: Kamatte Shinsotsu-chan ga Maikai Sasottekuru

synopsis:
"BLACK COMPANY, AAAAAAAA!!"

Masato Kazama, 26 years old, is a salaryman who works in an advertising a black comp... agency. In other words, a company slave. Nagisa Inami, Masato's kouhai, is a new employee and also the perfect heroine. She has good looks, is stylish, and is even a fast learner. She's also very friendly. The only downside is, she really loves her mentor Masato.

"Ehe～♪, You can praise me, but all I can give you is a kiss!"
"Senpai, let's go drinking again today"
"Here, I recommend this sake! Don't tell me you won't drink your cute kouhai's sake!"

Every time I finished my work, she always invites me to go drink drinking, and when she get drunks she acts spoiled.

"If we miss the last train, we can just stay in a hotel"
"......What?!"

Is it because she loves sake so much? Or because going home is a pain? Or because she is still in youth? Or maybe...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Sakagami-sama ga Tsuiteiru!
title_japanese: 逆神サマが憑いている!
synopsis: When high-schooler Yoshihiko Sumiyoshi makes a wish to become taller at a shrine, shrine maiden Ion Sakagami rushes to stop him, but she is too late. Sumiyoshi faints, and when he awakens, he finds he has shrunk to a miniature size...

title: Akabane Honeko no Bodyguard

synopsis:
They have only one goal—to kill Honeko Akabane! One day, Ibuki Arakuni learns that his childhood friend, Honeko Akabane, is being targeted by assassins! Both of them are in Class 3-4 at Sosoji High School, and Ibuki is ordered to protect Akabane for one year. His goal is to ensure that she graduates safely, but he must do so without her realizing it. And so begins his secret life as a bodyguard at school! However, there seems to be more secrets within "Class 3-4"...?! This is the start of a new and exciting action school comedy!!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: I Accidentally Tamed the Duke
synopsis:
In her parents' twisted political game, Yurania Vincent played the most important role: destroying the artifact that protects the entire empire from monsters. As a way to gain access to the artifact was through the Euclid family, her parents made her consume an herb that turns her blind and mute so that Duke Casius Euclid would take pity on her and marry her. In the end, Yurania was imprisoned for treason, forced to spend her miserable final days alone. Her desperate wish to rewind time and do everything differently suddenly comes true, and Yurania awakens in her bed days before she betrays her nation.

Yurania's priority is to regain her sight and voice by finding an antidote for the poison. Severing ties with her parents is the easiest task, but gaining independence and freedom requires that she leave the Euclid household without revealing her deceit. However, her plans are complicated when the usually cold and disinterested Casius starts to adamantly oppose the idea of divorce.

[Wr

title: Surge Towards You
synopsis:
Despite his impressive Olympic-level figure skating career, Dan Yi-rim has always considered himself defective. His pheromones do not give off a scent, even though he is an omega—a secondary sex defined by the ability to give birth and attract the socially superior alphas with their pheromones during a "heat cycle." When Yi-rim suddenly becomes lightheaded and falls into a river, he is saved by Yeom Cheong-ho, a professional swimmer. But Cheong-ho, an alpha, has been struggling with an extreme aversion to omega pheromones.

Yi-rim and Cheong-ho quickly discover that their unique constitutions are complementary and that sexual contact seriously improves Cheong-ho's performance in the pool. Desperate for human connection, Yi-rim is initially more than willing to be used by Cheong-ho. However, as Yi-rim's feelings change with time, he wonders if they will ever form an emotional bond.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Game Maou
synopsis:
Shrouded in pixels, reality becomes a video game! There's no going back! Real-life permadeath on ultra-difficulty, let the game begin!!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: My Civil Servant Life Reborn in the Strange World
title_english: My Civil Servant Life Reborn in the Strange World
synopsis:
Den made a promise to his mother on her deathbed that he would find a respectable job. And he almost kept that promise... until truck-kun sent him to a new world. Den is reborn as one of the most powerful magic users and is next in line to be chief of the fearsome Crow Tribe. But Den intends to keep his promise and runs off to the capital to become a civil servant. With a cast of colorful roommates, a family hunting him down, and a shadowy plot to overthrow the empire, can Den actually achieve his simple life goal?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Hanbun Kyoudai
synopsis:
Side-eyes. Confusion. Whispers. Giggles.

Being a mixed-race Japanese person is not easy, and that's especially true for Kazumi Mandanda Yoneyama and her brother. Despite being born and raised in the Land of the Rising Sun and having a Japanese mother, the siblings, who share a Black French father, are treated as outsiders. But knowing they have as much right to belong as anyone else, they and their mixed-race friends search for ways to cope and find wholeness in their half-Japanese identities.

In a country as homogenous as Japan, Kazumi and others like her must continue to put one foot in front of the other and contend with feelings of otherness every day. As they navigate this road rife with trials and pitfalls—microaggressions, misunderstandings, social transgressions, and racism—it becomes clear that self-acceptance isn't as simple as a wardrobe change.

This is a story of hope and the search for coexistence, dedicated to all those struggling with their identity.

(Source: VIZ Med

title: Fushigi Yuugi: Tokubetsu-hen
title_japanese: ふしぎ遊戯 特別編
synopsis: A special one-shot about Miaka and Tamahome, to celebrate the Fushigi Yuugi series' 30th anniversary.

title: I Stole the First Ranker's Soul
title_english: I Stole the First Ranker's Soul
synopsis:
Moa Son, an ordinary office worker, wakes up in a dungeon in the middle of the night and awakens as a collecting hunter. After barely making it out alive, she falls into the same dungeon but gets rescued by the first-ranked hunter, Jihan Seo, and becomes bound up with him. Now he's offering to make her strong on this one condition—"Promise me you will do your best to kill the bosses of all the dungeons that exist in the world." Come again?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: How to Be a Family
synopsis:
Do-yeon and Eun-ha, who became a family due to their parents' remarriage, become unrelated again due to their parents' divorce. After a few years, Eun-ha meets again, and Eun-ha is obsessed with Do-yeon. His feelings for Eunha are not "brotherly love."

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Makita-kun no Koiji wo Jama suru to Shinu
title_english: Don't Get in the Way of Shun's Romance
title_japanese: 牧田くんの恋路をジャマすると死ぬ
synopsis:
Kaoru, a high school student infamously known as a fighting-fanatic, gains a sudden fascination with a new transfer student who is rumored to be incredibly dangerous. One day, he witnesses this mysterious underclassman, Shun, in a blood-boiling fight and ends up falling head-over-heels in love... But, when he goes to confess, he's mistaken as another attacker and must defend himself against the younger boy's lethal strikes! While the fight leaves Kaoru beaten and bruised, he suddenly finds himself being kissed...!? As if that wasn't confusing enough, Shun seems endeared by Kaoru's inexperience with love and agrees to date him, kicking off the start of a terrifying romance!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Tengu no Daidokoro
synopsis:
On, a boy from New York, discovers he is a descendant of a tengu. According to their traditions, after reaching 14 he must spend a year of seclusion in Japan with his older brother, Motoi Izuna. Tengu aren't particularly powerful; they live a simple life working in the fields and enjoy cooking, which only disappoints On. His interest only gets caught after discovering his brother has wings! Will he also develop tengu powers?!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

A young girl, Memempu, who wants to be a Marker one day, and a man, Gagumber, who used to be one. This mismatched father and daughter now take on the Labyrinth! "If there's no path, dig one!"

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title_japanese: クズ浪人生、人生が辛いので夜のお姉さんを呼んでみた
synopsis:
Makino failed her college entrance exam. She only finds comfort in her 2D game characters... until she finds an ad for a call-girl who looks exactly like her favorite in-game waifu! The yuri love comedy between a gullible young woman and a street-wise call-girl begins!

(Source: COMICSMART, translated)

title: Tensei Ojisan, Heroine ni Naru.
title_japanese: 転生おじさん、ヒロインになる。
synopsis:
Ittetsu Wakigata—A straight forward, family man who has worked for more than 23 years as a company employee. His job title is general manager but in his off time, he likes reading manga? This salaryman who was living a mediocre yet happy life, got reincarnated into the world of a Shoujo Manga. "How did I end up in this place as a high school girl? My beloved family must be waiting for me!" Cheer on this reincarnated uncle as you read this story ripe with love and laughter!

(Source: Flex Comix, translated)

title: I Confessed to the Boss!
synopsis:
Everyone loves Mr. Perfect, team leader Dohoon Ji—except for one person, that is. For the past two years, Dajung has only had eyes for her coworker, Hyunwoo. On the night of the company dinner, Dajung runs after him as he leaves and asks him to be her boyfriend. However, once the tall figure she confesses to steps out of the shadows, Dajung realizes she was talking to none other than Mr. Perfect himself! But what's more shocking is... he agrees to date her! What in the world is he thinking?!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Pizzicato no Nemuru Mori
synopsis:
Emily has lived a sheltered life. Longing for a life like the protagonist in her beloved novel who shares the same name, Emily leaves home on her own and travels to the villa inherited from her great-great-grandfather on Hazama Hill. There, she finds a sleeping boy. Named Shura, he says he was given the house key and deed to the villa from a backpacker...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Aisaretagari no Gemini
title_japanese: 愛されたがりのジェミニ
synopsis:
Sae Hagiura, a typical college student who just wants to have a normal, low-key life, learns that the tall and handsome returnee twins Yu and Shu have enrolled at his college. Even though he's decided to avoid them as much as he can since they aren't his type, he spots them arguing with a woman by the red-light district on his way home from work. After Yu and Shu use Sae by pretending they have dinner plans with him to get the woman to leave them alone, they drag him into their shop and use him some more...!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Ore no Level Up ga Okashii!: Dekiru Otoko no Isekai Tensei
title_japanese: 俺のレベルアップがおかしい！ ～デキる男の異世界転生～
synopsis:
Zarmen, an adventurer who can't level up decides to retire from the adventurer business. Furthermore, in order to graduate from virginity, he decided to splurge on all the assets that he had diligently saved up since his reincarnation at a high-class brothel. The woman who appeared in front of him was the finest woman he would ever have known. Thanks to her hospitality, Zarmen fully enjoys his first time, but at that moment, his ears hear a mysterious announcement...

[Impregnation confirmed.]
[Level up!]

"Does this mean that the more 'seeding' I do, the stronger I get?"

An extraordinary implantable foreign world adventure fantasy created by a bottom adventurer who has been at level 1 for many years levels up through sex!

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

title: Saint Seiya: Kaiou Saiki - Rerise of Poseidon
title_japanese: 聖闘士星矢 海皇再起 RERISE OF POSEIDON
synopsis:
The manga's story begins when a new threat arises while Athena's warriors are busy fighting Hades. To combat the new threat, Poseidon, the emperor of the sea, awakens.

(Source: ANN)

title: How Did I Become the Princess?
title_english: How Did I Become the Princess?
synopsis:
Once upon a time, ​​I was a weary, nameless warrior with neither family nor money. Some might say this was just my lot in life, but not me. When I am given the chance to return to the past, I take it, hoping to return to simpler times. However, after turning back time, I am shocked to learn that I am actually Princess Nanael, the long lost daughter of the emperor of Ovyulia. With my new name and new home, I'm dead-set on not losing my family ever again.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Preventing the Making of a Tyrant
title_english: Preventing the Making of a Tyrant
synopsis:
In contrast to her past life in Korea, the storybook world Rayne Haatz inhabits is full of wonders—think dreamy powers, nobles inspired by card suits, and anthromorphs. There's just one issue... her destiny in this world is to die! Luckily, it seems that someone wants her alive. In her fourth life, Rayne vows to stop her scheming family from giving Emperor Jaynen the dark nightmares that drive him mad and lead to her death. But after three deaths, has Rayne learned enough to change her fate? Or will her feelings for Jaynen complicate her plans?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Catching Two Birds With One Sweet Princess
title_english: Catching Two Birds With One Sweet Princess
synopsis:
After awakening in a webnovel as Princess Clara, this former office worker isn't getting the royal treatment. As the shy sister of the tyrannical King Bastian, she's immediately faced with disdain and so much drama! Plus her character's destined to be seduced by his latest hostage, Crown Prince Daniel, accused of betrayal, and executed. But Clara's got a backbone and a plan to win over her brother. She's ready to take control, slap some sense into meddling nobles and servants, and resist the charms of her handsome (really handsome) charge!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Shibanban
synopsis:
Meet Aka, Kuro, Cha, Shiro, the Roly-Poly Pups, and the rest of this colorful cast of adorable Shiba Inu dogs! Whether they're venturing out into stormy weather in a raincoat, lazing at the beach, napping in a cozy dog bed, or eagerly eyeing dinner someone left out on the table, their fun (and sometimes mischievous) antics are sure to delight.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Ryuuou Heika no Gekirin-sama: Honzuki Nezumi Hime desu ga, Nazeka Ryuuou no Saiai ni Narimashita
title_english: The Dragon King's Imperial Wrath: Falling in Love with the Bookish Princess of the Rat Clan
title_japanese: 竜王陛下の逆鱗サマ ～本好きネズミ姫ですが、なぜか竜王の最愛になりました～
synopsis:
In a fantasy world inspired by ancient China, thirteen clans rule the land, and the Rat Clan is the weakest. Rueiin, the princess of the Rat Clan, is summoned to the land of the dominating Dragon Clan along with the princesses of the other tribes. The Dragon King seeks a bride, and they are all candidates! Instead of vying for the Dragon King's favor, though, Rueiin takes the chance to lose herself in the palace's enormous library—a place she can read to her heart's content, since she's driven by an insatiable curiosity. It's there that she's "found" by the Dragon King himself, who immediately kisses her and claims she's the one for him?! A fantastical love story begins!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Tarinai Futari
synopsis:
Can his male coworker help Kio get over his failed romance?

Knowing he'll never be special to his boss, Kio Shioumi hides his feelings for her behind a smile. One day, his expressionless coworker Osamu Bannai recognizes something's up, and asks him how it feels to be in love. Caught off-guard by the question, Kio's even more perplexed when... Osamu asks him out! Osamu wants to date the real Kio, not the character he plays around the office. An awkward robot of a man and a down-in-the-dumps Kio embark on a trial romance to find the true meaning of love!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Kusushi no Hakushaku Reijou wa Densetsu no Koryuu ni Aisareru
title_japanese: 薬師の伯爵令嬢は伝説の仔竜に愛される
synopsis:
The earl's daughter Fiz inherited her mother-in-law's skills as a pharmacist, which were already becoming obsolete. One day, she found a baby dragon who lost its parents, and she secretly took care of it. She named it Kuel, who was the legendary Holy Dragon Rune Fairies Dragon and could manipulate various magics and even become a humanoid! Fiz tries to raise the beast even though she is unfamiliar with parenting, but due to the schemes of her sister-in-law and her fiancée, she is falsely accused of murdering her lord.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Oshikake Gal no Nakamura-san
title_japanese: 押しかけギャルの中村さん
synopsis:
Akiyama and Nakamura-san are polar opposites. As an easily flustered otaku, Akiyama can't even imagine a world where an outgoing, flashy gal like Nakamura wants anything to do with him. But after she saves his life, she demands something unbelievable—to live with him! Proud, bold, and unafraid to show off her body, Nakamura is the perfect image of a gyaru. Except, the moment she's apart from Akiyama, she becomes a flustered, blushing mess. Discover what sweetness lies beneath the surface in this odd couple rom-com.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Yakutatazu to Iwareta node, Watashi no Ie wa Dokuritsu shimasu!
title_japanese: 役立たずと言われたので、わたしの家は独立します！
synopsis:
Flora, the daughter of the western frontiers Margrave, came back from the battlefield to find out that her fiancé wishes to annul their engagement. It didn't really matter to her, but what did that foolish prince mean by "a worthless nobody of the Margrave's family on the edge of civilization"? And while there are signs of a conspiracy in court, even worse news about the invasion of demons arrives from the territory. The advance of the saint, who is loved by the legendary dragon and the fluffy spirits, has finally begun!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Ouji no Honmei wa Akuyaku Reijou
title_english: Game World Reincarnation: Sex on the First Night
title_japanese: 王子の本命は悪役令嬢
synopsis:
You're my fiance, so it's only natural that we do this tonight. He kisses me deeply and devours my whole body... My first sweet sex on my first night of reincarnation.

(Source: WWWave Corporation)

title: Grandeur Oukoku Saiseiroku: Hametsu no Akuyaku Oujo desu ga Kyuukoku End wo Onozomi desu
title_japanese: グランドール王国再生録 破滅の悪役王女ですが救国エンドをお望みです
synopsis:
Mari, a former management consultant, reincarnated as the villain princess Violetta in the otome game Grandor Koi Revolution.

If I proceed according to the scenario as it is, I'll be executed... I absolutely hate that ending! So I changed my ways and started to move for the sake of the people and country. But one change from the kingdom's former consultant and the entire kingdom is changing before I even realized it?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: When the Black Moon Rises
synopsis:
Sehwa Ju lived a blessed life as a daughter of the mystic realm's most powerful clan, until she was framed for treason and executed by those she trusted most. But when the power of a divine wish grants her a second chance, she knows that she must use it to save her family and take down the corrupt clan leaders. With the handsome head of the rival Baek clan as her unlikely ally, Sehwa is set on revenge, but with those closest to her still plotting against her, is history doomed to repeat itself?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kirawaretai no: Koushokuou no Kisaki wo Zenryoku de Kaihi shimasu
title_english: The Love King and His Ornamental Wife
title_japanese: 嫌われたいの～好色王の妃を全力で回避します～
synopsis:
Sir Alphonse... Ah, when I think of him, my heart burns with love. But if I marry him I'll become the Love King's queen and be banished from the country. Quite an unfortunate end.

Ugh, I hate this life! Which is why I want him to hate me...

So from that day onwards, the Duke's daughter, Louise, works hard to make her fiancé Alphonse hate her.

(Source: NHN comico Corp.)

title: Ore wa Kage no Eiyuu ja Arimasen! Sekai Kusshi no Majutsushi?...... Nani Sore (Bou)
title_english: I Am No Hero of the Shadows!
title_japanese: 俺は影の英雄じゃありません!　世界屈指の魔術師?……なにそれ（棒）
synopsis:
The Hero in the Shadows—a mysterious savior who appears and disappears out of nowhere to rescue those in need. To the world, his identity is an enigma... or at least it WAS, until the entire town discovers it's none other than Phil Salembart, the lazy, womanizing son of a count!

Now stuck with the embarrassing truth out in the open, Phil scrambles to deny it—while women indebted to his hero alter ego keep flocking his way: a saint, a noble's daughter, even the kingdom's princess?!

A fantasy comedy that starts AFTER the big reveal—because this Hero didn't stay in the shadows for long!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: 99-kai Danzai sareta Loop Reijou desu ga Konse wa "Chouzetsu Aisare Mode" desu tte!? Shin no Chikara ni Mezamete Hajimaru 100-kaime no Jinsei
title_english: The 100th Time's the Charm: She Was Executed 99 Times, So How Did She Unlock "Super Love" Mode?!
title_japanese: 99回断罪されたループ令嬢ですが今世は「超絶愛されモード」ですって!? ～真の力に目覚めて始まる100回目の人生～
synopsis:
Alphina is falsely accused of plotting to assassinate Saint Debonaire. Time rewinds every time she's executed for a crime she didn't commit, but with the cruel Saint Debonaire against her, the same fate awaits Alphina ninety-nine times in a row: death by decapitation. But something different happens the hundredth time around. Just as Alphina is preparing herself for yet another execution, she discovers that she can hear people's true feelings—and that everyone secretly loves her! Can Alphina take advantage of her newfound ability and sidestep her fate at the guillotine?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Konyakusha ga Uwaki Aite to Kakeochi shimashita. Ouji Denka ni Dekiai sarete Shiawase nanode, Imasara Modoritai to Iwaretemo Komarimasu.
title_english: A Royal Rebound: Forget My Ex-Fiancé, I'm Being Pampered by the Prince!
title_japanese: 婚約者が浮気相手と駆け落ちしました。王子殿下に溺愛されて幸せなので、今さら戻りたいと言われても困ります。
synopsis:
Amelia is a studious young countess and water mage. Her fiancé, Reese, is the second son of a marquis and wields earth magic, a desirable skill for the agricultural domain that Amelia's father rules. The couple grew up together and has always gotten along well, so their happy future together seems certain. Yet after Reese enters the Royal Academy of Magic, Amelia loses all contact with him. Although she assumes he's just busy with his studies, when she enters the academy a year later herself, her classmates inexplicably ostracize her as Reese continues to avoid her. Throughout this confusing ordeal, the isolated and anxious Amelia finds comfort in the kindness of Sarge, the fourth prince, who seems to have taken an interest in her...

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Yomei Hantoshi to Senkoku sareta node, Shinu Ki de "Hikari Mahou" wo Oboete Noroi wo Tokou to Omoimasu. Noroware Ouji no Yarinaoshi
title_english: I Only Have Six Months to Live, So I'm Gonna Break the Curse with Light Magic or Die Trying
title_japanese: 余命半年と宣告されたので、死ぬ気で『光魔法』を覚えて呪いを解こうと思います。～呪われ王子のやり治し～
synopsis:
Prince Callus was born with a mortal curse that marks him as a Taboo Being. His days are numbered, and he's been told the last six months of his life will be nothing but bedridden suffering. This grim future haunts him...until he meets Gourley, who can wield light magic. Callus becomes the magician's apprentice in hopes that this legendary power might dispel his curse if he can manage to master it in the time he has left. He has immense magical energy and the rare ability to see spirits on his side, after all, not to mention friends and family who are there to support him every step of the way. And so Callus stakes his life on this mission... It's time to learn light magic or die trying!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Kanpekisugite Kawaige ga Nai to Konyaku Haki sareta Seijo wa Ringoku ni Urareru
title_english: The Too-Perfect Saint: Tossed Aside by My Fiancé and Sold to Another Kingdom
title_japanese: 完璧すぎて可愛げがないと婚約破棄された聖女は隣国に売られる
synopsis:
Philia hails from a family renowned for producing generations of saints, and she is no exception. In fact, she is known as the most powerful saint of all time, so extraordinarily gifted that many people find her insufferable. When even her fiancé decides he can’t stand her, he suddenly calls off their engagement. He’s so eager to never see her again that he sells her off to a neighboring country in dire need of a saint of their own. Now, Philia readies herself to face the unknown, fully expecting more miserable treatment. After all, she’d be a fool to expect anyone to welcome her with open arms…right?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Osagashi no Hatsukoi Aite wa Tabun Watashi desu, to wa Totemo Ienai.: Toubou shita Moto Seijo, Mofumofu wo Kojiraseta Seinen to Saikai suru
title_japanese: お探しの初恋相手はたぶん私です、とはとても言えない。~逃亡した元聖女、もふもふをこじらせた青年と再会する~
synopsis:
Medi, an escaped ex-saint who can transform into a wolf, lives in the forest. One day, when she was in the form of a wolf, she saved a lovely boy who got lost in the woods. Ten years later, a beautiful young man named Claude visits Medi. 

"I'm looking for the wolf who saved me in this forest a long time ago." Medi tries to deceive him by hiding that she can turn into a wolf, but Claude asks her to help him find the wolf?!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Isekai no Boukun Outaishi ni Metoraresou desu: Tensei Majo wa Kuroki Ookami ni Kyuuai sareru
title_english: The Tyrant Crown Prince From Another World Wants to Marry Me!? The Black Wolf Courts the Reincarnated Witch
title_japanese: 異世界の暴君王太子に娶られそうです！？～転生魔女は黒き狼に求愛される～
synopsis:
After meeting an unfortunate accident and losing consciousness, corporate slave Yuki wakes up in a fantasy world! Thinking she'd live a dazzling new life in a new land, she's instead hunted by scoundrels and takes refuge in a brothel. She finds herself in even more danger, though, as she's called a witch! Just then, the mysterious knight Matias comes to her rescue. However, he expects her body in return. His aggressive kisses and sweet caresses have her swept up in the pleasure. Matias takes an interest in her boldness and reveals that he's the crown prince! He passionately proposes, wanting Yuki for himself...!

(Source: Renta!)

title_english: The Tyrant Crown Prince From Another World Wants to Marry Me!? The Black Wolf Courts the Reincarnated Witch
title_japanese: 異世界の暴君王太子に娶られそうです！？～転生魔女は黒き狼に求愛される～

After meeting an unfortunate accident and losing consciousness, corporate slave Yuki wakes up in a fantasy world!
