Just then, the mysterious knight Matias comes to her rescue. However, he expects her body in return. His aggressive kisses and sweet caresses have her swept up in the pleasure. Matias takes an interest in her boldness and reveals that he's the crown prince! He passionately proposes, wanting Yuki for himself...!

(Source: Renta!)

title: The Only One Who Didn't Know
title_english: The Only One Who Didn't Know
synopsis:
Pyo Min is your average hetero dude in college: he likes his meat, never really has any money, and he really likes girls. Until he meets Jisoo, that is. After a night of too many drinks, he realizes that not only does he have it in him to sleep with the same sex, he...really likes it. But the deeper and deeper he finds his emotions for Jisoo become...the further Jisoo pulls away... What secret is Jisoo hiding?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Juujun Nadeshiko
synopsis:
1. Tsurego Shimai to Kindan no Doukyo Seikatsu
2. Harenchi Kinshi!: Watashi no Seiheki Barechatta!?
3. Himawari ga Saku Koro ni (When the Sunflowers Bloom)
4. JK Kanojo to Shitai Koto
5. Hatsujou Koinu Akane-chan
6. Ometsuke Kitsune Inaho-chan

title: Hen na Mono Mikke!
synopsis:
Toru Usui was transferred from the city office to a museum, where he had a shocking encounter with with Akari Kiyosu, an ornithologist. What happens behind-the-scenes at a museum, where their jobs will pay off 100 years later?

"I love this! I want to find out!"

For the first time in his life, Usui's heart was touched, by working with these extraordinary researchers, who live by these words!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Tonari no Aki to wa Kakawaranai
title_japanese: となりの秋とは関わらない
synopsis:
Uzuki Soetani is a contract worker who lives a modest, yet peaceful life, with her pet cat, Jujumaru. She also has a theory that, "all handsome men have a hidden dark side." Recently, to better her life with Jujumaru, Uzuki accepted her company's offer to become a permanent employee. But the workload turned out to be harder than she imagined and one day, Jujumaru fell sick. When she had to choose between her job and her cat, the man who had just moved in next door suddenly offered to look after Jujumaru. This man turned out to be Yamada Aki, someone Uzuki couldn't forget even if she wanted to...

(Source: Shodensha, translated)

title: Yeonwoo's Innocence
synopsis:
Yeonwoo is easily mistaken for a female student due to his soft and delicate appearance. He develops a crush on Haesol Kang, the most popular student in school. However, due to his shy and timid personality, Yeonwoo has never spoken to Haesol even once despite being in the same class.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Baihua Baise
synopsis:
Grown-ups have always told Yu-Fan that a girl should act like a girl: learn the piano, be quiet and dignified rather than noisy and rough, and wear skirts. Under pressure from their mother and grandmother, Yu-Fan has no choice but to hide who they really are and dress up as the girl they want them to be.

This story deals with the evolution of Yu-Fan through their quest for identity and acceptance, but also the evolution of their family and Taiwanese society, culminating in the legalization of universal marriage in 2019.

(Source: Nazca Éditions, translated)

title: A Red Laurel to My Emperor
title_english: A Red Laurel to My Emperor
synopsis:
The unparalleled daughter of a god of war, Loel Neares, the first princess of Tortia. She lost both her parents and got married as if she was being sold to the enemy country Kairos. But it was all her "choice." During the first night with Emperor Kairos... "I will offer you my homeland, the Tortias of the North," she told Ethan Kairos, the golden-eyed emperor in front of her, while offering a risky "trade."

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Suki na Ko ni Kokuhaku shitara Hamedori Douga ga Okurarete Kita Hanashi
title_japanese: 好きな子に告白したらハメ撮り動画が送られてきた話

title: The Little Lady Tames the Leads
title_english: The Little Lady Tames the Leads
synopsis:
Emille Serron lives a peaceful life as the daughter of a marquess—that is, until she realizes she's a background character in a novel! In anticipation of the tumultuous events to come, Emille devises a plan to score brownie points with each of the protagonists. That way, no matter how things turn out, she'll be able to continue living her life in comfort. However, her plan backfires as the leads begin to fight for her friendship. Will Emille be able to live the quiet life she dreams of living?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Handmade Tales of the Handmaid
title_english: The Handmade Tales of the Handmaid
synopsis:
An 89-year-old grandma passes away and wakes up in a totally different world as Grana, a teenage maid at Viscount Winston's estate. Grana's kind soul and her natural talents for needlework and other crafts quickly win the hearts of the Winstons and the other maids. But in this world, her skills seem somehow related to magic! As Grana makes fast friends with the young heir to the viscountcy and explores her unexpected abilities, what could possibly await her?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Nigashitakunai Aitsu wa Kiss mo Shiranai
title_japanese: 逃がしたくないあいつはキスも知らない
synopsis:
"Do you know how two men have sex?"

Makoto Kurose is a man who is capable and reliable at work. Haruki, who would blush with just a kiss, falls for that man. Even though Makoto only saw him as a part-timer, before long, he was charmed by Haruki, who honestly and genuinely adored him. Despite thinking he should hold back his feelings; he begins to have lewd dreams involving Haruki... One day, Haruki says to him, "If I'm going to be held, I'd be okay if Makoto-san was my partner," and he is unable to hold back his lust...?!

(Source: Kasakura Shuppansha, translated)

title: Kimi no Hitomi ni Utsuru Sekai
title_japanese: キミの瞳に映るセカイ

title: Ore ni mo Aitsu ni mo Kokuranaide Kure
title_japanese: オレにもアイツにも告らないでくれ
synopsis:
The absolute rule for idols is "no love!" Yuto Sato, a struggling man who is having trouble finding a job, happens to become the manager of the popular idol group MINE. He is given an important mission to prevent love scandals! However, the members of the group are starved for male companionship after years of idol life...? The leader of the group, Rira Fujishiro, the absolute center, Momoka Seiten, the fast-paced Sora Mizumi, the cheerful Asuka Kazaharu, and the youngest, Miruru Meisei... their slapstick cohabitation life begins!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Heavenly Sword's Grand Saga
synopsis:
There are people in the world that thinks they are the "chosen" of the heavens. It's been decades since chaos and strife among heroes ensued because of those people. A certain disciple who has six masters has been entrusted with the fate of the central plains. "If you guys are the heavens, then I'm the sword that'll pierce the heavens." That was what he'd resolved to do... No one mentioned he was a fatty, though! In any case, now that he's here, he'll need to save the... world... Damn it, lose some weight first.

(Source: JK Media, translated)

title: Dungeon Odyssey
synopsis:
When the war between the aboveground and underground ended, humanity was joined by so-called "dungeon babies," those gifted with supernatural abilities and an obsession with the labyrinths below ground. Despite being a dungeon baby, Jinwoo Kim suppressed his instincts, choosing to live an ordinary life as a guide and caring for his family. But when an expedition goes wrong and he somehow ends up becoming the new owner of a labyrinth, he discovers that he cannot ignore his instincts forever...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: 6-nin no Shinanai Shoujo to Kanarazu Shinu Unmei no Hito
title_japanese: 6人の死なない少女と必ず死ぬ運命の人

title: Second Try Idol
synopsis:
Hyunwoo was a seasoned member of an idol band about to debut, but after a severe accident on set left him scarred, he abandons his dreams of stardom and becomes an idol trainer. Bitter about his current trajectory, he wishes for time to turn back... and after a plane crash, it does! Suddenly, he's nineteen again, with no scar in sight, a huge audience watching his group compete for the top spot on a music talent show, and loads of stage experience from his trainer days. Will he lead his group to fame or fade from the spotlight once again?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Ore no Keikaku wa Zettai ni Kuruwanai!!
title_japanese: おれの計画は絶対に狂わない!!
synopsis: A gag manga about if Kuro got invited to the Pirates Festival.

title: Tensei Colosseum: Saijaku Skill de Saikyou no Onna-tachi wo Kouryaku shite Dorei Harem Tsukurimasu
title_english: Reincarnation Coliseum: The Weakest Skill Conquers the Strongest Women and Creates a Harem
title_japanese: 転生コロシアム～最弱スキルで最強の女たちを攻略して奴隷ハーレム作ります～
synopsis:
High schooler Kouji Mikagami is painfully average in every way—except when he's playing video games! So getting summoned to a magical world and granted the ability to copy his opponents' skills should be his way to the top. But before he gets the chance, he's thrown into the coliseum as a combat slave...for his trash-tier skill! In the midst of his despair, he realizes only one path remains open to him—beat down the strongest girls with the weakest skill and make a name for himself!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Ginga Chikyuushoku Guide (Nippon-hen)
title_japanese: 銀河地球食ガイド(日本編)

title: The Boss in the Bedroom
synopsis:
Director Goo, leader of Sales team 3 at Yeong-rong Corporation, is very adamant about keeping his personal life and his private life separate. At the office, he's a notoriously no-nonsense boss who can't stand sloppy work, especially from employees who got into the company using personal connections. When he's off the clock, he becomes Young-Jo; the college aged, regular customer at S&M lounge bar who loves being degraded and abused in the bedroom. On a night out, he hooks up with an alluring, extremely wealthy party boy who turns out to have sadistic sexual tendencies. After thoroughly enjoying a night filled with pain and pleasure, he returns to work the next day to find a nightmare situation awaiting him. Who knew the sales team 3 latest recruit would be the company CEO's son. And to make matters worse, he's the same man from the night before who had Young-jo crying out and moaning the word "hyung..."

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Acquainted: Encounter Spin-Off
synopsis:
What appeared to be a one-time encounter in Spain blossoms into romance when by-the-book CEO Wooseok Jung and free-thinking architect Yujin Han meet again in Korea. The two are drawn to each other, but there's a catch: Yujin's the winner of a high-profile architecture competition held by Wooseok's company. When word gets out that these two are acquainted, will their love be able to survive the public's scrutiny... and their families' even harsher criticism?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Rebirth
synopsis:
Yeo-dam's life has revolved around the emperor. The emperor made sure that not only would Yeo-dam's family and friends never be a part of his life, but that Yeo-dam would be mentally and physically crippled so as never to leave him. In spite of this—or perhaps because of this—Yeo-dam feels that the death that befalls the emperor is undeserved. As a pontifice to the goddess Hwi-seon, he is allowed one wish in exchange for his life and he chooses to use it on the emperor. But the goddess feels it was the emperor's actions on Yeo-dam that was undeserved and she returns Yeo-dam back into his original life as a child, but with a twist: he has the gift of divine powers.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Inkya no Boku ni Batsu Game de Kokuhaku shitekita Hazu no Gal ga, Dou Mitemo Boku ni Betabore desu
title_japanese: 陰キャの僕に罰ゲームで告白してきたはずのギャルが、どう見ても僕にベタ惚れです
synopsis:
When the gorgeous Nanami Barato confesses to Yoshin Misumai, it seems too good to be true! Only, it is—and Yoshin knows it. How's an introverted guy like him supposed to keep his cool when he knows this is all just a dare? Even more puzzling, despite her gaudy appearance, this supposed gyaru isn't actually all that good with guys! Perhaps this is the perfect chance for this shy guy to pluck up his own courage and say yes to the guy-shy girl. So begins their new cushy life of morning meet-ups and handmade lunches. The thing is, judging by the way she's acting, Nanami has fallen head over heels for him! From dares and dating to downright disasters, can these two first-timers figure out their feelings and maybe even fall in love—for real, this time?!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Redemption Camp
synopsis:
Da-ae's past and present is filled with dirty little secrets. It was about time someone noticed. The only problem is Gitae, the minister's son, is not your ordinary someone. He gathers all the people that suffered from Da-ae's dirty acts and starts the road to her redemption.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Do It One More Time
synopsis:
A dissatisfied married couple is given a second chance at love and are transported back in time to the day they met. Will they get back together or find new loves?

(Source: MU)

title: Sasaki to Miyano
synopsis:
Welcome one and all—to the fabulous life and times of Sasaki, Miyano, and their closest companions! Ever wondered how Kuresawa met his girlfriend? Want to find out if Miyano and Kuresawa were always friends? Or contemplated just why Miyano and Hirano are so close? The answers to these questions—and many more—will be revealed!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Shousetsu Cider no You ni Kotoba ga Wakiagaru
title_english: Words Bubble Up Like Soda Pop
title_japanese: 小説 サイダーのように言葉が湧き上がる
synopsis:
Cherry struggles with communicating—even more than the average teenager. He keeps his noise canceling headphones on to avoid conversation and has trouble putting his thoughts into words. Writing haiku seems to be the only way he can express his emotions. It's the final summer vacation of his high school years, and it's passing by fairly uneventfully as he packs to move out of town and works part-time at a senior care center. But one day, he encounters Smile, a live streamer who's self conscious about her buckteeth and braces. Days with her are more exciting, and as they help one of the seniors track down an old record he lost long ago, Cherry suddenly finds himself more inspired and invested than ever before.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Shinigami-chan wa, Choroi
title_japanese: 死神ちゃんは、チョロい

title: Matei Kyoushi to Juuzoku Shoujo no Haitoku Keiyaku
title_japanese: 魔帝教師と従属少女の背徳契約
synopsis:
Joseph, the successor of the Great Demon Lord, became a teacher in the Wizarding Academy with the help of the demon princess Lilith who has the power of "love" that helps him to successfully ascend the throne, but the reason is to form a "sexual love bond" with some of his students!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Tensei shita kedo Cheat Nouryoku wo Tsukawanaide Ikitemiru
title_japanese: 転生したけどチート能力を使わないで生きてみる
synopsis:
Alfredo, who was reincarnated as the third son of a powerful noble in a different world with a cheat ability, notices that reincarnators (apostles) in this world are thoroughly exploited. Alfredo, who wants to avoid being exploited by society, decides to live while hiding the cheat power he has. After safely making it through (failing) the apostle examination, he sets out on a pilgrimage, where he discovers something mysterious is going on with how this world works and the apostles...

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Nineteen
synopsis:
A narrative comic that illustrates some of the most funniest and sexiest experiences in a way only our creator, N.ya, can.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: How Far Have You Gone?
synopsis:
Looks cute and sweet? Don't judge a book by its cover. Here's a story about the intricate, private details of a newlywed's sex life. Neither his first love, first kiss, nor first experience was with me, but he was my first everything. So how far have you gone?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Ore wa Shiranai Uchi ni Gakkouichi no Bishoujo wo Kudoiteita Rashii: Baito-saki no Soudan Aite ni Ore no Omoibito no Hanashi wo Suru to Kanojo wa Nazeka Terehajimeru
title_japanese: 俺は知らないうちに学校一の美少女を口説いていたらしい ～バイト先の相談相手に俺の想い人の話をすると彼女はなぜか照れ始める～
synopsis:
Unassuming bookworm Tanaka Minato never imagined he'd cross paths with the cold beauty of his high school, Saito Rena. But after a chance encounter reveals their shared love of books, they start meeting in secret, bonding over literary discussions. To fund his hobby, Minato works part-time in disguise to avoid breaking the school's no-job policy. At work, he often seeks advice from his co-worker, Hiiragi Rena, about his peculiar situation. Yet, something about Hiiragi feels strangely familiar...

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Atri: My Dear Moments
synopsis:
In the near future, a sudden and unexplained sea rise has left much of human civilization underwater. Ikaruga Natsuki, a boy who lost his mother and his leg in an accident some years earlier, returns disillusioned from a harsh life in the big city to find his old countryside home half-swallowed by the sea. Left without a family, all he has to his name is the ship and submarine left to him by his oceanologist grandmother, and her debts.

His only hope to restore the dreams for the future that he has lost is to take up an opportunity presented to him by the suspicious debt collector Catherine. They set sail to search the sunken ruins of his grandmother's laboratory in order to find a treasure rumor says she left there. But what they find is not riches or jewels; it is a strange girl lying asleep in a coffin at the bottom of the sea. Atri.

Atri is a robot, but her appearance and her wealth of emotions would fool anyone into thinking she's a living, breathing human being. In gratitude for

title: This Must Be Love
synopsis:
After her show, singer and radio host Hana Ban receives a cassette player from a fan. But being just one among many gifts, she doesn't think much of it—that is, until the press of a button sends her to the 80s! There, she meets the cassette player's owner, who happens to be the late musician Jaeah Woo. However, Hana meets him at a time when he hasn't yet become famous and is on the verge of quitting music. Will she be able to convince her idol not to give up on his dream and save his life?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Bunny Honey
synopsis:
1-2. Congrats
3. Club Guide
4-5. Love in May
6-7. Unbalance
8. Ending

title: Isekai Danyuu: Shirudanyuu ga Isekai Tensei shite Ero Chishiki Full Katsuyou de Musou Danyuu ni Naru Hanashi
title_japanese: 異世界男優～汁男優が異世界転生してエロ知識フル活用で無双男優になる話～
synopsis:
On his way home from work, Seiji Aogai, a struggling actor in the JAV film industry, accidentally looks away and gets hit by a magic mirror JAV Truck! He wakes up in a medieval-like world and gets caught up in "filming" with beautiful elves?!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Visual Prison: Comics
synopsis:
After the death of his grandmother who raised him, Ange Yuki travels to Tokyo to pursue the ghost of a childhood dream. His favorite vocalist, Guiltia "Guil" Brion of the band ECLIPSE, was once active in that city. Although Ange does not believe he has what it takes to sing himself, he wishes to follow in his idol's footsteps.

While in Harajuku, Ange witnesses an unbelievable live performance by ECLIPSE, which has now been reduced to only two members. As he is caught up in the music, the rival band LOST EDEN crashes the show and violently ruins the atmosphere. Feeling overwhelmed by the strange phenomena surrounding the dueling musicians, Ange is on the verge of passing out when he comes face to face with the very person he longed to meet.

Full of wonder at this unexpected encounter and the subsequent opportunity to duet with Guil, Ange is taken off guard by an apparent teardrop falling from the sky and leaving a brand on his hand—OZ. The mark is proof that the Scarlet Moon has ackno

title: Denpatou
synopsis: Taking place in the future when the era of telecommunication has long gone, this one-shot tells a story about a girl and one of the last radios on earth.

title: Seikou Domination
synopsis:
1. Seichouki
2. Oni or Shot
3-5. Otome no Jouran
6. Amazarashi
7. Kanjuku Chijo Tankoubon Hatsubai Kinen: Merry Christmas Comic!!

title: Kahan no Machi no Céline
synopsis:
This story takes place in Paris, 19th century France. Céline is 14 years old and has no dreams, no ambitions, and no idea what she wants to do—a girl of few expressions who seems as if she "came from the moon." When she arrives in the capital, she meets an old gentleman who offers her a "work where you experience jobs," but what could this mean? Perhaps Céline will learn more about herself in this rapidly developing city of Paris.

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

title: Saikyou Tenshi to Baito Senshi
title_english: The Strongest Angel and Part Time Job Warrior
title_japanese: 最強天使とバイト戦士
synopsis:
I'm in charge of training the part-timers of a game store. I was surprised to find out that the super cute newcomer, Nagisa, is the top ranked gamer "NAGi!" As I train her, the distance between us gradually shrinks, and our hearts won't stop beating...!?

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)

title: Warau Arsnotoria Sun!
title_english: Smile of the Arsnotoria the Animation
title_japanese: 咲うアルスノトリアすんっ！

title: Tsuihou sareta Cheat Fuyo Majutsushi wa Kimama na Second Life wo Ouka suru. Ore wa Buki dake ja Naku, Arayuru Mono ni "Kyouka Point" wo Fuyo Dekiru shi, Ore no Ishi de Itsudemo Kouka wo Kaijo Dekiru kedo, Nokotta Hitotachi Daijoubu?
title_english: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life
title_japanese: 追放されたチート付与魔術師は気ままなセカンドライフを謳歌する。～俺は武器だけじゃなく、あらゆるものに『強化ポイント』を付与できるし、俺の意思でいつでも効果を解除できるけど、残った人たち大丈夫?～
synopsis:
Rein the Enchanter is a support mage with the ability to enhance weapons and armor. But when he gets fired from his guild for the simple reason that he's already enchanted everything they own, he decides to take the power back into his own hands—literally! Rein recalls every enchantment he ever put on his guildmates' gear, retrieving the bonus points for himself. But does he really not have anything better to enchant with them than some Plain Clothes and a Copper Sword...? Come along on a cheat-tier journey from the most common of common origins!

(Source: Kodansha)

title: Monster Streamer for Gods
synopsis:
In Gangshik Choi's world, monster attacks are a common occurrence. Humanity is protected by hunters with superpowers who stream their fights online, and it is Gangshik's job to get it all on camera as the cameraman for a below-average monster streamer. In a stream gone wrong, he suddenly finds himself in front of the camera... but human viewers aren't the only ones watching him. Now, he is a streamer for the Gods, and more viewers mean more power. With monsters at every turn, how long can Gangshik keep the cameras rolling?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Ai to Yobu ni wa Mada Aoi
title_japanese: 愛と呼ぶにはまだ青い
synopsis:
"For some reason, for the first time in my life, I'm being kissed by a man."

The extraordinarily normal salaryman, Sawatari Takumi, has the same old conversation with his friend, Inubushi Motoki, on the way home from work. At least, that's how it's supposed to be, but he's suddenly kissed! "I've always thought you were cute." Takumi, unable to hide the shock and confusion he feels about his friend's sudden coming out, rejects Motoki with thoughtless, harsh words. Though he thought their relationship would end with that, things take an unexpected turn...! Thus starts a painfully sweet adolescence for these adults.

(Source: Sankosha, translated)

title: Boku ga Shachiku wo Yamete kara
title_japanese: 僕が社畜をやめてから

title: Panzer Geist
title_japanese: 機甲幽霊〈パンツァーガイスト〉

title: Boku no Kanojo wa Kirei ni Warau
title_japanese: 僕の彼女はキレイに嗤う
synopsis:
"I'll never tell Kii-kun!!" Kiichi's childhood friend Tsubaki harbored a certain "secret."  But when he pressed, he'd get: "It's fine, it's fine. I'm fine." A psycho-horror romance manga jumbled with pure love.

(Source: COMICSMART, translated)

title: Lady Devil
synopsis:
"Devil, I don't want to marry him."

In hopes to escape a forced marriage, Giovinetta makes a wish to the devil to save her, but what she doesn't know are the consequences of her actions. Read the steamy story of a girl who just wants to be with the one man she is forbidden to love.

(Source: Manta)

title: Gudaguda Taikouden Zipang
synopsis: A side story of Koha-Ace, featuring a Holy Grail War set during the Sengoku period.

title: Ryuugoroshi no Brunhild
title_japanese: 竜殺しのブリュンヒルド
synopsis:
Eden is a place of perfection, protected from outside harm by the silver dragon. In this idyllic land, the dragon raises a human girl found on the island's shores as his own. But when the dragon's life is mercilessly snuffed out by human machinations, the girl must choose whether to heed his dying wish and stay the course of righteousness... or walk a path of vengeance.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Ochikobore [☆1] Mahoutsukai wa, Kyou mo Muishiki ni Cheat wo Tsukau
title_english: The Dropout 1☆ Magician Unconsciously Uses Cheats Today as Well
title_japanese: 落ちこぼれ[☆1]魔法使いは、今日も無意識にチートを使う
synopsis:
The world of Lemshiria is guarded by twenty-two Gods. There one receives a special power called an "arcana" during their rite of adulthood, which determines their worth with "stars." The story follows Aster, a one-star "cheat" Magician.

(Source: MU, edited)

title: Tentacle Recipe
synopsis:
A man steps into a VR game room, looking for some light VR fun after a drunk night out—but the next thing he knows? He's trapped inside the game, being toyed by huge demonic tentacles! His captors, the crafty devil duo, pay no attention to his cries for help as they scout for their next target to be trapped in the cycle of endless agony and pleasure.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Dear My Killer Tune
title_japanese: ディアマイキラーチューン
synopsis:
Hairdresser Harutaka is a super-fan of Reiichi Himemiya, the guitarist of the legendary rock band The Lazy Rats. He's been devoted to the band for years, going to their concerts and amassing a gigantic merch collection. But when Reiichi walks into the salon Harutaka works at one day, the line between fan and celebrity begins to blur...

(Source: Animate International)

title: Toiro-kun wa Chikazukitai kara Akiramenai
title_japanese: 十色くんは近づきたいからあきらめない

title: Naderaretai Kimi wa Okubyou na Wanko
title_japanese: 撫でられたいキミは臆病なわんこ

title: Gekkou no Garan
synopsis:
In a world where humans and demons coexist, the demons have become a reliable source for the humans to help solve any demons who they cannot contain. However, there is a mirror demon that has begun to escape its thousand-year confines. Will the demons be able to soothe this ancient demon or will it destroy everything?

(Source: Exiled Rebels Scans)

title: Yuusha Party wo Oidasareta Kiyoubinbou: Party Jijou de Fuyo Jutsushi wo Yatteita Kenshi, Bannou e to Itaru
title_japanese: 勇者パーティを追い出された器用貧乏　～パーティ事情で付与術士をやっていた剣士、万能へと至る～
synopsis:
"Orn Doula, today will be your last day in the party."

Since the party was lacking someone who could play the essential role of Enchanter, it was the quickly adaptable Orn who had converted from Swordsman to Enchanter. On a certain day, Orn, who belongs to the Hero Party, is suddenly informed by the party leader—"your skills are lacking, so leave the party." The other party members also insulted him as a "weakling" and a "jack of all trades but a master of none."

After being expelled from the party and getting a fresh start, he decides to resume adventuring. This being so, he chooses to return as a Swordsman since he was an Enchanter only due to party circumstances. However, having been an Enchanter was definitely not a waste. His time in the Hero Party, knowledge, experience, and development of countless original magic will certainly nurture Orn into a swordsman of unconventional strengths.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Yuiitsu Muni no Saikyou Tamer: Kuni no Subete no Guild de Monzenbarai sareta kara, Takoku ni Itte Slow Life shimasu
title_japanese: 唯一無二の最強テイマー～国の全てのギルドで門前払いされたから、他国に行ってスローライフします～
synopsis:
Tamer is a profession that can tame monsters and use them as familiars. That was the vocation of the main character Kohaku, but he couldn't tame ordinary monsters. As a result, he was called "incompetent" and banished from the guild. However, he had a special power that allowed only him to tame the mythical "Phantasma," a legendary species so power and so rare that they have never been seen in public.

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)

title: Kyoukaisen
synopsis:
1. Kyoukaisen (Boundary)
2. Zigzag-sen
3. Suiheisen (Horizon)
4. Start Line

title: Scapegoat Baby
title_japanese: スケープゴートベイビー
synopsis:
Aoi greets his regular customer Amamiya at the flower shop where he works, but for some reason today, the pale, handsome Amamiya seems extremely unwell, as if he were feeling anemic. When Amamiya smells a giant bouquet of roses, he seems to feel slightly better, but it isn't nearly enough. Aoi accompanies him home to make sure he arrives safely, but things for Amamiya may be direr than Aoi realizes. To save Amamiya's life in this moment of danger, Aoi realizes he may need to supply something much more intimate than flowers!

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Fuguushoku "Tamer" wa Saijaku Skill "Seikenzuki" de Musou suru: Shounen wa Hard Mode no Jinsei wo Doryoku de Buchiyaburu
title_english: Born with the Weakest Job, I Worked My Hardest to Become the Strongest Tamer with the Weakest Skill: Fist Punch!
title_japanese: 不遇職『テイマー』は最弱スキル『正拳突き』で無双する　～少年はハードモードの人生を努力でぶち破る～
synopsis:
In this world, all humans are born with a job, a set of skills, and a base status. However, our protagonist, John Leetle received the short end of the stick and was born with the Tamer job and blessed with only one skill: Fist Punch; Both are considered to be the most useless bestowments one could receive. One day, by sheer coincidence, he manages to tame a baby Fenrir he found in the woods, and names it Ferryl. Having made his first friend, things were finally looking up for him. However, it appears Misfortune still haunts him closely, as a grim fate befalls his friend...

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Haibara-kun no Tsuyokute Seishun New Game
title_japanese: 灰原くんの強くて青春ニューゲーム
synopsis:
We all have embarrassing memories or deep regrets from high school, right? Socially anxious college senior Natsuki Haibara sure does. When he thinks back on that time of his life, all he has are fleeting fantasies of a happy adolescence that could have been. Imagine his bewilderment and surprise, then, when he inexplicably finds himself seven years in the past—one month before his first year of high school! Can Haibara avoid his previous mistakes, make his way to the top of the school social pyramid, and end up with the girl of his dreams? Or will he be forced to relive three years of solitude as the most hated guy in school? He'll need all the help he can get in order to succeed, from a workout regimen to online how-to guides, a childhood friend, and plenty of sheer willpower. Watch as Haibara takes a second shot at his teenage years!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Yukidoke to Agapanthus
title_japanese: 雪解けとアガパンサス

title: The Status Window to the Soul
title_english: The Status Window to the Soul
synopsis:
Princess Chervianne Aerveldote has lived a lonely life, and now she's being put to death for a crime she didn't commit. However, her execution turns out to be a fresh start when she wakes up as her 5-year-old self with an ability to read people's thoughts with status windows. Chervianne quickly learns how badly she misjudged everyone in the past, finding affection and betrayal in unexpected places. But will her newfound insight be enough to change her story and finally find love in her life?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Baby Divine Beast
synopsis:
With a warm family that showered her with love, Iyanelle's life was a bed of roses. That is, until the day she found herself bleeding out on the ground beside her dead father. The culprit? Her beloved brother, Crown Prince Agris de Roahim. Heartbroken and betrayed, Iyanelle could only accept her impending death. However, it seems fate has other plans for her... Next thing she knows, she's been reborn as a divine fox! In her new form, will she be able to bring her ex-brother's conspiracy to light?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Souzou Renkinjutsushi wa Jiyuu wo Ouka suru: Kokyou wo Tsuihou saretara, Maou no Ohizamoto de Chouzetsu Kouka no Magic Item Tsukuri-houdai ni Narimashita
title_japanese: 創造錬金術師は自由を謳歌する 故郷を追放されたら、魔王のお膝元で超絶効果のマジックアイテム作り放題になりましたを読む
synopsis:
The story centers around a bureaucrat named Thor, whose alchemy skills go unappreciated in his line of work. When he is expelled to the demon lord's domain, his life takes a huge turn. With his ability to create powerful magic items, he turns the kingdom around, alongside the company of a beautiful maid.

(Source: ANN)

title: Super Ball Girls
title_japanese: スーパーボールガールズ
synopsis:
Ichiyoshi is tired of his boring life working at the chocolate factory and keeping his greatest desires close to his chest. While walking home on Christmas night, he catches a mysterious Super Ball bouncing out of the darkness. He throws it as hard as he can... and an impossibly beautiful woman appears before him?!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Hottoite Kudasai: Juuma to Cheat Life Tanoshimitai!
title_english: Leave Me Alone: I Want to Enjoy Cheat Life with My Familiar
title_japanese: ほっといて下さい 従魔とチートライフ楽しみたい!
synopsis:
Mizuki, an office lady, wakes up in an unfamiliar forest, in the form of a little girl somehow. She seems to have been reincarnated in a different world, and Mizuki is at a loss, but for some reason, she gets more and more strong allies—or rather, more followers—such as the legendary monster Fenrir, a talented A-rank adventurer, and the others. "I just want to live a leisurely life, but why am I surrounded by overprotective adults!?"

(Source: AlphaPolis)

title: Hokenshitsu wa Futarikiri
synopsis: A collection of yuri stories in the nurse's office.

title: Otanko Nurse
synopsis:
Greenhorn nurse Yukie has a strong heart and a quick temper, quickly becoming a dangerous nurse prone to creating accidents. This is the diary of her growth.

(Source: Dayment Scans)

title: Noukase
synopsis:
In a world ruled by a tyrannical god, a young man decides to take matters into his own hands and punish him.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Kojirase Maid wa Aisaretai!
title_japanese: こじらせ処女〈メイド〉は躾〈愛〉されたい!

title: Tabi
synopsis:
1. Harukoma
2. Matsu no Ki wa Tokiori Mezameru
3. Tabi no Ouji
4. Hannenkan no Kyuuka
5. Suichuugoku no Musume
6. Okusama no Okoshitekata
7. Kaichou no Megane Densetsu
8. Eru no Orusuban
9. Kazoku Gassou
10. Sabaku no Tazaki-kun
11. Tarou to Tayura
12. Ran to Haiiro no Sekai: Bangai-hen
13. Toki no Tabi

title: Hokuou Futarigurashi
synopsis:
Fuyumi and Taoka are a couple who have just started dating. While they were all worn out after work, Fuyumi saw a show about life in Scandinavia and Sweden on TV. When Fuyumi saw the relaxed Scandinavian lifestyle, she couldn't help but mutter, "I want to live there." Yohei, who had been offered a chance to transfer to Sweden the day before, felt like her words were a stroke of fate, and proposed to her right then.

With the sudden immigration, the couple will lead a new life of "mysig" in a land of happiness.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Returning With Absolutely Nothing
synopsis:
In Aeria, a place where people from various worlds are summoned, the weak are destined to die. Sungmin Lee, a talentless mercenary, was no exception. Fortunately for him, a mysterious item he finds before his untimely death sends him back to the past. Now a 13-year-old with a second chance at life, Sungmin begins his desperate journey to become Aeria's strongest with no money or talent. The question is... will effort alone be enough to make a hero of a boy with absolutely nothing?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: TRPG Player ga Isekai de Saikyou Build wo Mezasu: Henderson-shi no Fukuin wo
title_japanese: TRPGプレイヤーが異世界で最強ビルドを目指す ～ヘンダーソン氏の福音を～
synopsis:
Commissioned in death to save a world in peril, a tabletop RPG fanatic is reborn as a humble farm boy with the rulebook for the universe at his fingertips! Young Erich's quest for an invincible character build will require more than his decades as a number-crunching munchkin, though. Even with power-leveled skills, feudal life is no cakewalk—especially when you keep drawing more attention than you can handle... Can Erich adapt to his strange new world before his worst impulses take the campaign of a lifetime completely off the rails? Let the dice fall where they may!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: You Too
synopsis:
The relationship of two childhood friends who share their dark history. After becoming adults, they reunite as roommates?

The daily life series of counterattacks. Will they be neck to neck in love, too?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: The Ghost's Nocturne
synopsis:
At the Palace of Yeomra in the afterworld, Jae-shin, the enchantingly beautiful yet deeply hedonistic son of the king, faces dire punishment. Having tampered with two men's lifespans, this alluring half-human, half-ghost is banished to the mortal world, where in daylight, he is stripped of his power and appears as a mere white puppy. The only way to return to his true form is to win over the heart of a human.

As if by fate, Lee Nok, a wistful and unfortunate prince pining for his childhood friend, takes pity on the animal and brings it in. While Nok's abundance of yin energy attracts malevolent spirits, Jae-shin must absorb yin to sustain himself. In every respect, Nok is the perfect target for Jae-shin's goals. He begins visiting the prince's chambers at night in his human form, hoping to erase the traces of affection for another from the prince's heart and lure him into eternal love.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Hug Kiss Hug
title_japanese: ハグ キス ハグ
synopsis:
Youko Kihara makes the resolution to say goodbye to her longtime affair partner after seeing her friend's marriage. Later on she gets ambushed by him in front of her house, and is saved by Fujiwara, a resident of the same apartment. Fujiwara snuggles up to Youko, who is filled with anxiety, until she falls asleep...? He says he will sleep with her when she is unable to sleep in the future.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Kimi wa Sukinosaurus
synopsis:
Kikumoto Kaoru has transferred to a new school in Wakayama Prefecture and in the mountains behind the school, he meets a mysterious girl, Momiji Shiraishi. From her he receives a strangely shaped ammonite, which leads him to the paleontology club.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Musashino Rondo
synopsis:
The story centers on an eccentric older sister and a younger brother with a broken heart. They will find a "seed that makes new love bloom."

(Source: ANN)

title: Boukoku no Emanon
synopsis:
A beautiful young man was sold to a caravan, and was the only survivor after being attacked by a group of bandits. He was rescued at the brink of death by a strong and brave prince, Altarf, who named him Yona. Yona pledged his loyalty to the prince and served him for several years. One day, while performing as a dancer at a banquet, Yona is given an aphrodisiac. His body starts to feel hot, putting him in a predicament. Under Altarf's heated gaze and touch, Yona's desire for him is ignited, and he becomes overwhelmed with shame. Yet Yona's feelings continue to grow. 

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Kami Maneki no Niwa
synopsis:
The Saitei (rear shrine) of Kabutozaka Province is a place to invite and entertain the gods. Gods with substance invite fertility and prosperity, but on the other hand, if they get violent, they bring terrible disasters to the country. Ayame, the daughter of a local count, went to Tokyo to find out the truth behind her best friend's death. There, Ayame, who accidentally calmed down the raging goddess, was appointed as a lady of the courtyard by her younger brother, Niran. However, that was just the beginning of an incident that would shake the country's existence...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Him and Him and Him
synopsis:
Yu Se-ah, a twenty-six-year-old college graduate, is embarking on her third year in the workforce. After spending years at full-speed to accomplish her goals, she finally finds herself with some breathing room. To escape the monotony of her daily routine, she delves into the nightlife scene. What begins as solo drinking sessions and occasional club visits quickly escalates. One fateful night at a bar transforms into an exhilarating whirlwind as she is pampered by not one, but three men—all of whom are related! While some might say you can have too much of a good thing, Se-ah isn't so sure.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Itazura Yuusha wa Shindeshimatta!
title_japanese: いたずら勇者は死んでしまった!

title: Kanojo wa Maruhi Bouei Heiki E-007
title_japanese: 彼女はマル秘防衛兵器E-007

title: Dolphin Fairy
synopsis:
Unemployed and depressed, Mokhwa decides to commit suicide by drowning. But first he must sign up for swimming lessons to use the pool. Just when he jumps in the water and lets his body sink...he is saved by his swimming teacher, Changgyeong. Mokhwa eventually begins falling for Changgyeong, a handsome man with a great body and amazing skills in bed. But the closer he gets, he can't help but feel there's something a little strange about his teacher...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Escape Devildom
synopsis:
Past the grey desert and across the ocean lay the demon lands. Bloodthirsty and savage, they've waged war with the humans since anyone can remember. And seated on his throne, behind castle walls and royal guards, sits the demon king. At least, that's what everyone thinks. And if Merlin ever wants to see his brother again, he'd better make sure everyone goes on believing he's the demon king. Otherwise, who knows what the demons'll do if they realize a human has been masquerading as their king?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Nocturnal Dogs
title_japanese: ノクターナルドッグズ
synopsis:
The soldiers of "Nox," a police unit, tasked with fighting against the spread of the Rufsol Virus. Veteran Rille has a new partner, Zein, an ex-elite police officer and survivor of the virus. Two men who are always at each other's throats, and their steamy romance.

(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)

title: High Card: ♢9 No Mercy
synopsis: High Card: ♢9 No Mercy is a side story to the High Card anime.

title: Ushiro no Shoumen Hitori dake
title_english: There Is Only One Person Behind Me
title_japanese: 後ろの正面ひとりだけ
synopsis:
1. Ushiro no Shoumen Hitori dake (There is Only One Person Behind Me)
2. Warui Ningen (A Bad Human)
3. Cinderella.exe
4. Mienai Mono, Boshuuchuu. (In Search of Something That Can't Be Seen)
5. Kin to Komugi to Ano Ko no Tazuna (Gold, Wheat, and His Reins)
6. Sankaku no Chouten (The Vertex of a Triangle)

title: Hypnosis Mic: Division Rap Battle - side D.H. & B.A.T+
title_japanese: ヒプノシスマイク -Division Rap Battle- side D.H. vs B.A.T+
synopsis:
With the Second Division Rap Battle around the corner, the matriarchal Party of Words finalizes the details of having a six-team tournament. To earn one of the spots in the competition, the Dotsuitare Honpo crew—Sasara Nurude, Rosho Tsutsujimori, and Rei Amayado—must survive the preliminary matches first. However, such is easier said than done, as Rosho's stage fright makes him question his usefulness to the team.

Meanwhile, Bad Ass Temple starts gearing up for the preliminaries, but each member is struggling with their own issues. For group leader Kuko Harai, a quarrel with his father causes him to doubt his ability to lead his team to victory; one of Jyushi Aimono's bullies returns from his brief stint in juvenile detention, thirsty for revenge; and Hitoya Amaguni's recent blunder in the courtroom raises the concern that he is unable to separate his personal and professional lives.

In a race against the clock, the two teams must face and resolve their difficulties to stand a chance

title: Sex Toy Try-Outs
synopsis:
The spark is slowly fading from Sanghyun and Sunhee's relationship, and they don't know what to do. Luckily for them, the answer to all their problems is right in front of them—in the sex toy shop Sunhee's been working at! Despite being a loyal employee, Sunhee's never used any of the products herself. But, desperate needs call for desperate measures. Will the two manage to salvage their relationship? Let the sex toy try-outs begin!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Campus Love
synopsis:
After a humiliating breakup, Kibum suffers from recurring nightmares of his cheating ex. But a new school year always comes with the added anticipation of romance, and Kibum is more than determined to spice up his love life once again!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Oukoku no Saishuu Heiki, Rettousei toshite Kishi Gakuin e
title_english: The Ultimate Weapon of the Kingdom, He Went to the Knight Academy as an Inferior Student.
title_japanese: 王国の最終兵器、劣等生として騎士学院へ
synopsis:
The inferior student is the strongest in the academy!! The kingdom's strongest weapon is longing for his "youth"?!

Being a "knight" means The world acknowledges your lineage and talent. A young man named Ain enrolled in the Knight academy in the capital. But, because he came from a church orphanage, he was placed in the lowest class, E class, what people call the Inferior class. And so, while being ridiculed by the aristocrats and honour students, Ain starts his school life... However, everything is just a cover, Ain or "Nameless No.1" is one of the Phantom Knights, the strongest weapon of the kingdom created by the dark-side of the church. While the principal who has been told his identity is being troubled, Ain is leading the Inferior class. His goal in the knight's academy is "making friends"?!

A thrilling fantasy of the strongest young knight who, out of touch with the world, overthrows the aristocrats.

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Nozomarenu Hanayome wa Ichizu ni Koutaishi wo Aisu
title_english: The Unwanted Bride Loves the Crown Prince with All Her Heart
title_japanese: 望まれぬ花嫁は一途に皇太子を愛す
synopsis:
She's an "unwanted bride," but she will do anything for her first and only love, Keith, to smile and be happy...

Tinaria, an unfortunate bride who was sent to an enemy country as a hostage after the defeat of her country, Lidea. The people are momentarily fascinated by the beautiful bride who becomes the wife of the crown prince, but then they remember Lidea's atrocious behavior and turn to hatred. Tinaria, on the other hand, has been single-mindedly devoted to the crown prince, holding on to precious memories from her childhood. Although she was born a princess, she was shunned by her family and treated as little more than a servant, but he was the first person to smile at her...

But when her husband, Keesfalt, coldly tells her that he has a lover... everything starts to go downhill.

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

title: 30-sai de "Seibetsu ga, Nai!" to Hanmei shita Ore ga Around Fifty ni Natte Wakatta Koto.
title_english: At 30, I Realized I Had No Gender: Life Lessons from a 50-Year-Old After Two Decades of Self-Discovery
title_japanese: 30歳で「性別が、ない！」と判明した俺がアラフィフになってわかったこと。
synopsis:
Following his 30th birthday, manga artist Shou Arai has been troubled by an existential question with no definitive answer: how does a person with no gender age? Since discovering that he was intersex 20 years ago, Shou has found very little information about individuals like him and what it means to grow up as a gender and sexual minority. But he is not the only one experiencing identity-related confusion, as his loyal readers and fellow manga artist colleagues are equally baffled and curious. While he goes through this mid-life crisis, Shou comprehensively documents the things he learns about aging and gender expression in hopes of answering all of these questions and helping those who are in similar situations.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kagirinaku Ningen ni Chikai Kekkanhin
title_japanese: 限りなく人間に近い欠陥品

title: Aioi Wakaba to Ita Hitotsuki ni Tsuite
title_japanese: 相生若葉といたひと月について
synopsis: A story between a reaper and a girl.

title: Kimi wo Someru Asayake ni
synopsis:
"You're like the wind."

Photographer Suguru comes to Enoshima to take photos when he suddenly spots a young man with hair the colour of the sunset falling into the water. Just as he's worrying about whether he should jumped in, the young man, Kengo, carelessly says, "It seemed like it'd feel good" and smiles like the sun. Although they part ways there, they meet again by chance at the shop Suguru stumbles across. Suguru, who hasn't yet found a place to stay, even receives an invitation to stay at Kengo's house...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Disney Twisted-Wonderland the Comic: Episode of Savanaclaw
title_english: Disney Twisted-Wonderland: The Manga - Book of Savanaclaw
title_japanese: DISNEY TWISTED-WONDERLAND THE COMIC ～EPISODE of SAVANACLAW～
synopsis:
One day, high school student Yuuka "Yuu" Hirasaka finds herself transported to the world of Twisted Wonderland after a black carriage crashes into her. Though she hopes to return home to Tochigi in Japan, the magicless judo practitioner ends up enrolling in the prestigious magic academy Night Raven College.

As Yuu acclimates to her new life, the annual interdorm Spelldrive tournament at the school is set to begin. The team-based game tests the physical and magical strength of each dorm's seven best athletes, all while being broadcast throughout the magical world. For the past two years, the Diasomnia dorm has crushed the competition thanks solely to their powerful housewarden, Malleus Draconia.

Amidst the excitement, a series of incidents across campus befalling the top Spelldrive players from all dorms is rendering them unable to compete. Concerned that these are no mere accidents, the headmage of the academy tasks Yuu and her dormmate Grim to investigate. While the pair dives deepe

title: Bad Boy
synopsis:
A kind guy who has strived to make himself into his crush's ideal type of guy over ten years. But! One day, she says that she likes bad boys...

From today onwards, I'm... going to be reborn as a bad boy.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Saijaku Tamer wa Gomi Hiroi no Tabi wo Hajimemashita.
title_english: The Weakest Tamer Began a Journey to Pick Up Trash
title_japanese: 最弱テイマーはゴミ拾いの旅を始めました。
synopsis:
In Ivy's world, stars are everything. She's a Tamer, born to subdue monsters and animals, but she was also born starless! With her life in danger, Ivy flees into the forest where she befriends a weak little slime named Sora—the one creature she can tame. Together, the unlikely pair set off on a journey, salvaging rubbish to survive. Along the way they'll win hearts, evade danger, and discover there's more to starless Ivy than meets the eye!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Tokyo Nyuusei Kanrikyoku
synopsis:
The Tokyo Interstellar Bureau of Immigration: Japan's finest cosmic border patrol team, busting their butts on the daily to keep Planet Earth safe. Ride along with Lein and Ann, two high school girls who kick ass, hunt down aliens, and look dapper while doing it!

(Source: VAST Visual)

title: Onzoushi no Narabu Mise
title_english: The Small Restaurant Lined with Son of a Noble

title: Kimi to Warui Koto ga Shitai
title_english: I Wanna Do Bad Things with You
title_japanese: 君と悪いことがしたい
synopsis:
Mamori Wataya has always faded into the shadows at her school. Tall and plain, she long ago accepted her role as a side character. When she befriends Soushi Fuji, her brusque classmate who walks with a cane and gets even when people underestimate him, a new avenue appears before her. Can Fuji teach her to embrace her bad side and become a villain like him?

When Fuji asks Wataya to drain the school pool for him, she gets her first taste of the high that comes from breaking the rules. Like the villains in anime and manga that Wataya admires, she's ready to try being a little naughty. Though she may not be ready for drastic crimes, Wataya knows she wants to start doing bad things.

(Source: VIZ Media)

title: Mannen 2-i Dakara to Kandou sareta Shounen, Mujikaku ni Musou suru
title_japanese: 万年2位だからと勘当された少年、無自覚に無双する
synopsis:
Cleo Farshid has been disowned from his noble family due to his inability to be number one in anything at the Royal Academy. Cleo decides to escape his stuffy life and live more freely, taking advantage of his skills to become an adventurer. Neither he or his father have realized how amazing it is to be ranked as second in everything at a school where the most talented compete. "I'm just an average person. I'm not an expert in anything." That sentiment kicks off an unmatched tale about a boy who is the strongest specifically because he's always second!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Ichikoe, Nifuri, Tachiaoi
title_japanese: いちこえ、にふり、タチアオイ
synopsis:
A brand new girl-meets-girl story, woven together by two people with completely opposite "looks" and "personas"!

Cram school teacher Kataoka Aoi was born with a beautiful face. From an early age, she always garnered the affection of everyone around her, yet the countless dramas it caused made her desire a quiet, modest life instead.

One day, she (reluctantly) accepts the principal's request to act in their school's commercial. But it quickly goes viral, resulting in her becoming popular inside and outside of the cram school, drawing attention wherever she goes.

Amidst the attention, the well-known and quirky store clerk, Yamada, approaches her and then...

(Source: GOT Corporation, translated)

title: One-in-Seven-Billion Irregular
synopsis:
Seungho Joo's ability to hyper-focus makes him a god in virtual reality games, until the day his brain becomes overloaded and he falls into a coma. Forbidden from playing VR games, he can only watch as the most hotly anticipated new RPG comes online. But when a new technology gives him a second chance to play, Seungho dares to return to the world of VR. In this ever-changing environment, can Seungho use his gift to stay one step ahead of the other players without putting himself back at risk?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: 8th Circle Mage Reborn
synopsis:
Henry Morris was an 8-circled wizard who was a legend—one of the founding fathers who helped his friend become the king of a unified empire. After the son took over the throne, Henry was executed with the false accusation of leading a rebellion against the empire. He then wakes up in the body of young Henry Morris, the eldest of a baron family, who also happened to have the same name. Henry turns his life around by relearning magic and also swordsmanship in order to become the first magic swordsman, all for the sake of revenge.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Couple Gaihi desu!!
title_japanese: 恋仲〈カップル〉外秘です!!
synopsis:
A beautiful and seemingly perfect secretary is celebrating a very spicy Halloween with her work colleague and secret boyfriend.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Koi to BL Danyuu to Share House
title_english: Love and BL Actor and Share House
title_japanese: 恋とBL男優とシェアハウス
synopsis:
Kyoka has a hard time looking people in the eye. She is shy and has never had any friends. But when she moves into a lively share house with fun and cheery housemates, Kyoka slowly learns how to come out of her shell. Though Kyoka admires each of her housemates, she especially looks up to Nozomi Harada, a BL actor who lives in the room next to her's. He is beautifully radiant and lights up any room. But even the sparkling actor can get gloomy sometimes. Will Kyoka be able to light a spark within Nozomi again...?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Trash Will Always Be Trash
synopsis:
Lady Layla Tevessa stood by her fiancé, Phillen Williot, through it all. After his parents died, Layla ran the Duchy of Williot alone, even after a war broke out and Phillen departed for the front lines. For six years, Layla awaited his return.

When Phillen finally comes back, he is accompanied by a beautiful and pregnant woman, Sisley Heliode. Witnessing Phillen's new sour attitude and the lengths he goes to for his mistress, Layla realizes that her position and future are in danger. While Layla's knowledge and experience that are vital to the duchy go unnoticed by the ignorant Phillen, a certain mysterious stranger's interest in Layla may just help her escape the now-suffocating Williot household.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Tefure.
synopsis:
Kagura already has a girlfriend. But Hosoya, the girl who sits next to Kagura, offers him a "tefure" relationship. What kind of relationship is this?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Midnight Men
synopsis:
Jung-hae has always wanted to live an ordinary life. But it's hard to pay the bills when you're deep in debt and barely scraping by working an honest, average job. One day, Jung-hae discovers that his brother is bringing in big bucks and suspects something dirty is going on, so he tails his brother...to a strip club full of male strippers?! When Jung-hae storms in to drag his brother out of the changing room, he has no idea that he's about to get a hell of a new job that's far from ordinary...and that the club's charismatic number one stripper, Yoo-gon, is going to change his life.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Please Kill My Husband
synopsis:
Brienne Lutengard knew that her parents were selling off their daughter and their status in exchange for money. Still, she thought she'd be able to live a relatively happy life with her husband, but it's not long until the new duke of House Lutengard shatters her dreams. Eight years later, the duke is found murdered in his residence, and Brienne is named the main suspect, along with three potential accomplices. All three are skilled swordsmen, none have an alibi for the night of the murder, and they're all young men recently caught up in a scandal with the duchess! Did the duchess really kill her husband? And if so, what could've been her motive?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Sukoyaka naru Toki mo Kakeru Toki mo
title_japanese: 健やかなるときも賭けるときも

title: Kareinaru Romantic Melodrama
title_japanese: 華麗なるロマンチックメロドラマ

title: Tsurumaki-sensei no Sakka Seikatsu
synopsis:
Daigo Maki has suffered more losses than an average person. He avoids building close relationships because it seems as though everybody close to him has died. Most recently, Daigo has lost his employer. Now, with no job and no friends to call on for help, Daigo is stumped... until a young-looking man asks if he wants a job on the spot. The conditions are suspiciously good: immediate start, short-term, able to work from home... What exactly is Daigo going to have to do!? Work for the devil or something!?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: VTuber wa Mama Naranai!
synopsis:
Kiyoshi Koyama, a first-year high school boy, is a very big fan of VTubers. One day, he fell asleep while illustrating a VTuber character after class. His illustration was seen by Nene Otogawa, one of his classmates. She admired his work and wanted to become a VTuber as well. Otogawa requested Koyama to draw a model for her. He initially rejected, but then accepted at last.

(Source: MU, edited)

title: Ore, Gal no Naka: Swap Party
title_japanese: オレ、ギャルのナカーSwap Partyー

title: Yoko-chan wa Positive
title_japanese: よこちゃんはポジティブ
synopsis:
Whether Yoko-chan is scavenging unsafe neighborhoods for food or bashing in the heads of zombies, she strolls through them without a care in the world. Negativity has no place in her routine with her constantly cheerful and can-do attitude. Nekkun, on the other hand, is pessimistic about his survival prospects in a world desolate of humans. The only reassurance Nekkun has from his predicament is being with Yoko-chan.

During their usual supply run, Yoko-chan realizes a pile of canned goods is gone, prompting her to find the party responsible for taking their food. However, Nekkun is wary of Yoko-chan's newfound mission, viewing the plan as unachievable in his eyes. But as long as Nekkun sticks with her, he may find even greater solace in their latest adventure.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Chiisakute Ookina Mune no Uchi
title_japanese: 小さくて大きな胸の内

title: Sugar Sugar Honey
synopsis:
"I shouldn't get involved with him..." Despite her heart's warnings, she just can't pull herself away from his sweet seduction.

Mizuki, a former marathon runner with a penchant for anything sugary, has now begun working at a hotel. She has zero experience in customer service, and is clumsy and socially challenged to boot. She's been slipping up repeatedly at work, which has only made things awkward with her coworkers. But when she runs into Kaji, the handsome hotel patissier/rumored womanizer, and accidentally vents her work frustration at him, he decides to appoint her as the test taster for his new creations?! Former runner/dessert-lover meets charming pastry chef in this heart-racingly sweet romance!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title: The Disloyal Subject Saves the Country
title_english: The Disloyal Subject Saves the Country
synopsis:
All the disloyal subject wanted was to take advantage of the kingdom's fall to pocket the royal treasure. But instead... he took an arrow for the queen and ended up dead. He is awoken in an afterlife by an apostle of god who mistook him for a faithful subject and tells him his job is to restore the fallen kingdom by reliving the historical moments that shaped it. Will he manage to rebuild the kingdom to its most glorious day and go down in history as the true loyal subject or... will his greed get in the way?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Tomodachi 100-nin Kireru kana
title_english: Can You Cut Off Your 100 Friends?
synopsis:
They're surely all around you, dominance-asserting friends, greedy friends, social network-dependant friends... toxic friends who you surely thought you were close with in the beginning, but are now just trouble to deal with. "Being with them is a pain but I have to stay friends with them, and having more friends is better..." Human researcher Ado Arima will teach you how to free yourself from such a curse!

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Charco
synopsis:
Enter the mysterious world of Charco, the world's most outrageous "ochappi," and her colorful friends. Charco is a surreal take on a typical children's story world, with talking animals and sentient food. Just... try not to think about it too deeply.

(Source: MU)

title: Konna no, Shiranai
synopsis:
Serika's younger cousin, Taichi, 6 years her junior, had passed his university entrance exams and until he's found a place to rent, Serika will be looking after him. Although he appears to be as pretty as a girl and a sweet angel, he's grown into a sadist devil in the time they haven't seen each other! He suddenly hugs her and kisses her—Serika's self control is on the brink of collapsing before Taichi, who has grown into such a splendid man.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title_english: The Owner Is So Sweet to Me.

synopsis:
I am Ilshin Yoo, a failed, third-rate web novel author. Don't start praying at me just in case because you think I'm a god. It's just my name. This is foul world where only hunters are appreciated. But even if you awaken as a hunter, not all hunters end up the same. It's a life dependent on hunter rank, which normally wouldn't change once it's been set. One day, I was able to awaken just as I had desperately wanted. But my awakened ability is somewhat strange. In this little world connected to my smartphone, those insignificant and weak ants being slaughtered consider me their god? And someone as insignificant as me has to save the world? Is that correct?

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Cross Over Rev!
synopsis:
The story takes place 10 years after Over Rev!. Ryouko returns to Japan, while there is a high school girl named Moto who also loves cars. Two people will cross paths and start more car legends!!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Omamori-kun

3. Pero no Iibun (Licky's Dogma)
4-5. Omamori-kun (Mr. Good Luck Charm)
6. Omamori-kun: Sonogo (Mr. Good Luck Charm Epilogue)

title: Ushimitsu Dokidoki Koshotentan
title_japanese: うしみつどきどき古書店譚
synopsis:
Komiya is a struggling grad student trying to make ends meet. He meets Youzou Nishi, owner of the Nishi Bookstore, while searching for an affordable room and board, which the latter had advertised in exchange for looking after the bookstore occasionally. After living a month with Youzou, Komiya is smitten. But Youzou is a great mystery. Apart from managing a bookstore, he also has another job that Komiya doesn't know much about, except that Youzou's clients all seem otherworldly. Komiya doesn't think about it much until an earthquake and rejuvenation water turns Youzou into a child. As it turns out, Youzou also runs a pawn shop of holy miracles for gods.

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Minasoko nite
synopsis:
It is said that, at the bottom of the lake in this town, there lies a "mermaid" that eats people. Today, the mermaid still wanders the town in search of companions, stirring up the restless hearts of the people. A modern fable about foolish girls who cannot live in clean water.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Rare Omega Shunki
synopsis:
Matori, a tiger from the Amur clan, aiming to be the "strongest omega," one day suddenly reunites with the Japanese wolf, Koko, whom he used to pine after when they were younger. Matori is charmed by his unchanging kindness and grown-up appearance, and they laid their bodies together. In the midst of this, Matori, who had a dream that he would mate with the person he loves, sees signs of Koko's alpha awakening, and worries that he may have only held him impulsively due to his heat...

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

title: Uchuu Kenetsukan
synopsis:
The future cannot be changed! In 2019, former track and field club member Maki Makino meets a mysterious man with sunglasses on her way to school who saves her life. That encounter connects her to her past and future... Presented with overwhelming power, a "boy meets girl" story opens here with unpredictable results!

(Source: LINE Digital Frontier, translated)

title: Martial Artist Lee Gwak
synopsis:
Gwak Lee, an ordinary military officer, loses the ability to use his arms and legs after being brutally beaten by Ilhyeon Gwan of Shinmaryeon clan. In the depths of despair, Gwak starts learning the "Jade Temple System," thinking he has nothing left to lose. After mastering the ultimate somatic technique, his body recovers from the disability. And now, Gwak promises to himself that he will not live as an ordinary martial artist as he was in the past, and continues to train in order to become a true warrior.

(Source: KENAZ)

title: Double Trap
synopsis:
Jinsung has always had a crush on his next door neighbor, Yura, ever since they were kids. Due to unforeseen circumstances, they had to move in together and they practically became brothers. Jinsung eventually gave up the thought of ever becoming Yura's lover because Yura would draw a line in the sand each time he tried to reveal his feelings. But one night, Yura's behavior begins to change. He seems to be turning into a different person in the evening...someone with an insatiable lust for the physical... Jinsung has to admit, a side of him does enjoy his feelings being reciprocated, but this feels wrong and unsustainable. What's gotten into Yura and is there something more sinister at play...?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Inwaku Nightmare Seek

synopsis: Included one-shot: Tariq-hen

title: City Lights Birthday
title_japanese: シティ・ライツ・バースデイ
synopsis:
Being a beta in a world where alphas and omegas were destined for each other, Azuma had long accepted that there was no such thing as 'fate' for him. Still trying to get over a heartache from the past, he meets 'Mahoro' by chance one Christmas night. Pitying Mahoro's unfortunate state, Azuma tries to offer help, despite being flustered. While Mahoro refuses Azuma's offer to stay at his house, he invites the latter to drop by his workplace as thanks. It turns out that Mahoro works in a brothel. As Azuma gets more drawn to Mahoro, he finds out that Mahoro is looking for someone: his fated partner. Against his better judgment, Azuma decides to help Mahoro.

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Shitsuren Omega wa Aisaretai
title_japanese: 失恋オメガは愛されたい
synopsis:
Shougo is an omega who is told that he doesn't look like one, due to the menacing look in his eyes. Shougo's childhood friend An-chan, an alpha, whom he has always had a crush on, introduces him to his destined mate and Shougo is left heartbroken. His friends worry about him after seeing how depressed he is and register him on a dating app and set up a date with a guy named "Ichi." Shougo wants to decline, but he doesn't know how. So what will happen when the day of the appointment arrives? What will he do when he finds out he's having too much fun?

(Source: MU)

title: Hanatori Kazetsuki: Bokutachi no Hatsukoi Kitan
title_japanese: 花鳥風月～ぼくたちの初恋綺譚～
synopsis:
The handsome, popular Mihiro is used to being the target of girls looking to ask him out. Still, as he begins to get fed up with shallow confessions of love from girls who don't even know him, he also finds himself being drawn to Tsumugi, his classmate whose hobby is peacefully watching birds. Tsumugi's favorite bird is the swallow, and he comforts Mihiro by telling him that even female swallows identify the most healthy male birds by their looks because it's a hint at how beautiful they are inside, too. For the first time, Mihiro feels a bit happy being complimented like this and begins to tease and pursue Tsumugi in return.

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Ryuu to Chameleon
synopsis:
Garyou Hanagami is a best-selling manga artist praised as a genius of the craft. Shinobu Miyama is a bitter rookie with a knack for copying other people's art styles. When an accident causes the two to switch bodies, Miyama is more than happy to take Hanagami's place, forcing the veteran to rebuild his career from the ground up. Now, the dragon must reclaim his throne from the chameleon who replaced him!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Bed no Naka de wa Sekaiichi Aishite
title_english: Love Me More than Anything When We're in Bed
title_japanese: ベッドの中では世界一愛して
synopsis:
At the seven-star Whittaker Hotel is a special suite with intimate services especially for its guests. Chief concierge Kashiro is a gentleman in the daytime, but a lustful leader in the bedroom who only provides his services to guests once. When young CEO Haruki stays at the suite, he discovers the intimate services the staff at the hotel provide. Although irritated by Kashiro's behavior, Haruki is somehow drawn to him.

(Source: Renta!)

synopsis:
"We will teach humans to fear the feline race!" They may seem cute and cuddly, but these kitties are up to no good! Under the direction of the purple-caped Feline Commander, the Evil Secret Society of Cats schemes against humanity in a series of humorous stories as adorable as they are diabolical. After all, the complex nature of cats is part of their charm.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Kokuhaku wa Yume no Naka de...
title_english: I Confess to You in My Dreams...
synopsis:
Mr. Shima can always depend on Chitose for speed and consistency. Chitose loves helping out, too. She hates the thought of Mr. Shima having to work overtime because of her mistake. Chitose is very fond of Mr. Shima, but has trouble showing it. Her face stiffens whenever he's near, and her wording becomes harsh. Mr. Shima probably thinks she's an ice queen!.. But during a company dinner party, Chitose and Mr. Shima drink a little too much and... wake up next to each other in Chitose's room! Ah well, at least nothing is going to happen... right?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

Included one-shot:
Volume 2: Love♡Training: Karadazukuri wa Shuugougo ni (Love♡Training: Physical Training Starts After Work Ends)

title: The Secret Queen
synopsis:
Praised solely on her looks for years, Lia was eager to put everything behind her and start anew... Until she got kidnapped and tossed into the harem of an unknown ruler. Desperate and afraid, Lia makes a deal with Karian, the handsome yet ruthless regent to the king, who seems strangely drawn to her. Will Lia be able to keep up appearances as Karian's concubine long enough to search for the hidden assassin in their midst? And once she does, will that be the very leverage she'll need to make her escape?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Evil Heart
synopsis:
Meet Death Claw, a man created to destroy and obliterate the locally loved hero, Astro Wink. The problem is though... He secretly loves her.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Yongsa High: Dungeon Raiders
synopsis:
An Earth in the 21st century that has fused with another world. An era of "dungeons" teeming with monsters and the "adventurers" that raid them. Also, the most elite educational facility in South Korea that fosters these adventurers: "Warrior High School." Although he was once considered one of the greatest adventurers in Asia, he has been accused of false charges and, while dungeon smuggling in order to pay for his sick father's medical treatments, Jaryong Yoo comes across one teen. "You there, get in Warrior High School." This is a story about a young man who's lost his dream, hiding his identity, finding himself once again.

title: Kunikida Shachou no Yuuga na Choukyou

synopsis:
Mei Hoshino wants to be loved by a gorgeous gentleman-like in romance novels. What she didn't expect was for the President of her company to be exactly that...! Mei is a beauty consultant for a widely successful cosmetics maker. Not only is she a consultant, but she is also the season's most requested employee by customers in the salon, earning her the reward of an elegant lunch with President Kunikida himself! Mei can't believe that the gorgeous gentleman of her dreams actually exists. She also can't believe she dared to ask him to a one-night stand...!

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

Included one-shot:

In the Dom/Sub universe, there is a secondary gender known as Dom/Sub (similar to the ABO universe). At a certain age, every individual's secondary gender is identified as one of three designations: Dom (has an instinct to control), Sub (has an instinct to be controlled), or Switch (possesses both characteristics). This series is an anthology of one-shots taking place within the Dom/Sub universe, each written by a different author.

A mobile game called Arcana Fantasy has taken the world by storm. However, individuals who log on to the game lose consciousness in the actual world and cannot escape the game until someone plays to the end. Can Yoon, the son of a pro gamer and policewoman, find his father in the virtual world and escape with the other victims?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: My Boss Can't Sleep Without Me
title_english: My Boss Can't Sleep Without Me
synopsis:
Eunsoo Chae just wants a stable life with no drama. After a wild night out leads her to sleep with a man she's just met, she's relieved to find that he only slept next to her... and nothing more. When she runs into him again, he reveals his desperate need for some shut-eye, which only Eunsoo could induce. He asks if they could sleep together again, and while he seems polite, she soon learns he's not just a random stranger, but Dojin Seo, a boss from her company! So much for a drama-free life!

title: Sono Himegoto
synopsis:
"Nice guy" Yuuta has been burned by yet another girl. After getting wasted at a bar, he's invited by the owner to a special place... a lounge where men dressed as beautiful women make their guests' wishes come true! Yuuta is introduced to the mysterious "Mitsu," who confuses him and piques his curiosity at the same time. Before he knows it, he's indulging in pleasures he never would've believed possible!

A story about a cool and beautiful crossdresser and a pushover who's unlucky in love.

(Source: Renta!)

Son of a noble family, Tsubasa Ichijou has a problem. He can only get pleasure from male maids. Azusa Kurokawa, a high school teacher and Tsubasa's exclusive maid, also has a problem. Even though he was nurtured into a full on pain-lover by the young sadistic tyrant that was Tsubasa, he, in turn, brought Tsubasa up to be a gentleman who just won't seem to assault him... As usual, Azusa is getting both annoyed and aroused by Tsubasa's words and actions when he gets an idea!

Can his manager really only climax when someone explodes inside him...!? Shun Sakuragi loves hooking up with random guys and uses a dating app to find eligible bachelors. One day, he matches with a hot-looking sales rep who's hunting for some quick action! He heads to a hotel to meet and is shocked to find his date for the night is actually his boss, Takuya Kurose...! He barely has a chance to figure out what's going on before the usually serious Takuya is using his wiles on him to get him into bed... It's incredible!!!

Shun's addicted to the pleasure and before he knows it, he finds himself falling for Takuya... title: Ore ga Sekiyuou to Koi ni Ochitara
