title: Pussy King-sama no Akuheki
title_english: A Dominating Prince and His Naughty Habits
title_japanese: プッシーキングさまの悪癖
synopsis:
The setting is a certain city in a certain Gulf state, the suburbs a ways away from the skyscrapers in the desert. Kadri is busy running grandma Jedda's restaurant when Fati, a famous tyrant of a prince, appears, demanding the closure of the restaurant for a development project underway. His curiosity is piqued when he sees Kadri stubbornly refusing to move out and suddenly suggests settling matters through a particular process. Rather than upset Grandma Jedda, Kadri decides to take on the challenge. He goes to the prince's palace with no bedroom experience to speak of and discovers pleasure for the first time in his life.

He tells himself that it's just a way to protect the restaurant, but can't stop reacting to the liberated prince with the naughty habits...!! A love story about a straight cook and an arrogant prince.

(Source: Renta!)

Included one-shot: Hametsu no Drift Night (Adrift in the Night)

title: Ningen Yametai Yonezawa-san
title_japanese: 人間やめたい米沢さん
synopsis:
Haru Yonezawa is an outstanding office manager who is looked up to by all of his teammates. On the surface, he is cool and collected, never getting his feathers ruffled by his grouchy boss. But the truth is he has a secret hobby that, if anyone found out about, would destroy his elite image. Every night, after a long, stressful day at work, he unwinds by dressing up and roleplaying... as a dog. Looking for a new "master" to help meet his needs, he calls upon a call-girl, who shows up and is none other than one of his subordinates from work!

(Source: Mangamo)

title: High Key x Low Key
synopsis:
Mao Yasaka realizes that he may be gay when he finds himself falling in love at first sight with a photograph of a model named Kei. The only place where Mao can see Kei is the art exhibitions of the mysterious photographer named Mel.

One day, as he is entranced by Kei's photo, someone at the exhibit asks to take photos of Mao. Who is it but Mel himself?! Before he realizes it, Mao is in bed with Mel, and is drowning in pleasure as Mel whispers to him "If you can be a good boy, I'll let you meet Kei."

Days later, Mao meets Kei, and it somehow turns into a situation where Mao is having sex with Kei as Mel takes pictures...?!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Wakeatte Shachou Reijou ni Hirowaremashita

synopsis:
Jihwan Hyun is an aspiring musician who can teleport. One day, he takes a trip to Germany on a whim, and is discovered by Nigel Ernst Kerne. Ever since that fateful encounter, Jihwan begins to frequently visit Nigel, who showers him with good hospitality and affection in return. But as the visits become more frequent and Nigel begins to want more of him, Jihwan isn't sure if this unique double life can go on. Can this unusual long distance relationship work? Or was it never meant to be?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kanchigai Love Factory
title_japanese: カン違いラブファクトリー
synopsis:
Souta is in love with his kind and handsome boyfriend, Youichi. And they're living together! Souta thought they could be in love forever, but it seems like Youichi has been hiding something lately?! When he started to worry about, he saw a suspicious email...

(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)

title: Love Me Tender ni Sayounara
title_japanese: ラブミーテンダーにさようなら
synopsis:
From the moment she was betrayed by her first boyfriend, Sachie Makimura decides to live her life freely in a share-house that forbids love! But it seems like the people staying there all have different views on love...?

(Source: LINE Digital Frontier, translated)

title: Minus Skill Mochi Yonin ga Atsumattara, nanka Synergy Hakki shite Saikyou Party ga Dekita Ken
title_japanese: マイナススキル持ち四人が集まったら、なんかシナジー発揮して最強パーティーができた件
synopsis:
Minus Skill. A negative debuff possessed by a select few since birth. A swordsman who has one such skill is once again in the throes of being thrown out of another party. Despite his abilities, that single skill had a huge downside, which would make him a burden to any would-be adventuring partners.

Sick and tired of the never-ending cycle, he has taken it upon himself to challenge a dungeon that may possess an item that could remove a skill of his. There, he meets a girl with the Priestess class who also has a Minus Skill but...

"Eh? Aren't our skills synergistic? Negatives coming together to form a positive!"

This is the story of people exiled from parties, who possess Minus Skills, banding together to eventually become the strongest party.

(Source: Novel Updates)

title: An Inescapable Love
synopsis:
For Princess Seollan, life as the twin sister and shadow of the sickly crown prince was a suffocating prison. So when the king commands her to marry Jihwan of House Choi, she knows it's her only chance to escape the palace and its shackles. Unfortunately, poor Jihwan was cursed by a vengeful white fox with a dangerous thirst for royal blood, and is dead set against their marriage. But in the end, the two are powerless to stop the wedding. Thus, Seollan is determined to find a cure for her new husband—but the truth that they uncover may be more cruel than the curse itself. Will their newfound love bloom bright in the snow, despite the harsh winds of fate that lie ahead?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: 10-nengoshi no Koi dakara
title_english: Because I've Been in Love With You for a Decade
synopsis:
It wasn't a joke. He was totally serious. Although a decade had passed, Haru, who used to be a professional surfer, still couldn't get over his broken heart. One day, he meets a young man named Narumi who says he has come to see him. "I don't care about your preference. Wanna have some fun?" Out of despair, Haru goes to a hotel with Narumi to try to forget everything, ignoring Narumi as he tries to talk to him. The next day, they meet again in the least expected way. The spiritless former surfer gradually starts to be moved by the earnest younger man in this frustrating but brilliant summer yaoi where emotions nurtured over a decade start to become entwined.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Neko de Yokereba
title_english: If You're Fine with a Cat
synopsis:
Mr. Cat is a "regular" cat who happens to be able to communicate with humans... Mr. Cat can communicate with humans, but he still finds it hard to understand all of their emotions. For example, within moments of each other, his maiden owner can get nervous, happy, and frustrated around the boy that she fancies. All Mr. Cat can do is listen and try to give advice. But then it comes to him: he can open a free station to listen to people's troubles! From a little boy who wants to play doll to an art student with financial worries, people from all walks of life are willing to sit down and speak to a stranger. Anyone, even you, can stop by to talk if you're fine with a cat, that is.

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Yakuza to Hanabira
synopsis:
Saki Ogawa lives a similar life to the flowers she tends to: she wakes up in the morning, is active while the sun is out, then goes to sleep at night to repeat it all the next day. So when she goes to a nightclub for a delivery, Saki enters a new world full of allure and mystique. The nightclub owner Renji Kanamori is just that: alluring and mysterious. Saki can only imagine all of the shady business he must conduct. At least she won't have anything to do with him...!

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

Born with the gift of "hearing"—deemed useless by those around him—Ars was imprisoned in a tower by his disappointed parents. But one day, he discovers that his enhanced hearing allows him to replicate any magic spell he hears, even legendary incantations wielded by the gods themselves. In time, Ars rises to become the world's most powerful mage. Stepping into the outside world, he begins his journey... utterly unaware of the overwhelming power he wields! A tale of divine gifts, unwitting might, and a clueless prodigy begins!

Art student Hibari Akanishi struggles to find free time between her part-time job and school. While continuing her project at work, her laptop is accidentally soaked and broken by a customer—a flashy guy making a scene. Furious that her hard work is gone, Hibari lashes out at him before she storms out.

At the end of her shift, the rude client takes Hibari to his apartment to apologize. The eccentric boy introduces himself as Gaku Sausei, a member of a rock band and fellow art student. He lends her his computer so she can finish her assignment by the deadline. title: The Hysteric Trigger

synopsis:
Emma Waller is a trainee of the American unofficial intelligence unit "CAT" with the ability to read minds. This is her revenge story against her mother's killer, the cold-blooded murderer known as the "Lollipop Man."

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Self-Made Lady
synopsis:
Stuck in a loveless engagement with the crown prince and tired of living in the violent capital city, Violet Hale wanted a way out of her miserable life. Enter the enigmatic archduke Cedric Etchell, who breaks off her engagement and agrees to a contractual marriage with her as thanks for saving his estate. Determined to make it on her own once the contract ends, Violet starts her own business. Love isn't in the plan, but could the archduke make this self-made lady have a change of heart?

(Source: Tapas Media)

Gi-woo has always been a merciless go-getter. He was a top student in school, and now he's playing all his cards right at work. He gets the ladies, too, of course, and though his marriage is loveless, you can't tell from the outside. One day, he receives news that an old professor of his, a father figure, has passed away. Gi-woo rushes to the funeral and meets the beautiful widow and her gorgeous daughter for the first time in years. Soon enough, desires old and new begin to snowball beyond control...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Class no Bocchi Gal wo Omochikaeri shite Seiso-kei Bijin ni Shiteyatta Hanashi
title_japanese: クラスのぼっちギャルをお持ち帰りして清楚系美人にしてやった話
synopsis:
He once helped a lonely gal from his class.

On a rainy evening, Akira Akamori, a high school student about to transfer to a new school, saw his blonde classmate, Aoi Sotome, drenched from the rain in a nearby park.

"...I don't have a home anymore," she said. Though Aoi was a complete stranger to him, he couldn't leave a girl alone, so he took her home. "Thanks for the help."

"I-it's fine..."

When Akira heard about Aoi's complicated situation, he decided to help her and let her live with him until he transferred to a new school. While confused by their first time living together, the two slowly came close to each other. It is a love story of two people who repeatedly meet and part ways, like a broken record.

(Source: SB Creative Corp., translated)

title: Deep 3
synopsis:
Demian Kawai, who grew up being told by his mother that he is the son of a famous basketball player, became a member of a basketball team. Demian's abilities have earned him the respect of those around him, but after an injury and the mistake in a game, he has lost his confidence. Although he tries his best to rehabilitate himself, Demian suddenly feels as if his upper body is frozen while playing. When he consulted a doctor, he was told that it was a symptom of the "yips." This is a "rise after the fall" story.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Let's Go, ASMR!
synopsis:
Soohyun, who runs a popular ASMR channel, scouts some new recruits to help him film and produce videos. There's Joonhyuk, an ASMR fan, Hyesoo, who has an amazing voice (but who only joins because he's got a huge crush on Joonhyuk), and Chanyoung, who joins to protect (?) Joonhyuk from Hyesoo. From the creator of Voice of Love comes a new BL series full of budding romance and tingles!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Wolf Pack
synopsis:
Set in the far-far north, where wolves rule, the head of the valley, Garm, follows the tradition of the lake chief, Hati, and becomes his mate, uniting their pack. Garm is frank and tough, and Hati is serious and pure. They respect each other's pride as chiefs and males, but being both Alphas, at first they are somewhat at odds with each other. As they share their lives and strengthen their bond, they gradually grow to become each other's one and only mates...

(Source: Denpa)

title: Kono Koi, Chaban ni Tsuki!?
synopsis:
Chako Hananoki thought she'd found happiness in a handsome fiancé, but when she realized a marriage to him would mean a total erasure of herself, she broke it off and moved back into her childhood home in the country—only to find a strange man and young woman living there? She finds a way to coexist with them, but when her stalker fiancé follows her home, she declares to him (and accidentally to the whole village as well) that this new man in her life is her husband?!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Kemuri no Saki no Shikishima-san
synopsis:
A romantic comedy about the secret interaction between Koda, a company employee, and Shikishima-san, the madonna of his workplace. Shikishima-san always wears a mask and rarely has a chance to take it off, and it is said that no one knows her true face. However, Shikishima is a smoker and Koda, who meets her in the smoking area, is the only one who knows Shikishima's true face.

(Source: Shonengahosha, translated)

Klaus reveals he is married to a member of Lamplight, but the identity of the bride remains unknown. In an effort to uncover the truth behind this strange secret, the girls review some of their recent smaller adventures to find any revelatory clues—until the investigation descends into a full-on battle royale! Get a peek into the girls' daily lives in this collection of vignettes!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Rasen no Meikyuu: Idenshi Sousa
title_japanese: らせんの迷宮 -遺伝子捜査-
synopsis:
In Tokyo, a murderer leaves his signature, an "X" on the dead body. When found, the mark appears eerily similar to that of the one seen on the body of the dead wife of Detective Genji Andou. Banned from the investigation, he secretly reaches out to Jin Jinbo, an associate professor at the medical school's genome analysis lab. Who better than a DNA expert to identify this potential serial killer?

(Source: MyDramaList)

title: Versus
synopsis:
Centuries ago, humanity's natural enemy, Demons, invaded the world and defeated humanity. The Great Demon Lord and his generals have since dominated the world, while the human race lives on in fear. In desperation, a group of 47 people gathered from around the world undertake a last-ditch effort to save humanity from ultimate annihilation. These heroes swear to defeat the demon army and win back humanity's freedom, but they have no idea the desperate measures that this battle will drive them to embrace...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Kick Off
synopsis:
Expensive shoes, a nice watch. Smoldering good-looks. That's the new guy, Jaeha Doh, appointed to lead a new team in the company. Tae-eun is a third-year copywriter who's vying to join this new group to move his career forward. Jaeha seems a bit strict but if he's achieved this position already at his age, he must be competent, right? But something suddenly dawns on Tae-eun... This Jaeha...is this the same Jaeha he went to school with, his first crush?! Second chances at love don't come around very often. But they were just kids when they first met, surely things are different now. Still, this guy is confident, hot and seems interested, why not make the most of this opportunity? But office romances are always complicated and there's a new air about Jaeha that feels just a little off... Love and lust ensue but things aren't quite as they seem...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

I, Kitty Senior, enjoy my life as a house cat. When it's time to eat, my humans are there to serve me food. When it's time for play, my humans are there with toys. And when it's time to sleep, I have my very own human heater waiting for me in my futon, his name is Dear, A.K.A. Undies Man (don't ask, humans are weird). All is purrfect. Well, all was perfect... until Nekomaki decided to bring a little demon "cat" called Acorn into the house. I'm not even convinced that this ball of snotty fur even is a cat. I can already tell: my twelve years on this earth is NOT going to be peaceful...

Kouya, who runs a host club with his friend since middle school, Akitomo, can't help but think that Akitomo's younger brother, Yuuma, is cute! Kouya decided that Yuuma would be his boyfriend once he turned 20, but lately, Yuuma's been feeling distant...?! On the day of his 20th birthday, it was a huge shock for Yuuma to ask him to introduce him to a guy!!!! He pushes Yuuma down saying, "Your first is obviously going to be me," just to instead be messed up and left panting by the virgin Yuuma...!!!?

Yuuma, mistakenly thinking that his beloved Kouya is a bitch dating his older brother, has sex with him, but it's actually Kouya's first time...?! The outcome of the misguided sex between two people with crushes on each other is?!

In a modern Japan where vampires and werewolves are commonplace in society, Kioi Uzuki runs a sharehouse with his grandmother. He's super excited when they get their first vampire tenant, but their first meeting is a bit of a bumpy one. How will this shy and closed off vampire react to a bubbly enthusiastic all-things-occult-loving human who really wants to be his friend?

(Source: MU)

title: The Sultan's Love
synopsis:
For eleven years, Sayeh has resided in the sultan's harem, staying out of sight and doing her best to avoid attracting any attention. All that changes when one night, she happens across the sultan's path and is called to his bedchamber... But just when all seems lost for Sayeh, news of a sudden revolt by the ninth prince, Kainer, rocks the palace. Under Kainer's rule, all the other women are set free from the harem, and Sayeh hopes that her freedom may finally be within reach as well. Instead, the newly crowned sultan pays her a personal visit, expressing feelings for Sayeh that she never could've imagined. But does Kainer's love offer her salvation or ruin...?

synopsis:
Suzume, a 17-year-old girl who lives in a quiet town in Kyushu, encounters a traveling young man who tells her "I'm looking for a door." She follows after him and discovers a weathered door in the ruins in the mountains, as if it were the only thing left standing from a collapse. As if drawn by something, Suzume reaches for the door...

Before long, doors begin to open one after another in various parts of Japan. As disasters come from the far side of the doors, the open doors must be closed.

The stars, the setting sun, and the morning sky—in that place she wandered into, there was a sky that seemingly blended all of time together. Guided by the mysterious doors, Suzume's "door-locking journey" begins.

Touya and Eiji were always almost like brothers since they were both little. They're five years apart, but they're best friends who have been together ever since. They both thought their relationship would continue as it always has, celebrating birthdays and spending Christmases together. That was until Eiji had to go to Tokyo to study to take over his father's company.

They were separated and meeting each other was a rare occasion now. Now they're in their third winter apart. Touya was excited to see Eiji for the first time in a while. However, he was kissed and confessed to by Eiji who had just returned?!

(Source: Kasakura Shuppansha, translated)

title: The Seagull and the Hunter
synopsis:
Taeyoung and Ami, young lovers from a peaceful lakeside town, grew up sharing dreams of fame and freedom. Taeyoung, son of actress Haedo Im, yearns to capture beauty from behind the camera, while Ami aspires to dazzle in front of it. But when Haedo's film director boyfriend comes to town hunting for his next leading lady, the couple's tranquility is shattered forever...

synopsis:
Lively teenager Mirai Sarutobi is determined to become a respected ninja, aspiring to match the legacies of her late father, Asuma, and grandfather, Third Hokage Hiruzen. As a regular bodyguard for Seventh Hokage Naruto Uzumaki, the active village leader, she feels she is steadily progressing toward her goal. When entrusted with escorting Sixth Hokage Kakashi Hatake during a border inspection, an eager Mirai senses a chance to establish her reputation by defending Kakashi against countless enemies. But what she anticipates to be a perilous, career-defining two-day mission turns out to be a leisurely 20-day vacation.

Reeling from her disappointment, Mirai struggles to enjoy touring hot springs alongside the absent-minded Kakashi and his overzealous friend Guy Might. As Mirai finally relaxes, however, she is suddenly offered a tantalizing opportunity—one that may just be too good to be true.

His secretary, Ms. Han, is the only one who seems to be capable of dealing with his insensible remarks... But even she has her limits. synopsis:
Ochiai, a salaryman working at a black company, is on his way home, on the verge of mental breakdown. He wants to die. But he doesn't want to die hungry! He passes by a ramen cart run by a young girl named Kira, with the sign "Shinigami Ramen." Kira calls herself a "Shinigami" (god of death) and offers Ochiai a bowl of ramen that's so good that it will allow him to die in peace if he eats it. Will he be able to enjoy the ramen and pass on, or not? Even if he doesn't die, the cute loli-reaper will give him hope for life!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Two Souls
synopsis:
Suyoung On is working as an officer of the Royal Pharmacy, and when he finds out about the emperor's plan to behead the king for the treason charges, he feels sympathetic and gives anesthetic potion to the king to lessen the pain. And during the execution, the king thanks Suyoung and curses the emperor as he dies. The next day, Suyoung wakes up in a strange place and realizes that he is living in the emperor's body! Shivering with fear, Suyoung hurries to the Royal Pharmacy and finds the emperor in his body. And from that point and on, a spectacular drama takes over the palace.

title: Rock wa Lady no Tashinami deshite

At an elite all-girls' academy where refined young ladies gather, Ririsa Suzunomiya, now the daughter of a real estate tycoon after her mother remarried, is forced to abandon her guitar and rock music to fit in. However, her passion is reignited by sounds from the old school building, where she meets a skilled drummer who shares her love for rock. Together, they embrace their inner rockstars, elegantly clashing and shouting their way through the academy in this captivating tale of grace and rebellion.

Within the hero's party is the world's strongest porter—and together, they've finally defeated the demon lord. Now that the party's penultimate goal has been met, the porter, Liddie, decides to follow his dream of becoming an adventurer! A world where the war between humans and demons has continued for hundreds or years... The hero was summoned from Earth to be humanity's ace in the hole. Aoi Yamato was a regular university student, but he led them to a sweeping victory and ended the war. Unable to forgo his scruples, he refuses to feed on humans and attempts to soothe his thirst with cat blood. On one such night when he's out prowling for a feline friend, he runs into his coworker in the same department, Yamadera. After a few drinks at a bar, Yamadera falls asleep at the station leaving his vexing neck exposed and vulnerable. Overcome with annoyance and hunger, Sayo takes a bite and discovers...? Will Sayo find a way to become human again? And what really lies behind Yamadera's sweet mask? Take a read and find out in this emotional and twisted tale between a 40-year-old virgin and his sadistic junior colleague!

In order to take responsibility, her beautiful company president, Eri, suggests that the two of the start going out with each other, even though they are both women. How will their relationship develop within the next 100 days?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Daiji na Koto wa, Ohanashi no Ato de
title_japanese: 大事なことは、おはなしのあとで
synopsis:
Dr. Kusaka from the pathology department is a very strict person. But outside the hospital's four walls, Iori is an ordinary man who loves reading and spending time with Keita, the man who comes over to read books to the kids. Is there a reason why it seems like they can't progress any further past friendship?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Almark
synopsis:
In the northern lands where war continues without end, young Almark hopes to be a mercenary like his father one day. Thinking the timid boy ill-suited for such a life, however, his worried father envisions a different future for him—all the way at the Nork Magical Academy in the peaceful South, once he's old enough to attend. And so, despite Almark's efforts on and off the battlefield, he eventually sets out for the academy to respect his father's wishes. But what lies ahead on his journey to becoming a magician?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Kabushikigaisha Kamikakushi
title_english: Kamikakushi Inc.: Agents of the Supernatural
title_japanese: 株式会社 神かくし
synopsis:
"Kamikakushi Inc."—a company that claims to make people vanish without a trace, disguising it as an accident. Arata Kagei, a struggling member of a phone scam group, is dragged by his senior to request Kamikakushi Inc.'s services to eliminate a target. But the true nature of this company is far more shocking than anyone could imagine—their real job is to introduce individuals to some very unexpected clients! Brace yourself for a dark suspense thriller where the mundane world collides with the supernatural!

(Source: Orange)

title: Kirio Fanclub
synopsis:
What would you do if your crush had ear-splitting farts?

For Aimi and Nami, the answer is to cry tears of joy for being able to pinpoint at a distance the object of their affections, Kirio, from a single toot. These are the kinds of deep, philosophical questions the two friends/rivals in romance pose to each other to prove their love for this boy who hardly seems to know they exist. That won't stop them from conducting nightly rituals to entice him into their dreams, though, or listing out what exactly they like about him, down to the very last organ. But when push comes to shove, will they choose their hilarious friendship over a shot at love?

Get ready for a rip-roaring romcom about the friendship behind what is fair in love and war!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Yuurei Yashiki Love Romance
title_english: Love Romance in a Haunted House
title_japanese: 幽霊屋敷ラブロマンス
synopsis:
A medium meets his soulmate, but he's an earthbound spirit and a boy to boot! "An absolute angel!" "I'm a ghost!" The ghostly boy, who has always been shunned by society, is gradually swept up in the young man's advances. This is a slightly terrifying yet very funny slapstick love comedy perfect for summer.

(Source: Number Nine, translated)

title: Smiley
synopsis:
Yuushi Kamome is a freelance journalist who lost his beloved daughter in an unforeseen accident. His descent into despair following her death drove his wife to leave him, and he lives each day a shell of the man he once was.

But his fate changes one day when members from a religious organization he had never heard of, the Smiling Hearts Society, knock on his door and hand him a flyer. He's ready to dismiss them until he notices the face of his estranged wife on the flyer, smiling ever so softly.

And so begins a tale of religion and insanity. What kind of sinister darkness lurks behind this religion and its strange smiles?

(Source: Kodama)

title: Shousetsu Blue Lock: Tatakai no Mae, Bokura wa.
title_japanese: 小説 ブルーロック 戦いの前、僕らは。

title: The Holy Power of Modern Medicine
title_english: The Holy Power of Modern Medicine
synopsis:
Yusung is a genius doctor famous in the medical world. He, who spent his whole life in an operation room, died in a traffic accident, and when he woke up, he was in another world. But...a saint? A holy empire? Healing magic? "I put so much effort into learning medicine, but now all I need to do is touch someone and they're healed? Seriously, I think I've gone crazy."

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: The Degrees Between Us
synopsis:
Dojin and Yeonwoo are in the same homeroom. Yeonwoo is the class rep and a bright, diligent kid. Dojin looks intimidating but he's actually just misunderstood. For some odd reason, Dojin has been becoming more and more aware of this strange, sprightly kid in his class. As fate would have it, they bump into each other after school one day. Yeonwoo describes to Dojin his most pressing problem in life: he's bored. Dojin makes Yeonwoo a promise that he'll be the freshness and excitement in his life whenever he needs to feel something new. But when Dojin innocently grazes Yeonwoo, there seems to be an electric warmth that shocks him. As these two grow closer and closer, to what degree will their intimacy develop? What will this warmth between them become?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: holoX MEETing!
title_japanese: ホロックスみーてぃんぐ!～holoX MEETing!～
synopsis:
When a job offer arrives from a company she never applied to, Sakamata Chloe is naturally suspicious, but she can't say no to the generous salary. Her new workplace is the Secret Society holoX, where fellow members Takane Lui, Hakui Koyori, Kazama Iroha, and their leader La+ Darknesss strive to achieve nothing short of world domination! (If they ever manage to scrounge up the funds, that is.) Discover the origins of the self-proclaimed "rightful rulers of Eden's planet" in this story based on the mega-popular virtual YouTuber stars of Hololive. "YES MY DARK!"

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Samsam's Home
synopsis:
After a recent divorce, Seung-gyu takes in an abandoned human–animal hybrid lingering outside his home, unable to ignore the quiet loneliness they share. As they begin living together, Seung-gyu names him Samsam and tries to care for him properly, but their gentle cohabitation soon deepens into an intimate bond.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Sentimental Lovers
synopsis:
Shiwook, a genius artist who was always lonely. Friends were jealous of him and adults tried to use him. If there was a single person who could understand and cherish him, Shiwook was ready to give everything he got. And finally, Shiwook met two men who could understand him. Ryu Shinwoo, the perfect man who never felt lonely and Song Jishin, who tried harder than anyone else not to be lonely. The two men are engaged in a war to take over Shiwook. But the most dangerous man among the three is Lee Shiwook...?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: My Cat Is a Vegetarian
synopsis:
One day, Taejun finds his cat, Tango, eating a mountain of meat based dish in front of Hyomin's eatery. "My cat is a vegetarian!" "Since when did cats became herbivores?! They are carnivores!" Taejun, a stern, stubborn vet who puts cats above people meets Hyomin, a wholehearted chef who makes scrumptious meat based dishes. Can these two very different people find love?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Twincognito Romance
synopsis:
Lee Haeun's peaceful life fell into pieces the night her twin Chaeeun disappeared without a trace. With no way to contact her sister and rent to pay, Haeun has little choice but to go to Chaeeun's company, disguised as Chaeeun herself! Things get even more complicated when she falls for the aloof Oh Joowan, her sister's colleague and mortal enemy! Will Haeun successfully dupe everyone, including her newfound crush, or will the consequences of going twincognito be too much for her?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: E ni Kaita Mochi wo Kaita Mochi
title_japanese: 絵に描いた餅を描いた餅

title: Koi to Tooboe
synopsis:
For the first time in a long time, Rentarou's visiting a remote, relatively unknown village named Oinu—where he and his mother used to live. Rentarou can't remember much of where he spent his carefree childhood, and he definitely doesn't remember anything about Ooinu's summer festival or its mysterious rural superstitions. Could the quiet, strangely helpful Shiro have the answers to all of Rentarou's questions?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Ame no Hi mo Kamisama to Sumou wo
title_japanese: 雨の日も神様と相撲を

title: Oshi ni Amagami
synopsis:
Hina Arukado is a modern vampire who drinks blood from bags instead of humans. But she's also a complete shut-in who hasn't left the house in 30 years. In an effort to reach her, Hina's worried dad does something that changes her life—he gives her the complete box set of the Vampire Cross anime series! Hina is instantly obsessed with everything about the show, especially the character Mao. But it's hard to fan as hard as she wants from her bedroom in Romania, so now Hina is out of the house and off to Japan to live her otaku dream!

Japan is otaku heaven for Hina, and she's so busy collecting as much merch as her new apartment can hold that she almost doesn't feel bad about missing out on the special menus at Vampire Cross cafes. If only she had a human friend who could eat all the themed food for her! But connecting with humans isn't easy until Hina literally bumps into her neighbor Kyuta, a prickly boy who looks just like Mao. Having her best friend live next door will be so convenie

title: Night Fishing
synopsis:
Baeksu's brother has gone missing. In a manhunt to find him, Baeksu Kang encounters the night fishermen. Their prey isn't fish, however—it's humans! Their favorite fishing spot? The Han River. Their last catch? Baeksu's brother. Can Baeksu stay alive long enough to find out the secret behind his brother's disappearance, or will the underground predators catch him first?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Egoist ni wa Nabikanai
title_english: I'll Never Fall in Love with an Egoist!
title_japanese: エゴイストにはなびかない
synopsis:
Jin Aohara's life is quite comfortable: he runs a popular rice ball shop with beachside views, and a variety of lovers happily come to his doorstep. As he closes shop one day, he witnesses a violent confrontation between two men over how one of them was bad at sex. After the disparaged man is knocked out, Jin decides to take him home until he regains consciousness.

When he comes to, the man introduces himself as Masaki Kazuma, who has come all the way from Japan to confront his ex-lover. But Jin believes there is more to this story than Masaki is willing to reveal. Since Masaki is without a proper hotel room, Jin allows him to stay until his return flight. But when Masaki decides to get handsy with him, Jin begins to wonder just what he has gotten himself into.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Yona and Chang-il
synopsis:
Yona's been dreaming of this day for seven years. It's his 18th birthday and he can finally sleep with Chang-il Park. What's with the age restriction, you ask? Well, Chang-il is a neighborhood prostitute that Yona's been following around like a puppy for years, just waiting for this moment. But one look at Yona's oddly big junk, and Chang-il has decided he needs to charge double for this little pervert. Will Yona, who has a thing for bad boys, finally be able to seal the deal? And will Chang-il treat this as just another business transaction or can Yona actually win him over...?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Lady Isabella's Path to Happiness
synopsis:
For centuries, the firstborn of House Helsington has been cursed to die young, so the family produces an illegitimate child, Isabella, to take on the curse instead. To get away from her terrible home and live her last days in peace, she wants nothing more than to escape. Her chance comes when Grand Duke Noverdic asks her to marry his son, Cleor. Once she arrives in the north, she is showered with endless affection from both her in-laws and her fiancé... to the point that it's almost suspicious.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Enrolling in the Transcendent Academy
synopsis:
After a hundred years of monsters, it's become the norm to train at hunter academies if you want to become a professional monster hunter. And that's just what hard-working orphan Seojun Kim dreams of. But after a freak accident dashes his hopes, ads for the mysterious Transcendent Academy pop up on his phone, offering him a chance to train virtually with history's most legendary warriors. As he levels up, he's soon caught up in the world of hunter academies, dungeon raids, and competitive tournaments. But the more he learns, the more questions he has about the people surrounding him, his past, and the secrets of the Transcendent Academy.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Zenin Ore no Solo Party
title_japanese: 全員俺のソロパーティ

title: Heibon Koukousei no Ore ga Game de wa Saikyou Guild no Guild Master nan desu ga......
title_japanese: 平凡高校生の俺がゲームでは最強ギルドのギルドマスターなんですが……

title: It's Just a Dream... Right?!
synopsis:
Vicious nightmares are much different from the regular ones: they are vivid almost like reality, persistent and recurring over an extended period of time, and most dangerously, they create physical injuries and extreme side effects called "malady." Shamans—individuals blessed with spiritual powers—perform rituals in which they enter the affected person's dreams and eliminate the "nightmare seedling" that is causing the vicious nightmares.

When 24-year-old Han Jungoh lands a job as a shaman's assistant, he ends up in the client's dream despite having no spiritual energy. His boss, the serious yet oddly adorable Shin Ibeom, is not too thrilled about Jungoh's interference with his work. However, Ibeom suddenly develops a malady—his body becomes hot and his head dizzy, unable to resist his physical desires. Too distraught and embarrassed to turn to his family, Ibeom asks Jungoh for help, swearing that his attraction is nothing but a bothersome side effect.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Imouto wa Kanojo ni Dekinai noni
title_japanese: 妹はカノジョにできないのに

title: Watashi no Kirai na Shachou
title_english: I Don't Like You... Mr. President!
title_japanese: わたしのきらいな社長
synopsis:
Shizuru Kohinata has a hard time expressing on her face how she feels. As a hotel housekeeper, she is scolded by guests for lacking remorse after making a mistake, and her coworkers denigrate her for being emotionless and scary. Shizuru's used to this treatment... and yet, today seems to be her limit. Tears start rolling down her cheeks and won't stop flowing, even in front of the owner of the hotel, Seishirou Kamiki. As the handsome VIP consoles her in her sadness, Shizuru finds herself waking up... naked in Mr. Kamiki's bed!? Shizuru has done it now. She'll be fired for sure and have to find a new job. Luckily, Mr. Kamiki has something in mind: if she won't wed him, why not work as his live-in maid?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: While I'm Back in Time, I'll Get My Revenge
title_english: While I'm Back in Time, I'll Get My Revenge
synopsis:
Most people would consider getting a second chance at life a blessing, but Arnell Radfell is furious when she wakes up to find herself back in the past. Terrified of having to suffer through the horrors of her past life twice, she attempts to end her life again but is rescued by Sir Herbert Schladin, the very man who gave her the courage to end her life the first time. However, when Arnell finds out that she can use the power of mana, she has a change of heart. They say revenge is sweet, and now, Arnell is determined to make everyone who made her suffer in her past life pay.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Rosalyn Vogart
synopsis:
Rosalyn poured her heart and soul into her family's business, making it the wealthiest trading company in the empire... but her ungrateful father refuses to let her inherit it! Instead, he pawns her off to the bankrupt royal family, offering her hand in marriage to Prince Robien and even agreeing to settle their debts in exchange for a noble title. Now, Rosalyn is hell-bent on leveraging her new status to take over her family's business.

But life at the palace is cruel. Hated by the people and the queen for her commoner status, Rosalyn can't trust a single person to help her. And yet, Robien continues to rescue Rosalyn when she needs it most. Despite her wariness to rely on him, she can't help but confide in him as time goes on. Can she truly count on Robien to help her reclaim what is rightfully hers?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Bokura wa Minna Kumorasetai
title_japanese: ボクらはみんな曇らせたい
synopsis:
1. Motto! Smile Charge
2. Kazan Trabasami to Watashi no Isshuukan
3. Wara wo Motsukamu Tami
4. Itai no Daisuki Ojousama Senki
5. Ohanabatake de Tsukamaete
6. Hahaoya Gawari no Oneechan ga Karada wo Kiriuri suru
7. Kuruma de xx! Shachuuhaku no Tabi!!
8. Yuukai Subscription Hajimetemita!

title: Yurika to Sayuri wa Koibito Doushi.
title_japanese: ゆりかとさゆりは恋人同士。

title: Telework Yotabanashi
synopsis:
Amidst a pandemic, system engineer Nokoru Mitsuhashi is ordered to telework. Spending far more time at home than he knows what to do with, he eventually meets Natsu Izumi, an archeology grad student living next door. While adjusting to life during the lockdown, Nokoru discovers newfound emotions as he navigates his relationship with Natsu, who—unbeknownst to him—is his future wife!

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Welfare Center
synopsis:
Seonghye wakes up in a room she does not recognize, surrounded by women she does not know. It is a torturous, malevolent prison, ironically called the Pureum Welfare Center. With no memory of how she got there, and using nothing but her wits, Seonghye must overcome hostile social dynamics, unknown dangers, and her own psychological roadblocks to rediscover her past and free herself from the Welfare Center.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Tank Chair
synopsis:
Shizuka takes on the most dangerous of assassin jobs, but she's not the one doing the killing. Rather, it's her brother, Nagi, a strong assassin who took a bullet to protect his sister, leaving him in a comatose state and having to use a wheelchair. However, Shizuka has figured out the key to waking her brother up: he must be faced with killing intent! Thus begins a violent journey of recovery, battling the most dangerous foes!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Road to Stardom
synopsis:
After a tragic accident, Jihoon Seo suffers a horrible injury that mars his face. With his dreams of being an actor seemingly dashed, he spends his time working in a small shop while imagining another life. But when he chances upon a spirit who heals his injury, Jihoon is given a golden opportunity to chase his goal once again. The road to stardom won't be easy, but with the help of his special guide and some unique friends he meets along the way, he's going to give one "spirited" performance!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: After School Mate
title_japanese: アフタースクールメイト
synopsis:
Family, friends, himself... Rika is frustrated by his inability to gain understanding of the gender difference between his body and mind, and one day he gets into a fight with his mother and runs away from home. There he meets Satsuki, a boy who can share his feelings of not being understood... The two meet and confront the issues they have been running away from... A coming-of-age drama that questions "individuality"!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Saiyaku Reijou no Fujouri na Jijou: Konyakusha ni Watashi Igai no Oaite ga Iru to Kiite shimatta no desu ga!
title_english: The Misfortune Follows the Unlucky Lady.
title_japanese: 災厄令嬢の不条理な事情 婚約者に私以外のお相手がいると聞いてしまったのですが!

title: Zaako Zako Zako Zako Sensei
title_japanese: ざーこざこざこざこ先生
synopsis:
Souichi Kirisaki, who teaches at a private middle school, has a problem. Three of his students, Chika Yuzukami, Yuki Kitsuregawa, and Momoka Watarase, make fun of him. Souichi wants to be well liked, but the girls look down on him and tease him every day. Souichi is troubled, but the truth is that all three of them love Souichi, they just can't be honest with him, plus Momoka is a stalker... A sassy and cute romcom between a teacher and three middle school students!

(Source: Flex Comix, translated)

title: Zaako Zako Zako Zako Sensei
title_japanese: ざーこざこざこざこ先生
synopsis:
Souichi Kirisaki, who teaches at a private middle school, has a problem. Three of his students, Chika Yuzukami, Yuki Kitsuregawa, and Momoka Watarase, make fun of him. Souichi wants to be well liked, but the girls look down on him and tease him every day. Souichi is troubled, but the truth is that all three of them love Souichi, they just can't be honest with him, plus Momoka is a stalker... A sassy and cute romcom between a teacher and three middle school students!

(Source: Flex Comix, translated)

title: Samurai Ω to Akutoku Shachou
synopsis:
"This cute sweet-tooth samurai is forever mine..."

Kenzaki Ryuunosuke, also known as Samurai-sensei, is an Ω who often gets mistaken for an α because of his manly looks and strong power. He took over his grandfather's dojo and became a kendo teacher, though recently, weird people have been visiting him for the shopping center development of the area. He protected the dojo, having the tables turned on them as if it were nothing.

But one day, their boss, Ootori Masamune, finally comes to the dojo, and...? Erotic omega-verse love between an overly-attached obsessive α and a strong, manly swordsman Ω!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Hands Up, You're Mine
synopsis:
It's Christmas eve and Ju-hyeon has no one to spend it with. Her own daughter is too cool to spend it with her mom and so is everybody else at the police precinct Ju-hyeon works at. Right when Ju-hyeon is ready to throw herself a pity party, Santa brings her an early Christmas present: Choi Si-Woo A.K.A one of her daughter's friends. But what started out as an innocent invite to share cake at her house soon turns into a hot steamy night. Come morning, Ju-hyeon wants nothing to do with Si-Woo but... Two things are for certain: Si-Woo is not going to let Ju-hyeon push him away and Ju-hyeon is definitely ending up on the Naughty List next year!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Zenin Ore no Solo Party: Betsusekai no Oretachi wo Shoukan shite Musou suru
title_japanese: 全員俺のソロパーティー～別世界の俺たちを召喚して無双する～
synopsis:
The story of an adventurer Esto who is looking for his teammates to explore the world. However, his skill "solo" changed everything.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Mystic Prince
synopsis:
The fourth prince Jeokyeon chose to hide being a woman and live as a man. Then later competes against nineteen other princes for the throne to become an immortal god. But amidst the sharp confrontations, an ancient conspiracy slowly unveils, and the fourth prince attracts more and more attention as his hidden talent comes to light. This is an epic of love and hate that blooms around a mystic prince.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Booty Camp
synopsis:
Ever find the one that got away? Harim and Eunju are old high school classmates who never got to fulfill their desires of being with each other. After graduating, they went their separate ways. But one day, they bump into each other and old flames get rekindled. Things are about to get hot and heavy, but there's just one thing. This stud has prioritized athletics above all else, meaning Eunju will have to show him the ropes in bed. Will they experience the ultimate high-intensity bedroom "booty camp" or will Harim's obsession with fitness get in the way of everything?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Down Came the Tiger
synopsis:
Hasun Kang has the ability to see vagrants, special beings that disguise themselves as humans. They have never caused him any trouble, until one day he is attacked by a vicious group of them. Just as he is on the verge of death, Beom, a tiger vagrant, pops out of his necklace and saves him. With Beom's help, Hasun learns that his family has a deep connection with the vagrants and a secret power that they desire. Can he learn how to control these powers and defeat these villains in time?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: I Only Want to Beat You
synopsis:
The male lead, Gigo Lee, who has never lost a single time in his life, and the female lead who defeated him Roji Oh. Who will end up as the victor of this "bet?"

(Source: Naver, translation)

title: The Cellist
synopsis:
Hayeon Kim was just covering for a friend at their day job when she unexpectedly ends up inside cellist Sehun Ji's private waiting room. Despite his immense musical talent, Sehun is aloof and cold-hearted, and doesn't take kindly to Hayeon's intrusion. Though he accuses her of attempted theft, he cannot get her out of his mind, and attempts to court her. But while Hayeon may be timid, she is not easily won over. If this cellist isn't careful, he may end up being the one getting played.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Koutetsu Jeeg
synopsis:
The story tells about Hiroshi Shiba, a car racer who is mortally wounded on a laboratory accident, but restored to life by his father, Professor Shiba, a talented scientist/archeologist, who is incidentally investigating the relics of the ancient Yamatai Kingdom. The professor discovers a tiny bronze bell with sorcerous powers, and shortly afterwards he is murdered by the henchmen of Queen Himika, the ruler of the Yamatai (sometimes translated as Jamatai) Kingdom, who wants to seize the ancient bell and its power.

(Source: MU)

title: Shousha Man no Isekai Survival: Zettai Hito to wa Tsurumanee
title_english: Another World Survival of Trading Company Man
title_japanese: 商社マンの異世界サバイバル ～絶対人とはつるまねえ～
synopsis:
A merchant by the name of Keigo  Okuda put everything into his work, day and night, until one day he won a lottery of 1 billion yen! With his money worries solved for life, he moved to the countryside far away from civilization to live the slow life. Then, suddenly he was transported to another world, along with his chicken coop?! In a world where he's unable to communicate with others, you think his merchant skills will help him?! A man in his forties who hates people retired to another world. The story of his slow life has begun!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: #Lovers
synopsis:
In a distant future, the earth has been destroyed by aliens. Keigo, a survivor of the human race who wants to kill the aliens more than anyone else, and Décolleté, the strongest alien who doesn't know what to do with her boredom. What sprouted the moment they met is pity, hatred, or love...? The counterattack by just the two of them begins.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Kyougoku-ke no Kekkon
synopsis:
"Marry me, just for show."

Seishirou Kyougoku, son and personal secretary of the incumbent Minister of Justice, found himself utterly baffled. First, his young half-brother Reo came to live with him! Then, an out-of-the-blue reunion with his old classmate Takeru Kyougoku led to Takeru finding out the truth about Reo!! And to top it off, now he's managed to get himself stuck in a sham marriage with Takeru!!! While breaking the news, Seishirou vows to put Takeru and Reo's wellbeing even above his own life, sham or not, but then Takeru pushes him down on the bed and demands a different sort of consolation prize for going along with this plan... Can real love bloom from a union born of lies?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title: Kyougoku-ke no Shoya
synopsis:
"Can you not learn to love me?"

Seishirou Kyougoku, son and personal secretary of the incumbent Minister of Justice, is now living the newlywed life with his just-for-show husband Takeru Kyougoku and his young half-brother Reo. However, being the honest and diligent man he is, Seishirou can't shake his guilt over dragging them all into this farce of a marriage. Despite his best intentions, he grows more and more despondent as time passes. That's when Takeru tells him not to worry because everything will turn out fine if they just turn their sham marriage into a real one... How exactly is love born?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title: The Odd One Next Door
synopsis:
Gaeun Yoo is done with dating. After her ex left her to marry a famous actress, she now spends her days running her late mother's studio and cleaning up after her twin's messes. But her quiet life changes drastically when crude and cranky Siwan Kang moves into a nearby house. Though Gaeun tries to be civil to her odd neighbor, sparks fly every time they meet, causing one argument after another. Will she ever manage to make peace with Siwan, or will the sparks set fire to something else in her?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: α no JK dakedo Konyakusha ga Ω no Sensei de Asoko ga Taihen desu
title_japanese: αのJKだけど婚約者がΩの先生でアソコが大変です
synopsis:
Nana Kitano, an alpha who is in the highest class of athletics, studies, family background, and appearance. Her family's custom requires her to have an arranged marriage with an omega, and her goal is to destroy the match. She wants to decide who she will marry. With this conviction, she goes to the arranged marriage venue to break up the marriage, but the person there is Kazuki Haibara, a teacher at her school. Shichi is surprised by this unexpected partner. However, she gradually becomes attracted to the teacher...?

synopsis:
College is a time of freedom, learning, and, let's be honest, sex. Juhyun and Jigoo spent most of their high school years studying and keeping their relationship a secret from everyone in their lives. But now, they've moved out which means no curfew, no rules, and no roommates. But they're about to learn that taking their relationship to the next level means taking on some new challenges, too.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Hush
synopsis:
It's the first day of the new school year and Juhyun... Well, he's not exactly enthused. In fact, the only things on his mind are girls. The girls at his school, to be specific. Jigoo, on the other hand, wakes up early and gets ready and stops by Juhyun's home on the way to school. And, as it turns out, Jigoo might not be as interested in girls as Juhyun is.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Warawa no Koukyuuhi Ranking wa 133-banme no you desu

synopsis:
Urei Getsu entered the Imperial Harem as a consort seven years ago and has lived in the Inner Palace since, as 133rd place in consort ranking. Urei has always wanted to go back to her home in Saimon. But when the opportunity arises, she refuses. Could it be because she truly believes she can climb up the ranks under a new emperor? Or could she be waiting for someone to come...?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Yankee Oniisan wo Munekyun saseru Houhou

Hajime, a straight-laced high school student, fell in love at first sight with Mitsuru, a yankee who helped him one day. Since Hajime has no experience in love, he starts approaching Mitsuru while studying shoujo manga. And when he starts to pay attention to his appearance in order to become the man Mitsuru likes, Hajime suddenly starts to get popular...?!

Included one-shot: Senpai no Inu ni Nattara

Now in his third year of college, Hiroto is shocked to find Mika when he wanders onto a part of campus he has never visited before. The only problem is that Kou Natsume, Mika's reincarnation, has no memory of the love they once shared. Hiroto vows to make Kou fall in love with him, but he keeps worrying about what might happen if Kou should remember the cruel fate that befell Mika.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

synopsis:

After losing her parents and ending up on the streets with her brother, Astel realizes she is actually in a novel where she and her loved ones die at the hands of a mysterious villain. Determined to change this, she decides to infiltrate the castle of Duke Anais and uncover the villain's identity! The first step of the plan succeeds, but now there's just one issue: she is bound to the shapeshifter duke as his mate! Will Astel be able to fulfill her goal while dealing with this new relationship?

(Source: Tapas Media)

I, who was merely a maid at the royal palace, heard the crown prince's secret by accident. The crown prince's fiancee who ran away was actually a man?! "Please spare me! I'll do anything!" However, if I play my cards right and save the monthly allowance I receive for acting as the saintess, I should at the very least be able to buy a building and live comfortably as a landlord! title: From BFF to Obsessive Hubby
synopsis:
Isabelle is in a pinch. In the absence of her protective nuns, a wicked priest has sold her to Duke Cardiego. A long time ago, the goddess Iris blessed three prominent families with unique magical powers, and the Cardiego family that controls the underworld is the most notorious one. By all accounts, Duke Cardiego's lower parts are dysfunctional, and he has ruthlessly murdered his every prospective bride. Although Lix is easy on the eyes, Isabelle sees him as nothing more than a genuine friend who platonically loves her enough to do this small favor for her. However, Isabelle's sudden sham marriage proposal throws a wrench in Lix's plans, as he has been waiting for the perfect moment to make a real offer first.

Iroha is an average student newly enrolled in Cipher Academy, a Spartan school where students must crack code after code after code with barely enough time to catch their breath! Then a mysterious person named Kogoe gives Iroha an unusual pair of glasses with a crazy secret behind them!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: In the Sunshower
synopsis:
Yoon Seul appeared in Sae-byeok's life for a brief moment, then disappeared like a fleeting sunshower. But mysterious circumstances have brought her back to the human world and into Sae-byeok's life once more. She needs to reclaim what was once hers. And in order to get it, Yoon Seul needs something from Sae-byeok that's more important now than ever: his love.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: As You Wish
synopsis:
Ein Price was 35 when he was murdered. Now he's 19 again and back in college with the man he was madly in love with: Ray Cunnington. After saving a dragon named Null, Ein was given three wishes. The first was a sausage. The second was for Ray to be the last face he saw before he dies. His wish was granted...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Shousetsu Kidou Senshi Gundam: Suisei no Majo

synopsis:
A.S. (Ad Stella) 122―An era when a multitude of corporations have entered space and built a huge economic system. A lone girl from the remote planet Mercury transfers to the Asticassia School of Technology, run by the Beneritt Group which dominates the mobile suit industry. Her name is Suletta Mercury. With a scarlet light burning in her pure heart, this girl walks step by step through a new world.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Ability
synopsis:
A world of supernatural where strong preys on weak. An Earth just not for humans... and a strange ability!

(Source: MU)

title: TS Gakuen no Nichijou
synopsis: A story set in a boy's school where multiple students occasionally transform into girls.

title: Sayonara Gengar

Manaka and Toudou have a dog and cat relationship. But one day, Manaka's doppelgänger appears and their relationship completely changes! Toudou, who loves dark matters, and Manaka begin to search for Manaka's true identity...!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Emerald no Kaizoku
synopsis:
Young pirate Captain Assur, his jet-black hair flowing, sets off for a homeland he has never seen. He rides the icy northern seas to a land of lilies and gold, a land of dreams. Among his companions are the beautiful Phillip and the princess of that homeland, Rovena.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

Included one-shots:
Volume 1: Ai wa Fushichou no You ni
Volume 2: Giniro no Romance

title: Tensei Yuusha wa Joshikousei!?: Maou no Dekiai ni Komattemasu
title_japanese: 転生勇者は女子高生!?～魔王の溺愛に困ってます～

title: Ten to Banrai
synopsis:
Ten, a tanuki who can shapeshift, was sent as a replacement bride to appease the thunder god. He was surprised to find out the god was actually his childhood friend that he hadn't met for a long time. However, the god doesn't remember him anymore.

(Source: MU)

title: Koi no Mae ni, Amaku Hajimete. Hikaeme Elite-kun ga Watashi ni Dake Hatsujou Shiteimasu

synopsis:
Childish Rui Sasaki is 25 years old, single, and a virgin. All she wants is to fall in love like everyone else and have sex with a nice boyfriend! While lamenting over this during drinks with her childhood friend, Naoko, she met Ritsu, a modest and handsome man. He was kind enough to listen to her complaints and take care of her drunken self. Suddenly, an intoxicated Rui falls on top of Ritsu and kisses him...?! For two beginners in love, each with their own issues, is it possible for love to start with sex? A pure story of two people in a complicated love affair is set to begin.

(Source: Pinkcherie, translated)

title: Unmei demo Netsuai wa Yurushimasen!
title_japanese: 運命でも熱愛は許しません!
synopsis:
Makoto Nanase has always been self-conscious about his appearance. He feels that he looks incredibly plain—the exact opposite of the almost supernatural cuteness his secondary sex, omega, is known for. To avoid judgment, he spends his daily life pretending to be a beta, a neutral secondary sex.

At the talent agency where he works, Makoto is assigned as the new agent for the model Rio Sakaki—both to his surprise and dismay. As an alpha, Rio has a natural urge that draws him to omegas, which he makes clear when he starts flirting with Makoto. However, as the two spend time together, Makoto begins to realize that Rio's claims of "love at first sight" may be more than just a pickup line.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kimi no Shita wa Dolce
title_english: Bacio Dolci: Lips Sweeter Than Cream
synopsis:
He may be on the mature side, but he's still ripe for the picking, and someone wants a taste!

Chef Saejima runs his own Italian restaurant, and business is not exactly thriving, much to his dismay. Hoping to uncover the secret to his rival restaurant's success, he infiltrates their staff, but his spying is derailed by love at first sight—for Dante, the handsome and just-his-type head chef. Not that there's any way such a gorgeous guy would ever date plain old Saejima... Or so he thought until one night, alone with Dante after closing, he finds himself being passionately kissed, and it doesn't take long for Dante's hand to slide down between his legs! What will become of him when Dante—secretly an incubus—discovers that he just can't get enough of Saejima's delectable semen...?

It's a sexy and wild ride as an incubus with a taste for the gourmet and a chef who's especially sensitive to pleasure discover their own recipe for love!

(Source: NTT Solmare)

title: Hakyoku Yotei no Akujo no Hazu ga, Reitetsu Koushaku-sama ga Wakarete Kuremasen!
title_japanese: 破局予定の悪女のはずが、冷徹公爵様が別れてくれません!
synopsis:
Grace is reincarnated in the world of novels as a greedy villainess. According to the story, she toyed with and abandoned the cold-hearted Duke Zane, which led to an opportunity for him to meet the heroine. If things went differently, a war would break out and Grace would die. In order to avoid a bad ending, Grace devotes herself to being a perfect villainess, but due to her serious personality, she fails to do so. Moreover, she is doted on by the Duke who is supposed to break up with her!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: The God of War
synopsis:
The master martial artist, Jinwoon, has already gone through two life cycles to defeat the menacing Lord of the Nine Heavenly Mercy Palace. In his first life, he couldn't even come close to his goal. In his second life, he died just before he could put the long martial arts war to an end. Now in his third life, he wakes up ten years in the past as Seomun Bi, the second son of the Seomun Clan and the younger brother of the sword master, Seomun Hui. With his newfound resources, he begins his training to become the exalted God of War once more. Will he finally be able to destroy his great enemy in this life?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Kaiki Senban! Nekomachi Shoutengai
title_english: Strange Happenings at Nekomachi Shopping District
synopsis:
At a particular shopping district located in an old Tokyo neighborhood, humans and cats seem to live together in peace. But these cats aren't your ordinary felines! They are spirits, whose human forms allow them to go about their days undetected amongst the other locals. And the truth is, this neighborhood attracts some rather unique problems because of its residents. Chisato, a shop owner and the only human aware of the cat spirits' presence, and Kotora, a young cat spirit band together in attempt to solve the various predicaments they encounter. But will luck be on their side?

(Source: Shodensha)

title: Tobioriru Chokuzen no Doukyuusei ni "XXX shiyou!" to Teian shitemita.
title_japanese: 飛び降りる直前の同級生に『×××しよう!』と提案してみた。
synopsis:
My first love, her name is Kurumi Koga.

She was so much more beautiful and mature than a typical high school student, which attracted a great deal of jealousy and dislike. So much so that she was on the verge of jumping off the rooftop because of all the bullying she received.

So, what can I do to help?

"Why not have sex with me!"
"...You pervert! (yuck!)"
"Maybe so! But are you sure? If you die here, your last memory will be the confession of some pervert you don't even know! It would ruin the mood!"
"...What have you done! You pervert!"
"I have my reasons. Because I love you more than anything in the world! Let's get married!"
"What, ehhhh?"

I will yell out my love until I die, if it will make a place for you in this world!

The most stupid and straightforward protagonist in the history of romantic comedies and the cool, sullen JK will hook up for a romantic comedy with a sugar content of 100%!

synopsis:
After being transferred to another world, Hiroyuki defeats his opponents, whether they are humans or demons, and lives at his own pace, just as he does in the present world.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Straight Outta Manhwa
synopsis:
Seon-Nyeo Han hears about an old romance manhwa from more than a decade ago, with a female lead character whose face and name are the same as hers. She obtains a copy of that manhwa by luck, and falls asleep while reading it. When she wakes up, she finds Nam-Wook Cheon, the male lead character, lying next to her. From the moment he comes "straight out of manhwa," Seon-Nyeo's normal school life begins to go awry!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Mofutte Ii no wa Omae dake
title_japanese: モフっていいのはお前だけ
synopsis:
Determined to defeat all canines, Shiro is a cute little white cat with a selfish attitude who's unwillingly picked up off the streets by Kuro's owner. Kuro is the large black dog who vows to protect Shiro, but one day after the two are all grown up, Shiro suddenly goes into heat!

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Minami-kun wa Sono Koe ni Jirasaretai
title_english: He Craves to be Teased by His Favorite ASMR Streamer
title_japanese: 南くんはその声に焦らされたい
synopsis:
The untalkative and constantly placid Karasuma Koudai is a college student who streams ASMR once or twice a week. However, recently, his views are not growing, so he is thinking of quitting. One day, he found out that his polar opposite, the cheerful and popular Minami Masaya, is actually an enthusiastic listener who comments on his streams. What surprised him more was when a blushing Minami confessed, "I can't ejaculate without Karasuma's voice..." Towards such an unexpected side of Minami, Karasuma unthinkingly offers to help him out...?! Initially, Karasuma felt a sense of superiority as Minami would react upon hearing his voice. However, he gradually wanted to lovingly and kindly touch Minami.

(Source: Kasakura Shuppansha, translated)

title: Don't Touch Me
synopsis:
Since he was a child, Dokyung Kang has been able to see an eerie black smoke that caused people to get hurt. One day, he runs into a man covered in this smoke, who turns out to be his infamous school sunbae Woohyun Park. Though wary of his cold demeanor at first, Dokyung is surprised to find out that whenever he touches Woohyun, the smoke disappears. Ecstatic to finally use his special gift for some good, Dokyung is determined to help his sunbae to get rid of the darkness surrounding him.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Hatenai Sora wo Kimi to Tobitai: Ame no Hi ni Idol ni Kasa wo Kashitara, Futarikiri de Lesson wo Suru Koto ni Natta

title: The Broken Ring: This Marriage Will Fail Anyway
title_english: The Broken Ring: This Marriage Will Fail Anyway
synopsis:
Nobody understands why the brilliant six-year-old Inés Valeztena de Perez picked Cárcel Escalante de Esposa as her fiancé. Considering her family's high status, she could have easily married the crown prince and led an outstanding life as the empress. Cárcel grew up believing that Inés loved him deeply, despite her eerily emotionless demeanor and understated style. But, put in a difficult position against his will, he harbored no affection for such a dull person and instead turned to countless other women behind her back.

Cárcel's whole reality crumbles when Inés catches him in the act—because she does not care whatsoever. She intends to turn a blind eye to his infidelity even after tying the knot, which leaves Cárcel in complete disbelief. Inés' indifference ignites a perverse desire inside Cárcel, and he abruptly loses interest in everyone else. However, there is a reason behind each of Inés' actions, and it all started when she took her own life for the very first time.

title: Mahou Shoujo♡Misoji
synopsis:
Appearances are everything for women. Youko Hoshi, in her thirties and single, strived to be happy without standing out, but one day she was transformed into a magical girl and forced to fight... An extremely niche heroic gag comic full of the sorrows of a woman who cares about appearances more than anyone else!

Haruta is introverted and always wears a bra to protect his sensitive nipples. What happens when his extroverted coworker figures out his secret and urges him to wear sexy lingerie...?!

(Source: Shusuisha)

title: Back to School: All Grown Up
title_english: Back to School: All Grown Up
synopsis:
Five years after high school graduation, Chiwoo and Kyujin are all grown up and still going steady. In fact, their bond is deeper than ever, both emotionally... and physically! But when Jihyun comes back on the scene, could there be trouble brewing in paradise?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Yes ka No ka Hanbun ka
title_japanese: イエスかノーか半分か
synopsis:
Kei Kunieda is the up-and-coming prince of the evening news. Inside, he’s the opposite: brash, hot-tempered, and prickly as can be. For years, Kei has successfully juggled his private and professional personas—until a chance meeting with stop-motion animator Ushio Tsuzuki threatens to bring it all crashing down. But is that really as frightening as the possibility that someone might love and accept both sides of who he is?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Tensei shite kara 40-nen. Sorosoro, Ojisan mo Koi ga Shitai.
title_japanese: 転生してから40年。そろそろ、おじさんも恋がしたい。
synopsis:
"What did I do with my youth?"

Once upon a time, there lived a man with memories of his previous life. He worked diligently and seriously for years. This man is known as Gerald, who leads his own guild. At the age of 40, he starts reflecting on the time gone by. Finally, he wants to fall in love. Of course, as a man who has never experienced love, his initial pursuits end in failure.

At that time, the girls around him begin to notice his charm and begin to pursue him. This is too much for a middle-aged man like him!

(Source: Earth Star Entertainment, translated)

title: Tensei shite kara 40-nen. Sorosoro, Ojisan mo Koi ga Shitai.: Nidome no Jinsei wa Harem Route!?
title_japanese: 転生してから４０年。そろそろ、おじさんも恋がしたい。 二度目の人生はハーレムルート!?

title: Akutoku Kizoku no Seizon Senryaku
title_english: Survival Strategies of a Corrupt Aristocrat
synopsis:
While playing games after my wife betrayed me, I suddenly died and woke up as Jack Girard, the protagonist of the fangame Survival Strategies of a Corrupt Aristocrat. Unfortunately, Jack has it even worse than I do. Between his parents trying to assassinate him, the betrayal of his personal maid and the house's butler, and a host of other horrors, his life—now my life—is one treacherous twist after another. However, with the help of Adele, the strongest supporting character of the game, and my foreknowledge of said twists, I'm determined to overcome it all and live in the lap of luxury!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Tsuki no Shirosa wo Shirite Madoromu
title_japanese: 月の白さを知りてまどろむ
synopsis:
Irede, the town of fine drink, masterful performing arts, and holy courtesans, was built long ago as an offering to a god. Travelers gather here in droves from across the continent, but unbeknownst to them, shades—creatures who lead humans astray—lurk in the streets. Sari, a maiden with the ability to bind shades, is the proprietress of a living myth: the courtesan house Pale Moon. And when she meets Xixu, a shadeslayer fresh from the capital, restless shadows begin stirring beneath the town's surface...

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Boku no Suki na Hito ga Suki na Hito
title_japanese: ぼくの好きな人が好きな人
synopsis:
Sora Akizuki, a second-year high school boy, confesses his feelings to Miya Fuwa, but she rejects him because she "likes someone else." The person she likes is... Asahi Suzukaze, the head of the mysterious "Clinical Trial Club." Sora joins the club, only to find out that Asahi also has someone she likes. He is a boy who once saved Asahi, who was seriously ill, by helping her get through a "clinical trial," so she calls him "the prince of clinical trials." But it turns out that boy is Sora, who was a mischievous elementary school kid at the time...?

This is a high-tension "clinical trial" romantic comedy with a complex intersection of love interests!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Kachou, Kekkon shimashou!!
synopsis:
Aoki, who lives with his only daughter after his wife died, has a special hobby of making sweets! One day while handing out his baked goods at work, Mizuno, an unfriendly subordinate, unexpectedly enjoyed the desserts. As a result, Aoki invited Mizuno to his house to deepen his friendship, but as soon as Aoki gave Mizuno a colorful handmade sweet, he proposed saying, "Chief, please marry me!"

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

title: Special
synopsis:
Superstrength-wielding Komoro Iga wears a helmet regardless of the season. Transfer student Hano is seated next to her. Without any comment from anyone else on Komoro's eccentricity, Hano adjusts to her new daily life.

title_japanese: 兄たちに愛されて、殺されて。
synopsis: Mahiru lives in peace with her adoptive older brothers—who happen to be identical triplets—until the news of her grandfather's death leaves them all shaken. In his will, the deceased man states that his possessions worth 15 billion yen will be inherited by the triplet that either kills or marries Mahiru! The tranquil atmosphere Mahiru has always known is plunged into chaos as the unwavering bonds she shares with her brothers are put to the test.

title: A Fine Line
synopsis:
Guys like Woojin have it all: the looks, personality, and background to be popular. There's no way Woojin would take interest in a nobody like Yunwoo, but Yunwoo ends up falling for Woojin and telling him how he feels. To Yunwoo's surprise, Woojin responds to the outburst with a risky suggestion of his own. Yunwoo can't seem to say no to Woojin, but how long can they last?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Netorare Kouhai Kanojo

Witness the story of Sumika, a cute college student who gets slowly corrupted into cheating on her boyfriend and loving it.
