No one really knows the purpose of the cafe, but one thing's for sure— it's magical.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Cafe Midnight
synopsis:
Cafe Midnight isn't your average cafe. It opens from dusk till dawn, the master never ages, and... it's a time slip?! There are visitors from different backgrounds and different time periods, all with their own stories to tell. One thing that they have in common? They've all somehow found their way to Cafe Midnight, where they can encounter those living in the present, past, and future. No one really knows the purpose of the cafe, but one thing's for sure— it's magical.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Dangeum and Jigyo
synopsis:
Our story begins with Jigyo, the crown prince, having recently been exiled from the palace with a guard, Dangeum, and the man who raised him, Chunggeum. The three are forced to pass their remaining days in a quiet village made up of mostly elderly residents. This leads to a listless and lonely Jigyo, who begins pressing Dangeum to relieve his traditional post as a voiceless shadow, and the two quickly grow closer. Hints of a bloody conspiracy, Dangeum's mysterious origin, and a Chunggeum who seems to know more than he's letting on—just how are these three characters connected, and what will happen to them during exile?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Only Hope
synopsis:
The night she witnessed her beloved husband involved in a murder, Eun-hye was murdered and time traveled nine years back to the day she first met him. Will she be able to put a halt to her husband's horrific killings? And, more importantly, will she ever be able to love again?

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Sisters at War
synopsis:
What if your worst enemy turned out to be your sister? Dark loner Haera and golden child Li-on have always been arch rivals, competing to be the best in their arts high school. Of course, Li-on always seems to win, with the support and privilege provided by her wildly wealthy, world-famous sculptor mother. Then again, Li-on has dark secrets of her own, and there's just something about Haera—her authenticity and vision. Will Haera and Li-on ever make peace? After all, there can only be one when it comes to the real deal.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Extraordinary Attorney Woo
synopsis:
Woo Young-woo is a rookie attorney on the autism spectrum at one of Korea's most prestigious law firms, Hanbada. Using her encyclopedic memory and creative thought process, she can find unconventional solutions to the toughest cases—but can she succeed while facing discrimination and stigma?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Mother's Contract Marriage
synopsis:
Years ago, a nobleman abandoned his wife, Ludia, and their daughter, Lyrica Vans. Without him, Ludia and Lyrica lost their status and were forced to move to the slums. While Ludia drinks her sorrows away, eight-year-old Lyrica works tirelessly to pay their living expenses, refusing to hate her mother for her neglect and abuse.

One day, a drunk Ludia falls asleep and wakes up a changed woman. Lyrica believes she is dreaming when her mother suddenly embraces her, with a string of apologies and loving words pouring from her lips. After Ludia exclaims that she will marry the dread emperor Alterres Takar, Lyrica is sure her mother has lost her mind.

However, Ludia quickly secures her marriage to Alterres, confessing to Lyrica that it is truthfully a contractual relationship. In no time, Lyrica is thrown into the role of princess, surrounded by glittering riches beyond her wildest dreams. Life as royalty is full of rules and devious schemes, but Lyrica's refreshing honesty and pure heart s

title: Boku no Dokuhime wa Kyou mo Kawaii
title_english: My Poison Princess Is Still Cute
title_japanese: ぼくの毒姫は今日もかわいい
synopsis:
When demon princess Raffy married Roren, an immortal knight who safeguards humanity, as part of a new peace treaty between humans and demons, she hadn’t quite expected... that he'd fall for her?! Not only that, he's weirdly stubborn enough to keep trying to get closer to her, despite repeatedly dying from the poison she naturally emits. Just how long will his adoration prevail...?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Eichi na Video wa Suki desu ka?
title_japanese: 叡智なビデオは好きですか？

title: Watashi wo Koroshita Wanko-kei Kishi-sama ga, Yandere ni Job Change shite Kyou mo Inochi wo Nerattekuru
title_japanese: 私を殺したワンコ系騎士様が、ヤンデレにジョブチェンジして今日も命を狙ってくる
synopsis:
Tiana's engagement was annulled by the prince of her own country, and she was sentenced to exile. However, the knight of a neighboring country, who was an aide to that country's prince, suddenly proposed to her. Since he was her type, Tiana accepted the marriage proposal and traveled with him to his country, but what awaited her was an unjust death. However, although she should have died, Tiana finds herself back when her engagement was annulled and she was proposed to by the knight!

"Now... Now it's too late... I'll have to kill her."

The last words the knight spoke before killing her lingered in her mind. But Tiana doesn't want to die again! Terrified, she tries to refuse the marriage proposal, but she can't escape from the knight who has gone completely crazy! A cat-and-mouse rom-com about Tiana, whose memories construe murderous intent, and a knight who refuses to let her escape and gets more and more yandere...

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Douki to Tawawa
synopsis: A crossover work between Ganbare Douki-chan and Getsuyoubi no Tawawa.

title: I Tamed My Ex-Husband's Mad Dog
title_english: I Tamed My Ex-Husband's Mad Dog
synopsis:
When Reinhardt Lincke first lived her life, she felt nothing but misery and rage. Her fiancé, Crown Prince Michel Allanketh, called off their engagement and exiled her after her beloved father died in his stead. It was hardly a banishment; wealth and warmth surrounded her in a prosperous territory, but her heart darkened with each passing day, aching from the injustice and betrayal. It is the strength of her anguish that miraculously transports her 15 years into the past, just before Michel abandons her.

Reinhardt's sole purpose becomes retaliation against the arrogant prince who robbed her of everything. She stabs Michel's leg and receives a harsh punishment: life in the snowy and dangerous mountains at one of the empire's forgotten corners. When Reinhardt finds herself in trouble, a small and disheveled child saves her life. She quickly realizes that the child is the emperor's 16-year-old illegitimate son, a skilled assassin whom Michel was to soon discover and mold into a perfectly

title: What the Duke Picked Up in the Forest
synopsis:
"I'm going to do this for the last time, so let me go back with my memories."

Those who died for me 29 times... I wanted to protect you with my own hands at least once. I want to protect those poor and pitiful "my people."

Thus, Elysia's 30th and last regression began. Everything began to change as if fate had been twisted into place. A child who was born without a "sign" in a family that received God's protection and lived a harsh life. I gradually realize that the beginning of the curse disguised as God's blessing all started with one person...

(Source: Story M, translated)

title: When the Third Wheel Strikes Back
title_english: When the Third Wheel Strikes Back
synopsis:
When Ye-Seo Jung wakes up one day, he finds himself trapped inside the body of Jesse Venetiaan, the ill-fated second male lead of a mega-hit fantasy romance novel "I Quit My Job, then I Became the Princess Bride." It turns out this second male lead is destined to die at war, trying to protect the male lead. Ye-Seo's goal is to avoid getting entangled with the main characters and survive until the war is over, all while searching for a way to return home safe and sound. But the female lead, Christelle, and the male lead, Cedric, keep approaching him...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Where on When,
synopsis: A high school student searches for mystical objects using a pendulum made of a coin and makes an unexpected discovery.

title: Boku dake wo Mitekure
synopsis:
Yoh was in love with his childhood friend Taishi. He was happy and had no doubts about his daily routine of taking care of Taishi, who was crippled. Except that he is a man and he has fallen in love with a "woman"...

(Source: COMICSMART, translated)

title: Boku to Gal ga Fuufu ni Naru made
title_japanese: 僕と君〈ギャル〉が夫婦になるまで
synopsis:
Sora Kanakura was a boy born into a poor household. He studied hard and managed to pass the exam to an excellent high school but, it soon turned out that his parents were in debt! When it was time to pay the debt off, a mysterious gal appeared and offered to pay off their debt. A big burden was almost off Kanakura's head, but the gal made a condition in return which stated that...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Shousetsu Blue Lock
title_japanese: 小説 ブルーロック
synopsis:
After a disastrous defeat at the 2018 World Cup, Japan's team struggles to regroup. But what's missing? An absolute Ace Striker, who can guide them to the win. The Japan Football Union is hell-bent on creating a striker who hungers for goals and thirsts for victory, and who can be the decisive instrument in turning around a losing match...and to do so, they've gathered 300 of Japan's best and brightest youth players. Who will emerge to lead the team...and will they be able to out-muscle and out-ego everyone who stands in their way?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Ai wo Kataru nara Hisoyaka ni
title_japanese: 愛を語るなら密やかに
synopsis:
This is the story of a cold-hearted mafia and the strange relationship he shares with the maid who works for him. In truth, he's actually a gentleman who is infatuated with his maid! From buying expensive gifts to planning the perfect date, he does everything he can to express his love—almost like he is unaware of the difference in their social standings. Thus begins a flashy, fun, and slightly dangerous romantic comedy.

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Yonayona, Amaku
synopsis:
Roma, who works as a high-end call boy by night, suddenly starts living together with the son of a wealthy man, Sharaku, due to his mother's sudden remarriage. The lifestyles of the cheerful Roma and the straight-laced Sharaku are exact opposites, and just when Roma thought there would be no common ground between them even if they lived together, Sharaku shows up as his customer for the night...! Rather than refusing him, they continue their play at Sharaku's request. They go all the way and have sex and the next day, he suggests an exclusive contract...?!

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

title: Doushiyoumonai, Boku no Hatsukoi.
title_english: I Can't Help It, My First Love.
title_japanese: どうしようもない、ぼくの初恋。
synopsis:
Yugi has been hiding his feelings. One day he finds out that his crush, Takeuchi, has been dumped by his girlfriend. Yugi dashes over to him to confess his feelings. Surprised by Yugi's pushy behavior, Takeuchi also starts to sense a change in himself. Watch these two clumsy people fall in love for the first time in this coming-of-age story!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Tanken Hakken Boku no Isekai Elf-san
title_japanese: たんけんはっけん ぼくの異世界エルフさん
synopsis:
One day home from work, the exhausted salaryman Amano's bath time is interrupted by an elf suddenly emerging from the tub! This clumsy but kind of brilliant otherworldly elf comes to the human world to take it easy and enjoy reading some manga.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: The Poem of Aster and Hana
title_english: The Poem of Aster and Hana
synopsis:
High schooler Hana Kim channels her pain and angst by leading a secret life as Sparrow, the live streamer! In her vids, she shares her love of poetry yet never her own face, because—let's be honest—people are the worst, especially on the internet. Her cherished anonymity is broken when her classmate Aster discovers her private life and wants to get closer to her. Will she keep her distance from him? Or will she let down the walls she built to protect her heart from life's cruel realities?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Gendai Shakai de Otome Game no Akuyaku Reijou wo Suru no wa Chotto Taihen
title_english: It's a Little Hard to Be a Villainess of an Otome Game in Modern Society
title_japanese: 現代社会で乙女ゲームの悪役令嬢をするのはちょっと大変
synopsis:
When an exhausted career woman is reincarnated as Runa Keikain, the villainess of an otome game born in the 1990s, she's determined to win at any cost. She may lose the love interest's heart, but she refuses to be ruined. Armed with the foreknowledge of the economic crash looming on Japan's horizon, Runa must revitalize her father's company and secure her freedom for herself and her new family.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Ming Gi Nyu
synopsis:
To an outcast like Yeon Wu, her first crush was a mysterious man named Ming Gi Nyu who emotionally supported her when she was at her lowest. However, as Yeon Wu enters college, she wants to forget all about him. The only problem is Ming Gi Nyu is not ready to let her go...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Douseikon de Oyako ni Narimashita.
title_english: Why I Adopted My Husband: The True Story of a Gay Couple Seeking Legal Recognition in Japan
title_japanese: 同性婚で親子になりました。
synopsis:
As a gay couple living in Japan (where gay marriage is not yet legal), Yuuta and Kyouta have found a unique loophole in order to live together and support one another financially, legally and medically; Kyouta adopted Yuuta. This nonfiction manga depicts how they met, living together, discussions with their parents, and their future anxieties and determination as they strive for independence and equal rights under Japanese law.

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Kirai ni Narasete Tonari no Ookami
title_japanese: キライにならせてとなりのオオカミ
synopsis:
College student Hibiki has been friends with Akira and Ryuusei for ages. All that time, he's kept his romantic feelings for Akira hidden; when Akira gets into a serious relationship, the news leaves Hibiki heartbroken. Ryuusei goes after Hibiki when he rushes off in distress and promises to keep Hibiki's feelings for Akira a secret... but the catch is, Hibiki will have to become Ryuusei's boyfriend...!

(Source: Houbunsha)

title: Bad Trip
synopsis:
As a yakuza underling, Kosuke makes a living by selling his body to men. Even though he usually leaves quickly after sex, he inadvertently ends up staying with a client until morning. And for some reason, he has absolutely no memories of what happened the night before. His client, Ryoichi, is incredibly handsome... and even after he sees Kosuke's tattoo, he asks to spend another night with him. After hearing a rumor that a drug which makes people's memories hazy during use called pierce has started circulating recently, Kosuke begins to suspect him. However, Ryoichi's overly friendly behavior keeps throwing him for a loop. But Ryoichi, who is actually a detective, is also tracking the source of pierce...

(Source: Shinkosha)

title: Wo de Wanghong Nanyou
synopsis:
Nan-ge is a popular youtuber about to reach 300,000 subs. But there's a problem plaguing him... his subscriber count is stalling at 299,000! At his wit's end, he takes up a friend's suggestion and tries collaborating with another popular influencer—Prince Mengtai. On-screen, Mengtai's pretty face and cute personality has captured the hearts of young girls everywhere. But in reality, Mengtai's personality is?!

(Source: Tong Li Publishing, translated)

title: Atashi wa Seikan Kokka no Eiyuu Kishi!
title_english: I'm the Heroic Knight of an Intergalactic Empire!
title_japanese: あたしは星間国家の英雄騎士!
synopsis:
Emma has just taken her first step as a knight. Emma's new job? Commander of a squad of useless layabouts. Just as her efforts start to change minds, a pirate base is discovered on Alias. What will happen when an elite force is sent in from the home planet to eliminate them?! An epic new tale of a failure's rise to glory in the Intergalactic Empire begins!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Bokura wa Minna Shiro to Kuro no Doubutsu Onayami Soudangakari
title_japanese: ぼくらはみんな シロとクロの動物お悩み相談係

title_japanese: こはるの空とアニマルライフ

title_english: Betrayed by the Hero, I Formed a MILF Party with His Mom!
title_japanese: 勇者に全部奪われた俺は勇者の母親とパーティを組みました!
synopsis:
After traveling and fighting their way to beat the evil demon king, Ceres' adventuring party kicks him out! Dismissed by the womanizing hero he had thought of as a friend, Ceres is now all alone. Worse yet, he's not actually from this world; he was reborn here with all his memories of his previous life still intact. Now alone, he heads to the market and sees someone he never expected—Shizuko, the hero's mother, rejected and up for sale. After hearing her story, Ceres decides to form his own adventuring party with the mothers of his former companions!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Isekai Kita no de Sukebe Skill de Zenryoku Ouka Shiyou to Omou
title_english: In a Different World, Try All My Might to Enjoy It With My Erotic Skills
title_japanese: 異世界来たのでスケベスキルで全力謳歌しようと思う

title: Isekai Trip-saki de Tasukete Kureta no wa, Hitogoroshi no Shounen deshita.
title_english: The Man Who Saved Me on My Isekai Trip Is a Killer...
title_japanese: 異世界トリップ先で助けてくれたのは、 人殺しの少年でした。
synopsis:
One day Megumi got transported to another world. She swiftly found herself assaulted by bandits, but a young man came to her rescue. She quickly became infatuated with him, and the two started a sexual relationship. She doesn't know anything about this world, and nobody explained the rules to her... But she believes that her savior will protect her.

But what does he want? He seems to be after something he seems to be using her to make something happen... However, Megumi has no idea. And that's how her new life begins.

(Source: DLsite)

title: Boichi Original SF Tanpenshuu
synopsis: A collection of Boichi's sci-fi one-shots.

title: Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e 0
title_japanese: ようこそ実力至上主義の教室へ0
synopsis:
This may be a story of the past that had been concealed, and mustn't be seen.

About 20 years before Kiyotaka Ayanokouji enrolled at Advanced Nurturing High School. There was a man. Atsuomi Ayanokouji, aged 31. A politician. Atsuomi was born as a "have-not" in Japan's society of disparity, but there was one thing he possessed more than anybody else: his uncontrollable, ever-expanding "ambition."

Atsuomi had been doing dirty work for Jinnosuke Naoe, the head of the Naoe faction that he was a part of. As a chance to reward all the hard work that he had done, Naoe offers him a top-secret project: the founding of an institution for a "Talented Persons Nurturing Program," which is under the direct control of the government. Atsuomi, who is busy pursuing his ambitions, brings them to fruition and names the institution he establishes the White Room. He had also started on another project: to get his own biological child to join him in the White Room.

This is the beginning of everything. A s

title: Sierra on Strike!
synopsis:
As high society's most eligible lady, Sierra Fernein did whatever it took to please her family, despite their flagrant disregard for her. But upon discovering she has only a month left to live, she decides to go on strike from being a prim and proper lady and live life on her own terms. Shedding the Fernein name, she declares war on anyone who dares get in her way, including her family and a few pesky admirers. But with just 30 days left, can Sierra finally enjoy the life of her dreams?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Bara to Koroshiya
synopsis:
The story is about a "savior" who will appear to help you with your troubles if you stand in front of a certain "happiness bell" with a rose.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Kojirase Ω no 2-dome no Koi
synopsis:
Ever since they were hired at the same time, Tasuku Sakura has seen Iori Narushige as a rival. Compounding this is the fact that Narushige is one of many alphas, members of a secondary sex with superior characteristics, working at their company. Sakura has been carefully hiding the fact that he is an omega, a secondary sex that causes him to experience periodic heats, as well as the disdain he holds for alphas.

However, everything changes when Sakura wakes up with a two-week gap in his memory, and somehow ends up as Narushige's mate. He can scarcely believe the tender care his coworker is suddenly showing him or the happy photos from their time together. With his life forever altered, Sakura does his best to understand his new life while Narushige vows to make Sakura fall in love with him again.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Ninkyou Neko Choko
title_english: Choco Is a Cat of Honor
synopsis:
This selfless, aggressive kitty cat wants to repay his debt with his body?!

Recently heartbroken Rin (26) turns to his beloved pet cat Choko and sighs out, "If only you were human, I'd just date you." That very same night... Choko turns into a burly honorable-gangster type, and he intends to repay Rin's kindness with his new manly body, no less!! "Go ahead, young master!! I await your command!!" ...Yikes, that's a scary face!! Rin can hardly recognize the adorable black cat he knows, but Choko sounds serious, and seriously fired up to take things to the next level...?! "Compared to some female human... I know you so much better, young master." This tale of duty, devotion, and heavy "petting" between a straight pet owner and a man (cat) of honor determined to outdo his master's exes will have your heart throbbing!!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title: Tonari no Class no Katou-kun
title_japanese: 隣のクラスの加藤くん

title: Tsukuyomi-kun no Kindan Oyashoku
title_japanese: 月読くんの禁断お夜食
synopsis:
Tsukuyomi-kun no Kindan Oyashoku centers on the relationship between foodie and expert chef Tsukuyomi, and a 27-year-old female personal gym trainer named Soyogi. They meet up regularly so Soyogi can re-energize herself on Tsukuyomi's food, but they have established an agreement that forbids any romance between them.

(Source: ANN)

title: Ore to Mou Ichido, First Love.
title_japanese: 俺ともう一度、初恋〈ファーストラブ〉。
synopsis:
Mia Takanashi, heiress to the famed Takanashi Group, has had the world at her feet since birth. With the future of the company to think about, deciding on a marriage partner early would have its advantages. However, just as Mia set her heart on one of several charming suitors, amnesia from a freak car accident sets her back to square one! Four wildly different boys appear before her, claiming to be her intended fiancé, but which one of them did Mia ultimately choose? She may just have to fall in love all over again to find out!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Hakoniwa no Ie
synopsis:
Kiyoko, a psychologist, raises the children of her former and only friend. Kiyoko, Haruto and Rion. This is a sad but funny pseudo family story of those out of "ordinary happiness."

(Source: Kodansha)

authors: Tsuchii|Kinatsu, Kanoto|Batsu|Edo|Kitou, Sakeru|Salamander|Gomashi|Ueda, Kyuu|Kamichi, Ataru|sometime|Shirou, Urayama|Moricocco|Takahara, Yu|Himiya, Jouzu|Chiruha, Chinmi|Koyubita, Bell|Akitokage|Hagiwara, Emilio|Bonryuu
synopsis: A collection of stories by various artists set in the universe of Blue Archive.

synopsis: A boy and girl bond over bonsai.

title: Chibikkokikoki

2. PVD sideP

5. Sensei no Jikaisaku ni Gokitai Kudasai!
6. Dagashi Kashi LW
7. Nubatama no Yume
8. Nichijou no Koto.

title: Kinryou Rock 0: Moonage Daydreams
title_japanese: 禁猟六区 volume.0 MOONAGE DAYDREAMS
synopsis:
Blood, sex and Rock & Roll! In this world, vampires live among humans, but coexistence is not easy. The moment they don't follow the rules, there are special agents prepared to take them down, some with the strength of the law, and others with the power of rock!

The prequel volume sets the stage with three short stories about the main characters that will collide in the main series.

(Source: Alien Books)

title: Shinkyuu Chie no Nekobitashi
title_english: Chie Shinkyu's Nekobitashi: The Daily Life of Chie and Her Cats
title_japanese: 新久千映のねこびたし
synopsis:
After mourning the loss of her beloved feline companion Suu, manga artist and cat mom Chie Shinkyuu decides to turn over a new leaf and find herself a new baby to love! Following a tip from her brother-in-law, Chie picks up the stray she calls "Sen" and takes him home with her. Surely nothing's going to go wrong... right?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Nanashi no Koibito
synopsis:
A cute and sweet rom-com about Itsuki and "Nanashi," who have only corresponded through letters.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Tomodachi no Neechan ni Koishita Hanashi to Neechan no Tomodachi ga Uzai Hanashi
title_english: I Fell for My Friend's Older Sister + My Older Sister's Friend is Annoying
title_japanese: 友達の姉ちゃんに恋した話と姉ちゃんの友達がうざい話
synopsis:
Rio is everything that Haruto wants in a girl: gentle, nurturing, and ladylike. The only problem is that she's the older sister of his best buddy Nao, and he fears that the difference in age means he's barely on her radar. If Haruto wants Rio to see him as more than her little brother's playmate, then he has to prove himself as a man in her eyes, no matter what it takes.

Meanwhile, Nao grows frustrated with Sena, a loudmouthed friend of Rio's who's too nosy for her own good. But what irritates him more than the constant pestering is how she just can't see him as more than a little kid. Can he help her get a clue?

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Shishosei
synopsis:
A tower containing all the books of a kingdom. On it is the librarian, the lord of the collection tower. The librarian existed only to be used by the Great King as a tool. The story of Shishosei begins when a barbaric girl named Millet is selected as the new librarian's maiden.

(Source: MU)

title: Pick Me Up
synopsis:
1-Star heroes are just fodder for learning a boss' attack patterns. That was Seojin Han's philosophy when playing the notoriously difficult game Pick Me Up. But after being transported into the game as one of those 1-star heroes, he's got no choice but to rise in rank and defeat the player controlling him and his party. Can a gacha game character hope to defeat a player akin to being his god?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Man Crush
synopsis:
With a racing heart, Jinho makes his way to Room 609, where Yunsoo is waiting for him. Yunsoo, the dreamy, blond, green-eyed stud he's had a crush on since forever. If he's lucky, he'll get to kiss him. If he's really lucky, he'll get to blow him. And one day, he'll get to go all the way... Deep down, Jinho knows being secret f-buddies isn't what he truly wants. But what can he do to turn a crush into something more?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Kimi to Sekai no Owari wo Tazunete

2. Tsugihagi no Kibou wo Daite

title_japanese: 勇者パーティーを追放されたので、魔王を取り返しがつかないほど強く育ててみた

One day, Raizel was suddenly summoned to another world to defeat the Demon Lord—but he was summoned with zero combat power. However, that was just a mistake of the combat capability calculator and he was in fact an overwhelmingly strong individual. After being exiled, Raizel set out on his own and during his adventures came to realize that the demons weren't actually evil entities and joined up with them. Mia, an orphan, is fascinated with Joshua, who saved her from being falsely accused of theft when she was a child, as he is "like a god." However, being the son of an oppressive former lord, Joshua's reputation is not good, and Mia is bitterly disappointed when she goes to work for him. While helping to save a tourist's life at the airport, her nursing skills and her vulnerable beauty instantly impress the man who has been sent to meet her: handsome A&E doctor Christos Constantine.

Christos is quick to offer Katie a job, and as they work together sparks begin to fly their reluctant respect for each other cannot hide the smoldering passion that sizzles between them. Although Christos is wary of love, he realizes he must put his heart on the line and convince this beautiful English rose to stay in the sun and become his bride.

Kouhei, a regular customer at her café, knows exactly how to make her tick. But Sana knows how to defend herself now: fight fire with fire! For some reason, Kouhei unlocks a comfort in Sana that lets her let loose. Maybe he can unlock even more feelings in Sana...?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Michi Michi

The two set out on an adventure into the outside world. On their journey, they encounter a "baby mountain" who doesn't know anything about themself, a "water person" who always imitates Chiaki, "Yamada-kun" who wears a mysterious costume, and many other strange and fun characters.

synopsis:

He isn't about to get his hands dirty doing all the work, so how about recruiting someone else to get things done? Enter Kaiser and Lina, his new henchmen. They've got the skills, the brawn, and... a thirst for blood! Kaiser and Lina will take down anyone standing in their boss's way, but as the bodies pile up, Hoyeon starts to wonder if his lackeys aren't just insanely strong, but rather flat-out insane!

Sei-chan was my hero when I was little, but he suddenly disappeared from my life. In the spring when I became a university student, I meet him again after 10 years. But he has changed, and one day we somehow ended up becoming sex buddies...!

(Source: Shu-Cream)

title: A Tree Without Roots
synopsis:
After the sudden suicide of his mother, Kwon Hee-seo has lived his life searching for answers. Taken in by an abusive foster family, he is left asking himself the same questions over and over again: What was the inciting incident that caused his mother to take her life? Who was the mysterious man that saved his? And could he be the same esoteric benefactor that has been shrouded in secrecy, supporting Hee-seo from behind the scenes? Unmoored like a tree without roots and desperate for answers, Hee-seo sets his family's home ablaze in hopes of drawing the man out from the shadows. But this reckless attempt for a semblance of clarity in his life may lead Hee-seo to more than he bargained for... Can a tree without roots grow to reach the sun? Or is it destined to wither away in the absence of light?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

College student Han Garam despises his annoyingly self-absorbed, spoiled, and homophobic roommate, Yoon Jaehyuk. Fueled by spite, Garam decides to pleasure himself on Jaehyuk's bed while he is away—but to the horror of them both, Jaehyuk catches him in the act.

This only intensifies their mutual loathing and sparks the beginning of never-ending fights over every little thing. However, when Jaehyuk begrudgingly helps a drunk Garam, their tension boils over into an unexpected hook-up. To his utter surprise, Jaehyuk actually enjoys it and soon begins scheming to tempt Garam into repeating the experience, confident that hate has no chance of turning into unexpected love.

title: Hotaru no Yomeiri

Satoko, the eldest daughter of the honorable Kirigaya family, has received many marriage proposals from men captivated by her beauty and grace. However, she has turned them all down due to her secret heart defect. Despite her condition, Satoko is still willing to find a husband to ease her beloved father's concerns.

While on a stroll, Satoko is kidnapped by a group of mercenaries, one of them being Shinpei Gotou—a legendary assassin tasked with executing her. Satoko tries to bribe Gotou into freeing her, but it proves unsuccessful. Out of options, Satoko makes a desperate gamble: under the pretense of love at first sight, she asks him to marry her.

Unexpectedly, Gotou takes the bait and vows to protect her. As the couple escapes to freedom, Satoko struggles to keep up the ruse and make sense of the mysterious man she has eloped with.

She also bumps into her childhood friend, Ritsu, who she remembers as a crybaby, and almost doesn't recognize him. Now living with her brother again, she can't help but notice her heart fluttering with each interaction. Does this mean she might like him?! Knowing how taboo these thoughts are, Ritsu suggests he and Yui date as a way to nip her feelings for Hayato in the bud. Yet this family tree may not actually be as simple as it seems...

However, there is a clause in the contract that he missed when he signed it...! The twins turn out to be the two boys Mutsuki bullied when they were children... so they put a collar on him and spend every day getting their revenge on Mutsuki.

Abandoned at birth in a stable, Shirone was raised by commoners. As a child, he had gifted insight and had learned how to read. A businesswoman who is in her thirties, Yugyeong Seo. She's in a relationship that seems to be sinking every second. Shina Takashi lamented his current days, where being ignored was not uncommon. One day, his parents dropped a shocking revelation. After being gruesomely murdered, Park Juhyeon begs the grim reaper for a chance to find his killer. To solve this mystery, he returns to earth as a ghost and teams up with Choi Seongmin, a vampire who assists the dead in the world of the living. As they dig deeper into the case, Juhyeon uncovers some disturbing clues and slowly realizes that his past was less clear-cut than he remembered. Was Juhyeon really just unlucky to meet an untimely death? Or did he have a hand in his own bloody demise?

(Source: Tapas Media)

The manga centers on Hanayo, an elderly woman whose husband of many years has only recently died. After finishing a Buddhist service for her husband, she finds herself walking out in town alone for the first time in a long time. She stumbles onto a cosmetics store, and meets a beautiful woman named Yoshiko Doujima, and falls in love at first sight. Hanayo had long given up on makeup after her husband nagged her about it, but putting some on with Yoshiko's help brightens her heart.

A young girl with amnesia awakened in a world where animals live. She was given the name "Win" by the witch Nigou, who put her through harsh training to raise her into a powerful warrior. Much time passes after Win's training began, and now the shadows of invaders stealthily approach...

But after an innocent, drunken one-night stand gone wrong, Ripley finds herself locked in a precarious game of romance with Duke Zeronis de Inglid, the dangerously handsome and obsessive male lead. Anxious to steer the plot back on track, Ripley befriends the original protagonist Etoile and tries to recreate the novel's ending by force. (Sou

title: How to Clear a Dating Sim as a Side Character

The only way to clear Midnight is to reach a happy ending with one of the five love interests, but each route poses a different set of problems.

Meeting the master of the mage's tower will lead to almost certain death, the crown prince doesn't even try to hide his animosity towards her, the merchant seems to be missing a few screws, and another barely speaks. The swordmaster seems relatively normal, but it turns out he's a devout follower of the temple she's desperately trying to escape. Will Yewon be able to capture the heart of one of these men and use her insider game knowledge to clear the game?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Puniru wa Kawaii Slime
title_japanese: ぷにるはかわいいスライム
synopsis:
This is the story of Puniru the slime and Kotarou, a middle school student, until they cease being friends...

Kotarou Kawaii is a second-year middle school boy. When he was in elementary school, a slime he created came to life, and for the past seven years, he has been spending time with the slime named Puniru as his "friend." However, there is one problem for Kotarou...

Over the seven years, both have grown significantly, and Puniru has transformed into an incredibly beautiful girl!

Besides her beautiful appearance, Puniru freely transforms into various cute forms as a slime, causing Kotarou to be both excited and bewildered by her carefree behavior every time.

Will Puniru and Kotarou be able to continue spending time together as "friends" despite these challenging days ahead?

At first, there was only Winter. But this lonely existence was too much for it to bear, so Winter split off part of itself to bring forth Spring. But the earth wished for Summer and Autumn as well, and their creation marked the birth of the four seasons. The changing of seasons became a duty that fell upon humanity, and those tasked with the transition are known as "Agents of the Four Seasons." This is the bittersweet story of Hinagiku and Sakura—the Agent of Spring and her devoted Guard, who set out on a journey to usher in Yamato's first spring in ten long years.

As he sees beyond Eddie's surly exterior and catches a glimpse of the man beneath the affectation, Haru begins to think about the message and emotions that Eddie tries to convey through his music. One evening, a stranger shows up at her door asking to rent a room. The young man claims to be a former go professional, and, indeed, he is a remarkably talented player. As the two adjust to life together as roommates, they are surprised to find themselves healing from the burnout they experienced as elite players—but a far more unexpected outcome still awaits them.

"Why? Why is it like this?" she kept asking before her death. However, when she opened her eyes, she had returned to five years before she died. "Was the way I lived wrong?" she kept thinking.

Sigrid decided to change her way of life: what to eat, what to wear, what to buy, everything. The way she changed led her to be the center of everything. Although, everything eventually started to go back to the way it was. And so, Sigrid came face-to-face with her old rival and enemy, Veramud.

However, his good disposition didn't bring only misfortune. In the past, he ended up saving a young girl called Jae-hee. And after a traumatic event lands Chan-ok in the hospital, she's the only one willing to help him turn things around. But his path to vengeance might not be as smooth as he'd like. KAI is a gang leader known for his rapping skills and less-than-pleasant dealings. His life had long been messed up with events he had no control over, and he had resigned himself to his current life. That is, until a poster leads him to a familiar face he hadn't in years. title_japanese: なんかもうあーあって感じ。
synopsis:
Moriya is a caring, loving boy with a strong feeling of morality and is adored by everyone. During the night of their school camp, he and his classmates decided to play the king's game. Tada, who tends to skip classes despite his excellent grades and no one knows what he's thinking, was chosen to be punished for "to spend a day as lovers"...?!

A heart-throbbing youthful love story between a charismatic boy and an honor student who is clumsy but devoted when it comes to love.

(Source: Sankosha, translated)

title: Fiancé Kachou wa Yasashii Do S
title_english: The Boss Is My Sadistic Sweetheart!
title_japanese: フィアンセ課長は優しいドS
synopsis:
I, Haruka Shinozuka, am 27 years old and still a virgin (never had a boyfriend, even). One day, the division chief, Ookubo, sees me despairing over being turned down after the confession I had to work up the courage to make. And if that weren't bad enough, he steals my first kiss in the name of "shutting up that pathetic wailing"! Division chief, who do you think you are? Do you think you can get away with anything just because you're handsome...? But his next words really throw me for a loop: "If you're still single when you turn 28, I'll take you." ...What? Was that just... a proposal?! Division chief, are you serious?! Before I know it, the two of us are at a hotel, and engaged in some serious premarital relations...

(Source: NTT Solmare Corporation)

title: Fukai no to, Atsui no. Office demo Ie demo Aisarete Komattemasu
title_english: Deep and Passionate: Wooed by Two Younger Men
title_japanese: 深いのと、あついの。 オフィスでも家でも愛されて困ってます
synopsis:
After pulling overtime alone together with Satou, her towering overgrown puppy of a junior colleague, Riko suddenly finds herself wrapped in his arms as his hot tongue runs over her skin, until her cocky stepbrother Yuuta catches them in the act. After that day, Yuuta starts watching her with a not-so-brotherly look in his eyes...? She'd always been married to the job with no time for love, yet now these two younger men are wreaking havoc on both her heart and her body with their fawning pursuit of her love...

(Source: NTT Solmare Corporation)

title: Osananajimi wa Yokozuna-sama!
title_english: Yokozuna, My Childhood Friend, My Love!
synopsis:
Personality, education, status, money... Everything about him was perfect! Ayako Makuuchi, an up-and-coming office worker in Tokyo, has put her shameful past behind her and now struggles to become one of life's "winners." She has set her sights on Nagata, a senior colleague and her ideal man, and as the distance between them decreases day by day, she seems well on the way to a blissful wedded life... or so she thinks. Enter her childhood friend Eiji, who knows her dark secret and somehow ends up crashing at her place in the city...?!

(Source: NTT Solmare Corporation)

title: Shiawase ni Nari na.
synopsis:
On my first day working part-time at a bookstore, the trainer Kai was so mystifyingly handsome that the very next day, I impulsively asked him out!! He was so quick to agree that I couldn't help asking, "Are you sure you understand what I mean?" But he fired back with a heated kiss and said, "You mean this, right?" That blitz attack had me completely head over heels, but then I learned of a rumor about Kai: "He'll hook up with people, but he never lets things get serious." Huh...?!

(Source: NTT Solmare Corporation)

title: Juuoku no Are. Yoshiwara-ichi no Oiran
title_japanese: 十億のアレ。～吉原いちの花魁～
synopsis:
Yoshiwara, old Edo's paradise of pleasure, has been reborn in modern-day Tokyo... In this playground of the powerful, where money rules all, women sell both their bodies and the idea of romance to their male clientele. Thrust into this world is the ingenue Asuka, who's been sold out by her foster parents to pay off their debts. While at first oblivious to the nature of Yoshiwara, she accidentally barges in on a "transaction" between a courtesan and her client. Confronted with her new reality of being bought and sold, she longs to make a break for it... but is there anyone around her she can trust...?!

(Source: NTT Solmare Corporation)

title: Kono Koi wa Jigoku no Hajimari
title_english: This Love Is the Start of My Nightmare
title_japanese: この恋は地獄のはじまり
synopsis:
Is this love a dream come true? Or is it the beginning of a nightmare? From cheating, to gold-digging, to dangerous cults, Satoru is a man so unlucky in love that every woman he's ever fallen for has betrayed him. He decides that if he's only capable of falling in love with wicked women, he might as well go with the marriage match his parents have picked out for him. But one look at Michiru, the woman they've set him up with, and Satoru is head-over-heels. And that can only mean one thing...

(Source: NTT Solmare Corporation)

title: Renai Kanjou no Marude Nai Osananajimi Manga
title_japanese: 恋愛感情のまるでない幼馴染漫画

title: Konya, Hokenshitsu de Guchagucha ni
title_english: I'll Make a Mess of You in the Nurse's Office Tonight
title_japanese: 今夜、保健室で ぐちゃぐちゃに
synopsis:
Such filthy things... At school, I carry out my work as a teacher with painstaking care, and others gossip that I'm "uptight" or "not interested in sexy stuff"... But night after night, I go home and touch myself to naughty thoughts of the school nurse Mr. Shirahane. Today, it's Mr. Shirahane with his hand under the desk, his fingers brushing over that sensitive spot as he says "You love being teased like this, don't you?"—caught in that fantasy, I came. Ugh, I'm such a pervert...!!

(Source: NTT Solmare Corporation)

title: Batsuichi Futari wa Mitei na Kankei
title_english: We've Got Two Divorces and No Labels Between Us
title_japanese: バツイチ2人は未定な関係
synopsis:
Mami has tried marriage once and failed, so now she's looking for something else. Even if her peers won't get it, she wants what she wants: not marriage, not romance, just a man to spend time with when she needs some company!

Sure enough, when she brings this up at her junior high class reunion, her friends all gang up against her. However, a handsome former classmate she'd almost never spoken to before—Nakamura—does empathize with her! When Mami learns that Nakamura is also once-divorced and, just like her, is looking not for a wife or a girlfriend but just a woman to spend time with, she makes a life-changing decision.

She's given up on living her life according to what's "normal." After spending thirty-some years toiling under the crushing weight of societal expectations, one woman finds herself a partner in crime and a new lease on life in this modern-day survival story.

(Source: NTT Solmare Corporation)

title: Yan You
synopsis:
After returning to school following a suspension for fighting, Thomas's classmates are fearful of him. When Zachary finds him crying alone, Thomas makes him swear to tell no one. Zachary, an A+ student, begins tutoring Thomas... until Thomas realizes the one he fought with was Zachary's brother.

(Source: Manta)

title: Ochibure Zeus to Dorei no Ko
title_english: Fallen Zeus and the Slave Boy
title_japanese: 落ちぶれゼウスと奴隷の子

title: Po Yun
synopsis:
Three years ago, the operation leader Jiang Ting made an error in judgment, a chain explosion occurred at the scene, and there were heavy casualties in the unit. Three years later, he, supposed to have died in duty, returned to the world, doing everything he could to bring forth the bloody, bizarre truth. Heroic souls resting in death, the ones behind it all closely approaching, sentiments built fighting side by side in blood and fire... "I used all of my luck in this life, to exchange for you. Thank you for bringing me back to this world, Yan Xie."

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: Occult Tanteidan: Shiningyou no Hakaba
title_english: Occult Detective Club: Graveyard of the Death Dolls
title_japanese: オカルト探偵団 死人形の墓場
synopsis:
Visions of discarded dolls plague Chika's nights after a foreboding encounter with a possessed doll sitting among a collection of occult curiosities... Only with help of Shiratori Fuyumi, president of the Occult Research Club, will Chika be able to solve the mystery of these deadly dreams.

(Source: Star Fruit Books)

title: Matsuri no Ato
synopsis:
I'd never even hit anyone before... 10 years since I punched Shuuhei at the festival, I still can't leave my room no matter how I try.

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Kaeru Ie ni wa Koi ga Inai
title_japanese: 帰る家には恋がいない
synopsis:
It's been two years since I got married to a handsome shoemaker, Akitaro. It is not a secret that I'm "happy" to be loved by him and having everyone envious of that. But I'm afraid of spending the night with him. Because it's possible to feel the desperate loneliness of the "night"...

(Source: Chibi Manga, edited)

title: Hatsujou Playroom
synopsis:
"I can't believe this is getting me excited."

Even after 10 years, Moriya can't get over his unrequited love for former high school classmate Tsujimura. In spite of that, he has a sexual relationship with his boss, Nanamiya, who knows about his feelings. Tsujimura joins their company, and he and Moriya meet again after so long. Nanamiya whispers to Moriya—who is confused by the feelings he should have given up—saying: "If you'd like to confess your feelings to him, I'll lend you a hand." Moriya dismisses it as a joke, but the same night the office suddenly goes out of power and he gets trapped alone with Tsujimura. On the monitor, the words: "If you wish to leave, then you must follow the orders given."

What was a light touch at first, gradually becomes more and more sexually intense. "I can't do this..." Moriya's thoughts can't help him to resist the passion and the pleasure Tsujimura's giving him...

(Source: Shu-Cream)

title: Apartment Yonkaidate
title_japanese: アパートメント四階建
synopsis:
Aki, who has lived life in easy mode. When he went on a trip to Finland where he rented an apartment, he met Mika, a handsome man from Northern Europe, and got drunk and H... lost his virginity!! He thought they would never see each other again, but Mika ended up staying at Aki's share house "Apartment Four-Story"?! While he was sleeping, he was bullied, pressured, and talked about as a lover. In addition, the residents of the share house, Kujou (Aki's friends) and Mosao (the plain bullied child), are also involved?!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

Included one-shot: Madamada, Gosan

title: Osotte Kure to Itteru Youna Mon da
title_english: You're Just Asking to be Ravished
title_japanese: 襲ってくれと言ってるようなもんだ
synopsis:
Overtime. Working from home late into the night. In the glitzy world of fashion magazines, publishing editor Fumi was run ragged in mind and body by her demanding work. Her only solace was visiting the local private pharmacy run by handsome and refreshing pharmacist Okada. Worrying over her on post-overtime mornings or at night after an exhausting workday, he kept her body in good repair. But that was just his kindness toward a regular customer—or so Fumi thought. While drunk after a mixer, she passes by the pharmacy; the usually kind Okada is acting oddly and suddenly drags Fumi into the pharmacy's waiting room...

(Source: NTT Solmare Corporation)

title: Dekiai Engage: 12-sai Toshiue no Ojisama to
title_english: Lovey-Dovey Engagement: My Fiance is 12 Years Older
title_japanese: 溺愛エンゲージ～12歳年上のオジサマと～
synopsis:
"Koharu, you've had a fiance since you were born..." This is what my grandfather confesses to me one day out of the blue. But how could I, a 25-year-old stranger to love, possibly have a fiance? And on top of that, instead of living by myself while my grandfather is in the hospital, I have to live with him instead...?! He's tall, handsome, wealthy, and a CEO... not to mention 12 years my senior! We've got nothing in common! But his kindness and his unexpected naivete touch my heart, and before I know it...?! Between our short-term cohabitation and an marriage pact made by our grandfathers, this is one romance we can't let anyone find out about...

(Source: NTT Solmare Corporation)

title: Shounen, Watashi no Deshi ni Natte yo.: Saijaku Munou na Ore, Seiken Gakuen de Saikyou wo Mezasu
title_english: Hey Boy, Will You Be My Apprentice?
title_japanese: 少年、私の弟子になってよ。～最弱無能な俺、聖剣学園で最強を目指す～

title: One Day Nyanger Sister
title_japanese: わんでいずにゃんがーしすたー

title: Uso Koi
synopsis:
High school student Kano is worried about her inability to find a boyfriend. Because it's her first time to fall in love, she has high ideals and can't take the first step... But then, she and Toki, who is her "least favorite type" and on the same organizing committee for the school festival as her, decided to become a fake couple for a limited time?! The most powerful bickering couple is born!

(Source: MU)

title: Apple Parfait: OneLoli Yuri Anthology
title_japanese: アップルパルフェ おねロリ百合アンソロジー
synopsis: An anthology of girls love short stories by various mangaka.

title: Ramen Akaneko
synopsis:
Meet Tamako, who's found her way into an interview at a ramen shop run solely by cats. When the feline manager asks if she likes cats, Tamako admits that she's actually more of a dog person...only to be hired on the spot! But her job description isn't quite what she expects—rather than serving ramen, she's now a dedicated cat caretaker...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Happy End wa Iranai: Mikanuji Tanpenshuu
title_english: I Don't Need a Happy Ending: A Collection of Short Stories
title_japanese: みかん氏短編集 ハッピーエンドはいらない
synopsis:
1. Suki ni Naru nante Arienai
2. Happy End wa Iranai (I Don't Need a Happy Ending)
3. Ai nante Shiranai
4. Kaisha wo Yasunda Hi no Koto
5. Aru Kaisha no Kanojo-tachi no Koto
6. Happy End wa Iranai, Sonogo

title: Kowareta Sekai no Mukougawa
title_japanese: こわれたせかいのむこうがわ
synopsis:
Fuu is a lonely girl from the lowest stratum of life. Her only friends are Asa, a little bird, and an old radio she found in the corner of a junk shop. Then there is Kazakura, a hungry girl who goes at her own pace.

From the moment they first meet, she calls Fuu "big brother" and follows her around with a cheerful smile. The place where they meet is the only remaining human country in the world. In the middle of an endless desert ruled by deformed monsters, human beings must live for the king, the messenger of God, taking pleasure in daily hardships.

But the world they know is all a big lie. With a lot of wisdom and a handful of courage. Now, the "world's heaviest escape drama" begins.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Herami Shimai wa Docchi mo Yanderu
title_japanese: 平良深姉妹はどっちもヤんでる
synopsis:
Sera, (Real Name: Herami Fukasera) is an approval-seeking girl (26 years old) who works at a maid café. Her younger sister, Kira, is an idol (19 years old) who is rapidly gaining popularity with her cool, and mature character. However, the real Kira only ever thinks of her sister and tries to cheer her up in every possible way to help her sister with her mental health and anxiety.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: The Poisonous Healer
synopsis:
In a world where monster hunters are hailed as heroes, Haesun Cheon has been treated like an outcast because of his abnormal looks. As if that wasn't bad enough, a pack of monsters attacks his neighborhood on the day he discovers he's dying from an unknown illness. With his sister's sacrifice, Haesun survives and somehow awakens to become a Poisoner, a rare hunter with toxic healing abilities. But will his poisonous powers cure Haesun's illness and guarantee a normal life he's always dreamed of?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Soshite Watashi wa Kyou mo Ano Otoko ni Taberareru
title_japanese: そして私は今日もあの男に食べられる

title: Toymaker Tria's Tyrant Problem
synopsis:
As the ordinary owner of a toy workshop, Tria spent her days struggling to pay off a mountain of debt with the help of Shadie, her trusty shadow friend. Luckily for her, a mysterious, half-dead client shows up one day, offering a jaw-dropping amount of money to make an expensive toy. Despite being wary of the man and his circumstances, Tria accepts the commission. But it doesn't take long for her to realize that this dictatorial client is just one of the many tyrants that will plague her shop...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Majo to Kurasu Mayoi no Mori
title_english: The Lost Woods to Live with a Witch
title_japanese: 魔女と暮らす迷いの森
synopsis:
Alma is a witch that lives in a magical forest. Once you enter the forest, you can't leave. One day, a dark elf wanders into the forest and they start living together.

(Source: MU)

title: Kono Monogatari ni wa Kankei ga Nai
title_japanese: この物語には関係がない

title: The Demon King Levels Up
synopsis:
Now that the demonic realm and the heavenly realm have called a truce, the human world has returned to an era of peace. Jeon Minchul lives the life of an ordinary college student until the day he comes across an artifact from the war and remembers—in his past life, he was the demon king who brought the world to its knees. Upon recalling these memories, Minchul awakens his old powers, along with some new ones. But can this demon king harness the powers of both good and evil to protect the peace?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Fallen House of Ardan
synopsis:
I was born as the oldest of a renowned swordsman family, and became stronger faster than anyone. Yet, I could not stop the dragons, a great disaster that had appeared on the continent. I closed my eyes in my final moments, thinking everything was over. I really thought it was over... But when I opened my eyes, I was back in the past. A past that was very different from the world I knew.

"What? Is this really my body? Why don't I have any mana?"
"Where did the castle go? Why's there only a wooden house left?"
"...What? The dragons and humans made a non-aggression pact?"

A family that had fallen and was on the brink of ruin. A family whose writing of divination had vanished. And a body in which no mana could be found!

"...I'll have to keep myself busy from now on."

The great hero of a renowned swordsman family. He is back in the past, in a "parallel world."

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: The Imperious Young Lord
synopsis:
The year is 203X, and Earth is under attack. The enemy? Extraterrestrials. Hyunsung Park, a militia commander, valiantly lays down his life to take down the enemy base. One moment, he's caught up in a malfunctioning teleportation device; the next... he's in the body of Ian Alberon, a 15-year-old lord! Thrown into a world of monsters and magic, Hyunsung—now Ian—must figure out how to navigate his new surroundings. And to top it all off, it seems his enemies may be much closer than he thinks...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Past Life Returner
synopsis:
In a world crawling with monsters and dungeons, Na Sunhoo and the other Awakeneds fight to protect humanity. But after he is killed in a deadly battle, a screen appears: "Initiate Time Regression?" Now with a second chance at life, Sunhoo returns to the past, determined to make as much money as possible to buy the land the dungeon is on and destroy it before the monsters can appear. With innocent lives at risk, can Sunhoo strike it rich and vanquish the monsters once and for all?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Becoming a Magic School Mage
synopsis:
Ehan was a stressed-out graduate student who vowed to never attend school again, until he was reborn as the third son of a noble family of mages. But since he isn't the sole heir, he has to make his own path by enrolling at Einrogard, the best magic school in the empire. And although everyone expects much from him, Ehan's time in academia has taught him that getting easy As is the best way to get through school. Despite his lack of ambition, can he graduate as a full-fledged mage?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The 10-Star Player's Lucky Draw
synopsis:
Casual gamers and skill gamers just aren't meant to get along. But what if the extremes of both are forced to team up? When Junghoon dives into the world's most mysterious new VR game, his craving for pure fun leads to a strange stroke of luck when his permanent patron spirit turns out to be Jinho Kang—a real-life hardcore gamer who's stuck serving as an NPC! Are they doomed to annoy the hell out of each other? Or is there more to this game than either one could have ever found on their own?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Isekai Tensei shita kedo Pants wo Rensei suru Nouryoku shika Arimasen
title_japanese: 異世界転生したけどパンツを錬成する能力しかありません
synopsis:
Kanata Takanoshima gets reincarnated into another world when he saves a girl from being run over by a truck and takes her place in death. When he wakes up in this new world he finds out he has the power of alchemy; more specifically: the power to cultivate panties out of thin air. Soon after he realizes his power he meets Nicolle, a strange girl in this alternate world with no panties in existence!

(Source: Anilist)

title: Kichikujima: Dust Emperor
title_japanese: 鬼畜島 ダスト・エンペラー

title: Kichikujima: Dust Emperor
title_japanese: 鬼畜島 ダスト・エンペラー

title: Boku shika Shiranai Kimi no Naka.
title_english: I Know You From the Inside Out
title_japanese: 僕しか知らない君のナカ。
synopsis:
"So it would be fine if I'd taken my hand out with my fingers dripping like this?" A quiet night at an internet cafe; a man and woman sharing a two-person booth... Under the blanket covering our laps, his fingers run wild stirring up my most private place... But, I can't let my voice out at a time like this...!! In real life, I (Nomiya) am an office worker whose presence barely leaves an impression, but online, I adventure as a lady warrior and chat every day with my close in-game friend Yurin. I also happen to be secretly in love with the dashing hottie at work, Kajimura, but... There's no way someone as plain as a starter avatar (me) could get close to a guy as popular as him...! Until one day, Yurin asks me to meet up IRL, and when I go to the meeting place, the person waiting is—?!

(Source: NTT Solmare Corporation)

title: Boku shika Shiranai Kimi no Naka. Extra Stage
title_english: I Know You From the Inside Out
title_japanese: 僕しか知らない君のナカ。EXTRA STAGE

title: Boku wo Dame ni Suru 38-sai.
title_english: In Over My Head With a 38-Year-Old
synopsis:
"If I went to Tokyo, maybe I could get a boyfriend!! Maybe I could fall in love!!" Or so he had always dreamed. But when college student Shota finally makes his first visit to Tokyo's gay district, Ni-chome, he strikes out big time. While despairing that he's just not cut out for dating, Shota comes across a foul-mouthed but kind donut shop owner and the delicious donuts he makes, which both help him start to get back in high spirits. However, when Shota accidentally catches sight of a new, more R-rated side of the donut shop owner... What will happen to this airheaded college student, and his dreams of true love, at the hands of this "adult" donut shop owner?!

(Source: NTT Solmare Corporation)

title: Dokuzetsu Megane wa Yoru dake Yasashii
title_english: The Bully in Glasses Is Only Nice at Night
title_japanese: 毒舌メガネは夜だけやさしい
synopsis:
At home, Miri is the picture of laziness. At the clothing shop where she works, she's a dazzling and stylish saleswoman. While living this double life, Miri seeks solace at a cafe near work where the barista Shirasaka always welcomes her with a kind smile. Seeing those gentle and beautiful eyes behind his glasses, whenever she visits she can't help but daydream about the joyous life she'd have if only Shirasaka were her boyfriend!! Fantasy flows into reality when Miri gets a lucky chance to go on a date with this soothing barista... Which is all well and good, except in spite of her dazzling exterior, deep down Miri isn't very feminine (she'll own up to that) and without thinking, she—?!

(Source: NTT Solmare Corporation)

title: Otto wa Watashi ni Mainichi Maiban Oboretai
title_japanese: 夫は私に毎日毎晩溺れたい
synopsis:
1. Otto wa Watashi ni Mainichi Maiban Oboretai
2. Ore wa Tsuma ni Mainichi Maiban Oboretai
3. Shitsuren Onna no Yomeiri
4. Arabian Halloween Night
5. Ore wa Tsuma ni Isshou Zutto Oboremasu

title: Sora-sama wa Mitasaretai!
title_japanese: ソラさまは満たされたい！

title: Happy Magical Nirvana
synopsis:
This is a tale of the men living in a slightly curious share house where both dreams and failures interweave.

Subaru is a beautiful but clumsy person who, for a long time now, has been one-sidedly in love with Daigo, a nice straight guy from his neighborhood. Daigo and his brother, Narufumi are turning their grandfather's traveler's lodge into a share house and while Subaru was helping them out, that's when he found a book filled with prophecies. It seems that even Subaru's future is written in it!

We want to live our lives laughing until the very end!

This is the start of these men's stories of love and laughter as they build their very own "retirement home."

(Source: MU)

title: Kakine to Keidai
synopsis:
"When I make a mistake, be there for me too." Those are some words that Keidai never expected he'd hear from his curt, quiet classmate Kakine. They may be working the same job and going to the same classmates, but they're not exactly friends, are they? Things get even more complicated when Keidai's dirty dreams begin to include a very familiar co-star...

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Kumo no Mukou, Yakusoku no Basho
title_english: The Place Promised in Our Early Days
title_japanese: 雲のむこう、約束の場所
synopsis:
In the Cold War era of an alternate history, the Soviet Union has taken control of the northern island of Japan and cut it off from the rest of the country. Just south across the strait, a boy named Hiroki is fascinated by the mysterious tower the Soviets have constructed on the unreachable island, and he and his friend Takuya decide to build a plane that will take them over to see it. As they work, a girl named Sayuri becomes a part of their lives and the promise to one day fly to the tower. But when she disappears without a trace, their promise I left unfulfilled-possibly forever.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Blood Strangers
synopsis:
Here are the key components of our story: two unusually beautiful boys (known only as Big Master and Small Master), an abandoned church, a blood-buying business, and a homeless young girl named Hansoo—who has unwittingly contracted herself to participate in said business. Big Master wants Hansoo out of the church as soon as possible, but it turns out that each of these characters needs something from each other. Big Master needs customers for blood (and Hansoo's blood asap); Small Master needs a link to the human world, and any way to aggravate Big Master (read: Hansoo); and Hansoo needs to keep away from Big Master long enough to stay in the church until she can afford her own place. It seems the boys might have a lot of time on their hands, but how long does Hansoo have to figure out what she's gotten herself into?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Tale of the Tiger's Bride
synopsis:
In the depths of the mountains lives a happily married couple! But this couple has a special something about them. And that is... that the husband is a tiger who talks and walks like a human...? The troublesome daily life between a rough but kindhearted tiger husband and a playful and talkative human wife!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: To LOVE-Ru Tokubetsu Yomikiri: Mikan to Maruru
title_japanese: To LOVEる-とらぶる-特別読切 美柑とマルル

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam Unicorn Episode EX2: Shishi no Kikan
title_japanese: 機動戦士ガンダムUC episode EX2 獅子の帰還
synopsis: An adaptation of the Shishi no Kikan script/drama CD, which takes place between the events of Gundam Unicorn and Gundam Narrative and focuses on Riddhe Marcenas.

title: Never Die Extra
synopsis:

A great forest, infested with flameling creatures and other fallen beasts, covers the world, and pockets of humanity live in small protected communities. Due to a special weapon used in the Last War, human beings spontaneously burst into flame even when merely getting close to a small source of fire. The only safe energy source for humanity lies within the bodies of flamelings, and the duty to hunt them falls to the sickle-wielding firecatchers who brave the depths of the great forest. 

Among the firecatchers, they whisper tales of one who would be "Firecatcher Lord," an individual who will be able to harvest the fire of the thousand-year comet, the "Wandering Spark" that has flown in the sky since it was sent up before the Last War, but is now returning to earth.

But it won't be that easy, especially when his best friend is Woobin Do. A man of many talents, Woobin seems to be the only one capable of reining the impulsive Hansol in. Will Hansol succeed in his quest to finally have his cherry picked...?

There's a very good reason for that, though—a mischievous fairy switched her with another baby at birth! When this detail comes to light, Anna's family kicks her out and ends her long-standing engagement to Edmund, a young nobleman who has always treated her with disdain. With her sheltered, privileged days behind her, how will Anna learn to adapt to life as a commoner with her new family?

(Source: Yen Press)

Manabu feels attracted to Iori, who is covered in bruises but has a strange sex appeal, and before he knew it, he was engrossed in taking photos. Crow Titus is the greatest hero in the land. He's gallant, brave, and adored by all—the perfect warrior. Or he would be if not for one minor detail: it's all an act! He'd like nothing more than to take it easy and live a quiet life, preferably with an above-average girlfriend and a significant amount of wealth. Unfortunately, his cursed blade takes control of his body in its quest for its favorite meal—souls. But thankfully, it prefers to feast on the wicked. So in order to keep his curse a secret (and his sword satiated), Crow must keep up the act as a hero and slay the dangerous aetherborn that have been plaguing humanity for a thousand years. Otherwise, his sword might turn its hunger on the innocent and turn Crow into a mass murderer!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Junkyouju Takatsuki Akira no Suisatsu
title_japanese: 准教授・高槻彰良の推察
synopsis:
Naoya Fukamachi is a university student whose ability to infallibly detect lies has left him friendless and isolated. But when he writes a paper about a strange festival he wandered into as a child, he catches the fancy of his folklore studies professor Akira Takatsuki, a handsome and eccentric man with a passion for all things mysterious. Soon, Naoya finds himself working as Akira's assistant, helping him to interpret an array of unexplainable phenomena, from haunted objects and cursed effigies to urban legends. As this odd couple continues their investigations, however, Naoya realizes that his professor has had a few bizarre childhood experiences of his own... 

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Hariko no Otome
synopsis:
Yui Nuir was reincarnated into a noble family of tailors in another world, retaining her memories of her previous life in Japan. Her miserable childhood had just one source of comfort: the fairies she befriended by mending their clothes with her magic. Unfortunately, Yui's relative lack of skill in blessweaving—the art of enchanting fabric through needlework—ultimately results in her being disowned by her family. But when she is taken in by a nobleman named Rodin Calostira, the first person to recognize her innate talents, her luck begins to turn around... 

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Setsuna no Fuukei
title_english: The Ephemeral Scenes of Setsuna's Journey
synopsis:
After being summoned to another world as the 68th hero in order to protect the world from monsters, Setsuna Sugimoto is abandoned because of his weak and sickly constitution and waits for his inevitable death. But when he meets Kyle, the former 23rd hero, he is given another chance at life and inherits Kyle's vast knowledge, power, and life force. Having finally gained the freedom to travel the world, Setsuna embarks on a journey as an adventurer, where he'll encounter all walks of life, meet new people, and say good-bye to others—each one bound to leave their mark on him and the world.

(Source: Yen Press)

Even though Aoi looks after Mondo in every way (including in explicit ways), Mondo tries to flee from her home. The outcome is uncertain.

synopsis:

With only a few days left, they confide in each other: Kaiami laments over the somber reason he will not be continuing his education, while Saegusa opens up about how lonely and isolated being the school doctor feels. Despite being surrounded by many people, the two find comfort only in each other's company as their inevitable separation draws closer.

Hundreds of years have passed by as they await the reincarnation of the princess who holds the key to breaking their curse, and now their once fiery rivalry has turned into something leisurely instead.

As he starts to feel desperate, Oogami decides to at least have his own household to which Nomiyamada said: "If you're gonna marry someone, then why not just marry me instead?" With Nomiyamada's proposal, Oogami suddenly finds that his lips and bottom half, that he has kept protected the past hundred of years, are now in danger of getting stolen!!

One of them is his twin sister, and the other is a perfect stranger. But which is which? From there begins a tangled give-and-take relationship between Maiku and the blue-eyed girls. Nao managed to find a job and leave her house of meatheads, but is forced to return home when her office is struck by layoffs. Sophia Riller, sixteen years old, was about to attend the Blessing Ceremony—a ritual in which a boy or girl of sixteen years is gifted with abilities from one of the various animal gods. Sophia, a clumsy type, was hoping that she would be chosen by a god that doesn't stand out...but...it was the Gorilla God who chose her! She was told that those blessed by the Gorilla God will have a gift for combat and needs to take the exam to become a Junior Knight. On the exam day, she met Louis, a handsome knight-to-be and two boys, who soon found out who Sophia was blessed by. Her life changes completely from that day...

Chloe will have fun with the phantom beasts with its power. However, the magic knight Ernesto appears, and the situation changes completely! He said that he was about to be killed by Chloe, and suddenly said, "If you're a bad witch, I'll kill you"...?!

title: Zetsumetsu Kigushu Hanayome: Shiitagerareta Hime desu ga Oujisama no Noroi wo Toite Shiawase ni Narimasu

Norstalt family was known for their superpowers. However, Elena was born with no power at all. Her mother adored her, but passed away when Elena was young. She was treated cruelly by her family as an "useless girl" and when she turned seventeen, she was ordered by her father to marry Yuri, the cursed second prince of Lodenium. The bride was supposed to be Vanessa, her younger sislte who was blessed with fire power, but their father decided to offer Elena instead.

When she reached the palace of Lodenium, she was told that prince won't come until the night of the Full Moon. It first bothered her, but people around her were all kind and gentle, and Elna started to enjoy living in the palace. Then she met a strange big wolf in the garden...

(Source: Kadokawa)

title: The Baengri Clan's Unwanted Granddaughter
synopsis:
Baengri Yeon knows her role well: she is a minor villain in a martial arts novel, scorned even for mourning the loss of her benevolent father, Euigang. But some villains possess the power to impact the story. The hero's archnemesis, Yayul, suddenly appears before Yeon and kills her, deviating from the original plot.

However, Yeon awakens in her six-year-old body, traveling back in time to just after an accident that stops her from becoming a martial artist—a disgrace for a member of the esteemed Baengri clan. She is already used to the family's bullying and abuse, but now she wishes to at least improve her relationship with Euigang. By opening her heart to her father and striving to prevent his senseless death, Yeon realizes the true extent of Euigang's love for her—and even the family patriarch seems to soften at the sight of his adorable granddaughter.

But when Byul suddenly disappears, Woohyun tracks her down at an abandoned hotel that his company plans to develop. To his surprise, it's a hangout for stray cats, a handsome young actor... and Byul!
