title_english: The Guy She Was Interested in Wasn't a Guy at All
title_japanese: 気になってる人が男じゃなかった
synopsis:
The black-clad boy that Aya Oosawa likes is perfect: he is effortlessly nonchalant, has a sharp sense of style, and listens to the best music. Ever since the trendy Aya stumbled upon a small CD store to enjoy the rock classics her friends are not familiar with, the mysterious employee behind the counter has been on her mind. Meanwhile, the quiet and aloof Mitsuki Koga listens to her popular classmate Aya rave about her crush, tormented by a nagging thought: how to tell Aya that the guy she is interested in is not a guy at all!

In reality, when Mitsuki sheds her plain high school uniform, she is the one manning the counter at her uncle Joe's CD shop. She wrestles with how to reveal her identity, but flirting with the stunning and clueless Aya is just too tempting. As music becomes their shared passion, it seems that Aya's feelings will remain unchanged—even when Mitsuki's secret comes to light.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Daijoubu, Omae ga Onna ni Nattemo Oretachi wa Shinyuu Dakara na!
title_japanese: 大丈夫、お前が女になっても俺たちは親友だからな!

title: Aru Hi Onna ni Natteshimatta Shinyuu ga Shiawase ni Naru made no Hanashi
title_japanese: ある日女になってしまった親友が幸せになるまでの話

title: TS Suki na Danshi ga TS shita kara Zenryoku de Risou no TS-kko wo Enjiru Yatsu
title_japanese: TS好きな男子がTSしたから全力で理想のTSっ娘を演じるやつ

title: Plaza Wars
synopsis:
As the toughest fighter in the world of crime, Gijun claims victory in a battle that ends the long power struggle between Seoul's gangs. But when his brother Giseok rises in rank within the enemy group, Gijun decides to slash his own heel and leave the business to avoid fighting him. Just when all seems at peace 15 years later, Giseok is mysteriously ambushed and killed in cold blood right before his own retirement. Filled with a chilly rage, Gijun sets off on a one-man hunt to track down everyone involved in his brother's death. And he has a feeling he doesn't need to look far to find the main culprit... With revenge and old gang rivalries factoring into the equation, Seoul's underbelly is in for yet another grisly bloodbath!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Hanbun Ageru
title_english: I'll Give You Half of Me
synopsis:
Two teenage boys barely knowing each other. One day, one learns the other is selling his body to get by. On a whim he runs away with him, but their journey to the sea quickly ends. Then, they reunite years later...

(Source: MU)

title: Psycho-Pass 3: First Inspector
synopsis:
Tokyo, 2120. In a society overseen by the Sibyl System, Inspectors Arata Shindou and Kei Mikhail Ignatov of the Criminal Investigation Department's Unit One clash over truth and justice. Kouichi Azusawa, the mastermind behind a string of crimes, sets his sights on the CID itself and launches an assault on the NONA Tower. Division 01 (a.k.a. Unit One) is in peril like never before—a case that will try Shindou and Ignatov's loyalties.

(Source: Psycho-Pass Wiki)

title: Izakaya Tantei
synopsis:
The master of the Izakaya "Arakan" is also a famous detective. In accordance with the veteran police detective Numata's request, he joins the investigations. A grueling detective story blended lightly with cuisine and seasoned with some human drama.

(Source: Media Do International/Nihonbungeisha)

title: Ningen Maid Robot Meruru
title_japanese: 人間メイドロボめるる
synopsis:
The story takes place in the near future, when technology has advanced to the point where "Maid Robots" are widely used. Yashiro, a salaryman for a black company also has a maid robot named Meruru, however she has a dangerous secret that even Yashiro doesn't know?!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Kanojo no Miryoku wa Sankakukin?
synopsis:
1. What's Onyanko
2. Kanojo no Miryoku wa Sankakukin?
3. Nanpa Ganryuujima
4. Jungle no Ouja Tar-san
5. Sotsugyou
6. Saint Ken-chan
7. Sonjo Sokora no Love Story
8. Bijo wa Nikuryouri ga Otokui

title: Yuganderu Watashi ga Dekiai saretemasu
title_japanese: 歪んでる私が溺愛されてます
synopsis:
Manga editor Rin Narita hates her overly self-confident ikemen senior Satoshi Takigawa!! One day, she calls him into the deserted reference room and asks him to help her with some document filming on the project she is working on. It's a sensual scene between two ex-lovers that the two are acting out and filming. An exciting, heart squeezing eros story where the two's twisted desires interweave with each other!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Furachi na Jukujo
synopsis:
1. Weekend Lover
2. Kaori
3. Yoru wa Betsu no Kao
4. Himitsu no Shoubu (The Secret Game)
5. Ano Hito no Himitsu
6-7. Anego to Mitsuo
8. Tabi no Haji wa Kakisutezu
9-10. Ano Hito mo Ouchi de wa

title: Nokemono-tachi no Yoru: Flame Knight
title_english: The Tale of Outcasts: The Flame Knight
title_japanese: ノケモノたちの夜 フレイムナイト

title: Doubutsu Ningen
synopsis:
Are we the predators or the prey? When an unsuspecting father and daughter stumble upon a strange gathering of humanoid animals with a taste for fine cuisine, their worst nightmare is about to begin. Here, creatures who are not quite human—and not quite animal at that— raise humans as livestock and slaughter them to put meat on the table. Through this bizarre and horrific tale, society's morals are put to the ultimate test: What does it truly mean to consume another living being?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: To Be an Actor
synopsis:
Young-guk Jang, who achieved great success as a supporting actor, received the honorable Best Supporting Actor Award at the Acting Awards for the first time. However, on that day, his mother passed away... Horrified by the death of his mother, whom he neglected for years, Young-guk decided to end his life... Before his death, he longingly recalled the warmth of his mother and the peaceful memories of the past. He regretted turning his back on those memories... At that moment, he suddenly regressed to his childhood...

"I regressed, to that past I missed. This time, I will definitely..."

Once again, the story of a person who wants to live as an actor begins. Will he be able to live a happy life unlike the previous life?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Keihi de Hotel-dai wa Ochimasen!
title_english: We Are NOT Expensing the Hotel to the Company!
title_japanese: 経費でホテル代は落ちません!
synopsis:
Kikuchi takes his work as an accountant for an advertising agency very seriously—and he has secretly always been in love with Higashikaneshiro, a laid-back designer at the same firm. However, after he is outed as gay, life at the office becomes difficult. His boss is emotionally manipulative, his coworkers talk about him behind his back, and even Higashikaneshiro ends up finding out that Kikuchi is gay. All this ends with Kikuchi quitting his job. On his last day, he finds himself really wishing the day would end already... but that's when Higashikaneshiro invites Kikuchi out for a going away party, just the two of them!!

(Source: NTT Solmare)

title: Elite Gekai no Ichizu na Kyuuai
title_english: This Elite Surgeon Wants to Give Me His Heart!
title_japanese: エリート外科医の一途な求愛
synopsis:
Hazuki is a secretary in the cardiothoracic surgery department and she has had enough with handsome men. They've only broken her heart! That's why she has to keep turning down the extremely good-looking Dr. Kagami, even though he is absolutely relentless in his pursuit. One night, Dr. Kagami just so happens to witness Hazuki getting turned down herself, and by a man who is not on her level. Dr. Kagami takes the chance to ask Hazuki what he's been meaning to all along: "Why don't you give loving me a chance?"

A sweet love story between a cool beauty and an elite surgeon that'll make your heart skip a beat!

(Source: NTT Solmare)

title: Hoshikuzu Kazoku
synopsis:
In a future world, children hold the authority to determine who may become parents. Having children is illegal—unless a couple first passes a strict examination, conducted by a child, that certifies them as capable providers. It is a veritable utopia with no child abuse...or at least, so it may seem. Hikari is one such examiner in this system, spending his days evaluating prospective parents. But one day, he comes across a couple that isn't quite like the others...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Ore ga Suki nado Warawaseru
title_english: You Love Me, Huh? Don't Make Me Laugh.
title_japanese: 俺が好きなど嗤わせる
synopsis:
After a night of heavy drinking with his competent and dependable coworker Kamiya, Kaji slowly begins to regain his consciousness... Only to find Kamiya straddled right on top of him, legs spread and wearing nothing but a half-unbuttoned shirt. When Kaji is finally able to muster the energy to get up, he immediately asks Kamiya to explain himself. His response? "Things went sour with my hook-up buddy, and I've been pent up lately. That's all." Since that day, for some reason, Kaji begins feeling drawn to Kamiya.

This is the story of a recently divorced man, his coworker who's secretly promiscuous, and the attraction that forms between them, set in the world of the ever-competitive Toto First Bank's head office.

(Source: Taiyo Tosho)

title: Kakunaru Ue wa
synopsis:
Dweeby high schooler Yuuki Uehara has created the perfect romantic comedy heroine—she's bashful, airheaded, and completely chaste. When an editor at Uehara's dream publisher coldly dismisses his manga story as trite and lacking realism, it sends Uehara into a spiral of despair that pushes him into the path of his bubbly, gorgeous classmate, Niina Miyamoto—an aspiring manga artist herself! Having gotten similar feedback on her own manga, Miyamoto proposes she and Uehara engage in a fake relationship, since neither of them have any romantic experience. But Miyamoto is far from the perfect heroine Uehara's concocted, and he certainly isn't the cocky hero from her story either. Can their wacky relationship turn their manga dreams into reality, or will it lead to even more comic disasters?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Manga de! Nyanko Daisensou
title_japanese: まんがで！にゃんこ大戦争

title: Takatora-kun to Omega-tachi
title_japanese: 鷹虎くんとオメガたち
synopsis:
The omegaverse manga takes place at a special academy where the children of the elite gather. Within the academy, Takatora is part of the "Alpha Special Class." He is the heir to one of the most distinguished families, and is known for his physique, intellect, handsomeness, and overwhelming charisma. There's no one at the academy who doesn't know him. But one day, Takatora's physical condition changes, and he starts to exhibit the "heat" symptoms of an omega.

(Source: ANN)

title: Jardinier no Aishita Dokuka
title_japanese: ジャルディニエの愛した毒花
synopsis:
When itinerant traveler Orbit, also known as "Ollie," gets stranded without permit or paperwork in the authoritarian city-state of Belote, the only place that will hire him is as a caretaker, or "gardener," at the male brothel Le Jouet Queue. He quickly discovers that all of the companions working there are "furless," half animal and half human beings who are treated as pets, property, and sometimes even as livestock for slaughter. For many of the furless there, life at the brothel is a marked improvement from all they've suffered earlier in their lives. They are fed, sheltered, pampered, and looked after by Ollie and the other gardeners—and even a gilded cage is better than the cruelties of the outside world.

But when Ollie's considerate, gentle nature and pure heart catch the eye of the tempestuous Aconit, the most prized and coveted furless in Le Jouet Queue, what begins as idle seduction soon blooms into something deeper. Aconit's haughty façade of careless allure masks his own ol

title: Ura de Yancha na Gouinda-san
title_japanese: 裏でやんちゃな剛院田さん
synopsis:
Bonsuke Hirano, an exceptionally ordinary high school boy, returns to his homeroom after school to pick something up, only to find the school's number-one serene beauty, Kokuru Gouinda, fidgeting around in his desk...

"Huh? Does she...like me? Wait, maybe not?" 

A young man's naivety meets the full force of a gal's allure in this tantalizing tale of teen love!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Hooked and Cooked
synopsis:
The owner of a seafood restaurant falls in love at first sight...with a merman! Hae-beom, often mistaken for a thug due to his tough appearance, unexpectedly receives help from a mysterious customer named Sang-ah. To his astonishment, Sang-ah turns out to be a merman who requires human saliva in order to gain his legs. Seizing the opportunity, Hae-beom offers him a daily kiss, harboring his own secret hopes and desires. For Sang-ah, it's just a means to an end, but Haebeom can't help but wonder: will Sang-ah ever reciprocate his feelings?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Soreja, Goumon Hajimemaasu!
title_japanese: それじゃ、拷問はじめま～す!

title: Gigantis
synopsis:
On that day, humanity was turned into "prey"―Gen is a high school student living on the island of Tsushima, a door to mainland Japan. Along with his sickly sister, Misaki, and his heartwarming mother, Gen was living a peaceful life, all until an "asymmetrical monster" appears on the island. All hell breaks loose on the island of Tsushima. These monsters devour everything from plants to animals, to humans, and mutate together. Will humanity stand a chance against these mutant creatures? Is there any hope?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Yakuza-sama no Omocha dj - Koyoi wa Tengoku
synopsis:
One night after work, Yuuya's colleagues treat him to an evening of drinks for a job well done on a difficult project. On the way home, while it's obvious that Yuuya's drunken a bit too much... he is in a really great mood. Not wanting the night to end, he heads over to Kurose's place with a present of booze in hand. With Yuuya high in spirits, and Kurose finding his inebriated state so very cute, Kurose also ends up drinking too much. As per usual for the two, they get nice and intimate and... you can guess what happens next!

(Source: DLsite)

title: Toki Majutsushi no Tsuyokute New Game: Kako ni Modotte Sekai Saikyou kara Yarinaosu
title_japanese: 時魔術士の強くてニューゲーム ～過去に戻って世界最強からやり直す～
synopsis:
After 100 years of hard work, the hero, Chrome, has become the world's only Chronomancer. However, by the time he became the world's strongest, all the people and towns he wanted to protect were lost. And so the course he chose... is to go back to his childhood and start his life all over again...?! This is the ultimate story of time-lapse fantasy!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Hagure Ningyo no Diana
title_japanese: はぐれ人魚のディアナ
synopsis:
A certain country long ago. A mermaid was brought to the castle. The rare mermaid with transformed legs, was supposed to be presented to the king of a neighboring country... But the prince who saw the mermaid said, "Would you like to be my princess?" A communal life that starts from there! How will the love of these two people go...!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Big Boss Gone Bad
synopsis:
Woo Soo-han is what you would call the "complete package." He's young, physically fit, handsome, and has flourishing career to boot. He's got everything anyone could ever desire, except maybe a relationship. That never bothered him, as work has always been his main priority. Everything changes when he meets his close hyung (and work subordinate)'s wife, Nayoung. From the moment he laid eyes on her, he felt an inexplicable attraction. Soo-han knew it was wrong and tried to forget about her, but when the two cross paths at a night club, and he ends up taking an intoxicated Nayoung back to her house. After discovering her husband isn't home, Soo-han finds that he is no longer able to control his urges...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Kowamote Joushi ga, Kawaisugiru Ken
title_english: Under that Grumpy Face, My Boss Is Just a Cutiepie
title_japanese: コワモテ上司が、かわいすぎる件
synopsis:
Everyone at the office is a little afraid of the boss, Mr. Mano, probably because he's always scowling and rarely talks. When Akane hits a rough patch and has little choice but to crash at Mr. Mano's place for a while, he spends his days on edge, painfully aware that he's an unwelcome guest... Until one day, in a strange turn of events, Akane finds out Mr. Mano's "dark secret" and can't help but feel a sharp twinge of affection. The guy's got a scary face, but then he'll get all bashful and turn pink, or let out a shy little laugh, or... Hang on, this is just way too cute!!

A super lovey-dovey romcom chock full of books that don't match their covers, starring a do-gooder businessman and his grumpy-faced boss.

(Source: NTT Solmare Corporation)

title: Korashimete Sashiagemasu!: Otenba Oujo no Gekokujou Nikki
title_english: I'll Teach You a Lesson You'll Never Forget!: The Diary of a Tomboy Princess
title_japanese: 懲らしめて差し上げますっ! ~おてんば王女の下剋上日記~
synopsis:
Lana, princess of the kingdom of Mitronia, is bright and energetic with excellent swordsmanship and academic ability. A stark contrast to her older brother Adrian, the self-centered and pompous crown prince. However, he is the one scheduled to take over the throne from their father as King of Mitronia next summer.

Fearing for the future of her country, Lana vows to replace her brother as queen...! Unfortunately, this is impossible under the current law, which states that "only males in the direct line can succeed to the throne." The current king, troubled by her unprecedented proposal, tells Lana that in order for her to gain his approval, she must "solve the problems of three noble families" throughout their kingdom. Lana immediately sets out for the lands in question, accompanied by four friends, including her childhood friend, the knight Kaiser...

The tomboy princess' exhilarating journey starts here!

(Source: NTT Solmare)

title: Ryoukataomoi Overkill!
title_japanese: 両片思いオーバーキル!

title: Succubus-ka no Majime na Pure-san
title_japanese: サキュバス課の真面目なピュアさん

title: Repair: Kono Sekai wa Jizoku Kanou desu ka?
title_japanese: リ・ペア　この世界は持続可能ですか？

title: Heisei Wotaku Remembers
title_japanese: 平成ヲタク リメンバーズ
synopsis:
The year was 2006. A time when people made fun of you just for being an "otaku." One man who survived the Otaku Ice Age travels back in time to those days! Otaku, regain your lost youth!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Ookami Shujin to Usagi Maid-chan
title_japanese: オオカミ主人とウサギメイドちゃん
synopsis:
In a world where beast people live, Coco, a rabbit girl, begins working as a maid in a mansion. The master, Lucion, is a handsome yet lonely wolf who is feared by everyone around him due to a condition called "Beast Devolution," which makes him more beast than man. Though Coco serves him the best she can, Master Lucion's heart remains tightly shut. But one day, a scent emanates from Coco's body, which greatly attracts Lucion...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: My Borrowed Body
synopsis:
What do you do when your body gets switched with your crush's?! Sang-yu is a painfully shy 18-year-old who has a crush on the class president, Darim. But there's no way she'd ever return his feelings: Darim is popular, smart, pretty...and she likes their classmate, Ho-young. The three used to be friends when they were little, but a lot's changed since kindergarten. All this gets jumbled when Sang-yu and Darim have a life-changing encounter at the neighborhood park. All of a sudden, Sang-yu and Darim have a lot more to talk about, and Ho-young finds himself feeling stirred as he watches the two grow closer.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Girl Reborn
synopsis:
Eunsung one day wakes up to find out he's a girl! He's able to hide his change of gender from everyone... or so he thought. His secret is discovered by his crush on day one and moreover, she asks him to pose as a nude model for her! How will Eunsung's life start anew as a girl?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Hajime no Koi
title_english: One Day My Love Will Blossom.
synopsis:
Hajime Mamiya decides to quit the yakuza business after the death of his boss. When riding on a bus, he meets Shou Kosaka, a college student who is close to his boyfriend. One day when Mamiya couldn't forget Kosaka's longing face towards his boyfriend, he reunites with him, who apparently works part-time at Deriheru. Mamiya doesn't know how it feels to love someone, but he learns of Kosaka's devotion to selling his body, and decides to buy all his time so that he doesn't have to take other customers.

A pure story of a slowly falling in love with a former yakuza who doesn't know love and a college student who wants to love and be loved!

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

title: 8-nenburi ni Dakaremasu
title_english: Make Love First Time in 8 Years
synopsis:
"Anyone is fine. I want to be held by a man again..."

Naoto, a popular teacher at a famous prep school, spends his days enjoying sex with one-night stands. Because of his good looks, physical strength and huge dick, he has been playing the role of the top for the past eight years. However, Andou, a student at the prep school, sees through his desire to be bottomed by a man. Naoto, who was forcibly embraced by Andou in a classroom, was blinded by lust and his own shameful desires were revealed, but...?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: Baachan ga Game Haishin shiteta Hanashi
title_japanese: ばあちゃんがゲーム配信してた話

title: Baraou no Souretsu: Oohi to Bara no Kishi
title_english: Requiem of the Rose King: The Queen and the Rose Knight
title_japanese: 薔薇王の葬列 王妃と薔薇の騎士
synopsis:
The series focuses on events not covered in the main Baraou no Souretsu series, including stories about the characters' everyday lives and Margaret of Anjou's past.

(Source: MU)

title: I Became the Villain's Trainer
synopsis:
When veterinarian Yoohee Han dies early, a grim reaper sends her into the world of a novel she once read to live out the rest of her time as the side character Alexa. She uses her knowledge of the novel (and of animals) to take on a more prominent role as the trainer of Isildus, heir of Terrecion, a wolf shifter who will remain in animal form until his 16th birthday. She becomes a beloved advisor in Terrecion castle, and her actions change the fates of other characters. How will little Issy feel about her when he becomes human?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Aoharu-sou e Youkoso
title_japanese: アオハル荘へようこそ
synopsis:
The manga is about five high school boys with different personalities living in a dormitory. Various incidents happen as the boys experience love and spend their youthful days together.

(Source: ANN)

title: Gomen ne Hatsukoi
synopsis:
Year 3 of high school, winter. Chiho and the friendly Sousuke kindly accept Mahiro, an out-of-season transfer student. Chiho and Sousuke are childhood friends who live next door to each other. They are not family, but they are special to each other—and Mahiro yearns for their relationship. These feelings eventually turn into her first love for Sousuke...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Higashi Sengoku-san no Make-up Doll
title_japanese: 東千石さんのメイクアップドール
synopsis:
Rei, who is relied on by everyone, ends up attending a party in place of an injured friend.

Just when Rei, who always wears boyish clothes and doesn't know much about fashion or makeup, is at a loss, the "fashion warrior" beauty student Azuma Sengoku appears...!? A new series overflowing with "cute"!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Girl Meet Girl
synopsis:
The "interspecies coming-of-age sci-fi" manga follows a naive high school girl named Mameko and an introverted pig girl named Yulily, who form a friendship and spend their youth in a mysterious world where different species co-exist.

(Source: ANN)

title: Bu Keai de TA
synopsis:
Betrayed by her fiancé, Ariana flees her wedding, her heart broken and frozen to even the thought of love. Still she rises to the top, as this charismatic beauty buries herself in work. But when her childhood friend suddenly moves back to town, he cheekily creates ripples in her otherwise peaceful life—and in her own home! She's never imagined being with him, while he's never imagined being with anyone but her. Can he melt the ice of her long-guarded heart? Sweet romance is on its way!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Tensai Majo no Maryoku Kare
synopsis:
Nayu, the one in a million genius witch who has been the talk of the town, has run out of magic! The price for all the things she has been allowed to do because of her brilliance is coming back to the former genius witch like a boomerang... Then, she meets her past student "Komugi" who loves her very much. This is a boomerang love comedy of karmic retribution by a former genius witch who can't be left alone even though it stings a little, abandoned by her magical powers!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Ai tte Yatsu wo Oshiete Kure yo
title_japanese: 愛ってやつを教えてくれよ

title: The Price of a Broken Engagement
title_english: The Price of a Broken Engagement
synopsis:
Clearly, God must have been joking when he sent down another oracle proclaiming that "the companion of His Royal Highness, the crown prince, is to be the precious daughter of Marquis Lurhtella." How could the oracle be mistaken?

As soon as I was born, I was selected to be the crown princess and have spent my entire life training to be a great empress one day, but everything changed overnight: my power, my status, and the way people look at me. I thought only his love wouldn't change. However, he did not hesitate to notify me of the annulment of our engagement, and that is how it ended between us. Giving up everything was a lot easier than I thought. But...

"It's a pleasure to meet you, Princess Pesentria."
"......"
"Speaking of the owner of the temple, I wonder if you remember me."

He, who had the greatest divine power in the empire, reached out to me. Can I hold his hand?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Hataraku Futari no Gohoubi Meshi
title_japanese: 働くふたりのごほうび飯

title: Lady Evony
synopsis:
Evony Vonieck's days are numbered. She has been sentenced to death for murdering her father and fiancé. She's saved when a guardian arranges for her release, sending her to the Duke's castle.

What she expects is the job of a housemaid, or worse, being chained in an underground dungeon, and starving to death. But Grand Duke Schneider's behavior towards her isn't cruel. 

What is the meaning of his generosity? And will Evony be able to adapt to her new life?

(Source: Radish Media)

title: Lady Swindler
synopsis:
To uphold her father's wishes, Seizel Aramis lived an honest and virtuous life, only to be betrayed by those she trusted, conned by crooks, sent to jail, and executed. But the moment she dies, Seizel wakes up in the past, right before her misfortunes began. This time, Seizel decides to live life differently by becoming the greatest swindler in the empire! Armed with a newfound goal and the determination to fulfill it, can Seizel succeed in going from noblewoman to con-woman?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kimi wa Itoshi no Liar Boy
title_english: You Are My Dear Liar Boy
title_japanese: きみは愛しのライアーボーイ
synopsis:
Ryuusei is tasked to be the star in a prank video in an attempt to go viral. His objective? Confess to his friend from his yankee days, Kiwami! Ryuusei shies away from the idea of making the man he admires the butt of a joke, but he's intrigued to see how Kiwami would react and reluctantly accepts. He tells himself he'll be satisfied if he gets a laugh out of him, but his friend's response is unexpectedly serious!

(Source: Julian Publishing, translated)

title: Gifted
synopsis:
One day, Natsuki Amakusa—the hope of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department—meets an unusual high schooler named Yuuya Shiki. Natsuki's interest in the high schooler is piqued after Yuuya happens to be passing through the scene of a difficult murder case and determines the perpetrator with ease. How did he know who the killer was? When an incident later takes place at Yuuya's high school, the two happen across each other again... Thus, a young policeman and a high schooler with a hidden power begin unraveling the mystery!

(Source: MU)

title: Karamawari Weekend
title_japanese: からまわりウィークエンド
synopsis:
"Kawanami-san, please fall in love with me."

Under the influence of alcohol, Mifune blurts out the feelings he has kept secret from his senpai, Kawanami. And when Kawanami's attitude doesn't seem to have changed after the confession, what is Mifune to do? Heart-pounding, sparkly sempai x unsociable kouhai with a one-sided love. A fresh debut! From Izui Zui, a tantalizing workplace love that you can't help wanting to cheer on.

(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)

title: Myo-chan Sensei wa Kaku Katariki
title_japanese: みょーちゃん先生はかく語りき

title: Gunjin wa Ai no Kemono
synopsis:
One day out of the blue, noblewoman Giselle is summoned to serve as the king's prized concubine. Alas, her heart belongs to another man: Wallace, a former slave and the soldier who saved her brother's life. Wallace worships the ground Giselle walks on and attends to her every need as her manservant. Much as Giselle mourns the line drawn between them, her days with Wallace are filled with bliss. Yet the king's word is absolute, so Giselle decides to give up on her paramour. Then, late one night, Wallace steals into her room in the palace. His gaze is desperate and hungry as he watches her. She knows it's a crime to spend the night with him...but can she help herself?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Wet Sand
synopsis:
Joseph "Jo" Landi has had a normal life, and he has recently moved in with his aunt to help out with her restaurant while focusing on his photography hobby. When he accidentally snaps a picture of Shin "Ian" Youngwoo, it leads to the two of them meeting. Jo has never had interest in men before, but Ian is strikingly handsome and has an air of mystery that Jo simply cannot get out of his head.

Unbeknownst to Jo, Ian is an ex-member of an Asian gang. The only thing preventing him from fully leaving the life of violence behind is his undefined relationship with Oh "TJ" Taejoon, his longtime friend and lover. TJ and Ian share a complex past, and Ian's unresolved feelings for TJ complicate his newfound connection with Jo. As the struggle for power within the gang intensifies, Ian wonders if he truly possesses the strength to let go of his past with TJ and embrace a brighter future—possibly with Jo by his side.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Revenge: Kaedamakon
synopsis:
Timid Tsukiko has a strained relationship with her beautiful sister Mitsuki. Whatever her domineering sister needs, Tsukiko complies–even pretending she's her sister on dates! But when Mitsuki gets engaged, and Tsukiko stands in for her at a wedding planning meeting, she ends up falling into bed with Mitsuki's fiance! Tired of playing second fiddle to her sister, Tsukiko decides to take something for herself for a change. In this startling tale of intrigue and romance, revenge is a dish best served steaming hot!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Included one-shot:
Volume 3: Nandemo Hoshigaru Haruna-chan
Volume 4: Fake: Gossip Reijou no Fukinshin Days

title: Villain
synopsis:
"I'm sure we freak them out just by holding hands."

Azuru Orio is a young man who doesn't understand his gender. In this town, the freest "male" is Renri Midou, the one Azuru should have fallen in love with. Based on Teniwoha's Vocaloid song "Villain," Fujita brings a manga overflowing with heartbreak and excitement.

In a modern era where we long for such stories, how will their love story conclude?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Doumo, Yuusha no Chichi desu. Kono Tabi wa Gusoku ga Gomeiwaku wo Kakete, Moushiwake Arimasen.
title_japanese: どうも、勇者の父です。～この度は愚息がご迷惑を掛けて、申し訳ありません。～
synopsis:
Croix, who works as a lumberjack in a remote village, spends peaceful days with his beautiful wife, Wiel, and his only son, Alka. One day, Alka receives an oracle that he is the only one who can defeat the Demon King, the "Hero," and together with his fiancé Saya, he sets out on a journey to subjugate the Demon King... However, one day, three years after receiving the oracle, Saya returned to the village in tatters. From Saya's mouth, Alka is flickering his authority as a hero, and is told that he does whatever he pleases without saving the world... to wake up his stupid son. Hit him with your strongest fist!!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: The Beloved Bashful Villainess
synopsis:
My wicked mother brought a girl one day. She was the duke's hidden daughter, Loretta, the heroine of Duke's Four Children. I am Melody, the villainess who was punished with my mother for harassing her. I don't want to die like that, so I have to treat her well now. I fed Loretta, put her to sleep, and played with her. And then her response was...?

"I hope Melody marries Loretta!" The endless barrage of affection led me to join her back to the duke and she said, "I'll stick close to Ms. Melody." Have you met someone who is a 'Fool for Melody' more than her? Why am I being loved when I've only been kind enough to make myself live peacefully...!

(Source: A.Tempo Media, translated)

title: Saihate Quartet
title_japanese: サイハテ四重奏〈カルテット〉
synopsis:
Angels descend upon Japan! They’ve come to deliver the Japanese people from demons, who have taken the music industry by storm. But their master plan is to shoot for stardom as idols?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: King of the Octagon
synopsis:
Hwiseong Lee, who was once a promising athlete with his gifted athletic abilities in high school, works part-time at a convenience store. One day, he is invited to an MMA event which eventually leads him to a new adventure. After visiting the Octagon for the first time, he feels overwhelmed by what he has just witnessed. How will his life change as he begins training, and will he rise to glory as an MMA fighter?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Stella: The Lost Star
synopsis:
With the entire Belvice Empire awaiting her abilities, Princess Stella's life is turned upside down when she fails to bring the stars into the sky. Discarded by her family as the empire is overthrown, she is taken in and raised by commoners. But when the empire is restored and her conceited sister finds her, Stella's peaceful life is threatened once again. Is she doomed to live as a puppet for the family that hated her? Or can she shatter their demands and rise as the true leader of Belvice?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Hatsujou 5-byoumae! Ponkotsu Around 30 Airu-san ga α no Ouji ni Aoraretemasu
title_japanese: 初情5秒前! ポンコツアラサー愛留さんがαの王子に煽られてます。
synopsis:
One day, our protagonist is assigned to be a mentor to the president's son, Taiga Narukami, an elite boy with a shiny new look. However, Taiga becomes frustrated with Airu's uncompromising attitude, and finally takes her lips in a forceful manner. Airu's body gets wet under Taiga's rough kisses and fingertips. When Narukami-kun touches her, her body becomes so numb that she can't think about anything else...!

(Source: Brite Shuppan, translated)

title: Koshotengai no Hashihime
synopsis:
Tamamori came to Tokyo with his sights set on getting accepted to the Imperial University. However, he doesn't pass the entrance exam, and is so undisciplined and wrapped up in endless fantasies that he's kicked out of his boarding house after only two years. Through a stroke of luck, Tamamori begins to live and work at Umebachidou, a used book store. There, he enjoys whiling away his time as a "student preparing for entrance exams" and taking advantage of friends who are also from his hometown. But one right after the other, mysterious deaths befall those friends and, realizing he's been repeating the same rainy three days over and over again, Tamamori finds himself racing throughout Jinbochou to save them.

(Source: MangaGamer)

title: Maou ni Sarawareta Seioujo desu ga, Maoujougurashi ga Hima Datta node Kinki Mahou de Abaremasu.
title_english: Abducted Princess Running Rampant: Wielding Forbidden Magic in the Demon King's Castle
title_japanese: 魔王にさらわれた聖王女ですが、魔王城ぐらしがヒマだったので禁忌魔法で暴れます。
synopsis:
As a holy princess born with divine powers, Mil spends her days blessing adventurers from all across the kingdom. Inspired by their tales of dragons, demons, and treasure-filled dungeons, she has long dreamed of someday setting out on an adventure of her own. But she's destined for an uneventful life confined to her father's castle. That is, until she's kidnapped by the Demon King and forced to use her powers to aid his forces instead! Unfortunately the novelty soon wears off, and life imprisoned in the Demon King's Castle turns into another dull routine. It seems Mil's only hope to escape the monotony is to somehow grow strong enough to break free and evade her captor. In a castle filled with demonic combat instructors, cursed weapons, and tomes of evil spells, Mil's development is going to be far from holy, but that's not about to stop her. She's determined to have the adventure she has always longed for, even if it means mastering forbidden magic!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Shuu ni Ichido Classmate wo Kau Hanashi: Futari no Jikan, Iiwake no 5000-en
title_japanese: 週に一度クラスメイトを買う話～ふたりの時間、言い訳の五千円～

Once a week, Miyagi pays 5,000 yen to her classmate Sendai. The 5,000 yen is to buy three hours of Sendai's time, which gives the right for Miyagi to give her orders.

Miyagi is at the bottom of the school caste while Sendai is at the top. The two, who never crossed paths at school, spend time together after school under such a contract. Miyagi's orders are determined by her mood of the day, and Sendai cannot disobey. One day after school, Miyagi calls Sendai to her room and gives her an order that she usually does not give.

In high school she found herself in the same class as Hoshiichi. At first, Koyuri was unsure, but she it turned out still enjoyed spending time with Hoshiichi! The two of them finally settled their differences. One day Hoshiichi asked Koyuri, "Won't you go out with me? Koyuri!", But before she could give a proper answer, things became complicated again...?

Natsumi, also known as "Ham-chan," hustles at a demanding office job like a hamster running in a wheel. Meanwhile, her boss Samejima is more like a shark. He's handsome, sure, but he's also imposing and scary...at least, until he confesses his feelings for her?! Natsumi is a little overwhelmed at seeing a vulnerable side to this gigantic man, especially since she doesn't have a lot of experience in the love department, but she's secretly thrilled to see more. Together, this big boss with a carnivorous appetite and the smaller woman who's hungry for his love are ready to unleash their wild sides!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Hen na Ryuu to Motoyuusha Party Zatsuyougakari, Shintairiku de Nonbiri Slow Life

title_japanese: 変な竜と元勇者パーティー雑用係、新大陸でのんびりスローライフ
synopsis:
With the Demon King defeated, the world is at peace once more... And with that peace, the hero's party's handyman Theodore is out of a job. With all the money he could ever need already tucked away, he considers retiring. But he's instead suddenly called on to investigate the New World! En route to his new destination, he comes across and tames a slightly offbeat juvenile dragon. And so, Theodore's life on the frontier begins! His busted trio of skills, Appraise, Craft, and Tame are all he needs in his lackadaisical cultivation efforts, surrounded by a bizarrely cute crew!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Boku wa Nanadome no Jinsei de, Kaibutsu Hime wo Te ni Ireta
title_english: I Got a Monster Princess in My Seventh Life.
title_japanese: 僕は七度目の人生で、怪物姫を手に入れた
synopsis:
Hugo is stuck in a time loop, forced to relive the same life up until the moment he is slain by one of his own relatives. But, after swearing revenge on his murderous family during his seventh reset, he meets a beautiful girl. According to rumor, this girl is a monster in human flesh, but he agrees to become her servant all the same. The birth of their partnership heralds an intertwining of fates, and Hugo's life will never be the same again...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: The Tyrant Wants to Be Good
title_english: The Tyrant Wants to Be Good
synopsis:
Nothing was ever handed to Dorothea Millanaire. No attention, no love, no power. So she decided to take them for herself... with her sword! She accepts her fate when she is executed for being a bloodthirsty tyrant, only to wake up... as a child?! This is her second chance. She must not repeat history. She must be good.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: My Brothers, the Protagonists
synopsis:
Until recently, I had three wishes that I could only hope to come true: "Please let my missing oldest brother come back," "Please let my second brother awaken so he could stop working as a rift porter," and "And my youngest brother...As long as he can open his eyes..." There's nothing I wanted but happiness... was what I thought...!

"Keuhk...I'll only play for 10 years so I can keep the darkness inside me, so work a little harder, youngest!" My oldest brother spoke as though he were still in his adolescence. "Since hyung is playing for 10 years, I'll also play for 10 years, too!" said my second brother who returned as an awakener from the future (as he claims to be). "You foolish pig, I'll give you an opportunity to serve this noble soul," said my third brother... Let's just move on since it makes my head ache just by thinking about him.

title: Mitsuka
synopsis:
"Be nice to the one you love!" "You're straight. I can't win against women."

Leo is a host, but he can't forget Takahiro—a male prostitute who initiated him to anal sex—and now he can't have sex with women anymore because of him. He begs Takahiro to sleep with him again, and they start living together as an extension of being friends with benefits—every day is a two-people orgy!

Just when Leo starts thinking he may be falling in love, one of his best customers asks him to sleep with her. Takahiro catches him in the act and loses his cool, angrily screwing him right in front of his customer...?!

(Source: Shu-Cream)

If you had the chance to start your career over again, what would you do differently? Junsu faces this question when he suddenly goes back in time to his first day at work as a rookie producer. After ten years of getting his ideas stolen by a scummy senior producer, Junsu gets a chance to change his professional fate. And better yet, he has all the skills and memories of the Junsu of ten years later. Will he be able to avoid his previous mishaps and make his dreams come true?

synopsis:
Magic is everything to Noelle. She loves it so much that she puts up with her horrible job at the Mages' Guild to practice it. The hours are long, the pay is rock-bottom, and the boss is a nightmare! But as long as she has magic, she can withstand the hardships. At least, until the day she hears these dreaded words:"You're fired." Noelle's hometown in the outskirts of the kingdom doesn't offer many alternatives for a career in magic—especially now that she's been blacklisted from guild work! Just when it seems like all hope is lost, Noelle's old friend Luke shows up to give her an opportunity she never could have imagined: a job as a royal court magician. Now Noelle is living the dream, rubbing shoulders with the kingdom's greatest magicians and showing off her skills. She has a beautiful new workplace and a generous new boss, but how will she cope with intense entrance exams, her marriage-obsessed mother, and the rules of etiquette? What awaits Noelle in her magical new career?

Not only can his magic help him sense color, but he can also use it to make handy items and even conjure a whole cat! Word of his skills and ingenuity soon reach the court and earn him a spot as disciple to the most powerful magician in the land. But is his ultimate goal even attainable?

Those sentenced to the fate of a hero are forced to fight at the front lines against the demon king's army—and if they die, all they can expect is to be revived and continue the battle. As Dojin grows up, he struggles to hide his feelings for Haesoo, but tries to do so regardless by assisting him in his priestly duties. A teacher who was bullied in the past, Koizumi plays the role of a good-looking and extroverted teacher to protect himself. Because of that, he's very popular with female students. In truth, he is a gay introverted virgin. Being transferred to a school in the countryside, the unfamiliar environment and stress of lying about his true character make him want to cry every day. On top of that, his intimidating and hard-to-handle colleague, Wanibuchi, finds out who he really is. For some reason, however, Wanibuchi likes him and invites him out every free day they get. He even goes as far as giving him a lewd kiss?! A totally inexperienced Koizumi keeps being teased—?!

Forced by poor health to take a leave of absence, curmudgeonly conductor Kiri returns to his rural hometown for some much-needed rest. But on his very first night back, he comes dangerously close to freezing to death—until local grocer Osamu scoops him up out of the cold and into the warmth of his embrace. Can this younger man, a years-long fan of Kiri's work, thaw out the ice in the maestro's heart? Or will Kiri be doomed to a life of frigid loneliness forever?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Gripping the wheel of a monster truck with a displacement of 30,000 cc and 1,000 horsepower, Hanamaru Bakuzou drives down the road of justice! Together with new delivery driver Shintarou Kuriyama, he takes on deliveries more dangerous than the next.

As part of her training programme, Sakura is tasked with writing reports about unusual crimes. During this process, she interviews Sumio Kodai, a former detective who is now being held in police custody after committing a crime of conscience. "If you don't connect with the darkness inside yourself you can't understand criminals, and you can't become an investigator." Sakura is left shaken by Sumio's words. And then, one day, news about a serial murder case is sprung upon her...

title: Hana to Unmei Chuudoku
synopsis:
Hana Yoshizawa has only one goal in life: to find her soulmate. Dreamy, distracted and hopeful, she wishes to find someone to share those feelings with; although she has no luck. After several failed love affairs, she does not lose sight of her ideal and share that desire with others. Therefore, she doesn't bother trying to convince her subordinate, Takada, that soulmates do exist and that he will find his someday...something Takada is not really interested in, nor does he believe they exist.

In this unique senpai-subordinate relationship there is something that none of them dare to say out loud, until one day they meet outside of work at Takada's house... Pancakes and a hidden longing, what will happen between Hana and Takada in an unexpected night?

title: Pure Love

Before she even realizes what she's doing, though, she has Ji-Hoon pinned underneath her as she orders him to "be a good boy." For example, settling down with Myusel...until a certain absolute monarch declares she wants to marry our protagonist too! Shinichi isn't the only one with a relationship to work out, either—there might just be sparks between Hikaru and Elvia, but will this seed of love blossom into a true inter-time-linear otaku romantic saga?! Meanwhile, Minori is busy...well, being Minori, which can only mean...something. No matter what happens, one thing's for certain: for Shinichi, nothing ever quite goes according to keikaku!* (*That means plan.)

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Let's Get Divorced!

To do so, she agrees to marry Han-gyeol, who holds a permanent resident status in Australia, and plans to divorce him as soon as she gets her visa. However, to receive their marriage certificate, they must prove that their love is "legit." How are they going to do that when their marriage is a fraud?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

synopsis:
The moment her uncle pushed her out of a window but failed to kill her, six-year-old Princess Claudia remembered everything. In her past life, she was a legendary witch who commanded a veritable army of magicians. She possesses a magic that can leave the world at her mercy! Never mind her cold reception in this life! Claudia decides to live free of worldly worries. She makes a servant of a handsome but unfriendly boy, Noah, and sets out to do whatever she pleases by using the advanced magic that once shook the world, sweeping away her opposition in the process! Unfortunately, using so much power makes her so sleepy… Zzz... Claudia rests easy in the arms of her unwilling servant after using too much magic. Here begins the story of a legendary witch ready for a comfortable, leisurely life with her grumpy, raven-haired servant!

As the pasts of these murderers are slowly revealed, what "punishment" awaits them in the end? When you learn of their crimes, will you be able to forgive them? Their physical chemistry is strong, but Akito has some reservations about Izumi's messy and wild lifestyle—not to mention the fact that he was once Izumi's teacher. In the midst of his days of mere subsistence and despair, Levi meets Prince Saphir, the 13th prince, who is known as the Moribund Prince. Their jokes and laughter would fill the classroom. But as the new school year rolls around, Fujikawa and Sasaki find themselves assigned to the same class while their friends are shuffled elsewhere.

"What exactly does that mean for Sasaki?" you ask? It means lunchtime with a perpetual food thief who takes every opportunity to take a jab at him. Every. Single. Day. It's not like they don't get along, but the two have quite the opposite energy levels... Will the calm and quiet Fujikawa and the energetic and fiery Sasaki be able to find an equilibrium? Atalante is the boss of a notorious organization that works in the empire's shadow. One day, she receives a request from the emperor to assassinate a new target: the tyrant archduke Lionel Vianc. Hinaki Kaguya is a college student with good looks who often catches the glances of her peers. However, she has a secret she can't tell anybody... She's obsessively in love with Subaru, one of the members of a popular online streamer group! Suddenly, a message from an unknown account comes to Hinaki as she wishes to be able to date Subaru... Will this be an answer to her intense passion?

(Source: NTT Solmare)

title: Baby Tyrant
synopsis:
When Yoon Gyeoul's life ends at the hands of her alcoholic father, she's honestly relieved; her life was just that miserable. But, to her dismay, she somehow wakes up as Mabel, the princess of the Ermâneau Empire and beloved daughter of Emperor Estevan. As if that wasn't enough, an oracle proclaimed that Mabel is destined to save the world from doom, causing her father to make her the ruler of the empire on her first birthday.

In order to fight this unwanted fate, Mabel vows to get herself dethroned, though her schemes only earn her a reputation as a genius emperor and growing group of allies. Slowly, she learns to accept the love of her family and friends, and vows to follow her destiny. Can Mabel really protect the world she now cherishes?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Unintentionally Ideal Adopted Daughter
synopsis:
Transmigrating into the main character of your favorite book sounds like a dream come true, but knowing Viola Vellatoux grows to be disappointed in her ending, Arin Han sets out to rewrite the story. However, her adoptive family will not hesitate to assassinate one another in their fight for control. The new Viola needs to use her wits to convince everyone that she has what it takes while remaining true to her goal. Further complicating her schemes, the male lead looks eerily familiar and has a strange effect on her when she gets too close.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Mikazuki March

To escape the stress of city life, high school, and her overbearing mother, Mizuki runs away from home to spend spring break with her aunt. Born under the Star of Darkness, Princess Baekseon always knew she was fated for something big, but it's only after she disguises herself as a boy and leaves the safety of the palace that she begins to see just how big. Malicious old hags, cheerful goblins, lovesick witches, and the promise of a mysterious soulmate with red and blue eyes are just the beginning: ultimately, what hangs in the balance is the fate of the world itself.
