He is a typical poor kid in the Republic of Korea, 21-year-old Sung-jae Kang, who is struggling to make ends meet when he receives his enlistment notice. He has a chance to become a legendary chef in the army by following a "game instruction" that only he can see.

(Source: Manhwa Freak)

title: Golem-san, Kuzuretemasu!
title_japanese: ゴーレムさん、崩れてます!

title: Saikou no Oshi no Mitsukekata
title_japanese: 最高の推しの見つけ方

title: 13-kaime no Ashiato
synopsis:
Following their son Ao's release from the hospital, Touya and Haru were all ready to start a new life with him in their picturesque new home. But that was before the postcards arrived... Each postcard details an event— one that won't happen until the next day. Follow this family on an adventure to unravel the mystery, stopping to help everyone they can along the way.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Marry-Go-Round
synopsis:
The manga centers on Mari Kazama, a man who suffered a major setback as a private tutor. In order to learn important things, he decides to live in a "marriage share house," and work as a teacher. In reality, the people living in the "marriage share house" are people who do not want to get married.

(Source: ANN)

title: Magic Maker: Isekai Mahou no Tsukurikata
title_english: Magic Maker: How to Create Magic in Another World
title_japanese: マジック・メイカー －異世界魔法の作り方－
synopsis:
Little Shion has a secret: he's the reincarnation of a man from another world who died longing for magic! Hoping that he might at last harness the power of magic in this new world, he finds that magic doesn't exist here either. But when Shion visits a lake with his sister, he witnesses a mysterious phenomenon that seems like the magic he yearns for! If magic does not exist, can he make it himself?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Pro Golfer no Ore ga Imouto no Putter ni Tensei shiteshimatta Ken
title_japanese: プロゴルファーの俺が妹のパターに転生してしまった件

title: The Monster Princess
synopsis:
In a mysterious dream, Princess Arbella Leon Camulita discovers a book that tells a story about her future. Princess Judith, a newly recognized royal and the daughter of a slave, takes on the role of the protagonist. She is bullied by her half-siblings until she awakens to her unrivaled magical abilities, eventually reaching a sweet and satisfying ending. On the other hand, Arbella, who was previously thought to be the most powerful magician, descends into madness with envy, and her greed brings about her demise.

Upset by the uncanny resemblances between her dream and reality, Arbella starts to notice her shortcomings and the rotten treatment that Judith receives daily. Determined to cure her own illness—the rare and incurable "magician's fever"—and avoid becoming a monster, Arbella leverages the power she still has as the first princess to both help Judith and escape her own grim fate.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Rikujou Jieitai Tokumu Chouhou Kikan: Beppan no Inu
title_english: Ground Self-Defense Force Special Intelligence Agency: Invisible Force
title_japanese: 陸上自衛隊特務諜報機関 別班の犬
synopsis:
The fate of the nation is in the hands of those who have abandoned the law and their names. In the Special Operations Group, an elite unit of the Ground Self-Defense Force, there was a female member who was tired of spending her days in training. One day, she is ordered by her superior officer to a certain garrison, where she is recruited by a mysterious man to join a unit called "Beppan." She was given the name "Nana." She was then thrown into the front line of a national defense battle colored by numerous schemes and violence.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Oujisama no Tomodachi
synopsis:
An unpopular teen seeks dating help from his handsome childhood friend—who happens to be a girl—in this shounen rom-com manga! But will her hands-on approach to teaching him cause a rush of unexpected feelings?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Oujisama no Tomodachi
synopsis:
An unpopular teen seeks dating help from his handsome childhood friend—who happens to be a girl—in this shounen rom-com manga! But will her hands-on approach to teaching him cause a rush of unexpected feelings?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Atsumare Doubutsu no Mori: Nonbiri Shima Dayori
title_english: Assemble! Animal Crossing: News from the Carefree Island
title_japanese: あつまれどうぶつの森～のんびり島だより～
synopsis:
On vacation with her parents, Hana suddenly spots a peculiar pair of raccoons disappearing into a thick undergrowth! She tails the duo and arrives at a deserted island, with colorful talking animals and plenty of interesting activities to do! Thus begins Hana's carefree life on an island of relaxation!

(Source: Shogakukan Asia)

title: Denounce
synopsis:
Gang-An's dream of designing the best sneaker in the world is snuffed out when her sneaker customization team, Tria, loses the Custom Kicks Championship. She tells herself that she has given up on her dream for good and tries to carry on with her life when she comes across a shocking truth. OnGrey, the second-largest sneaker brand in the world, has stolen her design from the Championship! Will Gang-An be able to return to designing despite her fears and succeed in her fight against OnGrey to reclaim what is rightfully hers?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Share House kara no Dasshutsu
title_japanese: シェアハウスからの脱出

title: Mii-chan wa Kawaretai
title_japanese: みーちゃんは飼われたい
synopsis:
Nice guy grocery manager Iori is stuck in a rut. He's overworked, underappreciated, and still grieving the disappearance of his beloved cat. But one fateful night, after rescuing a stray on his way home, Iori wakes up to a shock: the stray is gone, and in its place is a feisty, naked girl! Pushy, adorable, and oddly familiar, Mii-chan isn't just crashing at Iori's place—she's hiding a big secret. As Mii-chan paws at his heart, Iori's life is about to take a purr-fectly unpredictable turn!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Hatsukoi Jihen
synopsis:
Sana's first boyfriend, Yamato, was not exactly the looker, but he was kind. And that's what Sana loved about him. So when he suddenly dumps her without warning, her heart is left completely shattered. Having lost faith in the world, Sana vows to leave her past self behind, and transforms... into a full-on delinquent!

3 years later, when Sana had all but forgotten how it feels to love, two guys unexpectedly appear in her life. Koichi, the student council president and school celebrity. And... Sana's ex, Yamato?! Sana barely recognizes her ex, who has undergone a complete transformation of his own, becoming a heartthrob teenage actor! With conflicted memories and emotions on the rise, where will our protagonist's innocent heart take her?

(Source: NTT Solmare Corporation)

title: Isekai Rakuraku Survival: Seizon Skill Kyousha no Ore ga Bishoujo Yonin to Kurasu Mujintou Seikatsu
title_japanese: 異世界らくらくサバイバル～生存スキル強者の俺が美少女四人と暮らす無人島生活～

title: Hanjuku Hero
title_english: Hero of Eggs: The World Is Mature

title: I'm Nobody's Shadow
synopsis:
He was the hand of God, the painter of the century. My husband became the best artist in the empire, and I was his shadow. Even when my work became famous under my husband's name, even when people spoke ill of me behind my back, it was still okay—because I loved my husband.

However, on our wedding anniversary. "You are the only person I truly love." I witnessed my husband whispering his love to my best friend. At the very moment when my husband saw me discovering his infidelity, his face contorted viciously, and he pushed me away. "Why are you raising your voice to your husband?!" At that moment, I realized it. I realized that this man had never loved me. Thus, I decided to become the evil wife they spoke of.

(Source: Tiramisu, translated)

title: Douse Suterareru no nara, Saigo ni Suki ni Sasete Itadakimasu
title_english: Before You Discard Me, I Shall Have My Way with You
title_japanese: どうせ捨てられるのなら、最後に好きにさせていただきます
synopsis:
Agnès, the daughter of a duke, is in love with crown prince Lucilleur, the man she's been betrothed to since they were both children. But before they can wed, Agnès is hit with a bombshell: Lucilleur doesn't return her feelings and wants to break their engagement so he can marry his true love, a different noblewoman with a sweet and innocent demeanor. Agnès is more than just heartbroken—she's angry. Her "sweet" rival might not be sweet at all, and her beloved prince has wrecked her future. This means war...both in politics and in bed.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Chinkou Discover
synopsis:
A childhood friend and his ideal penis.

After developing a complex about their androgynous looks and name from a lifetime of being mistaken for a woman, Mari has grown up to be a high school boy who is obsessed with what he views as the epitome of manliness: the dick! His daily quest for the coolest of wieners bears fruit when, with one glance in the bathroom, he finds that his square of a childhood friend, Kengo, has a crotch that is king of the wangs!! Now he's a man on a mission to see it! Touch it!! And taste it!!!

(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)

title: "Issho ni Netain desu yo ne, Senpai?" to Amaku Sasayakarete Konya mo Nemurenai
title_japanese: 「一緒に寝たいんですよね、せんぱい？」と甘くささやかれて今夜も眠れない

title: Last Summer Vacation
title_japanese: ラストサマー・バケーション
synopsis:
Ayumi Umino has always looked up to people like Mizuki Otonashi; even with a terminally ill mother, Mizuki has managed to top their class in both popularity and kindness, to the point of not revealing that Ayumi cut class to drink alcohol. One day, Ayumi is approached by Mizuki's friends and asked to return Mizuki's painting set to her—despite her dark attitude toward the shallow girls, Ayumi accepts as a way to repay Mizuki's kindness.

However, as Ayumi arrives at Mizuki's house after taking a shortcut, she sees something she was never supposed to—Mizuki stepping out of a car, covered in blood and carrying a knife. Ayumi feels death creep near as Mizuki approaches her, but is surprised when she is instead invited inside for tea. She nervously accepts, now a witness to murder and scared for her life, but is curious about this side of Mizuki normally hidden from the public.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kiraware Yuusha wo Enjita Ore wa, Nazeka Last Boss ni Sukarete Issho ni Seikatsu shitemasu!
title_japanese: 嫌われ勇者を演じた俺は、なぜかラスボスに好かれて一緒に生活してます!
synopsis:
Just before the battle against the demon god "Demiurge" that destroys the world, the hero Ares is hated by his friends and is left alone. In fact, it was because he couldn't make his friends to join him in the fight against the last boss who might not make it out alive, so he dared to play the role of the hated one to get them to leave him. Ares, who had to fight Demiurge alone, was supposed to restore to peace in exchange for his life... but somehow he is still alive, and next to him is the Last Boss. Before he knows it, she has fallen in love with him, and Ares begins to live his life trying to save the world!

(Source: Hifumi Shobo)

title: Suki ni Nattara, Owari
title_japanese: 好きになったら、終わり

title: Hikikomori Hime to Dokuzetsu Kishi-sama
title_japanese: 引きこもり姫と毒舌騎士様

title: Yankee ni Koi to Ikuji wa Muzusugiru
title_japanese: ヤンキーに恋と育児はムズすぎる

title: Move, I'm Deciding the Ending!
synopsis:
While working late one night, Kang Hyuna died in a sudden explosion... or so she thought. She wakes up as Belita Olden, the villain in the game she developed, "The Guardian's Garden." Unfortunately for her, this character is destined to die at the end of each route for messing with the heroine, Margaret Averdeen. Determined not to die a second time, Belita decides to go against the game and help Margaret have a happy ending instead. Thus begins her journey for a second chance of her own making!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Otsbell to Zou
synopsis:
Ms. Otsbell has known as a remarkable woman with a smart head and aggressive hands. One day, a working elephant comes to her place wanted to find a job, a moment that would change the fate of Otsbell and the factory forever. Otsbell and the Elephant is adapted from the famous play by Kenji Miyazawa with a new interpretation...

(Source: MediBang)

title: Isekai Kimagure Burari Tabi: Dorei Harem wo Soete
title_japanese: 異世界きまぐれぶらり旅 ～奴隷ハーレムを添えて～
synopsis:
Yohei, the former NEET, is invited by a mysterious existence to be transported to another world. That different world had a game-like worldview with "jobs" and "skills" and many monsters. Meanwhile, Yohei sets a goal. "That's right, let's make a slave harem." This is the story of a troubled man building a slave harem in another world.

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

title: Tenshi Arles no Renai Kaigo-roku
title_japanese: 天使アルルの恋愛介護録

title: Kotei no Himawari
synopsis:
The manga centers on a magazine journalist named Takurou. A place that Takurou used to live in was flooded and became a lake due to a dam being constructed nearby. However, an extended drought period dried up the lake, and Takurou heads to his old, recently-emerged home.

(Source: ANN)

title: Butai Shoujo☆Kageki Revue Starlight: The Live Seiran - Blue Glitter
title_japanese: 舞台 少女☆歌劇 レヴュースタァライト -The LIVE 青嵐- BLUE GLITTER
synopsis:
Faced with the upcoming National High School Drama Championships, the students of Seiran struggle to uncover what it is they lack to seize victory.

(Source: MU)

title: Setsuna no Fuukei
title_english: The Ephemeral Scenes of Setsuna's Journey
synopsis:
After being summoned to another world as the 68th hero, Setsuna Sugimoto is abandoned by that same world due to his sickly constitution. But when he meets Kyle, a millennia-old former hero like him, Setsuna is given a third chance at life—inheriting Kyle's knowledge, power, and even life force. Now able to travel the world as an adventurer, Setsuna will encounter people from all walks of life, with each meeting bound to leave a lasting mark on himself and the world. And so begins a journey full of firsts...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Sekai wa Are de Dekiteiru
title_english: What This World Is Made Of
title_japanese: セカイはアレでデキテイル
synopsis:
No family, no home, and no savings—the Nakata brothers, Kanade and Kaname, have lost it all. So when a mysterious app offers to help them find lucrative work, what choice do they have but to sign up? Introduced to a gamified system of bounties, the two soon come face-to-face with the "odd" in odd jobs—the dangerous creatures they must now fight. But Kanade and Kaname have no choice: To make money, they'll have to take down these monsters called Worlds...or die trying.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Manner of Death
synopsis:
When the skilled coroner Dr. Bunnakit is called to examine the body of his childhood friend after her "suicide," he soon determines that she was actually murdered. That night, a mysterious stranger threatens him, telling him to rule her death a suicide—and after he confides in his prosecutor friend about this incident, his friend suddenly goes missing. But all hope is not lost, as a young lecturer named Tan offers to help him get to the bottom of all this—which would be more reassuring if Tan weren't the prime suspect...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Mata Korosarete Shimatta no desu ne, Tantei-sama
title_japanese: また殺されてしまったのですね、探偵様
synopsis:
Sakuya Otsuki is the son of a legendary detective, working to follow in his father's footsteps with his assistant, Lilithea. However, something's different about this high-school sleuth. Wherever he goes, he always manages to get himself entangled in his cases—as a murder victim! When Sakuya is tasked to infiltrate a luxury cruise ship, he finds himself killed once again. But every time he reopens his eyes, Lilithea is there by his side, ready to help him get to the bottom of the mystery...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Saiminjutsu tte Sugoi!
synopsis: A NEET uses a hypnosis app on his sister.

title: Kimi no Utagoe ni Kiss wo
Yasashii Shinigami no Kaikata the Comic
title_english: My Dog Is a Death God
title_japanese: 優しい死神の飼い方 THE COMIC
synopsis:
God of death, Leo, has been dispatched to Earth on a mission to save human souls, and has found himself at a small hospice called Okanoue Hospital. For this task, he's been granted a special form: one with four legs, a tail, and a keen olfactory sense. Thanks to his canine assets, Leo can seek out patients at the hospice who are plagued by a lifetime of regret. With his wet nose and doggy good looks, little death god Leo eases patients into their next life, setting them free of both the quiet hillside hospital and any lingering doubts.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Haru made no Kyori
synopsis:
Shun is timid and has a habit of giving up easily. That same Shun fell in love with his male classmate. So as not to let the people around him know about his sexuality, he lives his days trying to conceal it. However, the feelings he tried so hard to hide were exposed by the transfer student, Hiroki. At first, the my-paced and insensitive Hiroki did nothing but swing Shun around and confuse him, but he later finds himself gradually starting to be drawn to him.

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

title: Shigoto ga Dekinai Sakaki-kun wa Yoru dake Yuunou
title_japanese: 仕事ができない榊くんは夜だけ有能

title: Suki na Onnanoko ga Watashi ni Nazeka Kibishii
title_japanese: 好きな女の子が私にだけなぜか厳しい
synopsis:
Hina Kamiya fell in love at first sight with Honda, the gorgeous student council president. Through a change of classroom seating, Hina ends up as sitting next to Honda, viewing this as an opportunity for the two to become closer. However, Honda, who is kind to everyone, is rude exclusively with Hina...!?

(Source: Akita Publishing, translated)

title: Hataraku Saibou Muscle
title_japanese: はたらく細胞マッスル

title: Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei: Douran no Joshou-hen
title_japanese: 魔法科高校の劣等生 動乱の序章編
synopsis: The arc follows volumes 21 and 22 of the light novel.

title: Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei: Koritsu-hen
title_japanese: 魔法科高校の劣等生 孤立編
synopsis: The arc follows volume 23 of the light novel.

title: Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei: Escape-hen
title_japanese: 魔法科高校の劣等生 エスケープ編
synopsis: The arc follows volumes 24 and 25 of the light novel.

title: Futari nara Doko e demo
title_japanese: 夫婦〈ふたり〉ならどこへでも

title: The Dark Mage's Return to Enlistment
synopsis:
Minjun Kim, an ordinary high school senior in Korea, was suddenly summoned to another world, where he became a dark mage. Determined to return home, he overcame all sorts of hardships and saved the other world with black magic before leaving all his wealth and glory as a hero behind to return to Earth. However, before he could fully enjoy his life, a problem arose. A dungeon break had occured and monsters came pouring out, threatening his comfortable days. Therefore, Minjun, who had just returned to earth, had no choice but to... enlist on the very next day!!!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Kyokutou Chimeratica
synopsis:
"Chimeras," creatures that can steal and use the form of any creature except humans. Pursuing these creatures are "Hunters," and one of them, Yuuri, lives a free-wheeling life. But when she encounters a human-shaped Chimera, something "mysterious" takes rest within her. These hunters' spear skills will charm you! A super-beast hunting action story!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Shousetsu Cool Doji Danshi: Connect It Cool, Guys
title_japanese: 小説 クールドジ男子 Connect It Cool, Guys
synopsis: Well-known mishaps and new encounters await Hayate, Shun, Takayuki and Soma in their colorful everyday life. Moments that are deeply embarrassing to some bear unexpected insights for others.

title: Nemu-chan no Sei de Nemurenai!
title_japanese: ネムちゃんのせいで眠れないっ！
synopsis:
Souta is a second grade student. One day at night, Nemu, who calls herself a succubus, appears at his window. This is the beginning of a comedy between a clumsy succubus and an elementary school student.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Champion's Path to Murim
synopsis:
Champion Sanghyuk Kim, a living legend in the realm of mixed martial arts known as "Mister Perfect," was somehow reborn in the Murim world as the youngest son of Hojang Keum!

"This time, I'll forge a new legend in the Murim!"

Against the backdrop of martial artists and untrained fighters scattered around Murim comes an oddity trained in Boxing, Taekwondo, Muay Thai, Wrestling, Jujitsu, Capoeira, Judo, and a variety of modern martial arts, ready to shake up the Murim!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Tenka Musou no Otometachi ga Ore no Kodane wo Ubaiatteimasu!!!!!
title_japanese: 天下無双の乙女たちが俺の子種を奪い合っています!!!!!

title: Eitapa Neach Concerto
title_japanese: エイタパ・ニーチ協奏曲〈コンチェルト〉

title: Kingyoya-san no Karisome Fuufu
title_japanese: 金魚屋さんのかりそめ夫婦
synopsis:
The story of a contract marriage set in an old-fashioned goldfish shop. The story begins when Asahi comes to Shichi, who has taken over his grandmother's goldfish shop, and asks him, "It may sound rude to say this the first time we meet, but will you marry me?"

(Source: MU)

title: Dahae Dream
synopsis:
My freaky imagination about a man turns into his dream?! So, now... should I begin playing with lots of men?

"Be careful. You'll be dreaming of me tonight."

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special
title_english: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special
synopsis:
In the Shadow World, daily life is filled with chaos and catastrophe.

Commoner magician Desir Herrman uses his prodigal skills to enter the Shadow Labyrinth—the peak of the Shadow World. But when his party fails to clear the Labyrinth, humanity falls into demise.

This should mean death for Desir, yet he finds himself sent back in time to when he was a boy attending the Hebrion Academy. This is his second chance.

Can Desir hone his skills as a magician so he can save humanity the second time around?

(Source: Radish Media)

title: Sekkyaku Musou
synopsis:
In a shopping district of closed shutters and turned keys, Ajimaru, a lone Chinese restaurant, bravely faces its impending closure. Everything changes when they serve up a free meal to the starving Nasunosuke, wandering waiter extraordinaire, who might be just what they need to spice up their shop!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: The Maxed-out Player
synopsis:
After 20 grueling years of hellish training, Juhyuk's stats are maxed-out, and he is ready to venture out into Olympus, a virtual reality game. His master's last dying wish is for Juhyuk to be the Ultimate Evil, the most powerful in Olympus. But when he steps out of the tutorial area, every player tries to kill him, and the game forces him to start over from Level 1! With these setbacks, Juhyuk will need all the help he can get to complete his SSS-rank quest and become the next Ultimate Evil.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Marking Omega
synopsis:
Tori Yoshida is a "flawed" omega. Unlike other omegas, he has a unique constitution—he doesn't go into heat, ever since puberty, and can't smell or feel alpha pheromones. While this may be a setback for normal omegas, it's his saving grace that landed him his job as a teacher in a world where omegas are at a disadvantage. Everything is well until he meets the new teacher, Kei Hidaka, a supposedly beta. Things happen, and as it turns out, Kei is actually an alpha, and it seems he triggered Tori's first-ever heat. Now the two have to keep each other's secret from the whole school while maintaining a purely physical relationship. That's all it was, right?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Otogi no Hako no Reto
synopsis:
Clad in a blood-soaked coat and with no destination in mind, a young boy named Reto wanders into an Ainu village amidst a blizzard, whose residents provide him with much-needed shelter. All he has are two things: the memory of his mother dying before his eyes, and an ancient hunting knife without a blade...

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Zenbu Kowashite Jigoku de Aishite
title_japanese: ぜんぶ壊して地獄で愛して
synopsis:
Kurumi Yoshizawa is the student council president, with excellent grades and good manners... but in reality, she is spending her days struggling with the constraints of her mother and the excessive expectations of her teachers. One day, Yoshizawa is asked by her homeroom teacher to look after her absentee classmate Naoi, but Naoi could only look down on Yoshizawa as if she had been able to see through her heart. On the verge of breaking down from stress, Yoshizawa just barely suppresses the sudden urge to shoplift, but Naoi records the whole thing...

This is a violent coming-of-age story about two people struggling in everyday life with no escape.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Hijiri-kun wa Kiyoku Ikitai
title_japanese: 聖くんは清く生きたい
synopsis:
Hijiri Tsuchimikado is a man playing the role of the perfect student council president, with his good looks and excellent grades in both school and sports. After school, he witnesses his usually quiet female classmate Mitsuki Sado, tormenting their teacher Tamura in a very sadistic way! The perfect student council president gets caught up in Sado-san's secret fetish!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Included one-shot:
Volume 5: Barairo no Hishatai

title: Kyou wa Shinu noni Mottekoi no Hi
title_english: It Is a Good Day to Die
title_japanese: 今日は死ぬのにもってこいの日
synopsis:
It was supposed to be a memorable and exciting vacation with his girlfriend and 4 of his close college friends. Shouichi just wanted to have fun and learn the meaning of what it means to be "manly." Once they got to the hotel, the fun and drinking began. During the late hours of the night, they hear the scream of a woman coming from the parking lot. Next thing they know, Shouichi's friend "Ken" is nailed to the ceiling with his face completely punctured. The remaining people from this young group will need to figure out how to survive against this alien organism.

(Source: MangaHelpers)

title: Home Drama shika Shiranai
title_japanese: ホームドラマしか知らない
synopsis:
The sixth-grader Reo has to be mature for his age because of his divorced parents. When his father decided to remarry, Reo was sent away to live with his estranged mother who had remarried, too. It turns out the only one who could actually take him in is Reo's older step-brother who he had never met. This will make for an awkward family life?

(Source: MU)

title: Uma Musume: Pretty Derby - Star Blossom
title_japanese: ウマ娘 プリティーダービー スターブロッサム
synopsis: A new legend begins with the indomitable horse girl Sakura Laurel as the main character.

title: Uma Musume: Pretty Derby - Star Blossom
title_japanese: ウマ娘 プリティーダービー スターブロッサム
synopsis: A new legend begins with the indomitable horse girl Sakura Laurel as the main character.

title: Summer of Us
synopsis:
Jia was always a nice-mannered girl, but that didn't stop her from yelling at the cool and distant Jaehee in high school. Now 9 years later, Jaehee wants to spend more time with his first love. Jia knows to look past his games—but does she really want to, when he's become such a catch?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Afterlife Diner
synopsis:
"I was given a building as an inheritance?"

From a nobody who does all kinds of odd jobs and lived a hard life, I was given a chance to become a landlord right in the middle of Gangnam! But, the condition for this inheritance is to "operate a restaurant for 5 years." Moreover, I can sense a chill down my spine thanks to the weird customers that came in for today's store opening... Do I really just need to prepare food?

"So then...all the guests who came in yesterday..."

"They were ghosts."

Every night starting from 11 o' clock until 1 o'clock, we will now be open!

(Source: Epyrus, translated)

title: Aru Hi no Eri to Ani
Shika no Ou: Minasoko no Hashi
synopsis:
The threat of a Black Wolf Fever epidemic has passed, but the Zolian Empire has been plunged into a struggle for succession. At the invitation of the priest-doctor Mana, Hohsalle and Milalle travel to the place where the healing arts of the Pure Heart Creed originated. While there, they not only uncover the surprising history of Zolian medicine, but inadvertently become embroiled in the dispute for the imperial throne.

(Source: Official Website Nahoko Uehashi)

title: Bokura no Haru wa Inazuma no You ni
title_english: A Lightning Attack to My Heart
title_japanese: 僕らの春は稲妻のように

title: Hikari no Ou Gaiden: No no Hibi
title_japanese: 火狩りの王〈外伝〉 野ノ日々
synopsis: Hikari no Ou side stories.

title: All I Want Is You
synopsis:
With the death of his grandfather, Jihoo stands to inherit his company—and a massive amount of wealth. There's just one catch: he must spend a year with "the person he loves." But for Jihoo, that's complicated. Not only did that person, Eun-yul, leave him five years ago, but now she has a kid! Can Jihoo push through years of hard feelings and awkwardness to win her back? Is he really just doing it for the company?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Honey Honey Wedding
synopsis:
High school student Shin Hae Soo is suddenly getting married?! Her partner is her sharp tongued teach, Choi Hyuk Jun? The sweet love story after an arranged marriage of Hae Soo and Hyuk Jun, a clumsy couple with a 12 year age gap.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Shinitagari da ga Hara wa Naru
title_japanese: 死にたがりだが腹は鳴る
synopsis:
Ayumu Saijou is a high school girl at a loss over how to live her life, having been raised in a wealthy household with heavy expectations placed upon her shoulders by her strict father.

A small misunderstanding leads to trouble with friends and a reprimand from her father, driving Ayumu further into a corner. Wandering around seeking a place where she can be herself, she stops by a small shed standing in a corner of a park. In that place where she thought nobody was around, she caught sight of something...?

The story of a girl who can't live her own life and a young boy who can break her curse begins now.

(Source: Kobunsha, translated)

title: Tachibana-kun Daite Kudasai!: Hajimete no Aite wa Douryou Ouji!?
title_english: Please Sleep With Me, Tachibana!: My First Sexual Partner Is My Hot Coworker?!
title_japanese: 橘くん 抱いてください! ハジメテの相手は同僚王子!?
synopsis:
"I want to have s-sex with you...!" 

Office worker Sumire has been around girls all her life, and thus, is bad at talking to guys. This is why she's never had a boyfriend! But she wants to experience something at least once... and that something is sex! That may be a tall order for a woman who can't talk to men. However, there's one male coworker that Sumire feels comfortable talking with. When she asks him to have sex with her, he agrees! But on one condition... The popular hottie in the office, Tachibana; Sumire, the beautiful woman who's a virgin that can't get a man.

(Source: Bunkasha)

title: Imouto no Oppai ga Gokuiku sugiru!?
title_japanese: 妹のおっぱいが極育すぎる!?
synopsis:
1. Souieba Kono Natsu wa Atsukatta
2. Tokutei Gairai Kiken Seibutsu
3. Ameagari wa Kinembi♥
4. Harukaze Fuitara
5. Minamin Kuru na Isaa
6. Yoshuu Fukushuu Ganbarimasu!
7. Senpai
8. Toc x Toc PiQE-NiQUE
9. Shippo no Kimochi: 2-chupai
10. Over Take Over

title: Gachikoi Maou-sama
synopsis:
If I destroy the human race—then will you stay with me?

A hero took on the task of defeating the Demon Lord for the sake of world peace. When he arrived at the Demon Lord's castle, he was greeted by the Demon Lord herself with a marriage certificate ready to go! The hero was puzzled by the Demon King's strong desire for him. A love comedy about the world's survival between a stubbornly in-love Demon Lord and a tsundere hero!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kore Kaite Shine
synopsis:
Ai Yasumi, a first-year high schooler living on the remote island of Izu Ōshima, has one obsession: manga. When she discovers that her long-idolized but reclusive favorite manga creator, Yasuno-sensei, will make a rare appearance at Comitia, Ai doesn't hesitate—she has to meet her hero. But that single decision sets off a chain of encounters that will shatter her assumptions about art, genius, and what it truly means to create.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Sodacchau zo♥
synopsis:
1. Kyou kara Especially Niece
2. Itai no Itai no Tondeke... tte?
3. Shougakusei Bonyuu Momoka♥Milk
4. Futari no Sketchbook
5. Himesama Zoom In
6. Ouchi e Oide: Pajama no Hi
7-10. Glass ni Kaita Hoshi no Chizu

title: 7-nin no Nemurihime
synopsis:
In the enchanting Kingdom of Amaryllis, a wandering prince embarks on a noble quest to break an ancient curse that bewitched the land. His mission: to awaken the princess with a true love's kiss. There's just one tiny detail no one warned him about—there are seven princesses to kiss! Undeterred, he takes up the challenge and finds himself living amongst them to unravel the mystery behind the kingdom's slumbering state. Will they all eventually find their happily ever after?

(Source: MU)

title: Seibetsu Fumei na Chuusei Bokukko to Oneesan
title_japanese: 性別不明な中性僕っ子とお姉さん
synopsis:
Hinako, a 26-year old office worker, is confused by Itsuki's, her neighbor, gender, whom she thought was a boy when they were a child. Hinako spends her daily life surprised by Itsuki's casual gestures. However, it is actually Itsuki's heart who is pounding the most, having unrequited feelings for Hinako.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Botsuraku Reijou no Ikoku Kekkonroku
title_japanese: 没落令嬢の異国結婚録
synopsis:
"Starting today, you are my wife." 

To pay off the debt of her once-wealthy family, the beautiful Leyfa is sold off as "a rare item that will bring prosperity" and taken to a distant empire. There she met the handsome, but sickly head of the family, Shin Yu. Living the imperial life and suddenly married to a cool, mysterious husband, Leyfa uses her cooking prowess to become the "ideal married couple"! 

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Osoto Gohan wo Goissho ni
title_english: Please Join Us for Osoto Gohan
title_japanese: おそとごはんをご一緒に

title: Kono Naka ni Hitori, Ore no Yome ga Iru
title_english: One of Them Is My Wife
title_japanese: この中に1人、俺の嫁がいる

title: Descent of the Demon Master
synopsis:
He had always wished to live a new, ordinary life. That was his one and only wish. But the world did not allow him to. 'I wanted to live ordinarily, but you're the ones who provoked me first!' Who was the one who provoked the sleeping lion first? It's now time to witness the great Demon Master's reproval of the modern times!

(Source: Wuxiaworld)

title: Karina's Last Days
synopsis:
Though gifted with an ability to bring her drawings to life, Karina Leopold spent her years in the shadow of her famous siblings, forced to be the good daughter her parents wanted. But when she's told that a deadly disease will kill her in a year, she offers a deal to her fiancé, Milian Pastellio, with the goal to live the remainder of her days far from her family's reach. Much to her surprise, their encounter proceeds to change them both in a way she never imagined...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: There Must Be Happy Endings
synopsis:
Yeonu and Seonjae seem like a happily married couple, but in reality, their joyful newlywed home is colder than a blizzard. Sleeping on opposite sides of the house, Yeonu is counting the days until she's free from their two-year marriage contract. But when the day of their divorce finally arrives, Yeonu has no time to savor her freedom—because Seonjae is killed in a freak accident right before her eyes. Shocked to her core, Yeonu now regrets the time they wasted being cold and distant toward each other. In a strange twist of fate, the universe turns back the clock and gives her a chance to make things right. Yeonu wakes up to find Seonjae alive and well on the other side of her door. She can't let him die, but the only way to save him is to get him to love her. Can Yeonju save Seonjae—and their marriage—and change their tragic fate into a happy ending?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Isekai Yuusha Mizuki
synopsis: The story of a completely ordinary girl who gets summoned into another world to become its hero.

title: My Bad Younger Man
synopsis:
When Sol receives an engagement party invitation from Minji, the girl who stole her first love, she's determined to attend just to prove how great she's doing. But she needs to find a hot boyfriend first, when her dating life's been nonexistent! The only viable candidate she can find is her younger brother's friend, Joohyuk, who has had a major glow-up since his scrawny teenage years. "I'm not a little kid anymore. You'd better watch out." The tall, sexy Joohyuk seems like trouble...but desperate times call for desperate measures. As long as she can see Minji's jaw drop in shock, Sol is willing to put up with his demands. Little does she know that Joohyuk is actually out to get her for ruining his life in high school! Will Sol be able to make this rocky partnership work in her favor, or will the plan backfire on her?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Lend Me Some Sugar
synopsis:
After flunking the civil service exam, Kim Youngsoo spends his days working part-time at a pork cutlet restaurant, struggling to make ends meet. He plans to give the exam another shot down the line, but for now, his small moments of happiness in his mundane life come from treating the cute guy who drops by the restaurant to pork cutlets every now and again. Amidst the routine of his simple and peaceful life, an unexpected disruption arrives in the form of his neighbor, Lim Joongdo: a rude and conceited jerk who hurls insults at Youngsoo from the moment they meet. Frustrated and disheartened, Youngsoo chooses to just ignore Joongdo completely. But then...out of the blue, Joongdo does a complete 180 and starts acting all sugary and sweet. Did Joongdo genuinely have a change of heart, or is he sugarcoating his words to hide a bitter motive?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: San Ti
synopsis:
Set against the backdrop of China's Cultural Revolution, a secret military project sends signals into space to establish contact with aliens. An alien civilization on the brink of destruction captures the signal and plans to invade Earth. Meanwhile, on Earth, different camps start forming, planning to either welcome the superior beings and help them take over a world seen as corrupt, or to fight against the invasion. The result is a science fiction masterpiece of enormous scope and vision.

(Source: Tor Books)

title: Ane no Tomodachi
title_english: The Cutest Girl Closest to Me.
synopsis:
His sister's best friend, Hi-chan, wanders into the house where he and his sister live. Asahi, a nerdy high school boy, is left at the mercy of her perfect face, cuteness, and her abnormal sense of distance...?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: 86: Mahou Shoujo Regina☆Lena - Tatakae! Ginga Koukou Senkan San Magnolia
title_japanese: 86―エイティシックス― 魔法少女レジーナ☆レーナ ～戦え!銀河航行戦艦サンマグノリア～
synopsis:
A new 86 series spin-off set on the stage of the "Galactic Navigating Battleship San Magnolia"! To protect that ship and its people from their enemy, an army known as the Legion, the Handlers (Magical Girls) along with their partners the Eighty-Six (Guardian Spirits) run through the cosmos!

And so, the battle of the Magical Girl Lena is about to begin...!

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Watashi yori Tsuyoi Otoko to Kekkon shitai no: Seiso na Bijin Seito Kaichou (Jitsu wa Moto Banchou) no Himitsu wo Shiru Inkya (Jitsu wa Kanojo wo Koeru Saikyou no Yankee)
title_japanese: 私より強い男と結婚したいの 清楚な美人生徒会長（実は元番長）の秘密を知る陰キャ（実は彼女を超える最強のヤンキー）
synopsis:
Akira Kogure, an introverted loner high school student, befriends the student council president Shizuka Takasaki, who excels in both academics and athletics and is blessed with beautiful looks from birth. Though their relationship may seem to be normal, both are keeping a secret that they can't reveal to anyone?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Hyakunengo no Apollo: Fukuta Seira Sakuhinshuu
title_english: Seira Fukuta Collection of Works: "Apollo after 100 Years"
title_japanese: 百年後のアポロ 福田星良作品集
synopsis:
1. Shitsuji wa Amaimono ga Osuki (Butler Likes Sweet Things)
2. Blue Sugar Moon
3. Kingyo no Osushi (Call My Name "Osushi")
4. Sleeping Beauty
5. Ane Omoi
6. Tenkousei Uyama (Welcome! New Boy)
7. Bocchan (Young Master)
8. Hotel Raingrad
9. Hyakunengo no Apollo (Apollo after 100 Years)

title: Hachiouji Meibutsu: Tengu no Koi
title_japanese: 八王子名物 天狗の恋
synopsis:
Can a determined tengu bride change a lonesome bachelor's ways? Well, it's not like he's got much of a choice— 'cos she's already moving in! Young systems engineer Kotarou has had to make his own way in life. Nothing remains of his early childhood before he was orphaned—nothing except his grandparents' antique house in Hachioji and memories of Hime, the winged spirit girl he's come to dismiss as a youthful flight of fancy. But after his return to Hachioji and reunion with Hime, it becomes impossible to deny the existence of his fine, feathery friend—especially given that she's declared they're getting married at second sight!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Kamisama ga Koi wo Shiro to Itteiru!
title_japanese: 神様が恋をしろと言っている!
synopsis:
Chiyoko, in her second year of high school, transfers to a co-ed school due to her dad's job transfer. Since she's only attended an all-girls school since junior high, she excitedly plans to fall in love in her new school. Out of the blue, she begins to see the love meters of 5 hotties and an options window as if she were in an otome game?! She encounters various types such as a glasses boy, a playboy underclassman, and a mysterious senior. This is the beginning of a real otome game school life!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: The Princess After the Revolution
synopsis:
When Cheong-Ha Lee managed to score a stable job, it seemed she had finally gotten over the trauma of her past life as the young princess of Eophilt. That is until she walks into her new office to find her former knight standing next to the ex-lover who executed her... or, at least, they look like them. She resolves herself to put her memories behind her and adjust to working side-by-side with the living ghosts of her past. But, she realizes she's not the only one who remembers who they all used to be. Things only grow more complicated as office crushes are revealed, new members of the Kingdom of Eophilt appear around Seoul, and hiding their connection starts to bring up suspicions at work. Will Cheong-ha finally be freed from the mysteries of her past to live her best life in the present?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Haunted by Desire
synopsis:
Seong-jae Jo has a secret: he's been spending passionate nights with a ghost that looks like Dohui Hong, the man he's in love with. Plagued every night by his yearning and the unrelenting ghost, Seong-jae's health steadily worsens. Concerned for his ailing friend, Dohui offers to help Seong-jae escape his nightmares. It's a feat no ordinary man could accomplish, but Dohui is no ordinary man. See, Dohui has a secret, too. It just might be the key to saving Seong-jae...or to destroying them both.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: 8-gatsu 31-nichi no Long Summer
synopsis:
Two high schoolers, Suzuki-kun and Takagi-san, met in a time loop on August 31st. They are the only ones who can retain their memories when the day repeats itself. A possible cause of the time loop is Suzuki-kun's unfinished business for the summer, a guy's greatest objective... A time loop comedy of youth that tackles love head-on!

(Source: Kodansha)

title: The Resourceful Little Consort
synopsis:
In the nation of Seora, Yehwa Aryun is the Empress Regnant, and her court is full of consorts with special powers. The newest member of the imperial court is 8-year-old Sanya Yeoran. And although she has no powers, Sanya actually has the mind of an adult who knows exactly what will happen in this fantasy world, because she already read about it in her past life. Thanks to that, she comes up with a plan to avoid her tragic execution: stay away from Yehwa and her jealous consorts at all costs!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Love and Peace
title_japanese: らぶ あんど ぴーす
synopsis:
Mamoru Kouda, a high school boy, is the secretary of the student council in a school attended mostly by women. Despite his menacing expression, he has a weak presence and a peculiar ability only his childhood friends know of. Wishing for a peaceful school experience, he uses his ability to resolve disputes and misunderstandings between girls, protecting the precious GL within the school.

This is the story of a stealthy high school boy, who protects the hallowed halls filled with blooming yuri love.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Uma Musume Pretty Derby: Umamusu Meshi
title_japanese: ウマ娘 プリティーダービー うまむすめし

title: Banana Scandal
synopsis:
Studying abroad in the US, Dojin has experienced his fair share of unexpected surprises. New schools, new people, new roommates. However, of all the surprises, Dojin never expected to catch his roommate's handsome younger brother, Taehee, jerking off to him in his sleep?! That's when the scandal began...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Confessions of the Night
synopsis:
Enoch is a priest that has lost the love of his life. One day, he comes across a familiar face in the church where he preaches. The man, also called Ray like his beloved, pursues him posing as his late lover and Enoch decides to go along with his ruse. Will Enoch be able to resist temptation? Or will he end up making a pact with the devil?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Savage World
synopsis:
For the past three years Kijin Lee has lived as a secretary to Director Jinheon Joo of Xitec Trading with little to no personality or will of her own—even a haircut required his permission. With sales at Xitec Group plummeting, she's been transferred to assist the CEO, who happens to be the cousin of Director Joo. Her first day is cut short after an intoxicated Kanghyun Joo—dressed in sweatpants and sneakers—throws a drink at her. Her job depends on her ability to help him and Xitec Group, but this unruly CEO may prove to be her greatest challenge yet.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Jingai Kyoushitsu no Ningengirai Kyoushi
title_english: A Misanthrope Teaches a Class for Demi-Humans
title_japanese: 人外教室の人間嫌い教師
synopsis:
I'm Rei Hitoma, a self-professed misanthrope thanks to some past trauma. Just when I thought my new teaching job in the mountains would provide a chill, rejuvenating environment, it turns out that this school is actually for demi-humans who want to become full-fledged human beings! There's a mermaid, a werewolf, a rabbit, and a bird...all of whom are now my charges. It's my duty to teach them about humankind—and maybe in the process, I'll learn a few things myself. This isn't an alternate world or a case of reincarnation. It's just the story of a teacher at a somewhat peculiar school, and his students who are striving to become human.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Chotto Shakai Futekigousha-san
title_japanese: ちょっと社会不適合者さん

title: Touch Your Heart
synopsis:
Beautiful actress Jinsim Oh is entangled in a drug scandal that damages her career. When an opportunity to play a leading lady comes up, she can't believe her luck. But there's one condition: she must train to work as a secretary for the cold-hearted Jungrok. And her boss is definitely not happy with her.

Jungrok is an arrogant jerk. Can Jinsim keep her job and capture his heart?

(Source: Radish Media)

title: My Farm by the Palace
synopsis:
When Hazel Mayfield is sent to live with the Martins as a child, she falls in love with rural life and vows to have a farm of her own one day. Eleven years later, she receives an unexpected windfall as her grandfather hands her the deed to a plot of land in the middle of the capital. Ecstatic, Hazel sets out to realize her longtime dream of becoming a farmer. There's only one problem: Her new farm is right next to the imperial palace! And it seems the emperor himself has his eye on her land...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Iratsuku Suhada
title_english: Your Skin Is Tinged Red as If Burning with Heat
synopsis:
The moment I saw that milky-white skin of his turn red all over with heat, I couldn't help myself—I was absolutely incensed. This is a story about a regular-old hard-worker and a good-for-nothing genius and the hot college summer these polar opposites spend together. Seto's a first year in college and the ace of the beach volleyball team. He's hard on himself and everyone around him. The new guy, Umimoto, just can't help but pick a fight with him. They end up in a beach volleyball face-off. Umimoto doesn't practice—that's clear from how pale his skin is. Seto's sure he's got this one in the bag. But Umimoto's agility and grace absolutely beguile. Umimoto started the match with a promise: "If I lose, I'll give you head!" After the match, Seto hits the showers...what happens when Umimoto follows him in?

(Source: Futabasha)

title: A Monstrous First Day
synopsis:
Secretary Seungmoon Han ran for office with no hope of winning, but when his opponent's unexpected arrest makes him the victor, he winds up as the youngest assemblyman in South Korea. As he's being sworn into office, he thinks his life couldn't get any better... but that all comes crashing when a monster falls through the roof of the National Assembly! Now, with an eerie blue gate unleashing horrors onto the city, Seungmoon and his party members must find a way to save Seoul from destruction.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Akujiki Reijou to Kyouketsu Koushaku: Sono Mamono, Watashi ga Oishiku Itadakimasu!
title_japanese: 悪食令嬢と狂血公爵 ～その魔物、私が美味しくいただきます!～
synopsis:
Like any proper noble lady, one must have certain acquired tastes. For Melphiera Marchalrayd, she just happens to crave a rather exotic protein—monsters! But do not judge! Despite its bad reputation, monster meat can be used in exquisite cuisine and Melphiera is determined to change the kingdom's opinion of it! Unfortunately, since debuting in society, Melphiera has been struggling to find her perfect match...until she meets the fearless "Blood-Mad Duke" of Galbraith!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Naisho no Ofutari-sama.
title_japanese: ないしょのおふたりさま。
synopsis:
Is it wrong to think about eating food all day...?

Eliza, a young lady who is only interested in food, is brought a delicious gift by a delinquent named Misaki. She's scary... but she can't resist the allure of good food!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Naisho no Ofutari-sama.
title_japanese: ないしょのおふたりさま。
synopsis:

Eliza, a young lady who is only interested in food, is brought a delicious gift by a delinquent named Misaki. She's scary... but she can't resist the allure of good food!
