title: Ashita mo Mata Yuusha no Tonari
title_japanese: 明日もまた勇者のとなり

title: Ashita mo Mata Yuusha no Tonari
title_japanese: 明日もまた勇者のとなり

title: Sanbante Heroine no Sonogo
title_japanese: 三番手ヒロインのその後
synopsis:
"I lost. I can't be his girlfriend (heroine)."

Liara Natsuki, a bold, sexy, and curvaceous third-year high school girl, is widely acknowledged as "the third-best girl at school," but she is rejected by Kazuki Shikimura, the boy she has a crush on. When Kazuki's younger brother, Senri Shikimura, tries to console her, Liara jokingly says, "Maybe I should just go out with you instead." She is surprised when Senri agrees and confesses to her, "I've always loved you, Natsuki-san..."?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Itoko no Oneechan ni wa Natsukanai!
title_japanese: いとこのお姉ちゃんには懐かない！
synopsis:
In order to be accepted at a school with high academic standards, Masato has to take lessons from his "big sister" cousin who is too sexy for him! Can he overcome her temptation and concentrate on his studies? The heart-pounding study session begins!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: The Baengri Clan's Unwanted Granddaughter
synopsis:
Yeon was just an orphan on the streets when a man claiming to be her father brought her to his family home. But the Baengri estate was a den of vipers that swallowed her whole, and it's only when she's standing at the funeral of the father she never truly understood that she realizes how familiar this story is. When she wakes up six years old again, Yeon knows she can't waste her second chance. This time, she's going to save her father. This time, she's going to live without regrets.

(Source: Radish Media)

title: Pension Life Vampire
title_japanese: ペンションライフ・ヴァンパイア
synopsis:
Vampires and werewolves... One day, Eri, a "revision officer" who hunts down things that are said to resent mankind, wanders into a pension run by a mysterious girl. The encounter between a girl whose existence was denied and a legendary vampire. She won't change the world, but she can become kind. A heartwarming house administration comedy begins now!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Bokura wa "Yomi" wo Machigaeru
title_japanese: 僕らは『読み』を間違える
synopsis:
Students are always searching for answers to things they don't understand. Answers to tomorrow's test, reputation in class, that girl you like, who you like—those sorts of things.

I, Yuuma Takehisa, was also facing a certain question: about "I like you" written on the eraser. I was convinced that I was in love with Miyabi Wakamiya, the literary girl of my dreams, but that love ended in a crushed ball. In other words, was it someone else?

In the spring when I entered high school, this "misunderstanding" begins to change. The right time and place, Sena Munakata, a girl who radiates like the sun, picks up little mysteries at the school. They are "mysteries" involving several love stories.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Love Live! Superstar!! Chii-chan Buchou wa Yuunou desu!
title_japanese: ラブライブ! スーパースター!! ちぃちゃん部長は有能です!
synopsis:
Chisato Arashi is the president of Yuigaoka Girl's High School Idol Club. They are working hard to win the Love Live! competition. Singing, dancing and performing on stage... Liella! is still in a lot of trouble!

"No problem, I, Chisato Arashi, will take care of everything!"

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: 2nd Virgin no Jouzu na Sutekata
title_japanese: 2ndバージンのじょうずな捨て方
synopsis:
Chiaki ended up being called a dead fish after his first time having sex with his boyfriend didn't go so well. Afterward, he ended up drunkenly calling a gay AV company to apply as a gay actor, and the perfect guy he meets there is...?!

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

title: Katakoi Seesaw
synopsis:
Issei moves to the city for college and is reunited with his childhood friend, Chihiro. Although Issei had avoided him for some reason in high school, the feelings of wanting to be special to Chihiro remains, and so he starts to entice him! However, he seems to be having some problems...? 

A seesaw love between two childhood friends that begins with a reunion!

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

title: Hanaregatai Kemono
synopsis:
"Dilya, let's become family."

Dilya, a mercenary who does not know anything about family or love, spends a night with the king of the Golden Wolf Clan, the enemy kingdom. Although he is supposed to assassinate the king, he instead receives so much love that he finds it hard to leave the other man's side. Six years later, as he's raising the king's child in secret, the envoy of the king's younger brother, Yudha, suddenly comes.

"I have never been loved, so I don't know how to love." This is when Dilya's lonely life begins to change!

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Ookami-kun no Hazukashii
title_japanese: オオカミくんのはずかしい
synopsis:
Rentarou, who had been living as a lowly yakuza, came to a rural town to make a fresh start in life after the dissolution of his gang. There, he meets an unusual wild boy named Gin. Perhaps it was a bad idea for him to use the habits he had gained during his yakuza days to turn the tables on him, but from then on, he is being followed around by him. Although he is overwhelmed by his outlandish behavior, Rentarou has taken a liking to him because of his straightforward feelings. Then comes a day when he hears about Gin's shocking upbringing...

A dramatic love story between an ex-yakuza and a wild college student!

(Source: Cosmic Shuppan, translated)

title: Rankou de Wakarou!
synopsis:
1. Minna to Tagai ni Wakarou!: Rankou de Kangeikai!
2. Minna no Karada wo Motto Wakarou!: Shintai Sokutei!
3. Oya tomo Tanoshimou!: Dairankou Bunkasai!
4. Wakare no Toki koso Atsuku!: Dairankou Sotsugyoushiki!
5. Live! "Soto de Shiyou! Pakopako Densha Namabangumi"
6. Ishikawa Gakuen no Omoide, Pakopako Album

title: Tou no Shotou no Itoori Otome: Tensei Cheat wa Nai kedo Shishuu Mahou de Slow Life shimasu!
title_japanese: 塔の諸島の糸織り乙女 ～転生チートはないけど刺繍魔法でスローライフします!～
synopsis:
Susana, a girl born in a tailor's family, recalled her memories of her previous life one day when she six years old. The story of Susana, a girl who struggles to live a peaceful life in a place called "Tower Islands," where sorcerers live, begins in comic form!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Mama Gomen, Watashi Corona-ka ni Host Kayotteru.
title_japanese: ママごめん、私コロナ禍にホスト通ってる。

title: Tokyo: Shiki
synopsis:
"As for the tutoring fee, you can pay me with sex."

Kyouhei Saotome, a student, runs into Yuito Jinguuji, a classmate of his—who got into the university he had failed to get into—with the highest score. Born into a strict family where everyone is accomplished, Kyouhei was raised to become a model student, but he finds himself backed into a corner after facing his first setback: namely, failing to get admitted into university. Jinguuji approaches Kyouhei offering to become his private tutor in exchange for sex. Although he dislikes it, Kyouhei gets completely caught up in Jinguuji's sadistic acts as he grows extremely obsessed with Kyouhei...

(Source: Taiyo Tosho, translated)

title: Holesome Romance
synopsis:
Jung Hyun-ho is an average office worker who is infatuated with his team leader, Seo Doha, also known as Mr. Seo. Despite confessing his love, Mr. Seo remains strictly professional and pays no attention to Hyun-ho's romantic advances. Frustrated and unable to resist his feelings, Hyun-ho purchases a unique adult toy with intriguing instructions. Filled with a mix of excitement and guilt, he begins to indulge in his fantasies, imagining what it would be like to be intimate with his boss. However, at that very moment, a peculiar and unexpected event unfolds, causing a ripple effect on both Hyun-ho and Mr. Seo's lives in ways they could never have imagined.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Wavering Worlds
synopsis:
Eunsae is an ordinary student who happens to meet her alternate self in her dream one day. Eun-i and Sae-i are both Eunsae, just from parallel universes! After a year of regularly meeting up in their dreams, Eun-i makes a tempting offer: to switch places and jump into each other's universes for a week. Sae-i, having been envious of Eun-i's perfect life, decides to accept the offer. However, Eun-i is nowhere to be seen when the promised week is over. Will Sae-i be able to keep pretending that she's Eun-i until she can return to her own world?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: A Handsome Swordsman
synopsis:
Moosung is an inn server with a huge crush on Soyeon, a beautiful woman from an influential family. Unfortunately, she's only willing to marry... a very handsome swordsman. Now Moosung's life mission is to become the best (and most handsome) martial artist in the world and win over Soyeon's heart. So he starts training hard, but it's not until he reads a book of secret martial arts skills that his true potential is magically unlocked. Can Moosung become a great martial artist, or will someone else swoop in and steal the love of his life?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Saionji-kun wa Itsumo Kawaii.
title_japanese: 西園寺くんはいつもかわいい。

title: Topsy-Turvy
synopsis:
Ah-choo! Something about being around Jaehyun just gives Suyong the urge to sneeze. On the one hand, Suyong's body seems to be rejecting Jaehyun's mere presence but on the other...they can't seem to keep their hands off of each other. Seems like these two are the definition of love-hate relationship. The plot is always the same in these stories. They end up getting into the same college, becoming roommates and then living happily ever after. Right? Well, not quite for our dynamic frenemy duo. Suyong's sneezing fits end up ruining everything. He and good buddy Kim Norman have to matriculate a year later than planned. But a chance run-in on campus lands Suyong and Jaehyun back at each other's throats. Or is it with their tongues down each other's throats? Oh, and just who's the top and who's the bottom here? Something's gotta give...and where does our little friend Normie fit into this topsy-turvy mess?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Ippiki Ookami, Koi wo Suru
title_english: One Little Wolf Falls in Love
title_japanese: 一匹オオカミ、恋をする
synopsis:
"I absolutely hate going into heat... but will it lure in my true love? Or perhaps the person I've had an unrequited longing for all this time?"

When the sun slips beneath the horizon, Iori's body begins to change. He becomes wolf-like... and why wouldn't he? He is half beast, after all. Iori lives his life hiding this fact from the humans around him. However, there is a beautiful boy on his morning commute who Iori can't help himself from catching feelings for. But Iori feels hopeless—that no one will ever love him so long as he's this half-werewolf, half-human beast.

One fateful morning, Iori goes into heat unexpectedly and collapses on the train platform. His unrequited crush comes to his rescue. Lost in the heat of the moment, Iori turns to his crush and makes a request: "Won't you please fall in love with me?" A love story between a lonely but beautiful boy and a cowardly half-blood werewolf. Neither of them has known true love, but their unrequited longing for one another weave

title: Pocket Monsters: Liko no Takaramono
title_japanese: ポケットモンスター～リコの宝物～
synopsis: A comicalization of the new Pokémon anime.

title: Reborn as a Swordmaster
synopsis:
Yuma devoted his life to the empire as a eunuch, but was framed and executed. "If I had just one more chance..." Just when he thought his last moments were near, he regressed to his past, when he was sixteen. Was it a dream? No, he was really back in his past. And he knew the first thing he had to do. "I will not become a eunuch this time." He may have been an unfortunate eunuch in his past life, but this life will be prosperous! Yuma had become a eunuch at the trick of fate, but he had also regressed to his past because of fate. He began righting all the wrongs and misfortunes in his past. This marks the beginning of Yuma's sensational life of changing the world's fate!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Unmelting Words
synopsis:
Police officer Nohee is an Unliar: she is completely unable to lie. But telling the truth gets tricky when she meets the wanted criminal Yeonho. As a Word Wraith, Yeonho can make others do whatever he wants just by speaking—he can even kill them. Because of this astonishing ability, he's now a suspect in the murder of his adoptive parents. Yeonho insists he doesn't want to kill people, and asks for Nohee's help in evading capture. Can she trust this accused murderer and uncover the truth behind Yeonho's case?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Magic Maker: Isekai Mahou no Tsukurikata
title_english: Magic Maker: How to Create Magic in Another World
title_japanese: マジック・メイカー －異世界魔法の作り方－
synopsis:
Shion finds himself reborn into another world with high hopes of being able to use magic. Just one problem—magic doesn't exist in this world. Or does it...? Shion's beloved older sister Marie shows him one day that all hope may not be lost when she brings him to a mysterious pond. At first the siblings are wary, but Shion and Marie soon discover this pond can hold a powerfully magical punch! With Marie at his side, Shion embarks on a journey he once thought only possible in dreams: harnessing the power of fire, lightning, sorcery, and enchantment.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Cheat Skill "Shihai" wo Tsukatte Isekai Harem!
title_japanese: チートスキル『支配』を使って異世界ハーレム!

title: Boku no Kanojo ga Kyonyuu Dattara.: Oppai Anthology Comic
title_english: If My Girlfriend Had Big Boob... Oppai Anthology Comic
title_japanese: 僕の彼女が巨乳だったら。 おっぱいアンソロジーコミック
authors: Hirameki, Bonjin|Watari, Sae|Oouchi|Itose, Neme|Yakiniku Teishoku|Hasegawa, Sanji
synopsis: A collection of stories about girlfriends with big breasts.

title: Corpse Knight Gunther
synopsis:
Just as expected, the war between humans and vampires has ended with the victory of the vampires. In an effort to strike back, human refugees in the Holy Land "Bahal" successfully create an undying Corpse Knight, attached to a power source that can sustain him. Gunther, former gladiator and now corpse knight, is humanity's last hope.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Boukensha Party wo Tsuihou sareta Kaifukushi Shoujo wo Hirotte Ikusei shitara Masaka no Saikyou Shokugyou ni Tenshoku!?: Omake ni Kanojo no Yousu ga Naniyara Okashikute…
title_english: After Picking up and Training a Recovery Girl Who Was Banished from the Adventurer Party, She Changed Jobs to the Strongest Profession!?
title_japanese: 冒険者パーティーを追放された回復士の少女を拾って育成したら、まさかの最強職業に転職!? おまけに彼女の様子が何やらおかしくて…

title: Blue Rose Antique no Shoukoujo
title_japanese: 青薔薇〈ブルーローズ〉アンティークの小公女
synopsis:
Rosa, a girl who lost her relatives, is in the depths of despair. Due to certain circumstances, she is robbed of her place in life and even her mother's belongings. The person who reaches out to her is the handsome nobleman Alvin. He gives her a place, a job, a ladylike blue dress, and...

This story takes place in the era of the industrial revolution when fairy tales are stories merely for children. Here, a lonely girl and a silver-haired nobleman find irreplaceable love. This is a gentle fairy tale forgotten by time.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Shuusengo no Scarlet
title_japanese: 終戦後のスカーレット

title: Gokusatsudou: Gregor
synopsis:
A man is tortured by the yakuza to reveal the whereabouts of a large sum of money. But there seems to be a reason why the man decides to undergo this ordeal. He is a man burning with the lust for revenge.

(Source: MangaMogura)

title: Tenmaku Cinema
synopsis:
Extreme movie-lover Hajime Shinichi and the ghost of the mysterious genius screenwriter Takihiko Tenmaku—their meeting will provide some serious plot twists! It's ready, set, action for this coming-of-age series!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Included one-shot:
Volume 3: Yuugen to Jorei Gakkyuu (Yugen's All-Ghouls Homeroom)

title: Chiisai Boku no Haru
synopsis:
Souta Suzuki, a high school boy on the school volleyball team, is interested in his classmate Asahi Shinonome, a member of the girls' volleyball team. She thought of him as a good volleyball player, so she has been seeking him out every day. Souta was a keen volleyball player until junior high. However, because of his height, he could never become the spiker he longed to be. As a result, he got into the habit of giving up on things. Souta's high school life: Will he meekly accept what he cannot have? Or will he try to become a man who can stand with Asahi? Youth is a series of choices. Please, Souta, hang in there and do your best!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Shibatarian
synopsis:
In the spring of my third year of middle school, I found Shibata buried beneath a sakura tree. We watched movies and became fast friends, even planned to make a movie together for the school festival...but no one at school seemed to know him. I will discover Shibata and the whole world will turn into Shibata. This is a story of, by, and for Shibata. Now showing in a theater near you.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Included one-shot:
Volume 2: Noroi ni Kakerarete

title: Tasogare Cure Important
title_japanese: 黄昏キュアインポータント
synopsis:
Ryo works as a bartender at a gay bar. In a place where emotions of lust ran rampant, he is an outlier known for already being 'dried up' or impotent, which isn't the case. Ryo isn't just interested anymore. Enter Umezaki, Ryo's friend from college and his ex 'friends with benefits' buddy. Contrary to Ryo, Umezaki is a well-known playboy and flaunts his sex skills to anyone interested. But when Umezaki starts showing symptoms of impotence, it's Ryo who he turns to ask for help, much to the latter's frustration since Ryo still has feelings for Umezaki.

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Conveni Gotou kara Tasuketa Jimi Tenin ga, Onaji Class no Ubu de Kawaii Gal datta
title_japanese: コンビニ強盗から助けた地味店員が、同じクラスのうぶで可愛いギャルだった
synopsis:
"From today, will you come and stay at my house?"

Riku Kuromine, a second-year high school student, is dumped by his childhood friend and is in despair. He happens to walk into a convenience store and rescues a clerk who is being attacked by a robber. The clerk turns out to be Ayana Hoshimiya, the most popular, beautiful gal in school. This leads to Hoshimiya coming to him for advice about being stalked, and the two end up living together under the pretext of protecting her who lives alone—!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Han Daesung, Back From Hell
synopsis: One day, middle school student Daesung Han suddenly falls into hell, which had a game-like system. After fighting to survive for 80 years, he finally defeats the Demon God, and a message pops up asking "Would You Like to Return to Earth?" He accepts, and wakes up in a hospital bed, having been in a vegetative state ever since he fell into hell. Only 10 years had passed on Earth, and during that time, wormholes called Gates teeming with monsters from another dimension began appearing, which are dealt with by professionals known as Hunters. Daesung struggles with the harsh reality of losing all the power he'd gained in those 80 years, when suddenly a quest pop-up from hell appears.

title: Doku Doku Mori Mori
title_japanese: どく・どく・もり・もり
synopsis:
Once upon a time, there was a happy, cheerful village full of loving, joyous mushrooms deep in the forest. Everything was wonderful, and splendid, and bright—until the day he came. Bringing death and destruction wherever he went, the malignant miasmatic mushroom massacred the entire village for no apparent reason. And that, folks, is how the heroine of our story ended up on a journey to see to his demise...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Ore no Saenai Osananajimi ga S-Rank Yuusha ni Natteita Ken
title_english: My Boring Childhood Friend Became S-Rank Hero
title_japanese: 俺の冴えない幼馴染がSランク勇者になっていた件
synopsis:
The strongest hero within the Hero Army, Shion Halbert, swung his sword to protect the kingdom and its people. However, after a certain event, he was banished from the Hero Army. After changing his occupation to a blacksmith, he spent his everyday. However, one day, his once timid childhood friend, Leaflet, a sweet, beautiful S-rank hero appeared in front of him. The banished (former) hero will bring new life into the Hero Army?!

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

title: Blood Night Market
title_japanese: ブラッドナイトマーケット
synopsis:
Step into the pulsating heart of Blood Night City, a metropolis teeming with vampires thirsty for blood and humans eager to sell. In this dark urban landscape, Sotetsu toils as an employee of the Blood Control Bureau, an organization determined to stamp out illegal vampire activities. But when he crosses paths with the enigmatic Mozu, a self-proclaimed vampire gourmand, Sotetsu's world is suddenly turned upside down. For the first time ever, a vampire craves his "undesirable blood," but could there be more to Mozu's desires? As their destinies intertwine in a web of blood, prepare for a gripping tale of seduction, intrigue, and salvation unlike any other!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Akatsuki no Tori wa Nureta Tsuki ni Hizamazuku
title_english: The Daybreak Bird Overwhelmed by the Crimson Moon
title_japanese: 暁の鳥は濡れた月に跪く

title: Musou Kouro: Tensei shite Uchuu Senkan no AI ni Narimashita
title_japanese: 無双航路 転生して宇宙戦艦のAIになりました
synopsis: Japanese high-schooler Shin Asagaya has been reincarnated as the AI of a space battleship.

title: Muse on Fame
synopsis:
Meet Myeong, a struggling actress who spends her days auditioning for small roles and cleaning houses on the side to make ends meet. She's always had a burning passion for acting, but the road to stardom has been anything but easy. Despite her relentless efforts, Myeong remains relatively unknown in the industry.

Ironically, Myeong's name means fame, which only adds to the frustration of her current situation. But one day, while wandering through the city, she stumbles upon a photo exhibition featuring stunning images of her younger self, captured by a mysterious photographer.

As she gazes at the pictures, Myeong is transported back to a time when she was filled with hope and optimism. Seeing herself through the lens of another's perspective ignites a new fire within her. Could this photographer be the key to unlocking her potential and finally achieving the fame she was destined for?

With newfound determination, Myeong sets out to find the photographer and learn more about the pers

title: Madarame Shunin wa Ecchi de Zurui!
title_english: No Fair! Chief Madarame Is a Pervert! I'll Do You Inside the Way I Want.
title_japanese: 班目主任はエッチでずるい!
synopsis:
"If you can get me excited, then I'll give you a reward." I can't believe this... I'm having sex with my favorite chief! En, an office worker with almost no experience in love relationships, has a crush on the chief of the sales development department, Madarame. One day, En goes out for a drink with chief and ends up getting drunk after getting too excited. The chief takes care of the drunk En, but then she gets caught in the heat of the moment and takes him to a love hotel...!? "I may not be the man you think I am..." The nice and gentle chief slowly caresses his long fingers over her body... I can't hold it in anymore! If he goes any deeper inside of me... I'm going to lose my mind!

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title: Pierrot-Man
synopsis:
Manga artist Toratoki Yamamura's serialized work "Revenge Clown'' has been decided to be made into a movie, and with the support of his beloved wife, he is having the best night in both his professional and private life. However, that was just the beginning of the nightmare that was about to begin...

What is the unexperienced murderous intent called by unconscious malice? What is the true identity of the mysterious revenge demon "Clown Man"?

(Source: Nihon Bungeisha, translated)

title: Glitch
synopsis:
Siblings Minato and Akira Lee have moved to a new town, and they're expecting things to be different— but not this different! Ghostly figures tower over and pass through buildings, drawing no reaction from the locals, some of whom appear far from normal themselves. When Akira spots a strange creature outside her window, she and her new friends organize a search. If no one else can explain the uncanny appearances, the investigation club will get to the bottom of it!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: The Golden Forest
synopsis:
A slave girl blessed with a curse.

"Don't forget. You owe me a life, and you promised to be mine." Reniae was blessed with the ability to charm men by the goddess Inanna. But for her, it feels more like a curse. After being taken as a slave to the Golden Forest, she flees to the Northland where she finds Kun... and saves his life.

(Source: Manta)

title: Lonely Girl ni Sakaraenai dj - Kekkyoku Sonna Kimi ga Suki
title_japanese: 結局そんなきみが好き
synopsis: The story is about couple Wakana Morinaga and Yuina Minami, who appeared as side-characters in the main series, while they attend college.

title: Dainana Maouji Jilbagias no Maou Keikokuki
title_english: 7th Demon Prince Jilbagias, the Demon Kingdom Destroyer
title_japanese: 第七魔王子ジルバギアスの魔王傾国記
synopsis:
The hero Alexander and his comrades unleash a daring raid on the Demon King's castle, intent on assassinating him and bringing an end to the war against the darkness in one fell swoop. However, the raid goes awry when his party is effortlessly decimated by the Demon King's overwhelming power. But death is not the end of the road for Alexander, as he is reincarnated two years later as that very same Demon King's son. With the memories of his past life still intact, he vows to use his miraculous second chance to continue fighting—this time destroying the demonic kingdom from within as the Demon Prince Zilbagias. It doesn't take long for his mettle to be tested either, as passing as a young demon prince without blowing his cover proves to be quite a bit more challenging than he initially anticipated.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Isekai Fuuzoku Anthology Comic
title_japanese: 異世界風俗アンソロジーコミック
synopsis: A collection of stories revolving around erotic encounters in another world.

title: Legendary Ranker's Comeback
synopsis:
One day, the dungeon apocalypse game, Dream Side, turned to reality. Having just completed university, I was stuck inside an elevator while delivering packages when a blue screen appeared before me, along with a monster! As I used to be the number 1 ranker of that game, I destroyed the extremely difficult tutorial and continued playing the game like an elite player...

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Chronicles of the Demon Faction
synopsis:
Hajin Chun is the strongest assassin of the Orthodox Murim's Righteous Heavenly Alliance. Hajin loses his life as he tries to escape to find freedom. And then...

"The divine cult is immortal, may all demons submit. Congratulations on your recovery, third young master!"

He was reincarnated into the body of the Murim's public enemy, the third young master of the Demonic Cult?! The conquest of the Demonic Murim by Hajin Chun, the strongest secret weapon of the Orthodox Murim, begins now.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: 86: Alter
synopsis:
They were in the midst of youth, even on the battlefield... Shin, Lena, and their friends experience brief moments of peace and happiness while facing certain death, enjoying a short break, plunging into battle once again, and setting foot for the first time in the frigid United Kingdom—sharing them with their comrades, friends, lovers, and family.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Kocchi Minaide!! Omorashi Shoujo no Kekkai Anthology Comic
title_japanese: こっち見ないで!! おもらし少女の決壊アンソロジーコミック
synopsis: An anthology about girls wetting themselves.

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Suisei no Majo - Vanadis Heart
title_english: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury - Vanadis Heart
title_japanese: 機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女 ヴァナディースハート
synopsis:
It has been five years since the Vanadis Incident, in which all Gundams became forbidden... These mobile suits were deemed "curses," but now they're running amok on Earth.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Magi-Cu 4-koma: Yosuga no Sora
title_japanese: マジキュー4コマ ヨスガノソラ
authors: Kusakabe, Rei|Mizuna, Tomomi|Aona, Masao|Gunjou, Pizu|Tomo|Okosama Lunch|Rubisama|Yamaneko, Suzume|Toku, Sonchou|Maumen
synopsis: A 4-koma anthology comic of Yosuga no Sora by various mangaka.

title: Tanuma-dono to Gennai-san: Tokidoki Tokugawa Family
title_japanese: 田沼殿と源内さん～ときどき徳川ファミリー～

title: Ore to Anta no Aishou wa
synopsis:
Chancing upon a downcast salaryman in the park, college student Hikaru Hamada picks him up since he's his type. Though straight, the man has an interest in men, so Hikaru tries to embrace him. Yet the tables turn on Hikaru when the man enraptures him with his superior tongue technique. Though Hikaru is no bottom, he can't seem to refuse him. It's not the encounter they had expected, yet their meeting appears to have been fate...

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: I'm a Part-Timer for the Gods
title_english: I'm a Part-Timer for the Gods
synopsis:
Devoid of professional skills, unemployed Damduk Yu was forced to take a part-time job. Frustrated with his pathetic life, he vents to the gods, gets struck by lightning and passes out.

[Hiring] The gods are waiting for you.

When he wakes up, he finds a status window floating before his eyes.

"Since I have nothing to lose anyway, let's go with the flow..."

Jumping into the gods' part-time world to have a better life, the adventure of Damduk Yu, who became the lowest-class god in the part-time world, begins!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Sixth Sense Kiss
synopsis:
What if a simple kiss could reveal the future? This is Yesul Hong's secret ability: whenever she kisses someone, glimpses of the future flash before her eyes. She can't tell when that future will happen, but one thing is certain: her visions always come true. Unfortunately, every time she kisses a man, her ability reveals that their relationship is doomed to fail. It seems like she'll never be able to find Mr. Right—until she accidentally kisses her evil boss, Minhu Cha. He's done nothing but make Yesul's life a living hell ever since she started her job... so why does her vision of the future show them in bed together?! To make matters worse, Yesul's first love—who broke her heart when her ability showed him kissing another woman—is now her new coworker! Can Yesul put the past behind her and accept a future with the last man she ever expected to fall for? Or is everything in her visions really meant to be?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Perks of Being a Villainess
title_english: The Perks of Being a Villainess
synopsis:
Dohee lived as a pushover, died miserably, and was reborn in a novel as a notorious villainess. title: Good Night, See You in My Dreams
title_english: Good Night, See You in My Dreams
synopsis:
A long corridor bathed in red... A ghostly figure lurking in the shadows... Dozens of hands, their long, spindly fingers grasping at your throat... Sounds like the stuff of nightmares, right? But it's not the kind of thing that troubles Seongha. She's just your average high-school kid with a head full of exam stress. Her classmate Isu, on the other hand, has been plagued by that very dream for years. And it's taken its toll, leaving her exhausted and alone. So one day, when Seongha finds herself inside Isu's dream, both girls know that something seriously freaky is going down. Can Seongha save Isu from her nightmares?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Houkago Endless Honey
title_japanese: ホウカゴ・エンドレスハニー
synopsis:
After school, you're only mine! A BL series about the sweet after-school lives of teachers and high school boys!

(Source: WWWave Corporation)

title: Matagi Gunner
synopsis:
Former matagi, Hitonari Yamano, lives a lonely life in the countryside. He once put down his gun, but what he found in his hands was a "FPS" battle royal game! A unique sniper game was created by combining the latest e-sports with the traditional skills of the matagi. An unprecedented legend of the greatest sniper ever created begins in rural Japan!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: The Voodooist's Wrathful Return
synopsis:
Jinsung Ma was on the verge of clearing a quest in the game "Demon King Raid" when he was betrayed and abandoned by his expedition teammate. Just when he thought everything was over, he was pulled away by a strange voice and regressed... 

[Notification] You are being granted a different class according to the conditions of the final goal: Witch Doctor

He enters the game once again as a character he had never considered before. An exciting adventure of the Witch Doctor, Jinsung Ma!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Ten wo Iru
synopsis:
As the third son of a pauper samurai, Kanzaemon Hoshino is not allowed to have dreams—but dream he did in secret, of becoming the world's best archer in the Toshiya, also known as the "Olympics of the Edo era." Opportunity soon presents itself when he stops a raging bull in front of the master of the top archery dojo in Japan. Where sons of noble samurai see an amateur, Master Nagaya sees an unpolished prodigy.

(Source: Shogakukan Asia)

title: Man on the Screen
synopsis:
Early one morning, Yoojin awakens bleary-eyed to a bright light... Did he fall asleep with the TV on? Surely that isn't a real-life actor sleeping beside him? No, there's no mistaking it. The dreamy TV star Ryu Se-ryeon is actually in his bed... and he REEKS of alcohol! How?! When?! WHY?! Perhaps it has something to do with Yoojin's sister, who just happens to be Se-ryeon's girlfriend. Sound complicated? You ain't seen nothin' yet...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Stuck With the Protagonist
synopsis:
The birth of the illegitimate Prince Sirius Hyperion proves a centuries-old legend: the royal family carries wolf blood. Tortured by envy yet unwilling to kill Sirius outright, the emperor sends the 10-year-old boy to the notorious Duke Rhodes' brutal estate—where even the duke's children have not survived his infamously harsh education. Years of abuse drive Sirius mad, and he eventually sets out on a lonely path of revenge.

Among the duke's three surviving children, the youngest Elena was never meant to exist. She is a reincarnated woman with knowledge of Sirius' fate who also possesses a special power but remains helpless under the gaze of her cruel family members. However, Sirius' arrival changes everything. Stuck together in a cycle of suffering, Sirius and Elena forge a bond that may alter Sirius' fate, define Elena's existence, and even turn vengeance into an unexpected romance.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Ai, See You
synopsis:
Hit by a truck immediately after getting rejected by his crush, Tomoya seems to be out of luck. What is worse, he develops a bizarre aftereffect from the accident that causes him to see supernatural beings everywhere. The out-of-this-world hottie he finds sleeping on his bed is also one of "them"; bound to Tomoya's room for reasons unknown, the ghost has been trapped in the place without its owner realizing. The whole situation overwhelms Tomoya, but one thing sets this ghost apart from the rest: not only is he normal-looking, but he's also stunning, mature, and SUPER Tomoya's type. Though Tomoya's confession (and impulsive attempt to have sex with him) quickly ends in an angry rejection, things start to get wild when they realize that the two must now live together until the ghost can leave the room...

(Source: Renta!)

title: Kyonyuu-chan to Kyokon Joushi
title_english: Miss Huge Rack and Her Coworker, Mr. Well-Endowed: Getting It On at the Office
title_japanese: 巨乳ちゃんと巨根上司
synopsis:
Hotaru Shiina is an office worker with a powerful libido and imagination to boot. She spends her nights alone, pleasuring herself with adult toys. One day, while she's working overtime, she realizes she brought one of her toys to the office! To make matters even worse, Ryou, the top sales rep and someone she looks up to, walks in on her holding it! She thinks he'll be repulsed, but the usually sweet Ryou reveals his own dirty appetite. He pounds her hard with something way bigger than she's used to. She'll never be able to go back to satisfying herself again...!!! They've got great physical chemistry!! This is a secret office romance about two people who were made for each other.

(Source: Renta!)

title: PSO2 New Genesis: Central!
title_japanese: PSO2 ニュージェネシス せんとらるっ!
synopsis: Story following the exploits and updates in Phantasy Star Online 2: New Genesis through the Central Tower girls and a rotating cast of characters.

title: From Pakuri to Assistant?!
synopsis:
Jiun is an aspiring webtoon artist and Kanghyun is both his inspiration and crush. He's finally ready to debut a new comic when the feedback he receives is shocking: his work is so similar to Kanghyun's that he's pretty much a pakuri (someone who copies another's work). Distraught and ashamed, he decides to meet Kanghyun in person to apologize. But instead of being angry with him, Kanghyun hires him to be his assistant. Working for your crush: what could go wrong?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Renai Daikou
synopsis:
Half-Japanese Half-Swedish Mari Maria Winter Nanase has everything in life. She was raised in a well-off family in Scandinavia and America, she is popular among the girls, and she has good looks. However, she is missing one thing: she can't talk to boys!

After picking up a book on love in the library, she found a suspicious-looking ad on the back. The ad was for Love Agency, a service promising a "pro in love" to handle your love for you. When she scans it, an agent called "Kon-chan" pops out and promises to help her fall in love with her crush. However, her crush, Masaya Seki, isn't so innocent in his ways either and is also using this app to get with her. How will this pair of hopeless lovers turn out?

title: Kill Ao
synopsis:
Juuzou Oogami's a legend. Even among hit men, his name sends shivers down their spines. There's never been a job he couldn't handle—that is, until the day he awoke as a teenager! But how did his body transform? To find out, he'll have to infiltrate the one place he never thought he'd find himself in...school!

(Source: VIZ Media)

Follow Ebizou, a self-proclaimed genius, in his attempts to murder the old pawn-broker lady who called him a retard.

(Source: MU)

title: Koi wo Suru ni wa Chikasugiru
title_english: Too Close to Fall in Love
title_japanese: 恋をするには近すぎる
synopsis:
The ultimate "stepbrother" I can't escape from.

My father remarried and now I have a younger brother. He is fearless and handsome. To be honest, I'm in trouble because he's really my type. I tried to keep my distance so I wouldn't fall for him even more, but Motoya kept coming on to me and asking if I liked him, so I lost control and we became a bit too intimate...

I'm not sure how long I can endure the fierce attacks of my pushy brother-in-law, who keeps trying to seduce me...?!

(Source: Shu-Cream)

title: Nande Omae ga Ki ni Nannen!?
title_japanese: なんで恋敵〈おまえ〉が気になんねん!?
synopsis:
"But the guy I like should be that one!"

Having moved to Tokyo from the countryside, the gay Azuma met Kyoutarou and fell in love at first sight! He's so happy to have met his type, but Azuma feels a hostile presence behind him. He turns around to see Miyako glaring at Azuma from behind his glasses. Apparently, he too has had a crush on Kyoutarou for many years... Azuma wants to get closer to Kyoutarou, but Miyako keeps annoyingly getting in the way. But, as the three of them spend time together, Miyako's bad first impression, that made Azuma think he was an "sneaky bastard," began to change little by little.

(Source: East Press, translated)

title: Ore ni wa Zenbu Kikoeteru!
title_japanese: 俺には全部きこえてる!
synopsis:
When he was a child, high school student Asahi Miyahira started helping people to be like a popular superhero he saw. But he's always just a "good guy." Even though he's excited to change chasses and insists "This year I'll get a girlfriend," he ends up in the same class as cool and good-looking school idol Kaede Genda.

When he goes to bed frustrated, an angel appears before his eyes and tells him, "I'm giving you telepathic powers." He thought it was just a dream, but the next morning, he could hear people's inner voices when he touched them...?! To take advantage of his ability, and become the most popular guy in school, he decides to explore Kaede's thoughts, but...

A hectic youth love comedy that begins with telepathy.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Revenge of the Baskerville Bloodhound
synopsis:
Raised to kill like a pack of loyal hounds, the Baskerville children took countless lives as a band of fearsome assassins. Despite being the shunned illegitimate son of the brood, Bikir served his family faithfully, only to meet his untimely demise at his father's hands. But when he is inexplicably reborn with a second chance at life, Bikir, armed with the memories and knowledge of his past, swears to rise above the pack and take his revenge. This time, he's ready to bite the hand that feeds.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kyokutou Jihen
synopsis:
September 1945, Tokyo. A post-war process is underway in the underbelly of this city which became a burnt wasteland. It is the extermination of the remnants of the human weapons "Unit 731". Saika, a young immortal girl soldier, with her subordinate Kankurou Konoe, a combat medic feared as the Grim Reaper, takes on the responsibility of killing her compatriots in order to gain her freedom.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Shindou-kun wa Toriatsukai Chuui. Kouhai ga Seiteki Sugite Komattemasu!?
title_english: Shindou-kun's Tight Squeeze: Helpless Against His Alluring Touch
title_japanese: 進藤くんは取り扱い注意。 ～後輩が性的すぎて困ってます!?～
synopsis:
For three years, Rinko Omuro has dedicated herself to her dream job at Yatsuboshi Confectionery. While it hasn't all been cupcakes and mochi, she's proud of her hard-earned skills—until the day her boss assigns her to mentor the new hire, Ryoma Shindou. From the moment they meet, Shindou leaves a bitter taste in Rinko's mouth. His sharp tongue and bad attitude grate on her nerves, and worse yet, he insists he doesn't need her guidance at all. The most infuriating part? He's right. Shindou isn't just competent—he's faster, more efficient, and outshines her at work. But what begins as a clash of personalities soon simmers into something far more intoxicating. After a company dinner, Shindou makes a bold move and asks to go home with her. To Rinko's shock, the arrogant junior proves he's not just skilled in the office—he's devastatingly talented between the sheets, leaving her completely satisfied yet torn.

Now, as both her colleague and her lover, Shindou is pushing Rinko to her limits

title: Yaoyorozu Kuroneko Sokuhou
synopsis:
It is the Meiji era (1868-1912), and the Japanese Empire is rife with demons. Kuroi, who works hard as a police officer, is actually a black cat demon, and he uses his two faces to solve a variety of cases.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Koisuru Kyou mo, Kono Tsuugakuro de
title_japanese: 恋する今日も、この通学路で
synopsis:
Kosaka and Okano ride their bicycles together every morning. Since they switched classes in their senior year of high school, they have been in different classes, and their paths have somehow crossed...?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Shaka no Musuko
synopsis:
Who is he? Where did he come from? What did he come to do?

A man bearing the moniker "the Son of Shaka" comes by the peaceful, quiet Shogidani Village. Followed by a trio of triplet sisters, his agenda is unknown, but he quickly gains a good reputation within the village... He doesn't matter much to the village boy Tomeo, though, who is threatened with separation with his girlfriend, Seiko, and ever-persistent advances by the pesky Aoki. That is, until Seiko starts to feel swayed by the Son of Shaka's aid, his 'hand of love'. Tomeo's concern isn't just petty jealousy, though—the Son of Shaka's intent points to a certain direction....

George Akiyama presents a chaotic thriller of a close-knit village being stricken with corruption, calamity, and absolute evil.

(Source: MU)

title: Tensei-saki wa Moumoku Youjo deshita: Zense no Kioku to Mahou wo Tayori ni Ikinobimasu
title_japanese: 転生先は盲目幼女でした　～前世の記憶と魔法を頼りに生き延びます～
synopsis:
Countess Phyllis was reincarnated with memories of her previous life intact. Her family treated Phyllis badly because she was born blind. She was able to control more mana than normal people, and her ability to easily wield magic also made her disliked by others.

One day, while on an outing, Phyllis was suddenly attacked by demons. She found herself all alone, stuck at the bottom of a deep ravine... and just when it seemed hopeless, she was saved by a large wolf, a "sacred beast" of legend. Now together with the sacred beast Garu, Phyllis will get back to the surface and set out on her adventure!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title_japanese: 魔王道 ―千年前の魔王が復活したら最弱魔物のコボルトだったが、知識経験に衰え無し。神と正義の名の下にやりたい放題している人間共を躾けてやるとしよう
synopsis:
Bring wisdom and power to the demon realm, and build up his army by taking advantage of his past knowledge and experience. After uniting the wild demons under his banner, Ur, the reborn king of the demons, will take the fight to the human forces.

synopsis:
Agnes, who was ridiculed in the social circles for being an unfashionable noble, happened to help Nazelbert, the duke's son, who had been betrothed to the princess. However, the princess saw this and ordered Nazelbert to marry Agnes as punishment. Isn't it terrible to marry me as a punishment? Look, he seems to hate it too. Wait, he doesn't?

This is a story about an unfashionable noble and a duke's son, who grow closer to each other.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Kugii Kiyoi ni wa, Buchou no xxx ga Mieru Rashii.
title_english: It Seems That Kiyoi Kugii Can See the Director's XXX
title_japanese: 釘井浄には、部長の×××が視えるらしい。
synopsis:
When Director Waragaki wakes up at three o'clock in the morning... he finds his subordinate, Kiyoi Kugii, straddling him half-naked! Kugii claims to be helping dispel the ghost haunting Waragaki, but could he have another motive?

(Source: WWWave)

title: Boku no Kanojo wa Boku no Koto ga Suki ja Nai
title_japanese: 僕の彼女は僕のことが好きじゃない
synopsis:
My girlfriend Chisa is in love with another man. I won't do anything she doesn't want to, and I won't lay a finger on her. Simply because she has someone she likes who isn't me. However, I know that one day, she will show to me the same face she shows to the one she likes, and I'll continue being her boyfriend today once more.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)
