They have been living together for over a year, but as Haiga's own graduation approaches, the stress of a job search sets in, while Kanae's work as an audio engineer keeps him busy. As they both try to balance their respective workloads, they still make time for romance—but between meeting the family, long working hours, and a touch of jealousy, Haiga and Kanae learn that love sometimes takes a bit of work.

synopsis:
Excellent grades, good looks, above average fighting skills, and a sense of justice. A first-class model student, Hyunsung Kim was pushed off a rooftop just before his graduation and became a vegetative patient. For ten years, he endured hellish days with only his hearing and consciousness intact, yet unable to die, he suddenly returns to the day when the bullying began.

Life is so unpredictable. Myeong-hwa had everything: the pretty face, the artistic talent, and even a wonderful boyfriend, while Sun-hee had nothing. title: Black Dragon's Choice
synopsis:
To others, Jinha Im is a superstar. But to attorney Yoolli Cha, he's just a loyal customer at her mom's book rental shop who exclusively reads books with dragons in them. After Yoolli gets fired from her job, Jinha offers her a spot on his agency's legal team, with her law school senior as her boss! However, Yoolli doesn't know that her new workplace holds an ancient secret. Something... draconic. Could it be that Yoolli and Jinha's relationship goes beyond just books?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Hatsukoi no Tsuzuki wa Danshiryou de
title_japanese: 初恋のつづきは男子寮で

title: Dekiai nante Zurusugiru!!
title_japanese: 溺愛なんてズルすぎる!!
synopsis:
Miyu, a second year at high school, is in love with "love," and has the hobby of observing the school's hottest guys during break time, her enthusiasm for it never failing to amaze her friends, Ayuto and Eri. But when Eri asks Miyu why she won't pick the handsome and cool-looking Ayuto, whom she has an inseparable relationship with after finding out they were fans of the same band, Miyu replies that Ayuto is just a friend. In contrast to Miyu's lack of interest, however, is Ayuto, who has a crush on her that everyone but her can see! Suddenly, Miyu ends up exchanging contact details with the cool and popular Imai-senpai at Ayuto's part-time job, leaving her in high spirits! Meanwhile, Ayuto, who knows about Imai-senpai's womanizing tendencies, is worried... It's a sugary romance comedy between these two!!!

(Source: Starts Shuppan, translated)

title: Mori no Naka
synopsis: The story begins when a boy takes a girl who has been held for some reason. The relationship between them becomes clear as he escapes through the forest, trying to lose the pursuit.

title: Boku to Doll to Hourou Shoujo
title_japanese: 僕とドールと放浪少女

title: Jane Doe ni Shukufuku wo
title_japanese: ジェーン・ドゥに祝福を

title: Kamisama no Kaigogakari
synopsis:
One mysterious day, over twenty thousand otherworldly spaceships settle into stable orbit around Earth. Six months later, in a certain Asian village, a young girl named Zhihan discovers an old man who fell from the sky...but the strangeness doesn't end there. Soon, many more elderly drifters in peculiar outfits begin descending all over the world, claiming they created human civilization. Now it's humanity's turn to take care of their Progenitors—but as Zhihan will soon learn, accepting God into your home isn't such a simple matter...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Beastrings
synopsis:
Welcome to the city of Juso! The hero who once saved the city now serves as mayor, and alongside his two secretaries, he's hard at work making Juso a place anyone would want to live. Elsewhere, a young elf and her wolfman butler act out a real-life rom-com, and a dragon and a bard form an unlikely musical duo. All kinds live in harmony in Juso, lending surprise and adventure to everyday life. But when another disaster threatens to strike, will these citizens become part of an all-new legend? 

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen: Yozakura-ke Kansatsu Nikki
title_japanese: 夜桜さんちの大作戦 夜桜家観察日記

title: Shibou Yuugi de Meshi wo Kuu.
title_english: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table
synopsis:
When Yuuki wakes up in an unfamiliar manor wearing a maid uniform, she recognizes this as the start of a new death game. After assessing the situation, Yuuki begins to wander before discovering a room with five other maids. Each one is visibly anxious, and she learns from them that they are all new players who joined this lethal game for the prize money.

But Yuuki is different: she is a death game veteran whose only goal is to achieve 99 consecutive wins. Tasked with navigating a manor filled with countless instruments of murder, Yuuki takes point as the only experienced player in an environment that is designed to actively work against her. Despite this, she is determined to reach the end of the game with as many people as possible—if it coincides with her final goal.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Loop 8-shuume wa Shiawase na Jinsei wo: 7-shuubun no Keikenchi to Daisan Oujo no "Kantei" de Kakusei shita Ore wa, Aibou no Behemoth to Tomo ni Musou suru
title_english: 8th Loop for the Win! With Seven Lives' Worth of XP and the Third Princess's Appraisal Skill, My Behemoth and I Are Unstoppable!
title_japanese: ループ8周目は幸せな人生を ～7周分の経験値と第三王女の『鑑定』で覚醒した俺は、相棒のベヒーモスとともに無双する～
synopsis: Master swordsman, sage, dragon knight... Remille can't believe his ears when the princess lists off his possible futures. Born to a lesser noble house, he's never been anything but a low-level adventurer. In fact, he's lived that same life seven times—always forming an adventuring party with his friends at age fifteen, and always giving his own life to save theirs three years later. But not this time. The eighth loop is going to be different. After his most recent death reveals his friends' treachery, Remille finally takes a different path that leads him to Princess Ciel, wielder of the powerful Eye of Appraisal that can judge anyone's true potential. Will her wild claims about Remille's future come to pass? With her guidance, can he really become a great sage or a rider of dragons? Is the adorable catlike familiar he's tamed in past lives really a mighty behemoth, the strongest of the magical beasts? And will he really be able to escape the deadly destiny that's claimed his life seven

title: On-Air
synopsis:
On social media, Ayeong Oh has a perfect life. Her vlogs on the popular video-sharing platform MeTube command the adoration of thousands of fans as she regularly posts vlogs with her loving boyfriend, Jihun. However, when Jihun abruptly breaks up with her and disappears one day, her livelihood and MeTube fame are threatened. As Ayeong struggles to maintain her online celebrity status and delves into the mystery behind Jihun's disappearance, she gradually begins to uncover the sinister truth behind Jihun's real identity. Will Ayeong manage to find out who her ex truly was, or will her obsession with fame consume her first?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Around 40 ni Natta Saikyou no Eiyuu-tachi, Futatabi Senjou de Musou suru!!
title_english: Back to the Battlefield: The Veteran Heroes Return to the Fray!
title_japanese: アラフォーになった最強の英雄たち、再び戦場で無双する!!
synopsis:
The century-long war with demons was finally brought to a close by seven young heroes who slew the demon lord, routed the demon army, and ultimately led humanity to victory. The heroes then went their separate ways, and the land has been at peace for twenty-five long years...until now. Alan Granger, a former hero, enjoys a quiet life as a commander in the Royal Knights until the day he receives a report that shakes him to his core: the demon army has returned! He immediately knows what he must do—gather his old compatriots and face the demon army once again. But Alan and his friends are now all in their forties, while the demons are more powerful than ever. Do these veteran heroes have what it takes to leap back onto the battlefield and save the world a second time?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Around 40 ni Natta Saikyou no Eiyuu-tachi, Futatabi Senjou de Musou suru!!
title_english: The Strongest Heroes, Now in Their 40's, Once Again Become Warriors on the Battlefield.
title_japanese: アラフォーになった最強の英雄たち、再び戦場で無双する!!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Counter Stop Mura no Goinkyo Demon-san
title_english: The Retired Demon of the Maxed-Out Village
title_japanese: カンスト村のご隠居デーモンさん
synopsis:
After hearing there's a demon lurking in a village near the border, Albrea, the kingdom's strongest knight, sets out to slay the monster. When she arrives in town, however, she quickly discovers that all is not as it seems. It turns out the humble town of Montt has a lesser-known nickname—the Maxed-Out Village—and the mighty demon is a retired old man! Montt is also inhabited by a stew-loving demonic sword that likes to take the form of a young girl, a money-grubbing witch, and a drunken priest known as the Holy Fist... Just what are so many of the kingdom's greatest defenders doing in such a remote town? Through her encounter with the kindly old demon and the rest of the Maxed-Out Village, Albrea will learn what it truly means to be a knight!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Konyaku Haki no Sono Saki ni: Suterare Reijou, Oujisama ni Dekiai (Engi) sareru
title_english: Fiancée No More: The Forsaken Lady, the Prince, and Their Make-Believe Love
title_japanese: 婚約破棄のその先に ～捨てられ令嬢、王子様に溺愛（演技）される～
synopsis:
Estelle Flozeth is the sister of a countryside earl, and her newfound ability to see others' emotions through their mana has brought her nothing but trouble! Her life drastically changes one day when her childhood friend and fiancé is swept away from her by the daughter of a capitalist. Heartbroken, Estelle attends a ball and winds up meeting Prince Arcrayne, a wicked man who soon finds out about her special power and decides he must have her for himself! To that end, he proposes to her and begins acting like a veritable Prince Charming, pretending he fell in love with her at first sight—a charade that might fool everyone else, but not Estelle and her perceptive powers. Yet in spite of everything, she gradually finds herself drawn to the prince... Will their make-believe love blossom into the real thing? Find out in this reluctant Cinderella story fraught with political intrigue!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Rei: Irotoutoshi-hen
title_japanese: ひぐらしのなく頃に令 色尊し編

title: Horobi no Kuni no Seifukusha: Maou wa Sekai wo Seifuku suru you desu
title_english: The Conqueror from a Dying Kingdom
title_japanese: 亡びの国の征服者 ～魔王は世界を征服するようです～
synopsis:
After a life seemingly devoid of meaning, a man reincarnates in a new world as Yuri Ho. Immersed in novel experiences and embraced by parents who shower him with unprecedented affection, his will to live grows like never before. The future that lies before him is a peaceful existence on his father's ranch, breeding and raising birds to be ridden by warriors fighting distant wars. His new home, the Shiyalta Kingdom, has enjoyed peace and prosperity for centuries, shielded by friendly nations that, like Shiyalta itself, were established following the collapse of a once-great empire. It seems no threat can compromise this idyllic lifestyle. However, when the effects of a neighboring kingdom's war throw Yuri's family into crisis, he finds himself unable to stand by and watch.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: The Heir of Mythological Heroes
synopsis:
Jungmin Han, "the ace of written exams," gave up on becoming an adventurer as he didn't have the talent for it. After taking some time off from the adventurer academy, he starts to write a fantasy novel. And then, one day...

[Your work has been plagiarized by the world.]
[Sole class: original author of the story.]

The novel Jungmin wrote starts to become the reality and he receives the title of the "original author of the story." Can Jungmin achieve his dream of becoming a dungeon adventurer?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: 3-pun Matte Mugi-senpai
synopsis:
Yuasa Shio, a university student who continues to conduct research day and night, and Yakushiji Tsumugi, the graduate student who supervises her. Day after day, the two of them strive at both their university life and research, including late nights at the lab. They treat themselves with Cup Noodles. A story about a female science student's youth, research, love, and Cup Noodles.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Gokeiyaku wa Shokuji no Ato de!
title_japanese: ご契約は食事のあとで！

title: Futsuu no Koi tte Nani?
synopsis:
A viral GL manga about three high school girls and their bittersweet struggles in finding love and burgeoning sexuality.

What is normal love? We fell in love at first sight at the day of our high school entrance ceremony. But this love...it's not normal.

A yuri manga from three girls' perspectives that breaks through new grounds.

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Wild Strawberry
title_japanese: ワイルドストロベリー
synopsis:
Although not related by blood, Kingo and Kayano have grown up together in an orphanage and are the closest thing either of them has to a family. When it seems that their dreams of being adopted are about to come true, their new parents turn out to be Jinka! Just as Kingo is about to be eaten, a Jinka blooms in Kayano...but her Jinka is very different. It doesn't attempt to hurt Kingo or other humans. Kingo must do everything he can to keep his sister's affliction a secret so she doesn't get pruned. One day, while working as a lowly grunt for the Flower Funeral Forces, Kingo gets an alert about a Jinka near his apartment. He rushes to the scene to find Kayano surrounded, and earns himself a bullet through the head for trying to save her. But when he wakes up, he's in a mysterious pruning facility, his sister is gone, and he is now infected by a Jinka himself—Kayano.

(Source: VIZ Media)

title: i.d.
synopsis:
Akiko Hirukawa is a young woman who has lost herself in her everyday life. She works, not particularly skillfully, as both a telemarketer and a model, but she is deeply unhappy. Her only relief is letting out her stress by sparring at a dojo. Will Akiko be able to reconnect with herself and reevaluate her current lifestyle?

(Source: MU)

title: Monster and Ghost
title_japanese: モンスターアンドゴースト
synopsis:
Tsubaki Koton is a monster—a violent delinquent with a chilling past and a terrifying image to match. No other student dares to approach him, not even after transferring to a new high school. His anti-heroic acts of selflessness end only in bloodshed and rumors that spiral out of his control. Then, one fateful night, he's followed home by a stranger who sets out to change his life for good.

This boy, stubborn and hauntingly beautiful, is the pure-hearted Kabuto Yuuki, with his stunning jewel-like eyes that see past Tsubaki's fearsome façade. But although someone finally sees Tsubaki for who he truly is, Kabuto cannot be seen at all. After all, Kabuto is a ghost.

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: King-sama no Ichiban Hoshi
title_japanese: キング様のいちばん星
synopsis:
Seira Nanao is a 15-year-old who loves school and her friends. The girls' school she attended was closed down to merge with a super elite boys' school!! It was there she met a boy called "King"!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Elaine's Unique Situation
synopsis:
After giving up her dream to become a priestess, Elaine resignedly applies to work as a maid in the imperial palace and earn money for her family. While working, she runs into a mysterious man who treats her with unusual kindness. Moved by his gestures, Elaine begins to fall for him... until she finds out he's none other than the war hero, Prince Theo Veronica! But just when she tries to distance herself from the prince, he offers her a unique deal that will change her life forever.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kono Koi wo Hoshi ni wa Negawanai
title_english: There Is No Love Wishing Upon a Star.
title_japanese: この恋を星には願わない
synopsis:
Eri is the childhood friend we always spent time with. Someday I won't love her as a friend, but I'll never tell her that. Because I want to always be there for her...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Koori no Jouheki
synopsis:
Inept at dealing with people, Koyuki Hikawa maintains a wall between herself and others. She spends her time in high school away from others, all alone. At least until she encounters Minato Amamiya who keeps closing the distance between them for some reason. The aloof Koyuki, the popular Miki, the boundary-less Minato, and the easygoing and kind basketball team member Youta. This is the story of these somewhat complicated four and their tantalizing, bumbling youth.

(Source: LINE Digital Frontier, translated)

title: Oishii Kaori wa Kimi kara
title_japanese: おいしい香りは君から

title: Tonari no Hogosha-chan
title_japanese: となりの保護者ちゃん
synopsis:
After twelve years at girls-only schools, Riko is ready to start a new life at a co-ed university. One day, she volunteered to become the guardian of Mizuki, a junior-high boy living next door whose family was moving away. The first time dealing with college guys felt scary and intimidating. It's so much more comfortable talking with Mizuki, who is just a gentle boy. Wait, she's supposed to be the responsible adult here, no impure thoughts allowed!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Saikyou ni Uzai Kanojo no, Ashita kara Tsukaeru Mount Lesson @comic

title: Aashi to Watashi. Gal x Yuri Anthology
title_english: Me and, I. Gal x Yuri Anthology
title_japanese: あーしとわたし。 ギャル×百合アンソロジー
authors: Arai, Cherry|Yuzuki, Gao|Yukiko|Sakuragi, Ren|Taiyou, Marii|Mikanuji|Ohi, Pikachi|Key Yang|Goumoto|Oouchi|Suzuo|Hinosaka, Aki|Kaibashira|BirdHatter
synopsis: An anthology comic that features relationships between different types of gals.

title: Sensitive Boy
title_japanese: センシティブ・ボーイ
synopsis:
Seventeen-year-old Kaede Seto only wants to be a normal teenager. Following a traumatic experience in middle school, Kaede and his two best friends transfer to a boys-only high school, hoping to start anew. Though he sets his sights on getting a girlfriend, Kaede finds it difficult to allow others close due to what had happened at his previous school.

As Kaede struggles to come to terms with his trauma, he begins to receive attention from Tsubasa Arisaka, a hopeless romantic attending an all-girls school. As an avid shoujo manga fan, Arisaka has always fantasized about a perfect love story for herself, but her life thus far has not taught her that relationships in reality differ from how they seem in fiction.

Tsubasa's affections spur Kaede to work harder to overcome the demons that continue to haunt him. Despite his resolve, it is not solely his personal issues that stand in the way of a happy ending for the two of them. Both Kaede and Tsubasa—immature in life and love—need to learn

title: Ten Ways to Get Dumped by a Tyrant
title_english: Ten Ways to Get Dumped by a Tyrant
synopsis:
Being thrust into a novel as Scarlett Arman isn't the best of fates. First, Scarlett is engaged to the emperor—who, by the way, happens to be the most vicious tyrant the world has ever known. Second, Scarlett is just a minor villain and ends up dead at the hands of that very tyrant only halfway through the book. The solution? Make him break up with Scarlett, of course. But what happens when every scheme backfires because the emperor has schemes of his own? Why does everything seem to draw the emperor closer instead of driving him away?

(Source: Editio Publishing)

title: Isekai Shoukan Ojisan no Juu Musou Life: Sabagezuki Salaryman wa Kaisha Owari ni Isekai e Chokki suru
title_english: Middle-Aged Man Overpowers with Guns in the Another Universe.
title_japanese: 異世界召喚おじさんの銃無双ライフ ～サバゲー好きサラリーマンは会社終わりに異世界へ直帰する～
synopsis:
The middle-aged man and airsoft enthusiast Daisuke Koga is summoned to a different world on his 40th birthday. Given the ability to turn airsoft guns into real guns, Daisuke must save the other world while traveling back and forth between reality and the fantasy world. Alongside female swordsman Rena, Daisuke becomes the only gun user and dominates in the fantasy world after work!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Reborn as the Protagonists' Daughter
synopsis:
Emeliette is determined to have a loving family in her second life, but that's much easier said than done when her mother has passed away and her father, Duke Cardin vel Vardion, is cold and absent. So when the duke finally comes back into her lonely life, Emeliette gives her all to win his heart with her cuteness. As she grows closer to her father, she begins to realize her parents' legacy is greater than she ever imagined and that she herself may be a girl worthy of her own story.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Bokura no Ai wa Mada Aoku
title_japanese: 僕らのアイはまだ青く
synopsis:
In a small town by the sea, Shio spends peaceful days helping out in his family's shop. But he has always been troubled over his barren relationship with a married person (sex friend). One day, he meets a young boy named Someto who moved from the city. His relationship with his mother was strained, and Someto ran away to the countryside, trying to heal his heart. Shio then came to look after him as a "nice elder brother." However, he gradually realizes that his emotions are beyond that. On the other hand, Someto has begun yearning the gentel Shio. But he happened to see Shio kissing his sex friend, and he came to find out about his "adult" side...?

A naïve lonely boy x a caring beauty who tends to be swept away. The two immature people slowly get to know love.

(Source: East Press, translated)

title: Maigo to Omawarisan
title_english: Mr. Policeman and the Missing Kids
synopsis:
Welcome to Ponpo Land, where humans and animals co-exist in harmony. New police officer Daifuku joined the force with dreams of fighting baddies, but he's been assigned to the relatively peaceful Lost Children's Division. Things change one day with the appearance of a "lost" kitten who's actually run away from home! When her feline father comes to pick her up, Daifuku can't help but be intrigued by the new cat in town...

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Gakeppuchi no Darling Boy
synopsis:
Kanata's the ex-number one host who's in a dry spell of unpopularity. The newest host to start working there, though, Iori, is currently number one and has been forcing Kanata to drink all of the drinks that clients order for him each and every day... Then one day, Kanata learns that Iori's been giving free advice to hosts who are worried about their sales stagnating. Kanata's willing to give anything a try as he goes and visits Iori's place, but Iori guesses that in order to understand the feelings of his female clientele, Kanata needs to bottom...!? This story features a junior dominating his superior with erotic techniques under the guise of lessons.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Oyasumi Karasu Mata Kite ne.
title_english: Good Night Crow, Come By Again.
title_japanese: おやすみカラスまた来てね。
synopsis:
24 years old, unemployed, moocher. Zenjuu Sogawa is nearly dumped by his live-in girlfriend, and when heading to a bar in the midst of this heartbreak, he has a miraculous encounter. 

The most good-for-nothing men and women of different types come head-to-head in this romance drama (... good luck Zenjuu!).

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Sachi-roku: Sachi no Mokushiroku
title_english: Sachi's Records: Sachi's Book of Revelation
synopsis:
"Humanity's Judgment"—a process by which an angel and a demon meticulously pass judgment upon a human, and the final score determines the fate of mankind. But this time, the chosen subject is the incredibly mischievous 6-year-old elementary school student, Sachi Ueno?! Just how will the unconventional living arrangement of an angel, a demon, and a human shape the future of humanity?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: For the Third Time
synopsis:
Dohee is too busy girl-bossing her way up the corporate ladder to care about love. Her ability to randomly time loop makes her professionally successful but also renders all relationships meaningless. What's the point when she'll have to restart everything at some point? That all changes when Joonwon, her annoying new boss, reveals that he can time loop too. Though she cringes at the mere sight of him, he's also the only person who understands her. Will they learn how to find solace in each other, or will their professional friction mess up their one chance at love?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Umareta Toki kara Hetakuso
title_japanese: 生まれたときから下手くそ
synopsis:
An autobiographical manga based on the artist's childhood days in Nakamura, Kochi Prefecture, during the 1960s and 70s. The day to day lives of bumbling father Akira, reticent but steady mother Asami, and withdrawn, contemplative son Makoto are depicted through humorous and touching episodes, written in the local dialect, that evoke nostalgic memories of the Showa era.

(Source: Japan Media Arts Festival)

title: Korekara Ore wa, Kouhai ni Dakaremasu
title_japanese: これから俺は、後輩に抱かれます

title: Ore no Omocha wa Shinyuu ni Tsunagatteiru
title_english: My "Toy" is Connected to My Best Friend
title_japanese: 俺のオモチャは親友につながっている
synopsis:
Jin is the heir to his family's shrine, but he is seccretly in love with his childhood friend Misaki. Refusing to admit his true feelings, has led his dreaming mind to wander. To help him let out his pent up energy, a senior club member leds him a toy from his colletion. Jin releases his lust for Misaki with the toy everyday, but there's more than meets the eye to his new toy. It moves and feels as if it were real! What's more, by some miracle or curse, it's connected to Misaki! As Jin ravages the toy relentlessly, Misaki is sexually tormented! What will happen with this "miracle" toy? Can it truly connet more than just their bodies?

(Source: Houbunsha)

Noah's Ark describes the relationship between humankind and animals, tackling head-on the eternal problem of our "coexistence." This magnificent fabric, in which living beings are an extension of one another, is what gives our environment its balance. Hailing from Hokkaido, Kei Honjou offers us a touching documentary work, an ode to nature that gives a voice to animals and questions the choices made by our modern societies. A humanist manga, in the best sense of the word.

"Mizukawa-kun, I made a bento for you."

Huh?? Why?? Why did this scary-looking guy make me a bento!?

It is now lunch time. Mizukawa is your average boy who was just about to have his usual bread for lunch when Tsuchiya, his classmate who's constantly shrouded in dangerous rumors, suddenly gave him a bento.

"You'll get hungry just eating bread, and it's unhealthy too."

Huh? Is Tsuchiya actually a nice guy? And his bento is actually delicious...

With Tsuchiya's bento being the catalyst, thus begins an innocent love story between the average boy, Mizukawa and Tsuchiya, the scary-looking boy who's good at cooking.

title_english: Legend of Exorcism: Tianbao Fuyao Lu
synopsis:
Having lived his entire life on Mount Taiheng, half-yao Kong Hongjun is at last presented with the chance to explore the human world. He is assigned three tasks: uncover his father's murderer, eliminate the Black Jiao and its yao tribes that have infiltrated Chang'an, and return the Heart Lamp to a descendent of the Chen family. However, on his first night in the city, the Heart Lamp is mistakenly absorbed by military general Li Jinglong.

After receiving a mysterious invitation to join Chang'an's Court of Exorcism, Kong Hongjun is reunited with a disgraced Li Jinglong as his captain. Alongside a fellow yao, a noble from a foreign land, and a cowardly scholar, Kong Hongjun and Li Jinglong must work together to purge Chang'an of the yao lurking in its streets. In the meantime, Kong Hongjun also needs to hide his true identity from Li Jinglong who loathes yao—all while attempting to retrieve the Heart Lamp from his body.

Now, an editor, what sits on his desk is none other than Kazami's manuscript. Can Ikuse look beyond the past and nurture Kazami's talent as his editor? Can they move forward, or are they doomed to repeat the past?

Determined to escape from those who know of his failings, Eugene flees to the Lykeion Magic Academy where he meets Erinyes, a fallen Demon Queen imprisoned beneath the school. Taken in by his potential, Erinyes appoints Eugene to be her caretaker. Not long after, the headmaster of the academy assigns Eugene to be the guardian of Sumire, a mysterious girl from another world who just so happens to be an Ifrit of legend.

Remu wants to prove the improvement in academic efficiency from afternoon napping, while Niiya, who wants to enjoy his peaceful naps alone, reluctantly gets caught up in it. She thinks Junrei is meeting her for the first time, but Chika is actually the boy Junrei made a promise to be her groom when she was little! As they learn about each other's emotional scars and reach out to each other, the distance between them gradually closes. But when Junrei doesn't remember her "promise," the time comes that they may have to say goodbye!

(Source: Libre, translated)

When she was unable to fully demonstrate her power, she was forced into the Aldamann family. Eventually, the castle's cold treatment of her would change completely and gain the affection of the marquis. Her brother-in-law Dainan immediately falls in love with Chelsea, and he can't stop loving her all the time!  

Miracles continue to occur one after another around them as the fantasy love story unfolds between a false saint and her brother-in-law.

synopsis:
Reborn into a novel, 5-year-old Mariette has spent her life on the run with her witch mom Yurie, who is desperate to save her daughter from the imperial temple's relentless witch hunt. But when Yurie finally dies from the mana that has overtaken her body, Mariette must fulfill a promise to watch over her new dad, the strong and cool Duke Descartes, who is destined by the story to be a slave of the temple. With the help of her witch protector Koon, can Mariette awaken her powers and save her dad?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Moto Shougun no Undead Knight @comic

Lambert, one of the great generals from Regios kingdom, was suspected of planning a rebellion against his lord at the end of the unification war, and as a result, he died an unnatural death.

Two hundred years later, when the era had changed and the Regios kingdom had entered its peaceful era, he was accidentally revived as a demon called Undead Knight Lambert, whose entire body was wrapped in a flashy Demon Metal Organ.

So Lambert set out on a journey to punish the wrongdoers while enjoying the peaceful sight of Regios kingdom. But... this peaceful era was basically an easy mode for Lambert, the greatest general of the chaotic era.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

synopsis:
It's said that the people in this world have evolved from their cat ancestors. Both males and females can give birth.

Masachika's a famous actor. His husband, Grim, hosts his own radio show. Despite being worried at first about their age gap and difference in status, Grim is soon overcome by Masachika's extreme love and the two marry. Masachika starts his life as a newlywed! However, as an actor, he's so popular that his schedule is overwhelming and the two have trouble finding the time to spend and enjoy with each other. Masachika's feeling unsatisfied, but one moment in front of his man has him weak in the knees. Grim can't help loving that about him. Their thoughts and love for each other growing deeper by the moment, Masachika goes out on an extended shoot. After two weeks go by, his texting with Grim becomes scarcer and scarcer until eventually it stops altogether...!

title: Bloody Eye: Sarasarete Shine
title_japanese: ブラッディ・アイ－晒されてシネ－
synopsis:
A reporter working for a weekly tabloid is getting involved in a bizarre serial murder case where a red eye symbol is left behind on every victim.

(Source: Manga Mogura)

title: Constellations of the Gods
synopsis:
Princess of the Underworld and Goddess of Resurrection, Lucalis, comes into being from the peculiar union of Hades and Persephone. Despite her divine nature, Lucalis finds herself facing a challenge beyond her years: she’s never felt love! This has slowed her growth, both in body and heart. With this handicap, how can Lucalis face the jealousies, power struggles, and divas of Olympus’s divine world?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Post-Possession Damage Control
synopsis:
Seven years ago, Kanna was thrown into the body of a Korean girl named Joohwa. She had everything in her new life—a loving family, a great boyfriend, a hard-won medical license, even her own clinic! But that all changes when she's suddenly swapped back one day. Just as she's been in Joohwa's body, Joohwa has been in hers... and she's left Kanna's life a mess! First things first, she's going to divorce her cold husband, Duke Silvian Valentino. After that? Revenge on everyone who's wronged her.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Blue Flame
synopsis:
Mun Gaya suffered from childhood trauma. After transferring schools, he meets Cha Aeri, the perfect model student and the beloved queen. Gaya gradually falls in love with her, and something inside that has been suppressed begins to awaken.

"Can we be free in this hell?"

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: A Martial Master Wakes Up as a Concubine
title_english: A Martial Master Wakes Up as a Concubine
synopsis:
Even Cheon Nyeonbi, one of the four archvillains of the martial arts world, fell in love—only to be poisoned by her beloved and left to die alone in a cold, dark cave. Brokenhearted and furious, Nyeonbi suddenly opens her eyes as the affluent Lady Cheon Soyeo, a quiet and dreary concubine in the imperial palace with no prospects and seemingly nothing in common with Nyeonbi.

Nyeonbi's quirky and bold personality quickly makes waves throughout the palace. She is confident her newly acquired womanly charms have won the affections of the infamous General Heuk-hap, who secretly brings her rice cakes at night but ignores her during the day. Moreover, the emperor suddenly begins to summon her for "night duties," yet he makes no advances on her. Confused by the men's behavior, Nyeonbi attempts to avoid the uninteresting schemes of the court and learn the reason behind this ridiculous second chance at life.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Baby Pharmacist Princess
synopsis:
Just by clicking the wrong button, I ended up possessing the game's princess character, "Cherise"! Yoon Che-ri, a graduate of a pharmaceutical university. Like the so-called hardcore gamer she is, she unexpectedly transports into the VR game she plays every day. A red rabbit puts her in debt to the game, owing 10 billion gems... If she doesn't repay the debt of 10 billion gems, she won't be able to log out?

♡ Surprise Quest Triggered ♡
User's ability confirmed as "Pharmaceuticals," customized settings have been completed accordingly. Future quests will focus on "Pharmaceuticals."

[Confirm] ◀

Huh? Why do I feel excessively capable...? If things go on like this, I might be able to return soon! Will Cherise really be able to settle the 10-billion gem debt and return to her original world?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: How to Diet as a Lady
title_english: How to Diet as a Lady
synopsis:
Whether it's going on a diet or navigating high society, Yoonah never thought she'd have to worry about either... before waking up in the Brighton Empire as Lady Eleanor. Not only is "Eleanor" clueless when it comes to things like etiquette, but she also has to deal with snobby socialites who constantly ridicule her figure. Fortunately, the talented captain of the imperial knights and the most elegant lady in town agree to help her on her journey to health and grace. But is Eleanor prepared for the horror of eating salads 24/7 while minding all her table manners?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Jibun wo Suki ni Naritai kara Seikei suru Hanashi
title_english: The Story about Plastic Surgery to Love Yourself
title_japanese: 自分を好きになりたいから整形する話
synopsis:
Haruka Suzuki, age 24, has low self esteem and body dysmorphia thanks to her family upbringing. What gives her hope to change her life is cosmetic surgery.

High costs, postoperative pain, risk of surgical errors and complications... cosmetic surgery is not some sort of magical cheat that can easily change how you were born. Nevertheless, Haruka has decided of her own free will to have plastic surgery, in order to look forward to living her life...!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Skalighty
synopsis:
A robot on a solitary journey in a world that has ended. Ars aims to help the human survivors' by taking their bad memories and "killing" them. They also want to learn more about humans and their relationships with each other. A fragile but gentle journey to the end of the world begins...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Naruto Gaiden: Uzu no Naka no Tsumujikaze
title_english: Naruto: The Whorl within the Spiral
title_japanese: NARUTO-ナルト-外伝 〜渦の中のつむじ風〜
synopsis:
Long before Naruto Uzumaki mastered the formidable Rasengan, Minato Namikaze trains to develop the ninjutsu under the tutelage of his mentor Jiraiya. Minato strives to create his own powerful technique to protect Kushina Uzumaki, the strong-willed woman he loves.

Honoring Uzumaki clan tradition, Kushina's body hosts the nine-tailed fox spirit, Kurama. The demon seeks to break free from his confines and wreak havoc on the world. As Kushina struggles against Kurama's power and her own inner turmoil, Minato hurries to complete the Rasengan and save her from herself.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

synopsis:
In July 2116, the Southeast Asia Union (SEAUn) and the Japanese government begin to export the Sibyl System to the coastal town of Shambala Float during a civil war as an experiment in spreading the system throughout the world. Under Sibyl's rule, Shambala Float achieves temporary peace and safety, but when SEAUn sends terrorists to Japan, now able to slip through the Sibyl System and attack Japan from within, the shadow of a certain man falls on the incident and Inspector Akane Tsunemori must lead her team to Shambala Float to investigate.

(Source: Psycho-Pass Wiki)

title: The Player
synopsis:
"Another fool secured."

I met my first love at college, and I believed it would last forever. However, I soon realized that I was just one of the men being toyed with by her.

After this revelation, Chanwoo decides to treat trash like trash. Observing this change, Jeonghwa does her best to maintain control over him. Nevertheless, Chanwoo still has his friend Soyeon, his cute underclassman Jihye, and his professor Yura. What will unfold for the five of them?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

A university student, Tsubame Takashina, who has no presence, meets a boy, Taisei Kyogoku, and tries to overcome her negative attitude little by little.

(Source: Number Nine, translated)

title: Taming the Corrupted
synopsis:
Aren Sercia succeeded in finding the man who would one day become the strongest swordsman. Before the crown prince could take him under his wing, she registered him as her younger brother. Although they shared not a single drop of blood, she treated him more kindly than anyone else, raising him well. One day, he would surely save her from her bastard of a fiancé who killed her in her previous life, and she would also have him go to war in her father's stead.

"From the moment I first saw you, I have never thought of you as family, my dear sister." His sharp eyes were filled with possessive desires. It was a beast that she brought in as her younger brother.

(Source: Naver, translated)

First-year high school student Kenjiro has been secretly in love with Tosaki-san from the same class since the beginning of the school year. Tosaki-san is kind to everyone, but for some reason, she's cold only towards Kenjiro...!

(Source: MU)

title: Ghoul ga Sekai wo Sukutta Koto wo Watashi dake ga Shitteiru
title_english: Only I Know the Ghoul Saved the World
title_japanese: グールが世界を救ったことを私だけが知っている
synopsis:
A heavy mist has fallen over the world, twisting many humans into horrifying monsters. Humanity is losing the battle against these grotesque fiends, but it is not entirely without defenses. Leon Crossheart is an adventurer, a hero, a hunter of ghouls... and a ghoul himself ! His strength and regenerative ability are unmatched, but this power comes at a price: He's reviled by the very people he strives to protect. However, there is one girl he saved who sees beyond his frightening appearance. Alice is so grateful that she wants to be his disciple, and she isn't taking no for an answer! Will she bring light into his dark and bloodstained life, or will he keep her—and therefore his own salvation—out of reach?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Zombie Fight
synopsis:
As life gets harder, Ian pushes his emotions away and resists. His father's violence and debts increase. The misfortunes continued and his body became increasingly numb, when he accidentally walks in on an illegal fight and receives an offer. "If you get in the game, I will give you all the money on this floor." His survival period begins, where he must survive in an illegal fighting arena.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

synopsis:
In another world where the Royal family power is on decline, and turmoil are lasting.

In a remote village, a young child, who will later be named Ars, is "gardening" and "improving the land." Having the memories of his previous life, he who was fond of "city building" games, initiated to do "selective breeding for crops" and "house constructions" with his own magic to get out of poverty, and finally acquired a "brick creation!" Selling his bricks to a peddler, he obtains a rare egg of a "tamed beast," but can he raise it safely?

Later called as a "Living God," this is the beginning of the heroic tale of a young boy who founded a nation!

(Source: TO Books, translated)

title: Way to Heaven
synopsis:
A strange relationship began when orphan siblings met an old lady who claimed to be their grandmother. However, the old woman is a martial master, who has lost her memory due to an illness. The old lady recognizes the hidden talent of the eldest sibling and starts to train him. Thus begins the journey of the Martial Goddess's disciple, the boy who is destined to reach the pinnacle of heavens.

(Source: Realm Scans)

title: Ane ni Iwareru ga Mama ni Tokkun wo Shiteitara, Tondemonai Tsuyosa ni Natteita Otouto: Brocon Ane ni Kitaeraresugita Shinmai Boukensha, Yagate Eiyuu to Naru

title: Void: No. Nine - 9-banme no Utsuro
title_japanese: Void: No. Nine -9番目のウツロ‐
synopsis:
Three hundred years ago, God destroyed the world. All that remains of humanity lives deep underground, far from the blasted surface—and far from The Emissaries, remnant soldiers of the divine war against mankind. Most live quite lives in the tunnel cities, but the few daring or desperate enough to risk death work as scavengers, collecting relics of the old world...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Yuki to Sumi
synopsis:
Sentenced to death for the crime of sadistically killing his entire village, Neneo is all but ready to accept his unfortunate fate when he is mysteriously bought and saved by the wealthy heiress Freya. Emotionless and numb to the world, Freya is also an outcast, hiding deep wounds of her own. Unfazed by the tales of Neneo's crimes, she enlists him to accompany her in her exile to the far north. As this unlikely pair, both shunned by a cold world, venture together into the deep snow, they begin to find warmth in each other. But the past won't let itself be so easily forgotten...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Superstar wo Uttate.
title_japanese: スーパースターを唄って。
synopsis:
"I don't know if I want to rap. I don't have anything I want to sing."

Yukito Ooji, is a 17-year-old drug dealer living on the streets of Osaka in a hopeless environment, killing his emotions. He lost his mother, a drug addict, and his beloved sister when he was a child, leaving him alone in the world, but he has a best friend who believes in him. Will he be able to get out of his helpless situation?

(Source: MU)

title: My Home Afro Tanaka
title_japanese: マイホームアフロ田中
synopsis:
Hiroshi Tanaka, 35 years old. After marriage and having a baby, his next distant dream is one of owning a home. "Land is expensive! But I don't want to take out a loan!" With his head turning afro, he embarks on a new journey.

An unpredictable home-life comedy begins!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Kono Yo wa Tatakau Kachi ga Aru
title_japanese: この世は戦う価値がある
synopsis:
Kiri Itou, third year in a company. She gets by on stacks of energy drinks, dealing with a bad job, a sexually harassing workplace, and a morally harassing boyfriend. In the midst of her daily life, she is trying to survive with only one thing in mind: "I want to be useful to other people"... until a letter arrived in her mail. In it was a card. It was her right to live freely.

At the age of 25, the end of a life of dedication. And the biggest and last revenge of her life begins!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Green Light for Romance
synopsis:
When the fortune teller told Shion Lee, "You are destined to be with bad guys!" Shion was skeptical, but so far, the fortune teller has been 100% correct. Every single man she has dated turned out to be a shameless jerk! Enter Yujin Oh, a student she met years ago when her teaching career had just begun. He's all grown up now, and he's handsome, kind, and sincerely interested in her. Will Yujin turn out to be a green light in her love life or is he just another horrible date?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Rental Hero
synopsis:
Juwon Lee works as a doppelganger who poses as a hero's alter-ego, and fills in for them in their social life while they perform their duties as heroes. One day, Justice, the strongest hero, approaches Juwon and requests his services with the promise of a hefty payment in return for his work. However, when Juwon arrives at their meeting spot, he is instead greeted by a completely unexpected sight...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Uraomote no Koiwazurai
synopsis:
Ryou Igarashi has good looks and the perfect job at a bank. He even has a fuck buddy, Asahi Takakura, a charming and stylish older man. They're madly in love—or so Ryou believes—so he decides to take the next step: he proposes!

"I'm not looking for that kind of relationship." He gets totally rejected, shattering his pride and heart!

Ryou throws himself into his work, hoping to forget all about his broken heart. One day, Asahi shows up at the bank asking for a loan—unshaven, dishevelled and shabbily dressed; he looks completely different from before. Things get awkward as their relationship teeters between the personal and professional. Even the section chief, Iwasaki, gets involved!

A drama-filled love story between clumsy and timid men!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Boruto: Two Blue Vortex
synopsis:
In a cruel twist of fate, Boruto's and Kawaki's lives have been switched due to a powerful jutsu. Now branded a traitor, Boruto is on the run from his village and training with Sasuke. But when Konoha comes under attack, it's time for a grown-up Boruto to return home and show how powerful he's become!

(Source: VIZ Media)

title: I'll Become the Heroine in This Life
title_english: I'll Become the Heroine in This Life
synopsis:
If Amber Verdi had known a goddess was a fan of her novel, she never would've discontinued writing it. Unfortunately, she's angered a goddess. And as punishment, she must become a side character and help the female and male leads, Freya Ardel and Kyle Blackwood, reach a happy ending. But when Freya suddenly dies as a result of her actions, she manages to pacify the enraged goddess once again by becoming the new heroine of the story. Will Amber's journey with Kyle bring a satisfying conclusion for her most extreme fan?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Maou ga Zutto Miteiru
title_japanese: 魔王がずっと見ている
synopsis:
One day, Reynolds, a demonic youth who worries that the job of "demon king" is not suitable for him, finds a purpose in life. That is to support Ellie, a brave girl who is single-mindedly working towards her dream of "defeating the Demon King." This is a story about a demon king who can't take his eyes off the hero!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Yumenashi-sensei no Shinro Shidou
title_japanese: 夢なし先生の進路指導

title: Talent Agent and the Threads of Fate
title_english: Talent Agent and the Threads of Fate
synopsis:
Ever since former screenwriter, Injoon Kim, was nearly taken to the underworld by mistake, he has been able to see Threads of Fate—white where fortune awaits, and black where misfortune looms. This newfound ability quickly proves itself useful as Injoon becomes a manager in the entertainment industry and successfully saves the actress, Hye-ryung Yun, from a fatal accident. Will Injoon be able to use these Threads to his advantage and bring Hye-ryung to stardom?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Datsugoku Doctor Inochiya Enma
title_japanese: 脱獄ドクター いのち屋エンマ
synopsis:
There are hundreds of manga about skillful doctors already, but among them "Doctor Enma" offered a different kind of entertainment. Mitsuya Enma was known as a "Speed of Light Surgeon" that can conduct any operation successfully in a short time. The only person he couldn't save with his hands is his little sister, forcing him to involve with drugs trafficking to collect treatment money. He was arrested and put in a cage, but one day, a mysterious, beautiful woman, Kanon, helped him jailbreak on one condition; to serve as a black-market doctor that has to do a time-limited illegal operation with Kanon as the assistant.

(Source: Torico)

title: Kimetsu no Yaiba Novelize
title_japanese: 鬼滅の刃 ノベライズ
synopsis:
As long as anyone can remember, there have been rumors of man-eating demons living in the woods. Even in the more enlightened Taishou era, the townspeople never go near there at night. Tanjirou Kamado, a kind boy who has been supporting his family as a coal seller since his father died, quickly learns that the local superstition is more than just rumors when he returns home one day to find his family slaughtered by demons. Only he and his sister Nezuko manage to survive, but she is transformed into a demon. Determined and resolute, he is recruited into the Demon Slayer Corps and his quest to help turn his sister human again and avenge his family's deaths begins.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Nidome no Koi wa, Hayami-kun to
title_japanese: 二度目の恋は、早水くんと
synopsis:
The manga is about a girl who confesses to a guy she likes, right after starting school, but gets instantly rejected. To make the failed confession more heartbreaking, the school's cool guy witnesses the whole scene.

(Source: ANN)

title: Baeru Koi toka Shirimasen
title_japanese: 映える恋とか知りません

title: Boukun Ou no Kekkon
title_english: The Marriage of a Tyrant King
synopsis:
It'll be simple once we've bed each other. You'll lose yourself to me... especially if this is your first. Ritsu, a normal college student, receives an unexpected letter. It says that he is betrothed to a king in a foreign country per his late grandfather's promise...! With no interest in love, let alone marrying a man, he refuses! Ritsu travels far to arrive at the royal palace where he meets Seren, a king with unparalleled beauty. Seren steals a kiss, claiming there isn't a living soul who hasn't fallen for me...

(Source: Mobile Media Research/Funguild)

title: The Human
synopsis:
In 2036, the World Olympic Committee made the groundbreaking decision to lift all restrictions on doping for athletes. All those hallowed, longstanding records of human ability were buried in a single night of competition. The public enthusiasm for the performances was suffocating. The new rules were here to stay.

But, not all athletes want to dope. Not all of them see the "enhanced" records as legitimate. And Mike, a clean-running 100-meter specialist, is about to hit these steroid monsters with his very best shot.

(Source: MU)

title: All Day Jo Ayoung
synopsis:
A blunt but kind big brother and the bright and innocent Ayoung live in apartment building 201, suite number 202. This is the story of the everyday life of these cute siblings and their unpredictable neighbors!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Dogsred
synopsis:
The stage is the proud land of the north—Hokkaido. The year is 2010. Rou Shirakawa has just received the highest score in history at the All-Japan Junior Figure Skating Championships! But suddenly, he loses control and starts destroying the stage. He is quickly disqualified and banned from the skating world for life. Now nicknamed "the Rabid Prince," Rou ends up in Tamakomai, an ice hockey town in northern Japan. And on a hockey rink on a frozen lake, he meets the ruthless Genma brothers! Rou will soon learn of the famous Oino-kami high school and their quest to win an unprecedented 20th straight national hockey championship. And also the strong, yet beautiful battle sport—ice hockey! Change, grow, evolve! Turn defeat into victory in this red-hot redemption story!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Boku Igai Zennin Tenseisha ka yo
title_english: Everyone Is from Another World, Except Me!?
title_japanese: 僕以外全員転生者かよ
synopsis:
Rocco is a novice adventurer who begins his journey to save his sister Natty, who is cursed by a demon and asleep.

At an adventurer's guild, he meets Taiga, who was given extraordinary abilities when he was reincarnated from another world! He also meets Sawyer and Mia, who were also reincarnated from another world and have cheat abilities, but something happens that shocks even them!

An entertaining and poignant otherworldly fantasy featuring a party of a novice adventurer, Rocco, and three reincarnated characters from another world!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Hakoniwa Monster: Shoujo Mangaka, Tokidoki Kamibukuro
title_japanese: 箱庭モンスター ～少女漫画家、ときどき紙袋～
synopsis:
A manga editor who finally freed himself from the exhausting work on weekly shounen magazines thought things would be easier when he started in a shoujo magazine's editorial department. But the manga artists there turn out to be truly one of a kind!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Kimi no Koto ga Daidaidaidaidaisuki na 100-nin no Kanojo: Bangai Koimonogatari - Secret Love Story
title_english: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You: Secret Love Story
title_japanese: 君のことが大大大大大好きな100人の彼女 番外恋物語 ～シークレットラブストーリー～
synopsis:
The hit manga The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You gets its first-ever spin-off novel! Rentarou loses his memory, Nano gets possessed by an alien, everybody gets isekai'd into Shizuka's favorite book, the cast pilots a giant robot—what on earth is going on?! Includes brand-new illustrations from series artist Yukiko Nozawa!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: The Archduke's Fabulous Fake Marriage
synopsis:
When Shaye opens her eyes in the Schubeiden Archduchy, she knows she must run. Reincarnated as the fourth villainess from a novel she never even finished, Shaye has no intention of staying with the male lead, Archduke Lacius de Schubeiden, and meeting her doom. However, Lacius saves her from slave traders, and as he is a rare art magician who brings drawings to life, Shaye reconsiders her position as she needs enough money to disappear.

Cursed with an allure that drives women to obsession, Lacius immediately finds Shaye's indifference refreshing—and potentially useful. He proposes a three-year fake marriage, during which Shaye will deter his relentless admirers. Enticed by the offered money, Shaye agrees to play the perfect villainess, protecting him from the three other far more dangerous villainesses—at least until the heroine finally arrives.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Cat in the Chrysalis
synopsis:
Neglected by her family, Kitt develops a silent affection for Edwin, a man she encounters in a library, yet she never reveals her feelings before he tragically dies. Haunted by this loss, Kitt miraculously awakens in a time prior to the fatal event. As she attempts to save Edwin, she finds out he has lost his will to live a long time ago, caught in a cycle of death and time reversals. Undeterred by Edwin's cold demeanor, Kitt persists in her efforts. Could she hold the key to his salvation?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Mechamecha Kininatteru Gal ga Nanka Yabee Kanji ni Natteku Yatsu.
title_japanese: めちゃめちゃ気になってるギャルがなんかやべー感じになってくやつ。

title: Teni Muhou: Kizuna
title_english: Kizuna: Hand of God Unbound by the Heavens
synopsis:
"A doctor is never off duty. Every day of the year, every hour of every day."

Even though his enemy is the corrupted medical world, Jou Busujima, the highly-skilled rumored surgeon will never turn down any patient!

(Source: Torico)

title: Minikui Yuukaku no Ko
title_english: Ugly Duckling of the Entertainment District
synopsis:
Abandoned by her latest family, Esora is left with nothing and nowhere to go. Starving, she steals food from a temple and sneaks inside to wait out a thunderstorm. When she wakes up, she's been transported to a different realm, and sold in chains to a mysterious man in a paper mask. Trapped in a strange new world, Esora must now begin training to become a Courtesan if she wants any hope of regaining her freedom and discovering the masked man's secret...

(Source: Mangamo)

title: Ore no Koto Mukashi no Mama dato Omotteta? Irai shita Housekeeper wa Bed Making ga Nigate deshita.
title_english: I'm Not the Boy You Remember: My Housekeeper Has Trouble Keeping the Sheets Clean
title_japanese: 俺のこと昔のままだと思ってた? ‐依頼したハウスキーパーはベッドメイキングが苦手でした。‐
synopsis:
Shizuka is a successful, career-driven woman. But, unbefitting of her pristine appearance, her apartment is a total mess. A friend, unable to accept the sorry state of her friend's place, books a cleaner to come and sort it out. On her doorstep stands her former junior high-school classmate, Takumi Yotsuya, who she had once said hurtful things to. As Takumi deftly cleans her apartment, he comes across a very embarrassing personal object. Mortified, Shizuka agrees to do anything Takumi says as long as he doesn't tell anyone. His reaction is to bring her close and lick her ear. The once timid and effeminate Takumi has grown into a hunk of a man... one that drives Shizuka wild!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Märchentic Bazooka
title_japanese: メルヘンチック・バズーカ
synopsis:
Aiming to be top comedians, the comedy duo Märchentic Bazooka live together and go to training school while streaming videos. Aki is a handsome yet unfortunate man who has had an intense crush on his partner Haru, also known as "My Sweet Angel," since their high school days when they first formed the duo. Though Aki tries terribly hard to show his feelings, Haru won't have anything to do with him...?

(Source: Julian Publishing, translated)

title: The Tower's Trapped Hunter
synopsis:
In a monster-infested world, only those summoned by the Tower become hunters, powerful individuals with special skills. Despite his ardent wish to become one, Hyunsoo Cho is stuck slaving away for other hunters. But when a near-death experience gives him a chance to fulfill his dream by bringing him to the Tower, Hyunsoo seizes it, only to discover that he cannot leave until he reaches the 100th floor! Will this hunter successfully get to the top, or will his dream end up being a nightmare?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: I Hold the Tyrant's Heart
synopsis:
While being reborn into a loving noble family with powerful elven blood certainly isn't a bad fate, Eucenielle can't forget the people she left behind in her previous life. All she wants is to return to her original world, but things get complicated when the crybaby crown prince, Tes, falls head-over-heels for her. Once they reunite as adults, Eucenielle is disturbed by the drastic change in Tes' looks and personality, which everyone else seems oddly oblivious to. Though she has a feeling Tes resorted to dark measures to win her heart, Eucenielle finds herself being drawn to the tyrant regardless...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Komadori wa, Yoru no Tobari
title_english: Robin in the Veil of Night
synopsis:
After a string of suspicious deaths strikes the political sphere, police officer Norito is dispatched to investigate the possible involvement of a religious cult. He drags his brother Shinji, a reticent folklorist, along to Hirasaka, a remote village hidden deep in the snowy mountains. Norito and Shinji are taken to the residence of the village chief, a strikingly beautiful Shinto priest named Yoshiomi. The snow shrouds his estate in disquiet, and the brothers realize that their lives might be in danger unless they uncover what—or whom—the people of Hirasaka are hiding.

(Source: SuBLime)

title: Kono Ai wa Itan.: Belial Bunsho
title_japanese: この愛は、異端。-ベリアル文書-
synopsis:
Beautiful and distorted sensual story of the devil and the girl. Yoshino, who wasn't drawn in the main story when she was 18 years old. The contract with the devil Belial "will pay one price and one wish will come true" will change when Yoshino reaches the age of 18. A kiss that entangles the tongue as a consideration. A record that depicts the time when it changed from parents to men and women from the perspective of Belial.

(Source: MU)

title: Kuma Kuma Kuma Bear Gaiden: Yuna no Yorimichi Techou
title_japanese: くまクマ熊ベアー外伝～ユナのよりみち手帖～

title: Bara wa Shuraba de Umareru: 70-nendai Shoujo Manga Assistant Funtouki
title_japanese: 薔薇はシュラバで生まれる―70年代少女漫画アシスタント奮闘記―
synopsis:
Then an assistant for manga artists like Suzue Miuchi and Fusako Kuramochi in the golden age of shoujo manga (that is, manga aimed at girls), the artist of this book lovingly recounts the untold labors and passions of the genre's then-upcoming superstars. In the era's popular artistic style, the book recounts little-known anecdotes about the origins of masterworks and the veritable war zones of production, putting readers in the midst of it all.

(Source: Japan Media Arts Festival)

title: Don't Fall for the Villainess
synopsis:
My name is Lee Sera, and I somehow woke up in the body of the beautiful but despised public enemy of the empire, Igna Larkbella. To make matters worse, a letter just arrived demanding payment on an overwhelming amount of debt Igna acquired after ruining her family's 500-year-old business. It seems like I'm not going back home any time soon, so I need to set things straight if I'm going to survive here. It's time to make this villainess the most popular girl in the empire!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Tensei shitara Saikyoushu-tachi ga Sumau Shima deshita. Kono Shima de Slow Life wo Tanoshimimasu
title_english: Living a Laid-Back Second Life on the Island of the Strongest Species
title_japanese: 転生したら最強種たちが住まう島でした。この島でスローライフを楽しみます
synopsis:
Arata's wish for a strong body that doesn't get sick or hurt was granted when he was reincarnated on what he thought was an uninhabited island. While there aren't humans living there, the island is full of Divine Beasts, Ancient Dragons, Vampires, and Monsters! Arata thought he was in a desperate situation right from the get-go, but apparently his strong body that doesn't get sick or hurt is just too strong?!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Ani ga Nokoshita Koi no Yukue
title_english: My Brother Left Behind Someone We Loved
title_japanese: 兄が遺した恋のゆくえ
synopsis:
After his brother Haruki passes away, Kazuki heads to a coastal village to meet Yukito, his brother's omega widow, with the hopes of living with him after their devastating loss. Yukito reluctantly agrees to let Kazuki stay in the shed on the property but insists that he doesn't need any help in his day-to-day life. However, with the side effects from the heat suppressants taking their toll on his health, could living with Kazuki end up being beneficial after all?

(Source: Animate International)

title: Shiotaiou na Watashi ga Amayaka sareteimasu
title_japanese: 塩対応な私が甘やかされています
synopsis: One-shot series.

title: Twinstar Cyclone Runaway
title_japanese: ツインスター・サイクロン・ランナウェイ
synopsis:
Set 6,000 years after humanity has spread out across the stars, the story takes place inside a gigantic city ship orbiting a remote gas giant. The ship is home to a civilization of space fishers that catch valuable fish-like creatures known as Besshu. The society harvests the Besshu through ships operated by enforced male-female pairs of operator and pilot, who are seen by the male-dominated society as a married couple. The story centers on Terra, who is seeking a partner to operate a ship, and finds her in the mysterious runaway girl Diode, with both uniquely able to use the ship despite both being female.

(Source: ANN)

title: Big Man on the Court
synopsis:
Make a wish and destiny will make sure to interfere. Eundeok is a (wannabe) normal high school freshman. But alas, he is too tall and built for his own convenience—chased by every varsity team wooing him since Day 1, he runs and runs and then ends up in a basketball court, a space where his childhood trauma and frustration still remain. Mistaken as a rumored super-rookie, our hero reluctantly picks up the ball. But, this time, it looks like there is something to help him carry on.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Eve Festival
synopsis:
The story of two high school students and their growth as they have a hard time around immature adults. Jungwon Yoon, the model student and class president who seems to be hiding a secret, and Gilsung Kwak, a rising Taekwondo player stuck in his rebellious phase. Why are these two drawn toward each other? The tearful growth of two people exploring their youth!

(Source: Gobooky Books, translated)

title: Oshikake Jimiko no Seijijou
title_japanese: 押しかけ地味子の性事情

title: Suki ni Nattara, Sayounara.
title_japanese: 好きになったら、さようなら。
synopsis:
High school honors student Soya Furuhashi seems stern on the outside, but his underlying earnestness and naturally airheaded personality have made him well-liked by his peers. One day in the school bathroom, Soya meets a mysterious-looking guy who's drenched from head to toe. Wondering why he's never seen this student before, Soya later finds out that it was Motonari Kuga, the guy who was held back a year after rumors that he seduced other men...

(Source: Renta!)

title: Saikyou no Youhei Shoujo no Gakuen Seikatsu: Shoujo to Shoujo, Kaikou suru
title_english: School Life of a Mercenary Girl
title_japanese: 最強の傭兵少女の学園生活 ―少女と少女、邂逅する―
synopsis:
Cierra, a young girl who's been a skilled mercenary her whole life, decides to retire from being a mercenary and try to live like a regular school girl. While at her new school, Cierra befriends Alna, a young noble girl who's being targeted by assassins, and vows to protect her.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Kuma Kuma Kuma Bear: Kyou mo Kuma Kuma Biyori
title_japanese: くまクマ熊ベアー ～今日もくまクマ日和～

title: The Gangster Daughter of the Henchman Duke's Family
title_english: The Gangster Daughter of the Henchman Duke's Family
synopsis:
My name is Leonora Hachania. I'm the daughter of a minor extra villain, but I have a great desire for power. I can't leave the Hachanias as insignificant as the original!

"Cloudy to the left!" "Do it!" "Cloudy to the right!" "Just do it!" Showing off my sunglasses made with ink, I raised my voice. "Enoch, don't cry!" The third child, who made weak eye contact with me, was surprised and sniffed his runny nose. "Wahh, I won't cry!" I succeeded.

"Was it supposed to be this week? It's like trash." "Gasp! S-save me!" "Brother, why don't you kill him quickly because it looks like it would be a better thing for him." My older brothers who used to be extras became the world's greatest villains who can even blow the male lead away! The clumsy villain dad was a challenge though. "Lini, what else are you planning to do..." "Hoho, never mind. You're planning something mean like my daughter. That's good."

He was converted into a dual-personality villain. Haha! Good. I must use the original infor

title: Stalker
synopsis:
A reclusive, disfigured man stalks a pretty, good-natured housewife. One day, he witnesses this woman's daughter being kidnapped.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Gouman Ouji to Secret Love
title_english: The Arrogant Prince and Our Secret Love
title_japanese: 傲慢王子とシークレットラブ
synopsis:
Akito Kurehashi's got a small frame and baby face, but his skills as a bodyguard are top notch. Muzaffarid, crown prince of an Arabian oil-producing country, sets his hawk-like eyes on him! He doesn't want his body and heart stirred up by such an arrogant prince, and yet...!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Ikemen (Kari) to Renai shitemimashita!
title_japanese: イケメン(仮)と恋愛してみました!
synopsis:
1-3. Ikemen (Kari) to Renai shitemimashita! (I Dated a Part-Time Dreamboat)
4-6. Cherry Nail
7. Haru to Kai (Haru and Kai)

title: Fukushuu Daikou Hizumi-san
synopsis:
Masaichi Hizumi has a peculiar profession; as a revenge agent, he is hired by wronged individuals to carry out their revenge. This often results in forcibly introducing the target to the pleasures of anal sex. Serial adulterer Mikoto Kuga has found himself as one of Hizumi's targets, and Hizumi manages to make him feel things unbeknownst to him. But when Hizumi is hired by a second person to humble Kuga, their relationship evolves in a way that neither of them could have predicted.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

Included one-shot: Toshoshitsu no Yuurei-kun (Phantom, the Library Ghost)

title: Tatte wa Ikenai Danshiryou
title_japanese: たってはいけない男子寮

title: Yuki to Sumi
synopsis:
Company employee Tokiwa lives with his cousin Asagi. The two of them were living their normal, comfortable lives until one day, intoxicated with liquor on the night of Tokiwa's birthday, they began to reveal their deepest secrets...

"The truth is, I remember my past lives."
"The truth is, I'm a time traveler."

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kiss Meow
synopsis:
Sara comes back to life from a car accident with the grace of a cat god. But she is now under a cat spell—that is, Sara turns into a cat on rainy days. There is only one way to break the spell. She must fall in love with the cat butler of her destiny who truly loves and cares for cats, and kiss. On top of that, a mysterious yet familiar cat murderer starts chasing Sara's catself after she witnesses the murderer killing a cat with a stone. Will Sara be able to protect herself from the cat murderer? Will she be able to break the spell with a kiss from the butler of her destiny?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Beast Code
synopsis:
Raiki is a high school student who transforms into a dragon because he was born with the "Beast Code DNA" that laid dormant within him and generations of other people for centuries. Raiki now struggles with his new abilities and clashes with others who also possess the Beast Code DNA but plan to use their powers for wrongdoing. Conversely, Raiki's girlfriend Tomoko possesses DNA that instinctively compels her to battle against anyone who has the Beast Code DNA.

What is the fate of this couple who are now forced to fight to the death because of their genetic code? Beast Code is an ambitious sci-fi fantasy that asks what dictates the destiny of people: love or biogenetics?

(Source: eigoMANGA)

title: Kanojo to Kare no Kankei: Heibon na Hayakawa-san to Heibon na Miura-kun no Hibon na Kankei
title_japanese: 彼女と彼の関係 ～平凡な早川さんと平凡な三浦くんの非凡な関係～
synopsis:
"I wish I had a girlfriend, I don't even care who—"

"Really? Anybody? Even me?"

Kaho, who has never had a boyfriend before, wants to have a male-female relationship. Takumi, who wants a girlfriend, just happens to be talking about it in front of her... A heart-throbbing coming-of-age love story!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Tsuihou Boukensha no Yarinaoshi: Youseikai de Kitae Naoshite Jibun no Ibasho wo Tsukuru
title_japanese: 追放冒険者のやりなおし～妖精界で鍛えなおして自分の居場所をつくる～
synopsis:
"Glen, your bad reputation is dragging the party down. We're kicking you out today."

A party of adventurers formed from childhood friends. The day after a promotion exam, Glen was summoned to the guild and expelled by the party leader. The reason given was the "bad rumours" that followed Glen. The rumours had no basis, but Glen was already considering leaving the party, so he accepted the outcome and left the party. Alone, he returned to his hometown for the first time in a long while to catch up.

"Glen, leave this place."

What awaited him there were the people who raised him believing in the bad rumours.

"If you think I'm like that, then I'll be like that" he shouted as he disappeared into the forest.

This is a story about an adventurer trying to regain the things he has lost. Those who abandoned him will wallow in grief, while he moves forward with his new companions.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Sekai de Yuiitsu no "Shinkentsukai" nanoni Senryokugai to Yobareta Ore, Kakusei shita "Shinken" to Saikyou ni Naru
title_japanese: 世界で唯一の【神剣使い】なのに戦力外と呼ばれた俺、覚醒した【神剣】と最強になる

title: Dekiai sasete Kudasai, Yuuryou de
title_japanese: 溺愛させて下さい、有料で
synopsis:
Junko was deceived by her lover, who she didn't know was married. Because of it, she loses her job as a teacher. Junko's mood doesn't clears up, even when she won 5 million in the lottery, and she becomes desperate... In that moment Haruto appears in front of her, a handsome mysterious young guy.

"Would you like to spend your life with me for a fee?"

Haruto's words were so comforting to Junko, who wanted someone to be kind to her, even if it meant paying for it. It was only for one night, but Junko, who was empty in both body and mind, drowned in Haruto's lip service. But Haruto, who said that he was working as a escort to pay for his tuition, seems to have known Junko for a long time...?

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: The Dating Simulator Cheat Code
synopsis:
Ham Yulha downloaded a suspicious app to gain knowledge for a fling with Kang Junseo, a senior in the same department, who she fell in love with at first sight. Through the app, one can see the likability of handsome men, so in order to increase Junseo's likability...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Keyaki Shoutengai Sakura no Yu
title_japanese: けやき商店街 桜ノ湯
synopsis:
Tatsumi Azuma, a sociable third-year student at Keyaki High School, crashes into second-year Shunpei Eguchi and fractures his hand. But the stone-faced Shunpei is no ordinary student—rumor has it he'll kill anyone who so much as looks him in the eye! Afraid of retaliation, Tatsumi tells Shunpei he'll do anything to make up for his blunder. Thus, Shunpei puts him to work by making him help out at his family's bathhouse, Sakura-no-yu!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Argonaut: Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka - Eiyuutan

title_english: NieR Replicant ver.1.22474487139... Project Gestalt Recollections
title_japanese: NieR Replicant ver.1.22474487139... 《ゲシュタルト計画回想録》
synopsis:
From director Taro Yoko  and writer Jun Eishima comes this novel expanding upon the world of the critically acclaimed game NieR Replicant ver.1.22474487139...

The protagonist is a kind young man living in a remote village. In order to save his sister, Yonah, who fell terminally ill to the Black Scrawl, he sets out with Grimoire Weiss, a strange talking tome, to search for the "Sealed verses."

(Source: Square Enix)

title_japanese: ハッピーマリオネット

title: Outreijou
synopsis:
A large bus carrying students from Ryoureikan High School, attended by children from respectable families, plunged into an accident. The bus ended up at the scene of a yakuza conflict. While the students managed to survive, when they regain consciousness, it is the yakuza who were supposed to have died in the accident that end up inhabiting their bodies.

Eiji Shiokawa, a member of the Tsukihiro syndicate, awakens as "Shiori Kirino" and tries to blend into school life for the time being. However, suspicious incidents begin to occur in the surroundings...

With the appearance of a refined young lady with the soul of a yakuza, a never-before-seen conflict unfolds on the stage of an ultra-refined girls' school!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Shikyuuji: Koukou Kyuuji ni Ashita wa Nai
title_japanese: シキュウジ -高校球児に明日はない-
synopsis:
A legendary face-off between two high school baseball players in the national finals, one a naturally gifted talent, the other a hard-working monster. A fierce rivalry with their lives on the line.

(Source: MU)

title: Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken Bishokuden: Peko to Rimuru no Ryouri Techou
title_english: Regarding Reincarnated to Slime Gourmet Story: Peko & Rimuru's Cooking Book
title_japanese: 転生したらスライムだった件 美食伝～ペコとリムルの料理手帖～
synopsis:
The spinoff manga centers on a wounded goblin slayer warrior named Peko, a name given by Rimuru. Along with the new name, Rimuru gives Peko a new command: make everyone happy with a full stomach. Novice chef Peko's new challenge in the kitchen begins.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Noa-senpai wa Tomodachi.
title_english: Noa Is My Senior, and My Friend.
synopsis:
Sometimes, when life is hard, you just need a "friend."

Working at a game company, Rihito Ootsuka (23), is a "normal" guy who is a steady presence on and off the job. Noa Saotome (27) is a "hard-core" woman who likes to go all out at everything she does. Two people who usually wouldn't get along become "friends" by chance...? This is a start of an workplace "friendship" comedy that's a little sweet but also a little heavy!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Maru-kun: Hataraku Maltese
title_japanese: まるくん～はたらくマルチーズ～

title: Overpowered Healer
synopsis:
Summoned to another world and living as a mediocre healer, Sido, by a stroke of luck, begins to hear the voices of the gods. It turns out that the gods have been playing a long-term game with humans?!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Heart Crush
synopsis:
Second-year resident Daon Yoo followed her heart and confessed her feelings to visiting professor Juheon Kang at his farewell party. It's not like she's gonna see him again, right? But little did she know that he's decided to stay! Confused, embarrassed, and regretting the night before, Daon doesn't know what to do. Can she survive the rest of her residency while working with her crush? And what made Juheon decide to stay? Plus... will her colleagues ever stop being so damn annoying?!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Inu wa Kogarete Hizamazuku
title_english: A Good Dog Gets Down on His Knees
synopsis:
"Mr. Warden, the face you make when you're getting fucked... is adorable." He knows he shouldn't enjoy being dominated by a prisoner this much... But in this Dom/Sub universe, the cocksure prison warden can't help falling prey to the dangerous new prisoner.

(Source: WWWave Corporation)

synopsis: Chronicles the final battle of the series main character Curtis Rothko and explores what he was doing during the events of Mobile Suit Crossbone Gundam Dust.
