title: Douluo Dalu 5: Chongsheng Tang San
title_english: Soul Land V: The Rebirth of Tang San
title_japanese: 斗罗大陆 5 重生唐三
authors: Tang Jia San Shao|Dr. Daji|Yu, Yue
synopsis:
Tang San reincarnated into the world where monsters dominate against humans, treating them as slaves. Witnessing the cruelty of the monsters, he trains to save the humans from eternal demise. Not only does he vow to save humans, he has the important quest to find the reincarnated Xiao Wu.

(Source: INKR)

title: Bokutachi wa Mada Aoku: Daigaku Nyuugaku-hen
title_english: We're Still in the Spring of Life.
title_japanese: ボクたちはまだ青く 大学入学編
synopsis:
Issei Saegusa is a young man who met Tooru Arochi, a brusque transfer student, during his senior year of high school. After a series of twists and turns, the two are accepted into the same university. The morning of the entrance ceremony arrives with great anticipation. Although Issei wants to spend more time with Tooru, he doesn't want to neglect his studies either, because he is studying aerospace engineering. Tooru, on the other hand, wants to improve his social skills in university. Then, he meets someone new right away...?

(Source: Sankosha, translated)

title: Ramen Saiyuuki
synopsis:
Yutori Shiomi just graduated college but has only recently tasted ramen six months ago after coming back to Japan from the US and falling in love with it. She is incredibly talented in cooking, and has impeccable taste buds and food sense. She applies to the Serigawa Project, a company started by the famous ramen chef Serizawa Tatsuya that operates as a restaurant consulting company that focuses on ramen shops. Yutori is just as creative as she is blunt, even criticizing Serizawa’s ramen with its flaws. Although Yutori gets the job at the company, she will need more than creativity and cooking skills if she wants to master this job.

(Source: MangaHelpers)

During an outdoor class, Kenichi finds a hidden apple tree and eats one of its fruit. However, what awaits him after eating that forbidden fruit is terrible misfortune, as lucky sukebe accidents befall him! Is it only a coincidence or is it the apple tree's curse? Kenichi's turbulent and lewd days begin—!!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Even though she is totally unqualified, she goes there anyway. When she saw the new hire get into an accident outside his door, Miwa steps in to become the "pretend" housekeeper for her idol.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Unmei no Tsugai ni Propose da Nante
title_japanese: 運命の番に求婚〈プロポーズ〉だなんて
synopsis:
After a long struggle, former middle school rivals Yuu Shishikura and Haruto Kotani have officially become a couple. Though they have their playful spats, they are very passionate about each other. However, Yuu wants to take the next step in their relationship and look toward marriage, while Haruto carries some baggage from his family. They still have a long and winding road ahead if they want their relationship to stand the test of time.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Ai dake Sagashite Irarenai
title_japanese: 愛だけ探していられない
synopsis:
"I'm over 30, my job is great, and I have no plans to get married. Girls can live strong and independent lives!"

Miho is a dental hygienist with many boyfriends, Haruka is a model with a boy-toy boyfriend, and Kanuma is a construction worker with no man in her life. They are in their thirties, and while their work is fulfilling, their love lives are becoming more and more difficult...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Included one-shots:
Volume 1: Shiba Ichizoku no Hanayome
Volume 2: Reikoku Danshaku

title: NTR Ecchi
synopsis:
The innocent looking school teacher, Nao, is in a loving relationship with his handsome boyfriend, Ryota. For their one year anniversary, Ryota prepared a special present for him. Waiting alone at the park in the dark, Nao is accosted! It turns out, it's all a part of Ryota's cockold fetish! Nao always folds to Ryota's whims and desires, but can their relationship handle the strain of Ryota's domineering personality?

(Source: Houbunsha)

synopsis:
Alice, an elf who runs a confectionery shop in the forest, has to pay off the debt left by her parents. One day, while she was looking for fruits to use as ingredients, she fell in the Fountain of Wishes, and somehow got transported to modern Japan...!?

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken Bangai-hen: Toaru Kyuuka no Sugoshikata

synopsis:
Shizuko is a high school girl who told her senpai, Rei, that she thinks he's cute. Rei, a boy who is very popular with the girls, is surprised that she considers him cute and not handsome or cool like the other girls. A cute love story between a kouhai and her senpai.

(Source: MU)

title: Nise Moteo ni Renai Shinan wa Nigaomoi
title_japanese: 偽モテ男に恋愛指南は荷が重い
synopsis:
"Master, please make me a man."

Yuuma Hotaka has been changing schools all the time and has little connection with his friends. Not wanting to be forgotten after transferring schools, he came up with the idea of creating a strong character to live his school life. He now plays the role of a popular guy who has girlfriends all over the place, and together with his prince-like appearance, he has succeeded in becoming a popular guy. In reality, however, he is a pure-hearted boy who has never been in a relationship, let alone kissed anyone.

Then, a real popular guy, Tadashi Someya, transfers to Hotaka's class! Hotaka is impatient with Someya's attention-grabbing presence, but Someya begs him to teach him a technique to make the guy he likes fall in love with him. He asks Hotaka to teach him some techniques to make the guy he likes fall for him. The contents of the lesson are all practical exercises such as kissing and licking his chest...? 

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

In the Kingdom of Niels, where dragons fly, Kyle, a "half-demon" knight of demonic descent who can speak the tongue of dragons, has a fateful reunion with his past lover, Alfred. Three years ago, for reasons he keeps to himself, Kyle bade farewell to his boyfriend, though he has never forgotten about him. But Alfred, who had once been his direct superior, is now just a count of the borders, a margrave, while he is but an ordinary knight. Kyle also holds a certain secret, which he can never tell Alfred... Since he has no right to by his side, Kyle tries to distance himself from Alfred, but Alfred won't allow them to part―?

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

To bring order to the celestial world, the first Jade Emperor gathered representatives of the 12 Zodiac Signs, the 10 Symbols of Longevity, and the Guardians of the 5 Directions to create Cheonjihae. Lyun joined this organization as the trainee Yellow Dragon. What does Cheonjihae look like on her first day at work...? A fantasy drama about a special agency that takes place in a celestial world where various races live together.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

synopsis: Follows judoka Satoshi Fujigaki (modeled after real life Paralympic judoka Satoshi Fujimoto) as he trains in hopes of winning a gold medal in the Paralympics.

title: Kyuuketsuki no Inshuuai
synopsis:
The moment Kio meets her new company director, Haruomi, she feels a strong aching from within her body. He sweetly seduces her while kissing her neck relentlessly. The days of a neverending piercing sensation, gasping and moaning in pleasure. While drowning in his love, she recalls the memories of her previous life, "Haruomi" crying while holding "her" dying body. Sharp-blade fangs sticking out from his mouth... Surpassing time, both of them reunite. "I definitely won't let you go again." A tenacious love between a vampire and human, revolving around the past and present.

(Source: Printemps Shuppan, translated)

title: Shop Jibun
synopsis:
Naoto Nonoshima; commonly known as Choku, is an office worker who works for a medium-sized company known as Maruju. Desperate and drunk, Nonomura wakes up the next day in front of a store called "Shop Jibun." By getting involved with the store, Choku experiences various encounters with different people. One encounter that stands out is Mina, a 19-year-old girl with mysterious powers. During these experiences, Nonoshima begins to question his job as an unskilled office worker and is compelled to make a decision.

(Source: Goma Books, translated)

title: Daishimin
synopsis:
Kaneichiro Yamagata (45) is a novelist with a wife and children. He always aims for a "chic" way of life and is devoted to sake, gourmet food, and hobbies. The cheap apartment where Yamagata works is filled with eccentric residents. Together with one of them, Naoji Satake, he rode a classic car (Triumph TR3A, made in England) and headed for Yamanashi. Satake had been thinking about committing suicide due to the failure of his business, but as he listened to Yamagata's way of life along the way, he began to think again about living.

(Source: Goma Books, translated)

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Flanagan Boone Senki
title_english: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Battle Tales of Flanagan Boone
title_japanese: 機動戦士ガンダム フラナガン・ブーン戦記
synopsis:
A new tragic tale from the "One Year War" unfolds. Flanagan Boone, a Zeon soldier, trained under his beloved Commander Garma Zabi, but then, the Gundam, the "White Devil of the Federation," appeared... A new story of the One Year War begins from the perspective of Flanagan Boone, who appeared in the famous episode "Across the Atlantic Ocean" (Episode 28) of the Mobile Suit Gundam anime!

(Source: Hero's, translated)

title: Fate/Prototype: Sougin no Fragments
title_japanese: Fate/Prototype 蒼銀のフラグメンツ
synopsis:
Tokyo, 1991. Seven mages gather to summon seven heroes from history, myth, and legend to do battle in a great ritual. The last ones standing will obtain the Holy Grail—a font of limitless power said to be able to grant any wish. One such Master is Manaka Sajou, a young maiden with immense expectations placed on her. But when she lays eyes on the one she summons, what she sees is not her Servant but the fairy tale prince of her dreams!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Tensei Nihakobinin no Isekai Kouryakuhou
title_english: A Reincarnated Carrier's Strategy for Another World
title_japanese: 転生荷運び人の異世界攻略法
synopsis:
Sei has always yearned for a life of freedom, and when he's reborn into another world, it seems like he would finally have his dream life. Except he was born as a "carrier," a non-combative class that mostly uses their abilities to transport goods. But Sei has found a way to use his powers both in and out of fights, surviving on his own despite his low class. And while he travels the land seeing sights and picking up women, he'll prove that a lowly carrier is capable of conquering the world!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Tasogare no Hito
synopsis:
The manga's story begins when the relative of the president of a major company moves with their family to a quiet rural town. There, the family's son Tatsuomi plans his suicide, but is spotted by Riko, a local girl. While Tatsuomi is troubled by many things, Riko still intends to befriend him, and they slowly grow closer. When Tatsuomi's birthday approaches, Riko gives him both a gift and a certain promise.

(Source: ANN)

title: Fate/Samurai Remnant Jou
synopsis: Adaptation of the Fate/Samurai Remnant game prologue.

title: Do It Yourself!!
title_japanese: Do It Yourself!! -どぅー・いっと・ゆあせるふ-
synopsis:
Childhood friends Serufu and Purin are being torn apart after enrolling in different high schools. As Serufu dwells on ways to mend their broken relationship, a lucky quirk of fate brings her to the DIY club. It may be on its last legs, but this encounter will turn out to be a defining moment of Serufu's youth.

This is a story about furniture, friendship, and life. About girls that constantly toil and tinker in spite of the setbacks they suffer. They relentlessly struggle to finish what they start with their own hands, never giving up as they carve out their futures... And you are about to see them take their first steps.

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Bokura ga Koisuru 5-byou Mae: Ubu Koi BL Anthology

synopsis:
Whether it's between best friends, co-workers, classmates, or total strangers, those first moments when hearts flutter are always special. This manga collection features twenty-nine short BL stories from a variety of hit manga artists, including the creators of BL Metamorphosis, Manly Appetites, I Think I Turned My Childhood Friend Into a Girl, and more!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Star of the Overlord
synopsis:
With the appearance of the Overlord's Star in the sky, the world plunges into chaos, and only the one born with the essence of the star can save it. Amidst the upheaval, former comrades Woonhoi Baek and Ryuyoung Chun each dream of becoming the Overlord. Ryuyoung to save his family, and Woonhoi because he has nothing else to lose. But as the star shines brighter, the two find themselves swept up in an impending war. Both men's ambitions burn fiercely, but only one Overlord can reign supreme!

(Source: Tapas Media)

synopsis:
Stella finds herself reincarnated into the beloved fairy tale "Cinderella" as one of the evil step-sisters who bullies Cinderella?! She tries to get along with Cinderella in order to avoid the original ending of the fairy tale, which would see her fall into ruin...!?

A unique, realistic (?) Cinderella story that begins with reincarnation!

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

title: Radio Storm
synopsis:
Are love and salvation possible at the end of the world? For war academy student Sak, they're nothing more than pipe dreams. Bullied by his peers for his seemingly useless powers, Sak can only focus on survival. But when a deadly plague compromises the haven of his school, fantasy suddenly starts looking a whole lot more like reality. To keep safe, Sak must find his Caller—a person who amplifies his abilities and who he'll feel an innate, deep sense of affection for. The only problem? When he finally meets his stranger, he's convinced Sak has lost his mind...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Koutei to Kaibutsu
synopsis:
"I am the first emperor, Utosa"

In the basement of the palace, a mausoleum was protected by heavy metal doors. A monster was said to sleep there. Tao, a mere puppet to his ministers, had never once tasted power. Even his only friend was executed by the ministers under him. Desperate, he enters the forbidden depths, encountering a man with white hair...?

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Punks△Triangle
synopsis:
Fashion student Chiaki dreams of seeing his designs on the runway, worn by none other than Ai—the charismatic male model who changed his life. When a prestigious competition promises to make that dream come true, Chiaki is fired up to win. But his hopes are dashed when he's paired with the clumsy and unfashionable Enaga for the project. One fateful night, after a run-in with some delinquents, Chiaki is unexpectedly saved by his idol Ai. Even more shocking, Ai seductively offers to teach him how to have fun at night...

Caught between the alluring, mysterious model he worships and a clumsy, rough-around-the-edges classmate who can't seem to stay out of trouble (but may be hiding a surprising secret), Chiaki faces a heart-pounding, pure boy's love dilemma that will turn his world upside down!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

It took five years to grow his fanbase, but he's hit a serious plateau. When he gets a chance to collab with Yuu, a brand-new femboy VTuber, he gets a huge boost in followers—and maybe a friend too?! But when they finally meet IRL, it turns out that the voice behind Yuu is actually an incredibly handsome man! Can Yuu bring out Haruki's true nature and help him be more comfortable in his own skin? Log on for this Boys' Love Vtuber romance!

For the sake of that man who lost his purpose in life, Kanji started to perform his magic tricks! The next day, Nise, who looked much better, came to the bar where Kanji was working part-time. "Thanks to you, I had a special time. I want to become your special one." In front of his coworkers and other customers, Kanji was confessed to by Nise and it was completely like a proposal?!

He was content with his school life until Shouta Tsuchiya, a flirty moron, appears on the scene one day. "Wow, your experiments are so cool, senpai!" Although they're complete opposites in every way, for some reason, Shouta takes a liking to Okano. And as he's pushed around by Shouta after he strong-arms his way into the science club, Okano begins to develop feelings he's never felt before...!

In a remote village, a young child, who will later be named Ars, is "gardening" and "improving the land." Having the memories of his previous life, he who was fond of "city building" games, initiated to do "selective breeding for crops" and "house constructions" with his own magic to get out of poverty, and finally acquired a "brick creation!" Selling his bricks to a peddler, he obtains a rare egg of a "tamed beast," but can he raise it safely?

Later called as a "Living God," this is the beginning of the heroic tale of a young boy who founded a nation!

Reborn from modern Japan into a medieval fantasy world where gender roles are flipped, Faust is an anomaly—a rare male knight! Raised as a frontier lord, his old-world values clash hilariously with his new life. The queen's attire leaves little to the imagination, and the busty duke's "friendly" advances verge on harassment! Despite getting flustered in court, Faust is a dazzling hero on the battlefield whose prowess can turn the tide of any battle.

When Faust is tasked with advising Princess Valiele on her first mission, what was meant to be a simple skirmish against bandits quickly spirals into an unimaginable trial. Dive into the first volume of a heroic gender-bent saga!

Akasegawa is not in the mood to write so he teases Marutomi by saying, "I can't write until you make me feel like it. You can't do it, can you?" But he gets an unexpected reply, "If it'll you write..." Akasegawa realizes that Marutomi might be more amusing than he expected...!

Eun-ha, who dreamed of becoming a teacher, finally became a shift student. However, she finds out that one of her classmates is Seung-min, who was Eun-ha's first love and childhood friend. However, Seung-min was an iljin (bully/delinquent) when they were in middle school and high school and he cut ties with her, but now he's approaching her little by little!!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: As If Love Doesn't Exist
synopsis:
Siyeon had the rug pulled out from under her when she realized that everything in her life was a lie—her parents are not her real parents, her fiance not really her fiance, and her cousin Eunhye is actually the birth daughter of this household. Siyeon is resigned to her misfortunes until Eunhye reveals to Siyeon that all of this was planned and orchestrated. Swallowing her tears of anguish, Siyeon makes a fateful wish that brings her 10 years into the past where she may be able to change everything... or can she?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Tonari no Vampire-san
title_japanese: となりのヴァンパイアさん
synopsis:
What will happen if three vampire sisters started living in your ordinary neighborhood? There's Ella, the beautiful and conservative eldest sister; Angelica, the air-headed and girly middle child; and Rinden, the quiet and cool youngest daughter. They have to stay in Koharu apartment to learn more about human society, from experiencing human romance, the thrill of chasing dreams, to endless struggle in tight-budget conditions.

(Source: Torico)

title: Summer Letter
synopsis:
"You're my new boyfriend!"

With the lousy excuse that she made a bet with her friends, Boye storms into the life of quiet, model student Taebom, demanding that he act the part of her boyfriend. Little does he know however, that Boye has had her eye on him for quite some time...

(Source: Manta)

title: Young Love
synopsis:
At an age when everything is uncertain but exciting, a group of university students find themselves dealing with the ups and downs of life, love, and friendship. Popular freshman Yootae is learning how to take his first steps into romance, while shy senior Somin recovers her confidence after her failed first love. Meanwhile, campus beauty Hyeri just wants to avoid being the target of rumors when cool and confident Hwawoon enters her life. Can they all find love amidst the turbulence of youth?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Bakegitsune no Chuushin
synopsis:
In a war-torn world, there lives a demon fox named Tamamo who has deceived many people and ruined many lands. Her next target is the young warrior Naozumi, but little by little, she becomes attracted to his honesty and integrity. Then Tamamo learns that Naosumi is being shunned by his relatives and his life is being targeted...

A Sengoku fantasy romance begins!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Dating to Survive
synopsis:
Would you confess your love for someone if it meant saving your life? Well, that's what I did. I'm a ghost named Umin, and my girlfriend is a ghost hunter. Quite the cliche, I know... Honestly, I don't know how I'm gonna get rid of her, but I can't just let her kill me, either!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Hourly Love
synopsis:
"Date me for 20,000 won an hour."

Cha Do Hyun is a poor college student. One day, he got a ridiculous offer from Lee Sana, a younger student at the university. Should he accept the offer from this girl, who was looking for a good place to bury a body on campus? Everything about it is suspicious, but having just been fired from his part-time job, the offer is too sweet for Cha Do Hyun to turn down!

"You are totally worth the money."
"Keep that thought to yourself!"

A woman with nothing but money, a man with everything but money, and their suspicious dating service.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Wizard!!: Bakuen no Seifukusha
synopsis: Reboot of the original Bastard!! Ankoku no Hakaishin pilot one-shot.

title: Checkmate
synopsis:
Soohyun doesn't have a "first love," but he definitely has a "first hate"—his high school classmate Eunsung. A smooth-mannered all-star, Eunsung snaps up first place in everything, leaving Soohyun always trailing behind in second place. Winning out over Eunsung is the one thing that motivates Soohyun, but after graduation, Soohyun contents himself with a dull, mediocre life. One day, Eunsung appears on the news, knee-deep in scandal and, for once, not perfectly at ease...lighting Soohyun's inner fires once again. Desperate to see a fallen Eunsung with his own eyes, Soohyun jumps into the fray as a reporter, and gets Eunsung to strike an outrageous deal with him.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Absolute Submission
synopsis:
Daim Jin, who was harassed by bullies, stumbles across a game that changes his life. An overpowered strategy RPG game that allows him to boss around bullies and nurture good-natured helpers! The end goal of the game being the elimination of school violence from the world!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

The sickly Princess Jeongmyeong knew nothing of the violence and betrayal surrounding the royal court. Yet when the threat of a vile mythical beast and the machinations of the cruel Gaesi Kim loom large, she will do all she can to save her family from certain doom. Armed with only her wits and courage, Jeongmyeong must accept the aid of a stunning blue goblin who vows to be her loyal guardian. Can love win and save this unlikely pair from the vicious schemes that bedevil their every move?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Love Song ga Utaenai
title_japanese: ラブソングが歌えない
synopsis:
Chihiro, who quit his previous band due to a failed love affair, has been a vocalist in his current band for two years after being invited by Mikumo. Chihiro has been asked to sing a love song many times, but for some reason he has always refused. In their final year of college, job hunting started to get them busy, and before the band part their ways, Mikumo confesses how much he loves Chihiro's voice and asks him to rethink the idea of singing a love song for the last time.

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

title: 20-byou Date
synopsis:
A boy living on the 7th floor of an apartment has a crush on a high school girl, who always gets on the same elevator as him from the 6th floor. To get closer to her, he tries to find out more about who lives on the 6th floor, only to discover that no high school girls live on the floor...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Blurred Lines
synopsis:
Geonwoo and Haru have been friends since elementary school. Now university students, their friendship continues as strong as ever. Both are currently single so after her friend cancels their Christmas Eve plans, Haru decides to invite Geonwoo to spend it with her. A memory of a promise made when they were younger as well as Haru's choice in clothing that night makes Geonwoo start seeing Haru in a different light, and the fine line between lovers and friends starts getting blurred.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: A Not So Fairy Tale
synopsis:
When a naïve woodcutter steals the robe of a fairy descended from heaven, he condemns her to centuries trapped in the human realm. In the present day, the fairy is known as Moran Cheon, a renowned actress who is unexpectedly accused of murder. Bitter and resentful from her exile, Moran sees her plot for vengeance take shape when she discovers that Jeha Sa, a police detective tasked with investigating the murder, is the reincarnated woodcutter of centuries past.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: A Superstar From Birth
synopsis:
From elves, fairies, slimes, gift items, devils and more, countless and thousands of reincarnations have led to a new life. I, Seo Jun Lee, have been reborn as a human child! In the library of my life, where memories of my previous lives remain like fairy tales, I happen to see a past life with the dream life I desperately wanted. On top of that, I've been given abilities that grabs people's attention! With my handsome face doing all the hard work! My insane acting skills! This time, at long last, I will achieve my dream and become a superstar!

"Wet's dow it!"

(Source: Kakako Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Kegare no Nai Hito
synopsis:
Ichirou Akitaka, framed for a crime most heinous—child molestation and murder.

Engulfed by despair and contemplating the final release of suicide, he is pulled back from the brink by the young, earnest priest, Kiba. Despite the sordid label society had pinned to him, Kiba shows Akitaka an unending mercy and kindness.

A life of peace he'd yearned for, days unmarred by reproach... But could such salvation truly exist in this place?

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

Volume 2: Kamen no Nakami

title: Return of the Mount Hua Sect
synopsis:
When Cheongmyeong of the Mount Hua Sect awakens a hundred years in the future, his last memories are of a bloody battle against the Leader of the Demonic Cult, the evil Cheonma. The battle almost saw the end of the Ten Great Sects of ancient China, when Cheongmyeong ended the hard-fought struggle by striking down Cheonma. Soon after, he succumbed to his wounds, filled with regret at their pyrrhic victory. All is not lost, however, as he awakens to his second chance at life. Shocked to find his beloved Mount Hua Sect reduced to a mere shadow of itself in the present day, Cheongmyeong embarks on a journey to restore Mount Hua to its former glory.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Martial God Who Regressed Back to Level 2
title_english: The Martial God Who Regressed Back to Level 2
synopsis:
Earth lost the fight for survival in the BattleNet system and humanity now faces eradication. However, Jihan Seong is given another chance. He has returned three years into the past before BattleNet became a life-or-death game. With his knowledge of the future, he's determined to become the strongest player. Will Jihan be able to change the fate of humanity? And more importantly, can he protect the ones he loves from those who want him to fail?

(Source: Tapas Media)

synopsis:
Moojin Kim's job was to support the supernatural beings known as "vagrants" on missions, cleaning up the messes they leave behind. Then one day, he is killed in a fight between vagrants, but to his surprise, he wakes up in the year 2002, the peak of his youth! Though excited to relive the good years, he finds out that, unfortunately, he's been cursed by a demon! Now, the only way for Moojin to cure himself is by working with the ones he hoped to avoid the most... the vagrants.

(Source: Tapas Media)

The senpai she admires is cursed to become a plushy...!?

Ikumi is a high school girl whose hobby is making plushies. She presents a handmade plushy as a thank-you to Ayato-senpai, the popular student council president, but she is shocked to witness him tossing it away behind her back. That's when the "curse" of the stuffed animal's spirit deity is activated, and Ayato-senpai himself becomes a plushy...?

The only way to break the curse is to make Ikumi happy!  It's the start of their plushy life♪

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title_english: According to the Hero Who Returned from Another World
title_japanese: 異世界帰りの英雄曰く
synopsis:
Daiki Kurosu is an ordinary high school student. He worries about his test results and deals with his cute but overbearing little sister, but he's not entirely dissatisfied with his peaceful everyday life. However, Daiki feels a sense of discomfort with such a routine life. One day, he meets a girl on a street corner who appears with a sudden intense palpitation. She is a witch living in the present world...!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Four Dangerous Brothers to My Rescue!
title_english: Four Dangerous Brothers to My Rescue!
synopsis:
Warmhearted Lestia has resigned herself to a life of misery under the thumb of her abusive uncle. However, right when things seem to take a turn for the worst, a mysterious boy claiming to be one of her four long-lost brothers appears in the nick of time to save her. After being whisked into a life of luxury, Lestia has her doubts about taking on the Verchester name. But after the discovery of her latent magical powers, Lestia starts to accept two strange truths: She is a true Verchester, and she has a destiny to fulfill.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Empress of Ashes
synopsis:
When Eilec wakes up in the past after slaughtering everyone who played a part in his beloved wife's death, he knows the best way to avoid making the same mistakes would be to let Rose go. Despite this, Eilec is determined to change the future with her by his side, as he can't imagine a life without her. But when Rose regains her memories and sees that Eilec has dragged her into the hellish world of nobles and their political scheming for the second time, he realizes he has made a grave mistake. The hatred and resentment that burns in her eyes are almost as hot as the fire that killed her in the past. Will Rose find it in herself to forgive her husband, or will she burn everything to ashes, including him?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: The Red Nights at the Duke's Castle
title_english: The Red Nights at the Duke's Castle
synopsis:
When Sorel Idris turns around to find a stranger in her home, she isn't that surprised at first. After all, her father warned her this would happen. But when she detects the faint scent of blood in the air, she can't keep her rabbit ears from popping out in shock. Her father failed to mention that her soon-to-be husband, Duke James Calier, was a vampire centuries older than her! On top of that, she discovers she's the heiress to a considerable fortune. Sorel slowly adjusts to her newlywed life while attending the university of her dreams.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Surviving in the Emperor's Bed
synopsis:
When Robelia Naegrad married Emperor Carmond DeHardt, it was expected that she would produce an heir to the imperial bloodline of the Golden Dragon, one who would inherit the family's mind-control abilities. However, with her own deadly powers being manipulated for her devious mother's mysterious scheme, Robelia must do all she can to avoid sharing a bed with her husband. Caught in between the two, will she be able to resist Carmond's continued seduction and avoid becoming her mother's pawn?

(Source: Tapas Media)

synopsis:
"If you can really make me the Center...then we can get married."

Meet Mizuki Natsuno, the least popular member of the nationally acclaimed idol group, Melty Strawberry. She has an eternal fan in Koichi Okuta, who is always pouring heart and soul into supporting her. Normally, a fan would never get to interact with their idol beyond the stage. But one thing led to another, and Koichi now finds himself living together with Mizuki in his own house. He vows to make her the new Center of Melty Strawberry, sparking an unconventional tag-team between a devoted fan and his idol. Together, they attempt to elevate Mizuki's career from obscurity to stardom!

(Source: Kodansha)

title: OL ga Game Center de Atta Yankee Danshi Koukousei ni Natsukareru Hanashi

synopsis:
Ellie has feelings for her childhood friend, Kanata. Standing in Ellie's way are various women and magus surrounding Kanata... An original spin-off where you can fully experience her fluctuating emotions!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: I Got a Boy
synopsis:
Hyojoo can't wait to graduate into adulthood. Gunta, her annoying brother on paper, knows she has a past that still haunts her. They may live under one roof, but share nothing else—until summer break arrives with a rush of smoldering possibilities and a glamorous brush with celebrity. Love or lies, Hyojoo may have to choose...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: I Got No Boy
synopsis:
"I want to know who my father is!" In this sequel to hit romance series I Got a Boy, more than a decade has passed since Hyojoo's restless young days and she's now the single mom of a spunky teenage daughter, Godam. But when Godam asks piercing questions about her father, the answers don't come easily. What happened to Hyojoo in all that time, and can Godam uncover the truth about their past?

(Source: Tappytoon)

synopsis:
A dismembered corpse of a naked woman was found on the riverbed at night. It soon turned out that the method of the case was very similar to the novel "Vexations" published in small copies 10 years ago. Investigator Kosaku Kurumiya's younger sister Reimi has a visual impairment. She has contributed to solving numerous bizarre cases by making full use of her sharpened sense and her reasoning power. Will she really get to the heart of an unprecedented case?

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Kamiato to Fluorite
title_japanese: 噛み痕とフローライト
synopsis:
When retail worker Kosaka Haru sees a man attack another on the street, he thinks very little before intervening. As he wakes up the next day in an abandoned building surrounded by a ravenous mob, he wonders what he has gotten himself into. Soon, Akihito, the man he saved, arrives and informs Haru that he had been mortally wounded in the attack. The only way Akihito could have saved Haru was to bite him—and turn him into a vampire.

Vampire transformations are not immediate, and Haru now exists as a "tank," a partially-converted human, for the foreseeable future. Tanks are considered an irresistible reservoir of blood to other vampires, as biting one of these individuals does not have the consequence of creating offspring. Akihito promises to protect Haru during this perilous stage, but his feelings toward Haru—and Haru's feelings toward his own vanishing humanity—remain uncertain.

title: Étrangère
synopsis:
Two Korean military soldiers, San and Biyeon, are participating in a joint forces exercise when their futures become intertwined through an accident, leading them down a path of struggle, pain, frustration, longing, and enlightenment. Their adventure starts in a new world, a world where things are not always as they seem. Common sense needs to be reviewed and old ways of understanding the world no longer apply. Only their determination and will drive them forward. What is the limit of human potential? How much can be planned and how much must be left to chance? They can only depend on their will to blaze a path forward...

(Source: Wuxiaworld)

title: Death When Separated
synopsis:
The perfect influencer life. Having a date with the girl you like. Only confession remains, but I got caught up in an absurd terrorist incident?! "It's not an obsession, we really...! If we break up, we die!!"

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Why Are You Obsessed With Your Fake Wife?
title_english: Why Are You Obsessed With Your Fake Wife?
synopsis:
Nadia Valajit thought she had nothing more to lose until her family and fiancé betrayed her. After she finds herself thrust back in time prior to the events that ultimately led to her death, Nadia kicks off her plans for payback by marrying Glenn Winterpel, the icy marquess to the north and the Valajit family's favorite punching bag. Armed with knowledge of the future, Nadia sets the table to serve up her ice-cold revenge, but she might end up melting the marquess's heart instead...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Goshujinsama no Iyashikei Kareshi
title_japanese: ご主人様の癒し系彼氏

title: Ghostly Vendetta
synopsis:
Han-gyul Kim was a child prodigy, born to act. Using his ability to see ghosts, he was able to deliver a captivating performance that helped him stand out in the competitive industry. All the other child actors admired him, and it seemed like he had a bright future ahead of him, until the mysterious red thread appeared. From that very moment, his life became mired in disaster. Ten years later, living an ordinary life and putting his childhood fame behind him, he finds out that the red thread on his finger leads somewhere—a black thread attached to childhood actor-turned-superstar, Eunhan Jung. Their similar pasts have to mean something, but what secrets lie behind these ties that bind them?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Reincarnation of the Veteran Soldier
synopsis:
Days before Sergeant Kim's discharge, he passed away. Suddenly getting told to go to another world, the man couldn't believe it and started to make a mess. He was soon punished to go to the new world naked with no skills. A tearful survival fantasy story from a soldier's perspective.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Tonari no Gal ga Miyabi sugiru!?
title_japanese: 隣のギャルが雅すぎる!?
synopsis:
The new semester has begun, and the earnest high school student Kazesaki has just obtained his desired seat at the back row by the window. However, seated next to him is Tachibana-san, a gal who often has other gals gathering around her and they're always unruly. Kazesaki, whose peaceful life by the window has been disturbed, resentfully observes the behavior of these gals and notices that Tachibana-san's conduct is—unlike them—somehow more elegant...!?

(Source: Coamix, translated)

title: The Girl Next Door Knows Best
title_english: The Girl Next Door Knows Best
synopsis:
For Song Sera, 32 years old, there was never a man who she couldn't get if she set her eyes upon him. "But what about Kwang? Why his favorability doesn't increase?"

Sera Song previously quit her job but due to financial issues, she joined her brother's friend's gaming company. However, unlike when he was young, CEO Cha Geum Kwang has grown up to be a handsome man. But when Sera suddenly opens a gaming app which tells her the love favorability of others around her, she is sure she can make him love her.

"I can see his favorability but why doesn't it increase?" What's the way to increase Cha Geum Kwang's love favorability?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Nobara to Pretender
title_japanese: 野ばらとプリテンダー
synopsis:
Desperate to financially support his ailing mother, Noah leaves his hometown to enter into the service of the Reinhardt family. Upon his arrival his new master, Lord Rupert, demands that Noah pretend to be his lover! Lord Rupert wishes to avoid a political marriage, and Noah is determined to keep his job, so the two men work out an arrangement.

However, the more time they spend together, the more Noah realizes that his forlorn master is beset by loneliness—and Noah wants their love to be real. Can Lord Rupert ever see him as more than just a servant?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

synopsis:
Aki Satou is gravely ill, so her classmates make a thousand cranes for her as a well-wishing gift. When Kazuto brings it to her however, she calls it trash and reveals her life's own bitterness to him.

(Source: MU)

title: Youyou Koizakura
synopsis:
Tadaomi, an exorcist, was searching for Otaro, a demon he met when he was a child and suddenly disappeared one day. Finally, while working on a mission, Masaomi reunites with Otaro. However, for some reason, Otaro treats him coldly and tries to push him away. Masaomi realizes that he is in love with Otaro, and begs him to have sex with him just once. Otaro fulfills his wish but...!?

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

title: Razwald wa Ou ni shika Kagayakanai
title_japanese: ラズワルドは王にしか輝かない

title_japanese: ダウナー系上司を恋に落とす方法

title: Akegarasu Yume Koi Uta
synopsis:
"You paid for me, so touch me however you please..."

Office worker Akito is taken away by a tofu boy yokai and steps foot into red-light district exclusive to yokai! There he meets the beautiful male prostitute Suiren—a tan, black-haired tengu. A story of pure love between a male prostitute and a customer unfurls in a dazzlingly luxurious red-light district!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Uragirimono no Love Song
title_japanese: 裏切り者のラブソング
synopsis:
It's Italy, 19XX, and the Gardino family, which rules a port town, has two candidates for the next boss. One is Gino, a pure-blooded executive who respects tradition. While the other is Dante, a liberal who seeks a new future. Gino sees Dante as his rival, but Dante always tries to find some reason to get involved, Inadvertently, Gino's "biggest secret" is revealed to Dante. So to keep his secret a hidden, Dante asks... to hold Gino for one night.

(Source: Denpa)

title: Sono Me de Shikkari Daiteoke
title_japanese: その目でしっかり抱いておけ
synopsis:
Ousuke Akiyoshi is a young model with no motivation. Even after being chosen for a special feature by an extremely popular photographer, Shogo Nowaki, he doesn't seem to care. However, on the day of the shoot, Shogo tells Ousuke that he's not beautiful anymore. Filled with anger, Ousuke goes to his hotel and confronts him, but it leads to a very different situation. Shogo's penetrating eyes reveal Ousuke's true self and warm his cold heart.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Phantom Busters
title_japanese: ファントムバスターズ

title: I Swear I Really Like You
title_english: I Swear I Really Like You
synopsis:
What am I to you? Boyfriend? A boy toy? A hostage? A witness? Why did you save my life and just walk away? Why would you transfer to my school and tell everyone we go way back? On a different note, why do you always have a gun? And why do those foreigners keep chasing after me? Will I survive being next to you?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Himitsu no Mori no Majutsushi wa Nodoka wo Negau
title_english: The Secluded Sorcerer Wants a Peaceful Life
title_japanese: 秘密の森の魔術師はのどかを願う
synopsis:
Shagar is a great hero whose incredible magical power ended a war... Or at least, that's what he used to be known as. Cut to the present day, and Shagar's magic has been sealed away, unable to be used at all. The former great hero spends his days deep in a forest in complete solitude, other than the occasionally visit from Luso. If this rugged mercenary doesn't stop by regularly, Shagar won't be able to transfer his pent-up magical energy outside of his body, which could very well kill him.

When attacked by monsters while gathering water one day, Shagar is saved by the young Fio, who insists on being his disciple! Though Fio has great potential for magic, his true strength lies in his seemingly unlimited capacity to accept Shagar's magical energy. These two might have the kind of chemistry that Shagar has spent so much of his life searching for...

(Source: Takeshobo)

title: Akihabara wa Euthanasia no Yume wo Miru ka?
title_japanese: 秋葉原はユーサネイジアの夢を見るか?

title: The Dragon King's Bride
synopsis:
Ten years ago, a young girl saved the life of a dragon. Little did they know that they would be brought together again by the vicissitudes of fate, when Lucina's family estate is invaded by the fearsome Tayar nation led by King Hakan. After Lucina's selfish stepmother offers her up as a bride to Hakan in exchange for their lives, Lucina realizes that she is now fated to journey to the arid kingdom of Tayar and marry its seemingly brutish king. Will fate lead the unlikely pair to ruin or romance?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Hikikomori Renkinjutsushi wa Hikikomorenai: Ouchi de Nonbiri shitai Funtouki
title_japanese: 引き籠り錬金術師は引き籠れない～お家でのんびりしたい奮闘記～
synopsis:
Celes is a reclusive alchemist with good skills but no interpersonal skills. One day, she decides to leave her home and arrives in a country town on another continent. She begins to live there, but the medicines she makes cure incurable diseases, and when she fights, she destroys demonic beasts. Before she knows it, the town is buzzing with activity, and the number of requests increases one after another! The story of the struggles of a beautiful and pitiful alchemist girl who seeks a slow and unhurried life!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Matataki no Ao wo Tadotte
title_english: Follow the Twinkling Blue of the Stars.
title_japanese: またたきの青をたどって
synopsis:
Yamato Tsukimachi, who has fulfilled his dream since high school and works as a teacher, finds a familiar name in the list of transfer students one day. "Isshin Komiya"—that was the name of a former best friend who fell ill and was unconscious when he was in his third year of high school. He says that Isshin, who regained consciousness two years ago, has been transferred to rehabilitate and restart his high school life. Although it's a different kind of teacher and student than before, the two have met again like a dream, and decided to fulfill the "list of things to do before graduation" that they couldn't do in the past.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Lucky☆Star: Konata 30
synopsis: Official spin-off manga, following Konata and her friends in their 30s.

title: Trapped in a Game That Flopped
title_english: Trapped in a Game That Flopped
synopsis:
Save the Earth is the latest big thing in the game world. Players can experience the most realistic fights and adventures by simply equipping their VR headset, and the game's advanced AI constantly generates unique moves and challenges. However, this has caused the game's difficulty to rise abnormally, and an operations team employee is swarmed with bug reports and complaints. To resolve the issues, she logs in as a non-playable, immortal character—Shari Azrael, Dover Village's apothecary.

As Shari, she suddenly notices something strange: though only a day has passed in the real world, she has been living inside the game for over two years. With her attempts at logging out proving futile, she becomes concerned for her real body's wellbeing. Shari contacts the game masters, but they are virtually useless. It soon turns out that Shari can only escape by beating the game: a feat nobody has accomplished before. Shari must now prevent Crown Prince Cassel Lukwig from falling asleep, or all

title: Koi ka Yamai ka Unmei ka
synopsis:
Yanagi (28) works at a café where lately, he's been having visions of the new guy, Sakaida, a college student, making a move on him. Sure, Yanagi may not have any interest in love, but he never thought he could actually be into guys. Unable to stop his fantasies, it turns out that Yanagi just might...

(Source: Renta!)

Included one-shot: Senpai ni Saiminjutsu wo Tameshitara Ecchi na Koto ni Narimashita

title: Shoujo Null
synopsis:
With the proliferation of organic robots called Gijins, humanity is enjoying prosperity in 23rd century Tokyo. But when a young man named Riaha meets a certain Gijin, he uncovers the dark truth of the world!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Koibito Keiyakuchuu ni Tsuki
synopsis:
Company employees Yanaka and Moriyama are lovers... Well, pretend lovers. After being repeatedly approached by women he had no interest in, Yanaka was at his wits end and asked his friend and colleague, Moriyama, to pretend to be his lover. In exchange, he'd do whatever Moriyama asked for. Well, what Moriyama asked for was... Yanaka's body! Moriyama, showing this side of himself, flusters Yanaka, but Yanaka does eventually surrender himself... How will a relationship started from a lie pan out?

(Source: Taiyo Tosho)

title: I Love You wo Utaenai
title_japanese: I love youをうたえない

title: Bukiyou na Bokutachi no Koi to Mahou
title_japanese: 不器用な僕たちの恋と魔法

title: Mitsuru Quest
synopsis:
The manga's story is about a boy who enters a game world, and he aims to clear it with a 30-something middle-aged man who also loves playing games.

(Source: ANN)

title: Dragon Quest: Dai no Daibouken - Xross Blade
title_japanese: ドラゴンクエスト ダイの大冒険 クロスブレイド

title: Bloody Sugar wa Yoru Warau
title_english: Bloody Sugar Laughs at the Night
title_japanese: ブラッディ・シュガーは夜わらう
synopsis:
"Nega"—It is a bizarre disease that develops by acting on the negative emotions of human beings. Symptoms vary from person to person and cannot be seen by ordinary humans. Church and Jed are unalike brothers whose livelihoods are doctors who specialize in "Nega." The two are looking for a "certain nega" for their beloved sister, Basil...!? A dark, sweet fantasy presented by the most notable writer, Matsuri Midou! 

(Source: Coamix, translated)

title: Magic School Girl: Spare No Villains
title_english: Magic School Girl: Spare No Villains
synopsis:
Garin, an ordinary high-school girl, is given magical powers that can help fight all kinds of "villains" around her. The catch? The magic transformation is nothing short of mortifying to the teenager. But do not judge a book by its cover! With the power vested in her thanks to a peculiar god's random blessing, Garin and her gang free humanity from the evil plot to villainize the world—and hopefully boost her grades along the way.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Takanashi-ke no Imouto wa Hanayome ni Naritai!!
title_japanese: 小鳥遊家の妹は花嫁になりたいっ!!
synopsis:
The manga centers on a young boy who loves playing soccer. One day, he suddenly has to live together with two beautiful twin sisters and their younger sister. Their exciting life of living together begins.

(Source: ANN)

title: Tengokudou Kissaten: Around Heaven
title_japanese: 天国堂喫茶店 ～アラウンド・ヘヴン～

title: Kiss & Cry: Tanoshii Jinsei no Suberikata
title_english: Kiss & Cry: Fun Way of Life
title_japanese: キス＆クライ～楽しい人生の滑り方～

title: Yang Guifei, Kirara
synopsis:
Yang Guifei, Kirara centers on Yougyoku Kan (or Yang Yuhuan in Chinese), who lost her parents and now lives with her adoptive parents in cramped conditions. She was naturally born with a rare beauty, and although her beauty troubles her, she wants to know the meaning of love someday.

(Source: ANN)

title: Uchi no Kuro Madoushi ga Kawaisugiru!
title_japanese: うちの黒魔導士がかわいすぎる!
synopsis:
Aria, an honor student and prefect at her magic school, has just one problem—Jade, the black mage. He is known for being cold and harsh toward his peers, and Aria has been doing her best to avoid him. But when she runs into him by accident, she hears...his thoughts?! Now that she knows what he's thinking, he's almost kind of cute...

(Source: Yen Press)

Included one-shot:
Volume 1: Zubora Seijo to Healthcare Akuma

title: Dragon Ego
synopsis:
Inside the world's most popular MMORPG, the fearsome Dragon of Despair Taphras is raided by the game's most powerful guild, composed of six top-rankers. Upon Taphras' defeat, he is divided into six items and split between each of the guild members. Little do they know that Taphras' sister, Ignis, the Dragon of Destruction, has been awoken. Now, to resurrect her brother, Ignis must take down the guild members one by one and unite the missing items in this dragon-sized tale of revenge!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Dokidoki Nupunupu Memorial wa Sayonara
title_japanese: ドキドキヌプヌプメモリアルはさよなら

title: Watashi no Aishita Haha no Koibito

title: Kuroneko Ron to Kurashitara

title: Love Logic
synopsis:
Bad luck? Fate? That's never been in the cards for mathematics genius Heeseo Kang. What he trusts are cold hard facts, based on only physics and probability. But his whole world goes toppling down when he's faced with one Hanbyeol Doh from the popular idol group Illogic. Heeseo finds truth and beauty in Hanbyeol's beautiful face, and there's no stopping him from going to the Illogic concert. But then Heeseo fails to get tickets, and the student he's tutoring, Gunwoo Nam, doesn't even get into university... And the day after their drunken night of despair, Heeseo wakes up to find none other than Hanbyeol in Gunwoo's living room. There's something going on here, and it's definitely suspicious...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Zenryaku, Oniichan wa Seijo ni Narimashita.
title_english: Dear Sister, I've Become a Blessed Maiden
title_japanese: 前略、お兄ちゃんは聖女になりました。
synopsis:
What seems like an ordinary spring break evening for Umehiko and his little sister, Momo, quickly turns to confusion when a mysterious symbol appears in the sky. Next thing the siblings know, they're in a strange world that's definitely not their own. But Umehiko is only concerned with making sure his sister gets back home safely. Unfortunately, right as he sends her back into the magical seal, he's pulled away and stranded in a whole new world! Theodorus, a powerful sorcerer who's been working tirelessly to summon a blessed maiden, declares that Umehiko will become his spring for unlimited power and puts a strange symbol on the confused man's body. Suddenly, Umehiko is overcome with an uncontrollable lust—that only Theodorus can satisfy. Can he endure being the sorcerer's new "blessed maiden," or will he manage to find a way to escape?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Satsuei no Ato de Tabesasete?
title_japanese: 撮影のあとで食べさせて?
synopsis:
The rookie actor Haruki has his first role costarring with the popular actor he's looked up to since he was a kid, Yuito Shinonome. Excited to greet him, Haruki heads to Yuito's dressing room only to find him blue in the face and collapsed on the ground!! As Haruki looks after Yuito, he asks what happened—and Yuito tells him he can't handle sexually-charged behavior! "Haruki, you're my fan, right? Could you pretend to be my lover?" The moment Haruki agreed to the direct request of his favorite actor, for some reason a kiss falls upon him, sweet and swooning...!?

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title: Inda no Onihime Annerose
title_japanese: 淫堕の鬼姫アンネローゼ
synopsis:
Gridania is a small kingdom renowned for its two national treasures: Queen Hildegard of unparalleled beauty and mercy; and the lovely Princess Anne-Rose, a genius warrior whose mastery of the sword makes the greatest experts green with envy.

But every kingdom, even the best of them, has dark subjects ready to do anything for their own interest. To achieve his ends, the Minister of Finance Hingen uses the pretext of a treaty of alliance with a neighboring country in order to send the queen and her daughter there. The trap closes on the two women who then become sexual slaves...

(Source: Manga Sanctuary, translated)

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Cucuruz Doan no Shima - Doan to Rolland
title_japanese: 機動戦士ガンダム ククルス・ドアンの島 -ドアンとロラン-

title: Undertaker
synopsis:
The manga centers on the seemingly childlike Hiromu Sugisawa, and the elder Routa Daidouji. Both are employed as Undertaker agents, who put to rest the Sotai, the resurrected undead who seek to prolong their lives by attacking the living.

(Source: ANN)

title: Yoruko to Otsutome Doubutsu
title_japanese: 夜子とおつとめどうぶつ

title: Choose Your Heroes Carefully
synopsis:
Stuck in a game with a lousy hero? Me too!

Minjoon, a normal office worker, wakes up inside the game he was reviewing for his friend. It's not his fault the trailer was so boring it put him to sleep! Bewildered, Minjoon is tasked with summoning a hero to guide. The hero certainly looks strong, but he seems to be less useful than expected.

(Source: Manta)

title: Shinimodori no Sachiusu Reijou, Konse dewa Saikyou Last Boss Oniisama ni Dekiai saretemasu

title_japanese: イキガミとドナー・二人のイキガミ

title: Kakuriyo no Yadomeshi: Ayakashi Oyado ni Yomeiri shimasu.
title_japanese: かくりよの宿飯 あやかしお宿に嫁入りします。
synopsis:
Aoi wants to work off her debt to the Tenjin-ya inn, but she only has one day to find a position and none of the managers are willing to hire a human! If she can just get someone to see past her family background, Aoi is certain she can prove her worth!

(Source: VIZ Media)

title: Double Suicide
synopsis:
Kei has been a vegetarian and tended to have an unbalanced diet since childhood. He and his much older brother Sai, who has a brother complex but who's become reliable, get along well together. For some reason, ever since he was a child, Kei has wanted to taste blood. Even though he knows it's wrong, he can't help thinking about it, so his university classmate, who cuts herself, agrees to share her blood with him. As soon as Kei discovers the taste of blood, he realizes he's always wanted to eat Sai...

Can Kei become aware of his affection for Sai without confronting his desire to eat him?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: Bittersweet
synopsis:
After he was laid off, Seho wasn't sure what his next move was going to be. He only took a job at a cafe so that he'd have something to do with his time. He never imagined that he'd catch the eye of the cafe owner, or that being with an older woman could be so electrifying. Then again, Mira assets are definitely one of kind.

Things are looking up until Mira asks Seho to move in with her and her daughter. Nayoung may seem innocent, but things aren't always what they seem. And Seho's about learn just how complicated family relationships can be.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Kingin Sasameku Himitsu wa Yoru
title_english: Twinkling Secrets Told Us Tonight Is the Night.
title_japanese: 金銀ささめくひみつは夜
synopsis:
Alloy uses magic to support the nation's lifeline and is the active leader of the operational department. With his beauty and friendly personality, he does not take advantage of his noble lineage and is adored by everyone around him. On the other hand, Mikado, a poker-faced workaholic seems to not get along with Alloy like everyone else. They are on opposite wavelengths, but the two are actually in a secret relationship?

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

title: No Rose Without Thorns
synopsis:
Up-and-coming idol group member Rose goes on a secret date with her boyfriend for her birthday, only to be kidnapped and demanded money for their freedom. Her abductors seem far from stable, and her boyfriend seems to be more invested in his own freedom than her safety. Now that she realizes that she is completely on her own, Rose must outsmart her captors and fight for her freedom.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Secrets of the Mystic Moonlit Library
title_english: Secrets of the Mystic Moonlit Library
synopsis:
In an empire where women are forbidden from learning the ancient language, Luna cross-dresses as "Lou" to work as an ancient language translator. Sure, her actions are punishable by death, but what haunts her more are the depressing details of her future self's diary from the mysterious library in her dreams. Making money as a translator is the fastest way she can leave her uncaring uncle's house and change her dismal future. However, Luna's main client happens to be her cousin's fiancé, Duke Rothenbern, who gets drugged with a potent love potion and needs her "assistance" detoxifying it...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Maguwaibeya no Kanrinin-san

title: Kemono no Gochisou, Hijoushoku
title_japanese: 獣のごちそう, 非常食
synopsis:
When he was young, a herbivore named Hakka was caught in a trap and was unable to move. A carnivore named Daiya picked him up and decided to keep him as "emergency food," but as they spent time together, they began to feel as if they were family.

Ten years pass and the two become adults. Daiya still thinks of Hakka as family, but he realizes that Hakka's feelings are different from his own.

(Source: Sankosha, translated)

title: Henshuu Ou
synopsis:
Kampachi Momoi, as a child, loved the manga Ashita no Joe and followed his dream to become a professional boxer, but at the age of 24, he was diagnosed with a career ending injury. As hard as it was to turn away from the one thing that he worked his entire life for by sacrificing everything else, it was inevitable. His longtime friend, Hiromichi Oume, who works as an editor at a manga publisher, gets him a job. Kampachi has to restart his life and needs to learn everything from scratch but he brings the same passion he had for boxing to being an editor and fights his way through the corporate world, round by round.

(Source: MangaHelpers)

title: Juusan Kihei Boueiken: Anthology Comic Star

title_japanese: 上手に待てができるかな

title: Shuki Shuki Max Heart♡
synopsis:
Ryukujin, a hard-working student who lost his father when he was young and his mother was sick, spends his days working part-time, and for many years he had unrequited love for his childhood friend Torayuki. However, when he realized that they were in love with each other, his excitement suddenly leaps when he suddenly started to leap through time!

(Source: MU)

title: Himitsu wa Sarashite Mederubeki
title_english: The Secret Should be Exposed and Loved.
title_japanese: ひみつは晒して愛でるべき
synopsis:
Tokumoto, who's hardworking and highly trusted by people around, has a secret. That is, he uses sex toys to play with his behind. As he's a virgin in his 30s, his butt is prepped but it wasn't used at all. He also thinks it's bothersome to find a lover. One day, Tokumoto was hunting for sex toys when he was seen by Kayama, a sociable, friendly junior man. However, Kayama, who has been interested in Tokumoto for some reason, suddenly asked, "Can't I be your partner?"

(Source: Kaiousha, translated)

title: Beloved by the Male Lead's Nephew
title_english: Beloved by the Male Lead's Nephew
synopsis:
One day, memories of my past life came to mind. In my second life, within a novel, I was the villainess who became obsessed with the male protagonist and met a self-destructive end. Living a peaceful life in the countryside, I was summoned by my father. The capital was in turmoil, and he wanted me to find the former prince...

As memories of my previous life resurfaced, the child I had picked up turned out to be the nephew of the male lead! But I had already sent a letter vowing to never bother the male lead again...

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Fumigiku-san no Okiniiri

synopsis:
Amelia was adopted by the Alster family, a famous alchemist family. Thanks to her unparalleled talent and sincere efforts, she became the youngest alchemist in the history of the court. However, the situation changed drastically with the birth of her younger sister Rivera. All the expectations of those around her turned to her sister, and she became a nuisance to both her family and her colleagues.

Despite this, Amelia continues to work diligently and manages to keep up with the amount of work that she is assigned to do day after day as if she were being harassed. Then, one day, her fiance, Caius, tells her that he is breaking off their engagement and expelling her from the Court.

Her fiancé is taken away by her sister, her position at the Court is revoked, and she loses everything she has built up and falls into despair... Rather, Amelia was grateful.

"Thank you for everything, Caius. And Rivera, I know you have a lot of work ahead of you, but please hang in there, okay?"

Amelia i

title: Hwarin, the Flaming Scales
synopsis:
In the cutthroat world of martial arts, Hwarin Yu reigns supreme as the leader of the Black Sky Sect. But when he is betrayed by his own disciple and pushed to the brink of death, he's transported to another dimension where he finds that he's now become a woman! But the new Hwarin isn't willing to stay trapped in this prison forever. With the help of a snarky dragon and a bit of magic to boot, Hwarin is returning to the martial arts world to take names and reclaim his (or is it her now?) former glory.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Teihanpatsu JK Oneechan Manami wa S na Otouto ni Sakaraenai
title_japanese: 低反発JKお姉ちゃんマナミはSな弟に逆らえない

title: Yoru ni Kikasete
synopsis:
Story of romance, friendship, and betrayal. High school first-year Miya Yashiro's life gets turned upside down after being asked to call out for her classmate Harutaka. In the novel "My Dorothea," Maristella La Belflair is written as the titular character's "dear friend," but is more like her doormat. Ultimately executed due to Dorothea's plot, she is given another chance at life after her death and is determined to survive this time. The problem is, she's caught the eye of the male lead, Xavier, who is supposed to end up with Dorothea! With a love triangle and Dorothea's schemes to deal with, can this former doormat step up to the challenges in her new life?

(Source: Tapas Media)

synopsis:
After being reborn as a weak wind spirit destined to be killed in the battle against cursed beings, Asella had only one goal: survive! But her plans go awry when she forms a pact with Captain Lassez Siertensia, the man who will cause her death. Desperate to change her fate, Asella tries to find a way to break the pact quietly, only to attract the unwanted attention of four other men who take an interest in her. Will Asella find a way to overcome her misfortune without being swept off her feet?

(Source: Tapas Media)

synopsis:
"Passion can go to hell." What will be the fate of the basketball team full of losers?

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Not Your Typical Reincarnation Story
synopsis:
Choi Suna once enjoyed the familiar plot of a novel following Rhyse Sinclair—the virtuous ward of the prominent Rudwick family—who is entangled in a love triangle with the Rudwick sons. The elder Cliff becomes her main love interest, while the younger Killian remains lovelorn forevermore, trapped in a loveless marriage with the vile Edith Rigelhof from an opposing family. Seductive and cunning, Edith is a textbook villainess destined to die at Killian's hands after relentlessly tormenting Rhyse and serving as a spy for the Rigelhofs.

When Suna unexpectedly reincarnates as Edith, she finds her new life all too similar to her own abusive past. Determined to change Edith's fate and live, Suna swears off villainy and refuses to let Killian and his family mistreat her by showing them she is nothing like the other Rigelhofs. As she plans her escape while occasionally flirting with the endearingly distrustful Killian, she vows that her reincarnation story will be anything but typical.

title: Between Fate and Fortune
synopsis:
How many coincidences does it take for something to become fate? For Dojun Chae the only thing fate has ever brought him is bad luck and misfortune. As a result, he refuses to believe in such romantic notions, and instead has his mind set on a simpler goal: live happily. But with an ailing parental figure, a "brother" who keeps getting into trouble, and an ever-growing series of debts, even such a simple goal is beginning to feel unachievable. But maybe, for once, fate has something different in mind. Because, whilst the first few times Dojun meets Tae-seok Heo are nothing short of disastrous, they just can't stop bumping into one another. Could these coincidences be fate after all? And maybe—just maybe—this fate might finally bring fortune.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Yome Gaki ssu
synopsis:
Super serious and uptight high school student Koutarou Suzuki and his obnoxious gal kouhai Sorako Mozu get along like cats and dogs. She spends her days tormenting him, while he spends his days getting outraged by her. However, the two of them share a secret...that they're living together as fiancés!! Under the condition that Koutarou marry Sorako, who comes from a wealthy real estate family, they've agreed to buy his father's company and save it from going under!!

Having to deal with Sorako, who uses this and that (and you know what) to torment him, can Koutarou make her yield and successfully marry her?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Class "Mushoku" no Eiyuutan: Koushakuke wo Tsuihou sareta ga, Jitsu wa Nagutta dake de Skill wo Kakutoku Dekiru to Wakari, Tairiku Ichi no Eiyuu ni Noboritsumeru
title_japanese: クラス≪無職≫の英雄譚～公爵家を追放されたが、実は殴っただけでスキルを獲得できるとわかり、大陸一の英雄に上り詰める～
synopsis:
In a world where Classes are bestowed by the gods upon everyone when they reach eighteen, the existence of Skills within these Classes tends to overshadow any hard work, setting one's life path. Within this imbalanced system, Lythe, who trained in hopes of becoming a Holy Knight, was heartlessly classified as Jobless during the Class assignment, resulting in his expulsion from the town by his father, the Duke. As he scraped by as a luggage boy, there came a day when the merchant caravan he was with got attacked by bandits. Lythe, attempting to save the child, engaged in a battle with the skillful attackers, accepting his impending death. Yet, a mysterious voice echoed in his head when he punched a bandit in his last act of defiance...

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Maou 2099
synopsis:
​The cyberpunk metropolis Shinjuku—a massive city-state bedecked with neon signs, towering skyscrapers, and the latest cutting-edge technology. It is here, in year 2099 of the Fused Era, where the legendary Demon Lord Veltol has his second coming five centuries in the making. But this landscape is nothing like the one he conquered all those years ago, for the fusion of magic and engineering has elevated civilization to dazzling, unprecedented heights. Veltol may have been reduced to a historical footnote, but make no mistake...this brave new world will be his for the taking!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: The Eldest Brother of Baekdu
synopsis:
Honor. Glory. Justice. These are what martial artists fight for. Not Gumho Go, the second brother of the Baekdu Wind Sword Sect and the biggest slacker the martial arts world has ever seen. Spending more time sleeping than training, he's perfectly happy being seen as a fool by his master and fellow disciples. But when the first brother is killed by a mysterious assailant, Gumho is forced to take his place as the eldest brother. As new enemies emerge to threaten the sect, Gumho is going to have to step up to become its unlikeliest protector!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Tenkousei ga Oshi Seiyuu Datta Hanashi
title_english: The Story That the Transfer Student Was My Favorite Voice Actor
title_japanese: 転校生が推し声優だった話
synopsis:
The new student who transferred to Yuka's class is her favorite voice actor, Oto Sakashiro. She just wants to watch over him from the shadows, but for some reason he takes care of her and plays around with her!

(Source: MU)

Boku ga Kimi no Namae wo Yobu kara follows another version of Shiori Satou in another parallel world, which she begins to exchange diaries with her other self following her experience of Parallel Shift.

(Source: Wikipedia)

title: Guimi Zhi Zhu
synopsis:
Through the storm of steam and machinery, who can achieve the extraordinary? In the mist of history and darkness, who whispers to me? When I woke up from the haze of mystery, I found myself in a world of guns, cannons, giant ships, airships, difference engines; potions, divination, curses, hanged men, and sealed artifacts. But the light still shines between it all, and the mystery is never more than two steps away. This is the legend of the Fool.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Yoru-san no Itoshi no Bansan
synopsis:
Yoru is a vampire, a predator of the night dwelling among humans. But compared to a meal of fresh blood, he'd much rather partake in the culinary delights of the human world—fragrant stews, tasty meat buns, and sweet pastries are all irresistible delicacies to him. Unfortunately, being a vampire means he cannot stomach human food...unless he first drinks blood as an appetizer. Thus, Yoru spends his nights sinking his fangs into criminals and evildoers, all for the sake of the beloved supper awaiting him...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Utsurou Kanojo-tachi

title: The Crown Princess Scandal
synopsis:
Victimized by her little sister's trick, Hwa-yeong heads to the imperial palace to participate in the crown princess selection process. Now she'll have to put up with... six months of palace stay?! No way! As a last resort, Hwa-yeong tries to do everything wrong to get disqualified and sent home early but instead finds herself in the royals' favor. What's worse, coincidence keeps bringing Shin-yeong, the Crown Prince, in her way, and now things are becoming more intense and personal for both of them.

"You wish to get kicked out now? I'll do everything in my power to see the opposite happen!" Will Hwa-yeong see her way through these obstacles and return home before six months?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Castle: Keeper of the Sacred Eye
title_english: The Castle: Keeper of the Sacred Eye
synopsis:
In modern-day Korea, the Imperial Family holds a secret duty of exorcizing "Imae," creatures that lurk within paintings to feed on the grief of humans. But such beings can only be detected by people like Jo Yuyeon who possess the Sacred Eye. Despite knowing that Crown Prince Geon needs her special vision, Yuyeon gets caught up in a deceptive marriage plan to make it seem like another woman has her ability instead. But no secret can be kept forever. What will become of Yuyeon once it's revealed that she is the keeper Geon has always been looking for?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Mashino Aruchi
synopsis:
One day, a normal high school girl awakens to newfound powers.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Tokyo Kaijin Rhapsody
synopsis:
Hachiro keeps his true identity as a Fear a secret while working odd jobs—until he sees the Unbelievables, a newly established mecha-suited unit of the Metro PD. Now he wants to be just as cool as they are! But are there limits to what a monster can do?

(Source: VIZ Media)

title: Ore ga Donna Sentaku wo Shiyou ga, SS-kyuu Bishoujo-tachi ga Zenryoku de Chuumoku Shitekuru
title_japanese: 俺がどんな選択をしようが、SS級美少女たちが全力で注目してくる

title: Shoutai Fumei to Kyoufu
synopsis:
Kaname Isurugi, who suffered facial injuries in an accident, has a hard time getting along with the people at his school ever since he entered. When school counselor Sugata asks Kaname to help solve the problems of the girls in his charge, Kaname half-heartedly makes contact with four of them. After a month passes without any response, Kaname begins to question his actions. Suddenly, Kaname has a shocking "fateful encounter."

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title_japanese: 忌み子と呼ばれた召喚士@COMIC
synopsis:
"I will show no mercy to anyone who lays a hand on my family!"

A world in which people are desperate to obtain the power of spirits, who possess enormous magical power and wisdom. Vilm, an abomination with black hair and black eyes, spends his days protecting the village with his spirit family. One day, he is forced to take responsibility for a decision he made and set off on a journey to the outside world... An exhilarating summoning battle fantasy in which a loner and a spirit beast sister "ultimately" change the world begins now!

(Source: TO Books, translated)

title: Tensai Saijaku Mamonotsukai wa Kikan shitai: Saikyou no Juusha to Hikihanasarete, Mishiranu Chi ni Tobasaremashita
title_japanese: 天才最弱魔物使いは帰還したい～最強の従者と引き離されて、見知らぬ地に飛ばされました～
synopsis:
Allow me to introduce myself, I am Phil Garden. Despite being told I had no talent, I used every resource at my disposal to become a decently-ranked "demon tamer." With the esteemed task of defeating the "Demon King" that I had earned, I found myself caught up in an incomprehensible phenomenon, torn apart from my demon–slave—that I had crafted into the strongest existence, and banished to a far-off land.

Powerless, without connections or money, this is a story of how I lost everything to the Demon King’s plot, only to find new companions in a foreign land and strive to rise again as the strongest.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Color Collection
title_japanese: カラー・コレクション
synopsis:
Kii Saiki is enrolled in the graphics course at an art university and he's been feeling anxious because he's not been doing too well with his assignments. That's when Souta Amano, a senior from the sculpture course, suddenly called out to him telling him, "Hey, you're cute." Ever since then, Amano started to appear more often in front of him and though Saiki was initially dumbfounded by this, he eventually...?

This is an omnibus of youthful love stories all set in an art university.

(Source: Home-sha, translated)
