title: Sexcape Room: Wipe Out
synopsis:
Eunhyuk finds himself in a room with his old crush and muse, Anna. Since the two parted on bad terms, the situation isn't ideal. But if that isn't bad enough, turns out that in order to get out of this room, they need to...have sex! With so much on the line, will the two be able to break out?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Ice Love
synopsis:
When you're a short track speed skater, every second counts. But despite training 24-7, Hoonjae is no match for his arch rival Seojoon. What's more, with practice taking up all his time, Hoonjae hasn't been able to explore life's pleasures—like girls, for instance. One night, he decides to take the plunge and lose his virginity. Once he does, he starts flying across the ice! Plus, all the gorgeous girls around the rink suddenly see Hoonjae in a different light. Soon enough, things begin to get hot and steamy off the ice...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Ice Love
synopsis:
When you're a short track speed skater, every second counts. But despite training 24-7, Hoonjae is no match for his arch rival Seojoon. What's more, with practice taking up all his time, Hoonjae hasn't been able to explore life's pleasures—like girls, for instance. One night, he decides to take the plunge and lose his virginity. Once he does, he starts flying across the ice! Plus, all the gorgeous girls around the rink suddenly see Hoonjae in a different light. Soon enough, things begin to get hot and steamy off the ice...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: What a Girl Wants
synopsis:
After six years of life as an author, Yoon Seri hits a new hurdle: writer's block. Determined to overcome it, she sets her sights on a new genre, R-rated literature, only to find that her lack of experience is holding her back. Her search for a sexual sensei leads her to Lee Siyoon, a man willing to show her the ropes in more ways than one. But after her first taste of sexual liberty, she finds she can't stop thinking about it. After unexpectedly reuniting with her childhood friend-turned-neighbor, Seri realizes there might be more than one way to break this writer's block after all...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Saishou Hosa to Kurokishi no Keiyaku Kekkon to Rikon to Sonogo: Henkyou no Chi de Futari wa Fuufu wo Yarinaosu
title_english: Marriage, Divorce, and Beyond: The White Mage and Black Knight's Romance Reignited
title_japanese: 宰相補佐と黒騎士の契約結婚と離婚とその後 ～辺境の地で二人は夫婦をやり直す～
synopsis:
Heroic black knight Lina can fell monsters and slay dragons with ease, but when it comes to romance, she's still a total rookie! After dozens of dates ending in failure, she's ready to give up on her quest of finding a husband, even if the idea of a family is an alluring one. The hitch? Marriage is a requirement for all black knights! You see, the ability to use old magic—essential for safely slaying dragons—is a rare gift, so there's staggering pressure for black knights to pass their power on to the next generation. Worse yet, Lina's in immediate danger without a partner to bless her armor. But it's going to take the right person... Enter the prime minister's aide, Joshua Granwell, a handsome and talented white mage who's a perfect match for her mana. He'd make the ideal spouse for Lina—except she does not want to marry a noble. A contractual marriage might save Lina's life, but surviving the marriage hereafter will be a challenge all its own!

(Sourec: J-Novel Club)

title: Kakure Saijo wa Zenzen Megenai: Gibo to Gimai ni Ie wo Oidasareta node Konyaku Haki shite Moraou to Omottara, Shinshi Datta Konyakusha ga Hageshiku Dekiai shite Kuru You ni Narimashita!?
title_english: Jeanette the Genius: Defying My Evil Stepmother by Starting a Business with My Ride-or-Die Fiancé!
title_japanese: 隠れ才女は全然めげない ～義母と義妹に家を追い出されたので婚約破棄してもらおうと思ったら、紳士だった婚約者が激しく溺愛してくるようになりました!?～
synopsis:
When Jeanette's father suddenly goes missing, her evil stepmother seizes the opportunity to cast her out of the house! Now she's left with no family, no belongings, and nowhere to live. But Jeanette the eternal optimist firmly believes in one thing: "Every crisis is an opportunity for growth!" Eager to face her new life, she has only one thing left to do to break free of her old—call off her engagement with the popular and beloved Count Claus! Little does she know the saintly gentleman she's supposed to marry is secretly a blackhearted schemer, and he has other plans. In fact, he's so madly in love with her, he'll use any means necessary to stay by her side and assist her! Once the couple begins working together, Jeanette's enterprising nature starts to shine. With her positive attitude, her natural genius, and her clever, besotted fiancé, can Jeanette triumph over adversity and earn back what's rightfully hers?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Rutile Quartz no Taikan
title_japanese: ルチルクォーツの戴冠
synopsis:
Slaine is a humble, provincial commoner in the small Kingdom of Hasenvalia... Or so he thinks until the day the entire royal family is wiped out in a palace fire and Slaine comes to learn he's really the king's illegitimate son. It now falls on him to succeed the throne. Despite his lack of knowledge and experience, Slaine's natural wits and dedication—plus the support of his aide-de-camp, Monica—allow him to excel against all odds. The future for him and the kingdom looks bright—right up until the eve of his coronation, when the great Empire of Galed declares war against Hasenvalia. Faced with such a frighteningly powerful foe, Slaine is forced to make a choice between fleeing into political exile or resisting invasion to the bitter end. Caught between the conflicting agendas of neighboring nations, this boy from a backwater town must learn how to grow into his crown. Witness the birth of a king!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Osaka
synopsis:
T-shirts, keychains, snacks... when you hear souvenirs, you don't usually think of people. But for Park Sejin, it's another story entirely. Having just ended things with his high school sweetheart, Sejin goes on what was supposed to be a couple's trip to Osaka alone. Heartbroken and bored out of his mind, the college virgin wanders the neon streets of Japan in an attempt to find some sort of meaning in his life. That's when he runs into the buxom-yet-innocent Haru Nakashima: a lonesome Japanese girl in the same boat. One thing leads to another, and the two share a steamy night of passion and pleasure; but when Sejin wakes, Haru is nowhere to be seen. And that's the end of it...or so he thinks, until she shows up as an exchange student at his college! With the two reunited, will they be able to spark the flames that burned so brightly that fateful night? Or are things doomed to fizzle out in disappointment?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Next Door Boyfriend
synopsis:
Yoona is suddenly introduced to a suspicious secret part-time job, asked to befriend the employer's son while monitoring him. But turns out he's the guy next door?! A complicated campus life with the cold and picky neighbor begins.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: The Sacred Life of a Webcomic Artist
title_english: The Sacred Life of a Webcomic Artist
synopsis:
Imagine you were a once-famous adult webcomic artist going through a career slump. Would you rather work with your stunningly sexy but jerk of a producer, Jooho, or your first love and story writer, Minjoon? Well, Hayoon has to work with both! With bills to pay and nothing but ramyun to eat after a string of failed series, Hayoon must successfully launch a new title with both of them on her team. Will she be able to navigate this professional nightmare and revive her career with a bang? And which man will end up taking the spot of her male lead?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Love Love shitai Tatsunomiya-san wa Jouriku Shimashita
title_japanese: 結婚〈らぶらぶ〉したい竜宮さんは上陸しました
synopsis:
The manga centers on a good-looking college student named Nagisa Nii. She saves a stranded turtle by the sea, and she is brought to the Ryuuguu castle under the sea as the turtle's way of saying thank you. Nagisa meets Princess Otohime in the castle, and Otohime falls in love with her. Otohime follows Nagisa on land, and starts living next to her using the name Kameko Tatsunomiya.

(Source: ANN)

title: Hitozumoney: Watashi no Naka ni Ikura Dasu?
title_japanese: ヒトヅマネー～私のナカにいくら出す?～
synopsis:
1-5. Hitozumoney
6. Afterlife
7. Licentious Judge
8. Himitsu no Umareta Hi
9. Mounting
10. Kousaku
11. Milk Rush

title: Watashi wa Teki ni Narimasen!: Aku no Majutsushi ni Tensei shita kedo, Shinu no wa Gomen nanode Scenario ni Sakaratte Ikinobimasu
title_english: I Will Not Be an Enemy!
title_japanese: 私は敵になりません!〜悪の魔術師に転生したけど、死ぬのはごめんなのでシナリオに逆らって生き延びます〜
synopsis:
From an early age, Kiara has been plagued with dreams of another world—dreams in which a girl she doesn't recognize plays a strategy RPG called "Farzia: Kingdom at War." Farzia is, in fact, the same kingdom where Kiara currently lives. Oh, and one other thing: there's an enemy character who's also named Kiara, though her name is Kiara Credias. Naturally, as with any other RPG villain, this enemy is slain by the heroes.

So when her adoptive father, Count Patriciél, orders her to marry Viscount Credias, Kiara comes to a horrifying realization: perhaps those "dreams" were visions of things to come! She hatches a plan to get the hell out of Dodge and create a new future for herself—one where she STAYS ALIVE, thank you very much!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Outaishi-sama, Watashi Kondo koso Anata ni Korosaretakunain desu!: Seijo ni Hamerareta Binbou Reijou, Nidome wa Kushizashi Kaihi shimasu!
title_japanese: 王太子様、私今度こそあなたに殺されたくないんです! ~聖女に嵌められた貧乏令嬢、二度目は串刺し回避します!~
synopsis:
The poverty-stricken noblewoman Liesel was murdered by her lover, the crown prince, in an elaborate ruse set up by the evil saintess. However, she receives a second chance to live as she suddenly wakes up as her childhood self. She takes this event as a chance to change her life, and live without ties to both the crown prince and the saintess, but by a strange twist of fate, she becomes entangled with the saintess's childhood friend! A woman with a strong will to live who has been ensnared by fate—Liesel's success story begins here!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Kakkoii Onnanoko to 12 Centimeter no Yakusoku
title_japanese: カッコいい女の子と12センチの約束
synopsis:
Tomoaki Kamba admired his boyish childhood friend, Ibuki Tachibana, and promised to become "more cool" than her. However, four years have passed, and Ibuki has grown up to be an even more handsome girl! Their relationship is as unchanged as a 12cm height difference that cannot be filled...?

The curtain rises on a pure love story about a cool girl who is sorely in love with a boy who wants to be cool!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Suna no Tsurugi
synopsis:
Collection in which most of the stories take place at the end of the Second World War. Higa gives us an inside look at the battle of Okinawa, from the first signs to the consequences, through different points of view of inhabitants, soldiers, Japanese and American, in this war where there is neither good nor evil, neither good nor bad, only a cruel feeling of absurdity. The men are in turn overwhelmingly stupid, full of wisdom or infinitely touching in their humanity.

(Source: MU)

title: God Jangsan Tiger
synopsis:
Sia Hong is someone who doesn't have any luck with love, money, family, nor answers to life. But one winter day, she picked up a cat, or rather a Jangsan Tiger?

"Huh? I imprinted on a beast with strange abilities—a Jangsan Tiger?"
"I will decide the fate of my contractor."

A life-changing romance thriller with a beast-man, no, a real beast! 

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Madobe no Linoa
synopsis:
The manga about a "new encounter" is set in a rural town in Bavaria, Germany. A traveler visits the town and meets a mysterious girl who frequently escapes from an orphanage. The traveler also keeps a secret of his own.

(Source: ANN)

title: Doukei no Atelier
synopsis:
"I want you more, Masafumi."

The relationship between Kei Higuchi and Masafumi Tsurumi, which was just for the sake of a single artwork, has slowly started to progress. Are they classmates, friends, or lovers? Kei is unable to ask him, thinking that everything will come to an end if he makes an assertion. Masafumi thinks he their relationship is obvious, which ends up in misunderstanding. What will happen to their relationship which was supposed to just be physical and would eventually end?

(Source: GOT)

title: Utsuro naru Regalia
synopsis:
She's a dragon. He's a dragon slayer. And in this world, the Japanese have been wiped out! That day, giant dragons appeared in the sky above Tokyo, and the collapse of the nation of Japan began. With the arrival of monsters called Moju, Japanese people went extinct, and the nation was transformed into a lawless land occupied by armed forces and criminal syndicates. Yahiro is one of the few remaining. Having gained immortality from dragon's blood, he spends each lonely day as a "salvager," transporting artwork out of the uninhabited ruins of Tokyo...until one day, a pair of twin art dealers request that he salvage a particularly powerful and mysterious item.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Saegusa-san wa Megane-senpai to Koi wo Egaku
title_japanese: 三枝さんはメガネ先輩と恋を描く
synopsis:

The victorious demon king, Johann, becomes the ruler of the world, and surprisingly, maintains lasting peace across the land. One day, Johann meets the priest Eugene, who is gifted with a special kind of magic power. Despite their racial difference, Eugene earnestly proclaims his admiration for Johann. Intrigued, and hoping to taste that special magic, the king lures the priest into his bedchambers and practically forces himself on him, claiming this would be an honor for Eugene. When Eugene calls out in surprise, a powerful magical barrier activates, sending Johann flying across the room...! This is a romantic comedy starting from a fateful encounter between a cocky demon king and a priest whose past intrigues him to no end!

synopsis:
Mo Dahye only tried out for a reality dating show to show the producer, Lee Wongu, that she was totally over her one-sided love for him. What she didn't count on was getting cast! Now, Dahye will spend a week with seven men who are trying to win her heart, all while Wongu watches. However, not everyone is who they claim to be, and some people didn't join the show for the right reasons. Will Dahye be able to find the right man for her, and will the viewers agree with her call?

title: Torima Minshuku Yadori-teki na!

In an unexpected turn of events, a university student named Youichi Sakimori ends up freeloading there. The playful and alluring innkeeper Hana Yadori has him dancing in her palms from morning till night...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Seventeenth Son
synopsis:
Ahn Dongha is next in line to take over his village, but there’s just one problem: he can’t do so without a wife. The women of the village are clamoring at his feet to get a chance to convince him to wed…by any means necessary.

synopsis:
Makoto Sakura, sixteen years old, finds himself without a place after dropping out of high school. Suddenly, an otherworldly relic appears before him. On that day, dungeons began to appear all over the world. Humans acquired a level system that completely overturned their previous values. Amidst this revolution, Makoto finds his place inside the dungeons.

Acquiring cheat skills like "Experience Points x1000" and "Level Free," he becomes a level 10,000 powerhouse. As the strongest "Player," he embarks on dungeon exploration!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Amayakasanaide Nakisou dakara
title_english: If You Spoil Me That Much, I'm Gonna Cry

synopsis:
"I can't do it. I'm not even gay anyways. What was I thinking? Being a call boy for a guy...!"

Yuuta is a poor university student who spends his days and nights working part-time to support his family. He is reaching his limit when he's offered a high-paying job as a sex worker. In his sleep-deprived state, he accepts immediately, but having to spend the night with a guy when he isn't even gay? This is asking way too much! Discouraged and overwhelmed, Yuuta gathers up his courage to confide in his ridiculously attractive customer, Mr. Shiraki, about his situation. After hearing about the situation, Mr. Shiraki calmly requests Yuuta to get on the bed anyways. "Wait, no! Am I going to have to sleep with a man after all?" Follow along to see what unfolds between our poor university student and this mysterious heartthrob in a bitter-sweet and pure love story.

(Source: NTT Solmare)

title: Ore no Joyuu ga Ichiban Midara
synopsis:
One day Takumi, a university student who writes erotic novels on the side, is approached by his beautiful classmate Nodoka Otoha. She says that she's a fan of his work, then suddenly shows him a video of herself masturbating and asks him to help her become successful as an amateur porn star.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Define the Relationship
synopsis:
Six years ago, on New Year's Eve, two men shared a brief but unforgettable kiss at midnight. Born as an alpha, a superior secondary sex, Karlyle Frost appears as icy as his noble family name. Although the Frosts produce dominant alphas, who possess even more outstanding innate traits than regular alphas like Karlyle, the duty of continuing the bloodline still falls on him. However, this obligation only hinders Karlyle psychologically, and he develops sexual performance issues with the omegas—capable of bearing children—that his family selects for him.

To resolve Karlyle's problems, the family doctor advises that he sleep with other alphas. This is when Karlyle suddenly reunites with the man he kissed—the dominant alpha Ash Jones. Unlike Karlyle, Ash is effortlessly warm and charismatic, and kindness comes to him naturally. Even so, during their two-month arrangement, Karlyle wishes to leave any potential feelings out of it. But as they begin to meet, Karlyle feels an oddly tender attr

Bridle

Je-hyeok, a priest who repents for his childhood as a bully and lives for God, receives a necklace as a reward for the confession. As soon as he puts on the necklace, Je-hyeok's body heats up and a counselor approaches. Playing with and teasing the priest's erect penis, he reveals that he is an outcast who was bullied by the priest during his school days...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Dawning
synopsis:
Dawn, who lost his parents when he was young, visits the address of a letter from the past to know the circumstances surrounding the death of his parents. There, he met Hames and lived with him. After a while, he felt affection for him. One day, as he spends his peaceful days with him, Dawn finds out that the person who killed his parents was Hames himself...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

synopsis:
The feeling of destiny with only one glance? I never thought I would fall in love that dramatically. Not until I met you on that rainy day...

(Source: Nihon Bungeisha/Media Do International)

title: Un-Re-Write
synopsis:
The ashes of past feelings are still smoldering in their hearts, and now they'll get reignited... A mysterious reunion love story between a cop and a private eye by the masterful Yuzu Marita!

(Source: Nihon Bungeisha/Media Do International)

title: Sukidarake da yo Yamada-san!!
title_japanese: スキだらけだよ山田さん!!
synopsis:
Starting in the spring, Tonari is a university student. Though he set about living alone in an apartment, next door is a slightly eccentric woman, a weirdo who basically "doesn't wear anything!" A comedy about delayed adult responsibilities, full of openings, is about to begin!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Yuki-chan, Aishiteru!
synopsis:
Haru and Yuki, two childhood friends turned lovers, now share their lives under the same roof. They've been inseparable since they met, and their love for each other knows no bounds. Haru, a big softy, often tries to show off a cooler side to impress Yuki but always ends up fumbling in the most endearing ways. Yuki, however, adores Haru just as he is and knows exactly how cool he can be. Despite their blissful relationship, Yuki begins to worry about their future and how they fit into society's expectations. Together, they embark on a tender journey of love and self-discovery, finding the courage in each other to build a future filled with joy and acceptance. 

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title: Palace Meidi Bangai-hen: Heika no Protocol
title_english: Palace Meidi Side Story: Majesty's Protocol
title_japanese: パレス・メイヂ 番外編～陛下のプロトコール～

title: J⇔M
synopsis:
J is a lone assassin feared as "untouchable" in the underworld. Megumi is a lonely girl who has no place at home or school. When the two meet, an unexpected story begins.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Woochi the Wiz Streamer
synopsis:
Woochi Jeon was the greatest taoist 500 years ago, and now he's ready to take over the era of social media! All he dreams of is a peaceful life as a successful online streamer. However, Jinhee Kang, the granddaughter of a man Woochi saved in the past, comes to him with a mysterious scroll and zombie-like monsters in hot pursuit. As he tries to find the source of these monsters, he's invited to Exceed, a competition for top streamers, only to find there might be a link between the two...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Tada Ookina Neko ni Naritai
title_japanese: ただ大きな猫になりたい
synopsis:
The manga centers on Rika Kuroki, a 28-year-old single woman, who already gave up on falling in love and getting married. But when Rika's housemate leaves her to get married, she becomes afraid of growing old alone and decides to adopt a rescue cat. However, at the cat adoption event, Rika was told that a single person cannot adopt a cat. But she finds another person to help her adopt a cat.

(Source: ANN)

title: The Girl Beyond the Wall
synopsis:
Jong-hyeon is your average college student with a crush on a girl who's dating somebody else. The fact that the guy she's dating is a total jerk is just salt on the wound. Meanwhile, his classmate Seojin happens to have a crush on that total jerk. After sharing drinks and sob stories, the two of them end up having sex. That's not a big deal. The big deal is the scheme that Seojin proposes to him to get their respective crushes to break up. It might be the worst idea ever, but it's an offer that he can't refuse...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Kamikudaite Ai wo Oshiete
title_english: Chew Me Up and Teach Me About Love
title_japanese: 噛み砕いて愛をおしえて
synopsis:
Hitomi has a secret crush on his kind and muscular neighbor, Kamiya. Hitomi always brings him extra food from his part-time job, but, one day, Kamiya's attitude suddenly changes. His kind smile disappears and with wild panting, he steals a kiss from Hitomi while pushing him against the wall. Then, animal ears appear on Kamiya's head...!

This is a passionate love story between a noble college student and a gentle giant who suffers from theriomorphosis.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Majutsu Guild Sousui: Umarekawatte Imasara Yarinaosu Nidome no Gakuin Seikatsu
title_english: Commander-in-Chief of the Magic Guild!: A Second Chance at School Life
title_japanese: 魔術ギルド総帥～生まれ変わって今更やり直す2度目の学院生活～
synopsis:
The Heavenly Visitor and Great Sage, Cedric, is a sorcerer with immense magical prowess, so much so that he has become known as the living legend. In an unfortunate twist of fate, he faces an early demise at the hands of his traitorous subordinates. But Cedric turns this predicament into an opportunity for even further growth. Having felt the limits of his power, he had been studying the secret of rebirth to begin anew as a newborn human. However, when he puts his research into practice, he finds himself in the body of Alphred, a weak boy who is being picked on at school! Frustrated with his circumstances, he offers up his life to summon an avenger in Cedric, setting the stage for an epic revenge saga of the greatest sage!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Risou no Shiri
synopsis:
Atsushi Kido is an office worker with unusual tastes. Exhausted by days of overwork and power trips from his boss, he stops by his old part-time job, the Discipline Club, and is immediately asked to help out. When he enters the playroom, Atsushi finds a beautiful businessman with the prettiest posterior tied up and waiting...! The man, calling himself Aya, confesses to using his authority to harass people at work, and lifts his hips for a punishment. Atsushi can't get enough of Aya's behavior!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Aiqing de Yangzi: Xin Zhi Suo Xiang
title_english: What Love Looks Like: Heart Wants What It Wants
title_japanese: 爱情的样子: 心之所向
synopsis:
"Though both share a common goal, they couldn't be any further than friends"

Clara Lu, a determined but clumsy stage actress, gave up sports to pursue the arts. She's worked hard to improve her craft, but to no avail. In the same theater troupe is Charles Chi, a proud and talented actor who can never quite win the acting awards he yearns for. The two hate each other, but their relationship shifts to something warmer when they both experience the pain of being dumped by a long-time lover. Will they listen to their hearts and give love another chance?

(Source: Comikey Media)

title: Ranker
synopsis:
Once a winner of the middleweight challenger's decider bout showdown, Junseo Kang is now a retired fighter struggling to overcome his worst nightmare: zombies. Every time fear catches him, he sees others as zombies. Now with the new opportunity rising, he sees his way out: join the ranker game, win the prize money, and overcome his fragile mental. In an all-or-nothing showdown, a total of 100 characters must fight for their players and eliminate each other to get to the top 5 ranks to win the accumulated prize money of 20 million dollars.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Fushi no Gunzei wo Hikiiru Bocchi Shiryoujutsushi, Tenshoku shite SSS-Rank Boukensha ni Naru.
title_japanese: 不死の軍勢を率いるぼっち死霊術師、転職してSSSランク冒険者になる。
synopsis:
"The ultimate ambition of the most formidable necromancer... is to make friends?!"

In the eleventh hour of the Saldia Empire's impending defeat, salvation arrives in the form of Rogue, a lone necromancer. Armed with immense power and leading legendary aides, his solitary goal is to forge friendships. Employing the abilities of Kalfa, the most distinguished appraiser, he masks his loathed profession in that of an "adventurer." Rogue steps into the world as a rookie adventurer, but his extraordinary power can't be completely hidden, sparking rumors that gradually trigger a grand disturbance in the kingdom. Embark on a fresh adventure with this lone necromancer!

(Source: Starts Shuppan, translated)

title: Sylph no Hanahime
synopsis:
In the imperial capital of Ventfleur, the newly enthroned Princess Natalia is approached by the inscrutable and suspect Sister Sara... The fantasy yuri adventure of a lonesome princess and meddlesome nun!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Takamine, a girl who can't seem to find something she likes or even really enjoys, has a chance encounter with Sakura, a student from a different school. When the two accidentally swap books, a connection is made that neither expected. While Sakura enjoys reading and talking about books, Takamine finds she quite likes Sakura's excitement and wonders if she'll ever feel so passionate about something...or someone. 

A sweet, slow burn romance about two young women and the relationship that blossoms between them.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

A girl named Yui Kawaga, who's devoted to her swimming club activities, had a dilemma. Her male senpai Okabe has done nothing but play around with girls, and she's trying to get him to be serious with his club activities.

"He's the lowest of the low, but the club needs his talent."

At the end of her inner struggle, she winds up offering him her body herself. Perhaps it's due to Okabe's skillful techniques, or maybe Kawaga's own natural sensitivity she didn't know she had, that from her first time having sex, she reaches powerful orgasms to such a degree that she can't even move. A classmate who is always nonchalantly late to school, but his true identity is...?! The new serialized story of battles and oversleeping begins!!

title: Shino to Ren
synopsis:
The tomboy and the quiet girl don't seem to have much in common at first glance, except that they're head over heels in love. Ren is loud, brash, and possessive—a far cry from Shino's calmer, more reserved demeanor. But hey, sparks fly in the most unlikely cases, and this couple can barely keep their hands off each other. Between Ren's aggressive flirting and Shino's adorable personality, if one of them isn't blushing, whoever's reading along with them sure will be.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Konna Koi nara Owari ni Shitai!
title_english: Is This the Kind of Love I Want?
title_japanese: こんな恋なら終わりにしたい!
synopsis:
When Uta comes out as gay and confesses he wants to sleep with another man for once, his friend Ryouma—who's a virgin himself—obliges. But Ryouma is straight. Or at least, he thinks he is. The two men live together as friends, living their own lives and dating their own partners. But they continue to be inextricably drawn back to one another...

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Jin: Anime Seirei no Moribito Gaiden
title_japanese: ジン～アニメ精霊の守り人外伝～
synopsis:
Set six years before Seirei no Moribito, this is the origin story for Jin, one of the Imperial Hunters.

(Source: MU)

title: Tata the Cat
synopsis:
It's summer vacation and all middle school student Suyeon wants to do is to go down to Gorong Village to spend time with her granny. But the moment she gets there, she is greeted by wondrous sight—a special cat named Tata, who blooms from a gigantic flower bud! Now, Suyeon is up for an unforgettable and magical adventure with her new companion, Tata—who might help her uncover the secrets that bind Tata, Gorong Village, and herself together.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Yozora no Futari Camp Gohan
title_english: Camping and Cooking Together Under the Stars
title_japanese: 夜空のふたりキャンプごはん
synopsis:
Momoka is an office lady who loves to cook and to eat. Takumi is a high school boy whose hobby is night sky photography. Following a certain encounter, the two have end up going camping together. A delicious camp meal for the two people with an age difference!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Iyahaya Atami-kun
synopsis:
Atami-kun has a gorgeous face. A romantic heart. And a steady stream of girls asking him out at every opportunity. Which is all wonderful, except...he likes guys, not girls. An upperclassman who enjoys reading, the long-haired boy who sits in front of him, the cute worker at the flower shop—each love fleeting but sincere, and just a bit complicated. Each bringing its own joy and melancholy. My oh my...even for Atami-kun, life truly isn't easy.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Onee Shikkaku: Kedamono ni Hyouhen shita Gozen 3-ji
title_english: Life with My Roomie: He Turned into a Beast at 3 A.M.
title_japanese: オネエ失格～ケダモノに豹変した午前3時～
synopsis:
Emi Asai, a run-of-the-mill office worker, is currently living an apartment with her older cousin, Kiichi Uno. A good-looking guy, Kiichi works nights as a bartender. Best friends since forever, they couldn't have been more different in their daily schedules, or their choice of lovers... Until one late night, when their relationship gets turned upside down!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Hontou ni Baka na Oneechan
title_japanese: 本当にバカなお姉ちゃん

title: Insatiable Massage Club
synopsis:
Seo Minjae, who recently treated his hyperhidrosis at a mysterious clinic, now possesses a strange power no one can quite explain. To manage its lingering symptoms, he turns to the campus rehabilitation club, Care, for an affordable solution. To join, he must pass an initiation test: a one-on-one massage session in front of the club president. The catch? His massage partner is none other than Yoo Ara, a judo major who once slammed him into the ground after mistaking him for the campus pervert. Now, Minjae must use his mysterious power to pull off the ultimate act of persuasion.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Ouji no Himegoto
synopsis:
The ace of the female volleyball club, Touka Ayame, is tall and neat and is called a "prince." But this prince has a hobby that can't be shared with others...

Actually, I like naughty TL (Teen Love) novels! There's one more thing that I can't tell anyone about... I'm a little worried about Asagi-senpai, who is also a member of the library committee... He doesn't call me a prince, he treats me like a girl... He's special.

One day, she finds out Asagi-senpai's secret... The author of the TL novel that Ayame likes is Asagi-senpai!? The story of two people with a secret begins.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Locked Onto You
synopsis:
Detective Ganghui encounters Hajun, a world-famous designer who looks exactly like her late boyfriend, Yujin. He even wears the matching ring Ganghui and Yujin had shared. Hajun seems to know what's bothering her but won't tell her the secret behind the uncanny resemblance. Instead, he keeps persuading her to date and later marry him. Now Ganghui has two options: follow her heart and fall in love with that man or follow her head to find out the truth about him. Oh, wait. Maybe, just maybe... she'll be able to choose both.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Terminally Ill Young Master of the Baek Clan
synopsis:
Baek Yigang is a son of the Baek Clan, one of the seven great clans of Zhongyuan. Afflicted with the Taiyin Qi Blockage, he is cursed with a shortened lifespan and the inability to collect internal energy. He had been peacefully spending the rest of his days indoors when he was ambushed by a group of masked people. During the ambush, he lost his servant who was like a sister to him. Chased by the attackers, Baek Yigang escaped through a secret underground path. When he came across a blocked path, he decided he'd at least die fighting and picked up a rusted sword that was stuck in the ground...

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Hilde Takes House Arpeggio
synopsis:
When Hilde Ruth is put on trial for defending herself from a lecherous customer, she meets Viscount Logen Strauss, who reveals that she's actually the granddaughter of the powerful Duke Arpeggio! Eager to become a noble, Hilde happily accompanies Logen to her ancestral home. But instead of a tearful family reunion, she's coldly ordered to pass a test to prove herself worthy of the Arpeggio name. Under such circumstances, will Hilde successfully claim her spot in House Arpeggio?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Absolute Master of the Senate
synopsis:
As the leader of the demon sect, Yan Suyun lived a difficult, wretched life. It is only as he is dying that he realizes he never lived the life he truly wanted. Reborn as a child, Suyun is now determined to be an honorary elder of the powerful Wulin Alliance, one of the many enemies of the demon sect. Despite his aspirations, Suyun is only a puny kid and has much to learn of the alliance's ways. With his second life hanging in the balance, can Suyun go from absolute demon to absolute master?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Academy's Genius Swordsman
synopsis:
Following a momentous battle against giants for the fate of the world, Ronan emerges victorious as the last man standing of the imperial army. As he laments this hollow victory with his dying commander, Grand Marshal Adeshan, they quickly learn that the war is far from over and an overwhelming force of giants descends from the heavens. Fearing the worst, yet seeing hope in the courageous Ronan, Adeshan uses her last time slip to send him back to the past, so that he can enroll in the prestigious Phileon Academy and become the strongest swordsman the empire has ever seen!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Righteous Demon of Kunlun
synopsis:
The True Celestial Demon of the Heavenly Demon God Clan was a menace, striking fear into his enemies. After an untimely demise, the True Celestial Demon finds himself reborn... as a baby? A baby in the care of the Kunlun School, at that! Jing Guang, as he's now called, is determined to become an even greater martial artist in this life, but something seems off about the Kunlun School's technique. Can Guang use his knowledge and experience to transcend the Kunlun School and his former self?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Tales of a Shining Sword
synopsis:
Eunho, the strongest in the youkai realm! He gained the chance to become a human being after losing the woman he loved and killing countless youkai. After passing the gate of reincarnation by accumulating merit for a thousand years to abandon his immortal body... He became a human being, held a sword, and learned martial arts for the first time. But this is very... easy?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Movies Are Real
synopsis:
While working as a small supporting actor in a movie, Ki Man-sung has nothing else going for him. However, that was when, through mysterious circumstance, the movie set had become reality during filming. With the sound of the director's cut, during that short take, he's not an actor but actually thrown into the events occurring, showing the pain and emotions he faces in that moment. He can only come back if he creates that perfect take...! Can he grow to become the greatest actor?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Tasogare Out Focus: Long Take
title_english: Twilight Out of Focus: Long Take
title_japanese: 黄昏アウトフォーカス long take
synopsis:
Winter is coming for roommates-turned-lovers Mao and Hisashi, bringing with it a whole slew of unexpected challenges and a noted cooling in their relationship that makes Mao wonder if the foundation they've built really is as strong as it once seemed. To make matters worse, this period of transition before their final year of high school has also shaken up the one constant Mao had always relied on: film. Weighed down by such uncertainty, will the two manage to find something solid to see them through a season of darkness, or will the curtain fall on their romance for good?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Excited at the prospect of living in close proximity to Ayumu, Aki soon allows himself to become an outlet for Ayumu's dirty desires. Something unexplainable happens and San is transported back 170 years in the past and comes across a captured Myeon. As the two tussle over this incredibly valuable object, it is clear that whatever happens from now on, history as it was known has been altered and their destinies are now forever intertwined.

Now, a thousand years later, all he wants is to get a nice, cushy job as a civil official and build a quiet life for himself. Too bad that he still has fighting prowess he can't explain. Too bad that as a child, he was taken in by a renowned general and trained alongside Chou Hakurei, famed for her talent and beauty. Too bad that he's gotten into rescuing pretty (and pretty immature) merchant prodigies. Sekiei was really looking forward to some peace and quiet so he could kick back and read, but when the foreign nation of Gen launches an invasion that triggers war, he's forced to put his books down. With the power of skills he'd hoped never to put to use again, Sekiei will once more have to make a name on the battlefield... Will he and his friends be enough to save their homeland?

Soon after, Don Sullivan comes back, whisks Iruma away, and begs the boy to become his grandson. And just like that, Iruma begins his new life as the next in line to lead a gigantic gang of—dare we say—demonic mafiosos!

Now living the nightmare that was once her playground, Tory faces a serious question: can she build her skills fast enough to buffer against the brutality of war, or is she doomed to become another bloody stain on the battlefield?

Pervasive thoughts of the mysterious man have consumed his mind since the day they crossed paths as children. But when the two meet again by chance, he discovers a disappointing truth: his cherished first love is Heo Minjae, the reckless black sheep of the H Corporation's main family. In his younger years, he dreamed of glory as a master swordsman, but those days are long behind him. Out of the blue, he receives a visit from a famous former pupil who brings him world-shattering news—he's been appointed as a special instructor for the knights of the Liberion Order! With his life now turned upside down, Beryl travels to the capital and reunites with some of his former students: elite knights, an ace wizard, and even an adventurer who's attained the highest guild rank possible. But why do they all want his tutelage?! As far as he's concerned, they clearly don't need him anymore. Can Beryl live up to his new position? Despite Zenos's diligent efforts to hone his skills to nothing short of perfection, the party deems him useless and kicks him out. Bereft of money and options, Zenos starts an illegal clinic and becomes a shadow healer. Word of his healing genius spreads quickly throughout the city's underbelly, and as his reputation grows among the dregs of society, knowledge of Zenos's esteem reaches the wrong ears...

Now bereft of money and out of options, Zenos decides to put his self-taught skills to use elsewhere and opens an underground clinic. Word quickly spreads about the brilliant healer working incredible magic in the city's shadowy underbelly. Even the royal palace is taking notice... But one glance in the mirror shatters his dreams of badassery! He's entered the game as Piggy, the love-to-hate overweight villain whose stalker-like obsession with his reluctant fiancée spells his doom. With elitist bullies roaming the school halls and cutthroat adventurers lurking in the dungeon, our hero has to act fast to lose weight and level up if he wants to survive and break free from his scripted fate. Using his peerless knowledge of the game, he's ready to exploit every trick to become the world's greatest unsung hero!

title_english: The Oblivious Saint Can't Contain Her Power: Disgraced No Longer, I'm Finding Happiness with the Prince!
title_japanese: 無自覚聖女は今日も無意識に力を垂れ流す ～公爵家の落ちこぼれ令嬢、嫁ぎ先で幸せを掴み取る～
synopsis:
Lady Carolina Sanchez has spent her entire life believing she is the "Sanchez family disgrace," a notion constantly reinforced by her elder sister, Flora. In public, Flora is a model of kindness and gentility, always coming to her baby sister's defense...but behind closed doors, she heaps abuse on Carolina, leveraging Carolina's perceived shortcomings to suit her own ends. When Carolina is sent to the neighboring Malcosian Empire for a political marriage to Prince Edward Ruby Martinez, she expects to disappoint her new family too. But, to her surprise, her husband-to-be and her new in-laws seem to genuinely adore her! Can Carolina escape the anguish of her past and rise to the occasion as Edward's imperial consort? She just might, especially if she's not quite as powerless as she assumed...

title_japanese: 婚約破棄を狙って記憶喪失のフリをしたら、素っ気ない態度だった婚約者が「記憶を失う前の君は、俺にベタ惚れだった」という、とんでもない嘘をつき始めた
synopsis:
Viola wants nothing more than to break off her dull arranged engagement with Phillip. He's the son of a duke, and Viola is thoroughly convinced she's an unfitting future wife for a man of his station. Worst of all, he seems utterly uninterested in her. So when Viola is in a carriage accident, she takes the opportunity to fake amnesia in hopes of getting out of her betrothal. Little does she know Phillip is also an opportunist, and he takes advantage of the situation by feeding the "amnesiac" Viola a tale she can scarcely believe—that they've been passionately in love this entire time! Now trapped in her own lie, Viola is forced to play along. Can this curious couple outwit each other into happiness? Or will their bizarre web of deception get them both caught?

In the blink of an eye things go from attentive boss to pretend boyfriend and/or personal body guard, and he doesn't seem to care to hide it!

But now that they're officially a couple, Ami seems a little off. While Rei is head over heels for her, Ami is a player who isn't even sure how to love just one person. Rei is crushed by Ami's seemingly careless approach to their relationship, but even so, she won't give up. Will Rei's earnest but cumbersome feelings for Ami win out in the end? Or is the girl she loves simply too far out of reach?

(Source: Yen Press)

With his frail physique and meek nature, Kwon Mi-eum is in no position to repay his father's considerable debt. Seizing the opportunity, the crooked lenders hold his father hostage and coerce Mi-eum into a simple job: to infiltrate the affluent household of Baek Jitae and report his every move.

Mi-eum's role is an unusual one—to assist Jitae with his bath. But Mi-eum's insecurity and awkwardness amplify the pressure he feels, which leads him to unintentionally disrespect his new boss and jeopardize his mission. Curiously, Jitae's interest in Mi-eum grows each day, and Mi-eum starts to wonder if he is really playing Jitae or if the tables have turned.

The Tokoshie call themselves weapons as they take over the streets with their overwhelming powers. Then, they vanish, and a decade passes. A certain military enterprise develops a battle drone that can fight the Tokoshie. A certain wealthy person goes underground to seek the Tokoshie's secret to living forever. A certain girl embarks on the path to battle with the Tokoshie, her parents' enemy. This is the chronicle of the long fight between humanity and humanity's foe Tokoshie.

(Source: ANN)

Despite being shunned by those around her, zombie girl Mukuro lives a healthy life with her only human friend Ruri.  A smidgen sad but heartwarming daily life.

While at school, Kouhei rescued Souta from a piece of pipe falling on top of him, Souta became concerned about Kouhei's shoulder, saying, "If you get injured, you won't be able to throw a ball.'' Slowly over time, the two of them grow closer, although Kouhei finds it strange that Souta knows that he used to play baseball.

One day, when Kouhei was sleeping in his classroom after school, Souta almost kisses him...?

When Princess Adelheid Kotrov of the Kotrov Empire leaves her nation for an arranged marriage, she holds little expectation, only hoping that she and her future husband can get along well. However, upon her arrival at the Echmont Empire, she is immediately humiliated. Emperor Karl Ulrich Echmont demands Adelheid's subservience and silence, while his concubine, Diane Poitier, shamelessly flaunts her unchecked influence.

Despite being alone in a foreign land, Adelheid refuses to surrender. Her education has prepared her for becoming an outstanding empress, and she is also a striker—a powerful mage capable of single-handedly destroying the towers that drop from the sky and unleash swarms of wild monsters. Adelheid has no interest in Karl, but she is determined to find a dependable ally, resolve the poorly handled issue of the towers, and take charge of all that rightfully belongs to her.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

synopsis:
Tanaka, a father of three and a gymnastics school instructor, suddenly finds himself on the brink of unemployment. Amidst this turmoil, a familiar figure appears before him to save the day...and it's the popular children's show host, "Gymnastics Buddy," Asato?! What's more, he can exterminate the mysterious "bugs" that only Tanaka has been able to see since childhood?! Hold your breath as Tanaka takes a daring vault into an unforeseen twist of fate!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

The Party of Heroes defeats the Demon King, a menace to the world. But as the enemy meets his demise, he unleashes miasma capable of destroying the entire world. In the face of despair, Saint Sophia makes the ultimate sacrifice to halt this devastating miasma. Years roll by, and when she finally awakens, she finds herself in a world twenty years into the future.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Hu Yan Zhuan
synopsis:
When half–fox demon, half-human Feijin loses his family at an early age, he is taken in by and becomes the pupil of Sage Gaochun. As the centuries pass, Feijin’s admiration for his master turns romantic, but such relationships between a master and his pupil are not allowed. And though Feijin continues to confess his feelings to Gaochun, he is gently rebuffed each and every time. Desperate, Feijin puts his master under a spell and whisks him off to bed, but the typically gentle and reserved Gaochun surprises Feijin with his passion. It’s only later that he learns his master had once been deeply in love with a demon and was severely punished for it!

But one night, after a particularly long workday, she's threatened by a stranger in a dark alley—and dashing to her rescue is none other than the doctor! Before she knows it, she finds herself captivated by him...

Ever since, he has been frantically searching for Apollo and her voice, but with little success.

However, when Yamabuki's school merges with an all-girls school, things begin to change. As the Broadcasting Club makes an announcement during the very first day, he is shocked to hear Apollo's voice, but there is a problem—all four members of the club sound like her! While each of the girls, Rikka Inohana, Shinobu Uzuki, Nene Himekawa, and Iko Kirino want to pursue their own careers with their voices, Yamabuki joins the club in the hope of identifying Apollo. Alongside his close observation, Yamabuki vows to guide the girls to greater heights.

But when his subjects head out of the bar and he is about to follow them, he is stopped by the black-haired beauty, who begs him to not leave and to stay with him. Kaga can't help but feel nervous; but he can't take his eyes off the subjects, so he leaves... only to be beaten in a dark alley?!

But she didn't expect change to come in the form of her fellow cast member, model Kang Woo. Kang Woo is charismatic, handsome, and something she's never experienced before. Will his presence give her the bitter bite she needs in her sickly sweet life?

Masumi, who has a nice face but is not very popular or lucky with men, falls in love at first sight with Takatsuka, a man who's exactly his type. However, they met at a year-end party where Masumi was cross-dressing. He knows that he has to reveal his real gender, but he likes Takatsuka so much that he keeps going on dates with him. Finally, they get into that kind of mood at Takatsuka's place, and Masumi confesses his feelings to him. He was prepared to be rejected, but Takatsuka's reaction was unexpected...!

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: Creepy Honey Trap
title_japanese: クリーピーハニートラップ

title: Akuma na Osananajimi no Ijou na Junjou
title_english: My Childhood Friend Like the Devil Loves Me Abnormally
title_japanese: 悪魔な幼なじみの異常な純情

title: Shinitagari-kun to Inma
title_japanese: 死にたがりくんと淫魔
synopsis:
One day, Takeru, who is a hikikomori with no job, no money or girlfriend, suddenly meets succubus Rui out of nowhere. Since then, he has been having sex with Rui every morning and every night. His savings are running low, and when he tries to find a job, he is seduced by Rui... Will life with a sex-crazed demon really work out?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: Umino-san wa Fukanshou
synopsis:
1. Umino-san wa Fukanshou
2. Umino-san wa Fukanshou?
3. Hikari-kun Higaisha no Kai
4. Damasareta no wa Kimi no Hou
5. Damasareta no wa Boku no Hou
6. Zoku: Hikari-kun Higaisha no Kai
7. Kubota-san wa Chokkan

title: Kiritani-kun wa Sakaraenai
title_japanese: 桐谷くんは逆らえない

title: Chihiro-san
synopsis:
An unapologetic former sex worker starts working at a bento stand in a small seaside town, bringing comfort to the lonely souls who come her way.

(Source: Netflix)

title: Kagehime
synopsis:
The story follows Souichirou Niimi, a third-year art college student, who is dedicated to creating sculptures of beautiful breasts and seeking the ultimate beauty. One night, he is attacked by a youkai and meets Kagehime, a Shadow Princess who fights youkai. In order for Kagehime to operate in the human world, she needs a physical body, and Souichirou agrees to create one for her.

(Source: Shounen Gahousha, translated)

title: Blooming
synopsis:
Oh Kyuri, a lifelong Jeju Island native and hopeless romantic novice, has only one goal in life—to turn her humble coffee shop into a thriving franchise. Love? Not on her radar.

But her peaceful routine is shattered by an infuriatingly rude customer, Cha Sooin. Without hesitation, he takes a sip of her coffee and sneers, "This tastes like dirty mop water."

Kyuri is convinced this man is nothing more than the worst customer she's ever had.

At least, until she sees him naked.

Now, she's restless, unable to sleep, and worst of all—feeling things she never expected...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Attention Residents
synopsis:
You are here to play, and the only way out is death. You could bond with the other tenants, but are you sure you can trust them? Seonghan moves into his new cheap rental, where he immediately gets involved in an elaborate game of death hosted by his neighbor. The tenants struggle to fight for their lives, but some of them seem to have deadly secrets of their own...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Back Home Blues
title_japanese: バックホームブルース

title: Boku wa Love Song ga Utaenai
title_japanese: 僕はラブソングが歌えない

title: Shigotogaeri, Dokushin no Bijin Joushi ni Tanomarete
title_english: On My Way Home from Work, My Beautiful Single Beauty Boss Asked Me to Do Something for Her.
title_japanese: 仕事帰り、独身の美人上司に頼まれて
synopsis:
"Please... I want you to have sex with me."

Haruhiko Sanezawa, a young employee at the company, is invited to a hotel after a drinking session with Yuuko Monou, his strict boss who is feared as the "Empress" of the company. Embarrassed, she has a request for a bewildered Sanezawa...

"Would you be willing just to conceive a child with me?"

It's the start of a relationship without romance, between a man and woman, which they cannot disclose to anyone. A face his boss can only show to him, with the rule that they cannot fall in love.

And yet they are gradually drawn together... It's the start of a forbidden immoral adult love comedy!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Koibumi to 13-sai no Actress
title_japanese: 恋文と13歳の女優〈アクトレス〉
synopsis:
Fumi Isshiki works as an accountant at an entertainment agency. One day, he is transferred to the management department, where Ayano Haga, a 13-year-old child actress, seems to take a liking to him...?

Although she is just a child, she acts more mature than most adults. A dramatic story woven between a professional child actress and her manager!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Shinitagari to Hibari
synopsis:
The rounin, Kuchiki, and the young girl, Hibari, live together. Having lost her parents and facing the world alone, Hibari finds solace in Kuchiki's caring presence and begins to regain her smile and strength. However, a casual remark from a boy named Matsunosuke, who lost his mother in a fire, triggers memories of her father's past sins in Hibari's heart.

Can two souls burdened with wandering hearts find a way to live for tomorrow? This is a story of human compassion and emotions in the streets of old Edo.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Nekokaburi Reijou Aria no Koubou
title_japanese: 猫かぶり令嬢アリアの攻防
synopsis:
Aria, a beautiful young lady known as the "Lily of the Valley," may seem pure and modest, but she is also a jewel thief causing a ruckus in the royal capital. Raoul, known as the "Blue Moon Paladin" for his ruthless enforcement of the law, manages to discover the thief's true identity—? The battle begins between the lady thief who will never be caught, and the strict knight who never lets his prey escape!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Ian Lane: Executor
synopsis:
Ian Lane wakes to find himself in an eerie house with no memory and only ominous strangers for company. He soon discovers that he's a member of a team of afterlife enforcers and that he was recently tricked into giving away an important key, setting off a chain of events that disturbs the entire balance of the beyond. It's up to the executors to set things right again, but between formidable new foes and demons from Ian's dark past, this job gives new meaning to the phrase "life or death."

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Suki tte Itta no Omae Darou ga!
title_japanese: 好きって言ったのお前だろうが!
synopsis:
When Akira was a child, the stage was where he felt like home. Many years later, he's still an actor, but not very successful. His distractions are visiting bars and occasional one-night stands. One night, he meets his former classmate Takao. Akira recognizes him instantly, since Takao was the one who told him: "I'm your biggest fan!" But now Takao doesn't even remember his former idol! Akira will not put up with this...

(Source: Egmont Manga, translated)

title: Chameleon wa Tenohira ni Koi wo Suru.
title_english: Love in the Palm of His Hand
title_japanese: カメレオンはてのひらに恋をする。
synopsis:
"To think that just what I've always wanted to hear would come from someone I just met."

Fujinaga is a university student who dreams of becoming an actor so he can do what he loves best—conveying emotion and story through physical expression. But after failing multiple auditions, his hopes are dashed and his confidence crushed. When he meets Keito, a fellow student with congenital hearing loss, Fujinaga is suddenly introduced to the world of sign language. Although clumsy at first, Fujinaga quickly picks up signing and surprises Keito with his astonishing talent of expressing emotions through action.

Is it that only in a place beyond all verbal limitations can two people, both yearning to be understood, forge a bond they never expected?

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Wakarasero! Namaikitsune-sama
title_japanese: わからせろ！ナマイキツネ様

title: Kokuma Musou
synopsis:
A sorcerer of black magic rises from the depths of hell to take revenge on the hero who betrayed him and his comrades in arms. However, the sorcerer could not defeat the hero and turned into a poisonous mist that poisoned the World Tree shrine. But a holy girl manages to resurrect him, will the sorcerer be able to avenge him?!

(Source: MangaDex)

title: The Duchess's Secret Writing Life
synopsis:
As an introvert, Alisha Weber has spent most of her time writing the fantasy series "The Knight's Return" under a pseudonym, only to have her freedom threatened when she's pressured to marry. Enter Duke Lhesa Armunt, another introvert with a similar issue and a rabid fan of "The Knight's Return"! Upon meeting each other, they realize they're a rather good match and agree to a contract marriage. But how long can Alisha keep her writing life a secret when living with a huge fan of her own work?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Tsugi wa Anata ga Yarareru Ban desu.
title_japanese: 次はアナタがヤられる番です。
synopsis:
An armed group has invaded the school and announced that normal high school life has come to an abrupt end. The students are toyed with by men who rule the school with gun in hand. A bacchanalia of sex and death ensues. What lies ahead is... An erotic suspense horror begins.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Daisuki na Shinyuu ga VTuber no Jibun ni Gachikoi shiteta Hanashi
title_english: My Best Friend Is in Love with My VTuber
title_japanese: 大好きな親友がＶチューバーの自分にガチ恋してた話

title: Wo de Mama Shi Da Mingxing
synopsis:
What will happen when an overly-supportive daughter discovers loads of photos of her mom, a famous actress, on the internet posing with her female co-stars in ways that "friends" would not do?

(Source: MU)

title: Hana Ikeru: Kawakita Koukou Kadou-bu
title_english: "Hanaikeru": Kawakita High School "Kadou" Flower Art Club
title_japanese: ハナイケル －川北高校華道部－

title: Nakanaka Kishou na Mitsuya-san
title_japanese: なかなか稀少な光谷さん

title: Sute Akuyaku Reijou wa Kaibutsu ni Otogibanashi wo Kataru
title_japanese: 捨て悪役令嬢は怪物にお伽噺を語る
synopsis:
Hailing from a ducal family, Sylph Biebel has a duty to marry Prince Mikhail Luxborn and someday rule the nation. But Sylph dreams of becoming a librarian, an impossible goal for a lady. Yearning for the freedom her beloved books provide, she often sneaks into the royal library, posing as a commoner.

There, Sylph befriends Kanna Copierne, a fellow bookworm and secretly a noble. When their true identities are revealed, their friendship continues—until Sylph introduces Kanna to Mikhail. Kanna suddenly denounces Sylph as a jealous bully plotting to kill her. For that reason, Sylph is locked in a small cage and abandoned near the neighboring Kingdom of Dagenhelm to be devoured by its king, a man-eating monster.

However, Sylph is saved by Faber, the real king of Dagenhelm and actually a young man with a keen interest in stories. As Faber takes a liking to Sylph, even this girl who was unfairly pushed into the role of a villainess may seize her happily ever after.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Hellcraft
synopsis:
Betrayed by the world, high school student Yeom Seung-gi shuts himself away in his room. Baphomet, the newly designated ruler of hell, chooses Seung-gi as his hell maker. In return for his assistance in creating hell, Baphomet grants Seung-gi the right to choose its prisoners. Seung-gi joins forces with the demon in order to seek revenge, expecting it to be a win-win relationship...

Suddenly, a death game begins—to survive, they must be sent to hell!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: The Awl
synopsis:
The Awl is a story of ordinary folks struggling to be treated as humans.

In the face of corporate greed and reprehensible actions, a bond of respect has formed between young executive Yi Su-in and union activist Gu Go-sin. Seeing what his employers are capable of, Yi joins Gu in trying to establish a union for the company's employees. But despite the unacceptable working conditions, the workers are reluctant to go through with it...until they witness a shocking situation involving one of their fellow employees.

(Source: Ablaze)

title: Two on Ice
synopsis:
When he was in third grade, Hayuma Minekoshi became entranced by the world of figure skating. After meeting a mysterious girl and witnessing her perform a mesmerizing triple axel at a competition, Hayuma resolved to learn the sport—even if he had to teach himself the basics. Despite the hardships, Hayuma persisted in hopes of encountering the enigmatic prodigy again. However, one year later, Hayuma discovered that the girl he admired disappeared from the limelight. Having never learned her name, he gave up hope of being able to find her again.

Now in his third year of middle school, Hayuma moves from his small northern hometown to Tokyo, where he has a chance to learn figure skating properly. In a twist of fate, that same mysterious girl reappears at the rink. As the two reunite, former prodigy Kisara Saotome reveals that she had quit competing in singles to try her luck in pair skating. Seeing potential in Hayuma despite his lack of experience, Kisara invites him to be her temporary

title: Watashi tte Gaiaku desu ka? Ohanabatake Seiyuuchuu no Baai
title_japanese: わたしって害悪ですか？～お花畑声優厨の場合～
synopsis:
An office worker lady is following a male voice actor as a fan. But step by step, her fan support turns into an obsessive urge for possession where she feels responsible of protecting him from potential "parasites."

(Source: Manga Mogura RE)

title: Mata Raishuu, Anata no Utsuwa de Itadakimasu
title_english: Tell You I Love You Week After Week
title_japanese: また来週、あなたの器でいただきます

title: Kurosaki-kun wa Dokusen Shitagaru: Hajimete no Koi wa Amasugite
title_english: Kurosaki Wants Me All to Himself: The Intense Sweetness of First Love
title_japanese: 黒崎くんは独占したがる～はじめての恋は甘すぎて～
synopsis:
"I want you, Moka..." There's a popular guy in class, and he can't stand the way the other girls look at him. The only girl he wants all for himself... is the plain girl sitting in the seat in front of him?! Moka Asano is your average high school girl, and sitting behind her is Izumi Kurosaki. Kurosaki's the captain of the soccer team, and is so popular that the neighboring schools have fan clubs for him! The girls always crowd around his desk, so Moka can never get a chance to sit down at her desk in the morning... but everything changes when Moka gets the chance to be close to Kurosaki when they see each other in the old school library. Even though Kurosaki hates being around girls, and tends to give everyone these cold stares, he looks at Moka with a bright smile and asks her "do you wanna date for real?" It's like he's a completely different person!

(Source: Starts Shuppan)

title: Donna Oppai ga Osuki desu ka? Kimi no Suki na Oppai ga Kitto Mitsukaru Anthology
title_japanese: どんなおっぱいがお好きですか？ キミの好きなおっぱいがきっと見つかるアンソロジー
synopsis: An anthology with a focus on breasts.

title: Her Nickname Is...
synopsis:
Ever wonder what having sex with a werewolf would be like? How about a vampire? Well, Hyunee and Mina are two normal girls, but when things get hot and heavy they're not afraid to let their animalistic sides come out! Driving their boyfriends crazy, there's always another sex romp around the corner. Come along for the ride, where in each episode, you can see a different "monstrous" side of these hot girls and really see what "Her Nickname is..."!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Two Eves: The Girl Trapped in the Wall
title_english: The Two Eves: The Girl Trapped in the Wall
synopsis:
Humanity finds itself in a dire situation when a broken satellite attracts asteroids due to its magnetic parts and pierces through Earth's atmosphere. In South Korea, Bongjoon Goh takes shelter in his landlord's bunker alongside the owner's young daughter, clumsy yet beautiful Ban Hyun-mi.

Despite their age gap, the two quickly become intimate. But after Mae Nan-hee, a medical student living in the same apartment, finds her way to the bunker, Bongjoon and Hyun-mi's relationship changes dramatically. With Bongjoon falling head over heels for Nan-hee, Hyun-mi ends up being pushed aside. However, Nan-hee's gentle and caring personality is not what it seems.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Koukyuu mo Nidome nara: Shirobutahi Sairai Den
title_english: My Return to the Imperial Harem: The Tale of Snow White Sow
title_japanese: 後宮も二度目なら ～白豚妃再来伝～
synopsis:
Jurei, a royal concubine nicknamed "Snow White Sow," was banished to the red-light district after being falsely accused of a crime. Four years pass, and she’s kidnapped and makes a return to the harem. Getting recognized will only spell out death for her! But because of her slimmed down figure and the newfound shining determination in her eyes, she gives off the air of a completely different, astounding beauty! Her attempts at escaping backfire, and the skills she developed in the red-light district prove so useful that she ends up becoming a consort candidate to the emperor. Can Jurei escape the harem without anyone discovering her true identity?!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Seitokaichou wa Koi ga Shitai
title_japanese: 生徒会長は恋がしたい
synopsis:
The perfect student council president and the former delinquent current teacher. The only failing of the student council president is that he doesn't know what love is!?

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

title: Konaide Kounotori
title_english: I Don't Want a Visit from a Stork

title: Anata no Koisuru Kirai na Watashi
title_english: The Me That You Love, The Me That I Hate
title_japanese: あなたの恋する 嫌いなわたし
synopsis:
Saki Asahina has a secret... though everyone at work thinks she's a true beauty, once her makeup comes off, she's as red as an octopus! Having been cruelly bullied in the past for how she looks, Saki has put years of effort into perfecting her makeup game! Now she's never lacking in attention (or the gossip that comes with it), but she has yet to catch the eye of her boss, Fujimichi Bansho, who she's had a crush on for years. One night, while out buying beer and with her makeup off, Saki finds herself being asked out by her boss, who doesn't realize who she is! Just who has he mistaken her for? How long can she keep her makeup-less face a secret?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Fumi-chan no Rakuen
synopsis:
Fumi is a novelist with writer's block. Now she's shacking up with a man in an old house in the countryside. Nighttime picnics, frolicking in the river, harvesting vegetables—they eat lots of delicious food, sleep peacefully, and have sex wherever and whenever the mood strikes. It's like a never-ending summer vacation.

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

title: Shinkeinaikai to Otome Gamer
title_japanese: 神経内科医と乙女ゲーマー
synopsis:
The purpose of busy nurse Mana's life is to play many otome games!! Dr. Takano, the most popular doctor in the hospital, examined Mana when she collapsed from playing too much video games...?! The thrilling love story of a handsome doctor and a nurse!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Zense, Deshi ni Korosareta Majo desu ga, Norowareta Deshi ni Ai ni Ikimasu
title_japanese: 前世、弟子に殺された魔女ですが、呪われた弟子に会いに行きます

title: Point Shooting
synopsis:
After sending his only niece, whom he had raised since his brother and sister-in-law's tragic accident, off to be married, Police Inspector Seo Gun-seok finds himself feeling old, tired, and empty. That is, until his world takes an unexpected turn when an unanticipated visitor arrives. Cho Jun-heon stirs up painful memories. As his niece's childhood friend, Gun-seok had witnessed Jun-heon's growth, even teaching him how to shoot, which eventually led to Jun-heon pursuing competitive shooting. However, Gun-seok's last memory of Jun-heon is rejecting the university student's feelings. But as if nothing had ever happened, Jun-heon reappears six years later: taller, constantly flirting with Gun-seok, and seemingly hiding something...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Falling into the Arms of a Mad Villain
title_english: Falling into the Arms of a Mad Villain
synopsis:
Instead of being caught by Prince Charming, I've fallen into a complete nightmare! Not only did I transmigrate into a trashy romance fantasy novel, but I fell from the sky and ended up in the arms of the mad villain, Edwin Crawford. Before I knew it, he called me his wife from the heavens and was raving about some prophecy. I don't even know who I am, so how can I be his wife?! Until I figure out what is happening, will it be safe to stay in the embrace of the Mad Dragon of the West?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Akuyaku no Goreisoku no Dounika Shitai Nichijou
title_japanese: 悪役のご令息のどうにかしたい日常
authors: Fuwai, Nimu|Uma no Koe ga Kikoeru
synopsis:
When I was selfish and laughing loudly, I (6 years old) remembered my previous life. Is this the world of RPGs? Moreover, I am the weakest of  three brothers, defeated by the heroes of the future. I am the so-called villain. How unlucky. This is terrible. I was confused and depressed, so I decided to stop being a villain first! Be a good boy, get along with my beloved brothers and servants, and defeat the death flag!!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: This Is the Wrong House, Mr. Villain!
title_english: This Is the Wrong House, Mr. Villain!
synopsis:
What do you do when a murderous villain ends up unconscious at your front door? For Yuri, the answer is simple: leave his body outside protagonist Anne-Marie's house and then live in peace as a background character! But for some reason, Yuri can't bring herself to let him ruin sweet, innocent Anne-Marie's life as is written in the original story, so she takes him in and slowly nurses him back to health. Little does Yuri realize the consequences of letting a villain inside her house...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Killer Peter
synopsis:
After devoting his life to the crime organization, Glory Club, Peter retires his status as a legendary killer and spends his remaining days running a quiet used bookstore. But after being ambushed and nearly killed one day by the very organization he dedicated his life to, Peter finds his body magically reverted back to its teenage years. Now that Peter was back to his peak physique, he sets out to settle the score with Glory Club.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Baby Saint Wants to Destroy the World!
title_english: The Baby Saint Wants to Destroy the World!
synopsis:
The perpetual cycle of reincarnation, the recurring tragic deaths. Lucyphela, a formidable witch who became tired of life after enduring 99 lifetimes. She aims to halt the cycle by causing the world's demise. Nevertheless, upon awakening, she discovers her rebirth as the "baby saint," fated to rescue this world?

Nurtured by the very priests who were formerly her adversaries. Menaced by former companions who were once her apprentices! Can the baby saint provoke the world's ruin unscathed?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: The Monster Male Lead Living Under My Bed
title_english: The Monster Male Lead Living Under My Bed
title_japanese: 내 침대 밑에 괴물 남주가 산다
synopsis:
Waking up as a character destined to be killed by her family, Irina Sordier refuses to follow the script. She plans to survive by escaping after her father marries her off to Archduke Alexei Ruslan. That is until she is saved from her abusive circumstances by a slime! The two bond quickly, but the slime suddenly vanishes, and Irina laments its loss. Years later, she meets Alexei, but he seems to know things about her that only the slime would! Can Irina save herself and the slime after all?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Let's Meet After Work
synopsis:
Three years ago in Spain, Chaewon had to break up with her boyfriend, Seongjun Han, because her father collapsed after his company went bankrupt. In order to pay the debt her father owes to his former employees and loan sharks, she decides to take part in a posthumous marriage for 200 million won. As a condition for the marriage, she's not allowed to date anyone for 1,000 days. On her wedding day, she runs into Seongjun, who still has feelings for her, and now she has to work part-time at his company for three months.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Short Circuit Love
synopsis:
Seol Jaeha and Lee Hyun have been best friends since childhood. They do nearly everything together, and despite Jaeha's unprecedented popularity at school, he only has eyes for Hyun. Enter the new transfer student (and Jaeha's personal nightmare), Kim Doyoung. Hyun and Doyoung spend more and more time together every day, leaving less time for Jaeha to make his move. What's worse, Doyoung is icing him out for some unknown reason, all while growing ever closer to Hyun. The two seemingly butt heads at every turn, and Jaeha simply cannot figure out why. The answer is simple: Doyoung sees Jaeha's coy, flirtatious teasing of Hyun as bullying, and wants to protect his new friend. Their wires crossed, an unending cycle of misunderstandings and misfortunes between the rivals ensues; however, a fateful game of basketball just might spark something electric between them...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Osu World
synopsis:
In a particular Southern country, many animals are living in the garden of a king's palace.

Agifu, a black leopard, is the leader of the pack, and one day he's asked to care for Val, a young white lion. Val's a coward, a cry-baby, and tiny, but under the strong and dashing Agifu, he grows into a fine man while learning to adore Agifu. Each time he yearns for Agifu, he tries to mate with him, but fails.

This is the start to a furry love story where both sides can't seem to be with who they want when they go into heat!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Tsugou no Ii Hate
synopsis:
One day, Toruko, an ordinary housewife, discovers that her husband Wataru is having an affair. In order to quench her own thirst, she calls on a male escort, Shoji. Toruko becomes addicted to her relationship with the young man, but the dreamy good times do not last long.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Koukaku Kidoutai: Stand Alone Complex - Tachikoma na Hibi
title_japanese: 攻殻機動隊 STAND ALONE COMPLEX タチコマなヒビ

title: The Stellar Swordmaster
synopsis:
The so-called "Lighthouse of the North," the prosperous trading town of Schoarra, hides a dark underbelly: seedy slums ruled by five ruthless crime bosses. When streetwise orphan Vlad finds the brothel he works for decimated by a disgraced knight, he turns to the path of the blade, pledging himself to the pursuit of power by sword. Blessed with the ability to seek wisdom from his sentient sword, Vlad embarks upon a journey of growth and peril as swordsman in service to the powerful House Vayezid.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Words in Your Snare
synopsis:
A recluse by choice, young cafe owner, Lee Jooin, has fled the hustle and bustle of Seoul to live in the countryside in peace. His peculiar ability to read people's thoughts as text left him unable to trust or face the words left behind in his broken home. But, his peaceful new life is suddenly interrupted when a sack of drugs winds up on his doorstep. With that, he finds himself tangled up with an unusual new customer, the right-hand man to the infamous Sa Gang, Mookya. Besides Mookya's adorable quirks, there's one thing about him that Jooin can't ignore; the fact that he can't see Mookya's thoughts.

After longing to find someone with whom he can have a normal relationship, Jooin follows Mookya back to Seoul. But, with an incestuous brother who's been waiting for Jooin's return, life-threatening investigations with the police, and other mind readers to worry about, their relationship ends up being anything but normal. As both of these mysterious men become more and more infatuated wi

title: The Returner's Road to Retirement
synopsis:
After two decades of battling extradimensional monsters and protecting the world, Dae-in Lim is finally ready to retire and enjoy a peaceful life. However, the morning after his retirement party, he wakes up to find himself back in time... before he even gained his powers. Armed with knowledge of the future, Dae-in is determined to secure his fortune and retire again, but this time within three years.
