title_english: Miiyu Just Wanted His Dead Lover Back
title_japanese: ミィユは死んだ恋人を喚び戻したかった
synopsis:
The strange life of a man brought back from his previous life. Can a man, brought from the modern day, fall in love again with his beautiful elven former lover...?!

(Source: WWWave Corporation)

title: Hajimete no Samejima-kun
synopsis:
Inori was attracted to Sameshima-kun, a mysterious delinquent who hardly shows up at class. It turns out he's trying hard to become an artist. So despite her friend's objections, Inori offers to model for his paintings to get closer to Sameshima.

(Source: MU)

title: Idol Yameru kedo Kekkon Shite Kuremasu ka!?
title_english: Will You Marry Me Because I Quit Being an Idol!?
title_japanese: アイドル辞めるけど結婚してくれますか!?

title: Isekai kara Kita Elf to Tomo ni Sugosu Nichijou
title_english: Daily Life with an Elf from Another World
title_japanese: 異世界から来た君〈エルフ〉と共に過ごす日常

title: Ogami Tsumiki to Ki Nichijou.
synopsis:
After meeting Tsumiki on his first day of school, Yutaka decides he wants to be as self-assured as she is. But when Tsumiki invites him into her werewolf world, vowing to help him come out of his shell, Yutaka puts on the brakes. Tsumiki spends her days jumping out of windows, climbing mountains, and burying sandwiches to snack on later. Yutaka isn't used to any of that. Can he overcome his anxieties and learn to howl at the moon?

(Source: VIZ Media)

title: Shugo Chara! Jewel Joker
title_japanese: しゅごキャラ！ ジュエルジョーカー
synopsis:
The magical girl classic finally continues with this sequel manga to Shugo Chara! Amu Hinamori, the Joker Guardian, is a middle schooler now—back with friends and rivals old and new.

Sugar and spice, and everything nice—that may be what girls are made of, but Amu Hinamori is so much cooler, especially now that she's left behind her days at Seiyo Elementary and became a middle schooler! After transferring to Arcana Academy on a special assignment, her role as the Joker Guardian is to intervene in a crisis that is causing students to lose hope and confidence in themselves. But she has another, more important secret mission: to retrieve the all-powerful, mysterious Arcana Jewels.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Itoshi no XL Size Zoku Genteiban
title_japanese: 愛しのXLサイズ・続 限定版
synopsis:
Back in university, Yamamoto met Kobayashi, who was cursed with the fate of virginity, despite being such a hottie, because of his anaconda-sized dick. Taking pity on him, Yamamoto offered to solve the issue himself, and Kobayashi successfully rid himself of his virginity. Things happen, and after three years of dating, they graduate from university. Kobayashi has decided to go back home to Mie to help out at the family sake brewery. Meanwhile, Yamamoto has made up his mind to train in the birthplace of Japanese sake, Nara, in order to become a fully-fledged brewer so he can contribute at the Kobayashi brewery. Now, after a year-long distance relationship, Yamamoto is finished his training, and finally gets to work at the Kobayashi brewery just like he wanted, so the pair can be together all the time, but...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Itoshi no XL Size Zokuzoku Genteiban
title_japanese: 愛しのXLサイズ・続々 限定版

title: Itoshi no XL Size Zokuzokuzoku Genteiban
title_japanese: 愛しのXLサイズ・続々続 限定版

title: Tonari no Dairinin: Football Agent
title_japanese: となりの代理人 -フットボール・エージェント-
synopsis:
How do you ask for a raise? Should you accept the transfer offer from your dream club right away? How does qualifying for the World Cup work? Is it really time to sack the coach?

Don't worry footballers, your agent is here to help you reach the top!

(Source: Editorial Hidra, translated)

title: Hyaku Monogatari
synopsis:
Ichirui Hanri is an ordinary accountant serving his master. Though innocent, he is ordered to commit hara-kiri after being entangled in some trouble in his master's house. Just then, a witch named Sudama appears. She signs a contract with Hanri to obtain his soul in exchange for fulfilling three of his wishes. Hanri gets what he wants...but the price he pays is too high.

(Source: Ablaze)

title: Toutou Cang Bu Zhu
synopsis:
When Sang Zhi was thirteen, she fell in love with an older boy named Duan Jiaxu. He was a typical teen, careless and easygoing, and came over every afternoon to play video games with her older brother. She said nothing, keeping her feelings secret, but couldn't help the blush that appeared every time they crossed paths. Sang Zhi was content just watching him from the background, accepting that her crush would never turn into something more. But years later, Sang Zhi and Duan Jiaxu are reunited. Could this high school crush become a true romance?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: My Miniature Life Manual
synopsis:
Eunseo and Myeongjin are two childhood friends who grew apart as they got older, but things take an unexpected turn when Eunseo gets a packet of jelly beans from a mysterious old lady. The next morning, Eunseo becomes the size of a little bean himself! However, the only person Eunseo can ask for help is Myeongjin. Life is suddenly so different for Eunseo; Will they be able to find out why he shrunk, and bring Eunseo back to his normal size? And what will this do to their friendship?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Fumi wo Tsuzuru
synopsis:
Sasamura is curious about Ayano Otsuka, a mid-semester transfer student with beautiful handwriting. Otsuka comes to the Sasamuras' stationery store and tells him that she wants to send a letter, something that's unusual these days. Sasamura wants to get closer to her, but Otsuka has a secret that she can't tell anyone.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Watashi no Oshi wa Akuyaku Reijou. Maid Kitchen
title_english: I'm in Love with the Villainess: Maid's Kitchen
title_japanese: 私の推しは悪役令嬢。 メイドキッチン
synopsis: A cooking comedy in which two maids, Rae and Rene, are busy making sweets for the villainess Claire!

title: Dorahiyo: Isekai no Ryuu wa Watashi no Nadenade ni Yowai Mitai desu
title_japanese: ドラひよ～異世界の竜は私のなでなでに弱いみたいです～

title: Amai no wa Osuki?
title_english: How Would You Like Something Sweet?

title: Oujisama no Kainushigakari: Norowareta Denka ga Mofumofu Body de Sasottekimasu
title_english: The Prince's Keeper: The Cursed Prince Is Too Fluffy to Resist!
title_japanese: 王子様の飼い主係～呪われた殿下がモフモフボディで誘ってきます～
synopsis:
In the residential area of the royal capital, a socially anxious apprentice witch, Miranda, manages the storefront of an enchanted medicines and sundries shop. Her quiet life is interrupted when an invitation to a royal tea party arrives. At the palace's greenhouse, she encounters Prince Heinrich—but...as a cat?! Cursed to take the form of a fluffy feline, he then shockingly requests her to become his keeper! Thus begins the slightly suggestive tale of a witch with a handsome prince as a familiar!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Ookami Otoko to Nurikabe-chan
title_japanese: オオカミ男とぬりかべちゃん

title: Spider-Man: Kizuna
synopsis:
Spider-Man saves Yu, a timid boy from Ohakama City—only for a villain to activate a device that merges Yu and the hero together!

(Source: VIZ Media)

title: Unstoppable Hayeong
synopsis:
Yeonji, a high school girl who tries to help her classmate from abuse, ends up making herself the target of a bully. Her struggles only seem to get worse until the new girl Hayeong steps in for support, declaring war on the bullies. But the more Hayeong fights against mistreatment, the more hostility she attracts, and she must fight her way to keep the ones she cares for safe.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Shunkashuutou Daikousha: Aki no Mai
title_english: Agents of the Four Seasons: Dance of Autumn
title_japanese: 春夏秋冬代行者 秋の舞
synopsis:
Yamato's Agent of Autumn, Nadeshiko Iwaizuki, was enjoying spring with her beloved retainers: guard dog Hanakiri, head maid Miyabi Sanekazura, young aide Koyoi Shirahagi, and her first love and Guard, Rindo Azami. But their peaceful days are shattered by a request for a diplomatic meeting in a foreign overseas. Young Autumn accepts, but she has no idea the tangled web of intrigue that awaits her across the ocean...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Neko no Me Ningyou
synopsis:
A collection of three horror stories.

1. Neko no Me Ningyou
2. Hitokui Bokki
3. Hebi Otoko

title: Imouto ni Konyakusha wo Toraretara, Kemono na Ouji ni Kyuukon Saremashita: Matatabi toshite Dekiai saretemasu
title_english: My Sister Took My Fiancé and Now I'm Being Courted by a Beastly Prince
title_japanese: 妹に婚約者を取られたら、獣な王子に求婚されました～またたびとして溺愛されてます～
synopsis:
Cordelia, daughter of a countess, can't seem to get married–mostly because her little sister Priscilla keeps stealing the hearts of her suitors. Ready to resign herself to a spinster fate, Cordelia is surprised when a handsome man suddenly courts her–and he's a prince, no less! Prince Leonhardt, who possesses the power of a legendary lion, is a widely admired man but has his own quirks, such as pursuing Cordelia because he was drawn to her scent. How cat-like is this man?! A fun (and feline) fantasy romance!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Isekai Saikouhou no Guild Leader: Guild Saijaku no Boku dakedo, Guildsmen Zenin no Ai ga Omokute Guild wo Yameraremasen
title_japanese: 異世界最高峰のギルドリーダー～ギルド最弱の僕だけど、ギルメン全員の愛が重くてギルドをやめられません～
synopsis:
Crow, who was bullied just for having an unattractive face, gets hit by a car and wakes up in another world. Adventurers in this world are required to join a guild somewhere.

"No way, following someone else's orders is bothersome. I'll just create my own guild!"

Several years later, the guild he whimsically created became the strongest guild with top-class members. And, all of the guild members except Crow are either handsome, beautiful, or cute. Furthermore, Crow is the weakest in the guild.

"I can't be invincible in another world like this. I'll just switch to a slow life in the countryside."

But, when Crow wants to quit the guild, which has members that admire him with almost fanatical devotion, what will happen? Thus begins the dark fantasy story of a lethargic protagonist and his guild members who worship him.

(Source: Kakuyomu, translated)

title: Saikyou Tank no Meikyuu Kouryaku
title_japanese: 最強タンクの迷宮攻略
synopsis:
Rud is a tank of the Hero's Party and is said to have the highest defense ever in history. The party often does labyrinth raids, but to Rud, it means more than just a raid. To cure his beloved sister's illness, he is in search for the wish-granting treasure that might be hidden in those labyrinths. But one day, the arrogant hero kicks him from the party after an unsuccessful raid attempt, blaming it on his skills whose effects he is still unaware of.

Without nowhere else to go and nothing to do, he decides to return to his hometown, where his sister is waiting. On his way there, he saves a girl who was being attacked by a monster. Unexpectedly, this girl has an extremely rare skill called "Appraisal." Thanks to her skill, Rud is able to discover the truth behind his unknown skills, which turn out to be very powerful skills. With a defense of 9999 and powerful skills, thus begins the adventure of the strongest tank, Rud!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Sistervention
synopsis:
Her favorite character's fate is in her hands.

A woman's dream comes true when she transmigrates into the body of Rachel Agnes, sister of Liz Agnes—her favorite story villain. Her mission? Ensure that Liz goes down a better path. Yet, things become more complicated than expected, especially when a notorious archduke is thrown into the mix...

(Source: Manta)

title: Koibito ga Ubusugite Komaru
title_english: My Lover Is Just Too Innocent to Handle
title_japanese: 恋人がウブすぎて困る
synopsis:
Hasegawa is a bit of a high school nobody. He's plain, quiet, and unassuming...so it's a huge shock when Hiyama, the sunny social butterfly of their class, suddenly confesses to him! But how do you date a classmate you've never even spoken to before? By starting a good old-fashioned diary exchange, of course! Entry by entry, two romance novices find a way to bridge the gap between them—and maybe even discover love along the way...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Tai Sekaiyou Mahou Shoujo Tsubame
title_english: Magical Girl Tsubame: I Will (Not) Save the World!
title_japanese: 対世界用魔法少女つばめ
synopsis:
The world is in danger! Who will rise to protect it? Introducing Tsubame, an ordinary high school student who dreams of becoming a magical girl. But if she has to choose between the world and her friends... Buckle up for some passion, magical girls, and a dash of madness!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Included one-shot:
Volume 5: Dadadadaan

title: How a Goddess Wins Over Tigers
title_english: How a Goddess Wins Over Tigers
synopsis:
After being betrayed by her lover, the sun god Moha meets a bitter death—but soon finds herself thrust back into her past in someone else's body. Two tiger spirits from Moha's past vie for her affection as she struggles against the looming tragedy that once ripped her heart—and the world—apart. As Moha navigates this unfamiliar world alone with no divine power, will she be able to change the tragic course of her life and find true love?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Nabe de Naguru Isekai Tensei
title_english: Another World Reincarnation That Hits with a Pot

title: Tomodachi Kekkon
synopsis:
Marriage as Friends is a story about the relationship between two women, Seri and Machiru, who have been living together for seven years ever since they were college students. The two of them, who had lived together for a long time, discover that their lease renewal is in just two months. Seri, who is quick to fall out of love and in a cycle of finding a new romance and then breaking up one after the other, was happy with her lifestyle with Machiru with whom she was not in a romance relationship.

Meanwhile, one day, Machiru is suddenly approached by her boyfriend with a suggestion for her to live with him. At first confused by the sudden invitation, but thinking that it might be good to try to experience such a different living situation, she decides to cancel her cohabitation with Seri and considers living with her boyfriend but...

(Source: MU)

title: Otonari no Downer-san wa Muri Sasenai
title_japanese: おとなりのダウナーさんは無理させない

title: Ano Ko wa Shoujo no Furi wo Shite
title_english: She Pretends to Be a Girl
title_japanese: あの子は少女の振りをして

title: I Think I've Been Possessed Somewhere
title_english: I Think I've Been Possessed Somewhere
title_japanese: 제가 어딘가 빙의를 한 것 같은데요
synopsis:
Transmigration is easy. Step one: Figure out which novel you're in. Step two: Expertly navigate the complex web of political relationships, ensnaring the heart of your male lead. Step three: Live happily ever after. Or that's how it's supposed to go, unless you're avid-reader Elena Sevess and can't get past step one! Unless she can figure out where this story is going, Elena is in a world of trouble... or is it the world that's in trouble because of her?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Mukuchi na Nashimoto-kun no Kokoro no Koe ga Amasugiru
title_japanese: 無口な梨本くんの心の声が甘すぎる
synopsis:
Koharu has a secret she can't tell anyone: she can hear the thoughts of everyone around her. It's made her overly conscious of the people around her, too. One day, she accidentally hears the true thoughts of the supposedly scary delinquent, Nashimoto. "She's seriously an angel!! Her smile is so cute that I can't look directly at her!" As it turns out, Nashimoto is completely in love with her to the point of worshiping her every move?! Koharu also soon realizes that whenever she touches Nashimoto, she can't hear his thoughts anymore...?

(Source: Starts Shuppan, translated)

title: Iyashi no Otonarisan ni wa Himitsu ga Aru
title_english: My Charming Neighbor Has a Secret
title_japanese: 癒やしのお隣さんには秘密がある
synopsis:
Fujiko is a serious, hardworking, yet ordinary, office worker. She is insecure about not receiving a post-secondary education, but despite this, she worked hard and became a permanent employee at an insurance company. However, she spent her days unable to refuse any work given to her, accepting it all with a smile on her face. One day, a new neighbor named Nishina moved into the apartment next to hers—an incredibly handsome man and an elite-level office worker. He is also a very kind gentleman, and bit by bit, Fujiko begins to feel comforted by spending time with him. She wonders why he moved into such a run-down apartment building, and why he is so kind to her. Nishina doesn't give her many answers, but it seems there's more to the story than what he's revealing...

(Source: Amutus)

title: Tsuyokute New Game na Love Comedy
title_japanese: つよくてニューゲームなラブコメ
synopsis:
Komine is an ordinary grade-school kid who is at the top of his class. And for good reason—after dying, this is actually his second run at life. Knowing everything from upcoming class subjects to future events, Komine naturally excels at whatever he does... and then there's Sarara Miyano, Komine's classmate. The last time he was in school, he was despised by her because of some foolish actions he took in the past. But now that he's mentally older and wiser, maybe he can turn things around?

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Joou Ophelia yo, Onore no Shi no Nazo wo Toke
title_japanese: 女王オフィーリアよ、己の死の謎を解け
synopsis:
On the verge of death, Queen Ophelia wished, "I want to know who killed me." Then, in accordance with an "ancient promise" given only to the owner of the crown, the Fairy King Leah brought her back to life for just ten days! "I died once, so this time, I will do whatever I want."

Ophelia's husband, who tried to use her to seize power... Her brother, who is unreliable and tends to be swayed by those around him... A knight of the royal guard who has fallen in love with her... The list of possible culprits is endless. Who killed the queen?!

A royal mystery begins in the palace with a strong slap that will clear the queen's name before her death!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Phantom Busters
title_japanese: ファントムバスターズ
synopsis:
In search of a fourth member for the club, Mogari, Eugene, and new recruit Kaoru Kanzaki set their sights on Koutarou Tamon, a classmate who seems to be able to talk to ghosts. Unfortunately, Kotaro's got some major problems communicating with living humans! Will Kotaro be able to overcome his anxiety and join the Phantom Busters?

(Source: VIZ Media)

title: The Eighth Bride
synopsis:
Archduke Gabriel de Luzia is cursed. Since his seventh bride died in a tragic accident, he's become an outcast and has stayed holed up in his castle. His only companions there are his loyal servants, until the day a young woman comes wandering right through the castle's protective magical barrier! Having traveled all the way from her village, Marianne has a favor to ask of Gabriel, but nothing comes for free in this world, and what the archduke asks of her in return could put her life at stake!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Karakai Jouzu (?) no Nishikata-san
title_japanese: からかい上手(?)の西片さん
synopsis:
Chii Nishikata's teasing story begins?

This story focuses on Chii, the daughter of Nishikata and (formerly) Takagi. As always, she is working hard at teasing her seat neighbor, Ooshiro...!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Yankee Reppuu-tai
synopsis:
He has been expelled from and transferred to more than twenty schools, has never lost a bare-knuckle fight, risked his life for the women he's loved, and is an amazing guy with a cocky face.... His name is Monnojou Monda! With the legendary hardcore biker gang Reppuu-tai, Monnojou goes on a rampage against the super-villainous biker gang Black Zeppelin. Astride his cherished DJ-R, he makes his appearance with a roar!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Genkai OL to Joshidaisei ga ○○ suru Hanashi
title_japanese: 限界OLと女子大生が○○する話
synopsis:
Segawa-san is the star of the office who everyone depends on. But she's stretched thin, and the state of her apartment has gotten dire. After a fateful encounter, the college student next door offers to lend a helping hand!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Koi wa Jirai wo Funde kara
title_english: A Love That Begins After Stepping on a Mine
title_japanese: 恋は地雷を踏んでから

title: Yuuan no Kanata
synopsis:
After a heart-stopping encounter with an unearthly apparition, a young woman becomes fixated on the spirits that linger in the shadows. Drawn into a chilling journey to confront the very essence of fear, she steps into a world where the boundary between the living and the dead fades into oblivion.

(Source: Titan Comics)

title: Gyakusatsu Happy End: Ao no Shou
title_english: Massacre Happy End: The Blue Chapter
title_japanese: 虐殺ハッピーエンド～蒼の章～
synopsis:
Ao Minato killed his abusive stepfather and entered a juvenile reformatory. However, his youngest sister whom he had tried to protect committed suicide, and his older sister Akane has gone missing. Ao, who stumbled upon a weird shrine, wished for the safety of his sister, which is the only hope he has left, and swears to God that he will do anything for that... A new chapter for the blockbuster suspense Massacre Happy Ending.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Gal to Nekura no Kyuuketsu Kankei
title_english: The Bloody Relationship Between Nekura and Gal.
title_japanese: ギャルとネクラの吸血関係

title: VRMMO de Summoner Hajimemashita
title_english: I Began the Summoner in VRMMO "Fantasy World Online"
title_japanese: VRMMOでサモナー始めました
synopsis:
The world's first action game VRMMO FWO (Fantasy World Online). Our main character chose to become a Summoner. While not so much in particularly willing to go about aggressively capturing monsters or aim to be the strongest player. Just wanting to have an adventure to search for cute monsters and clothes' material. Without noticing in the flow of one situation after another, he becomes the top ranking Summoner.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: One Coin Clear
synopsis:
Taeyang must use his godlike gaming abilities to traverse the stages of roguelike virtual reality game "Dantalian" to find his trapped sister. The only catch is, in Dantalian, your life is synced to your character. If you die in the game, you die in real life.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Secret Flight: Business Class
title_japanese: シークレットフライト ～ビジネスクラス～

title: Executive Flight
title_japanese: エグゼクティヴフライト

title: Romantic Flight
title_japanese: ロマンチックフライト
synopsis:
1-2. Secret Flight
3. Secret Flight Bangai-hen: Happening ga Ippai (Secret Flight Extra Story: So Many Incidents)
4. Rhapsodic
5. Kichou no Himitsu (Captain Shiyoh's Secret?)
6. Otoko Club (Mens' Club)
7. Aizou (Love and Hate)
8. Ajimi (Taste Testing)
9. Kinpatsu no Koibito (Blond Lover)
10. Kimi no You na Hito (Someone Like You)

title: Oishii Ginza: Buyer Mari
title_japanese: おいしい銀座 バイヤー真理

title: Kage to Hinata no Borderline
title_english: Border Line of a Shadow and the Sun
title_japanese: 陰と日向のボーダーライン
synopsis:
1-3. Kage to Hinata no Borderline
4-5. Machikado no Prologue

title: Koi Tokidoki, Yakisaba Teishoku
title_english: Love is Sometimes a Grilled Fish Set Meal
title_japanese: 恋ときどき、焼きサバ定食
synopsis:
1-3. Koi Tokidoki, Yakisaba Teishoku
4. Memorable Memory no Saikai
5. Kuro ga Hito ni Natta Riyuu
6. Yamaneko-tei Danshikai

title: Rebirth, Redead
synopsis:
I, who had lost everything and tried to commit suicide, had my heart stolen and became "immortal." Encountering the supernatural and having my heart stolen, I, the protagonist Meguru Tachibana, begin working at the supernatural countermeasures organization known as the Public Safety Section Zero. This is a tale of the supernatural until I reclaim 'death.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: The Dungeon's Dying S-Class Lady
synopsis:
Top S-class hunter Shin Yuri helps protect Korea from the dungeons that have been wreaking havoc. And when all the hunters refuse to take on the "I've Possessed the Body of a Weak and Terminally Ill Noble Lady" dungeon, Yuri and her team head inside to challenge it. But while her comrades become an emperor, a pope, and a master of the magicians' tower, she becomes a dying noble lady! They have one year to prevent the destruction of the continent, but can she help with this frail body of hers?!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The 13th Night
synopsis:
With its splendid history of five hundred years, Lan Empire has its own share of lights and shadows. Abandoned at birth, Lynx grows up in one of its slums although she is a daughter of the powerful House of Joo, one of four founding families of the empire from its birth. Just as Lynx is about to be sold off as a concubine to a senile old man, a noble lady appears in front of her. Heeyun Joo, the noble lady with a striking similarity to Lynx, claims to be her long lost older twin sister. With her life being extinguished steadily, Heeyun asks that Lynx, her twin younger sister reunited only after 19 years, pose as her.

(Source: Netcomics)

title: Ore no Koigokoro ga Moteasobareteimasu
title_english: My Love is Being Played With
title_japanese: 俺の恋心が弄ばれています
synopsis:
In order to drive away his persistent previous boyfriend, Yuzuha, one of a set of twins who are popular influencers, declares he's dating his pudgy underclassman Yachiro, who happened to be passing by. Although he was partially caught up in it, the kind Yachiro went along with it and agreed to pretend to be his boyfriend. Yuzuha fully enjoys playing at being lovers with the warm and squishy Yachiro. However, when Yachiro loses weight and drastically changes into a gorgeous man, Yachiro's heart won't stop fluttering...

(Source: Kaiousha, translated)

title: Mononoke no Ran
synopsis:
In the bustling streets of Kyoto, two unlikely heroes are brought together by fate to combat the sinister forces that lurk in the shadows. Sei Hoichirou, a descendant of esteemed ninja lineage, longs for a peaceful life and resists the pressure from his grandfather to follow in his footsteps. However, his tranquility is shattered when he crosses paths with Kyouka Kagura, a descendant of onmyouji, who brings a new purpose to his life.

(Source: MU)

title: Oh! My Prince!
synopsis:
The prodigy who took the world by storm, resigned just after joining the school! Fluent in eight languages from a tender age and capable at everything, he passed the judicial examination while still attending high school, and was dubbed "the Genius of Geniuses." However, there was only one thing this genius did not possess—proper parenting. One day, he got hurdled into a gang fight with a group of rowdy students, and didn't manage to dodge a direct blow to the back of his head with a baseball bat and thus fainted. When he came to, he realized that he was, unexpectedly, in Egypt?!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Ore, Tsushima
synopsis:
One morning, an old lady meets a stray cat searching for food in garbage cans and decides to take him back home to give him a proper meal. Despite being surprised to learn that the cat named Tsushima has the ability to speak, she nevertheless chooses to adopt him and entertains all of his whims. Ore, Tsushima details the hilarious adventures of the gluttonous and lazy Tsushima leopard cat in his new foster family.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: So I Married the Abandoned Prince
title_english: So I Married the Abandoned Prince
synopsis:
Although Rita Cardinale married Grand Duke Giuseppe Catane to help her lover George become emperor, she is stabbed in the back by the love of her life and loses her entire family. As Rita uses her alchemy to try and stop the emperor's army from taking her fallen husband's land, she is sent back in time to right before she's married. Full of vengeance, Rita wants to stop George from becoming emperor. For her plan to work, she marries Giuseppe again, but why is he acting so different from before?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Nabe ni Dangan wo Ukenagara
title_japanese: 鍋に弾丸を受けながら
synopsis:
Meet Juntaro, a Japanese fishing addict who was born and raised in what is perceived to be one of the roughest parts of Japan. It is through his lens where you can experience various parts of the world, their culture, and of course their food. He particularly loves to visit countries and cities that are also believed to be highly dangerous due to his personal belief that they will absolutely have delicious food. Because this was intended for a Japanese audience, you will also get to witness various worldviews unique to Japan alongside it all. There's just one problem: he has extreme brainrot and views the world through a cute anime girl filter.

(Source: MU)

title: Royal Tailor: Oukyuu no Saihoushi
title_english: Royal Tailor: Clothier to the Crown
title_japanese: ロイヤルテーラー ―王宮の裁縫師―
synopsis:
Hana's lifelong dream is to become a tailor and make wonderful clothes for people of all the different fantasy races. However, in a world where humans are discriminated against, even getting work as a seamstress is a struggle. When a handsome, mysterious prince offers her a job, it seems like Hana's fortunes might finally be changing for the better!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: "Zako ni wa Kaji ga Oniai da www" to Iwareta Kaji Level 9999 no Ore, Tsuihou sareta node Boukensha ni Tenshoku suru: Saikyou de Musou shinagara Guild de Tanoshiku Kurashimasu
title_japanese: 「雑魚には鍛冶がお似合いだwww」と言われた鍛冶レベル9999の俺、追放されたので冒険者に転職する ～最強武器で無双しながらギルドで楽しく暮らします～
synopsis:
Makina, a blacksmith who worked in the renowned guild "Silver Wings," is expelled from his guild. The reason? Guild members who don't value their weapons believed it was more cost-effective to buy them rather than employ his services. Lost and uncertain about his future, Makina receives an invitation from his childhood friend and adventurer, Aria. She joins Aria's guild, "Rainbow Butterflies." It's here that Makina's blacksmithing talents truly shine. With his weapons in the hands of guild members, they collectively rise to become the mightiest of all.

(Source: MU)

title: Ameagari no Bokura ni Tsuite: Sono Saki
title_english: Stay By My Side After the Rain
title_japanese: 雨上がりの僕らについて ―そのさき―
synopsis:
Kanade and Mashiro have finally moved in together! Just as they're settling into the sunny haze of their new two-person life, it becomes apparent that Kanade's been hiding things from his family. Add a trip back home into the mix, and there's no telling how the weather might turn...

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Ameagari no Bokura ni Tsuite: Ever After
title_english: Stay By My Side After the Rain
title_japanese: 雨上がりの僕らについて ―ever after―
synopsis:
After vowing to spend the rest of their lives together, Kanade plans to celebrate Mashiro's birthday with a surprise, but things don't exactly go to plan. How will Kanade react when Mashiro does something that really ticks him off? Is their first trip away together destined for stormy weather?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: A Country of Maestri
synopsis:
When his musician sister suddenly goes missing, wood sculptor Baek Beom is thrown into the world of Artificers, immortal beings that obtain magical abilities through mastery of their craft. Determined to get answers, he teams up with Gino, an Artificer searching for a way to turn back into a human.

(Source: Manta)

title: The Greatest Heiress of the Empire
title_english: The Greatest Heiress of the Empire
synopsis:
Estelle was a woman who suffered from a stigmatized disease. One day, upon seeing the main protagonist Ceria, Estelle realizes that she has become the extra in a novel. Kicked out of her home as a child for being switched with a maid's child, Estelle is saved by the Valois brothers and begins to fall in love with Claude, the male protagonist who is supposed to be connected to the protagonist, Ceria...

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Usagi to Taka no Su
title_english: The Rabbit and the Hawk's Nest

title: 18 Bu Xian
synopsis:
In Clear Waters High School, the cheerful and humorous Justin used to be good friends with diligent Class President Ian. However, because of an unexpected note, they became gay partners in other's eyes. In their wonderful, yet unordinary 18 years old, will their "friendship" be able to take another step further?

(Source: Webcomics)

title: Cool, nanoni Yoru wa Amakute.: Doukyounin wa Dekiai Chuudoku

title_japanese: 年上御曹司は婚約者(仮)をイジワルに溺愛したい
synopsis:
"Suddenly, I've become the (temporary) fiancée of an older, perfect noble's son."

Ayame hides the fact that she is a high school student due to family circumstances and goes on a marriage interview. There, she meets Kujou, a perfect and handsome son of a noble, and the next president of his company. Kujou takes a liking to Ayame, and they suddenly find themselves on a date alone!

(Source: Starts Shuppan, translated)

title: S.K.T: Swallow Knights Tales
synopsis:
Endymion Kyrian was born with the natural talent of a host. With the only thought that he wanted to become a knight, he left the "Pretty Boys' Forest" host club and came from the province to the capital with his bloated dream, and finally joined the "Swallow Knights" chivalric order. But this chivalric order... is something suspicious? A story full of ups and downs about the former host Mion who became a knight!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Sto:Rage: Keishichou Gankyuu Bunsekihan

title_japanese: ストレイジ―警視庁眼球分析班―
synopsis:
2019, a year before the Tokyo Olympics. The police face mysterious murders involving burnt victims with missing eyes. Souta Aoba, the young inspector working on this case, must team up with Hitomi Tachibana in a very special unit: the Eyeball Investigation Team. Thanks to a revolutionary technology, this team can download the memory of the living and even the dead.

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

synopsis:
Naomi, a former woman of pleasure, has seen men pass... Also, today, when night falls, she likes to tell the stories of her former comrades in misfortune. In a Japan plagued by doubts and crises, in full change, follow the tragic lives of prostitutes who, too often, have been duped by men...

(Source: Akata, translated)

title: Lady Edita
synopsis:
When Edita Lutensbach finally wakes up after an accident, her loved ones let out a sigh of relief. But unfortunately, the person who has woken up inside Edita is someone from a different dimension. Feigning amnesia, Edita learns that her doting father is an emperor. However, she is his illegitimate child, which puts her in a precarious position. She also discovers that her fiancé has died and that the noble Duke Brant Albrenovich has promised to take on that role. Edita wants to get along with her mysterious new fiancé, but his abrupt changes in behavior are enough to give her whiplash. The two seem to share a complicated history that, unfortunately, Edita can't recall...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Dragon Yashinatte Kudasai
title_japanese: ドラゴン養ってください
synopsis:
Murakami is just your average college student—he attends class, works, and plays games on his days off. And it's a day like any other when he comes across a stray in the park near his apartment. But instead of a cute, fluffy friend, Murakami finds himself face to face with...a real-life dragon?! Her name is Ilsera, and she's on a training trip to become a fully fledged member of her species! Her only request is for Murakami to foster her during her time in the human world. And so Murakami somehow winds up with a strange new roommate...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Jikyuu 900-en de Kazoku Yattemasu
title_japanese: 時給900円で家族演ってます

title: Ore no Itoshii Kaijin R
synopsis:
Rei Kureno, the straight-laced, over-serious president of the student council, is the type of person that treats everybody equally. Day after day, he strives to carry out his duties. Suddenly one day, an evil monster called "Dark Genesis" came flying in from space. His aim is "to obliterate the hero who's occupying the body of a student in the academy." In order to protect the students, Rei let himself be possessed by the monster...! And then, showing up in front of Rei's eyes is Minori Fuwa, a delinquent who had no idea that he's the hero. Rei wanted to clean up the villain in the most amicable way possible, so he approached Minori and deepened their relationship. However, Minori got attracted by Rei and when Minori confessed to him, Rei's body changed into a monster's. The way for him to return to normal is through the hero's kiss...?!!

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: The Ending, I Want to Change It
synopsis:
Byun Sooah, an impoverished novelist who exclusively writes bad endings, suddenly possesses the villainess Choi Sehwa in the ongoing serialization of "End of Youth." Surrounded by characters with flawed personalities such as traitors, sociopaths, individuals with multiple personalities, and psychopaths, can Sooah survive and find her way back to the original world?

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Ramen Kuitee!
synopsis:
Beni, a ramen store owner, decides to close his shop after the death of his wife. Akahoshi, a culinary expert, wanders alone in the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region wilderness after an accident during a TV interview. Marie is a high school girl who is contemplating suicide due to classmates' rumors about her. A bowl of ramen brings these three people together in an unexpected way and changes them.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Included one-shots:
Volume 1: Kasa ga Nai!!
Volume 2: Uchuujin ka yo!

title: Rubbing It In
synopsis:
In a pristine and upscale new city, which is home to many corporate elites, a mysterious massage shop opens. What sets it apart? Its owner, the sole masseur, who possesses a strikingly handsome figure and a perfectly sculpted physique. Yoona, one among countless lonely married individuals, wrestles with unfulfilled desires brought on by her workaholic husband's performance issues. When tales of this alluring new salon reach her ears, Yoona decides to pay a visit in search of the solace she craves...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Battle Royale: Enforcers
title_japanese: バトル・ロワイアル―執行者たち 〈エンフォーサーズ―〉
synopsis:
Twenty years ago, the fascist government of the Republic of Greater East Asia seized control of Japan. In order to terrorize the citizens and crush any possibility of rebellion, the government set up Program 68, a savage military program where Japanese high school students were sent to a remote island and forced to kill each other—the Battle Royale.

After being banned for two decades, Program 68 is back, now under the direction of a sinister government artificial intelligence. The troubled and misbehaving kids of Daitoa Academy's Class F have been chosen, armed, and divided into squads, and now must fight each other to the death. Friendships and loyalties will be tested, and only the strongest will survive.

(Source: VIZ Media)

synopsis:
Hanataro, the young president of a large company, is getting pestered by those around him to produce an heir, but he has neither the desire nor the time to get married. But then Kaname, his secretary and best friend, makes a proposal: "Shall I have the baby?" Kaname immediately starts taking a drug which allows men to get pregnant. However, the side effects of the drug cause a tingling sensation that won't stop...?

(Source: Sankosha, translated)

title: Mr. Magic Man
synopsis:
Maseong is a celebrity magician with a profound secret: he can actually move things with his mind! When he runs into a mysterious young woman with amnesia claiming to know him from a past life, Maseong's existence is upended. Cheondong seems to attract attention wherever she goes, including that of Maseong's charismatic (but maybe evil) boss, Phillip, and Phillip's lecherous half-brother, Pilyeong. Who is Cheondong, why does she know so much about Maseong, and will they be able to work through more than five centuries of baggage and just fall in love already?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Kuso Onna ni Sachi Are
synopsis:
"I've been cheating on you. Oh, and it's not just one guy. It's three. Sorry about that." Back in middle school, Sunao Akiyoshi's first-ever girlfriend shattered his heart, and he swore off love. However, all that changes when he develops a crush on a girl in his university's film club. Just as he's finally beginning to move on from the past, he bumps into his ex-girlfriend. Little does he know that this is only the beginning... To his horror, he wakes up in her body the next morning!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: One Regret Is Enough
synopsis:
After helping the Four Warriors put the evil dragon Aktale back to sleep, Cornelia thought she would be honored as a hero, but she was gravely mistaken. Though she helped lead the warriors to victory, no one recognized her efforts, since she was a commoner. Even the warriors themselves did not stand by her side. After regretting giving her all to help the empire, she leaves the capital to start anew, but just as she is settling into her new life, the evil dragon awakens again...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: To My Husband's Mistress
synopsis:
Letitia Violet is the most unfortunate and pitiful of them all. Her husband, Aster Winchester, married her out of guilt, drove her father to an untimely death, and is now demanding a divorce. After everything, Aster has fallen for another woman, Rianca Snowither, and the entire Winchester family favors her greatly over Letitia. Her love for Aster made her blind to the misdeeds of the Winchesters, and in the final act of Letitia's pathetic life, Rianca stabs and pushes her into the icy depths of a river.

However, Letitia lives. Prince Sionian Sol Meyer Sommerhurst of the Westeros Empire saves Letitia with a kiss, as he is blessed with divine power to repel evil and heal people. He allows her bitter and triumphant ex-family to hold a phony funeral for one reason: to find the vile monster who murdered his loved one. To execute his plan, Sionian needs a noble lady to infiltrate high society, and by giving Letitia a new, unrecognizable face, he joins forces with her to enact the perfect re

title: Like Family
synopsis:
Being a famous celebrity isn't easy, especially when you have no family to share your success with. After her mom's death, A-list actress Han Nana is left all alone and in a total career slump. In comes Yoo Sungwoo, a high school senior and orphan who used to be close to Nana before her big break. Although Nana takes him in as a sort of younger brother, the longer they live together, the more apparent it becomes that Sungwoo doesn't just think of her as an older sister. Meanwhile, Nana's career starts looking up when she's given a lead role in an upcoming romance drama. The only problem is that her counterpart is Lee Han, the famous actor who was once the root of Nana's despair, though he doesn't seem so cold to her this time around...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Zatsuyougakari Ken Shien Jutsushi wa Party Tsuihou ni Akogareru: Seken wa Tsuihou Boom nanoni, Ore wo Kadai Hyouka suru Party Member-tachi ga Kesshite Tebanasou toshite Kurenai
title_japanese: 雑用係兼支援術師はパーティー追放に憧れる～世間は追放ブームなのに、俺を過大評価するパーティーメンバーたちが決して手放そうとしてくれない～
synopsis:
"Stormbreaker," an up-and-coming party of young adventurers, is making waves in the dungeon conquest world with its record-breaking speed. Amidst this, Monoch, who works as a handyman and a support mage, begins to doubt whether he will be expelled from "Stormbreaker" due to the recent "Attacker Supremacy" trend. However, the other members have no intention of kicking him out. In fact, they are the complete opposite...? Is the negative handyman actually a genius(?) support mage? Join these cute and unique members as they aim to become the strongest party!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Bikishin Densetsu Momo
synopsis:
Momo, a girl who doesn't know love. Taro, a boy who is a milksop. There's a great contrast between Momo and Taro, who met on the mystery planet Kikyu. Together, they make mighty works. Based on a well known old Japanese folktale, Momotaro, contemporary giant-killing begins.

(Source: Alien Books)

A tie-in novel based on the Disney Twisted-Wonderland mobile video game and inspired by Alice in Wonderland.

Meet the curiouser and curiouser students of Night Raven College. When Yuuya Kuroki is transported to the mysterious academy for the magically gifted, he discovers he must navigate a colorful cast of characters as he searches for a way home.

(Source: VIZ Media)
