title: Toshishita Osananajimi wa Amaku Semetai Otoshigoro
title_japanese: 年下幼馴染はあまく責めたいオトシゴロ
synopsis:
Minato Aoi and Yuki Shiraishi are childhood friends that grew up together like brothers. A decade passes with Minato taking care of and spoiling Yuki... Now that they're in high school, he is suddenly pushed against the wall by Yuki.

"I've always been attracted to you in this way, nii-chan."

Freaking out at Yuki's sudden confession, he throws Yuki to the ground! But without losing heart, Yuki continues making advances to Minato, using every trick in the book! How does Minato respond to this...?

(Source: Eiwa Shuppansha, translated)

title: Yankee-kun ga Nakasareru Wake
title_japanese: ヤンキーくんが泣かされるワケ
synopsis:
Naruse, a strong delinquent, admires his first love, Kuga, who saved him from bullies when he was a child. Six years later, he enrolled into the same school as Kuga, but when they met again, Kuga had become a shadow of his former self. Naruse believes that he's still the Kuga he fell in love with, so he's determined to confess his feelings before graduation. He tries to approach Kuga in order to gain his favor, but for some reason, Kuga mistakes him as a bully...

(Source: East Press, translated)

title: Succubus-sama ni Hallelujah!
title_japanese: 淫魔〈サキュバス〉様にハレルヤ！
synopsis:
A veterinary student, Hallelujah Tendo is an honest person whom everybody calls "the angel of the veterinary faculty." One day, he helps a mysterious creature with bat-like wings, but it turns out to be the super cranky demon, Lucif! Lucif has been purged from the heaven by the angel Micha, with the succubus seed implanted inside his body. Touched by Hallelujah, he is instantly turned on and from the extreme hunger, orders Hallelujah to "Put your semen...inside of me now." Unable to grasp the situation, Hallelujah is robbed his virginity and even worse, he is tied with Lucif by magical collars and chains. His new life begins and he must frequently provide Lucif with his semen... As Lucif gradually recovers his power, his fellow demon, Baal Belial senses his presence and appears at Hallelujah's place to bring him back to the Hell.

(Source: Renta!)

Included one-shots:
Volume 2: Makikomare-kei Saiuke no Sainan (The Misfortune of Ending Up as the Biggest Bottom), Re:Makikomare-kei Saiuke

title: Usotsuki to Hatsukoi
synopsis:
Izumi realizes from a young age that his romantic orientation is toward the same sex. Even when he becomes an adult, he hides that fact and pretends to be like everyone else.

One day, on his way home from a business dinner, he gets embraced by a young man who exclaims, "It's you, Kou-kun, isn't it...?! I've always wanted to meet you!" The guy in question is his friend he had lost contact with eight years ago, Shion, who is also the boy Izumi felt guilty toward for being attracted to, and whom he distanced himself from all those years ago.

Questioned why they suddenly lost contact, Izumi blurts out that he always loved Shion, to which Shion replies that he feels the same. They end up dating, and they're lovey-dovey and happy, but sometimes, Shion's behavior seems off...

(Source: Kasakura Shuppansha, translated)

title: Bokura ga Kowareta Natsuyasumi.
synopsis:
"Be my arm." Our relationship as I knew it broke the day I said that...

Hiromu's loved basketball since he was a kid, and his friend, Ryuuji, has always been beside him. The two were days away from realizing their dream of playing together at the national high school tournament when Hiromu collides with Ryuuji and injures himself during practice. Unable to play in the big game, Hiromu tries getting revenge by asking Ryuji, "Become my arm until I heal." To his surprise, Ryuji agrees...

(Source: Renta!)

title: [Shougeki] Oshi no Biyou-kei Haishinsha ga Kyaku toshite Kita Kekka,,,
title_english: SHOCK! My Favorite Online Beauty Streamer Showed Up at My Work, and What Happened Next...
title_japanese: 【衝撃】推しの美容系配信者が客として来た結果、、、
synopsis:
Harumi works as a beauty consultant for a cosmetics company, but his poor customer service skills stop him from making any progress. He finds himself frustrated day in and day out. The one thing he loves more than anything are the beauty videos made by his favorite online beauty streamer, Sakaki. But watching Sakaki's cross-dressing and men's makeup tutorials, Harumi finds himself so entranced that he just can't help but jerk himself off, which fills him with even more self-loathing. One day, Harumi sees his idol in the store he works at, and even gets the chance to help him try on some makeup. As he applies Sakaki's lipstick, Harumi is caught between the greatest happiness of his life and his own crushing sense of guilt... Which one will win out!?

(Source: GOT)

title: Uchi na Gal Sa
synopsis:
Saburou moved to Okinawa with this parents. Wanting to change his gloomy personality, he tries to act like a delinquent, but fails miserably and ends up as a shunned loner. He gets disheartened, but that all changes when he catches the attention of an Okinawan gal named Maya. They skip school and travel around Okinawa, as she drags him along to play with her endlessly! The excitement keeps Saburou on the edge of his seat, and furthermore, Saburou and Maya actually share a secret!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Not Interested in Dating
synopsis:
"I want to live a simple life." Dohui wants to live as she always has, and her co-worker Dong-i likes to be alone. They have no intention of dating anyone in their workplace... Or do they? We invite you to the intimacy of two people who keep encountering each other.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: World's Greatest Senior Disciple
synopsis:
A senior disciple from a countryside martial academy returns as the world's best! Dragged into a brutal political war, senior disciple Hyeok Musang didnt return after the bloody war ended. No one knew whether he was still alive for 5 years. Upon barely returning to his hometown, he found his Dragon Tiger Martial Academy being persecuted and destroyed by a third-rate gang. He thought he could live peacefully with his fellow members after winning the war but seeing the miserable state of his master and fellow disciples, he was filled with anger and guilt.

With the return of the senior disciple, everyone thought things would get better but only for a moment. Things were still happening in his hometown of Yangzhou County. Was the war really over? The head disciple raises his sword against the dangers threatening his Dragon Tiger Martial Academy.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Cry, or Better Yet, Beg
synopsis:
After losing her parents at the age of 12, Layla Llewellyn is passed from one uncaring relative to another until she's sent away to another country altogether. Arriving in the Empire of Berg, she is placed in the care of Bill Remmer, a gruff distant relative who seems to care for little else other than his work as a groundskeeper for the renowned Herhardt family. After years of neglect, all Layla wants is a place to call home, but her encounters with the dashing Duke Matthias von Herhardt and the rest of high society pose trials and tribulations for the tender-hearted girl.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Virus Tensei kara Hajimaru Isekai Kansen Monogatari
title_japanese: ウイルス転生から始まる異世界感染物語
synopsis:
I was run over by a truck and died, so for some reason, I got to decide which race to reincarnate as via roulette. What the roulette chose was...a virus!? Seen off by a beautiful, easygoing goddess, I was sent to another world.

"As expected, a virus is too meaningless. There were dragons and the like among different races..."

I was depressed, but I soon noticed the cheat ability. Free possession. Copy skills that you can get every time you are infected. An almost infinite stock of life. Self-modification and weakening the enemy. Having become an immortal virus, I decided to enjoy a new life in a different world.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Iseop's Romance
synopsis:
Standing at the pinnacle of the leading conglomerate TK Group is the perfect man, Tae Junseop. He is more appealing than fictional male leads, and his beautiful relationship with his non-famous girlfriend often makes headlines. In comparison, his cousin Iseop feels inferior; even after a decade of dedication to TK Group, he has lost out to Junseop in every way, and to top it off, he has no dating experience whatsoever.

The efficient Kang Mingyeong has been TK Group's star employee for 10 years. She entered the workforce at the same time as Iseop, and she has been climbing the corporate ladder with ease, making her yet another target of Iseop's envy. When Junseop suddenly assigns her as Iseop's personal assistant, she faces real challenges: Iseop behaves childishly, hates when others touch his belongings, and appears to absolutely despise work. For the sake of her family, Mingyeong perseveres through the hardships of serving such an unpredictable man, and gradually his quirks seem more

title: The Princess Is Going on Strike
title_english: The Princess Is Going on Strike
synopsis:
Ariel Frey Brixia was raised as the illegitimate daughter of a duke. Forced to wear a mask her entire life with red eyes and ugly scar, she worked herself to death to earn her family's approval and love. She fought tooth and nail to stay alive, and all she got in return was death at the hands of her family.

And then time turned back.

After going back to the past, the ugly scar on her face are no longer there.
Staring into her clean face, she makes a decision. To strike out in revenge against the family that killed her.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Noroi to Seishun: Fumino Aya Tanpenshuu
title_japanese: 呪いと性春 文野紋短編集
synopsis:
A collection of one-shots about twisted love.

1. Jomaku
2-3. Noroi to Seishun
4. Bokura Jigoku no Touhikou
5. Himitsu no Hanazono PINK
6. Doku wa Mawaru
7. Kamisama no Shinzou

title: Houtai Gokko
synopsis:
Itsuki (who is afraid of getting hurt) gets close to Hino (a high school celebrity) through their studies, but, because of a trivial misunderstanding, they become estranged. Time passes, and they are reunited at the same medical school, where they have been paired up for practical training...? A pure love story about medical students! 

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Majo no Shikkounin
synopsis:
Witches who defy the law must face judgment. 150 years ago, witches descended from the moon, and ever since, this country has promoted and fostered a deep bond between them and its people. However, not all witches abide by the law. Chosen from their own ranks, an "Enforcer" brings them to justice. Among them is Witch Natalia, who one day encounters a boy afflicted by a curse...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Lend Me Your Lips
synopsis:
When Yeo-Eun gets a text message from her boyfriend with details about a hotel room and a time, she is overjoyed. But it's too early to celebrate because a few minutes later, he sends her another message saying that the first one was for his team's after-party event. Although slightly disappointed, she decides she should surprise him at the hotel nonetheless. Unfortunately, when she gets there, she witnesses her boyfriend with another woman walking right toward her. In a moment of panic, Yeo-Eun grabs the man in front of her and steals his lips to keep herself from being caught. As it turns out, she just kissed the fiancé of the woman her boyfriend was having an affair with! Now suddenly, Yeo-Eun finds herself caught up in a whirlwind of events full of romance and revenge.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Amalgam Hound: Sousakyoku Keijibu Tokusouhan
title_english: Amalgam Hound: Criminal Investigation Bureau - Special Investigation Unit
title_japanese: アマルガム・ハウンド 捜査局刑事部特捜班
synopsis:
Amalgams: fearsome tactical weapons deployed to the front lines of battle. As the leader of a special investigation unit tasked with hunting down rogue Amalgams, Theo Starling has no love for these tools of war. In a strange twist of fate, he's assigned a partner named Eleven, who looks like a young girl—but she's actually an astonishingly lifelike Amalgam. And though Eleven is incapable of understanding human emotions, Theo must cast aside his reservations as they work together to uncover a terrorist plot threatening the nation...!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Aru Majo ga Shinu Made
synopsis:
On Meg's seventeenth birthday, she learns that she only has one year left to live. Her mentor—the Eternal Witch, Faust—explains that she is cursed and the only way to save herself is to grow a seed of life using one thousand tears of joy. Of course, such tears aren't easy to come by. As Meg begins her quest, she finds herself drawn into the lives of her friends and neighbors in ways she never imagined. By sharing their burdens and using her magic to comfort them, she learns how precious those moments of connection can be even in the face of death.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Falling
synopsis:
Do Ahyeon is a total nutjob, at least according to her boss, Heeseong. Not only is she blackmailing him into sleeping with her for fun, but she's got a phone full of guys she's ready to get down and dirty with at a moment's notice. Sharing is caring in Ahyeon's world, and there's more than enough of her to go around. But while wading through her diverse cast of boy toys, from total players to absolute control freaks, Heeseong begins to realize that he has real feelings for Ahyeon. And now, he won't settle for being second... or third, or even fourth best. It's a love-hate relationship of the most complicated kind, but he's willing to do whatever it takes to win this wily woman's heart.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Ikinokori Renkinjutsushi wa Machi de Shizuka ni Kurashitai: Rinkan no Mahouyaku
title_english: The Alchemist Who Survived Now Dreams of a Quiet City Life: Cycle of the Elixir
title_japanese: 生き残り錬金術師は街で静かに暮らしたい ～輪環の魔法薬～
synopsis:
For an alchemist like Mariela, performing incredible feats of magic are just part of the job. So when a stampeding hoard of monsters threatens to devour the kingdom of Endalsia, she decides to put herself in a brief state of suspended animation to survive. Luckily, she awakens safe and sound—200 years in the future... Now, all Mariela really wants is a quiet, laid-back life in this land she barely recognizes. It's too bad potions have become a luxury good, and she's the only girl in town with the skills to make them.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Haikyo no Meshi
synopsis:
In an era where humanity, which once expanded its dominance to the stars, has long since lost its supremacy, scattered settlements around fully automated common bread production plants remain as the last bastions of human survival. Haruka travels through ruins to avoid the peering eyes of the "Church," which advocates eating common bread over any other food.

(Source: AlphaPolis)

title: A Beastly Scandal
synopsis:
The representative of "purity," and the nation's most popular actress, Yeo Goeun, and the twisted scandal maker, Seo Beomi. In truth, the two of them share a secret. They are "acting as best friends" due to their company's ruse. The two of them look extremely close and affectionate in the reality program, "The BFF Special," but all of this is an act!

"I don't plan on becoming friends with you! E.v.e.r."
"I don't plan on being friends with you either."

In the beginning, they were busy being hostile to each other whenever they met. But as they filmed the show, the two of them became closer, and Goeun, who previously disliked Beomi, has a small change of heart... Beomi continues to approach Goeun, and it can't be told whether he realizes Goeun's feelings or not. The image of Beomi that appears in front of Goeun every time she desperately needs someone, and the image of him she saw in the pub before filming the show overlaps, bringing chaos to her mind. She had thought he was a person wh

title: Uwakimono ni wa Horemasen
title_japanese: 浮気者には惚れません
synopsis:
"I want to hate him, but... I love him after all!!!" College student Yuki is at the mercy of his playboy childhood friend. He knows that Kazu, a cheater who wants to be loved, is obsessed with the idea that, "If you fall in love, you lose." Even so, Yuki can't let go of his love for Kazu... A pessimist who longs for devotion, and a carefree cheater who likes anyone who loves him. What lies in store for this one-sided love?

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Hajimete, Moratte Ii desu ka?
title_japanese: はじめて、もらっていいですか?
synopsis:
"Things you want to do... Want to do it with me?"

Yuuki has a list of things she wants to do with a boy and Kiritani wants to help her?

(Source: MU)

title: Sakusei Byoutou: Zennenrei-ban
title_japanese: 搾精病棟 全年齢版
synopsis:
The worst compulsory ejaculation by vicious nurses! Due to a rare disease, Yamada, the protagonist, has to ejaculate every three hours. With broken bones in both hands, he has been hospitalized in a hospital crawling with monsters and goblins in the form of evil nurses. One after another appear a problem child, a reign of terror, violence, and sex. Will Yamada live to see the day of his discharge from the hospital? "Semen Extraction Ward," which rocked the internet, has somehow been completely remade for general audiences!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Bakunyuu-tachi ni Tsuihou Sareta ga Modore to Iwaretemo, Mou Oso...... Modorimashuuu! The Comic
title_japanese: 爆乳たちに追放されたが戻れと言われても、もう遅……戻りましゅぅぅ！ THE COMIC

title: Demons' Crest
synopsis:
Sixth-grader Yuuma Ashihara and his twin sister, Sawa, are playing Actual Magic, a brand-new virtual reality MMORPG, when it suddenly begins fusing with the real world. Amid all the chaos and confusion, it becomes clear that death is lurking around every corner, including when Yuuma runs into his classmate Sumika. Before, she was one of the cutest girls in his class, but she's since undergone a terrible metamorphosis—into one of the game's horrifying monsters! From the author of Sword Art Online and Accel World comes a story beyond VR and AR, where gaming and reality are one and the same...and staying alive is just the beginning!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Isekai Kita node Mahou wo Sukebe na Koto ni Riyou Shiyou to Omou
title_japanese: 異世界来たので魔法をスケベな事に利用しようと思う

title: Akuyaku Reijou no Naka no Hito
synopsis:
In order to clear the name of "Emi," who had reincarnated as the villainess, Remilia—the real Remilia who had been watching all along inside—awakens. Now it's time for the true villainess' revenge to begin!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Zanzai Shounen
synopsis:
Ibuki, a boy who is being abused by his mother's boyfriend, picks up a sword in a back alley. That sword has the power to erase the person it cuts from this world, including the memories of their existence...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Akutoku Joou no Kokoroe
synopsis:
In a world of royalty and magic, a young Japanese woman is reincarnated as Princess Luxeria. But the princess is born with magical abilities so strong and terrible that she agrees to live her life locked away in a tower. When her family is betrayed and her royal parents are murdered, she's forced to step out of her self-imposed exile and into a treacherous world. Princess Luxeria must pretend to be the perfect puppet ruler... all while concealing her burning desire for vengeance.

(Source: Seven Sees Entertainment)

title: Youkoso! Fact (Tokyo S-ku Daini Shibu) e
title_japanese: ようこそ!FACT(東京S区第二支部)へ

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam Walpurgis Eve
title_japanese: 機動戦士ガンダム ヴァルプルギスEVE

title: Yonimo Kahogo na Maou-sama
title_english: The Demon King Is Way Too Overprotective!
title_japanese: 世にも過保護な魔王サマ
synopsis:
Seina Yamada's life is already teetering on the edge—between juggling high school, managing her friendships, and covering her rent solo, she barely has time to breathe. But when she nearly falls prey to a scammer and loses her hard-earned rent money, things go from bad to worse. Just when it seems like she's hit rock bottom, a mysterious (and incredibly handsome) stranger with horns swoops in, claiming he's a demon king who's crossed dimensions just to be with her. Why? Because, according to him, Seina is the reincarnation of his lost love!

Skeptical but unable to shake him off, Seina finds herself with a new, otherworldly roommate who's hellbent on keeping her safe, whether she wants his protection or not. What's a girl to do when her biggest problem suddenly becomes a supernatural—and superhot—roommate?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Noss & Zakuro
synopsis:
Shadowsville is a spooky supernatural town between this world and the next, making it the perfect home to mother-daughter vampire duo, Noss and Zakuro! Except, they really aren't that spooky. The beautiful Noss and her adopted daughter Zakuro spend their time drinking blood from juice boxes, shopping for anti-sun accessories, and hanging out with their monster buddies. A fang-tastic parent-child dark comedy tale!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Caligula no Koi: Side Master
title_japanese: カリギュラの恋 サイドマスター
synopsis:
High school student Kiyotaka Doyama is working as a master in the SM-Club "Basement." On a whim, he decides to get involved with one of the guests. When this regular turns out to be teacher Makoto Naruse, surprise and delight are equal—on both sides. Slowly, a unique romantic relationship develops. After his graduation, Kiyotaka showers Makoto with love, but as Makoto is busy at work and cannot meet him for a while, Kiyotaka gets irritated.

(Source: Gentosha, translated)

title: Mahou Shoujo 201
synopsis:
Shinobu Fujiyama (aka Sexy Fujiyama) is a general working for the evil Flowerbad Gang who are trying to take over the city. Standing in her way is the masked magical girl, Princess Mamu, who wouldn't you know it, has just moved in next door to Fujiyama's place... 

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Hero's Diner
synopsis:
After saving Terra from the demon king, Yoo Seungwoo came back to Earth with just one goal: open a restaurant and serve his customers Terra's dishes! The catch? Said dishes are made from monster parts and are mostly disgusting. On top of that, his return ends up drawing the government's attention and attracting otherworldly monsters to his planet! In the midst of all the chaos, will this hero manage to fulfill his goal while keeping his business and the world intact?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Lovely Death
synopsis:
"Today, we die." Four young women have gathered at a guesthouse to commit group suicide. Equipped with strong rope, a playlist, and apathy for life, Yeon and her friends seem to have a foolproof plan. Yet when they finally meet Death, Death rejects them and takes away their right to self-extermination. They may regain that right under one condition: they must retrieve someone who escaped Death at the same guesthouse years ago. The thing is, that person now lives in a prison.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Itsutsu no Tou no Itadaki e
synopsis:
In a realm forged by divine hands, the "Five Towers" materialized upon an island, their origins a creation of the gods themselves. The age-old legend foretells that any valiant soul who conquers these mystical towers shall have their deepest wish granted, but lurking in their path are formidable monsters of untold ferocity. The journey is perilous, for the trials are nigh insurmountable, demanding the challengers gather both equipment and magic wrestled from vanquished monsters, a process of relentless empowerment.

It has been two centuries since the towers first rose from the earth, standing as unconquered bastions of otherworldly might. In the middle of this, a lone hero named Ash Brave emerges as a fresh challenger, unyielding in his quest to face the towers' unbroken sovereignty.

(Source: SB Creative Corp., translated)

title: Mirai Majutsu no Hanayome
synopsis: A romantic comedy about a boy who can see monsters and a magical girl who has the power to see the future.

title: Ore no Imouto ga Saikou no Okazu Datta
title_japanese: 俺の妹が最高のオカズだった
synopsis:
My younger sister Miyu caught me fully enjoying a "younger sister" eroge! She's always expressionless and a bit cold, but for some reason, she ends up helping me masturbate!... doing things like cumming on my sister's skin and getting her to touch it! After so much skinship, my body won't respond to anyone but my sister!

(Source: France Shoin, translated)

title: June's Love
synopsis:
June, a political reporter at a newspaper giant, decides to quit her job after her boss turns down her idea for a gutsy and powerful political piece...and ends up getting a job offer from her long-time crush who also happens to hold a high position at a massive film company. She meets the big up-and-coming actor, Taeoh, her first day on set and finds his attitude nothing but suspicious. June, giddy from all the time she gets to spend with her crush, Jungwoo, finds herself blindsided by a proposal from none other than the hot actor himself!

(Source: Netcomics)

title: Nengan no Akuyaku Reijou (Last Boss) no Karada wo Te ni Ireta zo!
title_english: I Got My Wish and Reincarnated as the Villainess (Last Boss)!
title_japanese: 念願の悪役令嬢（ラスボス）の身体を手に入れたぞ!
synopsis:
A sickly girl named Elizabeth has been reincarnated as an otome game villainess! She begins her life anew, blissfully unaware that her fate is to be killed by the heroes. She might enjoy a healthy life now, but will she be able to turn fate on its head?!

(Source: Kodansha)

title: Gokainin!!
synopsis:
"I'm...pregnant." Sawa, who works as a graphic designer at an advertising agency, discovers one morning that she's got a bun in the oven. Only one person could be the father, and it's her handsome, but strict supervisor at work, Director Ishiki. The incident happened a few months ago when she was celebrating a job well down with him after a huge project they worked on together. Perhaps they were feeling a bit too relaxed, but once a few drinks hit, they ended up sharing a kiss. The unexpected soft and gentle smooch with her drill sergeant of a supervisor leads to them spending the night together... However, it was only a one-time thing and they were never an item, so Sawa wavers about whether or not to tell him that she's pregnant. A romance that blossoms from an unexpected pregnancy is about to unfold!

(Source: Starts Shuppan)

title: Danshi Koukousei wa Isekai de JK ni Natta
title_japanese: 男子高校生は異世界でJKになった
serializations: Suiyoubi wa Mattari Dash X Comic

title: Ore ni wa Kono Kuragari ga Kokochi Yokatta: Zetsubou kara Hajimaru Isekai Seikatsu, Kami no Kimagure de Kyousei Haishinchuu
title_english: The Darkness Was Comfortable for Me
title_japanese: 俺にはこの暗がりが心地よかった ―絶望から始まる異世界生活、神の気まぐれで強制配信中―
synopsis:
"1000 randomly selected humans from countries all around the world will be brought to a parallel world where all their actions will be broadcast to the whole world."

God appeared suddenly in the world and randomly selected 1000 human beings...

High-school student Hikaru, ever since his childhood friend Nanami had been chosen as a part of the 1000 humans, has been going around collecting information about the parallel world for Nanami's sake, in order to prepare Nanami to be transferred to the other world safely. On morning of the day of transfer, as Hikaru awaits to enter Nanami's home, something unimaginable happens...

As more people tune into the isekai life streams, points can be earned to gain magic, items, etc. which then can be used to kill monsters!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Boku no Tsugai wa Neko Shinshi: Eikoku-hen
title_english: My Mate Is a Feline Gentleman: UK Arc
title_japanese: 僕の番は猫紳士 英国編
synopsis:
Toushirou, an omega, and Alex, his Nyartigian alpha mate, are spending each day together in bliss—until Alex receives a summons to go to the UK for a temporary assignment. What's more, the letter comes with an extra note: Bring your omega mate with you. Though Alex hesitates over the dangers of bringing an omega overseas, Toushirou is fascinated by the idea of visiting a foreign country. But the new land awaiting them might not be as welcoming as Toushirou hopes, and the two must give their all to protect their relationship against those who wish to tear it down...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Boku no Tsugai wa Neko Shinshi: Yokohama Kosodate-hen
title_english: My Mate Is a Feline Gentleman: Yokohama Arc
title_japanese: 僕の番は猫紳士 横濱子育て編
synopsis:
Yokohama, Taisho era. Toushirou and the beastfolk Alex are happily married—and are blessed with a pair of adorable twins! Raising the children keeps Toushirou busy, but with Alex's loving support, Toushirou savors the happiness of living as a family of four. Then, one day, he is offered a translation job...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Nemuro-kun wa Kao ga Ii!
synopsis:
Nemuro-kun sits next to me. He always hides his face with his bangs, and most people at school do not know his real face. One day, Takamura happened to know his face, and she couldn't take her eyes off Nemuro-kun! I love Nemuro-kun's face. But that is all I know. This is a school love comedy that begins with a face, where they gradually get to know each other!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kuzu na Kemono wa Aishisugi
title_english: I Won't Fall for This Ravenous Beast!
title_japanese: クズなケモノは愛しすぎ
synopsis:
"I promise... I'm going to win you over, body and soul." All Aoi wants is to be able to enjoy her youth just like any other teenager her age, but she's stuck acting as a caretaker for her childhood friend, Souma. If that weren't bad enough, Souma is a total piece of trash that gobbles up any girl who comes along like some ravenous beast! "I'll never let a guy like that have me!" she promises herself, but Souma one day declares that there's a girl he "needs more than life itself" and starts making advances toward Aoi?! "Tonight... I want to sleep with you," he says and carries Aoi to his room, uses her as a body pillow, and even kisses her..?! She's unable to push him away for some reason, and... Thus begins the sugary romance between Aoi and her assertive childhood friend who's set on winning her heart...!

(Source: NTT Solmare)

title: Beasts of Desire
synopsis:
Power. Pleasure. Both can drive one's humanity to its extremes. So when Jin Hyeon-jin, president of the prestigious Jinhwa Company, is suddenly found dead, his son Sihyeon can't help but to question everyone around him. Most suspicious of all is Kang Seung-tae, a recent external hire who is shrouded in mystery; yet this cold and calculating figure may be Sihyeon's only hope for discovering what really happened on that fateful night. And so, he proposes a deal...he will help Seung-tae become the successor to Jinhwa if the latter is able to get to the bottom of his father's fateful demise. But words alone will not be enough to convince the enigmatic-yet-carnal Kang, who desires more: "You. Your life. Your everything. That is what you bring to the table."

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Kuroneko Kaiki Club
synopsis:
Yuzuki is a girl who often gets scared, but she can see spirits. She has no psychic powers, but she joins the school's occult club to investigate rumors with its club members.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

Included one-shot:
Volume 2: Red Moon

title: All Rounders!! Tensei shitara Youjo deshita. Ie ni Izurai node Ossan to Bouken ni Demasu
title_japanese: オールラウンダーズ!! 転生したら幼女でした。家に居づらいのでおっさんと冒険に出ます
synopsis:
Indra (5) grew up in her family while being shunned and ostracized. When she regained the memories of her previous life, she decided to run away from home and thus trained herself to absurdity.

During her training, she encountered the young adventurer Sword, who looked just like a middle-aged guy. Worrying about the impertinent, eccentric, pointlessly strong young girl, Sword invited her to go on a journey with him.

(Source: Novel Updates)

title: Dadamore!
synopsis:
1. Niwatori Koi Moyou (NiwaTori Falling in Love)
2. Airi-chan wa Netoritai! (Airi-chan's Gonna Steal You Away!)
3. Saiou ga Mama (Fate is a Fickle Mom)
4. Ikiri Kyousei Shojo (?) Bitch! (Eccentric Reform - The Virgin(?) Slut!)
5. Order Maid!
6. Junketsu Shoujo to Zasshu Ken. (The Purebred and the Mutt)
7. Seinaru Fukuin (Unholy Gospel)

title: Isekai Card Musou: Majingoroshi no F-Rank Boukensha
title_english: Invincible Card Summoner: A Demon-Slaying F Rank Adventurer
title_japanese: 異世界カード無双 魔神殺しのFランク冒険者
synopsis:
Kanata sits in an empty classroom playing card games on his phone…until an earthquake traps him in an otherworldly dungeon ruled by a demon! But there, he discovers that he can summon the 300 cards from the game and invoke their powers! Can he fight his way to freedom with his card gaming skills?!

(Source: Kodansha)

title: Majutsu Tantei Tokisaki Kurumi
title_english: Casebook of Kurumi Tokisaki, Magic Detective
synopsis:
Artifacts—magical tools with abilities that surpass human understanding. After dozens of these powerful items are stolen, supernatural crimes begin happening all over Tengu City. Luckily, one girl can solve them all: magic detective Kurumi Tokisaki. Along with her companion Matsurika, Kurumi attempts to unmask the dastardly thief, and in the process, retrieve the Artifacts. However, as each incident is resolved, the identity of their mysterious perp only becomes less and less clear. How will the ace detective close her biggest case yet?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Ningyou Yuugiroku
title_english: The Genius Puppeteer Loves the Holy Knight Fiercely
synopsis:
As a high-ranking general captured after the end of a war, the Holy Knight Gilbert braces for execution... when at the last moment, his life is saved by Chris, the enemy nation's master artificer and puppeteer. An arrogant, wickedly playful man who surrounds himself only with dolls of his own making, Chris claims to admire the beauty of Gilbert's soul and intends to use him to create his newest masterpiece.

When Gilbert refuses to go along with Chris's plan, he is forced to choose between certain death and forsaking his faith to become an immortal doll. Hoping to buy enough time to make his escape, Gilbert instead offers himself up to Chris as a slave. But if that's the game this knight wishes to play, then Chris fully intends on toying with him until Gilbert breaks to his will...

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Heat x Beat: Hikikomori Omega ga Idol ni!?
title_english: Heat x Beat: A Shut-In Omega Becomes an Idol!
title_japanese: Heat×Beat～引きこもりオメガがアイドルに!?～
synopsis:
As an omega abandoned by his betrothed alpha mate, shut-in Minoru shares his heartbreak with the world in the form of music. But when one of his songs catches the attention of famous idol Hijiri, Minoru is suddenly swept from the lonely solitude of his room and thrust into the spotlight—as an omega idol and music producer performing alongside his two alpha bandmates, Eiji and Tatsuya!

For any other group, this could prove a recipe for controversy and disaster, but Minoru isn't worried; his lingering attachment to his former mate keeps him from acting on his omega instincts. For a while, he's even able to throw himself whole-heartedly into his new role, learning to embrace the world he'd once retreated from, and even growing closer to his bandmates and fellow idols, especially the frank and affectionate Eiji. But Eiji is hiding a secret of his own—a connection to Minoru's past that might shatter the tentative trust and affection that's been growing between them.

(Source: Tokyopop)

Exposed to Harumitsu's passionate attacks filled with youthfulness and innocence, Mikame tries to act like an adult and brushes him off, while his mature body and dried-up heart start longing for Harumitsu...!!!

(Source: GOT)

One day, Komatsu Hinata, a book-loving high school student, meets a blond delinquent on the train on his way to school. Hinata is so happy that someone is interested in his favorite novels and gets unintentionally excited, but the delinquent gives him a surprising response, and Hinata spits out terrible words at him. Thinking that they would never meet again, he finds out that the delinquent is Igarashi Yukito, a student in the same class who has never been to school since the school started...?

(Source: Media Soft, translated)

synopsis:
"Anyone who touches this person will have to risk their neck."

The king's son-in-law who lost his wife before the wedding. Due to the national law, he must remain as the royal bridegroom who can only live as a widower for life, while his two brothers-in-law become rivals in love over him.

Kameyama, a middle-aged man, can't help but notice what the pretty girl he sees at the train station is wearing. That Milbon scent is loved by all of mankind! This glittering case is from Sebon Star! That glowing skin... isn't a treatment, just a highlight! Which brand's cosmetics wear off, and which ones last? "I wanna know all about it!" he thinks to himself. Many of those "young lady things" he's become obsessed with now, appear before him! 

(Source: Flex Comix, translated)

title: Narikin Football
title_japanese: ナリキンフットボール

title: Gitei to Tsunagaru Karada, Kedamono no Koi.
title_english: Intertwined with My Stepbrother, Loved by a Beast.
title_japanese: 義弟と繋がるカラダ、ケダモノの恋。
synopsis:
Dumped by her boyfriend, and with her workplace bankrupt, Maiko Nishino's life is a series of misfortunes. To make things worse, an old friend sold her off as debt insurance, putting Maiko in dire straits! That's when her younger stepbrother, Touri, who she hasn't seen since she parted ways with him 15 years ago, steps in to save her. In that time, Touri has grown into a handsome young company president. In return for his help, Touri wants... Maiko's body!?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Kekkon shimashou, Koisuru Mae ni
title_japanese: 結婚しましょう、恋する前に

synopsis:
Friendly foodie Sogeum is excited to start a new chapter of her life at the famous Ruru Culinary High School. However, she unexpectedly reunites with her first love Eunjae, who broke her heart with hurtful words three years ago. Not only will they live under the same roof and attend the same school, but they will also be part of the same club. Sogeum will now have to battle against her rekindling feelings for Eunjae while dealing with a bumpy school life.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: In Holy Acrimony
synopsis:
Since being marked as a saint at the tender age of 8, Gloria has been slaying demons and healing soldiers on the battlefield. That is, until one day, the Empire decides to cast her aside in favor of a new, more docile saint by framing her as a fake. Quick to switch to solution mode, Gloria assembles a motley crew and sets up a plan to take revenge on those who wronged her. With her hunky acolytes and her trusted mace in hand, can she restore her honor and make the damned rascals pay?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kanda Gokurachou Shokuninbanashi
title_english: Neighborhood Craftsmen: Stories from Kanda's Gokura-chou

synopsis:
It's not about the money. It's about heart. Here in this masterpiece historical anthology, that heart will be laid bare to you: the spirit of craftsmanship, flowing from fingertip to final product, be it a barrel, indigo cloth, razor-sharp sword, soft tatami mat, or even complete plastered building...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Isekai kara Elf-san ga Ochitekita no desu ga!?
title_japanese: 異世界からエルフさんが落ちてきたのですが!?

synopsis:
When Shinta Shinohara was suddenly summoned to another world with the objective of subjugating the Demon Lord, he makes full use of his cheat skill that sees people's status and tries taking a look at the Princess who summoned him. When he did, it's written there that the Hero is arranged to be assassinated after the Demon Lord's subjugation. That's right, this is a shitty otherworld where the Hero's life is treated like dirt. To avoid being assassinated, Shinta pretends to submit, but...

(Source: Micro Magazine-sha, translated)

title: Martial Wild West
synopsis:
In a world where the Han Empire never fell, martial arts is a power used to squeeze people dry. So when a new continent is discovered, both good and evil men alike flee to settle there and escape the tyranny of the Emperor, opening up the era of a Martial Wild West.

In the turbulent frontier, Zhang Qian is a man that reincarnated from our cushy, modern world, but his new world is nothing like the fantastical world he dreamed about from reading martial arts novels. While the martial arts in his new world are powerful, they are also too crude and lack elegance. And so Qian journeys along the continent for his dream of bringing true martial arts back to the new realm.

(Source: MU)

title: Guuzen Yuri
synopsis:
1. Sora no Tabi wa Tanoshii
2. Sensei no Sensei ni Narimashita
3. Motoyan Manager to Urekko Wakate Seiyuu

The monster's blood in his veins exploded when he woke from death! Monsters that existed only in fairy tales appear in the middle of a city in the 21st century, break down buildings and harm humans. A group of humans with extraordinary abilities against them! The story of Naro, an outcast boy who fights against monsters.

(Source: MU)

title: Isekai Barrister
title_japanese: 異世界弁護士〈バリスター〉
synopsis:
Yuuto Shiba is a 29-year-old who, despite his desire to be a barrister, is a complete failure of a man. In a fit of drunkenness, he gets hit by a truck and dies. In the afterlife, he is brought into the world of Luanolde and is tasked with implementing Japanese law into the country's court systems.

(Source: MU)

title: I Moogie You: A Slippery Love
title_english: I Moogie You: A Slippery Love
synopsis:
As Sia unpacks her life into a new home, she uncovers her grandmother's diary. It speaks of a mysterious man who gifted her grandmother tea leaves laced with otherworldly powers. Intrigued and desperate to unravel the tale, Sia digs deeper and hears whispers of a mansion—a place said to be the dwelling of a reclusive individual plagued by mental anguish. Some even claim it's the prison of a man ensnared by witch hunts long ago. Compelled by this swirl of dark rumors, Sia takes the daring step to visit the mansion, a house shrouded in secrets and sealed away for decades.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Virtual Strangers
synopsis:
After a stalking incident, Yoon Ji-gu has become understandably wary of strangers. So when an odd man moves in next door, he immediately suspects the worst. Little does he know, Yeowoon is just a regular guy trying to land a job and enjoy his free time—until he finds himself dealing with a hostile neighbor. As their real-life misunderstandings escalate, the two unknowingly team up in their favorite online game, forming an unexpected duo. 

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: A.O.Z. Re-Boot: Gundam Inle - Kuro Usagi no Mita Yume

synopsis: U.C. 0091. Following the end of the first Neo Zeon war, Neo Zeon remnants who refused to follow Char Aznabale's reborn Neo Zeon have formed a new faction called ReZeon. ReZeon absorbed the remaining members of the now defunct Titans faction, and fled to Mars under the command of supreme leader Alicia Zabi. Now the Titans remnants plan in secret to initiate the "Inle's Wings" plans.

title: Kimi to Uchuu wo Aruku Tame ni
title_japanese: 君と宇宙を歩くために
synopsis:
Kobayashi just can't focus—not on studying, not on work—and the adults in his life think he's in danger of becoming a worthless dropout. Then, one day, a strange new presence arrives in his class: an energetic and naïve kid named Uno. Kobayashi saves Uno from getting scammed, and that close encounter launches a new friendship. Uno's definitely a space cadet, but Kobayashi can't help admiring the way he floats through life, and before he knows it, he might start feeling his feet lift off the ground, too...

title_japanese: もうすぐ食われるかもしれん
synopsis:
Ever since university student Reo accidentally bumped into Takuma, a plain-looking boy whom he met for the first time, he's been getting stalked. Reo is scared that Takuma is out for revenge. "Will he try to get back at me for bumping into him?!" As Reo desperately begs for his life, Takuma suddenly confesses, "I love you." Apparently, Takuma fell in love at first sight with Reo on the day they bumped into each other! Takuma suggests to a confused Reo, "I want you try to going out with me for a period of time."

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Shiro no Ouji to Kuro no Ouji
synopsis:
Veteran dancer, Kuroda Hiroya, is double cast to dance alongside the ballet world's new prince, Shiraishi Ryouhei, in "New Swan Lake." Shiraishi one-sidedly sees Kuroda as his rival, but due to a trauma, Kuroda doesn't want to compete with him. Though he admires Kuroda for a performance of his he saw when he was a child, his obsession up until this point is unusual, and somewhere along the way, his feelings turn into lust and love. Every time they dance together, their building lust is shown through their tights... When they're alone together, Kuroda who was suffering, is passionately moved! A young genius x beautiful veteran ー the beginning of a sensual and erotic competition! (Source: Houbunsha, translated)

The bodies of the top idol and school bullying victim have been switched?! Hong Joo-ah, an outcast who is bullied every day at school. The top idol loved by the whole nation, Ko Yo-Han. Joo-ah envies the life of an idol receiving love, and Yo-han envies the life of an ordinary and free person. One day, while longing for each other's lives, their bodies are reversed?

Forced to choose between family and friends, Crinn chooses to join the guerilla fighters of the Deloyer rebels. Crinn pilots the newly completed combat armor "Dougram," and joins the Sun Fang Corps. His heroic efforts turn things around for the rebels and their counteroffensive.

However Earth forces Captain Travis, wounded in battle with Dougram, grows a burning passion for revenge. With the lust for vengeance and a burning confidence, he launches a large scale pursuit operation against the Sun Fang corps when at they're most vulnerable, leading to a desperate struggle for survival.

Twenty-eight-year-old Kei Shiraishi has tasted both the sweets and sours of love and has since vowed never to fall in love again. As a freelance beautician, he is designated by upcoming actor, Taiga Jinnouchi, who was in need of a hairdresser. Taiga, who initially had a mysterious and standoffish air around him, completely changed in Kei’s hands. What was supposed to just be another appointment ended with them going out for a meal and…

“Are you looking for someone to have some fun with?”

The adventurer Zion, who possesses the "Translator" skill, the ability to understand the language of demons and animals, spends his days and nights on quests with his childhood friends in order to make the A-Class party. However, he is suddenly kicked out of the party because his abilities are not useful in battle. Disappointed, Zion makes a new start as a solo adventurer, thanks to the encouragement of Angelina, the guild receptionist. Later, several races join Zion's party, including a female slime swordsman and half-demon whose skills were deemed useless, and form a party of outsiders who are later described as heroes.

(Source: TO Books, translated)

title_japanese: 甘すぎてずるいキミの溺愛。
synopsis:
"You look so sweet, I could eat you up." When Chiko returns to her classroom to pick up the notebook she left behind, she notices a sweet smell. Following the scent to a seemingly empty room, she comes across the handsome, but aloof Mikoto Yukino, asleep. When he wakes up and catches her staring, Chiko finds herself on the receiving end of some very affectionate advances, and becomes completely overwhelmed, yielding to his rhythm. As Chiko and the chocolatey-sweet Mikoto continue meeting at this new secret spot of theirs, a cavity-inducing story of high school love slowly begins to unwrap!

(Source: Starts Shuppan)

title: Mukuwarenakatta Murabito A, Kizoku ni Hirowarete Dekiai sareru Ue ni, Jitsu wa Motteita Densetsu-kyuu no Kami Skill mo Kakusei shita

Matteo, who was supposed to be just a common villager, is reborn as the grandson of an imperial aristocrat, Lawrence. He spends his days being doted on by his powerful grandfather. With his immense magical powers, Matteo rapidly hatches a dragon egg and tames the dragon, naming it Eva. When his magical abilities are measured, it's revealed that he possesses the strongest magic power ever recorded!

He quickly learns how to use magic, reviving ancient spells and effortlessly drawing the most powerful sword that absorbs magic, making it the strongest. Matteo is also favored by the emperor he meets, but the emperor holds a secret...?

Clever, illustrious, strong, as expected! The life of the most beloved noble, where everything is affirmed, boldly begins!

(Source: MAL News)

This is the story of Julis, who can't use magic, but is enrolled in the magic academy. And Cecilia a Saintess, who is the highest priestess, who are involved in various events at the academy!

(Source: MU)

title: Secret Siblings
synopsis:
From the outside, Taesung and Haeun look just like real siblings. They were certainly raised that way, living together in the same house since they were kids. But here's the secret: they aren't actually related. Haeun's just been living with Taesung's family since her parents went to live abroad, and that's the way it's been for the last 15 years. They're basically real sister and brother at this point...until one day, Taesung comes to learn a prank from his friends. Grab a girl's sides, and you can tell from her reaction what she really thinks of you. Taesung tries this out on Haeun that night, eager to see how she reacts...and accidentally ends up grabbing her boobs. Uh-oh. But just what is up with Haeun's reaction? She's blushing, squirming, not saying anything... Is this how you would normally act in front of your brother? Things come to light, and Taesung's starting to look at his "sister" a little bit differently now...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

synopsis:
Cheng Ke quit his job, moved away from his rich family in pursuit of arts. He is a sand painter who creates stunning pieces of art using sand. He becomes Jiang Yu Duo's tenant who's a gang leader and takes care of his sister's apartments. Their worlds collide as they move from mutual rejection to mutual understanding. Through hard work and struggles, they each achieve success and move towards a better future.

(Source: Yaoi Wiki)

title: Yatagarasu Series
synopsis:
This series is a story of the legendary bird in Japanese mythology, Yatagarasu.

In this world of Yatagarasu, which is like ancient Asian world, they had been cultivated their own culture living with a human appearance for a long time, however, urgent issues are occurring; the succession of loyal family, the power struggles of noble families and the war with invaders from the other world. The keys to tackling the problems are loyalty and friendship.

In each volume, stories unfold according to different perspectives, and the continuing mysteries are resolved in unexpected ways at the conclusion of each book.

As the series go on, through the mysterious adventures, the young prince and his friends successfully overcome many difficulties during their adolescence and the whole world of mythology gradually show its secret meanings in the magnificent scale, including its connection to temporary world.

(Source: Bungeishunju)

title: Yankee-kun ni Gohoubi Nama Voice

synopsis:
Mutsumi Igarashi is a punk who works at a convenience store. For some reason, the hot regular, Hayato Kuzumi, picks on him whenever he goes into the store. Hayato's criticisms drive Mutsumi up the wall, so to soothe himself, he listens to Prince Lion's voice in his favorite romance game for girls. Just as Mutsumi is fretting over anyone finding out about his guilty pleasure, his phone breaks. His coworker, Tsubasa Kazami, hooks him up with a part-time cleaning job for money to buy a new phone. However, his new boss turns out to be Hayato! One afternoon at Hayato's place, Mutsumi stumbles upon Prince Lion merch! What's Hayato doing with it!?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Dad, My Lover
synopsis:
Makoto is a poor student who started sugar dating casually after a friend recommended it to him. Through a dating website, he meets a man in his thirties who calls himself Sako. Makoto imagined that he'd get to enjoy the fuzzy feelings of being a lover, but all he was asked to do were chores and errands. Although confused by his expectations, Makoto doesn't give up and tries to have a physical relationship with him. However, Sako had no intention of doing so. After getting scolded, Makoto discovers that Sako was mistaking him for a housekeeper. Makoto wants money, and Sako wants someone to do his housework. With their interests, Makoto ends up being hired as his housekeeper, but gradually, he becomes unable to control his feelings...

(Source: GOT)

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Senkou no Hathaway
title_japanese: 機動戦士ガンダム 閃光のハサウェイ
synopsis:
In Hathaway's Flash, Hathaway Noa, still haunted by his past actions (not to mention the spirit of deceased Newtype Quess Paraya), joins a terrorist organization called Mafty and adopts the false name "Mafty Navue Erin." The organization Mafty is fighting a terrorist campaign against the Earth Federation government, and they are eventually able to acquire the incredibly powerful prototype Ξ Gundam, which Hathaway becomes the pilot of. Using the Ξ Gundam, Mafty attempts to attack a meeting of high-ranking Federation cabinet members in Adelaide, Australia, to force them to vote down a provision which would strengthen the Federation's already considerable power.

(Source: Wikipedia)

title: Ookami-kun no Kyuuai
synopsis:
"I want you as my bride!"

On a rainy night, veterinarian Akitaka rescued an injured wolf. The next day, an unknown young man named Rio visited him to thank him for his help that night. Akitaka doesn't remember him and claims that he has the wrong person, but that's when Rio announces that he is the wolf he saved that night and shows him his ears and tail as proof! Moreover, Rio is a candidate to succeed the throne of a kingdom, and he has come to take Akitaka as his bride...!?

(Source: Kasakura Shuppansha, translated)

title: Uchida-san wa Zettai ni Gal ja Nai!

synopsis:
After losing his parents in a tragic car accident at a young age, Taejun Kim vows never to forgive those responsible. Now, as an adult, fate reunites him with So-eun Han, the daughter of the driver who took his parents' lives. Young, powerful, rich, and handsome Taejun is hungry for revenge and will bully So-eun until he feels satisfied. However, complications arise when love enters the equation, blurring the line between resentment and affection. A story in the making, in which "I will never forgive them!" turns into "I think I like you..."

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Koisuru Ojisan to Hiroware Idol
title_japanese: 恋するオジさんと拾われアイドル
synopsis:

"I need you!" Lars, an adventurer warrior, was always treated as the errand boy by his party. His life changes forever when his party kicks him out, forcing him to change jobs. It is then discovered that Lars has an overwhelming talent in magic rivaling that of the "Great Sage"! Friends, adventure, and perhaps...love? A new career with abundant talent!

(Source: Square Enix)

title_english: My Former Student Is a Hunk?!
title_japanese: 教え子くんとはデキません
synopsis:
After a night of drinking and lamenting over her love life, Hinata is surprised by a knock on her door. But even more surprising is the handsome man on the other side! Except there's one problem: he's her former student from years ago. Shintarou has always loved Hinata and spent years proposing and expressing his love for his sensei even though she was 17 years older. Hinata did her best to spare his feelings and told him she'd only marry him once he was 18 and an adult. Sure enough, that time has come. But can Hinata really get mixed up with one of her former students?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Black Black Lotus
title_japanese: ブラック・ブラック・ロータス
synopsis:
Renna, just transferred to Fuyou Girls School, meets Kyouko, who is called "Black Rose" and respected by everyone. Black Rose is beautiful, mysterious, and seems to know Renna. She claims that it's Renna's voice that attracts her, and that was why she saved Renna when they were in grade school.

Suddenly Renna remembers...the reason why she had to change school and move to a remote place four years ago. It was something she forgot to protect herself. Renna is devastated when she knows that Black Rose is dead...she was supposed to see her on the day she was killed!

When Renna receives a black card that invites her to "Black Black Lotus," a murder matching website, she finds out that someone who used her name killed Black Rose. Who is that?!

(Source: Kadokawa)

title: All Rounder
synopsis:
A world full of zombies. But this apocalypse... is it worth trying?!

[Skills can be "transferred" from experts.]

Mental care, wooden construction, heavenly magic, animal communication, mechanical engineering, performance, etc. There is so much to learn! The sprint of the prepared survivor, who is good at everything, begins!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Boy-Friend's Rule
synopsis:
High school sophomore Kim Jiun believes in love at first sight—and the most recent object of her affections is the gentle and dashing Choi Jae-i. Just as the introverted Jiun musters up the courage to confess her feelings to Jae-i, he reveals that he has had a years-long crush on a girl from middle school. Somehow, Jae-i ends up mistakenly believing that the person Jiun likes is his rather reserved best friend, Lee Seohyeon.

As Jae-i attempts to play matchmaker for his two friends, Jiun properly thinks about Seohyeon for the first time. He has always remained at the edge of her interactions with Jae-i, and the few times they were left alone, she struggled to understand his dry-wit humor and indifferent attitude. But Jiun now notices his quiet thoughtfulness and the rare warmth of his smile, wondering if the love she has been searching for has been right in front of her all along.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Reveries of the Moonlight
synopsis:
Stripped of everything he cherished to a pack of vampires, Saegun meets the legendary Jinma Slayer Sylvester and enters the path of the vampire hunter... Welcome to the lunatic moon.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Sousou no Frieren Anthology: Kotonaru Tabi wo Tanoshimu Mahou
title_japanese: 葬送のフリーレン　アンソロジー～異なる旅を楽しむ魔法～
synopsis: An anthology of Sousou no Frieren by various mangaka.

title: Jiejiao de Xiangyang Huawu
synopsis:
Nineteen-year-old He You is about to begin her new life as a university freshman but finds herself at odds with a stranger on her very first day moving in. Down in the dumps, she finds herself in front of a fragrant flower shop and is whisked in by its beautiful, friendly, and desperate-to-hire owner. Inside, He You finds a flower from her childhood—a magical, enchanted flower—as well as the stranger from earlier, who turns out to be the owner's son. Could this mean that the frigid young man before her is the very same "magical" boy from her memories?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: Mesu no Yado: Tsuma wa Midare Kegasareru
title_japanese: 雌ノ宿〜妻ハ乱レ穢サレル〜

title: Elqueeness
synopsis:
Kang Ji-hoon, an ordinary high school student who died in a painful accident, finds out in the underworld that he is actually a 'Water Spirit King mistakenly born as a human'. 

"Making water spirits? How do you do that?"

 The adventures of Elqueeness, the Water Spirit King who was mistakenly born as a human!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: The Soul Guardians
synopsis:
Hyun-Am trains in Tai Chi Qigong in order to fight the water ghost that killed his sister; Father Park, unable to save his friend's daughter from an unknown evil spirit, chooses to become a priest walking the path of asceticism; Jun-Hoo, the only survivor of Eastern Sea Esoteric Buddhism, is a genius who has inherited all the magic of the five guardians of Esoteric Buddhism; Seung-Hee, who has a secret, gets involved in a mysterious case due to her father.

An occult fantasy in which individual exorcists, each driven by their own causes, solve crimes and fight together against evil demons—demons who rule the spiritual and emotional worlds of mankind, and drive society into chaos.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Oh, My God!
synopsis:
The story set in Heaven, except it's a corporation with a hierarchy. There are gods from the major religions, and they're all discussing to wipe out humankind (again) when suddenly! A human girl enters. What will happen? What about the end of the world?

(Source: Easy Going Scans)

title: Aru Majo ga Shinu Made: Owari no Kotoba to Hajimari no Namida
title_english: Once Upon a Witch's Death: The Tale of the One Thousand Tears of Joy
title_japanese: ある魔女が死ぬまで 終わりの言葉と始まりの涙
synopsis:
On her seventeenth birthday, the apprentice witch Meg learns that she only has one year left to live. Her teacher, the long-lived witch Faust, explains that the only way to undo the death curse is to collect tears of joy and grow the seed of life. To find them, Meg will have to leave the sheltered life she's always known and head out into the world. There will be meetings, partings, and friendships aplenty, and of course many tears. Meg will learn the most important lessons for a witch are bright, sweet, and somewhat heart wrenching.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Idol no Oshi Osame
title_japanese: アイドルの推しおさめ

title: A First Time for Everything
synopsis:
For the first 28 years of her life, Do-young has relied only on herself for satisfaction—in fact, she's never been with a man even once. But when she is caught by her former classmate-turned-boss getting her rocks off, she is about to discover a whole new world...one that going it solo can never compare to. 

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Shita no Kuchi Kara Meshiagare
title_english: Please Have Me from Your Bottom Mouth
title_japanese: 下のくちから召し上がれ

title: Dame Ningen no Aishikata
synopsis:
Shinba has no talent, no job, no money—in short, he's got nothing going for him. But despite the odds, this good for-nothing guy has a girlfriend. Hizumi is beautiful, smart, and extremely competent. Some might wonder how she could love such a loser. Well, it might have something to do with the way he tries his best but still fails pathetically, or the way he quivers with tears in his eyes as he begs for another chance...but who's to say?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Kabe Circle Doujin Sakka no Nekoyashiki-kun wa Shounin Yokkyuu wo Kojiraseteiru
title_japanese: 壁サー同人作家の猫屋敷くんは承認欲求をこじらせている
synopsis:
For Mamoru Nekoyashiki, a doujinshi artist, the only thing that satisfies his need for approval is to sell his original BL manga at the popular Kabesa section (a section for popular doujinshi circles on the wall side of the venue) and be recognized by readers at the event. But then one day, something happens to him!

He meets Kazama Issei, a childhood friend he once had a crush on who is now a popular up-and-coming idol. Their lives in distant worlds should never have crossed paths, but... You can't take your eyes off this story of two young men growing up in each other's presence!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

synopsis:
1. Suteru Kami Areba Hirou Kami Ari (One Man's Trash is Another Man's Treasure)
2. Nukenin, Sore wa Kurushi (Runaway Ninjas Have it Rough)
3. Kuru Mono Kobamazu (Turn None Away)
4. Rokujou Futari (Six-Tatami Couple)
5. Sandome no Uwaki (Third Cheating)
6. Koketsu ni Irazunba Koji wo Ezu (Can't Catch a Tiger Without Entering Its Lair)

title: Uma Musume: Pisupisu☆Supisupi Golshi-chan
title_japanese: ウマ娘 ピスピス☆スピスピ ゴルシちゃん
synopsis: A gag comedy spin-off of Uma Musume: Pretty Derby featuring Gold Ship as a kindergartener.

title: Elegant Desire
synopsis:
For the past twelve years, she has been waiting for her first love, who motivates her to play the violin and pursue her dreams, but that little hope shattered into pieces when she finally sees him unexpectedly kissing a rich married middle-aged woman the moment the elevator doors opens. In a turn of events she becomes the tutor of the married lady's son. With her first love having no memories of her and the shocking affair upon her eyes, how will things unfold?

"My first love that became the property of a wealthy middle-aged married woman. My first love can't be the kind of guy who's stuck with an old lady..."

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Majo to Youhei
synopsis:
Zig—a tall, broad-shouldered mercenary—participates in a witch hunt. Following a fierce duel with the deadly witch, he becomes privy to her desire. "I want you to protect me," she requests, tired of having her life trivialized. Seeking a place to survive, the witch and the mercenary set their sights on an unknown continent!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Justice Arcade
synopsis:
Lee Doosan is a master of the arcade. The only place he can find reprieve from the agony of adolescence, the games there act as an outlet for the stress and strain of daily life. But when he runs into his childhood best friend at the hottest spot in town—Justice Arcade—the real games begin. As the two boys try to reconcile their complicated feelings about the past with the realities of the present, will they be able to achieve a high score for their futures? Or is this reunion "game over" from the get-go...?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The 9th Class Swordmaster: Blade of Truth
title_english: The 9th Class Swordmaster: Blade of Truth
synopsis:
Adopted by the powerful Macgovern family after the death of his entire tribe, Karyl becomes the empire's greatest swordmaster who leads his men to victory in the Oracle War. But on the final battlefield, Emperor Olivurn betrays him and dooms the nation. Determined to find the cause of this treachery, Karyl travels back in time and commits himself to learning skills he never had in order to uncover the truth. Will he succeed? Or will Olivurn's trickery outsmart him again?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Taiyou no Tou
synopsis:
ABANDON THE PURSUIT OF ORDINARY HAPPINESS! One young man's barren college life changes forever when he shares a budding romance with a girl named Mizuo...only for it to all come crashing down when she has the gall to dump him! With the specter of a solitary Christmas Eve looming, he tears through the streets of Kyoto with just his powerful (some might say delusional) imagination to protect him from the cruel world at large.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Renge to Naruto!
synopsis:
It's been a few months since the neighborhood Chinese restaurant closed down, and when I stopped by for the first time in a while, I found that it had been transformed into a flashy, mysterious restaurant with its old signboard still intact. When I went inside, there was a gal there... This is a story about a Chinatown restaurant where gals are hospitable.

(Source: MU)

title: Gra Demios
synopsis:
Year 2223, Kyoto Prefecture. The human population is decreasing due to the bird-like creatures called "Harpies," which feed on humans, plunging the world into a crisis of poverty. Sokaishougo, who loves gambling, the adult industry, and food, is one of the members of the "Executioners," a unit tasked with exterminating the Harpies. While skipping work as usual, Sokaishougo is suddenly attacked by a large flock of Harpies. It seems like Sokaishougo is about to be devoured by humanity's natural enemy, but there is a "secret" hidden within his body...?

This is the opening of an unconventional gluttonous dark fantasy.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Hoteru Watashi ni Koi wo Oshiete
title_english: Teach Me Love as I Burn with Desire
title_japanese: ほてる私に恋を教えて
synopsis:
Miku is a high school student who is very good at fantasizing, but knows nothing about real boys. At school, she hides her interest and acts as a pure character, but one day her childhood friend, Shida, finds out that she's been reading erotic manga!

"I thought my life was over...but then Shida-kun asks me if I want to gain some experience with guy...?"

It's a romantic comedy about a girl with a delusional brain and a teasing boy.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Shokyuu Mahou shika Tsukaezu, Karyoku ga Tarinai node Tetteiteki ni Kougeki Mahou no Kaisuu wo Fuyashitemiru Koto ni Shimashita
title_japanese: 初級魔法しか使えず、火力が足りないので徹底的に攻撃魔法の回数を増やしてみることにしました

title: Chiisana Shima no Yasashii Koi
title_english: Sweet Love in a Small Island
title_japanese: ちいさな島のやさしい恋
synopsis:
A small clinic on a small island.

This is a story about Kurasawa Shizuka who took over his late father's clinic, and his childhood friend Tsutomu, a high school student, who works there part-time. Tsutomu always has a poker face, and Shizuka is sure Tsutomu knows nothing about romance. Shizuka kisses him just to see Tsutomu's reaction, and something changes in them... It was only out of curiosity but now his desire is fired up?!

In the meantime, Tsutomu has to leave the island with his father who is transferred to another location. What will happen to them after being apart?

A tender love story that takes place on a small island, starts here.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: TV Animation Snack World
title_japanese: TV Animation スナックワールド
synopsis:
In "a certain era" on "a certain continent," banal things are happening. The construction of "Large-Scale Leisure Facilities" has demanded that all the villages are to be evicted, but when these demands are denied, the village and its residents are obliterated.

A boy named Chap once lived in tranquility, but that happiness soon came crumbling down. He decides to embark on a journey of revenge but soon falls madly in love with the king's daughter, Princess Melora. In order to fulfill her selfish wishes, he gathers his friends in order to overcome the impossible.

title: Watashi no Kanojo
synopsis:
Novelist Yuu Kanamori publishes a novel about her mother's death, which wins an award, gains widespread attention, and even leads to an autograph session. On her way home afterward, she meets a mysterious girl named L. From that moment on, Yuu finds herself unable to write and begins to struggle. As time passes, the distance between them gradually closes, and she grows closer to L, who offers her encouragement and support?

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Viola Tames the Duke
synopsis:
I did wish upon a mysterious painting to live a new life, but I didn't think that'd mean becoming Viola, a villain bound to die for copying her friend Robina's art and stealing her lovers! Still, I've got one good chance at survival if I stay away from Robina's men and use a different art style... if not for the fact that Robina now wants me to seduce Duke Depheloa, the male lead who's destined to kill me! But can I still turn this story around and get the happy ending Viola never had?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: I Will Not Return to My Family
title_english: I Will Not Return to My Family
synopsis:
In a world where she's shadowed by her siblings' brilliance, Letitia Leroy stands out for her lack of extraordinary powers that the members of the Leroy family are known to have. Unbeknownst to her, her very existence embarrasses her family, which leads her to heart-wrenching abandonment. But in the darkness of rejection, Duke Enoch Achilles and his siblings become her unwavering pillars of support, providing Letitia with the love and belonging her family denied her. Will these newfound bonds prove stronger than the ties of her own blood?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Love for Hire
synopsis:
The last thing a powerful attorney like Jin Doha wants to do on the weekends is fill in for his sister as a housekeeper. It doesn't help that his client, Yi Wonyi, always finishes the chores for him. Wonyi, on the other hand, is just trying to live her best life as far away from her messy family as possible. At the law firm where she works, she's known for being cold and distant, but somehow Doha never sees that side of her. Could her rare show of openness have to do with her feelings for him?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Undead Unluck: Romantic na Hiteisha no Kyuujitsu
title_japanese: アンデッドアンラック ロマンチックな否定者の休日

title: Tensei Shachiku no Cheat Saien: Bannou Skill to Benri na Tsukaima Yousei wo Kushi shitetara, Kizukeba Tairiku Ichi no Seisan Kyoten ga Dekiteita
title_japanese: 転生社畜のチート菜園 ～万能スキルと便利な使い魔妖精を駆使してたら、気づけば大陸一の生産拠点ができていた～

title: The Fateful Invitation
synopsis:
After Hillaria sees a future where her beloved nation is burned down to ashes just because she refused the emperor's proposal, she accepts an invitation to the imperial palace with a mission to change this grim future and prevent the fall of her home country. How will the story unfold for Hillaria and her unique powers?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Songzang Xiezouqu
synopsis:
In search of her dreams, Lin Chu-sheng quits university, leaves home, and starts working for a funeral director.

While she may work with the dead, most of her time is spent dealing with the emotions of those still living: a father unable to accept his son's suicide; a bigamist's families meeting only after his death; a mother unwilling to let a child go; and parents unsure if their son's body will ever be found. Lin Chu-sheng witnesses the full range of human experience and reflects on her own family and life.

This is the story of the emotions that linger during a funeral process, told through the perspective of a new employee.

(Source: Nazca Éditions, translated)

title: Uchi dewa Kaemasen!
title_english: I Can't Keep It in My House
synopsis:
Nanami is a 26-year-old single office lady on her way home from working late, trying to catch the last train, when she witnesses two guys get into a fight. She ends up helping to take care of Souta, a college student who got beat up in the fight. Although he has a handsome face, he is a womanizer, and on that same night, he rolls into Nanami's house and starts to...!?

"You can treat me like kind of a pet."

A slightly dangerous cohabitation romantic comedy between an experienced college boy and an older office lady who is a zero at love!

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Oshi to Neteshimattan da ga?
title_english: I Accidentally Slept with the Guy I Stan
title_japanese: 推しと寝てしまったんだが?
synopsis:
Yoh Enatsu lived a life of despair working in a toxic environment. He was saved by Yuki, a stage actor with a loose sense of virtue. Yoh ends up having sex with Yuki during a bus tour held for the fans, but finds himself drowning in guilt. To set things right, Yoh decides to distance himself from Yuki, but when he comes home from work, he finds Yuki waiting for him in front of his apartment! On top of that, they have sex for the second time, and even end up living together...!!

(Source: GOT)

title: Atsuku, Amaku, Hageshiku. XL Size no Kare no Ude no Naka de Aisarechuu
