authors: Minami, Haruko|Serizawa, Nae|Shibatora|Azuma, Pechiko|Mugino, Sumire|Aoi, Ue
synopsis:
1. Miagetara Kare no Toriko [Minami Haruko]
2. Chippai-chan wa Kedamono ni Amakami sareru [Shibatora]
3. Ookina Kare wa Amaimono ga Osuki♥ [Azuma Pechiko]
4. Kedamono Onee wa Junjou-kei [Mugino Sumire]
5. Toshishita Ookami-kun wa Hatsujou wo Kakusenai [Serizawa Nae]
6. Ikatsume Ojisama to Himitsu no Training: Kare wa Watashi no Hatsu x Aite...!? [Aoi Ue]

title: Ame Nochi Maru
synopsis:
One day, hair styler Kota finds a distressed Maru crying at a nearby playground. Taking pity on the dog-like Maru, Kota takes him home and finds himself unable to ignore the man's vulnerable state. What follows is both a self-introspective and romance story as the two men attempt to overcome their individual trauma and learn how to love and be loved in return.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Nani Miten da yo!
synopsis:
1. Nani Miten da yo!
2. Suki na Ko ni Hana wo Keraremashite
3. Majime na Hito ga Suki nan desu!
4. Aragae! Kinniku Onna no Mount Position!!
5. Michizure Senpai
6. Bachiboko Ojousama
7. VS Yabee Onna
8. Kasu no Sainou

title: Uramin
synopsis:
The virtual video site "Uramin TV," a popular channel with more than three million registered users, distributes videos in which punishments are meted out to evil people. The "Uramin" who runs the site, Minori Yoshiura, has a rabid following, but the fact of the matter is she became a recluse after suffering gruesome bullying in elementary school. She vows to take revenge on perpetrators of bullying and broadcasts live-broadcast revenge videos. Her first target is Kyouka Takemiya, the ringleader of the bullies, who is living a carefree life despite having thrust Yoshiura into the depths of hell!! She is going to obliterate that woman from society!

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

title: Kokurou Ou to Hakugin no Niehime: Henkyou no Chi de Saiai wo Eru
title_japanese: 黒狼王と白銀の贄姫ー辺境の地で最愛を得るー
synopsis:
Princess Eder of Zels, who has grown up oppressed by the queen and her brothers because she is the daughter of a servant girl, marries the king of the nation that has just defeated them instead of her sister as compensation for losing the war. She marries Ortius, known as the "Black Wolf King." He is a barbarian king who is rumored to have the body of a wild beast and is only capable of fighting. However, on the day of the wedding ceremony, Eder meets a beautiful, tall, black-haired young man with a bright light in his eyes. Their chance meeting soon turns into a situation that shakes the survival of the kingdom...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kogare Ai
synopsis:
Kana and Kaoru have been together since childhood. They aren't lovers, but they are more special to each other than anyone else.

Five years after Kaoru left for Tokyo and they were separated, Kana follows after him! However, she discovers that Kaoru had been living with his girlfriend. Without realizing who the girl is, Kaoru became friends with the ex-girlfriend...!?

A tingling love story in which single-minded unrequited love is chained together!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Lion Heart
synopsis:
As the ace heart surgeon of Seomoon Jaeil Hospital, Dr. Yoon Haejun always puts her patients first. To give them even better care, she hopes to open a heart transplant center on the premises. But when one of her patients goes AWOL and saddles the hospital with his bills, the whole project is put in jeopardy. Her only hope? Become the fake girlfriend of the wealthy hospital chairman Seo Yihan! But as Dr. Yoon will soon learn, melting his frigid heart may be more difficult than operating on one!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Jiken wa Skirt no Naka de
title_japanese: 事件はスカートの中で
synopsis:
Yunatsu Sakahara has a secret—a strange "sound" that, since childhood, only Yunatsu can hear. Whenever someone pays strong attention to another person, she hears what sounds like the click of a camera shutter. Engrossed in playing the role of a clumsy, ditzy heroine in order to attract attention, Yunatsu's desires escalate! In order to attract even more attention, Yunatsu thinks up a forbidden "up-skirt" method...!? And what is the reason behind the smile of the mysterious girl who knows Yunatsu's secret...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Kinryou Rock: Code Amrita
title_japanese: 禁猟六区 コード・アムリタ

title: Nichiasa Suki no Otaku ga Akuyaku Seito ni Tensei shita Kekka, Hametsu Flag ga Houkai shiteiku Ken ni Tsuite
title_japanese: ニチアサ好きのオタクが悪役生徒に転生した結果、破滅フラグが崩壊していく件について
synopsis:
Yuugo Kurei is a high school student that loves tokusatsu hero shows. One day, he loses his life protecting a child from a street slasher, but he is reincarnated in another world as Yuugo Clay, a character from a certain game. However, Yuugo is the most disliked person in the school and is destined to die tragically... If his secret is discovered, he could be condemned to a life as a guinea pig... He doesn't want that! He transfers to a new school in order to protect his secret, only to find out that it's a harem school full of women!? Sure enough, he can take any woman his prisoner: a friendly and amiable senior, a sexually frustrated teacher, the school's "prince," the scion daughter of a conglomerate... This is the story of one Adam being pursued by four billion Eves.

(Source: Suiseisha, translated)

title: Ryuujin-sama ni Oyomeiri
synopsis:
Tsuwabuki, a lion-dog, is forced by his sister to take on the sacrificial role of healing a weakened god. He ends up becoming the dragon god's bride, and...?!

(Source: Shusuisha)

2. Muhyoujou na Kare wa Sekkyokuteki

4. Ore no Hou ga

title: Backlight
synopsis:
A life in the spotlight is a dream for many...but it's behind the scenes where the real drama takes place. Baek Yeongwoon plays manager for Seo Hae-yool, an up-and-coming actor at All One Pictures with a secret: his success is fuelled by an industry "sponsor" who loves more than just his talent. So when a love affair between the young star and a mysterious figure threatens the livelihood of their company, it is up to Yeongwoon to track his client down and put an end to their risky romp. But the truth may be too much for him to bear, as the other party turns out to be top model—and Yeongwoon's first love—Han Seo-in. As Yeongwoon struggles to reconcile his unresolved feelings for Seo-in with his sense of duty toward his work, the two fall into a intricate web woven of unanswered questions and lingering emotions that changes the trajectory of their lives forever...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

synopsis:
1. Nariyuki Lovers! (Casual Lovers!)
2. Mono wa Tameshi ni (The Proof Is in the Pudding)
3. Chorokute Warui!?
4. Tanebi (Ember)
5. Never Too Late
6. Sucre-Coeur
7. Speechless
8. Special
9. Folklore♡
10. Boku no Utsukushii Hito (The Beauty in My Life)
11. Kansatsu to Jissen (Observation & Implementation)

title: Candy Man
synopsis:
Kyuyeon Kim plays a female character in the online game, Arcana, under the name "Yorong" with one main motive which is to seduce male players and freeload off them. However, things take an interesting turn when Yorong seduces a certain male player, "Yummin." This is because, unbeknownst to Kyuyeon, this player turns out to be Kimin Yum, his classmate and one of the most popular guys at his school. Strangely, as time passes, Yummin gets increasingly clingy to Yorong, and Kimin also starts getting extra friendly with Kyuyeon. With things beginning to get more deeply entangled both in the online and offline world, can Kyuyeon figure out how to get out of this mess?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Madogiwa de Amu
synopsis:
Ota-kun is being bullied. Yamagishi-san, who sits in front of him, can't bear to see it and starts exchanging letters with him. Ota-kun decides to give Yamagishi-san a hand-knitted bracelet as a birthday present, but...!?

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Kuro Tobi no Seija: Tsuihou sareta Kaifuku Jutsushi wa, Ariamaru Maryoku de Yami Mahou wo Kiwameru
title_english: Saint of Black Kite: The Banished Healer Masters Dark Magic With Abundant Magical Power.
title_japanese: 黒鳶の聖者～追放された回復術士は、有り余る魔力で闇魔法を極める～
synopsis:
Russel was a saint who was an expert in recovery magic. He was in a group with his childhood friends until the rest of the members learned recovery magic. Branded unnecessary and expelled from his group of friends, he meets a mysterious beauty named Sybilla. His infinite magical potential, combined with her guidance, now allow him to reach heights once deemed impossible!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Real World Mobile
synopsis:
Gang-u Choi is an ordinary high school student who likes video games. One day, he hears that his favorite game store is going out of business. When he visits the shop one last time, the store owner hands him a QR code for a mobile game. Gang-u starts up the game out of curiosity, but something feels off... His mission is to drink 3 glasses of water?! When he decides to ignore the mission, he suddenly receives a penalty in real life! As the missions get more dangerous, will Gang-u be able to protect his reality?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Secret of House Francesca
synopsis:
House Francesca holds a secret. There's an imposter within the house who seeks revenge. But who could it be? Is it the late duke's greedy sister who loathed sharing the riches of the duchy but loved spending them on herself? One of the duke's brothers, both of whom were hungry for the power that the duke held? Or could it be his daughter, who was under a spell to kill those who got in her way? Whoever it may be, can they keep their identity concealed, or will their dastardly deeds be revealed?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Itsumo no Otouto no Seiyoku Shori wo, Kyou wa Love Hotel de Shitai Ane.
title_japanese: いつもの弟の性欲処理を、今日はラブホでしたい姉。

title: Jibun no Kaita Manga ga Jissha AV ni!? Sekkaku nanode Satsuei Genba no Kengaku ni Ittekimashita.
title_japanese: 自分の描いた漫画が実写AVに!?せっかくなので撮影現場の見学に行ってきました。

title: Daifugou no Itoshii Nameinu
title_english: The Licking Dog is Loved by the Millionare
title_japanese: 大富豪の愛しい舐め犬

title: Otome Game wa Shuuyrou Shimashita
title_japanese: 乙女ゲームは終了しました
synopsis:
Aletta, the daughter of a viscount, was a Japanese high school girl during her previous life. Now, she enjoys living in an unfamiliar world in a slightly unusual family environment. One day, at the school party she attended, the villainess' condemnation event broke out! Seeing this, Aletta realizes that this is the world of the otome game she played in her previous life.

However, the heroine is frightened, and as for the villainess, who is sentenced to exile, a development that was not in the original scenario occurs; Aletta's fiancé rushes to join the villainess! With the venue in an uproar, Aletta reaches her limit and collapses. As a result, Aletta's "militant" family goes mad, causing an uproar throughout the entire country!

A thrilling fantasy in which a brawny background character tries to clean up the aftereffects in a world after the scenario collapses.

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title: Isekaigaeri no Yuusha wa, Dungeon ga Shutsugen shita Genjitsu Sekai de, Influencer ni Natte Kane wo Kasegimasu!
title_japanese: 異世界帰りの勇者は、ダンジョンが出現した現実世界で、インフルエンサーになって金を稼ぎます！
synopsis:
One day, an ordinary high school student is transferred to another world. He raises his level in the other world, successfully defeats the Demon King, and saves the world! With his strongest status, he decided to return to his own world. However, in the world to which he returns, a new "dungeon" has appeared. A modern dungeon fantasy where the former hero becomes a warrior, delving into dungeons created in his own world!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Chaos Attack
synopsis:
DoAh Lee, a seemingly "normal" high-school boy, gets caught in a strange and embarrassing situation. Before he knows it, he is blackmailed into becoming the manager for a team of quirky, unruly, not to mention slightly lazy, heroes. Will he ever go back to his "normal" high-school days?

(Source: Easy Going Scans)

title: Extreme Super Darling
title_japanese: エクストリームスーパーダーリン
synopsis: Transfer student Rio Ikeda is welcomed to the school with a tea party at the student council. When she returns to the student council room she is caught up in something curious between the student council vice president and president.

title: Kingdom Bangai-hen
title_japanese: キングダム 番外編
synopsis: Kingdom Bangai-hen is a side story of the Kingdom manga set during the Sanyou Aftermath Arc.

title: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai: Tensai-tachi no Renai Jinrousen
title_japanese: かぐや様は告らせたい 小説版 ～天才たちの恋愛人狼戦～
synopsis:
The setting is Tsukikagekan, which stands on a solitary island owned by the Fujiwara family. In addition to the members of the student council, Moeha Fujiwara and Kei Shirogane are involved in a battle similar to a werewolf game over a treasure that can make wishes come true!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: The Emperor's Woman
synopsis:
Leia, the beautiful empress of the empire, is executed after infuriating the emperor through her evil deeds. Just when she thought all of her glory and shame was finally over, she wakes up in her past! A reborn Leia is determined to live an upright life, and to not repeat her past mistakes. She is hit with guilt whenever she meets a person who she mistreated in her past life. She even finds a true friend with her newfound beauty and honesty. But Leia's heart beats faster when she meets Hail, a classmate, who bears a resemblance to her spouse in a previous life, the Emperor. Leia, still not sure of whether her feelings are love or fear, finds herself spending more and more time with Hail...

(Source: Netcomics)

title: Supremely Talented Player
synopsis:
Six years ago, humanity was almost brought to an end when mysterious towers filled the skies across the globe, unleashing deadly monsters. Fortunately, the people known as "players" emerged, blessed with supernatural powers that they harnessed to save mankind. Among them is Yuseong Kang, a phenomenal player who has saved the world time after time. Once again, he has successfully averted global catastrophe... and in an internationally broadcasted interview praising his heroic endeavors, he says, "I'm just in it for the money."

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Cool na Megami-sama to Issho ni Sundara, Amayakashi Sugite Ponkotsu ni shiteshimatta Ken ni Tsuite
title_japanese: クールな女神様と一緒に住んだら、甘やかしすぎてポンコツにしてしまった件について

title: I Raised a Black Dragon
synopsis:
Did you just imprint on me?!

After dying from overwork, Noa ends up possessing the body of Eleanora, the villainess from a novel. Noa simply wants to lead a peaceful life and tries not to interfere with the original story. That is, until a baby dragon that's meant to imprint on the heroine imprints on her instead...

(Source: Manta)

title: Omori
synopsis:
Since the terrible tragedy of four years ago, Sunny hasn't set foot outside his house. Now, in an attempt to shake him out of his torpor, his family has decided to leave Faraway Town. Three days before the move, Sunny's childhood friend Kel shows up to hang out one last time—but the world outside the young shut-in's door has changed completely, and Sunny's reunion with his old pals goes from bad to worse. Whether by chance or fate, the chain of events that begin to unfold calls up a past they all thought was buried forever...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: The Archduchess's Loyal Shapeshifter
synopsis:
The empire's archduchess Rosalin has a mysterious new lover, Fenrir, a lowborn shape-shifting anthromorph. However, in a world that separates them by class, their love didn't bloom easily. Turning a blind eye to the injustices of the empire, Rosalin showed no interest in anyone but herself, and having never known his parents or even his own name, Fenrir trusted no one. In a society full of prejudice and hate for their love, can this unlikely couple overcome the odds against them?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Necromancer Academy and the Genius Summoner
title_english: Necromancer Academy and the Genius Summoner
synopsis:
Necromancers have built a name for themselves as fearsome practitioners of magic capable of dropping entire empires to their knees. Simon Follentia is a necromancer with incredible latent talent! After being scouted for the necromancer's academy, this genius is ready to be nurtured and taken to the next level. But could Simon's insane talents attract some unforeseen consequences?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Ikusa Otome to Ikusagoto!: Onna Seikishi-hen
title_japanese: 戦乙女といくさごと!～女聖騎士編～

title: Sekkahi Den: Rantei Koukyuu Shimatsuki
title_japanese: 雪花妃伝 ～藍帝後宮始末記～
synopsis:
"As long as this girl exists, she will bring harm to the emperor." That is what the oracle decreed.

Sou Rinsetsu (Song Ling Xue) was supposed to have spent the rest of her life living in a quiet shrine. However, the young girl's fate was upset. Forcefully brought out by the emperor's order, she was sent into the capital to live as a queen, empty as that title was. With the passage of time, she had grown into a beautiful, intelligent woman. What awaited her now was a world wrapped in conspiracy. A Chinese-style fantasy.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Baka Onna 26-ji
synopsis:
Atsuko and Yuri were classmates in elementary, junior high, high school, although they hardly ever spoke to each other during their school days. At their first reunion in 15 years, Atsuko discovers Yuri's secret and makes a move. What is the destination of these two opposites, who have completely different interests and groups and whose personalities do not match?

(Source: Shueisha)

title: Dungeon Hoiku
synopsis:
Takashi Koizumi, a salary man, dies slipping on the skin of a banana. If he can reach the magical Fountain of Purification which resides at the bottom of a difficult dungeon, he will be allowed into Heaven. But to accomplish that, he needs to conquer the dungeon by summoning monsters. His first monster was a level 1 female goblin.

(Source: MU)

title: Takamori-kun wo Damarasetai!!
title_japanese: 高森くんを黙らせたいっ!!
synopsis:
Minamikawa-san, a girl with the ability to read minds, is curious about the boy sitting next to her, Takamori-kun. It's because Takamori-kun's mind is so darn loud...!!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Goshujinsama Otawamure wo: Oresama Yajuu wa Mate ga Dekinai
title_japanese: ご主人様お戯れを～俺サマ野獣は待てができない～

title: Maid wa Koisuru Hachiya-kun
title_japanese: メイドは恋する蜂谷くん
synopsis:
My name is Hachiya, I'm a normal high schooler. After confessing to my beloved Hanazono-san, I was rejected with the reason, "I already have an engagement arranged by my parents." That person is the wealthy and handsome Ikegai-kun, who also happens to have a good personality. Thinking that I had no chance in a straightforward competition, I, Hachiya, decided to cross-dress as a maid and work at the Ikegai house. My plan is to make Ikegai-kun fall for me and break their engagement... Thus begins a slightly silly, cross-dressing maid's comedy that leads to a chaotic love triangle (?)

(Source: Shougakukan, translated)

title: The Fitness Villainess
synopsis:
Being reincarnated into your favorite game isn't so bad, but what if you're now the main villainess who is destined to die from bad health in almost every ending? After spending her past life in a hospital, Aslan is determined to make her new body healthy, even if she has to become a fitness fanatic... After she conquers that, she'll work on an important aspect of surviving the game—her likability. However, can she succeed when everyone expects her to be a villainess?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Holding You Captive
synopsis:
Freedom is all our heroine wants, but that isn't what she finds when she is summoned across worlds into the body of Lady Beatrice and is newly named "Regria." As a "divine being" who can purify the minds of "divine knights," Regria is expected to wed the Belligram Empire's Prince Rahich, who only sees her as a tool that will keep him from going insane. But when Beatrice's original soul finds Regria in a moment of danger, she tells her how she can be free: by untangling Rahich's twisted soul and making him kneel at her feet.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Megumi no Milk
synopsis:
A boy who falls to his death from a cliff comes back to life with the help of the "God of Milk." However, in order to do so, he has to crossdress and disguise himself as a woman and infiltrate the Ichigo girls' school where the shrine once stood. Here he has to keep squeezing and drinking the milk of his schoolmates.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Sword Art Online Alternative: Gourmet Seekers
title_japanese: ソードアート・オンライン オルタナティブ グルメ・シーカーズ
synopsis:
"I'm not interested in attacking Aincrad! I aim to open a diner!"

Yuzu and Hina, a brother and sister who are new to the game and just wanted to experience cooking in a VRMMO, are trapped in Sword Art Online. The choice they made was to master the "Cooking" skill! Together with other players who also love to cook, they form a party called the "Food Quest Group." They spend their days devoted to cooking, completing quests that reward them with delicious ingredients and rare cooking utensils, and trying to recreate modern Japanese cuisine. Spending their days entirely on cooking, they open a food stall. The menu is so ingenious that it has even captured the stomachs of the most determined players!

A laid-back gourmet quest life in the world of SAO begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Dokudami no Hanasaku Koro
title_japanese: どくだみの花咲くころ
synopsis:
Shigaraki is prone to tantrums, and his unpredictable behavior causes him to be an outsider in his class. One day, model student Shimizu peeks at Shigaraki's clay art piece during arts and crafts and is immediately captivated by it. This event leads to him becoming obsessed with Shigaraki's creations.

(Source: Kodansha)

title: Green Green Greens
title_japanese: グリーングリーングリーンズ
synopsis:
Haku Yaesaki is a bored high school student with no direction in life. Right as he starts noticing how all his friends have dreams they are striving for, he meets pro golfer hopeful Nadeshiko Oga and his empty life begins to change. Now, it's time to find a whole new you as this golfing adventure tees off!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Shuumatsu Sekai no Hakoiri Musume
title_english: Through the Viewport: Child of a Ruined World
title_japanese: 終末世界の箱入りムスメ
synopsis:
Long after the fall of humanity, the world lies in ruin. Factions of autonomous war machines, monstrous biological weapons, and other horrors of a bygone era battle it out in the remains of the society that created them, their conflicts endless and seemingly meaningless—until, that is, a machine finds its own meaning in the form of a human child. That machine, Humanoid Mobile Weapons Unit Number Ten, develops a fiercely protective bond with the child, and soon the two of them set out on a journey together. Their mission: to search for other human survivors, to deliver the child to her people...and to enjoy the trip for all they’re worth!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: My Sister's Private Life
synopsis:
A woman wakes up in a hospital with no memory of who she is. She doesn't even recognize herself in the mirror. She hit her head while falling down the stairs and suffers from temporary amnesia. As she gets to know herself, she is disappointed to find out that her handsome husband doesn't even want to touch her and her career as an influencer is falling apart because she is suspected of murder. But it turns out she is living the life of her twin, Haemi.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: "Honyaku" no Sainou de Ore dake ga Sekai wo Kaihen Dekiru Ken: Hazure Sainou "Honyaku" de Kizukeba Sekai Saikyou ni Nattemashita
title_english: Only My Undesirable Translation Talent Can Change the World
title_japanese: 【翻訳】の才能で俺だけが世界を改変できる件 ～ハズレ才能【翻訳】で気付けば世界最強になってました～
synopsis:
Noah is the eldest son from a noble family known for their magical prowess. As such, his father expects him to possess a Talent for elemental attack magic. But during his appraisal, it was revealed that not only couldn't he use magic, but he had a particularly useless Talent—"Translation." Yet, no one could have guessed that this astonishing ability has the power to change the world!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Meitou "Isekai no Yu" Kaitakuki: Around 40 Onsen Mania no Tensei-saki wa, Nonbiri Onsen Tengoku deshita
title_japanese: 名湯『異世界の湯』開拓記～アラフォー温泉マニアの転生先は、のんびり温泉天国でした～
synopsis:
Yoshizou Yukawa is a passionate hot springs enthusiast—a hot springs hunter who was able to sniff out the source of springs. One day, while searching for a hidden hot spring to revitalize a town, he slips off a cliff and dies. He is then reincarnated into another world by an Inari deity of a small shrine hidden in the rocks. Yoshizou is joined by Inari's messenger princess, Mayudama. The hot spring hunter within Yoshizou is stirred right away, as he takes a bath with Mayudama in the hot spring he just discovered. Then, an elf girl appears...

(Source: MAL News)

title: Meitou "Isekai no Yu" Kaitakuki: Around 40 Onsen Mania no Tensei-saki wa, Nonbiri Onsen Tengoku deshita
title_japanese: 名湯『異世界の湯』開拓記～アラフォー温泉マニアの転生先は、のんびり温泉天国でした～

title_japanese: 名湯『異世界の湯』開拓記～アラフォー温泉マニアの転生先は、のんびり温泉天国でした～

(Source: MAL News)

title: Princess wa Hitoribocchi
title_japanese: プリンセスはひとりぼっち
synopsis:
Years ago, Rose-Anitra left her home country of Alp D'Montez amidst claims she was an illegitimate heir to the throne. Her bucolic life as a married veteran is shattered when her husband is quickly ravaged by cancer. Newly widowed, she's sought out by an older assistant to the throne. Alp D'Montez needs fresh blood and bold tactics to stay afloat, but the plan to save her homeland involves her marrying Prince Nikolai. Can Rose help save a country while protecting her heart?

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: 7-dai Tatarimasu node Hayaku Kekkon shite Kudasai!
title_english: Get Married So I Can Curse Your Firstborn and Finally Be Free!
title_japanese: 7代祟りますので早く結婚してください!
synopsis:
Kuro, a black cat, is a god of fortune down on her luck. She's turned into a "vengeful god" against her will, and the only way to return to her former status is to curse seven generations of the Nishikori bloodline. She's close to being free, but to get there, she needs to make sure the seventh generation actually gets born. That means finding a match for Nishikori Kotaro...which is harder than you might think, because Kotaro is tragically unpopular. Not only that, he insists that the only woman he wants...is cat-eared Kuro herself!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Returned by the King
synopsis:
"I'll eat all your skills!"
"Fuck this awakening bullshit."
"To hell with being a loser."

Kim Taehyun, whose awakening level remained undetermined, was treated as a loser because he failed to awaken. However, he awakened his ability at the moment of his death when a gate was created which lead to the king. Afterwards, Taehyun, who has returned due to the power of the king, gains a new skill called Predation. Taehyun, a 35-year old man, regresses to when he was 19.

[Skill has been devoured]

Using this power, I can be placed among the best.

(Source: StoryYa, translated)

title: Sakura-kun no Hatsukoi wa Natsuiro ni Saku
title_japanese: さくらくんの初恋は夏色に咲く
synopsis:
Ever since he quit his job, Sakura Hare has been a shut-in, and spends his days getting by lethargically. On the other hand, Hare's childhood friend, Takehana Sakura, is an adventurer who travels around the world with a smile on his face. "Even though he was so timid, I was the one who gave him the push..." As Hare's thoughts turn more and more somber, Sakura suddenly returns...

(Source: Media Soft, translated)

title: Lemon Soda Flavor Kiss
title_japanese: レモンソーダフレーバーキス
synopsis:
"A kiss from my best friend!?"

Rio and Leo have been childhood friends since kindergarten. However, as they start their last year of high school, they're in separate classes for the first time. It's during this first day of the new school year that Leo suddenly confesses to Rio and kisses him... What's going on?!

(Source: No Pressure Scans)

title: Kizuato ni Kuchizuke: sweet time
title_english: Cover My Scars With Your Kiss: Sweet Time
title_japanese: 傷あとにくちづけ sweet time
synopsis:
Seiichi Kurusu and Nao Seto are officially dating and living together. 

Even though they share a home now, their busy jobs have made it difficult for them to spend time together. When Seiichi reveals that his father has been trying to set him up with marriage interviews, Nao realizes that he doesn't want to let Seiichi go. With Seiichi's position as the eldest son set to inherit his father's company, will they be able stay together forever?

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Fake Fact Lips Break
title_japanese: フェイクファクトリップス break
synopsis:
At odds with each other since their high school days, corporate salesmen Ryo and Zen have finally become lovers. The transition has not been a smooth one, however, with each man still baiting the other into petty competitions as they struggle to navigate their new dynamic. And with their hectic work schedules cutting into their time together, it isn't long before anxiety and jealousy begin to creep into their hearts. Yet just when it seems like progress is being made, their coworker, Futami, returns to the main office from Osaka and tries to insert himself into Ryo and Zen's rivalry! Is some friendly competition all he's after?

title_english: Love Is Like Full of Honey
title_japanese: 恋は溢れる蜜のように
synopsis:
Chizuru Nagahama, a college student, is troubled by a promise she made with her step-brother, Kirito, when they were kids. "Until you meet someone special, I'm going to always be yours." The promise escalated over the years, until Kirito, who grew to be very handsome, started taking care of her physical desires...!! An enchanting brother making his sister give in to her desires. A story of forbidden love.

(Source: Renta!)

Included one-shots: Motto, Amaku Aisaretai no♡, Zenbu, Daete Ageru♡

title: Mouai Erotomania: Ecchi na Mousou Shitemo Ii desu ka?
title_english: Lost in Fantasy: It's Okay If It's Only in My Imagination, Right?
title_japanese: 妄愛エロトマニア~えっちな妄想してもいいですか?~
synopsis:
Nako is ga-ga for her handsome little stepbrother, Mizuki. In addition to wanting to protect and take care of her brother, she finds herself swept away by urges to play out one sensual situation after another with him in her imagination. Although she's been able to maintain a proper, sisterly distance, an unforeseen turn of events finds the two of them temporarily living together. Will Nako still be able to keep her cool with her darling brother sleeping in the next room over?

(Source: Renta!)

title: My Alternate Ending
synopsis:
Could things get any worse for Yul? Actually, yes. She's stuck in a dark and tragic novel as an imprisoned guinea pig for wizards, with death being the easiest way out. The one other way to escape her hellish prison is to use Kal, the story's male lead and the most powerful test subject in history. Unfortunately, the hot-tempered Kal has no patience for her grand plan. With such an uncooperative ally as her best chance at freedom, will Yul be able to change her fate and have a happy ending?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Ninin ga Shinobuden Plus
title_japanese: ニニンがシノブ伝ぷらす

title: Odoro Ryouiki Nayura
synopsis:
There is an absolute realm where darkness stirs...

In a classroom filled with frivolous ghost stories, a girl unnoticed by all sits alone. Her name is Nayura Sumiyuri, and she has a secret...

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

title: Shitsuraku Banchou
synopsis:
Toushin's boyfriend Takumi has an insatiable sex drive. To push Takumi to his limit, he proposes a week of abstinence to experience a day of ecstasy!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Mahoutsukai Rosé no Sado Life
title_english: The Sado Life of Rosé the Witch
title_japanese: 魔法使いロゼの佐渡ライフ
synopsis:
The story begins when Rosé is transported from another world to Japan. Right after arriving, she is attacked by a bird, but she's saved by a local resident named Sana Tsuchiya.

Since Rosé has just arrived and lacks both money and any sense of her surroundings, she ends up moving in with Sana. At first, after watching TV at Sana's house, Rosé assumes she has been transported to Tokyo—but in reality, she is on Sado Island.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Sake no Hosomichi
synopsis:
The main character, Sotatsu Iwama, is an office worker. He looks forward to a drink after work more than anything. Many scenes of him drinking with his colleagues and friends are depicted, but he also enjoys drinking alone. He often talks about his personal theories on how to drink sake and his knowledge of sake and appetizers.

(Source: Wikipedia, translated)

title: Dattara Ore ni Horete Shimae
title_japanese: だったら俺に惚れてしまえ

title: Ichiban Kowai Hanashi
authors: Yokoyama, Mayumi|Komuro, Eiko|Sakamoto, Isao|Mizoguchi, Ryouko|Makihara, Wakana|Nanase, Rei
synopsis:
Warning! This is a collection of seriously scary tales!

A mysterious day in a certain town. The price of a promise. The desire to accelerate the progress of mankind. This collection of tales explores the strange possibilities of our reality. Warns against overambitious desires, and reminds us why horror opens our eyes to the wider world. It's sure to send a chill down your spine!

(Source: Shogakukan Asia)

title: Akaten Majo ni Isekai Saikyou no Kobetsu Shidou wo!
title_japanese: 赤点魔女に異世界最強の個別指導を!
synopsis:
A fantasy story about a dumb witch trying to get into a magic school!

Summon Restriction Zone Magic School Maleficium is a super challenging school for witches. Everyone knows of it, everyone wants in, and everyone dreams of getting in, but more than 99.9999% of girls across the land find only humiliation and defeat when they try. And the famous Summon Restriction Zone Magic School Maleficium is... not the setting of this story.

"I'm going to work hard on the entrance exam and get into Maleficium next year!"

Witch Trainee Viocia Modestracci is a girl who dreams of being a witch. But when her answer sheet displays a score of 0, she has no chance of passing.  However, she has a very reliable helper on her side.

"I will make sure you pass. That's what this teaching contract means."

Viocia strives to get into that magic school with the help of the strongest tutor—Yagoro Myousou.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Douse, Kono Natsu wa Owaru
title_japanese: どうせ、この夏は終わる

title: Meitantei Conan: Konjou no Fist
title_english: Detective Conan the Movie: The Fist of Blue Sapphire
title_japanese: 名探偵コナン 紺青の拳〈フィスト〉
synopsis: Manga adaptation of the twenty-third Meitantei Conan movie.

title: Point of No Return
title_japanese: ポイントオブノーリターン
synopsis: It's a story about high school students who are childhood friends with an age gap and who start to become aware of each other after a "kiss"!

title: My Demon
synopsis:
Do Do Hee is the successor of the Future Group. She doesn’t trust in anyone and is cynical about love. Do Do Hee gets involved with a demon named Jung Gu Won and makes a contract marriage with him.

He can live for eternity by making dangerous, but sweet deals with humans who endure hellish lives. But after looking down upon humans for 200 years, he gets involved with Do Do Hee and somehow loses his power. To prevent his own extinction, he must protect Do Do Hee who has taken all of his power.

(Source: MyDramaList)

synopsis:

2. Mama Colla (Mama Fakes)
3. Genki ni Dashite! (Let It All Out!)
4. Sugao no Mama de (Wear Your True Face)
5. Milk wo Ageru (Giving Milk)
6. Haha no Honto, Onna no Honto (A Mother's Truth is a Woman's Truth)
7. Haha e no Katsuryoku (Energy for Mother)
8. Happy Sky
9. Gibo-sei (Stepmotherly)
10. Mezame: After (Awakening: After)

title: Dear Teddy Bear
synopsis:
Minhyung's lifelong desire is simple: to wholly possess Yijae, the man who raised him. Cunningly concealing his dark devotion, Minhyung eliminates any obstacles in his path until Yijae becomes reliant on Minhyung alone. That is, before the arrival of a man named Hyeon Ho disrupts everything. Will Minhyung's meticulous plans withstand this bold interloper, or will he be forced to confront the harsh reality that some childhood dreams may remain unfulfilled?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Ruirui Senki
synopsis:
Kasane are spirits who latch onto the shadows of people's hearts. But as long as Yayoi and Aoba are around, evil spirits won't be hurting any students at the school! Beautiful art and occult action! The door to the unknown has now been opened...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Included one-shot:
Volume 2: Shikigami
Volume 3: Ruirui Senki (pilot)

title: Where the Heart Is
synopsis:
Min Harang's future is clear. Go to KNU law school, become a prosecutor, and be successful. At least, that's what her mother wants. But when Harang fails the entrance exam, she has to come to terms with the fact that her mother's wishes might not line up with Harang's own. Out sulking in the rain after an explosive argument, help comes in the form of her sex-crazed neighbor - the very man who's constant moaning distracted her from studying! And since it's his fault anyway, it's only fair that he take responsibility, right? But there's more to the man that first appears, and soon Harang finds herself coming face to face with a different form of family. It just goes to show that home is truly where the heart is.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: A Demon's Wish
synopsis:
Doya Seo, a demon, is one day captivated by a mysterious dream. That same day, he happens upon Wish So, a new freshman. Curiously, each moment their paths intersect, Doya finds himself engulfed in a perplexing whirl of emotions and physical sensations that his demonic sensibilities fail to decipher. Meanwhile, Wish finds herself amidst a flurry of events after being invited to the home of famous actor Jaehyeon Woo. In a world where the supernatural coexists with humanity, and caught between the devilish charm of Doya and Jaehyun's allure, will Wish be able to navigate her school life without trouble?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The High School Survival Guide for a Wizard
title_english: The High School Survival Guide for a Wizard
synopsis:
Despite her hatred of humans, the powerful wizard Oz decides to attend a human high school and make friends due to an old deal. Unfortunately, she has difficulty adjusting due to her uncontrollable magic. Things get even more complicated when a mysterious tornado from Oz's world drops a knight named Dorothy at her school. In an effort not to blow her cover, Oz quickly takes him in, oblivious to the fact that this annoying intruder may be the key to unlocking the school life she wants.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Saigo no Natsu wo Hitozuma to
title_english: Last Summer with a Married Woman

title: Kodomo no Kuni
synopsis:
In a town inhabited only by children, a terrifying threat appears: the "otona" (adults), who kidnap them. San, whose older brother Haru serves as the military captain combating these monsters, dreams of following in his brother's footsteps and joining the army. However, he fails the entrance exam... Just as he's plunged into despair, Haru's condition suddenly takes a turn for the worse!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Hikaru ga Shinda Natsu
synopsis:
It has Hikaru's face. It has Hikaru's voice. It even has Hikaru's memories. But whatever came down from the mountains six months ago isn't Yoshiki's best friend. Whatever it is, it's dangerous. Carrying on at school and hanging out as if nothing has changed—as if Hikaru isn't gone—would be crazy...but when it looks so very like Hikaru...and acts so very like Hikaru...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Immortal Eye
synopsis:
After his wife and child leave him, Park Taesan decides it's time to give up his life as a major player in organized crime. Before he can retire though, he's betrayed by one of his own and brutally murdered. However, Taesan gets a second life when his organs are sold on the black market and transplanted into Yoo Chang, the successor of a major company. With a mild-mannered pushover and a revenge-thirsty thug fighting for control of the same body, will either make it out alive?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Gal to Iinchou ga Guuzen Saikai suru Hanashi
title_japanese: ギャルと委員長が偶然再会する話

title: Morishita-kun wa Arimatsu-san ni Muchuu desu
title_japanese: 森下くんは有松さんに夢中です
synopsis:
College student Morishita discovers a high-paying part-time job nearby and eagerly applies. At the café, known for its exquisite coffee and friendly staff, the only employee, Arimatsu, is a challenging person. Feeling competitive, Morishita vows to excel in his job. However, as Morishita becomes captivated by Arimatsu's coffee-making skills, an unforgettable sight leaves a lingering impression. Is there a hint of romance between the carefree handsome college student and the cool, strict employee?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kodoku no Ie
synopsis:
Tateyuki Chouno is devastated when his apartment and extensive collection of insect specimens burns to the ground one evening. But his luck turns around when a chance leads him to meet famed entomologist Izumo Kusanagi. Chouno is floored by the kind hospitality of Kusanagi and his beautiful daughter Touko. However, the warm atmosphere of the estate belies a sinister secret. What is the true nature of Dr. Kusanagi's research? And is Chouno already trapped in a deadly web of terror?

(Source: CLLENN)

title: Mob kara Hajimaru Tansaku Eiyuutan
title_english: The Story of an Exploration Hero Who Has Worked His Way Up from Common People
title_japanese: モブから始まる探索英雄譚
synopsis:
Kaito Takagi, a low status high schooler, your typical Mob character so to say, was just a normal everyday explorer who hunted slimes every day in the dungeons that appeared in Japan, earning pocket money while admiring his childhood friend, the class queen, from afar. One day, a golden slime he had never seen appears before him. After he defeats it, he obtains an extremely rare item worth hundreds of millions as a drop, a servant card that can summon mythical beings!! After he makes up his mind and summons it, a warrior maiden with unparalleled beauty appears. Rise above being just a mob explorer Kaito! A modern battle fantasy story has begun!

(Source: Hobby Japan, translated)

title_english: The Count's Youngest Son Is a Gamer
synopsis:
Dohyeon is a top-ranking gamer in Connect, an immersive VR game that is overrun by corrupt guilds. After being murdered for discovering a mythical item, he wakes up as Lord Raul Ashton, an NPC in a closed beta version of Connect. Now the sole player in this realm, he decides to use his knowledge from his past life to prevent the downfall of House Ashton and unlock unprecedented powers. For Dohyeon, Connect is no longer just a game—it's now his reality. Join him as he embarks on a thrilling quest to reshape his fate!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: The Genius Assassin Who Takes It All
title_english: The Genius Assassin Who Takes It All
title_japanese: 혼자 다 해 먹는 천재 암살자
synopsis:
He is a successful writer who has created a fantasy world in his novel. But he made a terrible mistake in the end, causing the protagonist to reveal himself as a traitor and the world to be dominated by the demon king. He received the wrath of readers and regretted his choice.

Then he woke up in his own novel, in the body of the villain Shin Kang Ho, a ruthless killer who works for the demon king. He is five years before the disastrous ending, and has the chance to change the fate of the world. But Kang Ho has no intention of being a hero. He knows the world is cruel and full of greed. So he decide to use his talent and knowledge to achieve everything you can, without caring about others.

Kang Ho will devour all the resources, rewards, skills and treasures he finds on his way. He will become the strongest and richest of all.

(Source: MU)

title: I Killed the Main Player
synopsis:
Being a character of your favorite game is great! Sure, he's just a minor NPC, but Corin knows this game like the back of his hand. With his knowledge and the main player Sihu's abilities, everything's going smoothly—until Corin discovers Sihu's been murdering innocent NPCs and stealing their items. Horrified but powerless to stop him, Corin awaits the end of the game—only for Sihu to mysteriously fail at the last mission. Instantly, Corin travels three years back in time. Now, he's determined to kill Sihu and take on his role—defeat the final boss and save the world.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

synopsis:
It has already been two years since I possessed a character in this insanely difficult game. In order to go back to Earth, I have no choice but to stop the downfall of this world and reach the ending of this game. [You have collected the body of a "pathetic soldier." Inheriting abilities.] [Inherited rewards: Stamina +1, Proficiency +1, Dehaman's Armored Combat (D)] I will see through to the end of this game no matter what!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: I Am Not a Regressor
synopsis:
The Mara destroyed everything in its path, including the Awakened. It selected humans with the stigmata of each sign in the night sky, except for one—Shin Hyuk Lee. This lone Awakened dealt the final blow against the Mara. Upon achieving such a feat, Vega, the goddess of Lyra, appeared to grant his wish. Shin Hyuk wished to go back with the Lyra stigmata to prevent this tragedy from happening again. Upon returning, Shin Hyuk's body rejected the Lyra stigmata and died... with the Mara beside him.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Apothecary Prince
synopsis:
In a twist of fate, the life of a doctor of Korean medicine flips upside down in a single night. Doctor Han Lee is reborn as Lachiel, the sickly Crown Prince of the Empire of Magentano. Han is now armed with medical knowledge and skills found nowhere else in this new world—but can he heal an empire and mend his own body at the same time? Witness his journey of self-exploration and resilience as he maps destiny's meridian, in pursuit of the acupoint that can reverse his fate.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Seisan Mahoushi no Rakuraku Henkyou Kaitaku: Saikyou no Ajin-tachi to White Kokka wo Kizukimasu!
title_english: The Crafty Mage: Frontier Settling Made Easy
title_japanese: 生産魔法師のらくらく辺境開拓 ～最強の亜人たちとホワイト国家を築きます!～
synopsis:
Joshua is an overworked, underpaid production mage for the prestigious Knights of Schwarz order. When the order's corrupted commander dismisses Joshua from his toxic job, he embarks on a quest for a new purpose. Along the way, Joshua's path intertwines with Illya, the princess of a Demon tribe, whom he saves from hunters targeting "demi-humans." As thanks, he's welcomed to the Demon tribe village. Witnessing their torment by the Demon King's army and slave traders, Joshua resolves to employ his production magic to aid them. Get ready for a fantasy where the greatest production mage and his friends work together to craft a splendid nation!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: The Outcast Is a Fighter
synopsis:
Cha Moo-gyeol, a mixed martial artist, falls into a vegetative state while engaging in martial arts in a no-weight class after being tricked by Chairman Jang. Afterwards, Cha Moo-gyeol is used to renew Chairman Chang's image. Eventually, he dies and is possesses the body of Cha Mu-gyeol, a high school student with the same name. A solid body with S-class durability. A status window ability that can upgrade martial arts abilities. It's different this time. With the unfulfilled dream of the strongest man, the fight to get revenge on Chairman Chang begins.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Pocket Monsters: Yorimichi Volteccers!
title_japanese: ポケットモンスター～よりみちぼるてっか～ず!!～

In each chapter, Liko interacts with a Pokémon from the Rising Volt Tacklers and its Trainer.

(Source: Bulbapedia)

title_japanese: だいすき♡ポケットモンスター

title: Ore no Haitoku Meshi wo Onedari sezu ni Irarenai, Otonari no Top Idol-sama
title_japanese: 俺の背徳メシをおねだりせずにいられない、お隣のトップアイドルさま

title: Ryoukan-san wa Tokidoki Ii Ko.
synopsis:
Kouki comes across as the perfect student, but deep down he has a penchant for torture that he keeps in check. However it doesn't take long for Tobari, the new superintendent, to learn his secret! Tobari shows his conniving side and has Kouki help him with his work in exchange for his silence. Kouki's desires start to overwhelm him, and soon he develops a need to dominate Tobari...

A dormitory romance that begins with the tying of a different knot!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Level 596 no Kaji Minarai
synopsis:
The beasthuman Noa has a dream of becoming a blacksmith, as Noa's father, Nomad, used to be the acclaimed Divine Blacksmith. Since Noa's mother died, Nomad has drowned his days in liquor and grief, so Noa ventures to dangerous places to get Nomad's smithing materials. This leads to Noa's life being in continual risk. Noa is now 14 and doing normal work as a smithy to support Nomad, when Nomad makes an unreal discovery about his child! All of the materials Noa's collected are unbelievably rare! Nomad calls his familiar adventurer to check Noa's level...and it's at an amazingly high 596! What's the secret to this super-high level, higher than even the kingdom's hero?! Check out this adventuring fantasy that unfolds around a puppy-human apprentice that's out of this world!

(Source: AlphaPolis)

title: Kimi ni Koisuru Hazu ga Nai: Romance-hen
title_japanese: 君に恋するはずがないーロマンス篇ー
synopsis:
Kitaoji, an elite salaryman who loves shoujo manga, is going out with his quiet and handsome colleague, Arima. The moment they started talking about moving in together, Kitaoji has to go on a long-term business trip to Osaka!?

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

title: Seeding
synopsis:
Geum knew that Jeonjin Seok loves her. She pretended not to notice and married Hyeon Ryong, but they struggled with having a child. When Hyeon Ryong realized that he is infertile and will never be able to give Geum what she wants, he asks Seok to hold her.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Breakup 101
synopsis:
When Hwang Jinwoo stumbles into a gay bar, he accidentally crosses paths with the seemingly cold and aloof Baek Wooseok. After a few too many drinks, Jinwoo lets slip some embarrassing words, and one thing leads to another—they end up spending the night together. But what Jinwoo thinks is a one-and-done deal, Wooseok seems to think is the start of something more! Jinwoo needs to come up with a plan to break this off, and quick.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Game Tomodachi no Onnanoko
title_japanese: ゲーム友達の女の子とヤる話

title: Isekai AV Satsueitai: Remaster
title_english: AV Film Crew in Another World: Remaster
title_japanese: 異世界AV撮影隊 リマスター

title: The Saintess Returns to the Emperor
title_english: The Saintess Returns to the Emperor
synopsis:
After being betrayed by her lover, Riella decides to end it all, only to be saved by Emperor Herrhan. Without ever getting to thank him, she sneaks away to start her life anew. But soon, she finds herself on the brink of death once more when she's wrongfully framed for trying to assassinate the emperor. Fortunately, Herrhan comes to her rescue yet again, and this time, Riella will be able to repay him in an even bigger way than she imagined. As it turns out, she is the empire's sole saintess who has the power to heal the cursed ruler...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Let Me Die in Peace!
synopsis:
By the time Princess Ophelia Lidania's fourth death rolls around, she's gotten pretty sick of dying painfully. However, she seems unable to avoid her fate of being killed by her half-brother Ewout Lidania. She's tried being nice to him, locking him up, and having him killed, but it always ends the same way. So, her goal for her fifth life is to just die painlessly. To this end, she hires the elite assassin Nau to stay by her side. But will this be enough to overturn her fate and bring her peace?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Shoujo After School: Chitose Shiki Tanpenshuu
title_japanese: 少女アフタースクール ―千歳四季短編集―
synopsis:
1. Shoujo After School
2. Mayonaka ni, Binetsu
3. Aimai Gallop
4. Stela no Kidou
5. Watashi no Prêt-à-porter
6-7. Azfareo no Sobayounin Bangai-hen

title: I Came Back as a Martial Genius
title_english: I Came Back as a Martial Genius
synopsis:
Demons came pouring from a portal that appeared out of nowhere and caused the Cataclysm. But all hope is not lost thanks to the Awakeners, people who can fight these demons. Jun Lee, a D-rank Awakener, is one of them. He fought demons heroically, but as someone who inherited nothing from his family, he could only go so far. As Jun Lee's life slowly whittled away, a system message appeared, informing him that a special martial arts route had opened...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Anime Bungou Stray Dogs Shousetsuban
title_english: Anime Bungo Stray Dogs: Novel Version
title_japanese: アニメ 文豪ストレイドッグス 小説版
synopsis:
Young, hungry, and homeless, the orphan Atsushi Nakajima sees his hard-knock life turn around when he meets Osamu Dazai, a peculiar man who’s part of a group of detectives with special powers. And he wants Atsushi’s help to catch a man-eating tiger that’s terrorizing Yokohama?! Experience the beginning of the hit anime series adapted into a novel!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: 2023 These Days Love Special
synopsis: An anthology of romance short stories by various authors.

title: This Life Starts as a Child Actor
synopsis:
Was this life a failure? On the contrary, he liked it! Kang Su-hyun has failed in everything he has done in life for four years. He finally found his calling as an actor and thought he was seeing the light, but he collided with a truck coming from the opposite side and despaired as death approached...

"Wait a minute, didn't I die?"

When he regained consciousness, his appearance reflected in the mirror was the cutest version of himself from when he was five years old? Yes, in this life he resolves to be a child actor.

Kang Su-hyun's acting career begins!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: One of the Four
synopsis:
When Seonghyun turned out to be an Omega, he lost connection with his four high school friends. Thinking that they would never meet each other again, he's suddenly reunited with them. That fateful day, Seonghyun was surrounded by the four Alphas, and no matter how much inhibitors he took, he went into heat.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Brave Witches Prequel: Orussia no Daichi
title_japanese: ブレイブウィッチーズPrequel オラーシャの大地
synopsis:
A story depicting the days before the anime "Brave Witches". Forefront of defending humanity from the invasion of Neuroi, the 502nd Joint Fighter Wing is created in Petersburg. The story follows the new members of the 502nd as they join the team.

(Source: Strike Witches Wiki)

title: Shuumatsu, Kimi to
synopsis:
Gourmet BL. Two people peacefully enjoying meals together against the backdrop of a mysterious zombie outbreak. Shuuhei is consumed by the promise he made with Tomoya back in middle school. "Would you eat me?"

(Source: MU)

title: Being Loved for the First Time
title_english: Being Loved for the First Time
synopsis:
After sacrificing herself to save the world over 99 different lifetimes, Anastasia Enderblanc starts her 100th life with frustrated resignation. Born as the youngest child of House Enderblanc, she expects another abusive family that fears her power, but is confused when they shower her with love instead. Their genuine affection surprises her, but she keeps waiting for the other shoe to drop. Can Anastasia accept the Enderblancs' love, or will she be disappointed and betrayed once more?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Amayakashite! Oppai Maid-kun
title_japanese: あまやかして! 雄っぱいメイドくん
synopsis:
"Welcome to the afterlife, master!" A corporate slave finds his dying wish of being pampered by beautiful maids fulfilled...except that the maids are men?!

(Source: WWWave Corporation)

title_japanese: 異世界で生き抜くためのブラッドスキル

title: Zense de Tsurai Omoi wo Shita node, Kamisama ga Shazai ni Kimashita
title_english: God Came to Apologize Because I Had a Hard Time in My Past Life
title_japanese: 前世で辛い思いをしたので、神様が謝罪に来ました
synopsis:
Saki Amemiya has spent her life filled with misfortune, from bullying to power harassment. It is right when she thinks she can finally get to go home after having worked overtime until the last train, that lightning strikes and ends her life. She wakes up and realizes a young boy claiming to be a god appears in front of her, and he confesses to her that "All the misfortunes you've had are my fault!." Saki is recommended to be reincarnated into another world as an apology, she accepts the proposal to attain happiness at last. Many divine protections are bestowed upon her...? With the apology cheat, she becomes a beautiful and genius girl?! This time, for sure, she will attain happiness!

(Source: AlphaPolis)

title: Believe My Sign
synopsis:
Soo-jeong is always getting on the self-absorbed Eunchan's nerves since he first appeared before him out of the blue. Soo-jeong feels the same way towards the socially inept Eunchan, who is often harsh towards him. Their ironic relationship develops as they try to survive together, even though they don't trust one another. What should you trust? Your past experiences and memories, or intuition?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Shape Up Ran
synopsis:
Ranko Kotobuki is a highschool girl with excellent style and superpowers from her bodybuilding training. Souichirou, her relative who has come from Okayama to attend a cram school in Tokyo, is staying at her house...?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Suki na Ko no Shinyuu ni Hisoka ni Semarareteiru
title_japanese: 好きな子の親友に密かに迫られている
synopsis:
During middle school, Rento Seko fell in love with his classmate Misa Yosaki, who had once saved him. Rento, who went to the same high school as Misa, repeatedly made bold advances toward Misa, but all of them were unsuccessful. However, Rento never give up. Such days continued for about a year.

Today, as usual, Rento confesses his love to Misa, and Misa's best friend, Haru Hinata, always gets in the way of Rento to protect Misa. Yet, the three of them often chat normally, and they also often go home together. On the way home, Rento sits on a bench in a nearby park after parting ways with the other two at a crossroads. After a short while, Haru, who was supposed to have left, arrives.

"Well then, let's go to my house again today."

This is the story of the three of them.

(Source: Kakuyomu, translated)

title: Sensei mo Shousetsu wo Kakun desu yo ne?

title_japanese: 限界ダンジョンの繁殖事情
synopsis:
Egin is the boss of a dungeon where heroes have hunted out all the monsters. In order to revive the dungeon, where there is now a 100% chance of reaching the boss's room, Egin and Saille (a virgin unicorn and his second in command) tackle trying to breed more monsters. But the dungeon's monsters are hard to deal with... such as complicated slimes that have fallen in love with humans, and a shy Dullahan. Will Egin really ever be able to revive the dungeon?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title_japanese: ボロボロのエルフさんを幸せにする薬売りさん
synopsis: A humble medicine peddler comes across an elf slave, saddled with disabilities stemming from months of abuse. Can he save her?

title: Please Show Up!
synopsis:
One day, Kim Jiyong, an ordinary student, dreams of Jung Jihye and falls in love with her at first sight. But when he tries to find her... it turns out that the woman committed suicide two years ago?!

The romantic story of Jiyong who wants to return Jihye's life, please show up!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Idol-sama ga Real Koi suru na
title_japanese: アイドル様がリア恋するな
synopsis:
Fuma Kodaka is laser-focused on his acting roles to the point of ignoring anything that doesn't have to do with his career. So when this stubborn actor has trouble getting into character for his role in a new TV show, he feels lost. Luckily for him, he bumps into Kanade Suou, a super-popular prince-like idol. Kanade is strikingly similar to Fuma's next role, so in order to study Kanade's sweet and sparkly mannerisms, Fuma asks him out on a whim. Surprisingly, the handsome idol readily agrees without any hesitation!

(Source: Animate International)

title: Hool!gan's
synopsis:
In nineteenth century London, deep in the East End, there live the Hooligans: a band of miscreants led by alchemist Lee Heartrib, the current head of the Antilia Family mafia. Entrusted with guardianship of the city by his predecessor, Lee uses his alchemy to keep the junkies happy—but his true aim is creating a "paradise" for the good of the people. And sometimes, that involves getting his hands dirty, especially when he's pitted against the other mafia heads, or shadowy beings who want to eliminate human life on earth.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Itsuka no Main
synopsis:
Third-year junior high student Tenta Kannonji is a member of the Asakusa-based biker team Kaminari Shounen. He is not good at fighting, but good at bluffing.

title: Kaisha to Shiseikatsu: On to Off
title_japanese: 会社と私生活－オンとオフ－
synopsis:
Meet two office workers whose professional lives "on" the clock and private lives when they're "off" couldn't be more different. He dresses like a lolita. She dresses like a punk. When their contrasting "on" and "off" modes collide, it inevitably leads to heart-pounding antics!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: TS Akuyaku Reijou Kamisama Tensei Zennin Tsuihou Haishin RTA: Kiraware Tsuihou End wo Mezashiteru noni Saikyou Musou Road kara Orirarenai
title_japanese: TS悪役令嬢神様転生善人追放配信RTA～嫌われ追放エンドを目指してるのに最強無双ロードから降りられない～
synopsis:
A man who lost his life in an accident is reincarnated into an otome game world with a mission given by gods who want entertainment. The mission is to be incarnated as a villainess character who turns out to be a good person, but it's a livestream of speedrunning getting exiled?! He was told that the sooner he was exiled the more benefits he would get in the next life, so from the very start of the game he picked a fight with all of the characters so he could be exiled quickly, but instead, he became an invincible and popular person... !? The original protagonist respects her, a handsome aristocrat makes the main character his goal and trains into a cheat class, the original story completely falls apart! The exile end becomes more and more distant, replaced by looming instant death events... As Marianne Biesround, for the sake of her next life, she will destroy everyone (and every flag) that stands in her way with the strongest "Meteor" magic!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Kokoro Nochi Hare
title_english: Partly-Cloudy Hearts With Chance of Sunshine
synopsis:
It's their final year of high school. Gaku's one-sided feelings for Haru, which he'd kept hidden all these years, have begun to stir. They'd been friends ever since high school began, and they thought that their relationship would never change. They would hang out with girls from another school, focus on studying for college entrance exams, and take a breather at the school festival... "I love you Haru." With the confession, their world would change.

This is a year of a normal student life in which best friends who were always by each other's side become lovers.

(Source: GOT)

title: Chuuken-kun
synopsis:
Akira, a sensitive high school boy who struggles with socializing, admires Nao, an older cafe employee. He respects Nao as his mentor and follows him around like a faithful dog out of sheer hope of getting closer. As they spend their days eating, traveling, and chatting, Akira's feelings gradually develop into romantic love, but...

This is an everyday love story which portrays step-by-step feelings of a loyal but clumsy school boy and a guy with maxed-out social skills.

(Source: GOT)

title: Kimi ni Sasageru Otokomae
title_english: I Offer My Manliness to You
synopsis:
Ran, a high school sophomore, is suddenly confessed to by Hikaru, a handsome male kouhai. Ran is bewildered by the unexpected confession from someone whose name she did not even know. Nevertheless, the distance between the two of them slowly shrinks...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Shall We, My Lady?
synopsis:
As a devoted knight of her kingdom, Irene M. Voltern has fought for her country countless times. And even when she is offered as a tribute to the Perkan Empire, she readily accepts her fate. She is prepared to become Crown Prince Kael's concubine, but he wouldn't dream of making her do anything against her will. Having fallen head over heels for Lady Irene at first sight, he will do anything to make her happy. But after spending her life putting others first, can Irene finally live for herself?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Savage Castle
synopsis:
Every night, Else von Roatte's bed is warmed by the company of her favorite servant, Ian. Knowing Ian must bend to her will, Else is tormented by guilt, but she allows herself no other real pleasure. Although her father tolerates her tantrums and showers her with riches, he does not love her. Else is sickly and fragile, and her family keeps her alive just so she can marry and provide them with an heir.

The bitter treatment has turned Else into a spoiled and entitled young lady; she is ill-mannered and has a penchant for dramatics, but she cannot help herself if another woman so much as talks to Ian. However, contrary to appearances, Ian hides an intense obsession with Else. Driven to finally reveal his true identity and return to the position of power that was stolen from him, Ian intends to free Else from her cursed life and give her the world.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Oi, Hazure Skill dato Omowareteita "Cheat Code Sousa" ga Bakemono Sugirun daga.
title_japanese: おい、外れスキルだと思われていた《チートコード操作》が化け物すぎるんだが。
synopsis:
In a world where everyone is bestowed a skill at the age of 18, Arios, the son of a sword saint, was without a doubt expected to be granted the Sword Saint skill, but... was instead given a skill called Cheat Code Manipulation. With the unprecedented skill being treated like garbage, Arios gets thrown out of his home. However, with this useless skill, he is able to control some not-so-ordinary cheat codes! With his childhood friend, the princess following him, he spreads his peerlessness across a new land without even knowing it!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: In Full Bloom
synopsis:
The kingdom of Juushin is suffering at the hands of a cruel emperor. In order to stop his father's rule of tyranny, the crown prince will enlist the aid of a legendary assassin with reasons of her own for wanting the emperor dead. One ruler, one schemer, and... one assassin.

(Source: Easy Going Scans)

title: Yandere Imouto ni Aisaresugite Kozukuri Kankin Seikatsu the Comic

title: Wo de Zhuli Nanyou
synopsis:
Nan-ge's ex-boyfriend—the glamorous internet personality with millions of subscribers—Ivan, accidentally met his old college xuedi, Wu Shi, and hired him to be his personal assistant. When it comes to Wu Shi, Ivan only remembered being his direct senior in college, who would have thought that their fate started even earlier!? One by one, through photos that Wu Shi had hidden in his room, Ivan begins to remember memories of his youth that even he himself had forgotten...

(Source: Tong Li Publishing, translated)

title: Boku ga Koisuru Cosmic Star
title_japanese: 僕が恋するコズミックスター
synopsis:
Eichi, a boy in love with his adored classmate "Haida," decides one day to confess his love and just as he is about to confess to Haida, a beautiful cosmic girl appears from the sky...?

(Source: MangaDex)

When the idol Chico announced her retirement, Yamada-san, her biggest fan, felt an overwhelming sense of loss. But then a new office lady joins her workplace, and it turns out to be the former idol herself...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Nebula's Civilization
synopsis:
Seong-un Choi is the top-ranked player in the game "Lost World," being the only player to have completed all its achievements. However, his triumph is short-lived as a mysterious message transports him to the real "Lost World," transforming him from a mere gamer to a contender for godhood. Amidst others vying for divinity, will Seong-un be able to achieve true godhood and reign supreme in this new realm?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Blue de Roi
synopsis:
Izumi, a high school student, possesses the mysterious ability to see "wings" on certain people's backs. He has since hidden this power, but after reuniting with the man called "Mana", his everyday life suddenly changes?

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

title: Gokutora no Honey Bunny
synopsis:
Ao, a caring rabbit, one day meets a beautiful boy of the name Asuka who fled to Ao's town. Asuka is a tiger and the heir of a yakuza family from a neighboring town, and Ao and Asuka's family become friends. They are separated when Asuka returns to his home, and twelve years have passed since then. Asuka, who was grown up to be a magnificent male tiger, suddenly appears in front of Ao and asks him, "Will you be my mate as promised?" Ao is surprised by the sudden proposal from the man he once loved like a younger brother...?!

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

title: Keshigomu Kareshi
synopsis:
The day of high school entrance exam, Sena gave half of his eraser to a boy who seems to be troubled. When Sena successfully entered the school, unfortunately he never saw him again. Two years later, when Sena had almost forgotten about it, a flirtatious boy named Koga, comes from America and transfers to his school. Koga begins his search for the "Eraser Goddess" he fell in love with at the first sight on the day of his entrance exam. Sena realizes that he has been mistaken for a girl and runs away desperately, but...

The fresh boys are in love with each other in a cute and innocent way!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Yanyaka Sanpo
synopsis:
Yanaka, Nezu, and Sendagi: commonly known as "Yanesen." Set in streetscape retaining the atmosphere of the Shouwa era, this is a story of one cute kitten's communion with humanity (felinity?).

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Daisuki na Kaiinu ga Tensei shitekita
title_japanese: 大好きな飼い犬が転生してきた
synopsis:
The pet dog (best friend) that he was reunited with is an elementary school student!?

Tomoki Takakura, a corporate drone, has a chance encounter with a boy named Leo. Leo suddenly informs him, "I'm your reincarnated dog...!!?"

"This time I will protect you."

Everyday, bit by bit, Tomoki is healed by his beloved Leo.

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

title: Kyuutei Joi no Kanbi na Chiryou de Koutei Heika wa Furuitatsu
title_japanese: 宮廷女医の甘美な治療で皇帝陛下は奮い勃つ

title: Kimi wo Utsushita Natsu
synopsis:
Despite being a photographer, the one thing second-year high school student Midori Okimizu cannot seem to find is a subject he wants to capture. That all changes one day when he watches Arata Shishi, a first-year student well-known for being violent, flawlessly completing a judo throw known as a seoi nage on another student. The expression on Shishi's face compels Okimizu to take a photo of a person for the first time ever.

Shishi notices the boy taking her photo and confronts Okimizu. Fully expecting her to retaliate against him physically, Okimizu is shocked when Shishi asks to see the photograph instead. Complimenting the shot, Shishi wishes she could learn more about herself, giving Okimizu the idea to ask her to be a model. While Okimizu is still terrified of Shishi, he begins to understand her character through his photography, including the reason behind her notorious reputation.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Naeng Sowol: The Cold Moon
synopsis:
In order to avenge her family, Naeng Sowol has trained to be a special rank assassin her whole life. But before she completes her last mission, she is thwarted by Baek Woonbi, the heir of the most powerful faction in the martial world, who intervenes for his own plans. Despite their initial skirmishes, the two eventually agree to cooperate. It isn't long before their endeavors together stir up long-lost emotions inside Sowol... and reveal a truth that could change the martial world forever.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Quanqiu Gaokao
synopsis:
This is an examination that puts your life at stake. Answer a plethora of questions, pass the exam, and you may live. Two-faced examiner, Qin Jiu, meets the cold examinee, You Huo. In this inhumane system, both of them who have lost their memories go head to head against each other. Despite that, they have a strong mutual understanding. Alarms go off and the system collapses time and time again. During which, their memories gradually return. It turns out that even at the end of the world where there's only dust left, you're still the first person I met. What's so great about this system? We'll just destroy it. The world is brilliant and grand still, so welcome home.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: Shouri no Megami: Nikke - Sweet Encount
title_japanese: 勝利の女神：NIKKE すいーとえんかうんと
synopsis:
NIKKE and their friends live peacefully. A laid-back comedy in which the main character N102 works as a maid at a maid cafe called "Maid For You" where Cocoa and Soda work too.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Misoji Gay, Tatanaku Narimashita. Jiko Hitei to Tatakatta 1460-nichi
title_japanese: 三十路ゲイ、勃たなくなりました。 ～自己否定と闘った1460日～
synopsis: A memoir about the author's struggles with erectile dysfunction as a gay man in his 30s.

title: The Contracted Grand Duchess
synopsis:
The young and lovely Princess Rien Digrit seems to be the unluckiest girl in her land. Her fifth husband in under a year fails to survive their wedding night, and all kinds of rumors place the blame on her. But her father promises things will turn out for the better should she marry Baron Madd Cranchesta, his close associate.

Before long, Rien realizes she is but a pawn in her father and Madd's conspiracy for political gain; neither of them has ever truly cared for her. Fed up with her own weakness, Rien demands a divorce, only to pay with her life. However, by some miracle, Rien opens her eyes in the past, moments before she is introduced to Madd.

Rien quickly trades her insecurities for a steely resolve for revenge, understanding that her best bet at survival is postponing her engagement to Madd. This time, she chooses to seek out a man who is a thorn in her father's side—the infamously cold and distant Grand Duke Clocean Ellagadar.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Futanari Goshujin-sama to Josouko no Ama Love Choukyou Nikki
title_english: A Crossdresser and His Futanari Mistress’s Lovey-Dovey Training Routine
title_japanese: ふたなり御主人様と女装子の甘ラブ調教日記
synopsis:
Makoto's mistress Anna can't get over how adorable he looks when he crossdresses! What kind of exciting antics will they get up to today?

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Netori Mahoutsukai no Bouken
title_japanese: 寝取り魔法使いの冒険
synopsis:
Young swordsman Alvin has put together a nearly perfect adventuring team with his best friend and ranger, Renka, and the adorable priestess Milis. Though they have managed well so far, things really start improving after the wizard Shinji joins their group. Now, they're becoming the best team ever! But what Alvin doesn't know is that while Shinji is a capable and reliable wizard in the streets, behind closed doors, he's tangled up in the ladies' sheets. And his lust doesn't stop with his teammates—Shinji's also managed to find his way into the beds of companions and enemies alike. Will Alvin remain blissfully unaware of Shinji's lecherous ways, or will things come to a head if he finds out?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Sekai de Ichiban "Kawaii" Amamiya-san, Nibanme wa Ore. The Comic
title_english: The Cutest Is Amamiya, the Second Is Me.
title_japanese: 世界で一番『可愛い』雨宮さん、二番目は俺。 THE COMIC
synopsis:
Hikari is a popular model nicknamed the "Cutest Girl in the World," but behind that gorgeous female façade is an ordinary high school boy named Harema Kouki! Since his model self is so adorable, Kouki never really finds other girls cute...until one day, when he realizes his plain and boring classmate, Amamiya-san, is actually cuter than he is! A high school rom-com between an overconfident diva and a diamond in the rough!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

4. Kare no Karada wa Watashi Senzoku♥

title: Buddy Cat
synopsis:
Eight, a cool and handsome Hachiware cat, and Mike, a sturdy tortoiseshell cat. The two don't seem to mesh with each other but they are the strongest duo, standing up against evil!

(Source: Shounen Gahousha, translated)

title: My Evil Husband Is Obsessed With the Wrong Person
title_english: My Evil Husband Is Obsessed With the Wrong Person
synopsis:
Getting reincarnated into the world of a novel is never easy, but possessing a doomed bride on her way down the aisle to marry a murderous emperor is just unfair! Now, the newly reincarnated Angelica has no choice but to learn to survive the whims of her new husband, Emperor Ranielo... Well, at least until he falls for his fated love interest and she can slip away unnoticed. But as the days pass, Ranielo's interest in her only grows. Can this tyrant be tamed, or will Angelica find that some destinies can't be unwritten?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Kimochi Warui kara Kimi ga Suki
title_japanese: きもちわるいから君がすき
synopsis:
Tsukasa, who falls in love with her best friend Yoriko, hides her feelings and continues her daily life. In the meantime, Yoriko also seems to have deep affection to Tsukasa. This is a precious, pure, and disgusting story of their sick love.

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Kimi to Kanaderu Love Song
title_japanese: 君と奏でるラブソング
synopsis:
After the passing of his parents, Koutarou finds himself managing their coffee shop alone. His only companion is a cat and, despite concerns from those around him about his loneliness, Koutarou struggles to forge deep connections with others. One day, a self-proclaimed angel appears before him—Rudy.

"I've been waiting. I want to hear you sing," Rudy says.

Koutarou's heart skips a beat; he had abandoned music a long time ago. Rudy decides to move in with Koutarou—not that Koutarou agreed to anything—and, from there, their life as housemates begins...

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Uchuu Seibutsugakusha Pratess

One day, returning from a dungeon, an elf with drool dripping from her mouth and reddened cheeks comes to the clinic, pushes Toowa down, and starts to moan! However, when he thoroughly examines her without touching, he discovers a dark design in the vicinity of her belly button!

When she—Sylvie, an A-rank adventurer—recovers her senses, she dashes out of the clinic and returns with her comrades...!?

Toowa, who treats all manner of people he encounters with kindness, is going to heal both their bodies and minds.

Haruki Ito is an ordinary high school student just like many others. However, things take a spectacular turn during a seemingly ordinary class when Haruki, along with all his classmates, are suddenly whisked away into another world!

Curiosity and excitement fill the air as Haruki comes to realize that he has been granted a divine power known as the "Ripper." This power, unparalleled in its might, sets him apart as a force to be reckoned with. As the story unfolds, Haruki discovers the true extent of his newfound ability.
