Whether it's forming unlikely alliances or facing cunning foes, Haruki's path is paved with thrilling surprises and comical moments.

However...he was reincarnated in the middle of a vast natural wilderness surrounded by trees!

(Source: MU)

title: Houkago no Dungeon Diver: Nihon to Isekai wo Ikiki Dekiru You ni Natta Boku wa Level Up ni Isoshimimasu
title_english: After-School Dungeon Diver: Level Grinding in Another World
title_japanese: 放課後の迷宮冒険者〈ダンジョン・ダイバー〉～日本と異世界を行き来できるようになった僕はレベルアップに勤しみます～
synopsis:
Why not unwind in another world once in a while? High schooler Kudo Akira happens upon the ability to travel between Japan and the fantastical world of Do-Melta. Not bound by any dire mission or duty, he leisurely enjoys exploring his way through the massive dungeon in the center of the world and all the trappings that come with it. The guild receptionist is trying to mooch off of him, his magic instructor has "rewards" for him, and he just might have some fun with a girl he saves...

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Sousei no Tenkentsukai
title_english: Heavenly Swords of the Twin Stars
synopsis:
In his past life, Chou Sekiei was the undefeated war hero Kou Eihou—no pressure, right? Now, a thousand years later, all he wants is to get a nice, cushy job as a civil official and build a quiet life for himself. Too bad that he still has fighting prowess he can't explain. Too bad that as a child, he was taken in by a renowned general and trained alongside Chou Hakurei, famed for her talent and beauty. Too bad that he's gotten into rescuing pretty (and pretty immature) merchant prodigies. Sekiei was really looking forward to some peace and quiet so he could kick back and read, but when the foreign nation of Gen launches an invasion that triggers war, he's forced to put his books down. With the power of skills he'd hoped never to put to use again, Sekiei will once more have to make a name on the battlefield... Will he and his friends be enough to save their homeland?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Botsuraku Yotei no Kizoku dakedo, Hima Datta kara Mahou wo Kiwametemita

synopsis:
What's a guy to do when his life suddenly changes while innocently enjoying a nice, cold drink after work? And I mean really changes. This middle-aged commoner now finds himself in the body of Liam Hamilton, the young son of a noble house teetering on the brink of collapse. Between his fervidly desperate father and his utterly apathetic brothers, the only bright side to his new situation is that Liam can finally try learning magic like he's always wanted. Little does he know his hobby of choice may be about to turn his life upside-down yet again! Will Liam be able to master the craft of magic? And will it be enough to save him from the shadow looming over his family...?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Ryuu Taikou no Senzoku Jijo wa Goenryo shitai!: Tensei-saki no Okyuuji Aite wa Zense no Moto Konyakusha deshita

synopsis:
On her sixteenth birthday, Viscountess Mille-Feuille Forêt Noire, a member of a long-lived race called dragonkin, remembers her previous life as the murdered fiancée of Dragon Duke Vacherin. She immediately vows never to get involved with him again and aspires to live a peaceful life by hiding what she knows, but after a twist of fate or two...she soon winds up the Dragon Duke's personal attendant! Past intrigue now begins to yield problems in the present. Who killed Mille-Feuille in her last life? How can she improve the lives of fellow dragonkin women? Is she in love with the Dragon Duke, or are her feelings just lingering attachment from their old romance? And how will this all affect her new relationship with her former fiancé? History may or may not repeat itself in this romantic fantasy!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: The Marquess's Favorite
synopsis:
Arhin Avand is taking a big risk disguising herself as a man to be a knight—because if she's discovered, she'll be deemed a witch! But thankfully, the only person who sees through her disguise is Marquess Ludvig Vert, her new captain and the first man she ever kissed. Now, as they work together to carry out secret missions for the good of the empire, Arhin can't help but feel like he's giving her special treatment. Is the marquess's favoritism a good thing, or will it totally blow her cover?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Villainess Empress's Attendant
synopsis:
Though the empress of the Rantias Empire has no equal in beauty and grace, she rarely leaves her palace, feeding the rumors of her cruelty and ill manners. All of the servants fear her, and not a single aide stays for long. That is, until Paresa Menzel is appointed the empress' personal attendant. Unlike those who came before her, Paresa speaks her mind and completes her duties with astonishing skill and composure, quickly earning the empress' favor.

Paresa's competence is unmistakable, but her past is full of mystery—a combination that raises many questions about her origins and circumstances. Nevertheless, despite all of Paresa's secrets, one thing is certain: no matter what, she will do everything in her power to protect the villainous empress.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

Sora has to take the princess back to the castle as soon as possible! Flying between two worlds! This is the beginning of a Precure adventure! It's hero time!

After losing his father in a tragic accident, Shinobu Iijima and his younger sister Megumi are taken in by their father's old friend, Ayumu. Shinobu works hard in the hopes of starting a new life for himself. Megumi, and a mobile game called La Vita Online, are the only things keeping him afloat. One day, Ayumu reveals his true intentions of tearing Shinobu down and getting his hands on Megumi. But just after Shinobu learns that Ayumu deleted all of his game data in La Vita, their high-rise apartment catches on fire and Shinobu falls to his death, Megumi in tow. He wakes up in a strange new world... and realizes he's been reincarnated into the world of La Vita Online. An announcement from the devs tells him that Ayumu is already there, and a countdown to Megumi's arrival is ticking. Shinobu vows to protect Megumi after she arrives at any cost, even if it means he has to crawl his way up from level 1 to fend off all the other reincarnated players.

title: Houtai Koushaku no Kekkon Jijou

synopsis:

Five years later, Alfred returned to high society, where nothing but cruel rumors awaited him. People had started to call him the "Bandaged Duke," and new enemies had sprouted left and right. Ignoring their insults, Alfred withdrew to the Besculey Palace, with only his duties as duke in mind.

However, Alfred's years of solitude end with a royal order: he must marry a woman of the king's choosing. His new wife is Sierra Crufeldt, a widely known blind songstress hailing from a family of talented musicians. Expecting an unwilling and frightened young woman, Alfred is surprised to discover Sierra is elated about the marriage and eager for his company. Alfred believes he is nothing but a cursed man undeserving of happiness, but the unconditional love of a woman who intends to remain by his side no matter what may just forever change his life.

However, when he moves close to her ear and says, "Should I help you forget about your Ex?" and proposes being "hug buddies," she's unsure how she should react! "You're actually feeling lonely, right?" Chisa tries to act strong, but Toudou's gentle hugs and kindness slowly seeps into her heart. Can Sumire-chan stage her comeback in the Reiwa era? Stay tuned!

So this time, Erendelle decides to survive by seducing Castian, the prince responsible for her death. The only issue? She's from a family that he considers to be his enemy! Will Erendelle overcome this high hurdle and avoid dying a fourth time?

When she receives a call from a friend, Yukino remembers that she had made a promise to attend a wedding "with her boyfriend" and panics, saying, "Oh no, we broke up six months ago...!"  The wedding is next week, and Yukino is worried about what to do. She asks Aoshima to pretend to be her boyfriend for just one day and attend her friend's wedding. To her surprise, he agrees! Yukino is relieved, but in fact, Aoshima has a plan... As they pretend to be together, Aoshima somehow starts to become interested in Yukino, who she had no interest in at all, and Yukino is at the mercy of a mean, younger tsundere boy. Sian uses the "cup," and tries hard to revive the land. Surprisingly, it seems this "cup" can produce more than just water?! Here starts the story of a boy who was once called even worthless saves the world!

title: Tenohira Neko
synopsis:
A minuscule cat appears one rainy day, perched on Kanade's chair. But the moment he spots the tiny ball of fluff, it vanishes! Kanade knows fairy cats are a rare sight to behold, hiding out of reach in nooks and crannies—but now that he's seen one, he is determined to win its affection. Can Kanade coax the fairy cat out and befriend it?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Mugi no Wakusei
synopsis:
In a mountainside bakery, the young shopkeeper Konta meets Mamita, an alien whose spaceship crashed and is looking for food. Konta winds up taking the stranded alien in as his little brother. This is the diary of a baker and an alien as they live together as "siblings."

(Source: Shodensha, translated)

title: Hazure Skill "Soine" ga Kakuseishi, Boku ga Saikyou Harem wo Kizuku made: Micchaku Soine de Ganbou Kaihou!? Yuuwaku saremakutte Komattemasu!!

title_japanese: ハズレスキル『添い寝』が覚醒し、僕が最強ハーレムを築くまで～密着添い寝で願望解放!? 誘惑されまくって困ってます!!～
synopsis:
As a former dropout, Regnard defies the haters and enrolls in the esteemed Royal Academy of Lasarzia. But when it comes time to receive his skill, things don't quite go as planned. Rather than a cool skill or fantastic abilities, he gets a cuddle skill. Mocked and ridiculed for this bizarre ability, Regnard is sure he'll be stuck as a loser. That is, until he spends the night with the beautiful honor student Frost. With his new ability unlocked, Regnard will follow the path to adventure—and build the ultimate harem!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

synopsis:
"What would've happened to us, if we hadn't kissed that day?" Miho, who's never been good at making friends, shows up to an alumni meeting in hopes to see his old former friend, Hiroya, one more time. They fell out of touch due to certain reasons, but Miho's determined to put his fleeting crush past him and rekindle their friendship. But when Hiroya says that he was married and got divorced, Miho can't suppress his shock. Taken aback by the fact that there is much of Hiroya he doesn't know, he sneaks out of the rowdy reunion venue only to be chased after by Hiroya...!

Kanata, fed up with his noisy neighbors, is asked by his childhood friend, Yuji, to room with him. Kanata immediately agreed, but secretly has a one-sided crush on Yuji. "I wanted to ask my flawless childhood friend, who's also handsome, kind, and can cook, if he had a girlfriend... why did I end up lying that I had a girlfriend!?" And now, Yuji says he's going to teach me how to have sex. He's feeling me up with his big hands, it's so hot I feel like I'm melting...!!

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title: Samurai Non Grata
title_japanese: サムライ・ノングラータ
synopsis:
In Europe, particularly in France, notably in Paris, the lives of three individuals intertwine through business and investigations. First is Yoshiaki Hongo, a polyglot and the son of a well-traveled Japanese banker, working as a "broker" or "property dealer." Narcissistic in nature, he enjoys bodybuilding and sculpting his physique, a contrast to his lack of endurance in intimate situations with women. Rintaro Norimizu, a former member of the Japanese Self-Defense Force and a ex-soldier of the Foreign Legion, engaged in combat in Chad and served as a mercenary in Libya, now offering his services to the highest bidder. Lastly, there's Fuchi, a Vietnamese of Chinese origin, a fashion magazine model, who escaped Saigon in a helicopter at the age of five and uses her charms to achieve her goals. Through four independent investigations, we follow the misadventures of these unconventional characters, sometimes at odds and sometimes destined to collaborate.

(Source: Pika Édition, translated)

title: Koi ni Naru ni wa Yayakoshii
title_english: It's Complicated to Fall in Love
title_japanese: 恋になるにはややこしい
synopsis:
The most popular guy at school has his heart set on someone... and it's me?!

On behalf of his twin sister, Tsuzumi, Chikage asks Issei out, a popular honor student at his school. Not wanting Issei to date his sister, he approaches him hoping to get rejected. To his shock and dismay, Issei accepts the confession! Furious, Chikage plays along and the two start going out—all while pretending to be Tsuzumi. As their relationship progresses, Chikage learns more about the unexpected sides of Issei, and little by little, he begins to let his guard down around him. Then one day, Chikage discovers the truth behind his confession...!

(Source: Leed-sha, translated)

title: Melting Slowly
synopsis:
Yeomin Chae has been living in the shadow of her stepsister, Nari Chae, ever since they were kids. One day, Seungjae, Yeomin's ex-boyfriend, tells her that he's marrying Nari out of the blue. After being betrayed by the person she trusted most, she runs into Hwan Yun, who is the grandson of Taeju Group's chairman. Frustrated with her life, she suggests to Hwan that he marry her. As the two decide to get married, what exciting events and struggles will they encounter?

Ao is a poor omega who works part-time jobs to get by. One day, he finds a job as a test subject for heat suppressants! But when he shows up at the company, he suddenly gets his virginity stolen by a beautiful man! That man had instantly realized that Ao was an omega even though his stern face led others to think he was a beta. He even became Ao's stalker, but he was actually Sakuya Nishina, the pharmaceutical company's representative! Ao obtains suppressants under the condition that he allows Sakuya to try and seduce him. Will Ao be swept away by the intense love attack of the top alpha elite Sakuya?

title_japanese: 王都の外れの錬金術師 ～ハズレ職業だったので、のんびりお店経営します～

Daisy dreamed of becoming a powerful mage like the rest of her prestigious family—but at her baptism, she's blessed with the so-called useless job of Alchemist. She braces for pity instead of praise...but to her surprise, she's met with love, encouragement, and a shiny new set of alchemy tools.

With a rare Appraisal skill and an endless curiosity for crafting, Daisy sets out to master her new role one potion at a time. Her bright, carefree future as an overpowered alchemist is just beginning!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Outo no Hazure no Renkinjutsushi: Hazure Shokugyou Datta node, Nonbiri Omise Keiei shimasu

Daisy's new life is already a world apart from the last. Once cast out for a "worthless" job and left to die alone, she's now the cherished daughter of a viscount—with a rare skill, a loving family, and a future that's finally hers to shape.

Sure, she's been saddled with the "undesirable" job of Alchemist again, but things couldn't be more different this time. With her Appraisal ability, the blessing of the spirits, and brand-new alchemy tools at her side, Daisy is ready to turn her second chance into something truly magical.

Before long, she's brewing potions for kingdoms, gathering rare materials with ease, and still finding time to bake fresh bread.

This time, the overpowered alchemist is going to make sure her future shines bright!

Sugaru, a remote village that doesn’t even appear on any maps. In this village, there were daughters of a family that inherited the power of a god for more than a thousand years. They were called "Sugaru-sama" and ruled the village for generations.

In 1985, a girl who was a candidate to be Sugaru-sama's successor is found dead with her head cut off. Detective Misasagi Mikage, a beautiful girl with a jade left eye wearing a suikan, takes on the case. Mikage, whose mother is a legendary detective, discovers facts that the police have overlooked one after another and seems to be getting to the bottom of the matter. Despite her intentions to keep her feelings a secret, her body goes into heat, which is a phenomenon that was thought to have disappeared long ago. Even as a researcher in his thirties, Hasumi cannot think rationally in this situation. This is an omegaverse story about two people who love each other being brought together.

When the infamy of the Demon King echoes to the ocean's depths, Yuria, the king of the sea, decides to venture onto land and challenge them. However, the very act of gaining two legs robs her of all her power, transforming her into a helpless child. Now faced with this unexpected twist of fate, can Yuria rise above this setback and defeat the Demon King to claim her place as the most powerful being in the world?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: After Killing You
synopsis:
Mismatched lovers Eunsung and Hyunwoo face a bizarre twist of fate. When Hyunwoo abruptly ends their relationship, Eunsung finds himself committing the darkest of crimes. However, Eunsung wakes up in a world where the cold body in his arms isn't Hyunwoo's and instead, he's the one who's been killed... In this surreal switch, Eunsung realizes a chilling truth—their destinies are entwined in a dark cycle of love and murder. Despite this deadly paradox, Eunsung still believes they are meant to be together, and this time he won't let anything get in his way...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Loop kara Nukedasenai Akuyaku Reijou wa, Akiramete Sukikatte Ikiru Koto ni Kimemashita

Selene Vixent has died nine times. In every life, she's been betrayed by her fiancé, abused by her noble family, and laid low by an untimely end all because she was unable to awaken the power of Sun, a so-called protective gift passed down in her family. Yet Selene is determined to escape this cursed time loop and, after her ninth demise, abandons any further attempts to be a good girl. She awakens to the power of Shadow—seen as an ominous portent of misfortune—and fully embraces her new life as a villainess. But Selene's dark path is about to take another strange turn when Dier Veldt, the former crown prince, reveals that he knows all about her time loop. He even offers his help, but under one condition: she must kill him in exchange. With her newfound villainy, can Selene break free of this endless time loop once and for all?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Nonke Joushi, 30-nichi no Kaihatsu Method

After a near-death experience during an undercover investigation, police officer Wu Yu is transferred to a new district where he can continue fighting crime under a lower profile. But keeping the city safe doesn't come easy when he is constantly at odds with Captain Bu Chonghua, his superior in the force who desperately wants him gone. The head honcho may not be impressed with his blasé attitude, but Wu Yu learns that there is more to Captain Bu than meets the eye as the two embark on a series of drug busts, murder investigations, and even cases involving the supernatural. While foiling sinister plots and uncovering dangerous secrets, together, these total opposites must put aside their differences in the name of justice, and perhaps they'll find common ground along the way.

Mirai, on the other hand, has repeatedly stayed in school and spends his days doing nothing. Mirai is kicked out of his parent's house and moves into Hotaru's apartment, but life with Hotaru, who has grown up before him, is not as cordial as it was when they were students... He hates Hotaru now. One day, Mirai can no longer accept the "boring" Hotaru, but something changes when a drunken Hotaru kisses him. He tells himself that it's all Hotaru's fault, and he ends up holding him in his arms.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Dice Roll!

Born with bad luck, Chiyuki is prone to encountering all sorts of "bad things," from minor misfortunes to life-threatening situations. Despite this, she somehow manages to avoid any major accidents and is able to enter high school. Having grown up naturally shy, making friends is a tall order for her. However, Miho, the captain of the Adventurer's Guild Club, hears rumors about her and invites her to join the club and play tabletop RPGs... What fate will Chiyuki's roll of the dice reveal?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Until the Tragic Male Lead Walks Again

Countless marriage proposal rejections are nothing for Lamille Claude, a newly reincarnated character in the dark fantasy novel "The Broken Sword." Her mission is to prevent the male lead, Roel Arnen, from succumbing to all his misery and becoming the story's villain. To do so, she'll need to bring him under her protection as her husband until he regains the ability to use his legs and reclaims his former glory. But it isn't easy considering Roel's reluctance to accept Lamille's confessions of love. Will Lamille be able to win Roel's heart in time to save him from his tragic fate?

(Source: Tappytoon)

The year is 158 AD, and the Roman Empire thrives under the 20th year of Emperor Antoninus Pius’s reign. Lucius, a Roman bathhouse architect, is now sixty years old and plagued with back pain. When he regained consciousness, he finds himself in an unfamiliar world where he has been reincarnated as Hawk Gold, a woman-loving, obese child of a wealthy family with no morals whatsoever, perhaps due to his spoiled upbringing. He began keeping his distance from the women who flock to him for money and power, including his beautiful maid, younger sister, and fiancée in this second life he was suddenly forced to live. Adopted by Archduke Credel, Bunnie bears a curse mark instead of his beloved daughter, Ophelia, to die at the age of 18 in her place. Abused and detested, Bunnie refuses to allow for a similar death. Using her people-reading skills, Bunnie fights to clear her name and prove her worth—all in the hopes of escaping before she reaches adulthood.

Eiko Ichikawa, a staff employee at a toy company, inconspicuously handles the necessary work for the company on a daily basis. One day, her manager points out a mistake and scolds her. The absurdity of being told off for a single mistake when she normally performs her job without appreciation... Eiko feels crushed, but the manager's right-hand man, Bandou, saw what happened and invites her out for a meal. Eiko is nervous about what he might tell her, but contrary to her fears, Bandou praises her a lot! That being said, his "praise" is a little strange...?

He happens to stumble upon a job posting for a live-in position at a detective agency, but the employer is Torano Jiu, a mighty tiger beastman! One is Conan Watson, a college student who dreams of becoming a doctor and has just left the countryside for the first time in several years. And the other is Arthur Holmes, an eccentric young man who calls himself an inventor and is driven by his own curiosity. The two of them ended up living together because of a mischief of fate or something else that happened. After a certain incident unfolds in London, he gets caught up in a number of mysterious incidents. Conan witnesses the inferences drawn from Arthur's genius observation eye.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Because he turned 30, Tsukasa then receives a "Body Remake Application" notification... It seems that recent research has allowed for humans to freely remake their bodies after the age of 30. Tsukasa gives it a shot and remakes his entire body to that of a woman's—but after going home—he finds out that his wife Subaru (30) underwent the same procedure and is now a man?! With their minds unchanged and their bodies reversed, the couple begins their second life together!!

As he moves on with that slight advantage, he finds out that there are others who are getting the same message as him. Will he be able to find his family? And where are the messages in his head coming from?

One day, elementary school student Kei Nimori witnesses his name suddenly written on the blackboard in the classroom along with the mysterious word "Houkagogakari"... In the peculiar school called "Houkagogakari," where monsters are recorded and suppressed at the risk of their lives, the "midnight fairy tale" of boys and girls is now unlocked.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Ako Ootsuki is a 29-year-old virgin who has been missing the right moment for a long time and is getting impatient. On her 30th birthday, she is invited by a man she has been interested in. She lost her virginity and at the same time she was dumped and hit rock bottom...

"I'll never have sex again."

That's what Ako decided. However, a junior colleague at work, Nitta, asked her to go out with him, "Let's go out with each other on that condition." She can't believe it. But he keeps coming on to her...?

A clumsy, sweet, and just barely less than sexual office love story begins!

Struggling against the creature's power, Jacque seeks help from Terius, only to be shocked by a surprising demand—the devil king insists on subjecting Jacque to the same fate, citing the necessity of releasing tentacle poison. As uncertainty about Terius's true intentions grows, Jacque grapples with the challenge of preserving his once-peaceful life as a servant in the devil's tower.

One day for their art club meeting ("full of jerks like Joohyuk," Eun-oh would say), Joohyuk asks—or rather, commands that Eun-oh hire a model for their nude sketches. Will Rosé be able to take her revenge, or will her imperial past haunt her royal future?

Amidst the flames of war writhing with conspiracy and resentment, a makeshift team of four girl-type mimics was formed. Their name: Mimicry Girls. Shooting, CQC, infiltration. Aika Ito, is 27 years old. She and Shinya, a high school classmate, got married after 10 years of dating and soon ended up pregnant. Though things were smooth sailing, Shinya was assigned to work abroad, forcing the two to live in separate countries. After giving birth, Aika visits Shinya for the first time, but when she meets him again, she's met with a cold attitude. Aika is perplexed by the sudden change in her husband. It was in that moment that her husband's colleague, 22-year-old Mona, a local woman, comes to visit...

With almost no budget, he'd resorted to digging through back issues and unused research material, looking for inspiration. As he did, a terrifying truth began to emerge about a certain place in the Kinki region. I have collected the relevant articles, interviews, and other excerpts in this book. And once you have understood everything, I would like to ask for your cooperation. I hope you will get in touch.

Upon finding out that he has been played by the emperor, Yahn vows vengeance, but he falls to the mighty emperor's powers. However, instead of dying, Yahn opens his eyes to find that he has gone back in time, to when he used to be a soldier in training. Will he now seek vengeance on the emperor, or will he go look for his family? The choice is now in his hands.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

If they complete their mission, they can return to their original world. However, this new world is filled with terrifying monsters... Can they survive and return to their original world?! The survival game for humanity's salvation on the line has begun...!

Fueled by the resentment of an unknown past, this journey unravels hidden identities, embarks on undercover missions, faces death trials, navigates through betrayals, and wades through bloodbaths. What do the shadows conceal, and what destiny awaits in the heart of the unknown?

When Bongsoo's plans to form an emotional connection go awry as Jiwon responds with a naughty proposition, the innocent and naïve Bongsoo is caught completely off guard. How will Bongsoo handle the sudden onset of sexy workplace flirting?

Before her reincarnation, she had favored the prince's knight escort instead of the prince who was the love interest. As it was a rare opportunity, she was hoping to get the knight escort to fall in love with her while helping her sister. However, he is not interested in Lobelia at all. Will Lobelia be able to reach a happy ending?

synopsis:
One year after the events at the Sanctuary, Subaru Natsuki trains hard to better face future challenges. The peaceful days come to an end when Emilia receives an invitation to a meeting in the Watergate City of Priestella from none other than Anastasia Hoshin, one of her rivals in the royal selection. Considering the meeting's significance and the potential dangers Emilia could face, Subaru and his friends accompany her.

However, as Subaru reconnects with old associates and companions in Priestella, new formidable foes emerge. Driven by fanatical motivations and engaging in ruthless methods to achieve their ambitions, the new enemy targets Emilia and threaten the very existence of the city. Rallying his allies, Subaru must give his all once more to stop their nefarious goals from becoming a concrete reality.

title: Haibara-kun no Tsuyokute Seishun New Game
title_japanese: 灰原くんの強くて青春ニューゲーム

We all have embarrassing memories or deep regrets from high school, right? Socially anxious college senior Natsuki Haibara sure does. When he thinks back on that time of his life, all he has are fleeting fantasies of a happy adolescence that could have been. Imagine his bewilderment and surprise, then, when he inexplicably finds himself seven years in the past—one month before his first year of high school! Can Haibara avoid his previous mistakes, make his way to the top of the school social pyramid, and end up with the girl of his dreams? Or will he be forced to relive three years of solitude as the most hated guy in school? He'll need all the help he can get in order to succeed, from a workout regimen to online how-to guides, a childhood friend, and plenty of sheer willpower. Watch as Haibara takes a second shot at his teenage years!

To live a normal life, she makes sure to hide her face when she enters dimensional gates and clears dungeons. But when her cover gets blown one day, she becomes the center of a bidding war among the world's top guilds. As she goes on more perilous missions with her identity exposed, she wonders if she'll ever get to live a normal life again.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Otogibanashi wa Awa to Kie
synopsis:
The manager of the ramen store, Oka, and the son of a Yakuza family, Akemi, have been sex-friends since they graduated high school. The two won't admit that they have feelings for each other as Oka drags the memories of his first love and Akemi keeps people at a distance because of his family. Knowing that this fleeting relationship has to end one day, what will become of these two when Oka's first love visits his ramen shop...?

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

title: Shishunki Kyoudai
synopsis:
Yousuke Hino is thinking about when to start using "ore" instead of "boku." Recently, he's been worrying about the fact that he can't beat his twin sister Mikage at anything. In height, grades, and sports, Yousuke feels like she has him completely beat, and as a result has become uncomfortable around girls. He wanted to change things since becoming a second year middle school student, but...

(Source: Wani Books, translated)

title: Übel Blatt II: Shiseru Ou no Kishidan
title_english: Übel Blatt II: Knights of the Fallen King
title_japanese: Übel Blatt Ⅱ 死せる王の騎士団
synopsis:
The new manga is set one year after the final battle with Glenn, with Elseria crowned the empress of an empire that is now chaotic and filled with dissidents. Köinzell, now Lord Viceroy Ascheriit, is assisting Elseria with stabilizing the empire, alongside the imperial general Geranpen, his chief official Ato, and the Blatt Meister Ikfes. In the Empire's southern frontier, a new threat emerges in the form of The Knights of the Fallen King, remnant loyalists of Glenn who believe in his eventual return, and are sowing unrest in the empire's far reaches.

(Source: ANN)

title: SKK: Shoujo-tachi no Sekai
synopsis:
In a mysterious world devoid of humans, Katana, Saya, and Kodachi are three inseparable friends. Their days are filled with laughter and games in the eerie quiet. But beneath this calm, an obscure presence lurks in the shadows...?! From the creator of Muto to Satou, Akatsuka-sensei, comes a new, uncharted adventure—innocence meets mystery in a world unknown!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title_japanese: 底辺ハンターが【リターン】スキルで現代最強 ～前世の知識と死に戻りを駆使して、人類最速レベルアップ～
synopsis:
Monsters suddenly appear in the world from gates and dungeons, and Asuto Yuuki becomes a hunter who awakens to his skills. However, no matter what he did, his skill "Return" wouldn't activate, and it was supposed to be useless. Until he meets his doomed future. By making full use of his "Return" skill, which allows him to return at any time after death, Asuto aims to become a stronger hunter than anyone else. All in order to defeat the worst monster that will destroy the capital in 10 years.

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)

title: Corrupting the Heroine's First Love
synopsis:
In a land overshadowed by darkness, Karina Apocalita rises as a formidable figure, her being a tapestry of power from a diverse race. Her destiny intertwines with Reneiger, a knight from the virtuous Latem order, known for justice and as the former love of a legendary heroine. Their paths take an unforeseen turn when Karina, unaware of her impact, saves Reneiger's life. This act, challenging his convictions, triggers a crisis within him, tarnishing his once radiant aura and precipitating a fall from grace.

Faced with his altered fate, Reneiger prays for forgiveness, realizing his escape from Karina's shadow is but a dream. This pivotal moment raises a haunting question: will Reneiger rediscover the light, or be consumed by the darkness emanating from Karina?

(Source: WordExcerpt)

synopsis:
Hansel and Gretel are two siblings that live in a distorted fairy tale world. They hunt monsters for a living while searching for a wizard called "The Black Hand."

title: The Egoistic Courtship
synopsis:
As the last of the divine beasts who protected the land, Lionel Milliard was coveted by women for his power and influence. But after an accident with an ancient relic binds him to an inn worker named Hanna, he finally finds one woman with no interest in him! Lionel, intrigued by Hanna's rejection, convinces her to go on a journey with him to free them of the relic's power. Hanna reluctantly agrees, but will she be able to fend off Lionel's advances, or will this beast devour yet another woman?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Around 40 Boukensha, Densetsu to Naru: SS-Rank no Musume ni Kyouka saretara SSS-Rank ni Narimashita
title_japanese: アラフォー冒険者、伝説となる ～SSランクの娘に強化されたらSSSランクになりました～
synopsis:
One day, Wollfe, an average adventurer, is entrusted with a mysterious baby. Through the retirement funds Wolffe has, the girl—Reminia—quickly grows to be a strong heroine and is called to serve in the royal palace as a "woman of valor." Worried about living so far away from her father, Reminia increases all of Wollfe's physical attack, physical defense, magical defense, speed, and auto-recovery stats to MAX. It's then that the success story about a common old man who becomes a legendary adventurer begins!

(Source: Flex Comix, translated)

title: Ego Eris: Kendo no Chi
title_japanese: エゴ・エリス－剣奴の血－
synopsis:
The year is 75 CE in the ancient Roman Empire. Imprisoned in the Colosseum is a criminal named Aaron. Aaron has been deemed a criminal to be killed for the amusement of the citizenry, but he is burdened by the fate to never die.

Let the historical spectacle begin!!!

(Source: Nihon Bungeisha, translated)

title: Nisshoku Stereo Sound
title_japanese: 日食ステレオサウンド
synopsis:
A novelist who left behind a single masterpiece 44 years ago before cutting all contact with the world, and the young painter who met him.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: All Football Talents Are Mine
synopsis:
Ho-yeong dreamed of becoming a professional football player. But God didn't give him the talent, and he died by a lightning strike without achieving his dream. Then, the demon Mammon appeared and gave him the ability to steal the talent of other players.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Sekai de Ichiban Utsukushii Ryuu ni Ai ni Iku

title: Ai de Tokashite Uruoshite
synopsis:
President of the gaming club at his college, Jun Kanamori is a hot guy among a sea of gaming geeks. Jun has always derived genuine joy from being fawned over by the other members in his club. That is... until Sota Shinonome joins the club!!

Sota is a cocky and hot freshman who Jun later discovers lives right next door to him. To blow off some steam after a slump in subscribers on his game streaming channel, Jun decides to stream on an adult website for other men, but in the middle of his show, the last person he would expect unlocks his door and walks right in on him...!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Boukensha Zettai Korosu Dungeon
title_japanese: 冒険者絶対殺すダンジョン
synopsis:
Dungeons—marvelous labyrinths packed full of dreams where heroes gather in search of fame and fortune. Unfortunately, Eine and Nacht can't say they feel the same. While all the other reincarnated earthlings get to live out awesome isekai fantasies, the two of them are stuck slaving away as dungeon staff! And whether those inconsiderate adventurers win or lose, a messy pile of corpses will need tidying up. But if the two are disposing of bodies anyway...then what's a few more? Why not make their workplace a terrifying deathtrap from which none ever return? Maybe then they'd finally have some peace and quiet!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Sokuochi Lolibabaa
synopsis:

2. Kyouju to Bakeneko (The Professor and the Bakeneko)

4. Anata no Sei desu yo (It's all your fault)
5. Oyasumi Grenadine (Sweet Dreams Grenadine)
6. Sokuochi Lolibabaa (Instant Loss Lolibabaa)

title: My Beloved Oppressor
synopsis:
When the hand that used to so lovingly hold Annette Rozenberg ends up being the one that causes the downfall of her family, Annette demands that Heiner Waldemar give her a divorce. But Heiner refuses, stating that he must see her miserable by his side, no matter what. At odds, the two continue a precarious relationship, only to be met with wounds of the past that bring them tragically together.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Heaven's Door: Kanojo no Saigo no Natsu

title: Shouwaru Tensai Osananajimi to no Shoubu ni Makete Hatsutaiken wo Zenbu Ubawareru Hanashi
title_english: Farewell, My Firsts: How My Heartless Childhood Friend Stole All My First Experiences One Bet at a Time
title_japanese: 性悪天才幼馴染との勝負に負けて初体験を全部奪われる話
synopsis:
Every time I lose to the girl I hate, my true feelings are exposed—Wakaba Yoshizawa's childhood friend is absolutely perfect. She is an honor student who is gifted in both beauty and intelligence... or so it appears on the surface. In reality, she's a mean-spirited girl who looks down on others. In my desperation to beat Komaki, I bet my most precious thing—my dignity. In the end, I lost.

"Wakaba, kiss me of your own volition."

My first kiss was taken. I try to challenge Komaki again to reclaim my dignity, but she adds a new condition: each time I lose a bet, Komaki will take another of my firsts. My first date, my first confession of love, my first time sleeping in the same bed as someone else. I should feel hatred towards Komaki, who stole everything from me. But what are these emotions that flood into the hole left in my heart from all of my stolen firsts?

(Source: Kakuyomu, translated)

title: Cardfight!! Vanguard: will+Dress D2
title_japanese: カードファイト!! ヴァンガード will+Dress D2
synopsis:
Mukae Jinki has gathered 15 fighters, and one who was chosen from winning all the Shop Tournaments. These 16 fighters will fight for the throne to be the strongest, as the curtain for the Second Deluxe opens!! Who will be the one to control the fight, who will be the one to win!?

(Source: Bushiroad, translated)

title: Futari no Konyakusha ni Dekiai sarete
title_japanese: 二人の婚約者に溺愛されて
synopsis:
Café barista Hinako Hayase lives with her handsome fiancé Seiya Kagaya, a hotshot lawyer she met in her coffee shop. He's everything she could ever want in a future husband: sweet, caring, and handy in the kitchen as well as the bedroom. But just when she thinks it's all smooth sailing, her loving partner transforms from a gentleman into a tyrant overnight! He may look the same on the outside, but he's not the Seiya she knows and loves...so who is he?!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Haikei Mishiranu Dannasama, Rikon shite Itadakimasu
title_english: To Sir, without Love: I'm Divorcing You
title_japanese: 拝啓見知らぬ旦那様、離婚していただきます
synopsis:
Byletta, daughter of a viscount who has talents for swords and business, has been married to Arnald, son of a count, for eight years...however, he was away at war, and they hadn't met even once. When the war ended, she decides to ask for divorce even before she sees his face. She writes Arnald a letter saying "Dear Sir, I would like to ask for divorce." Arnald, handsome but had never loved someone, and Byletta, who was rumored to be a villainess, meet for the first time in their bedroom. He asks for a wager, and guarantees her that he will divorce if Byletta wins. If he wins, they will stay married forever. "If I can get you with child in a month, I win." Arnald says. That was something Byletta could never imagine.

(Source: Kadokawa)

title: Healing the Duke of Darkness
synopsis:
To flee from her abusive family, Evelyn Diego pretends to be a goddess from a prophecy and tricks the blind Grand Duke Devan Lantimos into believing she can lift his curse. Unfortunately, her powers fail to heal him completely, and things get even more complicated as she discovers that Devan's curse isn't quite what she thought it was. With time running out and her family looking for her, will Evelyn be able to cure Devan and get the freedom she so desperately wants?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Jigoku Kurayami Hana mo Naki
title_english: Hell Is Dark with No Flowers
title_japanese: 地獄くらやみ花もなき
synopsis:
Seiji Toono sometimes sees the people around him as monsters. It is a curse that had driven him to a life of despair, living out of internet cafés with nowhere to call home...but all that changes one twilit evening when he stumbles across a huge European mansion. There, Seiji meets a bewitchingly beautiful boy dressed in a kimono with a white peony motif on the shoulder, who introduces himself as Shiroshi Saijou. This mysterious young man seems to know more about Seiji than he does himself, and before he knows it, Seiji has agreed to become Shiroshi's assistant in exchange for room and board. Little does he know, however, this "proxy service," as Shiroshi puts it, is none other than outsourced death! Sending monster-possessed sinners to Hell, will bring Seiji face-to-face with terrifying new creatures each and every day!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Harapeko Kopeko wa Niku to Sumu!
title_japanese: 腹ぺここぺ子はニクと棲む!
synopsis:
A new and exciting law of the jungle comedy about Kopeko, an unknown creature, and Ef, her intended foodstuff.

Kopeko, a creature kept segregated in a mysterious facility, has lived a life of daily feeding. All of a sudden, a girl named Ef is brought before her. Kopeko is bewildered by the sudden change in her environment, but realizing Ef is to be her prey, she pounces...!?

(Source: Kill Time Communications, translated)

title: Motto Motto Dakishimete Motto Motto Kiss wo Shite

synopsis:
Koko works at a professional "spooning" service where her usual customers are older men. She never really enjoyed the work but she bears through it for the pay. But one day, an attractive woman comes to her inquiring for her services. This client is definitely different from the others and when they are together, it feels different too. It actually feels good? Koko never experienced this with her previous clients and this is the first time she looks forward to a session. Even after their time together, it leaves Koko wanting more...

(Source: Lilyka)

title: Kenshin to Matei no Musuko wa Date ja Nai

serializations: Suiyoubi wa Mattari Dash X Comic
synopsis:
The world's most skilled sword god (♂) and witch empress (♀), who had saved people many times, fought fiercely in order to test each other's strength. And then, when all of a sudden they decided to marry, they suddenly disappeared. Three years later, in the Demon Forest, which is said to be the graveyard of adventurers, there were a couple and their son, Ryuku. Having inherited his parents' talents, Ryuku sets out on a journey alone.

Strongest x Strongest = Super Strongest!!! The fantasy adventure of a boy with unnaturally strong powers starts here!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

Mii-chan is no good. She can't do what everyone else can do. At school, her friend Akemi-chan always throws buckets of water on her. Then one day, she meets Mike-kun, who is playing a game on the rooftop...

title_english: How to Deal When Your Intimidating Neighbor Is Actually an Omega

synopsis:
College student Kouta Enatsu is somewhat strange compared to his fellow alpha peers. Despite having many of the superior characteristics typical of the secondary sex, he is unable to smell pheromones and does not understand why all of his friends are obsessed with omegas—people whose secondary sex causes them to go into heats, which make them irresistible to alphas. Kouta instead longs for the days when they could just talk about baseball. But all of this changes when he smells incredibly intense pheromones on the other side of his apartment wall.

Thinking his tough-looking neighbor brought an omega home, Kouta leaves the area to give them some alone time. However, he is shocked when he discovers that despite his tough looks, his neighbor is an omega who is dealing with a powerful heat. Kouta steps up and does what he can to help but is left wondering how their relationship will evolve afterward.

synopsis:
Saeki is an ordinary high school boy with a girlfriend, Sara, who is the heiress of the Saionji Group, and whose beauty and intelligence are the envy of everyone.

Sara seems like a prim and proper young lady to other people, but the two share a secret! Because of the secret, Saeki can't fully commit, but Sara prepares lunch for him, she hugs him to deepen their relationship, and she acts like she's trying to seduce Saeki to corrupt him!!!?

What is the secret of their relationship and what is Sara's true purpose...!!? A love comedy about a young lady disguising herself, and a boy in an enviable situation!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Golden Man
synopsis:
Golden Man, the great hero who protected Neo York, has suddenly vanished from the city of freedom! At the scene of his disappearance, an abnormally strong young man with amnesia has collapsed. In their hero's absence, Golden Man's support team sends the young man out in his place to confront the villains that menace the city. However, this man has a secret, and it might just threaten the peace of Neo York...!!

(Source: Yen Press)

synopsis:
With both my parents passing away early on, I've spent my days working to support my younger brothers and sisters. One of the few things that helped me through this was fawning over my favorite character from a mobile game, and my boss, who happens to be the handsome and talented producer that created said game. But, one day he found out about my secret part-time job. If I'm fired, I can't pay the bills. If I can't pay the bills, we'll be out on the street...!!! But instead of exposing me, he makes me an offer. The deal? Become his housekeeper. I didn't think that would include putting him to bed though...?!

(Source: NTT Solmare Corporation)

title: Maou no Inori ga Kanau Toki

The gloomy Demon King and the happy-go-lucky Hero go on a journey through a post-apocalyptic world.

title: Kodomo Dorobou
synopsis:
Minori is the only daughter of the Sano family, a family that is the picture of happiness. One day, Minori returns home after cheerfully forgetting something as usual, and encounters a burglar who has been breaking into the house. She falls from the balcony, and to her surprise, she and the thief switch bodies! Until they get each other's bodies back, they begin a strange four-person life: father, mother, daughter, and thief. A disturbing, heartwarming comedy begins!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

I use the hero who fiercely loves me, and in this world I aim to live long!

"Please, use me."

Lizette, a count's daughter, is a "recaller," or a holder of previous lives' memories, and she is on her fourth life. In her past lives, always on her 20th birthday, she would be killed and eaten by the same demon. So to live a long life in this one, Lizette retreated to a remote countryside sanctuary, where monsters don't appear, living quietly and peacefully.

However, one day, she, once again, met a boy whom she saved in her childhood, Ralph. Somehow, he had become the country's hero, who toppled a demonic king.

If it may be possible to avoid death by Ralph's side... With this in mind, Lizette accepted his proposal.

"Even if your life is switched, I will always protect you, Miss Lizette."

While bewildered by Ralph's exceedingly heavy affection, Lizette approaches the truth of her repeating deaths. Will Lizette be able to live pass her 20th birthday unharmed this time?!

From now, the s

title: Wakeari Hakushaku-sama to Keiyaku Kekkon shitara, Gijou (Rokusai) no Keiyaku Haha ni Natteshimaimashita.

synopsis:
Maria Martini, the daughter of a baroness, is contractually married to Count Ricardo Ricœur for one year only.

Ricardo's wife has been unfaithful to him and left him, and he has been repeatedly honey-trapped by women who want to marry him again. Maria's role was supposed to be a cover to protect him, but during the course of their life together, Ricardo's behavior became strange. The first thing that comes to mind is that Ricardo's stepdaughter, Lydia, is very interested in her new mommy.

A contractual marriage begins a too-happy married life.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: My High School Romance
synopsis:
"Don't date my brother, date me."

Seunghyun hates losing, and so does Yujin. Afraid of losing his brother to Yujin, Seunghyun asks him out. And Yujin, wanting to make Seunghyun suffer, accepts. What could possibly go wrong? More importantly, who's gonna win?!

(Source: Manta)

title: Imouto ga Onna Kishi Gakuen ni Nyuugaku shitara Nazeka Kyuukoku no Eiyuu ni Narimashita. Boku ga.
title_english: After My Sister Enrolling in Girl Knights' School, I Become a HERO.
title_japanese: 妹が女騎士学園に入学したらなぜか救国の英雄になりました。ぼくが。
