synopsis: This is the story of a man and woman who switched bodies and remain switched even after they become adults.

title: The Reborn Young Lord Is an Assassin
title_english: The Reborn Young Lord Is an Assassin
synopsis:
Cyan Vert, illegitimate son of the duke and the empire's greatest assassin, is betrayed by the righteous brother whose shadow he's always lived in. But just before the fatal blow strikes his throat, Cyan awakes to find he's just a boy again. The young lord has been reborn, and this time, he's not going to live in anyone's shadow!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Act Like a Boss Monster, Mr. Swallow!
title_english: Act Like a Boss Monster, Mr. Swallow!
synopsis:
The Primordial Core's an unconquerable dungeon, the lair of the most powerful monster ever to exist, the Original Monster, the incarnation of evil—Swallow... who happens to be a lazy boss monster who just wants to sleep. Taking care of this lazy bum is Renee, a homunculus maid whose obsession with Swallow knows no bounds. At this point, the only one keeping the dungeon running is Patrick, the last brain cell of the bunch—and he's a skeleton! Will Mr. Swallow get any rest amid all this chaos?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Married to a Duke Called Beast
title_english: Married to a Duke Called Beast
synopsis:
Nadia Lancaster is the youngest daughter of a humble baron, and a proposal from the infamous Duke Staton was the last thing she was expecting. Afraid to refuse such a powerful man in the empire, she is forced to accept despite the chilling rumors that swirl around him. Before she knows it, it's their wedding night and her mind is filled with nothing but anxiety. Will Nadia be able to look past the rumors and give her new husband a chance, or does she found out that he really is a bloodthirsty beast and live out the rest of her marriage life in constant fear?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Yoiyami Sugar Cat
title_japanese: 宵闇シュガーキャット
synopsis:
A super-elite office worker, Kayahara, does not want to hire any more female housekeepers. Every time he hires, it ends with her confessing her love to him, which is just annoying. And Kayahara does not have good experience with ex-girlfriends. So, when he finds a male housekeeper on the internet, he jumps at the chance to try. Kayahara is pleased to find that the new housekeeper, Sho, is a good cook, and a cat drawing on his message card is so cute. A few weeks later, Sho finds a vibrator under the bed. Kayahara does not know its existence as the toy belongs to his ex-girlfriend. He is embarrassed when Sho hands it out to him, but at the same time he notices something at Sho's reaction. Kayahara starts to wonder if Sho is gay. And he starts to imagine that Sho might use that item to masturbate...

(Source: Takeshobo)

title: Sensei wa Gochisou
synopsis:
Maki, who is actually a vampire, can only live as long as he sucks blood. When his uptight teacher, Kojima, finds out that he is a vampire, Maki makes a move assuming that he's a virgin because he's a man, but his cute reaction makes him horny...!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Isekai Trip Sex
title_japanese: 異世界トリップセックス
synopsis:
Summoned to another world to be the consort of a king?? What will happen in the other world "sex" trip? The King, may not be who everyone thought he was.

(Source: MU)

title: Otaku Baachan
synopsis:
The daily life of a grandma who had been captivated by 2D characters and became an otaku even after turning 80, and her grandson who kindly watches over while trying to keep a straight face! An "old age x fandom" gag comedy!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kimi wa Kawaii Reptile
title_japanese: きみはかわいいれぷたいる
synopsis:
Itsuki, twenty-seven years old, owns a reptile shop. He enjoyed life, surrounded by many kinds of lizards. Taking care of them is what makes him happy. He had no interest in human girls...he never had a girlfriend in his life. However...his favorite lizard, Fuu (Central Bearded Dragon), turned into a human girl! Now Itsuki has to feed her, bathe her, and help her with molting! A love comedy of a shy boy and lizard-girls!

(Source: Kadokawa)

title: Hoshi no Kirby: Pupupu Hero
title_japanese: 星のカービィ プププヒーロー
synopsis:
Kirby, the gourmand who will suck up anything, has come to the peaceful land of Pupupu!

"Pleased to eat you! I'm Kirby!"

The slapstick and lively days are about to begin, involving Chilly, who has come to live with Kirby!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Sensei! Bokutachi ga Sekai wo Horoboshimasu.
title_english: Teacher, We Will Destroy the World!
title_japanese: 先生! 僕たちが世界を滅ぼします。
synopsis:
Teachers are entrusted with the sacred duty of guiding and protecting their students—but not undercover assassin Mr. Solo. In a world where magic users and non-users coexist, he walks a solitary path as the wizard hitman "Number Zero." His latest mission: pose as a magic instructor for the unruly, bottom-tier, second-year students of Class D. To complicate things, he's saddled with a new partner—a transfer student with the same deadly assignment. As they pursue dangerous student targets, unexpected twists arise in this exciting magic school fantasy!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Carefully Choosing a Husband
synopsis:
After her mother's death, Elrose Basellan was cast out by her father for 14 years. With news of his passing, Elrose rushes to claim her inheritance, but can't do so unless she's married! Desperate, she prays for a husband, and the mysterious Rakshan seems to fall from the sky! They agree to a temporary union that benefits them both, but unexpected issues keep delaying their plans for divorce. Will this fake marriage become something more? Or should Elrose have chosen her husband more carefully?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Menhera to Kyuuketsuki no Kodomo
title_japanese: メンヘラと吸血鬼の子供

title: Demi-Human Share House
title_japanese: 亜人〈デミヒューマン〉シェアハウス
synopsis:
When Kei Satou, a corporate slave with low communication skills, applies to live in a share house, he thinks that it'll be a good way for him to make friends. But the other three occupants of this house seem a little different...almost monstrous even? Can Kei overcome his introversion and become friends with these supernatural girls!?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Ojisan Love Hame Wagon
title_japanese: おじさんラブハメワゴン
synopsis:
Eikichi Oonuma, a middle-aged doctor who runs a small clinic, is suddenly confessed to by a big, blond-haired delinquent and forced into a van. The man turns out to be Shinya, a deliquent Eikichi saved before. Shinya hugs him, kisses him, and in no time at all, they're living together!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Oshi no Keima-kun ni Gachikoi shitemasu
title_japanese: 推しの桂真くんにガチ恋してます
synopsis:
"All I want is to sleep with you." 

Sweet, young, and popular actor Keima Akizuki has a secret: he's actually a sharp-tongued video-game nerd! When a mysterious younger man threatens Keima with that secret, he has no choice but to pay the stranger off... with his body! Keima thinks it will be the last time he sees him until they're introduced the very next day! He's Haruto Kanzaki, a junior actor at Keima's agency, and is scheduled to star with veteran Keima in a new detective drama.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Nukunuku Seikatsu
synopsis:
1. Sannin no Shiawase na Seikatsu
2. Hinekure Mono to BSS
3. Oshiete Ageru
4. Ona-Support-sei Live
5. Aitsu ga Uchi ni Kuru Riyuu
6. Kaikan Signal
7. Otokonoko Trial
8. Soba ni Iru

title: Choudokyuu Cheat Akuyaku Reijou no Karei naru Fukushuutan
title_english: The Remarkable Revenge of a Vindictive Villainess
title_japanese: 超弩級チート悪役令嬢の華麗なる復讐譚
synopsis:
The protagonist awakens to find herself reincarnated as Lunaria il von Solfege, her beloved villainess from her favorite game. However, along with this new identity come Lunaria's tragic memories—public condemnation, complete abandonment, and ultimately, a desperate attempt to take her own life with a dagger. "You can leave everything to me, Lunaria. Now that I am you, I will never let them get away with this," she vows. The remarkable revenge of a villainess fighting for the sake of love starts here.

(Source: Kodansha)

title: Hoshikuigoroshi no Egnaro
title_japanese: 星喰い殺しのイグナロ

title: Tasogare ni Maniaeba: Akai Sashimi Sakuhinshuu
title_english: When You Run into It at Dusk: A Collection of Akai Sashimi Works
title_japanese: たそがれにまにあえば 赤井さしみ作品集
synopsis: A collection of short stories by Sashimi Akai.

title: Kurage no Uta
synopsis:
When 18-year-old Kazuma Inoue is introduced to fellow student Otoha Mizuki's trending music, he is left unsatisfied, as he would rather maintain his focus on practicing for his upcoming track and field competition. One evening while on a run, Kazuma happens to run into Otoha, and her in-person singing captures him in a way her recordings failed to. After revealing his feelings, Kazuma is surprised to learn that Otoha shares his opinion in disliking the music she records. His interest now piqued, Kazuma begins to regularly seek out Otoha and learn more about her. As the two observe their respective interests and confide in each other, Kazuma and Otoha find themselves growing more confident in their abilities and more motivated to achieve their goals.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Tsuma wo Dousoukai ni Ikasetara
title_english: After My Wife Went to a Reunion...
title_japanese: 妻を同窓会にいかせたら
synopsis: Included one-shot: Sono Wana wa Mieteita

title: Nimotsumochi no Noukin Musou
synopsis:
The more he carries, the stronger he becomes! An unmatched fantasy by the weakest adventurer duo!

Ryuk, a boy with a unique skill "Porter," which allows him to carry a massive amount of items, was being exploited as a chore boy for the S-rank party "Black Lion of Foresight." One day, the party managed to acquire a storage item more convenient than Ryuk's skill; thus no longer needed, Ryuk is banished inside a dangerous dungeon. Despairing in this hopeless situation, suddenly he meets a shrine maiden girl, Mio, and then...?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Isekai Teni shite Kyoushi ni Natta ga, Majo to Osorerareteiru Ken: Aoi-sensei no Gakuen Funtou Nisshi
title_english: The Fearsome Witch Teaches in Another World: Ms. Aoi's Lesson Plans
title_japanese: 異世界転移して教師になったが、魔女と恐れられている件 ～アオイ先生の学園奮闘日誌～
synopsis:
Stripped of her life for reasons unknown, Aoi Konominato wakes up as a child in an unfamiliar world, still haunted by regret and goals left unfulfilled. After twelve years of learning under the tutelage of an elven sage named Owain, she's mastered the art of sorcery and is sent by her wise—if eccentric—mentor to the renowned Fiddich Academy to serve as an instructor and further her studies.

Bitter memories of her past life as a fledgling teacher still nip at her heels, yet despite her initial reluctance, Aoi knows that this is her chance to do things better. Determination won't be enough, though. Between misbehaving students of noble birth and elitist instructors, Aoi may have bitten off more than she can chew...or she might just be the missing ingredient the academy needs to become a paragon of educational equality and discipline.

Class is in session, and the fearsome witch of Fiddich Academy has come prepared to teach them all a lesson they won't soon forget.

(Source: J-Novel Club

title: Moushinteki Cherry
title_english: Foolish Love Cherry Boy Will Nonstop

title: Toumei no Iro Mizu no Aji
Nobunagaverse: Nobunaga Multiverse
title_japanese: ノブナガバース NOBUNAGA MULTIVERSE
synopsis:
Nobuhiro Oda, who is descended from the Oda family, has lived an ordinary life while studying history at university. One day, a woman appears to him, claiming to be Nobunaga from a parallel world. Nobuhiro is bewildered by this bizarre turn of events. Then, a person who claims to be a "Pruner" appears and declares that he is there to fix the "existences that distort history" and is after Nobunaga's life, and the two become embroiled in a fierce battle...

(Source: Coamix, translated)

title: Horiguchi-san Chi no Reo Musuko
title_japanese: 堀口さんちのレオムスコ

title: Personal Preference
synopsis:
Ju Doeun learned from an early age that people are fickle. As a result, she's focused solely on things that don't change—for example, her family's world-famous luxury handbag label IJu. In order to clinch her succession of the company, she agrees to get engaged to a famous designer to bring him on board. However, when she becomes entangled with police detective Gu Seyoung, she finds herself developing real feelings for the first time. Can Doeun learn to let her personal preferences take over?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Price Is Your Everything
synopsis:
Transported back to her first academy days, Nerys Truydd revisits a life marred by betrayal and torment. Exploited and poisoned by her own family and husband, her demise was met with a vow to curse those who wronged her. Now granted a second chance, Nerys vows to rewrite her fate. As she navigates her past, memories of those who hurt her flood back. Determined and fueled by retribution, she seeks to reclaim all she lost. Can she overturn her tragic past and emerge victorious from the shadows of her betrayal?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Back-to-School Boss
synopsis:
Joo Sihyeon, a successful 33-year-old CEO, has decided to return to high school to get his diploma. As Sihyeon tries to find a way to balance school and work, Eun Haim is worried about her new job as the older student's homeroom teacher. Haim soon realizes that's the least of her worries, as it turns out Sihyeon is the same man she had a one-night stand with in Canada just months ago! The two thought they would never see each other again, but who knew they would meet in a classroom like this?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Xiao Mogu
synopsis:
In the year 2020, Earth's magnetic poles disappeared and humankind was nearly wiped out by cosmic radiation. Within the span of a hundred years, living creatures began to mutate and devour each other while the remaining humans, numbering in the tens of thousands, struggled bitterly in their man-made bases.

In the Abyss, home to the mutated xenogenics, there lived a sentient little mushroom. Because it had been nourished by the blood and flesh of the deceased human An Ze, not only did it take on a similar-looking human form, but a similar name as well: An Zhe.

An Zhe is determined to go to the human base to search for his spore, which had been harvested by humans. Once there, however, he faces the omnipresent risk of discovery and certain death as he tries to keep his non-human nature hidden from the Judges, whose responsibility is to inspect for and eliminate xenogenics like himself. And of all the Judges, Colonel Lu Feng is the most perceptive and merciless—as soon as he determines

title: Rikedan! Watashi ga Dokushinryou no Kanrinin ni...!?
title_japanese: リケダン! 私が独身寮の管理人に…!?
synopsis:
Dumped by her sweetheart and disappointed by unemployment, Erika Tanaka became the caretaker of a bachelor's dormitory for elite science men. However, it turns out to be a nest of unstylish science guys with zero romantic skills!?

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Zai Jian, Wo de Guo Wang
synopsis:
When Zhang Li left for a trip to the Ebiz ruins, he didn't expect to bring back company, especially not a man made of stone! Though Li grows fond of the living statue, their time together doesn't last long, as "Rocky" soon crumbles before Li's eyes. Wishing for a miracle, Li suddenly finds himself in Ebiz far back in the past and reunites with Rocky. However, his companion is no longer a statue but rather the nation's king, who doesn't recognize Li at all and imprisons him! How will Li escape this predicament and get his beloved back?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Hottarakashi Meshi
synopsis:
At 25, Fuuko's true love isn't romance; it's food. Her path to cooking begins with a lucky bingo win—a nifty rice cooker! But with her kitchen occupied by her pet hermit crab, Hikki, Fuko has to get creative... Cooking with only a rice cooker?! Challenge accepted! Join Fuuko as she steams ahead in this lazy gourmet adventure!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Gal Maid to Akuyaku Reijou: Ojousama no Happy End shika Katan!
title_japanese: ギャルメイドと悪役令嬢 ～おじょーさまのハッピーエンドしか勝たん!～
synopsis:
Celina, a gal, has been reincarnated into the world of an otome game that her otaku friend had been strongly suggesting she play. Celina, who has been reincarnated as merely a mob character, decides to become a maid for the villainess Almeria, but...

A fantasy yuri love comedy about a maid (former life: gal) who devotes herself to making the villainess happy!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Future Bank
synopsis:
Lee Chanhyuk desperately needs money. Not only does he have to pay his mother's hospital fees, but he's also been roped into paying off his friend's debt. But when a man appears and offers him 300 billion won if he breaks a high school bully's finger, he takes a chance and is shocked to see his bank account overflowing with cash. As it turns out though, as easy as it is for the money to come in, it can disappear just as fast! To what lengths will Chanhyuk go to keep his newly-minted fortune?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Anta no Ballad
synopsis:
1. Anta no Ballad
2. Amaoto ni Waltz wo Odorou
3. Doshaburi Cheek
4. 10-gatsu wa Ballad

title: Love Behind the Scenes
synopsis:
Director Na Eunseo just needs the third season of her reality dating show Housemate to do well. Then she can finally direct the program of her dreams! However, when the icy former child star Ha Sewon is added last-minute to the cast, he causes incident after incident and threatens to ruin her plans. At least Eunseo has her sweet, shy friend Ahn Jaehee in the cast to help her out. But why are no sparks flying this season? And why do the two male contestants only seem to be looking at Eunseo?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Teihen Ossan, Cheat Kakusei de Isekai Rakuraku Life
title_japanese: 底辺おっさん、チート覚醒で異世界楽々ライフ
synopsis:
He was a low level office worker reincarnated as a low level adventurer, but he had the "game" skill. Having wallowed in games until his reincarnation, a second life with no future would be... This is the chronicle of the life of a middle-aged man who makes a huge comeback from rock bottom.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Don't Be Too Nice
synopsis:
The Great Barrier split the primeval continent; it spewed vicious magic beasts out into the human territory and swallowed countless people into its unknown abyss. A hero soon rose: Carlos Arthur Ingram became the savior of humanity and soon established the Caleta Empire, declaring war on the magic beasts and the Great Barrier itself. Centuries later, Dame Rustica Genas dares suggest venturing beyond the Great Barrier, and Carlos puts her under a curse for treason.

For four years, Rustica has lived quietly in the countryside, but that changes after a reckless one-night stand with an incredibly beautiful man, Hayden Constante Rostana Bellor. Moreover, he bears unsettling news: the Great Barrier has been breached. While Hayden disappears before Rustica can learn about his true identity, Carlos suddenly requests that she return for a mission that may unravel both the mystery that is Hayden and what truly exists beyond the Great Barrier.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Da Capo
synopsis:
"Yohan Go? He's Eunjo Cha's toy. He'll do anything Eunjo tells him to do." 

Eunjo Cha, a world-renowned pianist, visits the city to overcome his slump. Inspired by sex with Yohan, Eunjo offers him a deal, thinking that he can overcome his slump. Yohan accepts the deal just so he can hold onto Eunjo...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: An Unexpected Engagement
synopsis:
Alicia, Neustein's princess, meets her fate the moment she raises her sword and encounters the wolf of the north, Cabelenus. "I just know when to give up." But Cabelenus didn't let her go, the woman who had given up a long time ago. The two of them fall uncontrollably into each other in their united fate...

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Hisame Furaba Koi Chigiri
synopsis:
"I'll have you join me in matrimony..."

Toono Itsuki is a university student who majors in folkore studies. He's currently headed towards his grandparents' hometown as part of his fieldwork. There, a local warned him, "do not approach the mountain on days when the rain is cold." Despite the warning, Itsuki still went to the mountain, and there he met...!?

Here's a BL about a local god and a folklore geek!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Tsuma ga Kanpeki Sugiru node, Chotto Midashite Ii desu ka?
title_japanese: 妻が完璧すぎるので、ちょっと乱していいですか？

title: Isekai Saikyou no Yome desu ga, Yoru no Tatakai wa Ore no Hou ga Tsuyoi you desu: Chiryaku wo Ikashite Nariagaru Harem Senki
title_english: She's the Strongest Bride, but I'm Stronger in Night Battles: A Harem Chronicle of Advancing Through Cunning Tactics
title_japanese: 異世界最強の嫁ですが、夜の戦いは俺の方が強いようです 知略を活かして成り上がるハーレム戦記
synopsis:
Compelled to marry a royal demoness and put to work—on the battlefield and in her bedroom—Albert finds his new life in another world anything but peaceful. Yet thanks to his knowledge of Earth's history, Albert is able to launch a revolution, and is having a ball doing it alongside his sexy demon bride!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Ookami α-san to Ookami Ω-kun
title_japanese: オオカミαさんとオオカミΩくん
synopsis:
Nobody realizes Ichirou Ohkami is an omega. At his high-class restaurant job, he poses as an alpha to advance his career and status. Everything is going smoothly until a new trainee, Ako Oukami, becomes a thorn in his side. When he tries to show her who's boss, she reveals she’s secretly an alpha. If he doesn't submit to her will, his life will be ruined.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Juuji Michi
synopsis:
Man, King, Virtue, and Divinity. The "Four Paths of Light" thought to guide one's way to the moral way of life and humanity is no longer pursued. In its place is the "Four Paths of Sin"; where one lives only for their desires... In a world that is in chaos with rampant looting and murder, one man with hope and humanity at his core dares to pursue the righting of humankind... The provoking story of sword battle fantasy is back!

(Source: AlphaPolis)

title: "Shindemiro" to Iwareta node Shinimashita.
title_japanese: 「死んでみろ」と言われたので死にました。
synopsis:
The tragic woman who went back in time will change the future for her beloved family!

After being treated coldly by her husband, Natalie, a former countess, committed suicide after her husband, Julius, encouraged her to die. Before she knew it, she finds herself back in time to more than ten years ago, when she was still happy. Losing her parents to disease and war, and being married off to Julius, the jet-black knight who saved her country... she doesn't want to live that life anymore! But every time she tries to change the future, she gets caught up in unexpected incidents, and somehow she always gets saved by Julius!

I don't want to be told "I want to protect you" all of a sudden...!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Darashinai Oneesan wo Kaitai
title_english: I Want to Keep a Sloppy Woman
title_japanese: だらしないお姉さんを飼いたい

title: The Martial World's Undead Apocalypse
synopsis:
For destroying the treasured library of the Hwasan Sect, Chungsoo was sentenced to be imprisoned in Hwasan's penitentiary for three years. But when his punishment ends, he discovers that his sect has been overrun and destroyed by undead monsters called sigwi. With no way of knowing if anyone else survived, Chungsoo is left to fend for himself until he runs into a stranger who may have the answers he needs. The question is whether he'll be strong enough to face the truth...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Ittsumo Shiotaiou na Osananajimi dakedo, Ore ni Kataomoi shiteiru no ga Barebare de Kawaii.
title_japanese: いっつも塩対応な幼なじみだけど、俺に片想いしているのがバレバレでかわいい。
synopsis:
"Today, I'll confess to Kou-chan!"

A voice suddenly heard by Kouta Nitake, a high school boy who is not particularly popular. It is the voice of Ayano Yumemigasaki, a childhood friend who always has an attitude that doesn't look like him! Kouta didn't know that Ayano has fallen in love with him. "I really wanted Kou-chan to talk to me..."  Kouta begins to be aware of Ayano's unrequited love. However, there is an unexpected side effect of "voice of the heart"...?!

(Source: Hobby Japan, translated)

title: Itoshi no Inma wa Banken Wanko ga Dokusen shimasu
title_english: Beloved Succubus Belongs to a Guard Dog
title_japanese: 愛しの淫魔は番犬ワンコが独占します
synopsis:
Shiki, who gets randomly hit on by the other guys all the time, has only one male friend, an underclassman Atsuya. Since he can talk and joke around with him like normal friends do, Atsuya has taken a special place in his heart. However, after finding out that Atsuya has a crush on someone, Shiki starts to feel a strange thirst and a burning sensation in his body. Gradually losing control over his growing desire, Shiki kisses Atsuya in a daze. What's the truth behind Shiki's behavior...?! The awkward but loyal watchdog and a guy magnet of a boy's tantalizing love affair with younger top!!

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title: Toshishita Chef no Torokeru Onedari
title_english: The Younger Chef Melts Me With his Begging
title_japanese: 年下シェフのとろけるおねだり
synopsis:
Satsuki, a man working at a small Italian restaurant, is secretly in love with his younger coworker, Kaoru. Figuring him straight... Satsuki resigns himself to keeping the other as mere eye candy, but for some reason finds himself at Kaoru's house...!? With the wine warming up his body, he finds himself beginning to grow turned on... With Kaoru himself feeling the thrill and saying such words as "Satsuki, you are so hot. I can't... I can't hold back" the two of them are unable to hold back their desires for one another. This is an erotic love story that starts from the joining of the bodies of an eager young pup of a straight chef and a beautiful but unlucky in love sommelier.

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title: A Suspicious Confession
synopsis:
Upon returning from a business trip, workaholic Ko Minhae is met with the news that her crush is engaged to her roommate. Devastated, she tries to drink away her sorrows before a horrific car accident sends Minhae into the past. With a second chance, she swears to live differently... starting by confessing to her crush! But unbeknownst to her, her plans are put in danger by a secret admirer who has his sights set on her. This time, will Minhae finally succeed in making her love come true?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Tsuiteru Gal Yuusha: Isekai no Chi ni Tatsu
title_japanese: ツイてるギャル勇者 異世界の地に勃つ
synopsis:
1-4. Tsuiteru Gal Yuusha
5. Joker Game: Shikumareta Zecchou Duel
6. Gin Ookami Sylvia: Shokugoku Colosseum
7. Futanari Kaitou Night Rouge: Chijoku no Keibi System
8. Zetsurin Hishou Spermax: Kirishima Nabiki no Baai
9. Aku no Onna Kanbu Yametara Moto Mahou Shoujo ni Fukushuu saremashita

title: Sennyuu Maid Monika: NTR Houkokusho
title_japanese: 潜入メイド モニカ NTR報告書

title: Unemployed Gye Baek-soon
synopsis:
"I have nothing saved up, my qualifications are average, and my bank balance is always below ten thousand won." Can Gye Baek-soon, who is described as a 'spine breaker,' really escape being unemployed?

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Mechanical Buddy Universe 1.0
title_japanese: メカニカル バディ ユニバース 1.0
synopsis:
An android whose mission had been long completed finds a child abandoned in the ruins of a war-ravaged city. Amidst a dystopian world, a machine and human become mother and son.

(Source: Square Enix)

title: The Young Emperor Is Obsessed With Me
title_english: The Young Emperor Is Obsessed With Me
synopsis:
A thousand-year plan was ruined by a beautiful boy raised in the forest. In the end, Ariel abandoned the boy. Ten years later, that same boy, Cedric, who harbored a grudge for being abandoned, invaded the forest.

In the midst of the blazing fire that burned the forest, he proposed, "Let's get married, Ariel."

Ariel: 1000+ years old, her occupation is great wizard (special note: no magic power). Does she need to rewrite her life plan?!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Dameo no Shiina-senpai to Yabao no Sasaki-kun
title_japanese: ダメ男の椎名先輩とヤバ男の佐々木くん

title: Gyakutai sareteita Shouka no Reijou wa Seijo no Chikara wo Te ni Ire, Mujikaku ni Youshanaku Gyakushuu suru
title_japanese: 虐待されていた商家の令嬢は聖女の力を手に入れ、無自覚に容赦なく逆襲する
synopsis:
The discarded girl is the strongest saint!? She shows no mercy to her enemies! A popular work from "Become a Novelist" is eagerly awaited to be turned into a manga!! Sonia, who has been oppressed by her aunt's family for many years, is discarded in the forest and prepares herself for death... Although Sonia is prepared for death, she is found by the kindhearted priest Falne...!? An exhilarating tale of a discarded saint's revenge!!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Gekijouban Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken 0: Guren no Kizuna-hen
title_japanese: 劇場版 転生したらスライムだった件0 紅蓮の絆編
synopsis: Prequel to the Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken: Guren no Kizuna-hen movie.

title_english: Cities and Infrastructure: Shintaro Kago Collection
title_japanese: 駕籠真太郎作品集 都市とインフラストラクチャー

title: Overnight Success
synopsis:
After suffering both scam and divorce, Minsik Chu teeters on the edge of financial ruin. Still, he doesn't let it completely ruin his humanity—a fact soon rewarded when the old man he helps out turns out to be more than meets the eye. Minsik is rewarded for his help, being told that the key to his future lies within his dreams... Specifically, dreams where he dates oh-so-sexy women! Each dream is guaranteed to tell him which crypto he should invest in the next day, turning him into somewhat of an overnight success! Money, fame, and women—what more could a guy want!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Neko no Manimani
synopsis:
One rainy day, unsuccessful novelist Matabi adopts an injured cat she found on the road. However, the cat turned out to be a 1200-year-old Nekomata, a youkai capbable of transforming into a human. Capable of speaking human language and with the appearance of a pretty girl, she introduces herself as Kaneko.

Having run dry of material for her work, Matabi feels a faint hope that she may get some new ideas with Kaneko around. However, her rowdy days are just beginning...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: 100-Day Romance
synopsis:
In her final moments after being hit by a car, Yoon Jaeyi regrets never having been in a relationship. Fortunately for her, the god of the afterlife is really into returnee stories and has decided to turn back time for her! Jaeyi now has 100 days in which to find a boyfriend if she wants to keep living. Maybe this will be the nudge she needs to confess to that cute regular at her cafe! Or, when her childhood friend returns from overseas, she might finally get the romance she's always dreamed of.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Fall for You
synopsis:
Hankook University's Seo Jihyeok is the most popular professor on campus with female students. Because of this, he's had trouble finding a T.A. who can get the job done and not fall in love with him. The dean of his department thus decides to bring in Yoon Heemin as his new T.A. Perfect at her job, she also immediately tells Jihyeok that she has zero interest in him. Although happy to have a competent aide, things take a turn when Jihyeok realizes he might be the one falling in love this time.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Sore Jaa Korekara Nani wo Suru?

Otsu, freshly divorced, had become the target of many women at his workplace, but this bad experience was causing him to lose interest in them. The prying eyes of those around him were also beginning to bother him, and Otsu felt he needed to meet new people. That's why he decided to register on a gay dating site!

That's where he met Aki, a handsome young man who kept to himself. Devastated by an impossible love affair, Aki had registered on the site to find one-night stands and break his loneliness. This could be a dangerous move, so Otsu couldn't help worrying about him and invited him back several times, but Aki isn't easy to read and Otsu doesn't know how to handle him... Love really is a complex thing!

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Cake mo Hana mo Houseki mo
synopsis:
Out of all the patrons who visit Azami in the brothel, her top customer is a young girl of similar age named Mary. For the last six months, Mary has been coming to the seedy establishment daily, showering Azami with lavish gifts in exchange for friendship—something Azami does not actually reciprocate. Believing Mary to be another naive, rich hypocrite, Azami has no issues with extorting their one-sided relationship for her financial benefit. However, an encounter with another one of her regulars begins to change Azami's perspective of the situation, causing her to act in a way that contradicts her hidden intentions.

But her plan goes awry when she has a one-night stand with her new sexy CEO, Lee Wonwoo! Eunseo runs from the hotel, leaving behind a heel that Wonwoo uses to find her. She wants nothing to do with him, but his interest in her only grows. With such a fervent suitor, can Eunseo stay away from love? Or can Wonwoo bring her the happy ending she wanted?

synopsis:
Once a famous actress, the vampire Im Sooyi fell in love with a human, Cha Seunghyun, and left the public eye to raise their three boys: Jisung, Yusung, and Hyesung.

Now 29 years old, Jisung is in a loving relationship with his coworker Kang Yeri, and he never craves blood. The handsome 27-year-old Yusung can consume both human food and blood, but he has yet to abandon his womanizing ways and form a meaningful bond with someone. Meanwhile, the cheeky 17-year-old Hyesung survives only on blood, which has led to some unproductive homeschooling.

As Jisung and Yeri hide their office romance, Yusung meets a woman immune to his charms, and even Hyesung has a fateful encounter with a girl who gives him butterflies. Sooyi may be an adoringly attentive mother who likes to meddle, but there is no greater joy than witnessing her sons discover the ultimate secret to overcoming their thirst for blood—love.

Unfortunately, his work causes him to be haunted by nightmares of his clients' blackouts. So when he stumbles upon a chance to save a little girl whose fate has been sealed by a photo, he seizes it. But can he change a bleak future that's been set in stone?

Their daily fare consists mainly of "boiled beans." In pursuit of a slow life, Ed's life of gathering and hunting begins!

Three years after graduation, Hironobu finds himself unable to find a girlfriend because of memories of Taro and calls it "Taro's Curse." While desperately trying to move on, he runs into Taro and is confused when the latter acts like nothing has happened between the two.

title: Log in to Lust-a-land

Nothing out of the ordinary has ever happened to Namjoo, that is, until the day he picks up a mislaid USB on the street. Curiosity gets the better of him and when he takes a look inside, he finds a steamy VR game that's still in the works. To Namjoo, the game looks ready for release, but little does he know about the bug that's affecting all of the NPCs and making all of them super horny. Meanwhile, Hye-na's panicking about her lost USB and is determined to get it back before more people find out about the game's fatal flaw. Join Namjoo and Hye-na on their journey to Lust-a-land, a world that isn't for the faint of heart...or the low of libido.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Life, Once Again
synopsis:
Han Maru, an ordinary husband and father, dies tragically in an accident but is granted a second chance at life. With only vague memories of the past, he relives his high school days and rediscovers his passion for theater, a dream he once sacrificed. However, longing to find his wife and daughter again in this life, he fears choosing theater might steer him away from them. Juggling dreams and family, he navigates life's intricate choices, seeking fulfillment in this extraordinary second chance.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Hiding the Archduke's Humiliating History

After being neglected in her past life, Izelle is ecstatic to be reborn as a rich character until her family suddenly goes bankrupt! While thinking about what to do, she's given the perfect chance to solve her financial crisis when she saves young Archduke Karl Byron from being bullied. Unfortunately, Karl doesn't remember her at all when they reunite as adults, and she has no choice but to coerce him into helping her. Can Izelle get what she wants, or will Karl be more trouble than he's worth?

title: Foam of the Sea

Just when she's about to drown, the voice of a mysterious witch offers her a second chance at life. However, this chance only comes to her seven years later, when she rises from the ocean in a new body without a voice. Although Margaret receives help from a local apothecary named Jack, the other southern villagers aren't as eager to let an outsider into their fold...

(Source: Tappytoon)

On a desolate Earth that has become difficult for human habitation, Itsuki, unconscious for two years because of an accident, ekes out a living on an island yet flourishing with his caretaker from childhood, Jun. While Itsuki doesn't remember what kind of accident he was in, he's fine with how things are as long as he's with his love, Jun... that is, until they have to start worrying about their dwindling resources. One day, the two of them find a mysterious machine and hear a voice from its communications device. Perhaps... there are other people still living on Earth as well. Though Itsuki is excited that the two of them can continue living together forever if they receive help, Jun's response is not so hopeful...

Hiroki Oogami, a drugstore employee, enjoys chatting with Shintaro Takimoto, a customer who always visits the drugstore just before closing time. In a strange turn of events, Shintaro confesses to him and they decide to try a relationship. As they go on dates, Hiroki sees new unexpected sides of Shintaro, but...

(Source: Libre, translated)

synopsis: The most powerful families of the court owe their influence to three things: property, titles, and magic. House Konbayazen, lacking a sorcerer, became a laughingstock among fellow aristocrats; that is, until the head of their House took his daughter Sabina and invited the curse of death upon her—turning her into "death incarnate." This curse causes any who utter Sabina's name to catch a fatal illness and contact with her flesh causes one's own to rot away. This new power allows her father to monger fear, killing anyone who dare stand in his way. After countless years of abuse at the hands of her father, Sabina is allowed to convalesce in the countryside to regain her strength. He sends her to an empty, abandoned village with the imperial knight Erzan Muskovayev to be her bodyguard...but there is something different about Erzan. Normally repulsed by the heat of another person's body, Sabina immediately finds an abnormal comfort in his presence. What's more, Erzan seems immune to any cur

title: Ochibure Oujo to Isekai Yuusha no Kenkokushi
title_english: A Ruined Princess and a Different World's Hero Make a Great Country!
title_japanese: 落ちぶれ王女と異世界勇者の建国史
synopsis:
Nation building begins with futon building!?

Kiki presents an isekai building & crafting, boy meets girl story. An unreliable princess and try-hard(?) hero team up to build various things!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Mamono no Kuchibiru
synopsis:
At first, it was a small "favour." Kibakura had instantly fallen in love with Aikyou, his junior one grade below him. They had first met at last year's ball game tournament, where they had a short conversation. Since that day, Kibakura would often watch Aikyou in the library after school... Aikyou quickly understood the situation and asked Kibakura for a favor in exchange for letting him do what he wanted...

(Source: MU)

title: Shibatte Mitsumete
title_english: Tie Me Up, Stare Me Down.
synopsis:
Sawada is the manager of the sales promotion department at the headquarters of a food supermarket. He is caught between his superiors and subordinates, and his struggles are endless. One day after working overtime, while looking for a place to have a drink, he sees a sign that says "Fetish Bar." When he opens the door, he is greeted by women dressed in fishnet stockings and bondage gear!? After experiencing bondage by Nana, the most popular queen, Sawada experiences pleasure and a sense of freedom he has never felt before...

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

synopsis: Included one-shot: Koi ni Tsuki Mono!

title: Ie ga Shikke Sugite Haetekita Genkaku Yuuhatsu suru Kinoko wo Goshoku shite Hatsujou shita Ato no Are ya Kore
title_english: What Happened After My Place Got So Humid It Grew Magic Mushrooms and I Ate Them and Got Super Horny!
title_japanese: 家が湿気過ぎて生えてきた幻覚誘発するキノコを誤食して発情したあとのあれやこれ

title: Zombie Revelation: 82-08
synopsis:
A mysterious virus breaks out on board the Boat 82-08 out at sea. The people who find out about it first only want to use it as a weapon but quickly lose control over the virus. Will the Trio survive long enough to rejoin their friend Jinu? Or will it be Jinu who doesn't make it out to meet his friends?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Memorial
synopsis:
In a future where the world has been devastated by a deadly gas called Izpo, Minhui and his friends find themselves embroiled in a thick conspiracy—where the stakes are high, and bets are made with one’s life. Only the Memorial Chips guard humanity against the lethal gas that permeates the atmosphere. But are these electronic securities truly built to guard us—or watch us? Follow Minhui as he examines what reality is, and comes face-to-face with the truth that will change him forever.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Itsumo Tsukiyo ni Kome no Meshi
A Child Who Looks Like Me
title_english: A Child Who Looks Like Me
synopsis:
A surprise pregnancy sends Jeong-o, a college junior, into a panic. Her supportive boyfriend Jiheon plans a loving proposal, but a car accident erases his recent memories, including their romance. Seven years later, they reunite unexpectedly—but Jiheon has no recollection of Jeong-o or the fact that they share a precious daughter between them.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Yowayowa Futako-chan
title_japanese: よわよわふた娘ちゃん

title: Love Hug Therapy
synopsis:
Akizuki, a university student, has finally achieved his dream of living alone... But not quite. Unable to pay rent on his own, he starts sharing a room with his friend Hayase. Soon after moving in, Hayase says "I can't imagine a life without hugs," which is confusing to Akizuki, but for some reason they end up hugging each other every day...? What's more, if he forgets his turn or doesn't hug him, he'll be fined and have to do whatever he's told. Akizuki gradually gets used to the physical contact with Hayase, but...?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title_japanese: 生まれ変わったら貞操逆転世界

title: Kyousei Kekkon: Gaten Nikushoku Danshi x Intelli Soushoku Joshi
title_english: Mandatory Matrimony: A Hot Working Guy and a Cold Office Girl
title_japanese: 強性結婚～ガテン肉食男子×インテリ草食女子～
synopsis:
A rapid decline in birthrate forces the government to implement a mandatory marriage system. Two complete strangers have no choice but to marry one another! If you refuse, you can get fined and lose your job! If the married couple can't find common ground within two weeks of cohabitation, they can go their separate ways. Nanao, an ice queen at her office, suddenly finds herself forced to marry a brazen construction worker who doesn't let her out of his arms every night until morning! Just what is going to happen to this mismatched couple!?

(Source: Renta!)

title: The Twin Sister Goes on Strike
title_english: The Twin Sister Goes on Strike
synopsis:
It is imperial belief that twins are bad omens, so Rosette Sigran was out of luck when her twin sister, Lea, was born a saint. Despite possessing the saint's mark, however, it is not Lea, but Rosette who has immense divine power. She does her best to help Lea with her holy acts, but their power-hungry father only sees Rosette as a blight on the family, and so he transfers Rosette's power to Lea and has her killed. Rosette then wakes up years in the past, but this time, she's done playing nice.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Gal Nanajimi wa Koko ga Suki
title_japanese: ギャルななじみはここが好き

title: Mei Ri Bian Che
synopsis:
Cheng Huan couldn't get a taxi home until her co-worker Liao Jia gave her a ride in his car. Since then, the two keep bumping into each other, and Liao Jia keeps giving Cheng Huan a free ride. As the two keep seeing one another brought by fate, their little encounters turn to something more.

(Source: Mangatoon HK Limited)

title: Kanojo-tachi wa Ana wo Umetai
title_english: They Want to Fill in the Holes
title_japanese: 彼女たちは穴をうめたい

title: The Queen's Secret Lessons
synopsis:
Boasting a kempt appearance and brains to boot, Yaha seemed to have everything required to become the queen. But she lacked one very important skill—the one required upon nightfall in his majesty's chambers. After being ignored by the king on their first night as a married couple, Yaha's anxieties multiply amongst rumors that the gorgeous court lady Seo-kyung has been reappointed. In order to overcome this challenge, Yaha summons a famous "novelist" to the palace for some private lessons. It's clear that Yaha has much to learn, but just how far will they take these lessons...?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Tensai Renkinjutsushi wa Kimama ni Tabisuru: 500-nengo no Sekai de Mezameta Sekai Saikou no Moto Kyuutei Renkinjutsushi, Potion-zukuri de Seijo-sama Atsukai sareru
title_japanese: 天才錬金術師は気ままに旅する ～500年後の世界で目覚めた世界最高の元宮廷錬金術師、ポーション作りで聖女さま扱いされる～
synopsis:
The youngest girl ever to become a court alchemist, Seyi, was busy with hard work every day. One day, the royal city was suddenly attacked by a horde of monsters, she woke up 500 years later. The city had already been destroyed, and Seyi, freed from her hard work, was determined to travel through a completely changed world. She was supposed to travel freely, but her potion-making skills quickly become the talk of the town?! The genius alchemist's leisurely, slow-life journey begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Gozen 0-ji no Amai Wana
synopsis:
When Kouki enters college, he reunites with Rei, his best friend from middle school, and ends up sharing a room with him. Rei takes care of the lazy Kouki without looking bothered by it. For Rei, who was once the target of bullying, Kouki is the hero who saved him from rock bottom. Kouki thought that him and Rei were dear friends, but he's sometimes confused by Rei's obsessive feelings towards him...?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: Mad na Alpha wa Marmot ni Koi wo Suru
title_english: The Alpha Doctor Falls in Love with a Guinea Pig
title_japanese: マッドなα〈アルファ〉はモルモットに恋をする
synopsis:
Genjirou Momoyama is a poor and unpopular omega, and suppressants don't work on him. Every time his heat comes, he has to go to an omega shelter, and it's tough. Touji Sakurada, a high-end alpha who owns a leading pharmaceutical company in the development of suppressants, falls in love at first sight with Genjirou as his "clinical trial subject." Genjirou, tempted by the reward, agrees to be Sakurada's subject, but starts getting tired of Sakurada's research and constant monitoring...! An omegaverse romance comedy starring a rich alpha who wants to save omegas and a poor, big, unpopular, and non-standard omega is here!!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Kimi ni Koisuru Sanshimai
title_english: Three Sisters in Love with You
synopsis: Itsuki lives with Amane and her two sisters, Shion and Mone.

title: Ginyoubi no Otogibanashi
title_japanese: 銀曜日のおとぎばなし
synopsis:
Poe is the princess of a race of little forest sprites. She meets a kind human boy, Scott, and with him tries to save herself and her people.

(Source: MU)

Included one-shots:
Volume 2: Marine Blue no Oto
Volume 3: Curly Pomeranian
Volume 5: Chotto Koakuma

title: Astral Online: Maou no Noroi de Saikyou Bishoujo ni Natta Ore, Saijakushoku da ga Cheat Skill de Chou Seichou shite Musou suru
title_english: Astral Online: I, Who Became the Strongest Beautiful Girl Due to the Demon King's Curse, Have the Weakest Job, But I Grow Up Super Fast With My Cheat Skills and Become a Warrior.
title_japanese: アストラル・オンライン 魔王の呪いで最強美少女になったオレ、最弱職だがチートスキルで超成長して無双する
synopsis:
Sora Kamijou, a high school boy who is addicted to VR games, starts playing Astral Online, a VRMMO that has been talked about as a god game, and suddenly finds himself fighting against the Demon King, the last boss. In addition to the sudden battle, the Demon King casts a curse on him and transforms him into a beautiful silver-haired girl...? A new VRMMO fantasy involving both the game and reality begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: SNS de Daininki na Layer ga Watashi wo Sasotte Off-Pako no Hanashi.

title_japanese: SNSで大人気なレイヤーが私を誘ってオフパコの話。

title: Senpai, Asa made Aishimasu.
synopsis:
Hibiki, 28 years old, was dumped by her boyfriend she'd been going out with for five years, but Yusa, her junior at the office makes a fierce move on her saying that he had his sights on her for a long time. He's usually cute, but he's sexually aggressive between the sheets. A secret office romance with a wicked handsome junior begins.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Endan Yobanashi
synopsis:
Yamayu has spent decades traversing Japan, collecting stories of ghostly encounters and grim fates from every corner of the land. Kensei Hokamoto's deft strokes bring the dead to life and illustrate the truth behind every story—horror is born of the darkness in the human heart.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Inari no Kekkon
synopsis:
They'd always been friends since childhood, but now they're living as a married couple.

Inari is small and born of a wild fox. Shiro is absentminded but possessed of strong spirit powers. They thought nothing would ever change, but since the night they exchanged vows, the boundaries between them have grown closer...

A warm and fluffy "nonhuman x newlyweds x yuri" story about living in the woodlands.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Watashi no Hatsukoi wa Hazukashisugite Darenimo Ienai
title_japanese: 私の初恋は恥ずかしすぎて誰にも言えない
synopsis:
Chiaki is handsome, academically gifted, athletic, and born into a wealthy family with a beautiful sister. Despite his seemingly perfect life, he faces a persistent problem: he's never been lucky in love and struggles to capture the attention of girls. Determined to turn things around in high school, he wakes up one morning to a surprising transformation—he has turned into a girl!

He is shocked to find out that he has lost the appearance he was so proud of, but when he looks in the mirror, he sees a very cute girl in the reflection. He immediately goes to show it off to his twin sister Kaede, who happens to be very popular with the girls, but there is also something very strange happening to her...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kiraware Majo to Karada ga Irekawatta keredo, Watashi wa Kyou mo Genki ni Kurashiteimasu!
title_japanese: 嫌われ魔女と体が入れ替わったけれど、私は今日も元気に暮らしています!
synopsis:
A happy slow life begins with a switch! Marietta, princess of the snow country of Snewe, is trapped in a magic tower because she can't use magic. Eight years later, on her wedding day with the prince of the silver country, she thought she had succeeded in summoning a holy beast, but then... What appeared was...?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Shuumatsu wa Watashi no Ie de Pan wo Tabemasen ka?
title_english: Would You Like to Eat Bread at My Home at the End of the World?
title_japanese: 終末は私の家でパンを食べませんか?

title: The Life of a Returning Officer
title_english: The Life of a Returning Officer
synopsis:
Choi Jonghyuk, captain of the intellectual crime unit, loses his mother and his own life to a mysterious mastermind for digging too deeply into a case. In his last moments, Jonghyuk catches a glimpse of the man who kills him before waking up as his 17-year-old self. To prevent his mother's death, Jonghyuk swears to hunt down the one responsible. Luckily, he has knowledge about the future and his experience as an officer. But will these tools be enough to catch the criminal that eluded him once?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Scavengers Another Sky
title_japanese: スカベンジャーズアナザースカイ
synopsis:
The "Scavengers" are armed girls living at a secret research facility called "Bus Stop"... They are sent to a different world where treasures lie in wait. What is lurking in the Black Parade? Search! Fight! Collect! The girls risk their lives picking up trash in order to earn one million dollars and be free!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Dawn of the New Body
synopsis:
Yoo Geon is just a normal teenager, were it not for the fact that he's dying from a disease that gives him excruciating pain but also blesses him with supernatural strength. And despite his best efforts to focus on his illness and avoid the troublesome criminals and delinquents at his school, he has no choice but to intervene when their schemes cause a classmate to get kidnapped. Sick of their behavior, Geon decides to put an end to their crimes... even if it's the last thing he ever does.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Logging in as a Monster
synopsis:
Lee Jinhyuk has enjoyed his decade-long reign as Cornsilk, the undefeated number one PVP player in virtual reality game "The Abyss." But with the sequel "Abyss World" resetting all players as newbies, Jinhyuk accepts a sudden sweet deal from his Abyss Studios developer half-brother Jinho to log in as the infamous boss monster Black Knight. After slaying 100 rankers during the opening event, Jinhyuk agrees to keep the monster login scheme going... but will his unmatched talent blow his cover?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Boku no Kanojo wa Dekkawaii
title_japanese: 僕の彼女はデッカワイイ
synopsis:
Ever since a girl rejected him due to his height, Amane Komi had long abandoned the hope of anything exciting in his school life. However, after meeting his tall classmate Asumi Obinata, his heart has begun to flutter once more.

Obinata is not only the tallest person in the class, but she also practices martial arts and possesses extraordinary strength. Contrasting her appearance, she is always bubbly and caring about the people around her, which has captured Komi's heart.

Having mustered enough courage, Komi reveals his romantic feelings to Obinata. Although taken aback, she gladly accepts his heartfelt confession. As the unique couple spends more time together, their bond blossoms into a tender romance.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kankin Ou
synopsis:
A girl who calls herself a devil appeared before a timid student named Fumio Kijima. The girl claims to be a campaign girl from the demon world and she gives him the ability to "summon a room" from nothing but thin air.

At first he doesn't abuse his power and uses it as a convenient ability in his everyday life. But one day he is bullied by his classmates under an unfair pretext and is made to suffer. In the past he would have wallowed in misery and cried himself to sleep, but now he had a power to call upon.

"I will make them regret it!"

Using his powers to summon his "room," he begins his era of confinement and brainwashing to achieve his goals.

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)

title: Kankin Ou

title: Geinoujin no Kareshi
synopsis:
Tsumugi has been rooting for Kira, an actor who's had his big break, from the time he was still in the lowest rank. One day, she visits a condominium for her housekeeping part-time job, yet to Tsumugi's surprise, she finds Kira there!

Kira tries to shorten the distance between them without hesitation. But at that point, he's being suspected to have a relationship with an actress. Tsumugi wants to avoid Kira thinking that she might cause him trouble if some paparazzi catches them. Nevertheless, Kira is determined to win her heart.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Reliance
synopsis: A spin-off of 14-sai no Koi focusing on Aoi Shiki and Haijima-sensei, from the perspective of Aoi's classmate, Iori Tachibana.

title: As Leticia Wishes
synopsis:
Stella, the beloved princess of Tyrien, was imprisoned all her life before being used in an eerie sacrifice. After her consciousness fades away, she wakes up to find herself hatching from an egg as a child! Despite her initial bewilderment, Stella quickly adapts to her new life as "Leticia" and becomes attached to Beth, a kind professor who may hold the key to finding out who and what she is. But does Leticia have what it takes to uncover the secrets behind both her lives?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Ore no Osananajimi wa Main Heroine Rashii.
title_japanese: 俺の幼馴染はメインヒロインらしい。

title: Nicotine to Kiss to Sex to
title_japanese: ニコチンとキスとセックスと
synopsis:
"Don't underestimate a former top host." An ex-host tries to seduce inexperienced and shy CEO! Even though he is just the CEO of a printing company, Hirotaka helped Minami get out of the host business with exceptional offers. Minami never understood why Hirotaka did so much for him, but he eventually realizes that Hirotaka is actually in love with him. Just a slight touch or a suggestive whisper makes Hirotaka shy and clearly nervous. In spite of that, he runs away when Minami tries to make a move on him... There's no way he can be satisfied with just looking at him when they both have feelings for each other. He wants to try having sex with him. He wants to make love to him and make a mess out of him. Minami forcefully grabs him, pushes him down, and gives him a passionate kiss...!

(Source: CLLENN)

title: Yoru no Otsutome Nante Tanondenai!
title_english: I Never Asked for Night Service!
title_japanese: 夜のオツトメなんて頼んでないっ!
synopsis:
"I've come as an offering! Please let me stay here!!" "I don't need a guy as an offering! Go home!" 

Suddenly, Takeharu, a human man, arrives at the cat yokai Kokuten's doorstep in the mountains with this request. Takeharu refuses to leave even when told to, so Kokuten ignores him—but then, before he knows it, both his house and yard are cleaned up! Kokuten thinks, "Maybe this guy could be useful..." But when night falls, Takeharu tells him, "I've been directed to service you at night as well," then pushes him down in a flash. Though Kokuten resists, Takeharu tells him "I'll make you feel good," and forces things along without any hesitation. When he touches Kokuten down there with his large hands, Kokuten can't stop his gasping moans...! This is a slapstick romcom featuring a strong-willed (despite being an offering) and doting human, and a free-spirited and kind cat yokai, who gets serviced day and night!

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title: Actor Class
synopsis:
Up-and-coming actor Seo Kangwoo is up for "Rookie of the Year" when his former lover, industry exec Lee Jiwon, suggests they act like a couple in public. Although they are no longer dating, Jiwon now needs Kangwoo's help to create a dating scandal that will break off an engagement set up by her family. With his lingering affection for Jiwon, Kangwoo jumps at this chance to be close to her again. Although it's all supposed to be acting, will Kangwoo's real feelings for Jiwon blow everything?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Bequeathed
synopsis:
Yoon Seoha doesn't have time for anything else, what with trying to stay afloat at her job and making plans to take down her cheating husband. That all changes when her uncle passes away, and she's left with their family's burial ground. But upon agreeing to accept this inheritance, mysterious and sudden deaths begin happening around her. Disturbed and frightened, Seoha tries to get rid of the land, only to realize there may be more to this deadly family bequest than meets the eye...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: 99 Boss
synopsis:
The protagonist, Na Seon-wook, was born with the heart of a tiger. He was a troublemaker, but at the request of his parents, he hid his strength and transferred to Gukyang High School, a school located in a remote area that he thought would be quiet. However, it was a place where various old-fashioned cultures and dangerous people gathered. Seon-wook, who wanted to graduate quietly, eventually he couldn't help but feel his hot blood and began educating them!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Shachiku no Ore ga Ero de Isekai Sukuu tte!? ※Tadashi Ossan shika Inai
title_japanese: 社畜のおれがエロで異世界救うって!?※ただしおっさんしかいない
synopsis:
Aoki Soman, a good-natured engineer, gets into an accident during a quarrel with his colleague Tategawa. When he wakes up, he finds himself in an unknown country called Mt. Baiyang. There, a middle-aged man who calls himself Yi-Yan, tells Aoki that he possesses the rare power of "Yang" (lewd power). Aoki, who suddenly became the savior of Mt. Baiyang, set out on a journey with Yan to visit the sage in order to teach him the mysteries of the sun to protect this country from the demon king, Kuze no Tsuki.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Spicy Milk Candy
title_japanese: スパイシーミルクキャンディ
synopsis:
Aki Izumi, the student council president, is a serious and honest young man. He has a secret boyfriend who possesses the gentle smile of a prince, someone he always feels proud of. He immersed himself in the love that his boyfriend Iichi gave him, enjoying the sweet aftertaste that love life brings. Because of a certain incident, Izumi was forced by Iichi to participate in "Punishment Play," something that had never happened before...!

“You have to apologize properly, can you do that?”

He couldn't move his arms and the words were harsh and sounded like scolding. Izumi panicked because he couldn't believe that the guilty feeling of being scolded made him feel pleasure...?!

(Source: Shu-Cream, translated)

title: I Listened to My Husband and Brought In a Lover
title_english: I Listened to My Husband and Brought In a Lover
synopsis:
Louise wants nothing more than to live a happy life with her husband, Reyard. She loves her husband so much even though he has never been faithful to her. She had to watch him bring home mistresses and pretend like she wasn't bothered by it. After all, Reyard was never deceitful about his wishes. He told her that if she were to object to his lovers, then their marriage would be over. Louise feels lower than low, so when Reyard insists that she take on a lover of her own... she does just that.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Ramiel no Mokushiroku
synopsis:
To asses if humans can continue to exist, three angels become human for three days to find out if the humans on earth are worthy.

(Source: MU)

title: Amai Bouken
synopsis:
Rebecca, who works at a research institute, made a big decision on her 30th birthday. She ventures out in search of change in her life. Shaking off her handsome boss Kent with his protective face, Rebecca gets her start with a stunningly beautiful makeover with the help of her sister. While her colleague invites her on a date, Kent keeps getting in the way with his bitter face for some reason. "Is it just his sense of duty as a boss that keeps him chasing me?" Rebecca finds herself attracted to Kent, but it's rumored that he only has physical relationships with women...!?

(Source: Harlequin, translated)

title: Oshi to no Yuri wa Arienai!
title_japanese: 推しとの百合はありえない!
synopsis:
An Tsukamoto, the too-perfect class president, is worried that Kaoru Kenzaki, a gal in her class, is so stupid that she's at risk of repeating the year...! An, who can't tolerate anything but perfection, struggles to correct Kaoru...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

synopsis:
Twenty-three-year-old Jongsoo is your average guy who has nothing much to show for himself save his youth. He's got an interest in video production but not much experience. When he sees a job post for Europe Entertainment, he figures he'll apply and give it his best shot. But when he arrives at the building he's pleasantly surprised by how nice it is...and by all the female workers he's passing by... There's something a bit suspicious about this place that he can't quite put his finger on but Jongsoo, with nothing to lose, has decided to go all-in on this opportunity! Even if the place is a little weird, at least the job comes with some tempting benefits...!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Most Perfect Marriage
synopsis:
Hyewon is in for the surprise of a lifetime when she suddenly gets a marriage proposal from her boss and longtime crush, Jihoon. Everything's perfect except for the fact that it's a loveless fake marriage! However, Jihoon's sizzling kiss to seal the deal leaves her completely defenseless. Instead of refusing, she decides to seize the chance and accepts the two-year faux marriage to try and make him truly hers. Can she turn this fake arrangement into a genuine love story?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: My Ex, Client
synopsis:
Jihyo is an Account Exec at a mid-size ad firm. Her ex-boyfriend Jegook shows up one day as a very important client. She'd rather not work on his project, but there's no way to escape! With influence and power, this CEO has his sights on her. What does this ex client want from her after all this time?!

(Source: Tappytoon)

synopsis:
Meet Shisoya Toki, a quiet female teacher with a thing for "clothes." Often seen as cold and unfriendly, her students call her the "unfortunate beautiful teacher." But one day, while organizing supplies in the old school building, she finds a brand new pair of bloomers. Suddenly, her kinky curiosity about "clothes" goes wild!! Sometimes SEXY, sometimes CUTE—get ready for a wild ride full of seductive cosplay!

(Source: Nihonbungeisha, translated)

title: Sono Me wo Sorashite Kureru na yo
title_english: Don't Take Your Eyes Off Me
title_japanese: その目を逸らしてくれるなよ
synopsis:
Jun is a member of the boy band Primula, the son of his agency's CEO, and the songwriter for his group. Little do they know that this is a fabrication created by the CEO. Straight off the back of their band's debut, Jun is shocked to discover that Isshin, a member of the group, is the person whose credit he has been taking. Hoping that it will help vent his anger, Jun lets Isshin have sex with him, and from that day forward places himself completely at the other man's mercy. Jun does everything he's told without complaint, saddened by Isshin's hatred for him. Soon after that, Isshin has full control over his training regimen, clothing, and even his meals. But even then, Jun fails to notice the unusual fixation Isshin has on him... the messy, muddled love story of a genius pop star and a performer with no way out!

(Source: Shinkosha)

title: Zense Koitsu ni Korosaremashita
title_english: He's the One Who Killed Me in My Past Life
title_japanese: 前世こいつに殺されました
synopsis:
There are two things that are bothering Ayato Yanagi, a guy who has memories of his past life. The first thing is that because he used to be an aristocrat in his past life, he has trouble finding his place in his current life and keeps losing his job, making him broke. The second thing is that he vividly remembers how he got killed in his past life. 

His friend introduces him to a new job of being a dorm supervisor to a bunch of heirs to powerful companies. Ayato is happy with finally finding a job where his aristocratic background will finally come into use, but the first person who greets him at the dorm is the quiet and mysterious Soh Takimoto. The moment Ayato lays eyes on Soh, he understands that Soh is the man who killed him in his past life! So begins Ayato's challenging job as a dorm supervisor...!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Genshi Shoujo Urara
synopsis:
A teenage boy get transported back to the prehistoric era where he encounters a bunch of strong, huge, busty stone age girls fighting against dinosaurs.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Sub-sama, Shitsuke no Jikan desu
title_english: It's Time for Your Obedience Training, My Subservient Pet
synopsis:
He never wanted to know this kind of pleasure. He should be the one commanding his young staff member, not the other way around!

In a world where everyone has a second gender, former top host Kyoya runs his own host club now, specializing in providing a safe space for commanding hosts and their obedient clients. Everyone thinks Kyoya's on the commanding side, but he actually takes medicine to suppress his subservient urges! He's managed to build his small empire without anyone finding out, until Sota, the new club staff member, commands him to kneel one day out of the blue. Kyoya's humiliated as he can't help but bend the knee.

Sota asks Kyoya to be his partner in exchange for pretending to accept Kyoya's commands. Sota suggests they keep each other's secret true second genders to themselves and enter into a relationship where their roles are reversed inside and outside the club...

(Source: Renta!)

title: Emerald Midnight's Lover
synopsis:
The year is 1887 in the rolling hills of the French countryside. The estate of Viscount de Rougemerle gently basks in its verdant glory, a beacon in the twilight years of the aristocracy. With the return of the viscount's wayward son Cameron, however, the tranquility of this stately home threatens to shatter into scandal. It falls upon Edgar O'Grady, an Irish butler in service of the Rougemerles, to maintain decorum in the household, all the while protecting his childhood friend June and his master's daughter Lady Victoria, as each furtive glance gleams the emerald green of envy...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Return of the Gods
synopsis:
Uju Hyeon dreams of living the ordinary life of a high school student, but his dream will never come true as he possesses special powers that others don't have. One day, after being chased by an evil spirit, he is taken to the School of the Tiger and learns that he has a dragon orb in his body. Will Uju be able to protect himself and the dragon orb from evil spirits?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: I Swear We're Just Friends
synopsis:
Karcion Liciantus is a celebrity at the prestigious Alena Academy. He wields magic with unprecedented ease and, owing to his noble background, rarely refrains from harming others. To minimize contact with his admirers, Karcion decides to create a private after-school club with one friend he tolerates, but there is a small issue: they need a third member to officially start the club.

Enter Rienne, a stunning commoner and transfer student who has already set hearts aflutter around the academy. As the only person who has yet to get on Karcion's bad side, Rienne receives an invitation to join his club. Contrary to Karcion's initial fears, Rienne is indifferent to his looks and power, but something about her nonchalance and flirty remarks completely enamors him. However, the discrepancy in their social status makes romance impossible, and Rienne must resist Karcion's affection to convince all the envious students—and herself—that they are nothing more than friends.

title: I Stole the Tyrant's Virginity
synopsis:
Reborn as a villainess in a romance novel, Eudis Peregrine knows she's destined to die at the hands of the tyrannical Emperor Theodore Waldemar. To avoid this cruel death, Eudis plans to stay far away. But after a drunken night at a masked ball, she wakes up in bed with none other than the emperor himself! Now, with the smitten Theodore proposing marriage, Eudis must navigate this unexpected plot twist. Can one night of romance change her predetermined fate, or is she bound to her tragic ending?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: I'll Protect You, Daddy!
synopsis:
Hanelope knows her dad, Prince Hart von Reinhart, is a good person, it's just that the world doesn't know it! The cunning Saint Asta has fooled everyone into thinking the prince is a cruel monster, so Hanelope is determined to put a stop to it once and for all! Hiding her quick wits behind a cute smile, she fights against pesky vassals, malicious rumors, and the manipulative Asta for her dad's happiness. Can Hanelope give her dad a happy ending? Or is this too much for a little girl to handle?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Made into the Main Character
synopsis:
After Tiarosetti learns from her Guide that sacrificing herself to save the male lead, Lexion Spero, and following the plot is the only way to return to her world, she desperately carries out her role. But confusion strikes when she wakes up where her story starts, and Lexion saves her before he should. The Guide states she's now the main character, and Lexion isn't the male lead! Can Tiarosetti find her way home, or will Lexion's inconsistent behavior shackle her to his world forever?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: I'll Just Look for a New Family
title_english: I'll Just Look for a New Family
synopsis:
Leticia has been used as the successor in cold treatment because she is the duke's illegitimate daughter. Her devotion is ruined by Sujin, the adoptive daughter from another world, and she dies due to a false accusation. At the end of it, she opens her eyes again at the age of sixteen. In this life, she will carve her own path in life.

"I will leave the family."

However, the more she tries to avert her fate, the more she becomes entangled with dangerous but fascinating people.

"You shouldn't have saved me if you weren't going to spare me a glance."
"Please leave the owner of the magic tower and make me your husband."

A turbulent second life. Can Leticia find her new family?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Too Late for Regrets
synopsis:
The tale of Princess Ines is a tragic one. Born a royal of the Zener Empire, she is reviled and neglected as a child born out of wedlock. To compound her misfortune, Ines is married off to Grand Duke Ryan of Eleanor, a renowned war hero of the Lezan Empire who fought against Zener. Ryan proves a stern and distant husband to Ines, and she soon determines that she must fight for a life of dignity—if not in Eleanor, then elsewhere. Thus begins a marriage of emotional reserve and regrets...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Persona 3 FES: 4-gatsu 1-nichi-hen - 4-koma Gag Battle

title: How to Survive in a Horror Game
title_english: How to Survive in a Horror Game
synopsis:
Suddenly thrust into her favorite mystery murder game, our protagonist embodies Arviche Green, a supporting character doomed to bite the dust. Compounding the chaos, she wakes up in the house of the prime suspect, Duke Leikas Learmond, as the in-house tutor to his niece and nephew! Convinced of the Duke's guilt, she juggles evading the main storyline while also uncovering the truth. With her virtual lives dwindling, can Arviche game her way out, or is a game-over fate sealed?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Dead Ending Collector Maid
synopsis:
Rowena is the only maid that the sensitive and crazy prince, Cardin, keeps by his side. One day, she discovers a monster in the emperor's garden. At the same time, she is attacked and on the verge of death...

Beep Beep!
[Amazing experience! Death confronted!]
[You've acquired an experience point!]

Something strange appeared.

[If you don't want to die, press accept.]

Of course she didn't want to die! Rowena accepted the questionable proposal...and went back in time three years. That was how the regressions began. If she wants to ultimately survive, she has to die and regress and obtain clues! Will Rowena be able to overcome all the dead endings and achieve the best end?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: The Villains' Little Heiress
synopsis:
It has been ten years since I reincarnated as an extra in a novel. It is also the day my grandfather, the owner of the house where I grew up and of the infamous ducal family of Blasco, died.

"His Excellency the Grand Duke bequeathed all his assets to the girl Katisha."
"His Highness the Grand Duke."

So my grandfather is the Duke of Blasco? The inheritance is great, but this extended family is bound to hound me to no end.

"No thanks..."
"Excluding inheritance tax, you can keep everything else in Blasco's name."
"See'ya!!"

Now, let's see what I can do with all this money! After all, money is what makes the world go round—especially for a materialist like me!!!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Villain Fiancé Is in My Way of Happiness
title_english: Villain Fiancé Is in My Way of Happiness
synopsis:
Thisbe was tired of being the Saintess of Prophecy from day one. Years after being reincarnated into a novel, she navigates a new timeline where, instead of being a murderous has-been saintess, she chooses peace. And yet she somehow still ends up framed for murder—by her own fiancé, no less! Determined to prove her innocence, gain her freedom, navigate her love life (and maybe help save the world in the process), Thisbe will clear her name not as a saintess, but as the main character!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Escape From the Daytime Drama
synopsis:
An unknown actress's life is ruined when she wakes up as Cha Yeryeon, the villainess of a daytime drama. Determined to avoid an antagonist's fate, Yeryeon works to nudge the story toward a different ending. But as her actions threaten to upend the lives of other characters, Yeryeon has to figure out how to get her satisfying story while also protecting the people she cares for. Will Yeryeon flip the script and change the drama for the better? Or will she be stuck playing the bad guy forever?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: I Think It Would Be Better for Me to Become King
title_japanese: 차라리 내가 왕이 되는 게 나을 것 같다
synopsis:
Astarote is a young woman who is transported into a romance game that she loved. She takes on the role of the villain, who is married to Prince Cedric, her favorite character. However, she discovers that the end of the game is tragic for her, as she is accused of being an impostor and is executed by the king.

She tries to change her husband's destiny, making him become the new king, but in every route, she ends up dying. Desperate, she decides to take radical action: she will become the queen and change the course of history. But to do so, she will have to face many obstacles, intrigues, enemies, and secrets.

(Source: MagusManga)

title: Obey the Flowers

I possessed a villainess who would be brutally murdered by a crazed male lead. My only way to survive is to tame him and take him to the female lead. Can this plan with a cruel and charming yet incomprehensible beast succeed? However, the expression of the beast has been gradually changing.

title: Motto Kawaiku Natte Ii
title_japanese: もっと可愛くなっていい

Wataru Manaka lands a job with his dream company, only to be transferred to a department managed by the devil himself, Reiji Kenzaki. Wataru is scolded by his new supervisor day in and day out, and he wonders if he'll ever win Reiji's approval. While his co-workers get a reprieve from Reiji when they clock out, that's not the case for Wataru. Due to a financial crisis in Wataru's family, not only is Reiji his supervisor, but he's also his roommate! Through their shared living arrangement, Wataru slowly starts to see different sides to Reiji he never knew existed beyond his cold exterior. But, who knew Wataru would receive the praise he craves from Reiji at work, at home...!?

(Source: Renta!)
