"Watch out for the guy with the ponytail," a warning Myung-il Lee heard on his first day in prison. But when he unintentionally rescues the central figure of the rumors, Jingi Choi, it takes an unexpected turn. And with Jingi's younger brother, Heonjae, involved, things get even messier...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Akogare no Hito ni Ubawaremashita

Tomomi is a bit of a klutz who's been working for one year now. He secretly admires Chisato, who's like the man of his dreams with his thoughtful ways, always looking out for him in times of need. Tomomi wants to get to know him better and asks him out for a drink, but ends up drinking too much and passes out to awaken in Chisato's apartment. Recalling the gentle way Chisato patted him on his head, Tomomi asks him to touch him some more... but Chisato takes his request the wrong way...!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Shitsuren Shousetsuka no Koi

synopsis:
Novelist Yui Tsubakiyama, winner of a writer's award at the young age of 18, is in a slump. He writes stories vividly depicting young love, and has been nicknamed the heartbroken novelist. He has been writing novels based on his own relationships, but does not expect to meet anyone new... That's when he meets Chiaki, a refreshingly handsome businessman from out of town, who asks him for directions. An everlasting love that doesn't end in heartbreak between a younger businessman and a heartbroken novelist!

(Source: Renta!)

His partner for cleaning activities is Yuugo, a freshman who has been absent from school for some time. Wataru is taken aback by Yugo's cocky attitude, but he can't help but notice the resemblance between him and his childhood friend, and he starts taking care of him. But Yugo has a secret...?

title: Potion Witch
synopsis:
In Blalock City, every criminal fears the mysterious vigilante Witch Raven. When night falls, even the shadiest wrongdoers all fall victim to the witch's curse, which leaves them with physical alterations they cannot conceal nor cure. However, during the day, Witch Raven is just an ordinary pharmacist named Vanna Spalding.

Vanna proudly runs her humble little herbs and potions shop, but beneath her innocent store actually lies a hidden basement full of illegal potions and evidence of her nighttime identity. Vanna is confident no one will ever discover her secret, until one day when she finds a police officer, Sion Crawford, standing in the middle of her hideout. The police are after Witch Raven, but Sion seems disinterested in arresting her. Instead, when one of Vanna's experimental potions causes a small accident, Sion enlists her help in investigating a case that may soon prove to be far more serious than either of them are prepared for.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title_japanese: 幸運値999の私、【即死魔法】が絶対に成功するので世界最強です～魔力値1で追放されましたが、確率チートで成り上がる～
synopsis:
Born into a prestigious family of magicians, Sachi faced despair when her magical power was assessed at a mere 1. In contrast, her luck stat was an astonishing 999, but to magicians, it was deemed worthless...?

(Source: Starts Shuppan, translated)

title: Gamera: Rebirth - Code Thyrsos
synopsis:
Set 100,000 years before the events of Gamera: Rebirth, the comic depicts the downfall of the ancient kingdom of Elistania, which had begun manufacturing giant creatures known as Kaiju to stage artificial wars for the benefit of its elite. A boy named Lucius, whose father was killed in one such war, is disfigured in an encounter with a Kaiju and vows to see the aristocracy destroyed.

(Source: Wikizilla)

title: Shittaka Elf to Koibito Gokko
title_english: Let's Play Lovers with "Elf" Pretends to Know Lovers!
title_japanese: 知ったかエルフと恋人ごっこ

title: Datsusara 41-sai no Mangaka Saichousen: Ousama Ranking ga Bazuru made
title_japanese: 脱サラ41歳のマンガ家再挑戦 王様ランキングがバズるまで

title: Sleeping Booty: Muboubi Imouto wo Suki Houdai!
title_japanese: Sleeping BOOTY -無防備妹を好き放題!-

title: Meiko no Asobiba
synopsis:
Set in 1973, the story depicts the "dangerous games" played by Meiko, a young girl who possesses a mysterious eye. Meiko uses this eye's power to complete certain "jobs" with her father.

(Source: Comic Natalie, translated)

title: Canelé: Soeur Yuri Anthology
title_japanese: カヌレ スール百合アンソロジー
authors: Takahashi, Mako|Canno|Nanasaka, Nana|Dokuta, Pepako|Meno|Kumo, Suzume|Neji|Ameno|Takase, Waka|Kashikaze|Sumire
synopsis: An anthology of girls love short stories by various mangaka.

title: Monster no Niku wo Kutteitara Oui ni Tsuita Ken
title_japanese: モンスターの肉を食っていたら王位に就いた件
synopsis: "Eat Or Die!" The first prince of the kingdom of Farune, Mars, is only twelve years old, yet he lives in fear of assassination. In order to avoid the deadly poison in nearly all of his meals, he slips out of the castle into the nearby monster-infested forest, where, battling monsters and his own hunger, he has to hunt for his meals in order to stave off starvation. Then, one night, as he's searching for his next bite of monster meat, a red-haired woman shouldering a greatsword appears before him and says to him, "You have promise. Become my apprentice." How is he supposed to tell her that this must be some sort of mistake? But there's a secret that only she knows, and that he's stumbled upon: eating monsters makes you stronger! With her training and his newfound power, Mars will finally overcome all those pesky assassination attempts. However, that doesn't end things; no, it's only the beginning of a nationwide—even continent-spanning—series of wars and plots with him right in the midd

title: Gakeppuchi Reijou wa Kurokishi-sama wo Horesasetai!
title_english: Marrying the Dark Knight (For Her Money)
title_japanese: 崖っぷち令嬢は黒騎士様を惚れさせたい!
synopsis:
Clarice's younger sister is her whole world. In a world of monsters, born into a noble family that's gone broke, there's nothing Clarice wouldn't do for her. So when she gets sick, and there's only one way to save her, Clarice doesn't blink! She agrees to an arranged marriage with the Dark Knight, a ferocious warrior who goes everywhere in magical armor—even their wedding! Afterward, Clarice is ready to consummate the marriage and charm her new spouse into paying to save her sister's life. There's just one problem: The Dark Knight won't let her into the bedroom! And Clarice finally finds out why...she's secretly a woman! With female knights forbidden, the Knight seriously lacking in social graces, a household full of servants scared out of their wits, and monster fights breaking out constantly, Clarice realizes that this wedding of convenience is going to be more inconvenient than she bargained for!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Dekiai α to Nora Ω no Kekkon
title_english: Marriage of a Doting Alpha and Stray Omega
synopsis:
"Let's get married." 

A proposal after just meeting!? Goro, an Alpha who hates Alphas and has lived life as a Beta, is in a back alley when he finds an Omega suffering from being in heat, whose name is Ichitaka. Unable to go against his Alpha blood, Goro follows his desire and has his way with Ichitaka. Goro is tormented by guilt after having come inside Ichitaka many times but next to him Ichitaka says "It happens a lot..." while taking a pill. Goro isn't convinced and decides to take responsibility. Thinking of when Ichitaka would someday meet a person he'd want to mate with, Goro has an idea. "Not mating but marriage."

(Source: Shusuisha)

title: Sabishigariya na Usotsuki Otoko no Otoshikata
title_english: How to Capture the Heart of a Lonely and Deceptive Man
title_japanese: 寂しがりやな嘘つき男の落とし方
synopsis:
"Once I set my sights on something, I can't help but want to possess it." 

Dressed impeccably in a suit with a dignified expression, Shiba, a company owner took an instant liking to Sakura, introduced as a business partner. Despite Shiba's attempts to approach him, Sakura seemed to have an impenetrable guard, appearing as difficult to conquer as a fortress. However, by chance, they met again at a bar, and a drunk Sakura invited Shiba into a one-night relationship. Yet, the next day, the cute demeanor from the previous night was nowhere to be found as Sakura acted extremely cold. Despite having desires, Sakura didn't want romance and preferred a rational relationship. Shiba, intrigued by this man who drew an extreme line, proposed a friends-with-benefits arrangement until the business deal was over...?

(Source: Shusuisha)

title: Mistress
synopsis:
Sold to the Gwak household as a young boy, Dol-swae grows from being a shy boy to a handsome, sturdy man. He's not the only one who grew up to be attractive, though. Lady So-hee, who he serves, and Yeo-reum, a fellow servant in the Gwak household, are now gorgeous women. The playful relationships they had together as children are now full of heated tension as they orbit each other. Something much steamier than love is in the air...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Koibito Tutorial
synopsis:
The prince-like girl, Asahi, and supposedly normal (but of course handsome and earnest) guy Kuro are in the same club. They agree to pretend to date as a "Boyfriend/Girlfriend Tutorial."

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Koibito Tutorial
synopsis:
The prince-like girl, Asahi, and supposedly normal (but of course handsome and earnest) guy Kuro are in the same club. They agree to pretend to date as a "Boyfriend/Girlfriend Tutorial."

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Manga Touken Ranbu Musou
title_japanese: 漫画 刀剣乱舞無双

title: Akogare no Sakka wa Ningen ja Arimasen deshita
title_japanese: 憧れの作家は人間じゃありませんでした
synopsis:
The series follows literary editor Asahi Sena on her new assignment to her favorite writer. She soon discovers that he may not be human and discovers a world of supernatural mystery.

(Source: ANN)

title: Tiny Drive
synopsis:
When her father remarries, middle-schooler Suwako suddenly gains a big sister. Now, with this new, somewhat unusual sibling by her side, Suwako finds her daily life is in for a change.

(Source: Shounen Gahousha, translated)

title: Vabi VTuber!! Pappy
title_japanese: バビブイチューバー!! パピィ

title: Childhood Friend Complex
synopsis:
Ha-neul and Mincheol have been childhood friends for all of their lives, but their relationship takes on a whole new dynamic when they undergo a series of unexpected events. Although they vowed that they'd never be romantically attracted to each other, they just might be proven wrong... especially when things start to escalate and neither can predict where they'll end up.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Mitsuba Monogatari: Noroi no Shoujo to Shi no Rondo
title_japanese: みつばものがたり 呪いの少女と死の輪舞〈ロンド〉
synopsis:
Awakening from a prolonged slumber with a mysterious sense of omnipotence, the girl Mitsuba finds herself far from welcomed by her stepmother. Through the stepmother's scheming, Mitsuba not only loses her noble title but is also forced to enroll in a military academy. However, Mitsuba harbors vague memories of another world and unwittingly possesses the power of a curse. This is the tale of a girl who, despite being feared by those around her, forges her own path with extraordinary abilities—a unique narrative of conquest in a different world.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Ojousama no Renai Jijou
synopsis:
Kaya is the true model student: beautiful and rich, but modest, outgoing, but prim and proper. This is a mask, however, as at her heart, she's a massive pervert. Carrying this mask all the time is causing her stress to build up, but she connects with Takasaki, a part-time teacher at her school and starts a relationship that allows her to release her stress.

Today will be the last day Takasaki is teaching at her school, so he prepares a special parting gift for her...

(Source: 2D Market)

title: Isekai Toushou no Maken Seisakugurashi
title_japanese: 異世界刀匠の魔剣製作ぐらし
synopsis:
One fateful day, unknown blacksmith Lutz accidentally forges a truly exceptional katana: his life's magnum opus. However, a certain incident forces him to give up the blade. To make matters worse, he forgot to stamp his maker's mark on it, making it impossible to prove that he crafted it. Meanwhile, the katana falls into the hands of Gerhardt, the local lord's personal spellforger. The moment he picks it up, he is enchanted by its beauty...

In this sword-making tale, an obscure blacksmith and a nameless katana move the hearts and fates of people!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Uma Musume: Pretty Derby Anthology Comic Star
title_japanese: ウマ娘 プリティダービー アンソロジーコミック STAR
authors: Endou, Minari|Daioki|Tori|Aoi, Manabu|Tonpuu|Kurobuchi, Kashiko|Arito, Arayuru|Dark|Sakeno, Rarukan|Hundred Burger|Ginga Ceremony☆☆☆
synopsis: An anthology comic of Uma Musume: Pretty Derby by various mangaka.

title: Boku no Kanojo wa Sasuga desu.
title_japanese: 僕の彼女はさすがです。

title: The Grand Duke's Fox Princess
synopsis:
Help, I'm stuck as a fox and can't turn back into a human! I, Princess Eristella Leonalph, am the greatest magician in the empire, but I've been cursed to be hated by everyone. I was chasing after dark magicians when I became stuck like this! How am I supposed to break the curse? Maybe my fiancé, Grand Duke Heinlesione, can help, but our relationship is rocky... Well, even if I become a palace pet, I can't give up! After all, some things are easier when you're an adorable little fox.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Princess Maid
synopsis:
Princess Siana quietly endured her parents' abuse for years, but when Crown Prince Rashid of the nearby empire conquers her kingdom and kills her entire family, she refuses to die without standing up for herself. Siana begs for her life, and Rashid allows her to be a maid at the palace, where she thrives in her simple life of service... until that new life is threatened by Rashid's interest in her. Can Siana finally enjoy the peace she deserves, or will Rashid's fascination disrupt it all?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Ani no Shinyuu Oyome ni Oide
title_english: Be My Bride, Best Friend of My Brother
title_japanese: 兄の親友お嫁においで
synopsis:
At age 29, Masaki isn't the least bit interested in marriage. The day that Jo, his best friend since childhood, tells him he's getting married, Masaki breaks his arm in an accident. He can't manage any of the housework, and Jo sends his sister, Ai, to come over to help. It's been 12 years since Masaki last saw Ai. He's shocked to see that she has become a tall, handsome, male high school student! Masaki is unable to hide his confusion when Ai says he has always loved him and wants a romantic relationship with him…!!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Afterglow
synopsis:
Higuchi Kiyotaka has hit rock bottom. Once a promising doctor on his way to becoming a cardiovascular surgeon, a traumatic incident has forced him to relocate to a rural town in Kyushu where he's relegated to practicing general medicine. Each day is a struggle to communicate with his heavily accented patients and overcome his intense feelings of guilt and depression. After an evening spent drinking himself into a stupor, he has a fateful encounter with a mysterious yakuza named Tenju, who promises to help the young doctor forget all his troubles for a night. As Higuchi finds himself drowning in unknown pleasures, he can't help but wonder—just who exactly is Tenju? And what does he want from him?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Tsuihou Kizoku wa, Hazure Skill "Kodai Shoukan" de Eirei-tachi to Henkyou Ryouchi wo Saikou suru: Eirei-tachi wo Shoukan shitara Shitawareta node, Saikyou Ryouchi wo Tsukuriagemasu
title_japanese: 追放貴族は、外れスキル【古代召喚】で英霊たちと辺境領地を再興する～英霊たちを召喚したら慕われたので、最強領地を作り上げます～
synopsis:
Dilluk received a useless skill known as "Ancient Summoning," but he managed to work his way up to be the king's advisor anyway. But then he was demoted to be the lord of a village in ruin in the middle of nowhere, all because of a co-worker's scheme. When he witnesses the sorry state of his new territory, "Ancient Summoning" awakens! He summoned a hero from 4000 years ago! The heroes have unbelievable powers and he will work with them to create the greatest territory!

(Source: Starts Shuppan, translated)

title: The Edge of Ambiguity
synopsis:
For Shin Soo-young, school is nothing more than a place to study. He's there to get good grades, get into a good university, and get himself a good enough job so that he can help his family. He's certainly not looking to make friends. You see, for Soo-young, human relationships are...uncertain. And because they're uncertain, they're unsafe. Tae Jihwan, on the other hand, swans through life without a care in the world. He's got it all: money, good grades, and more friends than any one person could truly need. And yet, he seems to have his eye on becoming friends with Soo-young as well. No matter how hard he tries, Soo-young can't figure out what Jihwan wants from him, but the other boy is nothing if not persistent. Slowly but surely, Soo-young starts to let his walls come down, but just how long can he keep his balance on the edge of all this ambiguity...?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Mega Rosalia
synopsis:
She is the true villain, strong, cruel and relentless, who will kill anyone who gets in the way of her desire for glory. Manipulate a witch with the power to go back in time to deceive and kill the other rival nobles. A fantasy full of intrigue and suspense that aspires to reach the queen's throne from the bottom!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Géricault
synopsis:
In early 19th century France, Napoleon's First Empire collapsed and the Bourbon monarchy was restored. The renowned genius painter Théodore Géricault exhibited the painting "The Raft of the Medusa" at that time.

A realistic depiction of the tragic accident in which the French sailing frigate, "Méduse," ran aground on a sandbank off Mauritania. A work that generated a real stir among the public.

With a composition based on historical records and dynamic drawings, this work dramatically portrays the life of the "pioneer of modern art" in search of the essence of art.

title: It's Just Business
synopsis:
"A love life? Give me a break." A complete non-believer when it comes to romance, Eunho is focused on climbing the ladder at work. Smart with excellent social skills to boot, both her bosses and clients love her. But when a new hire suddenly appears in front of her and an old first love start to shake things up again, she can't help but waver.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: I Just Want My Happy Ending!
title_english: I Just Want My Happy Ending!
title_japanese: 파혼한 영애는 엔딩 외엔 집착하지 않는다
synopsis:
My fiancé just broke off our engagement, but I'm done crying over pathetic guys. I don't need a man to lead me to victory—I'll find my happy ending on my own! I've been trapped in a fantasy dating sim for three years and still haven't reached a good ending. After all, it's hard to win when I'm Serdel Loeveste, a forgettable side character. In this next playthrough, I'll have to take more risks instead of simply doing what I'm told. Will I finally be able to escape the game this time?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Ryman Meets Host
title_japanese: リーマンミーツホスト
synopsis:
Shuuichi Katayama is an office worker whose hobby is to love male idols. He has no girlfriend, few friends, and leads a dull life until he happens to stop at a host club and meets the host Yuu Tsukishiro. A simple businessman and a host on the verge of turning 30. The encounter in Kabukichou leads them to share their hobbies and life problems, and they gradually build a mysterious "adult friendship"...!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Wakaretemo Itoshikute
synopsis:
Lacey was unilaterally terminated from her marriage by Lewis after only one year. After he left, the daughter in her stomach became the center of her heart and all of her love. Nineteen years later, Lacey reunites with him on a relief mission for an incurable disease. Lewis's voice hurts stubbornly... But just by listening to it, it was as if time has been rewound, his smell and the feel of his skin coming back vividly. When he notices his daughter, he mutters bitterly, "I hoped it wasn't my child." He confesses a secret he never intended to tell in his entire life...

(Source: Harlequin, translated)

title: Dolled Up
synopsis:
Mia is a shy 20-year old college student who needs major help in the makeup department. Enter Marina, a brutally honest doll that is alive and dishes out expert advice on makeup. She offers to teach Mia everything she needs to know to create a new image for herself and win over her crush, Jack. Though Mia agrees, she finds that her journey into makeover and life with Marina complicates her love life in ways she did not expect.

(Source: SpotToon)

title: Hatsukoi Jikan.
synopsis:
1. Kumori Glass no Mukou
2-3. Little My Maid
4. Tomura to Juri
5. Love & Sick
6. Flying Start!
7. Flag Kaishuu wa Totsuzen ni (The Puzzle Pieces Are Suddenly Coming Together)
8. Re:Hatsukoi (Re:First Love)
9. Little My Maid After

title: System Rules
synopsis:
Yoon Siwoo, a master of the fighting game "Blood Fist," got something special. Even in real life, he can see a system that usually appears while playing games. Feeling bored with the game, Siwoo began to turn towards actual combat and tried to use his abilities to conquer his school, but was defeated by Snow leopard "Hong Minjae." To compete with him again, Siwoo joins the martial arts club Lalapalooza...

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Merciless
synopsis:
Do Janggon is a human weapon and former special forces spy against North Korea. When both of his arms got injured he was caught and brought to the Daesan Welfare Center, that abuses human rights and exploits labor. The doctor said it would take him a month to fully recover. So he has to hold out in the welfare center until his arms are healed.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Solo Martial Arts
synopsis:
In the realm of martial arts, you're either strong or dead. Ilyong Kim learned this the hard way after spending seven years training, only to die at the hands of a master. Resurrected in his home dimension, Ilyong's experiences have granted him the power he's sought all along. As an Awakened with no mana, Ilyong struggles getting a guild to accept him, but his fighting prowess quickly sets him apart from other new adventurers. But can he keep up with the monsters he must now face?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Drama Writer Who Reads Spoilers
synopsis:
Sixth year drama assistant writer Jang Yeon-jae. He desperately wanted and tried, but ahead of his debut, his teacher the main writer Kim Tae-jin stole his script.

"Sir! How could you do this! That's my script!"
"Yeon-jae. It is true that I was a little influenced by your ideas. But that is definitely my work."

After leaving the assistant writer job out of anger, he looked for a way to knock Kim Tae-jin down, but there seemed to be no hope. But at that moment... A miracle happened.

[You can purchase 200 characters of the script with a rating of 0.1%.]
[When broadcasting with this script, the expected average rating is 15.2%.]

[Do you want to buy?]
[Yes / No]

A must-watch the moment it airs! Assistant writer Jang Yeon-jae's high-rating drama, Drama Writer Who Reads Spoilers!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: She Will Choose Me Tonight
synopsis:
As a child, Ahrin is adopted by the wealthy Chairman Moon, but is shunned by his family. Although her adoptive mother, Anna, hates her guts, her snooty remarks only make Ahrin's attachment to her stronger. When Ahrin grows up and discovers her ability to turn men into her minions by kissing them, she comes up with the devious plan to hold her brothers hostage and get what she wants from Anna. What results is a scandalous power struggle that threatens to topple the Moon Family's legacy! Will Ahrin succeed in taking over the family that once treated her like dirt?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Under the Shade of Wild Roses
synopsis:
Gyeongseong is a city of desire and turmoil. Within it, a flower blooms without a smile: the gisaeng Lee Sun. After 10 years, she meets again the man who took everything from her, Han Seojin.

A pain pierces her heart. Painful memories resurface with every moment. The only way to end it is to seek revenge against Han Seojin. Fate turns into a cruel connection, and a flower blossoms upon hatred. Inflicting wounds, devouring each other, and once again parting ways—all of this occurs in the melancholy city of romance, Gyeongseong.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Looking for My One-Night Villainess
synopsis:
In the novel The Highs and Lows of Leonie's Life, Liberata Bernadette is a mean villainess whose relentless bullying of Leonie Almas drives the male lead, Archduke Gerlach Cygnus, to kill her. The woman who now inhabits Liberata's body is trapped in a cycle of despair, repeatedly living and dying as a villainess no matter how she tries to steer her fate.

Expecting it to end in familiar fashion, Liberata starts her 20th life unconcerned about any consequences. However, after drinking too much at a banquet, she wakes up next to none other than Gerlach! Something has gone terribly wrong; the archduke was supposed to meet and fall in love with Leonie that very night.

As the plot has been altered, the world begins trying to destroy itself—by erasing its main character, Leonie. And to complicate Liberata's attempts at getting the novel back on track, Gerlach is indifferent toward Leonie, fully resolving to pursue the woman who stole his heart in just one night.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Addicted to You
synopsis:
On a dark, quiet night, as Se-a returns to her empty home, flickering lights reveal a man in a cap standing at her doorstep. He calls her name, and when she turns, she's stunned by the familiar face: someone she believed had died ten years ago. Letting him in sets off a chain of unraveling truths, buried secrets, and painful misunderstandings. But he's not the only one hiding something. As past and present collide, can the two mend the distance that time and silence have carved between them?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: A Kiss Before I Sleep
synopsis:
Jiho has a superpower that causes explosions whenever she gets excited, making dating and fun nearly impossible—until she discovers that touching her new neighbor, Yechan, miraculously helps her control her ability. Determined to maintain physical contact without outright harassing him, Jiho embarks on a mission to "seduce" Yechan and become his girlfriend. Along the way, ghostly advice and a whirlwind of chaos lead her to uncover the mystery of their unique connection in this unpredictable romance.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Imperfect Cinderella Story
synopsis:
Jung Eon is a maid who works in the house of a rich and powerful family. She dreams of escaping a life of servitude and saves every penny she earns. One day, she receives an unexpected proposal from her childhood friend and boss, Hyun Mae-hwa. He's as pretty as a flower, but has a horrible personality. Mae-hwa says he wants to marry her because of a prophecy that says Jung Eon has six benefactors in his destiny. She didn't realize it at the time, but the contract was truly unfair! Can Cinderella escape her unlucky prince?

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Who's That Long-Haired Senior?
title_japanese: 그 머리 긴 선배, 이름이 뭐더라?
synopsis:
Sol Song has a uniquely quirky taste in men: they absolutely must have long hair. Otherwise, she sees them as literal "stone heads," devoid of facial features. So, when her first love—and the only long-haired guy on campus—shows up with a buzz cut, she's devastated. But as they start to reconnect and emotions deepen, Sol must discover whether she likes Okseok for who he truly is or just for his hair.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: When the Mad Emperor Holds Me
title_english: When the Mad Emperor Holds Me
synopsis:
Princess Celeste has endured a life of torment under her half-brother Raf's oppressive rule. Just as she loses all hope, an unexpected opportunity for marriage appears. Batizo, the fierce emperor of the Kelenev Empire, and his enigmatic aide, Terkan, enter her life, offering a chance to escape. As Celeste finds herself caught between Batizo's wild intensity and Terkan's dark allure, a complex web of romance, jealousy, and power begins to unfold. Will Celeste navigate her way to freedom and love, or will she be ensnared by the dangerous passions that surround her?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Hongkki's Mesopotamian Mythology
synopsis:
"Who created humans?"
"Why do humans die?"
"How did love coexist with war?"

The primal curiosities of humans regarding life and death are combined with lively imagination to create mythological stories that make us laugh and cry. These myths originate from the "first myths discovered in the first civilization of humanity"!

Love, war, intrigue, adventure, and the end of the gods and the people who worship them—which originate from Mother Nature and natural disasters—ultimately convey one message to us: "Human life is beautiful because it has an end."

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Ojou, Renai no Ojikan desu.
title_english: Now, My Lady, It's Time for Romance
title_japanese: お嬢、レンアイのお時間です。
synopsis:
Ritsu, the daughter of a crime boss, is misunderstood by her coworkers at the company where she works to conceal her true identity. Although she comes off as aloof, she's actually just incredibly bad at communicating with others. The only person she can be herself around is Yaezo, the man tasked to watch over her, who enjoys teasing her to no end.

One day, her father tells her she has six months to find someone she wants to marry! Somehow, she ends up practicing her dating skills with Yaezo!  When he whispers sultrily in her ear and melts her body with his silky touch, Ritsu realizes he's definitely not acting like an employee anymore...

(Source: Renta!)

title: Togabito no Kokuin
synopsis:
"People say 'I love you' to someone. But I wonder where that love is." A beautiful boy named Mikage, who looked like a ceramic doll, appeared in front of Kanna, a young man who could not find what he was looking for. "If you want it, come to me. I will love you." This is a story of those who have committed a sin, gone off the path of humanity, and have an imprint called a "holy mark," a proof of their sin, on their bodies.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Nikoben!
synopsis:
Norimichi is in his first year in high school, and his daily life is full of being bullied. However, there is one thing in his life that he enjoys—spending his evenings making elaborate lunch boxes. The only one in his family who needs a lunch box is his father, though. One day, his father finally refuses his decorative lunch; he says that it's embarrassing to have such a cute lunch made by his son, and he thinks Norimichi needs to learn to stop doing "girly" stuff like that. Norimichi is devastated that his one happiness has been taken away, but the events of the day lead to him giving his rejected lunchbox to an unsociable girl at school, Umemiya. She is delighted by his adorable lunch box, and he is thrilled to be able to make her smile. Now he has an exciting new target for his creative lunchboxes, and maybe this first step can lead to something more!

(Source: MU)

title: Tsugou Yoku Onnanoko no Fuku dake Zetsumyou ni Tokasu Sanseiu ga Furu Machi
title_japanese: 都合よく女の子の服だけ絶妙に溶かす酸性雨が降る町

title: Sailor Fuku to Himawari
synopsis:
In order to forget her impossible love towards her foster father, she rebounds on any guy she can get her hands on, but...?

(Source: Chibi Manga)

title: Bentenbashi Minami Shoutengai Joshi Pro Wrestling!!
title_japanese: 弁天橋南商店街女子プロレス!!
synopsis:
A former women's wrestler returns to a rundown shopping district with her child. Her idea for revitalizing the shopping district is to start street wrestling!? Can this mama wrestler make it rain money!?

(Source: Shonen Gahosha, translated)

title: Izumi to Ryuu no Zukan
synopsis:
"The Dragon Book" which thoroughly covers all dragon and shows adventurers the way to their dreams. Said book is a best-seller and a representative work of Sword and Friends & Co., but its contents are based on nothing more than the the dubious stories of adventurers that haven't been verified, as a matter of fact it's riddled with mistakes. The head of the editorial department of Sword and Friends & Co. starts planning a complete revision of "The Dragon Book." Two of which who were selected are a rookie reporter with a child-like appearance, Izumi, and the beastman bodyguard, Alf. Pursuing the truth about dragons, the compiling journey begins.

(Source: Comic Natalie, translated)

title: Higeki no Heroine Buru Imouto no Sei de Konyaku Haki shita no desu ga, Nazeka Seigikan no Tsuyoi Outaishi ni Karamareru You ni Narimashita
title_english: I Abandoned My Engagement Because My Sister Is a Tragic Heroine, but Somehow I Became Entangled with a Righteous Prince
title_japanese: 悲劇のヒロインぶる妹のせいで婚約破棄したのですが、何故か正義感の強い王太子に絡まれるようになりました
synopsis:
Leia's life is turned upside down after her younger sister claims she's a cruel villain. Leia's fiancé breaks off their engagement, leaving her no choice but to throw herself into her saintly duties. But when confronted by the righteous Crown Prince Eric, she finds herself under his scrutiny. He's determined to suss out her true nature, but why does it involve living in the palace with him?!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Higeki no Heroine Buru Imouto no Sei de Konyaku Haki shita no desu ga, Nazeka Seigikan no Tsuyoi Outaishi ni Karamareru You ni Narimashita

But when confronted by the righteous Crown Prince Eric, she finds herself under his scrutiny. He's determined to suss out her true nature, but why does it involve living in the palace with him?!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Koikogare Overlap
title_japanese: 恋焦がれオーバーラップ

title: The Killer's Shopping List
synopsis:
Eunji Cha suffers from an undiagnosed medical disorder and frequently experiences violent seizures. After enduring years of abuse by her parents she wakes up from one particular episode and discovers the horrible truth behind the peculiarities of her family. The scars left on her mind after that day forever shape her character as she battles her inner demons and tries to keep her fiendish desire to murder at bay. Years down the road, her fate becomes intertwined with a man whose very nature is a stark reflection of her own. Will Eunji be able to contain the darkness within her? And will she come out on top in this perilous game of cat-and-mouse?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Killer's Shopping List
synopsis:
Eunji Cha suffers from an undiagnosed medical disorder and frequently experiences violent seizures. After enduring years of abuse by her parents she wakes up from one particular episode and discovers the horrible truth behind the peculiarities of her family. The scars left on her mind after that day forever shape her character as she battles her inner demons and tries to keep her fiendish desire to murder at bay. Years down the road, her fate becomes intertwined with a man whose very nature is a stark reflection of her own. Will Eunji be able to contain the darkness within her? And will she come out on top in this perilous game of cat-and-mouse?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Idol Be Back!
synopsis:
Anju Sakurai is a former member of the indie (underground) idol group "Aisu♡Beverage" which has disbanded. Her dreams of becoming an idol, which were once shattered, are set in motion once again when she meets the genius junior high school Vocaloid Producer, Tsubaki Kurokawa. This the story of the resurrection of underground idols whose dreams have been shattered!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: The Villainess Captured the Grand Duke
title_english: The Villainess Captured the Grand Duke
synopsis:
When I transmigrated into a novel, I did what anyone would do—propose to my favorite character, Grand Duke Reigrein. I mean, he's the perfect man, so who wouldn't want to marry him? As Schueur, I was supposed to be the villainess, but I'd rather save my honey! His Highness's special ability consumes his emotions every time he uses it, so my goal is to awaken feelings in him. So far, I've only caused him irritation and annoyance, but one day I'll make him notice me!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Otaku Onna no Naishogoto
title_japanese: オタク女のナイショごと

title: Sensei nante Daikkirai!!
title_japanese: センセイなんて大っ嫌い!!

title: Ochikobore Sprinters
title_japanese: 落ちこぼれスプリンターズ

title: Ane Tomo Reina-san
title_japanese: 姉トモ レイナさん

title: Sekai no Hate no, Mannaka de.
title_english: In the Center of the World's End
title_japanese: 世界の果ての、真ん中で。
synopsis:
I don't like to show my feelings.
I don't like getting involved with others even more.

Maho who has repeatedly transferred schools is not big on relationships, feeling that "the world stays the same whether I'm here or not." But when she meets a boy called Satonaka, her world of loneliness starts to change into one where she can connect with others.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Ghost Fixers
title_japanese: ゴーストフィクサーズ
synopsis:
Following a certain event, Mikurigaoka New Town transformed into a crucible of supernatural phenomena known as GHOSTS! In said town lives Hifumi, a middle school boy, who one day encounters a girl who just moved in...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Kono Koi wa, Minna ni wa Naisho.
title_japanese: この恋は、みんなにはナイショ。
synopsis:
1. Muteki no Kouhai ni wa Kanawanai.
2. Kaichou to Naisho no Seitokaishitsu
3. Oshinobi Date wa Sentou de
4. Kimi dake ni Tsutawaru Moji de

title: The Great Wish
synopsis:
The Empire's one and only princess. She had everything within her grasp from the moment she was born: a keen intellect, superior talents, even the position as the heir to the throne. One day, before her twentieth birthday, she begins to have dreams. These dreams show her the events that are to happen dozens of years later. She believes this foresight is a blessing from the heavens and is thankful for it. However, the more she dreams, the stranger they become. The future Sienna envisioned was nothing like this. The half-brother she despised has retaliated. Her mother, who Sienna had believed to be her absolute ally, has a hidden agenda. And finally a man who has great influence over her, both in reality and in her dreams, appears before her. Suddenly, everything around her begins to change, transforming her in the process.

(Source: Samyang CNC, translated)

title: Ablovecadabra
synopsis:
Grim, a great wizard who has left behind numerous great deeds and is etched into history and memory. For the first time, he was trying to use the magic he had always used for someone else just for himself. That's right... to summon his ideal lover! A great magician in love, an incubus king who is super strong in love, an evil dragon girl who misunderstands love, and the world's most fantastic love story set in a fantasy world. The story begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: My Exes Fell for Me
synopsis:
How awkward would it be to reunite with not one but two of your ex-boyfriends, and at the workplace nonetheless? When Nabom Han comes face-to-face with her unforgettable first love, Chajun, and her ex-boyfriend she hoped she'd never see again, Tae-o, she must learn to navigate the relationships from her past while ensuring the success of her father's struggling manufacturing business. They say you should never mix business with pleasure, but will Nabom be able to resist the temptation?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: End Roll no Ato ni wa Saikou no Tabi wo
title_english: Have a Great Trip After the End Credits
title_japanese: エンドロールの後には最高の旅を
synopsis:
Aino the Hero and Iro the Mage. After defeating the Demon King, the two women embark on a journey around the world to fulfill a promise they made long ago. This is their story after the end credits roll—the greatest adventure dedicated to each other. A heartrending, radiant road trip fantasy.

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Seal The Deal
synopsis:
What if marriage was just a business deal? Park Minho, the heir to one of Korea's largest corporations, thinks it might be the way to please his ever-discontent father. No messy feelings, no one gets hurt. To his surprise, he stumbles upon Lee Jinyoung. She might not have the conventional credentials or looks of his other potential matches, but she's on the same page about marriage. Scarred by her own past and too busy for love, Jinyoung agrees to play the part of the perfect wife and daughter-in-law in exchange for financial support. After sealing the deal on their contract, the question lingers: can their "love" story ever turn into something more?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Shin Zeon no Saikou
title_english: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Revival of Zeon
title_japanese: 機動戦士ガンダム 新ジオンの再興

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Zeon no Saikou - Remnant One
title_japanese: 機動戦士ガンダム ジオンの再興 レムナント・ワン
synopsis:
In U.C. 0092 the "Cerberus Squadron," of Newborn Neo Zeon—a Newtype unit led by Brown and Meyer—are ordered to capture Fifth Luna.

(Source: Gundam Wiki)

title: Zettai Maken no Duelist: Ansatsu Kizoku ga Dorei Reijou wo Ikusei shitara, Majutsugoroshi no Kyuukyoku Makenshi ni Sodatte Shimattan da ga
title_english: Duelists with the Absolute Anti-Magic Swords
title_japanese: 絶対魔剣の双戦舞曲〈デュエリスト〉～暗殺貴族が奴隷令嬢を育成したら､魔術殺しの究極魔剣士に育ってしまったんだが～

title: Royal Cinderella Mama: Tengaikodoku no Botsuraku Reijou wa Reitetsu Koutei ni Dekiai sareru
title_japanese: ロイヤル・シンデレラ・ママ 天涯孤独の没落令嬢は冷徹皇帝に溺愛される

title: Dark Hunter: Houkago no Futari
title_japanese: ダークハンター～放課後のふたり～

title: Samezoku e no Sasagemono: After Marriage
title_japanese: 鮫族への捧げ物 after marriage
synopsis:
"I'll give you everything you want..."

It has been a year since Avel, the son of the Tangata Clan's patriarch, married into the Miyaru Clan, a clan with shark blood.

The next chief of the Miyaru Clan, Tukiri, has taken Avel, who has a fertile female body, as an "offering" for the peace between the two clans, but in fact, he has been in love with Avel since he was a kid. Avel was living a happy marriage life, receiving the ardent love of Tukiri. However, one day, Avel's body undergoes an unexpected change...?

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Sabori nara Hokenshitsu de Douzo?
title_english: Wanna Skip School in the Infirmary?
title_japanese: サボりなら保健室でどうぞ?

title: Mesugaki ga Watashi wo Wakarase ni Kuru node Mesugaki no Chikara wo Karite Kocchi mo Wakarase ni Ikimasu.
title_japanese: 友達〈メスガキ〉が私を理解らせにくるので勝利の女神〈メスガキ〉の力を借りてこっちも理解らせにいきます。
synopsis:
The protagonist Iroha is no good at either studies or sports, which is why her classmate Hifumi (a bratty girl) is always making fun of her. Appearing by Iroha's side is the goddess of victory Cheeky (also a bratty girl), and she lets Iroha use various special items to claim victory, but then...!? The curtain rises on bratty girl vs bratty girl setting things straight with each other!!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Busa Neko ni Kaerareta Kiyowa Reijou desu ga, Saikyou no Gunjin Koushaku ni Hirowarete Kizetsu Sunzen desu
title_english: A Timid Lady Was Turned into an Ugly Cat, but on the Verge of Fainting Is Picked Up by the Most Fearsome Military Duke
title_japanese: ブサ猫に変えられた気弱令嬢ですが、最恐の軍人公爵に拾われて気絶寸前です
synopsis:
Marie's life as a viscount's daughter is snatched away when her own sister curses her to become a cat...and then steals her betrothed! Forsaken, she collapses from hunger, when tender hands reach out—and on the other side is the undefeated duke with a reputation for being cruel and unfeeling?! Marie's turn from misfortune to a comfortable cat life begins here!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Sprite
synopsis:
Suzuho, tormented by relentless bullying, crosses paths with Raiko—a girl whose personality is a stark contrast to her own—following an unexpected motorcycle accident. Inspired by Raiko's vibrant spirit, Suzuho begins to embrace a more positive outlook on life, until she is confronted once again by her tormentors.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Fan to Off-Pako Shiteshimatta
title_japanese: ファンとオフパコしてしまった

title: "Sainou no Utsuwa" de Mezasu Meikyuu Saishinbu: Skill Yoko Nobashi no Hazu ga, Bannou Cheat Datta!
title_japanese: 「才能の器」で目指す迷宮最深部 スキル横伸ばしのはずが、万能チートだった！
synopsis:
Ryo is suddenly transferred to another world and is given the "Vessel of Talent," an ability that grants him the choice to level any skill he wants. Armed with the strongest growth cheat, he sets out to explore the labyrinth to find out why he was transferred there!

(Source: MU)

title: Suming Zhi Huan
title_english: Lord of Mysteries 2: Circle of Inevitability
synopsis: Sequel to Guimi Zhi Zhu.

title: Gobbling the Goblin
synopsis:
A most loutish goblin named Heuk-ran is the master of Goblin Mountain. He's a powerful creature who enjoys tormenting humans as if they were his personal playthings. The people tried all that they could to appease him but even the great shaman couldn't get through to him. But as he finds his next victim to satisfy his whims, will he finally be outfoxed by the clever little Yeon?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Koi no Kiseki
synopsis:
Chubby and plain, Taeko's biggest worry is whether she'll ever have the courage to tell her crush how she feels. Then one day a mysterious cousin comes to stay and Taeko's world is shattered. Cast out of her own home after her mother's death, Taeko stumbles into the night and is hit by a truck. When she wakes up, she's greeted by a doctor who promises to turn her life around. And thus begins a tale of revenge and intrigue that's a roller coaster of cracked out soap opera fun from start to finish.

(Source: MU)

Included one-shots:
Volume 8: Dareka ga Kimi wo Aishiteru, Tokyo Omnibus

title: Kore Dakara Doutei wa.
title_english: This Is Why I Can't Deal with Inexperienced Guys
synopsis:
The super popular high school guy's got the hots for his brute of a childhood friend! 

Yoruichi and Benio attend the same high school and despite being completely different types, they've been best friends since kindergarten. Benio's not bad-looking, but he's got an overbearing personality that drives girls away. Yoruichi, on the other hand, has a hot face that's got the entire female student body flocking around him constantly. Yoruichi's always had a thing for the inexperienced Benio, though, and can't help but leap at the chance to teach him how to bang a girl. Meant only as a joke, Yoruichi's shocked when Benio's curiosity takes over and the two start making out and even caressing each other! A happy-go-lucky dude with a V-card and his downer of a sensual friend engage in love-making lessons with different implications for both.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Hotchpotch Punch
synopsis:
Kiho Kuroishi is a high school girl who's an honor student at school, and devotes herself to her disabled mother at home. She is quiet and gentle, but deep down inside she has always had the urge to hit someone. As her feelings gets stronger day by day, Kiho encounters a street criminal. She snaps and unleashes her rage on the bad guy without restraint...? Here comes the JK who will revolutionize the world of women's MMA!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Ark
synopsis:
Hyunwoo is a struggling part-timer who can barely make ends meet, let alone prepare for a proper job. The only thing he excels in is online games, which contributes nothing when it comes to his search at finding a cushy job at a big-name company.

One day, he learns that "Global Exus," one of the biggest gaming companies, is using their newly developed virtual reality game, "New World," to recruit new hires. With an empty bank account, an absent father, and a sick mother to care for, the game seems like Hyunwoo's only chance to turn his life around. Gone are the days of living paycheck-to-paycheck as a failed athlete, in this "New World," Hyunwoo becomes the warrior "Ark." Will he be able to find his way to outrank the others and secure the job of his dreams?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Wind Beneath My Wings
synopsis:
Uncomfortable around people and hiding from his past mistakes, Seoha Lee moves into his grandma's house in the hopes of a bit of peace and quiet. Little does he know, his grandma has plans to take on a tenant—and not just any tenant, but a half-bird man named Shane who pays in raw gemstones and claims to have known Seoha in a past life! Whether friend or foe, this feathered fellow claims that Seoha's real name is Hearth, and that he needs to serve him for three lifetimes in order to demonstrate his virtue. Shane claims that this is the only way for Seoha—fine, Hearth—to regain his position in the heavens. The thing is, while the wings may be undeniable, there's still no proof that Shane isn't just a bird-brained lunatic. So why does he seem so familiar...?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Cuffed!
synopsis:
Youngsoo has a secret. He hates frogs. No wait, actually his real secret is...that he's gay! But things are looking up because he's finally broken free from his parents' house and gotten a place of his own. There's just one issue. His new apartment actually came with a roommate, his childhood classmate, Eunsung! And not only did he get scammed into getting a place with an unexpected roommate, it's the kid who gave him frog trauma in the first place! On top of all this, Eunsung's a cop in a unit formed to crackdown on homosexuality. Plus, Youngsoo's longtime friend, Jiho, can't help but give Eunsung the side-eye as well... Something's definitely gotta give and someone just might end up cuffed. It's just a matter of whether that's a good thing or a bad thing...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Sunnyside Daycare Classmates
synopsis:
In the far, far future...

"Jin" opens his eyes with no recollection of where or who he is. All he knows is that he's bloody, bruised, and a damn strong fighter. And just like that, Jin grows up without it occurring to him that his past is important at all. That is, until he's captured by a security company named "Scanner" and meets strange men who claim to be his former "Sunnyside Daycare" classmates. It looks like Jin's going to have to strap in for a bizarre and horrifying adventure...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Kaze to Sharin
synopsis: Included one-shot: Ani no Soushiki

title: Koi wo Suru nara Nidome ga Joutou
title_english: Fall in Love for the Second Time, Bring It On
title_japanese: 恋をするなら二度目が上等
synopsis:
Business editor Akihiro Miyata asks successful professor Takashi Iwanaga to write a column for his magazine. When they meet, Miyata realizes Iwanaga was his first love in high school—under a different last name. Iwanaga is excited to reconnect, but Miyata isn't thrilled; he cut ties with Iwanaga back then and has tried to move on. Juggling his busy life and a girlfriend, Miyata's world starts to fall apart as he has to work with Iwanaga. Can they move past the past and start fresh?

(Source: MyDramaList)

title: Bachigai na Kyuukon
synopsis:
Jake and Rachel were enemies over the custody of baby Emma. However, the court decided for them to "raise Emma together," and from that day on, they stayed at each other's houses to take care of Emma. As time goes on, Rachel realizes that Jake hides a sensitive heart behind his seemingly arrogant demeanor. And on the night she hears about his sad past, the two of them share a passionate and deep kiss, but...?

(Source: Harlequin, translated)

title: Hatsukoi Tensei Near Death Goddess
title_japanese: 初恋転生ニアデスゴッデス

title: Hazure Skill de SSS-Rank Makyou wo Ikinuitara, Sekai Saikyou no Renkinjutsushi ni Natteita: Kaiteki Kyoten wo Tsukutte Nakama to Tanoshii Isekai Life
title_japanese: 外れスキルでSSSランク魔境を生き抜いたら、世界最強の錬金術師になっていた～快適拠点をつくって仲間と楽しい異世界ライフ～

title: Unmei no Ω: Soredemo Boku wa β no Kimi wo Aisu
title_english: My Destined Omega: I'll Still Love You, My Beta
title_japanese: 運命のΩ～それでも僕はβの君を愛す～
synopsis:
Even betas and omegas can have children. With the goal of making a happy family, Tatsuki (omega) and Ryodai (beta) have been living together for three years. Just when they were at the height of their happiness and thinking about marriage, Okishima (alpha) finds Tatsuki. Feeling something different than with other alphas, Tatsuki immediately goes into heat!! With the appearance of his "destined partner," Okishima, Tatsuki and Ryodai's relationship starts to collapse. As much as he would rather be with the one he loves than the one fate has chosen for him, his body just won't listen... A heart-wrenching Omegaverse love story torn apart by fate.

(Source: Shusuisha)

title: Unrequited Love Doesn't End With Marriage
synopsis:
The moment Duke Argus saved her, a refugee, Miel fell in love. And it's been eight years since she earnestly buried that feeling in her heart...

"Marry me," he says to her, now a capable officer. "You seem to be the most steadfast."

What he wants is a contract marriage, where she will remain duchess until he can pass the title down to his nephew. As always, a cold man... He said he would take care of everything, her younger siblings' education and her family's debt, as long as she didn't produce an heir. So, she accepted it. She was able to hide her emotions from everyone until the end.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Kuu King Special
title_japanese: 喰王〈クウキング〉スペシャル
synopsis:
A mysterious Hostess club manager Mondo Kuwase, known as Kuwamon, starts working and introduces everyone to the world of local and regional food from all over the country! A new sensational gourmet manga!

(Source: Nihonbungeisha)

title: Utsukushiki Vampire
title_japanese: 美しき吸血鬼〈バンパイヤ〉
synopsis:
Lilah, an Austrian Count's daughter, is approached at a ball by Justine, an enchantingly beautiful woman of fellow Habsburg descent. The two quickly become friends, but little does Lilah know that Justine's keen interest in her may become a death sentence.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Kamen Fuufu: Onzoushi wa Konya mo Tsuma wo Aisenai
title_japanese: 仮面夫婦～御曹司は今夜も妻を愛せない～
synopsis:
Mikoto, whose grandfather was a member of the former upper ranks of society, decides to get married at a young age for the sake of her family. Kazuki, who becomes her new husband, is the son of a distinguished family, as well. He also happens to be Mikoto's first love, and took care of her when her mother passed away when she was a kid. However, when she meets Kazuki again, there is no trace of his kindness from back then, and he treats her ruthlessly from their first day of marriage. Even if he doesn't love her, Mikoto still vows to be a good wife. But then, she hears a rumor about his relationship with another woman...!? The shocking volume 1 of a thrilling romance story filled with love and hate.

(Source: Renta!)

title: Musubime wo Hodoitara
synopsis:
Yuzuru Nishina is a third-year university student who doesn't really know his own sexual orientation or what it feels like to "like" someone. While drunk at a pub he was forced to go to by a fellow seminar member, Nishina reunites with Ryousuke Hase, a tea ceremony practitioner who captivated him with his beautiful manners at tea ceremonies when he was a child. When he gets drunk and asks for love advice, Ryousuke presses him, saying, "Well, why don't you try it with me?"

Behind his carefree façade, Ryousuke is tied to the traditional family business and his family, and Yuzuru faces him honestly despite being pushed around—the path of first love that is forged by the tea ceremony.

(Source: J-Publishing, translated)

title: Chouko Soushuuhen
synopsis:
Chouko is an elegant and refined girl from a good family. However, she has two little quirks: she speaks with a slightly forced accent and she is a helpless nymphomaniac.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Kizu darake Seijo yori Houfuku wo Komete
title_english: With Vengeance, Sincerely, Your Broken Saintess
title_japanese: 傷だらけ聖女より報復をこめて
synopsis:
Lua is a saintess candidate who possesses the power of healing. But her ability had one flaw: she could only heal others by transferring their wounds onto herself. synopsis:
Yousuke is busy with his job as a model. Due to certain circumstances, he has to work with Mitsuki, who has been transferred from another company, but their first meeting ends up being a disastrous half-asleep kiss...!?

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Yankee to Caraméliser
title_japanese: ヤンキーとキャラメリゼ
synopsis:
Take one influencer and one bad boy extraordinaire, whisk in a sprinkling of sweets, a scoop of social media, and you get...? Maki and Akito's love story, hot out of the oven! After all, even though Maki might have a bit of a bad rep, the guy must be just as gooey on the inside as the glorious goodies he posts all over social media. So when Akito gets a taste of how dangerously delicious his desserts are, he can't help wanting a taste of the man himself...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Doku no Okurimono
synopsis:
Gift Hisono is a gifted painter cursed with financial woes. On the brink of finishing his latest work, his trusty palette knife suddenly snaps! In a desperate attempt to afford a replacement, he steals paint from his close friend and fellow art club member, Taima. This act of theft witnessed by another club member, Kadomi, marks the beginning of his poisonous downfall...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Akuyaku wa Koishicha Dame desu ka?
title_english: Are Villains Not Allowed to Fall in Love?
title_japanese: 悪役は恋しちゃダメですか?
synopsis:
She wasn't reincarnated as the heroine of the dating simulation game, but the villain...!

Due to her selfish, domineering personality, Mylene's fiance, prince Rendall, doesn't like her in the slightest. However, she becomes disorientated by the return of the memories of her past life, and he finds out that she's actually an innocent crybaby! Convinced that she's scheming to dump him for someone else, he gets jealous and warns her to stay away from other guys. With other key characters getting involved in the fray, what will become of Mylene's love!?

A popular academy slapstick romcom, finally put into comic form!

(Source: Renta!)

title: The Executioner
synopsis:
A hero should never kill anyone, not even the worst of villains. Gangyu could never understand why his team of heroes lived by those words, but he tried his best to do the same... until the villain who wiped out his squad killed his brother in prison. Gangyu breaks his vow and enters Ruculus with permission to kill as the prison's executioner. Now, he must fight his way through the villains to kill the worst of them all. 

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Buta-san Daisuki Nunone-chan
title_japanese: ブタさん大好きぬのねちゃん
synopsis:
Nonona-chan's friend, Nunone-chan, is a slightly unusual girl. She uses pig meat and organs, which she always carries around with her, to express her pure love for Nonona-chan. Nonona-chan likes Nunone-chan, but doesn't like pig meat and organs. One day, Nonona-chan avoided her at school, and...

(Source: GOT, translated)

title: Drama na Koi wa Kihon kara
title_english: Dramatic Love Starts from the Basics
title_japanese: ドラマな恋は基本から
synopsis:
Yuuki Shinji is an ordinary businessman, 35 years old, single, no girlfriend, living at home. He is worried about his future as a single man, but he has little experience in love and is afraid of marriage activity. But when he meets a female doctor, he falls in "love beyond his imagination," a love that turns his life upside down!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Monster Princess of the Snowy Mountain
title_english: Monster Princess of the Snowy Mountain
synopsis:
Valerie Beloff, a princess in exile, decides to take her own life on her 19th birthday. Abused by her own mother and exiled for her mother's crimes, she had to live in the freezing Makleroad palace by herself, and she somehow acquired the powers of an ancient monster—the power to freeze things. Hopeless, she seeks an escape in death... only to find herself before her cruel mother, yelling at her once again. Is she dead? Is she reliving a memory? When her mother strikes her, the throbbing pain lets her know that this is neither a dream nor a memory!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Sentimental Darling
title_japanese: センチメンタル・ダーリン
synopsis:
Ryosuke and Shun are in their fourth year of college and have been dating for five years. They've been happy together every day, and it's been smooth sailing... but lately, even when they've had sex, it's just been "good work." I want to cherish our time together! I want us to be more intimate! So Ryosuke decides to make a plan...?

(Source: Kasakura Shuppansha, translated)

Included one-shot: Neko-san Kochira, Te no Naru Hou e

title: Shinkansen Henkei Robo Shinkalion: Dive the World
title_japanese: 新幹線変形ロボ シンカリオン ダイブ ザ ワールド

title: Kotowarenai Kaichou wa Tomoe-kun ni dake Shiteagetai
title_japanese: 断れない会長は友江くんにだけしてあげたい
synopsis:
The student council president, who's large in all sorts of ways, can't refuse any request. If it's for the sake of a student, she'll try her hardest to fulfill it. Tomoe-kun, the student council vice president, constantly tries to stop her from going too far. But she wants to receive an ecchi request only from Tomoe-kun...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Koi no Chishiryou
synopsis:
He'll never forget him—his ex-classmate Yuu, that is. College student Ryousuke was absolutely devastated when Yuu confessed his feelings and then promptly disappeared from his life without waiting for a reply. After desperately searching for years, Ryousuke is overjoyed when they suddenly meet by chance. His happiness is soon eclipsed by the fact that Yuu walks off into the arms of another man...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Kitsune no Natsu
synopsis:
Norihiro returns to his hometown during summer vacation with a lingering feeling that something is calling to him. On the way back to his home, Norihiro encounters a mysterious fox man in a wedding dress waiting for him. Who is this fox and why does he want to "consummate" their marriage?!

(Source: Fantasista Inc., translated)

title: Konna Kekkon, Masaka Watashi ga Suru nante!? na Hon.
title_japanese: こんな結婚、まさか私がするなんて!?な本。
authors: Aihara, Miki|Aoki, Kotomi|Nanao, Mio|Fujio, Ai|Asada, Tomo
synopsis: Anthology by various mangaka.

title: Black and White Martial Emperor
synopsis:
The great house of the Azure Mountain Yeon clan was annihilated by forces that conspired against them. The only survivor was Yeon Hojung. Left alone in the uncaring expanse of the central plains, Hojung turned to the path of darkness for survival and ruthlessly chased power to become the Dark Emperor. After a long, bloody battle that ended in his demise, Hojung reawakens to find himself 26 years in the past with his beloved Yeon Clan and a second chance at life.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Reincarnated King of Fists
synopsis:
In a world where humans enslave non-human species, the powerful wizard Leppenhardt creates an empire to safeguard these beings. However, his reign ends when he's defeated by the brutally strong Tesron, the "King of Fists." But death isn't the end, because Leppenhardt awakens in Tesron's young body! Now armed with incredible strength and a new identity, he sets off to free the non-human races again. Can the new King of Fists reshape the world for all, or will his second chance slip away?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Watashi no Sensei wa Kao dake Kowai
title_japanese: わたしの先生は顔だけ怖い

title: Sono Uruwashiki Hito wa,
title_japanese: そのうるわしきひとは、
synopsis: Included one-shot: Watashi wa Kamisama ni Aisareteiru

title: Wail of a Dragon's Rage
synopsis:
Ananta, a descendant of one of the First Six Incarnates, can transform into an unstoppable brawling dragon whenever anything stands in his way. And it's a power he'll need in his quest to exact revenge against the Wings Incarnate, a power-hungry deceiver that resembles a heavenly angel only in appearance.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Fukumen no Hitsuji
synopsis:
Does the absence of a loved one make you feel sick? Do you miss someone enough to consider dying yourself? If that is the case, enter this building and make your way into the basement. A person wearing a strange mask awaits to solve all of your issues. Their solution? Hush. Once you leave, no one must know...

(Source: Omaké Books, translated)

title: A Knight With a Time Limit
title_english: A Knight With a Time Limit
synopsis:
Leaving behind his miserable life and untimely death, Luis Cloyde is reborn into a new world filled with fantastical beasts and adventure. The catch? He must continue killing other living beings to extend his own life. But given a second chance at life, Luis Cloyde is willing to do just about anything to survive.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Heavenly Demon's Descendant
synopsis:
Jin Suho lost his mother as a child and decided to become a hunter as he sought revenge for her. He gave his life to training himself and finally became a B-rank hunter. Then one day, Suho meets a mysterious man at a Red Gate, which appeared by chance. The mysterious man who introduces himself as the Heavenly Demon reveals to Jin Suho that Suho is his descendant and that he requires Suho's body to deal with his rival, the Blood Demon.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Myst, Might, Mayhem
synopsis:
Jeong, the Slaughtering Scythe Demon, feels joy in killing others. He happens to look just like Mok Gyeongwoon, the third young master of the Mok Sword Manor...

"Be my substitute, and I'll let you out of prison."
"That opportunity. Will you give it to me?"
Crack!!!

He kills the Third Young Master and decides to become the real one. Can the fake Mok Gyeongwoon survive as the real one? The serial killer begins his new life as the Third Young Master of the Great Mok Sword Manor.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Reincarnated Murim Lord
synopsis:
Regret is the bane of old men. When aging Alliance Lord Hajin Cheon of the Grand Martial Alliance reflects on his immense legacy, he finds that he recalls little of his deeds or even the lives of his closest advisors. Stricken by a mysterious ailment, Hajin suddenly passes away only to wake up in the body of Ridan Byeok, heir to the Byeok Clan of swordsmen. The only problem is, Ridan is a well-known wastrel, the polar opposite of the virtuous and stern Hajin. Righting the wrongs of his predecessor, Hajin begins to uncover the truth behind his death...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Demon King's Doll Butler
synopsis:
After being ripped from the spiritual world and implanted in a doll by sorcerers, Perrie's only wish is to return to the afterlife. But when dying proves to be impossible with her current indestructible body, she encounters the Demon King, who suggests that his son Julian is capable of giving her the death she desires. The only catch? She has to raise and protect him from other demons who want the throne! Will Perrie get what she wants, or will death always be out of reach for her?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Maemuki ni Shine!
synopsis:
All for the sake of love. The death-defying confession by Yuzuki Onodera, a man with an absurd destiny, begins!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: The Duke's Debt
synopsis:
In the icy lands of the North, the duke battles nightly with an uncontrollable desire that consumes him. Seeking respite, he meets a mysterious wizard who proposes a pact: to quell his urges, the duke must give up his essence for the wizard's research. But just how far are these two willing to go to help one another?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Kanpeki na Machi
synopsis: Included one-shot: Neko Sagashi

title: Legend of the Thousand Year Tiger
title_english: Legend of the Thousand Year Tiger
synopsis:
A tiger-hating hunter, a human-loving tiger, and a possessed tax collector walk into a historical webtoon. This thrilling yet passionate tale follows these three entities as they defy the foodchain and challenge the order of nature.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Futsuu to Bakemono
synopsis:
Itou, a socially awkward teenager, finds herself jealous of her classmate Takahashi, who seems to get along with everyone. However, one day, she witnesses Takahashi...eat someone whole!? That's amazing! A monster who knows how to blend right in with humans? Itou definitely needs to be her friend now!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Nemurenai kara Daitekure!
title_japanese: 眠れないから抱いてくれ!
synopsis:
Ever since Hasegawa moved into a new apartment, he has been bothered by recurring dreams "of having sex with an unknown man"...! Worried that his sleeplessness might affect his productivity at work, he reaches out to the previous resident of his new place. Once he realizes the dreams seem to be a glimpse into a future, he decides to go ahead and get it over with! He ends up asking Kuramochi, his colleague and rival at work, to lend him a hand. But he certainly did not expect the real thing to be more intense than his dreams! A love comedy between an experienced bossy extreme sadist and a serious office worker tormented by lewd visions!

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title: Chichi wo Okorasetai
title_english: May My Dad Be Angry Again.

title: Sketch: Season 1
synopsis:
First impressions are everything, right? But it doesn't seem that way when Yikyung comes across Joobin. When they first meet, Joobin is just a handsome stranger with an exciting air of mystery. Yikyung itches to draw him, to sketch out his beauty on paper like the artist he is... But at their next encounter, Joobin is a completely different person. Sensitive, outspoken, and passionate about his own work as a photographer, he proposes that Yikyung become his model. And drawn to this other side of his, Yikyung says yes. Between lens and paper, who'll be the first to sketch out the other to perfection?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Chikuwa Senki: Ore no Kawaii de Chikyuu Shinryaku
title_japanese: ちくわ戦記～おれのカワイイで地球侵略～

title: Negai no Astro
synopsis:
As the battle to decide the next leader of the Yotsurugi gang that runs Asakusa is heating up, a meteorite strike suddenly awakens superpowers in the people of Japan. How will Hibaru Yotsurugi, the son of the previous gang leader, come out of this?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Negai no Astro
synopsis:
As the battle to decide the next leader of the Yotsurugi gang that runs Asakusa is heating up, a meteorite strike suddenly awakens superpowers in the people of Japan. How will Hibaru Yotsurugi, the son of the previous gang leader, come out of this?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Kyokutou Necromance
synopsis:
One day, Kaoru Uno suddenly starts seeing mysterious monsters known as shiryo or death spirits. With the arrival of his late father's coworker Youji Amane and a special ring his father gave him, Kaoru is ushered into the world of necromancers!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Psych Biyori
synopsis:
Psych House—a special home set up for those with supernatural powers. One day, Nemuru, a boy with a Psych that allows him to change size, invites Kotone, a girl with a teleportation Psych, to live at Psych House. The mysterious but normal days of those with psychic powers now begins!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Heimin Shusshin no Teikoku Shoukan, Munou na Kizoku Joukan wo Juurin shite Nariagaru
title_english: The Rising of the Commoner-Origin Officer: Beat up All the Incompetent Noble Superiors!
title_japanese: 平民出身の帝国将官、無能な貴族上官を蹂躙して成り上がる

title: I Thought I Tamed the Villain
title_english: I Thought I Tamed the Villain
synopsis:
After a close call with death, Iris has a sudden revelation: she's been living inside a novel from her past life. But if her memory's correct, all the characters in the novel, herself included, ultimately meet their demise at the hands of the villain, Theo. Determined to survive, Iris resolves to befriend Theo in hopes of reforming him while he's still young. At first, everything seems to go according to plan... But when she reunites with him ten years later, she realizes something's gone terribly wrong. Why is the same ruthless villain she saw in the novel... standing before her?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Raul to Kyuuketsuki
synopsis:
As a young orphan, Raul was adopted and saved by the effeminate, eternally youthful vampire Rose. Since then, he's wanted nothing more than to help and protect his vampiric savior. His conviction—and training—has helped him grow into a strong, muscular young man. However, no matter how much Raul grows, Rose can't help seeing him as that little orphan boy...

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Happy Birthday, Sayonara
title_japanese: ハッピーバースデー、さよなら
synopsis:
"Every morning, I give birth to an identical copy of myself."

This is a story of love and hate, set within a bizarre fantasy.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Mother Crisis
title_japanese: マザー クライシス

title: Tunnel Nuketara Miakezaka
title_japanese: トンネル抜けたら三宅坂

title: Strongest Fighter
synopsis:
Woken up from a date, he's suddenly in a movie set? Wait, he's been reborn as a baby martial artist! In Jongnam Clan, which was once one of the 9 strongest clans, he receives the name "Gunchung" and uses the knowledge of his past life to learn the true meaning of martial arts. When your perspective is different, your martial arts changes. Armed with knowledge, Gunchung brings about a new age of martial arts!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Reincarnator
synopsis:
God created the Abyss to escape his boredom. Trapped in the hellish Abyss, humanity was on the path to the apocalypse...

"Is it over for us... now..."

On the brink of humanity's annihilation, the four strongest survivors tried to prevent it by traveling back in time to the point just before humanity was pulled into the Abyss. But only one of them could go back to the past.

“What's there to think about? Isn't it already decided who's going? The strongest among us, Kang Hansoo."

This is the story of the life of the legendary powerhouse, Kang Hansoo, who returned to save humanity from its doom. Will he be able to save everyone?

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Katsute Onnanoko Datta Hitotachi e
title_english: Dear Girls Who Have Grown Up
title_japanese: かつて女の子だった人たちへ
synopsis:
"I want this man for myself." Nails, makeup, hair... Remi, an office worker, doesn't slack off when it comes to investing in herself. The reason she's willing to go this far? To snag a man who's worthy of her, of course. One day, her childhood friend, Yumi, asks Remi to check out a man that she is interested in and introduces them. Much to her surprise, Takashi is ideal husband material, and the perfect high-caliber man that Remi has been looking for! She immediately decides that she'll make him hers, no matter what. And Takashi doesn't seem too put off by Remi flaunting her good looks his way... What will come of this greedy love affair?! A collection of stories about girls and their lives now that they're all grown up.

(Source: Starts Shuppan)

title: Meshibe no Album

2-4. Meshibe no Album
5-7. Uta wa Tomodachi

title: Battle Beast
synopsis:
One day, the two siblings, a hyena and a rabbit, are abducted by underworld residents and forced to participate in a battle royal. On an uninhabited island teeming with large beastmen, they must use their individuality as a weapon to overcome their opponents!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title: Chokozai Utsuwa
synopsis:
Higuchi, a management consultant, is assigned to the loss-making pottery shop "KONNO," but is annoyed from day one by the cocky attitude of the third generation president's younger brother, Yuichiro. While working there, Higuchi finds out why Yuichiro treats Higuchi so poorly. Although Higuchi is aware that Yuichiro hates him, he gradually becomes more and more attracted to him as he sees Yuichiro's dedicated and earnest attitude toward pottery manufacturing...

(Source: MediBang/Media Do International)

Included one-shot: Tomo to Koi (Love and Friendship)

title: Buchou to Shachiku no Koi wa Modokashii
title_english: Love Between a Manager and a Corporate Drone Is Frustrating
title_japanese: 部長と社畜の恋はもどかしい
synopsis:
Maru is a corporate drone who lacks the concept of leisure time. After the company's drinking party, Maru wakes up at a love hotel with Teiji, known as the "manager who always clocks out on time". In contrary to his straight-laced nature, Teiji turns out to be sweet, gentle and affectionate in bed...How could she not fall for that! Yet, the next day, he recalls the night with a simple, "we're grown-ups" statement?!

(Source: Bunkasha)

title: Tokyo no Gal jakee!
title_japanese: 東京のギャルじゃけぇ!

title: Mashounen B.T.
synopsis:
Middle schooler Koichi Mugikari befriends the "Wicked Boy" B.T. after the latter saves him from a pair of extortionists. The two end up becoming involved in an incident with an arsonist live streamer.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Migawari no Hanayome wa Yandere Ryoushu ni Torawareru
title_english: The Substitute Bride Is Captured by the Yandere Lord
title_japanese: 身代わりの花嫁はヤンデレ領主に囚われる
synopsis:
Lara, a nobleman's daughter, was sent to the castle of Lord Walter in the place of her older sister who eloped. Lara expected to be treated cruelly, but for some reason, Walter became intensely attached to her, as if his engagement with her sister had never happened in the first place... An other-world yandere love fantasy!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Love Affair
synopsis:
To uncover her brother's death, she must betray the person she loves. Lee Sunwoo, a live-in trainer who infiltrates to uncover the truth, and Seo Mundo, an arrogant but charming third-generation conglomerate. A hot love affair between two people who keep getting entangled yet are unable to part ways.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

Despite the fact that his ex-girlfriend left due to him constantly working overtime, Yoshihito Naoe doesn't think of himself as enslaved by his company. Between living for his job and providing for his beloved hamster Hanako, one thing that always helps relieve his stress is following the social media account of a cat named Goma. But it turns out that his favorite cat idol and their owner are much closer than he'd ever imagined...?

(Source: Mexico, translated)

title_japanese: 異世界で愛されすぎて困ってます! 異世界BLアンソロジー

title: Door no Mukou ni wa Romance
title_japanese: ドアの向こうにはロマンス
synopsis:
When Kagami calls an escort service to a hotel one night, the guy who shows up at his door turns out to be precisely his type. But his elation at this stroke of luck soon vanishes as he realizes that Minato is, in fact, a food delivery boy who has come to his room by mistake. Unable to pass up this one-time chance, Kagami plants a kiss on Minato as a joke... But when Minato serendipitously shows up at his house the next day, Kagami finds himself drawn more and more to this sweet and straightforward boy...

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

title: Wakeari Joshi wa Yoru no Ecchi de Shirokuro Tsuketai
title_japanese: 訳アリ女子は夜のエッチで白黒つけたい

title: Boku no Ikezu na Konyakusha
synopsis:
Miyuki-san is an elegant young lady from Kyoto. But our relationship is complicated. Why? "My, you sure are good at flattery," she says. But were those words sincere? Or just for show? Though we care for each other, we keep talking past one another—a frustrating, bittersweet love story.

(Source: Bushiroad Works)
