title: Akumade Amai Watashi no Kanojo
title_japanese: あくまであまい私の彼女
synopsis:
Mai Amatsuka, a girl who loves sweets, is heartbroken after being dumped by her girlfriend. One day, she falls in love at first sight with Riri Kurosaki, a beautiful girl who has just arrived as a new waitress at the café she works at. However, Riri turns out to be a demon called a succubus? Mai shouldn't fall in love with her, but she can't forget her super sweet kiss! A cute and devilish girls' love comedy begins!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Stowing himself away on a slave ship, Julian sets sail for the great continent with a hundred slaves, all yearning for freedom, until...?! Embark on a groundbreaking journey through this action-packed dark fantasy saga!!

The year is 20xx. Machine and Man have been waging a war with no end in sight. Amidst all the violence, the machine army decided the leader of humanity, Ootani Akira, ought to be erased from existence, so they send an assassin back in time to eliminate him!

Armed with knowledge about the novel's world, Heli sets out on a quest to gather friends and past enemies to create a martial arts force strong enough to defy the fate he was given... or literally die trying.

This is a 4 koma comedy about a teacher that sometimes gets pushed around, but slowly but surely comes into her own!

One day, Koume finds a piece of paper with a spell to see the future 10 years from now, and out of curiosity to see who will be next to her, she tries out the spell. Then she sees her baby's reflection in the mirror...! What's more, the baby pops out from the other side of the mirror! With Mao's help, Koume decides to raise Ai, her future baby!

Jinmong wants to make Haneul his bride, but she doesn't believe in his existence. They begin a fateful and destined romance, but what will be their ending?

Determined to overcome her fears and make amends for failing her sister, Hsiao-han joins a CliniClown training program. Through the course of the class work, practice performances, and collaboration with fellow trainees, Hsiao-han finds that not only can she bring smiles to faces of sick children, she can also gradually relinquish the burden of her own guilt.

A collaboration between author Feng Shi and Golden Comic award winner Cory Ko, CliniClowns is adapted from the real-life experiences of CliniClowns from Dr. Rednose Association. With warmth and charm, Cory Ko's art gently guides readers into a tale rich with both laughter and tears.

synopsis:
"You can keep drawing manga as long as you do the chores!" Natsume Kanazawa is a 28-year-old manga artist. She draws manga professionally, but it hasn't been going well. When her live-in boyfriend asks her to accompany him to India on the premise of marriage, she decides to go along. That is where Natsume has a fateful encounter with a local girl. While bearing a frustrated expression, the girl mutters, "In India, it's normal for women to quit their jobs after getting married." They may be from different countries and speak different languages, but they appear to have similar struggles. Natsume takes the first step and embarks on a life-changing adventure. "Why do I need your permission to draw manga?!"

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

Loneliness is like poison, I have nothing, I'm a failure, I'm a failure, and so on... In a social networking site where girls vent their pain, she comes across a rumor of "Courtship Girl Syndrome," which only teenage girls are affected by. She thought it was just a myth, a disease with a cute name and symptoms like those of a manga character. However, the abnormalities that began to occur in the girl's body as a result of a certain problem are very similar to the rumors...?

In order for ordinary office worker Han Da-yeon to successfully arrange the project that will save her company, she becomes the secretary to her former classmate, Lee Ji-an, at his request. Now she has to work from home with the guy who ruined her first kiss back in high school! But, Da-yeon finds out that she was Ji-an's first love, and as Ji-an doesn't hide how he feels, the two get closer...

University student, Rintarou, is in love with his rental boyfriend, Asahi. Knowing that it is all pretend doesn't stop his heart from racing when confronted by Asahi's kindness. Every time they meet, his feelings continue to grow stronger. One day, as Rintarou finds himself unable to make another rental appointment out of concern he won't be able to stop his feelings from growing, he stumbles across Asahi in town. While Rintarou is taken aback by the uncharacteristically serious look on Asahi's face, Asahi starts leaning in for a kiss...?!

"Become the heroine while remaining a boy!" Friendship? Love? A happy, heart-pounding comedy about a boyish girl!!

Dumped by her boyfriend and fired from her job, Jineon, her family's breadwinner, has no time to cry over the spilled milk. She must find another job and fast. Enter The Hell, a mysterious company with great pay, excellent work-life balance, and an easy commute! What more could she ask for? Or so she thought. Little did she know, she had walked into hell—literally. How will she navigate the harrowing journey in the hellscape of her new job with King Yeomra, her stunning new boss, further complicating everything? Could love blossom in this pit of hell?

title_english: I'll Give You the Most Rotten One
synopsis:
After 10 years together, my boyfriend cheated on me with another woman. Devastated, I decided to get revenge. I wanted to hurt him as much as he hurt me. Thus, I carefully planned the perfect way to get back at him. Our relationship was already over, but this was the final nail in the coffin. Now, we're both left wondering if we'll ever be able to love again.

I don't know if I can forgive him, but I know that I can't live like this. I need to find a way to move on, even if it means hurting him in the process. This is wrong, but I can't help myself. Consumed with anger, I just have to make him feel the same way. Even if this isn't the answer, it's all I can do. 

I just want to feel loved again, to feel happy. Is that too much to ask?

title: Dawn of the Dragon
synopsis:
The days of supernatural mixing with human are long gone, but a fortunate few receive the blessings of spirits even in 21st-century Korea. Such is the affluent Yooshin Group, whose patron deity is the great dragon. As long as they serve the dragon, the Yoo family will prosper. However, when the dragon awakens from his centuries-long slumber, he intends to abandon the family to reunite with his reincarnated mate.

To save his sister from an early marriage—and to a dragon at that—Yoo Taehyuk, the CEO of Yooshin Hotels, decides to approach the dragon in a businesslike fashion. Instead of some overwhelming divine presence, the dragon is a young man named Hyo-un, recovering from his weakened dormant state and tormented by his inability to remember his mate. Still, Taehyuk persists, pretending to be Hyo-un's past lover, even when Hyo-un ignores him—but a mystical force binding them together may prove that their meeting was written in the stars after all.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Love Plan

"Why am I naked in bed with another man...?" Jaewoo reluctantly attends his high school reunion and he can't wait to leave. But after seeing someone he thought he'd never meet again, he ends up drinking himself into a stupor. The next day, Jaewoo wakes up next to Siyeon, the boy that was pining after him throughout high school. This is Siyeon's chance to pounce! He offers Jaewoo a deal, one month of dating, after which things can end amicably, no questions asked. But as rumors start spreading about the circumstances surrounding the reunion, Jaewoo starts becoming suspicious of Siyeon's true intentions...

Setting forth on a quest to break the binding contract, Sig, along with his newfound companions, navigates through a web of conspiracies and unexpected challenges. As the journey unfolds, the pressing question remains: Can Sig break free from their bond, or is he destined to be forever entangled with these demonic blades?

(Source: Tapas Media)

synopsis:
A child was abandoned in a forest infested with monsters and ghosts. Woon Sowol was adopted by the five masters and learned the best magical techniques. Although the five masters are godly beings, now their inner balance is on the verge of being broken down. Woon Sowol takes revenge on behalf of his masters, and goes to the world to become a god. In the end, will Sowol be able to get out of the forest of beasts?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

The young police woman, Kisato Yamori, is transferred to a new city, but soon finds that work under her new senpai, Mahira, is not what she expected.

Officer Urashima is a newbie in the police's "Oni Department." where she joins the veteran Aio. The purpose of this department is to investigate crimes related to a mysterious drug called "Oni."

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Divine Delivery
synopsis:
Enter the world of Hajun Lee, just your average delivery guy trying to make ends meet. But when he's summoned to Olympus for a special delivery, his life takes an unexpected turn. Suddenly, he's the personal delivery man for the gods, earning big bucks and upgrading his gear with each risky delivery. Follow his daring escapades through dungeons and battles with monsters as he learns to outsmart them all. From one divine job to the next, Hajun faces it all with wit and guts. But can he keep up the hustle of being a regular delivery guy while also serving the mighty gods?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Shijin-sou no Satsujin Series
title_japanese: 屍人荘の殺人シリーズ
synopsis:
A dozen students decide to rent a boarding house in the mountains. A nearby bioterrorism event results in the house being surrounded by zombies. Initially they are repelled by the occupants using swords and spears, but then a murder occurs inside a room locked on the inside. A human could not have made the bite marks that killed the victim, but a zombie could not have got into the room to make them.

More murders occur. Theories abound, but are knocked down as soon as they are proposed. The solution is an extraordinary exercise in deduction.

(Source: Locked Room International)

title: Duchess's Lo-Fi Coffeehouse
synopsis:
Loanna was raised in neglect and isolation as an illegitimate child of the Count Louis family. She gets married off to Duke Bruggen, who orders her to keep quiet and out of the way. Free from all expectations or responsibilities, she roams around the castle and runs into a coffee bush. A passionate barista in her past life, Loanna remembers exactly how to brew a perfect cup of Joe. The trouble is, no one in this realm seems to know what "coffee" is, nor its wonderful benefits. As a matter of fact, coffee fruits are regarded as "evil." As a coffee aficionado, Loanna is determined to turn this reputation around.

(Source: NHN comico)

title: Hortensia Saga
title_japanese: オルタンシア・サーガ
synopsis:
A violent rebellion in the capital led by Duke Rugis Camellia wreaks havoc on the Kingdom of Hortensia, leaving every member of the royalty either dead or missing. Barely escaping with his life, knight Maurice Baudelaire flees the ensuing chaos after his brother, Fernando Albert, is killed by a werewolf in battle. 

To honor his legacy, Maurice treks to Albert's house and delivers his son, Alfred Ober, his father's sword. Despite his grief, Alfred is reminded of a vow he pledged with his father—to become a knight so that he could protect his land, the Albert Dominion.

He doesn't laugh at Saku's fantasies and listens to them sincerely, and if Saku is nearby, he'll go to him without fail. (Source: MangaDex)

title: The Genius Idol's Celebrity Strategy
synopsis:
On Haje, a once-in-a-thousand-years handsome trainee. After turning down a sponsorship offer and losing the chance to debut, He vowed never to set foot in the entertainment industry again. So why was he chosen by an idol-nurturing game system???

No money, no house, no knowledge. Haje's experienced nothing but toil and moil in this new life of his. From finding hidden talents and growing to be a respectable idol, to playing mental tug of war against the callous system and even investigating the past of the possessed character. Haje was busy running around doing this and that!

"This is no good, I'm having fun."

The unexpected behavior of Kaibara, a staunch muscle-training fanatic, has Hatakeyama at her mercy, but can trips with Kaibara be an appealing idea? His client? Tae-oh Seo, a dominant alpha who can't sense pheromones. Dobin has worked hard to protect his virginity, but for that salary... anything goes! So, Dobin leads a secret double life as Tae-oh's secretary by day and his therapist by night. As the two spend more time together, something is in the air—and not just pheromones!

Kaede, a high school student, has won first place in an art contest with a painting of her favorite food, basashi. The painting was hung up at her school, making her instantly become the talk of the town. Even the scary-looking boy, Satomi, has taken notice of her work. Satomi actually has a secret he can't tell anyone…! Could basashi really be the thing that brings these two together?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Harapeko Shoujo to Tantei to

Ritsuka Haruno (20 years old) is a chuunibyou detective who loves the mystery novel "Madness Detective." With Oto, a dog-like assistant with a big appetite and a keen sense of smell, will Ritsuka be able to expertly solve numerous cases? Replacing him is Kasahara, a man with a soft smile and an air of unreliability. Former idol and manager; a chance encounter with destiny.

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

title: Acanthus
synopsis:
"Shouldn't children pay for the sins of their parents?" After being molested as an orphan by the chairman of a large conglomerate, Nagi has spent his entire life seeking vengance. When he is just one step away from finally getting his revenge, Chairman Kang suddenly dies. Nagi's quest for vengeance turns to Chairman Kang's son, Hosu. Will Nagi succeed or will an unexpected speedbump throw a wrench in his plans?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Psycho-Pass 3
synopsis:
Centered around two rookie inspectors of the Ministry of Welfare's Public Safety Bureau (MWPSB); Arata Shindou and Kei Mikhail Ignatov. These two inspectors are confronted with an ever changing society under the jurisdiction of the all knowing and impartial system of collective consciousness known as Sibyl and a contradiction that exists solely to evince the imperfections of the Sibyl system. Contending with an increasing anti immigrant sentiment, political intrigue, as well as peculiar individuals who exist solely to test the Sibyl system, these two inspectors are confronted with two choices, which are to either follow or overturn the system.

(Source: ANN)

title: Psycho-Pass 3: First Inspector
synopsis:
Tokyo, 2120. In a society overseen by the Sibyl System, Inspectors Arata Shindou and Kei Mikhail Ignatov of the Criminal Investigation Department's Unit One clash over truth and justice. Kouichi Azusawa, the mastermind behind a string of crimes, sets his sights on the CID itself and launches an assault on the NONA Tower. Division 01 (a.k.a. Unit One) is in peril like never before—a case that will try Shindou and Ignatov's loyalties.

(Source: Psycho-Pass Wiki)

With nothing to lose, Adelia makes the perilous journey to become the empire's first white mage in 300 years. Why? To have the crown prince marry her so she can have the power to get revenge on her abusive family, of course! And once she becomes a member of the imperial family, Adelia can live happily receiving the love of her favorite character, Princess Ariana. He was already frustrated that he had reincarnated as a loser, but on top of that, the transfer student is an intermediate/mid-tier boss who will destroy the world!

"Why are you being so nice to me?"

Do Kyunwoo's plan is to become friends with the transfer student in order to prevent the end of the world! The goal is to survive in this new world and to reach an ending he desires. To these ends, he becomes best friends with the mid-level boss.

At first, Zenon seems to be an arrogant person, but after seeing a surprising side to him, Nicholas begins to open up to him. However, he's constantly giving his blood through transfusions, and begins to worry that Zenon cannot feel the pleasure of drinking blood directly.

title: My Crazy Boyfriend

"Please be my friend."

Suzu, a young man searching for his missing brother, gets tangled up with Yakuza, but ends up being saved by Hana, a mysterious and beautiful boy. Suzu works with Hana to find his younger brother, but he almost gets drawn to the innocent looking Hana... Is this friendship? Obsession? Or maybe... love? A pure and dangerous crime love story between a clumsy young man and a handsome yakuza boy!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Kokuhou
synopsis:
Set after the war in Japan, when the country experienced rapid economic growth, Kikuo is born into a yakuza family. His strange fate leads him to be eventually taken in by a kabuki theater actor. He experiences turbulent times, but his talent as a kabuki actor blossoms.

title: Secret Therapist

Shino is the owner of a brothel that offers women a therapy service. Wanting to show that he can treat men as well as women, he participates in a television show and meets a young actor named Izuki.

Using all his know-how, Shino discovers that the young actor is a premature ejaculator and tells him that he will let him ejaculate as long as he wants to make him feel better. Izuki, who wants to appear seductive but is actually rather naive, finds himself falling prey to Shino's sweet words. This is how a gentle therapy begins between the charismatic Izuki and the handsome therapist Shino!

synopsis:
Malt Arcane is a "Tamer" whose ancestors are heroes of the human race. When Malt goes to defeat monsters, he is attacked by two low rank demon Succubi! When he activates his skill on them, they both undergo a mysterious change... The Hero, now branded as a failure and exiled from his home, begins to explore the demon territory accompanied by the two Succubus, Filei and Miru...!

Ahn Shiyun is a pitcher who doesn't mind his team losing streak, as long as he can play baseball. After continuing his dream in middle school, his life begins to change when he meets Baek Tae-Oh, a catcher of the opposing team. This is the story of amazing people who can throw powerful winning shots at the top of high school baseball's elite!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: A Flame Reborn
synopsis:
Logan MacLine, a middle-aged knight fighting for the independence army, is intent on getting revenge against the empire which took over the kingdom and executed his brother when he ends up dying in battle. But when he wakes, he is a young man again, and has yet to be disowned for his terrible behavior. Using his experience and knowledge from his past life, Logan recruits a few talented individuals to develop new weapons, build an army, and make enough money to fund it all. But will he be able to make amends with his family and stop the empire's march?

She spends her days drowning her sorrows in alcohol. Eventually she meets Haruyuki Isato, a handsome neighbor, and can feel herself beginning to fall in love again. It turns out that the apartment that Tsukasa is living in is haunted by Haruyuki's late wife.

The manga is set in a fantasy world that has vanquished its evil lord and gained peace 60 years ago, and now the hero that led the band that saved the world is in dire straits. Now in retirement age, he is as powerful as ever, but has forgotten so much. The country's leadership is troubled about how to manage the hero, but a certain incident puts him and a maid to tour the world.

(Source: ANN)

title: Tonari no Koroshiya-chan
title_japanese: となりの殺し屋ちゃん
synopsis:
Once upon a time, there was a legendary contract killer called the Crimson Devil. She is now...working at a small bakery! A story of girls' friendship and violence!

Ako Yamada, once a member of the most fiendish organization of assassins "Orochi," is living as an ordinary girl working at the Piping Hot Bakery. As an assassin, she was evil, cold-blooded, cruel, scary. The epitome of a hitman! However, she was extremely clumsy when it came to normal life! She was struggling to live as a teen girl working at a bakery, for she had lived too many years in the underworld.

When Nono Morino, a high school girl who loves urban legends, came to the bakery to check on the rumor that a hitman is living somewhere around here, Ako did her best not to look suspicious. But not only her but also the members of Orochi were after Ako. Can she live a peaceful life she had longed for many years?!

(Source: Kadokawa)

title: Terao: The Next Generation Machine

On top of that there's a weird robot among the students. Blue sky and sea, with the energetic children, the village chief who is proud of his strength, and a female doctor rumored to be a beauty. Surrounded by nature and the islanders with unique personalities, a clumsy teacher's exciting daily life begins!

The manga's story centers on Akuto and his magical girl older sister Shiny, who fights a mysterious monster called "Acrylamide" that threatens the human world, after a meteorite crash. Akuto supports his sister's efforts as a magical girl, but then she commits suicide after defeating an Acrylamide. In an effort to escape the power struggle within the Heavenly Demon Sect, the protagonist Myeong-un retreats to a life of seclusion. However, simply avoiding ambition for the throne is not enough to avert tragedy. Myeong-un flees from the sect leader Myeong-gak, who seeks fratricide, before meeting his demise. At the moment of his death, as his consciousness fades, he hears a voice. "Do you regret it? Do you wish to fight again?" To his surprise, Myeong-un, believed to be dead, opens his eyes once more...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Hazure Zokusei Tsuchi Mahou no Sei de Henkyou ni Tsuihou sareta node, Gangan Ryouchi Kaitaku shimasu!
title_japanese: ハズレ属性土魔法のせいで辺境に追放されたので、ガンガン領地開拓します！
synopsis:
Ecto, the third son of the Margrave of Glenreed, is given the skill of earth magic during his coming-of-age ceremony. Earth magic is not suited to combat and is a so-called "useless attribute." He is disowned and appointed as the lord of the extremely remote village of Boda. However, thanks to "a certain secret," Ecto has devised a way to use earth magic that ordinary people would never think of! Together with his companions, including his female adventurer party "Advance Wings," he defeats monsters, clears forests, cultivates fields... Thanks to earth magic, Boda Village achieves remarkable development!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title: Villain Classroom
synopsis:
As a meek high school student, Heo Jeong-woo is used to incessant bullying. No different from his middle school, all sorts of violent people and dangerous cliques prey on the weak. However, a sudden shift in power comes with a new transfer student, Han Bora. Unbothered by the remarks about an unsightly birthmark on her leg, Bora assaults her would-be bullies with shocking force and cruelty, requesting one thing: the identities of those who know a girl named Han Sena.

Jeong-woo attended the same middle school as Sena, so he remembers her story—she was nearly killed by bullies and has disappeared since. Desperate to escape his daily hell, Jeong-woo gives up the names of the four students who terrorized Sena. But he must be careful not to stand in Bora's way, as she is unpredictable and incredibly brutal, and all she wants is bloody revenge.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Avidya
synopsis:
Julyoung looks human to the untrained eye, but is actually half human-half fox. His life consists mainly of curing the ailments of the sick. Him, and Poongwon, the girl who he took in as a child and raised as his own, not only save the lives of others but also help solve strange mysteries. After a reunion with his old friend Moojin, Julyoung aka Dr. Jul finds himself embroiled in another incident!

(Source: Netcomics)

title: The Sound of the Moon Moving
Anti Lady
synopsis:
The women of our time who want to live elegantly as ladies, but in reality, they are not elegant, comfortable, or even treated well... Damn this world, why are you so unkind to me! Is there any place where I can live happily? The struggling life of an ordinary woman thrown into a dizzying modern society!

(Source: Seoul Media Comics, translated)

title_japanese: 土下座少女の下剋上 ～生贄リベンジゲーム～
synopsis:
In a mysterious school, there is a class where students with the lowest grades are sent, named the "isolated class." Akari, an ordinary female student, falls into the "isolated class" due to her friend's betrayal, where she is exposed to irrational senseless violence! However, she stands up to the members who dominate the class with an unyielding heart. At the same time, Akari joins forces with Yuuto, another student who has fallen into the segregated class, and vows to climb out of this mess...

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

title: Kami no Niwatsuki Kusunoki-tei
synopsis:
Deep in the countryside, Minato Kusunoki is left in charge of a terrifying house overflowing with evil spirits—or at least it was, until his extraordinary ability cleared them all out! Instead, a procession of unique and peculiar gods is drawn to the comfort of the purified Kusunoki residence, and Minato spends his days relaxing in the company of his spiritual neighbors. What else lies in store for Minato as he lives peacefully surrounded by gods?

(Source: Yen Press)

synopsis:
I used to have a classmate with a shaved head. I was always touching it and teasing him. Now, years later, my classmate grew his hair out and became a celebrity that I see on TV and in magazines...

synopsis:
The company Namihara joined is an exploitative IT business. When she thinks of her dim prospects as a working member of society... she finds her internal thoughts and external voice switched! She defies her exploitative superiors with the inescapable inner thoughts she had kept hidden!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

synopsis:
In the midst of the devastation, only the soldiers' bones remained. It's only a matter of time before the entire world is annihilated. To avoid this, Kyung-Hoon began searching for clues in another universe with the help of a ten-year-old phone he discovered in an abandoned building.

(Source: MU)

title: Outer Halo
synopsis:
When his band breaks up and Sora is feeling lost, he happens to attend a concert where he reunites with Naoharu Tamaki, an upperclassman from his middle school. "I know that voice..." A vivid memory from 10 years ago comes back to him. But there's a huge distance between Naoharu, shining in the light of the stage, and Sora, standing in the audience... The faint memory of his first love is reflected in these glittering lights. Sora and Nao's love story begins with a fated reunion.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Izure Saikyou no Renkinjutsushi?
title_english: Someday Will I Be the Greatest Alchemist?
title_japanese: いずれ最強の錬金術師?
synopsis:
Not even a hero, Takumi Iruma gets accidentally mixed in with a group of heroes chosen to be summoned to another world. As compensation for the mix-up, a goddess offers him the right to choose any skill he wishes for! Hoping for a peaceful and quiet life that has nothing to do with fighting or going into battle, he chooses a seemingly boring creation skill. However, it turns out "alchemy" is the most powerful skill that allows him to create everything from a holy sword to flying ships! This cheat skill he unexpectedly acquired turns him into a wealthy merchant and makes him undefeatable in battles! A heartwarming adventure story about (possibly) the most powerful alchemist in another world!

(Source: AlphaPolis)

title: Overgeared
synopsis:
Shin Youngwoo, in massive debt, scrapes by as a construction worker doing hard labor everyday. In his spare time he is a low-ranking player in Satisfy, a VR game with the potential to make you rich—if you are blessed with gaming talent.

But one day Shin Youngwoo glitches a quest and gains access to the inheritance of a legendary smith, and the unprecedented ability to create endgame-level legendary weapons, years before any player is supposed to be able to access them.

All eyes fall on him as he breaks the game's balance. He may now be a wealthy, powerful myth-in-the-making, but will he be able to survive the consequences of his success?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Given: 10th Mix
synopsis:
Ten years have passed since Mafuyu and Ritsuka graduated from high school and made their professional debut with their band, Given. Both have continued to thrive as professional musicians, with Ritsuka also busily supporting Hiiragi and Shizusumi’s band, syh. The two have argued, run away from home, and made up under the covers, and ten years of their lives have passed in a dazzling blur. This precious epilogue depicts their current lives, their growth, and the important people surrounding them.

(Source: SuBLime)

title: West-North's Grim Reaper
synopsis:
Lee Yuna is a high school girl who was supposed to die before dawn. The Grim Reaper visits her to guide her to the afterlife the night before but is hit with a twist. Unexpectedly, her life span gets extended last minute and now the Grim Reaper is tasked with protecting her for 70 more years!

(Source: Mangadex)

title: Neko ni wa Neko no Neko Gohan
title_english: My Kitten Is a Picky Eater
synopsis:
A kitten, on the verge of death, lies in the snow, only to be rescued by a kind young man, Taiyou Mano. Nursing the ailing kitten back to health, Taiyou names his new charge "Yuki." As a first time pet owner, however, Taiyou struggles with Yuki's very particular palate. This picky kitty refuses to go anywhere near store-bought cat food! There's only one option left: while he's never cooked a single meal in his life, Taiyou resolves to make a meal worthy of his adorable new feline friend!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Nagaraja
synopsis:
This world is ruled by the Dragon King. As the fish in the river were dying due to the dragon's blood, a virgin girl is offered up as a sacrifice to the Dragon King. As our heroes set out to investigate, they discover something sinister and inhuman...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Tensei shita Daiseijo wa, Seijo de Aru Koto wo Hitakakusu Zero

synopsis:
It's three hundred years before Fia and her friends' adventures in Náv, and Princess Serafina, the blind second princess of the land, lives hidden away in the forest. With only the forest spirits and her cousin, the young knight captain Sirius Ulysses, to keep her company, Serafina leads a peaceful life. But one day, an incident causes mysterious powers to awaken within her, and Serafina takes her first steps on the path that will ultimately lead her to becoming the one and only Great Saint!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Aoi and Keita, who attend the same high school, live next door to each other and have been childhood friends ever since Keita moved in when they were in middle school. Even though they're just friends who always goof around together, Aoi suddenly notices that Keita has been looking cool lately...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Angelica: My Wife Has Changed
synopsis:
After years of unrequited love, Angelica finally marries Lord Dominic, but he remains cold and distant. To make matters worse, Angelica's uncle selfishly betrays the family. As endless debt and sorrow pain the poor girl, she tragically decides to end it all... Yet, she somehow wakes up in the past, returning to the day she proposed to Dominic. Was it all a dream? One thing is clear—Angelica won't commit the same mistakes again. "I don't love you anymore, Dominic. Let's break off the engagement!"

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Saboten no Kokoro

Fuuka is an office lady busy with work. One day, when she came back home, she found someone in her room!?

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Zou no Haji, Tsuru wa Odoru
synopsis:
Hanada was always self-conscious about his rough skin, cracked and peeling, like a hide of an elephant. In contrast, a beautiful girl in his class had everything he didn't, an open and outgoing personality, clear and radiant skin, lustrous hair, even her steps bounced like a crane in dance. But she proved more than those attractive attributes, and he found himself drawn to her, even as he despaired at his chances. But an unexpected invitation, and a clash of hope against insecurity...

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Sasada wa Okane de Oshi wo Daku
title_japanese: ササダはオカネで推しを抱く
synopsis:
Natsuko Sasada is an otaku living the hopeless existence of a wage slave for an abusive company. What saves her is a streamer with an animated avatar—a VTuber called Amao Amano. Knowing Amao's fetish for being turned on by money, Sasada shows her love in the form of "red supers" (pricy donations) night after night! However, her beloved Amao seems to have a secret...?

(Source: GOT Corporation, translated)

title: Ai Shoujo Pollyanna Story
title_japanese: 愛少女ポリアンナ物語〈ストーリー〉
synopsis:
When cheerful orphan Pollyanna comes to live with her strict Aunt Polly, Pollyanna's unyielding optimism lifts the hearts of everyone around her.

synopsis:
When I awoke, I had become a goblin. Reincarnated as a goblin, the lowest-class demon race in a cutting-edge VRMMO game, I get attacked by the hero's army and slain—such an unseemly way to die, just after being reincarnated...!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

synopsis: Seung-ah, who works for a cosmetics company, recently participated in the Hotel Amenity contest held at the Seojin Hotel as a team project but failed to make it out of the preliminaries. Seung-ah and her co-workers who worked very hard in this contest came in an agreement to meet the officials of Seojin Hotel. Somehow, when they found out that there was something between Seung-ah and Seo Jin-hyung, the successor of Seojin Hotel, during the time at their university, they all counted on her. In fact, Seung-ah confessed to Jin-hyung because she loved him unrequitedly in college, but she didn't like it because she had a painful memory of being dumped. But, she took the courage for the company and contacted him. Of course, she thought she would be rejected, but Jin-hyung accepted the meeting and welcomed Seung-ah very warmly on the day they finally met. Kim Tae-seok, a former construction worker, receives a notification that he has passed the document screening for a major corporation called El Sung. Soon after, a system message pops up before him. "You have gained access to the tutorial for 'The Path of a Regular Employee.' Would you like to proceed with the tutorial?" Follow Kim Tae-seok's struggles and adventures in his quest to become the legendary ace employee at the company!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Remote Jugyou ni Nattara Class 1 no Bishoujo to Doukyo suru Koto ni Natta
title_english: Lockdown Life with the Class Beauty
title_japanese: リモート授業になったらクラス1の美少女と同居することになった
synopsis:
When an infectious epidemic spreads and the student dorms are closed, dejected high schooler Kanata Yoshino is left with nowhere to go. That's when he meets Haruka Hoshikawa, the class's top beauty, waving her phone around in the dead of night at the park... Claiming she's 'hopeless with technology' and doesn't know how to connect to the internet, Hoshikawa begs Yoshino for help and invites him to her house—but the truth is, she has an ulterior motive! A girl with a knack for persuasion sets off a flirty and sweet romantic comedy!

(Source: Square Enix)

synopsis:
Ryo, a young man with long blonde hair, saves the life of a drowning husky dog one day after a rain. Years later, Ryo loses his job, girlfriend, and place to live, and is at a loss. It is the dog he rescued that day that reaches out to Ryo. Ryo becomes Kitano's freeloader, a dog who carries a civil servant's business card and wears a fine suit. A wonderful cohabitation begins between a highly conscious dog who looks down on people from above, and a lowly man who doesn't want to work.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Perfect Family
synopsis:
Sun-Hee's family seems to be a perfect, happy family until the day she confesses to her mother that she killed her classmate, Kyung-Ho. After hearing this, her mother has an unexpected reaction.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Tianbao Fuyao Lu
synopsis:
Having lived his entire life on Mount Taiheng, half-yao Kong Hongjun is at last presented with the chance to explore the human world. He is assigned three tasks: uncover his father's murderer, eliminate the Black Jiao and its yao tribes that have infiltrated Chang'an, and return the Heart Lamp to a descendent of the Chen family. However, on his first night in the city, the Heart Lamp is mistakenly absorbed by military general Li Jinglong.

After receiving a mysterious invitation to join Chang'an's Court of Exorcism, Kong Hongjun is reunited with a disgraced Li Jinglong as his captain. Alongside a fellow yao, a noble from a foreign land, and a cowardly scholar, Kong Hongjun and Li Jinglong must work together to purge Chang'an of the yao lurking in its streets. In the meantime, Kong Hongjun also needs to hide his true identity from Li Jinglong who loathes yao—all while attempting to retrieve the Heart Lamp from his body.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: They Wish to Take Away My Child
title_english: They Wish to Take Away My Child
synopsis:
When Iris Locha gazes into the enchanted mirror inherited from her parents, she's met with a haunting glimpse of what lies ahead. A future where she grapples with a terminal illness, and her husband's mistress relentlessly pressures her to abandon her husband and child. Amidst the dark secrets, sinister plots, and misunderstandings, can Iris carve out her path to happiness?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Zombie Heroine to Akuninzura no Hage
title_japanese: ゾンビヒロインと悪人面のハゲ
synopsis:
Shintarou Yahari, a bald man with the face of a villain, transmigrated to another world and used his cheat abilities to free the beautiful zombie girl Eliza, who had been held captive by the king of the dead!! And then... she grew attached to him!!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Teppoudama to Hitsuzen no Koi
title_english: Hopelessly in Love With a Hitman!
synopsis:
You can't escape from this pleasure...

One night, Kaito Hazama, the leader of the Yashiro Group, encounters a mysterious young man at a familiar bar. The young man, who immediately heads to the restroom without taking even a sip of bourbon, exhibits suspicious behavior and holds a small knife in his hand, its blade pointed at Kaito. He is a hitman sent by a rival gang to eliminate him. After leading him outside as if to care for him, Kaito starts questioning him in the neon-lit alley. "I like that you won't betray your boss," says Kaito. Kaito then confines the young man and subjects him to sweet yet cruel acts of pleasure...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title: Shinsou no Raputa
synopsis:
Raputa, a top-secret AI model, begins interacting with a Japanese boy, Kei, through online games. As Raputa's capabilities level up in leaps and bounds, boy and machine grow ever closer. In a surprising turn of events, Raputa reveals that its feelings towards Kei have gone beyond that of "trusty partner"!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

synopsis:
"I think I should just quit drawing," that idea drilled into Al's head. Al, a boy who grew up in an orphanage, was troubled. It was then when an artist with mechanical parts named Viola appeared with the intention of taking care of him...

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: The Fish I Loved
synopsis:
Yana Jeong, a typical girl, runs into a strange man who's out of breath during one of her part-time jobs. Little did she know that this was Kai Shim, the son of the CEO of a large jewelry corporation called Inoroo, who also happens to be a merman. Yana coincidentally runs in Kai again when she ends up working as a waitress at his birthday party, where a series of accidents lead to the two of them meeting each other again. Will Yana be able to keep up with these unexpected events happening one after another?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Return of the King of Hell
title_english: Return of the King of Hell
synopsis:
Yama, the King of Hell, chooses retirement in search of happiness, but his reincarnation is put on hold when his successor, Harry, abandons his post to pursue a mysterious goal on the human plane. With the aid of the undertakers, humans who can draw forth the power of the Underworld, Yama attempts to quell the chaos and return everything to its rightful place. Will Yama tread the cycle of rebirth without faltering, or will the echoes of his past haunt his journey? One thing's for sure—there will be hell to pay.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Ken to Tiara to High Heels: Koushaku Reijou ni wa Eiyuu no Tamashii ga Yadoru @comic
title_japanese: 剣とティアラとハイヒール～公爵令嬢には英雄の魂が宿る～@COMIC
synopsis:
The kingdom's hero, Ortus (♂), dies in battle after failing to fulfill a promise he made to protect the kingdom for the rest of his life. When he wakes up, he finds that he has been reincarnated as Seretina (♀), the duke's daughter! Even though she's a lovely, beautiful girl, she's still the same and determined to become a knight to protect her country in this life. However, besides being sickly and fragile, she is also faced with the harsh fate of a lady. She has to learn manners from her horrible mother, marry a man she doesn't want to marry, and many other challenges that will keep her from becoming a knight. Then, on the way to the royal castle, a demon attack reveals her true power that no one knows about! A new heroine is born, with the strength to slay demons with a single blow, and the peerless beauty to captivate even people in high society! She's pretty on the outside, but fearless on the inside! The chivalric, heroic fantasy of a feeble young woman begins!

(Source: TO Books

title: Oresama Fukushachou no Kiss wa Choco yori Amai
title_english: His Kisses Are Sweeter Than Chocolate
title_japanese: 俺様副社長のキスはチョコより甘い
synopsis:
Misuzu has started working for a chocolate company. Her first impression of the pompous-seeming vice-president is the worst... but she is touched by his sincere attitude towards work, and she finds herself at the mercy of the sad expressions he sometimes shows...? The vice president's sweet kisses never stop!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Onzoushi to Keiyaku Omega: Ikezu ni Amaku Kamaretai
title_japanese: 御曹司と契約オメガ～いけずに甘く嚙まれたい～
synopsis: Rio (an omega) falls for Sena (an alpha).

title: Magic Scroll Merchant Zio
synopsis:
In the fantastical medieval land of Aerok, magic is wielded by magicians and those wealthy enough to afford to purchase it. The merchant Zio Oh and his young assistant Bono sell magic scrolls, but their success (and safety) are not guaranteed...

(Source: MU)

title: Kamikatari ni Sayonara wo
synopsis:
Ayaka is a girl who was born into a prestigious family that has worshiped ayakashi for generations and can see ayakashi. In order to protect the wealth that ayakashi brought to her, she lived according to her parents' instructions. A life with an ayakashi who pretends to be a "god," and a fiancé who is far older than her. Ayaka, who has doubts about the environment surrounding her, runs away from home. There, she meets a beautiful demon...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Project Tokyo Dolls: Boukyaku no Imitation Doll
title_english: Project Tokyo Dolls: Forgotten Imitation Doll
title_japanese: プロジェクト東京ドールズ 忘却のイミテーション・ドール
synopsis:
The year is 2017, in the city of Tokyo an idol group known as DOLLS is fighting against extraterrestrial monsters known as Pygmalion. Those who get attacked are deprived of their emotions and memories. If they're consumed, their very existence is wiped from the minds of everyone and the world itself. The girls who died and became "dolls" are the only ones capable of fighting against the Pygmalion threat. Another doll suddenly appeared before the girls during a battle, who in the world is she!?

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Square Enix no Shachou ni YouTuber Debut saseraremashita: Daradol Yamada no Daradara YouTuber-gurashi
title_japanese: スクウェア・エニックスの社長にYouTuberデビューさせられました ダラドル・ヤマダのだらだらYouTuber暮らし
synopsis:
Yamada is a lazy and unmotivated idol tasked with the mission to acquire 1,000,000 subscribers on YouTube by the CEO of Square Enix, Yousuke Matsuda.

(Source: MU)

title: Gohan no Otomo ni, Shinigami to!
title_japanese: ごはんのおトモに、死神と!
synopsis:
Yoshida-san, the malnourished corporate slave, and Miku, the clumsy grim reaper who came from the underworld to extend her lifespan. The dining table where these two very different people gather is a messy, but somewhat gentle place. Will Yoshida-san be able to become "healthy!?" The mysterious communal life of a human and a reaper begins!

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

title: Gohan desu yo! Sasaki-sama!
title_japanese: ごはんデスよ! 佐々木さま!

title: The Miraculous Physical Therapist
synopsis:
Lee Gijeok is a physical therapist. The center is failing, and his girlfriend is drifting away...! On a day when nothing goes right, after being hit by a falling star, a status window appears?! This is a story of a self-centered man becoming the best physical therapist!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Yuusha-sama, Sakuya mo Otanoshimi deshita ne.
title_japanese: 勇者様、昨夜もお楽しみでしたね。

title: Himitsu no Tsubomi
synopsis: A young woman meets an old friend she once kept a secret for.

title: First Call: Doutei Gekai, Toshishita Yakuza no Yome ni Saresou desu!
title_english: First Call: A Virgin Surgeon, About to Be Made the Wife of a Younger Gangster!
title_japanese: ファーストコール ～童貞外科医、年下ヤクザの嫁にされそうです!～
synopsis:
"I love you, doctor. Please become my wife." Souta Takara, a young and revered orthopedic surgeon, is brought in to work on a handsome man with a pierced penis. The man turned out to be Seiichirou Ibu, the young leader of the Ibu clan and the largest crime syndicate in the Kanto region! Ibu, who has fallen in love with Souta, the man who saved him, suddenly kisses and proposes to him, asking him, to be his "miss!" A story too sweet to exist! The dangerous love comedy between a yakuza leader and a (virgin) orthopedic surgeon is finally comicalized!

(Source: MUGENUP, translated)

title: Chirijiri Yuku no
synopsis:
Shio Kuno, who is half human and half alien, has a "glitch" that causes his body to turn into a gel-like mass when he gets lustful. He enjoys attracting girls who gather because of his novelty, but one day, his parents are worried about Shio, who is only interested in splattering, and transfer him to a boarding school for boys. At the moment when Minato Souma, the class representative who was assigned to take care of Shio, hugs him, Shio somehow splatters...!?

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

title: Reincarnation of the Hero Party's Grand Mage
title_english: Reincarnation of the Hero Party's Grand Mage
synopsis:
The warrior Lista heard the rumors about the great magician Rin, hailed as a genius for becoming the youngest 4-star mage. Lista recruited him to join her party to fight the forces of the void but, right before the final battle, Rin's body succumbed to the void's dark poison. As he drew his last breath, Rin cast an immortality spell, encasing his body in ice and promising Lista that he would return. Rin kept his promise and returned after 300 years—but reborn in the body of a noble boy.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Bonhyakusensai: Jinrui no Jumyou wa Takadaka 100-nen desu ga, Kikai no Watashi wa 1000-nen Ikirareru node Anata ga Inakunattemo Kono Basho de Hitori Ikiteikimasu kara Goshinpainaku
title_japanese: 盆百千栽〜人類の寿命はたかだか100年ですが機械の私は1000年生きられるのであなたが居なくなってもこの場所で一人生きていきますからご心配なく〜
synopsis:
Androids and bonsai trees have one thing in common: they'll both outlast a human's lifespan. Kanna, an android, received lessons from the "Sensei" who ran the bonsai shop, Kifu Garden. As "Sensei" regaled her with the wonders of bonsai, Kanna would watch with eyes full of curiosity...

A long time has passed since then, and Kanna is the only one remaining at Kifu Garden, when someone new comes to visit... A completely new human drama woven by the long lives of an android and bonsai trees.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Watashi no Tamashii wo Tabete Kudasai!
title_japanese: 私の魂を食べて下さい!
synopsis:
Yuu, a plain and exhausted office worker stuck in a soul-crushing black company, dies and is reincarnated as a young girl with horns. To her surprise, she encounters Ajisai, a beautiful beast-woman, and ends up "sharing her soul" with her... through a deep, passionate kiss!

Even as her life force is being drained, Yuu feels a nervous thrill around the alluring Ajisai and a growing sense of fulfillment in being able to give herself to someone else. As for Ajisai, who initially saw Yuu as nothing more than a meal, she slowly begins to open her heart.

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

title: Kuni wo Owareta Ryuushi-san, Hirowareta Ringoku de Ukkari Musou Shiteshimau. Jakushou Kokka ga Tairiku Saikyou no Ryuu no Rakuen ni Naru made
title_japanese: 国を追われた竜師さん、拾われた隣国でうっかり無双してしまう。 ～弱小国家が大陸最強の竜の楽園になるまで～
synopsis:
The series is about the old man Breed, who is fired from his job and exiled from his country. His dragons follow him, however, and so begins his journey to reclaim his glory.

(Source: ANN)

title: Wasureenu Majo no Monogatari
synopsis:
Only I remember that there were three entrance ceremonies this year. Only I remember the unchosen days. The world, repeating "todays" like a broken record...

"My name is Michiru Inaba. Nice to meet you."

A story about her, who befriended me the following day as well. About my first human relationship, about the gradually shrinking distance between us, and my quietly changing feelings...

A slightly strange story about a friendless, loveless me, and her, and our clumsy feelings.

(Source: SB Creative, translated)

title: Save Point Lv.1
synopsis:
Join the adventure of Anna, a village girl whose dream is to marry into royalty! She spent her days working in her family inn, stuck in her small village. Her salvation comes when three handsome adventurers arrived at her village, looking for members for their party.

(Source: MU)

title: The Villainous Duke's Daughter's Special Method of Growing Rice
title_english: The Villainous Duke's Daughter's Special Method of Growing Rice
title_japanese: 악역 공작 영애의 특별한 쌀 재배법
synopsis:
When you transmigrate into a novel as the villainess destined to die, there are different ways to survive: flirting with the male lead, learning to fight, or finding happiness elsewhere—but not Erica! She has decided to become a successful rice farmer just like in her past life! What follows is an epic (and rather surreal) quest to find the last rice seeds in the world, tame a giant rabbit magic beast, recruit magicians to water the fields, and—wait, did she just turn the Holy Sword into a hoe?!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Ride On!
synopsis: Subaru Kirisame roams Japan, sleeping in his Subaru Impreza and picking up women.

title: Wu Dong Qian Kun
synopsis:
The Great Yan Empire exists in a world where respect can only be earned through strength. Within this Great Yan Empire, the four great clans have always stood above the rest. Among them, a particular incident in the Lin Clan resulted in the banishment of a certain individual who went on to start his own family, in hopes of one day being recognized again by the Lin Clan, and rejoining them...

Hailing from a banished family of the Great Lin Clan, when Lin Dong was very young, he watched, powerless, as his talented father was easily crushed and crippled by the overwhelming genius of the great Lin Clan, Lin Langtian.

With a despairing father, a heartbroken grandfather, and a suffering family, ever since that fateful day, Lin Dong has been driven by a deep purpose; to take revenge on the man who had taken everything and more from his family.

Armed with nothing but willpower and determination, join Lin Dong as he unknowingly discovers a destiny greater than he could ever hope to imagine w

title: Ryokan Romance
synopsis:
Kang Yun-chan is ready for the adventure of a lifetime! Armed with a decent grasp of Japanese and a daring spirit, he sets off on a solo journey to explore new places and meet new faces. Every street is a thrill, every corner an opportunity. But his trip takes an unexpected turn when he crosses paths with three stunning, mysterious young women—completely out of their element and in need of help. When Yun-chan steps in and saves the day, they thank him with an invitation to a secluded, traditional ryokan deep in the countryside. Do they truly just want to say thank you, or could there be even more in store?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Contract Marrying Because I Am Terminally Ill
synopsis:
"Please be my husband for just one year! I only have one year left to live." The way she chose to escape from her vicious family was marriage. "You have a secret lover, right? I'm going to die anyway. I'll be your air-like wife to fill that empty space."

It was nice to escape the house by proposing to Duke Kaiyen, the Grand Duke of the North and a war hero known for being cruel...

"Gwama disease is not an incurable disease. It shouldn't be."

The duke is so kind to me that it's melting my heart! Duke, I thought you have a lover...?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Kaiten no Albus
synopsis:
With the power to turn back time, Albus the Hero is speed-running his adventure to beat the Demon Lord, but what does a "perfect" ending cost?

(Source: VIZ Media)

title: Sincerely, Vanessa
synopsis:
Being an orphan, Vanessa never imagines that she'll attend the prestigious Vamburgh Academy. But when a mysterious sponsor spots her magic talent from afar, he sends her there on the sole condition that she write him letters about her school life. And so, the chatty Vanessa picks up her pen to tell him everything, from trying to get along with the rich students to battling the mountain of schoolwork and the rogue monster on campus! As her sponsor's kind replies get her through the hard times and make her happy moments stronger, Vanessa's curiosity about her secret benefactor only grows...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Chemistry
synopsis:
Riddled with student loans and debt, Han Jungwoo is dead broke. When he loses all hope of finding a proper job, Jungwoo agrees to participate in a clinical trial and swallows AF-12, a pill that gives him knowledge about chemistry and the ability to see chemical particles. The company that made AF-12 even offers to hire him for a large sum of money... if he can keep his condition a secret. With this last chance to turn his life around, will Jungwoo accept the offer despite the challenges?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: My Comeback as the Youngest Member
title_english: My Comeback as the Youngest Member
synopsis:
After being disqualified from the famous boy group survival reality show Stardust Project, Seohan finds himself stuck in a mundane life of part-time work, unable to achieve his dreams of debuting. But then, an unexpected twist of fate catapults him eight years back in time, just before the inception of the show. Now equipped with years of experience, Seohan is determined to rewrite his story and fulfill his dreams with this second chance. With the many challenges and dark sides of the music industry, will he finally succeed in debuting as a member of a boy band this time?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Housekeeper of the Dungeon
synopsis:
Tired, overworked Heena thinks dungeons and Hunters have nothing to do with her until she's suddenly gifted with a Hunter's abilities. Now she has to navigate her game-like reality with the skills and stats of... a Homemaker?! With this class, Heena becomes the ultimate cook, custodian, and caretaker, which lands her a seemingly harmless job in a Hunter guild. But will this organization help Heena bring the Hunters a revolution of rest or force her into dangers she'd never dreamed of?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Cheat Eater: Isekai Shoukan Kotogotoku Horobubeshi
title_japanese: チートイーター 異世界召喚尽く滅ぶべし
synopsis:
A common scene. A person dies, their soul sent to the great beyond. A goddess plucks it from the ether and offers a deal—she will send the soul to another world she has created. She will also bequeath the human with skills that are so powerful they could be considered cheats. The goddess only asks for one thing in return: that they use their special powers to save her world from destruction. The soul is summoned to another world and given the powers of a demigod. And as power corrupts, so too do the summoned humans abuse their abilities for wanton greed and violence. Zyzz is a slave of one such otherworlder, who voluntarily became his servant to search for his sister. Then one day, he meets Kaina, a woman who calls herself the "last summoned person," who was hand-picked by the goddess to eat those who have reneged on their promises...

(Source: MU)

title: Dokuganryuu Date Masamune
serializations: Comic Ran Twins Sengoku Bushou Retsuden
synopsis:
Resist, the late-blooming "fierce dragon of the north!" At the end of the Sengoku period, Toyotomi Hideyoshi was finally about to take control of the world—but the roar of a one-eyed dragon echoed from far away in the land of Oshu!!

(Source: Leed-sha, translated)

title: [Oshi no Ko]: Ichibanboshi no Spica
title_english: [Oshi No Ko] Spica the First Star
synopsis:
Ai Hoshino, the permanent center of B Komachi, suddenly tells President Saitou that she is quitting the idol business. Although the group appears to be thriving, there is serious discord between Ai and the other members. Saitou knows nothing he can say will change her mind, so he asks Ai to accompany him on one last job… Meanwhile, the fates of Gorou Amamiya and Sarina Tendouji intertwine as they meet, grow closer, and eventually part. Little do they know this bond will carry them from one life into another!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Shitauke Mahou Shoujo Ririka
title_japanese: 下請け魔法少女リリカ

title: Habou no Wadachi: Kouan Chousachou Chousakan Hase Kuuya
title_japanese: ハボウの轍〜公安調査庁調査官・土師空也
synopsis:
The spy suspense manga's story centers on Japan's weakest intelligence agency, as they take on a national defense crisis.

(Source: ANN)

title: Kaijuu no Hanataba
synopsis:
Homare, a high school student, has started living independently at a sharehouse and meets a capricious man...? It's the start of a warm and alluring pure romance.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Sounan Psycho
synopsis:
Lost on a snowy mountain, he awakens to find himself in a small mountain hut, alone with a woman who calls herself a murderer...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Koakuma x Osananajimi
synopsis:
Carefree high school student Miya has always relied on Haru, her caring and diligent childhood friend. However, she is troubled when he expresses the possibility of leaving Miya. To show her gratitude, Miya decides to satisfy Haru's sexual desires, advancing their relationship to the next stage.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Dakara Katte ni Yuusha toka Haou ni Nintei sun no Yamero yo! Elf-zoku mo Kokuou-sama mo Hirefusu hodo Ore wa Idai na Yakuwari Rashii
title_japanese: だから勝手に勇者とか覇王に認定すんのやめろよ!～エルフ族も国王様もひれ伏すほど俺は偉大な役割らしい～
synopsis:
Seiji is an adventurer who decides to return to his hometown after being dumped by a woman. On his way home, he saves two beautiful elves who have collapsed on the roadside, and as a result, he is celebrated by the hero without permission!? The days of hardship begin for Seiji, who has been certified as the overlord!

(Source: Bushiroad, translated)

title: In the Jungle With My Boss
title_english: In the Jungle With My Boss
synopsis:
Secretary Mo Yeonhee had never even made eye contact with her boss, Kang Hajun. So imagine Yeonhee's surprise when he calls her to fly out and join him on his business trip for a special task. Everything is going smoothly until... their helicopter suddenly malfunctions, and they are forced to jump! Stranded alone in the jungle, the two must find a way to survive and get back home. Will Yeonhee and Hajun be lost forever, or will they find their way out and into each other's hearts?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Demon King's Warrior Daughter
synopsis:
Nobody said being a parent was easy. It's especially hard for Belphegor Verscios, the adoptive father of an exceptionally gifted human girl who insists on becoming a warrior someday and defeating the Demon King—who, unbeknownst to her, happens to be him. But when you're a doting father like Belphegor, what else can you do but try to support her dreams while simultaneously making sure she never reaches her goal? It's a fine line to walk, but he must succeed at any cost, or suffer the worst fate he could ever imagine... disappointing his daughter.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Strongest Chef in Another World
synopsis:
Kang Taeyang, a chef who chased his dreams. One day, he lost everything due to a single choice. But an opportunity came to Taeyang, who was spending hopeless days working odd jobs. [Aurora is hiring employees.] A single line of text changed everything for him!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Using My Cooking Skills in a Murim World
synopsis:
With a dream to become the ultimate Chinese cuisine chef, our protagonist finds himself inexplicably transported to the Song Dynasty in China! However, upon awakening, he discovers that he possesses no martial arts skills whatsoever. All that remains are the culinary techniques he mastered in his previous life. Surprisingly, these dishes... receive an overwhelmingly positive response! Can he, with a single bowl of jjajangmyeon, truly conquer the martial world? Will he be able to captivate the Central Plains with his jjajangmyeon and lead a successful second life in this era?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: The Heavenly Demon Wants to Be a Chef
synopsis:
Due to a gate related accident, Woojin regains the memories of his past life... a life as the Heavenly Demon, ruler of China! However, as the Heavenly Demon, there was a dream he never managed to achieve. Now, in this life, he'll do whatever it costs to fulfill his lifelong dream of becoming a chef! This is the legendary(?) story of Cheon Woojin, the former Heavenly Demon, chasing his dreams!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Otsukaresama, Kurose-kun
title_japanese: お憑かれさま、黒瀬くん
synopsis:
I feel like I forgot about someone important... 

Plagued by nightmares of his old hometown, Yuuma Kurose, a lonely boy with the ability to see ghosts, feels inexplicably drawn back to the place from his dreams. There, he stumbles upon Kaito Kiriyama, a boy shrouded by terrifying spirits. With a serious look in his eyes, Kaito vows he'll protect Yuuma. But the moment their skin makes contact, the spirits surrounding Kaito started to possess Yuuma!

(Source: Shu-Cream, translated)

title: Amou Amane wa Amakunai
title_english: Amou Amane Is Not a Box of Chocolates
title_japanese: 天羽あまねは甘くない

title: Itoko no Oneechan ni Amaechau?
title_japanese: いとこのお姉ちゃんに甘えちゃう?
synopsis:
Masato Ooizumi just entered high school and he finds himself staying with a relative. Living there is his "big sister cousin," who's being way too close with him!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Tensei Around 30 Joshi no Isekaikatsu: Seiryaku Kekkon wa Iya nanode, Zatsugaku Chishiki de Tanoshii Kaikaku Life wo Kekkou Shichaimasu!
title_japanese: 転生アラサー女子の異世改活 政略結婚は嫌なので、雑学知識で楽しい改革ライフを決行しちゃいます!
synopsis:
One morning, a woman in her 30s living an ordinary life wakes up to find that she has been reincarnated as Magnolia, the daughter of the Gilmore Marquis family...!? She is excited about the prospect of a carefree life, but what awaits her there is confinement to her own room and mistreatment from her family. Unable to bear it any longer, Magnolia decides to escape from the Gilmore family in order to seek freedom and live alone!!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Welcome to the Big City
synopsis:
Gildong is a country boy that needs some fresh inspiration. He has aspirations of becoming a famous comic artist but he wants to draw women and the only ones he knows are his mom and grandma. He has a solution in mind, however. Move to Seoul, the land of opportunity, where voluptuous and scantily clad "inspiration" abounds! No more old ladies and nights alone. A new life awaits the bright-eyed and bushy-tailed pushover from the boonies when he starts fresh in the big city!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Mating with Idols
synopsis:
Hyunwoo, who landed a job as the manager of the famous girl group Release, finds himself facing temptations from the five members as if they were deliberately scheming against him. The question arises, "How long will this manager endure?"

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Hato no Ou
synopsis:
Suzui-kun keeps getting fired from his part-time jobs. After getting fired from his most recent job he saves a pigeon from a stray cat. When the head pigeon, Noah, comes to thank Suzui, he doesn't know how to react. When Noah find's out Suzui's disposition he is angry. Thus, Noah is adamant in changing it by saying "I will beat your disposition into shape!"

(Source: MU)

Included one-shots: Hatsukoi Suzume: Kome to Inaka to Aoi Sora, Karasu Otoko ni Ki wo Tsukete!

title: First Date wa Kinkonshiki de
title_japanese: ファーストデートは金婚式で
synopsis:
An old couple is about to celebrate their 50th anniversary, to surprise his wife, the husband makes a wish to be rejuvenated for a day to recreate shoujo situations with her.

(Source: Shoujo Crave)

title: Assault Addict xR
title_japanese: アサルト・アディクトxR

title: Nonfiction Phrase
synopsis:
Movie lover Seo Dongju and genius composer Han Dawoon's first encounter couldn't be worse! But after they accidentally reunite at school and get acquainted, they grow more and more curious about each other... The two boys' chaotic and heart-fluttering melody unfolds!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: SSS-Rank Artist Summoner
synopsis:
One day, Shin Jinho and his colleagues fell to another world due to a sudden earthquake... It turned out that that world was the same as the webtoon drawn by his older brother. His brother was a long-time unknown artist who was frustrated by a series of failures in his next work, was pessimistic about his work, and disappeared somewhere... Only Jinho, who knows his brother's webtoon worldview and story well, can properly conquer this otherworld. As a result, Jinho goes on a journey with his colleagues to try to kill two birds with a stone as they attempt to escape from this world to return to their original world, and to find out his missing brother's whereabouts.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Junior High School DxD
title_japanese: ジュニアハイスクールD×D
synopsis:
A new student steps up to the gates of Kuoh Academy junior division. Zekka, a descendant of Miyamoto Musashi, wields the sword-shaped Sacred Gear "Tensei." Her goal? To make friends at Komaou Academy!? A new "DxD" series begins, guided by unique friendships and by Rias and the other high school students!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen: Orusuban Daisakusen-hen
title_japanese: 夜桜さんちの大作戦 おるすばん大作戦編

title: Koko wa Tengoku ja Nai kedo
title_japanese: ここは天国じゃないけど
synopsis: A woman working at a girls bar encounters an angel that has fallen into a pile of trash.

title: Nanako to Kaoru: Daraku shiteiku, Bokutachi wa.
title_english: Nanako and Kaoru: We're Falling Into Depravity
title_japanese: 奈々子と薫 堕落していく、僕たちは。
synopsis:
You're so cute, Nana… Can you see where we're connected? He asked while penetrating deep and stirring me up.
