"Mizui, this spot of yours....is so soft...and sweet..." He's eating me out like a thirsty beast down there, but I've never felt this good before... On Christmas day, I finished work early and excitedly headed to my fiance's place only to discover that he was cheating on me with my best friend! Utterly devastated by the situation, I went to a river to rid myself of the engagement ring but ended up slipping as a result. Just as I was about to become one with the frigid winter river, Aiba, my colleague came to save the day. One thing led to another and we...

(Source: NTT Solmare)

title: Doukyo shitara, Byou de Taberaremashita. Shuuchaku-kei Osananajimi no Hageshime Ecchi
title_english: From Roommates to Bedmates in a Heartbeat: My Clingy Childhood Friend Likes It Rough
title_japanese: 同居したら、秒で食べられました。～執着系幼なじみの激しめエッチ～
synopsis:
Yukiko is a young woman who teaches calligraphy to children, and has dinner with her next-door neighbor and childhood friend, Megumi. One day, Yukiko's life is turned upside down when she finds an eviction notice in her mailbox. As luck would have it, Megumi's hospitalized mother invites Yukiko to live in their house, since she can't bear to see her son living alone. Yukiko is overjoyed at the chance to eat Megumi's cooking every day and relive the happy sleepovers of the past, but Megumi himself is less than pleased with the arrangement. While Yukiko sees him as her younger brother, he has deeper feelings for her, and wishes she would see him as more...When Yukiko is evicted from her home, her childhood friend's mother invites her to move in with Megumi. Yukiko is clueless about Megumi's feelings for her, causing Megumi to grow ever more frustrated, until he can't contain himself...

(Source: Renta!)

title: Gaman shinaide, Hades-sama. Reikoku na Meiou no Junai wa Sokoshirenai hodo Fukakute, Omoi
title_japanese: 我慢しないで、ハデス様。～冷酷な冥王の純愛は底知れないほど深くて、重い～
synopsis:
In the Realm of the Gods, new goddess Persephone spends her days tending to her fields of flowers. Every new sprout comes at the cost of an old one withering and dying—which is how she meets the handsome but taciturn Hades, who visits to collect the dead.

Persephone grieves for the death of her beloved plants, but Hades's warmth and encouragement touch her heart. Persephone learns Hades is a victim of the Gods' conspiracy, and she offers up her own body to save the Lord of the Underworld! Can their passion stand against all of Olympus?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Rekkyou Sensen
synopsis:
In the year 2206, planet Earth is on the brink of destruction. Due to pollution and a shortage of resources, scientists estimate that the planet will become unable to sustain life within the next hundred years. To resolve the issue of scarcity, the world's leaders have come together and decided on a desperate solution—the National Extinction Tournament. Gathering those with powers beyond human comprehension, these boys and girls will compete for the sake of their nations...and their own survival! Win and become a hero. Lose and death awaits not only you but everyone you love...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Haramu made Midareike: Migawari Hanayome to Gunpuku no Mouai
title_english: Until You Bear My Child: The Substitute Bride and the Beast Soldier
title_japanese: 孕むまで乱れいけ～身代わり花嫁と軍服の猛愛
synopsis:
"I'll have you birth my child in place of your sister." I thought that there is no love in marriages... but the fingers of this cold-blooded soldier are unexpectedly sweet, passionate and fierce...

(Source: WWWave Corporation)

title: Hanabusa-kun wa Okuchi ga Ojouzu
title_english: I'm in Love With Mr. Hanabusa's Mouth
title_japanese: 英くんはおくちがお上手
synopsis:
"Is this your first time? Would you like to borrow my mouth?" Coworkers Yuzuki and Himari are in for an exciting night when he offers to suck, lick, and slurp with this talented mouth. Will he make her cum for the first time?

(Source: WWWave Corporation)

title: Kono Hi, "Itsuwari no Yuusha" de Aru Ore wa "Shin no Yuusha" de Aru Kare wo Party kara Tsuihou shita
title_japanese: この日、『偽りの勇者』である俺は『真の勇者』である彼をパーティから追放した
synopsis:
A Demon Lord has arisen, and the world awaits a hero. In a peaceful village, two young boys—Foyle Austin and his best friend Yu—have long dreamed about being heroes, but the legends say there can only be one. Their paths forward seem decided when the goddess declares Foyle a "Hero," while leaving Yu's destiny unclear. But Foyle has a secret only he knows. The role given to him by the goddess is actually "Fake Hero." Far from being destined to overthrow the Demon Lord, defeat awaits him at the true hero's hand, and Foyle has a good idea who that will be. When Foyle expels Yu from his party, he cements his role as the true hero's adversary. His powers begin to fade as his friend grows ever stronger. Foyle clearly won't be the one to save the world, but after an encounter with a mysterious elf in need of help, he sets out to prove that even the villain can be a hero to someone.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Yabai Idol no Manager ni Nacchatta Hanashi
title_japanese: やばいアイドルのマネージャーになっちゃった話

title: Kashikokute Yuuki Aru Kodomo
title_japanese: かしこくて勇気ある子ども
synopsis:
Every young couple has high hopes for their unborn child, and Sara and Kouta Takano are no different. But only days away from giving birth, Sara learns about the tragedy of Malala Yousafzai's attempted assassination at the hands of the Taliban, and her pure and innocent belief in the future is shaken. If such a smart and courageous child can be hurt so badly by the world, how can she keep her own baby safe? With Sara now in a state of shock, will the young couple be able to bridge the widening gap between them, or will it tear their family apart?

The reality of this world, as seen through the eyes of an author that has spent years illustrating the women and their lives.

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Legend of the Holy Sword
synopsis:
The Holy Sword is the only weapon that can defeat the Demon King... and Knight John Forkinstrong lost it. From the desolate Forgotten Fortress to the eldritch hellscape of the Super-Huge Cursed Ravine That You Can Never Leave Once You Enter, John has searched high and low for decades, but to no avail. And the only thing that continues to fuel John's unwavering willpower... is the fact that it's literally embarrassing that he lost his own forking sword.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Skool of Street
synopsis:
DJ, drop the beat! When 18-year-old K-pop stan Suhyeon gets his heart broken, he turns to his actual true love, girl group sensation MainTainA—especially his bias, the group's main dancer, Hailey. Leaving his bittersweet first relationship behind to transfer to Seoul, Suhyeon finds not only a spitting image of his bias in the school dance club member Hye-eun, who is supposedly Hailey's younger sister, but also a new love in the most unexpected of places: the art of street dance! While helping Hye-eun overcome her stage fright, Suhyeon finds there may be more to life than love!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Futari no Kokuhaku
synopsis:
The story follows the life of Chiharu, a 31-year-old woman struggling with her job, her sick mother, and the pain of ending up being a burden to her lover after being diagnosed with early-onset Alzheimer disease.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Preview
synopsis:
Cheon Sunwoo, a timid, fearful student, gains the ability to see the future. If one cannot avoid fate, then stand against that fate.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Revenge Law Firm
synopsis:
A genius boy who had everything taken away in the name of the law. Dagon, the demon who murdered his father, has become the chairman of a global automobile company comparable to Tesla... and what was taken away by law is regained by law! Hae-seong Yoon becomes a lawyer and begins to gather suspicious people. Can a law firm with only two employees take down Yang Dagon, the tycoon who controls Korea?

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Legend of Dangun
synopsis:
There are animals that were abandoned by Dangun and live secretly in the human world. Narae, an ordinary high school student, discovers their existence... A modern version of Beauty and the Beast with comedy and exorcism action.

Will the project of becoming human, for the animals that could not become human, be successful?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Shinryaku! Uchuu Neko-chan!
title_japanese: 侵略! 宇宙猫チャン!

title: Tsugihagi darake no Saikyou Yuusha
title_japanese: ツギハギだらけの最強勇者
synopsis:
Ougi Arikawa, 16 years old, suddenly found himself reincarnated as a zombie?! Embarking on a journey to subjugate the Demon Lord as a zombie hero, but the use of "power" requires a "price"...? A dark fantasy in another world.

(Source: COMICSMART, translated)

title: Princess Hurricane
synopsis:
Taepung Gang is a transfer student with a dream. He's going to become the number one fighter at his new all-boys school, and he's got the skills, muscle, and notoriety to make it happen. He definitely wasn't supposed to swap places with Princess Lily, a peace-loving royal from a fairytale land—without either of their memories! Will Lily fulfill Taepung's dream of becoming the school's best fighter? Will Taepung survive his new life as the cursed princess? How does a delinquent become a princess anyway, or a princess become a delinquent for that matter?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Persona 3: Comic Anthology
title_japanese: ペルソナ3 コミックアンソロジー
authors: Magami, Guriko|Tensugi, Takashi|Tani, Kazuya|Sumino, Hirune|Shiroishi, Kotoni|Tatsumi, Jin|Uraki, Enya|Kirai, Yuu
synopsis: A Persona 3 anthology by various mangaka.

title: Bakemonogoroshi no Psycho Lily
title_japanese: 妖怪殲滅のサイコリリー

title: Daikyojin
synopsis:
In a world of towering giants, two witches embark on a perilous journey to fulfill an ancient duty. As they climb, facing physical and emotional challenges, they confront the mysteries of their past and the weight of their responsibilities. With each step, they draw closer to the truth, forging a bond that transcends time. But as darkness looms, they must find the strength to persevere, knowing the fate of humanity hangs in the balance.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Akogare no Maid-san wa Tobacco ga Niau
title_english: The Maid I Admire Looks Good with a Cigarette
title_japanese: 憧れのメイドさんはタバコが似合う
synopsis:
Veteran maid Hijiri is admired by her junior coworker and rookie maid, Suu. Through Hijiri, Suu is sucked into a new world of heart-pounding moments! A smoking-sweet romance brought to life by a cast of uniquely charming maids.

(Source: Square Enix)

title: The Golden Wife-In-Law
synopsis:
"The empire is at peace only when an empress with brilliant golden locks is at the side of the emperor." 

In the Empire of Oriet, every reign is marked by the birth of a single blonde woman who is worthy of being the emperor's consort. Thanks to this multiple century-long legend, the empire has prospered. However, unable to obtain a blonde consort, the current emperor was forced to marry a vicous dark-haired empress. Without their blonde beauty, the empire is facing its slow decline. Meanwhile, the second prince, Carlix, loses in the race to become the next emperor. Forced into a marriage to a woman who doesn't even show up to their wedding, Carlix is made even more furious after being publicly disrespected by her father, the duke. But then, as if by fate, Carlix stumbles upon a stunning blonde beauty. Will he be able to seduce her and steal her throne? 

"Give unto me your heart and body..."

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Mou Kyoumi ga Nai to Rikon sareta Reijou no Igai to Tanoshii Shinseikatsu
title_english: A Surprisingly Fun New Life for a Lady Who Was Divorced Because Prince Was No Longer Interested in Her
title_japanese: もう興味がないと離婚された令嬢の意外と楽しい新生活

title: The Aura of a Genius Actor
title_english: The Aura of a Genius Actor
synopsis:
Struggling actor Shin Yu-myeong has spent the last 15 years of his life trying to make it big, but has always failed to. After a devastating cancer diagnosis, he's drowning his sorrows when a yeon-gwi, an acting ghost, appears and offers to send him back in time and with an added boost of life energy to start his career over. Yu-myeong leaps at the chance and becomes a college student once more, running into Seo Ryushin, his one-time rival. But this time, Yu-myeong has the acting chops to back him up, and even Ryushin will have to acknowledge him!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Nandemo Ii kara Kietekure
title_japanese: 何でもいいから消えてくれ

title: Isekai demo Okkii Oppai ni Sawaritai! Anthology Comic
title_japanese: 異世界でもおっきいおっぱいに触りたい! アンソロジーコミック
authors: Mocoyama, Jin|Kameyoshi, Ichiko|Suzune, Rena|Narumi, Amiya|Nanatsu, Fuji
synopsis: An anthology of short stories by various mangaka.

title: You're My Flame
synopsis:
After being reborn as a desolate fire witch and villain destined to die a tragic death, Chersinia creates a plan to avoid her fate by gambling at a casino to become a wealthy recluse. The only problem? She somehow ends up with a slave boy named Ben instead of the money she needs! But much to her surprise, she starts to warm up to Ben, who provides the perfect joy and comfort in her lonely life. Little does she know that Ben has a dark secret that will change her life forever...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Take Me Back Home
synopsis:
Just when her crush was about to express his feelings for her, our FL is warped away into the world of an unknown web novel. Stuck as a noble lady. with a suspicious suitor who wants her life, and a mystery savior who looks a little too familiar... Death-threats, protective MLs, and a dark secret that surrounds the FL's new life!

I don't care anymore! Take me back home!

(Source: NHN comico Corp.)

title: I Didn't Sign Up to Be a Nanny!
synopsis:
While working the regular shift in a supermarket, Ailene finds herself waking up in the body of a nanny within a fantasy novel. Knowing this character dies at the hands of the twin princes at the beginning of the novel, Ailene vows to raise these boys to be kindhearted and avoid their dark storyline. She fits right into her role and things seem to be looking up until the empire's "mad dog" Duke Kasar stumbles into her life and asks her to pretend to be his lover. Will Ailene make it through the fantasy novel alive?!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Lady Blue Bird of the White Lion Family
title_english: Lady Blue Bird of the White Lion Family
synopsis:
In an adult novel, I possessed the villainess: Sophina, the bluebird and former wife of the white lion male lead, who was obsessed with him and was thrown away. She was stoned to death because of angry public sentiment.

"Let's get a divorce after grazing enough!"

As a result of my efforts, I became friends with the male lead instead of obsessing over him. In the meantime, I became close to my mother-in-law and other family members of the male lead, and I gained recognition from helping in managing the estate. Also, my business became a big hit! Everything was perfect. It was time for the male lead who went to war to bring the heroine, so all he had to do was divorce me now. But the problem was...

"I don't want to divorce."

It was because he became so attached. Maybe I was having an arrhythmia? My heart kept beating fast... Was I excited? So I was thinking of seducing the male lead...

(Source: Feelyeon Management, translated)

title: The Duke's Villainous Daughter Is Depressed
synopsis:
Irene Song had transmigrated inside a novel and became the villainous daughter of a duke. However, the duke, who was unaware of this fact, simply thought she had amnesia and sent her off to marry the second prince of Rennes Empire. Little did she know that the second prince was cursed by an evil wizard and and would turn into a dog during the day and could only turn back to human at night. What's worse, she even named the dog "Tofu" after she found it wandering the imperial palace. Who would have known it was her own husband?!

(Source: Kai Scans, edited)

title: The Unintentional Villainess
synopsis:
After being reborn in a novel, Renee Blair is determined to transform her reputation as "the villainess of the century," which will prevent her death at the hands of Sir Dywen the dragon slayer! But then she learns that the original Renee had been controlled by a pop-up game system of daily missions that forced her to either commit evil deeds or face painful penalties for declining. With this system continuing to affect her as well, can the new Renee outsmart the game and reset her evil legacy?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Knight Only Lives Today
synopsis:
"You're a genius." Those words he heard as a child were poison. Encrid dreamed of becoming a knight, but he soon realized it was futile. "You want to live by the sword with that level of skill?" Some laughed at him. "Just give up." Some advised him against it. Despite that, his dream remained steadfast. He slept less, ran more, and trained harder. One day, he died, having been stabbed in the neck. Encrid opened his eyes again to "today's" morning.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Black Collar: Aku no Soshiki wo Management
title_japanese: ブラックカラー ～悪の組織をマネジメント～
synopsis:
The manga centers on Sugawara, an employee of a consultant firm, who is not exactly excited about the lectures he gives to companies, and finds himself unresponsive in his work. After one night of heavy drinking, he gets kidnapped by an evil organization called the "Black Shock Gang," and he is given the mission to defeat heroes through an "organizational reform."

(Source: ANN)

title: Sokutaijou Shitai Wakiyaku nanoni, Netotteshimatta Oujisama ga Nigashite Kuremasen
title_japanese: 即退場したい脇役なのに、寝取ってしまった王子様が逃がしてくれません
synopsis:
"Do you think you can just sleep with me and get away with it by claiming it was a mistake?" 

Estelle, the daughter of a viscount, was reincarnated as a supporting character in a certain popular web novel. Estelle's role in the novel is to be condemned and exiled by the heroine for sleeping with her lover, the second prince. Wanting to leave the story quickly, Estelle plans to "pretend" to sleep with the second prince as the novel goes along... but she accidentally calls out to the hero, first prince Oscar...?!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Usausa Nyannyan
title_japanese: うさうさにゃんにゃん
synopsis: Included one-shot: Kinpatsu Sensei

title: Semimaru Zanjitsuroku
synopsis:
Semimaru, an office worker who awoke one morning only to find that he had tragically become a cicada. A classic example of the short-lived, a cicada... After seeing that he did not have long to live, Semimaru decided to meet his end in a cool way. See his thrilling new daily life and his coworkers, who have to watch themselves around him! The curtain on the industry's first gag cartoon of a cicada at its time of death has finally opened!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: The☆Doraemons Special: Robot Yousei Gakkou-hen
title_japanese: ザ☆ドラえもんズスペシャル ロボット養成学校編

title: Gakuen Sensui Kantai: Mermaid Girls
title_japanese: 学園潜水艦隊マーメイドガールズ
synopsis: In the manga's story, extra-terrestrial life known as Trench Walkers reveal themselves, emerging from the Antarctic, and walking on the sea floor. Their goal is to terraform the Earth to their liking, which involves raising the sea level by 70 meters, thus rendering Tokyo and many other population centers uninhabitable. They have also begun to change Earth's surface water into what they call Nectar, the "divine water." Those who are incompatible with Nectar have a high chance of death when imbibing it. However, there are girls who are found to be compatible with Nectar, and they are recruited to be marines in a fight against the Trench Walkers, boarding ships to do battle in a new deep sea front line. The story centers on Hiro Todoroki, who receives a message from an older sister, a marine supposedly missing in action. The message tells Hiro to find a formidable marine named Kiriri Tsunoba. Though lost and confused, Hiro heads to the Masakado Girls Academy Submarine Unit with the inten

title: Omae nanka Hirowanakereba Yokatta
title_japanese: お前なんか拾わなければよかった
synopsis:
Matsu, a beautiful girl who gets weaker every day, and Kotake, a beautiful woman who takes care of her with great affection. What are the true identities of these two...?

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

title: My Amnesiac Affairs
synopsis:
Yuri can't remember. After a fall on the stairs, her memory has gone blank. But as she starts to put the pieces back together of her former life, she stumbles upon the fact that she apparently dated five guys at once! Now, one by one, she has to figure out who her true love actually is...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Mona Lisa no Heya
synopsis:
Vincent Minnelli is a doctor who has been called to Sweden for university work. One day, when hunting, he shoots a girl, mistaking her for a wild animal. The girl, Joanna, discloses a shocking fact to him before vanishing the next morning. That same morning, Vincent curiously receives an invitation from General Ambrose du Kloster, the current owner of Scorkloster Castle, a lavish mansion by the lake. However, upon visiting said mansion, Vincent notices a girl, Mona Lisa, who looks strikingly similar to Joanna. Mona Lisa claims they have never met, and nobody has heard of Joanna...

(Source: Taiyo Tosho, translated)

Included one-shot: Shinin Keiyaku

title: Jakushou Ryouchi no Seizon Senryaku! Ore no Ryouchi ga Nando Kurikaeshitemo Metsubou surun dakedo. Kore, Doushitara Tasukarimasu ka?
title_japanese: 弱小領地の生存戦略!～俺の領地が何度繰り返しても滅亡するんだけど。これ、どうしたら助かりますか?～
synopsis:
Klein von Asgard was an ordinary lord that could be found everywhere. He ruled a peaceful territory without incident, but one day, an army was suddenly sent from the Marquis family, and the Viscount family of Asgard was destroyed. Klein lost his life as well, or so he thought. He woke up in his bed at home and noticed that he was had returned to three years before his destruction. Convinced that he would be destroyed in three years if nothing was done, Klein started a life-or-death survival operation in order to avoid the path of destruction. But he died. Time and time again, he died in trivial ways, and the territory was destroyed. He did not want to die. He also wanted to avoid the massacre of his subjects. With that in mind, he puts everything into redoing his life. Until the day of the happy ending.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Goddess' Tastes
synopsis:
Yu Yu was bullied during his school days for his obesity, but after years of hard work and exercise, he has become a famous beauty director sought by everyone. However, his issues with talking to women pose a problem when dealing with customers. Thus his boss assigns him and several other troublemakers a project in order to fix their problems. During this event, his old crush, Ain Joo, appears in front of him.

(Source: Copin Communications)

title: An Extraordinary Guardian
synopsis:
Kim Hashin, a low-ranking guardian god, is determined to make his town the happiest there is and get promoted to a higher rank. But his plan goes awry when Nam Dareum, a girl with an extremely low happiness level and no will to live, moves to town. Now Hashin must do everything in his power to make Dareum happy so that he can save her and everything he's worked for. As hardships and obstacles continue to mount, will Hashin manage to help Dareum find true joy in life and put his town back on top?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: NCT: Dream Contact
synopsis:
I had a dream last night. I can't seem to remember it... yet I feel like it was very important. Dreams connect us to others, to ourselves, to the past, present, and future. Dreams about you, dreams about me, and dreams about us. Dreams that seem far away yet will always remain in my heart. Dreams about dreams that are just one touch away from reality. Through our dreams, we are in contact, even if opening up is scary sometimes...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Fukujoushi Senmon no Shinigami-chan
title_japanese: 腹上死専門の死神ちゃん

title: Taxi Untenshu no Makino-san
title_japanese: タクシー運転手の牧野さん
synopsis: A story about being teased by a taxi driver.

title: Senpai no Kanojo ga Motokano Datta
title_japanese: 先輩の彼女が元カノだった

title: Zenbu Kudasai, Senpai.
synopsis:
Sakura Chiyoda, manager of the judo club, loves judo. She has a chance encounter with Dosaka, an underclassman and judo powerhouse, and scouts him for the club. However, in addition to refusing to join the club, he flatly rejects it as "juvenile." Sakura, however, is not ready to give up and proposes a certain “contract” with Dosaka. But therein lies a dangerous, unexpected, and sweet trap...

(Source: COMICSMART, translated)

title: Tsugai no Senritsu: α Girai no Ω ga Kanaderu Nocturne
title_japanese: 番の旋律～α嫌いのΩが奏でる夜想曲〈ノクターン〉～
synopsis:
A faithful α violinist and an α-hating beautiful omega.

"I will never become mates with an alpha." Haruto (Ω), whose heat cycles occur more frequently than other Ω individuals, works at an illegal piano bar during his heats, playing the piano that holds memories of his mother. He also earns money by toying with α individuals, who usually act elite. However, during one performance, when he locks eyes with Naruse (α), a popular violinist who unknowingly visits the illegal establishment, his body is struck by a tingling sensation...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title: Re:IF kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu: Zero kara Kasaneru Isekai Seikatsu
title_japanese: Re:IFから始める異世界生活 ゼロカラカサネルイセカイセイカツ
synopsis: An alternate story where Subaru accepts the deal with Echidna.

title: Selfish Romance
synopsis:
Hyeondo and Yumin, an ordinary man and woman in their 30s, break up with their respective partners for different reasons despite still being in love with them. Selfishly hoping to get their old flames back, the two form a plan. They pretend to date each other in hopes of provoking their former lovers. Will their selfish and foolish plan really work?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Ichinichi Goto ni Dere ga Fueteku Tsuntsuntsuntsuntsundere-chan
title_japanese: 一日ごとにデレが増えてくツンツンツンツンツンデレちゃん

title: Tadaima Ghost Town
title_japanese: ただいま廃街〈ゴーストタウン〉
synopsis:
The manga tells the story of a young boy named Misora, who ran away from a socially ideal dome-shaped colony. Misora arrives at an "outside town," where adults live in an old-fashioned way.

(Source: ANN)

title: Onna Kacchuu Kishi-san to Boku
title_japanese: 女甲冑騎士さんとぼく

title: Onna Kacchuu Kishi-san to Boku
title_english: Everyday Affairs with Lady of King's Blade
title_japanese: 女甲冑騎士さんとぼく

title: Magical Punch Magical Nuki
title_japanese: マジカルパンチ マジカル抜き

title: Sea Witch
synopsis:
Having capsized every ship that has ever passed by, the octopus sea witch Nakika has run out of food, for no ship would now dare approach. With little choice left, Nakika decides to turn herself into a human in order to infiltrate their society and gain sustenance. Unfortunately, her brilliant plan hits a snag the minute she reaches the shoreline, and it all seems to stem from an encounter with a young boy named Nagisa.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Majutsushi Danchou no Keiyaku Kekkon
title_japanese: 魔術師団長の契約結婚
synopsis:
The super handsome commander sorcerer Ray is so popular with the ladies that he's become uncomfortable with them. One day, his grandmother pressures him into going on a blind date, and there he meets Bridget, a workaholic auditor. When Ray learns that Bridget had given up on getting married just like him, he proposes a contract marriage to put an end to their blind dates. But when they begin their married life, and get closer by the day, they find it surprisingly fun?

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Ougon no Taiyou: Hirakareshi Fuuin 4-koma Gag Battle
title_japanese: 黄金の太陽 開かれし封印 4コマギャグバトル
synopsis: A 4-koma gag manga anthology of Golden Sun by various mangaka.

title: Gyon-Woo & Jik-Nyu
synopsis:
This story, which has been passed down for a long time, is a story from heaven. A long, long time ago, there were six rulers in Heaven. Each ruler had their own role to perform for the harmony of the world. The Ruler of Darkness had the power to draw anything and erase anything. The Ruler of Light knitted light to shine on the Earth. The Ruler of Flames danced to create eternal flames. The Ruler of Water brewed alchohol and showered water on the Earth. The Ruler of the Earth plowed the fields to enrich everything. The Ruler of the Wind played the flute to generate the winds. Each of the rulers had supreme power, yet they could not do everything themselves. Therefore each of the rulers had many spirits as servants. Amongst these servants, those with superior talents became the beloved sons & daughters of the rulers. This story is about the son of the Ruler of the Wind, Gyon-Woo. And the daughter of the Ruler of Light, Jik-Nyu.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Yuureijou no Dannasama
synopsis:
A selfish young lady who was supposed to be executed marries the lord of a ghost castle. Now, she can't leave even if she dies.

(Source: Shoujo Crave)

title: Onna Chara de Isekai Teni shite Cheat-ppoi kedo Zako Chara nanode Medatazu Heiwa na Shomin wo Mezashimasu!
title_japanese: 女キャラで異世界転移してチートっぽいけど雑魚キャラなので目立たず平和な庶民を目指します!

title: Kanaria wa Kiraboshi no Yume wo Miru
title_japanese: カナリアは綺羅星の夢をみる
synopsis:
Fumino, a schoolgirl who dreams of pursuing a career in fashion, meets a beautiful girl on the day she attends her first ball. She is attracted to the uniquely Japanese-looking girl called Tsubakihime, and her dreams begin to grow. However, her mother is not pleased with Fumino's taste and plans to block her path, while Tsubakihime has her own reasons...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Kodoku no Kochou wa Donna Yume wo Miru no ka?
title_japanese: 蠱毒の胡蝶はどんな夢を見るのか?
synopsis:
This world has been invaded by bugs.

With the appearance of the "Armored Bugs," mutating insect monsters that can overcome all modern weapons, humanity has been robbed of much of its living space. The only ones who can stand against such adversaries are the "Noble Butterflies," girls who harbor "Insects" that have gone through evolutions differing from the armored bugs.

One of the candidates to become a Noble Butterfly, Odamaki Ayumi, still suffers from the fact that she is unable to become one. Her best friend, who was supposed to be with her and was her object of admiration, has left her and no longer seeks her company.

Those days of despair came to an end when she was on the verge of death in a battle with armored bugs.
"Don't think that I... will die without doing anything!"

With the end near, the girl's body transformed into a butterfly one. And the flapping of her wings will bring about a revolution in the world...!

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Sunao ni Narenai Oshikiri-san
title_japanese: 素直になれない押切さん

title: Onose-sensei wa Sex ga Shitai
title_japanese: 小野瀬先生はセックスがしたい
synopsis:
"I want to come at least 3 times a day...!" Yoruichi Onose is a high school teacher, who wants to have sex at least thrice a day. However, he keeps getting dumped for his unbelievably high libido. His body craves sex, but he just can't get into casual relationships!! No longer satisfied with his finger, Yoruichi starts using sex toys that he collects out of curiosity. He is constantly ridden with guilt as he pleasures himself while thinking of his ex, Takuma, the man he gave his virginity to. However, on the first day of school, Yoruichi reunites with Takuma after six years. Apparently, he is also going to start working as a teacher at their old school! Yoruichi does his best to act like a good friend and coworker, but being in the presence of the all-grown-up and hotter-than-ever Takuma is driving him crazy. His sexual desires might just be on the brink of explosion!

(Source: Renta!)

title_english: #"How to Walk on a Broken Earth" @comic

title_english: I'm a Saint Who Protects the Nation, but My Little Sister Is More Important to Me than Anything Else: Anyone Who Makes Her Cry Will Feel My Fists! @comic
title_japanese: 国を守護している聖女ですが、妹が何より大事です～妹を泣かせる奴は拳で分からせます～@COMIC

title: Shousetsu Blue Period: Ano Hi no Bokura
title_japanese: 小説 ブルーピリオド あの日の僕ら

title: Rewriting My Third Life
synopsis:
After being abused and killed by her family in two separate lifetimes, Blesse Lavian expects nothing from them in her third life. This time, despite knowing the horrible end that awaits House Lavian, Blesse decides to keep quiet and flee when the time is right. But the more time she spends with her cold-looking father and half-sister, the more she realizes that the Lavians aren't so bad after all. Will Blesse take a chance and rewrite her third life, or will she end up betrayed once again?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kunigei: Ookuni Daigaku Geijutsu Gakubu Eiga Gakka
title_english: Kunigei: Okuni University Art Department Film Program
title_japanese: クニゲイ～大國大学藝術学部映画学科～
synopsis:
Daisuke Kagami has sported a passion for movies ever since he can remember. Driven by this ambition and a film festival award he won in high school, Daisuke feels spurred to enroll in a film program as an aspiring director. Surprisingly, he gets shut down immediately and receives disheartening feedback on an assignment he thought he would breeze through.

Meanwhile, Kado Osawa, a fellow freshman and equally an award winner in high school, delivers a shocking project unexpectedly well-received by their professors. Already disillusioned by this strange turn of events, Daisuke falls into torment after Kado bluntly criticizes his work.

As Daisuke grapples with the difference between his and Kado's creations, he realizes a high disparity in the level of effort the two of them put into their respective projects. Understanding why Kado had been able to move his audience, Daisuke resolves to throw everything he has into his own filmmaking.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Yumemiru Henshuusha to Mukiryoku Shousetsuka
title_english: The Starry-Eyed Editor and the Apathetic Writer
title_japanese: 夢見る編集者と無気力小説家
synopsis:
Kirari Miyamoto is absolutely ecstatic now that she is going to be the writer Mitsuru Kajiura's new editor. But, when she finally goes to see the prince-like figure of charm and charisma she had envisioned for years, she is disillusioned by the uninspired, divorced 38-year-old in front of her. Vowing to help Mitsuru recover that gorgeous inner world she loved so much, she says she will do anything to help his words come alive again... even if that means undressing herself in front of him and allowing him to touch every corner of her body...!!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Koakuma Kyoushi♡Psycho
synopsis:
A captivating new teacher, Kasai-sensei, arrives at a problem classroom. The previous teacher had been hospitalized for a suicide attempt due to student bullying. "My goal as a teacher is to bring joy to my students," Kasai-sensei says with a laugh, when the bullies start harassing her. However, the students do not yet know her true nature: Kasai-sensei is a psychopath...!?

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

title: Flavors of Reincarnation
synopsis:
After a heroic death, Oh Youngsil is given the chance to select her own rebirth. With all the flavors of life before her, Youngsil forgoes all else and piles on one "scoop" of beauty after another. But there's a catch. The choices she makes now take time off her life. To stop this, she is told she must give birth to "God's Helper," which will grant her wealth and happiness. Armed with beauty and not much else, will Youngsil taste the sweetness of life, or will reincarnation prove bittersweet?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kuzulesse Oblige: Bishoujo Game Sekai no Kuzu Akuyaku ni Tensei shiteshimatta Ore wa, Gensaku Chishiki no Chikara de Doushitemo Mob Jinsei wo Tsukamitoritai
title_japanese: クズレス・オブリージュ 美少女ゲー世界のクズ悪役に転生してしまった俺は、原作知識の力でどうしてもモブ人生をつかみ取りたい

title: Isekai Ouchou Monogatari: Tensei shitara Necromancer Atsukai sareteiru Wake da ga Sore mo Warukunai ka to Omoihajimeta
title_japanese: 異世界王朝物語 ~転生したらネクロマンサー扱いされているわけだがそれも悪くないかと思い始めた~

title: Life Cry
synopsis:
"Life Cry" is the most popular game in the world—an immersive fantasy realm filled with monsters, mages, and mercenaries. For the average gamer, it is the perfect escape from reality. But for Lime, this game is a bit closer to reality than fantasy, not only because he's a dark gamer exploiting the game's mechanics to pay his bills, but also because of the uncanny life-like emotions and reactions of the NPCs he meets. As Lime digs deeper into the game, he realizes there may be more to "Life Cry" than meets the eye.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Anata no Kotoba no Togirema wo.
title_japanese: あなたの言葉の杜切れ間を。
synopsis:
High-school seniors Akira and You are in different classes, but they have been close friends since they were kids. Akira knows there's always been something strange about him that even he can't understand, and it is that whenever he comes to treasure something, it soon disappears. Ever since he realized this, he has made sure not let himself get attached to anything. However, the day before graduation, something happens that puts Akira's way of thinking to test.

(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)

title: Shout Loud My Heart
title_japanese: シャウト・ラウド・マイハート
synopsis:
When Gen Utashiro makes eye contact with a fan while playing guitar for his band, Eve, it seems like a random happenstance. Little does he know that the fan was actually Mika "Mike" Itemadani, the lead vocalist for the equally popular band, Adam. Though Gen usually does not pay attention to anything outside his own life, he feels drawn to Mike, especially after they get a chance to chat and he hears Mike's beautiful voice.

Gen soon learns that Mike attends the same college that he does, and that their paths seem to cross quite frequently. Although Gen grows to enjoy their time together, he is left wondering what he really wants from Mike, and if their repeated interactions and parallel band names are really just a coincidence.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Arigatou, Ayamachi.
synopsis:
He's a dad. Why would he do that? Daycare worker Yukari was too busy with the children for love. In fact, she didn't have any opportunities to meet people in the first place... But, just when she was thinking that, she found herself having drinks with her friend Manami's boss, Koji. The man Manami said was "good-looking, but strange," was a gentleman and escorted Yukari back home. However, having had a few too many drinks, the two of them fell on to the bed, and... wound up kissing. The following morning, Koji was gone. Yukari was in agony recalling the previous night!! With those memories in tow, she did her work, but the "handsome dad" there to pick up one of the children was... the same man she had just shared her bed with!?

(Source: CLLENN)

title: Isekai no Dekiai wa Cheat-kyuu deshita!? BL Anthology
title_english: The Other World's Doting Was Cheat Level?
title_japanese: 異世界の溺愛はチート級でした!? BLアンソロジー
synopsis: An anthology of fantasy-themed boys love web novel adaptations by various mangaka.

authors: Min, Song-A|Honey Bee|Na, Yun-hui|Namsu|Im, Lina|Dooboo|Lee, Gpiee|Yeongmo|Xuann|Massstar|Sungeun|Ari|Seo, Ire|Namon|Hwang, Hyejin|Seyoon|Seohu|Haein|Kim, Kihyun|Yangha|Tari
synopsis: An anthology of secret romance stories.

title: Kareshimochi no Mei wa Shinjiteta Oji ni Okasareru
title_japanese: 彼氏持ちの姪は信じてた伯父に犯される

title: Zutto Suki datta Kyonyuu Osananajimi ga Furyou-tachi ni Moteasobareta Nanokakan
title_english: She Sold Herself Out to Save Me From Bullying
title_japanese: ずっと好きだった巨乳幼馴染が不良達に弄ばれた七日間
synopsis:
Koki is getting bullied. The girl he likes finds out and, in order to save him, decides to take things into her own hands. "Things" meaning "dicks" in this case.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Tengoku ni Umareta Bokura no Hanashi: Ishida Yuu Tanpenshuu
title_english: The Story of Us Born in Heaven
title_japanese: 天国に生まれた僕らの話 石田ゆう短編集
synopsis:
1. Hikari no Yukue (Whereabouts of the Light)
2. Bijin wa Mikka dewa Akinai.
3. Inu mo Kuwanai Boku
4. Majo to Watashi
5. Blue Blue Spring

title: Gekijouban Mononoke: Karakasa
title_japanese: 劇場版モノノ怪 唐傘
synopsis:
Asa and Kame meet on their first day of serving in the Ooku—and quickly discover that things there are more complicated than they imagined. A strange cult, an unexplained delay in a palace festival, and even samurai in the Ooku are just some of the oddities they encounter. And what does the Medicine Seller, who peddles love potions and mononoke exorcisms, have to do with any of this...?

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Musketeer
synopsis:
In ancient East Asia, only the best warriors are chosen to defend the dynasty. Even among the best, only three stood out. These three warriors were called "The Musketeers."

(Source: Tapastic)

title: Soiui Ie no Ko no Hanashi
synopsis:
Ema, Kouichi, and Sachiko are childhood friends raised in the same religious household. Now, at the age of 28, the three find themselves at a crossroads as they confront issues of marriage, work, and independence.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Ore no Isekai Shimai ga Jichou shinai!
title_japanese: 俺の異世界姉妹が自重しない!
synopsis:
"Live freely for my sake, remember to be happy." Those were the last words Yuya heard from his sister, his last remaining family member. However, Yuya caught the same disease as his sister, his life ended without fulfilling what his sister had wished for him.

――That was what was supposed to happen, but instead he was reborn into another world.

Yuya was confused, but also found a reason to live. That was, to fulfill the promise he had made with his sister. Yuya pursued happiness as the second son of a noble family――Lyon's life had only just begun...

――What? Because I'm the son of a mistress I'm forced to live alone away from the main house? Forbidden from studying? A political marriage has been decided for me? If that is the case how can I freely pursue my happiness??

Feeling he was cheated by fate until one day, he met a girl. The story of a boy pursuing happiness and his sisters with no self-respect starts now.

(Source: Novel Updates)

title: Kono Hi, "Itsuwari no Yuusha" de Aru Ore wa "Shin no Yuusha" de Aru Kare wo Party kara Tsuihou shita
title_english: The Fake Hero Crashes the Party
title_japanese: この日、『偽りの勇者』である俺は『真の勇者』である彼をパーティから追放した
synopsis:
A Demon Lord has arisen, and the world awaits a hero. In a peaceful village, two young boys—Foyle Austin and his best friend Yu—have long dreamed about being heroes, but the legends say there can only be one. Their paths forward seem decided when the goddess declares Foyle a "Hero," while leaving Yu's destiny unclear. But Foyle has a secret only he knows. The role given to him by the goddess is actually "Fake Hero." Far from being destined to overthrow the Demon Lord, defeat awaits him at the true hero's hand, and Foyle has a good idea who that will be. When Foyle expels Yu from his party, he cements his role as the true hero's adversary. His powers begin to fade as his friend grows ever stronger. Foyle clearly won't be the one to save the world, but after an encounter with a mysterious elf in need of help, he sets out to prove that even the villain can be a hero to someone.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Enoch: The Shining Tree
synopsis:
"You shall live and suffer for eternity, trapped within your armor, prisoners of time." Enoch's life is turned upside down when his entire family is slaughtered overnight by the cursed knights. The knights wander, sentenced by the witch's curse to a fate of endless empty slaughters. Enoch trampled under their trail of blood, burns for a vengeance that outlasts, outdoes eternity. Who will be whose fate? Who is the one that orchestrates their conflicting fates?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Dagashiya Yahagi: Isekai ni Shutten shimasu
title_english: Dagashi-ya Yahagi: Setting Up a Sweets Shop in Another World
title_japanese: 駄菓子屋ヤハギ 異世界に出店します
synopsis:
From the day he was born until the moment he died, 25-year-old Yusuke Yahagi never had a say in his life. Even after being hit by a truck and sent to a new world, he was given a job he hadn't asked for: a dagashi-ya. But the cheap and tasty snacks that line his shop are different from those back in Japan. From Curry Rice Crackers to Anzu Sticks, each item comes with its own special effects. Unfortunately, this new world has no idea what dagashi are! It's up to Yahagi to teach them about the wonders of dagashi as he builds a new life for himself, selling his stat-boosting snacks to help adventurers in need and earning loyal customers—like the lively pink-haired Meryl, the mysterious man in the silver mask, and maybe even a witch or two...?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Dagashiya Yahagi: Isekai ni Shutten shimasu - Teni-saki de Daihanjou
title_japanese: 駄菓子屋ヤハギ異世界に出店します ～転移先で大繁盛～
synopsis:
From the day he was born until the moment he died, 25-year-old Yusuke Yahagi never had a say in his life.
