But the cheap and tasty snacks that line his shop are different from those back in Japan. From Curry Rice Crackers to Anzu Sticks, each item comes with its own special effects. Unfortunately, this new world has no idea what dagashi are! It's up to Yahagi to teach them about the wonders of dagashi as he builds a new life for himself, selling his stat-boosting snacks to help adventurers in need and earning loyal customers—like the lively pink-haired Meryl, the mysterious man in the silver mask, and maybe even a witch or two...?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Doku no Ou: Saikyou no Chikara ni Kakusei shita Ore wa Biki-tachi wo Shitagae, Hatsujou Harem no Aruji to Naru
title_english: The Poison King: Now That I've Gained Ultimate Power, the Bewitching Beauties in My Harem Can't Get Enough of Me
title_japanese: 毒の王 最強の力に覚醒した俺は美姫たちを従え、発情ハーレムの主となる
synopsis:
Thirteen years ago, a terrible monster called the Poison Queen attacked the Jade Kingdom. A brave party of adventurers defeated her, but in the process one of them was stricken with a curse. In order to survive, she had to pass it down to her own son. Scorned as a cursed child since birth, Caim Halsberg is hated by everyone except his late mother and Tea, a maid working for his family. While his father and twin sister reside in their mansion, Caim is forced to live alone in a forest hut. But everything changes when a certain doctor helps him to overcome the curse and claim its power. Having now become the Poison King, Caim goes on a journey to achieve his one wish—but he never imagined that his poison would have quite the peculiar effect on the beauties he meets!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Yomei Hantoshi to Senkoku sareta node, Shinu Ki de "Hikari Mahou" wo Oboete Noroi wo Tokou to Omoimasu. Noroware Ouji no Yarinaoshi
title_english: I Only Have Six Months to Live, So I'm Gonna Break the Curse with Light Magic or Die Trying
title_japanese: 余命半年と宣告されたので、死ぬ気で『光魔法』を覚えて呪いを解こうと思います。～呪われ王子のやり治し～
synopsis:
Prince Callus Leditzweissen is a Taboo Being, an unfortunate soul born with a deadly curse that causes him constant suffering. With no known cure, the doctors say Callus only has six months left to live. But a magician named Gourley gives the boy a sliver of hope when he demonstrates the healing power of light magic. Callus is determined to learn how to use light magic in time to save himself, hoping to live longer to repay all the kindness he's been shown throughout his life.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Toru ni Taranai
synopsis:
Nikawa (senpai♀) and Sudou (kouhai♂) plan to put an end to their lives of poverty by making money streaming adult videos, but...!? A fetish comedy about two people short of money.

(Source: Shounen Gahousha, translated)

title: Isekai Oooku de JK wa Koi wo suru
title_japanese: 異世界大奥でJKは恋をする

title: Miyu-chan wa Zutto Tomodachi
title_japanese: みゆちゃんはずっと友達
synopsis:
In the summer of his second year of high school, the protagonist, Yuushin Tahara, finds that his childhood friend, Miyu Fukagawa, who had moved away, has returned to the house next door. Although Miyu has grown up to be quite cute, there's something a little strange about her... This is a fresh and suspenseful romantic comedy about the gentle protagonist and his cute but rather quirky childhood friend, along with their friends and the adventures they get into!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Rakuensei Sweet Room
title_japanese: 楽園性スウィートルーム
synopsis:
In a world where people are bought and sold like merchandise, Sui is used as a tool for pleasure, trained and put on medications to suppress his growth. 

One day, he is saved by a man known as "the Demon," who hunts down evil owners and punishes them with death in the name of "self-defense." With him, Sui can enjoy hot drinks, relaxing moments, hot baths and sharing a warm bed... Despite being unable to hide his trained responses, he discovers warmth and freedom. As does the Demon... The two start to relax, spending sweet time in their apartment...

(Source: Renta!)

title: Imouto wa Siscon Ani ga Mendokusai
title_japanese: 妹はシスコン兄がめんどくさい
synopsis:
Yui Hasegawa, a somewhat lackluster high school student, has a cool older brother, Yu, who is a scholar-athlete and the most handsome guy at the school. The two are so completely dissimilar that it's hard to believe they are brother and sister, to the point where there are rumors circulating that she doesn't get along with her "perfect brother." As for that... her accomplished and handsome brother is actually a severe siscon...! An uproarious home comedy about siblings who are polar opposites!?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Otaku-kun no Seiheki wo Isshou Yugameteiku Ishuzoku Musume-tachi
title_japanese: オタク君の性癖を一生歪めていく異種族娘たち
synopsis:
The main character, Otaku-kun, is tempted into all sorts of sexual fetishes by a variety of monster girls! Will he be able to hold on to his virtue?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Lily
synopsis:
Prim and proper honors student Fan Yilin and the mysterious and charismatic Lan Ruoxi met through a stroke of fate and a misunderstanding, and only got further involved with each other from that point on. The more they came to know each other, the more something different started blooming between the two. "I like you, only because it's you."

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: Oinochi Choudai!
synopsis:
The manga tells the story of a clumsy female ninja who attacked a Karakuri Castle with very lewd traps.

(Source: ANN)

title: Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei: Yoru no Tobari ni Yami wa Hirameku
title_english: The Irregular at Magic High School: The Dark Flashes in the Night's Veil
title_japanese: 魔法科高校の劣等生 夜の帳に闇は閃く
synopsis:
The story of the spinoff novel follows the Kuroba siblings, who are sworn to protect Tatsuya Shiba. They face a new threat when an enemy from a foreign mafia sets their eyes on Tatsuya.

(Source: ANN)

title: The Heavenly Demon Doesn't Want to Level Up
title_english: The Heavenly Demon Doesn't Want to Level Up
synopsis:
Goryeo prince Jin Yuseong is a martial arts hero, but after losing his comrades, his loneliness drives him to walk through the palace's magic gate for a fresh start. Arriving in modern-day Seoul, he becomes an unexpected hero in a gate break mission, drawing the attention of the Safe Gate organization, who protect civilians from the gates. Eager to escape recruitment into SG, Yuseong disguises as the high school nephew of a former comrade, but will this be enough to outrun his fighter past?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: I Am With the Music Immortals
synopsis:
A producer who had no talent but wanted to make it as a singer. Death came on what he thought was his last chance, but the music gods didn't turn their backs on him.

"If the music gods don't abandon you, can you really do it?"

With the gods of music, change began.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Kataware Reijou ga Dansou suru Riyuu
title_english: The Reason for the Twin Lady's Disguise
title_japanese: かたわれ令嬢が男装する理由
synopsis:
The Lowreis family was wrongly sentenced to execution for attempting to murder the royal family. As Linali Lowreis, the daughter of the family, is on the brink of death, she fervently prays for a second chance. Miraculously, she wakes up three years in the past, reuniting with her deceased family members. However, tragedy looms as her brother, Liam, is poised to attend the School of Poltis, the reason for the family's tragedy. She begs her father to send her instead of her brother, as she is better at sword fighting. Now, faced with a new identity and unexpected challenges, Linali must attend the School of Poltis in her brother's place.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Isekai Maou Gokko: Maou wa Hime wo Taoshitakunai!
title_japanese: 異世界魔王ごっこ～魔王は姫を倒したくない!～
synopsis:
Nono Sasaki is an ordinary girl who loves playing video games. However, one day, she gets into an accident and is summoned in the world of the game... as the Demon Lord!

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Tonde Hi ni Iru Natsu to Mushi
title_japanese: 飛んで火にいる夏と蛍〈むし〉

title: Shinsekai Builders: Class 24 "Karada" de Ikinokore
title_japanese: 新世界ビルダーズ～クラス24「体」で生き残れ～
synopsis: A busload of 24 high school students die on a class trip and are reincarnated as monsters in another world.

title: Orc no Shuhai ni Shukufuku wo
title_english: The Half-Blood Orc in the Blended World
title_japanese: オークの酒杯に祝福を
synopsis:
In this hard-boiled isekai fantasy set in "Blended World," where alcohol is the source of magical power, Elpis, a half-orc, and Margit, the daughter of a corrupt aristocrat, adventure in search of whisky, a spirit bequeathed by the transmigrator Tanaka.

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Hyakugan no Argus
title_english: Find Me When You Wake up
synopsis: Frill was born blind but suddenly awakens to the power of the "naked eye" and goes on a quest with his new companions to find other recipients of the eyes of the mythical hundred-eyed Argus.

title: The Regressed Demon Lord Is Kind
title_english: The Regressed Demon Lord Is Kind
synopsis:
Zich Moore, the fearsome Demon Lord, is struck down by the hero Glen Zenard. As he dies, he hears Glen's request: for him to be a good person if he is ever reborn. Miraculously, Zich awakens in the body of his younger self and resolves to be a better individual. But the problem is... he has no idea what it means to be good! Can the former Demon Lord truly learn what it means to be kind? Or will his old habits and misconceptions about virtue and goodness make redemption difficult?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Main Characters That Only I Know
synopsis:
"If I were given another chance..." Ten years after the apocalypse began on Earth, while he faced imminent death, Yoohyun was filled with regret. Just then, a bright light descended upon him. When he opened his eyes, he was greeted by an unfamiliar scene... Not only had he reincarnated as a non-human race called "Teller," but he had also traveled back in time by 10 years! "Now that it has come to this, I'll live my best life this time!" Unlike his previous life, where he was solely focused on survival, he is now determined to lead a successful life. In this new life he has gained, will Yoohyun truly be able to become the protagonist?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: My Very Own Tower Strategy Guide
title_english: My Very Own Tower Strategy Guide
synopsis:
15 days until the apocalypse happens. That's what Hoyeong Lee, a 29-year-old office worker, learns when he takes the mysterious medicine he got for saving a goblin from a bear trap. As it turns out, it allows him to level up more easily and provides him with a strategy guide! Everyone in the world is forced into groups to conquer the mysterious Apocalypse Tower, and Hoyeong has to find a way to work with his teammates so that everyone makes it to the top alive. Will his ability give him an advantage, or will it end up spelling out his doom?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Shizuka ni, Midara ni,
synopsis:
1. Himitsu no Jikan
2. Natsu no Kojin Renshuu (A Private Lesson in the Summer)
3. Omote no Kao Ura no Kao (Front Face and Back Face)
4. Te wo Tsunaide, Goshujinsama
5. Ano Hi wo Omoidashite
6. Futari no Ikisaki (The Couple's Destination)

title: Dragon Heat
synopsis:
Born from the legendary love between humans and dragons, the hybrid race known as Drik looks human but carries the strength, regeneration, and instinct of dragons, including a powerful heat cycle that returns again and again. Among them, Sieric Lorence stands apart, his bloodline so rich with dragon power that he has become an unrivaled knight.

Sent by royal command to rescue researchers trapped in ancient ruins, Sieric crosses paths with Jahid, a petty thief trying to steal his sword, a blade forged from dragon bones. As Sieric prepares to punish him, fate strikes cruelly. His heat arrives unexpectedly, and without suppressants, he is left dangerously vulnerable.

Noticing his condition, Jahid makes a bold offer. As a fellow Drik, he can help Sieric endure the heat, but only in exchange for his freedom.

In the heart of forgotten ruins, surrounded by danger and desire, a risky bargain is struck that could change both of their fates forever.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Last Dot
synopsis:
Juwon is a new hire in the product development team of a tea manufacturing company, quietly nursing a crush on his handsome and composed supervisor, Assistant Manager Yul.

Content to admire from afar, Juwon keeps his feelings to himself—until one day, Yul suddenly frowns and asks, "Did someone wear perfume in the office?"

Juwon denies it, but Yul insists there’s a scent that only seems to linger when he’s around. Intrigued, Yul starts leaning in close, sniffing Juwon during every encounter under the guise of a "smell check."

What begins as an awkward misunderstanding turns into a daily ritual—one that leaves Juwon flustered, especially as his body begins to react to Yul’s warm breath and closeness.

Caught between the sweetness of unspoken affection and the thrill of their strange new routine, Juwon wonders... Could Yul be picking up more than just a scent?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Diego
synopsis:
Years after losing Matthew, the friend he secretly adored, retired soldier Jaden still battles lingering PTSD. Hoping to clear his head, he drops everything and sets off on an unplanned adventure. His travels lead him to a charming town where he meets Diego, a man who looks astonishingly like Matthew. At first unsettled, Jayden soon finds himself drawn to Diego’s warm, lively spirit. As they grow closer, Jayden begins to rediscover joy, laughter, and maybe even love. Could this unexpected encounter be the fresh start he’s long needed and the chance to finally heal his heart?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: I Love You
synopsis:
"Seongwon Kang" has loved me since we were children, a time I barely remember. I'm still too young and unsure to say "I love you," while Seongwon always expresses his love confidently. I wonder if anything will change if I smell Seongwon's pheromones. If only I could manifest as an omega, then I could accept everything naturally...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Shout It
synopsis:
Jaeho initially mistakes Taein for a criminal, but they are forced to work together on a film project. As they get to know each other, Jaeho finds himself drawn to Taein's straightforward personality. Will their opposing personalities—one a perfectionist, the other a chronic mess-up—doom the film or spark an unexpected romance?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Ichinengo, Ore no Ko wo Haramu Imouto no Kiroku.
title_english: This is a Record of How My Sister Conceived My Child
title_japanese: 一年後、俺の子を孕む妹の記録。

title: Tonari no Figure Genkeishi
title_japanese: となりのフィギュア原型師

title: Kimi to no Honban
synopsis:
1. Watashi nari no Atooshi (Getting Back in the Saddle)
2. Chuuken Kanojo (Faithful Dog Girlfriend)
3. Itto wo Oikakete (Chase the Rabbit)
4. Mukuchi na Okuchi (Silent Mouth)
5. Peropero Chuudoku (Lick Lick Addiction)
6. Tsumi to Batsu (Crime and Punishment)
7. Occult Maniacs

title: Isekai Mesugaki Succubus-gari Ojisan
title_japanese: 異世界メスガキサキュバス狩りおじさん

title: Harem Ou no Isekai Press Manyuuki: Saikyou Musou no Ojisan wa Arayuru Shuzoku wo Yome ni Suru
title_japanese: ハーレム王の異世界プレス漫遊記 ～最強無双のおじさんはあらゆる種族を嫁にする～
synopsis:
"Turn me into a fat insemination ojisan.'"
"...Eh?"

The protagonist, who asked for such a perverted wish literally right before the goddess, was a man who lived an honest life of solitude. He died alone at the end of his life. Thus, he made a wish: in his next life, he wanted to be surrounded by many kind people who loved him. He wanted to create a big harem. Thus, he was sent to a world of sword and magic.

In this way, he became the mating uncle, Genji, a kindhearted old man with a milf fetish accompanied by the goddess-turned-fat-bird (tsukkomi) Pinoko!

Thus, he weaves the heroic tale of saving the weak, crushing the strong, and turning the women he likes into milfs.

(Source: Kakuyomu, translated)

title: Kaijin Fugeki
synopsis:
Two youths—Jin and Gao—lead a seemingly placid existence in the Japanese countryside along with their friends...but in fact they are holy warriors on the frontlines of the battle against armageddon. The coming of the nigh-unstoppable embodiments of catastrophe known as "Night" has imperiled the entire human race, and only Jin and Gao's ancient ability to call on the power of the gods through dance can stem the tide of destruction.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Shuzoku "Demigod" na Ore wa Isekai demo Futsuu ni Kurashitai
title_japanese: 種族【半神〈デミゴッド〉】な俺は異世界でも普通に暮らしたい
synopsis:
Ryouma Saionji, a young man who was supposed to be at home, finds himself in a strange cabin. In the midst of his bewilderment, he suddenly receives a text message on his smartphone from someone who calls himself "the god of games and pleasures." To his surprise, it is in response to a wish that Ryouma suddenly muttered, inviting him to another world. In addition to giving Ryouma a cheat setup for his phone, he also gets the privilege of being transferred as an extremely rare race of "demigods!" Ryouma, confused but excited that he has arrived in the other world he had dreamed of, follows the tutorial on his phone and heads for the town. However, as a Demigod, those around him take notice?!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title: Higa Shimai
synopsis: A mystical horror series about two psychic sisters who encounter terrifying supernatural phenomena.

title: Hajimete, Hajimemashita.
title_english: Starting to Fall in Love for the First Time
title_japanese: はじめて、はじめました。
synopsis:
"I don't want anyone else to see how cute you are."

After his father's death, Toki worked hard to support his four younger brothers and mother. After his mother remarries, her deepest wish is for Toki to live for his own sake. As his family wishes, Toki enrolled in a correspondence high school at 27. There, he meets his younger brother's friend and actor, Takara. The overly touchy but caring Takara wants Toki to be his friend, rather than an "older brother." It was at that moment that Toki's budding feelings began.

(Source: Kaiohsha)

title: My Husband Is Weak by Day, Strong by Night
title_english: My Husband is Weak by Day, Strong by Night
synopsis:
Meredith is the illegitimate daughter of a duke. Scorned by her own family, she is shocked to hear that they have arranged a marriage for her—with no other than the Emperor of Valtzein. She soon learns that His Majesty has been placed under a curse and is weak during the day, returning to his former self only at night. When he tries to kill her on their wedding night, she strikes a deal with him—she will find a way to use her healing magic to break him free from the curse, in return for a divorce. But the emperor has other thoughts—he's slowly fallen in love with her, and he won't let her go without a fight.

(Source: NHN comico Corp.)

title: Cage on the Water
synopsis:
After experiencing multiple diastrophisms, the Earth's sea level rose exponentially. Hoju wants to show his daughter, Han Byoel, the world and heads toward his hometown. There are multiple strange marks in the town he hasn't visited for 20 years... Will the two be able to survive safely?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Moujuu-tachi to Ohimesama
synopsis:
The one who protects the princess is the beasts that can transform into humans!?

Yoseph the bear, Ludwig the hound, Miers the Canaria and Lichart the white horse, are the only friends Yulia, Vek Kingdom's first princess, has. Inside the tower which she can't escape from, Yulia spends her days leisurely with her friends reading books and listens to stories. One night, accused of assassinating the king and queen, Yulia escaped into the forest with her friends, her favorite book and a little bag she got from her mother. "When you’re in serious trouble...this will save you..." Remembering her mother's words, Yulia opens the bag. Inside the bag is rainbow powder...?!

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

title: The Genius Murim Fitness Trainer
synopsis:
During the great pandemic, my gym went under. While desperately trying to make ends meet, I possessed a character in Murim. I was excited to see that I was in the Shaolin Temple, but what the hell? Everyone's bodies are wrecked from working out the wrong way! How can I just sit back and watch when I used to be a personal trainer?! I'll teach you the correct, modern exercise methods and heal you all with low-frequency treatment and infrared therapy using inner energy! X Days until the Shaolin Gym opens.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Triad and Tribulations
synopsis:
In Korea's gritty underworld, orphaned street fighter Minjo Lee and gangster-raised Kangchul Cha forge an uneasy alliance, each fighting for survival in a landscape ruled by money, power, drugs, and sex. Both are determined to catch the attention of Seokhwan Kwak, the formidable leader of the Samgeori gang. However, their aspirations are thrown into chaos when a traitor emerges within the organization, igniting a violent struggle for survival and supremacy in a brutal world where loyalty is scarce and betrayal is deadly.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Bocchi Kaibutsu to Moumoku Shoujo dj - Gladiolus no Hanataba wo Kimi ni
title_english: For You a Bouquet of Gladiolus
title_japanese: グラジオラスの花束を君に
synopsis: Bocchi Kaibutsu to Moumoku Shoujo hentai side stories about Lily and Heath.

title: Kyou mo Ashita mo, Kimi to
Foreigner on the Periphery
synopsis:
I don't want to work. Like at all. But I don't have a choice. On earth where Humans, Elves, Orcs, Trolls, Dragons, and Alien immigrants live, it is an endless repetition of incidents. This is the story of a man that's had to work in secrecy for 800 years because he'll die if he doesn't work.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Hitojichi Hime ga, Shousoku wo Tatta. Kokurou no Kishi wa Ringoku no Shiitagerareta Hime wo Zenryoku de Aishimasu
title_english: The Royal Hostage Has Vanished: The Black Wolf Knight Yearns for the Persecuted Princess
title_japanese: 人質姫が、消息を絶った。 ～黒狼の騎士は隣国の虐げられた姫を全力で愛します～
synopsis:
Upon his nation's victory against the Kingdom of Sylvario, Brigandian knight Ark McGuine is sent to collect Princess Sonia of Sylvario, whose hand in marriage had been offered in exchange for lesser financial reparations. But when she doesn't arrive by the agreed date, he's forced to spearhead an investigation into why. As a horrible tale of mistreatment and negligence comes to light, he grows more and more drawn to a woman he's never met, but it all ends tragically: Princess Sonia perished on the way to her new home from her country's own capital, and her own family members were at fault! Ark eventually returns to Brigandia, despairing over a love that could have been...until he runs into a girl named "Nia" in his own kingdom's capital who looks exactly like the princess!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: 7th
synopsis:
In a world of swords and magic, where the Goddess is revered, Lyell Walt was fortunate enough to be born the first son and heir to an earldom. That is, until his parents disown him for losing pitifully in a fight with his younger sister, Ceres. Lyell had once been hailed as a prodigy—a wonder child—but the birth of his sister changed everything. After Ceres wounds him in their duel, an enigmatic old man swoops in to rescue Lyell and bestows upon him a necklace containing a jewel that has been blessed by the goddesses and passed down through the last seven generations of Walt leaders. As Lyell sets out, necklace in hand, will he be able to prove himself despite his humiliating loss to his sister? And moreover, will he be able to solve the mystery behind Ceres's monstrous strength and the strange sway she seems to hold over his entire family?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Kaiketsu Lionmaru
synopsis:
During the Warring States period, the demon king Gosun, who has been hiding in the Himalayas for a hundred years and has mastered evil sorcery, is aiming to conquer Japan. Shishimaru fights as the invincible ninja Kaikitsu Lionmaru with the sword given to him by Koji Kashin, Japan's greatest ninja!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Promise of Starseed
title_japanese: プロミスオブスターシード
synopsis: The manga centers on high school students who want to enter an idol training school.

title: The Bad Son
synopsis:
Blood ties bind, but vengeance severs, and in the heart of a heartless man, a fire ignites. Pildu Kang, a prosecutor born into a legacy of corruption, uncovers his family's harrowing involvement in his mother's murder. Now, a chilling vendetta awakens the monster within, drawing out the primordial urge he has long sought to contain. Will he rely on the law to be his ally on this treacherous path, or will he become the judge, jury, and executioner?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Sanokuen Koukousei
synopsis:
Mitsuki is a high school student who works hard for the sake of his sick younger sister. However, without any parents, money, or knowledge, the only thing that comes to him is to work for an illegal business or a part time job maliciously exploiting and preying on the weak. Just when he's about to despair at the unreasonableness of the world, a beautiful woman who calls herself a detective appears. She decides to change Mitsuki's life of poverty...!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: King of the Arena
synopsis:
Lee Gilsoo moved schools in order to avoid the hell-like organizational bullying. At the new school, there are no bullies or bullying, but there is school violence?! A world of fair violence among students, the "Fighting Arena." Within the Fighting Arena, students fight and enjoy violence. Can Lee Gilsoo, who has only ever lived getting beaten up, adjust to this fierce world of violence? This is the bloody school action growth story of the loner bully victim, Lee Gilsoo!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Uchi no Deshi ga Itsunomanika Jinrui Saikyou ni Natteite, Nan no Sainou mo Nai Shishou no Ore ga Sore wo Koeru Uchuu Saikyou ni Gonintei sareteiru Ken ni Tsuite
title_japanese: うちの弟子がいつのまにか人類最強になっていて、なんの才能もない師匠の俺が、それを超える宇宙最強に誤認定されている件について
synopsis:
After I was kicked out from my adventurer party, I lived out my retirement in the mountains. However, my disciple became the strongest human in the world without my knowledge, which started the rumor that her master could only be the ultimate strongest person, eclipsing humanity. Hence, I now occupied rank one on the adventurer rankings. An aspiring student, a dragon, a hero, and a demon lord all came flocking to me, completely misunderstanding everything. Please stop. I'm just a small fry, okay? This is not a story about an OP MC. It's a comedy about a bunch of idiots who think I am.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute! Master of Garden: Shichikage Retsuden
title_japanese: 陰の実力者になりたくて!マスターオブガーデン～七陰列伝～

title: Please Don't Reply!
synopsis:
What's worse than someone who leaves you on read? How about someone who doesn't know when to end the conversation? Mira Hexen is cursed to always be the last one to reply for a whole year or she will be turned to stone. But that's a bit difficult when you're the chief of a company that produces a massively successful messaging device. Mira's latest VIP client is Euryx Deyra, an extremely friendly duke who feels the need to respond to every little thing she says. If only she could just tell him to shut up already...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: By My Side
synopsis: A short manga about the story of a school girl who has a flower growing from her hair and the teacher she spends time with during that period.

title: Sugar Girl Drip
title_japanese: シュガーガール・ドリップ
synopsis:
Marie, a sparkling university student and influencer with an overflowing psychological need for approval, gets a part-time job at a diner-concept cafe for the sake of getting to wear the uniform. There, she meets Aki, a so-called "minefield kid." A major life-changing incident occurs, and they end up spending time together as accomplices...!? So begins an overdose of desire in the neon-lit city that never sleeps!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Liefe no Shukufuku: Muzokusei Mahou shika Tsukaenai Ochikobore toshite Hottoite Kudasai
title_english: The Blessing of Liefe: Leave This Magical Letdown Alone!
title_japanese: リーフェの祝福～無属性魔法しか使えない落ちこぼれとしてほっといてください～
synopsis:
It is said that Liefes are only capable of conjuring the most difficult and least useful of spells... but that won't stop Yui from doing what she loves! Despite being born a Liefe, Yui adores magic and learning all she can about it no matter the challenge. The more difficult spells, the better! If only her noble father approved. Deemed a failure to the family name, young Yui and her mother are banished from their own home... but she won't let that stop her either! After years of struggle and devotion to her studies, Yui is accepted into one of the most prestigious magic academies in the kingdom. Here she will learn from the best magical practitioners in the world—if she can survive amongst all the pompous nobles with more bluster than brains. Constantly ridiculed and undermined by her privileged peers for being a Liefe, will Yui be able to study in peace and prove them wrong? And what ancient mysteries will her research uncover? That is, if the academy doesn't stop her first...

(Sourc

title: 99-kai Danzai sareta Loop Reijou desu ga Konse wa "Chouzetsu Aisare Mode" desu tte!? Shin no Chikara ni Mezamete Hajimaru 100-kaime no Jinsei
title_english: The 100th Time's the Charm: She Was Executed 99 Times, So How Did She Unlock "Super Love" Mode?!
title_japanese: 99回断罪されたループ令嬢ですが今世は「超絶愛されモード」ですって!? ～真の力に目覚めて始まる100回目の人生～
synopsis:
Falsely accused of plotting to assassinate the Saint, Lady Alphina finds her engagement to the frigid prince called off and her head under the guillotine. Time rewinds upon her death, but despite all efforts to stave off her fate, she faces the same end 99 times over. Just when all hope seems lost, she awakens a new power during her 100th loop. She can now hear the thoughts of those around her, and it turns out her accusers were a lot more enamored of her than she thought! Can she use this newfound ability to turn her fortunes around? The 100th time's the charm!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Miyaou Tarou ga Neko wo Kau Nante
title_english: Taro Miyao Becomes a Cat Parent?!
title_japanese: 宮王太郎が猫を飼うなんて
synopsis:
Tarou Miyaou is a renowned novelist and ardent admirer of Niccolò Machiavelli. Use whatever means necessary to achieve a goal...Tarou has modeled his life after his beloved Renaissance philosopher. One day, he is struck by an epiphany: having a cat around would cure his stiff shoulders! Lo and behold, Tarou becomes a proud cat owner but it's not all kittens and rainbows...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Bowblade: The Descendants of Bowblade
synopsis:
Eulji So Moon has aged well and is now a grandfather. He orders his mischievous grandson to go on a joyful trip to Zhongyuan! To save the fallen Namgung family clan and help them spread their wings once more, Eulji Ho’s journey starts now!!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: The Story of the Hated Mule
synopsis:
"This is her daughter?"

Tara, the illegitimate daughter of the noble Queen Adelaide, was thrown away as a baby and raised by poor relatives. They sent her to a notorious mage in the west named Judas, whom she had never met before. While she is overwhelmed by her so-called guardian's impossible beauty, he and the others in the castle treat her warily, hateful of the queen. However, the girl's lovable innocence and pitiful nature begin to melt the immortal magician's frozen heart...

"Stop acting cute. You're like a vixen."

"Why do you keep calling me a vixen?"

"I don't care if that child is broken. To me, life and destruction are one and the same."

A healing romance blooms between an obsessive and frigid "guardian" that only shows kindness to one girl, and a little "miss" scarred by her past.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Greenfingers no Hakoniwa
title_japanese: グリーンフィンガーズの箱庭
synopsis:
Asahi is a university student who is introduced to a new part-time job when a record store closes. The idea is to help a "slightly unusual botanist" who lives in a large mansion in the mountains behind the university. However, on his way to the mansion, he somehow gets lost in the mountains on a single road. In fact, Asahi had a strange experience in his childhood as well... Unseen kindness intersects with people's hopes and desires. The story of an invisible botanist and a part-time university student, and the strange plants that surround them, begins!


(Source: East Press, translated)

title: Boku to Futari no Shirokuro Gohan
title_japanese: 僕とふたりのしろくろゴハン
synopsis:
Takahiro Mikami is a hapless illustrator who lives with his two cats. He's feeling down because he's in a slump at work and eating alone is boring, when God suddenly gives him a surprise! His beloved cats became human! The food that he hastily made for them since they were hungry, to Takahiro was his first shared meal in a long time. Shaky words, small hands and feet, and cute cheeks from smiling when eating something tasty... A heart-warming story with two lovely half cats!

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

title: Want to See My Cat?
synopsis:
Chayeong Mun had the perfect life—a peaceful life in the countryside with a loving husband, three cats who run the house, and two dogs who think they're cats. One day, she goes into the city to meet her friends and dies while saving a student from being hit by a truck. The god in the afterlife gives her the incredibly rare chance to go back to her wonderful life, but only under the condition of going back 10 years in time. Given the second chance, Will she be able to marry her husband again and rebuild that perfect life she knew?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Yoru no Houmonsha
synopsis:
Q-rais entertains a series of surreal night-time visitors to his apartment.

(Source: MU)

title: Ian the Illegitimate Son Was an Emperor
title_english: Ian the Illegitimate Son Was an Emperor
synopsis:
Betrayed and on the brink of death, Ian Verocian, a mage and the emperor of the Variel Empire, is sent a hundred years back in time by a forbidden spell. He wakes up as Ian Vratz, a margrave's illegitimate son, and soon learns he's about to be sent off to a desert tribe as part of a political treaty. Now, Ian must use his wits and powerful magic to gather allies and figure out the plots lurking around him. The question is... can this young mage change his fate before time runs out once more?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Why I Quit Being the Demon King
title_english: Why I Quit Being the Demon King
synopsis:
In a time of chaos, the Demon King traversed through 665 realms before invading the human realm. It was a brave hero who ceased the war. Thanks to their divine sacrifice, mankind barely managed to survive. But that led to the story of the new Demon King. Meet Demon King Demiourgos, the 666th. "I quit being the Demon King," he said, before leaving the demon realm. This is a story about a runaway Demon King and a hero who becomes his subordinate. Why did the Demon King quit?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Koroshi to Uso no Marriage
title_japanese: 殺しと嘘のマリアージュ

title: Surviving the Apocalypse
synopsis:
A boy was locked in a basement and trained his entire life. His deranged father, the one who confined him, declared, "The Apocalypse is coming." Now, armed with the training and survival skills he had honed over years of practice, he must survive the impending apocalypse.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: The Genius Spirited Streamer
synopsis:
Gyeongbok Lee possesses a gift that grants him a sixth sense and supernatural foresight—however, this ability comes at a steep price, debilitating him each time it is used. Chanwoo owns a coffee shop in Seoul. His little brother Jungmin is living with him while he looks for jobs. These two brothers share something in common. They both have the hots for one Sung Dayeon. Looks like Chanwoo has to just wonder what could have been... But Jungmin's cheating ways end up bringing Dayeon into Chanwoo's arms. As problems arise, Han seeks help from his Monday self and colleagues, but he eventually realizes that in order to succeed, he has to start trusting in himself.

"Where am I? What... am I?"

Gold Armored Sword Dragon, the boss monster of Demon Palace's 7th floor and the Guardian of the Abyss, becomes self-aware and awakens in a game world! Gold Armored Sword Dragon is a giant dragon covered in golden scales, but he takes on a human form once he withstands a set number of attacks. He's a rare character in the game "New Legend of Mir," a supposedly authentic martial arts game.

Dorothy, the girl who call him "Geum Ryong" (Gold Dragon)... title: Potato

His dream seems to be answered when American transfer student Uto Imena winds up in his class! However, Suguru cannot ignore Uto's obsession with only eating M-Do's French fries. Determined to uncover the mystery behind her monotonous and unhealthy diet, he begins to experiment with his lunches to persuade Uto to try different foods. Along the way, he hopes Uto can teach him everything he has always wanted to know about American food culture.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

Takeya is an ordinary high school boy, and because of his experience of being rejected over and over again in the past, he is always careful not to mislead girls. But even though he is such a stubborn boy, there is one girl he is very interested in. She is Mitsuba Agari, who sits next to him. She is plain and often forgotten by others, and is like an invisible mob girl, but she keeps coming on to him!! Takeya tries to suppress his instinct to fall in love, but he is at the mercy of Agari who keeps coming on to him!!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Delicious Party♡Precure: Precure Collection

The mysterious, delicious world of CooKingdom, which rules over all the cuisine in this world. CooKingdom has closely guarded the Recipe-Bon, in which it's written how to prepare any dish. But, oh no! One day, it gets stolen by the Bundoru Gang! The Bundoru Gang plans to monopolize everything for themselves, and their next target is the Cuisine Fairy Recipeppi... The Energy Fairies have come to Oishi-Na Town in the human world in search of the Recipe-Bon. With their help, an unexpected turn of events leads to three ordinary girls transforming into Pretty Cures! They stand up to the Bundoru Gang, to recover the Recipe-Bon, and to protect everyone's delicious smiles!

(Source: Toei Animation USA)

synopsis:

What starts as a simple arrangement soon becomes complicated as unexpected feelings begin to surface. Can they stick to their promise, or will emotions get the better of them? Dive into a world where love is both the goal and the enemy, and find out if their hearts will follow the rules or break free.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Hiding Out in an Apocalypse

In a world where the supernatural blends in with regular life, there is an old Japanese house. Living there is a newlywed couple, a human man and a kitsune woman. What can disturb their happy life together... not just man-eating sparrows? The daily life between human and youkai is dangerous by day, but sweet by night!?

Hasumi, a university student who meets with misfortune whenever she does anything, is interested in Oikawa, who helped her out at the entrance ceremony. However, when she steels herself to talk to him, he doesn't even remember her... Then, at the suggestion of her older brother, who noticed how amusing Hasumi's game-playing was, she decides to livestream a let's play. The video unexpectedly goes viral, and Oikawa has found it too...? Gaming livestreamer x unlaughing guy—who will be the one to get hooked?

Now, in her late twenties, Yukari's worries about "love," "family business," and "marriage," are endless. Having hid feelings for Kanta for nearly 10 years, things grow complicated when the two hook up one night. Thereafter, the nature of their relationship grows murky, as it's unclear whether they're friends with benefits, something more, or nothing at all. Will this relationship that's too close to home end up in unrequited childhood love, or a mutual confession of romantic interest?! You don't wanna miss out on this neighborhood love story!

To make ends meet, she holds a day job as an office worker and only pursues her passion for songwriting at night. One day, Woo-rim unexpectedly crosses paths with Ki Yu-sung—the celebrity whose music had inspired Woo-rim to become a lyricist in the first place. As "Hana-kun" claims he has no home to go back to, they end up living together on a temporary basis. However, in doing so, Kaede starts to realize how it warms her heart to live with someone. Then, a certain event leads to a shocking revelation of who Hana-kun really is...?!

A clingy, good-for-nothing boy meets a tender-hearted overworked girl in this deadly romance?!

The Mystic Frontier is a region where humans and monsters coexist in the sense that they share the common principle of "survival of the fittest." In this land filled with strife, the young hero Lucciola Lunatria wields her silver claws in the hopes of delivering the land from monsters to usher in peace—at least, until she meets Bilqis Draco, a first-rate merchant of Mystic Frontier Trading Co.. Through their meeting, Lucciola learns that violence isn't the only solution to the answer she seeks, opening her eyes to a whole new world of possibilities in brokering an age of harmony to the frontier!

But that's a taller order than you'd think, and how is she supposed to know who has the goods in the first place? It's not like she can go around asking guys how big they are, can she? But who should confront her heads-on is none other than Minjae, a 20-year old guy in her department, when he greets her with his pants pulled down in the student council office. It later turns out the whole thing was an accident, but Yeji's already seen all of Minjae, and she certainly likes what she saw...

A devastating accident lands Eunha Seo in the hospital. Mysteriously, she wakes up 12 years younger in her 22-year-old body. Life has given Eunha a second chance, but this is not the life she remembers. Memories blur with reality as she navigates the unfamiliar friendships and romances of this parallel time. Like a surreal game of "what if?," Eunha is torn between the excitement of a new past and a longing for the life and love she once had. Will Eunha ever find solace? Only time will tell.

After enduring an upbringing full of torment, Lady Arianne refuses to be used as a means to anyone's end but her own. When her father moves to have her sold off as an additional mistress to the crown prince, she takes matters into her own hands by proposing a contract marriage with a duke instead!

synopsis:
Former high priestess Stella was banished from the front lines of the dungeon crusade by a new priestess, whose false accusations cost Stella not only her job, but also her engagement. One year later, Stella, who has become an adventurer, saves Reinhardt, a demihuman whose original form is that of a blue dragon. The two of them decide to pair up and begin to enjoy their days adventuring together.

However, in another part of the land, the dungeon crusaders who had cast Stella out are facing trouble. Though they thought their conquest would soon be finished, for some reason, it's been over a year and the end is nowhere in sight...

A former high priestess and a young man with a precious secret begin their journey here!

(Source: Futabasha)

synopsis:
Mokhwa fell in love with a prince, Gajun Lee, at the tender age of fifteen and together they ascended to the throne. However, what she did not know then was that her husband had deliberately trapped her in a web of lies from the moment they met in order to attain the power he craved so deeply. Marriage soon enlightens her to this truth, but she is unable to avoid him eventually leading her to her death. As the darkness begins to consume her, she promises herself that in her next life she will seek revenge and protect those she loves. When she opens her eyes again, she discovers she has returned to her 15-year-old self! As the future begins to unfold in similar patterns and she finds herself caught between Gajun and his older brother, the sweet Jejun, she becomes even more determined to change her fate and make those who wronged her pay.

(Source: NHN comico Corp.)

Embodying the culture that she experienced in her previous life, she was a reincarnator with the ability to make the empire flourish.

Rossite goes to the imperial capital with him, but even there, Karina slanders Rossite by spreading rumors that she is a fake princess... One day, Sephiel, who returned to five years old, decides to get rid of the family that abused her. The first thing to do is to enter the family of a powerful person who will protect you safely! By chance, the dragon family's bride selection ball, full of sinister rumors, opens, and she manages to take the place of the crown prince's wife.

"Why do you run away. Didn't you say you wanted to marry me?"
"How does this little thing know so much about my son?"
"You're pretty sassy for a girl... and quite cute."

From her little husband to her father-in-law to her grandfather, she attracted a lot of attention from the dragons in the royal family. She must have made the dragons on her side now that this has happened... Should she take revenge on the evil humans?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: I Was Just Taking Care of My Sick Father
title_english: I Was Just Taking Care of My Sick Father
synopsis:
Evrielle Solgren is devastated by the death of her father. Living in the capital with her tutor, she didn't even get to see him one last time before the north was sieged by monsters from beyond The Curtain. It was almost too much for a 14-year-old to bear...before she was killed and woke up in her five-year-old body. Now that she has been given this opportunity, Eve will do everything in her power to save her beloved father and stop The Northern Curtain from falling.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Loved by the Villains
synopsis:
After a life of family abuse and betrayal, Lumina Lanchoux, a supernatural Leggion being, is saved from the brink of death by her half-brother Endymion. Just then, her healing powers awaken, and she is discovered by Duke Hart, the most powerful living Leggion. He sends her back in time to age 12 with the mission of saving his son Karajan from death by his own superpowers. Under the care of House Hart, Lumina is set for a peaceful second life. That is until she learns of the duke's deadly secret.

(Source: Tapas Media)

Aaron Hunter's got it all. Looks, talent, and he just won the award for best actor. He does have one issue though: trouble sleeping. The only thing that'll get him to fall asleep is a certain song by a certain someone. And when they finally meet, this is Aaron's chance to get him to write a new song. But will the mysterious singer accept this deal? And will past traumas become illuminated by their newfound relationship...?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Aru Koroshiya no Kanwa

"I'll kill you beautifully."

Towa is a wealthy conglomerate CEO's sole daughter. Fearing for her life after her parents' deaths, she heeds her father's absurd instructions to move into an apartment building exclusively for criminals to protect herself. She moves in as the legendary assassin "Skull" whose face has never been seen. However, as soon as she moves in, she meets the real Skull, Hajime Koga, and suddenly her life is in danger. The apartment has a rule where any kind of crime is forbidden. In short, what happens outside of the apartment is fair game and as soon as she leaves she'll be killed?!

A never-ending game of "hide-and-seek" unfolds between Towa and the real Skull.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Double Face
synopsis:
Jihyun is tired of being a loser. No matter where he goes, he is practically invisible to everyone...which means he's never spent the night with a girl, let alone touched one. But after his friend Yoomi gives him a crash course in self-styling, things begin to change... Will Jihyun be able to handle his sudden ascension to campus king? Or will the inner nerd prevent him from reaching his true potential?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: I'll Choose My Husband
synopsis:
Adele Leopold has perished at the hand of the emperor three times now. As soon as her fourth life begins, she vows she won't go down the same path again. Filled with vengeance, Adele starts her new life with a plan to get back at those who wronged her. In all her lives, the one thing in common is that emperor wants her married into his family. This time, Adele will choose her husband and get the revenge she has been waiting for. But the person she decides to marry is no one anyone expected...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Isekai Metaller
synopsis:
Meet Alexi: a die-hard metalhead who, after getting electrocuted during his band's farewell gig, wakes up in a world full of dragons, werewolves, and monsters that are just begging for a guitar solo. And no, the "shock" he gets entering this new world isn't from the electrocution at his gig—it's from realizing that, somehow, the afterlife isn't quite as he imagined. Instead of a peaceful resting place, he's been dropped into a land where metalheads would literally die for the chance to live in.

With his trusty "Flying V" guitar, a level 999 power boost, and a heart full of rock 'n' roll, Alexi decides it's time to crank the volume up to eleven and save this crazy new world. Dragons? Perfect for a shredding solo. Werewolves? Time to headbang into battle. This isn't just any isekai—but one where the magic flows like electric riffs and every battle feels like a rock concert.

(Source: Titan Comics)

title: Shaman
synopsis:
A world where "Curses" exist. This is a story about a young Shaman and his companions saving the world from Curses.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Doukyo Shiteiru Kensei no Onna Shishou ga Kawaisugite Mainichi Shiawase desu
title_japanese: 同居している剣聖の女師匠が可愛すぎて毎日幸せです
synopsis:
Eugene Dawson, a lad who aims to get stronger, is currently training under his master, Liza Pulsandra, who is extolled as the Sword Saint. His days are spent happily with his master, who is the strongest in terms of physical strength, but whose private life is a bit of a mess. Or so one would think, but her undefended and erotic body and unconscious physical contact make something like training seem impossible...!? Can he really get stronger like this?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Yami Baito-saki wa Isekai deshita
title_japanese: 闇バイト先は異世界でした
synopsis:
Since his mother collapsed, Ryuji Hashiba, a high school student, has had to give up his dreams and work to earn the money to pay her hospital expenses. One day, Ryuji finds an unbelievably lucrative part-time job, and even though he knows it's shady, he participates in order to pursue his dreams again. When he follows his employer's instructions and passes through a mysterious door, an unknown world stretches out before him, and he is suddenly attacked by monsters...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Developers: Game Sousaku Numa e Youkoso
title_japanese: デベロッパーズ～ゲーム創作沼へようこそ～

title: Ikiokure Seijo no Shiawase
title_english: The Happiness of the Old Miss Saint
synopsis:
"Well, what do you expect? You're twenty-seven years old now."

Saint Marialite can't believe her ears when her fiancé, the crown prince, breaks off their engagement due to her age. She doesn't let that get her down, though; considering the hardship she has endured over the past few years, her mental fortitude allows her to calmly accept the prince's decision and return home. However, when she gets there, she finds...a boy with horns?! The demon prince grows at an unbelievable speed, and in no time at all, he falls head over heels in love with Marialite. Now, he's determined to bring her back to his own country! What might bloom between the easygoing saint and the naïve demon prince in this romantic fantasy?

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

title: Atsui Kiss wa Vacance de
title_japanese: あついキスはバカンスで
synopsis:
Jun, the successor of a rich family from Tokyo visits Okinawa in the middle of summer to attend a wedding ceremony. However, his father who was supposed to be waiting for him at the venue abandons him, leaving him a letter that says "Work hard at this inn"...!! As Jun is wandering about under the blazing sun, Natsumi, a handsome guy, offers to take him to the inn. As it turns out, he actually works there. Jun's heart starts racing when he hears that that they're going to live under the same roof and work together. "Well, you had this longing expression," Natsumi says after his hot tongue found its way inside his mouth.

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title: Becoming the Lady of the Cursed Ducal House
title_english: Becoming the Lady of the Cursed Ducal House
synopsis:
When Hana wakes up in a novel as Cielina, a character who is destined to die, she decides to keep a low profile—until disturbing rumors surface that her husband, Duke Killian Seyfried, killed his own niece and nephew. Diving into the mystery, she uncovers a haunting family curse that renders the children monstrous in others' eyes. Yet, Cielina's touch reveals their true forms. As she digs deeper, Cielina discovers she's been transported into this world by a goddess with a mission: to lift the Seyfried family's dark curse. Can she unravel the family's twisted secrets and alter her own fate?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Two Names of Night
title_japanese: 밤은 두 개의 이름을 가지고 있다
synopsis:
Rose falls asleep at home and nearly faints when she wakes up at the palace in the arms of Emperor Lukewarell. Despite her uncanny resemblance to his beloved concubine, Agnes, Rose manages to convince Lukewarell that she is an ordinary tutor with no relation. However, she must help him find the missing Agnes by masquerading as the concubine and feeling out the suspicious people around her. But the more Rose learns about Agnes' complicated relationships, the less she understands who this mysterious woman was. In fact, the dread in her heart only grows as she gets closer to the truth...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Unchanged Man
synopsis:
As a new transfer in his second year of high school, Gu Dohun faces relentless bullying for no clear reason—but his eyes are set on only one person: his quiet classmate, Jeong Yuwon.

Yuwon tries to keep his distance, but Dohun's strange, unreadable pull draws him in until a sudden, devastating incident rips them apart.

Years later, they reunite as team leader and subordinate. Yuwon tries to keep things professional, but the past refuses to stay buried...and neither does Dohun's gaze. Something about him feels familiar yet entirely different. Has he changed...or was he always like this?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Famous Restaurant
synopsis:
Joo In-Gong attends his high school reunion only to be pressured by a friend into lying about his job. Despite being unemployed, In-Gong explains he's the owner of a "Matjip," a term for a well-regarded local restaurant. To save face, In-Gong resolves to make this lie a reality and purchases an old, desolate restaurant. Business is struggling until one day he discovers an unknown seasoning left by the foreigner that lives above his shop, which immediately causes things to turn around. If only he had known just what that seasoning truly was...

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Tsuihou sareta Akuyaku Reijou to Tensei Danshaku no Slow de Fushigi na Kekkon Seikatsu
title_japanese: 追放された悪役令嬢と転生男爵のスローで不思議な結婚生活

title: Beijing News Agency
synopsis:
With the invention of the steam engine, the industrial revolution occurred and civilization developed really quickly. But people don't know that an energy source that is tens of thousands of times more efficient than a steam engine has already existed in Jungwon... That is the martial arts. What if the principle of martial arts, which had been hidden by a few established powers from the past, was spread widely to the public by chance... If so, how would have the world change?

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Kuramerukagari
synopsis:
This is a story that weaves together people and a town. A coal mining town crowded with small-scale excavators, commonly known as the "Hakoniwa." In this town that changes daily like a labyrinth, there's a girl named Kagari who runs a mapmaking business and a boy named Yuya who dreams of breaking free from the "Hakoniwa." Eventually, the two, along with the unique residents of the town, find themselves confronting a conspiracy that shakes the entire town. The fate of the" Hakoniwa" depends on Kagari's drawings on the map.

(Source: ANN)

title: Kill Me Dead
synopsis:
Assassin-for-hire Cheon Seowoo. After another successful mission, Seowoo's about to make her escape. But not before taking a pretty young thing home to toy with as her reward...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: NBA Story
synopsis: NBA Story chronicles three American basketball players: Magic Johnson of the Los Angeles Lakers, Michael Jordan of the Chicago Bulls, and Charles Barkley of the Phoenix Suns.

title: The Lovable Maid
synopsis:
Shunned by her noble father, and having gone mute after her mother's death, Fey was just drifting through life until the empire invaded. Amidst the chaos, the terrifying Marquess Max Warren saves her life. Grateful, she enters his service as a maid. Despite the potential communication gap, the two have no problem understanding each other. Not so much for the other nobles though, who grow suspicious of their bond. Can this lovable maid prove them wrong and show that true charm goes beyond words?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Shinketsu no Kyuuseishu: 0.00000001% wo Hikiate Saikyou e
title_japanese: 神血の救世主～0.00000001%を引き当て最強へ～
synopsis:
Subaru is an average guy—a loser, in fact. Becoming a Player who enters mysterious gates and slays creatures to defend humanity is a far-fetched dream. But after several years of constant bullying and abuse, a Door of Trials appears before him, and he finally becomes a Player. But his brother is out to get him, and Subaru is completely outmatched. Furthermore, the Sky Clock is ticking down, which could mean the end of the world when it hits zero.

Can Subaru overcome his brother and uncover the truth behind the gates that plague the world?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: I Became the Youngest Prince in the Novel
title_english: I Became the Youngest Prince in the Novel
synopsis:
The novel "Chronicles of the Hero of Frosimar" is a story about the failures of the protagonist, not the successes.

"This is terrible."

The First Emperor, who conquered the whole world, closed his eyes with a brief appreciation (after reading the novel). But the moment he opened his eyes again, there were only a few lines about him in the "Chronicles of the Hero of Frosimar." This was because he became an imprisoned prince who met death with his first appearance (in the novel).

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: The Savior's Bucket List
synopsis:
Yonghak ultimately failed to save the world despite repeated regressions. At the next regression, he decides to quit being a savior. But suddenly, disciples show up, one by one... Will the world be kept safe?! Will the savior be able to fulfill his bucket list of wishes for rest?!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Top Star's Talent Library
synopsis:
Sang-Jun is a talentless idol trainee. The day his director spoke to him about transferring entertainment companies, Sang-Jun received the book "The Law of 10000 Hours," and unlocked access to the "Talent Library." "Voice from Heaven" and "Flexible Dance Machine" are some of many talent books he borrowed from the library to gain talent.

Great, with this talent I'm going to become a top star!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam F90 Cluster
title_japanese: 機動戦士ガンダムF90クラスター
synopsis:
Universal Century 0121 - A battle known as the "First Oldsmobile War" erupted on Mars. The Earth Federation Forces 13th Experimental Combat Group thought they had quelled the Mars Independent Zeon Forces. But the battle for the Fastest Formula is far from over!
A new tale from F90FF, beginning on Mars... Where all Formulas converge!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Hitori to Hanasu no de Seiippai
title_japanese: ひとりと話すので精一杯

title: Gomen Asobase, Tonogata-sama!: 100-nin no Ikemen to no Flag wa Subete Orasete Itadakimasu
title_japanese: ごめんあそばせ、殿方様! ～100人のイケメンとのフラグはすべて折らせていただきます～
synopsis:
I reincarnated as Sophia, the heroine of an otome game I've been obsessed with. In the game, Sophia was extremely popular as one hundred handsome men were wooing her, but my bias was the villainess, Lady Altina. If the scenario goes as planned, I will have to "ruin" her... That's impossible!! In that case, I shall not fall in love with anyone! I will mow down every burgeon of love meant for me. A record-breaking(?!) flag destruction romance, begins!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Douluo Dalu
synopsis:
Tang San is one of Tang Sect martial art clan's most prestigious disciples and peerless in the use of hidden weapons. With high expectations, the sect's elders believe his future will be bright; yet Tang chooses to forsake this life at the cost of obtaining the sect's forbidden lore—an action punishable by death. Tang, now content with his ascension of knowledge, sees no reason to keep on living and jumps from Hell's Peak, but little did he know that that would not be the end of his existence.

In Douluo Continent, the strong prevail and the weak perish. Each person possesses an innate spirit, some of which can be cultivated and strengthened, bestowing its user with various benefits. Those who were born with such spirits can become Spirit Masters, a profession regarded as one of the continent's most noble.

Tang, reincarnated into this strange world, knows only the life of a blacksmith's son. At the age of six, he takes part in the Spirit Master ceremony, and discovers his spirit is Bl

title: The Villainess Just Wants to Live in Peace!
title_english: The Villainess Just Wants to Live in Peace!
synopsis:
I transmigrated as the villainess of a novel. I wanted to get rid of my death flag and live in peace, but apparently, I've already been whipping and tormenting the final villain. I wasn't the one who did it, but since I still felt responsible for it, I've been taking care of him, and the villain's loyalty toward me keeps increasing. I just want to enjoy my wealth and honor in peace. I don't know why the story keeps going astray!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Before the Real Heroine Steps In
title_english: Before the Real Heroine Steps In
synopsis:
Once bitten, twice shy. That is Anastasia's motto when she awakes with a second chance in life as the empress in her favorite novel. After realizing that even true love cannot change destiny, Anastasia attempts to help her husband, the emperor, find his happy ending with the female protagonist—the true heroine of the story. However, it seems that the emperor has other thoughts. She pushes him away so they can both live, but the emperor is unsure if he wants to live without his queen.

(Source: NHN comico Corp.)

title: Kaere! Ootsurudani Kitaku Club
title_japanese: 帰れ! 大鶴谷帰宅倶楽部

title: Takamine-san wa, Asuka-kun to Asobitai.
title_english: Takamine-san Wants to Play with Asuka-kun
title_japanese: 高嶺さんは、飛鳥くんと遊びたい。
synopsis:
Takamine-san has the air of a haughty girl, but she loves to play like an elementary school kid. Asuka-kun is burly and fierce-looking, but he is actually gentle and kind. The two enjoy playing old-fashioned games together, but every time, they inevitably end up in a heart-stopping situation...? This is a four-panel love-comedy with maximum joy, featuring two precious kids that you will want to watch over and protect!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Konya mo Serial Killer to Machiawase
title_english: Tonight, I Have a Date with a Serial Killer
title_japanese: 今夜もシリアルキラーと待ち合わせ
synopsis:
Crime is ever-rising, a fact that police officer Shiro Isogai lives with every day. After the brutal murder of his fiancée, Isogai has been working tirelessly to find the killer. Suddenly, a "mysterious informant" begins popping up, helping the police locate serial killers one after another. Isogai knows this could be his chance for closure and decides his only hope is to team up with this person. But when it comes time to meet the secretive ally, he's surprised to be face-to-face with a young woman, Kuroi Hinata. Teaming up with Hinata and her "sixth sense," Isogai prepares to hunt the city's deadliest criminals and find the clues he needs to catch his fiancée's killer.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Schoolmate Friend
synopsis:
Gyeoul, a friend from the same class, always maintains proper posture. For some reason, Gyeoul keeps catching Yohan's attention. Suddenly, the two of them become deskmates. Just like the physical distance, their hearts get closer.

This loud heartbeat. What should we call the rising blush of that face? A clueless boy and girl's first love story.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Okitsune-sama no Shoya wa Amakunai
title_japanese: お狐様の初夜は甘くない

title: In Between
synopsis:
Eunseo Lee and Sihwa Kang have been friends all their lives. One day, Eunseo shatters their comfortable relationship by asking Sihwa out, and Sihwa moves away soon afterward. Eunseo tries her best to forget him until they meet in a college class six years later. He seems to know about her unrequited love for him, and to make matters worse, he moves in with her family after running away from his hostile home environment. Can Eunseo cope with his sudden reappearance in her life? And is it possible that Sihwa loves her back?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: A Changed Man
synopsis:
"If I can't have you, no one can." Hestia killed her beloved brother Ian with her own two hands. Three months later, he reappears in front of her seemingly unharmed; however, he has seemingly lost all his memories and become an almost completely different person. Everyone in the kingdom welcomes him back with open arms, but only Hestia suspects some foul play at work. Has her brother really changed? Or Ian not who he seems?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Doomed House's Contract Daughter
title_japanese: 곧 망할 가문의 계약직 딸이 되었다
synopsis:
I thought I had regressed from this ragged life, but why has my time-limited life remained the same? I'm ruined... is this how I should live my life...? "This time, I'll get adopted by a normal family, and live in comfort for the rest of my life!" Step by step, I'm going to take revenge against the one behind my death, and I'll protect what's left of my small and precious life! However, did I put in too much effort? "Anisha, you're perfect." "I'm going to make this child a future professor."

All I wanted was to survive... "Well, somehow, you’ve passed. I'll have to adopt this brat." I ended up with a tycoon I didn't expect. One whose household will be massacred in a few years! How do I know that? Me too! I didn't want to! Know that! But what can I do? The milk has already been spilt. I'll just live in bliss while acting as the real daughter during my five-year contract, then I'll leave! However... "...I happened to pick this up on the way home." "Father, you're the best!" "I know." ..

title: I Became the Tyrant's Chambermaid
synopsis:
When Lee Chaerin kicks the bucket, she's whisked into a dark fantasy novel as Rose Estania, a chambermaid at the mercy of the tyrant crown prince, Kalix Forsman. Armed with nothing but her real-world hotelier skills and a diary from the real Rose full of cryptic hints but no escape route, she's forced to navigate a dangerous world teeming with Kalix's enemies. Can she keep his wrath in check, evade death, and find her way back to reality before it's too late?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Bless
synopsis:
One day, Eden falls from the sky. All he remembers is his name and that if he doesn't find the treasure and defeat the Demon King within 90 days, he will cease to exist. With his best friend Coupie, they work together to suppress magic and prevent Eden from disappearing!

(Source: NHN comico Corp.)

title: A Paladin in a Dark Fantasy World
synopsis:
Two years have passed since Eden was trapped in a dark fantasy game set in a medieval world with a reputation for extreme difficulty. He has struggled as a paladin and succeeded in destroying 49 demons, now finally able to proceed with the main story of the game. However, the more he plays, the more irregularities occur and the story and relationships with the NPCs change. Will he be able to prevent the destruction in the game and survive despite the numerous irregularities?

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: X: Long Shidai
synopsis:
This story is about Xin Yun, an ordinary person who was reincarnated at age 11. He was given an opportunity to cross into an unknown world, but because of his obsession for females ended up wasting his opportunity to become the strongest. Wallowing in his sorrows he walked right into a fight between the nine masters of power and ended up colliding with their power He wakes up to find out something incredible, or rather miraculous thing—he has returned to the time where he was first brought into this world. Filled with vigor once more he decides to break even in becoming the strongest in the world and his lust for women.

(Source: MU)

title: Beloved Golden Light Gratia
title_japanese: 신의 사랑을 받는 아이, 황금빛 그라티아
synopsis:
The useless troublemaker living in the slums, Gratia. One day, while believing that both the hatred from her family and the pain inflicted upon her were justified, she had a bizarre dream.

"In the present and in the future, you shall walk a great path. Countless people shall gaze upon you with eyes filled with admiration, and shall never doubt the path you walk." The man in her dream told Gratia that she would become a great person. "See you in the future, my lovely Gratia."

That strange and beautiful dream. After waking up from her dream, the ten-year-old Gratia realized that the dream had become reality.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Magao-chan no Sekimen Jijou
title_japanese: 真顔ちゃんの赤面事情

title: Flying High
synopsis:
College student Jung-hyuk just finished his military service and is ready to find a part-time job to pay for his expenses. To celebrate their discharge, he and his best friend Yong-il go clubbing together. Be it a coincidence or not, they meet Jia, Jung-hyuk's unforgettable first love, and her sexy friend Soojung. Contrary to his wishes, but still unable to refuse, Jung-hyuk ends up having a one night stand with Soojung. As if his life wasn't already complicated enough, now he keeps running into Soojung and Jia all the time, and he just can't seem to refuse Soojung's advances. He is torn since his body wants one thing, but his heart wants another. Add his best friend, his best friend's little sister and his newly found boss to the mix and things are sure to get even more complicated. Love triangles, steamy nights and unrequited loves. Who'll be flying high in the end?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Mata Ashita to Iwasete
synopsis:
On the way back from an office drinking party, Maizumi encounters a young boy. In a desperate attempt to quickly escape his situation, he lied about the boy being a relative of his, which then led him to get involved with the boy.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Dokusha Sanka-gata Anthology: Sister Complex
title_japanese: 読者参加型アンソロジー シスター・コンプレックス
synopsis: An anthology of sister-themed short stories based on reader submissions and drawn by various mangaka.

title: Jikanwari no Soto
synopsis: A short omnibus series about girls traveling to or from school.

title: Yamu ni Yamarenu! Tensei Kenja no Heion(?) na Nichijou
title_japanese: ヤむにやまれぬ! ～転生賢者の平穏(?)な日常～
synopsis:
After losing his life because of his own womanizing badness, the reincarnated former Great Sage Kenji Akiba contracts with the Great Demon Gremory in order to become the Great Sage once again, but that contract provides the opportunity for his MAX-level yandere followers, who continued loving him even after losing him, to find him, and they won't let him get away...!?

All heroines are confirmed yanderes! A dangerous normal romcom at the mercy of love assassins coming from another world!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Yamu ni Yamarenu! Tensei Kenja no Heion(?) na Nichijou
title_japanese: ヤむにやまれぬ! ～転生賢者の平穏(?)な日常～
synopsis:
After losing his life because of his own womanizing badness, the reincarnated former Great Sage Kenji Akiba contracts with the Great Demon Gremory in order to become the Great Sage once again, but that contract provides the opportunity for his MAX-level yandere followers, who continued loving him even after losing him, to find him, and they won't let him get away...!?

All heroines are confirmed yanderes! A dangerous normal romcom at the mercy of love assassins coming from another world!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Matataki no End Roll
synopsis:
Two eighteen-year-old friends embarked on a trip after they graduated. "This will be the last time before I let go of my feelings for you..." These were the thoughts of Liam, who had been in love with his childhood friend, Lucas, for years—a secret he had kept until one fateful night at prom, when he got so drunk that he accidentally kissed Lucas. As much as he tried to avoid it, he couldn't stop thinking about how these unrestrained feelings overwhelms him. "If things continue this way, we won't be able to remain friends anymore." Having made the decision to give up on love, Liam planned a graduation trip with Lucas, hoping to create one last cherished memory together. They set off in a worn-out car with the sea as their destination, embarking on a journey where a different kind of love would blossom between these two childhood friends.

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

title: No Goddess, No!
synopsis:
Yoon Heeji is serving as the nation's current goddess, granting wishes to those that pray to her. But being a goddess isn't all it's cracked up to be: there's paparazzi, constant criticisms from the public, and, well... granting wishes isn't so easy, either. As Heeji soon discovers, sometimes satisfying a wish client means having to go further than you ever planned...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: A Life-Changing Turn
synopsis:
"Did I hit a man?" With a mayor father, and one foot in Hankuk University, high school student Cho Soo is living the high life. One mistake leads to a hit-and-run. "It's okay because no one saw it," she thinks. But her life is slowly cracking down when the messages of M, an eyewitness who seemed to know everything, flying towards her.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: My Lovely Two-Two
synopsis:
After Dongho is left stuck with a dog he never wanted, something strange starts happening to him. The dog is actually a human?! How will Dongho live his daily life with a dog that only he can see is a naked young man?

(Source: Manta)

title: Haraguro Shitsuji no Eroi Kyouiku: Do S na Koitsu ni Sakaraenai
title_english: Malicious Butler's Erotic Training: I Can't Oppose This Sadist
title_japanese: 腹黒執事のエロい教育～ドSなコイツに逆らえない
synopsis:
"You're being forced, but you still feel good. What a pervert." A new butler, Toudou, appears before a rich college student, Akito. Akito worked the previous butler hard. He's planning to use Toudou as he pleases too, but when he says something unreasonable, it doesn't work on him! If anything, Toudou says, "It's time for your training," and pushes him against the wall while rubbing against his crotch with his knee. Being pushed and rubbed hard, Akito can't prevent his body from twitching. "Could it be that you feel good?" He keeps rubbing him while saying that annoying statement. Before he knew it, his underwear had become wet...!?

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title: My Numbered Days of Happiness
synopsis:
For a child born with the Narvidal's brand, life past the age of 21 is impossible. That is the unfortunate fate of Isabelle Bilothian, the first princess in five hundred years to be born into the Bilothian royal family. However, Isabelle is special: she remembers her past life in South Korea, where she was an orphan who battled an illness before dying at a young age. Moreover, she knows exactly who she has been reborn as—a villainess from her favorite novel.

Given her knowledge of key characters and future events, Isabelle quickly avoids her first close encounter with death and wins the favor of her family. Surrounded by the warmth of familial love and loyal subjects, Isabelle uses everything at her disposal to help the world around her and make the most out of her numbered days of happiness.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
