title: Who Is Fuou!?
synopsis:
Indeed, just who is Fuou? Is he the president of the girl’s wrestling team? Is he their beloved mascot? Is he not much more than a tiny boy in ill-fitting clothes? Is he a prize to be fought over? Is he a lunatic fighter when he gets a taste for blood?

(Source: MU)

title: Kyou wa Kanojo no Shinu Hi
My Lord Was Already Into Me When I Noticed
title_english: My Lord Was Already Into Me When I Noticed
title_japanese: 정신을 차렸을 땐 흑막 주군이 감긴 후였다
synopsis:
Ten-year-old Celine Mars dreams of becoming a great knight escort just like her father. She's set to serve under Damien Willow, the heir of a powerful Duke. There's only one problem—he's a total weakling, or so she thinks. Celine vows to train the poor, defenseless Damien to stand up for himself, completely unaware of his real strength. Meanwhile, Damien instantly takes a liking to Celine, finding her cluelessness and pure intentions both amusing and endearing. When will Celine finally realize she's got the wrong idea about Damien?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Angel Kiss
synopsis:
Hajin has suffered relentless torment from a stalker ever since he was outed... Pushed to both the metaphorical and physical edge, he sees no way out. Just as he's ready to give up on life, an unexpected savior appears: an angel named Kael. But this isn't your typical heaven-sent rescue. Kael offers a shady deal: he'll get rid of Hajin's stalker, but in return, he wants Hajin's soul. With nothing left to lose, Hajin agrees...only to learn firsthand what "touched by an angel" really means.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Summer Guest
synopsis:
Sanwoo is spending his summer employed as a custodian of an old house, where his lonely days are filled with nothing but manual labor and reflections on the past. One day, however, Sunwoo's solitude is interrupted by the arrival of Eunjae, the handsome young heir of the house. As old memories and feelings come flooding back, slowly the two boys slip into a steamy summer passion. But when another visitor comes looking for Eunjae, that's when things really begin to heat up...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Four-Way Stop
synopsis:
"A spell to change the genre of your life!" Yeah, that'd be nice. So far, Juwon's existence has been pretty ordinary: a boring daily routine with zero romance to speak of. Then one day, he sees a movie where the main character's life suddenly turns into a rom-com. Things have been weird ever since. Surely it can't be down to the movie, but... guys just won't leave him alone! His childhood friend, the cute barista from the coffee shop, his mean classmate, AND his first love?! Four hotties, all at once! Now Juwon stands at a crossroads. Which way will he turn?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: 3-gatsu no Hekireki
synopsis:
Yori is a first-year high school student who has a permanent disability in one of her legs due to a traffic accident. She ends up having to repeat a grade as she had to take a break for medical treatment and those around her now keep their distance from her. That is until she reunites with Yayoi for the first time in 10 years, a childhood friend a year younger that she doted on like a younger brother. However, Yayoi, whom she has not seen for a long time, seems to have an unusual obsession with Yori, like being extremely jealous of her oshis or telling her to marry him when they first met.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Yajikita Isekai Douchuuki
title_japanese: やじきた異世界道中記

title: Koi wo Suru Tsumori wa Nakatta: Double
title_english: I Didn't Mean to Fall in Love: Double
title_japanese: 恋をするつもりはなかった―double―
synopsis:
Rou and Yoshino have spent their days blissfully in love and by each other's side at every moment. But now that Rou has graduated university, it's time to become a proper working adult! Which means his time with Yoshino is decreasing and making Rou frustrated. Between this and learning to work with his new colleagues, Rou may not be up for the task of the working world—especially if it puts his relationship at risk!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Gakuen no Nagai Gogo
synopsis:
1. Houkago Jigoku Meguri Sono 2
2. Mitsuiro no Koe ga Hibiku Toki
3. Watashi ni Naru Koto wo
4. Lens no Oku no Himitsu
5. Mina ga Nemutta Naka de
6-7. Yami Saguru Mono ni Injoku wo
8-9. Kagayaku Mono Ten kara Ochi
10. Tsukiakari no Osake
11. Inretsu no Scanner
12. Chijou wa Tatta Mama Nemutteiru

title: Raising the Princess After Her Death
synopsis:
The long-term public service exam candidate, Minseo, finds himself trapped in the game, "Raising Lena" as he tries to escape his grim reality. In the game, Minseo becomes a character named Leo, and he must navigate through a world with three different scenarios to accomplish his mission of turning the protagonist, Lena, into a princess. However, the game "Raising Lena" boasts an overwhelming level of difficulty due to enemies who are set to thwart Minseo with their immense power and influence. Will Minseo be able to complete the game by making Lena a princess and return to reality?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Blink Master of the Magic Academy
title_english: Blink Master of the Magic Academy
synopsis:
The character with the highest difficulty and the worst performance, Baek Yuseol, was considered a trash character in-game because he could not use magic in a fantasy setting where everyone else could. However...

[Because the wrong ending has been reached, 90% of Aether World has been destroyed.] [Please reach the "True Ending."]

Suddenly, those words echoed in my mind before I was transmigrated to the Aether World.

[You can use the skill "Blink."]

"Just why did I possess this character?"

Blink was the only magic skill I had. Surviving in Stella Academy among genius mages, I became the notorious Blink Mage.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Samura
synopsis:
An odd realm, quite different from our own world... When he came to, he found himself in the most mysterious place.  A samurai in appearance, he had no knowledge of his true identity... In a world full of beings with the presentment of humanity and false embodiments of nature, he seeks to discover who he really is.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Imouto wa Naze Neteru no ka?
Denden Knight
synopsis:
Cold-blooded hunter Gilia vows to eradicate monsters called the Grimm following the death of his father, but when he encounters one valuable enough to allow him a life of luxury should he find a buyer, he elopes with her, the Snail Grimm Denden. What kind of trouble will they encounter along the way...?

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Oshipi Shoukougun
synopsis:
Ria is a mega fan of the wholesome streamer Uyu-sama. Yet right after Uyu announced his sudden retirement, a new student called Yuu transferred to Ria's school... who turns out to be none other than Uyu himself! Ria is shocked to see how different a person he is than as a streamer, but she can't hate him because he is her first love. Seeing her, Uyu somehow recruits Ria to be his manager!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Haruto-kun to Chiharu-chan ga Jirettai
title_japanese: 春斗くんと千春ちゃんがじれったい
synopsis:
Touko loves shoujo manga, especially the kind that gets her heart pounding... But shoujo isn't real life...or is it? On day Haruto and Chiharu appear in front of her, flirting like in a manga! But these two aren't dating!? And they're just childhood friends!?? No way! Check out Touko's daily observations, which are as exciting as they are frustrating☆

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Masakana Koi ni Narimashita.
title_japanese: まさかな恋になりました。
synopsis:
When Mizuki Date (27) moves in next door to Shiori Iwai (35), a woman past her prime, her daily life undergoes an upheaval!! The reason for the upheaval is he appears to have a fish for a face!? However, since spending the night with him, he sometimes looks like an extremely handsome man...!? Shiori's love quickly begins to stir...!! An intense nonstop heart-pounding love comedy!! 

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Urino Kiko no Heart Beat
title_japanese: 売野機子のハート・ビート
synopsis:
An anthology of oneshots.

1. Introduction
2. Yumi no Tamashii (Yumi's Soul)
3. Otto no Earphone (Earphones of My Husband)
4. Seikan Hikou

title: Sayonara Diamond
title_japanese: さよならダイヤモンド
synopsis:
The manga centers on three girl friends who spent their youth in the high school softball club. Now in their 30s, they turn their lives around and open a detective agency in Asakusa.

(Source: ANN)

title: Watashi no Koto Kirai tte Iimashita yo ne!? Hentai Koushaku ni Yoru Komatta Dekiai Kekkon Seikatsu
title_english: Didn't You Say You Hate Me!? The Troubled Doting Marriage Life of a Strange Duke
title_japanese: 私のこと嫌いって言いましたよね!?変態公爵による困った溺愛結婚生活
synopsis:
Philia is the daughter of an Earl and wishes to spend her life enjoying her hobbies and doing the things she likes. She has no interest in socializing with other socialites of her age and in dating the opposite sex. She enjoys reading books and listening to the stories of the coming and going merchants. She relied on her parents when it came to marriage. That is when Philia receives a marriage proposal from Duke Claude Morris, who is admired by everyone. Being unable to decline, Philia marries Claude. – On the first night of being married, they return to the Duke's estate where he suddenly pushes her away saying "don't come near me." With a stern face, Claude says "I don't plan on having a man and woman relationship with you," and Philia begins to ask the reason but...

(Source: Shusuisha)

title: Usemono Sagashi
synopsis:
Lost items are usually linked to tiny spirits known as usemono. Though they are not typically visible, usemono are located by finders, who utilize them to assist ordinary citizens retrieve their lost possessions. Yakan is one such finder—though he seems disinterested in using his skills for benevolent acts unless there is payment involved.

Yakan's notoriety catches the attention of Otowa, a samurai searching for items that were taken from his family by a group of bandits. Though Yakan is reluctant to help since he has another job, he is nonetheless roped into Otowa's predicament, which seems to be more complicated than originally portrayed.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Sasaki-san wa Chotto dake Sugoi.
title_japanese: 佐々木さんはちょっとだけすごい。

title: Villainess Reborn: 24 Hours
synopsis:
The warrior Erquanna wakes in a casket and hears people making light of her death. When she shocks them by opening her eyes, she realizes she's now in the frail body of Erne de Medina, a well-known dimwit from the empire. Erne made a deal with a demon (and died in the process) that Erquanna must now fulfill. She must fall in love with one of the three strongest men in the empire—and have them fall in love with her—before her time is up and her soul is taken as payment.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: My Fiancée Is a Vampire Hunter!
title_english: My Fiancée Is a Vampire Hunter!
synopsis:
Sometimes, all it takes is a little fall for you to see the world around you differently. When Louis is magically ensnared and driven off a cliff by Maxie, a ruthless vampire hunter, he wakes up only to realize that the woman who was determined to kill him a moment ago has replaced her memory with the impression that the two of them are engaged. Louis must decide whether to tell her the truth and risk paying with his life, or end up marrying a notorious, cold-blooded killer whose old memories could return to her at any moment. A little white lie couldn't hurt, right? Especially not when your life is on the line.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Aru Banka
synopsis: A story about an awkward trip of a mother and her daughter.

title: Inukugi wo Ute!
synopsis:
In a world where railroads are the vast continent’s only long-distance transportation, rails are a precious resource, and rampant black marketing of stolen rails necessitates frequent maintenance. When Kenity, who manages the cars for laying and maintaining the rails, is suspected of wrongdoing, investigator Elliot of the railroad supervisors board goes undercover as an outlaw worker. This is a fierce action drama about railroads and the men involved.

(Source: Japan Media Arts Festival)

title: Ore ga Sodateta "Hentai": Nusunda Pantsu wo Kaese!
title_english: I Made a Pervert Out of Him
title_japanese: 俺が育てた「変態」~盗んだパンツを返せ!
synopsis:
"I'm sorry... I love you so much, Kanade... I can't hold back anymore..." Don't say that while holding my underwear, damnit...!!

(Source: WWWave Corporation)

title: Cash or Credit
synopsis:
Keith, a legendary con artist who made a career out of swindling mafias and criminal syndicates, finds himself cornered by the police. To avoid capture, he hides in the most unlikely place—prison. But the temporary safety of his self-imposed confinement is short-lived when he catches the attention of the prison's ruthless warden, Della, the most feared guard in the joint. Now, Keith must navigate a new power struggle where he might be forced to lose more than just his freedom.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Ne, Ii yo.
synopsis:
1. Nono no Sasayaki (Nono’s Whisper)
2-5. Boku wo Isshou Tasukete Kudasai (Please Help Me Forever!)
6. Koi no Netsu Shisen (The Hot Gaze of Love)
7. Kokochi Ii Basho (Pleasant Place)
8. Kakioroshi
9. Hibi Mousou (Daydream)

title: Yurari Usuiro
synopsis:
Through a cracked door, heartsick Emi hears a playful growl. Cautiously, she lets her lover in—a wolf of a man wielding a bouquet of roses. His shoulders must have been four inches wider than mine. As I stood behind him, I fantasized about the broadness of his chest and the thickness of his neck...and about becoming his mistress once again.

And so their story goes. For a young woman interested in love without the hassle of a traditional relationship, an affair with someone else's spoiled husband is just what she ordered—until it's time to move on.

Then there's Yuko: with even less time for married men's shenanigans, she turns her attention to her aging father and the guilt of adultery that has gnawed at his heart for years. Her mother is long dead, yet her memory is enshrined for eternity in their—both father's and daughter's—mirrored indiscretions.

(Source: Drawn & Quarterly)

title: Harem Spiral
synopsis:
1-6. Harem Spiral
7. Hoshi wo Miru Kigi no Oto
8. Niiname-san no Yuuga na Oshigoto
9. Broken Border

title: I'm Not the Final Boss' Lover
title_english: I'm Not the Final Boss' Lover
synopsis:
Jun Karentia, reborn into a gaming world as a support mage, leverages her extensive game knowledge to team up with the main character, Fabian, aiming for a favorable ending. But she soon discovers a twist: the game doesn't end with just one playthrough. On the second run, Jun prepares to guide Fabian to the true ending, only to be unexpectedly abandoned by him. Alone in this complex world, she crosses paths with Grand Duke Mayer Knox, the captain of the Dark Knights and the hidden final boss, who is determined to recruit Jun.

Now, Jun confronts a new set of challenges. She wonders if she can alter the game's course and turn Mayer Knox, the final boss, into the actual protagonist. Her mind buzzes with questions about Knox's intense interest in her and how to dispel the swirling rumors of their supposed romantic involvement. Jun's journey in this gaming world becomes a complex blend of strategy, unexpected alliances, and unraveling the mysteries of her new reality.

(Source: WordExcerpt

title: Shades and Shadows
synopsis:
Hye-in is a quiet, introspective high school senior. As an aspiring art major, she hones her skills in the art club. When a handsome new T.A. named Mr. Lee starts at the club, Hye-in's curiosity awakens. Mr. Lee's talented, popular and sensitive. So why on earth has he taken such an interest in her? In the complex world of high school, things are never how they appear. It all depends on how you look at them...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Maboroshi Mata ne
synopsis:
Meiko and Hozumi were once the best of friends as children but an incident at the age of nine causes a rift between them. Now middle schoolers, Hozumi continues to ignore her but Meiko is still hung up over their estrangement and finds herself unable to move on from the event. One day, Meiko encounters a young boy who looks strikingly like Hozumi. Is he an illusion? A ghost? Or something else entirely?

A time paradox story about youth, juvenile delinquency, and changing a bad future.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Tonari no Seki no Yatsu ga Souiu Me de Mitekuru
title_english: The Mortifying Ordeal of Being Seen
title_japanese: となりの席のヤツがそういう目で見てくる
synopsis:
It all starts with a steamy exchange of sexually charged looks. Average teen boy Ikezawa can't help noticing Eguchi's tight top, and when he comments on it, she quips right back that his plunging neckline accentuates his toned chest! From then on, Eguchi tells Ikezawa every single hot thing she notices about him. Ikezawa can't help feeling flustered by her attention and even starts showing off for her. With chaotic flirtation in full force, what are these two smitten seatmates going to do but play even more to each other's gazes?

(Source: VIZ Media)

title: Warm Black Tea
synopsis:
An eighteen-year-old girl named Noori is to dress up as a boy and go to a boys' high school at the request of Mrs. Hong, for whom her grandmother worked as a house caretaker. Her striking resemblance to Mrs. Hong's son made her the perfect substitute to attend the school in his stead while he recuperated from a motorcycle accident.

However, it doesn't take long for her identity to be discovered by Seokyung, a boy in her class. Surprisingly, though, Seokyung promises Noori to keep her secret and stay friends with her.

Will Noori be able to accomplish her task? How will their friendship unfold?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Sousei no Onmyouji: Santen Haja
title_japanese: 双星の陰陽師 ―三天破邪―

title: Kusuriya no Seijo: Kazoku ni Shiitagerareteita Kusuriya no Onnanoko, Jitsu wa Sekaiichi Potion wo Tsukureru Sou desu yo
title_japanese: 薬屋の聖女 ～家族に虐げられていた薬屋の女の子、実は世界一のポーションを作れるそうですよ～

title: Pan to Shishunki
synopsis:
Yuuichi, the young master of a rich household, had always thought that there was something missing in his daily life. Could his interactions with his maid, Chiyoko, change this?

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Kuroko to Heel-kun
title_japanese: 黒子と悪役〈ヒール〉くん
synopsis:
First impressions of Rento Shishima always leave people breathless; he is incredibly beautiful and seems irresistibly charming. However, that only lasts until he opens his mouth. From the very first day of high school, Shishima has gained the reputation of a devil—he is rude, disrespectful, and feared by everyone.

Kayoko "Kuroko" Kuroda has always dreamed of helping others, joining various clubs and taking on menial tasks for anyone in need. Like everybody else, she avoids Shishima—until she accidentally catches his attention. As if unable to believe someone can be so genuinely kind, Shishima begins to follow her around, showing a softer side of himself that no one else gets to see. Despite Shishima's fiendish image, Kuroko soon finds her heart racing around the boy who, in her eyes, is nothing short of an angel.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kuroko to Heel-kun
title_japanese: 黒子と悪役〈ヒール〉くん
synopsis:

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kekkon suru tte Itta yo ne?
title_japanese: 結婚するって言ったよね?
synopsis: The main character, who promised to get married when he turned 18, looked at his family and realized "marriage is hell," but it was already too late. His childhood friend has grown up into a super duper nutjob woman he can't escape from?!

title: Koi wo Suru Hi no Lingerie
title_english: Lingerie for a Day of Love
title_japanese: 恋をする日のランジェリー
synopsis:
Nazumi, a girl whose recent job has just closed shop, and is now between jobs. After her friend gets her a job at a lingerie store, some customers make fun of her chubbiness, but she is pulled out of the situation by Reo, a former middle school classmate of hers who was once a delinquent.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Kano Yo no Kemono ga Miru Yume wa
title_japanese: 彼の世の獣が見る夢は
synopsis:
The manga's story centers on Sera, a high school girl who easily gets into trouble. She gets a detestable new bodyguard who crushes people without hesitation.

(Source: ANN)

title: Subako no Oujisama
synopsis:
Everyone has one or two things they don't want you to know. The secret of Aoyagi, a 29-year-old office worker, is that he is gay. For Aoyagi, who pays his sex friends to fulfill his body, love is like a dream from another dimension. The prince of his heart is Asagiri, a 37-year-old super-elite from the same company. A brief conversation with the prince in the lift in the morning is his daily happiness. And yet! One day, the prince finds out his secret! And what's more, the prince actually has a terrible secret too...?!

(Source: Taiyo Tosho, translated)

title: 0-saiji Start Dash Monogatari
title_japanese: 0歳児スタートダッシュ物語
synopsis:
Lilia, the newborn daughter of a marquis, has the memories of her previous life! With cheat-like gamer knowledge she aims to become the strongest girl in this new "other world"!

(Source: Shusuisha)

title: Tonari no Juunin
synopsis:
There's something dark and mysterious about the man living next door... And for a guy who's got a thing for the dangerous type, that's an irresistable draw!

(Source: FAKKU)

title: Luento Genjuu Trimmer
title_japanese: ルエント幻獣調整師〈トリマー〉

title: Koibito Ijou no Koto wo, Kanojo ja Nai Kimi to. @comic
title_japanese: 恋人以上のことを、彼女じゃない君と。＠comic
synopsis:
A fun, carefree, and casual relationship.

He spent the night with an ex-girlfriend. Exhausted from his demanding job, Fuyu Yamase reunites one day with Ito, his girlfriend from university, and they go out for drinks. As they bond over complaints and old stories, Fuyu thinks how nice it is to have this kind of friendship. But in a moment of drunkenness, they end up sleeping together. Although Fuyu regrets it, Ito sternly tells him, "Don't apologize." She continues, "Don't talk about doing things properly. Let's just stay together because it feels good." Ito, too, was tired of the societal pressures to be correct and the constraints of adulthood.

Thus, they form a peculiar relationship: excluding bothersome things like work and love, and just doing fun things. A short story series offering comfort and a touch of eroticism to those weary from society.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Watashi no Megami ga Kyou mo Oseru: Korekara mo, Itsumademo
title_english: My Goddess Is Precious Today, Too
title_japanese: 私の女神が今日も推せる ～これからも、いつまでも～
synopsis:
They start off as friends, total opposites who watch each other from afar, or maybe they're locked in a fierce competition. Either way, they can't stop thinking about one another. These fluttery feelings can only mean one thing: first love! Swoon over these budding teenage romances that celebrate girls loving girls.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Chou to Teikoku
synopsis:
Robbed of the person I love and my way of life, to whom should I direct my wrath at having everything taken from me?

The manga adaptation of a novel set in Imperial Russia at the beginning of the 20th century, depicting the love and revenge of women at the mercy of the malice of the times.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: They Say I Was Born a King's Little Daughter
title_english: They Say I Was Born a King's Little Daughter
synopsis:
Have you ever wondered what if Sanghee was born a king's son? Did you know Sanghee's sisters hate her guts? Whether it be Jinsu trying to make the perfect dish or Sanghee competing in a beauty contest, learn more about your favorite characters in the cutest spin-off of the hit series They Say I was Born a King's Daughter!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Henkyou no Roukishi
title_english: The Old Knight of a Frontier District
synopsis:
Abandoning money, fame, and honor, the knight Bard embarks on a journey to find his final resting place. Tasting delicious food, admiring the unfamiliar scenery all by himself, his journey to find a place to die quietly begins. What he doesn't know, however, is that this is the beginning of a new adventure for him.

(Source: MU)

title: Moto Konyakusha kara Nigeru Tame Kyuuketsu Hakushaku ni Koibito no Furi wo Onegaishitara, Nazeka Dekiai Mode ni Narimashita
title_english: I Fell into a Situationship with the Vampire Count?!
title_japanese: 元婚約者から逃げるため吸血伯爵に恋人のフリをお願いしたら、なぜか溺愛モードになりました
synopsis:
"I would like you to become my lover." Daughter of a viscount, Freya Villiers was being pressured into taking back her ex-fiance, Nathan, after their engagement was broken off due to him cheating on Freya with her sister. In order to flee her parents, who are all for her reconciliation with Nathan, she visits Count Bloodbury, feared by the nobles as a "vampire." With nothing to lose, she asks him to pretend to be her lover and...?!

(Source: Kodansha)

title: The Return of the 8th Class Mage
title_english: The Return of the 8th Class Mage
synopsis:
As a powerful 8th class mage, Ian Paige took countless innocent lives under the orders of Emperor Ragnar—a close friend and ruler of the Greenriver Empire. Despite their closeness, Ragnar views Ian as a threat and subsequently poisons him. Using time magic, Ian saves himself and returns thirty years to the past. Now a young boy, Ian joins an elite order of mages to hone his abilities once again. This time, he'll get revenge on the emperor who betrayed him and reclaim glory as an 8th class mage!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Return of the 8th Class Mage
title_english: The Return of the 8th Class Mage
synopsis:
As a powerful 8th class mage, Ian Paige took countless innocent lives under the orders of Emperor Ragnar—a close friend and ruler of the Greenriver Empire. Despite their closeness, Ragnar views Ian as a threat and subsequently poisons him. Using time magic, Ian saves himself and returns thirty years to the past. Now a young boy, Ian joins an elite order of mages to hone his abilities once again. This time, he'll get revenge on the emperor who betrayed him and reclaim glory as an 8th class mage!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Hakuryuu
synopsis:
Tatsuya Shirakawa, also known as Hakuryu, has established the Kurosu-gumi as a significant force in Shibuya's underground scene. His approach is uncompromising and lacks morality as he employs a ruthless range of skills. He displays a resolute personality with no hesitation in the face of adversity, making him a captivating yakuza leader. Unfortunately, the Tenwakai conflict jeopardizes their operations. Can Hakuryu and the Kurosu-gumi overcome this challenge and emerge even stronger?

(Source: Nihonbungeisha, translated)

title: Nihon Mukashibanashi Senshuu: Baika no Omoibito
title_japanese: 日本昔噺選集 梅花の想ひ人
synopsis: An omnibus of Japanese folktales.

title: Do Not Hold on to the Broken Branch
title_english: Do Not Hold on to the Broken Branch
synopsis:
After two failed engagements and the downfall of her family, Deatrice, the duke's daughter and once the most celebrated socialite in high society, finds herself in a reluctant reunification with Lucius. Lucius is her former fiancé and currently the emperor's favorite knight whose life had been ruined by her own father six years ago. Is this forced marriage the beginning of Lucius' vengeance? Could fate turn it into a second chance for them to get over the shadows of their painful past and find true love?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Archvillain's Dying Nanny
synopsis:
Born into a cursed noble family, Claude Ambrosia grows up to become the villain who destroys the empire in the novel "Flower of Darkness." Enter Sarah Millen, the writer of this story, who is determined to change Claude's tragic ending as his new nanny. Though cold to her at first, Claude slowly opens up to Sarah, who encourages the young boy to see his distant father, Duke Ethan Ambrosia. Can Sarah help this father and son heal? Or will the curse that haunts this family spell doom for them all?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Skill "Saisei" to "Hakai" kara Hajimaru Saikyou Boukensha Life: Gomihiroi to Tsuihou sareta kedo Kikakugai no Chikara de Nariagaru!
title_japanese: スキル【再生】と【破壊】から始まる最強冒険者ライフ～ごみ拾いと追放されたけど規格外の力で成り上がる！ ～
synopsis:
Rolf is a boy who received the rare skill regeneration and belonged to the strongest party. However, the skill never activates and he is banished as useless. He spends his days alone with only a tattered sword as a memento, but when he meets Elsa, who has the skill destruction, his ability awakens...!?

(Source: Starts Shuppan, translated)

title: Regnal Trigger
synopsis:
"You can bring Toa back with the Regnal Trigger..."

Twins Aren and Toa slave away for ten years at the mines of Treviyehn. Aren plots their escape, but when Toa takes her own life, he decides to follow suit. Just when Aren is about to lose all hope, the mysterious "Deed" appears, offering him what he desires most. But at what price...?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Miti no Echiechi Dungeon: Skill wo Yadoshita Ecchi na Ishou de Isekai Meikyuu wo Kouryaku seyo
title_japanese: ミティのえちえちダンジョン スキルを宿したエッチな衣装で異世界迷宮を攻略せよ

title: Counter Cube
synopsis:
What if there exists another world beyond lucid dreaming? That is where those who have been stolen of their dreams gather. Do Shi-Eon, who escapes reality by lucid dreaming, loses his dream and falls into the space of "Shared Dream." Now he must fight to reclaim his dream.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Shuukatsu Yuusha
synopsis:
Several decades have passed since the Hero defeated the Demon King and brought peace to the world, and the Hero has grown old enough to only vaguely remember his magic spells. When the remnants of the Demon King's army attack the Hero, he decides to set out on a journey again. This time, it's not a journey to save the world, but a "journey to the end of his days" to reflect on his life.

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Bakumatsu Yankee
synopsis:
In Edo period Japan, a mysterious foreigner washes upon the shore of Shinsengumi-claimed territory. The foreigner is nicknamed "Yankee," and eventually takes a liking to leader Souji Okita. As the two become good friends and even better warriors, the Shinsengumi faces threats beyond their control, and sends Okita and Yankee to take on enemies to further claim Japan as their own.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Sansei no Hantai
synopsis:
A poisoned human being is generated from waste fluid in a pharmaceutical company's experiments. He is not allowed to touch people, but one day he meets a kind-hearted woman!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Uroko
synopsis:
She comes to my sweets shop every day, demanding manju. What is the secret that she's hiding behind her mild demeanor?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Munou wa Fuyou to Iware "Tokei Tsukai" no Boku wa Shokunin Guild kara Oidasareru mo, Dungeon no Shinbu de Shin no Chikara ni Kakusei suru The Comic
title_english: As a Watchmaker, I Was Kicked Out of the Craftsman's Guild Because My Incompetence Was Deemed Unnecessary, But I Awakened to My True Power in the Depths of the Dungeon
title_japanese: 無能は不要と言われ『時計使い』の僕は職人ギルドから追い出されるも、ダンジョンの深部で真の力に覚醒する THE COMIC
synopsis:
In a world where skills are supreme, Shikuro is given the incompetent skill of "clock-user." One day, Shikuro, who is looked down upon by others, is accused of rape and sent to the frontier, where he is pushed down a hole that leads to a dungeon's deepest level. In the depths of his desperate situation, he thought to himself, "If only I could use my clock-user ability to stop my stomach clock as well." Then the hunger would stop. This triggered the awakening of his skill "clock-user." Eventually, he makes full use of his abilities and is recognized as an SSS-class adventurer.

(Source: Micro Magazine-sha, translated)

title: Kimi no Tame no Curtain Call
title_japanese: 君のためのカーテンコール
synopsis:
Shy, mousy Sakura Akutsu is content to keep her adventures confined to the pages of her notebook—until the brash, outgoing new transfer student Tsubame Hiiragi gets her hands on it, that is. The two secretly share the stories Sakura spins, but soon that secret proves too big to keep, and Tsubame whisks Sakura into a glittering world she could never have imagined!

As Sakura learns to be confident in who she is and ignore what others think, Tsubame learns to go below the surface and dig deep for emotional truths that may have eluded her... Together they'll learn about art, love, truth, and most of all, the theater...!

This creative and emotionally rich series uses every visual tool available to express the confusion and elation of adolescence.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Isekai Shachuuhaku Monogatari: Outrunner PHEV
title_english: Sleeping Overnight in My Car in Isekai
title_japanese: 異世界車中泊物語 アウトランナーPHEV
synopsis:
One young salaryman who adores his plug-in, hybrid car that uses both electricity and gasoline, had been using camping in it as an escape plan from everyday life. Suddenly, he finds himself transported to another world with his car! He'll start his life anew in this different world!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Kekkon Shiyou. Rikon Zentei de.
title_japanese: 結婚しよう。離婚前提で。
synopsis: In order to get her parents off her back, Rui enters into a temporary marriage of convenience with her NEET friend Kyousuke.

title: End Roll wa Kimi to
title_english: On the End Roll with You
synopsis:
Included one-shot:
Volume 1: Kyuuketsuki no Bansan wa Kyou mo Mazui

title: Watashi no Konyakusha wo Ubatta Danshaku Reijou ga Naze ka Natsuitekimasu: Uruwashi no Reijou ♂ no Hakarigoto
title_english: The Baron's Daughter Who Stole My Fiancé Somehow Misses Me
title_japanese: 私の婚約者を奪った男爵令嬢がなぜか懐いてきます～麗しの令嬢♂のはかりごと～

title: Ie wo Oidasaremashita ga, Genki ni Kurashiteimasu: Cheat na Mahou to Zense Chishiki de Kaiteki Benri na Second Life!
title_japanese: 家を追い出されましたが、元気に暮らしています ～チートな魔法と前世知識で快適便利なセカンドライフ!～
synopsis:
At age three, Tafelina Lowell Lera Duval was disowned by her birth parents, but was that actually a blessing in disguise? Raised in a remote region of Ozeria by the kind earl of Peylon, she was allowed to hunt in a forest full of monsters, invent magic tools based on memories of her previous life, and let her extraordinary magical talents flourish. But that all begins to change with the approach of her thirteenth birthday. As the child of a noble, she's obligated to attend an academy meant to raise and educate the next generation of nobles. That means moving to the royal capital, a sprawling city quite unlike her beloved home. Lera soon feels like a fish out of water, and things only get worse with kidnappings, the appearance of her half sister, and more. But Lera's not one to be disheartened easily and that isn't about to change!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Haishinsha to Ryman
synopsis:
Yuuto Ozu is a video game streamer who hates going outside. Nobuyoshi Usaki is a salaryman who has loved Ozu since they were in high school, but is unable to confess his feelings. Due to a stroke of luck and good timing, Usaki and Ozu start living together. Ozu cooks, cleans, and picks up packages, and Usaki does laundry, washes the dishes, and takes out the trash. Now that they are living together, how will their relationship change?

(Source: Toranoana, translated)

title: Comic Party Wonder Love
title_japanese: コミックパーティ ワンダーラブ
synopsis:
Raizo and TOS are two men who also write BL in their spare time. Raizo is a cool, laidback and handsome guy whose dark BL style is popular, while TOS has a light and fluffy writing, but is less popular due to his social awkwardness and difficulty communicating. Even though they are complete opposites in everything, they find themselves inexplicably drawn to one another...

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Daiyon Taisen: Seiu Mokujiro
title_japanese: 第四大戦 世羽黙示録

title: Meijoushigatai Mono: Lovecraft Kessakushuu
title_english: H.P. Lovecraft's the Unnamable and Other Stories
title_japanese: 名状しがたいもの ラヴクラフト傑作集

title: Manga de Yomu Taketori Monogatari/Uji Shuui Monogatari
title_japanese: まんがで読む 竹取物語・宇治拾遺物語
authors: Nozaki, Tsubata|Itsuki, Row|Konoya, Kei|Miyanishi, Atsu|Kanfuu|Kihara, Asuka
synopsis: A manga adaptation of Taketori Monogatari and Uji Shuui Monogatari.

title: Hakaiou: GaoGaiGar tai Betterman
title_japanese: 覇界王～ガオガイガー対ベターマン～

title: Inhale
synopsis:
Doyoung's life as he knows it starts to turn upside down with the kidnapping of his sister, Dohee. With his psychometric ability, he finds out that the people who kidnapped his sister aren't normal humans and that there are many others with special abilities like him...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: From Acting Genius to Top Idol!
title_english: From Acting Genius to Top Idol!
synopsis:
Paik Hyeon sacrificed everything to become the best actor in the industry. So when he's about to die in a plane crash, he makes a desperate wish for another chance to live. Hyeon's plea is granted, but who said anything in life was free? Reborn as his younger self, Hyeon must first become a successful K-pop idol if he wants to be an actor again. Can Hyeon make it in the cutthroat world of fierce competition, demanding schedules, and fake smiles? Or will he fail and lose his second shot at fame?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kishi Danchou no Musuko wa Akuyaku Reijou wo Dekiai suru
title_japanese: 騎士団長の息子は悪役令嬢を溺愛する
synopsis:
"Alice, I'm breaking off my engagement to you!" are the words Echs, the son of the Knight Commander, remembers from his previous life. In the very place where the prince's engagement is about to be broken off, he remembers the exact same situation from his previous life in a dating sim game. Though clearly fale, the villainess is blamed together with another character. And when he saw the heroine sneakily smiling at him, he made up his mind. He wants to save his favorite villainess and make her his own. This is just a sweet story about a hero reincarnated as the son of a knight commander in a dating sim game who dotes on the villainess.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title: Yanderegoroshi!! Shuuchaku Yabame no Osananajimi ni "Watashi mo Suki" to Tsutaetara, Love Comedy Route ni Shift shimashita
title_japanese: ヤンデレ殺し!! ～執着ヤバめの幼馴染に「私も好き」と伝えたら、ラブコメルートにシフトしました～

title: Ouma ga Toki no Kodomotachi
title_japanese: 逢魔が時の子どもたち

title: Sennen no Hanamichi
synopsis:
In 1523, a man became enamored by the angelic singing voice of the songstress Miko and believed that a thousand years was being added to his life from listening to her sing. He decides to dedicate his life to supporting her no matter what; yet, tragedy eventually rips his beloved idol away from him. Five hundred years later, the same man is still alive but is now rooting for the up-and-coming masked singer known as SuZu.

Having lived through many eras and supported many idols, the man is shocked that he was even able to find an idol with a sound that captures his heart like Miko did all those years ago. However, when SuZu announces that there will be forthcoming news regarding the future of her career, the man begins to worry that he is losing his newfound favorite just like before.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Boundary
synopsis:
Woohyun's life isn't great, but it isn't terrible either. Sure his boss gives him a hard time, but he's got a stable corporate job that pays the bills. He can't exactly remember what made him fall for his boyfriend, Seok-il, but hey, he's handsome. But when Woohyun bumps into his high school love, Minhyuk, he realizes that the magnetic spark is still there, even after a decade. And for the first time in a long time, Woohyun feels totally alive.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Bocchi the Rock! Epigraph
title_japanese: ぼっち・ざ・ろっく！ エピグラフ
synopsis: Bocchi the Rock! Epigraph was distributed as a bonus for attendees of the compilation films of Bocchi the Rock!

title: Youkai Buster Murakami
synopsis:
Terrifying youkai from hundreds of years ago have been released into the present day. Kuin the exorcist stands tall to protect the peace of this world! But in this war of Youkai vs. Exorcist, regular high schooler Murakami has entered the battle!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Included one-shots:
Volume 1: Senoo no Toubu
Volume 2: Mayonaka Tsukioka Koutou Gakkou

title: Teach Me!
synopsis:
They say third time's a charm, but what Jaehong needs is a miracle. After failing the notorious college entrance exam twice, he's determined to succeed and finally experience the ultimate campus life. However, he can't do it alone. His new math tutor, Eunsung Han, looks like he'll be Jaehong's best ally. The thing is...Eunsung isn't actually Jaehong's tutor! The misunderstanding gets cleared up quickly, but that doesn't change the fact that Eunsung was the best tutor Jaehong's ever had. Now Jaehong has a new objective: to persuade Eunsung to teach him. However, Eunsung doesn't seem too keen...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: 6 Under Ground
synopsis:
In the busy streets of Shinjuku, Keigo lives a careless life as a gangster. Before meeting Haiji and his gang, he was alone and unwanted. Now, Keigo is Haiji's most treasured pet, and Haiji will end anyone who gets to lay a finger on him. In a world of violence, will these two be able to last?

(Source: Fantasista Inc.)

title: Muyoku na Boku No Futei Koui
title_japanese: 無欲なボクの不貞行為
synopsis: Included one-shot: Kimi no Sakasu Koi no Kaori wa

title: 11-banme no Neko wa Nene
synopsis:
The manga's story centers in a country where cat people live, and human children are not allowed entry and is considered a serious crime. But one day, a human child slips in the country and gets mixed with the cat people. The human child has something to accomplish no matter what.

(Source: ANN)

title: Melin's Salvation Plan
synopsis:
I suddenly woke up in the body of Melinia, a supporting character and the first love of Male Lead A from "Azuli's Magnificent Misfortune." Since I know how this tragic tale ends, I decided to do what I can to stop the ultimate destruction of the kingdom from the male leads. But the more I try to fix things, I can't help but notice that the storyline seems to veer farther away from what I read. Will this plan of mine work? Or will it just cause more harm than the original?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Roommate 101
synopsis:
Lee Hyuk's a medical student at a good university, but his goals are more artistic. So he decides to chase his dreams by stealing his sister's money and running away from home! He lands himself a teaching job and a place to stay, and everything is going great until he discovers his landlord is his student and school delinquent, Lee Biru. Hyuk may be the adult, but he has no real life experience. Biru, on the other hand, is independent, and more than capable of fending for himself. A coming-of-age story about two men who hate each other, but are exactly what each other needs.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Gal wa Shisso Gohan ni Sosorareru
title_japanese: ギャルは質素ご飯にそそられる
synopsis:
Shirakusa, a high school boy who loves simple meals, finds solace in eating lunch alone every day. However, one day, he unexpectedly encounters Rabi, a gal from the same class, during lunchtime!?

(Source: Comic Trail, translated)

title: Return Like a Tidal Wave
synopsis:
It takes so little to become a target. Hojin only did what he had to do—help out a friend in need. He was trying to save his friend from Jung-yoon, the school's aggressive bully. Back then, he didn't know that doing the right thing can sometimes lead you to hell. Now the target of vicious bullying, Hojin's desperate to get back to normalcy. He's had enough. Something inside his soul has broken. He can't let this carry on. Small ripples of rebellion are forming inside him, and these ripples will soon turn into a tidal wave, a tidal wave that will wipe everything away.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Forged in Flames: The Piece Maker
title_english: Forged in Flames: The Piece Maker
synopsis:
It's red, hot, and burning with flames! Sage is a young boy from a small village who dreams of becoming a renowned Piece Maker like Edmond Dantes. But when his antics to help others with crafting skills get him in trouble with the local mercenary gang, a trio of rowdy blacksmiths who call themselves the Red Pepper Guild show up and come to his aid. He joins the Red Pepper Guild in their quest to solve the mystery of strange dungeons and mana stones, but can he survive the battles and the blazing dishes his eccentric guild master cooks up?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Exorcist no Kiyoshi-kun
title_japanese: 悪祓士〈エクソシスト〉のキヨシくん
synopsis:
The most powerful exorcist in history—Kiyoshi! In order to protect that which is precious to him, Kiyoshi has attained ultimate strength. But he has a secret he can't tell anyone... Become a sword that slays evil! Become a shield that protects the weak!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Himaten!
synopsis:
Working part-time with a house cleaning service, 16-year-old Tenichi Iemori dreams of one day building a cozy house for himself. He is content with his peaceful daily life, but as he starts his second year of high school, things begin to change. A popular makeup company president Himari Yoshino transfers into his class, and Iemori is placed in charge of looking after her for the day!

After surviving the day with Yoshino, Iemori heads over to clean the apartment of a new client. Upon his arrival, he is shocked to discover that the luxurious apartment is a complete mess, but what shocks him the most is the resident of the apartment—Yoshino! Although Yoshino is hesitant to let a classmate work for her, Iemori quickly proves his worth, leading her to entrust him with the job. And even though the two must keep their arrangement a secret to avoid unnecessary rumors, they gradually begin to get more comfortable in each other's company.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Buta Kizoku wa Mirai wo Kirihiraku you desu
title_japanese: 豚貴族は未来を切り開くようです
synopsis:
The glory of the past is long gone. Once hailed as a prodigy, now mocked as the "Pig Noble" due to his arrogance and appearance, Herbert, the son of a ducal family, falls into despair upon receiving a letter through temporal magic from his future self, revealing a tragic fate twenty years ahead. However, determined to face the self he had long avoided, the "Pig Noble" resolves to struggle and use temporal magic to carve out a different future for himself!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Muryoku Seijo to Munou Oujo: Maryoku Zero de Shoukan sareta Seijo no Isekai Kyuukokuki
title_english: Helpless Saint and the Powerless Princess
title_japanese: 無力聖女と無能王女～魔力ゼロで召喚された聖女の異世界救国記～
synopsis:
One day, part-timer Tamura Nana was summoned out of her room and into another world, after which her summoners declared her a saint and asked her to save their world. However, though she was hailed as a saint, it turned out that Nana possessed no magical power at all! And to make matters worse, she was chosen as a partner by a princess who can't use magic...

The helpless saint who has no magic and the powerless princess who can't use magic. And so begins the adventure of these two leftover heroes!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Mayou Inu, Sasou Neko
synopsis:
1-4. Inu to Neko no Hoken Taiiku
5. Mousou Tokkyuu Takuhaibin♥
6. Kyou kara Omae wa Ore no Dorei da
7. Himitsu no Otonarisan
8. Himitsu no Otonarisan: Gohan mo Kimi mo Tabesasete?

title: Moto Cheat☆Makeppanashi
title_japanese: 元チート☆敗けっぱなし

title: Tsubame wa Modottekonai
synopsis:
The story centers on Riki, a 29-year-old woman who quits her caregiving job in her Hokkaido hometown and moves to Tokyo to work at a hospital, but the exhausting and irregular job leaves her with financial problems. She hears of a high-paying side gig her colleague Teru. She heads to the Japanese branch of Arte, a specialized American assisted reproductive technology clinic to become a surrogate.

(Source: ANN, edited)

title: Gallbladder
synopsis:
Money, lust, and desire for powers. None of that is needed for a man whose importance is as small as a gallbladder. However, if a man wants true peace of mind, he will need to have those.

(Source: MU)

title: Suterare Elf-san wa Sekai de Ichiban Tsuyokute Kawaii!
title_english: The Abandoned Elf Is the Strongest and Cutest in the World!
title_japanese: 捨てられエルフさんは世界で一番強くて可愛い!
synopsis:
"Dear top players, this game is a real parallel world. If you reincarnate and save the world, any wish you have will be granted." Former popular voice actress Ayano responded to the proposal from the goddess, in order to shine as a voice actress once again. Reincarnated as the strongest species of high elf, she aims to "clear the game" in the parallel world with the strongest and cutest kemo-eared heroine using her gaming knowledge, but...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Drunk Bullet
synopsis:
After surviving World War I, Gary, a liquor-loving ex-serviceman, finally makes his way home. To his shock, Prohibition has post-war America in a chokehold! The curtains open on Gary's action-packed quest for a sweet, shining glass of booze!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Koronika no Nou
synopsis:
Zero was raised in a child protective institution. Despite the institution's philosophy of "If you desire it, have faith and fight for it," he disliked conflict and favored a peaceful life. However, upon learning of a certain secret, Zero finds himself embroiled in a cruel twist of fate!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Gogo no Oishii Yakuzen Nikki
title_english: Gogo's Diary of Delicious Medicinal Cooking
title_japanese: 午後のおいしい薬膳日記

title: Futago Challenge!
synopsis:
Akane and Kaede are twins who look identical. Their parents have been forcing them to be "more properly girlish" and to be "more properly boyish," so they have come up with a certain "challenge"...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Ai to Yorokobi no Sanka
synopsis:
Gwendolyn, the head of a poor orphanage, visits the earl of Cwm Rhyss to ask for donations for the children's Christmas gifts. The earl is famous for his disdain for others after being horribly burned in a fire five years ago. Gwendolyn, not afraid to stand up to the unpleasant man, ends up waylaid by a terrible snowstorm. A reluctant Gwendolyn has no choice but to spend the night with the bitter earl!

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Ore no Oshi wa "Kamisama" desu!?
synopsis:
Mamori, a die-hard idol fan, would do anything for his beloved Kamui, the lead singer of the popular male idol group "Gods." When a chance for Mamori to see his idol live and up close at a concert seems to fall from the heavens, he can't believe his luck. Everything seems like a dream come true, until Kamui looks directly into his eyes... and calls him his "ceremonial vessel"!!

In a world where heavenly beings walk the earth, Mamori learns that his bias is quite literally a god in human form... and he wants Mamori to bear him a child! So begins their divinely-ordered cohabitation, but can Mamori really accept that the person he idolized is a god? Was everything Mamori thought he knew about Kamui true, or has his love been built on a lie?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Shunkashuutou Daikousha: Hyakka Hyakuyou
title_english: Agents of the Four Seasons: One Hundred Songs and One Hundred Pages
title_japanese: 春夏秋冬代行者 百歌百葉
synopsis:
With the power bestowed upon them by the Gods, the Agents of the Four Seasons bring the seasons to the world. It is their duty to traverse mountains and valleys to bring the blessings to every corner of the world. Each Agent has a special guard for if anything happens to them the seasons stop to cycle.

Sakura Himedaka is the guard of Hinagiku Kayo, Agent of Spring. Ayame Hazakura guards Ruri Hazakura, Agent of Summer. Rindo Azami guards Nadeshiko Iwaiduki, Agent of Autumn. Itecho Kangetsu is the guard of Rosei Kantsubaki, Agent of Winter. They have just gone through battles with those who aim to destroy the system. This is a vivid story of four Agents and four guards who wish to protect the world but are also individuals who fall in love.

(Source: Kadokawa)

title: Itan no Shukusai
synopsis:
There's a reason Emi Shimamoto can't find a job. For as long as she can remember, she's been unable to tell the living from the dead, and spirits have tormented her wherever she goes. Resigned to yet another failure, Emi attends an interview with Moriya Foods, only to find herself strangely attracted to its young president, Jan. Though it doesn't take Emi long to realize that something is off with both Jan and Moriya, she's far too smitten to care. Meanwhile, Emi's brother grows worried over his sister's change in behavior and pays a visit to an investigation agency that specializes in supernatural phenomena... What follows is a journey into the dark depths of cults, family, and the paranormal.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Sasaki Jimusho Series
synopsis:
There's a reason Emi Shimamoto can't find a job. For as long as she can remember, she's been unable to tell the living from the dead. Resigned to yet another failure, she attends an interview with Moriya Foods, only to find herself strangely attracted to its young president and more determined than ever to get the position. Meanwhile, Emi’s brother senses that there is more going on with his sister than meets the eye, and he pays a visit to a certain agency that specializes in matters of the supernatural...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Wareta Cup wo Modosu ni wa
title_english: How to Repair a Broken Cup
title_japanese: 割れたカップを戻すには
synopsis:
Keita and Kippei have been in love for over 10 years but started having troubles expressing their passion physically somewhere along the way. Whether they are too used to each other, or just feel too awkward about it, their bedroom is almost dead. But when Kippei breaks a cup they made together on one of their first dates, it allows him to switch places with himself at the age of 18 and spend time with a younger Keita. By revisiting the beginning of their love story, Kippei might just be able to find the answers to his current predicament.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Heroine? Seijo? Iie, All Works Maid desu (Hokori)!
title_english: Heroine? Saint? No, I'm an All-Works Maid (And Proud of It)!
title_japanese: ヒロイン?聖女?いいえ、オールワークスメイドです(誇)!
synopsis:
"I will become the world's most wonderful maid!" With her skirt fluttering in black and white, the girl shouted. Her name is Melody. A reincarnated former Japanese girl, she now pursues her dream in her new life, working as an all-purpose maid for a poor count's family in the kingdom of Théolas. The tribe of angels, unable to return to their original world, keeps searching for the "great hole to return to," but they reach a certain young man...?

Reborn by the God's power as the third son of a noble family, named Alrain, he is showered with love by his family and grows up healthily. As soon as Kangjae hears, he cleans up his act, sticks to her like glue, and ponders how to make her stay. He's determined to keep Jian by his side, but can he come up with a proposal good enough for her before it's too late?

One day, a fox is ready to pounce on a rabbit, only to receive a confession from its would-be prey. Ignoring the fox's confusion, the rabbit professes, "I love you." The villagers seem to want the apathetic outsider gone, while burying dark truths and worshiping the mysterious "Mother." title_japanese: 身代わり乙女の幸福な嫁入り～めいこと結びのあかし～
synopsis:
The time is the Taisho era. The orphan Meiko, who suffers from weak eyesight, lives a modest but peaceful life at a temple orphanage.

One day, a suspicious person visits the temple and suddenly attacks Meiko. When she wakes up, she finds that time had rewound several months back. To avoid death, Meiko follows a guide. There she meets her long-lost twin sister, Kanako, the daughter of a marquis. After her parents tell her the story of her birth, Meiko is to marry Matsuwaka Akashi, a military man feared as the "Demon Akashi," as Kanako's substitute.

title: Kaiko sareta Kyuutei Renkinjutsushi wa Henkyou de Dainouen wo Tsukuriageru: Sokoku wo Oidasareta kedo, Saikyou Ryouchi de Slow Life wo Ouka suru
title_japanese: 解雇された宮廷錬金術師は辺境で大農園を作り上げる～祖国を追い出されたけど、最強領地でスローライフを謳歌する～
synopsis:
Isagi, a court alchemist, uses alchemy to reform agriculture in order to save the people who are suffering from food shortages. However, he fails to gain the understanding of the government, which prioritizes military affairs, and is eventually fired. Isagi is at his wits' end, but at the invitation of Mercia, a cat beast maid, they head for a remote beastman village. The alchemist's slow life of leisurely and carefree farming begins!

(Source: Starts Shuppan, translated)

title: The Exiled Hero
synopsis:
After seven grueling years, Jihan Yu, a support hero, is expelled from his guild. But fate throws him a curveball—a contract with an elemental grants him the ultra-rare power of a Wind Elementalist! In a world ravaged by monsters and invaders from other realms, Jihan joins the underdog Epic Guild. Can he utilize his newfound power and strategic mind to lead the ragtag guild to greatness, all while mastering his abilities, overcoming fierce rivalries, and surviving in this chaotic world?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Rental Tama-chan
synopsis:
A town hall official exhausted from work is using a so-called "Cat Rental Service" but much to his surprise, a human man with attached cat ears & cat tail is standing in front of him. Despite this, he enjoys his time with the fake cat.

(Source: Manga Mogura RE)

title: Kitayama-kun to Minamiya-kun
synopsis:
Minamiya has a strange talent. Just by looking at someone, he can imagine what they'd look like when they're super turned on. In fact, he can't really stop. However, there's one exception—for some reason, he can't picture what his cute male coworker, Kitayama, would look like in the throes of passion. Unable to get these thoughts out of his head, a misunderstanding leads to the two men going out. But can the frisky Minamiya handle the real deal?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Hotarubi Enya
synopsis:
1945, Tokushima. Yodono's a cameraman visiting the base to photograph the special unit pilots. He's photographing them with only one motif in mind: "Young and admirable soldiers." During his time seeking to photograph that, one soldier in particular catches his eye. Shizuma Tanaka, flight petty officer first class, always smiles when looking through the lens. One night, Shizuma comes to talk with Yodono. Conversations progress beyond the camera, and Shizuma directly asks, "Would you try doing this to me?" The two know that they can't be doing this, but continue to feel themselves draw closer to one another in this first chapter to a series of various characters in various places, navigating the complicated space of the military during World War 2.

(Source: Shinchosha)

title: Lost Virgin: How to Sex
title_english: Lost And Undefiled: Lessons in Sensuality
title_japanese: ロストバージン how to sex
synopsis:
Up-and-coming actor Takeru has finally started dating the super popular cross-dressing tv personality Choko a.k.a. Choji. He finds himself overwhelmed with emotion at his first-ever boyfriend, but the more time he spends with Choji, who's doing his best to help him with this new situation, the more he starts to feel like he wants to do his best to grow both as an actor and as a person, to be a perfect match for him.

At some point, Takeru explodes in popularity after his movie is a huge hit and he starts appearing on talk shows!! The more attention he attracts from the public, the more worried he gets about their relationship being exposed and starting a scandal. Also, new problems like fellow actors making passes at Choji and the filming of an intimate scene in his new movie make Takeru dread that Choji might get tired of him!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Monster Therapy! Karada no Nayami, Kono Ko-tachi ni Omakase Kudasai
title_japanese: モンスターセラピー! カラダの悩み、この子たちにお任せください
synopsis:
Ares, a lackluster tamer, has started doing "monster therapy," a folk remedy that utilizes the special characteristics of monsters. He straightaway tries using a slime for treatment, but for some reason the female client gets sexually excited!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

synopsis:
As the captain of Sunyu High's baseball team, Lim Sung is dedicated to bringing the team victory. That's why he wants to recruit a talented batter named Nam Heedo, but Heedo vehemently refuses his offer. Why? Because he can't stand the smell of people! But much to his surprise, Sung smells different to him. So to get Heedo on the team, Sung agrees to Heedo's innocent yet stimulating demands. However, how long can they keep their special arrangement a secret from the rest of the team?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: My Enemy Is My First Love
synopsis:
I have a love-hate relationship with my first love, Ji Yura, who is the elder of twin sisters and the very same person that bullied me and cruelly rejected my innocent feelings. Then, my first love changed to Ji Yuri, the younger twin of Ji Yura, who comforted me when I got bullied. However, when I thought I put those painful memories behind when I started university, Ji Yura reappeared in front of me!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Soup no Mori: Doubutsu to Kaiwa suru Olivia to Moto Youhei Arthur no Monogatari
title_english: Soup Forest: The Story of the Woman Who Speaks with Animals and the Former Mercenary
title_japanese: スープの森～動物と会話するオリビアと元傭兵アーサーの物語～
synopsis:
Olivia, who runs a soup restaurant outside of town on the edge of the forest, has a secret she can't tell anyone. She can hear animals' and humans' inner voices. This ability left her alienated from her family to the point that they sent her away to a convent when she was only five years old. After escaping while en route, she was brought to the restaurant by the people who would become her adoptive grandparents. Twenty years later, Olivia continues to live with her heart closed off to other humans, until, one day, a former mercenary by the name of Arthur stops by on a rainy morning, dripping wet.

And what are those feelings he starts to develop for her?

Soup Forest is a place of meetings and partings, a place filled with the forest's bounties, a place of gathering for both animals and humans. They come together, share a meal, go their separate ways, and continue on with their lives.

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

synopsis:
A fallen clan, a lone survivor, and a warrior grandfather. Jinsan Yu, once a legendary martial artist, swears to the heavens he would survive until Seol, a child with an extraordinary gift, comes of age. Through fate's hand, they encounter allies and enemies alike from the unlikeliest of places, and unearth deep conspiracies concerning the Yu Clan's downfall. "I'll protect you, Grandpa!" The supreme cry of his youngest granddaughter ignites a dying warrior's spirit.

An ordinary Japanese high school student takes home an abandoned supernatural cat left in a cardboard box. Maybe he shouldn't have meddled with kitties beyond human comprehension—after all, it had tentacles where its whiskers should have been! But it's too late!

With no Elder Sign on the cat door, soon the pick of the Mythos litter starts to invade his house, as furry and feline versions of Hastur, Yog-Sothoth, Nyarlathotep, and other adorable Lovecraftian horrors blast his mind, whisper impossible secrets, and generally get underfoot!

(Source: Dark Horse)

title: Wakeatte, Hensou shite Gakuen ni Sennyuu shiteimasu

synopsis:
Cesia, a mere servant, is attending the Royal Academy in place of the lazy, pampered daughter of the viscount she works for, all for a massive monetary reward upon her successful graduation that would allow her to live the rest of her life without any worries. She spends her days avoiding the feeble bullying of the ladies of the Academy while being worked to the bone at the viscount's mansion—until just before graduation, when she gets tricked and her pay completely vanishes! Furious, she vows to get even, no matter what it takes, when out of nowhere, the second prince shows up and offers to help her? A young high school boy finds himself drawn into this fight and struggles to stay alive while also trying to protect a young girl ganshi named Yoo Yoo that was left in his care.

However, it turns out this dog is no ordinary beast, but a divine beast. The divine beast, Ranag, becomes deeply attached to Lezay, the only one it can communicate with. In response, leader Alragia offers to take both Lezay and Ranag under the protection of the mercenary troop...? A little girl, a divine dog, and a mercenary squad. This is a bizarre off-world fantasy with some strange members!

But one day, while on a quest he miraculously finds a Legendary Book that can give anyone who reads it the never before seen Legendary Class! He was planning to sell it for a lot of money, but luck was always his worst trait. Of its former wealth, there is almost no trace left and humans have had to exile themselves on huge space colonies orbiting the Earth. Into this world, a powerful consortium was born, whose objective is to transform our planet into a resort, creating areas able to accommodate a limited number of inhabitants. Our story begins on one of the many space colonies, an unhealthy slum: Slick Star Midas. Hearing these words from her boss, Shuugo, makes her go crazy. A sweet kiss and passionate touch make her climax with her entire body. However, this happiness is only temporary. She decides to savor this one moment for the rest of her life, but then Shuugo suddenly proposes to her?!

Sensing shifts in mana, successfully manifesting it, and attending the most prestigious school at the top of his class at a young age, Ruin Ardell is on track to become a great mage. Everything was going smoothly until he discovered that he had a condition preventing him from expelling mana. Ruin's tumble from grace gave those jealous of him the opportunity to toy with him. With a newfound yearning for freedom, she dumps her loser fiancé and resolves to pave her own way... until the "angel of high society," Duke Louivan, suddenly proposes a marriage contract! But instead of a promotion, he gets framed for embezzlement—and even worse, death. To his surprise, Hyeonu wakes up after going back in time and being reborn as Dojun Jin, the youngest grandson of the chairman of Sunyang. As Dojun, he’s the last in line for succession, but his life as Hyeonu has taught him all the ins and outs of the company, plus he now has knowledge of the future at his disposal. Meet Sol Han, the human photocopier who can replicate anything she sees with precision! One day, she stumbles upon a mysterious genius's drawing in a VR game, igniting her passion for art. Curiosity leads her from a quiet countryside to Illip Arts High School, the epitome of artistic excellence. Amidst challenges and tangled friendships, Sol's journey, a captivating tale of youthful growth and camaraderie, unfolds in the picturesque halls of Illip.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: On a Leash
synopsis:
Baek Dam treats contract worker Yeon-il like a chew toy: dumping work on him, humiliating him, even exposing his alcohol-related trauma in a drunken slip. So when Dam wakes up bound in an unfamiliar place, a dog collar locked around his neck and a bowl of kibble shoved in front of him, he realizes the leash has changed hands. Cornered by a cold, unreadable Yeon-il, Dam is forced into the role of "Yeon-il's dog." As control tightens, desire and resentment twist together, and suddenly the rules of dominance and control are no longer so clear.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Peace Restaurant
synopsis:

The tension in her restaurant simmers not from culinary rivalry but from the precarious peace among patrons from warring dimensions. Will Sua's culinary diplomacy be enough to maintain this balance, or is her restaurant destined to become the epicenter of an ultimate showdown?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

"It's me." He introduces himself as Ji Tae-ho, the neighbor who used to live next door. But she can't seem to remember him, it's as if he's been wiped clean from her memory. Daye promises to get in touch with Tae-ho, but then inevitably forgets. "Noona, why haven't you contacted me?" A few days later, the embarrassment strikes again. Daye apologizes and agrees to have dinner with Tae-ho. Expensive sogopchang! They get drunk, brag about their small successes, and she somehow ends up inviting Tae-ho inside her house...? "That's crazy. The ball is there for you to hit it, if you won't then you can't call yourself a hitter."

title: Kanojo to Kanojo no Neko
synopsis:
On the outskirts of Tokyo, in a neighbourhood crossed by a commuter railway, local cats weave their way through the lives and homes of their owners as they navigate difficult times.

A cat named Chobi sends silent messages of courage to a young woman, willing her to end a faltering relationship; a gifted artist fatally misunderstands her boss's enthusiasm for her paintings; a manga fan shuts herself away after the death of her friend, while her cat Cookie hatches a plan to persuade her outside; a woman who has dedicated her life to a distant husband learns a lesson in independence from her cat.

Against the urban backdrop of humming trains and private woes, She and Her Cat explores the gentle magic of the everyday. Populated by both the friendly and the feral, it reveals—with heartstopping clarity and warmth—how even in our darkest moments, community and connection may lead us to a happier place.

(Source: Penguin Random House)

title: Kaijuu Kamui
synopsis:

In a desperate gambit, ace pilot Yamato Shidou is placed onboard a giant biological weapon, codename: Kamui. The only thing that can beat a kaiju...is another kaiju!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Hyojeong's always seemed kind of intimidating, but the way her eyes sparkle as she plays makes Miso want to learn more about retro games, and muster up the courage to befriend her. When Miso and her older brother Minjun head to the old video game store in their town, not only do they find that it's run by Hyojeong and her older sister, they also discover a nostalgic portal to the past...

Then he gets transferred to another city, and their cohabitation is called off!? "I don't want him to forget about me...!" When Kazuha pursues him, he...!? Endowed with memories of a past life as a Shinto exorcist and natural psychic abilities, she uses her exorcism skills to protect others from malevolent apparitions. In this first installment, Nicola clashes with ghosts, doppelgangers, and more than one ill-fated romance. Most spooky apparitions seem to spawn around the school, where the students' propensity for gossip provides ample sustenance for their existence. Here, the more vividly one imagines something, the more likely it is to come true. However, as first-year student Nicola ventures beyond her schoolgirl life at The Royal Academy, she finds that the tenacity of spirits (and grudges) means that they can turn up in the strangest of places.

Even her cold attitude doesn't discourage him! Using his swordsmanship prowess, he overpowers his magic-wielding peers—inadvertently smashing through anything that's common practice at magic school. In the process, his skills catch the eye of the Imperial princess. She tries to recruit him into the army, but he shoots her down. He doesn't want to be the strongest—all he wants is to live a peaceful and enjoyable life!

Forced to cook and clean, Chloe's world shatters one day when an encounter with her mother at knifepoint drives her to flee the only home she's ever known. Desperately seeking refuge, she escapes to the only sanctuary she knows: the royal capital. But is the big city everything she hoped it would be? Just as she finds herself on the brink of despair, a mysterious, gallant knight rescues her, offering a glimmer of hope and the promise of a new beginning.

From ancient orgies to disco-era hookups, Garam must document sex culture and harvest the elusive energy source known as... Orgasium.

History class has never been this NSFW.

In a world where humans and vampires coexist, a starving vampire Jess is trapped by humans and imprisoned beneath a slave camp. The warden tortures Jess, seeking a cure for his own disease, but Jess fails to heal like most vampires. Desperate, Philip locks Johan, a former doctor turned slave, underground with Jess to nurse him. As Johan works to gain Jess's trust, he finds himself dangerously drawn to the enigmatic vampire. Sensing Johan's feelings, Jess pretends to return them, planning his escape. But if they break free together, can they ever truly reclaim their old lives and escape this darkness?

Cecily is a romantic who dreams of finding true love—the only problem is that she's a witch! Scorned by society, she gives up on meeting her very own Prince Charming until a chance encounter with the gruff but gallant knight Zeke reignites her dream. She concocts a love potion in secret and brings it to him, but before she can get a word in edgewise, he accidentally drinks the whole thing! Will Cecily manage to come clean about the whole affair? And will this slipup lead to the happily ever after she's always wanted?

The truth is that Ebihara also likes Kaimori, but he does not have the courage to confess. Because of his past relationships, he can't have a physical relationship with him, and he can't even admit that he's fallen in love with someone of the same sex...

Soon their ship is attacked by Pirate Boal, and the two are caught in his ship. Moreover, the ship gets beaten by a storm, and they are thrown into the ocean. After drifting about for a while, they reach an isolated island on the Southern Ocean, which is Treasure Island on his father's map. It seems they finally achieve their goal, yet another trouble waits for them. Pete is kidnapped by the natives! Will they survive and find the treasure at the end?
