Eleven men and women who gathered to find true love, start to move based on their mental and physical attraction. Living together in place filled with different types of energy away from any surveillance camera!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Yoki Houritsuka wa Ashiki Rinjin
title_japanese: よき法律家は悪しき隣人

title: Shizuto-kun no Hajimete, Ubatteshimaimashita
title_japanese: 静人くんの初めて、奪ってしまいました
synopsis:
Living together with two handsome men?

Manga artist Himari Mizuno stands on the brink after her fiancé was stolen by a childhood friend, she lost her job, and she was kicked out of her home. She needs a place to live, so she decides to move into a share house for creatives. There she moves in two men: Shizuto Yuzuki, a highly wary novelist, and Aki Okamoto, a sociable designer.

However, at the welcome party on the first day, Himari has a certain misunderstanding with Shizuto and, drunk, she visits his room intending to correct him---!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: The Apocalypse Yakuza
title_japanese: ジ・アポカリプス・ヤクザ
synopsis:
Kawasaki was destroyed by a giant monster that suddenly appeared. In a city abandoned by the government, the only person fighting the monsters is a yakuza who was based in Kawasaki.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Goblin Reijou to Tensei Kizoku ga Shiawase ni Naru made: Konyakusha no kanojo no Tame no Zense Chishiki no Jouzu na Tsukaikata
title_english: The Reincarnator and the Goblin Maiden's Happily Ever After: Using a Past Life to Keep a Joyful Wife
title_japanese: ゴブリン令嬢と転生貴族が幸せになるまで 婚約者の彼女のための前世知識の上手な使い方
synopsis:
Ginorious Adolni has but one goal after reincarnating into a new world—find and marry someone he can grow old with. After living for close to a century without ever having a single relationship due to his hideous appearance, Ginorious wishes for companionship from the depths of his heart. The opportunity presents itself one day when he receives an offer to marry the daughter of the premier duke. It's a shocking proposal for the son of a simple viscount, until he learns that all their attempts to arrange courtships with higher nobles have already failed, and for one simple reason: the daughter's appearance, which has earned her the epithet of the Goblin Maiden. But Ginorious sees his past self in her, and soon learns that she has a genuinely beautiful soul. Ginorious resolves to use everything at his disposal, including knowledge from his past life, to make her happy.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Goblin Reijou to Tensei Kizoku ga Shiawase ni Naru made
title_japanese: ゴブリン令嬢と転生貴族が幸せになるまで
synopsis:
Ginorious Adolni has but one goal after reincarnating into a new world—find and marry someone he can grow old with. After living for close to a century without ever having a single relationship due to his hideous appearance, Ginorious wishes for companionship from the depths of his heart. The opportunity presents itself one day when he receives an offer to marry the daughter of the premier duke. It's a shocking proposal for the son of a simple viscount, until he learns that all their attempts to arrange courtships with higher nobles have already failed, and for one simple reason: the daughter's appearance, which has earned her the epithet of the Goblin Maiden. But Ginorious sees his past self in her, and soon learns that she has a genuinely beautiful soul. Ginorious resolves to use everything at his disposal, including knowledge from his past life, to make her happy.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Kumori Nochi Hare
synopsis:
A glimpse into the unlikely friendship between a standoffish boy and a boy who always keeps him company.

(Source: Coamix, translated)

title: Kaibutsu-tachi wo Suberu Mono: Saikyou no Shien Tokka Nouryoku de, Kizukeba Sekai Saikyou Party ni!
title_english: The Boy Who Ruled the Monsters
title_japanese: 怪物たちを統べるモノ 最強の支援特化能力で、気付けば世界最強パーティーに!
synopsis:
Sol Rock plays the role of support in Black Tiger, an up-and-coming party of prodigies known as the Miracle Children. His party sees him as deadweight and he's expelled by the leader, but the truth is that he has a special talent that gives him the godlike power to bestow incredibly OP skills and stats upon his companions! Only two members of his party, "Iron Wall" Reen and "Saint of Healing" Julia, realize that Sol is the source of their amazing powers, and they choose to leave with him. With no one holding him back, Sol can finally unleash his true potential, and he decides to use it to create the world's most powerful party. When Sol is offered five cards, each depicting a monster powerful enough to take on the world on its own, he begins a journey to gather them all to his side and fulfill his dream!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Kaibutsu-tachi wo Suberu Mono: Saikyou no Shien Tokka Nouryoku de, Kizukeba Sekai Saikyou Party ni!
title_english: The Boy Who Ruled the Monsters: Before I Knew It, the Ultimate Specialized Support Skill Led to the World's Ultimate Party!
title_japanese: 怪物たちを統べるモノ 最強の支援特化能力で、気付けば世界最強パーティーに!
synopsis:
Black Tiger is a party of five up-and-coming prodigy adventurers known as the Miracle Children. Among these big names, Sol Rock was the only black sheep—mocked as a useless support mage, treated like a grunt, and eventually even kicked out...But the truth is, he has the strongest talent of all—Player! This godlike power allows him to buff his allies and control the flow of battle. And now, with no party to call his own, he begins to assemble the strongest group the world has ever seen...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Keikoku Akujo no Yarinaoshi Oujotan: Kishi Danchou ga Bukiyou de Hanaremasen
title_english: Tale of the Ravishing Villainess's Royal Second Chance at Life
title_japanese: 傾国悪女のやり直し王女譚 騎士団長が不器用で離れません
synopsis:
The villainess who almost destroyed her kingdom found herself looped back to five years before her death. She is a fourteen-year old girl, loved by her father, the King, and her two brothers. Sophia remembers everything that she had done, to her maids, to her knights, to her family. Bryath, her bodyguard, was loyal to her until he dies at war that she and her brother Riley started. She decides to save everyone including her, in this life. Everyone was aghast when Sophia told them she'll start studying for the kingdom. She is determined to be a real princess for people, not villainess, in this life. Now she must uncover all conspiracies to avoid the tragedy. But something is off about Bryath...he is too protective in this life!?

(Source: Kadokawa)

title: The Hero's Ready to Retire
synopsis:
Everyone's shocked when 9-year-old prodigy Adelia Ester suddenly refuses to enroll in the elite knights' academy. They don't know that Adelia was magically sent back in time after wasting her life on the battlefield and suffering an early death! Now, Adelia's out to protect her peace from her ex-boss, the evil future emperor, by setting her ally on the throne instead. Will Adelia succeed in one last mission and finally retire for good? Or will she find herself forced to be a hero once more?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: 'Cause Calypso Can
synopsis:
Calypso has experienced repeated reincarnation, and is her 4th reincarnation. In her previous lives, she always died before she reached the age of 22 and returned to where everything started. During her 3rd life, she discovered that when a dragon goes on a rampage, it distorts dimensions. Determined to use this knowledge, she plans to exploit the dragon's power to return to her original world. Currently, Calypso finds herself in a childcare story, where she encounters a man who she believes to be her father but doesn't recognize her. Seeking his help, Calypso involves her "father" and family in her quest, turning them into unwitting allies in her journey.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Moto Ansatsusha, Tensei shita Kizoku no Reijou ni Narimashita.
title_english: The Former Assassin Who Got Reincarnated as a Noble Girl
title_japanese: 元暗殺者、転生して貴族の令嬢になりました。
synopsis:
High Society Is Rough For Assassins!

Enter Lady Selena, the former assassin who assumed it'd be easy to step into the role of pampered mademoiselle, but who finds herself aggravated by how differently she views things compared to her flower-brained mother and her scheming, deceitful (yet utterly ineffective) stepsister. She navigates tea parties filled with ladies attempting to assert their dominance, attends an academy thick with ulterior motives, and dodges harassment flung at her with an icy glare and fierce counters, but it's that stone-cold heart of hers that leaves her isolated and alone.

One day, she learns her stepsister has become engaged to the second prince, a fact that forces her to run away from home. She doesn't get far before bumping into someone, however, and that someone just happens to be the first prince.

Come watch as the cold-blooded former assassin who's never known love dives fearlessly into noble society!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

title: The Dying Villainess Denies Adoption
synopsis:
After transmigrating into the body of a terminally ill villainess, Ibellin decides to find a peaceful life and a happy ending instead. Rather than selling off the main villain, Raven, to get the expensive medicine needed to treat her illness, Ibellin decides to heal the boy and then quickly send him on his way. But when Raven's father comes to seek her out, Ibellin is given a choice she's never imagined before. Will she accept it, or will she decline in hopes of finding happiness elsewhere?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Mob nanoni Makikomareteimasu: Ouji no Ibukuro wo Tsukanda Rashii
title_english: I'm an Entangled Mob: Seems the Way to a Prince Is His Stomach!
title_japanese: モブなのに巻き込まれています ～王子の胃袋を掴んだらしい～
synopsis:
"Mira, get this... I'm the heroine of this otome game world!" At Spica's confession, memories of a past life flash before Mira's eyes. Spica says that Mira is only a mob character in this world. In which case, the love interests and game events aren't a concern, and Mira is free to live quietly and enjoy fine cooking—supposedly. But a late night bowl of udon sets life on a different course... and now a mob character's cooking has a main character by the stomach?!

(Source: AlphaPolis)

title: Saikyou F-Rank Boukensha no Kimama na Henkyou Seikatsu?
title_english: The Carefree Frontier Life of the Strongest F-Ranked Adventurer
title_japanese: 最強Fランク冒険者の気ままな辺境生活?
synopsis:
Lumen, a city on the farthest reaches at the edge of the feared magical borderland. Roy is an new F-ranked adventurer that wandered to Lumen on his own whim. Life on this monster-infested outpost should be a harsh burden for a newbie like him...however, Roy's actually top-class in both swordsmanship and magic?! The sudden appearance of this out-classed "novice" causes havoc in the world, starting in this remote city!

(Source: AlphaPolis)

title: Nobara ni Utaeba
synopsis:
Young school boy Theo is singing one day when he spots someone lying on the ground. However, that "someone" turns out to be the spirit of the rose garden, who calls herself Wild Rose! Theo is charmed by her, but she seems to be out of his reach...

(Source: Coamix, translated)

title: Kimi ga Asu, Kono Sekai kara Kieru Mae ni
title_japanese: きみが明日、この世界から消える前に
synopsis:
Kiho, who has always studied since she was a child, did not have any friends when she entered junior high school. She becomes friends with a classmate who asks her to help him with his studies, but for a certain reason, she is further isolated from the rest of the class. Furthermore, one day after failing the high school entrance exam and entering her second choice high school, she loses the point of living and decides to end her life, when a fateful encounter occurs...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Battle Scar
synopsis: Battle Scar is based mostly on true experiences of Ukrainian soldiers and civilians during the Russo-Ukrainian War.

title: Tatta Hitotsu no Koto shika Shiranai
title_japanese: たったひとつのことしか知らない
synopsis:
Fujinoki, an ordinary office worker, finds unexpected joy in the irregular calls from his elementary school classmate, Akaiwa. After 20 years without seeing each other, Fujinoki has no clue about Akaiwa's whereabouts or occupation. However, their peculiar phone-only friendship takes an unexpected turn!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Saikyou Death Beam wo Uteru Salaryman, Isekai wo Yuku: Ken to Mahou no Sekai wo Muteki no Beam de Musou suru
title_english: From Desk Job to Death Beam: In Another World with My Almighty Lasers
title_japanese: 最強デスビームを撃てるサラリーマン、異世界を征く 剣と魔法の世界を無敵のビームで無双する
synopsis:
Kaito Irie—an unremarkable young man without even hobbies to speak of—has been killed thanks to a goddess's careless mistake. As recompense, he is offered the chance to continue living in a new world with not just one newfound passion to guide and fulfill him, but three: "Collection," "Animal Ears," and "Laser Beams." But with everything looking too good to be true, Kaito can't help but wonder...is there a catch? Using his new god-given power to fire a beam powerful enough to smite any foe and precise enough to replace any tool, Kaito becomes an adventurer in search of riches and glory. Along the way, he tirelessly helps the oppressed, half-animal, half-human hybrids that inhabit his new home. Is it out of the goodness of his heart...or out of a desire to get closer to their irresistibly adorable animal ears?! Here unfolds the epic tale of a typical, run-of-the-mill guy who just happens to wield a peerless beam of death!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Koyubi-sensei no Reiteki Chousen
title_japanese: こゆび先生の霊的挑戦

title: The God of Pro Wrestling
synopsis:
Junho Kim loved pro-wrestling more than anyone, but he couldn't escape the racial standards. After his meaningless retirement, while working as a construction worker, he got caught up in an unexpected accident... And after he opened his eyes, he returned to the day before his WWF entrance exam!

"This time, I won't end as the villain 'Kung-Fury' with a 0.7% win rate!"

He returned to his 20s body with all the knowledge he's worked so hard for and information about the future. He will not repeat his history of being a "jobber," an expert at losing. He will rewrite the history of pro wrestling together with the wrestler that will take over the era in the future! To ultimately become the god of pro wrestling, an "icon" of the era!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Fated but Flawed
synopsis:
Beom Gyu-hwa always believed he was an alpha, until one strange night turned everything upside down. Desperate to pay tuition, he accepts a high-paying gig...only to find out it's at Sehan Hotel, a place he swore he'd avoid at all costs. Things take a turn when his body starts reacting oddly, his pheromones feel off, and worst of all, he runs into the last person he ever wanted to see... When instincts take over, Gyu-hwa is forced to confront a truth he never saw coming. He's in heat.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Be Honest With Me
synopsis:
"What 'filters' do we use when we talk to people?"

A timid college student, who always hid her true feelings, disappears after collapsing on the street one day and then returns one year later. It's later revealed that she now has a rare disease called Rayleigh Syndrome, which causes her to say whatever's on her mind.

A bumpy adolescence without a filter and a coming-of-age story where words can both hurt and comfort.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Sono Monban, Saikyou ni Tsuki: Tsuihou sareta Bougyoryoku 9999 no Senshi, Outo no Monban toshite Musou suru
title_english: No One Gets Past This Gatekeeper: The Unwanted Warrior Guards His New Post
title_japanese: その門番、最強につき~追放された防御力9999の戦士、王都の門番として無双する~
synopsis:
Sieg's defensive power is through the roof, and he's proven himself to be a rock-solid foundation for a heavy-hitting party, holding every last ounce of monster aggro. But that's not enough to prevent his party from kicking him right out the door! Who needs defense when you've got devastating attacks, right? Them, apparently—without their tank, the losses keep piling up! Sieg, on the other hand, lands a job as a gatekeeper at the royal capital and starts rising quickly through the ranks. Can he defend against the hordes of attackers, earn the trust of his squadron and the lovely but quirky ladies within, and untwist the problems of the besieged city—all at the same time?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Toshishita Douki wa Ijiwaru de Ichizu
title_english: We Had Sex Right Before Work...
title_japanese: 年下同期はイジワルで一途
synopsis:
"I can't go to work like this, so I'm gonna use you." He relentlessly makes love to my sensitive areas... I want to resist, but it feels so good!

(Source: WWWave Corporation)

title: Shiitagerareta Tsuihou Oujo wa, Tensei shita Densetsu no Majo deshita: Mukae ni Koraretemo Komarimasu. Juuboku to no Ohirune wo Jama shinaide Kudasai
title_english: The Legendary Witch Is Reborn as an Oppressed Princess
title_japanese: 虐げられた追放王女は、転生した伝説の魔女でした ～迎えに来られても困ります。従僕とのお昼寝を邪魔しないでください～
synopsis:
The moment her uncle pushed her out of a window but failed to kill her, six-year-old Princess Claudia remembered everything. In her past life, she was a legendary witch who commanded a veritable army of magicians. She possesses a magic that can leave the world at her mercy! Never mind her cold reception in this life! Claudia decides to live free of worldly worries. She makes a servant of a handsome but unfriendly boy, Noah, and sets out to do whatever she pleases by using the advanced magic that once shook the world, sweeping away her opposition in the process! Unfortunately, using so much power makes her so sleepy... Zzz... Claudia rests easy in the arms of her unwilling servant after using too much magic. Here begins the story of a legendary witch ready for a comfortable, leisurely life with her grumpy, raven-haired servant!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Yandere Mahoutsukai wa Sekizou no Otome shika Aisenai: Majo wa Manadeshi no Atsui Kuchizuke de Tokeru
title_english: The Obsessed Mage and His Beloved Statue Bride: She Cannot Resist His Seductive Voice
title_japanese: ヤンデレ魔法使いは石像の乙女しか愛せない 魔女は愛弟子の熱い口づけでとける
synopsis:
Lara Bradley, a renowned mage, sets off to defeat a low-risk monster with her young apprentice Alistair, who never stops proposing to her. But instead of a minor threat, they encounter the world's most dangerous creature—a dragon! In a desperate bid to save Alistair, Lara faces the dragon alone and casts a spell that turns herself to stone.

Twenty years later, the petrification spell breaks, and Lara awakens in a world that has moved on—except for Alistair, who never forgot her. The boy she once knew has grown into a powerful, determined man who's eager to make up for lost time with his beloved master. As they reconnect, will sparks fly, or are they doomed to repeat past mistakes?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Succubus Nakayoshi 3-ningumi with Akachan
title_japanese: サキュバス仲良し3人組 with 赤ちゃん

title: Sentou to Vampire
synopsis:
Luka is your picture perfect vampire―he's good looking, he's regal... He's also usually incredibly hungover and exhausted, and wants nothing more than a change of pace from his routine! When he takes a peek into the human world, he finds just the cure he's looking for―a relaxing bathhouse that will surely cure him of his hangover and rejuvenate him from head to toe. To blow his fatigue out of the water, Luka pays a visit to Mangetsu no Yu bathhouse where he meets the bathhouse's eldest son, Sakura. But between the bathhouse being short staffed and taking care of his little brother, Sakura has enough to worry about without a bougie vampire being added to the mix!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Umidori Tougetsu no "Detarame" na Jijou
title_english: The BS Situation of Tougetsu Umidori
title_japanese: 海鳥東月の『でたらめ』な事情
synopsis:
One day, Tougetsu Umidori suddenly receives a mysterious request from Nara Yoshino, a classmate of hers she is rather close with. Little does she know, however, that this is only the beginning of a series of bizarre events. Soon after, an enigmatic girl in a cat hoodie shows up at Umidori's house, calling herself "BS." Thanks to her, all manner of strange things happen, including toilet borrowing, betrayal, threats, a grapple for freedom, and finally a desperate plea for mercy. Once everything is over, this strange new girl asks: "Hey, will you kill the lies with me?" And without knowing why, Umidori joins in on her quest.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: My Virtual God Is a Teenage Girl
title_english: My Virtual God Is a Teenage Girl
synopsis:
From good looks, brains, hot body, wealth, and a gorgeous family. It seemed like Jumin's life was god perfect. Until he realized that his world was merely a simulation controlled by... well, a teenage girl! With just a click of her mouse, Jumin loses everything and returns to high school! Will he break free from the program and reclaim what he lost?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Manemane Nichinichi
synopsis:
Set in a high school baseball club, it is a "coming-of-age sideline story," focusing on the three team managers with very different personalities: Nagisa, who barely knows the rules of baseball; Ichinose, a flamboyant gal; and Himemiya, the quiet girl with a surprisingly nasty side.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Kyoukan Status MAX na Ore to Majuu no Isekai Soukoku
title_japanese: 共感ステータスMAXな俺と魔獣の異世界創国

title: Yaneurabeya no Koushaku Fujin
title_japanese: 屋根裏部屋の公爵夫人
synopsis:
Opal Holloway is a determined young lady whose ambition makes her stand out among her peers. When her entire life is seemingly changed overnight, she's left without a man to marry. However, she couldn't be more relieved, since she's been secretly in love with her childhood friend Claude. Opal hoped that she wouldn't be forced to marry a noble other than her childhood friend, but bad news arrives. Wed to a childish duke, whose servants refuse to treat her well, Opal feels like the whole world has turned against her. But Opal isn't one to take things lying down. She decides to use her wealth to steal Duke McLeod's land and manor away! Now in charge, will she be able to transform the servants and the duke? And will she ever be able to forget her first love?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Akatsuki no Majo Lacey wa Jiyuu ni Ikitai: Maou Toubatsu wo Oeta node, Nonbiri Omise wo Hirakimasu
title_english: Lacey Longs for Freedom: The Dawn Witch's Low-Key Life after Defeating the Demon King
title_japanese: 暁の魔女レイシーは自由に生きたい ～魔王討伐を終えたので、のんびりお店を開きます～
synopsis:
Now that she's defeated the Demon King and become the country's greatest mage, Lacey has officially fulfilled her life's purpose. All that's left is to spend the rest of her days in a loveless political marriage. But when her engagement is broken off, Lacey realizes that all she wants is to live freely. Her wish is granted, and she moves into an empty mansion near a sleepy village. Settling in is hard for her; shy and self-effacing, Lacey doesn't know anything about living on her own! She can fry legions of monsters, but frying up a meal? She'd rather starve. Luckily, her friends have her back; with the support of the community, her former party member Wayne, and a monster pet, Lacey slowly learns to take care of herself and come out of her shell. Meanwhile, Lacey's worth becomes clear to the townspeople when she solves their problems with magic that's both unconventional and spectacular. So begins Lacey's newfound calling as a magical handywoman!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Strongest Level 1
synopsis:
Boss raids are an amazing opportunity for hunters. That's why Gunwoo Lee agreed right away when he was asked to join. An intense battle ensued, but Gunwoo and his guild mates got the Boss's health down to 30 percent. However, that triggered an effect, and now the Boss is about to explode in three minutes. Gunwoo and his guild mates sense that they won't be able to defeat the Boss in time, so they decide to escape. As they were about to get out, Gunwoo was betrayed and trapped inside the dungeon...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Tsue to Tsurugi no Wistoria Grimo Acta: Hajimari no Namida
title_english: Wistoria's Wand and Sword Grimo Acta
title_japanese: 杖と剣のウィストリア グリモアクタ ―始まりの涙―

title: The Countdown of My Death Is Spamming My Status Window
title_english: The Countdown of My Death Is Spamming My Status Window
synopsis:
A masterpiece of over 3,000 volumes, I was incarnated into "Dawn of Repentance." Moreover, as the successor to the duke's family, facing a grim fate, I became my cherished character, "Michel Nephthys." But upon opening the status window, the countdown to death was D-3. With the thought that I couldn't die like this, I somehow managed to survive, and each time I changed the development, experience points were granted?! If that's the case, I'll change the original storyline drastically to reap the benefits. Leaving the deceased Michel Nephthys aside, I lived as the nanny's daughter, "Evan Laeff," doing as told, but missions kept pouring in on the status window, and failure meant death. Now that it's like this, whether the storyline changes or not doesn't matter. I will definitely survive and prevail!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Kono Koi, Okuchi ni Aimasu ka?
title_japanese: この恋、おくちにあいますか?
synopsis:
Nobody even tries to understand me...

I, Toui Kiminami, known as the school's number one problem child, have a dream for the future. For that dream, I couldn't care less about anything else. But one day, everything changes when I'm forced into an arranged marriage meeting by my father.

Her name is Rira Shirahime—the school's most beautiful girl and top student, plus the daughter of a company president and an active model known as "S-Hime." Everything about her is the exact opposite of me. With a true nature vastly different from her outward appearance, she stands in the way of my dreams and even threatens to kiss me every day, taking it upon herself to reform me.

This is bad. I have to do something about her quickly for the sake of my future... But it seems that even the seemingly invincible Shirahime has circumstances that require her to be perfect?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Shiryou Majutsu no Yougisha
synopsis:
"Do You Desire Eternal Life?"

The Kingdom of Rama, vast and powerful, faced a dire crisis. The legendary "Warlord," who built the great nation in a single generation, fell ill, sparking rebellions across the land and threatening the kingdom's very existence.

But then, an undead army suddenly attacked and swiftly crushed the rebel forces. Who was using the forbidden necromancy?

Conrad, a knight of the kingdom, pursued the mysterious necromancer. In a remote village, he encountered a suspicious mansion and a young girl named Luna who frequented it. With her red eyes, pale skin, and golden hair—who was she? Was the master of the mansion the necromancer?

(Source: Micro Magazine-sha, translated)

title: Sakamoto Days: Koroshiya no Method
title_japanese: SAKAMOTO DAYS 殺し屋のメソッド
synopsis:
Shin and Nagumo have a fishing duel at the Sakamoto family camp! Spin-off stories that you can read only in the novel, such as Shishiba and Osaragi's ramen eating trip, Kashima's remote work situation, and more!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: My Brother and His Gift
synopsis:
After losing his parents in a tragic car crash, college student Lee Sihyuk is left alone to raise his baby brother, Siha. In order to do so, Sihyuk decides to follow in his father's footsteps and become a translator. While working to apply for the job, he suddenly finds himself knowledgeable about things he's never learned and starts to gain recognition as a translation prodigy! But even with his mysterious new ability, can Sihyuk really balance work and school, all while raising a 3-year-old?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: I Thought My Husband Was Supposed to Die?
title_english: I Thought My Husband Was Supposed to Die?
synopsis:

There's only one problem: her mother-in-law is trying to frame her for the murder of her husband. Using her knowledge of the novel, can Alice subvert the original plot into something that might allow her to live in peace, or is she doomed to live as the caretaker of a comatose husband until her death?

He plans to sell the team and start fresh, only to find out the team has massive debt! Left with no other choice, Jungwoo must use his tactical genius to help this team rise from the ashes and be number one!

Uichi, once a happy and popular boy, is now the victim of cruel bullying. Then suddenly Yotsuha, his childhood friend and first love, shows up. How will this cute and kind-hearted girl try to help him...?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Angel Ace
synopsis:
Women's professional baseball is a national sport. A certain encounter in a corner of Japan propels a girl to the stage of her dreams!

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Anata ni Kirawaretain desu
title_japanese: あなたに嫌われたいんです

title: Suika wa Shoushika Tantou
synopsis:
In the year 20XX, Japan was in decline because of falling birth rates. To prevent Japan from dying out, it was decided that girls who reached a determined age would be allocated to single men. "Please make a baby with me..." says Suika, a girl who is shy but has a strong sense of responsibility, to Hedeki, a disappointing recluse who aspired to be a novelist. Under this unprecedented national policy, the two begin their stimulating life together!

(Source: Square-Enix, translated)

title: Kirawaremono no Akuyaku Reisoku ni Tensei shita noni, Nazeka Mawari ga Houtteoite Kurenai
title_japanese: 嫌われ者の悪役令息に転生したのに、なぜか周りが放っておいてくれない

title: In Summer
synopsis:
In Summer is a collection which consists of two bitter stories at the start but which ultimately bring balm to the heart. Each story illustrates a chance encounter experienced by two protagonists who suffered from loneliness, the loss of a loved one or school bullying, the most salient portrait of Korean society, particularly among young people. By sharing moments with each other under the splendor of the summer sun, accompanied by the song of the cicadas and the sound of the sea, they open up and understand each other.

(Source: Le Lezard Noir, translated)

title: Bushinden: Ikenie ni Sasagerareta Ore wa, Kami ni Hiroware Bu wo Kiwameru
title_japanese: 武神伝 生贄に捧げられた俺は、神に拾われ武を極める

title: Dear Summer Sky
synopsis:
Gihu, a high schooler with a passion for photographing the sky, dreams of entering a photography contest. However, the contest requires a portrait photo, which he's terrible at. He enlists the help of Haneul, a mysterious new transfer student who accidentally appears in one of Gihu's sky photos. Despite his struggles, he finds himself wanting to take more photos of her. As they prepare for the school festival, Gihu becomes more intrigued by Haneul, while she, initially misjudging him, helps him out of guilt after realizing she underestimated his abilities.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Definition of a Villain
synopsis:
A world where there are "superpowers," a new race of humans who surpass human abilities, and "guides" who can control their rampage. Betty, a guide, hides her identity and lives in a small town in America. One day, James, a super-powered hero, transfers to Betty's school to find the villain "Dave." Betty avoids James but continues to become involved with him. And to make matters worse, while trying to stop her best friend's rampage of superpowers, she is forced to use her guide abilities... It turns out that her friend is not an ordinary superpower, but a villain. It was Dave! Betty is caught between a villain and a hero, and her life, which she wanted to live normally, begins to spiral.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Bouken ni wa, Buki ga Hitsuyou da! Kodawari Rudy no Kajiyagurashi
title_english: Every Adventure Needs a Weapon! The Blacksmith Life of Rudy the Obsessed
title_japanese: 冒険には、武器が必要だ!～こだわりルディの鍛冶屋ぐらし～
synopsis:
Rudy has a goal—to become a top-tier weaponsmith and make the coolest weapons the world has ever seen! Sure, her boss always gets mad about her bizarre creations, but she has a blast crafting them. And she lives right outside a dungeon, so she's in the perfect spot to aid adventurers passing through on their way to fight monsters. Surely she won't bite off more than she can chew...right?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Twins Disturb
title_japanese: ツインズ ディスターブ
synopsis:
First-year high school student Souta Ogiura is charmed by the student council president, Chika Kisaragi, during her speech at the entrance ceremony. Unfortunately, Chika confuses the event with a graduation ceremony, which leads Souta to correct her in front of the entire student body. Chika thanks Souta for pointing out her mistake, stirring his emotions even further.

While trying to navigate the school, Souta bumps into the airheaded Chika again. Desiring to confess his feelings right then and there, he is interrupted by the unexpected appearance of Chika's twin sister named Rika. When Chika asks Souta to meet her on the school rooftop the next day, something seems strange, compelling him to confront her about it.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Omae no Hou kara Kiss Shitekure yo
title_japanese: お前のほうからキスしてくれよ
synopsis:
Ueno and Kanada seem like two complete opposites in the office. Ueno is an accountant who can strike fear into his co-workers with his strict and unbending ways. Meanwhile, Kanda is the superstar of the sales department—and thanks to his friendly and outgoing personality, he is even next in line to be manager! While most would think these two could never mesh, the truth is they're actually very close friends outside of work. 

Kanda often crashes at Ueno's place, and the two spend time with each other constantly, growing closer than most co-workers would. But when Ueno confesses to Kanada that he's gay, a myriad of unsaid feelings begin to grow between them. Ueno has mixed feelings about how close and touchy Kanada can be, while Kanada is hung up on the fact that Ueno claimed he wasn't his type! 

Can these two salarymen navigate their true feelings and realize the growing love between them?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Soredemo Shutter no Oto wa Naru
title_japanese: それでもシャッターの音は鳴る
synopsis:
Tobino is a perfectionist photographer. Because of his strictness, his assistant cameraman quit today. As an awkward atmosphere prevails at the site, a young man, Mitsuo, suddenly appears and says, "I'd like to be your assistant." Inspired by his free-spirited and carefree personality, Tobino gradually became more comfortable around him. But just when things are starting to go well at work, he discovers Mitsuo's secret...?

"Do you love photography?"

Even though they don't want it, and even though they hate it, they still keep clicking the shutter in search of an answer.

(Source: Printemps Shuppan, translated)

title: Uzugami: Bunretsu Zoushoku Ningen
title_japanese: 渦神 分裂増殖人間
synopsis:
Satoru Takeichi, nicknamed "Ichigo," works at a sawmill. While working, he gets caught up in a mechanical malfunction that amputates the pinky finger on his right hand at the first joint. He searches for the severed portion with the other employees, but they can't find it. However, when he's medically discharged and returns to his apartment, he finds another version of himself there... From then on, a strange shared life with "Nigou" begins.

(Source: Coamix, translated)

title: Hikari to Bara: Shousetsu no Shujinkou ni Natte Mibunchigai no Koi Shitemasu
title_english: An Innocent Maid for the Duke
title_japanese: 光と薔薇～小説の主人公になって身分違いの恋してます～
synopsis:
Twenty-eight and single, Akira secretly longs for her own Cinderella story. But she knows a fairy-tale is nothing but fiction. That is, until she finds a book about Rose, a maid in love with someone beyond her status. Absorbed in the novel, Akira somehow finds herself in the middle of the story, sewing a dress as Rose and being asked to dance by the dashingly handsome duke... What will happen to Akira, trapped in another world as the main character of a dazzling love story?

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

title: Asayake no Iro
synopsis: A girl wakes up to watch the sunrise.

title: Clothing Bin of Love
synopsis:
Enough one-sided love! The hottest gossip in Going High School, if you go to the used clothing box, give it money and shout the name of the person you like, then it will tell you the feelings of that person..! Song Aram, who's only interested in grades and money, is not wavered by that rumor. In that daily life, the school's popular boy, Jung Jinwoo suddenly comes into her life. What should she do about this rascal who might run off to who knows where?

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Blue Blood Vampire
title_japanese: ブルーブラッドヴァンパイア

title: Sea Melt Lover
synopsis:
Luta, a new race of humans that have animal genes and characteristics, quickly grew in population until humans became the minority. Now, the Luta keep humans as pets, using them to satisfy their sexual appetites and urges, something that Ernetis finds disgusting and despicable. Though he's also a Luta, he's never been fond of the way his kind treats humans. But when a party goes awry and a human named Jin breaks free from his tiger beastman keeper, Ernetis will find himself helping the brave escapee. 

A cross-species Boys' Love romance where two opposites will find love and hope with each other.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Fukurou no Koiwazurai
title_japanese: フクロウの恋わずらい
synopsis:
1-3. Fukurou no Koiwazurai
4-5. Ore no Kawaii Hatsujou Neko

title: To Whom It No Longer Concerns
title_english: To Whom It No Longer Concerns
synopsis:
Exploited by her brother, betrayed by her sister, and killed by her husband. So ended the tragic story of Ariana Lopez—until, at the moment of her death, she suddenly finds herself back in the past. Now that she has a chance to do it all over again, she enlists the help of Duke Dante Heigenberg, the most feared and desired man in the entire empire, to take revenge against her family and reclaim what's rightfully hers. But strangely, the duke seems to want Ariana more than just for her extraordinary musical talent...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Ishuzoku Tsuihou Concept Café
title_japanese: 異種族追放コンカフェ
synopsis:
Yoshio Yoshida, an office worker who enjoys going to cosplay cafés in his spare time, hears a rumor from a familiar café girl about a "concept café with a weird atmosphere" that had opened in the neighborhood. Intrigued, Yoshida visits the café and finds three unmotivated, blunt, and highly idiosyncratic café girls. In fact, they are a real demon, dwarf, and elf...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Rookerie no Kawarimono
title_japanese: ルッカリエの変わり者
synopsis:
The manga centers on a mysterious bar named Rookerie, where strange "birds" work, and where people can make strange orders.

(Source: ANN)

title: I Don't Want the Male Lead's Child
title_english: I Don't Want the Male Lead's Child
synopsis:
In the novel I was reading, my favorite character, Abril, had a tragic ending. After marrying the male lead, Asellas, she dies of magic intolerance while giving birth to his child. I only wished for her to be happy–but when I opened my eyes, I was suddenly in Abril's body! Before getting married to Asellas, I came up with a simple plan to survive: "I'll never have his child!" But of course, things aren't that easy...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title_japanese: キミが吠えるための歌を、

title: Unsouya no Ossan ga Nazeka Fukugyou de Zettai Muteki Kenshi wo Tsutomeru Koto ni: Saenai Jinsei wo Okutteta Ore ga Maou Toubatsu no Kirifuda ni?
title_japanese: 運送屋のおっさんがなぜか副業で絶対無敵剣士を務めることに～さえない人生を送ってた俺が魔王討伐の切り札に?～
synopsis:
Jack, a lackluster deliveryman, is living a boring life when he is suddenly summoned to the royal capital. There, he is startled to learn he will receive the tile of "One Sword," which is bestowed on the truly strongest swordsman. It's the epic tale of a boring middle-aged man with hidden power!

(Source: Akitashoten, translated)

title: Citrus Spring
synopsis:
1. Act Trouble!
2. Gypso Girl
3. Dekoboko Love Plus!
4. Yuuai Sabo Room
5. Kisekae Battle!
6. Aoharu Cheer★
7. Shecret
8. Houkago W.C.

title: Kurone-san wa Nyaa to Nakanai
title_japanese: 黒根さんはニャーと鳴かない
synopsis: Everyone at work loves Mamoru, because Mamoru never says no. Replacing lightbulbs, carrying boxes, taking over an impossible client from a retiring colleague... He'll do it all, and it's earned him the nickname "Prince of the Office." This glittering extrovert's opposite at work is Kurone, a quiet woman in another department who soaks up her boss's senseless mood swings with a blank stoicism. After one particularly long day, Mamoru is thrilled to be walking home alone, sipping a beer (because all his colleagues went drinking and left him to work overtime), when he encounters something strange: The usually glum Kurone is in the park, gleefully playing with stray cats. This secret seems silly, but it brings Kurone joy. It's the start of an unlikely relationship that will lead Mamoru to start reflecting on his life and who he really wants to share it with. Is work really all there is, or can he strike a balance with the help of these fluffy new friends—and a human who might become somethi

title_japanese: バックヤード ジャンク ユニバース
synopsis: A large collection of Takuji Katou viral works from social media.

title: Kannonji Suiren no Kunou
synopsis:
Suiren Kanonji. A perfect superwoman gifted in both beauty and intelligence, she is the star of the school. However, she is really a "pathological lover of yuri" and spends her days in agony, desperately ruminating about her favorite yuri couple, Ajisai Fuchuu and Tsubaki Nakameguro, who go seemingly unnoticed by others around them...!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Kyorikan no Chikasugiru Imouto to Amaama Icha Love Ecchi

title: Toshoshitsu no Kedamono-tachi
title_japanese: 図書室のけだものたち
synopsis:
It's always the quiet girls who are the freakiest...

Komiya just wants to read quietly in the library, but her classmates insist on having sex in the stacks! Lucky for Komiya, the literature she likes is hot and heavy, and nobody will notice if she gets off to the atmosphere her classmates generously provide. But one day, she's approached by one of the regular students breaking the silence of the library: a boy named Kijima, who's been surreptitiously reading the same hot and heavy literature she has! Will Komiya flee back into the pages of her books, or take the chance to bring her fantasies into the real world?

(Source: J18 Publishing)

title: Yaru Tame ni Yaru Koto!
title_english: Doing It for Its Own Sake!

title: Jimi de, Shoukyokuteki de, Eroi.
title_japanese: 地味で、消極的で、エロい。

title: Mermaid♡Prince
synopsis:
Masami, who's broke, is visited by some suspicious men who tell him that, thanks to his genes, he has a high chance of being able to reproduce with a critically endangered mermaid(♂), and if he's successful, they'll pay him 100 million yen. Bewildered, Masami is tempted by the 100 million yen, but...

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

title: Yarashii Uraaka-kun wa Samishigari
title_japanese: やらしい裏アカくんはさみしがり

title: Seinaru Otome to Himegoto wo
title_english: Doing Secret Things with the Holy Maidens
title_japanese: 聖なる乙女と秘めごとを
synopsis:
After spending the night playing the latest 18+ game, Itsuki Kusaka finds himself waking up in an entirely different world! Despite the fact he has no desire to be a hero, his attitude changes when a giant, naked goddess tells him the details of his mission. All Itsuki has to do is teach her disciples a thing or two about sex. With hands-on learning, of course. Is this a dream come true for this adult gaming fan, or will Itsuki find his mission to be more challenging than he expected?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Eden
synopsis: Undercover NIS agent Seonwu Park is disguised as a café owner in an affluent neighborhood to investigate a drug ring. When he stumbles upon a lead about a drug-fueled party, he infiltrates it under the guise of delivering coffee. However, a lapse in judgement leads him to the brink of disaster until a cafe regular Yohan Seo rescues him. As the heat of the moment escalates, Seonwu and Yohan find themselves entwined in an unexpected physical connection. Realizing that Yohan might have crucial information about the case, Seonwu seeks his help. Yohan, attracted to Seonwu, agrees on the condition that they become friends with benefits. Their unconventional relationship deepens, but as the investigation nears its end, Yohan abruptly cuts ties with Seonwu and seemingly dies in a car accident, leaving Seonwu heartbroken. Three years later, Seonwu, now hardened by his past, spots Yohan in footage from a new NIS sting—alive and well, under the alias "Yohan Romanov," a notorious Russian mafia mem

title: Sono Rettousei, Jitsu wa Saikyou Kenja
title_japanese: その劣等生、実は最強賢者

title: Daikenja Riddle no Jikan Gyakkou
title_japanese: 大賢者リドルの時間逆行
synopsis:
A young man named Riddle had lost all of his friends—and the entire world—at the hands of a mysterious organization known as the "Box of Malice." Having lost all hope to live, he dwelled in a pit of despair until he has one final revelation. What if... he could return to a time before everything ended? And so, after a thousand years, a deformed Riddle finally manages to reverse time. "I'm going to stop them this time...!" Equipped with a thousand years of knowledge and experience in his young body, the Great Sage Riddle's journey to the past now unfolds!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Shitsuren One Night Love: Kono Otoko wa Zurukute Amai.
title_english: Broken-Hearted One-Night Love: This Man Is Cunning and Sweet
title_japanese: 失恋ワンナイトラブ～この男はずるくてあまい。
synopsis:
"Let me hear your cute moans more." Yuzuru was dumped by his boyfriend exactly on his birthday. At this worst possible moment, he met a flirty man called Zen. "Can you really sleep by yourself tonight?" Even though it's their first meeting, Zen quickly made his way inside his broken heart... he has Yuzuru's at his mercy, entangling their hot tongues in a sweet kiss, and teasing him deep inside as they have sex.

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title: One Night After 19 Years
synopsis:
Jeong Eunseol and Ma Yusin have been inseparable since they were children, but lately, something has shifted. Returning from his army service, Yusin is often sought after by girls in Eunseol's orbit, all while he has been quietly shielding Eunseol from guys interested in her. When their families go on vacation together, Eunseol and Yusin find the boundary of their friendship tested. Together, they'll have to decide—what if their relationship was never just friendship?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Fukukaichou no Omona Oshigoto
title_english: The Main and Favorite Duties of Ms. Kurishita
synopsis:
There are two people who are always in the student council room. I, the student council president, and Namida Kurishita, the vice-president. At first, there were other officers, but they all stopped showing up because the Namida takes care of all the work. She is a beautiful honor student who never complains, but... she is always teasing me when we are alone!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Seikatsu Mahoutsukai no Gekokujou
title_japanese: 生活魔法使いの下剋上
synopsis:
I'm not "useless!" I'll prove it by conquering dungeons!

Suddenly, magic and dungeons appear in modern Japan, and life has changed completely. I, Gurimu Sakaki, am born with a talent for life magic that cannot be used for exploring dungeons or defeating demons. I was born with a talent for life magic, but while exploring dungeons, I got my hands on a rare item, the "Sage System," which allows me to create new magic...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Alive
synopsis:
Akira Hondou was shot to death by the U.S. military for a crime he did not commit. However, he somehow survived and became a teacher at a girls' high school. The objective of his assignment to this school? The key to that is in the hands of Hibiki Tsukishima, an ordinary high school girl in the art club... The story accelerates as Hondou, an out-of-the-ordinary egoistic gentleman, gets involved in his surroundings.

(Source: Cygames, translated)

title: Uragirareta Touzoku, Kaitou Maou ni Natte Sekai wo Shouaku suru
title_english: Demon King of Phantom Thief: A Betrayed Thief Reigned over the World
title_japanese: 裏切られた盗賊、怪盗魔王になって世界を掌握する

title: Chiisana Kimi to, Koe wo Tooku ni
title_japanese: ちいさな君と、こえを遠くに

title: Ten to Chi to Hazama no Sekai Yelatiam
title_japanese: 天と地と狭間の世界 イェラティアム
synopsis:
Heaven, where gods dwell. Earth, where demons dwell. And people live in the world in between. There were seven floating continents. When a continent falls, demons appear and become stronger, and when a continent rises, no demons appear and one can enjoy a moment of peace and tranquility. The Wheel of Fortune, given by the gods, is responsible for a continent's levitation. After 2,000 years, the Wheel of Fortune begins to change. The time for inevitable destruction, One boy soars through the space between heaven and earth on blue wings...

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)

title: Mikiri kara Hajimeru Garyuu Kenjutsu
title_japanese: 見切りから始める我流剣術
synopsis:
Rio, a boy living in a remote village, attends the village dojo for self-defense, but gives up, feeling that he cannot become stronger under the dojo's teaching methods. However, the village is a dangerous place, and Rio decides to create his own way of fighting—"Garyu Kenjutsu"—in order to survive! A royal road fantasy of swords and magic is about to begin!

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

title: Saikyou Kenshi, Saiteihen Kishidan de Funsenchuu: Orc wo Chi no Hate made Oitsumete Zettai ni Shimatsu suru dake no Kantan? na Oshigoto desu
title_english: The Strongest Swordsman with Knights of the Lowest Order
title_japanese: 最強剣士、最底辺騎士団で奮戦中 ～オークを地の果てまで追い詰めて絶対に始末するだけの簡単?なお仕事です～
synopsis:
The "Anti Foreign Dangerous Species Knights" was formed to protect the people from dangerous monsters, however this is more of a black company and it's only a knight order in name only...! Orcs that keep coming like pests no matter how many times they are taken down... salaries that don't increase at all... quirky co-workers... This is the story of the strongest swordsman of a commoner background, who works hard everyday cutting orc's heads in the lowest knight order which is ridiculed as "Pig Hunters."

(Source: Micro Magazine-sha, translated)

title: Three's Company, Or Is It?
synopsis:
One fun, slightly tipsy night with her brother's two best friends, Jiwon and Eunho, turns into a threesome Yeonhee never expected... and then somehow, it happens again. Who will she choose? Jiwon or Eunho? Who will emerge victorious as the winner of Yeonhee's heart... and lower regions? To add onto her troubles, she has to keep this all a secret from her older brother, Yeolchan. Will they pull it off? Or will one slip-up bring everything crashing down?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Even When I'm Dead
synopsis:
On the day of my wedding, I found out that my lover was cheating on me with my best friend. I died because of their betrayal, and when I opened my eyes again, I returned to the past. I thought this was a blessing from God, a chance to take revenge. But this return was neverending as I kept dying either from their betrayal or in an accident. After my repeated death, I realized that accidents did not cause all of my deaths but that I was being murdered. So this time, I faked my death and left everything behind to catch the murderer, who was killing me repeatedly and to take my revenge finally.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Perfect Male Lead
synopsis:
Having fled from her troubled past, Haeju enrolled late into the theater and film department, hoping for a fresh start in college. She envisioned a future brimming with promise, but soon realizes she can't outrun her past forever. Caught between her childhood friend and her rekindled first love, Haeju wrestles with conflicting emotions. Eunseok, her longtime friend, proposes a fake dating scheme to mask his own feelings and shield her from Jay's advances.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: CEO's Dog Collar
synopsis:
Mira Go is interviewing for an executive position at "Wolfheadin," a large corporation. It's a nerve-wracking interview with the famous CEO Kang Hyunrang in attendance. But strangely, the CEO is wearing a dog collar? Is she the only one seeing this?!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Surviving in a School Bully Webtoon
synopsis:
The author of the number one-ranked school bully webtoon, Noh Cheolmin, has been trapped in the world he created! And as the world's weakest character! His assistant, who ran away halfway into production, is in the body of the world's strongest, the Protagonist?! Can this chaotic duo, an author with a broken personality and his runaway assistant, survive in the harsh world of A School Bully Webtoon?

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Guest Gun
synopsis:
The No.1 Hitman, Kim Gun, finds himself plunged into the world of martial arts due to a mysterious accident. To return to his original world, he must complete a mission called "Martial Arts Conquest." With a total of two guns, Kim Gun's adventure to subdue the unfamiliar martial arts world begins.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Share House de Saikai shita Motokano ga Semattekuru
title_japanese: シェアハウスで再会した元カノが迫ってくる
synopsis:
Yuuji Kaga, a second-year university student, decided to move into a shared house in order to sever his lingering feelings for his ex-lover. However, on his first day of moving in, who appeared right before his eyes was none other than his ex-girlfriend, Mafuyu Himuro, the very source of those feelings. In front of the other residents, their relationship within the shared house remains a secret. But Yuuji's feelings start to waver due to aspects only known to him as her ex-boyfriend, like how Mafuyu becomes clingy when she drinks, or her fondness for "goodnight kisses." It's unexpectedly difficult to pretend to be strangers, especially when Mafuyu aggressively seeks physical closeness, demanding piggyback rides in private or stealthily initiating physical contact. "I still like Yuji. We broke up, but my feelings remain." The love comedy of the ex-couple's attempt at a fresh start begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Bokura no Ai wa Kimochi Warui
title_japanese: 僕らのアイは気持ち悪い
synopsis:
Everyone is hiding a "secret."

Azuki Komugi is obsessed with ruminating on her memories of her high school girlfriend "Meguru," and creating a body model of hers out of clay. One day, Azuki drops her homemade "Meguru" at the 100-yen shop where she works part-time, and sneaks into her workplace on her off-shift to get "her" back. However, what she sees there is a fellow co-worker, high school girl Yoyuki Remu, who is about to express her lust for "Meguru" in a way that is different from Azuki's...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Wakasama Oshitai Shiteorimasu!
title_english: I Long for You O Young Master
title_japanese: 若様お慕いしております!
synopsis:
Even in today's society, ninjas are active in the dark. One of them, Kon, is a bodyguard for Yuichi, the next head of the Nikaido family. Kon loves his lord so much that he interferes in certain arranged marriage proceedings, leaving a sexually frustrated Yuichi meting out sexual punishment on Kon. While Kon's happy that his beloved lord feels his body, his heart aches at the thought of Yuichi's future happiness without him...

(Source: Frontier Works)

title: Ichizu Sugiru Kouhai ga Ore wo Akiramete Kuremasen
title_english: My Overly Devoted Junior Won't Give Up on Me

synopsis:
Mikage is a jobless graduate from an underperforming high school leading a boring life. A handsome stranger suddenly comes to visit him, hugging and saying "I've come to be your lover". Naturally, Mikage panics! The handsome stranger turns out to be Mikage's high school junior named Amatsuka. He says he's come because he's fulfilled the conditions Mikage set to become his boyfriend at Mikage's graduation ceremony. Puzzled by it all, Mikage is taken over by Amatsuka's enthusiastic approach which winds up with the two living together at Mikage's place?!

(Source: Frontier Works)

title: Yarashii Oniisan de Doutei Soushitsu
title_english: A Lustful Older Guy Took My Virginity

synopsis:
Looking to lose your virginity? Come on in, as long as you're gay! Mizusawa works at a special shop that specializes in making boys into men, when he encounters a rare young customer. Despite his age and supposed experience, this young client turns the veteran Mizusawa into mush!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Kyuuketsuki wa Shinzou no Yume wo Miru
title_english: The Vampire Dreams of a Heart
title_japanese: 吸血鬼は心臓の夢をみる
synopsis:
"He'll do it with anyone if asked, even with me." It's not easy for college student Shuri to harbor affection for Hisato, a vampire who's been like a father to him, when Hisato will kiss, have sex with, and even whisper words of love to any who wishes for it. Wanting to become the "soulmate" that Hisato has been yearning for, Shuri is ruthlessly eliminating people getting close to him, but there's no end to people willing to give their blood and bodies to Hisato in return for the pleasure they get from getting their blood sucked...

(Source: Renta!)

title: Magical Girls Are The Idols of This World
synopsis:
Jingburger was having a rough time in life with finding a part time job and achieving her dream to become an idol. Since nothing was going as she was expecting, she was feeling very pessimistic about her future... until she met a magical poop head dog that suddenly told her that she had been forced to sign a "Magical Girls Contract" and took her to the "Magical World."

Now she has to defeat monsters in order to survive, but that's not all; the dog also tells her that if she succeeds in doing her duties of purifying monsters, she will be granted one wish. However, she is not the only magical girl desperate enough to have her wish granted, and there is another way to get your wish granted: by taking the soul of other magical girls!! 

"How do you expect me to fight terrifying monsters like that?!" 
"Why the hell is my weapon a hamburger?!!" 
"What am I going to do if other magical girls try to hunt me?!!!!"
 
Six magical girls are in for a thrilling action-packed adventure!

(Source: Te

title: Midnight Training Hour
title_japanese: ミッドナイト・トレーニング・アワー
synopsis:
Mao is a new host struggling to climb the ranks. Confident in his looks, he still finds himself frustrated by the lack of requests. His complaints are overheard by Hiyori Kanamori, a staff member from another club, who sharply criticizes him. Indignant, Mao is taken aback when his boss reveals that Kanamori was once the top host and insists Mao take "special lessons" from him. Reluctantly, Mao agrees and starts to find a sense of accomplishment with each lesson. Gradually, he also becomes intrigued by Kanamori himself. Just as things start to improve, the man responsible for Kanamori quitting reappears...

(Source: J-Publishing, translated)

title: Harapeko Oyako to Motokare Yanushi
title_japanese: はらぺこ母娘と元カレ家主
synopsis:
After graduating from art school, 36-year-old Takaharu has been living a quiet life, alone with his paintings. That is until, one day, when Kyou, his ex-girlfriend from 17 years ago, suddenly shows up with her daughter Minori, begging him for a place to stay. Just like their college days, Kyou loves his delicious cooking, as the three of them begin a new life under the same roof...?

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

synopsis:
For Yuu Suzukaze, reuniting with the childhood friend he adored feels like a dream come true. After ten long years apart, they can finally enjoy high school life together. But it turns out, this girl isn't exactly "single"!

The manga centers on Arata Kamishiro, a replacement high school teacher who takes the opportunity of his father's death to try and become the leader of a group of Hanamiko. What he didn't expect is that he would be assigned to a group of Hanamiko that may be more trouble than they're worth.

title: Memento in Kowloon
synopsis:
Deep within the maze-like high-rise slums of Kowloon Walled City, there resides a flesh-eating monster known as a jiangshi that goes by the name of Ma-Fu. These destructive creatures were almost driven to extinction by the Taoists—individuals who specialize in dealing with them. But unlike the rest of his kind, Ma-Fu was spared from death at the hands of Gannon, the most powerful Taoist to ever exist, and was sealed away within Kowloon instead.

Four decades later, Gannon's disciple En appears in the walled city in search of Ma-Fu, now a jaded, filthy shell of his former self. Learning that Gannon has died, Ma-Fu is initially ecstatic about the news but becomes annoyed when he learns Gannon himself had requested that Ma-Fu be in attendance at his funeral. As En forces himself into Ma-Fu's shabby abode to prepare it for the funeral, the jiangshi begins to question why he was spared extermination all those years ago.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

synopsis:
One day, during the rainy season, a young man is about to take another person's umbrella from the stand in front of a convenience store. He suddenly feels someone's gaze, and when he looks up in the rain, he sees a mysterious fish hanging from a string staring at him... It doesn't speak, doesn't move, and doesn't change its expression... The name of this mysterious fish is Pisu-chan. Pisu-chan—a mysterious fish that doesn't move at all—livens up the store, surrounded by the mischievous store manager, the mysterious bugs who are good at their jobs, and the innocent but merciless children who come to play... This is the first volume of a laid-back and surreal fish work comedy about Pisu-chan and the convenience store.

(Source: Square-Enix, translated)

title: Shui Gen Ni Mofa Shaonu, Wo Shi OOXX
A Handbook for Villainesses
synopsis:
Laviore Bailey, the "fake saintess" who banished the innocent princess and stirred up bad blood to wage war. She's the villainess with a façade of a saintess.

"I love you. So just shut your mouth and die. Okay?"

But the moment her trusted lover chose her as a sacrifice to the demon, and she realized her father was behind the plan, she killed herself by swallowing poison. It hurt. It was so painful that she could not even scream. But it was fine. Because she knew this was not the end.

"I will save you this time."

Then, she came back for her second life. She was determined to rescue those who were unlucky because of her and restored her life back.

"You do whatever you want for the man in your dream." Demian said with a rough smile.

"I'll also protect you the way I want to."

synopsis:
It's time! Introducing, in the "powerless" corner, the former undisputed MMA champion Gwangho Hwang, with a professional record of 49:1 and a reputation for all kinds of dirty tactics, returning fresh from a supposed "permanent" suspension. And in the "powered" corner... well, folks, let's just say it's a murderer's row of deadly opponents with an array of special abilities. Welcome to the octagon, the ultimate showdown between a league of enhanced super-fighters going up against Gwangho's brawn and his manager Seyeon's brains! The bell rings for Round 1. Touch gloves, and face the pain! Here... we... go! 

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: This Time, I Will Survive Until the End
title_english: This Time, I Will Survive Until the End
synopsis:
Adette Berse keeps getting reborn but never survives past 30, always after trying to get married. Determined to break the cycle, she vows to stay single and instead focuses on earning money for her family. In a society that frowns upon working women, she disguises herself as a man to invest in a business with Duke Mateilo. Intrigued by Adette's audacious maneuver, the duke eschews business talk for continuous meetings. With her future on the line, can Adette outwit him and survive until the end?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Flower That Swallowed the Sun
title_english: The Flower That Swallowed the Sun
synopsis:
For 200 years, Amarzan the Great Sorcerer strived to become a god. So when he was told that he still lacked something, he chose to start over. Now, he has been reborn as Shuriah, one of the Brionia Empire's greatest beauties and Crown Prince Lenkaizer's maid. Despite trying to focus on finding what she lacked as Amarzan, Shuriah finds herself overcome with the urge to kill Lenkaizer whenever he shows her interest. Is she in danger, or is this just a new emotion she's never experienced before?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Duke's Everything
synopsis:
Tired of high society life in the capital, Ellia Green leaves for the port city of Charlestone at the request of her childhood friend, Tobias. There, she must find Tobias' reclusive older brother Dan, the Duke of Winselton, but he is nowhere to be seen. Instead, she finds a curious young boy, Eddy, an elaborate disguise the duke uses with his magic powers. Ellia soon ends up doting on cute little Eddy, but as the duke's feelings for Ellia grow, he wonders if he can ever reveal his true identity.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Unwelcome Guests of House Fildette
title_english: The Unwelcome Guests of House Fildette
synopsis:
Hayden Grummond Fildette, the only son of Count and Countess Fildette, was the perfect heir and lovable anchor who kept his family together. But the peaceful days come to an end when an unwelcome guest from his father's past surfaces, threatening Hayden's position with a possible half-brother and tipping over his parents' precarious relationship. Will he and his family be able to withstand the storm of uncomfortable truths and misunderstandings, or sink in the raging conflicts?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Watashi no Koi no Hajimekata
title_japanese: わたしの恋のはじめかた
synopsis:
"I'd like to see the look on Senpai's face when she falls in love." Chisaki, a fan of romantic reality shows, has formed many couples in her daily life, earning her the nickname "MatchApp Senpai." She has no experience but is constantly gaining knowledge, and has given up on love for herself, but for some reason she is drawn to her kouhai Reo-kun! While supporting his friends' love lives, she ends up rehabilitating her own love life with Reo-kun!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Mutant Turtles: Ore-tacha Kame na 4-ningumi

synopsis: An ordinary schoolkid serves as the unwilling caretaker of the wacky and off-the-wall turtles, who are mistaken for foreign exchange students.

title: Mount Hua Sect's Greatest Genius
synopsis:
Baek Un-ho, a third-generation disciple from a respectable family but lacking inner strength, may be expelled from the Mount Hua sect. However, one day he stumbles upon a fateful encounter with Mong Won-kyung and emerges as an unparalleled prodigy of the Mount Hua sect. Just how powerful will Baek Un-ho become?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Solo Leveling: Ragnarok
synopsis:
After witnessing the death of one of their own, the Absolute Ones—creators of the many universes outside of our own—frantically seek to fill the power void left by their fallen brother. With earth's existence in danger once more as gates spill monsters into our dimension, Sung Suho must answer the call and conquer the shadow dungeon while learning of his father's legendary legacy.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title_english: The Cup of Vengeance Is in Your Hands
synopsis:
Princess Eudith's story begins when her cruel brother, the king, sells her off to the neighboring kingdom to marry the queen's powerless stepson, Prince Franz. Eudith becomes a pawn in the queen's plot to discredit Franz and place her biological son, Krald, on the throne. Desperate, Eudith attempts to end her misery but wakes up on the day of her fateful journey. Armed with knowledge and experience from her past life, Eudith seizes the chance for revenge by helping Prince Franz take his rightful place on the throne. Will Eudith succeed in her revenge and find happiness?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

synopsis:
Lady Solea's family can't figure out how she lost her memories or why she keeps raving about her "jackpot." They don't realize she's actually Yoon Jiyoon, a lottery winner who was suddenly brought into their world! Determined to return to her reality and claim her riches, Jiyoon sets off a series of shenanigans to send herself home. Yet when Solea's family proves more fun than expected and distracts her from the mission to leave, Jiyoon begins to wonder if family is worth more than a fortune...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Watashi wo Yashinatte! Yuusha-sama

synopsis:
After our protagonist saves a girl dressed as an elf at a doujinshi event, she starts calling him "Hero". He thought it was only a temporary role-playing session, but it seems the girl is serious about it... The curtains open for the difficult days ahead for the amnesiac elf and our protagonist, who was supposed to be an unremarkable person!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

synopsis:
Ginji has always been able to see youkai for as long as he has ever known. Even now, as a third-year middle school student, he can still interact with them, and he is growing weary of being the only person the youkai make themselves visible to. Expressing a desire to get away from them, Ginji applies to a high school in Tokyo in hopes of turning over a new leaf; however, the youkai catch wind of this plan and are determined to make sure it does not come to fruition.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Akuyaku Reijou wa Iya nanode, Imushitsu Joshu ni Narimashita.
title_english: I Don't Want to Be a Villainess, So I Became a Doctor's Assistant
title_japanese: 悪役令嬢は嫌なので、医務室助手になりました。
synopsis:
"I was a villainess..." One day, Layla Vivienne woke up and remembered that she was a Japanese person in her previous life and is now a rival character inside a romance game. In that game, Layla Vivienne had been engaged to the crown prince, one of the romance options. She didn't bully the heroine, but she was an unlucky character who ended up dying in every route except her older brother's. She wanted to avoid dying, so she came up with the idea of avoiding entering the magic academy where the game was set as a student. Layla chose to enter the academy as a doctor's assistant and tried to avoid both the romantic options and the heroine, but unfortunately...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title: Goth na Joshi to Loli Danshi

She's an everyday office worker who enjoys gothic fashion. He's an everyday office worker who enjoys lolita fashion. The stylish everyday lives of two people who share the same workplace!

title: Shinu hodo Tsuyoku Nare
synopsis:
"Revive, Human." Ai Shinogami, the weakest recruit in the United Galactic Army, was supposed to have died on the battlefield. However, the chest pierced by the Kaiki, humanity's enemy, has healed, and the torn arm has reattached itself. On the verge of death, Ai made a contract with Nosferatu, the king of the Kaiki, to coexist with him inside his body. Through this contract, Ai can revive even after dying multiple times, and his physical abilities continue to enhance as he becomes one with Nosferatu. Ai always returns alone from battles where his entire unit is wiped out, earning him the nickname "Grim Reaper" and inspiring fear in others. Yet, Ai continues to stand up against the Kaiki for humanity's sake, no matter how many times he dies.

(Source: INKR)

title: No More Midnight Magic!
synopsis:
Siora spent her days as the servant of an ancient god until she was sucked into a novel and possessed characters close to the male lead, Duke Kruelo Whitedesert. A mysterious voice tells her that if she prevents Kruelo from destroying this world, she'll return to her own. But the duke's life is fraught with danger, and she dies twice before accomplishing anything. With time running out, will Siora finally be able to go home, or will Kruelo's treacherous life kill her for the third time?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Takou no Koori Hime wo Tasuketara, Otomodachi kara Hajimeru Koto ni Narimashita
title_english: After Helping the "Ice Princess" from Another School, I Decided to Start as a Friend.
title_japanese: 他校の氷姫を助けたら、お友達から始める事になりました
synopsis:
Nagi Shinonome, known as the "Ice Princess," is a beautiful girl with a cold attitude who does not get along with other people. One day, Souta Minoru notices her being molested on the train and musters up the courage to step in and save her. The next day she comes up to him again and asks him...

"I want you to stay by my side."

Can Souta continue to be "just friends" with the "Ice Princess," who melts sweetly only for him?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Children of the Rune: Winterer
synopsis:
Boy! You absolutely must survive!

After his family is destroyed by his uncle, all Boris is left with is his sword, Winterer, which has been passed down from his ancestors. However, this priceless artifact is the envy of many people's eye. Every time someone tries to steal Winterer, Boris' heart grows a little bit colder.

Boris' journey to survive and protect his family's sword begins now, but what secret does Winterer hold? And what awaits him at the end of his journey?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kakutou Museigen Kyo Musume Tarmy
title_japanese: 格闘無制限巨娘ターミー
synopsis:
Graduation was approaching next week, but Tamiko Komachi, nicknamed Tarmy, kept failing job interviews because of her huge body. The homeroom teacher, who tried everything, found the one place where she was likely to be hired: women's professional wrestling! A huge body that can be seen as strange becomes a strong attraction in the professional wrestling world. Komachi was reluctant, but she decided to enter the world of professional wrestling after seeing the echoes of the words of the world's super idol stars that his coach told her, and seeing Princess Maki in a live match. Tarmy's legend begins now!

(Source: Group Zero, translated)

title: Tyranny of the Gale
synopsis:
The war of the Northern Xia lasted less than half a year. The war ended in victory for the Zhongyuan army, but in the process, Bai Lixue's family is devastated by a demonic cult. He lost both his parents and siblings. The only survivor, Bai Li Gang has only one goal... the complete annihilation of the demonic cult!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: OL VTuber to Oshi JK-chan
title_english: OL Vtuber and Oshi JK Chan
synopsis:
Hinano Kumagai, age 26, is a normal office worker who relieves her stress with baths, alcohol, and... VTubing! She streams Let's Plays. Her favorite Vtuber is Ato Emori, who portrays a character with a seductive and sexy voice that makes her heart melt! As chance would have it, Hinano ends up collaborating with her fave. When she goes there to meet up, the person waiting for her was...?! The precious story of an exhausted office worker VTuber and a mysterious high school girl who collaborate with each other in a very exciting way♪

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Haru wa Megurite

Haru is a curious middle schooler, traveling the world alone. This is a record of her "encounters," full of fresh surprises and a mysterious crush.

title: Please Forget Vivian
synopsis:
After Vivian and Samuel got married, Samuel became a different man, saying that having a child would get in the way of their love. So when Vivian discovered she was pregnant, she erased herself from his memories, which inadvertently caused her to erase her own memory and shorten her lifespan. Now, seven years later, she needs to find her forgotten husband so that he can take care of their daughter after Vivian dies. But was forgetting Vivian enough to turn Samuel into a loving father?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Santa Industry
synopsis:
The city-state of Greenpod is a divided society run by the brutal International Police. Here, money and power are king, but social status is precarious. When Mel, an undocumented slum-dweller with super strength and an invincible body, becomes set on revenge against Greenpod, she is saved by... Santa Industry package delivery service?! But these couriers are more than they seem—they're the underground resistance. Can their motley crew convince Mel to join them in their efforts to change society?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kyou kara Koko de KuraShimasu!?
title_japanese: 今日からここで暮らシマす!?
synopsis:
It's an isolated island in the middle of the ocean, but... it's actually part of Tokyo Metropolis!

After graduating from high school, Aoko Takamine takes her mother's suggestion and moves by herself to the Izu Islands. She planned to live a leisurely life, but when she lands on the isolated island of Aogashima, far off in the ocean, she finds living on her own is unexpectedly difficult..?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: The Holy Emperor's Grandson Is a Necromancer
title_english: The Holy Emperor's Grandson Is a Necromancer
synopsis:
After a near-death experience, something has changed about the Holy Emperor's troublemaker of a grandson. To be precise, his body was taken over by a Korean man who died while playing a VR video game! But when his necromancer character is mixed with a Holy Prince's blood, things start getting funky. The zombies he makes are incredibly nice, his curses start healing people, and the girl he saved from being turned into a zombie suddenly gains super strength. Now he has to play the hero, but he'd really rather just go for a nap.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Ultimate-Mama
synopsis:
Teen model Manatsu is nearly attacked when a monster suddenly appeared but is saved by the superhero Ultima. But Manatsu, who has been splattered by the monster's blood, is now a target for danger! A couple of girls from the enemy faction are fooling around with each other, Manatsu's mother is flirting with a female secret agent, and then Manatsu and Ultima need to have sex with each other... A tumultuous "Yuri x Gag x Hero" comic!

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)
