title_japanese: 機動戦士クロスボーン・ガンダム 神の雷計画の真実
synopsis: Parodic retelling of the events of the Kidou Senshi Crossbone Gundam: Kami no Kaminari Keikaku no Shinjitsu from the perspective of one of that manga's side characters.

title: Doredake Doryoku shitemo Mannen Level 0 no Ore wa Tsuihou sareta: Kami no Teki to Yobareta Shounen wa, Shachiku Megami to Deatte Saikyou no Chikara wo Te ni Ireru
title_japanese: どれだけ努力しても万年レベル0の俺は追放された～神の敵と呼ばれた少年は、社畜女神と出会って最強の力を手に入れる～
synopsis:
No matter how hard he tries, Tinto's level never increases, and he's been dubbed the "enemy of God." After he gets kicked out of the party he's been in, the goddess Estelle appears before him, kneeling and apologizing. It turns out that it was because of her mistake that Tinto was still at level 0! By way of apology, he's given 100 times the experience points he would have gained up until that point, and overnight, Tinto becomes the strongest adventurer!

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)

title: Douse Shinu nara Kiss shitai!
title_japanese: どうせ死ぬならキスしたい!
synopsis:
Kanemaru, an inveterate serial dater, takes an interest in Liu, a transfer student at his college who works at his favorite Chinese eatery. But just as Kanemaru works up the courage to ask out Liu, they're suddenly attacked by a gang of kidnappers! Each and every time things start to heat up between the two, a wild and unpredictable predicament just so happens to get in the way... Strap in for a madcap BL about a couple the universe itself is determined to keep apart—even if it means they have to die!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Hanareta Futari
synopsis:
Childhood friends Koutarou and Subaru have always competed against each other in soccer, but when they become high school students, Koutarou realizes the difference in talent between him and Subaru...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

synopsis:
Zhu Yunwen, who barely survived the Jingnan campaign, received the souls of two of the world's strongest martial artists, the First Heavenly Demon of the Demonic Cult and Huineng, the Sixth Patriarch of the Shaolin Temple, in his body, and was reborn as Heaven Destroyer. This is the story of the Heaven Destroyer's journey to become an absolute existence!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

synopsis:
Demon King Astrea tasked 72 worthy Demon Lords with destroying the world. Demon Lords—a title only given to those who passed Astrea's test. Each was given powers befitting their title. Kharos, the ruler of madness and greed, was no exception. But his granted power was less than satisfactory. He received the power of "Gacha"—a luck-based ability with an abysmal pull rate. With this power, Kharos must do his best to engulf the world with madness and greed!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Skeleton Warrior
synopsis:
Kim Sojun, a former high school teacher who lost everything playing the stock market and came face-to-face with cruel reality, stumbles upon a heap of gold coins during a school trip. However, the moment he touches a coin, he is cursed and transported to a murim world. He wants to live a lazy and cushy life with the gold he found, but the System won't let him do it. Not to mention, there are other transmigrators from the modern era who came to this world earlier than him. Surrounded by martial artists and skeletons, the murim life of Kim Sojun begins!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Boku no Kanojo wa Dekkawaii
title_japanese: 僕の彼女はデッカワイイ

synopsis: A heartwarming romantic comedy about a tall girl with high specs and a weak-willed little boy!

title: Monster Hunter
synopsis:
A boy's life is turned upside down when monsters attack take everything away from him. The monsters hold him captive as their endless supply of food because of his regenerative ability. For years, he grunts his teeth and seeks revenge. However, he lacks the power to beat the monsters and gain freedom. One day, a monster hunter appears... A story of divine powers and the boy named "Lizard Tail" on his mission to eradicate monsters.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: I Can Do It
synopsis:
Assistant manager Cho Daechan who worked as a office worker for ten years died in vain from being overworked at a young age, because he could not endure the abuse of power of his evil boss. He thought it was all over... He opened his eyes again as a 18 years old high school student. A miraculous opportunity that will never happen again. "In this life, I will grit my teeth and live my life! I will clear up my life of being trampled on and succeed as if I am showing off. You don't think I can do it? No, I can do it!"

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Roar: Naraku no Heroine
title_english: Roar: A Star in the Abyss
synopsis:
"Who is the villain of your story...?" 

Misato had a perfect childhood, with parents who loved her and a home on an idyllic island in Japan's inland sea. But then a TV show starts shooting in town. Misato's cast as an extra, and in an instant, her life is turned on its head. A woman appears claiming to be her real mother, and before she knows it Misato is living in a lavish mansion surrounded by greedy schemers of all stripes. The curtain rises on the story of a rising star who plunges into an abyss—where the only sustenance is vengeance!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Nostalgic Warrior
synopsis:
"The Ghost Wolf of the Battlefield howls in the Murim!" So Cheon-Ho returns to his homeland after a decade of war and learns that his father has passed away and his disciple-brother, who was no different from his family, had disappeared without a trace! He briefly spends pleasant days with his childhood friend, So-Hyae, but is entrusted with her daughter, Hui-Yeon before she dies of a disease. Cheon-Ho, who has lost everything, starts an endless war against the Martial Artists in order to protect Hui-Yeon... A macho man with an unbreakable constitution and overwhelming power. He puts everything on the line to protect the child of the woman he loved!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Tsuma no Nakami wa Kodomo no Mama Datta no de Aru.

synopsis: There is a powerful spirit doctor, renown in the world of yaoguai (sentient spirits/demons/animals/forces of nature), who wears a silent bell, though few know what she looks like. She travels the world helping yaoguai who are suffering from various spiritual ailments, sometimes helping humans along the way. She is accompanied by a young monk and a serpent demon in the form of a man. We look into the stories of various yaoguai and the sources of their suffering.

title: Ura Koishi Kimi
synopsis:
When the demon Shimaki grew weary of eating humans, he gathered their bones and created something in the form of a human: Okibi. Little by little, through Okibi, his empty days begin to change.

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

title: Meririrarariri
synopsis:
When she loses her calm, she is unable to use magic. In order to become a great witch, Merrily has lived her life according to her mother's teachings, keeping her mind clear no matter what. Then one day, Merrily meets a boy named Danka. As she interacts with him, Merrily's heart changes...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Katte na Yuujin
synopsis:
On his way home from Saturday night cram school, Chihiro is spotted by his childhood friend Sakuma. Unlike the studious and reserved Chihiro, Sakuma does whatever she wants and is not afraid to express herself. Though she has not seen Chihiro since middle school, Sakuma decides to invite herself over to his house, which only seems to draw his ire. But as Chihiro tries to walk away, Sakuma acts in a way that makes him reassess his image of her.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Romance Code
synopsis:
After having her research proposal rejected yet again, genius robotics researcher Kei wonders if anyone will ever understand what she is trying to achieve. She is consoled by Marie, a robot of her own creation specifically designed to love Kei unconditionally. In order for Marie to have the capacity to feel and understand love, Kei created the Romance Code, a proprietary simulation that requires frequent updates to maintain.

Kei's fortune changes one day when she receives an email from a major robotics company inviting her to join their team. Though elated for her creator's newfound employment, Kei's busy schedule soon changes how Marie processes her emotions. Wondering if this is just a result of not having her regular maintenance, Marie keeps these feelings hidden from Kei until her creator reveals new developments that reprogram her in a way she did not expect.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Life Liar From Hell
synopsis:
Suffering from a serious illness with a slim chance at recovery, Sara Toosaka's affluent but absent father pressures her to find and marry someone to give her a reason to hold onto life. As such, Sara is constantly visited by boring men in suits who line up in front of her hospital room to ask for her hand in marriage. But one among all of the monotonous suitors is Yoshito Hisasaki, an eccentric swindler-like character who stands out like a sore thumb.

Yoshito has a big mouth and tries to use fantastical tales of fate to try and win over Sara's heart, much to her annoyance. Though she shows no interest in the man, Yoshito ends up coming back—something no other potential suitor has done. Even so, Yoshito's persistence has Sara unknowingly opening herself up to him with each passing visit, kindling something more between them.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Twice Upon a Time
synopsis:
A once-glorious life ends in betrayal, and a desperate wish is granted. Waking up in the present, Song Siwoo finds himself thrust into an unfamiliar world seemingly filled with echoes of his past. Whilst he soon discovers that fate still binds him to old friends, bitter enemies, and a beloved lover, nothing is as it seems—especially when reincarnation plays tricks with gender! Can he navigate these renewed connections and unravel the mysteries of his twice upon a time...?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The 10th Class Lout of the Knight Family
synopsis:
The human world is on the verge of destruction after the attack of the Demon King Erodin. After the fight against the Demon King, the Gold Dragon Exigar is reincarnated as Kain Logdel, a human who is a lout that knows nothing about magic. While trying to escape from his sword-crazed family’s duties to stay at the training camp by hiding his sword skills, Kain is on the verge of being exiled because of the unexpected message from his Family Head... Amidst all of this, the Demon King, with her new appearance, is also looking forward to reuniting with him?!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Rockabye Baby
title_japanese: ロッカ・バイ・ベイビー
synopsis:
Year 20xx. The economy collapsed, and public order worsened. Asahi, who was on the verge of ending his life in a dirty alley, is rescued by a young man who introduces himself as "Suzu."

Initially, Asahi, who intended to die, lashed out at Suzu, but since his true desire to live was exposed from the depths of his heart, he has come to forgive Suzu. He may not be stable, but he doesn't seem deceitful either.
While treating him as if he were much younger, Suzu, who occasionally wears a surprisingly lonely expression, made Asahi's heart tremble for the first time.

"That's what I thought. I wanted to know more about Suzu. No matter what kind of sorrow he carries..."

(Source: Shu-cream, translated)

title: Inazuman vs Kikaider
title_japanese: イナズマンVSキカイダー
synopsis:
Inazuman and Kikaider, two great heroes, clash!

The "New Human Empire" attacks the world with a plan to exterminate the human race! Kazada Saburou transforms into "Inazuman" with his supernatural powers. And Jirou "Kikaider," a warrior with a mechanical body, joins in. The two heroes of Ishimori's works finally collide!

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Love in Spring
synopsis:
Jihoon is the last person to be seen with a girl. He's spent his entire life turning down girls because his heart simply does not skip a beat for any girl. And then there's Sol, whose heart beats for every man out there. Serendipitously, the two meet at their college orientation, and whereas Jihoon finds himself helplessly in love, Sol finds herself able to breath in the presence of a man for the first time ever. Jihoon needs to win her heart, but he can't even speak to her without blushing or stuttering. Luckily for Jihoon, his friends come up with a devious plan to bring Sol and Jihoon together. Will the plan work?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

synopsis: An anthology comic of Sasayaku You ni Koi wo Utau by various mangaka.

title: Sleepless Beauty
title_japanese: スリープレス・ビューティー
synopsis:
"I wish I could share my sleepiness with you, Oz-san."

Oz, a designer who has insomnia, secretly admires Amamiya, a kouhai in the general affairs department. Oz admires the way he can quickly turn down a drinking session he doesn't feel like attending, and the way he takes a nap for exactly 15 minutes during his lunch break. Oz, who has a tendency to overthink things and is unable to get along easily with others, looks at him with envy.

On his way home one day, Amamiya invites him out for a drink, and fueled with alcohol, Oz grumbles about his insomnia problems. Afterwards, he decides to let a drunk Amamiya stay at his house. There, Amamiya proposes "co-sleeping" as a solution to Oz's insomnia, and...!?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: Yakyuubu no Hino ni Koi wo Shita
title_japanese: 野球部の樋野に恋をした。

title: A Fairy-Tale Ending for a Fake
title_english: A Fairy-Tale Ending for a Fake
synopsis:
Adopted into a ducal family, Odette Grizelle is merely a "fake" daughter, a stand-in for the duke's long-lost real daughter. Bullied by her brothers and looked down on by the maids, life isn't easy for Odette. So when the duke's real daughter Beri is found, Odette thinks it's finally time to make her exit. But surprisingly, Beri is thrilled to have her as a sister, and Odette now sees she has more supporters than she thought. With their help, can this fake find a real-life fairy-tale ending?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Emperor Thinks I'm Dying
synopsis:
As his strongest knight, Lindelle helped the emperor ascend the throne. But at his coronation, she coughs up blood—a side effect of her contract with the dragon Laroque, who promised to grant Lindelle any wish if she can find the dragon's real body. Meanwhile, Laroque's magic is destroying Lindelle's body, and the only way to heal is to fulfill the contract. But the emperor's word is law–and he says Lindelle can't leave until he finds a cure!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Ore no Haitoku Meshi wo Onedari sezu ni Irarenai, Otonari no Top Idol-sama
title_japanese: 俺の背徳メシをおねだりせずにいられない、お隣のトップアイドルさま

title: Xiao Mogu
synopsis:
In the year 2020, Earth's magnetic poles disappeared and humankind was nearly wiped out by cosmic radiation. Within the span of a hundred years, living creatures began to mutate and devour each other while the remaining humans, numbering in the tens of thousands, struggled bitterly in their man-made bases.

In the Abyss, home to the mutated xenogenics, there lived a sentient little mushroom. Because it had been nourished by the blood and flesh of the deceased human An Ze, not only did it take on a similar-looking human form, but a similar name as well: An Zhe.

An Zhe is determined to go to the human base to search for his spore, which had been harvested by humans. Once there, however, he faces the omnipresent risk of discovery and certain death as he tries to keep his non-human nature hidden from the Judges, whose responsibility is to inspect for and eliminate xenogenics like himself. And of all the Judges, Colonel Lu Feng is the most perceptive and merciless—as soon as he determines

title: Heroine nanoni, Ikemen Idol♂ ni Narimashita!?
title_japanese: ヒロインなのに、イケメンアイドル♂になりました!?
synopsis:
Rion aims to make her debut as an idol in order to get closer to Kanata, the idol she adores. While nervously preparing on the day of the audition, she bumps into Sakiyo, who is in the same group as Kanata! At that moment, something happens, and her sex ends up getting reversed...!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Kusuburu Kemuri no Nare no Hate
synopsis:
What's smoldering is someone's feelings...?

When Masaki goes off to college, he ends up staying with his older cousin Haruomi, whom Masaki admires and has a crush on. However, when Masaki meets him again for the first time in several years, Haruomi has completely changed from the older brother figure Masaki admired to a sloppy old man. Masaki is shocked by his appearance, but he remains kind to Masaki, and Masaki's feelings for him grow stronger once again. However, no matter how hard Masaki tries to tell him how he feels, Haruomi stubbornly refuses.

"I love you."

Masaki is frustrated that Haruomi can't even accept his words, but Masaki can sense that Haruomi is indecisive...

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

title: Yuusha Party wo Tsuihou sareta Shiromadoushi, S-Rank Boukensha ni Hirowareru: Kono Shiromadoushi ga Kikakugai Sugiru
title_english: Scooped Up by an S-Rank Adventurer! This White Mage Is One Heck of a Healer
title_japanese: 勇者パーティーを追放された白魔導師、Sランク冒険者に拾われる ～この白魔導師が規格外すぎる～
synopsis:
Lloyd, a white mage trained by Lady Merlin herself, is a member of the illustrious Hero's Party—until they kick him out for being "too weak," that is. What the Hero's Party doesn't know, however, is that he's actually crazy strong! No longer shackled to the party that never understood his worth, Lloyd is quickly Scooped Up by an S-Rank Adventurer who immediately recognizes his talent and invites him to join her party.

Together, Lloyd and his new comrades set off on a quest to hunt a pack of high wolves, but they soon discover that there's much more to this simple job than what meets the eye...

(Source: J-Novel Club)

synopsis:
Yamamoto, who works in a convenience store, has developed feelings for a girl who comes to order steamed meat buns every day. At the same time, he starts to get pranked by the neighbor opposite his house. Where will his feelings take him?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Crossing the Lines
synopsis:
Ara and Garam are childhood friends who used to have a sibling-like relationship. When they are finally placed in the same class (for the first time since the age of 8) as they enter their 2nd year of high school, their situation begins to change towards an unexpected direction. Will they be able to cross the line of dating, or not?

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Lucifugus
synopsis:
In a village illuminated only by candlelight, there exists a gate that no one dares to go near. A young girl has never considered what lies beyond it—that is, until the day she receives a book from a suspicious man. The book contains a story that is wholly different from the historical records she would normally spend her time looking at, and its contents begin to ignite a dangerous sense of curiosity in the process.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

Yoi Akete Romanesque
synopsis:
Tokyo in the early Showa era. Genichiro has been assigned to supervise the popular author Yuzuru Nijou. However, he is surprised to discover that the author he thought was a man is really a younger woman...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: The New Hire Is the Demon Lord
title_english: The New Hire Is the Demon Lord
synopsis:
Dullahan, the demon lord who once terrorized the world, finally revives in modern-day Korea, eager to take revenge against the hero who defeated her centuries ago. But all she can find is his descendant, Yongrae Kim: a hapless, incompetent office worker with no prospects and no joy in life. Ending his life now would only be doing him a favor, so Dullahan decides to improve his life first... but Yongrae's two-timing girlfriend and his many strict superiors at work stand in the way. Can Dullahan crush the office hierarchy and awaken Yongrae's dormant hero abilities to make her revenge more satisfying?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Life Saver Witch
title_japanese: ライフセーバーウィッチ

title: Ideal Match Delivery Service
synopsis:
Eunhyeong's world crumbles when her husband-to-be leaves her on their wedding day. While in a drunken stupor at home, she discovers an ad for a match delivery service on her phone. The next morning, a man named Minho shows up at her door, claiming to be her ideal match. What starts as a one-time free trial evolves into a routine of repeated orders, and sparks soon ignite between them as they find comfort in each other. Can they transform this unexpected twist of fate into a lasting love story?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Hana Himeru Kimi no Meteor
title_japanese: 花秘める君のメテオール
synopsis:
Every hundred years, the Monster's Bride is chosen—a sacrifice given to the demonic creature confined somewhere within the country. When Stella's sister is chosen, she volunteers to go in her place. Stella is soon sent to be the bride of the blood-soaked vampire Lavi. But behind the blood and fangs, Stella finds this monster harbors a deep loneliness. Will her affections pull him out of his deadly despair, or is their love cursed from the start?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Omae no You na Shoshinsha ga Iru ka! Fuguushoku "Summoner" nanoni Last Boss to Iwareteiru Sou desu

title: The Tale of the Tiger Girl
title_english: The Tale of the Tiger Girl
synopsis:
In Joseon's capital of Hanyang, rumors are spreading of an evil king cursing the kingdom with ghosts. First, there's the wailing man pulling an empty handcart. Then, a strange corpse appears in a well, turning the water to blood. To investigate, the prince calls his outcast brother, spirit seer Lord Muyoung, who comes down from the mountains with his skittish young disciple Haerang. Can this pair unravel the mystery, or will they too get caught in the web of royal curses and vengeful ghosts?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Solo Munching Game Breaker
synopsis:
Axe was once the best player in "Ryn Online," an action-packed fantasy RPG. But when his comrades kill him, Axe is forced to start all over. Devastated by their betrayal, he swore off gaming and opened a fried chicken shop to make ends meet. But when a new VR game called "Fate" is released, he notices that the friends who betrayed him are also playing. Now, he's willing to go back to gaming and munch on chicken-fried monsters to get stronger for his revenge!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Skill Breaker of the Namgung Family

So when he wakes up to find himself alive in his son Namgung Cheon's body, he is determined to give Cheon a better life. Now, he's ready to take on proud clan heads and cruel bullies using his trusty martial skill copying technique. Can this skill breaker bring honor to his son and clan, or will his shameful past break him first?

Two agents from the Nordic Naming Bureau (NNB), an agency specialized in investigating crimes committed by "Namers," handle the case of a man and his missing wife and son. Due to his lack of talent, Seonghyeon gave up acting and became a writer. Seonghyeon is a genius author with a natural talent for screenplays, but he still misses acting. Then one day, he got into a truck accident on set.

"If I'm born again, I have to act," he promised and closed his eyes.

Seonghyeon returns 13 years back into the past to when he was 24 years old. And the method acting ability that goes into his scripts became the character itself! Okay, this life is about being reborn as a genius actor!

synopsis:
Was there ever a greater tragedy than love turned to hate? Such is the tragic downfall of Emperor Ludwig of Berzantium, as he is betrayed and murdered in a fiery blaze by his empress. Olive Charleterre was once a bright young debutante, until her spirit was broken by the emperor's cruelty. Yet when Ludwig opens his eyes, he finds he has been sent back in time to his childhood. Whether he uses this boon to reclaim his lost love and forge a new path away from his villainous future—only time will tell.

Emilone was a well-known actress before she got transported to another world and became a saint. She got a plausible name of the "Holy Lady Who Moved Dimensions," but she didn't receive any attention. This happened because all the empire's attention was on Princess Ronella. synopsis:
After dying in a car accident, I possessed the villainess Daphne in an R-rated dark romance novel. Of all people, why did I have to possess her? This life wasn't going to be easy either... title: Jiden Itagaki Keisuke Jieitai Hiroku: Waga Seishun no Narashino Daiichi Kuuteidan

synopsis:
An autobiographical manga depicting the harsh life experienced by Keisuke Itagaki in the JGSDF 1st Airborne Brigade that consumed his youth!! The fierceness of the most elite unit in the Self-Defense Forces far exceeds people's common shambling impression of the SDF...!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Kougyou Aika Volley Boys

synopsis:
The story follows the risqué misadventures of three students named Akagi, Miyamoto, and Taniguchi—known by others as "The Asanuma Technical High School Idiot Trio." The trio start a second volleyball team at their school in a misguided attempt to be popular.

(Source: MU, edited)

title: Roses and Champagne
synopsis:
Korean-Russian lawyer Lee-Won Jeong rushes to work one day when he literally collides with a striking, blond-haired, gray-eyed stranger. Lee-Won thinks nothing of the chance encounter—until their paths cross again under far more ominous circumstances.

The stranger is revealed to be Ceasar Sergeev, the heir to the powerful Sergeev mafia empire. But even that is just the tip of the iceberg.

As a dedicated civil rights attorney, Lee-Won suspects the mafia is pressuring a senator to cheat his client, and he's determined to uncover the truth. But as Lee-Won delves deeper, Caesar's obsession with him grows more intense. Now, Lee-Won is about to learn just how perilous it is to attract the attention of the Russian mob.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Ojisan, Ore ni Koishite Kudasai
title_japanese: 叔父さん、俺に恋してください
synopsis:
Akihito Kusunose, an elite company employee, has a nephew named Ren Kusunose, who joined his workplace as a new employee. When Akihito was in high school, he was confessed to by Ren, however, he disregarded his confession as a misunderstanding typical of adolescence.

After 5 years, he reunites with Ren, only to find out that his feelings for him never faded away. His cute nephew starts showing his true colors and Akihito becomes self conscious of him but as his uncle, he is unable to reciprocate his feelings. One day, when they are alone in the office, Akihito compliments Ren on his work, and he is so elated that he kisses Akihito in the spur of the moment. Akihito shuts him down, but he begins to realize that his feelings for Ren are changing. What will happen to their long-standing forbidden love?

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Tsurenai Kemono ni Kamitsukitai
title_japanese: つれない獣に噛みつきたい
synopsis:
Manager Kyosuke Kozuka from the Fox race is hired as the exclusive manager of a popular model from the White Tiger race, Ojiro Mifuyu. Despite being quite renowned for his skills, Kyosuke worked hard to hide from others around him that he is an Omega to survive in a society with strong prejudice against his animalistic gender. But one day when Mifuyu touches him in the dressing room, an unexpected heat happens...!? "I'm the only one who is allowed to have sex with Kyosuke" says the younger, more passive alpha model.

(Source: Booklive, translated)

title: Hitsujikai no Kyoudai
synopsis:
Once upon a time there was a brother and sister who were shepherds in a land where there were more sheep than people. However, the sister was a werewolf. What is the answer that the older brother, Ulu, and the werewolf sister, Yuuf, arrive at every day while being tossed about being "different from humans?" A story that makes you realize the forms of the kindness of the people you meet.

(Source: Pie International, translated)

title: Haru no Regista
synopsis:
Haru Arai, a high school girl who used to be called a genius soccer girl, has transferred to a high school far from her hometown and is about to start a new life away from soccer. However, a new student, Satsuki Osanai, appears before her and, admiring past glories, declares that she will join a soccer club that is on the verge of being disbanded. This is a girls' soccer story about a girl who gave up on her dreams and a girl who chases her dreams!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Dare ga Yuusha wo Koroshita ka
synopsis:
Four years have passed since the Demon King's defeat. Now at peace, the Kingdom launches a project to honor the deceased Hero by compiling his many achievements. As they interview the Hero's former companions—the Sword Saint Leon, the Saintess Maria, and the Great Sage Solon—everyone is evasive about the truth behind the Hero's death. "Why did the Hero die?" Was it the Demon King who killed him, or his companions?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Escaping the Illusion
synopsis:
Beloved idol Yoonjae Ahn, renowned for his impeccable charm and striking appearance, secures a coveted spot on a popular variety show, boosting his solo career. Just as he's savoring success, his forgotten past resurfaces, threatening his celebrity status. Can Yoonjae shield his career from the looming secrets? With stakes at their highest, will his charm and unwavering determination prove sufficient to conquer the ghosts of his past?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: In the Shadow of the Spring
title_english: In the Shadow of the Spring
synopsis:
Twenty-three-year-old Yun Chahui is already tired of life: tired of Cheongna, her rural hometown where nothing seems to change; tired of her family's failing apple orchard; and tired of running away from Park Wookyeong, her childhood friend and first love. Although Chahui and Wookyeong grew up together, their lives couldn't be more different—Chahui's family has constantly been down on their luck and struggling to get by, while Wookyeong's family breezes through life as the wealthiest people in town. 

When Chahui returns home to nurse her ailing mother and help her unreliable father tend to the family farm, she has no choice but to face her past—and her past love with Wookyeong—that she's been trying so hard to forget.

Can love blossom again among the apple orchards of Cheongna, or are some things meant to stay in the past?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Boku no Hero Academia the Movie: You're Next

synopsis:
Roy Aveillam, from a notorious ducal family, is feared by everyone around him for his irreverent and arrogant attitude. However, in the midst of the turmoil with his classmate Van, he regains his "memory of his previous life" and his "desire!" It was a wish to "master something and become special." And then, Roy has an even more special encounter. He meets someone who has magic in this world! At the age of 8, he awakens to "magic" and aims to turn his life around with the help of his many encounters!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Harumei

I, Mei Tachibana, have two childhood friends. Haru-nii is 10 years older, and he and I have been like siblings to each other. Ren is my age, and before I realized it, he was always by my side. To me, both of them are precious and irreplaceable beings. "What does it feel like to be in love?" When I turned 16, I began to wonder, and little by little my relationship with the two of them began to change...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Yeo Jooyeon has always been different. Ever since her school days, her unusually strong sexual desires pushed her to seek an unconventional career path by joining an adult toy company. "Jooyeon, how about becoming our model?"

The Sky tore asunder, and humans from another world emerged, possessing extraordinary abilities! On a quest to discover how to use magic, Joan stumbles across Byungcheol, a human from another world, and starts to get involved in unforeseen events.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Take Two

Jiyoo unexpectedly reunites with her first love, Noah, on a film set after 10 years apart. Sparks fly and they share a passionate night, rekindling old feelings. Jiyoo hopes for a deeper relationship, but Noah remains a mystery. Just as their ambiguous relationship starts to unfold, a new star, Hyeseong, enters the scene, shaking things up even more. Will Jiyoo and Noah find their way back to each other, or will Hyeseong change everything?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Cold? Hot!
synopsis:
After rejecting all the men who were fawning over her big chest, Jihyun realized she turned 27 years old. After receiving a wedding invitation from her friend, she became nervous. Beautiful and single, Jihyun fell in love at first sight with a man three years younger than her named Sungwoo. He's kind and mature. Moreover, he's extremely hot. Together, the two experience each other. They go through heaven and hell, hot and cold, but...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

The protagonist caught a cold over Christmas, took the day off from work, and was laid up alone in bed. Then an unknown blonde gal showed up to take care of him. "Uhh... who?" he wondered, but being in the worst physical health, he ended up letting her take care of him...

Following her parents' separation, Himari has become jaded with life and contemplates whether there is any point to it all. Pondering what she can do to change the monotony, Himari sees a boy perched on a window, looking as if he is about to jump out of it. Fearing for his life, she tries to rescue him, only for the boy to fall on top of her and confess his feelings for Himari instead.

Eventually realizing he is the infamous playboy Rui Midorikawa, Himari is hesitant to get involved further with him. Even so, Rui's persistence begins to affect her outlook on life, making Himari wonder if she even deserves to have a relationship with someone like him.

synopsis: A suspense comedy series set after World War I that centers around Baron Bat, a thief who steals to help the weak.

Despite the unsightly scar on his face, he meets his kind-hearted wife, Dam Hwayeon, and they live a trouble-free life. However, the Dam Clan, revealing their true intentions, causes the downfall of the Yeon Clan. Hwicheon then barely escapes and finds refuge in a cave. Here, he has a fateful encounter, through which he acquires advanced martial arts skills. Suddenly he finds himself traveling back in time to the moment right after his marriage 15 years prior. Knowing in advance the wicked acts the Dam Clan will commit, Yeon Hwicheon preemptively exacts a fierce revenge, finally causing its extinction. There is an old saying like this, but there was a guy named Hyun Woo-yong who completely defied the warning against boasting about fists in Boseong. He was an 18-year-old high school student. Hyun Woo-yong, who had beaten up not only the delinquents at school but also the gangsters who backed them, ended up getting arrested for causing serious injuries. He served two years in the notorious "True Light Juvenile Detention Center" and was released. Afterward, he headed to Seoul. At the age of 21, Woo-yong returned to high school as a second-year student with a single goal in mind: to graduate high school safely and receive his diploma. title: Black Chains

Despite standing by Black Dragon Akelans' side for 14 years as his loyal vassal, Hasolan was never accepted as his mate, her love left unrequited until the day she took her own life. But upon opening her eyes, Hasolan finds herself back in the past on the day she first awakened Akelans. Though she tries to change her fate in this life, she ends up in the merciless dragon's clutches once more. Except this time, there's something different about him. To Hasolan's shock, Akelans acknowledges her as his mate right away. But at this point, it may be too late...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Kuufuku na Bokura
synopsis:
Humans are nearly extinct, and zombie society is on the verge of a food crisis. Wataru, a zombie whose quirk is that he has retained his human intelligence and emotions, hatches a plan to achieve a breakthrough in the food crisis. His ambitious plan is to find surviving human males and females, breed them, and begin farming humanity (food)! However, the first surviving woman he manages to locate is his ex-girlfriend, for whom he still harbors feelings even now!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Imitation Play 2: Dawn

Haruma and Nagisa have overcome their strained relationship due to their "sex friends contract" and have confirmed their feelings for each other. Now that Haruma is his boyfriend, he grows sweeter with each passing day, and Nagisa is constantly at his mercy with his straightforward expressions of affection...! They

Even when female customers who are after Haruma ask if he has a girlfriend, he can't bring himself to say that it's "me"... Then, a certain person who is looking for Nagisa appears—!? What lies beyond the unrequited love that was thought to be impossible to fulfill.

Kou's high school friend, Daiki, contacts him for the first time in nine years and they decide to meet. Even though they had become estranged after Kou rejected Daiki's confession a long time ago, Daiki tells him that he still loves him. Kou has no intention of responding to his feelings, but after thinking about it, he proposes to be his sex friend and he accepts...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

"Welcome to the game, player."

The story is about a boy named Kang Min who lost his brother due to a game called "Ghost Stories Game." Five years later, he receives a mysterious phone call telling him to participate in the game if he wants to find his brother. After accepting the offer, he begins to encounter various ghost stories. Giving up means death, and the only way to end the game is to reach the ending. Will Kang Min be able to find his brother by reaching the ending?

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Tensei Oujo wa Ai yori Ryouchi ga Hoshii node Seiryaku Kekkon wo Kibou Shimasu!

title: Guide to Rule the Netherworld
synopsis:
Jihwa Yeon died before her time. However, she is sent back to live the remainder of her life with a reaper to watch over her. She is also chosen as the unprecedented 1,001st candidate for King of the Netherworld. Now she must participate in brutal exams for the throne while getting burned for her trusting, helpful nature. She is told she is a "good person" and suspects it’s because she has no noteworthy traits. With no special powers, Jihwa will see how far being a good person will take her.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Absolute Regression
synopsis:
The past has changed, but like a fiery comet, he still comes. Mugi Hwa, the one without equal, slashed through Murim's skies with his sword, toppling every lord who dared to face him—even Cheonma, Mugeuk Geom's father. But Mugeuk didn't accept defeat. Instead, he turned to the forbidden: a time-bending ritual that hurled him into his own past. Now, retracing his steps, he races against the clock until Mugi emerges once again. But this time, it's not just about power, but mending old wounds and forging new bonds to unite his people and prepare for the bloodtide to come.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Okane Daisuki: Otokonoko-hen
title_japanese: オカネダイスキ 男の娘編

Who knew you could get such a cute femboy for only 50K yen!? Toa flashes his slender legs to anyone willing to pony up the price for an all-nighter. One lucky fan is about to pop his femboy virginity, and once the man whips out his package, Toa can't look away. Savoring this macho dick with each heart-stopping pound, Toa's going to get turned into a howling girl by sunrise!

title: Yoshida Lemon Drops

Following the death of his father, a man sets out to sea with one goal in mind: to catch a swordfish. Having grown up watching his father struggle to ever reel in such a beast of the ocean, the man is determined to avenge him no matter what.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kitsune to Tanuki no Oshikakekon
title_english: Kitsune and Tanuki's Courtship Tug of War
synopsis:
"Be my partner!"—Aiming to get their paws on money and food, fox spirit Ginjiro and tanuki spirit Kinsaku take on human form and cozy up to an unknown human. But this human, Yoichi, sees through their disguises in an instant and leaves them both besotted with him. From that day, they each pursue him fiercely, but Yoichi's heart cannot be swayed. One day, the two spirits learn of Yoichi's past and, knowing there is just one thing that can soothe his wounded heart, they decide to sneak into his bed that night...

(Source: Houbunsha, edited)

title: Booyakasha!
synopsis:
Despite his flashy looks, Detective Kai Kaburagi has a surprising soft side. When tasked with finding a missing college student, Kai's search leads him to a host—Ruka. There's just one catch: Ruka vanished from Kai's own detective agency a year ago with a lingering "I love you" that left Kai unsure if it was genuine. Annoying and fickle, Ruka might be a pain in the ass, but Kai can't seem to abandon him. They have an unbreakable bond that can't be described with just "messy" dating back to middle school. Reunited with Kai, Ruka is ecstatic, dangling a lead on the missing girl in exchange for a very specific favor. When Kai reluctantly accepts, Ruka immediately quits being a host and bursts back into the agency.

(Source: Shinkosha, translated)

title: Soredemo Ningyo wa Koi ni Hanikamu

A shut-in son, a daughter who courts sugar daddies, and a cheating husband. "This family is a failure." So thinks Noriko, a housewife who is spending her days without dreams or hopes for the future. However, fate takes a dramatic turn when she impulsively kills her husband's boss. "In order for the whole family to live happily, we need to hide the body." The broken family forms a strange bond as they collude in covering-up the corpse.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Houri is living an extremely uneventful life when, as if drawn to his crosswalk, a truck nearly runs him over. A passing man saves him, and the moment he sees the man's face, Houri's eyes are filled with flashbacks of their past lives when they had been intimate. The two are led by extraordinary fate to make love, but the next morning, the man bluntly says he doesn't remember Houri...!? A story of a love that recurs, until death do they part.

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Kyoudai Seido no Aru Yankee Gakuen de, Kyou mo Chigiri wo Semararetemasu

Kanae's got no idea what to do about the whole thing, and when she finally confronts Yukiji... he doubles down and suggests a pact to do this more?! She knows it's wrong... but can't help but think about all these new feelings...

(Source: Houbunsha)

title: Taimado: Time Slipper Omotenashi Madoguchi

Amidst a zombie apocalypse, Vin Yeom, an exterminator, finds a new purpose as an undertaker, specializing in funerals for the infected. Within the walls of the quarantine zone, he and his team navigate a treacherous world, providing solace to grieving families. Their company offers a unique but costly service that bridges the gap between life and death, allowing for one last goodbye. But in this world of death and despair, secrets linger, and the very loss that led Vin down this path may unearth a conspiracy that will shock the world and perhaps... help him find his way back.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Koori no Hime wa Chiisana Hidamari de Tokasaretai
title_japanese: 氷の姫は小さな陽だまりでとかされたい
synopsis:
Miharu Aoba is a high school boy who, in lieu of his busy parents, looks after his kindergarten-age siblings. Although he doesn't have time for romance, he enjoys spending time with his younger siblings. One day, Aoba brings them to a play date at the home of a classmate of his, the cool beauty Yuki Mizudori, who is known as the "Ice Princess." Mizudori asks him, "Can you make me smile?" A youthful romantic comedy about high school students who cherish their little siblings!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Eguchi-san Chi no Junjou Succubus
title_japanese: 江口さんちの純情サキュバス

title: Let Me Kidnap the Male Lead!
title_english: Let Me Kidnap the Male Lead!
synopsis:
Following a carriage crash, our heroine recalls being reincarnated as Vivian in a novel called "The Bloody Flower." Poor Vivian now knows she's a side villain who dies after kidnapping the male lead. But if she doesn't kidnap him and guide him to the female lead, the demon will destroy the world anyway! Unfortunately, the male lead was only described as "handsome," and this world is crawling with handsome men. Thirty kidnappings later, all Vivian has is a handful of good-looking fans who loved their luxury hostage experience. If only someone could point her to the man she's looking for...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: When the Witch's Daughter Lifts the Male Lead's Curse
title_english: When the Witch's Daughter Lifts the Male Lead's Curse
synopsis:
When Daisy wakes up in the novel "In Love With A Monster Prince" as the daughter of the witch who torments the male lead, Dionel, she must do whatever she can to prevent Dionel from killing her alongside her foster mother when he comes to seek vengeance in the future. Thirteen years pass, and Daisy is confident that she has achieved this goal until she realizes the original story has changed. Where is the female lead who's supposed to lift Dionel's curse with a kiss? And why is Dionel under the impression that Daisy abandoned him?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Traces of the Moon
synopsis:
One would think Asina has it all as the daughter of Cromwall's archduke, but a serious case of the travel bug has her ditch her comfortable estate for the beautiful but deadly desert. Unfortunately, the first person she meets there happens to be Sihad Zain Behdad, the king of Cromwall's enemy nation, Pesian. First, he throws her in prison because he finds her suspicious. Then, he captures her when she breaks out and throws her in his harem! Can Asina hide her identity long enough to escape from the Sihad, or will she fall prey to the aloof king's unexpected charm?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Love Doesn't Matter
synopsis:
One might think being engaged to Hadius Myer, the son of one of the most prestigious families in the kingdom, sounds like a fairy tale, but for Emilia Bern, a commoner, her reality is nothing but a nightmare. Tired of the constant criticism she receives from other nobles and her fiancé's cold attitude, all Emilia wants now is to end this charade. But when Hadius turns 19, his attitude suddenly changes. The truth is, Hadius has always been in love with Emilia, but he has been keeping his distance from her because of his unstable position within his family. Unfortunately, Hadius has already lost Emilia's trust and must prove his sincerity to gain it back. Will the two be able to overcome adversity and hardship and find a way to be together?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Mottomo Kirawareteiru Saikyou no Akuyaku ni Tensei
title_english: Reincarnated as the Most Hated Villain
title_japanese: 最も嫌われている最凶の悪役に転生
synopsis:
Seto Arima is a 23-year-old part-time worker. One day, he ends up reincarnated as Lobelia Crowley, the arch-villain of a popular mobile game! He tries to do good deeds in order to avoid a catastrophic ending, but he can't stop speaking with invective...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Ookami wa Tsuki ni Koi wo Suru
title_japanese: オオカミは月に恋をする
synopsis:
Runa Ookamigawa is a beautiful and perfect student council president. She is scary when she gets angry, so the frivolous and incompetent vice president Yuuga Tsukiyama calls her "Wolf-senpai." The two are like the moon and the turtle, contrasting with each other and not getting along.

One day, Tsukiyama finds out about Wolf-senpai's true nature through a secret part-time job...!? The mismatched love story of two people with secret faces begins!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Maoujou no Ryouriban: Kowamote Mazoku Bakari dakedo, White na Shokuba desu
title_japanese: 魔王城の料理番 〜コワモテ魔族ばかりだけど、ホワイトな職場です〜
synopsis:
Tsumugi, a human who works in the cafeteria of the Demon King's castle, is actually an isekai transmigrator. Formerly a homeless woman on the brink of death in her original world, she stubbornly defends her dream life, which guarantees food, clothing, and shelter, not to be outdone by the boorish and fierce-looking demons...!? A gourmet isekai love comedy set in the Demon King's castle.

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Beyond Walpurgis
synopsis:
One day, the owner of the divine universe makes a wager with Mephistopheles, a being from "the other side," on whether a special soul born on Earth will follow or stray from the divine path. In present time, mid-19th century Prussia, Martin, an aspiring novelist, meets Elysse Wagner, who unbeknownst to him was Doctor Faust, the Witch of Königsberg. Together, they end up embarking on a journey to find an ominous group that claims to know a way to bring the dead back to life. Only, there is more to Doctor Faust than Martin could've ever imagined...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: One-Room TA
synopsis:
When college student Uyun meets the quiet and introverted TA Jinhyeong, he immediately asks him out, saying he wants to get to know him more. After just three days of dating, Jinhyeong moves in with him, and that's when he starts showing a completely different wild side. All of his BL novel and comic consumption has perverted his perception of the perfect first time with his boyfriend. He's thought of it all, from doing it in the subway to having Uyun role-play as a K-pop idol. But as weird as Jinhyeong's ideas are, Uyun doesn't entirely hate it...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: SCP tte nan desu ka?
synopsis:
A request was sent to two manga artists, M and H, from the editorial department of Ichijinsha's Comic Howl.

"I would like you to create artwork based on the name (storyboard) for 'SCP,' which is popular on the internet. Additionally, I would like you to draw a manga that serves as an introduction to 'SCP."

The two accepted the project, but there were many unknowns about the original name. While tilting his head in confusion, M—who is learning about SCP from H, who is knowledgeable about horror—continues to draw the manga. M will be in charge of the introduction part, and H will handle the artwork for the original name part. The most popular horror author on the web, Nashi, returns to her roots.

A thought-provoking horror story that will surely help you understand what SCP is once you read it.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: The Scandalous Secret of the Crown Princess
title_english: The Scandalous Secret of the Crown Princess
synopsis:
Min Bo-ha possesses the psychic ability to read memories with her hands. Abandoned by the Min family and living from hand to mouth, one day she is given the position of the Crown Prince in place of her injured brother. Bo-ha puts on makeup and tries to fulfill her duties as a Crown Prince, but little did she know this decision will change her life forever.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Would You Like to Sign the Contract?
synopsis:
"This is for the Chairman. Is there a problem with that?" These words came back like a dagger, and that day, I died. And I came back to life. From Yoon Suk, who was the director of the best real estate investment company in South Korea, to Kim Dong-kyu, who was a loner, as well as a loser. Momentary frustration, I rose again for revenge. Wait for me. I'll make sure to make them pay for what they did to me. Today, I plan as Yoon Suk and execute as Kim Dong-kyu. For the sake of our revenge.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Chetamja: The King's Eyes
synopsis:
Become a Chetamja! Turn your rage into a weapon that defends the kingdom!

When young Gwiyeong loses his family in a brutal Jurchen raid, he swears to hunt down every last one of them. His skill in battle soon catches the attention of King Sejong, who offers him a chance to join Chetamja—an elite force of secret agents serving as the king's eyes and ears in the north. Now, alongside his comrades, Gwiyeong must carry the flame of vengeance and forge it into a blade of duty that will defend the kingdom of Joseon from the shadows.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Emergency Stairs
synopsis:
Haejin is a buttoned-up office worker whose marriage is going stale. However, sparks are flying at the office: his boss and an attractive coworker have a secret bond, and Haejin himself keeps running into a cute intern. One day, Haejin discovers an anonymous 18+ advice forum where someone alludes to having a crush on him. Will he stay his usual path, or try taking the emergency stairs for once?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Kyou kara Senpai wo Wasuremasu
title_english: I'll Forget You Starting Today, Senpai!
title_japanese: 今日から先輩を忘れます
synopsis:
Hiromi is suddenly reunited with her high school boyfriend—at a professional match-making service! But their reunion isn't a sweet one, because he doesn't seem to remember Hiromi at all. In fact, he starts making wild accusations that make her question all her memories from back then. This sharp-tongued stranger is like an entirely different person from the guy she remembers! Is this a match doomed to fail?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Shuumatsu Sekai Yuri Anthology
title_english: Girls in Post Apocalypse World Anthology
title_japanese: 終末世界百合アンソロジー
synopsis: A yuri anthology about girls in a post-apocalyptic world.

title: Okuribito
synopsis:
Daigo Kobayashi is a cellist, but when his orchestra is dissolved he returns to his hometown in Yamagata prefecture with his wife Mika. He finds a classified ad for a company which provides assistance for "departures" and goes for an interview. The company has just two people, a female clerk and the president, and the business of the company turns out to be a preparation of deceased bodies for funerals by wiping them clean and putting makeup on them. Nonetheless, Daigo joins the company as a trainee, attracted by a good salary, and gradually realizes the value of the job of an encoffinner.

(Source: JFDB, translated)

title: Kyun to Shite, Yamagami-kun!
title_japanese: キュンとして、山上くん!

title: Mint Cherry Blossom
title_japanese: ミント・チェリー・ブロッサム
synopsis: Included one-shot: Sentimental Sunny

title: Urenokori no Dorei Elf wo Hirotta node, Musume ni Suru Koto ni Shita
title_english: My Daughter Was an Unsold Slave Elf
title_japanese: 売れ残りの奴隷エルフを拾ったので、娘にすることにした
synopsis:
Weiss comes across a high elf girl for sale, a superior species of elf that is thought to be extinct. He decides to buy her and raise her as his daughter. She doesn't even know the language, but Weiss's hard work raising her pays off...? You won't be able to take your eyes off the high elf as her growth doesn't stop!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Shadow of the Supreme
synopsis:
Yangcheon Ku, born to the virtuous House of Ku of Sanseo, the Little Star and next Head of House. Status: The world's most hated demonic martial artist. Cause of death: Defeated during the Virtuous-Demonic War, tortured upon capture. Or so he thought. Moments after dying in the arms of his childhood friend, the Heavenly Sword herself, Seol-ah Wi, he finds himself back in the past. Already things have changed, but is it enough to ensure his second chance at life doesn't end with the same regrets?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Tonari no Kurokawa-san
synopsis:
Hajime Takahashi enrolled in Shuubi High School solely because it's the sacred place of his favorite manga. Everywhere in the school are locations that appeared in the manga, and he's super excited! Amidst this excitement, Takahashi meets a beautiful girl, Yayoi Kurokawa, who looks just like the heroine from his favorite work, and they come to share a certain secret. This awkward duo weaves a sweet and tangy youth romantic comedy that will make you grin!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Tonari no Kurokawa-san
synopsis:
Hajime Takahashi enrolled in Shuubi High School solely because it's the sacred place of his favorite manga. Everywhere in the school are locations that appeared in the manga, and he's super excited! Amidst this excitement, Takahashi meets a beautiful girl, Yayoi Kurokawa, who looks just like the heroine from his favorite work, and they come to share a certain secret. This awkward duo weaves a sweet and tangy youth romantic comedy that will make you grin!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Doushi Shoujo yo, Teki wo Ute
synopsis:
The novel's story begins in 1940, centering on Soviet citizen Serafima, who lives in a small village outside Moscow. She hunts deer together with her mother, and enjoys her friendship with her childhood friend Mikhail. When the Germans invade the Soviet Union, her village is caught up in the offensive, with all her friends and family dying or missing as a result. Saved only by a Red Army force, Serafima joins the Red Army and trains as a scout sniper in an all-female unit of snipers, swearing vengeance on her enemies.

(Source: ANN)

title: Tensei Yuusha no Kimama Tabi
title_english: The Carefree Journey of the Reincarnated Hero
synopsis:
Solo adventurer and hero Leon was a master of all trades: sword-fighting, magic, healing, you name it. When he single-handedly defeated the Demon King, a curse was placed upon the lone hero. Without a party to save him, they both met their tragic ends. Years later, a timid noble boy is attacked by an ogre, triggering memories of his past life as the great hero who shares his name—Leon! With these memories recovered and powers reawakened, Leon decides to start a new carefree journey!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Kasanegasane no Hatsukoi desu ga
title_japanese: かさねがさねの初恋ですが

title: Tounyan Kitan
title_english: The Mysterious Tale of The Tao Niang Peach Girls
synopsis:
Did you ever hear the tale of the Tao Niang Peach Girls? I thought not. It's not a story the vanilla-lovers would tell you...

Aged men have power, money, and time, but youth would evade their grasp.... if not for the Tao Niang. Are they urban legends, or creatures who have existed since the dawn of the Qin dynasty? Young girls fed nothing but peaches since infancy, raised such that so their very bodies harbor the secrets of rejuvenation, perhaps even immortality... and in this modern age, as with everything, available at a price. A man with his youth restored remembers not his own strength, and the Tao Niang are fragile... and short-lived. But that is, after all, the purpose of the peach girls.

(Source: J18 Publishing)

title: Bokura no Himitsu Kichi
synopsis:
When you make your secret base, be sure to do a better job hiding it from horny high-school seniors!

Ryouta and Jun have turned an abandoned shack into their own personal hangout, but two horny high-school seniors have claimed the space as their own before the two even get a chance to enjoy the fruits of their labors! The two bide their time until the older boy leaves and charge in to give the remaining girl a piece of their mind, but Ryouta and Jun are no match for a half-dressed high-school girl and she knows it! Turns out the boy from earlier wasn't her boyfriend, just a friend with benefits... and she's willing to let Jun and Ryouta in on the fun if they forgive her!

(Source: J18 Publishing)

title: Mesugaki wa Shosen Mesu
title_japanese: メスガキはしょせんめす

title: Uchi no Aniki ga Onnanoko ni Natta kara Minna de Mawasou ze!
title_japanese: うちの兄貴が女の子になったからみんなでマワそうぜ!

title: Futari dake de
synopsis:
1. Isogazu ni Yukkuri to (Don't Rush, Take Your Time)
2. Isshou ni Ireba (As Long as We're Together)
3. Futari dake de (Just the Two of Us)
4. Kyoumi Aru mon!! ('Course I'm Interested!)
5. Sekai de Ichiban (Number One In the World)
6. Sunao ni Narenai (I Can't Be Honest)
7. Kininaru Fukurami (Uneasy Swelling)

title: Joshi Shashin-bu to Ojisan Shidouin
title_japanese: 女子写真部とおじさん指導員

title: Koisuru Passion Monster
title_japanese: 恋するパッションモンスター

title: Trade Off
title_english: Trade Off: My Desires For Your Dreams
synopsis:
Many are prepared to sacrifice themselves for the people they care about, but few realize the real price they've agreed to pay.

Sakura is a student manager for her high school's baseball team. One of the players is her crush, Idea senior in his final season, but with an injury that might prevent him from playing. Of course, his coach would be happy to let him have this one last tournament with his team! That is, so long as Sakura's willing to make it worth his while. Sakura begrudgingly agrees, unable to stand the thought of refusing to help Ide... but will Sakura be able to reconcile her growing feelings for Ide with her willingness to give herself over to another man?

(Source: J18 Publishing)

title: Jackal to Pomeranian no Car Sex Suru Hon
title_english: Jackals & Pomeranians & Sex in a Car
title_japanese: ジャッカルとポメラニアンのカーセックスする本
synopsis:
Akane Shimose is all fired up to give her grumpy senpai, Gen Inomata, the best date ever! Too bad everything that can go wrong, does. But if there's one thing these horn dogs excel at, it's raunchy romance—even if it means fogging up the windows of a parked car!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Renai Side
synopsis:
Ayumu attends a high school festival at the school of his former classmate and first love, Tsubame, but Tsubame's friend, Ryuu, sees through his lingering feelings for his first love and harshly criticizes him. Hurt, Ayumu tries to find a new love, but the person he meets almost kidnaps him. Ayumu is saved by Ryuu, who unexpectedly...?

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

title: Amaku Nitsumete, Tokidoki Namete
title_japanese: あまく煮詰めて、ときどき舐めて
synopsis:
Hiding the fact that he's gay and living a peaceful life in the countryside, Ayato is the successor of a strawberry farm. One day, Nakaikawa, a salesman for a manufacturer, comes to ask for a contract. He was shying away from the bright and sparkling aura of ''the city dweller'' but when he accidentally drank alcohol, he got drunk and his reason collapsed. 

"You're cute and honest. I like you, I want to know more about you..." said Nakaikawa. Is this sales talk or...?

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Kikoeta Koi no Byoushinon
title_english: The Second Hand Ticks With the Sound of Love
synopsis:
"You're too clingy. I only saw you as a friend with benefits." 

With that cruel line and a broken watch, Yudai broke up horribly with Chiaki seven years ago. Unable to forget him even though he pushed him away himself, Yudai keeps Chiaki's watch with care. One day, the two meet again... The time that had stopped starts moving again, together with their lonely hearts.

(Source: CLLENN)

title: Second Kiss
synopsis: Included one-shots: Toaru Cool Beauty no Koi, Futari no Happy Trip

title: Nennen Korori yo Amatsuka-kun
title_japanese: ねんねんころりよ天使くん

title: Omega no Ore no Usotsuki Kusuriyubi
title_japanese: オメガのおれの嘘つきくすり指

title: Hidden Depths
synopsis:
Freelance photographer Felix accidentally walks into the wrong hotel room and meets Uriel, who mistakes him for a hired companion. After a chaotic misunderstanding, they become strangely connected. Felix starts having drowning nightmares and, as he investigates, discovers unsettling truths about Uriel and the origin of his dreams, pulling him into a web of mystery and danger.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Migawarikon no Koukyuuhi wa Koutei Heika ni Nigashite Moraenai
title_english: I'm Only a Substitute Consort, but the Emperor Won't Let Me Leave
title_japanese: 身代わり婚の後宮妃は皇帝陛下に逃がしてもらえない
synopsis:
"Shuran... You will go to the inner palace instead." The daughter of a wealthy merchant, Sai Reiran, was chosen to become His Majesty the emperor's newest consort, however, on the trip to the Imperial Capital, she runs away with the son of another merchant! In order to fulfill the emperor's orders, and keep their heads, the family orders Reiran's cousin, Shuran, to take her place instead! They tell her to just pretend to be Reiran, while they search for the real one, however that's easier said than done! Shuran struggles to keep her real identity a secret and ends up being caught up in all sorts of trouble! Not to mention the intrigues and plots that go on daily in the inner palace... How will Shuran survive...?!

(Source: Shusuisha)

title: Suterare Hanayome no Saikon: Koori no Henkyouhaku wa Saiai wo Chikau
title_japanese: 捨てられ花嫁の再婚 氷の辺境伯は最愛を誓う
synopsis:
Chloe has just finished a five-year contract marriage, despite being abused by a hostile marquess family. Unable to decide what to do with her life after the divorce, she finds herself living with her former fiancé and childhood friend Theodore, her first love! He has become a frontier count, but he remains as kind as he ever was—and he is still the same man. Chloe has begun to be attracted to Theodore.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Wagamama Kouhai-kun
synopsis:
"Since you already promised, I'll take you at your word and have you go along with me until I'm satisfied."

Toda receives a sudden confession from his Kouhai at work, Hijima. Toda wants to stay as Senpai-Kouhai like they've always been, but Hijima pursues a romantic relationship with him. As Toda is half-forced into dating him, Hijima has him completely wrapped around his finger... An office love comedy between a meddlesome senpai & a cute, selfish kouhai!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Otoshigo to Juusha no Monogatari
title_english: Story of the Master and Servant
title_japanese: 落とし子と従者の物語
synopsis:
Monstrous-looking slave Kustar was waiting for his death in his cage when the aloof but beautiful Julius bought him as his bodyguard. As the second of son from a concubine, Julius is embroiled in various feuds with his family and often have to sleep with male "guests." His cold demeanor towards the pure and devoted Kustar slowly changed as he learned to open his tightly closed heart.

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title: Venus Mission: Moto Koroshiya de Youhei no Chuunen, Yuusha no Ansatsu wo Irai sare Isekai Tensei!
title_japanese: ヴィーナスミッション ～元殺し屋で傭兵の中年、勇者の暗殺を依頼され異世界転生!～
synopsis:
The request from the goddess is to assassinate 32 heroes!? 42-year-old Takashi Suzuki is a former hitman and mercenary. Although he died of cancer, he was reincarnated into another world due to his potential as an assassin. He uses the modern combat techniques he developed in his previous life, the ancient martial art "Shingu-ryu," and his newly acquired powerful magic to face off against the unrivaled heroes. An exhilarating fantasy of swords, magic, and guns begins!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Paw-ther Knows Best
synopsis:
On his daughter's wedding day, a father dies and mysteriously reincarnates as the family dog in her new home. As he adjusts to his canine form, he uncovers a shocking secret: his seemingly perfect son-in-law might be unfaithful. With keen senses and newfound determination, this papa dog must protect his daughter from betrayal. Can he save her from heartache without revealing his true identity?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Shinjuku Liar♡Girls
synopsis:
Having quit their grueling jobs at a maid cafe six months prior, former coworkers Hina and Viola now live stream their lesbian relationship online for anyone to see. Though they seem like a cute couple in front of the camera, they are only putting on a show for people who tune in, as they are not actually dating. Even so, Viola harbors one-sided feelings for the hard-working Hina but has accepted that they will never be reciprocated.

Though they are early into their livestreaming career, their growing popularity is starting to grab attention, and the fake couple soon find themselves getting project proposals. In order to capitalize on this surge in views, Hina proposes they go on a date to Mouseland—but this brings out more complicated feelings between the two than they initially realize.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Ma no Mono-tachi wa Kuwadateru
title_english: The Demons Are Planning Something Good!
title_japanese: 魔のものたちは企てる
synopsis:
People don't truly appreciate the amount of R&D that goes into running an evil army of darkness. I mean, you can't just let the heroes waltz up to the final boss unscathed, can you? Do you know how much logistical work it takes to keep the traps armed? To come up with new, innovative methods to torment, maim, and humiliate humans? From slime that only melts clothes to titillating tentacles that squeeze you just right, follow along with the Demon Lord's underlings as they devise, concoct, and scheme up exciting new ways to strike fear in adventurers' hearts!

(Source: Yen Press)

title_japanese: 死んだら悪役令息で幻のΩなんて冗談じゃない！
