title_japanese: 映画ブラッククローバー 魔法帝の剣

title: Eiga Black Clover: Mahou Tei no Ken
title_japanese: 映画ブラッククローバー 魔法帝の剣

title: Bokura no Issen
synopsis:
Sakura Shiba (22 years old) was walking home in a drunken state when he was helped by a much younger boy named Ageha Onaga. In his drunken stupor, Sakura kisses Ageha and drunkenly agrees to a relationship with the boy as a form of "taking responsibility." Sakura is tormented by guilt afterwards and tries to run away, but both parties aren't really willing to let the other one go.

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

title: Multiverse no Watashi, Koishite Ii desu ka?
title_english: Can I Fall in Love with a Multiverse?
title_japanese: マルチバースの私、恋していいですか?
synopsis:
Jogo has a crush on his classmate, Miyato. One day, they unexpectedly end up walking home together after school. When Miyato is about to be hit by a truck, Jogo throws himself in harm's way to save her. In the final moment before impact, Jogo wishes he could have told Miyato how he felt. But then he hears a mysterious voice saying, "You can do it over. This time, don't have any regrets."

When he wakes up, he finds himself unharmed, lying on the ground, with a different version of Miyato beside him—she looks the same, but her clothes and hairstyle are different.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Nougaku Hakase no Isekai Musou: Kinki no Chishiki de Kizuku Monster Musume Harem
title_english: Building a Monster Girl Harem with Forbidden Science
title_japanese: 農学博士の異世界無双～禁忌の知識で築くモンスター娘ハーレム～
synopsis:
In this savage isekai world, seduce and dominate cruel monster girls with your pharmaceutical knowledge!!

One day Shirou, a harmless and kindhearted professor of agriculture, is transported to another world, together with his seminar students and his entire laboratory. It is a hopeless world where humans are treated as slaves and ruled by monster girls...! Without any powers and with the lives of his students as slaves being threatened, Shirou uses the materials in his laboratory and his own pharmaceutical knowledge to do whatever it takes to seduce the monster girls...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: The Academy Is Doomed
synopsis:
Amon Drake arrives in the capital with dreams of success. On his first day as a teacher at the prestigious Amonis Academy, he is met with shocking news: "Haven't you heard? This academy is on the brink of bankruptcy." On top of that, the only people left at the academy are a gambling-addicted principal and drunken teachers. Amon thought, "If the academy goes bankrupt, doesn't that mean my contract would become void too?" They say escape favors the intelligent. If you don't want to waste your life away, bring the academy to ruin. The story of a wise man's escape from the academy begins now!

(Source: Papyrus, translated)

title: The Legendary Hunter Becomes Young Again
synopsis:
"If only I were 10 years younger...!!"
[A special reward is given that reflects the target's wish.]

Gwak Pilseong, a legendary hunter enjoying his retirement at the age of 80.
He accidentally gains the ability of immortality and rejuvenates, returning to the hunter industry after a long hiatus...

There are too many rotten scoundrels in the hunter industry!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Mami-chan
synopsis:
The manga centers on 74-year-old Mami Inaba, who has been running a diner in a sleepy port town for 20 years. But when a nearby newly-opened apartment building also has a shopping mall within walking distance, she finds that there has been little foot traffic toward her diner. When she has a chance encounter with a supposedly-missing famous actress Hijiri Umakoshi, the pair begin to form a plan to revive Mami's struggling business.

(Source: ANN)

title: Yume de Are dake Yatta noni
title_japanese: 夢であれだけやったのに

title: Kaettekita Kaitou Recipe
title_japanese: 帰ってきた怪盗レシピ

title: Yasashii Koe yori Meshi ga Ii
title_japanese: 優しい声よりメシがいい

title: Watashi ni dake Tenparu Joushi no Hanashi
title_english: My Boss Only Gets Flustered Around Me
title_japanese: 私にだけテンパる上司の話
synopsis:
My boss, Chief Hiyakawa, always has a scowl on his handsome face, intimidating just about everybody. But for some reason, he makes mistakes in front of me, blurts out what's on his mind, and shows his careless side... Blushing, acting suspiciously, and speaking in a boisterous manner! A love comedy about a cute, love-struck working adult with a stressed-out boss begins!

(Source: Square-Enix, translated)

title: One Loves Monster
title_japanese: ワン・ラブズ・モンスター
synopsis:
Yume Sonozaki is a shy, reserved college girl who's inexperienced with love. At her after-school club, she hits it off with a nice older student, Aoi, who becomes her first boyfriend. She's happy with him, but for some reason, they haven't gotten to first base! As the days go by, she finds herself sadder and more desperate. Yume finally bites the bullet and asks if she can stay the night, and a bewildered Aoi agrees. Nervously, she waits for Aoi to step out of the shower, only to discover his personality has changed completely. What is this strange, animalistic allure? Thus begins a love triangle with two men in the same body!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Ai no Senbiki: Mamakatsu Shitara Mama ga Dekita Hanashi
title_japanese: アイノセンビキ ～ママ活したらママができた話～
synopsis:
The protagonist ​​is a middle school boy named Jun Hikawa, who lost his mother at birth. He glares at his classmates who complain about their own overprotective mothers and wonders what it would be like if he had a mother of his own. The story begins when Jun, who wants the warmth of a mother, lies about his age and matches up with a stranger on a sugar mama dating app.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Totsukuni Touka: Bakumatsu Tsuuyaku Moriyama Einosuke
title_japanese: とつくにとうか －幕末通訳 森山栄之助－

title: Maigo no Onnanoko wo Ie made Todoketara, Genkan kara Detekita no wa Gakunen Ichi no Bishoujo deshita
title_japanese: 迷子の女の子を家まで届けたら、玄関から出て来たのは学年一の美少女でした
synopsis:
One day, Yuusei Kuroda, an introverted high school student with zero dating experience, returns a lost little girl to her house... when the most beautiful girl in his grade, Ayano Shirakawa, appears! "As thanks for saving my sister," she begins to approach him boldly for some reason, and every day is filled with mishaps!? On top of that, a busty otaku classmate and an attention-seeking junior girl also appear, and his daily life suddenly becomes more glamorous!? A school romance comedy where fate changes as you suddenly become close to "the girl of your dreams!"

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Maigo no Onnanoko wo Ie made Todoketara, Genkan kara Detekita no wa Gakunen Ichi no Bishoujo deshita
title_japanese: 迷子の女の子を家まで届けたら、玄関から出て来たのは学年一の美少女でした
synopsis:
One day, Yuusei Kuroda, an introverted high school student with zero dating experience, returns a lost little girl to her house... when the most beautiful girl in his grade, Ayano Shirakawa, appears! "As thanks for saving my sister," she begins to approach him boldly for some reason, and every day is filled with mishaps!? On top of that, a busty otaku classmate and an attention-seeking junior girl also appear, and his daily life suddenly becomes more glamorous!? A school romance comedy where fate changes as you suddenly become close to "the girl of your dreams!"

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Lolita to Ane
synopsis:
Miyuko's older sister Hinako is the talk of the town with her flashy lolita outfits. Though Hinako looks like a princess in her frilly dresses, Miyuko is not very keen on the fashion herself. However, these negative feelings are soon called into question when Miyuko lays her eyes on a dress Hinako had recently bought.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Akuyaku Reijou no Ane desu ga Mob de Ii node Shinitakunai
title_japanese: 悪役令嬢の姉ですがモブでいいので死にたくない
synopsis:
Giselle, the older sister of a villainess, faces downfall or death on every route. After remembering her memories from her past life, she begins re-educating her younger sister Odile, who is the source of all evil, to prevent her from becoming a villainess! What's more, Giselle's future fiancé is also a troublesome man who is certain to fall into the dark side...!? Giselle's struggle to live a peaceful life begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Deathcord
synopsis:
One day, Kyung-min, whose self-esteem has hit rock bottom from being bullied by his friends, suddenly receives an invite to "DeathCord," a chatting room where you can kill people through voting. Anonymous death penalty vote in the chat room! Anonymous participants invited to the chat room are keen to kill people for their own reasons. However, one of the chat participants becomes the target of the death penalty, after that, the participants in the "DeathCord" chatroom start struggling to identify each other... A murder game that won't end unless they kill each other!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Izuki-kun wa Tadasaretai
title_japanese: 伊月くんは正されたい
synopsis:
Izuki-kun has a crush on an older student: Ririko-senpai, the president of the disciplinary committee! Izuki repeatedly tries wearing his uniform sloppily, just to have a chance to talk to her even a little bit, but Ririko is way ahead of him...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Bunkei no Kimi, Rikei no Anata
title_japanese: 文系のきみ、理系のあなた

title: Yuribute
title_english: Yuribute: Comic Yuri-Hime Short Story Tribute Anthology
authors: Dokuta, Pepako|FLOWERCHILD|Nanaji, Yuuki|Tamasaki, Tama|Tsutsui|Kumo, Suzume|Shiroshi|Iwami, Kiyoko|Shimamizu, Eke|Kashiwagi, Tsukiko|Kaneko, Aru|tsuke|Shino, Hirofumi|Kabocha|Ono, Rin|Sakasana|Amazaki, Suika|Urushino|Hino, Arashi|Sakanaya|Sumire|Tsumugi, Meme
synopsis: Anthology by various mangaka.

title: Inbiri no Mura: Kao no Onaji Otokotachi
title_japanese: いんびりの村 －顔の同じ男たち－

title: Oretachi One Set
synopsis:
Six months ago, Ayase and Waku met for the first time after ending up in the same class. The two boys could not be more different from each other; Waku is outgoing and shameless whereas Ayase is reserved and refined. Even so, they quickly become friends, yet Waku soon realizes that his feelings for Ayase go beyond a normal friendship. Determined not to let this tear his current relationship with Ayase apart, Waku resolves to keep his attraction a secret but finds that it is increasingly difficult to ignore his friend's every action.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Doctor Elise
synopsis:
Jihyun Song devotes herself to saving lives as Korea's eminent Master Surgeon. She remembers her first life as Elise, a selfish empress, and she's determined to do good this time around. But Elise de Clarence isn't done with her yet! After a freak plane crash, Jihyun gets another shot at her first life in a world of regency, war, and politics. Can she employ her modern surgery skills to save Britia and get out of her engagement to the crown prince before her wretched past repeats?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Otona wa Wakatte Kurenai.
title_japanese: 大人はわかってくれない。
synopsis:
The manga centers on a girl named Tsumugi who enters a private school for high-class families, and has a fated encounter that will change her life.

(Source: ANN)

title: Isekai Maid no Mitsuboshi Gourmet: Gendai Gohan Tsukuttara Oukyuu de Dai-bazuri shimashita
title_english: The Maid's Three-Star Cuisine in Another World I Used Real-Life Dishes to Become a Palace Sensation
title_japanese: 異世界メイドの三ツ星グルメ 現代ごはん作ったら王宮で大バズリしました
synopsis:
Gluttonous girl Shirley has been reborn in another world, but there is one problem: the new world does not seem to have hamburgers, beef bowls, or ramen noodles she loves so much. While missing the previous life's age of plenty, she rouses herself to action, declaring, "Well, if you don't have one, you just got to make it yourself!" In order to recreate the modern-day dishes, Shirley busies herself with cooking every day and the rumor of her starts to spread. Then one day, a scout from the royal palace pays Shirley a visit and asks her to be a maid to make snacks for the prince?! B-grade gourmet food and sweets are her areas of expertise! A culinary maverick causes quite a stir in the royal palace?! 

(Source: Kodansha)

title: Ushiro no Seki no Fukuwa-san
title_japanese: うしろの席のふくわさん
synopsis:
Mitsuru did not expect his seatmate to be a ventriloquist. The shy Komachi Fukuwa is unable to speak and uses a puppet to communicate in her place. Although he is initially surprised, Mitsuru befriends Fukuwa through her eccentric puppet partner. Longing to hear Fukuwa's real voice at some point, Mitsuru arranges to have her teach him the art of ventriloquism; but things do not go as planned when Fukuwa's puppet does all the talking for her.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Level Reset: Gomi Skill dato Kanchigai shita keredo Jitsu wa Tondemonai Cheat Skill Datta
title_japanese: レベルリセット ～ゴミスキルだと勘違いしたけれど実はとんでもないチートスキルだった～
synopsis:
Ragnus, who had been garnering attention as a child prodigy, turned 10 and was set to participate in the "Skill Awakening Ceremony" held for the nation's boys and girls. Though everyone expected him to be conferred a legendary skill, Ragnus received an unknown skill called "Level Reset." The fatal ability to reset his level to 1 everyday was deemed "junk," and all at once he was reduced to a life of slavery. However, while being treated like a slave by those around him, Ragnus realized the great potential of his skill and decided to run away from home. Vowing to prove to the world the value of his cheat-level skill, he set out on a journey, but...

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

title: Watashi wa Nise Seijo Rashii node, Kyuutei wo Dete Ringoku de Kurashimasu
title_japanese: 私は偽聖女らしいので、宮廷を出て隣国で暮らします
synopsis:
Tiara, who has special power to heal people, had been working in the Imperial Court of Lerys since she was just a girl. As a "Saint," she healed wounded or sick people every day until she was exhausted.

However, one day, she was accused of pretending to be a saint—the second princess, Isabelle, who hated her, wanted to show how powerful she is. Tiara thought for a moment... she was never happy here. It would be better to be kicked out of here and live a life of her own! While she was trying to find a book to read before leaving, she met Alex. When he heard what happened, Alex suddenly said "Why don't you come to Ekwald, my land?" Tiara never knew that he was the prince and the strongest dragon knight of Ekwald! Tiara's journey begins.

(Source: Kadokawa)

title: Day Walker
synopsis:
National Intelligence Service black ops agent Suhyeok is tasked with assassinating Nanayama, the Yakuza leader heading a drug trafficking organization in Korea. To his surprise, the target is a captivating woman named Anna, who appears disconnected from any violence. Sensing something amiss with his mission, Suhyeok embarks on a path of vengeance against both the National Intelligence Service, which has betrayed him, and Nanayama, who massacred his comrades.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: The New Beggars' Sect
synopsis:
The protagonist, wandering the martial world with a secret of the red dot, has a fateful encounter with a legendary figure and joins the Beggars' Sect. The master who imparted absolute martial arts to the protagonist meets a mysterious death. With the death of the master, who was the pillar of the beggars, the Beggars' Sect gradually declines. In response, the protagonist decides to leave the sect, investigate the master's death, and create a new Beggars' Sect that will not be looked down upon.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: The Most Handsome Man Becomes a Skeleton
synopsis:
In a world where even monsters can't resist his charm, Louis, the most handsome man alive, faces an unexpected twist of fate. One day, a deadly plague sweeps through his village, claiming Louis as one of its victims. However, upon his death, he exclaims, "Where did my sculpted face go? What's with this skeleton head?!" Now, as the strongest and most handsome man in the world—stripped of both beauty and ugliness—Louis embarks on a journey filled with trials and tribulations as a skeleton. Will Louis be able to reclaim his human form and return to his life as the world's most handsome man?

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Maoujou, Akibeya Arimasu!
title_japanese: 魔王城、空き部屋あります!

title: Tutorial ga Hajimaru Mae ni: Boss Chara-tachi wo Hametsu sasenai Tame ni Ore ga Dekiru Ikutsuka no Koto
title_japanese: チュートリアルが始まる前に ボスキャラ達を破滅させない為に俺ができる幾つかの事
synopsis:
As soon as he opens his eyes, the man realizes he has been reincarnated into the world of the famous RPG series Spirit Wars: Dungeon Magia. However, it isn't as the protagonist that he has been reincarnated, nor even as a background character... With weak abilities, little to no talent, and the catchphrase "Nya-ha-ha!" he has been born again as a bottom-feeder boss destined to die in the tutorial! All that awaits him is his own grim end! But after finding out that his beloved older sister is destined to die from illness, he makes her a promise: "I'm going to wreck every unfair plot point in this damned world with my own two hands!" Taking advantage of his vast knowledge of games, the man decides to rebel against the original scenario. The strongest secret boss, the boss from the saddest route... He sets out to meet all the bosses of the world. But what lies in store...?!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Last Boss-tachi no Kakushigo: Maoujou ni Tensei shita Moto Shachiku Programmer Jiyuu Kimama ni "Magic Code" wo Kaihatsu suru
title_english: The Hidden Cubs of the Last Boss: A Former Corporate Programmer Reincarnated in a Demon King's Castle Is Free to Develop a "Magic Code" at Will.
title_japanese: ラスボスたちの隠し仔 ～魔王城に転生した元社畜プログラマーは自由気ままに『魔導言語〈マジックコード〉』を開発する～

title: Debuff Master
synopsis:
Han Taesung, a gamer for a living, is cornered at the edge of a cliff. "I have been watching you for a long time." Deus, a hidden NPC of level 999, appears In front of Taesung!

"Would you like to become the disciple of the hidden NPC Deus?"
"Yes!"

Thus the master's teachings began!! "Two blows are not cool, you must defeat enemies in one blow." Taesung becomes a Debuff Master who knocks down enemies in single blow. Everyone will fall prey! Defeat them in one hit!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Knight's Restaurant
synopsis:
"I'll turn back the hourglass of blessings." Blessing? At this point, isn't it more of a curse? After 99 regressions, Chef Baek finally loses to the demon. Using the buff recipes he has mastered, he opens "Knight's Restaurant," selling expensive magical food. "My goal in this life is to die of old age!" he declares, but Chef Baek hires employees with mysterious pasts and begins a curious journey with them, riding his rickety old food truck...

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Bouken ni Iku Fuku ga Nai!
Kaichou, Ii Ko wa Mou Owari
title_japanese: 会長、イイコはもう終わり
synopsis:
Asahi, the student council president who is smart, has a good personality, and is loved by everyone has a secret he can't tell anyone. That is the desire to be embraced by a man. He wants to have "experience" by the time he graduates, so he looks up a dating site but he gets found out by Hida, who always had an unfriendly attitude towards him! 

"I'm interested in seeing the real face of senpai, who's always acting like a goody-two-shoes." He know that he's just teasing him but his body can't help but feel good...

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Oniure Idol ga Kyou mo Watashi wo Oshitekuru
title_japanese: 鬼売れアイドルが今日も私を推してくる
synopsis:
Unpopular underground idol and actress, Enatsu Sayuki, faces her work diligently everyday to achieve her dreams of making it big in the world of acting. ...However, for some reason, the superstar idol Sera Touma—who should be her rival—becomes her biggest fan!! Adorable enough to make Sayuki jealous, Sera takes every chance to passionately declare her love, throwing Sayuki’s life into chaos. Will Sayuki be able to achieve her dreams? And what will become of the one-sided love(?) between Sera and Sayuki…!? The curtain rises on the clash between these young talents in the fierce age of idol showbiz—let the show begin!!

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

title: Hoshikuzu no Kodomotachi
synopsis:
A father and his robot daughter have a heart-to-heart about what it means to be family and to be related.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Elite Mahoutsukai, Omutsu wo Haku
title_japanese: エリート魔法使い、オムツを履く
synopsis:
Aqua, an elite mage who graduated at the top of her class from magic school, demonstrates her abilities even in dungeon escort missions. However, she constantly wears a stern expression. That's right, she has a secret that no elite should ever have, one that absolutely must not be discovered...!

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

title: The Strange Tales of the Crescent Moon Hall
synopsis:
Even now, countless irregular beings roam this land from ancient tales. Among them is high school student Yu Dan, who possesses the ability to see ghosts. Seeking assistance, Yu Dan turns to the half-fox demon Baek Ran, ruler of all spirits at the Hall of Crescent Moon.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: I'm Going Through Time to Meet You
title_english: I'm Going Through Time to Meet You
synopsis:
Master sorcerers are rare. Fewer still deal with space and time. So when the empire comes for Eleanor, she escapes to the past with plans to befriend her still-living mother. But the past isn't what she hoped—she can't enroll in the academy, her mother is aloof, she's at odds with the only person willing to help, and they're also plotting to overthrow the throne. With no way to know what secrets she'll uncover, at least one thing is clear: getting involved is the only way to keep her mom safe.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Seikatsu Majutsushi-tachi, Dungeon ni Idomu
title_japanese: 生活魔術師達、ダンジョンに挑む
synopsis:
Due to pressure from the Magic Academy's Combat Department, the Life Magic Department's budget is reduced to nearly nothing. To get some quick cash its three members—Reeone, Souko, and Kenny—go dungeon diving. Meanwhile, at the academy several problems start popping up...!

(Source: Novel Updates)

title: Tsugi wa, Motto Kimochi Ii yo
title_japanese: つぎは、もっときもちいいよ

title: Somei Yuki Massage-bon
title_japanese: 染井ユキマッサージ本

title: Bocchama Sakusei no Jikan desu.
title_japanese: 坊ちゃま 搾精の時間です。

title: Yarisaa Gasshuku ni Otoko wa Boku Hitori
title_japanese: ヤリサー合宿に男は僕一人

title: Hangyaku no Soul Eater: Tamashii no Hoshokusha to Shoujo-tachi
title_english: The Revenge of the Soul Eater
title_japanese: 反逆のソウルイーター -魂の捕食者と少女たち-

title: Grand Metal Organs
title_japanese: グランメタルオルガンズ
synopsis:
In a world where electricity equals power, Enlil is an outcast—born without the gift. But his dream of joining the elite Electrical Police Department keeps him going. When he’s finally given a chance, he uncovers a horrifying truth: the powerless aren’t just ignored—they’re erased. Betrayed by the hero he once admired, Enlil is struck down. But death doesn’t end his story. Awakened with dark, unnatural power, Enlil returns—not as a hero, but as a nightmare.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Shinyuu no Musume ni Semarare Komatteimasu
title_english: I'm in Trouble with My Best Friend's Daughter
title_japanese: 親友の娘に迫られ困っています
synopsis:
Kiyoharu's predictable everyday life comes to an abrupt end as suddenly his best friend's daughter shows up, declares that she'll be living with him, and demands he makes her his wife.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Touch Me, Tease Me
synopsis:
Sojin and Jeongho have been friends for years, but she never knew he was keeping a secret...and a big one, at that. But when she hears talk around campus about how her best friend is packing quite the surprise, she just wants one little peek. Or two, or three...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Oshi ga Joushi ni Narimashite
title_english: My Oshi Is Now My Boss
title_japanese: 推しが上司になりまして
synopsis: Office lady Hitomi Nakajo is in a state of grief after her idol, Toma Kiryu, announced his retirement. After all, Hitomi's life purpose consisted of seeing Toma's plays. Just as things seemed hopeless, the very same idol becomes none other than Hitomi's boss?! It turns out Toma is the son of the company head that Hitomi works for. While Toma is amicable with all the female employees, Hitomi just panicks when Toma, her crush, approaches her. Consequently, she takes an indifferent attitude toward Toma. For Hitomi to act so indifferently toward Toma despite his status, intrigues him. Although Toma has received top-notch education as a gifted student, he's had some difficulty getting used to his first job off the stage. His never-back-down attitude leads him to try to solve everything on his own, but Hitomi, who sees through this, fills in the gaps in a subtle way so as not to hurt Toma's pride. Having taken notice, Toma steps up as an even more dependable boss and human being, leading the

title: Ie ni Kaettara, Shiranai Ossan ga Ita
title_japanese: 家に帰ったら、知らないオッサンがいた
synopsis:
There's an random geezer in my living room, but I seem to be the only one out of the loop... A person that everyone in my family seems to know him except me, what are the true colours of this "geezer"!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Nederland no Kissaten
title_japanese: ネーデルラントの喫茶店

title: Penguin Kissa wa Kyou mo Seiten
title_english: The Sky Over Penguin Cafe Is Still Blue
title_japanese: ペンギン喫茶は今日も青天

title: Tsukikake Gohan
synopsis:
Genta Kouno is a former yakuza who was incarcerated in a prison after a certain incident. After serving a sentence of more than ten years, he is released, but the world has completely changed from the past. He was able to find a place to live and a job through the introductions of his probation officer, but he feels uncomfortable with the kindness shown to him by others and tries to become independent as soon as possible. However, it is not easy for a criminal with no family or friends to live a "normal" life... But even Kouno has one thing to look forward to. That is daily "meal time." He makes simple but special dishes with his limited money. While Kouno is living his life day by day, despite the difficulties of life, a hungry boy appears in front of him.

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: A Most Consummate Night
synopsis:
Narin and Danwoo are in an arranged marriage, and on their wedding night, they simply sleep side by side without any intimacy. Narin tries not to think about it, but she can't help wondering if she lacks appeal. One day, while exploring a bustling market full of curious items, she purchases a mysterious incense burner recommended by a vendor. The seller claims that lighting incense in it will instantly enchant whoever smells it. Eager to test it, Narin lights the incense, and Danwoo, inhaling its scent, feels an unfamiliar heat rising within him. Sensing the moment, Narin approaches him, only to be grabbed from behind by someone else. Turning around, she is shocked to see another Danwoo standing there.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Seishun Goumon Romantic☆Tokita
title_japanese: 青春拷問ロマンティック☆トキタ
synopsis:
For someone as boring as Yoshino, being confessed to by Tokita—the girl that everyone in his class has a crush on—is the last thing he was expecting of his high school life, and he does not hesitate to accept the declaration of love. Their relationship does not start off normally, however; Yoshino soon finds himself held captive by Tokita, with her suggesting this is all so they can deepen their bond. Unsure of how he is going to get out of this situation, Yoshino attempts to uncover why his classmate is taking such a drastic course of action to achieve her goal.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Poppo-chan On wo Kaesu
title_japanese: ぽっぽちゃん恩を返す
synopsis:
Riding through some rice fields, Nodoka Tairadori notices a crane entangled in the crops and helps free it. As he watches the majestic bird soar away, he continues on his way, hoping that the favor will eventually be returned, much like an old tale.

Nodoka wakes up late the next day and starts speeding on his bike to school; however, he stops when he sees a peculiar girl acting like a pigeon in the park. Introducing herself as Poppo—the rock dove that Nodoka unknowingly saved from the crane he freed yesterday—the girl declares that she will do her best to repay the boy for his kindness. Confused as to why the crane is not repaying the favor, Nodoka declines Poppo's offer but finds that the girl will not relent in her resolve.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Senya Senshoku Monogatari: Hai Kuni no Hime desu ga Koori no Ouji Denka ga Doumo Dekiai shite Kureteimasu
title_japanese: 千夜千食物語 〜敗国の姫ですが氷の皇子殿下がどうも溺愛してくれています〜

title: Gohan ga Tanoshimi
synopsis:
"So, what shall I eat today?"

Tuna and cheddar cheese, an egg sandwich, and strawberry daifuku toast: breads that brighten the morning. The unforgettable pasta from that neighborhood shop run by real artisans. Washing down sizzling hot dumplings with drinks would be the perfect weekend bliss. A special brunch with a table filled with crepes. Packing a pretty tin with all your favorite snacks. Your favorite cute cup. Buying a new dining table to welcome a new way of living.

Ida Chiaki draws her very first essay manga here, depicting about the many small joys of eating.

(Source: Bungeishunju, translated)

title: Seasons of Lovesome
synopsis:
Life isn't always perfect, but love certainly makes it better. The exciting tale of young love continues a year following the story Seasons of Blossom. Bomi and her university classmate Pureum's lives center around a new place, "Cafe Blossom & Nemone Art Studio," as they navigate the joy and hardships of university and professional life.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Tensei shitemo Kiraware Ouji Datta node Kankei Shuufuku Ganbarimasu.
title_english: Even Though I Was Reincarnated, I Was Still a Hated Prince, So I'll Do My Best to Repair Our Relationship
title_japanese: 転生しても嫌われ王子だったので関係修復頑張ります。

title: Zero Lover
synopsis:
Nonke Chat Boy Ren's LIVE streaming has become a daily routine for the exceptionally beautiful young man, Taka, who makes a fortune working as a host to fund it. To Taka, Ren, viewed through the screen, is more deserving of the title "flower" than the wealthy female customers who generously donate. The sparkling piercings on Ren's nipples and the special streams in bunny outfit are all thanks to Taka's efforts as a long-time viewer. Suddenly, Taka receives a message from the person on the other side of the screen saying "I want to see you." Although Taka is shaken, he decides he cannot miss this opportunity and finally agrees to meet offline. They end up having a physical relationship, leading to a happy ending... or so it seems, as Taka harbors a deeply troubling trauma about love and being loved...?

(Source: GOT, translated)

title: Asuka
synopsis:
Azusa Kino is a sincere and cheerful 16-year-old girl who has become the subject of Takamichi Mishima's upcoming film production and his one-sided attraction. Writing the character in his script as "Asuka," Mishima is tasked with trying to recruit Azusa as the lead actress. However, his pure and innocent image of her is shattered when he comes across Azusa making out with her boyfriend. Heartbroken, Mishima gives up on the project, but a chance encounter with Azusa following the incident makes him wonder if the Asuka from his script is appearing before him.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: The Dang Clan's Swordmaster Heir Just Wants a Normal Life
title_english: The Dang Clan's Swordmaster Heir Just Wants a Normal Life
synopsis:
The Dang clan of Sacheon, once renowned for its poison and hidden weapons, is now on the path to its demise. That is, until Yeonmyeung Dang, an outcast boy of the clan, awakens by recollecting the memories of his past life as the "god of swords" who devoted his life to mastering the sword. Will the boy be able to protect his family and fulfill his dream of living a normal life?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Tenbou Daikaku
synopsis:
Since ancient times, the arcane arts have been used as tools of political strife and weapons of war. Practitioners of these arts, known as spellcasters, sought to ensure the survival of their kind by demonstrating the utility of their powers to the government. However, as the ages passed and the number of spellcasters grew, momentum built within the arcane community to reassess their societal standing. It was in this climate that a nation of spellcasters—commonly known as the Eastern Enchantment—was born. And the governing body of this land came to be called... the Empyreal Cabinet.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Kamen Rider Revice: Ore no Aniki wa Kamen Rider
title_english: Kamen Rider Revice: My Brother Is Kamen Rider
title_japanese: 仮面ライダーリバイス オレの兄貴は仮面ライダー
synopsis:
Set within the universe of Kamen Rider Revice: The Movie, this story follows the events of the short film but from Daiji's perspective. As his brother Ikki and his demon Vice battle the evil Deadman's, Daiji reflects on his brother becoming a Kamen Rider.

[Written by Milo__Ian]

title: Reset Game
synopsis:
When he wakes up, he is in a white room with no exits and red cubes closing in on him… Why?! Who? For what reason? The person who suddenly appears before him, is she an enemy? Even a childhood friend can't be trusted.

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

title: Tsuihou Yuusha no Yuuga na Slow Life: Jiyuu ni Nattara Ore dake no Saiai Tenshi mo Te ni Haitta!
title_japanese: 追放勇者の優雅な生活〈スローライフ〉～自由になったら俺だけの最愛天使も手に入った!～
synopsis:
After suddenly being fired despite serving as a hero for 30 years, Alec was left with nowhere to turn. Orphaned from a young age, he had no parents to rely on, and having been a hero since childhood, he lacked basic common sense. With nowhere else to go, Alec ends up at an unexpected place—a slave market!?

There, he encounters the beautiful and kind-hearted Lilicia...

This is the story of an unwittingly strongest protagonist and an angelic heroine weaving an excessively naughty second life together.

(Source: Square-Enix, translated)

title: Macaron: Idol Yuri Anthology
title_japanese: マカロン　アイドル百合アンソロジー
authors: Ohi, Pikachi|Kumo, Suzume|Key Yang|Yuzuhara, Moke|Shimamizu, Eke|Yamada, Ako|Kanbayashi, Makoto
synopsis: A yuri anthology that depicts the colorful and sparkling love story of idols.

title: 7Fates: Chakho
synopsis:
One day, Zeha wakes up in a hospital with no memory of how he got there. Retracing his steps, he stumbles upon a terrible truth—the city is under attack by otherworldly monsters called the Beom, and at the center of it all is Zeha himself! But thankfully, he does not stand alone. He soon crosses paths with other young men he feels a mysterious connection to. The seven hunters, seemingly brought together by fate, vow to fight to their last breaths, but as the battle grows more and more desperate, they begin to realize the Beom invasion was just the tip of the iceberg... The global K-pop phenomenon BTS gets reimagined as seven brave hunters, but their message of hope remains the same!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: The Star Seekers
synopsis:
In an age when magic idols reign supreme, all Star One has going for them is their incredible work ethic. Though the five members have been giving it their all for the past three years, their lack of magic remains a hopelessly insurmountable wall, and with their fans dwindling, it seems to be the end of the road for their careers—or so they think, when they suddenly manifest the powers they'd been dreaming of! It's finally the big break the group was hoping for, but when a mysterious group of hostile individuals attacks them, Star One realizes just how special they are. The fate of the world seems to rest on their shoulders—whether they want it to or not!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Dark Moon: The Blood Altar
synopsis:
The seven most popular boys at Decelis Academy all share a secret—they're vampires. The brothers have been on the run for years after a mysterious enemy burned their orphanage down, and just when they think they've finally found a bit of respite, the appearance of new student Sooha changes everything! Beginning as a budding friendship after Sooha is saved from a monster attack by the oldest brother, Heli, their lives quickly take a turn for the strange. Why is it that all of them have supernatural abilities and share dreams about a princess and her knights? As Sooha and the boys find themselves inexplicably drawn together, a dark moon rises ominously overhead... And their fated love just might deliver a deadly bite.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Kyodai Kousaten no Shingoukiin-tachi
title_japanese: 巨大交差点の信号機員たち

title: Yoru ni Kakeru Kimi to, Me ni Mienai Koi wo Shita. Series
title_japanese: 夜に駆ける君と、目に見えない恋をした。シリーズ
synopsis:
On an April night in Tokyo, still too early for fireworks, university student Kakeru Mano meets a woman named Koharu Fuyutsuki. She is a beautiful girl who stands out from the crowd, laughs a lot, and exudes a warmth that contrasts sharply with Kakeru's own introversion. But there was something Kakeru didn't know at first—she can't see. Unlike Kakeru, Koharu hasn't given up on anything, even with her blindness. She attends university daily, shows interest in clubs, makes friends—and dreams of launching fireworks one day. Kakeru wonders why, when she can't see them...but maybe it doesn't matter. And maybe he can start moving forward, too, for the girl who's always been by his side.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Toumei na Yoru ni Kakeru Kimi to, Me ni Mienai Koi wo Shita.
title_japanese: 透明な夜に駆ける君と、目に見えない恋をした。
synopsis:
On an April night in Tokyo, still too early for fireworks, university student Kakeru Mano meets a woman named Koharu Fuyutsuki. She is a beautiful girl who stands out from the crowd, laughs a lot, and exudes a warmth that contrasts sharply with Kakeru's own introversion. But there was something Kakeru didn't know at first—she can't see. Unlike Kakeru, Koharu hasn't given up on anything, even with her blindness. She attends university daily, shows interest in clubs, makes friends—and dreams of launching fireworks one day. Kakeru wonders why, when she can't see them...but maybe it doesn't matter. And maybe he can start moving forward, too, for the girl who's always been by his side.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Tsumi to Batsu no Spica
synopsis:
Hatori is a teacher living a typical life at an ordinary high school. One day, he notices that a student of his, Supika Tsumugi, is being bullied. On the way home in the rain, he happens to find himself alone with Tsumugi. Hatori tells her, "I'll do something about it," but Tsumugi holds his hand gently and says with a laugh, "Hatori-sensei is such a liar." A teacher and a student... two people who shouldn't get overly close. A somewhat fascinating girl completely changes Hatori's ordinary life...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Anata no Osoba ni
synopsis:
Ibuki Doi has never forgotten his first love from high school—Mikami Baba, the kind, handsome, and totally straight student council president. Though he was too shy to approach Mikami back then, Ibuki always held his idol near and dear to his heart, wishing him nothing but the best! However, when he learns Mikami is soon to be married to a man, he just can't help it—he's absolutely devastated. He drinks himself into a stupor to drown his sorrow but is surprised to wake up and find...he's back in high school?! Could this be Ibuki's second chance to make things go his way?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Konyaku Haki sareta Koushaku Reijou wa Reijou no Kamen wo Nugisuteru
title_english: The Duke's Daughter Drops Her Engagement and Facade
title_japanese: 婚約破棄された公爵令嬢は令嬢の仮面を脱ぎ捨てる
synopsis:
After being publicly dumped by her fiancé, the Crown Prince Lombard, the duke's daughter Christiana appears unshaken. Despite being educated to be a refined noblewoman and the perfect queen, she has always harbored a different dream—to become Lombard's knight. Now, with the engagement off, she finally has the chance to pursue her true calling.

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Samurai the Western
title_japanese: サムライ・ザ・ウエスタン

title: Trouble County
title_japanese: トラブル・カウンティ

title: Densetsu no Ansatsusha, Tensei shitara Ouke no Aisare Suemusume ni Natte Shimaimashite.
title_japanese: 伝説の暗殺者、転生したら王家の愛され末娘になってしまいまして。
synopsis:
"Babuba, Babubabubabubabu!?" (Am I going to be a baby!?)

Thoth, a legendary assassin in the underworld, was sold by his parents at a young age and was raised strictly as a killer, so he never knew the love of a family he lacked. Suddenly, he saves a cat and dies, but after his death, he's destined for hell for taking countless lives. However, because of one good deed, saving a cat, he's allowed to be reincarnated and is born again as a royal princess, Patricia. Then, God commands him to save the royal family, his family. He was supposed to be reborn as a helpless baby, but his assassin skills haven't faded, and he continues to battle killers one by one.

Gradually, Patricia develops a desire to protect the family that loves her simply because they are family...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Tensei Daimajo no Isekaigurashi: Kodai Rome-fuu Kokka de Hajimeru Mahou Kenkyuu @comic
title_japanese: 転生大魔女の異世界暮らし～古代ローマ風国家で始める魔法研究～@COMIC
synopsis:
"I want to be the wizard of my dreams!"

Zenith, a young girl reincarnated in the ancient Roman-style country of Jupiter, goes to study in the capital with only her momentum. She spreads water magic and floods the classroom. She even falls unconscious after using herself as a test subject, and shoots hot air out of her buttocks in an experiment, and her outlandish behavior never stops. Despite the white eyes of the people around her, she sells shaved ice using ice magic to earn money for her research, and it accidentally becomes a big hit...?

"Amazing! I've made the discovery of the century again!"

Sometimes a catastrophe, sometimes a success(?), sometimes a laugh-out-loud moment!

(Source: To Books, translated)

title: Kozure Batsuichi, Saigo no Koi wa Numa deshita.
title_english: When a Divorced Single Mother Met Her Love Swamp
title_japanese: 子連れバツイチ、最後の恋は沼でした。
synopsis:
A scummy but perfect bachelor soothes the heart of a hardworking single mom!!

Touko is a single mom who spends her days working and raising her kid without relying on anyone. One day, Touko collapses from overwork and is rescued by a male university student who lives in the unit next door. He's a handsome-grade eligible bachelor, but also a bit scummy. For Touko, who hates men, it seems to be the start of a final love...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Tonari no Seki no James-kun
title_japanese: となりの席のジェームズくん
synopsis:
Mutsumi has always struggled to express herself—so much so that she eventually gave up on speaking altogether. But her quiet world is shaken when a foreign transfer student who can't speak Japanese is seated next to her! Communications barriers won't stop this heartwarming story about girl who can't speak and a boy who can't be understood.

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Tera no Tonari ni Oni ga Sumu
Around 40 Otoko no Isekai Tsuuhan Seikatsu
title_japanese: アラフォー男の異世界通販生活
synopsis:
The story of a middle aged man doing whatever he wants with the power of 1-click online shopping!

Kenichi, a single man in his 40s, is transported into another world for no apparent reason. As he tries to escape a dangerous forest teaming with monsters, he realizes he has the power to access to a huge online store.

By using this power to exchange goods he found in this new world for cash, and then buying modern ones off the internet, he was able to quickly create a very popular business. However, his goal is to have a slow and leisurely life. Instead of growing his business even more, he decides to settle down and live off of the power of Jeff Bezos.

The mail order life of a middle aged man in other world begins now!

(Source: MU)

title: We Are Not Dating!!
synopsis:
"Why do you keep asking if we're dating? We're just holding hands, we're not dating!!" It's a slice-of-life romantic comedy about couples who aren't really couples!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Telecaster B-Boy
title_japanese: テレキャスタービーボーイ

title: Senaka wo Azukeru ni wa
synopsis:
When Ionia, proud knight of the realm, loses his life in a violent insurrection, his memories are inherited by a boy born one day after his death. Years later, Leorino Cassieux, fourth son of the Margrave of Brungwurt and blessed with angelic beauty, begins to see Ionia's memories in his dreams. He relives Ionia's ill-fated romance with the king's younger brother, Prince Gravis, as well as his death at the hands of a traitor to the kingdom! But as Leorino tries to make sense of the feeling swelling in his chest, he stumbles too close to the truth of that fateful day. The traitor's identity is revealed, and in a panic, the traitor threatens to end himself and take Leorino with him! As Leorino's life hangs in the balance, he instinctively cries out for his only hope: the love of his past life, Gravis.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Rutile Quartz no Taikan: Slaine to Ou to Eiyuutan
title_english: The Crown of Rutile Quartz: The Boy and the Throne
title_japanese: ルチルクォーツの戴冠 ースレインと王と英雄譚ー
synopsis:
Slaine is a humble, provincial commoner in the small Kingdom of Hasenvalia... Or so he thinks until the day the entire royal family is wiped out in a palace fire and Slaine comes to learn he's really the king's illegitimate son. It now falls on him to succeed the throne. Despite his lack of knowledge and experience, Slaine's natural wits and dedication—plus the support of his aide-de-camp, Monica—allow him to excel against all odds. The future for him and the kingdom looks bright—right up until the eve of his coronation, when the great Empire of Galed declares war against Hasenvalia. Faced with such a frighteningly powerful foe, Slaine is forced to make a choice between fleeing into political exile or resisting invasion to the bitter end. Caught between the conflicting agendas of neighboring nations, this boy from a backwater town must learn how to grow into his crown. Witness the birth of a king!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Press Play, Sami
synopsis:
After her parents died, Sami gave up her life of fortune to live independently, doing odd jobs to make ends meet. When she starts to get involved with two of the most popular boys at her high school, Sami faces twists and turns—Chan is her neighbor, and Pyojun makes her have conflicted feelings. Things get more complicated when she finds out that Chan has feelings for Pyojun as well! With her mom's only keepsake in hand to keep her feet on the ground, Sami navigates obstacles that she wasn't prepared for—and aren't even in her budget!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Ai no Serifu wa Irimasen
title_english: I Don't Need a Script for Love
title_japanese: 愛のセリフはいりません
synopsis:
Popular actor Subaru Yuuki meets up-and-coming model Kudo Kaiho at a gay bar, and the two flirt and have a one-night stand. When Subaru's co-star is injured and forced to step down from the drama they're shooting, who should arrive to replace him but Kudo! Despite their recent fling and the obvious chemistry between them, Subaru must resist Kudo's advances because it's his personal policy not to get involved with cast members. Besides, he's not interested in a real relationship; he prefers to keep things no strings attached. Kudo, however, remains undeterred and makes a suggestion: what if, after the show is over, they become lovers?

(Source: Shu-cream, translated)

title: Chuck and the Girl
title_japanese: チャック・アンド・ザ・ガール
synopsis:
"I remember. A town encircled by the hills and sea. A dreamy time with someone special..." 

My name is Amy. I moved from Los Angeles in America to Yokohama with my mom. Am I lonely? No, not at all. I mean, isn't it cool to live in a foreign country? My grandma is cool too, so it's great! I'm going to live here!

Just a step before adolescence. One girl's experience of simply dazzling light and shadow.

(Source: Two Virgins, translated)

title: Kimi ni Aitai
synopsis:
Two boys and a wingless dragon travel through the snows. What is the purpose of their journey...?

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Oretachi wa Koibito ni Muiteinai
title_english: We're Not Cut Out to Be Lovers
title_japanese: 俺たちは恋人に向いていない
synopsis:
The neighbor of the silent mechanic Kumazawa is Koichi, a streamer who broadcasts about love stories. Koichi is as friendly as a Shiba Inu, and he quickly finds his way into the heart of the tough-looking Kumazawa, unconsciously inviting him.

"Don't test my patience any more."

His unconscious, natural rampage seems likely to burn out the rationality of a sensible person...!?

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Unmei Dakedo Aiirenai
title_japanese: 運命だけどあいいれない
synopsis:
Izumi, the sales ace with excellent grades, good looks and great communication skills, has someone he absolutely cannot lose to. His name is Sendo, the most unlikable man who took the top spot from Izumi.

One day, Izumi is asked by an acquaintance to be a "fake for a gay dating app." He accepts without thinking much about it, but most of the messages he receives are just for sex... Among them, he hits it off with "K," the only one who he gets along with in every way, and they decide to meet in real life.

However, it's none other than Sendo who shows up at the meeting place...!? "I've matched with so many people, I can have high hopes for you too," he says, confidently, and gives him an intense pleasure that melts away. His forceful but sweet fingers reveal a deep heat he didn't even know he had—?

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Gokusaishiki ni wa Doku ga Aru
synopsis:
Atsuto, who was suspended from high school for problematic behavior, decided to stay with his older cousin, Toru, for two weeks. The conditions given for living together were: "Never touch Toru's bangs." However, Toru's eyes, which were hidden as if to reject others, stole his heart in an instant when he was young.

Atsuto wants to know more about this person, he wants to see him. Using the massage as an excuse, Atsuto becomes more and more obsessed with Toru's vicious eroticism, but Toru has a younger "super-brother" who loves his older brother too much, how will Atsuto achieve his goal...!?

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Tsuyogari Omega wa Bokura no Tsugai
title_english: The Feisty Omega and His Twin Mates
title_japanese: つよがりオメガは僕らの番
synopsis:
Natsuo Takahina is an omega who has lived a life pretending to be a beta to protect himself from the predatory alphas around him. Despite his precautions, Natsuo suddenly goes into heat on his way to a job interview and is nearly attacked! Thankfully, a pair of elite alpha twins, Togasaki and Tomoya, manage to save him in the nick of time. However, instead of feeling at ease, Nastuo can't resist the intense attraction he feels around these two brothers—which means that he's found his fated mate! Problem is...which one of them is it?! A sexy BL omegaverse romp where a reluctant omega learns that two lovers are better than one!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Tobioriru Chokuzen no Doukyuusei ni "XXX shiyou!" to Teian shitemita.
title_english: I Suggested to a Classmate Just Before Jumping Off That We Should "Do XXX."
title_japanese: 飛び降りる直前の同級生に「×××しよう！」と提案してみた。
synopsis:
My first love, her name is Kurumi Koga.

She was so much more beautiful and mature than a typical high school student, which attracted a great deal of jealousy and dislike. So much so that she was on the verge of jumping off the rooftop because of all the bullying she received.

So, what can I do to help?

"Why not have sex with me!"
"...You pervert! (yuck!)"
"Maybe so! But are you sure? If you die here, your last memory will be the confession of some pervert you don't even know! It would ruin the mood!"
"...What have you done! You pervert!"
"I have my reasons. Because I love you more than anything in the world! Let's get married!"
"What, ehhhh?"

I will yell out my love until I die, if it will make a place for you in this world!

The most stupid and straightforward protagonist in the history of romantic comedies and the cool, sullen JK will hook up for a romantic comedy with a sugar content of 100%!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Nejire no Ichi wa Kousa shinai
title_japanese: ねじれの位置は交差しない
synopsis:
Mizuki is a high school girl with past trauma involving an older man that kidnapped her. After finding out about her kidnapper's current situation, what will she do...?

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Super Dragon Ball Heroes: Avatars!!
title_japanese: スーパードラゴンボールヒーローズ アバターズ!!
synopsis:
The story follows Beeta Atsui as he goes on countless arcade adventures with his friends to become a Super Dragon Ball Heroes master, all while trying to deal with his everyday life.

(Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)

title: Baby Shachuuhackers
title_japanese: ベイビー車中ハッカーズ
synopsis:
The story follows a high school girl who ends up spending the night in a car with a student in the same school.

(Source: ANN)

title: Ai da toka Fukushuu da toka
Serial Killer Isekai ni Oritatsu: Isekai Battle Royale
title_english: The Serial Killer Is Reincarnated into the Another World. Battle Royale in the Another World
title_japanese: シリアルキラー異世界に降り立つ 異世界バトルロイヤル
synopsis:
In the beginning, the goddess, worried about the excessive number of reincarnated people, declares that the reincarnated people will start killing each other.

(Source: Comic Natalie, translated)

title: Kimama Gohan no Susume: Jikan ga Attara Nani Tsukuru?
title_japanese: 気ままご飯のススメ〜時間があったら何作る?〜
synopsis:
The kinds of dishes that have you thinking, "I'll make that when I have time." When will you make them? When you quit your job!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Meshimazu Onna Atsukai sareta node Konyaku Haki Shitara, Naze ka Tsundere Ouji no Kokoro to Ibukuro Tsukanjaimashita
title_japanese: メシマズ女扱いされたので婚約破棄したら、なぜかツンデレ王子の心と胃袋つかんじゃいました

title: Nigasanai yo? Fukuroji-kun
title_japanese: 逃がさないよ? 袋路くん
synopsis:
Fukuroji, a high school boy who spends his days trying not to stand out, is forced one day to confess his feelings to the class idol as part of a punishment game. However, he accidentally confesses to Tsubaki Sakura, the school's most feared and fierce-looking girl. In an attempt to clear up the misunderstanding, Fukuroji tries to explain things to Tsubaki alone, but she suddenly takes off her school uniform...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Hiyakeato no Musume to Fuufu ni Natta Sono Yoru, Gibo mo Ukkari Haramasete shimau Natsu
title_japanese: 日焼け跡の娘と夫婦になったその夜、義母もうっかり孕ませてしまう夏

title: Kuroki Kemono to Yoru no Hana
synopsis:
Azuma, who is entangled in a violent world and is the candidate for the position of boss of a gang, meets a blind young man, Haruki, during a visit to a flower shop on his way to the previous leader's grave. What begins as mere curiosity evolves into a deep and comforting connection. As their time together increases, Azuma's feelings shift from intrigue to intense desire for Haruki. This leads to a complex entanglement of obsession and passion...

(Source: Kasakura Shuppansha, translated)

title: Dark Mermaid
synopsis:
She just wants to start fresh so she can graduate in peace. She just wants to leave behind all the bad memories—her sleepwalking, the trauma from being bullied at school—all of it. She did everything she could to keep to herself, but the class president, Hae-on, just won't leave her alone. One day, when Seulbi visits the local lake Hae-on recommended, she comes across something she never imagined seeing in her wildest dreams: a wild, dark mermaid.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Gunjin Koushaku wa Migawari Hanayome wo Dekiai suru
title_english: The Duke Adores His Bride's Body Double
title_japanese: 軍人公爵は身代わり花嫁を溺愛する
synopsis:

Back in high school, Hyeon Jiwoo was the ace of the legendary Seongeon High baseball team—and secretly dating his younger teammate, Choi Seonho. But their sweet first love came to an abrupt end when Seonho suddenly left for the U.S., breaking up with Jiwoo without warning.

Fast forward 10 years: Jiwoo has buried all his desires and emotions under a mountain of work, living a quiet, no-nonsense life... until Seonho shows up again. Not as a successful returnee or old flame, but as a temp worker—causing a scene with a bottle of whiskey in hand!

Cue the chaos: awkward reunions, unresolved tension, and one very confused adult trying not to fall all over again. He was Jiwoo's first love, first heartbreak... and possibly, his newest headache.

Is this a second chance at love—or just a second round of disaster?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Kawaii Sensei
synopsis:
Middle school English teacher Mr. Miyata is bummed at the idea of having to supervise the kendo club from spring, all because he's bad at getting along with sporty types. At first, he also thinks that Mr. Samehara, the affiliated high school's P.E. teacher in charge of coaching the kendo club, will be a meathead, too. But, he begins to feel that there might be something going on behind his fleeting, fake smile. Unable to resist the urge to find out what he's hiding, Mr. Miyata takes a leap of faith and...

(Source: Renta!)

title: Ecchi na Oniisan ni Seiheki Baremashita
title_english: A Naughty Guy Finds Out About My Sexual Fetish
title_japanese: エッチなお兄さんに性癖バレました

A young delinquent boy named Rinsei has a secret hobby. He finds pleasure in anal exploration! Due to an unexpected turn of events, he has to start living with a new family. He meets a flamboyant, silver-haired man named Takanari over there, who ends up learning about his secret.

(Source: Booklive)

title: Stalker x Stalker
title_japanese: ストーカー×ストーカー
synopsis:
Getta and Taiyou, two university students, were close friends. One day, it is revealed that Taiyou has been stalking Getta. However, Getta has also been stalking Taiyou, collecting his baby teeth and so forth... A reciprocal love-suspense(?) comedy about two stalkers stalking each other!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: I'm the Tutor of the Twin Highnesses
title_english: I'm the Tutor of the Twin Highnesses
synopsis:
Sara Popo was a highly regarded elementary school teacher in her past life. Reborn into a new world, she becomes a sought-after tutor for aristocratic children. Her unique methods quickly earn her praise—and the emperor's attention. He asks Sara to tutor his notorious twin siblings, infamous for their wild pranks. While a daunting challenge, she can't refuse the emperor's generous offer.

Winning over the twins might be her specialty, but can she handle the emperor's irresistible charm too?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: I Don't Wanna Work!
synopsis:
Rotieh Panderion has been entrusted with an important task: She must create "Nectar," an immortality-granting elixir. In return, she will be granted a position among the world's deities. After toiling away for a hundred lifetimes, she's had enough hard work and decides to go on strike! But her latest reincarnation is a poor, illegitimate princess accused of attempted murder. Now, Rotieh must clear her name and restore her lost wealth, but that's easier said than done when she doesn't wanna work!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: DT ga Dosukebe Gal ni Fella Nuki Sakusei Namahame Sex de Moteasobareru.

title: Mushi Musume
synopsis:
In a world where humans and insects are in conflict with each other, Mashiro heads for the mountains to eradicate the insectoid menace. There, he runs into a mysterious girl named Yuren, who lives with her mother on this hazardous hill riddled with bugs. Mashiro is shocked by this fact, but, perhaps, there is more to Yuren than meets the eye...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Mushi Musume
synopsis:
In a world where humans and insects are in conflict with each other, Mashiro heads for the mountains to eradicate the insectoid menace. There, he runs into a mysterious girl named Yuren, who lives with her mother on this hazardous hill riddled with bugs. Mashiro is shocked by this fact, but, perhaps, there is more to Yuren than meets the eye...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Tokyo Crater no Akari
title_japanese: 東京クレーターのアカリ
synopsis:
25 years ago, a meteor struck Tokyo, creating a flooded crater and messing up the ecosystem. Now, the city's overrun with a weird virus and mutant creatures. Here comes Akari, a badass local cop who zips around on her trusty bike, Chrome, keeping the peace and protecting the citizens in this crazy submerged Tokyo.

(Source: MU)

Included one-shot:
Volume 2: Sky Parking

title: Eden
synopsis:
The sci-fi fantasy series Eden is set thousands of years in the future, where a city known as "Eden 3" is inhabited solely by robots whose former masters vanished a long time ago. On a routine assignment, two farming robots accidentally awaken a human baby girl from stasis, questioning all they were taught to believe—that humans were nothing more than a forbidden ancient myth. Together, the two robots secretly raise the child in a safe haven outside Eden.

(Source: Netflix, edited)

title: Shinkon Quest: Maou no Musume wa Majime Yuusha wo Otoshitai♡
title_english: The Newlywed Quest: The Demon King's Daughter Wants to Bed the Diligent Hero
title_japanese: シンコンクエスト 魔王の娘は真面目勇者を堕としたい♡
synopsis:
A hero who defeated an evil demon king—his descendant, Harold. In this peaceful era, Harold has become a convenient handyman for the townsfolk.

One day, a sacred book predicting the world's destruction is discovered. The condition to avert this catastrophe is... "You must complete the 'Shinkon Quest' with the demon king's daughter." Thus begins Harold's unexpected married life with Yona, the demon king's daughter. While Harold feels bewildered, Yona expertly handles household chores and sweetly pampers him when he's tired. However, she harbors a secret... 

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kakekoi Romanesque: Taishou Akuyaku Reijou to Saikyou Mafia
title_japanese: 賭恋ロマネスク~大正悪役令嬢と最狂マフィア
synopsis:
"Let me have fun with you, until I break you into little pieces..."

What will be the fate of the villianess, as death hangs in the balance? With a gun and betting on her life, will it capture this very dangerous man's attention?!

(Source: WWWave Corporation)

title: Watashi ni Yasashii Yoru
synopsis: Ako starts living with her gay brother, Nobuo.

title: Seisui Kakumei: Omorashi Seijo wa Sono Seisui de Musou suru
title_japanese: 聖水革命 ～おもらし聖女はその聖水で無双する～
synopsis:
"Basically, the holy water is pee, right...?!"

Since she dropped out of school because she peed her pants, Suzuna has been helping her older sister, a manga artist, by working as her assistant. One day, after staying up all night, Suzuna loses her footing and falls down the stairs... 

Suzuna thought she was dead, but she finds herself reincarnated as the saintess in her sister's serialized series, "The Saintess's Holy Water is a Panacea and Unrivaled in Another World"...!?

An isekai tale of peerless pee begins!!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Unmei no Makimodoshi
synopsis:
Meet the Spacetime Strategic Enforcement Unit, an organization dedicated to rescuing people from terrible destinies and tragic deaths. The unit's nickname, "The Fate Rewinders," is well earned—armed with Retry Eyes, micro–time machines implanted in their eye sockets, agents of the SSEU are equipped to stick around until they solve the case, whether that means trying once, twice, or ten thousand times!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Shadow Assassins World: Kage wa Usui kedo, Saikyou Ninja Yattemasu
title_japanese: シャドウ・アサシンズ・ワールド～影は薄いけど、最強忍者やってます～

title: Innu
synopsis:
Asakusa's a big, scary place for a little pug all on his own. Or so high school student Sally thinks when she finds the pup abandoned by the Sumida river and gives him a home and a name: Innu. But there's more to this pupper than meets the eye. He's a talking dog. A fighting dog. A no-nonsense, hard-boiled son-of-a-gun. If he knows what's good for him, he'll be a good boy and lay low, but that's gonna be hard when his new owner's the daughter of a yakuza! This doggone DOGGO's in for a rough time in this hilarious, action-packed manga about the yakuza and the pug who joins them.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Kyuuketsuki Sakka, VRMMORPG wo Play suru. @comic
title_japanese: 吸血鬼作家、VRMMORPGをプレイする。@COMIC
synopsis:
Haruto Renge, a novelist who has lived since the Kamakura period, is a vampire with an aversion to blood. Due to his catastrophic lack of technological skills, he has been leading a super analog lifestyle. However, during a meeting one day, his editor suggests that he write his next manuscript within a cutting-edge VRMMO game. With both excitement and anxiety, he steps into this new world, only to be greeted by sunlight for the first time in hundreds of years and a variety of delicious foods that he could never enjoy in reality. He quickly becomes enthralled with the game...

"Wait, what? My brainwaves aren't human—so I'm being treated like an NPC? A cardiac arrest and an ambulance is being called? Whoa, whoa, hold on a second!"

This gentle vampire, a total newbie gamer, starts hopping between the game and the real world. Unknowingly, he begins to drag those around him into a slapstick VRMMORPG adventure!

(Source: TO Books, translated)

title: Because of You
synopsis:
Se Woong became middle-aged without any proper confession to his first love. In his dried up life, Yoo Il, who is brightness and youth himself, appears. But, he is the son of his friend... and that friend of his was Se Woong's first love.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Dungeon Haishin wo Kiriwasureta Yuumei Haishinsha wo Tasuketara, Densetsu no Tansakusha toshite Bazuri Hajimeta: Inkya no Ore, Nazo Skill dato Omotteita "Rule Mushi" de Ukkari Musou
title_japanese: ダンジョン配信を切り忘れた有名配信者を助けたら、伝説の探索者としてバズりはじめた ～陰キャの俺、謎󠄀スキルだと思っていた《ルール無視》でうっかり無双～
synopsis:
Tsukushi Kirishima is a born loser, a second year high school student who is mocked even by his underclassmen. He has been granted a mystery skill called "Ignore Rules," but he doesn't know how to use it, so he struggles in obscurity both as a student and an explorer. One day in a dungeon, he encounters the famous streamer Miru Ayatsuki. Miru's goal is to film the "emergency monster" that has suddenly appeared in the dungeon, but its strength poses an uphill battle and he finds herself in mortal danger! The same moment Tsukushi intervenes and comes to her rescue, the mystery skill "Ignore Rules" activates...

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Takumi na Kiss de Juchuu Shite
synopsis:
Hirose, the heir to a large company, wanted to test his abilities, so he joined a cosmetics company mid-career. However, unlike his ambitions, he was running in circles and found himself struggling.

Then one day, at a work site, he reunites with Adachi, his high school classmate and club friend. Adachi, now a young vice president of a construction company, was still perfect, charismatic, and deeply trusted by his subordinates.

Hirose had hated Adachi since the old days. Now that Adachi has become his business partner, Hirose tries to assert his superiority somehow, but... "How is this guy so good at everything?!"

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Neko ni Matatabi Ore ni wa Anata
title_japanese: 猫にまたたび俺にはあなた
synopsis:
One night, Mahiru, a veterinarian, comes home late to find his neighbor, Keito, passed out at his front door. Mahiru took him into his apartment to give him a place to sleep. Mahiru, who was sleeping soundly, felt something strange and woke up only to find Keito blowing him! What's more, Keito, while still half-asleep, tries to insert Mahiru's cock into his ass, repeatedly saying "I love you," probably mistaking Mahiru for someone else, but has trouble putting it in. Mahiru, however, who can no longer stand the stimulation starts doing it with him...!

(Source: CLLENN)

title: Jijii no Koi
synopsis:
"I will never give up on you" he said as he handed him his second button during the graduation ceremony. Since then, half a century has passed. The married Takuro from a well to do family is still madly in love with the still single novelist Genta. A charming and lovely 75 x 75 senior comedy.

(Source: Libre, translated)

Included one-shots:
Volume 1: Oton to Tecchan, Oniichan to Melorina, Saitou-kun wa Mendokusai

title: Sui mo Amai mo
synopsis:
Kiyoshi, a former firefighter, and Shuji, a former chef at a three-star restaurant, are a couple who have been dating since they were young and are finally celebrating their 30th anniversary. They have already retired and are enjoying this time, spending happy days taking care of each other. The two, who have reached old age, taste delicious things, and sometimes reminisce about past memories.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Sazanami-chou to Hazama no Ko
title_english: Children Between the Sky and the Sea
title_japanese: さざなみ町とはざまの子
synopsis:
Though it's her first time in Sazanami-chou, it somehow feels familiar. Yui has decided to work at an isolated store in the town. What she discovers in this town that smells of the sea is...

(Source: East Press, translated)

title: Dokudoku
synopsis:
Freshman-year literature university student Yoshida moves into his new apartment next to an arts student from the same school. In his desire to start his life anew, what might a chance encounter with them bring?

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Tonari no Seki no Yankee Shimizu-san ga Kami wo Kuroku Sometekita
title_english: The Delinquent Girl Beside Me Suddenly Dyed Her Hair Black
title_japanese: 隣の席のヤンキー清水さんが髪を黒く染めてきた
synopsis:
Why is the toughest girl in school trying to be my type?! "My type? A girl with long black hair who carries herself well."

That's what I told my friends during a casual conversation about romance. The very next day, Shimizu—the blonde delinquent who sits next to me—suddenly shows up with her hair dyed black. From then on, every time I mention my ideal girl, she starts doing things she normally wouldn't—showing up to cooking class (which she used to always skip), packing me homemade lunches, etc.

This is the heartwarming slice-of-life high school rom-com about the awkward advances of the school's most intimidating delinquent girl.

(Source: One Peace Books)

title: Uza Gal Tanabe-san wa Kyou mo Uza Karamu
title_japanese: うざギャル田辺さんは今日もウザ絡む

2-3. Hatsukoi (First Love)
