5. Aiyoku no Amity (Passionate Amity)
6. Renai Kanjou (Being in Love)
7. Sonatine
8. Aoi Yuuwaku (Blue Temptation)
9. Aiyoku no Amity: After (Passionate Amity: After)

title: Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka Shouhenshuu
title_english: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? Minor Myths and Legends
title_japanese: ダンジョンに出会いを求めるのは間違っているだろうか 掌編集
synopsis:
The city of Orario is a vast metropolis with an underground labyrinth known as the Dungeon. There, adventurers put everything on the line to keep the monsters at bay and explore the unknown! This is where heroes are made and legends are born. Smaller stories can also be found here, and a surprising number of them revolve around a young boy who came to the Labyrinth City chasing his dreams until he met a certain goddess...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Tefuda ga Oome no Victoria
title_japanese: 手札が多めのビクトリア
synopsis:
Victoria's peaceful, everyday existence has begun! Ever since she retired from the espionage world, she's been living as a civilian, just like she always dreamed. But her past as a spy is hard to run from- even though she turned her back on danger, it can't stop finding her! So when she meets Nonna, a young girl totally on her own in the world, Victoria has to decide what's truly important to her...peace or her new friend?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: A Small Change: Finding the Joy in Everyday Things
title_english: A Small Change: Finding the Joy in Everyday Things
title_japanese: 아주 약간의 변화: 머리 묶는 법 열두 가지
synopsis:
A young woman is out in the world for the first time, living on her own. When she decides to tie up her hair one day, she embarks on a journey of small, almost imperceptible but important changes. Relationships develop, problems emerge and decisions are made. As the year progresses and she navigates the ins and outs of daily life, she also discovers new ways of styling her hair. Because nothing stays the same—and sometimes, changing your hairstyle can have a deep impact on your life.

(Source: Tuttle Publishing)

title: Helena Yu Dayelang Xiansheng
title_english: Helena and Mr. Big Bad Wolf
synopsis:
Helena has always found her strength through stories. When her father left and didn't come home one night, and when Arthur, her only brother, got into an accident... reading and creating stories was what kept Helena going. By a stroke of luck, she attends an autograph signing of her favorite author, Mr. Big Bad Wolf, and the two grow closer, bonding over their shared love for storybooks. The cold, reserved man with a wolf head is shrouded in mystery, but perhaps he has a gentler side only Helena can see...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Ryuu ga Ita Machi
synopsis: Michiko Nekoyama, who has vowed to put aside all childish things, has an unforgettable summer with Kirin Tooyama.

title: Danshi Kinsei Game Sekai de Ore ga Yarubeki Yuiitsu no Koto: Yuri no Aida ni Hasamaru Otoko toshite Tensei shiteshimaimashita
title_english: The Only Thing I'd Do in a No-Boys-Allowed Game World: Reincarnated as a Yuri Ship-Sinker
title_japanese: 男子禁制ゲーム世界で俺がやるべき唯一のこと 百合の間に挟まる男として転生してしまいました
synopsis:
A dream-come-true scenario quickly becomes a nightmare when a yuri fanboy discovers that he's been reincarnated into one of his favorite yuri games—as Hiiro, an annoying male character whose only purpose is to get between the heroines. Realizing that he's destined for ruin in a world where men are at the bottom of the pecking order, Hiiro scrambles to get stronger and avert his fate. But his desperate efforts end up making the game's heroines—Princess Lapis, Snow the maid, and the protagonist Sakura—fall for him instead of one another! At this rate, he'll be killed for coming between them! Can Hiiro get the girls interested in one another before it's too late?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Raw Blue no Hyouhon
synopsis:
The heart of every living being hardens and remains after the body dies. One day, the traveling merchant Faris found a girl who had collapsed in the desert and took her under his care. The girl, who introduced herself as Eva, was told by Faris about their current location, the oasis city Aurof, and he took her to the town to show her around. As they walked through the merchant city lined with villas, Eva gradually began to open up to Faris and confessed, "I ran away from that house." Thus begins the story of a girl carrying a forbidden secret.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Bug Train
synopsis:
This place is within the game world. We are NPCs. The day that we become aware of this, we become a "bug." If Operators catch NPCs that become bugs, they become "patched." If you wish to survive, follow the tracks that are hidden in the field and get onto that train!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Your Grace, Please Fail for Once!
title_english: Your Grace, Please Fail for Once!
synopsis:
Nellie Pepper, land steward to the paranoid psycho Duke Lionel Alterwood, dies from overwork after three years of torture. As she closes her eyes, her final wish is to get revenge. Miraculously, she soon wakes up on her first day of work again! Ready to sabotage her cruel boss, she embarks on all sorts of wicked plans. However, every attempt hilariously backfires, and she ends up improving the duchy instead! Will Nellie be able to enact her revenge and finally make the duke fail for once?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Boku wa, Kimi no Nan desu ka
title_japanese: ボクは、キミの何ですか
synopsis:
Ibuki's mad that her boyfriend's flirting with another girl, but she's also ranting about it in bed with another guy. She acts like it doesn't matter since she loves her boyfriend the most, but how loved is she really?

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Hokenshitsu no Kamisama wa Hito no Mono ga Hoshii
title_japanese: 保健室の神様は人のモノがほしい

title: The Ki Sisters
synopsis:
In the shadowy heart of Seoul near Cheonggyecheon Stream lies a sinister mansion whose porch only fools would dare tread. Welcome... to the house of the Ki sisters: Jang-nyeo, Sal-gyo, Jae-rim, and Jenny. Homeschooled and raised in isolation, the four sisters and their inadvertently menacing demeanor may strike terror into the faint-hearted, but don't judge a book by its cover: the youngest, Jenny Ki, is a scary—I mean, starry-eyed hopeless romantic who's out to find love! The problem is... everything she knows about love is from romance novels. Will Jenny put the Ki in "kiss" or "kill?"

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Alice to Therese no Maboroshi Koujou
title_japanese: アリスとテレスのまぼろし工場
synopsis:
Masamune, a third-year middle school student, lives in a town where time has halted for him following an explosion at a steel mill. As he spends his days depressed and forbidden to change, he is suddenly guided by his mysterious classmate, Mutsumi, into the fifth blast furnace of the steelworks. There, they encounter a wild, wolf-like girl who cannot speak. The meeting between Masamune and the two girls marks the beginning of the disruption of the world's balance. What future awaits the unstoppable impulse of love? 

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Cang Lan Jue
synopsis:
According to legend, in order to obtain terrible power, Dongfang Qing Cang of the Moon Tribe became an emotionless monster. He killed his father, seized the position of Moon Supreme and led an army of 100,000 Moon Tribe soldiers on a path of devastation. Shuiyuntian (the immortal fairy realm), Cangyan Sea (the Moon Tribe), and Yunmeng Lake (the mortal world) were in grave danger.

To save the world and stop Dongfang Qing Cang and his army, the first God of War of Shuiyuntian destroyed her primordial spirit. Dongfang Qing Cang's army and primordial spirit were sealed and his body was locked away in Haotian Tower under the immortal bonds of the Haotian Matrix. However, if his primordial spirit was restored and Dongfang Qing Cang were to break free from his tower, the world would be in danger once more. Legend says that only the Goddess of Xishan can prevent this catastrophe, but she vanished without a trace.

30,000 years after the first God of War's sacrifice, there was a disturbance in

title: Merry Witches' Life: Berlebagille no 3-nin Miboujin
title_english: Merry Witches' Life: The Three Bereaved Women of Berlebagille
title_japanese: メリー・ウィッチーズ・ライフ ～ベルルバジルの3人の未亡人～
synopsis:
Zoe is a clumsy witch who sets off on a journey in search of freedom from the Isle of Wizards. After arriving in the unknown village, Zoe marries her fated partner—but tragically loses him in an accident shortly after the marriage. Grief-stricken, Zoe struggles to find meaning in her life without him until she encounters Eliza, a ladybug who has also recently lost her husband. Soon after that, Zoe finds out that her friend, Sisyka, has been widowed too.

United by their circumstances, the three women begin their journey of witch training.

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Nariyuki de Konyaku wo Moushikonda Yowaki Binbou Reijou desu ga, Nazeka Jiki Koushaku-sama ni Dekiai sarete Torawareteimasu @comic
title_english: Trapped By His Love: The Duke's Unexpected Bride
title_japanese: 成り行きで婚約を申し込んだ弱気貧乏令嬢ですが、何故か次期公爵様に溺愛されて囚われています@COMIC
synopsis:
When her engagement to her childhood bully is announced, Alice Coleman—the gentle-hearted and serious daughter of an impoverished noble family—is utterly aghast. In a desperate bid to find someone to stand in as an alternate fiancé, she blurts out a proposal... to the wealthy, high ranking son of a Duke, Arthur Grindelbard.

And to her shock, he accepts.

Despite the strange beginning of their engagement, Arthur is an adoring fiancé to Alice, eager to spoil her with luxurious gifts and earn her affection. But behind his charming smile and solicitous attention lies a deeper intent and focus, hints of a man who has had his eye upon Alice for far longer than he cares to admit...

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Souai Ero-ki
synopsis:
While Kou is becoming frustrated with Kishi for being a little too gentle with him, Satoshi and Eishou are having trouble finding a way to walk the same path together in the future. In the meanwhile, Tarou and Mitsuru are rapidly becoming more and more physically compatible, however, their lack of verbal communication may prove to be detrimental. Just where will these boys' path lead them...?! Find out in this exciting conclusion of Pure Love's Sexy Time.

(Source: Digital Manga Publishing)

title: Runaway Darling
synopsis:
Darling is a carefree, cheerful, romantic, and flirtatious gentleman. The moment he appears, the fate of the underworld is set into rapid motion...! A fact its residents know, fear, and dread! Get captivated by this brilliant action-drama starring the underworld's top escape artist!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Ichi ka Bachi ka
synopsis:
Wakatsu Mameda is a second-year student at Ouka High School and the manager of the basketball club's fifth-string team. Despite his low-profile role, he harbors a secret: he is the son of the club's head coach, Jinichi Shirakami—a fact he desperately hides. When his talent is discovered by genius player Hajime Akuro, the duo teams up to challenge Jinichi's ironclad regime and revolutionize high school basketball!

(Source: MU)

title: I Became a Ruined Character in a Dark Fantasy
title_english: I Became a Ruined Character in a Dark Fantasy
synopsis:
Ian Hope was once a normal gamer who downloaded the latest dark fantasy game, Aquilonia. The problem is he downloaded it illegally, which he believes is why he was transported into the game's world! Now, as his game character, he has to survive this cutthroat place full of corruption and betrayal. But that won't be easy since his character has already been ruined with skills that won't help him as the game progresses toward an apocalypse. Will he survive this dark fantasy? Or is all hope lost?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Lord Hero of House Remes
synopsis:
No one understands why local lowlife Lord Aden Remes suddenly acts like the upright knight he was meant to be. The truth is, Aden's been possessed by Aden Albireo, the empire's hero who died after defeating the villainous Underlord and facing betrayal by his closest friends. Now, Aden's out to get revenge on those who killed him with the help of a few new allies and none other than the Underlord himself! Can Aden and his gang buckle down and power up? Or is the lord hero fated to fail once more?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Subscribed to GodTube
synopsis:
Living by selling information about monsters, Maeng Siwoo is considered completely useless in the hunter industry without any standout qualities. However, he fiercely battles to provide for his sick younger sister. One fateful day, he is gifted a mysterious smartphone by a transcendent being within a dungeon, appointing him as the channel manager for such beings. The world is rife with the ongoing turmoil between humans and demons. After capturing Georgios, the supreme commander of the human army, the demon army enlists a torture professional to extract human army's critical secrets, but...!?

title: The Password Is 002!
synopsis:
The night before Sujeong plans to confess her feelings for Dojin, she runs into him on the street and is devastated to find out that he doesn't even know her name. Too afraid to face him in class the next day, Sujeong hides in the storage locker, where she meets Dojin's younger brother Jaeyun. With Jaeyun's help, will she able to win Dojin's heart?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Incognito Princess
synopsis:
When a woman dies prematurely, a goddess allows her to choose a new world to reincarnate into. Without hesitation, she picks the web novel Infinite Splash—home to her beloved favorite character, Kylo Grey. In a stroke of irony, she becomes the stunningly beautiful but utterly evil Princess Agnes Saint, who obsesses over the male lead, Raymond Spencer, and detests Kylo for being a commoner.

In the original story, Kylo's bitter rivalry with Raymond and deep insecurities made him Agnes' sworn enemy. Yet fans ultimately wept at his death, as his sacrifice was devastatingly selfless. The new Agnes, however, could not care less about the established plot. All she wants is a front-row seat to Kylo's life and to prevent his senseless death. But to live her fangirl dreams, she must drop her fixation on Raymond, convince everyone that she has changed, and somehow earn Kylo's trust.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Divorcing the Emperor
title_japanese: 결혼도 안 했는데 무슨 이혼인가요, 폐하
synopsis:
Ten years after the end of the territorial war that engulfed half the continent, a document with a seal of pure gold arrives at the estate of the war hero, Isaac Meserin. It's a divorce decree from the emperor addressed to his only daughter, Clicia Meserin, who isn't even married yet. As if the sudden divorce wasn't enough to drive her mad, she is ordered to be exiled for ten years according to imperial regulations!

"Is everyone crazy? I haven't even gotten married yet! What do you mean divorce!!!"

She can't let this slide, so she decides to go to the capital to set things straight! However, contrary to her confident initial plans, the situation keeps getting more complicated.

Clicia barely arrives on time, but she is speechless. Not because the bank was closed or her black card was blocked. But because of the wanted posters plastered on both sides of the bank's main entrance—dozens of them.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Be RF Savvy or Die
synopsis:
What could make a romance fantasy superfan happier than getting pulled into a fantasy world? But Daline Este's dreams of being the protagonist in her story come crashing down when reality sinks in. She hasn't been pulled into one of her favorite novels like she dreamed—instead, she's landed in a world on the cusp of crisis as several novels tangle together and threaten to tear it apart. Now, Daline must use her expertise to set the stories straight before her happy ending goes up in flames.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: I'm Here to Destroy
synopsis:
Elariah was born as the almighty god of plants, but she was falsely accused of being an evil deity that would destroy the world and imprisoned in an isolation cell for two hundred years. In that time, she became addicted to melodramas and novels while locked in her room, so she escaped to the human world and possessed Roselita Derman, a dying marquess. She thought that human life would be easy like in dramas and novels, but things didn't go according to plan. Huh, Roselita didn't commit suicide by drinking poison!? To clear the name of Roselita, who was miserable and unjustly accused, Elariah must find out the truth, even if it means breaking things here and there.

"Erk! Who are you, really?!"
"Me? I'm the hammer fairy who protects love and justice."

And she's going to have a fateful love that she has only seen in dramas and novels!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: The Killer Whale's Comfort Penguin
synopsis:
Lia, a penguin-turned-human, hides her anthropomorphic self from her dad for fear of abandonment and hatred. Fleeing her home, she's discovered by Souradel—a killer whale anthro with a thing for penguins. His obsession with her fluffy belly leads to wild misunderstandings, mistaken kisses, and hilariously tense encounters. Now, Lia must dodge his affections while keeping her identity secret.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Obsessive Male Lead's Dad Is Being Hit On
synopsis:
Seungyeon, a frustrated writer, wakes up one day in the body of the father of a character from a BL novel written by his sister. Woojin, who saved his life from imminent danger, is the father of the protagonist's love interest. Seungyeon discovers that he and Woojin are the parents of the main BL characters.

Seungyeon tries to follow the original plot, but soon realizes something is wrong. His relationship with Woojin becomes increasingly intimate and different from what he expected. Will Seungyeon be able to return to his normal life, or will he be trapped in his sister's romance forever?

(Source: MU)

title: I Possessed a Villainess, but I Wanna Raise Cats!
title_english: I Possessed a Villainess, but I Wanna Raise Cats!
synopsis:
Seo Eunsu was only looking for her lost cat when she was hit by a truck. The next thing she knows, she's in the body of Lewayne Rarsel, a villainess from a novel! She's the cruel paramour of the emperor and has nothing but contempt for therianthropes, people with animal forms. Now, the only way to avoid her fate of becoming the emperor's consort is to marry Duke Dimitri de Blua, a feline therian. But can the duke forget her notorious reputation and realize that Lewayne just wants to raise cats?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: I Became the Emperor's Cat
synopsis:
After a sudden car accident, I woke up to find myself reincarnated as a cat in a novel. It's absurd enough to be reincarnated into a book I only read three chapters of, with no knowledge of the rest of the story, but to become a cat?! Still, this cat might be a beastman. Before I lose my life at the hands of the ruthless emperor, I'll do whatever it takes to become human! But this emperor, known as a cold-hearted tyrant, is surprisingly kind to me, a mere cat.

The story of a cat—no, a person turned into a cat—navigating the imperial palace while eating garlic and mugwort!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Do You Need Salvation?
synopsis:
The main character was born with the ability to interfere with other people's dreams. I thought I would live a life of pleasure as the daughter of the beloved count in this life...

"I think it will be difficult for Miss Miena to survive this winter."

Continuing my previous life, this time I am living a life with a time limit. To make matters worse, she squandered the family fortune to save me and the family was on the verge of ruin.

"Even if you go, you have to pay off the family wealth and debts you wasted because of me before you leave!" I simply tried to spend the rest of my life working hard, using my skills to gather information and accumulate wealth...

"Who's there?"
"Angel... It seems a little..."
"Something fierce entered my dream without fear."

I think I touched dreams I shouldn't have touched.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: My Misraised Husband
synopsis:
Leverticia Celsiear, a wisecracking noblewoman-turned-knight is used to taking care of herself and her younger brother. But she never expected to add the eight-year-old duke, Caius Baltail, to her protection list—until the emperor arranged their marriage. Meanwhile, she's also got an eye on her nemesis, rival knight Anthody Everett, is tracking down the truth about her parents' death, struggling to get out of debt, and even gets stuck in a time-distorted dimension! Whew! Good luck Leverticia!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Adopted by My Enemy
synopsis:
My nineteen years of life were taken advantage of by a fake family. With the vow to seek revenge still fresh in my mind, I chose to live my life again. Yet why have I returned to the night I was kidnapped from a burning castle?

"Hwelp me! Hwelp me! The willian ish twaking Maedie!"

My savior ended up being the enemy's son?! For days and nights I followed him to the enemy's castle, but upon arrival, a warm welcome—"Ack! Father! Second Brother's picked up another living thing!"—wasn't what awaited me.

"You're my daughter, do whatever you want."
"Brother is here, it's okay. No one can touch you. No one."
"Liana, my dear child."
"Why shouldn't you marry your brother?"

They've all gone crazy...

(Source: Malang, translated)

title: I Found Myself a Crazy Stepdad!
title_english: I Found Myself a Crazy Stepdad!
synopsis:
"No... Mama, don't die."

It's already my 10th life. I've seen my mama's death nine times, but I still can't get used to it. Thud. Thud. I heard footsteps in the distance and hurriedly drew a magic circle. Then, I finally succeeded. I'm finally free from the emperor who abused my mama and me!

"Who are you?" A handsome man as if made in the image of God. It was exactly whom I was looking for: the Grand Duke Avelon.

"I made it in time. The search is over. My papa candidate!"
"...What...? Papa candidate?"
"Yes! Please take care of my mama and me!"

It didn't matter that he looked at me as if it was absurd. He's the one I picked to be my papa.

"If you do, I'll make you emperor!"
"Ha?"
"Because I'm strong!"

You're going to need me. So take care of us!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: I Quit Being the Male Lead's Rival
synopsis:
On a day as usual as any other, Anabelle remembers memories of her previous life. She has been reincarnated as the second most popular character in a novel. She also did all kinds of bad things to the male lead, and in the end, she ended up in prison! To avert this fate, Anabelle begins to save Ian, the male protagonist, from danger. However, for some reason, Ian suddenly becomes obsessed.

"Why do you not talk harshly to me these days? Curse me... Please."

This man seems a little strange!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: We Hate the Male Lead
synopsis:
Baron Pelles is a pitiful, penniless noble, and it appears that his only daughter, Luna, is a wretched villainess who tarnishes their already poor reputation. Luna obsesses over her childhood friend, Fersen Rodrien, and all the other noble ladies sympathize with his tender-hearted fiancée, Seira Granada, to the point of bullying and physically harming Luna and her servants.

When Luna regains memories of a novel from her past life, she realizes death is near—and Fersen is to blame. Fersen is charming only on the surface; in reality, he is delusional and suffocatingly obsessive, and Luna truly loathes him. Out of frustration, she swears that even the empire's infamous cold-hearted psychopath and Fersen's enemy, Antes Vincent, would be a better match for her. Though determined to pull her family out of poverty and sever ties with the main leads, Luna soon regrets her words—because Antes might just take them seriously.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: I Got Divorced and Abandoned My Family
synopsis:
"Even if it's my child, I can still not love them."

The day she terminated the five-year-long contracted marriage and filled out the divorce papers, Hilia left Caligo without a second thought—leaving the by-product of the contracted marriage, their child, with him. Hilia Halos was a woman who was colder, more selfish, and more wicked than anyone else.

"Here's the alimony. Since I don't need this anymore, I'll hand it over to you." That was what he thought, until he ceded the baronial estate that she so coveted and disappeared.

Hilia was sure she would be indifferent—about leaving the child, and about abandoning the man who brought her excitement. "Mother, you don't, hab to, lub, Riche. Riche gonna, only come, sometime. Riche will, lub you more..." She was actually indifferent. She would have been in the future, as well. If only the dirt-covered child didn't just appear out of nowhere after four years and told her such a thing. "So...!" Tears dripped down the child's cheeks. Hil

title: Husband Replacement
synopsis:
Asili thought she and her husband were in love, but he abused her and she died giving birth to a child. Before she could take revenge on him, she opened her eyes and found herself in a pre-marriage phase with him. She felt like she was going to live that hellish life again, so she looked for a replacement husband for her. Asili went straight to visit Duke Esperad Kamedeschi, who was rumored to have been afflicted by a curse after his fiancée died under mysterious circumstances.

"I'm Asili, I would like to ask Your Grace to marry me."
"Does what you said mean that you wish to die now?"
"Do you think the misfortune that has befallen me is a joke?"

Asili knows that he will become emperor, so she tries to win his heart. Moreover, she has finally replaced her husband, and yet he is still arguing with her. Will Asili be able to take revenge across time and space and succeed in replacing her husband?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: This Time I'll Change My Husband
synopsis:
"I have found someone I love. So please break off your engagement, young lady."
"Huh? Your real name is..."

One day, I entered the novel "River of Forgetting" and lived quietly as a duke's daughter. I discovered that my fiancé was an ordinary person who was a main character. According to the original work, his love interest is a female protagonist and a saint, and I was engaged to a male lead... A supporting character is destined to be assassinated without the knowledge of any mouse or bird, right?

That night, I learned two shocking truths and confessed them to a man who was drunkenly passing by. I thought he looked like my favorite shady character in this novel, the crown prince of Hyperion, Saul Lucius...

"Do you want to get engaged? Marriage or dating? An affair is fine..."
"Whatever."

This man was Hyperion. As a result, the engagement with the crown prince went smoothly... But my fiancé who dumped me has become obsessed with me. Does anyone know why he's like this...? Or rather

title: Armonia the Monster Whisperer
synopsis:
Armonia has lived alongside monsters all her life. They've raised, protected, and loved her since she was a toddler. So when she heard about a monster hunt that would threaten her monster friends, she saw no other choice but to try and stop it. But to do that, she can no longer avoid interacting with humans. Now, she's on her way to meet the leader of the monster hunt, Kansler Hydeh, in hopes of changing his mind. And if he doesn't listen to her as well as monsters do, Armonia will make him!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Lady of the Bank
synopsis:
After the death of her family, Adriana Eren Toscaria was betrayed by her countrymen and killed when the Keiltz Empire invaded her lands. In her last moments, she prayed to never be reborn, only to wake up eight years before her tragedy began. In order to uncover the cause of House Toscaria's ruin and save her loved ones, Adriana begins working at her family's bank, disguised as an apprentice banker. Now, the question is whether this inexperienced noble lady will succeed before she gets caught!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: My Brother's Boyfriend Fell for Me
title_english: My Brother's Boyfriend Fell for Me
synopsis:
I fell into the ultimate noir BL novel. I was also the obsessive maniac and villainess who fell in love with the boss and brutally died during the main characters' first meeting! I thought I'd change the love between the two, which originally ended with the death of my bias due to schemes, into a happy ending, but...

"Let's go together, to my hell." What? Did my favorite character just kidnap me?

"I liked you, but this is too much." To ensure that the story unfolded just like it did in the novel, I tried to seduce my favorite character just enough that he would hesitate to kill me.

"Why do you like me?" But something feels off. "Just try running away. That's if you can, Princess. I've got my eyes on you right now, I'll go crazy if you do." The male lead's boyfriend has started obsessing over me.

"Please, don't abandon me..."

So dangerous and dizzying, it's impossible to escape!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: The Youngest Is Trying to Prevent the World From Ending
title_english: The Youngest Is Trying to Prevent the World From Ending
synopsis:
After hitting my head, I remembered my past life and realized I was in a novel. Ugh, why do I have to be Diana Cartier, the bratty child brainwashed to do evil deeds and destroy the world?! I won't let that happen. I'll stop the end of the world with my own hands and save my brothers! Wait, why is the novel's protagonist lying on the street? And oh, aren't those animals so cute? Make way for the cute youngest who's trying to save the world!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Male Lead Is Trying to Change the Female Lead
synopsis:
She ended up possessing the body of an extra named Luberia, who is barely mentioned in the story. And right in the tragic novel "Emperor Caesar," full of wars and disasters, where the protagonist sacrifices everything for the love of the hero and everyone ends up dying! She planned to live discreetly and hide her strength... But the male lead, Caesar, keeps looking for her and even proposes marriage, saying he wants to keep her around. Luberia doesn't want to meet the same tragic end as the protagonist, so she tries to avoid Caesar at all costs... But due to Caesar's intimidating appearance and assertiveness, before she knows it, she ends up engaged to him. Will Luberia manage not to fall in love with Caesar and survive until the end?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Supporting Characters Also Need Some Love
title_english: Supporting Characters Also Need Some Love
synopsis:
While driven in her life and supported by loving parents, Mihyang Kim has been a sidekick, shadowed by her childhood friend, Shiyeon. When both of them suffer a fatal accident, Mihyang is reborn as Damia, and Shiyeon is reborn as Eileene in a new fantasy world. Surprisingly, their new lives as nobles and socialites in this new world mirror their lives back in Korea, and Damia drives herself to find her own path in life, escaping the shadow of her long-time friend.

However, with Eileene caught in a web of royal politics and a large conspiracy slowly revealing itself in the kingdom, Damia must find a way to help her friend, and survive this new world herself!

(Source: NHN comico Corp.)

title: Saitei Ouji-tachi ni Yoru Koui Sou "Jou" Sen: Binbou Kuji no Koui nante Dare ni demo Kureteyaru!
title_japanese: 最低皇子たちによる皇位争『譲』戦 ～貧乏くじの皇位なんて誰にでもくれてやる!～

title: Sentai Taboo
synopsis:
In the near future, humanity is in the depths of fear due to the monsters' onslaught. Day by day, the united Cross Rangers squadron is enforcing justice to protect world peace!... or so they're supposed to. Cross Red (a.k.a Reo Akama) is a man who burns with righteousness. His overflowing sense of justice leads him one night to commit a taboo with Cross Pink. And so begin their days of downfall...! A suspenseful story of the immorality of justice!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Gunjou Other Half
synopsis:
"I found you, my fated person"

I thought it was something that existed in a totally different universe from mine...

Natsume Naganuki is unexpectedly assessed to have transitioned into an Omega. Unable to catch a break, on that same day, he meets his "fated pair," Kouta Arima. The naive and innocent Arima, who transferred into his school, remains undettered and constantly whispers his love to Naganuki.

Naganuki had spent his life peacefully until now, but before he knows it, he's already swept up by Arima's enthusiasm...?!

(Source: Shibuya Rokkasha, translated)

title: Kimoota Mob Youhei wa, Minohodo wo Wakimaeru
title_english: The Dorky NPC Mercenary Knows His Place
title_japanese: キモオタモブ傭兵は、身の程を弁える
synopsis:
As a mercenary, John Ouzos is no stranger to the battlefield, but he's never fought for glory. To pay off his father's debts (from purchasing a farm) and to afford his own hobbies (anime), John grudgingly pilots his ramshackle ship (the Patchwork) wherever the money leads him as long as the mission doesn't seem like too much of a hassle. As far as he's concerned, trouble always follows the protagonist in a story—so he's making sure he's not even a side character. He's gonna be just an NPC. Despite his short, portly frame, swarms of beautiful, strong, statuesque women approach John as he drifts through the galaxy. They're only interested in working with or dueling him, though, and only because he happens to be one of the best pilots out there. John does his best to avoid the women and stay under the radar. After all, more attention means more trouble! Pirates hiding in asteroids, space opera pastiche, and humorous misunderstandings abound in this high-flying series!

(Source: J-Novel Cl

title: Closed Room Mafia
synopsis:
High school student Kang Chul-joing awoke in an unknown locked room. He finds himself in a chaotic situation, he searched around the room and found an old MP3 player. What he learned from the message left on the MP3 player was that he was poisoned and that he had only three hours left to live. Kang Chul-joong, who was usually a mystery quiz enthusiast, tries to escape the unknown room by finding clues based on his reasoning skills that he has accumulated over the years. However, the reality is different from the ideal. What is the last clue that he noticed when he made a series of mistakes and ended up in an urgent situation where the poison spread and he start vomiting blood?!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Koukyuu no Dokuka
synopsis:
A "poison queen" who knows all kinds of poisons and a boy who is a "cross-dressing queen" solve the mysteries that lurk in the palace!

The time is the Great Tang Dynasty. The boy Yu Lan enters the palace as a disguised as a woman in place of his sister who has disappeared. He meets Dudu, a poison queen who claims to be able to use all kinds of poisons, both ancient and modern. The two are challenged to solve the mysteries of the mysterious incidents occurring in the imperial palace.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Yoi to Yukusue: Sakamura Yukke, Shousetsu Comicalize Tanpenshuu
title_japanese: 酔いとゆくすえ ～酒村ゆっけ、小説コミカライズ短編集～

title: Saishou Kakka no Midara na Takurami
title_japanese: 宰相閣下の淫らなたくらみ
synopsis:
"No matter how much I drink it up, it keeps overflowing like a spring." These touches are supposed to be loveless, but they feel good regardless...

Christina, the daughter of a viscount, had the bad luck of her fiance eloping with someone else. In the midst of her shock, her fiance's older brother Lucian offered to marry her in his brother's place. He's attractive and intelligent on top of being the country's prime minister, yet he wants to be the spouse of a girl whose fiance ran away and someone no one wants to dance with at a ball? Christina was nervous, but she was brought to his manor where she had her heart and body taken by him when he passionately touched her all over. This marriage was nothing more than a way for him to hide his brother's scandal. After all, he had someone else he was in love with...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title: Seventh Time's the Charm!
synopsis:
How would you win over an enemy who just won't stop killing you? Laila thought she had escaped death by figuring out how to turn back time, but her assassin finds her again... and again... and again! All because her sadistic villain of a father had to murder his entire family... When all her evasion plans fail, there's only one option left: coddle her enemy through his childhood and hope he'll spare her when he comes back to exact his revenge. But why is this wacko so pigheaded?!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Houmurareta Kimi e
synopsis:
In ten or so years, the moon will collide with the Earth, bringing with it the end. Before the apocalypse happens, Nekuro confesses to her best friend Kiri. Kiri, seeing no hope for the future, takes her confession half-jokingly until one day, when Nekuro dies.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: I Married the Enemy Who Killed My Parents
title_english: I Married the Enemy Who Killed My Parents
synopsis:
Lunae Lebouton couldn't be more thrilled to say "yes." With her happiness secured, she truly has it all, but the best day of her life quickly becomes the worst. Ripped from her blissful life, she wakes up orphaned and married to the same man she saw that night–Duke William Vuittolang. Determined to reveal the truth and get back to the arms of her love, she soon discovers she's surrounded by enemies and worse—someone is not who they claim to be. Who is to blame, and who can be trusted?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: I Became the Sultan's Precious Cat
synopsis:
I had been reborn and plunged into a strange world with sultans and harems. And on the contrary, I'm not a human anymore, but a kitten who can't speak! There's only one way for me to become a human. And that is to kiss a prince who is a qualified sultan.

Prince Sulayman, who mistook me for an assassin and treated me with indifference: "I don't want to give you to anyone. I will protect you. You... you're my precious cat."

Prince Theron, who I thought was gentle, spoke to me obsessively: "Don't choose my older brother, please choose me. I will give you everything in this kingdom." He whispered such sweet temptations into my ear.

I have to kiss one of them to keep my human form. What is my future going to be like?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: The Maid Holds the Tyrant's Leash
title_english: The Maid Holds the Tyrant's Leash
synopsis:
Liana Theodore was a maid who knew her place. Knowing their difference in status, she was determined to bury her love for Prince Illyd. But when Illyd awakens as a Manish with fiery powers, Liana is found to be his Aradhna—his salvation from madness and his destined other half. Can Liana conquer her new life? Or will she be ensnared in his grasp?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Tyrant's Etiquette Tutor
synopsis:
It's a tale as old as time: Livia is known as an elegant, cold daughter of Duke Blanche who upholds the etiquette of the noblesse above all else. Croft is a lonely Emperor shrouded in dark rumors in dire need of a proper court education. It seems the perfect match—except Livia, possessed by the spirit of a fiery reader who dropped the novel before reaching the end, is determined to change her fate as an Empress destined to die a violent death.

Royal intrigue, assassination plots and political turmoil are the least of Livia's worries, of course. When she enters a magical marriage contract with Croft to rehabilitate his image, each swearing to divorce when they fall in love with someone else, forces beyond their control pull Livia and Croft toward a conspiracy that could upend their lives forever.

(Source: Editio Publishing)

title: You Didn't Tell Me the Start of My Transmigration Was a Gate
synopsis:
Even as the most acclaimed Hunter of her generation, Seoha Han couldn't save the ones she loved from the destruction the Gates wrought on Earth. Now that she has transmigrated back to her first Gate, Seoha won't let fate become her. Equipped with her skills as an Awakened, a living pistol, and the knowledge of humanity's fate, she'll defeat every monster in her path if it means another chance at living with—and loving—her found family at the end of the world.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Since When Were You the Villain?
synopsis:
She transmigrated into a book without knowing what novel it was. Then, one day, her fiancé appeared. Killian was a perfect Northern Duke with black hair, red eyes, and a handsome face. It was a contract marriage.

"He is obviously the male lead." So, Sophia believed this without a doubt. She thought he would be the male protagonist. But...

"Ah, I got caught." The smell of blood brushed against her nose. Killian's eyes narrowed. Then she realized the fact that he was a villain, and a cold hand caressed her cheek. Raising the corners of his lips slightly, he whispered softly, "There won't be a breakup, Sophie."

Wasn't this a trope? She absolutely abhorred this type of plot twist.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: I Will Be the Main Character in That Prison
synopsis:
"In the afterlife, I hope to be reborn as a rich man's dog."

Yujin is orphaned and unable to find a regular job. While thinking about being a rich man's dog, she is hit by a truck and enters the game Golden Cage! She finds herself possessing a little gray-haired extra who is killed by the prince at the beginning of the game.

Not wanting to live a life struggle, she decides to take the place of the game's heroine and become the prince's pet dog...

"Woof, woof, woof!"

By barking like a dog, she succeeds in attracting the prince's attention and gets a job as his dog! Eugene earns the title of "puppy-sama" and is given a cushy puppy life... but the problem is, the crazed emperor, who was obsessed with whether the "dog" would run away in the original, is not so obsessed!

"What's wrong, my dear Yujin?"

Instead, he just looks at her with warm eyes... Awww, maybe I should have pretended to run away. Yujin's struggle to enjoy a cozy and comfortable life as a dog!

(Source: Kakao Entertain

title_english: I Will Kill the Male Lead
synopsis:
I, Kwon Jin-ha, felt sick after reading a romantic novel. I was feeling all the emotions and sensations felt by the female protagonist "Elby"; we were connected. Due to the terrible pain and sadness, I went to the hospital several times, but the doctors said that nothing was wrong with my body. In the end, I sent an email to the novel's author. When I sent an email, all I got was a happy reply...

"Do your job properly, Elby."

I possessed the body of Elby in the novel. As soon as it happened, I got slapped by the male lead. Upon that, I had only one thought:

"The male lead? It's over if I kill him, right?"

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Another World Dump Truck
synopsis:
Yul, the manager of the interdimensional dump truck office, accidentally kills an innocent man named Kwon Yoo-jun. In order to make amends, Yul enters a romance fantasy novel where Yoo-jun is the villainess and tries to send her back to her original world. However, due to various complications, Yul becomes trapped in the novel. With the office staff scattered and no knowledge of the novel's plot, Yul desperately searches for a way out. But, Yoo-jun, who is now pretending to be a noble lady in the new world, causes Yul a headache.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: I Need Someone to Stop My Older Brothers
title_japanese: 누가 우리 오빠들 좀 말려 주세요
synopsis:
I only went to calm the disturbance in front of my house, but the one I encountered was the Demon King that I punished, and unfortunately, I was falsely accused of being the demon king and died in the hand of the subjugation team.

"I'll kick your ass, Pamel Asinov! I'll make you shed tears from both of your eyes!"

Among them, the worst one was the hero, Pamel Asinov, who drove me to death as a Demon King! But when I pleaded to take revenge, I opened my eyes, 500 years later! Pamel's been dead for a long time, and the "brothers" who came one day...

title: The Secret of the Lovely Duchess
title_english: The Secret of the Lovely Duchess
synopsis:
Luclia is a girl who was trapped in the demon archduke's dungeon for seven years and saw ghosts. One day, the prison wall collapsed and a man came.

"Wow! Are you a prince?"
"Sorry, I'm just a duke."

Davier, Duke of the House of Montenfeltro. Sure enough, with his temperamental and violent personality, he would take Luclia, an unknown girl, as his princess?!

"Duke, I wonder why you brought her here..."

Luclia has just entered the world with the mysterious Duke Davier. Can two people understand each other and still be happy?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: The Saint Reborn as the Villain
title_english: The Saint Reborn as the Villain
synopsis:
For ten years, Beatrice lived as a saint to protect the empire and earn her family's love. But when Lina steals her position, Beatrice is accused of witchcraft and sentenced to death. In her second life, she vows to get revenge. Thus begins Beatrice's transformation!

(Source: Manta)

title: The Emperor's Concubine
synopsis:
Ran is the young empress of the North Empire. In order to protect her empire, she must assassinate the Orhan, the new emperor of the West Empire. Ran plans to ensnare Orhan in a honey trap by guising a beautiful assassin as tribute of good will. It is revealed, however, that the emperor is not interested in any other woman but Ran herself. Rude and arrogant like a savage, the emperor dares to claim the heart of the noble empress. Left without a choice, Ran decides to hide her identity and sends herself as tribute to the emperor. Can the empress win the emperor's trust? Will the empress be able to assassinate the emperor?

(Source: NHN comico Corp.)

title: I Changed the Villain
synopsis:
She is reincarnated as a secondary character in a novel who is killed early on by the villainous male sub-protagonist. But the villain says things like: "You are as graceful as a deer that grazes the mountains." This villain, he has no intention of killing me... This is an emergency.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: The Villain Dreams of the Heroine Every Night
title_japanese: 공포게임의 악역은 밤마다 여주인공의 꿈을 꾼다
synopsis:
I possessed Celine, the heroine of a horror game. Every day, I died in various ways. One day, the villain Leonhart appeared in front of me, but unlike the Leonhart from the game, his condition was normal? A sweet and thrilling adventure romance between Celine, who struggles not to die anymore, and Leonhard, who wants to escape from his endless nightmares.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: The Princess Ruins Everything
synopsis:
Aristana was once first in line to inherit the throne of Yiogrante. But after being charged with killing her own brother, her siblings vie for the throne that was almost hers. With her hopes of becoming empress shattered, Aristana lives every day as the imperial disgrace until she meets Marquess Patelo, an admirer who has come from the future. He knows she will rule the empire one day, but she no longer wants the throne. She'd rather ruin everything and everyone who has ever caused her pain!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Palace Beast
synopsis:
The princess knew she had extraordinary abilities, but knowing that she would never become a queen, the princess wanted to live the rest of her life quietly with her maid. However, the conspiracy of the state covets the country, and the prince, who feels that the princess is a threat, touches the princess's maid and the maid disappears. The moment he touches the maid who truly cares for her among those who have lived in the palace all their lives and only told lies for their own benefit, the extraordinary serpent begins to stretch to become a dragon that jumps over the Imoogi himself to protect her people.

"The current princess will unify the three kingdoms."

In a country built with God's consideration and dragon's favor, human greed and ability stained by the dragon's curse, and a scheduled war that began with prophecy. Can the prophecy be completed and the princess become empress?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: My Condition Is Divorce
synopsis:
Seven years after leaving the Herbet Empire to escape her selfish mother, Rosena Estalot returns seeking treatment for her sick son, Illion. There, she reunites with Yerhan, the third prince of the empire and Illion's father. When Yerhan proposes marriage, Rosena, reluctant to reenter high society and confront her mother again, agrees on one condition: an eventual divorce. With Rosena so set on pushing him away, can Yerhan win her heart before their marriage runs its course?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Here Reigns the Vengeful Villainess
synopsis:
In the grand empire of Tygen, Robellia's serene life takes a dark turn, catapulting her into a saga of vengeance. In a world of power and intrigue, she exposes hidden truths, navigating a tumultuous path between hero and villain. Armed with extraordinary magic, Robellia is steadfast in unveiling the obscured secrets of the empire and recovering her lost happiness.

(Source: NHN comico)

title: Koukyuu no Kemono wa Ai wo Haramu
synopsis:
Leixing has lost the emperor's favor and is forced out of the inner palace. Knowing that a demi-human who leaves the inner palace is sure to face a miserable life of persecution, he wants to make it back somehow. It is at this point that he sees fellow demi-human Tengel be kidnapped as a slave. Leixing notices Tengel's blessed body from the frontier and plots to make him fit the emperor's taste to regain his own position in the inner palace, but...

(Source: Kasakura Shuppansha, translated)

title: Soko wa Sawaru na tte!
title_english: Hands Off, I Said!: I'm His Desert Island Delicacy
synopsis:
The story starts with Natsuki, a genius hacker, and his gang of criminals. After a heist, they plan to sail away to the Southern Islands until the heat dies down. However, a storm capsizes the boat and shipwrecks Natsuki! After waking up on a mysterious beach, Natsuki realizes that he is stranded with little to no hope of being rescued... Just then, Adone, a black-haired, tan, apparent native of the island appears. He's wearing a revealing loincloth and carrying a spear. Not understanding the language of our protagonist, Adone inspects Natsuki for danger by touching him all over. Finally, an embarrassed Natsuki reluctantly agrees to take off his clothes... Just how far will this relationship go? Will Natsuki ever get off this island!?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Unsleep
synopsis:
All Lee Seung-hyeon wants is to pass his final summer class, taught by an infamously strict professor. Seung-hyeon has already failed once after missing the final presentation due to a misunderstanding in a crowded train. This time, he is determined to ace the group project—if only a certain evasive classmate, Seo Chaejun, would show up and do his part.

Seung-hyeon tracks Chaejun down and realizes Chaejun was behind the train incident that led to his previous failure. Determined not to let the same guy ruin his grade twice, Seung-hyeon insists Chaejun participate—only to discover that Chaejun suffers from chronic insomnia that is relieved solely through sexual acts. While most would back off, Seung-hyeon sees a chance: if it gets Chaejun to class, he is willing to go all the way.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Mayaka-neesan wa Uso ga Tsukenai
title_japanese: まやか姉さんは噓がつけない
synopsis:
Junya is a third-year junior high school student. He's good at sports, but as for studying... he's rather terrible. Recently, he's had a problem. His childhood friend, Mayaka-neesan, keeps messing with him! Could that mean she really likes him? The beginning of a playful and deceptive romantic comedy where he's at the mercy of an ever-shifting liar!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Ultraman: Along Came a Spider-Man
title_japanese: ウルトラマン アロング・ケイム・ア・スパイダーマン
synopsis:
When a battle against Doctor Doom goes awry, Spider-Man is transported across dimensions to a Japan where giant monsters known as Kaiju roam and the country is protected by a giant of light—Ultraman! But when two of their worlds' most dangerous villains form an alliance, will Spider-Man and Ultraman be able to live up to the title of hero, or will they be forced to discover that overcoming evil means sacrifices must be made?

(Source: VIZ Media)

title: Hanadoki wo Kakeru
synopsis:
The main character is Satsuki Fujishiro, a high school boy who is neither good at his part-time job nor at his studies. His only pleasure is to copy the dances and songs of his favorite idol group. One day, Minami, a popular boy at school, asks him to join a young boy's idol group because of his ability. The story depicts Satsuki's to act courageously in order to be needed by someone.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

synopsis:
As queen, Marie had it made: she spent her days in luxury and her nights bedding multiple beautiful women. Alas, her tyrannical ways eventually caused her downfall, and her people sent her to the guillotine. Yet when the blade drops down, Marie doesn't die. Instead, she wakes up one year in the past! Stuck in an endless loop, nothing she tries seems to change her fate. Her only chance of avoiding certain death is to win over the countless women who have it in for her...by seducing them one by one! A brand-new bawdy yuri comedy!

However, they're both able to value what the other "loves" and come to an understanding, so they decide to pretend to be dating in order to deceive their parents...!?

synopsis:
Noko Chijou, a slightly gloomy girl entering high school, has begun living independently as she's always wanted. Noko has been hoping for a peaceful new life, but suddenly Chika Uchino, a subterranean person, appears from the basement of Noko's new home. What's more, Poi Amatsuka (a heavenly person) and Makina Tsugou (Noko's enigmatic classmate) also barge in, and everyday is a frenzied madhouse! Noko's long-awaited high school life takes a swerve, and before she knows it, she finds she's made herself an overconcentrated yuri harem!? A silly, cute, addictive♪, yuri comedy with abrupt plot development...

"One more time...!! Let me redo our wedding ceremony!!!"

Verbena, the head of a mage squad, perished in the prior war. Gil, her surviving subordinate, is determined to devote his remaining lifespan to pining for her. However, Verbena has been reincarnated as Aurelia, the daughter of the marquis of a rural duchy, and is exulting in her new life.

Aurelia, who retains memories of her prior life, is arranged by her father to marry Gil, who is now a national hero and the mage-Count of Lothroy. Gil, unaware that on the inside she's the same woman he first loved, tells her, "Let's have a white wedding."

This is the discrepant love story of a man with a complicated first love and a cheerful reincarnated girl.

(Source: SB Creative, translated)

The high school freshman Mamoru Kishino was expecting a fateful encounter and he met the pretty girl classmate Koko Oshii, and happened to know her secret. To his surprise, he found out Oshii-san's bladder is super weak...!! To not leak this secret, Kishino swore to protect Oshii-san('s bladder).

title: Drunk on You
synopsis:
After gaining admission to Han University in Seoul, Yunho is sent to live with his brother, Yunsoo, and his wife, Yoosun. But when he walks on his sexy sister-in-law breastfeeding, he is unable to shake the image from his mind. Coupled with the knowledge that Yunsoo can't satisfy her carnal desires, Yunho is torn between his duty as a younger brother and his hunger for Yoosun as a red-blooded man. But when he becomes the object of the campus bombshell's desire, it might be just what he needs to serve as a distraction...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

synopsis:
At the age of 8, Kuuya Aragaki was caught up in a shipwrecking and transmigrated to another world. The other world seemed peaceful at first, but the countdown to its destruction had started... It was a world where men were suddenly transformed into monsters called "renma"! Kuuya was at a loss for what to do when his master, who had raised him and guided him since childhood, also turned into a renma. That's when a ship carrying a girl from the neighboring continent washed ashore in front of him...!? The only man left in the world can turn it back from the brink of destruction!

Wang Husky and Zhang Bernard are childhood friends who work in the same Private Detective Agency. But their main job duty is to investigate sweets?! Couple that with soft breaths and adorable animal ears, you get a detective story filled with adventure!

303-goushitsu no Kamisama

synopsis:
Aruka, a silver-haired, blue-eyed girl, somehow finds herself becoming a goddess!

Even so, she still gets hungry, so she spends her days secretly eating strange creatures. Then she meets Akira, a boy who doesn't go to school. He lives listlessly at home and attracts strange creatures, which makes him useful for Aruka...!

This is a story of friendship, pure but strange, and sweet relationship revolving around an unusual goddess and gloomy boy.

Forensic pathologist Sayori Somei has the idiosyncratic ability to hear the voices of corpses. However, her daily life is interrupted by a creepy corpse brought to her by Detective Takemoto. And no wonder: that creepy corpse turns out to be a cursed corpse.

title: Escaping Execution
synopsis:
As the winner of Crown Prince Karzhan's fiancée competition, Veniti Lysie should be happy, but everything changes on their wedding night when she's framed for his murder and executed. After returning to the past, she decides to lose the contest so she can live, but she keeps advancing! She bumps into Karzhan as they're both running away from their duties and learns that there's more to their past than she thought. Can Veniti save herself, or will she be unable to escape her execution?

Ever since the day Seiji climbed down a creepy dark well as a kid to retrieve a wayward ball and picked up an odd-looking pomegranate, he's had to dodge an unending stream of near-fatal "accidents" that push everyone around him away—except for his best friend Haru. But all that changes when their high school bus crashes, killing everybody on board but Seiji. Suddenly, rumors from his childhood about that fateful well reaching into the depths of the underworld take on a whole new light, and Seiji is launched into an epic adventure to save his friend—and his own soul.

The journey into the underworld of Greek legend as never seen before begins in this darkly thrilling action-adventure!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Kaidou Arukun desu
synopsis:
Kitagawa is a salaryman who moves into a super cheap apartment in Tokyo. However, the property is haunted by a ghost! To help the ghost, Omichi, find peace, Kitagawa promises to uncover the truth behind her death and fulfill her last wishes. However, the only clue he has is Omichi's memory of walking along the Tokaido Highway in the Edo period. synopsis:
Philia's family has produced saints for generations. It's no surprise that she's known as the greatest saint of all time—and set to marry the second prince, Julius. What no one expects is for Julius to call off the engagement, claiming that Philia's perfection makes her charmless and unlikable. To add insult to injury, Philia is packed off to a neighboring country in exchange for gold and resources, forcing her to leave her homeland!

Despite bracing herself for mistreatment, Philia finds a warm welcome in her new town, where she puts her saintly abilities to good use erecting barriers against monsters and curing epidemics. But even as she flourishes in her new life, her homeland is under threat of destruction!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Zombie World de Harem wo Tsukurou!
title_english: Let's Make a Harem in a Zombie World!
title_japanese: ゾンビ世界〈ワールド〉でハーレムをつくろう!
synopsis:
When a zombie apocalypse suddenly breaks out during the school festival, shogi player Koutarou manages to save the beautiful and buxom Kana just before she's taken by a swarm. But when they reach shelter, they discover she's been bitten! Desperate not to die a virgin, Kana asks Koutarou to sleep with her before she changes, and he obliges, thinking this could be his only opportunity. After sharing their first time together, they discover a miracle: Kana's bite is fading away! Does Koutarou have the cure for the virus inside him? Convinced this is true, Kana is determined to stick close to him and have plenty of fun in the meantime. But when they make their way to Kana's school for shelter and protection, they come across something that could be more dangerous than the zombies.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Maxed Talent Player
synopsis:
In 2018, monsters swarmed Seoul, and heroic "players" saved the city. Fast forward a decade, Hyukjin Kim, stuck in a seven-year rut after failing to become a player himself, gets a do-over. Zapped back to 2018, Hyukjin seizes his chance to rewrite history. With knowledge from the future and his re-awakened player talents, Hyukjin battles beasts and conquers dungeons in a pulse-pounding quest for redemption and survival!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Something's Wrong With My Inventory
synopsis:
Yuujun Shin, a wealthy crypto investor, spends his time mastering a little-known game and purchasing all the best perks to dominate. When the game unexpectedly merges with reality, Yuujun finds himself in the game world with access to his massive virtual inventory. Now, with his amassed power and resources, he is more than ready to navigate this new reality...or is he?

Why is the toughest girl in school trying to be my type?! "My type? A girl with long black hair who carries herself well."

That's what I told my friends during a casual conversation about romance. The very next day, Shimizu—the blonde delinquent who sits next to me—suddenly shows up with her hair dyed black. From then on, every time I mention my ideal girl, she starts doing things she normally wouldn't—showing up to cooking class (which she used to always skip), packing me homemade lunches, etc.

This is the heartwarming slice-of-life high school rom-com about the awkward advances of the school's most intimidating delinquent girl.

synopsis:
"I want to be by my sister's side until the very end..."

In the autumn of her twenties, Rachel marries her childhood friend Noah, who had been her longtime crush. Even though she knows that the person Noah really loves is Alicia, his blood-related older sister and Rachel's best friend... Alicia, beautiful and intelligent, has a congenital heart condition, so Noah's married life is full of lies in order to spend Alicia's meager remaining life with her. Rachel's heart aches with both extraordinary happiness and a sense of guilt... but who is the real "bystander" in this love?

title: Hakumei ni Michiru
synopsis:
"If I don't forgive you... Who else can?"

Shen Feng, the youngest of the Shen family, once vowed to surpass his childhood mentor and first love, the powerful and graceful Xiao Xing.

But when a deadly feud erupts between their families, their bond is torn apart by betrayal and bloodshed. Ordered to destroy the Xiao family, Shen Feng defies fate and spares Xiao Xing—knowing it means losing him forever.

Fifty years later, after his father's assassination, Shen Feng returns home... only to come face to face with the man he thought he'd lost for good. As past and present collide, can love survive the shadows of loss and regret...?

(Source: Tokyopop)

After Maria's tragic demise, Shadow is sent to a mysterious dimension known as White Space, in which he meets a mysterious one-eyed creature. The creature promises that Maria can be brought back to life as long as Shadow finds the Three Wishing Orbs.

(Source: Sonic Wiki Zone)

title: Only to You
synopsis:
Born into privilege and raised like a princess, Oh Roji looks spoiled on the outside, but underneath the theatrics is someone painfully soft-hearted. To live a "normal" life, she’s spent years pretending to be the perfect girlfriend, forcing herself through a relationship that finally ends when her hopelessly bad-in-bed boyfriend pushes her past her limit. One night, Roji wanders into a women-only bar...and locks eyes with Lee Jin. Instant attraction. A spark she’s never felt before. And when Jin shows her what real desire feels like, Roji discovers a world of pleasure that she can only share with her.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: My Fairest Lady
synopsis:
"Mr. Hyde, I'm getting married."

Hyde, a cold and love-averse individual, is tasked by the prince to go undercover as the tutor of Lily, the adopted daughter of Viscount Bardin, to uncover clues about illegal firearm trafficking.

"And who will be the lucky gentleman to take your hand in marriage, my lady?"
"Lord Lucien Sornell, the first son of Count Sornell. Are you perhaps acquainted with him?"

During his mission, Hyde discovers that his innocent and demure pupil, Lily, is engaged to Lucien, a notorious rake in high society.

Ahh, yes. She's been adopted to be married off, so I guess now is when she comes in handy.

"Mr. Hyde, what do you think the lord likes in a woman?"

With her big, innocent eyes, Lily looks so pure, yet she has the delicate beauty of a painting. Her body is frail, yet she is well-developed in all the right places, and utterly adorable. For just one week, she vows to become the most beloved bride.

title: Tricky Lovers
synopsis:

As she was once again indulging in a BL manga featuring a submissive character, she accidentally bumps into "Junwoo," who bears an uncanny resemblance to the dominant character from the story. Despite being the opposite of her type, Sua feels an inexplicable attraction to him. A few days later, she runs into Junwoo again, and this time, she notices something unusual about his phone's wallpaper. Is this guy, with that tough exterior, blushing over a cute character on his screen?!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Magic-Girl Service
synopsis:
One day, completely against his will, Kim Namju finds himself hexed by a sparkly fairy named Seobi—and just like that, he becomes the unwilling mascot of a team of magical girls.

Their mission? To defeat the Demons of Desire, monsters born from the collective lust of humanity, who are now plotting to take over Earth.

So far, so weird—but then comes the kicker.

To truly purify these lust-fueled demons, Namju has to help the magical girls and monsters fulfill their wildest desires. Yes, all of them.

Cue awkward moans, questionable missions, and Namju screaming, "This is NOT what I signed up for!"

Now stuck between sparkles and sin, Namju must somehow save the world, preserve his sanity, and—if possible—not die of embarrassment.

Saving Earth has never been this extra.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Working It Out
synopsis:
Maeng Byeongtae has it all—a privileged background, a flawless physique, and more than enough where it counts. As a personal trainer, women were just passing distractions, good for relieving tension and nothing more.

But everything changes when Seo Jihye walks into his gym.

A new client. A married woman. The kind of trouble Byeongtae usually avoids without a second thought.
And yet, something about Jihye—her quiet poise, the way loneliness clings to her—begins to shake his resolve.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

To combat these creatures, warriors donning mechanical armor emerge as humanity's last hope. Prepare yourself for a groundbreaking mecha action saga, where breathtaking visuals meet an expansive universe. The battle for survival starts now!

Now, to survive in this game-like world, he must slice through challenges and enemies alike. Will his unmatched skills in the kitchen be enough to carve out a new destiny?

They live in a vast mansion called the "Jewel Box," and their duty is to grant people's wishes. The new arrival at the Jewel Box is Yuni, a girl with iron ore in her eyes, who is far from a beautiful jewel. Although she started her life as a "Master Jewel," she was not able to help people as much as she would like. Then she meets Alecrea, a master jeweler who is rumored to be a "Jewel Killer." He seems to be pursuing the unknown dark side of the jewelry box. In order to get closer to the truth, Yuni helps Alecrea and meets various other jewelry masters. Little does she know that she herself will eventually become the one to change the world.

Follow your wishes and uncover the truth of the beautiful jewel box world. The unpredictable buddy and love fantasy between a girl with black iron and a rebellious young man begins!

Yet, Haejin's tenacity prevails. One fateful day, he crosses paths with a homeless General, and a random act of kindness unveils hidden potential within Haejin. The enigmatic General utters the cryptic phrase, "Martial Arts does exist!" Join us on a journey as Haejin, a prodigious talent in the realm of Martial Arts, sets out to conquer the modern Martial Arts world. His story is a testament to unwavering dedication and the mysterious power that lies within.

Before she dies from the online shaming, the mysterious creature Dolo has just the thing for her—a capsule to change her destiny! All it requires in exchange is something valuable to her.
