serializations: Suiyoubi wa Mattari Dash X Comic

title: What's Our Hero Doing?
synopsis:
Our protagonist, who has cleared the extremely difficult "Vanta Black Ring" a thousand times, woke up in the body of "Ordinary Villager A (Hans)" in its tutorial area. Monsters were attacking the village! In the midst of life and death, he couldn't help but think of the hero named Cadis and how he'd show up and defeat the monsters... That was until that very hero died from a single attack. But just when he thought everything was over, he absorbed the hero's abilities! What happened to the protagonist who wanted to survive comfortably beside the hero, exactly?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Boss Return
synopsis:
The boss has returned?! Ganghun Baek, the boss of a national criminal organization, suddenly wakes up in his old high school classroom after being stabbed by his trusted subordinate. Will he be able to avoid a life of violence this time and prevent his wife's death?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Zero no Majutsushi: S-Rank Yuusha Party wo Zenryoku de Support Shiteita noni Tsuihou sareta Saikyou no Majutsushi wa Party Kyoufushou ni Natta node Zenryoku de Ohitorisama Musou wo Hajimeru Koto ni Shimashita @comic
title_english: Zero Magician: I Was Supporting the S-Rank Hero Party with All My Might. The Strongest Magician Who Was Exiled Developed a Fear of Parties. I Decided to Put All My Effort into Making Each Person Unique.
title_japanese: ゼロの魔術師～Sランク勇者パーティを全力でサポートしていたのに追放された最強の魔術師はパーティ恐怖症になったので全力でお一人様無双を始める事にしました～@COMIC

title: Fukigen na Koushaku-sama wa Uso Hakkenki Tsuki Reijou no Torisetsu wo Goshomou desu
title_japanese: 不機嫌な公爵様はウソ発見器付き令嬢の取説をご所望です
synopsis:
Ophelia, the daughter of an earl, has the special power to "perceive lies," but, unable to socialize, lives a reclusive life. One day, in order to catch a glimpse of Claudio, the duke she admires, she overcomes her aversion and attends a soiree, but she ends up trembling tremendously in response to his "lies"..!?

(Source: Micro Magazine, translated)

title: Majo no Kuusou Cosmetics
synopsis:
Welcome to a "fantasy cosmetics" shop, full of dreams and magic produced by a witch. Following the fragrance of flowers, you'll find the cosmetics shop "Charm Dresser." There, you will find magical "fantasy cosmetics" that grant patrons' wishes.

(Source: East Press, translated)

title: Satou-san wa PJK
title_english: Sato-san Is a Professional Joshi Kousei

title: #MeToo: AV Shutsuen wo Kyouyou sareta Watashi
synopsis:
In recent years, the issue of coerced adult video performances has developed into a social problem. Young girls are tricked by adults' tempting words and made to perform against their will. Based on interviews with the people involved, this work realistically depicts the process that forces them to make their AV debut. AV victims who have been unable to speak out until now are finally raising their voices!

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

title: Dragon Gal no Nailist
title_english: The Nail Technician of the DragonGAL!!
title_japanese: ドラゴンギャルのネイリスト
synopsis:
One day, Hajime Azuma, a high school student with a knack for building plastic models, is summoned to the roof by his classmate Sayori Gotou, a demi-human gal with dragon blood. Though Sayori may seem like an upbeat girl, she actually has a life-or-death problem for a gal: her nails are too hard to do nail art. After hearing that nails and plastic models are similar, Sayori tells Hajime she'd like to hire him as a manicurist, but...

Hajime, who has no experience doing nail art at all, is troubled, but through trial and error he manages to meet Sayori's expectations. And so begins a busy daily life, doing nails not only on hands but also on feet, and for swimsuit photo shoots with other demi-human gals! The beginning of a youthful romantic comedy about a dragon gal and a male modeler nail artist!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Happy Birthday Chitose-kun
synopsis:
College student Chitose Tada spends his birthday alone and remembers his classmate from high school—Koutaka, who transferred in his second year, was tall, handsome, and talented at sports. At first, Chitose thought he was rude, but sees his true nature and is pulled in by him.

(Source: Home-sha, translated)

title: Tatanai Inma no Shoutai wa
title_english: The Identity of the Whore Who Can't Get It Up.
title_japanese: 勃たない淫魔の正体は
synopsis: Cudo was assigned to take care of Vert, a lazy incubus dropout. As the Demon King ordered him to make Vert remember the joys of sex, Cudo tried to get Vert motivated, but then...

title: Gangimari Hatsujou Punchline
title_japanese: ガンギマリ発情パンチライン
synopsis:
Shiro loves Zen, the gangster boss who is a handsome herbivorous human (with horns). Shiro wants to be a member of the gang, and he honestly tries to help the boss. But as is often the case with carnivorous humans (with tails), it is so easy for him to pick up fights, which always end up causing trouble for Zen. But why does Shiro have such a short temper? Maybe because Shiro is in heat! As he does not have much knowledge about sex, Zen offers him a technical help for his musterbation. While doing it, Zen's facial expression is very calm, but the action gets more and more exciting and passionate... He is doing this as a kind of treatment, isn't he? But now, it looks like they are having a real love affair!

(Source: Takeshobo)

title: Kago no Naka no Ω: Yasashisugiru Sokubaku
title_english: The Caged Omega: Bound by Love
title_japanese: 籠の中のΩ～優しすぎる束縛～
synopsis:
Aya, an Omega, loses his memory in a traffic accident. When he regains consciousness, he is taken in by Haruto, an Alpha doctor who stays by his side. Haruto says that they were in a romantic relationship, but Aya can't remember anything.

When the two of them return home, he suddenly begins to experience heat symptoms. As Aya desperately searches for a suppressant, Haruto slowly pushes him down from behind... "You don't have to take it," he says, covering Aya's mouth with a kiss. Then, as Aya goes fully into heat, he passionately embraces Aya's throbbing body...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title: Kedamono ni Hizamazuku wa Yoru no Shimobe
title_japanese: ケダモノに跪くは夜の下僕〈しもべ〉
synopsis:
Leading his troops by day, Tenma Sawatari is the captain of the Special Operations Unit, formed to handle incidents with beastmen. With his inherited beastmen genes, he's stronger than the average human, but he is quick to lose control and rampage when injured. To help surpress his instincts, he begs his subordinate and childhood friend, Kazami, for help. Only when the two have sex can he calm down. The only problem is they are human and beastman!

(Source: Futabasha)

title: Bokura no Kawaii Ningen-sama
title_japanese: ボクらの可愛いニンゲンさま
synopsis:
Amane has taken a complete U-turn in his life, moving from Tokyo City back to the countryside after his grandmother left him her house. The night after moving in he decides to kill time by jerking off when two attractive and completely naked men suddenly appear before him! They turn out to be spirits that were sealed away in the house and are extremely curious when it comes to humans. And now they're both licking Amane all over...?! This is a love story of two doting spirits and a gullible idiot as they learn how to live together.

(Source: Futabasha)

title: Asahi-kun to no Kurashi wa Dekiai ga Sugiru
title_english: Living With Asahi Has Me Smothered in Love
title_japanese: 旭くんとの暮らしは溺愛がすぎる
synopsis:
Ayano, a fledgling BL manga artist, had been dating her boyfriend Kazuki for a year and they just moved in together three weeks ago. But Kazuki got fed up with Ayano's lack of life skills and dumped her. After a night of drinking, Ayano was almost attacked by a stranger on her way home, but she was rescued by her ex-boyfriend Asahi. And Asahi ended up living with her in the same room where she used to live with Kazuki. Asahi seems to be up to something, but Ayano pretends not to notice?

(Source: MU)

title: Yosoji no Ossan, Kamisama kara Cheat Skill wo 9-ko Morau
title_english: I May Be a Forty-Something Old Guy, but Some Goddess Gave Me Nine Cheat Abilities!
title_japanese: 四十路のおっさん、神様からチート能力〈スキル〉を9個もらう
synopsis:
Norito Kirishima, a lackluster office worker, is hit by a truck and reincarnated in another world as Nort Mistland, a "strayed one." By way of apology, he receives nine cheat abilities from the goddess and embarks on a second life full of hope, together with the sacred beast Wolf and the great fairy Mana. However, he learns that prior "strayed ones" were used by the people in power at the time and met a terrible end... 

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title: Kimi no Oppai wo Shaburitai
title_japanese: きみのおっぱいをしゃぶりたい
synopsis:
1. Elite Dansei no Tame no Akachan Play
2. Nanny My Love
3. Yuifan-chan Kita Aru yo Akachan Play-hen
4. Model House
5-6. Seishun wa Kidou nari
7. Koushite Watashi no Imouto wa
8. Graduation

title: Nonohana Katarazu
synopsis:
Becoming "friends" with the nearby flowering plants whose names I don't know... A story about the plants within a 1,000 step radius and myself.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Eien no 0
synopsis:
Your grandfather was a coward.

That is the angry recollection with which a former Zero fighter pilot greets two Japanese siblings who, typically, despite being educated, know next to nothing about a defining war in the Pacific that took place within living memory. The testimony rattles and confuses aspiring lawyer Kentaro and newly minted journalist Keiko since virtually the only fact they've grown up hearing about Kyuzo Miyabe is that he died a kamikaze. When the young pair digs deeper into the man's past, other surviving comrades only seem to confirm the verdict, but its very import begins to shift in surprising ways.

In addition to providing a window into the experiences of the losing side's flyboys and a frank look at contemporary Japan's amnesia regarding the war, this novel also undertakes a blistering critique of the folly and inhumanity of the Imperial Navy and Army and a nuanced exploration of the differences between kamikaze pilots and today's suicide bombers. At its core,

title: Hinata to Oniichan
synopsis:
A black mist covers the sky, a ruined city, monstrous creatures, and non-human beings. The ones who delve into all these mysteries are the strange siblings living in such a world—Hakumei and Hinata. And so, their pure yet twisted sibling love is explored.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Coin Revenge
synopsis:
Yoo Beom is a genius college student who lost his family to an organization that manipulated cryptocurrency prices. Deciding to seek revenge, he hides his identity and infiltrates the cryptocurrency gangster organization, "ONE." He uses his genius brain to begin a bloody revenge on the cryptocurrency organization that ruined his life.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Manga de Wakaru Butsuri: Rikigaku-hen
title_japanese: マンガでわかる物理 力学編
synopsis:
Megumi is an all-star athlete, but she's a failure when it comes to physics class. And she can't concentrate on her tennis matches when she's worried about the questions she missed on the big test! Luckily for her, she befriends Ryota, a patient physics geek who uses real-world examples to help her understand classical mechanics-and improve her tennis game in the process!

(Source: No Starch Press)

title: Tsukuribito: Parasports wo Sasaeru Hito ya Mono
title_japanese: 職人〈つくりびと〉 ～パラスポーツを支える人やモノ～

title_japanese: 貰った三つの外れスキル、合わせたら最強でした

title: Harapeko Reijou, Level Up Shokudou Hajimemashita: Ukkari Nuita Houchou ga Seiken deshita!?
title_japanese: はらぺこ令嬢、れべるあっぷ食堂はじめました 〜うっかり抜いた包丁が聖剣でした⁉︎〜
synopsis:
Lala Rose, who is the daughter of an extremely poor baron and possesses the "Hungry" skill, is thrown out of her employer's residence when she slaps him, a sexually harassing marquis. Undiscouraged, she has just set out for the royal capital in search of employment when she discovers a beautiful kitchen knife stuck into the ground. "I'll just borrow it a bit... and simply open some walnuts to eat tomorrow..." The moment she pulls it out, the knife starts to glow and talk...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: List Rouge
synopsis:
In a world where humans are designated as an endangered species by the dominant race of Chimeras, the propagation of mankind is managed by well-intentioned breeding programs. This is in the case of a certain young human girl, who is raised in luxury and ease so that she may one day serve her role in the conservation of her kind. But when new feelings begin to bloom in the heart of the Chimera boy who works as her caretaker, the stage is set for an incident that will go down in history...

(Source: Yen Press)

Included one-shot:
Volume 1: List Rouge (pilot)

title: Ochikobore Eishi Minarai no Shounen. (Jitsu wa) Saikyou Saiaku no Ansatsusha.
title_english: The Lazy Boy Is, in Fact, the Strongest and Most Brutal Assassin.
title_japanese: 落ちこぼれ衛士見習いの少年。(実は)最強最悪の暗殺者。
synopsis:
In a certain kingdom's capital, war is approaching.

A young boy named Il, an apprentice guard, is treated as a useless person who can't do his job properly, living a lazy life while constantly relying on his stepsister.

Amidst this, a certain rumor is spreading throughout the city. It is said that a mysterious group of assassins known as the Night Dwellers are operating in the shadows.

This is the story of the worst assassin among them.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Another Blue Lock: Episode Harajuku
title_japanese: ANOTHERブルーロック -EPISODE 原宿-
synopsis: Depicts Nagi and Reo in Harajuku before joining Blue Lock.

title: Higan Shigan no Monodomo yo
title_japanese: 彼岸此岸のものどもよ

title: To Abandon or Be Abandoned
synopsis:
After completing all 200 endings of her favorite game "Nayla," a girl is given a 201st playthrough. She accepts and wakes up in the game as Claudia, Nayla's wicked sister who always meets a grim fate. Desperate to survive, she proposes a marriage contract with the cursed prince, Nathan, to achieve the goal of making a pact with five spirits. Meanwhile, the seemingly virtuous heroine Nayla is determined to frame Claudia as evil. Is Claudia truly the villainess, or is there more to her story?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Moto Akuyaku Reijou to S-kyuu Boukensha no Honobono Machigurashi: Fuguu na Chara ni Tensei shiteta kedo, Risou no Bijo ni Nareta kara Plus-Minus Zero da yo ne @comic
title_english: The Ex-Villainess and the S-Rank Hero's Warm, Cozy City Life: I Reincarnated into an Unfortunate Character but I Became My Ideal Pretty Lady so It Balances Out.
title_japanese: 元悪役令嬢とＳ級冒険者のほのぼの街暮らし～不遇なキャラに転生してたけど、理想の美女になれたからプラマイゼロだよね～＠COMIC
synopsis:
"I'm pretty amazing, you know?"

"With me, you'd be even more powerful."

The pair that has it all have an S-rank adventure and romance! An isekai rom-com! Alicia is a haughty duchess who likes to cake her face with makeup. On the night before her banishment for bullying the heroine, Alicia remembers she is a villainess in an otome game... While feeling at a loss, she realizes something else. She has big breasts, good looks, and magical powers?! Who knew she was a triple threat! An idea dawned upon her, and she sought out her nerdy brother to be his assistant to research magical tools. Alicia displayed her talent and soon longed for a life of fun and freedom, rather than the strict upbringing of a queen. In the end, Alicia decides to live her life as a commoner... And she gets teased by the S-rank adventurer, Hayato?!

An isekai rom-com with an S-rank adventure and romance!

(Source: NTT Solmare)

title: Bathtub de Kurasu
synopsis:
A 22-year-old woman starts living in her family’s bathtub.

"Humans are too high-strung..."

Medaka Isohara is a girl with a slightly different sensibility from others. She was born small and grew up small, with almost no desires. She has no material desires, no appetite, no interest in romance, and no ambition for the future. If possible, she would prefer to die at twenty...

Supported by her amusing family—a farting father, a mother who has beaten cancer twice, and a mischievous and creative brother—she has lived a fairly enjoyable life. However, when she left home for a job, an incident occurred. Unable to endure her boss's power harassment, she fell into depression and returned home in just a month.

title: Koi toka Yume toka Tententen
title_japanese: 恋とか夢とかてんてんてん

title: Ookami no Hanayome
synopsis:
Louie, the sixth prince born from an affair between the king and a maid, has a secret he can't tell anyone. Suddenly, he is sent off by the king to be married to someone in a foreign land as a "princess," being promised that his mother will be safe only if things go smoothly. The kingdom he is being sent to is the neighboring kingdom, where people live in harmony with wolves. However, the evening the ceremony is finished, Louie's new "mate" Prince Zeth soon discovers that he is not the princess he was said to be... now begins a new story in the kingdom of wolves!

(Source: Frontier Works)

title: Rikon kara Hajimemashou: Gokujou Shachou wa Omiaizuma wo Nigasanai
title_english: Our Story Starts With Divorce: The Elite President Won't Give up on This Arranged Marriage
title_japanese: 離婚からはじめましょうー極上社長はお見合い妻を逃さないー
synopsis:
Waka is a 20-year-old university student when her grandfather sets up a first meeting with Keiji, a strikingly handsome older man who also happens to be the President of a huge company. Though she is filled with doubts at an arranged marriage at first, Keiji proves himself time again and again to be a true gentleman with his kindness, leaving her heart racing and bringing her to realize that she has completely fallen for him. But even though they are now officially a married couple, night after night passes without them having their "first time" together... This must mean Keiji has feelings for someone else, right? So, for his sake, Waka proposes they get divorced. But with this, the true feelings that Keiji has been hiding the whole time run wild in his desperation to make Waka his, and their relationship suddenly takes a sharp turn into a sweet but unfamiliar territory! The delicate timing of love is all too apparent in this story where everything starts with divorce!

(Source: Start

title: Requiem of Subdued Souls
synopsis:
"If there is an omen of disaster in the Hwarang, who else could it be besides Seol Yeongrang, who controls spirits?"

Hwarang Seol Yeongrang was prophesied as one who would bring forth disaster. The only way he could return to his ranks is by solving incidents, in turn proving he wasn't the omen he was painted as. And whilst he ventures, a mysterious mad man named Zaha appears. In the era of Silla, where humans, yokai, and spirits roam, a hwarang's requiem unfolds.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Ultimate Tutorial Warrior
synopsis:
Junsu is an ordinary college student who spends an extraordinary amount of time trying to beat a pay-to-win hero collector game called Arcane Seoul. All his hours of painstaking gameplay finally pays off when he lands Cheonma, one of the ultimate SS-ranked characters in the game, seconds before a truck runs him over. Now, he finds himself as Jeonsa Kim, a basic tutorial-stage character who can learn any skill. Can he use his gaming knowledge to survive the godforsaken, magic-driven, and monster-ridden alternate world of Arcane Seoul?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Touhikou ja Arumai shi
title_japanese: 逃避行じゃあるまいし
synopsis:
1-3. Touhikou ja Arumai shi
4-5. Koishisa Tsunotte
6. Koishisa Tsunotte: Ureshi Hazukashi-hen
7. Souiu no Hayaku Itte yo!
8. Kore mo Ai no Katachi
9. Party no Ato wa Itsumo Samishii

title: "Furetai" wa Koi no Hajimari
title_english: "I Wanna Touch You." Then Love Begins.
synopsis:
Kaede Minato is bookworm admired by other students for her cool demeanor and beautiful features. Momoko Hattori is a beautiful girl with a charming face who quickly became the school's idol when she enrolled. Their paths hardly ever cross, but after Momoka spots Kaede in a certain place, they fast become close.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: The Swordmaster's Reincarnation
synopsis:
Despite his ordinary skills, Sir Shake, captain of the guard, dedicates his life to defeating the demons and bringing about an era of peace with the immortal swordmasters. However, when Shake finally succeeds and also becomes a swordmaster, he dies, only to reincarnate 20 years later as Asher. He's shocked to find that his comrades have vanished and demons are rumored to have returned. In the midst of all this chaos, can Asher find his former allies and vanquish the enemy for good?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Bokusatsu Pink: Seihanzaisha Shokeinin
title_japanese: 撲殺ピンク～性犯罪者処刑人～

title: Taida na Akujoku Kizoku ni Tensei shita Ore, Scenario wo Bukkowashitara Kikakugai no Maryoku de Saikyou ni Natta
title_english: Reborn as an Aristocratic Scoundrel, I Broke the Game and Mastered Magic Beyond Limits!
title_japanese: 怠惰な悪辱貴族に転生した俺、シナリオをぶっ壊したら規格外の魔力で最凶になった
synopsis:
I don't know how it happened, but somehow I've died and reincarnated into my favorite academy game. And if that wasn't weird enough, I'm now the depraved and lazy villain, Weiss Fansent, whose misdeeds lead him to a deadly end. Something I'm determined to avoid at all costs. With little time left until the academy's entrance exams, I have no choice but to dive headfirst into serious and grueling training. Which means swordsmanship with the S-rank adventurer Miruku Abitas, followed by intense magic practice. It was demanding and exhausting, but getting stronger means I have a better chance of avoiding my disastrous end. But I seriously underestimated just how powerful Weiss truly is, and I wind up stunning everyone at the exams! Have I somehow become more powerful than the hero? A fantasy series about changing the villain's fate with hard work and amazing powers!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Sister Registar
synopsis: Sister Registar explore the themes of "idols" and "family," focusing on the behind-the-scenes drama of an idol and her family, who create her costumes.

title: Sentimental Reasons
synopsis:
Soohyun's finally found a man who's big enough to dominate him. Now, how to capture him? 

Everyone wants Soohyun Choi—he's tall, muscular, gorgeous, and he's a talented interior designer. But there's something people don't know. Soohyun's ex wrecked his confidence by saying he was a boring lay, and now he can't get it up! He decides that the only solution is to switch positions and become a bottom. But it's hard for someone Soohyun's size to find a top who's big enough to dominate him. He moves from company to company while searching for his dream man. As he leaves his latest job after another failed attempt, he looks up to see the newest employee—the man of his dreams! 

"I'd like to renew my contract!"

(Source: Netcomics)

title: Yugetatsuran
synopsis:
Udai Ooguro, a hot springs enthusiast, admires an anonymous hot springs reviewer known as "Iyashinbou" and uses his reviews as a guide to visit obscure hot springs in mountain villages. Udai has dreamed of bumping into him at a hot spring someday, and that day has finally come. This is the story of the mysterious master and disciple's journey to visit hidden hot springs.

(Source: Comic Natalie, translated)

title: Hakutaku
synopsis:
Hikuma is a young man who seems to live in his own world. One day, he meets fellow high school oddball Noto and the two of them embark to create a video game that will impress their classmates. When the class finally plays the game that the two of them have put their blood, sweat, and tears into, their whole lives change!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: The Last Passage
synopsis:
Hell? Far from it. After all, isn't this what you wanted? After choosing to end his own life, Huiseo Yun awakens adrift on a wooden raft in a bleak, desolate ocean. Attacked by a monstrous creature that defies reality, he questions if it's a dream... but his instincts scream otherwise. Just when all seems lost, he is rescued by a mysterious woman who resembles a grim reaper. As he catches his breath, Huiseo asks: am I in hell?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Saboten Buddy
synopsis:
A lawless wasteland known as the Choya Desert was created by a past war. Romeo Rubin, a lone mercenary who's made a name for himself in this harsh land, finds an unexpected new sidekick—a cactus?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Rental Room Brides
synopsis:
A monthly rented apartment where only girls can live in. And it happens to be that my parents allow me to be the manager there? They also said to choose a bridesmaid among them...?! I'm prepared for all bridesmaids in the rented apartment!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Manko☆Chishin: Baka demo Yomeru Koten Bungaku
title_japanese: 漫古☆知新―バカでも読める古典文学―

title: Ai toka Ii kara Dakishimete
title_english: Forget about Love, and Hold Me Already
title_japanese: 愛とかいいから抱きしめて
synopsis:
Yuriko, 35 and single, leads a humdrum everyday routine of work and looking after her disabled father. At the kindergarten where she teaches she's treated as an old maid, and at home her father won't listen to a thing she says. And of course she has no plans to marry... after all, she's just going to live out the rest of her boring life here in the countryside anyway, right? But while she's lost in thought over it, she causes a fender-bender. She doesn't know how to react, but Sosuke, the man in the other car, tells her he'll forget it ever happened... if she has sex with him! But after she goes with the flow and "just does it," it turns out that he's actually the father of one of her students?! And as if that weren't enough, Takumi, her kindergarten's cheeky young chief director, arrives on the scene...? Thus begins a clumsy love triangle for a flawed adult who had given up on love.

(Source: NTT Solmare)

title: A Tidal Wave of Glory
synopsis:
Halo, the best musician of the time, suffers a traffic accident on the way to the Grammy ceremony. And when he regains consciousness, he finds himself in the body of a little Korean boy named No Hae-il. He finds himself in a completely different place and time. He confirms that No Hae-il's English name is Halo and feels a strong destiny. Halo, who entered Hae-il, proves to be a musical genius at this time as well.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Solo Resurrection
synopsis:
[Innate Ability: Resurrection]

"What? What's with this super OP cheat skill?"

However, Kang Hyeon didn't know. What it meant to die, want to die, and not being able to. The man who became the most infamous hunter on Earth with his immortal body!

As a human disaster—no, as one against the disasters facing the human race, I will solo resurrect today as well!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

Cecil Perdium, the Mercenary King, was killed in battle before he could avenge his family. As he faces death, he learns that Duke Delphine, the man who caused the downfall of his family, didn't work alone. Suddenly waking up as his teenage self, Cecil must work to both overcome his poor reputation and build up his strength to save his family. With their soldiers and knights defecting due to the harsh conditions they must endure, he has his work cut out for him. Can Cecil become the mighty warrior he once was and avert his family's fate?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Heir
synopsis:
As a young boy, Taeha Jin's life is turned upside down when an attack during a family yacht trip robs him of his parents and future as heir to the Cheon-gu Group—Korea's leading conglomerate. Uncovering the dark truths behind the accident—one of vicious power struggles and family betrayals—he escapes to Italy, vowing revenge. Seventeen years later, Taeha is finally back in Korea. A man driven by vengeance, he can't wait for the sweetest revenge as he makes those who robbed everything from him pay dearly. The stakes are high, and the battle with Cheon-gu begins!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Bocchi Shi no Yakata
synopsis:
A "pure" manga by a 76-year-old artist who experiences and draws aging. The setting is an apartment complex built during Japan's period of rapid economic growth. There, elderly people are living alone with their cats, waiting for their "solitary death" that will come someday. What kind of story will they face tomorrow? The author, 76 years old and living in an apartment complex herself, depicts the overwhelming present as the future for all of us.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: The Roguish Guard in a Medieval Fantasy
title_english: The Roguish Guard in a Medieval Fantasy
synopsis:
In a brutal medieval world where innocence means life and guilt means death, Aron, captain of the castle guard, enforces order within the fortress. But when demons begin to corrupt men's hearts, violent events erupt, including repeated attempts to assassinate the lady of the castle. As Aron hunts the culprits, he encounters a demon that marks him, granting incredible strength but tainting his body with dark magic. Now, with his mind clouded and powers growing, Aron must unravel the mystery before the castle and his soul fall to ruin.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

"There's no doubt about it, a divorce is necessary." The problem is the marriage contract with my husband. If I file for divorce first, the penalty is a staggering five billion! My father poured all his money into preventing cultural assets from being smuggled out, leaving me with nothing but an eye for beautiful things. It's clear that a remarkable divorce plan is needed!

Hoping he can teach himself, he impulsively buys a box of sex toys. To justify this decision, Taeshin appoints Yoon as his temporary assistant. But the role comes with a heavy price: Yoon must regularly transfer yang energy to Taeshin through intimate physical contact.

Though hesitant, Yoon agrees, knowing it's the only way to survive.

As the line between duty and desire blurs, both man and reaper are forced to confront their past, their bond, and the strange pull growing between them in the space between life and death.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Focus

When I was a kid, there was an older guy that I really liked. He was the only light in my world, but that light plunged me into darkness. Even so, I still yearned for him. Even if I was angry at him, but I still loved him. For 14 years... 

"Why don't you use me, why don't you need me? Why do you keep driving me crazy?"

After meeting him, my childhood memories and my true nature started to resurface. I tried desperately to avoid him, but I became addicted to the feeling of freedom to have what I truly wanted...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Konyakusha ga Uwaki Aite to Kakeochi shimashita. Ouji Denka ni Dekiai sarete Shiawase nanode, Imasara Modoritai to Iwaretemo Komarimasu.
title_english: A Royal Rebound: Forget My Ex-Fiancé, I'm Being Pampered by the Prince!
title_japanese: 婚約者が浮気相手と駆け落ちしました。王子殿下に溺愛されて幸せなので、今さら戻りたいと言われても困ります。
synopsis:
The daughter of a minor noble, Amelia hails from a remote agricultural domain. From an early age, she has been engaged to Reese, who can provide the earth magic her domain needs. Though it was only meant to be a political marriage, they got along well—until recently. Since Reese began attending the Royal Academy of Magic, he's become oddly distant and stopped contacting Amelia. Now that it's time for Amelia to enroll too, she hopes to find some answers—but she still can't get ahold of Reese, and it's tough to make friends among the upper-class students at the academy. Can anyone help her through this disheartening experience? A dashing prince, perhaps...?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Yotogi-mura: Aru Inaka no Kishuu
title_japanese: ヨトギ村 ～ある田舎の奇習～

title: Acchanchi
synopsis:
The series follows the daily life of a solitary woman as she becomes roommates with a mysterious old woman.

(Source: ANN)

title: To Drown in You
synopsis:
Hyeseong, a boy living on a remote island, and Yunhae, a mysterious mermaid, become each other's only friend. But soon after they meet, they're separated after Hyeseong moves away. Six years later, Yunhae develops a mysterious power and finds Hyeseong again. Unfortunately, too much has changed, and Hyeseong can no longer dedicate all his time to her as he did in their childhood. He tells her they are too different, but Yunhae's attachment to Hyeseong slowly transforms into an obsession...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Tsuki no Shirosa wo Shirite Madoromu
title_japanese: 月の白さを知りてまどろむ
synopsis:
Irede: the world's oldest pleasure town, built as an offering to a god. Here alone, myth has endured the passing of millennia. In a townscape dyed vermilion by the light of hanging lanterns, fine wine and masterful music sate the desires of guests who travel from across the continent to experience Irede's wonders—and meet its beautiful courtesans. Yet all is not well here, as shades—supernatural entities born of human desires—lurk in the shadows, their motives known only to themselves, and deep beneath the earth, something primal stirs. When Xixu, a straight-laced military officer, arrives from the capital to become the town's newest shadeslayer, he encounters Sari, a young courtesan with hair the color of moonlight. Thus begins a tale of love and conflict, of desire and blood, and of gods and men.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Blade Skill Online: Gomi Shokugyou de Saijaku Buki de Kuso Status no Ore, Itsunomanika "Last Boss" ni Nariagarimasu!
title_english: Blade Skill Online: Crushing the Competition with My Abysmal Stats, Useless Class, and Garbage Weapon!
title_japanese: ブレイドスキル・オンライン ~ゴミ職業で最弱武器でクソステータスの俺、いつのまにか『ラスボス』に成り上がります! ~
synopsis:
Yuri has been cursed with the worst luck imaginable for as long as he can remember. That's why things are bound to look up with the release of Blade Skill Online, a VRMMO where luck is a stat you can actually control! Eager to the right build, Yuri follows an online guide and picks the summoner class with a bow for his weapon. Now reversing fortune is just a matter of dumping all of his stat points into luck!

Or at least, that was the plan. Turns out he's been trolled! Summoners are useless, the bow is garbage, and the game's barely playable with his abysmal stats. To top it all off, the avatar randomizer turned him into a hot girl, and now a bald barbarian won't stop hitting on him! But Yuri's not about to let the trolls have the last laugh. With a PvP event on the horizon, he's determined to make his build work and crush the competition!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Mii-kun to 5-kai no Onegai
title_japanese: みーくんと5回のおねがい
synopsis:
Ooshiro, who is enjoying living alone, is reunited with his younger childhood friend, Kanata, for the first time in seven years! Kanata has grown up to be more handsome than he imagined, but when he remembers the time he confessed his feelings to Kanata, he feels a bit uncomfortable. Kanata uses the "I'll do anything you say ticket" to ask Ooshiro to move in with him! Is that confession still valid? But when Kanata stares at me with puppy dog eyes, I can't say no... How will the 5 tickets be used after this?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Thiendavis: The Road to Salvation
synopsis:
Evie Ariatte, a lovely saintess candidate, has her bright future shattered when a sudden curse forces her to answer every question with the truth. This unexpected twist of fate threatens her reputation and jeopardizes her dream of becoming the saintess. As her blunt honesty earns her both friends and enemies, will Evie uncover the hidden truths of Thiendavis and bring about its perfect salvation?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Your Majesty, That's Enough
synopsis:
Sharan is a pagan slave in the Valdek Empire. Every night in her dreams, she sees visions of a man wandering around, unable to sleep. The man is none other than Julian, Emperor of the Valdek Empire. He is suffering from severe insomnia caused by someone's black magic, and Sharan wants to cure him of his insomnia in exchange for freedom from slavery. But Julian won't let go of Sharan, who is the only thing that can save him, whether she's a lowly pagan slave or the love of his life...

Julian, the sleepless emperor. and the only one who can put him to sleep, Sharan, a pagan slave and the emperor's shaman.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Densetsu no Yankee wa Elite Salaryman?!
title_english: The Legendary Bad Boy Is an Elite Office Worker!?
title_japanese: 伝説のヤンキーはエリートサラリーマン!?
synopsis:
Souta is about to graduate from high school, but is feeling a bit bitter that he has not become the ideal Yankee he envisioned. One day on his way home, he is confronted by a dorky businessman with a short haircut and glasses, with whom his fellow delinquents have gotten into a fight! To Souta's surprise, the businessman turned out to be Keigo Morohoshi, a legendary Yankee whom Souta had looked up to! From that day on, Souta started going to Morohoshi in his spare time in order to become his apprentice.

(Source: Cosmic Shuppan, translated)

title: Imokusa Reijou desu ga Akuyaku Reisoku wo Tasuketara Kiniiraremashita
title_english: Lady Bumpkin and Her Lord Villain
title_japanese: 芋くさ令嬢ですが悪役令息を助けたら気に入られました
synopsis:
"Lady Bumpkin"—that is what most of high society called Agnes Evantail, eldest daughter of the venerable House of Evantail. Ridiculed for her outdated makeup and antiquated clothing, she has been a pariah among her peers for as long as she can remember. After yet another failed attempt at becoming engaged, her parents make her attend the princess's engagement celebration in hopes of finding a fiancé there. Agnes begrudgingly goes to the party, where she encounters perfect Nazelbart Florescruz, the princess's fiancé, and the only person to ever show her kindness.

When the princess schemes against him and he's branded a villain, it's Agnes's turn to offer him a helping hand. The two are then bound together in the most unlikely turn of events—how will their story unfold?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Saeki-kun wa Are ga Shitai
title_japanese: 佐伯くんはアレがしたい
synopsis:
Youhei and Koutarou started dating near the end of their last year in high school. Not wanting for either of them to get distracted before graduation, Koutarou asked to wait for them to have sex until after their exams. A story of two young boys on their way to their first sexual experience.

(Source: Junet, translated)

title: Kono Otoko, Kusareen ni Tsuki
synopsis:
Ayumi Kurosawa has started to live alone after entering university so that he can masturbate without any worries. However, his new neighbor is his childhood friend and first love, Junpei Shiraishi. By chance, he sees him using a toy to pleasure himself and asks, "Isn't the real thing better?"

(Source: GOT, translated)

title: Mayonaka no Ore wo Mite
title_english: My Noons and Midnights Are for You
synopsis:
The gloomy, unconfident Mayo is the face behind the bright and cheerful "Mahiru," a currently popular Vtuber. As people grow to love his complete opposite, "Mahiru," Mayo can't help but feel the crushing reality of his own loneliness grow more and more. Even his manager Ogino, who spoils him and showers him with praises, probably only sees him as "Mahiru" and not as the real "Mayo." 

Because he understands this, Mayo can never admit that he wishes to take Ogino's words seriously and wants to be loved by him. But, as if he can clearly see through Mayo and his "desire to be teased," Ogino asks "Would you rather me bully you instead?" uncovering the depths of his body as it trembles with anticipation...?!

(Source: Shu-cream, translated)

title: Disaster Is Always By My Side
title_english: Disaster Is Always By My Side
synopsis:
Everything seems perfect in Dami Yun's life. Her career prospects look bright, and her childhood crush Ho-won even moved back to Korea to confess to her. But her world turns upside down when an anonymous letter leads her to a mysterious house, where she ends up trapped for three hours... except in the outside world, a decade has passed and Dami has been declared dead! Can Jaenan, the mysterious, surly god and owner of the home, help her navigate this chaos? Why does disaster strike wherever she goes? And why is this unhelpful god having prophetic dreams about them being together?!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Gaogao
synopsis:
Enami confessed to his crush, Ritsu, but was turned down. Just as he thinks this love is over, he stumbles upon Ritsu's secret...?! A rom-com that perfectly captures the bittersweet struggles of youth!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: How to Use a Man's Necktie
synopsis:
Due to his father's debt, Park Woojin and Cha Taesung met as debtor and debt collector. After many twists and turns, the two gradually became romantically involved. They'd have a smooth-sailing relationship, even though Taesung could be a bit possessive. The only issue was that during sex, Woojin would have flashbacks of Taesung strangling him, causing Woojin to fall out of the moment. One day, a mysterious note along with a necktie arrived for Woojin... When he tries it on Taesung, Woojin witnesses its thrilling powers...!?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Boss, This Is a Massage Shop!
title_english: Boss, This Is a Massage Shop!
synopsis:
As a reward for saving his subordinate's life, gang boss Kang Cheol receives a coupon for a super-secret massage club. Tense from a long battle, he visits the massage parlor in hope to get a little R&R—only to be given a change of clothes that is bit too revealing, and a masseuse  that is a little too handsy...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: SM Yuri Ecchi Anthology
title_japanese: SM百合えっちアンソロジー
authors: Homura, Subaru|sorani|Yuino, Chiri|Itsuki, Kuro|Yakiniku Teishoku|Hinohara, Fuki|Mori|Hino, Arashi
synopsis: An anthology of SM-themed girls love short stories by various mangaka.

title: A First of Summers
synopsis:
Lim Hyeonseon has followed the well-traveled path of life: he graduated, secured a job, and got married. But the marriage ended in a divorce, and on his 40th birthday, he finds himself lonely and constantly bombarded with questions about his non-existent love prospects. In search of anything resembling fulfillment, Hyeonseon recalls an old electric guitar he bought 16 years ago but never attempted to learn. He hesitantly enrolls in a music class taught by the spirited 24-year-old Cha Yeoreum.

Although Hyeonseon is persistently self-conscious about his age, seeing people of all ages so excited to learn fills him with newfound enthusiasm. Most unexpectedly, he befriends his young instructor and soon realizes just how much he enjoys Yeoreum's company and boundless energy. But Yeoreum's feelings seem to gravitate toward love, and no matter how much Hyeonseon tries to draw a line between them, it appears impossible to resist the pull of a summer romance.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Chanto Norotte Ichiko-chan
title_japanese: ちゃんと呪ってイチコちゃん

title: Sink for Me
synopsis:
Six years ago, novelist Jung Seon lost everything, including his young son and his marriage. To escape the grief, he moves to a quiet rural village for a teaching gig, where he forms an unexpected, deep bond with an orphan named Hyeon-wu. Just as they grow inseparable, Hyeon-wu vanishes without a word on the eve of his adulthood. Two years later, he suddenly reappears as a charismatic stage actor, ready to script a new, intense chapter in their lives.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: MAIDes: Maid, Jigoku no Senjou ni Tensou sareru. Koyuu no Gomi Shuushuu Mahou de, Saijaku Class no Mama Jinrui Saikyou ni. @comic
title_japanese: ＭＡＩＤｅｓ〈メイデス〉メイド、地獄の戦場に転送される。固有のゴミ収集魔法で、最弱クラスのまま人類最強に。@COMIC

title: Kanojo ga Kuzu wo Aisuru Wake wa.
title_japanese: 彼女がクズを愛するワケは。
synopsis:
Mii-chan loves Hiro-kun, a broke and unemployed cheater! After all, he's been with her for over a week, and he remembers things like when they're meeting up and even her name! Hiro-kun is bewildered because Mii-chan's standards for a boyfriend are way too low, so he can't be a scumbag! Kind, but trash. A trash-love comedy about how Mii-chan likes that sort of boyfriend!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Deep Blue
synopsis:
"Please stay by my side."

After getting involved in a scandal, Kihae is forced to give up his acting career. Then he starts hearing voices whenever he encounters strangers. Therapy, music, avoiding people—he's tried it all, but nothing seems to help. That is, until he meets Mujin.

(Source: Manta)

title: Meet Me Today
synopsis: An anthology of first person perspective romance series by various authors.

title: You Just Made My Day
synopsis:
The transfer student Yebom was jealous of Eunho, an honor student everyone liked. Many years later, Yebom's life feels hopeless and bleak when one day, she finally learns about the reason behind Eunho's death that occurred a long time ago. Yebom, filled with regret, returns to the time when she was 18 and faces him once again. What drove the seemingly perfect boy to death? Yebom is finally ready to hear Eunho's story.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Nakanu Hotaru wa Ao ni Kogareru
title_japanese: 鳴かぬ蛍は青に焦がれる
synopsis:
While living in the high school dormitory, Usami falls in love with his roommate Aonagi. Aonagi has a large birthmark on his arm, but because of his bright, confident personality, he doesn't feel the need to hide it. He became a very special person to Usami after he gently encouraged and supported him when he was feeling down. However, recently Aongagi has gotten his first girlfriend, and the Usami by his side is not impressed. Torn between wanting Aonagi to turn to him and not wanting to ruin this relationship, what will the wavering Usami do...?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: V Yattetara Aikata ni Kokuhaku Saremashita
title_english: My Partner Who Streams Vtuber with Asked Me Out.
title_japanese: Vやってたら相方に告白されました

title: Kanojo wo Ubatta Ikemen Bishoujo ga Nazeka Ore made Nerattekuru
title_japanese: 彼女を奪ったイケメン美少女がなぜか俺まで狙ってくる
synopsis:
"Hey, boyfriend, how you doing?"

Souta Sakuhara is a first-year high school boy. His first ever girlfriend has just been stolen away from him by a "girl friend." That girl friend is Shizuno Mizushima, a tomboy who's also the tallest girl he's ever met, who's now his hated rival in love, taunting him with it. But then...

"Since nobody else wants to be your girlfriend, how about you go out with me?" She suddenly pins him against the wall! She also started saying, "Give me a month, and I'll make you fall in love with me... I'm not going to let you go so easily!"

A one-way romantic comedy in which a handsome and beautiful girl will tempt you every day!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Watashi no Kokoro wa Ojisan de Aru
title_english: This Alluring Dark Elf Has the Heart of a Middle-Aged Man!
title_japanese: 私の心はおじさんである
synopsis:
With no friends, family, or romance to speak of, Haruka has lived his life just going through the motions—until the day he awakens in the body of a beautiful, and womanly, dark elf! Suddenly, a world beyond his wildest imagination awaits, and uncontainable excitement races through him. There's just one problem: He gave up on putting himself out there a long time ago and has no idea how to strike up a conversation with other people. Teenagers and (other) women are certainly no exception.

But with a bottomless well of mana and a ridiculously tough body to boot, Haruka won't let any overthinking get in the way this time. Little by little, the dark elf works past his (her) fears and self-doubt, forging deep bonds with precious new friends and growing together with them. So begins a heartwarming story of an old man determined to make the most of this new fantastical lease on life!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: The Masters Have Subscribed
synopsis:
"Cheong-un, parry the attack! Move faster or the obstacle course will kill you!" The progenitors of the great Wudang sect and the mighty Shaolin encounter post-ascension issues when they find themselves reduced to servants in the godly realm. Their only hope and escape from their divine chores lie in the hands of less-than-average Cheong-un, who can hardly beat his peers in the sect. Can the masters raise an average boy into a master of martial arts and finally relieve themselves of their menial chores?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: My Avatars' Path to Greatness
synopsis:
Seonghyeon Han is a victim of a violent crime that left him with impaired legs and a fear of the outside world. Now, he faces an even greater challenge: while he gained the power to create clones, he has just 24 hours before being sent to another dimension. As the countdown ticks down, Seonghyeon makes a desperate move—he sends his clone through the interdimensional portal, and discovers his real body can remain safe at home. Thus begins the epic tale of Seonghyeon's... clones.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Hello, Mr. Veterinarian!
synopsis:
The night before Lee Jun is set to open his own animal hospital, his childhood pet Pebble visits him in a dream, giving him a mysterious gift. Jun successfully treats his first patient, but when the dog thanks him for saving his life, Jun realizes he can speak to animals! Word about the vet who can understand them spreads quickly among the four-legged residents of the neighborhood, and they come flocking to Jun's hospital. With his new ability, will Jun be able to save all these furry friends?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Absolute Reign
synopsis:
Twenty years have passed since the Great War, but petty theft and exploitation have taken root during times of peace. The once dazzling world of Murim is a mere shadow of its former self, but one young enigmatic swordsman has sworn to restore Jianghu to its former glory. Will the noble principles of justice and loyalty prevail over corruption and greed?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Chronicles of a Doomed Prodigy
synopsis:
Gifted by the heavens yet cursed by fate, Yeonshin was born with unimaginable talent in martial arts. But this very gift condemned him to a life that would end before adulthood. With the right opportunities, he had the potential to become a legendary hero, or the reincarnation of the Heavenly Demon. Yet fate cast him into the third-rate Jeong Clan, a family of no particular renown. Now, with time slipping through his fingers, Yeonshin must find a way to defy his doomed destiny.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Ryouen to Akujiki
synopsis:
I don't think that our love might be reciprocated. I'm happy with a lifelong fruitless one-sided love.

Or so I thought, but then Odajima showed up at the matchmaking venue...!? And for some reason, he seems to be positively considering marrying me.

Wait! Aren't we living in different worlds?! Because I'm gloomy and servile, and you're cool, kind, and popular...? And so we're... getting married!?!? A see-saw game of obsessive love between a super-obsessive top and an unconsciously loved and servile bottom!

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Kawaii Gimai ga Konyaku Haki sareta Rashii node, Ima kara "Orei" ni Mairimasu.
title_english: I Heard My Lovely Sister-in-Law's Engagement Was Broken So I'm Going to Show Them My 'Thanks!'
title_japanese: 可愛い義妹が婚約破棄されたらしいので、今から「御礼」に参ります。
synopsis:
The most talented girl in the kingdom, Roselia, is a scholar, fighter, and the apple of everyone's eye. Today happens to be the day of marriage to a childhood friend and now lover, Robert, the head of a ducal family. Everyone was congratulatory and enjoying the wedding, until...Robert's cute little sister Margaret was brought into the ceremony in tatters! Margaret was attending the Royal Academy and engaged to the prince. But he broke the engagement accusing her of a crime that was never committed, and ruthlessly beat her! Roselia is now furious at their disgusting treatment of Margaret, who did everything to clean up the prince's messes! But is Roselia really going to confront this corrupt royal court head on?!

(Source: AlphaPolis)

title: Isekai Gohoushi Kiroku
title_english: At Your Service in Another World
synopsis:
Two years after Rin Tachibana, a romance-challenged woman in her thirties was unexpectedly whisked away to another world, she has settled into a quiet life as a clerk for the Magic Knights. But when the king secretly orders her to service her arrogant colleague Oscar Garland—a notorious misogynist—her peaceful routine goes off the rails! Yet, watching the proud knight unravel under her touch sparks a surprising thrill. Now, Rin must juggle her day job with her after-hours activities, all while keeping her late-night duties a secret. But can she really keep her cool working alongside him by day while bringing him to his knees at night?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Sutochiru
synopsis: Three street children (Chamcham, Stella and Ozaki) seek to change the world tied to adult rules.

9. Watashi ga Kaisha wo Yameta Toki no Hanashi

11. Otona ni Nareba Wakaru
12. Virgin Road
13. Hokuriku Shinkansen no Hanashi: Kagayakimasshi

title: Mikeneko Shinkyuuin
synopsis:
An acupuncture clinic in the mountains that treats both the body and the soul. Allow Dr. Takarayama and his cat, Tamakon, to soothe you in this heart-warming collection of stories!

(Source: Renta!)

title_japanese: 最強の女傭兵 近未来でスポーツ美少女となる

synopsis:
1. Hanamura-san to Ookubo-kun
2-3. Nakimushi na Sadistic
4-7. Unmei no Hito
