synopsis:
A collection of adolescent yuri stories.

1. Yawaraka na Meinichi (Gentle Farewell)
2. Utakata Sensou (Ephemeral War)
3. Onaka Ippai ni Naru dake ja Dame da yo
4. Kao ga Suki (I Like Your Face)
5. Shigurein
6. Mada Haru ja Nai noni

title: 100-nichigo ni Saku Yuri
synopsis:
This full-color manga features one hundred different yuri scenarios, all from the artist Muromaki's #100DaysofYuriChallenge! Packed full of high-school, adult, and age-gap couples in cute, funny, and spicy scenarios alike, this book has plenty for readers to enjoy!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Bed in Rule
synopsis:
Fumine, a new actor, is chosen to play opposite Ed, a popular international actor who is top of his class in terms of both looks and talent. He is filled with anticipation, but Ed, who is rumored to be a gentleman, is in fact a sarcastic fellow! And yet, they decide to live together for the sake of acting...?

The rule of living together is "not to fall in love with Ed." But when they kiss and hug like real lovers, sleep in the same bed together and get to know Ed, who stoically strives to be a top actor, they develop feelings of love for each other—and then...

Limited love between an international star actor and a fledgling newcomer!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Tanaka-ke, Tensei suru.
synopsis:
Do you like cats? Do you like isekai? Do you like dying horribly in an earthquake with your whole family? Then you'd fit right in with the Tanaka family! They might not have enjoyed that last part, but they're certainly enjoying their new life in another world as the esteemed Stewart family. That's right—the whole family reincarnated together, and they're just as messy as they were in their first life. Kazushi (65) and Yoriko Tanaka (65) are now the esteemed Leonard (35) and Melsa (35) Stewart. Their three children, Wataru (38), Minato (35), and Heita (33) are now George (15), Emma (12), and William (9) Stewart. Come follow the Tanakas—or Stewarts—as they navigate high society with tea parties, marriage propositions, fashion design, bugs, monsters, and most importantly, giant cats!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Bunny and Her Oppas
synopsis:
When Bunny told the world she only cared about personality, she really meant it...until her personality-hire of a boyfriend turned out to be a complete jerk! It’s time to accept the truth: handsome men are the best! Now, Bunny is determined to stay single for the rest of her college life, appreciating handsome men from afar. But when five gorgeous men appear in her life, things get complicated. A simple glance at any one of them has her heart racing. How will Bunny survive their charms?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Maison
synopsis:
Once a slave, Lev is unexpectedly freed by a passing nobleman named Nox and brought into his household to start a new life of quiet stability.

But everything begins to shift the night Lev shares a bed with Arad, Nox's close friend.

From that moment on, the balance between the three begins to twist, tangle, and unravel, turning the mansion into something far more complicated than a place of refuge.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Pet Mimamori Camera ni Ane to Otouto no Sex ga Utsutteta.
title_japanese: ペット見守りカメラに姉と弟のセックスが映っていた。

title: Shiromajo-san to no Henkyougurashi: Saikyou no Majo wa Nonbiri Kurashitai
title_english: A Cozy Life in the Woods with the White Witch
title_japanese: 白魔女さんとの辺境ぐらし ～最強の魔女はのんびり暮らしたい～
synopsis:
After getting fired from his adventuring clan for his lack of combat ability, Tori wanders around and runs into the city's strongest adventurer—the White Witch! Since he has nowhere else to go, she hires Tori for his exceptional skill in...handling chores?! With his talent for cooking, cleaning, running errands, and other domestic odd jobs, he's the perfect fit for taking care of the extremely lazy White Witch and the garbage dump she calls her house. Follow Tori as he grapples with his new job as the caretaker of the beautiful White Witch and her three familiars. Perhaps once he has cleaned up the place, he can finally live a cozy life in the woods with his new employer!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Kakure Saijo wa Zenzen Megenai: Gibo to Gimai ni Ie wo Oidasareta node Konyaku Haki shite Moraou to Omottara, Shinshi Datta Konyakusha ga Hageshiku Dekiai shite Kuru You ni Narimashita!?
title_english: Jeanette the Genius: Defying My Evil Stepmother by Starting a Business with My Ride-or-Die Fiancé!
title_japanese: 隠れ才女は全然めげない ～義母と義妹に家を追い出されたので婚約破棄してもらおうと思ったら、紳士だった婚約者が激しく溺愛してくるようになりました!?～
synopsis:
Jeanette's evil stepmother has been tormenting her for years, making her into the laughingstock of high society. And when Jeanette's father suddenly disappears, the opportunistic woman casts her out of the house! Still, the eternal optimist Jeanette sees this as an opportunity for growth. Eager to start her life anew, she decides to call off her engagement to Count Claus Guivarch; rumor has it that the young man is being forced into this marriage to clear his family's debt, and Jeanette wants to set him free. But to her surprise, the gentleman has other plans—he refuses to break up, and even offers to help her reclaim her father's corporation. With the chances Claus gives her, Jeanette's business acumen quickly begins to shine. But what's behind Claus's unexpected affection...?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Tensei-saki ga Kiyowasugiru Hakushakufujin datta: Zense Saikyou Majou wa Kaiteki Seikatsu wo Okuritai
title_english: The Countess Is a Coward No More! This Reincarnated Witch Just Wants a Break
title_japanese: 転生先が気弱すぎる伯爵夫人だった 前世最強魔女は快適生活を送りたい
synopsis:
Lam Mercure has always led a miserable life. Due to her cowardly nature, she spent her childhood ridiculed by her family, and things only got worse when she became the second wife of Char, the Earl of Mercure. Char is a busy mage who's perpetually absent from the estate, leaving Lam to fend for herself—and his servants take every chance to torment the poor countess, fully aware she is too timid to retaliate...until something unexpected happens. While being bullied by her handmaidens, Lam hits her head and regains the memories of a past life—five hundred years ago, she was Aurora, the strongest witch in history! Now that she remembers her true self, Lam won't live as a victim any longer. With her reawakened powers, she'll punish the servants, talk back to her husband, and reclaim her freedom—on her own terms!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Ie wo Oidasaremashita ga, Genki ni Kurashiteimasu: Cheat na Mahou to Zense Chishiki de Kaiteki Benri na Second Life!
title_english: Disowned but Not Disheartened! Life Is Good with Overpowered Magic
title_japanese: 家を追い出されましたが、元気に暮らしています ～チートな魔法と前世知識で快適便利なセカンドライフ!～
synopsis:
At age three, Tafelina Lowell Lera Duval was disowned by her birth parents, but was that actually a blessing in disguise? Raised in a remote region of Ozeria by the kind earl of Peylon, she was allowed to hunt in a forest full of monsters, invent magic tools based on memories of her previous life, and let her extraordinary magical talents flourish. But that all begins to change with the approach of her thirteenth birthday. As the child of a noble, she's obligated to attend an academy meant to raise and educate the next generation of nobles. That means moving to the royal capital, a sprawling city quite unlike her beloved home. Lera soon feels like a fish out of water, and things only get worse with kidnappings, the appearance of her half sister, and more. But Lera's not one to be disheartened easily and that isn't about to change!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Isekai Seifukuki: Fuguu Shuzoku-tachi no Saikyou Kokka
title_english: The Conquest Record of Magic & Sword: The Mightiest Nation of the Unfavorable Species
title_japanese: 異世界征服記～不遇種族たちの最強国家～
synopsis:
The protagonist was playing a video game with only the bottom-ranked "Seven Unfavorable Races" as his companions—goblins, harpies, elves, etc. He built a castle, founded a country, and conquered the world. But one day, he is suddenly transported to the world of that game, and everything has been reset...!? All that remain are the "Seven Unfavorable Races" that he had originally made his minions. In order to revive "Gloria Septem"—the kingdom he once built—he aims with his companions to conquer another world a second time...!!

(Source: Flex Comix, translated)

title: Houkago, Famiresu de, Class no Ano Ko to.
title_japanese: 放課後、ファミレスで、クラスのあの子と。

title: Gariben-kun to Uraaka-san: Sanzan Osewa ni Natteiru Ero-kei Uraaka Joshi no Shoutai ga Class no Idol Datta Ken
title_japanese: ガリ勉くんと裏アカさん 散々お世話になっているエロ系裏垢女子の正体がクラスのアイドルだった件

title: Reborn as the Overpowered Genius Lord
title_english: Reborn as the Overpowered Genius Lord
synopsis:
His talent was forged on the battlefield, but before he could fully develop it, he died. However, when he opened his eyes again, he realized he had been reborn as Dane Sogres, the youngest son of a prestigious count. The talent he now possessed... was not limited to just one field?! A talent in spearmanship, assassination, magic, summoning, and even swordsmanship—which he had not been able to develop fully before! He can finally nurture his endless talent in the embrace of the happy family he had always longed for.

"Spearmanship! Dane must absolutely learn spearmanship!"
"Are you saying that because you really don't know how useful learning stealth and assassination skills could be?"
"Magic is the future, Father, Mother!"
"For my younger brother... summoning would also be really nice..."

...Mm, this is a happy family, right?

(Source: kwbooks, translated)

title: Tonari no Jiisan
synopsis:
Yuki, a girl living in a rural town, studies art with a goal of becoming a painter in the big city. One day, her older sister decides to leave town to fulfill her dream. Yuki rides the train with her to see her off, but on the way there, Yuki is assailed by a strange phenomenon!? Reality or an illusion... a chilling horror!

(Source: Shounen Gahousha, translated)

title: Kuma to Karasu
synopsis:
I want to continue this journey together with you. This is the story of a lonely bear and an outcast crow, and their journey to find their "irreplaceable companion."

Somewhere in Japan is a black bear who lives deep in the forest. In his childhood, he was separated from his family and has never met another bear. The bear is alone, until he meets a city-raised crow... The two decide to search for the bear's companions that he's never met before. Passing through mountains, forests, grasslands, volcanoes, and lakes, meeting deer, owls, herons, and boars, can the two find their "irreplaceable companion?" What about the existence of Yatagarasu, the God who grants only one wish?

(Source: Bungeishunju, translated)

title: Raishuu, Ame ga Futtara
synopsis: A story where woman meets woman on a rainy day.

title: Smother Me
synopsis:
In the gray streets of Detroit, young Akio experiences the warmth of his mother's hand for the first time as they make their way to meet a stranger. The harrowing reality seeps in when he realizes that he is sold to Moreh, a child trafficker, never to see his mother again. After passing a life-or-death test, Akio is presented with the choice to abandon his past life and become an assassin.

Under the alias "Snake," Akio enters a cycle of regular killings. While he grows more efficient, all of his assassinations haunt him. Everything changes when Snake meets a blind girl whose innocence and compassion give him a new goal, setting him on a tumultuous path that will alter his life forever.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Midareta Futari no Yarare Meshi
title_japanese: みだれた二人のやられめし
synopsis:
A hungry resident and a landlord who wants to eat anytime. When these two meet... an irresistible night begins...!! It's so delicious, they get all worked up!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Horror Eiga ni Detekuru Eroi Onna wa Zettai ni Shinu
title_japanese: ホラー映画に出てくるエロい女は絶対に死ぬ

title: Gomidame no Garnet
title_japanese: ゴミ溜めのガーネット
synopsis:
Kanae, a hitman, encounters a half vampire named Sara at a dump site and is attacked. With nothing to lose, Kanae is completely indifferent to having his blood sucked or his home invaded.

Sara, a bloodthirsty defective vampire abandoned by his parents, offers Kanae a deal: "In return for taking care of your decrepit lifestyle, become my food..." What begins as a physical relationship fueled by the arousal of bloodsucking, brings a warmth they've never known, melting away the loneliness they've both carried...

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Vivid Monsters Chronicle
title_japanese: ビビッド・モンスターズ・クロニクル
synopsis:
In order to achieve her goal, Yumeko Makino starts the game "Vivid Monsters Chronicle." This manga follows her and her friends who she meets along the way, in game and in real life.

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Shoushinmono na Veteran Chuunen Boukensha to Dorei no Kitsunemimi Shoujo
title_english: The Middle-Aged Adventurer & the Slave Girl
title_japanese: 小心者なベテラン中年冒険者と奴隷の狐耳少女
synopsis:
Gino, an adventurer, has survived as an adventurer for more than 20 years since he left the countryside at the age of 15 thanks to his cautious personality. Gino, who had already reached the veteran level, had gained a certain position and wealth but knew that his appearance was not pleasant to women, so he retired as an adventurer to marry and build a family. He gave up the opportunity and decided to buy a sex slave with the property he had saved so far. Gino chose to continue his adventurer business tomorrow, but after the sex slave came home, Gino's life began to change little by little...

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Influencer Love
title_japanese: インフルエンサー・ラブ

title: Gakkou de Nakadashi no Shukudai ga Deta node Oniichan ni Tetsudatte morau Hon
title_japanese: 学校で中出しの宿題が出たのでお兄ちゃんに手伝ってもらう本

title: Kunikida-senpai no Kakushigoto
title_japanese: 国木田先輩のかくしごと

title: Mamono no Heya: 6-nenburi ni Saikai shitara Hikikomori NEET ni Natteita Shinyuu no Oneesan ni Semararete Seieki wo Shiboritorareru Hanashi
title_japanese: マモノノヘヤ ～6年ぶりに再会したら引きこもりニートになっていた親友のお姉さんに迫られて精液を搾り取られる話～

title: Alpha no Chouinshiki
synopsis:
Oscar, an Alpha, was raised as the crown prince of Galguard and has grown to be both handsome and refined. For some reason, he is to conduct a signing ceremony alone with Prime Minister Legrand of the allied nation. The moment Oscar confronts Prime Minister Legrand, his body suddenly goes into "heat" simulating that of an Omega, even though he's supposed to be an Alpha.

Could Prime Minister Legrand actually be the "Supreme Alpha" who is said to be the only one in a hundred years to cause even an Alpha to go into heat...?

(Source: Media Soft, translated)

title: Boss, Bxtch, Baby!
synopsis:
Would you rather be the target of a ruthless gang of loan sharks or become the boy-toy of an unhinged corporate heir for a year? This is the predicament Hojin finds himself in when Yooseong, a former one-night stand, wrestles him into a deal that'll solve all his money problems. He'll have to pay a hefty price in return, but Hojin soon comes to learn that his cruel master for a year hides a rather lonely heart. Thus, the two begin to grow closer... Will they actually find comfort in each other or will this year crush Hojin for good?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Aru Oshiire Atama Otoko no Hanashi: Mokuhan Mangashuu
title_japanese: 木版漫画集 或る押入れ頭男の話
synopsis:
"To me, vanishing was eternal release."

A man who left his father's house lost interest in studying, lost faith in humanity, and locked himself in his apartment. So a year passed alone. Everyday, he thought more and more often about suicide, but one day he looked in the mirror and was stunned: instead of a head he now had a wardrobe. His existence became like a wardrobe—small and closed to the whole world.

(Source: Seirin Kougeisha, translated)

title: Majo ni Kubiwa wa Tsukerarenai
title_english: Can't Be Put Collars on Witches.
title_japanese: 魔女に首輪は付けられない
synopsis:
When the nobility tries to monopolize magic, the crime rate surges. As a countermeasure, the Empire establishes a bureau dedicated to investigating magical crimes. Rogue, a detective, is reassigned to the sixth branch office because of his superior's—Velladonna's—scheming. There, he'll work alongside a witch who almost destroyed the Empire. Because of the dangers such witches pose, they are bound with collars that restrict their power. However, Rogue's charming new partner, "the Puppeteer," has no qualms about toying with him!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Ayashii Omawari-san
synopsis: A series that peeks into the daily life of police officers.

title: Jukai: Shounin Yokkyuu no Mori
title_japanese: ジュカイ―承認欲求の森―
synopsis:
Freelance writer Shunsuke Koshiji went to the Sea of Trees at the foot of Mount Fuji in response to a video streamer's message for help. Upon arrival, he found dozens of other streamers gathered there, their goal being to find a secret cult known as "Jofuku Divine Teaching," who are said to operate in the forest. But that night, something happens... 

The Sea of Trees and a dark cult... both will bring out the streamers' ugly true desire of wanting to go viral...

(Source: Nihon Bungeisha, translated)

title: Genius Grandson of the Loan Shark King
synopsis: Kim Mu-hyuk, the Grandson of the Loan Shark King Cheon Tae-san, whom even the wealthy elites of South Korea bowed to, strives to be recognized as a member of the Cheon Family. Despite his efforts, Mu-Hyuk is betrayed and killed by his uncles in a vicious struggle over his grandfather's inheritance. However, instead of dying, he wakes up in the 1990's, with a second chance to rewrite his fate. Determined to prevent the death of his grandmother, who raised him, and reclaim the legacy of the Cheon family, Mu-hyuk sets out to preserve his severed friendships and take brutal revenge on his uncles and anyone else who stands in his way. Though once a troublemaker, Mu-hyuk quickly rises to the top both academically and socially, earning his grandfather's trust. As he solidifies his place in the family, Mu-hyuk begins manipulating the underworld, gaining control over criminal organizations and influential figures in politics and business. Gradually, he paves his path to fulfill his ambitions an

title: Uchi no Chiisana Jochuu-san
title_japanese: うちのちいさな女中さん

title: The Otherworldly Genius Method Actor
synopsis:
Kang Ujin is an ordinary nobody—until one day, he gains a strange ability. Whenever he reads a script or screenplay, he's pulled into a mysterious dimension where he can relive the character's experiences. When he ends up showcasing a performance born from that dimension, his acting is so overwhelming that it leads to a massive misunderstanding. Mistaken for a once-in-a-generation acting prodigy, Ujin is suddenly thrust into a world of media and celebrities far beyond his quiet, insignificant life.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: E ga Umai Yamashita-san
title_japanese: 絵が上手いヤマシタさん
synopsis:
Yamashita always sneaks in some sketching in her notebook during class. One day, Miya, who sits in front of her, compliments her drawings. Suddenly, Yamashita's peaceful daily life begins to change...! A heartwarming coming-of-age drama that lovingly portrays the self-consciousness in youth!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: E ga Umai Yamashita-san
title_japanese: 絵が上手いヤマシタさん
synopsis:
Yamashita always sneaks in some sketching in her notebook during class. One day, Miya, who sits in front of her, compliments her drawings. Suddenly, Yamashita's peaceful daily life begins to change...! A heartwarming coming-of-age drama that lovingly portrays the self-consciousness in youth!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Ayakasarete Kazoku Keikaku
title_japanese: あやかされて家族計画

title: Maishuu Kinyou, Shibare ni Kite
title_japanese: 毎週金曜、縛られに来て

title: Midareta Futari no Mitasare Gohan
title_english: Make Me Eat! Make Me Happy!
title_japanese: みだれたふたりのみたされごはん
synopsis:
Runa Hikami is an office lady who decided she wouldn't eat too much no matter how hungry she is. Ichika Koizumi is a high school girl who eats whenever she feels like it regardless of the time or place. Runa's restraint means she won't make any compromises when it comes to eating delicious things. Ichika isn't fussy when it comes to eating and doesn't know anything about ways to make things tastier. When these two eat together, it becomes an "obscene meal"!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Included one-shot:
Volume 1: Midareta Futari no Yarare Meshi (pilot)

title: Becoming a Family With the Duke and His Dear Son
title_english: Becoming a Family With the Duke and His Dear Son
synopsis:
After being transmigrated as Ibellia the villainess, Soyoon strives to twist the plot in order to survive in her favorite web novel. Her plan is to break off the engagement with Duke Cassis Adelhardt and live a quiet life on her own. However, the duke and his young son Lucius will not let her go so easily. "Lady Ibellia... Will you be Lus' mommy?"

(Source: NHN comico Corp.)

title: The Grand Duke of the North
title_english: The Grand Duke of the North
synopsis:
Yumi, an actress with no experience in love, is terrified when she wakes up in a dark romance as Selene Belias on her wedding night! Yet instead of confining her like in the novel, her husband, "Monster Archduke" Varas, brings her gifts and takes her on outings. She falls for him... but then discovers he thinks she's a witch and is searching for the real Selene! Can this actress convince her first love that she's really his wife? Or is she to be cast out of this role that's not rightfully hers?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Locked Up by My Mad Dog
title_english: Locked Up by My Mad Dog
synopsis:
Elizabeth found herself reincarnated as the deceased first love of Ernst, the male protagonist of a 19+ dark novel. And to make matters worse, she ends up with the fate of an extra who doesn't even appear in the original story, dying at the hands of the traitor Karsis on her wedding day.

She tried to stop the rebellion to survive, but the scale of the mess the original owner of her body had caused was just too big. Not only had she had an inappropriate relationship with her loyal servant Karsis, but she had also wronged him terribly. Feeling guilty, she tried to set him free, but...

"That won't do. Betrayal, that is. If you throw away a dog that was already abandoned once, this time it might bite its master."

With half-crazed eyes, he was trying to kill me...? Wait, hold on. Ka-Karsis!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: No Retaliation from the Supporting Cast
title_english: No Retaliation from the Supporting Cast
synopsis:
After being transported into a novel she read, Agrain tries to live a quiet life as a side character maid. But that changes when the novel's timeline is suddenly altered, and she finds herself working directly for the terrifying Duke Ingord. Agrain knows that the only way she can survive now is to do anything he asks... but what exactly does he want from her?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Aisanai to Iwaremashitemo: Moto Maou no Hakushaku Reijou wa Kimajime Gunjin ni Ezuke wo Sarete Shiawase ni Naru
title_english: Dinners with My Darling: How the Former Monster King Ate Her Way to Happiness
title_japanese: 愛さないといわれましても ～元魔王の伯爵令嬢は生真面目軍人に餌付けをされて幸せになる～
synopsis:
"I will never love you."

The wedding night of a political marriage. Abigail is impatient when her husband suddenly declares that he doesn't love her. Does that mean you can't have dinner! A new kind of baiting love story in which a countess, a demon king in a previous life who has been abused by her family all her life, is fed by her husband, a serious soldier, and becomes happy!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Isekai⇔Chikyuukan de Kojin Boueki shitemita
title_japanese: 異世界⇔地球間で個人貿易してみた
synopsis:
One day, Wataru stumbles upon a gate that allows travel back and forth between Japan and another world. Beyond the gate is a fantasy-like world. Seeing a town whose civilization was undeveloped in many respects, he realizes the potential for great profit. In other words, bringing sugar, spices, coffee, hygiene products, and the like to the other world and making a fortune. Striking it rich in the other world, Wataru suddenly realizes something when he sees a potion for sale: "Maybe this would be better in the other world?" Wataru makes a killing bringing potions that instantly heal the user's wounds to earth. He also buys beautiful slaves, and before long, he is doing great on earth too.

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

title: Yakusai Kochou
synopsis:
Spirits begin terrorizing a school and it is left up to the sexy student Kochou Enoki to use her attractive body and magical powers to defeat the attackers. Teamed with her sister and Kousaku, their human decoy, they attempt to free the school from the spirits.

(Source: ANN)

title: Moguri Shokudou wa Nagareyuku
title_japanese: もぐり食堂は流れゆく
synopsis:
Things you shouldn't eat, and things you shouldn't let people eat... In a world where "normal food" is banned , there is a small restaurant run by a husband and wife that serves dangerous things.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Café Puparia
synopsis:
In the late Taisho era a refined social club for adults called Café Puparia stands quietly in a corner of Asakusa. The hostesses each carrying their own burdens struggle to find a way to live true to themselves.

(Source: East Press)

title: The Dokkaebi's Soul Qi Bride
synopsis:
Lee Shinhui has always juggled odd jobs to support his ailing brother, but when he accidentally shatters a mysterious marble, he's dragged into a demonic realm! Just as all hope seems lost, he's rescued by a powerful dokkaebi named Ohwi, who demands Shinhui's soul qi to satisfy his own hunger. Trapped in a dangerous world and bound to Ohwi's desires, can Shinhui find a way back home, or is he doomed to become Ohwi's personal soul qi vessel forever?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Hanamikouji Kita Nikki
synopsis:
Mitsuki is a high school girl living on the north side of Hanamikouji in Gion. The north side of the street is a pleasure quarter full of host and cabaret clubs, and is the opposite of a quaint tourist area. Mizuki is asked by Hikaru, the manager of a club she knows, to read The Tale of Genji for him, but she can't quite grasp the emotion of "aware." One day, Mizuki goes on an adventure in Kyoto with Koume, an aspiring maiko..?!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Kotoba no Tsuujinai Kimi to
synopsis:
1. Kotoba no Tsuujinai Kimi to
2. Kotoba no Tsuujinai Kimi to: Bonus Track #Harajuku
3. Kotoba no Tsuujinai Kimi to, Hong Kong de

title: Akuyaku Reijou-tachi wa Yuruganai
title_japanese: 悪役令嬢たちは揺るがない
synopsis:
It has been half a year since Aini Mikkola, the saintess in training who who hails from a barony in the countryside, arrived at the Royal Academy. The school is in turmoil. The boys, the sons of aristocrats, are at the mercy of Aini's innocent, natural cuteness, while the girls are angry at her disregard for the manners of the aristocracy. In the midst of all this, there were three daughters who were dubbed "the villainesses," in reference to a popular story. Seraphina, the crown prince's fiancée and the daughter of an upright marquise. Sandra, the noble daughter of a viscount who made their wealth from commerce. Bernardetta, the brilliant daughter of the current Prime Minister's who is a marquise. When a sense of disquiet begins to grow in the school, these women finally stand up! To correct Aini's mistakes and to follow their own hearts.

This is a record of the battle between the three "villainesses" and the saintly apprentices, a battle for the way of life of women.

(Source: Kadok

title: Seishiki ni Majo ni Natta Nidome no Akuyaku Oujo wa, Mou Futatabi to Taisetsu na Mono wo Ushinawanai to Kokoro ni Chikau @comic
title_japanese: 正式に魔女になった二度目の悪役皇女は、もう二度と大切な者を失わないと心に誓う@COMIC
synopsis:
Princess Alice, who was turned back to her 10-year-old self with the "witch's power" before she died, meets Theodore, a heretic (Nox). He is the most hated and shunned member of the Knights' Order, but for a girl who was killed because of her crimson hair, he is the only person who can share her loneliness! However, contrary to the rumors (of the past), she is intelligent and gets caught up in a battle over the right to inherit the throne...?

"Would you like to become a witch's knight out of self-interest?"
"That's a ridiculous invitation, I don't think you're a princess, is it?"

A relife story of a figurehead princess and a lonely knight who finally meet, both of whom have "crimson"!

(Source: TO Books, translated)

title: Classmate wa Isekai de Yuusha ni Natta kedo, Ore dake Gendai Nihon ni Okizari ni Saremashita
title_japanese: クラスメイトは異世界で勇者になったけど、俺だけ現代日本に置き去りにされました
synopsis:
"Congratulations! You 25 have been chosen as heroes to save the world!"

Just before summer vacation in their third year of middle school, a class is suddenly transported to another world by the goddess Ashera. The 26 students are given statuses that allow them to use skills and cheat abilities to become heroes in the other world. However, the number of students transported is 25—leaving behind Shuu Iori, the boy who had just transferred and wasn't counted.

While his classmates train in the other world to prepare for their battles as heroes, Shuu remains in peaceful Japan, devoting himself to studying the status he was given. Quietly experimenting with his skills, he occasionally uses them to help those around him. But before he realizes it, Shuu has become a target of various organizations around the world—!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Murasaki ni Orange
synopsis: Kirisaki, who spends every day studying, is suddenly invited to a Halloween party by the eccentric twins in her class.

title: Yuri no Ko
synopsis:
Mana and Tsukushi are childhood friends who have complexes about each other. Though they care for each other, neither of them can reveal her true feelings. Suddenly, a girl who calls herself "the girl from the future" appears before the two of them and their unrequited love. What is the girl's purpose? And what will become of Mana and Tsukushi's love? A girl-meet-suspense story intertwined with life, death, and children!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Tsuihou sareta Tensei Ouji, "Auto Craft" Skill de Ryouchi wo Bakusoku de Kaitaku shi Saikyou no Mura wo Tsukutteshimau: Saikyou Craft Skill de Hajimeru, Rakuraku Ryouchi Kaitaku Slow Life
title_japanese: 追放された転生王子、『自動製作〈オートクラフト〉』スキルで領地を爆速で開拓し最強の村を作ってしまう〜最強クラフトスキルで始める、楽々領地開拓スローライフ〜
synopsis:
Third Prince Theodulf has been banished to a wasteland known as the Land of Death because he didn't receive a gift from the Goddess. It's a barren land where the air is so noxious, nothing can grow there. Surviving there is impossible...or so everyone thought! As it turns out, Theodulf is a reincarnated being and has received a power known as "Auto-Craft" from the Goddess. In a world where demihumans―humans born with animal traits―live amongst normal people, Arashi Usami, the biggest delinquent in school, has a huge secret. Despite being big and brawny with looks that could kill, he's actually a rabbit type demihuman.

Rixie is a succubus often masquerading as a service provider who visits homes, whether it to be checking the gas valves, the water pipes, or the internet connection. "Dungeon Brave Soul." It's a game that has won over many men, but then its sequel—with its NTR, depressive, and bad ending developments—has broken the brains of many men. I've been reincarnated as Zenon Baskerville, the game's overwhelmingly despised villain!? To avoid the bad ending, I try to live quietly, but for some reason, the protagonist suddenly glares at me...!?

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)

title: Milady's Land's a Mess!
synopsis:
Chae-ohk used to work like a slave in a tiny office, which lead to her obvious death by fatigue. When she sees that no one truly wishes for her happiness, even at her funeral, she decides to truly part ways with it all and heads to heaven when... She is reincarnated as Dinabrucé Cierrius, the sole daughter of Duke Cierrius. Is this how she was going to be compensated?! But just as she is about to get excited for her newfound luxurious life, she hears that her fief and estate is about to go bankrupt?!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Kiite, Ore no Hazukashii Oto
title_japanese: 聞いて、俺の恥ずかしい音
synopsis:
Terasaki, the top earner in the sales department, is adored for his good looks and friendly personality. One day, he runs into Andou, a colleague who is the complete opposite of Terasaki and is not well-liked in the company, when he rushes to the restroom...?

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Love Chair Lab
synopsis:
The Love Chair Research Lab advances day by day. The secret lies in our employees who throw themselves into their work with dedication!

"Ah! Mmf! Hanjun... it feels amazing as you're going so deep."

"Goya, you're holding onto me so tightly too. Did you know I've wanted to bang you since I left for work?"

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Hunks, Harems, and Hardcore Habits
synopsis:
Trapped in a game where she's a spy tasked with seducing the men of the Empire, our protagonist finds herself in a twisted reverse harem scenario with no way out.

"Did I log in to the game last night? But I don't remember logging in..."

What started as an immersive gaming experience for her day off quickly turns into a nightmare when she realizes she's stuck inside. Now, surrounded by irresistibly handsome men and intense encounters, she desperately wants to escape.

But there's one problem: the game doesn't plan on letting her leave anytime soon!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Koi wa Full Swing
synopsis:
Koko Aiwa can't live without being in love. Her friend Kumi Motoya criticizes her for this, yet struggles with her own romantic feelings. Suddenly, everything changes when they meet "Lovemee," an extraterrestrial visitor from the planet Love-love!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Koi wa Full Swing
synopsis:
Koko Aiwa can't live without being in love. Her friend Kumi Motoya criticizes her for this, yet struggles with her own romantic feelings. Suddenly, everything changes when they meet "Lovemee," an extraterrestrial visitor from the planet Love-love!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Alt Account Trap!
synopsis:
Everyone knows Kang Su-hyun. The Class president, social butterfly, the kind of guy who shines in every corner of campus life. But even the brightest star has shadows.

His secret? He runs a private "alt account," an anonymous SNS page where he draws and posts scandalous 19+ art. It's his hidden world, one that absolutely no one can ever discover.

At least, that was the plan.

One day, his double life is accidentally exposed to the very last person he'd want: Lim Ji-ah, the school outcast who barely talks to anyone. "Wait... sunbae, you're that famous lewd artist? Hehe... guess I've got some leverage now, huh?"

From that moment on, Su-hyun's carefully maintained image as Mr. Perfect begins to crumble. Stuck between bribes, blackmail, and the most awkward partnership imaginable, can a campus golden boy survive having his NSFW alter ego in the hands of an unlikely accomplice?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Secret Pleasure Report
synopsis:
From reckless one-night encounters with strangers, to shameless nude confessions in secluded parks... this is the secret pleasure report, unveiling every forbidden moment of men and women’s most dangerous, intoxicating desires.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: N
synopsis:
My vision and mind were consumed by N.

The disappearance of five junior high school boys. The brutal murder of an entire class at ■■ Elementary School. A car crash leaving two dead. The letter "N" was left at the scene of each of these crimes.

A popular urban legend has it that the main culprit is a religious group named "N," which was supposed to have collapsed 2,000 years ago.  What on earth is "N"?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: The Queen of Kisses
synopsis:
The life of world-renowned actress Yuri Son—hailed as the Queen of Kisses for her spectacular on-screen kiss scenes—takes a tragic turn when her husband Dave Chun, IT billionaire and Silicon Valley legend, disappears on the first night of their honeymoon. Suspected of murdering her own husband as it was just the two of them on a private yacht out at sea, Yuri attempts to prove her innocence with the help of Dojun Lee, a criminal lawyer with whom she shares a complicated past. The trial seems impossible to win, but will she be able to uncover the truth behind this locked room mystery?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Strawberry Kiss Melt
title_japanese: ストロベリーキス・メルト
synopsis:
Welcome to the Cakeverse! If someone loses their sense of taste during adolescence, they are diagnosed as a Fork. The only way Forks can taste anything is by consuming Cakes, people who smell and taste sweet to them.

Ageha hates that he's a Fork, and he makes a point of avoiding others to keep his natural instincts under control. But when his popular schoolmate Kaede stops by and visits him at the school nurse's office one day, Ageha notices a sweet aroma. Since he thinks he must be dreaming, he goes all out and lets his desires loose. But when he wakes up, he realizes Kaede is a Cake who now has Ageha's Fork identity all figured out!

If Ageha wants to keep the fact that he's a Fork a secret, he needs to play along with Kaede's urges. But since Kaede's fluids are the only way Ageha can taste anything, this arrangement is actually extremely mutually beneficial!

(Source: Animate International)

title: Kabukichou Bad Trip: Ikeda to Rio
title_english: Kabukicho Bad Trip: Ikeda and Rio
title_japanese: 歌舞伎町バッドトリップ 池田とリオ
synopsis:
Ikeda is the manager of a coffee shop in Kabukicho, Japan's famous red light district. The host Rio seems to have taken a liking to him, and it's only together that they may be able to overcome their traumas.

(Source: Animate International)

title: Shilly-Shally
synopsis:
Nicolas has started a new life in a new city and is ready to leave his dark past behind. One of the first people he meets is the mysterious Al, a man who has trouble making decisions. He asks Nicolas to be his "decision manager" and help him choose what to do every day, from what to eat for breakfast to what to wear to work.

Although the decisions seem innocuous at first, Nicolas can't help but sense that something sinister is going on behind the scenes...

(Source: Animate International)

title: Kakko Tsukanai Haitatsuin-san
title_japanese: かっこつかない配達員さん
synopsis: A romantic story about an employee at a stationery store and a delivery man.

title: Kawai Full Throttle!
synopsis:
Kawai, an emotional, quirky, and somewhat twisted elementary school girl, accidentally lets her classmate Takenouchi witness one of her most embarrassing moments. But somehow, this awkward incident leads to an unexpected friendship between the two. Watch as these two, far from your typical elementary school kids, engage in lively, heartfelt conversations in this heartwarming comedy!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Business Boukun to Mezasu Happy End: Otomege Sekai de Zense no Oshi Idol to Konyaku!? Mou Tada no Fan ja Iraremasen
title_english: Flirting with a Faux Tyrant in the Entertainment Biz
title_japanese: ビジネス暴君と目指すハッピーエンド ～乙女ゲー世界で前世の推しアイドルと婚約!? もうただのファンじゃいられません～
synopsis: After otome game producer Misora and her favorite idol L each meet with fatal accidents, they wake up inside the world of Misora's video game, engaged to each other in a fantasy kingdom.

title: They All Live in the Little Lady's Garden
title_english: They All Live in the Little Lady's Garden
synopsis:
In this new life Evelia just wanted to be loved but she was born with the talent of a master of spirits, thanks to the seal of the king of spirits. She receives unconditional love from her parents and siblings, and is constantly chased by knights who want to be her guards. Furthermore, she also attracts the attention of several powerful men, who have ambitious plans for her.

One of them is Ashrath, the king of demons and the only dragon in the other world, who wants to make her his bride. Another is Lelian, her childhood friend and the future emperor, who promises to build her an empire. And there are still others who hide their secrets and intentions. Evelia will have to deal with them all, while walking along the flower path of an irresistible girl.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Jirai Glico
synopsis: Imoriya Mato just wants to live a quiet life at school, but she's also competitive by nature. Her friend, Kouda-chan, asks her to represent their class in the competition for the right to use the rooftop at the school festival, known as the "Fool's Smoke Game." She gets caught up in a series of unusual challenges...? Deception and logic lead to victory—the ultimate battle of wits where no one dies!

title: Which Wizard Will Kill Me?
synopsis:
Life at Papilon, the elite magic school, is full of hardships for Rhea, who's failing in every possible way. One day, when her hidden friendship with the top student and her childhood friend Sion gets discovered by the mysterious transfer student, Joon, Rhea can't help but notice the energy of death surrounding him... Who will be the wizard to kill her?!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: How to Put Your Savior on the Throne
title_english: How to Put Your Savior on the Throne
synopsis:
When Ines is sent back in time, she vows revenge on the man who betrayed her. But just as she's consumed by vengeance, she crosses paths with Carson—the man who once saved her life in her previous timeline. Drawn together, they find that saving each other may be the key to healing themselves.

(Source: Manta)

title: Ossan Yuusha wa Kajiya de Slow Life Hajimemashita
title_english: The Pop, Who Used to Be the Hero, Started a Slow Life as a Blacksmith.
title_japanese: おっさん勇者は鍛冶屋でスローライフはじめました

title: Seiryakukon Kougou wa Fukushuu no Doku ni Saku
title_japanese: 政略婚皇后は復讐の毒に咲く
synopsis:
Amelia, the daughter of Yua Levanna's second queen, is despised by the royal family due to her inherited "poison magic," a unique ability from her mother. After enduring torment and witnessing her mother's tragic demise, as the kingdom exploited her poison for military gain, Amelia clings to her mother's dying words: "No matter what happens, don't give up."

One fateful day, the enigmatic northern empire of Saulverka announces that its emperor seeks a new wife. Meanwhile, Amelia's half-brother Craig seizes the throne of Yua Levanna by assassinating the previous king and sends Amelia to the notorious and cold-hearted Emperor Noam in Saulverka. Her reception by Noam is chilling and unwelcoming.

While lamenting her existence, Amelia uncovers the truth behind her mother's death. Fueled by an intense desire for revenge, she embraces her seething anger and vows to avenge her mother against the royal family.

(Source: NHN comico)

title: Aisuru Hito wo Korosu Toki, Watashi wa Nani wo Omou Darou
title_english: To Kill My One and Only Solace
title_japanese: 愛する人を殺す時、私は何を思うだろう
synopsis:
It all began on the night of Erica's fourteenth birthday. The ruthless Imperial Army launched a brutal assault led by an enigmatic armored man, killing the citizens of her kingdom. To compound the tragedy, the Armored Man took the life of the person Erica loved most in this world—her mother—right before her eyes. What should've been a joyous celebration turned into a nightmare, leaving Erica to grapple with the heart-wrenching loss of her mother, friends, and the familiar world she once knew.

Ever since that day, Erica has vowed to avenge their deaths and kill the Armored Man. She finds solace in Raoul, a young man she meets by coincidence. As their bond deepens, Erica remains blissfully unaware that Raoul conceals a dark secret—he is the very Armored Man she seeks to destroy.

This gripping tale unravels the intertwining destinies of Erica and Raoul as they navigate the tumultuous journey of growth and hardship. Will vengeance tear them apart, or will it be the force that binds them

title: Deep Down
synopsis:
Ian dreams of executing the perfect mission and climbing the ranks to a major promotion one day. However, his ambitions are constantly thwarted by the incompetence of his subordinates, the twin brothers Dylan and Elliot. Because of them, Ian's squad is always branded as the troublemakers within the platoon.

One day, after being pushed to his limits by the twins, Ian's situation takes a darker turn when he is accused of being a spy for the enemy. To break Ian's spirit, the company commander, knowing Ian looks down on the twins, orders Dylan and Elliot to rape him. For the first time, Ian feels the grasp of real fear...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: The Bastard of Swordborne
synopsis:
Theo Ragnar, the 31st son of the mighty Grand Duke of Ragnar, was born without the legendary Ragnar Gift—a fatal flaw in a family where might is right. Labeled the "Ragnar Defect," he and his mother were betrayed, meeting a brutal end at the hands of those they trusted. But death was only the beginning. Reborn at 17, Theo awakens not only with the Ragnar Gift, but with powers far beyond imagination. Fueled by vengeance and a second chance, he sets out to claim the glory he was once denied.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Bastard of Swordborne
synopsis:
Theo Ragnar, the 31st son of the mighty Grand Duke of Ragnar, was born without the legendary Ragnar Gift—a fatal flaw in a family where might is right. Labeled the "Ragnar Defect," he and his mother were betrayed, meeting a brutal end at the hands of those they trusted. But death was only the beginning. Reborn at 17, Theo awakens not only with the Ragnar Gift, but with powers far beyond imagination. Fueled by vengeance and a second chance, he sets out to claim the glory he was once denied.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: High School Queen
synopsis:
Cheongha Kim, a legendary swordswoman from the Joseon era, awakens centuries later in the body of Dajin Park, a quiet high school student. Armed with deadly combat skills, Cheongha must face school bullies, navigate the chaos of modern-day life, and find her place in a world far different from her own. The halls of Juwon High are about to meet a warrior unlike any they've seen before.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Mamatomo to Sodateru Love Comedy
title_english: The Love Comedy Which Nurtured With a Mom Friend
title_japanese: ママ友と育てるラブコメ
synopsis:
Kyouta Kuremoto is a high school student who loves his 3-year-old sister. His parents both work, and they also do the housework and take care of the children. Sumi Akiyama is a lonely girl with beauty and a clear mind. She distanced herself from everyone because of her aura. One day, Kyouta, who was attending the entrance ceremony at his sister's kindergarten, surprised to find Sumi taking pictures like a cameraman. "Iku, how cute..." It turns out she loves her little brother! Knowing that they take care of their younger siblings, they gradually begin to deepen their relationship. Cooking, picking up their siblings at kindergarten, weekend dates. Yes, the relationship between the two is exactly like "mom friends." A childcare romcom has begun!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Don't Delete
synopsis:
Hong Tae-i had a big fight with Shin I-ru, a team member of the same group project, who did not get along with her at all. Then, she finds a strange application on her phone and meets I-ru again at a drinking party. But what is that number floating on his head? Tae-i creates an event without even realizing it.

"I don't know yet... Can you tell a little more? Tae-i noona?"

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: The Sold Off Bride
synopsis:
A noble man in silk clothing appears in front of the fifteen-year-old Eun Hong, who is about to be sold off to the courtesan house due to her father's debts. He was the same man who occasionally bought the straw shoes that Eun Hong sold at the market. After coming across him at the courtesan house, Eun Hong is sold off to him for a handsome sum of five hundred taels...

"Until you are able to fulfill five hundred tael's worth of work, you are my bride. Will you marry me?"
"I cannot do such a thing because I do not love you."
"I will give you 3 years. You can start paying back the five hundred taels after 3 years. Until then, all you need to do is pretend to be my bride."
"Pretend to be your bride?"

Choi Taewoong, the 21-year-old leader of the Fire Dragon Trade business, the largest business in Joseon. He buys and sells everything with money, but will he be able to buy a bride with money as well?

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: To Die or to Fall in Love
title_english: To Die or to Fall in Love
synopsis:
Isabella Woodville has always lived in her sister's shadow, but her life takes a dark turn when she witnesses a murder at a masquerade ball. Targeted by a masked serial killer after receiving the notorious black invitation, she's kidnapped and brought to a cursed estate. The twisted wager? Fall in love with him within 15 days, and she dies. Resist, and she survives. Caught in a deadly game of love and survival, Isabella must navigate the line between reality and the seductive fantasy she's been thrown into.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Hello, Mr. Blue
synopsis:
"She who is afraid of water, what kind of love song will she compose when she meets he who is wandering in the sea?" One day, Areum received a phone call saying that she had a younger brother who was adopted to France? That man is also a world-renowned diving expert! What exactly is going on?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment, translated)

title: Hitori de Ikiru wa Mama Naranu
title_english: You Can't Live All on Your Own!
title_japanese: ひとりで生きるはままならぬ
synopsis:
What is considered "normal" for a 30 year old? Should she be married, have a career, live independently...?

Shuko Maeda, 28, is a single office worker who lives in a shared house with her three friends. One of them is Eika Matsuki, a career woman whose life revolves around work. Then, there's Misaki Kawaseda, a musician, singer and hopeless romantic. Finally: Shio Momoyama, who works freelance and is laid back in her professional and personal life. Together, they navigate the stresses and joys of daily life as women approaching 30, in a society that has certain expectations for them, while they all try to find their own unique way to thrive!

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Monochrome no Futari
synopsis:
A reliable office worker, Hanaichi Fudo, undoubtedly had a gift for the arts but gave up on his dreams of becoming an artist to lead a normal life. One day, his senior at work, Saori Wakaba, asked Hanaichi for help in writing her manga. Will he take up the pen again?! 

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Monochrome no Futari
synopsis:

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Hypnosis Massage Parlor
synopsis:
Heejoo, struggling to maintain her exhausting work life, comes across a flyer one day: [Women-only Healing Massage Shop—OPEN EVENT!] 

An intimate massage that soothes her deep-seated fatigue begins...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Fire in the Whole
title_japanese: Fire in the whole (파이어 인 더 홀)
synopsis:
Haeseong is gradually dying in this life where he doesn't look forward to tomorrow. He planned to end his meaningless breathing himself but ends up being brought back to life by the firefighter Hyeonwoo.

Haeseong was sure there would be no reason to run into Hyeonwoo anymore, as he successfully saved him, but this man seems nosier than he thought. Hyeonwoo shows up again with a bag full of adult goods for the sake of Haeseong, who takes care of his insomnia by having sex!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Marugoshi Deka
synopsis:
Kazuto Marugoshi is a Tokyo Metropolitan Police officer who doesn't like using guns. Together with his colleague Teizo Isoji, he saves damsels in distress and solves crimes both big and small on the mean streets of Tokyo while using only martial arts.

(Source: MU)

title: Elf to Hitotsu Yane no Shita
title_japanese: エルフとひとつ屋根の下

title: Kinirobachi ni Mitsu
title_english: The Golden Bee Drops Into Honey
synopsis:
Shuuto Hachioka is an artist who is color blind. One drunken night, he meets a wealthy man named Akifumi Mitsuya. He is drawn to Akifumi, who has a refined appearance and lives in luxury. He also feels an affinity for the mysterious man's unprejudiced demeanor and soft appearance, and agrees to stay at his mansion temporarily. However, as the night wears on, Shuto is enticed by the voices he overhears and ends up witnessing Akifumi's warped proclivities. Thus begins a dangerous, deceptive story between a "pet dog" and his "owner!"

(Source: Renta!)

title: Say the Spell, Rose!
synopsis:
Kkotbun lives a miserable life as a slave in Joseon. As punishment for merely wanting an education, she is sent up a mountain to catch a rabbit in the dead of winter. When she comes across a ferocious tiger, she thinks she's met her end, but to her surprise, she wakes up in a world filled with colorful magic. Renaming herself Rose, she's now a potential pupil of the greatest light mage in the land. But with her affinity to dark magic, can she thrive rather than just survive in this new world?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Shirayuki Yume to n-nin no Yume Kareshi
title_japanese: 白雪友芽とn人の夢彼氏
synopsis:
The story revolves around Yume, who once indulged in an imaginary romance with the dream boyfriends she conjured in her notebook. She grew out of her imaginary romance as she became an ordinary member of society until something unbelievable happened one day.

(Source: ANN)

title: I Raised a Villain
synopsis:
Yeon finds herself as an extra in her own novel. To make the most out of the bizarre event, she goes on a quest to find her handsome male lead Chang. However, who she finds is none other than the younger, frail version of the antagonist Bi. Yeon finds that the "antagonist" Bi is being pushed through the narrative of a villain—can she stay by his side through it all?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Koisuru Suzume wa Ichizunari Gapponban
title_japanese: 恋する雀は一途なり合本版

title: Obsessed With Hazel the Sweet Witch
title_english: Obsessed With Hazel the Sweet Witch
synopsis:
Waking up in a fairy tale she illustrated, Hazel is rumored to be a wicked, man-eating witch. In truth, all she wants to do is bake sweets and share the kindness. So when the adorable Luna and Luca show up at the door of her gingerbread house, Hazel is determined to care for the siblings. However, things go awry when their guardian and brother, Grand Duke Elliot Blaine, show up, accusing her of kidnapping them. Now, with her charm and cooking skills, Hazel must prove she is indeed a sweet witch!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Hanarerarenai, Nigashite Yarenai
title_japanese: 離れられない、逃がしてやれない

title: Fellow Mellow
synopsis:
University student Akane is at a club hanging out with his friends when he's reunited with Mitsuhisa, a friend from high school. Akane has an idiosyncrasy so his high school classmates found him creepy and always kept a distance from him. Among them, only Mitsuhisa hung out with him without fear. Although he's forcible and selfish, Mitsuhisa has a charm that attracts people around him. Akane was also quickly attracted, got carried away, and fell into a physical relationship with Mitsuhisa. However, for some reason, Akane disappeared without a trace right after their high school graduation ceremony and cut off all ties with Mitsuhisa...

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

title: Jakdu: Shaman's Blade
synopsis:
Yongjin is a struggling orphan—a blunt realist with no time or money to spare on superstitious nonsense. But on his 16th birthday, he finds his life taking a dramatic turn when his classmate Huisu, whom he had never interacted with before, suddenly asks to be his girlfriend. For the first time, Yongjin isn't alone—but his new company isn't exactly the kind he had always wished for, as he finds himself being chased by spirits instead! Though this wasn't quite the sweet sixteen he had in mind, Yongjin must now navigate through a new world he never thought existed.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Suki nara Nugasete.
title_english: Undress Me If You Love Me

title: Wicked Spot
synopsis:
After spending over a century hiding in the shadows, powerful sorceress Sadako stumbles upon the dazzling world of social media and decides to post her way into her first real contact with humanity. She soon becomes an internet sensation, attracting a huge following of doting fans—and shocks them all by announcing she is a witch. The big reveal turns one follower called Hanako, a lonely young woman with seemingly inhuman strength and a curious resistance to magic, into a dedicated hater, and inadvertently sends them both on a whirlwind adventure beyond their wildest dreams!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Blue Flight: Ground Handling Joshi Monogatari
title_english: Blue Flight: Ground Handling Girl's Story
title_japanese: ブルーフライト～グラハン女子物語～

title: Changing the Genre From Angst to Heartwarming
title_english: Changing the Genre From Angst to Heartwarming
synopsis:
I've been reincarnated. Into a novel I used to enjoy in my past life, no less! My name is Renatis, and I'll be playing the part of little sister to the female lead in this dark, tragic whirlwind of a story where a beastly bad boy shatters my sister's hopes, dreams, and her life. My sister is too good and too beautiful, and I'm not about to let that happen to my perfect sister. So, I'm taking charge. I shall turn this dark, tragic story into a heartwarming tale of healing. I will save my sister.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Dorei Senshi no Isekai Taneuma Seikatsu: Mahou mo Bujutsu mo Saikyou da shi Harem made!?
title_japanese: 奴隷戦士の異世界種馬生活～魔法も武術も最強だしハーレムまで!?～

title: Tada no JK, Isekai de Maou ni Naru
title_japanese: ただのJK、異世界で魔王になる
synopsis:
Airi Katagiri, an ordinary high school girl, is suddenly transported to another world! In this new world, she finds demons trying to resurrect the Demon King...!? The JK Demon King descends onto the demon world! A fantasy about being transported to another world!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Manin Densha to Kimi
synopsis:
One day on the train to work, Mayama, a company employee, found his hand pushed against the chest of a young man dressed as a woman, against his will. The next day, he was coerced into a game of "molesting" with a photo taken the day before used as leverage. Tsukasa, a college student, can only feel aroused on the train due to his past trauma. Each morning, they meet in the same spot, their bodies pressed closely together until they reach their stop. As their encounters continue, they must navigate the complexities of their situation and the unexpected bond that begins to form between them.

"I have to push him away, but when he touched me, his eyes trembled with sadness, and I couldn't resist..."

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

title: Shitsuji, Sou ja Nai wa
title_japanese: 執事、 そうじゃないわ

title: Iinchou to Mondaiji no Nakayoshi♡Keikaku
title_english: The Plan to Have the Student Council President and the Problem Child Get Along
title_japanese: 委員長と問題児の仲良し♡計画

title: Gokiburi no Ie
synopsis:
1-3. Kurayami no Onna-tachi
4. Gokiburi no Ie
5. Kao no Nai Onna
6. Jukai Kitan
7. Rei to Asobuna Kodomotachi!!
8-9. Akumu no Tobira

title: Lingerie no Megami-sama
title_japanese: ランジェリーの女神さま
synopsis:
Inside of Teiou's women's underwear department, there is a goddess full of love for lingerie. Her name is Amane Ebisu—a charismatic clerk and fitter. Amane's determination allows her to help every guest with their troubles choosing underwear, or with the troubles in their hearts!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Hakoiri Create
synopsis:
Riri Raita is a tired office worker at an advertising production company. One day, a young lady named Hairu Hakoiri comes to the seat next to her as a new employee! If you read this, you might learn a thing or two about design work! Here is the start of a super authentic work 4-panel story!

He finds that his aptitude for weapons, magic, and all other combat-related skills is the lowest rand, so he takes odd-jobs repairing the castle walls and digging for minerals, where his exceptional abilities are immediately revealed. He proves to be skillful in cooking, building, mining, crafting magical tools—in fact, his aptitude for every skill unrelated to combat had an SSS-ranking! Kurt, however, seems completely unaware to his talent and ends up saving people, the town, and even the country through his unaware actions!?

However, Seonwoo happens to discover one person on campus who is not afflicted by this: Choi Mooyoung, the most famous playboy on campus! "Model? I'll do it. Go out with me instead." Will Seonwoo be able to take a picture of Mooyoung and debut safely in a famous overseas magazine?! The dilemma of a horror romance with him, who she never wanted to be involved with, begins!

title: Sosei Jikkensha Rei-gou
synopsis:
It's the Meiji era, at the height of the Russo-Japanese War. The brothers Aka Mifune and Ao Mifune, doctors at a military hospital, using the notes left by their father, commence experiments on "resuscitation" of the dead. With animal experiments on monkeys proving successful, officers eager to pursue military applications of "resuscitation" order them to perform experiments on human bodies, but midway, Ao, the younger brother, is attacked by a mysterious group of assassins and killed. So begins a suspenseful story of forbidden and bizarre medical arts!!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Shuumatsu Yarakashi Meshi

But then, a certain general practitioner appears before her and offers her a new view on medicine.

(Source: Manga Mogura)

title: 10-gatsu no Hanabi
synopsis:
After his first summer break in college, Taichi installs a dating app out of frustration at not having a girlfriend. To his surprise, he matches with a woman he once saw crying at his summer beach job...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: My Students' Guardians Are Obsessed With Me
title_english: My Students' Guardians Are Obsessed With Me
synopsis:
Eleanor died from overworking as a teacher in her past life, so now she's determined not to work! She teaches her brother to be the prince's aide so he can be the breadwinner instead. When he reveals his sister is the true genius, she is asked to tutor the siblings of the most influential men in the land: her best friend, a handsome duke, and the crown prince. How can she refuse?! But is a good education all they want from her? Maybe this time, her job won't ruin her life but lead her to love...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Villainess Extra's Guide to In-Game Purchases
synopsis:
As soon as I made 2.2 billion won through cryptocurrency, I found myself in the body of a villainous extra in a game I used to play.

On the day I hit the jackpot with crypto, I was suddenly transported into the game I had been enjoying the day before. In the game, I was destined to be used and then killed by the villainess in the early stages. To avoid this fate, I betrayed the villainess, Cleora, but was still killed in the end.

However, after returning to the first day I transmigrated, I gained the ability to use the 2.2 billion won I earned in real life as currency in the game's cash shop.

With such an enormous amount of in-game cash, will I be able to survive until the end this time?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: The Acting Empress Still Spends the First Night
title_english: The Acting Empress Still Spends the First Night
synopsis:
Zelda von Trova never wanted the title of Acting Empress, but when she's forced to wed the Emperor of the Raphion Empire in place of the runaway princess, she has no choice. Yet after sharing the first night with him, her divorce plans begin to waver. As their attraction grows, Zelda's heart is torn— will she be able to walk away when the time comes, or will love unravel all her plans?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Teach Me How to Desire
synopsis:
In a war against demons for the fate of the world, even three chances at life may not suffice. Such is the fate of Lady Sacred Beryl, a divine maiden tasked with rooting out demonic corruption, only to be murdered and travel back in time—twice. Upon her third attempt, Beryl realizes the truth: Her only hope to purify the realm is to face the fearsome House Vine, a lair of demons in mortal guise. Can Beryl survive in the domain of Duke Beleth von Vine, or will she find nothing but death and damnation once more?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: For the Princess Who Will Disappear
title_english: For the Princess Who Will Disappear
synopsis:
After a life pickpocketing, Sasha discovers she might be a princess!? Selling a necklace by mistake leads her all the way to the royal palace. Quick-witted and bold, Sasha, the street-savvy princess, and Rascan, the cold-hearted duke and her fiancé who silently stands by her side, embark on a secret romance!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: We've Already Broken Up, Your Majesty
title_english: We've Already Broken Up, Your Majesty
synopsis:
After a fatal carriage accident, Rumiere Lashantia wakes up disoriented and is diagnosed with amnesia. While her identity and distant memories remain intact, her recent memories seem to have been erased. In her journal, she finds a chilling entry: "You can't love him." The man in question is Carl Winger, her ex-lover, whom she broke up with days before. Despite not remembering him, Rumiere is drawn to Carl and is determined to uncover the truth about the nature of their relationship.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Darling, Why Can't We Divorce?
synopsis:
A sickly woman falls asleep while ruminating on the disappointing ending of a romance novel following a countess and a lost prince, torn apart by two villains: the power-hungry Duke Sylvester Lizen and his unwilling wife, Ophelia McGuffin. The woman found Ophelia's character the most tragic: because of her obsessive love for the prince, he tricks her into killing Sylvester and then ensures that she dies for her crimes.

When the woman awakens as Ophelia, she realizes she has not yet murdered Sylvester but has begun to harass the countess. She tries to divorce her wicked husband, but Sylvester only appears to enjoy her depravity. Out of options, Ophelia strikes a deal with her husband: if she successfully seduces the prince, Sylvester will grant her the divorce—but in time, Ophelia may realize that her marriage to the other villain is not all that bad.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: The Villain's Daughter-in-Law
synopsis:
Luciel, the "Crystal Fairy," creates jewels whenever she feels strong emotions. After being used and ultimately dying, she finds herself returned to the past!

"This time, I won't live like that again."

To avoid the terrible fate she remembers, she proposes a contract marriage to the most notorious villain family in the empire. But something strange happens. It was supposed to be temporary, yet...

"How about making you our daughter instead of just a daughter-in-law?"
"I've always wanted a granddaughter. You're perfect!"
"When I grow up, I'm going to marry sister-in-law!"

Wait, aren't you supposed to be the villain family? Why are you acting like this? And then there's him...

"Whether you create jewels or flowers, it doesn't matter to me." Belstein's reaper, the man who led her to ruin in her previous life, now smiles at her with a young face. "If you try to escape my sight, I'll chase you to the ends of the earth, Luciel."

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: At Your Mercy
synopsis:
Getting transported into a novel once? Unusual. Twice? Welcome to Ji-an Han's reality. Her second possession lands her in the body of a noble lady with an unfortunate reputation—the court fool. While still adjusting to this twist of fate, the enigmatic Crown Prince Iskan enters the scene with an unsettling proposition: "Take me as yours," he says, "I'll become your most cherished possession." Between her reputation as a fool and a prince whose motives remain unclear, can Ji-an navigate this complicated new reality?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: I'm Finding a New Husband
synopsis:
Riat, caught up in her husband's treason, faces death. After repeatedly returning to the past at the cost of half her lifespan, she finally breaks the cycle by offering her husband's head to the emperor. With only one year and three months left to live, her one wish is—"I'm going to fall in love."

At last, an announcement spreads across the entire empire: a competition to find Riat's new husband, with a grand prize of one billion gold. Candidates begin to flood in, but suspicious figures also start gathering around her...

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: The Immoral Duke Needs to Be Homeschooled
title_english: The Immoral Duke Needs to Be Homeschooled
synopsis:
Estella Margaret Montiel is a dedicated governess for House Bertha. However, she is currently facing more pressing matters than math or grammar. She knows her pupils' half-brother, Duke Diego Bertha, plans to kill everyone in his family! Determined to protect her students from a tragic fate, she sets out to reform the charming yet dangerous duke. Can her resolve and guidance truly transform the devilish Diego and teach him the value of family? Or will her class be dismissed much too early?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Duke's Family Is Not My Problem
title_english: The Duke's Family Is Not My Problem
synopsis:
I'm the one who was abandoned, but I think I grew up with the healthiest mindset! I went undercover as the fake's lady-in-waiting, but when I got there, my old family seemed... off? I thought, "Not my problem!" and focused on my mission, but then...

"Are you not going to live with us?" The eldest, who used to be controlling towards the fake, starts acting weird around me.

"I never thought I'd feel such camaraderie and trust with someone of the opposite sex. You make me feel strangely comfortable."

The second brother, who almost went down a dark path, managed to get his life back on track—thanks to me. I tried to ignore it and rush off to my next mission, but everywhere I go, I run into people whose lives are ruined. I mean, why is everyone so conveniently messed up for me to save them?!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: She's Not Our Daughter!
synopsis:
Sierra's peaceful village life is disrupted when her ex-boyfriend, Duke Cassius Ideos, shows up and mistakes the child she's raising as his daughter. The thing is, the girl is her niece, not her kid! When he refuses to listen to any explanation, her only option is to follow him to his duchy and await the results of a paternity test. All Sierra has to do is keep to herself for three months, but will things remain that simple when she begins to suspect that the duke still has feelings for her?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Dimension Wave
title_japanese: ディメンションウェーブ
synopsis:
Dimension Wave—a super popular VRMMO game where players can experience several years of fantasy in just twenty-four hours of real time. Enticed by the entry ticket his sisters won, a young man takes part in the project's Second Wave. However, as soon as he enters the world of the game, he finds that his sisters have played a trick: he's been transformed into a girl with the cringy name Kizuna†Exceed. But instead of letting it get to him, he decides to chill and take this new life as it comes. Without sparing a fraction of a second deciding, Kizuna immediately chooses to fish rather than fight on the front lines in this fantasy world. Alongside his sisters, Kanade and Tsumugi, a Japanese-style beauty named Shouko, Yamikage the fake ninja, and other quirky comrades, he works to enjoy his second life to the fullest.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Goto, a university lecturer, had seemingly built a happy family: a beautiful wife who is a painter and lovely, talented children... But that happiness was merely a facade. During the day, he suspected his wife of infidelity, and at night, he was tormented by nightmares, gradually wearing down his mental stability.

One day, Goto returned home to find his room in chaos and his daughter in tears. Convinced that his wife was to blame, Goto vows to protect his beloved family...!? A family suspense of immorality!

When she finally wakes up, and after a small misunderstanding, her family believe that she has amnesia, so Gina pretends to not remember asking Carlo to break off the engagement and everything from the past month. However, when Carlo does come to see her, he tells her, not about their engagement breaking up, but that he proposed and that she accepted. When a university student from the modern world is reborn as Marcia, she vows to prevent her own death while giving Lalisa the happily ever after she deserves. title_japanese: タラシくんとナルシちゃん
synopsis:
Shirata-kun, who is called the school's most "shallow" student, falls in love with Shinaharu-san, the school's most narcissistic student...? This is a handsome school love comedy between the two of them that is too frustrating.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Watashi wa Cinderella ni Korosareta
title_japanese: 私はシンデレラに殺された
synopsis:
Charlotte lives a happy family life with her kind and lovely sister-in-law, Cinderella. One day, however, she is accused of assassinating the king and is executed. It was Cinderella, of all people, who framed her for a crime she did not commit. Charlotte was supposed to have died, tormented by regret and fear. However, she wakes up again and returns to the world before she was killed...⁉ This is a "loop suspense" in which she swears revenge on her sister!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Yamazu ni Koishite, Koroshiya-san!
title_japanese: 病まずに恋して、殺し屋さん！
synopsis:
Sumika has always been unable to read the atmosphere, and people have always kept their distance from her. One day, she offers a handkerchief to someone fighting on the street, and to her surprise, that person transfers to her new school the next day...?! "I quit my job as an assassin for you. Please fall in love with me." The first confession in her life was a fearful signal that her life was being targeted by an assassin organization.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Suberu Tenshi
synopsis:
In the summer of his second year of high school, the ordinary boy with no dreams or goals, Shiroma, sees an unexpected figure of a beautiful girl in his class! The story of a youthful manzai duo through trials and errors begins here.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Kowamote Akuma wa Iyashitai!
synopsis:
All modern people are tired. Mameka Inukai is an office worker whose life is filled with work every day and she is at her wit's end. Wishing for some healing in her life, Mameka orders a cute dog demon in her drunken stupor, but what she received instead was a frightening looking demon...

The demon arrived by mistake, but it seems that his personality was actually the therapeutic type...! A slice of life comedy with frightening-looking demon to heal your tired heart.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Yana-san no Otanoshimi
synopsis:
Yana has a big attitude, cold reaction, and strong language, and she is a bad girl in full swing. But thanks to her, happiness is born! A lovable bad girl comedy for the new era!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Ren-kun wa Warui Otona
title_japanese: れんくんは悪いおとな
synopsis:
Mimi, a high school girl, has a childhood friend, Ren-kun, who is a working adult. Ren-kun is a bad adult. He pretends to go to the office and continues riding the subway to the last stop, or calls Mimi up in the middle of the night and asks her to make a cake. A relaxed life with an older childhood friend that will loosen your heart when you read it.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Oyasumi Fumi-san
title_japanese: おやすみ ふみさん
synopsis:
Rinta, who moved to the city from the countryside and enrolled in a university in the heart of the city, meets Fumi-san, rumored to be the most beautiful girl on campus, in the literature club he joined. After attending a drinking party together, he ends up walking her home. He safely escorts her to her house and is about to head back when suddenly... Fumi-san transforms and forcefully invites him to her bed—!?

"I wonder how long you can keep being a good person, Rinta-kun...?" Fumi-san pushes Rinta to his limits, testing his self-control until it shatters.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Tsuihou sareta Renkinjutsushi, Adult Goods de Sekai wo Sukuu: Donna Monster mo Zettai ni Ikaseru Otoko
title_japanese: 追放された錬金術師、アダルトグッズで世界を救う ～どんなモンスターも絶対にイカせる男～
synopsis:
"All you've made is adult goods!" Orga-Zum, whose alchemy skill turns everything into "adult goods," ends up kicked out of the party for "bringing our rank down." However, the female knight CKK Rose appears and discerns Orga's true power. The "Sex War of the End," to save the world from destruction by lust monsters, begins now.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Mabuta no Ura no Natsu
synopsis: Included one-shot: Yoru ga Akeru Mahou

title: Komugi ga Jiman no Panya-san
title_japanese: こむぎが自慢のパン屋さん
synopsis:
Komugi, a cat, has been reborn as a human in order to repay the kindness of Honami, the girl who took care of Komugi in her previous life. When Komugi visits her old home, she finds that Honami has become the manager of a bakery. "Please let me work here." It's a workplace comedy that unfolds in a small bakery located at the end of a side street off the main road!!

(Source: Square-Enix, translated)

title: Watashitachi wa Kakechigatteiru
title_japanese: 私たちはカケちがっている

title: Magokoro Scramble!
title_english: Magokoro Scramble! What Lies in Your Heart?
synopsis:
Is this love natural instinct or fate? Koharu is born to a bloodline who can read people's minds. Although he told himself he would never open up to anyone besides his family, those plans are thrown off when he meets an eccentric girl by the name of Yuki. With their encounter, Koharu begins to fall deeper and deeper... into the pit of romance!

(Source: MANGA Plus)
