(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Sajou no Chou wa Torawaretai
title_english: The Desert Butterfly Yearns to Be Caught
title_japanese: 砂上の蝶はとらわれたい
synopsis:
Seto, the young head of a desert country, was restless and dissatisfied. Even when he wanted to enjoy a night out, his personal bodyguard Kyle was too controlling. And yet, even when he provoked him, he wouldn't even lay a finger on him...

"You like me, so why won't you make a move...!?"

It's been over a decade since Seto bought Kyle, who was a slave, and they became master and servant. Although he couldn't hide his obsession, Kyle never let up on his servant appearance, so Seto grew impatient and said, "What's the big deal about being held by a man?" and Kyle finally changed...!

"If anyone's fine, then I'm fine with it being me, right?"

Seto had no way to resist the unknown pleasure he was taught...!? A love story of master and servant who can't be honest with each other!

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Aka to Kuro
synopsis: An adaptation of Stendhal's novel Le Rouge et le Noir.

title: Boku wa Ashita, Kinou no Kimi to Date suru
title_japanese: ぼくは明日、昨日のきみとデートする
synopsis:
Takatoshi Minamiyama majors in art at a university in Kyoto. On the train to the school, he sees Emi Fukuju and falls in love with her at first sight. Gathering up all his courage, he speaks to her. They begin to date and enjoy happy days together, but Emi reveals her secret to him.

(Source: MyDramaList)

synopsis:
"Makina-san, let's play." After chanting these words and tapping the card three times, a mysterious yet beautiful vengeful spirit named Makina-san will appear.

An ordinary highschooler named Ryousuke Togawa investigates the haunting that has been troubling his best friend. In the face of the menacing spirit, he does the charm taught by his upperclassman, Nishijima. Suddenly, Nishijima herself appears from thin air, declaring she is Makina-san.

(Source: Hobby Japan, translated)

4. Satoumizu

title: Shunmin Otoko no Yuuwaku
title_english: The Seduction of the Deep Sleeper
synopsis:
Toma Sugawa is a cool-headed, unsociable businessman. For some reason, he's not in a relationship, and he spends his life watching the days go by. One thing that has become a part of his daily routine, is waking up one of the tenants in his grandfather's apartment complex. That tenant is Kaoru Aida. He has countless alarms go off, and still doesn't wake up until Toma comes in to wake him. On top of that, he asks Toma to wake him up the next morning, without a lick of remorse. With an attitude like that, of course Toma is on the verge of snapping. But one day, Toma goes to wake him up as usual, and Kaoru, still sleepy, pushes him down?!

(Source: NTT Solmare)

title: Watashitachi no Oma〇ko mo Kanri Shite♡

synopsis:
High schooler Rico is determined to make her grandfather's karate dojo go viral, constantly posting on social media. Just as she's searching for the next trending topic, an alien appears?! A story of an unlikely friendship between an Earthling and a space visitor begins!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Yuujou Taikikengai

title: Leende-koku Monogatari
synopsis:
Princess Yulia leaves her home of Shriver, and travels with her father, the leader of an order of knights, to Leende, a place that is said to be cursed. When she meets Tristan, a young man with amber eyes, she begins to rethink her own life, but she soon becomes embroiled in a situation that threatens the kingdom...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Isekai Nonbiri Sozai Saishu Seikatsu
title_japanese: 異世界のんびり素材採取生活
synopsis:
Sozai Shuu, a working adult with a slightly weird habit of loving to collect raw materials, was transferred to another world by God after losing his life. In order to live leisurely, Shuu wished for "a power to live a carefree life collecting raw materials in another world." His wish was successfully granted however, his magic power is strangely enormous, and his skill is really convenient? Seems like God misunderstood that he wanted to harvest materials from monsters leisurely so the power he gave Shuu was so incredible... Nevertheless, Shuu does not take it to mind and freely uses his unique skill "Detect" in another world to search for materials, harvest them, eat them, make money off of them and lives a carefree life collecting materials.

(Source: Takarajimasha, translated)

title: Full Metal Panic! Family
title_japanese: フルメタル・パニック! Family
synopsis:
Their new mission... is to peacefully raise a family!? Full Metal returns! A thrilling new series begins!

"I'm going to need a weapon. They're in the closet. Go get them."

20 years after the climactic battle for the fate of the world, Sousuke Sagara is married to Kaname Chidori and they are living a peaceful life together.

"Dad, you want your usual carbine and grenade?"
"You're still hiding a stash!? Every time you say, 'I don't need weapons!'"
"Mama, the enemy is coming. You can complain later."

Their daughter Natsumi is a high school girl who matches her father's fighting prowess, and their son Yasuto, an elementary school boy, is a skilled hacker. Now that they have joined the family business, the word "peace" is no longer in their dictionary.......!?

A brand new series depicting the exciting daily life of the Sagara family!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Tensei Kusushi wa Hiru made Netai
title_japanese: 転生薬師は昼まで寝たい
synopsis:
Is the slow life still out of reach...? The turbulent journey in search of a peaceful land begins!

Without really knowing what was happening, Thor was reincarnated into another world, where he was granted the "Blessing of the Apothecary." This rare blessing allowed him to instantly know where to find medicinal ingredients and to mix potions in the blink of an eye! Seizing this opportunity, Thor decided to use his newfound powers to sell potions, earn money, and move to the highly cultured Zogen Empire, where he could live a quiet and leisurely life with minimal work. However, on his journey to find this peaceful place, he keeps getting caught up in troublesome situations like monster hunting missions and bandit extermination. As if that weren't enough, a massive talking cat (or something that looks like a ragdoll cat) decides to tag along with him. Through various troubles and encounters with all kinds of people, will Thor be able to safely reach his peaceful destination and achieve h

title: Shinonome-kun to wa Dekinai Kankei
title_japanese: 東雲くんとはデキない関係

title: Neko Ningen
synopsis:
Hachisuke is a cat humanoid living in a world where humans and cats coexist. But Hachisuke is withdrawn and has difficulty being loved by humans. After all, cats are still treated as cute "objects" for humans. See the world through Hachisuke's eyes as he tries to fit into modern society and endure the prejudice that comes with being different.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Spy Kyoushitsu 2-bu: Manamusume
title_japanese: スパイ教室2部 愛娘
synopsis:
With the killer virus successfully retrieved from the Galgad Empire, the girls are ready to go on even more missions! The only problem is...Klaus refuses to take them on any! Can these fledgling spies prove their skills once again and face the new evil lurking in the shadows...?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: "Hitokiri" Shoujo, Koushaku Reijou no Goei ni Naru
title_japanese: 『人斬り』少女、公爵令嬢の護衛になる
synopsis:
Shurine is a girl who was raised to serve as a guard and has mastered the sword. However, she is falsely accused of assassinating the person she is guarding and goes on the run. Driven from her hometown, Shurine meets Lutecia, a duke's daughter whose life is in danger after being caught up in a royal succession issue. As Lutecia is being attacked by an assassin, Shurine makes a proposal to her. "I'm a bit short on money. If you need a guard, I'll hire you right now." The meeting of these two will determine the fate of the kingdom! The girls' swordplay battle fantasy begins!

(Source: Micro Magazine-sha, translated)

title: Mori no Hashikko no Chibi Majo-san @comic
title_english: Little Witch at the Edge of the Forest.
title_japanese: 森の端っこのちび魔女さん@COMIC
synopsis:
Growing up deep in the forest, Misha is a thirteen-year-old girl learning how to craft medicine from nature's bounty, but she's also picked up a tremendous amount of knowledge from her mother, an estranged member of a distant tribe of remarkably skilled apothecaries. When tragedy draws the pair out of their forest home, Misha finds herself confronted with a grim truth: all the knowledge in the world is of no help if she doesn't have the experience to put it to use. Faced with her own inadequacy, the young girl resolves to learn how to put her gifts to use properly. Her world is about to expand far beyond the forest she once called home.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Watashi ga Sekai wo Sukuu Riyuu
title_english: The Reason I Save the World
title_japanese: わたしが世界を救う理由

title: Shiokaze to Ryuu no Sumika
synopsis:
Transport yourself to a remote town where mystical dragon folk live among humans.

After the passing of her father, Mizuka goes to live with her uncle in a seaside town. Mizuka is determined to embrace her new life, but she finds herself in the mysterious circumstance of living with a boy who turns out to be part dragon!

(Source: VIZ Media)

title: Kimi no Sensei demo Heroine ni Naremasu ka?
title_english: Can I Still Be Your Heroine, Even Though I'm Your Teacher?
title_japanese: 君の先生でもヒロインになれますか?
synopsis:
"I'll be making your meals from now on, Sensei."

I, Reiyu Tenjou, am a high school teacher. When I shared some food with my neighbor, it turned out to be my student, Yuunagi Nishiki. If this fact is discovered, I might be fired from the school? That's why we signed a "Neighbor Agreement" in order to keep our secret. Since we both live alone, the plan was to help each other out when one of us was in trouble—but somehow, I got won over by his cooking. Instead of helping him, I find myself increasingly spoiled and dependent that I can't live without him anymore.

"No, Reiyu Tenjou. He's your student, someone you are not supposed to fall in love with!"

Drawing closer and then apart—their love sways ambiguously like waves. A youth romantic comedy filled with secrets between a teacher and student begins here.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Ha
synopsis:
Akane, a reckless elementary schooler, chips her front tooth after jumping from the second floor of her school. As she starts visiting the dentist, she runs into Tatchi, a classmate who's stopped going to school. The two begin to get along with each other, but where will their friendship lead?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Ha
synopsis:

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Only Virgins Left Alive
synopsis:
Choi Gyutae is a French high schooler who comes to Korea as a transfer student. On his first day of class, he meets Lin Seok: a handsome student who just so happens to be in the same class. Lin Seok's friendly disposition and irresistible charm leads Gyutae to fall head over heads the moment he lays eyes on him. However, on their way back home Seok says something that makes Gyutae lose all hope of the two of them ever dating: "Guys who don't keep their virginity...should really just go die." Taken aback by this unrealistic condition for love, Gyutae decides to settle for the two of them remaining platonic for the rest of their lives. Six years later, they've become good roommates and even better friends. But when Gyutae witnesses something that shocks him to his core, their relationship might be in danger. Will a misunderstanding cause their friendship to be dead in the water? Or will their relationship be able to survive the competition?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: 4 Week Lovers
synopsis:
Wanna fake-date for 4 weeks?

Dojun's life at college is off to a perfect start! Until he meets his roommate, Jaehee, a high school friend whom he may have ghosted. Jaehee claims he's over their unresolved past, but after an accident resulting in a fractured wrist, he makes Dojun a proposition...

(Source: Manta)

title: The Ron Project
synopsis:
An unprecedented virus spreads across the world.

After deserting the military upon learning the truth behind its human experiments, Tae-an is captured once again. When he wakes up, the first thing he sees is the gentle smile of the laboratory director watching him.

Trapped inside an obsession he cannot understand, Taehan begins to slowly break.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Gilded Seven
synopsis:
With the criminals of "La Llorona" finally caught after a successful raid, Keigo and his team's celebration of success is short-lived when disaster strikes: Yellowstone erupts! In the chaos of the eruption, Keigo is separated from his fellow officers and flung towards his death—except, when Keigo comes to, he's perfectly fine, but he quickly learns he's far from home. That's when he comes face-to-face with someone he never expected to meet: Abraham Lincoln. 

Somehow, Keigo has been sent back to the wild American West of the 1800s, only this isn't the same period he learned about. Here, Abraham Lincoln was still shot, but never died. And that's not even the most surprising news he drops on Kiego: the six dangerous members of "La Llorona" are here too! Throw out the history books and get ready for a new take on the American Wild West! 

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Mii-chan to Yamada-san
title_japanese: みいちゃんと山田さん
synopsis:
In the heart of Shinjuku, there are a variety of host and hostess nightclubs open to customers seeking a night of indulgence with a gorgeous companion. Yamada is one of those companions. She balances university and work, but finds herself more interested in becoming a model hostess than a star pupil. The pay is too tempting to resist, which is why so many girls come and go in the industry. But in 2012, she meets someone completely different. Mii-chan is a petite young woman who seems to be rather useless at most things—barely able to read or write and, unfortunately, clumsy—earning her ridicule from staff and customers alike. However, her bright energy and endless motivation proves hard to ignore, and Yamada finds herself drawn in by Mii-chan's charm.

A beautiful and tragic story about an unlikely friendship and the unfortunate end that separated them forever.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Belladonna no Koibito
synopsis:
Bella has been cursed with a poison that takes the life of anyone she touches. The only way to break the curse is to receive "true love"... Before long, Bella is living a life of solitude in the woods of the rumored "Witch of Poison," but one day she meets Anna, an unsuccessful painter...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Mahou Shoujo ni Yasashii Gal
title_english: Gal Who Are Kind to Magical Girls
title_japanese: 魔法少女にやさしいギャル

title: Hiding a Warehouse in the Apocalypse
title_english: Hiding a Warehouse in the Apocalypse
synopsis:
Imagine you are stuck inside a warehouse while the world is experiencing an apocalypse. That's exactly what's happening to Jeong-gyeom, except he suddenly awakens a very odd but powerful ability to store anything in a parallel dimension, giving him the tools to defeat the creatures wreaking havoc on the world. But as he ventures into the ravaged city of Seoul, he realizes there is more to this apocalypse than meets the eye as he encounters other survivors and mysterious monsters on his quest to find his family.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Yamiochi Yuusha no Haishin Haishin: Tsuihou sare, Kakushi Boss Heya ni Hourikomareta Kekka, Boss to Tansakushagari Haishin wo Hajimeru @comic
title_japanese: 闇堕ち勇者の背信配信~追放され、隠しボス部屋に放り込まれた結果、ボスと探索者狩り配信を始める~@comic
synopsis:
It's been fifty years since dungeons first appeared on Earth. In the present day, dungeon exploration and live streaming have become commonplace. Kuga became a dungeon explorer alongside his close friends, but because he's a "jack-of-all-trades, master-of-none" hero, he ends up getting banished from the party.

In his despair, Kuga is tossed into the hidden boss room, which is rumored to be impossible to return from alive. There, he encounters Alicia, a vampire beauty. He prepares himself for death, but Alicia seems very interested in human streaming, and asks: "Could you teach me how to stream?"

With nowhere to go, Kuga reluctantly agrees to Alicia's proposal, and they start an unprecedented explorer-hunting stream. For some reason, their stream goes viral at an abnormal rate, and an unknown power awakens in Kuga...? Meanwhile, something strange is happening to the party members who banished Kuga...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Fuku wo Kiru nara Konna Fuu ni For Ladies'

title_japanese: 服を着るならこんなふうに for ladies'

title: Tetsumo Syndrome

title_japanese: テツモ・シンドローム
synopsis:
The "everyday" lives of Fuuna Minami, an eccentric girl who loves model railroading, and Mari, a normal girl, become "extraordinary" with nostalgic products from the early days of N gauge.

(Source: Neko Publishing, translated)

title: Tsukiaikirenai Mainichi
title_japanese: 付き合いきれない毎日

title: Douwa Meikyuu
synopsis:
Welcome to the labyrinth of stories... authored by Mimei Ogawa, whose works stand alongside Grimm and Anderson. In this work, Nodoka Tsurimaki has drawn our generation and all future generations into the author's beautiful fairy-tale world. Together with Ogawa, a boy lured in by a strange signboard, please take your time and have your fill of this space between dreams and reality. And please, make sure not to lose your way in this vibrant world of fairy-tales...

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Yankee JK Kuzuhana-chan: Another Side of Heroine
title_japanese: ヤンキーJKクズハナちゃん アナザー・サイド・オブ・ヒロイン

title: Phantom Whispers
synopsis:
Noa has struggled with hearing unsettling voices since she was a child. But when a mysterious murder takes place, the voice in Noa's head urges her to uncover the killer. With the police skeptical and her sanity on the line, Noa must navigate a web of fear and suspicion, guided by a ghost, to catch a ruthless killer before she herself becomes the serial killer. Will Noa uncover the murderer, or will her own mind betray her?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Tales of the Unusual 2
synopsis:
From twisted games of evil demons and the roaming of the undead to strange technology that makes the impossible happen, dive into Tales of the Unusual 2, another thrilling collection of supernatural horror stories that will have you scrolling for hours. With just the right balance of dark humor and the unexpected, each short story pulls you into a new immersive world and unravels plot twists you never would've imagined. Just remember, there's nothing to be afraid of... If you have nothing to hide.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Pieces of Humans
synopsis:
"Healed Zombies," those with rotting bodies but sound minds, are desperate for living humans; not just to kill but to receive transplants of their healthy body parts and survive! Fragmented spirits, fragmented bodies, and fragmented humanity... this is the desperate survival of broken people, left only with pieces of humans!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Shinigami no Houshuu
synopsis:
A job-hunting Grim Reaper encounters an elementary school student with a certain wish... What is the "real" job of this most un-deathlike Grim Reaper?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: 69 University
synopsis:
In a world where sex rules everything, 69 University is the best sex college in the country. Students here will become the leading talents of the country's sex industry. Hidden behind the prestigious title, 69 University's dirty side is a promiscuous campus life where the moaning never stops. Will I be able to graduate safely?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Ubu na 27-sai to Muku na 11-sai
synopsis:
A comedy about an adult who isn't good at socializing and a child who is innocent. Under one roof! Natsuki Jougyouji is a talented company employee who is dedicated to her job... but she is inflexible and not good at socializing. Kaya Kozakura is a hard-working, cheerful, and positive child who knows how to look for the good in people. The two end up living together by chance. Will they be able to live safely under the same roof with the age difference between them?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

But for Soo-In, Eunho's ex-girlfriend was too strong of a force. There was nothing she could do for him other than hug him tightly when he was sad. So now it has to be revealed. Even the men he's dated have broken up with him because they cannot keep up with his obsession. In the end, he takes his last challenge and searches for a sex partner under the pretense of a roommate... But he met Choi Hyun, a roommate who suited Tae-oh's taste more than he could have imagined! I, Mizuki Saiki, have an older twin sister named Miyuki: and to suit her own purposes she is practically forcing me to crossdress, so that I can attend her all-girls school as a female student in her place.

"But this way, I can stay together with my beloved childhood friend Kaya-chan... as long as I don't get found out!"

Mamori, a youkai otaku who's been treated as a weirdo, witnesses her classmates being attacked by strange monsters. Can Mamori save her classmates from the monsters? As descendants of a divine flower, women of the Sacred Bloom tribe have the power to heal all wounds as well as release an irresistible scent that renders all men lovestruck. Ari is the last surviving member of her tribe, but she has yet to learn how to control her mysterious powers. When Prince Dokyeom learns of this, he vows to protect Ari and eventually make her his bride and empress of Dowol. But as Ari's powers awaken, can she keep other men at bay long enough for her to become empress?

(Source: Tapas Media)

When Ilulu came to our world, she had plans for chaos and destruction! And now? She's working at a candy shop with the owner's teenage grandson, Taketo, as her supervisor. But Ilulu's sense of humor and lack of knowledge for the human world, combined with her busty—er, boisterous personality—makes things quite difficult for Taketo, a simple, growing young man who just so happens to suffer from the occasional nosebleed. 

A fun and flirty slice-of-life comedy about a clueless dragon living in the human world and the boy who has to keep her in check!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Wolf Under Sheep's Clothing
synopsis:
Orphaned at a young age, Estelle Serenity couldn't have made it without her childhood friend Rickert. People say there's no such thing as platonic relationships between a young man and a woman, but Estelle truly believes their sacred friendship will last forever... that is until one night at the masquerade, Estelle hooks up with a charming stranger. When she wakes up the next day in bed with none other than Rickert, Estelle must decide whether she'll protect her friendship or give this new thing a try... But Rickert seems to have other ideas, like a wolf drooling after a clueless ewe...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

Freshman Ji Yulmu looks like the ultimate bookworm: thick glasses, baggy clothes, and a quiet, studious vibe. But inside her little green notebook? Nothing but filthy fantasies and kinky stories she'd never dare say out loud. That is, until her campus crush, upperclassman Jeong Wook, finds it. Instead of judging her, he's thrilled, and he wants to "talk" about her writing. Now Yulmu is getting dragged into Wook's mysterious X-Games club, where nothing is as innocent as it looks... and everyone, from Cha Ji-un to Seon Inhyeok, wants to play.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: My Blood-Curdling Campus Life
synopsis:
A cute guy with an angelic face? Check. A cold and aloof outsider with a cat? Check. A class full of vampires? Check... Wait, what? All her life, Seonha Shin has lived in the shadow of her sister, Seonghye, who is one year older than her. Luckily, there is one thing Seonha does better than her sister—donating blood! When Seonha gets special admission into a prestigious university as a blood donor, she finally starts to feel like the main character of her life. Little did she know she'd be surrounded by vampires!

When Iru starts college, she unexpectedly meets Ha-im, a guy who looks just like Hayul—the one who used to torment her as a child. She feels uneasy around him yet finds herself drawn to his seemingly perfect nature. Is it really okay for her to open up her heart to him?

Lawrence and Holo have settled into an idyllic life together after opening the Spice and Wolf bathhouse, but their happy marriage is suddenly intruded upon by an unexpected guest. During Nyohhira's sleepy off-season, the gruff stranger wanders alone from door to door as if in search of fleeting memories from long ago. Soon after his silent arrival, rumors about the possible construction of a rival hot spring village begin to spread. To protect their new home, the wise wolf and the cunning merchant return to the town of Svernel, but what they find there may spell the end of their adventures for good...

(Source: Yen Press)

synopsis:
Lara Bradley, a renowned mage, sets off to defeat a low-risk monster with her young apprentice Alistair, who never stops proposing to her. But instead of a minor threat, they encounter the world's most dangerous creature—a dragon! In a desperate bid to save Alistair, Lara faces the dragon alone and casts a spell that turns herself to stone.

Twenty years later, the petrification spell breaks, and Lara awakens in a world that has moved on—except for Alistair, who never forgot her. The boy she once knew has grown into a powerful, determined man who's eager to make up for lost time with his beloved master. As they reconnect, will sparks fly, or are they doomed to repeat past mistakes?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Arase Itou has the ability to see a few minutes into the future, but the glimpses he sees are always linked to misfortune. With his kind-hearted nature, Arase decides to use this inconvenient power to help girls facing various troubles and prevent their unfortunate futures. However, Arase doesn't realize that, little by little, the girls are growing fond of him. And he remains oblivious to the quiet rivalries forming between them over his attention.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

synopsis:

That is...until he was transferred to the Entertainment Department and became the worst performing reporter there. As he felt more and more desperate to come up with a good story, his former colleague hooked him up with the tickets to an after party, where he met the hottest celebrity, Kang Min-woo. During the party Min-woo takes interest in Hae-soo and makes him an interesting proposition that could potentially benefit the both of them. However as Hae-soo begins to help Min-woo and go along with his plans, he can't help but feel that Min-woo wants more than just an acting partner. Hae-soo can't turn Min-woo down because he needs the scoop! What does Min-woo want with Hae-soo? How will Hae-soo protect his life between his crumbling job and his shady informant?

Jeongyeom has avoided his arranged marriage for years, but with mounting pressure from the other family, he can no longer delay. Yet, his heart has already been claimed by someone irreplaceable—his younger brother, Dong-im. Dong-im is not only Jeongyeom's forbidden love but also the one Jeongyeom has kept by his side, no matter the cost.

In the biting chill of winter, longing for a spring that may never come, Jeongyeom finds himself once again drawn to Dong-im's room.

"Dear brother, how does it feel? How does it feel to marry my woman?"

Nie Mozuno is a small, timid boy with a weak personality, often targeted by delinquents or stumbling into open manholes—just a typical "prey" type with a knack for attracting trouble. For most, kumdo is just a hobby. Practitioners are there to entertain and Si-ho Ye is the best entertainer of them all. Quicker, more agile, and more experienced than most, he was a force to be reckoned with in the kumdo world. Si-ho was content living his life as the best at something that barely mattered until the day his sister died. Convinced she was murdered and determined to take revenge, Si-ho sets out to show the dark underbelly of Korea why swordsmen were once revered...and feared.

K-pop idol Yoon Eden has wasted away for years under a mediocre label with an incompetent CEO. He is disillusioned and on the verge of quitting when he's sent back in time to the day of his debut. Now, Eden is determined to use his songwriting talent to rewrite his career and gain some well-deserved fame. Despite his CEO still pushing cheesy songs and tacky concepts, can Eden, with the help of his group members, truly reignite his spark and become a sincerely dazzling idol?

synopsis:
Im Hyunsung was a famous chef and restaurateur until he met his untimely death at the hands of his family. In his final moments, he is given the chance to get revenge, but only if he completes a special quest: save the failing idol group Climax as its leader, Cheon Yise! Equipped with Hyunsung's entrepreneurial and cooking skills, will Yise pull the group together and help Climax rise to the top for a successful comeback? Or will the group—and his new life—be on the chopping block?

title: Koisuru Kaseifu
synopsis:
Living under the same roof as someone who rejected you!? This is the premise of a housekeeper-themed omnibus series.

Suzuki, who works for a housekeeping agency, finds himself assigned to a particularly troublesome client. To his surprise, he discovers that this client is none other than a former classmate who turned him down when he confessed his feelings back in high school!

The most unexpected of friends, Ilay's personality and family background are nothing like Luca's. However, it is through their differences that the two friends will begin to shape not only each other, but even the very planet on which they live.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Sultry Satisfaction
synopsis:
After breaking off her engagement to her douchebag fiance, the last thing Jae-eun expects is to start sleeping with her boss, Seokwon. But when an intimate night of drinking leads to a heated tryst at a hotel, the unlikely pair learn that they have unmatched chemistry in the bedroom. This then sparks a passionate coworkers-with-benefits relationship that puts more at risk than their reputation at the office. With Seokwon being a single father and Jae-eun's recent breakup, they both know bringing feelings into the mix will only complicate things. Still, keeping things purely physical proves easier said than done.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Nameless actress Kim Young-won. The role she had desperately wanted was snatched away by an old rival, backed by the power of a wealthy sponsor. Determined not to let it go, Young-won follows her and encounters a man known as the 'sponsor.' In a fit of anger, she impulsively kisses him. However, this man is not the 'sponsor' she thought. Years later, after his military service, Suyeong attends a welcome party and runs into Chaeri, who has transferred as a new student to his school. Meanwhile, Jong-u is plagued by the ghost of "Room 203," his former neighbor who came within inches of killing him. His sick brother Jongseok was his only reason for living, but with Jongseok now dead, will he help Da-eun? And will Gyuheon ever be found?

Too determined to abandon his ambitions, he discovers a book written by the founder of magic itself, and it teaches him to do magic without AI. Suddenly much more powerful than his classmates and school bullies, it seems he might have a bright future after all—if he can survive the secret plots against him.

Shin Hyuk, the Korean leader of the elite special forces unit "55," composed of the world's best black agents, is devastated when his younger sister, Soo Min, who dreamed of becoming an idol trainee, is murdered in South America. The world tries to cover up the truth. Abandoning everything to investigate his sister's death, Shin Hyuk uncovers that the international drug cartel "XICA" is a likely culprit. In pursuit of revenge, he deliberately approaches the global K-pop star Yoo Chae-won, whom they originally targeted, as her bodyguard. Ultimately, he plunges into Brazil's deadly favela, a land where even the gods have turned their backs...

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: The Fire Fighter
synopsis:
Cheol-woong, an ordinary college student who was contemplating what to do with his life, finds himself on the path to becoming a firefighter after saving a life in a fateful incident. However, in the early 2000s, the treatment of firefighters in South Korea was far from what Cheol-woong had imagined. As a new firefighter, he dedicates himself fully to his duties. One day, he encounters an event that will become a turning point in the history of firefighting in South Korea.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Sweet Bitter Sweet
title_japanese: スイート・ビター・スイート
synopsis:
Mashiba's one reprieve from overwork is buying jewel-like chocolate from a shop he once found by chance. After a long stretch of going without his sweet treat, work finally gives him time to stop by. However, the shop closes right before he arrives, leaving him dejected. Thanks to prince-like chocolatier Minemura's kindness, however, Mashiba receives the opportunity to taste test new products. The sweet taste of chocolate and kindness makes him cry. Anyone would blush from the combination of sweet treats, a kind, handsome man, and a warm, consoling hand to rub their back. But, one day, Minemura makes things physical when the two of them leave his shop...!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Busamen Gachi Fighter

synopsis:

One day, he stumbles upon a way to travel to another world. When a mysterious status screen appears on his computer, Shigeru sacrifices his looks to gain an overwhelming 100 trillion and 5,100 parameters. Now reborn as an "Absolute God," he begins his second life in another world.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Nigate na Koibito
synopsis:
A straight-forward coming-out love story between a cool high school boy and a handsome classmate who fall in love!! Kasahara, a high school student , is outed as gay at school and then isolated from his class. The only person whose attitude doesn't change is his classmate, Katou. Irritated by Katou's kindness, Kasahara blurts out, "What would you do if I told you I like you?" However, upon hearing this, Kato makes a bold move, saying, "I like you too!!" And so they start dating!?

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

Rindo Tachibana is a clerk at a piercing and accessories shop who is too kind for his own good. Unfortunately, he's got bad luck with the ladies, and on top of that...he's being stalked. When Rindo suddenly gets asked out by a girl who is everything he ever wanted, he feels it may be too good to be true. And it is.

After getting handcuffed to the bed at a nearby love hotel, Rindo finds out that the girl he thinks is his type actually turns out to be a man...the man who's been stalking him! It feels a bit different hearing ""I love you"" from the man that ten minutes ago you thought was your ideal girl...

Get ready for a boys' love manga following a friendly man and his stalker that loves him dearly. What will come of their relationship after they have...sex?!

(Source: NHN comico Corp.)

title: Manga de Wakaru CPU

Ayumi vows to find out everything she can about her new nemesis. Lucky for her, Yuu Kano, the genius programmer behind the Shooting Star, is willing to teach her all about the inner workings of the microprocessor—the "brain" inside all computers, phones, and gadgets.

(Source: No Starch Press)

But his present normal life as a high school student changes with the arrival of transfer student Mai Shiina, who also has a secret herself.

Among the vampire exterminators, there is a unit of "troublemakers," a.k.a. "Mazarasou." Newly assigned there is Reo, a girl with a certain secret. Haru Nitta has just entered junior high and is confused by the changes around him. That is when he is approached by a mysterious older sister one evening on a park bench.

"Come on, boy. Choose your Bey."

One day, Taku, who lives in Tokyo, receives news of his grandmother's death. He visits his hometown of Kobe for the funeral, but... This is a story about a man who reflects on himself after the death of a loved one.

title: Ano Kiss wo Tadotte
synopsis:
Twenty-year-old Kouta works at a local guest house, and when a new part-timer joins the staff, he's mortified to learn it's someone he never thought he'd see again—his junior high classmate, Chizuru. Not only do these two share a past, they've shared a kiss, albeit one that only happened because of a "punishment game." Thanks to that, Kouta assumes Chizuru wants nothing to do with him. Yet the moment these two former classmates are alone together, Chizuru kisses Kouta again, then confesses he took the job just to be with him! Is this another cruel prank, or a chance to start over?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Isekai de Toshishita Kishi ni Sewa wo Yakareteimasu

title_japanese: 異世界で年下騎士に世話を焼かれています
synopsis:
Mitsuki is an ordinary thirty-something office worker leading a monotonous life. His routine's suddenly shattered when he tries to help a girl in distress, only to be transported to another world. While the girl's meant to be there, Mitsuki's out of place, and nobody knows what to do with him. Fortunately, Volk, a noble knight, takes it upon himself to care for Mitsuki–even gently tending to him after he's rendered unconscious from an injury. But when Mitsuki comes to, it's not Volk next to him but a large black wolf! Just who—or what—is Volk and how is Mitsuki expected to survive in this unfamiliar world?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Neko no Oshigoto
synopsis:
Ever wondered what it would be like if your cat had to get a job? The cats in this book do every kind of occupation you can imagine, and they do it just the way they like. Feline chefs, dentists, wrestlers, detectives, opera singers and much more await in this hilarious full-color collection! Also includes a set of stickers featuring some of the working cats!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Kimi wa Ore no Tsuma ni Naru no Dakara
title_japanese: 君は俺の妻になるのだから

Alice, heiress of the prestigious Cunningham Hotel Tokyo, knows just how lucky she is. Her fiancé Reiji, the Cunninghams' dedicated secretary, is handsome, cool, and responsible—and Alice is completely head over heels for him. Yet no matter how fervently she expresses her love, his responses are always ice-cold. Sure, he'll tease her with passionate kisses, drive her wild with his touch, and ensure she drowns in waves of pleasure. But what she truly desires is his heart! Does Reiji love her or is it purely physical between them?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Ato wa Gojiyuu ni Douzo! Tutorial de Kamisama ga Last Boss Taoshichatta node, Watashi wa Suki Houdai Ikiteiku
title_english: Knock Yourself Out! The Goddess Beat the Final Boss in the Tutorial, So Now I'm Free to Do Whatever

synopsis:
My name's Karina—or at least, it is now! I used to be a nondescript, run-of-the-mill Japanese salaryman until I was whisked away to a divine realm where the Goddess of Time and Space told me I'd be living a new life in a new world—and as a girl, since apparently she prefers it that way. First she wants me to beat some final boss she has a grudge against, then she takes control of my body to show me how to use my new spatial magic powers in a tutorial fight... Wait, isn't that the final boss I'm supposed to beat?! Less than in a minute into the tutorial and he's dead?! And now she says the world's my oyster. Seriously?!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Ken to Mahou to Gakureki Shakai: Zense wa Gariben Datta Ore ga, Konse wa Kazemakase de Jiyuu ni Ikitai
title_english: Pens Down, Swords Up: Throw Your Studies to the Wind
title_japanese: 剣と魔法と学歴社会 ～前世はガリ勉だった俺が、今世は風任せで自由に生きたい～
synopsis:
The third son of a viscount, Allen Rovene has hated studying since the day he was born. And no wonder—after suddenly regaining the memories of his past life at the age of twelve, he realizes he spent the entirety of his previous life hunched over a desk, studying like a studyholic! Reborn into his dream world of swords and magic, he's determined to make the most of his second chance by ditching the books and living a carefree, unburdened life—until he realizes the path to freedom has a detour in the form of the most renowned school in the kingdom: the Royal Knight and Mage Academy of Yugria. To become the magic-wielding, sword-swinging adventurer of his dreams, Allen's going to have to repurpose his well-honed study skills toward one goal—passing the hellish entrance exams and heading to the Royal Academy!

Luckily, dungeon crawling is a job that anyone can do—even a child. To provide for her family, Mercedes begins training at the age of a kindergartener, and because she’s from a nation of vampires, she fortunately has the potential to become strong. At the eleventh hour, she regains her memories from a previous life and unlocks the secrets to her skill: a power that allows her to order gourmet food directly from Earth! Arriving on the dragon's island, she sets about gaining his trust with tasty treats. Whether she's serving up dry-aged beef or a roasted ham and cheese sandwich cooked over a salamander's flame, these delicacies are sure to delight the hungry dragon!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Doubutsu Byouin no Ofutarisan
title_english: Two Guys at the Vet Clinic
title_japanese: 動物病院のおふたりさん
synopsis:
Takaha, a veterinary student, finds a stray cat that needs help and rushes it to an animal hospital...where he falls in love at first sight with Baba, the director. Trying to get closer to him, Takaha gets a job there, and Baba's flirtatious behavior inflames his feelings till he can no longer repress them... A slow burn age-gap BL story about a straightforward younger veterinarian and his complicated boss!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Elite Jieikan ni Dekiai sareteru... Rashii desu? Moshikashite, Kore tte Koi desu ka?
title_english: Adored By an Elite Officer: Could This Be Love?
title_japanese: エリート自衛官に溺愛されてる…らしいです?: もしかして、これって恋ですか?
synopsis:
Not only has Nagiko's employer gone belly up, but she's also been dumped by her longtime boyfriend! Feeling adrift, she reunites with her childhood friend Kouhei Samegawa for the first time in years. And in the middle of catching up, he...proposes marriage?! The engagement may seem impulsive, but Kouhei is clumsy, sweet, kind, and completely devoted to his new wife! What's more, his job in the Japanese Self-Defense Force requires daily training, and his extraordinary declarations of love never stop! Hearts will flutter in this newlywed romance!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

2. Yoi Akari (Evening Light)

title: Nazotoki wa Dinner no Ato de
title_japanese: 謎解きはディナーのあとで
synopsis:
Reiko Houshou, heiress to a large conglomerate, seems like any other wealthy lady. However, not many people know that she is a rookie detective for the Kunitachi Police Department. In addition, she hides her identity from her incompetent boss, Kyouichirou Kazamatsuri, a flashy heir to his family's motor business.

During an investigation involving her college friends, Reiko has trouble identifying the culprit and their motive. Out of nowhere, a man approaches Reiko and introduces himself as Kageyama, her newly assigned butler. As soon as Reiko confides in him about her worries, he criticizes her lack of deduction skills and helps her quickly crack the case. Now with the sharp-tongued Kageyama at her side, Reiko may just become the detective she desires to be.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Shabake
synopsis:
It is the Edo period. Ichitarou, the young master of Nagasakiya, one of the largest stores in Nihonbashi, has been in poor health since birth and is unable to go out. However, Ichitarou is always protected by demons such as Shirasawa and Inugami, who serve him. One night, Ichitarou goes out secretly and witnesses a murder. From that day on, bizarre murders begin to occur one after another in Edo... With the help of the demons, Ichitarou's search for the culprit begins!

(Source: Official site, translated)

title: Love Is an Illusion! Superstar
synopsis:
Byul, a popular alpha and a first-year high school student, once trained to be an idol but has since left that path to attend school like a regular kid. His world takes an unexpected turn with the sudden birth of a younger sibling, introducing new challenges to his daily routine. Byul's childhood friend, Siwoo, has secretly harbored feelings for him for years. However, both being alphas, Siwoo has kept his emotions hidden.

As the two navigate their growing closeness after a period of time apart, Byul faces adolescence head-on, grappling with friendships, family relationships, and his sense of identity. Along the way, he rediscovers his passion for music and begins to mature through these transformative experiences.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Justice Deserved
synopsis:
Ever feel like the legal system's punishment just isn't enough? Taepil Kim knows that feeling better than anyone. Ever since he was slapped with ten years in prison for retaliating against two burglars who killed his wife and left his son in a coma, he stopped having faith in the kind of justice the judicial system could bring. But one day, he's given the opportunity to become a Punisher—a government-authorized vigilante who acts according to the Code of Hammurabi. The bad guys better watch out now, because Taepil is determined to give them a taste of their own medicine...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Hanarete Kudasai, Meisen-san
title_japanese: 離れてください、冥仙さん

title: Demons' Crest
synopsis:
Sixth-grader Yuuma Ashihara and his twin sister, Sawa, are playing Actual Magic, a brand-new virtual reality MMORPG, when it suddenly begins fusing with the real world. Amid all the chaos and confusion, it becomes clear that death is lurking around every corner, including when Yuuma runs into his classmate Sumika. Before, she was one of the cutest girls in his class, but she's since undergone a terrible metamorphosis—into one of the game's horrifying monsters! From the author of Sword Art Online and Accel World comes a story beyond VR and AR, where gaming and reality are one and the same...and staying alive is just the beginning!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Tsuihou sareta Maou wa Chikyuu wo Mezasu!
title_english: The Exiled Demon Lord Heads to Earth!
title_japanese: 追放された魔王は地球を目指す!
synopsis:
The Demon Lord was purged from the demon race and sealed away by the Hero, but an eternity has elapsed and she has finally been revived! She awakens in a wasteland, with stars twinkling in the pitch-dark sky, the air feeling somewhat thin, and somehow her body feeling light... When she regains her composure and searches for any sign of the Hero, she finds he seems to be on a faraway blue planet in the sky...? She doesn't know where she is, but putting that aside, the Demon Lord will make strenuous efforts to defeat the Hero!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Omawarisan, Mata Ashita
title_english: See You Again Tomorrow, Mr. Policeman
synopsis:
Haruto's a popular, kind, and reliable policeman. During one of his patrol shifts, he almost gets into an accident, but is luckily saved by a tall, handsome guy named Sakura who catches and carries him off like a princess!

Sakura's younger and stronger than Haruto, and he's currently working as a bodyguard for a celebrity. Haruto can't help but be enamored with him, even as another man. When Haruto tries to get close to Sakura, he quietly distances himself from him... It seems Sakura has some kind of trauma when it comes to cops. However, Haruto's cheerful nature eventually gets Sakura to open up. Heart-throbbing events unfold as Haruto starts to discover a side of Sakura that only he gets to see...!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Kore ga Saigo no xxx kamo
Vigilante 2
synopsis:
After graduating from the Korean National Police University and becoming a detective, Jiyong is assigned to investigate a suspicious report and comes face-to-face with a nationwide jeonse scam. As he confronts criminals who slip through the cracks of the legal system without proper punishment, Jiyong begins to question the rules of vigilante justice he once set for himself. While pursuing the scam’s ringleaders, the four vigilantes receive a threat from someone who knows their true identities and begin to sense the looming presence of a far greater evil.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Konya, Uchi ni Oide: Reitetsu Joushi no Risei ga Toketara
title_english: Come over Tonight: Melting Down My Ice Cold Boss
title_japanese: 今夜、うちにおいで～冷徹上司の理性が溶けたら
synopsis:
All I need in life is a decent job and some money. Or that's what I thought. Sayako Tono, who works as a chief at a company, has been living a frugal life unrelated to romance. Sayako comforts her subordinates disciplined by Director Yukisada, who is rumored to be good-looking but very strict, but she also realizes his kindness. One day, Sayako comes home to find her apartment in trouble and finds out that the new landlord is Yukisada. "Would you like to stay at my place until you find the next room?" A cohabitation love comedy between a handsome cool boss and a caring girl!

(Source: Amutus, edited)

title: Medical Top Surgeon
synopsis:
"The key to a successful operation lies in Seongil Seoul Hospital itself."

Yoo Jinwon, a specialist in surgical operations, receives a request to perform a secret surgery from Seong Wooje, the chairman of South Korea's largest corporation, the Seongil Group. At long last, the opportunity for revenge has arrived! Can Yoo Jinwon not only conquer Seongil Seoul Hospital but also seize control of the entire Seongil Group with just a scalpel? Let the battle no one thought possible begin.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Monster General Recorded Legacy
synopsis:
Frozen human? A martial arts supreme leader the world never knew! The slumbering Strange Master awakens!

After falling unconscious due to an unexpected accident, he wakes up to find that thirty years have passed. During that time, his sect, the White Sword Sect, has fallen into decline and was destroyed by the martial world's forces. He learns the tragic news that Jin Yeongrim, his senior and the sect leader, has met a grim end.

The man whose mere presence made the martial arts world tremble—Sword Master Yu Jangryeong. His legacy has been entirely inherited by a man the world has never known—Ja Un-hyun.

In this unfamiliar world, where his loved ones are now part of the past, Ja Un-hyun transcends conventions and life-and-death struggles. With his unpredictable eccentricity and unparalleled martial arts skills, he embarks on a thrilling, action-packed journey filled with laughter and boldness.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Gekitsumi Dungeon desu ga "Skill: Hanshoku" de Gyakuten shitai to Omoimasu
title_english: It's a Very Crowded Dungeon, but I Want to Turn It Around with "Skill: Breeding"
title_japanese: 激詰みダンジョンですが《スキル：繁殖》で逆転したいと思います
synopsis:
Reborn as a dungeon master in another world, Akira Hanamura quickly constructs a comfortable dungeon within his first 30 minutes in this new realm. However, he soon realizes his creation is a "zero-defense" setup—vulnerable to the constant influx of adventurers and, if conquered, spells instant death for him. Faced with this dire predicament, Akira must use his unique "Reproduction" skill to multiply his monster minions and fortify the dungeon. With each encounter, he gradually transforms his humble lair into an ultimate stronghold, utilizing strategies, monster alliances, and swift adaptability to fend off every challenge.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Isekai Tensei Ojisan wa Shizuka ni Kurashitai
title_japanese: 異世界転生おじさんは静かに暮らしたい

title: Shin Nuke
synopsis:
My dead older brother came back to life, even though his heart was supposed to have been removed. Why?...

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Kick the Bucket
synopsis:
Jinseop, a withdrawn and unassuming intern at a large corporation, has a dark obsession: stalking Taeyoung, the charismatic and seemingly perfect deputy manager of his team.

Jinseop becomes fixated, hoarding items tied to him; whether discarded objects or things briefly touched. However, Jinseop's adoration turns to fury when he discovers Taeyoung lobbying the chairman for a promotion. Driven by a sense of betrayal, Jinseop crafts a sinister plan to blackmail Taeyoung to strip away his pride and transform him into a submissive "pet."

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Ubau Mono Ubawareru Mono
title_japanese: 奪う者 奪われる者

title: Idol Shikkaku
synopsis:
Keita, a boring university student, is a "gachikoi" (fan who's seriously in love) otaku of Mimika, the center of the idol group "Tetra." Even though he's aware that it's a love that will never happen, he continues to push on with giving her his emotional support.

On the other hand, as her group's popularity continues to rise, Mimika bears anxiety over the uncertainty of the future even while she's happy with the fervently cheering Keita's affection. One day, Mimika falls into despair after her mother gets into a traffic accident, and with the help of social media, she heads towards Keita's part-time workplace...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Doumo, Butsuyoku no Seijo desu: Musou Skill "Clear Houshuu" de Seidai ni Kanchigai saremashita

synopsis:
The story centers on Materi, a high school girl who is suddenly summoned to a kingdom in another world, with a supposedly powerful skill in her. But the kingdom's ruler deems Materi's "Clear Reward" skill useless, and exiles her, thus activating her skill. As it turns out, Materi can gather rare weapons and useful items just by clearing the trials given to her. Materi becomes obsessed with acquiring skills and gathering items.

(Source: ANN)

Yoi, a male disciplinary committee member, is dedicated to guiding his fellow students. One day, he catches a glimpse of a female student named Akebono, known for disrupting the school's discipline, secretly devouring people's hearts...!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Seishun Senshi Asahi-kun
synopsis:
The protagonist, Asahi Mononobe, is a high school freshman who loves the once-popular battle hobby "Battle Pin." He's shy and whenever he talks to people he becomes an awkward "ahe"-ing Asahi... But he really wants to have a "youthful" life!! Suddenly, Asahi and his partner, Red Sun, find themselves caught up in a war that threatens the survival of the Earth from their peaceful everyday lives. Will Asahi be able to have a proper "youthful" life!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

synopsis:
Haruki Sakuma is a high school freshman boy who loves games. He is a coward who often tries to please those around him and has a hard time saying no, always relying on Karen Minatsuki, who goes to the same school. One day, a loud thunderclap rings through the school, and before he knows it, Sakuma has turned into a girl! When he wakes up, he finds himself in the world of his favorite game, "Mirage Universe," and due to a game bug, Sakuma and Minatsuki have switched genders!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Sakura Shunin wa Z Sedai ga Wakaranai.
title_english: Generation Z Is Outside Chief Sakura's Understanding
title_japanese: 佐倉主任はZ世代がわからない。
synopsis:
Sakura is a Millennial who's already been divorced. Despite being the chief of the sales department, he struggles to build a working relationship with Aoi, a new Gen Z employee. One day, while working late, Sakura decides to relieve some stress in private, only to be caught in the act by Aoi! The next day, as Sakura considers quitting out of embarrassment, Aoi surprises him by doing the same thing in front of him to stop him from leaving!

(Source: Kaiohsha)

title: No.1 Omega-sama wa Unmei wo Shinjinai
title_english: The Top-Ranked Omega Doesn't Believe In Destiny
title_japanese: No.1オメガ様は運命を信じない
synopsis:
An alpha terrified of other alphas meets a proud omega. Their undestined love begins with a fake relationship contract. Aka, the top-ranked omega at his club, one day gets requested by Soei, a rich heir way out of his element. Aka's more than excited to land a wealthy client, but it all goes downhill when Soei's sympathetic look enrages him instead. In this world, alphas are said to be superior, but Aka is certain that it's the other way around... omegas are the ones who really rule the world!

The two spend a night together, surrendering to their instincts and losing their senses. Soei takes a liking to Aka and, to the latter's dismay, then introduces him to his parents as his fated pair. It turns out, Soei just wants to get out of an unwanted arranged marriage. He pleads and presents Aka with a lucrative fake partnership contract. Does this mean Aka will finally have to face the one thing he's evaded his whole life—fate!?

(Source: Renta!)

synopsis:
A young scientist working to restore a civilization destroyed centuries ago by cataclysmic war unearths a devastatingly powerful doomsday weapon—which saves her from a marauding robot, then promptly transforms into human guise, identifying her as its new master. Thanks to the input from a romance novel, this handsome anthropomorphic weapon dedicates itself body and soul to our heroine, who in turn realizes that this may be the answer to her total inability to interact with human men...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

synopsis:
When their mother dies, junior high school student Ryota takes care of his toddler brother Chika and their home. Overwhelmed by all the work, he begins neglecting himself. Without any time to himself, Ryota comes to resent his little brother and soon the resentment turns into murderous thoughts. Little by little the pressures of childrearing make Ryota lose his mind. But is Ryota truly the issue? Or…

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Obsessed With Shuelina
synopsis:
Shuelina has only ever wanted to be loved as she grew up in an orphanage. But after her birth father rejected her in a previous life, she tries to find a family who will accept her in this one. Luckily, Archduke Bylot and his sons fall for her indomitable spirit, and they shower her with the love she has longed for. But once they find out she's the long-lost imperial princess, can she be a part of their family? Or will she have to go back to the people who sent her away in the first place?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: I Became a Childhood Friend of the Obsessive Sub Male Lead
title_english: I Became a Childhood Friend of the Obsessive Sub Male Lead
synopsis:
Born with memories of the novel How to Survive as an Ordinary Lady, Princess Rietta Lise is next in line for the throne of the Kingdom of Lise. But after being sold to the empire by her father, a king who lives in luxury and pleasure, she enters the ducal Mayer estate. Upon realizing that Noel, the duke's second son, is the sub-male lead of the novel, she'll try to repay the dukedom's favor by making him the real male protagonist!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title_japanese: 魔物をペット化する能力が目覚めました うちの子、可愛いけれど最強です!?
synopsis:
Tooru, an utterly exhausted office worker, is transported to another world. A mighty dragon is facing off against a knight right before her eyes! But when, by chance, Tooru brushes her hand against the beast, the dragon shrinks down in size!?

"I see. So I can transform monsters into pets..."

The knight she saved welcomes her as the "Saint of Salvation", but another saint appears and now there's a fake-saint dilemma!?

Zyrad is smiling at her and saying "It makes me happy when you smile", the pet-ified monsters are getting attached to her... wasn't she supposed to be aiming for a quiet, happy life!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

synopsis:
"...I hate you!"
"What a coincidence. So do I."

The two once belonged to opposing organizations of supernatural power users, and fought for their own opposing goals. Roushi Saikawa, also known as the "Feather Hunter," and Ritsuka Yanagi, the strongest supernatural power user known as the "White Demon." The two spent their days battling each other and had no normal social experience, but...

"I love you, Rou-kun."
"Me too, Ritsuka."

After their organization was disbanded, they somehow started dating and then got married! Is their hatred 100 times more adorable? Now, they are the epitome of a lovey-dovey couple, kissing each other at the door every morning when they go to work. But the husband had just one problem. That is, he had never shared a bed with his wife... In other words, even though he was married, he was still a virgin! This is the story of the hardships faced by such a husband, who gets caught up in numerous troubles but continues to make desperate attempts to deepen his l

title_japanese: 前世が伝説の大魔女だった不遇聖女は皇帝陛下に溺愛されています
synopsis:
"Rejoice! I, the Emperor, shall make you my bride!"

Orphaned and mistreated by her relatives, Sumire Inazuma never expected her life to change—until she and her cruel cousin Botan are suddenly summoned to another world as "Saints of Salvation."

But when the Emperor Carlyle appears, it's not the lovely, manipulative Botan he proposes to—it's Sumire.

Why her? And what is this mysterious, powerful bond that seems to link them across lifetimes?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Reito no Yuruui Tensei Seikatsu
