title: Trip Lovers: Tsui no Te
synopsis:
On his way home from work after an all-nighter, the workaholic Dr. Jikumaru Touji falls through a mysterious hole and wakes up in... another world! There, he stumbles upon the nearly dead assassin Naina and saves him with his "healing powers," but come morning, he discovers that for some reason, he now looks like a kid!? Jik (Jikumaru) starts looking for a way to return, while Naina protects him from this strange new world where the only law seems to be the law of the jungle. But before Jik knows it, his feels change and he wants to live in this world with Naina...

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: The Heavenly Demon Wants a Quiet Life
title_english: The Heavenly Demon Wants a Quiet Life
synopsis:
"In my next life, I wish to walk a completely different path..."

The Heavenly Demon, whose life revolved around fear and reverence, gained a crucial clue to mastering the Soul-Augmentation Art at the moment of his death: the "Soul-Augmentation Art" wasn't just about consuming the souls of others. The Heavenly Demon then awakened in the body of Byeok Taesan, a frail young noble who could die at any moment... To survive, he must make his way to the courtesan house! The Heavenly Demon, now transformed into the "Night King," begins his ambitious journey of survival.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Ultimate Shut-In
synopsis:
Kill monsters, save your neighbors, and expand your domain, all from the comfort of your couch. When his city becomes infested with monsters, Jaehyeon discovers an ability that makes him the absolute master of his apartment building. But his ability comes with a catch—he cannot leave his apartment. Now, he must arm his neighbors and lead them beyond their building to survive the post-apocalyptic world they find themselves in.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Ultimate Shut-In
synopsis:
Kill monsters, save your neighbors, and expand your domain, all from the comfort of your couch. When his city becomes infested with monsters, Jaehyeon discovers an ability that makes him the absolute master of his apartment building. But his ability comes with a catch—he cannot leave his apartment. Now, he must arm his neighbors and lead them beyond their building to survive the post-apocalyptic world they find themselves in.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Gu Sera
synopsis:
Gu Sera, the number one troublemaker at Gangsan High, the most notorious high school in the entire country. As a child, she secretly harbored a crush on her boarding house oppa, Lee Seojoon. Now, he arrives at Gangsan High for his teaching internship, only to face endless challenges with its unruly students. Determined to protect her crush, Gu Sera decides to transform the nation's most problematic high school into a model institution!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Noroi ga Kimi wo Ubau Yoru
synopsis:
One day, a monster commonly known as the "Goblin Queen" suddenly attacks the village. Nobody yet knows of the emotions she harbors.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Flip Flop Star Drop
title_japanese: フリップ・フロップ・スタードロップ
synopsis:
Just as she is confessing her feelings, a meteorite falls!? Will he able to fall in love again with the "you who loved me" who has lost her memory?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Open Car Girls
title_japanese: オープンカー・ガールズ

title: In Good Faith
synopsis:
Prosecutor Baek has built his career by manipulating evidence and witness testimonies with the help of a gangster. His success catches the attention of higher-ups in the prosecution, who now want him to clean up his act and arrange a marriage with a woman from a respectable family. Seeing this as the perfect opportunity to discard the gangster who has been clinging to him, Baek accepts the proposal. However, the gangster—who has long harbored feelings for Baek and aided him in his illicit dealings—feels a deep sense of betrayal and rage upon hearing the sudden news. Now, with resentment festering, their once-covert partnership threatens to unravel in ways Baek never expected...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Jesus: Sajin Kouro
synopsis:
The legendary killer, hiding under the guise of school teacher Shingo Fujisawa, returns to Japan after more than ten years! What made him come back? What has he been doing for these ten years? Is one of his new students connected to 24?

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Perfect Glitter
title_japanese: パーフェクト グリッター
synopsis:
Momo spends her days posting pictures on social media and survives on the few "likes" she gets. One day, she suddenly receives an invitation to meet up with her idol, Ichika, an influencer. Momo is overjoyed by the unexpected good news, but what awaits her ahead? Is it heaven or a one-way ticket to hell?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Power Harassment Genkai Yuusha, Maougun kara Koutaiguu de Scout sareru: Yuusha Ranking 1-i nanoni Tedori ga Gomi Sugite Seikatsu Dekimasen @comic
title_japanese: パワハラ限界勇者、魔王軍から好待遇でスカウトされる～勇者ランキング1位なのに手取りがゴミ過ぎて生活できません～＠comic

title: Only My Psycho
synopsis:
This is District A, a jumble of skyscrapers and slums, somewhere in Asia. Sakaki Takeru, who grew up in such a place, is scouted by an underworld organization's assassin squad and, under the guise of recruit training, becomes partners with Atonashi Isagi. Upon their first meeting, Takeru falls for Isagi's looks, gentle personality, and the fact that he's still a virgin. As a perfect match both professionally and physically, they seem to be off to a smooth start. Until "something" happens that provoked Isagi's wrath...

(Source: Taiyo Tosho, translated)

title: Tensei Renkin Shoujo no Slow Life
title_japanese: 転生錬金少女のスローライフ
synopsis:
After being worked to death twice, village girl Melia is living her third life. She is determined to live a slow life this time, but suddenly she gets arrested for using alchemy...!? It's the start of workaholic fantasy set in another world!

(Source: Koadokawa, translated)

title: I Was Tricked into this Fake Marriage!
title_english: I Was Tricked into this Fake Marriage!
synopsis:
When the Delpice Empire conquers her home country, Leyrin Efran must marry an imperial or give up her family's peerage under the new regime. She outsources her matchmaking woes to a guild that finds her the most perfect, drop-dead gorgeous husband for her temporary contractual marriage. But it turns out Leyrin has been duped into marrying the guildmaster of all people! Not only that, but it might not just be his looks that are killer...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Ki no Mi Ki no Mama
The Bokki Is Yours
title_japanese: ザ・ボッキ・イズ・ユアーズ

title: White Pawn
synopsis:
Kuroki, a freshman in college, becomes infatuated with his senior Shirasawa, who enjoys dominating men, and plans to seduce him at the school's entrance ceremony, but ends up being the one who gets captured. Despite the setback, Kuroki is determined to win over Shirasawa's heart and comes up with a cunning plan to turn the tables.

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

title: Hanako-san, Tabenaide
synopsis:
A boy named Tooru has stopped going to school due to a certain incident, and continues to lament his current situation of simply living by inertia. One day, Tooru learns that his alma mater, Hanakaze Elementary School, is going to be closed. In a panic, he finds himself trespassing on the school grounds. Just when he thought there was no one there... he finds Hanako-san, the girl who used to play with him in the toilet!? Tooru is flustered by Hanako-san's aggressive approach. And there's more to this school than just Hanako-san...?!

Wouldn't you like to be loved to the core by the Hanako-sans? A slightly naughty tale of adolescence.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Mimiko-chan, Omeshiagari Kudasai
title_japanese: みみこちゃん、お召し上がりください

title: Drama Queen
synopsis:
After saving the earth, aliens have taken up residence with the humans in Japan. Nomamoto, a factory worker with an abusive alien boss, one day meets Kitami, who tells her his own family was killed by aliens. The two quickly forge a friendship, but one day Kitami does the unthinkable...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Drama Queen
synopsis:
After saving the earth, aliens have taken up residence with the humans in Japan. Nomamoto, a factory worker with an abusive alien boss, one day meets Kitami, who tells her his own family was killed by aliens. The two quickly forge a friendship, but one day Kitami does the unthinkable...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Boku to Chourui Hyakkaten
synopsis:
Haru Shirosaki, nine years old, is a 4th year elementary school student with no hopes or dreams for the future. One day, he visits the "Bird Department Store," a specialty store that has a collection of birds from all over the world. What will an encounter with Enji Kochikawa, the store's manager who's full of hopes and dreams, bring about...!?

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Otoriyose shimasshi!
synopsis:
With the rise of remote work, clothing designer Himari Kaga enjoys ordering delicious food online♪ An online gourmet diary of making the most out of her time at home.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Ohitsuji-chan wa Sawaritai
title_japanese: 御羊ちゃんは触りたい

title: Yuusha ni Uragirareta Tensei Healer ga Maou no Chouki ni Naru made
title_english: The Reincarnated Healer Betrayed by the Hero Is the Demon Lord's Beloved
title_japanese: 勇者に裏切られた転生治癒士〈ヒーラー〉が魔王の寵姫になるまで
synopsis:
"You are the bride offered to me."

Alicia, who was reincarnated and grew up as an orphan in another world, was engaged to her childhood friend, Chris. However, after becoming a hero, Chris fell in love at first sight with the saint, Princess Elené. Succumbing to the princess's temptation, he ends up stabbing Alicia. The one who rescues the heartbroken Alicia is none other than the Demon King, who was supposed to be her enemy...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title: Watashi no Kouguchi-sensei
synopsis:
Ruri Kouguchi, a skilled yet socially awkward male manga artist, has built a career creating niche loli manga. His carefully structured life takes a chaotic turn when Karen Shiina, an energetic young woman claiming to be a university student, joins him as his assistant. While Karen appears eager to learn, she harbors a mysterious secret and ulterior motives for working with Kouguchi. As they navigate the creative challenges of manga production, their quirky relationship evolves, blending humor, tension, and unexpected revelations.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Kanshuu no Ou
synopsis:
Despite having access to numerous mistresses, King Faslan, who ascended to the throne at a young age, chose only one woman. Though he continued to love her and her alone, their happiness was fleeting and brief. All that remained was her 'custom' that she left behind—

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Asa no Fuukei
synopsis: A short story based on the TYPE-MOON visual novel Mahoutsukai no Yoru.

title: Mahoutsukai no Yoru: Aru Hi no Dekigoto
title_japanese: 魔法使いの夜 或る日の出来事

title: Tsukiji Tobimaru to Iu Hito
synopsis: A Mahoutsukai no Yoru side story focusing on Tobimaru Tsukiji.

title: Shibou Yuugi de Meshi wo Kuu.
title_english: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table
synopsis:
When Yuuki wakes up in an unfamiliar manor wearing a maid uniform, she recognizes this as the start of a new death game. After assessing the situation, Yuuki begins to wander before discovering a room with five other maids. Each one is visibly anxious, and she learns from them that they are all new players who joined this lethal game for the prize money.

But Yuuki is different: she is a death game veteran whose only goal is to achieve 99 consecutive wins. Tasked with navigating a manor filled with countless instruments of murder, Yuuki takes point as the only experienced player in an environment that is designed to actively work against her. Despite this, she is determined to reach the end of the game with as many people as possible—if it coincides with her final goal.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Gakuen Idolmaster: Comic Anthology
title_japanese: 学園アイドルマスター コミックアンソロジー
synopsis: An anthology comic of Gakuen Idolmaster by various mangaka.

title: I'm a Max Level Regressor
synopsis:
As a member of the "Nine Road" for decades, I've traveled the world preventing global catastrophes. My long-awaited retirement was finally within reach. At 56 years old, what awaited me was the fame of being a battle-hardened veteran who had reached the highest EX rank, and countless accolades as humanity's hero and Earth's guardian! All that was left was to truly enjoy a life of wealth and glory! And just as I was about to settle into a comfortable retirement... "Aaaargh! This can't be happening!" I woke up to find myself as my 24-year-old self from 32 years ago! Even worse, I'm back in the past when I had absolutely nothing!!! "I wasn't supposed to be the regressor!" Moreover, Nicholas from the Nine Road was meant to be the returner. Does this mean I have to gather the Nine Road myself from scratch? A life forced to start over as an unexpected regressor! This time, I'll finish things quicker and try to enjoy life.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: How to Survive Restructuring
synopsis:
The moment I was notified of being included in the company's restructuring list, a deafening roar, as if the sky was falling, marked the transformation of the world.

[The sale of this Earth has been decided.]
[Accordingly, a restructuring of personnel is underway.]

Life-threatening restructuring. Missions that grant extraordinary powers upon completion. If this is some kind of miraculous joke, I will give it my all! "I've found it. A way for all of us to survive together." The rapid rise of Lee Eun-ho, a restructuring target, begins now!

title: Saikin Kokuhaku wo Kotowatta bakari no Kouhai Joshi ga Gimai ni Natteshimatta
title_japanese: 最近告白を断ったばかりの後輩女子が義妹になってしまった

title: Magan no Akuyaku ni Tensei shita node Oshi Chara wo Mimamoru Mob wo Mezashimasu
title_japanese: 魔眼の悪役に転生したので推しキャラを見守るモブを目指します

title: A Hunter's Stamina
synopsis:
In a world where dungeons have opened and some people awaken as hunters, South Korea offers an unusual deal—become a hunter and serve for ten years, and your siblings will be exempt from military service. This leads to a strange trend of wealthy families adopting children to shield their own. Yeon-woo was adopted under such circumstances, becoming a hunter to protect his younger brother, Jeong-woo. Now, five years into his service, when an unknown dungeon opens near Jeong-woo's university, Yeon-woo volunteers for a dangerous mission, ready to risk everything to protect his brother—even his life.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Bishoujo Senshi Stress
synopsis:
The truth behind those dreamy Magical Girls and Pretty Guardians who inspire children's dreams...?! A new tale of a Pretty Guardian that's both realistic AND totally awesome!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Ueki no Housoku: Exhibition
title_japanese: うえきの法則 エキシビション

title: Isegure: Isekai Cheat Musou Ore TUEEE-kei Ikiri Tenseisha ni Kamaseinu ni Saretsuzuketa Elite Kishi, Chou Gureru.
title_japanese: イセグレ　異世界チート無双　俺TUEEE系イキリ転生者にかませ犬にされ続けたエリート騎士、超グレる。

title: The Boyfriend I Hate
synopsis:
Inha was always compared to Yejun. Just as she was growing weary of the endless comparisons, she happened to receive an art award that brought her some attention, and so Inha began to pursue the path of art.

Eight years later, she reunites with Yejun... only to find that he, too, is now doing art. Believing it's inevitable that she'll once again be compared to him, Inha starts making plans to distance herself from Yejun.

A coming-of-age romance about Inha, who harbors a dislike for Yejun.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: How to Raise Your Skeletons
synopsis:
A necromancer is a profession considered the noble of nobles, with less than 1,000 in the population worldwide! I was born with a diamond spoon, no, a necromancer spoon in my mouth! ...Or so I thought.

"I'm just a defective necromancer."

[Using skill, "Summon Ordinary Skeleton" (E-rank).]

You'd think a necromancer should be able to summon liches, Dullahans, or death knights. But nope, I can only summon skeletons. But then one day, suddenly...

[Hidden condition achieved!]
[Condition: The 10,000 Uses Rule]
[Your rank has upgraded to D-rank!]

I achieved the hidden condition and gained the ability to raise my skeletons. From E-rank to S-rank! The story of Joo Donghoon unfolds, the world's only cursed necromancer, who's speeding toward becoming a ranker!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Roku Gen Shoujo
synopsis:
My dad is a famous guitarist. Sometimes, he shows up out of the blue, and teaches me how to play guitar.

Mom hates Dad and the guitar, and she takes it out on me... But I won't let that stop me. Even if I'm scolded, even if I'm bullied—so long as I have this, I'll be just fine.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Bakewell Memories
synopsis:
A small master and her maid live in an old mansion deep in the woods. One day, the master requests of the maid, "I'd like to try a dessert that's popular in town..."

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Aitsu wo Koroshite Uchi mo Shinu
title_japanese: あいつをコロしてうちもシヌ

title: Human Lost: Ningen Shikkaku
synopsis:
The year is 2036. A revolution in medical treatment has conquered death by means of internal nanomachines and the "Shell System," yet only the richest can afford to partake. Yozo Oba isn't the richest. Troubled by strange dreams, he flippantly joins his friend's biker gang on an ill-fated incursion to "The Inside," where society's elite lives. This instigates a journey of terrifying discovery that will change Yozo's life forever.

(Source: ANN)

title: Shagai Torishimariyaku Shima Kousaku
title_japanese: 社外取締役 島耕作

title: Hazureta Kubiwa wo Suteru Toki
title_japanese: 外れた首輪を捨てるとき
synopsis:
Is it so wrong for two abandoned souls to fall in love? Kuroda catches his boyfriend cheating and gets dumped on the spot, only to discover another man, Shirato, was also dumped. Out of pity, Kuroda takes the crying Shirato home, and their shared loneliness leads to a one-night stand. But what should have been a one-time mistake turns into something deeper, as Kuroda finds a strange comfort in being embraced by Shirato. But how can he confess his growing feelings now?

(Source: Printemps Shuppan, translated)

title: Amamiya Kyoudai no Antique File
title_japanese: 雨宮兄弟の骨董事件簿〈アンティーク・ファイル〉

title: Asura no Sata
synopsis:
"Only do good deeds."—Asura follows his late mother's teachings and always strives to do good in life. No matter how much he is bullied, he goes on with a smile, firmly believing that evildoers will receive divine punishment. Until one day, an ominous old man offers him a key that can open the doors to hell...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: The New Hire's Secret
synopsis:
With a handsome face and manners that would put a diplomat to shame, new hire Hyeonu Lee is a sight for sore eyes to Senior Manager Iyeon Shin when he walks through the doors of Hanshin Worldwide. Feeling like she's won the lottery, Iyeon is looking forward to her company life alongside this polite and hard-working young man—"Hey, Iyeon. Get this done by tomorrow." Hyeonu is no regular employee; he's the son of the CEO. And as he begins to show his true nasty nature behind closed doors, Iyeon begins wondering what she did to deserve him.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Cafe Owner Is an S-Class Guide
title_english: The Cafe Owner Is an S-Class Guide
synopsis:
A newly awakened guide slash cafe owner fights an uphill battle trying to protect her business from a handsome yet explosive esper, who finds both her and her powers as addicting as caffeine.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: I Grabbed the Leash of the Blind Beast
title_english: I Grabbed the Leash of the Blind Beast
synopsis:
When an average twenty-something wakes up in the battered body of a nameless extra from a romance novel, all she wants is to go home. But first, she'll have to see the story through as Rona, the maid of Grand Duke Ileon, the novel's hero who was blinded by poison. She just has to make sure the heroine restores his sight with a special flower so they can have their happy ending—easy enough, right? With a plot gone awry, Rona's dangerous past, and the grand duke's affections, can Rona stick to the story?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: TimeTuber Yukari
synopsis:
One day, high school girl Yukari finds the mysterious clock "Deus Ex Machina," which sends her to the Showa Era...?! A time travel story of a modern high school girl and retro Showa begins!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

Included one-shots:
Volume 1: Déformation, Shichinin mo Keiji

title: Toki no Yuusha
synopsis:
The manga centers on Barto, a boy who bears the crest, and awakens as a hero when he turns 17. Barto travels through time alongside despair, and is the world's only hope, as human territory gets encroached upon by demons. 

(Source: ANN)

title: Under the Influence
synopsis:
A secret community app exclusively for alphas and omegas—no betas allowed. During the hectic rush hour, a provocative post appears on its anonymous board: "Omega in heat, currently loose on the train to ** at XX station. As they say...the early bird gets the worm. Good luck hunting!" As nearby alphas eagerly join the hunt, Haeyoung, caught off guard by an unexpected heat, finds himself trapped in a dangerous game of pursuit. With predators closing in, can he escape before it's too late?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Swallow You Whole
synopsis:
Jaheon comes from a lineage of omegas. Omegas who have raised the children of their branch families, only for them to be offered to the Snake God, Lord Mugo, every 12 years. Though it is said that Mugo handpicks his sacrifices no one in the head family believes such an old tale anymore. However, Jaheon knows that Lord Mugo came to him when he was a child and picked him to be the sacrifice, and even remembers the events of the day. Even though Jaheon has prepared himself, both body and mind, for as long as he could remember, upon entering Mugo's lair he quickly realizes that he doesn't want to be eaten as a sacrifice, at least not after finding out the "Lord Mugo" he adored was just one of the snake god's three personalities. Will the Snake God take pity on his sacrifice? Or will Jaheon be swallowed whole?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Heimin no Watashi desu ga Koushaku Reijou-sama wo Taburakashite Ikiteimasu
title_japanese: 平民の私ですが公爵令嬢様をたぶらかして生きています
synopsis:
Lilah, a commoner, is kicked out of the house she grew up in and ends up homeless. But for some reason, Eva, the daughter of a duke, takes a liking to her, and Lilah ends up becoming her bodyguard!? So begins a fantasy about an upstart commoner who clashes with nobility!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Mahoutsukai no Hikkoshiya
title_japanese: 魔法使いの引っ越し屋

title: Size Gap
synopsis:
Saetbyeol is an office worker who is loved by her colleagues for her small and cute appearance. They're worried about her because she looks very tired lately... 

"Saetbyeol, you seem exhausted these days." "Yeah, because I was playing with my little brother." Huh?!! Her little brother in the picture is a huge black man?! And this figure is definitely... what the fuck?!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Maryoku Zero dakedo Butsuri Mahou de Saikyou desu
title_japanese: 魔力ゼロだけど物理魔法で最強です
synopsis:
In a world where magic determines your worth, the protagonist, Apollo, has no magic power at all. No matter how much he trains, he is unable to use magic. But when the village elder calls him a good-for-nothing and plans to exile him from the village, Apollo discovers that he doesn't possess "Magic Power," but rather "Physical Force." Using this "Physical Force" for magical feats, he uncovers an unimaginable strength far beyond conventional magic. Apollo receives an invitation from the capital city and, along with his childhood friend Luna, who is the only one who ever truly believed in him, sets off on a journey away from his hometown!

This is the story of a world where a guaranteed way to turn one's life around exists. A tale of a boy's rise from adversity in an otherworldly fantasy begins now!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Yuusha ni Narenakatta San Baka Trio wa, Kyou mo Otokomeshi wo Koshiraeru.
title_japanese: 勇者になれなかった三馬鹿トリオは、今日も男飯を拵える。

title: Kimi no Taion Kimi no Kodou
title_japanese: キミの体温 キミの鼓動

title: Ponkotsu Maou no Inakagurashi
title_english: Country Life of a Ponkotsu Demon King
title_japanese: ポンコツ魔王の田舎暮らし

title: Tamagawa-san Detemashita?
title_japanese: 玉川さん 出てました?
synopsis:
The erotic comedy manga centers on a convenience store manager named Tamagawa-san, who is doing a job interview with a girl who greatly resembles the famous sexy actress Yuri Miyama. The sexy actress retired at the height of her popularity, and Tamagawa really wants to ask and confirm if the girl is indeed Yuri Miyama.

(Source: ANN)

title: Oni no Katekyo ni Narimashita.
title_japanese: 鬼のカテキョになりました。

title: Doukutsu Ningen
synopsis:
The story follows a young man Hajime who returns to his hometown and meets up with an old friend. While catching up, the two somehow find themselves in front of the local legend: The Man-Eating Cave.

(Source: ANN)

title: Mukuro to Kishi
synopsis: A knight accepts the duty of protecting royalty, only to uncover shocking truths during his mission...

title: The Cop Is Too Strong
synopsis:
Shin Haesu, an officer that specializes in excessive force, suddenly obtains a power that allows him to go 60 minutes back in time. He knew that his father's death was a murder disguised as a suicide on the same day. Haesu goes to become an officer to catch the culprit behind his father's death. That's when a superpower comes to him in the midst of a mysterious accident! A huge shadow gradually comes into view as he solves criminal cases and chases the organization.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Ayashii Iyashi no Yakumo-san
title_japanese: あやしい癒しの八雲さん

title: Juvenile Police
synopsis:
In 20XX, due to the increasingly vicious crimes committed by minors, the government establishes a special team called the Juvenile Police, made up of students hired as officers. The ordinary boy, Do Jae-ha, loses his closest friend, who was also a member of the Juvenile Police, in an accident and chooses to follow the path of the Juvenile Police.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Yuurei to Tsukareta Kaishain
synopsis:
One day, a ghost who remained in this world with lingering attachments encountered Nozaki, an office worker left exhausted from work.

"Nobody even looks at me..."

Nozaki was consumed with loneliness. The ghost, who was all alone at the end of his own life, decided to watch over his daily life. Though left at the mercy of his job, Nozaki desperately carried on each day. Until one day, he encountered someone new. Through connecting with others, Nozaki will gradually take back the feelings he lost amid the restless day-to-day.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: A Better Labor
synopsis:
After the great explosion, the world could never return to what it once was. Divided into small countries driven by specialized labor forces, it's now a dog-eat-dog new world. But Clawhammer Jang listens to more than just his stomach. As he pushes forward, he joins forces with others, new friends also gifted with immense power following the aftermath of the great explosion. But is Jang strong enough to stand for what he believes in? And who will stand with him?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The S-Classes That I Raised
synopsis:
Yoojin is an F-ranker overshadowed by his little brother, an S-ranker. All he does is get in his brother's way, causing trouble wherever he goes. When a seemingly routine dungeon raid goes wrong and costs Yoojin his brother's life, Yoojin decides to use the wish granted by clearing the dungeon to reset his timeline. The young boy "I" becomes swallowed up by the pleasure of drawing and completing a painting, embarking on a long creative journey. Along the way, he must confront "you" who lies in the shadows. What is the true nature of "I," that weaves between impulse and imagination?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Yuutousei no Mondai
synopsis:
Akira Inaba, a sophomore, is a candidate for the next student council president thanks to his irreproachable conduct and great academic achievements. He's highly trusted by his teachers and adored by his classmates alike for his bright and friendly personality. However, he also had a serious problem...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Paragon Demon: Revenant Saga
synopsis:
Anything and everything—Unhwi Yeon, heir apparent to the Heavenly Demonic Cult, owes his master at least that much. Unable to learn who is backing the cult members who betrayed them both, Unhwi is forced to flee into the body of Unhwi Dang with the help of forbidden magic. Isolated, alone, years into his future, moving from one assassination attempt to another—but capable of cultivating Naegong for the first time in his life. Anything necessary to protect his master is as good as done.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Madness
title_japanese: サイバーパンク: エッジランナーズ MADNESS
synopsis:
Rebecca grows up with her big brother Pilar as they pursue their shared dream of becoming a legendary edgerunner like their father. In the megalopolis of Night City, where obsessions with technology, violence, and power run rampant, they struggle, suffer, and cause chaos wherever they go! As they go about their daily lives, a mysterious man appears before them—changing the trajectory of their future. In this manga, a prequel to Cyberpunk: Edgerunners, siblings Rebecca and Pilar's lives are full of madness as they rush through Night City to prove themselves as edgerunners!

(Source: Dark Horse)

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Madness
title_japanese: サイバーパンク: エッジランナーズ MADNESS
synopsis:

(Source: Dark Horse)

title: Hoshikuzu no Oyasumi
synopsis:
Ren Hoshiai and Yuya Tenmando are childhood friends who are married. The two have an incredibly cute son, Makoto, and every day as a family is filled with sweet happiness, like a dream. However, this is a delicate balance built on the secret that Yuya holds—he's an alpha, not an omega, and the one who gave birth was actually Yuma, Yuya's twin.

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Shayou no Saki
synopsis:
Omi was left all alone after his father disappeared, leaving behind a large debt. When he attacked the debt collector, Shinome, who had taken everything from him, the man surprisingly took an interest in Omi and declared that he would become his guardian. Expecting to be treated harshly, Omi was instead treated kindly by both Shinome and the other members of the group. As he grew up, bewildered yet thriving, Omi, now a high school student, realized that he had special feelings for Shinome. Even if he couldn't be seen as a romantic partner, he wanted to stay by Shinome's side forever. Whether Shinome was aware of Omi's modest wish or not, he was told that he would have to return to a normal life after graduation...

(Source: J-Publishing, translated)

title: Mizu Mahou gurai shika Torie ga Nai kedo Gendai Chishiki ga Areba Juubun dayone?
title_english: Though I've Got Nothing but Aquamancy, It's Enough to Have Modern Wisdom, Isn't It?
title_japanese: 水魔法ぐらいしか取り柄がないけど現代知識があれば充分だよね?
synopsis:
Frim, a 5-year-old orphan living in the streets of the slums district, was a Japanese person in her past life.

Her everyday life is filled with violence and injustice, and she has no one she can rely on for help. All she has is "magic that can produce water" and "modern knowledge." Even hoping for a roof to sleep under is a luxury under such circumstances.

But this world is lacking in things like ideas for improving working conditions, and by coming up with new ways to use aquamancy aside from producing potable water, Frim gradually makes her presence known!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Alone Like a Wolf
synopsis:
Toward the end of the Joseon period, in a village between the borders of Joseon, Russia, and China, an old man who buried his violent past, Mu Myeong, lives his life out. Suddenly, a pale Russian girl, as white as a birch branch, comes into his life. For the girl, he plunges himself into the inferno once again! The blade of twilight shining in the sea of blood! The birch tree branches cannot be trusted!!!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: The Elegant Sea of Savagery
synopsis:
The daughter of a noble family deep in debt, Irina Nordiak's only desire is to marry her long-time love Ludwig Fontern, but her financial situation prevents this. With no other options, she calls upon an old schoolmate, Ileanor Schuberg, who is now a wealthy lord. While cruel to others, he acts like a different person to Irina, pining over her while detesting her love for Ludwig. Though he agrees to pay off Irina's debt in exchange for her servitude, he has no intention of letting her leave.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Saving My Sweetheart
synopsis:
Despite being the daughter of a saint, Leticia is rumored to be a bloodthirsty tyrant. But none of those rumors are true! After living as her vindictive mother's scapegoat, Leticia is cursed to die if she doesn't kill her beloved husband, King Ditrian. After the clock miraculously resets to days before their wedding, she gets a second chance to save not only Ditrian, but the entire empire. Will Leticia's true character be revealed before it's too late, or is history doomed to repeat itself?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Mikazuki to Neko
synopsis:
Neither lovers nor family, three cat-loving men and women live together. Akari, a 40-something single woman working at a bookstore, lives happily with Kanoko, a 30-something female doctor, Jin, a 20-something man working at an interior design store, and Mikazuki, their beloved cat. For Akari, who has led a very normal life in Kumamoto, it is the most "unusual life" of her life, but it is a very enjoyable one. This is a story of three lost adults and their beloved cat, who are on the way to a full life like a crescent moon.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Hone Hime Rosalie: Shisha no Saigo wo Tsuitaiken shi, Chikara wo Hikitsugu
title_japanese: 骨姫ロザリー ～死者の最期を追体験し、力を引き継ぐ～
synopsis:
Rosalie, a girl capable of communicating with the dead, is ostracized by society because of her unique ability. She lives in isolation, working as an investigator who gleans critical information from the deceased unearthed in ancient ruins. Her life takes a dramatic turn when she encounters the remains of Hugo, a once-legendary death knight. Through their connection, she inherits his extraordinary powers. This marks the beginning of her journey as "Bone Princess," a figure destined to influence the world.

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Manga de Wakaru Angou
synopsis:
Inspector Jun Meguro has been tasked with tracking down a crafty art thief who leaves clues in the form of perplexing cryptographic puzzles. Lucky for him, his sister Ruko is a math whiz who is willing to teach him about cryptography so that he can crack the case. But can they decode the thief’s ciphers before she steals again?

(Source: No Starch Press)

title: Bully and Stalker
synopsis:
Jun-han Go has a rotten personality, but he's smart. He's good at pretending to be a good person without getting caught. Despite his disadvantaged family background, he found a way to make a life for himself and seemed destined for success as an influencer... until he escaped a hit-and-run accident and meets into an annoying ex-classmate, Habin Shin.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: My Sadistic Master
synopsis:
Jin Yu-an is a shy, sweet-faced sub who's never actually tried any real SM play. He's never had a partner or a lover—mostly because he's way too busy, kind of a scaredy-cat, and hasn't found anyone who fits his taste.

One day, while browsing a BDSM app, he stumbles upon a profile that makes his heart race... only to realize the guy hasn't logged in for years. Still, hoping against hope, Yuan starts sending him cheerful messages. And then—a reply.

[You got a death wish? Can't you see my age?]

Oops. He missed the guy's age. And the terrifying attitude in the response? Yikes. But somehow, Yuan gets stubborn and insists on meeting him. The guy is exactly his type—intense gaze, scary tattoos, and an aura that screams danger.

BDSM? More like organ theft?? 

Still... should he give this scary-sexy dom a shot?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

Soyo, a demon fox, sneaks into the palace to steals a man's affection. While searching for the world's best Yang energy, she meets prince Ahan. Soyo tries to seduce him, but her true identity is discovered, and instead, she becomes aroused by his touch...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: My Younger Sibling Was a Genius
synopsis:
Yun Ha-Jun struggled to pursue his musical career despite his lackluster talent and ended up sacrificing his own family along the way.

"If only I could turn back time...!"

One day, after living with regrets and alcohol for a while, he wakes up and finds himself in the past. Just then, it dawns on him: the fact that his younger sister is a musical genius! Now is the time to turn his life around by producing his younger sister into becoming the best singer!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Hitoribocchi no Hana Musume wa Ori no Naka no Ryuukishi ni Koi Negau the Comic
title_english: The Lonely Flower Girl Who Prayed for Love with a Caged Dragon Knight
title_japanese: ひとりぼっちの花娘は檻の中の竜騎士に恋願う THE COMIC
synopsis:
A flower-selling girl with a light heart falls in love with a captive dragon knight... Ricardo, a hero of an enemy country, offers his own life in exchange for saving his beloved dragon, who was injured in battle. The poor flower seller's daughter, Suiren, falls in love at first sight with the sight of Ricardo, who is trapped and helpless, but never loses the light in his eyes... A fantasy romance about a hero with a different status.

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

title: Death Loop Reijou wa Ikinokoru Tame ni Ryoute wo Chi ni Someru you desu
title_japanese: デスループ令嬢は生き残る為に両手を血に染めるようです

title: Iya dato Itte Moratorium
title_japanese: 嫌だと言ってモラトリアム
synopsis:
When Mitsu was in high school, he had a physical relationship with his childhood friend Nana, whom he had a crush on. However, when Nana suddenly asked him, "Do you want to stop doing this kind of thing?" Mitsu was unable to tell him that he didn't want to, and ended up heartbroken. Mitsu has not been in contact with Nana since then, but his feeling for him still remained. When Mitsu became a university student, he runs into him again while working part-time. He is relieved to find that he doesn't seem to notice him, but short after, he is ambushed at the end of his shift and they end up going to Mitsu's house together. There, Nana shows his obsession with Mitsu for some reason. While the memory of his hurt returns to him, Mitsu's feelings for him still remain...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Mamonogurai no Boukensha
synopsis:
Nobody wants "Grubby Forager" Rudd on their adventuring team. His nickname—and his stench—come from his constant treks into the Noxious Labyrinth to gather medicinal herbs, a job he survives only thanks to his status immunity skill. When he's finally recruited as a party porter, things seem to be looking up... Until a deadly dungeon monster appears and his fake allies use him as bait before abandoning him! Wounded, destitute, and barely surviving the attack, Rudd breaks a forbidden taboo to stay alive: eating monsters. But the more he devours, the more power he gains, kicking off a thrilling, adventurous gourmet fantasy!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Everyday Host
synopsis:
The story follows Hajime Sekiguchi, a former life insurance salesman who, in a moment of desperation, makes the unexpected leap into the world of hosts.

At Club One, Hajime finds himself surrounded by a cast of eccentric personalities: a "younger brother" type host with 20 years of experience, a former idol specializing in romantic sales tactics, and a hyper-aggressive host obsessed with mobile games. Despite thinking, "This isn't a job for anyone with a sane mind," Hajime uses his polished insurance sales skills to attract clients and carve out a surprising niche for himself.

(Source: MAL News)

Though Yumeo may be an introvert, he's actually an incubus. One day, his succubus mother orders him to "lose his virginity," and, being at a loss for what to do, Yumeo heads to the home of a classmate who's rumored to be a slut, but... the gal turns out to be incredibly innocent...!?

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

synopsis:
The fabulously wealthy heir to the Tsuwabuki Concern, Ichirou Tsuwabuki, has arrived inside the next generation VRMMO, "Narrow Fantasy Online." His cousin Asuha has asked for his help in finding someone inside the game, and he's come to help her out. Of course, while he's happy enough to help his cousin out, Ichirou also cannot be satisfied with anything but total mastery of whatever he tries. He quickly proceeds to dominate the game world using his natural genius... and his wallet!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Shachiku Kensei, Haishinsha ni Naru: Black Guild Kaishain, Ukkari Kaishayou Kaisen de S-kyuu Monster wo Aite ni Musou suru Tokoro wo Zenkoku Haishin shiteshimau
title_english: Overpowered and Underpaid: An OP Swordmaster Turns Hit Streamer
title_japanese: 社畜剣聖、配信者になる 〜ブラックギルド会社員、うっかり会社用回線でS級モンスターを相手に無双するところを全国配信してしまう〜
synopsis:
"Work—that's the true grave of life..." With a heavy sigh, exploited guild employee Makoto Tanaka trudges into yet another dungeon. Per protocol, he starts a stream for company records—only this time, he accidentally sets it to PUBLIC.

Soon, over a hundred million viewers from all over the country are watching live as this so-called "modern-day swordmaster" takes down the Tyrant Dragon with a single strike! Overnight, Tanaka becomes a viral sensation. Seizing the chance, he ditches his soul-crushing job to begin a new career: an overpowered ex–office drone turned solo dungeon streamer!

(Source: Square Enix)

title_japanese: バケモノのきみに告ぐ、
synopsis:
Bardium is a tightly guarded city where magic, miracles, and illusions aren't allowed. Here, in a dimly lit room, a young boy named Norman is being interrogated. He's asked about Unlaw—supernatural monsters who gain abilities from unstable emotion. Four of these beings, all beautiful women, are now hunting each other down, and Norman must sate their desires while dealing with other oddities cropping up all over Bardium. The city is in chaos, and yet, there is hope. Everything will come down to a single boy's words.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: 3X3!
synopsis:
Ménage à trois? More like menace à trois! As a bashful, introverted BL lover, all Minji Kim ever wanted for her final year of middle school was to be left alone to draw dinosaur-themed superhero smut—Ahem, tasteful fanfiction. So exactly how she became part of the so-called Future Vision Club with school rebel Hae-in Shin and straight-laced student Jisu Han, she'll never quite understand. The only thing that's clear is that the year ahead promises to be unforgettable, to say the least! So, prepare for trouble and make it... triple?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Anzuru Koi wa Yasashikute
title_japanese: 案ずる恋はやさしくて
synopsis: A two-part short story about Megurun and worrywart Outan.

title: The Gangster at My Motel
synopsis:
In Damyeon, where there are no tourist attractions, seeing a foreigner is very rare... especially one covered in blood. It's the first time in all Yuhui's 20 years that she's seen someone who looked like a mobster.

"I've been wondering, sweetheart."
"Yes."
"Did you take it out on purpose to show me?"

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Like a Chilling Flame
synopsis:
Heavy are the shoulders that bear the burden of a household. To keep his waning clan afloat, leader Baek Mujin has no choice but to leave his homeland and venture out into the martial arts realm. When he passes the entrance exam of the Northern Sky Union with flying colors—leaving behind one unconscious opponent in the process—Mujin soon finds that the realm is not the noble place he once envisioned. With his powerful frost-style qi, however, he sets out to make a chilling mark amidst the fiery maelstrom engulfing the realm.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Festival of Warriors
synopsis:
"Alma mater, home town, blood ties—they're all but a façade!"

The war against organized crime waged by the government has failed miserably... and the world turned into a battlefield of mayhem ruled by one's fists. The one who unified this hell, Chairman of the Taejin Group, Jin Young-ui, has decided to open a competition of man, "Festival of Warriors" in search for a successor. Will our unemployed thug Kang Dae-oh rise to the top of the pyramid?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Elevator Girl wa Koko ni Iru
title_japanese: エレベーターガールはここにいる
synopsis:
The elevator travels again today, carrying people's thoughts and pasts. Inside the elevator that Kasumi Kazuki boarded was an elevator girl named Marika. When she asked Kasumi about her destination, Kasumi couldn't quite remember where she was headed...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Tokyo Death Race
synopsis:
In the near future, the year 205X, the Shuto Expressway becomes a graveyard! Weapons are allowed in the ultimate deadly public road race: The Extreme Death Race for the Fastest and Most Wicked!!

Former racer Souma Hayate, abducted by a sinister group, is forced to participate in the Tokyo Death Race, a deadly competition spanning the entirety of Tokyo's metropolitan roads, to pay off his debts. Once hailed as a genius racer with a bright future, Souma now stakes his survival on his skills behind the wheel.

Race through Tokyo City faster than anyone else—for the sake of survival!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Meteoric Milky Night
title_japanese: メテオリックミルキーナイト
synopsis:
A shooting star grants a zoo's favorite penguin's wish, turning him into a human?!

Subaru, a flirtatious emperor penguin, wishes to meet his soulmate. When a shooting star streaks across the sky, he is transformed into a handsome man in the nude! He is then taken in with the stoic polar bear Kai, who has also turned human. While Subaru is confused by Kai's lack of personal space, the two started rooming together with the zookeeper's support. ☆

Kai is now a 19-year-old college student. Subaru, on the other hand, works as a host. After showing what he can do as the guy who brought the most bank to the zoo, a drunken Subaru returns home and Kai helps him to bed. When Subaru teases Kai about his virginity, Kai pushes him down saying "teach me"?!

The Arctic vs the Antarctic! A spectacular ★ transformation on a starry night! A novel romance between a clingy polar bear and a lonely penguin! ♡

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Yume nara Samete... Bishoujo Idol Horror
title_english: Perfect Blue: Awaken from a Dream
title_japanese: 夢なら醒めて… 美少女アイドルホラー
synopsis:
Delve deeper into the dark underbelly of super-stardom, where fame comes at a steep price. In this sequel anthology to the hit psychological thriller, Perfect Blue, creepy fans thrust their idols into struggles of life and death. Gruesome body switches, bloody fan letters, and a stalker in a terrifying rabbit costume–it’s a life of fame and misfortune that lies in wait for these hapless pop stars.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Naka●shi Shimai no Hen●i Kiroku
title_japanese: ナカ●シ姉妹のヘン●イ記録
synopsis:
The story follows Akiho Niido, an 18-year-old college student leading a fulfilling life, except for her unemployed sister, Kana, who is staying with her. Akiho struggles to manage her sister's untidy habits. Their situation takes a turn when Chibusa, a busty woman identifying herself as a debt collector, visits them. She informs Akiho that Kana has accumulated a debt of 3 million yen. Unable to repay the debt, Chifusa offers them a "Problematic Part-Time Job" in exchange for a high pay. The job's details remain confidential, leading to a slightly erotic work comedy about two sisters entangled in a peculiar debt.

(Source: Bushiroad, translated)

title: Tail Concerto
synopsis:
Prairie, a land of floating islands previously inhabited by an ancient civilization that has since vanished, leaving behind relics with mysterious powers. It is now home to the Caninu, and a smaller population of Felineko. Tensions exists between the two people, as do questions concerning what happened to the ancient civilization.

The answers to those questions would begin 10 years ago, when Alicia Pris, a Felineko girl who had just moved to Prairie, met a Caninu boy named Waffle Ryebread.

synopsis:
When her sister, the king's fiancée, disappears, Countess Iris is forced to go to the royal palace to take her place. The king is rumored to be a tyrant, cursed with the blood of the silver wolf, that will surely lead to the ruin of his house! She tries to avoid it, but she ends up spending the night with him! Iris thinks she is doomed, but then she finds out that the king, who is supposed to be a vicious beast, turns out to be more like a cuddly puppy, and she can't help but fall for him!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Iron Emperor
synopsis:
Life as the demon king was going well until he was resurrected as the descendant of his rival! After a battle with Rakan the Warrior, the powerful mage Saemon was killed. He was dead, or so it seemed, until he unexpectedly awakened in a new body 500 years in the future! Now pretending to be Lord Luke de Rakan, Saemon needs to help his citizens, pay his kingdom's debts, and convince his servants he isn't crazy... at least until he can regain his true power and avenge the love of his life!

(Source: Tapas Media)

Miko is a white cat who used to be a stray but has since become the most pampered cat in the world! She doesn't care if her owner is working or on a call—she demands affection at all times.

title_japanese: 10年ぶりに再会したクソガキは清純美少女JKに成長していた
synopsis:
Arizuki, who quit his job in Tokyo, decided to look for a job in his hometown of Shizuoka. He bumped into a high-school girl when he was about to re-start his life. That very girl, was the girl who lived with him next door. That very girl with whom he used to play a lot, but Arizuki was yet to notice that at all. All because of her transformation...

(Source: Kakuyomu, translated)

title: Shokei sareta Saikyou no Gunyou Majutsushi, Haisenkoku no Elf Hime to Kokka Saiken su: Sokoku yo Jama suru no wa Katte da ga, Sono Majutsu Tsukutta no Ore nanode Kikanai ga?
title_japanese: 処刑された最強の軍用魔術師、敗戦国のエルフ姫と国家再建す～祖国よ邪魔するのは勝手だが、その魔術作ったの俺なので効かないが?～
synopsis:
The magical nation of Ingressa came to dominate neighboring countries with the power of groundbreaking military magic. Supporting this dominance from behind the scenes was Hert Eisenheim, who rose to the rank of archmage at a young age. However, due to a scheme by the court magician who was jealous of his talent, Hert was executed as a war criminal–-but when he awoke, he found himself summoned before a young girl. The girl's name was Iris Refrain, and she was the first princess of the elven kingdom that he had destroyed. This is the start of a rebellion fantasy story about a banished man and a girl rebuilding her destroyed nation!

(Source: Flex Comix, translated)

The Granbell family, into which I was born in this life, is a prestigious magical family with considerable influence. I thought I had hit the jackpot, reincarnating into a winning life, but it turned out that the family was on the verge of collapse. And to make things worse, the cause of that collapse was... ME!?

Now, I want to finally obtain the family I've always dreamed of! With my cuteness, I'll solve any problem!

First Princess of the Elixir Kingdom, Roselia is referred to as the "Poison Princess" and is hated by many. She was unfortunately born with the power to create poisons rather than the ability to create "Cure Potions"—a healing power passed down in the royal family. Roselia was given the chance to have her position solidified as the heir to the throne after her mother died. That was the condition—to be able to create Cure Potions before the age of 18. Roselia, alone, tries her hardest to create Cure Potions, and then she meets one of the few people who have ever treated her nicely, Lord Elliott, her cousin! She finds herself drawn to him and he proposes!

"Do you wish to rewind your life?" At her lowest moment, overcome with despair, the Poison Princess's fate changes, and she heads off onto a new journey to find happiness and... maybe even love...?

This is a story of humans and demons, masters and slaves; a tale of revenge and a tale of loyalty shall is only beginning to unfold.

But that all changes when she's suddenly swapped back one day. Just as she's been in Joohwa's body, Joohwa has been in hers... and she's left Kanna's life a mess! First things first, she's going to divorce her cold husband, Duke Silvian Valentino. After that? Revenge on everyone who's wronged her.

Thirteen-year-old Towa, suffering from a severe case of "Chuunibyou" syndrome, is suddenly transported to another world. Although he is a rare foreigner in the new land, he has yet to manifest his "gift"—a unique ability granted only to otherworlders. To hide his lack of powers, he puts on an arrogant front, which ended up pushing away even the person he secretly admired, his own guard knight, Griz. One day, he was attacked from behind. "I've been killed!" he thought—only to wake up back in his original world.

Fifteen years passed, and he lived a mundane life as an ordinary office worker, haunted by memories of Griz. Then, he suddenly found himself lost in that other world once again! Determined to live a quiet life this time, but for some reason, Griz, whom he's reunited with, keeps closing the distance between them...?

When she wakes up as an extra in a fantasy novel, married to a villain and destined to be poisoned to death, Lea knows she must change her fate. Her strategy? Get rid of the booze and men in her harem, soften up her tyrannical emperor husband by being kind and gentle with him, and make him fall in love with her for real! synopsis:
Ryeon knew from the moment she was born that her life was a cursed one. Born sickly in a martial arts family meant she had nothing else to do other than wait for death. And when that icy embrace came, it delivered not peace but a second chance at life! Regressed to her days as a child, Ryeon resolves to cure herself and live a long, healthy life for the sake of herself and her family.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Dying Emperor's Personal Physician
synopsis:
Executed for failing to save the emperor, Serena Vincent wakes up again and again on the day she's assigned as his physician. Azaid Khan Krothen, the emperor's bastard son from a lowly maid, was cast aside at birth. But he now sits on a throne others want to control. As Serena races to cure his mysterious illness, each failure ends in her death. Trapped in a deadly loop, she must find the cure to the emperor's illness... before her next death is her last.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Hildegart Reincarnate
synopsis:
As the best arcane swordsman, Hildegart's feats made House Acaraxia the greatest noble family in the empire, amassing both wealth and prestige. But after being tasked with sealing away the Demon God, Hildegart was forced to sacrifice her life. In a twist of fate, she wakes up in the body of her 12-year-old great-great-grandniece 80 years later, where, much to her shock, her family has fallen into total ruin. Can the reincarnation of the first Hildegart restore her family to its former glory?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Black Santa

title: Our High School Music Genius Is Paganini's Reincarnate

synopsis:
Hajun just wants to play violin. He may lack confidence and skill, but even so—he'll keep practicing, if only for himself. But when his school's annual music test rolls around, Hajun finally tries proving to himself that he can perform... only to fail, miserably. As his nerves overwhelm him, in steps the mysterious Juwon to accompany him on piano. Turns out Juwon is a musical prodigy! With his help, Hajun is finally able to make real music. But just who is he? And why is his playing so familiar?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Ao wa Kataku Haru wa Yasushi

synopsis:
After the tragic fates of her first three lives, Serena is determined to cruise through her fourth one. But to Serena's dismay, she's been reincarnated as a villainess hated by everyone, including her husband! Serena just wants to get a divorce and quietly start fresh, but with a talking bunny doll begging her to save the world and her husband suddenly acting more caring, nothing seems to be going to plan. When life has her cornered, will Serena be able to take the easy way out?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Empress Flower Garden
synopsis:
Jeongha, our protagonist, died after being hit by a truck on her 25th birthday. Before dying, she meets a strange grandmother who gives her a necklace. Jeongha wakes up in a place that wasn't the hospital, but another world. There, she was informed that she would participate in a contest to apply to be the next successor to the throne, where the country is governed only by women, and that the next ruler has to choose her emperor/concubine, who is a man.

(Source: MU)

title: The Youngest Disciple of the Hwasan Sect
title_english: The Youngest Disciple of the Hwasan Sect
synopsis:
Now, it's the age of "The Great Possession." One day, on my way home, I was hit by a truck and died. But when I opened my eyes again...

"Bring the child closer."

I found myself reincarnated into the body of an abandoned child, right in front of the Hwasan Sect, in a world that looks unmistakably like an Eastern martial arts fantasy! Why did I spend all this time reading healing childcare novels, alongside my usual martial arts novels?! And of all places, I ended up in the Hwasan Sect, not even one of the prestigious Five Great Clans but a sect from the Nine Schools?! Now, the adults are trying to turn a helpless baby into a legendary swordsman, and even the young master from the Namgung family is throwing a tantrum, insisting on taking me home... Please, from now on, can you send me to a proper childcare romance instead of this mess?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

(Source: ANN)

title: Koukyuu no Renkinjutsuhi: Aku no Hana wa Ougon no Koi wo Yumemiru
title_japanese: 後宮の錬金術妃 悪の華は黄金の恋を夢見る
synopsis:
Is she a villainous woman, or something more? Facing perilous situations with the use of alchemy, a suspense story set in the Chinese imperial harem.

Byakuren (Bai Lian) is the Ryuu (Liu) family's eldest daughter. Feared by even the maids for her arrogant and cold demeanor, rumors of her bullying her half-sister Mokuran drift about the household. However, everything was an act to protect Mokuran. Though Byakuren enters into the inner palace as a concubine candidate and begins to move towards fulfilling her goal, the machinations of those around her immediately break apart Byakuren's written scenarios one after the other...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: The Monstrous Duke's Adopted Daughter
synopsis:
Leslie Sperado, a twelve-year-old daughter of a marquess, is treated like a mere instrument to support her beautiful sister. Brainwashed to believe that she deserves nothing but contempt, she suffers an unrelenting torrent of criticism and rejection from her parents. She nonetheless keeps yearning for their love until one day—she is shoved into a pavilion blazing with fire as her sister's scapegoat. After barely surviving the fire, Leslie awakens to her power of black magic and decides to cut ties with her family. Regrettably, she is bound in law to comply with parental authority for six more years. When she learns that her only chance of salvation is to find another guardian, she sets out to strike a deal with the notorious Duchess Salvatore. Will Leslie escape her family's oppression and find solace within her new family?

(Source: Netcomics)

title: For Better or For Worse
synopsis:
The spunky Lady Dillion didn't realize she was the villain of a romance novel until she encounters Marquess Cedric. Seeing him jogs a dormant memory of the novel's plot, in which her beloved younger sister dies in childbirth after marrying Cedric. Determined to prevent this, Dillion marries him herself, but what fate awaits her when she knows he's meant to fall in love with the real female lead later? In this marriage of convenience, it seems nothing turns out quite how either of them expects...

(Source: Tapas Media)

There was a young gladiator girl who was famous in the Colosseum, her name is "Invincible Sword" Ramune. Ramune was bought as a slave, but unexpectedly became free due to a horse-drawn carriage accident. A girl that doesn't know what "normal" is, lives her life by seeing the world, learning, and being touched by the kindness of people.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Datte Nozomarenai Tsugai desu kara
title_japanese: だって望まれない番ですから
synopsis:
A human girl was chosen as the fiancée to the prince of Dragonkin—she was supposed to be the "Mate." A heartbreaking love fantasy of a couple who were meant for each other.

Adeline, daughter of an earl, was offered an engagement from the Dragonkin Realm. They wanted her to be the "Mate" for the third prince. All Dragonkins have to find their "Mate" and take them to their castle built on the floating island and live together, although their lifespans might be different. Adeline was fragile... She could hear that everyone in the castle criticized her as someone not worth being the Mate to the prince. Even the prince himself seemed to hate her. She ended her miserable life by someone's poison.

Two hundred and fifty years later, Adeline is reborn in the same world. And again, she receives an invitation from the Dragonkin for a ball to find their Mate. She tries to run away... not knowing that there is a secret beyond this invitation.

(Source: Kadokawa)

title: Amagami to Hakuchuumu
title_english: A Playful Cat and a Daydream.
synopsis:
Michishita, an introverted gay architect, has a crush on his mysterious apartment neighbor, Kase. Kase always hides his face behind a mask and rarely makes conversation with anyone, leaving Michishita with no intention of pursuing his unrequited love, content to just admire him from afar. One day, Michishita falls victim to a serious accident, only to be saved in the nick of time by Kase. However, Kase gets seriously injured while shielding Michishita and is taken to the hospital in critical condition, unconscious. When Kase finally awakens, to Michishita's surprise, he starts calling him "big brother" and begins acting adorably toward him...?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: The Superfan and the Hottie
synopsis:
Woo Jung is figuring out what he wants to do with his life. He joins Twitter and becomes a fan of an account named "Universe." Jooin Yoo works as a designer by day, and by night, she uploads fanart under the username Universe. Despite never seeing each other, the two form a friendship and soon decide to meet. Fantasy and real-life clash as Woo realizes Jooin's artwork isn't the only thing he finds attractive, and Jooin is shocked when she realizes Woo is not a girl...but a very handsome guy.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Gokinjo JK Isezaki-san wa Isekaigaeri no Daiseijo
title_japanese: ご近所JK伊勢崎さんは異世界帰りの大聖女
synopsis:
The manga centers on Matsunaga, a salaryman who one day sees Seina Isezaki, his high schooler neighbor, being accosted by a thug. When he rushes to protect her, he is stabbed in the process. As he lays on the ground accepting that he is dying, Seina begins to glow, and she uses a mysterious power to heal his wounds. In that instant, both of them are transported into a fantasy world. It is then that Seina reveals that she was once a saint in this world, and one day got transported to Matsunaga's world through unknown means, and it also meant that she lost her magic. But somehow, when she touches Matsunaga, she gets her powers back.

(Source: ANN)

synopsis:
A dream of death was the wake-up call he needed. Lofus Ray Lightless is far from a paragon of virtue. In fact, he revels in his villainy. But a vivid dream of the many ways he's fated to die convinces him that he must change his ways—or at least pretend like he will. With his trusty butler at his side, Lofus sets forth to turn the tides of fate in his favor so that he can enjoy a long and selfish life. But the future isn't quite what he's seen, and he might have bitten off far more than he can chew...

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Silenzio Agata, a hero of unparalleled fame known as the "Sword of Alba." His second life suddenly begins as a carefree school life?! After whimsically saving the life of a feathered fairy along the way, he ends up studying abroad at a "school for elven boys and girls"?!

"I don't know Japan or Tokyo, but I do know good sushi!"

Yugo Matsuda Irving's dream is to surpass his late mother as a sushi chef. Living in Hawaii has given him plenty of opportunities to make sushi but he's always dreamed of going to Japan where his mother trained as a chef. One day, he's finally given the chance when he receives an invitation from his mother's former partner, the owner of the greatest sushi restaurant in Japan. How far will self-taught Yugo make it in the cut-throat sushi industry?

synopsis:
Kazari is a popular vocalist in a band. He has a "secret" that he can't tell anyone. Koutarou, a younger rookie guitarist, joined the band as a new member through the introduction of Kei, a member of the same band. From the first time they met, Koutarou was interested in Kazari and tried to close the gap between them forcefully. Although he felt it was bothersome, he continued to brush him off, saying that he would be happy to hang out with him if it was just for fun.

One day, Koutarou saw an expression that he could never imagine from the always-strong Kazari. Kazari seemed to be hiding something, and he started to get closer to him more than usual, wondering, "Why was he looking like that?"

(Source: CLAP Comics, translated)

title: Yuusha yo, Ware wo Sodateyo!
synopsis:
Demon King Velgar met a dramatic end after his battle with the hero Karen. Although the Demon King left behind his last words, "In my next life.. I swear I'll come back to destroy you!!!," he later does indeed achieve reincarnation. What awaits him in his humiliating new life after being reborn...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Hitori Camp shitara Isekai ni Teni shita Hanashi
title_japanese: 一人キャンプしたら異世界に転移した話
synopsis:
Kaede, an office worker, is on a solo camping trip in the mountains to heal from a broken heart, when she finds herself in another world. At first, she lives a life of life and death, intimidated by the strange monsters she has never seen before, but with the attitude that it can't get worse, she perseveres. She also becomes friends with Fenrir and fairies and gets adapted to this other world, but... So begins the isekai camping life of Kaede, a woman with amazing initiative!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Tensei Reijou to Suuki na Jinsei wo
title_english: The Trials and Tribulations of My Next Life as a Noblewoman
title_japanese: 転生令嬢と数奇な人生を
synopsis:
Karen is reborn in another world, but she's entirely ordinary—no powers, no special skills, and no grand mission to accomplish. Fortunately, life is easy as a rich noble. Karen lives the good life until her mother completely forgets everything about her. When it's discovered that Karen is actually the child of an affair, she's banished from the family and forced to live on her own as a fourteen-year-old commoner! However, two years later, her family presents her with a chance to rejoin the ranks of the nobility under one condition: she must marry either the elderly, widowed margrave who lives on the frontier, or the dashing soldier who's seemingly destined for greatness. Which will she choose?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

The poisoned Yo Yohwa then regresses to an earlier time together with the prince and is determined to get on his good side this time in order to escape. title: Please Stop the Pope
synopsis:
While livestreaming about his struggles, Siwoo receives a donation with a strange request. He agrees, only to discover it came from Limen, the goddess of Eden, who has suddenly tasked him with defending her world from seven demon rulers. Ten years later, Siwoo returns to Earth as the pope of Eden, only to find it overrun by monsters. The demon rulers show signs of reappearing, and to maintain his divine power, he must spread Limen's faith across Earth. Can Pope Siwoo complete his holy mission?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Legendary Hero Is an Academy Honors Student
title_english: The Legendary Hero Is an Academy Honors Student
synopsis:
In the Age of Catastrophe, five heroes saved the world from a primordial evil. One of the heroes, now reborn as Leo Plove, is excited to revisit his glorious past—only to find his name erased from history. Determined to uncover the truth, he joins Lumerne, a hero military academy, unaware he's about to discover dark secrets surrounding his reincarnation. Why are his past records hidden, and who wants to keep them that way? Will Leo be able to set things right and reclaim the credit he deserves?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Hana wa Kuchi hodo ni Mono wo Iu
title_english: Flower Is the Window to the Soul
title_japanese: 花は口ほどにモノを言う
synopsis:
This is a world where plants can grow from human bodies. But due to a certain "incident," plants no longer grow from the body of Hana, the protagonist of this story. After her class had a change in seating arrangement, the boy who moved next to her confessed to her and slowly, her colorless days begin to change.

This is a beautiful love story that paints the subtleties of a pubescent girl's delicate heart and the vibrant colors of plants.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

On a planet existing remote from other planets in space, there extends a land of white ashes. Organisms that resemble a triangular rice ball inhabited the land. The planet was once a place where humanity built a civilization. One day, something that looks like a human wakes up...

title: The Villainess Is Everyone's Favorite
synopsis:
"Damn this world, let it burn!"

A single exasperated cry while succumbing to overwork. But instead of dying, I woke up inside the game I'd been playing. As compensation for the hellish life I endured, I gained a unique ability to view information about people and objects. Determined to use this skill to lead a peaceful, carefree life, my resolve was interrupted by an unexpected system message:

[To a player who has suffered immensely and wishes for the world's downfall, the system grants the chance to fulfill that desire.]

<MAIN QUEST> Destroy the world.

What?! I didn't mean it literally! Fine. If this is how it's going to be, I'm not backing down. Let's see who gives up first!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: My Daddy Hid His Power
synopsis:
Q: Describe your feelings upon discovering your trusted dad isn't just an extra.
A: W-what the heck... Give me back my "Random Imperial Citizen #1" life...

Living in a world of constant war—365 days of chaos—a simple, extra's existence was a blessing. At least, that's what I thought. In a small village, I enjoyed a humble life with my loving, ordinary father, James Brown, 27, the epitome of an unremarkable single dad. Or so I believed.

"...Dad?"

synopsis:
I am a healer who is addicted to games. Somehow, the world changed and I became the world's only healer.

[There is a place that needs you, a unique healer. Will you respond to the summons?]

What? You have tanks but no healer? No, wait. Isn't that just bad balance?

"I need you. My savior," said the head of the world's top ten guild.

"Don't abandon me... because I can't breathe without you," said the current top ranker.
