title: Country Life With His Sexy Majesty
title_english: Country Life With His Sexy Majesty
synopsis:
Rienna Fonde was meant to marry a crown prince, but after he cast her aside for the so-called saint, she was disowned by her own father. Abandoned and alone, she moves to Fostine, a lush, peaceful countryside, where she puts the knowledge from her past life to good use. After years of country living, Rienna has become a renowned farmer and loves her new life. But then, a mysterious farming tool brings a tall, handsome man to her doorstep. Will this man ruin her country life or enrich it?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Day the Real One Appeared
title_english: The Day the Real One Appeared
synopsis:
Mel Slofi, an orphan of common birth, had her hair turn white after a childhood fever. While unconscious from the illness, her parents abandoned her due to their crushing debts, leaving her to be taken in by Noma.

One day, Duke Heaven, grief-stricken and mentally unwell after losing his youngest daughter, mistakes Mel for his deceased child, Bleria Charlotte Heaven, because of their similar hair color. To quell the growing rumors about his father's instability, Damian Jeremiah Heaven, the duke's son, visits Mel. He demands that she pretend to be Bleria to protect the family's reputation.

Living as Bleria, Mel is soon thrust into preparing for an engagement with Gopher Isaac Allnight, the heir of the powerful Allnight Ducal House. But what challenges await her in this life of deception?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: An Extra, Yet the Duke's Only Daughter
title_english: An Extra, Yet the Duke's Only Daughter
synopsis:
Reincarnation Life Cast by Dice, aka "ReLife," is a mobile game that I transmigrated into. The objective is to help the main characters save the world from the evil demon king, with each character classified by how crucial they are to the plot. I awoke in the body of Alyssa G. Dravein, a side character who dies by her father's hand when she turns nine years old. But, my dad seems to love me so much—where did it all go wrong? Can I change my fate and live to see 10?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Trapped at Home With the Male Leads
title_english: Trapped at Home With the Male Leads
synopsis:
After being reincarnated into the body of a novel's wealthy heiress, Cherry Sinclair quickly realizes that the world is coming to an end, but she's determined to survive the apocalypse, no matter what. Using the money that came with this new life, she devises a plan to create a shelter to hide from the monsters. What she does not expect, however, is for the male leads of the novel to also end up in the same house! Will all of them be able to work together to survive in this chaos?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Habatake Majutsu Sekai no Shitei-tachi!
title_japanese: はばたけ魔術世界の師弟たち!

title: Megenai Koshimizu-san wa Shouwaru Otoko wo Horesasetai
title_japanese: めげない小清水さんは性悪男を惚れさせたい
synopsis:
Koharu Koshimizu, an 30-something woman with little romantic experience, has always wanted to redo a love that ended in high school when she was too shy and couldn't do anything about it. Upon entering a new company, she unexpectedly meets Rikka Date, the man she had a crush on at the time.

This coincidence makes her determined to ask him out to dinner, but she gets drunk out of nervousness... and when she wakes up, she's naked in bed! Date makes a proposal to her after she apologizes for the previous night's mistake: "Become my slave."

Koshimizu wants to be promoted from slave to lover, and Date, while nonchalantly brushing it off, acts suggestively. What will become of their love!?

(Source: France Shoin, translated)

title: Lala Lab☆: Gal to Kagaku to Seishun to!
title_japanese: ラララボ☆ ～ギャルと科学と青春と!～
synopsis:
Lala Mizusawa might look like a flashy gyaru and act high-energy, but don't be fooled—she's a hardcore science geek and a third-year biology major with dreams of becoming a great scientist! While her lofty goal sometimes shakes her confidence, she's got her quirky labmates to keep her going: the refined and otaku-spirited Hanako Naito, and the lazy pajama-wearing Toki Busujima. Together, they celebrate the thrill of growing microbes, steam sweet potatoes in the autoclave, and dive headfirst into their delightfully chaotic campus life (if you can call it that)!☆

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Praesepe Outside the Cage
synopsis:
Trapped inside the world of "Praesepe in a Cage," Yun Juyeon becomes the game's female protagonist, Praesepe, and must navigate a tangled web of romance and danger to escape. After completing all five male protagonists' storylines, she's thrust into "secret mode," where everything changes. The characters she thought she knew are acting strangely, and Praesepe begins uncovering secrets—memories, death, and a mysterious new ally named Grand Duke Fenrick. As she gets closer to finding the "real" male protagonist, Praesepe must decide who to trust, and whether escaping the game is truly the freedom she desires.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Please Become My Sister-in-Law!
synopsis:
"So, what do you think about my brother?"

One day, out of nowhere, a charming princess appeared in the life of Claire, the mistreated protagonist of an unknown author's work. Princess Yuri, without any prior connection, unexpectedly proposed that Claire marry her brother—known as the empire's most eligible bachelor. Overwhelmed by the princess's stubbornness, which not even the emperor could sway, Claire found herself in a contract engagement with the second prince.

"I just want you to play along until Princess Yuri is satisfied. I'll make sure you're compensated accordingly."

As Claire waited for the contract to end, Prince Raymond began to approach her. Why would someone who is only tied to her by a contract...?

"I don't want to let you go. I feel like locking you away so you can't leave."

For Claire, who fears both giving and receiving love, the wave of affection from her potential in-laws has only just begun.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Twin Moon
synopsis:
A woman identical to me appears in my dreams, crying.

"Who are you?"

For three years, Shunaelle, the Demon King of the North, has been haunted by the same dream, growing curious about the woman and deciding to track her down. The truth? She's a fragment of Shunaelle's soul, cast away into the human realm. When Shunaelle tries to absorb the fragment back into herself, the woman resists.

"I don't want to be absorbed!" Instead, she makes a plea: "If you want me back, live my life—a life filled with regret—and make it right."

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Day of Disaster
synopsis:
In 2009, a resident of a small mountain village is shot and killed, and this murder leads to a series of sinister events. Jeong-u Cho, a boy who was born and raised in the village, begins to feel a mysterious gaze on him, and finds himself caught up in an uncontrollable disaster.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Witch Doctor of Walpurgis
synopsis:
Upbeat witch doctor Kina Witchwood receives an ominous prophecy: she will face her execution in six months, but not before encountering three men—one she cannot refuse, one she cannot persuade, and one to whom she will vow her life. Though she tries to defy fate, she soon finds herself appointed as the emperor's personal physician and thrust into the heart of the imperial palace's treacherous political intrigues.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: I Couldn't Care Less About the Original, I'm Just Trying to Survive
title_english: I Couldn't Care Less About the Original, I'm Just Trying to Survive
synopsis:
In my past life, I was Soonjung Lee, but I died from overwork. When I awoke in the novel I'm Choosing the Sub Male Lead in This Life!, I swore that I wouldn't suffer again—I'd get rich and live as I pleased! But the side character I transmigrated into, Penelope, is nothing more than the widowed baroness of a poor territory. I need to do better—I must become wealthy! But, unfortunately, to reach my goal I'll need the lord of the magic tower's help, and he's not exactly the nicest guy...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Mushiatsui kara Nuguu
synopsis:
Ryota's older sister is a little strange. When her body gets hot, a mysterious energy builds up within her, causing a powerful explosion! The force of the blast, known as "Nugu," shreds all her clothes and leaves her completely naked!! But as long as it's only Ryota around, there's no reason to be embarrassed, right? They're siblings, after all.

(Source: MU)

title: But You're 2D
synopsis:
One day, a mysterious force drags the loner high school student Choi Sooa into a romance comic that she liked. And the person that she meets in this unknown yet familiar place is... her favorite character, the male lead Jung Jihoon?! A slice-of-life drama of the inexperienced nerd Sooa growing up as she goes through ups and downs with her comic friends.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Kaze no Iro made Oboeteru
title_english: Crush on You Like Spring Thunder.
synopsis:
The first year of high school: Spring. Mori, who has just entered school, learns of his classmate, Michioto, who is rumored to be the "treasure of the boys' school." Mori volunteered to ask for Michioto's contact information on behalf of a friend who was too scared to talk to him. Mori headed towards Michioto without really thinking about it, but the moment Mori sees him, it's love at first sight...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Disciple of the Three Kings
synopsis: Chaos descended upon the world as portals to other dimensions erupted, unleashing monstrous hordes. With humanity teetering on the edge of annihilation, the martial arts realm of Eun, the magical kingdom of Ainhalt, and the mechanized realm of Gehenna converged, their superpowered inhabitants rising to confront the monstrous threat. Yet, these heroes were far from benevolent. They subjugated Earth's newly empowered "players" under a brutal law of the jungle. Lee Ro-Woon, a beacon of hope, sought to unite the players and the interdimensional invaders for a peaceful coexistence. Betrayed by his allies and ostracized by the otherworldly powers, Lee Ro-Woon was cast into the abyss, his spirit broken and his dreams shattered. On the brink of despair, he contemplated giving up on everything, when he became the vessel of chaos and was transported to a sealed world. There, he encountered three supreme beings. Lee Ro-Woon becomes the disciple of the Three Kings and rises to rule over everything

title: Regression of the Yong Clan Heir
title_english: Regression of the Yong Clan Heir
synopsis:
Yong Hwalin, debilitated by illness and weakness as the heir to the Tianzhong clan, ultimately gave up the path of martial arts and lived as a merchant after marrying into another family. Carrying his regrets until the time he met his end, he unexpectedly travels back to the past he thought he would never revisit...! Returning to the time of his lowest point, he swears to his shattered heart that his fate will be reborn through his own hands.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: The Thief Princess
synopsis:
Everything is cloaked in mystery with "The Thief Princess". In reality, she is Lucian, the princess of the kingdom. With the wedding to her betrothed Hebron drawing near, Lucian concocts a daring plan to sabotage the ceremony and flee. Under the cover of the night, she sneaks into the prince's chamber while he sleeps. But after he unknowingly ingests a strange potion, Hebron captures her. Convinced the events are nothing more than a dream, Hebron kisses Lucian... Can Lucian truly steal what is most precious to him?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: No Mercy
synopsis:
Sierra witnesses her husband's secret meeting with her best friend Belieta. She is stabbed by her husband and closes her eyes. As Sierra, who was tired of life, feels free from her impending death, she hears a mysterious voice...

"You can't escape, Belieta."

In her second life that she unwillingly began, Sierra vows revenge. This time, she will take everything from Belieta.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Wasn't This Supposed to Be a Strategy Game?
synopsis:
I've possessed a hidden character in a notorious strategy game with a 0% clear rate. To escape this game, I must bring peace to the empire...

"So, from now on, I'll trust only you, Priest."
"You'd better give up on that plan."
"Priest, did you really use me?"
"For some reason, I feel something special from you, Priest."
"You promised you'd come back."

...Why is my favorability rising, and why does it feel like this is turning into a reverse harem? Excuse me, wasn't this supposed to be a strategy game?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: 24-hour Rebirth Consultation Center
synopsis:
Laura, the last heir of a fallen noble house, carries a duty passed down for generations—helping those lost in time and space find their way home. It's just that nobody has shown up for the past 500 years. And now, three clients arrive at once! Can Laura handle restoring her fallen house and babysitting time-traveling bachelors?

(Source: Manta)

title: Moon River wo Watatte
title_japanese: ムーンリバーを渡って
synopsis:
The dystopian science fiction manga centers on high school girl Manatsu, and the trouble she gets into when one of her casual photographs ends up showing something that should not be shown in their society. Soon, she will have an encounter with "the outside world" that will upend her world completely.

(Source: ANN)

title: Conveni-kun to Ryman-san
title_japanese: コンビニくんとリーマンさん
synopsis:
Ryosuke (gay, virgin), a college student working part-time at a convenience store, is passionately in love with Satoshi (straight), a regular customer and businessman. Ever since falling in love at first sight with his somewhat fragile and mysterious appearance, he fantasizes about the XXX aspects of this man, whose name he doesn't even know, and comforts himself with his right hand... Just when he's so in love he doesn't know what to do, an unexpected opportunity presents itself to get closer to him!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Genius Hitter Hits Fastball
synopsis:
Even he, Kang Geon-woo, a genius major leaguer who gained wealth, fame, and everything, could not continue a happy married life with his wife. He, who felt regretful about his wife's absence, returned to the past with the power of a mysterious ring. As a high school student in the midst of a fresh romance, will he be able to find love this time?

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Nazeka Tsukaima no Usagi wa Boku wo Dekiai shisugiteru
title_english: Somehow, My Familiar Rabbit Loves Me Madly
title_japanese: なぜか使い魔のウサギは僕を溺愛しすぎてる
synopsis:
Aidan McGuire is a new magician in the Guardians of the Order. Every Guardian has a humanoid familiar, and summoning one is mandatory! But during the summoning ceremony, Aidan summons a cute rabbit! He was told "deeper contact" was necessary for the familiar to showcase its true power... so when he tried kissing it, the rabbit disappeared and a young man named "Hidetora Jougasaki" appeared in its place! A cute (!?) fantasy BL story about a magician with a vague memory of a past life.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: The Tale of a Fox's Love
title_english: The Tale of a Fox's Love
synopsis:
Yeon, a nine-tailed fox who despises humans, avoids an accident with the help of Dong-i, who happens to be a human. In essence, a nine-tailed fox is a being that must repay a favor it receives. Yeon visits Dong-i without missing a day in order to repay the favor. But Dong-i feels burdened by the kindness. The two, who seemed like they could never become closer, become aware of each other's wounds and shortcomings, fill them in, and feelings emerge within their hearts. With different backgrounds, species, and even ways of loving, can the love between a Gumiho and a human truly end happily?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Shimeitehaikan
synopsis:
A police officer is assigned to a small town. As she relentlessly pursues criminals and shows zero tolerance for evil, what awaits her—words of gratitude, or something else? This is a story that explores the nature of justice and evil.

title: Scandalous Wedding
synopsis:
A string of demotions and even a broken engagement with the princess. Knight Asha, once on close terms with the emperor, had steadily veered off the path to success, receiving demotions as his annual birthday gifts. That is, until his 24th birthday, when he was finally ordered to return to his post. With his return, he decided to try to get married like his friends, albeit belatedly... But there's simply no one suitable! 

During his time away from the capital, Emperor Kiel had revised the laws and regulations, leaving him in an even trickier position. Can Asha manage to find a partner and succeed in getting married?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Off Leash

Rion, the third-generation heir of a wealthy American conglomerate family, is known as a charming man who is always surrounded by people. Frantic to win his heart, Woori throws herself at the opportunity. As romantic tensions rise, Woori must navigate her feelings and the show's drama. Can she untangle her heart and find true love amid the chaos?

Can a useless conjurer face the challenge of confronting a legendary beast?

synopsis:

But when a chance encounter evolves into a series of shared moments, an unanticipated twist in their relationship finds Jason and Frank being roommates. Will Jason find his new normal is love?

(Source: YUZU comics)

title: Pole of Inaccessibility
synopsis:

During their college days, Muyeong had always admired his senior, Jae-ui, harboring feelings that went unnoticed. Now, as adults, Muyeong is excited to reconnect and warmly approaches Jae-ui. However, Jae-ui doesn't share the same enthusiasm. Instead of welcoming their reunion, he seems distant and reluctant to engage in conversation.

Despite Jae-ui's cold demeanor, Mu-yeong persistently tries to bridge the gap between them. But as their interactions continue, Jae-ui reveals a deeply personal and painful secret, one that explains his reluctance to reconnect. As the past resurfaces and hidden emotions come to light, their relationship takes an unexpected turn, leaving Muyeong to question whether some distances are truly impossible to overcome.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: A Gloomy Delusion
synopsis:
"Tae Seongjae... He's the one who will take me back home."

One day, without warning, I woke up as Seo Seungwon, a character in a BL novel given to me by my younger sister.

The aftermath of being transported into this world is brutal—I'm plagued with relentless nosebleeds, bouts of coughing up blood, and unimaginable pain. I discover that staying calm lessens the torment, so I desperately try to empty my mind and maintain my composure. But as my original memories start slipping away day by day, I spiral into despair.

Still, I refuse to lose hope. To escape this nightmare and return to reality, I set my sights on the novel's ending. Following the story's flow, I resolve to become Tae Seongjae's lover, face abandonment, and eventually fake my own death—all to achieve my goal of going home.

But when I meet Tae Seongjae earlier than expected, everything starts to veer off course.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Shixian Jiaohui de San Miao Hou

synopsis:
The friendly, kind Student Union Event Division President Hezhan has a carefully maintained image but when fellow student Shunwen witnesses Hezhan's outburst in a meeting room, he inadvertently becomes the keeper of Hezhan's hidden side. Worried his secret will be revealed, Hezhan approaches Shunwen but every time their eyes lock, it feels like Shunwen sees right through him and he must "never lock eyes for more than three seconds." Will Hezhan be able to protect his secret or will Shunwen reshape Hezhan's life and his own?

(Source: YUZU comics)

If she stays this way, she will be killed by the hero prince and die a miserable death, just as in the novel. She vows to reform herself with all her might and begins to struggle, but she finds herself caught up in unexpected doting and obsession! Will Celine be able to find "peaceful happiness"?

As a lazy office worker, I was addicted to the smartphone otome game "Love Blooms in the Demon World." The game is a school romance in which the heroine, who is from a low-class demon race, develops a love with a handsome guy she is trying to conquer.

I became so absorbed in it that I was killed in a traffic accident...

I (Zakuro) want to maintain my comfortable life as a spoiled daughter, and of course I definitely don't want to be killed instantly. Using my innate knowledge of games, I raised my level to MAX and avoided all the "instant kill flags"...

Wait a minute!

From the bad-mouthed genius good-looking boy to the cool, quiet assassin,

Abandoned by his parents, bullied in high school, and left in solitude—a young boy named Kenya Mikazuki. At the brink of despair, he encounters a fateful meeting in his only hobby, VR gaming. However, in the story, one of them is destined to die... To change that fate, he dedicated his life to mastering the game and becoming the strongest in the world. Suddenly, Kenya finds himself entering the world of "Knight of Giant"?!

The strongest gamer embarks on a heroic tale of becoming the strongest in another world, in order to save the heroines he fell deeply in love with. The story begins.

Now, a revenge 20 years in the making begins, aimed at capturing the most dangerous of these resurrected beings.

Due to a declining birth rate, pets are being transformed into humanoid members of society. But are they truly human? Or are humans truly animals?

When misanthrope Ao discovers her family dog, pit bull Taika, standing over the mauled body of her father, she must decide whether to forgive or forget. Ao isn't ready to lose both her beloved father and her devoted pet, so when her mother has Taika humanized, Ao embraces the new dogman and even brings him to school with her. There, Taika meets a German shepherd, an elite police dogman, and begins to unlearn canine behaviors and replace them with human customs. Now, the two dogmen compete to see who will be the first to track down the source of the mysterious traces of blood in Ao's locker...

One day, an unidentified smartphone is sent to Juhyuk, leading to a series of events that will completely change his life.

"The voice phishing calls I'm getting... are they selling the future?"

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: The Investor Who Sees the Future
synopsis:

He decides to use this ability to invest in various companies and make money, aiming to become the world's number one investor. How far do the limits of his foresight extend? One night, Mukojima faces a crisis inside his apartment and the one who comes to his rescue is none other than Mikoshiba, his neighbor. By taking his invitation, Mukojima ends up in his neighbor's apartment, where they share some drinks.

title: Deriwo no Oshigoto
synopsis:
Sakurako, a shut-in and an obsessive fan of ero-ge (erotic fantasy games), hires a call-boy, Fuji, to try and experience the feelings of her favorite game character. Things go awry when a clumsy stumble causes the carefully-hidden otaku-ware and an erotic game on the TV to unpause—revealing Sakurako's ulterior motives. But it turns out that Fuji is a fan of the same game—so they end up spending the night playing games instead. The two keep in touch, and Saurako is able to find the courage to go outside, if it means spending more time with Fuji (and fangirling out at a game-themed cafe!).

No longer the boy next door who used to follow her around like a puppy, Yun is now a man, and he acts strangely aloof around her. While Dam has found herself resenting her first love, Yun is secretly quite excited to be around his first love once again. As the two become reacquainted after their time apart, they may be in for a lesson on what love really is.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Memory Shop

Feeling down? Stop by Cunimaru—a cozy shop where souls waiting for reincarnation gather to reminisce about their happiest memories. Savor a warm cup of tea and join Jiun Lee, Cunimaru's new owner, as she embarks on a journey of healing, both for herself and her new friends, while unraveling the mysteries of this whimsical afterlife retreat.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Ookami no Seiza
synopsis:
Ookami no Seiza is partly inspired by the real-life Japanese horse bandit, Hakuro Kohinata, and depicts the tumultuous life of Kensaku Ohinata, who moved to China at a young age, was kidnapped by a group of horse bandits, but rose to prominence among their ranks and eventually grew up to unite a number of them under the name of Xiao Dongyang. Kensaku's adventurous spirit and ambition, as well as his positive, brave personality, can sometimes lead to light-hearted mischief, but as he matures into a young man, he grows to experience bouts of delusion. Regarded as one of Mitsuteru Yokoyama's most realistic and human works, this manga draws inspiration from another real-life Japanese horse bandit: Date Junnosuke, thus vividly depicting the rarely seen reality of horse bandits.

(Source: Yokoyama Mitsuteru Official Website, translated)

title: Shachiku Tamer, Kawaii Slime no Okage de Mujikaku na Mama Musou suru: Ukkari Kokunai Top no Haishin ni Utsurikonde Saikyou ga Baremashita

title: Koppa Maichiru Sono Koro ni

synopsis:
Kei Maebara gets a job!! The bizarre and eerie world of public service, depicted by Ryukishi07, from Higurashi When They Cry.

In the 13th year of the Heisei era, in the Tokyo Metropolitan Area, Coastal Region... Due to the prolonged economic recession, the police force has weakened, and the growing number of disillusioned youth turning to semi-criminal lifestyles has led to a drastic decline in public safety... Amidst all this, Kei Maebara begins working at the district office. Can he become a respectable public servant?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Kaii-san to Asuka-kun no Ohanashi
title_japanese: 怪異さんと飛鳥くんのお話
synopsis:
This is a problem. The more attached Asuka-kun becomes, the cuter he looks… Ever since Kaii-san picked up his lost commuter pass, Kaii-san has somehow ended up living in Asuka-kun's house...!? Eating meals together, trying their hand at gardening, spending Halloween together... Little by little, the distance between them seems to be shrinking.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kuchibiru kara Ai
synopsis:
Riku, a beloved handyman known throughout the town, struggles with crowds due to his sensitive ears. After failing his entrance exams for that very reason, the one who supported him was his high school friend, Sumiharu. Despite being busy running his own business, Riku found comfort in Sumiharu's companionship. However, one day, during an ordinary phone call, Riku unexpectedly felt aroused just from hearing Sumiharu's voice. Confused by this sudden change in his feelings, Riku begins to notice that the physical closeness between him and Sumiharu is steadily increasing. What could this mean for their relationship?

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

title: Maken Gishi Bacchus: Shinken wo Mezasu Tenseisha wa, Kutte Nonde Tsukutte Sugosu
title_japanese: 魔剣技師バッカス～神剣を目指す転生者は、喰って呑んで造って過ごす～

title: Watashi no Okaasan
title_english: The Alien Who Saved Me from My Mother's Abuse Becomes My True Mother.
synopsis:
Towa is an elementary school child abused by her mother. She learns the being who saved her is an alien who has taken over the mother's body. Towa manages to feel familial love from the alien who, though clumsy, tries to become her "mother."

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Tensai Kagakusha-tachi ga Saikou no Robot wo Tsukutta Manga

title_japanese: アバンダンド〜強すぎて武器が壊れる勇者と武器職人のエルフ〜
synopsis: An elf blacksmith meets a hero who's so strong every weapon shatters in his hands after a single use.

title: Kanojo no Real ga Kirinukenai!
title_japanese: 彼女のリアルが切り抜けない!
synopsis:
Riku Mikami, who is starting as a university student in the spring, finds out that his favorite VTuber is taking a hiatus. The one who cheers him up is Rui Saionji, his classmate. Will Riku resolve to make Rui his "oshi"?

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Yuusha ni Minna Netorareta kedo Akiramezu ni Tatakaou. Kitto Saigo wa Ore ga Katsu.
title_japanese: 勇者にみんな寝取られたけど諦めずに戦おう。きっと最後は俺が勝つ。

title_japanese: 友人の式日 るぅ１ｍｍ作品集
synopsis:
1. Nanashi no Koibito
2. Yuurei Yashiki Love Romance
3. Frankenstein no Yuujin
4. Yuujin no Shikijitsu

title: Eiyuu to Hanzai-ou no Kikan: RE:Criminal
title_japanese: 英雄と犯罪王の帰還 ーRE:クリミナルー

title: Tenshi no Saezuri
synopsis:
Sanae Kitajima is a psychiatrist specializing in end-of-life care. Her boyfriend, Takanashi, who once struggled with a deep fear of death, returns from an Amazon expedition profoundly changed. What happened during the expedition? What is the true meaning behind his cryptic words, "I can hear the whispers of angels"?

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Floating Mate
synopsis:
Following his parents' divorce, Onishi decides to skip the school trip. When he arrives at what he expects to be an empty classroom, he finds his classmate Kitami there instead. This is the tale of two ordinary yet remarkable days shared between two students who stayed behind.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: The Regretful Villainess Is Happily Divorced
title_english: The Regretful Villainess Is Happily Divorced
synopsis:
Marlena Loewysome was doomed by her story's plot, trapped in a marriage with the cheating, neglectful Duke Oscar Creedwell and ever jealous of the female lead Serwen. But she has a plan: Use her acting chops to fool Oscar into demanding a divorce, then escape with the alimony she deserves and open a theater. Things are going her way—until Oscar comes crawling back and a new suitor shows up, begging for her affection. Can Marlena act her way out of this drama before she ends up with more regrets?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: 9-kai Ura no Koi
title_english: Love in the Bottom of the 9th Inning

title: A Fairy Tale Written by a Villain
title_english: A Fairy Tale Written by a Villain
synopsis:
Death by bungee jump—that's exactly what should've ended Jung Seha's life. Now she's Princess Isabelle, struggling to not die again in The Little Mermaid. In this fairy tale turned real, Isabelle must contend with a dysfunctional family and a very obnoxious marriage partner—Grand Duke Waschke, a very rich, handsome man afflicted with a curse that takes the life of his bride on the first night of marriage. Will Isabelle find a way around the curse? Or will she die trying—again?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kyouai no Cupid
synopsis:
The protagonist asks Cupid to win the heart of his beloved. However, Cupid holds her shot, asking, "Isn't this just brainwashing?"

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

title: Shuujin Tensei
synopsis:
Chris, caught up in a suicide bombing carried out by escaped death row inmates, finds himself reincarnated into another world of swords and magic. Determined not to lead a miserable life this time, he resolves to make the most of his innate special abilities. However, those death row inmates have also been reincarnated into this world...!?

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Konyakusha wa, Watashi no Imouto ni Koi wo Suru
title_english: My Fiancé Falls in Love with My Sister
title_japanese: 婚約者は、私の妹に恋をする
synopsis:
Aah, again? My fiancé was gazing intently at my charming younger sister. When I saw the blaze that lit up in those cold eyes, I was assaulted by déjà vu. My fiancé had been in love with my younger sister even in the last life. There was nothing I could do but watch. And, by some karma, I was someone who kept returning to that exact moment.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Ore wa Yome ni Sakaraenai... Seiheki wo Nigirareteiru
title_japanese: 俺は嫁に逆らえない…性癖を握られている

title_english: Love Is Right Next to Me.

title: Shirojika wa Ai wo Utau
title_english: The White Deer Speaks for Love
synopsis:
Saya, son of Louie and Zeth and a part of the Royal family, has fallen for the white deer Yullur. Though they are so far apart in age, Saya has always held on to the playful vow he made as a child to make Yullur his mate. Currently, Saya has been unable to decide on a candidate to be his mate, and is beginning to feel the pressure to find one as he is royalty. Realizing now that he cannot avoid how he has always felt, now might just be the time to confess his feelings. However, Yullur seems to have different thoughts...?

(Source: Frontier Works)

title: Mukahi-kun wa Koukousei
synopsis:
Aoi, landlord of a share house and a florist, can't keep his mind off his first love, Mukahi. One day, the two bump into each other at a wedding. They realize that they are still in love with one another, and spend a blissful night full of passion. However, Mukahi comes to live at Aoi's share house, and there's no doubt about it... Mukahi is a high school senior?!

(Source: Kaiohsha)

title: Please Say Love Me!
title_japanese: プリーズ セイ ラブミー!
synopsis:
Mizuki is a high-schooler, miraculously born to be loved by everyone he encounters. Everyone except his childhood friend, Reo. From the first day they met as kids, Reo not only rejects Mizuki's invitation to hangout, till this day, he still shows no interest at all in Mizuki. Mizuki wants Reo to tell him that he likes him, so he takes him by surprise while he is taking a nap, and uses his body to make the fact that he likes him a reality! The plan is a success, as Reo's cock is captivated by Mizuki's body, which he has perfected for the occasion! However, what came out of Reo's mouth was most shocking: I'll never fall in love with you...!

(Source: Kaiohsha)

title: Koi nanka Suru Hazu mo Nai
title_english: There Is No Way I Would Fall in Love
title_japanese: 恋なんかするはずもない
synopsis:
Taniya, a member of the accounting department, does not like irregularities and prefers to live a quiet, unassuming life. One day, he is coaxed to attend a drinking party by a colleague where he runs into paperwork resubmission man?! His name, Irobe, and he was someone Taniya would seemingly never be able to get along with, until a conversation between them proved to be unexpectedly, pleasant. On their way home, while Taniya was basking in the ambiance of good vibes, he's suddenly kissed by Irobe. Though Irobe confesses his attraction to Taniya, bitter memories of a same-sex partner in Taniya's past resurface...?

(Source: Kaiohsha)

title: Next Door Friend
synopsis:
You were just my next door friend, now you look different.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Ore Igai, Zenin Mushoku.
synopsis:
Mankichi Akatsuki works for a publicly traded IT company, and his work and relationships are going great, but there's one thing that sets him apart: the rest of his family (mother, older sister, and two younger sisters) are all unemployed. Though they're all motivated, for some reason they can't find work. On top of that, his childhood friend Minayo loses her home and comes to live with them... His goal is for everyone to become independent! And to wed his childhood friend!! A harem family comedy!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Metaphor: ReFantazio
title_japanese: メタファー：リファンタジオ
synopsis:
The United Kingdom of Euchronia is thrown into chaos following the assassination of its king... Our Hero, the Traveler Will, and his Fairy Companion Gallica, race to Grand Trad to undertake a Special Mission. Discover the bonds that form between eight races across three countries.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: 5-toubun no Hanayome: [Shunkashuutou]
title_japanese: 五等分の花嫁【春夏秋冬】

title: Saneka no Yomeiri
synopsis:
Tatsuhiko inherits his grandfather's home after his passing. It's been ages, so he heads to the old homestead for a visit. In a storage room there, he encounters a tanuki who claims to be a god. Tatsuhiko and the tanuki god repair the home together while sharing stories about his grandfather. Following this strange turn of events, the two decide to get married?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Otsubone Reijou to Shuka no Kisetsu: Reitetsu Saishou-sama no Okazari no Tsuma ni Natta Hazu ga, Dekiai sareteimasu
title_japanese: お局令嬢と朱夏の季節 ～冷徹宰相様のお飾りの妻になったはずが、溺愛されています～
synopsis:
Alellia, who has had her engagement broken off, is past the marriageable age, and is known behind her back as the "domineering female supervisor." She spends her days performing her duties as the right-hand woman of Marquess Istilia Wegmund, "the cold-hearted prime minister."

One day, while performing her duties, the Prime Minister asks her to marry him. Rumor has it that the Prime Minister is in love with another woman. Alellia accepts the engagement, believing that she is being asked to enter into a contractual marriage.

A newly-married life with the cold-hearted prime minister begins...!

(Source: Earth Star Entertainment, translated)

title: Youngest Sister-in-Law in a Tragic Reverse Harem
title_english: Youngest Sister-in-Law in a Tragic Reverse Harem
title_japanese: 피폐 역하렘 남주들의 막내 처제가 되었다
synopsis:
One feverish night, 6-year-old Liliana Bercchio suddenly recalls the plot of a tragic reverse harem novel. Unsure if she's been reincarnated or has time traveled, her young mind struggles to make sense of it all. Her family is doomed to get caught up in the protagonists' mess—but there's still time... or so she thought. When she witnesses the female lead's death and the deranged male leads appear before her sisters, the story takes a turn. They seem different now, but is her family truly safe?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Fangaku!! Tokyo Daikuudou School Life RTA
title_japanese: ファン学!! 東京大空洞スクールライフRTA

title: Topographia
synopsis: After killing and stealing the guitar of a puck-rock musician, a man ages until he dies and his soul has an astral journey through time and space.

title: Kuromaku Ikka ni Tensei shita kedo Gensaku Mushi shite Dokuritsu suru
title_english: I've Been Reborn into a Mastermind Family, but I'm Going Independent, Ignoring the Original Story.
title_japanese: 黒幕一家に転生したけど原作無視して独立する
synopsis:
A voluntary banishment declaration from the family, known as a "mastermind family!" In order to avoid destruction, Yuri decides to live an unconventional slow life in the frontier...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Menhera Usagi wa Yandere Ookami ni Dekiai sareru
title_japanese: メンヘラうさぎはヤンデレ狼に溺愛される
synopsis:
Tsumugi is a menhera girl who's been dumped by a string of boyfriends for being too clingy. Her last boyfriend got angry at her for sneakily looking through his phones and kicked her out of the house. And that's when Itoshi, the super kind younger guy who completely accepts her, comes to the rescue. His gentle comfort soothes Tsumugi's broken heart, however, there's something he's hiding...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Koibito no Shita no Namae ga Yobenakute Komattemasu
title_english: I'm Having Trouble Calling My Girlfriend by Her First Name.
title_japanese: 恋人の下の名前が呼べなくて困ってます

title: The Black Serpent
synopsis:
"I shall destroy the factions of justice and avenge the deaths of my comrades!"

Jeonghwa, the captain of the Black Serpent Squad, loses everyone she grew up with when the lawful factions betray them after the battle against the chaotic factions. On the verge of death herself, she must now claw her way up to deliver true justice to the so-called justice factions.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: We Are Young
synopsis:
Since the old days, mystical creatures have existed to help humans. However, now that the times have changed, they suddenly receive a warning from their god: "Prove that you are still needed."

While grappling with how they can assist humans in the modern era, these creatures decide to send their younglings to the human world to seek answers.

Meanwhile, university student Park Geuru, who lives his miserable days commuting for five hours to school due to a sudden move, accidentally ends up making a bet with the goblin Sihan...

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Toumei to Zanzou
synopsis:
Shoko, an aspiring artist, made her living drawing portraits. One day, a young man wrapped in bandages asked her to draw his self-portrait, but as it turned out, he was actually an invisible man...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: XXX or BEAT
synopsis:
Yuuki Tsukimiya is part of the popular idol group "XXXME (Kiss Me)". He's busy every day but enjoys secretly going to the live performances of his favorite band "growly the footman" (GROFF). He is fascinated by the "world of explosions" that is different from the world of glittering idols.

One day, Yuuki, who was invited to GROFF's live afterparty, got nervous in front of his favorite band member Aga Daisuke, so he drinks too much and passes out. When Yuuki wakes up at Daisuke's house, who took care of him, he asks Daisuke, "Can you teach me how to play the guitar?" but was asked to do something naughty in return...!?

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Shinmai Necromancer, Maou wo Sosei suru.
title_japanese: 新米ネクロマンサー、魔王を蘇生する。
synopsis:
"O spirit destined to be mine, rise once more from the realm of the dead!"

In the depths of an extravagant tomb, Alice, a novice necromancer, channeled her mana into an ancient coffin as she cast her spell. Dust scattered through the air, and a wave of overwhelming mana surged, leaving her breathless. But what emerged was not the mindless undead she had expected—it was a handsome young man, casually perched atop the coffin, his piercing gaze meeting hers. With a bright, disarming smile, he introduced himself—but Alice soon realized the truth: this was no ordinary man. He was the legendary figure who, centuries ago, had plunged the world into chaos and terror... the Demon King himself.

(Source: Sankosha, translated)

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Na mo Naki Senjou
title_japanese: 機動戦士ガンダム 名も無き戦場
synopsis: A manga adaptation of the game Mobile Suit Gundam Online.

title: Kanojo ni Norowareteru kedo Shiawase nanode OK desu☆
title_japanese: 彼女に呪われてるけど幸せなのでOKです☆
synopsis:
Being kind to girls is the most important thing to 17-year-old Harunari Iida. As the kind of guy to carry the bags of all the girls in his class with him to school each morning, those around him sarcastically called him the "Ultimate Gentleman Iida." One day, he encountered Sari Kageura, a beautiful girl with a strange aura, but he noticed a cursed-looking monster emerging from her body. Iida was going to hurry and flee, but wasn't something amiss...? He was cursed by the heroine?! A new sensation horror romcom!

(Source: COMICSMART, translated)

title: Shiitagerare no Majutsushi Reijou wa, "Hyourou Saishou"-sama ni Dekiai sareru
title_japanese: 虐げられの魔術師令嬢は、『氷狼宰相』様に溺愛される
synopsis: Sophia, the daughter of a marquis, was engaged to the second prince, Delm. Both of them worked at the Royal Institute of Magic Research, but Delm often pushed his work onto Sophia under the guise of their engagement. One day, Sophia invented a new type of magic, but Delm stole her research paper and registered the magic under his own name. When Sophia demanded her rights back, Delm refused and falsely accused her of lying about the theft. As a result, Delm was celebrated as a genius within the institute, while Sophia was ridiculed and labeled incompetent for failing to produce any results. Her reputation as a researcher was ruined, and her only cherished laboratory was taken away by Delm. To make matters worse, Delm declared their engagement annulled, stating, "Someone as incompetent as you isn't worthy of being my fiancée." Devastated, Sophia returned to her family estate, having lost everything. However, through a twist of fate, she became engaged to Leo Santorina, known as the "Ice

title: Konyaku Haki da, Hatsujou Seijo.
title_english: The Inconvenient Life of an Arousing Priestess
synopsis:
Monster-fighting priestess Monica's impressive powers earned her an engagement with the crown prince, but... those powers come with a downside, arousing anyone affected, including herself! When the prince finds out, their engagement doesn't last long. 

While news of the "indecent" holy woman spreads throughout the land, an unexpected connection from her past approaches Monica for help: he needs her powers, and the rumors don't seem to bother him. His name is Richard, and unbeknownst to Monica, he is also a prince...

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Yomei Wazuka dakara to Tsuihou sareta Seijo desu ga, Junrei no Tabi ni Detara Choukenkou ni Narimashita
title_english: The Banished Saint's Pilgrimage: From Dying to Thriving
title_japanese: 余命わずかだからと追放された聖女ですが、巡礼の旅に出たら超健康になりました
synopsis:
Princess Platina, a devoted saint to her kingdom despite enduring cruel mistreatment, receives devastating news—she doesn't have long to live. Her stepsister seals her fate by ordering her on a harsh pilgrimage to the Holy Land, effectively banishing her from the royal castle. Eisen, a captive knight, is forced to accompany her as both attendant and witness to her death. What will become of their lives on this journey...?

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Akuma Koujo
synopsis:
She had a dream. Something about it was wonderful and brimming with light. It even felt so...real. But this world with trains, schools, books, movies, and friends isn't her home. Yet, something within her longs for it. When she awakes, she's in the demon world, living as a lesser demon. It's a carefree life—or it was until a more powerful being crossed her path. Then everything happened so fast: the magic summoning circle appeared and she didn't hesitate, she closed her eyes and jumped into it. 

When her eyes opened again, she was in the Holy Kingdom and...a baby?! Despite being in the form of a human baby she knew she was still a demon. Without her demon strength or power, would she be able to stay safe as a weak baby? The life of a demon growing up as a human begins!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

The manga's story centers on Mamoru Genki, a macho young man who believes in protecting people, but he himself is driven by debt and is forced to commit robbery with a loosely organized crime gang. Mamoru and other gang members rob an insect museum of an old professor, whom he just met and "protected." Pushed to the limit, Mamoru unleashes the true power of his well-trained body, and tries to stick to his ideal of protecting people.

(Source: ANN)

title: Daigaku Nyuugakuji kara Uwasa sareteita Bishoujo San Shimai, Ikiwakareteita Gimai Datta.
title_japanese: 大学入学時から噂されていた美少女三姉妹、生き別れていた義妹だった。

The three sisters, once clingy and needy as children, have now grown into beautiful young women—and for some reason, they've developed a strong possessive streak! This youth romance-comedy kicks off as they reunite, and the beautiful trio start competing for attention!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Hanakotoba no Inouryoku wo Te ni Shita Ore wa, "Gyakkyou" no Chikara de Musou suru
title_japanese: 花言葉の異能力を手にした俺は、「逆境」の力で無双する
synopsis:
Confronted by parasitic plant monsters called "Weeds," the protagonist Yuu finds himself in dire straits against their overwhelming power. In this moment of absolute crisis, Yuu awakens to an unknown ability that transforms him into a Weed. This is a world where the language of flowers becomes supernatural powers. With the ultimate ability that blooms in "Adversity," he'll mow down every enemy!!

(Source: COMICSMART, translated)

title: Kakurete Ichaicha Share House!
title_japanese: かくれてイチャイチャシェアハウス!

synopsis:
Han Ji-hyuk, the legendary necromancer who saved humanity on the continent of Seron, finally returned to Earth, longing for a peaceful and happy retirement. But from the very first day back, his plans for a quiet life went completely off the rails.

At the age of twenty, Ji-hyuk had been summoned to Seron by a magician named Theros, where he was forced to live as a necromancer. After countless years of battling and hardship, he finally defeated the Demon King and returned to Earth. But the Earth he came back to wasn't the one he remembered. The world had been ravaged by Gates and monsters, and to make matters worse, all the gold and treasures he brought back had vanished into thin air. Now stuck as an F-Rank Awakened, Ji-hyuk had no choice but to start from scratch to earn a living.

So, when will Ji-hyuk finally achieve the peaceful retirement he's been dreaming of? Or is his journey far from over?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

synopsis:
Now that she's defeated the Demon King and become the country's greatest mage, Lacey has officially fulfilled her life's purpose. All that's left is to spend the rest of her days in a loveless political marriage. But when her engagement is broken off, Lacey realizes that all she wants is to live freely. Her wish is granted, and she moves into an empty mansion near a sleepy village. Settling in is hard for her; shy and self-effacing, Lacey doesn't know anything about living on her own! She can fry legions of monsters, but frying up a meal? She'd rather starve. Luckily, her friends have her back; with the support of the community, her former party member Wayne, and a monster pet, Lacey slowly learns to take care of herself and come out of her shell. Meanwhile, Lacey's worth becomes clear to the townspeople when she solves their problems with magic that's both unconventional and spectacular. So begins Lacey's newfound calling as a magical handywoman!

Simun Kim—an alchemist out of necessity, due to an inability to use magic—successfully transmuted the Philosopher's Stone to stop this cosmic threat. But he still failed. As death closes in, the Philosopher's Stone rewinds time, waking Simun in the past with one last chance to rewrite the end of the world.

Demis refuses at first, but upon discovering Dante's immortality, he becomes intrigued. A dangerous promise is made—one that ties them together in a fate neither of them could have foreseen.

title: You Are So Lovely

After rescuing a young hybrid named Lee Hae-on from an accident, Juhyeok planned to keep him around just until he recovered. But the once-scrawny stray grows up—fast—and now towers over his reluctant guardian, refusing to leave his side. Juhyeok can handle gangs and thugs, but nothing could prepare him for this: Hae-on's first heat. Sweet, clingy, and completely unaware of personal space, Hae-on's affection is anything but subtle. Raising a hybrid was never part of the plan—but neither was falling for one.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

A seemingly harmless reunion with an old classmate, Shin Subin, ends in a brutal murder. And then, inexplicably, Woori wakes up back in high school, right beside Subin who has no idea that he just killed his deskmate. Trapped in a deadly time loop where almost every timeline ends with his death at Subin's hands, Woori becomes desperate to escape his fate. After multiple resets, Woori finally comes to the conclusion that the only path to survival may be ensuring Subin's happiness. With just one life left, Woori sets out to give Subin the happiest life possible.

By night, she's back to being human. Forced to live under one roof with the aloof CEO, Chahyeon Baek, the two begin to grow closer in the most unexpected way. But can Umi ever return to her normal life for good? Or will she be stuck living on a leash forever?

And when they run into each other again "by chance," one thing becomes clear to Ji-u: She must have him—whatever that may entail. Ji-u wants Yuseung's rare ability to make werewolves stronger through touch. Yuseung, on the other hand, wants information on key figures in the werewolf world to eliminate them. Will they each get what they're after? Or more importantly—will they fall in love?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Miss Pendleton
synopsis:
Twenty-nine-year-old spinster Laura Pendleton is known to be a talented matchmaker in London society. When she's asked to find a wife for the eligible bachelor lan Dalton, she believes it will be an easy task―until she meets the gorgeous yet blunt and aloof Mr. Dalton in person.

Although Miss Pendleton introduces him to several beautiful young ladies, the cynical Mr. Dalton appears to have eyes only for his matchmaker. But Miss Pendleton has no interest in marriage, especially not to such a wealthy nobleman, due to her shameful past. Instead, Miss Pendleton makes arrangements to become a governess and thereby escape her abusive uncle on her own. But Mr. Dalton is nothing if not persistent. When Miss Pendleton faces unexpected troubles, he offers her the governess position for his young nephews in order to get closer to her.

Mr. Dalton's love, bordering obsession, for Miss Pendleton means that he won't give up until he can convince her to become his―despite all that is at stake.

However, this man turns out to be Chris, the poor boy she looked after before abandoning him long ago. The once-fragile boy now approaches her without hesitation. Does he approach out of past attraction, or is there something more underneath?

However, it quickly becomes clear that Cain's true object of affection is her younger sister, and the proposal was made to the wrong person. Despite this revelation, Mireille is forced by her father to take her sister's place and marry Cain as a stand-in bride. Prepared to bear the guilt of this deception, Mireille braces herself for a cold and loveless life. Yet, to her surprise, Cain cherishes her deeply as his bride. Why does he continue to treasure her so sincerely despite the truth?

Learning from that, he vowed to focus entirely on his university film club activities, completely ignoring romance. But that resolve was short-lived—before he knew it, he found himself falling for Ootsuka Ozora, a girl he met in the film club...!?

synopsis:

She has lived her lifetime constantly fighting yokai but her most dangerous opponent turns out to be just one guy?!

On the orders of Buddha, Monk Sanzang and her companions pilgramaged the Western regions in search of his teachings. Unlike Sun Wukong, Zhu Bajie, and Sha Wujing, who hoped to become gods in recognition of their contribution, rather than being tied down to the life of Buddhism, Sanzang wanted to remain in the human world and enjoy a new life as an ordinary human.

But as she was being dragged to Heaven by orders from the Buddha, she notices a strange tunnel leading to the human world in which she escapes into...

And the place where she fell is the Republic of Korea's Jeju Island! And she meets a guy named Lee Hyun?!

The time-slipped Monk Sanzang a.k.a Hyeonjeong and the tsundere Lee Hyun's turbulent romance!

The bested kingdom bows before the mighty empire, and Helio requests one of the five princesses as his future empress consort. The princess is evidently no more than a hostage; so the king offers the poor Lilliana, the unloved and shunned daughter. But Lilliana cannot bring herself to care—she has decided to flee!

In fact, Lilliana knows all about Helio thanks to a childcare feel-good fantasy novel she read in her previous life. Their adorable pink-haired daughter will eventually melt Helio's icy heart, and Lilliana will appear only in flashbacks, having died in childbirth. Absolutely dead set on staying alive, Lilliana insists on emphasizing all her shortcomings—but it makes Helio surprisingly fond of her. Fukusuke Mogi, a plain but nice guy, secretly admires Yua Kureha, the most beautiful girl in the class. However, the one rumored to be with Yua is Fukusuke's best friend Fujisaki, the ace of the basketball team.

Feeling down about being a "mob character" overshadowed by his best friend, Fukusuke discovers another super cute girl who's hidden in Yui's shadow and doesn't stand out—Amari Usuha!

He secretly snaps photos of Ido cheating and uses them for blackmail. All Gyeonwoo wants is just one night with Ido. Their night of passion went as planned, but as Gyeonwoo turns over in bed, he finds a new guy lying beside him... As Gyeonwoo is forced to reckon with his new reality, what shape will his love for Ido take on?

Four years ago, after Seyeon lost her memories for five months, she began to dream of this every night. A dream where she made love to a man whose face she couldn't see and whose identity remained a mystery. His body was strong, but his touch was gentle, and every movement he made was mesmerizing. Every time Seyeon felt those clear sensations, she was rendered confused, wondering who this man was. Was he her lover? The father of her child? Or just a man she knew for one fleeting night? Amid the doubts that remained unanswered, one day, she met Soohyuk, her father's personal doctor who had just moved from America. And when Seyeon first saw him, she felt an inexplicable sensation... synopsis:
Betrayed by her fiancé Prince Raymond and her best friend Samantha, Sophia and her whole family were executed. When she wakes up in the morning, she realizes that she is back it time before her engagement. In order to change the fate of her family's execution, she refuses the engagement with the second prince Raymond and decides to make the first prince Alexis the crown prince to avenge her family. However, it is not an easy road...

How will the fierce battle for the crown end? Will Sophia be able to change her destiny? The epic revenge drama is about to begin.

The Crown Prince Wilhelm suddenly announced the dissolvement of his betrothal to Constance (Connie), the daughter of a marquis. It seems like he had fallen in love with someone else... a saint who had appeared recently. Connie grew depressed at the cruel declaration, as she had spent the past two years acting as his consort. But one day, her memory returned, and she realized that she had been reincarnated as the villainess in a romance novel.

"Whatever. I don't need a cheater (with the option to become a villainess). I'll live on as the leader of my land!"

This is Connie's story of how she lives her life with strength in the borderlands far away from the capital city!

Excited by this dream-like turn of events, Soma is thrilled, but what he discovers is the disappointing true nature of his favorite...

Easily able to discern the true nature hidden behind others' smiles, he encounters a formidable opponent in the form of a cheerful, twin-tailed beauty named Kyuuragi. Whether it's intentional or innocent, her every move and gesture is cunningly calculated, catching Matsuura off guard... "Stop it! I'm going to fall for you!!!"

A rom-com about a caring but also annoying high school girl who loves cats despite her fur allergy. One day, she rescues a weak cat and takes it home, only for it to turn into a human boy overnight! And this mysterious cat boy is no less than the grumpy guy in school she can't seem to get along with!

After one fateful match, former professional boxer Ryou Harima awakens from a two-year vegetative state to find out his career is over, his father has died, and he's been betrayed by his gym... Ode, once a Genesis Weapon himself, investigates the secrets of the M3 company, seeking memories of his life before becoming a weapon. When he discovers children being used in experiments to create others like the Genesis Weapons, he sets out on a journey to find the comrades who escaped with him and to uncover what M3 is after.

At school, he suffers from unreasonable bullying by the rich kids and is looked at with a sense of pity by the girl he admires. Appearance, wealth, talent—life is determined by what you are born with. No matter how hard you try, you can never beat those born with it... Just as Ayumu is lost in despair, an otherworldly demon suddenly appears before him. "If you wish, I can guarantee the results of your efforts," says the demon, introducing himself as Dashoku. What he offers is an app called "Rental Effort"—an app that allows Ayumu to borrow the results of effort and instantly gain abilities in advance. PriPara is a place where anyone can be an idol. However, a major update went haywire and now PriPara is in danger of disappearing! In the fashion capital of PriParis, the former Prisiennes who used to be charming and sparkly idols have lost their memories and now go about their day-to-day lives feeling as though they're missing something.

Things suddenly change when one of these Prisiennes receives an invitation card. On a sleepless night, the rich scent of casablanca fills the air and Phantom Thief Genius Neo appears.

"Bienvenue! Let us fall together into nighttime Idol Land PriPara!"

Hibiki Shikyouin's brilliant play begins in secret while a detective named Chris searches for the truth behind Phantom Thief Genius Neo!

synopsis:
Eunjae Seo, a not-so-fortunate member of a wealthy conglomerate family, goes on a blind date with Shi-u Yun, whom her grandfather arranged for her to marry. Initially wary of Shi-u due to his bad reputation, Eunjae starts warming up to him as Shi-u confesses he fell in love with her at first sight. She ends up falling deeply in love with him. The two seem to be a happy couple, until Shi-u begins to reveal his secrets to her after their wedding.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

A guild master, once ranked number one, wakes up 500 years in the future after winning a major siege. The guild is gone, the world feels strange, and everything has fallen apart. Determined to rebuild the guild and adapt to this unfamiliar time, they embark on a journey to restore their legacy and conquer the challenges of the new era.

(Source: LuaScans)

At 4, Groo is undoubtedly the youngest S-ranked awakened in the country. But as her kindergarten class's (self-proclaimed) ace, she can take a challenge! So when her first quest window tells her to find a grown-up who'll take her in, she marches down to the top guild in Korea and demands to be recruited. Sensing that this overpowered orphan shouldn't fall into the wrong hands, the guildmaster has no choice but to adopt her. But he has no idea this tiny girl is about to turn his life upside down!

Upon meeting the mild-mannered yet inscrutable lawyer Oh Inseop, Gijeong begins to find her life changing, though little does she know that wherever Inseop goes, death follows.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Black Leopard Family's Snow Leopard Baby

The child of a black leopard and a snow leopard shapeshifter, 7-year-old Tiel escapes her abusive family to seek refuge with the father she never knew. All she wants is safety, but her father, the feared Duke Asterian, has other plans... to give his long-lost daughter a loving family and a wonderful home! Now, Tiel is set on protecting her family from the evil forces who want to take her away. Can she fight these foes to save her new home? Or will Tiel lose her loved ones once and for all?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Spy Life in the Demonic Sect
title_english: The Spy Life in the Demonic Sect
synopsis:
Iseo Jang, the Murim Alliance's prodigy spy, has spent 14 years deep undercover in the Demon Sect, earning the ruthless title of "Rabid Dog" for his work as their counterintelligence agent. But his newest mission is his most absurd yet: make the Sect's laziest, most notorious delinquent—Wu Ma—the next Cheonma. To pull it off, Iseo ditches his post and applies to be Wu Ma's official aide. In a world of betrayal, martial arts, and political games, can even a talent like Iseo turn a hopeless young master into an heir?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Heroine's Friend Strikes Back
synopsis:
Reborn as a side character wrongfully accused and executed, Mia resolves to rewrite her fate. Returning to the moment she first met the villainous heroine, she vows to stand tall and fight back, sparking a thrilling rebellion against a fabricated destiny.

(Source: LuaScans)

title: What Death Taught Me
synopsis:
As Rinette Dikla Hilt burns at the stake, she begs the heavens for a second chance to atone for her sins and escape her wretched fate. Unaware that Argos, the second prince and her beloved, and Kanna, her adopted sister, were conspiring against her, Rinette played her part in the death of Crown Prince Pinberk. The blame fell on her as Argos and Kanna dropped their masks and displayed their wicked greed for power.

Waking up on the day her father brings in Kanna, Rinette decides to utilize what death taught her. Although Rinette ruins Kanna's initial plans, Kanna still covets all that Rinette possesses and is prepared to kill for it. Rinette plots to avoid Argos and grow closer to Pinberk—occasionally relying on an unexpected ally—but she knows not to trust anyone while ensuring that Kanna never gains a place in her family and the opportunity to destroy her again.

title: This Marriage Will Surely Succeed

Iona Modrov, known as the emperor's sword, hound, and secret lover, endures a harsh life as the illegitimate child of the Modrov family. Despite her sacrifices, she is forced into a political marriage and ultimately betrayed by the emperor.

On the brink of death, the only one who comes to save her is her unwanted husband, Duke Leroy Han. In her final moments, she asks for a last kiss before dying—only to wake up in the past before everything went wrong.

Determined to change her fate, she runs to Leroy and boldly proposes: "Duke, marry me. This time, I will make you happy!"

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

With her feisty temperament and unyielding attitude, Katherina Smirnoff is labeled a villainess by the men around her. Tired of the smug suitors trying to change her, she decides she'd rather not marry at all. While striving to escape their pursuit and stand up for herself, Katherina crosses paths with Nikolai de Bassily, the feared Grand Duke of Blood. To her surprise, he seems drawn to her and understands her for who she is. Could this be a chance at true love for the free-spirited Katherina?

Known as the "Queen" for her strong-willed and arrogant personality, Yamamoto had always found her difficult to get along with. Indeed, she soon rockets up the ranks, angling toward the pinnacle of the guild: Blank Rank, something only a select few across the entire world have ever achieved. In the midst of her meteoric rise, she receives a request from Logan, an aged adventurer who was once a force to be reckoned with in his prime. That request leads her to meet Nell, a young girl with adventurer aspirations of her own. Little does Surena know that this encounter will see her reach new heights. Amidst the ruin, Pyo Guwon walks against the tide of fleeing survivors. On his path, he finds Heo Jinwoo, left for dead after an attack. Instead of passing by, Pyo offers a hand, posing a single question: "How does it feel to survive hell?" With that, he leads Jinwoo to a village where death holds no meaning—but in a world that refuses to let go of the past, survival is never that simple.

Il-tak came up with an idea for raising his ranking... "If I become friends with Hyun-woo Lee, the real powerhouse in the second grade of the school, I can rise to the ranks of the bullies again!" 

However, for some reason, Hyun-woo is trying to distance himself from Il-tak... Will he be able to regain his former glory?

Just when he thinks all hope is lost, the God of Seduction, affectionately nicknamed Ecchan, suddenly appears to turn his fortunes around! Ecchan reveals that the only way to make things right is to find Satoru's perfect partner—a match so ideal that sparks are guaranteed to fly.

Enter Shinya Hoshina, a wildly popular actor and Satoru's supposed soulmate. Satoru manages to get close to Shinya, leading to a night that redefines everything he thought he knew about pleasure. But as Shinya's kindness and sincerity begin to melt Satoru's heart, what started as divine intervention turns into something much deeper.

Then one day, he wakes up in another world, only to discover he’s a dark elf, and a beautiful woman at that! Despite having a body as tough as steel and a vast reserve of magical power, the timid Haruka still goes through life indecisively. Yet she (he) forms a party with fellow adventurers twice her (his) age and steadily adapts to this new world. The middle-aged man who once gave up on bonding with others opens his heart and strives to grow as his new self in another world. So the curtain rises on a twisted but classic story of adventure!

Armed with monstrous abilities, he enrolls at Aslan Magic Academy with a single goal: to become the strongest student and avoid his villainous fate. However, rewriting his story and shaking up the delicate balance of character dynamics is easier said than done. Luckily, Luke's growing charisma and power make him a magnetic force, drawing everyone to his side—ranging from high nobles to shadowy schemers, and even the love interests meant for the hero. It seems like he may just sidestep his bad ending. But even the smallest change threatens to send the entire narrative into chaos. Can Luke rewrite his fate, or is his disastrous destiny inevitable?

And if that's not strange enough, the cat transforms into an extremely handsome man named Kanawa, who declares in front of everyone that he wants to be kept by Haruta! Can Haruta escape this cat-astrophe, or is he stuck being the proud owner of a handsome catboy?!

After a portal is torn open between the monster world and their own, Ten and his brothers are pressed to hunt down the invaders threatening humanity—with the promise that success means getting a wish granted. But can they safely see their mission through? And will Ten ever achieve the normal days he dreams of?

Yet one day, the Imperial Princess Fiarca—his ex-fiancée who was thought to be dead—appears before him. When the empire's war finally comes to an end, he returns home as a distinguished army commander...so Byletta takes the opportunity to request a divorce. But in response, he proposes a wager that'll keep them together for one more month. A clumsy love story unfolds between a young woman with the reputation of a villainess, and a young man who has never known love!

Sano thinks he's found the solution, but he gets more than he bargained for when he buys three colored chicks from a festival stall to keep him company—not only do they grow rapidly and develop reptilian tails, but they seem to be able to talk! Between learning the ropes of mountain living, getting acquainted with his rural neighbors, and raising his questionable but adorable chickens, Sano's got a lot on his plate. Long story short, his solitary new life might turn out to be more exciting than he anticipated!

When he's reborn in a fantasy world as Hisui, the youngest son of Baron Clematis, it seems like his dream is finally coming true—until he realizes this noble house is totally broke! With a family full of bullies and a monster-infested barony, Hisui's new life isn't exactly the relaxing getaway he wanted, though he at least has kindly older sisters to lean on. Just when escape seems impossible, Hisui runs into three self-proclaimed goddesses who grant him their power and awaken his incredible magical abilities! In her short fifteen years of life, she had learned, above all else, to endure. Unfortunately, however, her fiancée wasn't quite so noble—a fact Sophelia learns firsthand when she catches him half-naked with her very own sister! Running to Sophelia's aid is none other than Livionis, a knight of the kingdom who has long been secretly in love with her. Captivating the forlorn Sophelia at first sight, Livionis invites her to flee the kingdom and run away with him. Making up her mind in an instant, Sophelia takes Livionis's hand and leaves behind the only life she'd ever known. Concealing her past and taking on a new identity as "Sophie," she tumbles headfirst into a riveting romance with Livionis. Venturing into the unknown wilderness of an uncertain future, just where will this young duo find themselves as new love rings?

Kota, being a bit rambunctious, would always drag around the quiet and meek Naoto, getting him caught up in his antics. There was one time, however, when Naoto went against him. After that, Naoto moved away without saying a word. Since then, Kota has regretted bullying Naoto when they were kids. When they saw each other again, Naoto talked to Kota like nothing happened. Kota blurts out an apology and says to make up for things he'll grant Naoto one wish. But Naoto wishes for him and Kota to become lovers?! 

(Source: MangaPlaza)

synopsis:

Fast forward three years, and they're living together. The honeymoon phase is long over and Haruka's lack of romantic gestures has really started to get on Kosei's nerves.

"But today was our anniversary..."

When Haruka fails to live up to Kosei's expectations yet again, he has had enough and wants to break up! Seemingly apathetic, Haruka agrees. Despite his frustrations, Kosei loves the small things Haruka does for him, but the small misunderstandings between them have left Kosei feeling broken. A bittersweet love filled with heartbreak as these two try to understand each other. This bittersweet romance explores the heartbreak and challenges of two people in love trying to truly understand each other. 

(Source: MangaPlaza)

After venting to a friend over drinks, Jiyeong blacks out—only to wake up to a shirtless Garam staring down at her.

What started as a harmless little obsession is spiraling fast into chaos. Can Jiyeong separate love from... limbs?

Every night, she finds herself beneath him, powerless against the pleasure and confusion he brings. Is it a dream? A different world? Or something in between? synopsis:
The crown princess Lune Renard has been captured by the revolutionary army, condemned to death as the vixen who threw the nation into chaos by hiding her past as a lowly orphan. However, Lune never wanted to be the crown princess, and her marquis adoptive father practically sold her to the crown prince. But as she and her family are executed, the Great Fox Spirit Reineke hears Lune's prayers and sends her back in time to avert this terrible fate. What's more, she now has fox ears that can hear the voices of spirits! Lune is determined to save her people, but she must first win over House Renard, the family that adopted her but always treated her coldly—especially her brother Liam. She was sure that Liam hated her, but now he's always doting on her! With Liam and the spirits by her side, Lune will find a happy ending for everyone!

Because of him, the smart, hardworking girl Takahide always found herself in second place despite her best efforts. If only she could find a weakness in Amano somehow...! But when she kept glancing at Amano with that thought in mind, Amano misunderstood and thought that she liked him. So he suddenly confessed to her...? Can she beat him at "love"? A school love comedy between a genius boy and a bright girl!

While Nea adjusts to her role (and Dino's peculiar brand of companionship) she is tasked with the search for the Grimmdoll Chain: an artifact in possession of the elusive Masked Monster. If not her lifespan, what will Dino require of her in exchange for her wishes...?

Asaki's grandfather, the current head of the Hibana family, tells her that her condition for quitting as an exorcist is to capture the Hibana family's sworn enemy, the Yatagarasu clan. While Asaki is struggling to find Yatagarasu, a mysterious transfer student, Amahara Ten, appears in front of Asaki and suddenly kisses her hand and says, "I am Yatagarasu, the crow whose life you saved."

title: Munou Nintei de Boukensha Kubi ni Natta kara Jimoto ni Kaette Kekkon suru: Kekkon Aite ga Sekai wo Horoboshikaketa Ryuuou no Musume de Ore no Nouryoku ga Kakusei shita
title_japanese: 無能認定で冒険者クビになったから地元に帰って結婚する～結婚相手が世界を滅ぼしかけた龍王の娘で俺の能力が覚醒した～
synopsis:
Judged for having no chance of getting a skill, Alex gave up on his dreams of becoming an adventurer and put his days in a guild behind him. Upon returning to his hometown, he was approached by his childhood friend, Heroine Nadja, who proposed her hand in marriage. The two then decided to spend the rest of their lives in peace. But then, a flock of monsters attacks their town...

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Youjuu-sama no Gochisou-chan
title_english: Gobbled up by the Beast Spirit
title_japanese: 妖獣様のごちそうちゃん
synopsis:
Being invited to join a coworker for dinner has never been so steamy!

Uru's main joy in life is eating as much food as she can find. On the other hand, the private life of Nokyo, her handsome colleague, is so mysterious that no one has ever seen him eat! Although many of the women at their company have targeted him for his good looks, Uru's been content to casually admire him from afar. But, she's in for a shock when she catches him after hours in the break room with a female coworker. In addition to witnessing the embarrassing scene, Uru quickly realizes that Nokyo is actually a beast spirit who feeds off human energy from activities in the bedroom. Now that Uru's seen his true form and interrupted his meal, she's next on his list to gobble up!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Oozumou Reijou: Zense ni Sumou-bu Datta Watashi ga Suteneko Ouji to Haa Dosukoi Dosukoi
title_japanese: 大相撲令嬢 ～前世に相撲部だった私が捨て猫王子と はぁどすこいどすこい～
synopsis:
When Floortje is reincarnated into the world of an otome game, things immediately go wrong. Her fiancé, Prince Jonas, breaks off their engagement, and the supposed protagonist, the Saint of Light Jaromíra, makes Floortje out to be the villainess. Little do they know, however, that Floortje was a sumo wrestler in her past life—and she won't let these weaklings stand in her way! After rescuing the cat-eared Prince Richie from the castle's dungeon, Floortje embarks on a journey with an ever-growing sumo stable to save the kingdom from the grips of the real villains, Prince Jonas and Saint Jaromíra. With the spirit of sumo—her most trustworthy ally—to guide her, she's ready for a smackdown! But why was she reincarnated into an otome game, and how did its protagonist turn evil in the first place?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title_japanese: 旦那様がちっちゃいモフモフになりました ～私を悪女だと誤解していたのに、すべて義母の嘘だと気づいたようです～
synopsis:
I, Lily, the daughter of a baron, was proposed to Louis, the heroic knight and head of the ducal family, whom everyone admires. However, in the two years since we got married, I have been hated by Louis-sama and abused by his mother-in-law and sister-in-law. That's because my mother-in-law is telling Louis-sama that I'm an "evil woman" who indulges in extravagance and abuses her servants! One day, after getting used to our tentative life as a married couple, I was cleaning the garden when I saw a very cute, fluffy little animal the size of my palm! I couldn't help but call out to the child who has eyes and fur that look just like Louis-sama... but I couldn't believe it was him!?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Mamono no Mori no Shoujo Nova
title_english: Nova, Little Girl in the Monster Forest
title_japanese: 魔物ノ森ノ少女ノヴァ

Nova, a spirited young girl raised by monsters in the forest, has one big wish—she wants to use the earth's blessing known as "Magia." However, it seems there is a secret about Nova that only Cerberus, the leader of the forest, knows... Unaware of this hidden truth, Nova continues to run happily and innocently through the forest today. The magical tale of a girl raised by monsters begins...!

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

title: Giniro no Michi: Handayama Ibun
