Yodoi apologizes to Murase, saying that it is his fault that he is being bullied, and he begins to care about Murase. However, the bullying of Murase becomes excessive, and Yodoi, who is enraged—?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Abyss Cruise
synopsis:
Jun Jung was a bystander who watched his classmates bully Soorim Sung, a student who transferred to Bukak High School at the start of his second year. Although Jun never participated in the bullying, he also never did anything to help stop it. Six months later, Jun's class was picked for Abyss—an escape room on a ship. Jun and his classmates couldn't be more excited, but their excitement soon turns into fear when they realize the person behind Abyss is out for blood...

When Ella finds a sickly young boy suffering from a mysterious illness in a cave, she brings him home, only for her to discover a special healing power that helps him recover. Six years later, Carl has grown into a striking young man, but to Ella, he remains like a brother... or so she thinks. Though childhood friends, what Ella doesn't know, is that Carl is the lost crown prince of the Easton Empire, believed to have perished in a fire... and is only biding his time to make things right again. But Carl has another secret—his feelings for Ella go far beyond family...

Everything from their looks to their personalities has changed, and Hyunwoo is soon faced with the ultimate question: "Is it okay to sleep with your friends?!"

synopsis:
Levin, a young man who was supposed to summon a sacred beast in a grand ritual, ended up calling forth a tiny lizard instead. Furious, the king exiled him from the kingdom. Guided by the lizard, Levin soon encounters a colossal dragon that carries an entire continent on its back!? As it turns out, this little lizard is actually a pure white Divine Dragon, and the vast continent on its back is her homeland. At the dragon's request, Levin takes on the task of developing the desolate Dragon Continent and restoring the lost capital of the Divine Dragon Clan. From building his dream home with mysterious magical tools to being healed by adorable sacred beasts, Levin embarks on a thrilling sky-high adventure, soaring freely between the heavens and the earth!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title: Seijo-sama wo Osagashi deshitara Imouto de Machigai Arimasen. Saa Douzo Otsure Kudasai, Imasugu.

My sister goes to church every day and gives energetically to charity, and everyone praises her, saying that she must be a saint. Stunned, Aria confronts him, and Julius offers a way out: if she can defeat him in any competition before the wedding in six months, he'll cancel the engagement. But with Julius' unmatched skills, winning won't be easy. Can Aria outsmart the talented prince and reclaim her life?

But as soon as I did just that, the world collapsed, and I looped back in time to Alexandra's childhood. Years later, I met the older, incredibly gorgeous first prince. Oh, and he seemed totally into me! Could this be true love?!

One day, a new night-shift part-timer appears at the small convenience store—his rugged looks fill everyone with unease, but soon he brings about a refreshing change to this small convenience store. He helps not only his coworkers but also customers, resolving their worries and troubles. Who is this mysterious night-shift part-timer?

Koharukawa is a BL manga artist working under the pen name Kanade Ooharu. At his class reunion, Koharukawa reunites with his first love, Akina, who tells Koharukawa that he would do anything for Kanade Ooharu's autograph. Without thinking, Koharukawa asks the other to bite his neck...?

synopsis:
Seo Hoyoon, the genius producer of a popular idol survival show, is infamous for his sharp tongue and coldheartedness. Cursed by a trainee for it, he wakes up as a member of a flop idol group called "The Dawn." To avoid being stuck in this parallel world forever, Hoyoon must make his group top-tier... but with the competitive industry and challenging tasks, it won't be easy. With his wits, know-how, and a little help from those around him, will this producer-turned-idol make it big?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: This Life is K-Pop Revenge
synopsis:
The perennial dreamer and aspiring composer, Nopara, has once again had his song credits stolen. In a moment of contemplating giving up on his dreams, he gets into a traffic accident and, upon opening his eyes, finds himself in a university lecture room from ten years ago. Before him, laughing, is Lee Joo-hyuk, the son of the CEO of Lee Woo Entertainment, the one who stole his dream. Alright! If I've been given a second chance, I'll bet everything and bring you down!!

To make lots of friends and enjoy a peaceful, ordinary college life. But who are these four mysterious guys constantly hanging around her? "Are you my enemy? My ally? Or... do you like me?" Thrown into a whirlwind of emotions at twenty, can Cho-eun finally achieve the campus life she's always dreamed of?

synopsis:
Everyone is tempted to beat up their boss, but it's hard to do. And what if that boss is a war hero, and a Grand Duke? Watching Curtis performing service inspections without even trying, Chloe just gritted her teeth. And then a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity came to her. In response to the king's order to marry a foreign nobleman, Curtis put forward Chloe, his adjutant, as his lover. Now that the gun was in Chloe's hands... "First, kneel. Your HIghness, the Grand Duke."

(Source: Naver, translated)

At least, according to the novel she has been reborn in. At 10 years old, she is given the chance to live with her father, the Master of the Magic Tower, Diamid. Nora, who works as a maid in a wealthy estate, is having a secret love affair with Makoto, the young master. But one day, Makoto suddenly dies in a car accident. While Nora is overcome with grief, Makoto's twin brother, Nozomu—who had been adopted out as a child—suddenly appears before her. "Shall I become Makoto for you?" The same face. A different person. With a sense of pride, I took the first step forward, but somehow things didn't go as expected and the situation became increasingly complicated...

Legend has it the flesh and bones of elves can be ground up into a true panacea, and this elven maiden is on the brink of death after being ruthlessly tortured by slavers. A golden coin he possesses transforms into the goddess of the sun, Solana, and Leon is thrust into an epic adventure to unravel the mysteries of the gods' seals. Discouraged as she is, Rio was holding onto a faint hope of love with Haruta, the only person at school who ever seems to notice her. When she realizes one day that he has a crush on Katsuki rather than her, she's so upset that she flees the classroom, wishing she could finally just disappear for real. But, while she's nursing her hurt feelings, someone comes and finds her; it's none other than "the reaper," aka Echizenya, the gloomy guy who's always hiding away in the corner creeping out their classmates. As someone who can see phantoms, the haunted rumors mean little, but the residents of Everdin Manor are no average ghouls. Despite their lively warmth, they live under a curse that turned them into invisible beings. Theresia hopes that by absolving the woes of the manor's true evil specters, she can restore the duchy and return home. Can she put these spirits to rest and finally live in peace?

Then, one day, he meets MAO—a beautiful streamer girl—on a video site and falls in love at first sight. He is actually an idol otaku, and when he watches her previous videos, he discovers that she is a cross-dressing guy. Although he is supposed to be straight, Shun is perplexed by his crush on MAO, even though he knows he is the same sex as him. He then discovers that MAO has similar characteristics to Nakadai, the regular customer...!

Seonu, a teenage boy with a prosthetic leg, carries the lifeless body of Iseo through the snow-covered wasteland, determined to bring her home one final time. With no historical record mentioning his skill, people assume it can only do mundane things like open doors and windows. Armed with this cheat-like power, Hiraku sets out to carve his own path in this action-packed fantasy!

With this power, Allen comes up with the idea of traveling between Japan and the other world and making money by selling various items to people from the other world, those who have been transferred, and those who have been reincarnated, who are hungry for entertainment! Before long, he gets to know the daughter of a large company and the princess of a kingdom in the other world, and enjoys the other world to the fullest...!!

synopsis:
One day, a man awoke to find himself in the world of "Lovely Sorcerer," a game he loved so much that he had even created a strategy site for it! And yet, he had reincarnated as some nameless noble mob character!? On top of that, he was even stronger than the main character!? Gaining a status that could make him the strongest set his gamer blood ablaze!

title_english: Nagisa Natsunagi Still Wants to Be a High School Girl: The Detective Is Already Dead, Ordinary Cases
title_japanese: 夏凪渚はまだ、女子高生でいたい。 探偵はもう、死んでいる。Ordinary Case
synopsis:
All I wanted was to be a regular high schooler, and that wish is why I'm here right now. My name is Nagisa Natsunagi, and I'm just a high school girl, nothing more-not yet anyway. If there's one thing that's different about me, it's that, up until recently, I was too sick to come to school. Miraculously, I received a new heart, and the surgery was successful. Now I'm finally living the life I always wanted! But I can't help wondering about my donor...I hear there's a boy in town who can solve any case. Maybe he can help me?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Trauma Center: Dr. Baek
synopsis:
Baek Kang-hyuk, a man with heightened senses. After losing his father, he relentlessly pursues his goal of becoming the greatest trauma surgeon in history. But now, with a touch of madness... With his model-like appearance at 185cm, he sweeps through the hospital, confronting patients with his entire being to become a trauma surgeon.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Ryan Begins
synopsis:
Ever since he was a cub, Ryan has dreamed of adventuring across the world. But now that his parents—the King and Queen of Doong Doong Island—are missing, it falls on Ryan to rule the island as their heir...which means he can never leave. Rule or escape, which will Ryan choose?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Pure Love of a Man
synopsis:
"Nice to meet you. Kang Ha, who will be the head of the Overseas Sales Department starting today. It's Jin." After making a mistake with my first love 10 years ago, I thought I would never see you again. "Even if you die, you won't be able to date me, and I don't have the confidence to treat you as a subordinate." "Then there is only one answer." What is it? "We have no choice but to be partners." Looking at Ha-jin's softly curled eyes, Ji-hye felt it. After 10 years, the great ordeal of Kang Ha-jin has intervened in her life again.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title_japanese: スパイ教室3部 忘我

The only path to survival is deceit. The "War of Light" is over, giving rise to the modern-day information war waged by spies, or the "War of Shadows." Evil is always lurking just around the corner.

title_english: The World's Strongest Witch: I'm Starting My Free Life in a World Where Only I Can See the Online Strategy Guide

synopsis:
When Lorna manifests a completely useless ability, she's labeled an embarrassment to her family and kicked out of the house. With no money or food, she's about to hit rock bottom. But then, she figures out how to use her supposedly worthless SSS-Rank skill, "Internet." This cheat-level talent gives her the know-how to gather an unlimited amount of valuable items and easily acquire rare equipment. Armed with godlike knowledge, Lorna's free to do anything she wants! If only she could figure out what "lmfao" means...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Haguremono
synopsis:
After serving nine years for a crime he didn't commit, Hachiya Ken is free—but his past is far from behind him. Released from prison, he's confronted by Hana, the fiery daughter of a ghost from his past. Together, they're forced to navigate a deadly web of betrayal, yakuza power, and political corruption.

As they uncover a conspiracy that runs deeper than either could have imagined, Ken must confront his own demons—and decide how far he's willing to go for redemption.

From the dynamic creative duo of Yuu Nakahara and Ryuu Kamio, who delivered the brilliant baseball manga Last Inning, Stray is a relentless crime thriller where nothing is what it seems. Can Ken survive long enough to expose the truth, or will his next swing be his last, as he strikes out in this game of power.

(Source: Titan Comics)

Included one-shot: Outlaw (pilot)

title: Momfluencer
synopsis:
How far would you go for fame and wealth? Fledgling mommy influencer Juyeon Park is desperate to join the ranks of popular internet celebrities. Thanks to a video of her daughter going viral and her "friend" from high school, popular influencer Yehui Kim, she finally gets the chance to join the ultra-exclusive Deep Pink Society, a group made up of former idols, wealthy CEOs, and social media stars. Elated at the chance to become one of the glittering elite, she's determined to do whatever it takes to make this work—no matter the cost.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Martial God Who Levels Up
synopsis:
The greatest martial artist on the continent and the supreme Martial Emperor who unified the martial world—Suhyeok. He had achieved everything, yet a lingering emptiness in his heart remained unfulfilled by his yearning for family... In the end, he crossed dimensions using the power of sorcery, but what lay before his eyes was...

"...I was in a coma for five years in a hospital!? And what's with this system window floating in front of me!? Black Sage, you big-mouthed bastard! You said you'd send me back to my world! Why the hell is everything so messed up!?"

During the five years he lay unconscious, his family had been struggling to pay his hospital bills... "For my family's sake, I need to make money—fast and a lot of it." The strongest Martial God of the Hwan Continent, Suhyeok! Now Awakened, he begins his journey to level up.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: World's Best Gonryun Tavern
synopsis:
"Who are you...?"
"I am Unryong."

After a hundred years of isolated training, Unryong finally steps back into the world. But the Kunlun Sect he once knew has changed beyond recognition, worn down by the passage of time. Starving and aimlessly wandering, Fate brought him an unexpected encounter.

"When times are tough, we should help each other out, right?"

Deeply moved by the warmth of a stranger's kindness after a century of isolation, Unryong finds himself staying at the Kunlun Inn. With martial arts skills unmatched across the land and culinary mastery that could bring even the fiercest warrior to tears, Unryong, now the chef of Kunlun Inn, begins a new chapter in his life—one filled with flavor, warmth, and perhaps... a little peace.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Her Tiny Highness, the Mastermind
synopsis:
The martial arts world's most dangerous mastermind finds herself reborn in the weakest possible form: a tiny toddler and holy monarch's successor, destined to die young. But Danye Jin didn't survive centuries of martial arts intrigue just to accept defeat in diapers. Armed with ancient techniques and disarming baby charm, this mysteriously capable little girl is turning imminent death into the realm's greatest adventure. Who knew saving yourself could be so adorably dangerous?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Uwasa no Incubus Channel
title_japanese: うわさのインキュバスch
synopsis:
Behind the scenes of human society, there exists a completely meritocratic incubus society. In this world, incubuses maintain their livelihoods by absorbing and converting energy from humans' boundless greed through intercourse with them! Nico is a no-good incubus who barely managed to join the elite dispatch team alongside his childhood friend, Innis, who is smart, good-looking, accomplished, and an all-around perfect guy. Despite Nico's resolve to catch up to his childhood friend, his performance proves to be less than satisfactory, and he is instructed to change his target from women to men...! Meanwhile, Innis saves Nico from his fate by proposing a video streaming system that will allow them to absorb human energy indirectly... Is this for real? Or, is Innis just doing this for the video? The incubus duo's channel is about to take the world by storm!!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Tensei Nanmin Shoujo wa Shiminken wo 0 kara Mezashite Hatarakimasu! @comic
title_japanese: 転生難民少女は市民権を０から目指して働きます!@COMIC
synopsis:
Lill, who was reincarnated into a refugee settlement, is once again starving today. To make matters worse, she's being shunned because of her lazy parents and is on the verge of being exiled!? Determined to secure her place, she works hard every day to earn the trust of the residents, even if just a little. Her earnest efforts as a small girl gradually start to gain recognition from those around her. Her dream? To one day eat a warm, hearty meal until she's full! Then, she learns that even a refugee can live in town if they become a B-rank adventurer—so she sets her sights on escaping her refugee status! Will this hardworking reincarnated girl win your heart too? A laid-back isekai adventure fantasy!

(Source: TO Books, translated)

title: Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e: 3-nensei-hen
title_japanese: ようこそ実力至上主義の教室へ 3年生編
synopsis:
From their humble beginnings as Class 1-D, Horikita and her classmates are ready to begin their third year as Class 3-A! But there's no time for celebrating–the battle is far from over. With only one year left until graduation, even the smallest failure can pull them off track. Not only will they have to fight harder than ever, they'll have to do it without their most influential student: Ayanokouji Kiyotaka.

Amid the chaos of losing Ayanokouji to Class C, Horikita's class finds themselves faced with one cruel truth: if they can't defeat Ayanokouji, they don't stand a chance to graduate from Class A. Do they have what it takes to remain on top, or are they doomed to fail?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e: 3-nensei-hen

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Okaeri Suiheisen
synopsis:
Ryouma runs a public bathhouse with his grandfather in a seaside town. One day, during his usual routine of running the bathhouse after school, a boy named Reo appears, claiming to be his father's illegitimate son. A bittersweet yet heart-warming drama unfolds between half brothers in a public bathhouse!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: SutoSuto: Stalker ga Stalker sareteru Hanashi
title_japanese: ストスト~ストーカーがストーカーされてる話~
synopsis:
There is an intense gaze from afar.

Mitsunaga's friend, Tate, fed up with his friend's "stalker," decides to confront him directly. Yet, instead of a hostile showdown, it turns out all three of them have their own motives...? Those tangled emotions are simply irresistible!

(Source: MU)

title: The Corporate Underdog Who Does Everything Right
synopsis:
Chae Gyeong-jun, who gave up both college and his dreams due to the IMF crisis, once again faces despair due to of his grandmother's sudden hospitalization fees. But then, a "Mysterious Benefactor" steps in to cover the hospital costs for his family... "Who would provide support that doesn't help them at all, and why?" In search of an answer, Gyeong-jun heads to Taeseong.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: The Good Student
synopsis:
After losing his memories in an accident, Eun Jo transfers to a new school, convinced he's a model student—quiet, kind, and hardworking. But when he sees his classmate Bom being bullied, something in him snaps. His instincts take over—and so do his fists. As Eun rises against the school's cruel hierarchy, he starts to wonder: Who was he before? And why does Bom feel so familiar? Packed with school drama, mystery, and unexpected fists, this is the story of a "good student" who may not be so good after all.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Kyuutei Madoushi, Tsuihou sareru: Munou dato Oidasareta Saikou no Madoushi wa, Buka wo Hikitsurete Boukensha Clan wo Hajimeru You desu
title_japanese: 宮廷魔導師、追放される ～無能だと追い出された最巧の魔導師は、部下を引き連れて冒険者クランを始めるようです～
synopsis:
Arnaud, the Court Magician of the Desant Kingdom, known as one of the "Seven Masters," was busy defending his territory, which was overrun with powerful monsters. However, his modest achievements were deemed insufficient to fulfill his duties as one of the Seven Masters, and he was exiled from the kingdom. Forced to leave with his loyal subordinates, Arnaud travels to the neighboring country of Linburu, where he becomes a legendary figure whose name is known by all for his true power!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Kiss kara Hajimaru Isekai Harem: Ipputasai no Isekai ni Tensei shita node Kami ga Kimeta Unmei no Hito wo Sagashimasu
title_english: A Different World Harem That Begins with a Kiss
title_japanese: キスからはじまる異世界ハーレム ～一夫多妻の世界に転生したので神が決めた運命の人を探します～

title: Aku no Reijou to Juuni no Hitomi: Saikyou Juusha-tachi to Densetsu no Akujo, Jinsei Nidome no Kareinaru Musouroku
title_english: The Wicked Princess and Her Twelve Eyes: The Legendary Villainess and Her Elite Assassins
title_japanese: 悪の令嬢と十二の瞳 ～最強従者たちと伝説の悪女、人生二度目の華麗なる無双録～
synopsis:
Lady Selina was betrayed by the crown prince, framed for a crime she didn't commit, and executed by poison. That should have been the end of her story—until time rewound, handing her a second chance.

This time, she's not holding back. After all, that "murder" she was accused of was just a little misunderstanding! Dropping a flowerpot on the saintess's head isn't exactly lethal. Reflecting on her downfall, Selina realizes she didn't fail because of her schemes. She failed because she didn't have loyal minions to execute them properly.

Determined to rewrite her fate, she takes in a group of orphans with nothing to lose and subjects them to grueling, cutthroat training. What emerges isn't just a team of assassins—they're the deadliest, most fanatically devoted elite the kingdom has ever seen. And they answer only to her.

Armed with her overpowered entourage and sharp wit, Selina is ready to crush anyone who stands in her way. Dive into a chaotic adventure where a morally flexible villa

title: The Lone Guide
synopsis:
Jian, an S-rank guide in Korea who isn't compatible with any espers, people gifted with superpowers, finds herself on a strange continent one day. There, she meets Duke Wisrode, an esper she can finally guide. However, her excitement is short-lived when she discovers that she is the only guide in this land, which is full of espers, and the duke wishes to keep her to himself. Will Jian be able to find her way back to her own dimension safely? Or will she be stuck here as the lone guide forever?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Hiroi Neko no Mocha
title_english: Mocha the Cat and His Forever Family
synopsis:
Mocha is a male calico cat—an extremely rare combination said to bring good luck. Abandoned on the streets as a kitten, now he's spoiled by his adoptive humans, who love his typical cat moods and mischief. Whether he's walking on the book they're trying to read, climbing the curtains, or just doing a biiig stretch, he'll put a smile on your face just like he does for his family!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Guardian of the Dragon
synopsis:
An apprentice priest under the protection of the princess. An orphan abandoned in a mysterious forest. And... She, Freya, who sees others' emotions as colors. Positive emotions are gold. Negative emotions are black. Her mysterious ability was her own secret. During her pilgrimage to become a priest, Freya woke up in a strange man's bed.

"You... What are you?" the man, Aran, asked threateningly, his red eyes shining.

He looked exactly like the hero in the mural Freya had seen since she was a child, and even had the same name. But Aran did not show any color of emotions. At first, she thought it was a dream. She thought she was having strange dreams multiple times. But it seems... It's not a dream.

Who is this man? Where do I go every night? Why is it me?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Plenus
synopsis:
"I've kept your memory alive because it's the only way this world can continue. You're the only one who can save it, Emo."

The war is won, but the wheat farming is ruined! The empire of Lipolka is plagued by famine, a curse cast by a demon who lost a battle to a warrior just before he died. I, Eudemonia Plenus, was born to this land with the knowledge of my previous life, with the historical mission of improving the food culture of the continent! People are starving to death for lack of food, yet they eat no potatoes, no sweet potatoes, no tomatoes... The little lord's continental version of the "three meals a day" project!

What can I do when my mind is an adult from a previous life, but my body is a baby? Ouch, big trouble!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Negai Ai: Hajimete Doushi no Hajirai Yuugi
title_english: Virgin Ventures: The Hilarious Hijinks of Erotic Amateurs
title_japanese: ねがいあい～ハジメテ同士のはじらい遊戯～
synopsis:
Miki is a rookie erotic novelist who's never so much as held a woman's hand. Riko is a die-hard lingerie enthusiast with zero experience with men. Together, these two clueless virgins embark on a literary collaboration—attempting to bring the heat despite the cringe of their inexperience. Miki fully embraces Riko's obsession with underwear, but when he makes a very hands-on request in the name of research, Riko has to wonder...can you really write what you don't know?!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Like Father, Like Daughter
synopsis:
Once known as the White Night Witch, Alisia is reborn without her powers as a young princess neglected by her father, the emperor. When she regains her magic after hearing the news of his death in battle, she plans to rule the chaotic empire herself... That is, until the emperor returns alive. Now, Alisia must mend fences with her father while also handling schemes and secrets lurking around them. Will these two, so different yet so similar, make amends and work together? Or is it all too late?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Maria: The Deposed Empress
synopsis:
"Wait, from now on, I will inflict divine punishment."

Maria, who had lived her best as the empress of the empire, as the emperor's wife. However, all that returned to her was the cruel betrayal of her husband and friend, and in the end, she only watched the deaths of her beloved ones. Maria, who was so thoroughly used by others, eventually gains the title of deposed empress and is dragged to another country. However, the red-haired man named Gunther whom she met there brought back truths different from the memories of the past that Maria knew, and Maria, at the edge of despair, wants to live once again. And her heart races at the thought of living and taking revenge.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Tonari no Joushi wa Zetsurin Ikebo: Mimi kara Itchau Amanure Sex
title_english: His Sensual Whisper: The Voice That Sets Me On Fire
title_japanese: 隣の上司は絶倫イケボ 耳からイッちゃう甘濡れセックス
synopsis:
After a missed connection years ago, office worker Mizuho developed an irresistible craving for deep, sultry voices. With such a unique fetish, she's been on the hunt for that perfect tone to satisfy her desires. When she meets Hibino, a handsome salesman with a voice that's smooth as velvet, at a company drinking party, Mizuho can't help but melt. Captivated by his seductive timbre, she invites him back to her place, where just a single suggestive whisper sends her senses into overdrive. Is Hibino the passionate partner she's been waiting for, or will her hopes for a true connection fall on deaf ears?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: The Duke's Obsession with His Wife
title_english: The Duke's Obsession with His Wife
synopsis:
Anriette may look like an average noble, but she's actually a human who's been transported into the world of her favorite novel, cursed by its author for writing fanfics critical of the original ending. And as Anriette, her fate is to be slain by the very male lead she wrote her fanfics about! Can she use her inside knowledge to craft the ending she always dreamed of for her favorite lead?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Taming My Master Mage
synopsis:
Kinemia Lyon's got two rules for surviving a novel: recruit talented geniuses to save her territory and don't get involved with Ayan Krotz, a dangerous mage. But when Ayan gets captured for trespassing on her land over and over again, she decides to hire him as her bodyguard instead. Unfortunately, letting Ayan into her life means dealing with his erratic magic and even more concerning personality! Can Kinemia come to tame this master mage? Or will she regret not kicking him out for good?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: You Think It's Easy Rewriting a Story?
title_english: You Think It's Easy Rewriting a Story?
synopsis:
Reincarnation stories are all the rage these days, but I never thought I'd be the one getting reborn! But still, life as a rich man's beautiful daughter is pretty sweet... except for one thing. No matter what I do, where I run, or who I romance, this novel is dead-set on getting me hitched to the handsome duke destined to kill me! There must be some way to change my fate, right? I won't go out like this!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Akuyakuzuki no Ore, Oshi Chara ni Tensei: Game Joban ni Shujinkou ni Korosareru Oshi ni Tensei shita node, Ore dake Shitteru Game Chishiki de Hametsu Flag wo Tsubu shitetara Akuyaku-tachi no Teiou ni Natteta Ken
title_english: I Like Villains, So I Reincarnated as One
title_japanese: 悪役好きの俺、推しキャラに転生 ～ゲーム序盤に主人公に殺される推しに転生したので、俺だけ知ってるゲーム知識で破滅フラグを潰してたら悪役達の帝王になってた件～
synopsis:

Armed with an undeniable charm, handsome looks, and unshakable confidence, Woo-bin isn't here to reform these villains... He's here to rule Murim in his own way! title: Emperor of Solo Play
synopsis:
Betrayed by his guild and defeated by a top player, Hyrkan loses everything. Before he can get revenge, a fatal accident ends his life—only for him to wake up years in the past, back at the start of Warlord. Now, with his memories intact, he's determined to rise to the top alone. But in a game where power means everything, can he truly survive without any allies? The Emperor of Solo Play is back, and this time, he's playing by his own rules.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Regressed Empress's Abduction Marriage
synopsis:
Eliano, the daughter of a powerful duke, marries the seventh prince of Jakador, and they fall in love. But their happiness is short-lived when the prince ascends to the throne. After suffering a miscarriage, she is cruelly poisoned by her husband and dies. Eliano miraculously wakes up to find herself 21 years old and is now determined to avoid the tragic future she once lived. Will she be able to find happiness in this new life?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: My Dead Lover Returned as a Tyrant
title_english: My Dead Lover Returned as a Tyrant
synopsis:
As the black sheep of the royal family, Lise had been exiled to the countryside at a young age. While she found her own humble happiness with her lover, Destad, her quiet life came to an ugly end when she witnessed his death. Miserable years later, her kingdom is conquered by an infamous emperor and Lise is taken as his concubine. She resigns herself to a wretched fate, only to discover that the tyrannical emperor is none other than her long-lost lover. Is this miracle the start of a better life? Or is it the beginning of yet more despair?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Anata wa Watashi no Unmei no Hito
title_japanese: あなたは私の運命のひと
synopsis:
Megu has recently discovered she is an omega, and when her friends tell her there is an alpha in their all-girls school, she wonders if her pheromones can reveal who it might be. When Megu runs into the vice president, Akina Nagamine, in front of the student council room, her inner omega awakens a desire she has never known, causing her to beg uncontrollably for the other girl's embrace...

(Source: Anime Planet)

title: I'm the Final Boss Villainess He Must Kill
title_english: I'm the Final Boss Villainess He Must Kill
title_japanese: 그가 죽여야 할 최종 악녀가 저랍니다
synopsis:
Hongyeon Kim has spent her afterlife generally being bored. So when a new program is introduced to entertain the dead, Hongyeon jumps at the chance to be transported into her favorite novel. However, when she finds herself in the body of the villainess, the demon princess Bella, she attempts a spell to speed up time to the end of the novel. Instead, she finds herself ten years in the past. Now, she must wait fifteen years to escape all while living with demons and raising the main character!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: I'm a Beast, Not a Bunny!
title_english: I'm a Beast, Not a Bunny!
synopsis:
Born to a wolf-shifter and a lion-shifter, Chloe knows she'll be a predator like no other. So she's got no idea what to do when she one day shifts into... a bunny! Even worse, Chloe then realizes she's also in a novel, one where her family's to be killed due to a series of misunderstandings. Determined to save her parents, Chloe sets out to unravel the lies and bring peace to her family. But can Chloe uncover the truth while keeping her transformation unknown? Or will this bunny be bested by fate?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Deposed Empress' Scandal
synopsis:
Lucentia is a woman who was forced to marry the emperor but was accused of treason and beheaded. She managed to escape death thanks to a precognitive dream and fled to the enemy empire, where she became Rose Von Isaac, a rich and powerful merchant. But Lucentia could not escape her fate, as she was the only one who could save the Duke of Aytan, a legendary swordsman who had a secret that could change everything. She proposed that he be her guardian, but he asked her to be his lover.

Lucentia decided that she would no longer be manipulated by fate and that she would live her life as she wanted.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Mahoutsukai no Yoru: Comic à la Carte - Witchcraft-hen

authors: Futaba, Masumi|Aona, Masao|Hazumi, Nariyuki|Ooishi, Kou|Azuma, Shouko|Mata

title: Apricot no Shinzou
synopsis:
Chitose Hibi is a novelist in college who has continuously submitted screenplays to scriptwriting contests in pursuit of a certain dream. After yielding no results, he finishes writing his script, "Apricot Heart," deciding it will be his last. However, before he can submit it, Chitose is shocked to learn that the actor Kyouhei Serizawa is going on hiatus, even though his dream has been to have him act in one of his scripts...

After giving up on submitting his work, Chitose ends up falling asleep, but suddenly, Kyouhei appears right before his eyes?! A sweet and sour youth love story, filled with dreams and romance.

(Source: Media Soft, translated)

title: SSS-Rank Cafe by the Dungeon
synopsis:
Rieul toils away at her office job until a sudden dungeon break ends her life. But instead of dying, she wakes up three years in the past with a second chance at life. Determined to change her fate, she reopens her late grandmother's cafe. But the moment she gets to work, she awakens as a Cafe Owner-class hunter... with a talking cat agent named Mieum! Between brewing coffee and clearing system quests, Rieul's new life is anything but peaceful. Has her quiet dream already gone up in smoke?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Not Your Monster-in-Law
synopsis:
Kim Hana is reincarnated as Wilhelmina, a fallen noblewoman whose fate takes a turn when she's married off to the wealthy House Layton. But there's a catch—her husband is already dead, leaving her to become the Dowager Duchess. Younger than her new stepson and his wife, she must navigate the treacherous waters of high society and a daughter-in-law determined to make her life miserable. Will she find a way to remedy this family drama or be unfairly painted as the monster-in-law she's not?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Duchess Mecklen's Graceful Rebellion
synopsis:
Eleanor Mecklen was never more than a political pawn who married into the prestigious House Mecklen of the Barden Empire. Under the scrutiny of her mother-in-law, Duchess Carolyn, Eleanor endured endless humiliation. But when Carolyn meets an untimely death, Eleanor is accused of murder and sent to the executioner's block. But death does not claim her. Instead, she reawakens at House Mecklen. Armed with the knowledge of what's to come, Eleanor has a second chance to seize her fate.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: It's Annoying Because My Childhood Friend Is an Archmage
synopsis:
My childhood friend is an archmage, one that cannot control his powerful mana and occasionally goes on a wild rampage. "Skyla, would you like to have the empire for your birthday? I'll make you the emperor!" To be more precise, he is an archmage with no common sense and morals. Once again, I'm still struggling to keep him from destroying the empire today.

...Life is very hard.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Majo to Kyurasu
synopsis:
Long ago, the talented witch Shien helped her apprentice Tama escape from the witch hunts and then disappeared. Hundreds of years later, the two finally reunite in modern-day Japan! However, there is no trace of Shien's former self. She is now a "downer witch" smoking cigarettes by the window...! A decadent comedy about the everyday lives of the diligent Tama and the lethargic Shien!

(Source: Hero's, translated)

title: I Became the Black Swan Mother of the White Swan Princess
synopsis:
The transmigration that happened to others happened to me, too. I'm pretty sure I'm now a supporting character... but exactly which novel is this? When I opened my eyes, I was a widow with stepdaughters my own age, and not only that—I turned into a black swan every night due to a dark curse! Holding back my tears, I decided to take charge of my fate... wait, why should I? Why so serious?

A duchess during the day, a queen of the lake during the night—I have the best luck to be able to leisurely float around! Life should be lived unplanned! When I had just about decided to live my life like this, a white baby swan, one that was not in my no-plan life plan, came to me. "Mommy, are you really my mommy?"

What, you were a person? And even the youngest sibling of the tyrant emperor? "I'm not your mother! Can't you tell by the different colors of our feathers?" I'm a black swan, you're a white swan! But why is she so crazy cute. Can our mother-daughter love endure the obsession and persecuti

title: How to Reject the Perfect Marriage
title_english: How to Reject the Perfect Marriage
synopsis:
Evangeline O'Hara has it all—wealth, privilege, and the most coveted engagement in the empire. But when tragedy strikes her family, the future duchess can no longer ignore certain truths. She is alone now, and this marriage won't change that for the better.

Duke Decarno von These has no doubts, as no other woman could be more perfect for the role. Things may be complicated now, but the conclusion is inevitable. Once they wed, the rest of these problems will vanish.

Why should he think otherwise?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Manga de Wakaru Bunshi Seibutsugaku
title_english: The Manga Guide to Molecular Biology
title_japanese: マンガでわかる分子生物学
synopsis:
Rin and Ami have been skipping molecular biology class all semester, and Professor Moro has had enough—he's sentencing them to summer school on his private island. But they're in store for a special lesson. Using Dr. Moro's virtual reality machine to travel inside the human body, they'll get a close-up look at the fascinating world of molecular biology.

(Source: No Starch Press)

title: Even if the Reincarnated Crown Prince Is Arrogant
synopsis:
Hundreds of years ago, the crown prince who died in a conspiracy was reincarnated as Wang Dodo, a high school student. Dodo, who has regained his memory through past events, tries to revive the memory of Ryu Sehwan, a university student who is the reincarnation of the Heir Princess and continue his love with Princess Choi. At this moment, the secret of Dodo's death as the Crown Prince is slowly revealed, and those who participated in the death begin to appear one by one...

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Imperial Marriage
synopsis:
Eunri Dam was only a child when she found Gyeol's bloody body in the river by her home in Je. Back then, she didn't know his real name was Segyeol Yiheon or that he was the crown prince of Sayuta...Je's enemy nation. Gyeol knew that Eunri was to be engaged to the crown prince of Je, but even that couldn't stop him from falling for her. Before returning to his homeland, Gyeol promised Eunri that he would marry her one day. After that...everything went up in flames.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Low-Level Civil Servant Wants to Climb the Social Ladder
title_english: Low-Level Civil Servant Wants to Climb the Social Ladder
synopsis:
Namia, the magic-scroll-writing genius, gets taken advantage of by everyone—from her lazy boss to her greedy family. But when she uses her knowledge of this novel to save the life of Prince Kiaros, it's time for her life to turn around. Those who used her will finally get what's coming to them, while Namia's skills and good deeds are finally recognized and rewarded. But little does she know that her new assistant is really the prince in disguise, and someone is still trying to kill him!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Ghost Dating Simulation
synopsis:
Choi Do-yeon, a gaming streamer struggling to make ends meet in a semi-basement rental, receives a game link from "Sakje-hyung," a senior from his hometown and a fellow content creator who has always supported him. Without giving it much thought, he downloads "Heart-pounding Ghostly Poem," only to encounter eerie figures that should never have appeared.

Before he can even process what's happening, he finds himself trapped in a high-stakes dating simulation—with vengeful spirits.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Aori-kei Game Haishinsha (Hatachi), Haishin no Kiriwasure ni Yori Ii Hito Bare suru.
title_japanese: 煽り系ゲーム配信者（20歳）、配信の切り忘れによりいい人バレする。
synopsis:
"What happened today is a secret between us, okay?"

Haruto Nakayama is a gaming commentator known for his toxicity as the streamer "Oni-chan," After finishing his usual streaming session, Haruto accidentally forgot to end the stream. As a result, his secret life as a streamer working to support his younger sister's education and living expenses is exposed. Furthermore, it's also revealed that he meticulously prepares scripts to provoke others, all while being, in reality, a genuinely nice person!

To make matters more complicated, during a livestream by the popular VTuber and professional gamer, Ayaya (aka Aya Shirayuki), Haruto unintentionally reveals his true personality once again. Unexpectedly, this led to them growing closer to each other as they continued to play games and go on outings together.

Thus begins a one-on-one romantic comedy between the business-minded toxic streamer and the popular VTuber heroine!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Part-Time Grim Reaper
synopsis:
Lee Do-jin needs a lot of money to cover his younger sister's medical bills. He calls the number on a strange, ominous business card he finds by chance, and  encounters a silver-haired woman known as Chasa. She offers him a temp job to stop "Mokdugi," predators that feast on souls tainted by sin.
