[Saving the world at the gym!]

The year is 20XX. With the invasion of monsters straight out of a B-movie, humanity opens its eyes to a new power! Among the heroes who ooze strength and power without having to work out is a "tiger" who guards the Stronger Gym... No, it's not a tiger, it's a man wearing a tiger-patterned t-shirt and pants! Today, he greets his gym babies with joy like any other day.

"What? A gym baby?! Don't be scared. Come on in!"

Come watch the main character and his Stronger Gym friends cultivate a healthy mind and a healthy body!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Kochira, Shuumatsu Teitai Iinkai
title_english: This Is the End Stagnation Committee.
title_japanese: こちら、終末停滞委員会。

title: Konyaku Haki saretari sarenakattari desu ga, Fukou Reijou ni Narimashita. Zamaa shinakutemo Shiawase desu: Anthology Comic
title_japanese: 婚約破棄されたりされなかったりですが、不幸令嬢になりました。～ざまぁしなくても幸せです～ アンソロジーコミック
synopsis: An anthology of fantasy romance stories written by various authors and with art by Nagi Ookawa.

title: Oborete, Ai Doku
synopsis: An office worker and a high school girl both play hooky.

title: Sayounara, Watashitachi ni Yasashikunakatta, Subete no Hitobito
title_japanese: さようなら、私たちに優しくなかった、すべての人々
synopsis:
In seeking revenge against the seven individuals who killed her sister, the girl sacrificed her life.

In the rural town of Agata, surrounded by mountains on all sides, Shiori Nakagawa, a student at the local high school, had become a truant due to bullying. One day, Mei Satou arrived at Shiori's house as a roommate. Mei, who kept her heart closed to everyone, confided in Shiori about her purpose in coming to this town.

"I want to slaughter all seven people who drove my sister to death."

Three years ago, Mei's sister, Akari, had taken her own life after experiencing horrendous bullying in this town. Mei had returned here for the sake of revenge. Mei planned to carry out the bloodstained ritual "Okakashitsutsumi," passed down at the Agata Shrine, and house the giant snake god "Okakashisama" within herself to execute the plan of killing the seven individuals.

On the night of the summer solstice, Mei successfully performed the ritual. From that point onward, one by one, Mei, with the p

title: Inside the Elevator
synopsis:
The second son of fashion group UNO FNC's chairman, Kang Taeheon, was a perfect man—known by everyone in the company and disliked by none. At least, that was the case until he touched my butt.

"You don't need to act so kind and well-mannered in front of me, Team Leader. I know exactly what kind of person you are!"
"And what kind of person am I?"

When I shouted that he was the type of person who went around touching other people's butts, he had the audacity to ask me what kind of person I thought he was. What am I supposed to do with a man like this? To make matters worse, he even confessed that he liked me! There's no way a creep like him could be sincere, but no matter how much I try to resist, his words and actions directed at me somehow start to feel like they really belong to someone who genuinely likes me.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Don't Confess to That Boy
synopsis:
Lee Da-jung is a timid high school ghost. She's possessed Chae Rim, who has everything: beauty, money, and popularity! She tries her best to imitate Chae Rim... but her identity is discovered by one person: Baek Isaac, Chae Rim's best friend.

"I'll help you pretend to be Chae Rim."

Can she trust this friendly but suspicious boy? What is the secret of her death? A breathtaking occult comic!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Hikage Majo wa Kizukanai: Mahou Gakuen ni Nyuugaku shita Tensai Imouto ga, Ane wa Motto Sugoi to Iifurashiteita Nante
title_japanese: 日陰魔女は気づかない～魔法学園に入学した天才妹が、姉はもっとすごいと言いふらしていたなんて～

title: Natsu Kuyuru Sukimono no Yado
title_japanese: 夏くゆる好色男〈すきもの〉の宿
synopsis:
Miharu, an otaku boy who works at a shabby inn in a hot spring resort, is in a relationship with Fujio, the inn's heir and a former porn actor. He racks his brain trying to think of a way to revive the hot spring resort, but he doesn't really know what Fujio is thinking. One weekend, Miharu attends a comic event, so Fujio invites him to his second home in Tokyo for the first time...!? A sexual love diary between a former porn actor and an otaku boy.

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

title: My Teacher Has Chosen My Husband Candidates
title_english: My Teacher Has Chosen My Husband Candidates
synopsis:
Lena has been counting the days until she comes of age. This is all to finally confess her feelings to Nix, her teacher, so that he can become her husband instead of her guardian. But on her long-awaited birthday, Nix suddenly vanishes without a trace, and five years pass in the blink of an eye. Lena dutifully tends to Nix's store while waiting for his return. Then one day, out of the blue, she receives an absurd letter from Nix that says he'll be sending prospective husbands her way that he has carefully sought out and selected during his absence. All Lena wants is for Nix to come home, but surely it couldn't hurt to play around with these candidates in the meantime, right?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Akumade Sukisugiru dake
title_japanese: あくまで好きすぎるだけ
synopsis:
Kurumi, the protagonist, has fallen for Kamiyama-kun, who's obsessed with the occult and a little weird. She's happy in the moment when he immediately agrees to become a couple, but what awaits her is a series of rather difficult dates....?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Himegimi wa Wakaki Shougun ni Oboreru
title_english: She Is Addicted to Him, and Vice Versa.
title_japanese: 姫君は若き将軍に溺れる
synopsis:
In the Kingdom of Arstoria, Princess Yuria is the king's only daughter, and her existence is of great importance to the country. Women have no right to inherit the throne or lead the royal family—instead, her husband becomes king, and their children will be the future heirs.

Amid swirling conspiracies and intrigue, her childhood friend, General Regius, who holds the title of army commander, is always by her side, protecting her.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Shinjuu Kishi-sama no Senzoku Maid: Munou to Yobareta Reijou wa, Hontou wa Kishou na Seizokusei no Tsukaite datta you desu
title_japanese: 神獣騎士様の専属メイド～無能と呼ばれた令嬢は、本当は希少な聖属性の使い手だったようです～
synopsis:
Tilia was born into a noble family famous for their magic, but she was the only one among them without any magical power. Because of this, she was considered useless and treated as a servant in her own home.

One day, gentle mythical creatures begin to approach her in mysterious ways, drawing the attention of a duke who suspects she might have a hidden gift. Over time, the two grow closer... This is the story of a mistreated girl who finally learns her own worth.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Hunting Moms
synopsis:
Teachers shouldn't touch their students. But what about their moms? Well for one teacher, he learns a way to get any woman he wants. Will he use this power for good or evil?

(Source: Topco)

title: Holding You Close
synopsis:
After three failed marriages, Archduke Theo de Phoenix has long accepted that love simply isn't in the cards for him. After all, who could love a war-hardened monster like him? So when his fourth bride arrives, he greets her covered in blood, gives her a shabby attic for a room, and keeps his distance. Surely, this one will run too. But Yuelina is not like the others. To Theo's disbelief, she welcomes his presence and fills his cold world with warmth and light. As the walls around his heart begin to thaw, will Theo finally allow himself to love?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Karakurikara
synopsis: In a world fractured by hatred between humans and Mononoke, Karakuri, a human with a mysterious past, defies societal norms by siding with these misunderstood creatures.

title: Raden no Roukaku
synopsis: Chika, a boy who has trouble discussing his interests and preferences with others, gradually becomes attracted to Hanako, his friend's older sister...

title: Moralless Scandal
synopsis:
Lorena chose death to take revenge on the husband who ruined her life. Thrown back in time, she is determined to rewrite her destiny, protect her family, and destroy her husband. There's only one way to win: a scandalous divorce. "I need a wild dog... because I'm going to hunt down a hound." A dangerous alliance. A deadly deal. Will she be able to take everything back this time? 

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Red Shirt
synopsis:
It all started with a retirement. A legend in the underworld of killers and assassins, Cha Sihyeok, otherwise known as "The Red Shirt," leaves a life of violence behind for his loving wife Miju and their unborn child. Little did he expect, however, that bonds made in blood cannot be so easily erased. When tragedy strikes, Sihyeok is dragged back into the deadly struggle between mob factions... and the fight is far from over.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Hatsukoi made no Shouten Kyori
synopsis:
Haruto, a university student, has been harboring a one-sided love for his childhood friend Tsubasa. Tsubasa, a popular guy admired by girls and working as a fashion model, has always prioritized Haruto above anyone else. But now, their time together might be running out... In just six months, Tsubasa will be leaving the dorm to live on his own. Feeling increasingly lonely, Haruto ends up talking to Tsubasa about a confession he received from a junior student...

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

title: Takabisha Koujo wa Damattenai
title_japanese: 高飛車皇女は黙ってない

title: Shinimodori Reijou no Karisome Kekkon: Nidome no Jinsei wa Kimajime Shougun to Seijuu Mofumofu
title_japanese: 死に戻り令嬢の仮初め結婚 二度目の人生は生真面目将軍と星獣もふもふ

title: Turning the Tables
synopsis:
"Sunbae...! I want you now!"

This is it. After having a hopeless crush on him for three years...it's all finally over. Or so I thought.

"I've changed my mind. Go out with me."

Three years of rejection, and all it took was one night in bed? Unbelievable. Furious, I walked away...and didn't look back. But now, that arrogant sunbae has reappeared, asking for my help.

"No need for money. Why don't you convince me with your body instead?"

"Are you sure you won't regret it?"

"Are you any better in bed now?"

What started as a challenge—payback for the man who once crushed my pride—quickly turns into something far more dangerous. This time, who will be the one in control? Let's find out.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Nee, Wasurete Ii yo.
title_english: Hey, You Can Forget About Me.

title: Douka Sore ni Kizuitemo
title_japanese: どうかそれに気づいても

title: The Wolf of Cheonun Peak
synopsis:
To protect her village, Chohee is offered as a human sacrifice to the feared Choneun Peak. But instead of death, she finds herself face-to-face with the infamous leader of a band of outlaws—rumored to be more beast than man. Yet the more time she spends in his shadow, the more his brutal reputation begins to crack. Who is the man behind the mask of the wolf—and why does he seem more protector than predator? In the deadly silence of the mountains, a dangerous bond begins to form.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Akuyaku Reijou ni nanka Narimasen. Watashi wa "Futsuu" no Koushaku Reijou desu! New Route!
title_japanese: 悪役令嬢になんかなりません。私は『普通』の公爵令嬢です! ～New Route!～
synopsis:
A Japanese person reincarnated into an otome game chock full of death flags for the villainess, Rosalind. "I'm going to live an enjoyable life in this world!" Making full use of the game knowledge to avoid death flags, for some reason events keep happening one after another?! Contracting with spirits, helping her father (the prime minister) with his work using her modern day knowledge, taking a walk with the holy beast... and on top of all that, even starting up the heroine's event...? Will Rosalind be able to smash through every unknown death flag that comes her way...?! And will she be able to be fluffy lovey-dovey with the supporting beastkin character she liked from her previous life?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: I Became the Catnip for Ruthless Beastmen
synopsis:
Yernian, who died cruelly as a test subject, returned to the moment the kingdom collapsed?! Unlike her previous life, she is safely rescued by the leader of the Myo tribe! Yernian is given a new life as the only princess of the Myo tribe and the "Savior of the Myo," the only hope to save the collapsing tribe. She originally planned to eventually leave and live freely... But the beastfolk princes who seemed so proud keep getting closer to her?!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Toaru Kagaku no Railgun
title_japanese: とある科学の超電磁砲〈レールガン〉
synopsis:
To celebrate 15 years of the manga, Kazuma Kamachi tells the story of the peaceful, ordinary, and ever-so-slightly unusual everyday lives of these esper girls!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: I'm Ready for Divorce!
synopsis:
While my husband is away fighting a war, I'm preparing for our divorce. But when he returns, he's changed into a sexy alpha male. It's tempting...but I must stand my ground. When he learns of my plans, my husband accuses me of having a lover and wanting to runaway to be with him. What's a soon-to-be ex-wife to do!?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: A Happy Ending for the Young Villain
title_english: A Happy Ending for the Young Villain
synopsis:
When Ahn Dohwa finds herself in an unfinished novel as Archmage Reina Heart, she resolves to lie low until the story reaches a resolution. However, unable to turn a blind eye to the abuse inflicted upon the story's villain, Prince Kevenriak Heteroven, she takes the young prince under her wing and begins training him as her pupil, hoping to change his destiny. But when everything starts to deviate from the original story, Reina's resolve wavers... Can she protect everyone's happy ending?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Baby Demon King Finds the Hero Dads Way Too Annoying
title_japanese: 아기 마왕님은 용사 아빠들이 너무 귀찮아
synopsis:
She was reincarnated as a four-year-old little demon king in a slave market. The demon king is even a puppet being used by other demons because she is too weak! But did the warriors misunderstand the demon who was tormenting me as a demon king and punished him?

Oh, wait a minute. I'm young and weak, and there's a long way to live in the demon world anyway...

"Can't I hide the fact that I'm the Demon King somehow and make the warriors my guardians?"

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Three Mouthwatering Meals for Two
title_japanese: 맛있는 세 끼 - 저스트 더 투 오브 어스
synopsis:
Dr. Cha Soohyuk is a pediatric trauma surgeon who grew up in America after being adopted. Now he's back in Korea in search of his birth parents, but from the nosy strangers to the spicy food, he's having a really tough time! Then one day, he runs into Lee Yoona, the owner of "Mouthwatering Meals" who has a fear of men. In an attempt to overcome her trauma, she cooks for him, and her food matches his tastes perfectly. Now, he only eats what she cooks for him, for all three meals of the day!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Shigatsu ni Nareba Kanojo wa
synopsis:
On the morning following the eve of their engagement, the fiancée disappears from the man's side. He is left to reminisce about why she chose to run away.

(Source: IMDB)

title: Loopy Peeps!
synopsis:
Fuyuha's carefree with his love life, he and his best friend Chiharu loves fooling around. They absolutely love the party scene and spend their days and nights having nonstop fun. Their club at college has a rival, run by Nanatsu, a tan hottie famous for banging over 1,000 people. Fuyuha tries to keep his distance from Nanatsu to avoid any unwanted hassle. One night, though, he stumbles into a room in a club where everyone's going to town on each other in the dark. He thinks he's sucking off Chiharu, and the two end up going all the way. He's shocked when the lights come on and it's that playboy Nanatsu rocking his world!! What was supposed to be a one-time thing turns into more as the arrogant king locks his sights on Fuyuha! As long as Fuyuha's having the time of his life, anything goes! The wild young lives of party guys are on full display!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Magic Theory Prodigy
synopsis:
Rowan glimpses a dark future just ten years away. Unfortunately, he's no powerful leader—just an orphan with an incredible talent for magic. Luckily, his potential won't stay hidden forever. He joins Union Academy, which is filled with potential partners in the fight against dark magic... if only his teachers and classmates could understand magic theory on his level. But if Rowan can keep everyone focused, they might just stop their world from going up in flames.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Serpent in the Empress's Chamber
title_english: The Serpent in the Empress's Chamber
synopsis:
Lenisha helps Laxus, a bastard prince and her paranoid husband, ascend the throne, only for him to strip her of everything she holds dear and cast her away from the imperial palace. But the fallen empress still has one burning purpose left, and that is revenge. To reclaim her power, she allies with Sir Kassius, a war hero with unique features and a mysterious background. As they work together to ensure Laxus meets a painful death, they find themselves secretly drawn to each other.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Elegant Aubrey
synopsis:
Aubrey Sandalwood had one goal: to hide her past as a slave, and become the perfect lady in high society. But at her long-awaited debut party, she runs into a man from her past—the boy who rescued her from the island she was trapped on. Colhard Karnus, the only one who knows her secret.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Mighty Master Is Crazy About Me
title_japanese: 내게 미친 세계관 최강자를 조심할 것
synopsis:
For her sister's happiness and happy ending, Charlotte decides to bring home the knight who holds her sister's heart. However, that means getting to the Black Dragon Order, where the mysterious Archduke Ludovika lurks. With rumors of the archduke's penchant for men, Charlotte dons a wig and becomes Charcharl, a new squire of the order! Despite trying to lay low, she keeps drawing the archduke's eye and suspicions. Can Charcharl keep up the act till the end, or will her cover get blown?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Seeking Your Forgiveness
synopsis:
"Let's get a divorce."

Marianne's declaration of divorce. The arrogant Christoph firmly believed it was just a fleeting whim on her part. After all, everything in the world had always gone his way. But he was wrong. Consumed by regret, Christoph tries his best to win Marianne back, but her heart has already turned away, and she doesn't easily let him near.

"What can I do to make you love me again, Marianne?"

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Stepmother Loves the Harem
synopsis:
Eliana Rose was supposed to have her happily ever after when she married a handsome baron. But after the wedding, she learns the truth about her new husband: he's in love with another woman. Even worse, the baron's mistress is none other than his own adopted daughter, Lady Charhen. Heartbroken and betrayed, Eliana devises a master plan to secure her rightful place in high society and save her family. Her path forward is treacherous, but to secure a fortune, a lady must be bold.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Bad Deeds of the Terminally Ill Empress
synopsis:
It was an arranged marriage, but it was her first love. She loved him not because he was the Emperor, but because it was him. In a wheelchair, Stella dedicated herself to the empire and her husband. However, what came back was a cruel death. The goddess Eunsaji returned Stella, who died paralyzed. He chose his childhood friend in this life as well. Looking at her husband, Stella impulsively took a gladiatorial slave.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: I Became a Fake Family With My Boss
synopsis:
Jung Yu-na is a working aunt(?), who lives a strong life raising her niece Ji-an in place of her older sister and her husband who lost their lives in a hit-and-run accident. One day, Kang Eden, the new CEO of the asset management company where Yu-na works, takes office. From the worst first meeting to the mistakes that keep happening! Yu-na has been renewing her days of being miserable since meeting Eden...

Meanwhile, Eden, who needs a family for his business in the Middle East, proposes to Yu-na and Ji-an, who have been constantly catching his eye, to become his fake family. The three of them start living together to become the perfect family. Unlike their first meeting, which was unpleasant, Yu-na and Eden gradually fall for each other as they keep seeing different sides of each other...

They just wanted to be a fake family, but somehow they even fall in love?! Will Eden and Yu-na be able to become a real family?!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: The Life Tips of a Pretty Girl
synopsis:
In 2006, Kang Haena, known as the "menace" of Beomchon High School, was actually just a teenage girl dreaming of love! One day, while reading the comic "The Life Tips of a Pretty Girl," she suddenly finds herself in the body of a girl from the future—the model student Kang Haena of Beomchon High in 2025. To return to her original body, she must find her destined partner... A destined partner? Here?!!

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Marriage Blues
synopsis:
On her wedding day, Hana Gu realizes her relationship lacks love and flees the ceremony. During her escapade, she runs into her ex-boyfriend, Gawi Nam who helps her by using his mysterious ability to time travel into the past. Determined to erase her unwanted marriage, she uses this ability to try and change her fate, but the future proves less malleable than expected. Amid repeated failures, she finds solace in Gawi, who is also trapped in the past, facing similar struggles. As they fight fate together, old feelings from their first love resurface, making Hana question—does she truly want to change her fate?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: I Died and Everything Changed
synopsis:
My funeral has begun. "How can she not shed tears when her twin sister died?" "I heard she's an idiot, so the rumors must be true." "I heard she has an inferiority complex. Who knows, maybe she is happy inside." I died of poison. And overnight I became Mergen's burden, Irene. You said you wanted to live like me? No, Irene. You shouldn't live like that.

"You're not going anywhere without my permission, noona." Since when did Abel, who treated Irene like a bug, start calling me noona? "Keep your promise. Our deal isn't over yet." My ex-fiancé, with whom I had a strictly business relationship, started treating Irene like the old me. "I don't care what it is. I'm a vulgar mongrel, unlike you, so I can digest whatever I swallow." Why does the Grand Duke, whom I thought was the enemy, do this?

The attitudes of the three men are puzzling. It is said that there are no permanent enemies or allies, but has there ever been a time when things were so unclear as now?

(Source: ROK Media, translat

title: Koukou Jidai ni Gouman datta Joou-sama to no Dousei Seikatsu wa Igai to Igokochi ga Warukunai
title_japanese: 高校時代に傲慢だった女王様との同棲生活は意外と居心地が悪くない
synopsis:
"Hey, wanna do it?"

A romantic comedy about living together with a scarred queen in a relationship that's more than friends but less than lovers!!

One late night, Yamamoto, a college student working part-time at a convenience store, reunites with Hayashi Megumi, his high school classmate and the most beautiful girl in their class. Known as the "Queen" for her strong-willed and arrogant personality, Yamamoto had always found her difficult to get along with. However, during a routine conversation, he notices painful bruises on her wrist. After learning that her boyfriend had been abusing her, Yamamoto decides to let Hayashi stay at his place...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Lotto 1st Place Winner Goes to Work Too
synopsis:
Gong Eun-tae, an ordinary sales employee you can find anywhere, wins the jackpot in the lottery—something he had only dreamed of! After taxes, he takes home 1.8 billion won. A large sum, but is it really enough to turn his life upside down?

"Let's just live as I always have... I'll think of the lottery as insurance for my peace of mind."

With that reassuring safety net, he takes the leap—and suddenly, everything he does starts going unbelievably well?! Today, Eun-tae heads to work once again! But this time, with a whole new mindset.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: The Dignity of a Chaebol
synopsis:
Son Joong-gil, chairman of the Korea Finance Group, who represented Korea in the 1990s. Thirty years after he closes his eyes, he opens them in the body of his grandson, Son Jeong-hoon, in 2022. A financial group that has declined noticeably compared to 30 years ago. Son Joong-gil is trying to bring the group he helped build to the top again.

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: Mahou Shoujo to Mayaku Sensou
synopsis:
"Candy," a mysterious drug whose main ingredient is just ordinary sugar, is spreading like wildfire in Tokyo. When Susui, a narcotics agent who has infiltrated the yakuza to get closer to Candy's manufacturer, finds himself in danger, a self-proclaimed "magical girl" named Riri Hoshina comes to his rescue...!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: I Approached a Female Agent with No Dating Experience
synopsis:
In an era of peace, a knight named Lire, who once made countless contributions on the frontlines, now serves quietly in the rear. However, the quiet days don’t last long as an enigmatic junior knight, Kato, visits and expresses affection daily. Having never experienced such courtship in her life, Lire is always flustered, but Kato does not care and keeps pushing forward. The conclusion may already be determined, but what events will unfold in the process for these two?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: The Knight and the Witch
synopsis:
Zerak, a bold and beautiful witch born from a gemstone, dreams of joining an official witch gathering. But her fiery fashion sense and unapologetic attitude don't sit well with the more conservative witches, who quickly shut her out.

Determined to find a place where she truly belongs, Zerak sets off on a journey to seek a gathering that will accept her. Along the way, she finds herself entangled with three very different men—each more complicated than the last.

Will Zerak be able to claim her place among the witches, or will these unexpected encounters change her path forever?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Zeitaku Zanmai shitai no desu! Binbou Ryouchi no Mahou Kaikaku Akuyaku Reijou Nante Narimasen!
title_japanese: 贅沢三昧したいのです! ～貧乏領地の魔法改革 悪役令嬢なんてなりません!～

title: Hiyaketa Natsu no Hada to Shiroi Oppai no Shoujo-tachi
title_japanese: 日焼けた夏の肌と白いおっぱいの少女達
synopsis:
1. Game Center no Hiyake Shoujo to Wareme no Natsu
2. Usotsuki Ane to Damasare Otouto no Hoken Taiiku
3. Kizukai Dekiru Ko
4. Kodomo demo Chanto Koi wo Suru
5. Eat-in to Onnanoko
6. Natsu no Pool to Randoseru Shoujo
7. Kodomo datte Ecchi ga Shitai
8. Inaka Shoujo to Himitsu no Asobi
9. Manatsu no Atarikuji

title: Miro in Memory
synopsis:
Haechan dreams of becoming a hero, saving Korea from the deadly Calamities. But as a powerless guard, he is seen as a weakling. That is, until he meets Miro, a mysterious girl who offers him immense power in exchange for his help in destroying the sacred Seal Talismans—the true source of the Calamities' wrath. Now, Haechan must embark on a dangerous mission to free the world from its torment, all while living a double life filled with secrecy, betrayal, and a growing conflict between heroism and villainy.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Omoide Teiryuujo
synopsis:
Japan, 1950. In a country that still hasn't recovered from the atrocious war, there was one girl who was trying her best to live. Her name was Maki Sawada, 17 years old. To get by, after finishing school she started working as a "bus girl," doing her best every day as a bus conductor. As she devoted herself to her job, she got a chance to meet many different people... This is a moving story about living life with a positive attitude in an era where the scars of war still remain.

(Source: Nihon Bungeisha, translated)

title: Soratobu Kujira: Suzuki Suzuhiro Sakuhinshuu
title_japanese: 空飛ぶくじら スズキスズヒロ作品集
synopsis:
1. Kimura-sensei
2. Juusei wo Kezuridasu
3. Trainspotting
4. Taxi Driver
5. Kids Return
6. Soratobu Kujira

title: Silver Mountain
synopsis:
The story centers on a boy who is kidnapped by a Tengu and is taken to an enchanted land. The boy speaks of an unbelievable world where people who want real existence strive to reach the peak of martial arts.

(Source: ANN)

title: Chuumon no Kanau Ryouriten
title_english: The Restaurant Where Wish Come True

title: Urakata de Support shiteta Geinou Ikka wo Tsuihou sareta Boku wa, Futsuu no Seishun wo Ouka shitai.
title_japanese: 裏方でサポートしてた芸能一家を追放された僕は、普通の青春を謳歌したい。
synopsis:
A boy named Atsumu was branded as "useless" by his famous sisters and banished from his entertainment-industry family. However, hidden within him was an extraordinarily talented "behind-the-scenes support" skill that neither he nor his family had noticed! After transferring schools, Atsumu is now determined to live a normal life, but as he crosses paths with talented entertainers—VTubers, idols, and models—his natural ability starts to shine, making him their indispensable support. They can't help but adore him, turning his simple wish for normality into a showbiz underdog success story!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Master of All Skills
synopsis:
"Whoa, your skill is insane!"
[Skill successfully copied.]

There's no power he can't claim. What's yours becomes his—what's his stays his. This is the beginning of Yoo Ju-Yeon's unstoppable rise as the ultimate Skill Master!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Sahoko Quest: Inkya Joshi, Shinshi Muke Doujin RPG Sekai de Yuusha ni Naru
title_japanese: さほこクエスト～陰キャ女子、紳士向け同人RPG世界で勇者になる～

title: True End: Sahoko-chan no Isekai Tengoku Kairaku Jikoku
title_japanese: TRUE END～沙帆子ちゃんの異世界天国快楽地獄～

title: Mr. Tiger's Snacks
synopsis:
Hoseok is a tiger who wants to make and sell cute desserts in peace. While he was once a member of a shady syndicate, he makes the decision to wash his hands of that life and instead follow his dream of opening his own dessert shop! But this new life isn't as easy as it sounds. Can Hoseok overcome the prejudices his neighbors have against him and make his dream come true? A slice-of-life story to warm your heart!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: When the Archduke's Leash Is Pulled
title_english: When the Archduke's Leash Is Pulled
synopsis:
Jenna, a girl cursed to see others' emotions as light, awakens as an extra in a novel. Yearning for a quiet life, she settles in a forest cabin—only to discover it belongs to Enoch Winchester, a cursed duke cloaked in an ominous black light. When Enoch realizes Jenna may hold the key to breaking his curse, he proposes a contract: she must spend time with him each day and come whenever he calls. Jenna agrees, but with one condition—he must appear in the form of a snow leopard whenever they're together.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: I Want My Bad Happy Ending!
title_english: I Want My Bad Happy Ending!
synopsis:
Yuri Elrose is the heroine of a dating simulation game... with a deadly twist. If she ends up with any of the four charming male leads, the final boss starts a war, and she dies. Her solution? Aim for the "bad" ending: raise everyone's affection evenly, stay single, and live a quiet, solitary life. But the more she keeps her distance, the more they seem to gravitate toward her. And now, even the mysterious final boss seems interested...! Can Yuri manage to get her boring, disaster-free ending?!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Second Child of God
synopsis:
Jiseo, born with the fate of the second child of God. Hyunjin, who appeared before Jiseo as he lamented his fate, tries to help him but ends up being possessed by a ghost...

(Source: Naver Corporation, translated)

title: The Dark Duke's Pet Bird
synopsis:
What life is there for a creature forever trapped in a cage? Such questions ring true for Isabella Heloise, illegitimate child of an abusive count who uses her as a pawn for his political ambitions. When Isabella's betrothal to an influential noble is broken off, her value within the Heloise household plummets, prompting her to flee from her father's violence. Isabella finds herself alone and destitute, only to be found by Ethan Holden, a dashing duke with a nonetheless ominous air. Can Isabella trust the handsome duke, or has she found herself in yet another cage?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Ladies Top 100
synopsis:
As an avid reader of romance fantasy novels, I wasn't that surprised when I transmigrated into one. But I didn't expect it to be a multiplayer VR game beta test! Luckily, the 99 other girls are super nice, and they caught me up: all we have to do is pick a male lead and reach a happy ending. Here's the catch... We're being ranked, and the more eligible our suitor is, the more money we'll get at the end. In this game that tries to pit us against each other, can female solidarity conquer all?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Shovel Up!
synopsis:
I logged into a viral virtual reality game and was given... a weird shovel. It can create anything, but monsters only attack me. After smashing everything with the shovel, strange people started to appear! Who will win? Let's find out in a fight!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Peaches and Dream
synopsis:
Born and raised on a diet of peaches, a do-myeong named Seolwon was destined to become a courtesan of the highest class, an exquisite creation known as a jade feet. But when his incomplete body is deemed defective and dangerous, he's cast aside as a failed product, discarded like broken porcelain.

Before he can be sold off cheaply, a mysterious attack leaves him unconscious. When he wakes, he learns he's already been bought, for a staggering sum, by an unknown master.

His search for answers leads him to Dream Palace, a sprawling casino ruled by the enigmatic Jay, a man whose beauty and power are matched only by his madness.

Cursed by a succubus, Jay suffers from uncontrollable fits of desire and delirium. The only cure, it seems, lies in the stray do-myeong, the discarded creation who may now hold the key to both salvation and ruin.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Unholy
synopsis:
He dreamed of loyalty. The kind of unshakable trust that binds a servant to his master. But the demon prince desired nothing but love. This is their unholy love story.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: The Alluring Tale of Mong-Ryong
synopsis:
Mong-ryong, a brilliant and stunningly handsome secret royal inspector in Joseon, is sent on his first mission with full confidence. But his destination? None other than Namwon, a region plagued by the notorious pervert governor, Byeon Hakdo.

While trying to expose corruption, Mong-ryong finds himself in serious trouble—he's about to be forced into serving the lustful governor. Just when things look dire, a strapping local official, Ibang, catches his eye.

Thinking quickly (and a bit shamelessly), Mong-ryong grabs Ibang and declares, "Take responsibility! You're the one who made me like this!"

If he's going to fall into a man's arms, he figures, he might as well choose the better-looking one.

What starts as a scheme to escape danger soon spirals into chaos, confusion, and unexpected sparks. Will this rookie inspector survive Namwon's corruption... or lose his heart in the process?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Uhouho Donkey-kun
title_japanese: ウホウホドンキーくん
synopsis: A manga adaptation of the first three Donkey Kong Country games.

title: Iron Acguy
synopsis:
Gunpla-loving high school student Atsuyama is not satisfied with making kits, so he finally comes up with the idea of ​​making a life-sized Acguy!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Watashi, Kumo na Monster wo Tame shita node, Spider Silk de Saihou wo Ganbarimasu!
title_english: I've Tamed a Spider Monster, So I'm Going to Try My Best at Sewing with Spider Silk!
title_japanese: 私、蜘蛛なモンスターをテイムしたので、スパイダーシルクで裁縫を頑張ります!

title: Oshi to no Doukyo ga Toutosugimasu!
title_japanese: 推しとの同居が尊すぎます!
synopsis:
Hajun, a member of the popular K-pop idol group "HANURu", had gone on hiatus for military service. But even after his discharge, there were no signs of his return—leaving fans restless and anxious. Nana, a devoted fan of Hajun, continued supporting him while secretly worrying about his absence. However, after her parents' sudden remarriage, she was forced to move out of her home. With no other choice, she headed to the new place her parents had arranged—only to find none other than her bias waiting there!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: I'm Attracted to You
synopsis:
Kang Ha-young, who works at a so-called family-like small company, spends every day... Overtime, overtime, and more overtime! Why am I the only one doing all the work...? Then one day, Min Tae-hoon, a contract worker who might just help her escape the endless overtime, appears in front of her! But something's suspicious about this guy... Why would someone with such high qualifications come to our company? Wait... is he gay? Or bi? Or maybe a player!? They say to avoid trouble, but she just can't help being curious about Min Tae-hoon.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Hoshinaki Sekai no Annainin
synopsis:
The story follows Destination Management Company, which offers any lost foodie a one-on-one, personalized guided tour to the world's finest cuisine.

(Source: ANN)

title: Korogaru Hoshi no Asterism
title_japanese: 転がる星のアステリズム

title: Punk Gun
synopsis:
On the outskirts of the crime-infested Dead City, a young boy named Aiboba and his band of orphans become involved in a dangerous incident.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Arabake! Arabaki Gungun Park
title_japanese: あらばけ!荒吐グングンパーク
synopsis:
Sixteen-year-old Inari Anamori has always had a soft spot for animals. But on his first day at his new school, things take a wild turn—he's suddenly attacked by a bizarre creature he encountered in the forest! Just when things look grim, he's rescued by Gunze Arabaki, a mysterious loner with a deep disdain for people. Their fateful encounter throws Inari headfirst into a chaotic school life filled with strange creatures, wild antics, and nonstop surprises. Get ready for the start of Kyosuke Usuta's latest gag manga—an off-the-wall comedy where the weird is just getting started!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Yamete Kure, Tsuyoi no wa Ore ja Nakute Ken nanda......!
title_english: Make It Stop! I'm Not Strong... It's Just My Sword!
title_japanese: やめてくれ、強いのは俺じゃなくて剣なんだ……！
synopsis: Crow Titus, notorious layabout, wasn't prepared for the destruction of his village by the aetherborn. On Earth, far in the future, ordinary creatures have been twisted into the monstrous aetherborn—beasts of legend and nightmare who wreak havoc on humanity. The only defenses against the creatures are mythical weapons known as aetherial arms, which, luckily, appeared right around when the monsters did. Less luckily, some humans choose to use those weapons for evil—for example, the attack on Crow's village was instigated by a dark magus wielding one. The lone survivor of the massacre, Crow somehow stumbles upon an aethereal arm, Muramasa. Sword in hand, Crow decides to fight back—or, well, Crow can't decide much at all. Muramasa has taken control and manipulates Crow like a puppet, using the man's body to feed his insatiable appetite for souls! Can Crow play the part of a hero while surviving Muramasa's madness? What about surviving the advances of Iris, his newfound magus knight mentor?

title: Noroma Mahou to Yobareta Mahoutsukai wa Juuryoku Mahou de Musou suru: Mada Juuryoku no Gainen no Nai Sekai Nite, Shounen wa Banyuu Inryoku Ou to Naru
title_english: Defying Expectations with Gravity Magic to Be Unparalleled
title_japanese: ノロマ魔法と呼ばれた魔法使いは重力魔法で無双する ～まだ重力の概念のない世界にて、少年は万有引力の王となる～
synopsis:
Wade, a boy born in the slums and raised by terrible parents, finds a glimmer of hope when he becomes an apprentice adventurer. Enduring grueling training, he's promised to be taught magic if he perseveres. On the day of his fateful magic instruction, while others are granted promising fire and water magic, Wade receives what seems like the worst of luck—a magic called "Slow Magic."

In despair upon realizing it's a spell that makes him clumsy, Wade recalls memories of his past life as a corporate slave. "Huh? 'Slow Magic'? That sounds like gravity magic, a powerful spell!"Yes! In this underdeveloped world, where the concept of gravity is largely unknown, Wade is underestimated.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Toshiue Otoko to Seishun no March
title_japanese: 年上男と青春のマアチ

title: Kusa Mahoushi Chloe no Nidome no Jinsei: Jiyuu ni Natte Ko Dragon to Level Max Kusushi Life
title_japanese: 草魔法師クロエの二度目の人生 自由になって子ドラゴンとレベルMAX薬師ライフ
synopsis:
Betrayed by her parents, cast aside by her fiancé the prince, and left to die in a dungeon by the mentor she once trusted—Countess Chloe meets a tragic end... only to awaken in the body of her five-year-old self.

Given a second chance, Chloe refuses to walk the same path of sorrow. This time, she'll use the one thing everyone looked down on—her "useless" grass magic—to carve out a life of her own, far from the chains of nobility and heartbreak.

(Source; Kadokawa, translated)

title: The Eunuch's Second Life
synopsis:
Jang Jinmyeong, a martial arts master who mastered the forbidden technique "Gyuhwa Bojeon," reached the peak of power—only to be branded a traitor and thrown off a cliff. Just before his death, he realizes two grave mistakes: He gained immense power through Gyuhwa Bojeon at the cost of losing his manhood, and he failed to eliminate the vile traitors Wang Jin and Seop Pyeong when he had the chance. But instead of dying, Jinmyeong awakens in a mysterious realm, where he encounters the original copy of Gyuhwa Bojeon, and is sent 32 years back in time—right before he lost his manhood. Now, with his body intact and the power of Gyuhwa Bojeon still coursing through him, Jinmyeong embarks on a new path. This time, he will correct the regrets of his past life... and seek vengeance against Wang Jin and Seop Pyeong, the men who betrayed him.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Happy Face: From Slave to Arena Legend
synopsis:
Born and raised as a slave in the arena, Happy survived by relying on nothing but his monstrous strength. When his master is executed and the arena collapses, Happy is finally freed for the first time in his life. Now, stepping into a world he barely understands, he begins to learn about family, friendship, and society—one painful, awkward step at a time. But the world refuses to let him rest. His identity as a former slave, the endless wars against crime, the buried secrets of his birth... all of them drag Happy into new battles, each more brutal than the last. Through it all, he grows—beyond a mere fighter, beyond a monster—rising until he stands at the very pinnacle of the world. From the bloodstained sands of the arena to the peak of power, this is the story of the boy who never forgot how to smile.

(Source: RESET SCANS & Utoon)

title: Ouhi-sama wa Rikon shitai: Isekai kara Seijo-sama ga Kita node, Mou Oyakugomen desu wa ne?
title_english: Her Majesty Wants a Divorce: Now that a Saint has Come from Another World, I Suppose I'm No Longer Needed, Right?
title_japanese: 王妃様は離婚したい～異世界から聖女様が来たので、もうお役御免ですわね?～
synopsis:
Ylis, a saint who has memories of her past life in another world, married King Reinhardt for political reasons, but was leading a loveless life. Then, after finding out that Reinhardt has spent the night with the second saint Hina, she decides to leave him, declaring, "I'm leaving the palace!" What the future holds for the queen who is unsavvy in matters of love, and king who has a hot and cold tsundere personality? Will their misunderstandings ever be resolved?!

(Source: K Manga)

title: Senjou no Seijo: Imouto no Kawari ni Koushaku Kishi ni Totsugu Koto ni Narimashita ga, Ima wa Shiawase desu
title_english: The Battlefield Saint: I Was Made to Marry a Duke Knight in Place of My Little Sister, but I've Since Found Happiness
title_japanese: 戦場の聖女〜妹の代わりに公爵騎士に嫁ぐことになりましたが、今は幸せです〜
synopsis:
Unlike her younger sister, who is known as the Saint, Finne is rather unremarkable, and has been treated poorly at home. After being sent to a dangerous battlefield as a military doctor, Finne meets a critically injured duke knight named Leon and uses her healing magic to save him from the verge of death. Then, everything in her life starts to change dramatically...?!

(Source: K Manga)

title: Jiki Koushaku Fujin no Yakuwari dake wo Motomete Kita, Koori no Bara to Utawareru Danna-sama ga Kateinai Stalker to Kashita Ken
title_english: My Ice-Rose Husband Said He Only Wants Me to Play the Role of the Next Duchess, but Now He's Stalking Me at Home!
title_japanese: 次期公爵夫人の役割だけを求めてきた、氷の薔薇と謳われる旦那様が家庭内ストーカーと化した件
synopsis:
Viola, the daughter of a declining count (she was Japanese in her previous life), was married off to Albert―the next duke―by her parents. However, on the very first night of their marriage, her husband declares, "All I ask of you is that you carry out your role as the wife of the duke in appearance only," effectively shattering any hope of a romantic relationship. Despite the soul-destroying statement from him, Viola picks up the pieces and starts to live happily and without restraints, announcing, "Forget my ice-cold, rude husband. I'm gonna live my life the way I want!" However, her new husband and mansion seem to hide a secret...?! It's a smothering romance of a reincarnated, happy-go-lucky lady who, by comforting the traumatized husband, turns him into the most doting of husbands.

(Source: K Manga)

title: Zekkyou Daiyogen
synopsis:
1. Daiyogen
2. Zoku Daiyogen
3. Yumeji no Noubaku Kagaku Dokuhon
4. Iyoutou Hyouryuuki
5. Aa Ijou: Les Miserables Gaiden
6. Umi no Ko Yama no Ko Chimata no Ko
7. Aru Asa, Okitara...
8. Aa!! Kanashimi no Gankutsu Shoujo

title: S-kyuu Party kara Tsuihou sareta Kariudo, Jitsu wa Sekai Saikyou: Shatei 9999 no Otoko, Teikoku no Sogekishu toshite Musou suru
title_japanese: S級パーティーから追放された狩人、実は世界最強 ～射程9999の男、帝国の狙撃手として無双する～

title: Yachiru-san wa Homeru to Nobiru
title_japanese: やちるさんはほめるとのびる
synopsis:
Yachiru is a Hasshakusama youkai living in the human world. Because the prevailing public image of Hasshakusama is that they're lewd (not scary), her powers have weakened and her height has shrunk from its original 8 shaku (240 cm) to about 190 cm. She strives to correct that impression, but each day is another failure. However, while at the cinema to study horror films, she meets Seiichirou, a young man who is a huge fan of Hasshakusama. That's when Yachiru realizes that whenever Seiichirou praises her, her height returns to its original size...!!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Ponkotsu Yuusha Party, Ryuu wo Hirou
title_english: Ponkotsu Hero Party Picks Up a Dragon
title_japanese: ポンコツ勇者パーティー、竜をひろう

title: Shoukan Skill wo Keishou shita node, Kiwametemiyou to Omoimasu! Mofumofu Mahou Seibutsu to Isekai Life wo Mankitsuchuu
title_japanese: 召喚スキルを継承したので、極めてみようと思います!～モフモフ魔法生物と異世界ライフを満喫中～

title: Baburasete, Motto
synopsis:
Kiri Amamiya may seem like a diligent honor student, but the truth is that he's very insecure, and he can't stop sucking on a pacifier when he feels anxious. Kiri used to be able to enjoy his pacifier time in secret in his dorm room, until he started sharing the room with Yukimura Enami, a pleasant and cheerful underclassman. Then one night, Yukimura sees Kiri sucking on his pacifier...?!

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Taishou Junai Fukushuutan: Haha wo Yakikorosareta Watashi wa Oni to Kasu
title_japanese: 大正純愛復讐譚 ～母を焼き殺された私は鬼と化す～

title: Inkya no Ore ga Sekigae de S-kyuu Bishoujo ni Kakomaretara Himitsu no Kankei ga Hajimatta.
title_japanese: 陰キャの俺が席替えでS級美少女に囲まれたら秘密の関係が始まった。
synopsis:
My peaceful school life... is officially over.

Izumiya Ryouta, an introverted otaku, suddenly finds himself surrounded by the top three beauties of the class after a seat change. In front of him sits the little-sister-type Miyama Airi. To his left, the cool and detached gyaru, Ichinose Yuria. And to his right, the refined, black-haired class rep, Kuroki Ruri. On the surface, they're flawless beauties—but Ryouta stumbles upon secrets that none of them can ever let out...

"P-Please...! Just don't tell anyone about this!"

"From now on, we're in that kind of relationship."

"This is a secret... just between you and me, Ryouta-kun."

All he wanted was a quiet otaku life—so how did things end up like this?! Caught between three troublesome girls, an introverted otaku desperately fights to avoid any more chaos in this love-comedy showdown!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Shakunetsu no Majo-sama no Tanoshii Onsen Ryouchi Keiei: Maryoku Zero de Henkyou ni Tsuihou saremashita ga, Saiyakukyuu no Atatame Skill de Onsen Teikoku Tsukucchaimasu
title_english: A Scorching Witch's Fun Hot Spring Territory Management
title_japanese: 灼熱の魔女様の楽しい温泉領地経営 ～魔力ゼロで辺境に追放されましたが、災厄級のあたためスキルで温泉帝国つくっちゃいます～
synopsis:
"Due to your lack of magic power, you are banished to the frontier!"

Yuo, the duke's daughter who had an unknown and useless skill was shunned by her family due to her "incompetence." One day, her family assigns her as the lord of a remote, demon-infested frontier as banishment. She arrives at the poor village and finds a strange flooded swamp. Using her "Heater" skill, she transforms the swamp into a hot spring. Realizing the miraculous power of hot springs, she decides to develop a hot spring resort. Various talents start to gather from all over the world, attracted by her hot spring territory. Join Yuo as she struggles to transform her poor domain into a rich, independent nation. May the world learn the glory of hot springs! Viva, onsen!

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Kyuuketsu Izon Gal no Hoshimori-san
title_japanese: 吸血依存ギャルの星守さん

title: Hametsu Flag Kaihi no Tame Yamaoku e Hikikomotteita Saikyou no Akuyaku wa, Tasuketa Heroine ni Yotte Omotebutai e Tatasareru
title_english: The Strongest Villain, Who Had Retired to the Mountains to Avoid His Own Flag of Doom, Being Dragged to the Front Stage by the Heroine He Saved.
title_japanese: 破滅フラグ回避のため山奥へ引き籠っていた最強の悪役は、助けたヒロインによって表舞台へ立たされる
synopsis:
He got reincarnated as the most powerful and hated villain in an action-romance RPG! His name is Alba, and no matter how the story ends, this villain is destined to die. If he wants to survive, there's only one option: stay out of the spotlight!

Alba is happy living a quiet life deep in the mountains... until the day he accidentally saves a beautiful girl—an act that shatters his plans completely. As fate would have it, this girl is one of the key characters responsible for his death in the game's original story! Now dragged into the elite academy where the game unfolds, Alba must dodge danger at every turn if he wants to stay alive. This is the story of a man fighting to survive — by running away from his own destiny!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Isekai Shitateya Sofia: Binbou Reijou, Gendai Chishiki de Fuku wo Tsukutte Minna no Kurashi wo Yutaka ni Shimasu
title_english: Fantasy-World Dressmaker Sofia: The Broke Noble Daughter Will Make Clothes Using Modern Knowledge to Enrich Everyone's Lives
title_japanese: 異世界仕立て屋ソフィア 貧乏令嬢、現代知識で服を作ってみんなの暮らしを豊かにします
synopsis:
Sofia is reborn as a mob character in the world of her favorite otome game. Faced with the threat of her family's downfall, she begins to make clothes using her knowledge from her previous life as a seamstress. She opens a tailoring shop, and various requests come her way...? A work fantasy in which a poor daughter changes the world with the magic of clothes!

(Source: Coamix, translated)

title: Top Delinquent of the Demonic Sect
synopsis:
Hey, I'm Gucheon (The Highest Sky), the strongest of the Demonic Cult. Anyone know how to get back to the Cult?

Gucheon, the absolute being who trampled the martial world and ruled at the very top. He was the one who led the Demonic Cult to its peak, and to the righteous sects, he was called the Heavenly Demon. The final war against the Demonic Sect, launched by the combined forces of all sects, including the Nine Great Sects. After a fierce battle, Gucheon was killed by an unknown entity. Just when he thought everything was over... He opened his eyes , not in Jianghu, but inside a weak body in the modern era?!

"What the...?! Where is this crazy place?! Send me back!!"

Gucheon descends upon the modern world...!!!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

title: Summer Pockets Mugyu Days: Tsumugi no Shima Sanpo
title_japanese: Summer Pockets むぎゅでいず〜紬の島さんぽ〜

title: Nigakute Amai: Refrain
synopsis:
Nagisa Katayama, a good-looking high school teacher, is a boy-crazy vegetarian with amazing cooking skills. He's living the bachelor life that everyone dreams of, yet somehow finds himself surrounded only by baggage-ridden women who hate vegetables. One day, he's elated to hear that his landlord's "grandson" is moving in next door, but his excitement is short-lived... The long-awaited continuation of this foody love comedy begins!

(Source: Manga Mirai)

title: Life Reboot for a Gaming Addict
title_english: Life Reboot for a Gaming Addict
synopsis:
After six years, gaming nerd Lee Jinho finally finishes Reset Life, a brutal mobile game where you have to clear 99 different lives. Just as the thrill of victory fades and emptiness takes hold, a sudden message reveals the game has merged with reality. The true 100th round begins, marking the start of his real reset life. Stressed and feeling lost, Reina spends an evening drowning her sorrows in beer at an empty park. She rants and vents out loud to the starry sky that she wants to give up and quit being president, just letting off steam. Except, she fails to realize that her subordinate, 37-year-old section chief Kenichi Ishizumi, heard her drunken ramblings! With the strength and spirit of legends flowing through him, Eustus's journey from zero to the strongest in history begins!

He died full of regret after witnessing his work partner of 20 years, Kim Sangjin, distorted his very own autopsy report when he was still conscious and accused him of committing suicide. However, ever since Ukai lost his long-time friend and secret lover Amakata, he's been hiding the fact that he is gay, keeping his feelings bottled up for no one to know of. One day, Ukai notices a student has been following him around and trying to get closer to him. As things start to become more than just a minor issue, Toki steps in to help. Time passes, and Fuyune has become a trainer, Akine has become a ranch manager, and Natsune has become a jockey, all pursuing the dream they have entrusted to her beloved horse. As the line between threat and connection blurs, tragedy strikes when a coyote slips past his guard and kills one of the flock. With loyalty shaken and feelings he can't name, Dennis must choose. In time, Ars rises to become the world's most powerful mage. Stepping into the outside world, he begins his journey... utterly unaware of the overwhelming power he wields! Determined to win the cat's affection, he brings its seemingly ordinary owner, Roserikta, into the royal palace. But appearances can be deceiving—Roserikta is clearly hiding something... something magical. Thus begins a whimsical romance between a cursed prince, a mysterious woman, and one unforgettable feline.

While chasing a young lord, she stumbles into a hidden chamber and is trapped for what feels like 100 days. But when she escapes, twelve years have passed, and the world is at war with monstrous beasts. Now, Airi must navigate a broken kingdom and rewrite the story of her second life.

Now, after waking up again as her younger self, Vionne calmly assesses her situation and past memories to avoid marrying Crown Prince Sirius and meeting the same fate. As different choices lead to a change in relationships and a turn of events, will Vionne prevent this life from being another tragedy?

As a plant, Senelia is to weaken him so that he cannot challenge Clifford's throne. But Senelia falls for the man, Veneruccia, whom she's meant to undo. She goes back seven years and possesses the body of Jang Bo-ran, a top idol at the time and a judge on the audition program "I Am the Strongest Idol"... synopsis:
On her first day of college, Ho-eun joins a campus club—only to find herself surrounded by charming, shamelessly bold upperclassmen.

All she's asked to do is read a book out loud. It seems simple enough... until she realizes exactly what she's reading.

Flustered and unsure how to react, Ho-eun is caught between embarrassment, confusion—and a strange thrill she can't quite explain. The way they look at her, the way they tease her... it awakens something unfamiliar.

She wants to run, but something holds her in place. After all, her graduation depends on this club.

Will she manage to escape the clutches of her dangerously perverted sunbaes, or will she be pulled deeper into their twisted game?

They realize that a certain organization is involved in these mysterious deaths. Perhaps the brother and mother did not commit suicide, but were manipulated into dying...? And what is the "strange creature" involved? A summer of suspense begins as the boys pursue the mystery.

One day, while heading to work, he crosses paths with his incredibly beautiful boss, Benikawa, and instantly falls in love. At that moment, for the first time in years, something stirs within him—he's back in action as a man! With his confidence restored, Nakada begins to excel at his job, climbing the corporate ladder at an impressive pace. But his newfound success also leads to unexpected encounters with his female subordinates...!? A bold and risqué workplace comedy where success and romance go hand in hand!

But his peaceful days are constantly disrupted by Nishino-san, the cheerful and unpredictable girl who ends up sitting next to him. "Don’t pollute my sanctuary! Don’t intrude on my time!" Contrary to his wishes, day after day, Nakayama is at Nishino's mercy in this chatty rom-com about a germophobe and an unsophisticated high school girl!!

However, while hiding her true identity and searching for answers, she only comes up with more questions. Every day passed in a flash, yet those summer days felt like they could last forever in that clubroom. But when this summer ends, the dominoes between us will all begin to fall, at once.

Stuck for 108 days while heaven's agent searches for the fraudster, Ju-in crosses paths with Ju Do-gwon, another soul-scam victim in the same situation. Yet with a domain to do whatever she pleases and subjects who grow fond of her, this underhanded banishment might be the key to fulfilling her dreams! Because of her past life, she prefers to live a normal, peaceful life and serve others in this life rather than enjoy honor and status. This is the story of Alesia, a girl who makes it rain when she sleeps and who tries to live a positive life and be kind to others out of regret for her past life.

As memories from her past life rush back to her, Delga realizes that Asher is destined to become a bloodthirsty killer. Between running the duchy and keeping her secret abilities in check, Delga has no patience for any of Asher's mischievous schemes. Can Delga find a way to stop him from going down the wrong path? Determined to avoid this fate, she becomes the sweetest sister, doing anything for Clara's happiness. synopsis:

Even worse, she gets invited to his engagement party. To avoid embarrassment, Megumi enlists the help of her junior colleague, Dr. Akiho, to pose as her boyfriend. Akiho agrees, but his motivations are not entirely altruistic. As they continue the charade, genuine feelings begin to surface between Megumi and Akiho. Their budding relationship faces numerous obstacles, including Akiho's arranged engagement to his childhood friend, Marika, and familial pressures. Megumi also confronts her own insecurities and past traumas, particularly concerning marriage and family. Throughout the series, Megumi and Akiho support each other through personal and professional challenges, gradually building a deep and authentic connection.

However, Karen is homeless and moves from one friend's house to another, and by chance, the sensitive Nayu and free-spirited Karen end up living together. Iku, whose hair and eyes are as pale as white snow, is mistreated by her family because of her strange, demon-like appearance. She is treated as little more than a servant until the day she is sold to a man for money, a fate she thought impossible to escape from... One day, however, the next head of a prominent family, Subaru, learns of Iku's secret and offers her a marriage proposal. Though it is a political marriage, the two, both burdened with a damaged past, gradually become attracted to each other...? A love story of destiny unfolds as the hearts of a couple who have never known love melt together!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

The fastidious wimpy crybaby detective, Sumeragi Sento, and his twin assistants, Mete and Yunde Hoshibami, are cloaked in a dubious atmosphere. The detective agency "Night Owl" is willing to take on any request, depending on money and conditions. There is a girl whose organs have been stolen, a top dancer who has disappeared, and surrounded by the presence of money and violence, the Owl eats rats today.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title_japanese: 『理想の花嫁を探して幸せにして差し上げます』と言ったら、そっけなかった婚約者が何故か関わってきますが、花嫁斡旋頑張ります
synopsis:
After ten long years of engagement to Gilbert Norman, heir to a ducal house, Seara Elliot, daughter of a humble viscount, finally makes up her mind—it's time to call it off! Though her heart still belongs to Gilbert, his distant attitude toward her and the gentle smiles he offers to other women have convinced Seara that she's not the one he wants. If setting him free means his happiness, then so be it. Rather than cling to a hopeless love, Seara decides to let him go with grace. But to her astonishment, Gilbert refuses! Completely bewildered, Seara begins to question everything: his intentions, his feelings, and the truth behind his cold façade. Determined to secure his happiness one way or another, she sets out on a mission: to find and recommend the perfect bride to take her place... even if her heart hasn't quite caught up with the idea yet.

(Source: Crossed Hearts)

Robou is a corporate drone with an extraordinary passion for giant humanoid robots. One day, he's deeply hurt when a colleague bluntly states, "There's no need for giant humanoid robots." Later that evening, he's approached by a being from another world who pleads with him to "fight using a giant robot." After some hesitation, Robou chooses to reincarnate into this new world. There, he finds himself inhabiting Volcamion—a mighty humanoid mecha revered by the Volcami Empire. Thus begins Robou's second life as a god within a giant robot.

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)

As the illegitimate daughter of a count and his maid, Katrina was born into miserable circumstances. And now that she's lost her mother, the treatment from her stepsister and stepmother the countess has only grown worse. One day, her stepsister receives a royal order to move to the northern outskirts due to her unseemly behavior at a recent party. There, she is to learn proper conduct under the tutelage of the resident prince, rumored to be a cruel man. Not wanting to subject her daughter to such punishment, the countess decides to send Katrina instead. Katrina arrives in the north shaking in fear. But contrary to the stories, the "merciless and cold-hearted" prince is kinder than she believed. Might the pure-hearted Katrina find love in the wintry countryside?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Kyouka, an office lady, has fallen for her coworker Wataru. But there's a twist. He's haunted by the ghost of his ex-girlfriend, Madoka! Determined to clear the way for their romance, Kyouka tries to exorcise Madoka, who keeps interfering with their relationship, but...!?

A heartwarming love story about a love triangle with an ex-girlfriend.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

synopsis:
Takeru Narihira is a lone wolf delinquent who spends his days getting into fights, avoiding friendships, and being captivated by a mysterious girl named Tsukimiya—someone he's only ever seen in his dreams.

One day, a sudden accident sends him tumbling off a cliff. When he regains consciousness, he finds himself in Denji Heian-kyou, a futuristic version of the ancient capital, where advanced technology and mysticism coexist. This world is under the protection of the legendary onmyouji, Abe no Seimei—and to Takeru's shock, Tsukimiya is real and living in this very place.

Just as he begins to revel in this fated encounter, a deadly black mist known as Yamikaoru descends, bringing forth monstrous beings called Oni. In the chaos, both he and Tsukimiya are killed—only for Takeru to awaken once again in Denji Heian-kyou.

Urushi Chino joined a reference book publisher mid-career. There, she meets Fukuyama, a reference book nerd with a strong personality. His behavior is unbecoming of a member of society, but his knowledge of reference books is extraordinary! This is an uneven work comedy between a reference book geek and a subculture trend-hopping woman!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Nankai Trough Kyodai Jishin
synopsis:
At 15:07 on February 11, 2025, the "Nankai Trough Mega-Earthquake" occurs. At that time, the protagonist, Mei Saitou, who was at Nagoya Port, sees the city completely changed. As a major tsunami warning is issued, Mei tries to escape to safe high ground. However, next to her is an elderly person who is injured and unable to move... Will she abandon him or help him? She is forced to make the ultimate decision. And the fear of an "invisible tsunami" that will strike. An unprecedented disaster that will surely occur someday. What will happen when that happens? How can we survive? Based on thorough research, this is the "reality of an earthquake that will occur someday."

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Dekiai ga Tomaranai Kamoku na Kouhai ni Yoru Kaihatsu Keiryaku

synopsis:
In a world where demons prevail and humans are rare, the demon Oobami is renowned for his giant horns. But no one has ever seen them... In reality, they're the size of a pea! When his junior, Akaishi, picks up his supplement meant to grow his horns, Oobami thinks he's in trouble. But instead, Akaishi approaches him, saying, "They're not out yet, but giant horns are guaranteed. I can make them grow." Akaishi forcefully tries to feed him by sticking a finger in his mouth...!?

(Source: Libre, translated)

Yachiyo doesn't know why exactly Haguchi ended up living with her, but he's here now, making her tiring daily life a little bit brighter, one delicious meal at a time. Where does Haguchi come from, and is there anything his mysterious blobby self can't do?

(Source: Fantasista)

title: Makemasen kara to Iiharu Kao no Ii Onnanoko wo, Zenryoku de Kuppuku saseru Yuri no Ohanashi

synopsis:
Sara Kureha is the reigning "Super Onee-sama" of an elite ladies' academy, a position she's earned through nothing but relentless effort. Her status is suddenly challenged by Rui Mareshino, an effortlessly perfect beauty who proposes a secret contest to determine who is truly fit to get on top. With the school-wide popularity poll just two months away, they need a way to settle the score, just the two of them. Rui's method is... quite unexpected.

"So, that's why... you're going to be my girlfriend." 
"Huh...?"

The rules of their new relationship are simple: the first one to make the other completely submit proves she is worthy of ruling the school! And so begins a secret war of seduction, with each girl launching an all-out offensive to make the other fall for them first. In this heated battle, whose heart—and body—will be the first to surrender? And who will be the one to conquer them? Prepare to be dominated by this romantic comedy showdown between two pretty girls!

"Suck it nicely, you weakling!"

The one servicing that bastard's thing was my beloved girlfriend. There was nothing I could do before that scene...

After starting to play an erotic game recommended by a friend, Mitsuki falls head over heels in love with the game's main heroine, Kotoha. But this game is a NTR game in which the heroine is seduced by the player's best friend, Ryou?! While searching for a happy ending with Kotoha, Mitsuki accidentally falls onto the train platform. When he wakes up, he finds himself faced with none other than... Kotoha!? To his surprise, Mitsuki has been reincarnated as the player character of "that" game...!

With his vast knowledge and love of games, Mitsuki is determined to change fate this time. In order to protect Kotoha and the others from Ryou, Mitsuki must achieve a perfect happy ending!

(Source: viviON, translated)

title: Aliens

Ami, an office worker and extraterrestrial, ends up getting demoted to Earth for certain reasons. What's more, on the way to Earth, she gets into an accident?...

(Source: Hero's, translated)

title: Douki no Dokusenyoku wo Aotteshimatta you desu
title_japanese: 同期の独占欲を煽ってしまったようです
synopsis:
Kana's in love with her friend Takumi. They've known each other forever, and they're even coworkers now. Of course, he has no idea. Why would he? He's hot and competent, so he's got plenty of women to choose from. She, on the other hand, wears glasses, has a baby face, and has absolutely no experience with men. Desperate, she forms a plan with another colleague to ask Takumi to pop her cherry for her on the pretense that this is all to get with another guy. At first, he tries to dissuade her but soon realizes how adamant she is. And, as much as he thinks this is a bad idea, he can't stand the thought of her doing it with some other dude!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Girl Friend
synopsis:
Taeu and Jieun are friends—just friends. Both of them were comfortable with this arrangement, with neither holding any romantic feelings for the other. However, when Jieun returns from summer break looking noticeably different, Taeu's feelings for his friend begin to change, and new feelings of jealousy and confusion taking their place. When Jieun develops a crush on a handsome classmate, things start to get even more complicated between the two of them as Taeu begins to try to beat out his new competitor and take his longtime friendship with Jieun to the next level.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Narikin Shouka Monogatari: Tsundere Ojisan wa Bijin na Toshishita Josei wo Iyaiya Metoru

synopsis:
On the day Aria, the daughter of the Marquess, turned eight years old, she regained her memories of being Saintess Esta, one of the Four Saints who defeated the Demon King 1,000 years ago. Aria is thankful to God and happy for her new life, that is until she realizes that for some reason she was born with the ring of her comrade-in-arms in her previous life, Prince William...

(Source: Kill Time Communication, translated)

title: The S-Rank Spiritualist's Taming Journal
synopsis:
In a world of hunters, monsters, and dungeons, Ina is just an ordinary Korean woman—and she wouldn't have it any other way. Ina was a spiritualist in her previous life, but now she can finally enjoy a peaceful world... or so she thought. One day, after touching a mysterious egg found in a dungeon, Ina reawakens her S-rank spiritualist ability! With her new spirit companions, a couple of troublemakers named Iz and Rika, will Ina ever fulfill her dream of living a quiet life?

(Source: Tapas Media)

After collapsing from overwork, Hinata can only retain memories for a minute. Her younger sister Shizuru struggles alone to support her, but the unimaginable hardship takes its toll both mentally and physically. As she approaches her limit, even the sisters' bond begins to waver...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

synopsis:
Hong Shiho is a 20-year-old senior in high school who shook things up the day he transferred. With a complicated past and a lively personality, Hongshi welcomes everyone, but still finds it a bit difficult to treat them all equally. What color will each day be for Hongshi and his circle of friends?!

(Source: Jaedam Books, translated)

title: My Contract Husband Looks Like the Male Lead
title_english: My Contract Husband Looks Like the Male Lead
synopsis:
At the age of 8, Anya Lockhart realizes she's been born into a tragic dark romance novel she read in her past life. And unfortunately, she's the female lead destined to fall into the crazy emperor's clutches! So when his proposal arrives, she packs up and runs away from home. After years on the run, she meets Dale, a sweet mercenary living in a remote southern village. But is there more to Dale than meets the eye? The more she learns, the more he doesn't seem like an ordinary mercenary...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Glass Heart
synopsis:
Akane Saijou, a drummer who was ousted from her previous band just before her debut, is unexpectedly chosen by Naoki Fujitani, a reclusive and brilliant musician, to join his new band, TENBLANK. Together with band members Shou Takaoka and Kazushi Sakamoto, the band gains fame through Fujitani's distinctive compositions and their electrifying performances. As TENBLANK rises to stardom, they face numerous challenges, and Akane's journey from obscurity to stardom unfolds as Fujitani's secrets emerge. Will the band withstand the storm, and where will Akane's heart lead her?

(Source: Netflix)

title_japanese: 妃殿下の微笑 身代わり花嫁は、引きこもり殿下と幸せに暮らしたい
synopsis:
Is it wrong to seek the happiness someone else denied you?

Sara, a royal maid in the Kingdom of Saleilles, is ordered by the king to enter a political marriage with the eldest prince of their rival kingdom, Ferrier—but as the body-double of the real princess! But then Sara's boyfriend cheats on her with the princess she considered a friend and turns on Sara completely! Utterly betrayed by those she trusted most, Sara hits rock bottom, heart shattered...

Farewell, Princess I used to love and respect. Farewell, my once-beloved boyfriend.

So Sara makes a decision—she will find happiness in Ferrier no matter what! But that all hinges on her husband-to-be...a reclusive, misanthropic prince who has a slightly difficult personality and is constantly wearing a mask. To make matters worse, rumors are spreading in Ferrier of a terrifying black beast on the prowl...

Can Sara ever hope to find happiness in these conditions?!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

title: Gunshin to Itsuwari no Hanayome
title_english: The War Lord and His Fake Bride
synopsis:
"I've come to get my wife." On the day of the wedding, the groom, Koumei Oh, showed up soaked in blood. The bride, Meirin, couldn't hide her horror at the sight. The Oh family, a military family, has been cursed to die by the age of 30 due to their violent acts in battle. In this age, doctors have lost their position in society and the Xian have been entrusted to save people. The emperor, hearing rumors that "those who make a vow with a Xian and produce descendants shall never perish," arranged for Koumei to marry Meirin, a Xian. However, Meirin doesn't actually possess the powers of the Xian and is marrying Koumei in place of her older sister, Shenrin. Meirin fears she may be killed if this lie is discovered, but Koumei turns out to be different from the rumors, and Meirin begins to fall in love...

(Source: Amutus)

title: Hanayome Shugyou wo Yametakute, Reitetsu Koushaku no 13-banme no Konyakusha ni Narimasu
title_japanese: 花嫁修業をやめたくて、冷徹公爵の13番目の婚約者になります
synopsis:
Ilaria, the daughter of a fallen nobleman, is forced to undergo rigorous training to marry a man of high status in order to restore her family's fortunes. At a ball where she is looking to meet someone, Elliot, who is rumored to be a "cold-hearted duke" who has broken off 12 engagements, suddenly asks her to marry him, and they end up living together in a mansion...? A duke with a history and a down-on-her-luck noble daughter with a good heart!

(Source: COMICSMART, translated)

title: Seishun Gestalt Houkai
title_japanese: 青春ゲシュタルト崩壊
synopsis:
Asaha Mamiya, a second-year high school student, develops adolescent face loss syndrome, but fears that others will find out about her condition and worries about it alone. The only person who notices her change is her classmate Hijiri Asahina, who is watched by teachers for his flashy appearance and violent attitude. Asaha is pushed around by Hijiri, but little by little she begins to look at herself in a new light. Meanwhile, as Hijiri spends time with her, he also begins to face "something" that has been bothering him for a long time.

(Source: MyDramaList)

title: Ano Ko to Futari de.
synopsis:
The same part-time job, the same surname, the same family environment - other than that, Yuna Satou and Ema Satou have absolutely nothing in common. But thanks to a strange twist of fate they end up sharing an apartment... Sometimes they fight, but maybe it's because they're total opposites that they can be together. A new-generation of girls story about young women who live flexibly and resiliently!

(Source: Home-sha, translated)

title: Sayonara, Ano Hi no Fukujuu
title_japanese: さよなら、あの日の服従
synopsis:
Kashiwagi, who is dating a yakuza in a gray area, is invited by Tatsumi, an office executive, to a drag bar. Kashiwagi is reluctant to go, but he is curious about Tatsumi's favorite girl, Mei. After the bar closes, Kashiwagi ambushes Mei. There, he meets Koikawa, whom Kashiwagi bullied in high school...

(Source: Leed-sha, translated)

title: Saioshi no Gikei wo Mederu Tame, Nagaiki shimasu!

There, he meets Orsis, who was his favorite person in a previous life. While this coincidence seems to good to be true, he remembers that he is why his beloved lost his smile, and begins to search for a way to live a long life so that he continue to love him.

(Source: MU, edited)

To cover her father's hospital bills, Jiwan agrees to become Taeseong's legal wife for three years; a marriage of convenience with one condition, one billion won once the contract ends. Bound by strict terms, the contract prohibits any contact throughout their marriage. Three years pass, and two weeks before the contract expires—Taeseong suddenly shows up at her door convinced that Jiwan is the love of his life. Now, with her payout on the line and Taeseong clinging to a love that never existed, will Jiwan still be able to walk away with the life she planned?

The viscount's daughter, Chloe, was the chief magical tools artisan for a country that perished a thousand years ago in her previous life. On the country's orders, she had created many weapons of slaughter. She laments her previous life and decides to, "live a respectable life this time." One day, at her graduation party, her best friend's engagement is broken off because of a lie. Chloe tries to save her best friend by unraveling the truth.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
