title: The Runaway Extra and the Obsessive Duke

synopsis:
In this world, a duke's full power can only be unlocked by uniting with his "phero," his destined mate. So, to undermine his rival, Krua's father sends her to Duke Arzenta disguised as his phero, hoping she'll take his innocence and his power with it. But Krua has no intention of playing along! If she can just convince her fiancé to join hands with her and keep up the enamored newlyweds act until his real phero appears, she'll be able to flee safely when the time comes... But will he let her go?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Unbreakable Mind of the Regret-Genre Heroine
synopsis:
It turns out I was the female lead of a regret novel. And right now is apparently the period when the male lead and my family from the regret novel are accumulating bad karma! Wow, did they really torment me this much? That's harsh. But it's fine. In my past life, I had over 10 years of experience working in various service jobs, so I can handle pretty much any difficult person with a soulless attitude!

"Giselle, I can't tolerate your insolent words and behavior. I told you to be quiet."

"Ah, really. Okay."

"What?"

"Just like Madam Mariposa said, I'm filthy, so I'll just wrap myself in a trash bag and go bury myself underground right now. What's the point of someone like me living anyway?" I just decided to cut ties with the family that tormented me and become stronger than the male leads—

"Giselle Florette. I would like you to become my wife publicly." The villain, Duke Kalinos, proposed I act as his wife? "The compensation is 5 billion gold per year."

"I will serve you well."

From the library to the lecture halls, these tantilising tales are being whispered behind every closed dorm door. Want to find out what really goes down on campus?

synopsis:
Jo Jiwon is just your average college kid—well, except for the part where he scams people by pretending to be a shaman. Thanks to his silver tongue and some lucky guesses, he gains a reputation as a spiritual powerhouse.

Unfortunately, word gets around... all the way to Jeong Tae-oh, a superstitious mob boss who actually believes in that stuff. When Tae-oh shows up demanding help, Jiwon pretends to take the job—then immediately tries to run. Too bad he gets caught.

He wakes up in a sketchy motel, staring death in the face. Thinking fast, Jiwon blurts out: "Y-you need me as a talisman! To stay alive, we have to... sleep together!"

He's sure a tough guy like Tae-oh would bolt at the thought.

Instead, Tae-oh just shrugs. "You should've said so earlier. Is once enough or do we need more?"

Graciela freezes the duke's assets, breaks off her engagement, buys the name of an aristocratic mother and son, and pretends her younger brother is her son... A heartwarming (?) "mom-com" with four moms begins!

"Here, it's yours." With only a key and car left behind by his vanished father, Ikuto—now grown up and licensed to drive—defies his mother's attempts to get rid of the vehicle. He moves his belongings into the car and begins living there, but after a decisive argument one day, he runs away from home. Pressing the pedal to its limit as he races through mountain roads, that's when...!?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

When he does, they capture him and decide to give him to the Demon God as a sacrifice. Exhausted from the villagers' hate, a burning desire to annihilate the village that cast him out began to grow. Yukio strikes a bargain with the Demon God: his own flesh in exchange for their destruction. But as he offers himself up to be consumed, Yukio finds himself engulfed in sensations of warmth and affection he never thought possible. As the Demon God's touch and words envelop him, Yukio's world spins into a dizzying blur of ecstasy and longing... Something he had never experienced before...!!

It has been agreed that Lynette will marry Alfred―a man who is rumored to be a playboy and wants a young lady who can manipulate men―in place of her sister, who ran off with the dowry. In order not to be kicked out, she tries to act like the vixen Alfred wants, but he isn't reacting the way Lynette hoped?! As it turns out, Alfred is not actually a playboy, but a pure-hearted novice in love. However, he decides to pretend to be a playboy to figure out the true intentions of Lynette, who was sent by the queen, his archenemy!

(Source: Kodansha)

However, there is a deep reason behind his frosty behavior...

With the dowry already spent, it's decided that Marie will take her sister's place and become the Earl's betrothed. Can Marie win the heart of the handsome Earl, or is she destined to live a life without a single nice thing?

synopsis:
Lilith served the young master of the Gratton family as his maid. She secretly had feelings for him, but after he suddenly got married, his newlywed wife announced that she was fired!! Lilith was sunk in despair, but she found herself getting hired by Dunkirk—the strongest soldier who's good-looking and a womanizer—to be his maid and fake fiancée for six months. Despite that, he treated her tenderly from the bottom of his heart!? On top of that, the power that Lilith held had a secret to it... This is the world's strongest doting love story that begins from heartbreak!

Titianne was dumped by her ex-fiancé because she was a knight. But then, the Duke whom she admired proposed to her! However, on the day of her wedding, she hears that the Duke has a lover...

"I'll be happy with a nice man too!"

While Titianne, who vowed to escape from her own wedding, makes plans to find true love elsewhere, the Duke doesn't seem to want to give up on marrying her, saying, "I won't allow other men to lay a finger on her."

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Isekai Maid ga Yattekita: Ihoujin Datta Koro no Maid ga Gendai no Wagaya de Ecchi na Maid-san ni

Takahiro was suddenly summoned to another world to be a hero. However, the special ability he was granted was "Steal"—a skill to pilfer things from others. The king who summoned him was disgusted by such a lowly ability, dismissing it as shameful and casting Takahiro out into the streets with no money. Takahiro had no choice but to make a living as an adventurer. Unfortunately, the monsters in this new world were far more powerful than he anticipated, and his "Steal" skill proved utterly useless against them. Realizing he needed help, Takahiro decided his best option was to buy a strong slave to form an adventurer's party. He immediately went to a slave trader, where he experienced a fateful encounter with an Oni girl.

Kazuho and Tokio have been best friends since elementary school. As the years went on, Kazuho realized his feelings for Tokio were more than just friends, and he began pulling away from Tokio, desperate to keep his feelings a secret. While once close enough to give each other piggyback rides, the two boys, now high school students, pass each other in the hallway as the distance grows between them. But when Kazuho can't keep his feelings hidden from Tokio any longer, will the two friends only continue to drift apart, or will it be the start to them experiencing the feelings of first love together?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Ao to Kagerou
synopsis:
Makoto's favorite childhood memories are of playing baseball with his best friend and former teammate Shuusuke, the catcher of his baseball team. When Shuusuke suddenly moves away, Makoto is left devastated, but clings to the promise of the two of them someday reuniting at Koshien Stadium. Now in high school, Makoto is the star pitcher of his high school's baseball team, and he and Hokuto, the team's catcher, are an all-star duo. But one day, Shuusuke suddenly transfers to Makoto's school, and now baseball isn't the only thing on the boys' minds under the scorching heat of the baseball diamond...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

After a brutal breakup, Yubyeol flies to Spain alone where one wild, blurry night with a stranger named Seonu changes everything. Back in Korea, fate brings them together again... but this time, they only have 90 days before Seonu must return to Spain. Between unresolved heartbreak, unexpected chemistry, and a deadline she never asked for, can Seonu find his ticket into Yubyeol's heart before the final boarding call?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Ice Lord
synopsis:
At the young age of twenty, Seol Mudok, a master swordsman, became the Lord of the Northern Sea Ice Palace. Plunged into despair after the death of his lover, he discovers that with the legendary flower, the "Lotus of Love," that his deceased lover has been reincarnated. In his quest, he descends into another world...

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Prefect no Okibi
synopsis:
Kuze is a first-year student at a boarding school attended by the sons of wealthy Japanese families. One day, the serious and good-natured athlete is suddenly nominated to become a Prefect. The nominator is Hanabishi, Royston Academy's biggest playboy. He is one of the richest, smartest, and most talented Prefects in the academy. Why did the student representative's right-hand man nominate him of all people...!? Kuze wasn't a fan of Hanabishi's, but the more he gets to see and know Hanabishi, the more attracted he becomes. The start of a dramatic love story where the underclassman takes the lead at a school with its own rules and hierarchy!!

(Source: Brite Publishing)

title: Shinya 0-ji no Ikenai Himitsu
title_japanese: 深夜0時のイけない秘密

title: Second Play Virgin
title_japanese: セカンドプレイヴァージン

title: SAN-chi Chokusou! Yami Baito
synopsis:
One day, Akari Kurono, a very poor high school girl surviving on plain pasta and tap water, applies for a high-paying part-time job at a dubious occult store. Together with the mysterious store manager, Amenpine, and his occult-loving co-worker, Koyo Meiji, they are determined to capture the "Dark Nui," horrifying entities that threaten the human world!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Nekotan! Nekomachi Kaii Kitan
title_japanese: ネコたん!～猫町怪異奇譚～

title: Futei no Olympia
synopsis:
A dull, unreliable middle-aged salaryman, Tamaki Kuroudo, is treated as a hopeless old man by everyone. Teased about his pot belly, treated coldly by his daughter at home, and when he happens to glance at his wife’s phone, he sees suspicious call logs with one of her coworkers. As he spends his pathetic days, his capable subordinate Ayase Mizuki invites him to the equipment room. While helping her move some equipment, he accidentally touches her breast and she records that very moment on video. After work, he’s blackmailed with the video and taken to, of all places, a sports gym? The price of sexual harassment is body transformation? A secret muscle-training comedy he hides from his wife!

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Sanshoku Bentou
synopsis:
Narumi, a single businessman who has lived alone for 10 years, ends up living with two cousins who lost their mother. After learning that they usually order food delivery, Narumi decides to cook for them. The food Narumi makes is something he learned from his cousins' late mother, and it reminds them of their mother.

"Will you teach me how to cook?"

A mother's cooking connects hearts. A heartwarming story of cooking and family.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Meshitero-kei Gradol wa Gaman Dekinai!?
title_japanese: 飯テロ系グラドルは我慢できない!?
synopsis:
Eiko, Shizuka, and Mitsuki are a trio of gravure idols. Their popularity is booming, but there are rumors on the Internet such as "Have you gained weight recently?" Shizuka has even been suspected of being pregnant. In fact, the girls' weight has been rising steadily. The president of the office, while stating that "eating well is not a bad thing," told the girls that if they could not manage their health, they should quit the gradol business, and if they could not lose weight until Christmas time, they would be fired. The three, all of whom love good food, join forces to face the challenges of dieting.

(Source: MU)

title: Ore dake wa Matomo-kun: Chuugakusei-hen
title_japanese: オレだけはマトモくん 中学生編

title: John Titor no Koiuranai
title_japanese: ジョンタイターの恋占い
synopsis:
John Titor was the supposed time traveler who made headlines in 2000 with his various predictions about the future. A fortune-telling program he allegedly coded has become wildly popular. Despite finding it all rather sketchy, Raraka Akio, a girl harboring an unrequited crush on Tsubasa Amanogawa, decides to give the fortune-telling machine a go. But when the name of her destined partner appears...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Aa, Tanuki wa Mou Dame desu
title_japanese: 嗚呼、たぬきはもうだめです

title: Otouto no Omokage
synopsis:
It's the 10th year of the Taishou era. At a health exhibition, a mysterious friendship blooms between Akihiko, a boy who dreams of becoming a military doctor, and Hisao, who has a metal prosthetic arm. But each time Akihiko meets him, Hisao continues to waste away, and his prosthetic limbs proliferate...

A retro Sci-Fi drama overflowing with darkness and beauty that questions humanity and its agency!

(Source: Kodansha)

title: The Apocalypse-Level Death Knight Returns
synopsis:
Everyone's talking about how troublemaker Demian Haxen's suddenly become a devoted son and brother. What they don't realize is that he's returned to the past after spending decades as the brainwashed death knight of Dorgo, the archlich who murdered Demian's family. Given a second chance at life, Demian's out to power up and protect his family to defeat Dorgo when he comes to conquer the world. But will Demian alone be enough to prevent the apocalypse? Or will his failure mean death for them all?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Shuudengo wa Amai Kiss shite
title_english: A Sweet Kiss After the Last Train
title_japanese: 終電後は甘いキスして
synopsis:
In her fourth year as a working adult, Saeka is seen as dependable and responsible—someone everyone in the office relies on. She can't even let her guard down around her younger boyfriend, and her only outlet for stress is smoking cigarettes secretly. Then suddenly, her former boss—who knows all about the mistakes she made when she was just starting out—gets transferred from Kansai!? He's the one person she absolutely doesn't want to show weakness to, but before she knows it, she finds herself constantly being drawn to him in this bittersweet, heartwarming love story!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: A Cadet Becomes a Prophet?!
synopsis:
Fernan Fallenberg is the young heir of House Fallenberg, one of the Empire's most prestigious houses, and a top student at the Imperial Academy. However, he's infamous for something else: his obsession with money. As a ruthless money-hound, he only acknowledges those who bring him profit and views everything in the world through the lens of monetary value. People avoid him, finding his greed repulsive. But was divine punishment finally upon him? One day, out of nowhere, disaster strikes Fernan like a bolt from the blue. As his consciousness begins to fade, something attempts to invade and take over his mind, but Fernan forcefully expels it instead. From that moment on, he begins to see something strange: a prophetic book that reveals the future. And not just any future, but a prophecy of the end of the world.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Return of the Demonic Instructor
synopsis:
The Central Plains fell to the invasion of the Demon Realm. A martial artist, Sa Bigang, was ultimately dragged into that infernal world. After surviving the brink of death and enduring hell itself, he awakens ten years before the invasion ever began. And now, Sa Bigang sets out to stop the Demon Realm's return. To do that, he must restore order to the murim and build the ultimate force: the Undefeatable Corps. As the man who will rewrite the past and safeguard the future... This time, he will never lose.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Kaisha de Majime na Shizuno-san wa Ie de Otoko wo Katteru Rashii
title_japanese: 会社で真面目な静野さんは家で男を飼ってるらしい

title: Q.E.D. Univ.: Shoumei Shuuryou
synopsis:
A new series of the mystery manga masterpiece Q.E.D.: Shoumei Shuuryou has begun!

Kana Mizuhara is a freshman at Harvard University, and Sou Touma is a researcher at Massachusetts Institute of Technology. They work together to tackle difficult cases in America.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Ani no Kage
synopsis:
One morning, a boy wakes up to find a ghost that looks exactly like him?! Who or what is this mysterious spirit? Why has it appeared here and now...?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Otto ni Korosareta Hazu nanoni, Nidome no Jinsei ga Hajimarimashita
title_japanese: 夫に殺されたはずなのに、二度目の人生がはじまりました

title: Botsuraku Reijou desu ga, Kono Tabi Tsundere Kishi-sama no Koibitoyaku ni Narimashita
title_english: I'm a Fallen Heiress, but Now I'm the Hot and Cold Knight's Fake Girlfriend!
title_japanese: 没落令嬢ですが、この度ツンデレ騎士様の恋人役になりました
synopsis:
"Who would ever worry about you?!" Rimmel used to be a noble, but after her family lost everything, she now lives as a commoner and works at a bar. Her childhood friend Hewitt, the heir to the Count Stan family, often visits, but only to make sarcastic comments. Ever since Hewitt declared he wanted to become a knight at age twelve, they've grown apart. Rimmel thinks Hewitt is coming to the bar just to see Heather, the baron's daughter who helps run the bar and is popular with the customers. One day, Rimel spots the swindler who ruined her family's life.She asks Hewitt for help, but the man escapes. Later, the knights ask Rimmel to help with their investigation, by pretending to be Hewitt's lover to lure the criminal out. Now, caught up in something much bigger than she expected, Rimmel must face the past she tried to leave behind.

(Source: Shusuisha)

title: Seiso Seijitsu ni Ikiteitara Konyakusha ni Uragirareta node, Yarinaoshi no Sekai dewa Akuyaku Reijou toshite Ikimasu
title_english: I Lived an Honest Life Only to Have My Fiancé Betray Me, So in My New Life I'll Live as the Villainess
title_japanese: 清楚誠実に生きていたら婚約者に裏切られたので、やり直しの世界では悪役令嬢として生きます
synopsis:
"There's no such thing as sincere love..." Mianna Caroline was raised strictly as a light mage user from a young age. After her mother passed away, her father remarried and adored her stepsister, ignoring Mianna. Then, to make matters worse, her fiance broke off their engagement, saying he wanted to marry her stepsister instead. Mianna always believed that living honestly would be rewarded, but this betrayal makes her fall into using "dark magic" that humans aren't supposed to have access to. But in the next moment, she wakes up to find herself returned to the day she was born! Then, God tells her, "I'll give you a second chance." With a fresh start, Miana's journey to find love and heal her heart begins again...

(Source: Shusuisha)

title: Rou no Naka de Mezameta Akuyaku Reijou wa Shinitakunai: Shokei wo Kaihi shitara, Matteita no wa Dekiai deshita
title_japanese: 牢の中で目覚めた悪役令嬢は死にたくない～処刑を回避したら、待っていたのは溺愛でした～
synopsis:
One day, Riri Amano, who is living in debt left behind by her parents, suddenly finds herself as the "villainess" of another world. When she wakes up, a handsome knight is taking care of her...? After a fateful encounter in prison, she finds out the truth about her special skills and with her positive attitude, she gets involved in the world around her. And what is the inevitable happy ending...!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Tada no Tomodachi ja Nakunaru Shunkan
title_english: The Moment When We Are No Longer Just Friends.
title_japanese: ただの友達じゃなくなる瞬間
synopsis:
Hajime has a secret crush on his classmate Kazuma. But Kazuma has a girlfriend! He can't say anything if they are just friends. In that case... Hajime reveals his feelings to Kazuma, and Kazuma tells him, "We can't go back to being just friends now."

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Zutazuta no Ude ni Kiss
synopsis:
One day, Hitomi, a college student with a communication disorder, falls in love at first sight with Chigasaki, a beautiful younger man who is just his taste, who is visiting the university. However, he is unable to find the courage to speak to him, and when their eyes meet, Chigasaki is scared of him, and he ends up heartbroken. Two years later, however, he is unable to give up on his feelings and sneaks into the welcome party for new students at the club to which Chigasaki belongs. Hitomi is a bit of a floater, but when a drunken Chigasaki bites him on his arm with scars...! A fetish-erotic love story between a S-ish baby-faced hottie and a single-minded minefield man is born!

(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)

title: The Villain Profiler
synopsis:
Lee Shinyeok lost his mother to a murderer and had an accident. After stacking up knowledge in a mysterious space where he could learn and study for 15 years, he wakes up from a coma. This is the story of a genius who uses his 15 years of knowledge and skills to unravel the injustices of the dead, and of those who are a dangerous threat to people in becoming a profiler; the pinnacle of a profiler.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Warrior of the Mind Sword
synopsis:
Those who can draw a Mind Sword are called "Warriors." Ellon sets off on a journey to become one, but the warriors he dreamed of turn out to be nothing more than brutal killing machines. Will Ellon overcome this harsh reality and become a true warrior?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Alaze, the trainer who was deemed useless and cast out from the hero party, returned to his hometown to heal his broken heart and live a peaceful life. However, one day, a girl appeared before him, asking, "Please, train me!"

title: Like Wind on a Dry Branch
title_english: Like Wind on a Dry Branch
synopsis:
In a land of magical spirits and northern lights, two wounded souls find rest and healing in each other.

Rieta Tristi has known nothing but hardship: her husband died of the plague, her young daughter was stolen away by slave traders, and now the cruel Lord Casarius, who had long coveted Rieta as a mistress, has ordered on his deathbed that she be buried alive with him. Her heart already shattered by grief, Rieta has little will to resist her grim fate—until the womanizing tyrant of the north, Archduke Killian Axias, suddenly appears and whisks her away. To Rieta's surprise, the cold and ruthless archduke turns out to be not only sympathetic, but deeply thoughtful and caring. As the leaves change and temperatures drop, Rieta warms up to her unexpected savior, who has been grieving a loss of his own.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: My In-Laws Are Obsessed with Me
title_english: My In-Laws Are Obsessed with Me
synopsis:
When Pereshati Zahardt's father passes away, he leaves his entire fortune to her. Outraged and consumed with greed, her evil stepmother and stepsister conspire with Pereshati's lover to murder her and steal her inheritance. Mysteriously, Pereshati comes back to life and travels back in time before her death. To protect herself while plotting her revenge, Pereshati enters into an unlikely marriage with Therdeo Lapileon, a handsome grand duke and the head of the extremely powerful and notorious Lapileon family. But not long into their union, Pereshati discovers that the Lapileons are hiding a terrifying family secret. Now she must keep her guard up on all sides as she walks on thin ice between the Lapileon family and her own—while also ensuring her thirst for revenge will not go unquenched.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Warm Black Tea
synopsis:
An eighteen-year-old girl named Noori is to dress up as a boy and go to a boys' high school at the request of Mrs. Hong, for whom her grandmother worked as a house caretaker. Her striking resemblance to Mrs. Hong's son made her the perfect substitute to attend the school in his stead while he recuperated from a motorcycle accident.

However, it doesn't take long for her identity to be discovered by Seokyung, a boy in her class. Surprisingly, though, Seokyung promises Noori to keep her secret and stay friends with her.

Will Noori be able to accomplish her task? How will their friendship unfold?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Uchi no Mei Shimai ga Yuuwaku shitekuru.
title_japanese: うちの姪姉妹が誘惑してくる。
synopsis:
Shiori and Mio's parents are away on a two-year business trip, so it's a good thing they've got their uncle around to watch the house! He's watching more than just the wallpaper, though. Sharing a home with two attractive girls means his eyes tend to wander, though of course he keeps his hands (and thoughts) to himself... that is, until Mio lets slip that her older sister Shiori is actually in love with her uncle! With the cat out of the bag, Shiori pushes her relationship with her uncle as far as it can go—and for his drop-dead gorgeous niece, he's willing to let her take things all the way! With all that fun happening under the one roof, it's not long until Mio decides she wants to join in too...

(Source: J18 Publishing)

This brothel for keeping your own demihuman maids is a well-kept secret... so it's a lucky thing that you're in the know, and even luckier you have four of them to yourself.

synopsis:
Heewon Jang wanted to be a perfect teacher and set a moral example, both in the classroom and in life. But due to a  deviant one-night stand, she finds herself pregnant. To make matters worse, the baby's father is none other than Doojoon Kang, the uncle of a student and the chairman of her school board. Of course, he wanted to take responsibility but her reputation is at stake. In a romance that's not in the typical order, how will their story unfold?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Shinya 0-ji no Shisho Minarai
synopsis:
An Mihara, a high school student, is staying with a host family during her summer vacation at a private library, known as the "Book House," located in the suburbs of Sapporo. Breaking the rules announced to her by the unfriendly library owner, Seiji, An wanders into the library in the middle of the night. There, she finds herself in a desolate underworld, a "library labyrinth" where "phantoms of stories" wander about! Anne is assigned as the librarian of the labyrinth and is ordered to "restore the labyrinth by having as many people as possible read the books in the library."

In an old house surrounded by beautiful nature, the "story" of a girl with no self-confidence begins to change color.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kami ni Koi nado Hayasugiru
synopsis:
Asa, a goddess of love, has a mission: to make humans fall in love. While searching for one more suitable pair to meet her quota, she comes across a handsome boy. Nevertheless, the "arrow of destiny" she shoots is ineffective...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Tensei shita Watashi wa Osanai Onna Hakushaku: Koukennin no Koushaku ni Ezuke shinagara, Ryouchi Hatten no Tame ni Bannou Mahou de Iroiro Tsukuru Tsumori desu
title_japanese: 転生した私は幼い女伯爵 後見人の公爵に餌付けしながら、領地発展のために万能魔法で色々作るつもりです

title: Imaginator!
synopsis:
Hinata, a Heisei gal, dies from an incurable illness. When she is reincarnated, it is into a fantasy world where imagination literally becomes magic—known as imagical. While renowned imaginaters (magical artists) are being reborn into this world, Hinata is just an ordinary girl who loves handicrafts... Deemed useless and unfit for the task of protecting people from monsters, she's cast aside. Even so, with her trademark positive attitude, Hinata decides to go out into town to buy some cute clothes, only to find that not a single stylish outfit exists! This is a world with zero interest in "art" or fashion! However, a chance encounter between this outrageous gal and a cynical artist sets the stage for a bold new stroke of color across the world... A remake fantasy where a wild gal and jaded artists transform a world with zero imagination!

(Source: TO Books, translated)

title: Room Tours
synopsis:
Ataru Nakahara, a university student struggling with job hunting, ends up working for spatial designer Natsuko Takaishi through an unexpected turn of events. Together with his new boss Natsuko, a stoic and creative first-class architect who has worked for a major company, Nakahara will plunge into days of trial and error in order to fulfill the wishes of eccentric clients. A work-related buddy manga full of ideas for interior design and renovation lovers!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Koyoi mo Ore wa Joshikousei to Zassou (Bansan) wo Sagasu
title_japanese: 今宵も俺は女子高生と雑草（晩餐）を探す

title: Senchi kara Kaettekita Takashi-kun. Futsuu ni Koukou Seikatsu wo Okuritai
title_japanese: 戦地から帰ってきたタカシ君。普通に高校生活を送りたい
synopsis:
The hero who saved the world from an alien invasion war, Takashi Shibusaki. This legendary warrior has one dream: To live a normal high school life. After the war ended, he was excited that this wish would be realized, and he immediately decided to return and live a quiet life in Japan. However, his comrade-in-arms from Northern Europe, Natalie, somehow ends up moving into Takashi’s house, claiming that they're going to live together...?

Everything is for a peaceful youth. Takashi, the most powerful warrior who wants to avoid love and fighting, will he be able to obtain the peace he wants?

(Source: Shufu to Seikatsu Sha, translated)

title: In the Shadow of the Spring
title_english: In the Shadow of the Spring
synopsis:
Twenty-three-year-old Chahui Yun is already tired of life: tired of Cheongna, her rural hometown where nothing seems to change; tired of her family's failing apple orchard; and tired of running away from Wookyeong Park, her childhood friend and first love. Although Chahui and Wookyeong grew up together, their lives couldn't be more different—Chahui's family has constantly been down on their luck and struggling to get by, while Wookyeong's family breezes through life as the wealthiest people in town. 

When Chahui returns home to nurse her ailing mother and help her unreliable father tend to the family farm, she has no choice but to face her past—and her past love with Wookyeong—that she's been trying so hard to forget.

synopsis:
Yuto Dryg, a young man working as an odd-jobs handler for the advanced guild "Black Thunder," is blamed for the failure of a mission from a nobleman and gets fired from the guild. All that's left in Yuto's possession is a weak magical beast Rock Lizard egg that the Guild Master forced on him, saying, "This is your severance pay"... However, what hatched from that egg wasn't a Rock Lizard, but a legendary Dragon!? A buddy fantasy where a good-natured young man and the strongest baby dragon rise to the top!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title: Saikyou Itan no Shokubutsutsukai
synopsis:
When the protagonist Left reincarnated into another world, the gift he received was a "Plant Encyclopedia"—an ability that could only summon weeds. However, this blessing concealed a true power...!? A tale of becoming the strongest plant user by wielding a unique gift!

(Source: Bushiroad Works, translated)

title: The Turn-Based Mage
synopsis:
After easily beating the Abyss of the Maze on its highest difficulty, Kaleb faces a new challenge...surviving his favorite video game for real! Even as a powerful mage, Kaleb learns things won't be as easy as foes pretend to be friends, allies need rescuing, and danger is always a turn away. Armed with an insider's knowledge and a magic hourglass that allows him to plan devastating attacks, Kaleb must save his friends and prepare for a battle with the Maze Master if he ever wants to get home!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Overpowered Support
synopsis:
Kim Ho, an avid enjoyer of the RPG "Dragon Slayer Academy", is the single most powerful support in the game. After spending countless hours, he eventually manages to reach the major milestone of raising 1,000 heroes to S-rank and is presented with a hidden quest. Tempted by the possibility of raising his S-rank heroes to the more powerful EX-rank, he accepts the quest without a second thought, only to find himself trapped inside the game world...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Indomitable Wanderer
synopsis:
I am a wanderer martial artist. I don't shy away from blood, but I'm ready to retire. Should I take one last job? Or not? For many long years, he has roamed as a wandering martial artist, living as a hired blade to make ends meet. But now, he finds himself utterly penniless, living in poverty with nothing to his name. As a master of martial arts at the peak level, he makes a decision, to take on one final, high-stakes mission, earn a fortune, and put an end to his life as a wanderer. The story follows his journey as he takes on this last assignment and the unexpected twists that unfold along the way.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Kawaii Watashi no Anata
title_japanese: かわいいわたしのあなた
synopsis:
Itsuki lost his grandmother, his only immediate relative, when he was a baby. For the 23 years since then, he has been living in a dilapidated apartment with Mizuki, who is 16 years his senior. Itsuki has been suppressing his unrequited love for Mizuki since his childhood, thinking this parent-and-child relationship would continue forever. However, the apartment complex will be demolished soon, and the danger of their cohabitation coming to an end is looming...

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Ao ni Tokeru Jellyfish
title_japanese: 碧にとけるジェリーフィッシュ

title: Dungeon Gakuen no Teihen ni Tensei shita kedo, Nazeka Ore ni wa Kouryakubon ga Aru

synopsis:
"Takashi Takasugi is the lowest-ranked student in his class, plagued by bad luck. He clashes with the protagonist, leaves the academy, and is rumored to have died—a truly unfortunate character."

That's how the game's strategy guide described him... and now, the protagonist finds himself reincarnated as this bottom-tier nobody!

Drowning in despair, he searches his classroom desk—only to discover the very strategy guide he bought in his previous life. "If I use this, I can become the strongest!?" Determined to escape his tragic fate, Takasugi sets off to secretly grind his skills in dungeons... but hardship awaits at every turn. However, when he starts traveling alongside the game's beautiful heroine, Hanagasaki, his destiny takes a dramatic turn!

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

title: The Ordinary Lawyer's Subspace

A strange door appeared in front of lawyer Han Beomsang. Beyond it lies a space where time does not flow.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Sunju Geum, who died of choking while eating pineapple pizza, is reincarnated as an angel in the dimension of Shirley Fleichen. He is the only healer there, but the best healing is to destroy all dangers before their allies get hurt! How to live as an angel that has a worse personality than devils...

(Source: MU)

title: Shukujo no Kagami Yamemashita. Toki wo Gyakkou shita Koushaku Reijou wa, Wagamama na Imouto ni Furimawasarenai You Seikaku Waruku Ikinobimasu!

synopsis:
Betrayed and killed by her cunning half-sister Muriel, noble lady Christina meets an untimely and bitter end—or so she thought. When she suddenly wakes up three years in the past, she finds herself with a second chance at life and vengeance. This time, she refuses to be the ideal noblewoman everyone expects. Teaming up with her fiancé, the sharp-witted Second Prince Iril, who is investigating strange incidents along the border, Christina prepares to fight back. She’s done playing the perfect lady—this time, she’ll survive with a wicked smile.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Hinata to Hikari
synopsis:
Hinata, who is an ordinary middle school girl from every angle, is the twin sister of the popular idol Hikari! In order not to disappoint Hikari's fans, Hinata has always kept her sister a secret and behaved in a low-key manner. One day, in order to save Hikari from a pinch, Hinata switches places with Hikari and jumps into a glittering world!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Kouseki Reijou: Botsuraku shita Akuyaku Reijou ga Tankou de Hitoyama Ateru made no Ohanashi
title_japanese: 鉱石令嬢 ～没落した悪役令嬢が炭鉱で一山当てるまでのお話～
synopsis:
Suzu, a mineral researcher, suddenly loses consciousness at work!! When she wakes up, she finds herself in the world of an otome game, reincarnated as the villainess, Mahalia!? If this continues, her life will fall apart just like in the game!! She escapes from the royal palace and makes her way to a coal mine, where she meets Abel, the leader of the mine. In order to survive, Suzu proposes that they make steel using coke, a type of coal that does not yet exist in this world...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: The S-Class Hunter's Peaceful Life with Monsters
title_english: The S-Class Hunter's Peaceful Life with Monsters
synopsis:
Chimera hunter Number 17 has spent decades hunting monsters. On his latest mission, he's ordered to ensure the human hunters' escape and never return to base. In other words, he's meant to die. As his body dissolves, his life flashes before him: kidnapped as a boy, forced into endless battles, reduced to a mindless weapon. But against all odds, his body reforms into his human form. No longer Chimera Hunter Number 17, he stands before a vast open land on his own two feet as Do-un Cheon, a human, ready to start his life anew, making friends out of monsters and building the family he never had.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Defense Breaker
synopsis:
Jihun is pulled into Knight Defense, a game where he must lead the kingdom's knights against endless waves of monsters. Weighed down by the scars of his real life, Jihun chooses not to fight and turns his back on humanity. But as soon as he does, the system unveils a new path: the Monster Faction. Defense is over. It's now time for offense.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Kokou no Ou to Hidamari no Hanayome ga Saikou no Fuufu ni Naru made
title_japanese: 孤高の王と陽だまりの花嫁が最幸の夫婦になるまで
synopsis:
Wilfred, known as the "Martial Tyrant," is a king feared by his subjects. Alicia, a princess from a humble background, is married to King Wilfred in a political arrangement. Alicia is afraid of the intimidating Wilfred at first, but over time, she begins to notice his hidden, more gentle side. In return, Alicia's kind and innocent personality also touches Wilfred's heart... This is a story of a marriage of opposites, where a solitary king and a sunny princes discover love and become the happiest couple in the world!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Chuumon no Ooi Mahoutsukai: Keiyaku Hanayome wa Onedari Jouzu na Saikyou Majutsushi ni Dekiai sareteimasu!?

title: Koutei Heika no Senzoku Shisho Hime
title_japanese: 皇帝陛下の専属司書姫
synopsis:
Kanon realizes that she has been reborn as the villainess of a game. On her 18th birthday, her fiancé, who had chosen her half-sister to be his fiancée instead, breaks off his engagement with Kanon. Obediently accepting this decision, Kanon heads for the imperial capital. Her goal was to escape the worst possible outcome and live a peaceful life as a librarian, but she ended up signing a love contract with the emperor, one of the love interests of the game?! My fiancé, my step-brother, and my boss are all love interests of the game, and I'm just the heroine's stepping stone?! Being the villainess of an opportunistic game is no joke! A villainess' work x contract love fantasy!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Kikan Gentei, Daiyon Kishidan no Kitchen Maid: Kekkon shitakunai node Shuushoku shimashita @comic
title_english: Temporary Kitchen Maid of the Fourth Knights Order: I Didn't Want to Get Married, so I Found a Job
title_japanese: 期間限定、第四騎士団のキッチンメイド～結婚したくないので就職しました～@COMIC
synopsis:
Alice, a viscount's daughter, agrees to work as a live-in kitchen maid because it's her one way out of getting married! Unfortunately, her new life won't be as smooth sailing as she had hoped. Her assignment is the Fourth Paladin Order, which happens to be full of handsome men...her natural enemy! The reason for that? Well, in Alice's previous life, she had a handsome husband who betrayed her. He was nothing but a piece of trash without any other redeeming qualities. But as Alice fills the paladins' stomachs with her hearty Japanese dishes, they slowly begin opening up to her, revealing secrets they had hidden away, Perhaps her job won't be so unpleasant after all. Food, excitement, and wholesomeness all around!

(Source: TO Books)

title: Midori no Kaze ni Kimi wo Hiraku
synopsis:
A house surrounded by lush, overgrown greenery, and a beautiful, but distant man - this is what the gardener Nishikigi finds at his new workplace. He's not sure what to make of the master of the house, Kuraoka, especially when he asks to observe him and his work for his new children's novel.

Nishikigi is only certain that the two of them are from different worlds and see everything differently—maybe even irreconcilably so. But just like the light and wind start to come in once he tames the overgrown garden, so love begins to flow into their hearts.

And thus, a slow and beautiful romance begins between two complete opposites.

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Datenshi Soprano-chan no Fukushuu
title_english: Revenge of the Fallen Angel Soprano-chan
title_japanese: 堕天使そぷらのちゃんの復讐
synopsis:
In the summer of her sixth grade year, Mirei Nakamura hurt her best friend, who had confessed her feelings, with heartless words. For years, she had been haunted by the thought of wanting to start over, but when she reunited with Soprano Okuno, who had transferred to her school, she couldn't find a way to begin again. Soprano had become a famous model known as "Angel Soprano," but what about Soprano?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Laizi Qingshui de Haizi: Son of Formosa
title_japanese: 來自清水的孩子 Son of Formosa
synopsis:
Part One: Taiwan, 1930s. Tsai Kun-lin, an ordinary boy born in Chingshui, recounts a carefree childhood despite the Japanese occupation: growing up happily with the company of nursery rhymes and picture books on Chingshui Street. As war emerges Tsai's memories shift to military parades, air raids, and watching others face conscription into the army. It seems no one can escape. After the war, the book-loving teenager tries hard to learn Mandarin and believes he is finally stepping towards a comfortable future; but little does he know, a dark cloud awaits him ahead.

Part Two: Taiwan, 1950s. In his second year at Taichung First Senior High School, Tsai is arrested simply for joining a book club and subsequently tortured, deprived of civil rights, and sent to Green Island for "reformation." Lasting until his release in September 1960, Tsai, a victim of the White Terror era, spends ten years of his youth in prison on an unjust charge. But he is ready to embrace freedom.

(Source: Levine Qu

title: Hello, Little Griffin!
synopsis:
26-year old Hansol's finally got a place of his own! But on moving day, he opens the door to find an unexpected roommate: a little white griffin. Where did it come from? Is it lost? But just look at those fluffy bird paws and cute kitty toe beans! Maybe he can stay, just for a while!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu: Love Comedy ga Hajimaranai
title_japanese: 僕の心のヤバイやつ ラブコメディが始まらない

title: Shachiku no Ore, Dragon ni Natsukareta node Pet Haishin wo Hajimemasu: Chibikko Dragon to Monster Bokujou Life
title_english: Corporate Slave, Starting Live Video With the Dragon Who Misses Me So Much
title_japanese: 社畜の俺、ドラゴンに懐かれたのでペット配信を始めます～チビッ子ドラゴンとモンスター牧場ライフ～
synopsis:
Decades ago, mysterious dungeons suddenly appeared in Japan. Monsters poured out, plunging the world into chaos. But thanks to international countermeasures, the threat gradually diminished. What was once called a fantasy world became an everyday reality for those living in the present. Joji Makise is one such person, exhausted from dealing with an unreasonable boss and endless overtime. One day on his way home, he comes across an injured, weakened baby dragon. Naming the dragon Ohagi, Joji uploads a video of their encounter, and it instantly goes viral. From dungeon explorations to meeting a wise old wolf, Joji's life takes a turn as he embarks on a dreamy slow-life journey, full of fluffy and adorable creatures.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Ore wa Boukensha Guild no Akutoku Guild Master: Jinzai wo Tekizai Tekisho ni Tsuihou shitara, Nazeka Mechakucha Kansha saremashita
title_english: The Corrupt Guildmaster Is Beloved by the Banished
title_japanese: 俺は冒険者ギルドの悪徳ギルドマスター ～人材を適材適所に追放したら、なぜかめちゃくちゃ感謝されました～
synopsis:
"I'm exiling you from this guild!! But I've prepared a new career path where you can make the most of your abilities!!" Act, an adventurer who once experienced the bitterness of being exiled from his former guild, decides to establish and manage a new guild called "Heaven-sent Gem." However, because Act exiles so many members, rumors begin to spread in society about a "corrupt guild master"... Surrounded by unique companions like a cool puppy-like maid, a tomboy princess, and an overpowered hero, the (supposedly?) corrupt guild master continues to assess, nurture, and exile people every day!!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Oda-ke no Chounan ni Umaremashita: Sengoku Jidai ni Tensei shita kedo, Shinitakunai node Kaikaku wo Okoshimasu

title: Yagate Tako ni Naru Kimi to
title_japanese: やがて蛸になるきみと

title: Sugiyuki Kako to Mitai Asu
title_japanese: 杉雪カコと見たい明日

title_japanese: 午後のみどりで待ち合わせ
synopsis: Ray and Chikage met at a park when they were young. The two were close enough to be called best friends, but...?

title: Ane no Kawari ni, Yomei Ichinen to Iwareru Koushaku Shisoku-sama to Konyaku suru Koto ni Narimashita
title_english: In Sickness and in Health: How I Got Engaged to the Son of a Marquis with One Year Left to Live
title_japanese: 義姉の代わりに、余命一年と言われる侯爵子息様と婚約することになりました
synopsis:
Edith is an orphaned girl who is treated coldly by her adoptive parents and sister. One day, her adoptive sister is offered a marriage proposal to Lionel, the eldest son of the Marquis of Granville, a very prestigious family. However, there is a reason for this proposal... so Edith becomes engaged to him instead of her sister.

"I'm sorry, I can't believe you're engaged to me like this. Can you just bear with me for one year?"

Her fiancé has only one year to live, but pure love brings about a miracle in this happy love story!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Kyouseiteki ni Akuyaku Reijou ni Sareteita node Mazu wa Okayu wo Tabeyou to Omoimasu.
title_english: Considering I'm Being Forced into the Villainous Rich Girl Role, I Will First Eat Some Porridge.
title_japanese: 強制的に悪役令嬢にされていたのでまずはおかゆを食べようと思います。
synopsis:
After being reincarnated in a game world, Ravie Heathfen, has been forced to play the role of the villainous noble lady after the game's heroine placed a slave curse on her. When the magic suddenly came undone, she gained back her bodily freedom and also memories of her past life but she has to make sure that the heroine doesn't find out or she'll lose her head! She wants to escape immediately but it's just impossible with the horribly skinny state her body is currently in. So for now, she'll just have to settle with eating porridge first and start building back her physical strength! But her fiancé the prince, the muscular knight, and others would unexpectedly come and start quarreling with her. It seems that our skinny young lady's escape plan will be filled with plenty of great difficulties!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Kojirase Outaishi to Yakusoku no Himegimi
title_japanese: こじらせ王太子と約束の姫君
synopsis:
Leylia is a tomboyish princess from the small country of Barcos. In order to protect her country from a vicious superpower, she accepts an offer of marriage with a neighboring country. However, the crown prince has a lover, and he has given her ten unreasonable conditions, including: only a fiancé for the time being, not to appear in public, not to talk to each other... etc. Leylia intends to fix the attitude of the haughty crown prince who takes advantage of his superior position... But then, for some reason, she and the crown prince suddenly got close...? The princess of a weak country makes a selfish crown prince cry foul! A royal palace love fantasy!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Seikatsu Majutsushi-tachi, Kaitei Shinden ni Idomu
title_english: Life Magicians, Challenge the Undersea Shrine
title_japanese: 生活魔術師達、海底神殿に挑む

title: Sakurairo Dialogue
title_japanese: さくらいろダイアローグ
synopsis:
Set in a rural town in northern Tohoku, this coming-of-age story follows a girl who feels suffocated by life in the small town and a boy who is here to escape from the city. They meet through a certain piece of music, and gradually open their hearts to each other.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Asamura-san to Yoyama-san
synopsis:
Ryouka Asamura, a sensible high school girl, “picks up” Mio Yoyama, a drunk office lady, on a dark street at night…

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Juusho Futei Camper wa Dungeon de Nonbiri to Kurashitai: Kiken na Shinsou Monster mo Ore ni Totte wa Shokuzai desu
title_japanese: 住所不定キャンパーはダンジョンでのんびりと暮らしたい ～危険な深層モンスターも俺にとっては食材です～

title: Kuni ni Suterareta Rakuin Yuusha, Youjo ni Hirowarete Shiawase na Slow Life wo Hajimeru
title_japanese: 国に捨てられた烙印勇者、幼女に拾われて幸せなスローライフを始める
synopsis:
For nineteen years, Wel stood as the Holy Sword Hero, defending the Kingdom of Klenrad from monstrous threats. With just one year left before his retirement, betrayal struck from the shadows. Framed by the royal princesses, he was branded a criminal and exiled from the kingdom he bled to protect.

Stripped of his name and honor, Wel vanished beyond the borders of mankind—into the lands of the demonfolk. There, he was taken in by Natalia, a fierce warrior of the Oni Tribe, and her daughter, Delilah. Wel began a new chapter among the demonkind, gradually finding peace as he built a quiet life in their village.

As bonds grew between him, Natalia, and Delilah, the former hero who once stood at the forefront of war now embraced a life of warmth, healing... and the calm before whatever storm might come next.

(Source: MU)

title: Ryouma ga Yuku
synopsis:
At age 12, Sakamoto is ridiculed to tears as "Sakamoto the bed-wetter." Struggling to even learn his letters, he is given up on by his temple school teacher. However, coming to terms with his mother's death becomes a turning point for Ryouma, and he begins to transform into a strong man.

(Source: Bungeishunju, translated)

title: Genkai Shuuraku wo Datsu Mura shita Renkinjutsushi, Tokai de "Saikyou" nano ga Baremakuru.: Rougai domo ni wa Iikaken Aiso ga Tsukimashita
title_japanese: 限界集落を脱村した錬金術士、都会で"最強"なのがバレまくる。～老害どもにはいい加減愛想が尽きました～
synopsis:
"Young people these days really lack the feeling of respect for their elders!" Magna, the only alchemist in a village suffering from depopulation and aging, was suffering from power harassment. Feeling a sense of duty to be relied upon by the villagers, Magna endured harsh working conditions, but the reality was one of malicious exploitation...!? Japan, early 20th century. Subaru Karasuma, an aspiring writer with dashed ambitions, neck-deep in loans he has no hope of paying back, decides it's time to draw the curtain on his miserable life. Utsuro is an unidentified monster whose favorite food is the "nectar" bioenergy that only young girls possess. Iruka Natsumi—a member of Hyakkaen, an organization that fights Utsuro day and night—lives in fear of being eaten by Utsuro. One day, a girl named Sagara Asuka appears before her. Asuka declares, "I will defeat all the Utsuro in this world with my own hands," and tells Natsumi that they will live together until she turns 19, when the nectar disappears from her body. Asuka shows overwhelming strength in her battle with Utsuro, but she has a secret...

Satou is a manga editor who suffers from "Magical Girl Phobia" triggered by dreams featuring a mysterious magical girl. However, one day, he comes across a manga featuring illustrations strikingly similar to the magical girl from his dreams. Nao Niimi was bullied as a kid because of her appearance. In order to reset the past and start over, she changed who she was competely. Now she lives in Tokyo and works at the apparel shop of her dreams. The only problem is, she's still not happy. It seems being beautiful isn't the only thing in life... Nao's ugly past begins to haunt her as she struggles through everyday life. One day, she runs into Sachi Fukuhara, who begins to ruin everything, from turning her coworkers against her, to harrasing her nonstop. Nao must come face to face with the struggles of the past and the ugly truth that is right in front of her...

(Source: NHN comico)

synopsis:
Sig worked as a versatile blacksmith in an S-rank guild. Fed up with the exploitative work environment, he decides to leave the guild! Sig, who loves forging katanas above all else, chooses to live a peaceful life in the countryside. However, the swords he crafts begin to influence the world!? The ideal slow life of the strongest blacksmith pursuing his craft at his own pace begins with a bang!

(Source: Starts Shuppan, translated)

title: Dodododo!

A fetishistic dystopia of the near future, soaked in lust!

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

title: Inakagurashi no Masou Kusushi wa Kaerizaku: Fusei Habikoru Moto Shokuba wo Kaiko sareta node Dokuritsu shitara, Nazeka Kakukai no Chou Ichiryuu-tachi ga Atsumattekimashita
title_japanese: 田舎暮らしの魔草薬師は返り咲く～不正はびこる元職場を解雇されたので独立したら、なぜか各界の超一流たちが集まってきました～
synopsis:
In a world dominated by healing magic, Harris was developing "medicine" called magical herb remedies. Just as he was getting fired up, thinking, "Once this is complete, injuries and illnesses can be cured without relying on healing magic!" he was suddenly fired and stripped of everything... With no home, hope, or place to belong, Harris hit rock bottom. But then, the top-class former patients he had helped with his "magical herb medicine" came rushing to his aid...!?

The curtain rises on a top-class reversal drama that will turn the healing magic-centric world upside down!!

(Source: Starts Shuppan, translated)

title: A Single Dad in Another World
title_english: A Single Dad in Another World
synopsis:
His wife has gone missing. His baby daughter is terminally ill. But as Junhu falls to his death, he wakes up in his wife's unfinished dark fantasy novel—a world infested with vile demons. Armed with knowledge of the story, he allies with powerful demon hunters to avert the tragedies to come. Yet every action rewrites the story in unpredictable ways, and Junhu must seek answers if he hopes to keep his daughter safe.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: How to Live as a Civil Servant in Murim
synopsis:
One day, Yeon Woo-hyeok falls into the martial world and becomes a civil servant. He is a seasoned player of the martial arts detective game, Great Hwan-Guk's Famous Bodyguard. Without any warning, he finds himself reincarnated as the bodyguard from the game. Fortunately, he realizes that the game's events are unfolding exactly as he had memorized them. As he begins solving cases, he starts adapting to his new life as the bodyguard. But his joy is short-lived when he discovers his ability, "Yeongan," is actually the opening of his dantian. Because of this, he faces the imminent danger of dying young. Wait, even just being a bodyguard is tough, but now he must learn martial arts and become a powerful master?!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

synopsis:
Two straight guys, completely off each other's radar as potential romantic interests. Yet somehow, they became the first person the other thought of—every single time. Yoshida, a florist, and Iida, who works for a big company, meet through their mutual friend, Ao. Initially, they see each other as sharp-tongued and cunning—people you can't easily trust. But when Yoshida proposes a partnership to co-manage the flower shop, the "most formidable duo" is born. From bitter rivals to reliable partners, and then, somewhere along the way...

(Source: Printemps Shuppan, translated)

title: The Girl from the PC Café
title_english: The Girl from the PC Café
synopsis:
At a local PC café, the shy owner secretly pines for his drop-dead gorgeous part-timer, Mina. But subtle details about her stir painful memories he can’t ignore, leaving him torn between fear and desire, especially when her bright smile makes his heart race all over again.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Gomi Skill kara Hajimeru Isekai Eiyuutan: "○○" ga Install saremashita. Tsumari Muteki desu!

synopsis:
Leorus, an adventurer, was abandoned by the guild and received a dismissal notice. His skill “Install” only allowed him to read and memorize information from recorded media like books. Everyone in his party, especially Kainz, looked down on him and scorned him as the holder of a trash skill.

Then, on the day of a dungeon expedition, Leorus advanced together with Kainz and the others, but suddenly a powerful enemy appeared, putting the group in grave danger.

As Leorus faced a life-threatening situation, he mustered all his strength and reached for a mysterious book before him. A enigmatic beautiful girl appeared...!?

(Source: Kill Time Communication, translated)

title: Maryoku 0 demo Majutsugurui Datta node, Daini no Jinsei dewa Musou suru: Ore dake Shitteiru Majutsu Chishiki de Kyokudai Mahou wo Buppanasu
title_japanese: 魔力0でも魔術狂いだったので、第二の人生では無双する～俺だけ知っている魔術知識で極大魔法をぶっ放す～
synopsis:
There once was a man who, despite having no mana, was captivated by magic and dedicated his entire life to its study. His story, unable to abandon his desperate wish to use magic, takes a dramatic turn when he's reincarnated into the body of Filio, a boy who died mysteriously by suicide! Together with his first friends at the magic academy and a beautiful teacher, he overcomes one disaster and crisis after another with overwhelming magic! The ultimate magical domination by a former zero-mana genius who’s finally obtained mana begins here!

(Source: Starts Shuppan, translated)

title: Da Capo
synopsis:
Only in death did I realize the meaning of my life.

Daehwa Kim is a piano prodigy who drops out of a prestigious performing arts high school due to a lack of passion. Just when he finally discovers his love for the piano at 30, he gets into a fatal accident, only to wake up as a high school student again! Can he turn his fate around this time?

(Source: Manta)

title: Houchiku sareta Tensei Kizoku wa, Jiyuu ni Yarasete Moraimasu
title_japanese: 放逐された転生貴族は、自由にやらせてもらいます
synopsis:
Toa was reincarnated as the second son of a noble family while retaining memories of his life on Earth. Although he aimed for a leisurely and comfortable life in another world, he was exiled to a border fort at a young age due to his lack of talent in swordsmanship and magic. Ten years later, following his father's death, he was called back only to be disowned by his older brother, Grass, who had inherited the family. Undaunted by these harsh circumstances, Toa decided to use the skills and knowledge he acquired at the border fort to become an adventurer. However, after helping a girl named Nikka during the guild's entrance exam, he becomes entangled in an incident that shakes the royal capital!? The exhilarating battle fantasy begins, where those who underestimate him will pay double!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title: Romance in Seorabeol
synopsis:
Can this modern-day girl survive in the past?

After a drunken encounter with a Buddha statue, Soyeong Kim suddenly finds herself in the Silla Dynasty. Not only did she travel back in time, but she is the spitting image of Princess Soryong, a mysterious princess with a huge secret. What will become of her, and will she be able to return home?

(Source: Manta)

title: So Close Yet So Far
synopsis:
Let me hold your hand once more.

Jiwoo can see the future of those she holds hands with. Yet when she holds Haesung's hand, she can see her own! Hoping to know her fate in the upcoming art contest, Jiwoo tries to hold Haesung's hand again, but he refuses. What trauma lies in his past? Can the two pull each other back to the present?

(Source: Manta)

title: Saikyou Shoukanshi wa Around 30 Ossan: Card wo Oya ni Shobun sareta Card Gamer no Isekai Musou
title_japanese: 最強召喚士はアラサーおっさん ～カードを親に処分されたカードゲーマーの異世界無双～
synopsis:
Sousaku Kamifuda, a card gamer who, even at 30, continues to enjoy the same otaku lifestyle he had as a child. While his fellow otaku friends progress through various life stages, leaving him isolated, his mother sells off his precious collection. Before he can even process his despair, he's suddenly transported to another world. Though initially at a loss, Sousaku discovers that his otherworldly transfer has granted him the ability to turn monsters into cards and summon them. After using this power to save two girls from a monster attack, the middle-aged card gamer's conquest of this other world begins...!!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Alien to Love
synopsis:
High schooler Gyubin Ji, a psychic who can read minds, meets Byeol Yu, a mysterious new classmate. The twist? Byeol is actually a human-hating alien in disguise, sent to decide humanity's fate! As unexpected sparks fly between them, Gyubin must win Byeol's heart—and save Earth! Will he make it?

(Source: Manta)

title: Totsuzen☆Parallel!

After falling through a magic mirror, Nanako and company find themselves stuck in a world where the people are talking animals—and now must find their way back home.

(Source: MangaDex)

Hakurai Private Academy, a boarding school where young ladies receive a higher education in bridehood. Should the maidens lose their "purity" during the three year course, they are immediately expelled, losing any chance at their dreams of becoming brides. For the girls living at this school, it is a future they consider worse than death. One day, something happens in the dormitory of the student council! In their midst is a two-faced wolf aiming for their purity, and it is up to them to pull back the mask!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

Manga symbols—"manpu" in Japanese—are iconic or symbolic expressions used uniquely in manga, such as sweat drops, popping veins, and smoke puffs. Giga Town: A Guide to Manga Iconography! is (probably) Japan's first guide to this manga iconography, collecting and explaining these symbols, with a short manga featuring the frolicking animals of the famous Japanese scroll Choju-jinbutsu-giga to explain each one!

At a certain yandere cafe, customers can safely indulge in the fantasy of being the object of dangerously obsessive love. For yandere-obsessed high schooler Kuraki, having a cast of professional yanderes performing terrifying acts of devotion on him is a dream come true! But as the staff begin to fall for Kuraki's natural charm, their "performances" start to feel a little too real...?! A comedy about an oblivious yandere-loving boy and the yanderes he unintentionally creates!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Koe no Furu Heya
synopsis:
A soothing voice says "You've got this." In his one-bedroom apartment, that voice becomes a small source of comfort to face the next day.

Itaru Kagurazaka, a corporate illustrator working long hours, lives alone in a soundproof apartment. One day, he suddenly gets a friend request from his former high school classmate, Fumiya Ouji, who claims that he's being stalked. Feeling he has no choice, Itaru lets him stay over. But from that moment on, Itaru finds a new kind of "stimulus" he never anticipated.

For years, Yuki has pined for his junior colleague, Ao. But when they are suddenly matched together on a dating app, Yuki has no choice but to reveal his crush! Jeonghwan, once a legendary mercenary, returns under an identity no one expected—a prosecutor. His mission is to uncover the truth behind his mother's mysterious death, the tragedy that robbed him of his peace and future. To take his revenge, Jeonghwan must wield two weapons: violence for those who stand in his way, and the law for those who must be judged.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: A Horde of Zombies
synopsis:
Koo Seong-Hwan was a former Ju-Jitsu World Champion. When he opened his eyes, the world was destroyed. Even though his body was infected, he had to find his daughter...!

(Source: Naver, translated)

"You, and only you, must dominate the world!" With just that one sentence, Jin San-wol's fate was sealed. At the age of twenty-three, he became the head of Jongnam Sect. All that remained were just eight disciples. Once a sect that dreamed of being the greatest under the heavens, Now it merely struggles to survive, holding onto the faintest thread of legacy. To honor his master's dying wish—to survive—Jin San-wol steps into the ruthless world of martial arts.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: The Sound of Gifted Silence
synopsis:
Kang Moo-Jae inherited the best blood in the music industry. However, he was frustrated when he witnessed the overwhelming musical talent of Jin Yu-Seong, a hearing-impaired man... A fierce competition between two boys begins for a single spot.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Fate/Grand Order: Cempasúchil
title_japanese: Fate/Grand Order センパスチル
synopsis:
While visiting modern Mexico for the Day of the Dead, Tenochtitlan and Tezcatlipoca talk about how their homeland has changed since the days of the Aztecs, and the ways that it has stayed the same.

(Source: TYPE-MOON Wiki)

title: Fate/Grand Order: Avalon Tale - Nakatani Sakuhinshuu

Artoria Avalon travels through the Singularities and Lostbelts, interacting with characters who played a prominent role in each story and learning about them.

Empress Desa, a great witch and ambassador for the founding of the country, proposes a bet to find herself among 108 people with identical faces to test the emperor's sincerity. Meanwhile, Arit, a young witch who admires Desa, secretly participates in the bet to stop Desa?!

synopsis:
After dying as an orphan unable to support her siblings, Siella Feiront is reincarnated as the villainess of a novel and the evil matron of Siella's Orphanage. Indignant at how poorly the children in her care have been treated, she immediately gets to work—repairing the rundown manor, buying the children clothes, and cooking nutritious meals—until she's left with next to no money. title: Private Tutoring
synopsis:
After years of being cooped up at home, Ah-Yeong finally lands a job as a café manager—thanks to a friend—and moves into her first apartment. Wanting to be a friendly neighbor, she brings cookies to the guy next door... only to discover he's none other than Wujin, the student she used to tutor ten years ago! What starts as a casual reunion soon turns into regular dinners and cozy evenings together. But one night, while Ah-Yeong is distracted prepping dinner, Wujin accidentally knocks over a box—and out rolls a very intimate gift from her friend: a dildo. Mortified, Ah-Yeong scrambles to hide it, but Wujin just smiles and says, "As your former student, I feel it's only right I help out."

Excuse me?! When did this shy little student grow up—and how did this become that kind of tutoring?

This definitely wasn't in the lesson plan...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: When a Genius Office Worker Crosses the Line
synopsis:
A former member of the best film studio in Korea, a genius marketer, and the only employee who failed his peer evaluation and was involved in a bribery case, a public enemy within the company. All of these modifiers summarize Han-Rok's life as an office worker. He only wanted to focus on his work, and he hated politics and flattery, so he rejected all lines, but the price he paid was betrayal and false accusations from those around him, and at that moment, he was at a loss... He returned to that day five years ago when everything started to go wrong. Han-Rok, who started to cross the line with the determination not to be taken advantage of again in this life, started to see a clue to the problem that had not been visible until then.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Zombie Papa
synopsis:
Minseok loses his daughter again and again in a world overrun by zombies. He's been mysteriously given 100 lives to save her and has watched her die in 99 of them. On his final one, he dies before they even make it out the front door–except this time, he wakes as a zombie. But a zombie papa still has a father's heart. Now stronger than ever, he's ready to take on the world to protect his baby girl.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Four Options
synopsis:
To Yoonha, a model student at an elite high school, romance has always felt like a frivolous distraction. But when four surprising choices for love appear, her pencil begins to waver. Will she choose the right answer and ace the ultimate test?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: High School Hack and Slash
title_japanese: ハイスクールハックアンドスラッシュ
synopsis:
Touma Funasaka is offered an unusual recommendation for his next school by his homeroom teacher. The school in question is Toyashihara Academy—a national, full-boarding institution that accepts only students through recommendation, with no general admissions. It also happens to be his teacher’s alma mater.

The low tuition and full-boarding system seemed like the perfect opportunity, so Touma decides to enroll. But what awaited him was an academy that defied common sense—a place built atop a vast underground dungeon, ruled by sex and violence.

Though bewildered at first, Touma quickly adapts to the decadent academy life. While indulging in a corrupt and hedonistic youth, he also joins comrades to form a party and challenge the dungeon’s depths!

synopsis:
With a growing interest in matters of sex, high schooler Masamune has developed a desire to fondle tits like his life depends on it. Unfortunately for him, he only has access to the burly pecs of his childhood friend, Hajime. He doesn't mind, though, and gives them a nice, firm squeeze. Hajime's chest is hard, muscular and without a hint of softness, but fondling it still makes Masamune feel all tingly! Masamune might just be in love with Hajime('s tits)! A handsome, silent type and an airheaded cutie! Two childhood friends brought together by a love for boobs!

title: Memoir of the Legendary Scholar
synopsis:
Kim Si-seup, a man whose destiny is to fight with the forces of the otherworld for the rest of his life. He was rumored to be a prodigy when he was a child, but fate wasn't on his side. The artist that he visited to find out the identity of the woman that appeared in his dreams every night only said things that he couldn't understand... "The world is not everything you see. Maybe there's another world we don't know about... That is what I'm talking about." As he lives in this world, he realizes the existence of another world. He's a man who struggled pitifully in order to protect the life and way of this world. The story of Kim Si-seup begins! This is a crossover fantasy historical manhwa happening between Joseon and Seoul!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Pride of the Blade
synopsis:
One day, Dae Do-Oh appeared on the battleground between the Iron Flag Alliance and the Nine Dragon's Cult. He is the captain of the Joker Squad, a sub-unit of the Iron Flag Alliance's Black Flag Hall. Contrary to their name, the Joker Squad accumulated many accomplishments on the battlefield. At the same time, unknown enemies are plotting against both the Iron Flag Alliance and the Nine Dragon's Cult. What will happen next? What will Dae Do-Oh do?  The battle for survival begins now!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Natural Enemy of Man
synopsis:
The strongest killer, "Blade Rabbit," lives a quiet life under the name of chef Goya after retirement. One day, he senses an indescribable ecstatic scent from a girl, Jin Seo Nu, who visits his restaurant. And what appears in pursuit of her are her former colleagues, killers, and natural enemies. Natural enemies who want to complete their missions, and chef Goya who wants to monopolize her scent. The desires and instincts surrounding the girl begin to intertwine.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: The Choice
synopsis:
To save one, she'll kill the other.

A miraculous, 1-in-200,000 chance birth of conjoined twins. The probability of their survival? Less than 5%. Born with just one heart between the two of them, the Kang sisters face a sinister fate: for one to survive, the other must die. Their mother faces a horrible choice. How would you decide?

(Source: Manta)

title: The Goblin and I
synopsis:
The new student is... a goblin?!

After surviving an accident, Jiyoo is left with the ability to read memories, thoughts, and emotions left behind in various objects. She's been using her ability for the greater good, but after becoming the subject of unwanted attention, she's decided to stop... until Young turns up at her school.

(Source: Manta)

title: Horror Game Sekai ni Tensei shitara Satsujinki no Oshi ga Ita
title_japanese: ホラゲ世界に転生したら殺人鬼の推しがいた

title_japanese: 呪いの魔剣で高負荷トレーニング!? ～知られちゃいけない仮面の冒険者～
synopsis:
The third son of a rural noble family, Tris, dedicated himself to training with the goal of becoming an adventurer. One day, he was gifted a magic sword of unknown abilities. Until the age of 15, unaware it was a cursed blade, he spent his days tirelessly swinging the sword. Without realizing it, the boy had been undergoing ultra-high-intensity training due to the sword’s power. Before he knew it, he had acquired hero-level strength!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kao ga Ii kara Korosenai!

synopsis:
Chrome was a magician in the hero's party. He fought the Demon Lord's army alongside people like Irina, the lover who vowed to marry him in the future, and the hero, Yuuno, who was his close friend. They were all close companions. However, that was only in Chrome's mind.

His lover, Irina, became intimate with the hero, Yuuno, and Chrome was sacrificed to make the hero stronger. Chrome's magic powers were snatched away and he was kicked out of the party. Demons surrounded him as he was on the verge of death and he was driven to a corner.

At that moment, Chrome awakened to a "darkness" within himself. Amidst his despair, he acquired an unrivaled skill. Now with this skill, he could exact revenge.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Tensei shitemo Jikka wo Oidasareta node, Kondo wa Jibun no Ishi de Ikiteikimasu
title_japanese: 転生しても実家を追い出されたので、今度は自分の意志で生きていきます
synopsis:
The protagonist, who lost his life in an unfortunate accident while returning from a part-time job, is reincarnated as a baby named Alex in a fantasy world. Having been abandoned by his birth mother in his previous life, Alex decides to live freely this time. However, he learns that he’s destined to be abandoned in this life as well. Alex intensively trains in magic with Liz, his adorable little sister figure who shares his fate! Even when they're left behind in a deep forest on the fated day, they aim to escape using the magic they've mastered together. The two little ones make it past the forest to the Hohenheim domain. They have great adventures, starting their lives as adventurers with Jin, a kind young man they meet by chance, and even saving the town from a horde of monsters! Meanwhile, an evil plot is unfolding in their family home...!?

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title: Taida no Ouji wa Sokoku wo Suteru: Koori no Majin no Tousouki
title_japanese: 怠惰の王子は祖国を捨てる～氷の魔神の凍争記～
synopsis:
The small Land Kingdom found itself at war with the Froisel Empire, one of the continent's greatest powers. With no way to resist, the decimated Land Kingdom army entrusted the rear guard to the fourth prince, Lut, an illegitimate son, to allow the main force to retreat to the royal capital. Prince Lut, known as "The Incompetent," led a mere fifty-three soldiers. While victory seemed impossible, Lut harbored a secret: he was a Divine Rank magician, said to be one of only a handful in the world! Though Lut overwhelmed the enemy commander by demonstrating his godlike power, he and his fellow soldiers wished to surrender to the empire. This is the tale of the strongest ice wielder who abandons his homeland to become the empire's guardian deity.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

synopsis:
Ryou, a water attribute mage, plans a comfort trip for his favorite sweets... no, to heal his friend Abel. The destination he chooses is Candia Island, where a grand festival is being held. While enjoying the warm welcome from the cheerful villagers, Ryou and his companions learn that the festival is actually a memorial service honoring a mage and an elf who fought and sacrificed their lives for the island. However, before they can reflect on this history, suddenly ferocious magical beasts attack the village! Ryou faces them to protect everyone, but... for some reason, he can't use his specialty water magic!? A comfort trip turns into a desperate situation on an isolated island with no help!? The side story of the strongest water mage's carefree adventure begins here!

(Source: TO Books, translated)

title: Jimi na Ojisan, Jitsu wa Eiyuu deshita. Jikaku ga Nai Mama Musou shitetara, Mei no Dungeon Haishin de Sarasareteta you desu
title_japanese: 地味なおじさん、実は英雄でした。 ~自覚がないまま無双してたら、姪のダンジョン配信で晒されてたようです~
synopsis:
Keita Sato (41, single) is overworked at his corporate job, dealing with tedious and stressful tasks day in and out. How does he relieve his stress? By sneaking into modern-day "dungeons," using them as a batting cage, and blasting away ferocious monsters! One day, his live-in niece Hikari secretly follows him and livestreams his adventures, only for his unbelievable strength to go crazy viral!! Keita unknowingly captures the attention of not only viewers, but other big-name streamers. So begins the fantasy tale of an ordinary office worker's unwitting rise to fame and glory!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Born to an archduke, Luria's noble status hides a deeper secret—in her past life, she was once a powerful saint beloved by spirits yet scorned by humans, known in death as the "Witch of Calamity."

Now reborn with those same overwhelming powers, she's finally found herself in a loving family. With more to lose this time if her past is ever found out, she turns to a dream she had once upon a time, and quietly resolves to live a comfortable life in the countryside, surrounded by animals.

But when her powers slip out and heal the sick, spirits and guardian beasts who once adored the saint in her past life start flocking to her again! What's this OP girl to do in this new life with old fluffy friends?
