title: Taiyou wa Hidamari to Warau
title_japanese: 太陽はひだまりと笑う
synopsis:
Taiyo Kiriyama knew he wasn't allowed to have pets in his apartment. But when he comes across an abandoned cat, he can't help but try to smuggle the sweet creature in! Unfortunately, he's immediately caught by the building manager, Asahi Taira. After Taiyo begs, Asahi agrees to let him keep the cat for a month while he finds it a home—but in exchange, Taiyo will have to become Asahi's errand boy. 

It's not an easy gig, but after getting to know Asahi, Taiyo finds that the other man has a hidden charm and begins to enjoy the time they spend together. While Taiyo's feelings for Asahi begin to grow, he soon learns that Asahi is in love with someone already. Can he help Asahi find his happiness and love, or will Taiyo's own emotions get in the way?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Crush on Teen Edge
title_english: Waiting for You at the End of the Runway
title_japanese: クラッシュ オン ティーンエッジ

title: I'll Change the Ending with Education
title_english: I'll Change the Ending with Education
synopsis:
Killed when her employer, the drunkard Timothy Reynold, is accused of treason, Agnes May Graham wakes up 14 years in the past. Eager to change her fate, Agnes becomes young Timothy's tutor in order to guide him toward a better path. However, she soon learns Timothy's misbehavior stems from the negligence of his guardian and her killer, the distant Duke Ethan Battenberg. Educating children is Agnes' expertise, but how can she solve this problem when it's her employer who really needs a lesson?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Guiding the Lead Out of His Trauma
title_english: Guiding the Lead Out of His Trauma
synopsis:
When the reader wakes up in a novel as Liliope, a guide who tragically dies because of the unstable male lead, Octaeon, she has her work cut out for her. Liliope's death traumatizes Octaeon in the original novel, but the female lead helps him recover, and the two fall in love. However, Liliope's brother, Hyacin, despises Octaeon for killing her and morphs into the novel's villain. Refusing to let her death drag him into darkness and despair, Liliope decides to rewrite her ending. However, as she weaves her new fate, she realizes her ending isn't the only thing that's changing.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Protect the Fake Saintess!
synopsis:
Dana, a Korean high school senior just days away from her college entrance exam, meets an unlucky end. Hit by the infamous "romance fantasy truck" and reborn in another world, she figures she might as well make the best out of it, but she suddenly stumbles across the Saintess's secret! "I don't want to die, so I guess I'll keep the cat in the bag, Saintess!"

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Eldest Daughter Takes Over
synopsis:
As the eldest daughter, I've always yielded to the whims of Meldor, my little brother and the future Duke Elton. But one day, memories of my previous life started flooding my mind, and I realized this wasn't my first time sacrificing everything for a younger sibling... That was my breaking point. Enough! I've done my time! Starting today, I'll meticulously reclaim everything I was ever forced to surrender to Meldor, and I'll give that spoiled brat a good lesson while I'm at it. Just you wait!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: I Have a Dragon's Heart
synopsis:
A thousand years ago, the hero Sharon defeated a fierce dragon. One day, a mysterious man appears in front of Aru, who grew up admiring Sharon. What? He says he's the fearsome dragon, and that I'm the hero! A cute and tender romance fantasy about a dragon and a hero reunited after a thousand years!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: How to Survive a Haunted School
title_english: How to Survive a Haunted School
synopsis:
After her brother Raven's mysterious death at the prestigious Saint Gloria Academy, Melody gets one impossible shot to infiltrate the elite school as a student by turning back time by a year. But beneath Saint Gloria's gleaming halls lie chilling secrets. Students whisper lies, ghosts linger in classrooms, and worst of all, Raven keeps avoiding her. With time running out and Raven slipping further away, can Melody uncover the school's dark truths? Or will she become one of its buried secrets?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kudaranakute, Kirei de.

When he was young, Prince Takaoka had been told stories of India by Fujiwara no Yakushi, the favorite concubine of his father, as a bedtime story, and he had longed for that land. Decades later, as he grew up, he set out on an exotic, mysterious and fantastical journey to make his dream come true.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Hisashiburi ni Atta Motokano ga Itako ni Natteta
title_english: My Ex-Girlfriend Became a Spirit Medium
title_japanese: 久しぶりに会った元カノがイタコになってた

The "legendary spiritual medium" he was ordered to visit turns out to be his ex-girlfriend who dumped him years ago! As they proceed with the spirit summoning ritual while he's still hung up on her, they discover that he was born with the ability to exorcise spirits...? A clingy and spiritual romantic comedy about two people who can't be honest with their feelings!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Shinitagari ni Tsugu Koufukuron

Yoru, who had been suffering from the pain of living due to a series of misfortunes, was offered a helping hand in the form of the country's "forced policy to combat declining birthrates"... which meant she was selected to be executed. Akari, her childhood friend, appeared before her, who was overjoyed. Yoru decided to spend her last moments happily as a final reward, but...?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

This necklace shall transform its wearer into their desired form... The boy who obtained this magical necklace x The prince he yearns for. What will become of this love whose true nature cannot come to light...?

title: Itazurakko Yo ni Habakarazu!!
title_japanese: イタズラっ子世に憚らず!!

In order to plunge the human world into a spiral of chaos, the demon girl Leopold has descended on earth. The one she chooses as her first target is a high school girl who seems a bit dull. Her attack is a success, and Leopold laughs loudly. However, what Leo doesn't yet know is that this high school girl is a demon's worst enemy...

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Marriage of Convenience 2: The Unforgettable Song
title_english: Marriage of Convenience 2: The Unforgettable Song
synopsis:
Cyril de Séverin, a king who rose to a noble position, yet possessed neither family, nor power, nor love—nothing at all. When he failed to protect Alexandra, his one and only salvation, and met his death, he was suddenly brought back ten years into the past by an unknown force. To a time when Alexandra was still the daughter of Arno, dreaming of becoming a knight... A time when Saint Bianca and war hero Zachary were still alive.

"I'll do whatever it takes so you never give up on your dreams again."

In order to prevent the same tragic future, he must protect her. But this time—will Cyril be able to convey his true feelings? A follow-up to the legendary KakaoPage romance fantasy Marriage of Convenience. A story of salvation and love that will move every heart—a song never to be forgotten.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Gal to Ooyasan
synopsis:
Kotoha is a second-year high school student who puts all her energy into her part-time job, her studies, and her fashion sense. One day, when she returns to her boarding house, she finds out that Itsuki, a university student, is her temporary landlord!? Itsuki is great at cleaning, cooking, and being considerate, but Kotoha can't hide her excitement and confusion at his perfect landlord skills and his doting attitude!

A peaceful battle begins between an independent-minded honor student gal and a naturally charming university student...♡

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Dachou Juujin no Hachamecha Musou: Aho Kawaii Saikyou Shuzoku no Leader ni Narimashita
title_japanese: ダチョウ獣人のはちゃめちゃ無双 アホかわいい最強種族のリーダーになりました

title: Barbarian's Adventure in a Fantasy World
synopsis:
Every night, he prayed to every god in existence: Please, when I wake tomorrow, let me find myself in the middle of a fantasy. One day, that long-cherished prayer was answered, just not in the way he had hoped. He awoke to a blindingly white world, a snow-covered land of frost and silence... as a Barbarian. The term "Barbarian" was unfamiliar to him, but overwhelmed with awe at having entered a fantasy realm, he became eager to learn more about the world he had dreamed of for so long. Unlike ordinary barbarians, he earnestly studied the human language and accumulated knowledge to better understand this new world, even earning a legal mercenary license. However, his fearsome appearance and immense strength constantly led to one misunderstanding after another...

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Mae no Seki no Onna
title_english: The Girl in the Seat in Front of Me

title: Ima kara Honki Dasu

title: The Back Alley Mage's Second Life
title_english: The Back Alley Mage's Second Life

Once a loyal hound to a powerful magic family, Aster was used, betrayed, and killed. But death wasn't the end—it was a second chance. Back in the back alleys of his youth, Aster now holds the future's secrets in his hands. This time, he won't serve anyone. Can a man who once served power learn to become his own master?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Debut with You
title_japanese: 내 새끼 데뷔시키려다 내가 데뷔하게 생김

With her weird talents and weirder personality, idol trainee Yoon Hyesung can't help but catch everyone's eye, even though that's far from what she wants. She's actually a fangirl from a different future with one goal in mind—help Na Yeonwoo debut as an idol! Now as Yeonwoo's friend, Hyesung is determined to get Yeonwoo the top spot on an idol survival program with the help of an oddly supportive game system. Can Hyesung help Yeonwoo debut, even if it means she will too?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Jade of the Eight Gates

Jucho, a government official manipulating the young king from behind, begins to express his ambition to oust the king and take real power and plots a ruse. Meanwhile, Handong, a member of the emperor's special unit Surajo, meets the boy Jinbaek in a village he entered to following the traces of his disappeared colleague, and learns that his colleague met his end in this village. These two people who fought with the people sent by Jucho knew that they needed eight jades to rescue Jinbaek's grandfather who was held hostage and to stop Jucho's ambition, they started the journey together...

(Source: Naver, translated)

I was always a good person. And with a smile on my face, I ran the country into the ground.

Wasting a 500 trillion won budget to chase approval ratings plunged South Korea into its second IMF crisis. His life as the president who ruined the country over, Lee Seong-jun finds himself 30 years in the past. He returns to find a budget proposal—riddled with dirty tricks, corruption, and blatant self-interest—being pushed through the Ministry of Economy and Finance.

"I have to block all of these budget proposals, even if I'm vilified for it. It's the only way to save this country."

The dirty tricks, political strategies, and media manipulation I learned over years in politics... I will use every last one to become the gatekeeper of the nation's coffers.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Boy4Friends
synopsis:
Yang Ji-in is just an average otaku until a boy who looks exactly like her favorite anime character transfers to her class. Shin Mireu is overly friendly from the start, and she eats up the attention, much to the dismay of her longtime friend, Choi Bongjun, who begins expressing his feelings more openly. Even Mun Dongsu, her quiet academy comrade, wants to spend more time with her. To complicate things further, swimming sensation Gwon Hyeonu appears, acting like they’ve known each other for years. Suddenly, it feels like every guy in Ji-in’s life wants to keep her all to himself!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Doko Miteru ka Barebare da yo? Kazama Ayami Sakuhinshuu
title_japanese: どこ見てるかバレバレだよ? カザマアヤミ作品集
synopsis:
1. Seibutsu-bu Katsudouchuu!
2. Yukari-chan no Oppai Therapy
3. Saikyou Buki Excalibur
4. Himitsu no Kyoushitsu
5. Himitsu no Date
6. Kareshi ga Hoshii!
7. Osananajimi no Yuuwaku wa Kiku
8. Dokidoki no Circle Nomikai!
9. Senpai wa Iyashitai!

title: Immoral♥Crossover
title_japanese: インモラル♥クロスオーバー

title: Infinite Leveling: Murim
synopsis:
Killed on the battlefield without glory to his name, Yuseong Dan receives an opportunity to grow stronger with a strange quest and level system. But each quest he's forced to fight only seems to be getting harder and harder. Can he level up enough to avoid the same miserable ending and become the powerful hero he wishes to be?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Cheolsu Saves the World
synopsis:
A massive asteroid is about to hit earth!

Humanity has failed to stop a giant asteroid from plummeting into Earth, and life as we know it has ended. An ordinary Korean office worker named Cheolsu is somehow given the chance to go back in time and prevent this catastrophe from ever happening. Does he have a chance?

(Source: Manta)

title: Mission: Save the Hunter
title_japanese: 유언 때문에 죽는 건 잠깐 미뤘습니다
synopsis:
Chaeyoon, once a famous hero, now lives as an unknown hunter, fulfilling the odd dying wishes of ex-colleagues before he can end his own life. Haunted by the past and drawn to Jihan, a skilled hunter he meets, Chaeyoon questions whether fulfilling last wishes and finding his own solace is possible.

(Source: Manta)

title: Regas
synopsis:
In this kingdom, the power of the dragon is passed down through the royal bloodline, and these royal family members require the special help of dragon tamers, otherwise known as the "Regas." However, the current prince's blood bears the markings of an extremely powerful dragon's might. While everyone feared and avoided the aggressive young prince, Abel, a man trained in the traditional ways of the Regas, approaches him and teaches him about the world little by little. Will the young prince finally be able to open up his heart to this Regas and gain control of his powers amidst all the political strife...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: The Accidental Heiress
synopsis:
May the best heir win!

Florist Riella never meant to catch the attention of Duchess Horssen with her shining flowers, and she certainly didn't mean to inherit her entire fortune! So when the enraged Grand Duke Hann appears before her to claim possession of the inheritance, what is she to do? Can she defend her newfound title?

(Source: Manta)

title: The Rogue Prince Is Secretly an Omega
title_english: The Rogue Prince Is Secretly an Omega
synopsis:
Prince Etienne de Frederick was born a dominant omega, but in a world where omegas can't become the emperor, he must pretend to be a beta due to the empress's greed. When his childhood friend, Grand Duke Rishar von Eckhart, returns after three years as a war hero, there's no time to share a happy reunion as Rishar is a dominant alpha and his rival in the fight for the throne. The two continue to maintain a precarious relationship until, one day, Etienne has a sudden heat cycle, and Rishar finds out the truth. "Etienne de Frederick. You were... an omega?"

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Your Eternal Lies
synopsis:
Don't believe a word she says.

Infamous jailbreaker Rosen Walker is finally being transferred to the Isle of Monte, the most notorious maximum security prison in the world. Her guard? None other than the beloved war hero of the empire himself—Ian Connor. Now he must unravel the truth. Is Rosen really a murderer? Or is there more to the story?

(Source: Manta)

title: Amina of the Lamp
synopsis:
What can you do with three wishes?

Amina, one of the last wizards, loses her loved ones when her palace comes under attack. Trying to turn back time to save them, she gets stuck inside a lamp. Three hundred years later, Jakard, a military commander, wakes her up. He has three wishes before Amina returns to the lamp. What will he wish for?

(Source: Manta)

title: The Hunter's Gonna Lay Low
synopsis:
Life's never quiet when you've got S-Rank Rizz.

Former S-Rank Hunter Uijae, a.k.a. J, saved humanity from eldritch horrors emerging from dimensional rifts, only to time-leap 8 years into a future where he's presumed dead. Now a manager at a hangover soup joint, all J wants is a quiet life. But between selling off the relics of his past and catching the obsessive attention of Korea's #1 Hunter Sayoung, peace isn't on the menu!

(Source: Manta)

title: Observing Elena Evoy
synopsis:
"If you're not my rival, why do I feel this way?"

Blessed with both beauty and brains, it was only natural for Johann to be the top student at the Academy—that is, until Elena Evoy appears. To make things worse, she seems completely unfazed by his charms, shattering his self-esteem. So why can't he stop thinking about her?

(Source: Manta)

title: A Common Story of a Lady's New Life
title_english: A Common Story of a Lady's New Life
synopsis:
Valerie thought she'd be a genius mage in this world. But when her magic can't get past basic and her teacher shares a prophecy of a tiger coming to attack(!!), she opts to enjoy an ordinary life. Everything's fine until she's engaged to none other than Duke Kylus Dwello. It's just one thing after another—the mysterious Serena, the servants who ship the duke and Serena, a prince who doesn't understand boundaries, and even the duke looming over her bed! Can she get back to her nice, quiet life?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Reborn as the Enemy Prince
synopsis:
Imagine being kin to your sworn enemy.

Killed in battle while defending his country, Bern wakes up in the body of the enemy prince, Kalian, and vows to avenge his people. But between taming an abusive half-brother and surviving his mother's deadly web of intrigue, sweet revenge seems to slip further beyond his grasp at every turn.

(Source: Manta)

title: Father, Unrivaled
synopsis:
Gajang Noh is a strong, dedicated, and humble man, with much respect for the martial arts. After the death of his lovely wife, this muscle-for-hire just wants an easy job that allows him to be a good father to his three little babies. He’s even happy to pull guard duty and fend off amateur fighters if it means he can return home safely each night. But when a creepy cult starts stealing children from the city, Gajang must step up to the challenge and discover his true warrior potential.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Passion
synopsis:
Jeong Taeui has always lived in the shadow of his genius twin brother, but he's never been unhappy with his ordinary life. When his uncle shows up at his doorstep with a dangerous job offer disguised as a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, Taeui is skeptical, but he reluctantly agrees to work as an agent for half a year. Despite his initial qualms, he quickly adjusts to his new environment using his outgoing, positive personality. But from the moment Taeui meets Ilay Riegrow, an agent from another branch, his peaceful life slowly starts to change. Everyone says Ilay is a sadistic psychopath who should be avoided at all costs, but Taeui knows there's more to him than meets the eye. But getting to know Ilay is like playing with fire, and Taeui isn't sure if he's ready to get burned.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Night of the Soulless Heathens
synopsis:
Azadin, a member of the cursed Messenger Clan, is born with the worst of curses. Lacking magical prowess, he becomes the lowest-ranking messenger, wandering the continent collecting gold coins in hopes of breaking his curse. But when his twin uncovers a great conspiracy, how will he face the impending doom?

(Source: Manta)

title: Reunion
synopsis:
Maybe we're destined to meet.

Struggling to pay his mother's hospital bills, Hakyung receives an offer: the fees will be taken care of. The catch? In exchange, he must pretend to be a girl he once knew in order to deceive the chairman of a powerful company. It's going well until Yoonsung, the chairman's grandson, appears...

(Source: Manta)

title: You Get Me Going
synopsis:
Not even if he were the last man left on Earth!

Youngwon yearns for true love, but his overbearing nature always leads to failed relationships. Lately, he finds himself clashing with his polar opposite, Hyunwoo, at work. However, things heat up when they go on a business trip together. Will these sparks of enmity turn to love?

(Source: Manta)

title: Under the Oak Tree
synopsis:
Love is a fairytale. Or is it?

Stuttering lady Maximilian is forced into a marriage with Sir Riftan, but he leaves on a campaign after their wedding night. Three years later, he triumphantly returns, ready to cherish her. All fairytales end with a wedding and a happily-ever-after. Their love began with a wedding—this is no fairytale.

(Source: Manta)

title: Solo Glitch Player
synopsis:
Taepung Shin knows every nook and cranny of his favorite MMO video game Paradiso like it was the back of his hand! However, his gaming adventures suffer an abrupt end after his untimely death. But this is not his last hurrah since he's reincarnated as Jared, a delinquent lord of a frozen province... in Paradiso! Now, he must brave the world he loved and take advantage of all glitches he knows about and turn himself into the main character of his new solo adventure!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Love Tractor
synopsis:
When family obligations force Sun Yool, a stressed-out law school student, to the countryside, it seems like a great opportunity to escape the chaos of the city. After all, the great outdoors promises fresh air, sunshine... and a new romance?! Soon after arriving, Sun Yool is thrown into a series of strange encounters and misunderstandings with his 20-year-old neighbor, Yechan. But in spite of Yechan's bumbling first impression and Sun Yool's prickly exterior, the two find themselves drawn to each other... Will this tractor-driving stud's rustic charm be enough to melt this cold city boy's heart?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Her Merry Obsession
synopsis:
For two blissful years, Soryung's world revolved around her husband—until he vanished without a trace. In her search for answers, she learns the heartbreaking truth that he was never hers to begin with. But she's not about to let him slip away, even if he is a black ops agent with a hundred faces...

(Source: Manta)

title: No Moral
synopsis:
I'll see you in court... I hope!

Yunshin Do is a young and compassionate lawyer who gets recruited by a corporate law firm. His boss, Seheon Kang, is a domineering partner who prioritizes paychecks and only looks out for himself. Will Yunshin be able to prove his worth in court and find a way to melt his boss's ice-cold heart?

(Source: Manta)

title: Paws & Claws
synopsis:
Life sure is ruff, especially when you're Gyeon Heeseong. Abandoned by his pack of fellow dog shifters, he is forced to become a drug runner for a gambling ring. For his final job, he comes face to face with Savage Fang, the ruthless Wolf Den enforcer Yoon Chi-young. Everything goes (nearly) according to plan, but on his way back he is attacked and forced to return to his fearsome(?) true form...a little white cottonball of a puppy! After Chi-young finds Heeseong struggling on the streets, he takes him in, believing him to be nothing more than a stray. Will Heeseong be able to escape the ruthless, terrifying outpour of love Chi-young showers him with and escape his criminal past? Or will he be forever leashed to a life of kibble and kennels?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Nerd Project
synopsis:
Luke is having a rough time in college, and his breakup with his girlfriend Stacy is not helping. This is all because of that nerdy stud, Andrew! If only Stacy didn't obsess over Andrew's dorky charms, then Luke wouldn't have had to break their relationship off! To make matters worse, Luke is then forced to live in the same dorm room as Andrew! But with nowhere else to go and no money to his name, Luke resolves to make it his project to befriend Andrew, whether the nerd likes it or not!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kiss Me, Liar
synopsis:
Yeonwoo is a perfectly competent secretary. However, he's secretly in love with his boss, an extreme alpha named Keith, who has zero interest in male omegas. After a traumatic incident leaves Yeonwoo fearful of all alphas but Keith, he resigns to hide at home. Keith, inconvenienced by the absence of his trusty secretary, takes on the task of helping Yeonwoo recover. Will proximity and pheromones cause love to blossom in this working relationship?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kiss Me, Liar Side Story
title_japanese: 키스 미, 라이어(Kiss Me, Liar) 외전

title: Kiss Me If You Can
synopsis:
"Six months... Just six months, and it'll all be over." After a one-night stand with Hollywood top star Chase Miller, Joshua finds out he's pregnant. As a single father, Joshua raises their child in secrecy. But when he is forced to return to work as Chase's bodyguard, the two are reunited in a cruel twist of fate. Relieved that Chase doesn't seem to remember him, Josh's comfort is short lived—something primal, something desperate, yearns for the touch of his former lover, and every time he sees this beautifully twisted man, Josh's heart races in spite of his mind. The more time passes, the more boundaries blur as instinct takes over... Will Joshua be able to resist the lips of his former lover? Or are the strings of fate too strong to resist?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Codename: Anastasia
synopsis:
Agent Kwon Taekjoo is dispatched to Russia with two tasks. First, he must find "Anastasia," a new weapon that could change the world forever. Second, he is to avoid Russia's psychotic killer, Psikh Bognadov, at all costs. To assist him on his undercover mission, Taekjoo is sent a partner who only reveals himself to be a man named Zhenya. But Zhenya quickly proves himself to be just as dangerous and unhinged as the infamous Psikh himself. Just who could he truly be? And will Taekjoo succeed in tracking down "Anastasia"?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Netkama PUNCH!!!
synopsis:
Netkama—a male who portrays himself as female online. This is what Kim Seyeong decides to become after reencountering Shin Heejae, the guy who destroyed Seyeong's gaming career in "Arcadia" a year prior. His plan is to pretend to be a girl in the game, get Heejae to fall for him, and then make the big reveal to everyone so that his archnemesis will also be humiliated out of "Arcadia" forever. But being a dude trying to become the girlfriend of your worst enemy is no easy feat, especially more so when said worst enemy starts to show a bit too much interest in you. Will Seyeong come out the victor of this scheme? Or will he find himself losing to Heejae all over again?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Red Thread Quest
synopsis:
As a first-year law student, Lee Yeon never expected to cross paths again with his middle school crush—the charming upperclassman Hong Kihoon. But a chance reunion on campus leads to an even more unexpected twist: a spontaneous trip, and a strange challenge known only as the Red Thread Quest.

Red Thread Quest, Round 1: Five Kisses on the Cheek!

Skeptical about soulmates and fate, Yeon finds himself drawn into the legend of the Red Thread of Fate—and as each round of the quest unfolds, his relationship with Kihoon begins to take an unpredictable turn.

What started as a game might just lead them to something real...if the Red Thread Rock has anything to say about it.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Ranker's Return
synopsis:
During the early years of the hottest MMORPG called Arena, the world's top ranker Meleegod vanished after setting every possible record in the virtual world. In the real world, this deathly melee damage dealer was the happy-go-lucky Kang Hyeonu, who simply deleted his character and quit his hobby to finish mandatory military service and inherit his father's company. This rosy future dissolves within two years when a business rival makes his father go bankrupt. Hyeonu struggles to make ends meet with a string of part-time jobs, but his best friend has a better idea. He urges Hyeonu to conquer the Arena once again and earn a cushy living as a gaming celebrity. Vowing to strike it rich and avenge his father, the former Meleegod returns to the Arena as a newbie. Only this time, he's out for blood!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: The Pizza Delivery Man and the Gold Palace
title_english: The Pizza Delivery Man and the Gold Palace
synopsis:
Woo-won is a pizza delivery guy down on his luck, and Seo-an is wealthy man suffering from panic attacks and social phobia. You wouldn't think these two would have any reason to get to know one another, but one small kindness leads to a series of encounters that bring the two men closer together than either of them anticipated. Maybe they can find the solutions to their problems together... or perhaps they don't need solutions, but simply each other.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Borderline
synopsis:
When Hwang Mok-yeon's friend-with-benefits Chae Sunhwa proposes a threesome, he's only mildly intrigued until he hears who the third is. His target? Eun Nanjo: wealthy, polite, and perfectly presentable...but, according to Sunhwa, hopelessly boring in bed.

At first, it's just curiosity. But once the three of them are tangled in sheets, Mok-yeon finds he can't take his eyes off Nanjo...not even for a moment. And when he realizes Nanjo may be more interested in saving Sunhwa than claiming him, Mok-yeon makes a quiet, dangerous offer.

He leans in and says, "I want you. Do you think you could spread your legs for me?"

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Night Without Shadows
synopsis:
Beware, for the shadow speaks.

When junior knight Roselyn is rescued from the bottom of a cliff after an ambush by an enemy kingdom, her brother Calix is relieved—that is, until he learns that she's lost her memory. Now, she behaves like a child, eats like a horse, and wields unbelievable strength. But something's not quite right...

(Source: Manta)

title: Die Melusine
synopsis:
My serenade, my Kieron.

During one of his conquests, the heartless Archduke Kieron discovers Melusine, a mermaid in captivity. Their bond deepens, but according to legend, mermaids must kill their lovers to return to the sea. Melusine cannot bear to harm Kieron and leaves instead. What cruel fate awaits the lovers?

(Source: Manta)

title: Third Ending
synopsis:
Suh Yoonseul has had life easy—everyone likes him, he's good at his job, basically everything has always worked out as smooth as butter. However, there's something that brings all of his good luck down, and it's the infrequent dreams he has of Kang Jun. Who knew that rejecting a guy once would hang so heavy on your life? To make things worse, after he runs into Jun the dreams keep on coming daily. At his wit's end, Yoonseul takes some advice from a friend so that he can free himself from this jinx. It's simple. Make Kang Jun think that he's a nice person. That can't be hard, right?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Winter Wolf
synopsis:
Is it safe to fall in love with you?

After losing her family to the revolt, noblewoman Lysithea hires Taron, a strapping young broker, to help her flee the kingdom. But when a heavy snowstorm strands the bickering pair in an eerie abandoned mansion, Lysithea has no choice but to rely on her new partner. What dangerous romance awaits them?

(Source: Manta)

title: It Was Just a Contractual Marriage
title_english: It Was Just a Contractual Marriage
synopsis:
I, the last princess, will use you to survive!

As the last remaining member of the imperial family, Elise must do whatever she can to survive and someday reclaim her empire, even if that means marrying the archduke of an enemy nation and promising to bear his child! As a dragonborn, he needs an heir, and it's not as though he loves her... right?

(Source: Manta)

title: Burning Effect
synopsis:
In a world where the smallest offense warrants the death penalty, Burner’s plan was to keep her head down and get the hell out of Area 5. But after reaching her breaking point, she suddenly finds herself a wanted criminal at odds with the Central Bureau and its most powerful Admin, Great. As she begins to discover her own powers and gain new allies, all-out war breaks out between the government and the revolution. Will a rag-tag team of rebels be enough to win the fight to define justice?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Traces of the Sun
synopsis:
I can help you kill your friends.

Strange dungeons have started appearing all over the world and wreaking havoc. Yiseon, a guy with the power to rebuild cities, witnesses his friends being turned into the undead. Hyeon, a powerful hunter, comes to him with an interesting proposition. Yiseon has no choice but to accept his offer.

(Source: Manta)

title: Predatory Marriage
synopsis:
"Remember? I promised to ruin your life."

When Leah, a devoted princess, faces a tragic downfall, she plots one final revenge against the royal family by becoming an impure bride. Later, when her one-night stand unexpectedly appears, Leah finds herself unable to resist him as he brings madness into her once orderly life.

(Source: Manta)

title: Crimson Karma
synopsis:
Kasiya, a fearless warrior, embarks on a daring solo mission to take down the enemy's most powerful leader. Little does she know that the very allies she trusted have set this mission as a trap, which leaves her fighting for her life. When Kasiya awakens from one perilous encounter, the world around her has transformed into a realm teeming with knights, sorcerers, and royalty. Suddenly thrust into this dangerous dimension, she must unlock the secrets of this new realm in order to survive as it tests her skills, courage, and cunning.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Turning
synopsis:
"I thought I had lost my future forever... But the moment I realized that it had returned to me, my hands trembled with both joy and wonder."

Yudrein Ail is a commoner who was bestowed with powers on the night the Red Stone fell. He is also the first omega to rise to the rank of Imperial Trooper, but was accused of a crime he didn't commit and executed soon after—only to reawaken eleven years ago, before the war began. He can't repeat the mistakes of his past...to survive is to save the world. But in order to do so, he must prevent the man he killed from facing his inevitable death.

"The future won't be the same. I'll make sure of it."

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Getting to Know Grace
synopsis:
Andrew is the only daughter of the famous Grace family. She also has an incurable disease. Due to her family's high status in society, Andrew grew up with no friends save for her maid, Herta, whom she has become intensely infatuated with. Little does she know, her family is responsible for ruining Herta's life. Can Andrew break the hierarchy and be with her? Or will Herta end her suffering first...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Origin of Species
synopsis:
Lee Youngjin has never been like other Omegas. Rather than being physically superior to humans like the rest of his species, Youngjin is a gifted hacker. But when his talent leads him to an ill-fated heist mission, Youngjin finds himself trapped in the clutches of a powerful Alpha businessman named Seo Seunghyun. Now, he must do anything he can to guarantee safety for himself and his colleagues - even if it means sleeping with the enemy. But as the business deal between Youngjin and Seunghyun quickly becomes more personal, will they be able to see eye to eye? Or will their differences be too much to overcome?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Antidote
synopsis:
Two years ago, the great lord Sylhan was stripped of his title and status, reduced to a life of mania, amnesia, and slavery. He is resigned to his newfound lack of freedom, until a knight appears in front of him. A gentle hand around his waist, sweet lips pressed upon his own, and a deep connection forged in the unknowable past: Sylhan is confused, but unable to stop himself from being drawn ever closer to the mysterious man. The once proud lord can no longer lay claim to glory, wealth, or power...but what about love?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Shounen Seiai
synopsis:
1. Koakuma no Shoumei
2. Koakuma ga Kitari te Haru wo Uru
3. Mao-chin♂Natsu-zakari!
4. Kimi wo Metoru Hi
5. Kagoiri Musume
6. Ore ga Ichiban Aishiteru!
7. Yameru Toki mo Kore wo Aishi
8. Sea Side Pork
9. Kimi wa Marude Onnanoko
10. Kotora to Ookami
11. Chikan Densha Kissa
12. Ushimitsudoki no Raihousha

title: Guard Pass
synopsis:
While Sejun Im settles things with his fists, his best friend, Hajin Seo, eats and breathes grappling. Together, they fend off bullies on their school campus, but everything changes after a fight that sets Sejun on a mission to hold those responsible accountable for their crimes. What began as a schoolroom brawl quickly turns into a fight for justice and truth as Sejun hits the streets looking for any leads as to what happened on that fateful day.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: A Lovely Meal
synopsis:
One snowy winter evening, Changdeok spots a high schooler crouched in front of his favorite restaurant, blood running ice-cold in the falling snow. Lured in by the promise of meal made just like the restaurant's, Changdeok ends up inviting the boy—Jongwu—into his home; after all, Changdeok's life is as dry as day-old rice, and food is his only joy. So when Jongwu offers to cook him a delicious dinner every night in exchange for a place to stay, he reluctantly agrees. But as their unusual cohabitation begins, Changdeok can't shake this bloody feeling that Jongwoo might be hiding something... Hopefully being a good Samaritan doesn't come back around to bite him in the neck- er, butt...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Subaru to Subaru
synopsis:
One year after Takumi Fujiwara's student Kanata Rivington tore it up on Japan's mega-popular MFG street racing circuit, two new drivers are itching to try their luck at the event. Their names: Subaru Sato, from Gunma Prefecture, and Subaru Kudo, from Kanagawa. The worlds of Initial D and MF Ghost meld into one as these two Subarus join together to weave the ultimate street racing legend!

(Source: Kodansha)

title: The Foul
synopsis:
Ever since inheriting his father's debt as a teenager, Joo Hawon has been doing whatever it takes to buy his freedom back, whether that means working as a VIP dealer in the casinos of Macau, or taking other riskier jobs. In a world where money is worth more than lives, Hawon knows he's always walking a fine line. But when a mysterious casino guest by the name of Kwon Taeha offers to pay off his debt if he successfully finishes a job on a cruise ship, it's too good an offer to turn down–despite his instincts warning him of obvious danger. With lives and livelihoods at stake, could this man be Hawon's savior? Or will he be the devil that lures Hawon to depths deeper than he ever imagined?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Otona no Koi wa, Yabusaka ni Tsuki.
title_japanese: おとなの恋は、やぶさかにつき。

title: Love History Caused by Willful Negligence
title_english: Love History Caused by Willful Negligence
synopsis:
Woo-yeon is one of the brightest rising stars as a nationally beloved actor. Nobody is capable of hating such a talented and sweet man with his blessed looks. Or, well, that's what people who don't know the real Woo-yeon think. In reality, Woo-yeon is manipulative, cold-hearted, and dangerous. But his new manager In-seob is his biggest fan, and he's determined to stick by Woo-yeon's side no matter what. Except...remember how nobody in the know is capable of hating Wooyeon? Well, In-seob just might know more than he lets on...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Big Apple
synopsis:
Joachim Hjerpe is the one and only sniper of the Secret Intelligence Agency, an organization of individuals with very special abilities. The life of a sniper is extremely stressful, but quitting is not an option, as doing so could mean his own death. His only reprieve is meeting with his seductive and handsome lover, Juergen Eisler, who knows exactly how to fulfill Joachim's needs. But when the dangers of his professional life threaten to invade his personal life, Joachim decides to part ways with Juergen before it's too late. Juergen has no idea why Joachim suddenly wants to break up, and he'd sooner keep Joachim in shackles than let him walk out of his life. Will Juergen be able to persuade Joachim to tell him the truth?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: The Dirtiest High
synopsis:
A one-night stand turns into a messy love story.

Josh, a brilliant lawyer and obsessive neat freak, is coping with a broken engagement. The only upside? His firm changed cleaning services. But when the new cleaner is Angel—his one-night stand from last night—chaos ensues. Is this love or just a messy disaster waiting to unfold?

(Source: Manta)

title: Profundis
synopsis:
13 years ago, Baek Yugeon and his brother were the sole survivors of a mysterious anomaly attack, leaving them "awakened." While his brother obtained supernatural powers, Yugeon became a "guide," a being who is able to keep such powers under control through physical touch. When the same anomaly appears again, Yugeon's brother is left in critical condition with the only one who can save him being Woo Shinje, an S-class awakened and the commander of the hunting order, Erewhon. In exchange, Yugeon must serve as the guide to Shinje's team, which consists of the withdrawn Joo Taein, the beastly Yoon Chan, and the sadistic Kwon Heesu. Though Shinje seems like the nicest on the team, he might prove to be the most dangerous when he states another condition: Yugeon must follow him into the pit where the very anomaly responsible for all his tragedies awaits...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Savor the Taste
synopsis:
Can a princess's food save a kingdom?

Luana is reborn as an illegitimate princess inside a book. Resigned to her fate, she decides to spend her days cooking. Not long after, the cursed Duke Legion arrives and sacks the kingdom, but instead of falling for the princess, he's bewitched by Luana's food. He orders her to cook for him or die!

(Source: Manta)

title: Prison Love
synopsis:
There's more to her than meets the eye...

Having always been a good girl, Shushu is horrified when she's suddenly framed for murder and locked up in an all women's prison. To survive, she becomes the prison wife of her intimidating yet beautiful cellmate, Minicat. But is Minicat all that she... or he appears?

(Source: Manta)

title: My Egocentric Boss Is Obsessed With Me
title_english: My Egocentric Boss Is Obsessed With Me
synopsis:
For the chronically single and overworked Soohan, thirsting over his boss's firm booty is his greatest guilty pleasure. It's sad and pathetic, but after a long string of lousy exes and an even longer dry spell, the handsome and talented Mr. Woo seems just that much hotter. Sure, he comes with blazing red flags like his egocentric personality, his bizarre preferences, and his sadistic tendency to overwork his employees. But as off-putting as these qualities are, they aren't enough to deter Soohan's massive crush— especially when the man keeps calling him "babe" and giving him special attention outside the office. Why on earth is his demonic yet charming boss asking him to pick out his bedroom sheets and cooking him his favorite dinner when they aren't even dating? Though he doesn't want to get his hopes up, Soohan can't help but wonder whether his self-centered boss is actually obsessed with him...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Terrarium Adventure
synopsis:
I'm a zillionaire in a gacha game!

Obsessed with the clicker game Infinite Diamonds for over a year, Jaehee finally reaches the ultimate in-game achievement—only to suddenly find herself in the RPG gacha game Terrarium Adventure! Why was she pulled into the game, and how can she get out? For now, she has no choice but to explore!

(Source: Manta)

title: Gig of the Day
synopsis:
When debt leads to desire.

Yeomin is a college student juggling part-time jobs to repay his family's loans. But when a mysterious thug comes after him, things take a turn. To his surprise, this handsome heir wants more than just money—he's after something much more enticing. Can Yeomin resist the temptation?

(Source: Manta)

title: Finders Keepers
synopsis:
After his shaman grandfather passes away, Yoon Dam suddenly gains the ability to see ghosts—a gift he would rather not have. The only solution? The power of a goblin. Enter Lee Dohan, who claims to be exactly that. But there's a catch: every time Dohan tries to harm Yoon Dam, mysterious wounds appear on his own body instead. Intrigued by this bizarre connection, Dohan proposes a deal: "Why not just let me be your tutor?" Bound by strange circumstances and their own hidden agendas, the two set off on a journey neither of them could have imagined...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Kill Me Now
synopsis:
Haegu, a proficient and merciless hitwoman, executes a man in front of his own daughter and takes the child under her wing. She decides to name her Mian, the word for "sorry" in Korean, and gives her one mission: "Kill me when you can." From that moment on, Mian decides that she will do this by choking Haegu with feigned love and emotionally manipulating her into submission. But as Mian grows into an adult, she's thrown into confusion as what was supposed to be pure revenge turns into lust... and possibly real love. Meanwhile, Haegu grapples with her own feelings for Mian while continuing to carry out life-threatening missions. Can Haegu and Mian ever learn to truly love each other, or are they doomed to drown in their toxic cycle of violence and revenge?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Into the Rose Garden
title_japanese: 인투 더 로즈 가든 (Into the Rose Garden)
synopsis:
Count Aeroc Teiwind, a youthful aristocrat of noble lineage, finds himself captivated the moment he sees Kloff Bendyke, baron of a small countryside estate. Despite the disparities in their social standings, their wealth, and the unusual circumstance of them both being alphas, Aeroc still boldly professes his affections. However, Kloff chooses to wed one of Aeroc's kin instead. Consumed by jealousy, Aeroc calls for a harrowing punishment. Reeling from the consequences of Aeroc's actions, Kloff swears to seek revenge...no matter the cost.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Cozy Obsession
synopsis:
Huimin Seo happened to read a tragic BL novel where the two main characters had both his name and even his best friend's name, Iheon Cha. But rather than remaining as an incredible coincidence, this book becomes a new reality for Huimin. Before he knows it, he is transmigrated right into a major scene in the novel where Huimin Seo, a rare dominant omega, gets bought off in an auction by Iheon Cha, a powerful dominant alpha. Aware of the complications in this love-hate relationship that he cannot escape from, Huimin must tread carefully to turn things around entirely.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Salty Lust
synopsis:
Saying bye-bye to Earth and blasting off to school in space was a dream come true for Nux. But no one told him how mediocre he would seem stacked up against the brightest minds in the universe. With lackluster grades that could never afford him a scholarship, he's forced into illegal part-time work just to pay the bills. But when a handsome alien propositions him with an offer to make his money problems disappear, he realizes it comes at an astronomical price.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Beware the Ides of March
synopsis:
Ex-convict Park Mokhwa wants nothing more than to keep his head low and stay out of anything that has to do with his past. However, his new-found tranquility as a florist is shattered by the appearance of Kim Nakwon, corrupt cop and unabashed hedonist. Nakwon is sure that Mokhwa's the key to cracking an important case, and he'll do anything to get the taciturn man to talk. The best way to make someone confess is to cause them pain, and Nakwon thinks he knows just what'll hurt Mokhwa the most. But despite Nakwon's best efforts, Mokhwa continues to stay silent. It's not often that life doesn't go the way Nakwon wants it to, so his obsession with Mokhwa only grows stronger...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Diss Love
synopsis:
Eyan is a Korean songwriter who has been struggling with a slump. Despite wanting to write love songs, he can't force himself to. Due to his job, Eyan starts working with the hottest rising star in the K-hiphop industry, Cha Hyunho, who is famous for writing psycho songs despite being a good person in real life. Though he catches Eyan's eye, Eyan forces himself to brush off his growing feelings for Hyunho, for the sake of both of their careers, but, because they're signed on the same label, Eyan and Hyunho keep ending up together...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: I Got Pregnant With the Tyrant's Child
title_english: I Got Pregnant With the Tyrant's Child
synopsis:
For Elan the royal knight, the masquerade festival is a rare chance to let loose and relax. But her night of fun quickly turns into a morning of horror when she wakes up beside the ruthless Emperor Kylart. Knowing how cruel he can be to clingy women, Elan makes a run for it, hoping he hasn't seen past her disguise. But as she continues her nerve-wracking duties of guarding the emperor, she starts experiencing troubling health symptoms. A trip to the doctor reveals that she's pregnant! To make matters worse, rumor has it that Kylart is looking for the mysterious woman he met on the night of the festival. Can Elan keep her secret safe from the entire palace, when she can't even control her constant cravings and morning sickness?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Dear. Door
synopsis:
After a devastating personal loss, Kyungjoon wants nothing more than to drown his grief in the silence and safety of his houseplants. But Kyungjoon is also a cop, and it's a cop's job to go after criminals.

One day, hot pursuit of a suspect leads to Kyungjoon discovering signs of cult activity. Soon, the policeman is caught up in the machinations of monsters and demons, the worst of which is the demon king, Lord Cain, whose survival in this world depends on mana that can only be accessed through a "door." Cain's door happens to be inside Kyungjoon, and these two will have to get up close and very personal to open it.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Concubine Walkthrough
synopsis:
At first, Yona gave some major side-eye to the popular game "Concubine Walkthrough" until she got sucked into it—literally! Now stuck as the villain, she has her hands full facing the infamously cruel emperor, shaking off scheming concubines, and befriending NPCs. There's only one way the Game Master will let her out and that's to become the Empress! Will she be able to stay true to her honest and straightforward self despite the palace's intrigues? One extra problem: she's got competition...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Interview with a Murderer
synopsis:
As a reporter, Clark has interviewed many criminals but never a murderer. Enter Alex, the Triage Killer. A serial killer who kills in three, he agrees to an interview so long as Clark offers one thing in return: himself. Murder after murder, question after question, Clark will learn why Alex kills. And Alex... he will learn Clark isn't as innocent as he seems.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Automata
synopsis:
In the future, a mysterious entity called "A-R" has bridged the real and cyber dimension, advancing humankind. Meanwhile, agents of the global conglomerate ATMT directly interface into tech networks to maintain and upgrade machines. When some of these "Automata" discover unexpected new powers in the realm of everything that's connected, sides are chosen between rogue units, viruses, and even the corporation itself. Sharle, a newbie Automata, and his supporter CC now seek answers as they navigate an underworld of dangerous bytes that's about to burst onto reality.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Kneel Before Me
synopsis:
In the storm sleeps a giant...

When the unfaithful crown prince calls off their marriage, Lady Kyrie is exiled to a remote cottage. On the way, she discovers a hidden village while avoiding a snowstorm. It's there "the end" is awakened... and it's starting to become obsessed with her.

(Source: Manta)

Taeyang thought he'd never see Jiwan again after their messy breakup, but fate and the media have other plans. Now a heroic firefighter with a documentary deal, Taeyang reunites with his producer ex at the broadcasting station... except Jiwan is doing everything he can to avoid him. But then, why does he have a seven-year-old kid with the same name as Taeyang? Once he secures seven dates with Jiwan as "payment" for using his name, it's up to Taeyang to do some detective work and win over his reluctant ex in seven sundays.

(Source: Tappytoon)

synopsis:
Kyuho has become smitten with new club member, Yoongun. Not only is Yoongun's face gorgeous but there's something about the way he stands his ground confidently. As the two classmates get to know each other, Kyuho starts falling for Yoongun even harder. But when, out of the blue, Yoongun says, "you're not my style," to Kyuho, the two start a love-hate relationship for the ages.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

synopsis:
Yoon Byeol's world is turned upside down when his brother, Hyesung, gets into an accident. But when Byeol visits him in the hospital, he's surprised to find him in an expensive private room and learns that Hyesung received compensation for the incident. When he goes to confront Sung Woon, the person who pushed his brother down the stairs, Byeol is met with another surprise: Woon knows about a dark side of Hyesung that is hard to believe. What is their relationship, and why would Woon push him?

title: I Became the Lousy Side Top
title_english: I Became the Lousy Side Top
synopsis:
Seo Jaewoo wakes up to find himself in the world of a BL novel. But he isn't just any random person. He's actually the lousy side top character who's meant to torment the main bottom, Yoo Hyeonjin. What's worse is that by the novel's conclusion, all of Jaewoo's despicable actions catch up to him, and he is killed by the story's crazy main top and Hyeonjin's love interest, Choi Mujin. In order to avoid his death, Jaewoo decides to change his original role and get on Hyeonjin's good side. His method: lure him in with food, of course! While his tactic proves effective and he slowly befriends Hyeonjin, that doesn't become the only major change to the plot. After an unexpected encounter with Mujin, Jaewoo's position as the "lousy side top" gets completely flipped upside down...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Hair-Raising Desires
synopsis:
Hong Danwoo, a man in his 20s with wild hair, has been avoiding hair salons for years due to a private secret—having his head touched tends to raise his "other head." However, when his boss asks him to tidy up his appearance, Danwoo can no longer avoid the salons. When he reluctantly steps into one, he encounters the strikingly attractive stylist, Taehan. As the man trims his unruly mop, Danwoo quickly gets turned on. And with his huge secret out, Danwoo finds both his hair and body tangled in quite a mess!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Honey Bear
synopsis:
Moon Geonwoo's first love comes crashing into him smelling like the sweetest cookie around! After learning he's a new bakery owner in town named Yoo Hajin, Geonwoo asks him for a part-time job in the hopes of winning over his heart. Unfortunately, his plan is doomed from the start as Hajin is completely done with relationships now. But a little pushback is hardly an issue for the ace judo athlete Geonwoo. He's prepared to do anything to make Hajin fall for him, even if that means letting the baker squeeze his hot buns...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Monochrome Diary
synopsis:
Yoojoon is a good boy. That's why he was destined to fall head-over-heels for the handsome and charismatic Jiho. When Jiho says "Jump," Yoojoon asks "How high?" And as the pair become more inseparable by the day, they solidify their master-dog dynamic. But little do they know, each boy is harboring his own dark secret. Jiho, who suffers from severe apathy resulting from childhood trauma, is using Yoojoon as an expendable toy, and Yoojoon is intensely and obsessively in love with Jiho. Despite that, can the two boys successfully remove each other's masks and break the cycle of abuse?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Sunday's Solace
synopsis:
Jeong Rawon absolutely hates work and tries his best to appear as average as possible, awaiting retirement while dreaming of a life free of disturbance. However, for reasons Rawon cannot guess, the Songyeon Group heir and director Hyeon Zeo takes an interest in him. While Zeo is handsome, he is blunt to the point of rudeness with the inappropriate things he says to Rawon. But the last item on Rawon's life plan is to stir up trouble, so he allows for some mannerly banter.

Rawon's knack for public relations does not escape Zeo, and he is assigned to a two-month special team preparing to launch a luxurious resort on Jeju Island. Rawon would rather not let go of his peaceful Sundays, but he sullenly packs his bags and boards the plane to Jeju. Yet as the long work hours put them in constant proximity, Rawon finds Zeo's attention harder to dismiss.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Undercover Princess
synopsis:
A prosecutor-turned-royal must race against the clock to solve a string of serial murders… before she becomes the next victim! When an overworked criminal justice employee is suddenly reborn into a novel as the rebellious Princess Charlotte, she also finds herself engaged to the handsome Duke Adler. However, there's one big problem: according to the novel's synopsis, Charlotte is doomed to be killed on her wedding night, and the duke is the prime suspect. Now this princess must go undercover to capture the culprit behind the series of sinister crimes… and maybe capture some hearts along the way!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: To the Witch Who Forgot Her Bird
title_english: To the Witch Who Forgot Her Bird
synopsis:
Prince Alec, the troublemaker of the Royal Family, runs into some trouble himself when he discovers he is being hunted by assassins. With magic involved in this deadly scheme, the only one who can protect him is Victoria, the Witch of Bitter Cold, who offers her help in exchange for a "small" favor. But as her title implies, Victoria is devoid of human emotions and will stop at nothing to get what she wants. Although Prince Alec tries to maintain some distance between them, this proves to be difficult the longer he is stuck with his icy protector...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Sparkling Baby
synopsis:
While in New York, Yujin, a talented young photographer, is captivated by Hanjoon, a renowned fashion magazine director. They share a few drinks and a hotel bed, but Hanjoon leaves in the morning without a word, not expecting to see Yujin again. Years later, Yujin, now a prominent figure in his field, lands a job at Hanjoon's magazine in Korea. As Yujin's feelings for Hanjoon grow, Hanjoon can't seem to get over his ex. Will Hanjoon be able to move past his previous heartbreak and find new love?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Beau and the Beast
synopsis:
I've become a big, hairy beast!

After getting into a car accident, Hanbyul wakes up in the body of a princess. But something's wrong; she's doubled in size, grown hair everywhere, and seems to terrify everyone who looks her way—she's become a beast! How will she live on as the cursed Princess Alexa?

(Source: Manta)

title: Totem's Realm
synopsis:
Who's this mysterious Tarzan?

In a crazy turn of events, Sera, an office worker, is stranded on a remote island and captured by a native tribe. A mysterious Tarzan-esque man rescues her, but it turns out he's also on the run. As they flee the tribes that are after them, Sera develops a special power she can't quite understand. She also feels attracted to the strange man... 

(Source: Manta)

title: Ballboy Tactics
synopsis:
After retiring from gymnastics, Han Jiwon thought his biggest challenges were behind him. Turns out, winning Olympic medals was easy compared to surviving university as a painfully shy ex-superstar. Enter Kwon Jungwoo—campus heartthrob, basketball star, and a whole new world of trouble wrapped up in a perfect smile. But just when Jiwon thinks he has Jungwoo figured out, he discovers a surprisingly sweet side beneath that cold exterior. Can this unlikely duo overcome their differences and stick the landing on their budding romance?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Akuyaku Reijou no Tsuihougo! Kyoukai Kaikaku Gohan de Yuuyuu Sister-gurashi
title_japanese: 悪役令嬢の追放後! 教会改革ごはんで悠々シスター暮らし
synopsis:
Reincarnated as the villainess, Elizabeth Fontini fought against her fate, but it was all for naught. Repeated misunderstandings compounded with unfortunate circumstances lead to her inevitable downfall, and Elizabeth is banished to the nunnery.

However, what most thought to be punishment is actually Elizabeth's long-awaited freedom! Life as a sister isn't too bad, but her short respite is muddled by the arrival of Leonid Guardhelm, the head knight of her former kingdom. Not even he can put a damper on the optimistic girl's mood. Utilizing her past life's experiences as an event planner, Elizabeth sets out to revolutionize culinary arts and bring a sweet flavor to everyone's lives, one home-cooked dish at a time.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: For My Own Good
synopsis:
The only way out is through.

In the midst of a disastrous monster attack fated to end the world, a strange device throws Heejae back in time 20 years where he meets the students of his foster father, Seokyoung. Now it's up to him to take them under his wing and stop the apocalypse so he can finally set off for a peaceful life.

(Source: Manta)

title: Youkai Taisakuka no Hibi
title_english: A Day in the Life of the Yokai Division
synopsis:
Ayumu Hibi works at the city hall of an ordinary town. As part of the Youkai Division, he responds to daily reports of Youkai-related incidents from citizens. What kind of cases await him today...?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Tempest Night
synopsis:
A romance of temptation and trepidation.

Eunha, a peasant girl, is asked by a blind nobleman, Jihak, to become his reading assistant. Though reluctant, she accepts the shady Jihak's offer in hopes of earning enough money to free her sister from the courtesan life. And thus begins a dangerous romance of hidden intentions and passion.

(Source: Manta)

title: Rainbow City
synopsis:
Amidst a worldwide zombie apocalypse, genius researcher Doctor Hwa Seok's predecessor has been murdered. Now, Hwa Seok has been assigned the best bodyguard the military can offer, but Major Suhwan Kwak certainly has better things to do than protect a delicate, oddball scientist—like getting him into bed, for example. Doctor Seok can tolerate Major Kwak's brash, crass, and impassioned behavior, but with a murderer at large, can he trust him with his life?

(Source: Tapas)

title: Mr.A's Farm
synopsis:
Little A travels to a rural farm to reunite with the uncle who raised him—only to find the place eerily silent and his uncle nowhere in sight. What awaits him is a chilling "bible" detailing how to care for the livestock... but something feels off.

Because on this farm, the "livestock" aren't animals—they're humans.

Now thrust into the role of acting farm manager, little A is forced to manage Mr. A's Farm, a facility that produces livestock products using beast-like humans—creatures who think and act like people but are bred for their byproducts.

Dark secrets plague the estate in the uncle's absence. Little A must do all he can to keep the farm safe and sound... at least until his missing uncle, Mr. A, comes back.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Undefeatable Swordsman
synopsis:
The son of a lowly innkeeper, Wumoon Song always dreamed of being a martial arts master, a dream that would never become a reality thanks to his frail body. Then one night, a mysterious guest leaves behind a painting as payment that enthralls Wumoon for reasons he can't explain. It soon becomes clear that it's no ordinary painting when Wumoon starts showing prowess in the martial arts he's never had before. Thus begins the path for a scatterbrained kid to change his destiny and become truly undefeatable!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Flower of Allure
synopsis:
Iyeon wanted a quiet life as an arborist—but hidden upstairs is a comatose killer who once tried to murder her. When he wakes with no memory, she panics... and lies: "I'm your wife." Can she survive the man who doesn't remember her—or what he did?

(Source: Manta)

title: Answer Me, My Prince
synopsis:
Cordelia Grey, an editor at a publishing company, is given a manuscript of the sequel to The Princess and the Knight along with a vintage chest. But when she wakes up the next morning, the manuscript she placed in the chest is gone—a letter is in its place. It's from none other than Prince Archie Albert, the handsome playboy and protagonist from the novel. What begins as curiosity morphs into a deep friendship, but can they stop themselves from developing feelings for one another, and will they ever get to meet in person?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: I Can See Your Stats!
synopsis:
An estate to manage, a lover to tame.

Following the gruesome death of his family, mage Eyra inherits the Solath Estate and becomes a lord overnight, only to discover that he can suddenly see the stats of everyone he meets. Enter Yanu, a dashing jack-of-all-trades who seems hell-bent on distracting him from his newfound duties...

(Source: Manta)

title: The Golden-Haired Summoner
synopsis:
Following the trauma of a studying-induced death, Jinny is reborn into a fantastical realm filled with magic, orcs, and talking spirits. As Geenie Crowell, the daughter of a noble and a bona fide genius, everyone has big plans for her, including her new parents, teachers, and even the king! Not too keen on all these high expectations that might end badly for her again, Geenie thinks up the perfect way out from slaving over a hot magic wand: if she becomes a summoner, she'll be able to summon a spirit and have them do all the work!

But Geenie will soon learn that there's more to it all than just adorable spirit companions and collecting mana. Being a summoner comes with great responsibility–and dangerous consequences as well.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Date Me, Too!
synopsis:
At a college welcome party, Kang Juyeong overhears a juicy rumor about Choi Hyun, a popular student from the Physical Education department—apparently, he accepts professions of love from almost anyone, even strangers. As the drinks flow, the conversation escalates into a daring bet: whoever confesses their love to Choi Hyun wins 100 dollars.

Uncomfortable with the vibe, Juyeong leaves the party, only to run into Choi Hyun as he's breaking up with someone. Seizing the moment, Juyeong blurts out: "Go out with me too!"

But unlike the others, Juyeong's profession isn't just a spur-of-the-moment gamble—he's been secretly in love with Choi Hyun since high school. With Hyun caught off guard and no way to take it back, the two start dating that very night.

Will Juyeong's long-time crush turn into a lasting relationship, or is this love destined to be just another fleeting romance?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)
