Choi Jihu works as secretary to Jung Dawon, the CEO of Seungjin Corporation. On the surface, he seems like just another ordinary employee, but he's hiding a dangerous secret - he's received an offer promising an enormous sum of money in exchange for a damning video that could jeopardize Dawon's inheritance of the company. Hoping to make a big break, Jihu carefully collects evidence in secret. But one day, he gets caught...by Dawon himself! However, instead of reacting with anger, Dawon jumps to an unpredictable conclusion: "Secretary Choi, do you love me?" Panicked, Jihu blurts out a response without thinking: "Yes! I love you!" Having fallen head-over-heels for his secretary, Dawon is about to show Jihu what it means to be loved until you're dog-tired!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Secondo Piatto
synopsis:
Tae Hyeonwook, a police officer and an unexpected foodie, conceals his dejected heart when he hears that two of his friends, Minseok and Heeseon, will get married soon. Although his romantic relationship with Heeseon fizzled out in high school, Hyeonwook remained a good friend to her, though he still harbored feelings for her. After the couple held their wedding at a restaurant Minseok's friend, Seo Wonyoung, owns, Hyeonwook sees Wonyoung sobbing and chugging down alcohol while calling out Minseok's name. A few drinks later, Hyeonwook wakes up by Wonyoung's side the next morning...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Special Guidance
synopsis:
A prototypical B-grade guide, Kang Yoon-oh is content with his ordinary life as an average guide. That is until one day, an S-grade esper, Kim Hyuntae comes to him for guiding. After finding Yoon-oh's guiding abilities extraordinary and exactly what he needed, Hyuntae eventually requests that he become his very own personal guide. Now, working for Hyuntae, Yoon-oh's life is about to go from simple to special...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: A Simple Guide to Surviving as a Stepmom
title_english: A Simple Guide to Surviving as a Stepmom
title_japanese: 계모인데, 죽음을 피하는 게 너무 쉽다
synopsis:
When a girl abused by her father wakes up in a novel as Luella Masimelle, the cruel stepmother of the protagonist Hirah, she is determined to make things different. To do this, she proposes a contractual marriage to Duke Huppert to make him Hirah's guardian, but the duke surprisingly seems genuinely interested in her. And with the once timid Hirah also starting to open up and show affection to her, Luella begins to wonder if she'll finally have a happy family... Or is it all too good to be true?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Back to Work!
synopsis:
Jiyoon Cha is just trying to live her best life in spite of feeling unfulfilled by her corporate job and disillusioned with love. But what's a woman in her 30s to do when the pressure to marry is high, her prospects are either her aloof supervisor or her juvenile, artist ex-boyfriend, and not even her perfect work friend can hold it together? Can a girl just have her chicken and beer in peace, or is that just a pipe dream?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Don't Give the Book Your Heart
title_english: Don't Give the Book Your Heart
synopsis:
Ashilee Kaltanias is reborn as a side character in a novel. As an abandoned princess, she lives in secluded luxury until she discovers a book that predicts her death. Trying to find the key to survival, she ventures out of her palace only to attract the attention of Castor, the bloodthirsty crown prince. When Castor murders her as prophesied, Ashilee finds herself in an endless time loop that restarts when Castor kills her. How many more times must she die before she finds a way to live?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Garden of Silence
synopsis:
From losing her family to being mistreated by her in-laws and executed for crimes they forced her to commit, life was cruel to Guinevere Le Pur... Pitied by fate, Guinevere is given the chance to go back in time and learns that she was cheated out of her husband's bequeathed wealth. Now, she's determined to take back her stolen fortune and make sure her tormentors get absolutely nothing. But will Guinevere get her revenge, or will she walk down the fiery path of misery once again?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Wall of Glass
synopsis:
Liliana Pence's world as a naive, young noblewoman changes upon meeting Edward Carter, a commoner with an agenda of his own. Oblivious to his scorn for her, Liliana dreams of being together with him, until her dreams are shattered by her arranged marriage. Desperate to avoid the union, she confesses to Edward, only to have him coldly reject her and disappear. When Liliana's fortunes take a turn for the worse and she loses everything, the two reunite... but in a way neither expects.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Dragon's Proposal
synopsis:
As the White Dragon succumbs to the warrior's blade, it makes a final wish: to exact its revenge on the warrior, whom it had begun to consider its only friend. When the White Dragon next opens its eyes, it's to find out that it's been reborn...as a child. Not any child, but the warrior's only daughter!

The White Dragon, now known as Mir, has to adjust to being doted on daily until a certain incident breaks her newfound peace. Whisked away from her family, Mir is ordered to become the wife of a tyrant, but she won't follow orders without a fight. After all, Mir may have the body of a weak and feeble human, but she's still the strongest of all dragons at heart.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Loelline Seizes the Future
synopsis:
One day, a near-death experience causes Loelline Deaz to remember her past life, awakening the power to see the future through her dreams. However, there is one vision in particular that weighs on her the most—she foresees the murder of the empire's hero, Duke Dante Van Benerit! Loelline is the only one who can save the duke, but as she gets closer to uncovering the conspiracy behind his demise, she realizes that her past may have more to do with the grim future than she could've ever dreamed...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Please Look at Jasmine!
synopsis:
Believing Duke Aion to be indifferent and uninterested in her, Jasmine tries to get over her longtime crush on him through some dating and fun. But when she ends up in his arms due to a few too many drinks, she wakes up in bed next to the duke after a steamy night together! While thinking this one night will let her get over her first love, the duke suddenly seems to be reciprocating her feelings. Was Duke Aion interested all along? Jasmine will have to see if this romance was meant to bloom!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Dreadful Night
synopsis:
Wanna play a game? The only catch is, you're not just playing it, you've got to play your way out of it. That's exactly what is happening to Bada. And he's been at this for a while, trying to gather clues and items to find a way out of this damn horror RPG. The killer, the NPCs, the setting, Bada's now familiar with them all. He'll just have to endure a couple more games, maybe get killed a few more times...  But in this session, Nam Doha, someone who Bada thought was just an NPC, is suddenly acting strange. Has he been another player this entire time? Bada has to be tortured to end this storyline and start over and Doha has volunteered to do it, but the look in his eyes suggests he has other, even more sinister intentions in mind... What sadistic horrors must Bada endure to break free from this Dreadful Night?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Sacred Serpent's Seduction
synopsis:
How far would you be willing to go to save the ones you love? With his grandfather bordering life and death, Taesun takes on multiple jobs in order to pay a seemingly endless stack of hospital bills. On one of his odd jobs, he ascends the great mountain Geumryang, unknowingly the home of an eponymous serpentine spirit. When Taesun encounters the divine being, he too is on the brink of death, desperate for water in his slithering form. Taesun offers him a sip of water, and saves the sacred snake from certain death. Later that night, a cold-blooded body embraces Taesun and offers him an exchange: bear the ancient being's seed, and his grandfather will live. But is all really as it seems? After all, can one ever truly trust the forked tongue of a serpent...?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Lovely Geum Bokhee
synopsis:
Geum Bokhee's first love, Yoon Geonwoo, was someone who could never return her feelings. But she held on to her one-sided crush for seven years. But everything seems to change when she encounters Kim Geonyi, a grumpy classmate whose name is similar to Geonwoo's. Though she takes an interest in him, he doesn't share her sentiments... or so it seems. Will this new relationship finally end Bokhee's unrequited love, or steer her toward an ending she doesn't expect?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Quiet in the Office!
synopsis:
There's no such thing as work-life balance for poor Nayul, thanks to her evil boss, Sijin. Not only does he make her work overtime constantly, but she's also dumped by her boyfriend because of it. Fed up with Sijin's demonic ways, Nayul storms to his office to complain... and finds him jerking off!

Though the sight is initially grotesque, Nayul finds herself oddly turned on. Somehow, she ends up banging her boss on his desk, which leads to an irritating yet steamy colleagues-with-benefits relationship. But how long can Nayul keep this shameful secret from her prying ex and gossipy coworkers?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: The Absolute Threshold
synopsis:
Growing up with a mobster father, Joomi never had the luxury of being "normal." Despite the wealth and constant company surrounding her, she always felt alone, wanting to break free and live an ordinary life. But her hopes are forever shattered when she encounters Jeong Yoongyo, a cold-hearted successor to Korea's biggest mob clan.

Their chance meeting ignites a forbidden romance, leading to a fateful night of passion with grave consequences. Despite all the risks and odds, fate and desire draw them together, forcing them to navigate the perilous waters of their conflicting worlds.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Sweetie, Sweetie, Sweetie
synopsis:
After being hit by the fateful truck of transmigration, Jeong Yujin wakes up in the world of a fantasy novel as Lord Eugene Linweisen. Eugene's main role may be to marry the story's antagonist, Grand Duke Ivilaron, but Yujin has an even bigger job to fulfill: saving the world! But how is he supposed to achieve this feat when the gods won't even give him a simple status screen to help on his quest? Plus, what's only supposed to be a loveless contract marriage seems to be turning into something more the longer Yujin stays with the supposed villain...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Civilian A
synopsis:
Ordinary civilian Howoo's day turns into a disaster movie when a giant monster ambushes his city. All he hopes for is a quick and painless death, so he's pleasantly surprised when he's whisked out of harm's way by celebrity esper Yool. When the charming esper moves in next door shortly after, Howoo feels like he's living in a romcom. Not only does Yool know Howoo's name, but he also shows an oddly friendly interest in him when he's just one of the many civilians he's saved. And for some reason, Howoo feels a tingling sensation whenever their hands touch...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: A Friendship So Impure
synopsis:
Siyeong and Jihoo are "just friends." At least, that's what Siyeong tells herself before they share a steamy night that redefines their relationship forever. How was she supposed to know that the guy who invited her to work at his company, hasn't dated anyone in almost a decade, and has been pining for her since college might want more?

Still, being upset with her lying boyfriend was no excuse for the drunken night she had with her pseudo-friendzoned boss. Now Siyeong is torn between the man she's loved for the past nine years and the one who was by her side through everything. Can she find the will to forgive the very person who sent her running into the arms of another man, or will she fall head over heels for her longtime friend and risk losing him forever?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Neko to Ikoku no Prologue
title_english: An Opening Act of Cats and Distant Lands
title_japanese: 猫と異国のプロローグ
synopsis:
In pursuit of studying theater, Kei journeys to a distant land as a foreign exchange student. Struggling with cultural differences and loneliness, one day he follows a black cat resembling his family pet to a bakery, where a fateful encounter awaits...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: My Brother's Lover
synopsis:
Jinha meets his deceased brother's former roommate and lover, Won, at his brother's funeral, and falls for him instantly. Despite Jinha's estranged relationship with his brother, he and Won share a passionate moment and embark on a romantic relationship. Won becomes Jinha's only escape from the tragedy surrounding him. However, Won's charming demeanor begins to crack and reveals his possessiveness and manipulation, which seep into every aspect of Jinha's life. As their relationship intensifies, Jinha will have to face the reality of Won's dark side, or he might find himself trapped in something much more poisonous than he ever imagined.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Hibiware Koujitsu
synopsis:
A slightly offbeat slice-of-life comedy starring... a golem schoolgirl?!

It's spring of his second year in high school, and Otonashi can't help but notice the girl sitting next to him, cheerful, bright, and, well... a golem. Her arm pops off at the drop of a hat, flowers sprout from her head when she's happy, and she overheats whenever she's embarrassed. Every day with her brings something new and unexpected. Not quite a romance, but definitely not your average friendship... here begins the surreal, slightly strange daily life of two unusual classmates.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Bloom of Vengeance
synopsis:
Soon after losing her parents in a tragic car accident, Seolyoung meets her end, her death cleverly faked as a suicide by the murderer. She draws her last breath—cursing the Hong family for everything they'd done to make her life miserable—and wakes up in an entirely different world, with servants tending to her and addressing her as "My Lady." Now in her new body, Seolyoung must find a way to not only fend for herself in this hostile new world, but also cast her long-awaited revenge!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Recipes for a Ravenous Succubus
synopsis:
It's Baekyoung's 10th day as a succubus and she's hangry for a meal. As a matter of fact, she's getting downright desperate. Of course, a gourmet meal would be preferred but at this point any man will do, she just needs some sustenance. Ah, that guy right there! He looks a little nerdy but he'll do for now. But it turns out that this meal will be much juicier than Baekyoung ever anticipated and now she can't get this human off of her mind. The ravenous succubus has found her perfect meal, now she just has to make him all hers!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Mogami-ke no Kijitsu
synopsis:
On a cold winter night, the siblings return to their parents’ home after learning that Ginji, the second son of five siblings, has died.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Milk My Strawberries
synopsis:
After spending a lifetime drinking an absurd amount of strawberry milk, Song Seol-ah thought the worst she'd ever have to face was a stomachache. Until her chest started leaking the stuff, that is! As strange new urges overtake her body and mind, she tries to deal with it alone...until an ill-timed encounter with Kim Yushin, her childhood friend turned national medalist, throws everything into chaos. When he offers to help relieve her unbearable desire, she's thrust into a dangerously sweet arrangement that's quickly spiraling out of control.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Haou ni Natte kara Isekai ni Kiteshimatta! Edit shita Game Chara-tachi to Isekai wo Juurin suru Wagahaou: The Comic
title_japanese: 覇王になってから異世界に来てしまった!～エディットしたゲームキャラ達と異世界を蹂躙する我覇王～ THE COMIC

title: Love So Pure
synopsis:
"I... got a boner" is what Jihyun blurts out the first time he lays eyes on Yohan's handsome face... It's easy to get laid when you're a pretty, sassy bartender working at a popular gay bar. This lifestyle suits Jihyun just fine since he loves casual hookups without any intimacy... That is until he meets Yohan—his big, scary-looking classmate who's actually a pure-hearted sweetie. Can Yohan's simple love help commitment-phobic Jihyun heal from the traumas of his past?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Rendezvous
synopsis:
After being beaten up by bullies, high school senior Yiyeon Kang wakes up from a coma, only to find the world in ruins from an alien invasion. The streets around him are littered and empty, with bullies out looking for their next prey. As he navigates this new world, despite being too weak, he is determined to find and save his friend Younglin. Between bullies, aliens and this post-apocalyptic reality, he'll do all he can to survive... and to bring down those out to get him.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Assist Alien: Yandere Alien wa Ero Mangaka ni Aisaretai
title_japanese: アシスタリアン ～ヤンデレエイリアンはエロ漫画家に愛されたい～

title: Princess Villainess
synopsis:
Who wouldn't want to be a princess? You'd have maids at your beck and call, riches to indulge even your most unnecessary wants, and a dashing young prince who'd charm your socks off. But what if you became the villainess of a story?

One day, Jae-eun wakes up as Sheilia Aidenrose, the notoriously cruel princess of "The Rose of Isonia." As she knows all too well of Sheilia's gruesome end (the novel was written by her sister, after all), Jae-eun is determined to take matters into her own hands. She won't let Sheilia's fate be dictated by the original novel! Little does she know that this means she'll change the fates of all those involved, even that of the most minor characters...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: I Became the First Love of My Stepson
title_english: I Became the First Love of My Stepson
synopsis:
Eve Jenna, a poor noblewoman from the countryside, had only her beauty and practical mindset to rely on. In pursuit of financial stability, she became the fourth wife of Count Hound, hoping for security, if not love. Three years into their marriage, her seemingly stable life is shattered when her husband abruptly demands a divorce.

That same night, Eve receives an unexpected visit from Azazel, her husband's eldest son, who had always kept his distance. Without a trace of humor, he makes a shocking proposal: after her divorce, she should marry him. Stunned by the audacity of his offer, Eve dismisses it as mockery, but his next words leave her speechless—he's always desired her. What began as a contract marriage soon spirals into a series of events Eve could never have foreseen.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Hana's Demons of Lust
synopsis:
Hana thought she would only be haunted by the demons of the past, however, she soon learns that demons come in many shapes and sizes. After coming in contact with lust demon Luxuria, Hana soon finds herself wanted by just about every lust demon that exists. There's something about her body that makes her absolutely irresistible, making her the perfect prey. While she's trying to get her head around this, Luxuria comes up with a preposterous proposition which involves...entering a contract with him?!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Love Falls Like Rain
synopsis:
When Sarang discovers a mysterious yellow umbrella left by her doorstep, she doesn't think much of it. But one rainy evening she opens her umbrella and is magically transported to Albia where she runs into two men, one of whom could potentially be her soulmate. Will Sarang be able to find her true love in a foreign land on the other side of the globe?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Cherry Cake
synopsis:
Soohyeon's peaceful life in the countryside, running a quaint general store and tending a garden, is upended when rumors spread of a luxury hotel project—and the arrival of Taeyeon, a gruff yet oddly charming director from S.W. Construction who looks more like a mob boss than a businessman. Despite warnings from the village grandmas to steer clear, Soohyeon isn't intimidated, even as Taeyeon's attempts to "bribe" him with sweet treats start melting his defenses. But when an unexpected moment reveals Soohyeon's biggest secret, what starts as a clash of personalities turns into a tangled mix of sweetness, spice, and chaos that neither of them saw coming.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Summer Sparks
synopsis:
Joon-hwi has always been a beta. Which is a relief, given how his best friend and nationally beloved actor Seok-hyun hates omegas, and there's no way Joon-hwi's crush on him would be requited otherwise. But one day, when Joon-hwi discovers he might be the exact thing Seok-hyunh hates, everything spirals out of control...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Fight Club
synopsis:
Minchan has lived his whole life as part of the elite top 1%—an Alpha who always wins. Bored with his perfect life, he accepts a friend's invitation to join Fight Club, a brutal underground arena where only fighting skills matter.

What starts as a casual thrill quickly escalates when Minchan begins competing himself—and winning easily, just like always. But just as victory starts to feel hollow, he faces an opponent he can't beat: Taewook, a smaller, seemingly fragile Omega.

Crushed by his first-ever defeat, Minchan is furious—and obsessed. He approaches Taewook, only to be met with complete indifference, a blow to his pride he can't ignore.

Then one night, fate strikes: Taewook enters his heat cycle, and Minchan doesn't miss his chance.

Pride, instinct, and raw attraction collide—In this fight, winning might mean losing everything Minchan thought he knew.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: My Half-Baked Esper
synopsis:
In a world where interdimensional gates unleash monstrous threats, a rare few are born with extraordinary powers. These gifted individuals are known as Espers and Guides.

Choi Kyuhyuk is officially classified as an S-class Esper, but there's a catch. His self-regeneration ability is so weak that he's been downgraded to S-minus. People call him a "half-baked" Esper, and the name has stuck ever since. After sustaining a serious injury, he has been reassigned to a desk job in the Guide Line Department, where he now trains rookie Guides.

Life was relatively peaceful until one very specific problem arrived. Yeon Soojung, a Guide Kyuhyuk once saved as a child and treats like family, has just come of age. And now, he wants to initiate a sex guiding session with Kyuhyuk.

Worse still, Soojung makes his intent painfully clear: "Just sleep with me once. Let me give you the sex guiding, please."

Sure, guiding is essential for Espers to stabilize their powers. But the idea of doing it with him

title: Honey Trouble
synopsis:
Attached at the hip for 20 years, Jiheon and Wooju are practically inseparable. There's definitely something simmering between them but Jiheon is an alpha and Wooju, just a beta. Not only that, but Wooju's had his eyes on someone else lately, anyways. Ever the good friend, Jiheon makes an unexpected suggestion to Wooju in order to get the attention of the one he desires. But is there a layer of manipulation beneath this supposedly helpful gesture? What Jiheon feels is love, some might call...an obsession. And this obsession could lead to all sorts of trouble...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Ningyo
synopsis:
A man finds himself living with a mermaid in his apartment...

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Raising a Sacrifice
synopsis:
"It seems I must kill you, Your Grace."

Inas has always been Duke Nigel Montestein's most faithful knight. But when Nigel is betrayed and killed by Inas, he wakes up a year before his supposed death. Nigel's quick to realize this isn't a mere case of time travel however, and the only one who has answers is the man who betrayed him!

(Source: Manta)

title: Demolition Girl
synopsis:
Being the new girl is tough when you have to keep the fact that you're a yomul hunter a secret. Demons with human faces, yomul, run amok in Seoul, and it's up to Seul Park and her father to destroy them. But her charmed life as a regular high schooler comes under threat when a mysterious and powerful yomul discovers Seul's biggest secret—she's half-yomul herself. To make matters worse, he plans to use the cutest boy in school to lure her out of hiding.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Bongchon Bride
synopsis:
He bought me for 50 sacks of rice.

Soongap is nearly beaten to death by his master when friendly giant Bongchun buys him and saves his life. Bongchun's blind mother is delighted, believing her son has finally brought home a bride. And the more Bongchun treats Soongap like his darling bride, the more things get heated...

(Source: Manta)

title: Something Between Us
synopsis:
Even after fulfilling her dreams of becoming a magazine editor and living in Seoul, Ko Sooah can't seem to shake the feeling that something is still missing. When a difficult day at work and an argument with her mother drives her to get a tattoo, Sooah bumps into the last person she expected to see: her first love, Baek Hubeom. This encounter rekindles old feelings and sparks questions about what happened between them nine years ago, but will Sooah be able to muster up the courage to ask them?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Best Left Unwritten
synopsis:
Choi Sunwoo and Ahn Haejin couldn't have come from more different backgrounds. With a renowned linguistics professor for a father and an extremely successful author for a mother, Sunwoo was perfectly set up for a successful career in writing. Ahn Haejin however, had been left to take care of himself ever since he was in high school, working part time jobs just to survive. The two become unexpected friends as the sole members of the creative writing club, but after a dramatic falling out, Sunwoo and Haejin lose touch for years until unexpectedly meeting again working for the same publishing company. Sunwoo and Haejin try to keep things professional, but their sudden reunion dredges up painful memories from the past along with feelings they had both struggled to suppress...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Vanilla Taste
synopsis:
Hajun is flawless—rich, handsome, and top of his class. Sodam has loved him in secret for years, never expecting anything in return. But when Hajun asks him to be his SM partner, Sodam says yes. As nights grow longer, hidden desires—and darker secrets—begin to surface.

(Source: Manta)

title: High School Return of a Gangster
title_english: High School Return of a Gangster
synopsis:
A gangster dies saving a bullied teen—and wakes up in the boy's body. Living the school life he always dreamed of, he vows revenge for the boy's suffering. But when the boy's long-time crush begins to suspect he's not who he says he is, things start to spiral...

(Source: Manta)

title: Saturday's Master
synopsis:
Lee Seodan is ostracized at his company as a whistleblower and faces resignation.  Desperate, he applies to be part of Han Juwon's elite task force. Juwon makes an unexpected offer, tying them together for three months—weekdays at work, weekend nights at a hotel. As lines blur, so do their intentions.

(Source: Manta)

title: Shaman
synopsis:
Some wish to become gods while others wish to become human. Jowi who is raised by a family that practices Shamanism struggles to live since his sister's mysterious death. Ten years pass and Jowi finds new evidence that she may still be alive.

(Source: Taptastic)

title: Stigmata
synopsis:
Servant Sion wants nothing more than a quiet life. Instead, he's betrayed by the one he trusts and tortured by the jealous "Holy King" Siennas for bearing stigmata, a holy mark, on his back. But rather than dying, Sion's mind is reborn in the body of Siennas on his coronation day five years earlier...

(Source: Manta)

title: Taming the Tyrant
synopsis:
Betrayal, rebirth, and second chances.

Jae-Ryun seduced and betrayed the tyrannical emperor before being discovered and executed. Now he's woken up 20 years in the past and crossed paths with the emperor once again. Is this his chance to atone for his sins by reforming the man he loves, or are some romances fated to end in tragedy?

(Source: Manta)

title: Paljae, Child of Winter
synopsis:
It's more than just coincidence.

Young Paljae drifts to the isle at world's end to be taken in by Munryeong, a hermit with a mysterious past. But when Paljae begins to waste away in the sun-bathed climate, Munryeong takes his little companion on a journey to the cold north that uncovers their forgotten past encounter.

(Source: Manta)

title: Heart Stain
synopsis:
"Let's date until we graduate."

Woohyun has a secret crush on his homeroom teacher. His best friend, Doha, finds out and confesses his feelings for him. But then he makes an interesting proposition: "Go out with me. Fall for me before graduation, and I win. If you don't, you win." Can Woohyun like someone other than his teacher?

(Source: Manta)

title: Number of Cases
synopsis:
The last time Woojin saw Kyung was in high school, and back then Kyung had considered him a love rival. The pair meet again 12 years later at the wedding of Kyung's old unrequited love, Inseop. The two Alphas get to talking after the ceremony, but when pheromones start flying things begin to escalate...

(Source: Manta)

title: No Kidding
synopsis:
The new school year brings with it a myriad of new encounters. Seok's first meeting with Kiwoon involves snow, an obese calico cat, and a lingering sweet scent. As it turns out, the two are now classmates, and Seok finds himself slowly drawn to Kiwoon. Seok wants to grow closer to Kiwoon, but he proves to be a tough nut to crack. He's amiable enough, but Kiwoon soon senses an invisible wall between him and his target. Will Seok manage to charm his way through to Kiwoon's heart?

(Source: Manta)

title: Hana Chiruran
synopsis:
1. Graduation!
2. Roshutsu Bitch (Flasher Slut!)
3. Ero Ticket (Sexy Ticket)
4. Seiyoku no Aki (Lustful Autumn)
5. Natsu no H na Kawa Asobi♪ (Naughty Summer Play at a River)

title: Kill the Lights
synopsis:
During his youth, child star Haley Rusk once captivated the people of America with his charming face and acting. But now, as a narcissistic adult, he is notorious for something completely different. From scandalous sex to drugs, he's done it all—Haley Rusk is a bonafide Hollywood Bad Boy, in the worst way possible. After a very public and drunken confession to America's Sweetheart, Noah Raycarlton, his reputation finally hits rock bottom. Haley turns to some supernatural blood magic as a last-ditch attempt to repair his life, which ends in his body being possessed by the soul of a mercenary named Mason Taylor. Mason, while not confident in acting, seems to have a deep-rooted history with Noah. What kind of traumatic past do the two of them share? And, what really happened to Haley Rusk?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Monochrome Rumor
synopsis:
After being involved in a car accident together, Hajin is asked by Sihyeon to take care of Sihyeon's younger sister after his death. Hajin never expected that to mean he would wake up in the hospital in Sihyeon's body instead of his own. Even worse, Sihyeon was an infamous idol who would do anything for money, had multiple sponsors, and was apparently about to abandon the boy band he was a part of to sign a new contract with a larger agency. At first, Hajin believes the public's negative opinion about Sihyeon, but the more he learns about Sihyeon's miserable circumstances, the more enraged he becomes. Determined to get revenge in Sihyeon's stead, Hajin decides to reach out to an old acquaintance for help. However, the deeper he goes into his revenge plot, the more people he becomes entangled with...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: The Rotten
synopsis:
The rampant spread of a virus has turned most humans into grotesque beings called "the Rotten." Amidst the ruin, Seonho leads a small group of survivors and protects his companion Haesoo, who is bullied for being weak and timid. Seonho's group is thrilled to meet more survivors with a large stockpile of supplies—until they realize that this new group is shockingly barbaric and cruel. By far the most twisted is their leader Won, who has his dangerous eyes on Seonho. Determined to shield Haesoo, Seonho makes a deal with Won... but will any of them make it out alive?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Sweeten the Deal
synopsis:
Haneul, self-proclaimed campus flirt, has big dreams of landing a relationship in college. But one day, he stumbles upon a grim-looking man in what seems to be a shady drug dealer—and bolts in terror.

Fate, however, has other plans. Haneul runs into the supposed drug dealer, Choi Dajeong, once again in a club he only joined to follow his crush. But before he knows it, he ends up at his place!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Overclock
synopsis:
Andy, a financial planner on Wall Street, gets fired after an ill-fated hookup in a car. By chance, he lands a new job at an AI startup—only to discover that the company's CTO, Hwang Jio, is none other than his one-night stand from just days ago. Workplace romance is already risky, but when it's between a sharp-witted Wall Street man and a brilliant Silicon Valley techie, things get even more complicated.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Mary Jane
synopsis:
Dr. Doh Won is a renowned psychoanalyst. Upon returning to Korea, he takes a position at the Institute for Psychoanalysis and does his best to avoid criminal cases to protect his family. One day, the enigmatic arsonist MJ pays him an unexpected visit. MJ insists on ongoing sessions to address his uncontrollable desire to start fires. Reluctantly, Doh Won agrees, only to discover that MJ is more than just an arsonist; he's involved in something major related to a mysterious figure known only as 'Father.' Will Doh Won be able to extinguish MJ's love of fire? And just who is this 'Father,' and what connection does he have with MJ?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: On the Emperor's Lap
synopsis:
At a young age, little Bella was abandoned by a boy that she trusted for survival. She grew up unseen, unheard, and a war slave. Years later, after losing her ability to speak, she finds herself embraced by the man who once betrayed her. Bella realizes that the man, Kiris, has forgotten all about her, and his realization may come too late. In this heartbreaking fantasy romance about overcoming history and finding love again, will Bella be able to forgive and forget?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Leave Room for Love
synopsis:
Kang Yui lost his parents in an accident, and has been blaming himself ever since. As bad things keep happening to those who try to get close to him, he decides to shut himself off from the rest of the world and live a life of solitude. But then comes the effervescent Lee Hyun, his new roommate at university: with his motto of "never give up," Hyun is determined to wiggle his way into Yui's heart, one way or another. But is Hyun bound to be beaten in this battle? Or is there still room for love in Yui's life?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: I Declare Vengeance!
synopsis:
All Yun Jejin wanted was to succeed in life by climbing his way out of misery and misfortune—but his life takes a nosedive when he ends up a debt collector's target, all because he co-signed a loan for a friend. With nothing to his name and revenge on his mind, Jejin decides to pay it off the hard way...by becoming a gangster himself. But unbeknownst to him, someone's been watching his back: Choi Taekmu, a thug with a heart as big as his muscles, and a not-so-secret crush on the rookie mobster. As the two work together toward Jejin's goal, vengeance might not be the only thing that's coming in red hot...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: 6-okunen no Hakubutsu Tabi
synopsis:
Society has developed time machines, allowing people to travel back in time to the ancient past. Inochi and Akari, two university students majoring in paleontology, are traveling to various epochs. They witness dinosaurs, go camping in the Cretaceous period, and even eat ammonites. A dinosaur x girl story overflowing with ambience!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Love on My Terms
synopsis:
Chamin is an A-list actor with a talent for reading lines—AND people's thoughts. Mogyum is an actor getting his career back on track after a mysterious accident left him scarred as a kid. The relentless Chamin can't read scene-partner Mogyum's thoughts at all, making him all the more intriguing... He can't get in his head, but that doesn't stop him from trying to get inside his body. After all, they're just rehearsing the drama... The scenes heat up as the clothes come off between these two!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Bitch demo Genki nara Sore de Ii
title_japanese: ビッチでも元気ならそれでいい

title: Wolves Behind Bars
synopsis:
Kiyo, a struggling young artist, suddenly finds himself pinned as the prime suspect in a serial murder case. And as if going to prison wasn't enough, he's thrown into an Alpha-only facility crawling with thirsty alphas who are all too eager to eat him up. Thanks to his mysterious new cellmate Iri, Kiyo is able to escape their clutches, but bigger problems await...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Double-Binded By Love
synopsis:
When two lovers are bound by the red thread of fate, they are destined to be together forever. But what happens when the thread binds three people together? Kim Hyena and Lee Huiyeong are two souls who have reincarnated countless times throughout history, falling in love only to be torn apart by tragedy in each life. That is, until one day, Huiyeong’s soul is split into two by a servant of Grandma Samsin, the deity of lovers. With the red thread of fate tying Hyena to both halves of Huiyeong, who will she choose for her chance at everlasting love?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: One Night Mate
synopsis:
Woojin Cha wants his backpacking trip through Europe to be exciting—and maybe even a little bit spicy! Instead, his hotel reservation gets canceled, and it's pouring rain. To make matters worse, the only person around to help him is Seunghyuk, his year-long crush he's trying to forget! Despite Woojin's initial reluctance, one night as Seunghyuk's roommate turns into another... and another. This definitely isn't the trip Woojin had in mind, but he's starting to wonder, is it really that bad?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Dating 101
synopsis:
Back at her hometown for the first time in 9 years, this high school girl has no time to reminisce when it turns out the tiger from her childhood is still very determined to marry her. That said, there is a plan: she will transform this tiger into the most irresistible Casanova, and the tiger will surely go on to only seduce women "much better than someone like her."

(Source: SpotToon)

title: Dawn After Darkness
synopsis:
Can a single night with a single person change your life forever? Hyeon-oh's answer to this question is yes. Ever since a night he spent with Seo-hyun, he's clung onto the memories of it to keep himself going in the dark world of the yakuza. Years later, Seo-hyun appears in his life once more. Could it be a sign that dawn is here to chase the darkness away once and for all?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: If You Want Me
synopsis:
Seo Dogyeom, the young master of a mansion, and Yoon Seowon, the housekeeper's son, share a secret bond despite their different social statuses. After a kiss, Seowon falls in love, but Dogyeom abruptly leaves to study abroad. Five years later, Seowon, now an adult, is about to leave the mansion when Dogyeom returns and offers him a role as his pheromone partner.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: HOME5
synopsis:
When Do-ha has been kicked out of his parents' house and is in dire need of a place to live in, he finds his sanctuary in a beautiful, brag-on-social-media-worthy shared house in Home5. It's the perfect place for him! There's exactly one catch: the owner of the place is Si-woon, his first love from high school. It should be fine, though. They're cool with each other now, they both have their own lives, and there's no lingering feelings whatsoever, right? ...Right?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Control Time
synopsis:
Raymon has it all: perfect looks, a prestigious family, and unrivaled abilities in the workplace. But beneath his flawless exterior lies a chaotic love life, with a string of unsatisfying, fleeting encounters. His search for the perfect partner ends when a janitor named Winter seemingly saves him from a stalker's attack. Drawn to Winter's striking looks and submissive nature, Raymon proposes a FWB situation, to which Winter eagerly agrees. At first, their relationship seems ideal, but Raymon soon realizes the terrifying truth—Winter has been his stalker all along. Now trapped in a deadly game, Raymon finds himself pretending to love Winter in a desperate bid to survive. Winter, unhinged and obsessively devoted, will stop at nothing—even murder—to keep Raymon all to himself. And so begins a dangerous, seductive battle of control, where love and dominance blur into a deadly obsession.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Hold Over You
synopsis:
Choi Kwon is haunted by nightmares and cursed to watch those he cares about face tragic fates. Wracked with guilt, he isolates himself, until one day he decides to take a chance—only to see his classmate get hit by a car right in front of him. Though Shin Yooyoung survives, he now claims they were married in a past life—and that breaking this curse is within Kwon's reach. Faced with a strange new reality, Kwon must decide what to believe and just how far he'll go to end his torment.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Scammed and Rammed
synopsis:
Sun Mooyoung, a struggling fake fortune-teller, cons clueless chaebol heir Lee Jaeyi, who's never dated, into a bogus love reading and rakes in big cash. But when Jaeyi realizes he's been scammed, he sues Mooyoung for the fraudster he is! As if that's not bad enough, Mooyoung's boyfriend bails on him after hearing about the lawsuit. Now broke and desperate, Mooyoung hatches a ridiculous plan: make Jaeyi's fake love fortune come true to get the charges dropped. Can this hapless con artist pull off a miracle—or just dig himself deeper?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Be My Beta
synopsis:
Choi Yoo-il is no stranger to misfortune. From losing his parents in a freak accident to suddenly presenting as a recessive omega in his twenties, bad things seem to follow him around. But through it all, his only friend Cha Hwan has stood proudly beside him. Hwan lets Yoo-il live with him, and when Yoo-il loses his job, Hwan even finds him a new one. The problem is...Hwan hates omegas. Terrified of losing the only person to ever stand by him, Yoo-il tries desperately to hide the truth. With his first heat fast-approaching, will Yoo-il be able to come to terms with the inevitable changes in their relationship...?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Non-Refundable Alpha
synopsis:
Choi Jaewon was living a carefree life abroad, surrounded by playful alphas and chasing nothing but pleasure. But when his father lures him back to Korea, he's blindsided by a wedding—his own.

The groom turns out to be Yang Joonhee, a childhood friend who's grown into everything Jaewon's ever wanted. And before he can make sense of it, the vows are already said.

Joonhee insists they once made a promise. Jaewon doesn't remember it... but something in him starts to respond anyway.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Breakout Scandal
synopsis:
Jeong Da-um is a beta. There's nothing wrong with that, per se, but it's what drives him to quit his job as an idol to become a manager at an entertainment agency. There, he's determined to live an ordinary life, but that's pretty hard to do when you become the manager of Lee Yeon, an actor with a large fan following and an even larger reputation as a prickly alpha. When Yeon goes into an unexpected rut, Da-um's life very quickly starts getting out of the ordinary...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: In Your Wake
synopsis:
Yun-oh has only one person in the world who he can rely on: his hyung, Haewon.

For years, Yun-oh has harbored a secret, unrequited love for Haewon, who is not only someone he considers family but also his sole protector. As a beta, Yun-oh believes a future with Haewon, an alpha, is impossible, so he keeps his feelings buried deep and stays quietly by his side.

But when Haewon unexpectedly goes into rut, Yun-oh is caught up in the whirlwind, and his carefully hidden emotions are laid bare.

What will become of their fragile bond when Haewon discovers the truth Yun-oh has tried so desperately to conceal?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Well-Hung Hero
synopsis:
When portals to other worlds unleash monster-filled dungeons across Earth, humanity awakens to new supernatural powers. Meet Ash: an S-Class hero cursed with a truly massive gift. Blessed (or burdened) with a radiant, colossal holy member, Ash has become the ultimate solo player. After all, who could possibly handle him? Enter Roose: a mysterious villain with the power to nullify abilities...and apparently, the only one capable of taking Ash on (and in)! Ash's holy sword is ready, but can he win Roose's heart as well as save the day?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Eighth Time's the Charm
synopsis:
A one night stand becomes so much more when Yeon Subin and Jin Hoyeon begin spending more and more time together...until one day, out of the blue, Subin asks to break up for reasons unbeknownst to Hoyeon. But the two just can't stay away from each other, and so they get back together again...and again...and again. But each time, Subin suddenly breaks things off without telling Hoyeon why. Until finally, after their seventh breakup, Hoyeon is determined to find the reason why.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Golden Bells and Dragon Scales
synopsis:
Living alone in the forest ever since his family was framed and killed, Byeo-ru has lived a simple life: gathering food from nature, living in a small house, and avoiding the village people who aren't aware that he's still alive. He's fine living that way, until the day he finds a dragon's egg. Once hatched, dragon Shin-ri changes Byeo-ru's life into a more complicated one. Whether that is a good thing, Byeo-ru himself is not quite sure...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Ghost Gate
synopsis:
After staying late to work overtime, Lee Giyun stumbles upon his boss, Jeong Yitae, masturbating at a coworker's desk. Horrified, he tries to leave, but a disembodied voice urges him to stay. When Giyun tries to record Yitae's depravity, he is caught, and something about his boss seems disturbingly off.

From that moment, Giyun is pulled into a warped reality where nothing feels certain. As his relationship with Yitae takes a dark turn, strange and ghastly events begin to plague the office, ensnaring both Giyun and his coworkers.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Surviving as a Player
synopsis:
Trapped in the gaming world of Elix, Sehyun's once mode of solace is now his prison. Here, one must conquer empires or be conquered. What's more, dying in-game means dying in real life. Stuck in a perilous reality, Sehyun must save his empire while facing the effects of his corrupt past. To do so, he must regain the trust of his Grand Duke, Ruhak. But since he has so much resentment toward Sehyun, the only way to appease Ruhak is to succumb to his needs, no matter how immoral or carnal they are.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: At the Lake Where Waves Crash
title_english: At the Lake Where Waves Crash
synopsis:
Tensions are brewing in late 19th century Ireland, shortly before the Irish War of Independence. Author Raymond Ler Lyndon lives isolated in his romantic clifftop mansion, scorned by his fellow countrymen as a traitor while he waits for his long departed beloved to return. But when Owen, his first love's son, saves him from certain death, he is given a second chance at reclaiming the lover who abandoned him. Meanwhile, the rebellion is gaining traction and Owen's behavior grows increasingly suspicious. At the conflict's climax, which will they choose—love or freedom?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Fan in Denial
synopsis:
Geonwoo is a bodyguard who works on the security team for the idol group Magnum. He doesn't really have any complaints about his job, except for one person who keeps getting on his nerves: Doyoon. Throughout his career in the industry, Geonwoo has never met a more irritating idol who seems ungrateful to his fans. Doyoon is simply a brat with a pretty face, in Geonwoo's opinion, which is why he never intended to get mixed up with Doyoon in any personal way... So how did they end up in bed together?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: The Black Knight Under the Red Curse
title_english: The Black Knight Under the Red Curse
synopsis:
Ratan the mage is being pursued by the knights of the inquisition for studying the forbidden Red Curse. When he seeks refuge in The Black Forest, he runs into its deadly resident knight in steel armor who happens to be the curse's victim. Thankfully, Ratan's offer to lift the curse keeps the knight from killing him. But the solution involves some heated action in the bedroom, and Ratan isn't so sure that he'll survive to see another day...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Master of Master
synopsis:
There is no one in the world Choi Euncheol loves more than his dog Jong-gu. Having been there for him through heartbreak and happiness alike, the pup is as loyal as can be. The two are best friends, and more alike than they look...because Euncheol loves a little bark and bite in the bedroom. But when Jong-gu mistakes a little nighttime pet play for an attack on his masochistic master, he valiantly rushes to his defense and bites the "assailant" square on the buttocks! Euncheol decides to end things with his lover, and is now left with no one but his precious pet to help him grieve his relationship. When he awakes the next morning, however, Jong-gu has gone missing! In his place is a cute guy who seems strangely familiar, but Euncheol can't quite put his paw -er, finger- on why...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Sunyu of the Shadowless
synopsis:
When failed martial artist Kwak Noh is tasked with protecting a group of young orphans, he plans to send them off to good homes. However, after growing attached to the children, he decides to raise them all as disciples of the Shadowless Clan. But as times get tough, Kwak Noh is forced to journey far from home to make money, leaving Sunyu, first brother of the clan, to provide for his siblings. If Sunyu wants to step up for his clan, though, he'll need to step up his skills! Training begins now!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Senza Replica
synopsis:
Dowon chose to be a freelance guide for the freedom to do other things, but his cold and demanding esper, Kwonwoo, calls him for guiding every day without fail. Although he thinks he has his hands full already, he's proven wrong when Kwonwoo loses eight years of his memories and his powers due to an accident on the job. Now it's up to Dowon to restore both by giving the mentally 20-year-old Kwonwoo the kind of intimate guiding he always refused before. But surprisingly, this cheery and affectionate Kwonwoo seems all too eager to take things to the next level...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Tousan no Kaisha ga Tousan shita node Loli Fuuzoku Hajimemashita
title_japanese: 父さんの会社が倒産したのでロリ風俗はじめました

title: My Personal Caddie
synopsis:
Seo Yeowon, desperate for money, starts a high-paying caddie job at Royal Golf only to find that it's a private country club where only the most powerful and wealthiest people are allowed. Yeowon caters to the guests' whims and catches the attention of the mysterious and ominous Jang Giju, who makes him a lucrative offer he can't refuse, changing the course of both their lives. Can Yeowon handle Mr. Jang's eccentric and prolific tastes?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Who's That Girl?
synopsis:
Kim Sanghyeon has the talent and the drive to become a K-pop star—but one thing keeps holding him back: a false school bullying accusation. After countless rejections, his dream feels more distant than ever. But when the head director of a major entertainment company hands him a mysterious bath bomb that transforms him into his past-life self, he's suddenly staring at an unbelievably beautiful... woman? Sanghyeon's second shot at fame is about to begin—in the most unexpected way!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Friends Forever After?
synopsis:
Woojung was a child star who had to give up his dreams because of some malicious rumors. Carrying that trauma with him, he's now just a normal high school student. When some bullies confront Woojung on the first day of school, a majestic figure, like a hero from a video game, magically comes to Woojung's rescue...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Ring My Bell
synopsis:
Hell yeah! A major publisher wants Mai Sohn to write a webcomic on relationships. But she's struck with heartbreak as her girlfriend abruptly dumps her. It's hard writing about relationships without being in one, so she needs to find the inspiration for love—and find it fast. And what's up with her possibly homophobic neighbor? Why is she cool with Mai one minute and then so awkward and weird to her the next?! Can't a girl catch a break?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Hashiguchi-san no 〇〇 na Shuusei
synopsis:
Hashiguchi-san, who's in my class, is cute and can do anything. She's someone everyone admires... But am I the only one who feels like she resembles a certain animal?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Why Does Everyone Love Me?!
synopsis:
One day, the disgraced child actress Gwon Sara takes her own life, only to wake up... ten years in the past? Except now, she is successful, radiant, and adored by all. What happened? How did she go from public enemy number one to national sweetheart? And more importantly, can her fate truly be rewritten this time?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Carrying My n00b Waifu
synopsis:
Jungwoo is a Tamer in the MMORPG Karel's Hymn. While selling off items after deciding to quit, he meets a newbie, "Charongrong," who swears loyalty even if "she" becomes popular. He thought it was just a brief, passing connection—but he shouldn't have taken those words lightly.

(Source: Manta)

title: Stay Out of My Head!
synopsis:
Moon Ah-rim has a secret. One accidental touch, and he can hear exactly what you're thinking. So when he accidentally brushes against his longtime crush, Taehun, he expects butterflies...not full-blown NSFW fantasies! Sweet, gentle Taehun isn't supposed to have those kinds of thoughts, and especially not about him! Ah-rim is horrified...and maybe just a little intrigued. Because no matter how much he tells himself not to feel anything...his body's saying otherwise.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Romantic Flow
synopsis:
First rule of the workplace: don't date your boss. It's a rule that should be easy for workaholic lawyer Cha Hyeonseo to follow, especially since her new boss, Seo Jeonghyeok, has a reputation of being a heartless playboy who only cares about money. But despite his infuriating smirk and arrogant tone, Hyeonseo finds herself slowly being drawn to him as he wears down the armor of cold indifference she's worn over the years. But does he feel the same towards her? Or is Hyeonseo just setting herself up for a devastating heartbreak?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: To Mend a Heart
synopsis:
Jang Haneul lives on his family's chicken farm in the countryside and the few friends he had moved away after graduation. Then a boy named Namu comes from Seoul to visit his grandmother. Haneul is excited to make a new friend but is crestfallen when Namu treats everyone kindly except him. Haneul wants them to be closer, but after Namu drunkenly kisses him, Haneul becomes confused about what he actually wants.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Feel My Benefit
synopsis:
Joohyun dreams of a romantic first time with someone he truly loves. Enter Seojun, a shameless flirt with undeniable charm (and a body to match). Determined to stick to his ideals, Joohyun finds himself wavering as Seojun's relentless allure tests his resolve. Will his heart win over his head, or is this just a disaster waiting to happen?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Say a Little Prayer
synopsis:
Saein is an omega with a single mission in life: to rescue his mother from the clutches of Geunhan Pharmaceuticals. In order to achieve this, he becomes the bonder of Yungeom, a wealthy alpha who needs an omega to stabilize his pheromones. It seems like there's hope for Saein and his mother as he grows closer with Yungeom, but what Saein doesn't know is that there is a frightening, ugly truth lying under the kind facades of the people who are his new family...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Moonlight Beauty Parlor
synopsis:
Yun Ina is left without a job or home after she gets fired and her house burns down. Her luck takes a turn when Seo Hyeondu, owner of the Moonlight Beauty Parlor, offers her a place to stay as well as a job—on one condition! Hyeondu suffers from insomnia, and it seems Ina's presence is the only thing that allows him to sleep through the night. If she agrees to help him sleep at night, she can stay. As Ina spends more time with with Hyeondu, her heart begins to skip a beat when she sees how thoughtful he is with each of his clients. Is Hyeondu only keeping Ina around to help him sleep, or do his feelings run deeper?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: A Cat's Tale
synopsis:
The truth behind... farm animals?

The animals living on the farm of Saemin's family are not what they seem. Although they put up an act of innocence in front of Saemin's family, they are fully capable of deliberately committing horrifying acts. Told from the point of view of an extremely intelligent old cat, this is a thrilling tale of jealousy, manipulation, and murder.

(Source: Manta)

title: Tsuihou sareta Seijo desu ga, Douyara Watashi ga Honmono desu: Zense Kusushi wa "Iyashi" no Kusuri de Sukuitai!
title_japanese: 追放された聖女ですが、どうやら私が本物です 前世薬師は“癒し”の薬で救いたい!
synopsis:
After 19 years without manifestation of her saintly abilities, Emilia is finally exiled from the country. Determined to live her life as she pleases this time, she plans to run a pharmacy in a remote area! For a while, there are no customers, but then an event happens that causes rumors about her to swirl throughout the village...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Tensei Seijo wa Oshikatsu ga Shitai! Shiitagerare Reijou desu ga Oshi no Oujisama kara Dekiai sareteimasu!?
title_japanese: 転生聖女は推し活がしたい! 虐げられ令嬢ですが推しの王子様から溺愛されています!?
synopsis:
In an accident during her "oshi activities," the protagonist is reborn as the duke's daughter, Elicia. However, because of her black hair and black eyes, she spends her days being scorned as the "Daughter of Evil."

One day, she meets Crown Prince Reichelt and discovers her "oshi" for this life. She's actually a saint, but as long as she can continue her oshi activities without being found out, there's no problem!?

Too focused on her oshi activities, she doesn't realize the overwhelming love coming from her oshi!? A sweet, slightly misaligned love story!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kitto Kamisama mo Shiranai
title_japanese: きっと神様も知らない

title: 666 Dopes
synopsis:
Love even the scars.

Rings, chokers, black nails, and countless piercings in his ears—Akane is an eccentric member of the struggling band 666DOPES. Though Toui is at his mercy, he takes good care of him out of his weakness for love. Akane repeatedly hurts himself and demands painful sex. Confused but wanting to love him, Toui becomes curious to find out about the trauma he hides in his heart.

"Why do you hurt yourself?"

"No reason."

But a dark past lurks behind Akane. Between Thanatos and Eros, a lonely love between two people strikes a chord. Sex, love, and rock 'n' roll.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Sentou Gal to Iinchou
synopsis:
Ururu Kuroizumi is a high-achieving student and outstanding athlete, but she is also an extreme gal who flouts the school's rules. She wears heavy makeup everyday, but when she goes to the public bath, what she displays is her bare face and pure feelings of love...!? A love comedy about a strict student council president and a gal!

(Source: COMICSMART, translated)

title: Shoot My Shot
synopsis:
For Hoon, moving from Seoul to the middle of nowhere is only bearable because Jaehui, the local policeman, is the most beautiful being he's ever seen. Unfortunately, Jaehui's dad and Hoon's dad are already dating each other. To make things less weird, Hoon and Jaehui must break up their dads by proving their love is more passionate! Too bad Jaehui actually hates Hoon...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: For You Who Grieves
synopsis:
Doyoon Kim should've died in the car crash, but fate had other plans. He wakes up in the hospital, trapped in a bruised and unfamiliar body. Upon returning to university, he crosses paths with his old friend, Hangyeol. However, Hangyeol is unrecognizable. He is consumed by grief and unwilling to engage with Doyoon. Yet, a haunting familiarity tugs at Hangyeol, as if this stranger is an uncanny reflection of the dead man he still loves...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Alpha Boyfriends
synopsis:
Kwon Jushin gets a candle that can reproduce omega pheromones with 90% accuracy. Using this candle, he tries to think back to his first love, but for some reason, he thinks of his alpha acquaintance Sung Jewon rather than an omega.

Jushin decides to have fun with the candle instead of getting rid of it, so he has a bet with Jewon to see who can withstand the candle's effect.

However, the candle unlocks Jushin's desire to be with Jewon, and try as he might, he can't stop wanting him, a fellow alpha.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Dear Stranger
synopsis:
After surviving a car accident that left him in a months-long coma, Lee Soo-han wakes up with no memory of his past. Standing by his side is a mysterious man who claims to be his husband—Jo Yeon-seo.

Although they're supposedly married, the emotional distance between them feels insurmountable. Soo-han grows wary of Yeon-seo, yet he can't help but be drawn to the man's steadfast devotion.

Just as Soo-han begins to feel a connection, Yeon-seo shatters his expectations with a shocking revelation: he's ready to give Soo-han a divorce—for his own good.

The more his young husband pulls away, the more genuine Soo-han's feelings become. Determined to break through Yeon-seo's guarded heart, Soo-han takes matters into his own hands.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Order Up!
synopsis:
After a disastrous office romance, Hyojun quits his job in a fit of rage and opens a café...only to find himself serving more dust than drinks. Business is dead, and desperation sets in; with no other option, he decides to sell the matching couple ring from his ex. The sale goes through quickly, but on the day of the meetup, something unexpected happens: the café is suddenly packed. It turns out the buyer is a stunningly handsome student, and word of his looks has drawn a crowd. Watching people fawn over the mystery heartthrob, Hyojun makes a snap decision that will change his life forever. Did someone order a cup of burning love, cause this cafe's got that order extra hot for you!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Rainbow Donut
synopsis:
Lee Inwoo will do anything to for his family—no matter the consequences. After learning about a potential plot to leak sensitive information, Inwoo travels back to Korea to track his brother's last known location. His search leads him to Dr. Kang Dowoon, a doctor with connections Inwoo is dying to get his hands on. But, as the two grow closer, the both of them fall deeper and deeper into a tangled web of deceit and mystery that neither of them could have anticipated... Chasing this rainbow is bound to lead to something much less pleasant than a pot of gold.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Mix-Up
synopsis:
Jehyun, a beta researcher studying Alpha-Omega gene replication, is given a secret mission: lie low for a while and act as guardian for AP1, a dominant Alpha test subject. Moved by the experiment's innocent eyes, he grows attached to the young subject and names him "Ian." But the very next day, Jae-hyun wakes up to find a towering man waiting for him...a man who turns out to be none other than Ian himself, now suddenly fully grown and overwhelming in stature. In this twisted tale of genetic experiments and forbidden bonds, who's really taming whom?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: His Perfect Guide
synopsis:
Yeon Hae Geum, the nation's one and only S-Class Guide, has been in love for years with Seo Moon Hyeon—his guardian, mentor, and the man who raised him like family. From teaching him how to eat and read to mastering his guiding abilities, Moon Hyeon has always been Hae Geum's everything. But just when Hae Geum thinks he'll stay by his side forever, Moon Hyeon suddenly announces his engagement... without even telling him.

Crushed, Hae Geum prepares to walk away... that is until fate throws in a twist: Seo Moon Hyeok, Moon Hyeon's identical twin brother, shows up. Cold, blunt, and endlessly flirtatious, Moon Hyeok needs Hae Geum—not for love, but to power his climb to the top. Still, he's not above using his twin's face to seduce him.

Now trapped between a possessive first love and a reckless new temptation, Hae Geum must navigate a storm of emotions, pheromones, and dangerous attraction.

Will he remain loyal to the past—or give in to the thrill of something forbidden?

One face, two

title: Locked in Lead
synopsis:
Despite his job as a corrections officer, Jeongwon is terrified—but it's not the incarcerated criminals that scare him. No, what Jeongwon is scared of is the possibility of someone discovering the secret love he's being harboring for his stepbrother, Yejun. But when the two come face to face in the confines of the concrete cells, Jeongwon will not be able to hide any longer. Forced to confront his past, will Jeongwon be forever bound to his guilt? Or will he finally break free of the prison he's created for himself?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Not a Peep!
synopsis:
With the press of a button, Yu Sol's life is about to turn upside down. When a mysterious post with the power to transport the user to their favorite fictional universe pops up on his feed, Sol clicks "share" and falls asleep...only to awake the next day as a round, winged puffball! Try to speak as he might, he can only mutter one word- er, sound: "Peep!" With his new avian appearance, Sol must navigate the land of Sevon under the guiding hand of his new (strikingly handsome) owner, Karhan Barthés, while trying to find a way back to world from which he came.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Open the Door
synopsis:
"Mr. Esper, I told you already. I'm a B0-grade guide."

Lee Yeoni, a powerful dual-blood, has spent years hiding his striking looks and exceptional abilities while working in a quiet, rural town. But when circumstances force him to transfer to the capital, he finds himself entangled with Tae Hajin—an elite grade-S+ Esper with an intense, domineering presence.

Sensing that Yeoni is hiding something, Hajin becomes determined to uncover the truth. Using every trick at his disposal, he digs deeper into Yeoni's secrets, setting off a tense battle of wits and wills.

Desperate to protect his identity, Yeoni resists Hajin's pursuit—until he realizes he can turn the tables. If he must be exposed to danger, why not use Hajin as his shield? And so, he makes a bold decision...to become Hajin's exclusive guide.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

Since being identified as a Guide at the age of five, Choi Taehun has spent his life searching for his destined Esper, but has never found one. Now 28 years old, he unexpectedly meets his match at an autograph signing for top celebrity Ji Gwanyeong, after being persuaded to attend by his younger sibling. As they begin working together due to their unique connection, Taehun struggles with the unexpected intensity of their bond. He insists that their relationship must remain professional, denying any romantic involvement, while Ji Gwanyeong remains confident and unfazed, teasingly suggesting that their connection will evolve into something more. Despite his reluctance, Taehun finds himself increasingly drawn to Gwanyeong, leading to a complicated and tension-filled relationship.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Evolution of Species
synopsis:
Yoon is a free agent, using his extraordinary strength and cunning for any job that comes his way—legal or otherwise. But when a crucial mistake plunges him headfirst into the world of a shadowy crime network known only as the "platform," he enlists the help of a well-connected alpha named Kwon Shinwoo. Together, these reluctant allies will have to uncover the mysteries of the nefarious platform... and each other.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: I Think My Friend's Going to Become the Demon King
title_english: I Think My Friend's Going to Become the Demon King
title_japanese: 내 친구가 마왕이 될 것 같다
synopsis:
Sacher Blythe, desperate to live a long and peaceful life, fails to avoid the future demon king, Phelan Exa Drozen. But Phelan knows more than he should...he recognizes Sacher as an "outsider"—someone from another world who knows the future and wants to kill him. So Phelan proposes a truce and Sacher agrees, hopefully preventing him from becoming the demon king. But this agreement keeps Phelan closer than Sacher would like...and their reluctant friendship is quickly turning into something more.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Written in the Stars
synopsis:
Joo-hyuk has spent a lifetime at the bottom of the societal food chain as a recessive alpha. That hasn't stopped him from maintaining a peculiar relationship with the dominant omega at the top of the food chain, Yoosung. For ten years, Joo-hyuk finds himself longing for Yoosung, who only comes to him when he needs to hide away from the world for a night. After spending ten years as Yoosung's occasional sanctuary, Joo-hyuk, sick of his one-sided pining, puts an end to their arrangement. But are they really destined to end there? Or is there something written in the stars for them?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Tied Up in Twins
synopsis:
Sarang loves Jinwoo, Jinwoo loves Woojung, and Woojung loves... you get the idea. But after a mix-up of affections and tangled signals, can they find a happy ending stuck between love and friendship, or will even family bonds be lost in heartache?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Killing Mr. Park
synopsis:
Kill your husband and live with me.

One day, Sujin confesses to Min that she wants to kill her husband, Mr. Park, during the company field trip. Min, who has had a crush on Sujin for a long time, agrees to help her with her plan. But on the trip, despite seeming as if she doesn't remember the plan, Sujin acts strangely. What agenda could Sujin be hiding?

(Source: Manta)

title: A Small Lie
synopsis:
I write to you regarding my murder of your son.

Older brother Yuchan excels in his studies. Younger brother Yujae shows no interest in school. Their mother Jiwon is relieved when Yujae starts opening up to his tutor, Mira. But one day, Jiwon receives a shocking letter from Mira: "I write to you regarding my murder of your son."

(Source: Manta)

title: The Great Selection
synopsis:
"You decide the fate of humanity."

Gana's mother disappeared when he was young, but he believes she may have turned into a dolphin since he can communicate with them. Bullied by his family and other villagers, Gana must decide if he thinks all humans should perish, or if there are enough good ones to cancel out the bad.

(Source: Manta)

title: Merry on the Rocks
synopsis:
The gentle dance of snowflakes as they fall to the ground. Sparkling lights twinkling in the frigid night air. Couples holding hands and sharing in joyous laughter. While most people anticipate the Christmas season, for Noel Alan Brown it is nothing but an inevitable annual annoyance. Making his way through the gaudy streets of New York in pursuit of some semblance of enjoyment, he arrives at a club and meets Lee June: mysterious, seductive, and utterly irresistible. But after a night of intensely playful passion, June is nowhere to be seen... leaving nothing but another reason to add to Noel's Christmas hate list. Returning his focus to a crucial upcoming presentation, Noel tries his best to erase the alluring June from his mind to no avail. Luckily for him, he'll have a chance to see his disappearing lover again—because June is working for the competition! Tensions won't be the only thing rising as the two go at it in both the board room and the bedroom.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainmen

Ahn Jaeha, a national judo athlete, is invited as a temp instructor to Lim Seojin's training center.

Despite Seojin's warm demeanor, Jaeha's cold and stoic attitude creates an awkward tension between them. On his way home, Seojin unexpectedly runs into Jaeha, and in a spur-of-the-moment decision, they end up drinking together. But when Seojin wakes up from his drunken stupor, he finds Jaeha calling his name... while masturbating right in front of him!!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Unfinished Match
synopsis:
Jae-hyeong and Min have been friends and rivals in judo since childhood. Min always believed they would continue their journey in the sport together, but one day, Jae-hyeong suddenly disappears without a word.

Years later, Min enrolls at Jae-hyeong's university and tracks him down, only to discover that Jae-hyeong has quit judo entirely. Determined to bring him back, Min challenges Jae-hyeong to one final match—but the stakes are anything but ordinary.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Tiger's Bride
synopsis:
In the shadows of Mt. Bukhan, a lonely tiger spirit discovers the corpse of a man and seizes the chance to live among humans in his body. Dreaming of love but armed with raw instinct, he stumbles through human life until he meets Suhyeon, a quiet young man with a shaman grandmother who sends him to confront the unruly spirit. But when a protective charm breaks, the tiger's suppressed desires explode, and he becomes fiercely obsessed with making Suhyeon his mate—promising to protect him for life, no matter what.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Sun-Kissed Heartbeats
synopsis:
In the scorching heat of summer, Seokhyun's life takes an unexpected turn as he and his family leave the bustling city behind and settle into a serene countryside town. Seokhyun quickly attracts attention and gains popularity among his new classmates. However, Seokhyun's gaze is irresistibly drawn to Heebok, his quiet classmate with striking blond hair. As Heebok helps Seokhyun discover the simple joys of country living, tender moments are shared between them, and love quietly blooms beneath the warm, sun-kissed skies.

title: Past Friendship
synopsis:
Kwon Woo-young and Ko Tae-sung were always the closest of friends—inseparable and unbreakable.

Their relationship took a drastic turn when Lee Soo-hwa, a timid classmate from high school, grew closer to Woo-young. Tension and jealousy began to simmer between the two friends, eventually erupting in a mysterious incident that shattered their bond.

Even after enrolling in university, they couldn't repair their friendship. Struggling with his unresolved emotions, Woo-young chose to enlist in the army, hoping to bury his feelings for Tae-sung. But neither time nor distance could erase the complexity of his emotions. After his discharge, he moved into a new apartment—only to discover that Tae-sung was living in the same building.

What began as innocent friendship now burns with an intensity Woo-young can no longer deny.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Showered with Love
synopsis:
Yu Doha, a veterinarian and trainer at a monster biology facility, becomes an unexpected guardian to a juvenile tentacle monster after a slimy first encounter. Imprinting on Doha as its parental figure, the creature named Octo leaves Doha responsible for its care and training over the next year. However, Octo proves nearly impossible to manage alone due to its unpredictable behavior and insatiable sexual appetite.

To ensure Doha's safety, Cha Gyeonghwan, the facility chief's son, is brought in as his assistant. As they work to tame Octo's wild tendencies, the two grow unexpectedly close, their connection deepening into something far more personal.

"You told me to remember your scent wherever I go, so I did. You still smell sweet."

synopsis:

Eloise, a fugitive with a dark past, and Lord Johannes, the temple's relentless hound, enter a marriage built on lies. With one year to live, Eloise must steal the Stone of Time from Johannes without revealing her identity. Can she survive this deadly game of deception?

(Source: Manta)

title: Resurrection
synopsis:
Resurrecting someone is never easy.

Taesoo, K, and I have been best friends since elementary school but one day, K stops coming to school. Taesoo and I visit K but see him die of illness before their very eyes. K's mom tells them that to resurrect K, she has to get the right "ingredients"...

(Source: Manta)

title: The Golden Light of Dawn
