After losing her family in a demon attack, Rosha is reborn as the 777th most powerful magic knight in the Golden Dawn Society. To avenge her family, she trains hard and rises through the ranks against the odds. Then, she is tasked with protecting little Joshua, who is said to be the Child of God...

(Source: Manta)

title: Anti-Monster Force
synopsis:
The Anti-Monster Force—a group of hardened mercenaries contracted by the military to combat monsters. It's not quite where Regan, an ordinary young factory worker, expected to find himself, but a drunken night out with his friend leads him to sign an enlistment form. Before he can blink, he's through boot camp and the newest member of the AMF. Despite being assigned all kinds of grueling and humiliating tasks as the newbie, Regan does his best to fulfill his duty and protect humanity from fearsome monsters!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Uncanny Counter
synopsis:
In this world and the next, both good and evil exist. But who do you call when evil spirits from the afterlife escape to prey on innocent human lives? You call the Counters, people with supernatural abilities, who also happen to run a noodle shop. When one's killed, an ordinary high school student is unexpectedly chosen to take their place. The seemingly mundane life of So Mun takes a drastic turn as his body changes (curly hair now included) and he starts to show a talent for his new role.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Ghosts of Greywoods
synopsis:
Welcome to Greywoods, a beautiful mansion isolated deep in the countryside. Its main inhabitants? The Viscount Rose, his daughter Lady Eileen, the housekeeper, the butler, and... a new maid, Marie. As Lady Eileen and her newest (and only) companion begin to open up to each other, do their hearts follow close behind? Now, don't mind any lingering ghosts still haunting the grounds, they're not real! Nor are there any enduring secrets, deep-rooted betrayals, or an air of mystery... just trust me.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Flowar
synopsis:
"Wake up." These are the words Sora Han hears right before her heart stops and then begins to beat again. The first and only person in the world to successfully have a plant heart transplant, Sora has felt an inexplicable pull to go to outer space ever since her operation. At 25 years old, she finally gets the chance. But why does everything on the planet she travels to seem familiar? Sora learns more about herself on this journey than she could have ever imagined.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Doinaka Shusshin no Imo Reijou, Nazeka Koushaku ni Dekiai sareru

synopsis:
To maintain her baron family's reputation, Vivi, a young lady from the countryside, comes to the royal capital to work. Despite being a seamstress, she's a practical, no-frills country girl. One day, Vivi has a chance encounter with Alec, the captain of the Holy Knights, and—shockingly—he falls in love with her at first sight!

Even though Vivi is bewildered, Alec's overwhelming affection doesn't stop, and before she knows it, they end up living together!? It seems there's a deep reason behind his actions, but romance-clueless Vivi can't make sense of it at all...

synopsis:
"You know that house up on the hill? Food is delivered every week, but no one lives there."

For unhoused man Dylan Reese, that sentence is like a beacon. He thinks he's stumbled upon the most perfect situation, until the owner comes home that is! From Dylan's new attic abode, he can see right into the owner's bedroom...and even see him doing unspeakable things! So when Dylan is inevitably caught, he knows it won't be long before the other man's peculiar tastes become his problem to deal with.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: I Swear I'm Not a Scammer!
title_english: I Swear I'm Not a Scammer!
synopsis:
Yeonwoo's an author but his work isn't going so well and there's the slight problem of his stalker (aka his ex). When he looks for a new place to live, the landlord of the apartment is suspiciously young and way too handsome... but desperate times call for desperate measures!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Kill Me If You Can
synopsis:
In a world where doppelgängers exist and are tasked with killing their human counterparts, a devil named Joon falls prey to distraction and accidentally creates Doh Seong-ah. He's supposed to be taking the place of Lee Woo-yeol, but instead comes out looking like the male version of Joon's favorite idol! Undeterred, Seong-ah enters the human realm to start his mission, but Woo-yeol proves to be far more formidable and terrifying than Seong-ah anticipated... Can he succeed in eliminating Woo-yeol? Or will the world be big enough for the two of them after all...?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Clean and Dirty
synopsis:
Police officer Ma Youngtae thinks he's in for a long dry spell after being transferred to the countryside with only old people for miles. But a trip to the neighborhood cleaners ends in Youngtae getting more than just his laundry done when he finds Seo Daehyun, the only other young man in the village, in a compromising position. They strike a deal where both of them get down and dirty...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Fragments of Us
synopsis:
Yi Seoyo is a prince who grew up believing he was a Yang being. But when he reaches the age of thirteen, he discovers during a ceremony that he is merely a commoner, a fact that deprives him of his princely status and palace home. Just as he is about to forget about the palace's splendor, his royal past, and Nareu-ye, the boy he promised to take as his mate if he were a Yang being, Nareu-ye appears in front of him with everything he has been stripped of. Then, in the distant future, Yun Seoyo is born, carrying the memories of his past life as Yi Seoyo. He meets Kwon Chaheon, who looks identical to Nareu-ye but has an entirely different personality. Despite trying to distance himself from Chaheon due to his painful past, he gradually finds himself opening his heart to him...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Formless
synopsis:
Heewoon has what he thinks is an innocent little obsession, following (some would call it stalking) his fellow classmate Seo Kangwoo around. Pure curiosity is all it is. Plus, Kangwoo is super popular and good-looking and this is just for fun. But when things don't go according to plan and Heewoon gets caught red-handed, his life is about to change forever...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Love Is like the Weather Forecast
title_english: Love Is like the Weather Forecast
synopsis:
It's all rainy days for Ban Dong-wook. Haunted by ghosts, he is unable to fall asleep no matter what he does. But one night, with Lee Do-hyun by his side, he is able to clear his mind and drift off into dreamworld. Dong-wook is convinced he needs Do-hyun, but the latter is scared to love him in return. Will the two be able to work through the storm and find sunny days ahead? Or is the hurricane that is love destined to tear them apart?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Arashi ni Mau Psyche
synopsis:
Mitsuba Uno, a university student on a scholarship, immerses herself in her studies and part-time work, leading a life far removed from romance. One day, she meets Rei Mitsutani, an art major, and ends up cleaning his studio. Rei is a popular model who dresses in high-end brands and has a talent for drawing. Although Mitsuba knows that he lives in a different world than her, she begins to be attracted to him as they spend time together. However, Rei draws a line and says, "Stay away from me."

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Taboo Temptations
synopsis:
It's been almost 5 years since Hyeonseo's wife, Juha, has passed. Yet he's still not over the hurt and the lingering feelings of love he carries for his late wife. But who should come knocking on his door one day is none other than Juha's younger brother, his brother-in-law, Yuha.

Just having come back from studying abroad, Yuha needs a place to stay until he can get a place of his own. Hyeonseo gladly lets him stay at his place, but the problem is that Yuha looks too much alike Juha... And looks like someone's been sporting a crush all these years, and now that he's all grown-up and Hyeonseo is available, he's not afraid to make a move and give into these taboo temptations...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Check You Out
synopsis:
Won Ilhoo is eager to return to university life after being discharged from the army. But when he meets the king of campus, Yoo Chaeheon, things don't go quite according to plan. Sometimes it seems like Chaeheon is excited to get to know Ilhoo, showering him with praise about his good looks and treating him to his favorite foods...but then he rags on him for being a pushover with too much time on his hands! As a tug of war between compliments and curses commences, Ilhoo may just discover that he is more similar to Chaeheon than he'd like to admit...and that might not be such a bad thing after all.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Onward
synopsis:
Sometimes one splash is all it takes to make waves. Swimming prodigy Woo Seungwon, whose very being is vast and endless like the ocean, runs into former a-list singer Doh Si-on. Si-on, now a businessman trying to stay afloat, is doing his best to move forward with his life; but the weight of the world only drags him down, as if he is struggling to crawl through a swamp. Taking an interest in Seungwon, Si-on offers him the opportunity to make some extra money as his housekeeper...and perhaps do a little extra work on the side...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Secretary Jin's Confinement Journal
synopsis:
Kidnapped by the cold, dominating CEO from his favorite S&M novel, Yoohyun Jin, a masochistic secretary, looks forward to the anticipated torture. He eagerly awaits Yishin Kwon's touch, but as the lines blur, Yoohyun wonders if this delicious pain might unlock something deeper and more intimate...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Chuuken Exorcist Erihara Shiren no Shinpai
title_english: The Worries of Shiren Erihara, a Mid-Ranked Exorcist
title_japanese: 中堅祓魔師〈エクソシスト〉 襟原士蓮の心配
synopsis:
Veteran exorcist Shiren Erihara worries about absolutely everything. One day, he goes on a demon hunt with rookie Hajo, but his anxieties are endless - from wondering if he turned off the gas to worrying about losing the rookie's respect. Can this unlikely duo manage to exorcise a powerful demon?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Royal Wedding
synopsis:
The omega crown prince of the Kingdom of Wistad has been living in hell ever since the day he was tricked into imprinting on Duke Amandaris. This is because while an alpha's pheromone is supposed to be enticing and irresistible, it is nothing but unbearable stench to an omega that has already imprinted. However, the crown prince finally sees a glimmer of hope when he hears that there is an extremely affluent foreigner in the kingdom who is capable of undoing an imprinting. Unfortunately, this rare information doesn't come for free, so can the prince pay the right price to the man who has it all?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Bound to Be
synopsis:
There’s nothing really special about Seojin. Sure, he grew up with people associated with the supernatural side of life, but he’s just your average guy. Until one day, he finds himself cursed by a girl who kills herself in front of him. The only person who can help him is the head of the House of Serpents: Yoon-hee—who also happens to be Seojin’s ex. As they try to break the curse together, it turns out Seojin is hiding more than anybody can imagine...which might be the death of him. Are Seojin and Yoon-hee bound to fail, or are they bound for more than they ever expected?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Long Live Hatred
synopsis:
Chiyoung might be completely useless as a guide, but he's imprinted on the strongest ESPER around. It was love at first sight when Chiyoung was rescued from servitude by Baekhan Gi, a beautiful and supremely powerful Lieutenant Colonel. But Baekhan's affection turned quickly to disgust when he realized the pretty, young guide he'd claimed was a man. The only way to end their bond is for one of them to die, but Chiyoung hates himself for how much he loves Baekhan...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Yang Ilwoo and Me
synopsis:
Jang Baekhee is counting the days until he can escape Gicheon before his deadbeat father is released from prison. But then Yang Ilwoo arrives: a delinquent transfer student with a cheap perm, brassy hair, and a loneliness that mirrors Baekhee's own. Slowly, their uneasy friendship deepens into something tender. But Ilwoo came to Gicheon with a secret that could shatter the fragile comfort they've both found in each other. And when the past comes calling, can two broken souls survive the truth?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Eye of the Storm
synopsis:
Hwan Woon-ryong and Beom Pung-ho have spent their entire lives locked in a fierce rivalry. As the heirs to the world's two most powerful crime syndicates, their hatred runs deep—and so does their competition. But just as they're poised to seize the biggest opportunity of their careers, fate throws them a curveball: a toddler named Hwan Beom-hae, who, according to advanced DNA testing, is the biological child of both of them.

Caught between disbelief and chaos, the two enemies are presented with an absurd yet high-stakes mission: raise Beom-hae together, lovingly and responsibly. The reward? Exclusive construction rights to the largest global development project in history, sanctioned by the United Nations itself. But co-parenting isn't exactly easy when you'd rather strangle your partner than share snack time and diaper duty.

As Beom-hae's giggles and tantrums slowly chip away at their walls, Woon-ryong and Pung-ho must navigate tantrums, toys, and a growing sense of responsibility—n

title: A Crown of Thorns
synopsis:
Park Taewon never expected to fall in love with an alpha, let alone one twice divorced with a teenage son. But when tragedy strikes, Taewon finds himself alone with that son, Ahn Sangwoo, a boy he never managed to understand. Then Sangwoo starts getting closer. Too close. And when Taewon unexpectedly presents as an omega, what was once grief and confusion curdles into something far more dangerous. Now entangled in a bond steeped in grief and sin, Taewon is consumed by guilt he cannot confess, and a craving he cannot cleanse. Some attachments aren't born of love... They're worn like a crown of thorns.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Shachou! Watashi wa Anata no (Dansou) Hisho desu.
title_japanese: 社長! 私はあなたの(男装)秘書です。
synopsis:
Rei Usui was looking for a high-paying job to help pay off her father's debts when a mysterious man makes an offer with a salary that's too good to be true. He wants Rei to dress up as a man and become the private secretary for his son, Minato, in order to help Minato overcome his fear of women. However, Minato turns out to be rather arrogant and unpleasant. Will Rei be able to complete her cross-dressing secretarial duties without Minato finding out?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: When Pear Blossoms Bloom
synopsis:
After 13 years away from his hometown, Siu returns, reuniting with childhood friends he hasn't seen since "that incident" drove them apart. Though awkwardness lingers, their warm reception reassures him. But after a night of celebration, Siu wakes up to a shocking discovery—a kiss mark on his neck. Who could be responsible?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Lovemare♡ Bangai-hen
synopsis:
Thanks to a mysterious girl named Lovemare and her magic goat, Shun Kabuki lives out a different fantasy each day based on adult comics he’s drawn. And today, it looks like he’s tripping all over the place and falling dick-first into his classmates!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Rojiura de Hirotta Onnanoko ga Bad End-go no Otome Game no Heroine Datta Ken
title_japanese: 路地裏で拾った女の子がバッドエンド後の乙女ゲームのヒロインだった件
synopsis:
In a world of otome games where the protagonist was reincarnated as Ash Laven, a mob character with no connection to the main story. By a stroke of luck, he encountered the former heroine, Fine Stout, who had met a bad end in a back alley.

This strange encounter brought about a change in the story that was supposed to have ended...

This is a story of a protagonist who was supposed to remain a background character and a former heroine who was supposed to meet a bad end, as they attempt to redo their fate.

(Source: Novel Updates)

title: The Cat's Bride
synopsis:
A fateful encounter between a girl and a... cat?

Moments after trying to save a cat from an oncoming truck, Kang Haji finds herself transported to Cat Kingdom. There, she encounters Ko Gyeolhan, a cold and unforgiving prince, and is immediately thrown into a cell. What is this strange land, and will Haji be able to return home?

(Source: Manta)

title: V-Card Raider: Collecting the Male Leads
title_english: V-Card Raider: Collecting the Male Leads
synopsis:
Drunk after her latest heartbreak, lazy game addict Sylvia buys a mysterious game called V-Card Raider. However, before she even gets to play, she dies of alcohol poisoning and finds herself transported into the game world. There, she is told by a god that she is on the fast track to hell unless she sleeps with the main characters, collects the seeds of the World Tree, and saves the game universe! Is there a catch? Who cares?! Who wouldn't want to enter heaven by committing the sin of lust?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: By the Way, Dragon Mistress!
synopsis:
Though he had lost his family at a young age, through the help of Duchess Orleans and the emperor, Karl grew up excellently. But at the banquet Karl attends to tell the duchess of the emperor's meaningful words, a questionable explosion takes place. Duchess, what is your true identity?!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

title: Pound of Flesh
synopsis:
Sharing flesh for lunch? Very normal.

A world where people share their flesh. I give mine to others, and they carve a piece for me. It's toxic corporate culture on another level—how long could you last in a workplace like this?

(Source: Manta)

title: Our Peter Pan
synopsis:
Does she have a screw loose?

In a dystopian era where people are divided by rank, Future High is the only chance to change your life. The wild freshman valedictorian Ipeul Cheon causes chaos within the school and brings about small yet meaningful changes when fleeting moments of brilliance intersect with harsh reality.

(Source: Manta)

title: Fate/Samurai Remnant
synopsis:
The 4th year of the Keian Era, Edo Period. It has been several decades since the end of a turbulent, blood-soaked era. People were enjoying peace and tranquility. But, a battle between seven pairs of Masters and Servants is about to begin, as the "Waxing Moon Ritual" unfolds in the shadows. Miyamoto Iori, a young man in Asakusa, finds himself caught in the violence of a Holy Grail War.

(Source: ANN)

title: Tensei Seijo to Moto Maou no Kishi
title_japanese: 転生聖女と元魔王の騎士
synopsis:
Stella was living peaceful days in a small village church. One day, while using her secret power in the forest, she was spotted by Vincent, a knight from a neighboring country. The moment Vincent laid eyes on Stella, he said—

“I’ve been searching for you all this time.”

Stella ends up living under Vincent’s care. A connection that transcends time from a previous life—each of their feelings intertwine in this tale.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Nibanme na Boku to Ichiban no Kanojo
title_japanese: 二番目な僕と一番の彼女
synopsis:
Minamino Chinatsu is a beautiful girl who's incredibly popular and easygoing. Ever since I met her in the fall of my first year of high school, my life has been anything but ordinary. It all changed when another guy with the same name as me showed up at school-–a handsome one, no less-–and suddenly my classmates started calling me "Number Two."

"You're not 'Number Two' to me," she said. "Besides, it's me who wants to kiss you first."

My relationship with Chinatsu goes beyond just school. We play street basketball after class, cook meals together, share secrets, and even grow physically closer. I thought I was fine being alone, but she accepts me for who I am. And because of that, I want to give her the same in return.

This is a coming-of-age love story about realizing how precious even the simplest desires can be.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Not the First Time
synopsis:
It's been three years since Yeong-in and Seonghyeok parted ways. So why is Seonghyeok approaching her now—gentler, and more intense than ever? Will their reunion end differently than before? Can they fill the emptiness in each other's hearts?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Wish Upon a Husband
synopsis:
One wrong wish and now I have two husbands?!

After finding a wish-granting statue, Renea jumps at the chance to turn her love life around. However, what was supposed to be a wish to make her cheating husband fall in love with her ends up as a wish to marry the hunky statue instead! Can Renea pull off having two husbands without getting caught?

(Source: Manta)

title: Plum Candy Love
synopsis:
Yeonghyeon is a quiet and nice boy who is leaving school early when he runs into Daehan, an intimidating classmate rumored to have ties to a gang. Although Yeonghyeon tries to sneak past him, Daehan drags him to a cafe and asks him to be his boyfriend when they're both guys and have never even spoken before! Undeterred by Yeonghyeon's immediate refusal, Daehan walks him to school, buys him snacks, and changes seats to sit beside him. Eventually, his constant attention begins to grow on Yeonghyeon... They say opposites attract, but can these two very different boys find love together?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Plum Candy Love Side Story
synopsis:
Yeonghyeon is a quiet and nice boy who is leaving school early when he runs into Daehan, an intimidating classmate rumored to have ties to a gang. Although Yeonghyeon tries to sneak past him, Daehan drags him to a cafe and asks him to be his boyfriend when they're both guys and have never even spoken before! Undeterred by Yeonghyeon's immediate refusal, Daehan walks him to school, buys him snacks, and changes seats to sit beside him. Eventually, his constant attention begins to grow on Yeonghyeon... They say opposites attract, but can these two very different boys find love together?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Mint Candy Love
synopsis:
At first glance, Yeonghan seems like an ideal boyfriend, with stellar grades and good looks, but he's actually infamous for his awful temper. On the other hand, Yaejoon is mild-mannered and polite, and he loathes people like Yeonghan. Unfortunately, they have to act as a couple for a college course that assigns pairs to recreate a dating relationship. Yeonghan is displeased, and Yaejoon even more so. As the two clash and bicker, they slowly wear down each other's walls to discover their more vulnerable sides. Will this pretend relationship eventually turn into something more genuine?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Room to Love
synopsis:
After Dowan is shipped off for military service and Chain is left behind in their apartment, loneliness settles in...and so does the horniness. Just how exactly will Chamin cope with the absences of his boyfriend and a regular sex life?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Syndrome
synopsis:
Seo Jeong-in, the second son of a wealthy judge's family, fails to get into the university his father wants, unlike his older brother. Consequently, he ends up in a dormitory at a rural cram school catering to upper-class students. Having been aware of his sexual identity from an early age, Jeong-in has been enjoying a free-spirited and indulgent gay lifestyle. However, things turn for the worse when his dorm roommate, Seunghyun, captures footage of Jeong-in in a sticky situation with his friend Han Minwoo using a hidden camera installed in their room...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: TEN
synopsis:
Min Jiho's idol career as a member of a mid-tier K-pop group member ends in emotional turmoil and disappointment. Ready to leave the industry behind for good, Jiho unexpectedly finds himself filling in on a variety show...only to cross paths with Kang Taeyeon, the A-list actor he's long admired. A lighthearted moment on set quickly spirals into a headline-making scandal: the first same-sex "incident" in the industry. Though the rumors fade as quickly as they came, Jiho's quiet exit is once again delayed. When an awkward reunion with former groupmate Park Hyeondo pulls him back into old tensions, Jiho is forced to confront not just his past, but the unresolved wounds he thought he left behind with his life as an idol. In a world where appearances are everything, can Jiho uncover what he truly wants...and who he wants to stand beside him when the cameras are off?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Mayday Mayday Mayday!
synopsis:
Yoon Yuno is a small-time money launderer with a huge problem: he can't seem to escape the sexual advances of his client Vasily Ivanovich Kaminsky, a handsome yet deadly Russian mafia boss. Yuno is terrified of Kaminsky and determined to escape from him, but his attraction to the other man complicates matters. Will Yuno be able to resist Kaminsky's overtures and save himself? Or will he be devoured by Kaminsky's unrelenting obsession?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Payday
synopsis:
After a year of dating, Russian mafia boss Vasily Kaminsky and money launderer Yoon Yuno face an unexpected crisis when Vasily is injured, losing all but his memories from when he was 18. Reverting to the cold, ruthless man he once was, Vasily denies their relationship and cruelly pushes Yuno away. Heartbroken, Yuno contemplates walking away for good. But despite his harsh words, Vasily begins to cling to Yuno. Now, Yuno faces an impossible choice: leave before Vasily's memories return, or stay and risk his heart for a love that might no longer exist.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: 1 Milky Way Street
synopsis:
Milky Way Village is a charming, rustic town where the Milky Way galaxy illuminates the night sky. At its heart stands Night Compass, a cozy doll shop run by Baek Young-ha and his family. While Young-ha is passionate about creating and repairing dolls, his skills aren't as refined as his parents'. Still, he's determined not to let that stop him from pursuing his dream of sharing the joy of handmade dolls with the world—starting with his own community.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: A Fate Rewritten
synopsis:
Mr. Jung, shall I tell you a story? Something like a fairy tale. A long time ago, there lived a servant named Geolson and a nobleman named Jo Moonyoung. The two of them fell in love at first sight...but their story ends in tragedy." Two lovers, reborn in the modern age, are once again separated by fate; Jo Moonyoung, now Lee Hanyoung, is the cold and calculating CEO of SB Construction—the same company that is trying to destroy Jung Seokhyun's neighborhood. But when the two come face to face, Hanyoung realizes that Seokhyun is the very man who haunts his dreams: the reincarnation of Geolson. Convinced that this is his chance to correct the mistakes of his past and hold his forbidden lover in his arms one more, Moonyoung will do whatever it takes to rewrite their fated destiny in pursuit of a brighter future together.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Vampire Syndrome
synopsis:
A conspiracy led by a selected few, freed from the hands of death after being infected by the vampire syndrome. After successfully establishing their world secretly, they became the most powerful entities by having control not only of the police but also of politics and the media. People who knew of their existence called them "The Afters". Meanwhile, Taesu Dan, who had lost everything due to them, forms a strong team for his revenge. Having established his team, Taesu heads to "Red table", a prison camp for bloodbags, to rescue Dam Yi, the bloodbag with the best blood on Earth. How will Taesu Dan carry out his revenge? And will he and his friends succeed?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Witch's Island
synopsis:
When Hannah gets a high-paying job as a tutor for Eilie, a noble young lady, she expects to start a new, peaceful chapter of her life. However, strange things begin to occur at the mansion, and she quickly realizes there's more to it than meets the eye. What secrets are the inhabitants of this remote island hiding? In the darkness of mystery, there may be witches playing tricks.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Want You Like Crazy
synopsis:
General surgery resident Yoon Haesoo has always focused on paying off her father's debt and becoming a great surgeon. But after CEO Chae Jiseok enters the ER as a VIP patient, her world is completely turned upside down. Not only does he want her to be his only doctor, Jiseok wants to spend every second with her. Haesoo can't understand why a stranger would be so interested in her, but she also feels strangely attracted to him. Little does she know that this isn't their first time meeting...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Haru to Yuzu wa Mada Shitenai
title_english: Haru and Yuzu Haven't Done It Yet
title_japanese: ハルとユズはまだシてない
synopsis:
Haruhito and Yuzuki are childhood friends who just started dating. Just when their feelings finally got requited, and their relationship seemed to be smooth-sailing, Yuzuki feels frustrated that they haven't shared the kind of closeness most couples have... So he tries to take the initiative, but it seems like Haruhito has some issues...!?

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: A Bona Fide Killer
synopsis:
Yu Bona is no ordinary mom returning to the office after maternity leave. For her first assignment back she heads to a rooftop, points a sniper rifle at her target in a nearby hotel room, and "bang!" the legendary assassin "Kingfisher" is back. But as Bona takes on a series of new targets, her news reporter husband Taesung is ordered to investigate Kingfisher's return, and as the bodies pile up, the line between personal and professional slowly starts to blur.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Once a Hero
synopsis:
"Had he been a hero in his past life or something...?" "That's right. I once rescued this nation from destruction." When Ja-in is kidnapped due to his family's massive debt, Unjo happens to walk by and save him from his kidnappers. From that day onwards, Ja-in's life is never the same...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Killing Vote
synopsis:
Detective Joo Hyuk's ordinary life is flipped upside down on the day the killing vote begins, giving citizens a chance to punish killers that evaded punishment. Gaetal, the mysterious figure controlling this system, claims it's justice for the forgotten, while Hyuk and his team try but fail to prevent the deaths. With the increasing number of victims and growing support for the votes, will Hyuk be able to catch Gaetal and stop this madness? Or will he have to witness the demise of true justice?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Haitoku Cinderella
synopsis:
Shizuka is a housewife who's been living a sexless life since her husband has changed into an overworked and somewhat abusive man. One day, she discovers that he's been having an affair and runs off to a "rental boyfriend" that her friend introduced her to. She has one goal in mind: take back her confidence as a woman. She ends up meeting the most popular of the men in the rental boyfriend service, a man named Aki, and slowly begins to remember what was all like before her marriage. A new forbidden love is born... can a housewife really have this dream?

(Source: Coamix)

title: Gap no Aru Joshi Futari ga Yuri na Hanashi.
title_english: The Story of Two Gapping Girls Who Are Lovers.
title_japanese: ギャップのある女子2人が百合な話。

title: Belgrade Metro no Kodomotachi
title_japanese: ベオグラードメトロの子供たち

title: The Teacher in the Trap
synopsis:
Booze, smokes, and boys—Hayoon's life was a checklist of bad decisions. At 20, repeating a year in school, she thought she'd seen it all... until her new homeroom teacher, Mr. Hyungwon, walked in. Unfazed by the rumors swirling around her, Hyungwon is calm, mysterious, and always full of surprises. Naturally, Hayoon's curiosity turns into something deeper—her first taste of real love.

"I love you, Teacher."

"That's not love. You're just confused. It happens at your age."

But unlike the guys who usually fall for her with a wink and a smile, Hyungwon is the ultimate fortress—cold, distant, and impossible to crack.

Still, Hayoon's not backing down. That wall of his? She's ready to tear it down, brick by brick.

(Source: Ridi, translated)

title: Opium
synopsis:
1946 Choseon (Korea). Beautiful and brilliant Dr. Maria Arden returns to the country of her birth as the medical advisor to the U.S. Army—a stranger in an unfamiliar land ravaged by wars and corruption. There, she meets Dr. Kyeongju Lee, an alluring, mysterious woman shunned by society. Their innocent flirtations turn into a heated, forbidden love affair, as an illegal trade in opium threatens Choseon's fragile stability. Two outsiders drawn helplessly to each other, but... everything was a lie.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Tear of Solaris
synopsis:
Haunted by the memories of his first love perishing in a fire, Gabriel has always sought refuge from his childhood trauma in his vocation as a priest. However, his fragile peace is shattered when a deceptive and malevolent figure named Paolo enters his life under the guise of a devout believer and philanthropist. The mysterious Paolo possesses the ability to delve into his deepest thoughts and discovers his lingering feelings for his deceased first love, Saliou. Using this knowledge, Paolo begins to slowly manipulate Gabriel's body and soul... until the day comes when the pure and virtuous priest becomes completely his...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Camellia: Mastering the Three Kingdoms as Alice
title_english: Camellia: Mastering the Three Kingdoms as Alice
synopsis:
Dongbaek's life takes an unexpected turn when a mysterious crow pulls her from the modern world into ancient China. Trapped in the Three Kingdoms era, she must disguise herself as a man and gather allies from each kingdom in order to survive. Amid heavy political intrigue, she also faces a rival determined to defeat her. Can Dongbaek outsmart this enemy and navigate the dangerous world she now inhabits?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Miss Who Swallowed a Mage
synopsis:
Ever since her life was saved by a kind, golden-haired mage, Piachel has dreamed of being reunited with him. So when she's given an opportunity to become a "Sharing," a partner who shares their power with a mage through intimate relationships, Piachel takes the chance in the hopes of finding him. But will she be able to find her savior among the mysterious mages of the Magic Tower? And how much does she really know about the man she wishes to devote her body and soul to?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: A Spring Breeze in a Wasteland
title_english: A Spring Breeze in a Wasteland
synopsis:
Esen's death was only the beginning. After saving Cliff from her father's cruelty and being forced to become his wife, her life ended while giving birth to her enemy's child. But fate wasn't finished with her. When she wakes up in the past with knowledge of the future, Esen is determined to rewrite her fate and change her relationship with Cliff, who was once her enemy and is now her greatest challenge. Can love truly rise from the ashes of hatred?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: A Winter Cabin of Serenity and Insanity
title_english: A Winter Cabin of Serenity and Insanity
synopsis:
Roelle's life has been nothing but tragic at the hands of her abusive family. But the worst tragedy of all occurs when she kills her cousin after he tries to take advantage of her. In order to avoid being put to death for the murder, Roelle runs away deep into the winter forest, where she encounters the lone Kayden in his cabin. When Kayden allows Roelle to stay with him for a while, the hopeless cold quickly turns into passionate heat. Will this cabin become Roelle's haven? Or will it be the start of a new hell?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Belated Regrets
synopsis:
Jiwon's track record with men is horrible. It's so bad that she's nicknamed "the trash collector" amongst her friends. Unfortunately, the newest addition to the collection is Do-kyung, her boss. Do-kyung is rich, handsome, and... incredibly difficult in terms of personality. Jiwon is very aware that her crush on him will lead to no good, and she's proven correct after they impulsively spend a heated night together. His selfish and manipulative behavior is a glaring red flag, but she can't help wanting him. However, even Jiwon has her limits to how much pain her heart can handle...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Lying in a Dream
synopsis:
Haeseo seems to have it all: good looks, a caring personality, and a promising career as a speech coach. And, oh yeah, the ability to control people's minds and see into the future! The only problem is, whenever he uses his powers, he develops a certain *ahem* rock-hard condition. So when stunningly handsome Dohyuk offers to lend a hand, Haeseo must learn to lower his defenses and open his heart—that is, until he discovers that Dohyuk has been keeping secrets of his own...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Fighting Girls
title_japanese: ファイティングガールズ
synopsis:
Koume was top of her local karate class until Tiara showed up and beat her soundly. Koume vows to beat her rival the next time, but months and years go by without a single win...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Fighting Girls
title_japanese: ファイティングガールズ
synopsis:
Koume was top of her local karate class until Tiara showed up and beat her soundly. Koume vows to beat her rival the next time, but months and years go by without a single win...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Downpour
synopsis:
Having been outed at work, shoe designer Park Seokyeon is forced to start all over. He gets a new job at "Youm," an up-and-coming brand with an accepting work environment and generous perks. It seems like the perfect company, until Seokyeon finds out that the CEO is none other than his former crush, Jin Yeowon, the cold-hearted jerk who nearly drove him to end his own life. Now, they must work together, but will old feelings well up? Like a sudden downpour, love appears when you least expect it.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Secretary Gwanggong's Survival Diary
synopsis:
Who wouldn't be excited to find themselves transmigrated into a TV show? You get to meet your favorite characters, maybe even have a wayward romance...but for Si-On Baek, it turns out to be more horror than romcom. It's just his luck to end up as the secretary to one of the most ruthless and powerful alphas on TV. Now he has to figure out how to survive while hiding his omega status, which is proving to be quite difficult when alpha Tae-Oh Yoon won't stop getting so damn close...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Starstruck
synopsis:
Seo Hanjun and Cho Yujae have been best friends since they were young. Hanjun has secretly been in love with Yujae for a long time but doesn't dare to confess his feelings since he knows they won't be reciprocated. As long as Yujae stays his best friend, that is all that Hanjun needs to be happy. But as the university entrance exams approach and Yujae becomes more open about his feelings, Hanjun begins to wonder if it would be okay to reach for that star he thought he could never have.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Omoi Ai Monopolize
title_japanese: おもいあいモノポライズ

title: My Jumbo Babe
synopsis:
"That chubby dude will never know what he's in for." Hyesung happened to eavesdrop on a conversation amongst his boyfriend's classmates. But does that mean Hyesung's fashion design major boyfriend, Jungwon, will eventually move on to skinnier pastures? He can't let that happen! Hyesung is determined to lose weight and keep his lover. If only he knew that Jungwon actually loves him exactly the way he is...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Motokano-tachi to Yarinaoshi!?
title_japanese: 元カノたちとヤReなおし!?
synopsis:
Minato Haginouchi, heir to the prestigious Haginouchi confectionery company, is transferred to its headquarters in his third year to begin successor training. But at a company party, his father publicly names him the next president, declaring that any woman who wants to be the president's wife is free to pursue him. Suddenly, in a workplace already teeming with his ex-girlfriends, Minato becomes the unwilling target of their relentless advances!?

(Source: Shounen Gahousha, translated)

title: You Can't Come, Sir!
synopsis:
Guster Smith has dedicated 17 years of his life to being a hero—only to remain a penniless nobody in the grand scheme. So when the esteemed archmage, Lord Angel Romero, offers him a mission to once again save the world, he accepts without hesitation. But all is not as it seems, and Guster is about to find about that the archmage has quite the "staff" he uses to work his magic...and a plethora of special techniques bound to blow the knight's mind.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Wolf in White
synopsis:
After a traumatic incident in high school left Sejin with emotional scars (and a three-year delay), all he wants now is to quietly graduate from Korea's top university with decent grades. But what was supposed to be his easiest class turns into a paired project from hell, and who just so happens to be his teammate? The overly friendly, overly handsome Wuhyeon, of course! Not only is this guy clingy like lost puppy, but there's something about him that puts Sejin on edge... Why does Wuhyeon seem so familiar, and how does he know so much about Sejin...?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Our Home
synopsis:
Hoyoon, a cynical, jaded office drone, is roped into housing Juho, an annoyingly upbeat college freshman he once knew as the kid next door. Now, instead of quiet mornings, Hoyoon wakes up to home-cooked meals and a giant puppy of a housemate who can't stop looking at him like he's the best view in the house.

(Source: Manta)

title: Sweet Shot
synopsis:
Hamin was the quiet, chubby kid with a hopeless crush on his friend's older brother. Years later in college, he's slimmed down and unrecognizable. When Taerim starts treating him with the same gentle warmth as before, Hamin finds his feelings rushing back.

(Source: Manta)

title: Cannot Help It
synopsis:
Itae Jung, a Beta, suddenly finds himself being pursued by Dan Geum, a rich and famous Alpha from his school. They say an Alpha can never truly be attracted to a Beta, but considering the strange offers Dan keeps making to get closer to Itae... Is it just a hormonal malfunction, or could it be real love?

(Source: Manta)

title: Lucky Credit
synopsis:
No cash, no credit? No problem!

Haejun Do is trying to help his sick sister get into a clinical trial when he meets Seogyeol, the owner of Lucky Credit. This strange company issues credit cards to those with poor credit and who are unable to use normal banks, but there's a catch: instead of money, you have to pay with your luck.

(Source: Manta)

title: Bitter Sweet Sweet Darling
synopsis:
Shiwoo Jeong is trying to catch his big break when everything falls apart. He gets accused of stalking a star actor and is blacklisted by his high school crush, Taerim Han, who now runs a successful acting agency. Taerim decides to follow up on the disgraced actor only to realize Shiwoo's life is in shambles. He takes Shiwoo in to set him straight, but discovers that there may be more to this talentless hack. Can Taerim add such a risk to his agency's roster and make something of Shiwoo while his romantic feelings resurface?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Tale of a Villain
synopsis:
At Dowonhyang, a secret luxury retreat for the elite, Cheongwoo works as a server when he catches the eye of Wonjae, a man of power and influence who always gets what he wants. Unfortunately for Cheongwoo, what Wonjae wants is him. Though Cheongwoo tries to escape, the trap has already been set, pulling him into a dark, consuming spiral of desire and obsession he never saw coming.

(Source: Manta)

title: A Strategic Partnership
synopsis:
Omega Taekwondo star Taehyun must find a “partner” before his final Olympics to help control his hormone levels. That partner is none other than Sejin, a fencer he took care of 4 years ago. As their relationship continues to develop in unexpected ways, can he break his jinx and finally win gold?

(Source: Manta)

title: Like Mother Like Son
synopsis:
What happens when your mom's freshly-dumped boyfriend turns out to be exactly your type? In the case of Jiyun, his answer is obvious: sleep with him. Hyunsoo, the ex-boyfriend in question, could probably use a rebound. And maybe a one-time rebound can become the long game. Jiyun just needs to make the first move...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: In the Air: Be, be
synopsis:
I thought I was a beta all my life, but it turns out I'm an omega! And not just any omega, but one who's about to become the crown princess. Not only am I confused by shattered images of my past and the cumbersome imperial etiquette...most of all, I'm confused by my supposedly destined union with the so-called "golden alpha," crown prince Wookyung. Besides, I'm a man—how am I supposed to get pregnant?! But my desperation to avoid carrying his baby is only making the crown prince more and more upset... Something is in the air, and it's not just love...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Backdoor Neighbors
synopsis:
The small town farmer life is all Gitae has known his whole life. He's never been into mystery, intrigue, or complications. But all of that appears in the form of his newly hired helper Haeun—who is absolutely useless at farming. But Haeun's true talents lay somewhere else. Mainly in the bed...if only they could actually get into a bed, somehow.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: End It
synopsis:
As an omega, Joohae has lived a miserable life the past few years since his parents passed away. Buried under debt, trying to dig his way out by selling his own body, and still suffocating in the dirt anyway. That's the cycle of his life—until he's found by an alpha by the name of Cha Jinwook. Then, he's introduced to a very different kind of cycle...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Swept Away
synopsis:
Ba-da never dreamed of getting into a steamy relationship with a celebrity before. Well, until recently, that is. Now, after meeting famous actor Shim Chae-yoon and getting an offer from the nation's heartthrob to teach him how to be in a relationship, Ba-da has been having some explicit dreams. Except...maybe they're more than dreams. The line between dream and reality is fading faster by the day...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Take Me High
synopsis:
Arts major Il Yoo is trying to force his way into music major Leewon On's proximity, but little does he know that he was inadvertently the cause of Leewon's heartbreak three years prior. One thing leads to another and the two begin to draw inspiration from each other for their respective graduation projects.

(Source: Manta)

title: I Give You My All
synopsis:
Yun Sehui, a promising designer, lives as nothing more than a puppet for her family and is under the constant watch of her abusive stepmother. One day, she meets a seemingly perfect man, Han Taehyeong, who offers her an amazing job to free her from her shackles. However, it seems he may want more than just a standard work relationship.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Goddess's Guide to Farming
synopsis:
How far would you go to convince your billionaire father that you deserve the keys to his kingdom? Smart, ambitious Seol would do just about anything, including hard labor on a farm for three months. Of course, it helps that her new boss, Bongsu, is easy on the eyes. Will Seol prove to the hot farmer that she has what it takes? Will she win the respect of her family? Most importantly, how will she keep from falling in love with Bongsu?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Nurudenohana Koukou Lotion Sumou-bu
title_english: Nurudenohana High School Lotion Sumo Club
title_japanese: 白膠花高校ローション相撲部
synopsis:
Some say there are over 50 million participants in this national sport that needs no introduction—"Lotion Sumo." Asato Mizu brings you this classic coming-of-age sports story about young girls covered in sweat, tears, and lotion!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Zenbu Kimi no Sei dj - Otoko ni mo Onna ni mo Naru Couple ga Onsen Ryokou no Tsumori de Love Hotel ni Iku Hanashi
title_japanese: 男にも女にもなるカップルが温泉旅行のつもりでラブホに行く話
synopsis: Ryou and Nagisa accidentally book a stay at a love hotel instead of an onsen.

title: Sasaeng: Obsessive and Tenacious
synopsis:
The life of a celebrity is far from a bed of roses. Choi Deokhee, better known as Deok-E, knows that better than anyone else. Everything he's worked so hard to accomplish comes crashing down in a single night when he runs over a sasaeng fan who had abruptly dashed in front of his car. But by some stroke of luck, a mysterious man, Jung Yool, witnesses the entire incident and helps Deokhee cover it up. However, something imperceptibly sinister seems to be lying beneath Jung Yool's helpful facade...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Hirose-senpai wa Tomaritai
title_japanese: 広瀬先輩は泊まりたい

title: Nandemo Yurushite Kureru Itoko no Mii-chan.
title_japanese: なんでも許してくれる従姉妹のみぃちゃん。

title: Dark Elf wa Aragaenai
title_japanese: ダークエルフは抗えない

title: Machiawase wa Sasoriza no Dokoka de
title_english: Meet Me Up at Somewhere in Scorpio.
title_japanese: 待ち合わせはさそり座のどこかで
synopsis:
"You'll never fall in love with me."

Takamura, a high school student, returns to the town where he lived as a child and, by chance, finds himself in the same class as Rei, the boy he had a crush on back then. Rei also remembers Takamura, and feeling something akin to fate, Takamura once again begins to harbor a faint feelings for him. However, when Takamura witnesses Rei entering a hotel with a man after class, Takamura is surprised and asks him about it. Rei nonchalantly replies that the guy was a sex friend, and Rei's next words are: "I have no idea what it means to fall in love with someone"...?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: Tensai Daini Ouji wa Hikikomoritai: "Gokutsubushi" no Mujikaku Musou
title_japanese: 天才第二王子は引きこもりたい 【穀潰士】の無自覚無双
synopsis:
Neet van Avadora, the second prince of the great nation of Astoria, is a homebody who loves nothing more than staying indoors. After cutting himself off from the outside world for years to devote himself to magical research, he has, without even realizing it, grown into a true prodigy of magic.

One day, however, under orders from his father the king, Neet is forced, much against his will, to enroll in the Magic Academy. There, he gradually begins to enjoy student life, blessed with quirky but kind friends. But because of his overwhelming magical talent, he constantly finds himself caught up in one troublesome incident after another...!?

Meanwhile, Alex, the first prince, and the very cause of Neet's growth into an unknowing genius, sets a certain "plan" into motion. This plan will spark a great incident, one that will change not only Neet's fate, but also the fate of the entire kingdom of Astoria...

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title: Ani (Mahou Shoujo) vs Imouto (Les Succubus Kaijin)
title_english: Gender Bending Magical Girl vs Lesbian Succubi
title_japanese: 兄(魔法少女)vs妹(レズサキュバス怪人)
synopsis:
Tomoya (male) became a magical girl to protect the planet and his twin sisters from evil. Little did he know that he was fighting against the very same twins he wanted to save!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Haiboku! Aegis Taiger
title_japanese: 敗北!イージスタイガー

title: Darenimo Aisarenakatta Shuuwai Reijou ga Shiawase ni Naru made
title_japanese: 誰にも愛されなかった醜穢令嬢が幸せになるまで
synopsis:
Amelia was born unwanted. As an illegitimate daughter of a noble house, she spent her days starving—surviving on weeds plucked from the garden. Mocked as the "Filthy Lady" in high society, shunned by her family, and stripped of her dignity... she never expected anything from the world. Until one day, a marriage proposal arrives. Her fiancé? None other than Duke Logan—the infamous "Brutal Duke" feared by all. Why her? What does he want? And can a girl who's only ever known cruelty... survive a love that feels just as dangerous?

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Shinchou 175 cm no Rikujou Shoujo wa Kouhai Danshi no Seishi wo Nomitagaru.
title_english: Tall Track and Field Girl Wants to Drink Junior's Cum
title_japanese: 身長175cmの陸上少女は後輩男子の精子を飲みたがる。
synopsis:
Hazuki is the tall runner in the track and field club. Her performance has been lacking recently, so after practice she goes out to search for her boyfriend. Drenched in sweat, with her skimpy undersized tracksuit clinging tightly to her, she walks down the crowded corridors pretending she's not noticing the glances she's attracting. Finally, this closeted exhibitionist finds her boyfriend and asks him for one thing she's sure will improve her performance: his fresh, white, juicy, high-quality protein.

(Source: FAKKU)

title: Ode to Our Youth
synopsis:
"Bye, Yongsu... It's going to be hard, but please carry on... I really loved you..." Yongsu was dumped today by his girlfriend. And the burden she left is far too big... of a debt. Unfortunate credit delinquent Yongsu is now forced to live each day to the fullest. Every day is a struggle for him to pay up. And he meets various people along the way. His today comes and goes, just like everyone's todays.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Sura's Beloved
synopsis:
In the deepest depths of the mountains, there lies a small village where budding physicians learn how to help those in need. It is a place Cho-ah calls home, and he expects to spend the rest of his days there. However, everything changes when a mysterious, heavily wounded man appears out of nowhere. Cho-ah does his best to nurse the stranger back to health, despite the misgivings that his fellow students have about him. The man's name is Mujin, and it soon becomes clear that the only person he trusts is Cho-ah. How will this handsome stranger change Cho-ah's life?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Numeri Kansatsu Nikki
synopsis:
One day, middle-schooler Renga Ishida helps a slug. One moment later, the slug transforms into a beautiful girl named "Numeri"...!? It's the start of the saucy days of Renga and Numeri!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: How to Train Your Healer
synopsis:
Asta Chronicles, the cornerstone of MMORPGs, has surged into the stagnant gaming market like a blazing comet. On the day of the highly anticipated 'Mythic' difficulty raid update, the largest in recent memory, JJA (Sung Chahyun), the leader of the renowned guild 'Haste'—ranked first across all servers and boasting the most first clears—is thrilled. However, his excitement is dashed when he logs in to find that his partner healer is enlisting in the military that very day! Unable to tackle the new raid without his crucial partner, JJA posts a recruitment notice for new team members. Yet, is able to pass the most difficult requirement of them all: a one-on-one interview. After a day of meticulously managing his block list and flooding the chat with ♡♡s, a surprising newcomer appears—a perfect partner seemingly sent from the devs themselves! Can JJA nurture this adorable newbie, HealTeaser, into a raid-ready healer?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: My Perfect Omega
synopsis:
Nick Stockton, ex-mercenary and now head of a top security firm, has never once lost control—until he crosses paths with Owen Rose, the stunning CEO of Rose Biotech. The moment their eyes meet, Nick is hit with an overwhelming surge of pheromones. He knows instantly: Owen is his Omega.

When terrorists launch a sudden attack on Owen, Nick steps in without hesitation. Grateful and intrigued, Owen invites Nick to his secluded estate. But Owen harbors a dark belief—that he's a "monster Omega," ever since a childhood incident where he injured his Alpha cousin. He's spent his life in strict control... until Nick's bold, relentless (and a bit reckless) pursuit shatters his defenses.

As their bond deepens, Nick begins investigating the attack—and uncovers a chilling truth. This wasn't just a strike against Rose Biotech. Someone is after Owen himself.

And Nick will stop at nothing to protect what's his.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Never Mind, Darling
synopsis:
After an intense night of drinking, Dawoon has a dream about the kiss he and Jin shared back in high school, something he had long forgotten. He feels uneasy but ignores it, blaming the dream on his long hiatus from dating—until he runs into Jin on campus the next day.

Jin seems unusually playful and clingy, poking and prodding at feelings buried in Dawoon's heart. When Dawoon confronts him about it, a casual reply—"We just kissed"—only adds fuel to the fire.

As their long-standing friendship begins to blur into something more, Dawoon must confront his own complex feelings while Jin comes face to face with his heart's desires.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Hero Suit wa Araenai
title_english: The Hero Costume Can't Be Washed
title_japanese: ヒーロースーツは洗えない
synopsis:
This season's top hero Kabuto is so swamped with non-stop monster-slaying that he can't even find time to wash his suit—and boy, does it reek! Watch him struggle to squeeze some free time into his packed schedule...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Blurry Until You
synopsis:
Son Jewan was a rising star in the broadcasting world until he suddenly lost the ability to recognize faces. The loss forces him to rebuild his career as a freelancer and for three long years, every face was a blur. One day, he finally recognizes someone, Lee Jin, an assistant writer at a TV station he'd bumped into before having face blindness... whose name is also written on Jewan's body! Determined to reclaim his place at the top, Jewan proposes a contractual relationship with Jin, but things soon spiral far beyond what either of them expected...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The 11th School Trip
synopsis:
Gajun and Sunwoo, students with supernatural abilities, are trapped in a time loop during their school trip.

After witnessing their friends' deaths, Gajun realizes Sunwoo's death triggers the loop. He becomes fiercely protective, while Sunwoo, confused, tries to protect Gajun in return.

(Source: Manta)

title: Neuromance
synopsis:
"I've been looking for you all my life, but you...you don't remember me?" Within the back alleys of futuristic Jin-gwang district, Kangtae is the ultimate street fighter and task rabbit; an enhanced human with animalistic abilities, he is able to accomplish things most people find impossible. But these powers come with a cost: just like his bestial counterparts, Kangtae is forced into ruts when his wild side takes over. To make matters worse, Kangtae runs into mysterious-yet-alluring Rion—a Virtual World designer who claims to have known him in his youth. As the two explore their history together, they discover a romance nouveau only possible in this new age of humanity...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Evergrey
synopsis:
"You don't know how long I've waited, Danny...all while staring at this name on my arm." After moving to the small town of Edendale with his son, single father Danny begins to be frequently visited by Stan. After the visits become more and more unnerving, Danny begs Stan to stop—to no avail. Claiming the two are fated to be together, Stan will do whatever it takes to fulfill his destiny...come hell or high water.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: A Murderous Affair at 19 Sunset Street
title_english: A Murderous Affair at 19 Sunset Street
synopsis:
A man is found murdered in an apartment at 19 sunset Street. the prime suspect is Leon Devonport, the victim's lover, and all evidence found on the scene of the death seems to point to him. In order to prove his innocence, Leon seeks out Benjamin Wolf, a once-famous detective who has now retired from murder cases due to an incident in his past. Benjamin had long stepped away from murder cases, but at Leon's desperate request, with a bit of flirting, he reluctantly takes the case and begins to investigate. As the investigation progresses, Benjamin uncovers hidden truths behind the case and the complex relationships between all parties involved. What is the truth hidden behind this "murder?" What is Leon hiding from Benjamin?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: My Sassy Celebrity
synopsis:
Chun Woohyeon, a top South Korean star, is on the verge of losing his career due to endless scandals. To save his reputation, his manager suggests a strategic dating scandal. But who would be the perfect partner? That's when Baek Seondo, Woohyeon's long-lost friend—and former secret admirer—unexpectedly reappears. Now a photographer, Seondo lives far from the glamorous entertainment world. Woohyeon, unfazed by their past, casually proposes, "How about a fake relationship with me?" Seondo immediately refuses, but Woohyeon's persistence and his own unresolved feelings make him reconsider. As their contracted romance blurs the lines between pretense and reality, old wounds resurface, and hidden emotions begin to unravel. Seondo swore he wouldn't fall for Woohyeon again—but can he really resist the one person he's always loved? And what happens when Woohyeon realizes he might not want this to stay just an act?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: How the Broken Love
synopsis:
After discovering he's an omega, Yoontae runs away when his mother tries to pimp him out. A seemingly kind man offers him food and shelter—then abuses him. With nowhere else to go, Yoontae ends up in the very life he tried to escape, trading sex for survival. He convinces himself love can be bought or borrowed, until an abusive relationship leaves him broken once more. When his ex attacks him in public, a stranger named Wooseok steps in. Is this the start of something real—or just another trap?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: A Shade of Blue
synopsis:
Once a member of a powerful gang, Gu Taewon is now broke, homeless, and on the run. With nowhere left to turn, he finds himself on the edge—literally—contemplating his life atop a bridge. Just when things seem hopeless, a well-dressed stranger approaches with a surprising offer: "You need some money, right? I can help you."

Taewon doesn't refuse the offer to spend one night together with this strange man...but can he trust the hand that's pulling him back from the brink?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Worth the Wait
synopsis:
Never again, Juhyun thinks. I'll never fall for Shin Heeju again. But what do you know, he ends up running into Heeju again in college, his friend's older brother whom he's had a crush on for as long as he can remember. And this time Heeju's all drunk and slamming his head against a telephone pole. And from what he drunkenly tells Juhyun... he's just been turned down by another guy?! Juhyun knows he shouldn't start, that he shouldn't get his hopes up. He tells himself they're just friends. All he wants there is a peaceful life, but that flies out the window when he meets Sion, who seems friendly on the outside but has a few glaring red flags. Despite Seonu's efforts to avoid him, Sion becomes his friend with an odd persistence and is obsessive, touchy-feely, and manipulative. Even so, Seonu wants to trust the only person who seems to see his true self... but can he really let his guard down around him?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Spinach Bouquet
synopsis:
Country life is supposed to be idyllic, isn't it? A peaceful place full of amiable neighbors with big hearts, right? That's what Jiwoo is looking forward to... But out of all the next-door neighbors to have, he gets Dongchan. Curt, stand-offish, and inscrutable, Dongchan isn't the most welcoming of folks. In fact, he looks like he doesn't want Jiwoo and his family here at all. Bemused but not daunted, Jiwoo tries his best to adjust to life in the country... until it turns out that someone is trying to chase his family away from here. Jiwoo has his suspicions, but will he be able to find the real culprit?

In the final days of World War II, Japan lay in ruins and the cities of Hiroshima and Nagasaki had been obliterated. A tense drama unfolds in Tokyo as Japan teeters on the edge of Armageddon. Nihon no Ichiban Nagai Hi tells the true story of the day immediately before the surrender, as a group of fanatical army officers attempt to prevent the Emperor from surrendering—an act of high treason which will inevitably result in Japan's total annihilation.

title: An Unsettling Scent
synopsis:
While trying to hide the fact that he's an alpha, Hayden is approached by Brett for help on a class project. However, it turns out that Brett is not only a fellow alpha, but one that doesn't use scent blockers. The two naturally butt heads and continue as a series of unsettling encounters unfold...until Brett takes things one step too far.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Omega Bite
synopsis:
In a world where one's secondary gender determines everything, social status is set from birth. Inu, an alpha from a low-income family, is desperate to secure a future among the elite. To guarantee his success, he resorts to abusing pheromone enhancers...but when the side effects temporarily turn him into an omega, his carefully laid plans spiral out of control. So when Hae-yeong, a former classmate and a dominant omega from a powerful family, Haeyoung makes an unexpected proposal to cure him of his new-found issue, he has no choice but to consider it. Faced with a deal that could change his fate, Inu must decide how far he is willing to go to rewrite his destiny.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Rent Free
synopsis:
After being repeatedly evicted due to his intimidating appearance, Park Taeju finds a new place to stay through a friend's recommendation—at the home of Ju Hajin, an economics major known for his elite reputation. However, upon moving in, Taeju is shocked to discover condoms and sex toys scattered around the house, revealing that his new roommate has a notorious reputation as a sex addict. Despite the initial misunderstandings and clashes in their chaotic cohabitation, the two slowly start to become aware of each other in unexpected ways. Can they navigate this unconventional living arrangement and find common ground?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Uncommon Alpha
synopsis:
Alpha Han Wooyeon's only goal is to find the love of his life, omega Ji Eonhyeong, marry him, and spend the rest of their days in blissful happiness. When they finally cross paths again, eight years later, it feels like fate since Eonhyeong has also been waiting for their reunion. But there's one major problem... The delicate omega he remembers is gone, and in his place is a big, strong, strapping alpha who towers over Wooyeon. Can true love overcome such an unexpected twist of fate? Or is Wooyeon destined to lose his first love forever?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Changing Tides
synopsis:
Swimming is defined as the art of moving through water using one's limbs. Yet sometimes, no matter how hard one fights to keep going, they find themselves adrift in a vast ocean; isolated, with no home—and no one—to turn to. This is the story of two men who swim against the currents to reach each other. But as the two dive deeper into the waters of love, will they be swept away by the everpresent tides of change?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Yomei Ichinen no Koushaku Shisoku wa, Tabi wo Shitai

Yona, the first son of a ducal family, was bedridden due to his mana overload condition. One day, he discovered an ancient spell that allowed him to manipulate objects.

"If I can master this, maybe I'll be able to walk again..."

Yona worked hard and succeeded in learning the magic, but one day, his doctor told him he only had a year left to live. On the brink of despair, Yona decided to go on a journey in search of legends from all over the world as his final hope. But what Yona does not yet know is that on this journey he will perform miracles in various places and become a "little hero"...

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

When she saw her identity, she decided to live a happy slow-life as a noble lady. It'd be lucky that her fiance, Louis, wishes to call off their engagement. However, she soon realized why Fiona had to act like a villainess. She was sick and had a difficult time living as a normal noble lady. Since she'd like to live a happy life (alone), she started to change her food, life. and be honest with everyone. Then...something she'd never expected happened. Louis started to say that he loves her so much and never wants to break the engagement! What's happening? It's too different from the original game! Why is he so sweet...?!?!

Not long after the draig vanished from the continent, Crown Guard Commander Alexander is sent to investigate a sharp drop in taxes.

While lost in the remote town of Estrisen, he meets Klain... A strange man who calls him by a nickname and insists he's been waiting for him.

Beneath Klain's hood, Alexander glimpses something impossible: a draig's horn.

Curious and cautious, Alexander considers recruiting the magic-wielding Klain for the crown guard. But as their connection deepens, long-buried memories begin to resurface, tying the two men together in ways neither expected.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Divine Consequences
synopsis:
Ahn Jaeha was never going to be a shaman. Not in this life. He drank, he fucked, he sinned—anything to reject a divine being his family had served for generations.

But the divine being came anyway.

Now Jaeha can't get him out of his head. Or his body.

"You'll come to need me," he said. And Jaeha can already feel the craving setting in.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Forget My Wife, Try Me
synopsis:
Yin Taerim, CEO of a failing company, turns to Seo Yi-rin, a powerful executive with a reputation for sponsoring the lovers she takes a liking to. Desperate to save his business, he makes his move, but Yi-rin already has a new "puppy" to play with and shows no interest.

Instead, she passes him along. Not to a colleague. Not to a rival. To her husband.

That's how Taerim ends up in front of Jin Hakyung, the cold and unreadable head of a major company. Hakyung listens, watching him squirm through an awkward explanation. Then, with a slow smile tugging at his lips, he makes a proposal that stops Taerim cold.

"Forget my wife. Try me."

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Freezing Point
synopsis:
Saet-byeol, a sharp-tongued Omega hiding his secondary gender, has no intention of ever finding a mate. But everything changes when he discovers that his classmate Yul, an emotional Alpha with a fate complex, is his destined pair. The catch? Yul believes Saet-byeol is a Beta and mistakes his feelings for simple friendship.

Determined to ignore his growing attraction, Saet-byeol keeps his distance. When Jae-young, an openly dominant Omega, transfers into their class and immediately captures Yul's attention, Saet-byeol finds it harder and harder to keep his own heart frozen.

A cold-blooded secret, a one-sided fate, and a love triangle that defies logic. How long can they keep their true desires buried before everything starts to melt?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Sparks Fly
synopsis:
Saetbyeol had a lot on his plate: he's an omega who hates alphas, his mom is constantly causing trouble, and his high school boyfriend is a jerk. Naturally, he ran off and hid himself after graduation to live a new life away from these problems. But one day, he runs into Hyeontae, a friend from his past that he's been running from for so long. It shouldn't be a big problem though, since Hyeontae's a beta who just wants to be a good friend...or is he?

title: Codename: GHOST
synopsis:
In a world with supernatural abilities, those with powers can be registered as "special humans" and are assigned missions shrouded in mystery. Hoyeon, one such person, lives a seemingly ordinary life as a college student while keeping his powers a secret from those around him. When he begins a new job as a tutor at the Special Human Resource Administration, he meets Moonsung, an agent who just so happens to be taking his class. A simple teacher-student relationship, there's nothing more to it—that is, until a single touch from Moonsung causes Hoyeon's powers to spiral out of control. As their connection deepens, Moonsung soon realizes there's more to his tutor than meets the eye...but will he be able to unravel the mystery of the connection between the two of them?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Rabbit Hole
synopsis:
One drunken night, I thought I finally slept with Ko Woonha, the person I've quietly loved for years. At least... that's what I believed.

"Was it really you? Please tell me it wasn't..."

"If not me, then who were you expecting?"

Turns out, it wasn't Woonha at all! It was his younger brother, Ko San. 

Ko San, the walking disaster. The charming troublemaker. The human hurricane who makes me want to strangle him every time he smirks. The more I try to escape his orbit, the more tangled up I get... like he's pulling me into his chaos without even trying.

Was that night really just an accident? Or is Ko San deliberately keeping me within arm's reach? One thing's for sure. Whatever this is, it's not going to be simple...and I can't even look away.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Symbiosis of Luna and Sol
synopsis:
Han Boreum just wanted answers about his mysterious illness—not a death sentence. But the shaman he visits drops a bombshell: "You're overflowing with dark yin energy. If you don't sleep with a man full of yang energy, you won't live long."

Desperate to survive, Boreum sets out to find his "yang-guy," and right on cue appears Joo Taeyang—campus heartthrob, top business student, and nicknamed "Apollo" by his admirers.

Perfect, right? Except... he's a two-faced jerk only when it comes to Boreum.

Still, with his life on the line, Boreum launches a clumsy, tear-filled operation to seduce his moody match.

Between awkward attempts at flirtation and unexpected sparks, Boreum starts to wonder—Could survival turn into something a little sweeter?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Sealed with a Secret
title_japanese: 키스 미, 샷 미(Kiss me, Shot me)
synopsis:
Code Name: Silver Rings, a top corporate spy, is given the high-stakes mission of retrieving the password to a vault containing the design for a groundbreaking quantum computer. The only problem? His target, the vault's owner, has lost his memory in a car accident. Desperate, he infiltrates the man's home, pretending to be his lover...only to discover that the password is hidden within the body of the target's brother, Cha Wonwoo! As he searches for clues beneath Wonwoo's clothes, tension builds, with Wonwoo growing increasingly suspicious. What begins as a cat-and-mouse game of seduction turns into a battle of trust and repressed emotions. In the end, will this intrepid mission end with a kiss...or a bullet?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Radiant Darkness
synopsis:
Jeong Nanwoo, a world-renowned violin prodigy, overcame a troubled childhood to rise to global fame. Yet despite his success, he remains trapped in layers of emotional darkness he can't seem to escape.

Enoch Milligan, a charming Hollywood heartthrob known more for his looks than his acting skills, is desperate to prove himself as more than just a pretty face.

The two seem to share nothing in common—until a film project brings them together. Enoch is cast as the lead in a movie based on Nanwoo's life and insists on shadowing him to prepare for the role, ignoring Nanwoo's initial discomfort.

As Enoch stays by his side—warm, passionate, and unexpectedly gentle—Nanwoo's walls slowly begin to crack. The closer they grow, the more Nanwoo begins to rediscover beauty, trust, and a light he thought he'd lost forever.

Sometimes, healing begins with simply letting someone in.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: From Seed to Blossom
synopsis:
Asil, a poor noble, enters the academy as the top student, determined to restore his family's honor. Instead, he becomes the target of relentless bullying. Seeking justice, he confronts Valery, only to face an even harsher fate.

Reduced to Valery's pawn and isolated from everyone, Asil searches desperately for a way out. But Valery's growing obsession only tightens the chains around him.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: My Insatiable Demon
synopsis:
Kim Anon, a superior demon with murderous intent, barges into Jaekyung's restaurant, demanding what is rightfully his. Powerless before such a prestigious demon, Jaekyung can only submit and oblige the stranger. First, the stranger takes his money, then his food, his shoes, and more and more with breathtaking entitlement. Even so, Jaekyung finds himself dreaming that this stranger will take also take him!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: MacGuffin
synopsis:
Lee Soo-ha, who has been locked up in an unidentified facility for a long time, is dragged by strangers and meets a man one day.

Soo-ha starts living with that man, and finds out that he is an Omega who was sold to him, an Alpha. He is concerned about his situation where he has no heat cycle and is unable to conceive due to his abnormal physical condition, but that man doesn't care even though Lee Soo-ha is not doing his job as omega.

As the hatred towards him increases along with the feelings of awkwardness and dejavu, Soo-ha becomes more and more confused...

(Source: Ridi, translated)

title: Oil On Canvas
synopsis:
After an embarrassing run-in with auctioneer Luca Orsini at a Carnevale party, art restorer Dojin finds himself entangled in an unexpected restoration project. As secrets unfold and hidden motives come to light, Dojin must navigate a web of deception, art, and an unspoken connection that keeps pulling him back...
