synopsis:
Eunuch Lee Cheolsu is a secret power figure who controls the affairs of the empire at will. He possesses absolute power, wealth, and even strong martial arts skills... but what does that mean? If he can't do "that"!

Through a reincarnation technique, Cheolsu returns to the time before he became a eunuch. He has one goal in mind: to become an alpha male and enjoy life with the most beautiful women!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Steamy Desert
synopsis:
Serving a young master can be demanding in several ways, as poor Jayed learns while working as Seo Onka's bodyguard. Not only does he have to accompany Seo on all his nights of debauchery, but he's also constantly tempted by his sultry looks and body. Still, Jayed feels conflicted escorting Seo on his trip to meet his prospective fiancee in the desert. He knows this might be his last time seeing Seo alive, and not because the desert's crawling with dangerous criminals. But what he doesn't know is that things are about to heat up in a completely unexpected way...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Raw
synopsis:
Kang Taehwa's first crush came to him like a fever. And ten years later, that fever is still running high when he reunites with his once privileged and untouchable love, Moon Cheonghyeon. But the tables have turned now, as Taehwa has gone from being a poor street kid to the gangster boss of his own money-lending business, and Cheonghyeon is his latest customer. Cheonghyeon knows the violent and foulmouthed Taehwa is no good for him, but he is drawn back to him anyway. And hearing this, Taehwa becomes determined not to lose his first love a second time...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Mythical Errand
synopsis:
When college student Hera Kang agrees to carry out her professor’s errand, she has no idea that her professor is actually a centuries-old deity. And the errand in question? Hera must choose between a shapeshifting fox and snake, deciding which one of them will receive the amulet in her possession to become a god.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Patchwork
synopsis:
Copywriter Seon Jaewon has been losing his mind over a rival social media account that keeps parodying his creative ads. He's ready to kill whoever is behind it, but not before he's "killed" in bed by his hot neighbor, Lee Hyeonjin. After an impulsive first night together, the two men quickly hit it off, and Jaewon feels like he might finally see some sparks fly in his loveless life. Well, as long as this perfect man doesn't turn out to be his worst enemy or anything. But what are the chances of that... right?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Dawnbreak
synopsis:
Yeo Euiyeon, once a respected figure within his martial sect, vanished without a trace after betraying his order—murdering his own master and fellow disciples in cold blood.

Do Haegun, one of the sect's most promising young warriors, was raised like a son by Master Euiyeon. But after being suddenly abandoned as a child, Haegun grew up with a deep scar—feeling discarded, betrayed, and driven by resentment.

Years later, under orders to track down the fugitive Euiyeon, Haegun sets out on a mission fueled by a twisted blend of loyalty and vengeance.

But on his journey, he crosses paths with a mysterious man—someone who looks uncannily like his former master, yet behaves in completely different, disarming ways.

Is this truly Euiyeon reborn? Or a stranger caught in the shadow of another man's sins?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Banhyang: The Remote Island
synopsis:
Sehim's field trip to Banhyang Island takes an ominous turn when a fierce storm leaves everyone stranded. As three students inexplicably vanish amidst the storm, Sehim and his friends scramble to find out why. But, their desperate efforts only seem to drag them deeper into the island's sinister secrets— every revelation intensifying the chilling forces lurking on the island, their chances of leaving the island seem uncertain by the day.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Love Interest Zone
synopsis:
Myungha Tae is going to die in 300 days. Well... maybe. After getting sucked into his friend's novel, "Love Interest Zone," 29-year-old Myungha becomes a 19-year-old high schooler again with one mission—make Yeowoon Cha happy or die. With only 300 days to succeed, Myungha must break past Yeowoon's barriers and prevent him from experiencing the same tragic fate as he did in the novel. But with Yeowoon's favorability toward him in the negatives, will he be able to survive?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Yuurei-chan ga Kyou mo Midara ni Ikiteiru.
title_japanese: 幽霊ちゃんが今日も淫らに生きている。

title_japanese: 絶対に勝てないサキュバスちゃん

title: Our Resident Exorcist
synopsis:
Mild-mannered Sowol is a business owner like any other—only his laundry service, Yeon, services demons! Housed in the strange, mixed-use Trinity Residential Complex where demons and humans live side-by-side, Yeon is frequented by deadly demons and annoying customers alike. With a new part-time hire to train and mysterious new tenants moving in, Sowol's got more than his share of dirty laundry to handle.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: She Bites!
synopsis:
Hanna, a 28-year-old college student, is getting her second undergraduate degree to become a lawyer. However, she soon realizes that she was supposed to go to a law school instead of getting a second undergraduate degree. Out of money and out of place, she joins a start-up business club to make money. Working with four other slightly weird teammates, they are starting a pet clothing business together. This feels a little funky, but everything will be fine... right?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Tomodachizukuri
synopsis:
Tomoko Mochizuki, a high school girl bullied by her classmates, finds an abandoned doll on her way home one day and decides to take it with her. To her surprise, the beautiful doll has a will of its own. Listening to Tomoko's wishes, it begins acting to turn her classmates into "friends"...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Tensai Bishoujo Sanshimai wa Ore ni dake Choro Kawaii.

title: The Heroine's Tale
synopsis:
The heroine chosen by the goddess defeated the evil dragon that threatened the Coral Lake Kingdom and became the realm's savior by rescuing the prince. But what she received in return wasn't a marriage to the prince, nor treasure chests filled with gold, but a return to her hometown... poor and without any reward. Even so, with a heart set on helping others, the heroine falls into a trap laid by the Demon Lord, activating the sealing orb and losing all of her powers. Will the heroine be able to overcome this crisis? A reverse harem begins to form around her, starting with the activation of the sealing orb!

(Source: Ridi, translated)

title: The Princess's Bedroom Doll
synopsis:
From the moment Princess Raha's eyes turned blue—the color symbolic of the imperial heir—she has wanted nothing but death. After her brother seized the throne, he sent her an endless stream of bedchamber slaves captured from conquered lands, but none emerged alive. None until Shane Hildes.

(Source: Manta)

synopsis:
Yuno, the daughter of a lunch box shop owner, is interested in an eccentric and pierced weirdo named Hyou-chan. But is Leopard-chan someone Yuno should not fall for...?

(Source: MU)

title: Welcome to Rose Manor
synopsis:
Sick and tired of her mother's ruinous debts, Richelle accepts a post as tutor to the illustrious Otis family. But upon finding a letter with strict, eerie rules on how to survive within the manor of roses, Richelle senses that something sinister is lurking. Now, she must pay the price for her choice.

(Source: Manta)

title: One-Way Flight
synopsis:
Woo Eunjo is an airport employee who's secretly sleeping with the hottest and youngest plane captain, Ki Suho. Eunjo is convinced their friends-with-benefits arrangement won't ever become something more, but Suho's sweet gestures make it impossible to keep his feelings from growing. It doesn't help that Suho feels anxious himself at Eunjo's constant mixed signals and actually wishes their relationship could take off as well.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Concealing Sacred Simplicity
synopsis:
Michael is an exceptional mage who has wanted King Albert's heart since he first set eyes on him. Because Albert already has many lovers, however, Michael decides to become someone more special to him: the king's one and only minister of magic. Although the king and minister traditionally sleep together to exchange mana, Michael refuses and even invents a machine for the purpose despite Albert's frequent propositions. But when Albert overuses his magic in a wartime emergency and falls unconscious, Michael has no choice but to take the more traditional approach to save him...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Fate Mate
synopsis:
Kwon Sehyeon is both an alpha and omega who enters the beta dorm at his university to hide his unusual trait. Since his omega side awakened late and is unstable, he needs to avoid alphas at all costs. But as it turns out, his kind roommate and old friend, Seo Junhoo, also entered the beta dorm hiding the fact that he is an alpha. Once he learns the truth, Sehyeon knows he should change rooms and stay away from Junhoo. However, an unexpected heat cycle has the two friends crossing the point of no return...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Beneath the Sunflowers
synopsis:
Three years after leaving home, Yunjae gets a call from his sister. "Father's gone...." He feels no tears, no sorrow, because the man was never truly his father. Returning to his hometown under the heavy heat of summer, Yunjae finds his sister unchanged: fragile, beautiful, and heartbreakingly familiar. He knows what he feels must stay hidden, that some things are never meant to be spoken aloud. But the closer they grow, the harder it becomes to bury his forbidden longing, and the past they've both tried to forget begins to bloom again beneath the sunflowers.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Gentle Forest
synopsis:
Aiden is a quarterback and Seowon is a chronically-ill forest boy. Could it be any more obvious? Seowon can't quite bring himself to believe that a popular football player has been crushing on him for years, but Seowon's remote forest home might be the perfect place for romance to take root. But Aiden is only visiting Korea—is two weeks enough time to establish a relationship, or...a family?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Spiteful Affection
synopsis:
Best friends, household pet, or just charity case? Hayoon has no idea what she is to Minju after all these years. She's grateful Minju's family took her in despite her being nothing but a lowly recessive omega, but her relationship with Minju sure is confusing. Minju does seem to like her, whispering sweet nothings in her ear and helping her out when she's in her heat, but who can tell? Ever the stereotypical rich alpha, Hayoon knows for a fact that Minju gets bored easily, that she loses all interest once she gets what she wants. Unable to tear herself away from Minju's grip, Hayoon unwillingly comes to harbor affection, albeit spiteful affection, for her friend...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Most Ordinary Relationship
synopsis:
Wonwoo and I have been living together for the last ten years. We've also been dating for just a few months shy of ten years. Apparently, we were a fairly lovey-dovey couple when we first got together, but things are different now. These days, we fight more than we laugh, and our hearts rage with anger instead of racing with excitement. But any couple that's lived together through thick and thin for this long would say the same thing, right?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Hero Wants to Die
synopsis:
Geonho Kim already saved the world. As the last man standing after preventing the apocalypse, he's ready to pass on and greet his old comrades in the afterlife. But destroying a hero's enhanced body isn't so easy, and Geonho's been sent back to his own timeline where he's still 19, shy, awkward, and hopelessly in love with his classmate, Haejeong. There are 100 days before Geonho's meant to die—it'd be a shame if he found something to live for.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Whispers of Paradise
synopsis:
"Did you know that your father is a monster?"

Young Kane is an orphan boy who doesn't have a penny to his name. He has to resort to petty theft just to get some bread to eat. But out of nowhere appears a mysterious man, Shane White, who promises to take him in and become his adoptive father. Together, they go to the remote island where Shane and his other adopted children live. But this whole thing is definitely odd enough to raise Kane's suspicions... Still, perhaps finally having a family and living on this idyllic island is enough to overcome all that. Even so, Kane can't help but wonder just who this Shane is and what his actual intentions are...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: When the Weekend Comes
synopsis:
When Woojoo follows Yoonjae, his campus crush to college, he's in for a rude awakening on the first day of classes—Yoonjae's gone off to the military! Enter Yi-hyun, a hunky softie with a heart of gold. Woojae offers Yi-hyun a job to fill all the holes...left in his heart by Yoonjae's absence. All Yi-hyun has to do is hang out with Woojae every weekend, and he'll earn big in more ways than one!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Pride and Persistence
synopsis:
Baek Uigun is the stud on campus who has it all. The only thing he's lacking is...a conscience! And after spotting a guy in his lecture who had caught his eye at the club, he starts to make his move. But Dajun, the classmate, slips away like a slithering snake. It's whatever for Uigun, he'll just find someone else to sleep with... But things soon become an emergency when he realizes he can't get it up for anyone else! There's always pride before the fall...and this time Uigun has got to swallow his in order to get with Dajun...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Shingi: The Spirit's Playbook
synopsis:
Junbeom runs into Jina, an exorcist who captures mystical monsters called "Shingis." She gives Jumbeom a bell to protect him, which unexpectedly turns Junbeom into a shingi! Desperate to return to his regular human self, the two look for the man that sold Jina the bell, but he has disappeared. They follow a lead and locate the billionaire who owned the bell before a burglar stole it from him. However, Junbeom and Jina must first catch the burglar before he's willing to help. Will they ever succeed in returning Junbeom to his former self?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Yandere Yakuza no Shuuchakuai: Ojou wa Maiban Dekiai sarete Wakaraserareru
title_japanese: ヤンデレヤクザの執着愛 お嬢は毎晩溺愛されてワカラセられる
synopsis:
"From now on, is it okay for me to have an 'adult relationship' with you, Young Lady?"

Yui Amagi is the daughter of a yakuza family who longs for a "normal life." Her dream of living on her own finally comes true... or so she thought. But her assigned bodyguard—who also happens to be her fiancé—Ichika Izumo, the Wakagashira (Underboss) of the Amagi group, insists that "it's only natural for me to be here," while smoking a cigarette as if he owns the place.

Yui doesn't actually dislike Ichika (in fact, she secretly likes him), but she doesn't want a romance arranged by her parents. Without realizing her own feelings, she decides to spite him by joining a group blind date. However, once the party starts, she feels completely out of place and ends up depressed. To make matters worse, one of the men there takes advantage of her vulnerability and tries to take her to a hotel...!?

"You dare join a group date when you already have me, your fiancé?"

An impatient yandere Underboss × a stubb

title: Luck of My Life
synopsis:
Wooju's obsessed with fortunes and superstitions. Dojin is a psychiatrist who happens to be gay but is still stuck in the closet. When Dojin gets set up with Wooju's older sister on a blind date, she immediately understands the situation and strikes up a deal with Dojin. She'll keep the ruse going to keep Dojin's mom happy in return for Dojin's help in treating Wooju's condition. Could Dojin be just the lucky charm that Wooju needed...?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: How to Win over Your Crush
title_english: How to Win over Your Crush
synopsis:
At our high school graduation, the rival who had tangled with me for years suddenly confessed that he liked me. It was completely different from the victory I imagined, but still, I thought I had won. I walked away believing the score between us was finally settled.

That is, until years later, when he reappeared with a small child clinging to his hand. A son. Disgust and irritation flare up all at once.

A shameless fool… If his heart was going to waver that easily, why did he confess in the first place? 

But fine. It doesn’t matter anymore. The past, his choices, the kid—none of it changes what I already know. If I wanted to drag him back into my bed, it would be the easiest thing in the world.

In this bitter, twisted reunion, the line between victory and desire grows dangerously thin.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Star Wars
title_japanese: 스타워즈: 깨어난 포스 그 이전의 이야기
synopsis:
A long time ago in a galaxy far, far away.... It is a period of civil war. Rebel spaceships, striking from a hidden base, have won their first victory against the evil Galactic Empire. During the battle, Rebel spies managed to steal secret plans to the Empire's ultimate weapon, the DEATH STAR, an armored space station with enough power to destroy an entire planet. Pursued by the Empire's sinister agents, Princess Leia races home aboard her starship, custodian of the stolen plans that can save her people and restore freedom to the galaxy....

(Source: LINE Webtoon)

title: Youth Report: 1995
synopsis:
Spring, 1995. Messy-note business major and campus hottie Jinwu needs someone to rewrite his essays so that they are at least somewhat legible. Perfect-penmanship P.E. major Daehan needs dating lessons so that he can stay in a relationship for at least two weeks. So when the two end up living under the same roof, it seems like the perfect opportunity to help each other out... but after a few fated run-ins, it might be more than just skills that they're swapping!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Master-Peace
synopsis:
Ju Incheol had it all...sharp suits, political connections, and a rising career as the trusted aide to Assemblywoman Lee Myeongsun, a ministerial candidate destined for power. But politics is a knife's edge, and one wrong move can send even the best men tumbling.

When Incheol loses footing in the ruthless hierarchy of the office, he's handed a near-impossible task: resolve the explosive redevelopment dispute in Songmun City's Jungang District. Failure means exile.

He's ready to do whatever it takes—until he meets Ahn Pyeong-hwa, the quiet gym owner next door and the key to the problem. Pyeong-hwa's price for cooperation?

"Hit me. That's all I want."

Behind that strange request lies something darker than bruises.

And as Incheol sinks deeper into the deal, he realizes every favor, every blow, is pulling him into a world where politics and pleasure share the same shadow.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Tsukisome no Bansho
synopsis:
"Let me help you gain some dating experience." One day, rookie male teacher Moegi is approached by a male student seeking relationship advice. But what happens when Moegi himself has zero dating experience? A romantic comedy about "learning about love" by Akari Kajimoto.

"Seo-un University's D***** A* Exposed!" Dareum An goes from a goddess to a social pariah overnight, all because of those five words, a baseless rumor, and an anonymous forum app for college students called EvCam. Just when she feels ready to give up on everything, Muyeol Lee appears and offers to help her find the person who ruined her reputation. Can Dareum clear her name and regain her perfect life? More importantly... can she really trust Muyeol?

When Baek Seonwoo agrees to impersonate his identical twin to stop his brother's breakup with rich boyfriend Yoon Juwon, things quickly spiral out of control. Despite Seonwoo's desperate attempts to seduce Juwon, he gets nothing but cold indifference—until a drunken night leads to unexpected passion. The next morning, Juwon's sudden warmth leaves Seonwoo confused to say the least. How can someone do a complete 180 like that?! Unless...?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Kemono Sumu Natsu
synopsis:
When he was a child, Ritsuki brought home a kitten and named it "Tama." He spent his days raising the cute ball of fluff only for it to take the form of a young beast-man who goes by the name of "Shuri." However, as they become high schoolers, Ritsuki mysteriously starts to distance himself from Shuri who had always been by his side...

(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)

title: An Email From My Dead Lover
title_english: An Email From My Dead Lover
synopsis:
Heesoo Lee was shocked to see an email from his boyfriend who died in a tragic accident a year ago. He told himself it was a prank, but the ghostly visits every night were impossible to explain. With no one else to turn to, he reached out to the internet and connected with Yihyun Paek. Once Yihyun realized the dangerous situation Heesoo was in, he agreed to help. But nothing seems to be able to stop the ghost from coming each night, and it's getting more and more violent with every visit...

(Source: Tapas Media)

In a modern era where gates to another world have begun to appear, Katagiri, a 28-year-old washed-up hunter who gave up on his dreams, encounters the Holy Sword—and is chosen as a savior?!

synopsis:
"Because it's my first time, my commands turn into... pleading!"

Towa, who struggles with being too cute to come off as a proper dom, is having trouble finding a partner. One day, he stops his classmate Tanabe, who is trying to skip out on cleaning duty, with a firm "Wait." But strangely, that simple word triggers a command. Turns out, despite his fierce, guard-dog-like appearance... Tanabe is actually a sub! Suddenly swept into an unexpected play session, Towa panics. But when Tanabe demands, "Give me more commands," Toba blurts out... "Kiss"!?

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

title: Space Sweepers
synopsis:
With Earth's future in jeopardy, the space colony run by UTS officials is paradise. Ace pilot Taeho's a squadron leader for UTS, but after questioning their actions, he ends up on the scavenger crew of the Victory alongside rugged Tiger Park, sassy robot Updong, and fearless Captain Jang. They're chasing dreams, working off debts, and pissing everyone off. Enter Dorothy... they take her in and now EVERYONE'S after them. Can they figure out this mess or is this a ticking time bomb about to explode?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Shadow Garden
synopsis:
When young college grad Jung Seyi gets lost on the way to her grandma's funeral, she seeks shelter at a botanical garden she stumbles across deep in the mountains. Before she knows it, she's accepted a job as a member of the garden's crew under the guidance of the mysterious but charming director. The whole situation seems like a dream come true, but as Seyi begins to have eerie visions and experience disturbing things, she quickly realizes that she may have been lured into a nightmare...

(Source: Tapas Media)

Born with the ability to change people's moods, Lee Boknam was used to getting whatever he wanted. But when he inexplicably loses his powers at age 29, his flawless, comfortable life is turned upside down. The only clue is a mysterious letter from a woman named So Nagi. Desperate for answers, he tracks down Nagi in a rural town, where he learns that to prevent an early death, he must live an ordinary life. Now completely powerless, can Boknam adjust to life in the real world?

A desolate town thought a new chemical facility would bring economic revival but instead chaos breaks loose after a gas leak. The fearful townspeople begin their fight to survive while the government tries to hide the truth behind the event.

title: The Melancholic Conman
synopsis:
Running an odd job agency can be life-threatening at times, as Yisin learns after helping a mob boss's lover flee with his money. When the mob boss's subordinate, Director Yoon, threatens to string him up unless he finds the woman and brings her back, Yisin chooses to run away to Seoul instead. Though he expects the presence of Hyeonkyeong, a powerful rival mobster, to keep Director Yoon away from the city, Yisin couldn't be more wrong. As his past slowly comes back to haunt him, Yisin discovers that the director's vengeful obsession with him runs deeper than he realizes...

synopsis:
After being dumped by his boyfriend of 10 years, Jooyeong starts fresh at the only place that will hire him: a failing academy full of flunking students. When the director asks him to go on a show called "The King of Home Cooking" and promote the academy, Jooyeong dutifully agrees. What he doesn't expect is to run into Jonghan, the show's producer and his high school classmate who was much more than a friend. Their chance encounter sparks a heated fling behind the scenes, but all the while, the unresolved tension between them lingers like a ghost from the past...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Tell Me You Love Me
synopsis:
Do-kwon has a secret: he has a huge weakness for pretty faces. One look at the face of a pretty boy gets him internally screaming. And lo and behold, Ryeo-soo is one of the prettiest boys he's ever seen in real life. Do-kwon is busy mentally drooling over him every time they interact. Man, it's a good thing nobody can hear his silent fanboying, right? Except, Ryeo-soo has a secret, too. He can hear other people's thoughts. And he's really having a blast listening to Do-kwon's. There's one thing he's still waiting to hear, though...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Sierra to Juliet

However, when Doyeong is dragged into the United Esper-Guide Force Command, he is declared the perfect guide for the two most powerful espers alive: brothers Kangjoon and Yijoon. Thrust into a love triangle shaped by power and survival, Doyeong has to choose who and what he's willing to endure.

Taiki becomes that seed bearer to the current priestess who turns out to be his upperclassman, Misaki Amagawa. Long has he been infatuated with her but now they are together by fate. Whether it's in the shrine or at school, their desires are no longer in check as Misaki longs for Taiki's seed.

Things only get messier when he discovers he'll be living under the same roof as both Leo and Leo's overly clingy best friend, Son Yi-gang. title: The Guide's Treasure
synopsis:
The F12 Center is infamous for one thing—its dangerously high superhuman burnout rate. And that's exactly where civilian diagnostics officer Baek Shijin is suddenly transferred.

On his first day, Shijin is approached by Jeong Taeyool, an A-rank Guide with a reputation as sharp as his instincts, under the guise of an admin worker.

"Just stop giving Ham Geonwoo your attention, and we'll get along fine." Shijin only wanted to repay Ham Geonwoo, the Esper who saved him a decade ago. But somehow, his highest match rate is with Taeyool—who sees right through him.

"Doc, are you really using seduction to request a scan?" From then on, Taeyool seems to appear everywhere—especially when Shijin's in danger.

"If this were a real emergency, Alpha Team would be here to protect you in under 60 seconds." What kind of ending awaits a sharp-eyed Superhuman and a guarded civilian doctor?

title: Dead Core
synopsis:
Once a rising star in the popular band Rookie, Connie suddenly vanished from the spotlight after a fellow member stole one of his songs. He quit the band without explanation and disappeared from the public eye.

Five years later, after constant persuasion from his longtime fan Louie, Connie reluctantly joins a band at his college called Dead Core, and instantly becomes the talk of campus.

But things get complicated when his mysterious roommate Mika, who seems oddly familiar, begins inserting himself into Connie's life. From day one, Mika insists they'd make the perfect graduation project partners...and he's not taking no for an answer.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Modernist
synopsis:
The day of his older brother's funeral, Ho-il meets the mysterious Sangyeon and feels an immediate attracttion to him. However, it turns out that Sangyeon used to be Ho-il's brother's boyfriend, leading to a complicated relationship between the two men. However, something beautiful beyond their expectations just might bloom from their shared grief and affection.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: May the Best Brother Win
synopsis:
Seo Eun-il has had a one-sided crush on his childhood friend Nam Jeheon, now the CEO of IDBIO, for nearly a decade. As Jeheon's personal secretary, Eun-il spends plenty of time with him but struggles with his unspoken feelings. When Jeheon chooses to spend his birthday with someone else, Eun-il is left with an uneaten cake and unexpectedly encounters Jeheon's twin brother, Nam Pilwoo, who has just returned from the United States.

With secrets and long-held feelings bubbling beneath the surface, Pilwoo seizes the moment to seduce Eun-il, sparking conflict in the heart of Eun-il. As old memories resurface and hidden desires collide, Eun-il finds himself at the center of a tumultuous love triangle.

In this battle of hearts, may the best brother win...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Panoramic View
synopsis:
Orphaned at a young age, Woo Jungwon grew up neglected in an orphanage. One day, drowning in debt, the director decides to sell him off. Luckily, Kwon Junseo, a powerful mafioso, arrives just in time—to collect his money. But when he sees Jungwon being manhandled, something in him shifts. On a whim, he saves the poor boy.

For the first time in his life, Jungwon sees a ray of hope in his dark and bleak world. And from that moment, a flower of hope blooms within him—bright and powerful. But is that flower truly something beautiful? Or is it the beginning of something far more sinister?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: To Each His Own
synopsis:

The problem is, finding someone who actually meets his standards is harder than it sounds. That's when he notices Daol, a potential hottie with a not-so-sexy body. Sangnam casually suggests that he might consider dating Daol if he can "fix" him to suit his tastes, and a nervous but determined Daol agrees. What Sangnam doesn't know is that Daol has a secret preference of his own...and one he definitely hasn't told anyone yet.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Collateral Desire
synopsis:
Under orders from his police chief, Detective Yoo Jihan infiltrates the powerful Hwa Ryeon Seung syndicate. Unfortunately, he gets found out by Han Dokyung, the organization's second-in-command, who offers to keep Jihan's identity a secret if he becomes Dokyung's dog. Amidst the ensuing humiliation, Jihan begins to feel inexplicably drawn toward Dokyung...

One day, he meets Aoki, an older man who works at an izakaya, and gradually begins to feel emotions he has never felt before. synopsis:
Judith, a war orphan with supernatural powers, survives thanks to an anonymous benefactor. He showers her with gifts but never replies. When she finally receives a reply, she travels to meet him. But who is her benefactor out of the charming rogue, successful businessman, and snarky gang leader?

Mi-hun is a loner. He doesn't get out of the house after his parents' deaths. But after his encounter with the mysterious raincoat-wearing man from next door that just moved in, strange things starts happening in his dull and repetitive life. He finds out that the unexplainable "spontaneous human combustion" incidents that are happening in his town are somehow connected to that raincoat man. He can't help spying on his new neighbors, but that turns out to be the biggest mistake in his life.

(Source: SpotToon)

During a zombie apocalypse, five survivors have taken refuge inside an old building. Food is delivered to the rooftop, but the only way up is through a chute too small for the average adult. Seongguk's dwarfism makes him the only candidate, but when he faces backlash, dark ideas begin to stir...

In a world where love for one another has become a rarity... seven men will do whatever it takes to save what's left of humanity; using their... HANDSOMENESS. Watch Jehui and his misfit group of boys use their god given talent to conquer the world of webtoons in their quest to become 2D idols.

title: Projection
synopsis:

(Source: Manta)

title: Lethe
synopsis:
A man, heartbroken over the death of the wife he never got to say goodbye to, is killed in a drunken hit-and-run accident. He wakes up in a place somewhere between life and death where other recently deceased souls stay before moving on to the afterlife. When he realizes that his wife may still be in this place, he races to find her before it's too late.  

(Source: SpotToon)

title: The Queen: A Silent Classroom
synopsis:
A queen with an entire class in the palm of her hand, striking fear into the hearts of her subjects with a single glance. "This is wrong," they think to themselves—"This is not fair. We are all equal."—so why is it that not one of them speaks up? If silence is our answer to tyranny, then who will help the helpless?

(Source: SpotToon)

title: Sucker for Love
synopsis:
After years, Suk-O is thrilled to run into his high school crush, Suh-hee, but is shocked to find out that she is the mother of a newborn son. Unable to let her go, he finds himself in a budding relationship with Suh-hee and her child while another man from their past comes back into the picture.

(Source: SpotToon)

title: Howling: The City of Nightmare
synopsis:
Beautiful women are being targeted and horrifically killed by an unknown assailant. Cries for justice pour into the police department but the team assigned to the case is nowhere close to catching the evasive killer. But suddenly a reclusive young man with a mysterious ability arrives to offer his assistance and he may hold the key to finding the answers the police so desperately seek.

(Source: SpotToon)

title: Quoth the Boy

Ga-Ra "Mad Dog" Kang is a violent troublemaker feared across the school. His only weakness: the intense love he holds for a key-ring figure of his favorite anime character, Aris-chan. One fateful night, a girl appears before him looking just like her—is this fate? Could his beloved Aris-chan have come to life specially for him?

...Or so he thought.

When he wakes up, he finds himself back on the first day of his captivity—with Seo Wui-wu between his legs, tugging at his pants. Jaejin stares down at the familiar face, one he had come to resent over the four agonizing years of his previous life. Back then, he had believed he was merely a victim, dragged into an unfamiliar place and forced into submission.

But this time is different.

Now, Jaejin knows exactly how Seo Wui-wu thinks, what moves him, and—most importantly—how to control him. With the promise of guiding as bait, Seo Wui-wu will be his to manipulate.

As Seo Wui-wu's breath grows heavy and his dark hair falls messily over his forehead, his hungry gaze flashes with dangerous excitement.

Who will truly hold the reins in this second chance at fate?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Ero Ero SOS
synopsis:
A famous actor, a woman on the run and a handsome robot find themselves amongst a group of survivors after their plane crashes onto a mysterious deserted island. Romance, mayhem and hilarity ensue as they all try to survive their new surroundings and each other.

(Source: SpotToon)

title: Thanatos
synopsis:
Unable to endure the abuse at his orphanage, Taejoo murders the director and flees with nothing. Desperate to end his life, he stumbles upon a church of the Hwasin Faith to confess his sins before dying. It is there that Taejoo discovers his true identity: a god of death.

In his new life as a god, Tae-joo is joined by Jeong-hoo, a god-hating elder of Hwasin. Together, they navigate their complex destinies and unravel the mysteries of their divine roles.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Swim in the Scent
synopsis:
The cutting words of Lee Seok-jun's first love during his school days left a scar that still follows him into adulthood. His fear of intimacy and emotional distance have turned breakups into a recurring theme in his life.

One night, while venting about yet another failed relationship at a bar with friends, Seok-jun crosses paths with Yae Ji-hoo—a notorious bar regular with a reputation for living like a gigolo.

Enticed by Ji-hoo's bold offer of a "crash course in adult technique," Seok-jun narrowly escapes an awkward situation just in time.

But Ji-hoo's wounded pride refuses to let the matter rest. When he learns that Seok-jun works as a swimming instructor, Ji-hoo begins plotting an elaborate revenge scheme.

"I don't care if it's love or not. I just need to see him beg."

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: My Good-Hearted Darling
synopsis:
Shy and reserved Leewon has admired the charismatic Seo Han-gun for years, but their unexpected friendship blossoms into first love during middle school. Torn apart by reality, they lose touch for eight years—until a chance reunion in Busan forces them to confront old wounds and lingering feelings. Can love overcome the pain of the past?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title_japanese: yrhm 百合姫20thアンソロジー
synopsis: An anthology of girls love short stories commemorating the 20th anniversary of Comic Yuri Hime.

title: Blotted Pages
synopsis:
While grading assignments, Heo Do-ahn comes across a piece of fiction written by Kang Soowon—one that was never meant to be seen by anyone. In it are tales about an intimate encounter with the department's favorite, Yoo Sung-on. Do-ahn knows he must look away, but is drawn in deeper and deeper as the lines between fantasy and reality appear to blur...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Nameless Flower
synopsis:
Young Ruan, the little lord of House Marcellion, has never had an easy childhood. With his older brother constantly feigning illness, the burden of the harsh heir's training falls squarely on his small shoulders. One day, unable to take it any longer, Ruan dashes out of the mansion and loses himself in the forest.

There, he stumbles upon a boy his own age. They don't exchange names, and yet none of that seems to matter. With him, even nibbling on grass becomes an adventure. Ruan finds himself laughing, playing, and perhaps for the very first time, feeling free.

Day by day, his thoughts drift further from the rigid lessons of succession and closer to the warmth of that kindhearted boy. But gossip spreads quickly, and soon even the stern Count Marcellion hears whispers of his son's wandering heart...

Could a simple forest friendship change the path of an heir?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Devoured: The Serpent and the Pomegranate
title_english: Devoured: The Serpent and the Pomegranate
synopsis:
In the blessed land of Trastasa, Na-in is the cherished companion of Amon, the great and omnipotent god. Though Amon treats him with apparent tenderness, his cruel and indifferent ways haunt Na-in's every moment. When a striking servant with rare pink features called Rhan Gwen arrives, Na-in expects to lose Amon's attention. Instead, he discovers something unsettling... Rhan Gwen shows no interest in Amon, only in Na-in himself. As this mysterious yet beautiful man offers the gentle understanding Na-in has always craved, he faces an impossible choice between familiar darkness and uncertain warmth.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Legend of Crystania is set 300 years in the future from Lodoss, and is set on the continent of Crystania where the refugees from Marmo landed. It follows Pirotess's quest to free Ashram from the gripes of the animal god Barbas, and the hero Redon and his companions in a quest to free Crystania from Barbas' control.

title: Secret Family
synopsis:
Kang Geon, 17, transfers to a prestigious high school for only the top 0.1% of South Korean students. Raised as a secret agent in North Korea since the age of five, he is a genius and a human weapon. He is tasked with infiltrating South Korea's upper class and building connections. However, making friends proves to be a much bigger mission. This spy action drama follows Kang Geon, who lives as a fake family with his hacker father, who is under international surveillance, and his legendary assassin mother, and finds true happiness!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Impulse
synopsis:
The Earth suffers from frequent meteor strikes. On one of these strikes, a meteor crashes into a school and many students are killed and even more are seriously injured. Five students inexplicably come out of the wreckage unscathed and gain supernatural powers while becoming outcasts at school. As they begin to search for answers, they become targets for a secret government program that tests the group's abilities for reasons unknown to them all.

(Source: SpotToon)

title: Flower Dreams
synopsis:
Centuries of war and abuse of natural resources have transformed the world into a barren desert. In the town of Agadir, lives Fran, the owner of the only Flower Shop, and her 'detective' tenant, Sa Hwan. After Sa Hwan saves a lone traveller, they journey deep into the dangerous desert. Encountering several strange events, they become intertwined in the mysteries of their past. However, before long, they find themselves caught up in something far bigger than they could have ever imagined.

(Source: SpotToon)

title: Blood Poker
synopsis:
After reawakening from a C-rank to the strongest A-rank Esper, Ha Jaeil is pushed to the brink by insomnia and unresolved trauma, unable to endure even the slightest touch. His only match is Seung-hyeon, an A-rank Guide with a 98 percent compatibility who comes from the lawless District 13 and lacks all formal guiding skills. With no other options, the Haon Division orders an extreme solution: the two must share a bed twice a week. But when Jaeil wakes to unfamiliar hands in the dark and sees Seung-hyeon looming over him, he realizes that something else has awakened as well—and it is already guiding him.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Destiny Ending
synopsis:
Influencer Jihan has been chasing his first love Dojin since high school, after Dojin suddenly vanished without a word. Now in college, a mysterious account that always likes his posts might be the clue that leads him back. In a world where love hides in likes and fate rewrites itself in DMs, can Jihan and Dojin finally hit "post" on their destiny ending?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Fragment of the Moon
synopsis:
A doctor disgraced by a false accusation survives by practicing medicine in the shadows, only to be claimed by the ruthless boss of a powerful mafia syndicate. When the boss loses his memory after a serious injury, cracks begin to form in their twisted relationship, hinting at a hidden past that may be more dangerous than the truth itself.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Dawning Light
synopsis:
In the near future, a small number of Alphas known as the Awakened are born with extraordinary powers. Diego should have been one of the strongest, but every time he uses his ability, his body betrays him with violent seizures. When he's introduced to Shane, a quiet scientist who offers to create a stabilizer, Diego begins to feel an inexplicable pull toward him. As buried memories resurface, Diego starts to wonder if their meeting was fate, or the beginning of something that transcends time itself.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Card Shark
synopsis:
The world's best poker players are called 'sharks', and the most ruthless among them is known simply as Czar. Kim Yoon and a gang of thugs roam from house to house, seeking this legendary figure—despite rumors that no one ever returns from his domain. One day, a man in a red hoodie warns Yoon, "Sir, you'll die if you keep this up." Ignoring the warning, Yoon leaves to gather money for a new game. Suddenly, he hears the chilling sound of bones smashing and bodies crushing. As the noise fades, Yoon finally comes face to face with Czar...but when he offers Yoon a chance to play, Yoon sees it as a golden opportunity and believes his life is about to change. "I'll try it."

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Last Love of My Youth
synopsis:
Is 9 years too long to reconcile? For Bae Eunseok and Hwang Cheolmin, it sure feels like it. But as fate throws them together once more, the fond memories of their youth start creeping back. Could there be a chance for them once more, or will a new opponent keep them apart forever?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Lovelessly Ever After
synopsis:
Yuriel thought she was trapped in a dating sim, but she soon realizes it's actually a happiness sim. To escape, she must heal the world's wounded characters and bring them happiness—without them falling in love with her! Can she do it? Or will more than one NPC fall head over heels?

(Source: Manta)

title: The Seductive Wife
synopsis:
Some marry for love, and some marry for convenience. In Ijae's case, she marries Yuheon, the son of a business tycoon, to save her family after her father ends up in deep debt. Even though their marriage is contractual, Ijae feels an intense attraction for the cold and calculating Yuheon. Every night in her dreams, she imagines what it would be like to make love with him... until one day, the two end up actually sharing a passionate night together. But will their physical chemistry be enough to build a genuine connection? Or will Ijae remain a pawn in Yuheon's game?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Dragondaily
synopsis:
A runaway noble lady, now a maid at an inn.

Meryl Parte, the Count's only daughter, escapes an unwanted marriage and flees to Harp Island to keep a promise to her late mother. After a night at the rundown inn Dragondaily, she wakes up penniless and in bed with a mysterious man! He offers to help her, but only if she works as the inn's maid!

(Source: Manta)

title: Bottoms Up!
synopsis:
Yoon Heewoo is blessed with a slim build, a pretty face, and an irresistible charm. There's just one problem: despite being the toppiest top in the history of tops, everyone insists on treating him like a bottom! His sex life? A tragic comedy of mistaken positions. But one day, fate (or maybe just some shady tech) gifts him a mysterious hypnosis app... Watch out big guys with bigger egos—Yoon Heewoo is on the prowl. Bottoms up!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Please Save Me
synopsis:
This time, it's my turn to save you.

After being freed from a painful existence with the help of her ex-fiancé Prince Vicente, Elena wakes up inside the body of Evelyn, an orphan girl. Two years later, Elena discovers that Vicente has been locked up in a palace for her death. With this, she who was once saved now seeks to be the savior.

(Source: Manta)

title: Bird Cage
synopsis:
At Hertiar Academy, exclusive to the elite, Jeremy, the troubled heir of the Hertiar family, becomes dangerously fixated on Lucian. When Daniel arrives and discovers Lucian is the one he's admired for years, he ignores warnings and befriends him. Consumed by jealousy, Jeremy openly displays affection for Lucian in front of Daniel, trying to drive a wedge between them. One who can have everything except the one he wants. One who would like nothing more than to leave. And one who is determined to save his friend. Just who will come out on top of this struggle of love?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Death Planning
synopsis:
In a world where dying is no longer a tragedy, but a privilege, the rich design their own extravagant funerals resembling weddings. Ceremonies are held not for the deceased, but for those left behind. Han Heejun has lived selfishly his whole life and realizes no one will remember him if he dies. Desperate to leave behind a perfect image, he takes on death planning. But when Kang Ido, a wealthy client with the same deep emptiness, requests a quiet, meaningful death, Heejun's carefully planned world shifts.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Destiny Next Door
synopsis:
Whenever he steps foot outside, Dojun is faced with an unexpected challenge—the seemingly never-ending public displays of affection from his next-door neighbors! But the fact that they're both men means that Dojun's discomfort quickly earns him the label of homophobe. Determined to break free from stereotypes, Dojun attempts to bridge the gap by reaching out to his neighbor, only to find himself entangled in far more than neighborly relations.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Tatakau Salesman
synopsis:
In these times of war, corporations from various nations were zealously developing weapons, competing through live demonstrations of their battle suits. During one mission, Austin, the ace of Nightblower Corp., encounters a fighting salesman from a rival company...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Heat Protectant
synopsis:
Su Seong-hyeon, a successful hair designer, has been secretly in love with his best friend, Jeong Jun-yeon.

One day, Jun-yeon asks Seong-hyeon to tutor his younger brother, Jae-yeon. While Seong-hyeon believes Jae-yeon to be a Beta, he starts to faintly sense pheromones from him.

Then, one day, Seong-hyeon discovers a piece of clothing soaked in pheromones among the gifts he received from Jae-yeon. Overcome by the pheromones, he experiences an unusual heat.

At that moment, while on a call with Jun-yeon, he ends up pleasuring himself to the sound of his voice...

"What kind of insane Omega spreads their pheromones like this?!"

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Amber Alert
synopsis:
After saving little Amber from an abusive foster parent, hitman Tennessee gains someone worth protecting for the first time in his life. But the older Amber gets, the more his obsessive love for Tennessee grows, despite his rescuer still seeing him as the same little boy from years ago. It isn't until Tennessee gets into an accident that leaves him with face blindness that the lines between them begin to blur. Tennessee knows in his head that this is still Amber, but his impairment makes both the younger man's face and Tennessee's own feelings for him unrecognizable...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Karada wa Kodomo, Nakami wa Ossan no Nariagari Boukenki: Satella mo Tsuiteikimasu!

When Satella was young, her parents were killed by monsters. One day while hoping that her peaceful daily life would continue, she met Gray Millard, the third son of a noble family. She was touched by Gray's determination to carve out a future for himself using advanced magic and special skills, despite the harsh punishment his stepmother meted out to him. She decides to go on an adventure with Gray, who had his sights set on the world.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Weekly Boys' Romance
synopsis:
Five boys, living under the same roof, yet indifferent to one another, are given an ultimatum: "No girl problems, or you're out." With each of them harboring their own unconventional romance, can they succeed in protecting their clumsy, innocent love and rebuild their friendship?

(Source: SpotToon)

title: 50 Pixel Days
synopsis:
Bori Kim's grades are suffering from her constant doodling in class. However, once her drawings catch the attention of a startup game developer, she finds herself with a new job as an illustrator for a dating sim, as well as developing a romance of her own...

(Source: SpotToon)

title: Sherlock: Her Majesty's Detective
synopsis:
A new take on a classic tale, Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Jane Watson attempt to solve a strange and supernatural death in a fictionalized version of 19th century Britain. With the country at war, Sherlock and Jane soon realize that they have uncovered an intricate network of secrets that leads to a much larger and more dangerous plan that puts the whole world at risk.

(Source: SpotToon)

title: Capturing Spirits, Catching Feelings
synopsis:
Cho Yeon, a shaman-in-training, climbs a haunted mountain where seven women have gone up and been returned with no memory. She meets a mischievous, hopelessly horny ghost who's more interested in romance than haunting. Unable to seal him, they strike a deal: he helps her gather spiritual energy, and she'll help him avoid becoming a vengeful spirit. But every time he aids her, they must get intimate. When a mysterious man appears knowing her past, Yeon's journey becomes even more complicated.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: DK to Yakuza
synopsis:
Though the man in front of me wore a kind smile, he pinned me down, asked if I wanted him to come onto me and whether or not I would be his love plaything. Up until then, I, Saku Fujisaki, was just an ordinary student, but because of my mother's debt, I was taken away by the yakuza. Either I do backbreaking work indefinitely, sell my organs, or.... Right... With no other choice, I ended up as the young yakuza leader's love plaything. But is there something more...?!

(Source: C'moA Comics)

title: Hwarang: Flower Knights of the Underworld
title_english: Hwarang: Flower Knights of the Underworld
synopsis:
Seventeen-year-old Kang Junhwi, who can see ghosts, loses his memory after an accident. After passing the grim reaper's challenge to win another chance at life, he is thrust into the underworld to live as an intern Hwarang, or Flower Knight. Junhwi is assigned to partner up with Horan, a peace officer partner, as they take on a series of investigations under the supervision of Bihyeongrang. Magicians, monsters, and legendary figures come into play in the mythical underworld. But what will be revealed when Junhwi investigates the circumstances of his own fateful accident?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title_english: The Counselor Through the Years and Stars

title: Midwood
synopsis:
As the monster slayer troops, also known as Sretu, no longer functioned as it used to, humans became monster feed.

Jin Cheongdo, who has been living in a world full of monsters for his entire life, uses a legendary item, Midwood, to turn back in time, for the sake of killing Ian, who was the centerpiece of this whole mess...

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Because It's Love
synopsis:
Ki Seung-joo is a young, multi-talented top star who has it all. Yoo Lee-hyun is a newcomer to the celebrity scene, but quickly making an impact. While they navigate the twists and turns of celebrity life, Lee-hyun is also intent on resolving something from her past. Both are hyper-focused on their careers. But their chance meeting on the set of a variety show sparks something in them that neither have felt before...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Rewind
synopsis:
Devastated after the death of her only daughter, Eunjo joins a group suicide. Instead of death, she opens her eyes to the days before. Fate is cruel as she must now relive each joyful moment with the pain of knowing what's to come. As she flashes back into the past, Eunjo realizes her future is set in stone... or is it? Can she change this twist of time for the better somehow and save her loved ones?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Gone
synopsis:
Amidst a spore virus affecting millions of people, two different people's close companions are infected by the virus.

(Source: Sura's Place, edited)

title: Fenhong Duan Dai
synopsis:
Lumiao is a senior high school student who loves to dress up in frilly dresses and bows. One day she passes another student, the petite Yuxuan, on campus, and becomes convinced she has the perfect frame for the same style. But Yuxuan, a shy and short-haired sports-lover, resists her new friend's attempts to both persuade and trick her into a new look.

But as time goes on, Lumiao realizes her feelings for Yuxuan go beyond friendship and she becomes obsessed with everything Yuxuan does and thinks. What is Lumiao to do when she learns Yuxuan has a crush on a boy in her class? She wants Yuxuan to be happy, but she doesn't want to lose her. What will happen if she tells Yuxuan how she feels? 

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Operation Chromite
synopsis:
The world has always been changing and it will continue to change. One need look no further than Korea for proof. Transitioning from liberation and the gaining of independence to the Korean Civil War, the lives of Cheogul and his family rapidly change in the face of violence, corruption, and betrayal.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Nitamono Doushi
synopsis:
Teru is a boy who, haunted by a childhood trauma, sees himself as a loner and avoids human connection. His only joy comes from video games... until a fateful encounter at his usual arcade starts to shake up his quiet world.

A heartfelt, 88-page, full-length boy-meets-girl story of two awkward souls drawn to each other night after night.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Hakaiouji Zegard no Shuuraku Kourin
title_english: The Descent of Zegard, Prince of Destruction
title_japanese: 破壊王子ゼガルドの集落降臨
synopsis:
Prince of Destruction Zegard, destined to annihilate the world, arrives in a Japanese village with his maid Milky. An unforgiving massacre is about to begin...!?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Tight Fit
synopsis:
Police officer Kang Ha-da is a firm believer in serving the public and resolving crimes. It's never his intention to use his thick body and tight uniform to attract criminals, but they find him irresistible. Will Ha-da be able to wiggle his way out of tight spots to overcome some steamy trials to make arrests and uphold justice?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title_english: The Bubble Love of the Mermaid
synopsis:
Asana Amamizu's family has treated her like a monster ever since a mysterious red mark appeared on her wrist. Now sixteen years old, she attends the Yotsura Girls Academy, and all the students are chattering excitedly about the new language arts teacher, the handsome Sakuya Shigure. Asana, however, keeps her distance. That is until one day, when an unexpected marriage proposal falls right in her lap. Thus begins a romantic fantasy in the imperial city!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: In the Dreaming Hours
synopsis:
Since childhood, Do-kyung has been plagued by lingering spirits drawn to his strong yin energy—a curse that only worsens with age. Cornered by malicious ghosts, he's saved by Yoonje, a powerful spirit radiating yang energy.
But Yoonje doesn't offer his help for free.

"I'll share my energy with you if you share yours with me." Caught in an unusual pact, Do-kyung must navigate this strange exchange while fending off the feelings that begin to creep into his heart. Can their balance keep the darkness at bay?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Sincerely Yours
synopsis:
Jinhyeok can't accept the sudden death of his boyfriend, Doseong, who passed away in a tragic accident two months ago. One night, he writes a letter to Doseong before falling asleep...and wakes up to find him standing right in front of him.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Watch Out Behind You!
synopsis:
Lim Seojun, a college student, is popular with guys but struggles with his lack of popularity among the opposite sex. At the opening assembly, he tries to get closer to the girls, but they all flock around Yunwoo, a fellow student who has just returned from a break. Envious of Yoon-Woo's charm, Seo-Joon drinks too much and passes out. When he wakes up, he finds Yunwoo unusually affectionate—and feels something strangely stiff in a very unexpected place.

"Seojun hyung, can you feel it?"

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Junkyouju Takatsuki Akira no Suisatsu EX
title_english: Associate Professor Akira Takatsuki's Conjecture EX
title_japanese: 准教授・高槻彰良の推察EX
synopsis:
Professor Mitani, a specialist of Japanese history, comes to Professor Takatsuki with a mysterious doll. After Mitani posts a photo of the doll on his blog, someone claiming to be the grandchild of the doll's original owner reaches out. According to them, the doll moves around on its own and has naturally growing hair. Takatsuki smells something fishy and pulls in the reluctant Naoya to begin investigating! What answers will the pair uncover...?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Ironna Ojisan to Yacchau Ko
title_japanese: 色んなおじさんとヤっちゃう娘

title: Zonchuu: Zombie JK wa Game Haishinchuu
title_english: Zombie High School Girl Is Game Streaming Now
title_japanese: ゾンちゅう～ゾンビJKはゲーム配信中～

title: Aoi Mangakyou
synopsis:
1. Aoi Mangakyou
2. Boku no Norakuro
3. Karakou Monogatari
4. Boku no Heya ni wa Beethoven no Death Mask ga Atta
5. Tokiwa-sou no Charumera
6. Tokiwa-sou Monogatari
7. Ogawa no Medaka
8. Tezuka Osamu-shi no Itta Hi
9. Kaze no You ni... Se wo Hashirisugita Mushi

title: Kowashiya Gen
synopsis:
Iwao Asakura, a.k.a. Gen, president of Asakura Corporation, a subcontractor demolition company, regains his passion as a world-class demolition engineer when Keiko Otsuki, an employee of major general contractor Sanyu Heavy Machinery Lease, brings him a demolition job. He accepted her invitation to join the "Sanyu Group" and established the company "Sanyu Blasting Co." Later, he added an old acquaintance, Roku Iwashita a.k.a. "Roku the Tugger," a wooden construction specialist, Hideo Tokita a.k.a. Hide, a crane engineer who was about to commit suicide due to debt, and Hikaru Nakahara, a truck driver and former TV personality, to his team. However, in order to become "Japan's No. 1 demolition company" that is not bound by the traditions of bid-rigging that persist in the construction industry, he leaves the Sanyu Group and reestablishes himself as Itsutomo Blowup Co.

(Source: Wikipedia, translated)

title: Gaussian Blur
synopsis:
Day after day, honor student Hwang Dong Wook gets called out by the bullies in his class to serve as their punching bag. Day after day, the last-ranked student Choi Yool is shunned by her classmates because of her beauty and her grades. As it happens, the sullen boy and the carefree girl sit next to each other in class. When the top student is asked to lure her into the bullies dirty schemes, their lives take an unexpected turn...

(Source: Kawa Scans)

title: The Jinx's Lover
synopsis:
With ancestors who have inherited the practice of fortune-telling since the Joseon Dynasty, Seulbi is imprisoned as a fortune-teller in the wealthy Geumhwa family, unable to choose her own partner or life.

One day, however, she meets Sugwang, a young man from a fishmonger's shop. Fatefully, he becomes the man of her destiny. As a result, Sugwang is targeted by the Geumhwa Group, leading to a life of repeated misfortune and downfall.

The cheerful Seulbi refuses to give up on her pursuit of Sugwang and the creation of her own destiny.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Grudge-laden Lackey
synopsis:
The Taesung Gang was everything to its boss, Kang Deokbae. But his golden days come to an end on his 50th birthday, when a rival mob ambushes the gang and fatally injures him. After entrusting Taesung to his loyal subordinates, Deokbae closes his eyes and wakes up 30 years later as Lee Taejun, a 23-year-old gangster! And upon learning that his gang is no longer the upright group it once was, Deokbae swears to set things right... even if he must destroy Taesung from the ground up.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Dokidoki Dokidoki
synopsis:
The protagonist is a high school girl with the special ability to turn back time. Whenever her heart races, she accidentally activates her power, preventing her from getting closer to the boy she likes. But one day, she uses her ability and discovers he is an assassin.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Sabaku no Hanazono de Aimashou
title_japanese: 砂漠の花園で逢いましょう

title: Nyuukyo Jouken: Tonari ni Sunderu Yuujin to Kanarazu Nakayoku shite Kudasai
title_japanese: 入居条件：隣に住んでる友人と必ず仲良くしてください
synopsis:
"Wanted: People who don't care what happens to their lives! Monthly salary: ¥150,000 *Must live on-site"

With no savings or home left, and wandering aimlessly, Takahiro stumbles upon this job listing—managing an apartment unit as a live-in caretaker. The employment condition: "You must get along with your neighbor." What awaited him was a "neighbor" who clearly isn't human.

"This is a story I heard from a friend..."

Every day, his neighbor tells him "ghost stories"—fictional tales of events that in reality never happened. At least, that's what they were supposed to be...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Sleeves Stained in Blood
synopsis:
When the empress discovers Ji Cheong's feelings for the emperor, he silences her with his blade, sealing his fate as a traitor. Tortured and prepared to die, he faces the emperor with a final lie—that he tried to violate the empress. But instead of execution, he wakes in an unfamiliar palace, trapped behind walls of thorns...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Conveni de Deatta Eroi Onnanoko to Tadarekitta Kankei ni Narimashita.
title_japanese: コンビニで出会ったエロい女の子と爛れきった関係になりました。

title: Odd and Kind
synopsis: An omnibus of stories depicting the finer points of emotion, taking place on earth, in space, in the present, and in the future.

title: Jashin no Mago: Dark Elf Shimai to Sugosu Isekai Hikikomori Seikatsu
title_japanese: 邪神の孫 ダークエルフ姉妹と過ごす異世界引きこもり生活
synopsis:
Satoshi Katakura, living a shut-in life, earns money through investments using the inheritance from his grandmother. One day, he wakes up to find that an otherworldly realm has spread outside his home. Appearing before him are dark elf sisters who revere his grandmother as the Evil God.

"From this day forward, we pledge our eternal loyalty to you as our master!"

What is the sisters' true purpose? What is the real identity of his grandmother?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: The Way We See Each Other
title_english: The Way We See Each Other
synopsis:
Desperate to escape his painful past, 24-year-old Hyun-oh has cut ties with everyone he once knew. But when he unexpectedly runs into Chani, his former high school friend, Hyun-oh's world is turned upside down. He does everything in his power to push Chani away, only for Chani to insist on sticking around. With no other options, Hyun-oh fakes a confession of love, hoping it will drive Chani away for good—only for Chani to admit he feels the same.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Kashita Maryoku wa "Revo Barai" de Kyousei Choushuu: Youzumi to Party Tsuihou sareta Ore wa, Kawaii Support Yousei to Issho ni Toritateta Maryoku wo Unyou shite Saikyou wo Mezasu.
title_english: Magic Repo Man: Dumped by My Party, I'll Cash In With a Cute Support Fairy to Become the Strongest!
title_japanese: 貸した魔力は【リボ払い】で強制徴収～用済みとパーティー追放された俺は、可愛いサポート妖精と一緒に取り立てた魔力を運用して最強を目指す。～
synopsis:
Lent is part of the up-and-coming party known as the “Skypiercers,” and thanks to his unique Gift, he can loan massive amounts of magic to others. No MP? No problem with Lent around! Except, now that his companions have become formidable heroes (thanks to his skill), his usefulness is questioned. Kicked out of the group, Lent is furious…until he discovers a hidden power to his Gift. Now, with his adorably devious fairy partner, he’s going to claw back every last scrap of magic from his former party—with interest!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Eorin
synopsis:
E-On may be talented as a musician, but it doesn't take a genius to see that he's on the verge of burnout. Sleep deprived and drowning in deadlines, E-On finds the perfect chance to get away from it all when he's approached by his friend to do some sound mixing for him at the South Pole. Everyone deserves a break. But is E-On looking to take some time off from his problems or run away from them?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Happy House
synopsis:
Dukbong was desperate to find excitement in his lonely life, chasing rushes of joy until it lead him to steal a company flash drive from his own friend as a prank. Little did Dukbong know that this flash drive held the vilest secret of Korea's richest tycoon. That one little flash drive nearly got Dukbong killed...and now that same flash drive is in the hands of a sadistic young streamer. But Dukbong doesn't care! He's still alive, and there's much happiness to be found.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Isekai Gourmet de Nariagari Musou: Yama ni Tsuihou sareta node, Nonbiri Camp wo Tanoshindeitara Itsunomanika Tsuyoku Natteite, Oukou Kizoku ya Jitsuryokusha-tachi ga Ore wo Houtteoite Kuremasen. Ippou, Ore wo Tsuihou shita Kizoku-tachi wa Hametsu ga Hajimaru
title_japanese: 異世界グルメで成り上がり無双～山に追放されたので、のんびりキャンプを楽しんでいたらいつの間にか強くなっていて、王侯貴族や実力者たちが俺を放っておいてくれません。一方、俺を追放した貴族たちは破滅が始まる～
synopsis:
After being abandoned in the mountains, I started enjoying a carefree camping life—only to end up accidentally racking up some unbelievable achievements! As I tamed holy beasts and dominated every challenge, the ones who cast me out began to fall apart on their own... And for some reason, now I'm suddenly super popular!? A thrilling comeuppance fantasy packed with harem antics and gourmet adventures!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: A Vegetarian's Pet Vegetable
synopsis:
Would you eat your adorable, talking pet vegetable?

Is the argument over what's right or wrong to eat a matter of ethics or a difference in understanding? Ihae, children's story writer and vegetarian, begins each day by eating the leaf of his pet vegetable, "Aechae." But one day, an unpleasant surprise comes his way, suddenly hurling him into a crisis...

(Source: Manta)

title: Apostles' Creed
synopsis:
Haunted by the death of her little brother, So-Yeon fights against the vengeful spirits who killed him. She is an Overwatcher: a guardian who pacifies evil and lights the gateway to guide lost souls to peace. Every Overwatcher must protect an Apostle, those with the ability to light the gate. It's said that once an Apostle purges one thousand spirits, they must grant their protector one wish. In a muck of supernatural conspiracies and corruption, can So-Yeon get her wish and find her own.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The 100 Curses of Illeston Manor
synopsis:
A hungry tree, a shapeshifting rat, and a forgotten boy... These are just three of the 100 curses that haunt Illeston Manor. House Illeston thinks they'll be plagued by their curses forever until Simone the necromancer shows up to break them. All she asks for in return is a lavish life and protection from anyone who might harm her. But with every ghoul she defeats, Simone realizes that the true dangers lie within the manor itself. Can Simone save House Illeston? Or will she die trying...?

(Source: Tapas Media)
