On a dry street... Hearts thirst for one another...
 
(Source: FAKKU)

title: Rashikunakutemo Ii ja Nai!
title_english: So What If I'm Not Like That!?
title_japanese: らしくなくてもいいじゃない!

title: Behind the Scenes
synopsis:
Straight-laced honor student Jinwoo decides to break the rules just once, and steps into a club for the first time in his life. One drunken mistake leads to him spending a passionate night with a strikingly handsome stranger—the next morning, he wakes up alone in an empty room...with a pile of cash on the nightstand. Shocked and humiliated, Jinwoo assumes the worst, and buries the memory deep in his heart. Back at school, Jinwoo volunteers for a student performance...only to lock eyes with someone on stage. It's him. The man from that night, and the king of campus: Kwon Taeyeong. It's then that, in front of everyone and with a glint in his eye, Taeyeong smiles and utters two words that will change the course of both of their lives forever: "Found you." 

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Blackout
synopsis:
Ha Junseo was once a rising star in the classical music world.
Now, he manages the career of a more successful friend while drowning his own regrets in clubs and alcohol.
After a drunken one-night stand with a stranger, Junseo blacks out, only to wake up in the home of a large, scarred man named Kang Wujin.

"You don't remember me?"

Something about Wujin feels off, and Junseo tries to run, but the man only smiles ominously.

"See you soon, Ha Junseo."

Days later, Wujin reappears as Junseo's new boss. Trapped under his obsessive watch, Junseo must figure out who Wujin really is and whether escape is even possible.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Ian's Binding
synopsis:
Benjamin Barker, a special agent at the CBI, attempts to apprehend Ian Basti, the boss of a major crime syndicate, only to be overpowered and captured. As Ian's prisoner, Benjamin is subjected to countless forms of sexual torture and even abandoned by his fellow agents. Despite this, he decides to stay by Ian's side to learn more about the inner workings of the organization and their drug operations. Will Benjamin survive this ordeal, or will the mob boss's grasp suffocate his escape plans?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Don't Lie to Me
synopsis:
Five years ago, academy teacher Song Yeodan looked out for troubled student Yun Jaewon. But when Jaewon began mistaking that concern for something more, Yeodan knew he had to draw a firm line. Now, Jaewon is back, and he's older, sharper, and more relentless than ever. As time goes by, Yeodan can no longer ignore how much has changed. The boy who once trailed after him like a shadow now stands before him as a man, and Yeodan isn't quite sure how long he can keep denying the spark.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Thicker than Water
synopsis:
Sejun is your average human. Wait, no, hold up. He's a rich college student disowned by his family for being gay, but he's only human...but will he stay that way? Jaehee, his tutor, just might be able to teach him a thing or two about a new life as something else entirely.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Hara of Thunder
synopsis:
Kwon Hara is just an ordinary high schooler until she is summoned to the world of Tatara, where she meets her favorite book character, Tori Veriharts. Although star-struck by Tori, she desperately wants to return home to her beloved mother. The only way back, she is told, is to become the successor of the powerful lightning stone and defeat the evil wizard, Parus. With no other choice, Hara and Tori set out on an electrifying adventure to save Tatara and return home!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Two's Company, Three's a Good Time
title_english: Two's Company, Three's a Good Time
synopsis:
To spice up their stale relationship, Hyeseong and Seungju decide to bring a third man into the mix. But things take an unexpected turn when their guest turns out to be Inu—Seungjoo's junior from college and his longtime secret admirer. As Hyeseong grows jealous of the tension between Seungju and Inu, things heat up in more ways than one...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Granny
synopsis:
Jung Sookja's grandson, Gwon Yonghee, is her entire world. But everything comes crashing down after he ends up in a coma. The culprits behind it, the infamous Black Star Mob, are set free despite all evidence. Then one day, two men suddenly appear in front of Mrs. Jung, telling her they will train her so she can enact revenge on her grandson's assailants and take down the mob once and for all. Hesitant at first, she decides to work with them and begins to hunt down her prey one by one.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: SOS: Sleep or Sex
synopsis:
Sleepless nights, haunting dreams, and a desperate wish bring college student Choi Woo-hyuk face-to-face with an unexpected visitor—an impossibly handsome incubus who claims to have been summoned by his own desires. But when fantasy and reality blur, Woo-hyuk's restless nights take a steamy, surreal turn he never saw coming!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Love, To Us
synopsis:
After years of devotion, Si-u's boyfriend betrays him; then, the company he worked so hard at goes under. Feeling totally defeated, Si-u escapes into a game world just to take a break from reality. There, he meets a newbie named Woojin, whose kind advice and hard-working attitude inspire Siwoo to move on from his past and start living with purpose again. Determined never to fall for someone who'll hurt him again, Siwoo makes a vow to his friend: No love, no dating. Ever again! But when he meets his new boss, Si-u's willpower will be put to the ultimate test...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Off the Record
synopsis:
Kangjin, an unremarkable idol, seizes the chance to star alongside A-list actor, Heegwon, in a cliché-ridden cop movie. Though they start off on the wrong foot, when Kangjin's secret crush on a fellow group member is on the verge of being exposed, Kangjin is forced to beg Heegwon to pose as his lover.

(Source: Manta)

title: Please, Just This Once!
synopsis:
Known as the weirdo of the Early Childhood Education Department, Juyeong starts reviewing adult toys for cash—and gets caught mid-act by his junior and crush, Minhwan. Panicking, he blurts out, "Can you put it in? Please, just this once?" Surprisingly, Minhwan agrees... Could he like Juyeong too?

(Source: Manta)

title: Yuzu no Oobaka Juuhachinen
synopsis:
Stuck alone at a cafe with a regular he dislikes, Amawashi is pressured to reveal a secret that ends up drawing them closer.

(Source: Taiyo Tosho, translated)

title: Interview with the Crazy Rich
synopsis:
Yang Seojun, director of Taeyang Solar, finds himself caught in a life-threatening storm during a vacation hike in Sweden. As he takes shelter, he meets a pretty writer named Ji Eun who offers him the last of her food as they await rescue. But when he's back home, he just can't forget her, so he concocts a company-funded writing contest to find her. It won't be easy... even his assistant has her reasons to prevent their reunion. Will Seojun find Ji Eun again, or will she be lost to him forever?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Girls Fight★
synopsis:
Yui Tachibana wishes she could be the perfect girl she dreams of, in order to impress her crush, so she makes a wish, but things don't go as she expected. Now her dreamself persona runs loose, creating chaos around school, making life harder for Yui, and embarrassing herself in front of others. How will Yui resolve this situation?

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Sword World SFC Comic: Shikkoku no Curse
title_english: Sword World SFC Comic: Lacquer-Black Curse
title_japanese: ソードワールドSFC COMIC 漆黒のカース
synopsis:
In the town of Pada on the continent of Alecrast a mysterious addictive drug known as "Devil's Breath" is causing people to behave erratic and eventually die. A band of adventurers, including warrior Bart, the young sorcerer Rizan, the elf Silarm and the grassrunner Plum investigate what is behind Devils Breath. As they follow several leads through the town they stumble upon a party led by a female thief called Nightshade and a cult who follow the god Mireef.

(Source: Record of Lodoss War Wiki)

title: Zenin Shuugou Gyagutte!! Rockman!
title_japanese: 全員集合 ギャグって!!ロックマン!
synopsis:
The story features caricatures of characters from across the Mega Man franchises, focusing primarily on enthusiastic airhead EXE-kun, the matronly Guts Mama, and other characters from the then-current handheld titles.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Ochiru Iro wa, Kohakuiro
synopsis:
In a world still engulfed in war, Theo, who serves as a military lieutenant, feels uncomfortable around Kaguma, the captain of another unit, who constantly hits on him. However; one day, while shielding Theo from a sniper, Kaguma sustains an arm injury that takes a month to heal. Feeling responsible, Theo offers to nurse Kaguma for the month until he recovers, but... When he witnesses Kaguma masturbating, Theo ends up helping him deal with "that" as well...?

(Source: Cosmic Shuppan, translated)

title: Nimbus
synopsis: A one-shot about cancelling an online cloud storage service.

title: Just Contract Lovers
synopsis:
I won't actually fall for him!

As 34-year-old divorcé Sungyoon contemplates dating again, he runs into an old college friend, Hyunsoo, who's now a famous writer. When he learns that Hyunsoo's in a slump, Sungyoon offers to help... only to be taken aback when Hyunsoo suggests they be contract lovers to spice up his romance novel!

(Source: Manta)

title: Classmate wa Isekai Teni nanoni Watashi wa Isekai Tensei
title_japanese: クラスメイトは異世界転移なのに私は異世界転生
synopsis:
While her classmates have all gotten transported to another world, Akari alone dies and is reincarnated as a beautiful girl in that world. Even though trouble comes her way, she remains positive and cheerful, boldly embracing her second chance at life. Her days are filled with crushing crappy nobles, taking down criminal organizations, and staying extremely optimistic... It is clear why she was so well-liked by her classmates...!!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Tokimeki Tonight: Etou Mouri no Kakeochi
title_japanese: ときめきトゥナイト 江藤望里の駆け落ち

title: River of Bondage
synopsis:
"The kind of play I prefer is a little too hardcore for newbies."

Seo-ha, a university lecturer, is a natural submissive with deeply ingrained masochistic tendencies. Yet, fear of being outed has kept him from ever pursuing a real partner, leaving him to indulge only in fantasies.

When the fellow professor he has been secretly admiring announces their engagement, Seo-ha is devastated. In a moment of impulsive rebellion, he turns to a BDSM community to find a one-night play partner, hoping to finally experience the domination he's always craved.

But this leap into the unknown may lead him down a path far more intense—and dangerous—than he ever imagined.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Still, It Rains
synopsis:
While working undercover at Heaven's Harvest Sect, a cult devoted to a so-called god of abundance, journalist Jang Gijun expects the usual lies and fanaticism. Instead, he finds Hui-sae, a young and eerily serene cult leader forced to "share blessings" through his own body, offering himself to frenzied followers in rituals disguised as salvation. Convinced he's on to a bigger scoop that expected, Gijun watches the lines blur between devotion and exploitation, quickly realizing that the cult's darkest secrets may lie not in its doctrine, but in what it demands of the one they claim is divine.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: KasuRich
synopsis:
University student Mikado Kasuga lives for his favorite streamer, Zurich (real name: Rihito Nakahara). Convinced he's the only one who truly understands the man behind the screen, Mikado goes to an event to see his idol in person. But their meeting doesn't go the way he imagined—and Mikado soon learns that Zurich also has a peculiar and mutual attachment to him. A unique BL about the twisted, codependent bond between an obsessive streamer and possessive fan.

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Trick or Treat
synopsis:
Shi-Hyuk always had his pick when it came to women, but that hasn't helped him get it up in the last few days... Unable to find a medical reason for his issue, he seemed doomed to hang up the playboy lifestyle. But when he begins experiencing some strange dreams and sensations at night, even the level-headed Shi-Hyuk begins to believe something more spiritual is behind his bedroom malfunctions.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Dansou Oujo no Akusai Keikaku: Dannasama ga Zenzen Rikon ni Oujite Kuremasen
title_japanese: 男装王女の悪妻計画～旦那様がぜんぜん離婚に応じてくれません～

title_japanese: 押しの弱い地味系JSは援助交際を断れない。

title_japanese: ミントさんはあまあま交尾したい。〜巨乳ヒーラーのお姉さんがめちゃくちゃ誘ってくる話〜

title_japanese: シスター完全敗北。～無知なシスターが本能で発情交尾するまで～

title: How to Draw an Ellipse
synopsis:
Before starting a new job at a prestigious company, Yoo Juha happily jets off on a vacation with her girlfriend, Kim Minsung. But when people from Minsung's past show up and reveal that she used to be a genius hacker, Juha realizes she's being used as a pawn in a secret project planned by the company executives. In order to expose the scheme and protect Minsung, Juha joins hands with a mysterious duo who offer their help, but will the power of love be enough to win this battle of deception?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: I Stan You
synopsis:
While on his way to meet some friends, Kang Hada meets Yuri, the girl of his dreams. She's beautiful, kind, and a fan of the hottest boy band around. To win her heart, Hada decides to join in on the hype! He's buying albums, going to live performances, and even joining a fan club! But as the two get to know each other, Hada struggles with how to break the truth to Yuri. Meanwhile, Yuri has some challenges of her own... How long will Hada's luck last? Or, more importantly, will he win Yuri's love?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Drifting Brig
synopsis:
After three years of prep, Kim Minsu is ready to start his first day as a guard on the XB-880, a high-security prison in the middle of the ocean. On his first day, the prisoners riot and take over the ship. As they massacre the guards, Minsu poses as a criminal to survive. Though wary of this new face, he is accepted as one of them. Now, Minsu has to maintain this ruse until help comes, but as a powerful faction takes hold of the brig, he must work with the other inmates to fight for control.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Seducing the Jerk
synopsis:
Lingering feelings can haunt you.

Eunsung has always been genetically blessed in the looks department. But what happens when his good looks catch the attention of a ghost? And what will he do when the ghost refuses to pass on till Eunsung helps him get revenge on his first love... by turning him gay?!

(Source: Manta)

title: The Good Life
synopsis:
It's not my fault I'm so handsome!

Yoochang is a good-looking guy. So good-looking, in fact, that he had to transfer to an all-boys school to escape the horde of adoring girls. But now he's gone from being the subject of catfights to having guys brawl over him! Just how far will Yoochang's good looks take him?

(Source: Manta)

title: Für Elise
synopsis:
Are you... in love with a doll?

Taewoo and Yunsol have always been an unlikely pair. As childhood best friends, both are too afraid of losing the other to admit their feelings. But when Yunsol's soul becomes a part of her doll after a messy accident, things get even more complicated. Will the two be able to find a way for Yunsol to become human again... and find love on the way?

(Source: Manta)

title: If You Wish
synopsis:
Making a bet with… God?!

Jiyoung, an ordinary high school girl, just happens to come across God? God is fascinated that Jiyoung has never called for Him and suggests a bet: during His stay in the human world, if Jiyoung can suppress the urge to ask Him for anything, He will give her everything she can possibly wish for. She doesn't want to say yes, but who can say no when God looks this good!

(Source: Manta)

title: Knock on Wood
synopsis:
Two childhood friends, Eunchae and Jiho, decide to hit each other with a backscratcher to beat away bad luck. And why not? Nothing weird about a couple guys doing favors for each other—you scratch my back and I scratch yours! But sometimes it takes a hard hit to knock some sense into you... or some feelings into your body. Some very good feelings. As their bodies suddenly react to each new bump in their relationship, will their hearts also be tied together? For good luck, knock on wood!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Juliet, We're Not in Kansas Anymore!
title_english: Juliet, We're Not in Kansas Anymore!
synopsis:
What's more tragic than a play by Shakespeare?

As far as high school junior Juliet Holiday is concerned, her real tragedy is sharing a name with such a famous character. Then along comes a charming British transfer student named none other than Romeo. Did fate lead him to this small Kansas town? Pray tell, who's the real Romeo in Juliet's story?

(Source: Manta)

title: A Bad Case of Junioritis
synopsis:
Teen angst in full swing.

Woojung's hopes for a normal sophomore year are dashed after a run-in with Sera, a foul-mouthed troublemaker, who has a few choice words for him. What starts out as a simple accident snowballs into a big misunderstanding, and now Woojung finds himself tangled up with a bunch of depressed juniors!

(Source: Manta)

title: Dekapai Kishi Makaritooru!
title_japanese: デカパイ騎士まかり通る!
synopsis:
In preparation for the impending resurrection of the Demon King, a party sets out on a journey to seek the legendary sword. However, Alicia, a female knight who is the party's central member, possesses huge boobs, which, in this world, are considered a symbol of bad luck... What awaits them on this journey!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: A Morning Kiss at Tiffany's
synopsis:
From homeowner to housekeeper?!

Hari Yoo, owner of the luxurious "Tiffany Building," is living her best life... until her first love suddenly shows up with an eviction notice! On the brink of becoming homeless, Hari offers to be his housekeeper in exchange for a roof over her head. Can she win back her building... and his heart?

(Source: Manta)

title: All You Need Is Perfection
synopsis:
College freshman Kim Da-in enters Myeongmun University determined to craft the perfect campus life: top grades, meaningful friendships, and even a handsome boyfriend. However, her plans unravel quickly after meeting her stunningly beautiful namesake, Kang Da-in, and a reserved guy named Cha Su-hyeon. When Su-hyeon publicly rejects her in favor of the "prettier" Da-in, her carefully built vision begins to collapse. Surrounded by students chasing their own ideal selves, can Da-in figure out what perfection really means?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Usamimi Jackpot
title_english: Usamimi Jackpot in the Bunny Girl's Bar♥
title_japanese: うさ耳ジャックポット
synopsis:
Takato Washimi, a third-year employee at a toy company, is troubled and worn down after struggling to get his project approved. One day, he encounters a bunny girl in the city, and his life changes completely. His work fatigue, worries, and mistakes—everything is soothed and purified by a sexy bunny girl! An invitation to a night time dreamland! Welcome to the bunny girl bar, Jackpot!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Property of the King
synopsis:
The slave she thought was dead has returned—as a king. Now, he takes her as his concubine to destroy her kingdom and avenge his past. "My love wounds him. His love condemns me."

(Source: Manta)

title: Please Answer Me
synopsis:
I can't escape his piercing blue eyes...

Soon to be wed, Princess Rosetta embarks on the final journey of her freedom. During the trip the party are saved by a strange woman. But when it turns out her injured savior is also due to be wed, Rosetta volunteers to help the ceremony proceed. Little does she know her world is about to change.

(Source: Manta)

title: Office Romance Battlefront
synopsis:
Go-eun Lee is unlucky in love. She poured her money, heart, soul, and money (did we mention money?!) into her ex-boyfriend...who repaid Go-eun by cheating on her. Despite the hurt, she decides to leave the past in the past. Now love is the last thing on her mind. But for CEO Woohyuk Baek, Go-eun is always the first thought on his mind. Now that she's single, it's his chance to make a move! As if work isn't hectic enough, why not throw a little romance into the mix?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Ganglion
synopsis:
Early 2000s Tokyo. Isobe, a combatant for the evil corporation Ganglion, spends his days on the battlefield. Whether it's the "Tokyo Cedar Pollen Operation" or the "Mount Fuji Demolition Plan," he faces off in nothing but a bodysuit, only to be crushed by the hero Hopeman time and again. As he struggles under unreasonable bosses during the dawn of compliance, his story unfolds—a workplace drama dedicated to all who work, following the bittersweet life of a salaryman soldier.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Aisare Seijo wa Yamiochi Akayuku wo Sukuitai
title_english: The Beloved Saint Is Trying to Save the Villain Who Has Fallen Into Darkness.
title_japanese: 愛され聖女は闇堕ち悪役を救いたい
synopsis:
Due to her lack of magical powers, the count's daughter Sufia has been trapped in her house from a young age. Upon her father's remarriage, she sees her new stepmother and stepsister. From this comes a revelation: she has been reincarnated in an otome game. According to the storyline, Sufia will suffer under the thumb of her stepsister, Lily... But with her positivity and composure, Sufia is unmoved!

Furthermore, in order to save her favorite character, Evuard, who is bound to fall into evil, Sufia begins manipulating her sister from behind the scenes. Sufia succeeds in preventing his downfall. After using her knowledge of the game, Sufia acquires the title of "saint" and enrolls in the magic academy! No matter what, she resolves to save the other characters as well!

Thereupon, perplexed by Sufia's actions, Evuard begins showing an interest in her...? This is the story of an overwhelmingly positive heroine seizing her own happiness!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Tokimeki Tonight: Sorekara
title_japanese: ときめきトゥナイト それから

title: The Spooky Love Tale of Gongchan Seol
title_english: The Spooky Love Tale of Gongchan Seol
synopsis:
Ghosts aren't real... right? Gongchan has a wild imagination as a horror-novel author with a knack for turning his mundane life into a harrowing ghost story. These spooks live only in his head... that is until he meets Youngmin, a man haunted by the supernatural specters in Gongchan's novel! With everything around him suddenly turning into an eerie mess, is Gongchan's growing love for Youngmin the reason why his heart is racing? Or is it the bloody ghost behind him?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Ghosting Groom
synopsis:
Sarang Jin is one of the most famous actresses in South Korea, and she has it all—talent, good looks, and a loving fiancé... or not! One week before their wedding, her groom-to-be ghosts her. She desperately searches everywhere for Inha, only to discover he's lied to her throughout their entire relationship. To her dismay, his secret triggers her own personal misfortunes with shamanism. Heartbroken and traumatized by her past, will she be able to accept him for who he is?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Containment Zone Management
synopsis:
Welcome to the Containment Zone, where every space is warped by anomalies and bound by deadly rules. From unholy hospitals to sinister arcades, the four-man team of Department 2 ventures in daily to study the spaces and bring back supplies. Things are always guaranteed to get bizarre, but the job has to be done... no matter how many deaths it causes.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: How to Kill You
synopsis:
Han Woojae put his dream of becoming a screenwriter on hold to take care of his family and support his already successful writer wife, Lee Seojin, until their daughter turns 8. One day, a mysterious girl approaches Woojae, claiming that his wife is doing "bad things" behind his back. She tells Woojae that she is the only person who knows all of Seojin's deep, dark secrets. As Woojae learns about his wife's past, he wonders what lengths he must go to protect his family and keep them together.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Ornithophobia
synopsis:
Murder is in the air, a mystery's trail is marked with feathers and it's quickly running cold. Cheolmin Han is an office worker who suspects that he's losing his mind...or is he seeing the truth for the very first time? Who are these bird-faced, bloodthirsty creatures he's confronted with? Why are they hunting him? Where do they come from? What do they want? Who will believe him? Most importantly, how will he survive?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Saimin Septet
synopsis:
1-6. Saimin Goukan!? Ojousama Gakkou no Hentai Kyoushi
7. Shuukyou Kanyuu ni wa Goyoujin!?
8. Gekiatsu!? Kimeseku Elevator
9. Nure Mure Ecchi
10. Saimin Goukan!? Ojousama Gakkou no Hentai Moto Kyoushi

title: The Dead Man's Letter
synopsis:
Former judo star Joo Hana marries her friend, Do Woori, and stages an insurance fraud so they can leave the country as a rich couple. Everything goes according to plan, including Woori's disappearance, and Hana finally receives the money five years later. But when she goes to meet her husband, she comes face to face with his corpse instead. As Hana tries to figure out what's happening, she gets a letter... from her dead man. With this new clue, can she unravel the mystery of his death?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Dokidoki Ecchism
synopsis:
1. Nurete de Awa: Onsen de Hadaka no Tsukiai
2. Solo Camp de Nani Suru no? Ore no Tent de Shiranai Josei ga Nuideita
3. Natsumatsuri♪ Munasawagi♪ Tsuyayaka ni Suhada wo Miseru Kimi♪
4. Sumikkogurashi: Anata to Watashi no Honne to Tatemae
5. Kosuri Kosurare
6. Yarashii Kotoba: Ikisugi na Kaishaku
7. Tanoshii Koto wa Tension ga Takamaru kara Saishuu Check wa Neniri ni
8. Yankee卍 Oppai Momu
9. Mappadaka to Kurohada: Make Love in Beach

title: Onaho Ochi shita Kikai Tenshi-sama to Boku no Natsuyasumi
title_japanese: オナホ堕ちした機械天使様と僕の夏休み

title: Hajimete no Kyokutou Seikatsu
synopsis: Continuation of the one-shot Nangoku no Kotou ni Furoufushi no Shoujo wo Oe!!.

title: Otona dakara Zettai ni Makenai!!!
title_japanese: 大人だから絶対に敗けないッ!!!

title: Gachikoi shinai to Derarenai Heya
title_japanese: ガチ恋しないと出られない部屋

title: Natsu Gasshuku de Hamerareta Instructor
title_japanese: 夏合宿でハメられたインストラクター

title: Fukanshou dakedo Kyou Tomete.
title_japanese: 不感症だけど今日泊めて。

title: Gyaku Hame Minarai Instructor: Sports Club Kojin Shidou-hen
title_japanese: 逆ハメ見習いインストラクター～スポクラ個人指導編～

title: Plus Minus Zero
synopsis:
What caused the massive earthquake is a mystery. Could it have been the time machine Gyungbae built? Was it the construction going on outside the school? Or was it something darker? Something that now lurks the hallways of the buried school, preying upon those who lingered? Whatever it is, the students and teachers trapped within the darkened halls of the school have more pressing issues to think about, like finding more food, whether they'll ever be rescued, and who stole Eunhui's body...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Anata no Suki na Watashi
synopsis:
Mako, an apparel store clerk who has always been popular with the same sex because of her cool looks, has something she is hiding from her girlfriend Sayoko. It's that she's the type of person who wants to be pampered...! She tries not to ruin her image, but...

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

title: Ebi to Shake
synopsis:
Ebisawa, who plays guitar and sings in a band, was inspired by Shake's guitar playing and singing in "The Salmons." Determined not to lose, he pushed himself harder. Though his efforts paid off and Ebisawa gained popularity, the seemingly unbridgeable gap between himself and Shake eventually broke his spirit...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Lookout for Love
synopsis:
Suho has a problem. No, it's not the fact that he has severe social withdrawal. It's that he's head over heels for Sanghyeok, the hot new security guard working at Suho's apartment complex. After falling in love at first sight, Suho starts scheming and making excuses to hover around Sanghyeok at all times. The thing is, this only causes Sanghyeok to misunderstand Suho as a creep. Sanghyeok is already quiet and cautious for reasons unknown, and Suho's antics are not helping! Can Suho clear up the misunderstanding and ask him out?

(Source: Manta)

title: The Ex-tra Hot Neighbor
synopsis:
Finding the perfect guy isn't easy, but looks like Eunseo just hit the jackpot. Seung-hyuk's a handsome, hot hunk with a pretty face that anyone would fall in love with. How could you resist someone like that, especially if they feel so much like Mr. Right? Well, as with any good thing, there is a small catch. Apparently, Seung-hyuk is a friend's ex-boyfriend. Not just any friend, but Eunseo's new roommate, Minjae. What a fix. Eunseo wants to keep on meeting this hottie, but hurting his friend's feelings isn't right, right? Even if the hottie lives next door and they literally run into each other all the time? Right?

(Source: Manta)

title: Toraware Hanahime no Shiawase na Gosan
title_english: The Captured Flower Princess's Happy Miscalculation
title_japanese: とらわれ花姫の幸せな誤算
synopsis:
Princess Loutier of the Kingdom of Florella, Lou, was called the "Flower Princess" for she had a magical power to make flowers bloom through her song. It was a power that royals of Florella possess, but hers was especially powerful. That is why she was always told not to use her power... It was too powerful that once she harmed someone when she was little. Lou didn't know about love, but she felt happy when Prince Raynaud of the allied kingdom asked her to marry him.

However, on the day of the wedding, the Olgan Empire invaded Florella... Lou was captured by Prince Julius, a mysterious masked prince. Lou marries Prince Julius. She wants to hate him... but there is something soft in his heart that she can't ignore. Is this first love?

(Source: Kadokawa)

title: Akuyaku Reijou ni Tensei shita Watashi to Akuyaku Ouji ni Tensei shita Ore
title_english: The Villainess and Villain Try to Avoid Another Unhappy Ending
title_japanese: 悪役令嬢に転生した私と悪役王子に転生した俺
synopsis:
Honoka, a thirty-year-old working girl, fell down the stairs after her fiancé told her that he wanted to break up. The next moment, she was in the world of "Fated, Love: A Cinderella Story," a light novel that her sister was into.

She is now Clarisse, a seventeen-year-old aristocrat. Honoka knows that she is going to be a villainess along with Eduard, brother of Crown Prince Arnold. She decides to change her fate and live happily in this world. When she meets Eduard for the first time, they fall in love almost instantly. To her surprise, Eduard is nothing like the villain described in the book. He is gentle, clever and nice... and handsome! She never knew that Eduard too, had reincarnated from the world she came from.

(Source: Kadokawa)

title: Ore ga Inai to Sugu Chomeru Hakanagi Kasumi
title_japanese: 俺がいないとすぐ××〈チョメ〉る儚木かすみ

title: Tonari no Furyou Shoujo wo Tasuketara Ippai H na Koto Sasete Kureta Hanashi
title_japanese: となりの不良少女を助けたらいっぱいHな事させてくれた話

title: App de Ayatsuru Namaiki Shoujo
title_japanese: アプリで操るナマイキ少女

title: The Villainess's Debut Novel
synopsis:
Centuries ago, Mago was punished by a god for writing a calamitous book. She was doomed to be repeatedly reborn until she destroyed every copy of her novel under the surveillance of Ha Lib, the deity's errand boy. There are now only five copies remaining, but Mago's quest to end her cycle of rebirth is complicated when Do Kyujin, a charismatic CEO, joins the search for his own purposes. With yet another mysterious figure thwarting them at every turn, will Mago finally be able to rest in peace?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Genova no Deshi: 10-byou shika Tatakaenai Majutsushi, Nochi no "Maou" wo Sodateru
title_japanese: ジェノヴァの弟子 ～10秒しか戦えない魔術師、のちの『魔王』を育てる～
serializations: Suiyoubi wa Mattari Dash X Comic
synopsis:
This is the story of a certain master and apprentice on their journey. The master, Valen, was once known as the "Strongest Mage," but after a tragic event, he lost his beloved master, his sight, and all of his magical power. Now, Valen can only use his former powers for 10 seconds at a time, and he's awkward around women. His apprentice, Ria, is a magical prodigy who forced her way into becoming Valen's apprentice, almost like a wife barging in. However, she's determined to hide the fact that she's a woman at all costs. When Ria reveals the shocking truth that "Valen's master is still alive," their strange journey begins. But for some reason, their adventures lead to the potential destruction of the human world!? This is a fantasy adventure of a once-invincible mage with a 10-second limit and a cross-dressing girl with a secret!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Slow Damage: Clean Dishes - Leveret
title_japanese: スロウ・ダメージ Clean dishes -leveret-

title: Onegai desu kara Ukete Kure
title_japanese: お願いですからウケてくれ

title: Kimi wa Shuumatsu
synopsis:
An 'apocalyptic' boy-meets-girl rom-com about high school boy Yutaka Kuromori and the beautiful, popular girl adored by everyone, Aru Hoshina. Yutaka might shyly deny it, insisting “we’re not dating,” but Aru is always clinging to him, and the two are seen as the talk-of-the-school couple.

But behind what looks like an ordinary boy–girl high school relationship lies a secret—one so ruinous and capricious that, if mishandled, it could bring about the end of the world.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Konyaku Haki no Tetsuzuki wa Osumi desu ka? Daini no Jinsei wo Ouka shiyou to Omottara, Guild wo Tatenaosu Koto ni Narimashita
title_english: You Want to Break Off Our Engagement? Well, You'd Better Break the Bank!
title_japanese: 婚約破棄の手続きはお済みですか? 第二の人生を謳歌しようと思ったら、ギルドを立て直すことになりました
synopsis:
Patricia, daughter of Count Sainraime, was rather happy when her fiancé, Claude, told her he wanted to break off their engagement. She had already prepared perfectly for this day...all the documents that proved that she could receive a certain amount of money as compensation. Claude couldn't believe his eyes, for Patricia was a carefree girl in front of him for a long time. He didn't know that Patricia remembered her previous life as Akiko, an office worker, on her sixteenth birthday. There was no choice for him but to sign the documents.

With the money, Patricia bought her parents a second house and headed off to a town far away. She wanted to find a place to work. But when she found a job at a mercenary guild, it was a tough place...!

(Source: Kadokawa)

title: Onmyou Brothers
synopsis:
Shidou could see things that he calls "seeds of misfortune" ever since he was a child. It is something like a sticky shadow, and when he doesn't do anything, it brings misfortune to people. He always smashes it with his hand to eliminate them, counting the number as "virtue points." Shidou wishes to pile up good karma so that someday his "curse" will be lifted, and he will stop seeing nightmares.

One day, he finds a monster too powerful for him to handle... but tries anyway to save people. There he meets Mashiro, who knows a proper way to fight with the monster. He is an Onmyouji... who is in charge of bringing harmony to this world. Mashiro is immediately aware that Shidou has a special talent, that they'll be the most powerful pair!

(Source: Kadokawa)

title: Crush of the Decade
synopsis:
Yuna has kept a secret for ten whole years: she has a crush on her best friend, Da-hye. It's a secret she intends to keep for the rest of her life, but the new year brings a lot of surprises: including a strange new woman named Zoey, who just might change everything. Caught between two women, Yuna's one-sided crush just might die down...or turn into something else entirely. After a whole decade of pining, is it time for Yuna to finally find her happy ending? And if so, who will be the one to ultimately grant it to her?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Unnie tte Yondemo Ii desu ka?
title_japanese: オンニって呼んでもいいですか?
synopsis:
Natsuki has been a K-pop otaku for 15 years. She spends her days crying as she remembers her former favorite idol, Sora, who has retired. However, a comment from a younger colleague, "You only have one life to live. Are you just going to wait for your favorite idol to make a comeback?" One day, she decides to try a dating app. The person she matches with is a girl who looks just like Sora!

A love story between a K-pop otaku and a former K-pop idol!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Maoujou no Succubus vs. Inmon Jutsushi
title_japanese: 魔王城のサキュバス VS.淫紋術師

title: The Wife of the Dragon Duke
title_english: The Wife of the Dragon Duke
synopsis:
Anthia spent years saving lives on the battlefield. With the war finally over, all she wants is peace, but her father's debts threaten to destroy any chance of that life. Desperate, she answers a strange advertisement for a contract marriage to a duke seeking someone eerily similar to her. But upon arrival, she's met by Al, a mysterious man tasked with "preparing" her for the duke. As their physical bond intensifies, so do her suspicions about him, the duke... and their dragon-blooded lineage.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kaiki Ningyou-kan
synopsis:
1. Oningyou Asobi
2. Mannequin
3. Aoi Me no Mary
4. Fukuwajutsushi to Koi
5. Gishiki
6. Koi no Negai Kanaemasu

title: Hakidame ni Koi
synopsis:
Under the cold weather, Hiro comes across a man who collapses in a garbage dump near his house. He nurses the man, Yamaga, who is weak and refuses to be helped and decides to let him stay with him. The distance between them is strange and frightening, and Hiro is always at a loss for what to do, but as they live together, he begins to see an unexpected side to the man...?

(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)

title: Return to My Dark Past
synopsis:
What if you could undo your dark past? Chaebom Yu, a burned-out office worker, wakes up as her 17-year-old self, given a second chance to rewrite her life. She enters high school determined to avoid the mistakes that once haunted her. But the more she tries to fix things, the weirder her life becomes. Money starts slipping away, and strange boys keep showing up… Her “do-over” begins to feel just as messy as before! Can Chaebom truly escape her past, or is she just trading one chaotic life for another?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Ayashi no Ayashi
synopsis: An onmyouji gets temporarily reassigned to a preschool for youkai.

title: Soshite, Mina ni Natta.
synopsis:
In broad daylight, a horrific mass murder occurs, nearly also claiming the life of Mina, a high school student. Miraculously, she survives after undergoing a heart transplant. As Mina begins to settle back into a semblance of normalcy, she becomes alarmed by an overwhelming surge of murderous intent that she's never experienced before. Unbeknownst to her, the heart she received had belonged to Misako Shimizu, the very perpetrator of the mass murder. Mina's parents watch in confusion and fear as their beloved daughter starts transforming into a murderer whose murderous intent never stops...!?

(Source: Nihon Bungeisha, translated)

title: Shackled by Desire
synopsis:
Revered by his comrades, Seo Seungbum was once a man of unwavering strength. But when Hwang Jihyuk uncovers his darkest secret, Seungbum becomes powerless against him. Stripped of control, he is forced into a world of torment—drugged, violated, and reshaped under the guise of twisted pleasure. As Jihyuk's cruel obsession spirals deeper, Seungbum struggles to grasp what his captor truly wants. Trapped in a cycle of pain and desire, he fights to survive each day... not knowing if escape is even possible

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Hungry Tyrant
synopsis:
"The emperor devours men," the servants in the palace whisper. Han doesn't believe them, until on his very first day of service he is dragged to the emperor's bedchambers. Hunger and lust drives the tyranny that is rampant in the palace. Will Han be able to sate the tyrant and change him for the better?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Aisareteru Baai ja Nai no
title_japanese: 愛されてる場合じゃないの
synopsis:
Betrayed by love and cast aside by society, Liz finds herself at the edge of despair, with nothing left but her tragic fate. As darkness slowly closes in around her, a flicker of hope appears—a chance to reclaim her life and rewrite her story. Should the naive girl who once believed in love's promises face her cruel destiny, or transform into a force of vengeance against those who deceived her? The decisions Liz makes will shape her destiny, and the world around her, forever.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Curse of the Full Moon
title_english: The Curse of the Full Moon
synopsis:
After years of obscurity, rising star Sung Yi-hyun is finally basking in the spotlight... Conquering dramas, variety shows, and the glitz of celebrity life. 

Then one day, he gets a single text from his longtime lover, Jang Tae-eun: "Let's break up."

Ghosted. Dumped. By text. One of the three ultimate breakup sins.

Furious, Yi-hyun swears to live his best, wildest life—eating well, partying hard, and pretending not to care. But Tae-eun doesn't even flinch.

"Don't tell me... he's seeing someone else?"

When Yi-hyun storms over to confront him, he's greeted not by his ex—but by the biggest, brightest full moon he's ever seen. And just like that, the secret he's kept hidden for years is exposed... along with a tail and a pair of ears.

Mistaken for a stray and taken in by Tae-eun, Yi-hyun suddenly finds himself living under the same roof as his ex—not as a man, but as a dog named Rufus.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Missing Master
synopsis:
"Please don't push your disciple away anymore, Master.."

Ryu Jangjin lives an ordinary life, finding his only escape in web novels during his daily subway commute. But one evening, on his way home, a mysterious man suddenly breaks through his apartment window—from the third floor, no less!

The intruder, Sa Wihyeon, claims to be Jangjin's disciple, insisting that their true home isn't Earth, but a place called Honwon. He has come to take Jangjin back where he belongs. As an avid reader of isekai and wuxia novels, Jangjin is tempted by the fantastical idea—but reality calls, and he has work in the morning.

Ignoring his protests, Sa Wihyeon insists that Jangjin is only refusing because he has lost his memories. Before Jangjin can argue, he finds himself kidnapped and dragged into another world...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Mine to Begin With
synopsis:
Carefree and house-free, Seoha has spent a long time mooching off of guys in trade for some sex and fun. One day, he runs into Jaewon, a rich and quiet guy who seems to be willing to lend a helping hand with no strings attached...but are we sure that there's no strings pulling at Seoha at all?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: LO Channel [Member Gentei Haishin]
title_japanese: えるおーちゃんねる［メンバー限定配信］

title: Watashi no Stress Hassanhou
title_japanese: わたしのストレス発散法

title: Yuki wa Tomoe ni
synopsis:
A story set in the Taisho era, of two men living among the upheaval of early 20th century Japan. The lives of novelist Matsunaga Shunko and painter Ichiyanagi Suicho are completely engulfed by the mood of the volatile time period.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Isekai Teni shite Kyoushi ni Natta ga, Majo to Osorerareteiru Ken
title_english: The Fearsome Witch Teaches in Another World
title_japanese: 異世界転移して教師になったが、魔女と恐れられている件
synopsis:
After her death on Earth, teacher Aoi Konominato awakens as a child in an unfamiliar world, filled with regret about her lackluster life and unfinished goals. An elven sage named Owain takes her in, mentors her, and instructs her in the art of sorcery. Twelve years later, Aoi has mastered everything he’s thrown at her, and Owain deems her ready to further her studies of sorcery by becoming an instructor at the illustrious Fiddich Academy, the finest sorcery school in the world. Though she’s hesitant at first, Aoi sees this as a second chance to become her ideal vision of a teacher, albeit in a fantasy world. However, this magical school is brimming with problems—and misbehaving students. The children of nobles and royalty are used to doing whatever they want, but soon they’ll learn to pay attention in this fearsome witch’s class!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Gemma!
synopsis:
Gemma's a sweet little girl... and also a dragon. She may look innocent with her curly hair and rosy cheeks, but deep down, she knows she's a monster who can raze villages with a single breath. Because of this, she's hated and feared, even by those whom she once believed loved her. And then there's Garin, the most ferocious dragon hunter (though a bit jaded) in all of Chrysos, now tasked with guiding Gemma to safe harbor. A mischievous dragon girl and a dragon hunter... what could go wrong?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Karma
synopsis:
A man who owes a loan shark money and resorts to desperate measures to pay off his debt. A doctor who disposes of a body to cover up a crime and scrambles to keep his involvement hidden. A woman who is haunted by her past and seeks revenge against the men who have hurt her. Three very different people with their own reasons for committing terrible crimes, but when their paths intersect in a manner unforeseeable, their actions give rise to unimaginable consequences.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Make Heroine wo Katasetai!!
title_japanese: 負けヒロインを勝たせたい!!
synopsis:
Turn the losing heroine into a winning heroine! A romantic comedy about a pure heroine being guided by a mob protagonist!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Office Misconduct
synopsis:
Kim Gayeong is the best-selling author of "Office Misconduct," a story based on her first job experience five years ago. Gayeong's dreams to start her new job are shattered as she learns how tough the workplace can be. After being forced to take on unreasonable job requests and severe bullying from her supervisor, Nayeon, Gayeon decides to kill her. But her plans suddenly change when someone else murders Nayeon first. She's positive the culprit is from the office, but the question is, who?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Bear with Me
synopsis:
With her followers decimated by other churches, Granchia, the goddess of rightful revenge, is on the brink of destruction. Restricted and bound to human form, she must protect and support her one last true believer...or cease to exist. Can she find a way to gather her servants and muster enough power to avenge the wrongs done to her believer and his family? Or will her enemies succeed in their mission to destroy her last follower, dooming her to oblivion?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Love Derailed
synopsis:
For years, basketball player Lee Ahn has kept his feelings for his older friend Geonu locked away. But when he hears the sudden news of Geonu's divorce, his heart starts racing all over again. When Geonu reaches out to ask him to model for his company, Lee Ahn knows he has to take his shot. "I'm too horny to focus on basketball... Could you help me out?"

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Black-Haired Beast's Love
synopsis:
San once found comfort in Heemin's kindness. Years later, he confesses the love he has kept hidden, not to win Heemin over but to finally walk away with closure.

To his surprise, Heemin accepts his feelings without hesitation.

Struggling to trust something that feels too easy, San finds himself torn between doubt and longing. He yearns for a kind of love he has never learned how to receive.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Spectrophilia
synopsis:
Woojin's first love is dead. Not that he'd be particularly overjoyed to reunite with the intense guy who stole his heart in highschool under more normal circumstances, mind you, but having to attend his funeral feels like a slap in the face to his already unresolved feelings. So, when he starts dreaming about the late Jaeha, Woojin chalks it up to nothing more than his tumultuous emotions. Except, the dreams start taking a...sensual turn. So, when a mysterious man shows up to warn Woojin of the dangers of getting involved with ghosts, Woojin is left with a decision to make: just how much pleasure is worth the dangers of this spectrophilia...?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Demon Leader's Lover
synopsis:
Born under the ominous sign of "Ultimate Yang Obstruction," Dang Soun faced a turbulent life from the outset, destined to die before the age of thirty. Abandoned by his father and orphaned, he endures harsh conditions, resorting to begging and eventually gambling for survival. Despite narrowly escaping death on numerous occasions, Soun's fate takes a drastic turn when he is suddenly informed by his long-lost father and younger brother that he will become the concubine of the Demonic Sect. With his life constantly in jeopardy, survival becomes Soun's sole focus, even if it means becoming the Demonic Sect's Leader's concubine for a chance at a peaceful end.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Fanfiction
synopsis:
Failed horror writer Gong Chanhyuk's BL webtoons are wildly popular—but he hates writing them. Then superstar Lee Hyeoksu, his secret crush, shows up to pitch a drama adaptation. When an old tablet with steamy fanfic about Hyeoksu falls out of Chanhyuk's closet, things get... complicated. Hyeoksu suggests they reenact the story—and their "casual" affair begins. But when Chanhyuk overhears a suspicious conversation, everything threatens to unravel.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Touchdown Ace
synopsis:
Ace Lampard has it all—looks, charm, grades, and the attention of the entire school. He sits at the top of every social and academic ladder. That is, until a new transfer student, Colin McCarthy, unexpectedly takes the top academic spot and turns everything upside down.

Colin is shy, awkward, and completely out of place. After Ace steps in to protect him from bullies, Colin becomes infatuated and starts following him in secret. When Ace catches on, Colin prepares himself for rejection. Instead, he hears something completely unexpected.

"Be my Secret lover, Colin..."

What begins as a strange proposal slowly unravels into something much more dangerous. He isn't just an ordinary student with a crush. He has a reason for being here, and Ace is only the beginning.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Pinocchio in the Closet
synopsis:
Ji Wooin is a clumsy but good-hearted police officer in the Community Safety Division. At 28, he's still single, still a virgin, and constantly pressured by his family to start dating. As the only son, he finally gives in and accepts a strange charm from his mother that's supposed to help him find love.

He doesn't believe in things like that. It's clearly a scam. Or so he thinks.

The next morning, he opens his closet and finds someone sleeping inside. A beautiful stranger, fast asleep as if he's always belonged there.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Taming the Trashy Tutor
synopsis:
Ha Sungwon was once a promising young professor from a powerful academic family. But after a scandal involving abuse of power, he lost everything. Drowning in gambling debt, he tried to run, only to be captured and dragged away.

He wakes up in a luxurious but unfamiliar home. The owner? Yoon Sihyun, a former student Sungwon once tutored years ago. Now a grown man, Sihyun has turned into something far darker. He's obsessed, possessive, and disturbingly gentle.

Sihyun bought him, body and soul.

Cornered by this twisted devotion, Sungwon tries to resist. But Sihyun discovers a secret Sungwon had desperately tried to keep hidden. That secret gives him even more control.

"I love you, Professor. Stay by my side. Forever."

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Mob Shisai dakedo, Kono Sekai ga Otome Game dato Kizuita node Heroine wo Ikusei shimasu
title_japanese: モブ司祭だけど、この世界が乙女ゲームだと気づいたのでヒロインを育成します

title: There Are No Bad Dogs in the World
title_english: There Are No Bad Dogs in the World
synopsis:
Hyunchul Kang is a carefree college student, down for casual hookups with anyone that catches his eye—even if they're his brother's roommate, Hyunho Ki. Even if Hyunho already has a crush on Hyunchul's brother. Trouble is, Hyunchul can't help but wonder if Hyunho sees him as a stand-in for his brother. It shouldn't matter, considering there are no feelings involved, but it's sure starting to...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Camboy: Bunny
synopsis:
Jinhong never thought he'd be brave enough to do something like cam work, and he didn't think he'd ever gain fame as "BJ Bunny." But, as great as a loyal audience is, it makes dating hard. McCain, owner of Funny Fun, had no idea his products were reviewed on stream until he was told to look into it. It was just work...until he realized an order for a local address was identical to one Bunny had just streamed. The chance to meet him is too good to pass up—but will their secrets get in the way?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Love on Air
synopsis:
Kyunghoo Ha just wants to know why he got ghosted. Things seemed great between him and his unofficial boyfriend, Wonjoon Baek, until they suddenly weren't. After two years of military service, Kyunghoo is back and he is ready to get some answers. The only problem is, Wonjoon seems game to hook up, but he doesn't want anything more. Can Kyunghoo get his elusive and mysterious ex to communicate, or will he lose the guy and his reputation by trying?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Wedding Plans for Mr. & Mr.
synopsis:
Kyungwon Yoo is a successful wedding planner. Though excellent at planning other people's weddings, he's terrible at planning his own love life and is always falling for the groom. This rings true when his one-night stand, the handsome Kangwoo Suh, becomes his new client. Despite their unexpectedly hot first meeting and their endless magnetic attraction, Kyungwon now needs to plan Kangwoo's wedding. Can Kyungwon keep his cool to design the perfect wedding? Or will he succumb to the groom's lustful advances?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Tipping Point
synopsis:
Sanho has been crushing on Euihyun since their high school days, so ending up at the same college as him feels like fate. The problem is, Euihyun doesn't remember him at all. Still, Sanho's not about to give up that easily. But how long can his one-sided puppy love last if Euihyun keeps looking the other way?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Inochigake Dummy Romance
title_english: This False Love Carries the Risk of Death
title_japanese: 命懸けダミーロマンス
synopsis:
"This guy's my lover."

Ryou quits his job after his girlfriend got him involved in a pyramid scheme. One day, when he hasn''t heard from her, he goes to her home and finds a large number of Yakuza!

Ryou is in a desperate situation when he is suspected of being in league with his girlfriend, who has absconded with money belonging to the Ooguro group, but is rescued by Miyoshi, a middle-school classmate who happens to be a member of the Ooguro group.

The two end decide to live together as fake lovers until the situation cools down, but Miyoshi, who was supposed to have been a good friend at the time, is acting quite chilly toward Ryou...?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: Jealousy Provokers
synopsis:
Jealousy Provokers is a popular channel run by Yumin Sun and Geonwoo Ma. Clients reach out when they need help figuring out their crushes' feelings, and Yumin or Geonwoo play the part of a potential love interest to gauge whether the feelings are mutual. Woori Goh's a huge fan of the show, so when she lands a job as the new manager, she couldn't be happier! But she soon realizes that seeing someone on screen is a lot different than knowing them in real life...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Gifted
synopsis:
After his career as a pro baseball coach ends in disgrace, Jung Minyong comes to Dongcheon High School to whip the baseball team into shape. With his no-nonsense teaching style, the players are pushed to their limits, and when a gifted newbie is recruited to the team, the existing players are forced to face just how much they still have to learn. With Coach Jung laying down one reality check after another, will the players call it quits? Or will it be enough motivation to let their gifts shine?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Crownless Queen
synopsis:
On the day of her retirement, history professor Jung Gwinam is hit by a bus as she pushes her daughter out of the way. When she wakes up, she finds herself in a different world, a different time, and even a different body! Now living as Delia, the protagonist of her daughter's novel, she'll have to climb the social ladder to escape life as a peasant. Despite some historical inaccuracies in this fantasy world, will Delia's extensive knowledge be enough to help her make it back to the real world?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Like a Wolf
synopsis:
In order to pay off debts, Gunt participates in an underground fighting ring. The rules are simple: fight, win, repeat.

But what Gunt begins to realize is that he's not the only one there with debts to pay and people to protect. The question is, which of these fighters is the hungriest to survive.

(Source: Tapastic)

title: If You Can't Kill Me, Love Me
title_english: If You Can't Kill Me, Love Me
synopsis:
In a kingdom scarred by a historical rebellion, Penny, an assassin masquerading as a servant, aims to break free from Queen Nyla's grasp by executing a perilous mission: the theft of the king's ring from Princess Cher, known as the wicked Princess of Death. Yet her intentions take a turn as she slowly becomes captivated by the princess. As their destinies become entwined, Penny grapples with a dilemma, torn between her pursuit of freedom and the unexpected connections she forges with Cher.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kouenji Slapstick
title_japanese: 高円寺スラップスティック
synopsis:
Hibiki inherited the detective agency that was inherited from his wealthy grandfather, along with Ukyo, who was an employee at the time. Hibiki became bored with just being a detective, so he changed the business to a handyman business, and in many ways, he and Ukyo have become like partners. One day, the two receive a request to find evidence that a husband is cheating on his wife...

(Source: MU)

title: I Work at a Witch's Mansion
title_english: I Work at a Witch's Mansion
synopsis:
"What did I get myself into?!"

Elena works at a theater troupe as a cleaner with big dreams of making it on stage. But when the troupe is disbanded overnight, she's forced to find a new job. Luckily, she stumbles upon an old mansion where she's hired as a maid. But there's something strange about the madam of the house...

(Source: Manta)

title: Only One Tomorrow
synopsis:
She's starring in the role of her lifetime.

It's 1931, and Leewon's brother has been framed. As she tries to escape with him, she's knocked out and wakes up in the 21st century. When she's then asked to play the character of On Leewon in a film, she realizes that it's the story of her own past and resolves to find out who framed her brother.

(Source: Manta)

title: W: Two Worlds
synopsis:
Who knew I'd wake up as a comic book character?

Yeonjoo, the daughter of a famous cartoonist, is a student studying medicine at Hanguk University. On her birthday, after wishing for a man like her favorite comic character, Kang Chul, Yeonjoo wakes up in Kang Chul's world. Will Yeonjoo be able to find her way out of her father's cartoon universe?

(Source: Manta)

title: Bloody Lies
synopsis:
In a world where vampires and humans coexist, orphaned Eugene seeks recognition from his enigmatic vampire progenitor, Logan. Struggling with his lack of human emotions, Eugene stumbles upon an intimate scene involving Dominic, sparking a desire to reclaim his lost humanity. To learn emotions, Eugene makes an unusual deal with Dominic, blurring lines of desire, loyalty, and sacrifice in a world where emotions are both prized and perilous.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Fake Snow
synopsis:
"Did I steal this man's lover?"

Seo Inho wakes up in a world that he doesn't recognize. He cannot speak, and can hardly move, but hears voices calling out for him...only, it's by a name he doesn't know. Realizing that he has possessed the body of Kacius of this nation's royal guard. The only person he can rely on is Kacius's former colleague and lover, Albretto Noe. Determined to not only be protected by, but to protect Albretto, Inho begins to fall deeper and deeper into the life of Kacius, until it becomes nigh impossible to differentiate who he truly is any longer...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: I'm Your Guardian Angel!
synopsis:
But I'm supposed to make you happy!

Dove has always been the black sheep among his fellow Angels-in-waiting. To finally come into his own as an official Angel, he must make his designated human happy. But his assignment, Yena Jang, is a girl who already has it all—except love. Will Dove be able to fulfill her wishes?

(Source: Manta)

title: The Invitation
synopsis:
My husband's strange friend is living with us...

On a hot summer's day, Sanghyun's wife is approached by Ingyu, an old friend of her husband's. Although she is wary of his eerie looks and strange demeanor, Ingyu quickly reconnects with her husband, moving in with the two soon after. But after they invite him in, strange things begin to happen...

(Source: Manta)

title: Fire, Flowers, Dreams
synopsis:
In his seventh life, drenched in blood, Ryu Hui-kyeom seeks only one thing—revenge.

After rescuing a shaman in distress, Ryu Hui-kyeom is granted five lives, but each one ends in a tragic death. Now, as he is reborn once more, he is driven by the relentless desire to avenge the betrayal that haunts him. However, in this seventh life, something unexpected disrupts his plans, causing events to unfold differently from the way he remembers.

"Now that we're married, whether you live or die, you are mine." By a twist of fate, Hui-kyeom becomes the favored concubine of King Jin Hyeok-wi, who shows an unsettling obsession with him.

"If you try to escape, I'll cut off your legs and keep you in the palace." Caught between the possessive love of a king and his unyielding thirst for vengeance, Hui-kyeom's quest for revenge in his seventh life takes an unforeseen turn.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Down the Rabbit Hole
synopsis:
"Why does the Dragon King seek a rabbit?"

Cheong-wan, a turtle from the Dragon King's palace, ventures onto land to retrieve the liver of a rabbit to cure the ailing king. By sheer luck, he encounters the elusive rabbit almost immediately upon arrival. Determined to bring the rabbit back to the Underwater Kingdom, Cheong-wan is prepared to do whatever it takes.

"And how will you convince me?"

"Sorry?"

"If I go to the Dragon King's palace, what will you do for me in return, Cheong-wan?"

Cheong-wan finds himself mesmerized by the rabbit Jeok-ran's playful smile and enigmatic words. He realizes that to succeed, he must go to far lengths.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Secret Lessons in Love
synopsis:
Genius commoner Rose Bell is the top student at the prestigious Benkley Academy, but when Rose's perfect grade slips, she loses her scholarship. As she despairs, Jasper, the son of a duke, makes her an irresistible offer: He'll pay her tuition in exchange for secret lessons—just the two of them.

(Source: Manta)

title: Dear, Not Cunning Witch
synopsis:
Talent doesn't always run in the family.

In an age ruled by science, there remain almighty witches with mythical powers. However, Diana ended up lacking any of her mother's witchly talent. In fact, ever since she began training at the age of 7, her only goal was to reunite with her sister. But life never turns out how we want, does it?

(Source: Manta)

title: Don't Save the Duke
synopsis:
Reborn into the life of a maid in a novel, Betty has one goal: to live a quiet and unassuming life. Unfortunately for her, at the end of the original novel Duke Janus ends up annihilating the world. Now, Betty must try to change the story and escape from the duke, who is growing ever more obsessed with her.

(Source: Manta)

title: Kyououji no Ibitsu na Shuuai: Nyotaika Knight no Totsukitooka
title_japanese: 狂王子の歪な囚愛～女体化騎士〈ナイト〉の十月十日～

title: Sunshine Shower
synopsis:
Seoyoon Moon's life has been a rollercoaster of heartaches—losing his mom, dealing with his dad's cheating, and abandoning his beloved piano. But one constant has been his best friend, Yeonjae Woo. Surprise, surprise, Seoyoon's head over heels for him, but Yeonjae already has a girlfriend. What makes it spicy? Yeonjae is all about pushing those boundaries, blurring the lines between friendship and something... deeper.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Swallowing My Darkest Desire
synopsis:
Jihyun's mastery of the blade did more than win competitions. It also made Haekyum, a sword-turned-legendary being, fall deeply in love with him. While Jihyun grapples with the loss of his little brother, Haekyum steps in to fill the void in his heart. However, things take a turn when Haekyum decides to confess his true feelings and reveal his identity. Doubt creeps in—is Haekyum just a replacement for Jihyun's brother or something more?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Bad Life
synopsis:
A thirst for revenge drags Raymond into a sinister game at his new boarding school, as he finds himself the mouse within a dorm of twisted cats who wish to devour and defile him in the worst ways imaginable.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: The Mingling Phase
synopsis:
Seo Yeonwoo is in love with his best friend, Cha Dojin, and he's afraid of letting his feelings slip, knowing it could ruin their lifelong friendship forever. But when Yeonwoo slowly distances himself from Dojin and makes friends with a new student named Baek Ha, Dojin starts developing feelings he's never experienced before. Is it simple jealousy over losing his best friend? Or is it something more?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: The Heat Between Us
synopsis:
Opposites attract, but can they handle the heat?

Guide Yehyun must oversee the volatile Aesper, Haesung, or face suspension after a drunken mishap. With Haesung's fiery temper and drug issues, their partnership is off to a rough start—but their synergy is unmatched. Can these polar opposites find common ground before everything falls apart?

(Source: Manta)

title: Get Out of My House!
synopsis:
Hong Yo-han has finally realised his dream of owning his own home. On the first day of moving in, he invites his friends over for a housewarming party and spends his first night in his new home with excitement, but unexpectedly sees a ghost. Thinking it was just a nightmare, Yohan is tormented by the ghost appearing at random times. By chance, he discovers that the clue to solving the ghost problem lies with his awkward colleague, Go Philip, and in desperation, he invites Philip into his home...

(Source: Ridi, translated)

title: Degenerate
synopsis:
While pursuing a case, Detective Ieum Kim of the Violent Crimes Unit rescues a man collapsed on a mountain trail. Stricken with amnesia, the man believes himself to be a child... Thus begins Ieum's dangerous cohabitation with a mysterious stranger.

(Source: Manta)

title: Puppy Ever After
synopsis:
Gyujin is special. He's the only son of the legendary blue-eyed German shepherd family...and he's a 26-year-old virgin. To carry on the family lineage, his parents organize an arranged marriage. However, Gyujin cannot think of getting married to a stranger, let alone a female shepherd. He impulsively decides to ruin his parents' scheming by preemptively announcing that he prefers smaller dogs. In order to cover up his lie, Gyujin asks his childhood friend Youngwoon, a small breed, to act as his boyfriend in front of his parents. Youngwoon agrees under one condition: Gyujin must act like he really has feelings for him! With such a strange demand, could Gyujin be barking up the wrong tree?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Pygmalion
synopsis:
After being petrified by Medusa, the former hero, Max, has been reduced to little more than a stone ornament in the center of town. And it took all of one week before the townsfolk were ready to toss him in the trash! Thankfully, Eden, an old party member of Max's decides to bring him home. The two never got along when Max was human, so what exactly does the reserved Eden have planned for him?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Hyakkiyakou Jikkouiinkai
title_english: Night Parade of 100 Demons Organizing Committee

title: Master of the Fox Bead
synopsis:
Lee Jinhwa lived an ordinary life until she swallowed a fox bead gifted by a mysterious peddler, mistaking it for a wish-fulfilling marble. Little did Jinhwa know that her actions would lead her to be haunted by Koo Miho, an infamous nine-tailed fox who wishes to retrieve the bead. To add fuel to the fire, Jinhwa soon discovers that she's also become a target for various spirits and demons, and the only way to extract the cause of the issue is for Miho to kill her... or kiss her!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Subway Line 1
synopsis:
The world has come to chaos. An unknown virus haunts every living soul, and one man is determined to reach his beloved before it's too late. His journey takes him closer and closer, but he faces adversity and strife. That's when he faces reality. He sees the world around him. He sees a world faced with something more dangerous than the virus.

(Source: Tapastic)

title: Your Eyes, My Words
synopsis:
"Every day, I ravenously awaited those 30 minutes"... Hwane is studious, careful, and serious. Jinha is popular, cool, and fun. They seemed so different, and yet, throughout high school, they secretly met up for silent, passionate encounters. Hwane treasured these moments—until he is betrayed by Jinha's denial of him to their classmates. It haunts him even into adulthood. When chance brings them back together, will it restart their hot love or will they both be burned in disaster?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kimajime na Yuutousei wa, Sensei dake no Mesu ni Naritai.
title_english: A serious honor student wants to be the teacher's only female.
title_japanese: 生真面目な優等生は、先生だけのメスになりたい。

title: Idol no Watashi ga Aitsu no Sex Friend ni Natta Hi
title_japanese: アイドルの私があいつのセフレになった日

title: Owan-chan no Haranbanjou Men
title_japanese: おわんちゃんの波瀾万丈麺
synopsis:
Life at a ramen shop is never dull! Owan runs the neighborhood ramen spot called "Power Bomb." Just as she was praying for some hungry hero to save her struggling business, in walks...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Ippai Dashite Ii desu yo
title_japanese: いっぱいだしていいですよ

title: Nee... Oniisan Shimasen ka
title_japanese: ねぇ…お兄さんしませんか

title: Mama no Naka ni Iretemiru?
title_japanese: ママの中に入れてみる？

title: Beneath the Peach Tree
synopsis:
Being with you is a risk I'm willing to take.

On New Year's Eve, Doa, the daughter of an aristocrat, spends a romantic night with the nobleman who saved her life. However, he disappears the next day, and Doa fears she'll never see him again... That is until she sees him working in a butcher shop! Is the man Doa fell for not who she thought he was?

(Source: Manta)

title: Fight for My Way
synopsis:
Don't settle. Fight for your dreams!

Dongman dreamed of becoming a national taekwondo athlete. Aera wanted to become a successful news anchor. But who has time for childhood aspirations when there are bills to be paid? Follow Dongman and Aera in their fight to find love and success within the harsh realities of life.

(Source: Manta)

title: Inferiority Complex
synopsis:
Three years ago, Han Seojun walked away from both the stage and the man he loved. To the public, he was nothing more than "the decent supporting role standing next to actor Choi Seunghyeon." To Seojun, the humiliation of being overshadowed by his partner, and the pain of leaving him behind, was enough to end his career altogether.

Now, at 29, Seojun's world is far removed from the spotlight. He waits tables at a bar, scraping by on wages that disappear into debts and the money he dutifully sends to his parents in the countryside. His dreams are long buried, his heart heavier than his empty wallet.

And then Seunghyeon appears again. Not as a memory, but in the flesh, standing in Seojun's workplace, urging him to act on stage once more.

The man he loved. The career he abandoned. Both return at once, reopening wounds Seojun thought would never bleed again.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: One Step Away from Happiness
synopsis:
"Please wait for me. Just one more year!"

Bina and Heewoon have known each other since childhood. Now a third-year resident at Hyemun Hospital, she's shocked when he suddenly confesses his feelings for her. The problem? Their 10-year age gap! Will Bina be able to overcome her confusion and get one step closer to happiness?

(Source: Manta)

title: If You Can Hear My Song
title_english: If You Can Hear My Song
synopsis:
A great escape from an island town!

Two girls living different lives find their paths cross on an island—Seora, a transfer student from Seoul, and Bada, an islander who's never left the island. One thing they have in common is the desire to get away, which leads them to join forces in an escape plan from the island.

(Source: Manta)

title: Keeping My Boss on a Tight Leash
title_english: Keeping My Boss on a Tight Leash
synopsis:
Tangled up in some hairy business.

Office worker Nahee is working late when she gets caught in the crossfire between her boss and a would-be assassin. She's dragged into the secret world of human-animal shapeshifters, and it turns out her boss imprinted on her?! The two can't stand being together but can no longer bear being apart!

(Source: Manta)

title: Full Book
synopsis:
Choi Jaeseung has spent years indulging in one-night stands with BDSM partners, always as a willing masochist. But during a model casting, he suddenly comes face-to-face with the very person who awakened that desire in him: his high school senior, Min Hoyeon. After 13 years, Hoyeon has returned as Eli, a mysterious top model from the U.S.—and he wastes no time forcing his way back into Jaeseung’s body and life. What begins as unwanted contact spirals into a dangerous reunion where desire, power, and old wounds collide.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Toying with Daddy
synopsis:
Growing up with a silver spoon, Rosa has lived a flawless life as the perfect modern-day princess. She's always gotten everything she wanted—except for one thing: Kim Yeonwoo, the boy from the orphanage who once slipped through her fingers. 

Ten years later, starved for something to stir her restless heart, Rosa finally sees Yeonwoo again. But there's just one problem...he's now the man by her mother's side. Though she knows it's a dangerous love she can never have, Rosa can't resist toying with her new father-to-be, both in body and in mind...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: One of Three
synopsis:
Myeongha's beloved boyfriend Taeon—her pride and everything—has died, leaving behind a will addressed to his friend Jeongu: "I leave all my assets to my beloved girlfriend." But there's a twist—Taeon had not one, but three girlfriends. Under Jeongu's supervision, a quiet yet intense battle unfolds. With 3 billion won at stake, only one can inherit it all. Who will emerge as the "beloved girlfriend," and what truths will surface as each woman stakes her claim?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: One and Only
synopsis:
Ten years ago, Yeonju left Eunseong, the man she loved, to protect his budding career. Now a stylist and devoted single mom to her son, Hanbyeol, she's shocked to learn that the lead actor of her next film is the very man she walked away from...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Breed Me, Snakeboys
synopsis:
In a world where elite hybrids are groomed to become the perfect members of society, the prestigious Hybrid Academy trains its students to be poised, graceful, and ruthlessly rational—never swayed by primal instincts.

But not everyone plays by the rules.

Mo Danbok, 29. Towering at over 190 cm, he's a top-tier bodyguard known for his strength and skill. Though respected in his field, as a branch family member, everything he's built could be taken away with a single word from the main bloodline.

Then one day, a command arrives: "Protect the Sa Clan's direct heirs."

Summoned before the clan head, Danbok is handed a file. Inside—two names, two photos, and two absurdly beautiful faces that look more like artwork than people.

But looks can be deceiving. These aren't fragile ornaments—They're the cold-blooded, unpredictable heirs of the snake-blooded Sa Clan... and Danbok's new job is to keep them alive.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: My Stepson Is My New Alpha
title_english: My Stepson Is My New Alpha
title_japanese: 새 알파 아들, 헌 오메가 아버지
synopsis:
When Eunwoo marries his alpha coworker, Taejoon, he's ready for his own happily ever after. But all that changes when, one day, Taejoon brings home Joowon, his son from his former omega partner. Though Eunwoo accepts and raises Joowon as his child, the marriage takes a turn, and after the divorce, Joowon is sent abroad. Ten years later, Joowon shows up, claiming he one-sidedly imprinted on Eunwoo!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Bitten and Bound
synopsis:
Guide Heo Yoonjae thought he was done with the field after losing his esper to a brutal rampage, but fate seems to have other plans. On a trip to the Guiding Center for a one-day commission, Yoonjae finds himself faced with Woo Sanghyuk, an A-rank esper with a god complex and a reputation for blowing through guides like tissues. But Yoonjae isn't just any old guide, and he refuses to let an uppity young esper call the shots. Once Sanghyuk gets a taste of real guiding, he'll be putty in the palm of Yoonjae's hand. Or so he hopes, anyway.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: At Your Service
synopsis:
Kyuha's been hopelessly crushing on Woohyun ever since their freshman orientation. But at a drinking party, he hears a devastating rumor: queen bee Hyejin got to him first! Heartbroken and drunk out of his mind, Kyuha stumbles home, slips into a lacy maid outfit and racy lingerie, and takes some very questionable photos. He then sends some explicit messages to Woohyun via what he thinks is a anonymous burner account—only to wake up the next morning to see it was his real account after all! But Woohyun doesn't seem to mind...in fact, he seems more than happy to take Kyuha up on his offer!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Black, Venom
synopsis:
Baek Heon, the ruthless CEO of the criminal syndicate Yusu, finds himself under investigation by prosecutor Seol Jihun for allegedly plotting to assassinate a congressman.

Inside the interrogation room, Baek Heon becomes instantly captivated by Jihun and makes a chilling decision. If he's going to hell, he's taking this good-looking prosecutor down with him.

Jihun's life is soon upended. Framed for crimes he didn't commit, he ends up behind bars, his once-promising future shattered.
