But Baek Heon isn't done yet. For a man who confesses his deepest desire is to ruin a prosecutor, he's more than ready to drag Jihun into his world of obsession and poison—and Jihun might just be daring enough to see how far he'll fall.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: My Secret XXX Fanfic
synopsis:
After years of training, Kim Ryeo-dam finally made his idol debut. Though not the most popular member of his group, he had his own reason for staying: a quiet, persistent crush on his teammate, Cha Jinwon.

One night, alone at home, Ryeo-dam stumbled upon a spicy fanfic featuring himself and Jinwon. The story stirred something in him, and he slipped into the bathroom for a moment of release. But just as he emerged, flustered and breathless, he came face to face with Jinwon, who had returned early and seen everything.

Jinwon didn't get angry. Instead, he teased, his voice laced with curiosity and something unreadable. Ryeo-dam's mind raced to recover, but before he could stop himself, the words tumbled out.

"What if we tried it... for real?"

Regret hit him the second the words left his mouth. But Jinwon didn't laugh or step back. He simply leaned in and pressed a soft kiss to Ryeo-dam's cheek. And what brushed against Ryeo-dam's thigh wasn't just Jinwon's leg. He was hard.

(Source:

title: My Home as a Filming Location!
title_english: My Home as a Filming Location!
synopsis:
A young beekeeper in the countryside, Yeonwoo spends his free time drinking out of frustration. That is until he gets too drunk to remember signing a contract to rent out his house as a filming location for a variety show. Now Yeonwoo finds himself sharing space with kind and handsome star actor Dojun Kang. Will this city transplant and country mouse's budding bromance survive beyond 10 days of shooting?

(Source: Manta)

title: Oaiko.
synopsis:
High school student Kiyoharu has a cute girlfriend and is at the top of the caste system. However, he feels suffocated by the fact that he has to hide himself and suppress his true feelings.

Then he becomes friends with Mizuki, a member of the library board, because of a secret they share. With Mizuki, he's able to reveal his true self, and the two become closer and closer. Gradually, he begins to prioritize his time with Mizuki over his girlfriend...

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

title: The Taming of the Hellcat
synopsis:
She was forced to marry. Now, her husband wants a divorce. Leah retreats to a secluded villa to regroup—only to be saved from danger by a mysterious leopard. But the wild creature is no ordinary beast; he's Januk, a shape-shifting imperial prince, and taming him might be the start of something wild.

(Source: Manta)

title: Words & Kisses
synopsis:
She was the one I'd been looking for.

Just as I was about to get into another ambiguous, half-hearted relationship, I met her. Go Hyunjin. I couldn't take my eyes off her. I had been treading a dull path, and she knocked me right off. Then I felt it—a little piece of my heart, breaking off and slipping away. "She's so pretty..."

(Source: Manta)

title: The Iron Inside
synopsis:
Love and survival beneath the sand.

Baekgi awakens in a world engulfed in sand after being cryogenically frozen. She joins Spear and Shield, a unit entrusted with protecting the bunker, and begins training under her senior officer, Ibaek. They must fight to survive in this new world amidst sudden epidemics and monster attacks...

(Source: Manta)

title: The Dragon and the Prince
synopsis:
Against all odds, a stray arrow sparks love.

While hunting, young dragon Seolru mistakenly shoots a person. The unintended target is Ryun, Crown Prince of the Cloud Dragon Kingdom, who had been trapped in the area by the empress. Upon realizing that Seolru is not an assassin, Ryun takes her to his kingdom, where love is soon to blossom.

(Source: Manta)

title: Spring and Winter
synopsis:
Outed in high school?!

In the middle of the night, high schooler Jungyoon sends a teary text to her ex-girlfriend in the hopes of winning her back. But much to her horror, she discovers that she's actually sent it to Doyoung, the most anti-social girl in her class! Will she be outed at school?!

(Source: Manta)

title: World of Ten Billion
synopsis:
Will Heaven triumph or will the fairies conquer all?

A siren prince, Heaven has it all—talent, beauty, and powerful abilities. But one day, the fairies attack and he's forced into hiding, dressing as a woman and selling snake oil to get by. The surviving sirens dream of revenge and the return of their royalty... but Heaven's got other plans.

(Source: Manta)

title: Falling
synopsis:
This is a story of two women who found each other in the dark underbelly of a criminal organization.

Seungji has been a member of a crime syndicate where intrigue, betrayal, and violence are the norm. After getting double-crossed by her boss, she decides to lay low and joins an illegal trafficking gang as an underling. Yeongwon, who grew up mostly alone, has a chance encounter with an aunt who runs a criminal organization.

The aunt sends Yeongwon to Busan, where she's tasked with managing an office full of low-lives working for the trafficking network. As Seungji helps out the innocent and somewhat dim-witted Yeongwon, she always looks for a chance to hit it big and run away from the gang. Seungji trusts no one. She believes she should cheat others first to avoid being taken advantage of. On the other hand, Yeongwon vows she'll never betray the person she falls in love with. The two women who had never been loved slowly fall for each other.

(Source: Manta)

title: Nine
synopsis:
Time travel that messed everything up.

After discovering a mystery incense stick, Sela finds out that she can travel back in time by lighting the incense stick. With her new ability, Sela saves her mother and thinks she's finally found her happy ending. However, she realizes that her time-traveling ability comes with a price when she finds out that her first love Yijoon is now dating her best friend...

(Source: Manta)

title: Tendering Resignation
synopsis:
Three women, one messy love triangle!

Geumhee has always felt safe and comfortable working at her best friend Taeri's company. But everything changes when Bora comes and stirs things up—Taeri suddenly goes into hiding, and Geumhee gets thrown into the middle of... a police investigation and a messy lesbian love triangle!

(Source: Manta)

title: The Scarecrows
synopsis:
The fate of an unfaithful husband.

Mr. Kim has lived alone ever since his wife mysteriously fell off a cliff. Her body was never found, and Mr. Kim believes that she is still out there. On a dark, pouring day, Mr. Kim revisits the site of her presumed death. On his search for her, he comes across an old man that creates scarecrows for "souls"...

(Source: Manta)

title: Don't Fall In Love!
synopsis:
Helplessly falling in love at first sight.

Junghyun is a girl who easily gets carried away by her feelings. On her first day of work as a manager for actress Joo Heera, she falls head over heels for her! Junghyun can't afford to lose her job, but her heart melts every time she sees Heera's face. Will she be able to hide her feelings?

(Source: Manta)

title: Kaijuu 8-gou Tokubetsu-hen: Hoshina no Kyuujitsu
title_japanese: 怪獣8号特別編 保科の休日
synopsis:
The bonus episode included with the Kaijuu 8-gou movie is now a manga one-shot! How will the rookies of the third division deal with mysterious Vice-Captain Hoshina and the secrets of his day off?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Muchi Nochi Tsugai
synopsis:
When Hayato, an omega, hears about the concept of fated mates from his friends, he jokingly says that he would meet his if he could. On his train ride home one day, he suddenly smells something sweet and wonders if it's the pheromones of his fated mate. Sadly, he doesn't find that person in the crowd, but little does he know that Asahi, an alpha, is there and smells the same sweet scent.

(Source: GOT, translated)

title: Briefing
synopsis:
When news anchor Eunseong Kang meets the enigmatic Woojin Jeong, an unexpected connection pulls them into each other’s orbit. He’s a man trapped in a life that never ends; she chases meaning in fleeting moments. Their encounter feels less like coincidence—and more like fate.

(Source: Manta)

title: Carnal Instincts
synopsis:
Damian is a powerful duke with a demihuman condition that makes him averse to human scents. So when he sees Kanna—a girl sold into slavery by her own family—at an auction, he cannot resist buying her. Will this attraction grow into love, or remain a mere carnal instinct?

(Source: Manta)

title: Cloth and Dagger
synopsis:
Just who are you really, Father?

Agent Sijun Han is working undercover as a priest in Russia when he meets Anna, a Korean woman in the care of the church. The encounter stirs long-forgotten memories from his past, but as their relationship blossoms, the true target of Sijun's operation begins to emerge from the shadows...

(Source: Manta)

title: One Last Night With My Soon-to-Be Ex-Husband
title_english: One Last Night With My Soon-to-Be Ex-Husband
synopsis:
Bellia, the unfortunate Grand Duchess fated to die at the hands of her dangerous husband, planned to endure her loveless marriage just long enough to get a divorce. But before she could leave, one unexpected night changes everything.

(Source: Manta)

title: Grace in Wonderland
synopsis:
Grace Gurton has her eyes on Richard Spencer, captain of the rugby team. Despite his narcissism, she can't help but pine for him. Then one day, Grace gets an unexpected adoption offer from Richard's aunt, Mary Montague. Can Grace navigate her feelings for Richard now that she's part of the family?

(Source: Manta)

title: Before Autumn Comes
synopsis:
At 29, Eunseong is told she'll die by autumn. She skips chemo, quits her job, leaves her mother's house, and dyes her hair for the first time in her life. Then, on a whim, she adds one last thing: a night with a stranger who prefers no-strings-attached encounters. She decides to stay with him until autumn—when her time runs out.

(Source: Manta)

title: Please Shoot Me
synopsis:
During a mission gone wrong, Yeon Yoo's subordinate Ryoong is infected with the zombie virus—but he's... different. He doesn't hunger for flesh. He doesn't turn mindless. The only thing he seems to be craving is... Yeon. If he's not a zombie, then what could he have possibly turned into?

(Source: Manta)

title: The Daddy Dilemma
synopsis:
Who's my baby daddy?!

After her coming-of-age ceremony, Lisian wakes up to find her room a mess. She's shocked that she seemingly had a wild night with a stranger, but even more shocked to learn she's pregnant! Now the question is—who's the father? Her childhood friend, the crown prince, or a younger brother-like figure?

(Source: Manta)

title: The Fantastic Spinsters' Association of Joseon
title_english: The Fantastic Spinsters' Association of Joseon
synopsis:
No husband? No problem!

A group of plucky, unmarried women is stirring up trouble in Joseon, a land of conservative and traditional values. The goal: make money and solve crimes! The ladies of the Spinsters' Association, along with womanizer Eunho, set about investigating the mysterious disappearances of local women...

(Source: Manta)

title: The Commencement of Us
synopsis:
Fed up with being treated like a child, Han Yeseo asks her husband, Seo Jiheon, for a divorce on the day she graduates from college. Although Yeseo wanted to move on from her first love, Jiheon refuses and instead offers to truly show her what being husband and wife is all about.

(Source: Manta)

title: Reincarnation Laundry
synopsis:
Life on spin cycle, or hung out to dry?

Sangah's life becomes a living hell after meeting the mysterious Yacheon, who places a curse on her. She quits her job and returns to her hometown where she discovers a dry cleaner run by Chungmyeong, to whom her destiny is tied. The two must unravel their red thread of fate and save Sangah's soul.

(Source: Manta)

title: How to Survive Secretary Hong
synopsis:
During a terrorist attack, CEO Junghoon is saved by a soldier named Jang Hayoon. Determined to find her, he hires ex-special forces Jiwoo as his secretary. As they clash and grow closer, a hidden truth and a corporate plot threaten everything. Can Jiwoo protect Junghoon while keeping her secret?

(Source: Manta)

title: To Tread into Darkness
synopsis:
Beomyoon, a cursed prince, weds Chunghee, a lame, twice-wed woman used as a living talisman. The jaded prince finds himself consumed by love for this princess, who is nothing more than a pawn in a scramble for power. To protect her, he'll seize the throne and drown the world in vengeance.

(Source: Manta)

title: Here Comes the Wrong Groom
synopsis:
The talented and hardworking Bitt Geum learns her fiancé cheated—just a month before their wedding! Desperate and furious, she proposes to rookie developer Haneul to spite her ex, only to find out he's the brother of her company's CEO. Just how will this chaotic office relationship turn out?

(Source: Manta)

title: Terminus
synopsis:
It's hard for omegas to find jobs, but Song Hayoon does the best he can. He spends all his time on part-time jobs just so he can pay back his father's debts. It's not easy, but he makes it work... but sometimes he wonders if there ever will be an escape out of this never-ending vicious cycle of a life. Then one day, he comes to learn that the prestigious Taewon Group has taken over all his debts. And none other than the Executive Vice President, Kang Hyun-tae, comes to offer him a job... as his personal boytoy. Will this put an end to Hayoon's troubles, or will it be the start of his new misery?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Dream Team Retsuden
synopsis:
1-2. Shaquille O'Neal Monogatari
3-4. Reggie Miller Monogatari

title: Sonna Koi.
synopsis:
Yuzune, a cupid, has just been lazing around reading romance manga instead of hooking couples up. God gives him an ultimatum to get Sumire and Yuuji together, or he's fired. Should be a breeze for a cupid who knows all the romantic cliches, but Sumire has other ideas...?

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Deliver Us to Evil
synopsis:
In a quiet, remote countryside, a seemingly devout priest named Michael lives a peaceful life—until an incubus named Az appears before him.

Az threatens to expose Michael's darkest secret unless he offers up his life energy. Left with no choice, Michael spends a night with the demon... only to discover Az's unexpected weakness in the midst of their sinful encounter.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Forbidden Fruit
synopsis:
Devout and gentle-hearted, Agatho firmly believes in the power of piety. When he met Noah six years ago, he instantly felt that leading the quiet boy towards religion would do him the world of good. His instincts were right—now, Noah has become an invaluable member of the church. While Agatho is proud of how Noah has changed, sometimes he does feel uncomfortable with the amount of trust the boy showers upon him. After all, the line between blind trust and dogged obsession is very, very thin...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Stepping Into Trouble
synopsis:
Eunsu is not happy that his mother's new boyfriend has sons—a pair of twins at that. What was his mother thinking leaving out that important bit of information?! And when his mother tells him she might just marry the man, Eunsu is dead against it. But Eunsu's trouble ensues when the twins are more than determined to win their new 'hyung' over and lend him a helping hand to change his mind. Will Eunsu give in and be bound to them in more-than-familial ties, or will he stay steadfast in his decision?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Under the Moonlight
synopsis:
As the formidable vampire lord, Ayla is more than capable of concocting whatever evil schemes he desires. But he would much rather spend his time gallivanting across the continent causing trouble for both demons and humans alike. Which is why even after he's finally returned home after 17 years, he's delighted to be greeted by a dark aggressive assassin out for his neck rather than peace and quiet. However, upon closer look, Ayla discovers something much more unexpected about this mystery man. The first is that he's been hypnotized, and the second is...this man's body is completely Ayla's type!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Egg: Watashi, Anata no Kodomo desu.
title_japanese: egg わたし、あなたの子どもです。
synopsis:
In the year 20XX, with the declining birthrate and recognition of same-sex marriage, compensated third-party egg and sperm donation has been legalized. In a world where anyone can pay to "make" a child using other people's eggs or sperm, how will the shape of the family change?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Hajimete no Sex Friend
synopsis:
My first "friends-with-benefits" was also the first person I ever fell in love with.

Kiyotaka Sano and Tamaki Aihara—two people with basically zero romantic experience—match by happenstance on a dating app and end up becoming FWB. They both fall for each other. But they each convince themselves that if they don't keep acting like "calm, casual adults," the other will toss them aside. So even as they keep sleeping together... they can't seem to let their hearts get any closer...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Their Obsession Will Ruin Me
synopsis:
I woke up in a strange place, with only a phone to guide me. To recover my memories and return home, I had to raise my targets' affection levels and unlock a special ending. But once a target has over five hearts, it triggers overheat—and a dangerous, unhinged ending awaits. It's a delicate balance!

(Source: Manta)

title: Charlotte's Wheel
synopsis:
One hundred years after the defeat of the Twilight Witch, the Aurum Empire's "witch of the old castle," Vivian Dampierre, is accused of killing her adopted younger sister Charlotte. But just as the rebellion kills her trusted knight Ian and threatens to burn her at the stake, Vivian is transported three years back in time by the mysterious Twilight Witch. With this second chance, will Vivian survive to uncover the Twilight Witch's secret identity and turn the wheel of fate once more?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Devil's Tango
synopsis:
Daegun Gal is a salaryman currently suffering from long night shifts and little pay. Then, one night, a devil appeared and claims to know him personally?! This is the story of a man and the devil that swept him off his feet.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo
synopsis:
In 2086, Naunax, an extraterrestrial mothership carrying 50 thousand life-forms calling themselves Simurians, appears above Earth. Simurians possess powers similar to those of Japan's jujutsu sorcerers, and thus all diplomatic negotiations are redirected to the Japanese, who are tasked with assessing whether coexistence is possible.

Though facing a special grade incident rivaling Sukuna Ryoumen's attack 68 years prior, humanity welcomes the aliens—for now. Fearing that these powerful beings could declare war, Japan agrees for a Simurian envoy to accompany jujutsu sorcerers to school and missions. Two teenage sorcerers—Yuuka and Tsurugi Okkotsu, siblings and grandchildren of the late Yuuta Okkotsu and Maki Zenin—are chosen to team up with Marulu "Maru" Val Vol Yelvori, a friendly, three-eyed Simurian. As both sides withhold crucial details yet want eventual harmony, it falls to Yuuka, Tsurugi, and Maru to maintain the fragile peace and prevent mutual ruin.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Release Your Persona
synopsis:
As a top-tier film star, Jaegyu is no stranger to the spotlight or the toxic rumors that follow it. Exhausted by the public eye, he has become a professional at pushing people away. That changes when he meets his neighbor, Cheongrok, a counselor at a psychiatry office. Cheongrok does not recognize the star and treats him like anyone else. Intrigued by this normal treatment, Jaegyu finds himself drawn to the one man unimpressed by his fame. Despite his long career, Jaegyu has never experienced romance, not even through a script. So is he finally ready for the real thing?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Layers
synopsis:
Mia has a special talent which she didn't know she had until recently. If she concentrates, she can transfer in another dimension called "Layers". That dimension has no people except those that can transfer of course and... The monsters that lurk there! If you accidentally get trapped in "Layers" your only hope is... The Special Class!

(Source: MU)

title: Layers: Anarchy
synopsis:
They have a plan to replace the whole town with a fake ones from Layers. Will the special class be able to stop them?

(Source: MU)

title: When I Met You
synopsis:
Nineteen years ago, Jungwon took in a scrawny girl named Hyejun, seemingly abandoned in the middle of the road, out of pity. It began as mere compassion, but what he couldn't have realized back then... was that this pitiful girl would become the woman who would steal his heart.

(Source: Manta)

title: Obscene Contract
synopsis:
Hana is a strategic analyst for a baseball team who has had a crush on Jinhwon, a major league pitcher, since high school. To her pleasant surprise, she finds out he will return to play in Korea for a year—for her employer, the Black Hawks!

But when she learns of the real reason for his return, she feels hurt and betrayed, so she uses it as leverage to force him into a contractual relationship. The terms? He must have sex with her 10 times so that she can get over him. What she doesn't know is that he has a strong case of OCD and is repulsed by any sort of physical touch. And what he doesn't know is that their first experience will absolutely blow him away. 

(Source: Manta)

title: Some Hairy Business
synopsis:
Who knew dating could be so hairy?

After waking up from a night of drinking, Yeonhee is shocked to find herself in the bed of the hottest guy at school, Saeksi Ahn! And apparently she gave him a Brazilian wax?! Saeksi gives her an ultimatum—tell everyone they slept together and start dating, or he'll reveal their hairy business!

(Source: Manta)

title: The Future Is Wild Comic-ban: Kyoui no Shinka wo Togeta 2-okunengo no Seimei Sekai
title_japanese: フューチャー・イズ・ワイルド コミック版: 驚異の進化を遂げた2億年後の生命世界
synopsis: An adaptation of the 2002 miniseries The Future Is Wild.

title: Even If...
synopsis:
Even if it isn't love, it's still you.

Woohyun lives life on autopilot as a high-ranking member of a crime syndicate. But all that changes when his sister, conned by her boyfriend, commits suicide. Wanting revenge, Woohyun targets the boyfriend's sister, Yoohwa. But as their lives collide, she slowly weakens his resolve... and his heart.

(Source: Manta)

title: Before It's Too Late
synopsis:
Are we really friends? Or are we something else?

Seohee and Eunho have known one another for 15 years, and they've always been each other's top priority. Their relationship blurs the line between friends, family, soulmates, and lovers. But one day, it comes to a tipping point when Seohee suddenly declares, "Eunho, I can't do this anymore."

(Source: Manta)

title: Lucky Metal
synopsis:
Sure, people change... But this much?!

"Hey, Jina! It's me, Daesoo!" Be it love or life, 23-year-old Jina has never been lucky. After going through her sixth breakup, Jina's mom tells her a childhood friend is coming to stay with them. But Jina is in for a shock when she sees that her old crybaby pal has become... a death-metal rocker?!

(Source: Manta)

title: Check In to My Heart
synopsis:
My boss wasn't supposed to fall for me!

Ajin, the newest intern at the ritzy HU Hotel, seems to have it all: looks, intelligence, and money. But when Seolmin, the CEO, discovers that she's living in the basement of his hotel, Ajin desperately makes a deal with him to avoid getting kicked out. But this deal might change her life forever!

(Source: Manta)

title: The Many Seasons of Food
synopsis:
The delicious joys of living in the countryside.

Tired of the hustle and bustle of city life, Minyeong decides to move back home—to the middle of nowhere. With delicious food, romance, and a bottle of good whiskey, she soon starts to rediscover the joys of living a simple life.

(Source: Manta)

title: Love Order
synopsis:
He suddenly looks like a snack!

Just dumped, Eva turns to the comfort of food to heal her broken heart. But little does she know that her childhood friend, James, may just be the comfort she needs! Can James help Eva cook up a cure for heartbreak? Or will it be a recipe for disaster?

(Source: Manta)

title: Once Upon a Small Town
synopsis:
Who said rural life is peaceful?

Tricked by his grandfather, city boy Jiyool stumbles into Heedong village and is now the local vet. Nothing seems to go right for him in his new life, until in a sudden turn of events he is reunited with his childhood crush. Will he survive this bumpy ride on country roads?

(Source: Manta)

title: Kurumizawa Yoshihiko no Gukou
synopsis:
The year is 1971 and the once popular manga artist Kurumizawa is in a major slump. The pressure builds as each new submission is rejected. But one day, he meets a young, promising artist named Hata. When he sees Hata's wonderful work, Kurumizawa hatches a dark plan...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Kurumizawa Yoshihiko no Gukou
synopsis:
The year is 1971 and the once popular manga artist Kurumizawa is in a major slump. The pressure builds as each new submission is rejected. But one day, he meets a young, promising artist named Hata. When he sees Hata's wonderful work, Kurumizawa hatches a dark plan...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: 200% in Love
synopsis:
Rule #1: Don't reveal your identity

Sarang may be a loner at work, but in the MMORPG game Black Star, she's a charismatic hero! So when the toxic Black Peng steals her thunder as the strongest player, she begins to feel conflicted. Now the search is on—is Black Peng the new Art Director, Junghoon? Or her childhood friend, Joonyoung?

(Source: Manta)

title: Flash Behavior
synopsis:
Can Yuli save humanity?!

Eaters—intelligent creatures from outer space that prey on Earthlings. Problem is, even though they look like humans, no one knows how to talk with them! Enter Yuli, the only known human to date who can communicate with the Eaters. Can Yuli save the world AND her love life?

(Source: Manta)

title: I Don't Recommend Making a Mistake with Your Male Friend
synopsis:
"You spent the night with the guy who was your childhood friend??!"

From the obstetrics office to high school, I spent most of my life together with him, Ji Seo-jun. Thanks to his dazzling good looks, I, Moon Da-yul, his best friend, had to endure a difficult school time and swore I would never get involved with him again. But... after getting drunk, I woke up in a strange hotel room, and next to me was Ji Seo-jun! Can our 29-year friendship survive?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Shape of the Future
synopsis:
Don't open Pandora's box.

Estranged daughter Som discovers a mysterious box in her mother's closet after she falls ill and is hospitalized. Upon accidentally opening the box, Som meets a strange woman who introduces herself as a grim reaper. Just who is this mysterious woman and what is her connection to Som's mother?

(Source: Manta)

title: Justice Now!
synopsis:
For those fighting discrimination.

Why does systemic discrimination go unnoticed? Who are the people who stand to benefit from hatred? What if remaining neutral ultimately means you're siding with the oppressors? Follow this story about discrimination, equality, and the fight for justice through the eyes of four different characters!

(Source: Manta)

title: Yamiochi Last Boss Reijou no Osananajimi ni Tensei shita. Ore ga Shindara Bad End Kakutei nanode Saikyou ni Natta kedo, Mou Yamiochi "Yandere-ka" shitemasen ka?
title_japanese: 闇堕ちラスボス令嬢の幼馴染に転生した。俺が死んだらバッドエンド確定なので最強になったけど、もう闇堕ち【ヤンデレ化】してませんか?
synopsis:
"If you were to disappear... I might just lose myself."

Arcs is reborn into the world of the wildly popular otome game Celestia Kingdom. He thought he was just a background character—until it's revealed he's actually the childhood friend of the final boss! Determined to avoid the bad ending, he throws himself into his daily life as her servant. But it seems the true cause of her descent into darkness is... her childhood friend!?

An unpredictable tale of master and servant, between a slightly (maybe more than slightly?) yandere heroine and an obliviously overpowered protagonist, begins...!

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)

title: I Lived in a Shelter
synopsis:
The journey to overcoming abuse.

Haram is running away from home for the third time. After struggling with life in a dormitory, she's decided to stay at a shelter for homeless adolescents. Haram is worried about living with others while managing her depression and trauma... but she's determined to find happiness.

(Source: Manta)

title: The Cradle of the Enemy
synopsis:
After her father's treason led to the downfall of her family, Evelyn Ophrose lived in hiding until her childhood friend, Ian Callician, rescued her. While at first she's relieved, Evelyn slowly realizes Ian isn't the sweet boy she once knew, and is now trapped in his cradle of seduction and lies.

(Source: Manta)

title: My Desert Bloom
synopsis:
While struggling with hardships in her life, Yuna meets mysterious Iyun at a bar. The night she spent with him was supposed to be a fleeting moment. But fate, or rather Iyun, had other plans—for his meeting with her was far from a coincidence.

(Source: Manta)

title: Peony Elegy: Winter
synopsis:
Can I survive in this imperial palace under the greedy and fearful women of the Sword of the Fugung?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Peony Elegy: No Return
synopsis: Tells the story of the palace 20 years before Peony Elegy: Winter.

title: Please Stop Following Me, ML!
synopsis:
One day, I realized I had been reincarnated as the protagonist's friend in a tragic novel—one where I was doomed to die while trying to save the heroine. Determined to change my fate, I decided to tell the heroine everything... but for some reason, my words were censored, as if the universe itself was blocking spoilers! Frustrated, I stormed into the forbidden forest and shouted my secrets into the void—venting my anger at the male lead while I was at it.

It should've been fine. No one was supposed to hear me. Yet somehow, rumors spread like wildfire that the powerful Duke Vishvaltz was... into men?! Now, he's launching a full-blown investigation to find the source of the absurd gossip.

"...Your voice is quite unforgettable."

...Yep. My life is officially over.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Another Sunny Day
synopsis:
Dobin, the handsome art student, finds himself in the midst of heartbreak and wonders if he'll ever be able to get a good night's rest since his breakup. Jae-hee, the flower shop owner, has never fallen in love in his life and is uncertain if he'll ever find the one. What will happen when these two unlikely people cross paths? Will they find the answers in each other?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Bait
synopsis:
Prosecutor Hyeon Taesik is assigned to the infamous "Haemu Serial Murder Case," the same case in which his twin brother, Hyeon Minsik, was brutally killed.

During the investigation, Taesik encounters Mu Inhui, a priest and the prime suspect. Despite his growing suspicions, Taesik finds himself inexplicably drawn to Inhui.

Unbeknownst to him, everything has been orchestrated by Inhui—and Taesik is walking right into his trap...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Confessions of a Male Celeb
synopsis:
In a suspicious car accident, Seo Jiwoon's sister dies while top actor Cha Taehyuk walks off unscathed. While trying to uncover the truth, Jiwoon is also hit by a car. However, when he opens his eyes, Jiwoon realizes he has traveled back in time to his first day of work. Will this opportunity to work together with Cha Taehyuk be the perfect opportunity to avenge his sister's death?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Dreaminess
synopsis:
Nam Heeyeon has been having strange but steamy dreams with various men, from strangers to childhood friends! However, he doesn't mind these vivid fantasies and wakes up feeling content every morning. One day, he encounters Seongjun, someone he thought had only existed in his dreams. From there, his life gets entangled with all the men he'd been dreaming about, including his cousin Inhu, his childhood friend Hoyeon, and the mysterious Seokju. Amidst all the chaos, can Heeyeon take control of his situation, or will it sweep him away?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainiment)

title: Ura Kagyou Tensei: Moto Gokudou ga Kazoku no Tame ni Ryouchi Hatten sasemasu ga Nanika? @comic
title_japanese: 裏稼業転生～元極道が家族の為に領地発展させますが何か?～@COMIC
synopsis:
A yakuza who lived his entire life as a lone wolf is reincarnated into another world as Ryuu, the third son of a noble knightly family. For the first time, he experiences the warmth of a loving family and grows up cherished. However, he soon realizes that his kindhearted family, though strong in battle for generations, is hopelessly bad at business and incredibly poor! Deciding he has no choice but to step up, Ryuu first sets out to reform their finances. Utilizing his mysterious "Gokudou" skill and knowledge from his past life's shady dealings, he successfully sells the crops he cultivates. He even makes a fortune with a food stall at a local festival, launching one new venture after another. But as the family's fortunes rise, so too does the jealousy of worthless nobles who begin to hold a grudge against them. The curtain rises on a fantasy about fief management, full of duty and heart, starring a kindhearted former yakuza boy!

(Source: TO Books, translated)

title: Entangled!
synopsis:
Magical Boy Maple has one goal and one goal only: to protect the land from the evil hordes that seek to conquer and destroy it. Any lewd thoughts are just...a byproduct! He's dedicated to his cause, that's for sure, but his powers have yet to fully develop. That is, until the dark leader Daisy comes into his life. One look at those thick thighs and bulging pecs and—poof!—Maples magic comes in. And when the magical gods gift you tentacles, what else are you supposed to do if not use them...?!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Potato Royale
synopsis:
Jang Hada, a crop growth scientist, crash-lands in a famine-stricken world...where a priest named Pota mistakes him for their missing king. Declared the "Sun King," Hada is roped into saving the kingdom's failing crops while dodging awkwardly steamy lines and madcap encounters. With a little bit of sweat, potatoes, and some questionable chemistry—can they save the kingdom before it fries?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Bullanseo Photo Studio
synopsis:
A tragic love that transcends reality.

Seokyeong becomes a shadow of who she used to be after a car accident. While her body is on the verge of death, she meets a man who has lost his memory. Is this tied to the "haunted house" her mother bought for her? Are they ghosts? What is happening to Seokyeong, and why is she with this man?

(Source: Manta)

title: Once Upon a Deal
synopsis:
Ju Yunseong thought getting a job at JH Soft was the start of a normal office life—until he noticed his cold, intimidating CEO, Baek Hajin, glaring at him every time they crossed paths.

"Why is the boss always staring at me? Did I do something wrong on my first day?"

Determined to avoid him at all costs, Yunseong keeps his head down... until he stumbles upon a mysterious employee ID and uncovers a secret: his boss isn't just intense—he's a nine-tailed fox.

And to make things worse? Hajin's fox bead ends up lodged inside Yunseong's body. Now the CEO won't leave his side, and "normal" has left the building.

"Mr. Ju, you have two choices: stick close to me and do as I say, or I cut you open and take it back."

Excuse me?! Are those really my only options?!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Shining in Nightmares
synopsis:
Hwang Geumwoo, the CEO of the alcoholic beverage company "Golden Cloud," has never dreamed once in his life. However, one fateful night, Geumwoo finally experiences a dream. In the midst of his intriguing exploration, he encounters Eun Hosung, the "Nightmare Guard," who captures nightmares. Through his mysterious encounter with Hosung, Geumwoo's mundane daily life begins to change little by little...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Stand Up, Now!
synopsis:
Welcome to the world of stand-up!

What's the anatomy of a joke? Should you cross the line between funny and offensive? How do top comedians hone their craft, and how did stand-up start in the first place? Dive into the world of humor with your first ever webtoon guide to stand-up comedy!

(Source: Manta)

title: Dominant Castle
synopsis:
When graduate student Jeyeon arrives at Linderk Castle, she expects to uncover hidden masterpieces—not visions of ruin or the dangerously alluring Count Einbern. He holds the key to these treasures, but his lingering gaze and cutting words threaten to unravel everything—starting with her.

(Source: Manta)

title: Marriage of Inconvenience
synopsis:
Carefree chaebol Seohee Lee agrees to marry her university acquaintance Seunghyun Chae in a strategic marriage—only to realize too late that his mother is the stuff of nightmares for a daughter-in-law. Can Seohee survive her toughest challenge yet and perhaps even find true love?

(Source: Manta)

title: Should Not
synopsis:
Princess of the powerful Daham Group, Jein lives in luxury—until icy, mysterious Chungjo becomes her bodyguard for reasons he won't reveal. Forced to live under the same roof, cold walls crack and dangerous sparks fly. Guarding her was never part of his plan. Falling for her? Even less.

(Source: Manta)

title: Man's Best Boyfriend
synopsis:
How long is too long to spend in space?

When astronaut Webber Jones returns to Earth after a 20 year mission, he brings with him an interesting problem. Due to spending the last two decades with nothing but an AI robot dog as company, he's lost the ability to tell the difference between dogs and people. Of course, excitable psychiatrist Benjamin rogers isn't expecting this case to be easy, but he encounters an unexpected problem in the fact that the handsome, mature Webber is exactly his type! The things is, it's hard to treat a man who thinks of you as nothing more than his four-legged friend, and soon Benjamin realizes he may have bitten off more than he can chew...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Always Winter
synopsis:
When the timid Winter accidentally sends Joohan a nude meant for her boyfriend, an unexpected connection is formed between them, eventually culminating in them living together.

Will this unlikely pair be able to live together in peace—and perhaps even love?

(Source: Manta)

title: An Indecent Friendship
synopsis:
After 13 years of friendship, things take a turn when Taewon's pants get pulled down in front of Jaekyung. She thought she knew him better than anyone until she saw his wild, dirty side. Now that they've crossed the line, what awaits them?

(Source: Manta)

title: Dangerous
synopsis:
After breaking up with a boyfriend who disrespected her career, Jiwon spends a drunken night with a man who seems like a stranger. But he turns out to be a figure from her past—and now he's back in her life in a way she never expected, for better or worse.

(Source: Manta)

title: Abnormal Roommate
synopsis:
Lee Robin and Nam Hangyul were childhood friends. They haven't seen each other since elementary school; but when they both get accepted to the same university, their mothers suggest they become roommates, offering a seemingly perfect solution. However, Hangyul, who discovered his true sexual orientation due to Robin's influence in their childhood, worries about potential awkwardness. To his surprise, when Hangyul opens up about being gay, Robin is unfazed. Determined to keep his feelings for Robin a secret, Hangyul establishes ground rules for their living arrangement. Unfortunately, Robin remains oblivious to the underlying emotions, unable to comprehend why his new roommate seems distant and guarded. Will this "abnormal" situation eventually blossom into something more beautiful?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Love in Reprise
synopsis:
Seol Chae-woo is a top vocal talent at his university with a promising future seemingly his for the taking; until his life comes crashing down before his eyes. When his mother suddenly passes and his father's business goes bankrupt, Chae-woo is now forced to work odd jobs to keep his crumbling family afloat. But when his uncle approaches him with the idea of becoming a Reset Partner—one who carries an alpha's child for him in exchange for hefty compensation—Chae-woo has a choice to make. The only problem? The alpha in question is Chae-woo's rival—the enigmatic dominant alpha Beom Euigeon. Will the two be able to put their differences aside and create beautiful music together, or will this low note in Chae-woo's life become an indefinite song of sorrow?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Overrun
synopsis:
Dio has long harbored a crush on his unit superior, Aidan. Wanting no regrets before leaving the military, he confesses and spends a night with him. Infatuated by the night and Dio's sweet scent, Aidan asks him out. But as their relationship deepens, unspoken words begin to form between them...

(Source: Manta)

title: The Genius Grandson of House Namgung
title_english: The Genius Grandson of House Namgung
synopsis:
When young Hahyeon Shin's mother sacrifices herself to give him a chance to escape the family she married into, he finds himself alone in a hostile world. His only goal is to find his mother's family, the House of Namgung, and train in martial arts to avenge her and become a protector of the innocent. But when he is tested by the Namgung family, they discover that he is a martial arts genius with a perfect physique and the potential to become the greatest martial artist who ever lived.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Memento Bori
synopsis:
If only she could remember his face!

A one-night stand. Three possible suspects—er, lovers. Who did Bori really sleep with that night? A steamy office romance unfolds as our heroine follows the clues to find her man.

(Source: Manta)

title: William of the Wardrobe
synopsis:
The best guys are where you least expect them.

One lonely night, Julia finds an odd boy named William in her wardrobe. They quickly become friends, and soon he begins appearing whenever she needs someone to talk to. As the two grow closer, Julia falls for this mysterious boy, igniting a magical love story that transcends time and space.

(Source: Manta)

title: Manic Desires
synopsis:
A precarious relationship between a possessive guy and a vulnerable girl. Gyuyoung's only hope is to run away from her desperate reality, where people talk behind her about her mom, her only family, who works as a hostess at a sleazy bar in a small town. A once-in-a-lifetime opportunity ensues when Ikseon, a transfer male student to her high school, makes her an irresistible offer.

(Source: Manta)

title: Show Window Scandal
synopsis:
Harriet's sister returns with her stolen fiancé, demanding to stay at the estate. Enter Lennock Diorne, her brother's infuriating best friend. "You'll really let her win this easily?" His taunt sparks a reckless game of pretend. Is it pure revenge, or something far more dangerous?

(Source: Manta)

title: Black Storm
synopsis:
Love is a jungle, and only the fierce survive.

Kidnapped and held captive in the jungle, Tristan's only ally is Jia, a girl who was sold off to the cartel that killed his mother. She protects him—but as love grows, so does the danger. Can they escape together and make those who shattered their lives pay the price?

(Source: Manta)

title: Silver Tree
synopsis:
In this Holy War, who is the real enemy?

While delivering a sword to the Captain of the Holy Knights, Léa accidentally discovers a secret. Escorted by a knight named Baltha, Léa returns home to find her parents have been slaughtered and her sister is missing. Now she must survive in this harsh world while seeking out her sister.

(Source: Manta)

title: Mayonaka no Yoruko-san "Yoruko ga Aite shite Ageru"
title_japanese: 真夜中の夜子さん「夜子が相手してあげる」

title: Isnelda
synopsis:
Stuck between my first love and my hero.

After suddenly becoming an orphan, Isnelda is sent to live with her cold relatives until she reaches adulthood and can gain her inheritance. Yet upon becoming an adult, a benefactor returns to Isnelda's life, opening her eyes to a world of wealth, greed, lust, and... magic? What could go wrong?

(Source: Manta)

title: C.C
synopsis:
She always wanted to be a campus couple with someone, he just thought she was a weirdo with an impulsive streak. So what happens when what starts as a whim becomes something neither of them expected? Maybe love really does come when you least expect it...

(Source: Manta)

title: Bakusou Cupid Manjigawara Yashamaru
title_japanese: 爆走天使〈 キューピッド 〉 卍ヶ原夜叉丸
synopsis:
Ichika, who has a crush on Asuka, decides to try a love charm. However, what appears before her is a self-proclaimed No.1 Cupid named Yashamaru Manjigahara, who dons a gang-style uniform! With this delinquent-like Cupid in charge, will her love actually work out...⁉︎

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Bakusou Cupid Manjigawara Yashamaru
title_japanese: 爆走天使〈 キューピッド 〉 卍ヶ原夜叉丸
synopsis:
Ichika, who has a crush on Asuka, decides to try a love charm. However, what appears before her is a self-proclaimed No.1 Cupid named Yashamaru Manjigahara, who dons a gang-style uniform! With this delinquent-like Cupid in charge, will her love actually work out...⁉︎

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: I Tamed the Enemy Prince
synopsis:
To avenge the murder of her sister, Theadora Calyx goes to war with Dorzen, a rival empire. But when a divine error kills Theadora, she awakens to find her sworn enemy, Theodore Dorzen, smitten with her, and her sister still alive! With a new divine power to stop time, can Theadora rewrite history?

(Source: Manta)

title: The Duke's Plush Obsession
synopsis:
When Yul finds himself dropped into a BL novel, reincarnated as a stuffed toy that has ended up in the hands of an obsessive, tyrannical duke, he's sure he is done for. If the truth gets out, Yul will be burned at the stake! Can he find a way to get back to his real body or is he doomed to be stuck in this fantasy land?

(Source: Manta)

title: The Dungeon Raid Is Just a Side Quest
title_english: The Dungeon Raid Is Just a Side Quest
synopsis:
Isca is a promiscuous dark wizard who scrapes by doing guild quests. In a dungeon, he meets Sian, a beautiful priest hiding his looks, and Khalit, a demon prince seeking his lost powers.

Sparks fly, jealousy brews, and an accidental quest to save their world begins!

(Source: Manta)

title: Good Robot
synopsis:
A night on Mars in 2085, those who seek to protect her, those who seek to save her.

(Source: Daum, translated)

title: Welcome to the Abhuman Protection Bureau
title_english: Welcome to the Abhuman Protection Bureau
synopsis:
After discovering the count she served is half demon, Sera is kicked out and lands a new job at the "Abhuman Protection Bureau." Tasked with recovering a heirloom stolen from the vampire Vlad family, she juggles day missions and night caretaking—all the while a rather suspicious prince draws near.

(Source: Manta)

title: Team Zero
synopsis:
Romance rekindles amidst urban crisis.

"Team Zero" is a covert investigation unit unrecorded in any documents. During her pursuit of a monster terrorizing Seoul, Captain Yeoheun Jeong encounters her estranged first love, Jian Kang. Forced to work together, they uncover unsettling truths about the city's mysteries and their own pasts.

(Source: Manta)

title: Collector
synopsis:
Due to her stunning beauty and superb acting skills, actress Shin Sojin has been loved by everyone... except for Mrs. Jung, a cruel tycoon who has tormented Sojin all her life. But when wealthy CEO, Kang Seungwon, offers her a sponsorship, Sojin seizes the chance to take her down. With Seungwon by her side, Sojin slowly works toward getting her vengeance. But the closer she gets to her goal, the more she begins to realize that there is something deeper and darker about this arrangement...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Three Worlds
synopsis:
The good go to World One, the bad go to World Two, and the others await God's judgment in World Three. 19-year-old Yoon Cheol never questioned this system... until her sister, Jung, was taken to World Two for an unknown crime. Determined to uncover what that crime was, Cheol ventures to the boundary area between World Two and World Three, which is guarded by God's powerful subordinates. But with no special skills or knowledge of the world beyond her own, can Cheol hope to succeed?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Mujang
synopsis:
Set during the Goryeo military regime, a hero that arises from a slave to be reborn as a general.

(Source: Daum, translated)

title: Wind Sword
synopsis:
The world is riddled with beasts and demons, however little do people know that a magical barrier is currently sealing away high-level demons. There are those who wish to break the barrier and bring about the end of the world, and those who wish to protect it and its inhabitants. A great battle with heroes, villains, demons, and magic is about to begin and will determine the fate of the world.

(Source: Zero Scans)

title: Keep Us Together
synopsis:
Yoonsu coaxes new kid Yishin into joining him for Sports Day. Yishin finds him annoying, but once he realizes he always has him on his mind, he decides to transfer back to Seoul. Yoonsu, in tears, promises to visit, but 3 years pass since his last text. Yishin, feeling used, decides to use him back.

(Source: Manta)

title: Kakusei shitara Ao ga Moeta
title_english: When I Woke Up, the Blue Was Burning.
title_japanese: 覚醒したら青が燃えた

title: Curveball and Splitter
synopsis:
A one-night mistake brings Yesol to the doorstep of Hanrim, a cold yet familiar face from his high school baseball team. Only now, Hanrim isn't just cold—he's holding a grudge. What exactly happened between them, and why can't Yesol remember?

(Source: Manta)

title: Surviving the Apocalypse
synopsis:
Eunsoo's prescient dreams show him an apocalypse which is confirmed by his awaking powers. To survive, he bonds with Jaeyoung, a hidden powerhouse and seemingly guaranteed survivor. As monsters invade and the world unravels with gods, betrayal, and chaos, they must fight to stay alive—together.

(Source: Manta)

title: The Snow Queen
synopsis:
In a kingdom rotting from within, Rey, an Arcanist whose magic serves the city's power players, scrapes by in a dusty bookstore with one-night stands as his only relief. After one intense night with two men, one of them won't leave. Behind his refined mask lies a decadent hunger—and Rey knows it's poison, but he can't stay away.

(Source: Manta)

title: Arelyn Is Sick and Tired
synopsis:
The Caretakers' Council is a group of dedicated servants with only one goal: to nurse terminally ill Arelyn Halbern back to health. But Arelyn is already resigned to her fate, knowing she's simply an extra in a novel meant to die young. That is, until Crown Prince Pession Allermand takes an interest in her. Now, Pession visits Arelyn daily, nagging her to eat better, play, and be more active. With the novel's male lead lending his strength, can Arelyn finally find the will to fight her illness?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Waves Upon Waves
synopsis:
There's an old legend in Sereong's family: their flute "Manpa" will turn into a person if you care for it with enough love! But Sereong doesn't believe in this legend and plans to sell the Manpa... But then her Manpa turns into a human and tells Sereong he can grant wishes.

A romance between one who grants miracles and one who doesn't believe in miracles.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Brinny and the Empty Seat
synopsis:
The story of a possessor from a book who, for the sake of its goal, won't mind killing others.

Brinny, who's living while adapting to her stepfather, thought that story had nothing to do with her. Up until she was swept into an incident with the sickly second prince, Lucian. In the midst of the crisis, Brinny rescued Lucian by displaying her superhuman strength, and looking at the possessor "Ariadna" tied up had reassured her that everything had been resolved.

But for whatever reason, her beloved older sister and the first prince died in a carriage accident, and then even Lucian, who later became her fiancé, started to display some abnormal behavior.

The possessor wasn't executed in the past. Would "Ariadna" still be alive? In order to regain the empty seats of their lost loved ones, Brinny made a decision: To fight against the possessor.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Secret Love Affair Between a Former Saint and a Dark Hero
synopsis:
Kim Jiyeon, a college student on hiatus living an ordinary life, suddenly finds herself transmigrated into the romance novel Saint's Flower shown to her by a friend. She becomes the character Iolara, who only appeared halfway through the novel. The romantic world of the female lead and the male lead, which clearly isn't hers.

Still, she thought she could be happy as one of the characters in the novel. Like she had become the novel's protagonist. But everyone despises her. Hates her. She's Iolara, the villain who torments the female lead, a fake saint. But it's not true. Iolara herself was the true saint. Returning to the beginning with the blessings of the gods, she didn't need her family, the people who hated her, the position of the saint, or her beloved fiancé. She was going to walk a different path from her past.

"Even if this world tries to make me a villain, it doesn't matter. I will survive and be happy!"

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Wrong Night Stand
synopsis:
What does it take for a guy to get laid, you ask? Well, a hell of a lot of tries is the answer. Lee Si-hyeon is a 21-year-old virgin who has been in the bottom rungs when it comes to getting laid—and it's not the kind of bottom he aspires to be. After four failed attempts at having sex, Si-hyeon's fifth attempt is finally successful. Kind of. He wakes up in bed with his former-childhood-best-friend, present-arch-nemesis, Han Baek-kyung. Baek-kyung may not have been the top of Si-hyeon's list of eligible boys, but he could be the top Si-hyeon needs to undo the curse on his sex life.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: To My Beloved Enemy
synopsis:
"This makes it the 562nd time I've killed this bastard." 

Centuries ago, a monster by the name of Shinyoung cursed Dongyi with immortality. For years, he's done nothing but wait for the perfect chance to get revenge, but killing an immortal is nearly impossible. Trapped in a twisted, endless cycle, he's long since given up and settled into a strange form of cohabitation with his greatest enemy. But one day, when Shinyoung pushes him too far, Dongyi actually manages to kill him. Shinyoung, who always comes back laughing, doesn't return this time. An uneasy feeling creeps in, and Dongyi sets out to find him, only to discover that Shinyoung, for some reason, has lost all memories of him. 

"If you forget about me... then what happens to my revenge?!"

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: One Step from Hell
synopsis:
Years ago, Daniel Barton made a contract with a demon to survive. When he stole the demon's name and fled, the creature vowed to hunt him down. Now, Daniel is a mediator for an organization keeping the existence of non-human creatures a secret. When a case involving the First Lady's death brings him to Washington, Daniel reunites with Jesús Miller, the one whose name he stole. Though he has yet to be recognized, Daniel is worried that Jesús' growing interest in him may make escape impossible...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Off the Plate
synopsis:
Gyul Han met Jeongro Yoon in Portugal on an unexpected night. The two of them talked, drank, and went home together and... that was that. However, five years later, it seems fate wanted the pair to meet again. Jeongro is now a chef competing in a cooking show and Gyul is one of the judges on the panel. They are able to talk about cooking, their past, and their hardships but... will they ever be able to talk about their feelings for each other?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Master's Pet
synopsis:
When Ein is brought in to the Marquess Howard's manor, he finds himself serving TWO masters. Unaware of the tension between the two brothers, Ein seeks out ways to be as useful as possible. As he teaches the naïve Collin during the day and gives his body to the Marquess at night, Ein will find his eagerness to serve... put to the test. While one may lay claim to his body—for now—which master will be the one to claim his heart?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: I'm the Villain's Constellation with Empty Pockets
title_english: I'm the Villain's Constellation with Empty Pockets
synopsis:
Gahyeon never expected to find himself inside a novel, let alone as the Constellation of the villain, Taebeom Baek. Determined to prevent the world's destruction, he decides to sponsor Taebeom and lead him down a righteous path instead, but there's one problem—he's broke. As Gahyeon struggles to alter Taebeom's fate, their bond deepens, and Gahyeon faces a hard truth: his efforts to save the world may push Taebeom toward the very destruction he's trying to stop.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Popping Candy
synopsis:
Who's that beautiful man?! It's only the first day of the new semester, and Heewoong is already crushing on Hongyun, the gorgeous loner who's infamous for hating everyone on campus. When Heewoong hears rumors that Hongyun has been possessive and emotionally unavailable in all his past relationships, he's determined to find out who he really is. Will Heewoong be the one to finally push past Hongyun's walls or will he just be his next toy?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Write Me, Touch Me, Read Me
title_english: Write Me, Touch Me, Read Me
synopsis:
In an era where romance between hybrids and humans is taboo, Kang Seok-won finds himself crammed into an overcrowded subway on his way home from work. There, he keeps brushing against a large-built young man who gets his heart racing. Seok-won, who has the ability to read others' thoughts through physical contact, is suddenly overwhelmed by a flood of indecent ideas...and to make matters worse the subject of those indecent thoughts is...him?!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Duke's Baby Fever
synopsis:
The powerful Duke Reynal von Fenicaesar is known as the empire's hero and the Emperor's right hand, but his greatest secret is that he was born with both male and female reproductive organs! Under the guise of a sabbatical, he attempts to fulfill his desire to conceive his own heir. However, this proves to be more difficult than expected as ordinary seed isn't enough to impregnate him. Reynal searches for a man with superior seed to father his child, but is the perfect partner closer than he realizes?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Mr. Kang's Son-in-Law
synopsis:
Han Yisu's proud of himself for winning over Kang Jihyung, the perfect partner. Not only is Jihyung incredibly rich and handsome, he's also turned gay just for Yisu and Yisu alone. For Jihyung, Yisu's willing to move in with Kang Jungman, Jihyung's father and president of Cheonbong Corporations, and be the daughter-in-law that Jungman so seems to want. So just imagine his surprise when Jihyung suddenly brings home a woman and declares her his fiancee. And not just any woman, but Jungman's mistress from his favorite bar. Enraged, Jungman chases his own son out of his home and vows to cut him off. Meanwhile Yisu, heartbroken and confused, wants to move out, but Jungman insists that Yisu needs to "take my son's place." Yisu's always considered himself tough, but all this family drama is too much even for him... Just what is he to the house of Kang? Son-in-law, daughter-in-law, stepson, or maybe...all of the above?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Revenge Guide
synopsis:
Although he never wanted to see him again, S-Class Esper Seo Leehyeon ends up meeting Jin Taewoo during his Guide matching test.

In the past, they were each other's closest friend but their relationship fractured and broke due to a peculiar event. In an unexpected and unpleasant reunion, Jin Taewoo becomes Seo Leehyeon's exclusive Guide, due to their high compatibility. 
This guy, who's acting like he's taking revenge for the past, often gets on his nerves, and an aggressive guiding begins... "No matter how many times you reject me, you were meant to end up falling into my clutches." Can the Esper really escape from the Guide's revenge?

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Lima Syndrome
synopsis:
Muyoung has depended on Heewon for a long time. But he's had enough of freeloading and wants to break out on his own. The only problem is, is that Muyoung's an omega who is having a hard time finding a good job. Plus, his excessive pheromone problem isn't helping. Life for an omega isn't easy. But one day, Heewon proposes a way for Muyoung to reduce his excessive pheromone symptoms. All it requires is for an omega to mate with an alpha. And all Heewon desires is to make Muyoung be unable to live without him...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Gag Mangaka: Ningen Dock Death Race
title_japanese: ギャグマンガ家 人間ドックデスレース
synopsis:
The series stars a group of five manga veterans who journey to a local hospital for full-body examinations. Along the way, they swap horror stories about the toll that years of deadlines and desk work have taken on their middle-aged bodies.

(Source: The New Yorker)

title: Heavenly Moon
synopsis:
The Murim Warring States period is where only the strong survive. This is the survival story of war slave Cheong Gwang and premier courtesian Myeong-Wol.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Mia Is Back
synopsis:
Mia was Taesu's first love, who suddenly disappeared one day. After five years of silence, she reappears as a freshman at his university. But she's not the girl he remembers. He plays it cool, trying to ignore her, but can first love truly be forgotten? Or will fate give them a second chance?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Heavenly Match
synopsis:
A young girl accidentally awakens a guardian spirit sealed within a sword. Together they will face many challenges in order to complete a mysterious mission given by the gods. They meet other summoners and spirits, face demons, and details about their past lives are revealed.

(Source: MU)

title: Dear Hongrang
synopsis:
Is this a true reunion or a false deception?

When Jaeyi's half-brother Hongrang suddenly disappears, she bears the brunt of her wealthy family's scorn. Ten years later, a man claiming to be Hongrang appears, with much to gain should he truly be who he claims. Though Jaeyi can feel that something is off, the two seem somehow drawn to each other.

(Source: Manta)

title: My Sweet Dear
synopsis:
Burning fingers or mending hearts?

There are too many cooks in the kitchen! Dogun Yoon's head chef spot is threatened by total stranger Jungwoo Choi. As they battle it out, Dogun's phobia of being touched is as strong as ever... But why is it okay with him? Will their saucy arrangement lead to love, or will things boil over?

(Source: Manta)

title: Master Baek's Case Notes
synopsis:
After enduring their respective hardships—Youngwoo due to his special powers and Suhan from his thirst for revenge—the two finally overcome their struggles and misunderstandings to find peace. As they enjoy a sweet, laughter-filled newlywed life, a few small, unexpected incidents interrupt their peace.

(Source: Manta)

title: The Tale of the Frost Flower
title_english: The Tale of the Frost Flower
synopsis:
An imperial scandal and a shattered first love.

Sabi is secretly in love with her childhood friend Yusu and wishes to marry him. But the day after her coming-of-age celebration, she finds herself embroiled in a scandalous rumor and suddenly engaged to the emperor's son. Will Sabi be able to clear her name and find her way back to her true love?

(Source: Manta)

title: Scent of Desire
synopsis:
Despite repeated attempts, the young King Sihyun and Queen Soyoung struggle to conceive a child as Sihyun seeks to strengthen his position. Under pressure to take a concubine by the Queen Dowager, they try once again. But a perfumed sachet given to Soyoung unknowingly ignites the normally cold Sihyun's buried desire.

(Source: Manta)

title: Groupie Sweetie
synopsis:
Munhak, the bassist of Earth Square, has always stayed away from fans, especially with his leader's strict "no groupies" rule. But when a flirty fan named Jaehui catches his eye, Munhak can't say no. What starts as a fleeting encounter soon spirals into a risky, passionate affair that could ruin everything.

(Source: Manta)

title: Season of Change
synopsis:
Trying new things is never easy.

Ohran Lim is an ex-boxer who never managed to go pro. Now, she spends her days working at the local convenience store, wondering where it all went wrong. But after she meets young couple Woon and Baram, she slowly begins to change her outlook on life.

"I need to find what makes me happy."

(Source: Manta)

title: Her Story
synopsis:
The ugliness behind city glamour.

Playboy Ondal lives a life of wooing women and seeing ghosts. His curiosity is piqued when he hears about a serial murderer involving the supernatural, and his investigation leads him to a widow who had lost her husband in a similar manner years ago. Ready to face the truth, he hears her story.

(Source: Manta)

title: Anata no Soba ni: Shiawase no Arika
title_english: By Your Side: Where Happiness Lives
title_japanese: あなたのそばに ～しあわせの在り処～
synopsis:
Manga artist Shizuka suddenly hits a creative wall. Nothing's going right, and she's completely lost touch with her own feelings... A touching one-shot about reconnecting with yourself.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Mrs. Angel
synopsis:
A gangster girl in high school decides it's time to live life properly after graduating by marrying a nice man and living a normal life. However, her past as a gangster constantly threatens to come out from time to time and she has trouble holding back. And when she has a daughter... apples don't fall far from the tree.

(Source: Easy Going Scans)

title: Over Steam
synopsis:
In the aftermath of a great war between humanity and creatures known as the Talaiv, the storms of war are brewing again.

(Source: MU)

title: Tomodachi ni mo Naisho no Koto
title_japanese: ともだちにもないしょのこと

title: Trinity Wonder
synopsis:
What happens when the greatest martial artist of the Murim world meets a genius magician from a fantasy world?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Kanojo ga Ore wo Sukisugiru!!
title_japanese: 彼女が俺を好きすぎる!!

title: Watashi ga Dosukebe na Koto Darenimo Iwanaide ne?♡
title_japanese: 私がドスケベなことだれにも言わないでね?♡

title: Mitsu Ana: Osananajimi no Amaku Shitataru Mesu Anal?
title_japanese: 蜜アナ ～幼馴染の甘く滴るメス穴る？～
synopsis:
1-6. Mitsu Ana: Uwaki ni Naranai Osananajimi JK Anal no Tsukaikata
7-8. One Shiri: Shouta-kun ga Kinjo no Oneechan no Anal ni Oboreru made

title: Cigarette and Chocolate
synopsis:
Working as a servant for the handsome Duke, Theodore Winston, was dreamy enough, but Alois is determined to win his heart. He has tried every trick in the book to seduce his master, only to be met with a fatherly pat on the head. When rumors of a new Duchess threaten his dreams, Alois makes a desperate plea to the heavens. The magic works a little too well by bringing a youthful and ruthless version of the Duke across time and into his arms. Now that the tables have turned, will Alois finally get the love he has been craving?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Plot Twist!
synopsis:
Hawon, known for his good looks and numerous passionate encounters, suddenly finds himself facing an unexpected problem—erectile dysfunction—after receiving harsh criticism during a one-night stand. Shocked and embarrassed, he tries to drown his sorrows at a bar, where he ends up venting his frustrations to the bartender and anyone who'll listen. That's when Seokjun, who was singing at the bar, steps in to help drunk Hawon.

"Hey...can you get up...?"

"No! I can't get it up!!!"

As Hawon desperately pleads for help with his "technique," Seokjun offers to teach him through hands-on practice at a nearby motel. What begins as a night of comfort and guidance leads to an unexpected mix of motives and misunderstandings in this unlikely encounter.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Take Me to Heaven
synopsis:
Strange things have been happening to Lee Yuan lately. Fainting spells, waking up with strangers in his bed, lost memories...for someone who wants to live an uneventful life, he sure has been busy lately. That's when his friend Doyoon makes a confession: though he may look normal, Doyoon is in fact a reaper sent to earth to retrieve a ghost who refuses to move on. And just who should that ghost be possessing? You guessed it! The only way to send a spirit up to the afterlife is to satisfy its needs, and Doyoon is determined to suck the spirit right out of Yuan in more way than one...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Tiger and Me
synopsis:
When Cheong-gyeong is stranded on Mount Baekdu in the cold, he's rescued by Baek Beom, the tiger spirit that rules over the mountain. It is only right for Cheong-gyeong's memories of the supernatural to be erased and he be sent back to the human world, but Baek Beom finds himself unable to let Cheong-gyeong go. They end up spending an entire season together before Baek Beom is forced to erase Cheong-gyeong's memories and let him return to his life amongst humanity. And thus their story ends...or it may just be the beginning, right when Cheong-gyung meets a mysteriously familiar figure amidst his ordinary life.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Unsealed Desire
synopsis:
Lim Chanyeong was often physically punished by his teachers as a student, causing him to believe that he was masochistic. At the academy where he works part-time, he meets Goo Dongha, a teacher with massive masochistic tendencies. Due to a drunken encounter, Dongha mistakes Chanyeong for a sadist and the two embark on a whirlwind BDSM adventure together.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Attaque
synopsis:
Leesu came from a poor family but he didn't mind at all not having any money or status. Being the school's strongest fighter made him feel as if he was on top of the world in his eyes. But alas, a car accident made him lose what was most precious to him; his ability to fight! Craving for his past glorious days he turns to fencing with the hope to regain what he once had?

(Source: Easy Going Scans)

title: Trace: Perfume
synopsis:
The story of three protagonists living in the world of Traces and Troubles.

(Source: MU)

title: Kill Switch
synopsis:
"Don't ever, ever get involved with her."

The warning Jeong Won receives is clear: stay away from Kim Jisoo at all costs. But the thing is, there's just something so... intriguing about the other woman. Try as she might, Jeong Won can't seem to tear her eyes away whenever Jisoo Is in the room. One night, Jeong Won misses the bus, and the only way to get home is the back of Jisoo's motorcycle. It's a thrilling ride, that's for sure, but Jeong Won can't say for certain whether it's the rushing wind or the woman in front of her that's making her heart race. As they get closer, Jisoo doesn't seem like the bully she's painted to be. Could the warnings have been a lie all along, or is Jeong Won in for the ride of her life...?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Heartrate Presto
synopsis:
I'll be the one to save you this time.

While suffering from PTSD, Roman Brennon searches for pianist Yuri Jung's album. He finds it in a small store, but it's sold before Roman can buy it. It is here that he runs into Yuri himself, who has fallen ill and can no longer play the piano. Yuri once saved Roman, but can he return the favor?

(Source: Manta)

title: Assassin
synopsis:
Ichigar, the king, returns to the city without his Guardian. During an investigation following an assassination attempt, he notices Eli, a slave. Despite Eli's protests, he orders him to be his personal Guardian. As Eli tries to find a way out of his duties, this only attracts the king's attention.

(Source: Manta)

title: How to Escape the Clutches of an Obsessive Top
title_english: How to Escape the Clutches of an Obsessive Top
title_japanese: 그 가이드가 집착광공의 품에서 벗어나는 방법
synopsis:
Yeonsoo wakes up as a doomed, bratty guide in "The Guide's Abyss." He avoids Seunghyuk, an S-rank esper, but one accident later, they're involved. His careful plans are ruined, and though he pulls away, Seunghyuk sticks to him more. Will Yeonsoo survive, or will Seunghyuk's possessiveness prevail?

(Source: Manta)

title: Just Something I've Heard
synopsis:
From middle school to all the way to university, Baek Jaehyun had eyes for one person, and one person only: Jung Woojin. Over the seven years he spent pining over Woojin, Seungtae stayed by Jaehyun's side, albeit online, and listened to him tell stories about his "friend." However, feelings for someone have been taking root in Seungtae's heart recently, and they seem to be getting stronger after Seungtae and Jaehyun met for the first time in real life. Will love come true for these people, or end as a one-sided crush?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Kikikaikai
title_japanese: 鬼鬼戒解-キキカイカイ-
synopsis:
Aoi, a demon boy hiding his true identity, lives a quiet life as a normal high school student. But one day, a girl suddenly falls from the sky, and she's not what she seems. Get ready for a modern-day pop demon battle from a highly skilled artist in the manga world!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: One Winter
synopsis:
The story of the 1st winter Ga On became a ghost.

(Source: MU)

title: Lime Odyssey: The Chronicles of Orta
synopsis:
Follows the journey of an ordinary high school student who is thrown into the fantasy world of Orta.

(Source: AnalogScans)

title: Weak Teacher
synopsis:
The special discipleship of Moorim's best assassin, "Gwi-Myeon-Dok," will begin.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Hanyang Diaries
synopsis:
Come see Joseon's hippest new spot!

Mystery and romance take Cheongdam, the owner of a trendy shop in the middle of Joseon's hottest new area, by storm! Will she be swept off her feet by the dashing Eul Jiro, or his friend, the mysterious Yi Taewon?

(Source: Manta)

title: Seian
synopsis:
Kai is a reaper who guides the souls of the dead. After collecting ten-thousandth soul, the God of Death, Shainos, offers to grant him one wish. Kai chooses to disappear. However, he is reincarnated as Seian, the wayward second son of Count Shureiton. Now living in the place of Seian, whose life had been completely twisted, what fate awaits Kai from here on?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: The Villainess I Possessed Is Raising Hell
synopsis:
A demon from the demon realm possessed a human?! Bella, ruler of the Demon Realm and a demon, finds herself possessing Isabella Dunkeld—a villainess hated by her family and shunned by all. 'How did I end up in this body?'

She has no memory of making a contract with the human Isabella, yet when she came to her senses, all her powers were sealed and she was trapped inside Isabella's body. For now, she decides to act "human"... "So... how many people have I killed with these hands? Hundreds? Thousands?" "Uh... not a single person, my lady." "They call me a villainess when I haven't killed even one person?" The demon Bella finds humans truly baffling...

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Shiromajo-san to no Henkyougurashi: Saikyou no Majo wa Nonbiri Kurashitai
title_japanese: 白魔女さんとの辺境ぐらし ～最強の魔女はのんびり暮らしたい～
synopsis:
After getting fired from his adventuring clan for his lack of combat ability, Tori wanders around and runs into the city's strongest adventurer—the White Witch! Since he has nowhere else to go, she hires Tori for his exceptional skill in...handling chores?! With his talent for cooking, cleaning, running errands, and other domestic odd jobs, he's the perfect fit for taking care of the extremely lazy White Witch and the garbage dump she calls her house. Follow Tori as he grapples with his new job as the caretaker of the beautiful White Witch and her three familiars. Perhaps once he has cleaned up the place, he can finally live a cozy life in the woods with his new employer!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Slap!!!
synopsis:
The vivid memory of a strong slap, when I was smacked down by a mysterious girl. Carrying the pain of my broken heart, I joined the "Slap-Fighting World Championship!" Can I overcome the pain of that episode and find the will to win?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Yontouryuu no Saikyou Haishinsha: Yarikonda VR Game no Settei ga Genjitsu Sekai ni Hanei sareta node Haishiyotei Datta Job de Musou shimasu
title_english: The Greatest Live Streamer of Four Swords.
title_japanese: 四刀流の最強配信者～やり込んだVRゲームの設定が現実世界に反映されたので、廃止予定だった戦闘職〈ジョブ〉で無双します～
synopsis:
Hayate, a solo player of the ultra-popular VRMMO FWO, cherishes his obscure class: Quad-Wielder. But his world is shattered when he receives the worst possible news: "Quad-Wielding will be removed!"

Teamed up with Elena, a chaebol heiress and archer, Hayate unleashes his ultimate Quad-Wielding technique "Obscuring Moon"—all while unraveling the mysteries of the Creation Goddess. Then suddenly... the game and reality merge.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Project Mars
synopsis:
Cha Ddeosari, or Plankie, lost her family to an alien attack years ago and is bullied for her unusual name and obsession with aliens. When two mysterious Kudoomians—aliens with pink blood, disguised as humans—appear to capture her, she fights back using a strange power... the ability to control the stars. Outnumbered and outmatched, suddenly a blue alien steps into the fray, offering what might be the chance at friendship she's been searching for her entire life. Will Plankie finally find the ally she needs?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Death Is Mine
synopsis:
Yoon Jiha, a struggling actor who's been dreaming of winning people's affection for six years, has never even passed an audition. Haunted by a mysterious illness that foretells misfortune, he feels increasingly isolated. But when Song Chaeheon, a secretive, powerful agency director, offers to make him a star, Jiha is torn on what to do. Despite Chaeheon's arrogance, Jiha feels an inexplicable pull toward him. What does Chaeheon truly want, and why is he fixated on Jiha's potential?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Woof Wolf
synopsis:
School life is hard enough for Min-Woo without considering the fact that he's a werewolf. He's done well enough keeping that a secret but, when a new crush of his—Jae-Min—begins to take up residence in his head, Min-Woo's lies and alibis start to crack under the pressure.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Miserable in Love
synopsis:
