Aspiring novelist Kim Woojin has been a side character all his life. He can't write stories that are his own, and he's not even his boyfriend, Minho's, priority. But like every cloud has its silver lining, Woojin's comes in the form of an aspiring stage actor, Taehwan. However, Taehwan is not without his own problems: he suffers from terrible stage fright that keeps him from taking lead roles. A friendship blossoms between Woojin and Taehwan, with each helping the other overcome their fears. Will this newfound friendship remain just that or could Taehwan be the spark that gets Woojin's creative juices flowing again? And could they both muster up the courage to become the protagonists of their own stories?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Seasons in Bloom
synopsis:
Two young girls at a renowned boarding school depend on and despise each other for the attention they both desperately want—and the love they cannot sustain. Every rose has its thorns, each dazzling flame burns in this period thriller set in turn of the century Seoul, during Japan's colonial occupation of Korea.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: What Should We Eat?
synopsis:
Really? Chocolate for breakfast?

Despite having 0 interest in food, Mia is a longtime fan of the famous cooking YouCuber Woonha, aka "Cook-it-All." In a strange turn of events, he ends up moving into her place, where he discovers her horrifying eating habits. This just makes him want to make her a nice, home-cooked meal...!

(Source: Manta)

title: The World Ends at the Jump
title_english: The World Ends at the Jump
title_japanese: 세상을 끝내는 데 필요한 점프의 횟수
synopsis:
"We are no different from gods."

Hyunhee starts a new job as a server developer at a budding game company. As she digs deeper into a mysterious bug where if a player makes the character jump 65,536 times, the server shuts down, what shocking truths will she uncover? It's just a game... right?

(Source: Manta)

title: The Taming of the Prince
synopsis:
Ophedelia, the kingdom's famed "Silver Knight," returns from war a hero only to be forced to marry the jealous king who has long feared her popularity. Instead, she proposes to marry the king's brother, Prince Aiden, but behind their vows lies a secret: Ophedelia is plotting a coup, while Aiden is out to expose her treason.

(Source: Manta)

title: The Stand-In
synopsis:
Who needs actors when you have AI?

Doyong was a child star when he was six. But now at the age of 20, he's just another unknown theater actor. Then a big-shot production company comes to him with an offer: "We're just going to borrow your name and your face. CGI will do the rest."

After that, Doyong's life begins to change...

(Source: Manta)

title: Sweets in Suit
synopsis:
Sungyeon's long-time crush on her superior Jaeyoon takes an unexpected turn when a night of drunken confusion leads her to wake up in his house. She uncovers a secret that won’t leave her mind and is left wondering if the man she thought was gentle and professional is hiding a much wilder side.

(Source: Manta)

title: Romance in a Romance-less Era
synopsis:
Yoon I-gyeong slept with a man. With Cha Seon-ho, his landlord who changes men every week like clockwork. Seon-ho seems to represent non-romance on the surface, casually moving from one affair to the next, yet secretly dreams of romance. Watching Seon-ho exhausted from his one-sided love, I-gyeong began to want something more than just one night with him.

(Source: Manta)

title: Girl from the Future
synopsis:
My wife is 70 years younger than me.

2118, USA. Dean lost his wife in a car accident. When he hears of a man who disappeared without a trace thanks to a Time Paradox, he makes a plan to pass painlessly and join his wife. And so, Dean travels 50 years into the future. He meets a woman there. She looks shocked to see him. 

"Are you...?"

(Source: Manta)

title: A Hard Day
synopsis:
Mama, just killed a man...

After killing someone in a drunk driving accident, crooked detective Gunsoo Ko hides the body inside her mother's casket. But when a mysterious caller claims knowledge of the murder and demands the body back, Gunsoo finds herself embroiled in a corruption scandal far worse than she ever imagined.

(Source: Manta)

title: The Imposter
synopsis:
"Don't worry, I won't harm you."

Gaeun is enjoying her perfect high school life until she encounters Haeun, her identical twin. Except... she doesn't have a twin. Things start getting strange when everyone behaves as though Haeun has always existed, including Gaeun's own family. Now, Gaeun must defend her identity from this imposter.

(Source: Manta)

title: My Childhood Friend Is a BL Novel Protagonist
title_english: My Childhood Friend Is a BL Novel Protagonist
synopsis:
Mina wakes up inside an R18 BL novel as Sofia, the childhood friend of the main character, Aiden, and she's thrilled to have a front-row view of his reverse harem. But for some reason, the handsome male leads start to take an interest in her instead, leaving Aiden feeling somewhat... jealous?

(Source: Manta)

title: Dirty Talk Buddies
synopsis:
Ji Seoyul is a sex columnist with a secret—she's still a virgin! She ends up befriending the popular actor Kang Jooheon, who agrees to provide her with a new viewpoint for her column. Her only condition is that they not sleep together. But as they grow closer, will she be able to resist his allure?

(Source: Manta)

title: Love at First Bite
synopsis:
Kalyx, the golden dragon, loses a part of his sacred 'core' in the middle of metamorphosis. Celia was the one who took a bite out of it, mistaking it for a fruit. Kalyx vows to kill her in the next decade, but ends up meeting her as his maid. What could have been a dangerous cat and mouse game with Kalyx not recognizing a grown-up Celia slowly changes as the two gradually develop feelings for each other.

(Source: NHN comico)

title: The Perks of Being a Villain
title_english: The Perks of Being a Villain
synopsis:
An orphan in real life one day wakes up as a main character in a novel she was reading. An orphan in the novel as well, she is adopted to a villainous family who served as the main adversary against the main character in the original plot... except, the family seems way nicer than she expected. Are these really the same villains that caused so much pain the novel?

(Source: NHN comico)

title: Fake Wife
synopsis:
In order to save her ill father, Yoo Yeonwoo makes a dangerous deal to deceive the members of the esteemed Taeseong Group. Her task is to pretend to be her estranged twin sister, who disappeared just before her marriage to Taeseong's youngest son, Cha Kitae. Yeonwoo only needs to keep up the act for six months, but in the fifth month, she is found out at the worst time possible: right after refusing to get intimate with her sister's man. When asked for forgiveness, Kitae offers her a simple solution. "Just make it up to me with your body, Yeonwoo."

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Model
synopsis:
The Spartan model training project for confident and unique beauty begins!

(Source: Daum, translated)

title: Paradise
synopsis:
The story of a spoiled brat superstar who's set in his ways and a cold-hearted island girl's struggles!

(Source: Daum, translated)

title: Mirror Girl
synopsis:
If one day you find out that there is someone who looks exactly like you and with an intent to kill you and take your place, how will you handle it?

(Source: Easy Going Scans)

title: Panic World
synopsis:
1. Panic World
2. Yakou Toshi no Mirai
3. Kiiroi Usagi
4. Death Bird 4444 [Story: Fumimura Shou]

title: Gone with the Bubbles
synopsis:
As an unexpected descendant of a cursed family of mermaids, Eunwoo's only hope of survival is to never fall in love. For years this was easy enough, until one day he's forced to confront his childhood friend and first kiss, Taeho. But why has he come back, toying with Eunwoo's heart? Can Eunwoo resist Taeho's pull or will he succumb to his hidden feelings, and ultimately, disaster?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: UMA
synopsis:
Maximum cuteness! A heartfelt UMA comedy that will change your life!!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Curious Recipe
synopsis:
As a young boy, Junghyuk felt drawn to the tough Taesu who often swooped in to save him from bullies. Now after years have passed, it's his turn to make Taesu fall head over heels. Will plates of sweets be enough to win over his heart?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: In Shadow
synopsis:
In a world of superpowered heroes and villains, villain Peridot and hero Jackal strike a deal: Peridot pretends to be Jackal's puppet in public to help boost his rank, and in return, Jackal shelters him. But Jackal's growing obsession hints at a shared, hidden past...

(Source: Manta)

title: Autobahn Romance
synopsis:
For 10 years, Pyunghwa Gong and Saebyuk Shin have kept their love a secret from family and friends. But then, the alpha and omega pair invite their old classmates to their daughter's first birthday party, ready to reveal their unbelievable love story. Strap in for the romance of a lifetime!

(Source: Manta)

title: A Pearl of a Deal
synopsis:
Ethan, an author of children's books, travels to a coastal village rumored to be home to mermaids in search of inspiration for a new story. After an unexpected fall into the sea, he stumbles upon a mysterious pearl—one that grants him the ability to breathe underwater. Excited by his discovery, Ethan eagerly plans to use it as the basis for his next book.

But that night, the true owner of the pearl emerges from the depths. The mermaid forcefully claims what is his—and offers Ethan a deal he can't refuse...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Becoming the King's Concubine
synopsis:
As a method actor, Doha has always poured himself into his roles. For him, acting is an outlet he uses to deal with his difficult upbringing and the lingering struggles with self-worth that resulted from it. But one day, when Doha collapses after filming only to wake up and find himself transmigrated into the world of the screenplay and inhabiting the very character he had been playing, his acting chops are about to be put to the test. Not only will Doha have to give a convincing enough performance to fool everyone into believing he truly is the King's concubine, he must also find a way to change the fate of his character who, according to the screenplay, is slated for an untimely demise. The only problem is, there's just one way for Doha to save his own neck, and that's to win the affections of the King, who is proving to be a far cry from the gentleman he was written to be. Will Doha somehow manage to come out unscathed, or will this be curtains for him?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainmen

title: Do It for the Fans, Not Me!
title_english: Do It for the Fans, Not Me!
synopsis:
For Yoo Jaemin, debuting as an idol is everything, but his skills are outshined in particular by Jung Woohyung. The other boy's laid-back attitude, especially toward their fans, irks Jaemin, but their dynamic shifts when they become roommates and Woohyung starts noticing cute sides to Jaemin that he hadn't before. The fans notice this change and Jaemin focuses all his attention on them and their love, which bothers Woohyung. Will their group, 4ever, hit it big, or will Woohyung and Jaemin's tumultuous relationship lead to its downfall?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Don of a New Love
synopsis:
When Theo is tasked with closing a drug deal, he encounters a man named Eric, and the ghosts of his past come knocking. Theo feigns ignorance, but Eric seeks retribution. As the two dance between forgetting and remembering, could they stumble their way into reconciliation? Or perhaps this could be the dawn of a brand new feeling...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Please Spice Up My Life, Darling
title_english: Please Spice Up My Life, Darling
synopsis:
What Dohyun lacks in character, he makes up for with his looks and wealth. After cutting his studies abroad short, he returns to Korea, relying on his fortune as a safety net. Life feels predictable—until a call from his real estate agent brings him to his building, Yeyeon.

To his dismay, Dohyun finds himself trapped in an elevator with a strikingly handsome man who, much to his surprise, seems completely unimpressed when Dohyun casually reveals that he owns the building. The encounter leaves Dohyun both baffled and intrigued.

Unable to shake the memory of the mysterious Jeong Hyun, who turns out to work in his building, Dohyun begins to pursue him. What starts as an infuriating elevator mishap soon spirals into a series of unpredictable run-ins in the most unlikely places. As the tension between them grows, a barrage of witty banter and undeniable chemistry keeps pulling them closer together.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Cheat Day
synopsis:
A simple clerk and customer routine becomes a rhythm neither wants to lose. Inha's concern becomes habit, and Jaeon waits for it like breath. Convinced a beta cannot draw an alpha's eye, he uses a pill that mimics omega traits. Affection grows, but so does the strain of a bond built on pretense.

(Source: Manta)

title: Koisuru Futari wa Kiba wo Kakusu: Gap ga Arisugiru Couple no Hanashi
title_japanese: 恋するふたりは牙を隠す～ギャップがありすぎるカップルの話～
synopsis:
Yukiya Sengoku and Airi Ichijou are high school students who met online and became close friends through offline meetups. "I want us to get even closer." Yukiya and Airi sense the beginnings of romance, but each harbors a secret they can't tell the other—Yukiya is the leader of his local delinquent all-boys school, and Airi is the leader of her local delinquent all-girls school! Their true identities absolutely must not be revealed!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: For a Certain Princess
synopsis:
The Kingdom of Terossa is home to the discriminated Hoans, physically modified super soldiers. Rezaric, commander and the strongest Hoan, leads the kingdom to victory in the recent war, only to be sentenced to death. But when he accepts his fate, he's saved by the frail Princess Delmore and brought to her lab, where she promises to aid his escape. There, Rezaric learns more about his savior and even discovers a dangerous truth that will change his life and Terossa forever...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: So Did I Truly Die?
synopsis:
When a mana stone is stolen from the powerful Red Dragon, it morphs into a noble lady to track down the thief. This lady is none other than Cecilia Marinella, who was proclaimed dead five years ago under suspicious circumstances. With no memory of Cecilia's past, the dragon starts its search with the men closest to her. Could any of them lead it to the mana stone? And just what do they know about Cecilia's "death"? Soon, the search for the stone and the search for the truth become entangled...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Villainess Is Too Busy Baking Bread!
title_english: The Villainess Is Too Busy Baking Bread!
synopsis:
After overworking myself in my past life, I reincarnated as Rachel Leseltein, the villainess in a novel. I had no regrets, but I never got to chase my dream of opening a bakery. Unfortunately, every business the original Rachel touched crumbled, and she was ultimately destroyed by the story's heroine. But this time, I'm changing my fate! My father and brother don't support my idea, but I'll whip up sweet recipes, knead my way to success, and maybe attract a handsome duke with a sweet tooth.

(Source: Tapas Media)
