title: Ousama no Kyuujitsu
synopsis:
It's been eight months since Kakurai, CEO of a preeminent domestic apparel enterprise, last had a vacation, when he meets a pickpocket. That pickpocket turns out to be a young man named Kei. Upon meeting Kei, with his sharp, rebellious eyes, Kakurai's attracted to him, so he decides to take Kei along with him. At first, Kei acts like a wounded and cautious animal towards Kakurai, but then, seeing Kakurai's mature behavior and sincere attitude, he begins to open his heart. Will the adult who has everything―social status, reputation, money, etc―finally be able to encounter his true love for whom he'd throw it all away?!

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: Koutei no Mago ni Tensei Suru Koutei
title_japanese: 皇帝の孫に転生する皇帝
synopsis:
The first generation emperor rose up from being a mere slave to a man who built his own empire. However, all 26 of his heirs were incompetent. If he left things as they were, the empire would fall into ruin. To solve this crisis, the emperor decides to reincarnate as his own grandchild.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Akuyaku Reijou wa Scenario wo Shiranai: Otome Game no Sekai de Shinjitsu no Koi wo Sagashimasu!
title_japanese: 悪役令嬢はシナリオを知らない ～乙女ゲームの世界で真実の恋を探します！～
synopsis:
Marie has had memories of her past life since she was five years old. Upon entering the academy, she finally realizes that the world she's living in is the setting of an otome game her little sister loved! However, she barely remembers the characters or the story. Since she knows nothing, she decides to take it easy and aim for a wonderful romance. But soon, she finds herself attracting the affection of the very love interests who are supposed to be vying for the protagonist...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Nami wo Tadotta Saki ni
title_english: Let Me Listen to Your Heartbeat
synopsis:
Shy and withdrawn Tensei Iijima is unable to tell his classmate Shinoha Ichinose, who helped him in elementary school, that he wants to be friends with him, and his feelings become complicated. One day, as a university student, he happens to meet Shinoha on his way home, and little by little, the gears of fate begin to turn.

A heart-pounding story of pure-hearted boys' lives spun by two art students: a cool music nerd and a shy dog-like guy!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Shayou ni Kou
title_english: Fall in Love with the Setting Sun
synopsis:
Himari Hinanoi, a third-year high school student. During his final summer in high school, he reunites with Banri Hachiya, a freshman in college. Standing before his idolized senior, Himari's heart pounds, but his joy is short-lived as he finds out who Banri has a crush on... The person Banri has been secretly in love with is a man. And it turns out he's his younger brother's boyfriend...?!

Himawari is confused, but before he knows it, he realizes his true feelings lie deep within his admiration...

A coming-of-age story where the arrows of love intertwine!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Shoujo Manga nara Kanawanai Koi
title_english: Shoma Koi: This Ain't Some Shoujo Manga!
title_japanese: 少女マンガなら叶わない恋
synopsis:
A trio of childhood friends: a prince, a heroine, and a yankee. Suminao, a yankee, hides his unrequited love for Hiroomi, a popular prince, and tries to give up on his love, but... He can't stop blushing in situations with him!? Hiroomi is actually in love with Suminao so much so that his masculinity is on full display!

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: The Wizard and The Tree
synopsis:
The magic tree that grows in Tate's hometown always existed as a safeguard from evil entities and creatures. That is, until Tate came across a runaway slave and began nursing him back to health. Suddenly, this strange man's presence causes a chain of even stranger events to occur, including an attack on the town's magic tree!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Itoshii Bokura
synopsis:
"I am who I am today because of you."

High schooler Ryuu Komiyama is insecure about his looks, and is unable to stand up to his classmates who pick on him. That is, until one day, his beautiful classmate Ema Fukada calls out to him. Ryuu realizes that they were actually good friends in first grade, but tries to distance himself from Ema with the excuse that they are from different worlds.

Ema—who used to be as insecure about his looks as Ryuu—has changed not just physically, but mentally as well. Insisting that this change is all thanks to Ryuu, he starts trying to close the distance between them...

(Source: Julian Publishing, translated)

title: Raidorl Seiken Senki
synopsis:
Raidorl Zain was born and raised as the second prince of the Kingdom of Zain. He lived a peaceful life surrounded by his kind elder brother and loyal vassals, however, his fate completely changed drastically during his coming-of-age ceremony when he was chosen to be the holder of "Dáinsleif," the excalibur (sacred sword) of the royal house. His brother, the first prince, started to hate him as an enemy that threatened his claim to the throne, his vassals and even his own fiancée abandoned him, and he was banished to a town in development at the borders alone. Since then, Raidorl has struggled to survive at the borders that were a monster's domain, gaining the trust of those around him, he found a new happiness with his friends in that poor and harsh life.

However... his fate change once again when the neighboring Arsline Empire started to invade the Kingdom of Zain. Forced by his brother to fight to protect the kingdom from the Empire's invasion, Raidorl decides to plot a rebellion ag

title: Jingai Kenshi wa Chikara ni Miserare Ura Meikyuu wo Kouryaku su: Bakemono Atsukai sareta Moto Boukensha wa, Jibun dake ga Shiru Meikyuu de Hitome wo Ki ni Sezu Musou suru
title_japanese: 人外剣士は力に魅せられ裏迷宮を攻略す～化け物扱いされた元冒険者は、自分だけが知る迷宮で人目を気にせず無双する～

title: Transformers Go! Go!
title_japanese: トランスフォーマーごー！ ごー！

title: Zodiac Girls
synopsis:
Nina the cat lost the Zodiac Race by one spot, and she's held a grudge for millennia. When she forces a divine do-over, unlucky student Cosmo Lee becomes the reluctant referee. His mission? Gather twelve Zodiac Spirits for the ultimate competition. The catch? They've all possessed girls from his school. Can an ordinary boy survive refereeing an extraordinary battle between Heaven-sent superpowered heroines?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Savage Forest
synopsis:
Enya and Tarhan are forever bonded once Enya helps Tarhan's family find peace after a tragic accident. However, their bond is challenged when Tarhan goes from a distrusted outsider to the strong and popular vice chief of Agilea. In a society where a healthy body is considered one's greatest asset, Enya is treated with scorn because of her limp. On top of that, her place as Tarhan's lover is threatened when the princess of an ally tribe offers a marriage alliance in times of impending war. Will Enya and Tarhan's love prevail despite the numerous obstacles in their rocky path?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Scarlet Temptation
synopsis:
Shy and timid Yoo Seoyeong is desperate to get back at Min Jooyeon for ruining her life in high school, no matter how petty the revenge is. So when she sees Seo Jaeha, the gorgeous new department manager of her company and Jooyeon's fiance, she grabs the chance to seduce him into spending a steamy night with her. But what should've been a one-night stand becomes much more tangled as both Seoyeong's body and heart burns for Jaeha's affection. Will she walk out of her revenge plot unscathed? Or will she be scorched by the very fire she started?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: No Marriage, Angel!
title_japanese: 친구의 새어머니가 될 천사가 너무 착해서
synopsis:
I was out shopping for books one day when I was suddenly attacked! But a heaven-sent woman by the name of Chrisya Saldo took it upon herself to save me. She's beautiful, strong, and independent—I want to see her thrive, but she's being forced to marry to save her family business. I can't let some man lock her away—I am Diane of House Harp! My mother is a marquess! I have resources, I have money! Don't worry—I'll save you, my angel!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: For Your Well-Being
synopsis:
With her best interests at heart, Ethan decides to let his first love, Ruellie, wed his faithful knight, Zenon. However, on the day she is set to travel and meet her betrothed's family, tragedy strikes and she is found unconscious with her fiancé having gone missing. Ethan saves Ruellie, but upon waking up finds that not only did she lose her memories, she thinks Ethan is her fiancé! Will he be able to right these wrongs by recovering Ruellie's memories and finding Zenon?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Let's Live Together
synopsis:
After dying in an accident, an ordinary woman wakes up next to her favorite fictional character, the handsome Duke Roan von Bannester. Not only that, but she's now Delisse, his villainous wife! In the novel, they divorce due to Delisse's abuse, but the new Delisse is set on changing this. To try and thaw Roan's infamously icy heart, she showers him with fangirlish affection. But while living together may be her dream come true, can Delisse successfully transition from fangirl to loving wife?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Taeju's Brother, Taehee
synopsis:
With her wedding ruined by the groom's secret girlfriend barging in, Kangwoo crashes at her best friend Taeju's place, not expecting to run into her little brother Taehee in the morning. Despite their awkward first encounter, Kangwoo finds him to be perfect little brother material. But after he protects her from her obsessive ex's harassment, she sees him in a different light. He's tall and good-looking, he's a great cook, he's funny, he's sweet... Wait, has Kangwoo already fallen for Taehee?!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Mimi to Yoru no Rondo wo
title_japanese: みみと夜の舞踏〈ロンド〉を
synopsis:
Noa Yoyogi has always dreamed of being someone special. One day, she meets a fairy named Mimi, but Mimi is actually a demon, and soon Noa encounters a man who claims to be an exorcist...?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Hoshi no Densetsu Agartha
title_japanese: 星の伝説 アガルタ
synopsis:
Remi Tachibana is a girl who adores mysterious phenomena like UFOs - as well as the works of Shotaro Ishimori. One day, while she gushes over UFOs to Ishimori, a young man named Shun Kuroki comes in, wishing to become Ishimori's assistant. Remi and Shun take an immediate liking to each other, and Shun gets accepted. However, a series of strange phenomena begin to occur. Shun also appears to be hiding something as well...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Honey & Mustard 2.5
synopsis: A short story taking place after chapter 3 of Renai♥Joshi-ka.

title: Tenseisha wa Sekenshirazu: Tokuten Skill de Slow Life!?
title_japanese: 転生者は世間知らず ～特典スキルでスローライフ!?～

title: Omae ni Icchan Horetonnen!
title_english: The One I'm Most in Love with Is You.
title_japanese: お前にいっちゃん惚れとんねん!

title: Akumade Taida na Akuyaku Kizoku
title_japanese: あくまで怠惰な悪役貴族

title: Shuffle
synopsis:
Unbeknownst to his classmates, Shin Eunchae was born with a golden spoon in his mouth. He eats only the finest foods, travels in the most extravagant fashion, and has access to things beyond his classmates' wildest imagination. Kang Juwon, on the other hand, is a poor, aspiring actor with the determination to make it big. When Juwon saves Eunchae from dangerous situation with a sunbae, the two grow especially close. There's only one problem—Juwon hates Chaebols! Eunchae's elite background must remain a secret, but things get complicated when Eunchae wants to help Juwon achieve his dream to become an actor. How will Eunchae navigate this new, uncharted territory...?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Blood and Love
synopsis:
Since childhood, Jiwon has been captivated by stories of vampires. He promised himself that if he ever encountered a real one, he would go out of his way to befriend them. Finally, during Jiwon's college years, the opportunity strikes when he witnesses a handsome vampire indulging in a feeding session. Filled with indescribable excitement, Jiwon attempts to approach and even offer his own blood to the vampire. However, to his dismay, the mysterious bloodsucker vanishes in an instant. Disappointed and brimming with unanswered questions, Jiwon attends class the next day only to discover that the man from the previous night is none other than Yoon Seong-hyun, a sunbae in the same class. Will this unexpected revelation set the stage for Jiwon's ultimate dream of forging an extraordinary friendship or, perhaps...something more?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Shell
synopsis:
Shy and unpopular Park Dasom rushes to meet her only friend, the beautiful and adored, Chae Iseul. Instead, she finds Iseul's dead body, or rather, its hollow shell. Dasom enters it and takes over Iseul's seemingly perfect life. But as Dasom discovers horrific family secrets, she wonders where her friend went, and if it was an accident she ended up in Iseul's shell.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Housekeeper's Load
synopsis:
From cooking, to cleaning, to everything in between, Ha-yeon is the perfect housekeeper!

There's just one issue... Woojin, who translates erotic novels for a living, keeps seeing his hottie of a housekeeper in his fantasies! Maybe it's just Woojin's lack of bedroom experience making him sexually frustrated but he's gotta take care of this situation before things get out of hand. Woojin's old friend, the mischievous Sol, sends him something to try to help him out, but when Ha-yeon catches Woojin in a most compromising position with the gift, will this shocking discovery be too big a load for the both of them to bear?!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Secret Therapy
synopsis:
After Jaesung was usurped as top student by Lee Hyun, he lost all his mojo. And this lack of confidence has carried over to his performance in bed as well! Nothing seems to get it up for Jaesung anymore aside from a faceless adult content streamer. What Jaesung doesn't realize, however, is that the streamer who's fixed his impotence is actually the very student who caused it in the first place!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Covert Hearts
synopsis:
When Detective Yoon Yeoul tries to catch a groper on a crowded train, he instead nabs Jeon Taeheon, a prosecutor at the Seoul District Prosecutor's Office. After a rocky first meeting, they hope to never see each other again, but are then unexpectedly made the faces of a PR collaboration between the police and prosecutors. As they navigate their new roles, all kinds of tension flare between them. With sparks flying and their pride at stake, can Yeoul and Taeheon put aside their differences and unravel the mystery behind their puzzling new assignment?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Precious Thing
synopsis:
Ji Geon-woo has been a thief since childhood, surviving with quick hands and sharp instincts. He isn't greedy, stealing is simply a means to an end. One day, he sets his sights on a priceless necklace owned by Lee Yeshin, a troubled rich heir. To get close, Geon-woo infiltrates Yeshin's home as a bodyguard.

At first, Yeshin appears reckless and self-indulgent, but Geon-woo soon realizes he is deeply lonely, suffering from chronic insomnia. As their relationship blurs, Yeshin grows possessive, and Geon-woo finds himself wanting to protect him, rather than just stealing from him.

But when Yeshin discovers Geon-woo's true intentions, their fragile connection shatters. Now, Geon-woo must make a choice, walk away with the necklace or stay for Yeshin. Meanwhile, Ye-shin realizes that the only thing he truly wants isn't wealth, but Geon-woo himself.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Disastrous Romance
synopsis:
I'm going to tell you a story about a failed relationship. I didn't know it would turn out like this. But everyone has a story like this.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Tensei Kaku Gamer: Oji demo Kateru Isekai Kouryaku
title_japanese: 転生格ゲーマー ～オジでも勝てる異世界攻略～
synopsis:
Kairu Mitsushima, a middle-aged fighting game player who had his life changed after meeting Daigo Umehara, a "living legend" of the world of fighting games, is reincarnated into another world after a traffic accident...This world turns out to be a heroic world where battles are fought using fighting-game knowledge and techniques...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Fake Romance
synopsis:
"Do you want to sleep with me?"

Baek Kwon-young doesn't like Nam Juha, no, not at all! But desperate times come for desperate measures especially when Kwon-young's father announces that he wants Juha to become part of the Baek family. If Juha says yes to that proposal, that means Juha'll basically inherit Ilbi Group, the Baek family's conglomerate. Kwon-young has to do anything to stop this from happening. Will Kwon-young's fake romance be successful? What will Juha become? The stepson or the sex partner?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: My Breast Friend
synopsis:
Taeyang and Hee-tae have been best friends since childhood. They go to the same university, live in the same apartment, and spend almost every waking moment together. Hee-tae's whole world revolves around Taeyang, finding himself insanely jealous if anyone else garners Taeyang's attention. Taeyang, however, just finds Hee-tae's obsession with him adorable. One day, out of the blue, Taeyang's nipples begin spontaneously leaking milk and despite his best efforts to conceal it from Hee-tae, his dairy dilemma is quickly discovered. Hee-tae is udderly willing to do whatever it takes to help Taeyang nip this problem in the bud. Can these two take their relationship from best friends to breast friends?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Duke and the Tutor
synopsis:
Despite his common pedigree, Jace was never one to let status get in the way of his success at the imperial academy. Unfortunately, nobles' prejudices can be cruel and the optimistic upstart quickly finds himself without a job or any prospects. That is until he's offered a job as a private tutor for the Duke's family! Is Jace's life finally on the upswing? Or is this new gig too good to be true?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Heart Racer
synopsis:
Kim Shi-yoon and Kang Taesung have always been like oil and water. Shi-yoon, a doctor at a prestigious hospital, could never understand how Taesung would risk his life in competitive motorsports. Taesung, the heir to Fidus Family, found Shi-yoon's obsession with his work more depressing than it was valiant. Yet despite this, the flames of their love somehow burned brighter than the contentions they held. But when their egos get the better of them, Shi-yoon makes the decision to break things off. Three years later, Taesung runs into Shi-yoon again...with no memory of who he is or what they once shared. Determined to jump start their love, Shi-yoon must navigate the seedy underground of Taesung's hidden life in an attempt to make his heart race once again.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Lovesick Dog
synopsis:
"About 14,000 years ago, certain wolves caught a disease called 'lovesickness.' And when they met people, they became their companion dogs."

If one word could encapsulate Noh Ye-gyum, it would be "lovesick." Despite him loving people with all his heart, Ye-gyum finds himself trapped in an endless cycle of being used, betrayed, and ultimately abandoned. This time proves no different for him, as the family of his current "master" Jooyung drives him away to pave the path for Jooyung's advantageous marriage and future spouse. Alone once again, Ye-gyum is left to gather his belongings and leave. Or is he? Suddenly, a mysterious man named Jooin appears, sweeping Ye-gyum away to his home. There, he is fed, clothed, and showered with an overwhelming amount of affection. As Ye-gyum senses the telltale signs of his lovesickness resurfacing, an uncertainty lingers: will this man also leave him, or could he finally hold the cure to this lifelong affliction?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Secretary to Stage
synopsis:
Not everyone is infatuated with their boss like Doyoon. Ever since Gang Taehyuk's days as a 2nd gen idol—a pop star from way back—Doyoon has been obsessed. So, what does he do when Taehyuk retires and establishes an entertainment company to nurture new talent? Naturally, he trains to become Taehyuk's personal secretary, landing the coveted role. But Doyoon's life takes another dramatic turn when a member drops out of a new idol group just about to make their debut. There's no one better suited for the role, and Taehyuk wants Doyoon to step up and fill the spot. Besides, Taehyuk is willing to sweeten the deal with a wish, so looks like Doyoon is gonna have to leave the office and step into the spotlight...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Speak of the Devil
title_japanese: Speak of the devil (스피크 오브 더 데블)
synopsis:
Former playboy Lee Nan is proud to have given up his lascivious ways in favor of building a good career and a stable livelihood. Still, that doesn't make him blind, and he can't help but be attracted to his devilishly handsome boss, Jeong Yiyeon. Of course, he knows that a simple workplace crush is all it will ever be, and so he contents himself with simple flings. Until, that is, a chance meeting in a gay bar awakens a deep attraction that neither of them can deny... From lust to maybe even love, just what will come of this devil's bargain?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Marine Blue no Tansuigyo
title_japanese: マリンブルーの淡水魚
synopsis:
Yusei has lost both parents, while Hanami struggles with her relationship with her mother. Both grew up at the foot of Mount Fuji, and now they're faced with important decisions about their futures. Questions about themselves. About their families. About themselves and their families. After much worry and suffering, what "destination" will they ultimately choose? A gentle, tender human drama.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Battle Aristocracy
title_japanese: バトルアリストクラシー
synopsis:
The daughter of a baron, Alice Nanadan, vows to seek revenge against the "Battle Aristocracy," a system of noble ladies that continues to this day alongside the royal family. In this world, titles are not bestowed by bloodline, but rather by military might. Duels between young ladies eventually became known as "dances," a national pastime, and a major entertainment event that has garnered vast amounts of money. This year, the royal family will host a special dance to determine the bride of the second prince. Suddenly, Alice, a transfer student from an unknown baronial family, appears among the dances and throws herself into battle against the young ladies who are fighting for the throne, carrying the pride of their respective families. Honor, love, and the crown. The battle between these ladies, with everything on the line, is about to begin.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Koufuku no Oishii Michisugara
title_japanese: 幸福のおいしい道すがら

title: All the Way with You
synopsis:
Sooyeon's dating life is non-existent when her cheating ex shows up with wedding invitations and his to-be wife. However, when she's taunted for being single because she won't let a guy go past first base with her, she impulsively lies that she's dating the hottest guy nearby: Jihyeok. Fortunately, Jihyeok plays along and pretends to be her boyfriend, and Sooyeon's pride survives the encounter. However, things take a wild turn when she ends up at Jihyeok's place and goes all the way with him, kickstarting a bond that goes beyond everything she ever dreamed of.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: AMON: Unrelatable
synopsis:
Oswald Quinton, heir to a powerful military company, is well-known for his successful career but also for his brutal personality, a result of his troubled childhood. As Oswald discovers the significance of "Amon," a mineral crucial for his company's survival, he ventures to strike a deal with the landowner who possesses the land containing the vital resource. Initially resistant to selling, the landowner finally agrees under one condition: Oswald must help the landowner's daughter, Yoo Danhee, rediscover the joys of life. Danhee, scarred by her failed marriage, has lost her ability to love. As their paths converge, how will their relationship evolve?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Bloody Moon
synopsis:
Radan should have lived a blessed life as a prince, but a dark curse doomed him to become a killer the moment he was born. And when his mission to assassinate the prince of an enemy nation goes awry, Radan finds himself at the mercy of his target, Crown Prince Leshak. Unaware of Radan's true identity, Leshak shows him kindness instead of cruelty. Now that he's caught between his duty to his family and his blossoming feelings for Leshak, Radan must choose between being a lover or a killer...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Finding Twilight
synopsis:
Creserua is known as the "Twilight Dragon" and the only daughter of the Dragon Lord. The title sounds fancy, but in truth, her physical strength and mana are desperately lacking. She's reconciled with the idea that nothing will change for a dragon as weak as herself, but her expectations are upended when she wakes up one day next to three familiar men: her childhood friend, an estranged faerie, and her demon coworker. Then Creserua discovers she's pregnant, and she has no idea who the father is. Which man is it? More importantly, which man does she want it to be?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Last Cord wa Kimi no Te de
title_english: When You Play the Last Chord
title_japanese: ラストコードは君の手で
synopsis:
Hisashi Kunomiya slipped into the abandoned hotel at midnight, ready to end it all, when the sound of a guitar suddenly broke the silence. There in the darkness, a girl played alone...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Hotel Pharus
synopsis:
After he loses his job and gets dumped by a former flame, Daniel longs to break away from the constant noise of the city. Little does he know that a sudden inheritance in the form of a countryside hotel could be just the quiet escape he needed. But as he works to breathe life into the old hotel, he quickly realizes that it's anything but ordinary. With ghosts supposedly lurking the halls, a mysterious wing that no one is allowed into, and secret dealings behind closed doors, Daniel has his work cut out for him. Still, he's determined to uncover the mysteries of Hotel Pharus, and with the help of a handsome and willing guest upstairs, he may get more than he bargained for. Will he find the answers he's looking for or come to realize that some secrets should stay buried?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: How to Protect My Male Lead
title_english: How to Protect My Male Lead
synopsis:
Overcome with grief, Iris cradles her dying husband, Crown Prince Cedric, who was betrayed by her own bloodline. Suddenly, she's transported to another dimension where Cedric's life is written in a book, and pleads for the power to change the ending. That's when Iris is sent back to the time before her marriage, armed with the knowledge of impending treachery and determined to reshape Cedric and her destiny. As the past unfolds anew, Iris must outmaneuver both her family and the emperor to secure a future for them both. But can she truly alter fate, or is tragedy inescapable?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: How to Train a Good-for-Nothing Rich Boy
title_english: How to Train a Good-for-Nothing Rich Boy
synopsis:
As the spoiled son of a rich businessman, Yi Seo hates the idea of labor. So when his father threatens to cut him off unless he starts working, his first instinct is to run away to Germany. There, a mix-up involving suitcases results in him meeting the handsome Jaeha, who invites him to a bar for some wine. After a surprisingly deep conversation, the two men spend a passionate night together. But eventually, Yi Seo is kidnapped by his father's secretary and taken back to Korea. He then spends his days slacking off at his father's company... until Jaeha joins his department as the new team leader! To Yi Seo's surprise, the man has zero tolerance for his laziness, and threatens to heat things up at work, where people could walk in on them at any minute! Will Jaeha succeed in whipping Yi Seo into a model employee with his torturous yet pleasurable punishments?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: In the Name of the Savior
title_english: In the Name of the Savior
synopsis:
Yvonne Brigejer is an archmage and demidragon, the one human loved by the dragon Roigenkistro. Being a dragon's soulmate is a great privilege, but it also means that she occasionally becomes cold and heartless, just like a dragon. After Yvonne tries to harm her unborn child in a fit of rage, she makes Roigenkistro promise that he will protect her child and her lover, Jeye. But when Roigenkistro fails to keep that promise and Jeye dies, she decides to end her life as well. Sadly, instead of being reunited with Jeye in the afterlife, Yvonne wakes up in a world where no one remembers that she and Jeye were lovers and Roigenkistro is gone. Will Yvonne be able to overcome her sadness and find out what happened to the man and the dragon she loved?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Lustfully
synopsis:
As the second daughter of the affluent Daeju Group family, Yoon Seung-ah should have a perfect life of luxury. However, the dismal truth is that she has experienced nothing but contempt and restriction simply for being an illegitimate child. Then, one day, in a strange twist of events, Seung-ah meets Ki Taejun from the KCT Group, who wants to strike up a deal in exchange for helping her regain her freedom and sense of self. And for the first time, she decides to give in to her impulses which sets in motion an array of complications and desires…

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Miracle Illusion
synopsis:
Ever since his eighth birthday, Yeonwoo has been the target of cruel bullying by his classmates. It was a well-known fact that he was poor, smelly, and living with his grandma. But with the new transfer student Seongwoon's dramatic appearance, he gains his first real friend. Just as Yeonwoo starts getting used to his new happy life, Seongwoon and his parents are in a tragic accident that leaves him orphaned with no memories. Now, it's Yeonwoo's turn to take care of the precious person who gifted him so many of his "firsts"—even if Seongwoon doesn't remember a single one.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: My Sister's Happy Ending
synopsis:
Yoon Bom-bit loves dating sims, with her recent obsession being a game that stars Anette de Valois. She would do anything to give Anette the best ending, if it wasn't for the heroine's twisted stepsister, Mariette, foiling her plans. That is, until Bom-bit gets transported into the game as the villainous sibling herself! Will this incredible chance finally allow Bom-bit to help Anette get the happy ending of her dreams?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Metamorphosijin
synopsis: The story of an otherwise "average" office worker discovering her true potential.

title: Osananajimi no Seiheki Yugamemashita
title_japanese: 幼馴染の性癖歪めました

title: JK to Hobo Muriyari de Tejou Play suru Hon
title_japanese: JKとほぼ無理矢理で手錠プレイする本

title: Takihara-kun wa Watashi no Kokoro ga Yomeru kara Zurui
title_japanese: 滝原くんは私の心が読めるからズルい

title: Konki Girigiri Sister, Semete Shojo wo Sutetai.
title_english: The Nun on the Verge of Marriagle Age.
title_japanese: 婚期ぎりぎりシスター、せめて処女を捨てたい。

title: Couple Boukensha: Kuro to Roza
title_japanese: カップル冒険者クロとロザ
synopsis:
Kuro, a witch-doctor, and Rosa, a warrior, are a boyfriend-girlfriend adventurer party. They can handle subjugation quests without difficulty, but lately Rosa has something on her mind...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Wakeari Taimashi wa Tensei Succubus to Shi wo Kaketa Koi wo Suru
title_japanese: ワケアリ退魔師は転生サキュバスと死を賭けた恋をする

title: Bakunyuu Yuutousei ni Hitsuyou na Chinpo no Obenkyou
title_japanese: 爆乳優等生に必要なちんぽのお勉強
synopsis:
Akane wants to keep her cool around her boyfriend, but that's difficult when she's sexually inexperienced. When she confides in her home tutor, he says that all she has to do is get used to sex, and who's a better practice partner than this old man?

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Majigami: Kamikura-san wa Kamiguse ga Aru
title_japanese: まじがみ ～神倉さんは噛みグセがある～

title: Uchi no Tantou Idol ga Ero Sugite Komaru
title_japanese: ウチの担当アイドルがエロすぎて困る

title: Tsuihou sareta Akuyaku Reijou wa Danzai wo Mankitsu suru
title_japanese: 追放された悪役令嬢は断罪を満喫する

title: Yankee Haiyuu, Ecchi na Engi Shidou saretemasu.
title_english: I'll Act, But I Never Said I'd Do That!
title_japanese: ヤンキー俳優、えっちな演技指導されてます。
synopsis:
"I'll help you with your 'special training'!"

Aspiring actor, Tetsu, spends day after day auditioning for roles, but is turned down due to his delinquent personality, leaving him with little choice but to lodge with his long time friend, Satoshi, who is a popular scriptwriter. Finally, a shot at a lead role presents itself to a disparaged Tetsu, but the offer turns out to be for a "man on man romance" movie. Being attracted to men himself, Satoshi offers Tetsu his guidance to help him get into character, but ends up getting jeered at...

Clearly irritated, Satoshi says, "Fine. I'll help you out as an 'experiment'. Why don't we give it a try?" And with that, the two friends cross a line they never thought they would... all because of a movie!

A cool-headed, popular writer meets an idiotic delinquent actor in this heart-pounding sensual story!

(Source: Renta!)

title: Treasure Hunter
synopsis:
Jinho and Chundo are two best friends wasting their summer days away. But when they find a lottery ticket on the street by chance, they're thrown into a mysterious treasure hunt with two strange girls they don't fully understand.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Treasure Hunter 2
synopsis: Part 2 of Treasure Hunter.

title: Treasure Hunter 3
synopsis: Part 3 of Treasure Hunter.

title: Let Me Tag Along
synopsis:
The gold dragon has taken many human forms over the years in his games. His last game ended in "death." But when the human he'd befriended in his last game summons him, both are surprised. Mikhail can't unsee his dead friend Adrian in the dragon, while the dragon feigns ignorance, agreeing to help Mikhail find Adrian's body. While pondering his past lives, the dragon lingers on memories with Mikhail at the academy. But Mikhail isn't the only one from a past game to catch up with him.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Someone Hertz
synopsis:
Mimei shares the hobby of listening to a late-night comedy radio show with the funny and mysterious Kurage from his class. And she's famous for sending in hilarious comments that are read on the show? But Mimei wants to be just as funny as her! Are they friends, are they rivals, are they something more...? This radio rom-com is on the air!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Someone Hertz
synopsis:
Mimei shares the hobby of listening to a late-night comedy radio show with the funny and mysterious Kurage from his class. And she's famous for sending in hilarious comments that are read on the show? But Mimei wants to be just as funny as her! Are they friends, are they rivals, are they something more...? This radio rom-com is on the air!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Crush
synopsis:
Kyo is a college student living alone in Tokyo, completely absorbed in making rap beats. One day, his childhood friend Mana from back home shows up at his door. As they suddenly find themselves living together, Kyo must confront both his conflicted feelings and his music.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Kocchi Muite Glare
synopsis:
While going home from his part-time job, Zen, a normal guy, is suddenly transported to an unknown world. There, he meets a silver-haired man who hides his eyes, and learns that he's now in a parallel universe. Zen is a simple man. He doesn't understand what's happening, nor does he understand the existence of "doms" and "subs," but he's entranced by the man's glare...and he can't get enough of his commands.

(Source: MU, edited)

title: After the Tale
synopsis:
Saya suddenly loses a year's worth of memories. She begins living with her guardian, a man called Touji, but she can't shake the feeling that there's something off about who she used to be...

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Cheoyong: A Ghostly Romance
synopsis:
An unexpected ghostly romance.

Jaehee, who has been able to see ghosts his entire life, will do anything for money. So he doesn't miss an opportunity when he hears of Cheoyong, the ghost able to grant any and all sorts of fortunes. Instead, what he finds is a sleepwalking girl possessed by Cheoyong... What is this all about?

(Source: Manta)

title: The Script
synopsis:
Revenge 13 years in the making.

To reverse a curse put on her and her brother, Yeju has been searching for the shaman responsible for 13 long years. When the heir to the Tiger Clan, Heewu, sets Yeju up in order to steal her sword, the two realize that they have the same objective. But is this new man friend or foe?

(Source: Manta)

title: Moon Shark: From Underwater Princess to Celebrity
title_english: Moon Shark: From Underwater Princess to Celebrity
synopsis:
Sid, who is a Shark Princess of the underwater kingdom, falls in love with Raun, a member of the boy band BUB, and runs away to the surface to see him. Things are going great until the famous teen actor, Jihan Kang, steps into her life unexpectedly and they keep crossing paths. Will Sid be able to keep her secret and get what she came up to the surface for?

(Source: Manta)

title: Ranpo Amnesia: 21-banme no Jinkaku
title_japanese: 乱歩アムネシア 二十一番目の人格

title: Make Heroine ni Tensei shitara Seijo ni Narimashita
title_english: I Became a Saint When I Was Reincarnated as a Losing Heroine.
title_japanese: 負けヒロインに転生したら聖女になりました
synopsis:
I don't care if I'm a defeated heroine, I want to live quietly in the village!

...But neither my childhood friend nor the Demon King will let me escape! One day, Rachel realizes that this is the world of the fantasy game she played in her previous life, and that she is the defeated heroine. She begins to do what she can to avoid an unfortunate future, but...

(Source: Jitsugyo no Nihonsha, translated)

title: Netoge no Seibetsu wa Sensaku NG desu!
title_japanese: ネトゲの性別は詮索NGです!
synopsis:
Reiji Shishido, heir to a major conglomerate, is a high school student who fell in love in an MMO. Due to an in-game event, he proposed to and married Sakura, whom he had feelings for. However, he finds out that coincidentally, Sakura's real identity is the delinquent in his class, Ryougo Asakura?

Heir x delinquent's online and real lives blend together in this pure youthful BL comedy.

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Shinitakunai node Eiyuu-sama wo Sodateru Koto ni Shimasu
title_english: I Don't Want to Die, So I'm Going to Raise a Hero
title_japanese: 死にたくないので英雄様を育てる事にします
synopsis:
A university student named Nao Osaka reincarnates as the villainous young master Lian in a game. He is tasked with raising the future hero Alfred into a capable man and making him fulfill his mission to save the world. Despite Lian's efforts to be disliked, it has no effect... In fact, Alfred seems to like him...!? While Lian grows increasingly anxious, Alfred keeps getting closer and closer...!?

"Hey, is it okay if I touch you more?"

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Oshi ni Ninchi shite Morau Tame ni Idol Hajimemashita.
title_japanese: 推しに認知してもらうためにアイドル始めました。
synopsis:
A love and idol story about a nationally-favorite male idol and a newbie female idol, both of whom share unrequited love!

Komari Fumino is a girl who started her idol career in order to gain recognition from her favorite national idol, Nai-sama. Komari works hard as a new idol, but in fact, her only fan, a socially awkward boy, is actually Nai-sama in disguise!! And what's more, Nai-sama mistakes Komari for someone else's favorite...!?

(Source: Kill Time Communication, translated)

title: Love Me, Revive Me
synopsis:
For his entire life, Chae Jeong-hyeon has lived as nothing more than a shadow, an art restorer forced into the role of hidden ghost painter for his father, the celebrated Painter Chae. When the old master dies suddenly, Jeong-hyeon’s long-nurtured desire for revenge dies with him, leaving only despair and the urge to abandon everything.

But on the edge of surrender, a stranger appears: Yeom Tae-hwa, a man caught between mortal and divine.

Tae-hwa offers Jeong-hyeon a bargain. Restore what has been lost and share his roof, and in return, he will grant Jeong-hyeon the honor stolen by his father. Reluctantly, Jeong-hyeon agrees, clinging to the fragile hope Tae-hwa extends.

Yet as the days pass, cold obligation begins to blur into fascination. Living side by side, Jeong-hyeon is drawn closer to Tae-hwa’s enigma… and to the haunting secret hidden within his 200-year-old silence.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Mahiru no Yuurei
synopsis:
Inami, whose older brother doesn't go to school, and Kiyokawa, whose older sister doesn't go to school, both became the class pet caretakers when they were in fifth grade. Each carrying their own burdens, the two had supported each other through their daily lives. But then one day, an unexpected incident occurs…

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Ousama Game
synopsis:
Yui and Yoshimaru, who revived the rhythmic gymnastics club that was on the verge of being disbanded, gradually become attracted to each other. However, Yoshimaru, who is being lauded as a young star in Peking opera, gradually becomes a distant person to Yui... What will happen to their love!?

(Source: MU)

title: Kunoichi Indochuu: Yuzuha Kikyou-hen
title_japanese: くのいち淫道中～ゆず葉帰郷編～

title: Zatoichi Monogatari Noir
synopsis:
Just before the end of Edo period, under the Tenpou era. Inflation, rice shortages, political corruption, epidemics... In a world where common people suffer, a swordsman who has lost his sight and an Akita dog journey together in pursuit of "justice" and "strength." Where did they come from, and where are they heading? At the end of their path, will they find light—or darkness?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: One-Way Romance
synopsis:
Jae-hwan is an ambitious reporter. Whilst struggling to find an exclusive story, he hears a rumor that the successful Taeryong Group was in fact secretly related to the notorious Hong Kong mafia. In order to do some digging and to find some evidence of their connection, Jae-hwan goes to the Taeryong rooftop party and unintentionally becomes involved with Liu Yuan, the mafia boss. Will Jae-hwan be able to get the scoop from this heartless mobster? What is the secret connection between these two Hong Kong giants?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Stargazing
synopsis:
Reaching for the stars!

When his friend Byeol confesses that he likes someone else, Junseo is more confused than ever about his own feelings. While lost in thought, he's suddenly dragged off by a new "Mr. Byeol" to the oddest club on campus. Can this new star finally put a twinkle in Junseo's eye?

(Source: Manta)

title: Neap Tide
synopsis:
The sun or the moon. Who do I choose?

Ever since they were little, Sewoon believed that he and his best friend Dobin only had each other. But when a rift between them makes room for the newcomer, Daebum, Sewoon's torn on who to choose: the beautiful but cold Dobin, or the warm and inviting Daebum?

(Source: Manta)

title: Kiss of Damnation
synopsis:
I'm not here for love.

Siyoon's been crushing hard on his high school tutor, Woohyun, and finally works up the courage to confess to him after graduation. Woohyun's answer? "Let's be friends with benefits." One night, Kyunghoo sees Siyoon and Woohyun about to kiss outside a motel, stirring up something within him...

(Source: Manta)

title: A Holey Mission
synopsis:
Kim Gyojoo is a cult leader, a scammer, and a man who likes his money easy and his work easier. But one day, a bizarre quest is dropped on him by the heavens: get ravaged by ten of his own believers in three days or die. He has no interest in men, but he has even less interest in dying. Now he's bargaining, scheming, and gritting his teeth for the most humiliating survival mission of his life.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: 3 Days
synopsis:
Jeong Jiho is a low-ranking gangster faced with a life-threatening dilemma. He must have public sex with Choi Heeseong within three days, or he will die. But how is he supposed to get it on with a man, much less the underboss of a rival gang? He'll have to find a way, even if it means opening himself up to new options...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Work On Hold
synopsis:
Ahn Siyoung has waited for years for the day he becomes old enough to ask out his crush, Seo Dohyun. That day finally comes when Siyoung starts interning at Dohyun's company, albeit with a strange mission: "Have sex with your crush in the office, or you will die." Even though this is Siyoung's long-awaited chance at love, is this really the right way to go about it...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: S-Toxin
synopsis:
Plagued with splitting headaches, Jimin finds a doctor who diagnoses him with terrible news: he will die in three days unless he consumes someone else's load. Jimin dismisses this as a quack doctor's perverted scheme... until he wakes up to a mysterious screen counting down to his death. Seeing that the screen also states the same cure as the doctor did, Jimin decides to swallow the truth and the cure. Thus begins a series of steamy encounters that will save and change Jimin's life entirely.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Play to Be Gay
synopsis:
Woo-un is a member of an unsuccessful idol group about to end their contract for good. As a final bid to save their careers, the group resorts to enacting gay fanservice to boost their popularity. When Woo-un is paired with fellow group member Jaesam to play-act as a couple, he's secretly delighted. He has a crush on Jaesam, and this is the perfect opportunity to sneak in some justified physical affection. However, Jaesam seems reluctant to play along. Will they be able to save their careers this way? And is there more at stake than Woo-un is aware of?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: The Seductive Storyteller
title_japanese: 전기수 밥 빌어먹는 구멍은 삼천 가지라_떡방아전
synopsis:
Kang Hoe-yoon is the most captivating storyteller in all of Joseon. Wherever he goes, crowds gather to hear his thrilling tales. But he feels self-conscious whenever he notices the handsome Shin Eunro in the audience, an aristocrat he harbors a secret crush on. However, one day, Eunro approaches Hoe-yoon with a bizarre request. Eunro wants him to teach his future wife the "art of love," fearing she's too innocent for marriage. Will this be Hoe-yoon's chance to get closer to his crush, or will it be a disaster that leaves him heartbroken?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Bad Plan
synopsis: Ren has the biggest crush on his team lead... until the tables turn.

title: Prayers of the Vulgar
synopsis:
The servant of God, Saharo, breaks the biggest rule for an angel when she momentarily sympathizes with Evil. After letting Evil escape from heaven's grasp, Saharo loses her angelic wings and won't be able to reascend until she destroys the dark enemy once and for all. There's just one problem: her target is reincarnated as a human boy named Yannick Unbrey. While angels have the power to eliminate Evil, they are forbidden from ever killing a human being. Thus, Saharo's only choice is to watch over the boy and make sure the darkness within him never awakens. But the older Yannick gets, the more he becomes tainted by the wicked nature of the world. Will Saharo be able to protect Yannick from his slumbering demon, or will she end up giving in to its sinful call with him?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Reeling in the Male Lead
synopsis:
What's a girl to do when a problematic fave ends up as the catch of the day? After a long hospitalization in her past life, Yuri is thrilled to wake up on a mysterious island feeling fit and healthy. She even gets a reprieve from lonely island life in the form of a handsome man fished out of the ocean! But when she discovers the charming prince is destined to become the tyrannical male lead from one of her favorite romance novels, it's up to Yuri to keep him from going bad... no matter what it takes!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Ashita, Kimi no Mono ni Shite: More
title_english: Tomorrow, I Want You to Make Me Yours. More
title_japanese: 明日、きみのものにして more
synopsis:
Yuki, a shy and inconspicuous presence in class, and Hayato, the popular central figure admired by both boys and girls, are lovers.

Due to a small misunderstanding, it took them a while to reach their first intimate moment, but now they can't keep their hands off each other, indulging in passionate encounters every time they meet.

Despite their lovey-dovey relationship, Hayato is concerned about the toll it's taking on Yuki's body. On top of that, they're facing a pile of problems, including career path dilemmas and the risk of Yuki's dad finding out about their relationship.

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: I Became the Young Wife of the Male Lead of a Martial Arts Novel
title_english: I Became the Young Wife of the Male Lead of a Martial Arts Novel
title_japanese: 무협지 남주의 어린 아내가 되어 버렸다
synopsis:
As the transmigrated ancestor of Doyool, her favorite novel character, Seolryeon tries to arrange everything to make his life easier. But when she reincarnates as Yerin, his young bride, she finds that something has gone wrong over the years. The Frost Palace has fallen on hard times, and its people are suffering. Together with her new husband, she must right wrongs and root out the corruption that has befallen this once-great family. But how much can two young people do alone?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: I Didn't Mean to Send That, Sir!
title_english: I Didn't Mean to Send That, Sir!
synopsis:
A scandalous text meant for an ex-boyfriend mistakenly lands Seohae in hot water with her handsome, cold boss. His ultimatum—a contract marriage for his dying grandmother. Caught between office friction and unexpected family warmth, she navigates a bewildering path toward an unforeseen love.

(Source: Manta)

title: Keishichou Majuu Taisakushitsu: Ookami Keiji to Mezame no Kenja
title_english: Detective Wolf and the Awakening Sage
title_japanese: 警視庁魔獣対策室 狼刑事と目覚めの賢者
synopsis:
The story is set in Japan, 700 years after the age of swords and magic, where science has replaced magic. Social problems caused by magic and magical beasts are on the rise, and the Metropolitan Police Department establishes the Metropolitan Police Department's Magical Beast Control Division to deal with them. Kamishima, a werewolf (lycanthrope), is investigating a horrific case as a detective in the Magical Beast Control Division.

Meanwhile, the great elven sage Sajuel, who had been asleep for 700 years in preparation for the return of the Demon King, wakes up. However, the Demon King was resurrected and defeated 40 years ago. Sajuel is shocked to learn this, but he lends his wisdom to the Magical Beast Control Division and begins investigating with Kamishima and the others. A fantasy of magic and police unfolds.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Romance Is Dead
synopsis:
Luce Granzia was a Cinderella that almost was. But just a night before the wedding, her engagement is broken off and she finds herself guilty for something she hasn't done. Her life plummets, and Luce finds a job at the national laboratory in order to pay back a mountain of debt. Five years later, she's build for herself a new life, new relationships—but with the crown prince's orders, she must head back into high society.

(Source: NHN comico)

title: The Emperor's Sleepless Nights
synopsis:
Chloe thought Luke's revenge was just, as her own father had killed his father. That is why when she is brought back to the past, she decides to accept her tragic fate. But suddenly and unexpectedly, Luke's most trusted knight approaches her.

"He won't be able to kill you, so escape as if you're dead." She is convinced by Luke and decides to flee with him, thinking there will no longer be any obstacles as long as she fakes her own death, until...

"Your life belongs to me."

Chloe and Luke's paths cross again when they meet as the insomniac emperor and the pharmacist who concocts his sleeping pills. With a completely new identity, Chloe no longer looks the same, yet Luke is instinctively drawn to her. Will Chloe be able to escape death and become happy again?

(Source: NHN comico)

title: The Return of the Ex-Wife
synopsis:
Annis, a knight, married Marquis Devon Pizetra out of respect for her late mother's wish. As the lady of the house, she brought wealth to the family by successfully managing the finances. However, the incapable husband Devon spends her hard-earned money on his ex-wife, who is pregnant with his child. Devon asks Annis for a divorce but forces her to stay on the estate and continue to manage family businesses.

When Annis was broken by her husband's betrayal, she encounters Rowan, an old acquaintance and fellow knight who seems to have feelings for her that's been kept hidden for a long time.

(Source: NHN comico)

title: Moto Yuusha wa Monster Musume ni Yararetai
title_english: The Former Hero Is a Monster Girl Masochist
title_japanese: 元勇者はモンスター娘に敗られたい
synopsis:
Phil, a former hero, is now a forty-something-year-old adventurer...and he was still a virgin. Why? That was because he's only turned on by monster girls! Since he can't let anyone know about his fetish, he decided that he'll try to make it look like he's fighting with monster girls but be defeated by them. Succubus, slime, alraune (bewitching flower) ...he loves all of them!!! If he was defeated, they would do dirty things to him like this and like that...that was something he'd been dreaming all his life. Can he make his dream come true and have sex with one of them!?

(Source: Kadokawa)

title: Hikage no Amir: Tsuihou sarete Musou suru Saikyou Yumitsukai
title_japanese: 日陰のアミル 追放されて無双する最強弓使い
synopsis:
Amir Waker is an archer who's been banished from the S-Rank party "The Band of Prodigies," which mainly consisted of nobles. He then falsified his identity and registered himself as an F-Rank adventurer. He took an escort quest to the countryside. The quest was supposed to be an easy task for him as a former S-Rank. But surprisingly, the client of this quest is none other than the 3rd princess who's being targeted for some certain reasons! Will Amir be able to escort the princess safely from the strongest knights division of the kingdom? Amir is thus dragged into the political struggles and conflicts of the kingdom.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Teach Me How to Please You
title_english: Teach Me How to Please You
synopsis:
From cooking skills to blowjob techniques, it's Chang-nam's job to make sure the robots at his training facility know how to act both in and outside the bedroom. But teaching these robots how to please their masters proves to be more complicated than programming a few commands...

(Souce: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Nonbiri-jou no Chokomaka-hime
title_japanese: のんびりじょうのちょこまかひめ
synopsis:
Princess Chokomaka ("restless"—her real name is Princess Chocolate Cream) is a princess who lives in Laid-Back Castle with her parents, the king and queen. Princess Choko gets into lots of shenanigans, giving everybody a hard time. She can't settle down in one place—whatever she does, chaos follows!

(Source: 5MENP)

title: Yamabiko
synopsis:
1. Ousama to Majo
2. Toubou Zenya
3. Yoru no Obake
4. Yamabiko
5. Yomise

title: Shinimodori Koujo wa Kurikaesu Sekai wo Owarasetai
title_english: She Who Returned from Death Wishing to End the Repeating World
title_japanese: 死に戻り公女は繰り返す世界を終わらせたい

title: A Beloved Existence
synopsis:
Soyou, who was a promising track and field athlete, lost everything due to acute heart disease. She was sentenced to death but miraculously survives with a heart donation. She loses everything she had built up and returns to high school a year later than her peers, but it is not easy for her to make friends or pursue her dreams. Then, in the new semester of the second year, the moment she sees a boy in the classroom, her heart suddenly races, and she feels like crying... The man she met in her dream that night introduces himself as the owner of the transplanted heart and the father of the boy she saw for the first time today. Isn't that something? His son, Jaeha, has lost his entire family and is alone in this world... At the man's request, Soyou gives Jaeha a message of support, and with each action, precious people are found in Soyou's empty life—reasons for life, relationships, and dreams. Soyou progresses slowly, but one by one, she learns how to live.

(Source: MU)

title: Guild no Zatsuyougakari ga Shin no Kuromaku deshita: Kakureta Sainou de Anyaku Musou
title_english: Guild Handyman? More like Mastermind! Using My Hidden Skills in the Shadows
title_japanese: ギルドの雑用係が真の黒幕でした～隠れた才能で暗躍無双～
synopsis:
Unassuming, hard to notice, downright plain—that's how Tenes Lumel's coworkers at the adventurers' guild describe him. As the guild's handyman, he tackles the boring paperwork and menial labor, all while clocking out on time from his quiet job in the boonies. But the low profile he keeps by day hides a darker truth. In reality, Tenes is the mastermind behind a secret organization singularly determined to upend the twisted rules that govern the world. Exiled from a great noble house and abandoned by God, he won't stop until he's dismantled the system. From the shadows come powerful allies to stand by his side: a battle-hardened maid, an infamous bandit, and a legendary dark elf. Together, they're plotting their next move behind the scenes—and Tenes has more than a few tricks up his sleeve to set the stage.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

It is 1866, the third year of King Gojong's reign. It is also the second year Gyeom has been waiting for his lover, Jung, who left to learn and study about literature by himself. Finally, Jeong has come back after the two years. He tells Gyeom he can not afford to be happy in Joseon, and decides to leave for Qing (China)...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

title: To My Beloved Foe
synopsis:
On the cusp of calamity, the dead have risen! Corpses that have long grown cold return to steal warmth from the living, and the natural order dangles by a single thread of fate—a pair of lovelorn enemies tethered intrinsically by ice and fire. Together, Selena and Millard may yet salvage an era that's torn between bitter frost and scorching flame. They must enter the enigmatic Magic Tower with only one another to rely on, knowing they may never return…

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: My Childhood Friends are Trying to Kill Me
title_english: My Childhood Friends are Trying to Kill Me
synopsis:
I was reborn into my favorite novel as Lelia, a tragic side character. Sent to a royal academy as a decoy, I befriend four princes fated to slay a dragon. Years later, they return as heroes, only to accuse me of murder! How can I reclaim their shattered trust?

(Source: Manta)

title: Outis
synopsis:
Sian Lee is fated to die in May, the same month her family was massacred. As the curse draws near, a dangerous man named Gon Tae offers to save her.

"Say it," he whispers. "Tell me you want to live." In his obsession, all he asks in return is a promise to share life and death with him.

(Source: Manta)

title: The Matchmaker Gets Matched!
synopsis:
I brought the slowest couple in the universe together and finally got them engaged, but they called the engagement off on the day of the ceremony itself! I was reborn as the male lead's younger sister in a fantasy romance novel. But the female lead's older brother, Aiberg Rafaello, has a severe sister complex and would not let go of his sister. So, how do I make him stop obsessing over his sister? Find him a love interest.

"What kind of person do you like, your grace?" "I like someone with blazing-red hair and eyes like the flame, a lady who never stands down for anybody. Speaking of which... I'd say you match the description." I was only trying to save the lead characters' engagement. How did I end up flirting with the female lead's brother?

(Source: NHN comico)

title: My Otherworldly Marriage
synopsis:
Determined to escape her fate in the novel of being sold off to a loathsome man by her father, Beatrice Arosha runs off to the second male lead, Duke Ruslan Etenas, and proposes a contract marriage. After he immediately agrees, Beatrice moves into Etenas Castle, built on a sealed spirit gate and staffed by ghosts! But as she grows closer to the duke and experiences visions of the original Beatrice, she begins to realize the haunted castle may not be the strangest thing about her marriage...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Dame Skill "Auto Mode" ga Kakusei shimashita: Are, Guild no Scout no Minasan, Ore wo "Iranai" tte Ittemasen deshita?
title_japanese: ダメスキル【自動機能〈オートモード〉】が覚醒しました～あれ、ギルドのスカウトの皆さん、俺を「いらない」って言ってませんでした?～
synopsis:
Young Claus has been gifted with a skill called Auto Mode. It is an extremely rare skill, and he was so pleased when first received it... Yet, the skill's abilities [Auto Return] for "only to go home" and [Auto Travel] for "only to go to places that have been visited" are completely useless abilities for both combat and making money! However... the now leveled-up Claus has come to know the true nature of Auto Mode! This is a turnabout story from the bottom!!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Omoi Ai♡Monopolize
title_japanese: おもいあい♡モノポライズ

title: Sword Art Online Alternative: Gourmet Seekers
title_japanese: ソードアート・オンライン オルタナティブ グルメ・シーカーズ
synopsis:
"I'm not interested in attacking Aincrad! I aim to open a diner!"

Yuzu and Hina, a brother and sister who are new to the game and just wanted to experience cooking in a VRMMO, are trapped in Sword Art Online. The choice they made was to master the "Cooking" skill! Together with other players who also love to cook, they form a party called the "Food Quest Group." They spend their days devoted to cooking, completing quests that reward them with delicious ingredients and rare cooking utensils, and trying to recreate modern Japanese cuisine. Spending their days entirely on cooking, they open a food stall. The menu is so ingenious that it has even captured the stomachs of the most determined players!

A laid-back gourmet quest life in the world of SAO begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Hokuou Bishoujo no Classmate ga, Konyakusha ni Nattara Deredere no Amaama ni Natteshimatta Ken ni Tsuite
title_japanese: 北欧美少女のクラスメイトが、婚約者になったらデレデレの甘々になってしまった件について
synopsis:
"Renjou-kun, I want you to be my fiancé."

Tooru Renjou, who, at a bookstore, helped Aino Luthi—the Nordic beauty renowned as the school's cutest— is suddenly asked to become her fiancé. At first, it was merely a request to avoid an arranged marriage, but once Aino learned that her partner is to be Tooru, she suddenly becomes eager for the marriage…!?

This is the story of two people who were supposed to be only fiancés for the sake of formality, but who gradually come to understand each other and eventually become true lovers.

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)

title: La Mèche
synopsis:
Ha-seon, burdened by a crippling appearance complex, finally visits a plastic surgery clinic with the money he's been saving up. But when the merciless sound of "insufficient balance" dashes his hopes, he turns in despair to a loan company as his last resort. And there, he encounters Si-gyeon, a man so beautiful he seems almost like an angel...

"Even if you're going to leave, you'd better give me a taste before you go."

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: An Uneventful Neighborhood
synopsis:
When Taeyul moves to a quiet new town, strange things start happening—a bus drives itself, food is served in a restaurant with no staff, and the sky changes color with the flicker of a streetlight. And each time, a mysterious man chides and saves him before disappearing. But who, or what, could he be?

(Source: Manta)

title: Karnak, Monarch of Death
synopsis:
I was the ruler of death. However, it took me a century to realize one truth: To truly live as a human, you can't ever attempt to rule over such things. 

(Source: Wuxiaworld)

title: Scandalous M
synopsis:
Chanbit Han: award winning actor, trendsetter, and all-around nice guy... at least on the surface. As his manager and best friend, Baekyung knows the real Chanbit. Sure, he's kind and gentle but, in the bedroom, he's anything but. When Chanbit was starting his career, he fell in love with Youngha Do, entrepreneur and Chanbit's guide into the depths of BDSM. Now Youngha's back and is the CEO of Chanbit's entertainment agency. Torn between Youngha and Baekyung, will he follow his heart or his career?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Sweet Spooky Darling
synopsis:
Mature comic creator, Yuzu Woo, just wanted to move into her new apartment in peace. Too bad it's haunted... by a handsome young ghost?! Taeil Jung is twenty-six, err... was anyways. He's sweet, even if a bit of a ghastly goof but, to Yuzu, he's just super spooky! She tries to ignore him but soon she finds him haunting not only her apartment, but her heart. They say the home is where the heart is, but does it count if your roommate is dead?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Tsuitekuru
synopsis:
Seishiro Sakaki leads an unremarkable college life. One day, a beautiful woman with elegant features moves in across from his boarding house. As Sakaki's feelings for her grow, his affection slowly takes a dark and twisted turn...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

1. Furuhon to Shoujo (The Secondhand Book)
2. Uwasa no Bushi (The Phony Warrior)
3. Fushigi na Tegami (A Strange Letter)
4. Suikazake (Watermelon Sake)
5. Jonin (The Ninjess)

title: Arijigoku
synopsis:
1. Arijigoku (The Antlion Pit)
2. Tejou (Handcuffs)
3. Fushigi na E (An Unusual Painting)
4. Tsuya (The Wake)
5. Hatsutakegari (Mushroom Hunting)
6. Unmei (Destiny)
7. Chiiko (Chirpy)

title: The Possessed Acting Prodigy
synopsis:
Struggling actor Kim Hyeonsu suddenly gains a strange ability after an accident: he can dream the dreams of the dead. These aren't hazy nightmares or random visions, but vivid relivings of emotions and experiences that don't belong to him. When Hyeonsu channels those experiences into his roles, his acting becomes terrifyingly real, as if he's truly possessed. But how far can a haunted genius go before the dreams start consuming him?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Tale of the Skeleton Messenger
title_english: The Tale of the Skeleton Messenger
synopsis:
120 years have passed since the First Emperor's death. Venlyra, a powerful rogue and trusted herald of the Emperor, awakens from a long slumber to a crumbling empire that has strayed from the light. Once more, the Skeleton Messenger makes the rounds, bound for a decaying throne, and for the embers of a self long thought extinguished within. Hear ye, hear ye! Hark, and heed the Emperor's words! The hour of reckoning is upon you!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Norowanaide! Noroizaki-san
title_japanese: 呪わないで! 呪崎さん

title: Koi ga Mienai
synopsis:
The target of Ougi's one-sided affections says they should have sex to chase away an evil spirit...?!

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: #Kanagawa ni Sunderu Elf
synopsis:
2 years ago, the elves who lived in the hidden forest lost their homes due to a forest fire, now they are living in the Kanagawa Prefecture.

This story however focuses on a human who becomes the roommate of an elf living in an apartment.

(Source: MU)

title: If It's Remorse You Desire
synopsis:
Catherine Caliburn, a duke's daughter marked by tainted blood, desperately tries to end her engagement to Grand Duke Deimos Pendragon to keep her true origins a secret, but the Grand Duke has no intention of letting her go as he seeks revenge for her betrayal in his past life.

(Source: Manta)

title: License to Spill
synopsis:
When Hester, manager at Collateral, is left in charge after the owner's sudden disappearance, she learns the bar is a spy hangout and every patron is after intel on a mysterious fugitive named Jackal. Problem is, Hester's now forced to bluff her way through as dangerously suave spies flirt in for secrets she doesn't have—and her life's on the line.

(Source: Manta)

title: The Beastly Count After Dark
synopsis:
Violetta, striving to support her sister after losing their parents, encounters Theobald, an enigmatic aristocrat who irrevocably alters her life. Taking on the role as Theobald's maid, Violetta navigates treacherous waters filled with political intrigue and forbidden desires.

As Violetta and Theobald's relationship deepens amidst a backdrop of betrayal and manipulation, Violetta grapples with her conflicting loyalties and the moral ambiguity of her role as both confidante and pawn in a dangerous game.

(Source: NHN comico)

title: The Demon Who Kisses My Foot
title_english: The Demon Who Kisses My Foot
synopsis:
When young Maria is married off to Jacques Redford, a wealthy nobleman, she is grateful that he seems to be gentle and understanding. However, there are dark secrets to be discovered in the Redford estate, and Maria's life takes a turn for the worse as her husband's sadistic preferences come to light. With no one left to lean on, Maria finds solace in the companionship of Jacques' illegitimate half-brother, Lowell. Now that Lowell has returned home as a war hero, can he save Maria from her cruel fate?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: The S-Class Dungeon Owner
synopsis:
Being the owner of a dungeon is the best dream a demon could have. So when Succubus Adelaide inherits one from an unknown grandfather, she believes she's set for life. Will Hyeonyoung successfully ensnare Yoon and have his way with him, or will Yoon's earnest character thwart him yet again?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Lovers, Cats, and the Killer
synopsis:
Police trainee Mooyoon starts his career in law enforcement in a quiet suburban town only to notice stray cats and dogs disappear mysteriously. A joint rescue operation between the police station and the fire station brings him close to Taeyi, a young firefighter who happens to be his next-door neighbor. Together, the two begin to track down leads that unravel a much larger menace.

As the mystery intensifies, their bond only grows stronger... until an unthinkable tragedy strikes.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Lunar Rabbit Prince
synopsis:
According to prophecy, only wisdom—or "jihye"—can heal the division tearing the Moon Kingdom apart. Dooshik, the youngest prince of the rabbits, leaves the moon to find jihye and save his kingdom. Immediately upon arriving on Earth, he encounters Jihye Seo, a young man on a quest of his own. Jihye's quest... is to find big D. Can the duo overcome lies, disapproving family, and constantly getting distracted by the bedroom to rescue the moon?!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Evergreen
synopsis:
Seojin, a kind florist, finds himself thrown into events that span worlds and time when he rescues a mysterious man named Harold... a man he's seen before, in dreams. Fueled by burning curiosity and an addictive attraction, they will face the dark powers moving against them to seek answers. How did Harold end up in this world? Why does Seojin look like Harold's lost love, Helio? And can they find a way to be together in the face of their impossible odds?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Love Without Borders
synopsis:
Following a failed assassination attempt on the U.S. president three years ago, the National Intelligence Agency, having made little headway in the investigation, faces pressure to transfer the case to the United States. In the midst of this, Lee Yeonu, a former North Korean intelligence agent, seeks protection, propelling the inquiry into a new phase. With his identity and motives unclear, former special forces major Ryu Seong is assigned to protect Lee Yeonu. The central question lingers: is Lee Yeonu a crucial witness or a suspect in this intricate case?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Dreaming of the Dokkaebi
synopsis:
Ju Minchan had always suffered from frequent fevers as a kid because of some unfortunate curse. Now as a young adult, his condition has worsened into seizures which he can only keep at bay by hunting spirits. As if things couldn't get any worse, the effectiveness of this method starts diminishing as his seizures become more recurrent. Then, he learns about a powerful being who could lift his curse. Despite the risk that comes with hunting down this being, Minchan readily jumps at this chance to finally escape his harsh fate only to find out that he was never destined to live a normal life...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Shoot for the Stars
synopsis:
Falling star to superstar!

Forced to give up on his dream of becoming an idol, Yoosung laments having to spend the rest of his days working as his crush's manager. That is, until he wakes up as a trainee! How did he go back to the past? What are these mysterious skill bars only he can see? Could they be the key to success?

(Source: Manta)

title: Just Divine!
synopsis:
Mooksan has done anything and everything for treasure—from murder to theft, nothing is off the docket. So when he is given the opportunity to ascend to the divine realm of The Great Beyond, the ruffian has the chance to pull off a heist that will guarantee him the fortune of a lifetime. But as he begins to grow closer to the naively innocent Cheong-yeon—sole demigod child of The Great Beyond's ruler—the once fearsome bandit may discover that the greatest treasure of all is right before his eyes... and can only be stolen away with a kiss.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Prequel Romance
synopsis:
A snobby A-list star meets his match.

Taejin has it all—looks, talent, fame, money—everything except a decent personality! With his reputation on the line, Taejin gets sent to work in a factory for a movie that will save his career. But will he be able to survive a life of hard labor under the beady eyes of factory chief Hasung?

(Source: Manta)

title: How to Avoid a Debut
synopsis:
But I don't wanna be an idol!

Hahyeon is a dancer who's just graduated high school. At the desperate request of his producer uncle, he ends up participating in Survival ID, an idol audition program. The plan was to have him eliminated early on, so how is he making it through every stage?!

(Source: Manta)

title: Into It
synopsis:
A rookie actor and an A-lister cross paths.

An A-list actor and a rookie actor meet on the set of a TV show. "Did I… do well?" A whirlwind romance that blurs the line between acting and reality!

(Source: Manta)

title: Circuit Breaker
synopsis:
Jaewon, a small-time DIY trader, wins the lottery, but wakes up inside a web novel after a car crash. To return home to his prize money, he must help the male and female leads get their happily ever after, but why do all the handsome male lead candidates seem more interested in him than the heroine?

(Source: Manta)

title: One Take
synopsis:
Former rising star, current no-name actor Jang Seungmin's lucked out. Not only has he nabbed a role in a TV show, but he's also getting to work with the biggest star in the country, Ha Hyunje. Charismatic, handsome, but also a little bit of a jerk, Hyunje has a magnetic presence that draws everyone in. Before Seungmin knows it, he's become yet another Ha Hyunje fanboy. Seungmin's satisfied with keeping a safe distance between himself and Hyunje, but... why is Hyunje so interested in Seungmin? More importantly, what does "the incident" that happened seven years ago have to do with anything?

(Source: Manta)

title: Sangyang: The Wanderer
synopsis:
Someone's tattooing me in my sleep.

On the night of his birthday, Xin, the sole heir of the powerful Zhou family, reunites with Lau, his clan guardian, and confides in him about the mysterious tattoo forming on his back. Lau begrudgingly sets off to investigate this strange phenomenon, but what secrets will he uncover along the way?

(Source: Manta)

title: Dramatic Signal
synopsis:
When Do Jinwoo's idol career fails, he pivots into acting. His first big break? A drama with top stars Lim Sehyun and Choi Itae. Jinwoo is admired by Itae, but is awkward around Sehyun due to their shared past and the secrets that lie there. Can these three keep the drama from spilling off-screen?

(Source: Manta)

title: In the Hall of the Mountain King
title_english: In the Hall of the Mountain King
synopsis:
Sold off as a male bride to Marquis Oderic, who rules over the territory of Trupinen, Everard expects to be treated as a prisoner—but in Oderic's quiet care, he finds peace and freedom. Can love blossom in these austere halls?

(Source: Manta)

title: The Failed Heiress
synopsis:
Just before her passing, Seulgi's grandmother hands her a mysterious note. On it is an address where her grandmother claims to have hidden a secret inheritance. But when Seulgi visits the location, she finds that a stranger is already living there! Will Seulgi be able to become the heiress she was meant to be?

(Source: Manta)

title: The Blurred Lines Between Us
synopsis:
With a perfect older brother, Yim Juhyeong's inferiority complex has always driven him to be better than other people. Everything goes well until a new transfer student named Yim Seon shows up. Despite being superior to Junhyeong in every single way, Seon, for some mysterious reason, seems intent on devoting himself to taking care of Juhyeong. Even though Junhyeong should hate it, he doesn't understand why he can't push Seon away.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Squeaky Clean
synopsis:
Welcome to an LA Korean spa that accidentally turned into a holy ground for hot, chaotic gays! Enter Eden, a swoon-worthy CIA agent with the body of a Greek god, and Romeo, a mafia boss whose hands are as dangerous as they are... skilled. Both men lock eyes on one unsuspecting target: Sumin, a sweet and slightly flustered Korean student working as a scrub master.

Caught in a steamy love triangle full of slippery situations, shirtless standoffs, and suspiciously sensual scrubbing, Sumin becomes the prize in a ridiculous showdown between brawn and finesse.

Will Eden's all-American muscles win him the boy? Or will Romeo's sinful charm steal Sumin's heart (and maybe his towel)?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

Yuri, a high school student obsessed with efficiency, gets his hands on a watch that can make time feel twice as fast. What starts with skipping boring classes soon leads to him speeding up his entire life.

title_japanese: 新機動戦記ガンダムW 0.5POINT HALF PREVENTER-7
synopsis:
AC-197. Peace has returned to the people. And from this point on in history, weapons known as mobile suits, including the Gundams, were never seen again in the Earth Sphere. However, as long as mankind exists, there will always be battles. And that is precisely why an organization called the Preventers must exist. Heero and the others of PREVENTER-7 embark on a new operation to extinguish the flames that threaten to consume the perfect peace.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
