title: Problematic Student Patrol
synopsis:
When delinquent transfer student Ban Taehyeon, rumored to be the brawler at the center of a schoolyard fight, walks into class, the strict and upright Kang Hyeonbeom makes it his mission to keep him in check. Determined to reform Taehyeon into a model student, Hyeonbeom starts watching his every move... only to find himself slowly drawn into Taehyeon's orbit. As the line between discipline and friendship starts to blur, could Hyeonbeom really be the one getting "reformed" instead?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Outro
synopsis:
Her girlfriend, who she's been dating for seven years, is wallowing in bed with another girl, and her dream of debut has been shattered, so she doesn't have many expectations anymore. Suddenly, ray of hope appears in front of Jian; she receives an offer to appear in a program that highly appreciates Jian's self-composed song. Jian is excited about the opportunity to escape from her lover Yoowon...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

title: Libido Frame
synopsis:
From failed auditions to broken dreams, Hayun thought his acting career was over before it began. Now a small-time streamer, he's ready to give up on the spotlight for good...until a mysterious indie director makes him an offer that's impossible to ignore. One risky role, one intimate frame, and suddenly, Hayun's world is about to blur the line between performance and desire.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: In for a Penny
synopsis:
Since ancient times, fairies have existed to maintain balance in the world, each governing a fundamental human desire—wealth, pleasure, appetite, rest, and honor. Pence, a money fairy with an insatiable thirst for riches, was poised to become the next ruler of the fairy realm. But his greed came at a cost. When he exploits his powers at the expense of others, he is cast out and stripped of his status, forced to live among humans. Now stranded in the mortal world, Pence crosses paths with Yoojin, a relentless workaholic struggling to make ends meet. But old habits die hard, and Pence's schemes for easy wealth quickly backfire. As karma catches up to him, he's about to learn the true cost of greed—and what it really means to earn one's fortune.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Moralless
synopsis:
Ishino would like to say he's your average drug dealer. He'd really love that. Unfortunately for him, he also regularly goes into heat for some mysterious reason, and this kickstarts his maybe-strings-attached relationship with infamous mafia boss Nemeth. And that's just the first mafia boss who wants a piece of him. What is going on with Ishino's strange ability to attract dangerous figureheads, and just how much of his dignity will survive this?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Eat Your Heart Out
synopsis:
In a world devastated by a nuclear disaster 400 years ago, the privileged few found refuge in the Ark, while the outsiders mutated into beasts. Helm, a young biologist in the Ark, lives a life of  indulgence...or so it would seem. Reluctantly engaged in a power struggle with his own half-brother, Helm spends his days indulging in frivolity in an attempt to stay free from his brother's clutches. Yet his life takes a surprising turn when a captivating outsider tries to hold him hostage. Faced with a choice, Helm escapes the Ark, only to realize that the dangers outside may be more treacherous than he ever imagined...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Zenbu Oshiete, Sensei.
synopsis:
Rikako Kuramoto is an ordinary high school girl who has feelings for her handsome tutor. One day, when she found herself unable to concentrate on her studies because she loved her teacher so much, she asked him to give her a kiss at the place she requested for each time she achieved the maximum score.

(Souce: MU)

title: Space Orc: Banzoku no Senshi wa Yoake no Ten wo Kake Joou wo Nerau
title_english: Space Orc: Barbarian Raider of the Stars, Aiming for the Queen!
title_japanese: スペースオーク 蛮族の戦士は夜明けの天を翔け女王を狙う
synopsis:
In the far-off future, Earth's humans have finally expanded into the galaxy and opened up new possibilities. From genetic manipulation to the formation of clans, the universe is filled with opportunity. Which is precisely what orc barbarian Kurtz is counting on. Raised in the Ton-Tekin clan, a warrior tribe of orcs known for plundering, Kurtz has proven himself to be a worthy fighter. He's even been personally recognized by the beautiful queen, Malya, and earned the favor and affection of Princess Pika. Not bad for an orc of low birth.  

But while universal fame and fortune are quite the allure, Kurtz has one desire above all else: he wants to make the beloved queen Malya his bride! Get ready to take to the stars and rampage across the galaxy!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Should I Make You a Nuclear Weapon?
synopsis:
Director Kim Jun of the Defense Science Research Institute faces a tragic end while protecting the ADD chip, a military secret of South Korea, during a terrorist attack in 2024. However, he suddenly finds himself with an unexpected opportunity: he is reborn in the body of his friend Jeon Hyun-seung, who died in 1998! Revived as Kim Jun, he discovers that he can access future technologies using the ADD chip engraved in his body.

"If you give me the chance... I'll show you what I can create within three months."

Create the ultimate weapon to overcome the IMF crisis with future technology! Let me know if you need anything else!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Itooshii kara Mou Ichido
title_english: One More Time, Because I Love You.
title_japanese: 愛おしいからもう一度
synopsis:
Ainosuke has developed romantic feelings for his best friend and classmate, Hibe. On the day he has decided to confess, he falls asleep on campus and has a dream about the two of them having sex! After he wakes up, Hibe makes a move on him just like in his dream, and Ainosuke suddenly finds himself in a time loop where he repeats the same day over and over...

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Onmyou no Kami Kamo no Yasunori
The Late-Night Special
synopsis:
"For struggling idol Hana, a late-night variety show invitation feels like a golden opportunity. Sure, the program is infamous for its over-the-top content, but exposure is exposure... Right? With cameras and staff all around, what's the worst that could happen? The answer comes fast and shocking. The hosts and fellow guests clearly didn't get the memo about "professional boundaries." Suddenly, the games and skits spiral into outrageous territory, the kind of risqué chaos no public broadcast should ever attempt. Hana can only stare in disbelief as the so-called "entertainment" blurs every line between performance and scandal. Is this still a variety show or some twisted after-hours experiment? And most importantly, are the cameras really rolling right now?! Between shock, embarrassment, and unintended hilarity, Hana is caught in the most unpredictable "broadcast" of her life.

One thing's certain: this is late-night TV like no one ever imagined."

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Gazing at You
synopsis:
With the start of senior year, high schooler Lee Youngwon can't wait to graduate and leave his life of poverty behind. He only has to focus on studying so he can get into a good college. But suddenly, Mr. Popular, Yoo Sunwoo, who was never close to Youngwon, starts buying him food, helps him become class president, and even walks him home. Though Youngwon knows his top priority should be his grades, he begins to wonder why Sunwoo is always the subject of his gaze...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Untouchable Duke
synopsis:
Calix Bastian, the empire's one and only Grand Duke, harbors a secret obsession for Evan Chris, a low-ranking knight renowned for his beauty.

One night, under the cover of a training drill, Calix sneaks into Evan's room and is caught in the middle of a private act he cannot take back.

Using that moment as leverage, the two begin meeting in secret, their bodies drawn together by desire. But for Calix, lust alone soon feels hollow.

He wants something more, but how do you ask for love when all you've ever known is touch?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Minty Fresh
synopsis:
Raised in darkness, Ji-an learned early that giving up was the only way to stay alive. Then Hwan arrives: bright, irresistible, and dangerously easy to love. Their relationship feels inevitable, intoxicating, and fleetingly perfect. Until everything falls apart when Hwan takes Ji-an's place in a hit-and-run accident. Desperate, Ji-an rushes to the hospital, only to be met with unfamiliar eyes and a cruel voice.

"You smell like an omega. It's disgusting."

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The House of Blind Sheep
synopsis:
There's no place like home...

Having grown up in a nursing home, Sheena wished for nothing more than to be reunited with her family. But when she finally returns home after nine years, she finds herself feeling like a stranger in her own house as things take an eerie turn.

(Source: Manta)

title: While the Stars Slept
synopsis:
Business admin major Kwon Jaeyoon returns to campus after a year-long break, only to run into her old crush, Shin Seungwon. Though Jaeyoon tries to avoid him, Seungwon is drawn to her, and soon the two are studying together for his sports rehabilitation class, with Seungwon's body as the model!

(Source: Manta)

title: We Never Broke Up
synopsis:
Eunha is struggling to balance multiple jobs and drowning in debt when she runs into her ex. It's been years, but Wonseo drops a bomb: the two never actually ended things. Eunha is shaken by her words, but walks away. When eviction looms, Wonseo offers a lifeline laced with history. Torn by pride and buried feelings, Eunha takes the bait.

(Source: Manta)

title: I Wanna Be the Madam!
synopsis:
I'm gonna become the madam!

Failed college entrance exams leave Heera feeling hopeless. That is, until she submits her "appeal" to a theater troupe at a folk village, catching the attention of the troupe's leader and changing her path forever. Now, Heera strives not to go to college, but to become the troupe's madam!

(Source: Manta)

title: Tensei Kusushi Meikyuu Toshi Sodachi
title_japanese: 転生薬師は迷宮都市育ち
synopsis:
Yulianne died right after taking the entrance exam for pharmacy school, only to find herself reborn in another world as the second daughter of a pharmacist. The labyrinth city of Trian, where she lives, is filled with adventurers who delve into dungeons, making it a fierce battlefield for apothecaries. Upon regaining the memories of her previous life, Yulianne resolves to build knowledge as an apprentice bookseller, hone her magic, delve into the labyrinth with her companions, and in this world fulfill the dream she once had. Yes—to become a first-class apothecary!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Nice to Meet You
synopsis:
Same place, different time. "What does it matter if we have a 70-year age difference?"

Jinha, an office worker who is traumatized from the bullying in her past, receives a mysterious message from the future... A time slip story of fantasy and romance transcending time and space.

(Source: Manta)

title: Uchi no Maid ga Class no Suki na Ko ni Niteiru
title_japanese: うちのメイドがクラスの好きな子に似ている
synopsis:
Eiga, the next head of the prestigious Kujou family, is in a serious predicament. That is: love. He wants to approach Himeka, a girl in his class for whom he secretly has feelings, but because it is his first love, he can't think of a good way to do it... At that moment, he decides to ask for advice from Maria, a maid his age who serves the Kujou family...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Boukensha Al: Aitsu no Mahou wa Okashii
title_english: Al the Adventurer: That Magic Shouldn't Work!
title_japanese: 冒険者アル あいつの魔法はおかしい
synopsis:
After being kidnapped by goblins at the age of three, young Al is rescued thanks to his grandfather's bright and powerful magic, something Al had never witnessed before. From then on, Al became fascinated with magic and learned everything he could about it. But the path to mastering magic is far from easy. Even after 12 years of arduous training and preparation, Al's journey is only just getting started! Now that he's an official adventurer, Al is ready to travel across the land in hopes of finding the rare, ancient document known as the "Book of Spells." 

As Al begins his adventure, he quickly finds that his use of magic isn't quite standard. Will his unique techniques and passion for spells lead him down the path of a hero, or will his quest end before it can truly begin?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

When their classmate's expensive watch goes missing during swimming class, the prime suspects are the three students who sat out that day: Taewoong, Mitsuki, and Sakuma. Together, they set out on the hunt for the lost watch, but what they find is...

Kaname Ichinose and Ryou Aizawa are high school boys who live in the same dorm room and practice together after school despite belonging to different clubs. One day, Ryou is suddenly asked by Kaname to "protect him." Kaname says it's because the seniors in his dorm are teasing him too much, and Ryou accepts. However, when it comes down to it, Kaname has an even more serious agenda...

Makoto Mitsuya is an economics student living in a dorm. After his roommate is hospitalized, he indulges in his otaku hobbies to the fullest while living alone. However, his new roommate, Ken Hayami, turns out to be the complete opposite—a flashy party animal with a totally different personality and appearance from himself! Frustrated by their clashing personalities and Hayami's annoying behavior, Mitsuya initially holds a grudge, but slowly begins to open up thanks to Hayami's attempts to get closer.

One night while drinking together, Hayami teases Mitsuya for being an inexperienced virgin. Annoyed by the teasing, Mitsuya impulsively pushes him down. But when Hayami reacts with obvious pleasure, Mitsuya gets carried away—and the two end up having sex...?!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

synopsis:
The teacher I admired suddenly disappeared from the school. All that remains is a mysterious trunk and a letter entrusted for some reason.

"Search for the teacher."

With that determination in mind, Max rides the train Solaris across the world with the trunk in hand. The first trip beyond the border Tokyo as a destination. There she meets railroad sheriff Renancuff. After her encounter with him, she becomes embroiled in a battle that shakes the world.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Half-Blood
synopsis:
The most original union in history—human and ogre blood fused!

Leon, a half-blood born of human and ogre, but returning to the world as a half-breed only meant being used and betrayed by humans. Leon grew to despise them and swore revenge. Powerless and always the victim, Leon's miracle finally arrived—a chance to take vengeance on humankind.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Yori-kun to Yori wo Modosu Wake ni wa!
title_japanese: 頼くんとヨリを戻すわけには!
synopsis:
"So don't go off and start dating someone else just yet!" Hatsuho has just moved to Tokyo after getting into college and is looking forward to a dazzling college life until...she realizes that her next-door neighbor is none other than her one and only ex-boyfriend from junior high school that she had an awkward breakup with...! Even though he's a bit condescending, his good looks make him hard to hate... Hatsuho's days of being pursued by her problematic (?!) ex-boyfriend have just begun!!!

(Source: Kodansha)

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Chanto Suki tte Ieru Ko Musou
title_japanese: ちゃんと好きって言える子無双
synopsis:
There's always just one surefire way to win in a romantic comedy—simply saying "I like you!" The girls who have feelings for high school boy Izumi spent their days unable to take that first step forward.

[The School Idol Who Only Wants to Be Pampered When It's Just the Two of Them] Amane Amasaki.
[Even Though I Was Disowned, My Former Fiancé Just Won't Leave Me Alone!] Hakua Shiragiku.
[The Angel of the Academy... But the Devil Next to Her Is Surprisingly Easy] Haru Kasuga.

However, transferring into their class is Nanao Nanase, a seemingly ordinary girl who is actually a natural-born main heroine! Nano starts her fierce assault on Izumi with her shameless and straightforward approach.

"Izumi-kun, I like you. Please go out with me."
"Here, say 'ahh'~♪"
"Izumi-kun, you're the one who made me into this kind of girl, you know?"

In a panic, Amane and the others can't help but spring into action—"This girl... She actually did it!?"

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: The Marquis Is the Martial Archduke
The Swordmaster Who Leapt Through Time
title_english: The Swordmaster Who Leapt Through Time
synopsis:
The Kingdom of Vanroah has fallen. Lansen, the last prince, flees with the remaining survivors to a faraway land. Vowing to one day revive the kingdom, he becomes a swordmaster at a young age, only for a treacherous incident to strip everything away. Powerless to protect those he loves, he uses an ancient artifact to travel 10,000 years back in time to the Age of the Arcane. There, its rich knowledge and wisdom help him avert disaster in the present. But each time he turns back the clock, new secrets emerge, entangling the past and present in ways he never foresaw.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The End of an Imperfect Divorce
title_english: The End of an Imperfect Divorce
synopsis:
After a life of neglect and a cold, loveless marriage to Duke Johann Leopold, Olivia Blanchett's desperate attempts at love fail... until one day, Han Jian awakens in Olivia's body. She seeks a divorce and flees to a rival kingdom, where she meets the charming but cunning Marquess Edgar Lancelot. Olivia is eager to start over and live her own life, all while her ex-husband secretly watches from afar. Will old flames be rekindled in this tale riddled with regret and revenge? Or will new love bloom?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Site Use Only
synopsis:
Yu Bom has never cared for sweet boys her age. What stirs her is the fantasy of rugged older men, those with tanned skin, rough hands, and the raw masculinity of a hard life etched into their bodies. The construction site, filled with men who embody everything she craves, becomes the perfect stage for her secret desires. But fantasies have a way of bleeding into reality, and Yu Bom is about to step into a world that blurs the line between imagination and temptation.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Miren no Tonbo
synopsis:
Exterminating an enormous infestation of dragonflies. He thought his first job as a psychic's assistant was an odd job unrelated to spirits.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: D:AZE
synopsis:
In a world where vampires exist, a special undercover agency keeps the rest of society safe by hunting them down. Agent "First" Shin is the best of the best. The only problem is he keeps losing partners, so he's decided to stick to working solo. However, his manager has other plans, and a recruit is assigned to him. The new guy just won't leave him alone, yet annoyed as he is, First also can't ignore his model-like new partner. Is it his potential as a partner... or something else?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Memoirs of an Exorcist
synopsis:
Ji Taebom, a gifted exorcist in training, enrolls in the academy with his devoted friend Chun Haesu.

Though they've always been close, Taebom starts noticing an awkward distance between them. Just as the shift begins to weigh on his mind, he wakes one night to an eerie touch and soft lips brushing against his skin—only to find Haesu, flushed and possessed, staring at him with an unfamiliar intensity...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Immoral Relationship
synopsis:
Choi Kang, a key figure in the notorious "Seven" crime syndicate, reunites with his estranged stepbrother, Choi Leehan. Before they have a chance to mend their fractured bond, Leehan reveals his true identity: an undercover officer determined to dismantle the organization and free Kang from his criminal life.

But behind his seemingly noble offer lies a hidden agenda. What could he truly be after?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: OMG!
synopsis:
Kang Yohan, plagued by endless misfortune, turns to the supernatural to change his luck. Too broke for a proper summoning ritual, he settles for a "Do it Yourself" version and ends up with Chung—a so-called "cost-effective" god.

But life doesn't come cheap. Yohan is about to learn two hard truths: you get what you pay for, and nothing comes without a price.

Now, he must fulfill Chung's bizarre conditions to finally escape his cursed fate!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: A Rookie from the Above
synopsis:
Sung Hyemin, a senior associate at B-SAM (Bureau of Supernatural Ability Management), is on the verge of completing his final task for promotion when he's suddenly assigned a rookie, Lee Jeeyoon.

"I pulled a few strings to get in here so I could see you."

"...You pulled strings to land this job? Why?!"

With his long-awaited promotion at stake, Hyemin must navigate the chaos of mentoring this unexpected rookie from the above...!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Perfect Student's Secret Hobby
synopsis:
Kwon Joonhyuk, the class president infamous for his terrible personality, gets caught up with Min Dohyun at the freshman party. What starts as a seemingly harmless gathering takes a dark turn when Joonhyuk wakes up in Dohyun's place, his hands tied to a bedframe. Now, it's time to uncover the perfect student's secret little hobby.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Lingerie Night
synopsis:
"You'd keep wearing lingerie for me if I did what you asked?"

Yun Hee-il's secret fetish is uncovered by his close friend Hyuk, who uses it to tease him and push the boundaries of their relationship.

But over time, Hee-il starts to feel a strange attraction toward Hyuk, the only one who seems to understand his hidden side...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Bound by Duty, Torn by Pride
title_english: Bound by Duty, Torn by Pride
synopsis:
Falsely accused through a shadowy adversary's deliberate scheme, Dominic, the patriarch of house Winters, faces the imminent downfall of his entire family.

As he struggles to find a way to save his family name, a secretive and highly dangerous proposal is made—one that demands his body as collateral...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Run and Hit!
synopsis:
Koh Yangseo, the star center fielder for the Servals, always treated his junior teammate, Kang Hajoo, like a younger brother—until he discovered Hajoo's secret: he's gay.

When Yangseo catches him using a dating app, he becomes overly protective, determined to keep an eye on his innocent junior. But his watchful eye leads to unexpected closeness: the same team, the same field, and now... the same bed?!

Wait a second. Something's definitely off here...!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Rusty Nail
synopsis:
Isaac Carter, the underboss, and soon to be the next leader of the mighty outfit "Rustynail," is informed that he is going to be training Phil Rustynail, the Boss's secret son. What he couldn't tell was that he was Isaac's one-night stand... To make matters worse, the Boss is considering Phil as the successor to the crown of the world's most powerful crime family...!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Pest on My Shoulder
synopsis:
Gun-Min has no lofty dreams for his life. He's ready to socialize and study just enough to land a somewhat decent job. The only spice to his bland days are his repeat night-time fantasies involving his sunbae, Jeong Hu. But after waking up during one of these dreams, he finds a strange winged man at the foot of his bed! Is he be the culprit behind Gun-Min's sudden feelings for his upperclassman?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Yaritsukai to, Kuroneko.
synopsis:
After a tear in reality pulls Kagari Shuya into a white room he discovers a futuristic interface for reincarnating in a different world. After looking through the different races and skills he unlocks a new race, Seivault, a type of vampire with none of its characteristic weaknesses. All set to start his life in a new world, Shuya is confused to discover that he is enveloped in darkness. As it turns out something went wrong when he was transported and instead of appearing where he was supposed to he appeared in a underground cave. Shuya faces untold dangers, runs for his life, before finding his way out of the underground world. After escaping he meets his Shishou and begins to learn to fight with a spear.

(Source: Novel Updates)

title_english: When Pride Fell at My Feet
synopsis:
The beautiful Duke Enrico Michele approached like a devil whispering sweet lies, offering a cunning deal. "Just dance for me like a living doll. In return, I'll tell you about your dead parents." Along with his mysterious patronage came a chilling question: "Don't you want to know the truth?" And so began my secret, dangerous entanglement with the Duke, a meeting that should never have happened.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Survive
synopsis:
No one knows why these people are stranded here with death looming in the corner. As loneliness creeps in, it becomes all too easy to seek solace in others. But they must trust no one but themselves. Remember, the goal is to survive.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Counter
synopsis:
After moving back to Korea, the shy and quiet Joyce Cha was prepared to be alienated by her class. But she quickly hits it off with her classmate Sydney instead! Pretty soon, through Sydney, Joyce is meeting new friends, making new memories, and smiling more than she ever has. So then why is she receiving cryptic warnings about Sydney and her intentions from other classmates?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Goblin
synopsis:
I died... but I'm not dead?! The woman who killed me says she has a mission for me, and my life is now in her hands. She can turn back time to save me, or bump me off for good—all I have to do to stay alive is whatever she says... but what does she want?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Lights, Camera, Action!
synopsis:
Actor Geum Kiyool has been secretly in love with his roommate Seomoon Hyung since their school days. When Kiyool takes on an adult-themed music video, he tries to set the mood by experimenting with a toy, only to get caught in the act by Hyung himself! But instead of being shocked, Hyung unexpectedly offers to help him out. As the lines between fiction and reality begin to blur, both Kiyool and Hyung have to find the courage to step into the spotlight.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Tapping My Ex's New Lover
synopsis:
As far as Myojin is concerned, his relationship with Yijo is destiny. But if you asked Yijo, he'd tell you they were just hooking up. He might even tell you it's out of spite. To Yijo, Myojin is just his ex's latest lover and an easy route to take revenge. Because Yijo won't fall in love again, and he doesn't get happy endings—no matter how handsome, sweet, and adoring Myojin is. This time, Yijo will be the one breaking hearts.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Monsoon Rain
synopsis:
As the rainy season continues, a small rural village is shocked by murder cases that occur every rainy day. Witnesses say the suspect was so short that they were dragging a pickaxe. Rumors are spreading that the culprit might be a child... Who can the killer be?!

(Source: Toomics)

title: Tekiller
synopsis:
In another world, there is a bar. When you're drunk out of your mind and on the edge, the bartenders there will present you with a secret menu item: a special drink that will make your darkest dreams come true! The price? Your life, of course!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Genen no Shiro no Navin
title_english: Navin and Prince in the Castle of Phantom Flame
synopsis:
Navin, a 13-year-old girl who lived peacefully in a small village in the mountains, lost everything in an instant. The invasion of Adele's army led by Prince Lucian saw her village burned, her friends enslaved, and her mother beheaded before her eyes. Burning with hatred, Navin is picked up by Lucian, her mother's enemy, and forced to swear loyalty to him. She serves him in the closest place possible, in order to kill him one day.

A master-servant relationship connected by murderous intent—the beginning of a full-scale fantasy tale of revenge.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Yawahada ni Shunrai
synopsis:
Hoodwinking with love, feigning romance... It was all supposed to be deception... 

The most gorgeous shinobi on the planet, Kagaribi, was given the toughest mission of his life...a mission no one has ever returned from alive. He swore that he would take advantage of those who are led astray by love and use them as stepping stones to rise in this turbulent world, so he attempts to sneak into a hostile land and steal the heart (and body) of their priestess, Rindo, but it doesn't go as expected!! Don't miss this tale of mismatched Priestess vs. Shinobi romance set in the era of warring states!

(Source: Kodansha)

The manga shows Suu Kyi's early life and ends with her receiving the Nobel Peace Prize while under house arrest in 1991. It also depicts the events of 1988, when Burma's democracy movement first came to the world's attention.

In the Imperial capital of Tokyo, Tokito Tokitsukasa and his step-sister Kiriko are ordered to marry by their grandfather... but something isn't right. Kiriko can tell these people are keeping some secret from her... meanwhile, an infamous thief named Shiou escapes from the police in the night, only to run into a strange girl. And she looks just like Kiriko...

title: My Cocky Neighbor
synopsis:
Ji Soon-yi's always been the type to keep to herself. All her hobbies are things she can enjoy alone, and she's the happiest when she's at home by herself. Except...her neighbor certainly isn't the same. Nam Changlim may be a stud, but he has a different girl over every night and each time, Soon-yi can hear everything that's going on between him and his female companion. Annoyed, she curses Changlim and wishes that he be turned into a cock if that's all he can think about. Alas, she'd forgotten that she'd purchased a magic candle holder earlier on that day... And the very next morning, she wakes up to find a very disgruntled, very animate dildo at her door. Uh-oh. Soon-yi did think her neighbor was too cocky, but she didn't mean for the curse to be so literal...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Genius Blacksmith's Game
synopsis:
Hyeonsu's life took a turn for the worse when a fire left him covered in burns, his father in the hospital, and their family smithy in a blaze. But just as he was losing hope, his friend had an idea: If he can't be a blacksmith in real life, why not try it in Ares, the AI-powered virtual reality game? With a bit of luck, he might make enough money there to pay for his father's hospital bills. With so many irons in the fire, can Hyeonsu rekindle the flame of his passion and rise from the ashes?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kemuri no Mukou ni Koe ga Kikoeru
title_japanese: 煙の向こうに声が聞こえる
synopsis:
In the hot spring town of Yugawara, not far from Tokyo, Mitsuru Kadono runs a handyman business. An avid smoker, he harbors a unique secret: through the smoke of his cigarettes, he can hear the inner voices of others. Whether it's weeding gardens, giving tours, or offering life advice, Kadono listens to these unspoken thoughts as he supports the townspeople in their daily lives. And so, with a calm demeanor and wisps of smoke curling around him, he continues his quiet, reflective work.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Baby Dragon to the Duke's Rescue
title_english: Baby Dragon to the Duke's Rescue
synopsis:
After the loss of its divine beast, House Moonreppe is on the verge of collapse. Desperate to save his household, the young Duke Edenver Moonreppe decides to summon a legendary beast to become their new divine beast. He's prepared to take on whatever monster that is summoned, only to meet baby dragon Acille. Edenver is not sure such a small creature could be their new divine beast... until he discovers that this baby dragon packs quite the punch in terms of both power and loveability. Will Acille change Edenver's life for the better in more ways than one?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Hantoumei no Kimi e

Sumi bears a birthmark on her face. Meanwhile, the most popular student in her class seems to be having fun every day, even after catching the mysterious "transparency disease"...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Otokogi
synopsis:
After his father leaves when he is very young, Kyosuke Murata grows up under the thumb of his overprotective mother, Shizuko. When he reaches adulthood, he is thrown into the harsh, violent world of Japanese gangland when his mother becomes involved in a gang-related crime. He goes up against the Murata-gumi organization, only to find that his estranged father is its head. Rising up through the ranks, Kyosuke eventually unites half the gangs in Japan beneath his own leadership, only to find that the other half have also combined to resist his new power, starting the greatest gang war in Japanese history.

(Source: The Anime Encyclopedia)

title: Estancia 2
synopsis:
Twice a month, a freight train carrying new migrants arrive in Sakia. According to a new civil rights law, ex-convicts are given the right to voluntarily erase their memory and live here. As a purification city, this civil rights law began to be expanded to more people. Many of us criminals now living in Sakia only knowing ourselves only as immigrants. But Estancia, they say we will be forgiven if we reach Estancia.

(Source: Tapastic)

title: Mushihime 2: Hiruko
synopsis:
At the end of the battle, Insect Princess Kikuko disappeared along with Ryoichi. The town seemed to have regained its peace, but... Kikuko's genes continue to carry life, and finally, a new Princess is born who will bring terror to the world.

(Source: Home-sha, translated)

title: Snow Dome Town
synopsis:
The manga centers on Ako, who has never left the snowy northern town they have called home. Ako's friend Tako asks them to help on writing the story of a novel with a snowy motif. The pair travel to Tokyo to finish the novel, and eventually learn the truth and test of the town.

(Source: ANN)

title: Bateren Kaidan
synopsis:
In the shadows of Edo, under the ban on Christianity, lurks an ominous supernatural presence no one should approach. Give in to curiosity, and there will be no way back!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Painful, but Desirable
synopsis:
Doyun Cha decides he isn't looking for "true love." In fact, he wants a fake marriage. One fateful night, Hayeon, who's known him since their college days, confesses to Doyun that she wants in on his passionless arrangement. The problem is... she has a long-time crush on him! Can she convince him to fall head over heels for her? Or will he catch wind of her hidden intentions?

(Source: Radish Media)

title: Program Me
synopsis:
A salacious bondage sesh with the boss counts as overtime, right? Seungwon's first job lands herself in the lap of video game mastermind, Mimi Kim. Mimi "reluctantly" spins a web of lust, while coy Seungwon discovers her inner dominatrix. It's a titillating dance of kinks and toys, all for the sake of saving the company and the future of game development. Throw in a little blackmail and you've got the fantasy that HR reports are made of.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Daddy's Girl
synopsis:
After her mother's remarriage, Lee Hyeon-ah gains a new stepfather, Cha Kangjun: young, composed, and unsettlingly perfect. Though they share no blood ties and Hyeon-ah is already an adult, Kangjun's attention toward her grows increasingly intense after the wedding. When her ailing mother leaves overseas for treatment, the house becomes a sealed world of watchful silences, unspoken threats, and boundaries that erode one by one. Trapped between fear, dependence, and a pull she doesn't fully understand, Hyeon-ah must confront how far obsession can go when love, power, and secrecy twist into something dangerous.

Determined to return to the people he loves, Dex accepts. But to dig into Jin's memories, there's only one way forward: intimate contact that blurs the line between mission and desire. Baekryeon, a sacred dragon spirit, once took the human Ha-on as his mate, never realizing that love would be his undoing. When Ha-on discovers he was meant for nothing more than producing an heir, he vanishes, leaving Baekryeon to face the centuries alone.

Now, in the modern world, Baekryeon meets a man with Ha-on's soul and the same fire in his eyes. But with Ha-on having no recollection of their shared history, can Baekryeon truly atone for the sins of the past?

Amelia, the daughter of a countess, has been abused by her family and is disliked by her fiancé, Cedric, who sees her as unsociable. Amelia lives a life supported by her beloved job as a pharmacist, but one day, someone comes to visit... Cedric, who has been poisoned by someone and turned into a squirrel!?

"Please let me stay in this room," Amelia pleads. Thus begins her strange cohabitation with her fluffy fiancé (the squirrel)!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Kaori was the leader of a ladies' club. After being betrayed by her friends, she was reincarnated as Dahlia, the villainous young lady in her favorite otome game! In order to change Dahlia's sad fate, she uses her rebellious spirit and fighting prowess to stand up. However, for some reason, the first prince, Hedera, the cause of Dahlia's tragic love, becomes obsessed with her...!?

After being hit by a truck, she wakes and finds herself reincarnated as a villainous young lady!? To change her terrible fate, she decides to quickly break off her engagement!

title: Toshokan no Tensai Shoujo: Honzuki no Shinjin Kanri wa Boudai na Chishiki de Kuni wo Sukuimasu!
title_japanese: 図書館の天才少女～本好きの新人官吏は膨大な知識で国を救います！～
synopsis:
Martina loves books and has finally read every book in town, so she aims to become a government official in search of books from the undiscovered royal palace library. She takes on a highly challenging exam, but her incredible memory, never forgetting a single word of the book she reads, means she passes with a perfect score!? Assigned to the Political Affairs Department, Martina surprises those around her with her powerful memory, but one day, an unnatural monster appears...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Karappo Seijo toshite Suterareta Hazu ga, Totsugisaki no Koutei Heika ni Dekiai sareteimasu
title_japanese: 空っぽ聖女として捨てられたはずが、嫁ぎ先の皇帝陛下に溺愛されています
synopsis:
Tiana, who was mistreated as an incompetent saint in her homeland, was married off to the cursed empire. On her way there, however, her former life as a great saint is awakened, and Tiana, who has returned to her victorious nature, vows to repay Sylvia as soon as she regains her power. Meanwhile, in a neighboring country, her husband, the emperor with a brilliant brow, is Felix, her protégé from a previous life!

"This is a contractual marriage until the country stabilizes."

Felix has made up his mind that this is a contractual marriage until the country is stabilized, but he gradually begins to dote on Tiana...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

A man captures a mermaid to profit from her flesh, which is said to grant eternal life to anyone who eats it. But while waiting to make the exchange, something unexpected begins to bloom between them!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: The Dropout Returns
synopsis:
In middle school, Cheol Im was a living legend for his fighting prowess. Years later, he learns that his childhood friend from the orphanage, Kim Sol, was bullied to death. Determined to get revenge, Cheol returns to school. But his plans take an unexpected turn when Seo Ha-yun, a fellow orphan who was like a sister to him, is assigned as a teacher at that very same school. Now, Cheol is forced to choose between his thirst for revenge and his loyalty to the person who once protected him.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

Count Scrooge Caroldt was once an imperial tutor who betrayed Crown Prince Calsion and was executed, and I woke up in his body! I decided to change my fate by properly guiding the prince and years later, on the night of his coming-of-age ball, I was finally going to retire and live happily ever after. That is, until Calsion ripped up my resignation letter and forced his desires on me...! Now he wants to make me his consort?! I just wanted to retire in peace!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Hoshi ni Negai wo
synopsis:
Misaki can't catch a break from her mom's constant scolding. After one too many lectures, she rebels and runs away from home, only to encounter a star-shaped alien. This otherworldly visitor apparently came to Earth searching for a runaway child...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Katainaka no Ossan, Kensei ni Naru Gaiden: Hajimari no Mahou Kenshi
title_english: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman: The Mage Knight's Origin

synopsis:
Deep in the remote countryside of Liberia, young Fichelle Harbeller joins the dojo of famed swordsmaster Beryl Gardinant. Burning with a fierce determination, she quickly outpaces her peers in swordsmanship. And in the midst of her training, she also discovers her newly awakened talent for magic! Thus begins the journey of a girl striving to master both blade and sorcery.

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Anata no Oshiro no Kobito-san: Gohan Kudasai, Hatarakimasu
title_japanese: あなたのお城の小人さん ～御飯下さい、働きますっ～
synopsis:
In a forgotten corner of a massive castle, a starving child teeters on the edge of and death...until she suddenly awakens with the memories of Chihiro Sagami, an office worker from modern Japan?! Determined to survive at all costs, she stumbles upon a kindhearted chef and strikes a deal: food in exchange for work. Though small in stature, her nimble hands and capable skills quickly earn her the fond nickname "Little Helper" among the castle staff. But behind her infectious eagerness and penchant for delicious food, her mysterious golden eyes hold a great secret that could determine the fate of the world!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Seijo ga "Amayakashite Kureru Yasashii Dannasama" wo Boshuu shitara Kokuou Heika ga Rikkouho shitekita
title_english: The Saintess Recruited a Doting King Husband

synopsis:
Stacy climbed her way up to the top of the church as a powerful saintess—but in a male-dominated society, her cruel father just sees her as marriage material for political gain. Tired of being treated like a pawn, she comes up with a solution: a list of 8 unreasonable, non-negotiable, and self-indulgent conditions for any potential husband. That way, no one will possibly qualify, and she'll be happily single...right?

Until one day, someone actually steps forward claiming he meets every requirement—the King himself?! 

What started as a half-serious "perfect husband" checklist turns into a royal engagement!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Hitozuma Kyoushi ga Oshiego no Joshikousei ni Dohamari suru Hanashi
title_japanese: 人妻教師が教え子の女子高生にドはまりする話
synopsis:
"If you gonna be that kind, I'll fall in love with you, teacher."

Itsuki Ichigoharaーa married woman in her late twenties. Occupation: high school teacher. And yet, she made a move on a female student ten years younger than her. The student's name is Rin Togawa. She's tall, gentle, kinda childish, and pretty. And she's a really nice girl. While Itsuki was concerned about Rin, who had problems at home, they ended up kissing in bed. This is definitely a betrayal, an affair, a crime. How will Itsuki get through all these elements that could bring about her downfall?

"How did it end up like this?"

Lustful and unfaithful but somehow warm. A love story between a female teacher and a female student.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Blue Name Pressure
synopsis:
"How did I end up doing a strip show in front of a classmate I barely even know?"

Baek Han-yeong has lived his whole life as a perfectly ordinary No-Namer, someone without the fated mark of destiny. That is, until he gets to college and meets Ryu Cheong-hyeon, a bold Namer with the name "Baek Han-yeong" etched right across his neck.

Cheong-hyeon, convinced fate is at play, starts tailing Han-yeong everywhere, fascinated by the uncanny coincidence. Exhausted and desperate to prove he's just a plain old No-Namer, Han-yeong blurts out the wildest challenge imaginable... and ends up undressing right in front of him.

Regret hits immediately.

"If I could go back in time, I'd never throw out a stupid suggestion like that to this lunatic..."

But now that the line's been crossed, will fate keep dragging them back together, or was this one outrageous mistake just the beginning?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Mr. Maybe Mine
synopsis:
When Kim Minseok wakes up in a hospital, he's stunned to find two handsome men both claiming to be his lovers. Dismissing it as a prank, he prepares to leave, only to see an unfamiliar face in the mirror. Minseok is now in the body of Seo Hayoon, an evident two-timing schemer. Who was Seo Hayoon, and how did Minseok end up in his body? More importantly, how will he navigate this tangled web of relationships?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Love to Love You
synopsis:
Jiwoon is infatuated with the enigmatic Sejin, confessing his love daily despite constant rejection. Sejin, on the other hand, believes Jiwoon could never truly like him for who he is. However, when Jiwoon vows to stay by Sejin's side no matter what, the two decide to officially go steady. As their romance blossoms, Jiwoon is elated...but he soon discovers Sejin's hidden, sadistic tendencies. And things only get more complicated, as it comes to light that Jiwoon's best friend Inhyuk has been harboring feelings for him all this time! Will Jiwoon be able to accept Sejin for who he is and learn to love his lusty lover? Or will Sejin's lechery leave him longing for his bestie's embrace?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Kumo no Otoko
synopsis:
William was selling his body to survive when a mob boss named Eric takes him in as his new lover. Even after being entangled with the dangerous mob, William found peace and fulfillment in his every day life. That is, until an accident takes Eric from him. Without Eric around anymore, William escapes the mob.

As William lives a quiet life alone, a mysterious man from his past emerges, calling himself Nine, and William instantly recognizes him as Eric's adopted son. With the boss dead, Nine claims that he had no place to go. The mysterious man has an air of danger about him, but on the flip side, he appears timid and unreliable. Unable to abandon the poor boy now with no one to turn to, William opens his home to the younger man.

Meanwhile, the mob is still digging into the truth of their boss's death. Was it really an accident? Or...was it cold-blooded murder?

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Mousetrap
synopsis:
Cheon Yuhyeon is so close to inheriting the family business when his ailing father presents one condition: he needs to give his father a grandchild. It shouldn't be too hard for an omega like Yuhyeon, as long as he can find himself a suitable alpha that isn't his childhood friend and company rival Lee Hyeondo. But Hyeondo has been suffering a decade-long crush on Yuhyeon and desperately wants to be his baby daddy. And Yuhyeon is finding it harder to resist his friend's flirty tactics to get him in bed...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Kurokami Long Gomi Talk Deck Senpai
title_english: The Long-Haired Girl's Garbage Small Talk
title_japanese: 黒髪ロングゴミトークデッキ先輩

She's this untouchable upperclassman at school, but she's completely different on the bus ride there. This girl who's way out of my league keeps hitting me with the most garbage conversations, and I'm the only one who gets to see this side of her.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: SOS! Fledgling Report
synopsis:
Cheongyeon is an academic legend with a soul of ice. To save his college applications from a failing character evaluation, he agrees to mentor Suhan, the school's most notorious troublemaker. Suhan earns nothing but zeroes and lives with zero motivation. While Cheongyeon only wants his college recommendation, Suhan just wants to be left alone. As they clash over study habits and life choices, the top student begins to find his missing empathy and emotions in the most unexpected place.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Repeat Vice: Akuyaku Kizoku wo Shinitakunai node Shitennou ni Naru no wo Yamemashita
title_japanese: リピート・ヴァイス～悪役貴族は死にたくないので四天王になるのをやめました～
synopsis:
The arrogant noble Rufus is furious. Why? Because in a world where a popular RPG has come to life, he keeps dying miserably over and over again as a pathetic villainous noble. Such a disgraceful end is unworthy of a proud nobleman. He may only be twelve years old, but age doesn't matter. He is determined to do whatever it takes to avoid his tragic fate.

He takes down the corrupt official who started it all, eases the heavy taxes on his people, and continues to slay the monsters that ravage his domain. As he does, a hidden power that never appeared in the game begins to awaken. For some reason, the commoners begin to praise him, but he declares, "Don't misunderstand me, commoners. I'm doing this for myself."

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Shukufuku no Ceska
synopsis:
The story takes place in a world ruled by people who possess "Lua," supernatural powers granted by the gods. Ceska, a multilingual speaker who understands every language, attends an academy for the children of royalty and rulers from various nations. She also works as an interpreter. Meanwhile, Shiki, the prince of a nation whose people have no Lua and are called "Yaguu" and endure harsh discrimination, enrolls at the academy. Driven by a desire to befriend Shiki, Ceska actively converses with him, gradually closing the distance between them. However, a certain phrase uttered by Shiki triggers a massive shift in the world... This fantasy weaves its tale around Ceska, a genius linguist, and Shiki, the handsome prince of an oppressed people.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Moimon
synopsis:
The mysterious creatures that suddenly appeared are... Moimon.

A charming exterior, balanced against an inherent savagery and tough bodies. At first glance, it appeared that humanity had finally established a master-servant relationship with them through training... But as a new found ferocity spreads through wild Moimon, the continued survival of the human race is in question.

Kakeru is a boy from a warrior tribe that survives by hunting Moimon. Shimizu is a girl dreaming of adventure. Together, they set off to gather clues to stop the ferocious mutation of these creatures.

And so rises the curtain on a new and exciting monster battle action series featuring bizarre creatures called Moimon and the boy who hunts them!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Summer Moon: The Quprids
synopsis:
Yeoreum is just a normal high school girl determined to find a cute boyfriend. But everything changes when she stumbles across a constellation shard and transforms into one of the Quprid—warriors with magical powers. How is she supposed to date Gowon, the hottest boy at school, on top of protecting the galaxy? And why does her childhood friend Doyun seem to know more about the shards than he should?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Watashi ga Daisuki na Shousetsuka wo Korosu made
title_english: Until I Kill the Novelist I Love
title_japanese: 私が大好きな小説家を殺すまで
synopsis:
The popular novelist Yuuma Harukawa has gone missing. Behind his disappearance lies the presence of a single girl—a girl who had suffered abuse, and the beloved novelist who saved her. Their warped, codependent relationship slowly drifts toward destruction.

Magazine model Miyu-chan is busy with a photoshoot again today. Of course, her lunch isn't the low-calorie meal a model should have... instead, it's tonkotsu ramen packed with calories♡. With noodles, extra noodles, rice, and soup, Miyu-chan is enjoying a hearty diet when disaster suddenly strikes...!

title: Karei Naru! Uwakitsu Sanjuuni-sai

Laehwa Lee lost all her childhood memories after a terrible incident, and now that she's an adult, she's on a mission to recover them. But some people, like her rich and powerful stepfather, will stop at nothing to keep Laehwa under control. Out of options, Laehwa hires mercenary Itae Gwon to enter into a contract marriage with her. Though Itae is her shield, he also has an intense bloodlust. Will Laehwa be able to keep her cool as sparks begin to fly?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: To the Flawless Duke
synopsis:
Edith—who lost her mother at the hands of the Reynolds marquis family—was branded a madwoman. She dreams of vengeance, but a chance comes to the powerless: marriage to the third prince, Duke Myers, who is rumored to be perfect in every way.

It's a marriage of convenience meant to use one another, and that's fine. If I can make you live through hell without even knowing it's hell, I will do whatever it takes. Keep smiling, Reynolds. Until I have paved the road to the very fires of hell right before you.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Campfire Friends
synopsis:
After another soul-crushing day at the office, Chaesu wakes up inside the world of Campfire Friends, a cartoon he used to watch as a child. As he spends more time with his colorful woodland pals every night, he begins to regain his lost childhood innocence. But behind their cheery kindness hides a chilling secret...

A young man got caught up in gambling scam at a yakuza joint. Getting beaten up, his life is slipping from him when a hot dealer throws him a lifeline and bails him out. "Miss Bunny", as he calls her, turns out to be less of a savior and more of wolf in sheep's clothing: a sadist who recognized his masochism. After saving him, she's now his mistress and he's at her beck and call.

A certain young man was reincarnated as a young boy Leirus, as he is destined to defeat the demon king as the hero.... or not. Rather, he is put to work as a slave, waiting for death to take him from this world. Leirus who turned 15 was attacked by a chimera while being transported to a mine, and managed to escape through the confusion. However, without food, he was on the verge of starving to death, when he is suddenly brought back to life by a kind hearted girl Corona, the daughter of a dining hall. Leirus who manages to scrape by becomes an adventurer and finally experiences the kindness of people. However, the place he finds doesn't last for long. An Arch Mage who died without fulfilling his dream wakes up to finds himself being reincarnated as a member of the imperial family. And what's more is that his new body has a talent for close-quarters combat! This time he holds hope that he finally might be able to fulfill his desire of being world's strongest...

But after reincarnating his new name is Evangeline. Indeed, he had become a girl. In her princess life where muscle training and fighting are forbidden, Eva brings dumbbells to her room and wields a sword! And before long, she becomes the strongest!?

A fantasy about a tomboy princess' rise to the top!

But one day, Nona uses magic to fix Lovi's glasses and subsequently catches the attention of the Bureau of Magic Surveillance. A simple good deed becomes the trigger that sets Nona's destiny in motion...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

synopsis:
To conquer the dungeons that suddenly appeared on Earth a hundred years ago, students now attend academies to train as adventurers. Among them are two rivals: Kuroto Sainokami, the academy's strongest delinquent, and Yukihime Mononobe, an elite noble honor student. One day, the two of them find themselves trapped in a dungeon, inside a room that they can't escape unless they're holding hands!? Will these sworn rivals be able to clear this high-difficulty mission and conquer the dungeon...!?

In September 2015, Kwon Min, a top 0.1% student, accidentally uncovers the truth about Cha Yubin, the phantom student from the next class who stole 20 minutes of his mock exam. For 30 minutes a day, the two unravel a mystery of luck and fate more complicated than the toughest exam questions. A story of all the shining moments we want to hold onto—which also came to us at nineteen, an age that was ending in the blink of an eye as the final day-count dwindled.

Haruka is an ordinary, tired office worker like any other. Her only pleasure is buying ice cream from a vending machine in the park she stops by on her way home from work. She also enjoys talking about silly things with a young man she always meets there, who she thinks is younger than her. Haruka works hard, looking forward to talking with him, whose name she doesn't even know, but one day she finds out that he has a crush on a woman—and before she knows it, she realizes that she has fallen in love with him too. A love story set in a park at night, where unrequited love crosses paths.

Moving back to her hometown, she meets up with her former classmate Risa to catch up on old times, including her old crush and coach, Haba, who isn't the attractive teacher she remembers. As he gets entangled in one odd case after another, he finds there is much more going on in the world than meets the eye. The strangest part is, everything seems to trace back to Jonathan McStars. A special guest crashes the party, and this confident man in a suit turns out to be none other than Chizuwa, who's here to confront Kusui about the end of their relationship.

Kohaku, outcast of the White Tiger Clan, once shared an unbreakable bond with Seiryuu, chieftain of the Dragon Clan and lord of the beastfolk. As children, Seiryuu was the only one who made Kohaku feel like he belonged. But the centuries have driven them apart—Seiryuu now hides behind the facade of a constant smile, and Kohaku can no longer trust his heart to the whims of another. On the rare occasions that the two met, Seiryuu would casually propose marriage, only for Kohaku to refuse, unwilling to believe in his cavalier promises. However, things change when Kohaku finds himself next in Seiryuu's long line of matchmaking partners. Despite everything, nothing could have prepared Kohaku for the secret Seiryuu has been hiding for all these years. As the truth begins to unravel, can Kohaku finally understand his old friend's feelings? Or have time and trauma already doomed their chance at happiness?

He must leave the orphanage now that he's come of age, and there's one thing he wants above all else: freedom from poverty. His best shot at making a stable life for himself lies in graduating from Arneval Academy. If only the tuition weren't so expensive. In need of work, Louis registers with the Adventurer's Guild where he meets Bolt, a seasoned adventurer who insists they form a party together and even helps Louis save up for his school fees. But life at the academy still comes at a price, and Louis finds staying in the party with Bolt might not be so bad, especially as feelings begin to bloom with every new adventure. However, all is not as it seems. Bolt may not be who he claims, and the mysteries of Louis's own past might very well upend everything he thought he knew about himself. Will the truth break their bond, or will it draw them closer than ever?

The hard part will be avoiding the conflict to come, and doing that means bringing the family together again. He's just got to be sweet to his younger sister, get in his father's good graces, and cure his mother's terminal illness, of course. Should be simple enough, right? Wonwoo, whose face was unremarkable, was shocked to realize he had been 'chosen,' but the offer, with its large payment, was tempting, and he impulsively accepted. 

"The payment... is given upfront, right?" But that night left only pain. Wonwoo regretted it and began avoiding Kwon Taeshin. Even so, Taeshin became increasingly obsessed with him. "I've thought it through carefully, and it seems I want to do it with you again."

title: Nyotaika suru to 1000-bai Tsuyokunaru Skill wo Te ni Ireta!
title_english: I Got a Skill That Makes Me 1000 Times Stronger When I Transsexual!
title_japanese: 女体化すると1000倍強くなるスキルを手に入れた!

title: Be a Good Boy, My Dear Dog
title_japanese: Be a good boy, my dear dog
synopsis:
A Dominant Alpha, Shirou Atsumi, the ace of the sales department admired by all, has been struggling with unexplained physical ailments. To make matters worse, a conflict with a colleague causes him mental distress. The one who saves Shirou from his predicament is psychiatrist Akihito Masaki. As a Dominant Omega, Akihito easily uncovers Shirou's secrets, gradually drawing him into an intense, mind-scorching pleasure that engulfs him completely—?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kemono no You ni Ueteiru
title_japanese: 獣のように飢えている
synopsis:
"I'm gonna make the funk music I love popular." This was once Aida's resolution, but time slipped by, leading to an ordinary career instead. Now, with each passing day, the sensation of being trapped continues to torment him. In the midst of this, a former bandmate extends an invitation. And when Aida takes up his bass guitar for the first time in a long while, sure enough, his heart trembles to the music...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Televi Magazine-ban Kamen Rider
title_japanese: テレビマガジン版 仮面ライダー

title: Mattaku Icha Love suru Ki no Nai Kyonyuu Reijou Gal ni Niku Dildo Atsukai Sareteiru Ore no Hanashi
title_japanese: まったくイチャラブする気のない巨乳令嬢ギャルに肉ディルド扱いされている俺の話

title: Cosplay-bu Ura Katsudou Nisshi
title_japanese: コスプレ部裏活動日誌

title: Kim Ji-An, the Best Man
synopsis:
A loser named Kim Ji-an transferred to Sujung High School... But actually, he's the top dog of them all... and he's a girl!! Ji-an's parents, worried about their troublemaking daughter who's been in fights with boys in the past, want to send her only to an all-girls school. But Ji-an wants to attend a co-ed school.

In the end, she's allowed to go—on the condition that she'll disguise herself as a boy and keep it quiet... But it's already getting noisy!! -_-^

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Initializing the Sect System
synopsis:
The protagonist, who had worked himself to the bone at the Murim Alliance, finally retires and heads back to his hometown to fulfill his dream of becoming a sect leader. Due to his meager savings, he ends up purchasing a manor that was suspiciously cheap and rumored to be haunted. But then, an unfamiliar system suddenly appears before him. Though startled at first, the protagonist soon begins to use the system to efficiently recruit disciples and manage the sect's finances and resources. In time, with the help of the system, his sect grows rapidly, so much that it starts drawing the attention, wariness, and hostility of other Murim factions...

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Tensei Mae no Tutorial de Isekai Saikyou ni Narimashita. Junbi shisugite Dai-2 no Jinsei wa Easy Mode desu!
title_japanese: 転生前のチュートリアルで異世界最強になりました。 準備し過ぎて第二の人生はイージーモードです!
synopsis:
One day, a 33-year-old man who spent all his time playing video games to escape reality from an unreasonable life of bullying and power harassment died. However, he was chosen as a candidate for reincarnation to another world, but the woman who guided him to his reincarnation told him that she would not give him any cheats. Instead of cheats, he was offered three months of training at an otherworldly reincarnation training facility. The training facility was supposed to make it relatively easy to acquire skills, but what would he accomplish in three short months? He was given an Appraisal and an Item Box as bonus skills, but he was thrown into the training facility before he could even begin to set up his prowess.

He spent three months in the training facility, desperately training to survive his new life. But after 3 months, after 1 year, after 10 years, he was not reincarnated. He was worried he might have gone to the infinite hell of the game world since he died from playing too mu

title: The Rite of Prayer
synopsis:
As a child, Hanjoo was cherished and protected by Kiwon, the man he thought was simply his father’s friend.

Ten years later, they reunite and sit down for a long-overdue night of drinks. But in his drunken haze, Kiwon whispers a truth Hanjoo cannot ignore.

"You and I... we were lovers. In another life."

Suddenly, the lines between family, fate, and forbidden desire begin to blur. Can Hanjoo and Kiwon ever go back to the bond they once had, or will this revelation pull them into a love that defies time itself?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Yuru Gal Take-nii no Katabutsu Romanticist Kareshi
title_japanese: ゆるギャル武にぃの堅物ロマンチスト彼氏
synopsis:
Takemaru Odagiri is a third-year high school student who is about to take his entrance exams. When his family urged him to study for the entrance exam, he reluctantly dropped in at the bookstore and ran into Kazama, who was in the same class as him. When he suddenly called out, he had piled up a large amount of girls' comics at the cash register. He seems to be embarrassed and is pressed not to talk about it, but Takemaru is interested in the unexpected side of him who is straight-laced and from that day on, he and Kazama lend and borrow shoujo manga. Kazama's true face, which is gradually revealed, is an innocent boy who dreams of a manga-like love...!?

(Source: MU)

title: Agakimi Chiruran
synopsis: Tanka, a high school student with no hopes for the future, travels back in time to Ashikaga Academy, the largest educational institution for military strategists during the Sengoku period.

title: Watashi no Midara na Kugutsu
synopsis:
At work, you're the cold, strict senior colleague. At home, you're the gentle, sweet lover. Which one is the real you? A one-shot about a secret, warped obsession no one can know about!!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Yume Samashi
synopsis:
Ritsuki, an elementary school boy, hasn't been able to wake up early for half a year and now lives a reversed sleep cycle. One day, on his way to school, he wonders what will happen if he stays like this forever. Just then, a strange woman suddenly speaks to him, saying she want to be his big sister.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Cottage Garden
synopsis:
Burnt out and buried in work, Isaac Schrader drowns his stress in drinks with his only friend, James. The next morning, he wakes up in a hotel bed—hungover, disoriented, and far from alone.

Lying next to him is Theodore Donovan, his charming yet insufferable roommate from their boarding school days... a man who vanished without a word years ago.

Their reunion is anything but ordinary—and Theodore's sudden return feels far from innocent.

What is he really after?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Point of Impact
synopsis:
Former national archer Hwang Jungho was forced to retire after an injury turned his shoulder into a hypersensitive weakness. Avoiding touch and attention, he now lives quietly as a delivery driver.

That is, until a delivery brings him face to face with rising archery star Kang Junhyuk—who grabs Jungho's shoulder and triggers an overwhelming reaction.

"If this is because of me... I'll help you...!"

What kind of "help" is Junhyuk offering—and can Jungho resist him?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Bad Not Bat
synopsis:
Choi Jooha is a professional baseball player for the Hunters when his high school hoobae, Park Dojin, joins the team. The two spent their youth kissing, but didn't go any further than that. One day, Dojin drags Jooha into a bathroom stall, lamenting how they never did more and is determined to make up for lost time. Will Juha be able to balance both his personal and professional life, or will Dojin's brash behavior shove them both into the public eye?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Lucky Dice
synopsis:
"I have erectile dysfunction."

Not exactly the kind of confession Woo Hyeonsoo ever planned to make, but a few too many drinks later, his biggest secret slips out to his classmate Ha Jeongyoon. Mortified, Hyeonsoo braces for pity or laughter... but Jeongyoon just grins.

"Then why don't we test it out? Who knows? Maybe I can fix you."

Wait, what?!

Before Hyeonsoo can process what's happening, he's suddenly part of Jeongyoon's "scientific experiment." What started as drunken honesty turns into a very hands-on test of chemistry, curiosity, and terrible decisions.

Now, every accidental touch feels like a loaded dice roll. Will it be a total flop, or a nat 20?

Caught between panic and possibility, Hyeonsoo wonders if maybe, just maybe, his biggest problem wasn't physical after all... Because with Jeongyoon around, something else is definitely "rising" to the occasion.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: National Route 1
synopsis:
Tae-san, a young team leader at Janghyeon Construction, arrives in Jochiwon to prevent flooding from the Heungbok Reservoir—only to unexpectedly reunite with his first love from college, Su-yeon. "She's still the same, Lee Su-yeon... thoughtful, cautious, detached." As Tae-san feels his old emotions stirring, Su-yeon tries to stay steady. The only thing that has changed is the decade that has passed without each other—the time that turned them into adults. "Take your time to hesitate and think it through. I'll wait for you." Because the invisible line that once stood between us... I crossed it long ago.

(Source: Ridi, translated)

title: Nakasetakute Doushiyou
synopsis:
1. Omae no Nakigao Misetemiro
2-6. Nakasetakute Doushiyou
7. Nakasetakute Doushiyou

title: Nikushokujuu wa Amai Koi wo Suru
title_japanese: 肉食獣は甘い恋をする
synopsis:
Stuck in a toxic relationship, both Mari and Tomohiro were attracted to each other, but couldn't seem to meet each other's needs... until they had one night of crazy, no-limits breakup sex. Their relationship starts to mend, but one day, Mari finds out that she's pregnant! See how their relationship evolves as they handle the difficulties of pregnancy while staying freaky in the bedroom.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Seijunha Joyuu wa Toshiue Haiyuu ni Amaku Shitsukerareru.
title_english: Sweet Discipline for the Pure Actress
title_japanese: 清純派女優は年上俳優に甘く躾けられる。
synopsis:
TV stars Rena and Rintarou have been dating behind the scenes for over an year now. When the busy performers finally find time to be alone together, they can’t take their hands off each other!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Zetsurin Kareshi no Sukusuku Mesuiki Report
title_english: Making Your Stud Cum Like a Girl
title_japanese: 絶倫彼氏のすくすくメスイキレポート
synopsis:
How do you teach a lesson to your boyfriend who says he's an "S" when he's more of an "M"? You make him quiver in pleasure, you make him moan like a woman, and then you make him squirt!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Harami no Kuni no Alice
synopsis:
When Alice wakes up after losing her memories, she finds herself in a magical forest. The guardian of the forest, Punitz, takes her in and discovers that she has an ability unique to females: to give birth to new life.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Oyakuza Ojousama no Okashi na Kousou
title_japanese: おヤクザお嬢様のおかしな抗争
synopsis:
In a school where eating sweets is forbidden, there's a rampant underground trade in confectionery... This school is controlled by those known as the "Snackuza" who secretly sell sweets beneath the surface...!?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Turning Point
synopsis:
Baek Sarang, who was comfortable eating alone, meditating alone, and drinking alone. Yu Pyeonghwa wants to get along with others even at a loss. Love and peace, who have lived conflicting lives, meet each other and learn a new way of life. A realistic romance that is more adult than you think and more childish than you think.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Hoshi no Taion, Meguru Yume
synopsis:
On her 40th birthday, Yumeko's grandmother died. She was left all alone. She had no family, no boyfriend, and was working as a temporary worker. That's how Yumeko celebrated her birthday. Just as she was wondering what to do next, her in-game lover, Sierra, asked her to move in with her. Though hesitant, Yumeko agreed, and when she headed to Sierra's house, she found the hugely popular actress Shiori Hoshikawa there!

Surprised by this sudden turn of events, Shiori tearfully confessed to Yumeko, "I want to be with you."

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Namaiki Sugiru yo, Chigaya-kun
title_japanese: 生意気すぎるよ、茅ヶ矢くん
synopsis:
Ever since the day they met, no matter how many times she tries to brush him off, Natsune always finds herself at the center of Chigaya's playful aim-his words, his smiles, his relentless teasing, all reserved just for her. Flustered by his knowing grin and mischievous jabs, she can't help but wonder... could there be something more behind his teasing than just a joke?

A charming, heart-fluttering high school romance between two archers—a composed senior and her mischievous junior who just might be shooting straight for her heart!

(Source: Crossed Hearts)

title: Tenma to Sakaki
synopsis:
"I feel like being on top today." 

The mysterious and cool hottie Tenma, and the flirty but kind "prince" Sakaki. Both boys are super popular at school, but they are secretly lovers! From cool to cute, they show each other sides of themselves unknown to others, and they don't plan on sharing!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title: Requiem of the Scarlet Name
synopsis:
Born with noble blood but stripped of name and freedom, Shin Hee was sold into servitude and erased from history. Then came the rebellion, a single night of fire and blood that wiped out her entire family. But death was not the end. Reborn as Hwa-Ryeong, a courtesan of the pleasure quarters and no longer fully human, she walks the border between the living and the damned. The past clings to her like a curse, whispering of vengeance and loss. Now, two men stand in her path: Yu-Heon, her former fiancé who still carries the weight of her memory, and Crown Prince Lee Kang, the man who sought to possess her from the start. Between love and obsession, mercy and revenge, Hwa-Ryeong must decide what remains of her humanity, and whose blood must be spilled for her to finally be free.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Isekai Toushou no Maken Seisakugurashi
title_japanese: 異世界刀匠の魔剣製作ぐらし
synopsis:
The katana smith Lutz has just forged his magnum opus, a katana so bewitchingly beautiful that it's dangerous even to look at. Unfortunately, as an unlicensed smith, he has no way to sell it. But when his only real business partner, Claudia, is captured by crooked knights, Lutz knows exactly what to do with his perfect blade. On the other side of the city walls, Gerhard, an old enchanter, is facing a horrendous slump. Though he's confident in his abilities, he can't create a true work of art without a proper canvas, and he longs for nothing more than a unique sword to serve as his muse. This time for sure, he will create an enchanted sword that will wipe that damn disinterested look off of the so-called hero's face. This is a tale of the gloriously deranged few who have given their lives and souls to crafting enchanted swords. When they come together, will they bring forth a golden age or the collapse of society itself? To those maniacs, it doesn't matter either way.

(Source: J-Novel

title: Shinigami-chan wa Mimamoritai
title_japanese: 死神ちゃんは見守りたい

title: Ai yo Todoke★Mentanhan!
title_english: Delivery of Love★Noodle, Eggs, and Rice!
title_japanese: 愛よ届け★メンタンハン!
synopsis:
During the busy lunch hour at "Ma's Southern Southern Cuisine," a delivery order comes in. The person calling turns out to be a police officer who has feelings for Ma, and he seems to be in a desperate situation...?! 

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Tomodachinchi no Neechan ga Kowakute Ii Hito
title_english: My Friend's Sister Is Scary but Nice
title_japanese: 友達んちの姉ちゃんが怖くていい人

title: Heat of the Moment
synopsis:
Ju Hee-yeon, the newly crowned emperor of the powerful Jewon Empire, possesses unparalleled authority and control over everything... except for one persistent affliction: an unrelenting fever, borne from his condition to carry the powers of the dragon. As his fevers worsen and desperation takes hold, an unexpected remedy presents itself in the form of Yeo-heun, a half-goblin rumored to possess the ability to absorb and nullify others' heat. Intrigued, Hee-yeon seeks solace in an enchanting night shared with Yeo-heun. However, the emperor soon finds himself captivated beyond his expectations by the goblin's endearing charm. As time passes and Hee-yeon recognizes deeper feelings stirring within his own heart, he begins to question if his infatuation with Yeo-heun is truly only a consequence of the heat of the moment...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Kimi no Sei Nan Dakara, Sekinin Totte yo ne.
title_english: You Started This, So You Better Finish It.
title_japanese: 君のせいなんだから、責任とってよね。
synopsis:
I'm an office lady, and a part-time rental girlfriend. I'm good at getting along with people and can do anything. I'm not particularly interested in romance right now, but I imagine I'll get married and have kids someday...

Then I met Sui-chan, my first rental-girlfriend client. At first, I was hesitant because we're the same sex and she's younger than me... but then I thought, wow, I'm good with women too!?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Kimi to nara, Ashita wo Utaeru no
title_japanese: 君となら、明日を歌えるの

title: Love Thy Neighbor
synopsis:
When Hyeonu moves into Terrarium Apartments, the place seems idyllic—until he witnesses a man plunge from the building across his window. The residents dismiss the victim as a "misfit", and Hyeonu soon notices their unsettling, scripted routines. Beneath the cheerful facade lies something far darker: a community that demands conformity and punishes defiance. As the walls close in, Hyeonu realizes that once you enter Terrarium, leaving may no longer be an option. 

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Yowai Mono Club
synopsis:
I was confessed to. It was during the summer of my first year. I ended up dating Kana. Even though I didn't understand my own feelings...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Ookami to Randoseru: S-kyuu Saishuuka to Tensei Musume no Dungeon Gohan
title_japanese: 狼とランドセル～S級採集家と転生娘のダンジョンご飯～

title: Justice Saga: Ware no Tsukurishi Risou no Sekai de Youjo Musou
title_japanese: ジャスティス・サーガ ―我の創りし理想の世界で幼女無双―
synopsis:
The protagonist enters the world of stories he created when he was in his second year of middle school. Alongside him is his ideal, strong, and cute girl in a military uniform! Readers, step into the fantasy world he created back then.

(Source: Cygames, translated)

title: Net Idol no Haishin wo Tetsudatteita Manager no Ore, Nazeka Bazutteshimau
title_japanese: ネットアイドルの配信を手伝っていたマネージャーの俺、なぜかバズってしまう

title: Tonari no Osoegawa
synopsis:
In the Magic Realm, mages train hard to master their arts. However, one mage named Toya Osoegawa only cares about using magic to live a comfortable life! But now, thanks to the orders from the Divine Magus, the least motivated man in the Magic Realm has been sent to the Human Realm! Can he use his bizarre magic to protect humans and send evil wizards back to their world?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Kane no Naru Mori
synopsis:
