Rhodri arrives at the elven forest, but it's been overrun by elf-hunting humans! Though an elf himself, he possesses unparalleled worldly wisdom and negotiation skills. But are Rhodri's weapons truly intended for fighting humans...?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Haimiya-senpai wa Kowakute Kawaii
title_english: Haimiya Senpai Is Scary but Cute
title_japanese: 灰宮先輩は怖くてかわいい
synopsis:
At my high school, Haimiya-senpai is feared by all and considered too scary. This is apparently due to her intimidating appearance and blunt way of speaking... and those sparkling piercings! The long, gray wolf-cut hair! Even her Kansai accent is intimidating!!! But for some reason, this scary senpai treats me kindly...!? As "scary" turns into "cute," this scary heart-pounding senpai rom-com begins!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Tsui no Hanayome
synopsis:
Selma is a beautiful woman who just moved into town after getting married. Everyone is fascinated by her beauty, but the men around her die one by one...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Don't Build My Hopes Up
synopsis:
Rule one of harboring a secret crush: never get your hopes up. Especially if your crush is the nicest person you've ever seen. Yeonu's kind, thoughtful, and gentle—everything that Gyu-yeong wants his significant other to be. The problem is that Yeonu's nice to everyone, not just Gyu-yeong. Gyu-yeong knows that he's not special to Yeonu, but sometimes he wants to give in to the little voice in his heart. Maybe all of this does mean something, maybe Yeonu thinks that he's special, maybe Gyu-yeong will be allowed to build his hopes up, just this once.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Love Me Dramatically
synopsis:
When I told him my feelings, he replied, "I've always dreamed of a love straight out of a drama." I thought he was just telling me to be a good boyfriend, but as we got closer, I finally understood what he meant—He wanted us to live out a true romance drama. But can I really play my part in his script called life?

(Source: Manta)

title: Haunted Tales
synopsis:
Yang Gidam, a freshman at Soleum College, has always been fascinated by and drawn to the occult. It is only natural, then, that he finds himself joining the on-campus Ghost Story Club. Unbeknownst to him, however, his involvement in such activities has already been noticed by Seo Neul-Ham, an upperclassman with a cold aura who can see ghosts. One day, as if by fate, the two become entangled and are drawn into a spooky turn of events. How will this unlikely pair fare when the ghost stories that Yang Gidam so enjoys are no longer just tales?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: I'm Not Your Fated Guide, But...
title_english: I'm Not Your Fated Guide, But...
synopsis:
With a 92% match rate, the highest in the Center's history, Esper Gye Joonmin and Guide Won Yoogyul were supposed to be the perfect pair. Instead, they clash relentlessly from their very first meeting. For years, Yoogyul struggled with his unrequited feelings for Joonmin, believing the esper could never be his unless he forgot the guide he had imprinted on nine years ago. Yet, as time goes by, he begins to realize that perhaps hope is not lost. Will Yoogyul and Joonmin ever experience the kind of tender, heartfelt guiding that other pairs take for granted?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Salvation
synopsis:
Welcome to Ubrade, your majesty.

After falling into an icy pond, Minhu wakes up in an unfamiliar world. He soon realizes he's the prophesied hero who's supposed to bring salvation to Ubrade by marrying Emperor Sioen. Will Minhu find his way back to earth? Or will he accept his destiny as the savior?

(Source: Manta)

title: Nigashita Sakana wa Ookikatta ga Tsuriageta Sakana ga Ookisugita Ken
title_english: The Fish I Missed Was Big, But I Caught Another Fish Was Too Big.
title_japanese: 逃がした魚は大きかったが釣りあげた魚が大きすぎた件
synopsis:
From a very young age, people noticed that Maria, the youngest daughter of a duke, was filled with potential. She was raised as the heiress of her house, until the birth of her baby brother relieves her of her duties. She scrambles to find a husband, but all the eligible bachelors in her duchy are taken! At this rate, she's doomed to the life of a spinster!

Maria decides to study abroad in Rubini in hopes of finding a husband, with the help of her distant relative, Aida. But in a twist of fate, the Crown Prince breaks of his engagement with Maria, even though they've never met before!

"Huh?! I don't remember getting engaged!?"

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Witch Craft Works Extra
title_japanese: ウィッチクラフトワークス EXTRA
synopsis:
The main story has concluded but what happens after that? The fate of Takamiya-kun, Kagari-san, and Kasumi-chan, the future of the KMM group, the true enemy of the chairman, and the continuing story. The history that was left behind... We'll show you all the stories that were left untold; the rich side stories of Witch Craft Works begin!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: 100-oku no Otoko
synopsis:
My life... Please buy it for 10 billion! Tatsuya Tomizawa is an ordinary business man when he inherits his mom's 10 billion yen debt. In order to become a 10 billion yen man, he sells himself to Tenzan Kugayama. With stacks of cash and women by his side, he pulls himself up from the edge!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Teisou Gyakuten Sekai de Yuiitsu no Otoko Kishi no Ore, Onna Kishi Gakuen ni Nyuugaku shitara Nazeka Eiyuu Atsukai sareta: Zetsurin Skill de Harem Musou
title_japanese: 貞操逆転世界で唯一の男騎士の俺、女騎士学園に入学したらなぜか英雄扱いされた ～絶倫スキルでハーレム無双～
synopsis:
In a matriarchal world where women dominate and men are treated as lesser beings, Kureto was cast aside at birth for the sin of being born male. He scraped by as an orphan, unwanted and powerless—until the day his unique skill awakened. A "supreme virility" skill that strengthens him with every act shared with a woman.

Under the guise of "training" with his dorm caretaker, Kureto masters his newfound power, achieving strength no man should possess. When he's accepted into the elite Knight Academy—a school meant for noble-born women—he sees a chance to change his fate. To become an honorable knight, to reclaim his dignity, Kureto will fight—both in the arena and between the sheets—against the very women who once looked down on him.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Ame no Hi ni Aeru yo
synopsis: A mysterious day for a god and a kid whose family owns a bathhouse.

title: Oyasai Rebellion
synopsis:
This is Harvestland—the land of vegetables. In Eggplant Village, everyone was busy getting ready for the festival. But that day, when Nanana, the village guardian, came back from gathering soil, she walked into a nightmare: homes burning, and the charred remains of everyone she knew.

She was the only one left alive. Who would attack the village? And why target the eggplants?

And so begins the darkest tale ever told in Harvestland—the blood-soaked journey of one lone eggplant seeking justice.

(Source: Hero's, translated)

title: The Murderer Targets Brunettes
synopsis:
Reincarnated as a green-eyed brunette in the novel "The Murderer Targets Brunettes", Selenia knows that the murderer in question will be arrested within a year. To avoid being murdered herself, she holes herself up in her room until her adoptive father betrays her and has her sent to the mage tower. To her surprise, the master of the tower is Eon de Grandnoir, the very murderer she's trying to avoid! The tower is staffed entirely by green-eyed brunettes, who seemingly work there of their own free will. Can Selenia survive and solve the mystery in the process?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Tengoku: Gotou Yukiko Tanpenshuu
title_japanese: 天国 ゴトウユキコ短編集
synopsis:
1. Tengoku made Hitottobi
2. 2-gatsu 14-kka no Omoide
3. Katei Kyoushi
4. Maigo Inu to Watashitachi

title: High Society
synopsis:
Sell me! I'll be the most expensive lady to obtain.

While scheming to get out of an arranged marriage, Cesare runs into Adele, a shoeshine girl from the slums. The two make a 3-month deal to help Cesare elude marriage. However, Adele is so different from the women he's met before that he can't help but be drawn to her.

(Source: Manta)

title: Nailing the Assignment
synopsis:
Hee-seo was on the fast track to success—until her luck took a sudden nosedive. Her shaman grandmother insists it's because her yin energy is too strong, and the only cure is to find a man with powerful yang energy to balance it out. Hee-seo laughs off the superstitious advice...until the night she meets Gong Tae-su, the charismatic head of the planning team whose energy feels almost dangerously magnetic. One unexpected encounter later, her world starts to spin out of control—along with her heart. Maybe Grandma was right, after all...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Gaki Muchuu
synopsis:
A man visits a painter renowned for his skill but also known as an eccentric, having been ordered by his lord to commission a fusuma painting. The painter insists he won't paint the next work until he can properly depict a cat. As the man grows increasingly anxious over the never-ending, incomplete painting...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Gekidou
synopsis:
Entaro Mashiba, who earned a starting spot on his powerhouse high school baseball team and made it to Koshien, suddenly quits the team in the spring of his senior year. As those around him struggle to understand his abrupt departure, Konoka Tanabe from the drama club senses the drama in the emotions Entaro carries and decides to reach out to him.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Osananajimi Rikujou Shoujo no Minamikami Tsubame, Ossan Kyoushi ni Yogosareru.
title_japanese: 幼馴染陸上少女の南神ツバメ、おっさん教師に汚される。

title: Boku ni Haishin Bare shita U-Cup Chinkobi Joshi Amino-san
title_japanese: 僕に配信バレしたUカップチン媚び女子 網野さん

title: Konna Ii Koto.
synopsis:
Kisaki is a beautiful gyaru, top girl of her class. So imagine the shock Tairagi, our man character, gets when he invites her to her house. But things get more complicated when he finds Kanade, his middle school crush who he hasn't seen in a while, waiting for them in that same house. What's going on? How do Kisaki and Kanade know each other? How will our MC deal with getting double teamed by the two beauties? And how does sexy cosplay play into all that?

(Source: FAKKU)

title: Futari Bus
synopsis:
Shunpei lives in a rural town of barely 3,000 people. Every day, he rides the same bus as his classmate An Takayagawa, the only one who went off to a private middle school. The two haven't really talked since elementary school... until one day, something gives them a reason to.

A soft, sky-blue not-quite-love comedy, born on a bus for two.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Ichigeki Hitchuu! Hit-kun
title_japanese: 一撃必中! ヒットくん
synopsis:
Hit Toriga is an elementary school student who is actually a fearsome hitman! He uses special bullets to shoot through people's malice and eliminate evildoers one after another. Yuuki Shiratori, the anxious class president, can't take his eyes off him. One day, a self-proclaimed rival of Hit appears...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Sayonara Boku no Idol
title_japanese: さよなら僕のアイドル
synopsis:
The story is set in a high school "Idol Club." Mitsuki Tsunoda, an idol otaku high school boy, suddenly becomes a girl—but only physically. Soon after, his favorite former idol, who once disappeared from the spotlight, appears right before him! Aiming for the top with your favorite idol! A gender-bender school idol comedy begins!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Hasshaku-sama to Koropokkur
title_japanese: 八尺様とコロポックル

title: You Are My World
synopsis:
Childhood friends Juhyeok and Su-ah once promised to stay together forever, but when their secondary genders manifest in reverse, their worlds drift apart. Years later, Juhyeok's dream of Olympic gold is on the line, and Su-ah might be the only one who can help him reach it. What follows is a story of fate, pride, and a love that refuses to yield.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Usotsuki Lip wa Koi de Kuzureru
title_japanese: 嘘つきリップは恋で崩れる
synopsis:
A dull, loner guy and a fake "shiny" girl. What will happen to their mismatched campus life!?

Souhei Sagara is a university student who proudly champions the solitary lifestyle. Living next door in his rundown apartment is Haruko, a stylish and beautiful "shiny" university student. Haruko seems like she is from a completely different world than the dull Sagara, but she actually has a secret... She used to be a plain, makeup-free girl who successfully debuted as a "shiny" student when she started university!

After discovering her secret, Sagara, in an effort to preserve his peaceful loner life, decides to help the clumsy Haruko.

"If you really manage to become one of those shiny girls, you won't need to bother me anymore, right?"

"Sagara-kun, you're so difficult sometimes..."

If her true self is exposed, her rosy campus life is sure to crumble! What will happen to the awkward youth of this dull loner and a fake shiny girl!?

(Source: SB Creative, translated)

title: Uncover
synopsis: A Meika-san Can't Conceal Her Emotions artbook containing an extra chapter.

title: Kizuitara Musou Game no Akuyaku Shougun Datta Ken. Hametsu Route wa Bukkowasu
title_japanese: 気づいたら無双ゲームの悪役将軍だった件。〜破滅ルートはぶっ壊す〜

title: Spring Amidst My Wintertide
synopsis:
Serun Greenwood's kingdom has been ravaged by war and she has been captured, taken to become a sacrificial offering to the gods of the mountain. It is said that the wolves that guard the mountain will offer protection in return to those who give up a human sacrifice to them. And thus Serun's fate has been sealed. If only she had died with dignity along with her family instead of becoming lowly meat for the wolves. A painless death is all she can hope for but, alas, seeing those sharp, white teeth piercing through the darkness, it will be anything but. Then suddenly, he appears. A winter wolf who saves Serun's life, for the time being. But this oddly familiar beast, are his motives righteous or of ill intent? Will the harshness of their winter ever blossom into the warmth of a tender spring?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Ranju's Race to Romance
synopsis:
Ranju has had a massive crush on Jiha, the school's most popular girl, with her angelic beauty and kind nature. But when Ranju hears the shocking news that Jiha is going on a group date, she's thrown into a panic. Determined not to let her chance slip away, Ranju hatches a bold plan to win Jiha's heart before anyone else can. Will Ranju's daring moves lead to the romance of her dreams, or will she get stopped on her way to the finish line?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Aideen
synopsis:
Aideen, the esteemed daughter of Duke Glandya, is the Emperor's assassin and the leader of 'Owl.' For giving everything and serving her Lord faithfully, she was betrayed and sentenced to death by guillotine.

"I will take revenge on you. I will never forgive you even in death!"

Abandoned by her Lord, her life came to an end, yet the moment she opened her eyes again, she realized she had returned to a time when she was still only 17. In order to get her revenge, she decided to destroy her home country Perdi that the Emperor cherished more than his life.

"You are beautiful, Milady. Especially those red eyes of yours."

The man who personally sent the order to have Aideen executed, the Prince from the enemy country, Diceon, unexpectedly began to interfere with her life! The story of Aideen, the woman who was abandoned by the Emperor and was given a second chance at life to get her revenge and to destroy her home country, now unfolds!

(Source: MU)

title: Courtside Courtship
synopsis:
Genius. Champion. National treasure. Nam Woojoon has always admired Seo Siwon, but only from afar. That is, until the night he woke to find his idol on top of him, completely lost in pleasure. Now, as the heat between them rises, Woojoon's learning the rules of a new game, and he's playing to win.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Hotaru to Enge
synopsis:
Eating is living. Hiromu is worried about his grandfather, who hasn't been eating as much since his grandmother passed away. Hiromu struggles with how to convey his feelings to his grandfather... A quiet and warm story about the bonds of family.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: The Genre Is Way Too Different!
synopsis:
"I really can't hold back anymore." With those words, a pair of hot, alcohol-scented lips suddenly claimed mine—before I could even gather my thoughts, my dazed lips were swallowed up.

'Uh, this is a little...'

...No, this is completely wrong! Sasha finds herself possessed inside a romance-fantasy novel where the main plot revolves around the power struggles between nobles and royals. But the moment that story becomes her reality—the genre changes entirely. It was supposed to be a wholesome, all-ages story, one where the protagonists didn't even share their first kiss until around chapter 100...

"...Why does it feel like the genre here is way too different?"

(Source: Ridi, translated)

title: Ossan dakedo Seijo desu
title_japanese: おっさんだけど聖女です
synopsis:
One day, Wieland, a temple knight from the capital, arrived at a remote village in search of the long-lost Saintess. There, he meets Zef, an older man who undergoes the assessment at Wieland's request. To Zef's surprise, he's identified as the Saintess!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Nakasetagari no Hasugaya-kun
title_japanese: 泣かせたがりの蓮ヶ谷くん
synopsis:
Due to his past trauma, Yanai, a high school student, has difficulty expressing his emotions. One day, as he searches for ways to change himself, he finds out that his classmate, Hasugaya's family runs a chiropractic clinic that relieves emotional stiffness. After begging the reluctant Hasugaya to give him a treatment, Yanai is able to cry for the first time in years...and doing so makes Hasugaya ecstatic.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Chulso and Younghui's Story
synopsis:
One day, a mysterious classmate named Woo Young-hee suddenly appears out of nowhere. She doesn't seem quite human... Young-hee is actually a robot who came to school to learn about human emotions. Cheol-soo decides to help her understand them. But the more time they spend together, the more Cheol-soo begins to feel something for her—something he can't quite explain in words... A heartwarming tale of a world meant only for the two of them—where no one else can enter!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: JK Yuusha to Inkyo Maou
title_english: Hero Girl and Demon Lord Call It Quits
synopsis:
With the ages-old battle between good and evil settled...the demon lord becomes roommates with the hero?! A slice-of-life comedy with the oddest roommates ever!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Mofumofu to Mukumuku to Isekai Hyouryuu Seikatsu: Oishii Gohan, Kamisama, Kazokutsuki
title_english: Mofumofu & Mukumuku and Drifting Life in Another World
title_japanese: もふもふとむくむくと異世界漂流生活～おいしいごはん、かみさま、かぞく付き～

title: Office Contract Relationship
synopsis:
Seo-yoon adores all things pretty and handsome—in a word, "beauty." And what she loves even more than that are R-19 comics where a gorgeous man and woman lovingly explore their desire for one another! As fate would have it, a man who perfectly embodied her aesthetic ideals was right there beside her... working as her direct supervisor. She had certainly daydreamed about being in a relationship with him, but she never imagined it would actually happen. And especially not as a "contractual office romance"!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: The Duke's Fluffy Secret
synopsis:
Viviana Lorentz, the Duchess of House Fortuna, becomes utterly displeased with her far-too-rigid husband, Alto Fortuna, the duke who rarely entertains her at night. When she finally snaps and clashes with him, she ends up tumbling back in time, exactly a month before their destined marriage. Determined to escape the marriage this time, Viviana requests to call it off, only to be taken aback by Alto's firm refusal. As a final measure, Viviana decides to make a rather lustful "deal" with her current fiancé, not realizing she will end up facing his unexpected secret.

(Source: Manta)

title: Ripple Rooter
synopsis:
Chasing a supernatural kidnapper?

Vincent pretends to be a librarian in a small village, but really, he's a supernatural messenger who delivers gifts of fate to humans. Arugio, a new cop, has a mysterious agenda, bringing up forgotten crime files. What will happen when kidnapping cases spike and the evidence points to Vincent? A mystery thriller fantasy to keep you on your toes.

(Source: Manta)

title: Across the Milky Way!
synopsis:
Falling in love with him... or his twin?

Twin brothers Eunha and Eunsang are polar opposites—Eunha is shy and studies hard, while Eunsang is arrogant and a complete delinquent. When June, Eunha's crush, mistakes Eunha for Eunsang, Eunha decides to keep up the act. How long can he keep his secret?

(Source: Manta)

title: Fall For Me
synopsis:
Jihoon is confident that he can easily make guys, even straight ones, fall for him. It worked quite well up until he met Gyungwoo. Jihoon works as a nude model and is introduced to Gyungwoo for his personal photograph project. Gyungwoo appears nonchalant to Jihoon's looks, deeply hurting his pride. Now, Jihoon is determined to make Gyungwoo fall for him.

(Source: Manta)

title: Doberman
synopsis:
Eden City—a place where all the world's pleasures converge. Using her deceased twin's diary, Sarin searches the city for a certain man. During her search she encounters Owen, the king who rules over Eden City. Despite his oppressive demeanor and scrutinizing gaze, Sarin chooses to stay by his side. However, Sarin herself is hiding a secret...

(Source: Manta)

title: Dear My Beloved Wolf
synopsis:
Shyla accepts an arranged marriage to escape her father and travels to the North, only to find that her legendary Black Wolf husband is a prickly little pup who can't even take human form! With Calleon intent on chasing her away, Shyla must stand her ground to achieve her goal of becoming the duchess.

(Source: Manta)

title: Shita Kanda Toki to Daitai Issho
title_japanese: 舌噛んだときと大体いっしょ
synopsis:
Toori Oushiki is a passionate and energetic manga editor. One day, Tooru, a mangaka she has been pursuing for years, invites her to meet for the first time. Oushiki is excited, but just before the meeting, she learns that Tooru has posted on social media about quitting being a mangaka...!?

(Source: Shu-Cream, translated)

title: Mikeiken no Watashi ga Assistant desu ka!?
title_japanese: 未経験の私がアシですか!?

title: Sawatteminakucha Wakannai yo!
title_japanese: 触ってみなくちゃ分かんないよっ!

title: Saitei Chingin Maou: Rekidai Saikyou no Maougun, Sono Ashi wo Hipparu no ga Oshigoto desu
title_japanese: 最低賃金魔王 ～歴代最強の魔王軍、その足を引っ張るのがお仕事です～
synopsis:
Arquas is a man who lives only for his hobbies and training. He has been content with his modest life as a bronze-rank adventurer, the lowest-class. One day, however, the goddess of creation, Willas, suddenly appears in his home and offers him a job—to become the Demon King and stand in the way of the strongest demon king's army in history. The only compensation offered is minimum wage, but even so, Arquas accepts the job.

(Source: Nihon Bungeisha, translated)

title: Catherine's Key to a Happy Life
title_english: Catherine's Key to a Happy Life
synopsis:
Catherine Panya thought she could live a happy life after leaving her terrible family. She was lucky enough to find a huge manor for dirt cheap, but only because the land attracts demons! And the only one powerful enough to vanquish those demons is Grand Duke Chezare Christopher, the Great Sorcerer. Although the reason is unclear, he offers Catherine a key that can summon him whenever she needs him. Is this Catherine's literal key to happiness? Or will it unlock a door to even more trouble?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Bound
synopsis:
I want something I can never have.

As a young boy, Shinyeon falls in love with the crown prince at first sight. But he knows better than to harbor such feelings—his sister is vying for the title of crown princess. Determined to suppress his emotions, he leaves to fight in the war. But love is ever persistent... and cruel.

(Source: Manta)

title: Searching for Mr. Hairless
synopsis:
No matter how great her date may be, Rajung's love could never coexist with their body hair. The passion and excitement of a new relationship died instantly the moment she saw "hair:" hairy chest, hairy legs, the five o'clock shadow, etc. It's kind of like losing your appetite when you find hair in your food; it doesn't matter how good the dish is or if it's to your taste. At this rate, there's a good chance Rajung will die without ever seeing a man's penis, let alone have sex. Then her best guy friend, without batting an eyes, said to her: "Guess I should pluck all my pubic hair and show you mine."

(Source: Manta)

title: A Talented Maid
synopsis:
Princess Maurina lives in hiding, serving those who overthrew her country as the humble maid "Marie." Suddenly plagued by divine powers that awaken through portentous dreams, Marie's efforts to help those around her quickly place her at the center of a dangerous game of cat and mouse with the infamous Bloody Prince, the very man who destroyed her world. Will her abilities help her win friends and freedom, or will her secret be revealed, forcing her to marry a tyrant?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Tsuugakusei Nikki
synopsis:
Anyone has a bittersweet anecdote or two about commuting to school from back when they were still students. Even when it's cold, or when you're not allowed to take the long route and buy snacks to eat, or when you're not supposed to wear a sports jersey; just getting to exchange glances once with that person you liked made it all okay! Unfolding on the stage of a certain high school is an omnibus about going to and from school, an offering meant for everyone who's ever been a student before.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Gachankii
synopsis:
Jikkai High, with a low academic score of just nine, is a bottom-tier school where delinquents from all over the country gather, with new transfer students arriving almost every week. Our protagonist, Jou Sago, is terrible at fighting and spends his days being looked down on by everyone... but everything changes when the strongest of them all, Gokuu Hitomi, transfers in.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Tensei Reijou wa Seirei ni Aisarete Saikyou desu......dakedo Futsuu ni Koi Shitai! @comic
title_english: The Reincarnated Count's Daughter Is the Strongest as She Is Loved by Spirits, Though She Is Only Wishing for Regular Romance!
title_japanese: 転生令嬢は精霊に愛されて最強です……だけど普通に恋したい!@COMIC
synopsis:
Deirdre Abel von Belisario just wants to find love! After dying young in her first life—and worse, dying without a single hint of romance—this former office worker and self-proclaimed otaku has found herself reincarnated as the daughter of a margrave in another world. Determined to make the most of her second chance, she's set on finding love and giving her parents the grandchildren they deserve. Unfortunately for Deirdre, fate has other plans in store. She never meant to catch the eye of her land's Royal Spirits, let alone gain their blessing. And she definitely didn't mean to get pulled into the conflict between spirits and humans. She was just bored! Left with no choice but restore harmony to the empire, her dreams of a peaceful married life seem farther out of reach than ever. This is the story of a "graceful" young lady reluctantly revolutionizing an empire along the rocky road to love!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Tensei Reijou wa Seirei ni Aisarete Saikyou desu......dakedo Futsuu ni Koi Shitai!
title_english: Royal Spirits Are a Royal Pain! Give Me a Regular Romance
title_japanese: 転生令嬢は精霊に愛されて最強です……だけど普通に恋したい!
synopsis:
Deirdre Abel von Belisario just wants to find love! After dying young in her first life—and worse, dying without a single hint of romance—this former office worker and self-proclaimed otaku has found herself reincarnated as the daughter of a margrave in another world. Determined to make the most of her second chance, she's set on finding love and giving her parents the grandchildren they deserve. Unfortunately for Deirdre, fate has other plans in store. She never meant to catch the eye of her land's Royal Spirits, let alone gain their blessing. And she definitely didn't mean to get pulled into the conflict between spirits and humans. She was just bored! Left with no choice but restore harmony to the empire, her dreams of a peaceful married life seem farther out of reach than ever. This is the story of a "graceful" young lady reluctantly revolutionizing an empire along the rocky road to love!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Uchi no Inu ga Tsuyosugiru n desu ga!? Tensei shitara Megami-sama no Shukufuku de Sekai wo Sukuu Koto ni Narimashita
title_english: My Death-Defying Dog: Man's Best Friend, World's Best Savior
title_japanese: うちの犬が強すぎるんですが!? 転生したら女神様の祝福で世界を救うことになりました
synopsis:
The years have felt hollow ever since Hayate lost his beloved dog, Rikimaru. But after losing his ordinary life in a freak accident, Hayate is reincarnated in a fantasy realm whose resident Goddess tasks him with saving her world from impending doom—and gives him the chance to reunite with Rikimaru. The twist is, Hayate's not the one playing hero. His pup is! Granted the might of a legendary savior, Rikimaru wastes no time in vanquishing evil and enjoying his zoomies. Meanwhile, the good-natured and congenial Hayate is forced to navigate strange, new lands and thorny political intrigue. Still, if there's one thing Hayate knows, it's that he wants to do right by the innocents of this world...and pamper his lovable little pumpkin every step of the way!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: The House Without Time
synopsis:
A girl who's been abused meets a foul-tempered man who's lived in a world with nothing. A pristine white world where all laws and concepts have been reimagined.

Adel is the legendary hero who once saved the world. Ribe is a slave girl abandoned by her parents who's lived a hellish life. The two do nothing but bicker. Then a mysterious figure, Darudaru, appears before them. Into Adel's monochrome existence, Ribe's clumsy yet vibrant color begins to seep.

Was this meeting of the three truly chance? Or was it someone's design?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: The Taming
synopsis:
As the son of the fallen House Anatold, Michel's only duty is to help his family's social standing by marrying the prominent Duke Shelleg of the north. However, upon his arrival, he is met with the servant Ain, who is acting as the duke's stand-in to teach Michel what it means to be a northern husband. To his surprise, his most important duties take place in the bedroom! Michel is determined to be a proper partner, but what will he do when his newfound feelings for Ain start to get in the way?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Boita Boine
synopsis:
Haine is a boyish tomboy highschool girl who wants her very own yuri harem. She gets confident after helping a girl on the first day of school, but standing in the way of her goal is Shizuka, another boyish highschool girl who's seen as a prince and steals girls' hearts without even trying! Haine's new goal is to defeat Shizuka and build her yuri harem!

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Hi-Mecha ni, Boku wa.
title_english: The Boy Meets a Girl-Type Robot, and Dreams of a New World and Future.

title: Sugar Rain
synopsis:
After two months of barely getting by as a bathroom cleaner at a hotel, Johann is suddenly told to leave when his predecessor returns. All he has left is his younger brother, Philip, waiting for leftover buffet scraps. 

One day, a man approaches Johann, struck by how much he resembles an acquaintance, and offers him a job on the spot. It could be a scam, or something far more dangerous—but the pay is $5,000 a month.

The work is menial, in a crumbling shack far removed from the absurdly grand mansion nearby. Still, Johann is just happy to have the job—until he crosses paths with Helbert.

(Source: Ridi, translated)

title: The Man Next Door
synopsis:
"You're 189 cm, 25 years old, right?"

Min Park can't forget the man he spent a night with—someone who never even asked his name, yet effortlessly led him with the scent of strong cigarettes and a slender frame. Now, fate brings them together again at a bar near his home. The man still refuses to reveal his name. As Min offers to take the drunken man home and asks for his address, something about it feels eerily familiar...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

title: Sweet and Cold
synopsis:
There's nothing quite as beautiful—and dangerous—as you.

Juggling wild nights and chasing after Juan, who only seems to attract the wrong kind of people, Eugene has no time left for assignments. Juan's all too familiar with leaning in close, flashing that smile, even though they're not even dating. But now, that smile just feels suffocating. Eugene has had enough. His new goal? Wiping that infuriating grin off Juan's face—once and for all.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

title: Mastering the Secretary
synopsis:
Secretary Han has been working for the same family for years, so he watched the young master of the house grow up and has always doted on him. But now his beloved young master has taken a special interest in him. Unable to say no to his beautiful young master, they start a steamy sexual relationship. However, Secretary Han is in for an unexpected surprise because his master is going to show him what it's really like to be under him.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Dawn of the Legend
title_japanese: ドーン・オブ・ザ・レジェンド
synopsis:
Japan has collapsed in the wake of a zombie outbreak. Yet Dumitru the vampire continues his journey, alongside Ren; a young survivor whom he keeps around to serve as nourishment. What does he make of this world as they wander its ruins...?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Iwahada no Hanayome wa Ai de Tokasareru
title_japanese: 岩肌の花嫁は愛で溶かされる

title: My Sweet Psycho Baby
synopsis:
Heedo, fragile yet dangerously obsessive, locks debt collector Woorak in his basement after a violent outburst. Demanding affection, Heedo blurs love and desperation. As captive Woorak's defenses crumble, obsession and tenderness twist their bond until the line between captor and captive vanishes.

(Source: Manta)

title: Jobabu
synopsis:
Despite receiving recruitment offers from prestigious high schools, Akane Hinageshi, left traumatized after conflicts with past teammates, has given up on playing basketball. But what happens when she suddenly receives an offer she quite literally can't refuse...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Melt Bless You
synopsis:
Melt, the sheltered daughter of a notorious mob boss, has spent her life like a fragile flower trapped in a gilded cage. On her 20th birthday, instead of receiving a gift, she is kidnapped by a mysterious man named Budd. Together, they are thrust into a citywide chase, with hitmen, hounds, and every thug in town hot on their trail. But why is Melt the most wanted woman in New Jersey? As secrets unravel and bodies pile up, this gritty noir tale spirals into a storm of love, murder, and betrayal. Melt Bless You!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Taida na Akujoku Kizoku ni Tensei shita Ore, Scenario wo Bukkowashitara Kikakugai no Maryoku de Saikyou ni Natta
title_english: Reborn as an Aristocratic Scoundrel, I Broke the Game and Mastered Magic Beyond Limits!
title_japanese: 怠惰な悪辱貴族に転生した俺、シナリオをぶっ壊したら規格外の魔力で最凶になった
synopsis:
I don't know how it happened, but somehow I've died and reincarnated into my favorite academy game. And if that wasn't weird enough, I'm now the depraved and lazy villain, Weiss Fansent, whose misdeeds lead him to a deadly end. Something I'm determined to avoid at all costs. With little time left until the academy's entrance exams, I have no choice but to dive headfirst into serious and grueling training. Which means swordsmanship with the S-rank adventurer Miruku Abitas, followed by intense magic practice. It was demanding and exhausting, but getting stronger means I have a better chance of avoiding my disastrous end. But I seriously underestimated just how powerful Weiss truly is, and I wind up stunning everyone at the exams! Have I somehow become more powerful than the hero? A fantasy series about changing the villain's fate with hard work and amazing powers!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Doom: Satsujin Keisatsukan no Danzairoku
title_japanese: ドゥーム 殺人警察官の断罪録
synopsis:
Dan Hiroki, the Chief of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department's 1st Investigation Division. An elite among elites with a brilliant career, his hidden face is that of a serial killer who enacts vigilante justice upon sinful villains.

(Source: Coamix, translated)

title: The Taming of the Shrew
synopsis: A playboy named Petruchio accepts a request to seduce the unfriendly Katherina...?

title: Kyoukai no Melody
synopsis:
After losing his musical partner Kai in an accident just before their major debut, Kyousuke has distanced himself from music and lives without motivation. Three years later, Kai suddenly appears before Kyousuke, unchanged and as outspoken as ever.

"Being alive but doing nothing... that's no different from being dead."

Encouraged by Kai's words, Kyousuke returns to the world of music, rediscovering the joy of creating sound together. But their time together cannot last forever...

(Source: MAL News)

title: Mouretsu! Urayasu Tekkin Kazoku
title_japanese: モーレツ! 浦安鉄筋家族

title: Project Leader
title_japanese: プロジェクトリーダー
synopsis:
A single ship drifting through the vast expanse of space. A woman and a cat are heading toward Earth, but they cannot seem to reach it, and their hunger only grows. Then, someone arrives at her spacecraft...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Watashi to Adachi Mitsuru to.
synopsis: In celebration of Mitsuru Adachi's 55th anniversary of becoming a mangaka, Gosho Aoyama and Rumiko Takahashi contribute a manga essay about their friend and colleague.

title: Yotaka Futatabi
synopsis:
That woman is "Yotaka." Once famous in the underworld as the strongest assassin, she is now a 33-year-old (and very unlucky) drug addict and alcoholic. She's enjoying her unemployed life in a rundown apartment. ♪ With her mind and body completely slack, Yotaka receives an invitation from her assassin friend, "Kohai," to return to active duty...!!

Will she return to the battlefield once again?! Yotaka!!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Nyoro Nyooro
synopsis:
Nyororin, a girl with a snake-like body, lives with her otherworldly father, snake mother, and snake-like younger brother. Her daily life with her slightly strange friends is eccentric and unpredictable!? A slightly dark and slightly gentle manga!

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

title: Hangman
synopsis:
Had he stolen even the share that was meant for his brother, the one who grew up with him under the same roof? From birth, Han Jichan was exceptional—it was only natural for him to stand above everyone else. But an unchanging life inevitably breeds boredom.

As usual, Jichan was cleaning up the mess caused by his inept older brother and preparing to head home... when his eyes caught sight of a stranger—Suhyuk.

And that stranger was having sex with his brother.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: 10 Years
synopsis:
Death comes to Gwon Young by scent. Every ten years, the person Young loves most dies. Hoping to escape the curse, he moves away. But then he meets An Jiho, a man who seems to be quietly waiting for the end of his own life. Their connection forms fast and deep, filling the emptiness they both carry. But with another ten-year mark approaching, Young can't shake the scent of death on the air.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Biscuit
synopsis:
For years, Hoyeon has been targeted by creeps who mistake his gentle features for weakness. Somewhere along the way, he developed an unusual coping mechanism, turning the tables and forcing his pursuers into submission. The thrill of dominance becomes a habit, a preference, a dangerous kind of satisfaction.

Then one day, Taebum, a younger man with bold eyes and an even bolder heart, barges into his life with a straightforward confession. He is nothing like the others. No sleazy tricks, no clinging, just disarmingly pure affection delivered with calm confidence.

Hoyeon, determined to scare him off, tries to push him away the only way he knows how, by attempting to take control forcefully.

But Taebum, already prepared, meets him without fear and gives himself over completely.

Fine. If he wants to play that game, then Hoyeon will take him to the very end.

Let him see if he can handle it.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Duality of Desire
synopsis:
Identical twins Joo Baek-hee and Joo Baek-naa share everything, including their obsession with one person: Jung Hae-yoon, a seemingly ordinary friend caught between them.

To one, Hae-yoon is a precious toy; to the other, an irreplaceable treasure.

As the twins' twisted desires begin to blur the line between love and possession, can Hae-yoon escape from their beautiful but dangerous grasp?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Man Locked up in My Room
title_japanese: 반지하의 남자는 내 방에 감금되어 있다
synopsis:
Gaeseok leads an ordinary office life—or at least, one that appears so on the surface. Behind that façade lies his obsessive effort to maintain "normalcy." But all of it begins to unravel each night, when the thudding noises from the basement below his apartment disturb his sleep.

Deprived of rest and pushed into a state of raw nerves, Gaeseok finally makes a mistake at work. To him, "acting normal" is his only goal in life, and the pounding from below feels like a ticking time bomb threatening to shatter it all.

Driven to the edge, he confronts the source of the noise by going down to the semi-basement. There, after his heated complaint, a strange man emerges, oddly familiar in the way he addresses Gaeseok. Ignoring the accusations, the man calmly follows Gaeseok upstairs... and proceeds to bind his own ankle to Gaeseok's window frame.

Now locked inside Gaeseok's room, the man refuses to leave. What is his purpose? And what was the true cause of the relentless thudding from the bas

title: The Kiss of Trauma
synopsis:
Raised under the harsh rule of an abusive father, Juho has spent his life being compared to his perfect stepbrother, Hyeonwu. As his father's cruelty deepens and Hyeonwu's obsessive behavior grows more disturbing, Juho's spirit begins to break. Then one day, he meets Suhyeok, a kind and gentle man who offers the warmth and comfort Juho has never known. For the first time, Juho finds himself relying on someone outside his family, falling into a fragile love that feels almost like salvation. But as he clings to Suhyeok, Hyeonwu's fixation only festers. Years later, even as adults, Juho finds that the grip of his family's twisted love and his own buried wounds are far from healed, and one lingering kiss may awaken everything he's tried to forget.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Alisa and the Magical Diary
synopsis:
Alisa Benin has loved stories since her days at the Academy, so when she finds herself magically transported into the entries of her new diary, she gives the prince a story to soothe his tears. In these entries, Emperor Louis Ferdinando II is but a child, looking for friends. But in the present, Louis is perplexed by Alisa. Just who is this woman who has entered his dreams and, in doing so, altered his past? As Alisa comes to his aid, Louis will have to decide: Is this fairy friend or foe?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: She Wasn't My Daughter
synopsis:
When Diana le Pereshte is convinced that sacrificing her vision will restore her daughter's lost eyesight, her blindness reveals the hidden truth of her home—her "daughter" is her husband's and best friend's lovechild. Cast aside and left to question the fate of her real daughter, she succumbs to her death only to find she's woken up in the past, her vision now restored. With a second chance, can Diana find her real daughter and exact revenge, or will she find herself lost in the dark once more?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Ghostly Grind at Cuvershaiden Manor
title_english: The Ghostly Grind at Cuvershaiden Manor
synopsis:
Laura Highen needs a way to support her siblings and hears that House Cuvershaiden is hiring... except that the manor is haunted! Tempted by Duke Cuvershaiden's lucrative offer, Laura takes the job anyway. Who knows, with her ability to see ghosts, perhaps she can be of service!

(Source: Manta)

title: Live as a Villainess
synopsis:
One day, Kim Da-jeong, an ordinary office worker who suddenly possesses the world of a novel. In fact, it is Christine Rosalind, the villain character who dies at the beginning of the novel. Original death is avoided, but that is only temporary, you will die anyway, and when you die, you return to the starting point. How can I live without dying? The sky throws a clear answer to Da-jeong, who is in trouble: let her be a villain. But how do you do that when you have different personality??

"A world collapsing, twisting characters. If you want to live, you have to remember who you are."

Unexpected characters appear in front of Da-jeong, who is in such trouble. Raymon Myers, who is the man of the original story and is a perfect match for Christine, Diane Schneider, who was not found in the original, but has a reputation as a vicious witch in the world, and Cordelian Parker, who was possessed by the original author, the female lead of the original and the creator of this world. The three

title: Goshujinsama shika Katan! Light BL Anthology: Bokutachi Kedamono Goshujin no Koi Mimamoritai
title_japanese: ごしゅじん様しか勝たん！ライトBLアンソロジー ～ぼくたちケダモノご主人の恋見守り隊～
authors: Yamamoto, Mato|Sakumoto, Ayu|Tanno, Chikuwabu|Yamaguchi, Suguri|Kusege|Nihonmatsu, Shino|Hamasaki|Hanabusa, Suji
synopsis:
Rooting for my dear owner's love!!!!!

Pomeranians, raccoons, cats, beavers, dragons, ponies, hamsters, ring-tailed lemurs... So many cute animals! A 200% therapeutic, new take on the youth BL anthology scene!

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Utakata 80(s)
synopsis:
Hiroshi Utakata, a man who is trapped and bound in the 80s! Dressed in a new suit, driving his imported car, and relaxing with his favorite cigarette... What are his true intentions as he lives his unique lifestyle? A dramatic renaissance, gifted to modern people who have lost something important.

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Thundercloud Rainstorm
synopsis:
At his uncle's funeral, Jeonghan is reunited with Iljo, a man he hasn't seen in years. It turns out Iljo's struggling to stay afloat. Stirred by pity and charitable impulse, Jeonghan invites Iljo to move in with him. The problem is that Iljo catches feelings like a match to fuel. To top it off, Jeonghan isn't keen on dating him, but somehow, he's a pro at accidentally making things a lot messier for everyone involved. Is this a love story in the making, or a disaster waiting to happen?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Imouto Mae kara Ane Ushiro kara
title_english: Fuck'n with sisters, little one from the front, older one from behind.
title_japanese: 妹まえから 姉うしろから
synopsis:
1. Houteki ni Mondai Nai Ane to no Kankei
2. Imouto Lesson
3. Neechan no Sakauramix (Neechan's Unjustified Ragings)
4. Imouto no Iiwake (Sister's Excuse)
5. Ane ga Shibashiba Tsuyappoi Kao wo Suru node, Totemo Dogimagi suru (My Big Sister often has an Amorous Look on Her Face, and that makes Me Very Nervous)
6. Kyoudai no Himitsu no Su (The Siblings' Secret Nest)
7. Kaisoku: Ane no Koukishin (High Speed: Sister's Curiosity)
8. Imouto no Monohoshige na Shisen
9. Imouto no Shinro ni Tsurekomare
10-11. Ane no Berochuu (My Sister's Deep Kiss)

title: Ohayou, Jashin-san
synopsis:
A girl gazes out at the ocean one day, when a Great Old One appears?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Zubo App
synopsis:
The fetish matching app, ShlApp, is live and makes it all too easy to find people in your local area who share your most hardcore kinks! Full of users who primarily let their crotches do the thinking, it's perfect for the busy person of the modern era! But don't take our word for it—allow us to show you a hands-on report from one of our satisfied customers as he meets Rui, a thick and plump student council president who loves to get dominated, deep-throated, and enjoys a thick creampie on her safe days. After one non-stop night of degradation, she's found her new master!

(Source: FAKKU)

title: Kyoushi to Mama to Koibito no Kao
title_japanese: 教師と義母と恋人の貌

title: Kawaii Doumei
synopsis:
Suika is admired by both boys and girls at her high school for her cool and attractive looks. However, Suika herself secretly admires someone who's the complete opposite of her: Kana, a cute, mellow, and unassuming classmate. But Suika feels that cuteness doesn't fit her image and acting feminine somehow... scares her. But after Suika discovers Kana is also keeping her love for cute things hidden, they decided to form their own "Cute Alliance" where they can secretly enjoy their cute hobby together.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Game Sekai de Mamono ni Tensei shiteshimatta Ore, Zense de Oshi datta Heroine wo Hirotteshimau
title_japanese: ゲーム世界で魔物に転生してしまった俺、前世で推しだったヒロインを拾ってしまう
synopsis:
When I woke up, I had reincarnated into the world of a game I played in my past life. And what's more, as a monster that's hostile to humanity! It couldn't be helped, so I just lived quietly so humans wouldn't find me, but...

The heroine, Noa, who was my oshi in my past life, had collapsed near my home!!

After I protected and nursed her, my oshi gave me the name "Rei", so I decided to follow and protect Noa as my oshi for life. I meet other characters from the game too, and I'm watching over Noa's growth, but... the real Noa seems to be the type who's a bit clingy and has a... "heavy" love?

This is the story of me, reincarnated as a monster, somehow overcoming hardships together with my beloved oshi.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Boku no Ie ga Class no Furyou Musume ni Iribitarareteiru Kudan.
title_english: How My Room Became a Delinquent Hangout Spot.
title_japanese: ボクの家がクラスの不良娘に入り浸られている件。
synopsis:
Yoh Ueno gets more than he bargained for when Kisaragi, the class delinquent, starts hanging out at his apartment because of a shared love for video games. Things start heating up when the two begin "punishing" each other for losing, and the "punishments" quickly take a sexual turn...

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Yuuki-san wa Boku no Mono
title_japanese: 優木さんはボクのモノ
synopsis:
Yui has a bad habit of letting others walk all over her. She especially can't refuse Uchida's raunchy requests...

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Kouhan no Enen
synopsis:
Shanghai, 1920. Amidst the turbulent times, Shion, a student engrossed in reading the newspaper, hears the voice of a woman calling out to her. Her name is Shuryou, the wife of a military commander. She asks the well-educated Shion to write a letter on her behalf. Through exchanged words, the two are drawn to each other despite occasional clashes. Yet, a reality that promises no future together and the inevitable changes of the times painfully tear their feelings apart.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Netorare Tsuihou sareta Saikyou Kishi Danchou no Ossan, Katainaka de Eiyuu ni Matsuriagerareru
title_japanese: 寝取られ追放された最強騎士団長のおっさん、片田舎で英雄に祭り上げられる
synopsis:
For years, the commander of the knights, Warrena, has contributed to keeping the kingdom's peace. Though he survived a year-long campaign, his fiancée, the third princess, cheated on him and has gotten pregnant. In order to cover up the family scandal, the royal family declares that Warrena died during the campaign.

He gives up on his kingdom out of despair and decides to use his compensation money to live a slow and leisurely life in the countryside. One after another, he encounters a saint and a fox girl, and they eventually end up falling for him. However, he himself has a reason why he can't fall in love with them...?

A fantasy story about the rise of the strongest old man exiled from the kingdom!!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Hotokesama kara Ecchi Item wo Morau
title_japanese: 仏様からエチアイテムを貰う

title: Not What the Doctor Ordered
title_japanese: 공진단 먹고 나의 알파 시대 시작됐다
synopsis:
Yeongha is a talented practitioner of traditional Korean medicine, but ever since word got out that he's an omega, business has been at an all-time low. Meanwhile, his teenage neighbor, Pureum, is also struggling to stay afloat in the midst of college entrance exams... and a devastating crush on his hot, older neighbor. But after one of Yeongha's energy-boosting tonics turns Pureum from a beta into an alpha, the doctor will have to take responsibility for this medical miracle... in ways he never imagined.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Vengeance Named Love
synopsis:
Leon Winston, Captain of the Western Command's Domestic Intelligence Division in the Kingdom of Riphon, is both feared and revered. Known as the Vampire of Camden for his ruthless treatment of rebels, he strikes terror into both allies and enemies alike. But beneath his noble and elegant exterior lies a man consumed by a dark desire, one that burns as fiercely as his rage against the rebels. Sally Bristol, the unassuming maid in charge of the interrogation room, is the one who awakens this uncontrollable craving, fueled by the scent of her blood. And after a rebel spy mentions her name, Leon realizes he no longer has to suppress his violent desire for her. Will Sally be able to beg her way out of Leon's deathly grasp, or will she succumb to the bloodlust he can't resist?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Violet Romance
synopsis:
Baekdan, drowning in debt and running a tiny udon shop in the red-light district, meets Mooshin—a wealthy yet dangerous man who shatters her bleak routine. He might be her salvation... or her downfall.

(Source: Manta)

title: Hitokuchi Choudai
synopsis:
Yui Sasame, a descendant of vampires, feels out of place in her high school class. Unable to fit in with her human classmates, she's often late to school—something for which the class representative, Sekiya, relentlessly criticizes her. One day, angered by Sekiya's nagging, a dark impulse flickers through Yui's mind...

"Maybe I should just... suck him dry."

But that thought marks the beginning of something far more dangerous—an ecstasy said to surpass sexual pleasure a hundredfold. Thus begins the tragic tale of those consumed and undone by their own desires.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Jimoto Bakuhatsu
synopsis:
Hired as a pretend interpreter for a masked band who secretly just makes up all the answers for them during interviews...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Kimi no Egao wo
synopsis: Aoi is concerned that his childhood friend Hinano has stopped smiling.

title: Koori no Koushaku Reijou wa, Marou Kishi ni Amayaka ni Tokasareru
title_english: The Young Lady of Ice Is Sweetly Melted by the Demon Wolf Knight.
title_japanese: 氷の侯爵令嬢は、魔狼騎士に甘やかに溶かされる

title: Tsuihou Souryo no Kenja Time
title_english: The Exiled Sage's Moment of Clarity
title_japanese: 追放僧侶の賢者タイム
synopsis:
After the Demon King's defeat, the Great Sage declares that she will create and bestow upon the hero party whatever they desire as a reward for saving the Holy City. One member asks for a sword, another for a bow... But the priest Masura requests... a sex doll...!? A boy far too honest about his desires and a beautiful sex doll that comes to life... A chaotic comedy where sexual energy and magic explode!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: How to Ride the Hero's Coattails
title_english: How to Ride the Hero's Coattails
synopsis:
Ever read one of those webtoons where an obnoxious male protagonist transmigrates into his favorite game, uses his knowledge of the plot to become ridiculously overpowered, and somehow gathers a harem along the way? Now, imagine reincarnating into that story! That's what happens to Nahyeon, but unlike the freewheeling teenager of a hero, she has no interest in becoming the main character. After all, it's way easier to stick right at his side and benefit from his grand plan! Or so she thought...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Diamond Dust
synopsis:
Having lived as a beta his whole life, Seo Yeehyeon never imagined his path would cross with a golden Alpha like Liu Weikun—someone so far above his world, it felt like fate would never even bother. But one day, Weikun catches an impossible scent adrift in the air: the sweet, addictive pheromone of an Omega... coming from Hyun. Stranger still, it’s a scent only he can perceive. As desire and instinct blur into obsession, Yeehyeon finds himself caught between disbelief and temptation, his world crystalizing into one he never thought possible...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Quo Vadis, Domine?
synopsis:
To pay off his parents' debt, Hyeondo is sold into an arrangement as the fake fiancé of a powerful conglomerate heir. His supposed partner, Yisak, is an infamous alpha known for his volatility, a man others call mad. Yet when Yisak realizes his uncontrollable pheromones only calm in Hyeondo's presence, their dangerous charade begins to blur into something else. As secrets pile up and emotions tangle, Hyeondo must keep his true identity hidden long enough to survive the wedding or risk being devoured by the man he's bound to marry.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Savior's First Lady
synopsis:
To escape a ruined marriage, she decided to change her life, yet something feels strangely off.

"Bryn, I want you. My redeemer."

In her dreams, her husband had always cared for her tenderly, but in this life, he's far too good to be true. Edan Sheridan, the empire's shining hero and beloved savior. His only flaw was his wife, Bryn Sheridan, the nation's most hated woman. One day, Bryn saw the future where her life collapses. But... nothing changed. Knowing the future doesn't magically fix your present. But then the world handed her a second gift.

"So I really was extraordinary... I had this secret inside me all along."

The belief that she can do it. At last, she makes up her mind. Family matters, business, revenge, and maybe even divorce. She won't let a single thing slip through her fingers. This time, in this life, she will rise to the very top.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Ikusagami
synopsis:
Set in the late 19th century during the Meiji period, "Last Samurai Standing" takes place at the Tenryuji Temple in Kyoto. Come nightfall, 292 skilled warriors gather, lured by the promise of a grand prize of 100 billion yen. Among them is our protagonist, Shujiro Saga, who enters this dangerous game with one goal: to save his ailing wife and child.

(Source: Netflix)

title: Dostoevsky no Inu
title_japanese: ドストエフスキーの犬
synopsis:
1. 30-nen
2. Samen
3. Akai Umi
4. Kusomushi Ninpouchou
5. Arifureta Senritsu
6. Hane ga Haeta Manga Shounen
7. Zanki
8. Dostoevsky no Inu

title: Owari no Omomaru
synopsis:
Omomaru, a middle school boy who hates the entire world and thinks all humans should simply die, one day meets a female ghost named Reiko. This encounter has a major impact on his life....? It's the start of a great adventure sweeping through the afterlife in search of the "best ending"!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Rikka Kitan
synopsis:
Touma, a young wolf beastman who loves a peaceful life, is a regular policeman who protects the peace of the town of Edo. One night, he meets a mysterious girl who is being attacked by thugs. The girl's name is Rikka. She is a princess from the faraway country of Izumo, and is being pursued because she has a big secret. Touma happens to help her and ends up hiding her. Tired of her life on the run, Touma decides to offer peace to Rikka, but living with a girl for the first time is far from peaceful and marks the beginning of a very turbulent life!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Class Teni ni Makikomareta Conveni Tenin no Ossan, Yuusha ni wa Hitsuyou Nakatta Amarimono Skill wo Kushi shite Saikyou to Naru you desu.
title_japanese: クラス転移に巻き込まれたコンビニ店員のおっさん、勇者には必要なかった余り物スキルを駆使して最強となるようです。
synopsis:
Yuichi is an unremarkable convenience store clerk. On the day he finishes a grueling overtime shift that lasted nearly 24 hours, he gets swept up in a magical summoning meant to bring a group of high school delinquents to another world. While the officially summoned students each receive powerful skills from a goddess, Yuichi—who was never supposed to be there—ends up with a massive pile of leftover "trash skills" that were slated for disposal.

To make matters worse, the king who performed the summoning declares him useless and banishes him from the royal palace. However, drawing on the resilience forged through years of harsh work and the practical mindset he's cultivated over thirty-five years, Yuichi is determined to survive in this new world by "making the most of what he's got"!!

(Source: Bukansha, translated)

title: Yuusha no Oresama ga Madoushi nanka ni!
title_japanese: 勇者の俺様が魔導士なんかに!
synopsis:
Kaine is an egotistical and iron-willed knight who has a hard time getting along with Leo, a talented sorcerer. Leo's aloof nature annoys Kaine to the point he throws Leo out of the adventuring party only for the party to continuously lose its battles. Disgraced, Kaine asks for Leo to return but Leo has one condition: Kaine must get on his knees and apologize. Kaine, distressed and humiliated breaks down and seeing Kaine at his weakest awakens something inside Leo...

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Ginga Tokkyuu Milky☆Subway
title_japanese: 銀河特急 ミルキー☆サブウェイ
synopsis:
Arrested for reckless space driving, super human Chiharu and cyborg Makina are sentenced to clean the Milky☆Subway—an old interplanetary train.

Easy enough, right? Wrong. When the train suddenly takes off, they are thrown into a high-speed space-train spectacle packed with chaos, no plans, and zero strategy.

Just pure momentum!

(Source: Anime official website, translated)

title: The Killer Attorney
synopsis:
Byeon Hogil is a third-class killer in the criminal organization Glory Club, with no way up and only one way out. He pivots into law, but his knack for killing doesn't disappear. Juggling courtrooms and bullets, Hogil starts redefining justice his own way. The law has limits, but Hogil doesn't. When a lawyer has killer skills, justice is served... with a bang!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Knight of the Sightless Sky
title_english: The Knight of the Sightless Sky
synopsis:
A consuming fire, a dead king, and a family in ruin. Ten years after witnessing her mother's murder, a vengeful maiden returns to the palace as a deadly assassin. But her revenge plot shatters when she discovers an unlikely truth that makes her blade waver. Caught between the eyes of silver and violet, the barbed rose must decide... follow the treacherous path of vengeance or uncover the secrets that bind her fate to the kingdom's fragile crown.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Utakata no Mujina
synopsis:
During his second year of junior high, Kentarou Himoto was sent to live with his grandmother after his parents found out that he "liked men." He ended up in a remote village called Mushinashichi. In this village, there is a strange custom: every year, at the summer festival, 15-year-old children are gathered to divine whether they will stay in the village or not, and Himoto is asked to participate...?

A secretive village, a strange custom, and a destiny that cannot be defied... What will the fate of the boys at the mercy of this custom?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Do You Believe in Memories?
synopsis:
That day, swimming in the sea, he saw her. A beautiful mermaid, dancing in the water under the pale moonlight. She was beautiful. She was fantastical. And she was terrifying. That sight was burned into his young heart, an image that would never fade. Years later, people tell him it was just an illusion, a trick of his childhood mind. He refuses to accept it. Because if "growing up" means forgetting... he'd rather never become an adult at all.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: The Tears of a Jester
synopsis:
Two princesses, one throne.

Life is hard for a court jester. Not only do I serve as an emotional punching bag for the royals and aristocrats, forced to indulge their every whim, but now I'm also caught between two princesses. Is this a comedy? Or will this tale end in tragedy?

(Source: Manta)

title: Kyousei Kankei
synopsis:
The manga centers on a teacher who is constantly broke from drinking and gambling. For a certain reason, she finds herself in a high school boy's house.

(Source: ANN)

title: Thunder God's Reincarnation
synopsis:
He was the hero who brought down the Heretic Cult that drove the Murim world to ruin. But he was killed due to the betrayal of the seven emperors because he was too strong and they didn't want him to be a hero.

He was reborn as Baek Gong, a crippled person who was in despair. It's only been 30 years since my last life.

"So my enemies are still alive?"

This is his revenge and his final journey!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: When I Loved You
synopsis:
Thirteen years apart, one promise that never faded.

Yoon Yiyoung's schedule is packed with work to the point that she hasn't found the chance to go out on a date. One day her friend recommends her to attend a blind date not knowing that she would meet a man she once knew.

That man was Cha Muyeol, the current director of S Group's shareholding company's headquarter and director of S Group Medical. They had also once shared a moment in their youth.

After having separated and forging a path of their own for the past 13 years, Cha Muyeol had come to fulfill the promise they made in their past: marriage.

(Source: WordExcerpt)

title: Dengon Neko ga Cafe ni Imasu
title_english: Message Cat Is in the Cafe
title_japanese: 伝言猫がカフェにいます
synopsis:
After a long life with a loving human family, tabby cat Fuuta has passed into the afterlife—but he is not as far from his owner Michiru as it seems. Slight openings bridge the divide between the lands of the living and the dead, and they can be traversed.

Eager to see Michiru again, Fuuta interviews for a position at Café Pont, a café that exists in the liminal space between the two worlds, known for its unique message delivery service: Customers leave requests with the name of the person they wish to meet, and a messenger cat is assigned to arrange the "meeting." But these encounters cannot happen directly. The cats can only deliver the soul of the desired target by temporarily implanting it into an appropriate third party who then may relay the message in careful words.

(Source: Penguin Random House)

title: One Night Regret
title_japanese: ワン・ナイト・リグレット

title: Yowaki Max Reijou nanoni, Ratsuwan Konyakusha-sama no Kake ni Notte Shimatta
title_japanese: 弱気MAX令嬢なのに、辣腕婚約者様の賭けに乗ってしまった
synopsis:
I was reborn as a villainous daughter in a reverse harem otome game.

After being sick with a high fever at the age of 10, Pia Rockwell suddenly remembered her past life as a university student in Japan. But far from going down the villainess route, all this super timid girl wants is to finally use her knowledge from when she was a grad student studying to get her doctorate in paleontology. Her ultimate goal is to become a commoner, excavate fossils, build a museum, and then become a curator.

So in order to escape the villainess route and avoid being deported by her fiancé during the graduation ball, Pia decides to avoid the upcoming hurt and heartache and asks to break off her engagement to Rufus, the Prime Minister's son.

But will her cunning fiancé let her go that easily?

(Source: MU)

title: Tamura-ke Hyakumonogatari
synopsis:
Battling the supernatural are... a gyaru! A delinquent! And a scary-as-hell mom!? What kind of nightly battles with supernatural beings unfold at the Tamura family home!? A paranormal domestic comedy!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Gal no Ryouri ga Oishisugite Komaru
title_japanese: ギャルの料理がおいしすぎて困る

title: Tensei-saki wa Kaifuku no Izumi no Naka: Kurushikutemo Shinenai Jigoku wo Norikoeta Ore wa Sekai Saikyou
title_japanese: 転生先は回復の泉の中～苦しくても死ねない地獄を乗り越えた俺は世界最強～

title: Nanairo Raijutsushi no Eiyuutan: Subete wo Ushinatta Ore, Raimajutsu wo Kiwamete Saikyou e to Itaru
title_japanese: ナナイロ雷術師の英雄譚-すべてを失った俺、雷魔術を極めて最強へと至る-

title: Shourai Kekkon shiyou ne, to Yakusoku shita Osananajimi ga Kensei ni Natte Kaettekita: Dorei Datta Shounen wa Kakusei shi Saikyou e Itaru
title_japanese: 将来結婚しようね、と約束した幼馴染が剣聖になって帰ってきた～奴隷だった少年は覚醒し最強へ至る～

title: When I Loved You
synopsis:
Thirteen years apart, one promise that never faded.

Yoon Yiyoung's schedule is packed with work to the point that she hasn't found the chance to go out on a date. One day her friend recommends her to attend a blind date not knowing that she would meet a man she once knew.

That man was Cha Muyeol, the current director of S Group's shareholding company's headquarter and director of S Group Medical. They had also once shared a moment in their youth.

After having separated and forging a path of their own for the past 13 years, Cha Muyeol had come to fulfill the promise they made in their past: marriage.

(Source: WordExcerpt)

title: Fortune-Telling Lady
synopsis:
Actress Lee Sia hasn't just been haunted by ghosts for years, she's also been plagued by dreams of a girl named Camilla Sorphel dying repeatedly at the hands of her stepfather and stepbrother. Despite her efforts to ignore the dreams, when an accident at work makes her wake up as Camilla, she's forced to seek the help of various ghosts to win over her family and avoid getting killed. But can this former actress play the part of a loving daughter and sister to her future executors?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Staff Only
synopsis:
When presumed-beta Yoo Hansol visits the doctor for some concerning new symptoms, he's surprised to discover that instead of dying, he's actually an omega! Totally unused to the realities of being an omega, Hansol forgets his suppressants, starting a chain reaction he couldn't possibly have imagined. Nearly passing out on school grounds, Hansol is quickly rushed to the school nurse by the hunky gym teacher. The thing is, at this stage, there's only one way to soothe an omega in the throes of heat...and two oh-so-sexy alphas who are more than happy to help.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Cinema Next Door
synopsis:
The walls are thin, and it's hard not to know what your neighbor is up to, especially when they cry loudly every time they watch a movie.

(Source: MU)

title: Hai Kochira Kaikibu desu
title_japanese: ハイこちら解奇部です

title: Sweet Trap
synopsis:
Hwang Tae Ja was bored. Bored of night clubs, bars and women. Until he met a mysterious woman who didn't even bat an eye at his charm. How will the playboy win that person's affection when all he did that night they met was to embarrass himself?

(Source: MU)

title: Dark Moon: Two Moons
synopsis:
"Ah, so it's you. The one that's taken my place."

Still keeping their true identities secret, Sooha and Heli return to school as an official couple when suddenly a mysterious girl with Sooha's face named Selen appears. Sooha, with whom they have made countless memories together in the current, and Selen, with whom they share deep and fond memories from the past. As two people who never should have met collide, a dangerous and heartrending romance begins once more.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Jitsuryoku Shugi ni Hirowareta Kanteishi: Dorei Atsukai Datta Bokoku wo Sutete, Tekikoku no Eiyuu Hajimemashita
title_english: The Appraiser Taken in by a Meritocratic Empire: From a Slave in My Homeland to a Hero in the Enemy Nation
title_japanese: 実力主義に拾われた鑑定士～奴隷扱いだった母国を捨てて、敵国の英雄はじめました～
synopsis:
"You possess true skill. Your environment was simply holding you back." Alto, a young appraiser who was forced to work like a slave in the aristocracy-driven Kingdom of Dramd, has his life turned upside down when he is scouted by Beralt, a soldier from the enemy nation, the Glaus Empire. In this completely meritocratic country, Alto's off-the-charts appraisal talent is discovered, and he's suddenly nominated to be an executive candidate in the military! Immediately after joining, Alto has great expectations placed on him by the military executives, a group of powerful individuals. Yet, the people he chooses to ally with are only hopeless dropouts facing desperate situations... This is an exhilarating rise-to-power fantasy where Alto uncovers the hidden talents of his comrades and carves out a new destiny!

(Source: AlphaPolis)

title: June Noir
synopsis:
When his partner was murdered and the killer went free, Yoonseok took justice into his own hands. Now he's the pawn of a prosecutor who sends him into danger, his body sexually violated by criminals as a way to gather information. He's little more than a husk, hoping for death, when he begins investigating the gangster Baek Gitae, whose violent sadism triggers something in Yoonseok. Is he seeking out the gangster's sexual aggression as a way to escape his pain? Or is he beginning to enjoy it?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Aijin wo Kakou Reitetsu na Hakushaku to no Tenkeiteki na Seiryaku Kekkon, Soshite Kiraware kara no Dekiai, Sono Ketsumatsu.
title_japanese: 愛人を囲う冷徹な伯爵との典型的な政略結婚、そして嫌われからの溺愛、その結末。
synopsis:
A man seeking status and a woman seeking financial support. It was supposed to be a loveless, arranged marriage. But Renando falls in love with his wife, Elise, who is pure and kind to everyone. The two begin a blissful married life, but this story doesn't have a happy ending...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Sunnyside
synopsis:
Back in high school, Shinonome-senpai was the shining star of the light music club. But when Sumi reunited with her 3 years later, something about her had changed completely...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Hitodasuke wo Shitara Party wo Tsuihou sareta Otoko wa, Unique Skill "Otasukeman" de Nariagaru.
title_japanese: 人助けをしたらパーティを追放された男は、ユニークスキル『お助けマン』で成り上がる。

title: Kizoku Reijou ga Junk Food Kutte "Umai desu wa!" suru dake no Hanashi
title_japanese: 貴族令嬢がジャンクフード食って「美味いですわ!」するだけの話

title: 100-nichigo ni Shinu Akuyaku Reijou wa Mainichi ga Totemo Tanoshii.
title_japanese: 100日後に死ぬ悪役令嬢は毎日がとても楽しい。
synopsis:
The duke's daughter, Lelouche, receives a revelation from God: "You'll die in 100 days."

There are rumors that her fiancé, the crown prince, has found another woman and is about to annul their engagement. ...Moreover, it seems that no matter what she does, Lelouche can't escape death. However, the circumstances and the method of her death can be changed. After being told that, Lelouche offers a bet to God. "If I can show you a beautiful death, I want you to reward me."

"All right. In your next life, I will grant your wishes."

'...Well, looks like I got my hands full,' thinks Lelouche. She can't leave that thieving cat as it is. She also has to do something about her withdrawn brother. She has to prepare something to support her parents. She has a lot of things to do...! In the end, she shall regret nothing...! Thus, a life where she made a bet with God begins.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Ochikobore Makentsukai no Eiyuutan: Majutsu ga Tsukaezu Munou no Rakuin wo Osaremashita ga, "Majutsu Hakai" de Sekai Saikyou e Nariagaru
title_japanese: 落ちこぼれ魔剣使いの英雄譚～魔術が使えず無能の烙印を押されましたが、【魔術破壊】で世界最強へ成り上がる～
synopsis:
Hollow is a boy who was born in a world where magic was at its peak, and under the heroic bloodline "Vermillia." After birth, he was expected to hold immense magic reserves, but it turns out he was diagnosed with a condition called "Magic Oversensitivity" which disabled his ability to use magic. Shortly after, Hollow's disappointed father gave up on him and burnt a crest onto his hand labeling him as a useless human being... Right when all hope is lost, in Hollow's search for what he could truly accomplish, he stumbled upon a dungeon. And within that dungeon, Hollow had found a sealed magic sword "Kasumi," not knowing she would change his life. "I'll become the strongest Swordsman in a magic-ruled world!" In exchange for magic, Hollow would slowly learn that he had instead gained the ability to cut through every conceivable form of magic?!

(Source: Starts Shuppan, translated)

title: The Cell
synopsis:
Junsu, a public health doctor serving his mandatory term at Songhwa Prison, thought his assignment would be dull, routine checkups, a few minor injuries, nothing more.

But on his seventh day, the world literally collapses. A mysterious nationwide sinkhole disaster swallows cities whole, cutting the prison off from the outside world. Now trapped inside a fortress filled with men more terrifying than demons, Junsu has only one thought: "I have to get out of here."

Clutching a stolen keycard, his only ticket to freedom, he makes a break for it. But before he can escape, he runs into the infamous Lee brothers, Tae-hyeong and Tae-mu, cold-blooded criminals whose names alone strike fear even among inmates.

"What a feast. Lick it clean."

With monsters above and monsters within, Junsu's fight for survival turns into a chilling game of instinct, trust, and the brutal will to live.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Punch Drunken Love
synopsis:
On Christmas, college student Jongmin was enjoying his time off, drinking and having a one night stand. After a satisfying night, he turned on the light, only to find the one and only nerd in his department, Goo Youngho, next to him?!

"Why are you here?!!" Jongmin ran away after punching Youngho's face, but Youngho followed him behind!

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Best Friends For-Never
synopsis:
Since their school days, Ki Tae-hwa and Lee Yea-ju have been known as inseparable friends. But after Tae-hwa loses his girlfriend because of Yea-ju, he creates distance between them, using his enlistment as an excuse.

After his discharge, they meet again at a drinking party. Yea-ju confesses that he has remained single, quietly enduring the loneliness left by Tae-hwa's absence. Unable to turn away, Tae-hwa lets himself drift into a moment he never intended, telling himself it is only temporary. As he moves forward, hoping to return to the friendship they once had, he begins to question whether that is truly what he wants.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Menkui
synopsis:
"My sister... Is she really my sister?"

Can you truly say, without a shred of doubt, that the person you love by your side is family?

Haruka lost her parents when she was just a child. For a time she was separated from her older sister, Yurina, but now the two live together again, seemingly close as ever. To Haruka, beautiful Yurina is the very picture of the perfect sister. But even so, two unsettling doubts have taken root in her heart. The first one is that every time Yurina starts dating someone new, she always calls him her "first love.". And the second one is whether Yurina is truly her sister at all.
