Desperate to shake off these suspicions, Haruka opens her sister's old graduation album. What she discovers inside leaves her reeling. And one night, her worst fears take shape before her eyes. Haruka catches Yurina "carving up" her so-called first love with a kitchen knife...?!

(Source: viviON, translated)

title: Doku no Ou: Saikyou no Chikara ni Kakusei shita Ore wa Biki-tachi wo Shitagae, Hatsujou Harem no Aruji to Naru
title_japanese: 毒の王 最強の力に覚醒した俺は美姫たちを従え、発情ハーレムの主となる
synopsis:
Thirteen years ago, a terrible monster called the Poison Queen attacked the Jade Kingdom. A brave party of adventurers defeated her, but in the process one of them was stricken with a curse. In order to survive, she had to pass it down to her own son. Scorned as a cursed child since birth, Caim Halsberg is hated by everyone except his late mother and Tea, a maid working for his family. While his father and twin sister reside in their mansion, Caim is forced to live alone in a forest hut. But everything changes when a certain doctor helps him to overcome the curse and claim its power. Having now become the Poison King, Caim goes on a journey to achieve his one wish—but he never imagined that his poison would have quite the peculiar effect on the beauties he meets!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Boku no Blue Cat
title_japanese: ぼくのブルーキャット

title: Ao wo Fumu
synopsis:
Trapped in the trauma of a middle school heartbreak, Atobe always lives with his head down. Though he's been drawn to his classmate Amakawa, his lack of confidence kept him at a distance. But what he truly hid wasn't just romantic feelings...?

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Myakunashi Drive
synopsis:
Kitagawa is a funeral home employee with zero tolerance for irregularities. One day, while she's transporting a body, it suddenly strikes up a conversation—a talking corpse! Thus begins its final escapade—a wild car chase!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Colorist
synopsis:
A world tainted by darkness. Driven by the Black Witch, humanity is driven into a vast city of light and color. Humanity embarks on a journey to reclaim the world, and a young boy named Kay seeks to join the pioneering group. However, he is ostracized for being a colorless being, possessing no color. Then, one day, a tragic accident transforms Kay into the color black...

(Source: MU)

title: Guilty Girl
synopsis:
One day, fate (and a stack of written apologies) brings together Tadashi, a strict member of the school’s discipline committee, and Komachi Matoi, a rebellious girl who breaks rules just for fun.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Okaasan Boukensha, Login Bonus de Skill "Shufu" ni Mezamemashita. Shuuichi Moraeru Chirashi de Boukensha Seikatsu Ganbarimasu!
title_japanese: お母さん冒険者、ログインボーナスでスキル【主婦】に目覚めました。週一貰えるチラシで冒険者生活頑張ります!
synopsis:
Kachua, a mother of two, works part-time as a porter carrying supplies for adventurers while raising her children. She struggles daily to balance parenting and work, but one day she receives a skill from the goddess—and begins her life as a true adventurer! And her weapons? A ladle and a pot lid!? The newbie mom adventurer begins her laid-back, unstoppable journey! A relaxed and fun adventure tale begins!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Ushiyama-san
synopsis:
Ushiyama-san, the popular girl in class. I thought she was someone I would never have anything to do with, but...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Teisou Gyakuten Sekai de Tanomeba Yareru to Uwasa no Ore
title_japanese: 貞操逆転世界で頼めばヤれると噂の俺
synopsis:
I, Sora Satou, woke up to find myself transported to what they call a "reverse chastity world."

Although I was confused at first, little by little I adapted to this new world's values and eventually ended up working at a supermarket across from an all-girls high school. Just when I had finally gotten used to life as an employee under the kind and beautiful manager, a rumor started spreading: "That male employee... they say if you ask him, he'll let you do it." And so, a group of beautiful girls who took that rumor literally began to gather around me...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Teisou Gyakuten Sekai nara Moteru to Omotteitara
title_japanese: 貞操逆転世界ならモテると思っていたら
synopsis:
"A World Where Chastity is Reversed"—A dream world where the male-to-female ratio is 1:20, women have stronger sexual desires, and precious men live a smooth life protected by their bodyguards.

Fifteen years have passed since Ikuto Ichise was reincarnated into this world, which should have meant having a guaranteed harem, but for some reason, he isn't popular. Ikuto laments that it must be because his bodyguards are all handsome men, and especially his childhood friend Rui Toosaka, who is particularly high-spec... but in reality, the bodyguards are beautiful girls disguised as men!

Completely unaware, Ikuto is overly close and unguarded, making every girl feel like she has a chance. As he unintentionally forms an oblivious harem, Rui, who wishes to be seen as a girl, reveals everything to him—!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Otonarisan no Gal ga Boku wo Horesasetakute Zenryoku Sugiru
title_english: Too Much Love Power from the Gal Next Door!
title_japanese: お隣さんのギャルが僕を惚れさせたくて全力すぎる
synopsis:
I was raised in a large family without any private space, but finally got permission to live alone upon entering high school. Except it came with a condition: "Don't have inappropriate relationships with the opposite sex." And yet, just after helping out my neighbor and classmate out of a jam—Arisa Amagi, a gal—she's been trying to seduce me in every possible way?! There's no way I can resist this! A romantic comedy with some spiciness and a lot of sweetness begins!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Narukami Maiko no Hanbun Nouka
title_japanese: 鳴上マイコのはんぶん農家

title: From Sandbox to Bed
synopsis:
After catching her fiancé cheating, all Seoha wanted was to drink the pain away. Drunk and heartbroken, she shouted she'd sleep with another man too—only to wake up in a stranger's room, in just her underwear. But the man isn't a stranger at all... it is Dohyeon, her childhood friend turned longtime nemesis. What the hell is he doing here?

(Source: Manta)

title: Seikatsu Man
synopsis:
Meet Lifestyle Man, part-time superhero. Screwing up at work by day, smiting evil, saving lives, and earning gratitude by night, the most beloved hero of all time gets his own slice-of-life comedy series!!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Zenryoku Meshi: Arisa wa Yoku Yomi Yoku Taberu
title_japanese: 全力めし アリサはよく読みよく食べる

title: Meitei no Onna Youhei Belle
synopsis:
A young traveler, when looking to take on a mercenary as protection against bandits, is forced to go with the cheapest: a young, cheerfully drunken warrior girl, who spends her income mostly on alcohol.

(Source: MU)

title: Elf-zuma to Hajimeru Yuukyuu no Tabi: Densetsu no Yuusha, Aisuru Elf to Tomo ni 100-nen Mae ni Sukutta Sekai wo Tabisuru
title_japanese: エルフ妻と始める悠久の旅〜伝説の勇者、愛するエルフと共に100年前に救った世界を旅する〜
synopsis:
Lenas, the "Strongest Hero," defeated the Demon King only to be left on the verge of death by a deadly poison. To save his life, he was placed into a cryogenic stasis for a century until a cure could be created. During that time, the one who waited faithfully for him was his wife and fellow party member, Fina, an elf!

Finally reunited, the couple set off on a honeymoon across a world where they are now hailed as "Legends"! They hide their true identities to enjoy some uninterrupted lovey-dovey time, but trouble seems to break out wherever they go! Unable to ignore those in need, the former strongest hero and his wife begin a journey to correct the world's wrongs while flirting nonstop!

All with power that defies logic.

(Source: Hero's, translated)

title: Senpai, Tabetemo Ii desu ka?: Jimi na Kouhai wa Nikushokukei Chijo datta
title_japanese: 先輩、食べてもいいですか?―地味な後輩は肉食系痴女だった―

title: Suieibu de Kyonyuu no Kanojo ga Coach ni Netorareta Hanashi
title_japanese: 水泳部で巨乳の彼女がコーチに寝取られた話

title: Kimi wa Kore kara Boku no Kachiku
title_japanese: 君はコレから僕の家畜

title: Koishitai nara Boku ja Dame?
title_japanese: 恋したいなら僕じゃダメ?
synopsis:
That day, I learned the truth about his obsession... Iori's all-consuming fixation... and the kind of pleasure that melts you from the inside out. I'm Ritsu Hino, and my dream is simply to get a girlfriend! ...Except I've been striking out nonstop. One day, after yet another failed pickup, a guy claiming to be the brother of the girl who dumped me suddenly shows up. He says, "I want you to see her one more time," and I'm thinking, score! Or so I thought. But before I know it, he's saying, "I get jealous of every girl you talk to," while his hands start roaming all over me. I'm supposed to like girls, but when he whispers love into my ear and touches all the right spots, I can't fight the strange, addictive pleasure. Ever since that day, the heat in my body and the ache deep inside just won't stop. A twistedly devoted "girlfriend-face" seme × a short-tempered, easily flustered tsundere uke.

(Source: Shu-Cream, translated)

title: Horetara Make yo?
title_english: If You Fall in Love, You Lose
synopsis:
There's someone Haruto doesn't get along with. That person is Shin, a university student who works at his favorite restaurant. Haruto puts up with it, thinking that their relationship is merely a lunchtime encounter, but then Shin joins Haruto's company! For some reason, Shin seems to have taken a liking to Haruto, and he starts making aggressive advances towards him. Haruto hasn't had a girlfriend for a long time, and he's forgotten all about love, but... 

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

title: Sonna Gekijou de Naguraretai
title_japanese: そんな激情で殴られたい
synopsis:
This dark, broody BL romance explores themes of trauma, escaping cycles of abuse, and facing the parts of ourselves we keep locked away out of shame.

Nanase, a yanki working at a cleaning company, witnesses his coworker, Kurono, giving a blowjob to a senior. Nanase is repulsed at the sight, yet finds himself unable to think of anything else. Suddenly, as if Kurono can see through him, he invites Nanase to his house... A twisted love affair evolves from there between a hothead yanki and his mysterious colleague.

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Saenai Ore no Ijou na Kouhai
title_english: A Boring Man and an Extraordinary Man
title_japanese: 冴えない俺の異常な後輩
synopsis:
When two former classmates are reunited in the workplace, sparks fly in spite of their so-called social differences. A BL love story about overcoming self-doubt and embracing self-worth!

Office worker Mochizuki leads an ordinary life, busy with overtime work. Nothing special happens to him, until the day his former classmate shows up at his workplace: a popular guy with good looks, family background, and brains... Hinata Natsuki. Having been unexpectedly reunited, Hinata is determined to take their relationship from colleagues to lovers, but Mochizuki can't imagine why someone so extraordinary would want to be with someone so... ordinary.

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Yume Kanawanakereba Shine
title_english: If Your Dreams Didn't Come True, Die
synopsis:
Having turned 30, Hiro and his former classmates return to their old middle school to dig up time capsules they had left behind. Hiro finds shocking words from his past self inside his box...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Unrivaled Spear Demon
synopsis:
Shuji, a soldier who danced with death many times while on the battlefield, was possessed by the grudges and resentment of those he had killed. He too was eventually killed, but somehow he awoke in a younger version of himself. He returned to a time when he was still an errand boy, inexperienced with war, but retained his memories. Remembering Kyo Aiyo, his comrade and savior, Shuji traveled to the Tiger Pit Sect. However, instead of the strong and reliable woman, he was met with a cheerful and petite girl. He recalled the tragic past that had caused her to devote herself to the army, where in his previous life her family had fallen apart due to false rumors. 'This time, I will protect you.' He vowed to repay the kindness he received in his previous life by changing her fate. With a spear in his right hand, Shuji steps into the battlefield once again, becoming the Unrivaled Spear Demon.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Isekai Rakuraku Mujintou Life: Class Teni de Craft Nouryoku wo Eranda Ore dake ga, Bishoujo-tachi to Slow Life wo Okureruppoi
title_japanese: 異世界ラクラク無人島ライフ ～クラス転移でクラフト能力を選んだ俺だけが、美少女たちとスローライフを送れるっぽい～
serializations: Suiyoubi wa Mattari Dash X Comic

title: The Time When We Were Young
synopsis:
Choi Ah-ran, a novelist and publisher, runs a publishing company while hiding the humiliation of her past as Jo Ah-han, a writer who made a big name for herself 20 years ago with an internet novel about the most popular student of Sanggo High falling for an ordinary high school student. Ah-ran goes to her parents' house, where she grew up, to announce the end of her engagement, but loses consciousness and is dragged into the realm of internet novels, Cheonyang.

Cheonyang is completely different from reality. Her now divorced parents affectionately wake up Ah-ran, and emoticons expressing their feelings appear in the speech balloon. The spelling is a mess! Such a cliché blabber! Ah-ran goes to school in an unguarded moment and realizes that this is an imaginary world where the laws of internet fiction are constantly occurring.

"This is a world I made up, so I can escape!"

While searching for a way to go back home, she goes to the city with her friend Soyoung, and meets the Four Heave

title: Kikoku no Doujo: Ibun Ooeyama Oni Taiji
title_japanese: 鬼哭の童女 異聞大江山鬼退治
synopsis:
It was the Heian era. The oni warlord Shuten Douji and his band, who had occupied Mount Ooe, were supposed to have been vanquished by Minamoto no Yorimitsu and the "Guardians of the Imperial House"—or so it was believed.

But Shuten Douji is resurrected, using a young blind girl named Aoi as his vessel, and together with the one-armed oni Ibaraki Douji, he heads for the capital with revenge against the imperial court in his heart.

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

title: Himesama, Goranshin! Tensai Kyouikugakari (Ore) no Seizon Senryaku wa Cute na Himesama no Do S-ka deshita
title_japanese: 姫様、ご乱心!～天才教育係（俺）の生存戦略はキュートな姫様のドＳ化でした～
synopsis:
He reincarnated as... the villainous princess's instructor from the grotesque, yandere-filled eroge he used to play obsessively in his past life!? When Alfred regains his memories, he realizes he's destined to be beheaded by the princess, and falls into despair! Determined to shout "I don't wanna die!" and change his fate, he uses every bit of game knowledge revived from his past life to begin a full-power survival strategy. But in reality, the princess is unexpectedly adorable...!? Betting his life, he aims to prevent the heroine from turning into an S-queen (...or push her that way?), in this fate-changing romantic comedy—now begins!

(Source: Akita Publishing, translated)

title: Isekai kara Kaettekita Yuusha de Aru Ore ga Kabukichou de Ou ni Naru Hanashi
title_japanese: 異世界から帰ってきた勇者であるオレが歌舞伎町で王になる話
synopsis:
Yuuji Kuze, the hero who once saved another world, returns to Japan only to find himself without a place to belong—reduced to what society calls a "loser." Preferring to end his life, he wanders into Kabukichou and encounters a peculiar concept café. This café is a special place where girls who are also "otherworld returnees" work. "You should try becoming a hero in this city again," someone tells him, pushing him to stand back up. Thus, Yuuji vows to rise once more! A new adventure begins for the man who once saved an entire world.

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Frost Crack: Renzoku Sogeki Hannin no Suiri
title_japanese: フロスト・クラック ~連続狙撃犯人の推理~
synopsis:
"Do you know about the serial sniper case happening in Japan?"

One day, a man living outside of Japan gets a sudden phone call from a young Japanese police officer, who informs him of a serial murder case involving hunting guns. The overseas man is a former hunter, so the police officer tells him the whole story in detail, asking for his cooperation. The ex-hunter, drawing his conclusions, exposes the criminal's tricks. At first, the police officer rejoices, but before long, he realizes that the truth is still far away.

The whole story is told through a phone conversation full of suspense and many characters interweaving. The shocking conclusion awaits.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Unromantic Office
synopsis:
After working like crazy at a small company, Jeong Sunwoo finally succeeded in getting a job at a big corporation. With his neat looks, the flattery skills he'd honed from the previous (small) company, and top-tier social skills, Sunwoo was confident he could hold his own anywhere. But that confidence was shattered just 30 minutes into his first day... The newbie he lectured with 200% boomer energy turned out to be a higher-ranked employee than him?! He really made a memorable first impression.

(Source: Ridi, translated)

title: Freeter Time Machine Memory Hack
title_english: Part-Time Hero: Time Machine Memory Hack
title_japanese: フリータータイムマシンメモリーハック
synopsis:
"I'll never be a main character." Our hero has lost all hope in life when a mysterious woman suddenly appears before him, pleading with him to "save the world." What ends up in his hand? A game controller! Can he actually save the world?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Dougan na Joushi wa Suki desu ka?
title_japanese: 童顔な上司は好きですか?
synopsis:
Maki is a baby-faced but highly competent and reliable boss. On the other hand, there's Ayame, a mature-looking fresh graduate who is still trying to navigate the adult world. With his adorable face and reliability, Maki leaves Ayame blushing non-stop. An office romance between polar opposites: the baby-faced boss and the mature-looking fresh graduate!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Hensei
title_english: In the Twilight of Our Adolescence
synopsis:
A story about boys who grow from boys to adults during adolescence, and who worry, make mistakes, and gradually come to terms with the many facets of life.

Tanahashi Yusei is a popular boy who excels in both academics and sports, and naturally has people gathering around him. Yusei has a classmate he admires, but he can't tell anyone about him. That person is Nakagawa, an inconspicuous boy who his friends don't even seem to notice. The two become closer after a certain incident...

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Jijibaba Yuusha Party Saigo no Tabi: Oita Saikyou wa Iroasenu Mama Mirai e Susumu you desu
title_english: One Last Hurrah! The Grayed Heroes Explore a Vivid Future
title_japanese: ジジババ勇者パーティー最後の旅 ～老いた最強は色褪せぬまま未来へ進むようです～
synopsis:
Even great heroes eventually grow old. Decades after saving the world, a band of brave heroes now live quietly in peaceful retirement as their final days await just beyond the horizon. Knowing time is short, Ferd the Hero longs to reunite with his old friends and meet his great-grandchild while he still can. In the company of his wife, Elrica the Saint, Ferd sets off on a transcontinental journey to see their comrades and finally visit their family abroad. Yet their last hurrah is bound to be anything but ordinary. After all, wherever legends of great tread, great trouble is sure to follow. Only one question remains: Is there any problem the greatest heroes of their age can't solve?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Tensei shitara Saikyoushu-tachi ga Sumau Shima deshita. Kono Shima de Slow Life wo Tanoshimimasu
title_english: The Isle of Paramounts: Reborn into a Slow Life Among the Strongest in the World
title_japanese: 転生したら最強種たちが住まう島でした。この島でスローライフを楽しみます
synopsis:
Arata Toudou is just your average overworked corporate drone stuck in a monotonous grind—or at least he was, until a god’s careless mistake leads to his untimely demise. Life after death isn’t all that bad, though. As an apology, the god reincarnates him on a remote island in another world, complete with two overpowered cheats: a body immune to injury and illness, and a skill that lets him copy the spells and abilities of anyone he meets. At long last, Arata can finally live out his dream of a quiet, solitary life in the great outdoors. But blissful solitude isn’t what greets him. It turns out the not-so-deserted island is home to the world’s strongest legendary beings. One thing’s certain: With the charming castaway and master magician Reina here to help, Arata’s new life promises unexpected companions and delicious feasts galore!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Maid nara Touzen desu. Nureginu wo Kiserareta Bannou Maid-san wa Tabi ni Deru Koto ni shimashita
title_english: Looks Like a Job for a Maid! The Tales of a Dismissed Supermaid
title_japanese: メイドなら当然です。 濡れ衣を着せられた万能メイドさんは旅に出ることにしました
synopsis:
For plain little Nina, working as a maid in the house of Count Mirkwood is her whole world—until a false accusation has her swept out on the streets. Jobless and with nowhere left to turn, Nina decides to set out on her very first solo journey. But Nina isn't just any maid—she's a supermaid! Her talents quickly prove indispensable to the people she meets during her travels. There's Emily, a mage who can't use magic; Astrid, a brilliant inventor whose experiments never quite work; and Tien, an orphan who can't seem to keep a meal down. Meanwhile, back at the Mirkwood household, things go awry in Nina's absence... None of them realize it yet, but Nina might just be the answer they've all been searching for. Because when this supermaid is on the job, no mess can stand in her way!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Golden Kamuy: Tsurumi Tokushirou no Shukugan
title_japanese: ゴールデンカムイ 鶴見篤四郎の宿願

title: Toramimi Onna ni Natta tote
title_english: Even If I Become a Girl with Tiger Eyes
synopsis:
An unexpected transformation into a girl with tiger ears!

Richou Momoyama is an aspiring novelist and high school student. After suffering a major blow to his ego through a reality check, he found himself contracting "Beastification Syndrome." Tiger ears? Check. A tail? Yup. Becoming a girl on top of that? Just a nice addition.

How will he live his life from now on? Find out in this wild comedy filled with transformations into beast people and gender-swapping!!!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Yasashii? Mesugaki Succubus
title_japanese: やさしい?メスガキサキュバス

title: Aibou wa Slime!? Saikyou no Aibou wo Eta Boku ga Saikyou no Mahou wo Tsukatte Nariagaru
title_japanese: 相棒はスライム!? ～最強の相棒を得た僕が最強の魔法を使って成り上がる～
synopsis:
Zack, the protagonist, has hit rock bottom. His family hates him, and his fiancée has called off their engagement. A black object appears before him. It turns out to be Sura, a powerful black slime capable of human speech! A great adventure, with the strongest slime! They're aiming to rule the continent!?

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

title: Tepetoru! Teppen Tottaru!
title_japanese: てぺとる！～てっぺんとったる！～
synopsis:
With good looks and brains, university student Ryou Shinomiya is utterly bored with his smooth-sailing life. One day, he learns that his senior, Junta, who aspires to be a comedian, has split up with his double-act partner. Ryou, who has always been drawn to Junta's boundlessly cheerful and adventurous approach to life, suddenly decides to become Junta's new partner. Living together, entering competitions, performing live... A heart-fluttering BL story of two young comedians growing as a duo.

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Two Tigers, Too Close
synopsis:
When brawler Kang Jihwan is forced to transfer schools, the last thing he expects is to rely on the top student in class. But after accidentally tearing model-student Han Yuseong's uniform, and discovering the fierce tiger tattoo hidden on his back, Jihwan offers a deal: he'll keep Yuseong's secret if Yuseong becomes his tutor. To push Jihwan away, Yuseong turns up the heat with bold, intimate teasing... but the closer he gets, the more Jihwan finds himself drawn in. Between hidden claws and rising tension, two boys with tiger hearts may be getting far too close for comfort.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Yakuza in Love
synopsis:
Min Joon thought studying abroad in Japan would mean the beginning his fabulous gay life. But instead, he's scammed by his boyfriend, loses his passport and is basically screwed. What's worse, a kid comes up to him calling him "mama" and before he knows it, he's being kidnapped by the yakuza. Then the hot yakuza boss makes him an offer he can't refuse... so now it's either be "mama" to his little kid or to not live at all. What to do, what to do? And this yakuza boss is just too hot for his own good...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Ghostly Connection
synopsis:
When skeptic Jehyeon and paranormal-obsessed Yeonghu become unlikely roommates, they think they've lucked into the deal of the century: a huge apartment for an unbelievably cheap price. But they soon learn why the rent was so low... You see, something else is living there, and it's very interested in them! Now the two opposites must survive a nosy, perverted ghost and the bizarre mysteries of their new home...together.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Love, Unauthorized
synopsis:
Being popular is nothing new for Hyeok Jiseung. He's always had admirers, and Tae Eonho is just another one, aside from the whole being a guy thing. Jiseung found it Eonho's terrible attempts at hiding his crush amusing...until Eonho took things a step too far. Cute is one thing. Breaking into his room and hiding in his closet? That's another story.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: My Neighbor's a Tiger
synopsis:
Areum Ham can't believe that one night of drinking to forget meant forgetting everything. But when Bumyeong Baek, soccer star and childhood friend, demands to know what they did the night before, one thing slowly becomes clear: neither of them remembers if things ended with a kiss. But just when she thinks things are complicated enough, he has another demand lined up for her.

Since when was he interested in more? Does she feel the same way, or has this tiger set his sights on the wrong prey?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: To My Valentine
synopsis:
Jaden never expected to be caught up in the Olsen family's drama, but Philip, his old friend and secret crush, is terminally ill and wants to see his son, the boy Jaden once babysat, one last time. Jaden agrees to help, even though Harry refuses to face his father. Their reunion starts as a clash; Harry feels abandoned by Jaden all those years ago, but his feelings for him soon resurface. And Jaden begins questioning his own heart...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Soushitsu Mahoutsukai no Saikyou Kenja: Uragirareta Moto Yuusha wa, Ore dake Tsukaeru Saikyou Mahou de Anyaku suru
title_japanese: 喪失魔法使いの最強賢者～裏切られた元勇者は、俺だけ使える最強魔法で暗躍する～

title: Makai de Sodaterareta Shounen, Umarete Hajimete no Ningenkai de Musou suru: Makai no Joushiki de Ikitetara, Kizukeba Jinrui Saikyou ni Natteita
title_japanese: 魔界で育てられた少年、生まれて初めての人間界で無双する～魔界の常識で生きてたら、気付けば人類最強になっていた～

title: Tensei Kenja no Yarinaoshi: Ore dake Tsukaeru Kikakugai Mahou de Nidome no Jinsei wo Musou suru
title_japanese: 転生賢者のやり直し～俺だけ使える規格外魔法で二度目の人生を無双する～

title: Kakusei shitara Sekai Saikyou no Madou Renseishi deshita: Renkinjutsu ya Chiryou wo mo Ryouga suru Chikara de Subete wo Te ni Ireru
title_japanese: 覚醒したら世界最強の魔導錬成師でした～錬金術や治癒をも凌駕する力ですべてを手に入れる～

title: The Wandering Knight's Survival Manual
synopsis:
After dying due to an unexpected accident, Kim Yohan reincarnated as Johann Aitz of the prestigious Aitz Family. He may have been born a noble, but Johann Aitz ranks at the very bottom of the family hierarchy. To make matters worse, this world revolves around a ruthless medieval society.

"The only person you can trust is yourself."

In a world ruled by the law of the strong, survival requires only two things: money and power. While training relentlessly using the knowledge he gained in his modern life, Johann ends up encountering Kaegal, the Master of Poison of the Empire's greatest assassination guild, the Nesos Guild. This is the fierce struggle of Johann, who refuses to become just another prey of this brutal era.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Valkyrie-tachi to Kizuku Moto Teihen Murabito no Saikyou Harem: Suumannin no Onna ni Taishi, Otoko wa Ore Hitori
title_english: The Survivors of Humanity Are the Valkyries, Except Me.
title_japanese: 戦乙女〈ヴァルキリー〉たちと築く元・底辺村人の最強ハーレム ～数万人の女に対し、男は俺一人～

title: Koushaku Shisoku no Shuuchaku kara Nigeraresou ni Nai node, Nigenai Koto ni Shimashita
title_japanese: 公爵子息の執着から逃げられそうにないので、逃げないことにしました

title: Nekonome Yuuka wa Kataru bekarazu
title_japanese: 猫ノ目ゆうかは語るべからず

title: Nanimo Wakaranai
title_japanese: なにも理解〈わか〉らない
synopsis:
What if you were suddenly thrown into an unknown world with no memory? In this unfamiliar place, you meet a mysterious girl. To survive, you must learn to communicate in an unknown language and try to understand this world!

(Source: Houbunsha)

title: Qinai de Siduitou
synopsis:
The whole company knew that they were polar opposites who fought like cats and dogs. Yet during the year-end party, the wall between them shattered after they got drunk! And so, the two of them went from always being close to going off on each other to feeling very strange things following the accidental mishap...

(Source: Kuaikan World, translated)

title: Paris ni Saku Etoile
title_japanese: パリに咲くエトワール
synopsis:
In the early 1900s, two Japanese girls—Fujiko, who dreams of becoming a painter, and Chizuru, who is passionate about ballet—refuse to give up and reach for the stars (Etoile) even in difficult times. After meeting by chance in Yokohama, they reunite in Paris, where they strive to pursue their dreams together.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Stupid Cupid
synopsis:
After years of being classmates, Yedam finally worked up the courage to confess to his crush, Lee Jane... so why is he spending all his time going on bro-dates with their friend Suwon?! Turns out Jane is next-level dense—she thinks her two guy friends are in love with each other! And so begins Yedam's fight to convince Jane that she's the one he really likes. Can he break through her iron wall of cluelessness?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: A Second Chance
synopsis:
In-chul unexpectedly gets a second chance to meet his long-time crush after mysteriously going back in time. Determined to make things right, he tries to approach her again, but his newfound confidence also draws the attention of other colleagues at his office. What begins as a simple wish to reconnect turns into a whirlwind of misunderstandings, awkward moments, and heart-pounding encounters.

(Source: Topco)

title: Freshman
synopsis:
College is a place for learning, making memories, and unexpected surprises. One day, a misunderstanding involving a TA and professor puts him in an awkward situation. At the same time, a friendly freshman begins to show interest in him, leading to lighthearted campus drama and new friendships.

(Source: Topco)

title: Wolf Groom
synopsis:
After being cast out from her wolf pack, Yeon resolves to survive on her own, but a chance encounter leads her to share a hut with a handsome young human named Hwan. Against all reason, Yeon finds herself drawn to the dashing human male, but it turns out... he's a wolf, too?!

(Source: Manta)

title: Paradisus Valentinae
synopsis:
Valentina's former fiancé appears before her, looking like a ragged vagabond and carrying a letter secretly ordering his death, sent by none other than his uncle and her future husband. Though Valentina tries to push him away, Aethelred seems intent on winning her back.

(Source: Manta)

title: The Summer You Came
synopsis:
After quitting her high-pressure job, Seori returns home and reluctantly joins swimming lessons at her brother's urging. There, she meets instructor Yujeong—her brother's friend, who instantly recognizes her as his first love. Under summer's heat and rain, a heart-fluttering romance begins.

(Source: Manta)

title: Ready Shoot, for Love
title_japanese: 레디 슛, 포 러브(Ready Shoot, For love)
synopsis:
Yihyun, beloved daughter of a wealthy family, has loved A-list actor Seoan for years. When an arranged marriage lands her with him, she can't believe her luck! However, Seoan insists on a temporary marriage and to divorce later. As secrets unravel, will their union stay "temporary"?

(Source: Manta)

title: Don't Tell My Brother!
synopsis:
Shinwoo Cho's got money and looks, but Yuju Lee knows he's arrogant and scandalous. He's also her brother's best friend, so waking up in his bed after way too much wine was... not ideal. Yet the more Yuju tries to pretend it never happened, the more Shinwoo seems determined to remind her it did!

(Source: Manta)

title: Guilty Office
synopsis:
Morae Jung had a drunken one-night stand with her mentor from hell, Kangjae Seo, the night before he left for America. 5 years later he's back, but now he's her boss! What's more, he's got his sights on Morae. Will she be able to survive working under this man?

(Source: Manta)

title: A Lady's Risqué Hobby
synopsis:
Eileen Hamilton's brother, Stephan, is at a loss to find her a match. No suitor can overcome her love of reading or insistence on marrying for love. But Eileen has a secret—she's an author of erotic romances, and finding a cure for her inexperience and chronic writer's block is far more pressing than her prospects. Certain everything is ruined when her secret is revealed to her brother's friend Alexander, she's shocked when he offers to help. How could she refuse her crush?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Elegy of Rose Castle
synopsis:
Who knew that the life of an aristocrat would be full of such loneliness?

Ruri wakes up one day as Albertina von Rozenburg, the oldest legitimate child of the Rozenburg family. This new life of hers is full of tetchy servants, unfamiliar rules, and distant family members. Ruri longs to go back to her familiar world, but there's no one here to guide her. With no one to trust, Ruri becomes wary of everyone, even the only person who seems to care about Albertina: Elma, a young servant girl who follows Albertina with a dogged devotion.

When Ruri finds out that Albertina's only purpose is to get married off to an unpleasant, albeit very handsome, prince, she's had enough. She's going to find a way out of here, even if that means she doesn't act according to the traditions of this world, so be it.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Shinsei! Nyan Senshiis!
synopsis:
Nyan Warrior Vesta has been fighting solo to save citizens from people bitten by bad dogs. Until an unexpected potential partner appears: the standoffish guy who sits beside her in class!?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: The Player with 13 Hidden Traits
synopsis:
In the game world of Pangaenia, Hyeonmyeong is known as "the Phantom," an anonymous legend admired by players. In real life, however, he is jobless and still getting over his recent breakup. When his character is killed and permanently deleted, his only remaining goal to become the first gamer to beat Pangaenia is shattered. Soon, however, Pangaenia begins to merge with the real world, and Hyeonmyeong gets a chance to start over—this time, with 13 hidden traits.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Nemureru Mori no Rega
synopsis:
Deep within a dark, dark forest, there was a princess who had been put into a deep sleep by an evil dragon.

To save her, Rega, the captain of a kingdom's knights, challenged the evil dragon to battle. The dragon's power was immense, but with his feelings for the princess in his heart, he somehow managed to defeat it. Reunited with the awakened princess, Rega's heart overflowed with joy.

And then, the princess said to him: "Be cursed."

Now begins the adventure tied to this tale.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Suterare Ouji ga Saizensen de Tekikoku no Heishi wo Chiryou shitara Jitsu wa Dainana Oujo Datta Ken
title_japanese: 捨てられ王子が最前線で敵国の兵士を治療したら実は第七皇女だった件
synopsis:
Reincarnated from modern Japan as Reischel, the First Prince of the Kingdom of Agarham, the protagonist receives a supernatural power that allows him to heal any anomaly just by touching it. Following his father's death, Reischel is removed from his position as Crown Prince due to his younger brother's rebellion and is sent to the battlefront. Nonetheless, he spends his days healing wounded soldiers, both allies and enemies, and gradually establishes himself as the respected commander of the medical corps. One day, he treats a soldier who is on the brink of death, but that soldier turns out to be... ?! An intensely dramatic and slightly erotic isekai harem life begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Joukyou Koroshiya Musume
synopsis:
Born and raised in a rural town by a family of hitman, Chiharu Tamamano has spent the two years since graduating high school living a quiet, modest life as naturally a hitman herself. No dreams, no boyfriend, and still living with parents; her days are mostly "work" and spending time in the local shopping mall.

But her peaceful countryside routine is suddenly shattered when her mother announces, "I've found a new man," and orders Chiharu to move to Tokyo.

Thrown from her calm, comfortable rural life into the overwhelming big city, Chiharu must face unfamiliar challenges at every turn. Will she be able to survive the hitman trade in Tokyo and secure the "sparkling city life" she's been promised?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Big Life
synopsis:
Struggling writer Jaegun Ha's life is forever changed when he stumbles upon the grave of a prolific writer. He finds a box of belongings there guarded by a loyal cat. Each gift helps him write with supernatural speed and confidence. Soon, they help skyrocket him to fame and fortune. But with success comes challenges such as balancing artistic integrity with commercial success, enduring the continued rejection of his father, and dealing with a rival peer who meets him with envy and hostility.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Salty & Sweet
synopsis:
What if your partner wanted to break up... Unless you were willing to degrade him? Nanho just wants a normal relationship. As long as his lover has a handsome face, he's happy. His boyfriend, Myungjoon, is beautiful but can't get off unless he's being criticized. Myungjoon's hot brother, Su-an, also likes Nanho but he needs a partner that's into hardcore S&M. These three difficult people must navigate the struggle of meeting their own romantic requirements or end up frustrated and alone.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Relentless Fog
synopsis:
Haemu Kang is in crisis mode after his recent breakup. To ensure he's okay, his friends and former classmates rally together and take turns keeping him company. But hangouts quickly turn into something more, and Haemu finds the ultimate distraction: steamy encounters with guys leagues cooler than his ex. But will this mess up his chances with the one that got away? Haemu will find out when his secret crush shows up unexpectedly on his doorstep.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Spotlight Confession
synopsis:
Koh Eundan, once an Ex-Idol, now working as a photoshoot assistant, is helping out with top model Wonhae's cover shoot. The atmosphere heats up as Eundan is asked to help with grooming Wonhae's more private areas. Little does he know, Wonhae's motives aren't purely business-related, as he was one of Eundan's biggest fans back in his idol days...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Bloom
synopsis:
Shin Giwon has been searching for the reason he became famous: his very first fan. Little does he know, what he's looking for is a lot closer than he thinks...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Love and Roll
synopsis:
Oh Dokhee, the drummer of Bold Rabbit, an indie band on the verge of breaking out, is offered a high-profile photoshoot. Initially hesitant and shy in front of the camera, he agrees when he learns that the photographer is Myung Leejin, someone Dokhee has admired for years.

What begins as a simple photoshoot quickly spirals into confusion when Leejin misunderstands Dokhee. In an attempt to clear things up, Dokhee seduces him into intercourse. As the lines between desire and misunderstanding blur, Dokhee finds himself entangled in emotions he can barely control.

Will Dokhee's hidden love finally reach Leejin, or will everything unravel before it even begins?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Colorize
synopsis:
Back in high school, there was always a peculiar and subtle tension between Yoosung and Gunha. After losing contact with Gunha, Yoosung moved on, becoming an actor and trying to put the past behind him. However, when a stalker begins threatening Yoosung, his agency brings in Gunha as his personal bodyguard to protect their star. Now, Yoosung is forced to confront Gunha, along with the lingering past and unresolved emotions that still hang between them...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Love Lesson
synopsis:
Renowned for his dazzling looks and over-the-top acting, Lee Ji-yoo is the talk of the town—for better or worse. Desperate to shed his embarrassing reputation, he turns to Lee-do, a sharp-tongued entertainment director, for some much-needed acting lessons. But as the lines between teacher and student blur, one question remains: is this "lesson" really about acting?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Night Guest
synopsis:
Yieum and Jiho were very close when they were young... That is until Yieum's grandfather sent Jiho away to study abroad and forbade him from ever coming back. However the two have a fateful reunion after Yieum's grandfather passes away, leading them to discover the truth behind their past and finding passion they didn't realize was a shared one...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Kiss and Slither
synopsis:
When Han Sorang was hired as a model for a photoshoot, he didn't realize just how...authentic the director would want it to be. As if being brought to a dusty old palace and forced into women's clothing isn't enough, Sorang's day gets even stranger when a charm appears out of nowhere and sends him into a deep slumber. When he awakes, he thinks he is totally alone, until a man—no, a beast!—appears, declaring them spouses. Things are moving way too fast for Sorang, especially when the creature reveals himself to be gifted with an extra member. Two heads may be better than one, but three is far, far too many!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Freefall
synopsis:
Was the way I felt about you back then love? Friendship? Or perhaps it was jealousy all along.

Baek Hojin, a former national judo champion, has never experienced the feeling of falling in endlessly—until now. Choi Jeongwon, a brash magazine editor on the verge of losing his job, stumbles across a fragment of his past: a memory of Baek Hojin, his high school classmate and now one of the nation's most celebrated heroes.

Tasked with securing an exclusive interview with Hojin to save his career, Jeongwon must navigate old emotions and new challenges. But will he succeed before it's too late?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Too Many Heroes for the Demon Lord
title_english: Too Many Heroes for the Demon Lord
synopsis:
Berje Deias was once a by-the-book Demon King, but after being reborn, he is determined to break every rule there is. His second attempt at life, however, takes a chaotic turn when a kidnapping of a princess doesn't quite go to plan! Can he defeat an entire continent of heroes with his wild, untested methods?!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Choujikokouteijin
synopsis:
Arisa Kumagai, age 27. Works earnestly at her new job as an interior design salesperson. Lives in an apartment overflowing with self-improvement books. Meets unpleasant rumors from her coworkers and superiors with a smile. Arisa tries, and she tries, and she tries. But what comes after that...?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Akutou Ikka no Manamusume, Tensei-saki mo Otome Game no Gokudou Reijou deshita. Saijoukyuu Rank no Akuyaku-sama, Sono Dekiai wa Fuyou desu!
title_japanese: 悪党一家の愛娘、転生先も乙女ゲームの極道令嬢でした。～最上級ランクの悪役さま、その溺愛は不要です!～
synopsis:
After her sudden death at the hands of an assassin, the former granddaughter of a yakuza boss reincarnates in an otome game as the heroine. The game is, of course, set in the time of early European mafia (but with magic), specifically a kingdom where the royal family is supported behind the scenes by five major gangsters!

A dangerous love game between a former yakuza heiress and her villain fiancé begins!

(Source: TO Books, translated)

title: Genkai Shakaijin-san wo Sukueru no wa Kusodeka Kanjou Stalker-chan dake deshita
title_japanese: 限界社会人さんを救えるのはクソデカ感情ストーカーちゃんだけでした

title: Mumei Sanryuu Tamer wa Outo no Hazure de Nonbiri Kurasu: Demo, Kokka no Youshoku ni Tsuku Deshi-tachi ga Nazeka Tayottekimasu
title_japanese: 無名の三流テイマーは王都のはずれでのんびり暮らす ～でも、国家の要職に就く弟子たちがなぜか頼ってきます～
synopsis:
Bartz is a humble tamer who never asked for much—just a modest adventurer enjoying a carefree life with his contracted beasts, taking on small, unremarkable quests day by day. One day, while handling yet another routine request, he's visited by Noelie, a young woman who used to be one of the orphans he once looked after. She proudly tells Bartz that, thanks to his teachings, she's achieved great success—and now she's come to ask him to take up an important national position. Though Bartz feels the role is far beyond his abilities, he can't bring himself to turn her down. Determined to do what he can, he decides to accept the challenge. And as a result, his familiars and former students start to shine brilliantly, revealing Bartz's extraordinary gift for nurturing talent! A rise-to-greatness fantasy about an ordinary adventurer whose outstanding disciples and tamed beasts make him a legend!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title: Red Fox: Huel Redam
synopsis:
The continuation of the story Red Fox.

Sana, who was bestowed the destiny of eternal life, and the only being who can accept her, Iza. "The moments when you deeply yearn for someone always tend to come unexpectedly."

(Source: Ridi, translated)

title: Puppet in the City
title_japanese: パペット・イン・ザ・シティ
synopsis:
This is Seifuku-chou. The crime rate is always zero, there's nothing but good people all around. Violence is silly, and even speaking ill of others is not possible. Naturally, Kokoro Shiozaki thought this too. Until she meets the strange transfer student Kyou Miyabe... "I'll show you just what kind of town this really is."

(Source: Shu-Cream, translated)

title: Aruiwa, Watashi no Meitantei
synopsis:
High schooler Momo Odagiri leaves her island home to attend high school on the mainland. Having grown up on a boring island, Momo dreams of becoming a detective and is always on the lookout for cases. After moving into her first apartment, she meets the mysterious beauty Kotone Akaishi and falls for her at first sight. Declaring she'll make the reluctant Kotone her "assistant" against her will, the two form a buddy team to solve small everyday mysteries together.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Joudan de Onna Yuusha-tachi wo Kudoita Daimaou, Sarawarete Kyousei Shinkon Seikatsu
title_japanese: 冗談で女勇者たちを口説いた大魔王、攫われて強制新婚生活

title: Naze Nigerun dai? Boku no Shoukanjuu wa Kawaii yo
title_english: Why Do You Run Away? Why? My Summoned Beast Is Very Cute!
title_japanese: なぜ逃げるんだい? 僕の召喚獣は可愛いよ
synopsis:
Hey, the name's Heresy! I was born and raised in a remote farming village, but it's always been my dream to become a summoner. And thanks to the superspecial friend I made when I was little, I get to turn that dream into a reality! Isn't that right, Happy? (Source: Yen Press)

title: Emblem Wars
synopsis:
Among the numerous emblems to exist, only one is said to be cursed with the fate of ruin—the Emblem of Asura. After a man who serves an unseen will reduces Vahn's life to ashes and casts him into a timeless abyss, Vahn endures 999 long years of torment before awakening the true power of ruin. Reborn as vengeance incarnate, his retribution begins.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title_japanese: 殺し屋1〈イチ〉 誕生編

title: Kanae-chan wa Sonna Koto Shinai!
title_japanese: 香苗ちゃんはそんな事しない!

title: Himitsu no Adults Goods-ya-san
title_japanese: 秘密のアダルトグッズ屋さん

title: Office Drake: Ishuzoku Joushi
title_japanese: オフィスドレイク-異種族上司-

title: Uchuu no Naka de Anata dake
title_english: I Only Love You, You Only Love Me
title_japanese: 宇宙のなかであなただけ
synopsis:
1. Sekai no Naka ni Omae dake (You're My Entire World)
2. Uchuu no Naka ni Omae dake (You're My Entire Universe)
3. Bitter Sweet Chocolate
4. Neko no Wakusei (Planet of the Pussy Cats)
5. ♀♂ Hentai (♀♂ Pervert)
6. Ririko wa Oshitai shite Orimasu wa (Ririko Idolizes You)

title: Jiro Tenohira no Shirabe: Sukiyabashi Jirou Monogatari
title_japanese: JIRO 掌の調べ〜すきやばし次郎物語〜
synopsis: A biographical manga about sushi chef Jirou Ono.

title: Gal-Succubus Allergy!
title_japanese: ぎゃるばす・あれるぎー!

title: Acting Badly
synopsis:
Veteran actor Cha Jae-hwan has built his career on discipline and perfection. So when a close director friend asks him to star in the historical film Jahwa, he expects a challenge, but not this one.

At the first script reading, Jae-hwan meets his co-star, Shin Seong-hyeon, a rookie actor with raw potential but zero polish. His delivery is flat, his timing off, and his presence all over the place. For someone like Jae-hwan, who breathes precision, it's unbearable.

Yet instead of walking away, he finds himself guiding Seong-hyeon, patiently at first, then with a curiosity he can't quite name.

"Shin Seong-hyeon is an invasive species," the director jokes. "You can't control him. You just have to let him adapt."

But as rehearsals blur into something far more intimate, Jae-hwan begins to wonder who's really changing whom... The performance, it turns out, isn't just on camera.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Off Course, Into You
synopsis:
After leaving the city behind, Jeongwon returns to his seaside hometown of Samcheonpo. There, he meets Dojin, a runaway college student with a bad first impression and nowhere to go. When Dojin ends up staying at Jeongwon's house under the pretense of teaching him to swim, the two begin an unexpected cohabitation by the sea. As summer unfolds, their awkward start slowly turns into something tender—like the calm waves that bring them closer each day.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Mukashi Mukashi no Warui Majo
title_japanese: むかしむかしのわるい魔女
synopsis:
Once upon a time, in a land far, far away, there was a small kingdom. However, a wicked witch suddenly appeared and the kingdom that was once beautiful grew ever poorer. After 300 years of living in terror of the witch, the king decided to capture the witch. This task was given to one peasant boy, Len...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: My Sweet Enemy, Thy Name Is Husband
title_english: My Sweet Enemy, Thy Name Is Husband
synopsis:
My husband, my nemesis. Till death do us part.

Canach Riadon—a slave who rose to emperor and the man I wed in my first life. Yet our ill-fated marriage left my family murdered and my homeland destroyed at his hands. Now given a second chance, I vow to succeed in this political marriage and save all I love... Or will his love save me first?

(Source: Manta)

title: Unauthorized Access
synopsis:
Hyejun, a feisty female bodyguard, is hired by the young Jaehyun, but when she walks into his house, it's full of... more guards. But instead of protecting him, they're keeping him there. To hide her true identity as his personal guard, she goes undercover by pretending to be his girlfriend. One day, their undeniable attraction pulls them together to share a kiss. Now, as the lie seeps into their reality, having a strictly professional relationship is becoming less of an option.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The End of the World
synopsis:
Eesuh Yoon appears to have it all: beauty, intelligence, privilege, and a great career. Men are captivated by her, but none can truly capture her heart. Her future seems predestined—settle down with a suitable partner and live a life of luxury. Enter Taejoh Ryu, a wealthy and arrogant man determined to "humble her." However, their passionate encounter leaves Eesuh feeling distant and uninterested while Taejoh finds himself falling for the woman he once called a "doormat."

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Tanaka-san wa Gyutto shitai dake
title_japanese: 田中さんはぎゅっとしたいだけ
synopsis: Tanaka-san keeps breaking school equipment, so what's her senpai, the student council president, to do in response...?

title: Zero to Hyaku
synopsis:
Rei Shizuka, a first-year high school student, isn't gifted with height or strength, but he possesses a two-handed shooting style more precise than anyone else's. However, in boys' basketball, where such a weapon doesn't shine, he faces constant rejection. Will his unique skill ever reach anyone—or anything? Just as he begins to lose confidence, his fate changes with the arrival of Haku Misaka, a transfer student from America with a street-style background! Stay true to your own style! With Rei's two-handed shot and Haku's street moves, an unstoppable miracle is about to unfold. A super COOL youth basketball story begins!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Tadaima, Ojamasaremasu!
title_japanese: ただいま、おじゃまされます!
synopsis:
So is this what it means to have roommates now?! Office worker Rinko, 24, lives alone and is secretly an otaku. One day, her apartment gets connected to the two neighboring rooms through a "hole" in the wall. In the room on the left is a fresh-faced yet mysterious guy who is overly-sweet to Rinko. The room on the right is occupied by a guy with violent tendencies who is similarly mysterious... But wait! "I... I think I know him!" Rinko's only source of solitude, her apartment, has been turned upside down. Now, every day is full of heart-pounding surprises!

(Source: NTT Solmare)

title: Gozen 2-ji wa Shokutaku de
title_english: Two A.M. at the Dining Table
synopsis:
The dining table is heaped full everyday, even though Maria's mother is supposed to be dead... One day, a girl as cute as a doll appears before Maria, a gal haunted by her own mother's ghost.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Inazuma Eleven: Eiyuu-tachi no Victory Road
title_japanese: イナズマイレブン 英雄たちのヴィクトリーロード
synopsis:
"I hate soccer..."  Unmei Sasanami transfers to Nagumohara Junior High School in Kyushu, a school with no soccer club, because he doesn't want to watch soccer. However, an encounter there sends a bolt of lightning through Unmei's heart! It's Joji Sakurazaki, a man feared by those around him for his overwhelming strength. After seeing Sakurazaki's kicking power, Unmei invites Sakurazaki to join him, and plots to start a soccer club at Nagumohara Junior High...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Yamashisa no Netsu ni Dakarete
title_english: Enveloped by the Fever of Guilt
title_japanese: やましさの熱に抱かれて
synopsis:
Tougo, the top sales rep for a pharmaceutical company, has been stationed overseas in Germany for two years. Before returning to Tokyo, he visits a Christmas market to enjoy the scene.

In the holiday streetscape, he meets Okumura, a particularly eye-catching Japanese man carrying a giant stuffed animal. Mesmerized by his perfect face, Tougo reaches out to talk to him, and they make plans to meet again the next day. With his heart racing, he heads to their date. He is swept off his feet by Okumura's aggressive advances, giving over both body and mind in a night of passion.

Irresistibly drawn to each other, the two decide to spend time together as a "limited-time couple" until he has to return to Japan.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Shameless
synopsis:
Emperor Yi Yeon is famous throughout the kingdom of Hochang for his outstanding political prowess and ruthless attitude toward sycophants. After relentlessly bullying his palace cleaners into fainting on the job, junior eunuch Yoo Yak-woo is called upon to fulfill the cleaning duties, which he enjoys to the point of being nicknames Sogwija, aka "the cleaning demon." Immediately, this young, fresh-faced eunuch and his delectably juicy buttocks catch the emperor's eye. One night, Yi yeon calls Yoo Yak-woo to his room for a very "special" cleaning service and the shenanigans begin to unfold...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Healer
synopsis:
Yoon Dansae is a "healer" whose addictive voice heals souls but also drives people mad. Jang Sejin, who also loves to sing, grows resentful when his brother favors Dansae over him. Jang Kiha, seeking a true healer, mistakenly kidnaps Sejin instead of Dansae. Out of spite, Sejin betrays his friend, and both are turned into castratos, forced to sing for the elite. As Sejin's mental health crumbles, he's drawn to Cha Leesuk, a client who desires only Dansae's voice. But will he ever notice Sejin?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Bishuu Abekobe Iekai de Busaiku Outaishi to Kekkon shitai!
title_english: Miss Blossom's Backward Beauty Standards: Give Me the Ugly Crown Prince!
title_japanese: 美醜あべこべ異世界で不細工王太子と結婚したい!
synopsis:
While battling a deadly illness, Cocolette Blossom suddenly recalls her past life—a lonely existence spent fantasizing about her handsome 2D faves. Determined to finally live out her romantic dreams, she resolves to marry a real-life hottie this time around. But in her new world, "hotties" don't exactly meet her expectations. In fact, they look like absolute monsters—and the guys who actually catch her eye? They're considered hideous and total social outcasts! Undeterred, Cocolette sets out to snag her ideal man in Crown Prince Raphael. Yet even though they both fall for each other at first sight, the "hideous" Prince Raphael is weighed down by a dark past and cripplingly low self-esteem. With wedding bells still ringing, can Cocolette boost her prince charming's confidence enough to prove her love is real?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Yarinaoshi Reijou wa Ryuutei Heika wo Kouryakuchuu: Platy Tairiku Seishi
title_english: The Do-Over Damsel Conquers the Dragon Emperor: The Official History of the Continent of Platy
title_japanese: やり直し令嬢は竜帝陛下を攻略中 プラティ大陸正史
synopsis:
These are the darker stories about the continent of Platy, divided into the Rave Empire and the Kratos Kingdom, where there is no do-over and no Dragon Consort who loves Hadis. As various issues smolder beneath the surface of the two nations, tensions are high, and Hadis claims the throne as the Dragon Emperor. His only pillar of support is the Dragon God, invisible to the rest of the world. As the unfortunate history of the nations is unraveled and the secrets of his birth are revealed, countless betrayals and misunderstandings lead him to choose one route—purging everything within his sight.

What thoughts and hopes ran through the emperor's mind as Jill's family, friends, and Hadis's siblings were all sent to their miserable deaths?! Explore the true history of the world if Jill had never become the Dragon Consort and set the emperor straight.

"Kill everyone. Don't let a single soul escape."

Join Hadis in bringing about the end of the world...

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

title: Saikyou Ranking ga Aru Isekai ni Seito-tachi to Shuudan Teni shita Koukou Kyoushi no ore, Mob kara Ken Hijiri e to Nariagaru
title_japanese: 最強ランキングがある異世界に生徒たちと集団転移した高校教師の俺、モブから剣聖へと成り上がる
synopsis:
High school teacher Shigeto Kusunoki is transported along with his students to another world where everyone is placed on a "Divine Ranking". While his students gain overpowered abilities, Shigeto's meager skills land him at the very bottom, completely flipping their usual power dynamic! Thus, with nothing but a single sword, he begins his journey from the bottom as an unassuming schoolteacher to an unrivalled swordmaster!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Oshi no Imouto ni Tensei shiteshimatta node, Saikyou no Akujo ni Natte Oniisama wo Dokusen suru Koto ni Itashimasu
title_japanese: 推しの妹に転生してしまったので、最凶の悪女になってお兄様を独占することにいたします
synopsis:
Amamiya Nagisa was very much in love with the evil duke Noin, a character from her favorite light novel. On the verge of her death, what awaited her on the other side wasn't oblivion, but being reincarnated into Noin's younger sister Frau!

They might not be related by blood, but in the world of the novel, love between siblings is horribly taboo. Unable to bear the thought of anyone else having her beloved Noin, she will become the villainess Frau, tear down all his romance flags, and give them to him herself!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Futari Machiaruki
synopsis:
When Hinata, a female university student, starts living on her own after entering college, she finds herself in a city that's perfectly livable but dull and boring. Thinking she'll just spend the next four years of university here, she shrugs it off... until one day, she encounters Kage, a young man taking photos of seemingly ordinary spots around town.

Intrigued by Kage's actions, Hinata decides to go on a city-walking adventure with him! As they stroll together, the ordinary city she once found boring begins to reveal unexpected charm... and wonders! If you walk through a seemingly mundane town with the right person, the world bursts with fascinating colors!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: The Absolute Scholar
synopsis:
Cheon Taesan, the Scholar Specialist in Reforming Scoundrels. He gains renown by rehabilitating the most notorious ruffians in the Martial Arts World (Murim). Born with the Heavenly Martial Body, he faces a cruel fate where he must acquire the Seven Stars Primordial Qi just to extend his lifespan. As he interacts with the mysterious Ice Star Body, he draws closer to the hidden truths of the Martial Arts World.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: The Regressed Extra Becomes a Genius
synopsis:
I, a mere extra, have to protect the main character?!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: I Got Engaged to the Blind Duke
synopsis:
Reborn as a side character in a novel, Marin swears she'll avoid every major figure in the story. But when her family collapses overnight, she finds herself cast out onto the streets with nothing. "I need money—fast." Forced by circumstance, she accepts a six-month temporary position at the estate of the novel's blind male lead, Duke Gerald.

"How is life in the duke's manor?"
"Thanks to Your Grace's generosity, I'm living quite comfortably."
"You like living here? Then we should get engaged."

Marin freezes. How does enjoying life in the manor suddenly connect to an engagement?

"Congratulations. Now you can keep living in the place you like."
"By any chance... do I have the right to refuse?"

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: First Time for Everything
synopsis:
Katelyn Grint has spent her whole life pining for a man who's in love with her best friend. But a chance encounter with Terius Hert, the no-nonsense and infuriatingly attractive commander of her brother's order of knights, turns her world upside down. What was supposed to be a one-time mistake quickly becomes something much more complicated... and permanent. Katelyn is about to discover that not everyone is who they appear to be—and that some firsts lead to the most unexpected beginnings.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Crimson Ocean
synopsis:
Jake, who comes from a lower class, works as a minister after being discharged from the military. Meanwhile, while going alone to planet TA457 to conclude trade with the Thermo tribe, he crash-landed in an accident. 

"Can't we do it verbally, through conversation?" When Jake came to his senses, he found himself being assaulted mercilessly by an alien. Will Jake be able to adapt to life on planet TA457?

(Source: Ridi, translated)

title: Inchiki Seijo to Iwareta node, Kuni wo Dete Nonbiri Kurasou to Omoimasu
title_japanese: インチキ聖女と言われたので、国を出てのんびり暮らそうと思います
synopsis:
Frémea is the saint of the kingdom of Justitia, which only comes along once every hundred years. As the kingdom's saint, she has very little freedom, and in the company of her faithful knight, Roland, she heals the people of all the evils that afflicts them. One day, there is a rumor that Fréméa is an usurper. She is then banished from the kingdom. However, a new life full of freedom is now open to her, along with her protector Roland, who is the only one to believe in the young woman.

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

title: Mania
synopsis:
Former thug Choi Mun-hyeok will do anything to protect his younger siblings. When he's defeated in an underground fight club and sold in an auction to Seo Yeonjin, he reluctantly allows himself to be put on a leash for his family's sake. Yeon-jin, on the other hand, doesn't care much for family. In fact, he intends to cause a scandal that will outrage his billionaire father by embarking on a twisted, carnal affair with Mun-hyeok. All Mun-hyeok needs to do is serve Yeonjin well, in work and in bed. However, their passionate encounters might turn into something greater than they bargained for. After all, the line between passion and madness is a thin one...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Blossoms of the White Night
synopsis:
To secure an alliance between the northern kingdom of Leracal and the southern realm of Arnata, the countries' royal families agree to a political marriage. Tei, known across the frozen battlefields as the most fearsome warrior and monster hunter, volunteers himself as the kingdom's hostage, trading his life as a warrior for that of a bride. In Arnata, Tei finds not the hostility he anticipated but the calm, steady gaze of Shuraka, the young crown prince destined to become both his spouse and future Padisha of the empire. For Shuraka to claim the throne, however, he must survive an uprising that threatens the kingdom—once that forces him to draw the blood of his own brothers. Moved by the courage and gentle integrity of his betrothed, Tei pledges to protect him at any cost...and in the quiet hours of a white night, two hearts caught between loyalty and longing begin to bloom.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Tantei to Uranaishi
synopsis:
One day, private detective Kanako Udagawa receives a request from client Yuiko Shinonome to conduct surveillance on her fiancé. But when Detective Udagawa drops by the fortune-teller that the fiancé's been visiting on the sly, she encounters a boundlessly bubbly woman called Sakura! See the slapstick suspense unfold with this pair of polar opposites!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Poisoned Chalice: The Poisoned Princess
synopsis:
To take revenge on the husband who betrayed their nation, Adelaide returns from the brink of death. To get revenge on her husband, Adelaide decides to use her innocent brother-in-law, Cadis, and to let him go once her revenge is complete. After all, she was the poison he mistook for the Holy Grail.

"The only thing I'm afraid of... is being abandoned by you."

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Saijaku Kizoku ni Tensei shita node Akuyaku-tachi wo Atsumetemita
title_english: I Was Reincarnated as the Weakest Noble, So I Collected Some Villains.
title_japanese: 最弱貴族に転生したので悪役たちを集めてみた

title: A Homeless Vampire
synopsis:
After waking from a long slumber, the vampire Isle discovers his home has been taken, leaving him with nowhere to go. Taken in by Loan, he puts his extraordinary talent for identifying counterfeit wine to use, while slowly recovering fragments of a past he thought was lost. As his memories resurface and their unequal relationship deepens, desire, power, and fate begin to intertwine in ways neither of them expected.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Suki to Ittara, Kimi wa
synopsis:
Tomoyuki attends the wedding of Shintarou, a friend from high school he's secretly been in love with for years. On his way home, trying to drown the pain of heartbreak with too much alcohol, he stops by a park where he meets a mysterious handsome man named Haru. Haru, who says someone canceled on him at the last minute, suddenly asks, "Go on a date with me..."

(Source: Dogenzaka Shobo, translated)

title: What's Happening in Lindel?
synopsis:
Claudia, the successor of a priestly family, is framed by her half-brother and relegated to a remote territory. Adjacent to the land of the dead, the territory is full of undead and vampires, earning it the name "The Tomb of Priests." It is a place of arduous labor—Lindel Abbey!

"I have to live in this abandoned house for three years?!"

What awaits her is a shabby monastery! A colleague sees her divine power as a way to make money! An assassination attempt whose culprit is unknown! Also, "Karel, you know what? People see you and call you my dog." Eight years ago, while awakening as an immortal being, Karel met Claudia. Karel learns that someone is trying to kill Claudia, so to protect her, he rushes to Lindel... With the appearance of Claudia, the quiet Lindel is thrown into chaos. What else will happen today in Lindel, which is full of eccentrics?!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Hands Up!
synopsis:
Seven stories. Seven sparks. One crime each time. 

From pickpocketing to voyeurism, the boys in this BL omnibus break more than just laws. A smooth-talking scammer, an obsessive stalker, and a shameless cyberbully drag the objects of their desires into a world where danger fuels lust and every dirty secret is a turn-on. When one crosses the line, the other's already hungry for more. These stories prove that the hottest crimes are the ones you don't get caught for. After all, bad boys are irresistible.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Yuritra Jump: Ultra Jump Yuri Anthology
title_japanese: ユリトラジャンプ～ウルトラジャンプ百合アンソロジー～
authors: Hayashiya, Shizuru|Dowman, Sayman|Aoki, Juntarou|Dokuta, Pepako|Utsurogi, Angu|Fujisaki, Yuu|Fujichika, Koume|Fumio, Aya|Yuu|2C=Galore|Mirai, Denki|Ookita, Mahiro|Akitsuki, Itsuki|Fukumaaya|Emoto, Haru|U-temo|Kohara, Omi|Tokomichi|Miura, Cozumi|Yasuda, Kousuke|Shina, Yoshinao|Chino, Machico|Tsutsui|Kinoue, Seiichi|Goumoto|Yukio, Yuki|Otaki|Utatane, Yuu|Kaneko, Aru|Marukawa|Indo, Curry|Amazaki, Suika
synopsis: Ultra Jump's yuri comic anthology.

title: Alpha, Disqualified
synopsis:
In a society where only alphas and omegas matter, beta Kim Minjun has spent his life being overlooked. Everything changes when elite alpha Bae Yuri, desperate to escape his role, asks Minjun to act as his stand-in. What begins as a simple business arrangement slowly turns intoxicating, as Minjun discovers how it feels to be the one giving orders and Yuri finds himself responding like the omega he always wished he could be. In a world with such strict social hierarchies, can they resist the pull of a desire that breaks every rule?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Bloom in the Shadows
synopsis:
In the hidden slums of Hong Kong, two rival powers dominate the underworld: The Grove Syndicate and The Lotus Syndicate. Their relentless territorial clashes plunge the city into chaos.

Song Ran, the underboss of The Grove Syndicate, is captured by members of The Lotus Syndicate but escapes, only to collapse in front of a modest flower shop. There he encounters Ja Woonyoung, the shop's refined and gentle-looking owner whose presence feels strikingly out of place amid the shadows of the slums.

What begins as a chance encounter soon grows into a dangerous entanglement. As the war between The Grove Syndicate and The Lotus Syndicate escalates beyond control, Song Ran becomes haunted by vivid, feverish dreams of fierce intimacy with Woonyoung. Drawn to him yet disturbed by the menace behind his beauty, he finds himself unable to resist.

Beneath Woonyoung's graceful smile lies a chilling gaze that conceals his true nature. Caught between desire and suspicion, Song Ran must uncover the sec

title: In My Bad
synopsis:
Actor Gyeong Wuhyeon is a devoted fan of painter Do Han-ah. When a treasured piece of Han-ah's artwork is stolen from him, Wuhyeon is devastated, but fate steps in when he unexpectedly runs into Han-ah again at a charity event. To his surprise, Han-ah doesn't remember him at all, and a small misunderstanding quickly snowballs into the two of them falling into bed. Determined not to let the moment slip away, Wuhyeon sets out to show Han-ah just how much he truly values his work. As Han-ah slowly begins to open up, he finds himself drawn to Wuhyeon... yet every now and then, he catches a cool, unreadable side to Wuhyeon that he just can't figure out.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Aloof Rose Gardener
synopsis:
Sung Hagyeom is a rich, spoiled omega who aimlessly cruises through life, leaving chaos in his wake with his carefree behavior. But when a scandal complicates everything, his father forces him to live in the countryside with Doh Dohoon, a humble, beta gardener who owes him a favor. At first, Hagyeom is bored out of his mind, but then he catches a glimpse of Dohoon's naked, muscular body, and the boredom vanishes. Will Hagyeom's wily charms win Dohoon over, or will Dohoon's rose garden heal the unruly Hagyeom?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Go Deok-Chun's Food Truck
synopsis:
Jun-ho inherits his late Uncle Deok-chun's food truck. He travels the country, cooking to make the name Go Deok-chun known nationwide. Starting with Se-hee, the heir to a conglomerate, Jun-ho gets involved with women who each have their own stories in every region he visits! They all fall for him, but the one thing that truly captures Jun-ho's heart... is cooking! Follow the irresistible Jun-ho on his nationwide romantic food truck journey-business, let's begin!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Guild no Zatsuyougakari ga Shin no Kuromaku deshita: Kakureta Sainou de Anyaku Musou
title_japanese: ギルドの雑用係が真の黒幕でした～隠れた才能で暗躍無双～
synopsis:
Branded a criminal and abandoned by the gods, Tennes—the unwanted child of a servant and a high noble—was cast out of his household. Now he lives as a humble handyman at a rural adventurer's guild... or so it would seem. In truth, Tennes is the mastermind behind a secret organization plotting to shatter the twisted rules that govern the world. Gifted with the unique skill "Hermit," granted only to those without a divine revelation, and supported by his most trusted allies, he begins a covert revolution. "Come, let's change the world... but let's make sure no one notices." From the shadows, the strongest secret society "God Eaters" sets its grand plan into motion!

(Source: Drecom, translated)

title: May the Congressman Protect You
synopsis:
A fantastic duo of a political master and a complete novice!

I'm Gu Yeongjin, a six-term congressman—the pinnacle of South Korea's political world, the nation's hope! One fateful day in 2008, betrayed by my closest aides, I faced a special investigation and chose to end my own life. When I opened my eyes... it was Seoul, 10 years in the past?! Now a ghost, no one can see me or hear my voice. No one... except one person, Cha Jaerim, a 25-year-old Level 9 civil servant.

No connections, no money, stuck in miserable circumstances... But look at that ambition, that fire in his eyes... I like it! Fine. I'll make him my partner.

"You need to go into politics."

And I'll get my revenge.

A political genius ghost, Gu Yeongjin, teams up with a clueless rookie, Cha Jaerim, for the ultimate combo in May the Congressman Protect You.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Dazzling Breath
synopsis:
In a world where only Guides can stabilize Espers, Wonwoo, a soldier and Purifier, is swept into a parallel world through a mysterious fog, where he faces his dying self and gets a second chance at life. As he starts anew, he encounters the ruler of the North, Yoon, who seems strangely familiar...

(Source: Manta)

title: Mind the Gap
synopsis:
He cherishes Nathan, who comforts him regardless of his personality, but coldly pushes him away to protect him from a certain incident.

Nine years later, Alex reunites with Nathan as a witness in an assigned case... 

Alex tries to offer a belated apology, but Nathan firmly draws the line. Meanwhile, Alex suffers hormonal imbalances due to the side effects of the inhibitors, and Nathan catches him.

Despite his cold demeanor, Nathan offers to help. Their relationship, which began without emotion, begins to falter again.

(Source: Ridi, translated)

title: Yagate Efude wo Utsuroshi Kimi wa
title_english: Soon, You'll Try a New Brush.
title_japanese: やがて絵筆を映ろし君は
synopsis:
Airi Aikawa, who makes a living as a manga artist, has a much younger childhood friend named Hinaki, who was a former student in her art class. When Hinaki was about to give up on entering University of the Arts for certain reasons, Airi bravely proposes that they live together. However... Airi harbors a certain secret that she is hiding, not only from everyone around her, but also from Hinaki...!?

A manga artist × art student age-gap childhood-friend cohabitation comedy ♥.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Televi Magazine-ban Kamen Rider V3
title_japanese: テレビマガジン版 仮面ライダーV3
synopsis:
Shiro Kazami shared the victory with Takeshi Hongo at the Japan Motocross Championship. However, at that time, a small hydrogen bomb exploded in the western part of Tokyo, and many people, including Kazami's parents, lost their lives. In order to avenge his father and mother, Kazami burns with anger and confronts the monster Scissor Jaguar, but he is defeated in return. Kazami, who was seriously injured on the verge of death, was saved by Rider 2, who had disguised himself as a Gel Shocker combatant.

(Source: Ishimori Shotaro Pro, translated)

title: Let's Volleyball!
synopsis: Included one-shots: Aru Volley-bu no Mubou na Kake, Rikutsu ja Nai no

title: The Villain's Daughter-in-Law Rules by Nature
title_english: The Villain's Daughter-in-Law Rules by Nature
synopsis:
After six short, measly lives as insignificant items of a novel, Florine finally wakes up in the body of a shapeshifter. The problem? She's a tiny sable without enough power to turn into a human. While spending her days as a servant, she crosses paths with Kiraxus, the original novel's villain. She thinks her short life as a shapeshifter is over, but instead, he makes her the daughter-in-law of his family! Will Florine finally live the long life she desires? Or is it all too good to be true?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Her Majesty's Night
synopsis:
Aranhrod assumes the throne as the 17th ruler of the Laincaster Empire through the sole support of Grand Duke Roark, her most loyal and dedicated servant. Yet his devotion is met with her cold indifference, which he accepts with grace—that is, until night falls, and he has her begging for mercy.

(Source: Manta)

title: Alpha, Omega, Alpha
synopsis:
After being kidnapped, Class A Omega Yeonseo is rescued by Kangwoon Joo, a Class A Alpha and CEO of Cheonsang Group. However, she's also attracted the interest of another Class A Alpha, Shinwoo Lee. Now caught between the two Alphas of the Cheonsang Group, what fate awaits Yeonseo?

(Source: Manta)

title: Shigoku no Otoko: Mou Ichido Aisareru Yoru
title_japanese: 至極の男～もう一度愛される夜
synopsis:
What melts Yuka's heart, which was damaged by her husband's affair, is a "perfect man" who lives on the top floor of a luxury townhouse...? In this glittering world, Yuka slowly remembers the pleasure of being loved.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Tochigamisama no Sono Higurashi
title_japanese: 土地神様のその日暮らし
synopsis:
As a priest (healer) of the Hero's Party, Kousei Kiyogami helped defeat the Demon King. But when he finally returns to his original world, 22 years have passed.
