Having grown far too powerful in the other world, Kousei's divine energy is no longer human in scale, and the local onmyoji begin treating him as a living god.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Yumeotica
synopsis: The never-ending dream of a young girl.

title: Shizen wo Mamore! Pokemon Ranger
title_japanese: 自然を守れ! ポケモンレンジャー

title: Ganso Uchuu Kazoku Carlvinson
title_japanese: 元祖宇宙家族カールビンソン

title: Pawprints on Her Heart
title_japanese: 악녀 언니를 구하러 온 용감한 강아지입니다
synopsis:
When Coco dies after five happy years with her owner Chloe, she thinks her tail-wagging days are over. But Coco can't bear to stay in the afterlife as she watches Chloe's world crumble. Taking pity on her, the Puppy God grants Coco's wish to return. Now, she's a human child who gets adopted into Chloe's family. Unfortunately, she discovers that reaching Chloe's heart is harder than any trick she's ever learned. Can she fetch the joy Chloe has lost, or has their bond slipped away like a leash?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Motokano
synopsis:
A year ago, Katsuhiko Matsuyama's girlfriend Arumi quietly disappeared from his life. However, she suddenly returns to his home and creates a bizarre and erotic love triangle between him and his current girlfriend Yukino. But which one will he choose in the end?!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

Included one-shot:
Volume 2: Gekkouyoku

title: She's the Duke
synopsis:
As if reincarnating into a whole new world wasn't enough, Lewin was reborn to a father so bent on having a male heir that he used dark magic to disguise her as a boy. Over 20 years later, she finds an unexpected ally in a freshly-transmigrated fellow Korean girl. However, this new friend delivers shocking news: they're in a tragic BL novel in which a love triangle will ultimately lead to the apocalypse! Still, if Lewin can seduce the male lead first, they may just manage to save the world...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Yugami no Toriko
synopsis:
Tanaka, a delinquent feared by everyone around him and known as the "ferocious dog," spends his days constantly getting into fights. One day, however, a plain, unremarkable girl with glasses suddenly appears...! At first, Tanaka is irritated by her words and actions, as she shows absolutely no fear of him, but then he finds himself thinking: "Her twisted expression is so cute." Little by little, he becomes captivated by her unique aura and by feelings he has never experienced before. Thus begins a distorted and unconventional love story between a pure, glasses-wearing girl and a fierce delinquent.

(Source: MU)

title: Akinai Ningyo to Sora no Hatsukoi
title_japanese: 商い人魚と蒼空の初恋
synopsis:
Sara, a mermaid living in the modern world, has been dealing with yokai and humans alike as a "Trader." To her, humans are merely clients—trusting them with her heart was never an option...

One day, a mysterious young man named Sora wanders into her miniature garden. He doesn't seem like an enemy, but there's clearly something unusual about him. Sara offers him a deal. However, the one thing Sora truly desires turns out to be none other than Sara herself...!?

A cohabitation romance filled with love and secrets begins—all starting from a single "deal"...

title: Undercover Wife
synopsis:
Beauty was her curse. What others envied and longed for only brought her misery. Scarred and weary, I-yeon decided to hide her crafted-by-god looks. In doing so, she gained a new identity, the ugly secretary, Yu I-yeon. She endured the mockery and lived quietly in the shadows until one day... "Let's live together." An Do-hyeon, the only heir of the powerful Wooseung Group, suddenly proposed to her. No one can ever discover their contract marriage or her true identity. Under the same roof begins a thrilling and breathtaking romance of secrets and deception.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Replica: Mototsuma no Fukushuu
title_japanese: レプリカ 元妻の復讐
synopsis:
Aoi grew up constantly being made fun of and bullied for her appearance. After going through one bad experience after the other in school, she finally gets to marry the man of her dreams who loves her for who she is. However, he too eventually seeks out someone better-looking and cheats on her, resulting in their divorce. Oddly enough though... the woman he cheated on Aoi with is the same girl who bullied her throughout their school years...! Now Aoi's on a mission to get revenge on the man who cheated on her who is now married to the woman who made her life miserable. She has her face reshaped, her name changed to Sumire, and slowly begins to find her way into their lives...

(Source: Coamix)

title: Reincarnated as the Grand Duke's Third Son
title_english: Reincarnated as the Grand Duke's Third Son
synopsis:
Born at the bottom of society, Jake survives by leading Sabertooth, a mercenary group loyal to him. Yet he is ultimately betrayed and killed by the nobles he served. But instead of death, he awakens to a new life with soft, frail hands and the title of the third son of House Valdek, the most powerful family in the empire, rivaling even the crown. Surrounded by wealth and splendor, Jake realizes he has been granted a second chance to fulfill his ambition. So he sets off, determined to rise as high as possible. Look out, world, here comes Lucian Valdek!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Taming the Master
synopsis:
Lee San, vice president of the conglomerate group Lee San. He was adopted by Chairman Lee, but unlike the chairman's real son Lee Tae-gon, he has won the trust of the chairman with his seriousness and sincerity. One day, Tae-gon, who was a haphazard and reckless man, suddenly says, "I want to learn how the company works," and begins to achieve unexpected results. Then, faced with the threat of losing everything he has built up, San finally makes up his mind. "I will tame this self-centered young master myself."

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Hands Up Me
synopsis:
I've had a crush on the cute pretty, and cool Dohoon for 20 years now. Dohoon's type is usually weird, middle-aged men, but that's alright. I'll be a middle aged man one day. Maybe then he'll notice me..

But this time, Dohoon's got a fling with an extremely unusual man. And, honestly, this person is just not acceptable at all! So that's how Yoo Seowoo's rescue of Gu Dohoon from the "Eyesore Project" started... No, it's more a plan to break them up. Will Seowoo be able to succeed in destroying their relationship?

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Safari Game
synopsis:
While looking at the famous Serengeti "The Three Colors" sunset at a bar, Ian, a former military soldier met Lucy, a man who looked familiar. Swept away by his charm, Ian invited Lucy into his room. He felt comfortable with Lucy's beautiful smile and gentle touch, but can he do it with a man that he just met three hours ago?

But... "Are you going to put it in me?"

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Friendly XX
synopsis:
Woohyeok discovers that his big brother Sinwoo, who he has a crush on, has had feelings for their father for a long time. After a fit of rage, Woohyeok seizes the opportunity to release his lust for Sinwoo...

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Hello Again!
synopsis:
Ever since he was young, HeeMin has always liked his neighbour, SeonWoo hyung. HeeMin had given up on SeonWoo after he had moved away. However, coincidentally, SeonWoo is searching for a roommate and HeeMin is able to meet him once again. But, the love rival that has appeared in front of HeeMin now is none other than his older brother, YooMin!

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Gyeongseong In-House
synopsis:
Do-eun, the leader of the loyalist party Chunaengdan, sets out to infiltrate the home of Seo Mun-taek—the enemy of the nation. To do so, he approaches his son, Jang-han...

"What? You believe in free love, regardless of gender?"

What will become of Do-eun's 100th romance?

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Kyuuyuu to Furin shitemita
synopsis:
Ayuna Aki is an office worker who has been married for ten years, enjoying a quiet life with her loving husband... until she receives a postcard inviting her to a class reunion. That night, Ayuna dreams of her ex-boyfriend Tonoda and the intimate experiences they once shared. Whether asleep or awake, Ayuna broods on her encounter with Tonoda, aching with desire.  As Ayuna wavers over whether to attend the reunion, she receives a message from Tomoka, an old school friend...

(Source: GOT, translated)

title: Have a Goodnight
synopsis:
"One more—Let's do it just one more time, please."

Junwoo who has a severe case of somnambulism, has been sleeping soundly lately. Ever since he started having wet dreams about the guy next door...! 

They've been doing all sorts of things every night in his dreams... But turns out they weren't all a dream...?!

"Sleep here for the night, Junwoo."

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Uchuu Keiji Gavan
synopsis:
An another story to the 1982 tokusatsu. Retsu Ichijoji, a.k.a. Space Sheriff Gavan, returns to Earth in 2004, a chaotic time where everyone has lost sight of justice. Gavan still holds onto his own justice however, and meets a police officer struggling to hold onto his.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Chiyu Mahou wa Tsukaenai to Tsuihou sareta noni, Nazeka Tayoraretemasu: Ore dake Tsukaeru Chiyu Mahou de Seijuu to Tomo ni Kizukeba Sekai Saikyou ni Natteita
title_japanese: 治癒魔法は使えないと追放されたのに、なぜか頼られてます～俺だけ使える治癒魔法で、聖獣と共に気づけば世界最強になっていた～

title: Hazure Skill "Mezamashi" de Tondemo Ryouchi Keiei: Zako Skill dato Iwareta kedo, Jitsu wa Nemutteiru Kamigami wo Okosu Saikyou Cheat deshita
title_japanese: 外れスキル【目覚まし】でとんでも領地経営～雑魚スキルだと言われたけど、実は眠っている神々を起こす最強チートでした～

title: Isekai Nonbiri Camp: Seijuu-tachi no Sumau Shima de Jiyuu Kimama ni Slow Life wo Ouka suru
title_japanese: 異世界のんびりキャンプ～聖獣たちの住まう島で自由気ままにスローライフを謳歌する～

title: Romantic ga Niawanai
title_japanese: ロマンチックが似合わない
synopsis:
Haruki, an Omega without pheromones, is captivated by the "scent of destiny" emanating from a used T-shirt. But the owner is Mochimaru, a gloomy Alpha who is far from his ideal.

Even so, Haruki's body can't help but react. While he feels awkward about crossing the line with him, Mochimaru doesn't hide his obsession. Rather, he makes it very clear. And what's more, he confesses that he's a "failed Alpha"...

(Source: Shu-Cream, translated)

title: Hanrou to Shoujo
synopsis:
A solitary werewolf picked up a human girl... The tale of a non-human who transcends species and decides to live for the sake of humanity.

(Source: Kobunsha, translated)

title: Crimson Reset
synopsis:
After half a year on the run, the vampire Eugene was ultimately killed, offered up as a sacrifice to boost a holy knight's fame. Just as his life ended in bitter regret, a chance to return came to him.

"I will never die like that again. If I've truly returned to the past, then I'll never regret anything a second time... no matter what it may take."

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Kindan no Bansan
synopsis:
In a world where human civilization has collapsed and fishfolk have proliferated, a single human girl has turned up. Posei of the fishfolk, who believes in the legend that consuming a human being grants one authority and power, intends to make a meal of the girl, but…

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Do M Senpai ga Seishori Iin ni Naru made
title_japanese: ドM先パイが性処理委員になるまで

title: Do You Want to Do It Here?
Onna Kanbu wo Kakumattara Dousei suru Koto ni Natta Hanashi
title_japanese: 女幹部を匿ったら同棲する事になった話
synopsis:
On his way home from work, Eita comes across a super villainess in a dumpster and decides to shelter her instead of turning her in. She's unused to kindness, but it isn't long before Eita's sincerity melts her evildoing heart.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Iiwake shitemo Yurusaremasen!
title_japanese: 言い訳しても許されません!

title: Watashi no Te ga Suki na Hito
title_japanese: わたしの手が好きなひと

title: Imigo toshite Suterareta Shoukanshi, Jitsu wa Sekai Saikyou
title_japanese: 忌み子として捨てられた召喚士、実は世界最強
synopsis:
A mysterious figure who commands spirits beyond comprehension... a summoner. Born with a skill loathed by the nobility, Rybert has grown up despised even by his own parents. No matter how hard he tries, his efforts are always ignored. The only person who has ever believed in him was his younger sister, Azria. But when his sister becomes the victim of a bandit attack, his parents blamed it on him and cast him away. Consumed by despair, Rybert collapses in the streets, where he is found and taken in by Sasha, a guild employee. No longer bound by his torment, his powers as a summoner start to awaken...

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Youth Blossoms
synopsis:
World War III has ended, but Jimin's troubles are only beginning. A superhuman bloomer, he's enslaved in a scrapyard, where his life changes after he finds and repairs Aurora, a discarded battle bot. Post-war exploitation of the weak and clashing factions has given rise to the Second Lost Generation. Even if they escape, they'll still have to grow up in the chaos. But can they outrun the Stalker Bot and the mercenaries hot on their trail?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Farewell
synopsis:
Haunted by her mother's life as a mistress, Minkyeong carries only bitterness toward her father. She builds a fragile peace away from him, until a stranger named Jinhyeok enters her world. With calm but forceful resolve, he declares that wherever she runs, he will always find her. What begins in fear slowly becomes a dangerous comfort. However, on the day she offers him a birthday gift, the fragile boundary between them collapses. What follows after is not happiness, but a love steeped in destruction.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Sheep Mask
synopsis:
After enduring a military experience of sexual harrassment due to his senior—Yoohyuk—he found Yoohyuk's carefree, happy appearance on the internet post-discharge. Now, fueled by a thirst of revenge, he sets out on a mission: to kidnap Yoohyuk and make him pay.

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Viper
synopsis:
White Tiger member Yoojoon infiltrated the faction to get the corruption books of Congressman Jang Seokjoon, whom he serves. Yoojoon, who successfully caught the eye of Viper boss Jaeha as planned, asked Jaeha to spare his life. 

"Then can you suck my dick?"

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Can a Gangster Leave the Gang?
synopsis:
Hyungwon, a member of the Viper Gang, decides to leave the gang and flee the country. He still has a long way to go, but in a weak moment, he ends up having a one-night stand with Sungjin... But who is really Sungjin?

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Santa
synopsis:
Suho and Chiwon, who go way back to the same nursery school, are members of the Doksa Gang.

One day, backed by CEO Kim, Suho opens a room salon. Because of that, while looking at such Suho, Chiwon sets a trap to undermine him.

"It's alright, Hyung. I'll kill you."

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: The Weight of Betrayal
synopsis:
Gong Seok-hyun is the boss of the Baekho Organization. Cha Moo-young was its executive and has been loyal to the group since childhood. He was also Seok-hyun's lover. But suddenly Moo-young betrays the group and moves to the Viper Faction. Seok-hyun thinks of finding him and killing him. But then changes his mind as he can't give up on his beloved Moo-young, so he secretly meets with him. As he deepens his relationship with him, he tries to find out the truth behind Moo-young's mysterious actions.

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Log in Paris
synopsis:
Vlogger Cha-yeon, desperate to reverse his dwindling NeoTube subscriber count, decides to spice things up with a daring new series: "Heart-Fluttering Paris Package." Arriving at his destination with grand dreams, he meets his assigned partner, Jo Han-gyul—a stereotypical engineering nerd, complete with thick glasses and a plaid shirt. Cha-yeon can’t hide his disappointment; this is not the charming co-star he had in mind.

But when Han-gyul bumps into a café employee and gets drenched in his drink, his glasses slip off—revealing a stunning face hidden beneath them. Stunned by his unexpected good looks, Cha-yeon seizes the opportunity and proposes a contract romance. Yet Han-gyul sees right through him: "Be honest. This is your first time doing something like this, isn’t it?"

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: New Antique Partner
synopsis:
Sick of his repetitive lifestyle, Gaeul decides to go on the trip he's been putting off due to his many fears. He arrives in Paris with an excited heart in anticipation of a new relationship, but Gaeul's partner doesn't show up. Tired of waiting, he goes to find his partner, but to make matters worse, he bumps into someone who takes Gaeul's precious handkerchief as garbage...?

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Woohyun's Coincidence
synopsis:
Insecure and timid, Sejun finally escapes the gaslighting of his former partner. Hoping to find courage abroad and meet someone better to build a healthy relationship with, he signs up for a package tour. But during the trip, he ends up being stood up by his partner and left all alone. While stopping by a convenience store just to grab a meal, Sejun unexpectedly meets Woo-hyun, a Frenchman of Korean descent. After hearing Sejun's story, Woo-hyun makes him an offer:

"Why don't you travel with me instead?"

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: That Moment Then
synopsis:
Minsung is the school's most popular dominant alpha. One day, he loses his inhibitor and cannot overcome his rut. With a faint conscience, he ends up having sex... But the person he has sex with is someone attending the same liberal arts class as him, Inseo. Minsung slowly begins to fall for Inseo's bright image. He thought his encounter with Inseo was naturally alpha-omega, but Inseo's a beta...?!

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Winter, That Year
synopsis:
Seokyeong is a novelist who has been crushing on a friend for a long time. Time passes, and his friend's son, Yunho (who really takes after his father) finds Seokyeong and announces something unexpected: they will now be living together! Whether or not Yunho is aware of how Seokyeong is pained by the way he thinks of his crush whenever he sees him, he naturally touches him in dizzying ways... Will this cohabitation really be okay?

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Predator
synopsis:
Kail Black, a soldier stationed at an Antarctic research base, is assigned to support investigations into unexplained supernatural phenomena. But one morning, he wakes to a nightmare. The base has been overrun by monstrous organisms, and everyone is gone except for one man, Revo Keypling, who calmly introduces himself as a researcher.

With no memory of what happened, Kail struggles to understand the disaster unfolding around them. But something even more disturbing begins to haunt him. Every night, he dreams of Revo, their bodies intertwined like wild animals, the visions so vivid that they leave him breathless when he wakes.

And in those dreams, Revo always whispers the same chilling line, "Right here, this is where our baby will be born."

Trapped in an isolated base, surrounded by impossible creatures, Kail begins to wonder which is more dangerous, the things lurking outside, or the man smiling beside him with secrets of his own.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: A Grand Ambition
synopsis:
Yoonsu, the owner of a tailor shop who dreams of dressing the world's most handsome men in perfect suits, meets Junho—a man who fits his ideal type to a T! Without hesitation, he shoots his shot: "Please be my model!"

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: In the Pharmacy
synopsis:
He saw his crush ♡♡ing...? Chan ends up seeing his crush Yeonho ♡♡ing his colleague in the pharmacy. Shocked, Chan wants to resign but then ends up going for drinks with Yeonho—and when he wakes up in the morning he's lying naked (?) in bed with Yeonho...?!

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Our First Day
synopsis:
"It'll be great if hyung can see me as an adult", worried Sehyun. There was no progress in the relationship with his seven-years older lover, Gyeongwoo. Following his sister's advice, though he made a plan to appeal maturely to Gyeongwoo, it had not worked out well... At last, can they spend a lovely first day together?

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: I Was Possessed by Your Ex-Boyfriend
synopsis:
On the first day at his new job, Jiwoong ends up falling in love at first sight with his immediate boss, Kim Sangha. He vigilantly looks for a chance to get closer to him, but is disappointed when he hears that Sangha is currently mourning his dead lover. Then one day, when Jiwoong is driving drunk Sangha home, he suddenly feels his body slipping away...? Goodness, how do you deal with the aftermath of having sex with someone while being possessed.

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Death Match!
synopsis:
Lee Chang-ju. 26 years old. I'm about to get crushed to death by a collapsed building, just before I graduate from college. The reason I'm like this now is because a junior I met in liberal arts asked me to go to an exhibition in this building with him, so I followed him. All my friends told me to avoid him because he looked like a murderer, but I didn't believe a single one. No, objectively speaking, he's damn handsome and has a cute personality. What makes him look like a murderer?

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: PET
synopsis:
"If you're coming, then just come. You missed me didn't you."

"Understood, 'Master'."

A florist and his regular customer... On the surface, they seem normal but they have a very special relationship...Restraints, handcuffs, toys, SM...

The florist is a master and the other is a dog who listens obediently...However, things take an interesting turn when their already unusual relationship grows into something more.

(Source: Ridi, translated)

title: B-Grade Guide
synopsis:
Lee Jaeha, a B-class guide, recently had a very messy breakup after dating an esper from the same center for three years. Despite that, he finds himself forced to still guide him, and he applies for a transfer to a high-risk area. Surrounded by all kinds of rumors and stares, all he wants is a quiet and peaceful work life in the new center! However, Jaeha takes on the task of guiding Do Jiyoon, an S-class esper, on the verge of a rampage, and Jaeha's work life is getting farther away from peaceful...!

(Source: Ridi, translated)

title: Mark
synopsis:
Minho, the loyal subordinate and right-hand man of Hyung-nim, would carry out whatever orders given to him even if he would have to die. He spends days hugging Hyung-nim and have violent sex whenever Hyung-nim call for it.

While Hyung-nim got into a political marriage, Minho feels guilty being involved in a sexual relationship with Hyung-nim. How long can their precarious relationship last?

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Afternoon Tea wa Ikaga desu ka? Watashi to Kanojo no Fujun de Ichizu na Futarigurashi
title_japanese: アフタヌーンティーはいかがですか? 私と先輩〈カノジョ〉の、不純で一途なふたり暮らし

title: Munou to Yobareta "Seirei Tarashi": Jitsu wa Inou de Seireikai dewa Densetsuteki Hero deshita @comic
title_japanese: 無能と呼ばれた『精霊たらし』～実は異能で、精霊界では伝説的ヒーローでした～＠COMIC
synopsis:
In the hero party, he was treated as an unreasonable piece of junk, but he's loved by the spirit princesses! Young man Univas who contributed the most to the defeat of the Demon King by the hero party, using his ability to bond with spirits called "Spirit Taming". However, he is expelled from the party by the hero Braveban and his group, who do not recognize his talent, and loses his job. Univas was in despair, but he meets his old acquaintance, the Wind Spirit Princess Tifon, in a fateful reunion at the "Spirit Wedding" ceremony where the hero and the spirit princess get married...?

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

title: Marika-chan no Koukando wa Bukkowareteiru
title_japanese: 茉莉花ちゃんの好感度はぶっ壊れている
synopsis:
Confessing to my childhood friend Marika was impossible for someone as unpopular as me. So, I did what any desperate boy would do—I wished upon a shooting star! When I woke up, that dream had come true?! I could see a love meter for people, just like in a love simulation game. Once I realized this was real and not a dream I went straight to see Marika. Her love meter was so low it had broken and practically fallen all the way to hell! If she hated me so much why was she so nice?! Is this how she really felt or...?!

(Source: WWWave)

title: Boku wa Oresama ni Narenai
title_japanese: ぼくはオレ様になれない
synopsis:
Yamada, the most popular guy in school, has a secret he can't tell anyone: he used to be an overweight bullying victim. After lots of hard work, he managed to reach his current position in life, but what happens when the most popular girl in school, Manyo, learns the truth?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Pokemon Card Game XY Yarouzee!
title_japanese: ポケモンカードゲームXY やろうぜ〜っ!

title: Plaything: The Grand Duke's Boytoy
synopsis:
Ilic has committed the perfect crime—or so he thought. After killing his boss's son in self-defense, Ilic is soon found out by none other than Grand Duke Sa-yan. The duke is gracious enough to allow Ilic to keep his secret...as long as Ilic expresses his gratitude by begging the duke to bed him. And if Ilic refuses, his life may be endangered by his boss's wrath. Now entirely at Sa-yan's mercy, Ilic is forced to embark on an affair that involves much more than he bargained for: acts of indecency, political intrigue, and maybe even love.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Non-Delicacy Kubo wa Real no Koi ga Shiritai
title_japanese: ノンデリ久保は現実〈 リアル 〉の恋が知りたい
synopsis:
Kubo-kun tries to learn about romance so he can write light novels, but he's the supremely indelicate type!?

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

title: Gal no Jitensha wo Naoshitara Natsukareta
title_english: When I Repaired a Gal’s Bicycle, She Became Attached to Me.
title_japanese: ギャルの自転車を直したら懐かれた
synopsis:
Kousei Kutsuzawa is an introverted boy with zero friends. One day, as he was walking home alone as always, he bumps into the class's most popular girl, a beautiful gal sought after by every boy.

After saving her from falling and repairing her bicycle, he plans to leave right away... but she looks at him with admiring eyes.

An introvert and a social butterfly, two people who were never supposed to cross paths. Awkward yet irresistibly drawn to each other, their youthful rom-com story begins.

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Soredewa Mou Oai shimasen You
title_japanese: それではもうお会いしませんよう
synopsis:
Nozomi Sendou wakes up... as a ghost at her own funeral? Nobody can see her, except a shady psychic who asks "Do you have any... regrets?"

(Source: MangaDex)

title: I'm Stuck on a Remote Island with the Male Leads
synopsis:
I'm stuck on a deserted island with the male leads in an R-19 novel. I possessed Margaret, the villainess destined to be killed by the male leads after tormenting the female lead. So to survive, I have to run away from the male leads...

"Marga... ret?"

The first male lead's hand grabbed my ankle as I was about to run away. From the very beginning, my plans were ruined.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: The Regressed Villainess's Vow of Chastity
synopsis:
Lydia Evanshi had everything a noblewoman could wish for: an illustrious marquis lineage, wealth that could sustain generations, and a beauty fit for a portrait. The only thing she lacked was good taste in men. She threw her whole heart, soul, liver, and gall into supporting a prince of low birth, even helping him achieve his dream of becoming emperor. And he repaid her by having an affair with her distant relative, Giselle.

So Lydia made a choice, she and Giselle would drink poison together and show them what true obsession looked like. But the plan failed, and Lydia was hauled off to a brutal, desolate labor camp. Not long after, a plague swept through the freezing compound. With her thin, pale hands trembling, Lydia quietly waited for death.

"Why had I lived so foolishly for a man? If I could go back, I'd slap myself hard enough to crack my own jaw."

...And then, her chance arrived. She woke up on the very afternoon she had slipped poison into Giselle's teacup, tea time itself! S

title: 30 made Hitori Dattara Issho ni Kurasou tte Itta yo ne?
title_japanese: 30まで独りだったら一緒に暮らそうって言ったよね?
synopsis:
I thought it was just a careless promise we made while drunk: "If we're both still single by 30, let's live together."

In the dead of night, just before her 30th birthday, the suspicious figure who showed up at Tsukiko's house was none other than Sora—the one she made that promise with. It's not exactly glamorous, but their cohabiting life in their thirties turns out to be surprisingly fun—a coming-of-age story at thirty♪

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Catch Up
synopsis:
Gangster Joogeon Kang, aka "Black Kite," gets more than he bargained for when he shows up at Jaejoon Min's clinic looking for a certain intimate surgery at his boss's request! Unable to resist this intimidating guy and his excellent manhood, Jaejoon gets himself into trouble after a few nights of bliss and has to get out of town fast. He's on the hunt for the father who abandoned his mother at her time of need. But Black Kite isn't going to let him get away that easily. Better watch out, Doc!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Full Moon Alchemist
synopsis:
By the king's order, Ennid, a genius alchemist, needs to develop a potion that shows one's future companion. While experimenting, he sees a man in the mirror and then a boy... The test has failed, or so he thinks. But, soon, he meets the boy and saves him from slave dealers.

Later, the man in the mirror appears in place of the boy and defeats assassins who follow the boy. Ennid can't take his eyes off the man named Glunn, who is wearing no clothes. "Wait a minute, is that huge thing between his legs...?!"

Can Ennid break the curse of Glunn, who may be his future companion?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Kanjou Knockout
synopsis:
Kaya grows tired of holding her own feelings back, living life constantly accommodating others. One day, by chance, she becomes friends with her classmate, Ichikawa—a girl who is as straightforward with her feelings as it gets. Things get shaken up when she has Kaya tag along for a round of boxing...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Shoushimin: Shunki Gentei Ichigo Tart Jiken
title_japanese: 〈小市民〉 春期限定いちごタルト事件
synopsis:
Kobato is a high school freshman who wants to live a normal life, not become a great detective. He tries to lead a quiet and modest school life with his like-minded friend, Osanai, but one mystery after another keeps coming his way. Even though he doesn't want to stand out, Kobato is compelled to solve mysteries. Will he ever find peace?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Cosplay de Off-Pako-chan
title_japanese: コスプレでオフパコちゃん

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Ginkai no Genei Gravure
title_english: Mobile Suit Gundam: Silver Phantom Gravure
title_japanese: 機動戦士ガンダム 銀灰の幻影 グラヴュール
synopsis:
U.C. 0096. As the conflict between the Earth Federation Forces and the Neo Zeon remnants, known as the Laplace Incident, draws to a close, a new mission is given to the unofficial mercenary unit Argent Keel, which undertakes missions for both the Federation and Zeon alike: the assassination of a high-ranking Federation official. It was by no means a major operation. However, this job shakes up the existence of Argent Keel, which has remained silent for a long time, and unearths the truth that has been hidden as an illusion.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Cat Therapy
synopsis:
Tiger shifter Yongwoo is an actor within the shifter world. At a filming set, he happens to rescue a black cat who'd been abused for being bad luck, and ends up bringing it home to raise it. He names the kitty 'Dodong,' and steadily grows attached to the cat, only to have it disappear without a trace when he wakes up from a nap one day. And with his wallet and valuables whisked off, no less! The media erupts with reports that accuse Yongwoo of abandoning his rescue pet. In order to quell the public outrage, Yongwoo offers to live along with Haedong, the very same cat shifter who'd pretended to be a cat and tricked him all along.

(Source: Ridi, translated)

title: Shabake
synopsis:
It is the Edo period. Ichitarou, the young master of Nagasakiya, one of the largest stores in Nihonbashi, has been in poor health since birth and is unable to go out. However, Ichitarou is always protected by demons such as Shirasawa and Inugami, who serve him. One night, Ichitarou goes out secretly and witnesses a murder. From that day on, bizarre murders begin to occur one after another in Edo... With the help of the demons, Ichitarou's search for the culprit begins!

(Source: Official site, translated)

title: Isekai Elf Mura no Omawarisan
title_english: Police Officer from Elf Village in Another World
title_japanese: 異世界エルフ村のおまわりさん

title: Kaban no Yuusha no Isekai Nonbiri Tabi: Jitsu wa "Kaban" wa Nandemo Kyuushuu Dekiru shi, Nihon kara Nandemo Toriyose ga Dekiru Cheat Buki deshita
title_japanese: カバンの勇者の異世界のんびり旅 ～実は「カバン」は何でも吸収できるし、日本から何でも取り寄せができるチート武器でした～
synopsis:
A high school boy named Keisuke Sakudaira is suddenly summoned to another world just before he enters high school, where he's told he must defeat the Demon King as a hero. However, the sacred weapon (Holy Armament) bestowed upon him is nothing more than his ordinary school bag...!? Soon after, Keisuke is labeled as a defective hero and is abandoned by the queen, his summoner, in the most dangerous dungeon filled with powerful monsters. It seems he is doomed to die... But then, the "useless weapon"—the school bag—is revealed to have amazing cheat abilities that will change everything! Thus begins the unbelievable journey of a hero traveling through another world armed with nothing but a single bag!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: When Love Calls Upon Me
synopsis:
Reborn with memories she never asked for, Song Jian wants nothing more than a quiet, ordinary life. But everything changes when she meets him again—the man she once loved beyond reason, and the one who shattered her. No matter how hard she tries to stay away, fate keeps pulling them together in ways she never expected. As her new life begins to mirror the tragic patterns of her past, she must face one question: can she rewrite her story this time, or is she doomed to repeat it?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: App
synopsis:
Aside from the guy's tastes in bed, Taesik doesn't know anything else about his current partner. Not his real name, his appearance, or even his voice. How long is that kind of relationship going to last?

(Source: MU)

title: Cigarette
synopsis:
Shin Jinwoo, who is being forced to quit smoking by his girlfriend, suddenly has a hoobae confess to him. How will a cigarette close the distance between the two?

(Source: MU)

title: Don't Stop, Sir!
synopsis:
Eunho is a younger guy who has been chasing after me since we were kids and making it impossible for me to date anyone. Working at my father's company, I finally thought I was free from him and his advances. But my father made him my secretary and now he's even more annoying! Constantly telling my father that I'm not working enough, that I'm drinking on the job... On that day his tattling got me kicked out from the house, I learned something new about Eunho. That guy...he's actually ridiculously big.

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: The Delicious Bakery's Part Timer
synopsis:
Nanwoo starts working part-time at a bakery run by his old friend Segeon, hoping to mend their awkward and distant relationship. One day, Nanwoo visits Segeon, who's bedridden due to rut, and in that moment, something unexpected happens—Nanwoo manifests as an omega for the first time. Overcome by instinct and tension, the two end up entangled in each other's arms...

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: I Raised a Tiger Cub
synopsis:
When Jiha was younger, he babysitted the next-door neighbor's kid, Choi Inho. Many years pass, and Jiha, now an office worker finds Choi Inho at his doorstep. Jiha finds himself suddenly impel into a situation where he has to live with Inho because of Inho's scam (?). Inho, who's had a crush on Jiha since he was younger, tries to seduce Jiha but fails repeatedly.

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: High School Salty Heart
synopsis:
Cha Geonwu spent years nursing a hopeless crush on his classmate Lee Taejun, ever since middle school, all the way into college. Tired of dragging around a first love that never went anywhere, he escaped into military service just to reset his heart. But the moment he's back on campus, destiny laughs in his face, as a required course throws him right back into Taejun's orbit. Soon, one run-in turns into another, and somehow Geonwu ends up trapped in a new cycle he never saw coming. One where Taejun isn't just the crush he tried to forget...but the person he's suddenly sharing a bed with.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Marionette
synopsis:
The story of Ilya, who lives purely for his lover Henrik, a genius in a steampunk world. Despite horrible nightmares, life goes on as usual until a stranger visits. As Henrik grows jealous and possessive, Ilya begins to grow a spine want to live for himself. Will he be able to follow his own heart?

(Source: MU)

title: What's Your Name?
synopsis:
"I have to know his name. It has to be today." 

A student volunteered to be a student guide and he aims for a perfect performance until one student ruined it by breaking all the school regulations when it comes to proper attire and conduct, moreover he never tells his student information and left the guide with a kiss?!

(Source: MU)

title: Welcome to the Intimate Night
synopsis:
Leo is left for dead after a robber stabs him with a knife and runs away. But, up until the very moment he passes out, he keeps a firm grasp on his desire to live. He wakes up in someone else's bed, and he finds out that he was saved by Owen Bentley, a popular celebrity. He also finds out that Owen is a vampire—and that he had to turn Leo into a vampire in order to save him! But Owen harbors another secret, one that he seems to hide desperately... What is this secret? How will Leo find out?

(Source: MU)

title: This Engagement Is a Scam!
synopsis:
"I want to date and marry a cute, lovable, and affectionate herbivore hybrid!"

At a beastman social gathering, Sun Yoo-jin discovers he already has an arranged fiancé. Furious, he goes out to cool off and ends up rescuing Ha-jun, who was being bullied. To his shock, his fiancé turns out to be Jun—the very same Ha-jun.

Yoo-jin, charmed by Jun's adorable appearance, is convinced they are destined for each other. But when Jun leaves to study in the U.S., Yoo-jin is surprised when a stranger shows up claiming to be Jun.

"You're Jun?! This engagement is a scam!"

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Re-Season
synopsis:
For some reason a collegian Maru needs a new place to stay and ends living with his friend's bro, a novelist Yohan who complains about his lately insomnia and asks Maru to help him fall asleep. Guess what happens next?

(Source: MU)

title: Senjitsu Yuusha kara Tasukete Itadaita Seiken desu ga
title_japanese: 先日勇者から助けて頂いた聖剣ですが

title: Dollhouse
synopsis:
Yoshie, who lost her daughter in an unexpected accident, encounters a certain doll at an antique market. She dotes on the doll as if it were her real daughter, and her emotional wounds gradually begin to heal. However, when the couple has a new daughter, the doll starts to unravel their family’s happiness.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Manatsu no Slow End
synopsis:
On a completely normal day, I received the news that my childhood friend, Mao, had died. Loud with a quick temper, he was the last person I would have expected to die. And yet, out of nowhere, he was gone.

On the usual way home yesterday, Mao was about to tell me something...but then he stopped. I didn't press, thinking I would meet him tomorrow anyway. But Mao's "tomorrow" would never come. As I prayed to speak to him again, suddenly, he appeared before me. Transcending life and death, Mao's time that had abruptly stopped starts to move once again.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Closet ni Ohoshi-sama
title_japanese: クローゼットにお星さま
synopsis:
When Sei is stressed, it manifests through a mark that spreads like petals across his neck. He spends his days hiding behind discreet glasses and a suit that covers his neck. He is in love with Abu, a designer working for one of his client companies. Unlike him, who hides his homosexuality, Abu is openly gay and seductive. One evening, while going to a bar to relieve his stress, he runs into Abu! Circumstances force him to reveal the cause of the bruise on his neck. "Shall we have sex to see if it makes it disappear?" At Abu's kind suggestion, a romantic relationship begins!

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

title: Your Ryan
synopsis:
In the quiet village of Feltham, Eloise Surbiton leads a peaceful life far from the hubbub of the city, tending to geese and secretly fawning over dashing war hero Lt. Col. Ryan Wilgrave from afar. When her father mentions that a certain military man named Ryan will be moving to the nearby town of Cambourne, Eloise is thrilled—only to have her hopes dashed when she meets her new neighbor Ryan Thornton, a gruff soldier who is the opposite of the Ryan Wilgrave she knows. Little does she realize, there may be more to Ryan than meets the eye...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Saijaku na Boku wa "Kabenuke Bug" de Nariagaru: Kabe wo Surinuketara, Shokai Clear Houshuu wo Mugen Kaishuu Dekimashita!
title_japanese: 最弱な僕は＜壁抜けバグ＞で成り上がる ～壁をすり抜けたら、初回クリア報酬を無限回収できました!～
synopsis:
The series follows Henri Cleats, an adventurer who only has a single skill: Evasion. Wanting to take care of his sickly younger sister Colette, he joins a party. However, due to weak attack power and lack of skills, he is expelled from this party. However, it turns out that his evasion skill comes with a bonus: he is able to pass through walls and reach the end of dungeons without defeating the boss. Thus, he is able to claim a dungeon's First Clear bonus more than once. With his newfound knowledge, Henri sets out to clear as many dungeons as he can while also leveling up his power.

(Source: Wikipedia)

title: It's Halloween, So We're Reversing!
synopsis:
Da-on, who was dissatisfied with his position, prepares a Halloween party for his lover Hyun-woo. 

"Reverse potion, werewolf cookie" Da-on bought some interesting items at a prop shop he happened to enter. After eating werewolf cookies, Da-on got dog ears. Huh? Something changed in Hyun-woo after taking the reverse potion!

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Akuyaku ga Ippai Detekuru Eroge no Kimodebu Akuyaku Kizoku ni Tensei shita. Yasete, Hametsu Kaihi shi Akuyaku-tachi ni Yoru Hanzai wo Mizen ni Fuseide Slow Life wo Mezasu
title_japanese: 悪役がいっぱい出てくるエロゲのキモデブ悪役貴族に転生した。痩せて、破滅回避し悪役達による犯罪を未然に防いでスローライフを目指す

title: Nannimo Umaku Ikanakattara Dou deshou
title_japanese: なんにもうまくいかなかったらどうしよう
synopsis:
It's a big day for our protagonist, Usagida. She gets on an early train, unable to suppress her worries that something might go wrong during her high school entrance exam. Trying to go over her notes just makes her anxiety worse... When she finally can't help but burst into tears, a certain someone calls out to her...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Between Coolness and Passion
synopsis:
It was a summer when even breathing was hard due to the heat. The air conditioner in An Kyungsoo's room was long broken. As a replacement, his landlord sent him a humanoid air conditioner that is all the rage overseas, taking form in a handsome male model.

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Mislove
synopsis:
Known for loving nothing but pretty faces, Kang Jiheon never imagined falling for someone he couldn't recognize. When he drunkenly confesses to an unknown junior, Jiheon insists it was a mistake, only to be undone by Kwon Jeonghae's sincere tears. What starts as a reluctant relationship soon blurs into something genuine.

Was it really just a misunderstanding... or the beginning of a love neither of them expected?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: I Can See the Title
synopsis:
She can see the titles of the female leads. In a world brimming with regressors, reincarnators, and transmigrators, May is none of them. She's just an ordinary native of a romance-fantasy novel. No past-life memories, no transmigrator missions, no reincarnator powers. A 100% pure extra. Yet May possesses one bizarre, unparalleled ability: she can see the titles of the novels the female leads come from. Not just brief titles, but massive, spoiler-filled ones that practically reveal the entire plot.

May has kept that ability hidden and lived quietly—until a romance-fantasy female lead named Seol Eun-chae possesses her beloved younger sister's body. Desperate to bring her sister back, May searches for a way, and learns a shocking truth from a chance encounter with a mysterious master. "There is only one way to drive out a transmigrator: steal the male lead she's destined for."

...Hold on. Seol Eun-chae's male lead is WHO? The tyrant with a 0.000001% romance success rate, Rihaim Elivton?

title: Un-holy Night
synopsis:
On Christmas Day, 14 years ago, Joonyoung and Eunhyuk became step brothers after their parents remarried. However, their parents soon passed away in a car accident and Eunhyuk became the only person Joonyoung could depend on. To Joonyoung, Eunhyuk was the perfect guardian as well as savior. But upon a certain incident, Eunhyuk's existence took on a different meaning to Joonyoung. That incident had Joonyoung leaving Eunhyuk's side as if he was running away, and now that 6 years have passed, he ends up reuniting with Eunhyuk at a hotel. As Eunhyuk, who had desperately looked for Joonyoung, finds and warmly hugs his little brother, his eyes show nothing but iciness unlike the warmth of his embrace...

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Campus Secret Girlfriend ♡
synopsis:
Returning student, Junseob lied to his underclassmen that he was dating Seryeong, the campus goddess. However, Seryeong's identity is that of a crossdresser, and instead of pretending to be his girlfriend, Seryeong demands a relationship.

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Shameless for You
synopsis:
Five years into their relationship, Gong Minjae and Yoon Jaehyun are still in love, but Jaehyun can no longer be satisfied by ordinary intimacy. When a reckless encounter sparks something new, Minjae draws him Jaehyun into bolder, more provocative experiences, as he discovers a pleasure that's impossible to resist.

As their desire intensifies, so does the thrill of crossing lines.

Is it wrong to want this much... or is love meant to be shameless?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Mirror, Mirror ♡
synopsis:
Jang Ho-yoon picks up a mirror on the street. When he is almost raped by a mysterious man who emerges from the mirror that night, he covers the mirror with a cloth in repulsion... But he feels that his luck has strangely improved since that night.

(Source: Ridi, translated)

title: Digimon Believers
title_japanese: デジモンビリーバーズ

title: Hochiya-san wa Amari Aru
title_japanese: 保知矢さんはあまりある
synopsis:
Norito Yonezawa is a low-energy high schooler with little interest in reality. He can't stop thinking about his classmate, Hochiya. She's the complete opposite of him, eating whenever and wherever she wants with no regard to those around her. Despite this, somehow, he just can't look away...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: The Strongest Manager in History
synopsis:
Twenty years have passed since monsters invaded Earth through dimensional gates, and hunters have been fighting them ever since. Choi Kang-jun, a former B-rank hunter, suddenly announces his retirement and takes on a new role as a manager supporting other hunters. This is the story of the most powerful manager in history—one who recruits promising hunters with his silver tongue, and occasionally even takes up arms himself to fight monsters!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Swimmer Boy
synopsis:
Have you ever pretended you were good at sports to impress your crush? Enter high school student Oh Haemin, who desperately wants to catch the attention of Jeong Ina, recently elected president of the school swimming club. Ina is recruiting, and despite barely knowing how to float, Haemin somehow ends up making her think that he's an expert at the sport. Before long, Haemin has to prove himself in the lane. Sink or swim, it's time to make a splash!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Itsuka Sora kara
synopsis:
Yuuki Nakagawa is a high school boy who enjoys a level of popularity at his school, and whose life is going swimmingly. On his seventeenth birthday, his father suddenly tells Yuuki that he is an alien. Yuuki doesn't believe it, until he awakens to a strange new power...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Hatori to Furuta no Hinichijou Sahanji
title_english: Hatori and Furuta's Extraordinarily Ordinary Life
title_japanese: 羽鳥と古田の非日常茶飯事
synopsis:
Hatori is an average teen boy with no passions in life. One day he meets Furuta, a girl with a keen eye for the extraordinary that's hiding in the streets where they live... Small wonders can change the world in this (extra)ordinary coming of age series!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Meitantei Conan: Kurogane no Submarine
title_english: Detective Conan the Movie: Black Iron Submarine
title_japanese: 名探偵コナン 黒鉄の魚影〈サブマリン〉
synopsis: Manga adaptation of the twenty-sixth Meitantei Conan movie.

title: Marcel
synopsis:
After his sister's sudden disappearance, Rowe is contacted by the police officer Mark. Giving little information about the situation, Mark says Rowe has to infiltrate Mother Earth (ME), a huge pharmaceutical company, to find the whereabouts of his sister.

Rowe soon begins working there as a bodyguard, working close to Chairman A, a beautiful and mysterious man. Even though the situation is dangerous, there is a strange attraction between them, so strong that will lead them to a physical relationship. The more they get involved, the more Rowe can investigate the connection between ME and his sister's disappearance, but his heart often wavers wanting to believe in A...

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Shabake Manga
authors: Takahashi, Rumiko|Mimori|Hagio, Moto|Iwaoka, Hisae|est em|Kumota, Haruko|Murakami, Takashi|Tsubana|Suzuki, Shiho|Yasuda, Hiroyuki|Sakura, Sawa|Ueno, Kentarou|Yoshikawa, Keito
synopsis: An anthology comic of Shabake by various mangaka.

title: Hoobae's Touch Is Healing
synopsis:
"Sunbae, what have you been up to these last few nights?"

Taeyoung, who is living with his hoobae (his buddy and junior), Junghoon, has a problem. He relieves himself while thinking of Junghoon every night, but cannot finish. 

But while they're drinking together, Junghoon offers to lend his hand...!

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Step-Lover
synopsis:
When Kwon Yi-soo's mom marries her long-term boyfriend, of course Yi-soo's happy for her. But is it too much to ask that his new stepbrother not be his ex-fuckbuddy who is ALSO his boss, Han Gangjin? Yi-soo is desperate to stop him from revealing their relationship to their parents, but Gangjin doesn't have the same qualms. He hadn't been happy about Yi-soo breaking things off, after all. So Gangjin offers him a deal: they resume seeing each other in exchange for their parents' blissful married life. But can that be all that Gangjin wants...?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Makoto no Koi wo Suru Mono wa
title_japanese: まことの恋をするものは
synopsis:
Nanase moves to Tokyo to attend university. She dreamed of a bright and exciting campus life, but she fails to make friends and finds herself completely alone. Then one day, she starts talking to Hiyama, a philosophy student she's been interested in for a while who attends the same lecture, and her world begins to shine...

It seems her fateful love must have begun right then...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Aldo no Isekai Tensei
synopsis:
A man who lost his family and fell into the depths of despair meets his end—only to be reborn in another world of swords and magic as Aldo, the heir of a noble family. He begins a new life alongside his twin brother Elphas and his loving parents. However, haunted by the fear of losing those he loves once again, Aldo starts to shut his heart off from his family. But when the roar of a ferocious magical beast threatens to devour them, the boy rises to his feet— determined this time to protect what he once lost in his previous life. A story of redemption and a second chance at heroism begins!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Kao ni Denai Kashiwada-san to Kao ni Deru Oota-kun+
title_english: Expressionless Face Girl and Emotional Face Boy+
title_japanese: 顔に出ない柏田さんと顔に出る太田君+

title: A Wimp's Tower Strategy Guide
synopsis:
Mysterious black towers have appeared all over the world. Inside them are monsters, danger, and the promise of power and fame. Only a select few are chosen to enter as players. Everyone calls it a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, but 25-year-old Bong Juhyeok calls it a death sentence. He is a timid, anxious self-proclaimed "wimp," perfectly content with staying under the radar... That is, until he is named as a player. Will he risk everything by entering the tower, or keep running from the one chance that could change his life?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: The Youngest Hides a Lot of Things
The Demon Emperor Hopes for a Hero
synopsis:
Betrayed and faced with death by the one he trusted, the Demon Emperor meets his end. Having always longed for death, he welcomes his final moments with a sense of peace. However, 66 years later, he awakens in an unfamiliar body. To his surprise, this body is referred to as a 'hero'? The Demon Emperor never meant to exist for the sake of peace! Eventually, he embarks on a journey once again, not to seek happiness, but to embrace death...

(Source: MU)

title: Osananajimi wo Mirume ga Kawatte Shimatta
title_japanese: 幼馴染を見る目が変わってしまった

title: Boku wa Ano Yoru Ano Ko to
synopsis:
Right after getting his heart broken, Nao Michigami attends the after-party of a friend's wedding. He drinks too much and wakes up in bed in a love hotel... He has no memory of the night before! In order to find out who he spent the night with, Nao meets up with each of the women he met at the after-party to find out "what happened"...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Zombie no Baka Yarou!!! Shouyu wo Kari ni Iku dake de Shinu Koto ga Aru Sekai no Chuukyuu Survival Guide
title_japanese: ゾンビのバカヤロー!!!〜醤油を借りにいくだけで死ぬことがある世界の中級サバイバルガイド〜
synopsis: A survival comedy depicting the daily lives of 3 girls barricaded together in their boardinghouse in a city full of zombies.

title: Koi wo Suru nara Hirefushite
title_japanese: 恋をするならひれ伏して
synopsis:
Ryouta Hayase, a competitive spirit from the countryside, and his colleague, Tokitou Issei, are neck and neck for the top spot at the company's headquarters. But how can they be considered rivals if Hayase hasn't even won once? On top of that, Tokitou is also the heir to the company, which makes Hayase's inferiority complex gnaw at him more.

On the day of their company's awarding rites, a drunken Hayase, who is being looked after by Tokitou, reveals that he is actually gay.

"Show me what you've got" a drunken invite unexpectedly ends with Tokitou being all sweet and devoted in bed...?

A high-spec company heir x an employee who hates to lose.

(Source: Shodensha, translated)

title: Kanata e Todoite Koi wa Saku
title_japanese: 彼方へ届いて恋は咲く
synopsis:
In order to achieve his dream student life, Kotarou, who used his high school entrance as a chance for an image change, is struggling in getting his innermost wish: a girlfriend!... At least, it was supposed to be like that, but having taken care of his childhood friend Kanata, in a split second, it turned to autumn already!?

In a hurry, just when Kotarou was about to leave for an arranged mixer, he encountered Kanata who lives next door, but why does Kotarou feel so guilty? In that state, Kotarou suddenly gets confessed to by Kanata: "If you fall in love, you should do it with me..."!?

(Source: East Press, translated)

title: Isekai Summoner, Shinwa no Kaibutsu-tachi to Gendai de Musou suru: Uragirareta Moto Eiyuu wa, Ai Omome na Nakama to Heiwa ni Kurashitai
title_japanese: 異世界サモナー、神話の怪物達と現代で無双する ～裏切られた元英雄は、愛重めな仲間と平和に暮らしたい～

title: Kingdom of Innocence
synopsis:
I opened my eyes underwater, then found myself in a dazzling palace straight out of a historical fantasy. There is no doubt about it, I have been isekai'd right into the world of a novel. And lucky for me, it is even the genre I loved the most, so I know all the rules. Or so I thought. Because in this world, instead of gaining power through intimate encounters, anyone who loses their virginity becomes cursed. Yes, cursed. In a supposed mature fantasy. How does that even make sense? While I am still trying to wrap my head around this ridiculous twist, I receive my main mission: help the story's second male lead achieve his destined romance. Avoid curses, dodge questionable situations, fix the love plot, survive the chaos, all with my purity intact. Can I possibly complete this mission without destroying the entire story, or myself, first?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Wonder Love wa Mayonaka ni
title_japanese: ワンダーラブは真夜中に
synopsis:
"Recently, I've been having the same nightmare every night."

Yashiro has been struggling with insomnia ever since starting his new job. The reason? His new boss, Isshiki, is an old classmate who once witnessed the most traumatic moment in his life. To cope with his sleepless nights, Yashiro turns to one-night stands whenever he can't sleep. But one night, when things take a turn for the worse, Isshiki unexpectedly comes to his rescue, and somehow, they end up sleeping beside each other?! That night, Isshiki appears in Yashiro's dream as Yashiro's favorite character, the demon lord, Toma. Unlike the real Isshiki, this dream version is sweet, tender, and showers him with affection. Surprisingly, Yashiro wakes up feeling strangely refreshed... Could this be the cure for his insomnia?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title: Oshi Couple ni Aisarete Kaishaku Chigai desu!!
title_english: My Ship Couple Adores Me, But They Got It All Wrong!
title_japanese: 推しカプに愛されて解釈違いです!!
synopsis:
Mio's a BL fanfic junkie AND the leader of an idol group called "TryTrick"... Put those two together and you might notice he's totally shipping the two other members of his group, Nagi and Akira! However, Mio always finds himself getting between the two of them during shows and they both seem to be coming onto him?! Fan service on stage has been getting crazier with touchy moments, hugs, kisses, and more...! Akira Nagi X Mio has been progressing relentlessly amongst the fandom!!!!!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title: Tsuihou sareta Fuguushoku "Irotsukai" ga Sekai Sekai wo Nurikaeru made: Bishoujo darake no S-Rank Party de Saikyou Skill wo Hontou no Tsukaikata wo Shiri Musou suru
title_english: How the Banished, Unpopular Profession "Color Master" Repainted the World
title_japanese: 追放された不遇職『色使い』が世界を塗り替えるまで ～美少女だらけのSランクパーティーで最強スキルの本当の使い方を知り無双する～

title: Kaze no Sakai, Tsubasa no Hate
synopsis:
In the small country of Eltfatel, humans and the deer people, who live longer than humans, live together and support each other. This is a story of small acts of courage, woven by the bungling second prince and his deer attendant.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kaze no Sakai, Tsubasa no Hate
Shitagari Delivery
synopsis:
1. Seifuku to Suit (Uniform & Suit)
2. Fudeoroshi Delivery (Cherry-Popping Delivery)
3. Anaume Pinch-Hitter (Please Fill In, Pinch-Hitter!)
4. Mesu Mama (Horny Mama)
5. Osake, Nomemasu ka? (Do You Drink Sake?)
6. Wakarase Title Match! (Wipe the Floor With Them Title Match!)
7. Yoridokoro (Foundation)
8. Ii Tabi, Ero Kibun (Good Trip, Erotic Mood)

title: Chocolate Border Line
title_japanese: チョコレートボーダーライン
synopsis: The story of two childhood friends who are dating but have missed the chance to kiss.

title: Keiyaku kara Hajimeru Boy Meets Girl: Oyakata, Sora kara Dark Elf no Onnanoko ga!
title_japanese: 契約から始めるボーイ・ミーツ・ガール～親方、空からダークエルフの女の子が!～
synopsis:
Claude, a miner with no relatives, rescues Shion, a dark elf girl who fell from the sky. The encounter would dramatically alter both their destinies!!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Pondroid! Hama-san
title_japanese: ぽんドロイド! はまさん
synopsis:
One day, an old man walking through town unexpectedly ends up buying a used android named “Hama-san” at a bargain price! However, despite being a military robot, she's a complete mess with tears in her eyes...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: .A: dot Alice
synopsis:
High school Second year Izumi is surrounded by girls that are a little peculiar: haughty rich girl Shinonome and gamer junior Akaishi. Even his childhood friend and a transfer student turn up out of nowhere. It is the early 2000s. A nostalgic, heartwarming romance that tickles your memories of "those days" begins now!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Subete wa Kanojo Shidai
title_japanese: すべてはカノジョしだい

title: Marchioness Maron
synopsis:
Once reviled as the wicked magician Hailey, the most hated woman in the realm, she was cast into a poisoned wasteland to die. But death never came. A year later, she's alive and farming, bickering with a tree fairy, and somehow the new Marchioness Maron. As secrets of the contamination zone begin to surface and the ghosts of her past return, Hailey must decide whether to seek vengeance or build something new from ruins. When survival itself becomes the greatest twist of fate, who needs revenge?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Talk Dirty to Me
synopsis:
Yeon-Hwa is careful about her appearance as a K-Pop idol. Everything is meticulously crafted to make her look innocent, gentle, and friendly. But where the cameras can't see, she's a dominating participant in her idol partner's masochistic fantasies. It's a strange relationship to be sure but, as long as they're topping the charts, Yeon-Hwa will go along with anything.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Swindler Couple of Ardel
synopsis:
The legendary con artist in the pleasure city of Ardel, Sue Rolanne, is hired by an aloof duke to pull off the ultimate grift: deceive the king. To infiltrate high society, the pair stage a sham marriage and what began as a "contract couple" turns into a high-stakes, kingdom-wide con.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: For Your Perfect Ending
synopsis:
After being killed by the obsessive male lead Killian, Ines finds herself back in the real world as Sum. Determined to live differently this time, Sum resolves to finally claim a happy ending. But to her shock, she meets Lee Haewon, a school celebrity who looks exactly like Killian. As Sum grows confused by Haewon's kindness—so unlike the arrogant and violent Killian she once knew—Haewon hides his true intentions, carefully shaping himself into someone Sum would love. What awaits them in the future?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: OXO
synopsis:
Kwon Suhyeon lives life one heat at a time. With no real plans and even fewer morals, this shameless omega uses his devilish charm to seduce rich alphas, then cashes out by "invoking his rights" under the Omega Protection Act. It's an easy, sleazy hustle. But when his newest "victim," Ryu Hyeon, reveals he's an omega too, Suhyeon's foolproof scam suddenly gets a lot more complicated.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Maryoku Kare no Dark Elf
title_english: The Journey of a Dark Elf with Fading Powers
title_japanese: 魔力枯れのダークエルフ
synopsis:
What she saw after losing her powers was the true beauty of the world... Amira, once hailed as the "omnipotent caster," has fully exhausted her magic force, making her just a regular dark elf. Once, she illuminated the world with her spells; now, she converses with the wind, kindles fire, leans how to cook, and searches for new meaning to her life. Quiet happiness and small miracles have taken the place of almighty magic in her life. What will she find in this second-life fantasy as she experiences rebirth after her loss?

(Source: Kodansha)

title: Netsuen
synopsis:
It's the last summer of high school for drama club best friends Yuki and Natsu. While everything's going well for Natsu, Yuki instead finds herself caught in mental turmoil... See the portrayal of one youthful summer in this fiery theater tale!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Jumping the Geon
synopsis:
From childhood, Sohm has always felt queasy and unsettled whenever he looks at Geon, a boy who is almost like him but somehow completely different. The two can never meet eyes without arguing, and when their parents remarry and they suddenly become family, strict rules are put in place to keep the peace. Rule One: Go to and from school together. Rule Two: Hug for thirty full seconds before entering the house. Forced into daily embraces, their unwanted closeness begins to change in ways neither expected. Geon's teasing eventually leads to something far more risky than bickering, and the two find themselves sharing more than they had ever intended...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: A Killer Love Story
synopsis:
Kwon Jihyeok, a good-for-nothing who's lived his whole life relying solely on the handsome face he inherited from his parents, finds himself kicked out of his girlfriend's house with nowhere else to go.

While wandering in search of his next place to freeload, he stumbles upon a mansion with its door left open and decides to sneak in. But inside, he's greeted by the horrifying sight of a dismembered corpse.

Sensing imminent doom, he tries to escape, only for the missing homeowner to appear right then and there. One look is all it takes for Jihyeok to realize it: this guy definitely has the face of a serial killer.

For someone who's always coasted through life on his looks, this is the biggest crisis he's ever faced. To survive, Jihyeok might have to pull his most desperate move yet, using his charm to seduce this psychopathic killer.

Because if he fails, it won't just be his pride that gets pierced.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Serpent's Den
synopsis:
Edwin Rocher and Leila Garwen grew up as childhood friends, but everything shifted the moment they became adults. When Edwin quietly asked, "Teach me how to touch myself," Leila gave in to the request, thinking it would end there. Instead, he became addicted to the filthy pleasure Edwin fed him, and Leila found himself unable to escape the boy he once thought he knew so well. One night, Leila stumbles upon a creature with green eyes soaking in Edwin’s bath...a monster wearing the face he trusted most. In that moment, he realized he never truly understood what Edwin is, or what he wants. Caught between fear, desire, and the monstrous truth, Leila enters a den of corruption where escape is impossible and surrender may be the only path left.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Eroge Utsu End kara Heroine-tachi wo Kyuusai shitara
title_japanese: エロゲの鬱エンドからヒロイン達を救済したら

title: Haburare Rune-tsukai no Isekai Boukentan
title_english: The Adventures of a Rune Master
title_japanese: ハブられルーン使いの異世界冒険譚

title: Haburare Rune-tsukai no Isekai Boukentan
title_english: The Adventures of a Rune Master
title_japanese: ハブられルーン使いの異世界冒険譚

title: Moriagaranai Date
title_japanese: 盛りあがらないデート
synopsis:
Haida, cursed with chronic bad luck, signs up for a dating app as part of her “what-the-heck” phase. She matches with Kuroi, a man who joined for equally reckless reasons. But their conversation never quite clicks, and an unmistakably low-key, awkward mood sets in. Everything they do backfires, resulting in a date that is astonishingly unexciting. Thinking there’s no way there’ll be a second date in an atmosphere like this… wait, what? Why are they making plans to meet again!?

A first date with someone you met on a dating app that just doesn’t take off? The deadpan, surreal banter is way too addictive! A slow-burn, gently unfolding romance that begins with a dating app.

(Source: COMICSMART, translated)

title: Laundry Cat
synopsis: Suddenly the laundry machine turns garments into cats.

title: Kakushite Mahoutsukai Neu Galene wa 100-nengo, Hanayome to Natta
title_english: And Thus, 100 Years Later, the Wizard Neu Galene Became a Bride.
title_japanese: かくして魔法使いノイ・ガレネーは100年後、花嫁となった

title: ATM Ojisan: Isekai de Moteki ga Tomaranai!
title_japanese: ATMおじさん 異世界でモテ期が止まらない!
synopsis:
Daichi Fumita, a middle-aged man being treated as an ATM by his wife, daughter, and even his subordinates at work, meets an untimely end. Reincarnated into another world, Daichi has been granted the "support" skill by the goddess, a skill only granted to those who have worked hard for others. However, due to the power of the buffs it confers, he is again treated as an ATM in the other world and flees. 

Daichi opens a pub in a distant land and finally achieves a stable life. Then one day, Meltina, a girl who is a regular at the pub, arrives in tatters, saying, "I'm going to be sold to a brothel." After hearing her plight, Daichi decides to use the "support" skill that he had sealed away for so long...!?

(Source: Kill Time Communication, translated)

title: The Archmage Becomes the Swordmaster's Youngest Daughter
title_english: The Archmage Becomes the Swordmaster's Youngest Daughter
synopsis:
Rosette was a mage and assassin who lived as a mere tool, mistaking control for love, until her choices led her to kill Duke Adrian, the Empire's legendary swordmaster. Haunted by regret, she uses ancient magic to send herself back in time and fix everything that went wrong. However, although she succeeds in returning to her childhood, she ends up being adopted by the very duke she murdered in her past life. Will Rosette's knowledge of both magic and the future be enough to rewrite a tragic destiny and change fate itself?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Saikai no Yuusha
synopsis:
The hero who saved the world sets out on a journey once more, to heal the hearts—and also the bodies—of the women he encountered along the way.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Mystery Science Detectives
synopsis:
Join the Mystery Science Detectives, an after-school club with a knack for solving the trickiest, eeriest mysteries around. While working each case, the team reveals the scientific knowledge at play, explaining elementary and middle-school science concepts in an engaging way. Can you solve the mysteries before the team does?

(Source: Lerner Publishing Group)

title: My Secret Business with My Boss
title_english: My Secret Business with My Boss
synopsis:
The man leading up Soyoung's new team at work not only has a handsome face but is clearing packing something sizable in his pants. She can't help but steal glances at the prominent outline until one day, gazing at her like prey caught in a trap, Taekyung asks, "Do you really like it that much?"

(Source: Manta)

title: The Cocky Brother Learns a Lesson
title_english: The Cocky Brother Learns a Lesson
synopsis:
Born into the prominent Lee family, Yeon has always enjoyed a privileged and comfortable life. However, his achievements and competence pale in comparison to his older adopted brother, Kangwoo. This disparity fuels Yeon's constant, barbed mockery toward him. While Kangwoo usually endures the insults in silence, Yeon finally pushes him too far with a particularly offensive remark. When Kangwoo unexpectedly extends an invitation to his bedroom, Yeon's sheer arrogance compels him to accept. What Yeon doesn't realize is that his big brother is about to deliver a very intense and unforgettable lesson.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Kawaretekita Hanayome
synopsis:
1. Hanayome Sengen
2. Osawari Genkin
3. Ojisama no Aijin
4. Hot Closet
5. Kawaretekita Hanayome
6. Kawaretekita Hanayome Bangai-hen: Pure Bride

title: Paper Flower
synopsis:
Yeon Yoo-young has been living with his father and sister in the castle of Yongsan in the countryside since his mother was unfairly accused of theft and beaten to death. Tortured and abuse by his family, the young man has become frail and thin, and deemed a mute due to his inability to speak properly. One day, he decides to jump off a coastal cliff and end his life, but instead encounters Crown Prince Jinbi Hyul and falls in love at first sight! Yeon Yoo-young regains his will to live, but his sister soon plots to win the prince's affection for herself. Jinbi Hyul, however, is known for his cruel disposition...

(Source: Ridi, translated)

title: The Blooming Violet in the Back Garden
title_english: The Blooming Violet in the Back Garden
synopsis:
Timid orphan Violet discovers she's the empire's new saint destined to destroy the evil Malum. Unfortunately, she's surrounded by scornful nobles and a power-hungry emperor and pope. Alone, friendless, and overwhelmed, she finds solace in Ethelmund, heir of House Ermengart, who vows to protect her until the end. Can this fragile wildflower find her footing in the thorny and dangerous world of politics and betrayal? And will she be able to fulfill her destiny with only Ethelmund by her side?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Blood Under the Moonlight
synopsis:
Jaegal Minhwan is only a child when he's ordered by his father to enter the Midnight Forest—a mysterious and equally terrifying place said to house a great master of the martial arts. Minhwan eventually meets the rumored master, who introduces himself as Beom Dan-ryeong. However, he finds that the mysterious man is nothing as Minhwan imagined. Dan-ryeong is a strong, benevolent, and kind teacher, providing Min-hwan with the warmth he had always longed for. Throughout their years together as master and disciple, Minhwan is certain that nothing will shake their bond. Until one fateful night on the full moon, when it is revealed that Dan-ryeong has an unsatiable appetite for nothing other than... his disciple's blood. Under the moonlight, the cloying scent of blood intertwines with unknown desires... and the line between master and disciple begins to blur.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: They Say I Was Born a King's Daughter
title_english: They Say I Was Born a King's Daughter
synopsis:
Royalty isn't all it's cracked up to be.

A murder victim is reborn, fully conscious of her past life, as a king's unwanted daughter in a new world where despite the end of all wars and advancement of science, misogyny reigns.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: They Say I Was Born a King's Daughter Side Story
The Immoral Duke Needs to Be Homeschooled
title_english: The Immoral Duke Needs to Be Homeschooled
synopsis:
Reincarnated as a side character in Contractual Marriage to a Dangerous Duke, Estella works as a governess in the wealthy Bertha mansion. She bonds with her pupils, siblings Cedric and Cecilia, and is determined to save them from a tragic fate at the hands of Diego, their handsome but dangerous half-brother. To save them, Estella strikes a deal with Diego: spare the children and she will marry him. After all, a contractual marriage means love will certainly not be part of the deal... right?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Haha no Ai wa Mama Naranai!
title_japanese: 義母の愛はママならないっ!

title: The Hero's Savior
synopsis:
After years of torture at the hands of her own father, young elementalist Ariadne Eldier sees her chance to escape when her mother's untimely death prompts a visit from her grandfather, a powerful archmage. Once whisked away to safety, Aria begins her plans to not only distribute an elixir for the contamination plaguing the land, but also save the protagonist and prevent this novel's tragic ending. But with her own fated death looming, will Aria be able to become the hero this tale needs?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Smiling Boxer
synopsis:
Gang Chan, a young man from a rural village, dreams of becoming a boxing champion. He trains relentlessly every day to repay the elders who raised him.

One day, men in black suits arrive, threatening the villagers with a shady urban redevelopment project. Gang Chan steps forward to protect them, but the odds are overwhelming. In despair, he breaks down, blaming himself for failing his people—until a mysterious figure appears, changing his fate forever.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Hell City
synopsis:
In the sprawling megacity of Songcheon, home to over four million people, life is ordinary for high school student Minho, who dreams of becoming a judo champion. That is, until one day—in the blink of an eye, the city collapses into a living hellscape. Will Minho be able to survive?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Leu Leu Leu
synopsis:
In the midst of ordinary daily life, monstrous creatures suddenly appear—and around them, students begin transforming into monsters one by one. Normality is utterly destroyed; rescue seems impossible. The students, forced into survival, band together in their own ways to fight and endure.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Ryuubatsu no Fiera
synopsis:
The Kingdom of Swordland was reduced to ashes in a single night by a dragon that appeared out of nowhere. Princess Fiera, who lost her homeland and family before her very eyes, rises up to slay her sworn enemy, the calamity known as the "dragon," while bearing her brother's will and the unvoiced grief of the people on her still young shoulders!

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

title: Ryuubatsu no Fiera
synopsis:
The Kingdom of Swordland was reduced to ashes in a single night by a dragon that appeared out of nowhere. Princess Fiera, who lost her homeland and family before her very eyes, rises up to slay her sworn enemy, the calamity known as the "dragon," while bearing her brother's will and the unvoiced grief of the people on her still young shoulders!

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

title: Hazure Shoku "Shoukanshi" ga S-kyuu Bannoushoku ni Bakemashita: Munou to Sagesumareta Ore, Densetsu no Shoukanjuu-tachi ni Natsukare Chikara ga Kakusei shita node Sekai Saikyou desu
title_japanese: ハズレ職〈召喚士〉がS級万能職に化けました～無能と蔑まれた俺、伝説の召喚獣達に懐かれ力が覚醒したので世界最強です

title: Chiisana Madougu Gishi no Rakuraku Seisan Kakumei: Nandemo Tsukureru Cheat Job de Daini no Jinsei Ouka suru
title_japanese: 小さな魔道具技師のらくらく生産革命～なんでも作れるチートジョブで第二の人生謳歌する～
synopsis:
A man who ended his previous life alone and friendless was reborn as Bernie, a baby surrounded by a warm family. Granted the world's only cheat job, "Magical Tool Engineer," Bernie enjoys the ultimate crafting lifestyle alongside reliable companions and fluffy divine beasts!

(Source: Starts Shuppan, translated)

title: Yamaokusodachi no Ore no Yururi Isekai SeikatsU: Mofumofu to Saikyou-tachi ni Kawaigararete, Nidome no Jinsei Mankitsuchuu
title_japanese: 山奥育ちの俺のゆるり異世界生活～もふもふと最強たちに可愛がられて、二度目の人生満喫中～

title: Ikemen Sugimasu Natsume-san
title_japanese: イケメンすぎます棗さん

title: Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei: Kyuuten-hen
title_japanese: 魔法科高校の劣等生 急転編
synopsis: The arc follows volume 27 of the light novel.

title: Aisarenakatta Shachiku Reijou wa, Daini Ouji (Mofumofu) ni Iyasarechuu
title_japanese: 愛されなかった社畜令嬢は、第二王子(もふもふ)に癒やされ中
