title: Cinderella no Ane desu ga, Fuhoni nagara Ouji to Kekkon suru Kto ni Narimashita: Migawari Outaishihi wa Rikyuu de Slow Life wo Mankitsu suru
title_japanese: シンデレラの姉ですが、不本意ながら王子と結婚することになりました～身代わり王太子妃は離宮でスローライフを満喫する～
synopsis:
Adelina, Cinderella's stepsister, is forced into marriage with the nation's beloved "handsome prince" after Cinderella elopes with a wizard instead of accepting his proposal. Though the prince declares, "Even if we marry, I will never love you," Adelina has no objections! He's free to have mistresses or concubines—she plans to live as a figurehead princess, enjoying a laid-back royal NEET life in a remote palace surrounded by fluffy companions. However, as she pursues her goal of a peaceful life and an amicable divorce (with a generous settlement), the once-distant prince starts to take an interest in her...!?

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Shuku Seijo ni Naremasen deshita. Konomama Stealth shitai no desu ga, Akuyakugao to Seirei ni Aisare Taishitsu no Sei de Yappari Iroiro Okorimasu
title_japanese: 祝・聖女になれませんでした。 このままステルスしたいのですが、悪役顔と精霊に愛され体質のせいでやっぱり色々起こります

title: Last Love
synopsis:
Seol-a's boyfriend dumps her over text for a woman with better standing, and now they're getting married. Ji Seung-hu, the CEO, witnesses Seol-a berating her ex for it, but to her surprise, he reacts by taking her out to dinner after. After a drunken night in bed, she finds out she was his first, but could he be her last? Seol-a must now manage dating her company's CEO and the blowback of Seung-hu spurning other women over her, one of whom is now dying to ruin Seol-a's life.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Scramble Recipe
title_japanese: スクランブル・レシピ

title: Genkai JK Kirimi Sanjuuni-sai
title_japanese: 限界JKきりみさんじゅうにさい
synopsis:
Keigo Kazami (28), a high school teacher with a fondness for older women, is homeroom teacher to a class that suddenly gains a transfer student—Kirimi Takanashi (32), an active actress and the mother of one!? Kirimi has been trying to convince her truant daughter to attend school, but the daughter fires back: "Did you go to high school? You were already working in show business." To persuade her daughter, Kirimi boldly declares that she'll enroll in high school herself first—and even rocks the school uniform with enthusiasm! Keigo is completely thrown off by having a student older than himself, but the principal orders him to support Kirimi's "fun" school life. Can Keigo fulfill his duties without being tempted by Kirimi's alluring maturity...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Reijou Alice no Eiyuutan: Kizoku no Shoujo ni Tensei shita Eiyuu wa Yagate Saikyou to Nari Hitobito wo Sukuu Tame Musou suru
title_japanese: 令嬢アリスの英雄譚～貴族の少女に転生した英雄はやがて最強となり人々を救うため無双する～
synopsis:
Once hailed as a hero, his life was cut short by a blade... only to be reborn as a feeble young girl! Although overprotected by his maid, Sakuna, he will rise again to save those in need!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Ore dake Chou Tensai Renkinjutsushi: Yuruui Atelier Seikatsu Hajimemashita
title_japanese: 俺だけ超天才錬金術師 ゆる～いアトリエ生活始めました

title: Isekai Teni shita kedo, Ouritsu Gakuin de Jimuin Yattemasu
title_japanese: 異世界転移したけど、王立学院で事務員やってます

title: Taishuu Shokudou Akuyaku Reijou: Konyaku Haki sareta node Shokudou wo Hiraitara Iyashi no Chikara ga Kaika shimashita
title_japanese: 大衆食堂悪役令嬢 ～婚約破棄されたので食堂を開いたら癒やしの力が開花しました～

title: Bill
synopsis:
Bill Bark, the blacksmith who forged the hero's sword, is content with his ordinary daily life. However, as unrest begins to rise throughout the kingdom, it starts to shake even his life, and as the situation worsens, he is drawn deep into a series of uncontrollable events.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: The Princess Goes to School
synopsis:
Kim Seol lives as an ordinary high school student in South Korea, unaware that she is actually the daughter of North Korea's next leader. To protect her daily life, an elite agent is sent undercover to her school, creating a school romance comedy!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Grim Doctor
synopsis:
A downtown hospital taking in patients day and night is in dire need of doctors. When a new resident with an awkward smile joins, he begins treating patients while displaying skills that go far beyond your average resident's. His true identity remains shrouded in mystery, until an incident occurs...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Inko demo Seishun shitai
title_japanese: インコでも青春したい
synopsis:
Masato is a first-year high school boy who is still struggling trying to fit in with his class. He is curious about Rinko, another loner who sits next to him. One day, he accidentally witnesses her secret to-do list, and ends up offering to help Rinko live out the spirited school life of her dreams…

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Watashi wo Oidasu no wa Ii desu kedo, Kono Ie no Kusuri Tsukutta no Zenbu Watashi desu yo?
title_japanese: 私を追い出すのはいいですけど、この家の薬作ったの全部私ですよ?
synopsis:
Suddenly, Reifel, the daughter of a poor baron, had her fiancé stolen by her younger sister. After the engagement was abruptly broken off, she was kicked out of her home. She had worked hard as a pharmacist to support him, but this is how he treated her... Reifel is dejected, and her parents try to oppress her even more. I'm going to abandon my awful fiancé and my family! Having lost everything, Reifel decides to start a new life on her own. And when she begins working as a pharmacist in a remote village, she discovers that she has an incredible hidden talent...!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title: Seijo ga Kuru kara "Kimi wo Aisuru Koto wa Nai" to Iwareta node Okazari Ouhi ni Tesshiteitara, Seijo ga 5-sai Datta node Zenryoku de Aishimasu!!
title_japanese: 聖女が来るから「君を愛することはない」と言われたのでお飾り王妃に徹していたら、聖女が5歳だったので全力で愛します!!
synopsis:
"The saint will arrive soon, so I will never love you." With those words from her future husband, Emperor Yuri, Edelene resigns herself to a quiet life as merely a queen in name only. However, when the saint is finally summoned, she turns out to be a 5-year-old girl, trembling in fear from a life of abuse! This marks the beginning of a heartwarming fantasy about family love, as the wounded young saint is showered with unconditional affection by Edelene and Yuri, growing up happy and healthy under their care.

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

title: Denka, Anata ga Suteta Onna ga Honmono no Seijo desu
title_japanese: 殿下、あなたが捨てた女が本物の聖女です
synopsis:
In a small country on a certain continent, Lamberth, there is a being known as a "Saint" who possesses strong healing powers and brings prosperity to the country. Irene, the daughter of a marquis and engaged to Maynard, the first prince of Lamberth, is suddenly informed by Maynard that he is breaking off their engagement. The previous Saint has died, and it is necessary to decide on the next Saint as soon as possible. The two were originally engaged for political reasons, but Irene is irritated by Maynard's cold attitude. However, at the Saint selection ceremony, Irene is chosen as the true Saint...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Otsukare Around 30 wa Isekai de Mofumofu Dragon to Kishi no Sewa wo Shiteimasu
title_japanese: お疲れアラサーは異世界でもふもふドラゴンと騎士の世話をしています

title: Kiss the Scumbag
synopsis:
Five years ago, Winston and Yujin fell deeply and irrevocably in love at first sight. But their passionate relationship shattered when Winston discovered the unthinkable truth: Yujin's was having an affair with none other than his own father. Consumed by betrayal, Winston channeled the love he once cherished into resentment. Yet no matter how hard he tries, Winston cannot extinguish the pull he still feels. Now, reunited by fate and unresolved wounds, passion and scorn intertwine... But can either of them truly escape what they once meant to each other?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Ghost of You
synopsis:
In a world where implanted neural chips allow investigators to interrogate suspects through their own memories, detectives Kim Jinyeong and Seo Jisu prefer the old-fashioned method of chasing criminals on foot. Officially, they are colleagues-turned-lovers who divorced years ago; but off the record, they continue to seek each other out after work, haunted by a tangled relationship that neither has fully let go of. Then, one chilling Christmas night, Jinyeong disappears without a word. Exactly one year later on Christmas Eve, he returns and stands before Jisu as if nothing had happened. Where has he been, and what truth hides behind the silence of that missing year...?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Dekai Usagi ni Natsukareta!?
title_japanese: デカいうさぎに懐かれた!?
synopsis:
Hajime Ookami, a new member of the workforce, is so nervous the night before his first day that he can’t sleep. Plagued by anxiety over whether he can make it in this distant, unfamiliar city of Fukuoka, Hajime heads out for a midnight stroll. There, he is accosted by a strangely over-familiar, "giant" drunk woman, and the two of them end up heading out into the nighttime city together...!?

Set in Hakata, this is a heart-pounding story depicting the budding relationship between a grown man and woman!!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Usotsuki Niichan
synopsis:
Haruto had been eagerly awaiting his summer vacation reunion with his beloved big brother, only to be devastated when his mother told him the visit was canceled. But then... there he was! His brother, the one he'd been waiting for all along! The two enjoy their summer to the fullest with bug catching, soccer, and fireworks, but then...?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Koushaku Reijou no Rouraku Mission: Maou to no Seiryaku Kekkon ga Jinrui Saigo no Kirifuda desu!... tte, Maou ga Onnanoko no Baai wa Dou Sureba Ii no desu ka!?
title_japanese: 公爵令嬢の籠絡ミッション～魔王との政略結婚が、人類最後の切り札です！…って、魔王が女の子の場合はどうすればいいのですか!?～

title: Denka ga Hitomebore shita Reijou no Shoutai wa Anata no Goei Kishi desu! the Comic
title_english: Your Highness, the Lady Who You Fell in Love at First Sight Is Actually your Guardian Knight!
title_japanese: 殿下が一目惚れした令嬢の正体はあなたの護衛騎士です! THE COMIC
synopsis:
Elda, a straight-laced knight with zero charm or sex appeal, is suddenly ordered to disguise herself as the noble lady Elriana in order to guard the princess during a grand evening ball. Determined to fulfill her duty as a bodyguard, Elda throws herself into the mission—only for something completely unexpected to happen. Darius, the kingdom's second prince, famous both for his striking good looks and his dislike of women, falls in love with her at first sight...!?

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

title: Reikoku na Ookami Koutei no Keiyaku Hanayome: "Omae wa Kazoku ja Nai" to Suterareta Reijou ga, Juujinkoku de Aisarete Shiawase ni Naru made
title_japanese: 冷酷な狼皇帝の契約花嫁～「お前は家族じゃない」と捨てられた令嬢が、獣人国で愛されて幸せになるまで～

title: Kanjou ga Tenkou ni Hanei sareru Tokushu Nouryoku Mochi Reijou wa Konyaku Kaishou sareta node Fumou no Daichi e Totsugitai
title_english: A Daughter Who Has a Special Ability That Her Emotions Are Reflected in the Weather Wants to Marry into a Barren Land Because Her Engagement Has Been Broken Off
title_japanese: 感情が天候に反映される特殊能力持ち令嬢は婚約解消されたので不毛の大地へ嫁ぎたい
synopsis:
Charlotte, the daughter of a marquis, possesses a special ability to cause the weather to reflect her emotions. Because of this, she has always suppressed her feelings and lived with restraint. She has never allowed herself to cry, to be angry, or even to feel joy. However, her fiancé Theodore suddenly breaks off their engagement. To make matters worse, he seems to be completely smitten with a sweet commoner girl named Verona. Having reached the limits of her patience, Charlotte decides to marry the king of the Kingdom of Shurton—a land of barren soil. Her new fiancé, Azul, begins showering her with overwhelming affection that knows no bounds...!?

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Tezcatlipoca
synopsis:
Ousted by a rival cartel, a brutal drug lord flees Mexico to the distant East. An unwanted child commits a terrible deed and is locked away for years. A Japanese heart surgeon is shunned by the medical community and turns to working as an illegal organ broker. Three lives become entangled in threads of flesh and are plunged deep into a world of blood and bone. Together, they carve out a new criminal empire, but how long can a dynasty last? Destiny is not for mortals to decide. It is cast by the Night and Wind. It is cast by Tezcatlipoca.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Tobari to Hari
synopsis:
Work, cheap drinks, sleeping with random men—that was Takahashi's dull routine. Yet amidst it all, there was his unforgettable first love, Ishigami. Even after all these years, he'd kept clinging to his ghost.. but then...?!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: The Shaman's Dwelling
synopsis:
Once celebrated as a gifted shaman, Kwon Hae-eon has fallen far from grace. Having lost his divine power, he survives by scamming clients and pretending his abilities still exist.

Then one night, Mun U-jin, a devout Christian man possessed by an unknown entity, bursts into the shrine and jumps him. The moment their bodies intertwine, Hae-eon's long dormant spiritual power suddenly returns.

Sensing an opportunity, Hae-eon manipulates the unlucky, possession plagued U-jin into staying at the shrine. Each night, using U-jin's body as a medium, he engages with the mysterious being inside him, restoring more of his stolen energy.

But when morning comes, U-jin remembers nothing. All he sees are the unmistakable remnants of intense, forbidden intimacy that occurred while he was unaware.

For a man who has lived his life with strict faith and purity, the truth feels like a divine punishment.

"How much worse can my luck get, Lord? Why must I endure this torment?"

(Source: Lezhin Entertainm

title: Shokujin Keikaku
synopsis:
“Please… eat me. And make it delicious.”

A down-on-his-luck wolf, scraping by at the very bottom of society, and a human girl, who was supposed to be extinct, wants to be eaten. Their fateful meeting marks the beginning of a forbidden “Project” that will shake the very foundations of the beastfolk world.

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Garden of Kindness
synopsis:
Twenty-seven-year-old Yoon Yiso runs a lunchbox shop in name only while raising a seven year old child on his own. One day, a man named Haejun suddenly appears in Yiso's barren life, lingering by his side with a kindness that feels like a friend's and a lover's all at once.

Yiso accepts Haejun's warmth hungrily and lives in fragile peace, but when people from his past who once turned his life upside down resurface, he grows anxious that he might lose the happiness he has now. As time goes on, Yiso also begins to notice one strange thing after another about Haejun, who had always protected him. Was it a mistake to step into his garden from the very beginning?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: The Lovable Player
synopsis:
Back in school, Jae-woo and Hyun-min shared a bond that made them feel special—more than anyone else. Hyun-min receives a meaningful gift from Jae-woo and is certain it's a mutual green light. But when he sees Jae-woo giving the exact same gift to another girl, Hyun-min becomes convinced that Jae-woo is just a fickle little swallow, and the two drift apart. Six years later, they reunite at a class reunion, but Hyun-min still finds Jae-woo suspicious. Then...

"Sunbae, the last train's gone. Could you let me stay just one night?"

Seriously... how can someone be this shameless?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Outside the Door
synopsis:
Reclusive and withdrawn, Tae-jeong has spent years shut away from the world, surviving in the quiet suffocation of his own room. But when his father is suddenly hospitalized due to a car accident, even that fragile isolation begins to crumble.

Grief and fear twist together inside him, leaving only one outlet, an uneasy rush of desire that both calms and consumes him.

Enter Eun-won, the golden boy who has everything Tae-jeong doesn't: confidence, charm, a life untouched by loneliness. He looks at Tae-jeong with disdain, pity, and something darker, an attraction he refuses to name.

As the line between disgust and desire blurs, both are drawn into a dangerous intimacy born from guilt, curiosity, and longing.

What begins as comfort becomes compulsion, and behind locked doors, Tae-jeong and Eun-won learn that even the most broken hearts can crave, and destroy, in the same breath.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: An Unusual and Miraculous Encounter
synopsis:
When nobleman Lee Jung gets kicked out for defying his father's orders, he wanders until he meets the orphan Kwon Chansoo. Bewitched by Chansoo's resemblance to his first love, Jung finds himself drawn into Chansoo's world. But there's more to this orphan than meets the eye, and Jung is intrigued by the mysteries of it all. Will Jung figure out what he truly wants from life, or will Chansoo's many secrets trap him in a situation he can't escape from?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Imitation Gold
synopsis:
When his mother became the mistress of a wealthy chairman, Seonwoo was forced into the role of a "perfect" son in a picture-perfect but hollow family. No matter how hard he tried, he could never measure up... Especially next to Seungwook, who seemed to have everything from the start. Their bond fractured, and they went their separate ways. Five years later, Seungwook returns from abroad, and their paths cross again. But instead of reconciliation, he offers Seonwoo a dangerous proposition...one that crosses a line neither of them can ever take back.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: May as Well Get the Best Ending
title_english: May as Well Get the Best Ending
synopsis:
Avid BL lover Min Kirin attends a game expo to get some new BL games, but there are disappointingly few there. He nearly goes home empty-handed, but a mysterious, hooded man gives him a free copy of a VR BL game. Kirin is suspicious of the man and game, especially given the negative reviews, but he can't resist its mature rating and logs in just to be transported into that world! He needs to earn money and that's how he meets the various romanceable characters. Will Kirin find love with one of them and return to reality, or will he be unable to pick just one virtual hottie?!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Lost in Love
synopsis:
Everyone on campus knows the rich and handsome Jung Woojin, so when a guy like that offers to buy him a meal, Kang Seoju agrees immediately and that might have been the biggest mistake of his life. When Seoju regains consciousness, he finds himself stranded on a deserted island with just Woojin, unsure of how much time has passed. Woojin confesses to being hopelessly in love with him and is determined to make Seoju his, regardless of how Seoju feels. But as their entanglement grows, Seoju starts to wonder if this truly is their first time meeting.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Milk & Cream
synopsis:
Jinhyuk, blessed with the ability to sense non-human beings thanks to his shaman father, is astonished when Doey, a playful and curious fairy, falls in love with him and begins to visit his dreams. What starts as innocent and harmless fun quickly evolves into intimate encounters, blurring the boundaries between dreams and reality. As their bond deepens, Jinhyuk's initial uncertainty turns into an insatiable longing for Doey's enchanting presence. Together, they embark on a whimsical romantic journey, navigating the complexities of love in a dreamscape as fresh as milk and as sweet as cream.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Pieces of a Boy
synopsis:
Choi Ho-yoon, the second son of a prominent government official, resorts to selling himself to a stranger to undermine his abusive father's reputation. By chance, his first client happens to be Sehwan, a former close friend of Ho-yoon's older brother. Sehwan's dark desires ignite fury and stir up the scars and trauma within Ho-yoon, leading to a secret deal aimed at tearing down the Choi family.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Mukibutsu ni Ai wo Komete
synopsis:
A lone genius and the perfect android he constructed run a shop together, where they make prostheses for veterans who've lost their limbs in war. However, their prosthetic technology catches the eye of the military, who then decide to make use of it...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Higeki no Genkyou to Naru Saikyou Gedou Last Boss Joou wa Tami no Tame ni Tsukushimasu. The Savior's Pride
title_japanese: 悲劇の元凶となる最強外道ラスボス女王は民の為に尽くします。 The Savior's Pride

synopsis:
Out of an excessive desire for a new motorcycle, Alice, a simpleminded high school girl, stages an accident to destroy her current bike. Just when her "bike-and-telephone-pole-go-boom" plan seems to have succeeded, the ghost of her bike, which was supposed to have passed on, appears and possesses her!  Facing off against the spirits of inanimate objects—"thinghosts"—this world class moron runs riot. Disorder reigns supreme!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Suterare Kizoku no Mujintou Nobinobi Kaitakuki: Youyaku Jiyuu wo Te ni Ireta node, Mofumofu-tachi to Kimagure Slow Life wo Mankitsu shimasu

title: Yakume wo Hatashita Hikage no Yuusha wa, Henkyou de Jiyuu ni Ikiteikimasu

title_japanese: おはらい箱の天才付与術師は、辺境で悠々自適に暮らしたい～万能付与術で気付いたら辺境が世界最強の快適拠点になっていた～

title: Yuuki-kun wa Ecchi na Omocha
title_japanese: ゆうきくんはえっちなオモチャ
synopsis:
Through his school life, Yuuki was always excluded from everything to the point he wasn't even invited in the class group chat. Now in university, he has the goal of making some friends, he even dyed his hair to change his image. But seems like everything went wrong when he showed his otaku side in front of a scary classmate, Tatsumi.

(Source: MU)

Included one-shot: Kyodai Soshiki Harenchi Tekihatsu 24-ji

Yamato, a male student, is troubled by recurring "dreams." Every time he falls asleep, mysterious tentacles appear. His nipples are teased, his genitals are prodded, and eventually, even his rear is violated... Despite the fear and disgust, his body, against his will, feels increasingly good. Attacking him relentlessly during class, in the infirmary, anywhere—what is the true nature of these assaults?

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

Included one-shot: Neko to Janken

title: Tondemo Skill "Kaze ga Fukeba Okeya ga Moukaru" no Okage de Ore no Isekai Life wa Mamanaranai (Ii Imi de): Skill ga Shimesu "Amayadori" wo Shitara Densetsu no Dragon ga Nakama ni Natte Kizukeba Oukoku made Sukutteta
title_japanese: とんでもスキル【風が吹けば桶屋が儲かる】のおかげで俺の異世界ライフはままならない(良い意味で)～スキルが示す「雨宿り」をしたら伝説のドラゴンが仲間になって、気づけば王国まで救ってた～
synopsis:
At the feast for receiving the title of "Hero," Nova suddenly poured mead on the king. Expelled from the hero's party for this unexpected action... He reaches a small village where he befriends a legendary dragon and encounters one unpredictable event after another!? It turns out this man was a hidden hero who had achieved numerous accomplishments with the skill "If the Wind Blows, the Barrel Maker Prospers," which yields unexpected results when completing seemingly meaningless quests!? Even the king who exiled him eventually discovers that Nova saved his life, and the kingdom can't possibly leave Nova alone...? He thoroughly enjoys his life in another world with an absurd skill that even he can't predict!!

(Source: Starts Shuppan, translated)

title: Kikaijikake Senmetsu Shoujo

synopsis:
Baker Margot and her ghostly assistant Miro make specialty cakes for the dearly departed. Each cake is made custom—tailored to the lost individual. Still-living loved ones share their memories of the deceased which serve as inspiration for the flavors and style, creating a truly one-of-a-kind cake.

(Source: Dark Horse Comics)

title: Hinekure Koushaku wa Noroware Otome ni Kudokareru

synopsis:
Wrongly accused and left to die, a fallen queen opens her eyes ten years earlier—back at nineteen, just after her parents' deaths. Given a second chance, she swears never to be used again. To protect her family, she sets her sights on the empire's highest rank of knighthood: the Chevalier. Through relentless training and treacherous court politics, she forges herself into a true warrior—until the commander of the knight order appears before her, setting a new fate into motion.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Sugar Bitter Reverse

synopsis:
1. Sugar and Salt
2. Sugar and Bitter
3. Himitsu Addiction
4. Toi et Moi

6. Omake

title: The Scandal
synopsis:
Ji-woo's life was picture-perfect. A media mogul husband, a successful career in journalism, and the scoop of the century ready to boost her into the stratosphere—she had everything she could ever want. Only, that scoop? It's about her husband's affair with a top actress! Ji-woo flees to the States to start over, but to finalize the divorce, she's forced to return to Korea. That's when her ex-husband presents an offer she just can't refuse...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Azelda: The Elementalist's Contract Marriage
synopsis:
Killed for being an elementalist but brought back by the Spirit of Death, Azelda Madison is determined to survive her second chance at life. After relentless training, she meets her betrothed, Duke Shade Karloss, and fights by his side as a mercenary for five years while hiding her true identity. Unwilling to repeat the loveless marriage of her past, Azelda proposes a contract marriage with the duke. But as she gradually uncovers a hidden side to Shade, can she continue to abide by its terms?

(Source: Tapas Media)

synopsis:
After losing the ability to speak due to stress in his business consulting company, Doi had no choice but to be placed on medical leave, but no therapy or medication ever helped. Just as he thought his professional life was over, he walked by accident into an empty soba shop... where he found healing, the worst soba he had ever tasted, and the most handsome man he had ever seen in the face of Masato Anri, the owner. But who is Masato, really, and what kinds of secrets does he keep? And why does his soba taste so awful!?

(Source: MangaDex)

title: On the Contrary
synopsis:
From the moment Jiwoon met Yoosun, she wanted to be friends. Try as she might, however, none of her usual tricks for winning people over have gotten her more than a cold shoulder. Finally at her wit's end, the two have a falling out before Yoosun makes a confession. They've actually known each other since middle school! And, even back then, Yoosun was interested in more than just friendship.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Zenmetsu End wo Shinimonogurui de Kaihi shita. Party ga Yanda.
title_japanese: 全滅エンドを死に物狂いで回避した。パーティが病んだ。

Wolka, an adventurer, is a reincarnator from Japan. During a dungeon exploration, his party is ambushed by a powerful monster, and Wolka suffers fatal injuries while protecting his companions; in his final moments, he finally remembers the world he had reincarnated into was that of a dark fantasy manga he read in his previous life — that he and his companions were minor characters to be annihilated then and there.

But Wolka, empowered by his hatred for bad endings, desperately presses on for the sake of his companions — and defeats the monster. It only cost him an eye and a leg — but in exchange, he and his party escaped their intended fate. What he did not account for, however, was how the experience changed the young girls that were his companions.

title: Akuyaku Reijou wa Mou Zenbu ga Iya ni Natta node, Kioku Soushitsu no Furi wo Suru Koto ni Shita

synopsis:
I was a plain, unfeminine woman, but before I knew it, I woke up in the world of the game I was playing! And to think that I'd become the villainous young lady Alyssa, a character I hate the most... On top of that, Alyssa is on the verge of being sent to a dirty old man as a prostitute by her evil sister, the queen, under the guise of being a saintess! As Alissa tries to escape from the royal palace, a wild and mysterious handsome man assists her rescue. But the forceful man orders her to perform serve him in exchange for his help!

(Source: Harper Collins Japan)

title: DREAM over DREAM
synopsis:
As a high-schooler, aspiring manga artist Ayukawa tore apart a manga drawn by his friend Tsuchioka. Now, many years later, Ayukawa and Tsuchioka reconnect at their class reunion, and...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Share House Aobayu
synopsis:
Satoru Satomi, who inherited his family's financially struggling bathhouse "Aoibayu," hits upon a plan to revamp the business as a "bathhouse share house!" Then, a cool beauty applies to see the place...

(Source: Nihon Bungeisha, translated)

title: Kyuusei no Doomsday
title_japanese: 救世の終末時計〈ドゥームズ・デイ〉
synopsis:
Terrorism, natural disasters, apparitions, and monsters—this world was fast approaching its final destruction. To prevent the collapse of humanity, an organization called the [World Doomsday Clock Tower] was formed. Its newest agents? Itsukushima Gekkou, a heavy-duty otaku, and Mei Irumina, a "fanservice" streamer. A battle of extraordinary powers to save the world from the apocalypse begins now!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Kotou no Boukensha
synopsis:
Hiro and Dai are brothers whose father is a survival writer. An adventure comic in which brothers left alone on a deserted island grow strong to survive!!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Hametami ga Aru
synopsis:
1-2. Bijo to Yajuu: Gal to Kimoota (The Beauty and The Beast: The Gyaru and The Disgusting Otaku)
3. Futsutsuka Onaho (Clumsy Onahole)
4. Kaerareru Watashi (The New Me)
5. Ikuzo Rikujoubu! (Let's Cum Track and Field Club!)
6. Hatsujouki no Shishou ga "Kuru na" to Itta no ni (Even though my Horny Master told me Not to)

title: Moto Saikyou Tansakusha no Ojisan. Bishoujo Haishinsha wo Tasukete Oobazuri shiteshimatta
title_japanese: 元最強探索者のおじさん。美少女配信者を助けて大バズりしてしまった。
synopsis:
A middle-aged man who’s just been fired from his job heads into a dungeon to hunt monsters in order to make ends meet. There, he rescues a beautiful high school girl who works as a dungeon livestreamer. Aiming to boost her viewer count, she recognizes his impressive hunting skills and proposes that they team up. Together, the two set out to create even more thrilling and exciting dungeon footage, but…

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Senmetsu Tokku: Kaijuu Kanren Hanzairoku
title_japanese: 殲滅特区 -怪獣関連犯罪録-

title: Kinki Chihou no Aru Basho ni Tsuite
title_english: About a Place in the Kinki Region
title_japanese: 近畿地方のある場所について
synopsis:
My friend is missing. When he disappeared, he'd been working on a magazine about the paranormal—his first real job as an editor. With almost no budget, he'd resorted to digging through back issues and unused research material, looking for inspiration. As he did, a terrifying truth began to emerge about a certain place in the Kinki region. I have collected the relevant articles, interviews, and other materials in this book. And once you have understood everything, I would like to ask for your cooperation. I hope you will get in touch.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Hakyoku Yotei no Akujo no Hazu ga, Reitetsu Koushaku-sama ga Wakarete Kuremasen!
title_english: Breaking up Was the Plan, the Duke Falling for the Villainess Was Not!
title_japanese: 破局予定の悪女のはずが、冷徹公爵様が別れてくれません！
synopsis:
I was reincarnated into the pages of my favorite romance novel. Not as the bright, beloved heroine, but as the cruel, grasping villainess, a mere stepping stone in the story. My only job is to dump the "Cold-Hearted Duke" so he can meet his true love. Fail, and war breaks out. I die. Nobody gets their happily ever after.

Easy, right?

Except playing a vindictive noblewoman when I'd been an ordinary woman in my past life is harder than it looks. Because if that's the case, why—at the end of it all—is the duke holding me close, murmuring into my ear, "Grace... I will never, ever let you go"?!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

title: Heroine ni Konyakusha wo Torareru Mitai nanode, Akuyaku reisoku (Yandere Chara) wo Neraimasu
title_english: If the Heroine Wants My Fiancé, I'll Marry a Yandere Villain Instead!
title_japanese: ヒロインに婚約者を取られるみたいなので、悪役令息（ヤンデレキャラ）を狙います
synopsis:
"You're being tormented? In that case, let me be the one to adore you!!"

I reincarnated as Cynthia, a wicked noblewoman from a dating sim, and now the heroine is trying to steal my fiancé. If she wants him, I'm happy to cut ties and find someone new! Oh my, perhaps the yandere character named Siraiya (the third son of a duke), who's known for being an evil nobleman himself, would be a better match? Yes, he's exactly what I'm looking for!

"You're the one I want to marry!"

Will the villainess's love save the villainous nobleman? Find out in this reverse Cinderella tale!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

title: Hanaori-san wa Tensei shitemo Kenka ga Shitai
title_english: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life
title_japanese: 花織さんは転生しても喧嘩がしたい
synopsis:
Narukami Ryusei is your typical NEET. He spends his days shut in his room playing video games without a care in the world, living a lazy life. But the truth is, Ryusei used to be a powerful demon king in another world! So why not spend this new life doing whatever he wants? Except, he wasn't the only one reincarnated into this world. The hero who struck him down is here too—and she's a really cute high school girl?! Can Ryusei survive reuniting with his foe in a new world, or will he find himself fighting even in this life?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Shunrai Table Tennis
title_japanese: 春雷卓球〈 テーブルテニス 〉
synopsis:
Mirai Todoroki, a freshman at Arashino Girls' High School, is petite but has a deep passion for table tennis. She once had the skill to compete at the national level, but after suffering a crushing defeat against a player with overwhelming talent during her middle school years, she gave up the sport. Then one day, a transfer student named Oka Harusaki joins the table tennis club...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Kyou kara Futsuu no Maizono-kun
title_japanese: 今日からふつうの舞園くん
synopsis:
Tsukasa Asumi, a third-year student, has a strong sense of justice and takes good care of others, but she's just an ordinary girl. That is, until she suddenly receives a confession from Rin Maizono, a new student and former celebrity...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Zenbu Zenbu Kimi no Sei
title_japanese: ぜんぶ ぜんぶきみの性

synopsis:
"Don't you think we're missing that heart-fluttering feeling?"

From elementary school all the way to high school, Nam Do-yeon and Jeong A-rin have gone from childhood friends to lovers. For a couple who strives for a perfectly rational relationship, a plan to reclaim that one missing piece of excitement—Operation: Heart-Pounding begins!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Dareka Ookami-san no Shitsukekata Shirimasen ka!?
title_japanese: 誰かオオカミさんのしつけ方知りませんか!?
synopsis:
Himura Akane, a sophomore and member of the discipline committee, is very studious, but also sincere, petite, and adorable, making her beloved by everyone at school and very popular. One day, the principal asks her to be the tutor in charge of the education of Ren Ookami, the daughter of the board chairman. Since Akane's goal is to enter college on a scholarship, she decides to accept the assignment. However, Ren turns out to be much bigger than her physically and, on top of that, a troublesome girl with a cunning mind full of bad ideas...!?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Secret Relationships
synopsis:
Smart, clever, and resourceful, Daon worked hard to overcome being poor. But his cheap ways are getting on the last nerve of his coworker, Sunghyeon, who hates him! After an incident with his own impoverished parents, Daon is suddenly growing closer to Sunghyeon while balancing feelings for his former tutor, Jaemin. With mixed emotions and unspoken secrets, will Daon be rich with love or fall back into poverty?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Melting Home
synopsis:
In a world that's been nothing but unfair to them, Yoo Jin and Yegeon have found love with each other. However, love is not without its hardships. One is plagued by addictions to gambling and alcohol, while the other has a crippling fear of abandonment, making their time together anything but boring. Others may not understand their rocky relationship, but they have their own special way of working out their issues. Things may not be perfect, but love conquers all, doesn't it?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Cry Devil Cry
synopsis:
Yeon-geon Baek has harbored a crush on his best friend, Eihwa Yoon, for years, but he's finally had enough rejection. Determined to get away, he starts planning his leave to study abroad. He's spent too many years hiding behind castle walls built of secrets. However, the more he tries to distance himself, the more his secrets are pulled out into the open.

Maybe when it's over, things will be better, and maybe... he'll be able to have what he's always wanted.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Akuyaku Kizoku ga Hirakinaotte Hametsu Flag wo "Jitsuryoku" de Tatakiotteitara, Itsunomanika Heroine-tachi kara Eiyuushi sareru You ni Natta Ken

title: Ore dake Lv Up suru Skill Gacha de, Mattari Dungeon Tansakusha Seikatsu mo Yoyuu desu: Gacha Hiki Tanoshikute Yameranee!

synopsis:
While at work, Aoi Asumi dozes off, and when he wakes up, he finds herself in a dark cave.

Standing before him is a fluorescent pink gacha machine on legs. Unable to resist temptations like "Beginner-Friendly 10-Pull Gacha Now Live!" and "Guaranteed SSR Rare Skill!", he inserts a golden coin.

Opening the capsules grants him skills such as "Appraisal," "Fire," and "Swordsmanship Enhancement," causing his stats to rise one after another. Enchanted by the power of gacha skills, he starts defeating monsters to obtain gold coins, and before he knows it, repeated gacha pulls have made him incredibly strong.

After defeating the dungeon boss and stepping outside his first dungeon, he sets off alongside his gacha-machine partner and Asteria, an otherworlder he rescues along the way. Taking the name Verde Avenir, he begins a free-spirited journey to survive in another world, starting his new life as a dungeon-roaming explorer.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

High school student Himeka adores cake but faints whenever she eats it, which leaves her in a constant state of irritation. However, one day, her classmate Masaru informs her that her fainting is actually the result of a curse...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Hunger for You
synopsis:
In a wasteland where the dead hunt the living, Jay Lee's only light is Won. For seven years, they have wandered together, bound by a love that Won has carefully kept hidden. When a single night of intimacy finally breaks the tension, it feels like a new beginning. Instead, it is the beginning of the end. When a sudden crisis exposes Won's true identity, it triggers a violent separation that neither saw coming. In a world defined by hunger, the most dangerous thing Jay ever did was lose his heart to a mystery.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

Tragedy hits art genius Hyunsung Kwon in waves as his sponsors betray him and he falls into a slump. At risk of losing everything, he is forced to stop investigating his mother's scandal, only to realize his ex is the new beneficiary. Amidst the chaos, three men approach with ulterior motives...

(Source: Manta)

title: Zero Side

Chungwon, a narcotics officer, goes undercover to stop "Pink Out," a new drug in Korea. The dealers slip away, leaving only Yeong. Every test comes back clean, yet after much doubt, Chungwon takes home the bewildered 21-year-old who is so unworldly, it's as if he's been shut away his whole life.

(Source: Manta)

title: Houkai Sekai no Mahouzue Shokunin
title_english: The Wand Maker in the Collapsing World

Kenshi Oori is a man who has lived solely by his ingenuity. That has not changed even as civilization has collapsed. 

One day, a swarm of magical meteorites rained down on Earth, robbing the planet of all its electricity. Advanced society which relied on electricity collapsed in an instant. As the world fell into unprecedented chaos, Oori leisurely shaped one of the meteorites and fashioned a magical wand.

...That's right. Humanity lost its electricity but gained magic in return.

In a crumbling world where electronic devices no longer work, Oori's ingenuity, resulting in sophisticated creations comparable to precision instruments, could be the key to saving the world...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Auto Skill de Ore dake Chousoku Level Up: Megami ga Michibiku Taida na Tenseisha no Sakutto Isekai Kouryaku
title_japanese: 全自動攻撃【オート】スキルで俺だけ超速レベルアップ～女神が導く怠惰な転生者のサクッと異世界攻略～
synopsis:
Satoru, a young man who had been leading a degenerate life after a certain incident, is suddenly transported to another world through a mysterious in-game item! There, a goddess grants him a unique blessing — the "Fully Automatic Attack Skill," a power that defeats monsters without him having to lift a finger!! With this overpowered skill that allows instant level-ups and the goddess’s guidance, Satoru’s once-dulled heart begins to burn with passion once more—! Thus begins the fast-paced tale of a lazy young man and his unstoppable heroines as they conquer a new world together!

(Source: Starts Shuppan, translated)

title: Metsubou Countdown
synopsis:
A younger sister who was given a terminal diagnosis and her older sister, who couldn't accept that... Then suddenly, news arrives that the world will end in two weeks...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: A Hero Who Knows His Stuff
title_english: A Hero Who Knows His Stuff
synopsis:
For 20 years, Hyeonseok fought monsters in another world before finally managing to save it and be sent back to Earth as a reward. Now a former deliveryman named Chanseok, he looks forward to enjoying modern conveniences, only to discover that Earth is very different from what he remembers. Monsters have started appearing from Erosion Points that pop up at random, and people with innate abilities become Hunters to defeat them. Reluctantly, Chanseok applies to become a Hunter himself, mostly for the money. He saved the world once before, so how hard can it be the second time?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Kimi to Boku no Platonic
title_japanese: 君と僕のプラトニック
synopsis:
Suenaga, who has lost confidence in his social interactions, is so moved by Koba's performance at a university drama club performance that he decides to join the group. Koba has an unapproachable air about him, but he's sincere and kind, and he accepts Suenaga's shortcomings, like not being able to read the atmosphere.

Because of that, Suenaga finds himself wanting to know Koba more deeply. Then, one day, a drunk Koba tells him that he's asexual but not aromantic. Suenaga has a sense of embarrassment when he glimpses at Koba's inner self, and he feels emotions he's never felt before. He thinks that these feelings will only cause him trouble, but his feelings for Koba are already beyond his control...

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

title: Night of London
synopsis:
Martin Scofield's a lone werewolf who was born a highly breedable "snow." To avoid being used, he spent years on the run, taking odd jobs to survive. 

On the other hand, Daniel Sinclair was lovingly raised by two phantom vampires until a certain hunter killed them in cold blood and left him orphaned. 

When the two unknowingly reunite centuries later, Martin's mission to avoid love and Daniel's mission to avenge the only love he knew get sidelined as something much deeper develops between them.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Lucky Paradise
synopsis:
One very lucky morning, when sprinting to class, Ho-in accidentally bumps into Chunwoo. To his dismay, he also manages to spray pickle juice all over him later that day. Ho-in follows Chunwoo to his place to make up for his mistakes, but he somehow wakes up in Chunwoo's bed the next morning...leading to one lucky (?) encounter after another!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Ano Shima no Uminesou
synopsis:
Unemployed 19-year-old Kazuma has been summoned to Asagiri Island, rumored to be home to long lost pirate treasure. He ends up working as an odd-job man at Umine Inn, a traditional Japanese café with women-only lodgings and a host of eccentric yet beautiful women.

(Source: Kodansha)

title: Seijun Ecstasy: xx shinai to Derarenai Heya de Mazoku wo Buttaoshimasu
title_japanese: 聖巡エクスタシー－××しないと出られない部屋で魔族をブッ倒します－
synopsis:
Ex is ridiculed by his peers as a failure of a hero, whose sacred light has yet to manifest. But it turns out to have manifested in his dick! How is he supposed to defeat anything with that?! Even when his town is attacked, all he can manage to do is have his crotch glow. While bearing the weight of these worries, a mysterious shrine appears before him...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: The Prince Doesn't Cry Over Onions
title_english: The Prince Doesn't Cry Over Onions
synopsis:
After the war, Anna's restaurant held her village together. She took in strays and sowed farms from war-torn fields. When the lumbering bear of a man, Bertram, wanders into town, she puts him to work chopping onions. He doesn't shed a single tear. Instead, he offers his services to repay a debt to her late father. Meanwhile, Bertram, stripped of his ability to feel emotion, is not immune to Anna's warmth. As forces converge around the village, a charming tale of curses, loss, and love simmers.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: See You in the Future
synopsis:
Adrian Vernity would only ever scowl at his classmate Liz Plomento whenever he saw her. So imagine Liz's shock when she wakes up 5 years in the future, married to Adrian! Not only that, as Emperor and Empress, they are expected to consummate their marriage. Can Liz find a way out of this royal mess?

(Source: Manta)

title: Hotel Laurel no Wataridori-tachi
title_japanese: ホテル・ローレルの渡り鳥たち

title: The Purrfect Match
synopsis:
Kwon Jiwu is a top actor blessed with perfect looks and talent, but there's one strange problem: every male animal seems to be in love with him.

After yet another chaotic day on set fending off animal admirers, he's ready to snap when his cheeky junior co-star Ju Yeongwon starts picking a fight.

Just as Jiwu is about to put him in his place, something catches his eye. Cat ears? Wait a second, was Yeongwon one of those "male animals" all along?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Superlight Hands-Free Undies ver 2.0!
synopsis:
Beom Yeol has spent every Christmas alone, a shy virgin whose only thrill is secretly admiring Jun Sang, the tough gangster who protects his little shop. And this year is no different...or so he thinks.

While indulging in a slightly too vivid fantasy about Jun Sang, Beom Yeol suddenly comes face to face with a strange creature he has never seen before.

The being introduces himself as Ddobomi No. 8291, also known as "the God of Lust," and claims he has come to help Beom Yeol with his tragic lack of a love life.

His gift?

A pair of Bluetooth underwear that links Beom Yeol's senses directly to the most intimate parts of whoever he touches. 

With this outrageous invention and a long standing crush inches away, Beom Yeol might finally escape his lonely Christmas curse. 

The real question is... will he survive the experience?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title_japanese: 猫と男の子とその父親を買いました。

title: Gokuraku ni wa Mada Hayai
synopsis:
A tale of human emotion set in the Edo period, centered around Yukinari, an executioner, and the people around him. In this era, most criminals faced execution. One day, Saichiro, the son of a town doctor, witnesses Yukinari executing a criminal. Later, Saichiro sees Yukinari ignoring the pleas of the criminal's family. Yukinari, who seems to regard people as mere objects, responds to Saichiro's inquiry about why he won't listen to the family by saying, "I merely execute the sentence." Saichiro was dissatisfied with the answer, but then something happened... The story of a man who kills and lives unfolds.

(Source: Comic Natalie, translated)

title: Shima Rock
synopsis:
Uncomplicated rock 'n' roll for the complicated heart! The curtain rises on this remote island, where a tale of youthful band life begins.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: The Wolf Who Stole the Sun
title_english: The Wolf Who Stole the Sun
synopsis:
Golden Toldran is the wealthiest realm on the continent. Princess Charlotte, after years of religious devotion, is thrust into a public courtship she never desired. When Skadi, a singular suitor from the distant land of Nuanar, enters her life, boredom gives way to something far more dangerous.

(Source: Manta)

title: Aku no Reijou to Juuni no Hitomi: Saikyou Juusha-tachi to Densetsu no Akujo, Jinsei Nidome no Kareinaru Musouroku
title_english: The Wicked Princess and Her Twelve Eyes: The Legendary Villainess and Her Elite Assassins
title_japanese: 悪の令嬢と十二の瞳～最強従者たちと伝説の悪女、人生二度目の華麗なる無双録～
synopsis:
Lady Serena was betrayed by the crown prince, framed for a crime she didn't commit, and executed by poison. But instead of dying, she wakes up in the past with a second chance—and this time, she's not playing nice. After all, the so-called "murder" she was accused of was just a little misunderstanding! Looking back, Serena realizes her downfall wasn't due to poor scheming but a lack of competent underlings.

Determined to rewrite her fate, she recruits a group of desperate orphans and puts them through ruthless training, forging them into the most lethal, fanatically loyal elite force the kingdom has ever seen. Armed with her deadly entourage and sharp wit, Serena is ready to crush anyone who stands in her way. In this thrilling, cutthroat adventure, a morally flexible villainess seizes her second chance—not for redemption, but for revenge.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Royal Family
synopsis:
Kang Jihyuk was the eldest grandson of Taesung, South Korea's largest conglomerate. He should have inherited everything Taesung had to offer, but due to someone's conspiracy, he lost his parents and was abandoned in an orphanage. Twenty years later, he returns to Taesung under the name "Seo Jihyuk"... and his revenge begins.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Q. Gouman de Hidou na Akuyaku Kizoku ni, Seigi no Hero ni Akogareru Shounen ga Tensei shitara? A. Kuchi wa Warui ga Hito wo Sukuu Dark Hero ga Tanjou suru

title: Vincent the Great
synopsis:
The demons took his farmhouse, his wife, his peace. Now Vincent Burns lives to kill as many as he can. The excommunicated exorcist, along with Sister Beatrice and local sheriff Chloe, has found himself in the middle of a demonic plot to bring Hell itself to the United States, yet the biggest puzzle is the white-haired girl he found in a suitcase. Demons not only die upon biting her; flowers bloom from her wounds. Vincent and Beatrice must keep her safe until they know her purpose, while Chloe must keep her sanity against the demon horde.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Psychopath in Murim
synopsis:
[Welcome to Murim Online, the world where the strongest reside.]

[Your device has malfunctioned, and logging out failed.]

[Would you like to attempt to disconnect once more?]

[Yes or No]

When he tried returning to virtual reality, the place he logged into was instead the "real murim." A once-in-an-era psychopath fell into the murim due to the Grim Reaper's mistake. Dong Bongsu's merciless fangs cast a shadow over murim, which is rife with schemes and malice.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Mee-chan no Himitsu
synopsis:
Elderly Yuriko has memories of Mee-chan, a mysterious friend from long ago. Mee-chan would appear at crucial turning points in Yuriko's life, always treating her with warmth and kindness. Yet, no matter how many years passed, Mee-chan never aged...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Zoo's Panic
synopsis:
On New Year’s Eve, a pink smoke bomb turns the city into chaos, infecting people with a virus that transforms them into animal hybrids driven by uncontrollable lust. Yeonwoo and her friend Dojin hide out at Dojin's house after she infects him, but hunger forces them outside... into a world gone wild. With no cure in sight and a mysterious woman watching it all unfold, the only rule left is: stay inside… or lose yourself.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

Kang Chae-rin is a social media addict. She works hard, but she rarely gains followers. Chae-rin, who wanted to quickly live the life of an influencer, gets to know Yeon-woo, a returning student, and also an influencer. She approaches Yeon-woo thinking that if she gets attached to her, she will gain follower too!

(Source: MU)

synopsis:
Sister Alicia is admired for her pure and virtuous conduct. But inside her head... she is always consumed with perverted fantasies! Her feelings and fantasies about Leon, a junior monk, erupt in this perverted nun romcom!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: The Berserker's Second Playthrough
synopsis:
The protagonist, having possessed a berserker character within the game, has finally slain the Great Demon and cleared the ending after many events. He believed that was the end. However, before his eyes was not an exit to the real world but a [New Game+] button to start another run.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title_japanese: 心霊写真を撮りました

title: Seishun Cinderella
synopsis:
High school girl Shion decides to confess to the boy she likes. However, before she can even say "I like you," she receives her answer: "If you want to confess, at least do something about your appearance."

Ten years later, Shion works and has much more style, but still can't manage to have a normal relationship with a man. Ever since she got that answer, time has stopped for her. By pure chance she finds a photo from that time and, as she tears it up, she finds herself catapulted back to the same time as the photo. The modest high school girl from ten years ago has returned, but now she knows how to put on makeup and dress fashionably. And so, Shion has a second chance to live her high school life and erase her regrets.

(Source: MU)

title: Curious Miss Elena
synopsis:
Elena, the only daughter of a wealthy family, accidentally witnesses a friend's intimate moment with her lover and becomes curious about sex. As she grows closer to her loyal chauffeur, Kale, their secret bond blossoms into a forbidden love her father can never accept.

(Source: Manta)

title: Winter Field
synopsis:
Rensley Mallosen, the illegitimate prince of Cornia, is sent away to the frigid lands of Oldenlandt, disguised as a princess to wed the dreaded Grand Duke Zvendard. Planning to escape before the marriage ceremony, he remains silent, his face veiled. However, when the Grand Duke discovers the deception, he offers an entirely unexpected proposal: a faux marriage to shield Rensley from danger. As he learns of the Grand Duke's true gentle nature, Rensley struggles with his budding feelings for the man. The icy walls of the castle begin to thaw with their growing affection, and together, they must face unforeseen threats that challenge their relationship. Can their pretended union evolve into something real before dark forces threaten to tear them apart?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Mikaeri wo Motomeru Athena-san
title_english: Ms. Athena Expects Something in Return
title_japanese: 見返りを求めるアテナさん
synopsis:
Ishida is a boy who lives by the motto: "Don't expect anything from people—just keep doing good deeds." Right after entering high school, Ishida meets a blonde beauty, Athena Fujisaki, whose beliefs are the complete opposite of his. She absolutely wants to help anyone in need—however, she is not a pure-hearted good person. She's a peculiar and dangerous girl who demands an equal return for every favor she does! A coming of age comedy about a well-meaning but chaotic girl whose goodwill goes off the rails and the laid-back boy caught in her wake!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Ano sa, Maki-san
synopsis: A tale of slightly awkward youths in neighboring seats.

title: In My Sleep
title_japanese: 내가 잠이 든 사이(feat. 나쁜 친구들)
synopsis:
Yeona and her three longtime friends have shared an unshakable bond for years, one so familiar it feels safe from romance. Believing none of them see her as a woman, she lets her guard down and falls asleep at Taehyeok's place. But in the stillness of the night, a lingering touch awakens desires that have been carefully hidden, and a single moment of weakness begins to unravel their friendship into something far more dangerous and irresistibly tempting.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Make Me Purr
synopsis:
Jipil is a recently divorced man with no major flaws, just a few lingering emotional bruises. One night, after drinking a bit too much, he picks up a stray cat on the street and brings it home.

But the next morning, the creature in his bed is not a cat at all. It is Myohyeon, a runaway catgirl with ears, a tail, and her own share of complicated circumstances.

Memories of the "dream" he thought he had, the night he spent with her, suddenly come rushing back. Myohyeon insists he take responsibility and let her stay with him. Before Jipil can even argue, his friend shows up at the door.

Panicked, Jipil introduces Myohyeon, in her cat form, as the pet he is raising. And just like that, living together becomes unavoidable.

With a few ground rules set, the two begin an awkward but strangely sweet cohabitation. Can they follow the rules and keep life peaceful, or will the unexpected feelings between them break every boundary?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Futari no Shiawase na Seiryaku Kekkon
synopsis:
Arcad, human royalty of the Western Kingdom, is entering into a political marriage with the Chancellor of the North-East Magic Nation.

Despite his frightening appearance, his new husband, Denev, is brilliant, wise, and a perfect gentleman. He doesn't demand even Arcad's presence for their first matrimonial night, let alone anything else. So Arcad has a long, peaceful and uneventful political marriage ahead of him to look forward to...

If he could only stop thinking for 5 minutes how much he'd like to get it on with his new perfect gentleman of a husband.

(Source: MU)

title: Keiyaku Shimasho: Otsukaresama Joshi, Sewayaki Akuma to Kurasu

A demon named Adele appears before Hitsuji, a single office worker who leads a busy life! After making a contract with the demon, Hitsuji and Adele begin living together. While their life as a demon and a human may seem odd, it turns out to be surprisingly comfortable...!?

synopsis:
Toshiya just got himself his first-ever girlfriend, Ren, and things are going great. Not only is she super cute and kind, but she's also smart. There's just one problem... she's a total prude and won't let Toshiya have sex with her until they're married. Toshiya is going to respect Ren's wishes, but that all changes when he meets her slob of an older sister...

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: It Starts With Stalking
synopsis:
Taeha, who works as a cook at a restaurant, is always alone without anyone approaching him due to his bully-like appearance. Then one day, he meets Joowon, a part-time worker, at a cafe he went to on a coffee errand, and unlike himself, there are many people around him. He starts to admire him for his kind personality. In the end, he secretly takes pictures and spies his social media, becoming more and more of a stalker. Before long, he gets caught by JooWon...

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Hoshokusha-kei Mahou Shoujo
synopsis:
With humanity on the brink of extinction due to the deadly Incubi invasion, only powerful magical girls can save the day—so long as they survive!

When the Incubi emerged, humanity was rocked to its core. These otherworldly monsters invaded the world and captured humans, using them for breeding purposes. Only the Witches, magical girls bestowed with powers from supernatural beings, stand a chance against the creatures. High schooler Renka Azuma happens to be one of them, and fights back as Silver Lotus, a witch who can control swarms of insects able to devour the Incubi. Her days are lonely but her mission is clear: destroy every last Incubi out there.

Things take a turn when Silver Lotus comes across a novice witch named Azure Nova, saving her from a close call. She's surprised to learn that Azure is a self-proclaimed fan of hers and wants to work together! Suddenly, her dark, solitary days begin to grow a little brighter. 

But the Witches have a responsibility to protect humanity s

title: Renkinjutsushi no Yurufuwa Ritou Kaitakuki
title_japanese: 錬金術師のゆるふわ離島開拓記
synopsis:
No one can deny that Freya is a prodigy. And this genius has high hopes for her life after graduation, hopefully working in a wonderful workshop in a bustling city. So naturally, she gets assigned to a backwater island far to the south instead! The local guardian deity is a mythical beast named Lilil who deplores the awful state the island is in. Lilil asks Freya to develop the island with the help of alchemy, and Freya just can't turn down fluffiness! Freia quickly gets to work and creates high-quality potions, a box that produces cool air, and more amazing magic tools. And that's just the start for this genius alchemist's plans!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Venus Mission: Moto Koroshiya de Youhei no Chuunen, Yuusha no Ansatsu wo Irai sare Isekai Tensei!
title_english: Venus Mission: I Was an Assassin-for-Hire Who Died, Now I'm Hunting Heroes in Another World

synopsis:
Takashi Suzuki, a middle-aged mercenary and former hit man, just lost his battle with cancer. But death isn't the end for a killer of his caliber. A mysterious goddess has other plans: reincarnate him in a fantasy world—and give him a divine kill order: eliminate thirty-two heroes.

These so-called heroes? Japanese high schoolers summoned en masse, granted cheat-level powers, and now plunging the world into chaos.

Reborn as Rei and partnered with the beautiful and deadly elf warrior Lydina, Suzuki must bring every skill he has to the battlefield—from modern combat tactics and classical martial arts to his newly awakened magic. But this mission is more than a bloodbath. The goddess's true motives remain shrouded, and a larger conspiracy is unfolding behind the scenes. Can Rei survive long enough to cross every name off his list—including a Sword Saint, an Arch Sage, and a deadly Necromancer?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Ano Hana ga Saku Oka de, Kimi to Mata Deaetara.

Kano Yuri is frustrated by her unchanging, boring life. After fighting with her mother, she decides to run away, hoping to find a new purpose. But when she spends the night in an air-raid shelter, she wakes up in a completely different time! 

Alone in a time that’s not hers, she meets a handsome Kamikaze pilot who could help her—if her feelings don’t get in the way. Just what lies in store for this modern girl and soldier from the past?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Jo Yeon-oh is an extreme dominant alpha, heir to the Haeseong Foundation and CEO of Naban Gallery. By his side since childhood is beta So Gi-hyeon, who has quietly watched over him for years while nurturing his love alone. What once seemed like an unbreakable relationship begins to crack the moment Gi-hyeon confesses. The instant Gi-hyeon reveals the long held feelings in his heart, Yeon-oh responds with a humiliating dry heave.

"You forgot that you're a beta."

An alpha who feels a visceral disgust toward dating a beta. Faced with such cruel, bone deep rejection, Gi-hyeon tries to quietly bury his feelings, but Yeon-oh refuses even that. Driven by selfish obsession and a need for control over what he considers his, Jo Yeon-oh will not allow Gi-hyeon to leave his side.

"Fine. Let's date. You selfish bastard."

Instead of cutting ties, what begins is a deceitful relationship. Yet because it is Yeon-oh's choice, Gi-hyeon accepts it without protest.

synopsis:
Method actor Park Seha and flop idol Sohn Ji-eon are cast as lovers in a queer crime film. What begins as open hostility born from clashing backgrounds slowly transforms through forced rehearsals and intimate method acting. As Ji-eon's sincerity and relentless effort break down Seha's defenses, professional boundaries blur into dangerous attraction. Determined to call their growing closeness a "mistake," both men struggle to separate acting from reality. Caught between obsession and devotion, they must decide whether their connection is merely part of the role... or something real.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Tensei Teido de Mune no Ana wa Umaranai
title_english: The Hole in My Heart Cannot Be Filled with Reincarnation
title_japanese: 転生程度で胸の穴は埋まらない
synopsis:
The series is set in a world where people can turn their desires into magic. Particularly strong magicians, known as the Adept, are tasked with protecting the world from threats. Konoe, a man who was reincarnated into this world, lives with the trauma of his past life and has become distrustful of others. His disillusion grows as he trains to become an Adept, his disillusion not going away even after becoming an Adept. However, following an encounter with a sick woman named Telnerica, his life changes, seeing Telnerica as filling the void that has long existed in his heart.

(Source: Wikipedia)

title: Mismatch Guide
synopsis:
"Guide, I think the first thing we need to do... is tie up these rude hands of yours."

Pil Hyunseo is an SS-rank Esper with a gentleman's face and a god complex that puts all humans beneath his feet. And Jung Wooyeon is an S-rank Guide whose sense of justice is so strong he can't stay quiet in the face of wrongdoing.

Their first meeting starts off ordinary enough... until Wooyeon's unhesitating fist sends everything spiraling off course. After that incident, Hyunseo becomes determined to keep Wooyeon by his side, forcing a pair-match between them. What begins as curiosity soon twists into obsession.

Wooyeon tries to escape. Hyunseo refuses to let go.

As the two clash again and again, the wounds and truths they've kept hidden begin to surface. And slowly—almost imperceptibly—their relationship starts to shift into something neither of them expected.

(Source: Ridi, translated)

title: Heavenly Bodies
synopsis:
Obsessed lab hermit Han Woojin has a scandalous secret: his passion for science is literal. When he hits a breakthrough, his body reacts with an uncontrollable, physical intensity that has earned him the nickname Mad Woojin. Driven by cold logic, he treks to Deokmu Mountain to debunk rumors of a gold-granting goblin. Instead, he finds Baekbaek, a breathtaking god of wealth. Forget the gold, Woojin has found the ultimate specimen...and he's ready to experiment until they both reach their limit.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Honzuki no Gekokujou: Shisho ni Naru Tame ni wa Shudan wo Erandeiraremasen Dai 5-bu - Togireta Chishiki wo Tsunageyou!

title: Kigoku no Yoru
synopsis:
In an isolated village, there dwells a demon that devours people and rapes women to death...! What was supposed to have been a fun excursion for childhood friends turns into a hellish landscape when they stumble upon a cursed abandoned village.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title_japanese: わたしたちがわたなれ同人誌作れるわけないじゃん! ムリムリ!!(※ムリじゃなかった!?)

title: Dolly In, Dolly Out
synopsis:
A rising young director sets out to cast his next project and becomes fixated on a particular actor who refuses to be easily won over. A bold casting offer turns into an even bolder counterproposal, pulling the two into a delicate negotiation where ambition and attraction collide. As their collaboration moves forward, the line between work and romance begins to blur, setting the stage for a relationship neither of them planned.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: My Perfect Boyfriend
synopsis:
Ahn Chawoo is the ultimate magnet for terrible boyfriends. Every relationship ends the same way, and the latest one does not even last six months before ending in betrayal. Why is love never on his side? Is it really too much to hope for a boyfriend who is polite, handsome, fit, and, well, generously endowed? Chawoo cannot help feeling the universe is being unfair.

“Forget it. I am done with dating.”

But just as he swears off romance, someone catches his eye, Nam Doha, who happens to be polite, handsome, fit, and…everything else on his list. Of course, Doha looks like the definition of a straight campus golden boy, so Chawoo quickly crushes his own interest.

Until Doha suddenly lights up and says, “Wow, really? Then could you buy me lunch tomorrow?”

A throwaway comment, taken seriously. Maybe, just maybe, this time will be different.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Can I Cry Now?
synopsis:
After killing his brother, Clois ascends to the throne. His desire to become emperor was not for personal gain but for the sake of his beloved wife and soon-to-be-born child. However, upon his return, the corpses of his wife and child greeted him, demonstrating the futility of his efforts.

Seven years later, he couldn't find joy in anything in the world. So, he didn't care about the re-opening of the gifted academy's admissions after seven years. Until he saw a wrinkled application form rolling on the floor. Instead of trying to enroll the child in the gifted academy, he offered various excuses. The document, thrown away like trash without even being considered due to being from a workhouse.

"I approve this child's admission." He wasn't particularly interested. It was just a warning to those who tried to act arbitrarily. So he couldn't even remember the name of the child he picked.

"My name is Ivy Alden."

The child he met in front of his wife's and daughter's graves resembled the d

title: Salt Heart
synopsis:
Choi Asel, a waiter working at the bar Nante, simply serves drinks one night and ends up receiving an unusually large tip from Seo Jinhyeok. For some reason, Asel can't forget that day.

A month later, Asel is being sexually harassed in a private room when Jinhyeok, who hadn't shown his face since then, suddenly appears and rescues him.

"Does he remember me...?"

Just as hope starts to bloom, what Jinhyeok pulls out in front of Asel is...

"This is a token of my sincerity."

...a check.

(Source: Ridi, translated)

title: Things That Deserve to Die
synopsis:
Contract killer Lee Jagyeong's gun never misses, piercing the heart with flawless precision. It does not matter how bad the target is. He takes the job, kills the mark, gets paid, and that is the end of it. The only things he believes in are his own skills and money.

Then one day, a sudden high paying request comes in from a regular client. Five million dollars, with a single condition: Kill Kang Ilhyeon and retrieve one item from his safe.

The target is the son of Korea's crime syndicate kingpin. Kang Ilhyeon is a man with sharp, serpentine eyes. Standing inside a trap Ilhyeon has laid out, Jagyeong finds himself slowly being cornered, the noose tightening around his neck.

Will Jagyeong succeed in killing Kang Ilhyeon and completing the job, or will he meet a pointless death himself?

(Source: Ridi, translated)

title: Error Code
synopsis:
On the brink of a major update, the lead developer of a full-sensory VR game uncovers a fatal bug and is pulled into the world he built. Trapped inside a stage that responds to touch, breath, and desire, he's offered a single way out: complete a cryptic quest from an unseen presence. As the game blurs sensation and control, survival means surrendering to rules far more intimate than code.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Life as the Grand Duke's Daughter-in-Law Is Too Easy
Boukensha License wo Hakudatsu sareta Ossan dakedo, Manamusume ga Dekita node Nonbiri Jinsei wo Ouka suru
title_english: Enjoy New Life with My Daughter
title_japanese: 冒険者ライセンスを剥奪されたおっさんだけど、愛娘ができたのでのんびり人生を謳歌する
synopsis:
Douglas, once known as a legendary enhancement spellcaster, is now little more than your average, weak old man. On top of that, he was kicked out of the hero party, and eventually had his adventurer's license revoked... And that's how he ended up a vagabond, wandering aimlessly. After an encounter with Rabi, a cursed little girl, a new adventure begins...

(Source: Square Enix)

title: To Hell with the Status Window
synopsis:
The strongest man of the murim, Asura, got transported to another world. Having reached the pinnacle through his martial capabilities alone, he smashes the status window and the tower with his own hands—rejecting participation as a player outright.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: A Spirited Seduction
synopsis:
Thanks to the divine general's spirit, Yoo Eun-Cheon has become one of the most popular and rich shamans in Korea. But, when a night of passion results in him accidentally transferring that spirit to Lee Do-Rim, his cozy life is thrust into jeopardy. Thankfully, Lee Do-Rim is interested in Eun-Cheon. Can the disgraced shaman leverage that attraction into regaining control over the divine general?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: A World Without You
synopsis:
There's only one thing that's keeping Han Sekye alive: the blond man in his dreams. No matter how bad it gets, how lonely he is, he can count on the man to come meet him in his dreams and make it all okay. So what is he to do when the man suddenly stops coming? Sekye falls apart and for years, he struggles with depression living on in a world without the man. Then one day, Woo Yijun appears in front of him, looking just like the man in his dreams. And seeing that he is an aspiring actor, Sekye hires Yijun to act out for him the man from his dreams. Sekye knows that it isn't the same, that this can't go on, but he so needs the world that used to be his...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: XX a Modest Younger Brother's Friend
Akuyaku Reijou no Mamahaha ni Tensei shita node Musume wo Shiawase ni Shimasu, Chikarazuku de. the Comic

synopsis:
Selene, is reincarnated into the world of a otome game. She realizes that her stepdaughter, Ati, the daughter of the marquis family she married into, is destined to become the "villainess." But young Ati is... just like an "angel." How could you not love such a cute child? I will protect this stepdaughter, who was abused by her stepmother and raised without love, with all my might! "I will never let this child become a villainess!"

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

synopsis: A powerful mage is reassigned to a remote region so that her spells won't damage the capital.

title: The Terminal Teacher in the Doomed Duke's House
title_english: The Terminal Teacher in the Doomed Duke's House
synopsis:
Livia Plington is out of luck. Not only was her fortune stolen, but she's caught a fatal disease, and the only thing that can save her is the mysterious heirloom of House Mercedes. Livia's solution? Infiltrate Mercedes Manor as the young lord's private tutor and find the heirloom herself! But as Livia plays teacher, she comes to care for her student and even the tragic Duke Mercedes too. Can she heal the hearts of this family as well as heal herself? Or is this terminal teacher doomed to die?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kyuusei no Kishi Hime Faran
title_english: Faran, the Knight Princess of Salvation
title_japanese: 救世の騎士姫 ファラン
synopsis:
A girl named Faran, born as one of the Tokoyo People, a race said to possess the power to rule the world. However, her clan was wiped out by a mysterious force, leaving her as the sole survivor. Six years later, carrying vengeance in her heart, she sets out for the Empire. Along the way, she encounters a magical beast subjugation squad. Its leader is the beautiful imperial prince, Iris. After meeting him, Faran ends up accompanying the subjugation mission—and in the moment she shields a hunted magical beast, her hidden power awakens...! Will the scheming prince really leave such a free-spirited, extraordinary girl alone!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: This Is How You Take Revenge
synopsis:
Grace, a girl who lost her parents and even her family, has held only one thing in her heart for 13 years: revenge. And then there's Ares, who lost everything to the same enemy. Seeking revenge, Grace proposes a fake relationship with him, and the two enter into a cold pact. However, the feelings that sprout in the flames of revenge gradually blossom into love, and she fears that these feelings will become an obstacle to her revenge. Caught between revenge and love, what choice will these two make as they race towards the end?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

2. Hai Kyuu Ai

5. Kakioroshi
