8. Namaiki Lipp
9. Hakuchuu no Yume

title: Tatsumaki
synopsis:
A novelist, who is such a slump that he is actually thinking about selling his life and soul, meets a mysterious man and discusses the art of writing, and how things such as reality and existing conventions prevent him from writing. A strange series of events entangles a test knitter working under a harsh conditions, a frivolous man using online dating apps, and a woman carrying a corpse.

(Source: Shu-Cream, translated)

title: Amakuchi Tenshi to Spicy
title_japanese: あまくち天使とスパイシー
synopsis:
A demon as an angel's tutor?! As punishment for a certain incident, veteran demon Mark was assigned work in the human world. Then, pure and bubbly newbie angel Ten was sent to him! Though bewildered by the order that being this angel's "tutor" was part of his job, Mark found himself unexpectedly doting on the rather unreliable Ten. Then one night, they end up having a private lesson in 'purifying sins' using Mark's body...?! Naughty, sweet and spicy! The tale of an angel and a devil living together in the human world♪

(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)

title: The Politician Who Can See the Future
synopsis:
Fifteen years ago, his father, fighting against unfair dismissal, took his own life amidst the indifference of a conglomerate. Before the shock had even subsided, his younger brother vanished without a trace. Faced with a series of tragedies, his parents ultimately passed away, leaving Do-jun alone. Since that day, when everything was taken from him, Do-jun has lived for revenge and truth. Realizing that he could not change anything without standing at the center of power, He endured his lonely days with the sole goal of becoming a politician. And on the day he finally received his diploma, he swore before his parents' urns:

"I will find Yu-ri and bring her here to this very place."

"And those bastards...I will make them shed tears of blood."

That night, Do-jun had his first "dream of the future." A vision too vivid to be a coincidence. And that dream foreshadowed the brutal path he would take in politics.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Ryuuzaki-san ga Ore no Mae dake de Dereru Riyuu
title_japanese: 竜崎さんが俺の前だけでデレるリユウ

title: Love Rebooted
synopsis:
It's been a while since all androids have been outlawed. Soojung's never been one for technology, let alone androids. So it's a big surprise when her sister gets her a new job... and it's to keep an eye on her illegal android. Soojung feels uncomfortable around him as it is. He's weirdly too polite, has no emotion in his eyes, and he hasn't even got a name. But what Soojung doesn't know yet is that she's going to change all that. And what's more, this android is going to change her life too, in more ways than one...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Friend Girlfriend
title_japanese: フレンドガールフレンド
synopsis:
Yuuki and Asaka are childhood friends and best friends. One day Asaka, who had been confessed to by a boy, tells Yuuki, "I'm going to try dating him, just for the experience." Yuuki, unhappy at the thought of her best friend being swept away by some rando, finds herself wondering...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Love Me Like You Owe Me
title_english: Love Me Like You Owe Me
synopsis:
In order to pay off his mother's crushing debt, Woo Minjo finds himself delivering coffee in high heels to a construction firm run by the notorious gangster, Chu Gio. What starts as a misfortune spirals into a bizarre fate, as Gio quickly takes an interest in Minjo. And before he knows it, Minjo goes from a broke errand boy to the unlikely "bride" of a thug...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Hito no Kensaku Rireki ga Mireru Nouryoku
title_japanese: 人の検索履歴がみれる能力

title: Kimi to Sakura no Hanataba wo
Shingan no Merla
synopsis:
Magicians are special beings blessed by the Gods. Under the guidance of a former elite Nero, Merla trains diligently in magic together with her childhood friend, Silver. While living with the talented Nero and Silver, she was unable to gain confidence. Then, an invitation for the entrance examination of the prestigious Veolia School of Witchcraft arrived. This is a story about the two rising stars on a classic magical fantasy about talent!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Staging
synopsis:
Despite only being in high school, Fuji also works as a manga artist publishing a series. But one day, after a certain incident, he finds himself demanded by his classmate Nazuna to advise her on "showmanship" for her dance performance…?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Staging
synopsis:
Despite only being in high school, Fuji also works as a manga artist publishing a series. But one day, after a certain incident, he finds himself demanded by his classmate Nazuna to advise her on "showmanship" for her dance performance…?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Kouun no Shokichi ga Ijou ni Takakatta Koukousei ga, Kanzume Gacha de Te ni Ireta Skill wo Tsukatte Gendai Dungeon de Saikyou ni Naru Monogatari
title_japanese: 幸運の初期値が異常に高かった高校生が、缶詰ガチャで手に入れたスキルを使って現代ダンジョンで最強になる物語
synopsis:
Ten years ago, mysterious, laid-back characters called Danpons arrived from another world and created dungeons that have become a part of everyday life in Japan.

High school student Taira Ichino is invited by friends to explore the dungeon at Osaka Umeda Station. However, the place is teeming with people, making it impossible to defeat monsters properly. All he acquires are minimal experience points and a mysterious canned item called the "D-Can," whose contents and method of opening remain unknown.

Back home, as Taira yearns for a personal dungeon, the D-Can suddenly opens. Inside, he discovers a candy that allows him to learn skills.

This is the story of an ordinary high school student who, through sheer luck alone, sets his sights on a goal and relentlessly strives to become the strongest explorer.

(Source: Bushiroad Works, translated)

title: I've Become a True Villainess
synopsis:
I have to survive, no matter what!

I've died and been reincarnated as the villain of a romance novel! In order to avoid the hideous fate that awaits me, I've righted her wrongs and even gotten engaged. I should be home free, but strange things have started happening ever since the heroine appeared. Why won't her fiancé leave me alone?

(Source: Manta)

title: Slip
synopsis:
Minori—40 years old, single, and president of a design company—thought that he knew by now how to hide his feelings and handle his life. But then, at a friend's wedding, he meets his old business partner Takuya, and one touch is enough to undo him. "You're like an old married couple," people around them joke. But are they really? And how does one even begin to navigate a relationship between two men like them?

(Source: Julian Publishing, translated)

title: District 12
synopsis:
100 years after the devastation of a nuclear World War III, a small group of humanity managed to survive and unite to form a "world government." This organization brings together the greatest minds to rebuild society, establish order, and create safe zones called "Domes" where humans can live without fear of radiation or crime. As the population grows, the government sets its sights on constructing a Dome in District 12, located in Seoul, the Korean peninsula. However, powerful criminal organizations that have long dominated the area are determined to prevent the government's project from encroaching on their territory.

To thwart these criminal organizations and ensure the successful construction of the new Dome, the Korean Division of the world government deploys their top law enforcer, code-named "Alpha," and the newly appointed government administrator of the Seoul Division, "Amber."

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Oda Nobunaga ni Hyoui sareta Akuyaku Reijou wa Tenka Touitsu shitakunai!
title_japanese: 織田信長に憑依された悪役令嬢は天下統一したくない!
synopsis:
Risha, an extremely shy young woman, is falsely accused of injuring Tokia, a countess, at a party one day. However, this was a trap by Tokia to gain control of her family's land. Risha is framed as a villainous daughter, and as punishment for injuring Tokia, she is placed under house arrest in a stable. While she is burned by Tokia's friends and has no way to escape, Nobunaga Oda comes to possess her. The birth of a great impudent young lady!

(Source: MU)

title: Koishita Hito wa, Imouto no Kawari ni Shindekure to Itta. Imouto to Kekkon shita Kataomoi Aite ga Naze Imasara Watashi no Moto ni? To Omottara
title_japanese: 恋した人は、妹の代わりに死んでくれと言った。―妹と結婚した片思い相手がなぜ今さら私のもとに?と思ったら―
synopsis:
Lady Wisteria's greatest wish is to be worthy of the man she loves, Lord Bright. But when Wisteria's little sister, Rosalie, is selected to enter the Predawn Realm as its guardian, never to return, Bright begs Wisteria to take Rosalie's place! After all, Wisteria is skilled with magic, and resistant to the sinister miasma that threatens the mortal world. Heartbroken, Wisteria enters the Predawn Realm, accompanied by the sacred sword, Sartis. More than twenty years later, a stranger with a familiar face appears, demanding the sword and challenging Wisteria. Who is he, and why does he resemble Lord Bright...?

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Kuzu wa Eien wo Yume Minai
title_english: What's Wrong with Being a Jerk?
title_japanese: クズは永遠を夢見ない

title: Obscene Neighbors
synopsis:
Yoojoo has a specific taste when it comes to men: they must have broad, beautiful chests. She's never met her ideal chest before, until she finds it on Dojin, her next door neighbor since childhood. After a drunken night where Yoojoo gets to have a taste of Dojin's deliciously perfect pecs, she earns his forgiveness by being his errand girl and promising to let him do the same to her if she ever lays hands on his chest again. But there's no way it will happen again, obviously. Or so she thought...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Houkago, Voca-ken de!
synopsis:
Mira Sasaki is a first-year high school student who wants to have the youthful experience of being in a band. She tells a teacher that she wants to join the pop music band, but to her surprise, it has been disbanded! In fact, almost all music-related clubs had been wiped out! Facing this unprecedented circumstance, Mira joins the only active music-related club: the Vocaloid Research Club. She doesn't have the slightest clue what "vocaloid" means, but her worries are quickly put to rest. She is soon surrounded by upperclassmen overflowing with their love for vocaloid. Whether you love vocaloid or don't know about it yet, everyone is warmly welcomed! Voca-ken's laid-back, short comedy has begun! ♪

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Yuusha kara wa Nigerarenai
title_japanese: 勇者からは逃げられない
synopsis:
In an age where humanity is losing against the Demon King's army, everyone has been searching for a "Hero." Solo, a thief creeping around at the bottom of society, hears a rumor: "On a certain hill there's a "Holy Sword" that only the Hero can pull out. Aiming for a quick fortune, Solo tries to steal the sword—pedestal and all—but for some reason, the "Holy Sword" comes out. Treated as the "Hero" for having drawn the Holy Sword, Solo is poised to face the fate of the entire world.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: The Demonic Supreme Sword
synopsis:
The Soaring Heaven Demonic Cult achieved unification after 300 years thanks to Sama Geon. He had one wish: to live an ordinary life with his family. Returning to his hometown, he learned butchery and began a small business, but his younger sister's illness forced him to wield a sword once again—and the Soaring Heaven Demonic Cult is threatening his serene life. For the sake of peace, he must wield his sword once more.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Prism Rondo
title_japanese: プリズム輪舞曲〈ロンド〉
synopsis:
The dawn of the 20th century, a difficult period for women to realize their dreams. At an art academy in London, Lili, a Japanese art student chasing her dreams, meets Kit, an artistic prodigy from a family of aristocrats. Their meeting, transcending social status and their home countries, will set their fates in motion...!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Omochi Kaeri desu♥
synopsis:
1. Ofuro de 2-dome no Hatsukoi wo (Second First Love in the Bath)
2. Shojo na Watashi ja Dame desu ka? (Is It Bad That I'm a Virgin?)
3. Kisei Jijitsu kara Hajimemashou (Let's Start Off By Sealing the Deal)
4. Marin-chan wa Gaman Dekinai♡ (Marin-chan Can't Hold Back!♡)
5. Hokenshitsu no Mari-chan-sensei (Mari-chan-sensei's Office)
6. Yakimochi Kanojo ni Goyoujin! (Beware of Jealous Girlfriends!)
7. Toshi no Sa nante Kinishinai!? (Age Gaps Don't Bother You!?)
8. Manneri Dasshutsu Daisakusen! (A Grand Strategy to Shake Things Up)

title: Kounai Renai shitara Kubi♡
synopsis:
Shuuya Imari (26) works at a high school with a strict new policy: "In-school romance is forbidden—break this rule and you're fired." As a serious professional, he figures teachers shouldn't be wasting time on love when they have students to look after anyway. But his convictions are shaken when the school's new and strikingly handsome nurse, Rio Yotsuumi (22), begins pursuing him with alarming devotion!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Ichimei-sama Okotowari
synopsis:
A food stall ran by a mysterious female owner exclusively for undeads. The only customers here are undeads. Vampires, phoenixes, lifeless golems, and heroes cursed with immortality. Tonight, those with all sorts of backgrounds, tired of life, will awaken to life with gourmet food!

Mandrakes and explosive nitro bees! Delicious enough to kill you, but you'll die if you eat it! Delicious food is bad for your body!

An undead gourmet comic full of deadly poison bursts forth!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Hi no Tori: Reimei-hen
synopsis:
In a mythical age of ancient Japan, Nagi Iza, a young boy living on one of the southern islands, is on a quest to find the legendary Phoenix and save his dying father. Believing the magical healing properties of the blood of the mysterious bird is the only way to cure his father, Nagi sets off on a mission to climb up Fire Mountain, a local volcano and the home of the Phoenix.

(Source: Tezuka in English)

title: Juuji Tonbo wa Sora wo Tobanai
title_english: The Cross-Winged Does Not Fly Through the Sky.
title_japanese: 十字トンボは空を飛ばない
synopsis:
Nanami Itou, who has been quietly creating a yuri doujinshi novel, reunites with her old friend Kaori Aoto at a class reunion. Nanami gets drunk and asks Kaori, who still draws illustrations, to draw the cover for her doujinshi. Kaori readily agrees. However, Nagisa has caused various problems in the doujinshi community and been ostracized...!?

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Kuroneko no Kenshi: Black na Party wo Yametara S-kyuu Boukensha ni Scout saremashita. Imasara "Modottekite" to Iwaretemo "Mou Osoi" desu
title_japanese: 黒猫の剣士～ブラックなパーティを辞めたらS級冒険者にスカウトされました。今さら「戻ってきて」と言われても「もう遅い」です～
serializations: Suiyoubi wa Mattari Dash X Comic
synopsis:
With a magic value of 1, which is as close to 0 as possible, and the lowest adventurer rank of "F," Nine spends his days as an attacker in a party that has found him, but he and his beloved cat, Enu, are forced to do all the chores. However, one day, the leader sells off the black sword, a memento of Nine's father, without permission, and even uses violence against his precious Enu and Nine's patience reaches its limit! "I'm quitting now!'' Nine, determined to leave the party and start a new life, is suddenly confronted by an S-rank adventurer "Dahlia of Flash." And then he is scouted by the strongest party on the continent, "Red Hawk"...?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Shousetsu-ban Make a Girl: Make Myself
title_japanese: 小説版メイクアガール メイクマイセルフ

title: Akuyaku Reijou, Shomin ni Ochiru
title_japanese: 悪役令嬢、庶民に堕ちる
synopsis:
A salaryman was suddenly killed one day. When he woke up, for some reason he became Kotone Kisaragi, the selfish daughter of a famous family. Taking over the life of the daughter who was disowned by her parents' house, he decided to lead a normal daily life. However, because of the original Kotone, he can't live a normal life!

(Source: Gentosha, translated)

title: The Trap of Pleasure
synopsis:
Hoseon has suffered from the war Jang started for far too long, and hope has grown scarce, but pharmacist Doha Shin is determined to save as many lives as he can until the very end.

Except, he wasn't expecting to manifest as an omega at his age, and he wasn't expecting to wake up surrounded by Hoseon's army. He can't remember the face of the alpha who found and brought him here, and he never got his name. Now, saving the lives of these soldiers could mean saving the life of his love.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: [Live] The Hunt Begins
synopsis:
When Hwieon survives his brother's demonic attack, a grim reaper leaves him one cryptic mission: find the living Hungerwraith. Now a reluctant ghost-hunting streamer, he crosses paths with Gyeol—the worst possible ally, and the one person he can't seem to walk away from.

(Source: Manta)

title: Rock and Rent
synopsis:
When Wushin moves into his new place, the last person he expects to run into is Jaehyeok, the same guy who made his school days a living hell. Out of work and behind on rent, Jaehyeok ends up crashing at Wushin's apartment, turning his peaceful new start into pure chaos. Instead of the terrifying bully from his memories, Wushin now finds a lazy freeloader who trashes the house and drives him up the wall. But the Jaehyeok he remembers wasn't always like this; he used to shine so brightly it hurt to look. What could have happened to turn him into such a mess, and can Wushin survive living under the same roof as the one man he swore he'd never see again?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Lust and Found
synopsis:
Seokjun only wanted one thing: peace and quiet. Tormented night after night by the nonstop sexcapades of his new neighbor, Yechan, he reaches a breaking point and prays for the man's "precious equipment" to disappear. The next morning, the moans are gone...and so is Yechan's manhood. Shocked by the eerie coincidence, Seokjun feels guilty enough to try to help...but Yechan seems more interested in using him as a solution than finding one. What begins as a bizarre curse quickly spirals into a chaotic, heated romance between the man who wished it away and the man desperate to get it back.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Usoda Minori no Fake Kitchen
title_japanese: 宇曽田みのりの代用料理〈フェイクキッチン〉

title: Dokuro-san ga Miteiru
title_japanese: どくろさんが見ている

title: Ore ga Shift no Toki dake Baito-saki no Kissaten ni Kuru, Class no Bishoujo Model-sama
title_japanese: 俺がシフトの時だけバイト先の喫茶店に来る、クラスの美少女モデル様
synopsis:
After school, I'm the only one who knows what my classmate truly feels when she visits the café. A love story connecting a coffee-loving high school boy and a cool, beautiful model.

Shizuku Kamisaka, the beautiful model currently trending everywhere. Cool and composed. And—my classmate. She's popular both in school and in the public eye. Meanwhile, Juntarou Mikage, whose only notable trait is working part-time at a café after school, lives in a completely different world. They were two people who were never supposed to cross paths—but then...

"Welcome... wait, Kamisaka?"
"Mi... Mikage-kun?"

One day, Shizuku bursts into the café with tears in her eyes—!?

This is a love story about a coffee-loving high school boy and the cool, beautiful model from his class, brought together over a single cup of coffee.

(Source: SB Creative, translated)

title: Game no Sekai ni Tensei shitara Ore ga 〇〇 ni Naru made
title_japanese: ゲームの世界に転生した俺が〇〇になるまで
synopsis: After his grandparents—the last of his family—pass away, Kariya finds himself free to discover what awaits outside the harsh confines of his remote mountain village. However, beyond its borders lies a world embroiled in the fires of war, and Kariya is conscripted into the army before he can take his first step toward freedom. It doesn't take him long to realize the truth: this world is a near carbon copy of a game he played in his previous life. When his identity as a reincarnated player comes to light, Kariya is tasked with a perilous mission to escort Wald, a handsome prince disguised as his twin sister the princess, safely through enemy territory and back to the royal capital. But Kariya isn't the only one who knows the secret of this world—and having the combat proficiency of a common NPC won't keep anyone safe. Armed only with player foresight and the skills of an S-tier craftsman, he'll need every ounce of cunning he can muster to turn the tides of battle and bring his prince hom

title: Game no Sekai ni Tensei shitara Ore ga 〇〇 ni Naru made
title_english: Finding My Way to (You) in This MMO World
title_japanese: ゲームの世界に転生した俺が〇〇になるまで

title: Love Diary
synopsis:
"I want to build it together—the time between you and me."

Six young people who are still inexperienced in love. Within the bonds of being lovers, they learn to understand one another, share their thoughts, and finally come to truly face themselves.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Last Boss Toubatsugo ni Hajimeru Nishuume Boukensha Life: Hajimari no Machi de Wakeari Bishoujo-tachi ga Mechakucha Natsuitekimasu
title_english: New Game Plus After Defeating the Last Boss: All These Beautiful, Problematic Girls in the First Town Have Gotten Really Attached to Me...
title_japanese: ラスボス討伐後に始める二周目冒険者ライフ はじまりの街でワケあり美少女たちがめちゃくちゃ懐いてきます
synopsis:
Might the adventurer gave everything he had toward defeating the Demonic Dragon, and while he emerged victorious, it cost him his life. After the blessing of the goddess resurrected him, he’s back at level one. That barely matters though because he’s still ridiculously strong! He attracts the attention of many with his strength, and parties up with a harem of beautiful women! How will Might’s new adventures unfold?!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Konyakusha wo Sutetara, Tanoshii Mahou Gakkou no Seikatsu ga Matteimashita
title_english: Goodbye, Horrible Fiancé, Hello, Fun Magic School Life!
title_japanese: 婚約者を捨てたら、楽しい魔法学校の生活が待っていました!
synopsis:
Meet Misha, a strong-willed young lady betrayed by her fiancé. Refusing to take his treachery lying down, she punches him to teach him a lesson before canceling their engagement. Misha tries to use her newfound freedom to enroll in magic school, but a certain issue comes to light, forcing her to give up. However, during the entrance exam interview phase, she resolves a problem with herbs, earning the favor of the exam proctor, meaning that... Misha makes it into the school of her dreams! But what awaits her isn't just a world of magic that makes her heart dance with delight. There's a jiggly slime spirit, too?! She eagerly dives into a hectic yet exciting second chapter of her life. Will it be everything she hoped for?

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

title: Josou Danshi to Dansou Joshi wa Oniai Couple
title_japanese: 女装男子と男装女子はお似合いカップル
synopsis:
A romcom about Yukari, a girl who dresses like a boy, and Shion, a boy who dresses like a girl. This story depicts the daily lives of a couple who fit each other perfectly.

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: You're Just My Type, Sir
synopsis:
To the world, Ivan Park is an impeccable CEO. To Yegeon, he is everything. The devoted secretary hides his all-consuming obsession behind quiet professionalism. But when a rival appears to steal Ivan's attention, jealousy drives Yegeon to dangerous extremes. Passion, power, and desire collide in a love that cannot stay hidden, leaving Ivan to question whether Yegeon's devotion is salvation or ruin.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: The Youngest Loves His Leader?!
synopsis:
Pit-a-Pat's fans ship everyone together except Taejoon and Minjae. Which should be a good thing, because they're already dating! But the group's youngest member, Taejoon, can't help feeling insecure when everyone adores his leader so damn much. 

Can their love story overcome the struggles of fame and fandom?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Lips
synopsis:
Taekseung is too busy getting through each day to think about the debris lodged in his skull, ready to kill him someday. He has no regrets, but he still wants to experience a happiness that will make him want to fight for his life. Enter Sunyeon, Taekseung's high school crush. Mishaps and miscommunication kickstart their casual, confusing relationship, but still—Taekseung is starting to feel like it's something...more.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Jiyujiyo
synopsis:
Ji-Yu, a timid high school girl who wants to live an ordinary life, saves her childhood friend Do-Kyung from jumping off the rooftop on the first day of moving in. Together with Do-Kyung, who was a victim of school bullying, Ji-Yu begins an unexpected high school survival story.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Komadori wa Imawa no Mezame
title_japanese: こまどりは今際の目醒め
synopsis:
Yoshiomi lived in a village steeped in twin worship, where he was forced to bear the burden of a "curse." One day, a certain incident brings him into contact with police officer Norito, and the two gradually find themselves drawn to each other. But then, his comatose twin brother Miwa suddenly vanishes...!?

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

title: Tsuihou sareta Meika no Chounan: Baka ni Sareta Hazure Skill de Saikyou e to Noboritsumeru
title_english: Sowing Vengeance: The Eldest Son's Disgraceful Green Thumb
title_japanese: 追放された名家の長男 ~馬鹿にされたハズレスキルで最強へと昇り詰める~
synopsis:
Disowned, disgraced, and doomed to be a farmer. Being "blessed" with a farmer affinity is practically a death sentence for Chris Sparring. It's nothing close to the sword-wielding class he'd been raised to inherit, that's for sure. To make matters worse, his twin brother receives the affinity of a sword god instead, and wastes no time funneling years of jealousy into an attempt on Chris's life. With nothing left to lose, Chris must find a way to make it on his own and avenge his name. And this "useless" poison resistance of his may be just what he needs to turn the tables!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: The Iron Overlord of Sichuan
synopsis:
Bearing the traitor's brand, Tang Se-un spent a lifetime creating the tools of the Murim's destruction, waiting for a single moment to strike. But when the decisive moment comes, he is instead thrust back in time, carrying the weight of a future that hasn't happened. Let the furnace roar, let the hammer sing, and let their blood quench the steel. The Demon Smith stands before the anvil once more to forge a path tempered in vengeance.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Kanojo ga Mukashi no Mama Sugiru!
title_japanese: カノジョが昔のまますぎる!
synopsis: A university student reunites with his elementary/middle-school girlfriend, whose appearance hasn't changed one bit.

title: Sayonara Flower Petal
title_japanese: さよならフラワーペタル
synopsis:
“I love sex. It’s simple and easy to understand.”

Hana and Maki are two friends who make a living by having sex with complete strangers and livestreaming it online. With no home to return to and nowhere they truly belong, their life is still, in its own way, happy. At least, it was… until a certain boy (Hokuto) appeared.

(Source: Funguild, translated)

title: Fukou Reijou deshita ga, Happy End wo Mukaemashita: Anthology Comic
title_japanese: 不幸令嬢でしたが、ハッピーエンドを迎えました アンソロジーコミック
authors: Yukimori, Sakura|Miasa, Rin|Ono, Anbi|Yuzuhara, Tail|Ichi, Kotoko|Seo, Yuuri|Oda, Hiro|Mitsuki, Beni|Rana|Seikan|acca|Yokoyama, Moyo|Kiyone, Kei|Mizume|Yunishima, Baku|Nishine, Hanami
synopsis: An anthology of romance fantasy short stories by various authors.

title: Kyou mo Ashita mo Warabii-sensei
title_japanese: きょうもあしたも蕨井先生
synopsis:
One day, a Japanese professor on a field expedition to Australia has the surprise of a lifetime when a wallaby suddenly falls on him from the trees above. The wallaby is slightly put out (as he explains quite calmly) because, you see, he was distracted while reading a book about one of his favorite subjects—bushido. He's a bit of an otaku and has always dreamed of going to Japan. The professor is instantly charmed, of course, and whisks Mr. Wallaby off to Japan. Mr. Wallaby, inspired by the professor, says he also wants to become a teacher...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Daughter of a Superstar
synopsis:
Rumin is an acting prodigy with a Newtube channel that often goes viral. As it happens, she is also the spitting image of her favorite A-list actor Jeong Hajin. A shocking turn of events reveals that Hajin is actually Rumin's biological father. The cold-hearted actor reluctantly takes her in, but pointedly vows no affection. However, as Rumin's raw talent shines, Hajin finds himself becoming an unlikely mentor. Having long fantasized about Hajin being her father, can Rumin finally make her dreams a reality?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Isekai de Inmashi Harem
title_japanese: 異世界で淫魔師ハレム
synopsis:
Ichirou, an ordinary otaku working adult, is summoned to another world. Unusually for an "outsider," he is a "powerless person" with no special abilities. However, he has "awakened" to the other world as the possessor of "incubus powers," which allow him to control women through his semen. Realizing this, Ichirou uses his incubus powers to seducing beautiful women and girls one after another, eventually rising to become the king of a country...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Heat Stroke
title_japanese: 아기 삵을 낳아 줘, 나 미치는 꼴 보기 싫으면!
synopsis:
Goh Yumin, the eldest son of an endangered black-footed wildcat clan, has never even met a female of his own kind and is doomed to a lifelong single status. Now freshly in heat and losing his mind to breeding instinct, he catches wind of a secret rumor: a male wildcat can perfectly pair with a human man and impregnate him without fail.

Determined to continue his family line, Yumin sneaks into Hanguk University in search of the most beautiful and brilliant man he can find, and that is where he meets Beom Taejun, a stunning senior with an irresistible body.

Yumin sets aside his pride and desperately attempts to court him, only to end up pinned beneath Taejun on his own bed. To his shock, Yumin realizes he is the one being "bred," not the other way around. Even as he tries to escape, he finds himself addicted to Taejun’s touch.

Can Yumin break free, or will he lose himself completely before he can secure the baby wildcat needed to carry on his family’s bloodline?

(Source: Lezhin Enter

title: Kekkon wo Akirameta Cheat Majutsushi, Dekiai suru Manamusume ga Dekita node Issho ni Shiawase ni Narimasu
title_english: No Wife, No Problem: A Mage's Life with His Beloved Daughter
title_japanese: 結婚を諦めたチート魔術師、溺愛する愛娘ができたので一緒に幸せになります
synopsis:
All hail the world's strongest magical father-daughter duo! Light Marquinas is a legendary S-class mage, respected across the land for his unmatched magic. Dedicating himself entirely to his craft gave him fame and power, but also a lonely life. After forty years of being single and giving up on ever finding a partner, Light makes a divine contract to ask for one thing: a child of his own. His wish is granted with Lucia, a daughter born from his own blood—and she's no ordinary girl. Blessed with divine magic beyond her father's, Lucia is destined for greatness. Battling monsters? No problem. Protecting the kingdom? Easy. But one smile from Lucia, and this top-tier mage turns into the world's biggest pushover. Whether it's slaying monsters, protecting kingdoms, or just watching over her as she grows, Light will do anything for his precious little girl.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Saishou no Ki wo Motsu Koyakunin no, Henkyou Nonbiri Slow Life: Shusse Dekizu Sasen sareta Hazu ga, Nazeka Mawari kara Tayoraremakutteimasu
title_english: Take These Talents Elsewhere: A Delightful Demotion to the Countryside
title_japanese: 宰相の器を持つ小役人の、辺境のんびりスローライフ ～出世できず左遷されたはずが、なぜか周りから頼られまくっています～
synopsis:
Zen Leadon has worked in the central government for over a decade, always shuffled from post to post without any chance of promotion. Disappointed in him as a member of the esteemed Leadon family, his eldest brother Yohia demotes him to a post out in the countryside. A demotion like that would shatter anyone’s spirits...except for Zen’s. In fact, he’s over the moon with joy! However, that good fortune comes with a price. He’s suddenly tasked with the duty of sheltering the country’s princess—whose life is in danger—and acting as her father. And what’s more, that princess is the fourteen-year-old daughter of his first love. Will he be able to handle the new role that’s been thrust upon him?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Konyakusha-sama ni wa Unmei no Heroine ga Arawaremasu ga, Zantei Konyaku Life wo Mankitsu shimasu! Anata no Noroi, Kiraware Akujo no Watashi ga Toicha Dame desu ka?
title_english: Engaging with the Plot: A Former Cat's Attempt to Save Her Now Temporary Fiancé
title_japanese: 婚約者様には運命のヒロインが現れますが、暫定婚約ライフを満喫します! ～あなたの呪い、嫌われ悪女の私が解いちゃダメですか?～
synopsis:
Lucille's fiancé, the second prince, accuses her of a crime she didn't commit and then breaks off their engagement. Not only that, but her unjust punishment is a new betrothal to a cursed marquess! After a prophetic dream foretells her eventual execution, Lucille awakens to memories of her past life...as Lilybell, the world's most lovable cat, whose previous owners throughout history happened to include a great witch, a legendary alchemist, and a chosen hero. According to her dream, Lucille's new fiancé, Felix, already has a fated love destined to appear in the future. In other words, it's only a temporary engagement, so why shouldn't she just kick back and relax? With her super positive mindset and the skills she inherited from Lilybell's owners, Lucille soon finds herself helping the people around her. She also discovers the truth of her past companions and begins to unravel the mystery behind Felix's curse.

(Source: J-Novel Heart)

title: Adachi to Shimamura 99.9
synopsis:
As Adachi and Shimamura share life as adults, they've never been happier. Their relationship's so close now, it may last into their golden years... maybe even for the next 3,700 years, in fact! Just how long can the pair stay the course together?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Inkyogurashi no Ossan, Joou Heika no Tsurugi to Naru
title_english: Old Knight, New Post: From Retiree to Her Majesty's Blade
title_japanese: 隠居暮らしのおっさん、女王陛下の剣となる
synopsis:
Watt Sears has traded his glory days as a Mechsteel knight for a humble life as train station employee with a knack for showing new pilots the ropes. Problem is, the city's baron—his boss—would love nothing more than to see Watt reclaim his old mantle as a Steelrider who hunts monsters and defends the city. Now nearing forty, the once-legendary pilot would much rather support the new generation than stand in the spotlight himself. Peace and quiet were the last things waiting for Watt, however, as his storied past literally comes to find him. When Anna, his long-lost daughter from a bygone romance, appears before him to ask for his help in a brewing royal power struggle, Watt vows to protect her. But as assailants descend on the city from all sides, keeping his promise proves to be no simple task. With turmoil rattling the kingdom, can this old knight survive his new post and keep his daughter safe?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Isekai ni Otosareta... Jouka wa Kihon!
title_english: Flung into a New World? Time to Lift the 200-Year Curse!
title_japanese: 異世界に落とされた…浄化は基本!
synopsis:
Akira Tennou—an unremarkable thirty-five-year-old janitor—has got a lot to complain about. He was hit by a truck, unintentionally dragged into a hero-summoning spell, and now he’s stuck in some random gloomy forest in a parallel world. And he’s probably afflicted by a dark curse now, if his sister’s beloved fantasy manga are to be believed. The ominous shadows everywhere don’t give him much hope for his new life, especially when they’re also attached to the giant wolf that just snuck up behind him... But while this world does come with a curse, it also comes with something awesome: magic. Akira’s got the power to purify, and he’s gonna use it to free the creatures of the forest! Trying to figure out how magic works without a teacher isn’t going to be easy, but he’s not gonna let some stupid curse get between him and a bunch of cute animals. Even if those animals are huge... Who knew wolves could be this adorable?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Vampire Hunter ni Yasashii Gal
title_english: This Gyaru's Got a Thing for...Vampire Hunters?!
title_japanese: ヴァンパイアハンターに優しいギャル
synopsis:
Deadly monsters who stalked innocents in the night and preyed upon them in secret, versus the select few who used mysterious powers honed by intense training and determination to battle their foes... This was the world of bloodshed that Ginka Shijunana knew and lived for—an endless clash between vampires and vampire hunters—until one final victory ended their war. Ginka decides to become a normal high school student now that her vampire hunting days are over, but her combat skills are no match for the challenges of everyday interactions with other teenagers. Still, she hits it off with the flashy and fashionable gyaru Ruka Moriki. When remnants of Ginka's old life start to mysteriously reappear, however, will she pull Ruka into the darkness with her? Or will Ruka help her remain in the light? Find out all of this and more in the exciting first volume of This Gyaru's Got a Thing for...Vampire Hunters?!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Ie de Munou to Iwaretsuzuketa Ore desu ga, Sekaiteki ni wa Chou Yuunou Datta you desu
title_english: Worthless at Home, Whiz to the World
title_japanese: 家で無能と言われ続けた俺ですが、世界的には超有能だったようです
synopsis:
Raised by his strict family of five older sisters, Noa leaves home to become an adventurer in a faraway land. But despite being a supposed novice, he keeps shocking seasoned adventurers with incredible feats of strength and magic. It's no wonder, really. Unbeknownst to Noa, his sisters are some of the strongest people in the world—masters of magic, swordsmanship, trade negotiations, and more. While his sisters think of Noa as worthless, the rest of the world sees him for what he truly is: a whiz! Determined to forge his own path, Noa begins his new life where he's finally appreciated for his abilities. But what will happen when his overprotective sisters set out to bring him home? If worth is in the eye of the beholder, Noa is here to prove this whiz has been hiding in plain sight all along!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Tsundere Majo wo Korose, to Megami wa Itta
title_english: The Goddess Says, "Kill the Tsundere Witch!"
title_japanese: ツンデレ魔女を殺せ、と女神は言った
synopsis:
"I was proud to be the biggest tsundere fan in the world until the day everything changed: when I woke up from uneasy dreams to find myself turned into a staff and buried in a forest! Fortunately for me, a narrow-eyed, silver-haired beauty saved me. I tried to thank her, only for her to say...it's not like she saved me for my sake, or anything! What is that but the textbook line of a tsundere?! This perfect tsundere specimen is apparently Stella, a student of the Saint Antohsa Academy and the owner of a certain holy magic staff—me. Guess I'll have to cheer her on for the rest of my life! But wait, why am I a staff, anyway? When I visit the Goddess who rules over this world in the hopes of becoming human again, she tells me I need to kill Stella, the so-called evil witch, to have my wish granted! I have to choose between my shy beloved and world peace? Well, that's an easy one...

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Noroware Ryourinin wa Meikyuu de Mofumimi Shoujo-tachi wo Sodatemasu
title_english: The Accursed Chef and His Pair of Furry Foodies
title_japanese: 呪われ料理人は迷宮でモフミミ少女たちを育てます
synopsis:
After heroically sacrificing his life to save a child, twenty-five-year-old Koichi Suzuki is reincarnated as a young boy named Thor, born into a harsh, new world, thanks to a mysterious god dubbed "Indeed-Missy." His reward? A unique magical ability that lets him cook up monsters. Nothing comes easy in this cruel world, though. After nearly being sold off to slave traders by his scumbag parents, Thor finds himself orphaned and alone at the age of four, forced to scrape by using sheer grit and his newfound culinary skills. Just as survival feels within reach, he discovers two beastfolk girls on the verge of death. Helping them could spell his own ruin, but for a man who adored all things furry-eared in his past life, there's only one path forward. "There's no way I'm abandoning beast ears!" And so begins Thor's adventure of cooking his way through the dungeon!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Bakemonojou Sophie no Salon: Gokigen You. Kawa Ichimai nara Naosemasu wa
title_english: Welcome to Monstrous Miss Sophie's Enchanted Salon of Healing
title_japanese: 化物嬢ソフィのサロン ～ごきげんよう。皮一枚なら治せますわ～
synopsis:
Meet Sophie Olzon, the only daughter of a wealthy merchant family, cursed from birth with a mysterious skin condition. With her rough, bark-like appearance, Sophie has been cruelly nicknamed "The Monstrous Miss" by her peers and bullied relentlessly at school until she could bear no more. Forced into isolation, she retreats to her family estate and dedicates herself to mastering her peculiarly weak brand of magic that can only heal surface wounds.

One fateful day, when Sophie nearly succumbs to the weight of her condition, a forgotten truth hits her—she once lived a life as a single mother in modern-day Japan! With renewed purpose, the Monstrous Miss opens her heart and doors to those seeking her unique brand of healing.

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

title: Hiroware Deshi to Birei Majutsushi: Monogusa Shishou no Kutsushita Sagashi wa Kyou mo Taihen desu @comic
title_japanese: 拾われ弟子と美麗魔術師～ものぐさ師匠の靴下探しは今日も大変です～@COMIC
synopsis:
When she was cursed and left all alone in the world, an unusual cohabitation life began for Aria, a girl taken in as a disciple. Her heartbreak keeps getting worse thanks to one person: Lucas Bailey, a great magician who can’t put anything back where it belongs. Feared as a reclusive sorcerer living hidden away in an old castle, he’s a stubborn, antisocial man who speaks with oddly feminine wording. Yet behind that reputation, he treats Aria like family, and even gives her gentle kisses over her bandages while trying to lift her curse. Before she realizes it, she secretly falls in love with him… Thus begins a mismatched love fantasy between a disciple full of insecurities and a beautiful great magician.

(Source: TO Books, translated)

title: Living With the Dangerous Beast
synopsis:
Sohwa is a red fox with white hair, separated from her family and living alone in the mountains. One day, she comes across Dohwi, an injured and abandoned wild cat, and decides to take care of him. But little does she know that Dohwi is actually a fearsome tiger, reborn after a thousand years of life. Dohwi conceals his identity well, but as the years go by, he matures into quite the hunk and grows more and more attached to the beautiful fox. Sohwa grows suspicious amidst frightening dreams of being chased by a tiger, not to mention making steamy hot love with him, and their relationship is about to take a drastic turn... for better or worse.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Decision
synopsis:
Jun was a third generation chaebol who had everything and was getting tired of the dullness of everyday life. One day, he was drinking with his friends in a private bar room with some women they called over to accompany them, but he was in a dazed thinking what the difference was between death and his current life. Until a waiter stepped into that room and made his heart, which he thought was long dead, stir from its silence...

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Insatiable Lust
synopsis:
Taking orders from his boss, Namsoo goes to Baek-ho's Gang in order to take care of some business. But little did he know that Baek-ho's Gang's namesake and leader would take a particular liking to Namsoo and capture him all for his own. Now Namsoo just desperately wants to escape but how will he break free from this insatiable lust...?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Trap? Trap!
synopsis:
Adult novelist Baekyeon suffers from sociophobia and hasn't left his old decrepit villa for years. The only one who cares for him is his editor Soohyun. One day, the bugs keep appearing inside his home, and Baekyeon has had enought and calls Soohyun for help. Soohyun calls extermination service "BFX." The exterminator Hyuk, with a tall and muscular physique, shows up and Baek's cold heart is thawed...!

(Source: NHN comico Corp.)

title: Shall We Go Surfing?
synopsis:
How did the phrase "Surf with me" became a connotation for "Sleep with me"? 

There are strange rumors surrounding Ha Doyoon. Sung Jin, curious to find the truth behind those rumors, approached him. The events that unfolded during the 3 days that followed only made him more and more confused.

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Safety First
synopsis:
Tae-ho is in charge of Sejun, a newbie at the construction site. Tae-ho warns him to be careful because the site is dangerous, he's worried about the strangely over-eager Sejun. To top it off, he is burdened by Sejun, who keeps sniffing him and following him around—No way... is he fully aware and doing it on purpose...? 

"But Hyung... Are you in heat?"

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Inukano
synopsis:
Inukai is a girl who is like a dog: she's affable, lively and straightforward. Nekoi is an attractive boy who is like a cat: shy, quiet and dedicated to his hobbies. This is their love story.

(Source: MU)

title: Who Didn't Like It?
synopsis:
For 28 years, Min-seo has never been in a relationship. Hoping to finally create a new connection, he sets off on a package tour full of excitement. But the partner he's matched with spends the entire trip glued to his phone, showing nothing but disinterest. After a big fight, Min-seo is left on his own, fidgeting with the pointless "love kit" he got as part of the tour package... when suddenly, someone grabs his shoulder. Startled, he turns around to see a bespectacled man he's never met before. With clear nervousness on his face, the stranger meets Min-seo's equally flustered gaze and blurts out:

"Are you Korean?!"

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Love Debugging
synopsis:
Forced by his sister's threats, Cherry sets off on a trip to Paris through a travel app—only to run into his all-too-familiar rival, Lemon, in a completely unfamiliar place. Determined to ignore the infuriating Lemon, Cherry unexpectedly meets his assigned partner, Peach, who happens to match his ideal type perfectly. But just as Cherry begins to fall for Peach, an error in the travel app throws everything into chaos—and suddenly, Cherry, Lemon, and Peach are all registered as each other's partners at the same time!

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Sentimental Journey
title_japanese: センチメンタル・ジャーニー

title: My Dandelion Observation Log
synopsis:
Eunseom is the transfer student everyone is talking about. With his striking blonde hair and the dangerous rumors that follow him, he's impossible to miss. But Iseo, with a gentle nature, doesn't judge people by their looks or rumors, and finds Eunseom rather interesting. When they are assigned seats next to each other, Iseo tries to be friendly, but Eunseom remains on high alert. However, between shared desks and stolen glances, a quiet bond begins to form.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Orchard of Temptation
synopsis:
Peace and nature are the only things Seyeon expects to enjoy while staying in the countryside with a family she knows. So she's startled when she runs into the family's son, Jeongwook, who was her childhood friend. The two of them haven't seen each other since drifting apart in their teens, but that doesn't stop Seyeon from checking out Jeongwook's pecs. Once they catch each other in some suggestive situations, things heat up quickly between them. When the aloof Jeongwook suddenly confesses his feelings, it's up to Seyeon to decide where to take their secret fling in the orchard...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: How to Survive as the Monster Duke's Wife
synopsis:
Duke Bifolten, the man whose gaze alone is said to freeze anyone's entire body. Ilyin has a prophetic dream about spending her first night with him. Because she was shunned by everyone in the mansion for her prophetic dreams, Ilyin rarely ever stepped foot outside. To think she would spend her wedding night with Duke Bifolten, a man she's never even seen. But is Duke Bifolten really such a dangerous person? "He was definitely kind that night." Why is Duke Bifolten—the man who rules over winter with his authority and whose sword is faster than his words—gentle only with me?

"If you see what I look like, you will never be able to leave this castle again, Ilyin."

I just wanted to escape that house, but now, the Master of Winter is obsessed with me.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Tasokare, Kagerou.
synopsis:
On entering high school and looking at the class roster, Yuito Arisaka suffers a shock when he spots the name of the girl who used to bully him. However, the girl he sees there is someone else entirely, someone completely unrecognizable! A coming-of-age suspense story concerning "the girl whose existence evaporated."

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Nokaze no Pink na Torisetsu
title_japanese: ノカゼのピンクなトリセツ

title: 34-sai Urenokori no Koi wa Gyaku Propose kara
title_english: 34 and Counting: My Reverse Proposal to Find Love
title_japanese: 34歳・売れ残りの恋は逆プロポーズから
synopsis:
Misa Kasuga is a 34-year-old single female office worker. As she watches the younger staff at her company quit left and right to get married, Misa discovers that her boyfriend has been cheating on her, and their relationship comes to an abrupt end. Approaching her 40s, Misa worries about being labeled as "unwanted leftovers" at the company, but she is then invited out for a drink with her handsome boss, Noguchi. Getting drunk, she ends up impulsively proposing to him, but this unexpectedly results in the two becoming close! However, there are rumors floating around that there is some reason behind why the 40 year-old Noguchi is still single...!

(Source: Shusuisha)

title: Level Count Stop kara Hajimaru, Kamisama-teki Isekai Life: Saikyou Status ni Tensei shita node Suki ni Ikimasu
title_japanese: レベルカンストから始まる、神様的異世界ライフ ～最強ステータスに転生したので好きに生きます～
synopsis:
After waking to find himself reincarnated and his past-life memories erased, Merlin is looking forward to a life of ease—but his reality is anything but easy! "Blessed" with god-tier stats and divine good looks, he quickly discovers that a normal life is next to impossible for someone who's constantly mistaken for a deity. It doesn't help that being OP means he can barely lift a finger without causing mass destruction! Then there's the issue of all the girls who desperately need his help. Too overpowered and too overrun with damsels in distress—will Merlin ever get to kick back and enjoy his new life?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Dividing Up Dabin
synopsis:
Kim Dabin harbors a secret desire for BDSM. He's already exploring this world with Jung Cane, a charismatic idol and professor, when his longtime friend Ra Yun unexpectedly confesses his own love for kink. Caught between two irresistible men, Dabin's confusion leads to a reckless escape—only to wake up after a car accident with an outrageous offer on the table. He's given six months to live with both Cane and Yun, switching between them weekly, indulging in their seductive games as they fiercely compete for his heart. As the tension heats up and the lines blur between passion and possession, Da-bin must make the hardest choice of his life: which man will claim him for good?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Koi no Fukurami
synopsis:
1. Hari no Ketsuraku: Joshou (Chipped Glass: Prelude)
2. Ateuma no Koi (Cockblock Love)
3. Gal-Succubus Allergy!
4. Mo Ichido Kanadete, Rooster (Play It Again, Rooster)
5. Niji ga Sakanakutemo (Even if the Rainbow Never Shines)
6. Hari no Ketsuraku: Zenpen (Chipped Glass: Part 1)
7. Hari no Ketsuraku: Kouhen (Chipped Glass: Part 2)

title: I'm the Only One Who Doesn't Know That Villainess Is a Man
synopsis:
Vivian awakens to find herself possessed into the body of a terminally ill female lead, doomed to a tragic ending. Refusing to accept her doom, Vivian seeks out Rahel, the story's infamous villainess and the only person capable of curing her. What begins as a desperate gamble slowly turns into a genuine bond, and against all expectations, the two become close, true friends. But...

"Not for a single moment did I ever consider you my friend, Vivian."

"Do you really think you could enter a contract marriage with anyone else?"

...Wait. Wasn't Rahel supposed to be a villainess?! My best friend just turned out to be a male?!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: 3XLOVE
synopsis:
In his school days, Baek Kiho was an easy target, overweight, quiet, and even cursed with a name that classmates mocked as "Piggy Ho." Years of relentless bullying drove him to drop out, leaving only scars and shame behind.

But time changes everything. Kiho shed the weight, changed his name to Heeseong, and built a new life where no one could recognize the boy he once was. Then fate delivers an unexpected blow: his first love, Cheon Bokyeong, reappears. The very same Bokyeong who once despised him now approaches warmly, unable to connect Heeseong with the outcast she knew in the past.

Torn between the longing he still feels and the terror of exposing his past, Heeseong hides the truth and lets their fragile relationship grow. But secrets have a way of surfacing and for Heeseong, the fear of losing both love and dignity weighs heavier than ever.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: "Jishou Akuyaku Reijou" ni Korosareta Last Boss no Yarinaoshi: Bocchi na Reitetsu Koujo wa, Daini no Jinsei de Riajuu wo Mezashimasu
title_english: Reforming an Icy Final Boss: Getting Back at the Self-Proclaimed Villainess with the Power of Friendship
title_japanese: 『自称・悪役令嬢』に殺されたラスボスのやり直し ～ぼっちな冷徹公女は、第二の人生でリア充を目指します～
synopsis:
Milly Asteara's story should have ended in death by villainess. Known to some as the "final boss," Milly is an ice queen with a noble background and little interest in others. That chapter in her life comes to a close when she is callously murdered by Angelina Grey—the self-proclaimed villainess convinced this world is an otome game—and awakens three years in the past with all her memories intact. Determined to escape the humiliating fate that once claimed her life, Milly sets out to rewrite the future by gathering information, choosing allies, and reevaluating the world around her. Unfortunately, her rival won't stop until she gets her happy ending with Prince Gilbert, and she's willing to kill for it. Poisoned teacups, political rivalries, and hidden reincarnators turn everyday life at the academy into a battlefield. But for Milly, surviving this second chance means more than revenge—it's about carving out a life where she can truly belong!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Tsuihou sareta Seijo desu ga, Jitsu wa Kunijuu kara Aisaresugitete Kowain desu kedo!?
title_english: Even Exiled, She's Still the Beloved Saint! St. Evelyn's Weird and Wonderful Friends
title_japanese: 追放された聖女ですが、実は国中から愛されすぎてて怖いんですけど!?
synopsis:
She lost her fiancé, her sister, and her position as saint in one breath. Is nothing sacred anymore?! Evelyn has spent most of her life dutifully performing her role as the saint and keeping the country safe with prayers and healing magic. But everything comes crashing down when her ex-fiancé, the crown prince, exiles her and names her incompetent sister as the new saint. With no money and no practical skills to speak of, she has her work cut out for her if she wants to find her place in the world. Things start to look up after a mysterious young boy offers to help her make a living. Her experience with healing nets her a quick paycheck, and the people aren't shy about sharing their devotion for her—she even gets proposed to! As discontent spreads over the prince's folly and adoring fans flock to her side, Evelyn must navigate political intrigue, her newly realized fame, and unexpected romance in the air.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Dustland
synopsis:
In the Utsusemi District of Toaru City—where Suzuran All-Boys High School towers over the landscape—a young boy named Hibari Asada has moved into the Nakahara Apartments, a place better known as "The Ghost Projects." Still trapped in the shadow of his mother's death, Hibari remains unable to escape his suffocating loneliness. However, a chance meeting with Sanzou Kobayashi, a resident of the same building, begins to lead his youth toward something hotter and more irreplaceable than anything he's ever known!!

A legit sequel to the monuments of delinquent manga, Crows and Worst, finally kicks off!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Daytime in the Bunker
synopsis:
Seou always knew that running away from the son of a murderer would eventually haunt her, but she never expected to be locked underground with him. Years after she abandoned Wonhyeok following a bloody secret on some stairs, a twist of fate traps them together in the suffocating darkness of an abandoned bunker. As the heavy door clicks shut, Seou must decide if the boy she betrayed is here to finally protect her, or if he's been waiting all these years to exact his revenge.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Proust no Koibito
title_english: His Lover Wears the Scent of Cigarettes.
synopsis:
Working in human resources at a major pachinko manufacturer, Misaki comes off as a serious and inflexible person while on the job. However, in his off time, he lets loose and enjoys himself by spending time at pachinko parlors. While out and about, he meets an inexperienced-looking young man named Iori and is interested in the rare brand of cigarettes he possesses. Influenced by Iori's sense of distance and the smell of cigarettes, Misaki invites him to spend the night at a hotel and "do things that real adults do." But what happens when the next day, a new employee is late to the company's welcoming ceremony!?

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

title: Tonari no Seki no Fukami-kun ga Idol ni Naru kamo Shirenai
title_japanese: となりの席の深美くんがアイドルになるかもしれない
synopsis:
Akane Hayasaka loves a survival audition program where talented youngsters compete fiercely to become idols. One day, Akane learns that Fukami, who sits next to her at school, has passed the written examination for an extremely difficult audition. Akane hopes that the world will discover Fukami's brilliance, but Fukami himself doesn't seem keen on becoming an idol...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Kamaseinu kara Hajimeru Tenka Touitsu: Jinrui Saikouhou no Last Boss wo Enjite Gensaku Break
title_english: The Canon Fodder's Ascension from Pawn to World Unifier
title_japanese: かませ犬から始める天下統一〜人類最高峰のラスボスを演じて原作ブレイク〜
synopsis:
Arrogant, charismatic, and untouchable—what more could you possibly ask for from a villain? Zil was the epitome of a final boss, reigning supreme throughout part one of the anime Ragnarök: Twilight of the Gods. However, in a cruel yet hackneyed twist, he was reduced to fodder and insta-killed to make way for the next big baddie's grand entrance. It's far from the type of fictional character you'd want to randomly wake up as, but that's the sad reality our protagonist finds himself in after falling asleep in front of his TV. Not one to throw in the towel so easily, he swears to defy his fate even if it means facing the gods! But breaking canon is easier said than done. First, he must build up his strength and his forces while perfectly maintaining Zil's imposing facade and... Uh, hang on. Why is everyone suddenly worshipping him as a god? Oh well, as long as it boosts his chances of survival!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: 10-nenbun no Kotaeawase
title_english: Checking Your Answers for Ten Years.
synopsis:
Nao is afraid of what others think of him and has difficulty talking to others. Up until now, his best friend Keigo, who understands his feelings, would answer for Nao since he's not good at expressing himself. However, Keigo will soon be leaving their hometown. Nao has been thinking, "Keigo says he knows everything I'm thinking, but surely he's not aware of my love for him..." Nao continues to depend on his best friend's kindness and can't muster up the courage to tell him. Then one day, he gets told, "I know how you feel, Nao. This is the last time, so I want you to tell me directly."

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

title: Seijo-sama ni Naritai noni Kougeki Mahou shika Tsukaenain desu kedo!?
title_english: I Want to Be a Saint, But I Can Only Use Attack Magic!
title_japanese: 聖女様になりたいのに攻撃魔法しか使えないんですけど!?
synopsis:
Why can't my embarrassing past just disappear?!

"You're always alone." From the bottom of her heart, Yuffie Abisus desperately wants to be a saint for one reason only—so no one will ever say those aggravating words to her again. Fortunately for her, she's been blessed with an extraordinary supply of mana despite being a commoner. Determined to succeed in her mission to become a saint and have everyone fawn over her, she enrolls in the Academy of Magic where she's sure to free herself from her gloomy life. However, Yuffie has a secret. For whatever reason, she can only use attack magic, which itself falls strictly in the domain of men. Meaning she's incapable of utilizing healing magic, women's magic. Maybe that's why she ends up being labeled a second-rate student and isolated from the rest of her cohort from day one.

So begins the tale of a girl who's a smidge socially inept, disheartened by her struggle to make even a single friend, and once more mired in the drudgery of a loner li

title: Beware of Double Trouble!
synopsis:
"There are plenty of fish in the sea," or so they say. Easier said than done for Kim Gahi, whose crush is rising K-drama star Choi Yubin. Despite going to the same university as Yubin, Gahi can only daydream and grumble to her bestie and roommate Sara, as there's never any sign of her crush on campus. But then, while having drinks at a nearby pub, Gahi meets a boy who's the spitting image of Yubin. Seemingly more outgoing and down-to-earth compared to her idol, this look-alike is just the beginning of Gahi's campus drama...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Expiration Date
synopsis:
Betrayed by their lovers on the same night, Seoin and Minho part ways—only to meet again years later. Now a pro golfer, Minho won't stop chasing Seoin. But when Gitae and Muyoung resurface, the past they tried to bury comes back to life.

(Source: Manta)

title: Memai wa Madoi no Tsugai
title_japanese: 目眩はまどいのつがい
synopsis:
On the day of the earthquake, Hato Fujinoki cannot go home, leading the owner of the bookstore, Kazumi, to ask him to stay behind. With his legs injured and all, he agrees.

"At a time like this, you could say we're in the same boat," Kazumi says. 

Because of this sentence, Hato starts to pay more attention towards Kazumi. A few days later, Hato happens to visit a bar with his colleagues, where Kazumi, an alpha who works there, immediately senses that Hato is an omega. And the truth is...?

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

title: The Serpent's Shaman
synopsis:
After suffering frightening spiritual symptoms, Park Sinwu undergoes a shamanic ritual and meets Biyeon, the spirit he's destined to serve. Biyeon is beautiful, demanding, oddly affectionate... and insists that their "union" is the only way to protect Sinwu. But as Biyeon grows clingier and Sinwu's doubts deepen, he can't tell if this god is his guardian or something far more dangerous.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Sorta Psycho
synopsis:
Juheon is abducted by a stranger who refuses to explain anything, insisting he must remember the truth on his own. Overnight, his life is stolen from him, leaving him trapped in a room with only his captor's voice, touch, and rules to anchor him. Terror slowly warps into a twisted dependence, and even as he demands to know why this is happening, he can't stop reaching for the very man who tore his world apart.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: On the Dot
synopsis:
Kim Yujun never imagined his longtime coworker—and secret crush—Kim Jeong-hyeon would suddenly confess that he's fallen for a man. Shocked and unsure how to react, Yujun is even more taken aback when Jeong-hyeon asks him to be his "practice partner" for dating. What begins as a harmless experiment soon grows complicated as their everyday moments blur the line between acting and feeling. In the soft rhythm of shared glances and after-hours conversations, Yujun starts to wonder if he's the only one pretending. Sometimes, love arrives quietly like two clock hands brushing past each other, almost in sync.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Winter Season
synopsis:
Yi-hyun's everyday life was no different from usual. At least, not until Koo Seung-hyuk, the man he broke up with nine years ago, appeared.

"Did we ever run a hole-for-sale business here? Didn't know you were selling a man's ass for money now."

Seung-hyuk shows up as the owner of Club Nexus, where Yi-hyun works. The moment they meet again, he spits out venomous words, staring at Yi-hyun with eyes full of disgust, as if he has seen something filthy.

"But why look at someone like that? It hurts. I'm just trying to give an old friend a good opportunity after all this time."

It feels true that misfortune always comes all at once. After meeting Seung-hyuk again, Yi-hyun's life is swept up in a series of disasters. Their bond, seemingly ready to snap, continues on like a thin, fragile thread.

(Source: Ridi, translated)

title: Furueru Migite
synopsis:
Itsuki Haine illustrates the hit manga "Tokyo Crime." While working on the series with its mysterious author, Kalon, he stumbles upon a chilling fact... "a real murder has unfolded exactly as in their storyboard." From that instant, doubt and dread toward Kalon begin to consume him...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Shinigami
synopsis: Kazuo Yashiki is hired to infiltrate a suburban Tokyo school as a teacher in order to investigate gruesome spiritual incidents that occur there every ten years.

title: Chousei Kiroku: Anata no Moto e Todoku made
title_japanese: 調整記録 ご主人様 〈あなた〉の元へ届くまで

title: Himitsu no Chicchana Hamarigoto
title_japanese: ヒミツのちっちゃなハマりごと
synopsis:
1. Taiyou ni mo Kage ga Aru (Even The Sun Has a Shadow)
2. Watashi no Stress Hassanhou (My Stress Relief Method)
3. Boku no Jimoto wa Chotto-hen
4. Matsuri no Naka no Kinki nite... (A Bizarre Kinky Festival)
5. Jimi na Yatsu to wa Iwanaide (Don't Call Me a Plain Jane)
6. Danchi no Tokken (The Special-Privileges of a Multi-Unit Apartment)

title: Mount Hua Wind Sword
synopsis:
A streak of blue wind blows in Mount Hua, known as Chung Pung. Chung Pung, a disciple of the Mount Hua faction, experienced great sorrow after losing his master, Shun Hyun. However, during the mission to retrieve the Four Divine Swords, he encounters individuals who become his allies and comrades. Chung Pung's footsteps are like a raging storm that races through the world, and following him, a new wind blows in Mount Hua, like a single gust of wind.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Imouto no Haishin ni Hairikondara VTuber Atsukai sareta Ken
title_japanese: 妹の配信に入り込んだらVTuber扱いされた件

title: Waterworld
synopsis: In a post-apocalyptic future where the world is flooded after the polar ice caps have melted, the search for the last remaining dry land begins.

title: Hou no Bannin wa Mamoru Sekai wo Erabenai
title_english: The Lawyer Can't Choose the World He Protects
title_japanese: 法の番人は守る世界を選べない
synopsis:
Yuuki Nakamura, an elite prosecutor, attempts to prosecute the president of an IT company who caused a heinous traffic accident, but instead is killed by dark forces. When he comes to, he finds a goddess in front of him who asks him to bring order to another world with the power of law. He accepts the proposal, is given the skills to be a lawgiver, and is reborn into that world. His first job is to defend a legendary dragon who stands accused of "murder" for burning a party of heroes to death with his fiery breath..!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Kono Ue Kimi de Mitashitai
title_japanese: この飢え君で満たしたい
synopsis:
Monaka Yumemiya, a white-haired high school student, is actually an incubus, a demon that feeds on sex. He enters the dreams of Aoi Kanzaki, a woman with a life force that appears once in a millennium, and tries to drain all of her desires.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Am I Too Alpha for You?
title_english: Am I Too Alpha for You?
synopsis:
Alphas belong with omegas. Everyone knows that. Songs, poems, and fairy tales all say the same: only love between an alpha and omega is natural. Love between an alpha and a beta? Unthinkable. But Geonwu can't seem to help himself. Is Geonu too alpha for love...or just too stubborn to give up?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Carrot and Stick
synopsis:
Top idol Zetty's rare photocard—if Siwu doesn't buy it now, he'll regret it forever! After finally tracking one down, Siwu rushes to meet the seller, only to run into a little cash emergency. Hwiyeon agrees to give it up for a discount, but there's a catch. Siwu's gotta give it up, too...and we're not talking about photocards here.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Ikemen Sugimasu Natsume-san
title_japanese: イケメンすぎます棗さん

title: Break New World
title_japanese: ブレイクニューワールド

title: Ruru-senpai wa Ryuryuryuryuryu
title_japanese: ルル先輩はりゅりゅりゅりゅりゅ

title: Boku ni shika Sawarenai Succubus Sanshimai ni Shiborareru Hanashi
title_japanese: 僕にしか触れないサキュバス3姉妹に搾られる話
synopsis:
What do you get when a sex-deprived succubus meets the first man she can finally touch? A full contact, whole body, day-long banging session. The three Amaki sisters are untouchables at their school, and not just because of their perfect looks or standoffish personalities; anyone they touch immediately has an orgasm that will kill them if touched too long. While lamenting never being able to have a normal school life, Lamy, the middle sister, finally finds someone she can touch in her classmate Yuuki Subaru. And he's soon going to find out he can't keep her off him!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Yaoyoruzu Toriatsukai Setsumeisho
title_japanese: やおよろず取扱説明書
synopsis:
The modern-day gods and deities fantasy manga centers on Shiori, an ordinary college student who has been able to see strange things since she was a child. On the verge of losing her job after her employer goes bankrupt, Shiori gets introduced to a "certain job," in which all the Japanese gods, goddesses, and deities are the clients.

(Source: ANN)

title: Keep Holding On
synopsis:
8 years is a long time to have a crush. Doubly so if that crush is your own best friend. Han-gyeol is tired of his own heartsickness for his childhood friend Sooho, and he thinks that maybe it's about time for him to let go of these feelings. He's contemplating moving on, but there's something inside of him that can't help but cling to this crush. Will there be a reward waiting for Han-gyeol if he keeps holding on, or will it only end in heartbreak?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Happy Merry Ending
synopsis:
Seungjun works part-time singing congratulatory songs at weddings, and Jaehyun quit his job to work as an emcee for a wedding hall. The two end up crossing paths by chance. Will the talkative and personable Jaehyun be able to ruffle the feathers of the usually calm and collected Seungjun?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Hanzou to Juusannin no Kunoichi-tachi
title_japanese: 半蔵と十三人の女忍〈くのいち〉たち
synopsis:
The story is set in the village of Asama and follows Hanzou, a young orphan who dreams of becoming an elite ninja. Under the tutelage of the legendary and eccentric kunoichi Yata—a powerful warrior with an overwhelming personality Hanzou undergoes rigorous training while developing a deep bond with his mentor. When the villainous Honkiri Family attacks the village, Yata and the other kunoichis must defend their home. It is during this decisive moment that Hanzou witnesses the true meaning of "determination" and understands the weight of the responsibility to protect those he loves. The manga blends moments of everyday comedy, harsh training, and intense action, exploring Hanzou's journey from childhood to becoming an official ninja and forming his own team of comrades.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Yamitsuki
synopsis:
Hanae Kiri is being relentlessly stalked by a classmate of hers, Shouko Tayama, a tall, creepy girl who sends her love letters every day and drives her friends away from her. Her only escape is a friend she plays a game online with, known to her only as Bulk-san.

(Source: MU)

title: Oshioki☆Man Boo Influencer
title_japanese: おしおき☆まんBoo淫フルエンサー

title: Isekai Wakarase Ojisan Yuusha: Ryoujoku-hen
title_japanese: 異世界わからせおじさん 勇者凌辱編

title: Konyakusha no Imouto wa Kao SSR, Seikaku Saiaku Jigoku no Ero Dance Onna.
title_english: My Fiancee’s Sister Is a God-Tier E-Thot From Hell
title_japanese: 婚約者の妹は顔SSR、性格最悪地獄のエロダンス女。
synopsis:
Takuto used to be a loser, but he completely turned his life around. Now he has a good looks, a great job, and a fiancee from a wealthy family. Unfortunately, his sexual needs aren’t really being met, and that leads him to spending a lot of time looking for women on social media. When he goes to meet his in-laws for the first time, he’s shocked to find one of the women he found online is actually his fiancee’s sister. Maybe she can help him find the release he needs…

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: I'm the Commander of the Secondary Male Lead's Knight Order
synopsis:
"I'll protect the second male lead."

I was reincarnated into the world of a novel. After losing my family, I was sold off, and of all places, I ended up in the home of the second male lead. The second male lead Adrian is abused, betrayed, and used throughout the original story, and, ultimately, meets a hollow, miserable death.

"Even if he's just the second lead, does the story really have to drain him dry like this?!"

Nina decides to become Adrian's very first friend and change his fate. How to win over a suspiciously gentle male lead... Step one: feed him well. But maybe she twisted the original story a little too much.

"Don't talk like that. As if I'm overreacting to nothing, as if all of this means nothing to you."

Adrian's feelings begin to take a turn, in a direction Nina never expected.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Hakugetsu no Ban ni
synopsis:
Toushun was born with a spirit's heart inside his body. This overwhelming power was too strong for his mortal frame to contain, and thus shortened his lifespan. Already steps away from death's door, he heads out into the mountains to return the heart to its rightful owner.

Once there, he meets a beautiful spirit named Choufuu, who tells him that centuries ago, Toushun's ancestor was the one who stole his heart. To help make amends, Toushun agrees to enter into Choufuu's service. But, on the night of the full moon, a sweet scent lures him to the most enticing scene...

(Source: Animate International)

title: Oyasumi, Namida-kun
synopsis:
"I love your crying face more than anything in the world. After all, I'm the only one you can cry in front of, aren't I?"

Achiba, an elite salaryman with exceptional work skills, happens to reunite with Sanami—someone he barely knew back in high school—at work, and the instant they meet again, Achiba's tears just won't stop flowing!

Ever since a certain incident twisted his personality and made it impossible for him to cry, Achiba now finds tears pouring out whenever and wherever he sees Sanami, no matter the situation. Meanwhile, Sanami light-heartedly teases him, all while making moves that feel suspiciously like he's trying to seduce him...?

As his tears flow, Achiba's heart and body both start to melt.

(Source: Libre, translated)

title: Mushi Bazuru Himegimi
synopsis: The two members of the biology club try to forestall its disbandment by making insects go viral.

title: Link! Like! Love Live! @comic
synopsis: An adaptation of short stories included in the Link! Like! Love Live! First Fanbook.

title: Osana Robo to Abunai Hakase
title_japanese: 幼ロボとあぶない博士
synopsis:
The story follows a perverted professor who falls in love with her creation, a young robot who truly despises her.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Ilvizora no Touhikou
title_japanese: イルビゾーラの逃避行
synopsis:
The 6th Demon King, Ilvizora, was supposed to be quietly waiting for the final showdown with the Hero. That was how it should have gone, but the Demon King panicked and ran! A life-or-death game of tag between a cowardly Demon King and the strongest Hero begins now!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: A Drop So Inconsequential
synopsis:
Teddy Magazine editorial intern, Yoo Ji-yoo. One day, right before the magazine's deadline, the main article falls through. Then comes a special mission from the editor-in-chief, notoriously known as the "witch." The task? An exclusive interview with the photographer Jake, who is secretly returning to Korea! But at the airport, the Jake I meet is someone I know...

"Do-hyung oppa?" "And you're just standing there while I'm about to be devoured by the witch?"

His familiar low voice and signature musky scent. But unlike before, everything about him feels awkward. When he speaks to me or his touch brushes against me, my toes tingle for some reason. When he beckons me with a playful smile, asking why I'm not coming into his arms already, at that moment, he is no longer just "my brother's friend."

"You're so cute when you talk." "...Uh. What should I say to that?" "You're so beautiful I want to kiss you."

Yoo Ji-yoo's sweet romance with the dangerous Seo Do-hyung.

(Source: Kakao Enterta

title: Absolute Martial Arts
synopsis:
On the verge of death, I was saved by a group of elderly demon-level existences at the apex of cultivation. But I, Yeon-gang, had too much potential in martial arts, and alas was kidnapped and forced to become their disciple... Join me as I desperately try my best to escape their grasp, and enter the world of murim!

(Source: MU)

title: Alma-chan wa Kazoku ni Naritai Z
title_english: Alma-chan Wants to Have a Family! Z
title_japanese: 少女型兵器〈アルマちゃん〉 は家族になりたいZ

title: Unrefined Love
synopsis:
Lee Yeoreum, a university student, unexpectedly reunites with her first love, Ji Suyeong, and his fiancée, Bae Han-gyeong, the owner of the café where she works. Their relationship began in high school when Yeoreum's mother worked as a housekeeper at Suyeong's family home. After years of heartbreak, they meet again, but this time, Suyeong unknowingly drinks a potion that makes him fall in love with Yeoreum. With the potion's effects lasting one year, will their love become real, or will it fade once the potion wears off?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Shining Nananana
synopsis:
After being bullied and living as a reclusive loner addicted to gaming, Bitna gains courage from Chani, whom she meets in a game. She wonders if she can go out if she disguises herself. And on her first day out disguised, even the girl who used to bully her doesn't recognize her...?!
