Then, Bitna decides to go back to school, transformed by a new look: wig, contact lenses, makeup, even her posture and voice tone! She's confident in this new look! But the boy she ends up living with in the share house is so cold to her! But... could he really be...? Will Bitna's double life go unnoticed?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Yotta Hana ni wa Ura ga Aru
title_japanese: 酔った華にはウラがある

title: Broken Bloodline
synopsis:
Ju Cheongdo, the thirty-first heir of the Yusim Ju clan, carries a curse cast on him in childhood. Everyone he grows close to meets an untimely death, and the curse is now threatening his own life as well.

Desperate to hold on to the will to live, Cheongdo seeks out Yu Chanran, a man known for solving any problem for the right price, and places his last hope in him. 

When Cheongdo asks what it would cost for Chanran to act as his lover, the answer comes lightly but firmly.

"Hey, how much do you charge? For the boyfriend experience, I mean."

"I start at 100,000 won per hour."

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Dropout Angel
title_japanese: ドロップアウトエンジェル
synopsis:
Rikuto is a college student obsessed with self-improvement. One day, a fallen angel suddenly crashes into the home he worked so hard to build! A chaotic comedy about redemption starring 2 polar opposites!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Ashita no Kimi ga Suki
synopsis:
A 26-year-old boy is about to propose to his girlfriend. On the big day, although they have arrived at the meeting place, they don't find each other. They realize that they are indeed at the same place, but not on the same day...

(Source: MU)

title: My Beloved Dog
title_japanese: マイ・ビーラブド・ドッグ

title: Oniichan Oidee♥
title_japanese: おにいちゃんおいでぇ♥

title: Hijitsuzai Papakatsu Report
title_japanese: 非実在パパ活レポート

title: Boku no Koto Suki da yo ne?
Tsubasa to Anii ni no Super Dokidoki Kenkou Land
title_japanese: つばさと兄ぃにのスーパードキドキ健康ランド

title: Kininaru Otoshigoro "Sayonara no Sakura Namiki"
title_japanese: 気になるお年頃「さよならの桜並木」

title: Ippan Seija no Conquista
title_japanese: 一般聖者の救済戦線〈コンキスタ〉

title: Put Your Sword Away in the Bedroom
synopsis:
Assassin Yurian is given a deadly mission: marry Duke Larkan of the enemy nation, and then kill him. But Larkan is no ordinary target. Each night, he becomes a wild, lust-driven immortal beast! When Yurian's assassination attempt fails, Larkan offers her a deal: He'll help find her missing brother—if she can succeed in taming him. "If you want to kill me... tame me first." In the dark of night, an intense and dangerous connection is forged. Yurian fights to kill him; Larkan longs for death. Yet the more they clash, the deeper their forbidden instincts pull them toward one another...

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Empress's Concubine Scandal
synopsis:
"Love is like a dog."

At the moment the sword of the husband I loved more than anything cut through my spine, what flashed before my eyes were my sisters' words: "I curse you. Every moment I loved you is a disgrace to me." The powerful demon who once ruled hell had died, and now I woke up as the terminally ill wife of my ex-husband, who had become emperor.

"To become a demon again, love a human and stab a dagger into their heart."

I was destined to fall into that dog-like love once more.

(Source: Crescendo, translated)

title: Teaching Young Nobles Isn't Easy
synopsis:
Rejected by her family and betrayed by her fiancé and scheming half-sister, Efna gets a second chance at life when she wakes up before the accident that was meant to end her. Determined to live quietly as a teacher, she soon discovers that her mischievous Sunshine Class is only the beginning. Add a few politically feuding older brothers into the mix—a dashing captain, an emperor, and an archduke—and chaos is inevitable. Can Efna make it through nap time, or will she lose her sanity first?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Ore wa Gakuen Zunou Battle no Enshutsuka! Jishou Mob ga Kage kara Egaku Saikyou Shujinkou Musou Scenario
title_japanese: 俺は学園頭脳バトルの演出家! ～自称モブが陰から描く最強主人公無双シナリオ～

title: Osharezuki Ouhi wa Gisou Kekkon de Ousama ni Dekiai sareru
title_english: Their Marriage May Be a Sham, But the King's Love for His Stylish Queen Isn't
title_japanese: オシャレ好き王妃は偽装結婚で王様に溺愛される
synopsis:
The story begins when ordinary high school girl Chiyo Watanabe wakes up one day into a fantasy world, inhabiting the body of a Venessa, a lady of a ducal family. Though she thinks at first that she can enjoy the aristocratic high life, the discovery of her family's lordly sum of debts puts an end to that. Her last hope lies in her apparent betrothal to Alfred, the king of the Kingdom of Willand. Though the king does not seem to enamored with marriage, one year of a false relationship may buy Venessa the money she needs.

(Source: ANN)

title: An Appetite for First Love
synopsis:
A decade ago, Chae Songhwa and her friend Seo Hyunwoo promised to meet again as their best selves. Unfortunately, life hasn't quite turned out the way Songhwa imagined. So when they meet again at their high school reunion, Songhwa is stunned to find that Hyunwoo remembers her and wants to reconnect. One meal and a little too much wine later, he asks her to take him home, where the night takes a spicy turn. Are they simply spicing up their bland lives? Or is this the start of a delicious romance?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Pillow Talk
synopsis:
For fourteen years, Yihyun Han has hidden her love for her childhood friend, Yujin Jo. But when the two suddenly end up living together, Yihyun is forced to confront her buried feelings for him—feelings that soon take a sensual turn. With Yujin harboring sparks of his own, will their friendship finally ignite into romance?

(Source: Manta)

title: My Bad Bedmate
synopsis:
Se-jin, a dedicated high school teacher, reunites with Ju-hwan, the school's temporary chairman—and her first love. After an unexpected night, she tries to leave it as a memory. But Ju-hwan suggests a three-month "bedmate" relationship, and Se-jin finds herself sinking deeper into feelings she meant to forget.

(Source: Manta)

title: I Opened an Illegal Werebeast Hospital
title_english: I Opened an Illegal Werebeast Hospital
synopsis:
Reincarnating after a life of tragedy, Shana's ready to live her best life. As the only child to a doting duke, how hard could it be? That is until the crown prince claims she's his... and a handsome werewolf says only she can heal his kind! Well, time for Shana to open her (illegal) werebeast hospital!

(Source: Manta)

title: To the One Without Virtue
synopsis:
After falling victim to a deepfake scandal, Taeri seeks justice at the police station. There, she meets Prosecutor Chikyung Park—a man as composed and calculating as he is impossible to read. But when she refuses his settlement offer, his calm begins to unravel, and a dangerous obsession takes hold.

(Source: Manta)

title: My Loving Robot
synopsis:
When Seulyeong brought a puppy home, she never expected it to be an android—a sex android that looks exactly like her terrifying boss, Manager Seo! Now she's stuck hiding her look-alike manager at home while acting normal at work. But when her boss suddenly leans in for a kiss... chaos and temptation spiral out of control.

(Source: Manta)

title: Watashi no Egaku Sekai wa Kowareteiru.
title_japanese: 私の描くセカイは壊れている。

title: Futsuu no Onna no Futsuu no Shiawase
title_japanese: 普通の女の普通の幸せ

title: Tsuihou sareta Koushaku Reijou to Yuku Boukensha Seikatsu
title_japanese: 追放された侯爵令嬢と行く冒険者生活

title: Kuroneko Nyango no Bouken Reboot: Rare Zokusei wo Hikiateta node, Kimama na Boukensha wo Mezashimasu
title_japanese: 黒猫ニャンゴの冒険リブート レア属性を引き当てたので、気ままな冒険者を目指します
synopsis:
A boy, reincarnated in a different world, aspires to be an adventurer, but his body is that of the weakest race of cat people, and the magic he wields is an empty attribute that is ridiculed as "empty." However, the boy ignores the big handicap and uses his ingenuity to create weapons and armor from sky magic, transforming it into magic that allows him to walk in the sky. When he grows up supported by the kindness of those around him, and when he realizes the true value of the sky attribute, his journey as the strongest catman adventurer begins!

(Source: MU)

title: Mezame: Mesu no Honnou
synopsis:
1-3. Honnou ni wa Katenakatta
4-5. Otaku to Gal
6-7. Tokai Asobi
8. Gifu ni Tanetsuke sareru made

title: Catch the Smile!
synopsis:
"The Unsmiling Phantom Thief," Smile, steals treasure yet again to stave off his crushing boredom. Quick on the getaway, Smile leaves the police struggling to catch him, but one day a rookie officer by the name of Gonza steps up to take him on...!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Something About You
synopsis:
Because of a difficult family background, Jiwu enters college later than most of her peers. Quiet and reserved, she keeps to the edges of campus life, always feeling one step out of sync with everyone else.

There is one person she cannot help noticing, Wuyeon, a boy who seems to shine wherever he goes. He stands at the center of every group, laughing easily, drawing people in without effort. Compared to him, Jiwu feels invisible, and so she hides her feelings, nursing a silent crush she believes will never reach him.

To Jiwu, Wuyeon appears flawless, someone untouched by hardship or pain.

But one rainy day, that illusion shatters. Jiwu stumbles upon Wuyeon standing alone in the downpour, tears mixing with rain as he cries with heartbreaking beauty.

In that moment, Jiwu realizes that even the brightest people carry unseen scars. And perhaps her quiet presence could become a place of comfort for him.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Arabesque Koukyuu no Wakoku Hime
title_japanese: アラベスク後宮の和国姫
synopsis:
Lyra, a consort whose name will be passed down to future generations as a legend, was originally a princess of the Kingdom of Wa. She was captured in a conspiracy and forced into the harem of the Daril Empire. However, in this harem, she had a path to freedom if she remained childless for several years! This gave her hope, and she resolved not to approach the Sultan, but to wait until her term of indenture expired. However, she was soon tested by the Empress and provoked by a haughty consort candidate. Lyra overcame numerous adversities by displaying the intelligence and natural cheerfulness forged by her parents. She gradually became beloved by those around her, and even showed glimpses of her potential as a wise ruler... But as a result, why has she risen to the top and been treated as a favorite concubine?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Isekai de Tame shita Saikyou no Tsukaima wa, Osananajimi no Bishoujo deshita
title_japanese: 異世界でテイムした最強の使い魔は、幼馴染の美少女でした

title: Ayashii ne☆Watashi no Otouto Gyomei-kun
title_japanese: 妖しいね☆わたしの弟ギョーメイくん
synopsis:
He might LOOK shady to others, but Akiharu is actually just a harmless guy with a deep attachment to his doting older sister, Yukina. The contrast between his suspicious appearance and sweet personality makes him all the more adorable!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Yarinaoshi Reijou wa Ryuutei Heika wo Kouryakuchuu: Gyoumu Nisshi
title_english: The Do-Over Damsel Conquers the Dragon Emperor: Operation Records
title_japanese: やり直し令嬢は竜帝陛下を攻略中 業務日誌
synopsis:
A collection of short stories detailing Jill's life and work as the Dragon Consort!

"I didn't think that I'd get a wife... A Dragon Consort."

Hadis was asked for his hand in marriage during Gerald's birthday party. What did he say unbeknownst to Jill? Find out in the bonus short story, A Gift from God.

In Operation Endless Surprise Attacks, Jill dresses up to surprise Hadis at the party, but she's the one enamored by his enchanting appearance!

This short story collection is jam-packed with stories about the birth of Hadis Bear, a cooking battle between Hadis and Lawrence, and various scenes from the point of view of Jill's friends! Learn more about their antics in the operation records of the do-over damsel!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

title: Eiyuu Shoujo to Noraware no Gin-hime
title_japanese: 英雄少女と呪われの銀姫

title: Okaeri Mister Rolling Stone
title_japanese: おかえりミスターローリンストーン
synopsis:
Mikuriya, a stressed-out salaryman who just got dumped by his girlfriend and is overwhelmed by work, encounters an ant colony struggling to survive in the corner of a park...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Muteki no Ansatsu Madoushi, Last Boss Musume to Tabi wo Suru @comic
title_english: The Invincible Assassin Mage Journeys with the Final Boss Girl.
title_japanese: 無敵の暗殺魔導士、ラスボス娘と旅をする@COMIC
synopsis:
Brad Lester, once renowned as the strongest mage, vanished from public eye after the tragic death of his young daughter. While he is living a quiet life as a lowly day laborer, his beloved wife is murdered by the "World Peace Promotion Association," an organization seeking his power. Filled with despair and rage after losing everything, Brad sets out for revenge—only to find Valburga, the leader of the Association, has been transformed into a little girl!? Furthermore, she has lost her memories and has nowhere to go. Haunted by thoughts of his late daughter, Brad resolves to help his arch-nemesis regain her memories. Visiting the Olford Ancient Magic Research Institute, the mouse-worshiping town of Brooke, and the blizzard-shrouded village of Lutz, their long journey across the land begins. An adventure fantasy of the strongest mage and his "child" companion!!

(Source: TO Books, translated)

title: Zoufu no Hanataba
synopsis:
A horror mystery involving different species. The story begins when middle schooler Ryuunosuke visits his grandmother's house on an island. As Ryuunosuke walks past the stairs leading to the second floor at his grandmother's house, a strange, plant-like thing extends down from above. Intrigued, Ryuunosuke tries to climb the stairs, but his uncle stops him with an unfamiliar expression, saying, "What are you doing?" and "You'd better not go up." That night, however, Ryuunosuke's curiosity drives him to go upstairs after all...

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Karen-chan wa, Tatasetai
title_japanese: 可恋ちゃんは、たたせたい

title: Broadway no Hoshi
synopsis:
Sue, a Jersey girl, and her mother are left to fend for themselves after Sue's father leaves to find work in New York and never returns. After tragedy strikes the family once again, Sue goes to New York alone to become an actress and meets her true father.

(Source: MU)

title: What Happens If a Driver Is Unmarried
title_english: What Happens If a Driver Is Unmarried
synopsis:
Hardy works as a proxy driver of magic carriages until a shady request sends him to the wedding of Hysterion's infamous young heir. Forced to crash the ceremony, Hardy is stunned when Abel Hysterion, the center of every scandal, points straight at him and declares, "Here comes my bride."

(Source: Manta)

title: The Cruelty of Salvation
synopsis:
Olivia Liberty is the first commoner ever admitted to Herolington University. However, she cannot be properly recognized because she is a woman and must instead use the name of a man, Oliver, to receive credit for her creations. Meanwhile, Noah Astrid, Prince of Herod, takes notice of Olivia, who is beloved by the commoners of Herod. Noah seeks to involve her in royal affairs to raise the royal family's popularity and asks for her hand. But while every other member of the royal family treats Olivia affectionately, Noah alone continues to treat her coldly. Will he come to regret it?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: It'll Be Okay
synopsis:
Mouse was just a regular college student when her legs suddenly started to go numb. At first, she brushed it off, thinking it was nothing. But as the symptoms worsened and even walking became painful, a visit to the hospital revealed something she never expected. What do you do when your body begins to betray you, and nothing feels certain anymore?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Fog Land
synopsis:
Witness the corruption of reason and divinity. Escape the nine hells of Fog Land. Driven by his conviction that everyone deserves education, science teacher Kang Dante agrees to teach in Fog Land, a mysterious international prison that houses the world's most notorious criminals. But his very first class gets interrupted by a violent prison riot, after which, he finds himself in the cell of his mysterious captor. Dante must now travel through the nine circles of hell and escape Fog Land.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Trash Flower
synopsis:
Due to her family's debt, Song Joo Hee is unable to live her life. By chance, she meets Kang Se Ra, a rich runaway daughter, and spends the night with her. Drawn to Se Ra's charm, Joo Hee even accepts her offer to live together...

(Source: MU)

title: He Might Bite!
synopsis:
Black panther Pyo Yoontae returns to So Jeongseo's small town with one objective: to find his first love who had fur as white as snow. Being the school outcast, Jeongseo decides to help Yoontae in the hopes of finally making a friend. Besides, Yoontae's first love surely can't be Jeongseo himself, since he's a weasel with brown fur. But something about Yoontae feels awfully similar to a forgotten childhood playmate, and there is one secret Jeongseo is keeping from him. Every winter, Jeongseo actually sheds his fur and turns snow-white!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Do Not Throw Stones at the Stone Bridge
title_english: Do Not Throw Stones at the Stone Bridge
synopsis:
For as long as he can remember, Ha Nadeul has been tangled up with Ju Seok in everything he does. Tests, competitions, group projects, student rankings, you name it. And every single time, Nadeul loses first place to him by just a hair.

All Nadeul wants is freedom, counting down the days until high school graduation so he can finally escape his infuriating rival.

But fate has other plans. As a fortune teller once warned, "He is someone who will stick to you even in death."

Sure enough, the two end up at the same university.

One night, while Nadeul is working a part time shift at a convenience store, Ju Seok shows up looking teary eyed and suddenly confesses.

From that day on, Ju Seok launches an all out, shameless love offensive. And the more Nadeul tries to run, the more the two become hopelessly intertwined.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Glass Menagerie
synopsis:
After the fall of his noble family, Damon drifts from place to place until he hears of an open position as a private tutor for a sheltered young heir named Eden.

From their very first meeting, Eden blushes easily and wears his emotions openly, a lonely young master who seems far too easy to manipulate. Damon convinces himself that if he plays his cards right, he can settle here comfortably for the rest of his life.

But life in the mansion takes a turn Damon never expected, and he begins to suspect that his arrival was part of a carefully laid trap.

As Eden longs for beauty and Damon clings to what never changes, the walls of the mansion close in, and the truth behind their bond slowly comes to light.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Standard Love
synopsis:
Hwang Haechan, a Phys Ed major, has one nagging problem: despite his many attempts, his relationships never last. One night at a party, he meets Kim Tae-yi, the Business Department's heartthrob, and falls head over heels. Could all his past heartbreaks have been leading him to this perfect man?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Heart Effect
synopsis:
500 years ago, Chase Elkin sealed the Dragon of Chaos, Kelgrave, and became immortal. Now living a leisurely life, his world is turned upside down when the dragon-cursed Emperor Cyril appears before him. Smitten at first sight by Cyril's striking beauty, Chase is determined to help break the curse. Together, they embark on a perilous journey to the imperial palace.

But there's a twist! To prevent the curse from progressing, Chase must continue to kiss Cyril, leading to many awkward yet tender moments. What adventures will this bashful warrior and the handsome, irritable emperor face as they navigate their way to the imperial palace?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: My Bunny Bride
synopsis:
Galetocherdo, a fearsome serpent shark with an unexpected soft spot, falls head over fins at first sight for a rabbit statue and decides then and there that a bunny will one day become his mate.

So when he stumbles upon a white "rabbit" fast asleep on the roadside, he doesn't hesitate to bring it home.

There's just one problem. Virdo insists he's not a rabbit at all, but a hermaphroditic sea slug, and he very much did not agree to becoming anyone's bride.

Trapped in an unfamiliar place and relentlessly courted by a forceful yet strangely sweet shark who refuses to take no for an answer, Virdo is pushed into a whirlwind of misunderstandings, identity chaos, and dangerously close proximity.

As Galetocherdo demands "proof" and the line between obsession and affection blurs, Virdo must find a way to escape...or survive...this wildly inappropriate marine matchmaking.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Hit Me Hard
synopsis:
Ko Woonha lives in constant pursuit of stimulation, yet his dulled senses leave him unable to truly feel pain, let alone pleasure. That changes after a single night with Cha Gyuwon, the younger brother of his FWB, when Woonha is able to experience genuine desire for the first time in his life. The problem is, Gyuwon is everything Woonha claims to despise: younger, inexperienced, and sworn to remain chaste until marriage, he seems to cling to a naive fantasy of a first love that will last forever. Convinced he's made the worst possible mistake, Woonha tries to brush it off as nothing more than a lapse in judgment...until the reality of his situation hits him harder than he though possible: Gyuwon might be the only one who can make him feel anything—both physically and emotionally.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Housemate from Hell
synopsis:
Rigid and blunt college student Kwon Jeongha can't stand Gwak Hyeonwu, a handsome, popular classmate who casually toyed with the senior Jeongha secretly loved. The two clash every time they meet... until Jeongha picks up a mysterious necklace and their relationship flips overnight. Claiming he's a demon, Hyeonwu reveals that all the magic he'd stored in the necklace has been absorbed by Jeongha. To make matters worse, Jeongha will die unless it's returned. But the only way to transfer the magic back? Physical contact. Forced into an uneasy cohabitation with a demon he despises, Jeongha's quiet life quickly descends into chaos.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Golden Days: A Collection of Short Stories
title_english: The Golden Days: A Collection of Short Stories
synopsis: A collection of unforgettable tales by Oh Gye, blending tenderness and tension through ever-changing worlds.

title: Captivated by His Sweet Obsession
synopsis:
Roznia Hill is the younger sister of the Magic Tower Master, the villain of "The Duke's Only Companion." Knowing that the male lead will kill them both in the future, she tries her best to stay out of trouble. But one day, Roznia finds a man collapsed at her doorstep... It's Duke Lewellyn Rasiane, the male lead she's been trying to avoid! But to her surprise, he soon starts showering her with sweet words and affection, which leaves Roznia torn—is his love genuine, or does he have another motive?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Can't Quit This Bad Habit
synopsis:
Sohyun knows all about the grind. She's dedicated herself to crawling up the corporate ladder by any means necessary, but a girl's got to blow off steam sometimes! Speaks fly when Sohyun meets a handsome stranger during after work drinks, and their resulting one-night stand scratches an itch. But will it remain just one night?

(Source: Manta)

title: Jigokuhen
title_english: Ryunosuke Akutagawa's Hell Screen: The Manga Edition
synopsis:
Hell Screen follows Yoshihide, a renowned but tormented artist who, despite his talent, is rude, lazy and avaricious. Known for his abrasive demeanor, Yoshihide's one light is the deep affection he harbors for his daughter, Yuzuki. When she enters the service of the powerful Lord Horikawa, tensions rise between the artist and the lord's court, especially after disturbing rumors of Yuzuki's treatment emerge.

Tasked with painting a monumental screen depicting the torments of hell, Yoshihide's dedication takes a dark turn as he pushes the boundaries of morality in his quest for authenticity. As his obsession with capturing human suffering intensifies, the line between creation and cruelty blurs, leading to devastating consequences.

(Source: Tuttle Publishing)

title: Owari no Futari
synopsis:
In a world where humanity is all but wiped out in a war, two survivors, Yuno and Alice, live happily together. They may be the only two people left, but they are very, very happy...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Ore wa Omae no Ai de Itai
synopsis:
"I need to satisfy the customer, or else it'll be the end of me—"

Yui isn't able to get name requests and decides that today is the day he'll give his best customer service. But despite that, the one who appeared before him wasn't just any ordinary man; it was Giichi. He planned on proceeding as planned, but before he noticed, he was being played by him, and has now been captured by this sensation he's never felt before...

"Aren't you supposed to be a pro? Can't you put a bit more muscle into it?"

"No matter how much money piles up, I'll refuse a bastard like you."

In what direction does this dangerous relationship, interweaving an outlaw and a young man hanging on a cliff, lead to?

(Source: Shu-Cream, translated)

title: Makeinu to Lion
synopsis:
Riku, a university student left devastated after his long-term girlfriend is cruelly stolen by another man, undergoes a total transformation under the guidance of a charismatic middle-aged man named Yuji! From a "loser dog" to the king of beasts, Riku aims to become the ultimate lion! Witness the birth of a legendary playboy in the Reiwa era!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Shitennou Saijaku no Jiritsu Keikaku
title_japanese: 四天王最弱の自立計画

title: Watashi wa Nannimo Warukunai
title_japanese: わたしはなんにも悪くない
synopsis:
1-2. Self Help
3. Tachinpo!
4. Kawaii Hana ni wa...
5. Kusogaki Tanna-chan Jakuoji ni Makeru
6. Enjou Buzz wo Neratta Kusogaki no Matsuro
7. Futokou no Koibito
8. Massage no Ojisan

title: The Perfect
synopsis:
"Heartless," former humans devoid of emotions, have turned the world and Jemyeong Han's life upside down. Jemyeong, now facing termination over an unresolved Heartless case, turns to Heartless hunting company 4K for help. But it's not long before he's inextricably entangled with its problematic co-CEO, Guk. "What if you start wanting me over everything?" Those sappy words belong to a webnovel prince, not a shameless man like you!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Akuyaku Reijou no Nariagari: Ringoku de Houseki no Seijo to Yobareru made
title_japanese: 悪役令嬢の成り上がり～隣国で宝石の聖女と呼ばれるまで～
synopsis:
Our protagonist is the daughter of A Duke and is someone who gets lost in her own world when it comes to gemstones, Lady Eliza. While being crowned at the wedding ceremony with her adulterous fiancé, Prince Makis, she is able to correctly identify the nationally treasured tiara as being counterfeit. By revealing this, and calling it trash, Prince Makis breaks off the engagement right then and there and exiles her from the country. She's then welcomed by a neighboring country's crown prince and begins her exiled new life there... Hated by the people as a "Jewel Eater Villainess," will she be able to rise using her expertise and passion for gemstones?

(Source: MU)

title: Hebigami-kun wa Samui to Henshin shichau kara
title_japanese: 蛇神くんは寒いと変身しちゃうから
synopsis:
Hebigami is a new transfer student with a strange condition: whenever he gets cold, he turns into a snake! He’s feared by nearly all his classmates for his mysterious aura, but his seatmate Haruna knows his true kind nature. Since he can’t return to his human form until his body temperature is high enough, Haruna takes it upon herself to warm him up! A slow-burn, heartwarming, and youthful romcom about a nonhuman boy and an ordinary high school girl.

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Unmei Ijou, Koibito Miman. Douki no α to Jouai Keiyaku
title_english: Destined to Be a Pair: A Love Contract with My Alpha Coworker
title_japanese: 運命以上、恋人未満。―同期のαと情愛契約―
synopsis:
My body's burning... I'm unjustifiably wet and overcome with desire... Airi Yamashita is working hard at a prestigious company when her coworker, Ren Kugayama, returns from an overseas assignment. The competent alpha ignites Airi's competitive side, but whenever Ren's in front of her, she can't resist his scent, and her body begins to burn up... She can't bear it any longer and they end up in bed, where the most exquisite pleasure awaits...

(Source: CLLENN)

title: Dakarete Tamaruka! Rival Douki ga Watashi wo Ai de Oitsumeru
title_english: Hold Me? In Your Dreams! My Coworker Rival Corners Me with Love
title_japanese: 抱かれてたまるか!～ライバル同期が私を愛で追いつめる
synopsis:
"Do you really mean it? Are you saying you're not feeling good when you're so wet?" He's playing with all my sensitive parts, making my whole body melt. Is this what "coming" feels like...!?

I, Komari Kanata, a perfectionist, have a natural enemy. He's my colleague who always ranks number one in sales, Kiyose Higashimachi. I don't know if he's aware of my opinion about him, but he always picks fights with me. One day, he finds out about a secret of mine...!! "I can't stop myself when I see your troubled face." When he strokes me inside with his long fingers... I can't! No matter how sweetly you touch me, you're the only one who I won't let embrace me!!

A story about the stormy and heart-fluttering relationship between an unreadable man and a bluffing girl.

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title: Histamine Heartbreak
synopsis:
Achoo! Love is in the air—and it's causing Ki Jeyeon a real headache. As a dominant omega, she has the power to help alphas heal through a process known as "guiding." The only problem is, she's allergic to others' pheromones. Luckily for her, she has her childhood best friend and recessive alpha, Cha Jaeheon, to help her through all her symptoms! But wait, why is she starting to sneeze every time Jaeheon's around her now? That would mean he's releasing pheromones, which would mean... Oh... Oh no...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: 26-sai Shojo, Charao Joushi ni Dakaremashita
title_english: The 26-Year-Old Girl Had Her First Time Taken by Her Playboy Boss
title_japanese: 26歳処女、チャラ男上司に抱かれました
synopsis:
He's going at her so hard. She knows it's wrong, but it feels so good, she can't stop! Chikage Ayashiro (26) has been thrown into a project with her boss, Tooru Aogiri, who's a playboy and hard to grasp. After a kick-off party, she ends up alone with him for some reason! But, once the two talk, he seems more serious and... Drunk, they wind up at a hotel where Tooru turns out to be kind... As her body melts and he has his way with her, she can't stop screaming. It's her first time, and with someone she was hesitant around. So, why does it feel so good...!?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Proctology Anonymous Board
synopsis: Welcome to the Proctology Anonymous Board. Here, some things are just too painful to share without anonymity.

title: Mash Up
synopsis:
Noah's a small-time pickpocket. He's a bit of a slacker who's never really had a steady job but when he hears of an opportunity to steal a rare diamond, for the first time in his life, he gets ambitious. With his new crown jewel, he plans to start fresh and escape his mediocre life. But things don't go according to plan when two guys, who have it out for each other, both get involved. Noah's really mashed up between a rock and a hard place. How the hell is he going to get out of this one...?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Super Sparkle Stars
title_japanese: スーパースパークルスターズ
synopsis:
Keita runs away from his strict home and arrives in Seoul, South Korea. Determined to become the K-pop idol he has always dreamed of, Keita auditions alongside his rival, Sujin...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Olivia Maseki Houshokuten e Youkoso
title_japanese: オリビア魔石宝飾店へようこそ
synopsis:
After coming home one day after working herself ragged, Olivia finds her engagement called off by her fiancé. What's more, her adoptive sister claims Olivia's jewelry designs as her own while Olivia's adoptive family chases her out of her own home and store. Having lost everything, she tightly grips a letter of introduction her late father wrote and heads to the capital, all alone. There, she works hard and manages to start her own shop.

This is the story of a girl who hits rock bottom then climbs her way back to happiness through her own hard work, showing the people who took everything from her that she can't be kept down.

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

title: Teisou Gyakuten Sekai de Nariagari wo Mezashite Otoko Kishi ni Natta Boku wa, Yarimoku Onnatachi ni Karada wo Nerawaremakuru
title_japanese: 貞操逆転世界で成り上がりを目指して男騎士になった僕は、ヤリモク女たちに身体〈からだ〉を狙われまくる
synopsis:
The protagonist, who became so obsessed with being a military otaku that he became a soldier and died in combat, is lucky enough to successfully reincarnate in another world. Hoping to succeed as a military man once again in his second life, he becomes a knight, but the world he reincarnated into is a chastity-reversed world where men are sexually targeted...!? Armed with modern military knowledge and aiming to rise in this other world, what assails the protagonist are beautiful girls with all kinds of fetishes who are only after his body! Will he be able to grasp glory while fending them off...?

(Source: Mag Garden, translated))

title: Futsuu no Hon wa Arimasen!
title_japanese: 普通の本はありません!

title: Isekai Henkyou Meshi
synopsis:
A lone eatery stands in the remote frontier. Drawn by the cooking of a human known only as “Master,” demons, elves, and others of all races gather to savor his food. On the stage of this small restaurant, a gourmet tale of joy and sorrow alike begins to unfold!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Gokai sareta "Migawari no Majo" wa, Kokuou kara Saisho no Koi to Saigo no Koi wo Sasagerareru
title_english: The Sacrificial Witch and the Lovelorn King
title_japanese: 誤解された『身代わりの魔女』は、国王から最初の恋と最後の恋を捧げられる
synopsis:
As the only witch in this world, Lupia is gifted with the magical ability to take the injuries and illnesses of another and transfer them to herself—a secret she keeps to herself. She marries her first love, King Felix, and is deeply devoted to him, and the affection seems mutual. Unfortunately, due to a misunderstanding, Felix believes that she has betrayed him and begins to treat her coldly. After Lupia sacrifices herself to save Felix's life, she falls into a deep sleep. Thus begins the story of a long and unrequited love, and a husband's desperate devotion to his wife.

"Although you may forget your feelings for me, I shall always love you, and I will be sure to bring you back."

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Mizugi no Onna desu.
synopsis:
One day, a girl in a swimsuit suddenly appears at the home of a single man who is busy with his daily work. Who is she? And what is her purpose...?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Favorites
synopsis:
Kawachi-kun has a crush on Matsumoto-kun, a boy in the same year. He never expected his crush to notice him, but one day Matsumoto-kun starts pestering him—? A chatty boys' life story featuring two Kansai-dialect-speaking high school lads.

(Source: MU)

title: Ohayou, Oyasumi, Mata Ashita.
title_english: Good Morning, Good Night, and See You Tomorrow
title_japanese: おはよう、おやすみ、また明日。
synopsis:
When it comes to the topic of cancer, there is no one way to handle the news. For one young woman, Akiyama Momiji, the diagnosis leads her to reevaluate her life. Single and on her own, she's not diving into despair, instead she's ready to learn about herself and her identity in the wake of her diagnosis.

Based on the real-life experience of the author's own battle with cancer.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Nikoniko Genki☆Happy-chan
title_japanese: にこにこ元気☆ハッピーちゃん
synopsis:
love it when people call me carefree—that's because my Normal Person camouflage is working☆ Running on fumes every day! But I'm still alive! Your girl Happy proudly presents the ultimate happy survival show!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: I'm Watching You
title_japanese: アイム・ウォッチング・ユー

title: Kimi ni Naretara
synopsis: Chieri Takasaki wishes on a star and swaps bodies with her oshi idol, Ichika.

title: Mio-sensei wa Hatsutaiken shitai
title_japanese: 美魚先生は初体験したい

title: Damedame Mahoutsukai Pap!
title_japanese: ダメダメまほう使いパップ!
synopsis:
She's a hard worker, and a witch, but she's also worthless. Her name is Pompurupipipi Pop! Welcome to the world of gags and magic by Keiichi Arawi.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Boys Love Complex
title_japanese: ボーイズラブ・コンプレックス
synopsis:
"In times like these, your face comes to mind."

Shinta is an introverted virgin office worker who is self conscious about his looks — and currently obsessed with having VR sex in a virtual world. In VR, he is the handsome high schooler Makoto with a fulfilling school and sex life. He becomes friends with benefits with his classmate Aki, and his time with him becomes the only thing he looks forward to. In the virtual world, it is prohibited to share information about real life, so he can only see Aki online. In reality, he is made fun of by his coworkers and overworked by his boss. With these days where he feels the huge gap between his real and VR life, Shinta begins to desire to meet Aki in real life.

(Source: G-Walk, translated)

title: Nando Dakaretatte, Suki ni nanka Naranai yo
title_english: No Matter How Many Times We Sleep Together, I Won't Fall for You
title_japanese: 何度抱かれたって、好きになんかならないよ
synopsis:
"Your sexy voice, makes it hard to resist." I'm at the mercy of his fingers...my body shaking with sweet pleasure, all before knowing if I actually love him.

(Source: WWWave)

title: Isekai Yakuza: Gokudou desu ga Teni shitara Kyuuseishu ni Narimashita
title_english: I'm a Gokudou, but After Teleporting to the Another World, I Became a Savior.
title_japanese: 異世界ヤクザ～極道ですが転移したら救世主になりました～
synopsis:
During a gang conflict, Ryuuto Aigou, a yakuza member, is caught in the blast of a rocket launcher and unexpectedly transported to a different world. By chance, he saves an elf girl from goblins and is hailed as a hero. In this new world, various monsters like orcs, harpies, slimes, and dragons vie for dominance, reminiscent of yakuza turf wars. Ryuuto decides that if he's going to be here, he might as well aim for the top! He establishes his own crew and embarks on a wild, action-packed adventure as the most formidable yakuza in an unfamiliar realm.

(Source: Taiyo Tosho, translated)

title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: Akai Yuigon
title_japanese: ジョジョの奇妙な冒険 紅い遺言
synopsis:
Set before and during the events of Golden Wind. See the infamous assassin group going through their daily lives, showcasing their unique abilities and bonds between each other not seen in the main series, including the often forgot about members Sorbet and Gelato!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Find Yourself Another Trainer, Your Grace
title_english: Find Yourself Another Trainer, Your Grace
synopsis:
After being reborn, all Litia wants is a quiet career training dragons. But when Duke Albarant's temperamental dragon chooses her as its trainer, she's faced with an unexpected offer. She tries to refuse the persistent duke, but that's easier said than done when he never takes no for an answer. A dragon's choice, a duke's determination, and one very reluctant heroine—can Litia hold onto the peaceful life she's dreamed of, or will this second chance demand far more than she's ever bargained for?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Vengefully Wedded
synopsis:
The crazy princess and the barbarian of the North... Some would call it a perfect match, but neither is truly what they seem: Chloe was only branded as insane by her stepmother as part of a plan to assassinate her, and Callios is a fallen prince who cares deeply for his people. Chloe may have succumbed to her stepmother's schemes in her first life, but this time, she's determined to take revenge with the perfect ally at her side! Can these two make the empire pay for destroying their families?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Hakushaku Reijou wa, Keiyaku Kekkon shita Ore ni Itsu Koi wo Suru?
title_japanese: 伯爵令嬢は、契約結婚した俺にいつ恋をする?
synopsis:
The story of a beautiful Kingdom Knight wife with royal blood, and her husband, the plain seventh son of a poor Baron! Their love(?) suspense(?) story, beginning with a contract marriage, starts now! That marriage marks the beginning of the search for a culprit in an incident from thirteen years ago, swirling with secrets and conspiracies...

(Source: Gentosha, translated)

title: Tabisaki de Iede Shoujo wo Hirotta
title_japanese: 旅先で家出少女を拾った

title: Tokyo Seoul Love
synopsis:
Taiga is a part-time DJ and model who rose to popularity with his old hits. After a club show, he spots someone who's his exact type. Fully expecting it to be just a one-night thing, Taiga finds himself in an unexpected situation when a language barrier causes a misunderstanding. To make matters more complicated, his casual hookup left out one key detail about who he really is...

(Source: Occult Scans, edited)

title: Chou Kaguya-hime!
synopsis:
Tsukuyomi is a virtual realm where hopes and dreams come together. Iroha Sakayori, a 17-year-old high school student in Tokyo, leads an extremely busy life trying to balance part-time work and academics. She finds peace by watching a popular streamer named Yachiyo Runami, who is the administrator of an online virtual space called Tsukuyomi.

Iroha frequents Tsukuyomi, where people can live different lives and freely pursue their creativity, and she passes the time by supporting Yachiyo and playing battle games to earn a little extra money. On her way home one day, Iroha finds a telephone pole shining with iridescent hues. To her surprise, an adorable baby emerges from the pole. Unable to abandon it, Iroha takes the infant home and watches her rapidly grow into a girl her own age.

"Are you Princess Kaguya?"

The grown-up Kaguya develops a self-indulgent personality. At Kaguya's fervent request, Iroha helps her start streaming in Tsukuyomi. With Iroha as producer and songwriter and Kagu

title: Noble Lady Reformation Guide
synopsis:
Aristocratic young ladies are either rude and ill-mannered, or have nothing but flowers in their heads. Even in an era when talk like that was aplenty, there was someone who taught them. A commoner named Derrick realized he has talent for magic and made a name for himself as a mercenary. One day, he was invited to become the magic tutor for aristocratic young ladies. Thanks to Derrick, the star lecturer who turns those rude young ladies into a "proper person," prestigious noble houses start bombarding him with offers.

"There's no such thing as a bad young lady in the world."

At least, not in front of Derrick.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Kyou kara Onushi wa Warawa no Musuko
title_japanese: 今日からお主は蛇神〈わらわ〉の息子

title: Before the Grapes Ripen
synopsis:
Every month, Suyeong's mother receives one million won—money bound to a life-saving debt from years ago. After losing contact with the family behind it, Suyeong goes on with her life, unaware of how closely their paths will soon cross again. Transferred to a newly formed content team, she meets her new manager, Tae-eun—the same man she once saw publicly disgraced months earlier. Bound by an unspoken past and a debt neither of them chose, they keep their distance. But how long can that last?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Oni no Ko
synopsis:
Circumstances lead Ichirou Satou to transfer to a new school where he just wants to live a peaceful life, but a girl from his class piques his interest...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Kimi ga Shinu made Koi wo Shitai: Side Stories
title_english: My Wish Is Fall in Love Until You Die. Side Stories
title_japanese: きみが死ぬまで恋をしたい side stories

title: Moto Rakugaki to One Room-gurashi
title_japanese: 元らくがきとワンルーム暮らし
synopsis:
Life has never been easy for Nagata Kabi, but no matter what gets thrown her way, she manages to work through it and find peace in the chaos. In this latest diary manga, Kabi explores life living alone and the sudden appearance of an old doodle. Whether it's all in her head or just a way to cope with loneliness, Kabi embraces the company, naming her Anko, and proceeds to share her daily tasks with her new friend. Despite the delusion, Kabi can't help but long to continue the late-night meals and shared udon with such pleasant company.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Zenin Kakugo Gangimari na Eroge no Jakyouto Mob ni Tensei shiteshimatta Ken
title_english: I Got Reincarnated as a Cultist Mob in an Eroge Full of Maniacs with Death Wishes
title_japanese: 全員覚悟ガンギマリなエロゲーの邪教徒モブに転生してしまった件
synopsis:
After being reincarnated as a cultist mob in the notoriously brutal eroge Seeker of the Netherlight, Okley has only one goal: escape the deranged cult before he ends up sacrificed like all the rest. But one reckless move during a battle with the Holy Church earns him the attention of a savage female executive—and worse, the mad cult leader herself.

Now his everyday life turns into a living nightmare as he tries to survive in a world where every heroine is unhinged, eyes blazing with the kind of obsession that laughs in the face of death... and they all seem disturbingly fixated on him.

His life—and his chastity—are on the line in a no-save nightmare route.

Warning: This story contains nothing but cute girls with severely messed-up kinks and an unhealthy obsession with the protagonist.

(Source: Hanashi Media)

title: Zenzen Kawaikunai
title_japanese: ぜんぜんかわいくない

title: Dutch Wife to Sumu Imouto
title_japanese: ダッチワイフと住む妹

title: Delusional Romance Is a Bad Idea
Men and Women Shouldn't Sit Together After Age Seven
Efficient Dating of Single Men and Women
Konyaku Haki wo Manugareta Koushaku Reijou wa, Otto no Ai wo Shinjirarenai
title_english: The Duke's Daughter, Who Escaped the Cancellation of Her Engagement, Cannot Believe in Her Husband's Love
title_japanese: 婚約破棄を免れた公爵令嬢は、夫の愛を信じられない
synopsis:
"I always believed I was the only one who should stand by his side..."

Prince Ashley, the first prince of the Kingdom of Sforzia, and Lady Violetta, a duke's daughter, are engaged to be married. Although their engagement was arranged for political reasons, Violetta has worked hard to support him as the crown prince since they were young. However, as she became busier, they started spending less time together, and Ashley became close to a cheerful and naive young lady, who is Violetta's complete opposite.T hen, Violetta hears a shocking rumor: "Poor Lady Violetta. Imagine being cast aside by the crown prince!" Rather than let another young woman take him away, Violetta makes a firm decision: "Fine, I'll be the one to end this engagement!"

(Source: Shusuisha)

title: Living with Romeo
synopsis:
Sol, a college student, returns home for the first time in three years, only to find her mother Mi-ae living with a young guy named Oh Romi. At first, she thinks he's Mi-ae's boyfriend, but it turns out they're just housemates. Sol somehow ends up living with them, although she doesn't like Romi at all. She believes he's too brazen and carefree. However, in time, she finds herself inexplicably drawn to him...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Kokou no Ryouiki
synopsis: Goalkeeper Kouki Inugami is struggling to find his place on his school's soccer team.

title: Kimi to Hanabi to Yakusoku to
synopsis:
Makoto Natsume, a first-year junior high school student in Chōfu, Tokyo, is suddenly confessed to by a fellow freshman named Aki Hayama. Aki told him that her grandmother once told her about meeting a boy named Makoto Natsume in the future. Having never met before, Makoto is convinced that Aki is mistaken. When Aki brings up a painting of a fireworks, Makoto decides to help her find the Makoto Natsume she is looking for. The following year, the two head to Nagaoka, Niigata, to attend the city's famed fireworks festival, suspecting that the painting is linked to it.

(Source: Wikipedia)

title: Kimi to Hanabi to Yakusoku to
synopsis:
Makoto Natsume, a first-year junior high school student in Chōfu, Tokyo, is suddenly confessed to by a fellow freshman named Aki Hayama. Aki told him that her grandmother once told her about meeting a boy named Makoto Natsume in the future. Having never met before, Makoto is convinced that Aki is mistaken. When Aki brings up a painting of a fireworks, Makoto decides to help her find the Makoto Natsume she is looking for. The following year, the two head to Nagaoka, Niigata, to attend the city's famed fireworks festival, suspecting that the painting is linked to it.

(Source: Wikipedia)

title: Ai wo Chikau ni wa Hayasugiru
title_english: It's Too Early to Swear Our Love.
title_japanese: 愛を誓うには早すぎる

title: Torokeru Yajuu Ouji: Katsute no Tenshi wa Gachimuchi Body
title_english: My Sweet Wild Prince: Little Angel Turned Buff Beast
title_japanese: とろける野獣王子～かつての天使はガチムチボディ～
synopsis:
Koharu, the tough daughter of a martial arts family, was childhood friends with Masumi, an angelic boy who she often had to protect because he was bullied due to his mixed blood. When he moved away, Koharu went to college without him. One day, she gets harassed by a group of guys only to be saved by a host-club worker, who turns out to be Masumi! The little angel she remembers has grown up to be tall and amazingly strong! And kind of sexy now, too... Soon after, Masumi quits his job as a host to become a live-in instructor at Koharu's family dojo. What will happen with them under the same roof!?

(Source: Renta!)

title: Melanco Killing
synopsis:
Shougo Amane, a conman belonging to the criminal organization "Shikiyou," feels superior by deceiving and controlling people. He sets his sights on a new target and approaches her. However, it turns out to be a trap to capture him. On the brink of death, Shougo makes a certain proposal...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Under Doctor
synopsis:
If you want to live, find him. If you don't want to die, don't go near him. He is the greatest doctor and the strongest hero, the legend of the underworld—Under Doctor Haiji. Medical drama x heart-pumping action!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Udatsu no Yorimichi
synopsis:
Things just aren't going well for Udatsu, either at work or at home, and he ends up failing to keep a promise to his young son. His wife is angry, his son is sulking, and his own frustration continues to mount. In the midst of a quarrel with his wife, his son suddenly disappears. What will become of this family on the brink of collapse?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Chikasugiru Futari
synopsis:
From the moment they were born, they've been together through everything—waking hours, sleeping, and even bath time. At this point, calling them "childhood friends" feels a bit too soft. No, these two are "Sh*ttyhood Friends." More than childhood friends, but less than lovers. Having come full circle, they're basically an old married couple, with a messed up sense of personal space.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Shuumatsu, Nani Taberu?
synopsis:
In a world overrun by zombies and nearing its end, a man named Meshino, who claims to be the former head cook of the Japanese Maritime Self-Defense Force, appears in front of Minori, a girl separated from her family and living alone. He then declares that he will make "butter chicken curry" for her...!?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Isekai Mahou Shoujo Radical☆Haruna
title_japanese: 異世界魔法少女ラジカル☆ハルナ
synopsis:
Haruna, a magical girl who fought against evil to protect everyone's smiles, is suddenly transported by a mysterious magic circle to an unfamiliar parallel world. In this world—where the concept of "Magical Girls" doesn't even exist—the Demon King, once defeated by a legendary hero, shows signs of resurrection. As a result, massive swarms of magical beasts have begun to overrun the land. Upon learning that evil is robbing the people of this world of their smiles too, Haruna stands alone against a massive tide of monsters threatening to wipe out a village. No matter how many wounds she sustains, or how blood-stained she becomes, she never stops smiling as she eradicates the darkness. Slowly but surely, the name of the "Magical Girl" gets etched into the history of this parallel world.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Charming Grim Reaper
synopsis:
I, Han Ji-An, am already struggling as a no-name actress. To make matters worse, I ended up falling down the stairs and dying because of superstar Ji So-Won's fanclub. However, in reality, Ji So-Won is a grim reaper trying to take me to the afterlife!? That can't possibly be true!? I'm not ready to leave this life. No. It shouldn't be me!

(Source: MU)

title: Ore no Kanojo wa Kawaii Darou ga
title_japanese: 俺のカノジョはかわいいだろうが
synopsis:
Chocolate has had a one-sided crush with his gaming friend and best friend Bom for many years. Bom has told Chocolate she is a trans woman, when she should be his best friend. In the wake of each other's "confessions," the two begin to see every day in a new color.

A "boy meets trans girl story" with an otaku boy and a trans woman who are beginners in love! 

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Rival Arrival
synopsis:
It's up to me to decide the "end." Change the world with your rivals! Two people in their 60s star in a hot-blooded rival story!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: 8-ban Deguchi
synopsis:
Don't overlook any anomalies. If you find anomalies, turn back immediately. If you don't find anomalies, do not turn back. To go out from Exit 8.

(Source: Playism)

title: Koukoku no Souheki: Kizumono no Hanayome Gaiden
title_japanese: 皇國の双璧 傷モノの花嫁 外伝

title: Office Hero
synopsis:
Reborn in South Korea in 2026, former hero Yong Sajun struggles to adjust to a world without magic or dragons. After surviving a brutal job market, he finally lands a position at a major corporation—only to come face to face with the man he once loved in his past life: the prince he failed to save. Haunted by memories of tragedy, Sajun tries to keep his distance. But when he discovers that the prince has been cursed, Sajun resolves to save him once again...even if it means juggling deadlines and danger alike!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Dating 101
synopsis:
"Once I grow up, I am going to marry you, Yi-chan!"

From childhood, Seo Euna adored his next door neighbor Kang Yi-chan with absolute devotion. He followed him everywhere, chased off anyone who tried to get close to him, regardless of whether they were male or female, and declared him his future husband to anyone who would listen.

To Yi-chan, he was just a clingy little brother figure, unbearably persistent and impossible to shake off. So the moment he entered university, he disappeared from Euna's life entirely, convinced he had finally escaped.

Three years pass, and Yi-chan returns from military service relieved that the nightmare is over. Until the first day of class.

There, in his major lecture, sits a bright eyed freshman, smiling directly at him: Seo Euna. He has grown up, followed him to the same university, and looks more determined than ever.

This time, Yi-chan might not be able to run.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Love Beneath a Blue Tide
synopsis:
Lionel, raised in a violent and suffocating home, finds his first real affection when he meets Arthur, an immortal merman living in human form within an old castle.

But Lionel's family is obsessed with a legend that promises eternal life through the body of a merman, and they set their sights on Arthur. Torn between love and the chains of his family, Lionel must decide whom he will protect.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: To Love X
synopsis:
Hasol and Jinyul were once each other's exes. After returning to university, Jinyul unexpectedly runs into Hasol again. Uncomfortable with facing a former lover, Hasol tries to avoid him, but then becomes possessed by a ghost that had been stalking Jinyul.

As a result, the two end up doing things they never did back when they were still a couple...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Lies of the Damned
synopsis:
Tasked with guarding a demon hunted down by the villagers, Finn begins to doubt the truth he's been told. Everyone swears the demon is a murderer, yet the demon insists it's the villagers who are lying. Believing the wrong person could result in eternal damnation, but Finn can't help but be intrigued by the demon's claims...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: From Stray to Stay
synopsis:
While filming a TV animal program about feral dogs tearing up an apartment complex's trash area, the crew stumbles upon a mysterious man living among them...who just so happens to be the boss of a gang of loan sharks. With no one able to train the man-beast, he is brought to Lee Jiryong: star dog trainer in a heap of debt. In exchange for bringing their boss back to form, the sharks promise to eliminate all of his debt. Jumping at the opportunity, Jiryong takes it on...only to find out that this wild "canine" companion has both bite and bark alike.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Satsuriku Robot to Hito no Manaka
title_english: Manaka the Human and the Slaughter Robot
title_japanese: 殺戮ロボと人のマナカ
synopsis:
For the future her parents expect of her, Yui, a high school student, spends each day with machine-like precision. But one day, she meets a fearless girl with a body that's half robot...

A story of two girls: a girl who seems like a robot, and a robot who seems almost human.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Kaita Mono wo Jittaika suru Nouryoku de Motenai Ore ga Harem Seikatsu
title_japanese: 描いたものを実体化する能力でモテない俺がハーレム生活
synopsis:
Kagehiko was attending art school, feeling jealous of god-tier artists and frustrated with his own lack of improvement. One day, while brooding on a railway overpass, he bumps into a passing old man and... falls. When he wakes up... he realizes he's been granted "the ability to materialize what he draws." And then... starting with a dramatic reunion with Pastel, a beautiful girl he drew in his childhood, his life begins to turn around...

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Shiratori Kazuko wa 31-kaku
title_english: Shiratori Kazuko's Number of Strokes Is 31

title: Wavers
synopsis:
At a high school deep in the snowy mountains, a teacher was killed. There are 28 suspects. They all have superpowers.

(Source: Kadokawa, Translated)

title: Boyish Onna Tomodachi to Issen Koete Shimatta Ken
title_english: When I Crossed the Line With My Tomboy Friend
title_japanese: ボーイッシュ女友達と一線越えてしまった件

title: Lens-goshi, Tatta Ichido no Koi wo Suru: Shissou Reijou to Cameraman
title_japanese: レンズ越し、たった一度の恋をする～失踪令嬢とカメラマン～

title: D.I.L.D.O: Droid for Immersive Libido Dynamics Optimization
title_english: D.I.L.D.O: Droid for Immersive Libido Dynamics Optimization
synopsis:
For Seo Jaeyun, a seemingly innocent game of Secret Santa is about to change his life. After unwrapping his special gift, he is shocked to find a dildo—and one that can come to life, at that! The dildo will do anything to please his master, and try as he might, Jaeyun can't find it in himself to kick his newfound companion out. Instead, perhaps they can work together find the greatest gift of all...deep, deep inside.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: To My Dear Horror
synopsis:
When hardworking student Wan ends up covering his father's job at a wealthy estate, a run-in with the sprinklers leaves him soaked—and catches the eye of Junghoo, the ruthless heir who's never been denied anything. One look, and Wan's fate veers off course.

(Source: Manta)

title: Deep Pivot
synopsis:
Luck has only been on Yeonwoo's side twice in his life: when he and his brother were saved by an esper named Seojoon, and when he reunites with Seojoon as a 20-year-old guide. Unfortunately, Seojoon doesn't seem to remember saving Yeonwoo. Not only does the older man see Yeonwoo as a kid, but he also makes it clear that he doesn't want to get attached to any guide. However, there's no telling what'll happen when their sync rate is so high and Yeonwoo has had a crush on Seojoon for years...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: The Strongest Lady Hides Her Strength
title_english: The Strongest Lady Hides Her Strength
synopsis:
The Hero guards the empire in times of war but is sealed away when peace prevails, making her life an incessant cycle of fighting and slumber. That is, until she wakes up as Roshanne Leilaten, a meek noble lady looked down upon by even her own servants. Unwilling to give up the freedom she so yearns, Roshanne conceals her true identity as she investigates how to permanently break the seal that binds her to the emperor. But can a girl who's used to leading with her fists navigate high society?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kimi, Shioreru Koto Nakare
synopsis:
Kaoru, who has no boyfriend nor family, quietly runs a bonsai shop alone in an old house inherited from his grandparents. There he meets a young man in a flashy suit named Riichi. Riichi visits Kaoru every day to enthusiastically gaze upon a withered camellia bonsai that holds a special meaning for Koaru. One day, Riichi collapses from overwork and Kaoru takes care of him. Riichi then becomes attached to Kaoru and begins to visit frequently. Kaoru enjoys spending time with Riichi, but when he realizes he's gradually being drawn to him, a certain anxiety begins... A healing love story between a friendly younger man and a bonsai master with a secret!

(Source: eBookJapan, translated)

title: Rare Monster? Sore, Tada no Gaichuu desu yo: Shiranu Ma ni Dungeon-ka shita Jitaku de no Nichijou Seikatsu ga Haishin sarete Bazuttan desu ga
title_japanese: レアモンスター?それ、ただの害虫ですよ ～知らぬ間にダンジョン化した自宅での日常生活が配信されてバズったんですが～

title: Boy Meets Trans Girl
title_japanese: ボーイミーツトランスガール

title: Tsuuhan de Katta Youtou ga Gachi Datta: Tameshigiri shitara Kuukan ga Sakete Isekai ni Tobasareta Ageku, Densetsu no Yuusha dato Kanchigai sarete Komatteimasu
title_japanese: 通販で買った妖刀がガチだった〜試し斬りしたら空間が裂けて異世界に飛ばされた挙句、伝説の勇者だと勘違いされて困っています〜
synopsis:
College student Souji Miyamoto ends up getting transported to another world after swinging a replica sword he bought on impulse. Arriving in the middle of a kingdom's hero-summoning ritual, Souji is mistaken for the Hero.

By a strange turn of events, the princess discovers that he isn't a real hero. Told that he'll get executed if others find out he’s an impostor, Souji is forced to set out on a journey to defeat the Demon King. However, the members of the hero's party all seem to have their own eccentricities...!?

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)

title: Nami yori mo Odayaka de, Hoshi yori mo Aoku
title_english: Calmer Than the Waves, Bluer Than the Stars.
title_japanese: 波よりも穏やかで、星よりも青く

title: Senbonzakura: Taishou Hyakunen Teito Oukyou
title_japanese: 千本桜-大正百年帝都桜京-

title: Megami "Isekai Tensei Nani ni Naritai desu ka" Ore "Yuusha no Rokkotsu de"
title_japanese: 女神「異世界転生何になりたいですか」 俺「勇者の肋骨で」
synopsis:
The protagonist of the tale, simply referred to as "I," experiences an endless cycle of reincarnation. The narrative takes place in a different universe where people are free to select their next form. However, the waiting list for popular roles, like "Demon King" or "Hero with Cheat Skills and a Harem," has reached 50,000 years due to a recent spike in applications.

The protagonist decides to repeatedly reincarnate into increasingly strange forms because he refuses to wait. These roles include the rib of a hero in charge of a harem, a hermit crab, a vegetable, and even an explosive used to blow up blissfully happy couples.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Caught in the Dark Navy Admiral's Net
title_english: Caught in the Dark Navy Admiral's Net
synopsis:
Selah Cardi is a former marine biology student who woke up in a romance novel as an inconsequential extra. Eager to survive the plot, Selah manages to rescue Maria so that she and Duke Herbert, her fiancé, will be indebted to her. But then Admiral Ellaim notices her and her magical abilities that allow her to breathe underwater. Selah soon discovers that Ellaim is a merman called a siren, and that he needs her powers to recover from a mysterious illness. Will her dream of retiring by the sea in peace ever come true?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Friend Request
synopsis:
Online, Yuni is a glamorous influencer. In reality, she lives in poverty with her timid, overworked mother, Deulre. After a horrific family tragedy leaves Yuni orphaned, she's suddenly thrust back in time and finds her mother a teenager again. Determined to rewrite the future, Yuni enrolls in her mother's high school to protect her teen mom from her toxic friends and the choices that led to heartbreak, abuse, and death. But changing the past isn't easy—especially when your own mother sees you as the enemy. Can Yuni save her mother... and heal their broken bond in the process?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Reaper of Romance
synopsis:
Kang Seorim dies from overwork, only to be reassigned as a grim reaper. Sick of taking lives, he stumbles upon Cupid at work and realizes there might be something better than death: love. After all, why reap souls when you could reap romance? Cupid, however, is far from thrilled about someone challenging his divine purpose, and before long, the two are locked in a strange dance of rivalry, irritation, and an attraction neither of them expected.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Kanna to Niichan
synopsis:
Kanna is a girl who can see ghosts. One day, a mysterious individual wielding a shinai who only she can see appears before her, and, for some odd reason, begins following her around. Kanna dubs him "Big Bro," and through this strange relationship, she slowly begins to grow...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: The Demon God
synopsis:
A hundred children were trapped on Hengshan. Only one walked out alive—a boy named Dan Hyeongwoo. He survived the hell created by the Cheon Gija and gained power worthy of being called that of a demon god in return. But the world felt unfamiliar to him, and its rules made no sense... So, he becomes an escort warrior of the Henan Escort Agency, relearning what people are and what the world is from the ground up. Everything he does is for one single purpose: the day he will take revenge on Cheon Gija.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Kamakura Shiyakusho Fuurekika
synopsis:
"You're going to die."

Looking for a stable life, Sakanoshita started working at city hall this spring, but with those ominous words, he was whisked away to a certain department. In this department, which deals with "supernatural phenomena," Sakanoshita meets a hypocritically courteous man named Namerikawa. Physical abnormalities, mysterious occurrences. He can no longer be a "normal human."

Demons and humans. The two have intermingled. A horror bromance depicting human feelings and the supernatural.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: The Redemption of Earl Nottingham
synopsis:
Is my cursed husband's fate up to me?

Madelyn's husband Ian was left broken after the war, and in turn, made her life a living hell. Fleeing her doomed marriage, she meets a tragic end. But when she opens her eyes, she finds herself at 17 again. The war has yet to start, and Madelyn can still change her fate. But what about Ian?

(Source: Manta)

title: Rewriting My Tragic Ending
synopsis:
A turn of fate... by your own hand.

Alicia Melfont vows to restore the former glory of her house after the Dark God's agent massacres her family. But when a mysterious book reveals that she's only a supporting character meant to die for the true protagonist of the story, Alicia decides she won't let some silly book determine her fate.

(Source: Manta)

title: Shall We Bathe, Your Grace?
synopsis:
Marry me, and we can bathe twice a day!

Unwashed hair, dirty fingernails, and the sickening stench of body odor mixed with perfume! Nadia is horrified to wake up in a romance fantasy novel where bathing is abhorred. Her only hope lies in Duke Cartane, the one man who doesn't stink. Will he help her get her squeaky-clean happy ending?

(Source: Manta)

title: Lies Become You
synopsis:
Once an enemy, now a husband?

Femme fatale Veronica is sentenced to death for obsessing over the prince. With her life now in danger, she boards a ship to escape, unaware that it belongs to her archnemesis, the alluring Prince Halid. He agrees to help her, but only on the condition that she pretends to be his wife!

(Source: Manta)

title: Mokrin
synopsis:
Can love transcend all boundaries?

The 200-year long peace in Mokrin's island tribe is broken when the warlike Gyui-heols arrive to demand open borders. What's more, Eonyeong, the son of their chieftess, falls hopelessly in love with Mokrin. Now it's up to her—will she spurn his affection or marry him for the sake of her people?

(Source: Manta)

title: The Tainted Half
synopsis:
Two brothers. One concubine.

Seolha's face was disfigured by her mother, who sought to deny the emperor his prize: the most beautiful concubine in the world. Now forced to endure a lifetime of abuse, Seolha can only pin her hopes on Muon, the emperor's twin brother. But is he really someone she can trust?

(Source: Manta)

title: Part-Time Couple
synopsis:
Da-in never expected to reunite with her first love, Seojun, under such bizarre circumstances. Claiming that marriage is the only way to escape his supposed fated death, Seojun proposes a 100-day contract marriage. Refusing to be at a disadvantage, Da-in negotiates her own terms and plunges into an unconventional newlywed life. What starts as a calculated agreement slowly unravels into something deeper, as unresolved feelings resurface and the countdown to day 100 threatens to change everything.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Punisube Mocchiri Seichouki
title_japanese: ぷにすべもっちり性長期
synopsis:
1. Oshiego no Mesugaki Futari ni Game Kankaku de Kyoushi Jinsei Owaraseraresou ni Natteru Hanashi
2. Omase na Sakuragai (The Precocious Pink-Clam)
3. Bye-Bye Atashi no Hatsukoi (Farewell, My First-Love)
4. Shitteru yo? (Didn't You Know?)
5. Uchi no Imouto Shiri ga Kokuhou Sugiru Ken. (The Case Of My Little-Sister's Ass Being a Next-Level National Treasure)
6. Hiyake no Kokkyou (The Suntan Border)
7. Midnight Wedding

title: Uruwashiki Salvatore
title_japanese: 麗しきサルヴァトーレ
synopsis:
Academy Award-winning actor Salvatore has captivated the world with his overwhelming charisma. One night, he reunites with his former classmate Jane and confesses his long-kept feelings, but his words go unanswered...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Last Summer Sparkle
title_japanese: ラストサマースパークル
synopsis:
Every day is more exciting when your best friend becomes your lover...!

Kyouhei is a third-year high school student whose future plan form is still blank. Lately, Kyouhei has found himself preoccupied—all because his best friend, Eiji, confessed to him. Ever since the entrance ceremony, they've been inseparable. But now, Kyouhei wonders—will Eiji's confession change everything between them? Kyouhei can’t stop worrying about it, but before he knows it, his heart has already started pounding at the sight of Eiji whose cuteness he never noticed!

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

title: Hoiho Hoihoiho
synopsis:
After hitting her head, Kodama Konbukawa's psychic abilities awaken. With this power, she'll change everything! Or, well, at least her school life! But though she was supposed to be able to set her life of failure on the right course, things are never that easy even with psychic powers.

(Source: Amumo 98, translated)

title: Nazo no Shokugyou "Bonyuu Tamer" tte nan desu ka!?
title_japanese: 謎の職業【母乳テイマー】ってなんですか!?

title: Uso Tsuki Kitsune Tsuki
synopsis:
As for me, I want you to haunt me until I die. Futaba, a fox spirit who descended during a game of "Kokkuri-san," decides to haunt Kuramochi, a teacher who was present at the scene, intending to mess with him. But it turns out Kuramochi has been able to see supernatural beings since birth?!

"When such a beautiful spirit is right in front of me, acting spoiled, it would be unreasonable to expect me not to make a move."

Futaba is flustered by Kuramochi's obsession, which is more monstrous than any monster. The one who haunts is being haunted? A tale of being haunted and doted upon by an obsessive occult teacher who is in love with a beautiful fox spirit.

(Source: Taiyo Tosho, translated)

title: Sayonara Sea Moon
synopsis:
Yuu Karatsuki, once an elite detective, has hit hard times. Transferred to the countryside, he spends his days in hardship. Until, that is, he's asked to search for an escaped space jellyfish...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Puni-chan
synopsis:
Yuu-kun, a lonely elementary schooler was a introvert who was struggling to make friends. That's when Niinii... Wait that's not the name!! The fluffy and mysterious pillow called Puni-chan became his friend. A 4-koma manga!

(Source: MU)

title: Killer's Familia
synopsis:
Baal and Levi are members of the "Hornfolk" warrior race. The man who adopted them runs an organization of assassins but lives in constant fear of their sheer destructive power and complete lack of ethics. Good thing Baal and Levi love the boss! Nevertheless, the boss wants them dead! A pseudo-family battle comedy filled with plenty of affection, bloodlust, monstrous beasts, and monstrous people♪

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Busou Tensei Bishoujo to Gattai shita Ossan Densetsu ni Naru
title_japanese: 武装転生 美少女と合体したおっさん伝説になる

title: The Terminal Villainess's Cure
synopsis:
Lohiriel is the second daughter of House Casyan, a family infamous for its virulent poisons, and she has only one year left to live. That is, unless she can procure a rare plant that's exclusively grown in the imperial gardens... To access it, she strikes a daring deal with the crown prince: If he enters a one-year contract marriage with her, she'll provide him with a treatment for the ailing emperor. That means Lohiriel's medical expertise will prove useful for more people than she thought!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Mayohiga no Lolibabaa-tachi
title_japanese: マヨヒガの幼婆〈ロリババア〉たち
synopsis:
1-3. Mayohiga no Lolibabaa-tachi (The Loli Hags of Mayohiga)
4. Usagi no Shinto ni Naranai ka?
5. Osan Furugitsune
6. Minasoko ni Yuragu Medochi
7. Sondai Renjutsushi ni Shikaeshi shitai!
8. Pan no Kaori no Houjoushin
9-10. Ryuujin-sama ga Yome (My Wife The Heavenly-Dragon)
11. Mayohiga no Lolibabaa-tachi: Tanuki Onsen-hen

title: Gakuen no Madonna no Watanabe-san ga, Nazeka Maishuu Yotei wo Kiitekuru @comic
title_japanese: 学園のマドンナの渡辺さんが、なぜか毎週予定を聞いてくる@COMIC
synopsis:
Ryoichi Aikawa is a high schooler who prefers spending his youth fishing in solitude rather than chasing romance. For him, the tranquility of the harbor is everything—until one day he saves a girl from being harassed by some troublemakers. To his surprise, that girl is Watanabe-san, the incredibly popular school "Madonna." Ever since that unexpected encounter, the school idol has somehow taken an interest in Ryoichi's fishing hobby and started asking about his weekend plans every single week.

(Source: TO Books, translated)

title: I Became the First Prince: Legend of Sword's Song
synopsis:
Reborn as a sword, I lived for several hundred years, spending my entire existence looking after everyone. Then, out of nowhere, I took over the body of a fifteen-year-old uncouth first prince.

"Do you have any idea how many I've raised?"

The great knight once called the Undefeated, the Dragon Slayer who brought down the Mad Dragon, the Mercenary King, and more... I raised every single one of them. The Magic Sword Gruhorn possessed the body of the uncouth first prince... And has begun to write a new legend.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: Yuusha Izoku
synopsis:
The hero who defeated the Demon King and saved the world has died. Gil, a half-elf who carries his blood, heads eagerly to the funeral of the "father he's never met" after hearing about an inheritance, but...?! The womanizing hero's love-starved children collide in a ruthless, blood-soaked inheritance battle! Will it end in a mountain of corpses... or something else entirely?! A rare and outrageous post-adventure isekai story!!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Ore ni Tsugou ga Yosugiru Machi: Shihaisha Skill de Isekai Harem Musou
title_japanese: 俺に都合が良すぎる街～支配者スキルで異世界ハーレム無双～
synopsis:
The story centers on the reincarnated protagonist, Sakuta Doumyouji, in an "Erotic x Brain Battle" series. The town where Sakuta lives is said to be ruled by three powerful women, but the true ruler is actually Sakuta, who possesses cheat skills. The series depicts Sakuta as he operates secretly as the shadow ruler of this isekai.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Nani ga Tame ni Kishi wa Tatsu
title_japanese: 何がために騎士は立つ
synopsis:
There was a boy in Gerinzel, a small village in the Kingdom of Ilios. The boy's name was Cruz Linzar. Born as the second son of a poor farming family, he had nothing to inherit and felt inferior about having nothing. As he spent his days tormented by a vague sense of something, a man suddenly appeared in the empty village. The mysterious man, his name unknown and his face obscured by a mask, appeared before the boy. At his waist was a special sword, the kind wielded by a "knight."

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kubiwa no Nai Inu-tachi
synopsis:
The protagonist Haru volunteers in a shelter for dogs that have been abandoned and are in danger of losing their lives—the last refuge for rescue dogs. Here, she is confronted with the dark side of the pet industry, including puppy factories, retired breeding dogs, mixed-breed dogs, and abandonment. She witnesses the heartbreaking reality surrounding dogs and the world they live in. Determined to save their lives, Haru rises to the challenge.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Unmei nado Sonzai shinai node
title_japanese: 運命など存在しないので

title: Kaigeki no Kinato
synopsis:
In a world teeming with magic, young Kinato yearns for adventure! But his special magic power happens to be...seitai healing?! When adventure does come his way, will Kinato be able to use his minor healing abilities to become a hero?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Himorogi no Miko
synopsis:
The sacred maiden of the Kazami clan, a family of renowned onmyouji, can wield immense power so long as she maintains her purity. But when her childhood friend, Kyousuke, tags along on her missions...!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Doll Oji: #Doll ni Hamatta Ojisan no Hanashi
title_japanese: ドルおじ #ドールに沼〈ハマ〉ったおじさんの話

title: Yomeiya: Rougetsu
synopsis:
Kizuki Sakaki is a handsome, intelligent, and young male university student from a distinguished family who has become involved in politics. One day, a mysterious female student named Yui appears before him and claims to have the special ability to see how much time people have left to live. As soon as they meet, she makes a shocking confession to Kizuki: "You only have four days left to live, senpai♡" Kizuki doesn't take this absurd story seriously, but then he witnesses someone die just as Yui predicted...!?
