Human desires and lives intertwine in this suspenseful battle of wits between life expectancy specialists who trade people's lives!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Koroshiya Idol Matosaki Ayame
title_japanese: 殺し屋アイドル纏咲アヤメ
synopsis:
Ayame Matosaki is a professional assassin. She carries out her work simply as a means of survival, until one day she meets the ghost of an aspiring idol whose dream was cut short. Together, they must fight to the death to survive in the entertainment industry, in this girls' buddy action manga!

(Source: Shounen Gahousha, translated)

title: Ghostdog
synopsis:
As rain fell outside, a customer dressed in mourning clothes entered La Mer Bar alone. His clothes were drenched, water dripping from him. The bartender, Shimura, was captivated. The man ordered the Charleston, the signature cocktail of the previous owner, Satomi. This customer had likely been here before... Just as Shimura was pondering this, the customer ordered a second drink: "A Ghost Dog." "If anyone ever orders this cocktail, watch out. That guy might be a real dog ghost." Shimura remembered what the previous owner had told him long ago.

(Source: eBookJapan, translated)

title: Becoming the Cheon Clan's Mad Dog
Kono Inu to Kitara Mago no Koto shika Kangaeteinai: Kensei Maou no Yarinokoshi
title_japanese: この犬ときたら孫のことしか考えていない～犬生魔王のやり遺し～

title: Sususu Sundome
synopsis:
1. Sundome (On the Brink)
2. Oblate
3. Shitapi (Tongue Piercing)
4. Tomodachi no Koibito (My Friend's Lover)
5. Motokano (Ex-Girlfriend)
6. Sweets Game
7. Nure Sensei (Wet Sensei)

title: Sea of June
synopsis:
Busan, 1936. Yeon Jeong lives her life without fitting in anywhere, until she meets a mermaid by fate. The mermaid tells her that she has come to pick her up as promised, and asks her to follow her to the place where eternal happiness lies.

"Can I be happy there at last, living as myself?"

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

title: Souichi no "Itou Junji-ten: Yuuwaku"
title_japanese: 双一の「伊藤潤二展 誘惑」
synopsis: A parody one-shot promoting the Junji Ito "Enchantment" Exhibition at the Setagaya Literary Museum.

title: Katakoi Saburou
synopsis:
A story about an invincible samurai and a young princess that he has sworn to protect.

(Source: MU)

title: Classmate
synopsis:
"I'll be your friend."

A chilling ghost boy, Haesu Lee, visits the outcast, Eunha Joo. The moment she accepts this dangerous friendship, unexpected events unfold around Eunha... Will this hand offered by her mysterious friend be salvation, or a curse?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Uchuujin Fuzai Shoumei
synopsis:
Hundreds of years have passed since mankind ventured out into space, yet any evidence of other life remains elusive. For what reason do we live in this vast, lonely universe?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Azusasou no Shokutaku
title_english: The Dining Table at Azusa House
synopsis:
After completing their training with an assassin organization, four young people are brought in for their final test: to kill each other, to determine the sole survivor after six months. While you might think a brutal battle is about to begin, the four are enjoying their six-month reprieve, stretching their wings in the regular world! But of course, the assassin test continues...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Kazoku ga Neshizumaru Yoru ni Hitozuma wo Daita Hon
title_japanese: 家族が寝静まる夜に人妻を抱いた本

title: Unmei wa Yaku ni Tatanai
synopsis:
One day, red threads appeared on the fingers of all humans worldwide. Since those bound by that thread were destined for lasting relationships, it became known as the "red thread of fate," and a new era dawned where thread-based romance became the norm. While all this was happening, a red thread suddenly appeared on the finger of the protagonist, Tsumugi, who, incidentally, just happens to despise "thread-based love"....

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Doko yori mo Tooi Basho ni Iru Kimi e
title_japanese: どこよりも遠い場所にいる君へ
synopsis:
Kazuki Tsukigase is a high school boy who carries a certain secret. In search of a place where no one knows him, he enrolls at Sakijima High School on a remote island.

On Sakijima, there is a place known as the "Cove of Spiriting Away." One early summer day, Kazuki finds a girl lying unconscious in the cove. The girl—Nanao, 16 years old—later regains consciousness in the hospital, but her identity remains unknown. What is the meaning behind the word "1974" that she murmured?

A touching boy-meets-girl story.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Doko yori mo Tooi Basho ni Iru Kimi e
title_japanese: どこよりも遠い場所にいる君へ
synopsis:
Kazuki Tsukigase is a high school boy who carries a certain secret. In search of a place where no one knows him, he enrolls at Sakijima High School on a remote island.

A touching boy-meets-girl story.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Stone Flower
synopsis:
Ruten, a sick young girl living alone in a massive house in Kyoto, hires a woman named Kana to be her live-in housekeeper after a disastrous interview turns into a possible friendship. Kana is no ordinary woman, however—and nor is the Kyoto that she and Ruten live in, or the situations they find themselves in. Why is Kana immortal? What happened to cause Kyoto to be shrouded in a black mist for the past millennium? Why are there reptile people everywhere outside the city?

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Saikyou no Kensei, Bishoujo Maid ni Tensei shi Houki de Musou suru
title_english: The Strongest Sword Saint Is Reincarnated as a Beautiful Maid and Becomes Unrivaled with a Broom
title_japanese: 最強の剣聖、美少女メイドに転生し箒で無双する
synopsis:
The greatest sword saint of all time, Arnoick, has died. His sword skills were passed on to his apprentice, and it seemed his story had come to an end. But then, Arnoick is reincarnated as the beautiful maid Annette! Due to his thin arms and weak body, he was supposed to give up the path of the sword and live a peaceful life, but he takes up a broom and stands up to protect Rosalena, the daughter of a fallen noble family. An overwhelming fantasy about a man who turns into a beautiful girl and restarts his life!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: The Killer Guy Next Door
synopsis:
"What?? Me, like you?? W-where did this all go wrong??"

It was supposed to be the heart-pounding start of her first time living alone. But on the very first day of the new semester, Yeon-hee runs into Kim Jun, a man who looks exactly like a gangster. After a misunderstanding where Jun thought she was tailing him leads to a near-death(?) experience, Yeon-hee prays desperately that she never has to see that thug ever again.

But as fate would have it... he lives in the same building. He is even her next-door neighbor! Same school, and even the same club! Yeon-hee is getting a massive headache because of this neighbor who acts like he wants to kill her.

But at some point, Kim Jun, who seemed like such a gangster, suddenly does a 180 and starts getting closer to Yeon-hee...?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Chou Kaguya-hime!
synopsis:
Tsukuyomi is a virtual realm where hopes and dreams come together. Iroha Sakayori, a 17-year-old high school student in Tokyo, leads an extremely busy life trying to balance part-time work and academics. She finds peace by watching a popular streamer named Yachiyo Runami, who is the administrator of an online virtual space called Tsukuyomi.

Iroha frequents Tsukuyomi, where people can live different lives and freely pursue their creativity, and she passes the time by supporting Yachiyo and playing battle games to earn a little extra money. On her way home one day, Iroha finds a telephone pole shining with iridescent hues. To her surprise, an adorable baby emerges from the pole. Unable to abandon it, Iroha takes the infant home and watches her rapidly grow into a girl her own age.

"Are you Princess Kaguya?"

The grown-up Kaguya develops a self-indulgent personality. At Kaguya's fervent request, Iroha helps her start streaming in Tsukuyomi. With Iroha as producer and songwriter and Kagu

title: Accident Zone
synopsis:
Go Jaehyeok was once a promising star in the world of kendo, but his life took a wrong turn. Han Yeongwon, a senior police officer at the Daehan precinct, was the one who tried to keep Jaehyeok from straying. Completely different in personality, habits, and even the smallest details, the two men share only one thing in common: a child.

Because of that child, they come face to face again. Lacking any knowledge of childcare, Jaehyeok begins living with Yeongwon and learns things one step at a time. Along the way, he also starts to feel the effects of his own traits as a dominant alpha.

With their individual wounds, their children, and the confusing emotions they feel toward one another, the two men become entangled, slowly but surely forming a family of their own.

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Hatsujou Romantics
synopsis:
1. Saigo no Hi ni. (On the Last Day)
2. Sakaime (Boundary)
3. Zangyou! (Overtime!)
4. Around 30 Romantics (Thirty-Something Romantics)
5. Hanbunko. (Halfsies)
6. Ari no Mama no Kimi de Ite (Be Who You Are)

title: My Desire Is Not a Sin
title_english: My Desire Is Not a Sin
synopsis:
On their ninth anniversary, Ian receives what seems like a perfect gift, a building in the most coveted part of the city for the expansion of her art gallery. With the steamy night that followed afterward, it was set to become the most romantic anniversary ever... until her husband sneaks out in the middle of the night to cheat on her.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Tsuihou sareta Cheat Fuyo Majutsushi wa Kimama na Second Life wo Ouka suru. Ore wa Buki dake ja Naku, Arayuru Mono ni "Kyouka Point" wo Fuyo Dekiru shi, Ore no Ishi de Itsudemo Kouka wo Kaijo Dekiru kedo, Nokotta Hitotachi Daijoubu?
title_japanese: 追放されたチート付与魔術師は気ままなセカンドライフを謳歌する。 俺は武器だけじゃなく、あらゆるものに『強化ポイント』を付与できるし、俺の意思でいつでも効果を解除できるけど、残った人たち大丈夫?解除できるけど、残った人たち大丈夫？

title: In the Shadow of the Serpent
title_english: In the Shadow of the Serpent
synopsis:
In a world where malevolent spirits roam freely, Jeong Wol has spent his entire life pretending not to see them. Having witnessed countless evil entities since childhood, he believes that ignoring the supernatural is the only way to survive.

That fragile resolve shatters when he becomes entangled in a mission led by the Disaster Squad and loses his life in the process.

Or so he believes.

Jeong Wol awakens to find himself alive once more, bound by a mysterious pact with Sa Hyeon, a black serpent whose presence radiates both danger and allure. Granted immortality in exchange for an unknown price, he is forced to confront the very world he tried so desperately to deny.

Is this second life a blessing that spared him from death, or a curse that will drag him deeper into the serpent's shadow?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: My Beloved Lucien
synopsis:
Lucien, the notorious eldest son of House Hevonshire, is suddenly forced into a political marriage after years of scandalous behavior disgrace his family. On the eve of the wedding, he indulges in one last night of excess and accepts a drink from a mysterious stranger. Soon after, Lucien loses control of his body and is claimed by a man whose intentions seem anything but coincidental. When morning comes, Lucien is left with fragmented memories, a lingering presence, and the unsettling realization that someone has been waiting for him far longer than he ever knew.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Light I Give You
synopsis:
Once a promising athlete, Yoonbin is ready to give up after repeated injuries shatter his dreams. At his lowest point, a mysterious man with a tiger tattoo gives him the strength to stand again. Years later, after retiring as a gold medalist and becoming a taekwondo instructor, Yoonbin unexpectedly reunites with Kwon Young, an underworld boss and the man who saved his life. Haunted by his past, Young pushes Yoonbin away, convinced he brings only harm. But Yoonbin refuses to let go, because now it is his turn to become Young's light.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Saikyou★Majo-sama no Kinyoku Seikatsu!
title_japanese: 最恐★魔女さまの禁欲生活!

title: Akuyaku Reijou no Chichioya ni Tensei shita node, Tsuma to Musume wo Dekiai shimasu
title_japanese: 悪役令嬢の父親に転生したので、妻と娘を溺愛します
synopsis:
I woke up to find myself as Duke Kalis Fall—with a wife and a daughter! Kalis seems to have been a man indifferent to his own family, and tension reigns within the Fall household. Upon arriving in this world, the first thing I remembered was a certain otome game... but my daughter, Laurier, is the villain in that game! I'll make sure my beloved wife and daughter are truly happy, and I won't allow her to become a villain! Thus begins the story of a father determined to prevent a tragic ending!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Doko yori mo Tooi Basho ni Iru Kimi e
title_japanese: どこよりも遠い場所にいる君へ
synopsis:
Kazuki Tsukigase is a high school boy who carries a certain secret. In search of a place where no one knows him, he enrolls at Sakijima High School on a remote island.

On Sakijima, there is a place known as the "Cove of Spiriting Away." One early summer day, Kazuki finds a girl lying unconscious in the cove. The girl—Nanao, 16 years old—later regains consciousness in the hospital, but her identity remains unknown. What is the meaning behind the word "1974" that she murmured?

A touching boy-meets-girl story.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Nishi Tokyo Metal Brothers
title_japanese: ニシトーキョーメタルブラザーズ
synopsis:
Haruo is a high schooler from Biei, Hokkaido. When he was younger, expressing his emotions wasn't easy, but one day metal set him free. Since then, he's been honing his skills day in and day out, but now it's for him to decide on his next stage in life…?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: VTuber Kusamura Shigemi: Tooku ni Itteshimatta Ki ga Shita Oshi ga Zenzen Tooku ni Itte Kurenai Hanashi
title_english: VTuber Shigemi Kusamura: I'm my Oshi's Favorite
title_japanese: VTuber草村しげみ～遠くに行ってしまった気がした推しが全然遠くに行ってくれない話～
synopsis:
Shigemi Kusamura is a popular VTuber with 1.3 million subscribers. Her oldest fan, Nanashino, is happy for her success, but can't help but feel a little lonely thinking she has grown distant. However, Shigemi's affection for Nanashino never faded away. In fact, she still replies to every one of his comments, her feelings more intense than ever. What happens when your favorite VTuber turns around and makes you HER favorite?! A virtual rom-com about two people who idolize each other!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Ishi no Sekai no Zecchou Kenshi
synopsis:
In a region far from the frontlines of the battle between humanity and the Demon King, an incident occurred where an entire town was petrified. The Adventurers' Guild decided to dispatch two highly skilled individuals to investigate the cause: a saint elder sister and a dual-sword wielding younger sister. The younger sister, Rui, possesses a skill where her sensitivity increases the more damage she receives. One day, after sustaining a fatal wound, her overly sharpened sensitivity goes berserk, and despite being on the verge of death, she is assaulted by unimaginable pleasure...

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Vampire Miyui
title_japanese: 吸血姫〈ヴァンパイア〉 美夕維
synopsis:
Miyu and Yui—the destinies of these two vampire princesses finally intertwine!

Miyu, a vampire princess living an eternal life as a 14-year-old, observes the Shinma of the world with her servant Larva, finding the "stray Shinma" who have escaped into the human world and returning them to the darkness. Another girl, Yui Mizuki, awakened as a vampire princess and lives on.

Yui, who initially struggled with her new life, now lives her days as a human. The new story of these two vampire princesses, their encounter and intertwined destinies, now begins to unfold—!!

(Source: SB Creative, translated)

title: Kurenai no Majutsushi ni Subete wo Sosogimasu. Suki. @comic: Seijo no Chikara wo Karuku Mitsumorare Konyakuhaki saremashita. Koukai shitemo Shirimasen
title_japanese: 紅の魔術師に全てを注ぎます。好き。＠COMIC ～聖女の力を軽く見積もられ婚約破棄されました。後悔しても知りません～

title: I Tamed the Monster Prince
synopsis:
As the illegitimate child of House Flores, Irenea has been looked down on and mistreated all her life. When she learns that she is to marry the cursed "monster prince" Cesar, she quietly accepts her fate. However, Irenea is shocked to see that he is treated far worse than even a beast. Empathizing with Cesar and realizing that only she can help him, Irenea vows to give him a proper life—as a human. Yet with the whole world against them, can they ever find freedom and happiness?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Return of the Namgung Clan's Granddaughter
title_english: Return of the Namgung Clan's Granddaughter
synopsis:
Because she was kidnapped and raised by the Blood Demon, Seolhwa destroyed the Namgung Clan, unaware that she was its lost child. When she learned the truth only after being killed by the master who used her, she awakens eight years in the past and returns home to try and change fate. But a dark spell and forbidden seals keep her from speaking the truth. Can Seolhwa change the future of her clan and prepare Namgung for what's to come? Or will her family's blood spill once again?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Mugen no Majutsushi: Maryoku Nashi de Heimin no Ko to Hakugai sareta Ore. Jitsu wa Mugen no Maryokumochi.
title_japanese: 無限の魔術師 魔力無しで平民の子と迫害された俺。実は無限の魔力持ち。

title: I Don't Want to Be Loved
title_english: I Don't Want to Be Loved
synopsis:
After losing her child and catching her husband in a compromising position with her half-sister Leticia, Leannan takes her own life rather than continue living miserably. But instead of dying, she wakes up the day before Leticia comes to live with her family. Determined to prevent a repeat of her past, she comes up with a plan to get rid of all the obstacles... starting with her cunning sister and her cold husband. Will Leannan succeed and live happily, or will she drown in misery once more?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: What a Useful Sham Marriage
synopsis:
When a prophetic dream shows her future stepfather killing her family, Emeline Wedgewood sets out to stop her mother's marriage to the duke at all costs. And what better way than to start a scandal with the duke's son, Eric Orleans? Suspicious of his father's intentions, Eric proposes that he and Emeline marry so their parents can't. But will the scandal of the century be enough to foil the duke's plans? Or will their sham marriage pit these unlikely allies into greater danger than ever before?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Wolf of the Full Moon
title_english: The Wolf of the Full Moon
synopsis:
As the daughter of the premier of Joseon, Han Wolyeong had a happy life. That is, until her father's political enemies killed her clan and took her prisoner—enter Doheon, a mysterious god who saves her and confesses his love. Now, Wolyeong and Doheon are set to spend 30 nights of passion with each other to fulfill their destiny and get a wish from the heavens. But with Wolyeong's enemies still searching for her, is she truly safe? Or will her happiness be destroyed once more?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Three Men and the Torn Princess
title_english: Three Men and the Torn Princess
synopsis:
30-year-old virgin Hong Sera is invited to join the beta test of a mysterious game, "Imaginary Sex Kingdom." Once she presses "Play," she awakens as Princess Chloe, surrounded by three irresistible suitors—Lucas, Aiden, and Maverick. With beauty and grace, she captures each of their hearts, but the more she indulges in their affection, the harder it becomes to choose just one. Little does she know that in this kingdom of desire and temptation, even her wildest fantasies can come true...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Bunny, Leave the Door Open Tonight
title_english: Bunny, Leave the Door Open Tonight
title_japanese: 토끼야, 오늘 밤엔 문을 열어 둬
synopsis:
Chesterville's resident romance novelist, Sweetpea Rabbithole, knows how to write desire—but she's never tasted it. Determined to change that, she sets out to find someone who can show her what she's been missing. But when her childhood friend Edward learns of her plan, he's determined to be her first and only lesson. With a mask, a mysterious identity, and a master plan to show her he can be more than the little boy she grew up with, will these friends finally realize what was there all along?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Holy Knight's Bedtime Story
synopsis:
In this empire, the position of saint sees a high turnover... Because the saints just won't stop sleeping with the knights! So when the new saint Alisa finds out her personal guard is the very man who had her predecessors excommunicated, she's determined to keep her distance. But one day, the two find themselves trapped in a mysterious room forcing them to act out a rather risqué scenario in order to get out. How will the righteous holy knight deal with this decidedly sinful situation?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Aida Kawa Koubou no Futari
title_japanese: アイダ革工房のふたり

title: My Very Own X
synopsis:
If there's one thing Do Haejoo loves more than her job, it's handsome men. But after a breakup and a career blunder that lands her a week off, her luck turns around when she finds a mysterious flyer for a cleaning service exclusively for women. The cleaner who shows up is not only competent—he's drop-dead gorgeous and awakens her dull world with his special services. Is this the beginning of Haejoo's very own love story or a messy temptation that's too hot to handle?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Even the Slightest Touch
synopsis:
Han Yoo has a little problem—namely Dami Lee, the daughter of his mentor. Now that she's an adult, Dami has made it her mission to win Han over, even begging him to let her be a teaching assistant at the academy where he works! To make matters worse, his body starts acting strangely whenever she's around...

(Source: Manta)

title: Days of Our Love
synopsis:
Nahee is sent to bring food to Hyunjin, the chaebol heir just back from England. She dreads seeing the boy she used to roughhouse with, yet feels sorry for how lonely his glittering penthouse seems—until he corners her and blurts, "How can I see you as just a friend when you're so damn pretty?"

(Source: Manta)

title: Accidental Baby
synopsis:
Doh Ihyeon is the ultimate corporate workaholic, but he hides two secrets: he's a somewhat defective omega and he suffers from prosopagnosia—the inability to recognize faces. After a blurry, drunken one-night stand leads to an unexpected pregnancy, Ihyeon decides to keep the baby and brave single parenthood in secret. But his carefully constructed walls start to crumble when his superior, Seo Jeong-un, begins a relentless pursuit. Jeong-un is charming, persistent, and strangely familiar, but to a man who can't recognize a face, his flirtations are just another workplace distraction. Can Jeong-un break through Ihyeon's "iron wall," or will Ihyeon's condition keep the father of his child a mystery forever?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: When Life Gives You Tomatoes
synopsis:
By day, Jin Horang works as a janitor. By night, he picks up extra shifts at a club, scraping by while doing his best to stay cheerful. So when he suddenly receives a marriage proposal from the parent of his high school crush, Cha Ahjo, he can hardly believe it.

Back then, Ahjo was a beautiful omega who seemed to shine like a flower. Horang is told that Ahjo's health declined after a single reckless night the two once shared, and that this is why the family is pushing for the marriage.

Expecting a fragile and delicate figure from his memories, Horang goes to meet him again.

Instead, he finds a towering, wildly different man who barely resembles the gentle Ahjo he once knew.

Caught between nostalgia, shock, and an unexpected new dynamic, Horang is pulled into a whirlwind engagement that is nothing like what he imagined, turning his quiet life into a chaotic and heartfelt romantic comedy.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Nijigen Otaku-kun wa Gal Oppai de Kan Ochi Shasei
title_japanese: 二次元オタクくんはギャルおっぱいで完オチ射精

title: Myakuraku Naku Shiboritoraretai!
title_japanese: 脈絡なく搾りとられたい!

title: Rebirth of the Divine Demon
synopsis:
Feared as the Divine Demon, Jeong Cheon lived and died on the battlefield, knowing nothing but violence. When death finally claims him, it should have been the end. Instead, he awakens thirty years later in the body of Hwa Mujin, the powerless heir of a ruined clan. His overwhelming strength is gone, replaced by a frail body and enemies closing in from every side. To protect the siblings now in his care and reclaim a clan on the brink of collapse, the fallen legend must begin again and build a future from nothing.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Happy Twogether
synopsis:
Four years ago, Dream Boy was an idol group that got embroiled in a scandal, and unfortunately the members went down the path of fallen idols. In the present... Jaeyoung, the member 'Happy' of Dream Boy, struggles with financial hardship and is working as a delivery rider. On receiving news that the leader of his now-defunct group, Sookyum, is passed out from over-drinking, he rushes to him.

There he meets Seungmin, who, unlike Jaeyoung, is the hottest rapper/producer at present and who shares the same stage name 'Happy'. Seungmin ends up saving Jaeyoung, who had passed out from an epileptic episode due to photosensitivity, and extends an offer for them to work together...

"You know who I am, don't you? Let us work. Twogether."

(Source: Ridi, translated)

title: The Secretive XX
synopsis:
"You smell."

One day, Taegyeol, a 20-year-old returning student, is abruptly told by a classmate he has never met before that he "smells." Caught off guard by something he has never heard in his life, he tries to brush it off as a minor incident.

Later, a careless remark from a teacher comparing him to another returning student from a different class leaves Taegyeol irritated. Acting on impulse, he heads to that classroom, only to run into the same person again. It is Muwon, the guy who told him he smelled.

When Taegyeol confronts him about what he said earlier, Muwon dodges the question with vague, half-hearted excuses. Annoyed by his attitude, yet strangely unable to look away from him, Taegyeol ends up making the first move and asks to be friends.

"Want to hang out later?"

"I can't..."

Despite clearly saying no, Muwon is waiting for Taegyeol in front of the school gate after classes. So what is this guy really thinking?

(Source: Ridi, translated)

title: Soft Night
synopsis:
In a quiet rural village, there is a place where laughter never fades, from children to white-haired elders alike. It is a small piano academy run by the village's young headman. For reasons no one quite understands, a hollow-eyed man whom the headman calls his spouse teaches all the students alone, a one-man labor operation.

But beneath this peaceful everyday scene lies a chilling twist. Once the academy closes and night falls deep, the headman and the academy director begin taking out various murder weapons, one by one, from a secret storage room hidden inside the school.

A gang boss who abandoned his organization and went on the run, and the undercover police officer assigned to keep watch over him. That is their true identity, one the villagers know nothing about.

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

title: Mahou Shoujo Inaba
synopsis:
"Mahou Shoujo"

The light on the screen was so strong, gentle, and dazzling. Kido Ui, a girl saved by the sparkle, aspires to become a light that can shine on someone else.

"Cloaked in the cape of justice, I make my grand entrance! Magical Girl Inaba!!"

(Source: Bushiroad Works)

title: Reveries of the Moonlight
synopsis:
Stripped of everything he cherished to a pack of vampires, Saegun meets the legendary Jinma Slayer Sylvester and enters the path of the vampire hunter... Welcome to the lunatic moon.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Shinkyuu Iin
synopsis:
"Please worship me, Yomi Nagitsu!" The student council president candidate's shocking speech leads to his inevitable defeat. Though his fellow class representative Mayuri tries to cover for him, it seems he may be hiding a divine secret...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Shinrei Shashin Mitsubai Manual
title_japanese: 心霊写真密売マニュアル
synopsis:
Every photo that Umino takes turns into a ghost photo. When an escaped kangaroo accidentally reveals this to Umino's classmate Yamakawa, he proposes to auction off the ghost photos for cash—cash that Umino desperately wants in order to escape his abusive home life. Yet the world of ghost photography is no mere game, as these two teenagers find out...

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Suterare Kareshi Hiroimashita.
title_japanese: 捨てられ彼氏ひろいました。
synopsis:
On Christmas Eve night, college student Masuda meets Kurihara, a guy bawling his eyes out at the convenience store where Masuda worked part-time. Even though it was their first time meeting, Kurihara keeps whining about being dumped right before Christmas, a real hassle. But when Masuda learns Kurihara had been looking forward to the date, he couldn't just leave him hanging...

"Should I go in place of your girlfriend...?" 

Before Masuda knew it, he's offered to be a stand-in, and they ended up going on the date!? The next day, at the meeting spot, stands an intelligent-looking, sparkling Kurihara, a complete stranger compared to the crybaby from yesterday...!?

(Source: East Press, translated)

title: Kiss wa Shita kedo Tomodachi da yo na!?
title_english: We Kissed, but We're Still Just Friends, Right!?
title_japanese: キスはしたけど友達だよな!?
synopsis:
Hinata and Hayato, two college students with a long history, are stuck living together in a cramped apartment. During a drinking game of King's Orders, at a party where they'd hoped to lose their virginity, the two are given a shocking command... a passionate kiss between guys!! 

"It's all slippery inside his mouth...!"

As Hinata suddenly slips in his tongue, Hayato desperately tries to catch his breath, but Hinata's gaze is deadly serious...!?  Annoyed at being thrown off by Hinata, Hayato challenges him to a revenge match. But then, Hinata kisses him even more intensely than before...!

From that night on, the two are left grappling with unfamiliar emotions. A side of each other they never knew, despite being together all this time. Is our relationship really so fragile that a single kiss could break it...!?

A reckless romantic comedy that starts with a steamy kiss!!

(Source: GOT, translated)

title: Eiyuu Densetsu: Hajimari no Kiseki - The Miserable Sinners
title_english: Legends of Heroes: The Miserable Sinners
title_japanese: 英雄伝説 創〈はじまり〉の軌跡 THE MISERABLE SINNERS

title: Collage
synopsis:
Baek Seonghyeon, a poor working student, returns to university with a completely ruined timetable after getting the course registration date wrong. Forced to attend even a literature class he has no interest in, he looks up the course withdrawal period and happens to notice a note taking job posting on campus. Twice a week, a monthly pay of 1.5 million won. Without a second thought, Baek Seonghyeon sends in his application.

Never once imagining that there, he would meet a poet who would completely upend his life.

(Source: Ridi, translated)

title: Punpun: Lesser Ninkyouden
title_japanese: ぷんぷん -レッサー任侠伝-
synopsis: After getting drunk at the party celebrating his release from a 7-year stint in prison, yakuza underboss Masahide Kenzake wakes up in the body of a red panda.

title_japanese: あそこがチョロいあの娘の話
synopsis:

6. Namaiki Kusogaki Wakarasechao (Let's Put This Cheeky, Stupid Brat in Her Place!)
7. Seiheki Kaitaku!? Muriyari ga Osuki (Kink Trailblazer!? I Love It Forced)

9. Kaoru Ohisama Dare no Mono? (Who Does This Fragrant Sun Belong To)
10. Ano Ko no Kuchibiru Dare no Mono?

title: Akujo (to Gokai sareru Watashi) ga Haraguro Outaishi-sama no Aisareki ni Narisou desu!?
title_english: The Scheming Crown Prince's Wicked Consort
title_japanese: 悪女（と誤解される私）が腹黒王太子様の愛され妃になりそうです!?
synopsis:
With sharp eyes, forbidding features, and a commanding voice, Angelica isn't your typical beauty. The only daughter of a royal army general, she was raised as a soldier and earned the nickname "Ice Witch" due to her aloof personality. Thanks to all that, she's already lost one engagement, and has resigned herself to never marrying. But that does nothing to lessen the expectation that she will provide an heir...so what's a lady of battle to do but secretly hunt for a man to help her conceive? It isn't long before a man comes to her, and he happens to be Prince Elvan, the crown prince and the very person to whom Angelica has sworn allegiance!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Alien Headbutt
title_japanese: エイリアンヘッドバット
synopsis:
As a young man, Shirokiba left his small island seeking glory as a pro wrestler in Tokyo. After much sacrifice, he returns to his hometown as a champion, but he finds that it's overrun by mysterious aliens! Strike, throw, hold, cheat! He'll need to use everything he's learned from pro wrestling to take down these monsters! Blood, sweat, and aliens getting their butts kicked in this high-octane pro wrestling action series!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Alien Headbutt
title_japanese: エイリアンヘッドバット
synopsis:
As a young man, Shirokiba left his small island seeking glory as a pro wrestler in Tokyo. title: Ga
synopsis:
On their way to school, Nori, a high school girl, notices a moth stuck to her friend Hiro's head. Oblivious to her own predicament, Hiro goes on and on about the importance of proper grooming...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Vita Sexualis
synopsis: A manga adaptation of Ougai Mori's 1909 semi-autobiographical erotic novel.

title: Konyakusha ni Kirawaretiru You nanode Hanaretemitara, Nazeka Kougi saremashita
title_japanese: 婚約者に嫌われているようなので離れてみたら、なぜか抗議されました
synopsis:
Clarissa, the daughter of the Marquis of Merriam, is told by her fiancé Ryan that she is ugly and should hide her face with bangs. She is scorned in high society and referred to as the "Cinderella." Clarissa feels she has no place in the Marquis household where her stepmother lives, and she lacks self-confidence. But one day, while attending a party with Ryan, she meets a young man. A few days later, for some reason, she is summoned to the royal castle by the first prince, Lucas...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Please Assist with This S-Class Mission
title_english: Please Assist with This S-Class Mission
synopsis:
After a decade stuck as an E-Class hunter, Hara is suddenly hit with an S-Class Awakening Quest: date the nation's beloved news anchor, Seheon. There's just one problem—he's tied to an embarrassing event from her past she'd rather forget. Still, the promise of S-Class power is too tempting to ignore, so Hara proposes a contractual relationship to Seheon. What starts as a desperate deal for "Official S-Class Mission Assistance" quickly turns into a strange, unpredictable romance.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Yakyuuban Koushien
synopsis:
The naturally gifted Noboru Obutai took the middle school baseball world by storm, but a tragic accident robbed him of his passion. Just as the flames of his youth were all but extinguished, he encountered tabletop baseball!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Jibun wo SSS-kyuu dato Omoikondeiru C-kyuu Majutsu Gakusei
title_english: C-Level Magic Student Who Thinks He Is SSS Class
title_japanese: 自分をSSS級だと思い込んでいるC級魔術学生
synopsis:
The strongest man in school usually hides his true strength and acts like an ordinary student... There was a man who staked his life on such a delusion: Shion Ichinose, an ordinary student attending Crawford Magic Academy. Shion continued to behave like an "SSS-Rank" both inside and outside the school, but his eccentric behavior eventually involved those around him...? Only his delusions and acting are SSS-Rank!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Shiawase ni Naritai Masamune-kun
title_japanese: 幸せになりたいマサムネ君

title_japanese: ドラゴンの胃でおやすみ

2. Tropical na Zanshi (Tropical Remnants)

4. Kiss-nomication (Kiss Drinkommunication)
5. Kikyou no Kimochi (Chinese Bellflower's Feelings)
6. Otona no Kaidan (Stairway to Adulthood)
7. Muteki na Okota (Invincible Kotatsu)

synopsis: A manga based on SCP-040-JP.

title: Pechi Pan Pochin
synopsis:
Unaware of her apartment's tragic history, Kana finds herself tormented by mysterious sounds that exploit the fractures in her crumbling marriage and her struggles with motherhood...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title_japanese: EG☆RIDER イージーライダー

title: G-buri-chan
synopsis:
In a world where appearances can often be deceiving, there lives a very special cockroach. With her adorable appearance, this little cockroach stands out from the crowd. Unlike her peers, she loves being around humans, even though they don't always treat her in the best way.

(Source: MU)

title: No Affection Recipe
synopsis:
Yeonwoo starts working part-time at his uncle's bakery.

Despite his terrible manual dexterity, which leads to him being constantly scolded by the chef, Chakyeom, the masochistic Yeonwoo only finds it exciting.

One day, his uncle asks the two longest-serving employees at the shop to create a signature menu item, saying they can't lose to the competition...

(Source: Ridi, translated)

title: Danko Shikihen: Tora wo Danjite Iro Henzu
title_japanese: 談虎色変-虎を談じて色変ず-
synopsis:
Naruo Yurie, a student of calligraphy who can see "black figures" that are not human, has been involved in mysterious incidents since the day he met the landlord of the house where he lives in Tokyo... This is a story of love and longing between a divine beast and a human.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Tonari no Heya no Onna Kishi wa, Isekaijin de Nomitomodachi
title_japanese: 隣の部屋の女騎士は、異世界人で飲み友達

title: Imawa no Kiwa no Femme Fatale
title_japanese: 今際の際のファムファタール

title: Beyond the Sea
synopsis:
In the secluded town of Riverwort, Jade and Oje grow up relying on each other as family. But when Jade is suddenly consumed by an uncontrollable rut, he loses control and hurts the person he loves most. Consumed by guilt, Jade chooses to disappear, leaving Oje behind with nothing but unanswered feelings, until news arrives that the ship Jade boarded has sunk, forcing the truth of their bond to surface in the most devastating way.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Nisemono Ouhi, Ai wo Shiru
synopsis:
The turmoil that engulfed many nations and dragged on for more than a decade finally came to an end, with the Kingdom of Weikling emerging as the dominant power. Its young king, Lionel, demanded that each country offer up hostages.

In the Kingdom of Hammond, the only ones who met the conditions to be sent as hostages were the crown prince, Jonas—who was on the verge of marriage—and the queen herself. Unwilling to sacrifice his family, the king of Hammond abdicated in Jonas's favor, hastily arranged a marriage for him, and devised a plan to present a fake queen as the hostage.

The woman chosen to be a wife for that purpose alone was Laura, the daughter of an impoverished baron. The person Jonas truly loved was Silvia, his original fiancée, and even after the marriage, he never spared Laura a glance.

Though Laura had been threatened with her family's safety and forced to abandon her dream of becoming a civil official to accept the royal command, she was sent off to Weikling as queen o

title: Watashi no Koto Suki ja Nakatta no ka yo!?
title_japanese: 私のこと好きじゃなかったのかよ!?
synopsis:
Okabe vowed to focus on his studies in high school, but for whatever reason, the girls around him keep sending him mixed signals…

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Megami to Kekkon shite Isekai Shinkon Seikatsu
title_japanese: 女神と結婚して異世界新婚生活
synopsis:
Manabu Katou, an overworked salaryman, dies and meets a goddess who offers him reincarnation in another world. He falls in love with her and asks her to marry him. She agrees, and they begin their newlywed life together in a fantasy world.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Aishite Hoshii no wa Ore ja Nai noni! BL Game no Akuyaku Reisoku ni Tensei shita noni Kirawarenakute Komattemasu
title_japanese: 愛してほしいのは俺じゃないのに! 〜BLゲームの悪役令息に転生したのに嫌われなくて困ってます〜
synopsis:
One day, Arthur realizes that he's been reincarnated as the villain in a BL game. On top of that, he remembers that based on the plot of the game, he only has endings like the "Imprisonment Ending" and "Tentacle Ending" waiting for him! With no other option to save his chastity and life, his only way out is getting his fiancee to get with the protagonist! Dragging along his trusty servant Edgar, he tries to craft up schemes to get the two of them together. But, rather than being hated as the villain, he starts raising BL flags of his own?!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Kono Koi wa Kamisama datte Shiranai
title_japanese: この恋は神様だって知らない
synopsis:
On Christmas Eve, Mao is kicked out by his live-in girlfriend. Which happens to also be his birthday. This leaves Mao feeling abandoned by the world. While wandering aimlessly through the city, he collides with a man: Mikoto, his first love. Even though Mao is rejoicing over their miraculous reunion after twelve years, Mikoto doesn't even remember him... But when Mao tells him that he has nowhere to go, Mikoto invites Mao to his home. Mao follows him back home, except Mikoto is suddenly doing lewd things to him...?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: AV Joyuu-chan
synopsis: An early version of former AV actress Nayuka Mine's memoir manga.

title: The Cleaner
synopsis:
Jin Isu's seemingly ordinary life comes to a violent end when he and his father are suddenly targeted by a powerful conglomerate. He survives. But his father does not. In a world where crime and authority are one and the same, Isu enters the underworld to hunt the truth. His fight is no longer just for revenge... It's to expose a corrupt empire, no matter the cost.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Kagomi wa Chou Fancy
title_japanese: かごみは超ファンシー
synopsis:
Let's take a peek into a day in the life of Kagomi, who can’t help but worry over the tiniest things, and Tamayo, who gently watches over her!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

synopsis:
1. Ningyo no Meunière (Mermaid Meunière)
2. Robot no Iru Ie (The House With the Robot)
3. Hanako-chan
4. Komatta na Ojisan (Old Mr. Oh Dear)
5. Ushiro Sugata (The View From Behind)
6. Uchuu Manga Circle (Space Manga Buddies)
7. Uwasa Tori (The Gossip Bird)
8. Delivery Hell

title: Nugu Complex
synopsis:
After leaving behind his past as a failed idol from Meteor Boys, Seok-wu returns to university hoping for a fresh start. Unfortunately, his timing could not be worse...because rising star Yeowun, a rookie actor with a glittering career, also reenrolls. Seok-wu is used to the contrast in how people treat them, but when Yeowun starts provoking him in ways that feel far too deliberate, irritation turns into wounded pride. Just how far does Yeowun plan to trample on Seok-wu's dignity—and why does it feel so personal?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Milky Star
synopsis:
It all starts beneath a treadmill with a suspicious stain that definitely does not belong there.

Yonggeun Fitness is one of the most popular personal training gyms in Seongwang-gu District, and its night class in particular is so sought after that male members compete fiercely to get in. When the building's owner, Seon Bin, discovers a strange residue left behind after one of these late night sessions, he begins to investigate what really goes on after hours in Seongwang-gu.

What he uncovers is far from ordinary training. The so called night class turns out to be a secret hotspot where workouts are merely a cover for something far more indecent.

Furious that such shameless behavior is happening under his roof, Seon Bin vows to put an end to it no matter what it takes.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: You Were My Summer
synopsis:
After twelve years devoted to baseball and a failed confession to his first love, Kim Minseong drifts through life with nothing left to chase. Hoping for a fresh start, he sets out on a cross-country bike trip, only to be stopped by monsoon rain and an accident. Stranded, he reunites with Park Hyeonmin, his former junior from the high school baseball team, and ends up staying at his place until the weather clears. Full of awkward proximity, lingering heat, and emotions that won't stay buried. Even when summer ends, some feelings refuse to let go.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Close Up! Love's Next Chapter
synopsis:
Chaedam never planned to get cozy with the sexy CEO, but after discovering Yoowon's secrets, Chaedam has no choice but to fake amnesia to keep himself safe. Suspicious, Yoowon ups the ante and tells Chaedam that they were lovers before his memory loss. Chaedam knows it's only a ploy to keep him under Yoowon's watchful eye, but he can't reveal the truth without exposing himself to danger. So begins a cat-and-mouse game of deception and lust that sends them tumbling into bed together.

(Source: Tapas Media)

synopsis:
While driving along the backroads in search of some interesting material to film for his social media feed, a man comes across a roadside diner and decides to pop in. With the nearest town so far away, it's fortunate that they also serve as a hotel and have a room for him to stay the night. The locals have stories to tell about what goes on at the hotel, but the man has no idea just how wild his night is about to become.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Kimi ga Iu ni wa Inu no Koi
synopsis:
A beautiful student council president and an ordinary delinquent. A chilling Boy Meets Boy!

"Listening to what someone tells me, getting praised for it... I just want to live doing only that." Is that nothing more than a sinful fairytale dream?

Yet that is exactly the simple wish of Akira Tamanoi, an ordinary high school boy. Day after day with no dreams, no motivation... Then one day, as a penalty for being late, Akira is assigned to help the student council, where he meets the wise and beautiful student council president, Makoto Miyauchi. And then—what do you know? Miyauchi keeps asking Akira for favors at every opportunity.

"Please... thank you!" "You can't do it? ...You did well."

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Moto Tansakusha no Ojiichan: Mago ni Segamarete Dungeon Haishin wo Hajimetan ja ga, Nazeka Bazuriotta wai
title_japanese: 元探索者のおじいちゃん～孫にせがまれてダンジョン配信を始めたんじゃが、なぜかバズりおったわい～
synopsis:
Many years have passed since "dungeons" began to exist in the world. "Grandpa, stream a dungeon run for us! You used to be an explorer, right?" Urged by his grandchild, former dungeon explorer Genji Kudō decides to dive into a dungeon for the first time in 30 years. But Genji's dungeon strategies, shaped by the old ways rather than modern conventions, start to pile up unexpected results—until his adventures go viral and cause a sensation across the nation...!?

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

title: "Zettai Ouja" to Yobareta Saikyou Dorei no Boukentan: Tokihanatareta Dorei wa, Jiyuu ni Sekai wo Ouka suru
title_japanese: 「絶対王者」と呼ばれた最強奴隷の冒険譚 解き放たれた奴隷は、自由に世界を謳歌する
synopsis:
Gil reigned as the strongest gladiator slave in the arena. Despite his dominance, he lived with a constant, unquenchable thirst for something more. One day, he finally seized a chance to escape. Having fled the city and gained his hard-won freedom, he heads for the neighboring kingdom of Bastel, where slavery does not exist. There, he begins a new life as an adventurer. However, for the world's strongest gladiator, the business of adventuring seems to be far too easy...?

(Source: Coamix, translated)

title: For the Goddesses: For Daphne
synopsis:
As a devoted servant of Artemis, the nymph Daphne has taken a vow of maidenhood and pledged to never give her heart to a man. However, she finds her loyalty to her goddess shaken when she meets Apollo and is instantly mesmerized, feeling things she had sworn never to feel. As Daphne falls into temptation, she finds herself helpless against the chaotic whims of the gods. Will her transgression lead to true love? Or will the consequences of breaking her vow be more severe than she ever imagined?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Born to Be Beautifully Famous
synopsis:
When a perpetually overlooked supporting actor dies wishing to be jaw-droppingly handsome, he's reborn as Ma Gongja, a ridiculously beautiful baby who was left outside an orphanage. After a famous actress adopts him, Gongja suddenly has fame, fortune, and everyone falling for his cuteness, but he's just getting started! Armed with acting skills, this charming child is determined to become the most dazzling star there is, but will his stunning looks cause more trouble than he bargained for?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: A Butterfly Through the Mist
synopsis:
Ilex Davenport had it all—a noble title, top grades at the academy, and a reputation as its biggest playboy. He was living proof the world wasn't fair. Tilia Ambrose hated him for it. While he coasted through life, she was fighting to escape her toxic family. So how did she end up in his bed?

(Source: Manta)

title: Cuck-thology
synopsis:
The woman I love, the one I've cherished above all others, is being taken by another man right before my eyes! My heart should be breaking, and my blood should be boiling with righteous fury at the sight of her in someone else's arms. But as I watch from the shadows, a chilling realization begins to sink in, freezing the air in my lungs. Something is horribly, inexplicably wrong with this picture. Why does it look like she's enjoying this? In fact, she seems more than just willing... She looks more captivated and thrilled than she ever was with me!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Slave Diaries
synopsis:
Outwardly, they live an ordinary daily life and relationships, but within them lie unspoken desires and forbidden emotions. A momentary skinship, which began by chance, turns into an uncontrollable spark, and the attraction towards each other gradually spreads into deeper pleasure. A forbidden relationship brought on by one wrong choice; now they are sinking into a swamp of pleasure from which there is no return.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: You Hold the Key
title_japanese: 옆집 아저씨, 제 수갑 좀 풀어주세요
synopsis:
College student Jisu decides to spice up a quiet night alone with a bold new idea, only for everything to go wrong at the worst possible moment. Before she can even begin to enjoy herself, the key to her shiny new handcuffs slips away and disappears beneath the closet. Trapped, flustered, and out of options, Jisu realizes there is only one person who can help her: the handsome man living next door. Swallowing her embarrassment, she heads over in desperation, setting the stage for an unexpectedly intimate encounter that neither of them saw coming.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: This Girl Is a Little Wild
synopsis:
As he was being defeated, the Demon King used the last of his strength to curse Sir Roel, the legendary captain of the Holy Knights, into the body of a weak girl. Roel (who was a woman to begin with!) was tired of her former life and, unable to return to her original body, decides to live a luxurious life as Sila Epheria, the noble daughter whose soul got swapped with hers. Things don't go according to plan when her new family puts her in danger, forcing her to find a way to prove her true identity...

Will Roel/Sila be able to live a quiet life as she wishes? Or is there something more to the new life she's received?

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Oshikatsu Inochi no Onmyouji

A deadly curse is slowly killing Teo, and none of the healers or magic users he's ever met have been able to help him—until one day, during his travels, he finds the natural spirit Arvahany.

Arvahany hates humans and has secrets of his own, not the least of which is that he has lost a considerable part of his powers. Teo has something he wants, and so he binds him with a contract to save himself, promising Teo to break his curse at the end of it, as a reward...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Isekai Tabi wa Niwatorisu to Tomo ni

synopsis:
Seven-year-old Otoka remembered his past life memories as a Japanese Salaryman after helping two chicks of a monster resembling a chicken called Niwatorisu in the forest. However, the reality was his family was poor and large. There was no room to raise the chicks entrusted to him by the parent Niwatorisu. Three years passed after overcoming his family's opposition. The chicks grew into splendid female Niwatorisus and began to lay precious eggs. Then, this time, his siblings started targeting those eggs...!? "I'm leaving this house already!" Ten-year-old Otoka carries out a midnight flight together with the Mofumofu strongest Niwatorisus he named Shiro-chan and Kuro-chan. In this way, a free-spirited Isekai journey begins with the cute and these strongest fluffy heroines!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

On his 20th birthday, ramen shop worker Jyuri’s quiet life is upended when his estranged grandfather appears and asks him to move to Tokyo, enroll in a prestigious university, and train as the heir to his powerful corporation. Hoping to repay the family who supported him and honor his late mother’s wishes, Jyuri steps into a world of wealth and expectations far beyond his comfort zone. But his new life starts chaotically when he’s assigned a strict, intimidating caretaker, Kai, and forced to live with him in a luxurious apartment.

Sakurai, who has always been a "gloomy person" since childhood, is determined to leave that version of himself behind. He sees entering the workforce as a chance for a fresh start. Armed with only the superficial advice he found online, he decides to make his debut as an "outgoing person"... But his plan falls apart on the very first day. Trying too hard to be outgoing, he acts overly friendly with Toba, who's rumored to be called a "demon superior." Coupled together with his self-hatred, Sakurai later runs into Toba in the restroom and breaks down in tears in front of him. But unexpectedly, Toba's reaction is strangely...?

synopsis:
Ten years ago, on an unusually cold winter day, Do-eon's father brought home a young boy. Given the name Mi-yi, the child became Do-eon's younger brother in name, though they shared no blood.

At eighteen, Do-eon begins to care for Mi-yi out of simple compassion, gradually becoming his sole protector and the only safe place in his world. Sheltered behind Do-eon's quiet devotion, Mi-yi grows up clinging to him as his one constant.

Seven years later, everything changes when Mi-yi is involved in a shocking incident that leaves their father at the bottom of a staircase.

Haunted by guilt and secrets he cannot yet reveal, Mi-yi asks only one thing of Do-eon: not to hate him when the truth finally comes out.

title: The Unexpected Detour
synopsis:
Five years ago, an accident erased Ha Dogeon's memories. Even so, his life has remained mostly smooth, calm, and manageable. He believes the past he lost no longer matters.

That illusion cracks the night he returns home after a university alumni event. His designated driver, Yang Ha-il, is a stranger, yet the moment their eyes meet, something deep inside Dogeon stirs. A gaze that feels unfamiliar but achingly known, an attraction he cannot explain.

From that night on, Dogeon's carefully balanced life begins to shift. Emotions he does not remember choosing start to resurface, pulling him toward a man who feels tied to a time he was sure was gone forever.

Caught between erased memories and revived feelings, Dogeon is forced to confront the possibility that forgetting did not mean letting go.

As the past quietly pushes its way back into the present, Dogeon must face the question he never thought he would ask again, what if the most important part of his life is the one he lost?

Raised in poverty, Kim Woojoon has done every kind of job imaginable just to survive. When he rushes back to his rural hometown after hearing about his mother's car accident, he is crushed by the impossible weight of hospital bills and daily expenses.

Desperate, Woojoon stumbles into an interview at a luxurious hotel hidden deep in the countryside, a place that caters to the ultra rich and keeps its most exclusive guests in sealed off VIP rooms. There, he meets the enigmatic owner, Kang Ra-han, a man whose calm smile hides dangerous intentions.

Instead of an ordinary job offer, Ra-han presents Woojoon with a startling contract, one that blurs the line between employment and something far more intimate.

With his mother's life on the line and no other options left, Woojoon must decide how much of himself he is willing to give up in exchange for survival.

Then one night at a bar, he meets a man who embodies everything he's been craving: sharp eyes, a dangerous smile, and a touch that leaves him trembling. As Suhyeon falls deeper into the affair, Haemin discovers the truth, and what follows is a story of love, lust, and betrayal—perfectly arranged in threes.

One night, a mysterious viewer named "Santa" drops over ten million won on Sunny (real name Sun Ikyung) in a single stream. The shock is real, the thrill is undeniable... and the donor's identity is a total mystery. What Sunny doesn't know? Santa is no stranger. As the extravagant donations continue, and Santa's teasing, suggestive requests get bolder, Sunny realizes he doesn't mind the attention at all. Caught between three potential suitors and one very rich secret admirer, Sunny sets out to uncover the truth: Who is the "Santa" showering him with money, and...is he boyfriend material?

Her dad was always saying strange things. That he came from an empire called Talochium. And he believed that Tyr's hometown was there, too.

However, in a surprising turn of events, he discovers that magic has terribly declined. In this era where powerful spells is a rarity, his talentless self is now completely unmatched!
