title_japanese: TS転生美少女 音虎玲子は寝取られたい
synopsis:
"Whatever the case, I want to be a girl who gets NTR'd!"

A despicable villain who shattered countless couples in his previous life is reborn through TS reincarnation as the angelic beauty Netora Reiko. But this tr*shy girl has only one desire: to experience the ultimate netorare (NTR)!? Reiko, a breathtakingly beautiful girl who also understands the male psyche, sets out to create her perfect NTR scenario. With calculated tactics, she seduces her childhood friend and even his best friends one after another!

This NTR-loving TS beauty is out to deceive everyone and mentally destroy her childhood friend in the process... A wicked yet glorious romantic(?) comedy!

(Source: Hobby Japan, translated)

title: Hangyakusha toshite Oukoku de Shokei sareta Kakure Saikyou Kishi
title_japanese: 反逆者として王国で処刑された隠れ最強騎士
synopsis:
The kingdom's strongest knight, Aldia, was the central figure in ending the war between the Kingdom of Leshfeld and the Vulcan Empire. Although Aldia became a hero, he was executed as a traitor for false reasons. With regret in his heart for being unable to save the Empire's Princess Valtrune, who saved him when he was on the verge of death despite being enemies...

However, when Aldia woke up, he found himself in a world six years before the war broke out! Determined to save Valtrune's life, which he could not do before, Aldia decides to pledge loyalty to the Princess as a knight of the Vulcan Empire in his second life and change the world!

This is a regression story of a once-executed knight who returns to be the strongest again!!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Suki na Hito no Papa Hajimemasu
title_japanese: 好きな彼〈ひと〉のパパはじめます

title: Kami no Daikousha (Jishou): Subete wa Ano Okata no Oboshimesu Mama ni...... to Iimakuttetara Hiku ni Hikenakunatta
title_japanese: 神の代行者（自称） 全てはあのお方の思し召すままに……と言いまくってたら引くに引けなくなった
synopsis:
Zero, a young nobleman reincarnated from Japan, finds himself in a world of swords and magic. As a former otaku, his blood starts boiling—he wants to do something chuunibyou-esque! When he discovers his father's embarrassing "Notebook of the World's Truths" in the study, Zero seizes the chance to roleplay. Declaring himself the Emissary of the Holy God, he begins a grand rebellion against the false gods who rule the world—just for fun. But the gods actually exist!? And the girls he casually recruited as subordinates now worship him with complete devotion! Unable to back down, Zero continues to play the part of the Emissary, unknowingly guiding the world from the shadows!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Mukashi Totta Kinezuka de... to Iinagara Musou suru Teishokuya no Ossan, Jitsu wa Densetsu no Dungeon Kouryakusha
title_japanese: 昔取ったきねづかで…と言いながら無双する定食屋のおっさん、実は伝説のダンジョン攻略者
synopsis:
A world where dungeons have appeared on Earth. Nishida Kenichi, a 40-year-old man, quit his salaryman job to open a diner, but it was a total failure. After much agonizing, what he came up with was menu development using Dungeon-sourced ingredients & livestreaming his ingredient procurement! He breezes through conquests that would normally be life threatening—just who is this old man!? Viewers, idols, and even S-rank adventurers are obsessed with Nishida's overwhelming strength and mysterious charm!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: My Bias Is Showing?!
synopsis:
High school teacher Na Aejoon has a secret obsession. He's a total simp for the handsome Choi Siyeol from the popular idol group, A-One! Na Aejoon is so enamored with Siyeol that even his weekends are devoted to fanboying over—and dreaming about—the pop star. While he'd give anything to meet Siyeol even once in his lifetime, he's accepted the fact that it's not going to happen one day. Until it does.

Cast in a variety show, Siyeol is slated to be at Aejoon's school for filming. And what's better than seeing his idol every day? Catching his attention! Suddenly cast as Siyeol's co-star, Aejoon must put on the ultimate act: not showing his rabid fan side, lest he creep Siyeol out. But as the two grow closer, keeping secrets will become more of a challenge—for both of them.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertaiment)

title: Miseijuku Succubus
synopsis:
I love you, but should this love bear fruit, I would become a creature that would bring you harm... I know this, yet these feelings just won't stop. Where will they take me...?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Blues for Dandelion
synopsis:
Park Kang-tae, having inherited the debts of the Naksan faction, moves to Seoul. Through the grandson who sold him an empty house for a bargain, Kang-tae ends up moving into the main residence of "Big Brother" and meets Joo Yeon-hee, who introduces herself as a housekeeper.

"I came to help with the cleaning..."

It was an extremely rare occurrence for him, who had always been engrossed only in his work, to develop an interest in a woman. What exactly was this sense of déjà vu? Was the feeling of having met sometime before just a simple coincidence?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Yuge no Mukou ni Asa wo Miru
title_japanese: 湯気のむこうに朝をみる
synopsis:
Takumi has been dumped by his boyfriend after planning to move in together. When he quits his job and moves back home to work at his family's bathhouse, he meets Satsuki, a university student. Young and good-looking with a bright future, Takumi finds him very different from his heartbroken self. He thinks he should avoid approaching him casually, but when he is crying alone, Satsuki suddenly kisses him! As Satsuki directly confesses "I love you, Takumi," he cannot find the courage to respond to his feelings...

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

title: Ossan wa Isekai de Omoi wo Togeru
title_japanese: おっさんは異世界で想いを遂げる
synopsis:
An old man wrongly accused of groping ends up, before he knows it, in a mysterious temple with a suspicious goddess, together with a high school girl, Mizuki. The goddess Rakshel mediates the two as they continue bickering and gives them a royal order to defeat the Demon King. After receiving only three cheat-type special skills from the goddess, the old man is transported to another world along with Mizuki.

It's a medieval Europe–like world where the concept of levels exists. And on top of that... the Demon King they're supposed to defeat was already slain 100 years ago.

To begin with, with the old man's abilities, even taking down small fry like goblins is a struggle. To survive in a harsher-than-expected other world, he decides to buy a slave and form a party. That's where he meets Fam, a beautiful dog-eared girl. Together with Fam, the old man steadily works as an adventurer, tackling dungeons and quests one step at a time...

This other world isn't so easy!

(Source: Magazine Ho

title: I'm the Fake Bride Who Plans to Run Away
title_english: I'm the Fake Bride Who Plans to Run Away
synopsis:
Erika has endured countless slights at the hands of her mother's charge, the wealthy daughter of the Blanche home. But when the girl falls ill, Erika's mother is jailed by her father, the cruel Marquis Blanche. To free her, Erika must play the role of the Marquis' daughter in a sham marriage with Lord Sebastian Aklief. Sworn to secrecy, Erika must rely on her kind heart and newly awakening powers to help her navigate this new world of intrigue, magic, and mystery to free her mother—and herself!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Secretary Ran Away
synopsis:
How do you get over a guy you've been in love with forever? Yun Sehee decides the answer is asking him to date her, even if it's just for three months. The only problem? The guy is the cold, confident Kang Taewook, Sehee's boss! Unwilling to lose his top secretary, Taewook agrees to Sehee's unorthodox offer—with a plan to show her just how unlovable he is. Can Taewook make Sehee realize he isn't such a good catch? Or will he find himself falling for a girl who just wants to give him up for good?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Mimi Tori Tennyo
synopsis:
Ryuhei, now a graduate student, has felt a strange fascination since childhood with a certain folktale in a picture book. As he visits Shiraha Village, where the legend is said to have spread, and continues his investigation, a mystery, as well as creeping suspicion, begins to surface…?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Yuusha Party wo Oidasareta Kiyoubinbou Gaiden: Off no Selma-san wa Bukiyou!?
title_japanese: 勇者パーティを追い出された器用貧乏 外伝 オフのセルマさんは不器用!?
synopsis: A spin-off manga focusing on Selma Claudel.

title: Douro☆Star
synopsis:
To obtain the Ultimate License, said to let its holder drive any vehicle, Issei enrolls at Makibishi Driving School. His goal is the legendary car Counter-kun... but what awaits him is a driving school from hell?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: The Shepherd Wizard
synopsis:
There stood a seemingly ordinary shepherd named Turan from Hisaril Hill. Having lived while hiding his talent as a great archwizard, he finally steps out into the world.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Kono Koi no Hisaku wa Shippai desu
title_japanese: この恋の秘策は失敗です

title: Sweet Heat!
synopsis: Two professional wrestlers are rivals in the ring but lovers at home.

title: Koushiki Furin
synopsis:
Fumiya, an office worker in his seventh year of marriage, is troubled by his sex life with his wife. Though he loves her dearly, his own body fails to respond during intimacy. With no children and constant pressure from their relatives, the couple suffers daily. Then, one day, they are suddenly torn apart by the government and forced into cohabitation with "new partners." This is state-sanctioned infidelity, carried out under the guise of countermeasures against the declining birthrate!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Hajimemashite, Ore no Shinyuu
title_english: Nice to Meet You, My Best Friend
title_japanese: はじめまして、オレの親友
synopsis:
Shoutarou Tokitou, a university student, shares a room with his childhood friend Rin Kazama. When they were kids, the two of them went everywhere and did everything together. Shoutarou was always overprotective of Rin, who always followed him around, but after they started living together, Rin's attitude became cold and he started playing around with women... Before he knew it, a gap had formed between the two of them. One day, they got into an argument after Rin brought a woman into the house without permission, and in the process, Rin hit his head and lost all memory of their relationship. The two decided to continue living together as before for the sake of his treatment, but Rin is still as attached to Shoutarou as in the past... but seems to have ulterior motives...!?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Toropako♡Biyori
synopsis:
1. Genuine Love♡
2. Motto Misete yo! (Show Me More!)
3. Massage Panic
4. Hajimete Kinenbi (First Anniversary)
5. Kakushita Kokoro, Ecchi Moyou
6. Zettai Rouraku Sengen! (Declaration of Pure Enticement!)
7. Kanawanai, Kanaetai (I Can't Compete So I Wanna Satisfy)
8. Kurushiku Naruhodo Itoshiteru! (I Love You So Much It Hurts!)
9. Otameshi Mazo Kyoushi (Practice-Run Masochist Teacher)

title: Love on the Menu
synopsis:
As part of his pre-graduation internship, culinary student Lee Eunseong finds himself working at a sushi restaurant, where one familiar face shows up day after day. But when Eunseong accidentally stumbles upon his regular's secret, things take an unexpected turn. Jeon Hoyeong is determined to keep it hidden, while Eunseong can't decide whether he's annoyed... or oddly drawn in.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Eternal Flame
synopsis:
Once saved as a child by a boy who appeared like a flame, Jang Doha reunites with his savior and confesses his love. But Kang Taejun knows the truth. Doha's feelings are not love. He has returned for one reason only, revenge.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Masked by Love
synopsis:
After chatting with a flower shop's mascot part-time worker, Do-hui suddenly finds himself on the radar of the school delinquent, Yang-hyeon. Seeking comfort, he confides in the gentle person inside the bear costume, never suspecting it's actually Yang-hyeon himself. As misunderstandings and hidden crushes collide, a shy first love begins to bloom in the most unexpected way.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: One Room Dungeon Toushi
title_japanese: ワンルームダンジョン投資
synopsis:
The golden age of dungeon conquest! Studio Dungeon Investment, where you buy dungeons and rake in profits, has been all the rage. The protagonist, aiming to build his wealth, bought one himself, but...?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Golden Phantom
title_japanese: ゴールデンファントム

title: Enigmatica
synopsis:
World War II. Behind the horrific conflict known to all, there existed a secret war known to none. Codemakers and codebreakers. A story that unravels the lives of men who vanished into the shadows of history.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Exorcist Angel
title_japanese: エクソシストエンジェル
synopsis:
An angel spends her days in boredom, forgetting her duty. As part of a covenant, she was tasked with protecting a noble family. However, a thousand years later, a demon appears and finds an opening...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Party Tsuihou sareta TS Succubus-san wa Fukushuu ni Shippai suru
title_japanese: パーティ追放されたTSサキュバスさんは復讐に失敗する

title: TS Tensei shita Watashi ga Shozoku suru VTuber Jimusho no Liver wo Zenin Otoshi ni Iku Hanashi
title_japanese: TS転生した私が所属するVTuber事務所のライバーを全員堕としにいく話
synopsis:
Yumemi Renge, a current high school girl who's a TS reincarnate obsessed with VTubers and also a hardcore yuri fan, has made a bold decision: "I will dominate the VTuber world with a mesugaki (bratty girl) persona!"

After relentless effort, she successfully debuts as Hanayori Kohaku, and immediately sets out to seduce all her VTuber senpais and peers at her agency... but her bratty girl persona collapses almost immediately!

Despite that, her viewers love it, commenting things like "Brat lol", "She's basically Mama Hanayori now lol", and "Don't push yourself, Hanayori". Through collab streams and real-life interactions, she gradually charms her legendary senpais and quirky peers one by one—what will happen next!?

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Hole Up Gamers
synopsis:
In the near future, the full-dive VR game Visions has taken Japan by storm. However, a flaw in the game leads to a series of fatal accidents involving players who remain logged in for extended periods. To halt the game, an attempt is made to force all players to log out, but a group of players rebel and barricade themselves within the game world. To evict these players and bring them back to reality, Kokoro Hato—a protagonist belonging to the Regional Welfare Department's Hikikomori Support Office—ventures into the world of Visions to make contact, but...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kyuuketsuki to Chocolatier: Tensai Renkinjutsushi no Kanbi na Tankyuu @comic
title_japanese: 吸血鬼とショコラティエ～天才錬金術師の甘美な探究～@COMIC
synopsis:
Luvilia, a mysterious city where the supernatural gather. Poor alchemist Alfred is risking his life to challenge is... making the "ultimate chocolate" to offer to the vampire Shin!? The key to breaking the forced master-servant contract is a "blissful sense of being alive." That is his only weakness. Will Alfred kill him first with a single, supremely sweet morsel, or will he become his servant first...? Where will this sweet, melting battle lead? "Even your murderous face is enticing, isn't it?" "Drop dead already, you shitty vampire!" An absolute master-servant Gothic sweets fantasy!

(Source: TO Books, translated)

title: Bad End Mokuzen no Heroine ni Tensei shita Watashi, Konse dewa Renai suru Tsumori ga Cheat na Ani ga Hanashite Kuremasen!?
title_japanese: バッドエンド目前のヒロインに転生した私、今世では恋愛するつもりがチートな兄が離してくれません!?
synopsis:
One day, Reine found herself reincarnated as Rene, the heroine of a grinding-based otome game that she had dropped in the past.

Just when she thought her sparkling heroine life was about to begin, she discovered that Rene had been bullied at school and even jumped off a staircase. Um, that sparkling heroine life... isn't it over before it even begins?

What awaited Rene was a magic academy with a caste system based on academic performance and a messed-up event system, even referred to as a "shitty game." Moreover, the current Rene was an F-rank with no human rights. She was already in trouble.

That being said, this was, after all, a grinding game. As long as she works hard, her status would definitely rise up, and by talking to the capture targets, she could increase their favorability. Taking advantage of her strong mentality, she wants to enjoy her school life to the fullest, unlike her previous life which was filled with studies and work! She also wants to fall in love with a hand

title: Kyoudai Shikkaku
synopsis:
One night, Yahiro (17) accidentally watches a video of his 21-year-old brother appearing in gay porn and spends a sleepless night in shock. When morning comes, his brother is there as usual, making breakfast and preparing his lunch. Unable to meet his brother's eyes out of embarrassment and confusion, Yahiro begins a painful struggle with his feelings.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Hentai Sekai no Arukikata
synopsis:
1. Ero Quest
2. Hentai Sekai ni Chijo ga Iku (A Pervert Goes to Pervert World)
3. Seiki Daidigger (Sperm Machine Daidigger)
4. Chinken Shoubu wa Matta Nashi (No Match in a Cocktana Fight)
5. Ekimore (Leaking Juices)
6-7. Gekishindou Battle Rotor (Violent Vibration Vibattle)
8. Magekishindou Battle Rotor (True Violent Vibration Vibattle)
9. Haji wo Shire Merosu (Have Some Shame, Merosu)
10. Suki na Ko toshite Ikiteiku

title: The Trial
synopsis:
After years under a military dictatorship, a new government rises, led by S-rank Sentinel Jeong Eden, a revered national hero. But in the courtroom where he stands as the victim of an attempted murder, his gaze remains fixed on one man: Lee Garam, the accused deserter who once served as his Guide. As the trial unfolds, the truth behind their bond begins to surface, blurring the line between betrayal and devotion.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: A Tale of a Hundred Nights
title_english: A Tale of a Hundred Nights
synopsis:
Hoyeon Baek is fed up with his bad luck. That phony shaman telling him his nightmares are the result of being haunted by spirits was one thing, but sleeping with a hundred different souls in a human body to get rid of those dreams is another! The body in question? Dan Choi, dreamboat celebrity. He's just as haunted as Hoyeon, but that's nothing compared to the sadness he seems to carry inside. Strange powers brought them together, but could this odd relationship turn into something more?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Beneath Him
synopsis:
Jeongun, born into nobility, hides desires society would never forgive. After his former lover leaves him, he drags Solgae, his family's servant, into a forbidden bond of passion and power. If discovered, they could lose everything. Will they continue or return to the roles society demands of them?

(Source: Manta)

title: Tensei Bonjin no Eiyuu Sakusei Kyoushitsu
title_japanese: 転生凡人の英雄作成教室

title: Manimani!!
synopsis:
To avenge her murdered parents, and to bring peace to the people, a justice-driven princess of a fallen kingdom rises up alongside her retainer! But the princess herself is unbelievably weak?! A spunky princess and the ultimate retainer!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Liar Game: The Last Game
synopsis: After finishing the final round of the Liar Game, what is the new "game" that Shinichi and Nao will face...?!

title: Stained Scarlet
synopsis:
Hailed as the Pure-White Princess, Princess Celine bears a dreadful curse. When she comes of age, her white hair will turn scarlet, and her kingdom will drown in blood. Resigned to her fate, she meaninglessly drifts through life until she meets the enigmatic yet gentle Duke Weinberg, who awakens her desire and rekindles her will to live. But as their bond deepens, so do her doubts. Who is he truly? What lies behind his love? And what will become of her kingdom that's bound to her cursed fate?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Dreaming of Us
synopsis:
Estella Ignacio has blossomed into a beautiful and alluring young woman, something all too apparent to Matias Monsetrat, the man Estella has been secretly in love with since they were young. But before they can even tell each other their true feelings, their bodies become more honest than their minds. As they both give in to their carnal desires, they are plagued with doubts and insecurities about losing each other. Will their love end in a nightmare or a dream come true?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: At Her Ladyship's Naughty Command
synopsis:
As the only daughter of Count Grave, Abella has been pampered and permitted to be as wild as she pleases. Now, she's ready to channel her reckless charm into winning over Claude, her loyal but infuriatingly proper knight. With a glint in her eye and mischief on her tongue, Abella unleashes a series of salacious demands that are completely improper but undeniably tempting. Claude has always adhered to his lady's whims, so will her sultry orders finally unravel his sense of propriety?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kaishagaeri no Pas de Deux
title_japanese: 会社帰りのパ・ド・ドゥ
synopsis:
35-year-old Toru Kohinata, lacking in physical fitness, has a personality that can't refuse. He finds himself attending a ballet trial lesson at the invitation of someone, only to wake up the next day with sore muscles. Thinking he should give up, he witnesses his coworker Honoka Sakuragi dancing in the company's document room. Moved by her performance, Toru decides he wants to dance ballet seriously. However, when Honoka discovers a photo he accidentally took of her dancing, she accuses him of "voyeurism."

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Okashi no Ie no Majo wa Yarinaoshitai
title_japanese: お菓子の家の魔女はやり直したい

title: Ovcharka
synopsis:
A Russian mafia big boss is attacked in an assassination attempt. This betrayal, driven by a power grab within the organization, brings the entire crime syndicate to the brink of collapse. Ovcharka Boris stands before the blood of his closest friend and makes his choice: revenge.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: The Resurrection Boy
synopsis:
A boy who possesses the heart of resurrection. Not even hundreds of deaths can kill him. The laboratory that suppressed his and his friends' abilities their entire lives. Jio now sets his sights on that place.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Feasting Lord in Another World
synopsis:
A revolution begins in the small fishing village of Evergreen. A nutritionist reborn from a past life sets out to conquer this other world, deliciously and in no time at all.

"Welcome to Evergreen!"

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Why the White Cat Was Bitten by Count Black Leopard
title_english: Why the White Cat Was Bitten by Count Black Leopard
title_japanese: 흑표범 백작에게 물린 흰 고양이의 사정
synopsis:
Cat shapeshifter Irene's life changes drastically the day she accidentally goes into heat on her way home from work. Luckily, she is found by the black leopard Count Nox, who takes her back to his estate. Being the only two shapeshifters in the territory, their meeting feels like fate. But with Irene's commoner background and Nox's fierce protective instincts, fitting into high society is harder than they expected. Will the two be able to overcome their troubles and find happiness and true love?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: 101st Confession
synopsis:
For the past 13 years, Lucia has harbored a not-so-secret crush on her childhood friend, Herwyn. After 99 rejected confessions, she's determined to move on. But just as she prepares to accept her arranged engagement, fate takes an unexpected turn. When jealousy flares and hearts collide, Herwyn and Lucia are about to find out they're not done with each other yet. They say third time's the charm, but could this final chance be the one that changes everything?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Outlaws 0
synopsis:
He wipes them all out in one satisfying sweep! The rookie days of the monster detective, Ma Seok-Do! A covert operation begins to take down the worst and strongest crime syndicate.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Apocalyptic Weapon
synopsis:
Born from the weaponization of nuclear fusion technology, the superhuman weapons known as Defiers (D-fire) plunged the world into war—an apocalypse that wiped out 30% of humanity. The survivors came to loathe the Defiers, branding them the architects of extinction and calling them "Enders."

Theo, the sole survivor among the Enders, lived for 30 years under the surveillance of the Ainex Alliance, his core removed, passing his days as an ordinary family man. But when the anti-nuclear terrorist organization "Zero Core" attacks, Theo loses his wife—and his daughter Louise vanishes without a trace. The peace he struggled to protect is shattered in an instant. Vowing revenge, Theo reawakens the forbidden power he sealed away three decades ago to reclaim his daughter. Standing against Zero Core's vast conspiracy and a world steeped in prejudice, the lonely battle of the last Ender begins.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Hit Me One More Time, Teacher
title_english: Hit Me One More Time, Teacher
synopsis:
After crashing her ex's wedding, high school teacher Siyeon drowns her heartbreak in a hotel bar, only to end up in a reckless one-night stand with a charming young man. Although she's ready to forget the night ever happened, she's thrown into chaos when he appears at her school as her new coworker. As if that wasn't bad enough, he turns out to be Hajun, a former student she taught years ago. While Siyeon struggles to keep her walls up, Hajun boldly closes the distance, refusing to let their past—or their night together—stay buried.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Swan's Grave
synopsis:
Seeking a way back to her world, Anna becomes a maid at the infamous "Swan's Grave." When the marquis mistakes her for his vanished wife and offers a forbidden bargain, Anna is drawn into the haunting legacy of the Lorengreen house.

(Source: Manta)

title: Shakkin 100-oku no Kamimiko, Onsenyado no Ossan ni Kawareru
title_japanese: 借金100億の神巫女、温泉宿のおっさんに買われる
serializations: Suiyoubi wa Mattari Dash X Comic
synopsis:
I bought that shrine maiden!, It all started with property damage during an exorcism, leaving the exorcist shrine maiden Kasuri Kagamimori burdened with a 10 billion yen debt. Her savior? The old man who runs a mysterious hot spring inn called Kisensou? Now suddenly working as a maid at the hot spring inn, what awaits Kasuri...?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: The Goddess of Abundance and Her Troublemaker Apostle
title_english: The Goddess of Abundance and Her Troublemaker Apostle
synopsis:
Earth's life force is depleted, and it's dying. Humanity's only hope lies with Dispatchers, heroes sent to otherworldly realms to retrieve energy for survival. Oh Chansu is one of them, but despite his legendary father, he has zero talent. However, things change when Chansu is sent to the Block-Style Territory Expansion World as the Apostle of a forgotten, weakened Goddess of Abundance. Armed with nothing but a modified harvesting skill and a desperate drive to find his parents, Chansu must reclaim his territory block by block. From wretched outcast to genius apostle, the hunt to restore his Goddess begins now!

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Tougarashi Dragon no Shin: Shiikuin Reiji no Kansatsu Nikki
title_japanese: とうがらしドラゴンのシン 飼育員レージの観察日記
synopsis:
So, I've finally landed my dream job as a mythical beast keeper, but for some reason, the half-dragon Shin is giving me a total cold shoulder, and it's getting spicy! I've got my work cut out for me, but I'm gonna give it my all to become a pro keeper!

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

title: Oyasumi, Nini-chan.
synopsis:
In so much anguish that he couldn't sleep, Ameta thought in desperation that it might be better to end it all. Just as he was about to cast himself off, an angel suddenly dove from the sky and collided with his head. And so begins the heartwarming life of a young man named Ameta and his self-proclaimed angel.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Superhuman Streamer
synopsis:
Baek Uhyeon logs into Reverse Planet expecting a VR game, only to discover that the world is painfully real. A decade of grief and experiments turns him into a superhuman contract killer, and he finally executes the director behind his suffering. But when he returns to his original life, the ghosts of his fallen companions follow him. Haunted and restless, he goes back to Reverse Planet, only to realize he's entered the real game this time. Paired with superstar streamer Kang Soyul, his lethal efficiency goes viral... and puts him on the conspirator's radar. "This series contains depictions of disturbing imagery that may be upsetting for some readers."

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Isso, Koi Dattara Yokatta noni
title_english: I Wish It Had Just Been Love.
title_japanese: いっそ、恋だったらよかったのに

title: Lucky Mia!
synopsis:
Nam Eun-ho, a college student living alone with his younger sister, has lived a life of extreme misfortune, beginning with a childhood car accident. Eun-ho's sole goal is to live an ordinary life, remaining unnoticed. Then, one day, a campus goddess, unexpectedly entangled with him, strikes him with a sudden urge! Is this a stroke of luck, or the start of yet another misfortune?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Host Tenshi Lucian
synopsis:
Angel Amelia descends to the human world to save Lucian, an archangel who once saved her but has since fallen from grace. But for some reason, he’s working as a host in Kabukicho! Can she bring him back to heaven from this city of the night, swirling with worldly desire…?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Odenya Haruko-baasan no Henkutsu Isekai Chindouchuu
title_japanese: おでん屋春子婆さんの偏屈異世界珍道中

title: Wakatteimasu yo Dannasama. Douse "Aisuru Hito ga Dekita" to Iun desho? Doormat Heroine, Atama wo Butsuketa Hyoushi ni Zense ga Osaka no Obachan Datta Koto wo Omoidasu The Comic
title_japanese: わかっていますよ旦那さま。どうせ「愛する人ができた」と言うんでしょ？～ドアマットヒロイン、頭をぶつけた拍子に前世が大阪のオバチャンだった事を思い出す～ THE COMIC

title: Noroware Ouji to Chahakase no Musume: Genkoku Koukyuuden
title_japanese: 呪われ皇子と茶博士の娘 幻国後宮伝

title: Space Bunny
synopsis:
While out at a trendy cosplay bar with a friend, Siyun finds himself captivated by a striking bartender named Ara, who is sporting a pair of plush bunny ears. The night takes a chaotic turn when Siyun accidentally splashes a drink directly onto her headpiece. Flustered and desperate to make amends, he reaches out to help her remove the damp accessory, but as his fingers graze the fur, he freezes. The texture isn't synthetic! It's warm, pulsing, and inexplicably real.

Noticing his shock, Ara quickly pulls Siyun away from the thumping music and prying eyes to a secluded corner of the bar. After a heavy, hesitant silence, she finally lets her guard down. She reveals the soft, snow-white ears that are a part of her very being, whispering a confession that defies all logic: "The truth is... I'm actually a real bunny."

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Maryoku Zero no Ochikobore, Jusatsu no Youtou ni Erabareru.
title_japanese: 魔力ゼロの落ちこぼれ、呪殺の妖刀に選ばれる。
synopsis:
In a world where magic is commonplace, Chrom, the son of nobility, possesses no magical power whatsoever. Though unable to wield magic, he trained in swordsmanship, striving to be useful to the world. Yet his own father and brother branded him useless and banished him. His exile destination was a forest teeming with monsters. As Chrom lay crushed by despair, a monster appeared before him. Just as he resigned himself to certain defeat, the cursed sword discarded alongside him spoke to Chrom...

(Source: Coamix, translated)

title: Guuzen Tasuketa Bishoujo ga Nazeka Ore ni Natsuiteshimatta Ken ni Tsuite
title_japanese: 偶然助けた美少女がなぜか俺に懐いてしまった件について
synopsis:
"Um... Mikami-san?"

"Don't mind me."

"Aren't you a little too close?"

"Don't mind me♪"

Kirishima Rei, a self-proclaimed introverted loner, had completely failed his attempt at a high school debut. One day, by sheer chance, he ended up saving the school's most talked-about beauty, Mikami Hina, from a tough situation. In return, she insisted on repaying the favor by having lunch together.

But Mikami-san was clearly someone from a world far beyond his reach. This brief connection—once she had properly thanked him—was sure to fade away. Or at least, that's what Rei had assumed.

Yet, before he knew it...

Secret lunchtime meetings, whispered conversations after school, bumping into each other on the way to class, unexpected encounters on weekends—his time spent with Mikami-san kept increasing.

No matter how much he tried to keep his distance, she would just brush it off with a cheerful "Don't mind me♪" and push her way deeper into his daily life.

(Source: Novel Updates)

title: Ao ni Hatsukoi
synopsis:
Rookie police officer Shiomi meets his senior officer, Chief Sano, on his first day of work. Shiomi initially feels uncomfortable around Chief Sano, who is always looking out for him, but one day he realizes that Sano is watching over him with warmth, and gradually opens up. Shiomi is drawn to the friendly and reliable Chief Sano, and his feelings grow stronger.Then, in his second year on the force, Shiomi's wish finally comes true and he becomes Sano's partner.However, his joy is short-lived when he receives the news that "Chief Sano is getting married."

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Sushi Buster Kizamu
synopsis:
Two years after moving to Tokyo, Kizamu Kamoda has lost all his money and is searching for work when he stumbles upon a sushi bar. There he meets the master, a guy in nothing but a loincloth and a face right off a fish! Kizamu starts working right away, but it seems this place also performs exorcisms at night...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Tonari no Futomomo-san
synopsis:
Kuonji is a perfectly healthy high school boy, but his heart is held captive by one thing: the thighs of the girl sitting right next to him! Following a chance accident, he finally makes contact with the girl who was supposed to be way out of his league. Now, Kuonji's dull everyday life is about to take a massive turn...!!?

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Koori no Koushaku-sama to Karisome no Hanayome: Ai no Nai Oumeikon nanoni, Nazeka Dekiai saretemasu
title_japanese: 氷の侯爵様とかりそめの花嫁～愛のない王命婚なのに、なぜか溺愛されてます～

title: Double Down
synopsis:
"Can you suck it for me?" Jihan, who was caught having a crush on a man by Shin-woo. In exchange for hiding the fact, Jihan receives an unimaginable sexual request from Shin-woo. To make matters worse, when Shinwoo, who is a security guard and a popular star, is stalked, he starts living with him... Kim Shin-woo, who is always naughty, and Ji-han, who is helplessly swayed even though he doesn't like him. How will the relationship between the two people who have been twisted a lot be resolved?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Asobinin na Shoujo-tachi wa Kyou mo Houkago Yatteiru
title_japanese: 遊び人な少女たちは今日も放課後ヤっている
synopsis:
Daiki entered high school dreaming of a sparkling, youthful life. However, after reuniting with his older, introverted childhood friend, Kyouko, he is lured into joining the "Imitation Games Club."

The club's activities revolve around sophisticated versions of "make-believe" games like "House" or "Hide-and-Seek"—reimagined as intellectual pursuits for high schoolers. But for some reason, "accidents" keep happening, leading to some very steamy and unexpected developments!

While these boys and girls initially intended to play wholesome games, their childhood pastimes are fast-tracking them into a deeply immoral relationship...?! Playing children's games at this age is naughty, fun, and totally scandalous! An immoral youth comedy begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kamen no Kurokishi. Shoutai Bareta node Mou Gakuen demo Musou suru
title_japanese: 仮面の黒騎士。正体バレたのでもう学園でも無双する
synopsis:
The mysterious, strongest knight known as the "Black Knight" saves people in times of crisis. He was supposed to live as a masked hero in the shadows—yet his true identity is exposed as none other than Adele, the disgrace of a marquis family! Though Adel pretended to be incompetent in order to live a lazy life, his cover is blown, and now even at the academy he can no longer conceal his true power...!? A school tale of unrivaled dominance featuring a knight whose secret identity has been revealed!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: R2R: Run to Red
synopsis:
Living in the slums of District Zero, Ban runs a small errand service, taking on jobs others would rather avoid. One day, he accepts a request from Shinwi, the boss of a rising criminal organization, and stumbles upon the existence of the mysterious "Project W." While investigating the substance, Ban hopes to help Ray, the police officer who once took him in and whom he has secretly loved for years. But the deeper Ban digs, the more he uncovers a hidden truth Ray has long been keeping hidden. As secrets surface, Ban finds himself caught between loyalty, love, and a dangerous conspiracy.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Suki tte Itte Kuretemo Ii yo?
title_japanese: スキって言ってくれてもいいよ?
synopsis:
Kanade, a high school student who prefers to stay out of the spotlight, has been living a quiet and uneventful life. However, everything changes when Masaya, a former classmate from elementary school, transfers into his class. Masaya has always been popular and attention-grabbing, and Kanade wants nothing to do with him. Despite his efforts to avoid Masaya, Kanade finds himself relentlessly pursued from the very first day. When Kanade tries to keep his distance, an irritated Masaya boldly declares, "I'll make you say you love me!!" for reasons that are... unclear!? Caught off guard, Kanade is swept up in Masaya's relentless advances from that day forward...!!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Hashtag Is First Love
synopsis:
Yoon Ye-seol, the top student in her school, suddenly begins to see people's true feelings as "hashtags." But... above her first love, Seong Shin-woo, a tag appears: #My_first_love_who_turned_out_to_be_trash?!

The old wounds of abandonment—wounds she never understood—resurface, pushing Ye-seol to team up with Baek Sol, who also hates Shin-woo. Is it revenge? Or lingering affection that refuses to fade? And who will end up hurt this time?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Ore no Ichizu wo Jama suru Aitsu
title_japanese: オレの一途を邪魔するアイツ
synopsis:
Wakaba Osanai, a fifth-grade boy, is in love with his homeroom teacher! To become a man worthy of his teacher, he pretends to be more mature than he really is! But his childhood friend, Kai Wakanouchi, begins teasing him after he reveals his feelings for their teacher. Kai has feelings for him too... and she's trying to catch is attention by flirting!

Thus begins a "double unrequited love" romcom, featuring a boy struggling against the seductive antics of his childhood friend!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Hishikai Sentou Iron Recce
title_japanese: 非視界戦闘 アイアンレッキ
synopsis:
Faster than anyone. More dazzling than all else. An authentic rally racing manga by Masahito Soda!

Rally racing, the motorsport that determines the world's fastest outside the race track. A prodigy comes on the scene, shaking the world with his driving.

(Source: Shogakukan)

title: Warui Mushi
synopsis:
Commit a sin, and a "bug" attaches to you!

Misao is a young boy who can see the "bugs" that attach themselves to people who have committed sins.
Small bugs for minor sins, large bugs for grave sins...

Through these bugs, Misao is able to measure the weight of a person's sins. However, he gradually begins to see bugs that defy these rules, and at the same time, strange incidents start occurring around him...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Watashi wa Succubus ja Arimasen
title_japanese: 私はサキュバスじゃありません
synopsis:
Liz, a young noblewoman, is a star pupil at her academy—talented, refined, generous, and the apple of everyone's eye. But the day a legendary hero comes to the academy to convalesce, Liz, in spite of herself, does the unthinkable... She asks for the hero's underpants! Liz, as it turns out, has a secret. She was a member of the hero's party until all her memories were stolen during a climactic battle—including the fact that she's a demon of desire known as a succubus! She can hardly believe it when she reawakens to her completely out-of-character powers, but unfortunately for Liz, she's about to find out that it's not so easy to defy your true nature...

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: MBB: My Bad Boss
synopsis:
Do Hyun-woo, a hunting dog, is tasked with uncovering the secrets of the Black Cloud Society, a criminal organization that disrupts the city's order. Although his infiltration is successful, a mysterious figure known as "Team Ha Leader" begins to hinder Hyun-woo's every move. 

"Well, I'm a beta, after all..." 

"How strange. But why do you smell so good?" 

Team Ha Leader's intrusion into his personal space causes a setback in the infiltration operation...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment, translated)

title: Chiisakute Kawaii Bungeibu no Chiteki na Senpai wo, Hiza no Ue ni Nosetara Mainichi Suwattekuru You ni Natta
title_japanese: 小さくて可愛い文芸部の知的な先輩を、膝の上に乗せたら毎日座ってくるようになった
synopsis:
One day, the chairs in the Literature Club have been lent out to other clubs, leaving only a single chair behind. Kido and Yuzu begin a lighthearted argument, each trying to yield the remaining seat to the other. Each wants the other to sit more than themselves. Because of their mutual kindness, neither backs down, resulting in a stalemate—until finally, Yuzu's opinion wins out, and Kido ends up sitting in the chair alone. Kido feels guilty being the only one sitting, but right then, he has a flash of inspiration.

"Since I'm the one sitting in the chair, if I become the chair and let Yuzu-senpai sit on my lap... wouldn't that work?..." he asks.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kuroko-chan.
synopsis:
Kuroko Yuki is an otaku girl with a severe case of "chuunibyou" who constantly finds herself as the butt of the joke, both at school and at home. Living in a household of geniuses—a sister who's the strongest woman alive, a brother with an IQ of 300, and a musical prodigy younger sibling—Kuroko's daily life is a series of cringeworthy social failures. From sending family messages to her class group chat to bombing hard at karaoke, follow the high-tension, hilarious, and somewhat pitiful daily life of the lovable failure, Kuroko-chan!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Dungeon explorer Ruri Onimaru is a shy otaku girl with zero communication skills, but after she saves Mint Natsume, a hugely popular streamer with over 2.5 million subscribers, during a dungeon exploration livestream, Ruri accidentally goes mega-viral! Desperate to avoid attention, Ruri starts one-shotting monsters just to get things over with... only to become an overnight internet sensation!?

synopsis:
Captain Gorou Edajima, a seasoned captain who has visited the various countries of the Special Region on a research mission, and master cook Petty Officer, 1st Class Hajime Tokushima were given a special mission: rescue an American journalist kidnapped in the Special Region! Aboard an Oyashio-class attack submarine, they set out onto the seas of the Special Region, but little did they know their mission would lead them headfirst into a whirlpool of petty rulers and pirates vying for control in the Blue Sea...

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

synopsis:
Hiyori is plunged into despair after the death of Mikhail, the angel character she simped for. However, when she discovers Yuki Kuon, a basketball prodigy who is the spitting image of Mikhail, her life changes completely. As she pursues her, she finds herself joining a prestigious basketball club before she knows it...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Hicchuu no Dungeon Tansaku: Hicchuu nanode Anzenken kara Pechipechi Ya wo Utte Level Up
title_english: A Heroic Tale of a Humble Young Archer Who One Day Discovers an Incredible Way to Conquer Dungeons Using Special Skills, and Rapidly Grows into a Hero
title_japanese: 必中のダンジョン探索 ～必中なので安全圏からペチペチ矢を射ってレベルアップ～
synopsis:
In the modern day, where dungeons have appeared, Kaede Amamiya, an unpopular archer, discovers a cheat strategy that combines the unimpressive skill [Magic Arrow] with the rare skill [Sure-Hit]! Kaede's level begins to break through limits at an incredible speed! Popular streamer Liesche and other explorer beauties won't leave him alone...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Mikazuki no Ojousama Bibouroku
title_english: Mr. Mikazuki's Notes on His Lady
title_japanese: ミカヅキのお嬢様備忘録
synopsis:
"My Lady, you look so beautiful today... I'm so excited!" A quiet high school girl lives in a luxurious mansion, and her butler, Mikazuki, is obsessively in love with her. The stones the Lady steps on, the dust in her hair, the cream she leaves uneaten, the bathwater after she soaks... Mikazuki loves and wants to know everything about the Lady, and today he continues to shower his overprotective and perverted love on her. However, in fact, Mikazuki and the Lady harbor a secret that they have not revealed to each other...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Mahiru to Bara no Mahouron

Five years ago, Mahiru's best friend Yukinojou stole her magical powers, leading her to Heliogabalus, a special magic academy at the forefront of magical research.

title: Sanzu no Kawa de Zarigani Tsuttemita.
title_english: I Tried Crayfish Fishing at the Sanzu River
title_japanese: 三途の川でザリガニ釣ってみた。
synopsis:
Tsugumi spends day after day being run ragged by work. One day, she’s involved in a traffic accident, and when she comes to, she finds herself at the Sanzu River. There, a mysterious child named "Hanako" invites her to go crayfish fishing...!?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Adopting the Hero Changed the Genre
title_english: Adopting the Hero Changed the Genre
synopsis:
Nobody understands why the wicked Belinda Blanche is giving special treatment to her child servant. They don't realize she's actually from the modern world, and her servant's the hero of her favorite childcare game! All Belinda wants is to give the hero the love he deserves, but the game keeps twisting her words to make her sound like a third-rate villain. Can Belinda beat the game and figure out how to fangirl without saying a single kind word? Or will she be forced to play the bad guy forever?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: I Became the Magic Civil Servant in Isekai
title_english: I Became the Magic Civil Servant in Isekai
synopsis:
After casting a spell to posthumously fix his mana growth in a previous life, Seonal Hae now works at the Special Department of Different Species' Civil Affairs. He now uses his powerful new magical abilities to help anyone who has been maligned because of who they are... even if they're a medusa, centaur, or vampire!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Reborn as the Forsaken Baby Princess
title_english: Reborn as the Forsaken Baby Princess
synopsis:
Killed by her most trusted comrade, Assassin Agent Black is reborn as the baby princess of a historical novel. Immediately, she faces repeated assassination attempts and is even forsaken by the king when he refuses to give her a name, but she won't let anyone get her this time. As she uses her assassin skills to survive, she starts making allies, saves the prince's life, and even catches the king's interest. But with a target still on her, will that be enough to keep this little princess alive?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Summer's Destiny
synopsis:
Seungjo and Seohee grew up like family in the quiet town of Haeyoung. That is until 6 years ago, when he told her he likes her—but not as a sister—and then left when she hesitated. Now he's back, no longer a boy but a grown man. And he's done holding back.

(Source: Manta)

title: A Night of Deception
synopsis:
Yooju is forced to steal her twin sister's identity and enter a marriage of convenience. But Seunghan Do, the chaebol heir she's meant to deceive, sees through her charade from the very beginning. Instead of exposing her, he finds himself enthralled by her dangerous game.

(Source: Manta)

title: Tantei Reijou Julia Moriarty: Seibetsu mo Mibun mo Kawarimashita ga, Tenseisaki demo Tanteigyou Saikai shimasu

​How could this happen? While grappling with this mystery, Julia uses the power of "Retrocognition" (seeing the past) to confront various incidents as a detective lady. An isekai reincarnation mystery featuring a detective-turned-noblewoman officially begins!

Girls living at the bottom of the world. Their "everyday life" slowly begins to sparkle.

The protagonist, Towa, once died and was reincarnated into another world.

However, in that world, Towa sacrificed himself to protect his friends and died again... and then, he was reincarnated into the same world once more.

When they were kids, Haruse, who just moved into the neighborhood, started talking to the introverted Kanata. Ever since then, they grew up together like brothers: Haruse as the "older brother", and Kanata as the "younger brother". However, Kanata pines and lusts for his "older brother". Kanata broods, wondering how long their pretend-play at brothers will continue...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Sun Behind the Shadows
synopsis:
Drifting through orphanages, Munyoung lives with a nameless fear and a longing he can't explain... until a black fox only he can see appears and quiets it. But once he's adopted—more like imprisoned—by the powerful Chunsung group, the fox disappears. Years later, it returns with one offer: freedom, for a price.

(Source: Manta)

title: Come and Take It
synopsis:
Kang Jae-Hyuk was mesmerized the first time he heard Hajin play violin. He was so invested in Hajin's continued growth that he even sponsored him through his cultural foundation. As soon as Hajin hit twenty, however, he confessed his feelings for Jae-Hyuk and disappeared. Seven years later, the two reunite, but Jae-Hyuk is heartbroken to find that Hajin's love for violin has completely vanished.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Talisman
synopsis:
At a remarkably young age, Choi Mujin has already ascended to the prestigious position of second-in-command within the notorious national syndicate, 'Weolha Organization.' While he is a figure of intense envy and admiration among his subordinates, Mujin carries a burden no one else suspects, a hidden, degrading mission assigned by the Chairman himself. Every week under the cover of darkness, he is sent to extract semen from Baek Wuyeon, the Chairman's secluded "human talisman" kept hidden away from the world.

Inside the suffocating luxury of a high-end penthouse, the command is always the same: "Suck it." The moment Wuyeon's lips part, Mujin's autonomy vanishes entirely. Faced with an order he is powerless to refuse, Mujin finds himself trapped in a cycle of duty and desire. Can he successfully carry out his visceral task tonight, or will the weight of this secret finally break him?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Suisei
synopsis:
Two twin girls, abandoned on the doorstep of an orphanage. Identical in appearance, yet one blessed with a beautiful voice, the other cursed with an unpleasant one. That single difference would come to shape their lives in vastly different ways. A bildungsroman that stares straight at those standing at the edge of despair!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Mahou Shoujo Hibari Blood
title_japanese: 魔法傷女ひばりブラッド
synopsis:
In a Japan infested with monsters, an academy was established to train Magical Girls as a countermeasure. A monster named Girlande infiltrates the school as a teacher under the alias Eiji Asagi. Everything seemed to be going smoothly until he caught the eye of a certain Magical Girl.

Her name is Hibari Hinagi. It turns out they met ten years ago, and despite being a Magical Girl, she has become a "yandere" who is fanatically obsessed with Girlande (Eiji)! After she offers her cooperation, Eiji decides to take her along on his missions. However, this Magical Girl turns out to be a total klutz...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kaijoshi Kanna no Majutsuroku
title_english: Kanna the Unbinder: Memoir of Magic
title_japanese: 解除師カンナの魔術録
synopsis:
A hundred years ago, a single magician suddenly appeared and bestowed magic upon the people.

In a world where life has been dramatically enriched, there is a girl named Haru who despises the magic that brought misfortune to her own family. The person she encounters is Kanna, a Dispeller who can undo the magic that is the symbol of human progress and is feared as a heretic by the world. Their meeting sets in motion the judgment of the sins arbored by the greedy magicians.

An epic fantasy saga that exposes the truth of magical society!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Ashita mo Ii Hi de Arimasu You ni. Isekai de Atarashii Kazoku ga Dekimashita: 3 Kyoudai no Hokkori Gohan Nikki

synopsis:
Three brothers—Yuito, Haruto, and Yuuma—lost their mother in a traffic accident and were taken in by their father (who lived apart from her), spending their days enduring unreasonable violence. Just when they were on the verge of despair, given no proper meals and having no relatives to rely on—they were caught in a landslide and all three were reincarnated together into an isekai. A passing adventurer, Thomas, protected the three who had collapsed by the roadside, and together with his wife Olivia, who runs the eatery "Olive Tree," they welcomed the three as a "new family"... A warm isekai slow life spun by the beloved three brothers begins!

(Source: Earth Star Entertainment, translated)

title: Devituber!! Tsukishiro Arka wa VTuber de Maou wo Mezasu!
title_japanese: でびちゅーばー!!～月城アルカはVtuberで魔王を目指す!～
synopsis:
In the year 20XX, the VTuber culture that was all the rage in Japan has also become a big hit in the demon world. Demons use avatars to hide their real identities, and while streaming in the human world, they steal the 'souls' from their subscribers bit by bit. Arka Tsukishiro is a total newbie among these demon VTubers... and she has only reached double-digit subscribers. But, her dream is to become a great demon VTuber! So, how will it go...!?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Zunou to Inou ni Kinniku de Shouri suru Death Game: Zunousen ni Maiorita Saikyou no Baka

A murder game where one should use their bestowed supernatural powers and strategies to kill other participants and grant their own wishes... Or so it was supposed to be, but a "Muscle-brained" idiot, Tsuyoshi Kabajiima, who rips off the fastened collar and smashes through the closed iron door, has wandered in, causing the game to completely collapse!? The strongest death game tale, unpredictable even for the demon, begins here!!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

But the Demon Lord seems to have a secret he won't tell Komako...?

title: Saikyou Saiaku no Ura Boss, Tenseisha to Tomo ni Hametsu Flag Kaihi wo Mezasu

Schneizel, the second son of the prestigious Arclight family, is exiled after it's discovered he has dark magic. This event sets him on a journey to find the Evil God and demand to know why dark magic is so despised.

But Schneizel has a secret: another personality named Sanada has been living inside him since childhood, and he's taken over! According to Sanada, if things continue as they are, Schneizel is destined to become the "strongest and most evil final boss" and be destroyed.

To break this desperate death flag, Schneizel's fight has begun!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Totsunyuu Sakusen: Kiss ga Night

A man and woman are swept up in the romantic atmosphere of the gorgeous party they're attending. Surrendering themselves to the mood, their lips almost touch when... they quickly break away in panic. The two of them are actually undercover officers, and the key to the success of the operation is the moment they share a kiss...! A secret mission like never before is about to begin!

Kiminaga Oriomi, a struggling student, gets caught working a part-time job in violation of school rules. To avoid expulsion, he's assigned to serve as a housekeeper at the residence of the school's chairman. But there's a catch—the Kichijoji household is home to four breathtakingly talented and beautiful sisters who captivate everyone around them!

Kikuri, the eldest, is a renowned artist and VTuber. Ranka, the second sister, is a wildly popular streamer. Meru, the third, is a pro gamer. And Chinana, the youngest, is a genius voice actress. But despite their talents, their home life is a chaotic whirlwind—takeout meals, scattered laundry, and somehow ending up in Orimi's bed!?

As Oriomi navigates the sisters' unfiltered personalities and earns their trust with his housekeeping prowess, a mysterious message arrives: "You'll choose me again this time, right?"

Under one roof, a fateful story begins to u

synopsis:
Yun Bom is a shy and overworked high school ethics teacher who's assigned to the most avoided class at Shinsu High School. The cause of its reputation is Seon Jaegyu, a confrontational guardian who terrifies the faculty. Yet as Bom gets to know him, she discovers a devoted uncle with an unexpectedly tender heart. Though Bom tries to keep her distance when Jaegyu openly pursues her, she soon finds herself hopelessly falling for this quirky but charming giant of a man.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Ground Under

A wasteland overrun by giant crows. Sickchick, a girl who lives in this wasteland, while collecting feathers from the crows, she meets a group of hunters who have lost their way, wandering. They ask her to show them the way. Sickchick joins their group, and becomes embroiled in a conspiracy over natural resources hidden in the wasteland...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Akuyaku Reisoku, Suki na Hito wo Kane de Kau

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Shokugoku
synopsis:
After a passenger ship sinks, several adults and one child wash ashore near an abandoned lighthouse. Cut off from civilization, they struggle to survive as their situation becomes increasingly dire. As violence and taboo choices emerge, the survivors are pushed past moral limits. Through the fundamental act of "eating," the story explores what it truly means to be human when survival is no longer guaranteed.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Michi ni Slime ga Suterareteita kara Tsurete Kaerimashita: Ojisan to Slime no Honobono Bouken Life

title: Love Chain Love Gene

synopsis:
Manami, a university student, approaches Kouichirou, a science graduate student as well as his older sister's arranged marriage candidate, to gauge his character for her shy sister. But, his impression is absolutely terrible! However, on a rainy day, they unexpectedly meet again...! This is a frustrating, but heart-fluttering love story between Manami, the bold Dom who charges headfirst into love, and Kouichirou, the ideal bachelor with an ironclad wall.

(Source: Kobunsha, translated)

title: Ore no Koto wo Yoku Shitte kara Mono wo Ie!
title_japanese: 俺のコトをよく知ってからモノを言え!
synopsis:
Fujigaya is an out-and-proud gay man who's never failed at conquering anyone he set his eye on... Until his latest goal, the stoic hottie Tsuzuki, refuses him! Will Fujigaya win over his ideal man? Or will his ideal man win him over!?

(Source: MU)

title: The Final Case
synopsis:
Late-stage cancer. 3 months to live. How will retired detective Kang Insu make the most of it? When seeing the death-row convicts he arrested all escape from a prison van, he finds his answer: finish the job. It's something he could never do as an officer, but the law didn't do its duty. The problem is all the escaped convicts are moving far too swiftly for it to be a coincidence. They have someone behind the scenes giving them a helping. And this someone also has Insu's daughter in their sights

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Observing My Mom's Friend's Son
synopsis:
Lim Se-i spends time with her mother, Hyejeong, at Taeseung Mall, where they meet Myeonghyeon, the mall's CEO. Myeonghyeon asks Se-i to tutor her son, Seunghyo. However, Se-i accidentally walks in on Seungju, Seunghyo's older brother, naked. Seungju accuses Se-i of being a pervert, but Myeonghyeon doesn't believe him. Seungju insists Se-i is the only one who has seen him naked, and Myeonghyeon, confused, wonders if Seungju might be gay. Concerned, Myeonghyeon asks Se-i to investigate Seungju for three months. Will Se-i uncover the truth?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Non Tua
synopsis:
Vibia has served as a Vestal Virgin since childhood, sworn to chastity and charged with guarding the sacred flame of Vesta. Breaking her vow means death. Her ordered life collapses when she is pulled into the lethal intrigues of Emperor Domitian's court. Behind its beauty and splendor lurks Julia, charming and dangerously manipulative. Drawn into a tense triangle with the mysterious freedman Leonides and the hardened centurion Quintus Sirius Aquila, Vibia must navigate a treacherous landscape where her vows of purity become political weapons, her every action is watched, and one misstep could mean death in the clash between holiness and the corrupting force of imperial power.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Buyotopia
synopsis: Unable to defeat the Demon King, former hero Beyond ended up flooding the world with "blobs." Guilt-ridden, he shut himself away for years—until a turning point finally arrives...!! An over-the-top "Hero vs. Society Life" comedy.

title: Game Sekai Tensei "Dankatsu": Gamer wa "Dungeon Shuukatsu no Susume" wo "Hajime kara" Play suru
title_english: Reincarnation in the Game World Dankatsu: Game Addict Plays "Encouragement for Job Hunting in Dungeons" from a "New Game"
title_japanese: ゲーム世界転生〈ダン活〉～ゲーマーは【ダンジョン就活のススメ】を〈はじめから〉プレイする～

A legendary god-tier game, "Dungeon Job Hunting Recommendation," aka "DanKatsu," features an unprecedented 1,021 playable job classes and over 400 different endings! The more you play, the stronger you become, unlocking new abilities and rare items.

One dedicated gamer (PN: Zephyrus) finds himself reincarnated as the protagonist of this very game! Overjoyed at the chance to experience it in real life, he immediately enrolls in the Labyrinth Academy—the game's main stage. Armed with his extensive knowledge of the game's mechanics, he aims to obtain the ultimate class: Hero.

Not only that, but he also guides his timid childhood friend toward the Alchemist class, allowing the two of them to breeze through the academy's curriculum and rapidly level up! Powerful jobs, legendary loot, and epic rewards—secured at lightning speed!

(Source: TO Books, translated)

title: Gal to Couture: Ariake Momo wa Fuku wo Tsukutte Yuushou suru Koto ni Shita
title_japanese: ギャルとクチュール～有明モモは服を作って優勝することにした～
synopsis:
The story is based on the Fashion Koshien (National High School Fashion Design Championship) held in Hirosaki, Aomori Prefecture. Momo Ariake, a gal who grew up in a snowy region, meets Ren Ujou, a boy her age who aspires to be a designer, and they try their hand at making clothes to express the "cute" that only they can find inside of themselves. Momo and Ren then team up to aim to win the Fashion Koshien.

(Source: Comic Natalie, translated)

title: I'm a Homebody, but I Transmigrated Into a Dark Captivity Novel
title_english: I'm a Homebody, but I Transmigrated Into a Dark Captivity Novel
synopsis:
After dying from overwork, a woman is reincarnated as April Salt, a minor character forced to serve the demanding princess. Doomed to another life of endless labor, her fate changes when she is accidentally kidnapped by the undeniably handsome Grand Duke Kaian Braille. Instead of dying again, she is confined in luxury, with every need met. What should be a prison starts feeling like paradise. If only everyone would stop bothering her and let her do nothing!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The White Tiger Princess Is Safe
title_english: The White Tiger Princess Is Safe
synopsis:
From the moment Princess Juciellia Brianna Panterin was born, she was surrounded by expectations. As the first white tiger beastkin to be born in a hundred years, she is destined to save the world from destruction. Despite growing up adored by many, Juciellia struggles with her powers and fears she may not grow strong enough to protect her loved ones. With time slipping by and calamity drawing near, will the White Tiger Princess rise to meet the hopes of all before it's too late?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: To Steal a Thief's Heart
synopsis:
In Eden City, no one slips through the shadows quite like Gemma Steele, the infamous jewel thief. So when the determined Inspector Raven Hunt finally catches her, she expects a jail cell, not a proposal. But Raven needs her skills to retrieve a priceless royal gem, and a fake marriage is the perfect cover. Now, the city's most wanted thief and its most straightlaced officer must team up to play newlyweds. Can Gemma and Raven pull off their act without getting caught in each other's feelings?

(Source: Tapas Media)

synopsis:
In the decadent 90s, Yuki Ogihara has lived an unremarkable youth while harboring a secret love for delinquent girl Saiko Samejima. Yuki's intense longing sometimes manifests as licentious self-gratification, eventually evolving into fantasies of "being defiled together with Samejima." When Yuki hears rumors that "Samejima will sleep with anyone for money," she becomes consumed by jealousy—desperate to know everything about Samejima, to possess her completely. Meanwhile, Samejima finds herself torn between Yuki's idealized image of her and the reality of who she truly is.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Ossan Boukensha no Okureta Eiyuutan: Kansha no Suburi wo 1-nichi 1-mankai shiteitara, Kensei ga Deshiiri Shigan ni Yattekita
title_english: Old Man Adventurer's Tale of a Belated Hero
title_japanese: おっさん冒険者の遅れた英雄譚 感謝の素振りを１日１万回していたら､剣聖が弟子入り志願にやってきた
synopsis:
Guy Gullveig was abused by his half-brother because he was born as an illegitimate child. He was taken in by his grandfather, a former adventurer who lived deep in the mountains, and began training his body and mind by practicing "sword swings." Even after his grandfather passed away, Guy continued doing 10,000 practice swings every single day, and before he knew it, he had grown into a middle-aged man. One day, Guy finally leaves the mountains and heads to the city to become an adventurer, just as his grandfather once recommended. But there was one thing Guy didn't know... Thanks to the countless practice swings he had continued all this time, he had already become the strongest swordsman.

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Konya, Aether de Machiawase
title_japanese: 今夜、エーテルで待ちあわせ
synopsis:
Itsuki Kageyama, socially awkward and unable to fit in at her job, finds her one joy in life in an online game. One day, she meets Yoru, a new player, who, as they spend more time together, starts slowly changing Itsuki deep down.

title: Taoreta Fujin wo Sukutta Gohoubi wa, Musume no Bijin Futago to no Otsukiai Deshita.
title_japanese: 倒れた婦人を救ったご褒美は、娘の美人双子とのお付き合いでした。
synopsis:
Ao Kirishima encounters a collapsed woman on the street. Having learned CPR from his father, Ao rushes to her aid and does everything he can to help. Thanks to his actions, the woman survives—and her daughters turn out to be the strikingly beautiful twin sisters in his class, Yuzuki Kotobuki and Hikari Kotobuki. To express their gratitude, Yuzuki and Hikari begin searching for Ao.

“I’ll definitely make you fall for me.”

“I’ll make sure you come to like me.”

(Source: Novel Updates)

title: Gizmo Riser
synopsis:
In the towering kingdom of Urunaria, society is literally built on inequality. The wealthiest reside at the top, while the poor are confined to the dark, crumbling depths below. For Kuro, a young slave raised by his uncle in the lowest levels, life offers no future—only labor, loss, and silence. But when his uncle is executed by the state, Kuro inherits a mysterious device: Gizmo—a pair of mechanical gloves with the power to grip, scale, and defy the very system built to crush him.

Armed with nothing but this outlawed tool and his burning desire for freedom, Kuro begins his ascent, both up the tower and against a society that deems him worthless.

(Source: Titan Comics)

title: Undead-san no Bukiyou na Seishun
title_japanese: アンデッドさんの不器用な青春
synopsis:
One day after summer break, Sana Tsukuyomi, a flawless young lady, returned to school as an undead. As a school health committee member, Hiyoshi ended up helping her navigate her daily life, despite her movements being as stiff as a corpse's... A school romantic comedy featuring a heroine who's both scary and cute!

Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title: Zatsuyou Fuyo Jutsushi ga Jibun no Saikyou ni Kizuku made: Meiwaku wo Kakenai You ni Shite Kimashita ga, Tsuihou sareta node Suki ni Ikiru Koto ni Shimashita
title_english: Magical Buffs: The Support Caster Is Stronger than He Realized!
title_japanese: 雑用付与術師が自分の最強に気付くまで ～迷惑をかけないようにしてきましたが、追放されたので好きに生きることにしました～
synopsis:
Wim Strauss isn't a flashy fighter—he's a granting caster, a support mage who boosts his allies' strength in battle. His magic keeps the party alive. But when his quiet power starts to overshadow the wrong person, the team's prideful leader has him unceremoniously kicked out.

Enter his slightly clingy childhood friend Heidemarie, now a member of Nachtlibelle, a renowned A-rank guild counted among the strongest in the land. She offers Wim a chance to join her team—a fresh start among allies who actually value his skills. His magic may not dazzle, but with the right party behind him, he just might prove that the back line was never where he truly belonged.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Kiri no Prizrak
synopsis:
The nations of Erde and Morye are at war. Adam, a tank commander in the Morye army, survives against the forces of Morye and their biomechanical ant warriors thanks to his close bond with his comrade Lev. Ordered to extract information from a captive soldier from Erde due to his understanding of the language, Lev discovers an imminent assault from the dominant forces of Erde; an assault that will plunge Adam deep into the fog of war, and force him to understand the nature of his enemies...

(Source: Shufu to Seikatsu Sha, translated)

title: Boku dake Yomeru Kinsho Majutsu
title_japanese: 僕だけ詠める禁書魔術
synopsis:
Tamura, a plain and unglamorous announcer, has only one redeeming quality: he absolutely never stumbles over his scripts. Suddenly, he finds himself reincarnated into another world in the body of Phil, a boy with zero magic power. No overpowered abilities, no cheat skills—it seemed like another incredibly plain life was about to begin... until Tamura encounters a certain Forbidden Book.

Written inside is Incantation Magic, a forbidden art where biting your tongue costs you your life. Extremely long texts with a strict time limit—even this magic, deemed impossible to cast and branded taboo, can actually be chanted by Tamura, who absolutely never stumbles over a script...!?

Bite your tongue and your life is over!! An unprecedented incantation magic fantasy now begins!!

(Source: Coamix, translated)

title: Ego

synopsis:
The Sumida East High School basketball team achieves a dramatic victory in the Inter-High School Championships. While the first-year students shine, third-year student Nakano, dropped from the starting lineup just before the tournament, has mixed feelings...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Kuchidomeryou Cider
synopsis:
Fuji, the class president, was angry at Tachibana, a gal in her class who never listens to her. Because of this, Fuji decides to relieve her stress by smelling Tachibana's gym clothes, only to be interrupted by Tachibana herself during the act. How will Tachibana react, and what will Fuji do?

(Source: MU)

title: Copycat
synopsis:
A serial killer is staging corpses as "self-destruction art" and selling them to the ultra-wealthy for tens of millions. When failed artist Suchan Kim recognizes the concept as his own—stolen from an exhibition the world laughed into oblivion—his obsession with proving this mutates into something darker: a hunger for the recognition he never received. In a world where spectacle is worth more than life, will Suchan expose the killer, or become part of the masterpiece?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Sunny Surf
synopsis:
A shy woman who causes trouble at work escapes to the sea, where she faces her true self on a surfboard. A life-reset drama unfolds on cheerful waves.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Himegoe
synopsis:
Himeno is self-conscious about his high-pitched voice. Drawn to the voice of the club president, he ends up joining the broadcasting club, but he just can't seem to bring himself to reveal his real voice... A coming-of-age story about true-to-life teenagers!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Nisemono Seijo wa Unmei wo Kutsugaesu
title_english: The False Saintess Overturns Her Fate
title_japanese: ニセモノ聖女は運命をくつがえす
synopsis:
Reincarnated as Philomela, the hated character in the novel, she is doomed to die a cruel death... She has been called a fake saint, betrayed by her family and loved ones, and left with no way out. This is a fantasy of a saint who was called a fake, and whose life is turned upside down.

(Source: weavin)

title: Unlocking a Comfy Captivity
synopsis:
Sunwoo Yoon thought he knew who his enemies were, but when he woke up in Yihyun Choi's home after a night out, it didn't take him long to learn he was wrong. While he's angry that Sunwoo doesn't even remember him, that's not enough to change the situation.

Yihyun will have his revenge and make Sunwoo pay for ruining his life.

Now that he's being held captive, the only way out is through. As he starts to remember what they went through as kids, will his reasons for keeping Yihyun happy change?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Behold, the Tiger
synopsis:
It's Juho Doh's first day of college, and it's like an unbreakable curse has been lifted at last. After a childhood of being overlooked and ignored, he's finally starting to make friends! But attracting attention is a dangerous game when hungry ghosts start to take notice. And if running from spirits wasn't enough, there's a strange man who just can't get enough of him. Will Juho be able to live a normal life? Or will he be devoured by those closest to him?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Ore wa Mada, Honki wo Dashiteinai DX
title_japanese: 俺はまだ、本気を出していないDX
serializations: Suiyoubi wa Mattari Dash X Comic
synopsis:
Hermes is the fourth son of the Cano family. Although Hermes was said to be the downcast of his family, he was enjoying his life as an aristocrat, but by chance he inherited the family and became the head of the family!! He feared that he would no longer be able to live a leisurely life if he was expected and appreciated. He tries to hide his abilities in every situation, but...!? He is still the "strongest" head of the family, admired and respected by men who don't want him to be serious!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title: Whose Poo Is This?
synopsis:
Join Dr. Egg, Dr. Yang, and Dr. Woong as they study animals, explore the natural world, and solve mysteries using the incredible science of poo!

These educational graphic novels created by a trio of South Korean scientists bring the gross but fascinating world of poo right to you. Get up close and personal with lions and tigers and bears and all sorts of other animals as they do their business, and learn about them through their scat. Can you solve the poo-related mysteries before the scientists do?

(Source: Lerner Publishing Group)

Setsuka Hinon is the new cabinet minister in charge of Toilet Affairs!!!! With the goal of Standing Tall in her heart, she strives to promote women's pee-pee standing up as a kind of liberation... A cute water sport erotic comedy!

(Source: MU)

title: My Wavering Husband
synopsis:
The timing couldn't be worse. Sohui is pregnant, and her divorce from Jihyeok is already in motion. She spent three years trying to earn his love before deciding that holding on was merely a selfish dream. Now, she must protect her unborn child from a marriage that was never meant to be. Or was it? As Jihyeok faces the crushing void left by the divorce, his own family moves to sabotage his position at the company. Between corporate traps and a secret that could change everything, what is in store for this star-crossed couple?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Suterare Seijo no Isekai Gohan Tabi: Kakure Skill de Camping Car wo Shoukan shimashita

synopsis:
Rin Takanashi, a caregiver in her thirties, was unceremoniously discarded as "trash" despite being summoned as a saint.

However, as a lover of the great outdoors and all things camping, she was blessed with a special skill, [Survival], as well as another unique skill! Thus, a riveting tale begins: one of sweat, tears, and insatiable hunger as Rin, together with companions she picked up along the way, leisurely explores this parallel world and savors gourmet cuisine to her heart's content...

Or so the story should have gone, but it looks like their road is going in an unexpected direction...?

(Source: MU)

synopsis:
A man with the power to "read" the gods, Miyato, and his younger brother, Kujiki. Their unusual journey leads them to a village abound in rumors that a sacred beast, the Arahabaki, has been devouring humans...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Haru no Uta
synopsis:
Midori Okamoto is assigned the task of observing fellow student Haruo Shimura, who rarely ever comes to school. Intertwining herself with him and his younger brother, she soon finds out they can hear the voice of plants.

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Koganei Kyoudai no Kyuusoku
synopsis:
Older brother Arata, an otaku, and younger sister Hana, a gal, live together in the suburbs. Arata is taking time off of work due to mental illness, and feels guilty staying in his room all day doing nothing. Hana keeps telling him it's okay to do nothing, but also takes him places. Sunbathing, nighttime strolls, the beauty parlor... An unexpected summer break has arrived for the two siblings!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

synopsis: An anthology about obsessive love.

title: Ura Tokyo no Osoroshidokoro
title_japanese: 裏東京のオソロシドコロ
synopsis:
Beneath Tokyo lies "Ura-Tokyo," a shadowed counterpart to the city we think we know. There, a secret academy trains exorcists to battle evil spirits. After entering the forbidden grove of Madara Shirazunomori Forest, Soma Kuroniwa is cursed to harbor a spirit of exceptional danger. Hiding his true nature, he enrolls in the academy and throws himself into its brutal training program—one with a graduation rate of only a few percent. When a powerful spirit draws near, the inhuman force sleeping inside him awakens. An action-driven exorcist academy story set in a dark, immersive world.

(Source: Kodansha)

title: Maid & Roid wa Ojousama no Oyaku ni Tachitai!
