title: Fujisan Daifunka: Senryokugai Nitei sareta Ossan Kaishain Mochizane ga Tenpen Chii de Nariagari!?
title_japanese: 富士山大噴火～戦力外認定されたおっさん会社員モチザネが天変地異で成り上がり!?～
synopsis:
"The world might as well just turn upside down," thinks Mochizane, a salaryman who despite his earnest dedication to his job, spends his days being belittled by juniors from other departments and struggling to keep up with an endless mountain of work. In the midst of these exhausting days, Mochizane makes a mistake at work and is forced to head to Gotenba City at the foot of Mount Fuji with his boss. Just as he reaches his breaking point and decides to quit his company, something unthinkable happens...!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Fuguu Skill no Shien Madoushi: Party wo Tsuihou sareta kedo, Chokugo no Skill Update de Shin no Chikara ni Mezamete Saikyou ni Natta
title_english: The Supporting Enchanter of Desperate Skill
title_japanese: 不遇スキルの支援魔導士 ～パーティーを追放されたけど、直後のスキルアップデートで真の力に目覚めて最強になった～
synopsis:
"In this world, Skills determine your future."

Yota is a support mage with only one support skill that is widely unpopular. In a profession where it was difficult to raise your level, Yota even was slower than the others. As a result, the difference in his ability and his friends gradually widens, and finally, the leader, Laguiole, expels him from the party. But what they didn't know was that Yota's skill wasn't just support magic. It was the one and only strongest skill... This is the success story of one support mage who was unlucky.

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

title: Kaitei Seisounin Matataburris
title_japanese: 海底清掃人マタタビュリス

title: Xiao Huli Hua Xing Ji
synopsis:
A little fox, foraging in the wilderness, nearly fell into a trap but was rescued by its sister, a white fox. The white fox was a fox spirit who had cultivated for hundreds of years, skilled in transformation magic. The little fox followed her to learn the art, transforming into a beautiful woman to infiltrate the human world and marry a human. The transformation magic required understanding a human's thoughts and becoming the person they desired. Each successful transformation brought it one closer to becoming a nine-tailed fox.

"Only by becoming a woman, finding true love, and gaining more affections can you grow a tail," the sister's warning still echoed in its ears, yet the little fox repeatedly faced setbacks. By chance, the little fox transformed into the appearance of the deceased young master of the Qi family, embarking on a career in government, and unexpectedly discovered a shortcut to cultivation...

(Source: New Star Press, translated)

title: Ojousama-kei Teihen Dungeon Haishinsha, Meiwaku-kei wo Bokottara Bazutte Densetsu ni Nattemasu wa!?
title_japanese: お嬢様系底辺ダンジョン配信者、迷惑系をボコったらバズって伝説になってますわ!?
synopsis:
"Don't you feel ashamed in front of your mother, who spread her legs to give birth to you!?"

Several decades have passed since dungeons appeared all over the world. As dungeon streaming, broadcasting exploration footage, gained popularity, ojousama streamer Karin Yamada finds herself downcast over her rock-bottom status: zero viewers and only three subscribers. One day, Karin encounters a nuisance streamer trying to broadcast himself blowing up a dungeon wall. After thoroughly beating up this guy, who's secretly the strongest rising star, Karin goes viral as the Delinquent Ojousama...!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Uchikomori Tsuma wa Cosplay Haishinsha
title_japanese: うちこもり妻はコスプレ配信者

title: Time Is a Closet
title_japanese: タイムイズアクローゼット
synopsis:
This charming yuri manga follows two time travelers with an eye for fashion, journeying across eras in search of the most beautiful garments history has to offer. From forgotten wardrobes to dazzling period couture, their adventures weave together style, history, and a budding romance.

(Source: Crossed Hearts)

title: Futari de Afternoon Tea wo
title_japanese: ふたりでアフタヌーンティーを
synopsis:
This soft, heartwarming yuri follows Mitsuruko, a refined yet endearingly absent-minded young lady, and Ritsu, a practical vocational student newly arrived in Tokyo. What begins as a simple living arrangement soon unfolds into a companionship, shaped by shared laughter, chaos, and the charming ritual of afternoon tea.

A story where the smallest moments linger the longest, and where a single shared cup of tea can begin to feel like home.

(Source: Crossed Hearts)

title: The Reborn Prodigy of the Ducal Family
title_english: The Reborn Prodigy of the Ducal Family
synopsis:
Once the commander-in-chief of Earth's resistance and a legendary monster hunter, Hanseong was dragged into another world and enslaved by the Empire through a binding spell. For ten long years, he fought their wars, crushed their enemies, and was discarded like a weapon. But death wasn't his end. Revived by the Stone of Reincarnation, he awakens as Dale, the heir to a powerful ducal house. With unmatched brilliance and a burning desire for revenge, Hanseong begins his second life to destroy the Empire that once enslaved him.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Youkya ni Natta Ore no Seishun Shijou Shugi
title_japanese: 陽キャになった俺の青春至上主義
synopsis:
There are two kinds of people in this world: the popular extroverts and the gloomy introverts. If you want to make the most of your limited youth, there's only one path you should choose. In other words, if you want to be popular, become an extrovert.

Kyouta Ueda, once a former introvert, reinvented himself through sheer effort and determination when he entered high school. Now, surrounded by popular kids, his school life is going smoothly. All that's left is to get himself a gal girlfriend and everything will be perfect, yet for some reason, the romantic flags keep popping up only with introverted girls...!?

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title: Mamonotsukai no Musume
synopsis:
Veteran adventurer Hakura has overcome countless trials, but his latest fight with a deadly hydra nearly costs him his life. In the nick of time, he is saved by an intriguing young lady named Leen, who, to his surprise, possesses the rare ability to tame any and all monsters! Now indebted to this unscrupulous monstermancer, Hakura decides to join her in her travels, the two of them arguing and bickering every step of the way. What has drawn them together, and what adventures await this unlikely pair?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Shuraba no One Side Love
title_japanese: 修羅場のワンサイドラブ
synopsis:
The hit manga artist Kaede and his editor Eiji are childhood friends of 19 years.

As a talented and successful editor, Eiji's biggest concern is how clingy Kaede can be! Even during the busiest times right before a deadline, Kaede would rather wrap his arms around Eiji than get pages drawn. Even in their private lives, Eiji plays along to go on little dates with Kaede in place of Kaede's ex.

Little does the naive Eiji know, Kaede is trying to push his way into his life in hopes of become something even more...

(Source: Tokyopop, edited)

title: Kamisama Sakka wa Ai wo Tsuzuru
title_english: If I Could Write My Love Into You
synopsis:
Tsubaki's "duty" is to support the protective god, Shigure, in both his private life and his public job. Shigure is not just a god, but is also making a living as an author, and Tsubaki is a huge fan of his work.

However, one of Tsubaki's duties is to offer his "devotion" to his god...the only small, tiny problem is that this little ritual always leaves Tsubaki reeling. His pulse races, his breathing gets labored...and his whole body heats up!

Tsubaki is struggling just to keep both his excitement and this growing crush a secret, but things never seem to go his way...

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Haru ni Nagu Ao
synopsis:
"They're so blue and clear. They look like they're shimmering." He was the only person who would describe the eyes Souwa hates so much like that.

Souwa doesn't have any friends. His sharp, cold eyes attracted only delinquents to his side. He lives his days filled with fighting, tussling, and pain. But one day, the basketball club's vice-captain, Kyoushirou, approaches him. The dependable, popular, and all-smiles senpai is the direct opposite of everything Souwa is. He tries everything to avoid the glowing beam of sunlight that is Kyoushirou, but...

The caring, handsome senpai x the aloof and clumsy lone-wolf kouhai.

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Nekokke to Akuheki
synopsis:
When he drinks, he ends up wailing in tears or kissing the first person he sees... Kai Hoshino is a terrible drunk.

When Kai decided to become a hairdresser, just like the man who changed his life, this newbie stylist finally lands a job at the same salon as his idol, Sena!

Although Sena was sweet and kind to Kai when he was a customer, working-Sena is anything but! He is mean, orders Kai around, and is a total jerk. Talk about being disillusioned!

But before the shock even had time to settle, Kai is invited to a welcome party, where he meets his worst enemy...alcohol. Knowing his horrible drinking habits, Kai tries to avoid drinking too much, but nothing seems to go poor Kai's way.

When a tad too much alcohol leaves Kai a bumbling, rambling mess, Sena sees a new, much cuter side to the newbie. The heat turns up as the spice grows stronger... Will Kai's bad habits send him deeper into even more trouble with this handsome hairdresser?

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Kimi wa Akumade Tomodachi desu!
title_japanese: 君はあくまで友達です!
synopsis:
The game of push and pull between an arrogant demon and a meek, gloomy boy!

Raine gets overly obsessed with the things he loves. As a result, he doesn't have even a single friend! But that's not a problem for our little Raine! If he doesn't have any friends, he'll just have to make them.

Raine's idea is to summon a cute little demon to be friends with! But what appears is something far from cute...a large, sturdy build and an arrogance that matches his grand stature...the demon, Luchatra! If he doesn't fulfill his contract—to become friends with this human—he'll be sent straight back to the demon realm. 

But unfortunately, our cocky demon doesn't know the first thing about being friends...so he jumps to the only thing he knows—kissing and touching the innocent Raine!

Will Raine finally make his first friend? Or will the demon he summoned actually end up being something even more?

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Kyoudai desu ga Isekai de Kekkon shimashita.
title_japanese: 兄妹ですが異世界で結婚しました。
synopsis:
When a brother and sister who love one another dearly elope, they end up getting teleported to another world!? In that other world is an autonomously governed region where other similarly teleported people live.The siblings are told that they can get married there without persecution, so...?

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title: Moshne Project
title_japanese: モシュネプロジェクト
synopsis:
Miyabi, a factory worker, gets a surprise visit from an alien named Moshne. Will Moshne's ability to copy anything unleash a great calamity on the Earth?! Find out in this neo-alien story!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Botsuraku Yotei no Kizoku dakedo, Hima Datta kara Mahou wo Kiwametemita: Chris wa Goshujinsama ga Daisuki!
title_english: I Am a Noble About to Be Ruined, But Reached the Summit of Magic Because I Had a Lot of Free Time. Chris Loves His Master!
title_japanese: 没落予定の貴族だけど、暇だったから魔法を極めてみた～クリスはご主人様が大好き!～
synopsis:
Chris-chan, a young werewolf girl, is always busy under the care of her beloved master, Liam-kun! She works for the country alongside Lord Shenlong and other familiars, swims in the sea, explores mountains, takes baths, and even naps! Every day is filled with joyous activities. Today, as she snuggles up to her master's lap, she can't decide what to play next. Join Chris-chan in her fluffy and delightful everyday life.

(Source: TO Books, translated)

title: Botsuraku Yotei no Kizoku dakedo, Hima Datta kara Mahou wo Kiwametemita: Jodi wa Liam-kun wo Oshitai shiteimasu
title_english: I Am a Noble About to Be Ruined, But Reached the Summit of Magic Because I Had a Lot of Free Time. Jodie Adores Liam
title_japanese: 没落予定の貴族だけど、暇だったから魔法を極めてみた～ジョディはリアムくんをお慕いしています～

title: Datenshi Koumori-kun no Junai
title_english: The Pure Love of the Fallen Angel Komori-kun
title_japanese: 堕天使コウモリくんの純愛

title: Renkinjutsushi no Yurufuwa Ritou Kaitakuki
title_japanese: 錬金術師のゆるふわ離島開拓記
synopsis:
No one can deny that Freya is a prodigy. And this genius has high hopes for her life after graduation, hopefully working in a wonderful workshop in a bustling city. So naturally, she gets assigned to a backwater island far to the south instead! The local guardian deity is a mythical beast named Lilil who deplores the awful state the island is in. Lilil asks Freya to develop the island with the help of alchemy, and Freya just can't turn down fluffiness! Freia quickly gets to work and creates high-quality potions, a box that produces cool air, and more amazing magic tools. And that's just the start for this genius alchemist's plans!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Gunrou ni Hana
synopsis:
Yuri, a first-year high school student, finally enrolls at Hibari Technical High School with the dream of someday building "a really cool bike." But on the very first day, she gets dragged into the fight of one of the four notorious second-year troublemakers, Roa Akamatsu...! What's more, Yuri seems to be hiding something...! A coming-of-age romance about a tomboy heroine who gets tangled up with four boys with sketchy reputations!!

(Source: Kodansha)

title: E? Guild-nai de Yuiitsu "Cook" wo Kiwameteru Ore wo Kubi desu ka? @comic
title_japanese: え? ギルド内で唯一【コック】を極めてる俺をクビですか?@COMIC

title: Yandere Kakusei!! Suterareta Reijou wa Saikyou Koushaku ni Gekiomo Attack-chuu!
title_japanese: ヤンデレ覚醒!!捨てられた令嬢は最恐侯爵に激重アタック中!
synopsis:
On top of being discarded by everyone, Lady Imina has been betrothed to the cruel and terrifying Marquis Oscar. During their first meeting he suddenly draws a sword on her.... and yet Imina somehow falls in love at first sight!?

"So this... is what it means to love somebody♥"

The supposedly cold-hearted marquis is left flustered!? The strongest yandere's overwhelming love is about to explode...!!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Shoujo wo Karu Mura
synopsis:
1-3. Ryoshuu no Mura (Village of Prisoners)
4. Natsu no Hi
5. Kanojo ni Shitagi wo Todoketara

title: Not Your Ordinary Dad
title_japanese: 검은 머리 아빠는 거두는 게 아니다
synopsis:
As the sole princess of the empire, Vishnahel had her life all planned out until she was brutally executed. Thanks to her family's ancestral god, she's sent back in time... to live as her 5-year-old self! In order to restore glory to the empire, she must raise hell, team up with her new adopted father (whom she met in prison), and gather the most unlikely allies. With this first-time dad under her thumb, she's about to prove that sometimes the best way to win is to break all the rules!

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: I Became a Swordsmanship Instructor at the Academy
title_english: I Became a Swordsmanship Instructor at the Academy
synopsis:
When a failing web novelist drops dead at his desk, he's granted a wish in the underworld... and uses it to enter a novel. But instead of becoming the main character, he possesses Kang Shinhyuk, a total extra! Now set to be the protagonist's future teacher, Shinhyuk's out to use what he knows of the original plot to borrow the hero's power-ups for an easy, carefree life. But in a world of monsters and danger, can Shinhyuk really rest easy? Or will he be made to buckle down and hustle once more?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Bratty Lady Throws a Tantrum
title_english: The Bratty Lady Throws a Tantrum
synopsis:
Duke Heros Archeon slays the black dragon Sellus, thus freeing the world from calamity—or so he thinks. But then, Sellus transmigrates into the body of Daphne Archeon, the duke's cruel, petulant daughter, and somehow... this improves the girl's personality?! Sellus takes over Daphne's life and vows to train her body until she's strong enough to kill her father. However, when dark mages threaten her family and kingdom, a feeling of righteous responsibility flares in her bratty little heart.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Avengers: Electric Rain
synopsis:
A building inexplicably animates in Seoul, catching the attention of local superhero White Fox. Meanwhile, Hawkeye goes missing on a solo mission to an island in the Yellow Sea. And the rain in Seoul simply won't stop. The Avengers are bound for South Korea, and they're going to find trouble when they get there.

(Source: Namu wiki, translated)

title: Part Two of This Failed Fantasy Novel Begins
title_english: Part Two of This Failed Fantasy Novel Begins
synopsis:
I transmigrated into a novel, slayed the Demon King, and died—mission complete, right? I can go back to reality, right? Wrong! Turns out this flop story has a second part! Five years after I saved the day, I've reawakened in the same world as a haughty villainess. What's more, my old allies from Part One have all become awful people! I've got new rules and a new body, but it's still the same old mess...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: The Restless Insomniac's Release Remedy
synopsis:
After quitting her stressful job, Yeonha thought she'd finally escape her sleepless nights—but insomnia still haunts her. The only cure? Seongbin, the boy next door she's known since childhood. Only now, he's not so little anymore, and a single unexpected encounter might keep her up even more for entirely different reasons. Maybe the answer to this insomniac's prayers has been standing right in front of her all along. Will Yeonha finally find her sweet release, or be left counting sheep forever?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: When Spring Comes
synopsis:
Bom is trying to move on from her first love by focusing on work and her budding new relationship with her friend, Dongwook. But something seems... off. She can't seem to give him her heart. When her ex, Joonyoung, suddenly comes back into her life, the cracks truly begin to show. Dongwook's affection warps into obsession. But just as Bom starts to question how things ended up like this, a mysterious camera arrives on her doorstep with the promise of magical snapshots that will reveal the truth.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Kaifuku Mahou wo Kiwametara Bukkoware Seinou ni Natta. Mekake no Ko to Hakugai sareru node Jikka ni Tayorazu Ikiteiku!
title_japanese: 回復魔法を極めたらぶっ壊れ性能になった。妾の子と迫害されるので実家に頼らず生きていく!

title: Hirotta Dorei-tachi ga Tabidatte Haya Juunen, Nazeka Ore ga Densetsu ni Natteita @comic
title_japanese: 拾った奴隷たちが旅立って早十年、なぜか俺が伝説になっていた@COMIC

title: Itsuka Ojousama ni Naritai Kei Dungeon Haishinsha ga Honmono no Ojousama ni Naru made
title_japanese: いつかお嬢様になりたい系ダンジョン配信者が本物のお嬢様になるまで
synopsis:
Karona Rindouji has a dream: to earn 100 million yen and become the refined lady she's always admired!

Decades have passed since "Dungeon Disasters" began, where internet thought-noise invades the real world and forms dungeons. To prevent these disasters, the government created "Battle Cast Dungeon Alive," a national VR dungeon game. Clearing dungeons in the game earns rewards, but HP equals real money, so damage taken results in a loss. "Dungeon Streaming," where players broadcast their attempts, has become popular...

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

title: Ichijou Hanao wa Koi wo Shiranai
title_japanese: 一条華緒は恋を知らない
synopsis:
Hanao Ichijou, is a second-year high school student attending an elite girls' school. She is planning to marry someone her parents have arranged for her after graduation, but no matter how many arranged meetings she goes on, nothing seems to work out. Determined to understand what love is before getting engaged, Hanao decides to try commuting by train, using a shoujo manga she read long ago as her guide. There, she has a shoujo manga-like encounter with a boy. She asks him, who seems handsome and experienced in romance, to teach her about love.

(Source: MU)

title: Wagahai wa Neko Madoushi de Aru: Kijitora Luke no Kaiteki Cheat Neko Seikatsu
title_japanese: 我輩は猫魔導師である～キジトラ・ルークの快適チート猫生活～
synopsis:
After saving a cat from being hit by a car, a young man named Kaito Negoro is reincarnated into a fantasy alternate world. However, he is now a tabby cat! This is the story of how he becomes a super-powered cat and is picked up by a young noble girl, popularizes tomatoes, and occasionally saves various people, all while striving for a life with three meals a day and a nap (he provides his own snacks)!

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)

title: Ooedo Ukiyoe Kisou Tengai
title_japanese: 大江戸浮世絵奇想天外
synopsis: An omnibus serialization about various Edo-period woodblock artists.

title: Enya-baa no Oshikatsu Nikki
title_japanese: エンヤ婆〈ばあ〉の推し活日記
synopsis: A gag spin-off starring Enya the Hag and her Stand Justice, as she looks for the next person to be her "oshi."

title: Kaitai
synopsis:
Touko Ozawa wakes up inside an unfamiliar ship. Her memory is hazy, and there is a needle mark on her arm. There, she encounters two young people, Chisato Mikanagi and Hitomi Mikami. What they have in common is that they have no memory of how they got there. Inside a ship echoing with the sounds of inhuman footsteps and the eerie cries of "Gitagido Detaderaba...", who exactly took them and for what purpose...? In search of answers, the youths begin their exploration.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Tsurizao Hitotsu de Isekai Hourou
title_english: Wandering Around Another World with Just One Fishing Rod
title_japanese: 釣り竿ひとつで異世界放浪
synopsis:
Owari Machida was a professional fisherman who made a name for himself in the media, but his former glory proved short-lived, and he struggles everyday to make ends meet. One day, while out boat fishing, he gets swept away by the waves and fell into the sea, losing consciousness as he downs because of a malfunction of his life jacket. When Owari awakens, the scenery has completely changed—he finds himself in an Isekai... In this world where the culture of fishing has declined, Owari wanders around enjoying fishing with the fishing gear that transmigrated with him, while interacting with the locals...

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Dekapai Iinchou no Kuse ni Namaiki da!
title_japanese: デカパイ委員長のくせに生イキだ!

title: Deco x Deco
synopsis:
1-2. Kokonoe-senpai! Kore Kite Kudasai! (Please Wear This, Kokonoe-senpai!)
3. Little Bad Bunny
4. Wan Shot Underpuppy
5. Yes My Kitty
6. Shuchou Maid no Osewajutsu (The Care Technique of a Traveling Maid)
7. Witch Love Potion

title: Frankenstein no Sorekara
title_japanese: フランケンシュタインのそれから
synopsis:
The nameless "monster" that everyone has heard of at least once. Appearing before him, who suffers from loneliness, was a girl named Shion. She named him "Ren" and offered to help with his life. Thus begins the life of Ren, a artificial human, to imitate human... This is the story of the monster created by the famous doctor, Victor Frankenstein.

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

title: Youheidan no Itoshigo: Shinikake Koji wa Saikyou Shishou-tachi ni Sodaterareru
title_japanese: 傭兵団の愛し子 ～死にかけ孤児は最強師匠たちに育てられる～
synopsis:
Young Will is an orphan with no one to rely on. Left dying in a corner of the slums, his life is saved by chance when a passing mercenary finds him. To survive, Will asks to join the mercenary band. He's given an entrance test designed to be impossible to pass—but his talent is recognized, and he's accepted as a provisional member of the kingdom's strongest mercenary corps!? Receiving training from the band members—who are among the world's most powerful fighters—Will's extraordinary potential begins to bloom. Before he knows it, even the veteran mercenaries come to respect him—!? The ultimate growth fantasy of an unprecedented disciple raised by invincible masters!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Tatakai shika Shiranai Onna Kishi wo Amayakashi Tsuzuketa
title_japanese: 戦いしかしらない女騎士を甘やかし続けた

title: Ore no Mawari ni Kyonyuu ga Oosugiru
title_japanese: 俺の周りに巨乳が多すぎる

title: Please Give Me a Glass of Milk!
Himesama no Shitto de Youjo ni Sareta Danshaku Reijou desu: Hakkin no Kishi-sama kara no Propose!?
title_english: The Baron's Daughter's Childish Transformation: An Envious Princess's Curse and the Platinum Knight's Proposal?!
title_japanese: 姫様の嫉妬で幼女にされた男爵令嬢です～白金の騎士様からの求婚〈プロポーズ〉!?～
synopsis:
Berna, who works as a maid in the castle, is the occasional conversation partner of Dietrich, a beautiful, otherworldly young man who serves as the prince's guard. After Dietrich's marriage to the princess of the neighboring kingdom, rumored to wield dubious magic, is decided by royal command, Berna is to attend their engagement party as waitstaff. As soon as the princess shows up on the day of the party, she casts a spell on Dietrich, forcing him to propose to his true love in front of all of those in attendance. Berna who working to make sure the proposal went smoothly for Dietrich, is left speechless when he proposes to her instead! Enraged at Dietrich's actions, the princess curses Berna, turning her body into that of a little girl's! Let this love story between a common girl and a stunningly handsome knight commence!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Moto Inkya no Osananajimi ga Youkya JK-ka shite Kyori ga Chikasugiru
title_japanese: 元陰キャの幼馴染が陽キャJK化して距離が近すぎる

title: Gal Succubus ga Harem de Koyou to Ore no Junai wa Tomaranai!
title_english: Protecting my Love From a Succubus Harem
title_japanese: ギャルサキュバスがハーレムで来ようと俺の純愛は止まらない!
synopsis:
As he’s trying to summon his favorite succubus, Yusuke gets it wrong a whole three times and ends up summoning a whole harem of succubi in his house. But as they say, failure is a stepping stone to sex.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title: Tousan wa "Kensei", Kaasan wa "Kenshin", Boku wa "Ochinp〇 Chanbara Master"
title_japanese: 父さんは【剣聖】、母さんは【剣神】、僕は【おち〇ぽチャンバラマスター】

title: Koisuru Psycho no Shirayuki-kun
title_japanese: 恋するサイコの白雪くん
synopsis:
"Hey, I think I like you!" Shirayuki says with a smile. Haruki endures relentless bullying from a trio of classmates. One day, a beautiful transfer student named Shirayuki suddenly approaches him and asks if he would date him if the bullying stopped. Haruki dismisses it as a joke. But the next day, one of his tormentors disappears. Then another. One thing's for sure—Shirayuki is a psychopath that lacks common sense and empathy.

(Source: taskey, translated)

title: You're More Dangerous for Me
synopsis:
Not all powers are worth having. Damcho Baek has never doubted that—in fact, she'd do anything to get rid of her ability to hear people's emotions, a divine gift granted by a foreign god. At the end of her wits, she's shocked to encounter an exorcist named Jinhu Do, who might just know how to do it. The catch? To get rid of her ability, she needs to lose her virginity—but hearing people's thoughts makes that impossible. And since she can't hear Jinhu... maybe he could help her with that too.

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: A Mouthful of Sweet Cream Baguette
title_english: A Mouthful of Sweet Cream Baguette
synopsis:
Roah Egleydon is an avid lover of bread, so when a conference takes her to the home of the famous Everrose Bakery, she is determined to get her hands on some delicious baked goods. After a day of waiting in line in the sweltering sun, she finally makes it to the bakery, only to find them all sold out! That's when she meets Klimt, a mysterious, sexy baker who offers her a sample of his sweet cream baguette. Roah is intrigued by this handsome stranger, but is she biting off more than she can chew?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: Get in My Bed, Supporting Male Leads!
title_english: Get in My Bed, Supporting Male Leads!
synopsis:
Sure, I was reborn as the villainess, but her life seemed like a hassle, so I chose peace. But even though I'm keeping my distance from the main plot, the sub male leads keep showing up on my doorstep. They all want the same thing: to share my bed! Whatever the reason, I don't want to get involved... but how could I refuse?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title: SAHAN
synopsis:
Despite Earth's advanced space industry, Sahan's moonbound spaceship crashes, leaving him stranded out in space for a year. When he's rescued and brought back to Earth, he finds that 11 years have already passed there. While struggling to overcome his space trauma and adjust to the many changes on his home planet, Sahan finds himself leaning on Heegeon, the little boy next door who is now an adult and hasn't forgotten him. Heegeon might be the only one who can help Sahan find his place in a world that has long moved on without him...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Kyuuketsu Ouji to Ikenie Hanayome
synopsis:
Meirin An is born into a high-born house, but after losing both of her parents, her home gets usurped by a branch family; she faces mistreatment from them; and they use the presence of her sickly young brother to ensure her compliance. The branch family's daughter, Shuusetsu, takes Meirin's place and becomes engaged to the Third Prince, Tenga Roku. However, Tenga's true identity turns out to be a despised and feared vampire...!?

What awaits the ill-fated young girl is the devotion of a complicated vampire with secrets of his own!? A palace fantasy that begins with a contract marriage!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: I Picked Up a Snake on My Way Home from Work
synopsis:
The main character, No Seona, impulsively picks up a snake on her way home from work. However, it turns out that the snake is actually a member of the Suin Clan (snakes that can transform into humans)! After regaining its energy, the snake transforms into a human and starts playing the role of a devoted husband. Seona finds herself increasingly drawn to this snake, her heart racing. And perhaps the snake feels the same way... As the two grow closer, an unusual tension develops between them. Until finally, when the pants come off... it turns out the snake has two...

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Kyokutou Kyuuseishu Densetsu
title_english: Legend of the Far East's Savior
synopsis:
At the end of World War II, a demon-summoning ritual drastically altered the face of the earth. Now, a hundred years later, demons rule the world, and humanity fights back using magicite-powered armored mechs. In the year 2055, a boy named Keita Kawakami enrolls in Japan's military academy. Possessing memories of an alternate modern era, he successfully pilots a prototype mech that no one else has even been able to activate. When Keita is suddenly deployed to the battlefield, he uses the knowledge from his previous life to achieve results that defy all established norms. Thus begins humanity's battle to reclaim the world.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Doku ni Kuchizuke
synopsis:
Mashimo, a former police officer, now works as a handyman, taking on odd jobs that often involve dealing with “demi-humans”—people with animal-like traits. One day, on his way back from a job in a city where demi-humans live, he reunites with Crow, a snake demi-human who once helped him in the past. Mashimo finds Crow crouched down, looking weak and exhausted, and tries to take care of him. However, as a snake demi-human, Crow has a certain instinct: when his body grows cold, he must warm it through sexual contact…?! Pinned beneath Crow, the two end up spending the night together. Mashimo assumes it will be a one-time thing—but it seems Crow has taken quite a liking to him…?

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

title: Burrow and Bear It
synopsis:
Hae-gyeong, a rabbit shifter, has spent years pining for the golden boy of the neighborhood, Jaehyeon. Everyone loves Jaehyeon, but Hae-gyeong wants to be the only one. One impulsive, drunken night, the lines between them blur when Jaehyeon crosses the ultimate boundary, leaving Hae-gyeong more deeply in love than ever. However, the morning after brings a cold reality: Jaehyeon is drawing lines again. Now, Hae-gyeong must see if he can finally break through Jaehyun's walls, or if his true love will remain forever out of reach.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Renai Fushin na Reijou wa Reikoku Kishi-sama no Dekiai ni Kizukanai

One day, Countess Rosalie witnesses her lover, Hayden, cheating on her. Heartbroken, Rosalie becomes timid about love. However, she is then proposed to by the dashing future Marquis Rufus...!?

synopsis:
Despite being bound by a political marriage, Livenia and Heinrich form a bond and slowly become the family neither of them ever had. That is, until Livenia's sudden death tears them apart. After being reborn into a new body, she vows to shed the cruel judgment she faced as a young duchess, but seeing Heinrich still trapped in the shadow of her death even 10 years later shakes her resolve. Will she embrace her new life or return to her former groom's side to keep the promise she once made?

(Source: Tapas Media)

title_japanese: 筋ト令嬢クーラ様～悪役令嬢に恋する暇なし!～

A completely ordinary woman is reincarnated into the world of an otome game. Yet, her true identity is that of a macho girl who is physically and mentally fit because of her muscle training! Can the villainess Lady Kuura, who is destined for ruin, use her muscle power alone to smash her doom flags? And what of her relationships with the noble ladies and handsome capture targets surrounding her?

(Source: GOT, translated)

title: Isekai ni Tensei shitemo Shachiku desu ga, Oshini no Joushi to Ganbarimasu!
title_japanese: 異世界に転生しても社畜ですが、推し似の上司と頑張ります!
synopsis:
Liza works at an advertising agency in another world. Her motto is to work at a relaxed pace and leave work on time, but when she accidentally falls down the stairs, she remembers that she was a hardcore corporate slave in her previous life (and she also worked at an advertising agency). Although she is disappointed that she's in an alternate world and doesn't have any cheats or play the role of a villainous young lady, her original corporate slave mindset is awakened! She begins to work hard, but like in her previous life, she can't find a handsome older man to support. However, Yuna, the villainous young lady, says that Liza is supposed to be the heroine of an otome game...but no, no way!? Before she knows it, she's falling in love with the tolerance of her handsome older boss who looks like her idol. An office love story (planned) about a corporate slave in another world!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Haesu and Jinheon are childhood friends, but Haesu has a boyfriend and Jinheon is a gruff star athlete who just loves to tease her. After Haesu is dumped by her boyfriend Jeong-un because she just doesn't do it for him anymore, Haesu is understandably distraught and turns to Jinheon for a man's perspective. Little does she know that her tearful bid for validation will spark a flame that could threaten their 13-year friendship...

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

6. Hanikami Nightmare (Bashful Nightmare)

title: ○ to x
synopsis:
One day, circle and cross symbols suddenly appeared above people's heads. Though there's said to be no discernible correlation between the symbol and individual, prejudice against those who have a cross never fades. In our protagonist Kaito's class, there's only one person who bears a cross...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Love Loop
synopsis:
Choi Hyeon-gyeol is trapped in a hellish temporal prison. Every time the clock strikes midnight on the 15th, he is ripped back to the start of the previous day. Forced to repeat the exact same university assignments twenty times over, his sanity has worn dangerously thin. Pushed to his absolute breaking point by the monotony, Hyeon-gyeol decides to abandon all caution and indulge in a wild, impulsive escape from his scripted life. This leads him to an unexpected, heated one-night stand with his fellow classmate, Lim Yeonjeong.

He falls asleep expecting to wake up to the same familiar nightmare once again. However, against all odds, the loop finally breaks. For the first time in what feels like an eternity, Hyeon-gyeol opens his eyes to the fresh, uncharted morning of the 15th... with Yeonjeong right beside him.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Who Screwed Who?
synopsis:
Kang Hyo-in has been secretly in love with his best friend of eight years, Jin Ye-geon, and he's finally ready to turn that crush into something more. Armed with a meticulous plan to win Ye-geon's heart, Hyo-in is determined to confess the "right" way. But one drunken night he can't even remember throws everything off track, and suddenly they're dating before he can make sense of what happened. Now there's just one burning question he can't ignore: what exactly did they do... and which one of them ended up on the bottom?!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Today's Horoscope: Breakup
synopsis:
According to the morning's fortune, Park Muwoon was destined for a fated encounter. Instead, the universe delivers Na Yeontaek, the childhood tormentor he spent nine years trying to forget. What was supposed to be a "lucky" day quickly turns into a nightmare as the architect of Muwoon's past misery resurfaces. Now, forced back into each other's lives, Muwoon must confront a complicated history and the lingering shadows of a man he never wanted to see again.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Royal Reincarnation
synopsis:
A boy reborn as Nox, an omega noble, finds himself surrounded by men bound to him through blood, duty, and pheromones. With a hateful half-brother, a duke's son drawn to his scent, and a loyal servant who watches him too closely, every relationship is charged with tension. When his uncontrollable heat awakens, desire and power collide, pulling them all into a dangerous, irresistible web.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Tell Me Love Me
synopsis:
When Hyunwoo's reckless brother wrecks an expensive car, Hyunwoo scrambles to find money to clean up the mess.

Jaeyoon, his current boss and once his quiet admirer, steps in and offers to cover the debt for him. 

A single misunderstanding twists their intentions, pulling the two men into a complicated and unexpected new phase of their relationship.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Read the Fine Print, Demon!
synopsis:
Every night, Jaehyuk is visited by an uninvited stranger who leaves him drained in more ways than one. The intruder is Mor, an incubus desperate to survive yet terrible at gathering the energy he needs. 

What started as nightly harassment ends in an unexpected reversal when Mor is trapped in a binding contract with Jaehyuk.

One longs for freedom, the other wants a normal life, but their unwanted pact begins pulling their hearts in directions neither expected. 

With desire blurring every line between them, can they face their tangled feelings and uncover the truth behind their growing attachment?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Focusing
synopsis:
For as long as he can remember, Yun Jeongwu has been the backbone of his struggling family, working tirelessly to support a younger brother plagued by chronic illness. During those long, grueling years, Jeongwu happened upon a newspaper feature about a prodigious young Baduk player named Cha Jihan. Perhaps it was because Jihan shared his brother's age, or because the athlete had successfully overcome his own past health struggles, but Jeongwu found himself projecting his brother's image onto the boy, eventually becoming his most devoted fan.

Years later, Jeongwu has secured a position as the youngest staff member at a professional photography studio. It is there that he finally comes face-to-face with his idol, who has now expanded his career into modeling. The professional reunion takes a dark, bewildering turn that night. After a staff dinner, a drowsy Jeongwu retreats to his bedroom, only to be jolted awake by the sensation of wandering hands. Terrified, he stares into the darkness

title: Bias Wrecker
synopsis:
Rookie actor Yeo Jeongwon just landed a spot on the healing reality show A Month in Europe. There's just one problem: his ultimate celebrity crush, Kwon Haewoon, is his co-star! To survive the trip, Jeongwon has two simple rules: don't let anyone know he's a superfan, and don't get too close to Haewoon. But when Haewoon insists on being roommates and claims they've met before, Jeongwon's "professional" act begins to crumble. Between shared rooms and constant filming, he's one $5-a-month fan-app notification away from being outed as the world's biggest fanboy.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: New World Order
synopsis:
Errand service owner Wu Hyeondo never expected his first love to walk back into his life, especially not like this. Seong Su arrives clutching a flyer for a suspicious cult, claiming his dead son might still be alive. Reeling from the sudden mention of a child he never knew about, Hyeondo assumes Seong Su must have moved on and built a family after he left the island. But the truth is far more shocking than he could have realized...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Bittersour
synopsis:
Jiwon just wants to enjoy a steamy one-night stand, but the neighbor from hell keeps killing the mood. After nights of listening to a heartbroken stranger wail breakup anthems through the walls, Jiwon finally storms next door to demand silence. Instead of a typical nuisance, he finds Hyeon watching a cringey, viral video of Jiwon's most cringe college memory. Now that his secret "black history" is out, things are about to get a lot more sour—and a little bit spicy.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: The Method Messiah
synopsis:
Famous actor Kim Seongjae follows a suspicious man claiming to be his temporary manager, only to arrive at a remote village he escaped from at fifteen—the compound of a cult that once consumed his life. As Seongjae attempts to flee the place haunted by his past, a fatal mistake leaves the cult leader dead by his hand. Moments later, the followers arrive, forcing Seongjae into an irreversible decision to survive. Trapped on a stage where faith, violence, and performance blur, Seongjae realizes the man who led him here has been directing everything from the shadows. Once the cameras begin to roll, there is no cutting the scene short.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Marked
synopsis:
To the rest of the world, Ju Haram is the picture of innocence and grace, yet his nights tell a different story. From the vantage point of a stalker, Haram's modest reputation is a curated lie as he brings a revolving door of men back to his bed. Lost in a world of feverish fantasies, the observer has spent months imagining being the one selected for the night. The line between reality and obsession finally blurs when Haram makes his move, inviting his shadow into the very home he has been haunting for a year.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: A Perfect Relationship
synopsis:
Late at night in a secluded park, Ha Do-eon and Ahn Saebyeok move through an intimacy so natural it feels almost unreal. To anyone watching, they are the picture of a flawless couple: effortless, synchronized, complete. But their story didn't begin there. Three years earlier, a chance encounter drew them together, setting the stage for a relationship that only seems perfect on the surface...

Reborn as the fourth son of a Countess, Ludwig von Freudenstadt must navigate a world where women hold all the power! Unable to use magic, men are only valued for their ability as "Studs." The best studs produce the most powerful offspring, and Ludwig is quickly approaching his first breeding session. When his partners and their daughters all begin to exhibit strange magical qualities Lutz suddenly finds himself surrounded by women! With genes wanted by even the royal family, and a whole other world's worth of knowledge, can Lutz even manage to live his desired peaceful life?!

They are all problem students because they are adolescents and cannot handle their abilities well. Rin Kitaouji, a third-year teacher, is suddenly assigned to Class P one day. Can he make sure they all graduate properly and keep his easygoing job?!

When it comes to negotiating with clients, her aura of competence allows her to gain their trust and close contracts one after the other. Meanwhile, Michito Hiwada is a rookie employee who joined the company at the same time as Takano. Unlike Takano, Michito is actually good at his job, but he appears to be incompetent. When he learns they plan to sell doujinshi based on his series at a convention, he heads there, hoping to meet at least one person who genuinely likes what he draws, but then...?! A miscommunication comedy that explores otaku culture and depicts the realities of being a mangaka with a comedic touch! A story where the creator "god" and an otaku "believer" keep talking past each other.

In worlds where card games dominate everything, it's almost a cliché for the fate of the world to hang on the outcome of a card battle. I, Mitsuru Tanefuda, found myself reincarnated into such a world. Thankfully, my dream came true—I became the manager of my very own card shop.

In this world, people duel with cards, filled with joy and excitement, and I wanted to watch it all up close. But for some reason, everyone seems to think I'm some legendary hero who solved massive crises in the past, watching over the next generation like a noble predecessor. The truth is, I've never resolved any world-shaking incidents—not even once.

This is the story of a reincarnated man who became the manager of a card shop in a world where card games take precedence over everything else. Despite having no great achievements to his name, everyone around him assumes he must have been a hero who once saved the world.

According to rumors, he has ruled over the region's lord for over 300 years, and even claimed to be an immortal... one who lives a life no human should be capable of possessing. However, the beautiful transfer student Miu Fuuriniji changes Kenichi's undesirable fate: she is a first-rate martial artist who introduces him to Ryozanpaku dojo.

There, Kenichi meets the dojo's six eccentric masters, who then decide to take him in as their disciple! Shijou Saikyou no Deshi Kenichi tells the story of history's strongest disciple Kenichi as he trains tirelessly under the world's greatest martial artists—who each specialize in their own martial art—to gain the strength to protect the people and values important to him.

title: Keeping It Brief
synopsis:
Cha Yunho can't shake the feeling that a suspicious man in sunglasses is following him, shameless eyes glued to his bodacious backside. Just as Yunho tries to get away, the man suddenly makes an outrageous offer. He wants Yunho to become the model for his brand. To Yunho's shock, the stranger turns out to be Kwon Wuhyeok, his first love from fourteen years ago. Before he knows it, Yunho finds himself working at what might be the best job imaginable, spending all day with Wuhyeok. There's just one problem: Wuhyeok's brand's clothing is a little short, tight, and triangular for Yunho's liking...

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Tsukimino Karma wa Akumade Boku no Pet nanoni
title_english: Tsukimino Karma Is Just My Pet...
title_japanese: 月見野カルマはあくまで僕のペットなのに
synopsis:
Ryou Fudou is a loner because his face looks far too intimidating. One day, he is about to be hit by a truck when Tsukimino-san saves him. Wanting to thank her, Ryou-kun chases after Tsukimino-san, but ends up stumbling straight into a confession scene, where he gets asked, "Would you love me even if I were a demon?" Tsukimino-san casts a spell of amnesia, but for some reason Ryou-kun seems to have a constitution that repels magic, and the spell bounces right off him. Panicking, she then casts a subjugation spell to make him her "pet," but that too is repelled. Just as Tsukimino-san seems about to be won over by Ryou-kun's gift and words, the earlier pet-subjugation spell comes tumbling down from above... And so, unbelievably, Karma Tsukimino-san ends up becoming the pet of the human Ryou-kun.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Sangeki
synopsis:
High schooler Miko, who thought he'd be inheriting his grandfather's mountain, has lost his crush to his friend and is at the bottom of his school's hierarchy. His one solace was the mountain, but now a mysterious masked man is building a small cabin there... Tagline: Am I weak? A tale of love and hate spiraling around a mountain.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title_english: Naked Portrait: Rie Kanou Short Story Collection
title_japanese: 裸の肖像 加納梨衣短編集
synopsis:
1. Hadaka no Shouzou
2-3. Oboreru Ningyo-tachi
4. Penguin no Shi
5. Jusui Biyori

title: Q-ken
synopsis:
Due to her innate stage fright, Yuki Mikage has always been unsuccessful at everything she tries. She even gave up her love of quizzes in middle school after causing trouble for those around her and becoming isolated. Then, after entering high school, Yuki meets Ichika Konno, a classmate who openly declares her intention to compete in the "Quiz Koshien" (a national high school quiz competition). Inspired by Ichika, who has a clear opinion of her own and doesn't care what others think, Yuki joins the quiz club and rediscovers the joy of quizzes. Furthermore, inspired by Ichika's words after she notices Yuki's incredible memory capacity, Yuki declares, "Let's win the Quiz Koshien together!"

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Nekogo no Kyoukasho
synopsis:
One day, an editor received a mysterious manuscript mixed with characters and symbols, resembling a code. When Paul Gallico was consulted for deciphering, it turned out to be, astonishingly, a "Human Domination Manual" written by and for cats!

How to sneak into a comfy home? How to train the owner for favorable plays and food? How to capture human hearts and live a good life?

Cats are extremely intelligent, manipulating humans with cunning tactics that tap into the essence of humanity. They calmly analyze the weaknesses and follies of humans. Once their intelligence is known, humans inevitably find themselves under the dominion of cats.

(Source: Kadokawa)

title: Chika-chan wa Motto Shiritai
title_japanese: ちかちゃんはもっとしりたい
synopsis:
Chika, a second grader, can't help but be curious about Yuki, the boy who sits next to her. Wanting to know more about him, she one day encounters a mysterious creature named Pipsqueak...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Familiver Relations
synopsis:
Ku Yeonseo is AZ Company's marketing superstar, blessed with perfect looks, sharp skills, and one very inconvenient secret: He is a nine-tailed fox who spent a mere two hundred years growing all his tails. And yet, despite his outstanding track record as a kumiho, he's decided that being a regular human with exams, job hunting, and office deadlines sounded more appealing than becoming a celestial fox. Despite his carefully curated life, everything goes wrong when a single mistake exposes his identity to Yu Minhyeok, a straight-laced developer who, to Yeonseo's horror, is completely immune to his magic. Determined to protect his peaceful "human" life, Yeonseo comes up with a questionable plan to charm his way into Minhyeok and his younger sister's life regardless, magic be damned!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Risky Mentoring
synopsis:
Brilliant in both looks and talent, Ryu Chan-yeong is an elite violinist admired by everyone around him. For Joo Hajin, he is not just a role model but the person he dreams of standing beside on stage one day. That dream feels painfully distant until Hajin is suddenly given a rare chance to receive private mentoring from Chan-yeong himself.

But fate takes a strange turn when Hajin accidentally overhears something he was never meant to hear. Before he can even process it, Chan-yeong confronts him with a shocking proposal.

For a limited time, they will become intimate partners, and when Chan-yeong decides it is over, it will end cleanly. In exchange, Hajin will receive the mentorship he has longed for.

Caught between ambition, desire, and the dangerous pull of the man he admires, Hajin must decide how much he is willing to risk for his dream.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Tugging at My Heart
synopsis:
Struggling to make ends meet, Kang-i works endless part-time jobs until one evening at a high-profile party leads to a reckless one-night encounter with a rude chaebol heir who mistakes him for someone else. Planning to enjoy it once and walk away, Kang-i is stunned to realize the man is actually his childhood friend, the one he parted from on bitter terms years ago. This time, the past refuses to stay buried, and what was meant to be a fleeting reunion turns into an intense game of obsession, desire, and feelings neither of them ever resolved.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Insatiable Slave
synopsis:
Rohshan Owin believes he has lost his mind. He has abandoned the pride of his count's family and the duty to carry on his bloodline, all because he is addicted to his forbidden relationship with the slave Kyle Blackburn.

As the Black Dragon Festival approaches, Kyle grows more desperate. He wants Rohshan's confession before the ceremonial Nest Marriage, and he does everything he can to provoke, tempt, and unbalance him. The longer Rohshan hesitates, the more Kyle's patience fractures, his longing twisting into something dangerously close to madness.

"Just how long am I supposed to wait? At this rate, I'm going to lose myself completely."

Within Rohshan's mansion, secrets pile up, the suspicious deaths of his parents, the dark origins of his own unruly nature, and the true identity of the slave who has stolen his heart.

Caught between obsession, guilt, and a love that refuses to stay hidden, Rohshan must decide what he is willing to sacrifice before everything collapses.

(Source: L

title: The Byline Deal
synopsis:
Three years ago, Taeyang's boyfriend ended their relationship by announcing his engagement to someone else. Taeyang never expected to cross paths with him again, yet while investigating suspicious rumors surrounding the couple, the journalist suddenly finds himself face to face with his ex, Woo Juyeol. Juyeol offers Taeyang exclusive information for his reports, but the price is unsettling: Taeyang must be at his beck and call for sex, no questions asked... Determined to expose Juyeol's darkest secrets, Taeyang accepts the deal.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Three Nights
synopsis:
Hangyeol loves music, but for some reason, he just cannot write love songs. Desperate for advice, he visits a fortune-teller, only to receive the strangest solution imaginable: "If romance is too hard," the old man tells him, "then at least try sleeping with someone. Anyone." 

Leaving with more questions than answers, a flustered Hangyeol somehow ends up surrounded by three very different men...in more ways than one. Caught between inspiration, temptation, and pure confusion, Hangyeol must figure out whether he can finally lose his innocence—and maybe find his muse along the way.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Bite to Unlock
synopsis:
Hyeon-seung has gone his entire life without anyone realizing he's a vampire—until Taehee, his teammate for a group project, uncovers his secret. What's worse, Taehee is a hardcore vampire otaku, so try as he might to hide his identity, Hyeon-seung's identity has been laid bare. Taehee promises to keep quiet, but only after bombarding Hyeon-seung with endless questions and enthusiastic fanboying. Dazed and cornered, Hyun-seong finally agrees to help fuel Taehee's obsession, forming a strange symbiotic relationship fueled by blood and fandom. But as the two grow closer, their relationship grows into something more...giving bloodlust a whole new meaning.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Til Death Do Us Apart
synopsis:
Delivery driver Kang Han-gil has spent every waking moment trying to save his father, who has turned into a zombie. Poverty and exhaustion weigh on him, but he refuses to give up.

Then someone from his past reappears, Shin Midum, a man Han-gil hoped never to see again. Calling himself a "zombie caretaker," Midum claims he can cure Han-gil's father with a new experimental drug. But there is a price, and his demand is unsettlingly simple, he wants Han-gil in his bed.

Before Han-gil can decide whether to accept, disaster strikes. His zombified father escapes, the apartment complex collapses into chaos, and the entire building becomes a nest of the undead. Trapped together, Han-gil and Midum have no choice but to rely on each other.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: When the Violets Bloom
synopsis:
On a devastated Earth, the remnants of humanity dwell within the suffocating depths of underground bunkers, desperately preparing for a mass migration to a parallel universe. Subin, a dedicated warp researcher, finds his only solace in his lover, Kihyeok. Upon returning from a perilous surface expedition, Kihyeok presents him with an impossible gift: a living, blooming violet. "It's a miracle, Subin! The Earth might finally be breathing again!" he exclaims, his eyes shining with newfound hope. It is Kihyeok's vibrant stories of the outside world that sustain Subin's spirit in the dim, gray halls of the bunker; for Subin, this man is his solitary light and his only source of true happiness in a dying world.

However, his fragile peace is shattered when Kihyeok's fellow soldiers arrive at the laboratory with grim expressions. They deliver a bolt from the blue—news so devastating it threatens to unravel everything Subin believed about their future and his lover's survival.

(Source: Lezhi

title: My Rat Is an S-Class Awakener
title_english: My Rat Is an S-Class Awakener
synopsis:
Soul is dropped into a dimension where everyone's screaming about a status window he can't see. On top of that, his pet rat, who also got dropped in with him, turns out to be a beastman and a powerful awakener... And in love with him?! Will Soul and Rio accept each other and make it back home safely?

(Source: Manta)

title: The Legend of AAAA
synopsis:
An ordinary villager is tasked with accompanying a hero who smashes every crate and pot he comes across on his journey! Can this sort of hero truly stop the Demon King and save the world?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: A Delinquent's First Love
synopsis:
Shy and lonely college junior Lee Dorae never expects to see her high school crush again until she runs into Cha Haewon, who's just as handsome as she remembers. When Haewon suddenly confesses his feelings, Dorae is completely thrown off. Because one, he already has a popular girlfriend who happens to be Dorae's friend, and two, he believes he's still eighteen years old. After a car accident erased five years of his memories, Haewon is stuck in the past and determined to make Dorae his girlfriend. Now the two are confronted by the question: Can first love survive reality?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title_japanese: 虐げられた従者、敵地の天使なお嬢様に拾われる ～命令に従っていただけにもかかわらず、知らないうちに最強の魔術師になっていたようです～

title: Toono Monogatari
synopsis:
Yuki-onna, Zashiki-warashi, Tengu, Kappa, Okunai-sama—these are some of the various folk beliefs and legends recorded in The Legends of Tono, a collection of folklore from the Tono region. The stories were narrated by Kizen Sasaki, a native of the Tono area, transcribed by Kunio Yanagita, and published after extensive local research.

This work, which condenses Japanese views on life, death, and nature, is also called "the origin of Japanese folklore studies." This daring comic adaptation intertwines and revives four supernatural tales: "Oshira-sama," "Kappa," "Fox," and "Futtachi," for a modern audience.

(Source: Kadokawa)

title: Zanzou ni Kuchibeni wo
synopsis:
One day, novelist Katsuo Saji unexpectedly finds himself living as the protagonist in a fictional world. But this world has a strange rule: "One character vanishes at a time." When a character disappears, so do all the words that use it. And when a word disappears, everything it represents is erased from existence. For example, when the character "ぱ" (pa) vanishes, "パン" (bread which is "pan" in Japanese) disappears too. When "ゆ" (yu) is lost, so is "ゆうこ" (Yuko), Saji's eldest daughter. As one thing after another fades away, the boundaries between reality and fiction start to blur.

(Source: Kadokawa)

title_english: At 0:00 A.M., I Picked Up a Delinquent.
title_japanese: 午前０時、不良を拾いました。
synopsis:
Kayamori, who is living alone due to certain circumstances, comes across a handsome, ragged delinquent at the garbage dump one night. Seeing the lonely-looking boy, the words slipped out of her mouth: "Would you like to come over?" The two awkward friends begin living together.

(Source: MU)

title: Seigi-kun Blowback! Kageki na Nichijou Keigoroku
title_japanese: 正義くんブローバック! ～カゲキな日常警護録～
synopsis: Ordinary high school girl Mana Shinjou may never know peace again when her childhood friend Seigi-kun comes back into her life... armed with a glock.

title: Check Out My Manager
synopsis:
Kwak Eunho has spent 11 years as Ji Hyeon's friend and 7 years as his manager, all the while hiding his huge crush for him. But his secret partially comes to light when the two of them shoot a variety show called "Check Out My Manager," and Eunho drops a bombshell during the interview: "There is someone I'm interested in." This greatly irks Hyeon, who believes there is someone in Eunho's life that he doesn't know about. But that "someone" would have been so obvious if only Hyeon could have checked out his manager just a little more...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title_japanese: 虚無ねーちゃんはかまってほしい

title: Wasureta Koi no Shuufukuhou
title_english: How to Fall in Love with You Again.
synopsis:
Shoma Yagi, 18 years old, has been nursing a crush on his childhood friend and best friend, Mizuki—or so he thought. But when he opened his eyes, standing in front of him was Mizuki, now an adult, claiming to be his "lover"...? Before he knew it, he was also in his adult form, and it seems he has lost seven years of memories.

The Mizuki who is his "lover" (something he doesn't remember) is strangely erotic and restless, and for someone just realizing his first love, it's way too intense...!

A cool, doting seme × tsundere, pure uke. A heartfelt re-love BL starting from amnesia.

(Source: Shu-Cream, translated)

title: Roku no Okashi na Ie
synopsis:
Ordinary Seiroku Akari is a dedicated member of his high school science club. When he vows to uncover the truth behind an eerie urban legend known as "The Moonlit Tales of Kokubunji," he ends up being possessed by five curses.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Class de 2-banme ni Kawaii Boyish Osananajimi no Kanzen Kouryaku Shintaku Chart
title_english: The Divine Strategy Chart to Conquering the Second Cutest Boyish Childhood Friend in the Class
title_japanese: クラスで２番目に可愛いボーイッシュ幼馴染の完全攻略神託チャート
synopsis:
Aya Minatori, my childhood friend, is the second cutest girl in our class. The reason she is said to be second is because she already has a boyfriend. But to me, Aya has always been number one...

"I will make it happen"

During a two-night, three-day school trip, I received a divine revelation. It was the power to find a way to get my childhood friend back, to engrave pleasure into her body and transform it into one that cannot return to her boyfriend.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kimi to Oboreru Eden no Yoake
title_japanese: 君と溺れるエデンの夜明け
synopsis:
"Sentinels" cannot live without their "Guides"...

Koudai, an ordinary high school student, reunites after several years with his childhood friend Shiro, whom he once had feelings for. Their joyful reunion is short-lived when Koudai learns that Shiro is a "Sentinel" living in the underworld, and that Koudai himself is a "Guide," a person with supernatural abilities. As a price for their heightened senses, Sentinels face life-threatening danger unless they physically connect with their Guides. Shiro is no exception, and he demands sex from Koudai...!? 

"Rather than letting others have you, I'll be the one..." 

As they give in to their physical desires, special feelings gradually begin to grow. Koudai starts to desperately wish to save Shiro from the underworld, but...

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Pretty Collection
synopsis:
Mocked for having top-tier talent but the worst looks, Kim Yeppeum falls into despair, betrayed by those she trusted and robbed of everything she worked for. But then, a seeming miracle transforms her into someone breathtakingly beautiful. In the following days, she watches a dreamlike new life unfold before her eyes. Fame, attention, and endless praise are intoxicating, but something feels off. Soon, she realizes this beauty isn't a blessing. It is a curse.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

synopsis:
“Metaist”—one who knows that the world exists inside of a manga. And I am this world's sole metaist.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Apple Age
synopsis: After being forgotten by society, a robot maid and the ghost of a murdered girl embark on a soulful sci-fi journey searching for the latter's murderer and a place for the former to call her own.

title: Utsusemi no Katakage
synopsis:
Shiori is a high school girl who's lost her best friend. On a hot summer day like any other, she heads to the station on her way to school, and it's there she finds a girl crying alone. Curious, she decides to speak to her... A miraculous story set on a summer day.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title: The Dawn that Twists Your Neck
synopsis:
"I believed it was love. Until he pierced my heart."

Arsinoe, the princess of a kingdom, was disrespected by everyone because she inherited the blood of an enslaved mother. She believed her life would change through marriage to Crown Prince Alejandro of the empire. She thought she would begin a happy life as a beloved wife and respected empress—until her husband pierced her heart with a smile on his face. Regression that repeats with each death. After struggling to avoid the tragic ending, she realizes she can no longer try to escape it. Now, in her fourth life, Arsinoe resolves to become queen and take revenge on the crown prince. Walter Heiberg, the sharpest sword capable of annihilating everything. With him, she can cut through even fate itself.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title_japanese: 嘘憑きキツネツキ 番外編 ビデオレターの怪
synopsis: Side story set after Uso Tsuki Kitsune Tsuki's main story.

title: Youkaiou-kyun Gakuen
synopsis:
A youkai who unites with the “Golden Essence” will give birth to the Youkai King!!

Ousu Chimogami, who has just become a high school boy, finds himself enrolled in a class consisting of nothing but 13 beautiful youkai girls!! Possessing the "Golden Essence" necessary to give birth to the Youkai King, Ousu is the youkai girls’ top candidate for boyfriend. The curtain rises on a school life filled with one love-stealing battle after another, all orchestrated by these beautiful youkai girls♡

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Dekkkkarian
synopsis:
Gakuto Watari is a highly educated elite, but his extreme arrogance about his academic background has led to his total defeat in the job hunting wars, turning him into a toxic NEET who does nothing but lurk on internet message boards.

Suddenly, he is abducted by giant aliens known as a "Dekkkkarians." Under the guise of "rehabilitation," he is forced into manual labor in a mysterious underground facility alongside other middle-aged men mooching off their parents.

Naturally, his high-spec pride refuses to tolerate such tyranny and oppression. With a brain packed with extensive knowledge, he prepares to shut them down with logic and debate—or at least he would, if he weren't too terrified and overwhelmed to muster the courage...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: My Friend's Hidden Charm
synopsis:
Haesung and Jiwoon were childhood friends that grew apart after Jiwoon moved away. Reunited at college years later, the friendship is rekindled—but there's no sexual chemistry to speak of. However, that all changes when Haesung catches a glimpse of Jiwoon's package as he's getting dressed. After the "big" reveal, Haesung begins to view her hunky childhood friend in a new light!

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Manga Kaese yo
synopsis:
Take and Yuichirou have been close friends since elementary school. Now, old enough to drink alcohol, just what do 2 guys talk about at an izakaya...? An 11-page one-shot story of a friendship that remains the same even as times change!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

2. Gyakunan Jackpot

title: Shinimodori no Reigai Ouji ga Kenou to Yobareru made: Michibiita no wa Bukiyou na Koushaku Reijou no Inori deshita
title_japanese: 死に戻りの冷害王子が賢王と呼ばれるまで～導いたのは不器用な侯爵令嬢の祈りでした～
synopsis:
Dietrich, nicknamed the "Cold-Disaster Prince" because he seems incapable of warmth, became king at 17 under his ambitious mother's influence. But life turns tragically cruel: his younger brother Oscar seizes the throne, then he is publicly executed. Miraculously, at the very moment of his beheading, Dietrich's consciousness returns to four years earlier, when he was 13. With that memory, he resolves to right his mistakes: this time he will cherish his fiancée, Marguerite. In his previous life, he pushed her away with coldness, even though she stayed loyal and kind until the end, praying for him. Now, knowing what he lost, he vows to do everything differently. Thus begins his revenge, his path to being called the "Wise King."

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title: Jingai Karte: Youkoso Gensou Byouin e
title_japanese: 人外カルテ ～ようこそ幻想病院へ～
synopsis:
This is a rather unusual hospital where those who are not human come to visit. From insects and plants to unidentified life forms that usually remain hidden, patients burdened with strange abnormalities quietly arrive today as well. Welcome to the Fantasy Hospital.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kiki Kill
synopsis:
High school student Kiki's peaceful life collapsed entirely with the death of her beloved mother. Driven by rage, Kiki kills the man responsible—but that was merely the beginning of the story! The curtains now open on a blood-soaked, non-stop revenge drama!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Isekai Tensei Dungeon Master: Onsen Dungeon wo Tsukuru
title_english: Reincarnated, I'll Make the Hot Spring Dungeon!
title_japanese: 異世界転生ダンジョンマスター 温泉ダンジョンを作る
synopsis:
"You have been reincarnated as our Dungeon Master. Lure in many adventurers with their desires, and through exploration and combat, create a dungeon that can drain their blood, magic power, and life, Master."

One day, a man on the verge of death in a hospital in the modern world hears a strange hallucination. It tells him to operate a dungeon as a Dungeon Master. Faced with this unusually specific hallucination, the man, while lost in fantasies of dungeon management, passes away from his illness.

And now, just as the hallucination foretold, the man is truly reincarnated as a Dungeon Master. To the Dungeon Core who had been the source of the hallucination, he declares:

"Alright... I'm going to make a onsen dungeon."

And thus, his dungeon management begins.

(Source: Novel Updates)

synopsis:
The region of Parsa in the state of Karana is jointly governed by two great houses: the Fullranet family, masters of magical power, and the Romano family, unrivaled in martial might. Each house has a daughter whose breathtaking beauty and extraordinary abilities mark her as the future countess.

Annamaria Fullranet, known as "The Black-Magic Lady."

Rosaria Romano, known as "The Silver-Knight Lady."

Though childhood friends, a trivial incident in their youth shattered their bond, turning them into sworn rivals who clash at every turn.

Then, Duke Jeremiah arrives in Karana. A royal with prodigious magic, he had served as a general in the capital's Sorcerous Kingdom Army—only to abruptly resign and relocate to Karana. Rumors swirl: He's here to find a bride.

"Marry him, and I'll rise as duchess, lifting Parsa to new heights!" both ladies think.

As the two reignite their feud, Jeremiah reveals a secret.

"My source of magic—the gem Smeraldo—has been stolen. I can no longer cast spells

Master swordsman Dokgo Hyeon was crushed after being branded as the public enemy of the entire martial world. Broken in body and spirit, Hyeon believes his days and his troubles are finally over... until trouble finds him in the form of Somi, an adorable and unusually gifted little girl who refuses to leave his side. Through Somi, the battle-obsessed warrior who once dreamed of becoming the most feared name in Murim begins to discover the warmth of a heart he never knew existed.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

Subaru Kannagi made his full-contact karate tournament debut when he was a first-year high school student. Awaiting him were nothing but the strongest around, but... at that time, no one had any idea just how powerful he really was...

title: The Peaceful Life of a Maid Who Hides Her Power and Enjoys It
title_japanese: 힘을 숨기고 즐기는 평화로운 하녀 생활
synopsis:
Hero Andert: a great swordsman who sacrificed himself to end the Great War and one of the greatest heroes of all time. However, in reality, she was a cross-dressing woman who used the identity of her deceased brother. That was me.

"Huh?"

Four years after my death, I was alive again. With nothing to my name, I still had to make a living. The easiest way to do so: become a maid.

"What kind of mansion do you want to work in?"
"A mansion that is so hard and nasty that you don't even know if you die while two people work."
"What kind of employer do you want?"
"A vicious employer who squeezes his employees."

If the workplace was harsh, I would have better job security. The interviewer looked at me like I was crazy. But it doesn't matter. Here I will start anew—not as the hero Andert, nor as my dead brother. I would be Maid Daisy Lo.

(Source: Kakao Entertainment, translated)

title: I Only Need the Duke's Child
synopsis:
"If I could go back to the past, I wouldn't love him."

After her regression, her second marriage to her ex-husband was solely for the sake of the child. Unlike her previous life, where she craved love, she chose to marry him in this second life, which she obtained like a miracle, driven by the single-minded determination to reunite with her child.

"Please keep us married for just one year."

The price was that she would cooperate with him to uncover the secrets of the incident from ten years ago, just as he wanted. She thought they were a couple in name only, bound by a contract...

"It is not absolutely necessary to consummate the marriage on the first night—"

"I want to."

He was different from her previous life.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: The Scandal Maker Has Returned
synopsis:
"You know it, Uncle—that I'm not the 'Scandal Maker.'"

Framed for her cousin Bella's crimes, labeled a "Scandal Maker" and branded a "thief" who coveted a duke's belongings—all that was left for Harriet Listerwell was a ruined name and a life stained by false infamy. But the moment she discovers that behind every one of those tragedies was Bella's chilling smile, she makes a decision:

She will become the real Scandal Maker.

(Source: Naver, translated)

But he quickly quits after getting his butt handed to him by a real basketball prodigy. As the seasons pass and his wounds heal, Keiki is once again drawn to basketball by an unlikely new arrival.

Demon King Ruburuvim lived for over 1,000 years, mastering every possible magical theory. To conquer the one thing he couldn't master in his entire lifetime—Recovery Magic—he has been reincarnated as a young girl!!

It turns out that the key to mastering Recovery Magic is... making friends—!? The former Demon King, a slightly clueless "beginner" at being human, is about to dominate(?) academy life!

synopsis:
Having given up on his dreams and returned to his hometown, Keita reunites with his high school classmate, Tsubaki. Back then, Tsubaki would always whimsically mess with Keita while he quietly drew illustrations in the corner of the classroom... Between Keita, who failed to become a manga artist, and Tsubaki, who is burdened by her own particular circumstances—this adult gyaru and otaku are legit starting their lives over!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

synopsis:
"Makina-san, let's play." After chanting these words and tapping the card three times, a mysterious yet beautiful vengeful spirit named Makina-san will appear.

An ordinary high school student named Ryousuke Togawa investigates the haunting that has been troubling his best friend. In the face of the menacing spirit, he does the charm taught by his upperclassman, Nishijima. Suddenly, Nishijima herself appears from thin air, declaring she is Makina-san.

(Source: Hobby Japan, translated)

title: Isekai Tensei shitara, Oshi no Tekiyaku no Maid ni Narimashita
title_japanese: 異世界転生したら、推しの敵役のメイドになりました
synopsis:
Mikako has cleared the route of her favorite Otome game for her most favorite character, Aaron. She is moved to tears when she thinks of how many times she had been interrupted by Claude Langlois, Aaron's antagonist, and how hard she worked to clear the game. Filled with a sense of accomplishment, Mikako falls into a deep sleep before she knows it. When she wakes up, she is in the world of the Otome game she had just played, and she has been reborn as a maid of the hated Langlois family...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Nagomi Kyuuketsuki no Kogomi-san
title_japanese: なごみ吸血鬼のこごみさん
synopsis:
His first love is a warm-hearted but a little bit dangerous vampire! Shion is a university student who has come to repay the kindness of a beautiful woman who rescued him from a lost mountain when he was a child. He is reunited with her, but she is still the same as she used to be...?

(Source: Futabasha, translated)
