synopsis:
Kazuma Kuzuhara, a high school student who doesn't want to work, spent his days mooching off the huge amounts of money lavished on him by his childhood friends, the idols Yukina and Arisa. However, their excessive love of the two gradually begins to border on madness...? A dark youth love-comedy about living off the generosity of others!

(Source: Bushiroad Works, translated)

title: Shougakusei no Imouto wa Moto Tensai Majo desu
title_english: My Sister Is a Former Genius Witch
title_japanese: 小学生の妹は元・天才魔女です
synopsis:
In a world where there is a small number of witches but their magical powers are not so great, my little sister is a one-in-a-million exception who can utilize all kinds of spells! But because of it, my sister now becomes a exploitative (in terms of using magic) brat who always teases me for not having magic capabilities... However, what would happen when she actually runs out of MP (magical power)?

(Source: MangaDex)

title: Duplication Love
synopsis:
Dying and desperate for real love, Louis steals Phil—a lover dupe bound for disposal—for one month together. But when Phil starts falling for him, their fake romance becomes dangerously real.

(Source: Manta)

title: Breathtaking Alliance
synopsis:
It is the first freshman club retreat—the kind of night meant for excitement and budding romance. However, Kim Seonwu finds his heart sinking when he discovers that the senior he's been pining for already has someone in her life. His jealousy flares toward Noh Sang-yun, a fellow student with a rough, delinquent appearance who seems to be his primary romantic rival. The tension between them peaks during a reckless search for a local "haunted spot," resulting in Seonwu and Sang-yun becoming stranded alone together in the wilderness.

Seeking shelter from a sudden downpour, they break into a suspicious, dilapidated house, where Seonwu is unexpectedly possessed by a malevolent spirit. As his life hangs by a thread, Sang-yun drops his rebellious facade and delivers a chilling ultimatum: "If you want to live, do exactly as I say from now on." Seonwu had no idea that this "thug" would soon become his literal lifeline.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Even a Wild Man Wants to Love!
title_english: Even a Wild Man Wants to Love!
synopsis:
All Jung Hyundo wanted was a steady job, but he faced constant rejection. Determined to toughen up, he goes to Gwidu Mountain to improve his stamina, only to wind up hopelessly lost. In the midst of Hyundo's despair, a shaggy-haired man suddenly emerges from the shadows and whisks him away! The wild man introduces himself as Woo Jaechang, and a wary Hyundo knows this might be his only chance to escape. Will Hyundo and Jaechang make it off the mountain, or will it be their final resting place?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Invisible Partner
synopsis:
Baek Jihwan is used to being alone. Gay, kinky, and unapologetically himself, he never fit anywhere easily. When Seo Jaerim enters his life, Jihwan thinks he's finally found the perfect partner. Until the truth comes out: Jaerim is straight, has a girlfriend, and wants Jihwan's help learning BDSM for her sake. Jihwan rejects him immediately, but Jaerim keeps coming back.

Unseen by everyone else, Jaerim becomes the one presence Jihwan can't ignore... his invisible partner.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: I Only See You
synopsis:
Following the advice of his imaginary friend Jason, who told him, "Treat all girls like stones," Park Jin-yong starts seeing every girl as a stone. But then Sunwoo, a female student who doesn't look like a stone, appears before him, and for the first time in five years, the sight of a girl's face sends Jin-yong's happy little circuits into overdrive...

(Source: Naver, translated)

When you're a little tired of work and the various things of daily life... there's a restaurant that feels like home, serving the food you want to eat: Diner No. 3. Onigiri, yakisoba, fried chicken set meals, dashimaki tamago, saba miso... a diner manga packed with food that satisfies both your heart AND your stomach!

(Source: Shonen Gahousha, translated)

Akane and her elder brother Akira have been close ever since they were children, despite their age gap—Akane is now in high school, while Akira has given up his career as a police officer to pursue his dreams in music while living in a shared house with his friends. When Akira fails to turn up to see Akane, a visit to his shared house reveals that he has gone missing, and when the police refuse to investigate, Akane discovers a note from Akira hidden in his room that tells her to get out of the house as soon as possible: his four mysterious house mates are dangerous, and if she stays any longer, she'll end up dead...

(Source: MangaDex)

title_japanese: イケないエリートΩは淫らにとろける
synopsis:
In Kabukichou, a highly addictive love drug called "Burst" is rampant—it can artificially trigger an Omega's heat in its users. Kyouji, an elite Alpha detective leading the investigation, pays a large sum to a local influencer to chase down a lead. The person who shows up is Taiga — online streamer, former number-one host, and fellow Alpha. Kyouji had once sheltered a young Taiga and let him live with him. However, for reasons unknown, they had been out of contact for many years.

"I need you to work as my informant and help me investigate Burst."

Taiga agrees without hesitation. Relieved, Kyouji accepts the coffee Taiga offers and takes a sip — only to be hit by an intense Omega heat!? Can Kyouji endure the relentless heat — and still catch the culprit!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title_japanese: ダンジョンで戦い続けて20年の童貞勇者、地上に戻ったら男女比1:1000の世界だった
synopsis:
The legendary hero Ryuuto, who vanished into the depths of a Dungeon to subjugate the Demon King, wandered inside for 20 years before returning to the surface. However, the world he returned to was one where the male population had plummeted due to the Demon King's curse, and women's sense of chastity had drastically changed.

Every woman he meets is a beauty, and what's more, they all vie for Ryuuto's attention. While Ryuuto unintentionally charms those around him and causes commotions, he senses the shadow of the Demon King in the monsters emerging from the Dungeon and throws himself back into the battlefield.

The strongest (virgin) magician's harem fantasy begins!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

Corporate employee Yuuri's life was nothing but work... Nothing but a cog in the machine, day in day out. With her mind set on escape, she reunites with her childhood friend, Ayaka, for the first time in forever. However, Ayaka's life had turned out all too similar to her own. And then...

"Can we be kids together again?"

From that point on, their lives as wage slaves grind to a halt, heralding the beginning of their escape together under one roof.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kiss toka Koi toka, NG nanoni
title_japanese: キスとか恋とか、NGなのに
synopsis:
Rio and Yakumo are members of the idol group KEy, formed through an audition tv program. One day, while wishing to become closer to the cool Yakumo, an unexpected kiss completely changes their relationship! It turns out Yakumo was actually a super-devoted fan, absolutely obsessed and in love with Rio! Since confessing his feelings, Yakumo's romantic and lustful desires have only escalated. Seeing the special side he only shows him, Rio begins to waver between friendship and love...

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Tales of a Moonless Night
synopsis:
Prince Cho Yihyeon is forced to remain in the imperial palace of a foreign land for three long years. The emperor awaiting him, Tae Won, is rumored to be a merciless despot, yet he greets Yihyeon with unexpected innocence and charm. But that gentleness doesn't last. Beneath the smile lies obsession, and Tae Won's growing fixation leaves Yihyeon frightened and confused. Separated from his family and slowly losing himself, Yihyeon begins to fade.

Can love—or survival—exist under an emperor's twisted devotion, in a palace swallowed by a moonless night?

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Chatterbox
synopsis:
Seowu survives by selling information, living every day on edge. One day, a suspiciously friendly operative who leads with emotion instead of caution shows up at his door. Yijin is clearly dangerous, probably even from a rival organization. And yet... they talk far too easily.

Between a high-strung informant and a disarmingly open operative, a risky connection forms... Is this pull part of the mission, or something dangerously real?

title: Relative Sins
synopsis:
A prince with no claim to the throne, Yi Tae-rok lives a quiet life removed from power. At thirteen, he is entrusted with raising his nephew, Yi Nan-yeong, a gentle boy with no talent for the sword and no expectations placed upon him. At first, Tae-rok sees it only as duty.

But Nan-yeong grows up looking only at him. What begins as admiration slowly shifts into something deeper, something neither of them can easily name. Tae-rok notices the change and chooses silence, drawing careful lines he refuses to cross.

In the end, Nan-yeong seeks clarity in the only way he can, by testing his feelings with another man. And Tae-rok sees it.

"Then you become my scandal. And I become yours."

In a court bound by rules, blood, and reputation, their bond teeters on the edge of ruin, where desire threatens to turn into something neither can undo.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Unhinged Overnight
synopsis:
Doh Minhyeok is living a nightmare disguised as a fantasy. Forced to play the role of a cold-blooded tyrant by a relentless System, he's one skipped "brooding session" away from a death sentence. But the icy exterior starts to crack when he crosses paths with Lee Wuyeon. Wuyeon is the perfect "clumsy darling" trope, and more importantly, he's a walking dead zone for the System's influence. Minhyeok begins to pursue Wuyeon with a desperate intensity, but as the lines between survival and genuine attraction blur, he has to wonder if he's chasing a lifeline or a life sentence.

(Source: Lezhin Entertainment)

title: Ripe for the Picking
synopsis:

When a sudden stomach ache leads to a messy disaster in a neighbor's field, Seojin is caught red-handed by the hulking owner, Cheol. Cheol helps Seojin handle his spicy peppers by day, and Seojin returns the favor by night. Seojin thinks he's just using the local hunk for "farm assistance," but this country boy's heat might be too much to handle!

After a prophetic dream foretells her eventual execution, Lucille awakens to memories of her past life...as Lilybell, the world's most lovable cat, whose previous owners throughout history happened to include a great witch, a legendary alchemist, and a chosen hero. According to her dream, Lucille's new fiancé, Felix, already has a fated love destined to appear in the future. In other words, it's only a temporary engagement, so why shouldn't she just kick back and relax? With her super positive mindset and the skills she inherited from Lilybell's owners, Lucille soon finds herself helping the people around her. She also discovers the truth of her past companions and begins to unravel the mystery behind Felix's curse.

However, she begins to question the sloppy medical system of this new world; as a result of taking action for the sake of the patients, she incurs her superior's resentment and is fired from the palace.

"... I shall do things my own way, then."

With a fresh outlook, Marianna relocates to the Margrave's territory. Using her cheat-level compounding skills and pharmaceutical knowledge, she sets out to develop new medicines and overhaul the medical system! Alongside a handsome Margrave who—for some reason—has taken a liking to her and won't let her go, and her fluffy, adorable spirit companion, Marianna produces one achievement after another.

However, Sumi actually suffers from extreme stage fright and has been relying on medication to cope with his daily responsibilities. His only comfort is his cheerful junior, Emi Yasaka, who supports and looks up to him.

Sumi thinks he could continue hiding "the real him" from others, until one day he is asked to be the chief of a new project at the company. Will this opportunity ruin all Sumi's effort in building his image of a perfect man?

But this chance comes with a cruel condition: to undo his sister's death, Iwol must debut as a member of Spark himself. Thrown into the idol life he never wanted, he'll have to survive fame, internal politics, and his own reluctant heart.

One day, a transfer student named Misaki joins their class. However—for some reason—Misaki remains completely invisible to Kouki alone. While everyone around him interacts with Misaki as if nothing's wrong, Kouki is left wondering: What kind of expressions is he wearing as he speaks to him?

Before he knows it, Kouki finds himself constantly tracking Misaki with his eyes; through him, he is destined to confront a world he never knew existed.
